label: AbandonedShip_CaptainsOffice_Text_NoSuccessFindingScanner
source: I'm investigating this ship on behalf\nof CAPT. STERN.\pHe also asked me to find a SCANNER,\nbut I haven't had any success…$
translation: 我代表楠木馆长\n对这艘船进行调查，\p他还让我找一个探测器，\n但目前为止还没有找到......$

label: AbandonedShip_CaptainsOffice_Text_OhCanYouDeliverScanner
source: Oh! That's a SCANNER!\pListen, can I get you to deliver that\nto CAPT. STERN?\pI want to investigate this ship a\nlittle more.$
translation: 哦！那就是探测器！\p听着，你能不能替我把它\n送给楠木馆长？\p我还要对这艘船\n继续进行一些调查。$

label: AbandonedShip_CaptainsOffice_Text_ThisIsSSCactus
source: This ship is called S.S. CACTUS.\nIt seems to be from an earlier era.$
translation: 这艘船叫仙人掌号。\n它似乎有些年头了。$

label: AbandonedShip_Corridors_1F_Text_CharlieIntro
source: What's so funny about having my inner\ntube aboard the ship?$
translation: 带着游泳圈上船\n有什么好笑的？$

label: AbandonedShip_Corridors_1F_Text_CharlieDefeat
source: Whoa, you overwhelmed me!$
translation: 啊，你赢了！$

label: AbandonedShip_Corridors_1F_Text_CharliePostBattle
source: It's not easy throwing POKé BALLS\nwhile hanging on to an inner tube!$
translation: 抓着游泳圈的时候\n是很难扔精灵球的！$

label: AbandonedShip_Corridors_1F_Text_IsntItFunHere
source: Isn't it fun here?\nI get excited just being here!$
translation: 这里挺好玩的吧？\n我一来这里就兴奋！$

label: AbandonedShip_Corridors_B1F_Text_DuncanIntro
source: When we go out to sea, we SAILORS\nalways bring our POKéMON.\lHow about a quick battle?$
translation: 启航的时候，我们水手\n都带着自己的宝可梦。\l对战一场怎么样？$

label: AbandonedShip_Corridors_B1F_Text_DuncanDefeat
source: Whoops, I'm sunk!$
translation: 哎呀，我被击沉了！$

label: AbandonedShip_Corridors_B1F_Text_DuncanPostBattle
source: The ship's bottom has sunk into the\ndepths.\pIf a POKéMON knew how to go underwater,\nwe might make some progress…$
translation: 我们的船现在搁浅了。\p如果有会潜水的宝可梦的话，\n或许能帮上什么忙......$

label: AbandonedShip_Corridors_B1F_Text_YayItsAShip
source: Yay!\nIt's a ship!$
translation: 耶！\n是船啊！$

label: AbandonedShip_Corridors_B1F_Text_DoorIsLocked
source: The door is locked.\p“STORAGE” is painted on the door.$
translation: 门锁上了。\p门上写着"仓库"。$

label: AbandonedShip_Corridors_B1F_Text_InsertedStorageKey
source: {PLAYER} inserted and turned the\nSTORAGE KEY.\pThe inserted KEY stuck fast,\nbut the door opened.$
translation: {PLAYER}插入了\n仓库的钥匙。\p插入的钥匙很快卡住了，\n不过门被打开了。$

label: AbandonedShip_Text_TheDoorIsOpen
source: The door is open.$
translation: 门开了。$

label: AbandonedShip_HiddenFloorCorridors_Text_Rm1DoorIsLocked
source: The door is locked.\p“RM. 1” is painted on the door.$
translation: 门锁上了。\p门上写着"1号房"。$

label: AbandonedShip_HiddenFloorCorridors_Text_Rm2DoorIsLocked
source: The door is locked.\p“RM. 2” is painted on the door.$
translation: 门锁上了。\p门上写着"2号房"。$

label: AbandonedShip_HiddenFloorCorridors_Text_Rm4DoorIsLocked
source: The door is locked.\p“RM. 4” is painted on the door.$
translation: 门锁上了。\p门上写着"4号房"。$

label: AbandonedShip_HiddenFloorCorridors_Text_Rm6DoorIsLocked
source: The door is locked.\p“RM. 6” is painted on the door.$
translation: 门锁上了。\p门上写着"6号房"。$

label: AbandonedShip_HiddenFloorCorridors_Text_InsertedKey
source: {PLAYER} inserted and turned the\nKEY.\pThe inserted KEY stuck fast,\nbut the door opened.$
translation: {PLAYER}插入了钥匙。\p插入的钥匙很快卡住了，\n不过门被打开了。$

label: AbandonedShip_HiddenFloorRooms_Text_BrightShinyTrash
source: It's bright and shiny!\nBut it's just trash…$
translation: 金光闪闪！\n可惜只是些垃圾......$

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_DanIntro
source: DAN: While searching for treasures,\nwe discovered a TRAINER!$
translation: 文：在寻宝的途中，\n我们发现了一位训练家！$

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_DanDefeat
source: DAN: We couldn't win even though\nwe worked together…$
translation: 文：即使我们联手\n也没能打过他......$

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_DanPostBattle
source: DAN: We can't find any treasures…\nI wonder if someone got them already?$
translation: 文：我们什么宝藏也没找到......\n是不是已经被挖走了？$

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_DanNotEnoughMons
source: DAN: You don't even have two POKéMON.\nYou can't expect to beat us like that.$
translation: 文：你连2只宝可梦都没有，\n这样肯定赢不了我们。$

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_KiraIntro
source: KIRA: Oh?\nWe were searching for treasures.\lBut we discovered a TRAINER instead!$
translation: 夏：哦？\n我们一直在寻宝，\l结果却找到一位训练家！$

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_KiraDefeat
source: KIRA: Ooh, so strong!$
translation: 夏：哦，太强了！$

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_KiraPostBattle
source: KIRA: Where could the treasures be?\pI've already decided what I'm buying\nwhen we find the treasures!$
translation: 夏：宝藏究竟在哪里？\p我都已经想好\n挖到宝以后买什么了！$

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_KiraNotEnoughMons
source: KIRA: Oh, you don't have two POKéMON?\nWe'll have to battle some other time!$
translation: 夏：哦，你没有2只宝可梦？\n那以后再战吧！$

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_KiraRegister
source: KIRA: Oh, you make me so angry!\nI'm going to register you for that!$
translation: 夏：哦，你把我惹火了！\n我要登记你！$

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_DanRematchIntro
source: DAN: We've been searching for\ntreasures all this time.\pOur POKéMON have grown stronger, too.\nLet us show you, okay?$
translation: 文：我们一直\n在寻找宝藏。\p我们的宝可梦也变强了，\n给你展示一下吧？$

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_DanRematchDefeat
source: DAN: You're strong, as usual!$
translation: 文：你还是那么强！$

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_DanPostRematch
source: DAN: We can't find any treasures,\nwe lose at POKéMON…\pI want to go home… But if I say that,\nshe gets all angry with me…$
translation: 文：我们没找到宝藏，\n还输了宝可梦对战......\p我要回家......不过要是我真的说出来，\n她肯定会生气的......$

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_DanRematchNotEnoughMons
source: DAN: You don't even have two POKéMON.\nYou can't expect to beat us like that.$
translation: 文：你连2只宝可梦都没有，\n这样你是赢不了我们的。$

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_KiraRematchIntro
source: KIRA: Oh? We meet again!\pJust like us, you still haven't given up\nsearching for treasures, have you?\pWant to make it so the loser has\nto give up searching?$
translation: 夏：哦？我们又见面了！\p你和我们一样，还在寻找\n宝藏，对不对？\p不如来场对战吧，\n输的人放弃寻宝。$

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_KiraRematchDefeat
source: KIRA: Oh, we lost again…$
translation: 夏：哦，我们又输了......$

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_KiraPostRematch
source: KIRA: We're not leaving until we raise\nour POKéMON some more and we find\lthe treasures here!$
translation: 夏：不把宝可梦练得强一些，\n不找到宝藏，\l我们绝不回去！$

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_KiraRematchNotEnoughMons
source: KIRA: Oh, you don't have two POKéMON?\nWe'll have to battle some other time!$
translation: 夏：哦，你没有2只宝可梦？\n那只好以后再战了！$

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_JaniIntro
source: I'm not good at swimming,\nbut I am good at battles!$
translation: 我不擅长游泳，\n但我擅长对战！$

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_JaniDefeat
source: Oops.\nThat didn't go very well.$
translation: 哎呀，\n不对头啊。$

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_JaniPostBattle
source: Walking around barefoot in this ship\nis kind of gross.$
translation: 赤脚在这艘船上走\n还真有些难受。$

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_GarrisonIntro
source: Strength and compassion…\nThose are a TRAINER's treasures!$
translation: 力量与体贴......\n这就是训练家的宝藏！$

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_GarrisonDefeat
source: Ah, there is something about you\nthat sparkles.$
translation: 啊，没想到你还\n真有两下子。$

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_GarrisonPostBattle
source: In a cabin somewhere on board,\nI saw something sparkle.$
translation: 我在某个船舱中，\n看到有什么东西在闪光。$

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_B1F_Text_PerfectPlaceToGoExploring
source: This is a perfect place to go exploring!\nIt's exciting here!\pI bet there're amazing treasures on\nboard.$
translation: 这里绝对是最棒的探险地！\n太有意思了！\p我敢打赌船上\n有宝藏。$

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms_1F_Text_TakingALookAround
source: Ships of this sort are rare, so I'm\ntaking a look around.\pHmhm…\nThere appear to be other cabins…$
translation: 这种船很罕见，\n我得趁机参观一下。\p嗯......\n似乎还有其它船舱......$

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms_1F_Text_ThaliaIntro
source: What on earth would compel you to\ncome here? You must be curious!$
translation: 你究竟是为什么来\n这里？肯定是好奇吧！$

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms_1F_Text_ThaliaDefeat
source: Not just curious, but also strong…$
translation: 不仅好奇，还很强......$

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms_1F_Text_ThaliaPostBattle
source: The man next door…\pHe says he's just sightseeing,\nbut I don't know about that.$
translation: 隔壁的那个人......\p他说他只是来观光，\n可我觉得不对劲。$

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms_1F_Text_ThaliaRegister
source: You're such a tough TRAINER!\nLet me register you as a memento!$
translation: 你真是太强了！\n我登记下你的信息作纪念吧！$

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms_1F_Text_ThaliaRematchIntro
source: What on earth would compel you to\ncome back? You must really be curious!$
translation: 你究竟为什么回到\n这里？肯定是好奇吧！$

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms_1F_Text_ThaliaRematchDefeat
source: Aren't you too strong?$
translation: 你也太强了吧？$

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms_1F_Text_ThaliaPostRematch
source: I'm sure that man's up to something!\nHe just acts so suspiciously!$
translation: 我敢肯定那个人有什么企图！\n他的行为太可疑了！$

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms_1F_Text_DemetriusIntro
source: Waaah!\nI've been found! …Huh?$
translation: 哇啊！\n被发现了！......啊？$

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms_1F_Text_DemetriusDefeat
source: Oh, you're not my mom.$
translation: 呼，你不是我妈。$

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms_1F_Text_DemetriusPostBattle
source: I'm in trouble with my mom, so I ran.\nKeep it a secret where I am!$
translation: 我惹我妈生气了，所以就跑了出来。\n可不要告诉别人我在这儿！$

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms_B1F_Text_GettingQueasy
source: Urrrrppp…\pI'm getting queasy just being aboard\nthis ship…\pIt's not even moving, but…$
translation: 啊啊......\p我一上这船就想吐......\p虽然船还没开......$

label: AquaHideout_1F_Text_OurBossIsSnatchingSomething
source:
What? What? What do you want with 
TEAM AQUA?\pOur BOSS isn't here! He's gone off to
snatch something important!\p… …
Where did he go?\pWahaha! Do you really think I'd tell
you something that crucial?$
translation:
什么？什么？
你找海洋队做什么？\p我们的老大不在这里！
他去找一些很重要的东西了！\p......
他去哪了？\p哇哈哈！你以为我会告诉你
这么重要的事吗？$

label: AquaHideout_1F_Text_WhereMightMagmaHideoutBe
source: What? What?\nAre you a TEAM MAGMA grunt?\pI hear that TEAM MAGMA is trying to\nawaken an awesome POKéMON at their\lHIDEOUT.\pBut where might their HIDEOUT be?$
translation: 什么？什么？\n你是熔岩队的人吗？\p我听说熔岩队试图\n在他们的基地里唤醒\l一只不得了的宝可梦，\p但是他们的基地在哪里呢？$

label: AquaHideout_1F_Text_BossWentToJackASubmarine
source:
What? What? What do you want with 
TEAM AQUA?\pOur BOSS isn't here!
He's gone off to jack a submarine!\p… …
Where did he go?\pWahaha! Do you really think I'd tell
you something that crucial?$
translation:
什么？什么？
你找海洋队做什么？\p我们的老大不在这里！
他去抢潜水艇了！\p......
他去哪了？\p哇哈哈！你以为我会告诉你
这么重要的事吗？$

label: AquaHideout_1F_Text_BossIsOnRoute122
source:
What? What? What do you want with 
TEAM AQUA?\pOur BOSS isn't here! He's on his way to
MT. PYRE on ROUTE 122!\p… …
Why did he go?\pWahaha! Do you really think I'd tell
you something that crucial?$
translation:
什么？什么？
你找海洋队做什么？\p我们的老大不在这里！
他到122号水路上的送神山去了！\p......
他去干什么？\p哇哈哈！你以为我会告诉你
这么重要的事吗？$

label: AquaHideout_1F_Text_TeamMagmaAtMtChimney
source: What? What?\nAre you a TEAM MAGMA grunt?\pI hear that TEAM MAGMA is after\nan awesome POKéMON at MT. CHIMNEY.\pBut what is that POKéMON like?$
translation: 什么？什么？\n你是熔岩队的人吗？\p我听说熔岩队正在烟囱山\n寻找一只极其可怕的宝可梦。\p那宝可梦到底是什么样子啊？$

label: AquaHideout_1F_Text_BossIsInSlateportCity
source:
What? What? What do you want with
TEAM AQUA?\pOur BOSS isn't here!
He's on his way to SLATEPORT CITY!\p… …
Why did he go?\pWahaha! Do you really think I'd tell
you something that crucial?$
translation:
什么？什么？
你找海洋队做什么？\p我们的老大不在这里！
他到凯那市去了！\p......
他去干什么？\p哇哈哈！你以为我会告诉你
这么重要的事吗？$

label: AquaHideout_1F_Text_Grunt1Intro
source: Ayiyiyi!\nSuspicious character spotted!$
translation: 哎咦咦咦！\n发现可疑人物！$

label: AquaHideout_1F_Text_Grunt1Defeat
source: Grrrrr…\nI lost it!$
translation: 咕啊啊啊......\n我输了！$

label: AquaHideout_1F_Text_Grunt1PostBattle
source: I took the loss for the TEAM,\nbut I did my job…$
translation: 虽然为组织吃了败仗，\n但我的任务完成了......$

label: AquaHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt2Intro
source: If you want to know the secret about\nour HIDEOUT, you have me to beat!$
translation: 想知道我们基地的秘密的话，\n你得先打败我！$

label: AquaHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt2Defeat
source: I can't win at all…$
translation: 完全不是对手......$

label: AquaHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt2PostBattle
source: Our HIDEOUT's secret?\pWell, let's just say…\nThere's a submarine at the far end!\pBut, by now…\nKekekeke…$
translation: 我们基地的秘密？\p这么说吧......\n这儿深处有一艘潜水艇！\p但是，现在......\n嘿嘿嘿......$

label: AquaHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt3Intro
source: Fuel supply loaded A-OK!\nIn-cruise snacks loaded A-OK!\pNothing left to do but KO a pesky\nmeddler!$
translation: 燃料供给完成！\n巡航系统正常！\p一切正常，除了一个\n找麻烦的人！$

label: AquaHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt3Defeat
source: I took a serious licking!$
translation: 被打得落花流水！$

label: AquaHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt3PostBattle
source: Humph!\nThis was supposed to happen!\pMy mission was to just hold you up!$
translation: 哼！\n这是意料之中的！\p我的任务只是拖住你而已！$

label: AquaHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt5Intro
source: Yawn… Keeping watch over the\nHIDEOUT bores me. I'll take you on.$
translation: 哈欠......一直看守基地真是\n太无聊了，就跟你玩玩吧。$

label: AquaHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt5Defeat
source: Yawn…\nOh, I lost…$

label: AquaHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt5PostBattle
source: If you scurry too much, other TEAM\nAQUA members might get you.$
translation: 到处瞎转悠的话，\n其他海洋队成员可不会放过你。$

label: AquaHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt7Intro
source: Hey!\nYou there!\pWhich do you think is cooler?\nTEAM AQUA's uniform or TEAM MAGMA's?$
translation: 嘿！\n那边的！\p你觉得海洋队的制服和熔岩队的\n哪一个更酷一点？$

label: AquaHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt7Defeat
source: I lost in a cool way…$
translation: 我很酷地输掉了......$

label: AquaHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt7PostBattle
source: If you have a cool uniform, you look\ngood even in a loss, don't you think?$
translation: 如果你有一件够酷的制服，\n就算输了也依然很酷，不是吗？$

label: AquaHideout_B2F_Text_MattIntro
source:
Hehehe…\pGot here already, did you?
We underestimated you!\pBut this is it!\pI'm a cut above the GRUNTS you've seen
so far.\pI'm not stalling for time.
I'm going to pulverize you!$
translation:
嘿嘿嘿......\p都已经到这儿了啊？
真是小瞧你了！\p但是到此为止了！\p我可比前面那些杂兵们
都要强得多。\p我可不是拖延时间的，
我会将你捏成粉末的！$

label: AquaHideout_B2F_Text_MattDefeat
source: Hehehe…\nSo, I lost, too…$
translation: 嘿嘿嘿......\n看来我也输了......$

label: AquaHideout_B2F_Text_OurBossGotThroughHisPreparations
source: Hehehe!\pWhile I was toying with you, our BOSS\ngot through his preparations!$
translation: 嘿嘿嘿！\p我陪你玩的时候，我们的老大\n已经完成准备了！$

label: AquaHideout_B2F_Text_MattPostBattle
source:
Hehehe!\pOur BOSS has already gone on his way to
some cave under the sea!\pIf you're going to give chase, you'd
better search the big, wide sea beyond\lLILYCOVE.\pBut will you find it then?
Hehehe!$
translation:
嘿嘿嘿！\p我们的老大已经在去
海底洞窟的路上了！\p要是你想追的话，
就去水静市那边宽广的\l大海来慢慢找吧。\p不过你能找到吗？
嘿嘿嘿！$

label: AquaHideout_B2F_Text_Grunt4Intro
source: Wahahah, I grew weary of waiting!\nYou owe me a battle, too!$
translation: 哇哈哈，我已经等烦了！\n你也欠我一场对战！$

label: AquaHideout_B2F_Text_Grunt4Defeat
source: Tired of waiting…\nLost and dazed…$
translation: 等烦了......\n也败得一塌糊涂......$

label: AquaHideout_B2F_Text_Grunt4PostBattle
source: BOSS…\nIs this good enough?$
translation: 老大......\n这样算合格了吗？$

label: AquaHideout_B2F_Text_Grunt6Intro
source:
Warp panels, the HIDEOUT's pride
and joy!\pYou're clueless about where you are,
aren't you?\pFluster and tire out the enemy, then
lower the boom! That's our plan!$
translation:
这里的传送地板可是
基地的骄傲！\p你完全不知道自己
身在何处了吧？\p先扰乱敌人再突袭--
这就是我们的作战计划！$

label: AquaHideout_B2F_Text_Grunt6Defeat
source: What's wrong with you?\nYou're not tired at all!$
translation: 怎么回事？\n你居然一点都不累！$

label: AquaHideout_B2F_Text_Grunt6PostBattle
source: That reminds me… I can't remember\nwhere I put the MASTER BALL.\pIf I fail to guard it, our BOSS will\nchew me out…$
translation: 说起来......\n我忘了把大师球放在哪里了。\p要是弄丢了，\n会被老大骂死的......$

label: AquaHideout_B2F_Text_Grunt8Intro
source: When I joined TEAM AQUA, the first\nthing I had to learn was how these\lwarp panels connected.$
translation: 我加入海洋队后，\n第一堂课就是记住这些\l传送地板都通向哪里。$

label: AquaHideout_B2F_Text_Grunt8Defeat
source: I was too occupied thinking about\nthe warp panels…$
translation: 脑子里全都是\n传送地板的事情了......$

label: AquaHideout_B2F_Text_Grunt8PostBattle
source: I'll have to learn about how I can\nbattle more effectively…$
translation: 我想我必须学学\n对战的要诀了......$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_PlayerStepForward
source: REFEREE: TRAINER {PLAYER}!\nStep forward, please!$
translation: 裁判：训练家{PLAYER}！\n请上前一步！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_OpponentStepForward
source: REFEREE: TRAINER {STR_VAR_1}!\nStep forward, please!$
translation: 裁判：训练家{STR_VAR_1}！\n请上前一步！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_SetKOTourneyBegin
source: REFEREE: Set KO Tourney!\nBegin!$
translation: 裁判：三回合定胜负锦标赛！\n开始！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_WinnerIsPlayer
source: REFEREE: The winner is {PLAYER}!$
translation: 裁判：胜者是{PLAYER}！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_WinnerIsOpponent
source: REFEREE: The winner is {STR_VAR_1}!$
translation: 裁判：胜者是{STR_VAR_1}！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_MonsWillBeRestored
source: Your POKéMON will be restored to\nfull health.$
translation: 我来帮您的宝可梦\n回复体力。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_ReadyFor2ndOpponent
source: Next up, your second opponent!\nAre you ready to move on?$
translation: 接下来是您的第2个对手！\n准备好开始了吗？$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_ReadyFor3rdOpponent
source: Next up, your third opponent!\nAre you ready to move on?$
translation: 接下来是您的第3个对手！\n准备好开始了吗？$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_ReadyFor4thOpponent
source: Next up, your fourth opponent!\nAre you ready to move on?$
translation: 接下来是您的第4个对手！\n准备好开始了吗？$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_ReadyFor5thOpponent
source: Next up, your fifth opponent!\nAre you ready to move on?$
translation: 接下来是您的第5个对手！\n准备好开始了吗？$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_ReadyFor6thOpponent
source: Next up, your sixth opponent!\nAre you ready to move on?$
translation: 接下来是您的第6个对手！\n准备好开始了吗？$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_ReadyFor7thOpponent
source: Next up, your seventh opponent!\nAre you ready to move on?$
translation: 接下来是您的第7个对手！\n准备好开始了吗？$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_SaveAndShutDown
source: Would you like to save the game and\nshut down now?$
translation: 要写入记录\n并且暂停吗？$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_RetireFromChallenge
source: Would you like to retire from your\nSet KO Tourney challenge?$
translation: 要结束三回合定胜负\n锦标赛的挑战吗？$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_SavingPleaseWait
source: I am saving your game data.\nPlease wait.$
translation: 正在写入记录......\n请稍等。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_RecordLastBattle
source: Would you like to record your last\nbattle on your FRONTIER PASS?$
translation: 您要把您上次的对战记录在您的\n开拓通行证吗？$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_NowFaceTycoon
source: My dear challenger!\pYour skill level is truly astounding!\pWe now would like you to face our\nleader, the ARENA TYCOON!$
translation: 尊敬的挑战者！\p您的实力十分惊人！\p希望您能见见我们的大将，\n竞技场主将！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_PreparedForTycoon
source: A battle with the ARENA TYCOON!\nAre you prepared?$
translation: 同竞技场主将的对战！\n准备好了吗？$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_MakeWayForGreta
source: REFEREE: The ARENA TYCOON!\nMake way for GRETA!$
translation: 裁判：竞技场主将！\n给黄瓜香让路！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_GretaYoureChallenger
source: GRETA: Hey!\nHowdy!\p…Wait, are you the challenger?$
translation: 黄瓜香：嗨哟！\n你好！\p......等等，你就是挑战者？$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_IsThatRight
source: Is that right? Hmm…\nHmhm…$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_YouLookWeakTakeThingsEasy
source: I don't know how to say it, but…\nTo put it bluntly, you look pretty weak.\lAre you sure you're up for me?\pHmm…\pWell, all right!\nWe'll take things easy to start with!$
translation: 但该怎么说呢......\n老实说，我觉得你好像非常弱哎。\l你确定你招架得住吗？\p哈......\p那么，好吧！\n我们慢慢来！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_IgniteMyPassionForBattle
source: Okay! Let's see you ignite my passion\nfor battle!$
translation: 好！看你能不能点燃\n我的斗志！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_GretaYoureToughAfterAll
source: GRETA: Ow, wait a second!\nYou are tough after all!\pI like you!\nLet's see your FRONTIER PASS.$
translation: 哦，等一下！\n你还挺强的！\p我喜欢你！\n把你的开拓通行证给我吧！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_ReceivedGutsSymbol
source: The Guts Symbol was embossed on\nthe FRONTIER PASS!$
translation: 毅力象征被印在了\n开拓通行证上！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_GoingToBeFunNextTime
source: Hmm…\pIt's going to be fun the next time!\nI'm looking forward to it!$
translation: 哈......\p下次会更有趣！\n我很期待！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_GretaLookingForwardToSeeingAgain
source: GRETA: Hey! Howdy!\nYou finally won your way up to me!\pI was getting worried waiting for you!\nI was really looking forward to seeing\lyou again!$
translation: 黄瓜香：嗨哟！你好！\n你终于赢得了我对你的考验！\p你来得还真慢，让我好担心啊！\n我很期待能\l再见到你喔！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_SoAreYouReady
source: … … …\nSo, are you ready?$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_WontAllowHalfheartedEffort
source: I won't allow a halfhearted effort!\nBe ready for a thrashing!$
translation: 我决不允许三心二意！\n准备接招吧！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_LetsGetThisStarted
source: Come on, REFEREE!\nLet's get this started!$
translation: 来吧，裁判！\n让我们开始吧！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_GretaBlownAway
source: GRETA: Gaaah! Blown away!\nLet's see your FRONTIER PASS!$
translation: 黄瓜香：嘎啊！被击倒了！\n把你的开拓通行证给我吧！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_GutsSymbolTookGoldenShine
source: The Guts Symbol took on\na golden shine!$
translation: 毅力象征闪耀着\n金色的光芒！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_IfWeBattleAgainWontLose
source: Arrrgh!\nThis is so infuriating!\pIf we ever battle again, I won't lose!\nDon't you forget it! Bye-bye!$
translation: 啊！好气啊！\n真不甘心！\p如果下次再交手，\n到时候我绝对不会输的！\l你要记好了！再见！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaCorridor_Text_PleaseStepIn
source: Your battles shall be waged in\nthe next room. Please step in!$
translation: 您将在下个房间进行对战。\n请进！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_WelcomeToBattleArena
source: Where the battling spirit of TRAINERS\nis put to the test!\pI welcome you to the BATTLE ARENA!\pI am your guide to the Set KO Tourney!$
translation: 训练家的斗志\n将在此接受考验！\p欢迎来到对战竞技场！\p我是您的三回合定胜负\n锦标赛的向导！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_WishToTakeChallenge
source: Now, do you wish to take\nthe BATTLE ARENA challenge?$
translation: 要挑战对战竞技场吗？$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_AwaitAnotherChallenge
source: We await your challenge on\nanother occasion!$
translation: 随时恭候您再次挑战！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ExplainChallenge
source:
In the BATTLE ARENA, we undertake
the Set KO Tourney.\pAll participants enter with a team of
three POKéMON.\pThe three POKéMON must be lined up in
the order in which they are to appear.\pDuring battle, the POKéMON will appear
one at a time in the preset order.\pOnce a POKéMON enters battle, it must
remain out until the match is decided.\pIf a match remains undecided in
three turns, it goes to judging.\pIf you wish to interrupt your challenge,
please save the game.\pIf you don't save, you will not be able
to continue with your challenge.\pIf you pull off the feat of beating
seven TRAINERS in succession,\lwe will present you with Battle Points.$
translation:
在对战竞技场中，
我们将举办三回合定胜负锦标赛。\p所有的参赛者用3只宝可梦
组成的队伍参加比赛。\p这3只宝可梦需要按照
想要出场的顺序排列好。\p对战时，宝可梦会按照事先
安排好的顺序依次出场。\p一旦宝可梦进入到战斗，
就需要持续战斗至比赛结束。\p如果比赛在3回合内未能决出胜负，
将由裁判进行判定。\p如果您在挑战途中
想要暂停的话，\p请确保在退出前完好地写下了记录。
否则我们将视挑战为无效。\p如果您能成功击败7个训练家的话，
我们将向您呈上对战点数。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_OkayToSave
source: Before showing you to the BATTLE\nARENA, you must save. Is that okay?$
translation: 在带您进入对战竞技场之前\n需要先写入记录。可以吗？$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_WhichLevelMode
source: The BATTLE ARENA offers two levels\nof challenge, Level 50 and Open Level.\lWhich is your choice?$
translation: 对战竞技场提供2个等级的挑战，\nLv. 50级和自由等级。\l您要选择哪个？$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_SelectThreeMons
source: Very well, now select your\nthree POKéMON, please.$
translation: 好的，\n请选择参加的3只宝可梦。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLvOpen
source:
My dear challenger!\pYou do not have the three POKéMON
required for entry.\pTo qualify, you must bring three
different kinds of POKéMON.\pThey also must not hold the same
kinds of items.\pEGGS{STR_VAR_1}.$
translation:
尊敬的挑战者！\p您能够参加对战的
宝可梦不满3只。\p您需要准备3只
不同种类的宝可梦，\p且让它们分别携带不同道具
才可参加对战。\p此外，蛋{STR_VAR_1}。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_GuideYouToArena
source: I shall now guide you to\nthe BATTLE ARENA.$
translation: 现在我将带您前往对战竞技场。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_DidntSaveBeforeShuttingDown
source:
My dear challenger!\pYou did not save the game before
shutting down, did you?\pIt is unfortunate, but that has
resulted in your disqualification\lfrom your challenge.\pYou may, of course, start with a fresh
challenge.$
translation:
这位客人！\p您在上次结束时
没有写入记录吧？\p非常遗憾，没有写入记录的
挑战我们将视其为无效。\p当然，您随时可以开始
一次新的挑战。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_CongratsOnSevenWins
source: We congratulate you for your splendid\nstring of wins over seven TRAINERS!$
translation: 祝贺您完成7连胜壮举！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_RecordAchievement
source: Your achievement will be recorded.\nPlease wait while I save the game.$
translation: 您的成绩将被写入记录。\n正在写入记录......请稍等。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_PresentYouWithPrize
source: In commemoration of your 7-win streak,\nwe present you with this prize.$
translation: 作为7连胜的奖励，\n我们将向您呈上奖品。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ReceivedPrize
source: {PLAYER} received the prize\n{STR_VAR_1}.$
translation: {PLAYER}得到了奖品\n{STR_VAR_1}。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_BagFullReturnForPrize
source: Oh?\nYour BAG seems to be full.\pI urge you to clear space and\nreturn for your prize.$
translation: 哎？\n您的包包满了。\p整理空间后\n再来拿您的奖品。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ThankYouWaitWhileSave
source: Thank you so much for participating!\pPlease wait while I save the game.$
translation: 辛苦了！\p正在写入记录......请稍等。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_AwaitAnotherChallenge2
source: We await your challenge on\nanother occasion!$
translation: 随时恭候您再次挑战！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_LookingForwardToArrivalSaveGame
source: We have been looking forward to\nyour arrival.\pBefore I show you to the BATTLE\nARENA, I must save the game.\lPlease wait.$
translation: 我们一直恭候您的到来。\p在带您去战斗竞技场之前，\n我需要先写入记录，\l请稍候。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_RecordLastMatch
source: Shall I record your last BATTLE ARENA\nmatch on your FRONTIER PASS?$
translation: 要将您在对战竞技场的最后一场比赛\n记录到开拓通行证上吗？$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_BadIdeaToNotAttack
source: I lost on the REFEREE's decision…\pI don't think it was a good idea to only\nuse defensive moves and not attack…$
translation: 我被裁判判负了......\p看来只防守而不进攻是\n行不通的......$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_LandingHitsWorked
source: I won in judging!\pLanding hits consistently on\nthe opponent's POKéMON worked!$
translation: 我被判定获胜了！\p攻击持续命中对手的宝可梦\n这招果然行得通！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_MatchWasDeclaredDraw
source: Our match was declared a draw.\pWhen we ran out of time, both my\nPOKéMON and the opponent's had about\lthe same amount of HP left.$
translation: 我们的比赛被判为平局。\p时间到的时候，我和我对手的宝可梦\n剩下了相同的体力。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_OrderOfMonsImportant
source:
In the BATTLE ARENA, the order of
POKéMON is totally important.\pFor example, if your first POKéMON
has certain type disadvantages,\ltry making your second POKéMON one\lwith moves that are super effective\lagainst the first one.\pI think that will be a good way of
making an effective team.$
translation:
在对战竞技场中，
宝可梦的出场顺序至关重要。\p举个例子，如果你的首发宝可梦
存在属性劣势，\l不妨让第二只宝可梦配备\l能克制该劣势属性的招式。\p我认为这是组建强力队伍的
有效策略。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_RulesAreListed
source: The Set KO Tourney's rules are listed.$
translation: 上面列出了三回合定胜负\n锦标赛的规则。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ReadWhichHeading
source: Which heading do you want to read?$
translation: 要读哪一部分的说明？$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ExplainBattleRules
source:
The Set KO Tourney has special rules,
unlike standard battles.\pFirst, one battle lasts only
three turns.\pIf the outcome is not decided after
three turns, it goes to judging.\pThe REFEREE will choose the winner
based on how the POKéMON battled.\pAlso, a POKéMON cannot be switched out
until its battle's outcome is decided.$
translation:
三回合定胜负锦标赛采用特殊规则，
与常规的对战不同。\p第一，每场战斗只进行3个回合。\p如果比赛在3回合内未能决出胜负，
将由裁判进行判定。\p裁判会根据宝可梦的
战斗情况判出胜者。\p此外，对战期间不可更换宝可梦，
直至当前对战分出结果。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ExplainMindRules
source: The first judging factor is “Mind.”\nThis factor evaluates how aggressive\lthe battlers were.\pThe judging is based on how often\nthe TRAINERS ordered the use of\loffensive moves.$
translation: 第1个判定准则是"心"。\n这个因素评价战斗者的\l进攻意识。\p判定依据的是训练家下达\n攻击招式的命令的频率。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ExplainSkillRules
source:
The second judging factor is “Skill.”
This factor evaluates how effectively\lPOKéMON moves were used.\pIf a move worked successfully,
the Skill rating goes up.\pIf a move failed, the Skill rating
is lowered.\pIf it was an offensive move, the Skill
rating goes up if the move was “super\leffective” and goes down if it was\l“not very effective.”\pThe Skill rating will not go up for
moves such as PROTECT and DETECT.\pIf the opponent used PROTECT or
DETECT, and your POKéMON failed to\lhit with a move, its Skill rating will not\lgo down.$
translation:
第2个判定准则是"技"。
这个因素评价宝可梦的\l招式命中。\p如果招式成功生效，
技的评价就会上升。\p如果招式使用失败，
技的评价则会下降。\p对于攻击招式，
如果招式"效果绝佳"的话，\l技的评价就会上升。\l如果"没有效果"的话，\l技的评价就会下降。\p对于像保护和看穿的招式，
技的评价是不会上升的。\p如果对手使用了保护或看穿等招式，
即使您的宝可梦没能成功命中，\l技的评价也不会下降。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ExplainBodyRules
source: The third judging factor is “Body.”\nThis factor is based on how much HP\lremained at the end of a battle.\pThe rating takes into account how much\nHP a POKéMON had at the start of\lbattle, and what remained at the end.$
translation: 第3个判定准则是"体"。\n这个因素评价宝可梦在战斗结束后\l剩余的体力比例。\p这个准则会同时参考宝可梦\n战斗开始时的体力和\l战斗结束后剩余的体力。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_CongratsOnDefeatingTycoon
source: A victory snatched from the ARENA\nTYCOON, and a seven-TRAINER sweep!\pWe congratulate you on your most\nsplendid challenge!$
translation: 从竞技场主将手里得到了胜利，\n并且完成了7连胜壮举！\p我们为您的卓越的\n挑战献上祝贺！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_PleaseAcceptBattlePoints
source: My dear challenger, in recognition of\nyour indefatigable spirit, please\laccept these Battle Point(s).$
translation: 尊敬的挑战者，\n为了表彰您那不屈的意志，\l请收下这些对战点数。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_PlayerHasEnteredDome
source: {PLAYER} has entered the BATTLE DOME!$
translation: {PLAYER}进入了对战巨蛋！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_PlayerVersusTrainer
source: {STR_VAR_1}\nmatch!\p{PLAYER} versus {STR_VAR_2}!\pLet the battle begin!$
translation: {STR_VAR_1}！\p{PLAYER} VS {STR_VAR_2}！\p比赛开始！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_PlayerIsWinner
source: {PLAYER} is the winner!\nCongratulations!$
translation: {PLAYER}获胜！\n恭喜！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_TrainerIsWinner
source: {STR_VAR_2} is the winner!\nCongratulations!$
translation: {STR_VAR_2}获胜！\n恭喜！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_PlayerIsLv50Champ
source: {PLAYER} is the Level 50\nBattle Tournament Champion!\pCongratulations!$
translation: {PLAYER}是Lv. 50级\n对战锦标赛的冠军！\p恭喜！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_PlayerIsLvOpenChamp
source: {PLAYER} is the Open Level\nBattle Tournament Champion!\pCongratulations!$
translation: {PLAYER}是自由等级\n对战锦标赛的冠军！\p恭喜！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_RefereeDecisionPleaseWait
source:
What an unbelievable finish!
We have a double knockout!\pIn this event, the Battle Tournament
rules call for a REFEREE'S decision.\pPlease wait while the judging
is under way.$
translation:
真是让人意外的结果！
双方宝可梦同时倒地！\p按照比赛规则，出现这种情况时
我们需要请裁判员进行评判。\p请耐心等待
最终结果。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_BrightNewHope
source: The bright new hope!\p$
translation: 新的希望来了！\p$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_RisingStar
source: The rising star!\p$
translation: 后起之秀啊！\p$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_WillTheyRaceToChampionship
source: Will this TRAINER race to\nthe championship?\p$
translation: 哪一位训练家进入\n冠军赛了呢？\p$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_CanAchieveChampionFirstTry
source: Can the feat of a championship\non the first try be achieved?\p$
translation: 首次挑战就能获得冠军的壮举\n能够实现吗？\p$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_CanLossBeAvenged
source: Can the loss of the last match\nbe avenged?\p$
translation: 上一场比赛的失利\n会被一雪前耻吗？\p$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_OnFireForChampionship
source: The TRAINER is on fire for\nthe first championship try!\p$
translation: 训练家为了首场冠军赛\n将会全力以赴！\p$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_WinHereAdvancesToFinal
source: A win here means this TRAINER\nadvances to the final!\p$
translation: 这场的胜利将意味着训练家\n能够晋级决赛！\p$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_WillLongHeldDreamComeTrue
source: Will the long-held dream of\na championship finally come true?\p$
translation: 渴望以久的冠军梦\n最终能够实现吗？\p$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_TheInvincibleChampion
source: The invincible champion!\p$
translation: 无敌的冠军！\p$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_CanAnyoneHopeToBeatTrainer
source: Can anyone hope to beat this\nTRAINER?\p$
translation: 有谁能够击败\n这位训练家？\p$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_DoBattlesExistSolelyForTrainer
source: Do battles exist solely for\nthis TRAINER?\p$
translation: 难道一切对战都只为\n这位训练家而存在吗？\p$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_CurrentChampAimingToRetainTitle
source: The current champion aiming to\nretain the title!\p$
translation: 现任冠军\n正力争卫冕！\p$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_FormerChampHasReturned
source: The former champion has returned!\p$
translation: 上届冠军\n再次归来！\p$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_FormerToughnessReturned
source: The former toughness has returned!\p$
translation: 昔日强悍\n再次重现！\p$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_WillDoExpectedAdvanceToFinals
source: Will this TRAINER do as expected\nand advance to the finals?\p$
translation: 这位训练家会如期\n晋级决赛吗？\p$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_WillFormerChampRegainGlory
source: Will the former champ regain\nlost glory?\p$
translation: 上届冠军是否能成功\n重铸荣光？\p$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_FeelGlowOfTrueMaster
source: Feel the glow of a true master!$
translation: 感受真正王者的耀眼光芒吧！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_MakeWayForDomeAceTucker
source: And now… The TRAINER standing in\n{PLAYER}'s record-setting path…\pYes! The one and only!\nThe BATTLE DOME COMMISSIONER!\lOur very own DOME ACE!\lMake way for TUCKER!$
translation: 下面......{PLAYER}将要\n面对的训练家是......\p当然！就是他！\n对战巨蛋理事！\l我们的巨蛋超级巨星！\l用你们的热情来欢迎石南吧！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_SpectatorTuckerChant
source: Spectators: TUCKER! TUCKER!\nTUCKER! TUCKER! TUCKER!$
translation: 观众：石南！石南！\n石南！石南！石南！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_TuckerSilverIntro
source:
TUCKER: Ahahah!\pDo you hear it? This crowd!
They're all itching to see our match!\pAhahah!\pI bet you're twitching all over from
the tension of getting to battle me!\pBut don't you worry about a thing!\pI'm the no. 1 star of the BATTLE DOME!
I, TUCKER the DOME ACE, will bathe you\lin my brilliant glow!$
translation:
石南：哈哈哈！\p听到没？观众的呼唤
他们期待着我们的比赛呢！\p哈哈哈！\p你现在应该害怕得
全身发抖了吧！\p别紧张，别紧张。\p我是对战巨蛋的明星，第一明星！
我，石南，巨蛋超级巨星，\l要在我的光芒下与你战斗！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_LetsSeeYourStrategy
source: Your strategy!\nLet's see it!$
translation: 让我来看看\n你的战术吧！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_IncredibleVictorIsPlayer
source: Unbelievable! It's incredible!\nThe victor is {PLAYER}!$
translation: 不可思议！这真的太不可思议了！\n冠军竟然是{PLAYER}！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_WinnerIsTucker
source: The winner is TUCKER!\nThe DOME ACE has prevailed!\pCongratulations, TUCKER!$
translation: 冠军是--石南！\n巨蛋超级巨星还是胜利了！\p祝贺他！祝贺石南！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_SeeYourFrontierPass
source: TUCKER: Rules are rules!\nLet me see your FRONTIER PASS.$
translation: 石南：规矩就是规矩！\n拿出你的开拓通行证吧。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_ReceivedTacticsSymbol
source: The Tactics Symbol was embossed on\nthe FRONTIER PASS!$
translation: 战术象征被印在了\n开拓通行证上！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_WontUnderestimateYouNextTime
source: … … … … … …\pI sorely underestimated you. I won't\nmake the same mistake next time…$
translation: ...... ...... ......\p我太过低估你了，\n下一次我不会犯同样的错误......$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_CanWinStreakBeStretched
source: Can the win streak be stretched?\nThe confidence is there!$
translation: 我们的冠军还会继续称霸吗？\n让我们期待比赛的结果吧！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_LegendHasReturnedDomeAceTucker
source:
Ladies and gentlemen!
Boys, girls, and POKéMON!\pFinally!
Finally, the legend has returned!\pYes, the name of that legend!
Our very own DOME ACE!\lIt's none other than TUCKER!$
translation:
女士们，先生们，
男孩们，女孩们，还有宝可梦们！\p最后，
最后的最后，我们的传说回归了！\p是的，就是那个传说中的名字！
我们的巨蛋超级巨星！\l他就是--石南！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_TuckerGoldIntro
source:
TUCKER: Ah…
The pummeling roar of the crowd…\lTheir furnace-like heat of excitement…\lThis is a wonderful place…\pTo the crowd, I am the DOME ACE…
I represent their hopes and dreams…\lI must never fade from their sight…\pI must burn!
Brighter and more brilliant!\lI must light all that gather here!$
translation:
石南：啊......
观众们那一浪高过一浪的欢呼声......\l还有他们那如熔炉般火热的激情......\l这里真是个美妙的地方......\p对观众们来说，
我就是巨蛋超级巨星......\l我承载着他们的希望与梦想......\l我决不能从他们的视野中消失......\p我必须燃烧！
燃烧得更加明亮、更加耀眼！\l我必须点亮这里的所有人！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_UnleashAllPowerIPossess
source: I will unleash all the power that\nI possess! Right here and now!$
translation: 就在此时，就在此地，\n我要释放我所拥有的全部实力！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_NeverLostWhenPowerUnleashed
source: TUCKER: You're genuinely fantastic!\pNever before! I haven't ever lost in the\ntimes I've had to unleash my power.\pYes, quite fantastic!\nYour FRONTIER PASS, please?$
translation: 石南：你是一个非凡的人！\p我从未遇到在我释放出全部实力后\n还能打败我的人，从来没有过！\p是的，你拥有非凡的实力！\n好了，把你的开拓通行证给我吧。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_TacticsSymbolTookGoldenShine
source: The Tactics Symbol took on\na golden shine!$
translation: 战术象征闪耀着\n金色的光芒！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_LookForwardToNextEncounter
source:
You're strong, but above all,
you have a unique charm!\pIn you, I see a definite potential for
a superstar like me.\pI will very much look forward to
our next encounter!$
translation:
你真的很强。但最重要的是，
你拥有独一无二的魅力！\p我可以看到你的身体中
蕴藏着成为我这样的明星的潜力。\p我很期待我们
下一次的相遇！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_PlayerIsLv50Champ2
source: {PLAYER} is the Level 50\nBattle Tournament Champion!\pCongratulations!$
translation: {PLAYER}是Lv. 50级\n对战锦标赛的冠军！\p恭喜！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_PlayerIsLvOpenChamp2
source: {PLAYER} is the Open Level\nBattle Tournament Champion!\pCongratulations!$
translation: {PLAYER}是自由等级\n对战锦标赛的冠军！\p恭喜！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_PlayerVersusTucker
source: The final match!\p{PLAYER} versus the DOME ACE, TUCKER!\pLet the battle begin!$
translation: 现在进行决赛！\p{PLAYER}对巨蛋超级巨星，\n石南！\p比赛开始！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_RefereesDecidedWinnerTucker
source:
The REFEREES have reached
a decision!\pThe winner is…
Oh, my goodness!\lThe winner is our very own DOME ACE!\lIt's TUCKER!\pCongratulations! And thank you!
Let's hear it for the DOME ACE, TUCKER!$
translation:
裁判做出了
最后的决定！\p冠军是......
天啊！\l冠军是我们的巨蛋超级巨星--\l石南！\p恭喜你！还有，谢谢！
我们的巨蛋超级巨星，石南！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeLobby_Text_WelcomeSingleBattle
source: Where the strategies of TRAINERS\nare put to the test!\pWelcome to the BATTLE DOME!\pI am your guide to the SINGLE BATTLE\nTournament.$
translation: 训练家的战略\n将在此接受考验！\p欢迎来到对战巨蛋！\p我是您的单打对战\n锦标赛向导。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeLobby_Text_TakeSinglesChallenge
source: Would you like to challenge\nthe SINGLE BATTLE Tournament?$
translation: 要挑战单打对战锦标赛吗？$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeLobby_Text_HopeToSeeYouAgain
source: We hope to see you again.$
translation: 期待您的再次光临！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeLobby_Text_ExplainSinglesChallenge
source:
The SINGLE BATTLE Tournament
is exactly as the name suggests--\la tournament of SINGLE BATTLES.\pAll participating TRAINERS must
enter three POKéMON each.\pIn each battle, one of the three
POKéMON must be held in reserve.\pThe other two POKéMON can battle
one at a time.\pChoose the two battling POKéMON after
examining the opponent's trio.\pYou win the tournament by defeating
four TRAINERS.\pBattle Points are awarded to
the tournament winner.\pIf you want to interrupt your
tournament, please save the game.\pIf you don't save before interrupting,
you will be disqualified.$
translation:
单打对战锦标赛
正如其名--\l这是一项进行单打对战的锦标赛。\p所有的训练家需要选择
3只宝可梦报名。\p每场对战中，3只宝可梦中的1只
需要保留作为后备。\p另外2只宝可梦将
进行1对1战斗。\p查看对手的3只宝可梦后，
即可选择2只宝可梦出战。\p连续击败4位训练家
即可获得胜利。\p锦标赛冠军将会
获得对战点数。\p如果要暂停锦标赛
请写入记录。\p请确保在退出前完好地写下了记录。
否则我们将视挑战为无效。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeLobby_Text_OkayToSaveBeforeChallenge
source: Before I show you to the BATTLE DOME,\nI must save the data. Is that okay?$
translation: 在带您进入对战巨蛋前，\n需要先写入记录，可以吗？$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeLobby_Text_WhichLevelMode
source: The tournament offers two levels\nof challenge, Level 50 and Open Level.\lWhich is your choice?$
translation: 锦标赛提供了2种挑战等级--\nLv. 50级和自由等级。\l您要选择哪个？$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeLobby_Text_SelectThreeMons
source: Now select the three POKéMON that\nyou wish to enter, please.$
translation: 请挑选参加的\n3只宝可梦。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsEnd
source: Please come see me when you are ready.$
translation: 请在准备就绪之后，\n再来参加吧！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLv50
source: Excuse me!\pYou don't have three eligible POKéMON.\pYou must have three different POKéMON\nof Level 50 or less to enter.\pThey also must be holding different\nkinds of items.\pEGGS{STR_VAR_1}.$
translation:
很抱歉！\p您能够参加对战的
宝可梦不满3只。\p您需要准备3只等级50以内的
不同种类的宝可梦，\p且让它们分别携带不同道具
才可参加对战。\p此外，蛋{STR_VAR_1}！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeLobby_Text_ShowYouToBattleDome
source: I will now show you to\nthe BATTLE DOME.$
translation: 现在我将带您前往\n对战巨蛋。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeLobby_Text_DidntSaveBeforeQuitting
source: Excuse me!\pYou didn't save before you quit your\nchallenge last time.\pBecause of that, your challenge so far\nhas been disqualified. Sorry!$
translation: 抱歉！\p您在上次结束时\n没有写入记录。\p对不起，没有写入记录的\n挑战我们将视其为无效。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeLobby_Text_CongratsForWinningTourney
source: Congratulations for winning\nyour Battle Tournament!$
translation: 恭喜您赢得对战锦标赛！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeLobby_Text_HereIsYourPrize
source: Here is your prize for your Battle\nTournament victory.$
translation: 这是胜利的奖品。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeLobby_Text_ReceivedPrize
source: {PLAYER} received the prize\n{STR_VAR_1}.$
translation: {PLAYER}获得了\n{STR_VAR_1}作为奖励。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeLobby_Text_BagFullMakeRoom
source: Oh, your BAG appears to be full.\pPlease make room in your BAG, then come\nsee me.$
translation: 啊，您的包包已经满了。\p请将包包整理好之后\n再来找我。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeLobby_Text_ThankYouForPlaying
source: 感谢您的游玩！$
translation: 辛苦了！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeLobby_Text_RecordWillBeSaved
source: Your record will be saved.\nPlease wait.$
translation: 正在写入记录......\n请稍候。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeLobby_Text_WeveBeenWaitingForYou
source: We've been waiting for you!$
translation: 我们已经恭候多时了！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeLobby_Text_OkayToSaveBeforeChallenge2
source: Before I show you to the BATTLE DOME,\nI must save the data. Is that okay?$
translation: 在带您进入对战巨蛋前，\n需要先写入记录，可以吗？$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeLobby_Text_WelcomeDoubleBattle
source: Where the strategies of TRAINERS\nare put to the test!\pWelcome to the BATTLE DOME!\pI am your guide to the DOUBLE BATTLE\nTournament.$
translation: 训练家的战略\n将在此接受考验！\p欢迎来到对战巨蛋！\p我是您的双打对战\n锦标赛向导。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeLobby_Text_TakeDoublesChallenge
source: Would you like to challenge\nthe DOUBLE BATTLE Tournament?$
translation: 要挑战双打对战锦标赛吗？$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeLobby_Text_ExplainDoublesChallenge
source:
The DOUBLE BATTLE Tournament
is exactly as the name suggests--\la tournament of DOUBLE BATTLES.\pAll participating TRAINERS must
enter three POKéMON each.\pIn each battle, one of the three
POKéMON must be held in reserve.\pThe remaining two POKéMON must take
part in a DOUBLE BATTLE.\pChoose the two battling POKéMON after
examining the opponent's trio.\pYou win the tournament by defeating
four TRAINERS.\pBattle Points are awarded to
the tournament winner.\pIf you want to interrupt your
tournament, please save the game.\pIf you don't save before interrupting,
you will be disqualified.$
translation:
双打对战锦标赛
正如其名--\l这是一项进行双打对战的锦标赛。\p所有的训练家需要选择
3只宝可梦报名。\p每场对战中，3只宝可梦中的1只
需要保留作为后备。\p另外2只宝可梦将
进行2对2战斗。\p查看对手的3只宝可梦后，
即可选择2只宝可梦出战。\p连续击败4位训练家
即可获得胜利。\p锦标赛冠军将会
获得对战点数。\p如果您在挑战途中
想要暂停的话，\p请确保在退出前完好地写下了记录。
否则我们将视挑战为无效。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeLobby_Text_PrevTourneyResultsSinglesLv50
source: They're the results of the last\nLevel 50 SINGLE BATTLE Tournament.$
translation: 这是上一次Lv. 50级\n单打对战锦标赛的结果。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeLobby_Text_PrevTourneyResultsDoublesLv50
source: They're the results of the last\nLevel 50 DOUBLE BATTLE Tournament.$
translation: 这是上一次Lv. 50级\n双打对战锦标赛的结果。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeLobby_Text_PrevTourneyResultsSinglesLvOpen
source: They're the results of the last\nOpen Level SINGLE BATTLE Tournament.$
translation: 这是上一次自由等级\n单打对战锦标赛的结果。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeLobby_Text_PrevTourneyResultsDoublesLvOpen
source: They're the results of the last\nOpen Level DOUBLE BATTLE Tournament.$
translation: 这是上一次自由等级\n双打对战锦标赛的结果。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeLobby_Text_LastWinnerWasTough
source:
Did you see it?
The last Battle Tournament?\pThe winner, {STR_VAR_1}, was seriously
tough.\pYou should check out the results
on the monitor beside the PC.$
translation:
你看到了吗？
上一次的对战锦标赛？\p冠军{STR_VAR_1}
可真是厉害啊！\p你应该去电脑旁边的显示器上
查看一下比赛结果。$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_LongDreamedAboutBattleFrontier
source: The BATTLE FRONTIER…\nI've long dreamed about a place like it.$
translation: 对战开拓区......\n我梦寐以求的地方啊！$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_BattleDomeSign2
source: The BATTLE DOME\nBecome the Unbeatable Superstar!$
translation: 对战巨蛋\n成为无以伦比的超级明星。$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_QuestionMarkUnderConstruction
source: The ??????\nUnder Construction!$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeLobby_Text_WinnersGainReputation
source:
When a TRAINER chains tournament
wins at the BATTLE DOME, he or she\lgains a reputation as a star.\pTough TRAINERS are drawn by that
reputation to the BATTLE DOME.\pA true superstar is a TRAINER who
can keep winning tournaments.$
translation:
当一位训练家连续在对战巨蛋
中取得胜利，他/她\l将获得明星般的名誉。\p厉害的训练家将会慕名而来
挑战对战巨蛋。\p真正的超级明星是能够不断
赢得比赛的训练家。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeLobby_Text_TrashedInFirstRound
source: I ran into one of the tournament\nfavorites in the very first round.\pOf course I got trashed…$
translation: 比赛的第一场我就碰上了\n一个夺冠热门的选手。\p输掉也是预料之中......$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeLobby_Text_NeedToCheckOpponentCarefully
source: I would've won if I'd kept this POKéMON\nheld in reserve.\pYou need to check your opponent's\nPOKéMON carefully before choosing\lyour battling POKéMON.$
translation: 我要是让这只宝可梦保留待命的话，\n我也许就能赢了。\p你得仔细查看清楚对手\n的宝可梦后，\l再挑选你的宝可梦。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeLobby_Text_CongratsDefeatedTucker
source: Congratulations!\pYou defeated the DOME ACE and won\nthe Battle Tournament!$
translation: 恭喜您！\p您打败了巨蛋超级巨星，\n并获得了对战锦标赛的胜利。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeLobby_Text_AwardTheseBattlePoints
source: In recognition of your strategy--\na thing of beauty it was, too--\lwe award you these Battle Point(s)!$
translation: 为了表彰您的战略--\n简直堪称美妙绝伦--\l我们将向您呈上对战点数！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeLobby_Text_RecordLastMatch
source: Would you like to record your\nlast BATTLE DOME match on your\lFRONTIER PASS?$
translation: 要将您在对战巨蛋的最后一场比赛\n记录到开拓通行证上吗？$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeLobby_Text_RulesAreListed
source: The Battle Tournament rules\nare listed.$
translation: 上面列出了对战锦标赛的规则。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeLobby_Text_ReadWhichHeading
source: Which heading do you want to read?$
translation: 要读哪一部分的说明？$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeLobby_Text_ExplainMatchupRules
source: The tournament matchups are drawn up\nbased on the toughness of POKéMON\lheld by TRAINERS.\pThe matchups avoid having tough\nTRAINERS face each other right away.$
translation: 锦标赛的对战匹配是根据训练家\n持有的宝可梦强度来安排的。\p匹配规则会避免让实力强劲的\n训练家在初期就相互对战。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeLobby_Text_ExplainTourneyTree
source:
The tournament chart, or as we call it,
the “Tree,” is available for viewing\lin the Waiting Room from any guide.\pThe Tournament Tree will provide
several kinds of data.\pThe data on view includes the previous
tournament's results, the POKéMON held\lby TRAINERS, and the battle styles of\lTRAINERS.$
translation:
比赛进程表--也可以称为"树状图"
可以在等候室中任意向导处查看。\p树状图上会显示
不同类型的数据，\p包括之前的比赛战绩，
所持有的宝可梦，\l还有训练家的对战方式。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeLobby_Text_ExplainDoubleKORules
source: If battling POKéMON faint at the same\ntime--a double KO--in a tournament\lmatch, the REFEREES will review\lthe match and declare the winner.$
translation: 如果对战双方的宝可梦\n在比赛中同时昏厥，\l则会请裁判重新审查比赛\l并宣布其中的获胜方。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomePreBattleRoom_Text_ReadyForRound1
source: Your 1st-round match is next.\nAre you ready?$
translation: 接下来您将参加第1轮比赛。\n准备好了吗？$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomePreBattleRoom_Text_ReadyForRound2
source: Your 2nd-round match is next.\nAre you ready?$
translation: 接下来您将参加第2轮比赛。\n准备好了吗？$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomePreBattleRoom_Text_ReadyForSemifinals
source: Your semifinal match is next.\nAre you ready?$
translation: 接下来您将参加半决赛。\n准备好了吗？$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomePreBattleRoom_Text_ReadyForFinals
source: Your final match is next.\nAre you ready?$
translation: 接下来您将参加决赛。\n准备好了吗？$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomePreBattleRoom_Text_ChooseTwoMons
source: Please choose the two POKéMON\nthat are to appear in battle.$
translation: 请选择2只即将在对战中\n登场的宝可梦。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomePreBattleRoom_Text_RightThisWay
source: Right this way, please.$
translation: 这边请。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomePreBattleRoom_Text_RestoreMonsToFullHealth
source: Thank you for competing!\pI'll restore your POKéMON to\nfull health.$
translation: 辛苦了！\p我来帮您的宝可梦\n回复体力。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomePreBattleRoom_Text_Round1Complete
source: All 1st-round matches have been\ncompleted.\pThese are the teams that advanced!$
translation: 所有的第1轮比赛\n都已结束。\p这些是成功晋级的队伍！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomePreBattleRoom_Text_Round2Complete
source: All 2nd-round matches have been\ncompleted.\pThese are the teams that advanced!$
translation: 所有的第2轮比赛\n都已结束。\p这些是成功晋级的队伍！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomePreBattleRoom_Text_SemifinalsComplete
source: All semifinal matches have been\ncompleted.\pThese are the teams that advanced!$
translation: 所有的半决赛比赛\n都已结束。\p这些是成功晋级的队伍！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomePreBattleRoom_Text_CongratsReadyForRound2
source: Congratulations for getting through\nthe 1st round.\pThe 2nd round is next.\nAre you ready?$
translation: 恭喜通过第1轮\n比赛。\p接下来是第2轮。\n准备好了吗？$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomePreBattleRoom_Text_CongratsReadyForSemifinals
source: Congratulations for advancing\nto the semifinals.\pThe best four teams meet in this round.\nAre you ready?$
translation: 恭喜进入\n半决赛。\p4个强队在此相遇。\n准备好了吗？$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomePreBattleRoom_Text_CongratsReadyForFinals
source: Congratulations for advancing\nto the final match.\pYou're one win from the championship.\nAre you ready?$
translation: 恭喜进入\n决赛。\p您是冠军候选之一。\n准备好了吗？$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomePreBattleRoom_Text_PlayersNextOpponentIsTrainer
source: {PLAYER}'s next opponent\nis this TRAINER.$
translation: {PLAYER}的下一位对手是\n这位训练家。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomePreBattleRoom_Text_TourneyInRound1
source: The tournament is in the 1st round.$
translation: 锦标赛进入第1回合！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomePreBattleRoom_Text_TourneyInRound2
source: The tournament is in the 2nd round.$
translation: 锦标赛进入第2回合！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomePreBattleRoom_Text_TourneyInSemifinals
source: The tournament is in the semifinals.$
translation: 锦标赛进入半决赛！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomePreBattleRoom_Text_TourneyInFinals
source: The tournament is up to the final.$
translation: 锦标赛进入决赛！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomePreBattleRoom_Text_SaveAndQuitGame
source: Would you like to save and\nquit the game?$
translation: 要写入记录\n并且暂停吗？$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomePreBattleRoom_Text_RetireYourChallenge
source: Would you like to retire from your\nBattle Tournament challenge?$
translation: 要结束对战锦标赛的挑战吗？$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomePreBattleRoom_Text_SavingDataPleaseWait
source: I am saving your data.\nPlease wait.$
translation: 正在写入记录......\n请稍候。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomePreBattleRoom_Text_RecordLastMatch
source: Should I record your last match\non your FRONTIER PASS?$
translation: 要将您的最后一场对战\n记录到开拓通行证上吗？$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomePreBattleRoom_Text_ReadyForTuckerSilver
source: Congratulations for advancing\nto the final match.\pFor the final match, you will challenge\nthe DOME ACE TUCKER.\pAre you ready?$
translation: 恭喜您成功\n进入决赛！\p在决赛中，您将挑战的人是--\n巨蛋超级巨星石南。\p准备好了吗？$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomePreBattleRoom_Text_ReadyForTuckerGold
source: Congratulations for advancing\nto the final match.\pFor the final match, you will challenge\nthe DOME ACE TUCKER.\pAre you ready?$
translation: 恭喜您成功\n进入决赛！\p在决赛中，您将挑战的人是--\n巨蛋超级巨星石南。\p准备好了吗？$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomePreBattleRoom_Text_ReadyForTuckerSilverShort
source: Your final battle against TUCKER is\nnext. Are you ready?$
translation: 接下来的是您最后的对手石南。\n准备好了吗？$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomePreBattleRoom_Text_ReadyForTuckerGoldShort
source: Your final battle against TUCKER is\nnext. Are you ready?$
translation: 接下来的是您最后的对手石南。\n准备好了吗？$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryBattleRoom_Text_GetAMoveOn
source: Hey, hey!\nGet a move on!$
translation: 嘿，嘿！\n快点动起来！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryBattleRoom_Text_NolandImFactoryHead
source:
Hey, my name's NOLAND!
I'm basically in charge of this place,\lwhich is why I'm the FACTORY HEAD!\pI had a look at your Battle Swap data.\pYou seem to have the right idea,
but you're still square in your head!\pListen up, okay? Knowledge isn't only
about reading books or doing desk work.\pJust doing that sort of thing…
It may as well be useless!\pYou have to experience things with
your heart and your body, understand?\pI'll take you on under the same
conditions as you.\pI'll be using rental POKéMON, too!$
translation:
嘿，我叫达拉！
这里基本上由我负责，\l这就是为什么我叫工厂头目！\p我看了一下你交换式对战的数据。\p你好像有正确的想法，
但是你的头脑太过死板！\p听好了，知识可不只是读书
或者做功课。\p仅仅做那种事......
很可能毫无作用！\p你必须用你的身心去
亲自体验，明白吗？\p我要在同等的条件
下和你较量。\p我也会用租借的宝可梦！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryBattleRoom_Text_ShakeOutKnowledgeBringItOn
source: Shake out every last bit of your\nknowledge and bring it on!$
translation: 穷尽你毕生所学，\n放马过来！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryBattleRoom_Text_NolandLetsSeeFrontierPass
source: NOLAND: Smart going!\nLet's see your FRONTIER PASS.$
translation: 达拉：做得漂亮！\n拿出你的开拓通行证。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryBattleRoom_Text_ReceivedKnowledgeSymbol
source: The Knowledge Symbol was embossed\non the FRONTIER PASS!$
translation: 知识象征被印在了\n开拓通行证上！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryBattleRoom_Text_NextTimeNoHoldsBarred
source: Heh…\nYou're a pretty bright spark…\pNext time, I'll come after you hard.\nNo holds barred, understand?\pYou keep up your studies!$
translation: 哈......\n你真是个聪明的人......\p下次，我会全力以赴的。\n毫不留情，明白吗？\p继续学习吧！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryBattleRoom_Text_HarderLookThanLastTime
source:
NOLAND: Hey, hey! How's it going?
You keeping up with your studies?\p…Oh?\pYou've taken on a harder look than
the last time I saw you.\pNow, this should be fun!
I'm getting excited, hey!$
translation:
达拉：嘿，嘿！近来如何？
你有在继续不断地学习吗？\p......哦？\p你看上去比我上次见到你
时更坚毅了。\p那么，看起来这会很有趣！
我开始兴奋起来了，嘿！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryBattleRoom_Text_AllRightBringItOn
source: All right!\nBring it on!$
translation: 好！\n放马过来！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryBattleRoom_Text_OutOfMyLeagueLetsSeePass
source: NOLAND: What the…\nYou're getting out of my league!\pSheesh!\nLet's see that FRONTIER PASS!$
translation: 达拉：什么......\n你已经和我不在一个层次了！\p唉！\n拿出你的开拓通行证吧！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryBattleRoom_Text_KnowledgeSymbolTookGoldenShine
source: The Knowledge Symbol took on\na golden shine!$
translation: 知识象征闪耀着\n金色的光芒！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryBattleRoom_Text_LastTimeILoseToYou
source: Pfft, man!\pThat's absolutely the last time\nI lose to you!\pWe have to do this again, hey?$
translation: 切！\p这绝对是我最后一次\n输给你！\p我们必须再来一次，如何？$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_WelcomeForSingleBattle
source: Where the intelligence of TRAINERS\nis put to the test!\pWelcome to the BATTLE FACTORY!\pI am your guide to the Battle Swap\nSingle Tournament.$
translation: 训练家的智慧\n将在此接受考验！\p欢迎来到对战工厂！\p我是您的交换式对战\n单打锦标赛向导。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_TakeSinglesChallenge
source: Would you like to take the Battle\nSwap Single challenge?$
translation: 要挑战交换式对战\n单打锦标赛吗？$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_ExplainSinglesChallenge
source:
The Battle Swap Single Tournament
is a SINGLE BATTLE competition using\lonly rental POKéMON.\pFirst, you will be loaned three
POKéMON specifically for this event.\pUsing the supplied rental POKéMON,
you must conduct a SINGLE BATTLE.\pIf you win, you are permitted to trade
one of your rental POKéMON.\pRepeat this cycle of battling and
trading--if you win seven times in\la row, you will earn Battle Points.\pIf you want to interrupt your
challenge, please save the game.\pIf you don't save, you will be
disqualified from your challenge.$
translation:
交换式对战单打锦标赛
是一种只能使用租借的宝可梦\l进行单打对战的比赛。\p首先，您将获得3只专门为本次比赛
提供的租借宝可梦。\p您需要用这些提供的租借宝可梦，
进行一场单打对战。\p如果获胜，您可以将其中1只
租借宝可梦交换掉。\p如此反复进行对战与交换--
如果您能连续获胜7次，\l我们将向您呈上对战点数。\p如果您要暂停挑战，
请先写入记录。\p请确保在退出前完好地写下了记录。
否则我们将视挑战为无效。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_LookForwardToNextVisit
source: We look forward to your next visit.$
translation: 我们期待您的再次光临。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_WhichLevelMode
source: Which level do you wish to challenge?\nLevel 50 or Open Level?$
translation: 您要挑战哪个等级？\nLv. 50级还是自由等级？$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_OkayToSaveBeforeChallenge
source: Before you begin your challenge,\nI need to save the game. Is that okay?$
translation: 在挑战前需要先写入记录，\n可以吗？$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_WillHoldMonsForSafekeeping
source: Okay, I will hold your POKéMON for\nsafekeeping while you compete.$
translation: 好的，我将在您参加比赛时\n为您保管好宝可梦。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_StepThisWay
source: 这边请。$
translation: 这边请。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_ReturnMonsSaveResults
source: Thank you for participating!\pI will return your POKéMON in exchange\nfor our rental POKéMON.\pI must also save the event results.\nPlease wait.$
translation: 辛苦了！\p我将把您的宝可梦还给您\n并换回租借宝可梦。\p并且需要写入对战记录。\n请稍等。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_ReturnMons
source: I will return your POKéMON in exchange\nfor our rental POKéMON.$
translation: 我要归还您的宝可梦\n并收回租借宝可梦。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_CongratsSevenWins
source: Congratulations! You've won seven\nstraight Battle Swap matches!$
translation: 恭喜！您连续赢得了7场\n交换式对战的比赛！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_AwardBattlePointsForStreak
source: In recognition of your 7-win streak,\nwe award you these Battle Point(s).$
translation: 作为7连胜的奖励，\n我们将向您呈上对战点数。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_MaxBattlePoints
source: Oh, oh, oh!\pYour Battle Points are maxed.\pPlease come back after using\nsome Battle Points.$
translation: 噢，噢，噢！\p您的对战点数已经到最大值了。\p请使用一些对战点数\n之后再回来。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_WaitingForYouToResume
source: We've been waiting for you!\pBefore we resume your challenge,\nI must save the game.$
translation: 我们已经恭候多时了！\p在继续您的挑战前，\n需要先写入记录。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_WellReturnMons
source: We'll return your personal POKéMON.$
translation: 我们要归还您的宝可梦。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_ReceivedPrizeItem
source: {PLAYER} received the prize\n{STR_VAR_1}.$
translation: {PLAYER}得到了奖品\n{STR_VAR_1}。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_WelcomeForDoubleBattle
source: Where the intelligence of TRAINERS\nis put to the test!\pWelcome to the BATTLE FACTORY!\pI am your guide to the Battle Swap\nDouble Tournament.$
translation: 训练家的智慧\n将在此接受考验！\p欢迎来到对战工厂！\p我是您的交换式对战\n双打锦标赛向导。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_TakeDoublesChallenge
source: Would you like to take the Battle\nSwap Double challenge?$
translation: 要挑战交换式对战\n双打锦标赛吗？$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_ExplainDoublesChallenge
source:
The Battle Swap Double Tournament
is a DOUBLE BATTLE competition using\lonly rental POKéMON.\pFirst, you will be loaned three
POKéMON specifically for this event.\pUsing the supplied rental POKéMON,
you must conduct a DOUBLE BATTLE.\pIf you win, you are permitted to trade
one of your rental POKéMON.\pRepeat this cycle of battling and
trading--if you win seven times in\la row, you will earn Battle Points.\pIf you want to interrupt your
challenge, please save the game.\pIf you don't save before interrupting,
you will be disqualified.$
translation:
交换式对战双打锦标赛
是一种只能使用租借的宝可梦\l进行双打对战的比赛。\p首先，您将获得3只专门为本次比赛
提供的租借宝可梦。\p您需要用这些提供的租借宝可梦，
进行一场双打对战。\p如果获胜，您可以将其中1只
租借宝可梦交换掉。\p如此反复进行对战与交换--
如果您能连续获胜7次，\l我们将向您呈上对战点数。\p如果您在挑战途中
想要暂停的话，\p请确保在退出前完好地写下了记录。
否则我们将视挑战为无效。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_CongratsForDefeatingHead
source: Congratulations for defeating\nthe FACTORY HEAD and winning\lseven matches in a row!$
translation: 恭喜您击败了工厂头目\n并连续赢得了7场比赛！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_AwardBattlePoints
source: In recognition of your wealth of\nknowledge and keen intelligence,\lwe award you these Battle Point(s).$
translation: 为了表彰您拥有的知识财富\n以及非凡的智慧，\l我们将向您呈上对战点数。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_ExchangeMonsAndSave
source: Let me exchange your POKéMON\nfor our rental POKéMON.\pI need to save the battle data,\nso please wait.$
translation: 我将把您的宝可梦还给您\n并换回租借宝可梦。\p我需要先写入对战记录，\n请稍等。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_RecordLastMatch
source: Would you like to record your last\nBATTLE FACTORY match on your\lFRONTIER PASS?$
translation: 要将您在对战工厂的最后一场比赛\n记录到开拓通行证上吗？$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_NeedKnowledgeOfMonsMoves
source:
Hi!
You, there!\pAre you thinking that the events here
are easy since you don't need to have\la raised team of POKéMON?\pI wouldn't be too sure about winning
that easily.\pIf you don't have thorough knowledge
about POKéMON and their moves,\lit will be tough to keep winning.$
translation:
喂！
那边的，你！\p你在想既然不必去
培育一组宝可梦\l那么对战就会很容易是吗？\p我认为要赢并不是那么
简单的。\p如果你不具备对宝可梦及
他们的招式的透彻的知识的话，\l想要赢是很难的。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_SwappedForWeakMon
source: I swapped for a weak POKéMON…\nI thought it was a good kind to have…\pThey wiped the floor with us…$
translation: 我交换到了1只很弱的宝可梦......\n我本以为那种不错......\p结果他们把我打得一败涂地......$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_NeedToCheckOpponentsMons
source: Things haven't been going my way\nat all.\pYou need to check your opponent's\nPOKéMON during battle to see if\lthey're any good.$
translation: 一切都变得和我想的\n完全不一样了。\p你要在对战中仔细检查\n你对手的宝可梦是否强大。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_CantFigureOutStaffHints
source: You know how the staff here give you\na few hints about your next opponent?\pWell, I'm a full-grown man, but I have\ntrouble figuring out their hints.$
translation: 你知道这的工作人员会给你\n一些关于你下个对手的提示吧？\p好吧，虽然我是一个经验丰富的人，\n但我弄不懂他们的提示。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_RentalMonsAreVaried
source: Like, I'm really tough, but I get bored\nreally easily, so I just kept swapping\land battling over and over.\pSo anyway, when I kept entering\nBattle Swap events, I noticed they\lvaried the rental POKéMON.$
translation: 例如，我很强大，但是我很容易感到\n无聊，于是我不停的\l交换并且对战。\p不管怎么说，当我进入\n交换式对战活动中，我发现他们\l有很多不同的宝可梦租借。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_RulesAreListed
source: The Battle Swap rules are listed.$
translation: 上面列出了交换式对战的规则。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_ReadWhichHeading
source: Which heading do you want to read?$
translation: 要读哪一部分的说明？$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_ExplainBasicRules
source: In a Battle Swap event, you may use\nonly three POKéMON.\pWhether you are renting or swapping,\nyour team may not have two or more\lof the same POKéMON.$
translation: 在交换式对战中，\n您只能用3只宝可梦。\p无论是租借还是交换得到的，\n您的队伍中不能出现2只\l或以上相同种类的宝可梦。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_ExplainSwapPartnerRules
source: You may swap POKéMON only with\nthe TRAINER you have just defeated.\pYou may swap for only those POKéMON\nused by the beaten TRAINER.$
translation: 您只能与刚击败过的训练家\n交换宝可梦。\p您只能交换到该训练家\n所使用的宝可梦。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_ExplainSwapNumberRules
source: After every battle you win, you may\nswap for one of your defeated\lopponent's POKéMON.\pYou will not be able to swap POKéMON\nwith the seventh TRAINER in the event.$
translation: 每获胜1场对战后，\n您可以选择交换对手的1只宝可梦。\p第7位训练家\n不可进行交换。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_ExplainSwapNotesRules
source:
There are two key points to be aware
of when swapping POKéMON.\pFirst, when swapping, you can't check
the stats of the POKéMON you are\labout to receive.\pSecond, the POKéMON on your team
are lined up in sequence, depending on\lthe order in which you rented them.\pThis sequence remains unchanged
even when swaps are made.$
translation:
在交换宝可梦时有2个
需要注意的地方。\p第一，交换时您无法查看目标
宝可梦的具体能力。\p第二，队伍中的宝可梦的排列顺序
按租用时的顺序固定。\p交换后该顺序仍保持不变。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_ExplainOpenLvRules
source: In the Open Level, the rental POKéMON\nand the opposing TRAINERS' POKéMON\lare all Level 100.$
translation: 在自由等级中，所有租借宝可梦和\n对手训练家的宝可梦等级均为100。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryPreBattleRoom_Text_HoldMonsChooseFromSelection
source: First, we will hold your POKéMON for\nsafekeeping.\pYou may then choose from our\nselection of POKéMON.$
translation: 我们将先暂时保管\n您的宝可梦。\p您可以稍后从我们提供的\n宝可梦中进行选择。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryPreBattleRoom_Text_LetUsRestoreMons
source: Thank you for competing!\nLet us restore your POKéMON!$
translation: 辛苦了！\n我来帮您的宝可梦回复体力！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryPreBattleRoom_Text_ReadyFor2ndOpponent
source: The 2nd match is next!\nAre you ready?$
translation: 接下来是第2场比赛！\n准备好了吗？$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryPreBattleRoom_Text_ReadyFor3rdOpponent
source: The 3rd match is next!\nAre you ready?$
translation: 接下来是第3场比赛！\n准备好了吗？$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryPreBattleRoom_Text_ReadyFor4thOpponent
source: The 4th match is next!\nAre you ready?$
translation: 接下来是第4场比赛！\n准备好了吗？$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryPreBattleRoom_Text_ReadyFor5thOpponent
source: The 5th match is next!\nAre you ready?$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryPreBattleRoom_Text_ReadyFor6thOpponent
source: The 6th match is next!\nAre you ready?$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryPreBattleRoom_Text_ReadyFor7thOpponent
source: Finally, the 7th match is next!\nAre you ready?$
translation: 接下来是第7场比赛！\n准备好了吗？$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryPreBattleRoom_Text_SaveAndQuitGame
source: Would you like to save and quit\nthe game?$
translation: 要写入记录\n并且暂停吗？$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryPreBattleRoom_Text_RetireFromChallenge
source: Would you like to retire from your\nBattle Swap challenge?$
translation: 要结束交换式对战的挑战吗？$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryPreBattleRoom_Text_InvestigatedUpcomingOpponent
source: I've conducted a little investigation\nabout your upcoming opponent.$
translation: 我对您的下一位对手\n进行了一些调查。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryPreBattleRoom_Text_TrainerSkilledInNormalType
source: The TRAINER is apparently skilled\nin the handling of the NORMAL type.$
translation: 这个训练家显然很善于\n操纵一般属性。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryPreBattleRoom_Text_TrainerHasNoClearFavorite
