translation: 这个训练家显然没有特别\n擅长的属性。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryPreBattleRoom_Text_StyleSlowAndSteady
source: The favorite battle style appears to\nbe slow and steady.$
translation: 最喜欢的战斗风格好像是\n稳扎稳打的那种。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryPreBattleRoom_Text_StyleEndurance
source: The favorite battle style appears to\nbe one of endurance.$
translation: 最喜欢的战斗风格好像是\n着重耐力的那种。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryPreBattleRoom_Text_StyleHighRisk
source: The favorite battle style appears to\nbe high risk, high return.$
translation: 最喜欢的战斗风格好像是\n孤注一掷的那种。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryPreBattleRoom_Text_StyleDependsOnFlow
source: The favorite battle style appears to\ndepend on the battle's flow.$
translation: 最喜欢的战斗风格好像是\n善观战斗走向的那种。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryPreBattleRoom_Text_StyleTotalPreparation
source: The favorite battle style appears to\nbe one based on total preparation.$
translation: 最喜欢的战斗风格好像是\n万事俱备的那种。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryPreBattleRoom_Text_StyleWeakenFoe
source: The favorite battle style appears\nto be weakening the foe to start.$
translation: 最喜欢的战斗风格好像是\n弱敌为先的那种。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryPreBattleRoom_Text_StyleFlexible
source: The favorite battle style appears to\nbe flexibly adaptable to the situation.$
translation: 最喜欢的战斗风格好像是\n因地制宜的那种。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryPreBattleRoom_Text_StyleImpossibleToPredict
source: The favorite battle style appears to\nbe impossible to predict.$
translation: 最喜欢的战斗风格好像是\n高深莫测的那种。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryPreBattleRoom_Text_StyleUnrestrained
source: The favorite battle style appears to\nbe free-spirited and unrestrained.$
translation: 最喜欢的战斗风格好像是\n自由奔放、无拘无束的那种。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryPreBattleRoom_Text_LikeToSwapMon
source: Before starting the battle, would you\nlike to swap a POKéMON?$
translation: 在对战开始前，\n需要交换1只宝可梦吗？$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryPreBattleRoom_Text_YourSwapIsComplete
source: Thank you!\nYour POKéMON swap is complete.$
translation: 谢谢！\n宝可梦交换已完成。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryPreBattleRoom_Text_RightThisWay
source: Right this way, please!$
translation: 这边请！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryPreBattleRoom_Text_SavingDataPleaseWait
source: I am saving your data.\nPlease wait.$
translation: 正在写入记录......\n请稍等。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryPreBattleRoom_Text_RecordLatestBattle
source: Would you like to record your latest\nbattle on your FRONTIER PASS?$
translation: 您要把您上次的战斗记录\n到您的开拓通行证吗？$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryPreBattleRoom_Text_WaitFewMoments
source: Excuse me! Excuse me, please!\nMay I get you to wait a few moments?$
translation: 抱歉！请见谅！\n能稍等一下吗？$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryPreBattleRoom_Text_UnderstoodSirWillDo
source: …Uh-huh? What?! …Whoa!\nUnderstood, sir! Will do!$
translation: ......啊？什么？！......哇哦！\n明白了先生！马上就做！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryPreBattleRoom_Text_MessageFromHeadComeRightNow
source:
Oh, my…
Sorry to keep you waiting!\pI have a message from this facility's
boss, the FACTORY HEAD.\pHe says, “We're going to do it!
Come here right now!”$
translation:
哦，天哪......
很抱歉让您久等了！\p我收到了老板--工厂头目
那边发来的消息。\p他说，"我们即将开始！
现在马上过来！"$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryPreBattleRoom_Text_PreparedToFaceHead
source: The FACTORY HEAD is demanding you.\nAre you prepared to face him?$
translation: 工厂头目要求见您。\n您准备好迎战他了吗？$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryPreBattleRoom_Text_CantTellAnythingAboutHead
source: I'm terribly sorry, but I can't tell you\nanything about the FACTORY HEAD.$
translation: 十分抱歉，我不能告诉您\n任何有关于工厂头目的事。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceBattleRoom_Text_LetMeRestoreYourMons
source: Excellent…\nLet me restore your POKéMON.$
translation: 太精彩了......\n让我帮您的宝可梦回复体力。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceBattleRoom_Text_PreparedFor2ndOpponent
source: The 2nd opponent is next.\nAre you prepared?$
translation: 下面是第2个对手，\n准备好了吗？$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceBattleRoom_Text_PreparedFor3rdOpponent
source: The 3rd opponent is next.\nAre you prepared?$
translation: 下面是第3个对手，\n准备好了吗？$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceBattleRoom_Text_PreparedFor4thOpponent
source: The 4th opponent is next.\nAre you prepared?$
translation: 下面是第4个对手，\n准备好了吗？$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceBattleRoom_Text_PreparedFor5thOpponent
source: The 5th opponent is next.\nAre you prepared?$
translation: 下面是第5个对手，\n准备好了吗？$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceBattleRoom_Text_PreparedFor6thOpponent
source: The 6th opponent is next.\nAre you prepared?$
translation: 下面是第6个对手，\n准备好了吗？$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceBattleRoom_Text_PreparedFor7thOpponent
source: The 7th opponent is next.\nAre you prepared?$
translation: 下面是第7个对手，\n准备好了吗？$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceBattleRoom_Text_SaveAndQuitGame
source: Would you like to save and quit\nthe game?$
translation: 要写入记录\n并且暂停吗？$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceBattleRoom_Text_WishToQuitChallenge
source: Do you wish to quit your challenge?$
translation: 要退出挑战吗？$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceBattleRoom_Text_SavingData
source: Saving the data.\nHave patience…$
translation: 正在写入记录，\n请耐心等候......$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceBattleRoom_Text_RecordLastMatch
source: Do you wish to record your latest\nmatch on your FRONTIER PASS?$
translation: 要将您的最后一场对战\n记录到开拓通行证上吗？$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceBattleRoom_Text_ChallengingPalaceMaven
source: And now…\pBy winning consistently, you have\nearned the privilege of challenging\lour master, the PALACE MAVEN…$
translation: 现在......\p由于您连胜的战绩，\n您获得了挑战大师--\l宫殿守护者的资格......$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceBattleRoom_Text_ReadyForPalaceMaven
source: I shall send for the PALACE MAVEN.\nAre you ready?$
translation: 现在带您去见宫殿守护者，\n准备好了吗？$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceBattleRoom_Text_AnnounceArrivalOfSpenser
source: Let great fanfare announce the arrival\nof the PALACE MAVEN, SPENSER!$
translation: 让我们以最热烈的欢呼声，\n迎接宫殿守护者郁金的登场！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceBattleRoom_Text_SpenserFirstIntro
source:
SPENSER: My physical being is with
POKéMON always!\pMy heart beats as one with
POKéMON always!\pYoung one of a TRAINER!
Do you believe in your POKéMON?\pCan you believe them through
and through?\pIf your bonds of trust are frail,
you will never beat my brethren!$
translation:
郁金：我的身体永远
与宝可梦同在！\p我的灵魂永远
与宝可梦共鸣！\p年轻的训练家啊！
你信任你的宝可梦吗？\p你能矢志不渝地
信任它们吗？\p如果你的牵绊不够坚韧，
你绝无可能打败我的伙伴！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceBattleRoom_Text_ProveYourBondWithMons
source: The bond you share with your POKéMON!\nProve it to me here!$
translation: 就在此处，让我见证你和\n你的宝可梦之间的牵绊吧！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceBattleRoom_Text_SpenserPostSilverBattle
source: SPENSER: Gwahahah!\pHah, you never fell for my bluster!\nSorry for trying that stunt!\pHere!\nBring me the thing!$
translation: 郁金：哇哈哈哈！\p居然没被我的虚张声势唬住！\n刚才的拙劣演技真是见笑了！\p来！\n把东西拿来！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceBattleRoom_Text_LetsSeeFrontierPass
source: My, my, if only you could maintain that\nfacade of distinguished authority…\pHere!\nLet's see your FRONTIER PASS!$
translation: 唉，真是的，明明刚才还在\n保持着的威严形象呢......\p来吧！\n给我您的开拓通行证吧！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceBattleRoom_Text_ReceivedSpiritsSymbol
source: The Spirits Symbol was embossed on\nthe FRONTIER PASS!$
translation: 精神象征被印在了\n开拓通行证上！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceBattleRoom_Text_SpenserAwaitNextTime
source: SPENSER: Your POKéMON's eyes are \ntruly clear and unclouded.\pI will eagerly await the next\nopportunity to see you.$
translation: 郁金：你的宝可梦的眼中\n没有丝毫的迷茫，\p我会满怀期待地等候\n下一次我们的再会。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceBattleRoom_Text_SpenserThisTimeWontHoldBack
source:
SPENSER: Gwahahah!
You've battled your way up again?\pYou must have developed a truly
formidable bond with your POKéMON.\pSo be it!\pThis time, I won't bluster or hold back.
This time, there's no fooling around.\pReady now?
Prepare to lose!$
translation:
郁金：哇哈哈哈！
你又一路赢过来了？\p你和你的宝可梦之间
的牵绊看来已然坚不可摧。\p很好！\p这次，我既不会虚张声势，
也不会手下留情了。\l这次，我要动真格的了。\p准备好了吗？
做好失败的觉悟吧！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceBattleRoom_Text_Kaaah
source: … … …Kaaah!$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceBattleRoom_Text_SpenserYourTeamIsAdmirable
source: SPENSER: Well, that was some display!\nEven fully unleashed, my brethren\lcould not overpower you.\pYour team spirit is truly admirable!\pHere!\nBring me that thing, will you?$
translation: 郁金：何等激烈的战斗！\n就算是全力一搏，\l我的伙伴也没能打败你。\p你们的团队精神令人钦佩！\p来！\n把东西拿来吧！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceBattleRoom_Text_HurryWithFrontierPass
source: My, my, if only you could maintain\na certain level of decorum…\pGaaah, here!\nHurry with that FRONTIER PASS, you!$
translation: 唉，真是的，明明应该再保持\n点风度的......\p嘎啊，来！\n把您的开拓通行证拿来吧！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceBattleRoom_Text_SpiritsSymbolTookGoldenShine
source: The Spirits Symbol took on\na golden shine!$
translation: 精神象征闪耀着\n金色的光芒！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceBattleRoom_Text_SpenserComeSeeMeAgain
source: SPENSER: Gwahahah!\pCome see me time and again!\nMy brethren and I will be waiting!$
translation: 郁金：哇哈哈哈！\p记得常来！\n我和我的伙伴会等着你的！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceCorridor_Text_PeopleAndMonAreSame
source: People and POKéMON, they are but\nthe same…\pTheir individual nature makes them\ngood at certain things, and not good\lat others.$
translation: 人也好宝可梦也好，\n其实都是一样的......\p每个个体的性格决定了他们\n擅长哪些事情，\l不擅长哪些事情。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceCorridor_Text_LetMonDoWhatItLikes
source: Rather than trying to make a POKéMON\ndo what it dislikes, try to let it do\lwhat it likes and is good at doing.\pPut yourself in the POKéMON's position\nand consider what moves it would like.$
translation: 与其勉强宝可梦做自己\n不喜欢的事情，不如让它们\l去做喜欢并且擅长的事。\p站在你的宝可梦的角度思考一下\n它究竟会喜欢什么样的招式。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceCorridor_Text_MonDifferentWhenCornered
source: A POKéMON's nature is a remarkable\nthing…\pSome POKéMON behave in a completely\ndifferent way when they are cornered.$
translation: 宝可梦的性格\n至关重要......\p一些宝可梦在陷入绝境时可能会\n做出与之前完全相反的行动来。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceCorridor_Text_BeginningToUnderstandNature
source: Are you beginning to understand how\na POKéMON's nature makes it behave?$
translation: 你开始理解宝可梦的性格\n与它们的行动之间的关系了吗？$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceCorridor_Text_HeartfeltBondBetweenYouAndMons
source: Ah… I see a strong, heartfelt bond\nbetween you and your POKéMON…$
translation: 啊......你和你的宝可梦之间的\n牵绊是多么强大啊......$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_WelcomeForSingleBattle
source: Where the hearts of TRAINERS\nare put to the test.\pI welcome you to the BATTLE PALACE.\pI accept challenges to the SINGLE\nBATTLE HALLS.$
translation: 训练家的心灵\n将在此接受考验。\p欢迎来到对战宫殿。\p我在此受理单打对战厅\n的挑战申请。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_TakeSingleBattleChallenge
source: Do you wish to take\nthe SINGLE BATTLE HALL challenge?$
translation: 要挑战单打对战厅吗？$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ExplainSingleBattleChallenge
source:
In the BATTLE PALACE, there are
several auditoriums for SINGLE BATTLES\lthat are named SINGLE BATTLE HALLS.\pThe SINGLE BATTLES are conducted in
the usual way, except with one crucial\lrule that must be obeyed.\pTRAINERS are permitted only to switch
their POKéMON in and out.\pTRAINERS are otherwise forbidden to
command their POKéMON.\pThe POKéMON are to behave according
to their nature and battle on their own.\pYou must put your trust in your
POKéMON and watch over them.\pIf you achieve the honor of beating
seven TRAINERS in succession,\lwe will present you with Battle Points.\pIf you want to interrupt your
challenge, you must save the game.\pIf you don't save before interrupting,
you will be disqualified.$
translation:
对战宫殿里有几个专门为
单打对战准备的礼堂，\l我们称之为单打对战厅。\p单打对战与普通比赛的规则一致，
但需要遵守一条关键规则--\p训练家只能替换
自己的宝可梦，\p禁止对它们下达
任何战斗指令。\p宝可梦将完全凭借自己的
本能战斗，\p您需要完全信赖您的宝可梦，
在一边旁观它们对战。\p如果您能成功地连续
打败7个训练家，\l我们将向您呈上对战点数。\p如果要暂停挑战的话
需要先写入记录，\p请确保在退出前完好地写下了记录。
否则我们将视挑战为无效。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ReturnWhenFortified
source: When you have fortified your heart\nand POKéMON, you must return.$
translation: 当您的心灵与您的宝可梦都变得\n更强的时候，再回到这里来吧。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_WhichChallenge
source: There are two BATTLE HALLS,\nLevel 50 and Open Level.\lWhich is your choice of a challenge?$
translation: 对战厅有2种，\nLv. 50级和自由等级，\l您要挑战哪种？$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsEnd
source: Come back when you have made\nyour preparations.$
translation: 请在准备就绪之后，\n再来参加吧。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLvOpen
source:
Sigh…\pYou do not have the three POKéMON
required for the challenge.\pTo enter, you must provide three
different kinds of POKéMON.\pThey also must not be holding
the same kinds of items.\pEGGS{STR_VAR_1}.$
translation:
哎......\p您能够参加对战的
宝可梦不满3只。\p您需要准备3只
不同种类的宝可梦，\p并且让它们分别携带不同道具
才可参加对战。\p此外，蛋{STR_VAR_1}！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_NowSelectThreeMons
source: Good. Now, you must select your\nthree POKéMON.$
translation: 好的。那么请选择要参加的\n3只宝可梦。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_MustSaveBeforeChallenge2
source: I must save before I show you to\nthe BATTLE HALL. Is that okay?$
translation: 带您去对战厅之前\n需要先写入记录，可以吗？$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_FollowMe
source: Good.\nNow, follow me.$
translation: 好的。\n请随我来。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ResultsWillBeRecorded
source: I feel privileged for having seen\nyour POKéMON's exploits.\pThe results will be recorded.\nI must ask you to briefly wait.$
translation: 很荣幸能观赏到\n您的宝可梦的英姿。\p正在记录您的成绩，\n请稍候。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_FirmTrueBondsFor7WinStreak
source: To achieve a 7-win streak…\pThe bonds that bind your heart with\nyour POKéMON seem firm and true.$
translation: 您达成了7连胜......\p看来您的心灵与宝可梦之间的\n牵绊已经坚不可摧。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_FeatWillBeRecorded
source: Your feat will be recorded.\nI must ask you to briefly wait.$
translation: 正在记录您的成绩，\n请稍候。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_BattlePointsFor7WinStreak
source: For the feat of your 7-win streak,\nwe present you with Battle Point(s).$
translation: 作为7连胜的奖励，\n我们将向您呈上对战点数。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_NoSpaceForPrize
source: You seem to have no space for\nour prize.\pYou should return when you have\norganized your BAG.$
translation: 看起来您没有地方\n装我们的礼物了，\p整理好包包再\n回来这里吧。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_WeHaveBeenWaiting
source: We have been waiting for you…$
translation: 我们已经恭候多时......$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_MustSaveBeforeChallenge
source: I must save before I show you to\nthe BATTLE HALL. Is that okay?$
translation: 带您去对战厅之前\n需要先写入记录，可以吗？$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_FailedToSaveBeforeEndingChallenge
source: Sigh…\pYou failed to save before you ended\nyour challenge the last time.\pAs a result, your challenge has been\ndisqualified. It is most unfortunate.$
translation: 唉......\p您在上次结束时\n没有完好地写入记录。\p很不幸，没有写入记录的\n挑战我们将视其为无效。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ReceivedPrize
source: {PLAYER} received the prize\n{STR_VAR_1}.$
translation: {PLAYER}得到奖品\n{STR_VAR_1}。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_LadyCanTellWhatMonsThink
source:
For a hardy fellow like me,
hardy POKéMON are the best.\pOffense is the best defense!
A relentless attack is the ultimate!\pBut that's not what I wanted to chat
about.\pEvery so often a really cute lady
swings by here.\pShe says that she can tell what
POKéMON are thinking.\pI don't know about that part,
but she is really cute.\pHuh?
Why are you looking at me like that?$
translation:
对于我这样努力的人，
还是努力的宝可梦更适合我。\p攻击就是最好的防御！
不断的攻击最为重要！\p不过我想说的并不是
这些。\p我经常能看到一个可爱的
女孩在这附近玩，\p她说她能得知
宝可梦们的想法，\p那一点我不是很清楚，
不过她真的非常可爱啊。\p嗯？
你干吗用那种眼神看着我？$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_NatureAndMovesKeyHere
source:
Hmm…\pIt appears that the nature of POKéMON
and the moves that they have been\ltaught are the keys to battle here.\pTo be more precise, it's how well
the moves match the nature of\lthe POKéMON.\pIf your POKéMON is in trouble and
unable to live up to its potential,\lyou may need to examine how well\lits moves match its nature.$
translation:
唔......\p看起来宝可梦的性格
和它们所学会的招式\l是在这里对战的关键。\p准确地说，是取决于
招式与宝可梦的性格的\l契合度。\p如果你的宝可梦陷入危机，
不能依靠它自己的潜能获胜，\l你就得检查一下\l它的招式是否符合它的性格。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_MonDocileButTransforms
source: My POKéMON is usually very docile.\pBut when it's in a BATTLE HALL,\nit sometimes seems to become\ltransformed into something wicked!\pIt becomes totally intimidating.\nIt's shocking, even.$
translation:
我的宝可梦通常
比较温顺，\p但进了对战厅后，
一下子就突然变得\l非常凶猛强悍！\p那架势简直吓人！
我都震惊了！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_WhatNatureFavorsChippingAway
source: I wonder what sort of nature a POKéMON\nwould have if it favored enfeebling its\lopponents and chipping away slowly.\pI'd be surprised if it was a LAX nature.\pBut, nah, that can't be right.$
translation: 不知道一只喜欢削弱，\n然后慢慢消耗对手的宝可梦\l该算是什么性格，\p它要是乐天性格的话，\n我可真是惊了。\p但，呃，应该没可能吧。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_WelcomeForDoubleBattle
source: Where the hearts of TRAINERS\nare put to the test.\pI welcome you to the BATTLE PALACE.\pI accept challenges to the DOUBLE\nBATTLE HALLS.$
translation: 训练家的心灵\n将在此接受考验。\p欢迎来到对战宫殿。\p我在此受理双打对战厅\n的挑战申请。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_TakeDoubleBattleChallenge
source: Do you wish to take\nthe DOUBLE BATTLE HALL challenge?$
translation: 要挑战双打对战厅吗？$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ExplainDoubleBattleChallenge
source:
In the BATTLE PALACE, there are
several auditoriums for DOUBLE BATTLES\lthat are named DOUBLE BATTLE HALLS.\pThe DOUBLE BATTLES are conducted in
the usual way, except with one crucial\lrule that must be obeyed.\pTRAINERS are permitted only to switch
their POKéMON in and out.\pTRAINERS are otherwise forbidden to
command their POKéMON.\pThe POKéMON are to behave according
to their nature and battle on their own.\pYou must put your trust in your
POKéMON and watch over them.\pIf you achieve the honor of beating
seven TRAINERS in succession,\lwe will present you with Battle Points.\pIf you want to interrupt your
challenge, please save the game.\pIf you don't save before interrupting,
you will be disqualified.$
translation:
对战宫殿里有几个专门为
双打对战准备的礼堂，\l我们称之为双打对战厅。\p双打对战与普通比赛的规则一致，
但需要遵守一条关键规则--\p训练家只能替换
自己的宝可梦，\p禁止对它们下达
任何战斗指令。\p宝可梦将完全凭借自己的
本能战斗，\p您需要完全信赖您的宝可梦，
在一边旁观它们对战。\p如果您能成功地连续
打败7个训练家，\l我们将向您呈上对战点数。\p如果您在挑战途中
想要暂停的话，\p请确保在退出前完好地写下了记录。
否则我们将视挑战为无效。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ToDefeatMavenAnd7Trainers
source: To defeat the PALACE MAVEN\nand seven TRAINERS in a row…$
translation: 要连续打败宫殿守护者\n和7个训练家啊......$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_PresentYouWithBattlePoints
source: In honor of the bond you share with\nyour POKéMON, we present you with\lthese Battle Point(s).$
translation: 为了表彰您和宝可梦之间紧密的牵绊，\n我们将向您呈上对战点数。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_LikeToRecordMatch
source: Would you like to record your latest\nBATTLE PALACE match on your\lFRONTIER PASS?$
translation: 您要在您的开拓通行证上\n记录下您在对战宫殿\l最近的对战吗？$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_RulesAreListed
source: The BATTLE HALL rules are listed.$
translation: 上面列出了对战厅的规则。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ReadWhichHeading
source: Which heading do you want to read?$
translation: 要读哪一部分的说明？$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ExplainRulesBasics
source: Here, POKéMON are required to think\nand battle by themselves.\pUnlike in the wild, POKéMON that live\nwith people behave differently\ldepending on their nature.$
translation: 在这里，宝可梦需要凭借\n自己的思考来战斗。\p与野生宝可梦不同，\n和人们一同生活的宝可梦会依据它们的\l性格选择不同的战斗方式。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ExplainRulesNature
source:
Depending on its nature, a POKéMON
may prefer to attack no matter what.\pAnother POKéMON may prefer to protect
itself from any harm.\pYet another may enjoy vexing or
confounding its foes.\pDue to its nature, a POKéMON
will have favorite moves that it is good\lat using.\pIt may also dislike certain moves that
it has trouble using.$
translation:
由于性格的差别，有的宝可梦
喜欢不计后果的攻击，\p有的喜欢尽量保护自己
不受任何伤害，\p还有一些喜欢干扰
消耗它的对手。\p不同性格的宝可梦
都会有各自喜欢的\l并且擅长的招式，\p当然也会有不喜欢
并且不擅长的招式。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ExplainRulesMoves
source:
There are offensive moves that inflict
direct damage on the foe.\pThere are defensive moves that are
used to prepare for enemy attacks or\lused to heal HP and so on.\pThere are also other somewhat-odd
moves that may enfeeble the foes with\lstat problems including poison and \lparalysis.\pPOKéMON will consider using moves in
these three categories.$
translation:
招式分为3类：有直接给予对手伤害的
攻击型招式，\p有防御敌人攻击或
回复体力之类的\l防御型招式，\p还有能让对手陷入
中毒或麻痹等\l种种异常状态的\l干扰型的招式。\p宝可梦会自行决定
使用3种招式中的哪一种。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ExplainRulesUnderpowered
source:
When not under command by its TRAINER,
a POKéMON may be unable to effectively\luse certain moves.\pA POKéMON is not good at using any
move that it dislikes.\pIf a POKéMON only knows moves that
do not match its nature, it will often\lbe unable to live up to its potential.$
translation:
没有了训练家的命令，
宝可梦有可能无法\l有效使用某些招式。\p尤其会不擅长使用
自己不喜欢的招式。\p如果宝可梦只学会了
与它的性格不相符的招式，\l那么就很难凭自己的潜能获得胜利。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ExplainRulesWhenInDanger
source: Depending on its nature, a POKéMON may\nstart using moves that don't match its\lnature when it is in trouble.\pIf a POKéMON begins behaving oddly\nin a pinch, watch it carefully.$
translation: 根据性格的不同，宝可梦陷入危机时，\n它也有可能会使用并不\l符合它性格的招式。\p如果危机时宝可梦的表现\n开始变得异常，请多加注意它的表现。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeCorridor_Text_YourChallengeHasBegun
source: Your Battle Choice challenge\nhas now begun…$
translation: 您的选择式对战挑战\n现在开始了......$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeLobby_Text_WelcomeToBattlePike
source: Where the luck of TRAINERS\nis put to the test…\pWelcome to the BATTLE PIKE…\pI am your guide to the BATTLE PIKE…$
translation: 训练家的运气\n将在此接受考验......\p欢迎来到对战管道......\p我是您对战管道的向导......$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeLobby_Text_TakeChallenge
source: Would you like to take the Battle\nChoice challenge?$
translation: 要挑战对战管道吗？$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeLobby_Text_ExplainBattlePike
source:
Here we conduct an event we call
the Battle Choice.\pThe Battle Choice rules are very
simple…\pChoose one of three paths and make
your way to the goal room at the end\lof the BATTLE PIKE. It's that simple.\pHowever, what happens on the chosen
path depends entirely on the luck\lof the challenger…\pIf you reach the goal, you will be
rewarded with Battle Points.\pIf you want to interrupt your
challenge, please have a word with\lour staff in the big rooms on the way.\pIf you don't save before interrupting,
you will be disqualified.$
translation:
这里举办名为
选择式对战的比赛。\p选择式对战的规则
很简单......\p在3条道路中选择1条
抵达对战管道最后的终点房间。\l仅此而已。\p然而，在选择的道路上会
发生什么事完全取决于\l挑战者的运气......\p如果您达到了终点，
我们将向您呈上对战点数。\p如果您在挑战中想要暂停的话，
请与途中大房间中的工作人员沟通。\p如果在暂停之前没有写入记录，
我们将视挑战为无效。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeLobby_Text_LookForwardToSeeingYou
source: We look forward to seeing you\non another occasion…$
translation: 期待您再次光临......$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeLobby_Text_WhichChallengeMode
source: You have the choice of two courses,\nLevel 50 and Open Level.\lWhich will you challenge?$
translation: 您有2个选择，\nLv. 50级和自由等级。\l要挑战哪个？$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLv50
source:
I beg your pardon, but…\pYou do not have three eligible
POKéMON for the Battle Choice event.\pYou must have three different POKéMON
of Level 50 or less to enter.\pThey also must be holding different
kinds of items.\pEGGS{STR_VAR_1}.$
translation:
冒昧打扰，但......\p您能够参加对战的
宝可梦不满3只。\p您需要准备3只等级50以内的
不同种类的宝可梦，\p并且让它们分别携带不同道具
才可参加对战。\p此外，蛋{STR_VAR_1}！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsEnd
source: Please come see me when\nyou are ready…$
translation: 请在准备就绪之后，\n再来参加吧......$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLvOpen
source:
I beg your pardon, but…\pYou do not have three eligible
POKéMON for the Battle Choice event.\pYou must have three different
POKéMON to enter.\pThey also must be holding different
kinds of items.\pEGGS{STR_VAR_1}.$
translation:
冒昧打扰，但......\p您能够参加对战的
宝可梦不满3只。\p您需要准备3只
不同种类的宝可梦，\p并且让它们分别携带不同道具
才可参加对战。\p此外，蛋{STR_VAR_1}！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeLobby_Text_PleaseChooseThreeMons
source: Please choose the three POKéMON\nyou wish to enter in the challenge…$
translation: 请选择要参加挑战的\n3只宝可梦......$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeLobby_Text_SaveBeforeChallenge
source: Before starting your Battle Choice\nchallenge, I must save the game.\lIs that acceptable?$
translation: 在开始对战之前，\n需要先写入记录。\l可以吗？$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeLobby_Text_StepThisWay
source: Please step this way…$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeLobby_Text_ChallengeEndedRecordResults
source: Your challenge has ended…\pI shall record your results.\nPlease wait…$
translation: 您的挑战已结束......\p正在记录结果。\n请稍等......$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeLobby_Text_PossessLuckInAbundance
source: You have completed the challenge…\pI must say… You seem to possess luck\nin abundance…$
translation: 您完成了挑战......\p不得不说......您好像拥有\n非凡的运气......$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeLobby_Text_ShallRecordResults
source: I shall record your results.\nPlease wait…$
translation: 正在记录结果。\n请稍等......$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeLobby_Text_AwardYouTheseBattlePoints2
source: To commemorate your completion of\nthe Battle Choice challenge, we award\lyou these Battle Point(s)…$
translation: 为祝贺您完成对战管道的挑战，\n我们将向您呈上对战点数......$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeLobby_Text_ReachedBattlePointLimit
source: You appear to have reached the limit\nfor Battle Points…\pPlease exchange some Battle Points\nfor prizes, then return…$
translation: 看起来您的对战点数\n已经达到上限......\p请用对战点数\n兑换奖品后再回来......$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeLobby_Text_FailedToSaveBeforeQuitting
source: I beg your pardon, but…\pYou failed to save before you quit\nyour challenge the last time.\pBecause of that, your challenge so far\nhas been disqualified. I am sorry…$
translation: 冒昧打扰，但......\p您在上次结束时\n没有成功写入记录。\p真抱歉......没有写入记录的\n挑战我们将视其为无效。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeLobby_Text_SnatchedVictoryFromQueen
source: Congratulations…\pYou have snatched victory from the\nPIKE QUEEN and cleared the event…$
translation: 恭喜......\p您从管道皇后那获取了胜利\n并完成了挑战......$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeLobby_Text_AwardYouTheseBattlePoints
source: In recognition of your amazing luck,\nwe award you these Battle Point(s)…$
translation: 为了表彰您非凡的运气，\n我们将向您呈上对战点数......$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeLobby_Text_OneRoomAwayFromGoal
source: Arrgh! I blew my chance!\nI was one room away from the goal!\pIn this place, you'd better watch out\nfor poison, freezing, and so on.$
translation: 啊！功亏一篑！\n我离终点只差一个房间了！\p在这里，你最好留意中毒、冰冻等等\n之类的异常状态。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeLobby_Text_NeverHadToBattleTrainer
source: I've completed the challenge 10 times\nnow, but I've never had to battle\la TRAINER once.$
translation: 我已经完成了10次挑战，\n但我没有和任何一个\l训练家对战过。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeLobby_Text_ThinkAbilitiesUsefulHere
source: Listen! Listen!\pDon't you think that the special\nabilities of POKéMON will be useful\lhere?$
translation: 听着！听着！\p你难道不认为宝可梦的\n某些特性在这里\l会很有用吗？$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeLobby_Text_TrainersWhicheverPathIChoose
source: What is this weird place?\nI can't figure it out at all!\pI've taken the challenge a bunch\nof times, but all I ever do is run into\lTRAINERS whichever path I choose.$
translation: 这个怪异的地方是什么？\n我根本弄不明白！\p我已经进行挑战好多次了\n但无论我选哪个路线\l还是要遇到训练家。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeLobby_Text_RulesAreListed
source: The Battle Choice's rules are listed.$
translation: 上面列出了选择式对战的规则。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeLobby_Text_ReadWhichHeading
source: Which heading do you want to read?$
translation: 要读哪一部分的说明？$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeLobby_Text_ExplainPokenavBagRules
source: The BAG and POKéNAV may not be used\nduring a Battle Choice challenge.$
translation: 在选择式对战的挑战中\n包包和宝可导航不能使用。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeLobby_Text_ExplainHeldItemRules
source: During a Battle Choice challenge,\nany BERRY or HERB held by POKéMON\lwill be effective only once.$
translation: 在一次选择式对战的挑战中，\n宝可梦携带的任何树果或者香草\l只能生效1次。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeLobby_Text_ExplainMonOrderRules
source: During a Battle Choice challenge,\nthe sequence of POKéMON cannot be\lchanged.\pThe sequence must be set before\nstarting your challenge.$
translation: 在一次选择式对战的挑战中，\n宝可梦的顺序不能改变。\p顺序需要在您挑战之前\n就确定好。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomFinal_Text_CongratsThisWayPlease
source: Congratulations…\nNow, this way, please…$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_WillRestoreToFullHealth
source: Welcome…\nYou must be commended for your luck…\pYour POKéMON shall be restored\nto full health…$
translation: 欢迎......\n您的运气值得赞扬......\p我来帮您的宝可梦回复体力......$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_EnjoyRestOfChallenge
source: I urge you to enjoy the rest of your\nBattle Choice challenge…$
translation: 愿您享受接下来的\n选择式对战的挑战......$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_WillRestoreOneMon
source: Ah, you're a lucky one.\nI'm in somewhat-good spirits now.\pI will restore one of your POKéMON\nto full health.$
translation: 哦，您是个幸运的人。\n我现在心情还不错。\p我会帮您的1只宝可梦\n回复体力。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_BestOfLuckFarewell
source: The best of luck to you.\nFarewell.$
translation: 祝您好运。\n再见。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_CareForBattleWillRestoreMons
source: Excuse me…\pWould you care for a battle?\nI'll restore your POKéMON if you win.$
translation: 不好意思......\p要不要来场对战？\n如果你赢了就帮你治疗宝可梦。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_NowShallWe
source: Very well…\nNow, shall we?$
translation: 好......\n现在，可以吗？$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_HowUnsportingOfYou
source: I see…\nHow unsporting of you…$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_WillRestoreMonsAsPromised
source: Magnificent…\pAs promised, I shall restore your\nPOKéMON to full health.$
translation: 太漂亮了......\p就像承诺好的，\n我来让你的宝可梦恢复健康。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_BestOfLuckFarewell2

translation: 祝你好运。\n再会。$

translation: 奇鲁莉安！\n不得无礼！$

translation: 适可而止吧！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_AttacksWhenStartled
source: It attacks without warning if it is\nstartled by another person…\pAre you and your POKéMON all right?$
translation: 一旦受到了惊吓就会\n无视警告胡乱攻击......\p您和您的宝可梦还好吗？$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_ApologizeHopeMonsAreFine
source: I do apologize for what happened…\nI do hope your POKéMON are fine.$
translation: 我为所发生的一切道歉......\n我希望您的宝可梦没事。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_BattleSomewhatToughTrainer
source: Welcome…\pHere, we will have you battle\na somewhat-tough TRAINER…$
translation: 欢迎......\p在此您将会迎战一名\n颇具实力的训练家......$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_RestoreToFullHealth
source: How wonderful…\pTo honor your victory, your POKéMON\nshall be restored to full health…$
translation: 精彩绝伦......\p为了表彰您的胜利，\n我将为您的宝可梦回复体力............$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_EnjoyRestOfChallenge2
source: I urge you to enjoy the rest of your\nBattle Choice challenge…$
translation: 愿您享受接下来的\n选择式对战的挑战......$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_ImThePikeQueen
source:
I am LUCY…
I am the law here…\lFor I am the PIKE QUEEN…\pYou already know it, but to advance,
you must defeat me…\p…I'm not one for idle chatter.
Hurry. Come on…$
translation:
我叫小蓟......
我就是这里的法则......\l因为我就是管道皇后......\p你已经知道了吧，想要前进，
你必须击败我......\p......我可不是个喜欢闲聊的人。
快点，来吧......$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_HopeYouDidntUseUpLuck
source: Your luck…\nI hope you didn't use it all up here…$
translation: 你的运气......\n我希望你没有在这里把它用尽......$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_LucyShowMeFrontierPass
source: LUCY: … … … … … …\nShow me your FRONTIER PASS…$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_ReceivedLuckSymbol
source: The Luck Symbol was embossed on\nthe FRONTIER PASS!$
translation: 运气象征被印在了\n开拓通行证上！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_AllThereIsDisappear
source: …That's all there is…\nDisappear already…$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_LucyYouAgain
source:
LUCY: …You again…\p… … … … … …\p…I've trampled flowers and braved
storms to get to where I am…\pI don't feel any compulsion to keep
losing to the same opponent…\p… … … … … …
Fine… I'll do it…$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_NowComeOn
source: Now!\nCome on!$
translation: 那么！\n来吧！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_LucyFrontierPass
source: LUCY: … … … … … …\p…FRONTIER PASS…$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_LuckSymbolTookGoldenShine
source: The Luck Symbol took on\na golden shine!$
translation: 运气象征闪耀着\n金色的光芒！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_IWontForget
source: …You, I won't forget…\n…Ever…$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_ChoseRoomNoHeal
source: I welcome you…\pGiggle…\nYou seem to be bereft of luck…\pIf only you hadn't chosen this room,\nyour POKéMON could have been healed…$
translation: 欢迎您......\p咯咯......\n看来您运气不佳......\p如果您没有选择这个房间，\n您的宝可梦本可以得到回复......$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_ChoseRoomHealOne
source: I welcome you…\pSince you have chosen this room, I will\nrestore one POKéMON to full health…$
translation: 欢迎您......\p既然您选择了这个房间，\n我会帮您的1只宝可梦回复体力......$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_ChoseRoomHealTwo
source: I welcome you…\pSince you have chosen this room, I will\nrestore two POKéMON to full health…$
translation: 欢迎您......\p既然您选择了这个房间，\n我会帮您的2只宝可梦回复体力......$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_WillRestoreAllMons
source: I welcome you…\pGiggle…\nYou should thank your lucky stars…\pSince you have chosen this room,\nall your POKéMON will be restored…$
translation: 欢迎您......\p呵呵......\n您应该感谢您的幸运星......\p因为您抽中了这间房间\n您的宝可梦将会接收治疗......$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_ShallFetchOurMaster

translation: 我这就去请我们的主人......$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_WillRestoreTwoMons
source: Ah, you're a lucky one!\nI'm in good spirits now.\pI will restore two of your POKéMON\nto full health!$
translation: 哦，您是一个幸运的人！\n我现在心情不错。\p我会帮您的2只宝可梦\n回复体力。$

translation: 您现在在\n1号房间......$

source: We've been awaiting your return…\pBefore resuming your Battle Choice\nchallenge, let me save the game…$
translation: 我们已经恭候多时......\p在继续您的选择式对战\n挑战前，请让我先写入记录......$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeThreePathRoom_Text_PleaseEnjoyChallenge
source: Please do enjoy your Battle Choice\nchallenge…$
translation: 请好好享受您的选择式对战\n挑战吧......$

source: I am saving your data…\nA little time, please…$
translation: 正在写入记录......\n请稍等......$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePike_Text_PathBlockedNoTurningBack
source: The path is blocked!\nAnd there is no turning back…$
translation: 道路被阻断了！\n没有退路了......$

source: I beg your pardon, but…\pAre you perhaps finding it difficult\nto choose your path?$
translation: 冒昧打扰，但......\p您是否觉得有些难以\n选择道路？$

source: I see…\nI apologize for my impertinence…$
translation: 原来如此......\n抱歉失礼了......$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeThreePathRoom_Text_SomethingAboutRightPath
source: Ah, let me see… There is something\nabout the path on the right…$
translation: 哦，让我看看......有一些关于\n右边道路的事......$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeThreePathRoom_Text_SomethingAboutCenterPath
source: Ah, let me see… There is something\nabout the path in the center…$
translation: 哦，让我看看......有一些关于\n中间道路的事......$

translation: 哦，让我看看......有一些关于\n左边道路的事......$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeThreePathRoom_Text_AromaOfPokemon
source: It seems to have the distinct aroma\nof POKéMON wafting around it…$
translation: 似乎有宝可梦在里面的感觉......$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeThreePathRoom_Text_PresenceOfPeople
source: Is it… A TRAINER?\nI sense the presence of people…$
translation: 是......训练家吗？\n感觉到好像有人在里面......$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeThreePathRoom_Text_HeardWhispering
source: I seem to have heard something…\nIt may have been whispering…$
translation: 好像听得到轻声细语般的声音......$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeThreePathRoom_Text_WaveOfNostaliga
source: For some odd reason, I felt a wave\nof nostalgia coming from it…$
translation: 不知道为什么，\n有股熟悉的氛围......$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeThreePathRoom_Text_TerrifyingEvent
source: I am sorry to say…\pA terrifying event, yes, a horrible one,\nis about to befall you…\pI urge you to pay the utmost care\nand prepare for the worst…$
translation: 我很抱歉地说......\p一件可怕的事，没错，一件恐怖的事，\n将要降临到您头上......\p我劝您要万分小心\n做好最坏的打算。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeThreePathRoom_Text_DreadfulPresence
source: From every path I sense a dreadful\npresence…$
translation: 无论哪道门后都有一股很可怕的感觉......$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_WelcomeToBattlePyramid
source: Where the courage of TRAINERS\nis put to the test!\pWelcome to the BATTLE PYRAMID!\pI am your guide to\nthe Battle Quest.$
translation: 训练家的勇气\n将在此接受考验！\p欢迎来到\n对战金字塔！\p我是您的探索式对战向导。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_EmbarkOnChallenge

translation: 有勇气挑战探索式对战吗？$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_AwaitFutureChallenge

translation: 我们期待您未来的挑战！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_ExplainBattlePyramid
source:
The Battle Quest is a battling
event in which you must explore\lthe PYRAMID and try to reach the top.\pIn the PYRAMID are seven floors of
mazes, all of them filled with not only\lskilled TRAINERS but also wild POKéMON.\pYou must enter with three POKéMON,
none of them holding an item.\pOn your ascent, you will be provided
with a BATTLE BAG for items.\pIf you fail in your challenge, any item
placed in the BATTLE BAG disappears.\pIf you want to interrupt your
challenge, you must select “REST”\land save the game.\pIf you don't save before interrupting,
you will be disqualified.$
translation:
在探索式对战中，
您需要探索金字塔内部，\l并努力抵达顶层。\p金字塔中有7层迷宫，
每层不仅有强大的训练家，\l还有野生宝可梦。\p您需要带3只宝可梦进入，
并且它们不能携带道具。\p登顶的过程中，
您会获得一个战斗包包\l用于存放道具，\p如果挑战失败，战斗包包中的所有
道具都会消失。\p如果您在中途想要暂停的话，
请选择"休息"并写入记录，\p请确保在退出前完好地写下了记录。
否则我们将视挑战为无效。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_WhichLevelMode
source: The PYRAMID offers two courses,\nLevel 50 and Open Level.\lWhich will you enter?$
translation: 金字塔挑战有2种等级，\nLv. 50级和自由等级，\l要参加哪一种？$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_SelectThreeMons
source: Very good. Now, please select the three\nPOKéMON you wish to accompany you.$
translation: 好的，请选择要参加挑战的\n3只宝可梦。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLv50
source:
A slight problem, adventurer!\pYou seem to not have the three
POKéMON qualified for the challenge.\pThe three POKéMON must be different
and each no higher than Level 50.\pPlease also remember to take all
items from your POKéMON.\pEGGS{STR_VAR_1}.$
translation:
探险家啊，有点小问题！\p您能够参加对战的
宝可梦不满3只。\p您需要准备3只等级50以内的
不同种类的宝可梦，\p并且记得要取下它们携带的道具
才可参加对战。\p此外，蛋{STR_VAR_1}！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsEnd
source: When you are ready, please have\na word with me.$
translation: 准备就绪后，\n请告诉我一声。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_OkayToSaveBeforeChallenge
source: Before you enter the BATTLE PYRAMID,\nthe game must be saved. Is that okay?$
translation: 进入对战金字塔之前\n要先写入记录，可以吗？$

translation: 好的，现在我将带您进入\n对战金字塔。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_WeWillHoldBagForSafekeeping
source: We will hold your BAG for safekeeping,\n{PLAYER}, while you are exploring.$
translation: {PLAYER}，在探索期间，\n我们会暂时替您保管包包。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_PleaseTakePreviousBattleBag
source: In exchange, please take this BATTLE\nBAG, the one you used previously.$
translation: 作为交换，\n请带上您之前用过的这个战斗包包。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_PleaseTakeThisBattleBag
source: In exchange, please take this\nBATTLE BAG.$
translation: 作为交换，\n请带上这个战斗包包。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_ExchangedBagForBattleBag
source: {PLAYER} exchanged the BAG for\nthe BATTLE BAG.$
translation: {PLAYER}把包包换成了\n战斗包包。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_StepOnFloorPanel
source: When you step on this floor panel,\nyou will be transported to a higher\lfloor in the PYRAMID.\pI hope for your sake that your\nquest goes safely!$
translation: 每当您踩上这样的地板，\n就会被传送到金字塔更高层，\p祝您的探索一路顺风！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_DidntSaveBeforeQuittingTakeBag
source:
A major problem, explorer!\pYou did not save before ending
your challenge the last time.\pConsequently, your challenge has
been disqualified, I'm sorry to say.\pHere is the BAG we've been holding
for you.\p{PLAYER} got the BAG back.$
translation:
探险家啊，有个大问题！\p您在上次结束时
没有写入记录。\p遗憾地告诉您，没有写入记录的
挑战我们将视其为无效。\p这是您寄放在我们
这里的包包。\p{PLAYER}拿回了包包。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_YouveConqueredPyramid
source: Excellent to see you back!\pYou've conquered the PYRAMID!\nHow splendid!$
translation: 欢迎回来！\p您征服了金字塔！\n太了不起了！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_MonHoldingItemCannotTake
source: Ah, a slight problem.\pAt least one POKéMON is holding\nan item.\pI'm sorry to say, items obtained in\nthe PYRAMID cannot be taken away.$
translation: 啊，有点小问题。\p有的宝可梦\n携带了道具。\p抱歉，您不能带走金字塔中\n得到的道具。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HeldItemsMovedToBag
source: All items held by your POKéMON will be\nmoved to your BATTLE BAG, {PLAYER}.$
translation: 您的宝可梦携带的所有道具\n都会放回到战斗包包中，{PLAYER}。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_BagCannotHoldPickItemsToKeep
source: The BATTLE BAG cannot hold all your\nitems, I'm sorry to say.\pPlease pick the items you'll keep in the\nBATTLE BAG, and with your POKéMON.$
translation: 很抱歉，战斗包包装不下\n所有的道具，\p请选择您需要保留在\n战斗包包中的道具。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_LeastOneMonHoldingItem
source: At least one POKéMON is still\nholding an item.$
translation: 仍有宝可梦在\n携带着道具。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_PickItemsToKeep
source: Please pick the items you'll keep in the\nBATTLE BAG, and with your POKéMON.$
translation: 请选择您需要保留在\n战斗包包中的道具。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_ReturnedEverythingMonsHeld
source: {PLAYER} returned everything that\nthe POKéMON held.$
translation: {PLAYER}留下了宝可梦\n携带的道具。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_UsedBattleBagWillBeKept
source: The BATTLE BAG you used will be kept\nin readiness for your next challenge.\p{PLAYER} turned the BATTLE BAG over\nfor the BAG's return.$
translation: 我们会寄存您所使用的战斗包包\n以便您进行下一次挑战。\p{PLAYER}取下战斗包包，\n换回了包包。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_RecordResultsWait
source: I must record your results.\nPlease wait.$
translation: 正在记录您的成绩，\n请稍等。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_ForConqueringPyramidTakeThis
source: As a memento for conquering\nthe BATTLE PYRAMID, please take this.$
translation: 作为攻克对战金字塔\n的纪念品，请收下这个。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_ReceivedPrizeItem
source: {PLAYER} received the prize\n{STR_VAR_1}.$
translation: {PLAYER}获得了奖品\n{STR_VAR_1}。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_BagIsFull
source: …Ah…\nYour BAG appears to be filled.\pPlease return after you've organized\nyour BAG's contents.$
translation: ......啊......\n您的包包已经满了。\p请整理好包包\n以后再来。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_DisappointingHereIsBag
source: How disappointing for you…\pHere is the BAG we've been holding\nfor you.\p{PLAYER} got the BAG back.$
translation: 真遗憾......\p这是我们为您\n保管的包包。\p{PLAYER}取回了包包。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_LookForwardToNextChallenge
source: We look forward to your\nnext challenge!$
translation: 随时恭候您再次挑战！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HereIsPrize
source: We have been looking forward to\nyour arrival!\pHere is your prize for conquering\nthe PYRAMID.$
translation: 我们恭候\n您的到来！\p这是征服金字塔\n的奖品。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_TellYouWhatMisfortunesAwait
source: Welcome…\pI shall be pleased to tell you what\nmisfortunes await in the PYRAMID…$
translation: 欢迎......\p我会告诉你金字塔中\n有什么不幸在等待着......$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintParalysis
source: I see a shower of sparks…\p…And in it, I see your POKéMON\nstruggling with paralysis…$
translation: 我看到了大片的电火花......\p......你被麻痹的宝可梦\n正在其中挣扎......$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintPoison
source: I see poison…\p…And, I see your POKéMON suffering\nfrom the effects of poison…$
translation: 我看到了毒......\p......你的宝可梦\n正忍受着中毒的苦......$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintBurn
source: I see bright red flames…\p…And, I see your POKéMON suffering\nfrom burns…$
translation: 我看到了闪亮的火焰......\p......你的宝可梦\n正在被烧灼着......$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintPPWaste
source: I sense the tremendous pressure of\nunrequited anger…\pIt is a curse…\p…And, I see your POKéMON drained of\nPower Points and having no recourse\lbut to use STRUGGLE…$
translation: 我感受到了无尽的怒火\n产生出的庞大的压力......\p是诅咒......\p......你的宝可梦没有了\n招式点数，\l只有无助地挣扎......$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintLevitate
source: I see POKéMON loftily airborne…\p…And, I see your POKéMON frustrated\nby powerless GROUND-type moves…$
translation: 我看到了天空中翱翔的宝可梦......\p......你擅长地面属性招式的\n宝可梦被完全挫败......$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintTrapAbility
source: I sense terrific energy rising from\nthe ground below…\p…And, I see your POKéMON unable to\nescape the power's clutches…$
translation: 我感觉到地底升起\n恐怖的力量......\p......你的宝可梦根本\n无法摆脱这力量的威胁......$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintIce
source: I see ICE-type POKéMON…\p…And, I see your POKéMON fighting\nthe freezing effects of ice…$
translation: 我看到了冰属性的宝可梦......\p......你的宝可梦正在\n坚冰中与寒冷对抗着......$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintExplosion
source: I see a flurry of moves that imperil\nthe user…\p…And, I see your POKéMON falling\nto them…$
translation: 我看到了很多会使自己\n受伤的招式......\p......你的宝可梦\n正败在此处......$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintPsychic
source: I see PSYCHIC-type POKéMON…\p…And, I see your POKéMON in torment\nfrom PSYCHIC moves…$
translation: 我看到了超能力属性的宝可梦......\p......你的宝可梦正在被\n超能力招式折磨着......$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintRock
source: I see ROCK-type POKéMON…\p…And, I see your POKéMON suffering\nfrom ROCK moves…$
translation: 我看到了岩石属性的宝可梦......\p......你的宝可梦正在\n遭受岩石招式的打击......$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintFighting
source: I see FIGHTING-type POKéMON…\p…And, I see your POKéMON pummeled\nby FIGHTING moves…$
translation: 我看到了格斗属性的宝可梦......\p......你的宝可梦正在\n被格斗招式不断攻击......$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintWeather
source:
RAIN DANCE… SUNNY DAY…
SANDSTORM… HAIL…\pI see POKéMON that become stronger
with the weather…\p…And, I see your POKéMON confounded
by different types of moves…$
translation:
求雨......大晴天......
沙暴......冰雹......\p我看到了在这些天气下
变得更强的宝可梦......\p......你的宝可梦正在各种各样的
招式影响下不知所措......$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintBug
source: I see BUG-type POKéMON…\p…And, I see your POKéMON suffering\nfrom different kinds of attacks…$
translation: 我看到了虫属性的宝可梦......\p......你的宝可梦正在\n忍受各种各样的攻击......$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintDark
source: I see DARK-type POKéMON…\p…And, I see your POKéMON suffering\nfrom DARK-type moves…$
translation: 我看到了恶属性的宝可梦......\p......你的宝可梦正在被\n恶属性招式攻击着......$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintWater
source: I see WATER-type POKéMON…\p…And, I see your POKéMON suffering\nfrom WATER-type moves…$
translation: 我看到了水属性的宝可梦......\p......你的宝可梦正在被\n水属性招式攻击着......$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintGhost
source: I see GHOST-type POKéMON…\p…And, I see your POKéMON suffering\nfrom GHOST-type moves…$
translation: 我看到了幽灵属性的宝可梦......\p......你的宝可梦正在被\n幽灵属性招式攻击着......$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintSteel
source: I see STEEL-type POKéMON…\p…And, I see your POKéMON suffering\nfrom enormously powerful moves…$
translation: 我看到了钢属性的宝可梦......\p......你的宝可梦正在苦苦\n抵挡着强力的攻击......$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintFlyingDragon
source: I see flying POKéMON…\p…And, I see your POKéMON suffering\nfrom enormously powerful moves…$
translation: 我看到了飞在天上的宝可梦......\p......你的宝可梦正在被\n强力的招式攻击着......$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintStoneEvolve
source:
I see those that have evolved from
the power of stones…\pI also sense fire, water,
and electricity…\p…And, I see your POKéMON suffering
from those three powers…$
translation:
我看到了得到石头的力量
而得以进化的宝可梦们......\p我感受到了火、水
还有电......\p......你的宝可梦正在忍受
这3种力量的攻击......$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintNormal
source: I see NORMAL-type POKéMON…\p…And, I see your POKéMON suffering\nfrom enormously powerful moves…$
translation: 我看到了一般属性的宝可梦......\p......你的宝可梦正在苦苦\n抵挡着强力的攻击......$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_BelieveMyFortunesOrNot
source: Whether you believe my fortunes\nor not, the choice is yours…\pThe future can be changed anytime…\nI wish you safe passage…$
translation: 无论是否相信我的预言，\n选择权依然在你的手中......\p未来随时都可能被改变......\n愿你能平安通过这里......$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_TrainersNoticeRunning
source: Did you know?\pIf you run fast, TRAINERS may notice\nand come after you for a battle.\pSo, if you want to avoid TRAINERS,\ndon't catch their eyes, but sneak\lcautiously and quietly past them.$
translation: 知道吗？\p如果你跑得太快，训练家就会\n注意到你，然后追上来向你挑战。\p所以要躲过训练家的话，\n不要让他们看到你，\l要偷偷摸摸地绕过他们。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_LostLotOfItems
source: Awaaaaaaarrrrgh!\pI had a whole lot of items, but I lost\nthem all when I lost!\pAwaaaaaaarrrrgh!$
translation: 哇啊啊啊啊啊啊！\p我已经攒了那么多道具，却一不小心\n失败了，现在道具全没了！\p哇啊啊啊啊啊啊！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_YouveDefeatedPyramidKing
source: Welcome back!\nYou've done the unthinkable!\pYou've defeated the PYRAMID KING\nand conquered the BATTLE PYRAMID!$
translation: 欢迎回来！\n您完成了不可思议的壮举！\p您打败了金字塔法老，\n并征服了对战金字塔！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_GiveYouTheseBattlePoints
source: Young explorer!\nIn commendation of your courage,\lwe give you these Battle Point(s)!$
translation: 年轻的探险家啊！\n为了表彰您的勇气，\l我们将向您呈上对战点数！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_RulesAreListed
source: The Battle Quest rules are listed.$
translation: 上面列出了探索式对战的规则。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_ReadWhichHeading
source: Which heading do you want to read?$
translation: 要读哪一部分的说明？$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_ExplainMonRules
source: When the PYRAMID is conquered,\nthe wild POKéMON that appear in it\lare replaced by different kinds.\pExplore, observe, and learn what kinds\nof wild POKéMON you may encounter.$
translation: 当征服金字塔后，\n里面的野生宝可梦会\l替换成其他的种类，\p仔细探索，仔细观察，尽量去了解\n您可能遇到什么样的宝可梦。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_ExplainTrainerRules
source:
TRAINERS are lying in wait for you
inside the PYRAMID.\pOn each floor, there are up to
eight TRAINERS.\pWhen you defeat a TRAINER, you will
get a helpful hint for your adventure.$
translation:
在金字塔内会有训练家
等着向您挑战。\p每层最多会有
8个训练家。\p您每打败1个训练家，就会得到1条
对探索有用的提示。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_ExplainMazeRules
source:
The mazes in the PYRAMID rearrange
themselves every time you enter it.\pThe mazes are poorly lit.
You must advance with caution.\pThe light grows brighter whenever you
defeat a wild POKéMON or a TRAINER.$
translation:
每次进入金字塔后迷宫
都会重新组合，\p迷宫里很暗，
必须小心探索。\p每打败1个训练家或是1只野生宝可梦，
里面都会稍微变亮一些。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_ExplainBagRules
source:
The BATTLE BAG serves as your BAG
while in the PYRAMID.\pThere are two separate BATTLE BAGS--
one each for the Level 50 and\lOpen Level adventures.\pThey each can hold up to 99 pieces
of ten kinds of items.\pThe contents of the BATTLE BAG are
lost if you fail in your quest.$
translation:
在金字塔中，您可以像使用
您的包包一样使用战斗包包。\p有2种不同的战斗包包--
分别是为Lv. 50级和\l自由等级的冒险而准备的。\p2种包包都可以携带10种道具，
每种道具99个。\p如果在探索中失败的话，
战斗包包里的东西都会丢失。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidTop_Text_ReachedSummitUpYouGo
source:
It is a delight to see you here!
You have reached the summit of\lthe BATTLE PYRAMID!\pAbove here is the PYRAMID's
lookout point.\pIt is a place open only to those
who have conquered the PYRAMID.\pNow, please!
Up you go!$
translation:
很荣幸能在这里见到你！
你已经来到了对战金字塔\l最顶层。\p这就是金字塔的
观景台。\p这个地方只为征服了
金字塔的人开放。\p来吧！
继续向前吧！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidTop_Text_PlayerConqueredPyramid
source: The PYRAMID's new conqueror!\nLet the name {PLAYER} be known!$
translation: 金字塔的新任征服者。\n让众人铭记{PLAYER}这个名字吧！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidTop_Text_ChiefBeatYouHere
source:
It is a delight to see you here!\pUnfortunately, you were second by
a mere fraction of time!\pOur chief has already conquered
the PYRAMID ahead of you.\pHowever, my young explorer…
You are a TRAINER!\pAssert your power and take the glory
of the pinnacle from our chief!\pNow, please! When you are ready,
take one more step of courage!$
translation:
很荣幸能在这里见到你！\p很可惜，
你以分毫之差屈居第二抵达这里。\p我们的首领已经率先
征服了金字塔。\p不过，年轻的探险家，
你是一位训练家！\p用实力从首领手中夺取巅峰的荣耀吧！\p当你准备好时，
请再度迈出这勇敢的一步！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidTop_Text_ExplorationsAreGrandestAdventure
source: Young adventurer…\pWouldn't you agree that explorations\nare the grandest of adventures?\pYour own wits!\pYour own strength!\pYour own POKéMON!\pAnd, above all, only your own courage\nto lead you through unknown worlds…$
translation: 年轻的冒险家......\p你不觉得探索才是最为\n伟大的冒险吗？\p凭借你的智慧！\p你的实力！\p你的宝可梦！\p还有最重要的，你的勇气！\n唯有它将指引你走遍未知的世界......$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidTop_Text_ImPyramidKingBrandon
source:
Aah, yes, indeed this life is grand!
Grand, it is! Eh?\pI'm BRANDON!\pI'm the PYRAMID KING, which means
I'm in charge here.\pMost people call me the chief!\pYou coming here means you have
that much confidence in yourself,\lam I right?\pHahahah!
This should be exciting!$
translation:
嗯，生命何等壮阔！
壮阔至极！\p我是神代！\p身为金字塔法老，
这里由我掌管。\p人们都称我为首领！\p你能来到这里，
说明了你对自己充满信心，\l我说得对吗？\p哈哈哈！
这必将是一场精彩对决！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidTop_Text_BringCourageToOurBattle
source: Now, then!\nBring your courage to our battle!$
translation: 现在！\n带着你的勇气来战斗吧！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidTop_Text_BrandonFrontierPassPlease
source: BRANDON: Hahahah! Grand it was!\nGrand, yes, indeed!\pWell done! You've earned recognition!\nYour FRONTIER PASS, please!$
translation: 神代：哈哈哈！壮阔！\n何等壮阔！\p做得好！这是属于你的荣耀！\n拿出你的开拓通行证吧！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidTop_Text_ReceivedBraveSymbol
source: The Brave Symbol was embossed on\nthe FRONTIER PASS!$
translation: 英勇象征被印在了\n开拓通行证上！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidTop_Text_LookForwardToNextMeeting
source: Young explorer!\nI look forward to our next meeting!$
translation: 年轻的探险家！\n期待我们的下一次再会！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidTop_Text_BrandonYouveReturned
source:
BRANDON: …You've finally returned,
young explorer…\pYour love of adventure seems to come
deep from within your heart…\pYes… You are exactly as I was in
my own youth…\p… … …Ah…\pThe passionate!\pThe dangerous!\pThe desperate!\pThose days of death-defying,
life-affirming adventures are back…$
translation:
神代：......你终于回来了，
年轻的探险家......\p你对冒险的热情似乎源于
你的内心深处......\p对......你简直就像是
年轻时期的我自己......\p......啊......\p激情！\p危机！\p绝境！\p那些在生死边缘探寻生命意义的
日子又在此重现了......$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidTop_Text_MyCourageIsOffMeter
source: Now, then!\pI sense my own courage is off\nthe meter!$
translation: 现在！\p我已感受到澎湃的勇气\n即将满溢！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidTop_Text_EverythingYouHave
source: Everything you have!\nI'm braced for it all!$
translation: 倾尽你的一切吧！\n我已做好万全准备！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidTop_Text_BrandonRemarkableHaveThis
source: BRANDON: Hahahah!\nRemarkable!\lYes, it's grand, indeed!\pYoung explorer!\pYou've bested me through and through!\nHere! I want you to have this!$
translation: 神代：哈哈哈！\n精彩绝伦！\l壮阔至极！\p年轻的探险家！\p你完全超越了我！\n来！我希望你收下这个！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidTop_Text_BraveSymbolTookGoldenShine
source: The Brave Symbol took on\na golden shine!$
translation: 英勇象征闪耀着\n金色的光芒！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidTop_Text_FarewellForNow
source: Ah, yes! It just goes to show that\nI have much to learn still!\pMay our paths cross again!\nFarewell for now, young explorer!$
translation: 啊，没错！\n看来我要学的东西还有很多！\p愿我们再次相逢！\n让我们暂别吧，年轻的探险家！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidTop_Text_StepForwardWhenReady
source: Now, when you are ready, take courage\nand step forward.$
translation: 当你准备好时，\n请带着勇气向前迈进吧！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerBattleRoom_Text_RestoreMonsToFullHealth
source: We will restore your POKéMON to\nfull health.$
translation: 我来帮您的宝可梦\n回复体力。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerBattleRoom_Text_ReadyForOpponent
source: You will be facing opponent no. {STR_VAR_1}.\nAre you ready?$
translation: 接下来是第{STR_VAR_1}位对手，\n准备好了吗？$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerBattleRoom_Text_ReadyFor2ndOpponent
source: You will be facing opponent no. 2.\nAre you ready?$
translation: 接下来是第2位对手，\n准备好了吗？$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerBattleRoom_Text_ReadyFor3rdOpponent
source: You will be facing opponent no. 3.\nAre you ready?$
translation: 接下来是第3位对手，\n准备好了吗？$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerBattleRoom_Text_ReadyFor4thOpponent
source: You will be facing opponent no. 4.\nAre you ready?$
translation: 接下来是第4位对手，\n准备好了吗？$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerBattleRoom_Text_ReadyFor5thOpponent
source: You will be facing opponent no. 5.\nAre you ready?$
translation: 接下来是第5位对手，\n准备好了吗？$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerBattleRoom_Text_ReadyFor6thOpponent
source: You will be facing opponent no. 6.\nAre you ready?$
translation: 接下来是第6位对手，\n准备好了吗？$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerBattleRoom_Text_ReadyFor7thOpponent
source: You will be facing opponent no. 7.\nAre you ready?$
translation: 接下来是第7位对手，\n准备好了吗？$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerBattleRoom_Text_RecordYourBattle
source: Record your battle on your\nFRONTIER PASS?$
translation: 要将您的对战记录到\n开拓通行证上吗？$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_BattleRecordedOnPass
source: {PLAYER}'s battle was recorded\non the FRONTIER PASS.$
translation: {PLAYER}的对战已被记录到\n开拓通行证上。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerBattleRoom_Text_SaveAndQuitGame
source: Would you like to save and\nquit the game?$
translation: 要写入记录\n并且暂停吗？$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerBattleRoom_Text_SavingPleaseWait
source: Saving your battle data.\nPlease wait.$
translation: 正在写入记录......\n请稍等。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerBattleRoom_Text_CancelYourChallenge
source: Would you like to cancel your BATTLE\nROOM challenge?$
translation: 要结束对战间的挑战吗？$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerBattleRoom_Text_RecordCouldntBeSaved
source: There was an error of some sort.\nYour record could not be saved.$
translation: 发生了某些错误，\n记录无法保存。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerBattleRoom_Text_SalonMaidenOnHerWay
source: Excuse me, but…\pOur leader, the SALON MAIDEN, is on\nher way here in hopes of battling you.\pShe should be arriving very shortly.$
translation: 打扰了......\p我们的领袖，对战塔大君，\n正为与您对战而亲自前来。\p她应该很快便会抵达。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerBattleRoom_Text_ReadyForSalonMaiden
source: You will be facing the SALON MAIDEN.\nAre you prepared?$
translation: 对战塔大君在等着您，\n准备好了吗？$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerBattleRoom_Text_GreetingsImAnabel
source:
Greetings…
My name is ANABEL.\pI am the SALON MAIDEN, and I am in
charge of running the BATTLE TOWER…\pI have heard several rumors
about you…\pIn all honesty, what I have heard does
not seem attractive in any way…\pThe reason I've come to see you…
Well, there is but one reason…$
translation:
你好......
我的名字叫莉拉，\p人称对战塔大君，
也是这个对战塔的管理者......\p我听说过关于
你的传言......\p坦率而言，
这些传言并不吸引人......\p我来找你的原因......
有且只有一个......$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerBattleRoom_Text_LetMeSeeYourTalent
source: Let me see your talent in\nits entirety…$
translation: 让我见识你的\n全部才能吧......$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerBattleRoom_Text_AnabelTalentShallBeRecognized
source: ANABEL: Fufufu, nicely done…\pYour FRONTIER PASS, please…\nYour talent shall be recognized.$
translation: 莉拉：呵呵呵，干得好......\p拿来你的开拓通行证吧......\n我认可你的才能了。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerBattleRoom_Text_ReceivedAbilitySymbol
source: The Ability Symbol was embossed on\nthe FRONTIER PASS!$
translation: 能力象征被印在了\n开拓通行证上！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerBattleRoom_Text_UntilNextTime
source:
… … … … … …\pYou have confidence in your POKéMON
battling talent, don't you?\pI urge you to keep battling and
keep on winning.\pI will be waiting for you.
Until the next time we meet…$
translation:
...... ...... ......\p你对自己在宝可梦对战方面的
才能充满自信，对吗？\p那就继续战斗，
继续取胜吧。\p我在这里等着你，
等着下一次见面......$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerBattleRoom_Text_AnabelYouCameBack
source:
ANABEL: You really did come back to
see me…\p… … … … … …\pYou've won straight matches to see me…
I won't have to hold back against you…\pIt's been too long now…\pToo long since I've been able to battle
without thinking about anything…$
translation:
莉拉：你果然回来
见我了......\p...... ...... ......\p不断连续取得胜利来到我面前......
与你对战我不必手下留情......\p已经太久了......\p太久不曾有人能让我
心无旁骛地对战了......$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerBattleRoom_Text_LetsBeginShallWe
source: Let's begin, shall we?$
translation: 让我们开始吧？$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerBattleRoom_Text_AnabelCongratsYourPassPlease
source: ANABEL: Fufu, congratulations…\nYour FRONTIER PASS, please…$
translation: 莉拉：呵呵，恭喜你......\n你的开拓通行证......$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerBattleRoom_Text_AbilitySymbolTookGoldenShine
source: The Ability Symbol took on\na golden shine!$
translation: 能力象征闪耀着\n金色的光芒！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerBattleRoom_Text_WishICouldBattleYouAgain
source: That was fun…\pI have never had a POKéMON battle\nso enjoyable before…\pI wish I could battle with you again…$
translation: 真是令人愉悦啊......\p以前从来没有\n这么酣畅淋漓地对战过......\p希望以后还能和你对战......$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_DirectYouToBattleRoom
source: I'll direct you to your BATTLE ROOM now.$
translation: 我将带您到对战间。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_DidntSaveBeforeQuitting
source: Excuse me!\pYou didn't save before you quit your\nchallenge last time.\pBecause of that, your challenge so far\nhas been disqualified. Sorry!$
translation: 抱歉！\p您在上次结束时\n没有写入记录。\p非常遗憾，没有写入记录的\n挑战我们将视其为无效。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_CongratsBeatenSeven
source: Congratulations!\nYou've beaten all seven TRAINERS!\p$
translation: 恭喜您！\n您已击败全部7位训练家！\p$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_EarnedFabulousPrize
source: For beating seven TRAINERS in a row,\nyou have earned this fabulous prize!\p$
translation: 作为连续击败7位训练家的奖励，\n您将获得精美的奖品！\p$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_ReceivedPrize
source: {PLAYER} received the prize\n{STR_VAR_1}.$
translation: {PLAYER}得到奖品\n{STR_VAR_1}。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_BagFullMakeRoom
source: Oh, your BAG appears to be full.\pPlease make room in your BAG, then come\nsee me.$
translation: 啊，您的包包已经满了。\p请将包包整理好之后\n再来找我。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_ThankYouForPlaying
source: Thank you for playing!\p$
translation: 辛苦了！\p$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_RecordWillBeSaved
source: Your record will be saved.\nPlease wait.$
translation: 正在写入记录，\n请稍等。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_WeveBeenWaitingForYou
source: We've been waiting for you!\p$
translation: 我们已经恭候多时了！\p$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_ProgressWillBeSaved
source: Before entering a BATTLE ROOM, your\nprogress will be saved. Please wait.$
translation: 进入对战间之前需要\n写入记录，请稍等。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_AboutToFace50thTrainer
source: You're finally about to face the\n50th TRAINER.\pFrom here on, every time you beat seven\nTRAINERS in a row, your POKéMON will\lreceive a commemorative RIBBON.\pGood luck!$
translation: 下面您即将迎战的是\n第50位训练家了，\p现在起，您每次连续打败7位训练家，\n我们将会把奖章送给您参战的宝可梦。\p祝您好运！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_HereAreSomeRibbons
source: Here are some RIBBONS for beating\nseven tough TRAINERS in a row.\p{PLAYER} received some RIBBONS!$
translation: 这是连续打败7位\n强大的训练家的奖励。\p{PLAYER}得到奖章！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_PutRibbonOnMons
source: {PLAYER} put the RIBBONS on\nthe challenger POKéMON.$
translation: {PLAYER}给挑战的宝可梦\n戴上了奖章。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_DescribeFeelingsAboutBattleTower
source: Excuse me, do you have a moment?\pCan you describe your feelings when\nyou're about to begin a BATTLE TOWER\lmatch, or when you've either won or\llost a match?$
translation: 打扰了，\n能占用你一点时间吗？\p请说说你在对战塔比赛开始之前的\n想法，也可以谈谈赢了或输了比赛\l之后的感受。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_FeelWhatWhenYouBegin
source: Okay, what are your feelings when\nyou're about to begin a match?$
translation: 那么，你在比赛之前\n有什么想法呢？$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_FeelWhatWhenYouveWon
source: What do you feel when you've won\na match?$
translation: 那么，你在赢了比赛之后\n有什么感受呢？$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_FeelWhatWhenYouveLost
source: Can I hear about your feelings when\nyou have lost a match?$
translation: 能告诉我们输了比赛\n你有什么话想说吗？$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_DontThinkMuchAboutIt
source: Oh, so you don't think much about it?\nYou're one cool customer.$
translation: 啊，那么说你并不会多想吗？\n看来是个沉着的人啊。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_ChangedYourMind
source: Hunh? You changed your mind?\nI guess you're fickle.$
translation: 哎？你改主意了吗？\n看来你是个易变的人啊。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_ThatsHowYouFeel
source: Okay, so that's how you feel?\nThat's quite original.\pThanks!$
translation: 嗯，你是这么想的吗？\n很有新意啊。\p谢谢！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_WinsInRowRecorded
source: The number of matches you win in a row\nis recorded.\pI'd better not get beaten in\nan embarrassing way!$
translation: 连胜的次数都会\n被记录下来。\p我可不想输得太难堪啊！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_CanLeaveUntilLossOrSevenWins
source: Once you've entered the BATTLE TOWER,\nyou can't leave until you either lose\lor you beat seven TRAINERS in a row.\pYou'd best be certain that you're up\nto the challenge.$
translation: 进入对战塔后，只有被打败或者\n连续战胜7位训练家才能离开。\p开始挑战之前你最好\n做好充分的准备。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_DoubleBattleRoomConstruction
source:
Welcome to the BATTLE TOWER
DOUBLE BATTLE CORNER!\pUnfortunately, the BATTLE ROOMS
are still under construction.\pPlease come back when the work
is completed.$
translation:
欢迎来到对战塔
双打对战区！\p很不幸，
对战间还在建设之中。\p当建筑完成后
再来吧。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_MultiBattleRoomConstruction
source:
Welcome to the BATTLE TOWER
MULTI BATTLE CORNER!\pUnfortunately, the BATTLE ROOMS
are still under construction.\pPlease come back when the work
is completed.$
translation:
欢迎来到对战塔
多人对战区！\p很不幸，
对战间还在建设之中。\p当建筑完成后
再来吧。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_LookForwardToAnotherChallenge
source: We look forward to seeing you on\nanother challenge!$
translation: 随时恭候您再次挑战！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_WhichLevelMode
source: The BATTLE ROOM offers two levels\nof challenge, Level 50 and Open Level.\lWhich is your choice?$
translation: 对战间有2种挑战等级，\nLv. 50级和自由等级。\l您想选哪种？$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_PleaseSelectMons
source: Please select the POKéMON you wish\nto enter.$
translation: 请选择要参加的\n宝可梦。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_OkayToSaveBeforeEntering
source: Before entering a BATTLE ROOM, your\nprogress must be saved. Is that okay?$
translation: 进入对战间之前需要\n先写入记录，可以吗？$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_ShowYouToBattleRoom
source: I will now show you to the\n{STR_VAR_1} BATTLE ROOM.$
translation: 现在我将带您前往\n{STR_VAR_1}对战间。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_RecordLastMatch
source: Shall I record your last BATTLE TOWER\nmatch on your FRONTIER PASS?$
translation: 要将您在对战塔的最后一场对战\n记录到开拓通行证上吗？$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLv50
source: Excuse me!\pYou don't have {STR_VAR_2} eligible POKéMON.\pYou must have {STR_VAR_2} different POKéMON\nof Level 50 or less to enter.\pThey also must be holding different\nkinds of items.\pEGGS{STR_VAR_1}.$
translation: 这位客人！\p您符合条件的宝可梦不足{STR_VAR_2}只。\p需要有{STR_VAR_2}只不同的等级50以内的\n宝可梦才可以参加比赛，\p同时这些宝可梦携带的道具\n也需要各不相同。\p蛋{STR_VAR_1}。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsEnd
source: Please come see me when you are ready.$
translation: 准备好之后再来吧。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLvOpen
source: Excuse me!\pYou don't have {STR_VAR_2} eligible POKéMON.\pYou must have {STR_VAR_2} different POKéMON\nto enter.\pThey also must be holding different\nkinds of items.\pEGGS{STR_VAR_1}.$
translation: 这位客人！\p您符合条件的宝可梦不足{STR_VAR_2}只。\p需要有{STR_VAR_2}只不同的宝可梦\n才可以参加比赛，\p同时这些宝可梦携带的道具\n也需要各不相同。\p蛋{STR_VAR_1}。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLv50Singles
source: Excuse me!\pYou don't have three eligible POKéMON.\pYou must have three different POKéMON\nof Level 50 or less to enter.\pThey also must be holding different\nkinds of items.\pEGGS{STR_VAR_1}.$
translation:
这位客人！\p您能够参加对战的
宝可梦不满3只。\p您需要准备3只等级50以内的
不同种类的宝可梦，\p且让它们分别携带不同道具
才可参加对战。\p此外，蛋{STR_VAR_1}。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLvOpenSingles
source: Excuse me!\pYou don't have three eligible POKéMON.\pYou must have three different POKéMON\nto enter.\pThey also must be holding different\nkinds of items.\pEGGS{STR_VAR_1}.$
translation:
这位客人！\p您能够参加对战的
宝可梦不满3只。\p您需要准备3只
不同种类的宝可梦，\p且让它们分别携带不同道具
才可参加对战。\p此外，蛋{STR_VAR_1}。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLv50Doubles
source: Excuse me!\pYou don't have four eligible POKéMON.\pYou must have four different POKéMON\nof Level 50 or less to enter.\pThey also must be holding different\nkinds of items.\pEGGS{STR_VAR_1}.$
translation:
这位客人！\p您能够参加对战的
宝可梦不满4只。\p您需要准备4只等级50以内的
不同种类的宝可梦，\p且让它们分别携带不同道具
才可参加对战。\p此外，蛋{STR_VAR_1}。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLvOpenDoubles
source: Excuse me!\pYou don't have four eligible POKéMON.\pYou must have four different POKéMON\nto enter.\pThey also must be holding different\nkinds of items.\pEGGS{STR_VAR_1}.$
translation:
这位客人！\p您能够参加对战的
宝可梦不满4只。\p您需要准备4只
不同种类的宝可梦，\p且让它们分别携带不同道具
才可参加对战。\p此外，蛋{STR_VAR_1}。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLv50Multis
source: Excuse me!\pYou don't have two eligible POKéMON.\pYou must have two different POKéMON\nof Level 50 or less to enter.\pThey also must be holding different\nkinds of items.\pEGGS{STR_VAR_1}.$
translation:
这位客人！\p您能够参加对战的
宝可梦不满2只。\p您需要准备2只等级50以内的
不同种类的宝可梦，\p且让它们分别携带不同道具
才可参加对战。\p此外，蛋{STR_VAR_1}。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLvOpenMultis
source: Excuse me!\pYou don't have two eligible POKéMON.\pYou must have two different POKéMON\nto enter.\pThey also must be holding different\nkinds of items.\pEGGS{STR_VAR_1}.$
translation:
这位客人！\p您能够参加对战的
宝可梦不满2只。\p您需要准备2只
不同种类的宝可梦，\p且让它们分别携带不同道具
才可参加对战。\p此外，蛋{STR_VAR_1}。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_WelcomSingleBattle
source: Where the talents of TRAINERS\nare put to the test!\pWelcome to the BATTLE TOWER!\pI am your guide to the SINGLE\nBATTLE ROOMS.$
translation: 训练家的才能\n将在此接受考验！\p欢迎来到对战塔！\p我是您的单打对战间向导。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_TakeSinglesChallenge
source: Would you like to take the SINGLE\nBATTLE ROOM challenge?$
translation: 要挑战单打对战间吗？$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_ExplainSinglesChallenge
source:
The BATTLE TOWER's SINGLE BATTLE
ROOMS are facilities for conducting\lSINGLE BATTLES with three POKéMON.\pThere are many SINGLE BATTLE ROOMS
in the BATTLE TOWER for team battles.\pIn each of the SINGLE BATTLE ROOMS,
seven TRAINERS await your challenge.\pIf you manage to defeat all seven,
you will earn Battle Points.\pIf you want to interrupt your
challenge, please save the game.\pIf you don't save before interrupting,
you will be disqualified.$
translation:
对战塔的单打对战间
是用3只宝可梦进行单打对战的设施，\p对战塔内有很多单打对战间，
供团队对战使用。\p在单打对战间中，
会有7位训练家等待挑战，\p如果顺利战胜7人，
我们会向您呈上对战点数。\p如果您在挑战途中
想要暂停的话，\p请确保在暂停前完好地写下了记录。
否则我们将视挑战为无效。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_SelectThreeMons
source: Now please select the three POKéMON\nthat are to be entered.$
translation: 请选择要参加挑战的\n3只宝可梦。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_WelcomeDoubleBattle
source: Where the talents of TRAINERS\nare put to the test!\pWelcome to the BATTLE TOWER!\pI am your guide to the DOUBLE\nBATTLE ROOMS.$
translation: 训练家的才能\n将在此接受考验！\p欢迎来到对战塔！\p我是您的双打对战间向导。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_TakeDoublesChallenge
source: Would you like to take the DOUBLE\nBATTLE ROOM challenge?$
translation: 要挑战双打对战间吗？$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_ExplainDoublesChallenge
source:
The BATTLE TOWER's DOUBLE BATTLE
ROOMS are facilities for conducting\lDOUBLE BATTLES with four POKéMON.\pThere are many DOUBLE BATTLE ROOMS
in the BATTLE TOWER for team battles.\pIn each of the DOUBLE BATTLE ROOMS,
seven TRAINERS await your challenge.\pIf you manage to defeat all seven,
you will earn Battle Points.\pIf you want to interrupt your
challenge, please save the game.\pIf you don't save before interrupting,
you will be disqualified.$
translation:

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_WelcomeMultiBattle
source: Where the talents of TRAINERS\nare put to the test!\pWelcome to the BATTLE TOWER!\pI am your guide to the MULTI\nBATTLE ROOMS.$
translation: 训练家的才能\n将在此接受考验！\p欢迎来到对战塔！\p我是您的多人对战间向导。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_TakeMultisChallenge
source: Would you like to take the MULTI\nBATTLE ROOM challenge?$
translation: 要挑战多人对战间吗？$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_ExplainMultisChallenge
source:
The BATTLE TOWER's MULTI BATTLE
ROOMS are facilities for conducting\lMULTI BATTLES.\pFor MULTI BATTLES, you must partner
with a TRAINER in the TOWER and enter\lwith two POKéMON each.\pInside the TOWER is a room named
the BATTLE SALON where you may meet\lother TRAINERS.\pThere, you must find a TRAINER to act
as your partner in MULTI BATTLES.\pOnce you have partnered up, you will
be shown to a MULTI BATTLE ROOM.\pIn the MULTI BATTLE ROOM, seven
tag teams await your challenge.\pIf you manage to defeat all seven
teams, you will earn Battle Points.\pIf you want to interrupt your
challenge, please save the game.\pIf you don't save before interrupting,
you will be disqualified.$
translation:
对战塔的多人对战间
是进行多人对战的设施。\p要参加多人对战，您需要在塔内
选择1位训练家作为搭档，\l每人派出2只宝可梦进行比赛。\p塔内有个叫对战沙龙的房间，
可以在那里遇到其他训练家。\p在那里，你需要选择1位训练家
作为多人对战的搭档。\p组队成功后，
将被引导至多人对战间。\p在多人对战间中，
会有7组训练家等待挑战，\p如果顺利战胜7组，
我们会向您呈上对战点数。\p如果您在挑战途中
想要暂停的话，\p请确保在暂停前完好地写下了记录。
否则我们将视挑战为无效。$

source: Where the talents of TRAINERS\nare put to the test!\pWelcome to the BATTLE TOWER!\pI am your guide to the LINK MULTI\nBATTLE ROOMS.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_TakeLinkMultisChallenge

translation: 要挑战多人连线对战间吗？$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_ExplainLinkMultisChallenge
source:
The BATTLE TOWER's MULTI BATTLE
ROOMS are facilities for conducting\lMULTI BATTLES with a friend.\pYou must link with your friend using
Wireless Adapters or a Game Boy\lAdvance Game Link cable.\pYou must partner with your friend and
enter two different kinds of POKéMON.\pThere are many MULTI BATTLE ROOMS
in the BATTLE TOWER for team battles.\pIn a MULTI BATTLE ROOM, seven
tag teams await you and your friend\lto make a tag-team challenge.\pIf you manage to defeat all seven
teams, you will earn Battle Points.\pPlease beware that unlike other ROOMS,
you may not interrupt your challenge.\pOnce you start, you must battle seven
MULTI BATTLES in a row nonstop.$
translation:
对战塔的多人对战间
是和朋友一起进行\l多人对战的设施。\p您需要先使用无线适配器
或GBA连接线与朋友连接，\p携带2只宝可梦和朋友
组队进行挑战。\p对战塔内有很多
多人对战间，\p供团队对战使用。
在多人对战间中，\l会有7组训练家等待\p您和您朋友的组队挑战。
如果顺利战胜7组，\p我们会向您呈上对战点数。
请注意这里与其他房间不同，\p您不能暂停挑战。一旦挑战开始，
就需要不间断地进行7次多人对战。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_ExplainTowerRules
source:
The BATTLE TOWER is a facility where
four types of battles are waged--\lSINGLE BATTLE, DOUBLE BATTLE, MULTI\lBATTLE, and LINK MULTI BATTLE.\pFor each of these types, there are
separate BATTLE ROOMS.\pPlease speak with a guide offering
the type of battle you wish to enter.$
translation:
对战塔中
有4种类型的对战--\l单打对战，双打对战，\l多人对战和多人连线对战。\p每种对战都有不同的
对战间，\p请到相应的向导处
申请参加挑战。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_ExplainMonRules
source:
Depending on the BATTLE ROOM you are
entering, you will be required to take\la certain number of POKéMON.\pThe SINGLE BATTLE mode requires
three POKéMON.\pThe DOUBLE BATTLE mode requires four,
and the MULTI modes both require two.$
translation:
根据进入的对战间的不同，
需要携带的宝可梦的数量\l也各不同。\p单打对战模式
需要3只宝可梦，\p双打对战需要4只，
而多人模式需要2只。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_ExplainSalonRules
source:
The BATTLE SALON is where you must
find a partner to form a tag team for\lthe MULTI BATTLE ROOM challenge.\pChoose the best partner for you by
examining other TRAINERS'\lPOKéMON and their moves.\pYou may choose a new tag partner
after winning seven straight matches.$
translation:
您需要在对战沙龙内找到一同组队
挑战多人对战间的训练家。\p仔细查看每个训练家的宝可梦和
招式来选择您的最佳搭档。\p连续打败7组训练家后，
您可以选择新的搭档。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_ExplainMultiLinkRules
source:
The LINK MULTI BATTLE Mode is for two
friends to mount a challenge together.\pYou and your friend must be linked with
Wireless Adapters or a GBA Game Link\lcable.\pYou must choose two POKéMON at
the registration counter.\pThese POKéMON must be different
from those of your friend.\pYou may not interrupt this challenge
in the middle, unlike other modes.$
translation:
通过多人连线对战模式
可以和朋友一起挑战。\p需要先和朋友通过无线适配器
或GBA连接线进行连接，\p并在挑战申请处选好
您要携带的宝可梦，\p这些宝可梦的种类要

source: Hello, this is the EXCHANGE SERVICE\nCORNER.\pWe exchange the Battle Points you\nhave collected for lovely prizes.\pPlease choose a prize from this list.$
translation: 您好，这里是兑换服务区。\p我们用精美的奖品同您收集到的\n对战点数进行兑换。\p请在列表中选择一个奖品。$

translation: 哦，它们真棒！\n我想要它们！\l漂亮的垫子！\l大号豪华的玩偶！\l小号豪华的玩偶！\l我希望能全部得到！$

label: BattleFrontier_ExchangeServiceCorner_Text_GoGetYourOwnDoll
source:
Hah?
What are you gawking at?\pI don't like you staring at my plush
doll like that.\pIf you want it, go get one yourself!
Isn't that right, SMOOCHUM?$
translation:
啊？
你在看什么呢？\p我不喜欢你那样盯着
我的漂亮娃娃看。\p如果你想要，自己去弄一只！
对不对，迷唇娃？$

translation: 你知道吗？\p如果你能在任何对战设施\n创造新纪录，他们会开始给你\l越来越多的对战点数。$
