label: BattleFrontier_ExchangeServiceCorner_Text_FocusBandDesc
source: A hold item that occasionally\nprevents fainting.$
translation: 一件能偶尔防止昏厥\n的道具。$

label: BattleFrontier_ExchangeServiceCorner_Text_ScopeLensDesc
source: A hold item that raises the\ncritical-hit rate.$
translation: 一件能提高击中要害率的\n道具。$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge1_Text_PokemonBreederIntro
source:
For 70 years I have raised POKéMON!
I am the man they revere as\lthe legendary top POKéMON BREEDER!\pIf you ever become as seasoned as me,
you'll see the abilities of POKéMON\lat a glance.\pYou're a TRAINER. Doesn't it interest
you to know your own POKéMON's\labilities?\pHere!
Let's have a look at your POKéMON!$
translation:
我培育宝可梦有70年了！
人们尊称为传说中的\l宝可梦顶尖培育家！\p若你能积累我这般经验，
一眼就能看穿宝可梦的能力。\p你是训练家吧？
难道不想了解自己宝可梦的能力？\p来！
让我看看你的宝可梦！$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge1_Text_AverageAbility
source: …Hmm…\pThis one, overall, I would describe\nas being of average ability.$
translation: ......嗯......\p这一只，总的来说，\n有还算可以的能力。$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge1_Text_BetterThanAverageAbility
source: …Hmm…\pThis one, overall, I would describe as\nhaving better-than-average ability.$
translation: ......嗯......\p这一只，总的来说，\n有中等偏上的能力。$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge1_Text_ImpressiveAbility
source: …Hmm…\pThis one, overall, I would say is\nquite impressive in ability!$
translation: ......嗯......\p这一只，总的来说，\n有相当优秀的能力！$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge1_Text_OutstandingAbility
source: …Hmm…\pThis one, overall, I would say is\nwonderfully outstanding in ability!$
translation: ......嗯......\p这一只，总的来说，\n有了不起的能力！$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge1_Text_BestAspectHP
source: Incidentally, the best aspect of it,\nI would say, is its HP…$
translation: 要说它最突出的地方，\n应该是它的体力......$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge1_Text_BestAspectAtk
source: Incidentally, the best aspect of it,\nI would say, is its ATTACK…$
translation: 要说它最突出的地方，\n应该是它的攻击......$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge1_Text_BestAspectDef
source: Incidentally, the best aspect of it,\nI would say, is its DEFENSE…$
translation: 要说它最突出的地方，\n应该是它的防御......$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge1_Text_BestAspectSpAtk
source: Incidentally, the best aspect of it,\nI would say, is its SPECIAL ATTACK…$
translation: 要说它最突出的地方，\n应该是它的特攻......$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge1_Text_BestAspectSpDef
source: Incidentally, the best aspect of it,\nI would say, is its SPECIAL DEFENSE…$
translation: 要说它最突出的地方，\n应该是它的特防......$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge1_Text_BestAspectSpeed
source: Incidentally, the best aspect of it,\nI would say, is its SPEED…$
translation: 要说它最突出的地方，\n应该是它的速度......$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge1_Text_StatRelativelyGood
source: That stat is relatively good.\n…Hm… That's how I call it.$
translation: 有一般般的能力。\n......嗯......这是我对它的评价。$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge1_Text_StatImpressive
source: That stat is quite impressive.\n…Hm… That's how I call it.$
translation: 有还可以的能力。\n......嗯......这是我对它的评价。$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge1_Text_StatOutstanding
source: That stat is outstanding!\n…Hm… That's how I call it.$
translation: 有很不错的能力！\n......嗯......这是我对它的评价。$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge1_Text_StatFlawless
source: It's flawless! A thing of perfection!\n…Hm… That's how I call it.$
translation: 有最强的能力！\n......嗯......这是我对它的评价。$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge1_Text_NoTimeForMyAdvice
source: What?\nYou have no time for my advice?\pYou should always be eager to learn\nfrom the experiences of your elders!$
translation: 什么？\n没空听我建议？\p年轻人就该多学习\n年长者的经验！$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge1_Text_HaveBusinessNeedsTending
source: Yes, what is it now?\pI have business that needs tending!\nSave it for next time!$
translation: 是的，现在有什么事？\p我有一些事情要处理！\n下次再说咯！$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge1_Text_LetsLookAtYourPokemon
source: Ah, youngster! Do your POKéMON's\nabilities intrigue you?\pHere, here!\nLet's have a look at your POKéMON!$
translation: 哦，年轻人！\n想了解宝可梦的能力吗？\p来来来！\n让我看看一下你的宝可梦！$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge1_Text_EvenICantTell
source: An expert I am, but even I can't tell\nanything about an unhatched POKéMON!\pShow me a POKéMON!\nA POKéMON is what I need to see!$
translation: 哪怕是我这样的专家，\n也看不出未孵化宝可梦的能力！\p给我看只宝可梦！\n那才是我要看的！$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge1_Text_SaidMyMonIsOutstanding
source: He said my POKéMON is outstanding!\nI'm glad I raised it carefully!$
translation: 他说我的宝可梦有了不起的能力！\n精心培育果然值得！$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge1_Text_DidntDoAnythingSpecialRaisingIt
source: He said my POKéMON is outstanding!\nBut I didn't do anything special\lraising it…$
translation: 他说我的宝可梦有了不起的能力！\n可我并没特别培育过啊......$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_FrontierManiacIntro
source:
Howdy! When it comes to news about
the BATTLE FRONTIER, I'm no. 1.\pYou can think of me as
the FRONTIER MANIAC.\pJust checking, but you are a TRAINER,
isn't that right?\pI'll happily share the hottest news
I gathered about the BATTLE FRONTIER.$
translation:
嗨！我是对战开拓区
消息最灵通的人，\p你可以叫我开拓区迷。\p只要看一眼我就知道你是个训练家，
对不？\p我很高兴可以和你分享在
对战开拓区收集的最新最热的新闻。$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_SwingByForTheLatestWord
source: Howdy! Did you swing by to grill me\nabout the latest word? Oh, all right!$
translation: 嗨！你来是想知道最新的\n消息吗？好吧！$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_MyInformationsBeenUsefulRight
source: Well? Well? Well?\pI'm sure my information's been\nseriously useful to you, right?$
translation: 哇喔？哇喔？哇喔？\p我的情报对你来说\n非常有用，是吧？$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_FacilityIsHottest
source: Let's see now…\pIt sounds like the {STR_VAR_1}\nis the hottest place going.$
translation: 让我想想......\p现在好像{STR_VAR_1}是\n最热门的地方。$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_BattleTowerIsHottest
source: Let's see now…\pIt sounds like BATTLE TOWER\n{STR_VAR_1} is the hottest.$
translation: 让我想想......\p现在好像对战塔\n{STR_VAR_1}是最热门的。$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_SalonMaidenIsThere
source: Bet you didn't know this!\pOne of those top TRAINERS that SCOTT\ncalls the FRONTIER BRAINS is there.\pIt's this mysterious TRAINER called\nthe SALON MAIDEN that runs the place.$
translation: 告诉你个秘密！\p被亚希达称作开拓区大脑\n的顶级训练家之一现在就在那里。\p那里就是由那个名叫对战塔大君的\n神秘的训练家所掌管的。$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_SalonMaidenSilverMons
source: Have you battled the SALON MAIDEN?\pWhen she's measuring up her opponent,\nshe apparently uses these POKéMON:\pA PSYCHIC-type PSI POKéMON,\na FIRE-type VOLCANO POKéMON,\land a NORMAL-type SLEEPING POKéMON.$
translation: 你跟对战塔大君交过手了吗？\p一开始她测试对手的实力的时候，\n通常都会用这些宝可梦：\p超能力属性的念力宝可梦，\n火属性的火山宝可梦，\l和一般属性的瞌睡宝可梦。$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_SalonMaidenGoldMons
source:
Have you battled the SALON MAIDEN
when she's serious?\pWhen she's battling flat out,
she apparently uses these POKéMON:\pA DRAGON & PSYCHIC EON POKéMON,
an ELECTRIC-type THUNDER POKéMON,\land a NORMAL-type SLEEPING POKéMON.$
translation:
你跟认真起来的对战塔大君
交过手了吗？\p她全力出手的时候，
通常都会用这些宝可梦：\p龙和超能力属性的无限宝可梦，
电属性的天雷宝可梦，\l还有一般属性的瞌睡宝可梦。$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_DomeAceIsThere
source: Bet you didn't know this!\pOne of those top TRAINERS that SCOTT\ncalls the FRONTIER BRAINS is there.\pIt's this flamboyant TRAINER called\nthe DOME ACE that runs the place.$
translation: 告诉你个秘密！\p被亚希达称作开拓之脑\n的顶级训练家之一现在就在那里。\p那里就是由那个名叫巨蛋超级巨星的\n华丽的训练家所掌管的。$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_DomeAceSilverMons
source: Have you battled the DOME ACE?\pWhen he's treating the opponent\nlightly, he uses these three POKéMON:\pA DRAGON & FLYING DRAGON POKéMON,\na WATER & GROUND MUD FISH POKéMON,\land a FIRE & FLYING FLAME POKéMON.$
translation: 你跟巨蛋超级巨星交过手了吗？\p他没认真起来的时候，\n通常都会用这些宝可梦：\p龙和飞行属性的龙宝可梦，\n水和地面属性的沼鱼宝可梦，\l还有火和飞行属性的火焰宝可梦。$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_DomeAceGoldMons
source:
Have you battled the DOME ACE
when he's serious?\pWhen he's demonstrating his strategy,
he uses these three POKéMON:\pA DRAGON & FLYING EON POKéMON,
a WATER & GROUND MUD FISH POKéMON,\land a STEEL- & PSYCHIC-type IRON LEG\lPOKéMON.$
translation:
你跟认真起来的巨蛋超级巨星
交过手了吗？\p当他把自己的策略完全展示的时候，
通常都会用这些宝可梦：\p龙和飞行属性的无限宝可梦，
水和地面属性的沼鱼宝可梦，\l还有钢和超能力属性的铁足\l宝可梦。$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_FactoryHeadIsThere
source: Bet you didn't know this!\pOne of those top TRAINERS that SCOTT\ncalls the FRONTIER BRAINS is there.\pIt's this freaky TRAINER called\nthe FACTORY HEAD that runs the place.$
translation: 告诉你个秘密！\p被亚希达称作开拓之脑\n的顶级训练家之一现在就在那里。\p那里就是由那个名叫工厂头目的\n奇怪的训练家所掌管的。$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_FactoryHeadSilverMons
source:
Have you battled the FACTORY HEAD
already?\pLet me think… When he goes to battle,
he just gets three rental POKéMON.\pHe battles under pretty much the same
conditions as you.$
translation:
你跟工厂头目
交过手了吗？\p我想想......他对战时，
只是使用3只租借宝可梦。\p他和你在非常相似的
条件下对战。$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_FactoryHeadGoldMons
source:
Have you battled the FACTORY HEAD
when he's serious?\pWhen he goes seriously to battle,
he still gets three rental POKéMON.\pHe battles under virtually the same
conditions as you.$
translation:
你跟认真起来的工厂头目
交过手了吗？\p当他认真起来时，
仍然是使用3只租借宝可梦。\p他是和你在完全
相同的条件下对战。$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_PikeQueenIsThere
source: Bet you didn't know this!\pOne of those top TRAINERS that SCOTT\ncalls the FRONTIER BRAINS is there.\pIt's this scary TRAINER called\nthe PIKE QUEEN that runs the place.$
translation: 告诉你个秘密！\p被亚希达称作开拓之脑\n的顶级训练家之一现在就在那里。\p那里就是由那个名叫管道皇后的\n可怕的训练家所掌管的。$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_PikeQueenSilverMons
source:
Have you battled the PIKE QUEEN
before?\pWhen she's in a good mood, they say
she uses these three POKéMON:\pA POISON-type FANG SNAKE POKéMON,
a BUG & ROCK MOLD POKéMON,\land a WATER-type TENDER POKéMON.$
translation:
你跟管道皇后
交过手了吗？\p据说她心情好的时候，
通常都会用这些宝可梦：\p毒属性的牙蛇宝可梦，
虫和岩石属性的发酵宝可梦，\l还有水属性的慈爱宝可梦。$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_PikeQueenGoldMons
source:
Have you battled the PIKE QUEEN
when she's serious?\pWhen she's seriously annoyed, they say
she uses these three POKéMON:\pA POISON-type FANG SNAKE POKéMON,
a STEEL & GROUND IRON SNAKE POKéMON,\land a WATER- & FLYING-type ATROCIOUS\lPOKéMON.$
translation:
你跟认真起来的管道皇后
交过手了吗？\p据说她非常生气的时候，
通常都会用这些宝可梦：\p毒属性的牙蛇宝可梦，
钢和地面属性的铁蛇宝可梦，\l还有水和飞行属性的凶恶宝可梦。$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_ArenaTycoonIsThere
source: Bet you didn't know this!\pOne of those top TRAINERS that SCOTT\ncalls the FRONTIER BRAINS is there.\pIt's this cute TRAINER called\nthe ARENA TYCOON that runs the place.$
translation: 告诉你个秘密！\p被亚希达称作开拓之脑\n的顶级训练家之一现在就在那里。\p那里就是由那个名叫竞技场主将的\n可爱的训练家所掌管的。$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_ArenaTycoonSilverMons
source:
Have you battled the ARENA TYCOON
before?\pWhen she's assessing the foe's ability,
she supposedly uses these POKéMON:\pA BUG & FIGHTING SINGLE HORN POKéMON,
a DARK-type MOONLIGHT POKéMON,\land a BUG & GHOST SHED POKéMON.$
translation:
你跟竞技场主将
交过手了吗？\p一开始她估计对手实力的时候，
大概会用这些宝可梦：\p虫和格斗属性的独角宝可梦，
恶属性的月光宝可梦，\l还有虫和幽灵属性的空壳宝可梦。$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_ArenaTycoonGoldMons
source:
Have you battled the ARENA TYCOON
when she's serious?\pWhen she battles for keeps,
she supposedly uses these POKéMON:\pA DARK-type MOONLIGHT POKéMON,
a GHOST & POISON SHADOW POKéMON\land a GRASS- & FIGHTING-type\lMUSHROOM POKéMON.$
translation:
你跟认真起来的竞技场主将
交过手了吗？\p她在卫冕战里
大概会用这些宝可梦：\p恶属性的月光宝可梦，
幽灵和毒属性的影子宝可梦，\l还有草和格斗属性的\l蘑菇宝可梦。$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_PalaceMavenIsThere
source: Bet you didn't know this!\pOne of those top TRAINERS that SCOTT\ncalls the FRONTIER BRAINS is there.\pIt's this sinister TRAINER called\nthe PALACE MAVEN that runs the place.$
translation: 告诉你个秘密！\p被亚希达称作开拓之脑\n的顶级训练家之一现在就在那里。\p那里就是由那个名叫宫殿守护者的\n凶险的训练家所掌管的。$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_PalaceMavenSilverMons
source:
Have you battled the PALACE MAVEN
before?\pWhen he's testing the opponent's
spirit, he's said to use these POKéMON:\pA POISON & FLYING-type BAT POKéMON,
a NORMAL-type LAZY POKéMON, and a\lWATER- & ICE-type TRANSPORT POKéMON.$
translation:
你跟宫殿守护者
交过手了吗？\p据说他测试对手的心灵的时候，
通常会用这些宝可梦：\p毒和飞行属性的蝙蝠宝可梦，
一般属性的怕麻烦宝可梦，\l还有水和冰属性的乘载宝可梦。$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_PalaceMavenGoldMons
source:
Have you battled the PALACE MAVEN
when he's serious?\pWhen he throws his entire might into
battle, he's said to use these POKéMON:\pA FIRE-type LEGENDARY POKéMON,
a NORMAL-type LAZY POKéMON,\land a WATER-type AURORA POKéMON.$
translation:
你跟认真起来的宫殿守护者
交过手了吗？\p据说他把精力全部集中到对战的时候，
通常会使用这些宝可梦：\p火属性的传说宝可梦，
一般属性的怕麻烦宝可梦，\l还有水属性的极光宝可梦。$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_PyramidKingIsThere
source: Bet you didn't know this!\pOne of those top TRAINERS that SCOTT\ncalls the FRONTIER BRAINS is there.\pIt's this fiery-hot TRAINER called\nthe PYRAMID KING that runs the place.$
translation: 告诉你个秘密！\p被亚希达称作开拓之脑\n的顶级训练家之一现在就在那里。\p那里就是由那个名叫金字塔法老的\n火热的训练家所掌管的。$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_PyramidKingSilverMons
source:
Have you battled the PYRAMID KING
before?\pWhen he's checking the foe's power,
he apparently uses these POKéMON:\pA ROCK-type ROCK PEAK POKéMON,
an ICE-type ICEBERG POKéMON,\land a STEEL-type IRON POKéMON.$
translation:
你跟金字塔法老
交过手了吗？\p他检验对手实力的时候，
通常都会用这些宝可梦：\p岩石属性的岩山宝可梦，
冰属性的冰山宝可梦，\l还有钢属性的黑金宝可梦。$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_PyramidKingGoldMons
source:
Have you battled the PYRAMID KING
when he's serious?\pWhen he's pumped with hot power,
he apparently uses these POKéMON:\pAn ICE & FLYING FREEZE POKéMON, an
ELECTRIC & FLYING ELECTRIC POKéMON,\land a FIRE- & FLYING-type FLAME\lPOKéMON.$
translation:
你跟认真起来的金字塔法老
交过手了吗？\p他的热情燃烧起来的时候，
通常都会用这些宝可梦：\p冰和飞行属性的冰冻宝可梦，
电和飞行属性的电击宝可梦，\l还有火和飞行属性的火焰宝可梦。$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_DoubleBattleAdvice1
source:
Sure, there are several places where
you can enter DOUBLE BATTLES.\pBut the DOUBLE BATTLE ROOMS of
the BATTLE TOWER are, like, basic!\pThey're where you should learn about
how DOUBLE BATTLES are played here\lin the BATTLE FRONTIER.$
translation:
确实，有些地方也可以
进行双打对战，\p不过在对战塔的双打
对战间里，这可是最基本的！\p你可以在那里学习
如何在对战开拓区\l进行双打对战。$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_DoubleBattleAdvice2
source: Watch yourself in the battles here.\pI hear there are TRAINERS that have\nstrategies they developed just for\lDOUBLE BATTLES.$
translation: 在这里对战不要大意。\p听说有些训练家\n可是专门为了双打对战\l而培育宝可梦的。$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_DoubleBattleAdvice3
source: Once you're confident and comfortable\nwith DOUBLE BATTLES here, you should\lthink about challenging other places\loffering DOUBLE BATTLES.$
translation: 当你熟悉了这里的\n双打对战之后，\l就去试着挑战其他地方的\l双打对战吧。$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_MultiBattleAdvice
source: All sorts of TRAINERS gather in\nthe BATTLE SALON.\pJust think--you may run into your\nfriends or followers!\lYou should look carefully!$
translation: 对战沙龙里聚集了\n各种各样的训练家。\p想想吧--你可能会遇到\n你的朋友或粉丝！\l要好好注意周围啊！$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_LinkMultiBattleAdvice
source: If you're with a friend, head for the\nLINK MULTI BATTLE ROOM.\pIf you play with a strong friend,\nyou can expect to see tough foes!$
translation: 如果遇到了朋友，\n就去多人连线对战间吧。\p有一个很厉害的朋友在旁边的话，\n就有可能碰上很强的对手！$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_NewsGatheringPower
source: What amazing news-gathering power!\nMy mentor's like none other!$
translation: 收集消息好厉害！\n老师果然非同一般！$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_AmazingPowersOfObservation
source: What amazing powers of observation!\nMy mentor's like none other!$
translation: 调查资料好厉害！\n老师果然非同一般！$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_AmazingPowerOfPersuasion
source: What amazing power of persuasion!\nMy mentor's like none other!$
translation: 说服别人好厉害！\n老师果然非同一般！$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_ThisPlaceIsScaringMe
source: …What is this place?\nIt's scaring me…$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge3_Text_CantYouSeeWereBusyHere
source: …What's that you want?\pCan't you see we're kind of busy here?\nCan't your business wait till later?$
translation: ......你想干什么？\p没看见我们很忙吗？\n你就不能一边去等等？$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge3_Text_YouLookToughExplainGambling
source:
…Huh?
You look to me like a tough TRAINER.\pHeheh…
Listen, I have this proposition.\pWe have a little group going here,
and we play a little game with what\lgoes on in the BATTLE FRONTIER.\pThe rules are really simple.\pFirst, we pick one of the facilities
in the BATTLE FRONTIER.\pThen, we each pick a different TRAINER
who's taking that facility's challenge,\land bet with our Battle Points.\pThe guy who bet on the TRAINER with
the best record takes all the Battle\lPoints in the pool.\pSounds simple, huh?
So, anyway…$
translation:
......嗯？
我觉得你是个挺强的训练家。\p呵呵呵......
听着，我有个小提议。\p现在我们在对战开拓区
有一组人，\l我们正在做一个小游戏。\p规则很简单。\p首先，我们选择一种
对战开拓区的设施，\p然后我们各自选择一个
正在挑战的训练家，\l赌上自己的对战点数，\p选的训练家获得成绩最好
的人就可以得到所有的\l对战点数。\p很简单是吧？
然后......$

Oh, it's you…

translation:
啊，你来了......

对战点数还给你了......\p就让我们下一回
更加努力一些吧！$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge3_Text_HelloChampHeresYourPoints

Oh, yes!
Hello there, champ!\pI knew you could!
I knew you would!\lWe're both big winners!\pI'll return your Battle Points and,
of course, a little extra from me!$
translation:
啊，太棒了！
我在这儿！\p我就知道你可以的！
我就知道你会成功！\l今天我们两个是大赢家！\p你的对战点数还给你，
还有，这是额外的奖品！$

translation: {PLAYER}获得了\n{STR_VAR_1}BP的对战点数。$

translation: 你还准备挑战什么的话\n别忘了叫上我！$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge3_Text_BackedWrongTrainer

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge3_Text_TrainerGoodButRattled

translation: 那边的训练家......\p他的实力其实不错，可惜太容易紧张，\n总是通不过对战巨蛋......$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge3_Text_KnowWinnerWhenISeeOne

translation: 嘻嘻！\n我一眼就能看出谁会是赢家！$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge3_Text_ShouldBeTakingChallenges

translation: 那些训练家......\n他们在干什么？\l他们应该去挑战啊。$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge4_Text_WonderIfInterviewsAiring

translation: 不知道今天会不会有关于强大训练家\n的电视采访？$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge4_Text_IfIOpenedRestaurantHere
source: If I opened a restaurant here,\nit'd make money for sure.$
translation: 在这儿开个饭馆的话\n肯定能挣大钱吧。$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge4_Text_NeedBreatherAfterBattles
source: Whew…\pI need to take a breather after\nsome intense battles…\pBut even now, I never take a break\nfrom plotting strategy and combos.$
translation: 呼......\p那么紧张的对战之后，\n我得稍微休息一下了......\p但即使是现在，我脑子里也会\n一直设计着对战策略。$

translation: 呵呵！\n我能看出宝可梦在想什么哦！\p来吧！\n让我看看你的宝可梦！$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge5_Text_NatureGirlEgg
source: That's silly! An EGG is asleep!\nI can't talk to it!$
translation: 你在说什么傻话！蛋可在沉睡啊！\n我怎么跟它交谈呢！$

translation: 好像魔法一样啊！\n那边那位小女孩说她能\l懂得宝可梦在说什么！$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge5_Text_GirlSayingSomethingProfound

translation: 我感觉那个小女孩好像在\n说什么很晦涩难懂的话。$

translation: 我知道我知道！\p那个小女孩经常在\n红色的房子里玩！$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge6_Text_WouldYouLikeToTrade
source:
My POKéMON is a {STR_VAR_2}.
Do you know it?\lIt's quite cute and rather nice.\pThis little one, I could trade with
pride!\pWould you like to trade me a {STR_VAR_1}
for my {STR_VAR_2}?$
translation:
我的宝可梦是{STR_VAR_2}，
你知道它吗？\l它很可爱，很讨人喜欢。\p我可是很自豪有这么一只
能与别人交换！\p你想用{STR_VAR_1}
换我的{STR_VAR_2}吗？$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge6_Text_PromiseIllBeGoodToIt
source: Oh, it's adorable!\nThank you!\lI promise I'll be good to it!\pOh! I hope you'll be good to\nmy {STR_VAR_2}, too!$
translation: 哇，太可爱了！\n谢谢！\l我保证会好好照顾它的！\p啊，你也要好好照顾\n我的{STR_VAR_2}哦！$

source: Oh, I'm sorry!\nI don't intend to trade for anything\lbut a {STR_VAR_1}.$
translation: 啊，抱歉！\n我只想换一只\l{STR_VAR_1}。$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge6_Text_WellThatsFineToo
source: Oh, you won't?\nWell, that's fine, too.\lPlease come visit us again.$
translation: 哎，你不想换吗？\n唉，那就算了。\l下回再说吧。$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge6_Text_SkittySoMuchCuterThanImagined

translation: 嘻嘻！\n向尾喵比我想象中可爱多了！\l太高兴了！$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_LeftTutorIntro
source:
Buhahaha!\pYou couldn't tell it from looking now,
but I used to be one tough TRAINER.\pI had a reputation as the toughest
BEAUTY around, I tell you!\p… … … … … …\pWhat is it now?
You don't believe me.\pI'm not like that blowhard woman over
there. I'm actually talented!\pLet me prove it to you.
I can teach your POKéMON special and\lyet cute moves.\pBut my lessons don't come free.
How about paying for the moves I teach\lwith a wee bit of Battle Points?$
translation:
哇哈哈哈！\p也许现在这样你看不出来，
不过我过去可是个非常强的训练家。\p告诉你，以前大家可都称我是
最强的大姐姐！\p...... ...... ......\p怎么了？
你好像不相信？\p我可不是那边那个爱吹牛的女人，
我真正拥有着才能！\p证明给你看吧，
我可以教你的宝可梦\l学习特别而又可爱的招式。\p不过这可不是免费的，
你每学一次招式\l支付一些对战点数如何？$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_LeftTutorWelcomeBack
source: Buhahaha!\pAre you back to learn special and\nyet cute POKéMON moves?$
translation: 哇哈哈哈！\p你是回来学特别而又可爱的\n宝可梦招式的吗？$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_TeachWhichMove
source: Fine, fine, look here!\nWhich move should I teach?$
translation: 好，好，看这儿！\n要我教什么招式？$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_MoveWillBeXBattlePoints
source: The move {STR_VAR_1}, is it?\nThat will be {STR_VAR_2} Battle Points, okay?$
translation: {STR_VAR_1}，是吗？\n那要付给我{STR_VAR_2}BP的对战点数，如何？$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_TeachMoveToWhichMon
source: Fine, fine, now pick the POKéMON\nI should teach the move to.$
translation: 好，好，现在告诉我\n要教给哪只宝可梦。$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_HaventGotEnoughPoints
source: What the…\nYou haven't got enough Battle Points!$
translation: 什么啊......\n你没那么多对战点数！$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_IllTakeBattlePoints
source: Do you see how skilled I am now?\nI'll take your Battle Points, thanks!$
translation: 现在你知道我的本事了吧？\n好了，你的对战点数我收下了！$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_YouDontWantTo
source: What's that?\nYou don't want to…\pIf you want to see how skilled I am,\nyou come see me anytime!$
translation: 什么啊？\n你不想......\p好吧，想看看我的本事的话\n随时可以过来！$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_RightTutorIntro
source:
Ihihihi!\pI know it's hard to see now, but I used
to be one fantastic TRAINER.\pI had a reputation as the most
invincible SWIMMER around, I tell you!\p… … … … … …\pWhat's wrong?
You don't believe me.\pI'm not like that buffoonish woman over
there. I'm actually experienced!\pI can prove it to you.
I can teach your POKéMON hard and\lyet pretty moves.\pBut my lessons don't come free.
How about paying for the moves I teach\lwith a wee bit of Battle Points?$
translation:
嘻嘻嘻！\p我知道也许现在看不大出来，
不过我以前可是个非凡的训练家。\p告诉你，以前大家可都称我是
战无不胜的比基尼姐姐！\p...... ...... ......\p怎么了？
你好像不相信？\p我可不是那边那个小丑一样的女人，
我可经历过很多！\p证明给你看吧，
我可以教你的宝可梦学习\l强大而又漂亮的招式。\p不过这可不是免费的，
你每学一次招式\l支付一些对战点数如何？$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_RightTutorWelcomeBack
source: Ihihihi!\pHave you come to learn hard and\nyet pretty POKéMON moves?$
translation: 嘻嘻嘻！\p你是回来学习强大而又漂亮的\n宝可梦招式的吗？$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_ThinkLadiesDontGetAlong
source: Those ladies, the way they bad-mouth\neach other, you probably think that\lthey don't get along.\pBut if that were true, they wouldn't\nstay out here together, would they?$
translation: 那边两位女士总是不停地\n说对方的坏话，也许会让你\l以为她们俩关系并不好吧？\p但如果真是那样，她们就不会\n一块儿呆在那边了，不是吗？$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_LadiesWereStrongAndBeautiful
source:
When I was just a wee YOUNGSTER,
those ladies were strong and beautiful.\pThey were idols among us TRAINERS.\pEven now, age hasn't dulled their
abilities.\pIn fact, their POKéMON moves have
grown even more polished.\pBut… For some reason, I can't help
but feel this…\pTime is so cruel…$
translation:
我还仅仅是个少年的时候，
那两位可是非常强大又美丽。\p她们是我们这些训练家的偶像。\p就算现在，时间也不曾掩盖
她们的能力。\p实际上，她们的宝可梦招式
在时间的淘洗中愈趋完美。\p但是......在某些方面，
我却难以抑制地感受到......\p时间太残酷了......$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_SoftboiledDesc
source: Recovers up to\nhalf the user's\nmaximum HP.$
translation: 最多可以恢复\n使用者最大体力的\n一半。$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_SeismicTossDesc
source: Inflicts damage\nidentical to the\nuser's level.$
translation: 给予对手\n与自己等级相同的\n伤害。$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_DreamEaterDesc
source: Recovers half the\ndamage inflicted\non a sleeping foe.$
translation: 给予睡着的敌人\n伤害并回复造成\n伤害一半的体力。$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_MegaPunchDesc
source: A strong punch\nthrown with\nincredible power.$
translation: 给予对手\n强力的一拳\n的攻击。$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_MegaKickDesc
source: An extremely\npowerful kick with\nintense force.$
translation: 给予对手\n猛烈的一踢\n的攻击。$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_BodySlamDesc
source: A full-body slam\nthat may cause\nparalysis.$
translation: 用整个身体压制，\n可以使对手\n麻痹。$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_RockSlideDesc
source: Large boulders\nare hurled. May\ncause flinching.$
translation: 投出巨大的石块，\n可以使对手\n恐惧。$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_CounterDesc
source: Retaliates any\nphysical hit with\ndouble the power.$
translation: 以两倍的力量\n反击任何\n物理攻击。$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_ThunderWaveDesc
source: A weak jolt of\nelectricity that\nparalyzes the foe.$
translation: 用微弱的电击\n使对手麻痹。$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_SwordsDanceDesc
source: A fighting dance\nthat sharply\nraises ATTACK.$
translation: 战斗的舞蹈，\n可以大大提升\n攻击。$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_DefenseCurlDesc
source: Curls up to con-\nceal weak spots\nand raise DEFENSE.$
translation: 蜷曲身体\n隐藏起弱点，\n可以提升防御。$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_SnoreDesc
source: A loud attack\nthat can be used\nonly while asleep.$
translation: 只有睡着时\n才可以使用的\n声音攻击。$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_MudSlapDesc
source: Hurls mud in the\nfoe's face to re-\nduce its accuracy.$
translation: 把泥巴扔到\n敌人脸上，降低\n对手的命中率。$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_SwiftDesc
source: Sprays star-\nshaped rays\nthat never miss.$
translation: 射出必定\n能击中的\n星形光线。$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_IcyWindDesc
source: A chilling attack\nthat lowers the\nfoe's SPEED.$
translation: 能降低对手\n速度的\n冷气攻击。$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_EndureDesc
source: Endures any at-\ntack for 1 turn,\nleaving 1HP.$
translation: 在1回合中\n抵挡住任何攻击，\n总是剩下1点体力。$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_PsychUpDesc
source: Copies the foe's\neffect(s) and\ngives to the user.$
translation: 将对手的能力\n变化效果复制\n给自己。$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_IcePunchDesc
source: An icy punch\nthat may\nfreeze the foe.$
translation: 能够使对手\n结冰的\n冰冷的拳。$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_ThunderPunchDesc
source: An electrified\npunch that may\nparalyze the foe.$
translation: 能够使对手\n麻痹的\n电击的拳。$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_FirePunchDesc
source: A fiery punch\nthat may burn\nthe foe.$
translation: 能够使对手\n灼伤的\n燃烧的拳。$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge8_Text_WhatATrainerNeeds
source:
What a TRAINER needs…\pKnowledge…
Strategy…\lLuck…\lGuts…\lSpirit…\lBravery…\lAnd ability…\pWell, I'm all set in every way!
I'll be unstoppable at every building!\pHuh? POKéMON?
What's that?$
translation:
训练家所需要的一切......\p知识......
战术......\l运气......\l毅力......\l精神......\l英勇......\l还有能力......\p我可是拥有这一切！
在这里我必定是战无不胜的！\p嗯？宝可梦？
那是什么？$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge8_Text_KnowAboutFrontierBrains
source: Do you know about the FRONTIER\nBRAINS?\pThat's what SCOTT calls the seven\nspecial TRAINERS that run the seven\lfacilities in the BATTLE FRONTIER.$
translation: 你知道\n开拓之脑吗？\p亚希达是这么称呼\n管理对战开拓区七大设施的\l那七位特别的训练家的。$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge8_Text_ToldMeIHaveTalentForBattling
source: At the BATTLE TOWER, an older girl\ntold me that I have a lot of talent\lfor battling!\pI like POKéMON CONTESTS more!\pBut I'm no good at CONTESTS!\pI guess having talent and liking\nsomething aren't the same.$
translation: 对战塔里有一位大姐姐\n告诉我我在对战方面的才能\l非常出色！\p不过我更喜欢宝可梦华丽大赛！\p但我在华丽大赛上完全不行！\p我想也许喜欢和天赋\n是两码事吧。$

label: BattleFrontier_Mart_Text_ChaperonGrandson
source: We came here to chaperon our\ngrandson.\pBut since we're here, we thought\nwe should get some souvenirs.$
translation: 我们是来陪我们的\n孙子的。\p但既然来这儿了，\n我们觉得至少该带些纪念品回去。$

label: BattleFrontier_Mart_Text_ProteinMakeNiceGift
source: Dear, what do you think of this?\nWouldn't this make a nice gift?\pIt's…PRO…TE…IN?\nIt sounds delicious, doesn't it?$
translation: 亲爱的，你觉得这个怎么样？\n这应该是个不错的礼物吧？\p这是......攻击......增强......剂？\n听上去挺好吃的，不是吗？$

label: BattleFrontier_Mart_Text_FacilitiesDontAllowItems
source: A lot of the BATTLE FRONTIER's\nfacilities don't allow the use of items\lduring battles.\pThat rule makes things tougher than\nthey already are!$
translation: 对战开拓区里的\n比赛都不允许在对战中\l使用道具，\p这条规定让原来就很困难的对战\n难上加难！$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_BattleTowerSign
source: This is the BATTLE TOWER!\nKeep the win streak as the toughest\lTRAINER!$
translation: 这里是对战塔！\n不断连胜！最强训练家！$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_BattlePalaceSign
source: This is the BATTLE PALACE!\nKeep your eyes on POKéMON battles!$
translation: 这里是对战宫殿！\n好好注视！宝可梦对战！$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_BattleArenaSign
source: This is the BATTLE ARENA!\nLet the toughest teams gather!$
translation: 这里是对战竞技场！\n聚集吧！最强队伍！$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_BattlePyramidSign
source: This is the BATTLE PYRAMID!\nAdvance through the Battle Quest!$
translation: 这里是对战金字塔！\n前进吧！探索式对战！$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_RankingHallSign
source: BATTLE FRONTIER RANKING HALL\nSet your sights on new records!$
translation: 对战开拓区排名大厅\n关注最新的纪录！$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_ExchangeCornerSign
source: BATTLE POINT EXCHANGE SERVICE CORNER\nExchange your Battle Points!$
translation: 对战点数兑换服务区\n兑换你的对战点数！$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_BattleTowerFeelsSpecial
source: Wow!\nIt's huge!\pThe BATTLE TOWER feels special.\nIt's different from the others.$
translation: 哇！\n好大！\p对战塔看起来很特别，\n和别的建筑都不同。$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_ConquerLeagueAndFrontier
source: My grand ambition is to conquer both\nthe BATTLE FRONTIER and the POKéMON\lLEAGUE.\pAnd if my dream comes true…\pI… I'm going to ask MIMI next door\nif she will be friends with me!$
translation: 我的目标是征服整个\n对战开拓区和\l宝可梦联盟。\p如果成功了的话......\p我......我就去求我家隔壁\n的咪咪跟我做朋友！$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_PyramidTooHarsh
source: The BATTLE PYRAMID's too harsh!\nI just can't make it to the top!\pSince I'm out of options, maybe I can\nclimb the outside…$
translation: 对战金字塔实在是太难了！\n我想我是走不到最上层了。\p实在没有其他办法的话，\n也许我可以试试从外面爬上去......$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_ThriveInDarkness
source: I thrive in darkness…\nYes… What is worthy of me?\lNone other than the BATTLE PYRAMID…\pWhat say you to wandering in darkness\nand in utter and total desperation?$
translation: 我是在黑暗中长大的......\n是的......哪里最适合我？\l必然是对战金字塔......\p在黑暗中探索的时候\n你是不是也会陷入完全的绝望？$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_PutTogetherUltimateTeam
source: I didn't sleep for a week, but then\nI put together the ultimate team!\pI can't see myself losing, no joke.\nWe're storming the BATTLE ARENA!$
translation: 我一个星期没有睡觉了，\n但我已经找到了最强组合！\p我是绝对不会输的，我没开玩笑，\n我们的风暴会席卷对战竞技场！$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_DidScottBringYouHere
source:
Did SCOTT bring you here, too?
What is it with that guy?\pIt sounds like he really does know
how to spot talented TRAINERS, but…\pI've never seen him battling in person
ever.$
translation:
你也是亚希达带来的吗？
那家伙到底是什么人？\p他好像总能发现
天才训练家，不过......\p我从来没见过
他跟别人对战。$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_BelieveInYouBuddy
source: ZIGG!\nI believe in you, little buddy!\pI'll make my little ZIGG any favorite\ntasty treats you like if you win!$
translation: 兹格！\n我相信你能行的，伙计！\p我的小兹格赢了的话\n什么好东西都买给你！$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_ZigzagoonLooksVacant
source: ZIGZAGOON looks vacant…$
translation: 蛇纹熊看起来挺清闲......$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_PeopleCallMeBusybody
source:
People call me a busybody,
but I can't help it.\pYour hat's on crooked!
Oh, no, trash on the ground!\lOops, it's almost dinnertime!\pI don't know if I can stand to just
watch at the BATTLE PALACE…$
translation:
大家都说我爱管闲事，
但我总是忍不住啊。\p你的帽子歪了！
啊，天哪，地上有垃圾！\l哎呀，到晚饭时间了！\p真不知道我究竟能不能
安静地看对战宫殿里的对战......$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_OnceBeatGymLeader
source: I may not look that impressive now,\nbut I once beat a GYM LEADER.\pWho knows, maybe I should give it\nanother shot at glory.$
translation: 也许我看起来不像那种人，\n但我确实打败过道馆馆主。\p哎，我是不是应该再做一些什么\n来保持我的荣誉？$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_FastOnBikeAndBattles
source: I'm fast on my BIKE, and that goes for\nthe way I battle, too.\pI win matches in the blink of\nan eye!$
translation: 我骑自行车很快，\n对战的时候也一样快。\p眨眼之间我就可以\n赢得对战！$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_BetterThanDaddyAtPokemon
source: I'm better than my daddy\nat POKéMON.$
translation: 对于宝可梦，我比爸爸\n还要更胜一筹。$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_GoRackUpSomeWinsForDaddy
source: Go on, my baby sweetie!\nGo rack up some wins for Daddy!\pYou're just like your mother,\nso you'll be dominating!$
translation: 去吧，小甜心！\n为了爸爸取得胜利吧！\p你和你妈妈一样，\n绝对能够主导对战！$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_HeardPrettyGirlAtBattleArena
source:
It wasn't easy getting here,
but I'd heard about this knockout\lpretty girl at the BATTLE ARENA.\pInstead of her, do you know what
I found?\pA whole teeming mob of sweaty,
stinky, and primitive martial artists!$
translation:
这一路过来可真不容易！
但我可是听说对战竞技场\l有个无比漂亮的女孩。\p结果你知道我只
找到了什么吗？\p一大群满身汗臭的
粗野武术家！$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_SometimesImportantOldManInThere
source: I sometimes see this really important-\nlooking old man going in there.\pHe has these really awesome POKéMON.\nHe seems really nice, though.$
translation: 有时候能看到这位看上去\n明显是大人物的老人到这儿来，\p他的宝可梦真强，\n但他本人看起来很和善。$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_LegendOfBattlePyramid
source:
Do you know it?
The legend of the BATTLE PYRAMID?\pWhen there comes a confident TRAINER
reaching for the golden pinnacle,\lthere shall appear a man among men.\pDon't know that legend?
Well, of course not!\lI just made it up!\pWhat's it supposed to mean?
That, my friend, I can't say!$
translation:
你听说过那个关于
对战金字塔的传说吗？\p当一位勇敢的训练家到达
金光闪闪的顶峰之时，\l就会有一个人出现在人群中。\p你知道这个传说吗？
哈哈，你当然不知道！\l这是我刚刚编的！\p至于这是什么意思，
那是，呃，不告诉你！$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_GotWipedOut
source:
Man! Oh man!
I've never lost once before!\pBut I got wiped out with no saving
grace at all!\pAnd then I'm told I don't have any
talent?! Man!$
translation:
可恶！
我以前从来没输过！\p但一到这里我就被
毫不留情地打败了！\p然后还被人说我根本没有才能？！
可恶！$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_ToughTrainerInBattleTower
source: This guy ran into a horribly tough\nTRAINER while he was on the BATTLE\lTOWER challenge.\pNow look at him…\pYou need to be cautious if you ever\ndecide to go to the BATTLE TOWER.$
translation: 这个人在挑战\n对战塔的时候\l碰上了个非常强的训练家。\p唉，现在他变成这样了......\p挑战对战塔的话\n一定要三思而后行。$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_EnoughBattlePointsForDoll
source: Yes!\nI've finally got enough Battle Points!\pI guess I'll trade for another giant\nplush DOLL!$
translation: 好了！\n终于攒够了对战点数！\p可以再换一个\n毛绒玩具了！$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_LikeToHaveNameRecordedHere
source: Oh, yeah, okay!\nSo this is the RANKING HALL!\pI'd like to go down in history as\na super champ and have my name\lrecorded here for posterity.$
translation: 啊哈哈！\n这里就是排名大厅！\p我要让历史记住我这个\n超级冠军，把我的名字记录在这里，\l让所有的子孙后代都能看到！$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_CanDoAnythingWithYou
source: With you by my side, I can do anything.$
translation: 只要有你在身边，我会无往不利。$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_PowerOfOurLoveWillOvercome
source:
Ooh, darling, you are so wonderful!\pOoh, I just can't wait anymore!\pLet's go to a MULTI BATTLE ROOM
right this instant!\pIf we get together in the BATTLE SALON,
the power of our love will overcome\leveryone we meet.\pWhy, before us, darling, everything
will topple like dominoes!$
translation:
哦哦，亲爱的，你太棒了！\p哦哦，我再也等不及了！\p我们马上去挑战
多人对战间吧！\p如果我们一起去对战沙龙，
我们之间爱的力量一定会\l使我们战胜所有人。\p啊，亲爱的，在我们两人面前，
一切都像推倒多米诺一样！$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_FrontierNotExclusivelyForToughTrainers
source:
The BATTLE FRONTIER isn't exclusively
for tough TRAINERS.\pMany people with special abilities
have been invited, it seems.\pThat man SCOTT…\pHe may have built this place to serve
a bigger objective…$
translation:
对战开拓区并不是
强大的训练家专属的，\p似乎很多拥有特别能力的人
也在被邀请的行列。\p那个亚希达......\p他建造这个地方一定有着
远大的目标......$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_OddTreeHereSeemsToWiggle
source: Excuse me, young one.\nHave you good eyesight?\pThere is an odd tree past here, and to\nmy tired eyes it seems to wiggle.$
translation: 打扰一下，年轻人，\n你的视力还可以吧？\p我刚才看到那边有棵奇怪的树\n好像在摇摆。$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_OnceAnOddTreePastHere
source: Excuse me, young one.\nHave you a good memory?\pI have this feeling there once was\nan odd tree past here.$
translation: 打扰一下，年轻人，\n你的记忆力还可以吧？\p我好像记得那边曾经\n有棵奇怪的树。$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_StickyMonWithLongTail
source:
I…
I saw it!\pThere was a sticky sort of a POKéMON
with a long tail up ahead!\pIt was hiding under a boulder, and
it kept staring at me!$
translation:
我......
我看见了！\p是一只举着长长尾巴的
小小的宝可梦！\p刚才它藏在一块大石头底下，
还一直偷偷地盯着我看！$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_BattleDomeSign
source: This is the BATTLE DOME!\nYour path to the invincible superstar!$
translation: 这里是对战巨蛋！\n决定目标！无敌的超级巨星！$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_BattleFactorySign
source: This is the BATTLE FACTORY!\nSeek out the toughest POKéMON!$
translation: 这里是对战工厂！\n寻找！最强宝可梦！$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_BattlePikeSign
source: This is the BATTLE PIKE!\nChoose one of three paths!$
translation: 这里是对战管道！\n选择！3条道路！$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_ThisIsBattleTower
source: This is the BATTLE TOWER.\pTRAINERS bring their best-raised\nPOKéMON for elimination-style matches.$
translation: 这里是对战塔！\p训练家将他们最优秀的\n宝可梦带来进行淘汰赛。$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_MayISeeYourTicket
source: Hello, are you here for the ferry?\nMay I see your TICKET?$
translation: 您好，是来乘渡轮吗？\n可以出示您的船票吗？$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_MustHaveTicketToBoard
source: {PLAYER} doesn't have the TICKET…\pI'm terribly sorry.\pYou must have a TICKET to board\nthe ferry.$
translation: {PLAYER}没有船票......\p非常抱歉。\p必须要持有船票\n才能登船。$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_WhereWouldYouLikeToGo
source: {PLAYER} flashed the TICKET.\pPerfect! That's all you need!\pAnd where would you like to go?$
translation: {PLAYER}出示了船票。\p好的，没问题了！\p您想去哪里？$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_SlateportItIs
source: SLATEPORT CITY it is, then!$
translation: 那就前往凯那市吧！$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_LilycoveItIs
source: LILYCOVE CITY it is, then!$
translation: 那就前往水静市吧！$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_SailWithUsAnotherTime
source: Please sail with us another time!$
translation: 欢迎下次再来！$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_PleaseBoardFerry
source: Please board the ferry and wait for\ndeparture.$
translation: 请登船等候出发。$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_ThenWhereWouldYouLikeToGo
source: Then, where would you like to go?$
translation: 那么您想去哪里？$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_BestOutOfAllMyFriends
source: I'm the best out of all my friends.\nBut here…\lI've been useless!$
translation: 在朋友之中我是最强的，\n但在这儿......\l我根本不算什么！$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_CantFindBattleTower
source: I want to go to the BATTLE TOWER,\nbut I can't find it even though I have\la map of the BATTLE FRONTIER.\pThis place is just too big!$
translation: 我想去对战塔，\n但就算有地图，\l我也找不到对战开拓区。\p这块地方实在太大了！$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_GotSeasickOnWayHere
source: I wanted to take a challenge as soon\nas I arrived here.\pBut on the way, I got seasick…\nUrrrrp…$
translation: 我本来准备一到这儿\n就开始挑战的。\p不过，在路上，我晕船了......\n呜......$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_OnlyToughTrainersBroughtHere
source:
It's not as if just anyone can come
here, you know?\pOnly those TRAINERS who've been
recognized as tough are brought here.\pThat's why many TRAINERS don't even
know about the BATTLE FRONTIER.$
translation:
知道吗？
并不是所有人都能到这里的。\p只有被认定是强大的训练家
才能来到这里。\p所以很多训练家甚至对
对战开拓区一无所知。$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_SureWeCanChallengeWithNoMons
source: Hey, bro…\pAre you sure we can make challenges\neven if we don't have any POKéMON?$
translation: 嗨，伙计......\p你敢肯定我们没有宝可梦\n也能进行挑战？$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_BigGuySaidIllLendYouMons
source: Uh…\nI'm sure it'll be okay.\pI think…\pBut remember that big scary guy?\nHe said, “I'll lend you POKéMON!”$
translation: 呃......\n大概不要紧吧。\p我想是的......\p记得那个吓人的大个子吗？\n他不是说："我会借给你宝可梦！"$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_WhosRaisingThoseRentalMons
source: That's the BATTLE FACTORY.\nYou can rent strong POKéMON there.\pBut it makes me wonder.\nWho's raising those rental POKéMON?$
translation: 那边的是对战工厂，\n在那儿你能借到强大的宝可梦，\p不过我一直在奇怪，\n那些宝可梦是谁培育出来的？$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_ScaredOfPikeBecauseSeviper
source: I'm scared of going into the BATTLE\nPIKE because of SEVIPER…\pB-but I came all the way here, so I will\ntry to conquer everything!\l…Shudder…$
translation: 我不敢进对战管道，\n我怕饭匙蛇......\p但--但我既然已经到这儿来了\n我要努力战胜一切！\l......哆嗦......$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_LetsPlayRockPaperScissors
source: Let's play rock, paper, scissors!\nOne, two, three!\p… … … … … …$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_WonIllTakePikeChallenge
source: Yay! I won!\nI will take the BATTLE PIKE challenge!$
translation: 耶！赢了！\n去挑战对战管道咯！$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_LostIllPutOffPikeChallenge
source: Oh, no…\nI lost.\pI guess I'm not very lucky today.\nI'll put off my BATTLE PIKE challenge\luntil tomorrow.$
translation: 啊，不要啊......\n我输了。\p好像我今天的运气不是很好，\n明天再去挑战\l对战管道吧。$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_ChooseFishingOverBattling
source: I believe I'm the only person here who,\nfor some unknown reason, would choose\lfishing over battling.\pHuh? You can't catch anything here?\nThat's disappointing…$
translation: 我想这儿除了我，再没有别人\n会因为某些原因不对战\l反而去钓鱼。\p嗯？这儿什么都钓不到？\n好失望......$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_KeepBattlingUntilIGetSymbol
source: Today, I'm going to keep battling, no\nmatter what, until I get a Symbol.$
translation: 今天，不论发生什么，我都要坚持战斗\n下去，直到获得象征为止。$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_YoureOffToChallengeDome
source: Oh? You're off to challenge\nthe BATTLE DOME?\pI'll wish you the best of luck.\nLet us both win our way up and meet\lin challenges.$
translation: 嗯？你要去挑战\n对战巨蛋？\p祝你好运，\n希望我们都会一路获胜下去，\l然后在挑战中相遇。$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_DomeIsHereGrandpa
source: Grandpa, over here!\nThe BATTLE DOME is here!\lGo get 'em, Grandpa!$
translation: 爷爷，过来过来！\n对战巨蛋在这儿！\l一定要赢啊，爷爷！$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_WontLetGentlemenBeatMe
source: Ah, so this here is the BATTLE DOME?\nI won't let GENTLEMEN beat me!\pBut where is the entrance?$
translation: 啊，这儿就是对战巨蛋了。\n我不会被绅士打败的！\p对了，入口在哪儿？$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_NothingHereNotLongAgo
source: There used to be nothing here not all\nthat long ago.\pBut, now look at this place! Amazing!\nI'll bring my mother out to see this.$
translation: 就在不久之前，\n这里还是一片荒原。\p但现在看看这里吧！简直是奇迹！\n我要带妈妈来看看。$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_FinallyArrivedAtFrontier
source: I've finally arrived at the BATTLE\nFRONTIER!\pI'm sure to grab attention with\nmy looks and ability!$
translation: 终于到达对战开拓区了！\p靠我的美貌和才能，\n肯定很快会成为焦点的！$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_SquareFilledWithToughPeople
source: Munch, munch…\pIt looks like this square's filled with\ntough people.\pMunch, munch…$
translation: 嘎吱嘎吱......\p这广场上好像聚集了\n很多非常强的人啊。\p嘎吱嘎吱......$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_LastTimeOurEyesMet
source: Huh? Will you listen to yourself?\nThat's nothing!\pWhy, the last time I cheered for him,\nour eyes met and sparks flew!$
translation: 哈，你要不要听听你在说什么？\n那什么都算不上！\p看看，我为他加油的时候，\n我们交汇的眼神里都射出了火花！$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_DomeAceLookedBecauseOfMyCheering
source:
Whaaaaaat?!
Pfft!\pThat only happened because
I happened to be sitting next to you!\pThe DOME ACE only looked our way
because my cheering was so loud!$
translation:
什--么？！
哼！\p这是因为我恰好
坐在你旁边而已！\p是因为我的加油声很大，
巨蛋超级巨星才会注意到这边的！$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_DomeAceIsMine
source:
Oh, shush!
Keep that racket down!\pYou fair-weather fans should stick
to cheering for some GYM LEADER!\pThe DOME ACE is mine!
The only idol for me!$
translation:
啊，嘘~嘘~
吵死了，安静一下啦！\p你该让你那些不坚定的追星族们
给别的道馆馆主加油！\p巨蛋超级巨星是我的！
是只属于我的偶像！$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_FansOverThereUsedToBeTrainers
source:
Those people squabbling over there…\pIt's hard to believe, but they once
were TRAINERS, and good ones, too.\pThey used to be incredibly tough,
and they were famous, too.\pBut they were obliterated by this
certain TRAINER at a tournament.\pThey were so thoroughly whipped,
they became smitten by the TRAINER.\pNow they're just fans of the TRAINER.
They go cheer for their idol at the\lBATTLE DOME every day now.$
translation:
那边吵架的那些人......\p真不敢相信那些人以前也都是
训练家，而且还挺厉害的。\p他们以前非常强，
同时也相当有名气。\p但在一场锦标赛中，他们都被
某个训练家击倒了。\p他们完全地失败了，
同时开始对那个训练家神魂颠倒。\p而现在，他们仅仅是那个训练家的
狂热者而已，每天每天地在\l对战巨蛋为他们的偶像加油助威。$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_MonWithLongTailInFrontier
source: I heard a rumor that someone saw\na POKéMON with an unusually long tail\lsomewhere in the BATTLE FRONTIER.\pIt must be adorable. I'm sure of it…\pOh, challenges can wait. I feel driven\nto find the delightful creature!$
translation: 有传言说有人在\n对战开拓区的某处看到\l一种尾巴特别长的宝可梦。\p我敢肯定，它一定很可爱......\p啊，挑战什么的都一边去吧，\n我要去找那个小家伙了！$

label: BattleFrontier_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_NeverSeenPokemon
source:
There was someone here using a 
POKéMON I've never seen before.\pI never learned about it at
TRAINER'S SCHOOL at least.\pI wonder where you can catch POKéMON
like that.$
translation:
有人使用过我从来没有
见过的宝可梦。\p至少我在训练家学校
还从没听说过。\p不知道那种宝可梦
在哪儿能捕捉呢？$

label: BattleFrontier_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_NextStopBattleArena
source: Okay! Next stop, the BATTLE ARENA!\nI'd better get the right POKéMON from\lthe PC Storage System.$
translation: 好了！下一站是对战竞技场！\n最好先去电脑寄放系统\l换出合适的宝可梦来。$

label: BattleFrontier_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_GoingThroughEveryChallenge
source: Giggle… I'm going to go through every\nchallenge with just this baby!$
translation: 咯咯......我可要和这个孩子\n一同赢得所有的比赛！$

label: BattleFrontier_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Skitty
source: SKITTY: Mya myaaah!$
translation: 向尾喵：喵 喵！$

label: BattleFrontier_RankingHall_Text_ExplainRankingHall
source: This is the RANKING HALL.\pThis is where we recognize the immortal\nTRAINERS who left great records in\lBATTLE FRONTIER events.$
translation: 这里是排名大厅。\p这里是我们表彰那些在\n对战开拓区中创造伟大纪录\l的流芳百世的训练家的地方。$

label: BattleFrontier_RankingHall_Text_DomePikeFactoryRecords
source: BATTLE DOME, BATTLE PIKE,\nand BATTLE FACTORY Records$
translation: 对战巨蛋，对战管道，\n和对战工厂的纪录$

label: BattleFrontier_RankingHall_Text_PalaceArenaPyramidRecords
source: BATTLE PALACE, BATTLE ARENA,\nand BATTLE PYRAMID Records$
translation: 对战宫殿，对战竞技场，\n和对战金字塔的纪录$

label: BattleFrontier_RankingHall_Text_IsYourNameOnThisList
source: Hi, is your name on this list?$
translation: 嘿，你的名字在上面吗？$

label: BattleFrontier_RankingHall_Text_WowThatsSuper
source: Wow, that's super!\nI'll have to try harder, too!$
translation: 哇，太厉害了！\n我也得更加努力了！$

label: BattleFrontier_RankingHall_Text_WorkHarderIfYouSawFriendsName
source: Oh, is that right?\pIf you saw your friend's name up here,\nI bet it would make you work harder!$
translation: 如果你看到你朋友的名字在上面，\n我猜你肯定会变得更加努力的！\p你说是不是？$

label: BattleFrontier_RankingHall_Text_MyNamesNotUpThere
source: Hmm…\nMy name's not up there…\pWell, it's only natural since I haven't\ntaken any challenges yet.$
translation: 嗯......\n我的名字不在上面......\p没错，这很正常，\n因为我从没参加过任何挑战。$

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_FirstTimeHereThisWay
source: Is it your first time here?\nPlease step this way!$
translation: 您是第一次来吗？\n这边请！$

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_WelcomeToBattleFrontier
source: The front lines of POKéMON battling!\nWelcome to the BATTLE FRONTIER!$
translation: 这里是宝可梦对战的最前线！\n欢迎来到对战开拓区！$

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_IssueFrontierPass
source: For a first-time visitor, we issue\nthe FRONTIER PASS.\pIt's for use at all the facilities\nin the BATTLE FRONTIER.\pHere you are!$
translation: 每位初次来访的客人都可以\n得到一张开拓通行证。\p它可以在对战开拓区的\n所有设施中使用。\p给，这是您的！$

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_ObtainedFrontierPass
source: {PLAYER} obtained\nthe FRONTIER PASS.$
translation: {PLAYER}获得了\n开拓通行证。$

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_PlacedTrainerCardInFrontierPass
source: {PLAYER} placed the TRAINER CARD\nin the FRONTIER PASS.$
translation: {PLAYER}把训练家卡\n收入了开拓通行证中。$

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_EnjoyBattleFrontier
source: We hope you enjoy all that the BATTLE\nFRONTIER has to offer!$
translation: 希望您能尽情享受\n对战开拓区的一切！$

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_IfItIsntPlayerYouCame
source: ???: Well, if it isn't {PLAYER}{KUN}!\nYou came out here!$
translation: ？？？：嗨，这不是{PLAYER}{KUN}吗！\n你终于来啦！$

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_OhMrScottGoodDay
source: GUIDE: Oh! MR. SCOTT, sir!\nGood day to you, sir!$
translation: 向导：啊，亚希达先生！\n您好！$

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_ScottGreatToSeeYouHere
source:
SCOTT: It's great to see you here,
it really is!\pI hope you'll take your time and
explore everywhere.\pNaturally, I hope you'll also experience
the pure essence of battling.\pI also have my quarters here, so feel
free to visit if you have time.$
translation:
亚希达：能在这里见到你真是太好了，
真的！\p希望你慢慢探索
这里的每个角落。\p当然，也希望你能在这里
体验到最纯粹的对战精髓。\p我在这儿也有房间，
有空记得随时来坐坐。$

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_YourGuideToFacilities
source: I'm your guide to the various facilities\nhere in the BATTLE FRONTIER.$
translation: 我是您的对战开拓区的\n各个设施的向导。$

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_LearnAboutWhich2
source: Which would you like to learn about?$
translation: 您想了解哪个设施呢？$

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_BattleTowerInfo
source: It is the gigantic tower considered\nto be the BATTLE FRONTIER's symbol.\pThere are four kinds of BATTLE ROOMS\nin the tower for SINGLE, DOUBLE, MULTI,\land LINK MULTI BATTLES.$
translation: 这座巨大的高塔被视为\n对战开拓区的标志。\p塔内有4种类型的对战间，\n分别用于单打、双打、多人和\l多人连线对战。$

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_BattleDomeInfo
source:
The BATTLE DOME is the large building
shaped like a huge egg.\pEvents named Battle Tourneys are held
in this facility.\pThe Battle Tourneys are offered in
two courses--for SINGLE and DOUBLE\lBATTLES.$
translation:
对战巨蛋是外形像是巨大的
蛋一样的建筑。\p这里会举办名为
对战锦标赛的活动。\p对战锦标赛有2种模式--
单打和双打对战。$

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_BattlePalaceInfo
source: The BATTLE PALACE is the red building\non the right of the BATTLE FRONTIER.\pThere are two kinds of BATTLE HALLS\nfor SINGLE and DOUBLE BATTLES.$
translation: 对战宫殿是位于对战开拓区\n右侧的红色建筑。\p里面有2种对战厅，\n分别用于单打和双打对战。$

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_BattleArenaInfo
source: The BATTLE ARENA is the dojo-like\nbuilding at the center-right of\lthe BATTLE FRONTIER.\pAn event called the Set KO Tourney\ntakes place at the BATTLE ARENA.$
translation: 对战竞技场是位于对战开拓区\n中央偏右的道场式建筑。\p这里会举办名为三回合\n定胜负锦标赛的活动。$

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_BattleFactoryInfo
source:
The BATTLE FACTORY is the large
building that is the closest to us.\pAn event called the Battle Swap
is conducted there.\pThe Battle Swap event is offered in
two courses for SINGLE and DOUBLE\lBATTLES.$
translation:
对战工厂是离我们最近的那个
大型建筑。\p这里会举办名为
交换式对战的活动。\p交换式对战分2种，
分别是单打和双打对战。$

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_BattlePikeInfo
source: The BATTLE PIKE is the building shaped\nlike a POKéMON at the center-left of\lthe BATTLE FRONTIER.\pAn event called the Battle Choice\nis conducted there.$
translation: 对战管道是位于对战开拓区\n中央偏左的宝可梦造型的建筑。\p这里会举办名为\n选择式对战的活动。$

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_BattlePyramidInfo
source: The BATTLE PYRAMID is the enormous\npyramid.\pAn event called the Battle Quest\nis conducted there.$
translation: 对战金字塔是巨大的金字塔建筑。\p这里会举办名为\n探索式对战的活动。$

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_RankingHallInfo
source: The RANKING HALL is located near\nthe BATTLE TOWER.\pThere, you may see the most fantastic\nrecords left by the TRAINERS that\ltook on the many challenges of\lthe BATTLE FRONTIER.$
translation: 排名大厅位于对战塔附近。\p那里可以看到挑战过对战开拓区各个\n设施的训练家们所留下的非凡纪录。$

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_ExchangeCornerInfo
source: The EXCHANGE SERVICE CORNER is near\nthe BATTLE TOWER.\pThe Battle Points you have earned in\nthe BATTLE FRONTIER may be exchanged\lfor fabulous prizes there.$
translation: 兑换服务区位于对战塔附近。\p可以用在对战开拓区得到的对战点数\n兑换精美的奖品。$

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_YourGuideToRules
source: I'm your guide to the basic rules that\nare common to all the challenges\loffered by the facilities in the BATTLE\lFRONTIER.$
translation: 我是您的对战开拓区各个设施中\n各项通用基本规则的向导。$

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_LearnAboutWhat
source: What would you like to learn about?$
translation: 您想了解什么内容呢？$

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_LevelModeInfo
source: All the challenges at the BATTLE\nFRONTIER's facilities come in\ltwo courses--Level 50 and Open Level.$
translation: 对战开拓区的所有挑战设施\n都提供2种模式可供选择--\lLv. 50级和自由等级。$

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_Level50Info
source:
The Level 50 course is open to POKéMON
up to and including Level 50.\pPlease keep in mind, however, that
no TRAINER you face will have any\lPOKéMON below Level 50.\pThis course is the entry level for
battles at the BATTLE FRONTIER.\pTo begin, we hope you will challenge
this course.$
translation:
Lv. 50级允许等级50级以内的
宝可梦参加。\p但是，您遇到的训练家不会
使用等级50以内的宝可梦。\p这是对战开拓区的
入门级对战，\p我们建议您从这个模式
开始挑战。$

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_OpenLevelInfo
source:
The Open Level course places no limit
on the levels of POKéMON entering\lchallenges.\pThe levels of your opponents will
be adjusted to match the levels of\lyour POKéMON.\pHowever, no TRAINER you face will
have any POKéMON below Level 60.$
translation:
自由等级对于参加的宝可梦
没有等级限制。\p对手的宝可梦等级会根据
您的宝可梦等级进行调整。\p但是，您遇到的训练家不会
使用等级60以内的宝可梦。$

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_MonEntryInfo
source:
Virtually any kind of POKéMON may take
on the challenges at all facilities.\pEGGS and certain kinds of POKéMON,
however, are not permitted.\pThe numbers of POKéMON required for
challenges will depend on the facility.\pAt all facilities, however, two or more
of the same kind of POKéMON are not\lpermitted.$
translation:
绝大多数种类的宝可梦都可以
参加所有设施里面的挑战，\p但蛋和某些特定种类的宝可梦
无法参加。\p挑战所需的宝可梦数量
取决于具体设施。\p但在所有设施中，都无法使用2只
或以上的相同种类的宝可梦。$

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_HoldItemsInfo
source: When entering a challenge at a BATTLE\nFRONTIER facility, POKéMON may not\lbe holding the same kind of item.\pPlease make sure that all POKéMON\nentering a challenge are holding\ldifferent items.$
translation: 在对战开拓区参加挑战时，\n宝可梦不能携带相同的道具。\p请确保所有参加挑战的宝可梦\n都携带了不同的道具。$

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_YourGuideToFrontierPass
source: I'm your guide to the FRONTIER PASS.$
translation: 我是您的开拓通行证向导。$

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_LearnAboutWhich1
source: Which would you like to learn about?$
translation: 您想了解什么内容呢？$

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_SymbolsInfo
source:
There are seven facilities at
the BATTLE FRONTIER.\pTRAINERS who gain recognition for
their abilities may be rewarded with\lsymbols from each of the facilities.\pTo earn a symbol, TRAINERS may need
to defeat other TRAINERS in a row,\land may need to win events repeatedly.\pIt's certainly not easy to win symbols.
I wish you the best of luck!$
translation:
对战开拓区共设有
7个挑战设施。\p训练家若展现出卓越实力，
就能获得各设施颁发的象征。\p要获得象征，训练家可能需要
连续击败多位对手，\l或多次赢得赛事。\p赢得象征绝非易事，
祝您好运！$

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_RecordedBattleInfo
source:
It is possible to record one battle
on your FRONTIER PASS.\pYou may record a battle you had with
a friend or friends.\pOr you may record a battle conducted
at the BATTLE FRONTIER excluding\lmatches at the BATTLE PIKE or\lthe BATTLE PYRAMID.\pYou may choose to record your match
at the end of a battle.$
translation:
可以在您的开拓通行证上
记录下您的一场对战。\p您可以记录您与朋友
之间进行的对战，\p或记录下在对战开拓区进行过的对战，
但不包括对战管道以及对战金字塔中\l的对战。\p对战结束时您可以选择
是否要记录对战。$

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_BattlePointsInfo
source: Battle Points are rewards given to\nTRAINERS who battled outstandingly\lat the BATTLE FRONTIER.\pYou may trade in your Battle Points\nfor prizes at the EXCHANGE SERVICE\lCORNER.$
translation: 对战点数是向对战开拓区中表现出色\n的训练家给予的奖励。\p您可以在兑换服务区用\n对战点数兑换奖品。$

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_WelcomeToBattleFrontier
source:
SCOTT: Well, hello and welcome!
Heheh… Sorry about the cramped space.\pAnyway, {PLAYER}{KUN}, let me formally
welcome you to the BATTLE FRONTIER.\pThis is my dream come true.
It took me years and years, but I've\lfinally given shape to my dream.$
translation:
亚希达：欢迎欢迎！
嘿嘿......抱歉空间有点狭窄。\p总之，{PLAYER}{KUN}，
请让我正式欢迎你来到对战开拓区。\p这是我毕生梦想的实现，
经过漫长的岁月终于得以成型。$

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_HowMuchEffortItTookToMakeReal
source:
On reflection, it was a terribly long
journey…\pI left home alone on a quest to find
strong TRAINERS.\pNo one can imagine how much effort
or time it took to make this real.$
translation:
回想起来，这一路还真是
走了很久很久......\p独自离家踏上寻找
强大训练家的旅程......\p其中所付出的时间与
努力真是难以想象。$

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_HaveThisAsMementoOfOurPathsCrossing
source:
But that's all in the past.
No point dwelling on that!\pAll I want for you is to enjoy battling
to your heart's content here.\p{PLAYER}{KUN}, I want you to have this
as a memento for all the time our\lpaths crossed on our journeys.$
translation: 不说这些陈年往事了！\p我只希望你能在这里\n尽情享受对战！\p{PLAYER}{KUN}，请收下这个纪念我们\n旅途中屡次相遇的礼物。$

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_ObtainedXBattlePoints
source: {PLAYER} obtained\n{STR_VAR_1} Battle Point(s).$
translation: {PLAYER}获得了\n{STR_VAR_1}BP的对战点数。$

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_ExplainBattlePoints
source:
SCOTT: You can check your Battle
Points on your FRONTIER PASS.\pThe more success you have here at
the BATTLE FRONTIER, the more Battle\lPoints you will collect.\pUse your Battle Points the way you
see fit, like trading them for items.$
translation:
亚希达：你可以在开拓通行证上
查看你对战点数的数量。\p你在对战开拓区获得的胜利越多，
收集的对战点数就越多。\p这些对战点数随你所用，
比如用来兑换道具什么的。$

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_ExpectingGreatThings
source: I'm expecting great things from you!$
translation: 期待你的精彩表现！$

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_WhyIGoSeekingTrainers
source:
SCOTT: Every TRAINER is an individual.
They all lead lives of their own.\pBut when they're in a battle,
it doesn't matter who they are.\pThey're all the same!\pI love the purity of battle,
where everyone is equal.\pThat's why I go everywhere seeking
TRAINERS who are serious about\lbattling, and invite them here.$
translation:
亚希达：每个训练家都是一个独特的人，
他们都过着自己的生活。\p但当他们进行对战的时候，
他们是谁并不重要。\p他们都是一样的！\p我喜欢这样纯粹的对战，
大家都是平等的。\p因此我环游各地，
寻找重视对战的训练家，\l邀请他们来到这个地方。$

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_HaveYouMetFrontierBrain
source:
SCOTT: Have you met any of
the FRONTIER BRAINS?\pBetter yet, have you obtained any
symbols from them?\pI handpicked the FRONTIER BRAINS
as the toughest TRAINERS anywhere.\pBut I'm sure that seeing how tough
you are will startle even them!$
translation:
亚希达：你与开拓之脑
交过手了吗？\p还是说，你已经得到
他们的象征了？\p开拓之脑是我从世界各地
精挑细选出来的最强训练家，\p但我能肯定他们看到你的能力，
也会大吃一惊！$

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_MayFindWildMonsInFrontier
source:
SCOTT: You don't just train for battle,
right?\pI think I remember you working on
a POKéDEX as well.\pWell, guess what?\pYou may run into wild POKéMON in
the BATTLE FRONTIER somewhere…\lFufufu!$
translation:
亚希达：你的目标不只是对战吧？
对吗？\p我好像还记得你也在
收集宝可梦图鉴。\p猜猜怎么着？\p在对战开拓区的某些地方
你也能遇到野生宝可梦......\l呼呼呼！$

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_YouveCollectedAllSilverSymbols
source:
SCOTT: Are you enjoying things in
the BATTLE FRONTIER?\p…Wait a second…
Oh!\pYour FRONTIER PASS!
You've collected the full set\lof silver symbols!\pThat's more than impressive!
You are tough, just as I suspected!\pNormally, I wouldn't do something
like this, but this is a special time!\pI want you to have this.
I'm sure you can put it to proper use.$
translation:
亚希达：在对战开拓区
玩得开心吗？\p......等等......
啊！\p你的开拓通行证！
你已经收集到了\l所有的银色象征！\p简直超乎想象！
如我所料，你真的强大无比！\p虽说通常我不会这样，
不过这次就让我破例一回！\p相信你一定
能妥善使用。$

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_YouveCollectedAllGoldSymbols
source:
SCOTT: I hope you're enjoying
everything in the BATTLE FRONTIER.\p…Wait a second…
Oh, my disbelieving eyes!\pYour FRONTIER PASS!
You've gathered up the full set\lof gold symbols!\pThat's more than stupendous!
You're incredible, just as I suspected!\p… … … … … …\p{PLAYER}, you've got to accept this!\pI think you will be able to
appreciate the value of my gift!$
translation:
亚希达：希望你享受
对战开拓区的一切。\p......等等......
难以置信！\p你的开拓通行证！
你已经收集到了\l所有的金色象征！\p简直神乎其技！
如我所料，你真的无与伦比！\p...... ...... ......\p{PLAYER}，请务必收下这个！\p相信你一定能理解
这份礼物的价值！$

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_SoGladIBroughtYouHere
source: I must say I have the gift of knowing\na good TRAINER when I see one.\pI'm so glad I had the foresight to\nbring you here!$
translation: 不得不说我有着与生俱来的\n鉴别优秀训练家的眼光。\p我当初能邀请你来\n真是有先见之明！$

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_BerryPocketStuffed
source: Your BERRY POCKET seems to\nbe stuffed.$
translation: 你的树果口袋好像\n已经塞满了。$

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_Beat50TrainersInARow
source: SCOTT: Oh, I heard about you!\nHow you ruled the BATTLE TOWER!\lYou beat over 50 TRAINERS in a row?\pThat's fantastic!\nI want you to have this!$
translation: 亚希达：啊，我听说过你的战绩了！\n称霸对战塔，取得50连胜？\p太精彩了！\n把这个拿去吧！$

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_Beat100TrainersInARow
source: SCOTT: Oh, my! I heard about you!\nHow you overwhelmed the BATTLE TOWER!\lYou beat over 100 TRAINERS in a row?\pThat's ridiculously spectacular!\nYou've got to have this!$
translation: 亚希达：啊天哪，我听说你的战绩了！\n横扫对战塔，取得100连胜？\p简直精彩绝伦！\n这是属于你的！$

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_ExpectingToHearEvenGreaterThings
source: I'll be expecting to hear even greater\nthings about you now!$
translation: 我期待以后听到你\n更加精彩的表现！$

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_ComeBackForThisLater
source: Oops, well, if you have too much\nstuff, come back for this later.$
translation: 哦，你装的东西太多了，\n收拾收拾再来吧。$

label: CaveOfOrigin_B1F_Text_WallaceStory
source:
Ah, so you are {PLAYER}{KUN}?
I've heard tales of your exploits.\pMy name is WALLACE.\pI was once the GYM LEADER of
SOOTOPOLIS, but something came up.\pSo now, I've entrusted my mentor JUAN
with the GYM's operation.\p… … … … … …
… … … … … …\pGROUDON and KYOGRE, the two POKéMON
wreaking havoc here, are considered\lto be super-ancient POKéMON.\pBut there aren't just two super-
ancient POKéMON.\pThere is one more somewhere.\pSomewhere, there is a super-
ancient POKéMON named RAYQUAZA.\pIt's said that it was RAYQUAZA that
becalmed the two combatants in\lthe distant past.\pBut even I have no clue as to
RAYQUAZA's whereabouts…$
translation:
啊，你就是{PLAYER}{KUN}吗？
你的活跃表现我早有耳闻。\p我的名字是米可利。\p曾经是琉璃市的道馆馆主，
不过因为某些原因，\p现在我把管理道馆的事情
托付给我的老师亚当了。\p...... ...... ......
...... ...... ......\p在这里肆虐的2只宝可梦--
固拉多和盖欧卡，\l被称为超古代宝可梦，\p然而，超古代宝可梦
并不止这2只......\p在世界的某处
还存在着第3只--\p没错，那就是被称为烈空坐
的超古代宝可梦。\p传说在远古时期，
正是烈空坐平息了\l那2只宝可梦的的斗争。\p可就连我也不清楚它
如今究竟身在何处......$

label: CaveOfOrigin_B1F_Text_WhereIsRayquaza
source: WALLACE: {PLAYER}{KUN}, do you perhaps\nknow where RAYQUAZA is now?\pIf you do, please tell me.$
translation: 米可利：{PLAYER}{KUN}，\n莫非你知晓如今烈空坐的下落？\p可以的话，\n请务必告诉我。$

label: CaveOfOrigin_B1F_Text_ButWereInCaveOfOrigin
source: WALLACE: The CAVE OF ORIGIN?\pBut that's right here!\nI need you to do better than that!\pPlease, I need you to think about\nwhere RAYQUAZA might be right now.$
translation: 米可利：觉醒神殿？\p那不就是这里吗！\n拜托你再认真点！\p请你帮我再想想烈空坐\n现在究竟可能会在哪里。$

label: CaveOfOrigin_B1F_Text_OldLadyDidntMentionThat
source:
WALLACE: MT. PYRE?\pBut when I met the old lady there
earlier, she made no mention of it.\pI very much doubt that the old lady
would try to hide something from me…\p{PLAYER}{KUN}, could you think about this
more carefully for me?$
translation:
米可利：送神山？\p但在我之前去见那里的老婆婆时，
她并未提及此事。\p我不认为她会刻意地
隐瞒什么......\p{PLAYER}{KUN}，
能请你再认真想想吗？$

label: CaveOfOrigin_B1F_Text_CantYouRememberSomehow
source: WALLACE: Huh? You don't remember?\nHmm… That's a problem…\pCan't you remember somehow?$
translation: 米可利：哎？不记得了？\n唔......这就难办了......\p真的什么也回想\n不起来了吗？$

label: CaveOfOrigin_B1F_Text_WellHeadToSkyPillar
source: WALLACE: The SKY PILLAR?\pThat's it!\nIt must be the SKY PILLAR!\p{PLAYER}{KUN}, there's not a moment to lose!\nWe'll head to the SKY PILLAR right away!$
translation: 米可利：天空之柱？\p没错！\n一定就是那里！\p{PLAYER}{KUN}，事不宜迟！\n我们这就出发去天空之柱！$

label: CeladonCity_Condominiums_1F_Text_Meowth
source: MEOWTH: Meow!$
translation: 喵喵：喵！$

label: CeladonCity_Condominiums_1F_Text_TryThisDrinkInstead
source: You shouldn't spend all your money\non drinks.\pTry this instead.$
translation: 你不该把钱都花在饮料上。\p试试这个。$

label: CeladonCity_Condominiums_1F_Text_NothingBeatsThirstLikeTea
source: Nothing beats thirst like some hot\nTEA.\pIt really is the best.$
translation: 没有什么能比热茶更解渴了。\p茶是最好的饮品。$

label: CeladonCity_Condominiums_1F_Text_MyDearMonsKeepMeCompany
source: My dear POKéMON keep me company.\nMEOWTH even brings money home!$
translation: 我亲爱的宝可梦一直陪伴着我。\n喵喵还会拾钱回来呢！$

label: CeladonCity_Condominiums_1F_Text_DaisyComesToBuyTea
source:
Oh, hello, dearie.
Did you enjoy my TEA?\pBy the way, dear. Are you, by any
chance, from PALLET TOWN?\pA girl from PALLET TOWN, DAISY,
she enjoys TEA every day.\pShe visits the CELADON DEPT. STORE
to buy some TEA.$
translation:
你好哦，甜心。
我的茶好喝吗？\p对了亲爱的。你是不是从
真新镇来的吗？\p一个从真新镇来的小女孩，叫奈奈美，
她每天都要喝茶。\p她经常去玉虹百货大楼买茶叶。$

label: CeladonCity_Condominiums_1F_Text_Clefairy
source: CLEFAIRY: Pi pippippi!$
translation: 皮皮：皮 皮皮皮！$

label: CeladonCity_Condominiums_1F_Text_Nidoran
source: NIDORAN♀: Kya kyaoo!$
translation: 尼多兰：咔 咔呜！$

label: CeladonCity_Condominiums_1F_Text_ManagersSuite
source: CELADON MANSION\nManager's Suite$
translation: 玉虹大厦\n经理套间$

label: CeladonCity_Condominiums_2F_Text_GameFreakMeetingRoom
source: GAME FREAK Meeting Room$
translation: GAME FREAK会议室$

label: CeladonCity_Condominiums_3F_Text_ImTheProgrammer
source: Me?\nI'm the programmer!$
translation: 我？\n我是程序员！$

label: CeladonCity_Condominiums_3F_Text_ImTheGraphicArtist
source: I'm the graphic artist!\nI drew you!$
translation: 我是做平面设计的！\n你就是我画出来的哦！$

label: CeladonCity_Condominiums_3F_Text_IWroteTheStory
source: I wrote the story!\nIsn't ERIKA cute?\pI like MISTY a lot, too!\nOh, and SABRINA, I like her!$
translation: 我写了这个故事！\n莉佳很可爱吧？\p我也很喜欢小霞！\n啊，还有娜姿，我很喜欢！$

label: CeladonCity_Condominiums_3F_Text_ImGameDesignerShowMeFinishedPokedex
source: Is that right?\pI'm the game designer!\pFilling up your POKéDEX is tough,\nbut don't quit!\pWhen you finish, come tell me!$
translation: 程序运行正常吗？\p我是游戏设计师！\p集齐宝可梦图鉴非常困难，\n但别放弃！\p如果你完成了图鉴，就来找我吧！$

label: CeladonCity_Condominiums_3F_Text_CompletedPokedexCongratulations
source: Wow! Excellent!\nYou completed your POKéDEX!\lCongratulations!\l…$
translation: 哇噢！棒极了！\n你完成了宝可梦图鉴！\l祝贺你！\l......$

label: CeladonCity_Condominiums_3F_Text_ItsTheGameProgram
source: It's the game program! Messing with\nit could bug out the game!$
translation: 这是游戏程序！弄乱了的话\n游戏会出故障的！$

label: CeladonCity_Condominiums_3F_Text_SomeonesPlayingGame
source: Someone's playing a game instead of\nworking!$
translation: 有些人是在玩游戏，\n没在工作！$

label: CeladonCity_Condominiums_3F_Text_ItsScriptBetterNotLookAtEnding
source: It's the script!\nBetter not look at the ending!$
translation: 这是脚本！\n可别偷看结局哦！$

label: CeladonCity_Condominiums_3F_Text_GameFreakDevelopmentRoom
source: GAME FREAK Development Room$
translation: GAME FREAK开发室$

label: CeladonCity_Condominiums_RoofRoom_Text_TheresNothingIDontKnow
source:
There is nothing that I don't know,
like I wrote on the blackboard.\pI know about the world of POKéMON
in your GAME BOY ADVANCE!\pGet together with your friends and
enjoy trading POKéMON!$
translation:
就像我在黑板上写的那样，
我无所不知。\p我了解在GAME BOY ADVANCE中的
宝可梦世界！\p和你的朋友们一起玩吧，
祝你们交换宝可梦愉快！$

label: CeladonCity_Condominiums_RoofRoom_Text_ObtainedAnEevee
source: {PLAYER} obtained an EEVEE!$
translation: {PLAYER}获得了伊布！$

label: CeladonCity_Condominiums_RoofRoom_Text_WirelessAdapterLecture
source: POKéMON Lecture\pPlaying with the Wireless Adapter$
translation: 宝可梦讲座\p用无线适配器游戏$

label: CeladonCity_Condominiums_RoofRoom_Text_ReadWhichHeading
source: Which heading do you want to read?$
translation: 你想了解哪部分？$

label: CeladonCity_Condominiums_RoofRoom_Text_ExplainWirelessClub
source: The POKéMON WIRELESS CLUB is\nupstairs at any POKéMON CENTER.\pVisit one to link up with friend(s)\nusing your Wireless Adapter.$
translation: 宝可梦无线俱乐部\n在宝可梦中心的上层。\p去那里通过无线适配器\n和你的朋友通讯。$

label: CeladonCity_Condominiums_RoofRoom_Text_ExplainDirectCorner
source:
To link only with a friend, go to
the DIRECT CORNER.\pIt is the right counter at the
POKéMON WIRELESS CLUB.\pGo into the TRADE CORNER or the
COLOSSEUM with your friend.$
translation: 和单个朋友通讯，\n就去直连房间。\p宝可梦无线俱乐部右边的柜台就是。\p和你的朋友一起进入\n通信房间或者大竞技场。$

label: CeladonCity_Condominiums_RoofRoom_Text_ExplainUnionRoom
source:
To link and communicate with
anyone, go to the UNION ROOM.\pIt is the left counter at the
POKéMON WIRELESS CLUB.\pGo to the UNION ROOM and enjoy
meeting other TRAINERS.$
translation: 如果要和任意其他人通讯，\n就去联合房间。\p宝可梦无线俱乐部左边的柜台就是。\p去联合房间尽情享受和其他训练家\n通讯的乐趣吧！$

label: CeladonCity_Condominiums_RoofRoom_Text_PamphletOnTMs
source: It's a pamphlet on TMs.\p… …\pThere are fifty TMs in all.\pThere are also seven HMs that\ncan be used repeatedly.\pSILPH CO.$
translation: 是本关于技能学习机的小册子。\p...... ......\p一共有50种技能机器。\p还有7种能反复使用的秘传机器。\p西尔佛公司。$

label: CeladonCity_Condominiums_Roof_Text_IKnowEverything
source: I KNOW EVERYTHING!$
translation: 我知道这个世界的一切！$

label: CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_1F_Text_WelcomeToDeptStore
source: Hello!\nWelcome to CELADON DEPT. STORE.\pThe board on the right describes\nthe store layout.$
translation: 你好！\n欢迎光临玉虹百货大楼。\p右边的告示板\n罗列了商场的布局。$

label: CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_1F_Text_FloorDescriptions
source: 1F: SERVICE COUNTER\p2F: TRAINER'S MARKET\p3F: TV GAME SHOP\p4F: WISE MAN GIFTS\p5F: DRUGSTORE\pROOFTOP SQUARE: VENDING MACHINES$
translation: 一楼：服务台\p二楼：训练家商店\p三楼：电玩商店\p四楼：神秘的礼物\p五楼：药店\p天台：自动售货机$

label: CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_1F_Text_ServiceCounter
source: 1F: SERVICE COUNTER$
translation: 一楼：服务台$

label: CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_2F_Text_SuperRepelMorePowerfulRepel
source: SUPER REPEL keeps weak POKéMON at\nbay…\pHmm, it's a more powerful REPEL.$
translation: 白银喷雾可以防止\n弱小的宝可梦靠近你......\p嗯，它是种效果更好的除虫喷雾。$

label: CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_2F_Text_BuyReviveForLongOutings
source: For long outings, you should buy\nREVIVE.$
translation: 长途旅行的话，\n你该买些活力碎片带着。$

label: CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_2F_Text_FloorSign
source: Top-Grade Items for TRAINERS!\p2F: TRAINER'S MARKET$
translation: 为训练家准备的顶级物品！\p二楼：训练家商店$

label: CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_2F_Text_LanceComesToBuyCapes
source: We have a customer, LANCE, who\noccasionally comes.\pHe always buys capes.\pI wonder… Does he have many\nidentical capes at home?$
translation: 我们有个偶尔会来光顾的客人，\n就是渡。\p他总是来买披风。\p我很想知道......他家里是不是有很多\n一模一样的披风？$

label: CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_3F_Text_OTStandsForOriginalTrainer
source: Captured POKéMON are registered\nwith an ID No. and the OT.\pOT stands for “Original TRAINER” -\nthe TRAINER that caught it first.$
translation: 收服后的宝可梦会生成\n"ID号码"和"主人"(OT)。\pOT是"初始训练家"的简称--\n指的是最初收服它的训练家。$

label: CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_3F_Text_BuddyTradingKangaskhanForHaunter
source: All right!\pMy buddy's going to trade me his\nKANGASKHAN for my HAUNTER!$
translation: 好极了！\p我的朋友打算用他的\n袋兽和我的鬼斯通交换！$

label: CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_3F_Text_HaunterEvolvedOnTrade
source: Come on, HAUNTER!\pI love HAUNTER!\nI collect them!\pHuh?\pHAUNTER turned into a different\nPOKéMON while being traded!$
translation: 来吧，鬼斯通！\p我喜欢鬼斯通！\n我一直在收集它！\p啊？\p鬼斯通在通讯后变成了\n另一种宝可梦！$

label: CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_3F_Text_CanIdentifyTradeMonsByID
source: You can identify POKéMON you get\nin trades by their ID Numbers.$
translation: 你可以通过ID号码\n来辨识通讯交换来的宝可梦。$

label: CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_3F_Text_ItsSuperNES
source: It's a Super NES.$
translation: 这是一个超级红白机。$

label: CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_3F_Text_AnRPG
source: An RPG!\nThere's no time for that!$
translation: 一款角色扮演游戏！\n现在可不是玩游戏的时候！$

label: CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_3F_Text_SportsGame
source: A sports game!\nDad'll like that!$
translation: 一款体育游戏！\n是爸爸喜欢的游戏！$

label: CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_3F_Text_PuzzleGame
source: A puzzle game!\nLooks addictive!$
translation: 一款拼图游戏！\n看起来很有趣！$

label: CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_3F_Text_FightingGame
source: A fighting game!\nLooks tough!$
translation: 一款格斗游戏！\n看上去很过瘾！$

label: CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_3F_Text_TVGameShop
source: 3F: TV GAME SHOP$
translation: 三楼：电玩商店$

label: CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_3F_Text_RedGreenBothArePokemon
source: Red and Green!\nBoth are POKéMON!$
translation: 火红和叶绿！\n都是精灵宝可梦游戏！$

label: Text_CounterTeach
source:
Oh, hi!
I finally finished POKéMON.\pNot done yet? How about I teach
you a good move?\pThe move I have in mind is
COUNTER.\pNot like the one I'm leaning on,
mind you!$
translation:
嗨，你好！
我终于把精灵宝可梦通关了。\p你还没通关吗？
我教你个不错的技能怎么样？\p这个技能叫作双倍奉还。\p提醒你，
这不是我唯一依靠的技能！$

label: Text_CounterDeclined
source: You're not interested? Come see\nme if you change your mind.$
translation: 你没兴趣学啊？\n要是改变主意了就来找我吧。$

label: Text_CounterWhichMon
source: Which POKéMON should I teach\nCOUNTER to?$
translation: 我该让哪只宝可梦学双倍奉还呢？$

label: Text_CounterTaught
source: Are you using that COUNTER move\nI taught your POKéMON?$
translation: 你在用我教给你宝可梦的双倍奉还技能吗？$

label: CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_4F_Text_GettingPokeDollAsPresent
source: I'm getting a present for my\ngirlfriend.\pI guess a POKé DOLL will be it.\nIt's the popular thing.$
translation: 我在为我女朋友挑礼物。\p我觉得皮皮玩偶不错。\n这东西很流行。$

label: CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_4F_Text_CanRunAwayWithPokeDoll
source: I heard something useful.\pIf a wild POKéMON appears, you can\ndistract it with a POKé DOLL.\pYou can run away while the wild\nPOKéMON is distracted.$
translation: 告诉你个有用的信息。\p如果野生的宝可梦出现，你能\n用皮皮玩偶转移它的注意力。\p你就能趁机逃离和它的战斗了。$

label: CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_4F_Text_FloorSign
source: Express yourself with gifts!\n4F: WISE MAN GIFTS\pEvolution Special!\nElement STONES on sale now!$
translation: 请尽情挑选礼物！\n四楼：神秘的礼物\p进化专场！\n进化石特价热卖中！$

label: CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_5F_Text_ExplainStatEnhancers
source:
POKéMON stat enhancers can be
bought only here.\pHP UP increases the base HP of a
POKéMON.\pCALCIUM raises the base SP. ATK
stat of one POKéMON.\pZINC boosts the base SP. DEF stat
of one POKéMON.\pCARBOS enhances the base SPEED
stat.$
translation: 只有这里才能买到\n宝可梦能力增强剂。\pHP提升剂增加宝可梦的基础HP。\p特攻增强剂提升宝可梦的基础特攻。\p特防增强剂提升宝可梦的基础特防。\p速度增强剂提升宝可梦的基础速度。$

label: CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_5F_Text_HereForStatEnhancers
source:
I'm here for POKéMON stat
enhancers.\pPROTEIN increases the base ATTACK
power.\pIRON increases the base DEFENSE
stat.$
translation: 我是来这里\n买宝可梦能力增强剂的。\p攻击增强剂增加宝可梦的基础攻击。\p防御增强剂增加宝可梦的基础防御。$

label: CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_5F_Text_Drugstore
source: 5F: DRUGSTORE$
translation: 五楼：药店$

label: CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_Roof_Text_ImThirstyGiveHerDrink
source: I'm thirsty!\nI want something to drink!\p{FONT_NORMAL}Give her a drink?$
translation: 我渴！\n我要饮料嘛！\p{FONT_NORMAL}给她一杯喝的吗？$

label: CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_Roof_Text_GiveWhichDrink
source: Give her which drink?$
translation: 给她一杯喝的吗？$

label: CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_Roof_Text_YayFreshWaterHaveThis
source: Yay!\pFRESH WATER!\pThank you!\nYou can have this from me!$
translation: 太好了！\p是美味之水！\p谢谢你！\n给你这个！$

label: Text_ReceivedItemFromLittleGirl
source: {PLAYER} received a {STR_VAR_2}\nfrom the little girl.$
translation: {PLAYER}从小女孩那里\n获得了一个{STR_VAR_2}。$

label: CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_Roof_Text_ExplainTM16
source: TM16 contains LIGHT SCREEN.\pIt's a move that weakens the power\nof special attacks by your foe.$
translation: TM16是光墙。\p这个技能可以\n削弱你对手的特殊攻击。$

label: CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_Roof_Text_YaySodaPopHaveThis
source: Yay!\pSODA POP!\pThank you!\nYou can have this from me!$
translation: 太好了！\p是劲爽汽水！\p谢谢你！\n给你这个！$

label: CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_Roof_Text_ExplainTM20
source: TM20 contains SAFEGUARD.\pIt's a move that prevents status\nproblems among your POKéMON.$
translation: TM20是神秘护身。\p这个技能可以\n使你的宝可梦免受状态效果影响。$

label: CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_Roof_Text_YayLemonadeHaveThis
source: Yay!\pLEMONADE!\pThank you!\nYou can have this from me!$
translation: 太好了！\p是果汁牛奶！\p谢谢你！\n给你这个！$

label: CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_Roof_Text_ExplainTM33
source: TM33 contains REFLECT.\pIt's a move that weakens the power\nof physical attacks by your foe.$
translation: TM33是反射壁。\p这个技能可以\n削弱你对手的物理攻击。$

label: CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_Roof_Text_DontHaveSpaceForThis
source: You don't have space for this!$
translation: 你的包包满了！$

label: CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_Roof_Text_ImNotThirstyAfterAll
source: No, thank you!\nI'm not thirsty after all!$
translation: 不用了，谢谢！\n我一点不渴了！$

label: CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_Roof_Text_MySisterIsImmature
source: My sister is a TRAINER, believe it\nor not.\pBut, she's so immature, she drives\nme nuts!$
translation: 信不信由你，\n我妹妹也是一个训练家。\p不过，她太任性了，\n都快把我逼疯了！$

label: CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_Roof_Text_ImThirstyIWantDrink
source: I'm thirsty!\nI want something to drink!$
translation: 我渴！\n我要喝饮料嘛！$

label: CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_Roof_Text_FloorSign
source: ROOFTOP SQUARE:\nVENDING MACHINES$
translation: 天台：\n自动售货机$

label: CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_Roof_Text_VendingMachineWhatDoesItHave
source: A vending machine!\nWhat does it have?$
translation: 一台自动售货机！\n想买点什么？$

label: CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_Roof_Text_NotEnoughMoney
source: Oops, not enough money!$
translation: 不好意思，钱不够！$

label: CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_Roof_Text_DrinkCanPoppedOut
source: A can of {STR_VAR_1} popped out!$
translation: 一罐{STR_VAR_1}的饮料出来了！$

label: CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_Roof_Text_NoMoreRoomForStuff
source: There's no more room for stuff!$
translation: 你的背包满了！$

label: CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_Roof_Text_NotThirsty
source: Not thirsty!$
translation: 不渴了！$

label: CeladonCity_Text_GotMyKoffingInCinnabar
source: I got my KOFFING in CINNABAR.\pIt's usually nice, but it breathes\npoison when it's angry.$
translation: 我在红莲得到了瓦斯弹。\p它很棒，不过每次它一生气就\n会喷出毒气。$

label: CeladonCity_Text_GymIsGreatFullOfWomen
source: Heheh! This GYM is great!\nIt's full of women!$
translation: 呵呵呵呵！这个道馆很来劲啊！\n里面全都是女生啊！$

label: CeladonCity_Text_GameCornerIsBadForCitysImage
source: CELADON takes pride in its efforts\nto keep the city beautiful.\pThat's why the new GAME CORNER is\nbad for our city's image.$
translation: 玉虹市长久不变的靓景一直是\n城市引以为豪的地方。\p但是这样一来游戏厅的营业\n是不利于市容市貌的。$

label: CeladonCity_Text_BlewItAllAtSlots
source: Moan…\nI blew it all at the slots!\pI knew I should have cashed in my\nCOINS for prizes!$
translation: 哇......\n我玩老虎机人品爆发啦！\p赶紧用代币去兑换超级\n大奖去！$

label: CeladonCity_Text_MyTrustedPalPoliwrath
source: This is my trusted pal, POLIWRATH.\pIt evolved from a POLIWHIRL when\nI used a WATER STONE.$
translation: 这是我最信任的朋友，蚊香泳士！\p当我使用水之石之后，\n它从蚊香君进化过来了。$

label: CeladonCity_Text_Poliwrath
source: POLIWRATH: Ribi ribit!$
translation: 蚊香泳士 哩吡哩吡特！$

label: CeladonCity_Text_GetLostOrIllPunchYou
source: What are you staring at?\nGet lost, or I'll punch you.$
translation: 你在看什么呢？\n滚开，不然我就揍你。$

label: CeladonCity_Text_KeepOutOfTeamRocketsWay
source: Keep out of TEAM ROCKET's way!$
translation: 离火箭队远点！$

label: CeladonCity_Text_ExplainXAccuracyDireHit
source:
TRAINER TIPS\pX ACCURACY boosts the accuracy of
techniques.\pDIRE HIT jacks up the likelihood
of critical hits.\pGet your items at the CELADON
DEPT. STORE!$
translation: 训练家贴士\p命中强化能提高攻击的准确性。\p致命攻击提高触发命中要害的几率。\p它们在玉虹百货大楼都能买到！$

label: CeladonCity_Text_CitySign
source: CELADON CITY\nThe City of Rainbow Dreams$
translation: 玉虹市\n拥有彩虹般梦想的城市$

label: CeladonCity_Text_GymSign
source: CELADON CITY POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: ERIKA\lThe Nature-Loving Princess!$
translation: 玉虹市宝可梦道馆\n馆主：莉佳\l热爱自然的公主！$

label: CeladonCity_Text_MansionSign
source: CELADON MANSION$
translation: 玉虹大厦$

label: CeladonCity_Text_DeptStoreSign
source: Find what you need at the\nCELADON DEPT. STORE!$
translation: 在玉虹百货大楼寻找你想要的！$

label: CeladonCity_Text_GuardSpecProtectsFromStatus
source: TRAINER TIPS\pGUARD SPEC. protects POKéMON\nfrom status-reduction moves during\lbattle.\pGet your items at the\nCELADON DEPT. STORE!$
translation: 训练家贴士\p能力防守保护宝可梦\n使其战斗中能力不会下降。\p在玉虹百货大楼都能买到！$

label: CeladonCity_Text_PrizeExchangeSign
source: COINS exchanged for prizes!\nPRIZE EXCHANGE$
translation: 代币兑换奖品！\n奖品兑换$

label: CeladonCity_Text_GameCornerSign
source: ROCKET GAME CORNER\nThe playground for grown-ups!$
translation: 火箭队游戏厅\n大人们的游乐场！$

label: CeladonCity_Text_ScaldedTongueOnTea
source:
Aaaagh, ow…
I scalded my tongue!\pThis nice old lady in the MANSION
gave me some TEA.\pBut it was boiling hot!
Gotta cool it to drink it.$
translation:
啊 喔......
我的舌头被烫伤了！\p大厦里的老妇人
给我喝了一些茶。\p但茶太烫了！
必须等凉下来之后再喝。$

label: Text_SoftboiledTeach
source:
Hello, there!\pI've seen you about, but I never
had a chance to chat.\pIt must be good luck that brought
us together finally.\pI'd like to celebrate by teaching
you the move SOFTBOILED.$
translation: 小朋友，你好！\p我曾经看见过你好多次，\n但未能有过畅谈的机会。\p所幸现在我们成功相聚。\p让我教你技能生蛋\n来庆祝下这感人的一刻吧。$

label: Text_SoftboiledDeclined
source: I'll always be keeping an eye out\nfor you.\pI hope we can chat again.$
translation: 我会一直关注你的。\p有空了再过来聊聊啊。$

label: Text_SoftboiledWhichMon
source: So, who's the POKéMON that gets\nthe chance to learn SOFTBOILED?$
translation: 那么，哪只宝可梦想要\n学习生蛋呢？$

label: Text_SoftboiledTaught
source: I wish you the best of luck!$
translation: 祝你好运！$

label: CeladonCity_Text_SomeoneStoleSilphScope
