source: Oh, what am I to do…\pSomeone stole our SILPH SCOPE.\pThe thief came running this way,\nI'm sure of it.\pBut I lost sight of him!\nWhere'd he go?$
translation: 呃，我在做什么啊......\p有人把我们的西尔佛观测镜偷走了。\p小偷从这条路跑了，\n没错。\p但我找不到他了！\n他去哪了？$

label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_CanExchangeCoinsNextDoor
source: Welcome!\pYou can exchange your COINS for\nfabulous prizes next door.$
translation: 欢迎光临！\p你能去隔壁用代币换\n非常棒的奖品。$

label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_WelcomeBuySomeCoins
source: Welcome to ROCKET GAME CORNER!\pDo you need some game COINS?\nWould you like to buy some?$
translation: 欢迎来到火箭队游戏厅！\p你需要代币吗？\n是否想购买一些呢？$

label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_ComePlaySometime
source: No?\nPlease come play sometime!$
translation: 不需要？\n那改天再来玩玩！$

label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_SorryDontHaveCoinCase
source: Oh, I'm sorry.\nYou don't have a COIN CASE.$
translation: 啊，抱歉。\n你还没有代币盒。$

label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_CoinCaseIsFull
source: Whoops!\nYour COIN CASE is full.$
translation: 哎哟！\n你的代币盒满了。$

label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_CantAffordCoins
source: You can't afford the COINS.$
translation: 你的代币数不够。$

label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_HereAreYourCoins
source: Thank you.\nHere are your COINS!$
translation: 谢谢。\n给你代币！$

label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_RumoredTeamRocketRunsThisPlace
source: Keep this quiet.\pIt's rumored that this place is run\nby TEAM ROCKET.$
translation: 嘘，小声点。\p据说这里是火箭队经营的。$

label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_ThinkMachinesHaveDifferentOdds
source: I think these machines have\ndifferent odds.$
translation: 我认为这些机器的赔率都不同。$

label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_DoYouWantToPlay
source: Kid, do you want to play?$
translation: 孩子，你想来一把吗？$

label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_Received10CoinsFromMan
source: {PLAYER} received 10 COINS\nfrom the man.$
translation: {PLAYER}获得了10个代币。$

label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_DontNeedMyCoins
source: You don't need my COINS!$
translation: 我的代币可不能给你！$

label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_WinsComeAndGo
source: Wins seem to come and go.\nNothing's a sure thing.$
translation: 有赢就有输。\n世事无常。$

label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_WinOrLoseItsOnlyLuck
source: These slot games…\nWin or lose, it's only by luck.$
translation: 这些老虎机游戏......\n输赢全凭运气。$

label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_GymGuyAdvice
source:
Hey!\pYou have better things to do,
champ in the making!\pCELADON GYM's LEADER is ERIKA.\pShe is a user of GRASS-type
POKéMON, and at one with nature.\pShe might appear docile because of
her flower arranging…\pBut she's not one to be taken
lightly!$
translation:
嘿！\p别荒废在这里了，
未来的冠军！\p玉虹道馆的馆主是莉佳。\p她是个与大自然融为一体的
草属性宝可梦使用者。\p她精于花道，
虽然她看上去很娇小......\p但她绝不是个可以小看的对手！$

label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_RareMonsForCoins
source: They offer rare POKéMON that can\nbe exchanged for your COINS.\pBut, I just can't seem to win!$
translation: 你可以用赢来的代币可以去那儿\n换取稀有的宝可梦。\p但是，我老是赢不了！$

label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_SoEasyToGetHooked
source: Games are scary!\nIt's so easy to get hooked!$
translation: 赌博真是可怕！\n实在是太容易让人上瘾了！$

label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_WantSomeCoins
source: What's up?\nWant some COINS?$
translation: 有什么事吗？\n你的意思是想要些代币？$

label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_Received20CoinsFromNiceGuy
source: {PLAYER} received 20 COINS\nfrom the nice guy.$
translation: {PLAYER}获得了20个代币。$

label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_YouHaveLotsOfCoins
source: You have lots of COINS!$
translation: 你有好多代币啊！$

label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_NeedMoreCoinsForMonIWant
source: Darn! I need more COINS for the\nPOKéMON I want!$
translation: 该死！需要更多的代币才能换\n得到我想要的那只宝可梦！$

label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_HereAreSomeCoinsShoo
source: Hey, what? You're throwing me off!\nHere are some COINS, so shoo!$
translation: 干嘛干嘛？别烦我！\n给你代币，拿了就走吧！$

label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_Received20CoinsFromMan
source: {PLAYER} received 20 COINS\nfrom the man.$
translation: {PLAYER}获得了20个代币。$

label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_YouveGotPlentyCoins
source: You've got plenty of your own\nCOINS!$
translation: 你已经有那么多代币啦！$

label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_WatchReelsClosely
source: The trick is to watch the reels\nclosely.$
translation: 窍门就是紧紧盯着轮盘看。$

label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_GruntIntro
source: I'm guarding this poster!\nGo away, or else!$
translation: 我负责看守这张海报！\n快走开，否则给你好看！$

label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_GruntDefeat
source: Dang!$

label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_GruntPostBattle
source: The TEAM ROCKET HIDEOUT might\nbe discovered!\pI better tell BOSS!$
translation: 火箭队藏身处被发现了！\p我得马上报告老大！$

label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_SwitchBehindPosterPushIt
source: Hey!\pA switch behind the poster!?\nLet's push it!$
translation: 咦！\p海报后面有个开关！？\n试着按下去！$

label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_CoinCaseIsRequired
source: A COIN CASE is required…$
translation: 你还没有代币盒......$

label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_DontHaveCoinCase
source: Oops!\nDon't have the COIN CASE!$
translation: 哎呀！\n你还没有代币盒哦！$

label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_SlotMachineWantToPlay
source: A slot machine!\nWant to play?$
translation: 一台老虎机！\n想玩玩吗？$

label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_OutOfOrder
source: OUT OF ORDER\nThis is broken.$
translation: 上面显示"程序故障"\n看来这台机器坏了。$

label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_OutToLunch
source: OUT TO LUNCH\nThis is reserved.$
translation: 上面显示"外出用餐"\n看来这台机器被占了。$

label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_SomeonesKeys
source: Someone's keys!\nThey'll be back.$
translation: 不知是谁的钥匙！\n他们还会回来的。$

label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_PrizeRoom_Text_FancyThatPorygon
source: I sure do fancy that PORYGON!\nBut, it's hard to win at slots!$
translation: 我非常非常想要那个多边兽！\n可是老虎机太难赢了！$

label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_PrizeRoom_Text_RakedItInToday
source: Gahaha! I raked it in today!\nIf only every day were like this…$
translation: 哇哈哈！我今天人品大爆发了哇！\n要是每天都像今天一样就好了......$

label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_PrizeRoom_Text_CoinCaseRequired
source: A COIN CASE is required…$
translation: 你还没有代币盒......$

label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_PrizeRoom_Text_WeExchangeCoinsForPrizes
source: We exchange your COINS for prizes.$
translation: 你可以用硬代币和我们兑换奖品。$

label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_PrizeRoom_Text_WhichPrize
source: Which prize would you like?$
translation: 你想要哪个奖品？$

label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_PrizeRoom_Text_YouWantPrize
source: So, you want the {STR_VAR_1}?$
translation: 嗯，你想要的是{STR_VAR_1}？$

label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_PrizeRoom_Text_YouWantTM
source: Okay, a TM of {STR_VAR_2}\nis what you want?$
translation: 好的，你想要的是技能机{STR_VAR_2}？$

label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_PrizeRoom_Text_NeedMoreCoins
source: Sorry, you'll need more COINS\nthan that.$
translation: 抱歉，你的代币不够兑换它哦。$

label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_ErikaDefeat
source: Oh!\nI concede defeat.\lYou are remarkably strong.\pI must confer on you the\nRAINBOWBADGE.$
translation: 啊！\n我认输了。\l你真是太强了。\p我必须授予你彩虹徽章。$

label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_ErikaPostBattle
source: You are cataloging POKéMON?\nI must say I'm impressed.\pI would never collect POKéMON if\nthey were unattractive.$
translation: 你在收集宝可梦？\n真是一项了不起的工程啊！\p我从不收集不可爱的宝可梦。$

label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_ExplainRainbowBadgeTakeThis
source: The RAINBOWBADGE will make\nPOKéMON up to Lv. 50 obey.\pIt also allows POKéMON to use\nSTRENGTH in and out of battle.\pPlease also take this with you.$
translation: 彩虹徽章可以让50级以下的\n宝可梦听从你的指挥。\p它也可以让你的宝可梦在战斗中\n和战斗外都能使用怪力。\p也请你收下这个。$

label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_ReceivedTM19FromErika
source: {PLAYER} received TM19\nfrom ERIKA.$
translation: {PLAYER}从莉佳那里获得了TM19。$

label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_ExplainTM19
source: TM19 contains GIGA DRAIN.\pHalf the damage it inflicts is\ndrained to heal your POKéMON.\pWouldn't you agree that it's a\nwonderful move?$
translation: TM19是终极吸取。\p这个技能造成伤害的一半\n会被你的宝可梦吸收过来回复体力。\p难道你不认为\n这是个非常棒的技能吗？$

label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_ShouldMakeRoomForThis
source: You should make room for this.$
translation: 你的背包满了。$

label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_KayIntro
source: I should tell you about this GYM.\pOnly real ladies are allowed in\nhere!$
translation: 我要给你介绍一下这个道馆。\p只有真正的淑女才被允许进入！$

label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_KayDefeat
source: You're too rough!$
translation: 你太粗鲁了！$

label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_KayPostBattle
source: Bleaah!\nI hope ERIKA wipes you out!$
translation: 啊啊！\n我真希望莉佳好好教训你一下！$

label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_BridgetIntro
source: Oh, welcome.\nI was getting bored.$
translation: 唔，你好。\n我正无聊呢。$

label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_BridgetDefeat
source: My makeup!$
translation: 我化的妆！$

label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_BridgetPostBattle
source: GRASS-type POKéMON are tough\nagainst the WATER type.\pThey also have an edge on ROCK-\nand GROUND-type POKéMON.$
translation: 草属性宝可梦对水属性很有优势。\p它们对岩石属性和地面属性宝可梦\n也是强大的存在。$

label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_TinaIntro
source: …Weren't you peeking in here\nearlier?$
translation: ......你之前是在偷看这里吗？$

label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_TinaDefeat
source: You're an eye-opener!$
translation: 你让我大开眼界！$

label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_TinaPostBattle
source: Oh, you were looking at ERIKA…\nYou weren't looking at me…$
translation: 啊，你是在看莉佳......\n不是看我......$

label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_TamiaIntro
source: Look, look!\nSee my POKéMON!\pI like the GRASS type.\nI like how they're easy to raise.$
translation: 喂，喂！\n看看我的宝可梦！\p我喜欢草属性。\n它们培育起来很容易。$

label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_TamiaDefeat
source: No!$

label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_TamiaPostBattle
source: We only use GRASS-type POKéMON at\nour GYM.\pWhy? We also use them for making\nflower arrangements!$
translation: 我们在道馆里只使用草属性宝可梦。\p至于为什么嘛，\n我们也用它们来插花的！$

label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_LisaIntro
source: Oh, hey!\pWe don't like BUG- or FIRE-type\nPOKéMON in here!$
translation: 嘿，你好！\p我们不欢迎虫属性和火属性宝可梦！$

label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_LisaDefeat
source: Oh!\nYou!$
translation: 啊！\n你！$

label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_LisaPostBattle
source: Our LEADER ERIKA might be quiet,\nbut she's famous around here.$
translation: 我们的馆主莉佳很文静，\n她在这一带可非常出名。$

label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_LoriIntro
source: Pleased to meet you.\nMy hobby is POKéMON training.$
translation: 很高兴见到你。\n我的兴趣是训练宝可梦。$

label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_LoriDefeat
source: Oh!\nSplendid!$
translation: 啊！\n棒极了！$

label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_LoriPostBattle
source: I have a blind date coming up.\nI have to learn to be polite,\lespecially if I have to battle.$
translation: 我马上要去相亲。\n所以必须得保持礼貌，\l特别是要对战的时候。$

label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_MaryIntro
source: Welcome to CELADON GYM!\pYou'd better not underestimate\nthe nice ladies here.$
translation: 欢迎来到玉虹道馆！\p你最好不要\n小瞧了这里的小姐们。$

label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_MaryDefeat
source: Oh!\nBeaten!$
translation: 啊！\n输了！$

label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_MaryPostBattle
source: I didn't bring my best POKéMON.\nWait until next time!$
translation: 我没带上我最厉害的宝可梦。\n下次等着瞧！$

label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_GymStatue
source: CELADON POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: ERIKA\pWINNING TRAINERS:\n{RIVAL}$
translation: 玉虹宝可梦道馆\n馆主：莉佳\p获胜训练家：\n{RIVAL}$

label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_GymStatuePlayerWon
source: CELADON POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: ERIKA\pWINNING TRAINERS:\n{RIVAL}, {PLAYER}$
translation: 玉虹宝可梦道馆\n馆主：莉佳\p获胜训练家：\n{RIVAL}，{PLAYER}$

label: CeladonCity_Hotel_Text_ThisHotelIsForPeople
source: POKéMON?\nNo, this is a hotel for people.\pWe're full up, unfortunately.$
translation: 宝可梦？\n不，这儿是给人住的旅馆。\p不幸的是，已经客满了。$

label: CeladonCity_Hotel_Text_OnVacationWithBrotherAndBoyfriend
source: I'm on vacation with my brother and\nboyfriend.\pCELADON is such a pretty city!$
translation: 我在和弟弟、男朋友度假。\p玉虹市真是个美丽的城市！$

label: CeladonCity_Hotel_Text_WhyDidSheBringBrother
source: Why?\nWhy did she bring her brother?$
translation: 怎么会这样？\n为什么她要带弟弟一起来？$

label: CeladonCity_Hotel_Text_SisBroughtMeOnVacation
source: Yippee! I'm on vacation!\nMy sis brought me along! Awesome!$
translation: 好耶！我在度假！\n我姐姐带我一起来的！真棒！$

label: CeladonCity_House1_Text_SlotsReelInTheDough
source: Hehehe!\pThe slots just reel in the dough,\nbig-time!$
translation: 呵呵呵！\p老虎机就是个吸钱机，\n最棒的吸钱机！$

label: CeladonCity_House1_Text_ShippedMonsAsSlotPrizes
source: CHIEF!\pWe just shipped two thousand\nmore POKéMON as slot prizes\lagain today!$
translation: 队长！\p我们今天刚又运来了2000个宝可梦\n作为老虎机的奖品！$

label: CeladonCity_House1_Text_DontTouchGameCornerPoster
source: Don't touch the poster at the GAME\nCORNER!\pThere's no secret switch behind it!$
translation: 千万别去碰游戏厅的海报！\p那后面没有什么秘密机关！$

label: CeladonCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_PokeFluteAwakensSleepingMons
source: A POKé FLUTE awakens sleeping\nPOKéMON. You know that.\pIt does so with a sound that only\nthey can hear.$
translation: 你知道的，宝可梦笛子\n能唤醒睡着的宝可梦。\p它能吹出一种只有宝可梦能听到的声音。$

label: CeladonCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_RodeHereFromFuchsia
source: I rode here from FUCHSIA.\pIt's an uphill ride on CYCLING\nROAD, so I'm exhausted.$
translation: 我从浅红一路骑到这里。\p正好是单车路的上坡路，\n可把我累坏了。$

label: CeladonCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_GoToCyclingRoadIfIHadBike
source: If I had a BIKE, I would go to\nCYCLING ROAD!$
translation: 要是我有辆自行车，\n我就能去单车路！$

label: CeladonCity_Restaurant_Text_TakingBreakRightNow
source: Hi!\pSorry, but we're taking a break\nright now.$
translation: 嗨！\p抱歉，我们正在休息呢。$

label: CeladonCity_Restaurant_Text_OftenGoToDrugstore
source: My POKéMON are weak, so I often\nhave to go to the DRUGSTORE.$
translation: 我的宝可梦比较弱，\n所以我常去药店。$

label: CeladonCity_Restaurant_Text_PsstBasementUnderGameCorner
source: Psst! There's a basement under the\nGAME CORNER, I hear.$
translation: 嘿！我听说这个\n游戏厅下面有个地下室。$

label: CeladonCity_Restaurant_Text_ManLostItAllAtSlots
source: Munch…\pThe man at that table lost it all\nat the slots.$
translation: 吧唧吧唧......\p那边桌子上那个人，\n把家当全输在老虎机上了。$

label: CeladonCity_Restaurant_Text_TakeThisImBusted
source:
Go ahead! Laugh!
I'm flat-out busted!\pNo more slots for me!
I'm going straight!\pHere!
I won't be needing this anymore!$
translation:
去吧！哈哈！
我破产了！\p没法再玩老虎机了！
我要走了！\p给你！
我再也用不着它了！$

label: CeladonCity_Restaurant_Text_ReceivedCoinCaseFromMan
source: {PLAYER} received a COIN CASE\nfrom the man.$
translation: {PLAYER}获得了一个代币盒。$

label: CeladonCity_Restaurant_Text_MakeRoomForThis
source: Make room for this!$
translation: 把包包腾出点地方来！$

label: CeladonCity_Restaurant_Text_ThoughtIdWinItBack
source: I always thought I was going to\nwin it back…$
translation: 我总想着\n要把输的都赢回来......$

label: CeruleanCave_B1F_Text_Mew
source: Mew!$

label: CeruleanCity_BikeShop_Text_WelcomeToBikeShop
source: Hi!\nWelcome to our BIKE SHOP.\pHave we got just the BIKE for\nyou!$
translation: 嗨！\n欢迎来到我们的自行车行。\p我们已经为你挑选了这个自行车！$

label: CeruleanCity_BikeShop_Text_SorryYouCantAffordIt
source: Sorry!\nYou can't afford it!$
translation: 对不起！\n你付不起这个钱啊！$

label: CeruleanCity_BikeShop_Text_OhBikeVoucherHereYouGo
source: Oh, that's…\pA BIKE VOUCHER!\pOkay!\nHere you go!$
translation: 哦，那是......\p一张自行车兑换券！\p好的！\n给你！$

label: CeruleanCity_BikeShop_Text_ExchangedVoucherForBicycle
source: {PLAYER} exchanged the\nBIKE VOUCHER for a BICYCLE.$
translation: {PLAYER}用自行车兑换券\n兑换了一辆自行车。$

label: CeruleanCity_BikeShop_Text_ThankYouComeAgain
source: Thank you!\nCome back again sometime!$
translation: 谢谢！\n欢迎下次光临！$

label: CeruleanCity_BikeShop_Text_HowDoYouLikeNewBicycle
source: How do you like your new BICYCLE?\nDo you like how it rides?\pYou can take it out on CYCLING\nROAD and even into caves!$
translation: 你喜欢你的新自行车吗？\n你喜欢这样骑着它吗？\p你可以在单车路\n甚至在洞穴里骑着它！$

label: CeruleanCity_BikeShop_Text_MakeRoomForBicycle
source: You better make room for your\nBICYCLE!$
translation: 你最好留出空间\n来装你的自行车！$

label: CeruleanCity_BikeShop_Text_CityBikeGoodEnoughForMe
source: A plain city bike is good enough\nfor me.\pAfter all, you can't put a shopping\nbasket on a mountain bike.$
translation: 一辆普通的城市自行车\n对我来说足够了。\p毕竟，你无法把一个购物篮\n挂在一辆山地车上。$

label: CeruleanCity_BikeShop_Text_BikesCoolButExpensive
source: These bikes are cool, but they're\nway expensive!$
translation: 这些自行车太酷了，\n但是它们都很贵！$

label: CeruleanCity_BikeShop_Text_WowYourBikeIsCool
source: Wow.\nYour BIKE is really cool!$
translation: 哇。\n你的自行车真的很帅！$

label: CeruleanCity_BikeShop_Text_ShinyNewBicycle
source: A shiny new BICYCLE!$
translation: 一辆闪亮的新自行车！$

label: CeruleanCity_Text_RivalIntro
source:
{RIVAL}: Yo! {PLAYER}!\pYou're still struggling along back
here?\pI'm doing great! I caught a bunch
of strong and smart POKéMON!\pHere, let me see what you caught,
{PLAYER}!$
translation:
{RIVAL} 哟！是{PLAYER}啊！\p你还在这里
独自徘徊么？\p我可是做得很好！我收服了一群
既强壮又聪明的宝可梦！\p来吧，让我看看你收服了什么！
{PLAYER}$

label: CeruleanCity_Text_RivalDefeat
source: Hey!\nTake it easy!\lYou won already!$
translation: 嘿！\n放松点！\l你已经赢了！$

label: CeruleanCity_Text_RivalPostBattle
source:
{RIVAL}: Hey, guess what?\pI went to BILL's and got him to
show me his rare POKéMON.\pThat added a lot of pages to my
POKéDEX!\pAfter all, BILL's world famous as a
POKéMANIAC.\pHe invented the POKéMON Storage
System on PC, too.\pSince you're using his system,
you should go thank him.\pWell, I better get rolling!
Smell ya later!$
translation:
{RIVAL}：嘿，你猜怎么着？\p我去了趟正辉的家，叫他让我
看了他稀有的宝可梦。\p这样就使我的宝可梦图鉴
增加了好多数据！\p毕竟啊正辉作为一个怪兽狂
在全世界都很有名。\p就是他开发了
宝可梦存储系统。\p既然你正在使用他的系统
就应该去好好谢谢他。\p好了我得走了。
下次再见咯！$

label: CeruleanCity_Text_OhRightLittlePresentAsFavor
source: Oh, yeah, right.\pI feel sorry for you. No, really.\nYou're always plodding behind me.\pSo here, I'll give you a little\npresent as a favor.$
translation: 噢对了。\p看到你总是不声不响的跟在我身后。\n我有些不好意思。不，我是真心的。\p所以呐，我要送你一个\n小小的礼物。$

label: CeruleanCity_Text_ExplainFameCheckerSmellYa
source:
A chatty gossip like you…
That thing's perfect.\pI don't need it because I don't
give a hoot about others.\pAll right, this time I really am
gone. Smell ya!$
translation:
虽然这个东西废话很多......
但是东西本身倒不坏。\p我不需要它是因为
我才不喜欢和别人唠唠叨叨的。\p现在我可是真的要走了，
有缘再会了！$

label: CeruleanCity_Text_GruntIntro
source:
Hey! Stay out!
It's not your yard!\p…Huh?
Me?\pI'm an innocent bystander!
Don't you believe me?{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_RG_ENCOUNTER_ROCKET}$
translation:
嘿！给我站住！
这里可不是你的院子！\p......什么？
我是干什么的\p我是路过打酱油的！
......你不相信我？{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_RG_ENCOUNTER_ROCKET}$

label: CeruleanCity_Text_GruntDefeat
source: GRUNT: Stop! I give up!\nI'll leave quietly!$
translation: 成员：别打了！我投降！\n我会马上离开的！$

label: CeruleanCity_Text_OkayIllReturnStolenTM
source: …Okay.\nI'll return the TM I stole.$
translation: ......我懂了。\n我会把我偷的技能交出来的。$

label: CeruleanCity_Text_RecoveredTM28FromGrunt
source: {PLAYER} recovered TM28 from\nthe TEAM ROCKET GRUNT.$
translation: {PLAYER}从火箭队队员那里\n获得了TM28$

label: CeruleanCity_Text_BetterGetMovingBye
source: I better get moving!\nBye!$
translation: 我想我最好得撤了！\n再见！$

label: CeruleanCity_Text_MakeRoomForThisCantRun
source: Make room for this!\nI can't run until I give it to you!$
translation: 赶快把你的包腾出地方！\n给了你这个我才能走！$

label: CeruleanCity_Text_TrainerLifeIsToughIsntIt
source: You're a TRAINER, too?\pCollecting, battling…\nIt's a tough life, isn't it?$
translation: 你也是一个训练家对不对？\p收集，战斗......\n这是一条艰辛的路啊，可不是吗？$

label: CeruleanCity_Text_YouCanCutDownSmallTrees
source:
Did you know that you can CUT down
small trees?\pEven that small tree in front of
the shop can be CUT down.\pI think there's a way around it,
though.$
translation: 你知道用居合斩能\n砍倒细小的树吗？\p就算是那个商店面前的小树\n也可以用居合斩砍倒。\p我认为有条路在那附近。$

label: CeruleanCity_Text_IfSlowbroWasntThereCouldCutTree
source:
If that SLOWBRO wasn't there, you
could CUT down the small tree.\pThat way, you could get to the
other side.\pI think there's a way around it,
though.$
translation: 如果那只呆壳兽不在这里的话\n你就能用居合斩砍倒那边的小树了。\p这样一来，\n你就可以到另一边去了。\p虽然也有办法绕路过去。$

label: CeruleanCity_Text_PokemonEncyclopediaAmusing
source: You're making an encyclopedia on\nPOKéMON? That sounds amusing.$
translation: 你在做关于宝可梦的百科全书吧？\n听起来真厉害啊。$

label: CeruleanCity_Text_PeopleHereWereRobbed
source: The people here were robbed.\pIt's obvious that TEAM ROCKET is\nbehind this most heinous crime!\pEven our POLICE FORCE has\ntrouble with the ROCKETS!$
translation: 这家人被抢了。\p很明显这种十恶不赦的事\n背后又有火箭队在作怪！\p甚至我们的警力集结\n起来都敌不过火箭队！$

label: CeruleanCity_Text_SlowbroUseSonicboom
source: Okay! SLOWBRO!\nUse SONICBOOM!$
translation: 好！呆壳兽！\n使用音爆！$

label: CeruleanCity_Text_SlowbroPayAttention
source: Come on, SLOWBRO, pay attention!$
translation: 来吧，呆壳兽，注意了！$

label: CeruleanCity_Text_SlowbroPunch
source: SLOWBRO, punch!$
translation: 呆壳兽，给我狠狠地攻击！$

label: CeruleanCity_Text_NoYouBlewItAgain
source: No!\nYou blew it again!$
translation: 不！\n你又搞砸了！$

label: CeruleanCity_Text_SlowbroWithdraw
source: SLOWBRO, WITHDRAW!$
translation: 呆壳兽 撤退$

label: CeruleanCity_Text_HardToControlMonsObedience
source: No! That's wrong!\nIt's so hard to control POKéMON!\pYour POKéMON's obedience depends\non your abilities as a TRAINER.$
translation: 不对！那样不对！\n想要控制好宝可梦是很困难的！\p你的宝可梦对你信赖与否\n取决于你作为一名训练家的能力。$

label: CeruleanCity_Text_SlowbroTookSnooze
source: SLOWBRO took a snooze…$
translation: 呆壳兽打起了盹......$

label: CeruleanCity_Text_SlowbroLoafingAround
source: SLOWBRO is loafing around…$
translation: 呆壳兽在四处闲逛......$

label: CeruleanCity_Text_SlowbroTurnedAway
source: SLOWBRO turned away…$
translation: 呆壳兽躲得远远的......$

label: CeruleanCity_Text_SlowbroIgnoredOrders
source: SLOWBRO ignored orders…$
translation: 被呆壳兽无视了......$

label: CeruleanCity_Text_WantBrightRedBicycle
source: I want a bright red bicycle.\pI'll keep it at home, so it won't\nget dirty.$
translation: 我想要一辆红色的自行车。\p有了它我就会把它放在家里，\n这样它就不会被弄脏了。$

label: CeruleanCity_Text_ThisIsCeruleanCave
source:
This is CERULEAN CAVE.\pHorribly strong POKéMON live inside
there.\pIt takes a very special TRAINER to
be allowed inside there.\pYou'd have to be strong enough to
become the POKéMON LEAGUE\lCHAMPION for starters.\pAnd, you would have to have
made a great achievement.$
translation:
从这里进去就是华蓝洞窟了。\p那只强大得恐怖的宝可梦
就栖息在这里面。\p只有那些特别的训练家
才能够被允许入内。\p如果你成为了
宝可梦联盟\l的联盟冠军。\p才有足够的
实力进去挑战。$

label: CeruleanCity_Text_CitySign
source: CERULEAN CITY\nA Mysterious, Blue Aura Surrounds\lIt$
translation: 华蓝市\n被蓝色所环绕着的\l神秘城市$

label: CeruleanCity_Text_TrainerTipsHeldItems
source: TRAINER TIPS\pA POKéMON can be made to hold\nan item.\pSome items can even be used by\nthe holding POKéMON in battle.$
translation: 训练家贴士\p一只宝可梦只可以装备\n一个道具。\p其中一些道具\n甚至能在战斗使用。$

label: CeruleanCity_Text_BikeShopSign
source: Grass and caves handled easily!\nBIKE SHOP$
translation: 轻松愉快的在草地和洞窟间驰骋！\n自行车行$

label: CeruleanCity_Text_GymSign
source: CERULEAN CITY POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: MISTY\lThe Tomboyish Mermaid!$
translation: 华蓝市宝可梦道馆\n馆主：小霞\l男孩子气的美人鱼！$

label: CeruleanCity_Gym_Text_MistyIntro
source:
Hi, you're a new face!\pOnly those TRAINERS who have a
policy about POKéMON can turn pro.\pWhat is your approach when you
catch and train POKéMON?\pMy policy is an all-out offensive
with WATER-type POKéMON!{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_RG_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}$
translation:
嗨，你是个新人啊！\p只有那些懂战术的训练家
能在这儿出现。\p你收服和训练宝可梦时
会讲究战术吗？\p我的战术就是用
我的水属性宝可梦全力地猛攻！{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_RG_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}$

label: CeruleanCity_Gym_Text_ExplainTM03
source: TM03 teaches WATER PULSE.\pUse it on an aquatic POKéMON!$
translation: TM03是水波动。\p把它用在一只水属性宝可梦身上吧！$

label: CeruleanCity_Gym_Text_ExplainCascadeBadge
source:
The CASCADEBADGE makes all
POKéMON up to Lv. 30 obey.\pThat includes even outsiders you
got in trades.\pThere's more. You can now use CUT
anytime, even out of battle.\pYou can CUT down small trees to
open new pathways.\pYou can also have my favorite TM.$
translation:
蓝色徽章能让所有的
30级以下的宝可梦听你的话。\p包括那些从别人那儿交换得到的。\p而且你可以随时使用居合斩。
甚至是没在战斗的时候。\p你可以居合斩一些小树
去开辟新的道路。\p你也能得到我最喜欢的技能。$

label: CeruleanCity_Gym_Text_ReceivedTM03FromMisty
source: {PLAYER} received TM03\nfrom MISTY.$
translation: {PLAYER}从小霞那儿得到了TM03。$

label: CeruleanCity_Gym_Text_BetterMakeRoomForThis
source: You better make room for this!$
translation: 你最好为这个准备一些空间！$

label: CeruleanCity_Gym_Text_MistyDefeat
source: Wow!\nYou're too much!\pAll right!\pYou can have the CASCADEBADGE to\nshow you beat me.$
translation: 哇！\n你很厉害！\p很好！\p这个蓝色徽章你拿着，\n来证明你打败过我的证明。$

label: CeruleanCity_Gym_Text_DianaIntro
source: What? You?\nI'm more than good enough for you!\pMISTY won't have to be bothered.$
translation: 什么？你？\n我比你强多了！\p不能随便去打扰小霞。$

label: CeruleanCity_Gym_Text_DianaDefeat
source: You overwhelmed me!$
translation: 你打败了我！$

label: CeruleanCity_Gym_Text_DianaPostBattle
source: You have to face other TRAINERS\nto see how good you really are.$
translation: 你必须面对其他的训练家，\n看看你到底有多强大。$

label: CeruleanCity_Gym_Text_LuisIntro
source: Splash!\pI'm first up!\nLet's do it!$
translation: 哈！\p我是第一个！\n我们开始吧！$

label: CeruleanCity_Gym_Text_LuisDefeat
source: That can't be!$
translation: 不可能！$

label: CeruleanCity_Gym_Text_LuisPostBattle
source: MISTY is a TRAINER who's going to\nkeep improving.\pShe won't lose to someone like you!$
translation: 小霞总是不断地提升着自己。\p她是不会输给像你这样的人的。$

label: CeruleanCity_Gym_Text_GymGuyAdvice
source:
Yo!
Champ in the making!\pLet me give you some advice!\pThe LEADER, MISTY, is a pro who
uses WATER-type POKéMON.\pYou can drain all their water with
GRASS-type POKéMON.\pOr, you might use ELECTRIC-type
POKéMON and zap them!$
translation:
哟！
未来的冠军！\p给你一些建议吧！\p这个馆主小霞，
使用的是水属性宝可梦。\p你可以用草属性宝可梦
吸收它们的水份。\p或者你也可以用电属性
宝可梦电击它们！$

label: CeruleanCity_Gym_Text_WeMakePrettyGoodTeam
source: You beat MISTY!\nSee, what'd I tell ya?\pYou and me, kid, we make a pretty\ndarn-good team!$
translation: 你战胜了小霞！\n看吧，我说什么来着？\p你和我，小子，\n我们组成了一个强大之极的队伍！$

label: CeruleanCity_Gym_Text_GymStatue
source: CERULEAN POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: MISTY\pWINNING TRAINERS:\n{RIVAL}$
translation: 华蓝宝可梦道馆\n馆主：小霞\p优胜训练家：\n{RIVAL}$

label: CeruleanCity_Gym_Text_GymStatuePlayerWon
source: CERULEAN POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: MISTY\pWINNING TRAINERS:\n{RIVAL}, {PLAYER}$
translation: 华蓝宝可梦道馆\n馆主：小霞\p优胜训练家：\n{RIVAL} {PLAYER}$

label: CeruleanCity_House1_Text_BadgesHaveAmazingSecrets
source: Only skilled TRAINERS can collect\nPOKéMON BADGES.\pI see you have at least one.\pThose BADGES have amazing secrets,\ndid you know?$
translation: 只有有能力的训练家能够\n收集到宝可梦徽章。\p我看你应该是他们中的一个。\p那些徽章都有着惊人的秘密，\n你知道吗？$

label: CeruleanCity_House1_Text_DescribeWhichBadge
source: Now then…\pWhich of the eight BADGES should\nI describe?$
translation: 那现在......\p我应该描述八个徽章中的\n哪一个呢？$

label: CeruleanCity_House1_Text_ComeVisitAnytime
source: Come visit me anytime you wish.$
translation: 你随时都可以来找我。$

label: CeruleanCity_House1_Text_AttackStatFlash
source: The ATTACK stat of all your\nPOKéMON increases a little bit.\pIt also lets you use the move\nFLASH outside of battle.$
translation: 稍微提高你的宝可梦的攻击。\p也可以让你在不战斗\n的时候使用闪光。$

label: CeruleanCity_House1_Text_ObeyLv30Cut
source:
POKéMON up to Lv. 30 will obey
you.\pThat includes even outsiders you
obtain in trades.\pPOKéMON of higher levels will
be unruly in battle, however.\pIt also lets you use the move
CUT outside of battle.$
translation:
30级以内的宝可梦
都会听你的话。\p包括你交换得来的宝可梦。\p但是较高级别的宝可梦
仍然很难控制。\p也可以让你在
不战斗的时候使用居合斩。$

label: CeruleanCity_House1_Text_SpeedStatFly
source: The SPEED stat of all your\nPOKéMON increases a little bit.\pIt also lets you use the move\nFLY outside of battle.$
translation: 稍微提高你的宝可梦的速度。\p也可以让你在\n不战斗的时候使用飞翔。$

label: CeruleanCity_House1_Text_ObeyLv50Strength
source:
POKéMON up to Lv. 50 will obey
you.\pThat includes even outsiders you
obtain in trades.\pPOKéMON of higher levels will
be unruly in battle, however.\pIt also lets you use the move
STRENGTH outside of battle.$
translation:
50级以内的宝可梦
都会听你的话。\p包括你交换得来的宝可梦。\p但是较高级别的宝可梦
仍然很难控制。\p也可以让你在
不战斗的时候使用怪力。$

label: CeruleanCity_House1_Text_DefenseStatSurf
source: The DEFENSE stat of all your\nPOKéMON increases a little bit.\pIt also lets you use the move\nSURF outside of battle.$
translation: 稍微提高你的宝可梦的防御。\p也可以让你在\n不战斗的时候使用冲浪。$

label: CeruleanCity_House1_Text_ObeyLv70RockSmash
source:
POKéMON up to Lv. 70 will obey
you.\pThat includes even outsiders you
obtain in trades.\pPOKéMON of higher levels will
be unruly in battle, however.\pIt also lets you use the move
ROCK SMASH outside of battle.$
translation:
70级以内的宝可梦
都会听你的话。\p包括你交换得来的宝可梦。\p但是较高级别的宝可梦
仍然很难控制。\p也可以让你在
不战斗的时候使用碎岩。$

label: CeruleanCity_House1_Text_SpStatsWaterfall
source: The SP. ATK and SP. DEF stats of\nall your POKéMON rise a little bit.\pIt also lets you use the move\nWATERFALL outside of battle.$
translation: 稍微提高你的宝可梦的特攻和特防。\p也可以让你在\n不战斗的时候使用攀瀑。$

label: CeruleanCity_House1_Text_AllMonsWillObeyYou
source: All POKéMON will obey you!$
translation: 所有的宝可梦都会听你的话了！$

label: CeruleanCity_House2_Text_RocketsStoleTMForDig
source:
Those miserable ROCKETS!\pLook what they've done to my
house!\pThey stole a TM for teaching
POKéMON how to DIG holes!\pI was going to use it on a
MANKEY or a SANDSHREW…\pThat cost me a bundle, it did!$
translation: 那些卑鄙的火箭队！\p看看他们在我家里都干了些什么！\p他们偷了一个技能去教\n宝可梦如何挖地洞洞！\p我是打算把它用在\n猴怪或者穿山鼠上的......\p它花了我好多钱呢！$

label: CeruleanCity_House2_Text_TeachDiglettDigWithoutTM
source: I figure what's lost is lost.\pI decided to teach DIGLETT how to\nDIG without a TM.$
translation: 我想丢的东西就丢了吧。\p我打算让地鼠不通过技能\n学会挖地洞。$

label: CeruleanCity_House2_Text_TeamRocketTryingToDigIntoNoGood
source: TEAM ROCKET must be trying to DIG\ntheir way into no good!$
translation: 火箭队一定想挖地洞\n来做见不得人的事。$

label: CeruleanCity_House2_Text_TeamRocketLeftWayOut
source: TEAM ROCKET left a way out!$
translation: 火箭队逃跑时留下了个洞！$

label: CeruleanCity_House3_Text_PleaseTradeWithMyHusband
source: My husband likes trading POKéMON.\pYou're collecting POKéMON for your\nPOKéDEX, aren't you?\pWould you please trade with him?$
translation: 我的丈夫喜欢交换宝可梦。\p你是正在为完成你的宝可梦图鉴\n收集宝可梦吗？\p你想和他交换吗？$

label: CeruleanCity_House4_Text_NothingEntertaining
source: Sigh…\nToo much time, too little to do…\pIs nothing entertaining happening\nanywhere?$
translation: 唉......\n太多的时间，太少能做的事......\p就没有什么有趣的事情发生吗？$

label: CeruleanCity_House4_Text_NewNewsInformativeHaveThis
source:
Ah!
A new news report!\pHmm…\pI see!
That was quite informative!\pI applaud you for taking interest
in the news at your young age.\pAs my thanks for sharing the news
with me, I want you to have this.$
translation:
啊！
一条新的消息！\p嗯......\p我知道了！
真是长见识了！\p我很欣赏你这么年轻
能对这条消息感兴趣。\p作为你和我分享这条消息的谢意。
我要给你这个。$

label: CeruleanCity_House4_Text_IncredibleNewsHaveBerries
source:
Oh, oh!
Th-this news report!\pHmm…\pAmazing!
What an incredible piece of news!\pI haven't seen a news story this
incredible in too long a time!\pThanks for sharing this fantastic
news. Have a bunch of BERRIES!$
translation:
噢，噢！
这-这条消息！\p嗯......\p令人震惊！
多么不可思议的消息！\p我好久都没有听到过
这么难以置信的事情了！\p谢谢你分享这条惊异的消息。
给你一些树果！$

label: CeruleanCity_House4_Text_WishCouldShareNewsWithOthers
source: It seems such a shame to not share\nthis news with other folks…\pI wish I could tell someone…\nLet others know the news…$
translation: 不跟其他人分享这条消息\n好像很不厚道......\p我希望我能告诉大家......\n让大家知道这个消息......$

label: CeruleanCity_House4_Text_ThanksForSpreadingNewsTakeThis
source: Ah, you've spread the news for me?\pGood news becomes worthwhile when\nall sorts of people share it.\pAs my thanks for your spreading\nthe news, take this!$
translation: 啊，你把这条消息告诉了我？\p当各种人分享它时，\n好消息就会变得有价值。\p谢谢你传播这条消息，\n作为谢意，拿着这个吧！$

label: CeruleanCity_House4_Text_MagnificentNewsSpreadHaveBerries
source:
You've spread the news some more?
Magnificent!\pThat piece of news must be
delighted to be passed around so.\pYes, indeed!\pConsider this a show of
appreciation from me and the news.\pI'll give you more BERRIES than
I usually do.$
translation:
你又告诉了其他的人？
好极了！\p那条新闻肯定很高兴
被这样广泛的传播。\p是的，真的！\p从我和这条消息的角度
想想这个价值。\p我要给你比平常多的树果。$

label: CeruleanCity_House4_Text_EnjoyingMyselfWithAllSortsOfNews
source: I'm quite enjoying myself with all\nsorts of news.\pYes, I am satisfied!\nI won't be bored for a while.$
translation: 沉浸在各种各样的新闻中\n我很享受。\p是的，我很满足！\n我暂时是不会无聊了。$

label: CeruleanCity_House4_Text_YourBerryPouchIsFull
source: Hm? Your BERRY POUCH is full.\nMy gift remains ungiven, then.$
translation: 嗯？你的树果袋满了。\n我的礼物送不出去了。$

label: CeruleanCity_House1_Text_AnyInterestInBerries
source:
I concoct a variety of medicine
from BERRY POWDER.\pUsing good BERRY POWDER, I can
make any kind of medicine.\pNow tell me, have you any interest
in BERRIES?$
translation:
我可以用树果粉末
调制各种药物。\p用好的树果粉末的话，
什么药我都能做出来。\p告诉我，你对树果
有兴趣吗？$

label: CeruleanCity_House1_Text_HaveJustTheThing
source: Ah, good! For you, then, I have\njust the thing.$
translation: 啊，好的！为你，\n我只要那个东西。$

label: CeruleanCity_House1_Text_GoCrushBerriesAtDirectCorner
source:
There's something new on the second
floor of POKéMON CENTERS, at the\lDIRECT CORNER.\pThey installed a Wireless Adapter
machine for crushing BERRIES.\pThis is where you come in.\pI have a favor to ask, one that
I can entrust only to you.\pCould you make BERRY POWDER for
me using that machine?\pDon't forget, the machine is at the
DIRECT CORNER of POKéMON CENTERS.\pI'll concoct medicine for you if
you bring me some BERRY POWDER.\pDon't forget, crush BERRIES into
BERRY POWDER and bring it to me.$
translation:
在宝可梦中心的二楼
直连房间处\l有一些新的东西。\p他们安装了一个
可以捣碎树果的机器。\p这就是你要去的地方。\p我有一个请求，
我只能委托你了。\p你可以用那台机器
给我做一些树果粉末吗？\p别忘了，那台机器在
宝可梦中心的直连房间处。\p如果你给我带回一些树果粉末，
我会给你调制一些药物。\p别忘了，把树果压碎成
树果粉末带回来给我。$

label: CeruleanCity_House1_Text_WhyMustYouLieNoBerries
source: Why must you lie to me?\pHow many BERRIES do you have?\nNot a one!$
translation: 为什么要对我说谎？\p你有多少树果？\n一个也没有！$

label: CeruleanCity_House1_Text_TakeInterestInAllSortsOfThings
source: You have no interest in BERRIES?\pYoung one, it's important to take an\ninterest in all sorts of things.$
translation: 你对树果不感兴趣？\p年轻人，对各种事物感兴趣\n是很重要的。$

label: CeruleanCity_House1_Text_HaveYouBroughtBerryPowder
source: Er-hem! Have you brought me some\nBERRY POWDER?$
translation: 呃！你给我带回一些\n树果粉末了吗？$

label: CeruleanCity_House5_Text_ExchangeWithWhat
source: With what would you like to \nexchange it?$
translation: 你想用它交换什么？$

label: CeruleanCity_House1_Text_YoullExchangeBerryPowderForItem
source: Fine, you'll exchange your BERRY\nPOWDER for one {STR_VAR_1}?$
translation: 好的，你想用一份\n树果粉末交换{STR_VAR_1}？$

label: CeruleanCity_House1_Text_DontHaveEnoughBerryPowder
source: Hm? You don't have enough\nBERRY POWDER.$
translation: 嗯？你没有足够的树果粉末。$

label: CeruleanCity_House1_Text_TradeMoreBerryPowder
source: This is fine BERRY POWDER indeed.\nIt will make excellent medicine.\pWould you like to trade more BERRY\nPOWDER for something else?$
translation: 这真的是树果粉末。\n能用它制作出很好的药物。\p你想交换更多树果粉末\n来获得其他的东西吗？$

label: CeruleanCity_House1_Text_HopeToSeeYouAgain
source: That's fine, then.\nI'll hope to see you back again.$
translation: 好的。\n我希望你能再回来。$

label: CeruleanCity_House1_Text_SeeMeIfYoudLikeToTradePowder
source: Come see me if you'd like to trade\nyour BERRY POWDER.$
translation: 如果你想交换你的树果粉末\n就来找我吧。$

label: CeruleanCity_Mart_Text_RepelWorksOnWeakMons
source:
REPEL not only keeps bugs away,
it also works on weak POKéMON.\pPut your strongest POKéMON at the
left of the POKéMON LIST.\pIf your first POKéMON is strong,
REPEL's effect is boosted.$
translation:
除虫喷雾不仅使虫属性的无法接近，
还会作用于弱小的宝可梦。\p把你最强的宝可梦放在
宝可梦列表的最左边。\p如果你的第一只宝可梦很强。
除虫喷雾的作用就会更明显。$

label: CeruleanCity_Mart_Text_DoYouKnowAboutRareCandy
source: Do you know about RARE CANDY?\nThey don't sell it in shops.\pI think it makes POKéMON grow\nvery quickly all of a sudden.$
translation: 你知道神奇糖果吗？\n在商店没有卖的。\p它能迅速的提高宝可梦的实力。$

label: CeruleanCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_BillDoesWhateverForRareMons
source: That BILL!\pI heard that he'll do whatever it\ntakes to get rare POKéMON.\pHe's not above doing all sorts\nof things, I've heard.$
translation: 那个正辉！\p我听说他会不择手段地\n去取得珍贵的宝可梦。\p除此之外，\n他不做任何与之无关的事。$

label: CeruleanCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_EveryoneCallsBillPokemaniac
source: Have you heard about BILL?\pEveryone calls him a POKéMANIAC!\pI think people are just jealous of\nBILL, though.\pWho wouldn't want to boast about\ntheir POKéMON?$
translation: 你听说过正辉吗？\p人们都叫他怪兽狂！\p但我觉得这是人们嫉妒正辉。\p谁不想炫耀一下他们的宝可梦？$

label: CeruleanCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_BillCollectsRareMons
source: BILL has lots of POKéMON!\nHe collects rare ones, too!$
translation: 正辉有很多的宝可梦！\n他也收集珍贵的宝可梦！$

label: CeruleanCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_TryTradingUpstairs
source:
Why don't you go upstairs and try
trading POKéMON with your friends?\pYou could get a lot more variety
by trading.\pThe POKéMON you get in trades grow
quickly, too.$
translation: 你问什么不上楼\n去试着和你的朋友交换宝可梦？\p通过交换你会获得更多的种类。\p通过交换得来的宝可梦\n也成长得很快。$

label: CinnabarIsland_Text_DoorIsLocked
source: The door is locked…$
translation: 门被锁上了......$

label: CinnabarIsland_Text_BlaineLivedHereSinceBeforeLab
source: CINNABAR GYM's BLAINE is quite the\nodd fellow.\pHe's lived on the island since way\nbefore the LAB was built.$
translation: 红莲道馆的夏伯很古怪。\p自从实验室建立以来\n他就一直住在岛上。$

label: CinnabarIsland_Text_ScientistsExperimentInMansion
source: Scientists conduct experiments \nin the burned-out building.\pYou know, the one they call the\nPOKéMON MANSION.$
translation: 科学家们在烧焦的建筑里\n做实验。\p就是在那边被称做是\n宝可梦屋的地方。$

label: CinnabarIsland_Text_IslandSign
source: CINNABAR ISLAND\nThe Fiery Town of Burning Desire$
translation: 红莲镇\n燃烧着炽热欲望的小镇$

label: CinnabarIsland_Text_PokemonLab
source: POKéMON LAB$
translation: 宝可梦实验室$

label: CinnabarIsland_Text_GymSign
source: CINNABAR ISLAND POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: BLAINE\lThe Hotheaded Quiz Master!$
translation: 红莲镇宝可梦道馆\n馆主：夏伯\l燃烧的谜题狂人！$

label: CinnabarIsland_Text_HeyIfItIsntPlayer
source: Huh?\nHey, if it isn't {PLAYER}!$
translation: 嗯？\n嘿，这不是{PLAYER}吗！$

label: CinnabarIsland_Text_ComeWithMeToOneIsland
source:
Look, it's me, BILL.
Long time no see!\pI hope you're still using my
PC system.\pWell, listen, since we met up here,
how about spending time with me?\pThere's this little island in the far
south called ONE ISLAND.\pA friend invited me, so I'm on my
way out there.\pHow about it?
Do you feel like coming with me?$
translation:
看，是我，正辉。
真是好久不见了！\p希望你还在使用我的
电脑系统。\p呐，既然我们在这里遇上，
要不要陪我一下？\p在遥远的南方有个小岛
叫做一之岛。\p一个朋友邀请我过去玩玩，
我正在去他那儿的路上。\p怎么样？
你想跟我一块去吗？$

label: CinnabarIsland_Text_AllRightLetsGo
source: All right, then.\nLet's go!$
translation: 那么好吧。\n我们走！$

label: CinnabarIsland_Text_IllBeWaitingInPokeCenter
source:
What, are you too busy?\pWell, all right.
The boat hasn't arrived yet anyway.\pI'll be waiting at the POKéMON
CENTER over there.\pCome see me when you're done with
your business here.$
translation: 什么，你很忙？\p那好吧。\n船到现在还没有到。\p我会在宝可梦中心等着你。\p你忙完了之后，\n再过来找我吧。$

label: CinnabarIsland_Text_MyPalsBoatArrived
source: Looks like my pal's boat arrived,\ntoo.\pHe sent it specially here to\nCINNABAR to pick me up.$
translation: 看起来我同伴的船也到了。\p他是特意来\n红莲镇接我的。$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_BlaineIntro
source:
Hah!\pI am BLAINE, the red-hot LEADER
of CINNABAR GYM!\pMy fiery POKéMON are all rough
and ready with intense heat!\pThey incinerate all challengers!\pHah!
You better have BURN HEAL!{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_RG_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}$
translation:
啊哈！\p夏伯就是我，
红莲道馆火热的馆主！\p我炽烈的宝可梦都
狂野而富有热情！\p它们会把所有的挑战者燃烧殆尽！\p好了！
开战前你最好准备些灼伤药！{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_RG_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_BlaineDefeat
source: I have burned down to nothing!\nNot even ashes remain!\pYou have earned the VOLCANOBADGE.$
translation: 被燃烧殆尽的是我！\n烧得连灰烬也不剩！\p深红徽章是你的了！$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_FireBlastIsUltimateFireMove
source: FIRE BLAST is the ultimate fire\ntechnique.\pDon't waste it on WATER POKéMON.$
translation: 大字爆炎是一个\n高级的火属性技能\p别把它浪费在水属性宝可梦身上。$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_ExplainVolcanoBadge
source: Hah!\pThe VOLCANOBADGE heightens the\nSPECIAL stats of your POKéMON.\pHere, you can have this, too!$
translation: 哈！\p深红徽章能够将你\n宝可梦的特攻提高一点点\p还有，你还能得到它！$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_ReceivedTM38FromBlaine
source: {PLAYER} received TM38\nfrom BLAINE.$
translation: {PLAYER}从夏伯那里\n得到了TM38。$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_BlainePostBattle
source: TM38 contains FIRE BLAST.\nTeach it to FIRE-type POKéMON.\pVULPIX or CHARMELEON would be\nideal for that move.$
translation: TM38是大字爆炎。\n把它教给火属性宝可梦。\p六尾或者火恐龙\n是一个不错的选择。$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_MakeSpaceForThis
source: Make space for this, child!$
translation: 把背包腾点空间再来，小子！$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_ErikIntro
source: Do you know how hot POKéMON fire\nbreath can get?$
translation: 你知道宝可梦\n灼热的吐息温度有多高吗？$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_ErikDefeat
source: Yow!\nHot, hot, hot!$
translation: 哟噢！\n烫，烫，烫！$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_ErikPostBattle
source: Fire, or to be more precise,\ncombustion…\p…Oxygen in the air…\nBlah, blah, blah, blah…$
translation: 燃素，专业点说的话，\n可燃物......\p......空气中的氧......\n叽哩呱啦呱啦叽哩...$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_QuinnIntro
source: I was a thief, but I went straight\nas a TRAINER.$
translation: 过去我是一名小偷\n但我现在是一名正直的训练家。$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_QuinnDefeat
source: I surrender!$
translation: 我要去自首！$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_QuinnPostBattle
source: I get this uncontrollable urge to\nsteal other people's POKéMON.$
translation: 对于其他人的宝可梦我总是\n难以抑制的想着去偷。$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_AveryIntro
source: I've studied POKéMON thoroughly.\nYou can't win!$
translation: 我很努力的学过了宝可梦的知识。\n你赢不了我的！$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_AveryDefeat
source: Waah!\nMy studies were insufficient!$
translation: 哇啊！\n我学的还不够！$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_AveryPostBattle
source: My theories are too complicated\nfor you to understand.$
translation: 我的理论很高深，\n和你讲你很难明白。$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_RamonIntro
source: I like using FIRE-type POKéMON.\nI just do.$
translation: 走自己的路让别人说去吧。\n我就只喜欢火属性的宝可梦。$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_RamonDefeat
source: Too hot to handle!$
translation: 温度高得不能控制了！$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_RamonPostBattle
source: I wish there were a thief POKéMON.\nI'd use that!$
translation: 我希望有一种小偷宝可梦。\n那我就指望着用它了！$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_DerekIntro
source: I know why BLAINE became a\nTRAINER.$
translation: 我知道夏伯为什么会\n成为一名训练家。$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_DerekDefeat
source: Ow!$
translation: 喔$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_DerekPostBattle
source:
Our LEADER, BLAINE, became lost
in the mountains but good.\pNight fell when a fiery bird
POKéMON appeared.\pIts light allowed BLAINE to find
his way down safely.$
translation:
我们的馆主，夏伯在山里迷路了，
但幸运的是，\p当夜幕降临的时候，
一只灼热的鸟宝可梦降临在他面前。\p它发出的光使
夏伯找到了下山的路。$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_DustyIntro
source: I've been to many GYMS, but this\none best suits my style.$
translation: 我去过许多道馆，\n但这个最合我的口味。$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_DustyDefeat
source: Yowza!\nToo hot!$
translation: 哇哇！\n好烫！$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_DustyPostBattle
source: PONYTA, NINETALES…\nThose are popular FIRE POKéMON.$
translation: 小火马，九尾...\n都是受欢迎的火属性宝可梦。$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_ZacIntro
source: Fire is weak against H2O.$
translation: 火对H2O不利。$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_ZacDefeat
source: Oh!\nSnuffed out!$
translation: 呃！\n火熄灭了！$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_ZacPostBattle
source: Water beats fire, of course.\pBut fire melts ice, so the FIRE\ntype beats ICE-type POKéMON.$
translation: 毋庸置疑，水克火。\p但是火能融化冰，\n所以火属性能够打败冰属性宝可梦。$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_GymGuyAdvice
source:
Yo!
Champ in the making!\pThe hotheaded BLAINE is a FIRE
POKéMON pro.\pDouse his spirits with water!\pYou'd better take some
BURN HEALS, too.$
translation:
哟！
未来的冠军！\p热血的夏伯是一位
炎宝可梦教授。\p用水来浇灭他的斗志吧！\p你最好带上些
灼伤药。$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_GymGuyPostVictory
source: {PLAYER}!\nYou beat that firebrand!$
translation: {PLAYER}\n你击败了那个火焰狂人$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_GymStatue
source: CINNABAR POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: BLAINE\pWINNING TRAINERS:\n{RIVAL}$
translation: 红莲宝可梦道馆\n馆主：夏伯\p优胜训练家：\n{RIVAL}$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_GymStatuePlayerWon
source: CINNABAR POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: BLAINE\pWINNING TRAINERS:\n{RIVAL}, {PLAYER}$
translation: 红莲宝可梦道馆\n馆主：夏伯\p优胜训练家：\n{RIVAL} {PLAYER}$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_PokemonQuizRules
source:
POKéMON Quiz!\pGet it right, and the door opens to
the next room.\pGet it wrong, and face a TRAINER!\pIf you want to conserve your
POKéMON for the GYM LEADER…\pThen get it right!
Here we go!$
translation:
宝可梦竞答！\p答对了，
通向下一个房间的门就会打开。\p答错了，就得面对训练家的挑战！\p你如果想要把你的实力
保留到最后一刻......\p那就要尽可能的答对！
三，二，一，开始了！$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_QuizQuestion1
source: CATERPIE evolves into METAPOD?$
translation: 绿毛虫进化成铁甲蛹吗？$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_QuizQuestion2
source: There are nine certified POKéMON\nLEAGUE BADGES?$
translation: 宝可梦联盟徽章\n一共有九枚？$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_QuizQuestion3
source: POLIWAG evolves three times?$
translation: 蚊香蝌蚪能进化三次？$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_QuizQuestion4
source: Are electric moves effective\nagainst GROUND-type POKéMON?$
translation: 电属性技能对地面属性\n宝可梦有效果吗？$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_QuizQuestion5
source: POKéMON of the same kind and level\nare not identical?$
translation: 同一种宝可梦有着同样的等级\n它们的能力却不一定一样？$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_QuizQuestion6
source: TM28 contains TOMBSTONY?$
translation: TM28是岩石封锁吗$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_CorrectGoOnThrough
source: You're absolutely correct!\pGo on through!$
translation: 你答得太对了！\p请通过！$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_SorryBadCall
source: Sorry!\nBad call!$
translation: 不好意思！\n答错了！$

label: CinnabarIsland_Mart_Text_DontTheyHaveXAttack
source: Don't they have X ATTACK?\pI like it because it raises the\nATTACK stat in battle.$
translation: 他们这里没有卖力量强化？\p我喜欢这个道具\n因为它能在战斗中提升攻击。$

label: CinnabarIsland_Mart_Text_ExtraItemsNeverHurt
source: It never hurts to have extra items.\nYou never know what might happen.$
translation: 没有必要再用其它道具，\n你永远不知道将会发生什么。$

label: CinnabarIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_CinnabarGymLocked
source:
I came to visit the CINNABAR GYM,
but the door is locked tight.\pThere should be a key for it
somewhere.\pCould it be in that burned-out
mansion?\pThe GYM LEADER's friend used to
live there, they say.$
translation:
我是特地来拜访红莲道馆的，
但是这里的门却锁得很紧。\p这附近某个地方
一定有一把能开门的钥匙。\p它该不会在
那幢被烧毁的房子里吧？\p我听说这岛上的道馆馆主的朋友
曾经住在那里。$

label: CinnabarIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_VisitUnionRoom
source:
Do you have lots of friends?\pLinking up with the usual friends
is fun, of course.\pBut how about visiting the
UNION ROOM every so often?\pWho knows, you may end up making
new friends.\pI think it would be worth your time
to check the UNION ROOM.$
translation:
你有那么一些朋友吗？\p毫无疑问，
和他们联机是很有趣的。\p既然如此何不去
联合房间看看呢？\p谁知道呢，
你会交到新的朋友也说不定呢。\p我想联合房间
一定值得一去。$

label: CinnabarIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_EvolutionCanWaitForNewMoves
source: POKéMON can still learn techniques\nafter canceling evolution.\pEvolution can wait until new moves\nhave been learned.$
translation: 宝可梦在取消进化之后\n仍然可以学会新技能。\p可以等新技能学会了\n之后再进化。$

label: CinnabarIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_ReadyToSailToOneIsland
source: BILL: Hey, you kept me waiting!\nReady to set sail to ONE ISLAND?$
translation: 正辉：嘿，让我好等！\n准备好乘船去一之岛了吗？$

label: CinnabarIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_OhNotDoneYet
source: Oh, you're still not done yet?$
translation: 噢，你还是没准备好？$

label: CinnabarIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_LetsGo
source: Well, that's it.\nLet's go!$
translation: 好，就是这样。\n出发了！$

label: CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_PhotoOfBlaineAndFuji
source: It's a photo of BLAINE and\nMR. FUJI.\pThey're standing shoulder to\nshoulder with big grins.$
translation: 这张照片上的人是夏伯和\n富士老人。\p他们咧着嘴笑着\n肩并肩的站在一起。$

label: CinnabarIsland_PokemonLab_Entrance_Text_StudyMonsExtensively
source: We study POKéMON extensively\nevery day.\pPeople often bring us rare POKéMON\nfor examination.$
translation: 我们每天都要学习大量\n宝可梦的知识。\p人们经常带着稀有的宝可梦来\n作为对我们的考验。$

label: CinnabarIsland_PokemonLab_Entrance_Text_PhotoOfLabFounderDrFuji
source: A photo of the LAB's founder…\nDR. FUJI?!$
translation: 一张研究所的创始人的照片......\n富士博士？！$

label: CinnabarIsland_PokemonLab_Entrance_Text_MeetingRoomSign
source: POKéMON LAB\nMeeting Room$
translation: 宝可梦实验室\n会客室$

label: CinnabarIsland_PokemonLab_Entrance_Text_RAndDRoomSign
source: POKéMON LAB\nR & D Room$
translation: 宝可梦实验室\n研究与发展办公室$

label: CinnabarIsland_PokemonLab_Entrance_Text_TestingRoomSign
source: POKéMON LAB\nTesting Room$
translation: 宝可梦实验室\n聊天室$

label: Text_MetronomeTeach
source:
Tch-tch-tch!
I'll teach you a nifty move.\pTeach it to a POKéMON, and watch
the fun unfold!\pIt's a move called METRONOME.
Does it strike your fancy?$
translation:
喔嚯嚯嚯！
我想要教你一个有趣的技能！\p把它教给宝可梦，
然后开心地看着它用出来的那一刻！\p这个技能的大名叫做挥指。
你心动了吗？$

label: Text_MetronomeDeclined
source: I tell you, it's a lot of fun!$
translation: 我告诉你，真的很有趣！$

label: Text_MetronomeWhichMon
source: Okay!\nWhich POKéMON should I teach?$
translation: 很好！\n哪只宝可梦想要学会这个技能？$

label: Text_MetronomeTaught
source: Tch-tch-tch!\nThat's the sound of a METRONOME.\pIt tweaks your POKéMON's brain into\nusing moves it doesn't even know.$
translation: 喔嚯嚯嚯！\n我来告诉你挥指的原理吧！\p它能刺激宝可梦的大脑\n来用出它并不会的技能！$

label: CinnabarIsland_PokemonLab_ExperimentRoom_Text_HaveYouAFossilForMe
source:
Hiya!\pI am important doctor.
Yes, very much so, indeed.\pHere, I study rare POKéMON fossils.
All the time, I study.\pYou!
Have you a fossil for me?$
translation:
嘿！\p我是一个十二分重要的研究员。
没错，十二分的重要。\p看，我在研究宝可梦的化石。
每时每刻，我都在进行研究。\p你！
有化石带给我吗？$

label: CinnabarIsland_PokemonLab_ExperimentRoom_Text_NoIsTooBad
source: No!\nIs too bad!$
translation: 噢！\n太不好了！$

label: CinnabarIsland_PokemonLab_ExperimentRoom_Text_FossilMonBackToLife
source: You late.\nWhere were you?\pYour fossil is back to life!\nIt was {STR_VAR_1} like I think!$
translation: 你来晚了。\n你跑哪儿去了？\p你的化石复活了！\n正如我所预料的那样，是一只{STR_VAR_1}！$

label: CinnabarIsland_PokemonLab_ExperimentRoom_Text_ReceivedMonFromDoctor
source: {PLAYER} received the {STR_VAR_1}\nfrom the doctor.$
translation: {PLAYER}从研究员的手中\n得到了{STR_VAR_1}。$

label: CinnabarIsland_PokemonLab_ExperimentRoom_Text_ThatFossilIsOfMonMakeItLiveAgain
source:
Oh!
That is {STR_VAR_2}, it is!\pIt is fossil of {STR_VAR_1},
a POKéMON that is already extinct!\pMy Resurrection Machine will make
that POKéMON live again!$
translation:
喔！
那正是{STR_VAR_2}，我没看错！\p那是{STR_VAR_1}的化石，
一种被认为灭绝了的宝可梦！\p我研制的复活机器
能让那只宝可梦回到这个世界！$

label: CinnabarIsland_PokemonLab_ExperimentRoom_Text_HandedFossilToWeirdDoctor
source: So!\nYou hurry and give me that!\p{FONT_NORMAL}{PLAYER} handed over the\n{STR_VAR_2} to the weird doctor.$
translation: 所以呢！\n你得快点把它交给我！\p{FONT_NORMAL}{PLAYER}把\n{STR_VAR_2}交给了这个奇怪的研究员$

label: CinnabarIsland_PokemonLab_ExperimentRoom_Text_TakesTimeGoForWalk
source: I take a little time!\nYou go for walk a little while!$
translation: 我只需要一点点时间！\n现在你可以出去走走！$

label: CinnabarIsland_PokemonLab_ExperimentRoom_Text_YouComeAgain
source: Aiyah!\nYou come again!$
translation: 哎哎！\n你又来了！$

label: CinnabarIsland_PokemonLab_Lounge_Text_FoundFossilInMtMoon
source: I found this most remarkable fossil\ninside MT. MOON.\pI think it's of a rare, prehistoric\nPOKéMON.$
translation: 我这块令人羡慕的化石\n是在月见山找到的。\p我认为里面是一只罕见的，\n史前的宝可梦。$

label: CinnabarIsland_PokemonLab_ResearchRoom_Text_EeveeCanEvolveIntroThreeMons
source: EEVEE can evolve into one of three\nkinds of POKéMON.$
translation: 伊布可以进化成\n三种不同的宝可梦。$

label: CinnabarIsland_PokemonLab_ResearchRoom_Text_LegendaryBirdEmail
source:
There's an e-mail message.\p… … …\pThere are three legendary bird
POKéMON.\pThey are ARTICUNO, ZAPDOS, and
MOLTRES.\pTheir whereabouts are unknown.\pWe plan to explore the cavern
close to CERULEAN.\pFrom: POKéMON RESEARCH TEAM…$
translation:
一封电子邮件\p...... ...... ......\p世界上有三只传说中的
鸟宝可梦。\p他们是急冻鸟，闪电鸟，和
火焰鸟。\p它们的栖息地还是个未解之谜。\p我们计划先从
华蓝附近的山洞开始寻找。\p来自：宝可梦研究组......$

label: CinnabarIsland_PokemonLab_ResearchRoom_Text_AnAmberPipe
source: An amber pipe!$
translation: 一支琥珀笛子！$

label: DesertUnderpass_Text_FoundRootFossil
source: {PLAYER} found the ROOT FOSSIL.$
translation: {PLAYER}找到了根状化石。$

label: DesertUnderpass_Text_FoundClawFossil
source: {PLAYER} found the CLAW FOSSIL.$
translation: {PLAYER}找到了爪子化石。$

label: DewfordTown_Text_TinyIslandCommunity
source: DEWFORD is a tiny island community.\nIf something gets trendy here,\leveryone picks up on it right away.$
translation: 武斗镇是个很小的岛镇，\n如果什么在这儿流行起来，\l很快所有人都会开始谈论。$

label: DewfordTown_Text_TownSign
source: DEWFORD TOWN\n“A tiny island in the blue sea.”$
translation: 这里是武斗镇。\n"漂浮在蓝海上的小岛。"$

label: DewfordTown_Text_GymSign
source: DEWFORD TOWN POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: BRAWLY\l“A big wave in fighting!”$
translation: 武斗镇宝可梦道馆\n馆主：藤树\l"格斗浪潮！"$

label: DewfordTown_Text_HallSign
source: DEWFORD HALL\n“Everyone's information exchange!”$
translation: 武斗镇大厅\n"信息交换处！"$

label: Route104_Text_LandedInDewfordDeliverLetter
source: MR. BRINEY: Ahoy!\nWe've hit land in DEWFORD.\pI suppose you're off to deliver that\nLETTER to, who was it now, STEVEN!$
translation: 哈奇：喂！\n我们到武斗镇啦！\p我想你要去给那个......大吾，\n送信是吧！$

label: DewfordTown_Text_SetSailBackToPetalburg
source: MR. BRINEY: Have you delivered your\nLETTER?\pOr were you meaning to sail back to\nPETALBURG?$
translation: 哈奇：你已经送完信了吗？\p还是你想回橙华市去？$

label: DewfordTown_Text_PetalburgWereSettingSail2
source: MR. BRINEY: PETALBURG it is, then!\pAnchors aweigh!\nPEEKO, we're setting sail, my darling!$
translation: 哈奇：目标，橙华市！\p起锚！\n小皮，亲爱的，出海了！$

label: DewfordTown_Text_GoDeliverIllBeWaiting
source: MR. BRINEY: Then you go on and deliver\nthe LETTER. I'll be waiting.$
translation: 哈奇：那你去送信吧，\n我就在这儿等着。$

label: DewfordTown_Text_BrineyLandedInDewford
source: MR. BRINEY: Ahoy!\nWe've hit land in DEWFORD!\pYou just go on and tell me whenever\nyou want to set sail again!$
translation: 哈奇：喂！\n我们到武斗镇了！\p想再出海随时叫我！$

label: DewfordTown_Text_WhereAreWeBound
source: MR. BRINEY: Ahoy!\nFor you, I'll go out to sea anytime!\pNow, my friend, where are we bound?$
translation: 哈奇：喂！\n为了你我随时都能出海！\p说吧朋友，\n这次想去哪儿？$

label: DewfordTown_Text_PetalburgWereSettingSail
source: MR. BRINEY: PETALBURG, is it?\pAnchors aweigh!\nPEEKO, we're setting sail, my darling!$
translation: 哈奇：橙华市是吗？\p起锚！\n小皮，亲爱的，出海了！$

label: DewfordTown_Text_SlateportWereSettingSail
source: MR. BRINEY: SLATEPORT, is it?\pAnchors aweigh!\nPEEKO, we're setting sail, my darling!$
translation: 哈奇：凯那市是吗？\p起锚！\n小皮，亲爱的，出海了！$

label: DewfordTown_Text_JustTellMeWhenYouNeedToSetSail
source: MR. BRINEY: You just tell me whenever\nyou need to set sail again!$
translation: 哈奇：想再出海随时叫我！$

label: DewfordTown_Text_GettingItchToFish
source: This is a renowned fishing spot.\nAre you getting the itch to fish?$
translation: 这里是著名的钓场。\n你渴望钓鱼吗？$

label: DewfordTown_Text_GiveYouOneOfMyRods
source: I hear you, and I like what\nyou're saying!\pI'll give you one of my fishing RODS.$
translation: 我听到了，\n我真高兴你能这么说！\p我就把我的钓竿给你一支吧。$

label: DewfordTown_Text_ThrowInFishingAdvice
source:
And, as an added bonus, I'll even throw
in a little fishing advice!\pFirst, you want to face the water,
then use the ROD.\pFocus your mind…
If you get a bite, pull on the ROD.\pSometimes you can snag something
immediately, but with bigger catches,\lyou need to time the pulls on your ROD\lto haul them in.$
translation:
作为附送，
我给你几条钓鱼的建议吧！\p首先，面对水面，
甩出钓竿。\p集中精神......
鱼咬钩的时候，拉起钓竿。\p有时你马上就能钓到什么，
但想钓大家伙的话，\l你就得计算好钓的晃动次数\l才能拖它们上来。$

label: DewfordTown_Text_ThatsTooBadThen
source: Oh, is that so?\nThat's too bad, then.$
translation: 哦，是吗？\n真遗憾。$

label: DewfordTown_Text_HowsYourFishing
source: Yo!\nHow's your fishing?$
translation: 哟！\n鱼钓得怎么样了？$

label: DewfordTown_Text_GreatHaulInSomeBigOnes
source: Is that right! That's great!\nHaul in some big ones!$
translation: 是吗！太好了！\n继续钓更大的鱼吧！$

label: DewfordTown_Text_FishingAdvice
source:
Oh, hey, don't get down on yourself!
I'll give you a little fishing advice.\pFirst, you want to face the water,
then use the ROD.\pFocus your mind…
If you get a bite, pull the ROD.\pSometimes you can snag something
immediately, but with bigger catches,\lyou need to time the pulls on your ROD\lto haul them in.$
translation:
好了，别沮丧，！
我给你点钓鱼的建议。\p首先，面对水面，
甩出钓竿。\p集中精神......
鱼咬钩的时候，拉起钓竿。\p有时你马上就能钓到什么，
但想钓大家伙的话，\l你就得计算好钓竿的晃动次数\l才能拖它们上来。$

label: DewfordTown_Text_XIsTheBiggestHappeningThingRight
source:
I like what's hip, happening, and trendy.
I'm always checking it out.\pListen, have you heard about this new
“{STR_VAR_1}”?\pThat's right!
Of course you know!\pI mean, sheesh,
“{STR_VAR_1}”…\lIt's the hottest thing in cool!\pWherever you're from,
“{STR_VAR_1}”\lis the biggest happening thing, right?$
translation:
我知道什么在发生，什么最时髦，
我一直在调查。\p你听说过这个新词
"{STR_VAR_1}"吗？\p没错！
你当然知道！\p我是说，嘘
"{STR_VAR_1}"......\l是现在最新最热的词！\p无论你从哪儿来，
"{STR_VAR_1}"\l都是最重要的事，对吗？$

label: DewfordTown_Text_TellMeWhatsNewAndIn
source: Hunh?\nIt's not the hip and happening thing?\pWell, hey, you have to tell me,\nwhat's new and what's “in”?$
translation: 嗯？\n这不是现在最流行的吗？\p哎，那么，你得告诉我，\n现在最流行的是什么？$

label: DewfordTown_Text_OfCourseIKnowAboutThat
source:
Hunh?
“{STR_VAR_2}”?\p… …\p…Uh… Yeah! That's right!
Yeah, I knew that! Knew it all along!\pOf course I know about that!
“{STR_VAR_2},” right?\pYeah, that's it, it's there!
Isn't “{STR_VAR_2}”\lthe coolest, or what?\pIt's the hippest thing in hip.
You think I'd not know about it?\p“{STR_VAR_1}”…
It's, like, so five minutes ago.\pNow, “{STR_VAR_2}” is
what's vital and in tune with the times!$
translation:
呃？
"{STR_VAR_2}"？\p......\p......呃......对！没错！
我知道！一直都知道！\p我当然知道！
"{STR_VAR_2}"，对吗？\p对，是它，就是它！
"{STR_VAR_2}"\l不就是最酷的词吗？\p不就是在潮流最尖端的词吗？
你以为我不知道吗？\p"{STR_VAR_1}"......
那只是，呃，五分钟前的事了，\p现在，"{STR_VAR_2}"才是
最重要最时兴的！$

label: DewfordTown_Text_XHuhIThinkYIsCool
source: Hmm…\n“{STR_VAR_2},” huh?\pBut personally, I think\n“{STR_VAR_1}”\lis what's real in cool.$
translation: 唔......\n"{STR_VAR_2}"？\p但我觉得，\n"{STR_VAR_1}"\l才是最棒的。$

label: DewfordTown_Text_HearOfAnyTrendsComeShareWithMe
source: Well, if you hear of any happening new\ntrends, come share them with me, okay?$
translation: 那，如果你听说了什么\n新的流行词，来跟我说说好吗？$

label: DewfordTown_Text_YeahDefinitionOfInRightNow
source: Yeah, absolutely right!\p“{STR_VAR_1}” is the\ndefinition of “in” right now.$
translation: 没错，完全正确！\p现在"{STR_VAR_1}"\n就是流行！$

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_GymGuideAdvice
source:
Hey, how's it going, CHAMPION-
bound {PLAYER}?\pDEWFORD's GYM LEADER BRAWLY commands
FIGHTING-type POKéMON.\pGoing against him with NORMAL-type
POKéMON is asking for trouble.\pFIGHTING POKéMON will lay a serious
smack down on NORMAL POKéMON,\lso be careful!\pWhat's worse, the GYM is as dark as
the ocean floor.\pBut it will get brighter after defeating
the TRAINERS in your way.\pHey, okay, go for it!$
translation:
嗨，怎么样，向冠军的目标
冲刺的{PLAYER}？\p武斗镇的道馆馆主藤树
使用的是格斗属性宝可梦。\p想用一般属性
宝可梦对付他是自找麻烦。\p格斗宝可梦会对
一般宝可梦造成极大伤害，\l要小心！\p更麻烦的是，道馆里就像
海底一样黑暗，\p但随着打败一路上的训练家，
室内会越来越明亮。\p好了，加油吧！$

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_GymGuidePostVictory
source: Whoah! It's turned too bright in here!\pYour future is bright, too!$
translation: 哇！这里变亮了！\p你的未来也是一片光明！$

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_TakaoIntro
source: Might is right!\nCome on!$
translation: 力量决定一切！\n来吧！$

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_TakaoDefeat
source: Not enough power…$
translation: 力量还不够......$

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_TakaoPostBattle
source: Your skill overcame my strength!\nYour technique is commendable!$
translation: 你的技术胜过了我的力量！\n我欣赏你的实力！$

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_JocelynIntro
source: There's no need for BRAWLY to be\ninvolved!\pI'll crush you!$
translation: 没必要让\n藤树出手！\p我就能对付你！$

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_JocelynDefeat
source: But… How?\nHow could I lose so easily?$
translation: 但......怎么会？\n怎么会这么快就输了？$

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_JocelynPostBattle
source: I'm not going to waste this loss.\nI'll use it to motivate me to train!\pOne day I'll become a GYM LEADER…\pNo, I'll become the POKéMON LEAGUE\nCHAMPION!$
translation: 我不会浪费这次失败，\n我要用它来激励我继续训练！\p总有一天，我会成为道馆馆主......\p不，是成为宝可梦联盟\n冠军！$

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_LauraIntro
source: Don't you dare brush me off!\nIt's not my fault if you cry!$
translation: 你胆敢无视我吗！\n把你打哭了别怪我！$

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_LauraDefeat
source: Waaaaaaah!\nI lost!$
translation: 哇啊啊啊！\n我输了！$

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_LauraPostBattle
source: I battle in the dark to make my heart\nstronger.\pBut because it's so dark, I can never\nsee BRAWLY's face…$
translation: 我在黑暗中战斗，\n训练我的胆量。\p但这里实在太暗，\n我甚至看不清藤树的样子......$

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_LilithIntro
source: Ufufu…\nAre you stumbling around in the dark?$
translation: 哼哼哼......\n你在黑暗中跌跌撞撞地摸索吗？$

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_LilithDefeat
source: Oh, you…\nI don't want to know you!$
translation: 哎，你......\n真不想见到你！$

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_LilithPostBattle
source: You deserve to stay lost and end up\nback at the entrance again!$
translation: 尽管你可能迷路了，\n但最后还会回到出口的！$

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_BrendenIntro
source: I'll show you the gumption of\na sailing man!$
translation: 让你看看\n水手的智慧！$

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_BrendenDefeat
source: How'd this happen?\nIt's not like me to lose this way!$
translation: 这怎么可能？\n我怎么会这样输掉！$

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_BrendenPostBattle
source: Oh, aye! You're worthy of seeing\nour GYM LEADER.$
translation: 啊，没错！你有能力\n去见我们的道馆馆主。$

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_CristianIntro
source: If you mean to pass, it has to be\nthrough me!$
translation: 你想过去的话，\n先过我这一关！$

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_CristianDefeat
source: Grrrrr!\nVastly overpowered!$
translation: 咕呜！\n完全失败了！$

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_CristianPostBattle
source: You win!\nGo after that BADGE!$
translation: 你赢了！\n去争取徽章吧！$

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_BrawlyIntro
source:
I'm BRAWLY!
DEWFORD's GYM LEADER!\pI've been churned in the rough waves
of these parts, and I've grown tough\lin the pitch-black cave!\pSo you wanted to challenge me?
Let me see what you're made of!$
translation:
我是藤树！
武斗镇宝可梦道馆的馆主！\p我在这附近的险浪中翻腾......
在漆黑的洞窟中修行！\p想挑战我那就把你的实力......
全部展现出来吧！$

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_BrawlyDefeat
source: Whoah, wow! You made a much bigger\nsplash than I expected!\pYou swamped me!\pOkay, you've got me.\nTake this GYM BADGE!$
translation: 喔喔！\n你一定会成为浪潮！\p我知道了！\p收下这枚道馆徽章吧！$

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_ReceivedKnuckleBadge
source: {PLAYER} received the KNUCKLE BADGE\nfrom BRAWLY.$
translation: {PLAYER}从藤树那里\n得到了拳击徽章。$

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_KnuckleBadgeInfoTakeThis
source:
The KNUCKLE BADGE makes all POKéMON
up to Level 30, even those you get in\ltrades, obey without question.\pAnd, you'll be able to use the HM move
FLASH outside of battle.\pIf you'd like, use this TECHNICAL
MACHINE, too.$
translation:
拳击徽章能让等级30以内的宝可梦，
即使是交换得来的也乖乖听话！\p另外，你能在对战外使用
秘传招式闪光了。\p喜欢的话，
这个也给你吧。$

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_ExplainBulkUp
source: That TM08 contains BULK UP.\pIt's a move that raises both ATTACK\nand DEFENSE stats.\p… … … … … …$
translation: 那个招式学习器08中是\n健美！\p是能同时提升攻击和\n防御能力的招式！\p...... ...... ......$

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_RegisteredBrawly
source: Registered GYM LEADER BRAWLY\nin the POKéNAV.$
translation: 把道馆馆主藤树\n登记到宝可导航里了。$

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_BrawlyPostBattle
source: I can see your talent becoming a giant\nwave to cause a storm of astonishment\lamong TRAINERS one day!$
translation: 你的才能有朝一日将成为巨浪，\n掀起令所有训练家惊愕不已的风暴！$

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_GymStatue
source: DEWFORD TOWN POKéMON GYM$
translation: 武斗镇宝可梦道馆$

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_GymStatueCertified
source: DEWFORD TOWN POKéMON GYM\pBRAWLY'S CERTIFIED TRAINERS:\n{PLAYER}$
translation: 武斗镇宝可梦道馆\p藤树认可的训练家：\n{PLAYER}$

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_BrawlyPreRematch
source:
BRAWLY: A wave may draw back, but it
always returns to the shore.\pA giant wave of a talent like you…
I knew you would return!\pShow me how much higher
you've gone!$
translation: 藤树：海浪终会回到海滨。\p像你这样有天赋的巨浪......\n我知道你会回来！\p让我看看这巨浪已经达到\n何种高度了吧！$

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_BrawlyRematchDefeat
source: Wow!\nSwamped again!$
translation: 喔！\n又让我湿透了！$

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_BrawlyPostRematch
source: BRAWLY: Battling is vast and it's deep.\nYou can't see the bottom.\lIt's just like the sea of HOENN!$
translation: 藤树：对战是浩瀚无边，\n深不见底的。\l就像是丰缘的大海一样！$

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_BrawlyRematchNeedTwoMons
source:
BRAWLY: A wave may draw back, but it
always returns to the shore.\pA giant wave of a talent like you…
I knew you would return!\pOh? You only have one POKéMON
that can battle.\pI'm sorry, but I'd like you to come back
with at least two POKéMON.$
translation:
藤树：海浪终会回到海滨。\p像你这样有天赋的巨浪.........
我知道你会回来！\p哦？你只有1只可以
对战的宝可梦。\p但我希望你至少
带2只宝可梦来。$

label: DewfordTown_Hall_Text_CantImagineLifeWithoutTrend
source: What's in vogue? Why, it has to be\n“{STR_VAR_1}”!\pI can't imagine what life would be like\nwithout “{STR_VAR_1}”!$
translation: 现在流行什么？哎，当然是\n"{STR_VAR_1}"！\p不敢相信生活中没有\n"{STR_VAR_1}"会怎么样！$

label: DewfordTown_Hall_Text_GettingBoredOfTrend
source: What's in vogue? Why, it has to be\n“{STR_VAR_1}”!\pBut I'm getting kind of bored with it.\pI should look for the next big thing.$
translation: 现在流行什么？哎，当然是\n"{STR_VAR_1}"！\p但我对它已经有些腻了。\p说不定该找点\n新玩意儿了。$

label: DewfordTown_Hall_Text_TeachingMonAboutTrend
source: I'm teaching my POKéMON about\n“{STR_VAR_1},”\lbut it's not going well.\pIt's a bit too much, I think.$
translation: 我想把"{STR_VAR_1}"\n的事教给我的宝可梦，\l但好像不太顺利。\p我想这对它来说太困难了。$

label: DewfordTown_Hall_Text_DeepLinkBetweenXAndY
source: I'm studying up on the hip and trendy\n“{STR_VAR_1}” now.\pIs it true that there's a deep link\nbetween “{STR_VAR_1}”\land “{STR_VAR_2}”?$
translation: 我正在研究现今十分流行的\n"{STR_VAR_1}"。\p"{STR_VAR_1}"和\n"{STR_VAR_2}"之间\l是不是有很深的联系呢？$

label: DewfordTown_Hall_Text_MyHunchWasRight
source: Oh!\nSo, my hunch was right!\pI'm one step closer to being hip and\nhappening, yowza!$
translation: 啊！\n我的直觉是对的！\p我离流行达人又近了一步，\n万岁！$

label: DewfordTown_Hall_Text_NotEasyToKeepUp
source: What?!\nIs that so?!\pIt's not easy for an older fellow like\nme to keep up with trends!$
translation: 什么？！\n真的？！\p对我这样的老人来说，\n跟上潮流可不容易！$

label: DewfordTown_Hall_Text_TVShowAboutTrend
source: This whole business about\n“{STR_VAR_1}”…\lIsn't there a TV show on it?$
translation: 说到关于\n"{STR_VAR_1}"的事......\l是不是有相关的电视节目？$

label: DewfordTown_Hall_Text_IsTrendMorePopularAcrossSea
source: Across the sea…\pIs “{STR_VAR_1}”\neven more popular?$
translation: 在海的另一侧......\p"{STR_VAR_1}"\n是不是更加流行吗？$

label: DewfordTown_Hall_Text_CollectTrendMerchandise
source:
I collect official
“{STR_VAR_1}”\llicensed merchandise.\pI have official
“{STR_VAR_1}” DOLLS…\pOfficial “{STR_VAR_1}”
brand clothing…\pAnd officially licensed
“{STR_VAR_1}”\lpicture books.\pHeheh, I own!
I'm not sharing anything with you!$
translation:
我收集正版授权的
"{STR_VAR_1}"周边。\p我有正版
"{STR_VAR_1}"玩偶......\p正版"{STR_VAR_1}"
品牌服装......\p还有正版授权的
"{STR_VAR_1}"\l图书。\p嘿嘿，都是我的！
才不给你看呢！$

label: DewfordTown_Hall_Text_BooksAboutTrend
source:
IDENTIFYING GOOD
“{STR_VAR_1}” &\lBAD “{STR_VAR_1}”…\pTHE LINK BETWEEN
“{STR_VAR_1}” AND\lPOKéMON…\pUSEFUL
“{STR_VAR_1}”…\pIt's neatly jammed with books about
“{STR_VAR_1}.”$
translation:
辨别好的
"{STR_VAR_1}"&\l坏的"{STR_VAR_1}"......\p"{STR_VAR_1}"和
宝可梦之间的关系......\p实用的
"{STR_VAR_1}"......\p书架上塞满了关于
"{STR_VAR_1}"的书。$

label: DewfordTown_Hall_Text_TrendsScream
source: “{STR_VAR_1}'S\nSCREAM” is the title.$
translation: 标题是"{STR_VAR_1}的\n尖叫"。$

label: DewfordTown_Hall_Text_TrendsSmile
source: “{STR_VAR_1}'S\nSMILE” is the title.$
translation: 标题是"{STR_VAR_1}的\n微笑"。$

label: DewfordTown_Hall_Text_LastTrend
source: It's titled “THE LAST\n{STR_VAR_1}”.$
translation: 标题是"最后的\n{STR_VAR_1}"。$

label: DewfordTown_Hall_Text_BirthOfTrend
source: It's titled “THE BIRTH OF\n{STR_VAR_1}”.$
translation: 标题是"{STR_VAR_1}\n的诞生"。$

label: DewfordTown_Hall_Text_SawTrendCoolestThing
source: I saw “{STR_VAR_1}”!\nCool, huh?\pIt's, like, the coolest thing going!\pIt was awesome!\nIt was the real thing, oh yeah!$
translation:
我看过"{STR_VAR_1}"！
超酷对吧？\p这绝对是当下
最火的东西！\p太惊艳了！
这才是真正的潮流啊！$

label: DewfordTown_Hall_Text_AllegedTrendNotAuthentic
source: Oh, no, no, no.\pThat alleged\n“{STR_VAR_1}”\lyou claim to have seen--it's not.\pThe authentic article is much…\nHow should I say it?\lSharper, yet more mellow!\pAh, no matter. It's astonishing!$
translation:
啊，不不不。\p你说你看到过
"{STR_VAR_1}"\l--那不可能。\p真正的版本更加......
怎么说呢，\l更犀利也更柔和！\p总之简直
不可思议！$

label: DewfordTown_Hall_Text_ComposedTrendThemeSong
source:
Hey, listen, I composed a theme song
for “{STR_VAR_1}.”\p“{STR_VAR_1}”
is really popular right now.\pOkay, listen!
… …\pOh!
{STR_VAR_1}!\pWonderful
{STR_VAR_1}!$
translation:
嘿，听好，我为
"{STR_VAR_1}"作了曲。\p"{STR_VAR_1}"
现在真的非常流行。\p好了，听着！
......\p哦！
{STR_VAR_1}！\p美丽的
{STR_VAR_1}！$

label: DewfordTown_Hall_Text_WorkOnYourSinging
source: … …\pI dare say, chap, it would pay for you\nto work on your singing before you\ltrifle yourself with\l“{STR_VAR_1}.”$
translation: ......\p我说，伙计，\n你沉迷"{STR_VAR_1}"前\l能不能先学会怎么唱歌？$

label: DewfordTown_Hall_Text_OrganizeTrendParty
source: Anyway, as I was saying earlier, we\nshould get together and organize a\l“{STR_VAR_1}” party\lon the island.$
translation: 无论如何，\n就像我之前说的，\l我们该在岛上组织个\l"{STR_VAR_1}"派对了。$

label: DewfordTown_Hall_Text_BrilliantIndeed
source: Oh, a smashing good idea!\pIt will settle once and for all\nwho is the best at\l“{STR_VAR_1}.”\lBrilliant, indeed!\pStarting today, our lives will revolve\naround “{STR_VAR_1}”!$
translation: 啊，绝妙的主意！\p这样就能决出谁才是最擅长\n"{STR_VAR_1}"的人。\l真是绝妙的主意！\p从今天起，我们的生活就围绕\n"{STR_VAR_1}"了！$

label: DewfordTown_Hall_Text_TrendHasBecomePartOfLife
source: I was thinking, though…\pWouldn't you agree that\n“{STR_VAR_1}” has\lgrown from being something trendy to\lbeing a part of our daily lives?$
translation: 其实我在想......\p你不觉得\n"{STR_VAR_1}"\l已经从潮流变成我们\l日常生活的一部分了吗？$

label: DewfordTown_Hall_Text_TrendWeighsHeavilyOnMind
source:
Beg pardon?
That much, what?\pHowever, it's true that
“{STR_VAR_1}”\lweighs heavily on your mind, whether\lyou're awake or asleep.\pAbsolutely, you're the
“{STR_VAR_1}”\lPROFESSOR, old sport!$
translation:
什么？
有那么夸张？\p不过"{STR_VAR_1}"
确实让你魂牵梦萦，\l醒着睡着都在想。\p你简直就是
"{STR_VAR_1}"教授！$

label: DewfordTown_Hall_Text_IfWeTeamUpWellBeInvincible
source: If you and me team up as a combo,\nwe'll be invincible when it comes to all\lthings “{STR_VAR_1}”!$
translation: 只要我们组队，\n在"{STR_VAR_1}"\l领域就所向无敌！$

label: DewfordTown_Hall_Text_WellBeTrendDuo
source: Spot on, my friend!\pWe shall be the\n“{STR_VAR_1}” DUO!\pIsn't that a ripe image?\nHahahah!$
translation: 说得好，朋友！\p我们就是\n"{STR_VAR_1}"2人组！\p这形象太完美了！\n哈哈哈！$

label: DewfordTown_Hall_Text_GiveYouSludgeBomb
source:
For me, SLUDGE BOMB is at the peak
of popularity. It's the one.\pHunh? You're telling me that you don't
know about SLUDGE BOMB?\pThat's outright pitiful.
I'll give you one.$
translation:
对我来说，污泥炸弹才是
最为流行的。\p嗯？你说你不知道
污泥炸弹？\p这也太可怜了。
我给你一个吧。$

label: DewfordTown_Hall_Text_LoveSludgeBombButTrendInToo
source: I love SLUDGE BOMB.\pBut POKéMON with the move\n“{STR_VAR_1}”\lare in, too.$
translation: 我超爱污泥炸弹。\p但现在会\n"{STR_VAR_1}"的\l宝可梦也很流行呢。$

label: DewfordTown_House1_Text_LotToBeSaidForLivingOnIsland
source: There's a lot to be said for living on\na small island like this in harmony with\lPOKéMON and the family.$
translation: 住在这样的小岛上，\n与家人、宝可梦和睦共处，\l多么美妙！$

label: DewfordTown_House1_Text_LifeGoesSlowlyOnIsland
source: I left the major port of SLATEPORT\nCITY when I married my husband here.\pLife goes by slowly on this little\nisland. But being surrounded by the\lbeautiful sea--that's happiness, too.$
translation: 我跟丈夫结婚后就离开了\n凯那市的港口。\p在小岛上的时光过得很缓慢，\n但被美丽的大海环绕着--\l感觉真的很幸福。$

label: DewfordTown_House1_Text_Zigzagoon
source: ZIGZAGOON: Guguuh!$
translation: 蛇纹熊：咕咕！$

label: DewfordTown_House2_Text_WantYouToHaveSilkScarf
source:
Gorge your eyes on this!\pIt's a SILK SCARF. It's right at the
cutting edge of fashion, yeah!\pOh, I can see your eyes twinkling!
You appreciate my dazzling style!\pOh, you're a delight!
Here you go. I want you to have it!$
translation:
来一饱眼福吧！\p这是丝绸围巾，
是正流行的款式！\p啊，你的眼睛兴奋地发光了！
你欣赏我这眩目的款式！\p啊，真高兴！
给你吧，送给你了！$

label: DewfordTown_House2_Text_NoRoom
source: Oh, you don't have room?\pNow, listen tight, this SCARF is a must-\nhave! Why, I would sell all my items\lin order to get it!$
translation: 呀，你没地方装了？\p那，听好，这个围巾是\n你的必备品！哎，我要是你，\l我会卖掉我的一切来得到它！$

label: DewfordTown_House2_Text_ExplainSilkScarf
source: The SILK SCARF raises the power of\nNORMAL-type moves.\pIt's a marvelous SCARF that will go\nwith almost all POKéMON!$
translation: 丝绸围巾能提升\n一般属性招式的威力，\p是对几乎所有宝可梦都有\n极大用处的头巾！$

label: DewfordTown_House2_Text_BrawlySoCool
source:
Wow, you bothered to cross the sea
to visit DEWFORD?\pDid you maybe come here because you
heard about BRAWLY?\pHe's so cool…
Everyone idolizes him.$
translation:
哇，你是渡海来到
武斗镇的吗？\p是因为听说藤树
而来的吗？\p他真的很棒......
大家都很崇敬他。$

label: DewfordTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_StoneCavern
source: There's a stone cavern at the edge\nof town.\pI've heard you can find rare stones\nthere.$
translation: 镇子边上有个石窟。\p据说那里面能\n找到稀有的石头。$

label: DewfordTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_FaintedMonCanUseHM
source: Even if a POKéMON faints and can't\nbattle, it can still use a move learned\lfrom a HIDDEN MACHINE (HM).$
translation: 即使宝可梦昏厥不能战斗了，\n它也仍然可以使用秘传招式。$

label: DiglettsCave_NorthEntrance_RockTunnelPitchBlack
source: I went inside ROCK TUNNEL, but it's\npitch-black and scary in there.\pIf I could get a POKéMON to use\nFLASH and light it up…$
translation: 我去过岩山隧道，那里\n很黑，让人心里发毛。\p要是我能得到一个宝可梦会使用\n闪光来发光的话......$

label: DiglettsCave_SouthEntrance_Text_DiglettDugThisTunnel
source: Well, isn't this a surprise!\nDIGLETT dug this long tunnel!\pIt goes right to VIRIDIAN CITY,\nthey tell me.$
translation: 这不是一个大惊喜么！\n地鼠挖出了这个长长的隧道！\p他们告诉我，\n穿过这里就是常青市。$

label: EverGrandeCity_Text_EnteringVictoryRoad
source: ENTERING VICTORY ROAD$
translation: 由此进入冠军之路$

label: EverGrandeCity_Text_EnteringPokemonLeague
source: ENTERING POKéMON LEAGUE\nCENTER GATE$
translation: 由此进入宝可梦联盟\n中心大门$

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_Defeat
source: I, the CHAMPION, fall in defeat…\pThat was wonderful work.\nYou were elegant, infuriatingly so.\lAnd yet it was utterly glorious!\pKudos to you, {PLAYER}{KUN}!\pYou are a truly noble POKéMON\nTRAINER!$
translation: 我，冠军，输了......\p美妙得令人赞叹！\n优雅得令人眼红！\l这实在是太~辉煌耀眼了！！\p光荣属于你，{PLAYER}{KUN}！\p你是一名真正高贵的\n宝可梦训练家！$

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_PostBattleSpeech
source:
WALLACE: The POKéMON you sent into
battle…\pAt times they danced like a spring
breeze, and at times they struck\llike lightning.\pIt was with light, yet surefooted,
elegance that you led your POKéMON.\pEven I felt bedazzled by your
masterful performance!\pYou now stand at the glorious peak
of the POKéMON LEAGUE.\pI now proclaim you to be the new
HOENN region…$
translation:
米可利：你的宝可梦
在对战中......\p时而轻柔如风，
时而又迅猛如雷。\p还带着一丝，
无疑是从你那里耳濡目染所得的，\l轻盈而坚定的优雅。\p甚至连我都为你
出色的表现而深深地着迷！\p此刻你已站上宝可梦联盟
光荣的顶峰，\p我宣布你已成为
丰缘地区的新......$

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_MayAdvice
source: MAY: {PLAYER}{KUN}!\pHere's some advice before you challenge\nthe CHAMPION…$
translation: 小遥：{PLAYER}{KUN}！\p挑战冠军前\n给你几个建议......$

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_MayItsAlreadyOver
source: MAY: Huh?\nWhat, what, what?\p{PLAYER}{KUN}…\nCould it be that…\lIt's already over?$
translation: 小遥：咦？\n什么？\p{PLAYER}{KUN}......\n难道说......\l已经结束了？$

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_BrendanAdvice
source: BRENDAN: {PLAYER}!\pHow would you like some advice before\nyou challenge the CHAMPION?…$
translation: 小悠：{PLAYER}！\p挑战冠军前\n需要建议吗......？$

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_BrendanYouveWon
source: BRENDAN: {PLAYER}…\pAre you trying to tell me…\nYou've beaten the CHAMPION?$
translation: 小悠：{PLAYER}......\p你该不会......\n已经打败冠军了？$

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_BirchArriveRatePokedex
source:
PROF. BIRCH: See?
What did I tell you, {RIVAL}?\pDidn't I tell you that you don't need
to worry about {PLAYER}{KUN}?\p… … … … … … … …
{PLAYER}{KUN}, you've finally done it.\pWhen I heard that you defeated your
own father at the PETALBURG GYM,\lI thought perhaps you had a chance…\pBut to think you've actually become
the CHAMPION!\pAh, yes!\pWhat became of your POKéDEX?
Here, let me see.$
translation:
小田卷博士：看吧？
我说什么来着，{RIVAL}？\p早就告诉你{PLAYER}{KUN}
不用我们担心！\p...... ...... ...... ......
{PLAYER}{KUN}，你终于做到了。\p当我听说你在橙华道馆
打败了你的父亲，\l我就预感你可能有机会......\p但是没想到你现在
真的成为了冠军！\p啊，对了！\p你的图鉴完成得如何了？
来，让我看一下。$

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_BirchCongratulations
source: PROF. BIRCH: Anyways,\ncongratulations!\pNow, go proudly into the final room!$
translation: 小田卷博士：总之恭喜你！\p现在，昂首挺胸地走进\n最后的房间吧！$

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_WallaceComeWithMe
source: WALLACE: {PLAYER}{KUN}…\pNo, let me rephrase that properly.\pThe new CHAMPION!\pCome with me.$
translation: 米可利：{PLAYER}{KUN}......\p不，请容我改口。\p新任冠军！\p跟我来。$

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_WallaceWaitOutside
source: WALLACE: I'm sorry, but…\pFrom here on, only those TRAINERS who\nhave become CHAMPIONS may enter.\pYou'll have to wait outside with\nPROF. BIRCH.$
translation: 米可利：我很抱歉，不过......\p从这里开始，只有成为冠军的\n训练家才能进入。\p请你和小田卷博士一起\n在外面等候吧。$

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_MayCongratulations
source:
MAY: Groan…\p… … … … … … … …
… … … … … … … …\pI'm just joking! That's okay!
That's the rule!\p{PLAYER}{KUN}!
Honestly, congratulations!$

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_BrendanCongratulations
source: BRENDAN: Whaaaat?! … … … … …\n… … … … … … … …\pIt can't be helped if that's the rule.\p{PLAYER}, way to go!\nCongratulations!$

label: EverGrandeCity_DrakesRoom_Text_IntroSpeech
source:
I am the last of the POKéMON LEAGUE
ELITE FOUR, DRAKE the DRAGON master!\pIn their natural state, POKéMON are
wild living things. They are free.\pAt times, they hinder us.
At times, they help us.\pFor us to battle with POKéMON as
partners, do you know what it takes?\pDo you know what is needed?\pIf you don't, then you will never
prevail over me!$
translation:
我是宝可梦联盟四天王的最后一员，
龙属性大师源治！\p在天然的环境中生活的
宝可梦是具有野性的生物。\l它们不受任何约束。\p有时会妨碍到我们，
有时也会帮助我们。\p对于我们这些将宝可梦视为同伴
一同战斗的训练家来说，\l你知道怎样才能赢得胜利吗？\p你知道获得胜利所需的条件吗？\p如果你不知道，
那么你永远也无法战胜我！$

label: EverGrandeCity_DrakesRoom_Text_Defeat
source: Superb, it should be said.$
translation: 干得漂亮，\n就是这样。$

label: EverGrandeCity_DrakesRoom_Text_PostBattleSpeech
source:
You deserve every credit for coming
this far as a TRAINER of POKéMON.\pYou do seem to know what is needed.\pYes, what a TRAINER needs is a
virtuous heart.\pPOKéMON touch the good hearts of
TRAINERS and learn good from wrong.\pThey touch the good hearts of
TRAINERS and grow strong.\pGo! Go onwards!
The CHAMPION is waiting!$
translation:
身为宝可梦训练家，
你的确具备能走到这一步的能力。\p看起来你知道获胜
所需的条件是什么。\p没错。训练家需要的
正是一颗善良的心。\p宝可梦感受到训练家的善心
才会学着分辨对错，\p感受到训练家的善心
才会变得更加强大。\p走吧！前进吧！
冠军在等着你！$

label: EverGrandeCity_GlaciasRoom_Text_IntroSpeech
source:
Welcome, my name is GLACIA
of the ELITE FOUR.\pI've traveled from afar to HOENN
so that I may hone my ice skills.\pBut all I have seen are challenges by
weak TRAINERS and their POKéMON.\pWhat about you?\pIt would please me to no end if I could
go all out against you!$
translation:
欢迎您。我叫波妮，
是四天王的一员。\p我千里迢迢来到丰缘
磨砺我的冰属性技巧。\p但是我在这儿见到的尽是些
弱不禁风的训练家和宝可梦。\p您又如何呢？\p要是能让我使出全力也没问题，
那就太棒了......！$

label: EverGrandeCity_GlaciasRoom_Text_Defeat
source: You and your POKéMON…\nHow hot your spirits burn!\pThe all-consuming heat overwhelms.\pIt's no surprise that my icy skills\nfailed to harm you.$
translation: 您和您的宝可梦......\n灵魂燃烧的那么炽烈！\p这激烈的热量仿佛能吞噬一切。\p难怪我的冰属性技巧\n奈何不了您。$

label: EverGrandeCity_GlaciasRoom_Text_PostBattleSpeech
source: Advance to the next room.\pAnd there, confirm the truly fearsome\nside of the POKéMON LEAGUE.$
translation: 前往下一个房间吧。\p在那里，您会见识到宝可梦联盟\n真正可怕的一面。$

label: EverGrandeCity_HallOfFame_Text_HereWeHonorLeagueChampions
source: WALLACE: This room…\pThis is where we keep records of\nPOKéMON that prevailed through\lharsh battles.\pIt is here that the LEAGUE CHAMPIONS\nare honored.$
translation: 米可利：这个房间......\p这是我们记载那些在严峻的战斗中\n脱颖而出的宝可梦。\p这里也是赞誉联盟冠军的地方。$

label: EverGrandeCity_HallOfFame_Text_LetsRecordYouAndYourPartnersNames
source: WALLACE: Come on, let's record your\nname as a TRAINER who triumphed over\lthe POKéMON LEAGUE, and the names of\lthe partners who battled with you.$
translation: 米可利：来吧，作为称霸宝可梦联盟的\n训练家，让我们记录下你和与你一同\l作战的伙伴们的名字吧。$

label: EverGrandeCity_PhoebesRoom_Text_IntroSpeech
source:
Ahahaha!\pI'm PHOEBE of the ELITE FOUR.
I did my training on MT. PYRE.\pWhile I trained, I gained the ability
to commune with GHOST-type POKéMON.\pYes, the bond I developed with POKéMON
is extremely tight.\pSo, come on, just try and see if you can
even inflict damage on my POKéMON!$
translation:
啊哈哈哈！\p我是四天王中的芙蓉。
我在送神山进行修行。\p在修行过程中，我得到了能与
幽灵宝可梦亲密交流的能力。\p没错，我和宝可梦之间的
牵绊非常地深。\p那么，来试试看你有没有能力
伤到我的宝可梦吧！$

label: EverGrandeCity_PhoebesRoom_Text_Defeat
source: Oh, darn.\nI've gone and lost.$
translation: 哦，天呀。\n我输了。$

label: EverGrandeCity_PhoebesRoom_Text_PostBattleSpeech
source:
There's a definite bond between you
and your POKéMON, too.\pI didn't recognize it, so it's only
natural that I lost.\pYup, I'd like to see how far your bond
will carry you.\pGo ahead, move on to the next room.$
translation:
你和你的宝可梦也有着
不容置疑的牵绊啊。\p我竟然没看出来这一点，
也难怪是我输了。\p嗯，我想看看到你们的牵绊
能带你们到多远。\p前进吧，继续去下一个房间。$

label: EverGrandeCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_LeagueAfterVictoryRoad
source: The POKéMON LEAGUE is only a short\ndistance after the VICTORY ROAD.\pIf you've come this far, what choice\ndo you have but to keep going?$
translation: 穿过冠军之路，\n宝可梦联盟就在眼前。\p已经走了这么远，\n到底是什么让你坚持到现在？$

label: EverGrandeCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_BelieveInYourPokemon
source: The long and harrowing VICTORY ROAD…\pIt's like reliving the path one has\ntraveled in life…\pBelieve in your POKéMON and give it\nyour very best!$
