translation: 漫长而艰苦的冠军之路......\p它就像是你人生中\n所经历的小路......\p相信自己的宝可梦并且\n给予它你的信心！$

label: EverGrandeCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_ScottHappyForYou
source:
SCOTT: {PLAYER}{KUN}, you've clawed your
way up to face the POKéMON LEAGUE!\pI'm happy for you!
You made my cheering worthwhile!\p{PLAYER}{KUN}, if you were to become
the POKéMON LEAGUE CHAMPION…\pI'll get in touch with you then.\pOkay, {PLAYER}{KUN}.
Go for greatness!$
translation:
亚希达：{PLAYER}{KUN}，
你终于来挑战宝可梦联盟了！\p我真为你感到高兴！
我的支持没有白费！\p{PLAYER}{KUN}，
要是你成为了联盟冠军......\p那到时我会联系你的。\p好了，{PLAYER}{KUN}。
去攀登巅峰吧！$

label: EverGrandeCity_PokemonLeague_1F_Text_MustHaveAllGymBadges
source: Beyond this point, only those TRAINERS\nwho have collected all the GYM BADGES\lare permitted to enter.\pTRAINER, let us confirm that you have\nall the GYM BADGES.$
translation: 这前面只允许得到了所有道馆徽章的\n训练家进入。\p训练家，请让我们确认一下\n你是否拥有所有的道馆徽章。$

label: EverGrandeCity_PokemonLeague_1F_Text_HaventObtainedAllBadges
source: You haven't obtained all the BADGES.\pIf you're bound for the POKéMON\nLEAGUE, you must return with them.$
translation: 你还没有获得所有的徽章。\p如果你的目标是宝可梦联盟，\n那你必须全部集齐后再回来。$

label: EverGrandeCity_PokemonLeague_1F_Text_GoForth
source: TRAINER! Believe in yourself and your\nPOKéMON, and go forth!$
translation: 训练家！相信自己和你的宝可梦，\n前进吧！$

label: EverGrandeCity_SidneysRoom_Text_IntroSpeech
source:
Welcome, challenger!
I'm SIDNEY of the ELITE FOUR.\pI like that look you're giving me.
I guess you'll give me a good match.\lThat's good! Looking real good!\pAll right! You and me, let's enjoy
a battle that can only be staged\lhere in the POKéMON LEAGUE!$
translation:
欢迎你，挑战者！
我是四天王中的花月。\p我喜欢你的神情。
我猜这会是一场精彩的战斗吧。\l很好！看起来很棒！\p好！让我们还有你们，来一起好好享受
只有在宝可梦联盟才能体验的对战吧！$

label: EverGrandeCity_SidneysRoom_Text_Defeat
source: Well, how do you like that? I lost!\nEh, it was fun, so it doesn't matter.$
translation: 嗯，你觉得如何？我输了！\n嗯，不过这很有趣，所以也无所谓。$

label: EverGrandeCity_SidneysRoom_Text_PostBattleSpeech
source: Well, listen to what this loser has\nto say.\pYou've got what it takes to go far.\nNow, go on to the next room and enjoy\lyour next battle!$
translation: 好，\n听听我这个失败者的话。\p你已经具备了前进所需的一切。\n现在，继续去下一个房间\l享受你的下一场战斗吧！$

label: FallarborTown_Text_ShadyCharactersCozmosHome
source: Something's happening,\nand I don't like it!\pI've seen shady characters wandering\nin and out of PROF. COZMO's home…$
translation: 发生了些\n很讨厌的事！\p我总是看到鬼鬼祟祟的家伙\n在索蓝斯博士家进进出出......$

label: FallarborTown_Text_RegionKnownForMeteors
source: This region's been known for meteors\nsince the olden days.\pThey say METEOR FALLS was gouged out\nby a falling meteorite long ago.$
translation: 自古这片地区\n就以陨石而闻名，\p据说流星瀑布就是很久以前\n一颗陨石掉下来砸成的。$

label: FallarborTown_Text_MyPreciousAzurill
source: See! Take a look!\nThis is my precious AZURILL!\pIt's slick and smooth and plushy, too!$
translation: 来啊！来看看！\n这是我珍贵的露力丽！\p滑滑软软的，多漂亮！$

label: FallarborTown_Text_Azurill
source: AZURILL: Rooreelooo.$
translation: 露力丽：露力露。$

label: FallarborTown_Text_HaveYouChallengedFlannery
source:
Have you already challenged FLANNERY,
the LEADER of LAVARIDGE GYM?\pThe girl's grandfather was famous.
He was one of the ELITE FOUR in the\lPOKéMON LEAGUE at one point.\pIt wouldn't surprise me to see FLANNERY
become a great TRAINER in her own\lright.$
translation:
你挑战过釜炎镇道馆的馆主
亚莎了吗？\p那女孩的爷爷非常出名，
他曾是宝可梦联盟的\l四天王之一，\p如今亚莎也成长为一个
出色的训练家\l并不让我感到奇怪。$

label: FallarborTown_Text_BattleTentSign
source: BATTLE TENT FALLARBOR SITE\n“May the Greatest Teams Gather!”$
translation: 对战帐篷秋叶镇分址\n"最强战队，在此集结！"$

label: FallarborTown_Text_TownSign
source: FALLARBOR TOWN\n“A farm community with small gardens.”$
translation: 这里是秋叶镇。\n"有着小型田野的农村。"$

label: FallarborTown_Text_MoveTutorSign
source: MOVE TUTOR'S HOUSE\n“New moves taught to POKéMON.”$
translation: 招式爱好者的家\n"教会宝可梦新的招式。"$

label: FallarborTown_ContestHall_Text_DoAllRightInPreliminary
source: We do all right in the preliminary round,\nbut we can never win the appeals…\pMaybe it means I have to watch what\nother contestants are doing…$
translation: 我们在预选赛中确实做得很好，\n但是我们丝毫没有赢得吸引力......\p也许这意味着我不得不去观看\n其他对手是如何做的......$

label: FallarborTown_ContestHall_Text_MonAllTheseRibbons
source: See!\nMy POKéMON won all these RIBBONS!\pHave your POKéMON earned any RIBBONS?\nYou can check them on your POKéNAV.$
translation: 看吧！\n我的宝可梦赢得了所有的奖章！\p你的宝可梦赢到过奖章吗？\n你可以在你的宝可导航中查看。$

label: FallarborTown_ContestHall_Text_CantWinEverywhere
source: I can't beat GYM LEADERS…\pI can't win any CONTESTS…\pI've been here, there, and everywhere,\nand it's all for naught…$
translation: 我赢不了道馆馆主......\p我赢不了任何华丽大赛......\p我去过这里，那里和所有地方，\n但这都是徒劳的......$

label: FallarborTown_ContestHall_Text_SuperRankStage
source: POKéMON CONTESTS\nSUPER RANK STAGE!$
translation: 宝可梦华丽大赛\n超级会场！$

label: FallarborTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_MakeThinkImJustKid
source: Fufufufufu.\pI'm going to make everyone think\nI'm just a kid and let them play down.\pThen, I'll shock them and grab\nthe title!$
translation: 哼哼哼哼哼。\p我要让大家以为我\n只是个孩子而轻视我，\p然后让他们大吃一惊，\n拔得头筹！$

label: FallarborTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_FallarborTentMyFavorite
source:
You know how BATTLE TENTS offer
different events in different towns?\pMy favorite is definitely the BATTLE
TENT in FALLARBOR TOWN.\pI think it's fantastic how TRAINERS
try to win with all their faith in\ltheir POKéMON.$
translation:
你知道吗，不同城镇的对战帐篷
所举行的比赛也不同。\p我最喜欢的就是秋叶镇的
对战帐篷。\p训练家凭借着自己对宝可梦的信任，
努力赢得比赛，太令人激动了！$

label: FallarborTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_CameToCampOut
source:
I heard something about some tent,
so I came to camp out.\pI didn't know that tents these days
are so luxurious!\pSince I'm here, I may as well try
my hand at battling!$
translation:
我听说过一些关于帐篷的事，
所以才出来宿营，\p但我没想到现在的帐篷
会这么豪华！\p既然都来了，就进去试试
放手一搏吧！$

label: FallarborTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ScottLookingForSomeone
source:
SCOTT: Hi, {PLAYER}{KUN}!
So you came out to this BATTLE TENT!\pThe people in these parts tend to be
easygoing and laid-back.\pBut, you see, what I'm looking for are
people with…\pHow should I say this?\pSomeone bursting with the desire
and the drive to win.\pIf there were a TRAINER like that,
I'd immediately…\pWhoops! Never mind!
Keep working at it!$
translation:
亚希达：嗨，{PLAYER}{KUN}！
你也来这里的对战帐篷了！\p这里的人看上去大多都
比较悠然自得，\p但你知道，
我在寻找的是有......\p怎么说呢......\p胸怀强烈的求胜
渴望与决心的人。\p如果有那样的训练家，
我马上就......\p啊！没什么！
继续加油吧！$

label: FallarborTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ScottMakeChallenge
source: SCOTT: Instead of wasting your\ntime with the likes of me, why not\lmake a challenge?$
translation: 亚希达：与其同我闲聊浪费时间，\n何不试着去挑战一下呢？$

label: FallarborTown_CozmosHouse_Text_MeteoriteWillNeverBeMineNow
source: PROF. COZMO: Oh…\nI never should have let myself be\lconned into telling TEAM MAGMA where\lyou can find METEORITES…\pThat METEORITE from METEOR FALLS…\nIt's never going to be mine now…$
translation: 索蓝斯博士：唉......\n真后悔被熔岩队\l骗着说出了陨石的下落......\p流星瀑布的陨石......\n再也不会属于我了......$

label: FallarborTown_CozmosHouse_Text_IsThatMeteoriteMayIHaveIt
source:
Oh!
Hah?\pThat item…\pCould it be?\pIs it the METEORITE that TEAM MAGMA
took from METEOR FALLS?\pPlease, may I have it?\pI'm not asking for it for free.
How about in exchange for this TM?$
translation:
啊！
咦？\p那个东西......\p难道是？\p那是熔岩队从流星瀑布
抢走的陨石吗？\p拜托给我好吗？\p我不会白要的，
用这个招式学习器跟你换好吗？$

label: FallarborTown_CozmosHouse_Text_PleaseUseThisTM
source: PROF. COZMO: This TM, it represents\nmy feeling of gratitude.\lPlease use it!$
translation: 索蓝斯博士：这个招式学习器\n表示我的谢意。\l请好好使用吧！$

label: FallarborTown_CozmosHouse_Text_ReallyGoingToHelpMyResearch
source: PROF. COZMO: Oh, I can't believe it.\nThis is really, really great!\pThis is really going to help my research!$
translation: 索蓝斯博士：啊，简直不敢相信，\n真是太棒了！\p这对我的研究会有巨大帮助的！$

label: FallarborTown_CozmosHouse_Text_CrushedWithDisappointment
source: PROF. COZMO: Oh, but…\nI'm crushed with disappointment…$
translation: 索蓝斯博士：哎，可是......\n太让人绝望了......$

label: FallarborTown_CozmosHouse_Text_MayIHaveMeteorite
source: PROF. COZMO: Please, may I have that\nMETEORITE?\pI'm not asking for it for free.\nHow about in exchange for this TM?$
translation: 索蓝斯博士：拜托了！\n把那个陨石给我好吗？\p我不会白要的，\n用这个招式学习器跟你换好吗？$

label: FallarborTown_CozmosHouse_Text_CozmoWentToMeteorFalls
source: PROF. COZMO went off to METEOR FALLS\non ROUTE 114 with some people from\lTEAM MAGMA.$
translation: 索蓝斯博士和一些熔岩队的人\n去了114号道路上的\l流星瀑布。$

label: FallarborTown_CozmosHouse_Text_FeelSorryForCozmo
source: Poor PROF. COZMO…\nHe's so depressed… I feel sorry for him.$
translation: 可怜的索蓝斯博士......\n他一回来就很沮丧......真为他难过。$

label: FallarborTown_CozmosHouse_Text_CozmoIsSoHappy
source: Look at PROF. COZMO…\nHe's so happy! I think it's cute.$
translation: 看看索蓝斯博士......\n他完全高兴起来了！那样子真可爱。$

label: FallarborTown_Mart_Text_DecidingSkittyEvolve
source:
I'm having a hard time deciding if I
should make my SKITTY evolve or not.\pI only have to use this MOON STONE,
but it's so hard to decide…\pIf I make it evolve, it will become
much stronger.\pBut it will look so different, too.$
translation:
我一直在犹豫该不该
让我的向尾喵进化。\p只要使用这个月之石就可以了，
但我还没下定决心......\p它进化后当然会
变得更强，\p但看上去会完全不同了。$

label: FallarborTown_Mart_Text_Skitty
source: SKITTY: Miyao?$
translation: 向尾喵：喵--夭？$

label: FallarborTown_Mart_Text_SellNuggetIFound
source: This NUGGET I found here…\nI suppose I'll have to sell it, seeing\las how it has no other use.$
translation: 我在这儿找到的金珠......\n好像没什么用，\l我想该卖掉它。$

label: FallarborTown_MoveRelearnersHouse_Text_ImTheMoveTutor
source:
I'm the MOVE TUTOR.\pI know all the moves that POKéMON
learn--every one of them--and I can\lteach POKéMON those moves.\pI can teach a move to a POKéMON
of yours if you'd like.\pI'll do it for a HEART SCALE.
I'm collecting those now.$
translation:
大家都叫我
宝可梦招式爱好者！\p宝可梦成长过程中能学会的
所有招式我都一清二楚。\p我知道的那些招式
甚至可以教给宝可梦！\p如果你给我心之鳞片，
我就把知道的招式教给你的宝可梦！$

label: FallarborTown_MoveRelearnersHouse_Text_ThatsAHeartScaleWantMeToTeachMove
source: Oh! That's it! That's an honest to\ngoodness HEART SCALE!\pLet me guess, you want me to teach\na move?$
translation: 哇哦！\n这是心之鳞片！\p要把招式教给你的宝可梦吗？$

label: FallarborTown_MoveRelearnersHouse_Text_TutorWhichMon
source: Which POKéMON needs tutoring?$
translation: 要选择哪只宝可梦？$

label: FallarborTown_MoveRelearnersHouse_Text_TeachWhichMove
source: Which move should I teach?$
translation: 要学习哪个招式？$

label: FallarborTown_MoveRelearnersHouse_Text_DontHaveMoveToTeachPokemon
source: Sorry…\pIt doesn't appear as if I have any move\nI can teach that POKéMON.$
translation: 抱歉......\p看来我没有招式能\n教给这只宝可梦。$

label: FallarborTown_MoveRelearnersHouse_Text_HandedOverHeartScale
source: {PLAYER} handed over one HEART SCALE\nin exchange.$
translation: {PLAYER}将1个心之鳞片\n作为谢礼送给了对方！$

label: FallarborTown_MoveRelearnersHouse_Text_ComeBackWithHeartScale
source: If your POKéMON need to learn a move,\ncome back with a HEART SCALE.$
translation: 如果有想让宝可梦学习的招式，\n就把心之鳞片带过来吧！$

label: FallarborTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_LanetteGreeting
source:
Oh, hello.
You are?\pOkay, your name's {PLAYER}{KUN}.
I can see that you're a TRAINER.\pSo that means you use the POKéMON
Storage System I developed.\pHow I arrived at that conclusion is
a simple deductive process.\pYou spoke to me because you wanted
to access something on this PC.\pOh, I'm sorry. I'm LANETTE.\pHonestly, I'm glad to meet you--it's
great you're using the Storage System.\pIf you could, please visit me at home.
My house is on ROUTE 114.$
translation:
啊，你好，
请问你是？\p好的，{PLAYER}{KUN}，
看来你是个训练家，\p那么你一定在使用我开发的
宝可梦寄放系统。\p只要简单推理一下
就能猜出来了，\p你想使用这台电脑，
所以才会跟我谈话。\p呀，抱歉，我叫真由美。\p很高兴见到你--也很高兴
看到你在使用寄放系统。\p如果可以的话，欢迎你来我家做客。
我家就在114号道路上。$

label: FallarborTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_FossilManiacEdgeOfTown
source: I wonder what POKéMON looked like\nlong, long ago?\pMaybe the FOSSIL MANIAC at the edge\nof town will know.$
translation: 我想知道很久很久以前\n宝可梦是什么样子的？\p也许住在镇子边上的\n化石迷知道答案。$

label: FallarborTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_PlantHardyTrees
source: In the fields of FALLARBOR, we plant\nseedlings of hardy trees that thrive\leven in volcanic ash.$
translation: 我们在秋叶镇的土地里\n种下了在火山灰中也能长得\l欣欣向荣的大树的幼苗。$

label: FarawayIsland_Interior_Text_TheFeelingOfBeingWatchedFaded
source: The feeling of being watched faded…$
translation: 被监视着的感觉消失了......$

label: FiveIsland_Text_IslandSign
source: FIVE ISLAND\nChrono Island: Where Time Goes$
translation: 五之岛\n时间之岛：时间起源之处$

label: FiveIsland_Text_WeirdBuildingInMeadow
source: Oh, this stinks. I wanted to play in\nthe MEADOW.\pBut they put up a weird building\non it, so I can't play there.$
translation: 啊，真让人不爽。\n我想在空地里玩。\p但他们在那里造了个奇怪的建筑，\n让我没法去玩了。$

label: FiveIsland_Text_BeenGettingBusierAroundHere
source: It's been getting busier around\nthese parts lately.\pI haven't been catching many good\nfish lately, either.$
translation: 最近这里变得\n越来越繁忙了。\p我很久都没钓到好点的鱼了。$

label: FiveIsland_House1_Text_HusbandWentOffFishing
source:
Don't worry about buying anything
for dinner tonight!\p…That's what my husband said when
he went off fishing today.\pI'm not sure if I can count on him
to live up to that promise.$
translation: 今天我丈夫出去钓鱼之前和我说\n关于今天的晚饭食材，\p大可不必操心！\p其实我也不清楚\n他说的话是否可靠......$

label: FiveIsland_House2_Text_MeadowBelongedToFamily
source:
That MEADOW has belonged to our
family for generations.\pI should have had a giant mansion
built on it.\pIt would be preferable to having
those thugs run wild on it!$
translation:
那片空地好多年以前
就属于我们家了。\p我本想在那上面
建一个豪华别墅。\p但我现在担心的是，
那些来撒野的混混！$

label: FiveIsland_LostCave_Room10_Text_SelphyIntro
source: W-what do you intend to do with\nme?$
translation: 你，你打算对我做什么？$

label: FiveIsland_LostCave_Room10_Text_SelphyDefeat
source: Oh… I was afraid that you meant to\nharm me.$
translation: 噢......我好害怕，\n还以为你要来侵犯我。$

label: FiveIsland_LostCave_Room10_Text_MayIAskYouToTakeMeHome
source:
I am so glad that you happened
here.\pI grew rather bored of walking,
and I am feeling fatigued.\pMay I ask you to take me home
from here?$
translation: 我真高兴你凑巧也来到了这儿。\p我已经相当厌倦在这里徘徊了，\n我感到很疲惫。\p你能把我带回家吗？$

label: FiveIsland_LostCave_Room1_Text_LawsonIntro
source: Aiyeeeeeh!\pI thought this was an ancient ruin.\nBut it's teeming with ghosts!$
translation: 啊\p我以为这是一个古老的遗迹。\n但是这里到处都是幽灵！$

label: FiveIsland_LostCave_Room1_Text_LawsonDefeat
source: Aiyeeeeeh!\nMercy!$
translation: 啊啊啊啊啊啊啊！\n饶命啊！$

label: FiveIsland_LostCave_Room1_Text_LawsonPostBattle
source: I'm trying to get out of here, but\nI always end up at the same spot.\pMaybe the number of boulders is\na hint…$
translation: 我试着从这里走出去，\n但是总是在原地打转。\p也许\n这些卵石的数量是一个提示......$

label: FiveIsland_LostCave_Room4_Text_LauraIntro
source: I think there is a mysterious power\nat work in this cave.$
translation: 我认为在这个洞穴里\n充斥着一股神秘的力量。$

label: FiveIsland_LostCave_Room4_Text_LauraDefeat
source: If you don't go into the right\ntunnel, you won't get ahead.$
translation: 如果你走进错误的通道，\n你将无法前进。$

label: FiveIsland_LostCave_Room4_Text_LauraPostBattle
source: Earlier, a lady went into the caves\nahead.$
translation: 在早些时候，\n一位女士进入过这个洞穴。$

label: FiveIsland_Meadow_Text_EnteredPasswordAnotherNeeded
source: {PLAYER} entered a password.\p“GOLDEEN need log.”\p… …  … …  … …\pAnother password is needed to\nopen the door…$
translation: {PLAYER}输入了一段密码。\p"多多少少 少少多多"\p..............................\p开门还需要\n另一段密码......$

label: FiveIsland_Meadow_Text_EnteredPasswordDoorOpened
source: {PLAYER} entered two passwords.\p“GOLDEEN need log.”\n“Yes, nah, CHANSEY.”\p… …  … …  … …\pThe WAREHOUSE's door opened!$
translation: {PLAYER}输入了两段密码。\p"多多少少 少少多多"\n"大大小小 小小大大"\p...... ...... ......\p仓库的门打开了！$

label: FiveIsland_Meadow_Text_WarehouseDoorAlreadyOpen
source: The WAREHOUSE's door is already\nopen.$
translation: 仓库的门已经打开了。$

label: FiveIsland_Meadow_Text_Rocket1Intro
source: This area's strictly off-limits!\nOut, out!$
translation: 这个地方禁止入内！\n出去，出去！$

label: FiveIsland_Meadow_Text_Rocket1Defeat
source: Is this for real?$
translation: 这是真的吗？$

label: FiveIsland_Meadow_Text_Rocket1PostBattle
source: You don't have any business here!\nGo home!$
translation: 这儿什么都没有！\n回家吧！$

label: FiveIsland_Meadow_Text_Rocket2Intro
source: There's nothing past here except\nour WAREHOUSE.\pSo what brings you here?$
translation: 除了我们仓库的人\n再没有任何人来过这儿。\p谁把你带来的？$

label: FiveIsland_Meadow_Text_Rocket2Defeat
source: That wasn't supposed to happen…$
translation: 不希望发生的事出现了......$

label: FiveIsland_Meadow_Text_Rocket2PostBattle
source: You're wanting to know what's inside\nthis WAREHOUSE?\pIt's better you didn't know.\nFor your own sake, I mean.$
translation: 你很想知道这仓库\n里面是什么？\p你最好别知道。\n这是为了你自己好。$

label: FiveIsland_Meadow_Text_Rocket3Intro
source: You'd be wasting time even if you\nwere to get by me.$
translation: 就算你能通过我这一关，\n你还是在浪费你的时间。$

label: FiveIsland_Meadow_Text_Rocket3Defeat
source: Oh, that makes me furious!$
translation: 噢，我愤怒了！$

label: FiveIsland_Meadow_Text_Rocket3PostBattle
source: You won't be able to get in without\nthe passwords anyway.$
translation: 不管怎样，\n没有密码你就不能进去。$

label: FiveIsland_MemorialPillar_Text_MiloIntro
source: I'm the eldest of the BIRD\nBROTHERS.\pThe best thing about birds…\nIt has to be the beak.$
translation: 我是驯鸟师兄弟中年纪最大的。\p鸟系宝可梦最吸引人的地方......\n当然是它们的喙。$

label: FiveIsland_MemorialPillar_Text_MiloDefeat
source: Oh, so sharp!$
translation: 噢，太突然了！$

label: FiveIsland_MemorialPillar_Text_MiloPostBattle
source: You can fly to FOUR ISLAND from\nhere.$
translation: 从这儿你可以飞去四之岛。$

label: FiveIsland_MemorialPillar_Text_ChazIntro
source: I'm the middle kid of the BIRD\nBROTHERS.\pThe best thing about birds…\nIt has to be the wings.$
translation: 我是驯鸟师兄弟中的老二。\p鸟系宝可梦吸引人的地方......\n当然是它们的翅膀。$

label: FiveIsland_MemorialPillar_Text_ChazDefeat
source: Flap, flap!$
translation: 啪，砰！$

label: FiveIsland_MemorialPillar_Text_ChazPostBattle
source: There was a really somber guy\nover that way.$
translation: 那条路上有一个阴沉的家伙。$

label: FiveIsland_MemorialPillar_Text_HaroldIntro
source: I'm the youngest of the BIRD\nBROTHERS.\pThe best thing about birds…\nIt has to be the down.$
translation: 我是驯鸟师兄弟中年龄最小的。\p鸟系宝可梦最吸引人的地方......\n当然是它们的羽毛。$

label: FiveIsland_MemorialPillar_Text_HaroldDefeat
source: Down is so comfy…\nIt makes me drowsy…$
translation: 羽毛太舒服了......\n它让我想美美地睡过去......$

label: FiveIsland_MemorialPillar_Text_HaroldPostBattle
source: It fills me with happiness when\nbird POKéMON beg playfully…$
translation: 当鸟系宝可梦缠着我跟它们\n玩耍时，我心中就充满了快乐......$

label: FiveIsland_MemorialPillar_Text_ScrubScrub
source: Scrub, scrub…$

label: FiveIsland_MemorialPillar_Text_YourMonsLookHealthy
source: Hello…\nYour POKéMON look healthy…$
translation: 你好......\n你的宝可梦看起来很健康......$

label: FiveIsland_MemorialPillar_Text_ThisIsWhereIBuriedMyOnix
source: This is where I buried my ONIX…\nIt was named TECTONIX…$
translation: 这是埋葬我的大岩蛇的地方......\n它叫做阿岩......$

label: FiveIsland_MemorialPillar_Text_HereLiesTectonixLemonadeOffering
source: “Here lies TECTONIX” is engraved\non a boulder.\pThere is a LEMONADE placed as an\noffering in front of the grave.$
translation: 碑上刻着：\n"阿岩长眠于此"。\p坟墓的前面放着\n一罐果汁牛奶作为祭品。$

label: FiveIsland_MemorialPillar_Text_LeaveAnotherLemonadeOffering
source: Would you like to leave another\nLEMONADE as an offering?$
translation: 你也想留下一罐果汁牛奶\n作为祭品吗？$

label: FiveIsland_MemorialPillar_Text_PlacedCanOfLemonade
source: {PLAYER} placed a can of LEMONADE\nin front of the grave.$
translation: {PLAYER}在坟墓前面\n放了一罐果汁牛奶。$

label: FiveIsland_MemorialPillar_Text_ThankYouPleaseTakeThis
source:
Th-thank you…\pThat was my TECTONIX's favorite
drink…\pI don't even know you, but your
act of kindness…\pIt's uplifted me a little.\pCan you please take this as my
thanks?$
translation: 谢谢你......\p那是我的阿岩最爱喝的饮料......\p我不知道你是谁，但是\n你的仁慈感动了我......\p我现在振作一些了。\p作为我的谢意，\n你能收下这个吗？$

label: FiveIsland_MemorialPillar_Text_BeGoodToYourMonsToo
source: Please be good to your POKéMON,\ntoo.$
translation: 请你也好好对待你自己的宝可梦。$

label: FiveIsland_MemorialPillar_Text_DontHaveRoomForIt
source: If you don't have room for it,\nI'll hold it for you till next time.$
translation: 如果你没有空间装这个了，\n我会下次给你的。$

label: FiveIsland_MemorialPillar_Text_StillHaveThingAsMyThanks
source: Oh, it's you from that time…\pI still have that thing I wanted\nyou to have as my thanks.$
translation: 噢，你是上次的那个孩子......\p我仍然拿着想给你\n作为谢礼的礼物。$

label: FiveIsland_MemorialPillar_Text_ScrubScrubTectonix
source: Scrub, scrub…\p… … …\nTECTONIX…$

label: FiveIsland_MemorialPillar_Text_HereLiesTectonix
source: Boulders and rocks are neatly piled\nup as a cairn.\p“Here lies TECTONIX” is engraved\non a boulder.$
translation: 这个碑是一些很干净的石块做成的。\p碑上刻着：\n"阿岩长眠于此"。$

label: FiveIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_OnMyWayToPrepareMeal
source: I'm on my way to prepare a meal\nfor a certain high-society person.$
translation: 我正在为上流人士\n准备饭菜。$

label: FiveIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_YoureOnQuestToCatchEveryMon
source: You're on a quest to catch every\nsingle kind of POKéMON?\p…How incredible. Please tell me if\nyou catch a strong one!$
translation: 你正在尝试\n收服每种宝可梦吗？\p......真不可思议！如果你收服到强大的\n宝可梦，务必告诉我哦！$

label: FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_DaisyIntro
source: With these hands, I will create\nmy victory!$
translation: 用这双手，\n我要创造我的胜利！$

label: FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_DaisyDefeat
source: The shame of this…\nI'm red-faced…$
translation: 真是羞愧死了......\n我脸红了......$

label: FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_DaisyPostBattle
source: Uh-oh, my paint tubes have\nscattered everywhere!$
translation: 噢，我的涂料管\n散乱得到处都是！$

label: FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_CelinaIntro
source: Excuse me!\nI'm trying to paint.\lPlease keep out of my sight!$
translation: 不好意思！\n我正忙着画画。\l请你别挡我的视线！$

label: FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_CelinaDefeat
source: This loss…\nI feel like I'm whiting out…$
translation: 输了......\n我觉得我出局了......$

label: FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_CelinaPostBattle
source: GILLIAN?\nPlease tilt your head slightly…\lThere! That's the look I want!$
translation: 雪野？\n请稍微倾斜一下你的头部......\l好了！这就是我想要的姿势！$

label: FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_RaynaIntro
source: Hmm…\nThe angle, it is not quite there…$
translation: 唔......\n这鱼钓的，这儿真不安静......$

label: FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_RaynaDefeat
source: Oh…\nMy feelings, they are blue…$
translation: 呃......\n我的感觉，太烦闷了......$

label: FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_RaynaPostBattle
source: The sky and the sea…\nThey are so fickle.\pTheir changing expressions make\nthem difficult to capture.$
translation: 天空和海洋......\n它们都是变幻无常的。\p它们的这种特性\n使得人们很难征服它们。$

label: FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_JackiIntro
source: I am visiting my friend's retreat,\nif you must know.$
translation: 如果你一定要知道，\n我正打算拜访我朋友隐居的地方。$

label: FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_JackiDefeat
source: Oh, my, so strong.$
translation: 噢，太强大了。$

label: FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_JackiPostBattle
source: I find it pleasurable to leisurely\nbattle in the gentle sea breeze.$
translation: 在海边和煦的微风之中，\n来一场从容的战斗真是令人惬意。$

label: FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_GillianIntro
source: I'm thinking of having a pool\nmade specially for POKéMON.$
translation: 我正在想着\n专门为宝可梦建一个游泳池。$

label: FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_GillianDefeat
source: Oh, my goodness gracious!$
translation: 噢，我的天啊！$

label: FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_GillianPostBattle
source: A pool would be nice, but I must\nsay, a sun-room may be sublime.$
translation: 一个游泳池是很好，但是我要说，\n一个日光浴室也许更令人赞叹。$

label: FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_DestinIntro
source: I'm a good runner.\nI'm really fast!$
translation: 我很擅长跑步。\n我速度可是很快的！$

label: FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_DestinDefeat
source: Oops!\nI rushed things!$
translation: 哎哟！\n我撞到东西了！$

label: FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_DestinPostBattle
source: When I run with the wind, it feels\nlike I could fly!$
translation: 当我迎着风奔跑时，\n我感觉我能飞起来！$

label: FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_TobyIntro
source: I say, this marine life here at\nthis resort agrees with me.$
translation: 我发现这个度假胜地之中\n这些海上生物跟我很合拍。$

label: FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_TobyDefeat
source: That's a shocker!\nYou must be joking.$
translation: 这太震惊了！\n你一定在开玩笑。$

label: FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_TobyPostBattle
source: Getting so serious over this…\nHow nonsensical.$
translation: 变得这么严重......\n多么荒谬啊。$

label: FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_SelphyThanksYouMayGoNow
source: SELPHY: Thank you.\pYou may go now.$
translation: 秋穗：谢谢你。\p你可以走了。$

label: FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_SelphysHouse
source: SELPHY'S HOUSE$
translation: 秋穗的家$

label: FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_House_Text_PleaseHearMyWish
source: SELPHY: Oh?\nDo I know you from somewhere?\pOh, but that doesn't matter.\pI am exquisitely bored.\nPlease, hear my wish.$
translation: 秋穗：哦？\n我在什么地方见过你吗？\p呃，算了，那无所谓。\p我实在是太无聊了，\n所以，请听听我的愿望吧！$

label: FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_House_Text_WishToSeeMonPlease
source: I wish to see a POKéMON.\nA darling {STR_VAR_1}.\pI want to see one right away.\nPlease, make my wish come true.$
translation: 我想见一只宝可梦。\n一只可爱的{STR_VAR_1}。\p我迫不及待，想马上见到！\n求你了，实现我的愿望吧！$

label: FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_House_Text_OhImTiredOfWaiting
source: SELPHY: Oh, I'm tired of this.\nI'm tired of waiting for you.\pI'll forgive you this time, but\nplease don't fail me next time.$
translation: 秋穗：哦，我已经不耐烦了！\n你总是让我失望了！\p好吧，这次我就暂且原谅你，\n但下次别给我失败！$

label: FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_House_Text_MonYouCaughtForMeThankYou
source:
SELPHY: Oh, hello, there.\pOh, my gracious. That must be the
{STR_VAR_1} you caught for me.\pGiggle…
I see a resemblance to you.\pThank you so kindly.\p… …  … …  … …
Is something the matter?\pYou may leave.\p… …  … …  … …
Oh, fine. I understand now.\pSEBASTIAN!
I need you here this instant!$
translation:
秋穗：哦！\p哦，太好了！那一定是你
为我收服的{STR_VAR_1}。\p咯咯......
看起来和你蛮像的。\p真的很感谢你！\p...... ...... ......
还有什么事吗？\p你可以走了。\p...... ...... ......
呃，好吧。我知道了！\p庆介
快给我出来！$

label: FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_House_Text_ButlerYesMyLady
source: Butler: Yes, my lady.$
translation: 管家：我在，大小姐。$

label: FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_House_Text_SelphyGiveTokenOfAppreciation
source: SELPHY: See to it that this person\nis given a token of appreciation.$
translation: 秋穗：你就负责\n给那个人点什么奖励吧！$

label: FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_House_Text_ButlerIShallDoAsYouBid
source: Butler: I shall do as you bid,\nmy lady.$
translation: 管家：好的，我会按照您的吩咐。\n大小姐。$

label: FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_House_Text_ButlerPleaseAcceptThisAsHerThanks
source: Butler: I sincerely thank you for\npleasing Lady SELPHY.\pPlease accept this as her thanks…$
translation: 管家：真的谢谢你\n让大小姐这么开心。\p请接受你应得的奖励吧......$

label: FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_House_Text_ButlerBagAppearsToBeFull
source: Butler: Your BAG appears to be\nunfortunately full.$
translation: 管家：真不幸，\n你的背包好像满了......$

label: FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_House_Text_OhHowDisappointing
source: Oh…\nHow disappointing.$
translation: 喔......\n太遗憾了！$

label: FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_House_Text_SelphyWishYouBestOfLuck
source: SELPHY: I wish you the best of\nluck.$
translation: 秋穗：祝你好运。$

label: FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_House_Text_LadySelphySmileHasBrillianceOfSun
source: Butler: The smile of Lady SELPHY\nhas the brilliance of the sun.\pPlease, I beg you to bring joy\nto Lady SELPHY.$
translation: 管家：秋穗小姐的微笑\n就像温暖的阳光。\p拜托了！\n请带给秋穗小姐快乐！$

label: FiveIsland_RocketWarehouse_Text_ManyMonsLockedInPen
source: There are many POKéMON locked\naway in the pen…$
translation: 有很多宝可梦被锁在围栏里......$

label: FiveIsland_RocketWarehouse_Text_PenUnlockedMonsFled
source: The pen door is unlocked.\nThe POKéMON appear to have fled.$
translation: 因为围栏的大门没上锁。\n宝可梦逃跑了。$

label: FiveIsland_RocketWarehouse_Text_Grunt2Intro
source: Did you come here knowing it's\nTEAM ROCKET's WAREHOUSE?$
translation: 你敢来这里是因为知道\n这里是火箭队的仓库吗？$

label: FiveIsland_RocketWarehouse_Text_Grunt2Defeat
source: What do you think you're doing?!$
translation: 你清楚自己在做什么吗？！$

label: FiveIsland_RocketWarehouse_Text_Grunt2PostBattle
source: TEAM ROCKET broke up?\nWhat planet are you from?$
translation: 你说火箭队解散了？\n你来自哪个星球？$

label: FiveIsland_RocketWarehouse_Text_Grunt1Intro
source: Oh, now your POKéMON look strong.\nYou're willing to sell them?\pOh?\nYou wanted to battle?$
translation: 哦，你的宝可梦现在看起来很强。\n愿意卖掉它们吗？\p哦？\n想要打一场？$

label: FiveIsland_RocketWarehouse_Text_Grunt1Defeat
source: Oh, but…\nToo much!$
translation: 哦，但是......\n太多了！$

label: FiveIsland_RocketWarehouse_Text_Grunt1PostBattle
source: We can give you a great price.\nSell us your POKéMON!$
translation: 我们会给你开一个好价钱。\n把宝可梦卖给我们吧！$

label: FiveIsland_RocketWarehouse_Text_Grunt3Intro
source: I got word about you from the\nothers.\pBut there's no way a kid like you'd\nknow our BOSS GIOVANNI!$
translation: 我从别人那听说过关于你的事情。\p但是像你这样的孩子不可能\n了解我们的坂木老大！$

label: FiveIsland_RocketWarehouse_Text_Grunt3Defeat
source: Don't…you…dare…laugh…$

label: FiveIsland_RocketWarehouse_Text_Grunt3PostBattle
source: Don't mess in the doings of adults,\nyou jumped-up pip-squeak!$
translation: 不要掺和到大人的事情中来，\n你这只上窜下跳的小老鼠！$

label: FiveIsland_RocketWarehouse_Text_Admin1Intro
source: I don't know or care if what I'm\ndoing is right or wrong…\pI just put my faith in GIOVANNI\nand do as I am told.$
translation: 我不知道我做的是对还是错......\p我只是信任坂木\n并且按照命令行事。$

label: FiveIsland_RocketWarehouse_Text_Admin1Defeat
source: I…\nI'm shattered…$

label: FiveIsland_RocketWarehouse_Text_Admin1PostBattle
source: You're doing things according to\nyour beliefs and morals.\pI understand now…$
translation: 你在按照你的信仰和道德行事。\p我现在明白了......$

label: FiveIsland_RocketWarehouse_Text_MadeItSoYouCanComeBackThrough
source:
I've made it so you can come back
in through there.\pWhy don't you go get rested and
refreshed for what lies ahead?\pThe ADMIN after me outranks me
thoroughly as a TRAINER.\pYou'd better steel yourself for one
harsh challenge.$
translation:
我做到了，因此你能从那回来。\p你休息恢复下之后
准备继续前进吧。\p干部们成为训练家要比我晚，
但现在却完全超越了我。\p你最好好好锻炼自己
来迎接严厉的挑战。$

label: FiveIsland_RocketWarehouse_Text_Admin2Intro
source:
That's quite enough of you 
playing the hero, kid.\pSpreading lies about how TEAM
ROCKET has disbanded…\pIt's such an obvious attempt to
cause confusion in our ranks.\pFortunately, we're not so ignorant
to fall for the lies of a child!\pAnd now, I'll show you how scary
an angry adult can be!$
translation:
小朋友，
扮英雄的游戏结束了。\p散播关于火箭队
如何解散的谎言......\p这是一个明显的想要
扰乱我们的队伍的计划。\p幸好，我们不会无知到因为
一个孩子的谎言而就此沦落！\p而现在，我会让你见识一下
生气的大人有多可怕！$

label: FiveIsland_RocketWarehouse_Text_Admin2Defeat
source:
Urgh…
You were too strong…\p…
Th-that's GIOVANNI's BADGE!\pSo it's true?
TEAM ROCKET really has disbanded?$
translation:
呃......
你太强了......\p......
那-那是坂木的徽章！\p传言是真的吗？
火箭队真的解散了？$

label: FiveIsland_RocketWarehouse_Text_Admin2PostBattle
source: We will abandon this WAREHOUSE…\pBut don't think this is over.\nI won't let this be the end.\pI will find GIOVANNI.\nAnd I will resurrect TEAM ROCKET!\lI will…\pUntil then, farewell!$
translation: 我们将放弃这个仓库......\p但不要认为已经结束了。\n我不会善罢甘休的。\p我会找到坂木。\n并且复活火箭队！\l我要...\p就这样，再会！$

label: FiveIsland_RocketWarehouse_Text_ReportWithGraphsAndText
source: A report with graphs and text is on\nthe PC monitor.\p“The Influence of Magnetic Waves\non POKéMON Evolution”…\p… … … … … …\pIt's too difficult to understand…$
translation: 电脑屏幕上有\n图表和文字的报告。\p"电波对宝可梦进化的影响"\p...... ...... ......\p这太难懂了......$

label: FiveIsland_RocketWarehouse_Text_GideonIntro
source:
I almost managed to sell the
SAPPHIRE for huge money…\pThen, you just had to come along
and blow the whole deal apart!\pFufu… Fufufufu…
There's no forgiveness for you!$
translation: 我差一点就能把蓝宝石卖了\n赚到大笔大笔的钱......\p你却过来毁了整个交易！\p呋呋......呋呋呋呋......\n绝不能饶恕你！$

label: FiveIsland_RocketWarehouse_Text_GideonDefeat
source: Gah! Darn!\nDarn! Darn!$
translation: 噶！该死！\n混蛋！真气人！$

label: FiveIsland_RocketWarehouse_Text_GideonPostBattle
source: If I can't sell it, it's worthless!\nGo ahead, take it!$
translation: 如果我卖不了它，它就没价值了！\n来吧，拿着它吧！$

label: FiveIsland_RocketWarehouse_Text_GetLostLeaveMeBe
source: What do you want now?\nGo on, get lost, leave me be.$
translation: 你现在想要什么？\n走开，滚远点，让我一个人呆着。$

label: FiveIsland_RocketWarehouse_Text_GiovannisKidHasRedHair
source:
What, you again?\pYou… You're not GIOVANNI's kid,
are you?\pNo, that can't be right!
GIOVANNI's kid has red hair.\pYou don't have any reasons for
bugging me. Leave me alone!$
translation:
什么，又是你？\p你......你莫非是坂木的孩子？
我没认错吧？\p不，我认错了。
坂木的孩子是红头发。\p那你别来烦我了。
让我单独呆一会儿！$

label: FiveIsland_WaterLabyrinth_Text_LetMeTakeLookAtMons
source:
You travel all over the place,
don't you?\pYou're not driving your POKéMON
too harshly, are you?\pLet me take a look.
… … …   … … …$
translation:
你在各地旅行，
是吗？\p你没有对你的
宝可梦太严厉吧？\p让我瞧一瞧。
........................$

label: FiveIsland_WaterLabyrinth_Text_HmmISeeIsee
source: Ah, hmm…\nI see, I see…$
translation: 啊，嗯......\n我看到了，我明白了......$

label: FiveIsland_WaterLabyrinth_Text_TreatMonRightHaveThis
source: Oh, impressive.\nYou treat your POKéMON right.\pI think you can be entrusted with\nthis.\pPlease, I'd like you to have this.$
translation: 噢，太感人了。\n你的宝可梦被照顾的很周到。\p我想我能委托你做这件事了。\p拜托了，请收下这个。$

label: FiveIsland_WaterLabyrinth_Text_ReceivedEggFromMan
source: {PLAYER} received an EGG\nfrom the man!$
translation: {PLAYER}从这个人手里\n得到了一个蛋！$

label: FiveIsland_WaterLabyrinth_Text_DontHaveSpaceInYourParty
source: …Unfortunately, you don't have\nspace for this in your party.\pYou'd better come back for it\nanother time.$
translation: 很不幸，\n你的队伍已经满了。\p你最好再找个时间\n回来拿它吧。$

label: FiveIsland_WaterLabyrinth_Text_GladIMetSomeoneLikeYou
source: I received that EGG while I was\ntraveling.\pI'm glad I met someone like you.$
translation: 我旅行的时候\n得到了那个蛋。\p我很高兴遇到了你这样的人。$

label: FiveIsland_WaterLabyrinth_Text_CuteMonRemindsMeOfDaisy
source:
Oh, hello.
That's a cute {STR_VAR_2}.\pSeeing it reminds me of a sweet 
little girl I met while traveling.\pShe was gently grooming POKéMON…
She was a little angel.\pThat little girl's name…
I think it was DAISY.$
translation:
噢，你好。
真是可爱的{STR_VAR_2}。\p看见它我就想起了
我在旅行中遇到的一个可爱的女孩。\p她很温柔地照料着宝可梦......
她真是一个小天使。\p那个小姑娘的名字好像是......
她好像叫奈奈美。$

label: FiveIsland_WaterLabyrinth_Text_AlizeIntro
source: This is an excellent environment\nfor raising POKéMON.$
translation: 这真是一个培育宝可梦的\n绝佳环境。$

label: FiveIsland_WaterLabyrinth_Text_AlizeDefeat
source: Your POKéMON are growing up\nadmirably well!$
translation: 你的宝可梦成长得很出色！$

label: FiveIsland_WaterLabyrinth_Text_AlizePostBattle
source: You know, I think you have the\ntalent to be a good BREEDER.$
translation: 我想你有天赋成为\n一个很棒的饲育家。$

label: FortreeCity_Text_SawGiganticPokemonInSky
source:
No one believes me, but I saw this
gigantic POKéMON in the sky.\pIt seemed to squirm as it flew toward
ROUTE 131.\pBy the way… Sniff…
Um… You, uh…smell singed.\pWere you at a volcano or something?$
translation:
没人肯相信我，但我确实在天空中
看到了巨大的宝可梦。\p它好像在辗转着
飞向131号水路。\p话说......
唔唔......你身上，呃......好像有焦味。\p你刚从火山或什么地方来吗？$

label: FortreeCity_Text_SomethingBlockingGym
source: I want to go to the POKéMON GYM,\nbut something's blocking the way.\pAfter all the bother I went through\ntraining on ROUTE 120…$
translation: 我想去宝可梦道馆，\n但有东西堵了路。\p在120号道路训练了\n那么久，现在却......$

label: FortreeCity_Text_ThisTimeIllBeatWinona
source: I've got my pride-and-joy POKéMON\nwith me. This time, I'll beat WINONA.$
translation: 我带着我漂亮又可爱的\n宝可梦一起来了。\l这一次，我一定要打败娜琪。$

label: FortreeCity_Text_TreesGrowByDrinkingRainwater
source: The ground absorbs rainwater, and\ntrees grow by drinking that water…\pOur FORTREE CITY exists because\nthere's both water and soil.$
translation: 树木吸收了渗进地面的雨水，\n慢慢长大......\p我们茵郁市就是在\n水和土地上建造起来的。$

label: FortreeCity_Text_EveryoneHealthyAndLively
source:
The CITY consists of homes built on
trees.\pPerhaps because of that lifestyle,
everyone is healthy and lively.\pWhy, even myself--I feel as if I've
grown thirty years younger.$
translation:
城市中的房子
都建在树上。\p也许正因这种生活方式，
大家都很健康，充满活力。\p哈，我也一样--我感觉
好像年轻了30岁。$

label: FortreeCity_Text_BugPokemonComeThroughWindow
source: Living on top of trees is okay.\pBut sometimes BUG POKéMON come in\nthrough windows.\lIt can be really startling.$
translation: 住在树顶上\n没什么问题，\p但有时虫属性宝可梦会\n从窗户爬进来，\l经常吓人一跳。$

label: FortreeCity_Text_PokemonThatEvolveWhenTraded
source: There are POKéMON that evolve when\nyou trade them! That's what I heard.$
translation: 我听说，有些宝可梦\n会在交换中进化！$

label: FortreeCity_Text_SomethingUnseeable
source: Something unseeable is in the way.$
translation: 有什么看不见的东西挡在路上。$

label: FortreeCity_Text_UnseeableUseDevonScope
source: Something unseeable is in the way.\pWant to use the DEVON SCOPE?$
translation: 有什么看不见的东西挡在路上。\p要使用得文侦测镜吗？$

label: FortreeCity_Text_UsedDevonScopePokemonFled
source: {PLAYER} used the DEVON SCOPE.\pAn invisible POKéMON became completely\nvisible!\pThe startled POKéMON fled!$
translation: {PLAYER}使用得文侦测镜。\p看不见的宝可梦\n现出了原形！\p受惊的宝可梦溜掉了！$

label: FortreeCity_Text_CitySign
source: FORTREE CITY\n“The treetop city that frolics with\lnature.”$
translation: 这里是茵郁市。\n"与自然嬉戏的树上城市。"$

label: FortreeCity_Text_GymSign
source: FORTREE CITY POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: WINONA\p“The bird user taking flight into\nthe world.”$
translation: 茵郁市宝可梦道馆\n馆主：娜琪\p"翱翔在世界的\n鸟宝可梦训练家！"$

label: FortreeCity_DecorationShop_Text_MerchandiseSentToPC
source: Merchandise you buy here is sent to\nyour own PC.\pThat's fantastic! I wish they could\nalso deliver me home like that.$
translation: 在这儿买的商品\n都会送到自己的电脑里，\p太奇妙了！如果也能让他们\n把我那样送回家就好了。$

label: FortreeCity_DecorationShop_Text_BuyingDeskForDolls
source: I'm buying a pretty desk and I'm\nputting my cute DOLLS on it.\pIf I don't, when I decorate my\nSECRET BASE, my DOLLS will get\ldirty or poked with splinters.$
translation: 我要买张漂亮桌子\n放我可爱的玩偶，\p否则我装扮我的\n秘密基地的时候我的玩偶\l会弄脏，还可能被戳坏。$

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_GymGuideAdvice
source:
Yo, how's it going, CHAMPION-
bound {PLAYER}?\pFORTREE GYM LEADER WINONA is
a master of FLYING-type POKéMON.\pShe's waiting at the back of this GYM,
behind the rotating doors.\pShe's waiting for new challengers
who are trying to take wing!\pOkay, go for it!$
translation:
嗨，怎么样，向冠军的目标
冲刺的{PLAYER}？\p茵郁市道馆馆主娜琪是
飞行属性宝可梦大师，\p她在道馆的旋转门后面
等着，\p等待着想要
飞翔的挑战者！\p好了，加油吧！$

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_GymGuidePostVictory
source: You did it!\nYou've achieved liftoff!$
translation: 你做到了！\n你飞上了天空！$

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_JaredIntro
source: Behold the elegant battle style of\nBIRD POKéMON!$
translation: 观赏一下鸟类宝可梦\n优雅的战斗吧！$

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_JaredDefeat
source: You…\nYou're strong…$

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_JaredPostBattle
source: A TRAINER has to be smart to keep\nup with unexpected turns of events.\pDo you have the smarts to get to\nour LEADER?$
translation: 训练家必须有面对\n意料之外的转变的智慧，\p你有足够的智慧\n到达我们的馆主那儿吗？$

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_EdwardoIntro
source: The lovers of BIRD POKéMON aspire\nto join this GYM.\pAs a member of the FORTREE GYM,\nI'm not allowed to lose!$
translation: 所有鸟类宝可梦爱好者\n都渴望进入这道馆，\p作为茵郁市道馆的一员，\n我不能输！$

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_EdwardoDefeat
source: It was too much of a load for me\nto bear…$
translation: 这对我来说\n压力太大了......$

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_EdwardoPostBattle
source: The world is huge, and there are\ncountless tough TRAINERS.\pI'm going to keep training and make\nmyself even stronger.$
translation: 世界如此广大，\n在其中有数不清的优秀训练家。\p我得继续训练，\n让自己变得更强。$

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_FlintDefeat
source: WINONA, I…\nI lost!$
translation: 娜琪，我......\n我输了！$

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_FlintPostBattle
source: WINONA is cute and she's strong.\nShe's the ultimate LEADER!\pBlush…$
translation: 娜琪很可爱，也很强。\n她是最棒的馆主！\p脸红......$

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_AshleyIntro
source: WINONA taught me personally!\nYou can't beat me easily!$
translation: 娜琪单独教过我！\n我不会轻易输给你的！$

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_AshleyDefeat
source: I was beaten…$

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_AshleyPostBattle
source: Thanks to WINONA, the people of\nFORTREE can live without fear.$
translation: 多亏了娜琪，住在茵郁市的人们\n才能安居乐业。$

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_HumbertoIntro
source: When WINONA takes to battle, her face\nshines with beautiful determination…\pI'm not letting you witness that\nlovely sight!$
translation: 当娜琪对战的时候，她的脸上\n闪耀着坚定的决心......\p我不会让你看到\n她那可爱的一幕！$

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_HumbertoDefeat
source: Urk!\nI couldn't stop you.$
translation: 哎！\n我阻止不了你。$

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_HumbertoPostBattle
source: You'd better watch it!\nDon't get distracted staring at WINONA\lor you'll go crashing down in a heap!$
translation: 你最好小心！\n别分心盯着娜琪看，\l否则你会败得一塌糊涂！$

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_DariusIntro
source: You'd better know that there are all\nsorts of FLYING-type POKéMON.\pYou do know that, right?$
translation: 你最好知道世界上\n有多种多样的飞行属性宝可梦。\p你知道的，是吗？$

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_DariusDefeat
source: You seem to know your stuff!$
translation: 看来你很清楚自己的实力！$

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_DariusPostBattle
source: Sure, you beat me all right.\nBut you'd better watch it! Our LEADER\lWINONA's POKéMON are all business.$
translation: 你确实打败了我，\n但你最好小心点！我们的馆主\l娜琪的宝可梦都不好对付。$

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_WinonaIntro
source:
I am WINONA. I am the LEADER of
the FORTREE POKéMON GYM.\pI have become one with BIRD POKéMON
and have soared the skies…\pHowever grueling the battle, we have
triumphed with grace…\pWitness the elegant choreography
of BIRD POKéMON and I!$
translation:
我是娜琪，茵郁道馆的
道馆馆主。\p我和鸟宝可梦
一起翱翔天际......\p无论对战多么艰辛，
我们都会优雅地赢得胜利......\p见证我和鸟宝可梦的
优美舞步吧！$

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_WinonaDefeat
source: Never before have I seen a TRAINER\ncommand POKéMON with more grace\lthan I…\pIn recognition of your prowess,\nI present to you this GYM BADGE.$
translation: 我从没见过能比我\n更优雅地指挥宝可梦的训练家......\p为了表示对你那非凡才能的认可，\n我颁发这枚道馆徽章给你。$

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_ReceivedFeatherBadge
source: {PLAYER} received the FEATHER BADGE\nfrom WINONA.$
translation: {PLAYER}从娜琪那里\n得到白羽徽章。$

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_ExplainAerialAce
source: TM40 contains AERIAL ACE.\pIts speed…\nNo POKéMON should be able to avoid it.\p… … … … … …$
translation: 招式学习器40的里面\n是燕返，\p它的速度......\n没有任何宝可梦能侥幸躲过。\p...... ...... ......$

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_RegisteredWinona
source: Registered GYM LEADER WINONA\nin the POKéNAV.$
translation: 把道馆馆主娜琪\n登记到宝可导航里了。$

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_WinonaPostBattle
source: Though I fell to you, I will remain\ndevoted to BIRD POKéMON.$
translation: 虽然我输给了你，\n但我仍会专注于鸟类宝可梦。$

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_GymStatue
source: FORTREE CITY POKéMON GYM$
translation: 茵郁市宝可梦道馆$

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_GymStatueCertified
source: FORTREE CITY POKéMON GYM\pWINONA'S CERTIFIED TRAINERS:\n{PLAYER}$
translation: 茵郁市宝可梦道馆\p娜琪认可的训练家：\n{PLAYER}$

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_WinonaPreRematch
source:
WINONA: We humans can never escape
gravity's pull on the ground.\pBut by striving for excellence,
we have the power to soar!\pYou have scaled the pinnacle as
the reigning CHAMPION.\pPlease, allow me to see your power
at full flight!$
translation:
娜琪：我们人类永远无法逃离
地心引力的束缚，\p但通过不断地完善自我，
我们能拥有展翅高飞的力量！\p身为现任冠军，
你已经拥有训练家中最顶尖的实力。\p拜托你，请允许我见识一下
你那登峰造极的实力吧！$

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_WinonaRematchDefeat
source: I failed to reach your height again…$
translation: 我还是没能触及你的高度......$

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_WinonaRematchNeedTwoMons
source:
WINONA: We humans can never escape
gravity's pull on the ground.\pBut by striving for excellence,
we have the power to soar!\pYou have scaled the pinnacle as
the reigning CHAMPION.\pPlease, allow me to see your power
at full flight!\pOh, no… Do you have but one
POKéMON with you?\pPlease return with two POKéMON
at the very least.$
translation:
娜琪：我们人类永远无法逃离
地心引力的束缚，\p但通过不断地完善自我，
我们能拥有展翅高飞的力量！\p身为现任冠军，
你已经拥有训练家中最顶尖的实力。\p拜托你，请允许我见识一下
你那登峰造极的实力吧！\p哎，不......
你只带了1只宝可梦吗？\p至少带2只宝可梦
再回来吧。$

label: FortreeCity_House1_Text_YouWillTradeWontYou
source:
Wrooooaaar! I need it!
I have to get me a {STR_VAR_1}!\lI'll do anything for it!\p…Uh… Did you hear that?
My shout from the bottom of my heart?\pHaving heard that, you will trade
your {STR_VAR_1} for my {STR_VAR_2},\lwon't you?$
translation:
唔啊啊啊！我想要！
我想要只{STR_VAR_1}！\l我会拼尽全力找到它的！\p......呃......被你听到了吗？
被你听到了我那发自内心的呼喊？\p既然听见了，就用{STR_VAR_1}
来换我的{STR_VAR_2}吧，\l好吗？$

label: FortreeCity_House1_Text_MonYouTakeCare
source: Oh, yeah, right on!\p{STR_VAR_1}, welcome!\n{STR_VAR_2}, you take care!$
translation: 哦，耶，对！\p欢迎，{STR_VAR_1}！\n你要照顾好{STR_VAR_2}！$

label: FortreeCity_House1_Text_ThisIsntAMon
source: Uh, no, I don't think so.\nThat isn't a {STR_VAR_1}.$
translation: 呃，不，\n我想这不是{STR_VAR_1}。$

label: FortreeCity_House1_Text_YouWontTradeMe
source: No? You won't trade me?\nEven after I bared my heart to you?$
translation: 不？你不跟我换？\n即使你看到了我的真心也不肯换？$

label: FortreeCity_House1_Text_GoingToMakeVolbeatStrong
source: I'm going to make VOLBEAT super\nstrong from this moment on!\pI hope you do the same with PLUSLE!$
translation: 从现在开始，我要把甜甜萤\n养得壮壮的！\p你也要善待正电拍拍啊！$

label: FortreeCity_House1_Text_TradingMemoriesWithOthers
source: Trading POKéMON with others…\pIt's as if you're trading your own\nmemories with other people.$
translation: 和别人交换宝可梦......\p就像跟别人交换\n自己的记忆一样。$

label: FortreeCity_House1_Text_Zigzagoon
source: ZIGZAGOON: Gumomoh?$
translation: 蛇纹熊：咕莫莫？$

label: FortreeCity_House2_Text_HiddenPowersArousedByNature
source: People… POKéMON…\pTheir hidden powers are aroused by\nliving in natural environments…$
translation: 人类......宝可梦......\p他们隐藏的力量\n会被自然中的生活唤醒......$

label: FortreeCity_House2_Text_CoinInWhichHand
source: Let this old woman see if your hidden\npower has awoken…\pI hold a coin in my hand.\pNow, tell me, have I palmed it in\nthe right hand? Or in the left?$
translation: 让我这老人看看\n你隐藏的力量是不是觉醒了......\p我手里有一枚硬币。\p告诉我，我是把它藏在了\n左手里呢，还有右手里？$

label: FortreeCity_House2_Text_CorrectTryAgainWhichHand
source: Oh! Yes, correct!\pWe shall try again.\pIn which hand have I palmed the coin?\nThe right or left?$
translation: 哎，没错，答对了！\p我们再试一次。\p我把硬币藏在哪儿？\n左手还是右手？$

label: FortreeCity_House2_Text_CorrectTryAgainWhichHand2
source: Oh! Yes, correct!\pWe shall try again.\pIn which hand have I palmed the coin?\nThe right or left?$
translation: 哎，没错，答对了！\p我们再试一次。\p我把硬币藏在哪儿？\n左手还是右手？$

label: FortreeCity_House2_Text_YourHiddenPowerHasAwoken
source: Oh! Splendid!\nYour hidden power has awoken!\pHere, take this and awaken the hidden\npower of your POKéMON.$
translation: 啊！完全正确！\n你的力量觉醒了！\p来，这个给你，也让你的\n宝可梦的力量觉醒吧。$

label: FortreeCity_House2_Text_ExplainHiddenPower
source: HIDDEN POWER is a move that changes\nwith the POKéMON.$
translation: 觉醒力量是会随着使用\n它的宝可梦不同而改变的招式。$

label: FortreeCity_House2_Text_YouGuessedWrong
source: No, too bad.\nYou guessed wrong.$
translation: 哎，真遗憾，\n你猜错了。$

label: FortreeCity_House3_Text_MetStevenHadAmazingPokemon
source:
While speaking about POKéDEXES,
I remembered something.\pI met this TRAINER, STEVEN, when
I was searching for rare stones.\pHoo, boy, he had some amazing POKéMON
with him.\pThey weren't just rare, they were
trained to terrifying extremes!\pHe might even be stronger than the
GYM LEADER in this town…$
translation:
说到宝可梦图鉴，
我想起来了，\p我寻找稀有石头的时候
遇到了那个叫大吾的训练家。\p哈，他带着一些
奇妙的宝可梦，\p它们不止是强大，
还在训练中发挥到了极致！\p他也许比这城镇的
道馆馆主还要强......$

label: FortreeCity_House3_Text_OhYouHavePokedex
source: What's that thing you have there?\p… … … … … …\pOh, it's called a POKéDEX?\nIt's really awesome!$
translation: 你拿着的那是什么？\p...... ...... ......\p哦？它叫宝可梦图鉴？\n真奇妙！$

label: FortreeCity_House4_Text_BringsWorldCloserTogether
source: By being together with POKéMON,\npeople make more and more friends.\pAnd that brings the world closer\ntogether. I think it's wonderful!$
translation: 和宝可梦在一起，\n人们可以交上更多朋友，\p这让我们的世界\n变得更小。这多美妙！$

label: FortreeCity_House4_Text_GoBirdPokemon
source: There!\nGo, BIRD POKéMON!$
translation: 好了！\n去吧，我的鸟宝可梦！$

label: FortreeCity_House4_Text_AskedWingullToRunErrand
source: Heheh, I asked my WINGULL to run\nan errand for me.$
translation: 我让我的长翅鸥\n帮我送信。$

label: FortreeCity_House4_Text_WelcomeWingullTakeMentalHerb
source:
Good!
Welcome back, WINGULL!\pHuh? What is this?
What is it holding?\pA MENTAL HERB?
It must have picked it up somewhere.\pBut I'm not a TRAINER, so you can
have it.$
translation:
太好了！
欢迎回来，长翅鸥！\p嗯？这是什么？
它抓着的是什么？\p心灵香草？
一定是在哪儿偶然抓到的。\p但我不是训练家，
这个还是给你吧。$

label: FortreeCity_House4_Text_FriendsFarAwayThanksToWingull
source: Thanks to my WINGULL, I have friends\nwho live far away.$
translation: 多亏了我的长翅鸥，我才能够\n跟住在很远的地方的人交朋友。$

label: FortreeCity_House4_Text_Wingull
source: WINGULL: Pihyoh!$
translation: 长翅鸥：欧雷欧！$

label: FortreeCity_House5_Text_TreeHousesAreGreat
source: The tree houses of FORTREE are great!\pI think it's the number one town for\nliving together with POKéMON.$
translation: 茵郁市的树屋很棒！\p我想这里是和宝可梦\n共同生活的最好的地方。$

label: FortreeCity_House5_Text_AdaptedToNature
source: POKéMON and people have adapted to\nnature for survival.\pThere's no need to make nature\nconform to the way we want to live.$
translation: 为了生存，人类和宝可梦\n适应了自然，\p因此我们没必要\n让自然遵循我们的规则。$

label: FortreeCity_House5_Text_Zigzagoon
source: ZIGZAGOON: Bufuu!$
translation: 蛇纹熊：噗噗噗！$

label: FortreeCity_Mart_Text_SuperRepelBetter
source: SUPER REPEL lasts a long time,\nand it gets the job done.\pIt's much better than an ordinary\nREPEL.$
translation: 白银喷雾持续时间长，\n效果也好，\p比普通除虫喷雾\n好用多了。$

label: FortreeCity_Mart_Text_StockUpOnItems
source: I always stock up on more items than\nI'm sure I'll need.\pYou never know what might happen.\nBetter to be safe than sorry!$
translation: 我总是比计划中\n多存一些道具，\p因为没人知道什么时候会发生灾难，\n提前准备总比事后后悔要好！$

label: FortreeCity_Mart_Text_RareCandyMakesMonGrow
source: A RARE CANDY makes a POKéMON grow\nimmediately by one level.$
translation: 神奇糖果可以使宝可梦\n立即提升1级。$

label: FortreeCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_GoToSafariZone
source: Listen, kid, are you working\non a POKéDEX?\pHmm… Go to the SAFARI ZONE.\nThat's my suggestion.$
translation: 孩子，我问你，你\n在收集宝可梦图鉴吗？\p唔......那么听我的，\n到狩猎地带去。$

label: FortreeCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_RecordCornerIsNeat
source:
Have you done anything at
the RECORD CORNER?\pIt's pretty neat. It mixes and matches
the records of TRAINERS.\pI don't know quite how it works,
but it's cool. It's exciting, even!$
translation: 你去过记录角吗？\p那里超有意思的，\n可以混合训练家的记录。\p虽然搞不懂具体原理，\n但它很棒，甚至令人吃惊！$

label: FortreeCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_DoYouKnowAboutPokenav
source:
Oh, wow, you have a POKéNAV!
And it's just like mine!\pDo you know about POKéNAV's
MATCH CALL system?\pAccess it, and you can chat with
registered TRAINERS anytime.\pIt also shows you which TRAINERS
want a rematch with you.\pIt's really nifty! Those DEVON guys
sure know what they're doing!$
translation:
哇，你有宝可导航！
就和我的一样！\p你知道宝可导航的
对战寻呼系统吗？\p用它能随时跟
登记的训练家联系，\p同时也能显示出
哪个训练家想跟你对战。\p这太方便了！得文的人
真的很优秀！$

label: FourIsland_Text_IslandSign
source: FOUR ISLAND\nThe Warm, Blue, Floe Island$
translation: 四之岛\n温暖的蓝色浮冰之岛$

label: FourIsland_Text_LoreleiHasReturned
source: LORELEI has returned.\pDid she find the city life too\nstressful, I wonder?$
translation: 科拿回来了。\p莫非是因为\n都市生活的压力太大了吗？$

label: FourIsland_Text_LoreleiMetLaprasAsChild
source:
LORELEI has gone back.\pThe LAPRAS she has, I imagine it
to be the one she met as a child.\pI believe it was in ICEFALL CAVE
that she caught it.\pPerhaps that POKéMON has been with
her ever since.$
translation:
科拿已经回来了。\p我猜她的拉普拉斯就是那只
她在很小时候就遇到的宝可梦。\p我想她是在冻瀑洞窟
收服到拉普拉斯的。\p可能从那时起那只宝可梦
就一直陪伴着她。$

label: FourIsland_Text_MadeSlushieUsingIcefallCaveIce
source: Ooh, chilly!\pI made a slushie using ice I\nshaved inside ICEFALL CAVE.\pIt's chilly and tasty!$
translation:
啊，你发现我了！
请别告诉科拿。\p你知道科拿有许多许多
的毛绒娃娃吗？\p每次她回四之岛，
她的收藏都会增加！$

label: FourIsland_House1_Text_YoureAwfullyHeavy
source: There! Boing!\nYou're awfully heavy!$
translation: 就是那里！\n话说你真的好重啊。$

label: FourIsland_IcefallCave_Back_Text_LoreleiKeepHandsOffMons
source: LORELEI: Keep your filthy hands\noff the POKéMON in the cave!\pDo as I say, or you'll have me to\nanswer to!$
translation: 科拿： 把你肮脏的手从\n洞穴里的宝可梦中挪开！\p照我说的做，不然要你好看！$

label: FourIsland_IcefallCave_Back_Text_ShutItLadyLeaveUsBe
source: Aww, shut it, lady, and leave\nus be.\pDon't let your glasses get all\nsteamed up!$
translation: 啊，请冷静一下，小姐，\n让我们冷静一下。\p别让你的眼镜上爬满雾气啊！$

label: FourIsland_IcefallCave_Back_Text_LoreleiPlayerHelpMeKickPoachersOut
source:
LORELEI: {PLAYER}?!
What are you doing here?\pNo, we can catch up later.
Right now, I need your help.\pHelp me kick these poachers out
before they do anything else.\pThey've been catching POKéMON
here, then selling them off!\pAre you ready?
You take that one, please!$
translation:
科拿：{PLAYER}？！
你在这儿做什么？\p别急，我们等会儿能赶上的。
现在，我需要你的帮助。\p在这些入侵者做出什么之前，
帮我把他们赶出去。\p他们在这里捉宝可梦，
然后统统拿拿出去去卖了！\p准备好了吗？
你去对付他！$

label: FourIsland_IcefallCave_Back_Text_GruntIntro
source: W-what?!\pWho says we can't do what we want\nwith the POKéMON we catch?$
translation: 什-什么？！\p为啥我们不能用抓到的宝可梦\n做我们想做的事情？$

label: FourIsland_IcefallCave_Back_Text_GruntDefeat
source: We didn't plan on this!$
translation: 我们没想到结果会是这样！$

label: FourIsland_IcefallCave_Back_Text_LoreleiWhereHaveYouTakenMons
source:
LORELEI: Humph.
So despicably weak.\pYou!
Tell me!\pWhere have you taken the captured
POKéMON?\pI'm smashing your ring once and
for all!$
translation:
科拿：哼。
真是弱爆了。\p你！
告诉我！\p你把你们抓到的宝可梦放在哪了\p不说的话我就
砸烂你的戒指！$

label: FourIsland_IcefallCave_Back_Text_NotTellingYouThat
source: N-no way!\nI'm not telling you that!$
translation: 没-没门！\n我不会告诉你的！$

label: FourIsland_IcefallCave_Back_Text_LoreleiWellDeepFreezeYou
source:
LORELEI: If you won't confess,
we'll deep-freeze you.\pMy LAPRAS is furious for what
you've done to its friends.\pGo, LAPRAS!
ICE BEAM…$
translation:
科拿：我的拉普拉斯对你们对它同伴的
所做所为感到十分愤怒。\p如果你不肯说出来的话，
就让它把你们冻成冰块吧。\p上吧，拉普拉斯！
急冻光线......$

label: FourIsland_IcefallCave_Back_Text_OkayRocketWareHouseFiveIsland
source:
Wawaah! Okay!
I'll talk!\pThe POKéMON are in the ROCKET
WAREHOUSE on FIVE ISLAND.\pThere! I said it!
We'll be going now!\p…But I doubt you'll ever make it
into the ROCKET WAREHOUSE!\pHeheheheh!$
translation:
哇！好吧！
我说！\p宝可梦在五之岛的
火箭队仓库里面。\p就在哪里！我说了！
我们现在能过去吧！\p......但是我怀疑你能不能进得了
火箭队仓库！\p呵呵呵呵！$

label: FourIsland_IcefallCave_Back_Text_ThankYouThisIsAwful
source:
{PLAYER}, thank you.
But this is awful…\pI was born and raised here on
these islands.\pI had no idea that those horrible
criminals were loose here…$
translation: {PLAYER}，谢谢你。\n但情况太糟糕了......\p我在这片岛屿上出生和长大。\p我没想到那些可恶的\n罪犯会来这里......$

label: FourIsland_LoreleisHouse_Text_IfAnythingWereToHappenToIsland
source:
LORELEI: There's something weighing
heavily on my mind.\pIf anything were to happen on
the island where I was born…\pI wouldn't know about it if I were
in the POKéMON LEAGUE.\pI wonder if that would make me
irresponsible to my home…$
translation:
科拿：在我的脑海里，有件事
一直令我放不下心。\p如果在我所出生的岛上
发生了什么事情......\p而在宝可梦联盟的我
是全然不知的。\p我想知道......
我会不会为了这样的原因
不负责任地跑回家......$

label: FourIsland_LoreleisHouse_Text_IllReturnToLeagueInShortWhile
source:
LORELEI: So, you managed to solve
all the problems here?\pThat's wonderful.\pThat means there isn't any reason
for me to be here all the time.\pThank you…\pI'll return to the POKéMON LEAGUE
in a short while.$
translation:
科拿：那么，你会在这儿
设法解决掉所有的问题？\p那真是太好了。\p那也就是说我已经没有理由
一直呆在这儿了。\p真是谢谢你......\p我过一会儿就回
宝可梦联盟。$

label: FourIsland_LoreleisHouse_Text_WillDoWhatICanHereAndNow
source: I don't know what will happen in\nthe future, but…\pI will do what I can here and now.\nThat's all I can do.$
translation: 我不知道\n未来会怎样......\p但是，我会尽全力做我所能做的。\n那也是我唯一能做的了。$

label: FourIsland_LoreleisHouse_Text_StuffedMonDollsGalore
source: Stuffed POKéMON dolls galore!$
translation: 胖嘟嘟的宝可梦娃娃被打扮得很漂亮！$

label: FourIsland_Mart_Text_LoreleiGrewUpOnThisIsland
source:
We've had a great and powerful
TRAINER grow up on this island.\pI bet even you'd know her.
It's LORELEI of the ELITE FOUR!\pWhen LORELEI was just a tyke,
I taught her about POKéMON.$
translation:
在这座岛上
有一个伟大的训练家在这里长大。\p我猜你已经知道她是谁了。
没错，
她就是四天王的科拿！\p当科拿还是一个小孩子的时候，
我教过她宝可梦的战斗。$

label: Text_BodySlamTeach
source:
Ready?
Boing!\pWe're having a BODY SLAM match
to see who wimps out first.\pIf you were to join us, you'd be
squashed like a bug, though…\pHow about I teach BODY SLAM to
a POKéMON of yours instead?$
translation:
准备好了吗？
啪啪啪！\p我们在举行泰山压顶比赛。
我倒要看看是谁先倒下。\p即使你让加入我们，
你也是一个新手。\p不如让我把泰山压顶教给
你的一只宝可梦怎么样？$

label: Text_BodySlamDeclined
source: Come again!\nBoing!$
translation: 下次再来吧！\n啪啪啪！$

label: Text_BodySlamWhichMon
source: Which POKéMON wants to learn how\nto BODY SLAM?$
translation: 想让哪只宝可梦掌握\n泰山压顶？$

label: Text_BodySlamTaught
source: Boioing!$
translation: 啪啪啪$

label: FourIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_RareIceMonsInCave
source: There's a rare kind of ICE POKéMON\nthat lives in the cave.\pWe get a lot of visitors hoping to\nsee that POKéMON.$
translation: 在那个洞穴里住着一只\n稀有的冰属性宝可梦。\p很多游客都想去\n亲眼见识一下那只宝可梦。$

label: FourIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_DayCarePeopleFoundEggBefore
source:
Oh? A POKéMON EGG?
…I have no idea.\p…Oh, wait. The DAY-CARE people
in town were saying something.\pThey said that they'd found EGGS
before on their property.$
translation:
什么？宝可梦的蛋？
......我不知道。\p......哦，我想起来了！培育屋的人
在城镇里说过什么。\p他们过去在他们的房屋里
找到了蛋。$

label: FourIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_NewPokemonJournalHasntArrived
source: What's this?\pThe new POKéMON JOURNAL hasn't\narrived on this island?$
translation: 这是？\p新的宝可梦特刊\n还没有送到这座岛上来吗？$

label: FuchsiaCity_Text_DidYouTrySafariGame
source: Did you try the SAFARI GAME?\pThere are some rare POKéMON that\ncan only be caught there.$
translation: 你试过原野区游戏吗？\p有一些稀有的宝可梦\n只能在那里抓到。$

label: FuchsiaCity_Text_SafariZoneZooInFront
source: The SAFARI ZONE has a zoo in front\nof the entrance.\pOut back is the SAFARI GAME for\ncatching POKéMON.$
translation: 野生原野区在入口前面\n有一个园子。\p后面就是收服宝可梦\n的原野区游戏。$

label: FuchsiaCity_Text_WheresSara
source: ERIK: Where's SARA?\nI said I'd meet her here.$
translation: 阿初：敦子在哪里？\n说了在这里等她的。$

label: FuchsiaCity_Text_ItemBallInThere
source: That item ball in there…\nWere you wanting that?\pMe, too!\n…Huh? That's a POKéMON?$
translation: 那里放着个精灵球......\n你想要吗？\p我也是！\n......嗯？那是一只宝可梦？$

label: FuchsiaCity_Text_CitySign
source: FUCHSIA CITY\nBehold! It's Passion Pink!$
translation: 浅红市\n浅红，是浅红亮丽的石竹花！$

label: FuchsiaCity_Text_SafariZoneSign
source: POKéMON PARADISE\nSAFARI ZONE$
translation: 宝可梦的乐园\n野生原野区$

label: FuchsiaCity_Text_SafariGameSign
source: SAFARI GAME\nPOKéMON-U-CATCH!$
translation: 原野区游戏\n收服宝可梦吧！$

label: FuchsiaCity_Text_WardensHomeSign
source: SAFARI ZONE\nWARDEN'S HOME$
translation: 野生原野区\n园长的家$

label: FuchsiaCity_Text_SafariZoneOfficeSign
source: POKéMON PARADISE!\nWelcome to the SAFARI ZONE!\lSAFARI ZONE OFFICE$
translation: 宝可梦的乐园！\n欢迎来到野生原野区！\l原野区办公室$

label: FuchsiaCity_Text_GymSign
source: FUCHSIA CITY POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: KOGA\lThe Poisonous Ninja Master$
translation: 浅红市宝可梦道馆\n馆主：阿桔\l剧毒的忍者之王$

label: FuchsiaCity_Text_ChanseySign
source: Name: CHANSEY\nCatching one is all up to chance.$
translation: 名字 吉利蛋\n抓到的话说明你运气很好。$

label: FuchsiaCity_Text_VoltorbSign
source: Name: VOLTORB\nThe very image of a POKé BALL.$
translation: 名字 霹雳电球\n外观很像一个精灵球。$

label: FuchsiaCity_Text_KangaskhanSign
source: Name: KANGASKHAN\pA maternal POKéMON that raises its\nyoung in a pouch on its belly.$
translation: 名字 袋兽\p母亲般的宝可梦，用肚子上的\n口袋来养育自己的小孩。$

label: FuchsiaCity_Text_SlowpokeSign
source: Name: SLOWPOKE\nFriendly and very slow moving.$
translation: 名字 呆呆兽\n很友好，但是行动缓慢。$

label: FuchsiaCity_Text_LaprasSign
source: Name: LAPRAS\nAKA the king of the seas.$
translation: 名字 拉普拉斯\n又被称为海上的王者。$

label: FuchsiaCity_Text_OmanyteSign
source: Name: OMANYTE\nAn extremely rare POKéMON that was\lregenerated from a fossil.$
translation: 名字 菊石兽\n从化石中再生的\l极其稀有的宝可梦。$

label: FuchsiaCity_Text_KabutoSign
source: Name: KABUTO\nAn extremely rare POKéMON that was\lregenerated from a fossil.$
translation: 名字 化石盔\n从化石中再生的\l极其稀有的宝可梦。$

label: Text_SubstituteTeach
source:
Aww, I wish I was a KANGASKHAN
baby.\pI'd love to be a substitute for the
baby…\pAnd snuggle in the mother
KANGASKHAN's belly pouch.\pBut only POKéMON can use the
technique SUBSTITUTE…\pWant me to teach SUBSTITUTE to
one of your POKéMON?$
translation:
啊 我多么希望自己是
袋兽的孩子。\p我甚至愿意替代这个孩子......\p依偎在母亲
袋兽的袋子里。\p但是只有宝可梦能使用
技能替身......\p让我教给你的宝可梦
替身吧？$

label: Text_SubstituteDeclined
source: Oh, really?\nSUBSTITUTE seems so fun…$
translation: 哦，真的吗？\n替身其实很有趣呢......$

label: Text_SubstituteWhichMon
source: Which POKéMON wants to learn\nSUBSTITUTE?$
translation: 哪只宝可梦想要\n学会替身？$

label: Text_SubstituteTaught
source: Boy, what I'd give to crawl inside\na KANGASKHAN belly pouch…$
translation: 孩子，我需要什么才能爬进\n袋兽的袋子里呢......$

label: FuchsiaCity_Text_MyFatherIsGymLeader
source: My father is the GYM LEADER of\nthis town.\pI'm training to use POISON POKéMON\nas well as my father.$
translation: 我父亲是这座城市道馆的馆主。\p我日复一日的特训，就是为了成为\n父亲那样的毒属性宝可梦高手。$

label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_KogaIntro
source:
KOGA: Fwahahaha!\pA mere child like you dares to
challenge me?\pThe very idea makes me shiver
with mirth!\pVery well, I shall show you true
terror as a ninja master.\pPoison brings steady doom.
Sleep renders foes helpless.\pDespair to the creeping horror of
POISON-type POKéMON!{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_RG_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}$
translation:
阿桔哇哈哈哈哈哈！\p不过是个小孩子居然
妄想挑战我？\p这个天真的想法真是
让我乐得发抖啊！\p很好很好，让我向你展示
一下忍者的恐怖之处吧。\p猛毒会把你慢慢推向毁灭的深渊。
催眠会使得所有的敌人感到无助！\p在毒属性宝可梦带来
的绝望面前颤抖吧！{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_RG_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}$

label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_KogaDefeat
source: Humph!\nYou have proven your worth!\pHere!\nTake the SOULBADGE!$
translation: 呃！\n你证明了你的实力！\p这枚浅红徽章\n你拿去吧！$

label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_KogaPostBattle
source: When afflicted by TOXIC, a POKéMON\nsuffers more and more.\pIt suffers worsening damage as the\nbattle wears on!\pIt will surely terrorize foes!$
translation: 中了剧毒之后，宝可梦\n受的伤害会越来越多。\p还要坚持战斗的话\n承受的伤害就会越来越大！\p这是一个货真价实的危险品！$

label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_KogaExplainSoulBadge
source:
Now that you have the SOULBADGE,
the DEFENSE of your POKéMON rises.\pIt also lets you SURF outside of
battle.\pAh!
Take this, too!$
translation:
既然现在你得到了浅红徽章，
你宝可梦的防御会上升一点。\p同时冲浪在战斗之外的时候
也可以使用了。\p啊！
顺便拿着这个！$

label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_ReceivedTM06FromKoga
source: {PLAYER} received TM06\nfrom KOGA.$
translation: {PLAYER}从阿桔那里\n得到了TM06。$

label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_KogaExplainTM06
source: Sealed within that TM06 lies\nTOXIC!\pIt is a secret technique dating\nback some four hundred years.$
translation: TM06是\n剧毒！\p它可是个历史能追朔到\n四百年前的秘密技能。$

label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_MakeSpaceForThis
source: Make space for this, child!$
translation: 腾点空间再来，小孩！$

label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_KaydenIntro
source: Strength isn't the key for POKéMON.\nDo you understand this?\pPOKéMON is about strategy!\pI'll show you how strategy can\nbeat brute strength.$
translation: 力量不是宝可梦的一切，\n你懂这个道理吗？\p宝可梦需要智慧！\p我将会向你展示智慧\n是怎样战胜野蛮的暴力的。$

label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_KaydenDefeat
source: What?\nExtraordinary!$
translation: 什么？\n太惊人了！$

label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_KaydenPostBattle
source: So, you mix brawn with brains?\nGood strategy!\pThat's remarkable for a child\nTRAINER.$
translation: 这样啊，你智慧和力量完美结合了起来？\n干得好！\p这正是值得年轻的\n训练家们学习的地方。$

label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_KirkIntro
source: I was a magician once upon a time.\pBut I dreamt of becoming a ninja,\nso I joined this GYM.$
translation: 我过去是一名魔术师。\p但是我一直想成为一名忍者。\n所以我很享受在这个道馆度过的时光。$

label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_KirkDefeat
source: I'm done for!$
translation: 我做到了！$

label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_KirkPostBattle
source: Even though I've lost, I will keep\ntraining according to the teachings\lof KOGA, my ninja master.$
translation: 即使我曾经失败过，\n我仍然会跟阿桔继续修炼，\l他是最强的忍者。$

label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_NateIntro
source: Let's see you beat my special\ntechniques!$
translation: 让我们看看你被我强大的\n技艺打败的惨样！$

label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_NateDefeat
source: You had me fooled!$
translation: 你愚弄了我！$

label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_NatePostBattle
source: I like poison and sleep techniques,\nas they linger after battle!$
translation: 当消耗战拉开序幕的时候，\n下毒和催眠即是我擅用之术！$

label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_PhilIntro
source: Stop right there!\pThe famed invisible walls of\nFUCHSIA GYM have you frustrated?$
translation: 站在那里别动！\p浅红道馆传说中的\n隐形墙壁有没有使你感到绝望？$

label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_PhilDefeat
source: Whoa!\nYou've got it!$
translation: 呃啊！\n你做到了！$

label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_PhilPostBattle
source: You impressed me!\nHere's a hint!\pLook very closely for gaps in the\ninvisible walls!$
translation: 真是令我惊讶！\n给你一个小提示！\p在隐形墙壁里\n有一条不明显的缝！$

label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_EdgarIntro
source: I also study the way of the ninja\nwith Master KOGA!\pNinja have a long history of using\nanimals!$
translation: 我也在阿桔老师那里学习\n忍者之道！\p忍者有很长的\n使用动物的历史！$

label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_EdgarDefeat
source: Awoo!$
translation: 哇喔！$

label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_EdgarPostBattle
source: I still have much to learn.$
translation: 我还有很多的要学。$

label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_ShawnIntro
source: Master KOGA comes from a long line\nof ninjas.\pWhat did you descend from?$
translation: 阿桔大师来自\n忍者世家。\p你来自哪个世家？$

label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_ShawnDefeat
source: You're more skilled than I'd\nthought!$
translation: 你比我想象得\n更有战术！$

label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_ShawnPostBattle
source: Where there is light, there is\nshadow!\pLight and shadow!\nWhich do you choose?$
translation: 哪里有光，\n哪里就有影！\p光与影！\n你选择走哪条路？$

label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_GymGuyAdvice
source:
Yo!
Champ in the making!\pFUCHSIA GYM is a tricked-up place.
It's riddled with invisible walls!\pKOGA might appear close, but he's
blocked off.\pYou have to find gaps in the walls
to reach him.$
translation:
呦！
未来的冠军！\p浅红道馆是一个忍者屋。
这儿有充满谜团的隐形墙壁！\p阿桔应该就在这附近，
但路被挡住了。\p你得通过墙中间的缝隙
去找到他。$

label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_GymGuyPostVictory
source: It's amazing how ninja can terrify,\neven now!$
translation: 忍者带来的恐惧会使你震惊，\n就在下一刻逼近！$

label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_GymStatue
source: FUCHSIA POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: KOGA\pWINNING TRAINERS:\n{RIVAL}$
translation: 浅红宝可梦道馆\n馆主：阿桔\p优胜训练家：\n{RIVAL}$

label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_GymStatuePlayerWon
source: FUCHSIA POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: KOGA\pWINNING TRAINERS:\n{RIVAL}, {PLAYER}$
translation: 浅红宝可梦道馆\n馆主：阿桔\p优胜训练家：\n{RIVAL} {PLAYER}$

label: FuchsiaCity_House1_Text_WardenIsOldHasFalseTeeth
source: The SAFARI ZONE's WARDEN is old, \nbut he's still very much active.\pAll his teeth are false, though.$
translation: 原野区的园长老了，\n但他仍然十分有活力，\p不过他的假牙丢了。$

label: FuchsiaCity_House1_Text_BillIsMyGrandson
source: Hmm?\nYou've met BILL?\pHe's my grandson!\pHe always liked collecting things,\neven as a child!$
translation: 嗯？\n你见过正辉了？\p他是我的孙子！\p他总是喜欢收藏东西，\n像个孩子一样！$

label: FuchsiaCity_House1_Text_BillFilesHisOwnMonData
source: BILL files his own POKéMON data on\nhis PC.\pDid he show you?$
translation: 正辉将他的宝可梦的资料\n登陆在了电脑。\p他向你展示过吗？$

label: FuchsiaCity_House2_Text_DoYouLikeToFish
source: I'm the FISHING GURU's older\nbrother.\pI simply looove fishing!\nI can't bear to go without.\pTell me, do you like to fish?$
translation: 我是钓鱼大师的\n哥哥。\p我非常喜欢钓鱼！\n没有钓鱼的生活我真难以想象。\p告诉我，你喜欢钓鱼吗？$

label: FuchsiaCity_House2_Text_LikeYourStyleTakeThis
source: Grand! I like your style.\nI think we can be friends.\pTake this and fish, young friend!$
translation: 漂亮！我喜欢你的态度！\n我认为我们可以成为朋友。\p拿着它去钓鱼吧，年轻的朋友！$

label: FuchsiaCity_House2_Text_ReceivedGoodRod
source: {PLAYER} received a GOOD ROD from\nthe FISHING GURU's brother.$
translation: {PLAYER}从钓鱼大师的哥哥那里\n得到了好钓竿。$

label: FuchsiaCity_House2_Text_GoodRodCanCatchBetterMons
source:
Fishing is a way of life!
It is like the finest poetry.\pA crummy OLD ROD could only catch
MAGIKARP, yes?\pBut with a GOOD ROD, you can
catch much better POKéMON.$
translation:
钓鱼是一种生活方式！
就像是最优美的诗歌。\p寒酸的破钓竿只能够
钓到鲤鱼王，对吗？\p但是有了好钓竿之后，
你可以钓到更多更强的宝可梦。$

label: FuchsiaCity_House2_Text_OhThatsDisappointing
source: Oh…\nThat's so disappointing…$

label: FuchsiaCity_House2_Text_HowAreTheFishBiting
source: Hello there, {PLAYER}!\pHow are the fish biting?$
translation: 你好，{PLAYER}！\p钓鱼钓得怎么样啦？$

label: FuchsiaCity_House2_Text_YouHaveNoRoomForGift
source: Oh, no!\pI had a gift for you, but you have\nno room for it!$
translation: 喔不，\p我有一个礼物要给你，\n但是你背包放不下了了！$

label: FuchsiaCity_House3_Text_WouldYouLikeToForgetMove
source: Uh…\nOh, yes, I'm the MOVE DELETER.\pI can make POKéMON forget their\nmoves.\pWould you like me to do that?$
translation: 呃......我想说什么来着？\n我想起来了，我就是遗忘大师。\p我能让宝可梦忘记\n它们学会的技能。\p你需要我展示一下这门绝活吗？$

label: FuchsiaCity_House3_Text_WhichMonShouldForgetMove
source: Which POKéMON should forget a\nmove?$
translation: 哪一只宝可梦想要\n忘记技能？$

label: FuchsiaCity_House3_Text_WhichMoveShouldBeForgotten
source: Which move should be forgotten?$
translation: 要忘记哪个技能？$

label: FuchsiaCity_House3_Text_MonOnlyKnowsOneMove
source: {STR_VAR_1} seems to know only one\nmove…$
translation: {STR_VAR_1}好像只会\n一个技能......$

label: FuchsiaCity_House3_Text_MonsMoveShouldBeForgotten
source: Hm! {STR_VAR_1}'s {STR_VAR_2}?\nThat move should be forgotten?$
translation: 嗯！{STR_VAR_1}的{STR_VAR_2}吗？\n要忘记这个技能？$

label: FuchsiaCity_House3_Text_MonHasForgottenMoveCompletely
source: It worked to perfection!\p{STR_VAR_1} has forgotten\n{STR_VAR_2} completely.$
translation: 完美搞定！\p{STR_VAR_1}已经将\n{STR_VAR_2}忘得一干二净了。$

label: FuchsiaCity_House3_Text_ComeAgainToForgetOtherMoves
source: Come again if there are other\nmoves to be forgotten.$
translation: 如果你有别的技能想要忘记\n那么欢迎再次光临。$

label: FuchsiaCity_House3_Text_NoEggShouldKnowMoves
source: What?\nNo EGG should know any moves.$
translation: 你在想什么？\n蛋怎么可能会学技能。$

label: FuchsiaCity_Mart_Text_DontTheyHaveSafariZonePennants
source: Don't they have any pennants\npromoting the SAFARI ZONE?\pHow about some paper lanterns?\nAren't there even any calendars?$
translation: 野生原野区是不是应该弄些\n宣传标识啊\p比方说纸灯笼之类的\n他们没有考虑过吗$

label: FuchsiaCity_Mart_Text_DidYouTryXSpeed
source: Did you try X SPEED?\nIt speeds up a POKéMON in battle.$
translation: 你用过速度强化了吗？\n它能使你宝可梦在战斗中的速度提升。$

label: FuchsiaCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_CantBecomeGoodTrainerWithOneMon
source: You can't become a good TRAINER\nwith just one strong POKéMON.\pBut raising many POKéMON evenly\nis no easy task, either.$
translation: 只训练厉害的宝可梦\n你永远成为不了强大的训练家\p但是训练许多宝可梦\n也不是一件轻松的事。$

label: FuchsiaCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_PokemonLeagueWestOfViridian
source: There's a narrow trail west of\nVIRIDIAN CITY.\pIt goes to the POKéMON LEAGUE HQ.\nThe HQ governs all TRAINERS.$
translation: 常青市西边\n有一条小道，\p通向宝可梦联盟总部。\n总部统管所有的训练家。$

label: FuchsiaCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_VisitSafariZoneForPokedex
source: If you're working on a POKéDEX,\nvisit the SAFARI ZONE.\pAll sorts of rare POKéMON breed\nthere.$
translation: 如果你在制作宝可梦图鉴，\n去野生原野区看看吧。\p所有稀有的宝可梦\n都被饲养在那里。$

label: FuchsiaCity_SafariZone_Entrance_Text_WelcomeToSafariZone
source: Welcome to the SAFARI ZONE!$
translation: 欢迎来到野生原野区！$

label: FuchsiaCity_SafariZone_Entrance_Text_PlaySafariGameFor500
source: For just ¥500, you can play the\nSAFARI GAME.\pYou can roam the wide-open safari\nand catch what you like.\pWould you like to play?$
translation: 只要500，\n你就能参加原野区游戏。\p你可以在开阔的原野区里\n任意收服你想要的宝可梦。\p想试试吗？$

label: FuchsiaCity_SafariZone_Entrance_Text_ThatllBe500WeOnlyUseSpecialBalls
source: That'll be ¥500, please!\pWe only use a special kind of \nPOKé BALLS here.$
translation: 收您500！\p在我们这里只能使用\n一种特殊的精灵球。$

label: FuchsiaCity_SafariZone_Entrance_Text_PlayerReceived30SafariBalls
source: {PLAYER} received 30 SAFARI BALLS\nfrom the attendant.$
translation: {PLAYER}从服务员那里\n获得了30个原野球。$

label: FuchsiaCity_SafariZone_Entrance_Text_CallYouOnPAWhenYouRunOut
source: We'll call you on the PA when you\nrun out of time or SAFARI BALLS.\pWell, I'll wish you the best of\nluck!$
translation: 如果时间到了或者你的原野球用完了，\n我们会通过广播告诉你。\p好了，祝你好运啦！$

label: FuchsiaCity_SafariZone_Entrance_Text_OkayPleaseComeAgain
source: Okay.\nPlease come again!$
translation: 好的。\n欢迎下次再来！$

label: FuchsiaCity_SafariZone_Entrance_Text_OopsNotEnoughMoney
source: Oops!\nNot enough money!$
translation: 哎哟！\n您的钱不够！$

label: FuchsiaCity_SafariZone_Entrance_Text_GoingToLeaveSafariZoneEarly
source: Are you going to leave the\nSAFARI ZONE early?$
translation: 您想提前离开野生原野区吗？$

label: FuchsiaCity_SafariZone_Entrance_Text_PleaseReturnSafariBalls
source: Please return any SAFARI BALLS\nyou may have left.$
translation: 请交还您剩余的原野球。$

label: FuchsiaCity_SafariZone_Entrance_Text_GoodLuck
source: Good luck!$
translation: 祝您好运！$

label: FuchsiaCity_SafariZone_Entrance_Text_CatchFairShareComeAgain
source: Did you catch your fair share?\nCome again!$
translation: 您收服的够回本了吗？\n欢迎下次再来！$

label: FuchsiaCity_SafariZone_Entrance_Text_FirstTimeAtSafariZone
source: Hi! Is it your first time here at\nthe SAFARI ZONE?$
translation: 嗨！这是你\n第一次来野生原野区吗？$

label: FuchsiaCity_SafariZone_Entrance_Text_ExplainSafariZone
source:
The SAFARI ZONE actually has
four zones in it.\pEach zone has different kinds of
POKéMON, even some rare ones.\pUse the supplied SAFARI BALLS to
catch them.\pYou can also throw BAIT or ROCKS
besides the SAFARI BALLS.\pIf you throw BAIT, the POKéMON
becomes less likely to flee, but\lharder to catch.\pIf you throw ROCKS, the POKéMON
becomes more likely to flee, but\leasier to catch.\pWhen you run out of time or SAFARI
BALLS, it's game over for you!$
translation:
野生原野区里实际上分为四块区域。\p每个区域都有不同的宝可梦，
很稀有的宝可梦也藏匿其中。\p用给你的原野球去收服它们吧。\p除了向它们扔原野球，
你也可以投掷饵料或者石头。\p如果你投掷饵料，
宝可梦不易逃走，\l不过会更难收服。\p如果你投掷石头，
宝可梦更易逃走，\l但是会更好收服。\p如果时间到了或者原野球用完了，
原野区游戏也就结束了！$

label: FuchsiaCity_SafariZone_Entrance_Text_SorryYoureARegularHere
source: Sorry, you're a regular here!$
translation: 对不起，在这儿你得好好守规矩！$

label: FuchsiaCity_SafariZone_Office_Text_NicknamedWardenSlowpoke
source: We nicknamed the WARDEN\n“SLOWPOKE.”\pYou know, he has that vacant look\nlike a SLOWPOKE.$
translation: 我们给园长起了个外号叫\n"呆呆兽"。\p你想象一下，他发起呆来的样子，\n像极了一只呆呆兽。$

label: FuchsiaCity_SafariZone_Office_Text_WardenIsVeryKnowledgeable
source: WARDEN SLOWPOKE is very\nknowledgeable about POKéMON.\pHe even has some fossils of rare,\nextinct POKéMON.$
translation: 呆呆兽园长对\n宝可梦非常了解。\p他甚至还收藏了那些灭绝了的\n珍贵的宝可梦的化石。$

label: FuchsiaCity_SafariZone_Office_Text_CouldntUnderstandWarden
source: WARDEN SLOWPOKE came in, but\nI couldn't understand him.\pI think he's got a speech problem!$
translation: 呆呆兽园长来了这儿一趟，\n但是我完全听不懂他在说什么。\p我觉得他的语言神经出了毛病！$

label: FuchsiaCity_SafariZone_Office_Text_PrizeInSafariZone
source:
WARDEN SLOWPOKE is running a
promotion campaign right now.\pTry to get to the farthest corner
of the SAFARI ZONE.\pIf you can make it, you'll win a
very convenient prize.$
translation:
呆呆兽园长正在举办
一场宣传活动。\p努力向野生原野区
最深处进发。\p如果你能抵达终点，
你没准会得到一件非常棒的奖品哦。$

label: FuchsiaCity_WardensHouse_Text_HifFuffHefifoo
source: WARDEN: Hif fuff hefifoo!\pHa lof ha feef ee hafahi ho.\nHeff hee fwee!$
translation: 园长：哇伊嘿咻乎嘿\p乎哈希嘻嘿哇！\n哈希嘻呼！$

label: FuchsiaCity_WardensHouse_Text_AhHowheeHoHoo
source: Ah howhee ho hoo!\nEef ee hafahi ho!$
translation: 啊活货嚯惑伙！\n诶夫咦嘿嗨活！$

label: FuchsiaCity_WardensHouse_Text_HeOhayHeHaHoo
source: Ha?\nHe ohay heh ha hoo ee haheh!$
translation: 哈？\n他呵哈呵呵呵呵呵哈哈哈！$

label: FuchsiaCity_WardensHouse_Text_GaveGoldTeethToWarden
source: {PLAYER} gave the GOLD TEETH\nto the WARDEN.$
translation: {PLAYER}将金假牙\n交给了园长。$

label: FuchsiaCity_WardensHouse_Text_WardenPoppedInHisTeeth
source: The WARDEN popped in his teeth!$
translation: 园长戴上了他的假牙！$

label: FuchsiaCity_WardensHouse_Text_ThanksSonGiveYouSomething
source:
WARDEN: Thanks, son!
You're a real lifesaver!\pNo one could understand a word
that I said, not a one!\pI was too ashamed to show my face
around the OFFICE, even.\pLet me give you something for your
trouble.$
translation:
园长：谢谢你，小朋友！
你真是我的救命恩人！\p所有人都听不懂我说的话，
一个都没有！\p我甚至都没脸去
见我的那些员工了。\p让我给你点东西
做为感谢吧。$

label: FuchsiaCity_WardensHouse_Text_ThanksLassieGiveYouSomething
source:
WARDEN: Thank you, lassie!
You're a real lifesaver!\pNo one could understand a word
that I said, not a one!\pI was too ashamed to show my face
around the OFFICE, even.\pLet me give you something for your
trouble.$
translation:
园长：谢谢你，小姑娘！
你真是我的救命恩人！\p没有任何人听得懂我说的话，
我是说，一个也没有！\p我甚至都没脸去
见我的那些员工了。\p让我给你点东西
做为感谢吧。$

label: FuchsiaCity_WardensHouse_Text_ReceivedHM04FromWarden
source: {PLAYER} received HM04\nfrom the WARDEN.$
translation: {PLAYER}从园长那里\n得到了HM04。$

label: FuchsiaCity_WardensHouse_Text_ExplainStrength
source:
WARDEN: Inside HM04 you'll find
STRENGTH.\pIt lets POKéMON move boulders when
you're outside of battle.\pOh yes, did you find the SECRET
HOUSE in the SAFARI ZONE?$
translation:
园长：通过HM04可以
学会怪力。\p能让你在战斗以外的时候
用宝可梦推动大石头。\p喔，对了你找到野生原野区
里的神秘小屋了吗？$

label: FuchsiaCity_WardensHouse_Text_MonPhotosFossilsOnDisplay
source: POKéMON photos and fossils are on\ndisplay.$
translation: 宝可梦的照片和化石\n被陈列着。$

label: FuchsiaCity_WardensHouse_Text_OldMonMerchandiseOnDisplay
source: Old POKéMON merchandise is on\ndisplay.$
translation: 陈列着古代宝可梦\n货物。$

label: GraniteCave_1F_Text_GetsDarkAheadHereYouGo
source:
Hey, you.
It gets awfully dark ahead.\lIt'll be tough trying to explore.\pThat guy who came by earlier…
STEVEN, I think it was.\pHe knew how to use FLASH, so he ought
to be all right, but…\pWell, for us HIKERS, helping out those
that we meet is our motto.\pHere you go, I'll pass this on to you.$
translation:
喂，那边的。
前面黑得可怕，\l继续探索下去会很危险。\p先前有个人来过......
我想应该是大吾。\p他会使用闪光，
所以应该没事，可是......\p唔，对于我们登山男而言，帮助他人
解决困难是我们的座右铭。\p给，这个送你了。$

label: GraniteCave_1F_Text_ExplainFlash
source:
Teach that hidden move FLASH to
a POKéMON and use it.\pIt lights up even the inky darkness
of caves.\pBut, to use it, you need the GYM BADGE
from DEWFORD's POKéMON GYM.$
translation:
把闪光招式教给宝可梦，
使用的时候，\p就能够照亮
漆黑的山洞。\p但你必须先去武斗镇的宝可梦道馆
取得道馆徽章。$

label: GraniteCave_StevensRoom_Text_ImStevenLetterForMe
source: My name is STEVEN.\pI'm interested in rare stones,\nso I travel here and there.\pOh?\nA LETTER for me?$
translation: 我的名字是大吾。\p我对稀有的石头很有兴趣，\n所有经常四处旅行。\p哦？\n有给我的信？$

label: GraniteCave_StevensRoom_Text_ThankYouTakeThis
source:
STEVEN: Okay, thank you.\pYou went through all this trouble to
deliver that. I need to thank you.\pLet me see…
I'll give you this TM.\pIt contains my favorite move,
STEEL WING.$
translation:
大吾：嗯，谢谢你。\p特意专程送信过来，
要好好答谢你才行。\p我想想......
这个招式学习器给你吧。\p里面有我最爱的招式
钢翼。$

label: GraniteCave_StevensRoom_Text_CouldBecomeChampionLetsRegister
source:
STEVEN: Your POKéMON appear quite
capable.\pIf you keep training, you could even
become the CHAMPION of the POKéMON\lLEAGUE one day. That's what I think.\pI know, since we've gotten to know each
other, let's register one another in\lour POKéNAVS.\p… … … … … …$
translation:
大吾：你的宝可梦看起来
培养得很不错。\p继续努力的话，也许有一天能
成为宝可梦联盟的冠军呢。\l我是这么想的喔。\p对了！既然有缘相识，
就在宝可导航里\l互相登录一下吧。\p...... ...... ......$

label: GraniteCave_StevensRoom_Text_RegisteredSteven
source: Registered STEVEN\nin the POKéNAV.$
translation: 把大吾\n登记到宝可导航里了。$

label: GraniteCave_StevensRoom_Text_IveGotToHurryAlong
source: Now, I've got to hurry along.$
translation: 好了，那我先走一步了。$

label: GraniteCave_StevensRoom_Text_OhBagIsFull
source: Oh, your BAG is full…\nThat's too bad, then.$
translation: 喔，你的包满了......\n真可惜呢。$

label: IndigoPlateau_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_GymGuyAdvice
source:
Yo!
Champ in the making!\pAt the POKéMON LEAGUE, you will
face the ELITE FOUR all in a row.\pIf you lose, you have to start all
over again!\pThis is it!
Go for it!$
translation:
哟！
未来的冠军\p在宝可梦联盟，
你将会面临四天王的车轮战\p如果你输了，
一切都得从头来！\p事实就是这样了！
加油！$

label: IndigoPlateau_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_FaceEliteFourGoodLuck
source: From here on, you face the\nELITE FOUR one by one.\pIf you win, a door opens to the\nnext TRAINER. Good luck!$
translation: 从现在开始，你得接连不断的与\n四天王战斗。\p如果你赢了，通往下一位\n天王的门会为你打开，祝你好运！$

label: IndigoPlateau_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_LoreleiIsAbsentClosedForTimeBeing
source:
I am so sorry, but you've wasted
your time coming here.\pLORELEI of the ELITE FOUR is
absent, you see.\pAs a result, the POKéMON LEAGUE is
closed for the time being.$
translation:
耽误了您过来的时间，
我们感到很抱歉。\p如您所见，
四天王中的科拿小姐有事出去了。\p所以，宝可梦联盟
在她回来之前都无法开放。$

label: IndigoPlateau_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_AgathaWhuppedUs
source:
AGATHA's GHOST-type POKéMON are
horrifically terrifying in toughness.\pI took my FIGHTING-type POKéMON
and raised them to the max.\pI went at AGATHA feeling pretty
confident, but she whupped us.\pThat old lady's also got a really
short fuse, too.\pIt doesn't take anything to get
that scary lady hollering.$
translation:
菊子的幽灵属性宝可梦真的
强大得恐怖。\p我曾经把我格斗属性的宝可梦
训练到了一个极限。\p见到菊子之前我都感觉很轻松
但是后来发生的事实是残酷的。\p那个老太太的脾气
也不太好。\p我可没有说那个老太太
什么坏话啊！$

label: IndigoPlateau_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_LancesCousinGymLeaderFarAway
source: Maybe becoming an ELITE FOUR\nmember is in the blood.\pFrom what I've heard, LANCE has\na cousin who's a GYM LEADER\lsomewhere far away.$
translation: 也许四天王\n和其他人有点血缘关系。\p我曾经听说过，\n渡是一位离这里很远的\l道馆馆主的表哥。$

label: InsideOfTruck_Text_BoxPrintedWithMonLogo
source: The box is printed with a POKéMON logo.\pIt's a POKéMON brand moving and\ndelivery service.$
translation: 盒子上印着宝可梦的商标。\p这是宝可梦牌\n搬家服务。$

label: JaggedPass_Text_EricIntro
source: MT. CHIMNEY's JAGGED PASS…\pNow this is what I've always wanted\nin a mountain.\pThis jagged bumpiness…\nIt rocks my soul!$
translation: 烟囱山的凹凸山道......\p这正是我在每一座山中\n所渴望寻找到的东西。\p这凹凸不平的路面......\n震动着我的灵魂！$

label: JaggedPass_Text_EricDefeat
source: Losing left me bitter!$
translation: 失败让我痛苦！$

label: JaggedPass_Text_EricPostBattle
source: Yes, I did lose at POKéMON…\pBut, when it comes to the love of\nthe mountains, I have you beat!$
translation: 确实，在宝可梦的对战中我失败了......\p但说到对山的热爱\n我绝对不会输给你！$

label: JaggedPass_Text_DianaIntro
