source: Nobody understands the charm of\nBRAWLY…\pI don't care!\pEven if I'm the only one, I'm going\nto keep cheering for BRAWLY!$
translation: 没人了解藤树的\n迷人之处......\p我不在乎！\p就算只有我一个，\n我也要为藤树加油鼓劲！$

label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_MyFavoriteTrainerIsBrawly
source: Whatever anyone says, my favorite\nTRAINER is DEWFORD's GYM LEADER\lBRAWLY!$
translation: 无论别人怎么说，\n我最喜欢的训练家只有武斗镇的\l道馆馆主藤树！$

label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_YouveSurpassedYourFather
source: You've surpassed your own father in\nevery regard!\pI'm telling you, so there's no question\nabout it at all!$
translation: 你在方方面面都\n超过了你父亲！\p是我说的，\n所以这毫无疑问！$

label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_YourFatherNeverGaveUpSoKeepOnBattling
source: Even when things turned bleak,\nyour father never gave up.\pThis I know to be true.\pYou never give up even if you lose!\nSo keep on battling!$
translation: 即使遇到挫折，\n你的父亲也不会放弃，\p我相信这点。\p就算你输了，也不要气馁！\n坚持战斗下去！$

label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_LongWayToGoComparedToNorman
source:
NORMAN battled with more power,
charisma, and showmanship than you.\pEven though people may say that
you're strong…\pYou've still got a long way to go
compared to your father.$
translation:
尽管人们都说
你比较强，\p但千里的对战更有活力，
更有激情，更富于表现力......\p要赶上你父亲，
你还有很长的路要走。$

label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_YouAndNormanAreDifferent
source:
You're beginning to get the same
air of awe NORMAN exudes.\pBut there's something conclusively
different between you and NORMAN.\pI can't tell you what that is.
You'll have to find it yourself.$
translation:
你所散发出来的气息
和千里越发相似了，\p但你和千里之间
还有决定性的不同。\p我还不能告诉你这不同是什么，
你得自己去发掘。$

label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_WeDiscussStrongestTrainers
source:
Everyone here, we're all huge fans
of POKéMON battles.\pWe discuss who we consider to be
the strongest of all TRAINERS.\pIf you were to become famous,
we might even become your fans!$
translation:
这里的所有人都非常喜欢
宝可梦对战，\p我们互相讨论
所有训练家之中谁比较强。\p如果你出名了，我们也可能
成为你的粉丝！$

label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_OhWoweeItsPlayer
source: Oh, woweee! It's {PLAYER}!\nFor real, too!\pPlease, shake my hand, shake my hand!$
translation: 呀，哇啊！是{PLAYER}！\n是本人！\p跟我握握手吧，握握手吧！$

label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_AlwaysCheerForYou
source:
I'll always cheer for you, {PLAYER}!
Always, always!\pI don't want to see you lose ever,
{PLAYER}.\pBecause I know you're really,
really strong, {PLAYER}!$
translation:
我一直支持你，{PLAYER}！
一直都会！\p我不想看到你输掉，
{PLAYER}，\p因为我知道你真的
非常非常强，{PLAYER}！$

label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_EveryoneThinksTrainerIsCool
source: {STR_VAR_1} is really cool…\pEveryone thinks so, right, right?$
translation: {STR_VAR_1}真棒......\p大家都那么想的，是吗？$

label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_TrainerIsReallyCoolItsJustMe
source: {STR_VAR_1} really is cool, don't\nyou think so?\pEven if it's just me, I'm going to keep\ncheering my favorite TRAINER.$
translation: {STR_VAR_1}真的很棒，\n你说呢？\p就算只有我一个，\n我也要为最喜欢的训练家加油助威。$

label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_WishThereWasTrainerLikeThat
source: My favorite TRAINER is…\pCool…\pStrong…\pAnd really nice…\pI wish there was a TRAINER like that…$
translation: 我心目中的训练家是......\p沉着......\p强大......\p而且很友善......\p不知道是不是真的有这样的训练家......$

label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_WantToBeStrongLikeYou
source: Whoa! It's {PLAYER}!\nWicked!\pWhen I grow up, I want to be strong\nlike you, {PLAYER}!$
translation: 哇！是{PLAYER}！\n太棒了！\p我长大后也想变得\n像你那么强，{PLAYER}！$

label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_OnlyOneWhoCheersForYou
source: Even if I'm the only one…\pYou'll always be the only one\nI cheer for, {PLAYER}!\pBecause I believe in you, {PLAYER}!$
translation: 就算只有我一个......\p我也只会为你加油的，\n{PLAYER}！\p我相信你，{PLAYER}！$

label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_TrainerIsWickedlyCool
source: {STR_VAR_1} is so wickedly cool…\nI want to shake hands with my hero.$
translation: {STR_VAR_1}非常优秀......\n真想和我的英雄握一握手。$

label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_NeverGoingToStopBeingTrainersFan
source: Even if I'm the only one…\pI'm never going to stop being\n{STR_VAR_1}'s fan!\pBecause I've heard, {STR_VAR_1}\nnever loses!$
translation: 就算只有我一个......\p我也会是{STR_VAR_1}\n忠实的粉丝！\p我听说，{STR_VAR_1}\n从未输过！$

label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_YoureAmazingAfterAll
source: {PLAYER}!\nYou are amazing after all!\pEver since I set eyes on you,\nI knew that you were great.\pIt looks like my eyes didn't deceive me.$
translation: {PLAYER}！\n还是你最出色！\p我已看到你就知道\n你会是最棒的，\p我的眼光没错。$

label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_ImInYourCorner
source: Who cares about the others.\nI'm in your corner!\pYou don't need to worry. Just get\nout there and battle like always.$
translation: 我站在你这一边，\n谁去管别人呢！\p不用担心，\n你放心出去努力对战吧。$

label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_ThinkTrainerIsNumberOne
source:
You're a pretty decent TRAINER,
I think.\pBut I also think that {STR_VAR_1}
is number one right now.\pThat's just my opinion.
Don't worry about it too much.$
translation:
我想，
你是个非常优秀的训练家，\p但我觉得{STR_VAR_1}
现在是第一人。\p这只是我的想法，
别太在意。$

label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_YoureMaybeStrongerThanTrainer
source: Wow, you really are strong.\nMaybe even stronger than {STR_VAR_1}.\pBut {STR_VAR_1} needs me.\pIf I don't cheer for {STR_VAR_1},\nwho will?$
translation: 哇，你真的很强，\n也许比{STR_VAR_1}都强。\p但{STR_VAR_1}需要我。\p如果我都不支持{STR_VAR_1}，\n还有谁支持？$

label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_YouChangedMyMind
source: You've changed my mind!\nYou are strong, aren't you?\pI'd like you to tell me how you managed\nto get so strong!$
translation: 你让我改主意了！\n你真的很强，不是吗？\p告诉我你是怎么变得这么强的，\n好吗？$

label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_YouBattleAttractivelyInToughSituation
source: The tougher the situation, the more\nattractively you battle.\pI can't wait for your next battle!$
translation: 情况越严重，\n你的对战就越吸引人。\p我等不及想看你下一场对战了！$

label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_TrainerIsStandout
source: Among the recently hot TRAINERS,\n{STR_VAR_1} is the standout.\pThat toughness, it's simply not normal.\pYou're doing okay, but you're not in\nthe same class as {STR_VAR_1}.$
translation: 最近当红的训练家之中，\n{STR_VAR_1}最最突出，\p那种强大不是别人能做到的。\p你做得也不错，\n但你和{STR_VAR_1}不可同日而语。$

label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_NoOneCanKnockYouButTrainerStronger
source: You are really popular…\pYou're strong, and you're caring to\nPOKéMON. No one can knock you.\pBut, you know, I believe in {STR_VAR_1}.\p{STR_VAR_1} is definitely stronger!\nI'm positive!$
translation: 你现在真的很红......\p你很强大，对宝可梦\n无微不至，没人能打败你。\p但是，我还是相信{STR_VAR_1}。\p{STR_VAR_1}显然极强！\n我敢肯定！$

label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_YouImpressive
source: You…\pImpressive!$
translation: 你......\p不敢相信！$

label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_OnlyIRecognizeYourTrueWorth
source: Your true worth, it is fine if only\nI recognized it.\pThe others I doubt will understand\nthe hidden power that beats within.$
translation: 要是我早认识到\n你的能力多好。\p我怀疑其他人\n无法理解那内在的潜能。$

label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_HaventRealizedPotential
source: Yes, I see strength in your eyes.\pBut!\pYou still haven't realized your\npotential.$
translation: 是的，我在你眼中\n看到了力量，\p但是......\p你还未发掘出\n自己的潜力。$

label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_YourePowerfulButNotTrueStrength
source:
It is true that you are tremendously
powerful.\pBut!
I can tell…\pThat strength cannot be considered
true strength yet!\pTrue strength is…!
… …\pActually, I have no idea, either.$
translation:
毫无疑问，
你非常强大。\p但是我可以说......\p那力量还未成为
真正的实力！\p真正的实力是......
......\p实际上，我也不知道。$

label: LittlerootTown_Text_OurNewHomeLetsGoInside
source:
MOM: {PLAYER}, we're here, honey!\pIt must be tiring riding with our things
in the moving truck.\pWell, this is LITTLEROOT TOWN.\pHow do you like it?
This is our new home!\pIt has a quaint feel, but it seems to be
an easy place to live, don't you think?\pAnd, you get your own room, {PLAYER}!
Let's go inside.$
translation:
妈妈：{PLAYER}，我们到了，宝贝！\p跟我们的行李一起待在
搬家卡车里一定累了吧？\p这里就是未白镇了。\p喜欢吗？
这是我们的新家！\p虽然看起来有些古旧，
但你不觉得住起来应该很舒适吗？\p而且这次你也有自己的房间了，
{PLAYER}！快进来看看吧。$

label: LittlerootTown_Text_WaitPlayer
source: MOM: Wait, {PLAYER}!$
translation: 妈妈：等等，{PLAYER}！$

label: LittlerootTown_Text_WearTheseRunningShoes
source:
MOM: {PLAYER}! {PLAYER}! Did you
introduce yourself to PROF. BIRCH?\pOh! What an adorable POKéMON!
You got it from PROF. BIRCH. How nice!\pYou're your father's child, all right.
You look good together with POKéMON!\pHere, honey! If you're going out on an
adventure, wear these RUNNING SHOES.\pThey'll put a zip in your step!$
translation:
妈妈：{PLAYER}！{PLAYER}！
你跟小田卷博士打过招呼了吗？\p哇，好可爱的宝可梦！
是小田卷博士给你的吧？真不错！\p果然是爸爸的孩子，
和宝可梦很合得来嘛！\p来，宝贝！你要出去旅行的话，
换上这双跑步鞋吧，\p可以让你跑得很快的！$

label: LittlerootTown_Text_SwitchShoesWithRunningShoes
source: {PLAYER} switched shoes with the\nRUNNING SHOES.$
translation: {PLAYER}换上了\n跑步鞋。$

label: LittlerootTown_Text_ExplainRunningShoes
source:
MOM: {PLAYER}, those shoes came with
instructions.\p“Press the B Button while wearing these
RUNNING SHOES to run extra-fast!\p“Slip on these RUNNING SHOES and race
in the great outdoors!”$
translation:
妈妈：{PLAYER}，
这是这双鞋的说明：\p"穿着跑步鞋时，
按B键可以跑得更快！\p穿上跑步鞋，
在野外尽情奔跑吧！"$

label: LittlerootTown_Text_ComeHomeIfAnythingHappens
source:
… … … … … … … …
… … … … … … … …\pTo think that you have your very own
POKéMON now…\lYour father will be overjoyed.\p…But please be careful.
If anything happens, you can come home.\pGo on, go get them, honey!$
translation:
...... ...... ...... ......
...... ...... ...... ......\p要是知道你有了
自己的宝可梦......\l爸爸也一定会很高兴的。\p......但是，路上小心，无论发生了什么，
家门永远为你敞开着。\p去吧，向着自己的目标努力吧，
宝贝！$

label: LittlerootTown_Text_CanUsePCToStoreItems
source: If you use a PC, you can store items\nand POKéMON.\pThe power of science is staggering!$
translation: 打开电脑就可以存取\n道具和宝可梦了。\p科学的力量真伟大！$

label: LittlerootTown_Text_BirchSpendsDaysInLab
source: PROF. BIRCH spends days in his LAB\nstudying, then he'll suddenly go out in\lthe wild to do more research…\pWhen does PROF. BIRCH spend time\nat home?$
translation: 小田卷博士整天都泡在研究所里\n做研究，然后又会突然跑到野外\l去实地调查......\p他到底什么时候能在\n家里待上几天呢？$

label: LittlerootTown_Text_IfYouGoInGrassPokemonWillJumpOut
source: Um, um, um!\pIf you go outside and go in the grass,\nwild POKéMON will jump out!$
translation: 呃，呃，呃！\p如果走到野外的草丛里，\n野生的宝可梦可能会跳出来袭击的！$

label: LittlerootTown_Text_DangerousIfYouDontHavePokemon
source: It's dangerous if you don't have\nyour own POKéMON.$
translation: 如果没有自己的宝可梦的话，\n可是很危险的！$

label: LittlerootTown_Text_CanYouGoSeeWhatsHappening
source:
Um, hi!\pThere are scary POKéMON outside!
I can hear their cries!\pI want to go see what's going on,
but I don't have any POKéMON…\pCan you go see what's happening
for me?$
translation: 呃，你好！\p外面有可怕的宝可梦！\n我都听到它们的叫声了！\p我好想去看看到底怎么了，\n但是我没有宝可梦......\p能帮我去看看情况吗？$

label: LittlerootTown_Text_YouSavedBirch
source: You saved PROF. BIRCH!\nI'm so glad!$
translation: 你救了小田卷博士！\n太好了！$

label: LittlerootTown_Text_GoodLuckCatchingPokemon
source: Are you going to catch POKéMON?\nGood luck!$
translation: 你要去捕捉宝可梦？\n祝你好运！$

label: LittlerootTown_Text_TownSign
source: LITTLEROOT TOWN\n“A town that can't be shaded any hue.”$
translation: 这里是未白镇。\n"未能被任何颜色染上的城镇。"$

label: LittlerootTown_Text_ProfBirchsLab
source: PROF. BIRCH'S POKéMON LAB$
translation: 小田卷博士的宝可梦研究所$

label: LittlerootTown_Text_PlayersHouse
source: {PLAYER}'s HOUSE$
translation: {PLAYER}的家$

label: LittlerootTown_Text_ProfBirchsHouse
source: PROF. BIRCH'S HOUSE$
translation: 小田卷博士的家$

label: LittlerootTown_Text_BirchSomethingToShowYouAtLab
source:
PROF. BIRCH: Well, well, {PLAYER}{KUN}!
That was good work out there!\pI knew there was something special
about you when I first saw you,\lbut I never expected this.\pOh, yes. Do you still have the POKéDEX
I gave you?\pI have something to show you.
Let's go to my LAB.$
translation:
小田卷博士：{PLAYER}{KUN}！
果然没有看错你！\p第一次见面我就
知道你不简单，\l但我从未想到你能做得这么好。\p对了，你还带着我给
你的宝可梦图鉴吗？\p我有些东西要给你看，
跟我回研究所吧！$

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_IsntItNiceInHere
source: MOM: See, {PLAYER}?\nIsn't it nice in here, too?$
translation: 妈妈：怎么样，{PLAYER}？\n家里也很不错吧？$

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_MoversPokemonGoSetClock
source:
The mover's POKéMON do all the work
of moving us in and cleaning up after.\lThis is so convenient!\p{PLAYER}, your room is upstairs.
Go check it out, dear!\pDAD bought you a new clock to mark
our move here.\lDon't forget to set it!$
translation:
搬家公司的宝可梦帮我们把东西
都搬进来，并且整理打扫好了。\l真是太方便了！\p{PLAYER}，你的房间在楼上，
去看看吧，宝贝！\p爸爸特意买了新的时钟
来庆祝我们搬家。\l记得调好时间哦！$

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_ArentYouInterestedInRoom
source: MOM: Well, {PLAYER}?\pAren't you interested in seeing your\nvery own room?$
translation: 妈妈：怎么了，{PLAYER}？\p不去看看自己的\n新房间吗？$

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_GoSetTheClock
source: MOM: {PLAYER}.\pGo set the clock in your room, honey.$
translation: 妈妈：{PLAYER}，\p记得先去房间调好时钟哦。$

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_OhComeQuickly
source: MOM: Oh! {PLAYER}, {PLAYER}!\nQuick! Come quickly!$
translation: 妈妈：......啊！{PLAYER}，{PLAYER}！\n快过来看！$

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_MaybeDadWillBeOn
source: MOM: Look! It's PETALBURG GYM!\nMaybe DAD will be on!$
translation: 妈妈：橙华市道馆上电视了！\n说不定能看到你爸爸！$

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_ItsOverWeMissedHim
source: MOM: Oh… It's over.\pI think DAD was on, but we missed him.\nToo bad.$
translation: 妈妈：哎呀......节目结束了。\p刚才爸爸好像出镜了呢，\n可惜我们错过了。$

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_GoIntroduceYourselfNextDoor
source: Oh, yes.\nOne of DAD's friends lives in town.\pPROF. BIRCH is his name.\pHe lives right next door, so you should\ngo over and introduce yourself.$
translation: 对了，\n爸爸的朋友也住在镇上，\p他叫小田卷博士。\p家就住在隔壁，\n记得去打个招呼哦！$

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_SeeYouHoney
source: MOM: See you, honey!$
translation: 妈妈：再见，宝贝！$

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_DidYouMeetProfBirch
source: MOM: Did you introduce yourself to\nPROF. BIRCH?$
translation: 妈妈：拜访过小田卷博士了吗？$

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_YouShouldRestABit
source: MOM: How are you doing, {PLAYER}?\nYou look a little tired.\pI think you should rest a bit.$
translation: 妈妈：怎么样了，{PLAYER}？\n你好像有点累了，\p在家休息一下吧。$

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_TakeCareHoney
source: MOM: Take care, honey!$
translation: 妈妈：路上小心，宝贝！$

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_GotDadsBadgeHeresSomethingFromMom
source: MOM: Oh? Did DAD give you that BADGE?\pThen here's something from your MOM!$
translation: 妈妈：哎呀，\n那是爸爸给你的徽章吗？\p那么妈妈也要给你礼物！$

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_DontPushYourselfTooHard
source: Don't push yourself too hard, dear.\nYou can always come home.\pGo for it, honey!$
translation: 别太勉强自己，宝贝，\n累了的话就回家来歇歇。\p加油吧！$

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_IsThatAPokenav
source: MOM: What is that, honey? A POKéNAV?\nSomeone from DEVON gave it to you?\pWell, honey, how about registering\nyour mom?\p… … …$
translation: 妈妈：这是什么，宝贝？宝可导航？\n得文公司的人送你的吗？\p那不如把妈妈也\n登记一下吧？\p...... ......$

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_RegisteredMom
source: Registered MOM\nin the POKéNAV.$
translation: 把妈妈\n登记到宝可导航里了。$

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_Vigoroth1
source: Fugiiiiih!$

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_Vigoroth2
source: Huggoh, uggo uggo…$
translation: 呼咕，呜咕呜咕......$

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_ReportFromPetalburgGym
source: INTERVIEWER: …We brought you this\nreport from in front of PETALBURG GYM.$
translation: 记者：......以上就是我们在橙华市道馆\n为您带来的现场报道。$

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_TheresAMovieOnTV
source: There is a movie on TV.\pTwo men are dancing on a big piano\nkeyboard.\pBetter get going!$
translation: 电视正在播放电影。\p两个人在巨大的\n琴键上跳舞。\p该走了！$

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_RunningShoesManual
source:
It's the instruction booklet for the
RUNNING SHOES.\p“Press the B Button to run while
wearing your RUNNING SHOES.\p“Lace up your RUNNING SHOES and hit
the road running!”$
translation:
这是跑步鞋的
使用说明书。\p"穿上跑步鞋，
按B键即可奔跑。\p系好鞋带，
尽情奔跑吧！"$

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_TicketFromBrineyCameForYou
source:
DAD: Hm?\pHey, it's {PLAYER}!\pIt's been a while since I saw you,
but you look…stronger, somehow.\pThat's the impression I get.
But your old man hasn't given up yet!\pOh, yes, I have something for you.
This came to you from someone named\lMR. BRINEY.$
translation:
爸爸：嗯？\p哟，{PLAYER}！\p有段时间没见了，
不过你看起来......变强了呢。\p至少我是这么觉得的，
不过爸爸可还没认输呢！\p啊，对了，有东西要给你，
这是一个叫哈奇的人寄过来的。$

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_PortsInSlateportLilycove
source: DAD: Hm, a TICKET for a ferry?\pIf I recall, there are ferry ports in\nSLATEPORT and LILYCOVE.$
translation: 爸爸：唔，乘坐渡轮的船票？\p我记得凯那市和水静市\n都有渡轮码头。$

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_BetterGetBackToGym
source: I'd better get back to PETALBURG GYM.\pMOM, thanks for looking after the house\nwhile I'm away.$
translation: 我该回橙华市道馆去了。\p孩子妈，谢谢你在我不在的\n时候照顾家里。$

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_DadShouldStayLonger
source: MOM: That DAD of yours…\pHe comes home for the first time in a\nwhile, but all he talks about is POKéMON.\pHe should relax and stay a little longer.$
translation: 妈妈：你那个爸爸啊......\p好不容易回趟家，\n张口闭口都是宝可梦。\p他应该多待几天\n好好歇一歇的。$

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_IsThatABreakingStory
source: MOM: Is that a breaking news story?$
translation: 妈妈：是突发新闻吗？$

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_LatiEmergencyNewsFlash
source:
We bring you this emergency
news flash!\pIn various HOENN locales, there have
been reports of a BZZT…colored\lPOKéMON in flight.\pThe identity of this POKéMON is
currently unknown.\pWe now return you to the regular
movie program.$
translation:
紧急插播
一条快讯！\p丰缘地区多处地点有目击报告称空中
有--嗡沙沙--色的宝可梦飞过，\p现在这只宝可梦
身份依然不明。\p下面继续播放
正常节目。$

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_WhatColorDidTheySay
source: MOM: {PLAYER}, did you catch that?\pWhat color did the announcer say\nthat POKéMON was?$
translation: 妈妈：{PLAYER}，你听到了吗？\p刚才新闻里说的\n宝可梦是什么颜色的？$

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_StillUnknownPokemon
source: MOM: Well, isn't that something!\nThere are still unknown POKéMON.$
translation: 妈妈：哎呀，这可真稀奇！\n居然还有未知的宝可梦呢！$

label: PlayersHouse_2F_Text_ClockIsStopped
source: The clock is stopped…\pBetter set it and start it!$
translation: 时钟停着......\p把时间调好吧！$

label: PlayersHouse_2F_Text_HowDoYouLikeYourRoom
source:
MOM: {PLAYER}, how do you like your
new room?\pGood! Everything's put away neatly!\pThey finished moving everything in
downstairs, too.\pPOKéMON movers are so convenient!\pOh, you should make sure that
everything's all there on your desk.$
translation:
妈妈：{PLAYER}，喜欢你的
新房间吗？\p太好了！房间收拾得很整洁呢！\p楼下的行李也都
整理完毕了。\p宝可梦搬家服务真方便啊！\p对了，记得检查一下你桌子上
的东西是不是都齐了。$

label: PlayersHouse_2F_Text_Notebook
source: {PLAYER} flipped open the notebook.\pADVENTURE RULE NO. 1\nOpen the MENU with START.\pADVENTURE RULE NO. 2\nRecord your progress with SAVE.\pThe remaining pages are blank…$
translation: {PLAYER}翻开笔记。\p冒险须知第一条\n用START键打开菜单。\p冒险须知第二条\n记录选项可以写下记录。\p后面是空白......$

label: Common_Text_LookCloserAtMap
source: {PLAYER} took a closer look at the\n{REGION} region map.$
translation: {PLAYER}仔细察看\n{REGION}地区的地图。$

label: PlayersHouse_2F_Text_ItsAGameCube
source: It's a Nintendo GameCube.\pA Game Boy Advance is connected to\nserve as the Controller.$
translation: 这是NGC。\p上面连着个GBA\n当做手柄。$

label: RivalsHouse_1F_Text_OhYoureTheNewNeighbor
source:
Oh, hello. And you are?\p… … … … … … … … …
… … … … … … … … …\pOh, you're {PLAYER}{KUN}, our new next-door
neighbor! Hi!\pWe have a {STR_VAR_1} about the same
age as you.\pOur {STR_VAR_1} was excited about making
a new friend.\pOur {STR_VAR_1} is upstairs, I think.$
translation:
哎，你好，你是？\p...... ...... ...... ...... ......
...... ...... ...... ...... ......\p啊，你是隔壁的邻居
{PLAYER}{KUN}吧！你好！\p我家的{STR_VAR_1}
也和你差不多大。\p我们{STR_VAR_1}特别喜欢
交朋友，\p现在{STR_VAR_1}应该在楼上吧。$

label: RivalsHouse_1F_Text_LikeChildLikeFather
source: Like child, like father.\pMy husband is as wild about POKéMON\nas our child.\pIf he's not at his LAB, he's likely\nscrabbling about in grassy places.$
translation: 老公和孩子一个样。\p丈夫也和孩子似的\n疯狂地喜欢宝可梦。\p要是老公不在他的研究所里，\n那他肯定在野外的草丛里找什么东西。$

label: RivalsHouse_1F_Text_TooBusyToNoticeVisit
source: That {RIVAL}!\pI guess our child is too busy with\nPOKéMON to notice that you came\lto visit, {PLAYER}{KUN}.$
translation: 这个{RIVAL}！\p我想我家孩子现在\n满脑子都是宝可梦，\l没注意到你来了，{PLAYER}{KUN}。$

label: RivalsHouse_1F_Text_WentOutToRoute103
source: Oh, {RIVAL} went out to ROUTE 103\njust a little while ago.\pLike father, like child.\n{RIVAL} can't stay quietly at home.$
translation: 啊，{RIVAL}刚刚\n去了103号道路。\p孩子和老公一个样，\n{RIVAL}也在家里呆不住。$

label: RivalsHouse_1F_Text_ShouldGoHomeEverySoOften
source:
I think it's wonderful for people to
travel with POKéMON.\pBut you should go home every so often
to let your mother know you're okay.\pShe might not say it, but I'm sure she
worries about you, {PLAYER}{KUN}.$
translation:
我想，和宝可梦
一起旅行感觉一定不错，\p但你也得经常回家一趟
让你妈妈看看你怎么样了。\p她虽然不说，但肯定很担心你，
{PLAYER}{KUN}。$

label: RivalsHouse_1F_Text_DoYouHavePokemon
source: Hi, neighbor!\pDo you already have your\nown POKéMON?$
translation: 嗨，邻居！\p你已经有自己的\n宝可梦了吗？$

label: RivalsHouse_2F_Text_MayGettingReady
source: POKéMON fully restored!\nItems ready, and…$
translation: 宝可梦的体力完全回复了......\n道具也都准备好了，还有......$

label: RivalsHouse_2F_Text_BrendanGettingReady
source: POKéMON fully restored…\nItems all packed, and…$
translation: 宝可梦的体力完全回复了......\n道具也都打包好了，还有......$

label: RivalsHouse_2F_Text_ItsRivalsPokeBall
source: It's {RIVAL}'s POKé BALL!\pBetter leave it right where it is.$
translation: 是{RIVAL}的精灵球！\p最好不要乱动。$

label: RivalsHouse_2F_Text_MayJustCheckingMyPokedex
source:
MAY: {PLAYER}{KUN}!\pI was just checking my POKéDEX.\pThere's still a lot of POKéMON that
I've seen but haven't caught.\pAnd there are many others that
I think will evolve.\pI wonder where I should go catch
some POKéMON next?$
translation:
小遥：{PLAYER}{KUN}！\p我在看我的宝可梦图鉴呢。\p有很多我看见却
没捕捉的宝可梦，\p还有些我想
可能会进化。\p不知道下面该
去哪儿捕捉宝可梦呢？$

label: RivalsHouse_2F_Text_MayWhereShouldIGoNext
source: MAY: I wonder where I should go catch\nsome POKéMON next?\pWouldn't it be funny if we ran into each\nother, {PLAYER}{KUN}?$
translation: 小遥：不知道下面该\n去哪儿捕捉宝可梦呢？\p如果我们能偶然遇上，\n那会很有趣吧，{PLAYER}{KUN}？$

label: RivalsHouse_2F_Text_BrendanJustCheckingMyPokedex
source: BRENDAN: Hey, it's {PLAYER}.\pI was just checking out my POKéDEX.\pThere are still many POKéMON that\nI need to catch, I know, but this\lis looking pretty good.\pChecking this POKéDEX out gives me\nthe urge to hit the road again.$
translation: 小悠：嗨，{PLAYER}，\p我在检查我的宝可梦图鉴。\p我还有不少宝可梦要捕捉，\n但现在这样\l进展也不错。\p看着这宝可梦图鉴就觉得它好像\n在催我回草丛里去。$

label: RivalsHouse_2F_Text_BrendanWhereShouldIGoNext
source: BRENDAN: I'm having a hard time deciding\nwhere I should catch POKéMON next.\pHey, {PLAYER}, if I see you while I'm out\ncatching POKéMON, I can pitch you a\lbattle if you'd like.$
translation: 小悠：我正在头疼下面\n要去哪儿捉宝可梦。\p喂，{PLAYER}，我如果能在找\n宝可梦时碰见你，\l可以和你来场小小的对战。$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_BirchAwayOnFieldwork
source:
Hunh? PROF. BIRCH?\pThe PROF's away on fieldwork.
Ergo, he isn't here.\pOh, let me explain what fieldwork is.\pIt is to study things in the natural
environment, like fields and mountains,\linstead of a laboratory.\pThe PROF isn't one for doing desk work.
He's the type of person who would\lrather go outside and experience\lthings than read about them here.$
translation:
什么？小田卷博士？\p博士去实地调查了，
现在不在这里。\p啊，我给你解释一下
什么是实地调查吧。\p实地调查，就是走出研究所，
去田里或山间等自然环境中\l做研究。\p博士是那种坐不住的人，
比起坐下来读书\l了解什么事情，他更愿意\l走出门去，亲身体验一下。$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_BirchIsntOneForDeskWork
source: The PROF isn't one for doing desk work.\nHe's the type of person who would\lrather go outside and experience\lthings than read about them here.$
translation: 博士是那种坐不住的人，\n比起坐下来读书\l了解什么事情，他更愿意\l走出门去，亲身体验一下。$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_BirchEnjoysRivalsHelpToo
source: PROF. BIRCH is studying the habitats\nand distribution of POKéMON.\pThe PROF enjoys {RIVAL}'s help, too.\nThere's a lot of love there.$
translation: 小田卷博士正在研究\n宝可梦的栖息分布，\p他喜欢让{RIVAL}帮忙。\n两人感情很好。$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_LikeYouToHavePokemon
source:
PROF. BIRCH: So, {PLAYER}{KUN}.\pI've heard so much about you from
your father.\pI've heard that you don't have your
own POKéMON yet.\pBut the way you battled earlier,
you pulled it off with aplomb!\pI guess you have your father's blood
in your veins after all!\pOh, yes. As thanks for rescuing me,
I'd like you to have the POKéMON you\lused earlier.\p{PLAYER} received the {STR_VAR_1}!$
translation:
小田卷博士：......{PLAYER}{KUN}，\p我从你爸爸那儿听说了
很多关于你的事。\p听说你还没有
自己的宝可梦？\p但你刚才对战的样子
真是镇静自若！\p果然是遗传了
你父亲的才能！\p对了，作为谢礼，
你刚才用的那只宝可梦\l就送给你吧！\p{PLAYER}得到{STR_VAR_1}！$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_WhyNotGiveNicknameToMon
source: PROF. BIRCH: While you're at it, why not\ngive a nickname to that {STR_VAR_1}?$
translation: 小田卷博士：要顺便给这只{STR_VAR_1}\n起昵称吗？$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_MightBeGoodIdeaToGoSeeRival
source:
PROF. BIRCH: If you work at POKéMON
and gain experience, I think you'll make\lan extremely good TRAINER.\pMy kid, {RIVAL}, is also studying
POKéMON while helping me out.\p{PLAYER}{KUN}, don't you think it might be
a good idea to go see {RIVAL}?$
translation:
小田卷博士：如果你努力培育宝可梦
积累经验，一定可以成为一名优秀的\l训练家。\p我的孩子{RIVAL}也在一边当我的助手，
一边研究宝可梦。\p{PLAYER}{KUN}，
去见见{RIVAL}怎么样？$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_GetRivalToTeachYou
source: PROF. BIRCH: Great!\n{RIVAL} should be happy, too.\pGet {RIVAL} to teach you what it\nmeans to be a TRAINER.$
translation: 小田卷博士：太好了！\n{RIVAL}肯定会很高兴的！\p让{RIVAL}教教你\n成为训练家的意义吧。$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_DontBeThatWay
source: PROF. BIRCH: Oh, don't be that way.\nYou should go meet my kid.$
translation: 小田卷博士：别这么说嘛，\n去见见我家孩子！$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_BirchRivalGoneHome
source:
PROF. BIRCH: {RIVAL}?
Gone home, I think.\pOr maybe that kid's scrabbling around
in tall grass again somewhere…\pIf you or your POKéMON get tired,
you should get some rest at home.$
translation:
小田卷博士：{RIVAL}？
可能回家里去了，\p也可能去草丛里
调查什么了......\p你和宝可梦累了的话，
记得回家休息一下。$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_ReceivedPokedex
source: {PLAYER} received the POKéDEX!$
translation: {PLAYER}得到了宝可梦图鉴！$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_ExplainPokedex
source:
PROF. BIRCH: The POKéDEX is a high-tech
tool that automatically makes a record\lof any POKéMON you meet or catch.\pMy kid, {RIVAL}, goes everywhere
with it.\pWhenever my kid catches a rare POKéMON
and records its data in the POKéDEX,\lwhy, {RIVAL} looks for me while I'm out\ldoing fieldwork, and shows me.$
translation:
小田卷博士：宝可梦图鉴是一种
能够自动记录你遇见或捕获的\l宝可梦的高科技工具，\p我家{RIVAL}无论去哪儿
都一直带着它。\p每当{RIVAL}捕捉到稀有宝可梦
并记录数据到宝可梦图鉴上时，\l那孩子就会来找在外实地调查的我，\l把成果展示给我看。$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_CountlessPokemonAwait
source: PROF. BIRCH: Countless POKéMON\nawait you!\pArgh, I'm getting the itch to get out\nand do fieldwork again!$
translation: 小田卷博士：前面还有无数的宝可梦\n在等着你！\p啊--\n我又想去做实地调查了！$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_MayGotPokedexTooTakeThese
source: MAY: Oh, wow, {PLAYER}{KUN}!\nYou got a POKéDEX, too!\pThat's great! Just like me!\nI've got something for you, too!$
translation: 小遥：哇，{PLAYER}{KUN}！\n你也拿到宝可梦图鉴啦！\p太好了！和我一样！\n这个送给你！$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_CatchCutePokemonWithPokeBalls
source:
MAY: It's fun if you can get a lot of
POKéMON!\pI'm going to look all over the place
because I want different POKéMON.\pIf I find any cute POKéMON, I'll catch
them with POKé BALLS!$
translation:
小遥：宝可梦捕捉得越多
就感觉会越有趣！\p我要去各处寻找
不同的宝可梦，\p发现可爱的宝可梦的话，
就用精灵球捕捉它们！$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_OhYourBagsFull
source: Oh? Your BAG's full.$
translation: 呀，你的包包满了。$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_MayWhereShouldIGoNext
source: MAY: I wonder where I should go look\nfor POKéMON next?$
translation: 小遥：接下来该去\n哪里找宝可梦呢？$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_BrendanGotPokedexTooTakeThese
source: BRENDAN: Huh…\nSo you got a POKéDEX, too.\pWell then, here.\nI'll give you these.$
translation: 小悠：哦......？\n你也拿到宝可梦图鉴了啊。\p那这个送给你！$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_CatchCoolPokemonWithPokeBalls
source:
BRENDAN: You know it's more fun to
have a whole bunch of POKéMON.\pI'm going to explore all over the place
to find different POKéMON.\pIf I find any cool POKéMON, you bet
I'll try to get them with POKé BALLS.$
translation:
小悠：你知道吗，捕捉的宝可梦
越多就越有趣。\p我要去各地寻找
捕捉不同的宝可梦，\p如果见到很帅气的宝可梦，
我肯定会用精灵球捕捉到！$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_HeyYourBagsFull
source: Hey, your BAG's full.$
translation: 喂，你的包包满了。$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_BrendanWhereShouldIGoNext
source: BRENDAN: Where should I look for\nPOKéMON next…$
translation: 小悠：接下来该去哪儿\n找宝可梦呢......$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_SeriousLookingMachine
source: It's a serious-looking machine.\nThe PROF must use this for research.$
translation: 看上去是个很先进的机器，\n一定是博士做研究时用的。$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_PCUsedForResearch
source: It's a PC used for research.\nBetter not mess around with it.$
translation: 研究用的电脑，\n还是不要随便乱碰的好。$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_CrammedWithBooksOnPokemon
source: It's crammed with books on POKéMON.$
translation: 塞满了关于宝可梦的书。$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_BookTooHardToRead
source: It's a book that's too hard to read.$
translation: 一本晦涩难懂的书。$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_OtherRegionsUpgradeToNational
source:
PROF. BIRCH: Now…\p{PLAYER}{KUN} and {RIVAL}, I've had the two
of you help me study POKéMON.\pThanks to your help, new facts
are coming to light.\pIt appears that in the HOENN region,
there are also POKéMON from other\lregions.\pIt goes to show how rich and varied
the natural environments of HOENN\lhappen to be.\pThat's why I think it's necessary for
me to upgrade your POKéDEX to\lthe NATIONAL Mode.\pHere, let me see your POKéDEX units.$
translation:
小田卷博士：好了......\p{PLAYER}{KUN}，{RIVAL}，
你们在帮我研究宝可梦的成果显著，\p多亏了你们，
我发现了许多新的事实。\p看来在丰缘地区中
栖息着其它地区的\l宝可梦。\p这说明丰缘地区的自然环境
是多么地丰富多样！\p因此，我要把你们的宝可梦图鉴
升级为全国模式。\p来，让我看看你们的宝可梦图鉴。$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_MayUpgradeSoCool
source: MAY: Eheheh!\pIt's so cool that even my POKéDEX\nis getting updated!\pIt's because you went out and caught\nso many POKéMON, {PLAYER}{KUN}!$
translation: 小遥：嘿嘿！\p太好了，我的宝可梦图鉴\n也跟着升级了！\p多亏了你捕捉了那么多\n宝可梦呀，{PLAYER}{KUN}！$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_BrendanYouCanThankMe
source: BRENDAN: I went out all over HOENN\nand checked out POKéMON.\pYou can thank me for getting\nthe NATIONAL Mode POKéDEX.\pYep, you're lucky, {PLAYER}!$
translation: 小悠：我跑遍了全丰缘地区\n寻找宝可梦，\p你的宝可梦图鉴能够升级\n全国模式可要感谢我！\p你运气真好，{PLAYER}！$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_OkayAllDone
source: PROF. BIRCH: Okay, all done!$
translation: 小田卷博士：好，升级完成啦！$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_PokedexUpgradedToNational
source: {PLAYER}'s POKéDEX was upgraded\nto the NATIONAL Mode!$
translation: {PLAYER}的宝可梦图鉴升级成了\n全国模式！$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_GrassyPatchWaiting2
source:
PROF. BIRCH: But listen.
You've become the CHAMPION,\lbut your POKéMON journey isn't over.\pThere is no end to the road
that is POKéMON.\pSomewhere, there is a grassy patch
that's waiting for you!$
translation:
小田卷博士：记住，
即使成为了冠军，\l你的宝可梦之旅也仍未结束，\p这条名为宝可梦的道路
永无止境，\p总有一片未曾踏足的草丛
在等待着你去探索！$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_MayTakeBreakFromFieldwork
source: MAY: I think I'll take a short break\nfrom fieldwork.\pI think I'll help the PROF here for\na while.$
translation: 小遥：我准备暂时\n不继续实地调查了，\p留在这里帮博士的忙。$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_BrendanTakeBreakFromFieldwork
source: BRENDAN: For the time being,\nI'm taking a break from fieldwork.\pI'll be helping out the PROF here\nfor a while.$
translation: 小悠：从现在起，\n我打算暂停实地调查，\p就留在这里帮博士的忙。$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_CanHaveAnyOneOfRarePokemon
source: PROF. BIRCH: These are rare POKéMON\nonly found in another region!\pYou can have any one of these\nthree POKéMON!$
translation: 小田卷博士：这是只有在其它地区\n才能找到的稀有宝可梦！\p从这3只中\n挑1只吧！$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_YoullTakeCyndaquil
source: PROF. BIRCH: The FIRE POKéMON\nCYNDAQUIL caught your eye!\pYou're as sharp as ever!\pSo the CYNDAQUIL is your choice?$
translation: 小田卷博士：你看中了\n火属性宝可梦火球鼠！\p你还是那么地眼尖啊！\p那么，你要选择火球鼠？$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_YoullTakeTotodile
source: PROF. BIRCH: The WATER POKéMON\nTOTODILE is your choice!\pYou know how to pick a good one.\pSo, you'll take the TOTODILE?$
translation: 小田卷博士：你选的是\n水属性宝可梦小锯鳄！\p你总能选出最好的一个。\p那么，你要选择小锯鳄？$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_YoullTakeChikorita
source: PROF. BIRCH: The GRASS POKéMON\nCHIKORITA is your choice!\pYou sure know what you're doing.\pSo, you'll take the CHIKORITA?$
translation: 小田卷博士：你选的是\n草属性宝可梦菊草叶！\p你很清楚自己想要什么。\p那么，你要选择菊草叶？$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_TakeYourTimeAllInvaluable
source: PROF. BIRCH: Take your time before\nyou decide.\pThey're all invaluable POKéMON.$
translation: 小田卷博士：决定前好好\n考虑一下吧，\p它们都是很珍贵的宝可梦。$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_PickedFinePokemon
source: PROF. BIRCH: I see!\nYou picked a fine POKéMON!$
translation: 小田卷博士：明白了！\n你选了一只很好的宝可梦！$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_ReceivedJohtoStarter
source: {PLAYER} received the {STR_VAR_1}\nfrom PROF. BIRCH!$
translation: {PLAYER}从小田卷博士处\n得到了{STR_VAR_1}！$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_NicknameJohtoStarter
source: Want to give a nickname to\nthe {STR_VAR_1} you received?$
translation: 要给刚得到的\n{STR_VAR_1}起昵称吗？$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_GrassyPatchWaiting
source:
PROF. BIRCH: Listen, {PLAYER}{KUN}.
You've completed the HOENN POKéDEX,\lbut your POKéMON journey isn't over.\pThere is no end to the road
that is POKéMON.\pSomewhere, there is a grassy patch
that's waiting for you!$
translation:
小田卷博士：记住，{PLAYER}{KUN}，
即使完成了丰缘地区的宝可梦图鉴，\l你的宝可梦之旅也仍未结束，\p这条名为宝可梦的道路
永无止境，\p总有一片未曾踏足的草丛
在等待着你去探索！$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_BetterLeaveOthersAlone
source: You received the promised POKéMON.\nBetter leave the others alone.$
translation: 你已经拿到了你的宝可梦，\n其他的还是留下吧。$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_DontHaveAnyRoomForPokemon
source: Oh, you don't have any room for\nthis POKéMON.$
translation: 噢，你没有放下这只\n宝可梦的地方了。$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_MayWhatNextImStayingHere
source:
MAY: {PLAYER}{KUN}, after this…
What are you going to do?\pAre you going to keep battling
and sharpening your skills?\pOr are you going to try filling
the NATIONAL POKéDEX?\pI'm staying here to help the PROF.$
translation:
小遥：{PLAYER}{KUN}，这以后......
你打算怎么做？\p继续对战提升
自己的实力吗？\p还是试着完成
全国宝可梦图鉴？\p我要留在这儿给博士帮忙。$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_BrendanPreferCollectingSlowly
source: BRENDAN: Rather than collecting\nPOKéMON, I prefer slowly and \lsteadily raising the one I chose.$
translation: 小悠：比起收集\n宝可梦，我更喜欢一步步慢慢培育\l我自己选择的那一只。$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_MayHaveYouGoneToBattleFrontier
source: MAY: Oh, hi, {PLAYER}{KUN}!\nHave you gone to that place,\lthe BATTLE FRONTIER?$
translation: 小遥：嗨，你好，{PLAYER}{KUN}！\n你去过对战开拓区了吗？$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_BrendanHaveYouGoneToBattleFrontier
source: BRENDAN: Hey, {PLAYER}!\nHave you gone out to that place,\lthe BATTLE FRONTIER?$
translation: 小悠：喂，{PLAYER}！\n你去过对战开拓区了吗？$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_ScottAboardSSTidalCall
source:
… … … … … …
… … … … … Beep!\pSCOTT: Hi, hi, {PLAYER}!
It's me, SCOTT.\pI'm aboard the S.S. TIDAL now.
It feels great to be on the sea!\pBy the way…\pThere's this place that I'd like to
invite you to for a visit.\pIf you're interested, board a ferry
at either SLATEPORT or LILYCOVE.\pI'll fill you in on the details when
we meet. I'll be waiting!\p… … … … … …
… … … … … Click!$
translation:
...... ...... ......
...... ...... ......哔！\p亚希达：嗨，{PLAYER}！
是我，亚希达，\p我现在在破浪号上呢。
在海上的感觉真是不错！\p对了......\p有个地方想邀请
你能去看看。\p感兴趣的话，就去凯那市或
水静市的码头去乘船吧。\p见面之后再跟你详细说，
我等你！\p...... ...... ......
...... ...... ......咔哒！$

label: MagmaHideout_1F_Text_Grunt1Intro
source: When TEAM MAGMA has roll call, we get\nimportant guarding assignments in\lthe order that we line up.\pThat's why I'm stuck off in this corner.\nI'm always late to roll call!$
translation: 当熔岩队点名布置任务的时候，\n我们按照排队的顺序各自领到\l重要性不同的守卫任务。\p所以我才被安排到这个角落里--\n因为我点名的时候总是迟到！$

label: MagmaHideout_1F_Text_Grunt1Defeat
source: I'm always late for training sessions,\ntoo!\pI hate to say it, but I'm wimpy…$
translation: 我训练时也\n总是迟到！\p虽然不想承认，\n可我真的很弱......$

label: MagmaHideout_1F_Text_Grunt1PostBattle
source: Okay, I'll try to put a little more\neffort into things from now on…$
translation: 好吧，我以后做事会试着\n再努力一点的......$

label: MagmaHideout_1F_Text_Grunt2Intro
source:
Our leader told us to dig into
MT. CHIMNEY, so we dug and dug.\pAnd in the course of digging, we came
across something that blew our minds!\pWhat did we find?\pFuhahaha!
I'll tell you if you beat me!$
translation:
我们老大叫我们挖掘烟囱山，
所以我们就一直挖啊挖。\p在挖的过程中，
我们发现了劲爆的东西！\p究竟是什么？\p哈哈哈！
打赢我的话就告诉你！$

label: MagmaHideout_1F_Text_Grunt2Defeat
source: Arrgh!\nTaken down!$
translation: 啊！\n输了！$

label: MagmaHideout_1F_Text_Grunt2PostBattle
source: I won't tell you after all.\nYou'll find out when you get there!\pIt'd be better if you saved surprises\nto the end, don't you think?$
translation: 我才不会告诉你。\n你到了那里就知道了！\p悬念要保存到最后一刻，\n你说对吧？$

label: MagmaHideout_2F_1R_Text_Grunt14Intro
source:
What, what, what?\pOnly TEAM MAGMA members are supposed
to be in here!\pBut you're not dressed in TEAM MAGMA's
uniform…\pYou rouse my suspicion!
Battle with me!$
translation:
什么什么什么？\p只有熔岩队
才准进来！\p但你没穿熔岩队的
制服......\p你很可疑！
和我对战吧！$

label: MagmaHideout_2F_1R_Text_Grunt14Defeat
source: Aiyiyi…\nMy pride as a TEAM MAGMA member…$
translation: 呜哇......\n我作为熔岩队手下的尊严啊......$

label: MagmaHideout_2F_1R_Text_Grunt14PostBattle
source: If you suffer from chills, you should\njoin TEAM MAGMA.$
translation: 要是你怕冷的话，\n不如加入我们熔岩队吧。$

label: MagmaHideout_2F_1R_Text_Grunt3Intro
source: Hold it right there!\pYou don't really expect me to keep\nmy trap shut and let you waltz by me?$
translation: 站住！\p你不会以为我会眼睁睁地站在这里，\n放你大摇大摆地过去吧？$

label: MagmaHideout_2F_1R_Text_Grunt3Defeat
source: Ooh wow!\nI concede!$
translation: 哇啊！\n我认输！$

label: MagmaHideout_2F_1R_Text_Grunt3PostBattle
source: Maybe it would've been better if I did\njust let you go unchallenged…$
translation: 早知道这样，\n还不如直接放你过去算了......$

label: MagmaHideout_2F_1R_Text_Grunt4Intro
source: Ahah!\nAn intruder!$
translation: 啊！\n有入侵者！$

label: MagmaHideout_2F_1R_Text_Grunt4Defeat
source: Graaah!$
translation: 哇啊啊！$

label: MagmaHideout_2F_1R_Text_Grunt4PostBattle
source: I've already lost.\pDo I really need to keep running\naround in a circle?$
translation: 都已经输了......\p我还有必要继续在这儿\n转圈巡逻吗？$

label: MagmaHideout_2F_1R_Text_Grunt5Intro
source: Oh, oh!\nAn intruder!$
translation: 哦，哦！\n有入侵者！$

label: MagmaHideout_2F_1R_Text_Grunt5Defeat
source: Mutter…$

label: MagmaHideout_2F_1R_Text_Grunt5PostBattle
source: Actually, I'm no expert at battling…$
translation: 说实话，\n我本来就不擅长对战......$

label: MagmaHideout_2F_2R_Text_Grunt15Intro
source: I don't have a bone to pick with you.\nI'm just following orders!$
translation: 我和你无冤无仇，\n我只是奉命行事！$

label: MagmaHideout_2F_2R_Text_Grunt15Defeat
source: I may have lost, but…$
translation: 虽然我输了，可是......$

label: MagmaHideout_2F_2R_Text_Grunt15PostBattle
source: We dug up something beyond belief!\nAnd, we got the BLUE ORB!\pAll that's left is for our leader to…\nFufufu… Fwahahaha!$
translation: 我们挖掘到了难以置信的东西！\n还拿到了靛蓝色宝珠！\p现在只等老大......\n哼哼哼......哈哈哈哈！$

label: MagmaHideout_2F_2R_Text_Grunt6Intro
source: I can't stand heat. Maybe I should've\njoined TEAM AQUA instead…$
translation: 实在受不了这热气。\n或许我当初该加入海洋队......$

label: MagmaHideout_2F_2R_Text_Grunt6Defeat
source: Yeah, I really may not be right for\nTEAM MAGMA…$
translation: 看来我真的不适合\n待在熔岩队......$

label: MagmaHideout_2F_2R_Text_Grunt6PostBattle
source: Don't you get lonely for the sea\nbeing in a place like this?$
translation: 待在这种地方\n你不会想念大海吗？$

label: MagmaHideout_2F_2R_Text_Grunt7Intro
source: You can hear tremors here sometimes.\pCould it be the volcano rattling?\nOr is it GROU…\pWhoops!\nNo, no, never mind!$
translation: 在这里有时能感觉到晃动。\p难道是火山在震动？\n还是固拉......\p哎呀！\n不，不，没什么！$

label: MagmaHideout_2F_2R_Text_Grunt7Defeat
source: You're a fiery battler.\nJust like a volcano!$
translation: 你的进攻真猛烈，\n就像火山一样！$

label: MagmaHideout_2F_2R_Text_Grunt7PostBattle
source: You just happened to win this time,\nbut that doesn't matter.\pTEAM MAGMA's goal is about to be\nreached!$
translation: 就算这次你赢了也\n改变不了什么。\p熔岩队的伟大目标\n马上就要实现了！$

label: MagmaHideout_2F_2R_Text_Grunt8Intro
source: One of our guys was freaking out that\nhe lost his MAGMA EMBLEM…\pWait a minute!\nWas it you who found it?$
translation: 我们一个队员正因弄丢了\n熔岩标志而抓狂呢......\p等一下！\n该不会被你捡到了？$

label: MagmaHideout_2F_2R_Text_Grunt8Defeat
source: I'm having trouble believing this…$
translation: 真是难以置信......$

label: MagmaHideout_2F_2R_Text_Grunt8PostBattle
source: I'm getting this feeling that our plan\nis going to end in failure…$
translation: 我总感觉我们的计划\n会以失败告终......$

label: MagmaHideout_3F_1R_Text_Grunt9Intro
source: What did I do to deserve this guard\nposting?\pMy left ear is burning up!$
translation: 我怎么会被分配到\n这个岗位上？\p我的左耳快烤熟了！$

label: MagmaHideout_3F_1R_Text_Grunt9Defeat
source: I'm getting heat exhaustion…$

label: MagmaHideout_3F_1R_Text_Grunt9PostBattle
source: Do you think it's odd that we're wearing\nhoods in this magma-filled volcano?$
translation: 在岩浆火山里戴着兜帽\n在你不觉得奇怪吗？$

label: MagmaHideout_3F_1R_Text_Grunt16Intro
source:
We joined so we can help our leader
achieve his fantastic vision.\pI don't care if you're with TEAM AQUA
or if you're just some kid passing by.\pNo one interferes with us and gets
away with it!$
translation:
我们加入组织，
为的是帮助老大实现他的雄图伟业。\p我不管你是海洋队的人
还是偶尔路过的小鬼头，\p敢碍事的家伙
一个都别想跑！$

label: MagmaHideout_3F_1R_Text_Grunt16Defeat
source: Oh, no!\nYou're not to be trusted at all!$
translation: 哦，不！\n真是不可轻视！$

label: MagmaHideout_3F_1R_Text_Grunt16PostBattle
source: Listen to me.\nTEAM MAGMA is right!\pDon't listen to TEAM AQUA.\nDon't believe their lies!$
translation: 听好了--\n熔岩队才是正确的！\p别听海洋队的，\n别相信他们说的鬼话！$

label: MagmaHideout_3F_2R_Text_Grunt10Intro
source:
I understand everything our leader
says. But you know what?\pDoing stuff like digging up a super-
ancient POKéMON and ripping off\lsomeone's METEORITE…\pI think we're going a little too far.
What do you think?$
translation:
我明白老大所说的话。
但说实话--\p又是挖掘超古代宝可梦
又是抢夺别人的陨石......\p是不是有些做过头了。
你怎么想？$

label: MagmaHideout_3F_2R_Text_Grunt10Defeat
source: Yeah, I think we are doing something\nwrong somehow.$
translation: 果然......\n确实做得不太对。$

label: MagmaHideout_3F_2R_Text_Grunt10PostBattle
source: You know, losing to you cleared my mind.\pThe next time I see our leader,\nI'm going to ask him about what we do.$
translation: 说实话，\n输给你后我反而清醒了许多。\p下次见到老大的时候，\n我打算问个明白。$

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_Grunt11Intro
source: I want to see GROUDON, too, but they\nwon't let me see even its tail…\pIt's got me feeling really frustrated.\pOh, no!\nI blabbed about GROUDON!$
translation: 我也想见固拉多，\n但他们连尾巴都不让我看......\p真让我难受。\p哦，不好！\n我怎么说出固拉多的事了！$

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_Grunt11Defeat
source: I guess it's impossible to win if one\ndoesn't have a calm mind…$
translation: 我想头脑不够冷静的话\n是不可能赢的......$

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_Grunt11PostBattle
source: I wonder if GROUDON even has a tail?$
translation: 不知道固拉多有没有尾巴？$

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_Grunt12Intro
source: Fuhahaha!\nSoon! Very soon!\lOur grand objective will be achieved!$
translation: 哇哈哈！\n快了！就快了！\l我们的伟大目标就要实现了！$

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_Grunt12Defeat
source: Grrr…\nI've come so far, but now this?$
translation: 啊......\n我努力了半天得到的就是这种结局？$

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_Grunt12PostBattle
source: MAXIE, sir!\nAn intruder is headed your way!$
translation: 赤焰松老大！\n有一名入侵者去你那儿了！$

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_Grunt13Intro
source: You're not finished yet!\nYou're not getting by me easily!$
translation: 还没完呢！\n你别以为能轻易地干掉我！$

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_Grunt13Defeat
source: Was I that easy to knock down?$
translation: 我那么容易就被干掉了？$

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_Grunt13PostBattle
source: C-come on, one more match…$
translation: 来--来吧，再战一回......$

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_TabithaIntro
source:
Hehehe!
You made it this far, so I'll tell you!\pThat's right!
Up ahead, GROUDON is sleeping!\pMAXIE went to GROUDON just seconds
ago!\pIt's going to awaken real soon!
Hehe! Hehehe!$
translation:
嘿嘿嘿！看在你这么努力的份上，
我就告诉你好了！\p没错！
固拉多就在前方沉睡着！\p赤焰松刚刚已经
过去找固拉多了！\p它很快就要被唤醒了！
嘿嘿！嘿嘿嘿！$

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_TabithaDefeat
source: Taken down again…\nHehe…$

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_TabithaPostBattle
source: …And while you wasted time with me,\nMAXIE should have awakened GROUDON…$
translation: ......在你和我浪费时间的时候，\n赤焰松应该已经唤醒了固拉多......$

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_MaxieAwakenGroudon
source:
MAXIE: GROUDON…\pNothing could awaken you from your
sleep bathed in magma…\pThis BLUE ORB is what you sought.
Wasn't it?\pI have brought you the BLUE ORB.
Let its shine awaken you!\pAnd show me…
Show me the full extent of your power!$
translation:
赤焰松：固拉多......\p无论怎样也不会
从岩浆中苏醒的你......\p一直在寻求的，
是这个靛蓝色宝珠吧？\p我已带来了靛蓝色宝珠。
就让它的光芒唤醒你吧！\p向我展示......
展示的你全部的力量吧！$

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_MaxieGroudonWhatsWrong
source: MAXIE: GROUDON!\nWhat's wrong?\pWasn't the BLUE ORB the key?\pGROUDON!\nWhere have you gone…$
translation: 赤焰松：固拉多！\n怎么回事？\p难道靛蓝色宝珠不行吗？\p固拉多！\n你去哪了......$

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_MaxieOhItWasYou
source: MAXIE: Oh, so it was you?\pI've seen you poking around uninvited\nhere and there…\pI get it now!\nYou must have pulled a cheap stunt!$
translation: 赤焰松：哦，原来是你？\p我早就注意到你一直\n到处鬼鬼祟祟的......\p明白了！\n一定是你动了手脚！$

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_MaxieDefeat
source: What makes you so adept at handling\nPOKéMON?$
translation: 你为什么能如此娴熟地\n指挥宝可梦？$

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_MaxieImGoingAfterGroudon
source:
MAXIE: There has to be some reason
why GROUDON fled…\pThat's what you're trying to say,
aren't you?\p… … … … … …
… … … … … …\pHumph…
You think I didn't know that?\pWith GROUDON gone, there is no longer
any need for this blasted volcano.\pI am going after GROUDON, so this
is where we part!$
translation:
赤焰松：固拉多逃跑
另有原因......\p你想说这个，
对不对？\p...... ...... ......
...... ...... ......\p哼......
你以为我不知道吗？\p既然固拉多走了，
这座破火山也没意义了。\p我要去追固拉多，
告辞了！$

label: MauvilleCity_Text_UncleHesTooPeppy
source: UNCLE: It's because of POKéMON that\nthis boy's got more pep, I suppose…\lBut he's become a bit too peppy…$
translation: 叔叔：我想是宝可梦\n让那孩子打起精神来的......\l但他好像有点兴奋过头了......$

label: MauvilleCity_Text_WallyWantToChallengeGym
source: WALLY: Aww, UNCLE, please?\pI want to challenge this GYM and see\nhow much better I've become.\pPlease? May I, please?$
translation: 满充：叔叔，拜托你了。\p我想挑战这个道馆，\n我想试试我变得多强了。\p可以吗？$

label: MauvilleCity_Text_UncleYourePushingIt
source: UNCLE: Now hold on, WALLY.\pSince you started living with POKéMON,\nyou have grown quite a lot stronger.\pBut don't you think you're pushing it\nto suddenly challenge a GYM?$
translation: 叔叔：等等，满充。\p自从你开始和宝可梦旅行以来，\n确实成长了不少。\p但你不觉得现在就挑战道馆\n也太勉强了吗？$

label: MauvilleCity_Text_WallyWeCanBeatAnyone
source: WALLY: I'm not pushing it.\pIf I combine forces with RALTS,\nwe can beat anyone!$
translation: 满充：才不勉强！\p只要和拉鲁拉丝齐心协力的话，\n我们不会输给任何人！$

label: MauvilleCity_Text_WallyWillYouBattleMe
source:
WALLY: Oh! Hi, {PLAYER}!\pI've gotten a lot stronger since
we met.\p{PLAYER}, I want you and my UNCLE to
understand that.\p{PLAYER}, please, will you have
a battle with me?$
translation:
满充：啊，{PLAYER}！\p我比之前见面时
要强多了。\p{PLAYER}，
我想让你和叔叔看看！\p{PLAYER}，拜托了，
和我对战吧！$

label: MauvilleCity_Text_WallyMyUncleWontKnowImStrong
source: WALLY: Oh… If you won't battle me,\n{PLAYER}, my UNCLE won't know that I've\lbecome really strong.$
translation: 满充：唔......{PLAYER}，如果你不跟我对战，\n叔叔就不会知道\l我真的变强了......$

label: MauvilleCity_Text_UncleCanYouBattleWally
source: UNCLE: {PLAYER}{KUN}, was it?\nOn WALLY's behalf, can I ask you to\lbattle with him just this once?\pI don't think he's going to listen to\nany reason the way he is now.$
translation: 叔叔：你是{PLAYER}{KUN}吧？\n为了满充，\l能请你和来一场对战吗？\p我想他现在这样\n是没法听得进劝的。$

label: MauvilleCity_Text_WallyPleaseBattleMe
source: WALLY: {PLAYER}, please!\nBattle with me, please.$
translation: 满充：{PLAYER}，拜托了！\n和我对战吧！$

label: MauvilleCity_Text_WallyHereICome
source: WALLY: {PLAYER}, thank you.\pOkay… Here I come!$
translation: 满充：{PLAYER}，谢谢！\p那么......我要上了！$

label: MauvilleCity_Text_WallyIllGoBackToVerdanturf
source: WALLY: UNCLE…\nI'll go back to VERDANTURF…$
translation: 满充：叔叔......\n我会回绿茵镇的......$

label: MauvilleCity_Text_ThankYouNotEnoughToBattle
source: {PLAYER}, thank you.\nBeing a TRAINER is tough, isn't it?\pIt's not enough just to have POKéMON\nand make them battle. That isn't what\lbeing a real TRAINER is about.$
translation: {PLAYER}，谢谢你。\n果然做训练家真的\l很不容易啊......\p光是拥有自己的宝可梦\n让它们对战还不够，\l还算不上是真正的训练家......$

label: MauvilleCity_Text_UncleNoNeedToBeDown
source:
UNCLE: WALLY, there's no need to be so
down on yourself.\pWhy, what's keeping you from becoming
stronger and stronger?\pCome on, let's go home.
Everyone's waiting for you.$
translation:
叔叔：满充，
别这么沮丧。\p想想是什么激励着你
要变得越来越强的？\p好了，我们回家吧，
大家都在等你呢。$

label: MauvilleCity_Text_UncleVisitUsSometime
source: UNCLE: {PLAYER}{KUN}, it just dawned on me\nthat you must be the TRAINER who kept\lan eye out for WALLY when he caught\lhis POKéMON.\pWhy don't you visit us in VERDANTURF\nsometime?\lI'm sure WALLY would enjoy it.$
translation: 叔叔：{PLAYER}{KUN}，我刚刚才想起来，\n你就是那位看着满充捕捉他的\l第一只宝可梦的训练家吧？\p有空的话，\n来绿茵镇转转好吗？\l我想满充也会很开心的。$

label: MauvilleCity_Text_WallyPokenavCall
source:
… … … … … …
… … … … … Beep!\pWALLY: Oh, hello, {PLAYER}!\pI just wanted to tell you that
my uncle bought me a POKéNAV!\pNow I can get in touch with you
anytime, {PLAYER}!\p… … … … … …
… … … … … Click!$

label: MauvilleCity_Text_RegisteredWally
source: Registered WALLY\nin the POKéNAV.$
translation: 把满充\n登记到宝可导航里了。$

label: MauvilleCity_Text_ScottYouDidntHoldBack
source:
SCOTT: Hehe…
I was watching that match!\pYou're friends with that boy WALLY,
aren't you?\pBut you didn't hold anything back
and beat him impressively.\pYeah! That's what a real POKéMON
battle is all about!\pI idolize TRAINERS like that!\p… … … … … …
I'll be cheering for you!$
translation:
亚希达：嘿嘿......
刚才的对战我都看到了！\p那个叫满充的男孩
是你的朋友吧？\p即便如此你还是全力以赴
漂亮地取胜了！\p没错！这才是真正的
宝可梦对战！\p我所欣赏的就是这样的训练家！\p...... ...... ......
我会继续为你加油的！$

label: MauvilleCity_Text_WattsonNeedFavorTakeKey
source:
WATTSON: Oh, {PLAYER}{KUN}!
You look like you have a lot of zip!\lThat's a good thing, wahahahaha!\pFine! I've decided!
I need a favor, {PLAYER}{KUN}!\pMAUVILLE CITY has an underground
sector called NEW MAUVILLE.\p{PLAYER}{KUN}, I'd like you to go there and
switch off the GENERATOR.\pThe GENERATOR has been running a bit
haywire. It's getting unsafe.\pHere, this is the KEY to get into
NEW MAUVILLE.$
translation:
铁旋：嗨，{PLAYER}{KUN}！
你看起来挺精神嘛！\l不错，不错，啊哈哈哈哈！\p好！我决定了！
{PLAYER}{KUN}，我需要帮助！\p紫堇市这里有一个
叫做新紫堇的地下区域。\p{PLAYER}{KUN}，希望你能
去那里关掉发电器。\p最近发电器的运转有些失控，
现在那里不是很安全。\p给，这是进入
新紫堇的钥匙。$

label: MauvilleCity_Text_WattsonWontBeChallenge
source:
WATTSON: Don't you worry about it.
It won't be a challenge to you.\pThe entrance to NEW MAUVILLE is just
a short SURF away from ROUTE 110.\pThat's it, then, you have my trust!
Wahahahaha!$
translation:
铁旋：不用担心，
这对你应该是小菜一碟。\p从110号道路用冲浪一小段
就到新紫堇的入口了。\p那就这么说定了，我相信你！
啊哈哈哈哈！$

label: MauvilleCity_Text_WattsonThanksTakeTM
source: WATTSON: Wahahahaha!\pI knew it, {PLAYER}{KUN}! I knew I'd made\nthe right choice asking you!\pThis is my thanks--a TM containing\nTHUNDERBOLT!\pGo on, you've earned it!$
translation: 铁旋：啊哈哈哈哈！\p我就知道，{PLAYER}{KUN}！\n我就知道叫你去肯定没问题！\p这是我的谢礼--\n十万伏特的招式学习器！\p来，收下它吧！$

label: MauvilleCity_Text_WattsonYoungTakeCharge
source: WATTSON: Wahahahaha!\pIt pleases me to no end to see\nthe young step up and take charge!$
translation: 铁旋：啊哈哈哈哈！\p我最喜欢看到年轻人\n挑起重担，引领这个时代！$

label: MauvilleCity_Text_NurseHurtMonBackToHealth
source: You know, it's cool to have POKéMON\nbattles and stuff…\pBut if your POKéMON gets hurt,\nyou have to nurse it back to health.$
translation: 你知道吗，看着宝可梦对战\n真是太棒了......\p但如果你的宝可梦受了伤，\n就得赶快帮它治疗。$

label: MauvilleCity_Text_AllSortsOfPeopleComeThrough
source: The roads of this town stretch north\nand south, and east and west.\pBecause of that, we get all sorts of\npeople coming through.$
translation: 这个镇子的道路\n通向四面八方。\p因此在这里\n能见到各式各样的人。$

label: MauvilleCity_Text_RydelVeryGenerous
source: Have you been to RYDEL'S CYCLES yet?\pRYDEL, the owner, is a very generous\nman.$
translation: 你去过风野的自行车行了吗？\p那里的主人风野\n是个很大方的人。$

label: MauvilleCity_Text_PokemonCanJumpYouOnBike
source: Even if you're riding a BIKE,\nwild POKéMON could jump you.$
translation: 就算你骑着自行车，\n野生宝可梦也会跳出来袭击你。$

label: MauvilleCity_Text_CitySign
source: MAUVILLE CITY\n“The bright and shiny city of fun!”$
translation: 这里是紫堇市。\n"流光溢彩的欢乐城市！"$

label: MauvilleCity_Text_GymSign
source: MAUVILLE CITY POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: WATTSON\l“The cheerfully electrifying man!”$
translation: 紫堇市宝可梦道馆\n馆主：铁旋\l"开朗的电击大叔！"$

label: MauvilleCity_Text_BikeShopSign
source: “Ride in gravel and shake up your\nsoul!”\lRYDEL'S CYCLES$
translation: "骑车到砂石路上去，\n晃动爱车的灵魂！"\l风野自行车店$

label: MauvilleCity_Text_GameCornerSign
source: “The play spot for all!”\nMAUVILLE GAME CORNER$
translation: "大家的游乐场！"\n紫堇游戏城$

label: MauvilleCity_Text_ExplainTV
source:
Hi, do you check out TV at all?\pThey've added a bunch of cool new
shows recently.\pTV is so cool. I've seen my friends on
TV just out of the blue.\pAnd, sometimes, they even put you on TV
without telling you.\pI wish I would be on TV sometime.\pThat's why I think you should check
out TVs whenever you can.$
translation:
嗨，你看电视了吗？\p最近电视台
设立了很多新节目。\p电视太棒了，有一次我意外地
发现我朋友上电视了。\p而且有时候电视台根本不告诉你
你就会出现在荧屏上了。\p希望哪天我也
能上电视，\p所以你要经常
看电视哦。$

label: MauvilleCity_Text_BeenCheckingOutTV
source: Hi, have you been checking out TVs?$
translation: 嗨，你看过电视了吗？$

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_RydelGreeting
source: Well, well, what have we here?\nA most energetic customer!\pMe? You may call me RYDEL.\nI'm the owner of this cycle shop.$
translation: 哎呀哎呀，看看是谁来了？\n一位充满活力的客人！\p我？你可以叫我风野，\n我是这家车店的店主。$

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_DidYouComeFromFarAway
source: RYDEL: Your RUNNING SHOES…\nThey're awfully filthy.\pDid you come from far away?$
translation: 风野：你的跑步鞋......\n看上去已经很脏了。\p你是从很远的地方来的吗？$

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_GuessYouDontNeedBike
source: RYDEL: Is that right?\pThen, I guess you have no need for\nany of my BIKES.$
translation: 风野：是吗？\p那么我想你\n不需要我的自行车。$

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_ExplainBikesChooseWhichOne
source:
RYDEL: Hm, hm… … … … …\pYou're saying that you came all this
way from LITTLEROOT?\pMy goodness!
That's ridiculously far!\pIf you had one of my BIKES, you could
go anywhere easily while feeling the\lgentle caress of the wind!\pI'll tell you what!
I'll give you a BIKE!\pOh, wait a second!\pI forgot to tell you that there are
two kinds of BIKES!\pThey are the MACH BIKE and
the ACRO BIKE!\pThe MACH BIKE is for cyclists who want
to feel the wind with their bodies!\pAnd an ACRO BIKE is for those who
prefer technical rides!\pI'm a real sweetheart, so you can
have whichever one you like!\pWhich one will you choose?$
translation:
风野：唔，唔...... ......\p你说你从未白镇
一路来到这里？\p天啊！
那么远的地方！\p如果你骑着我的自行车，
你可以在感受轻风拂面的同时\l轻轻松松地到任何地方去！\p我跟你说！
我给你辆自行车！\p啊，等等！\p忘了告诉你，
我这儿有两种自行车！\p分别是音速自行车
和越野自行车！\p音速自行车是为
追风的单车一族而设计，\p而越野自行车则是给
喜爱车技的人所准备！\p我是好心人，
所以让你随便挑一种！\p你想要哪样？$

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_ChoseMachBike
source: {PLAYER} chose the MACH BIKE.$
translation: {PLAYER}选择了音速自行车。$

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_ChoseAcroBike
source: {PLAYER} chose the ACRO BIKE.$
translation: {PLAYER}选择了越野自行车。$

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_ComeBackToSwitchBikes
source: RYDEL: If you get the urge to switch\nBIKES, just come see me!$
translation: 风野：如果你想换一辆自行车，\n再回来找我！$

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_WantToSwitchBikes
source: RYDEL: Oh? Were you thinking about\nswitching BIKES?$
translation: 风野：哦？\n你想换一辆车吗？$

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_IllSwitchBikes
source: RYDEL: Okay, no problem!\nI'll switch BIKES for you!$
translation: 风野：好，没问题！\n我给你换一辆车！$

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_ExchangedMachForAcro
source: {PLAYER} got the MACH BIKE exchanged\nfor an ACRO BIKE.$
translation: {PLAYER}把音速自行车\n换成了越野自行车。$

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_ExchangedAcroForMach
source: {PLAYER} got the ACRO BIKE exchanged\nfor a MACH BIKE.$
translation: {PLAYER}把越野自行车\n换成了音速自行车。$

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_HappyYouLikeIt
source: RYDEL: Good, good!\nI'm happy that you like it!$
translation: 风野：好，好！\n我很高兴你能喜欢它！$

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_OhYourBikeIsInPC
source:
Oh? What happened to that BIKE
I gave you?\pOh, I get it, you stored it using your PC.\pWell, take it out of PC storage,
and I'll be happy to exchange it!\pMay the wind always be at your back
on your adventure!$
translation:
哎？我
给你的自行车呢？\p啊，明白了，你把它存到电脑里面了。\p把它从电脑里拿出来吧，
我很乐意为你换一辆！\p愿你在旅行中
体会到追风的快乐！$

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_HandbooksAreInBack
source: I'm learning about BIKES while\nI work here.\pIf you need advice on how to ride your\nBIKE, there're a couple handbooks in\lthe back.$
translation: 我在这儿工作的时候\n学到了很多关于自行车的知识。\p如果你想知道怎么骑车，\n那边有几本说明书。$

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_MachHandbookWhichPage
source: It's a handbook on the MACH BIKE.\pWhich page do you want to read?$
translation: 是音速自行车的说明书。\p想读哪一页？$

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_HowToRideMachBike
source: A BIKE moves in the direction that\nthe + Control Pad is pressed.\pIt will speed up once it gets rolling.\pTo stop, release the + Control Pad.\nThe BIKE will slow to a stop.\pWant to read a different page?$
translation: 按方向键可以\n使自行车向相应的方向移动。\p持续移动的话车会加速。\p若要停止，则松开方向键，\n自行车会慢慢减速停下。\p还要翻到其他页吗？$

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_HowToTurnMachBike
source:
A MACH BIKE is speedy, but it can't
stop very quickly.\pIt gets a little tricky to get around
a corner.\pRelease the + Control Pad a little
before the corner and slow down.\pWant to read a different page?$
translation:
音速自行车速度很快，
但并不容易停下，\p转弯的时候
也有些麻烦，\p需要提前松开
方向键减速。\p还要翻到其他页吗？$

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_SandySlopes
source:
There are small sandy slopes
throughout the HOENN region.\pThe loose, crumbly sand makes it
impossible to climb normally.\pBut if you have a MACH BIKE, you can
zip up a sandy slope.\pWant to read a different page?$
translation:
丰缘地区中某些地方
有小沙坡，\p普通方法很难爬上
这些松散细碎的斜坡，\p但如果骑着音速自行车
就能冲上沙坡。\p还要翻到其他页吗？$

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_AcroHandbookWhichPage
source: It's a handbook on the ACRO BIKE.\pWhich page do you want to read?$
translation: 是越野自行车的说明书。\p想读哪一页？$

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_Wheelies
source: Press the B Button while riding,\nand the front wheel lifts up.\pYou can zip around with the front\nwheel up using the + Control Pad.\pThis technique is called a wheelie.\pWant to read a different page?$
translation: 骑车时按住B键\n可以抬起前轮，\p此时按方向键\n能够抬着前轮移动。\p这叫做后轮特技。\p还要翻到其他页吗？$

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_BunnyHops
source: Keeping the B Button pressed,\nyour BIKE can hop on the spot.\pThis technique is called a bunny hop.\pYou can ride while hopping, too.\pWant to read a different page?$
translation: 一直按住B键，\n自行车会原地跳跃。\p这叫做弹跳。\p弹跳时也可以继续骑车。\p还要翻到其他页吗？$

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_Jumps
source:
Press the B Button and the + Control
Pad at the same time to jump.\pPress the + Control Pad to the side
to jump sideways.\pPress it backwards to make the BIKE
change directions while jumping.\pWant to read a different page?$
translation:
同时按下方向键和
B键进行侧跳。\p按方向键
决定向哪一边侧跳。\p跳起时按反方向可以
使自行车调头。\p还要翻到其他页吗？$

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_ThisIsMauvilleGameCorner
source: This is the GAME CORNER.$
translation: 这里是紫堇游戏城。$

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_NeedCoinCaseForCoins
source: Okay, you wanted some COINS for\nthe games?\pBut you don't have a COIN CASE for\nstowing the COINS.$
translation: 您想要些代币\n玩游戏吗？\p但您还没有装代币的\n代币盒。$

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_WereYouLookingForCoins
source: Were you looking for COINS?\pIt's ¥500 for 50 COINS.\nWould you like some?$
translation: 您要买代币吗？\p¥1000可以买50枚。\n您要买一些吗？$

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_ThankYouHereAreYourCoins
source: Thank you very much!\nHere are your COINS!$
translation: 谢谢惠顾！\n这是您的代币！$

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_DontHaveEnoughMoney
source: Um… You don't appear to have\nenough money for that many COINS…$
translation: 呃......您的现金\n似乎不够......$

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_DontNeedCoinsThen
source: Oh… You don't need COINS, then?\nGood luck on your adventure!$
translation: 哦......您现在不需要代币吗？\n那么，祝您旅途愉快！$

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_ExchangeCoinsForPrizes
source: Welcome.\pYou can exchange your COINS for\nprizes here.$
translation: 欢迎！\p您可以在这里\n把代币换成奖品。$

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_WhichPrize
source: Which prize would you like?$
translation: 您想换什么奖品？$

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_SoYourChoiceIsTheTMX
source: So your choice is\nthe {STR_VAR_1} {STR_VAR_2}?$
translation: 您要换\n{STR_VAR_1}{STR_VAR_2}吗？$

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_SendToYourHomePC
source: Thank you!\nWe'll send it to your PC at home.$
translation: 谢谢惠顾！您的物品\n已经送到您家的电脑中了。$

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_NotEnoughCoins
source: You don't have enough COINS.$
translation: 您的代币不够。$

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_NoRoomForPlacingDecor
source: There isn't any room available for\nplacing {STR_VAR_1}.$
translation: 没有足够的地方\n放下{STR_VAR_1}。$

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_OhIsThatSo
source: Oh, is that so? \nYou need to save some COINS before\lcoming back here.$
translation: 噢，是吗？\n多积攒一些代币\l再来吧。$

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_SoYourChoiceIsX
source: So your choice is {STR_VAR_1}?$
translation: 您想换{STR_VAR_1}吗？$

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_HereYouGo
source: 给你！$
translation: 请拿好！$

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_CantCarryAnyMore
source: Oh, you can't carry any more than that.$
translation: 噢，您不能再拿更多了。$

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_GotTwoOfSameDollWantOne
source: I made a mistake and got two of\nthe same DOLLS.\pWould you like one of them?$
translation: 我不小心弄错了，\n拿了两只一样的玩偶。\p你想要一个吗？$

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_HereYouGo2
source: 给你！$
translation: 请拿好！$

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_YouWantItButNotNow
source: Huh?\nYou want it, but not right now?$
translation: 嗯？\n你现在还不想要？$

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_DontBeNegative
source: Oh, don't be so negative!\nYou can have this!$
translation: 哎，别急着拒绝！\n你可以拿啊！$

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_CantWinJackpot
source: There's a prize I want, but I can't win\nthe jackpot.$
translation: 有个奖品我很想要，\n但我总不能连胜。$

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_NeedCoinCaseGoNextDoor
source: Hey, kid, if you want to play here,\nyou need a COIN CASE.\pI think the young lady next door\nhad one. Go see her!$
translation: 喂，孩子，你要想在这儿玩\n就得有个代币盒。\p我想隔壁的年轻女孩\n有一个，去找她吧！$

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_LuckOnlyLastSoLongTakeCoins
source: My luck can only last so long.\nThis is too much for me.\lHere, take some COINS!$
translation: 我的运气大概到此为止了，\n已经得到太多东西了。\l给你一些代币吧！$

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_MauvilleSomethingForEveryone
source: MAUVILLE has something for\neveryone.\pFor me, it's the GAME CORNER.$
translation: 每个人都能在紫堇市\n找到快乐，\p对我来说，快乐就是游戏城。$

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_RouletteTablesDifferentRates
source: The ROULETTE tables have different\nrates.\pCheck your COINS if you're going to\npick a table.$
translation: 轮盘机那边有不同的\n赔率，\p决定选择哪张桌之前先\n看看你剩下多少代币吧。$

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_EasyToLoseTrackOfTime
source: It's easy to lose track of time in here. \nI should get back to work.$
translation: 在这儿很快就消磨了大把的时间，\n我该回去工作了。$

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_CoinsAreNeededToPlay
source: COINS are needed to play here\nin the GAME CORNER.$
translation: 在游戏城这儿玩\n要使用代币。$

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_RouletteOnlyLuck
source: This ROULETTE thing…\nIt's rather demanding.\pWin or lose, it's only by luck.$
translation: 这种轮盘机......\n要求太高了，\p胜负全凭运气。$

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_UpTo3CoinsCanBeUsed
source: Up to three COINS can be used to play\nthe SLOTS.$
translation: 玩老虎机最多\n可以用3枚代币。$

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_DifficultToStopOn7
source: It's very difficult to make it stop\nright on “7.”\pIf it stops on “7” during the REEL TIME\nbonus game, you'll receive extra COINS.$
translation: 要让它正好停在"7"上\n实在太难了。\p如果转盘时正好停在"7"上，\n就能得到额外的代币奖励。$

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_HeresSomeSlotsInfo
source:
Here's some information for you
about the SLOTS.\pThe more lightning bolts you stock,
the more REEL TIME chances you get.\pIn a game with the maximum five
REEL TIME chances…\pIt is possible to receive four regular
bonuses, then a big bonus.\pThat would total 660 COINS, but it's
very difficult to get.$
translation:
给你些关于
老虎机的建议吧。\p储存的闪电次数越多，
转盘的机会就越多\p1回最多可以有5次
转盘的机会......\p有可能得到4次小奖
和1次大奖，\p这样总共660枚代币，
但那太难了。$

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_CantPlayWithNoCoinCase
source: You can't play if you don't have\na COIN CASE.$
translation: 如果没有代币盒\n就没法在这儿玩。$

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_GymGuideAdvice
source:
Hey, how's it going, CHAMPION-
bound {PLAYER}?\pWATTSON, the LEADER of MAUVILLE
GYM, uses ELECTRIC-type POKéMON.\pIf you challenge him with WATER-type
POKéMON, he'll zap them! Bzzt!\pAnd, he's put in switch-controlled
doors all over his GYM! Eccentric!\pHey, go for it!$
translation:
嗨，怎么样，向冠军的目标
冲刺的{PLAYER}？\p紫堇市道馆的馆主铁旋
使用电属性宝可梦。\p如果用水属性宝可梦
挑战他，会被他电麻的！吱--\p还有，他在自己的道馆里设置了一大堆
由开关控制的电子屏障！怪人！\p好了，加油吧！$

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_GymGuidePostVictory
source: Whoa, you're electrifying!\nYou've powered the door open!$
translation: 哇，真让人吃惊！\n你打开了屏障！$

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_KirkIntro
source: My electric soul, it'll shatter your\ndreams whole, whoa-yeahah!$
translation: 让我的电之魂\n粉碎你的梦想吧，哦--耶！$

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_KirkDefeat
source: That was plugged in, amped up,\nover-driven electric, man!$
translation: 插上了电源，\n但电流过载了！$

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_KirkPostBattle
source: POKéMON and rock, it's all about heart,\nwhoa-yeah!$
translation: 宝可梦和摇滚，\n都要用心来表现，哦--耶！$

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_ShawnIntro
source: I trained under WATTSON!\nThere ain't no way I'll lose easily!$
translation: 我跟着铁旋训练，\n不会轻易输给你的！$

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_ShawnDefeat
source: Unplugged and turned off…$
translation: 电源被拔掉了......$

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_ShawnPostBattle
source: WATTSON, our GYM LEADER, has been\naround for a long, long time.\pHe was battling even before your\ndaddy was born, that tough coot.$
translation: 我们的道馆馆主铁旋\n在这里已经很久很久了，\p你爸爸出生前\n他就在战斗。$

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_BenIntro
source: This GYM's got puzzles!\nIsn't it fun?$
translation: 道馆里有谜题！\n很好玩吧？$

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_BenDefeat
source: It's no fun to lose…$
translation: 输了一点也不好玩......$

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_BenPostBattle
source: WATTSON says he likes setting up\nlittle traps with switches.$
translation: 铁旋说他喜欢\n弄些开关控制的小机关。$

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_VivianIntro
source: With my charm and my POKéMON's moves,\nyou'll be shocked!$
translation: 我的魅力和宝可梦的招式\n会让你大吃一惊！$

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_VivianDefeat
source: I'm shocked by your power!$
translation: 你的力量令我十分吃惊！$

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_VivianPostBattle
source: I've heard that MAUVILLE was founded\nby WATTSON.\pHe was a TRAINER long before we\nbecame TRAINERS.\lHe must know all sorts of things!$
translation: 听说紫堇市是由\n铁旋建立起来的。\p在我们成为训练家之前，\n他已经做了很久的训练家了。\l他一定知道很多很多事情！$

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_AngeloIntro
source: I love shiny things!$
translation: 我喜欢闪光的东西！$

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_AngeloDefeat
source: Oh…\nMy eyes are frazzled…$

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_AngeloPostBattle
source: MAUVILLE GYM's WATTSON has a shiny\nforehead. It makes me happy!$
translation: 紫堇市道馆的铁旋额头上\n总是闪着光，我好兴奋！$

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_WattsonDefeat
source: Wahahahah!\nFine, I lost!\pYou ended up giving me a thrill!\nTake this BADGE!$
translation: 哇哈哈哈！\n好，我输了！\p你让我兴奋极了！\n收下这枚徽章！$

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_ReceivedDynamoBadge
source: {PLAYER} received the DYNAMO BADGE\nfrom WATTSON.$
translation: {PLAYER}从铁旋那里\n得到了电力徽章。$

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_ExplainDynamoBadgeTakeThis
source:
With the DYNAMO BADGE, POKéMON can
use ROCK SMASH out of battle.\pAnd, it will make your POKéMON a little
bit faster, too.\pHmm…
You should take this, too!$
translation:
有了这个电力徽章，
宝可梦就可以在对战外使用碎岩了，\p而且你的宝可梦的速度也会
变得稍微快一点。\p嗯......
你也收下这个吧！$

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_RegisteredWattson
source: Registered GYM LEADER WATTSON\nin the POKéNAV.$
translation: 把道馆馆主铁旋\n登记到宝可导航里了。$

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_WattsonPostBattle
source: I swell with optimism, seeing a promising\nyoung TRAINER like you!$
translation: 能看到像你这样前途无量的年轻\n训练家，我真高兴呀！$

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_WattsonGoForthAndEndeavor
source: Wahahahah!\nGo forth and endeavor, youngster!$
translation: 哇哈哈哈！\n年轻人，向前进，努力吧！$

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_GymStatue
source: MAUVILLE CITY POKéMON GYM$
translation: 紫堇市宝可梦道馆$

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_GymStatueCertified
source: MAUVILLE CITY POKéMON GYM\pWATTSON'S CERTIFIED TRAINERS:\n{PLAYER}$
translation: 紫堇市宝可梦道馆\p铁旋认可的训练家：\n{PLAYER}$

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_WattsonPreRematch
source: WATTSON: Ah-ha! Here at last!\nI know what you want.\lYou want to battle my POKéMON!\pWahahahaha!\pI'll make sparks fly from you!\nDon't say I didn't warn you!$
translation: 铁旋：啊哈！你终于来了！\n我知道你想要什么。\l你想和我的宝可梦对战！\p哇哈哈哈哈！\p别说我没警告你，\l我会让你火花四溅的！$

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_WattsonRematchDefeat
source: Oof…\nOur batteries ran dry…$
translation: 噢......\n我们的电池没电了......$

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_WattsonPostRematch
source:
WATTSON: We'll have to recharge our
batteries again.\pWhen we're fully charged up, we'll
gladly accept your challenge.\pSo, come back again sometime,
won't you?$
translation:
铁旋：我们又要给我们的
电池充电了。\p等我们充好电，
我们会很高兴接受你的挑战。\p所以，有时间的话再来吧，
好吗？$

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_WattsonRematchNeedTwoMons
source:
WATTSON: Ah-ha! Here at last!
I know what you want.\lYou want to battle my POKéMON!\pWahahahaha!\pOops! Wait!
You've only one POKéMON with you!\pCome see me with two or more
POKéMON, all right?$
translation:
铁旋：啊哈！你终于来了！
我知道你想要什么。\l你想和我的宝可梦对战！\p哇哈哈哈哈！\p哎，等等！
你只带了1只宝可梦！\p带2只以上宝可梦
再来吧，好吗？$

label: MauvilleCity_House1_Text_ImRockSmashDudeTakeThis
source:
Woohoo!\pI hear people call me the ROCK SMASH
GUY, but I find that sort of degrading.\pI think I deserve a bit more respect,
like maybe the ROCK SMASH DUDE.\pWoohoo!\pAnyways, your POKéMON look pretty
strong.\pI like that!
Here, take this HIDDEN MACHINE!$
translation:
呀嗬！\p人们叫我碎岩大叔，
但我不喜欢被这么叫，\p我应该有个更棒的称呼，
比如碎岩小哥什么的。\p呀嗬！\p不管怎样，
你的宝可梦似乎很强。\p我喜欢！
那，这个秘传学习器给你！$

label: MauvilleCity_House1_Text_ExplainRockSmash
source:
That HM contains ROCK SMASH.\pIf you come across large boulders
that block your path…\pWell, use that HM move and smash
them right out of your way!\pYes, sir! Smash rocks aside, I say!
Woohoo!$
translation:
那个秘传学习器的内容是
碎岩，\p如果你碰到有巨石
挡了你的路......\p那么，就用这秘传
学习器把它们打得粉碎！\p是的！我说，把巨岩打碎！
呀嗬！$

label: MauvilleCity_House1_Text_MonCanFlyOutOfSmashedRock
source: Oh, yes, if you smash a rock, a POKéMON\ncould come flying out of hiding.\pWoohoo!$
translation: 哦，对了，如果你打碎了岩石，\n藏在里面的宝可梦可能会跳出来。\p呀嗬！$

label: MauvilleCity_House2_Text_BuyHarborMailAtSlateport
source: If I had a BIKE, it'd be easy to cycle to\nSLATEPORT for some shopping.\pI'd be able to buy HARBOR MAIL at the\nPOKéMON MART in SLATEPORT…$
translation: 要是我也有自行车，\n骑车去凯那市买东西就更方便了。\p这样我就能去凯那市的\n友好商店买港口邮件......$

label: MauvilleCity_House2_Text_TradeHarborMailForCoinCase
source: Oh! You have HARBOR MAIL?\nWill you trade it for a COIN CASE?$
translation: 呀！你有港口邮件？\n愿意用它换个代币盒吗？$

label: MauvilleCity_House2_Text_IllTradeYouCoinCase
source: Oh, I'm so happy!\nOkay, I'll trade you a COIN CASE!$
translation: 哈哈，太高兴了！\n好，我用代币盒跟你交换！$

label: MauvilleCity_House2_Text_UseCoinCaseAtGameCorner
source: That COIN CASE can be used\nat the GAME CORNER.$
translation: 你可以在游戏城里\n使用代币盒。$

label: MauvilleCity_House2_Text_ThatsDisappointing
source: Oh, that's disappointing.\pA COIN CASE is needed for the\nGAME CORNER.$
translation: 哎，真失望。\p要在游戏城玩游戏\n必须有代币盒。$

label: MauvilleCity_Mart_Text_ItemsToTemporarilyElevateStats
source:
There are items that temporarily
elevate the stats of POKéMON.\pThe ones I know you use in battle
are X ATTACK and X DEFEND…\pI do believe that there are others
like them.$
translation:
有些道具可以
暂时提升宝可梦的能力，\p我所知道的可以在对战中使用的
有攻击强化和防御强化......\p我肯定还有其它
这样的道具。$

label: MauvilleCity_Mart_Text_DecisionsDetermineBattle
source: Use a certain move, or use an item\ninstead…\pThe TRAINER's decisions determine how\nbattles turn out, I think.$
translation: 使用某种招式，\n或者改用道具......\p我想，是训练家的选择\n决定了对战的走向。$

label: MauvilleCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_ManOverThereSaysWeirdThings
source: That man over there, he says weird\nthings!\pHe's funny in a weird way.\nI doubt I'll forget about him!$
translation: 那边那个人总是在说些\n奇怪的话！\p那个怪人真有趣，\n我想我不可能忘了他！$

label: MauvilleCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_MyDataUpdatedFromRecordCorner
source: When I accessed the RECORD CORNER,\nthe data for what's hot in DEWFORD\lgot updated.\pNow that bit of data is the same\nas my friend's!$
translation: 我去联机俱乐部的记录角时，\n武斗镇的流行词的资料就更新了。\p现在这部分资料和我朋友的\n一模一样！$

label: MauvilleCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_RecordCornerSoundsFun
source: A RECORD CORNER opened upstairs in\nthe POKéMON CENTER.\pI don't know what it's about, but it\nsounds fun. I'll go check it out!$
translation: 宝可梦中心楼上\n开了个联机俱乐部，\p不知道是干什么的，\n但听起来挺好玩。我要去看看！$

label: MauvilleCity_PokemonCenter_2F_Text_Youngster
source:
Did you know that you can link battle
at the COLOSSEUM here?\pThey put up your record on the wall
for everyone to see.\pIt's embarrassing if you lose more
often than you win…$
translation:
你知道吗，你可以在这里的
竞技场进行联机对战，\p他们还会把你的记录
贴在墙上给大家看。\p如果输的比赢的多的话
会感觉很没面子的......$

label: MeteorFalls_1F_1R_Text_WithThisMeteorite
source: Hehehe!\pWith this METEORITE, that thing in\nMT. CHIMNEY will…$
translation: 呵呵呵！\p有了这陨石，\n烟囱山的那个就会......$

label: MeteorFalls_1F_1R_Text_DontExpectMercyFromMagma
source: Heh?\pI don't know who you are, but if you get\nin the way of TEAM MAGMA, don't\lexpect any mercy!$
translation: 哎？\p我不知道你是谁，\n但是胆敢妨碍熔岩队的话，\l别怪我不客气！$

label: MeteorFalls_1F_1R_Text_HoldItRightThereMagma
source: Hold it right there, TEAM MAGMA!\pYou're badly mistaken if you think you\ncan have your way with the world!$
translation: 待在那不许动，熔岩队！\p如果你认为你能为所欲为，\n那就大错特错了！$

label: MeteorFalls_1F_1R_Text_BeSeeingYouTeamAqua
source:
Hehehe!
Even TEAM AQUA joins us!\pBut it's too much trouble to deal with
you all…\pHeh, it doesn't matter!\pWe've got the METEORITE, so off to
MT. CHIMNEY we go!\pHehehe! Be seeing you, you TEAM
AQUA dingbats!$
translation:
呵呵呵！
连海洋队都来凑热闹！\p不过和你们纠缠
太麻烦了......\p嘿，无所谓！\p反正得到了陨石，
出发去烟囱山咯！\p嘿嘿！再见了，
海洋队的笨蛋！$

label: MeteorFalls_1F_1R_Text_ArchieSeenYouBefore
source:
ARCHIE: Didn't I see you before?
At SLATEPORT's MUSEUM?\pAh, so your name is {PLAYER}.\pAt the time, I thought you were one
of TEAM MAGMA's goons.\pHumph…
You're one odd kid.\pTEAM MAGMA is a dangerous group of
total fanatics.\pThey engage in destruction, claiming
to expand the land mass.\pThey are the rivals to us,
the sea-loving TEAM AQUA!$
translation:
水梧桐：我们是不是见过？
在凯那市博物馆？\p啊，你叫{PLAYER}。\p那时，我还以为你是
熔岩队的成员呢。\p哼......
真是个奇怪的孩子。\p熔岩队是一群狂热的
极端分子的组织。\p他们号称要拓展大地，
到处搞破坏。\p和我们热爱海洋的海洋队
势不两立！$

label: MeteorFalls_1F_1R_Text_BossWeShouldChaseMagma
source: BOSS, we should give chase to\nTEAM MAGMA…$
translation: 老大，我们该去追赶\n熔岩队了......$

label: MeteorFalls_1F_1R_Text_ArchieYesNoTellingWhatMagmaWillDo
source: ARCHIE: Yes, yes, we must!\nWe've got to hurry.\pThere's no telling what TEAM MAGMA\nwill do at MT. CHIMNEY!$
translation: 水梧桐：没错！\n我们得抓紧了。\p谁知道熔岩队会在\n烟囱山搞什么鬼！$

label: MeteorFalls_1F_1R_Text_ArchieFarewell
source: ARCHIE: {PLAYER}, you should keep\nan eye out for TEAM MAGMA, too.\pFarewell!$
translation: 水梧桐：{PLAYER}，你也应该\n提防点熔岩队。\p后会有期！$

label: MeteorFalls_1F_1R_Text_MeetProfCozmo
source:
I… I'm COZMO…
I'm a PROFESSOR…\pTEAM MAGMA asked me to guide them
to METEOR FALLS…\pBut they tricked me.
They even took my METEORITE away…\pAnd then another similar bunch,
TEAM AQUA showed up.\pAfter that…
I don't understand any of it.\pBut that TEAM MAGMA…\pWhat are they going to do with that
METEORITE at MT. CHIMNEY?$
translation:
我......我是索蓝斯......
是一名教授......\p熔岩队要我带他们
去流星瀑布......\p但是他们骗了我。
甚至还拿走了我的陨石......\p然后和他们相似的组织
海洋队出现了。\p在那之后......
我完全搞不清状况。\p但是那个熔岩队......\p他们究竟要把陨石
带到烟囱山上做什么？$

label: MeteorFalls_1F_1R_Text_WhatsTeamMagmaDoingAtMtChimney
source: PROF. COZMO: But that TEAM MAGMA…\pWhat are they going to do with that\nMETEORITE at MT. CHIMNEY?$
translation: 索蓝斯博士：但是那个熔岩队......\p他们究竟要把陨石\n带到烟囱山上做什么？$

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_NicolasIntro
source: This is where we DRAGON users do our\ntraining.\pThe CHAMPION even visits.\nNow do you see how special it is here?$
translation: 这里是我们龙使者\n训练的地方。\p冠军也来过。\n你看得出这里有什么特别吗？$

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_NicolasDefeat
source: Urgh!\nI didn't expect you to be so strong!$
translation: 呃！\n没想到你那么强！$

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_NicolasPostBattle
source: The road ahead remains long and harsh.\pWhen will my POKéMON and I become\nthe best?$
translation: 前方的路还很曲折。\p何时我和我的宝可梦\n会成为最强？$

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_NicolasRegister
source: I want to know more about your power.\nLet me register you in my POKéNAV.$
translation: 我想更多了解你的力量。\n把你登记到宝可导航里吧。$

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_NicolasRematchIntro
source: Since we met, we have trained hard\nwith our sights on number one.\pHelp us see how much stronger we've\nbecome!$
translation: 自从上次相遇，\n我们一直为第一的目标而努力训练。\p帮忙见识一下我们成长\n得有多强大吧！$

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_NicolasRematchDefeat
source: Urgh!\nI didn't expect you to be so strong!$
translation: 呃！\n没想到你那么强！$

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_NicolasPostRematch
source: You've obviously kept up your\nPOKéMON training.\pSo long as you remain strong, I, too,\ncan become stronger!$
translation: 很显然你和\n宝可梦一直都在锻炼。\p只要你变强，我\n也会变得更强！$

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JohnIntro
source: JOHN: We've always battled POKéMON\ntogether as a twosome.\lWe've confidence in ourselves.$
translation: 源：我们一直是\n两人一起战斗的。\l我们对自己充满信心。$

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JohnDefeat
source: JOHN: Oh, my.\nWe've lost, dear wife.$
translation: 源：哦，天。\n我们输了，亲爱的老婆。$

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JohnPostBattle
source: JOHN: We've been married for\nfifty years.\pCome to think of it, I've yet to beat\nmy dear wife in a battle.$
translation: 源：我们结婚\n50年了。\p想想看，我都没有击败过\n我亲爱的老婆。$

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JohnNotEnoughMons
source: JOHN: Well, well, what a young TRAINER!\pWill you battle with us? If so, you'll\nhave to return with more POKéMON.$
translation: 源：多么年轻的训练家！\p想和我们对战吗？想的话就\n带来更多的宝可梦。$

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JohnRegister
source: JOHN: Young TRAINER, if the chance\narises, will you battle with us again?$
translation: 源：年轻的训练家，如果有机会\n的话，你还会和我们对战吗？$

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JayIntro
source: JAY: We've been married for\nfifty years.\pThe bond we share as a couple could\nnever be broken.$
translation: 初：我们结婚\n50年了。\p我们作为夫妻的牵绊\n永远不会解除。$

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JayDefeat
source: JAY: Oh, dear.\nWe've lost, my dear husband.$
translation: 初：哦，亲爱的。\n我们输了，我亲爱的老公。$

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JayPostBattle
source: JAY: Fifty years of marriage…\pIf we ever argued, we always settled\nit with a POKéMON battle…$
translation: 初：结婚50年了......\p每当我们吵架，我们都是通过\n宝可梦对战来解决......$

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JayNotEnoughMons
source: JAY: Well, well, aren't you a young\nTRAINER?\pIf you'd care to battle with us, you'll\nhave to come back with more POKéMON.$
translation: 初：好啦，好啦，你难道不是\n年轻的训练家？\p如果你想和我们对战，\n就得拿来更多的宝可梦。$

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JohnRematchIntro
source: JOHN: We've always battled POKéMON\ntogether as a twosome.\lWe've confidence in ourselves.$
translation: 源：我们一直是\n两人一起战斗的。\l我们对自己充满信心。$

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JohnRematchDefeat
source: JOHN: Oh, my.\nWe've lost, dear wife.$
translation: 源：天啊。\n我们输了，亲爱的老婆。$

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JohnPostRematch
source: JOHN: Married for fifty years…\pOn reflection, the dear wife and I,\nwe battled day in and day out…$
translation: 源：结婚50年了......\p仔细想想，我和亲爱的老婆\n每天都是在战斗的......$

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JohnRematchNotEnoughMons
source: JOHN: Well, well, what a young TRAINER!\pWill you battle with us? If so, you'll\nhave to return with more POKéMON.$
translation: 源：多么年轻的训练家！\p想和我们战斗吗？想的话就\n带来更多的宝可梦。$

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JayRematchIntro
source: JAY: We've been married for\nfifty years.\pWe've supported each other all that\ntime. We've made ourselves strong.$
