translation: 宝可梦中心真棒！\p你可以随时使用他们\n提供的服务，而且完全免费，\l什么也不用担心！$

label: OldaleTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_WirelessClubNotAvailable
source: The POKéMON WIRELESS CLUB on\nthe second floor was built recently.\pBut they say they're still making\nadjustments.$
translation: 二楼的宝可梦无线俱乐部\n最近刚刚建好，\p但据说现在\n还在调整中。$

label: OldaleTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_TradedInWirelessClub
source: The POKéMON WIRELESS CLUB on\nthe second floor was built recently.\pI traded POKéMON right away.$
translation: 二楼的宝可梦无线俱乐部\n最近刚刚建好，\p我马上就去交换了宝可梦。$

label: OneIsland_Text_BillLetsGoSeeCelio
source:
BILL: Here we are!
This is ONE ISLAND.\pThere are several islands around
here, and this is one of them.\pMy friend CELIO sent the boat to
fetch me here.\pHe's in charge of the island's PC
network by his lonesome.\p…Why am I telling you this now?
Let's just go see CELIO!$
translation:
正辉：我们到喽！
这里是一之岛。\p这附近还有好几个小岛，
这个岛只是其中之一。\p我的朋友锦辉派船来接我。\p他独自管理着
岛上的电脑网络联结。\p......为什么我现在要告诉你这些？
我们先去见锦辉吧！$

label: Text_WhereDoYouWantToSail
source: Ahoy, there!\nWhere do you want to sail?$
translation: 嘿，这里这里！\n你打算坐船去哪儿？$

label: OneIsland_Text_LuckyToHaveCelioHere
source:
Here we are on an island smack in
the middle of nowhere.\pWe're lucky to have an upstanding
young man like CELIO here.\pMy granddaughter was in a tizzy
over CELIO's friend.\pSomething about a famous
POKéMANIAC?\pI'm not sure what that means, but
CELIO is quite the man!$
translation:
我们来到了小岛的正中心。\p有一个像锦辉这样出色的
年轻人真是太幸运了。\p我孙女作为锦辉的朋友
感到很幸福。\p一个有名的
怪兽狂？\p我不清楚这到底是什么意思，
但似乎锦辉就是那样的人。$

label: OneIsland_Text_HavePCLinkageWithKanto
source:
My granddaughter was in a tizzy
over a new breakthrough.\pShe said we now have PC linkage
with people in KANTO.\pI'm not sure what that means, but
CELIO is quite the man!$
translation:
我的孙女对于新的突破
有些兴奋。\p她说我们终于等来了
电脑与关都的联动。\p我不确定这到底是什么意思，
但锦辉就是能做到这种事的人。$

label: OneIsland_Text_HavePCLinkageWithHoenn
source:
My granddaughter was in a tizzy
over a new breakthrough.\pShe said we finally have PC linkage
with people in HOENN.\pI'm not sure what that means, but
CELIO is quite the man.\pHe would make a fine husband for
my granddaughter!$
translation:
我的孙女对于新的突破
有些兴奋。\p她说我们终于等来了
电脑与丰缘的联动。\p我不清楚这到底是什么意思，
但锦辉真的做到了！\p对我孙女来说，
他一定会成为一个好丈夫！$

label: OneIsland_Text_IslandSign
source: ONE ISLAND\nFriends Gather at Knot Island$
translation: 一之岛\n朋友们聚集的小岛$

label: OneIsland_Text_PokemonNetCenterSign
source: Expanding the POKéMON World!\nPOKéMON NET CENTER$
translation: 扩展宝可梦的世界！\n宝可梦网络中心$

label: OneIsland_Text_IsntWarmClimateHereGreat
source: Hi, sight-seeing, are you?\nIsn't the warm climate here great?$
translation: 嗨，你是这里来观光的吗？\n这里气候温和，真是个好地方啊。$

label: OneIsland_House1_Text_GazeUponVolcanoOnSunnyDays
source: On sunny days, I step out and gaze\nupon the volcano.\pThat's my daily routine.$
translation: 在晴天的日子，\n我会去好好地观察火山。\p这是我日常做的事。$

label: OneIsland_House1_Text_LastTimeMtEmberErupted
source: Let me think… When was the last\ntime MT. EMBER erupted?$
translation: 让我想想......上一次\n灯火山爆发是什么时候？$

label: OneIsland_House2_Text_IWantToStayHereForever
source: Young people all want to go off to\nbig cities.\pBut I want to stay here forever!$
translation: 年轻人都想着去大城市。\p不过我想在这里待一辈子！$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_EmberSpa_Text_WaterWarmsMeToCore
source:
Hm!
Haaaaaaaaaaah!\pAaaah! This is heavenly!
The water warms me to my core!\pYou should jump in, too.\pGo to the middle, relax, and get
good and warm!$
translation:
嗯！
哈哈！\p真是天堂般的感受！
这些温暖的水涌入我的心！\p你也应该跳进来的。\p到中间去，放松，
去体会温暖和美好！$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_EmberSpa_Text_EnjoyBowlOfChowder
source: My favorite part of bathing comes\nup right after this.\pI enjoy a bowl of chowder to\nwarm me from the inside, too!$
translation: 马上要进行的是\n沐浴中我最喜欢的一个环节。\p我也喜欢吃下一碗大杂烩，\n享受从身体内部涌出温暖的感觉。$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_EmberSpa_Text_WaterExquisiteFullyRefreshed
source: The water is perfectly warm.\nIt feels exquisite…\p{PLAYER} and the POKéMON were\nfully refreshed!$
translation: 水非常温暖。\n有一种绝妙的感觉......\p{PLAYER}的宝可梦完全恢复精神了！$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_EmberSpa_Text_HotSpringIsTherapeutic
source: Soaking in a hot spring pool is\ntherapeutic, people say.$
translation: 据说，\n泡温泉有益于身体健康。$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_EmberSpa_Text_SeeHowSmoothMySkinIs
source: Have a look at my face.\nSee how smooth my skin is?\pThe hot spring's water keeps my\nskin younger than my age.$
translation: 看看我的脸。\n我的皮肤是不是很光滑？\p泡温泉使我看起来更年轻。$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_EmberSpa_Text_BrunoVisitsSpaOnOccasion
source:
After an honest day of training,
nothing beats a relaxing soak in\lthe hot spring pool.\pBRUNO, who's a senior ahead of me,
visits the SPA on occasion.\pHe comes to rehab injuries, both
his own and his POKéMON's.$
translation:
在经过一天辛苦的训练之后，
没有比泡温泉更让人惬意的事了。\p我的一个前辈叫做希巴。
有时会他会和他的宝可梦\p一起来到这个温泉，
在这里做水疗。$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_EmberSpa_Text_UsedThisToMakeEmberSpa
source:
Hot springs go hand-in-hand with
volcanoes.\pThe EMBER SPA here, well,
I made it years ago.\pI hewed the pool right out of a
gigantic boulder by hand.\pI was using this at the time.
I suppose I can part with it.$
translation:
温泉是伴随着火山而产生的。\p几年前，
我在这里建造了灯火温泉。\p我从一堆巨大的岩石中，
亲手开辟出了这个池子。\p那时我使用了这招，
我想我是时候该放开它了。$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_EmberSpa_Text_ExplainHM06
source: That shatters boulders as if they\nwere made of crackers.$
translation: 就像它们是用饼干做的一样，\n我用这招砸碎了巨石。$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_MariaIntro
source: The weather's gorgeous!\nPerfect for a battle!$
translation: 天气真好！\n最适合战斗了！$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_MariaDefeat
source: Aiyeeeeh!$
translation: 哎哟！$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_MariaPostBattle
source: Please don't splash my face!\nYou'll ruin the makeup.$
translation: 请不要把水花溅到我脸上！\n会把我的妆弄花了。$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_AbigailIntro
source: I'm beginning to get a sunburn…$
translation: 我快被晒伤了......$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_AbigailDefeat
source: Oh, you're so awful.$
translation: 呃，你真糟糕。$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_AbigailPostBattle
source: I like that cap you have.\nMaybe I should wear one, too…$
translation: 我喜欢你的帽子。\n也许我也应该戴一顶......$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_FinnIntro
source: Seen from here, MT. EMBER towers\ninto the sky.$
translation: 从这里望过去，灯火山的塔\n冲上了云霄。$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_FinnDefeat
source: Well, aren't you tough?$
translation: 呃，你很强吗？$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_FinnPostBattle
source: The sky is immense around these\nparts.$
translation: 巨大的天空笼罩着四周。$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_GarrettIntro
source: I took a break from swimming,\nonly to have you challenge me?$
translation: 我是为了休息才来游泳，\n没想到你会来挑战我？$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_GarrettDefeat
source: Hey, what the…\nYou're good, you!$
translation: 喂，怎么会......\n你真是太厉害了！$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_GarrettPostBattle
source: Instead of using SURF all the time,\nyou should swim some.$
translation: 你也该自己下水游游，\n而不是一直在冲浪。$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_TommyIntro
source: Wait! Wait a second!\nI think I've hooked a big one!$
translation: 等等！等一下！\n我这一杆肯定有货！$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_TommyDefeat
source: I've lost it all again…$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_TommyPostBattle
source: Not only did I lose, the big one\ngot away from me, too!$
translation: 我不仅输了，\n还把那只大的放走了！$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_SharonIntro
source: Could you help me out with my\ntraining?$
translation: 你能帮我我训练一下吗？$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_SharonDefeat
source: You were a cut above me.$
translation: 你伤害了我。$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_SharonPostBattle
source: It's clear that you're skilled.\nI like you!$
translation: 显然，你很有能力。\n我喜欢你！$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_TanyaIntro
source: There isn't a day in which we don't\ntrain!$
translation: 今天我们也要训练！$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_TanyaDefeat
source: I'm such a fool!$
translation: 我真愚蠢！$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_TanyaPostBattle
source: I'll train even harder from now on!$
translation: 从现在起我要更努力地训练。$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_SheaIntro
source: Every morning, before breakfast,\nI swim around this island.$
translation: 每天早上吃早饭之前，\n我都要到这座岛周围游泳。$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_SheaDefeat
source: Gasp…\nGasp…$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_SheaPostBattle
source: I lost because I'm pooped from all\nthe running I did…$
translation: 我输了是因为\n我跑步跑得没有力气了......$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_HughIntro
source: Dress appropriately for battle!\nLose that frivolous outfit!$
translation: 要穿着得体地去战斗！\n把那些多余的装备抛开！$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_HughDefeat
source: Why me?!$
translation: 为什么是我？！$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_HughPostBattle
source: Even martial artists are becoming\nfashion conscious these days…$
translation: 现在那些军队的艺术家们\n都变得很时尚了......$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_BryceIntro
source: You know, everything tastes great\nwhen you're out in the wild.$
translation: 知道么？当你在野外时，\n每种东西尝起来都很美味。$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_BryceDefeat
source: Awww, blown!$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_BrycePostBattle
source: The water in volcanic regions is\ndelicious.$
translation: 火山地区的水很好喝。$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_ClaireIntro
source: My lunch filled us up, so will you\nbattle us for some exercise?$
translation: 我们的午餐吃得很饱，\n你想和我们战斗帮助我们消化吗？$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_ClaireDefeat
source: That made me all sweaty.$
translation: 这让我浑身都出汗了。$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_ClairePostBattle
source: What should I do?\nI feel famished again.$
translation: 我该怎么办？\n我又饿了。$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_KiaIntro
source: KIA: My big brother and I make\nan awesome combination!$
translation: 阿幸：我哥哥和我\n是一个很可怕的组合！$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_KiaDefeat
source: KIA: Huh?!\nI can't believe it!$
translation: 阿幸：啊？！\n我无法相信！$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_KiaPostBattle
source: KIA: How could there be anyone\nbetter than my big brother?$
translation: 阿幸：怎么会有人\n比我哥哥更厉害？$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_KiaNotEnoughMons
source: KIA: If you want to battle with\nus, you have to bring at least two\lPOKéMON with you.$
translation: 阿幸：如果你想和我们战斗，\n你必须带着两只宝可梦。$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_MikIntro
source: MIK: Together with KIA, I'm afraid\nof nothing!$
translation: 阿和：和阿幸一起，\n我不惧怕任何事情！$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_MikDefeat
source: MIK: Whoa!\nThat's too much!$
translation: 阿和：哇！\n够了！$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_MikPostBattle
source: MIK: How could my combination\nwith KIA fail?$
translation: 阿和：我和阿幸的组合\n怎么会输？$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_MikNotEnoughMons
source: MIK: Hey, do you want to battle\nwith us two?\pBring two or more POKéMON with\nyou, then.$
translation: 阿和：嘿，你想和我们俩战斗吗？\p你得带着至少两只宝可梦。$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_RouteSign
source: This is KINDLE ROAD.\pGo straight for MT. EMBER.$
translation: 这是热气之路。\p直走去灯火山。$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_EmberSpaSign
source: Light the Fire in Your Heart!\nEMBER SPA$
translation: 点燃你火热的心！\n灯火温泉$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_BillHeyThereCelio
source: BILL: Hey, there!\nCELIO!$
translation: 正辉：哟，这边这边！\n锦辉！$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_CelioCantBelieveYouCameOut
source: CELIO: BILL!\nI can't believe you came out here.$
translation: 锦辉：正辉！\n你还真的来这儿了。$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_BillHowsYourResearchComing
source: BILL: Well, absolutely!\nHow's your research coming along?\p…Oh, wait a sec.$
translation: 正辉：嗯，当然了！\n你的研究进行的怎么样了？\p......噢，等一下。$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_ThisIsMyBuddyCelio
source: {PLAYER}, this is my buddy CELIO.\nHe's one dedicated PC MANIAC!$
translation: {PLAYER}，这是我的好友锦辉。\n他是个专业的电脑狂！$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_PlayerIsRisingPokemonChamp
source: CELIO, this is {PLAYER}, a rising\ncontender as the POKéMON CHAMP!$
translation: 锦辉，这是{PLAYER}，一个向着\n宝可梦联盟发起冲击的新星！$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_PlayerIsReigningPokemonChamp
source: CELIO, this is {PLAYER}, the\nreigning POKéMON CHAMP!$
translation: 锦辉，这是{PLAYER}，\n本届的宝可梦冠军！$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_CelioThatsReallyImpressive
source: CELIO: That's really impressive.\pI hate to say it, but I have zero\naptitude for battling.\pAnyways, I'm glad to meet you.$
translation: 锦辉：这真让人印象深刻。\p我不喜欢这样说，不过\n我对战斗没有兴趣。\p怎样都好，幸会幸会。$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_BillBringMeUpToSpeed
source: BILL: So, bring me up to speed.\nHow's your machine running?$
translation: 正辉：所以，回到正题吧。\n你的机器运行得怎样了？$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_CelioPCsCantLinkWithYours
source: CELIO: It's running fine, but we're\ntoo remote out here.\pThe PCs on this island just can't\nlink with your PC, BILL.$
translation: 锦辉：它们工作正常，不过\n我们这边比较偏僻。\p岛上的电脑跟你的电脑 \n连接不上。$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_BillLetMeHelpYou
source: BILL: Oh, yeah?\nOkay, let me take a look-see.\p…Hang on here…\nI think we can make it work.\lLet me help you, okay?$
translation: 正辉：喔，这样？\n好吧，让我看看吧。\p......等下......\n我想我们能把它弄好。\l让我来帮忙，好吗？$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_CanYouDeliverThisMeteoritePlayer
source:
{PLAYER}, can I get you to wait for
me just a bit?\p…Actually, can I get you to do
me a favor?\pThe island next to this one's
called TWO ISLAND.\pThere's a guy there that runs
a GAME CORNER.\pHe has this thing for rare rocks
and gems.\pWe keep in touch, being fellow
maniacs.\pSo, can I get you to deliver this
METEORITE to him?$
translation:
{PLAYER}，你可以在这里
等我一会吗？\p......事实上我想请你
帮我一个忙。\p这个岛旁边的另一个岛
叫做二之岛。\p那里有个经营
游戏厅的男人。\p他有很多珍贵的石头
和宝石。\p作为共同的研究狂，
我们一直保持着联系，哈哈。\p所以，能请你帮我
把这陨石交给他吗？$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_AcceptedMeteoriteFromBill
source: {PLAYER} accepted the METEORITE\nfrom BILL.$
translation: {PLAYER}从正辉手上\n接过陨石。$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_CelioPleaseTakeThis
source: CELIO: {PLAYER}, if you are going\nto TWO ISLAND, please take this.$
translation: 锦辉：{PLAYER}，如果你要去\n二之岛，带上这个吧。$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_PassLetsYouTravelBetweenIslands
source: It's a PASS for the ferry service\nserving the local islands.\pIt will let you travel between the\nISLANDS ONE, TWO, and THREE.\pOh, you should have this, too.$
translation: 这是这边的群岛的\n渡轮准乘证。\p拿着它你就可以去\n一之岛、二之岛和三之岛了。\p噢，把这也拿着吧。$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_ReceivedExtraPageForTownMap
source: {PLAYER} received an extra page\nfor the TOWN MAP!$
translation: {PLAYER}城镇地图得到了\n新的一页。$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_ReceivedTownMap
source: {PLAYER} received\na TOWN MAP!$
translation: {PLAYER}得到了\n一张城镇地图！$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_BillCatchYouLater
source: BILL: I'll catch you later!\nSay hi to the guy for me!$
translation: 正辉：我等会会追上你的！\n代我向他问好！$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_HmmHowAboutLikeThis
source: Hmm…\pHow about we try this like this…$
translation: 嗯......\p我们不如试试这样做吧......$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_GotPCWorkingStrollAWhileMore
source:
Oh, hey, {PLAYER}!\pDid you see?
We got the PC working!\pI've got a few things to show
CELIO here.\pCan you go out on a stroll or
something for a while more?$
translation:
噢，这边，{PLAYER}！\p看到了吗？
我们把电脑弄好了！\p我有点东西 
想给锦辉看看。\p你可以先到外面
等等我吗？$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_SorryForBeingPoorHost
source: I'm sorry for taking up so much of\nBILL's time.\pI'm also sorry for being such a \npoor host on your visit here.$
translation: 很抱歉占用了\n正辉这么多时间。\p同时我也为没能尽\n地主之谊而道歉。$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_UsualPCServicesUnavailable
source: The usual PC services aren't\navailable…$
translation: 电脑服务\n现在不能使用......$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_BillOhHeyPlayer
source: BILL: Oh, hey!\n{PLAYER}!$
translation: 正辉：噢，这边！\n{PLAYER}！$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_BillWeGotItDone
source: BILL: What kept you so long?\nBeen out having a good time?\pWe got it done.\nThe PCs are up and running!$
translation: 正辉：这儿有什么使你陶醉的东西吗？\n还是已经感觉腻了吗？\p这边的事都处理好了。\n这些电脑都能正常运作了！$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_CelioJobWentQuick
source: CELIO: The job went incredibly\nquick.\pBILL is one amazing guy…$
translation: 锦辉：这事处理得真快。\p正辉真是个了不起的家伙......$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_BillYouveLearnedALot
source: BILL: No, no! There was almost\nnothing left for me to do.\pCELIO, I have to hand it to you.\nYou've learned a lot.$
translation: 正辉：不，不！这没剩下\n什么我可以做的事了。\p锦辉，这边交给你了。\n相信你也学到了不少吧。$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_CelioOhReallyEhehe
source: CELIO: Oh, really?\nEhehe…$
translation: 锦辉：噢，真的？\n嘿嘿......$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_BillWeShouldHeadBackToKanto
source: BILL: Well, there you have it.\nI'm finished with the job.\lWe should head back to KANTO.\pCELIO, I'll be seeing you again.$
translation: 正辉：好了，就这么简单。\n我已经完成了我的工作了。\l我们回关都去吧。\p锦辉，下次再见了。$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_CelioPromiseIllShowYouAroundSometime
source: CELIO: {PLAYER}, I'm really sorry\nthat we sent you off alone today.\pI promise, I will show you around\nthese islands sometime.$
translation: 锦辉：{PLAYER}，今天没能\n让你享受一下，真的很抱歉。\p我保证，下次你来的时候\n我会带你在这些岛上逛逛。$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_CelioImModifyingMyNetworkMachine
source:
CELIO: Hello!
You look awfully busy as always.\pHow am I doing?\pWell, I'm modifying my Network
Machine.\pWhen I get done with the machine,
I hope you'll be first to use it,\l{PLAYER}.$
translation:
锦辉：你好！
你看来跟平时一样的忙。\p我？\p嗯，我最近在调整
我的网络服务器。\p我弄好了之后，
我希望你是第一个试用的，\l{PLAYER}。$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_CelioCaughtMoreMonMaybeICanBeUseful
source:
CELIO: {PLAYER}, how have things
been for you?\pOh, is that right?
You've caught more POKéMON.\pDo you know what?
Maybe I can be useful to you.$
translation:
锦辉：{PLAYER}，
你最近过的怎样？\p噢，这样？
你最近抓到很多宝可梦。\p知道不？
也许我能帮上你的忙。$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_YoullBeTradingFromTrainersFarAway
source:
I'm modifying the Network Machine
right now.\pI'm changing it so it can handle
trades over long distances.\pWhen I get finished, you'll be
trading for exotic POKéMON from\lTRAINERS far away.$
translation:
我正在调整 
我的网络服务器。\p我正在把它设定成
可以远距离的传送。\p我完成后，你可以
跟远方的训练家 \l交换宝可梦。$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_NeedsSpecialGemstone
source: But, there is a slight catch.\pFor the link to work, the Machine\nneeds a special gemstone.\pIt's supposed to be on ONE ISLAND,\nbut I haven't found one yet.\pWho knows where it could be.$
translation: 不过，现在有点小问题。\p要让这运行，它要\n装上一个特别的宝石。\p听说有一个在一之岛上，\n不过我一直找不到。\p天晓得它在哪儿。$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_TryingToFindGem
source:
I was trying to find the gem
even while I was studying.\pAs a result, I've made no headway
in both my search and studies…\pIf I relied on BILL, I'm sure my
research would progress.\pBut this time, I want to try to do
things by myself.$
translation:
我甚至在读书的时候 
也一直试着找到它。\p结果，我不能兼顾好
研究和读书的事......\p如果我找正辉的话，我相信
研究一定会很顺利。\p不过，这次我想靠
自己来完成。$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_OhThats
source: Oh!\nTh-that's…$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_HandedRubyToCelio
source: {PLAYER} handed the RUBY\nto CELIO.$
translation: {PLAYER}把红宝石\n交给了锦辉。$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_MayIAskOneMoreFavor
source: Thank you!\n{PLAYER}, you're simply amazing.\p… … …  … … …\pUm… May I ask one more giant favor\nof you?$
translation: 谢谢你！\n{PLAYER}，你真的是太棒了。\p...... ...... ......\p嗯......我可以请你\n帮我另一个忙吗？$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_PleaseINeedYourHelp
source: It… It's not anything weird.\nPlease, I need your help.$
translation: 这......这不是什么奇怪的事，\n请你一定要帮我，拜托了。$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_AnotherGemstoneInSeviiIslands
source:
While I was studying gemstones,
I discovered something important.\pThere is another gem that forms
a pair with this RUBY.\pThat other gemstone is supposed to
be in the SEVII ISLANDS.\p{PLAYER}, please, I need you to go
find the other gem.\p{PLAYER}, may I have your ferry
PASS and the TOWN MAP?$
translation:
当我研究宝石时，
我发现了很重要的事。\p世上还存在着
跟红宝石凑成一对的宝石。\p我认为宝石
会在七岛上。\p{PLAYER}，拜托了，请你
帮我去找出它们吧。\p{PLAYER}，我可以看看你的
渡轮票跟城镇地图吗$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_ReturnedTriPassForRainbowPass
source: {PLAYER} returned the TRI-PASS and\nreceived the RAINBOW PASS.$
translation: {PLAYER}归还了三岛通行证，\n并得到了彩虹通行证。$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_ObtainedExtraMapPage
source: Obtained an extra page for the\nTOWN MAP!$
translation: 得到了城镇地图\n的补充页！$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_PassLetYouGetToAllIslands
source: This is my own ferry PASS.\pIt will let you get to all the\nSEVII ISLANDS.\p{PLAYER}, please, I can't do\nit without your help.$
translation: 这是我的渡轮票。\p这能让你在\n七岛间穿梭。\p{PLAYER}，拜托了，我没了你\n我什么都做不到。$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_HandedSapphireToCelio
source: {PLAYER} handed the SAPPHIRE\nto CELIO.$
translation: {PLAYER}把蓝宝石\n交给锦辉。$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_ThankYouGiveMeTime
source:
CELIO: So this is the gem that
forms a pair with the RUBY…\p{PLAYER}, you've gone through a lot
to get this, didn't you?\pYou don't have to tell me. I know
it wasn't easy.\pThank you so much!\pNow it's my turn to work for you!
Please give me a little time.$
translation:
锦辉：那么这就是能跟
红宝石凑成一对的宝石......\p{PLAYER}，你为此付出了
很多努力，对吧？\p你不用告诉我。我知道
这一定不简单。\p非常的感谢你！\p现在是我回报你的时候了！
请给我一点时间。$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_OkayThisIsGood
source: Okay, this is good…$
translation: 行了，这就好了......$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_LinkedUpWithLanette
source: I did it!\nI linked up with LANETTE!$
translation: 我做到了！\n我跟真由美连接上了！$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_ManagedToLinkWithHoennThankYou
source:
{PLAYER}…
{PLAYER}, I did it!\pI've managed to link up with
TRAINERS in the HOENN region!\pFinally, the Network Machine is
fully operational!\p{PLAYER}, I owe it all to you!\pThanks to you, my dream came
true…$
translation:
{PLAYER}......
{PLAYER}，我做到了！\p我成功跟丰缘
的训练家联系上了！\p终于，这个服务器
可以正常运作了！\p{PLAYER}，这都是因为有你！\p感谢你，我的梦想
终于成真了......$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_WishYouBestOfLuck
source: I…\nI'm not crying.\pThat's enough about me!\p{PLAYER}, you're going to keep\nlooking for exotic POKéMON, right?\pI wish you the best of luck!$
translation: 我......\n我才没有哭。\p我已经很满足了！\p{PLAYER}，你会继续\n寻找珍稀的宝可梦的，对吧？\p我祝你好运！$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_CelioHearingRumorsAboutYou
source: CELIO: Hello!\p{PLAYER}, I've been hearing rumors\nabout you.$
translation: 锦辉：你好！\p{PLAYER}，最近我常常听到\n有关你的传闻。$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_BillsFirstMonWasAbra
source:
{PLAYER}, what's your favorite kind
of POKéMON?\pBILL is a POKéMANIAC, so he loves
every kind.\pApparently, the first one he caught
was an ABRA.$
translation:
{PLAYER}，你最喜欢
哪一种宝可梦？\p正辉是个怪兽狂，
所以他每一种都喜欢。\p不过，听说他的第一只
宝可梦是凯西。$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_BillsHometownInGoldenrod
source:
By the way, {PLAYER}, you're from
PALLET TOWN, aren't you?\pI've heard that it's a quiet and
pleasant place.\pBILL's hometown is GOLDENROD CITY,
where his folks still live.\pI've heard that it's quite the
festive, bustling city.\pI'd like to go there one day.$
translation:
说起来，{PLAYER}，你是从
真新镇来的，对吧？\p我听说那里是一个
很宁静跟和平的地方。\p正辉是从满金市过来的，
他的家人还在那边住着。\p听说那边是个
很热闹，很有活力的城市。\p我很想去见识一下。$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_BillCantStomachMilk
source: {PLAYER}, is there anything that\nyou can't stand?\pApparently, BILL simply can't\nstomach milk at all.$
translation: {PLAYER}，你有没有什么\n忍受不了的事？\p听说，正辉的胃\n对牛奶过敏。$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_CameFromPalletDontKnowIt
source: Oh, you're a stranger here!\nHi! Where did you come from?\p…PALLET TOWN?\nI don't know it!$
translation: 哦哦，陌生人啊！\n你好！你从哪儿来的？\p......真新镇？\n我听都没听过！$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_EnormousVolcanoOnIsland
source: On this island, there's an enormous\nvolcano.\pIt hasn't erupted lately, so why\nnot enjoy a hike?$
translation: 在这岛上，有个\n巨大的火山。\p最近都没爆发，\n去试试爬山怎么样？$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_WishICouldTradeWithBoyfriend
source: I wish I could trade POKéMON with\nmy boyfriend who lives far away…$
translation: 我希望可以跟我那\n住很远的男朋友交换宝可梦......$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_TradedWithFarAwayBoyfriend
source: I traded POKéMON with my boyfriend\nfar away!\pEveryone's saying that we can\nthank you and CELIO.\pSo, thank you!$
translation: 我跟我住很远的男朋友\n交换到宝可梦了！\p每个人都说我们\n要感谢你跟锦辉。\p所以，谢谢你！$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_MachineUnderAdjustment
source: Network Machine\nLink Level 0\p…POKéMON Storage System under\nadjustment…$
translation: 网络服务器\n信号强度：0\p......宝可梦储存系统\n正在维护中......$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_MachineLinkedWithKanto
source: Network Machine\nLink Level 1\pLink established with the KANTO\nregion.$
translation: 网络服务器\n信号强度：1\p跟关都地区\n连接上。$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_MachineLinkedWithKantoAndHoenn
source: Network Machine\nLink Level 2\pLink established with the KANTO\nand HOENN regions.$
translation: 网络服务器\n信号强度：2\p跟关都和丰缘地区\n连接上。$

label: OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_ObtainedTriPass
source: Obtained the TRI-PASS!$
translation: 得到了三岛通行证！$

label: OneIsland_TreasureBeach_Text_AmaraIntro
source: Lying back, rocked by the waves…\nIt's exquisite.$
translation: 被波浪冲刷的背部......\n这感觉很美妙。$

label: OneIsland_TreasureBeach_Text_AmaraDefeat
source: I lost…\nIt feels awful.$
translation: 我输了......\n感觉很糟糕。$

label: OneIsland_TreasureBeach_Text_AmaraPostBattle
source: The sea is pleasantly warm in these\nparts.$
translation: 这个地方的海水很温暖。$

label: OneIsland_TreasureBeach_Text_GoodThingsWashUpOnBeach
source: Good things get washed up by the\nocean current onto this beach.\pThat's why I often come here for\nsome beachcombing.$
translation: 有些好的东西有时候会被\n海浪冲到沙滩上来。\p所以所以我经常来这\n沙滩上碰碰运气。$

label: PacifidlogTown_Text_FastRunningCurrent
source: The sea between PACIFIDLOG and\nSLATEPORT has a fast-running tide.\pIf you decide to SURF, you could end\nup swept away somewhere else.$
translation: 暮水镇与凯那市\n之间的海流很急，\p如果你打算冲浪，最后恐怕\n会被冲到谁也不知道的地方。$

label: PacifidlogTown_Text_NeatHousesOnWater
source: See, isn't it neat?\nThese houses are on water!\pI was born here!$
translation: 看，很简单的镇子吧？\n房子都建在水上！\p我就是在这儿出生的！$

label: PacifidlogTown_Text_SkyPillarTooScary
source:
The SKY PILLAR?\p…Oh, you must mean that tall, tall
tower a little further out.\pIf you asked me, I wouldn't climb it.
It's too scary to get up that high.\pLife at sea level in PACIFIDLOG,
that suits me fine.$
translation:
天空之柱？\p......哦，你是说不远处
那座高高的塔吧。\p别问我，我不会去爬的，
登那么高太可怕了。\p对我来说，还是住在海平面上的
暮水镇中更安心。$

label: PacifidlogTown_House1_Text_RegiStory
source:
In the HOENN region, there are three
POKéMON that represent the power of\lrock, ice, and steel.\pEach of them is said to hide away deep
inside caves.\pThat's the story I heard when I was
just a little kid.$
translation:
在丰缘地区有3只宝可梦，
分别代表岩石、冰雪、钢铁的力量，\p据说它们都躲藏在
某些山洞的深处。\p这是我孩提时
听过的传说。$

label: PacifidlogTown_House1_Text_SixDotsOpenThreeDoors
source: “Six dots open three doors.”\pGrandpa used to say that, but I don't\nknow what he meant.$
translation: "6个点打开3扇门"。\p爷爷经常这么说，\n但我不知道是什么意思。$

label: PacifidlogTown_House2_Text_ChairmansYoungerBrotherOnVacation
source: Er-hem!\pI am the POKéMON FAN CLUB's most\nimportant person, the CHAIRMAN's\lyounger brother.\pI'm here enjoying my vacation with\nPOKéMON, yes, indeed.$
translation: 咳咳！\p我是宝可梦发烧友俱乐部的\n核心成员之一，\l会长的弟弟。\p我来这里和宝可梦\n一起度假，就是这样。$

label: PacifidlogTown_House2_Text_AhYourPokemon
source: Ah!\nYour POKéMON…$
translation: 啊！\n你的宝可梦......$

label: PacifidlogTown_House2_Text_AdoringPokemonTakeThis
source: It clearly likes you very much.\pA POKéMON that adoring and adorable\ndeserves a TM like this, no?$
translation: 看起来它很喜欢你。\p一个敬仰你也被敬仰的宝可梦\n值得奖给它这样一个\l招式学习器，对吗？$

label: PacifidlogTown_House2_Text_PutInSomeMoreEffort
source: Hmm…\nIt's not bad, but it's also not good.\pYou, as the TRAINER, need to put in\nsome more effort.$
translation: 唔......\n不怎么样，但也差不到哪儿去。\p作为一个训练家，\n你要更努力啊。$

label: PacifidlogTown_House2_Text_ViciousPokemonTakeThis
source: It has a vicious look to it.\pA frightening POKéMON like that\ndeserves a TM like this.$
translation: 它似乎充满了敌意。\p这样可怕的宝可梦，\n给它这个招式学习器吧。$

label: PacifidlogTown_House2_Text_ExplainReturnFrustration
source: If a POKéMON likes you a lot, RETURN's\npower is enhanced.\pIf it doesn't like you, FRUSTRATION's\npower goes up.$
translation: 如果宝可梦非常喜欢你，\n报恩的威力就会增强。\p如果它不喜欢你，\n迁怒的威力则会提升。$

label: PacifidlogTown_House2_Text_GetGoodTMInXDays
source: Oh, yes. In about {STR_VAR_1} or so days,\nI should be getting a good TM or two.\pYou should come see me then.\nI'll give you a TM that's suitable for\lyour POKéMON.$
translation: 啊，是的，大概{STR_VAR_1}天后我能得到\n一两个不错的招式学习器，\p那时再来找我吧，\n我会给你适合\l你的宝可梦的招式学习器。$

label: PacifidlogTown_House2_Text_Rurii
source: AZURILL: Rurii.$
translation: 露力丽：露莉莉。$

label: PacifidlogTown_House2_Text_VeryFriendlyWithTrainer
source: It appears to be very friendly with the\nTRAINER.$
translation: 看上去它对训练家\n非常友好。$

label: PacifidlogTown_House2_Text_Rururi
source: AZURILL: Rururi!$
translation: 露力丽：露露莉！$

label: PacifidlogTown_House2_Text_DoesntLikeTrainerVeryMuch
source: It doesn't appear to like the TRAINER\nvery much.$
translation: 它好像不是很喜欢\n它的训练家。$

label: PacifidlogTown_House3_Text_WillingToTradeIt
source:
Check out this {STR_VAR_2}!\pIt's the {STR_VAR_2} that I caught
yesterday to celebrate my birthday!\pOh, I can see that you want it!
After all, it's priceless!\pI'll tell you what. I might be willing
to trade it for a {STR_VAR_1}.$
translation:
看看这个{STR_VAR_2}！\p是我昨天为庆祝自己的生日
捉到的{STR_VAR_2}！\p啊，看来你想要它！
毕竟，它是无可估价的！\p但你如果愿意用{STR_VAR_1}
跟我换的话，我也可以考虑。$

label: PacifidlogTown_House3_Text_ItsSubtlyDifferentThankYou
source: Oh, so this is a {STR_VAR_1}?\pIt's sort of like a {STR_VAR_2},\nand yet it's subtly different.\pThank you!$
translation: 呀，这个是{STR_VAR_1}？\p虽然跟{STR_VAR_2}有点像，\n但它们还是有不同之处。\p谢谢！$

label: PacifidlogTown_House3_Text_WontAcceptAnyLessThanRealMon
source: No, no, no! I won't accept any\nless than a real {STR_VAR_1}!$
translation: 不不不，除了真正的{STR_VAR_1}，\n我什么都不换！$

label: PacifidlogTown_House3_Text_NotDesperateOrAnything
source: Oh, so you're not going to go through\nwith this?\pThat's cool. I'm not desperate to make\na trade or anything.$
translation: 哦？你不想考虑一下吗？\p也好，我也不是急着想交换的。$

label: PacifidlogTown_House3_Text_ReallyWantedToGetBagon
source: I know I could go looking for one\non my own, but…\pBut I really wanted to get a BAGON\nthat another TRAINER caught…$
translation: 我知道我也能自己\n去找一只，但是......\p我真的很想要一只\n其他训练家捕捉的宝贝龙......$

label: PacifidlogTown_House3_Text_IsThatAPokedex
source: Is that a POKéDEX?\pDid you get to meet a lot of different\nPOKéMON?\pI wish I was like you.$
translation: 那是宝可梦图鉴吗？\p你见过了很多不同的\n宝可梦了吗？\p我要是也能像你一样多好。$

label: PacifidlogTown_House4_Text_PeopleSawHighFlyingPokemon
source: People were saying they saw a POKéMON\nflying high above HOENN.\pIs it flying around all the time?\nDoesn't it need to rest somewhere?$
translation: 有人说看到一只宝可梦\n从丰缘地区上空飞过。\p它总是在天空中飞吗？\n它不用休息吗？$

label: PacifidlogTown_House4_Text_SkyPokemon
source: A sky POKéMON!\nA sky POKéMON!$
translation: 空中的宝可梦！\n空中的宝可梦！$

label: PacifidlogTown_House4_Text_WhereDidYouComeFrom
source: Where did you come from?$
translation: 你从哪个城镇来？$

label: PacifidlogTown_House4_Text_YesTown
source: Yes?\nYES TOWN?\pI've never heard of a place like that.$
translation: 什么？\n"是"镇？\p我从没听说过那种地方。$

label: PacifidlogTown_House4_Text_YouHaveToComeFromSomewhere
source: No? That doesn't make any sense.\nYou have to come from somewhere.\pOh! Wait! You're not going to say you\nwere born at the bottom of the sea?$
translation: 什么？我可不信，\n你肯定是从什么地方来的。\p哎！等等！你不会说\n你是生在海底的吧？$

label: PacifidlogTown_House5_Text_CantSeeMirageIslandToday
source: I can't see MIRAGE ISLAND today…$
translation: 今天看不见幻之岛......$

label: PacifidlogTown_House5_Text_CanSeeMirageIslandToday
source: Oh! Oh my!\nI can see MIRAGE ISLAND today!$
translation: 啊！哦，天哪！\n今天看见了幻之岛！$

label: PacifidlogTown_House5_Text_MirageIslandAppearDependingOnWeather
source: MIRAGE ISLAND…\pIt must become visible and invisible\ndepending on the weather conditions\lthat make mirages appear.\pOr is it really appearing and\ndisappearing?$
translation: 幻之岛......\p那大概是因为\n天气变化而\l不断隐现的幻影。\p还是说，它真的不停地\n消失或出现？$

label: PacifidlogTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_WhatColorTrainerCard
source: What color is your TRAINER CARD?\nMine's copper!$
translation: 你的训练家卡是什么颜色？\n我的是紫铜的！$

label: PacifidlogTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_OnColonyOfCorsola
source: PACIFIDLOG TOWN floats on top of\na colony of CORSOLA.\pIf I told you that, would you believe\nme?$
translation: 暮水镇浮在\n大群太阳珊瑚上。\p我这么说的话，\n你会相信吗？$

label: PacifidlogTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_AncestorsLivedOnBoats
source: The ancestors of the people in\nPACIFIDLOG were said to have been\lborn on boats and then lived and died \laboard them.\pI understand that they lived that way\nbecause they were searching for\lsomething.$
translation: 据说暮水镇人的祖先\n一生都与船只相伴--\l在船上生活，在船上终老。\p我想他们选择这样的生活，\n是为了追寻什么重要的东西吧。$

label: PalletTown_Text_OakDontGoOut
source: 大木：喂！等一下！别出去！$
translation: 大木：嘿，等等！\n别急着出去！$

label: PalletTown_Text_OakGrassUnsafeNeedMon
source: 大木：外面很危险！草丛里住着野生\n宝可梦！\p你需要有自己的宝可梦来保护自己。\p我知道了！跟我来吧！$
translation:
大木：太危险了！
有野生的宝可梦生活在草丛里！\p你需要拥有自己的宝可梦
来保护你自己。\p我知道了！
这边走，跟我来一下吧！$

label: PalletTown_Text_RaisingMonsToo
source: I'm raising POKéMON, too.\pWhen they get strong, they can\nprotect me.$
translation: 我也在培育宝可梦。\p等当它们变得强大了，\n它们就能保护我了。$

label: PalletTown_Text_CanStoreItemsAndMonsInPC
source: Technology is incredible!\pYou can now store and recall items\nand POKéMON as data via PC.$
translation: 科学力量真是神奇！\p通过电脑你可以像管理数据一样\n存取物品和宝可梦。$

label: PalletTown_Text_OakPokemonResearchLab
source: 大木宝可梦研究所$
translation: 大木宝可梦研究所$

label: PalletTown_Text_PlayersHouse
source: {PLAYER}'s house$
translation: {PLAYER}的家$

label: PalletTown_Text_RivalsHouse
source: {RIVAL}'s house$
translation: {RIVAL}的家$

label: PalletTown_Text_TownSign
source: PALLET TOWN\nShades of your journey await!$
translation: 真新镇\n在此揭开你的旅程！$

label: PalletTown_Text_OakLetMeSeePokedex
source: 大木：啊，{PLAYER}！你回\n来啦？\p你的宝可梦图鉴填了多少了？\p能让我看看吗？\p我看看……$
translation: 大木：啊，{PLAYER}！\n你回来啦？\p宝可梦图鉴完成得怎么样了？\p能让我看看吗？\p那我瞧瞧......$

label: PalletTown_Text_CaughtXPuttingInHonestEffort
source: You've caught {STR_VAR_2}…\pHm, it looks as if you're putting\nin an honest effort.\pWhen you manage to fill it some\nmore, come show me, please.$
translation: 你已经抓到了{STR_VAR_2}种......\p嗯，看得出来，\n你的确付出了你的努力。\p等你完成得多一些的时候，\n再拿来给我看看吧。$

label: PalletTown_Text_CaughtXImpressiveFollowMe
source:
You've caught… {STR_VAR_2}!?
Now, this is impressive!\pThere's something I wanted to ask
of you, {PLAYER}.\pCome.
Follow me.$
translation: 你抓到了......{STR_VAR_2}种！？\n真是难以置信！\p我有个请求，{PLAYER}。\p跟我来。$

label: PalletTown_Text_OakYouEnjoyingTraveling
source:
OAK: Ah, {PLAYER}!
You seem to be enjoying traveling.\pKnowing you, {PLAYER}, I can easily
imagine you going out to even more\lexotic locales.\pGood for you, good for you.
Hohoho.$
translation:
大木：啊，{PLAYER}！
你好像很喜欢旅行啊。\p{PLAYER}，
我猜想你一定会到\l更奇异地地方去冒险。\p好极了，好极了。
呵呵呵。$

label: PalletTown_PlayersHouse_1F_Text_AllBoysLeaveOakLookingForYou
source: MOM: …Right.\nAll boys leave home someday.\lIt said so on TV.\pOh, yes. PROF. OAK, next door, was\nlooking for you.$
translation: 妈妈：......好吧。\n电视上说过。\l每一个男孩子都有离开家的那一天。\p对了，隔壁的大木博士\n正在找你呢。$

label: PalletTown_PlayersHouse_1F_Text_AllGirlsLeaveOakLookingForYou
source: MOM: …Right.\nAll girls dream of traveling.\lIt said so on TV.\pOh, yes. PROF. OAK, next door, was\nlooking for you.$
translation: 妈妈 ......好吧。\n电视上说过，\l每一个女孩子都梦想着去旅行。\p对了，隔壁的大木博士\n正在找你呢。$

label: PalletTown_PlayersHouse_1F_Text_YouShouldTakeQuickRest
source: MOM: {PLAYER}!\nYou should take a quick rest.$
translation: 妈妈 {PLAYER}！\n你应该稍微休息一下。$

label: PalletTown_PlayersHouse_1F_Text_LookingGreatTakeCare
source: MOM: Oh, good! You and your\nPOKéMON are looking great.\lTake care now!$
translation: 妈妈：嗯，很好！你和你的\n宝可梦看起来精力十足。\l路上小心！$

label: PalletTown_PlayersHouse_1F_Text_MovieOnTVFourBoysOnRailroad
source: There's a movie on TV.\nFour boys are walking on railroad\ltracks.\p…I better go, too.$
translation: 电视上播放着一部电影。\n四个男孩沿着铁轨\l步行着开始了旅行。\p......我也该走了。$

label: PalletTown_PlayersHouse_1F_Text_MovieOnTVGirlOnBrickRoad
source: There's a movie on TV.\nA girl with her hair in pigtails is\lwalking up a brick road.\p…I better go, too.$
translation: 电视上播放着一部电影。\n一个扎着马尾的女孩\l沿着砖块砌成的路开始了旅行。\p......我也该走了。$

label: PalletTown_PlayersHouse_1F_Text_OopsWrongSide
source: Oops, wrong side…$
translation: 哎哟，方向错了......$

label: PalletTown_PlayersHouse_2F_Text_PlayedWithNES
source: {PLAYER} played with the NES.\p…Okay!\nIt's time to go!$
translation: {PLAYER}在玩红白机。\p......好的！\n开始吧！$

label: PalletTown_PlayersHouse_2F_Text_PressLRForHelp
source: It's a posted notice…\pIf you're confused, ask for HELP!\nPress the L or R Button!$
translation: 一份贴士......\p如果你有问题的话就看帮助！\n按L或R键！$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_RivalGrampsIsntAround
source: {RIVAL}: What, it's only {PLAYER}?\nGramps isn't around.$
translation: {RIVAL}：什么，只有{PLAYER}？\n爷爷不在这儿。$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_RivalFedUpWithWaiting
source: {RIVAL}: Gramps!\nI'm fed up with waiting!$
translation: {RIVAL}：爷爷！\n我都等不及了！$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_RivalNoFairWhatAboutMe
source: {RIVAL}: Hey! Gramps! No fair!\nWhat about me?$
translation: {RIVAL}：嘿！爷爷！这不公平！\n我也要！$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_RivalGoChoosePlayer
source: {RIVAL}: Heh, I don't need to be\ngreedy like you. I'm mature!\pGo ahead and choose, {PLAYER}!$
translation: {RIVAL}：哼，我没有像你一样那么急。\n我成熟得很！\p你先去选吧，{PLAYER}！$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_RivalIllTakeThisOneThen
source: {RIVAL}: I'll take this one, then!$
translation: {RIVAL}：那我就要这只了！$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_RivalReceivedMonFromOak
source: {RIVAL} received the {STR_VAR_1}\nfrom PROF. OAK!$
translation: {RIVAL}从大木博士那儿\n得到了{STR_VAR_1}！$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_RivalMyMonLooksTougher
source: {RIVAL}: My POKéMON looks a lot\ntougher than yours.$
translation: {RIVAL}：我的宝可梦看起来\n比你的厉害。$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_RivalLetsCheckOutMons
source: {RIVAL}: Wait, {PLAYER}!\nLet's check out our POKéMON!\pCome on, I'll take you on!$
translation: {RIVAL}：等等，{PLAYER}！\n让我们检验一下各自的宝可梦！\p来吧，我会打败你！$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_RivalDefeat
source: WHAT?\nUnbelievable!\lI picked the wrong POKéMON!$
translation: 什么？\n难以置信！\l我拿错了宝可梦！$

label: Text_RivalVictory
source: {RIVAL}: Yeah!\nAm I great or what?$
translation: {RIVAL}：耶！\n我很强吧？$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_RivalGoToughenMyMon
source: {RIVAL}: Okay! I'll make my\nPOKéMON battle to toughen it up!\p{PLAYER}! Gramps!\nSmell you later!$
translation: {RIVAL}：我要让我的宝可梦战斗\n来使它变强！\p{PLAYER}！爷爷！\n回见！$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_RivalGramps
source: {RIVAL}: Gramps!$
translation: {RIVAL}：爷爷！$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_RivalWhatDidYouCallMeFor
source: {RIVAL}: I almost forgot!\nWhat did you call me for?$
translation: {RIVAL}：我差点忘了！\n你叫我来干什么？$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_RivalLeaveItToMeGramps
source: {RIVAL}: All right, Gramps!\nLeave it all to me!$
translation: {RIVAL}：好的，爷爷！\n全部交给我吧！$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_RivalTellSisNotToGiveYouMap
source:
{PLAYER}, I hate to say it, but you
won't be necessary for this.\pI know! I'll borrow a TOWN MAP
from my sis!\pI'll tell her not to lend you one,
{PLAYER}! Hahaha!\pDon't bother coming around to
my place after this!$
translation:
{PLAYER}，我说句不好听的话，
你没必做这么多努力。\p我要去向我姐姐借张城镇地图！\p我会告诉她别借给你！
{PLAYER}！哈哈！\p之后不要因为这个
来我们家了！$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakThreeMonsChooseOne
source:
大木：{RIVAL}？让我想想…
…\p哦，对了，是我让你来的！稍等一下
！\p给你，{PLAYER}。\p这里有三只宝可梦。\p哈哈！\p宝可梦都装在这些精灵球里。\p我年轻的时候也是个很厉害的训练家
。\p但现在年纪大了，身边只剩下这三只
。\p你可以选一只。来吧，挑一只吧！$
translation:
大木：{RIVAL}？
我想想......\p噢，对了，是我叫你来的！
等等！\p来这儿，{PLAYER}。\p这儿有三只宝可梦。\p哈哈！\p宝可梦都在这些
精灵球里面。\p我年轻的时候，
可是一个厉害的宝可梦训练家。\p但是现在，我老了！
只剩下了这三只宝可梦了。\p你可以从中挑一个。
去选吧！$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakBePatientRival
source: 大木：别着急，{RIVAL}。你\n也可以选一只！$
translation: 大木：耐心点，{RIVAL}。\n你也可以选一只的！$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakWhichOneWillYouChoose
source: OAK: Now, {PLAYER}.\pInside those three POKé BALLS are\nPOKéMON.\pWhich one will you choose for\nyourself?$
translation: 大木：现在，{PLAYER}。\p在那三个精灵球里面\n都是宝可梦。\p你想要哪一只？$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakHeyDontGoAwayYet
source: OAK: Hey!\nDon't go away yet!$
translation: 大木：嘿！\n别急着走啊！$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakChoosingCharmander
source: Ah! CHARMANDER is your choice.\nYou should raise it patiently.\pSo, {PLAYER}, you're claiming the\nFIRE POKéMON CHARMANDER?$
translation: 啊！你选择了小火龙。\n你要耐心地培养它。\p好的，{PLAYER}，你确定要获得\n火属性宝可梦小火龙吗？$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakChoosingSquirtle
source: Hm! SQUIRTLE is your choice.\nIt's one worth raising.\pSo, {PLAYER}, you've decided on the\nWATER POKéMON SQUIRTLE?$
translation: 嗯！你选择了杰尼龟。\n它很值得培养。\p好的，{PLAYER} 你确定要选择\n水属性宝可梦杰尼龟吗？$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakChoosingBulbasaur
source: I see! BULBASAUR is your choice.\nIt's very easy to raise.\pSo, {PLAYER}, you want to go with\nthe GRASS POKéMON BULBASAUR?$
translation: 嗯！你选择了妙蛙种子。\n它非常好培养。\p好的，{PLAYER}，你确定要和\n草属性宝可梦妙蛙种子一起吗？$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakThisMonIsEnergetic
source: This POKéMON is really quite\nenergetic!$
translation: 这只宝可梦充满了活力！$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_ReceivedMonFromOak
source: {PLAYER} received the {STR_VAR_1}\nfrom PROF. OAK!$
translation: {PLAYER}从大木博士那儿\n得到了{STR_VAR_1}！$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakCanReachNextTownWithMon
source: OAK: If a wild POKéMON appears,\nyour POKéMON can battle it.\pWith it at your side, you should be\nable to reach the next town.$
translation: 大木：如果野生的宝可梦出现了，\n你的宝可梦能和它战斗。\p有了它在你身边，\n你就能抵达下一个城镇了。$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakBattleMonForItToGrow
source: OAK: {PLAYER}, raise your young\nPOKéMON by making it battle.\pIt has to battle for it to grow.$
translation: 大木：{PLAYER}，好好培育你的宝可梦\n让它战斗吧。\p它得在战斗中成长。$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakHaveSomethingForMe
source:
OAK: Oh, {PLAYER}!
How is my old POKéMON?\pWell, it seems to be growing more
attached to you.\pYou must be talented as a POKéMON
TRAINER.\pWhat's that?
You have something for me?$
translation:
大木：{PLAYER}！
我给你的宝可梦怎么样了？\p嗯，他好像已经
离不开你了。\p你一定是个天才宝可梦训练家。\p你说什么？
你有东西要给我？$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_DeliveredOaksParcel
source: {PLAYER} delivered OAK'S PARCEL.$
translation: {PLAYER}交出了大木的包裹。$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakCustomBallIOrdered
source: Ah! \nIt's the custom POKé BALL!\pI had it on order.\nThank you!$
translation: 啊！\n这是我订制的精灵球！\p是我订的没错。\n谢谢你！$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakHaveRequestForYouTwo
source: OAK: Oh, right!\nI have a request for you two.$
translation: 大木：噢，对了！\n我对你们两个有个请求。$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakPokedexOnDesk
source: On the desk there is my invention,\nthe POKéDEX!\pIt automatically records data on\nPOKéMON you've seen or caught.\pIt's a high-tech encyclopedia!$
translation: 那桌子上的是我的发明，\n宝可梦图鉴！\p它能自动记录你见过或收服的\n宝可梦的资料。\p它是一部高科技的百科全书！$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakTakeTheseWithYou
source: OAK: {PLAYER} and {RIVAL}.\nTake these with you.$
translation: 大木：{PLAYER}和{RIVAL}。\n拿着这个吧。$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_ReceivedPokedexFromOak
source: {PLAYER} received the POKéDEX\nfrom PROF. OAK.$
translation: {PLAYER}从大木博士那儿\n得到了宝可梦图鉴。$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakCatchMonsForDataTakeThese
source:
OAK: You can't get detailed data
on POKéMON by just seeing them.\pYou must catch them to obtain
complete data.\pSo, here are some tools for
catching wild POKéMON.$
translation:
大木：如果你仅仅是发现宝可梦，
你是无法得到它们的详细资料的。\p你必须抓住它们
来获取完整的资料。\p那么，给你一些收服
野生宝可梦的工具吧。$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_ReceivedFivePokeBalls
source: {PLAYER} received five POKé BALLS.$
translation: {PLAYER}得到了5个精灵球。$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakExplainCatching
source:
When a wild POKéMON appears,
it's fair game.\pJust throw a POKé BALL at it and
try to catch it!\pThis won't always work, however.\pA healthy POKéMON can escape.
You have to be lucky!$
translation:
当野生宝可梦出现时，
战斗就开始了。\p向它扔出一个精灵球
就能试去着收服它！\p但是，这不一定会成功。\p精神饱满的宝可梦是能逃走的。
想要成功需要点运气！$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakCompleteMonGuideWasMyDream
source:
To make a complete guide on all
the POKéMON in the world…\pThat was my dream!\pBut, I'm too old.
I can't get the job done.\pSo, I want you two to fulfill my
dream for me.\pGet moving, you two.\pThis is a great undertaking in
POKéMON history!$
translation:
收集齐世界上所有宝可梦的资料......\p一直是我的梦想！\p但是，我太老了。
我不能完成这项任务了。\p所以，我希望你们俩能替我
实现我的梦想。\p出发吧。\p这是宝可梦史上
最伟大的事业！$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakMonsAroundWorldWait
source: POKéMON around the world wait for\nyou, {PLAYER}!$
translation: 这个世界的宝可梦正等着你，{PLAYER}！$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakAddedNothingToPokedex
source:
Ah, {PLAYER}!
How is your POKéDEX shaping up?\p{RIVAL} has already caught some
POKéMON and added to the data.\pSo, {PLAYER}, let's have a look at
your POKéDEX.\p…What's the matter?
You've added no new data at all.\pI'll give you these, so do try a
little harder.$
translation:
啊，{PLAYER}！
你的宝可梦图鉴完成得怎么样了？\p{RIVAL}已经收服了一些宝可梦，
而且添加了一些资料。\p那么，{PLAYER}，
我来看看你的宝可梦图鉴。\p......怎么回事？
你还没有添加任何新的数据。\p这个给你好了，
希望你更努力些。$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakComeSeeMeSometime
source: OAK: Come see me sometime.\pAfter all, I want to know how your\nPOKéDEX is coming along.$
translation: 大木：有空了就回来看看我。\p我也想了解下，你的宝可梦图鉴工作\n进展到了什么样的程度。$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_BlankEncyclopedia
source: It's like an encyclopedia, but the\npages are blank.$
translation: 像图鉴一样的东西，\n只是里面是空白的。$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_ThoseArePokeBalls
source: Those are POKé BALLS.\nThey contain POKéMON!$
translation: 一些精灵球。\n里面装着宝可梦！$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OaksLastMon
source: That's PROF. OAK's last POKéMON.$
translation: 这是大木博士最后的宝可梦。$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_PressStartToOpenMenu
source: Press START to open the MENU!$
translation: 按开始键打开菜单！$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_SaveOptionInMenu
source: The SAVE option is on the MENU.\nUse it regularly.$
translation: 保存选项在菜单里。\n好好利用它吧。$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_AllMonTypesHaveStrongAndWeakPoints
source: All POKéMON types have strong and\nweak points against others.$
translation: 所有类型的宝可梦在对战时\n都有它的优势和弱势。$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_StudyAsOaksAide
source: I study POKéMON as PROF. OAK's\nAIDE.$
translation: 我作为大木博士的助手，\n也在研究宝可梦。$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_DaisyWillGroomMons
source:
Hi, {PLAYER}. I bet you've become
good friends with your POKéMON.\pBy the way, did you know about
DAISY?\pIf you show DAISY your POKéMON,
she can tell how much it likes you.\pOccasionally, she will even groom
a POKéMON for you.\pThis is a secret, so please don't
tell anyone.$
translation:
嗨，{PLAYER}。我相信
你和你的宝可梦相处得很好吧。\p对了，你知道奈奈美吗？\p如果你把你的宝可梦给娜娜妹看，
她会告诉你宝可梦喜欢你的程度，\p有时候，她甚至会帮你的
宝可梦梳理毛发。\p这是一个秘密喔，
请不要告诉任何人。$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakIsGoingToHaveRadioShow
source: PROF. OAK is going to have his own\nradio show soon.\pThe program will be called PROF.\nOAK's POKéMON SEMINAR.$
translation: 大木博士要有他自己的\n广播节目了。\p这个节目被叫做大木博士\n的宝可梦大讲堂。$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakIsAuthorityOnMons
source: PROF. OAK may not look like much,\nbut he's the authority on POKéMON.\pMany POKéMON TRAINERS hold him in\nhigh regard.$
translation: 大木博士可能长得不是很帅，\n但他是宝可梦研究的权威。\p宝可梦训练家都非常尊敬他。$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakFavorToAskYouPlayer
source: Ah, now this is excellent!\p{PLAYER}, I have another important\nfavor to ask of you.\pI need you to listen closely.$
translation: 啊，真是棒极了！\p{PLAYER}，我有另一个重大的\n事情想要请你帮忙。\p你可要认真听好了。$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakSightingsOfRareMons
source:
Recently, there have been sightings
of many rare POKéMON species.\pI'm talking about POKéMON that
have never been seen in KANTO.\pI would love to go see things for
myself, but I'm much too old.\pSince I can't do it, {PLAYER}, I'd
like you to go in my place.$
translation:
最近，出现了很多
珍贵的宝可梦品种。\p我是在说我们在关都
从来没见过的宝可梦。\p我想要自己去亲眼见识它们，
但是我太老了。\p我自己无法干这件事了，{PLAYER}
我想让你去替我完成。$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_RivalJustLetMeHandleEverything
source:
{RIVAL}: Hey, I heard that!\pGramps, what's with favoring
{PLAYER} over me all the time?\pI went and collected more POKéMON,
and faster, too.\pYou should just let me handle
everything.$
translation:
{RIVAL}：嘿，我听说了！\p爷爷，为什么总是要{PLAYER}帮你
而不是我？\p我用了更快的速度
收集了更多的宝可梦，\p你应该让我来完成
一切事情就行了。$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakNeedYourHelpTooNeedToSeePokedexes
source: OAK: I know, I know.\nOf course I need your help, too.\pNow, I need to see both your\nPOKéDEXES.$
translation: 大木：我知道，我知道。\n我当然也需要你的帮助。\p现在，我要看看你们俩的宝可梦图鉴。$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakTookBothPokedexUnits
source: PROF. OAK took both POKéDEX\nunits.$
translation: 大木博士拿了二人的宝可梦图鉴。$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakNowTheseUnitsCanRecordMoreData
source: … … …  … … …\p… … …  … … …\p…And that's done!\pNow these units can record data on\na lot more POKéMON.$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_PlayersPokedexWasUpgraded
source: {PLAYER}'s POKéDEX was upgraded!$
translation: {PLAYER}的宝可梦图鉴升级了！$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakMustReallyWorkToFillPokedex
source:
Now, {PLAYER} and {RIVAL}!\pThis time, you really must work
towards filling your POKéDEXES.\pI urge you to make them the best
and the most complete of all time!\pTruly, this is a monumentally great
undertaking in POKéMON history!$
translation:
现在，{PLAYER}和{RIVAL}！\p这次，你们真的要努力
填满你们的宝可梦图鉴。\p我希望你们能把它们做成
最好的最完整的图鉴！\p说真的，这在宝可梦的历史上
是一项伟大的任务！$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_RivalIllCompleteThePokedex
source:
{RIVAL}: Gramps, calm down.
Don't get so excited.\pI'll get the POKéDEX completed,
don't you worry about a thing.\pI think I'll try looking around
ONE ISLAND first…\pAnyways, I'm outta here!$
translation: {RIVAL}：冷静点，爷爷！\n可别太激动了。\p我会完成宝可梦图鉴的，\n你不用担心。\p我想我首先要调查一之岛......\p不管怎么说，我出发了！$

label: PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_HiBrothersAtLab
source: DAISY: Hi, {PLAYER}!\pMy brother, {RIVAL}, is out at\nGrandpa's LAB.$
translation: 奈奈美：嗨，{PLAYER}！\p{RIVAL}是我的弟弟，\n他在爷爷的研究所里。$

label: PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_HeardYouBattledRival
source: DAISY: {PLAYER}, I heard you had\na battle against {RIVAL}.\pI wish I'd seen that!$
translation: 奈奈美：{PLAYER}，我听说\n你和{RIVAL}进行了一场战斗。\p我真想看啊！$

label: PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_ErrandForGrandpaThisWillHelp
source: Grandpa asked you to run an\nerrand?\pGee, that's lazy of him.\nHere, this will help you.$
translation: 爷爷要你帮他跑趟腿？\p噢，他可真懒。\n给你，这个会帮到你的。$

label: PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_ReceivedTownMapFromDaisy
source: {PLAYER} received a TOWN MAP\nfrom DAISY.$
translation: {PLAYER}从奈奈美那儿得到了城镇地图。$

label: PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_DontHaveSpaceForThis
source: You don't have space for this in\nyour BAG.$
translation: 你背包里没有空间装这个了。$

label: PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_ExplainTownMap
source: You can use the TOWN MAP to find\nout where you are, or check the\lnames of places.$
translation: 你可以用城镇地图确认你的方位，\n或者查看\l那些地区的名字。$

label: PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_PleaseGiveMonsRest
source: DAISY: Just like people, POKéMON\nare living things.\pWhen they get tired, please give\nthem a rest.$
translation: 奈奈美：和人一样，宝可梦\n是活生生的生物。\p当他们疲倦的时候，\n请让它们休息一下。$

label: PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_ItsBigMapOfKanto
source: It's a big map of the KANTO region.\nNow this would be useful!$
translation: 这是关都地区的一个大地图。\n它肯定会很有用的！$

label: PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_ShelvesCrammedFullOfBooks
source: The shelves are crammed full of\nbooks on POKéMON.$
translation: 书架子上摆满了\n关于宝可梦的读物。$

label: PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_LikeMeToGroomMon
source:
DAISY: Hi, {PLAYER}!
Good timing.\pI'm about to have some tea.
Would you like to join me?\pOh, but look.
Your POKéMON are a little dirty.\pWould you like me to groom one?$
translation:
奈奈美：嗨，{PLAYER}！
来得正好。\p我正打算喝点茶。
要不要来点儿？\p噢，你看看。
你的宝可梦有一点脏了。\p你想让我帮它们梳理一下毛发吗？$

label: PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_DontNeedAnyGrooming
source: You don't need any grooming done?\nOkay, we'll just have tea.$
translation: 你不需要我帮忙梳理它们？\n好吧，我们喝茶吧。$

label: PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_GroomWhichOne
source: Which one should I groom?$
translation: 需要我梳理哪一只的毛发？$

label: PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_LookingNiceInNoTime
source: DAISY: Okay, I'll get it looking\nnice in no time.$
translation: 奈奈美：好的，\n我马上让它变得漂亮。$

label: PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_CantGroomAnEgg
source: Oh, sorry. I honestly can't\ngroom an EGG.$
translation: 噢，对不起。我真的\n不能梳理一个蛋。$

label: PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_MayISeeFirstMon
source: DAISY: Your POKéMON grow to love\nyou if you raise them with love.\pFor example, {PLAYER}, may I see\nyour first POKéMON?$
translation: 奈奈美：如果你用爱培育你的的宝可梦，\n它们会和你很亲近。\p比如说，{PLAYER}，\n我能看看你的第一只宝可梦吗？$

label: PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_CouldntLoveYouMore
source: It couldn't possibly love you\nany more than it does now.\pYour POKéMON is happy beyond\nwords.$
translation: 它非常非常喜欢你。\p你的宝可梦高兴得无法形容了。$

label: PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_ItLooksVeryHappy
source: It looks very happy.\pI wish {RIVAL} could see this and\nlearn something from it.$
translation: 它看起来很高兴。\p我希望{RIVAL}也能看见这一幕，\n然后从中学到些什么。$

label: PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_ItsQuiteFriendly
source: It's quite friendly with you.\nKeep being good to it!$
translation: 它对你很友好。\n继续好好地照顾它！$

label: PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_ItsWarmingUpToYou
source: It's warming up to you.\nTrust must be growing between you.$
translation: 它正在跟你建立感情。\n你们之间必须建立信任。$

label: PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_NotFamiliarWithYouYet
source: It's not quite familiar with you\nyet.\pPOKéMON are all quite wary when\nyou first get them.$
translation: 它和你不是很亲密。\p当你第一次得到宝可梦时，\n它们通常都很警惕。$

label: PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_DontLikeWayItGlaresAtYou
source: {PLAYER}, I don't like the way it\nglares at you.\pCould you try being a little nicer\nto it?$
translation: {PLAYER}，我不喜欢它看你时\n愤怒的目光。\p你能对它稍微好一点吗？$

label: PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_WhyWouldMonHateYouSoMuch
source: …Um, it's not easy for me to say\nthis, but…\pIs there some reason why your\nPOKéMON would hate you so much?$
translation: ......唔，我不好说什么，\n但是......\p宝可梦如此的憎恨你，\n是不是有什么原因？$

label: PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_LovelyAndSweetClefairy
source: “The lovely and sweet\nCLEFAIRY”$
translation: "可爱又甜蜜的皮皮"$

label: PetalburgCity_Text_WhereIsWally
source: Where has our WALLY gone?\pWe have to leave for VERDANTURF TOWN\nvery soon…$
translation: 我家满充去哪儿了？\p我们得马上出发\n去绿茵镇了......$

label: PetalburgCity_Text_AreYouRookieTrainer
source:
Hiya! Are you maybe…
A rookie TRAINER?\pDo you know what POKéMON TRAINERS
do when they reach a new town?\pThey first check what kind of GYM
is in the town.$
translation:
嗨！莫非你是......
新人训练家？\p你知道一位训练家来到
新城镇时首先要做什么吗？\p他们会去看看那里
有什么样的道馆。$

label: PetalburgCity_Text_ThisIsPetalburgGym
source: See? This is PETALBURG CITY's GYM.$
translation: 看到了吗？这就是橙华市的道馆。$

label: PetalburgCity_Text_ThisIsGymSign
source: This is the GYM's sign. Look for it\nwhenever you're looking for a GYM.$
translation: 这是道馆的标志。\n想要去道馆，找它就对了。$

label: PetalburgCity_Text_WaterReflection
source: My face is reflected in the water.\pIt's a shining grin full of hope…\pOr it could be a look of somber silence\nstruggling with fear…\pWhat do you see reflected in your face?$
translation: 我的脸倒映在水面上。\p那也许是张充满希望的笑脸......\p又或是在恐惧中挣扎的\n一张忧郁而沉默的脸......\p你的脸在水里会是什么样？$

label: PetalburgCity_Text_FullPartyExplanation
source: Let's say you have six POKéMON.\nIf you catch another one…\pIt is automatically sent to a STORAGE\nBOX over a PC connection.$
translation: 假如你已经带了6只宝可梦，\n那么再捕捉1只的话......\p就会通过电脑传送到盒子里。$

label: PetalburgCity_Text_GymSign
source: PETALBURG CITY POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: NORMAN\l“A man in pursuit of power!”$
translation: 橙华市宝可梦道馆\n馆主：千里\l"追求强大力量的男人！"$

label: PetalburgCity_Text_CitySign
source: PETALBURG CITY\n“Where people mingle with nature.”$
translation: 这里是橙华市。\n"人与自然沟通的城市。"$

label: PetalburgCity_Text_WallyHouseSign
source: WALLY'S HOUSE$
translation: 满充的家$

label: PetalburgCity_Text_AreYouATrainer
source: Excuse me!\pLet me guess, from the way you're\ndressed, are you a POKéMON TRAINER?$
translation: 打扰了！\p看你的打扮，\n是个宝可梦训练家吧？$

label: PetalburgCity_Text_WellMaybeNot
source: … … … … … …\pWell, maybe not.\nYour clothes aren't all that dirty.\pYou're either a rookie TRAINER,\nor maybe you're just an ordinary kid.$
translation: ...... ...... ......\p嗯，也不一定。\n衣服看起来挺干净的......\p可能是个新人训练家，\n或者只个普通的孩子。$

label: PetalburgCity_Text_ImLookingForTalentedTrainers
source: I'm roaming the land in search of\ntalented TRAINERS.\pI'm sorry to have taken your time.$
translation: 抱歉，占用你的时间了。\n我在这儿是为了\p寻找天才训练家。$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_DadYoureHereWithYourPokemon
source:
DAD: Hm?\pWell, if it isn't {PLAYER}!
So you're all finished moving in?\pI'm surprised that you managed to
get here by yourself.\pOh, I see.
You're with your POKéMON.\pHm… Then I guess you're going to
become a TRAINER like me, {PLAYER}.\pThat's great news!
I'll be looking forward to it!$
translation:
爸爸：嗯？\p这不是{PLAYER}吗！
搬完家了吗？\p没想到你能自己
一个人跑过来。\p啊，原来如此，
你是和宝可梦一起来的啊。\p那么......你是想像我一样成为
一位训练家吗，{PLAYER}？\p这真是个好消息！
我很期待！$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_WallyIdLikeAPokemon
source: Um… I…\nI'd like to get a POKéMON, please…$
translation: 那个......我......\n想要一只宝可梦，拜托了......$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_DadOhYoureWallyRight
source: DAD: Hm? You're… Uh… Oh, right.\nYou're WALLY, right?$
translation: 爸爸：嗯？你是......对了，\n记得是叫满充对吧？$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_WallyIveNeverCaughtAPokemon
source:
WALLY: I'm going to go stay with my
relatives in VERDANTURF TOWN.\pI thought I would be lonely by myself,
so I wanted to take a POKéMON along.\pBut I've never caught a POKéMON before.
I don't know how…$
translation:
满充：我马上就要搬到绿茵镇
去跟亲戚家那里住了。\p我一个人可能会寂寞，
所以我想带只宝可梦一起去，\p但我以前从未捕捉过宝可梦，
我不知道该怎么......$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_DadHmISee
source: DAD: Hm. I see.$
translation: 爸爸：......原来如此。$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_DadPlayerGoWithWally
source: DAD: {PLAYER}, you heard that,\nright?\pGo with WALLY and make sure that he\nsafely catches a POKéMON.$
translation: 爸爸：{PLAYER}，\n你都听到了吧？\p陪满充一起去吧，\n要确保他安全地捕捉到宝可梦。$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_IllLoanYouMyZigzagoon
source: WALLY, here, I'll loan you my POKéMON.\pWALLY received a ZIGZAGOON!$
translation: 满充，我先把我自己的\n宝可梦借给你。\p满充得到了蛇纹熊！$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_WallyThankYouAndDadGivesPokeBall
source: WALLY: Oh, wow!\nA POKéMON!\pDAD: Hm. I'll give you a POKé BALL, too.\nGo for it!\pWALLY received a POKé BALL!$
translation: 满充：哇！\n一只宝可梦！\p爸爸：嗯，再给你个精灵球吧。\n加油吧！\p满充得到精灵球！$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_WallyOhWowThankYou
source: WALLY: Oh, wow!\nThank you!$
translation: 满充：哇！\n谢谢叔叔！$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_WouldYouReallyComeWithMe
source: {PLAYER}… Would you really come\nwith me?$
translation: {PLAYER}......\n你会陪我一起去的对吧？$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_DadSoDidItWorkOut
source: DAD: So, did it work out?$
translation: 爸爸：那么，还顺利吗？$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_WallyThankYouBye
source:
WALLY: Thank you, yes, it did.
Here's your POKéMON back.\p{PLAYER}, thank you for coming along
with me.\pYou two are why I was able to catch
my POKéMON.\pI promise I'll take really good
care of it.\pOh! My mom's waiting for me,
so I have to go!\pBye, {PLAYER}!$
translation:
满充：谢谢叔叔，我成功了。
这只宝可梦还给您。\p{PLAYER}，
谢谢你陪我......\p多亏了你们，
我才能捕捉到自己的宝可梦。\p我一定会好好照顾它的......\p啊！妈妈还在等我，
我得走了！\p再见，{PLAYER}！$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_DadGoCollectBadges
source:
DAD: Now…\p{PLAYER}, if you want to become a
strong TRAINER, here's my advice.\pHead for RUSTBORO CITY beyond this
town.\pThere, you should challenge
the GYM LEADER, ROXANNE.\pAfter her, go on to other POKéMON
GYMS and defeat their LEADERS.\pCollect BADGES from them,
understood?\pOf course, I'm a GYM LEADER, too.
We'll battle one day, {PLAYER}.\pBut that's only after you become
stronger.$
translation:
爸爸：好了......\p{PLAYER}，如果你想成为一个
强大的训练家，我有几条建议。\p首先去距此不远的
卡那兹市，\p挑战那里的
道馆馆主，杜娟。\p然后再去其他宝可梦道馆，
打败那里的馆主，\p收集他们的徽章，
明白了吗？\p当然，我也是道馆馆主，所以我们
总有一天会对战，{PLAYER}，\p但那之前，你得先变得
更强大才行。$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_NormanGoToRustboro
source:
DAD: Hm? Aren't you going to the
POKéMON GYM in RUSTBORO CITY?\pThere's no challenge for me to
battle a greenhorn TRAINER.\p{PLAYER}, I want you to challenge me
when you become a lot stronger.\pI'll battle you, {PLAYER}, when you
can show me four GYM BADGES, okay?$
translation:
爸爸：嗯？你还没去
卡那兹市的宝可梦道馆？\p一个新手训练家
是没法打败我的。\p{PLAYER}，等你变强了
再向我挑战吧。\p当你收集4个道馆徽章后，
我再接受你的挑战，{PLAYER}。$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_NormanGoToDewford
source:
DAD: I see… So, you've beaten
the GYM LEADER in RUSTBORO CITY.\pBut there are many more TRAINERS
who are stronger than you, {PLAYER}.\pAcross the sea in DEWFORD TOWN is a
GYM LEADER named BRAWLY.\pYou should go challenge him.$
translation:
爸爸：嗯......看来你打败了
卡那兹市的宝可梦道馆馆主。\p但还有很多比你更强的
训练家，{PLAYER}。\p在海对岸的武斗镇里
有个叫做藤树的道馆馆主，\p你应该试试去挑战他。$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_YouHaveGottenStronger
source: DAD: Hm… {PLAYER}, you have gotten\nstronger.\pI can tell by the number of BADGES\nthat you've earned.$
translation: 爸爸：嗯......{PLAYER}，\n你变强了，\p从你获得的徽章数量\n就能看得出。$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_NormanIntro
source:
DAD: Hm…
So, you did get four GYM BADGES.\pFine, as I promised, we will have
a POKéMON battle.\p{PLAYER}…\pI'm so happy that I can have
a real battle with my own child.\pBut, a battle is a battle!\pI will do everything in my power as
a GYM LEADER to win.\p{PLAYER}, you'd better give it your
best shot, too!$
translation:
爸爸：嗯......
看来，你已经赢得4枚徽章了。\p很好，那就按我所承诺的
那样，让我们来对战吧。\p{PLAYER}......\p我真高兴能和自己的孩子
来一场真真正正的对战。\p但是，
对战就是对战！\p身为道馆馆主，
我会尽我所能赢取胜利。\p{PLAYER}，
你也要用尽全力啊！$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_NormanDefeat
source: …\pI… I can't…\pI can't believe it. {PLAYER}…\pI lost to {PLAYER}?\pBut, rules are rules!\nHere, take this.$
translation: 这......\p我......\p难以置信。\n{PLAYER}......\p我输给了{PLAYER}？\p但规则就是规则！\n来，收下这个。$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_ReceivedBalanceBadge
source: {PLAYER} received the BALANCE BADGE\nfrom DAD!$
translation: {PLAYER}从爸爸那里\n得到了天秤徽章！$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_ExplainBalanceBadgeTakeThis
source:
DAD: With that BADGE, the DEFENSE
of all your POKéMON will increase.\pPOKéMON that know the HM move SURF
will be able to travel over water.\pThis is my gift to you. {PLAYER}, I'm
sure you can use it correctly.$
translation:
爸爸：有了这枚徽章，
你所有宝可梦的防御力都会得到提升。\p学会秘传招式冲浪
的宝可梦也可以渡水了。\p这是我给你的礼物，{PLAYER}，
我相信你可以用好它。$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_ExplainFacade
source: DAD: TM42 contains FACADE.\pIt doubles the power of moves if\nthe POKéMON is poisoned, paralyzed,\lor burned.\pIt might be able to turn a bad\nsituation into an advantage.$
translation: 爸爸：招式学习器42里面是硬撑。\p如果宝可梦中毒、\n麻痹或者灼伤，\l招式的威力就会翻倍。\p用这招可以逆转\n不利形势。$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_DadHappyAndSad
source: DAD: As the GYM LEADER, I can't\nexpress how upset I am…\pBut as a father, it makes me both\nhappy and a little sad. It's odd…$
translation: 爸爸：作为道馆馆主，\n我不知道有多失落......\p但作为一个父亲，\n我高兴的同时又有点难过。\l真是奇怪......$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_PleaseComeWithMe
source: Ah, there you are, {PLAYER}{KUN}!\pPlease come with me.\nI have something I want you to have.$
translation: 啊，你来了，{PLAYER}{KUN}！\p跟我来，\n我有些东西要给你。$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_LetMeBorrowPlayer
source: NORMAN, you don't mind, do you?\pLet me borrow your {PLAYER}{KUN} for\na minute or two.$
translation: 千里，你不介意吧？\p我想把你的{PLAYER}{KUN}\n借去一小会儿。$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_DadGoingToKeepTraining
source:
DAD: {PLAYER}, you should go visit
your mother every so often.\pI'm going to stay here and redouble
my training.\pIt would bother me as a TRAINER to
not avenge my loss to you, {PLAYER}!$
translation:
爸爸：{PLAYER}，你该常回家
看看妈妈。\p我要在这儿继续锻炼
让自己变强。\p作为一个训练家，如果就这么甘心
输给你，我会很苦恼的，{PLAYER}！$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_DadNoAmountOfTrainingIsEnough
source: DAD: {PLAYER}, how are things going?\pThe world of POKéMON is deep.\pI honestly think that no amount of\ntraining would ever be enough.$
translation: 爸爸：{PLAYER}，最近如何？\p宝可梦的世界广阔无比。\p老实说，我觉得再多的\n训练也不够。$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_GymGuideAdvice
source:
Hey, how's it going, CHAMPION-
bound {PLAYER}?\pThe doors in this GYM open when you
beat the awaiting TRAINERS.\pWhoops! The doors in this room are
already open, so don't attack me!\pThe TRAINERS of PETALBURG GYM
use all kinds of items.\pThe door at the left leads to
the SPEED ROOM.\pThe door at the right leads to
the ACCURACY ROOM.\pThe room's name will be on
the door, so choose carefully.\pOnce you've chosen the door…
Well, hey, go for it!$
translation:
嗨，怎么样，向冠军的目标
冲刺的{PLAYER}？\p在这个道馆里，
你打败房间里的训练家后，\l通向下一个房间的门就会开启。\p哇呀！这个房间的门
已经打开了，别打我！\p橙华市道馆的训练家
会使用各种各样的道具。\p左边的门通向
速度房间，\p右边的门通向
命中房间。\p房间的名称就写在门上，
你要谨慎选择。\p选好房间之后......
哎，好了，加油吧！$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_GymGuidePostVictory
source: {PLAYER}! Whoa! You've overcome even\nyour own father!\pLike, whoa!\nWhat a stunning turn of events!$
translation: 哇！{PLAYER}！你甚至打败了\n自己的父亲！\p哇！\n多么令人吃惊的结局！$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_RandallIntro
source: The ability to attack before the\nopponent…\pJust that alone puts me at a great\nadvantage, don't you agree?$
translation: 比对手先一步发动攻击的\n能力......\p光是这点，就足以让我在对战中\n占尽先机，不是吗？$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_RandallDefeat
source: That was a magnificent battle!$
translation: 真是一场精彩的战斗！$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_RandallPostBattle
source: Go on to the next room where a new\nchallenge awaits you.\pAt the left is the CONFUSION ROOM.\pThe right door leads to the DEFENSE\nROOM.$
translation:
在下面的房间中
还有新的挑战等着你。\p左边是
混乱房间，\p右边则通向
防御房间。$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_RandallPostBadge
source: Whomever you beat, and whomever you\nmay lose to, you never shirk from\ltraining yourself and your POKéMON.\pThat's what I think being a\nGYM LEADER is all about.$
translation: 无论赢了谁，无论输给谁，\n都永远不能逃避训练自己\l和宝可梦的责任。\p我想作为道馆馆主，\n就应当如此。$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_ParkerIntro
source: This is the CONFUSION ROOM.\pLet me see how well bonded you are\nwith your POKéMON!$
translation: 这里是混乱房间。\p让我看看你和宝可梦之间\n有多强的牵绊！$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_ParkerDefeat
source: I couldn't confuse your team enough…\nYou share a strong bond together.$
translation: 我还不足以让你们的组合陷入混乱......\n你们间的牵绊真的很强。$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_ParkerPostBattle
source: The next room is the STRENGTH ROOM.\nCan you withstand brute force?$
translation: 下面是力量房间，\n你能抵挡住那强大的威力吗？$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_ParkerPostBadge
source: After you beat our LEADER, the\ntraining has become a lot tougher.$
translation: 自从你击败馆主，\n我们的训练强度提升了不少。$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_GeorgeIntro
source:
Just when you think you're going to
win, your opponent restores HP…\pCan you just imagine how awful that
must feel?\pI'll show you exactly how awful it
feels!$
translation: 当你以为自己就要赢了时，\n对手的体力回复了......\p你了解那种\n绝望的感觉吗？\p就让你亲身体会一下吧！$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_GeorgeDefeat
source: I couldn't restore HP enough…\nWhat ATTACK power…$
translation: 我来不及回复体力......\n何等强大的攻击......$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_GeorgePostBattle
source:
I should have expected no less from
our LEADER's kid.\pNo, wait! A TRAINER's abilities are
earned only through effort.\pI lost because my own efforts
weren't enough.\pGo on! The ONE-HIT KO ROOM is next.$
translation:
我该说真不愧是
我们馆主的孩子。\p不，等等！训练家的力量
全是靠自己的努力得来的。\p我的努力还不够，
所以才会输。\p加油吧！下面是一击必杀房间。$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_GeorgePostBadge
source: I'm going to keep training at GYMS.\nOne day, I'll become a LEADER.$
translation: 我还要在道馆继续训练。\n总有一天，我要成为馆主。$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_BerkeIntro
source: I'm not going to take it easy just\nbecause you're our LEADER's kid.\pI'll show you how horrid it is for\na POKéMON to take a critical hit!$
translation: 就算你是我们馆主的孩子，\n我也不会放水的。\p体会一下宝可梦被\n击中要害的恐惧吧！$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_BerkeDefeat
source: Your power…\nYou're the real deal.$
translation: 你的力量......\n果然名不虚传。$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_BerkePostBattle
source:
Your father really is strong.
He's a TRAINER worth my respect.\pAnd, I sense the same glow coming
from you as your father.\pI hope that you'll stage a terrific
battle with your father!$
translation:
你的父亲很强，
大家都很尊敬他。\p而且，我感到你身上也
散发着同他一样的光芒。\p希望你和你父亲之间
能有一场精彩的对战！$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_BerkePostBadge
source: Since your dad became the LEADER,\nthe TRAINERS of PETALBURG CITY have\lbecome a lot tougher.$
translation: 自从你爸爸成为馆主以来，\n橙华市的训练家\l都变强了不少。$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_MaryIntro
source: Giggle…\nThis is the ACCURACY ROOM.\pIt's pretty nasty when every attack\nlands without fail.$
translation: 嘻嘻......\n这里是命中房间。\p当所有攻击全部命中时，\n你会应付不过来的。$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_MaryDefeat
source: You were a cut above me…$
translation: 你技高一筹啊......$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_MaryPostBattle
source:
There are some even stronger
TRAINERS waiting for you.\pThe left is the DEFENSE ROOM, and
the right is the RECOVERY ROOM.\pYour POKéMON's ATTACK power will be
on trial either way.$
translation:
前面有更强的
训练家在等着你。\p左边是防御房间，
右边是回复房间。\p你的宝可梦的攻击
会在前方受到挑战。$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_MaryPostBadge
source: Do you know what we're trying to\nachieve as TRAINERS?\pWe're striving to become soul mates\nwith our POKéMON.$
translation: 知道我们作为训练家的\n终极追求吗？\p就是能与我们的\n宝可梦心意相通。$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_AlexiaIntro
source: The higher the DEFENSE, the more\nreckless I can be in attack.$
translation: 防御越高，\n攻击时越没有后顾之忧。$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_AlexiaDefeat
source: Our defenses weren't enough…$
translation: 我们的防御还不够......$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_AlexiaPostBattle
source:
I think you've taught me a valuable
lesson here.\pNow, go on! The left door goes to
the STRENGTH ROOM.\pThe right door opens to
the ONE-HIT KO ROOM.\pBoth of them have TRAINERS who are
skilled at offense.$
translation:
你给我上了
重要的一课。\p好了，加油吧！左边的门
通向力量房间，\p右边的门通向
一击必杀房间。\p两边的训练家都
十分善于进攻。$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_AlexiaPostBadge
source: Hi! Have you tried using SURF?$
translation: 喂，你尝试过冲浪吗？$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_JodyIntro
source: Our GYM LEADER told us to go all out\nand beat you.\pEven if you happen to be the\nLEADER's kid!$
translation: 我们的道馆馆主要我们\n尽全力打败你。\p就算你是馆主的孩子，\n我们也不能放水！$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_JodyDefeat
source: But… I went all out!$
translation: 但......我已经尽力了！$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_JodyPostBattle
source: The way you use your POKéMON…\nIt's like your father's style.\pGo on through! The GYM LEADER, your\nfather, is waiting!$
translation: 你使用宝可梦的方法......\n和你父亲很像。\p去吧，你的父亲，道馆馆主，\n正在等着你！$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_JodyPostBadge
source: Sure, it's fine to make your POKéMON\nstronger.\pBut what decides the winner?\pWhy, it's the feelings TRAINERS have\nfor their POKéMON.$
translation: 当然，让宝可梦变强\n并没有错。\p但是，是什么决定了胜负？\p正是训练家对他们\n宝可梦的感情。$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_DoorAppearsLocked
source: This door appears to be locked\nright now…$
translation: 这扇门现在\n锁着......$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_EnterSpeedRoom
source: “SPEED ROOM,” the sign says.\pDo you want to go through?$
translation: 牌子上写着"速度房间"。\p想进去吗？$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_DoorAppearsLocked2
source: This door appears to be locked\nright now…$
translation: 这扇门现在\n锁着......$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_EnterAccuracyRoom
source: “ACCURACY ROOM,” the sign says.\pDo you want to go through?$
translation: 牌子上写着"命中房间"。\p想进去吗？$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_EnterConfusionRoom
source: “CONFUSION ROOM,” the sign says.\pDo you want to go through?$
translation: 牌子上写着"混乱房间"。\p想进去吗？$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_EnterDefenseRoom
source: “DEFENSE ROOM,” the sign says.\pDo you want to go through?$
translation: 牌子上写着"防御房间"。\p想进去吗？$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_EnterRecoveryRoom
source: “RECOVERY ROOM,” the sign says.\pDo you want to go through?$
translation: 牌子上写着"回复房间"。\p想进去吗？$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_EnterStrengthRoom
source: “STRENGTH ROOM,” the sign says.\pDo you want to go through?$
translation: 牌子上写着"力量房间"。\p想进去吗？$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_EnterOHKORoom
source: “ONE-HIT KO ROOM,” the sign says.\pDo you want to go through?$
translation: 牌子上写着"一击必杀房间"。\p想进去吗？$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_EnterGymLeadersRoom
source: “GYM LEADER'S ROOM\p“See for yourself what POKéMON await\nyou!” the sign says.\pDo you want to go through?$
translation: 牌子上写着："道馆馆主的房间\p亲眼见识一下\n等待着你的宝可梦吧！"\p想进去吗？$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_GymStatue
source: PETALBURG CITY POKéMON GYM$
translation: 橙华市宝可梦道馆$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_GymStatueCertified
source: PETALBURG CITY POKéMON GYM\pNORMAN'S CERTIFIED TRAINERS:\n{PLAYER}$
translation: 橙华市宝可梦道馆\p千里认可的训练家：\n{PLAYER}$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_NormanPreRematch
source:
DAD: {PLAYER}…
I had a feeling that you would come.\pI would never refuse to accept
a challenge from you.\pYou do understand, don't you?\pInside a GYM, it doesn't matter that
we are a parent and child.\p…No, because we are parent and child,
we owe it to each other to do the best\lwe can. Isn't that right, {PLAYER}?$
translation:
爸爸：{PLAYER}......
我就知道你会来。\p我永远也不会拒绝
你的挑战的。\p你明白的，对吧？\p在道馆里，
无关我们是不是父子。\p不，正因为我们是父子，
我们才更要在对方面前用上全力。\l对吧，{PLAYER}？$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_NormanRematchDefeat
source: Uh… Haha…\nMaybe that was going too hard…$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_NormanPostRematch
source: DAD: {PLAYER}…\nWhat is your dream?\pMy dream…\nHahaha…\lIt has already come true, actually.$
translation: 爸爸：{PLAYER}......\n你的梦想是什么？\p我的梦想......\n哈哈哈......\l其实已经实现了。$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_NormanRematchNeedTwoMons
source:
DAD: {PLAYER}…
I had a feeling that you would come.\pI would never refuse to accept
a challenge from you.\pYou do understand, don't you?\pInside a GYM, it doesn't matter that
we are a parent and child.\pHm? Wait a second, {PLAYER}.\pDo you only have one POKéMON that is
capable of battle?\pSorry, but you'll have to come back
with at least two POKéMON.$
translation:
爸爸：{PLAYER}......
我就知道你会来。\p我永远也不会拒绝
你的挑战的。\p你明白的，对吧？\p在道馆里，
无关我们是不是父子。\p嗯？
等等，{PLAYER}，\p你只有1只
能对战的宝可梦吗？\p你得带至少2只
宝可梦来才行。$

label: PetalburgCity_House1_Text_TravelingIsWonderful
source: Traveling is wonderful!\pWhen I was young, I roamed the seas\nand the mountains!$
translation: 旅行太美妙了！\p我年轻的时候\n经常去游泳登山！$

label: PetalburgCity_House1_Text_GoOnAdventure
source:
Sigh…\pI wish I could go on an adventure
with some POKéMON…\pCrawl through some damp grass…
Climb rocky, rugged mountains…\pCross the raging seas…
Wander about in dark caves…\pAnd, sometimes, even get a little
homesick…\pIt must be fabulous to travel!$
translation:
哎......\p我要是能和宝可梦
一起去探险多好......\p爬过潮湿的草丛......
攀登崎岖的高山......\p穿越波涛汹涌的大海......
在黑暗的洞窟里散步......\p然后，偶尔泛出点
乡愁......\p旅行真的太美妙了！$

label: PetalburgCity_House2_Text_NormanBecameGymLeader
source: NORMAN became our town's new\nGYM LEADER.\pI think he called his family over from\nsomewhere far away.$
translation: 千里是城镇里新来的\n道馆馆主，\p他带着全家从很远的\n地方搬过来了。$

label: PetalburgCity_House2_Text_BattledNormanOnce
source: I battled NORMAN once, but, whew,\nhe was way too strong.\pHow would I put it?\pI just got the feeling that he\nlives for POKéMON.$
translation: 我曾经挑战过千里，\n但是，唉，他太强了。\p怎么说呢？\p我感觉他是\n为宝可梦而生的。$

label: PetalburgCity_Mart_Text_WeakWillGrowStronger
source: Even if a POKéMON is weak now,\nit will grow stronger.\pThe most important thing is love!\nLove for your POKéMON!$
translation: 即使宝可梦一时很弱小，\n但它总会变强的。\p这之中最重要的就是爱！\n爱你的宝可梦吧！$

label: PetalburgCity_Mart_Text_RepelIsUseful
source: Do you use REPEL?\nIt keeps POKéMON away, so it's\luseful when you're in a hurry.$
translation: 你用过除虫喷雾吗？\n它能赶走野生宝可梦，\l当你急着赶路的时候会很有用。$

label: PetalburgCity_Mart_Text_TakeSomeAntidotesWithYou
source: Do you have any ANTIDOTES with\nyou?\pIf you walk around with a poisoned\nPOKéMON, it will lose HP until it faints.\lTake some ANTIDOTES with you.$
translation: 你带着\n解毒药吗？\p如果带着中毒的宝可梦行动，\n它会不断失去体力，直至昏厥。\l带上些解毒药吧。$

label: PetalburgCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_PCStorageSystem
source: That PC-based POKéMON Storage\nSystem…\pWhoever made it must be some kind\nof a scientific wizard!$
translation: 电脑上的\n宝可梦寄放系统......\p无论是谁发明的，\n那人一定是个科学奇人！$

label: PetalburgCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_OranBerryRegainedHP
source: When my POKéMON ate an\nORAN BERRY, it regained HP!$
translation: 我的宝可梦吃了蓝橘果后，\n它的体力就恢复了！$

label: PetalburgCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_ManyTypesOfPokemon
source: There are many types of POKéMON.\pAll types have their strengths and\nweaknesses against other types.\pDepending on the types of POKéMON,\na battle could be easy or hard.$
translation: 宝可梦分为很多属性。\p每种属性对其他属性\n都有不同的优势和弱点。\p由于宝可梦属性的不同，\n战斗可能会变得更加容易或棘手。$

label: PetalburgCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_TreeckoIsGrassType
source:
For example, your TREECKO
is a GRASS type.\pIt's strong against the WATER and
GROUND types.\pBut, it's weak against FIRE-type
POKéMON.$
translation:
比如，你的木守宫
是草属性。\p它对水属性和地面属性时
占有优势，\p但对火属性宝可梦时
则处于劣势。$

label: PetalburgCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_TorchicIsFireType
source:
For example, your TORCHIC
is a FIRE type.\pIt's strong against the GRASS and
BUG types.\pBut, it's weak against WATER-type
POKéMON.$
translation:
比如，你的火稚鸡
是火属性。\p它对草属性和虫属性时
占有优势，\p但对水属性宝可梦时
则处于劣势。$

label: PetalburgCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_MudkipIsWaterType
source: For example, your MUDKIP\nis a WATER type.\pIt's strong against the FIRE type.\pBut, it's weak against GRASS-type\nand ELECTRIC-type POKéMON.$
translation:
比如，你的水跃鱼
是水属性。\p它对火属性时
占有优势，\p但对草属性和电属性宝可梦时
则处于劣势。$

label: PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_ThanksForPlayingWithWally
source:
You're…
Ah, you must be {PLAYER}{KUN}, right?\pThank you for playing with WALLY a
little while ago.\pHe's been frail and sickly ever
since he was a baby.\pWe've sent him to stay with my relatives
in VERDANTURF TOWN for a while.\pThe air is a lot cleaner there
than it is here.\pWhat's that? Where's WALLY?
He's already left, our WALLY.\pI wonder where he could have
gotten by now?$
translation:
你是......
啊，你一定就是{PLAYER}{KUN}吧？\p谢谢你刚才能
和满充一起玩。\p他从小就体弱多病。\p我们打算送他到
绿茵镇的亲戚家去，\p那里的空气
比这儿洁净。\p什么？满充在哪儿？
我们家满充已经出发了。\p不知道现在
该到哪儿了呢？$

label: PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_WonderHowWallyIsDoing
source: I wonder how our WALLY is doing?$
translation: 不知道我家满充在做什么？$

label: PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_PleaseExcuseUs
source:
{PLAYER}{KUN}! Please excuse us for
dragging you here this way.\pBut our WALLY's become very healthy
since he went to VERDANTURF TOWN.\pWe owe it all to you!\pWhen WALLY left town, you helped
him catch a POKéMON, right?\pI think that made WALLY really
happy.\pActually, not just WALLY.
It made me, his father, happy too.\pHappy that he's gained such a great
friend as you.\pThis isn't a bribe or anything, but
I'd really like you to have this.$
translation:
{PLAYER}{KUN}！原谅我们
这样拉你过来，\p但是，自从我家满充去了
绿茵镇之后，他的身体好多了。\p我们都欠你的情！\p满充离开镇子前，
是你陪他捕捉了一只宝可梦对吗？\p我想那让满充
非常开心。\p实际上，不只是满充，
作为父亲的我也很开心，\p很开心他能交上
你这样的好朋友。\p这点礼物虽然不算什么
但还是请你收下。$

label: PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_SurfGoAllSortsOfPlaces
source: If your POKéMON can SURF, you'll be\nable to go to all sorts of places.$
translation: 如果你的宝可梦会冲浪，\n你就可以去很多地方了。$

label: PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_WallyIsComingHomeSoon
source: WALLY's coming home soon.\nI'm looking forward to that.$
translation: 满充很快就会回家了，\n真想快点见到他。$

label: PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_YouMetWallyInEverGrandeCity
source: Oh? You met WALLY in\nEVER GRANDE CITY?\pOh, {PLAYER}{KUN}, don't be silly.\pHe may have gotten healthy, but he\ncan't go somewhere far away like\lthat all by himself.$
translation: 哦？你在彩悠市\n遇到了满充？\p哎，{PLAYER}{KUN}，别闹了。\p他可能健康多了，\n但它不可能一个人\l到那么远的地方去。$

label: PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_WallyWasReallyHappy
source: WALLY was really happy when he told\nus that he caught a POKéMON.\pIt's been ages since I've seen him\nsmile like that.$
translation: 满充非常兴奋地告诉我们\n他捕捉到了一只宝可梦。\p已经有很多年没看到过\n他那快乐的笑容了。$

label: PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_WallyLeftWithoutTelling
source:
I want you to keep this a secret
from my husband…\pBut our WALLY left VERDANTURF TOWN
without telling anyone.\pYou know, WALLY is frail, but
he's surprisingly strong-willed.\pI'm sure that he'll come back safe
and sound one day!$
translation:
有件事你一定要
对我丈夫保密......\p我们的满充没跟任何人说
就离开了绿茵镇。\p你知道，尽管满充身体很弱，
但他的意志很坚强。\p我知道他总有一天
会平安无事地回家的！$

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_NotAOneToBeFound
source: Hmmm…\nNot a one to be found…$

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_HaveYouSeenShroomish
source: Hello, have you seen any POKéMON\ncalled SHROOMISH around here?\pI really love that POKéMON.$
translation: 嗨，你在附近见到过叫做\n蘑蘑菇的宝可梦吗？\p我真的很喜欢那种宝可梦。$

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_IWasGoingToAmbushYou
source: I was going to ambush you, but you\nhad to dawdle in PETALBURG WOODS\lforever, didn't you?\pI got sick of waiting, so here I am!$
translation: 本打算偷袭你的，\n但看你好像打算在橙华森林里\l呆一辈子，\p我等得不耐烦了，\n干脆直接现身！$

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_HandOverThosePapers
source: You! DEVON RESEARCHER!\pHand over those papers!$
translation: 就是你！得文的研究员！\p把那些文件交出来！$

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_YouHaveToHelpMe
