source: Aiyeeeh!\pYou're a POKéMON TRAINER, aren't you?\nYou've got to help me, please!$
translation: 哇啊！\p你是个宝可梦训练家，对吗？\n拜托你帮帮我吧！$

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_NoOneCrossesTeamAqua
source: Hunh? What do you think you're doing?\nWhat, you're going to protect him?\pNo one who crosses TEAM AQUA\ngets any mercy, not even a kid!\pCome on and battle me!$
translation: 嗯？你知道自己在做什么吗？\n什么，你要保护他？\p就算你只是个孩子，\n和海洋队作对也没好下场！\p来对战吧！$

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_YoureKiddingMe
source: You're kidding me! You're tough!$
translation: 开玩笑吧！这么强？！$

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_YouveGotSomeNerve
source:
Grrr… You've got some nerve
meddling with TEAM AQUA!\lCome on and battle me again!\pI wish I could say that, but I'm out of
POKéMON…\pAnd, hey, we of TEAM AQUA are also
after something in RUSTBORO.\pI'll let you go today!$
translation:
咕......敢和海洋队作对，
你胆子不小！\l再来对战一次吧！\p虽然想这么说，
可我已经没有宝可梦了......\p而且，哼，我们海洋队还得在
卡那兹市找某些东西，\p今天就放你一马！$

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_ThatWasAwfullyClose
source:
Whew…
That was awfully close!\pThanks to you, he didn't rob me of
these important papers.\pI know, I'll give you a GREAT BALL as
my thanks!$
translation:
呼......
好险啊！\p多亏了你，
重要的文件才没被抢走。\p作为谢礼，
送你一个超级球吧！$

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_TeamAquaAfterSomethingInRustboro
source: Didn't that TEAM AQUA thug say\nthey were after something in\lRUSTBORO, too?$
translation: 说起来刚才那个海洋队的混混说，\n他们也在寻找卡那兹市的东西，是吗？$

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_ICantBeWastingTime
source: Uh-oh! It's a crisis!\nI can't be wasting time!$
translation: 唔喔！情况紧急！\n没时间再耽搁了！$

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_YoureLoadedWithItems
source: You're loaded with items.\nI can't give you this GREAT BALL.$
translation: 你的道具已经满了，\n我没法把这个超级球给你。$

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_GoBugPokemonTeam
source: I caught a whole bunch of POKéMON!\pGo, go, go!\nMy BUG POKéMON team!$
translation: 我捉了许多的宝可梦！\p上啊！\n我的虫宝可梦之队！$

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_ICouldntWin
source: I have all these POKéMON,\nbut I couldn't win…$
translation: 拥有这些宝可梦，\n我却无法获胜......$

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_ImOutOfPokeBalls
source: I caught a bunch of POKéMON.\nNow I'm out of POKé BALLS.$
translation: 我捉了许多的宝可梦，\n现在已经没有精灵球了。$

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_InstantlyPopularWithBugPokemon
source: If you take BUG POKéMON to school,\nyou get to be instantly popular!$
translation: 如果把虫宝可梦带到学校里，\n马上就会变成明星的！$

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_CantBePopularIfILose
source: I can't be popular if I lose.$
translation: 输了的话就不会成为明星了。$

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_PeopleRespectYou
source: If you have a big BUG POKéMON,\npeople respect you for it.$
translation: 如果拥有一只好大的虫宝可梦，\n大家会很羡慕你的。$

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_IWantRematch1
source: I want a rematch when my BUG\nPOKéMON grow up!\pI'm registering you in my POKéNAV!$
translation: 等我的虫宝可梦\n长大后，我们再比一次吧！\p我把你登记到宝可导航里了！$

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_IWantRematch2
source: I want a rematch when my BUG \nPOKéMON grow up!\pI'm registering you in my POKéNAV!$
translation: 等我的虫宝可梦\n长大后，我们再比一次吧！\p我把你登记到宝可导航里了！$

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_MyPokemonHaveGrown
source: My BUG POKéMON have grown.\nI'll be popular again.$
translation: 我的虫宝可梦长大了，\n我会再次变成明星的。$

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_CantBePopularIfLose
source: I can't be popular if I lose.$
translation: 输了的话就不会成为明星了。$

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_IveBeenTrainingHard
source: You get to be popular if you have\nstrong POKéMON, right?\lSo, I've been training hard.$
translation: 如果拥有强大的宝可梦\n就会被大家追捧的，对吧？\l所以我一直在刻苦训练。$

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_StayOutOfTallGrass
source: Yo, there!\nYour POKéMON doing okay?\pIf your POKéMON are weak and you want\nto avoid battles, you should stay out\lof tall grass.$
translation: 哟，那边的！\n你的宝可梦没事吧？\p如果你的宝可梦很虚弱，\n想避免战斗，那就得避开草堆。$

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_HiddenItemsExplanation
source: Sometimes, there are things on the\nground even if you can't see them.\pThat's why I always check where I'm\nwalking.$
translation: 有时候，地上会有些\n你看不见的东西。\p所以我不管走到哪儿\n都会仔细搜索四周。$

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_TryUsingThisItem
source: Oh, neat!\nThat's the BADGE from RUSTBORO GYM!\pYou must be a TRAINER.\nYou should try using this item.$
translation: 哦，真漂亮！\n那是卡那兹市道馆的徽章！\p你一定是个训练家，\n试试这个东西吧。$

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_MiracleSeedExplanation
source: It's a MIRACLE SEED.\nIf a POKéMON holds that item, its\lGRASS-type moves become stronger.\pBesides MIRACLE SEED, I think there are\nother convenient items for POKéMON\lto hold.$
translation: 这是奇迹种子，\n让宝可梦携带的话，\l它的草属性招式就会变强。\p我想除了奇迹种子，\n还有其它能让宝可梦携带的便利道具。$

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_TrainerTipsExperience
source:
TRAINER TIPS\pAny POKéMON that appears even once
in a battle is awarded EXP Points.\pTo raise a weak POKéMON, put it at the
left of the team list.\pAs soon as a battle starts, switch it
out. It will earn EXP Points without\lbeing exposed to any harm.$
translation:
有用的公告牌！\p所有在战斗中出过场的宝可梦
都会得到经验值。\p想培育弱小的宝可梦，
就把它放到队伍列表的左侧。\p战斗开始时，先把它换下场。
这样它不会受伤\l也能获得经验值了。$

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_TrainerTipsPP
source: TRAINER TIPS\pIn addition to Hit Points (HP), POKéMON\nhave Power Points (PP) that are used to\lmake moves during battle.\pIf a POKéMON runs out of PP, it must be\ntaken to a POKéMON CENTER.$
translation: 有用的公告牌！\p除了被打击点数HP(体力)，\n宝可梦还拥有用来在战斗中发动招式的\l招式点数(PP)。\p如果宝可梦的PP值耗尽，必须把它\n带到宝可梦中心去。$

label: Text_DreamEaterTeach
source:
Yawn!
I must have dozed off in the sun.\pI had this weird dream about
a DROWZEE eating my dream.\pAnd…
I learned how to eat dreams…\pOogh, this is too spooky!\pLet me teach it to a POKéMON so
I can forget about it!$
translation:
哈欠！
在这种阳光下我肯定会打起瞌睡。\p然后我做了一个一只
催眠貘正在吞食我做的梦的怪梦。\p在那之后......
我学会了如何食梦......\p噢，真是太恐怖了！\p让我把它教给一只宝可梦吧
这样我才能赶快忘了它！$

label: Text_DreamEaterDeclined
source: …Snore…$

label: Text_DreamEaterWhichMon
source: Which POKéMON wants to learn\nDREAM EATER?$
translation: 哪一只宝可梦想要学会\n食梦呢？$

label: Text_DreamEaterTaught
source: …ZZZ…\nI…can't eat…anymore…$

label: PewterCity_Text_ClefairyCameFromMoon
source: CLEFAIRY came from the moon.\nThat's what the rumor is.\pThey appeared after MOON STONES\nfell on MT. MOON.$
translation: 有这样一个传说，\n说皮皮来自月亮。\p在那之后月之石\n才出现在了月见山。$

label: PewterCity_Text_BrockOnlySeriousTrainerHere
source:
There aren't many serious POKéMON
TRAINERS here.\pThey're all like BUG CATCHERS,
you know, just hobbyists.\pBut PEWTER GYM's BROCK isn't like
that, not one bit.$
translation:
这里没有那种很严肃的
宝可梦训练家。\p他们都打扮得像个捉虫少年，
你懂的，就是一种癖好。\p可深灰道馆的小刚并不像这样打扮。
不像，一点都不像。$

label: PewterCity_Text_DidYouCheckOutMuseum
source: Did you check out the MUSEUM?$
translation: 你去博物馆看过了吗？$

label: PewterCity_Text_WerentThoseFossilsAmazing
source: Weren't those fossils from MT. MOON\namazing?$
translation: 不觉得这些来自月见山的化石\n很令人吃惊吗？$

label: PewterCity_Text_ReallyYouHaveToGo
source: Really?\nYou absolutely have to go!$
translation: 真的？\n你必须得去一次看看！$

label: PewterCity_Text_ThisIsTheMuseum
source: This is it, the MUSEUM.\pYou have to pay to get in, but it's\nworth it. See you around!$
translation: 博物馆就在这里了。\p虽然你必须花钱买了票才能进去，\n但是里面非常值得一看。回头见！$

label: PewterCity_Text_DoYouKnowWhatImDoing
source: Psssst!\nDo you know what I'm doing?$
translation: 嘘！\n你知道我正在做什么吗？$

label: PewterCity_Text_ThatsRightItsHardWork
source: That's right!\nIt's hard work!$
translation: 没错！\n这事做起来可不轻松！$

label: PewterCity_Text_SprayingRepelToKeepWildMonsOut
source: I'm spraying REPEL to keep wild\nPOKéMON out of my garden!$
translation: 我正在喷除虫喷雾使那些野生的\n宝可梦远离我的花园！$

label: PewterCity_Text_BrocksLookingForChallengersFollowMe
source: You're a TRAINER, right?\pBROCK's looking for new\nchallengers. Follow me!$
translation: 你是一个训练家，对吗？\p小刚正在寻找新的挑战者\n跟我来！$

label: PewterCity_Text_GoTakeOnBrock
source: If you have the right stuff,\ngo take on BROCK!$
translation: 如果你有了正确的信念，\n就应该去打倒小刚！$

label: PewterCity_Text_TrainerTipsEarningEXP
source: TRAINER TIPS\pAll POKéMON that appear in battle,\nhowever briefly, earn EXP Points.$
translation: 训练家贴士\p在战斗中出场过的宝可梦，\n哪怕是只打了瓶酱油都会获得经验值。$

label: PewterCity_Text_CallPoliceIfInfoOnThieves
source: NOTICE!\pThieves have been stealing POKéMON\nfossils from MT. MOON.\pPlease call the PEWTER POLICE if\nyou have any information.$
translation: 通知\p有些小偷正在对月见山的\n宝可梦化石下手。\p如果你有任何线索\n请马上通知深灰警察局。$

label: PewterCity_Text_MuseumOfScience
source: PEWTER MUSEUM OF SCIENCE$
translation: 深灰科学博物馆$

label: PewterCity_Text_GymSign
source: PEWTER CITY POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: BROCK\lThe Rock-Solid POKéMON TRAINER!$
translation: 深灰市宝可梦道馆\n馆主：小刚\l有如磐石般坚硬的宝可梦训练家！$

label: PewterCity_Text_CitySign
source: PEWTER CITY\nA Stone Gray City$
translation: 深灰市\n灰色的岩石之城$

label: PewterCity_Text_OhPlayer
source: Oh, {PLAYER}{KUN}!$
translation: 噢，{PLAYER}{KUN}！$

label: PewterCity_Text_AskedToDeliverThis
source: I'm glad I caught up to you.\nI'm PROF. OAK's AIDE.\pI've been asked to deliver this,\nso here you go.$
translation: 能够赶上你真高兴。\n我是大木博士的助手。\p给。\n我被叮嘱要把这件东西带给你。$

label: PewterCity_Text_ReceivedRunningShoesFromAide
source: {PLAYER} received the\nRUNNING SHOES from the AIDE.$
translation: {PLAYER}从助手那里\n获得了跑步鞋。$

label: PewterCity_Text_SwitchedShoesWithRunningShoes
source: {PLAYER} switched shoes with the\nRUNNING SHOES.$
translation: {PLAYER}换上了\n跑步鞋。$

label: PewterCity_Text_ExplainRunningShoes
source: Press the B Button to run.\nBut only where there's room to run!$
translation: 现在开始按B键就可以跑步了。\n但是只能在空旷的地方跑哦！$

label: PewterCity_Text_MustBeGoingBackToLab
source: Well, I must be going back to\nthe LAB.\pBye-bye!$
translation: 那么，我必须回\n研究所去了。\p再见啦！$

label: PewterCity_Text_RunningShoesLetterFromMom
source: There's a letter attached…\pDear {PLAYER},\pHere is a pair of RUNNING SHOES\nfor my beloved challenger.\pRemember, I'll always cheer for\nyou! Don't ever give up!\pFrom Mom$
translation: 是一封信......\p亲爱的{PLAYER}，\p这双跑步鞋\n是给我心爱的挑战者的。\p我一直都会祝福你。\n记住，永远不要中途就放弃了！\p妈妈$

label: PewterCity_Gym_Text_BrockIntro
source:
So, you're here. I'm BROCK.
I'm PEWTER's GYM LEADER.\pMy rock-hard willpower is evident
even in my POKéMON.\pMy POKéMON are all rock hard, and
have true-grit determination.\pThat's right - my POKéMON are all
the ROCK type!\pFuhaha! You're going to challenge
me knowing that you'll lose?\pThat's the TRAINER's honor that
compels you to challenge me.\pFine, then!
Show me your best!{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_RG_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}$
translation:
啊，你来了，我是小刚。
深灰市的道馆馆主。\p我，以及我的宝可梦的意志力
都和岩石一样坚定。\p身体都和岩石一样坚硬，
并且都有着坚定的决心！\p没错，我的宝可梦就是岩石属性的！\p哼，明明知道会输，
还是要来挑战我？\p是训练家的荣誉心让你
挑战我的吧！\p好吧，
展示一下你最好的能力吧！{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_RG_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}$

label: PewterCity_Gym_Text_BrockDefeat
source:
I took you for granted, and so
I lost.\pAs proof of your victory, I confer
on you this…the official POKéMON\lLEAGUE BOULDERBADGE.\p{FONT_NORMAL}{PLAYER} received the BOULDERBADGE
from BROCK!{PAUSE_MUSIC}{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_OBTAIN_BADGE}{PAUSE 0xFE}{PAUSE 0x56}{RESUME_MUSIC}\p{FONT_MALE}Just having the BOULDERBADGE makes
your POKéMON more powerful.\pIt also enables the use of the
move FLASH outside of battle.\pOf course, a POKéMON must know the
move FLASH to use it.$
translation:
我输了。
你赢得毫无悬念。\p作为通过尼比市道馆挑战的证明，
请你收下这个......\l宝可梦联盟的灰色徽章。\p{FONT_NORMAL}{PLAYER}从小刚那儿得到了灰色徽章！
{PAUSE_MUSIC}{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_OBTAIN_BADGE}{PAUSE 0xFE}{PAUSE 0x56}{RESUME_MUSIC}\p{FONT_MALE}有了灰色徽章，
宝可梦就能变得更加强大。\p而且在战斗以外
也能够使用闪光了。\p当然，宝可梦必须得
学会闪光才行。$

label: PewterCity_Gym_Text_TakeThisWithYou
source: Wait!\nTake this with you.$
translation: 等等！\n拿着这个。$

label: PewterCity_Gym_Text_ReceivedTM39FromBrock
source: {PLAYER} received TM39\nfrom BROCK.$
translation: {PLAYER}从小刚那儿得到了TM39。$

label: PewterCity_Gym_Text_ExplainTM39
source:
A TM, Technical Machine, contains a
technique for POKéMON.\pUsing a TM teaches the move it
contains to a POKéMON.\pA TM is good for only one use.\pSo, when you use one, pick the
POKéMON carefully.\pAnyways…
TM39 contains ROCK TOMB.\pIt hurls boulders at the foe and
lowers its SPEED.$
translation:
TM是技能学习机，
里面有宝可梦能学习的技能。\p使用技能让一只宝可梦学习。\p一个技能只能用一次。\p所以，当你使用时，
要认真挑选宝可梦。\p嗯......
TM39包含岩石封锁。\p它的作用是向敌人投石头
而且降低其速度。$

label: PewterCity_Gym_Text_BrockPostBattle
source:
There are all kinds of TRAINERS in
this huge world of ours.\pYou appear to be very gifted as a
POKéMON TRAINER.\pSo let me make a suggestion.\pGo to the GYM in CERULEAN and test
your abilities.$
translation:
在这个广阔的世界上
有着各种各样的训练家。\p你作为一个宝可梦训练家
看起来很有天赋。\p那么我给你个建议吧。\p去挑战华蓝的道馆
来检验你的能力。$

label: PewterCity_Gym_Text_DontHaveRoomForThis
source: You don't have room for this.$
translation: 你没有空间装这个了。$

label: PewterCity_Gym_Text_LiamIntro
source: Stop right there, kid!\pYou're ten thousand light-years \nfrom facing BROCK!$
translation: 在那站好别动，小孩！\p要想挑战馆主小刚，\n你还差了10000光年！$

label: PewterCity_Gym_Text_LiamDefeat
source: Darn!\pLight-years isn't time…\nIt measures distance!$
translation: 呃！\p光年不是时间......\n而是路程的单位！$

label: PewterCity_Gym_Text_LiamPostBattle
source: You're pretty hot.\n…But not as hot as BROCK!$
translation: 你相当热血啊。\n......但是比不过小刚！$

label: PewterCity_Gym_Text_LetMeTakeYouToTheTop
source:
Hiya!
Do you want to dream big?\pDo you dare to dream of becoming
the POKéMON champ?\pI'm no TRAINER, but I can advise
you on how to win.\pLet me take you to the top!$
translation: 嗨！\n你抱有着很大的梦想吗？\p你梦想着当上宝可梦的冠军吗？\p我不是训练家，\n但是我可以教你如何取胜。\p让我助你登上顶峰吧！$

label: PewterCity_Gym_Text_LetsGetHappening
source: All right!\nLet's get happening!$
translation: 好！\n我们开始吧！$

label: PewterCity_Gym_Text_TryDifferentPartyOrders
source:
The first POKéMON out in a match is
at the left of the POKéMON LIST.\pBy changing the order of POKéMON,
you may gain an advantage.\pTry different orders to suit your
opponent's party.$
translation:
在比赛中第一个出来的宝可梦
是宝可梦列表最左边的那个。\p改变宝可梦的顺序，
你能获得不同的有利形势。\p根据你的对手不同
试着使用不同的顺序。$

label: PewterCity_Gym_Text_ItsFreeLetsGetHappening
source: It's a free service!\nLet's get happening!$
translation: 这是免费服务！\n我们开始吧！$

label: PewterCity_Gym_Text_YoureChampMaterial
source: Just as I thought!\nYou're POKéMON champ material!$
translation: 和我想的一样！\n你是当宝可梦冠军的材料！$

label: PewterCity_Gym_Text_GymStatue
source: PEWTER POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: BROCK\pWINNING TRAINERS:\n{RIVAL}$
translation: 深灰宝可梦道馆\n馆主：小刚\p优胜训练家：\n{RIVAL}$

label: PewterCity_Gym_Text_GymStatuePlayerWon
source: PEWTER POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: BROCK\pWINNING TRAINERS:\n{RIVAL}, {PLAYER}$
translation: 深灰宝可梦道馆\n馆主：小刚\p优胜训练家：\n{RIVAL}，{PLAYER}$

label: PewterCity_House1_Text_Nidoran
source: NIDORAN♂: Bowbow!$
translation: 尼多朗：啵啵！$

label: PewterCity_House1_Text_NidoranSit
source: NIDORAN, sit!$
translation: 尼多朗，坐下！$

label: PewterCity_House1_Text_TradeMonsAreFinicky
source:
Our POKéMON's an outsider, so it's
finicky and hard to handle.\pAn outsider is a POKéMON that you
get in a trade.\pIt grows fast, but it may ignore an
unskilled TRAINER in battle.\pIf only we had some BADGES…$
translation:
我们的宝可梦是外来的，
所以它很难控制。\p外来的宝可梦就是说
你是通过交换得到它的。\p它成长得很快，但是战斗中
可能不会听训练家的话。\p但是如果有徽章就不一样了......$

label: PewterCity_House2_Text_MonsLearnTechniquesAsTheyGrow
source: POKéMON learn new techniques as\nthey grow.\pBut some moves must be taught to\nthem by people.$
translation: 宝可梦在成长过程中\n可以学到新的技能。\p但是有一些必须要有人教\n它们才能学会。$

label: PewterCity_House2_Text_MonsEasierCatchIfStatused
source:
A POKéMON becomes easier to 
catch if it has a status problem.\pSleep, poison, burn, or paralysis…
Those are all effective.\pBut catching POKéMON is never
a sure thing!$
translation:
当一只宝可梦进入异常状态时
会容易收服一些。\p睡眠，中毒，烧伤，或者麻痹......
这些都能对其造成影响。\p但是收服一只宝可梦
从来都不是件容易的事！$

label: PewterCity_Mart_Text_BoughtWeirdFishFromShadyGuy
source: A shady old guy sucked me into\nbuying this weird fish POKéMON!\pIt's totally weak and it cost ¥500!$
translation: 一个奸商忽悠我买下了\n这只奇怪的鱼宝可梦！\p它弱得可怕，竟然要500！$

label: PewterCity_Mart_Text_GoodThingsIfRaiseMonsDiligently
source: Good things can happen if you raise\nPOKéMON diligently.\pEven the weak ones can surprise\nyou if you don't give up on them.$
translation: 如果你耐心地培养宝可梦，\n就会产生好的结果。\p如果你不放弃它们，就算是\n弱一些的宝可梦也会给你带来惊喜。$

label: PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_Its50YForChildsTicket
source: Yes, yes.\nIt's ¥50 for a child's ticket.\pWould you like to come in?$
translation: 好的。\n儿童票要50。\p你想进去吗？$

label: PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_ComeAgain
source: Come again!$
translation: 下次再来！$

label: PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_Right50YThankYou
source: Right, ¥50!\nThank you!$
translation: 好的，收您50！\n谢谢你！$

label: PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_DontHaveEnoughMoney
source: 你的钱不够。$
translation: 你没有足够的钱。$

label: PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_PleaseEnjoyYourself
source: Please enjoy yourself.$
translation: 请尽情地参观。$

label: PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_DoYouKnowWhatAmberIs
source: You can't sneak in the back way!\nNice try, kid, but no.\pOh, whatever!\nDo you know what AMBER is?$
translation: 你不能从后门溜进来啊！\n身手不错，但这样做可不对。\p唉，不管怎么样！\n你知道什么是琥珀吗？$

label: PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_AmberContainsGeneticMatter
source: AMBER contains the genetic matter\nof ancient POKéMON.\pThere's a LAB somewhere trying to\nresurrect POKéMON from AMBER.$
translation: 琥珀里面有古代宝可梦\n的遗传基因。\p在某个地方有一个研究所\n正努力从琥珀复活宝可梦。$

label: PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_AmberIsFossilizedSap
source: AMBER is actually sap, that gooey\nstuff that oozes from trees.\pThe ancient sap fossilized over\ntime to become rock-hard AMBER.$
translation: 琥珀实际上是树液，\n一种从树里面流出来的黏黏的液体。\p古老的树液化石经过\n很长时间以后变成了坚硬的琥珀。$

label: PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_ShouldBeGratefulForLongLife
source: I should be grateful for my long\nlife.\pNever did I think I would get to\nsee the bones of a dragon!$
translation: 感谢上苍让我\n活了这么长时间。\p我从没想过\n我能亲眼看见龙的化石！$

label: PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_WantYouToGetAmberExamined
source:
Ssh! Listen, I need to share a
secret with someone.\pI think that this chunk of AMBER
contains POKéMON DNA!\pIt would be a shattering scientific
breakthrough if POKéMON could be\lresurrected from it.\pBut, my colleagues just ignore
what I have to say.\pSo, I have a favor to ask!\pI want you to get this examined at
a POKéMON LAB somewhere.$
translation:
嘘！听着，
我要告诉你一个重要的秘密。\p我认为这块琥珀
里面有宝可梦的DNA！\p如果宝可梦能从里面复活，
这将是整个科学界\l一个重大的突破。\p但是，我的同事们
都把我说的不当回事。\p所以我有一个请求！\p我想让你帮我把这个带到
一个宝可梦实验室去检测一下。$

label: PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_ReceivedOldAmberFromMan
source: {PLAYER} received the OLD AMBER\nfrom the man.$
translation: {PLAYER}从他那里得到了秘密琥珀。$

label: PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_GetOldAmberChecked
source: Ssh!\nGet the OLD AMBER checked!$
translation: 嘘！\n去检测这个秘密琥珀吧！$

label: PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_DontHaveSpaceForThis
source: You don't have space for this.$
translation: 你的背包满了。$

label: PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_WeHaveTwoFossilsOnExhibit
source: We have two fossils of rare,\nprehistoric POKéMON on exhibit.$
translation: 我们正在展出两只珍惜的\n史前宝可梦的化石。$

label: PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_BeautifulPieceOfAmber
source: There is a beautiful piece of\nAMBER in a clear gold color.$
translation: 这是一块漂亮的琥珀，\n闪烁着金黄色。$

label: PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_AerodactylFossil
source: AERODACTYL Fossil\nA primitive and rare POKéMON.$
translation: 化石翼龙的化石\n一种原始且珍贵的宝可梦。$

label: PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_KabutopsFossil
source: KABUTOPS Fossil\nA primitive and rare POKéMON.$
translation: 镰刀盔的化石\n一种原始且珍贵的宝可梦。$

label: Text_SeismicTossTeach
source:
The secrets of space…
The mysteries of earth…\pThere are so many things about
which we know so little.\pBut that should spur us to study
harder, not toss in the towel.\pThe only thing you should toss…\pWell, how about SEISMIC TOSS?
Should I teach that to a POKéMON?$
translation:
宇宙的秘密......
地球的奥妙......\p我们对这个世界的事
知道的太少了。\p但是这能激励我们更努力地学习。
而不是乱折腾。\p你唯一能折腾的一件事就是......\p嗯，地球上投怎么样？
要让我把这技能教给一只宝可梦吗？$

label: Text_SeismicTossDeclined
source: Is that so?\nI'm sure you'll be back for it.$
translation: 这样好吗？\n我确定你一定会回来的。$

label: Text_SeismicTossWhichMon
source: Which POKéMON wants to learn\nSEISMIC TOSS?$
translation: 想要哪只宝可梦学习\n地球上投？$

label: Text_SeismicTossTaught
source: I hope you won't toss in the towel.\nKeep it up.$
translation: 我希望你不再乱折腾了。\n继续吧。$

label: PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_WhatsSpecialAboutMoonStone
source: MOON STONE, huh?\pWhat's so special about it?\nLooks like an ordinary rock to me.$
translation: 月之石，哈？\p它很特殊吗？\n在我看来不过是普通石头罢了。$

label: PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_BoughtColorTVForMoonLanding
source: July 20, 1969!\pHumankind first set foot on the\nmoon that day.\pI bought a color TV just so I\ncould watch that news.$
translation: 1969年7月20日！\p人类在那一天第一次\n登上月球。\p为了看到那个新闻，\n我甚至买了台彩色电视机。$

label: PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_RunningSpaceExhibitThisMonth
source: This month, we're running a space\nexhibit.$
translation: 这个月我们正在进行\n关于宇宙的展览。$

label: PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_AskedDaddyToCatchPikachu
source: I want a PIKACHU!\nIt's so cute!\pI asked my daddy to catch me one!$
translation: 我想要一只皮卡丘！\n它太可爱了！\p我让我的爸爸去给我收服一只！$

label: PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_PikachuSoonIPromise
source: Yeah, a PIKACHU soon, I promise!$
translation: 好的，一只皮卡丘吧，我去捉！$

label: PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_SpaceShuttle
source: Space Shuttle$
translation: 航天飞机哥伦比亚号$

label: PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_MeteoriteThatFellOnMtMoon
source: A meteorite that fell on MT. MOON.\nIt is thought to be a MOON STONE.$
translation: 落在的月见山的陨石\n被称作月之石。$

label: PewterCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_TeamRocketMtMoonImOnPhone
source: What!?\pTEAM ROCKET is at MT. MOON?\nHuh?\pI'm on the phone!\nScram!$
translation: 什么！？\p火箭队在月见山？\n是么？\p我在打电话！\n要走了！$

label: PewterCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Jigglypuff
source: JIGGLYPUFF: Puu pupuu!$
translation: 胖丁：噗噗！$

label: PewterCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_WhenJiggylypuffSingsMonsGetDrowsy
source: Yawn!\pWhen JIGGLYPUFF sings, POKéMON get\ndrowsy…\p…Me, too…\nSnore…$
translation: 呵欠！\p当胖丁唱歌时，\n宝可梦会昏睡......\p......我也会......\n呼噜......$

label: PewterCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_TradingMyClefairyForPikachu
source: I really want a PIKACHU, so I'm\ntrading my CLEFAIRY for one.$
translation: 我真的想要一只皮卡丘，\n所以我用我的皮皮交换了一只。$

label: PewterCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_TradingPikachuWithKid
source: I'm trading POKéMON with that kid\nthere.\pI had two PIKACHU, so I figured\nI might as well trade one.$
translation: 我和那边的小孩交换了宝可梦。\p我有两只皮卡丘，所以我\n寻思着可以交换一只。$

label: PokemonLeague_AgathasRoom_Text_Intro
source:
I am AGATHA of the ELITE FOUR.\pI hear OAK's taken a lot of
interest in you, child.\pThat old duff was once tough and
handsome.\pBut that was decades ago.
He's a shadow of his former self.\pNow he just wants to fiddle with
his POKéDEX.\pHe's wrong.
POKéMON are for battling!\p{PLAYER}! I'll show you how a real
TRAINER battles!{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_RG_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}$
translation:
我是四天王之一菊子。\p孩子我听说大木
相当疼爱你。\p那个老傻瓜
曾经又猛又迷人！\p但是，这只是几十年前的事了。
现在的他活在他以前的影子里。\p成天玩弄他的破
宝可梦图鉴。\p他错了。
宝可梦是用来战斗的！\p{PLAYER}！让我来教你真正的
训练家是怎样战斗的！{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_RG_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}$

label: PokemonLeague_AgathasRoom_Text_RematchIntro
source:
I am AGATHA of the ELITE FOUR.\pYou're the child that OAK's taken
under his wing, aren't you?\pThat old duff was once tough and
handsome.\pBut that was decades ago.
He's a shadow of his former self.\pNow he just wants to fiddle with
his POKéDEX.\pHe's wrong.
POKéMON are for battling!\p{PLAYER}! I'll show you how a real
TRAINER battles!{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_RG_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}$
translation:
我是四天王之一菊子。\p我听说大木
相当疼你。\p那个老傻瓜
曾经又猛又迷人！\p但那是几十年前的事了。
现在的他活在他过去的影子里。\p成天摆弄他的破
宝可梦图鉴。\p他错了。
宝可梦是用来战斗的！\p{PLAYER}！让我来教你真正的
训练家是怎样战斗的！{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_RG_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}$

label: PokemonLeague_AgathasRoom_Text_Defeat
source: Oh, my!\nYou're something special, child!$
translation: 啊，真是了不得啊！\n你确实有些特别，孩子！$

label: PokemonLeague_AgathasRoom_Text_PostBattle
source: You win!\pI see what the old duff sees in\nyou now.\pI have nothing else to say.\nRun along now, child!$
translation: 是你赢了我！\p我想我明白那糟老头在你身上\n看到了什么了。\p我没有别的话可说了。\n到下个房间去吧，孩子！$

label: PokemonLeague_BrunosRoom_Text_Intro
source:
I am BRUNO of the ELITE FOUR!\pThrough rigorous training, people
and POKéMON can become stronger\lwithout limit.\pI've lived and trained with my
fighting POKéMON!\lAnd that will never change!\p{PLAYER}!\pWe will grind you down with our
superior power!\pHoo hah!{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_RG_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}$
translation:
我是四天王中的希巴！\p不论是宝可梦还是人
只要通过战斗的磨练\l都能变的更强。\p我就是靠着这股信念
和宝可梦一起生活一起训练\l而且之后我们也会永远会一起！\p{PLAYER}！\p尝尝我们强大的力量的吧！
同它把你打倒！\p喝啊！{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_RG_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}$

label: PokemonLeague_BrunosRoom_Text_RematchIntro
source:
I am BRUNO of the ELITE FOUR!\pThrough rigorous training, people
and POKéMON can become stronger\lwithout limit.\pI've lived and trained with my
fighting POKéMON!\lAnd that will never change!\p{PLAYER}!\pWe will grind you down with our
superior power!\pHoo hah!{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_RG_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}$
translation:
我是四天王中的希巴！\p不论是宝可梦还是人
只要通过战斗的磨练\l都能变的更强。\p我就是靠着这股信念
和宝可梦一起生活一起训练\l而且之后我们也会永远会一起！\p{PLAYER}！\p尝尝我们强大的力量的吧！
同它把你打倒！\p喝啊！{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_RG_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}$

label: PokemonLeague_BrunosRoom_Text_Defeat
source: Why?\nHow could I lose?$
translation: 为什么？\n我为什么会输？$

label: PokemonLeague_BrunosRoom_Text_PostBattle
source: My job is done.\nGo face your next challenge.$
translation: 我的工作已经完成了。\n去面对你下一个挑战吧。$

label: PokemonLeague_ChampionsRoom_Text_Intro
source:
{RIVAL}: Hey, {PLAYER}!\pI was looking forward to seeing
you, {PLAYER}.\pMy rival should be strong to keep
me sharp.\pWhile working on my POKéDEX, I
looked all over for POKéMON.\pNot only that, I assembled teams
that would beat any POKéMON type.\pAnd now…\pI'm the POKéMON LEAGUE CHAMPION!\p{PLAYER}!
Do you know what that means?\pI'll tell you.\pI am the most powerful TRAINER in
the world!$
translation:
{RIVAL}：你也来了，{PLAYER}！\p我之前就期待着
见你，{PLAYER}。\p我的对手就应该这样强大，这样才能
迫使我不断的前进。\p当我完成宝可梦图鉴时 我
到各处寻找宝可梦。\p不仅如此我建立的完美队伍
将会打败任何的宝可梦。\p而现在......\p我就是宝可梦联盟冠军！\p{PLAYER}！
你知道这意味着什么吗？\p我告诉你。\p我是宝可梦史上
最伟大的训练家！$

label: PokemonLeague_ChampionsRoom_Text_RematchIntro
source:
{RIVAL}: Hey, {PLAYER}!\pYou came back, {PLAYER}!
Hahah, that is so great!\pMy rival should be strong to keep
me sharp.\pWhile working on my POKéDEX, I
looked all over for POKéMON.\pNot only that, I assembled teams
that would beat any POKéMON type.\pAnd now…\pI'm the POKéMON LEAGUE CHAMPION!\p{PLAYER}!
Do you know what that means?\pI'll tell you.\pI am the most powerful TRAINER in
the world!$
translation:
{RIVAL}：嘿，{PLAYER}！\p你回来了，{PLAYER}！
哈哈哈，那真是太好了！\p我的对手就应该这样强大，这样才能
迫使我不断的前进。\p当我完成宝可梦图鉴时 我
到各处寻找宝可梦。\p不仅如此我建立的完美队伍
将会打败任何的宝可梦。\p而现在......\p我就是宝可梦联盟冠军！\p{PLAYER}！
你知道这意味着什么吗？\p我告诉你。\p我是宝可梦史上
最伟大的训练家！$

label: PokemonLeague_ChampionsRoom_Text_Defeat
source:
NO!
That can't be!\lYou beat me at my best!\pAfter all that work to become
the LEAGUE CHAMP?\pMy reign is over already?
It's not fair!$
translation:
什么！
这不可能！\l我尽了全力还是输了！\p我好不容易才终于
成为了联盟冠军，\p但我的时代已经结束了
这不公平！$

label: PokemonLeague_ChampionsRoom_Text_PostBattle
source:
Why?
Why did I lose?\pI never made any mistakes raising
my POKéMON…\pDarn it! You're the new POKéMON
LEAGUE CHAMPION!\pAlthough I don't like to admit it…$
translation:
为什么？
我为什么会输？\p我培养宝可梦时
从来没有出过任何的错误......\p可恶！你是新的宝可梦
联盟冠军！\p虽然我不太想承认这一点......$

label: PokemonLeague_ChampionsRoom_Text_OakPlayer
source: OAK: {PLAYER}!$
translation: 大木：{PLAYER}！$

label: PokemonLeague_ChampionsRoom_Text_OakCongratulations
source:
OAK: So, you've won!
Sincerely, congratulations!\pYou're the new POKéMON LEAGUE
CHAMPION!\pYou've grown up so much since you
first left with {STR_VAR_1} to work\lon the POKéDEX.\p{PLAYER}, you have come of age!$
translation:
大木：堂堂正正，你赢了！
真心地祝贺你！\p你是宝可梦联盟
新的联盟冠军！\p从一开始你带着{STR_VAR_1}去完成
宝可梦图鉴，\l应该说你长大了！\p{PLAYER}，你的时代来临了$

label: PokemonLeague_ChampionsRoom_Text_OakImDisappointedRival
source:
OAK: {RIVAL}…
I'm disappointed in you.\pI came when I heard you'd beaten
the ELITE FOUR.\pBut, when I got here, you had
already lost!\p{RIVAL}, do you understand why
you lost?\pYou have forgotten to treat your
POKéMON with love and trust.\pWithout them, you will never
become a CHAMP again!$
translation:
大木：{RIVAL}......
我对你很失望。\p听说你打败了四天王的消息
我飞奔到这里来。\p但是，当我到达的时候 
你已经输了！\p{RIVAL}，你明白你为什么
会失败吗？\p因为你没有给予你的
宝可梦信任和爱！\p没了它们，你再怎么努力
也不会再站在冠军的顶峰的！$

label: PokemonLeague_ChampionsRoom_Text_OakPlayerComeWithMe
source:
OAK: {PLAYER}.\pYou understand that your victory
was not just your own doing.\pThe bond you share with your
POKéMON is marvelous.\p{PLAYER}!
Come with me!$
translation:
大木：{PLAYER}。\p你能获得胜利
不止是靠自己的一个人力量。\p你和你的宝可梦心灵
有着奇妙非凡的感情。\p{PLAYER}！
跟我来！$

label: PokemonLeague_HallOfFame_Text_OakCongratulations
source:
OAK: Er-hem!
Congratulations, {PLAYER}!\pThis floor is the POKéMON HALL OF
FAME.\pPOKéMON LEAGUE CHAMPIONS are
honored for their exploits here.\pTheir POKéMON are also recorded in
the HALL OF FAME.\p{PLAYER}!\pYou have worked hard to become
the new LEAGUE CHAMPION.\pCongratulations, {PLAYER}, you and
your POKéMON are HALL OF FAMERS!$
translation:
大木：咳嗯！
祝贺，{PLAYER}！\p这层楼是
宝可梦荣誉殿堂。\p宝可梦联盟冠军
将因为他们的战绩而而得到荣光。\p他们的宝可梦也会被记录在
荣誉殿堂里。\p{PLAYER}！\p你努力战斗到此成为了
新的联盟冠军。\p祝贺你，{PLAYER}，你和你的
宝可梦是荣誉殿堂的成员了！$

label: PokemonLeague_LancesRoom_Text_Intro
source:
Ah! I've heard about you,
{PLAYER}!\pI lead the ELITE FOUR.\pYou can call me LANCE the dragon
TRAINER.\pYou know that dragons are
mythical POKéMON.\pThey're hard to catch and raise,
but their powers are superior.\pThey're virtually indestructible.
There's no being clever with them.\pWell, are you ready to lose?\pYour LEAGUE challenge ends with
me, {PLAYER}!{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_RG_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}$
translation:
啊！我听说过你的名字，
{PLAYER}！\p我是四天王的首领。\p你可以称呼我为龙之训练家，
渡。\p你应该知道龙是
神圣传说中的宝可梦。\p它们很难收服和饲养，
但只要培育得好，\p它们几乎坚不可摧。
一般的攻击对它们是没有用的。\p很好，你准备好夹着尾巴逃跑了吗？\p你的联盟挑战将会随我
而终结，{PLAYER}！{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_RG_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}$

label: PokemonLeague_LancesRoom_Text_RematchIntro
source:
Ah!
So, you've returned, {PLAYER}!\pI lead the ELITE FOUR.\pYou can call me LANCE the dragon
TRAINER.\pYou know that dragons are
mythical POKéMON.\pThey're hard to catch and raise,
but their powers are superior.\pThey're virtually indestructible.
There's no being clever with them.\pWell, are you ready to lose?\pYour LEAGUE challenge ends with
me, {PLAYER}!{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_RG_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}$
translation:
啊！
看来，你回来了，{PLAYER}！\p我是四天王的首领。\p你可以称呼我为龙之训练家，
渡。\p你应该知道龙是
神圣传说中的宝可梦。\p它们很难收服和饲养，
但只要培育得好，\p它们几乎坚不可摧。
一般的攻击对它们是没有用的。\p很好，你准备好夹着尾巴逃跑了吗？\p你的联盟挑战将会随我
而终结，{PLAYER}！{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_RG_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}$

label: PokemonLeague_LancesRoom_Text_Defeat
source: That's it!\pI hate to admit it, but you are a\nPOKéMON master!$
translation: 到此为止吧！\p我虽然不像承认，但你的确是一个\n宝可梦大师！$

label: PokemonLeague_LancesRoom_Text_PostBattle
source:
I still can't believe my dragons
lost to you, {PLAYER}.\pYou are now the POKéMON LEAGUE
CHAMPION!\p…Or, you would have been, but
you have one more challenge left.\pThere is one more TRAINER to face!
His name is…\p{RIVAL}!\pHe beat the ELITE FOUR before
you.\pHe is the real POKéMON LEAGUE
CHAMPION.$
translation:
直到现在，我依然不相信
我的龙会败给你，{PLAYER}。\p你现在是宝可梦联盟
联盟的冠军！\p......或者说，你应该是，但
你还有一个最后的挑战。\p你必须再与一个训练家战斗不可！
那位训练家的名字是......\p{RIVAL}！\p他先于你
战胜了我们四天王。\p他是真正的宝可梦联盟
联盟冠军！$

label: PokemonLeague_LoreleisRoom_Text_Intro
source:
Welcome to the POKéMON LEAGUE.\pI am LORELEI of the ELITE FOUR.\pNo one can best me when it comes
to icy POKéMON.\pFreezing moves are powerful.\pYour POKéMON will be at my mercy
when they are frozen solid.\pHahaha!
Are you ready?{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_RG_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}$
translation:
欢迎来到宝可梦联盟。\p我是四天王中的科拿。\p没有人能够比我更会使用
冰属性的宝可梦。\p冰属性的技能是最强大的。\p当你的宝可梦被冻成冰块的时候
它们就任我宰割！\p哈哈哈！
你准备好了吗？{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_RG_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}$

label: PokemonLeague_LoreleisRoom_Text_RematchIntro
source:
Welcome to the POKéMON LEAGUE.\pI, LORELEI of the ELITE FOUR,
have returned!\pYou know how it goes.
No one can best me when it comes\lto icy POKéMON.\pFreezing moves are powerful.\pYour POKéMON will be at my mercy
when they are frozen solid.\pHahaha!
Are you ready?{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_RG_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}$
translation:
欢迎来到宝可梦联盟。\p我，四天王中的科拿，
重新回到了联盟！\p不管之前发生了什么。
没有人比我更会使用\l冰属性的宝可梦。\p冰属性的技能是最强大的。\p当你的宝可梦被冻成冰块的时候
它们就任我宰割！\p哈哈哈！
你准备好了吗？{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_RG_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}$

label: PokemonLeague_LoreleisRoom_Text_Defeat
source: …Things shouldn't be this way!$

label: PokemonLeague_LoreleisRoom_Text_PostBattle
source: You're better than I thought.\nGo on ahead.\pYou only got a taste of the\nPOKéMON LEAGUE's power.$
translation: 你比我想象的更厉害。\n朝下一个房间前进吧。\p宝可梦联盟的力量\n不止是如此而已。$

label: PokemonMansion_1F_Text_TedIntro
source: Who are you?\nThere shouldn't be anyone here.$
translation: 你是谁？\n这里不应该有任何人。$

label: PokemonMansion_1F_Text_TedDefeat
source: Ouch!$
translation: 哎呦！$

label: PokemonMansion_1F_Text_TedPostBattle
source: A key? I don't know what you're\ntalking about.$
translation: 一把钥匙？我不知道\n你在说什么。$

label: PokemonMansion_1F_Text_JohnsonIntro
source: W-w-waah! You startled me!\nI thought you were a ghost.$
translation: 哇哇哇！你把我吓了一跳！\n我以为你是鬼呢。$

label: PokemonMansion_1F_Text_JohnsonDefeat
source: Tch!\nI can't get any wins.$
translation: 啊啊！\n我没有得到过哪怕是一场胜利。$

label: PokemonMansion_1F_Text_JohnsonPostBattle
source: I was exploring here by myself,\nbut I feel spooked.\pI ought to go soon.$
translation: 我一个人到这里来探索，\n但我觉得很害怕。\p我还是尽快离开这里吧。$

label: PokemonMansion_Text_PressSecretSwitch
source: A secret switch!\pPress it?$
translation: 一个秘密的开关！\p要按下它吗？$

label: PokemonMansion_Text_WhoWouldnt
source: Who wouldn't?$
translation: 谁不愿意？$

label: PokemonMansion_Text_NotQuiteYet
source: Not quite yet!$
translation: 还没到时候呢！$

label: PokemonMansion_1F_Text_ArnieIntro
source: I can't get out!\nThis old place is one big puzzle.$
translation: 我出不去！\n这个古老的地方是一个巨大的迷宫。$

label: PokemonMansion_1F_Text_ArnieDefeat
source: Oh, no!\nMy bag of loot!$
translation: 不！！\n这是我的战利品！$

label: PokemonMansion_1F_Text_ArniePostBattle
source: The switches here open and close\nalternating sets of doors.$
translation: 拨动这里的开关可以切换门\n的开关状态。$

label: PokemonMansion_1F_Text_NewMonDiscoveredInGuyanaJungle
source: Diary: July 5\nGuyana, South America\pA new POKéMON was discovered deep\nin the jungle.$
translation: 日记：7月5日\n圭亚那，南美洲\p在丛林深处发现了\n一只新的宝可梦。$

label: PokemonMansion_1F_Text_ChristenedDiscoveredMonMew
source: Diary: July 10\nWe christened the newly discovered\lPOKéMON, MEW.$
translation: 日记：7月10日\n我们把新发现的\l宝可梦称为梦幻。$

label: PokemonMansion_1F_Text_SimonIntro
source: This place is, like, huge!$
translation: 这个地方，真的，好大啊！$

label: PokemonMansion_1F_Text_SimonDefeat
source: Ayah!$
translation: 啊啊！$

label: PokemonMansion_1F_Text_SimonPostBattle
source: I wonder where my partner went.$
translation: 我不知道我的同伙去哪儿了。$

label: PokemonMansion_1F_Text_BraydonIntro
source: My mentor once lived here.$
translation: 我的导师曾经住在这里。$

label: PokemonMansion_1F_Text_BraydonDefeat
source: Whew!\nOverwhelming!$
translation: 呼！\n让人喘不过气来！$

label: PokemonMansion_1F_Text_BraydonPostBattle
source: So, you're stuck?\nTry jumping off over there!$
translation: 所以，你被卡住了吗？\n试着从那边跳下去！$

label: PokemonMansion_1F_Text_MewGaveBirthToMewtwo
source: Diary: Feb. 6\nMEW gave birth.\pWe named the newborn MEWTWO.$
translation: 日记：2月6号\n梦幻生产了。\p我们把新生的宝可梦称作超梦。$

label: PokemonMansion_B1F_Text_LewisIntro
source: Uh-oh…\nWhere am I now?$
translation: 哇啊......\n我现在在哪里？$

label: PokemonMansion_B1F_Text_LewisDefeat
source: Awooh!$
translation: 哇啊！$

label: PokemonMansion_B1F_Text_LewisPostBattle
source: You can find stuff lying around.\nThe residents must've left them.$
translation: 你可以发现到处都是散落的东西。\n一定是居民们丢下的。$

label: PokemonMansion_B1F_Text_IvanIntro
source: This place is ideal for a lab.\nLook at all this space.$
translation: 这里是建造实验室的理想地方。\n看看这儿。$

label: PokemonMansion_B1F_Text_IvanDefeat
source: What was that for?$
translation: 那是用来干什么的？$

label: PokemonMansion_B1F_Text_IvanPostBattle
source: I like it here.\nIt's conducive to my studies.$
translation: 我喜欢这里。\n它有助于我的研究。$

label: PokemonMansion_B1F_Text_MewtwoIsFarTooPowerful
source: Diary: Sept. 1\nMEWTWO is far too powerful.\pWe have failed to curb its vicious\ntendencies…$
translation: 日记：9月1号\n超梦太强大了。\p我们不能控制它了，\n它越来越邪恶了......$

label: PokemonTower_1F_Text_ErectedInMemoryOfDeadMons
source: POKéMON TOWER was erected in the\nmemory of POKéMON that died.$
translation: 宝可梦塔是为了\n纪念死去的宝可梦而建立的。$

label: PokemonTower_1F_Text_ComeToPayRespectsSon
source: Did you come to pay respects?\pBless your POKéMON-loving heart,\nson.$
translation: 你是来这里祈福的么？\p孩子，\n保佑你那颗爱着宝可梦的心。$

label: PokemonTower_1F_Text_ComeToPayRespectsGirl
source: Did you come to pay respects?\pBless your POKéMON-loving heart,\ngirl.$
translation: 你是来这里祈福的么？\p孩子，\n保佑你那颗爱着宝可梦的心。$

label: PokemonTower_1F_Text_CameToPrayForDepartedClefairy
source: I came to pray for my dearly\ndeparted CLEFAIRY.\pSniff!\nI'm awash in tears…$
translation: 我来为我心爱的皮皮\n的灵魂送别！\p呜！\n我止不住眼泪...$

label: PokemonTower_1F_Text_GrowlitheWhyDidYouDie
source: My GROWLITHE…\nWhy did you die?$
translation: 我的卡蒂狗...\n你为什么死了？$

label: PokemonTower_1F_Text_SenseSpiritsUpToMischief
source: I am a CHANNELER.\pThere are spirits up to mischief.\nI sense them high in the TOWER.$
translation: 我是通灵师。\p有些灵魂喜欢搞恶作剧。\n在塔的高层，我能感觉到它们。$

label: PokemonTower_2F_Text_RivalIntro
source: {RIVAL}: Hey, {PLAYER}!\nWhat brings you here?\lIs your POKéMON dead?\pHey! It's alive!\pI can at least make them faint!\nLet's go!$
translation: {RIVAL}：嘿，{PLAYER}！\n什么风把你吹来的？\l你的宝可梦死了吗？\p嘿！还活着嘛！\p我至少还可以把它们打到晕！\n开战吧！$

label: PokemonTower_2F_Text_RivalDefeat
source: What?\nYou stinker!\pI took it easy on you, too!$
translation: 什么？\n你这个讨厌鬼！\p我刚才对你手下留情了！$

label: PokemonTower_2F_Text_RivalPostBattle
source:
How's your POKéDEX coming?
I just caught a CUBONE!\pI can't find the bigger MAROWAK.
Where could they be?\pI bet there aren't any left!\pWell, I better get going.
I've got a lot to accomplish,\lunlike you.\pSmell ya later!$
translation:
你的宝可梦图鉴收集得怎么样了？
我刚抓住了一只卡拉卡拉！\p我找不到进化后的嘎啦嘎啦。
它们在哪儿呢？\p这里肯定是没有了！\p嗯，我得走了。
我可不像你，\l我还有很多事情要做。\p再见$

label: PokemonTower_2F_Text_SilphScopeCouldUnmaskGhosts
source: Even we could not identify the\nwayward ghosts.\pA SILPH SCOPE might be able to\nunmask them.$
translation: 我们无法确认\n幽灵的真面目！\p用西尔佛观测镜的话\n也许就能看清了！$

label: PokemonTower_3F_Text_HopeIntro
source: Urrg… Awaa…\nHuhu… Graa…$

label: PokemonTower_3F_Text_HopeDefeat
source: Hwa!\nI'm saved!$
translation: 哗！\n得救了！$

label: PokemonTower_3F_Text_HopePostBattle
source: The ghosts can be identified by\nthe SILPH SCOPE.$
translation: 用西尔佛观测镜\n可以看清鬼的真面目！$

label: PokemonTower_3F_Text_CarlyIntro
source: Kekeke…\nKwaaah!$
translation: 呵呵呵......\n咔哇哇哇哇哈！$

label: PokemonTower_3F_Text_CarlyDefeat
source: Hmm?\nWhat am I doing?$
translation: 嗯？\n我在做什么？$

label: PokemonTower_3F_Text_CarlyPostBattle
source: Sorry!\nI was possessed!$
translation: 抱歉！\n我刚才有些失态！$

label: PokemonTower_3F_Text_PatriciaIntro
source: Be gone!\nMalevolent spirit!$
translation: 滚！\n邪恶的幽灵！$

label: PokemonTower_3F_Text_PatriciaDefeat
source: Whew!\nThe spirit left!$
translation: 呃！\n幽灵终于消失了！！$

label: PokemonTower_3F_Text_PatriciaPostBattle
source: The others above…\nThey must have been possessed.$
translation: 上面的人......\n他们一定被鬼迷心窍了。$

label: PokemonTower_4F_Text_PaulaIntro
source: Ghost! No!\nKwaaah!$
translation: 鬼！不！\n咔哇哇哇哇哈！$

label: PokemonTower_4F_Text_PaulaDefeat
source: Where is the ghost?$
translation: 鬼在哪？$

label: PokemonTower_4F_Text_PaulaPostBattle
source: I must have been dreaming…$
translation: 我刚刚一定在做梦......$

label: PokemonTower_4F_Text_LaurelIntro
source: Be cursed with me!\nKwaaah!$
translation: 让我诅咒你吧！\n咔哇哇哇哇哈！$

label: PokemonTower_4F_Text_LaurelDefeat
source: What!$
translation: 什么！$

label: PokemonTower_4F_Text_LaurelPostBattle
source: We can't determine the identity of\nthe ghosts…$
translation: 我们不能确定幽灵\n的真面目......$

label: PokemonTower_4F_Text_JodyIntro
source: Huhuhu…\nBeat me not!$
translation: 呼呼呼......\n不要打我！$

label: PokemonTower_4F_Text_JodyDefeat
source: Huh?\nWho? What?$
translation: 嘿？\n谁？什么？$

label: PokemonTower_4F_Text_JodyPostBattle
source: May the departed POKéMON rest in\npeace…$
translation: 让死去的宝可梦\n安息吧......$

label: PokemonTower_5F_Text_RestHereInPurifiedSpace
source: Come, child!\nI have purified this space.\lYou can rest here.$
translation: 过来，孩子！\n我已经净化了这里！\l在这里回复体力吧。$

label: PokemonTower_5F_Text_TammyIntro
source: Give…me…\nyour…all…$

label: PokemonTower_5F_Text_TammyDefeat
source: Gasp!$

label: PokemonTower_5F_Text_TammyPostBattle
source: I was under possession.$
translation: 我被控制了。$

label: PokemonTower_5F_Text_RuthIntro
source: You…shall…\njoin…us…$

label: PokemonTower_5F_Text_RuthDefeat
source: What a nightmare!$
translation: 真是一场恶梦！$

label: PokemonTower_5F_Text_RuthPostBattle
source: I was possessed.$
translation: 我有些失态了。$

label: PokemonTower_5F_Text_KarinaIntro
source: Zombies!$
translation: 僵尸！$

label: PokemonTower_5F_Text_KarinaDefeat
source: Ha?$

label: PokemonTower_5F_Text_KarinaPostBattle
source: I regained my senses.$
translation: 我恢复了理智。$

label: PokemonTower_5F_Text_JanaeIntro
source: Urgah…\nUrff…$

label: PokemonTower_5F_Text_JanaeDefeat
source: Whoo!$

label: PokemonTower_5F_Text_JanaePostBattle
source: I fell to evil spirits despite my\ntraining in the mountains…$
translation: 尽管我在山上不断地修行\n却还是堕入了邪念......$

label: PokemonTower_5F_Text_PurifiedZoneMonsFullyHealed
source: Entered the purified and protected\nzone.\p{PLAYER}'s POKéMON were fully\nhealed.$
translation: 进入了净化和被保护的区域。\p{PLAYER}的宝可梦\n全都恢复了体力。$

label: PokemonTower_6F_Text_AngelicaIntro
source: Give…me…\nblood…$

label: PokemonTower_6F_Text_AngelicaDefeat
source: Groan!$
translation: 咕哇！$

label: PokemonTower_6F_Text_AngelicaPostBattle
source: I feel anemic and weak…$
translation: 我感到乏力而虚弱......$

label: PokemonTower_6F_Text_EmiliaIntro
source: Urff…\nKwaah!$

label: PokemonTower_6F_Text_EmiliaDefeat
source: Something fell out!$
translation: 有东西掉出来了！$

label: PokemonTower_6F_Text_EmiliaPostBattle
source: My hair didn't fall out!\nIt was a malevolent spirit!$
translation: 我头发才没有掉出来！\n那是一个邪恶的幽灵！$

label: PokemonTower_6F_Text_JenniferIntro
source: Ke…ke…ke…\nke…ke…ke!$

label: PokemonTower_6F_Text_JenniferDefeat
source: Keee!$

label: PokemonTower_6F_Text_JenniferPostBattle
source: What's going on here?$
translation: 这儿发生了什么事？$

label: PokemonTower_6F_Text_BeGoneIntruders
source: Be gone…\nIntruders…$

label: PokemonTower_6F_Text_GhostWasCubonesMother
source: The ghost was the restless spirit\nof CUBONE's mother!$
translation: 这个幽灵是卡拉卡拉母亲\n不能安息的灵魂！$

label: PokemonTower_6F_Text_MothersSpiritWasCalmed
source: The mother's spirit was calmed.\pIt departed to the afterlife…$
translation: 母亲的灵魂平静了下来。\p它转世投胎去了......$

label: PokemonTower_7F_Text_Grunt1Intro
source: What do you want?\nWhy are you here?$
translation: 你想干什么？\n在这里干嘛？$

label: PokemonTower_7F_Text_Grunt1Defeat
source: I give up!$
translation: 我放弃了！$

label: PokemonTower_7F_Text_Grunt1PostBattle
source: I'm not going to forget this!$
translation: 我永远不会忘记这件事！$

label: PokemonTower_7F_Text_Grunt2Intro
source:
This old guy marched right up to
our HIDEOUT.\pThen, he starts ranting about how
TEAM ROCKET's abusing POKéMON.\pSo, we're just talking it over as
adults.$
translation: 这老家伙直接走进我们的秘密基地。\p然后，他开始咆哮\n火箭队如何虐待宝可梦。\p所以，我们只是给他来了一场\n成年人的谈话。$

label: PokemonTower_7F_Text_Grunt2Defeat
source: Please!\nNo more!$
translation: 拜托了！\n不要再说了！$

label: PokemonTower_7F_Text_Grunt2PostBattle
source: POKéMON are only good for making\nmoney. Why not use them?\pYou stay out of our business!$
translation: 宝可梦唯一的好处就是赚钱。\n为什么不去利用他们呢？\p你离我们远点儿！$

label: PokemonTower_7F_Text_Grunt3Intro
source: You're not saving anyone, kid!$
translation: 你救不了任何人的，小子！$

label: PokemonTower_7F_Text_Grunt3Defeat
source: Don't fight us ROCKETS!$
translation: 不要和我们火箭队作对！$

label: PokemonTower_7F_Text_Grunt3PostBattle
source: You're not getting away with this!$
translation: 你会为此而后悔的！$

label: PokemonTower_7F_Text_MrFujiThankYouFollowMe
source:
MR. FUJI: Heh?
You came to save me?\pThank you. But, I came here of my
own free will.\pI came to calm the spirit of
CUBONE's mother.\pI think MAROWAK's spirit has
finally left us.\pI must thank you for your kind
concern.\pFollow me to my home, POKéMON
HOUSE, at the foot of this tower.$
translation:
富士老人：嗯？
你是来救我的么？\p谢谢。但是，
我来这里是自愿的。\p我打算来安抚卡拉卡拉
母亲不安的灵魂。\p我想嘎啦嘎啦的灵魂
终于离开了我们。\p十分感谢你的好心。\p跟我回一趟我的家吧，宝可梦之家，
就在这座塔底下的。$

label: RocketHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt1Intro
source: Who are you?\nHow did you get here?$
translation: 你是谁？\n你是怎么进来的？$

label: RocketHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt1Defeat
source: Oww!\nBeaten!$
translation: 啊！\n被打败了！$

label: RocketHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt1PostBattle
source: Blast it… You're dissing TEAM\nROCKET, aren't you?$
translation: 该死......是你瞧不起\n火箭队的吧？$

label: RocketHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt2Intro
source: You broke into TEAM ROCKET's\noperation? What nerve!$
translation: 就是你闯入了火箭队\n的总部吧？太不像话了！$

label: RocketHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt2Defeat
source: Boom!$
translation: 隆隆！$

label: RocketHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt2PostBattle
source: You're not going to get away with\nthis, brat!$
translation: 我们不会轻易放过\n你的，小子！$

label: RocketHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt3Intro
source: Intruder alert!$
translation: 发现入侵者！$

label: RocketHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt3Defeat
source: I can't do it!$
translation: 我做不到！$

label: RocketHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt3PostBattle
source: SILPH SCOPE? Humph!\nI don't know where it is.$
translation: 西尔佛观测镜？哼！\n我不知道它在哪里。$

label: RocketHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt4Intro
source: Why did you come here?$
translation: 你为什么来这里？$

label: RocketHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt4Defeat
source: This won't do!$
translation: 不可能！$

label: RocketHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt4PostBattle
source: Okay, I'll talk…\nTake the elevator to see my BOSS.$
translation: 好吧，我说......\n乘电梯去见我们的老大吧。$

label: RocketHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt5Intro
source: Are you lost, you little mouse?$
translation: 你迷路了吗，小老鼠？$

label: RocketHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt5Defeat
source: Why…?$

label: RocketHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt5PostBattle
source: Uh-oh, that ruckus somehow opened\nthe door!$
translation: 喔不，那阵骚动不知怎的\n打开了门！$

label: RocketHideout_B2F_Text_GruntIntro
source: BOSS said you can see ghosts with\nthe SILPH SCOPE.$
translation: 老大说用西尔佛观测镜\n你可以看清幽灵。$

label: RocketHideout_B2F_Text_GruntDefeat
source: I surrender!$
translation: 我投降！$

label: RocketHideout_B2F_Text_GruntPostBattle
source: The TEAM ROCKET HQ has four\nunderground floors.\pThink you can reach the BOSS?$
translation: 火箭队总部有\n四层建在地下。\p你以为你能见到老大吗？$

label: RocketHideout_B3F_Text_Grunt1Intro
source: Stop meddling in TEAM ROCKET's\naffairs or else!$
translation: 你给我站住，不许插手火箭队的\n事不然的话......！$

label: RocketHideout_B3F_Text_Grunt1Defeat
source: Oof!\nTaken down!$
translation: 啊！\n被做掉了！$

label: RocketHideout_B3F_Text_Grunt1PostBattle
source: SILPH SCOPE?\nOh, that machine the BOSS stole.\pIt's here somewhere.$
translation: 西尔佛观测镜？\n哦，那个老大偷走的机器啊。\p它应该就在附近。$

label: RocketHideout_B3F_Text_Grunt2Intro
source: We got word from upstairs that you\nwere coming!$
translation: 我们得到了楼上的情报，\n就知道你会来这里！$

label: RocketHideout_B3F_Text_Grunt2Defeat
source: What?\nI lost? No!$
translation: 什么？\n我输了？不！！！$

label: RocketHideout_B3F_Text_Grunt2PostBattle
source: Go ahead and go!\pBut you can't run the elevator\nwithout the LIFT KEY.$
translation: 想进去就进去吧！\p但是没有电梯的钥匙的话，\n你就无法操作电梯。$

label: RocketHideout_B4F_Text_GiovanniIntro
source:
So! I must say, I am impressed you
got here.\pTEAM ROCKET captures POKéMON from
around the world.\pThey're important tools for keeping
our criminal enterprise going.\pI am the leader, GIOVANNI!\pFor your insolence, you will feel a
world of pain!$
translation:
首先，我想我必须承认，我对你
能来到这里很是惊讶。\p火箭队从世界各地
收服宝可梦。\p它们是让我们的犯罪事业
持续下去的重要工具。\p而我就是他们的老大，坂木！\p你的嚣张到此为止了，
你将会承受到整个世界的痛苦！$

label: RocketHideout_B4F_Text_GiovanniDefeat
source: WHAT!\nThis can't be!$
translation: 什么！\n这不可能！$

label: RocketHideout_B4F_Text_GiovanniPostBattle
source: I see that you raise POKéMON with\nutmost care.\pA child like you would never\nunderstand what I hope to achieve.\pI shall step aside this time!\pI hope we meet again…$
translation: 我看到你养育的宝可梦\n是被你悉心照顾的。\p像你这样的孩子永远不会\n理解我所希望达到的目的。\p这一次我先选择撤退！\p我希望我们能再次见面......$

label: RocketHideout_B4F_Text_Grunt2Intro
source: I know you!\nYou ruined our plans at MT. MOON!$
translation: 我认识你！\n是你毁了我们在月见山的计划！$

label: RocketHideout_B4F_Text_Grunt2Defeat
source: Burned again!$
translation: 又被毁了！$

label: RocketHideout_B4F_Text_Grunt2PostBattle
source: Do you have something against TEAM\nROCKET?$
translation: 你对火箭队有\n特殊的感情吗？$

label: RocketHideout_B4F_Text_Grunt3Intro
source: How can you not see the beauty of\nour evil?$
translation: 难道你看不懂\n我们的邪恶的美学吗？$

label: RocketHideout_B4F_Text_Grunt3Defeat
source: Ayaya!$
translation: 啊呀！$

label: RocketHideout_B4F_Text_Grunt3PostBattle
source: BOSS!\nI'm sorry I failed you!$
translation: 老大！\n对不起我让你失望了！$

label: RocketHideout_B4F_Text_Grunt1Intro
source: The elevator doesn't work?\nWho has the LIFT KEY?$
translation: 电梯不运行？\n谁有电梯的钥匙呀？$

label: RocketHideout_B4F_Text_Grunt1Defeat
source: No!$

label: RocketHideout_B4F_Text_Grunt1PostBattle
source: Oh, no!\nI dropped the LIFT KEY!$
translation: 哦，不！\n我把电梯的钥匙给弄丢了！$

label: RocketHideout_Elevator_Text_AppearsToNeedAKey
source: It appears to need a key.$
translation: 看来需要一把钥匙来打开它。$

label: RockTunnel_1F_Text_LennyIntro
source: This tunnel goes a long way, kid!$
translation: 这条隧道有很长的路，孩子！$

label: RockTunnel_1F_Text_LennyDefeat
source: Doh!\nYou win!$
translation: 啊哇！\n你赢了！$

label: RockTunnel_1F_Text_LennyPostBattle
source: Watch for ONIX.\nThey appear only occasionally.\pHigh-level ones can put the\nsqueeze on you!$
translation: 大岩蛇的很少在这出没，\n但要是在寻找的时候，\p遇上了高等级大岩蛇，\n会给你造成重创！$

label: RockTunnel_1F_Text_OliverIntro
source: Hmm.\nMaybe I'm lost in here…$
translation: 嗯哼。\n我也许在这里迷路了......$

label: RockTunnel_1F_Text_OliverDefeat
source: Ease up!\nWhat am I doing?\lWhich way is out?$
translation: 放松！\n我在做什么？\l出去的路是哪条？$

label: RockTunnel_1F_Text_OliverPostBattle
source: That sleeping POKéMON on ROUTE 12\nforced me to take this detour.$
translation: 12号道路上那只沉睡的宝可梦\n让我不得不绕道而行。$

label: RockTunnel_1F_Text_LucasIntro
source: Outsiders like you need to show me\nsome respect!$
translation: 像你这种外行\n在我面前\n给我放尊重点！$

label: RockTunnel_1F_Text_LucasDefeat
source: I give!$
translation: 我投降！$

label: RockTunnel_1F_Text_LucasPostBattle
source: You're talented enough to hike!$
translation: 你已经有足够的能力去登山了！$

label: RockTunnel_1F_Text_AshtonIntro
source: POKéMON fight!\nReady, go!$
translation: 宝可梦！\n准备！\n战斗开始！$

label: RockTunnel_1F_Text_AshtonDefeat
source: Game over!$
translation: 游戏结束了！$

label: RockTunnel_1F_Text_AshtonPostBattle
source: Oh well, I'll get a ZUBAT as I go!$
translation: 好吧，我一会儿就去抓只超音蝠！$

label: RockTunnel_1F_Text_LeahIntro
source: Eek!\pDon't try anything funny in the\ndark!$
translation: 喂！\p这里这么黑，\n别想在这里耍小花招！$

label: RockTunnel_1F_Text_LeahDefeat
source: It was too dark…$
translation: 太暗了...$

label: RockTunnel_1F_Text_LeahPostBattle
source: I saw a MACHOP in this tunnel.$
translation: 我在隧道里见过腕力。$

label: RockTunnel_1F_Text_DanaIntro
source: I came this far looking for wild\nPOKéMON.$
translation: 我走了这么远\n就是为了寻找宝可梦！$

label: RockTunnel_1F_Text_DanaDefeat
source: I'm out of POKéMON!$
translation: 我的宝可梦全倒下了！$

label: RockTunnel_1F_Text_DanaPostBattle
source: You looked cute and harmless.\nWas I ever wrong!$
translation: 你看起来很可爱，\n而且无公害。\n莫非是我想错了么！$

label: RockTunnel_1F_Text_ArianaIntro
source: You have POKéMON!\nLet's start!$
translation: 你带着宝可梦！\n那么战个痛快吧！$

label: RockTunnel_1F_Text_ArianaDefeat
source: You play hard!$
translation: 你打得可真卖命！$

label: RockTunnel_1F_Text_ArianaPostBattle
source: Whew!\nI'm all sweaty now.$
translation: 哇哦！\n我现在汗流浃背。$

label: RockTunnel_1F_Text_RouteSign
source: ROCK TUNNEL\nCERULEAN CITY - LAVENDER TOWN$
translation: 岩山隧道\n华蓝市 - 紫苑镇$

label: RockTunnel_B1F_Text_SofiaIntro
source: Do you know how you can avoid\ngetting lost in the mountains?\pYou can bend twigs as trail\nmarkers.$
translation: 你知道怎样避免\n在深山里迷路么？\p你可以折断树枝\n作为路标。$

label: RockTunnel_B1F_Text_SofiaDefeat
source: Ohhh!\nI did my best!$
translation: 哦哦哦！\n我尽力了！$

label: RockTunnel_B1F_Text_SofiaPostBattle
source: I want to go home!$
translation: 我想回家！$

label: RockTunnel_B1F_Text_DudleyIntro
source: Hahaha!\nCan you beat my power?$
translation: 哈哈哈！\n你能战胜我么？$

label: RockTunnel_B1F_Text_DudleyDefeat
source: Oops!\nOutmuscled!$
translation: 诶呀！\n你竟然比我强！$

label: RockTunnel_B1F_Text_DudleyPostBattle
source: I go for power because I hate\nthinking.$
translation: 我只追求力量，\n因为我懒得思考！$

label: RockTunnel_B1F_Text_CooperIntro
source: You have a POKéDEX?\nI want one, too.$
translation: 你有宝可梦图鉴？\n我也想要一个。$

label: RockTunnel_B1F_Text_CooperDefeat
source: Shoot!\nI am so jealous!$
translation: 可恶啊！\n真嫉妒你啊！$

label: RockTunnel_B1F_Text_CooperPostBattle
source: When you finish your POKéDEX,\ncan I have it?$
translation: 当你完成了你的宝可梦图鉴，\n可以把它送给我吗？$

label: RockTunnel_B1F_Text_SteveIntro
source: Um… Do you know about POKéMON\ncosplay?$
translation: 嗯...你了解\n宝可梦cosplay吗？$

label: RockTunnel_B1F_Text_SteveDefeat
source: Well, that's that.$
translation: 好吧，就这样吧。$

label: RockTunnel_B1F_Text_StevePostBattle
source: POKéMON cosplay is dressing up as\nPOKéMON for fun.\pCLEFAIRY is a favorite.$
translation: 所谓cosplay宝可梦，\n就是为了好玩打扮成宝可梦的样子！\p我最喜欢扮成皮皮了。$

label: RockTunnel_B1F_Text_AllenIntro
source: My POKéMON techniques will leave\nyou crying!$
translation: 我的宝可梦技能，\n会把你打到哭！$

label: RockTunnel_B1F_Text_AllenDefeat
source: I give!\nYou're a better technician!$
translation: 我投降！\n你是一个更好的技术员！$

label: RockTunnel_B1F_Text_AllenPostBattle
source: In mountains, you'll often find\nROCK-type POKéMON.$
translation: 在山里，你经常会遇到\n岩石属性的宝可梦。$

label: RockTunnel_B1F_Text_MarthaIntro
source: I don't often come here, but I will\nbattle you.$
translation: 虽然我不经常来这儿，\n但我还是要和你打一场。$

label: RockTunnel_B1F_Text_MarthaDefeat
source: Oh!\nI lost!$
translation: 啊！\n我输了！$

label: RockTunnel_B1F_Text_MarthaPostBattle
source: I like tiny POKéMON.\nBig ones are too scary!$
translation: 我喜欢小小的宝可梦。\n大的实在是太吓人了！$

label: RockTunnel_B1F_Text_EricIntro
source: Hit me with your best shot!$
translation: 尽你所能打中我！$

label: RockTunnel_B1F_Text_EricDefeat
source: Fired away!$
translation: 开火！$

label: RockTunnel_B1F_Text_EricPostBattle
source: I'll raise my POKéMON to beat\nyours, kid.$
translation: 小子，我会培育我自己的宝可梦\n来打败你的！$

label: RockTunnel_B1F_Text_WinstonIntro
source: I draw illustrations of POKéMON\nwhen I'm home.$
translation: 我在家里的时候，\n给宝可梦画插画。$

label: RockTunnel_B1F_Text_WinstonDefeat
source: Whew…\nI'm exhausted…$
translation: 呼呼...\n累死了...$

label: RockTunnel_B1F_Text_WinstonPostBattle
source: I'm an artist, not a fighter.\nI'll go home to draw.$
translation: 我是一名画师，不是战士。\n我要回家画画去了。$

label: Route101_Text_HelpMe
source: H-help me!$

label: Route101_Text_PleaseHelp
source: Hello! You over there!\nPlease! Help!\pIn my BAG!\nThere's a POKé BALL!$
translation: 喂！那边的你！\n拜托！救救我！\p在那边的包里面\n里面有精灵球！$

label: Route101_Text_DontLeaveMe
source: Wh-Where are you going?!\nDon't leave me like this!$
translation: 你、你要去哪儿？！\n别丢下我啊--！$

label: Route101_Text_YouSavedMe
source:
PROF. BIRCH: Whew…\pI was in the tall grass studying wild
POKéMON when I was jumped.\pYou saved me.
Thanks a lot!\pOh?\pHi, you're {PLAYER}{KUN}!\pThis is not the place to chat, so come
by my POKéMON LAB later, okay?$
translation:
小田卷博士：哈啊哈啊......\p我刚想在草丛做调查，
就被野生的宝可梦袭击了......\p总之得救了，
谢谢你！\p咦？\p你不是{PLAYER}{KUN}吗？\p这儿不是聊天的地方，
跟我来宝可梦研究所吧？$

label: Route101_Text_TakeTiredPokemonToPokeCenter
source: If POKéMON get tired, take them to\na POKéMON CENTER.\pThere's a POKéMON CENTER in OLDALE\nTOWN right close by.$
translation: 宝可梦累了的话，\n就要带它们去宝可梦中心。\p附近的古玫镇里\n就有个宝可梦中心。$

label: Route101_Text_WildPokemonInTallGrass
source: Wild POKéMON will jump out at you in\ntall grass.\pIf you want to catch POKéMON, you have\nto go into the tall grass and search.$
translation: 在草丛中行走时野生宝可梦\n有可能跳出来袭击。\p如果想捕捉宝可梦的话，\n就得去草丛里寻找。$

label: Route101_Text_RouteSign
source: ROUTE 101\n{UP_ARROW} OLDALE TOWN$
translation: 101号道路\n{UP_ARROW}古玫镇$

label: Route102_Text_WatchMeCatchPokemon
source: WALLY: {PLAYER}…\nPOKéMON hide in tall grass like this,\ldon't they?\pPlease watch me and see if I can\ncatch one properly.\p…Whoa!$
translation: 满充：{PLAYER}......\n草丛里会藏着宝可梦，对吧？\p请你看看我捕捉宝可梦的\n方法对不对。\p......哇！$

label: Route102_Text_WallyIDidIt
source: WALLY: I did it… It's my…\nMy POKéMON!$
translation: 满充：成功了......这是我的......\n我的宝可梦！$

label: Route102_Text_LetsGoBack
source: {PLAYER}, thank you!\nLet's go back to the GYM!$
translation: {PLAYER}，谢谢你！\n我们回道馆吧！$

label: Route102_Text_ImNotVeryTall
source: I'm…not very tall, so I sink right\ninto tall grass.\pThe grass goes up my nose and…\nFwafwafwafwafwa…\pFwatchoo!$
translation: 我......不是很高，所以在草丛里\n走的时候我就被草遮起来了。\p草总是戳到我的鼻子里，然后就......\n阿--阿-阿--阿......\p阿嚏！$

label: Route102_Text_CatchWholeBunchOfPokemon
source: I'm going to catch a whole bunch of\nPOKéMON!$
translation: 我要捉一大堆\n宝可梦！$

label: Route102_Text_RouteSignOldale
source: ROUTE 102\n{RIGHT_ARROW} OLDALE TOWN$
translation: 102号道路\n{RIGHT_ARROW}古玫镇$

label: Route102_Text_RouteSignPetalburg
source: ROUTE 102\n{LEFT_ARROW} PETALBURG CITY$
translation: 102号道路\n{LEFT_ARROW}橙华市$

label: Route103_Text_MayRoute103Pokemon
source: MAY: Let's see… The POKéMON found\non ROUTE 103 include…$
translation: 小遥：我看看......在103号道路\n发现的宝可梦有......$

label: Route103_Text_MayLetsBattle
source:
Oh, hi, {PLAYER}{KUN}!\p…Oh, I see, my dad gave you
a POKéMON as a gift.\pSince we're here, let's have a quick
battle!\pI'll give you a taste of what being
a TRAINER is like.$
translation:
啊，你好，{PLAYER}{KUN}！\p......哦，原来爸爸送你了
一只宝可梦。\p机会难得，
我们来一场对战吧！\p让我教你怎样当
一位训练家！$

label: Route103_Text_MayDefeated
source: Wow! That's great!\n{PLAYER}{KUN}, you're pretty good!$
translation: 哇！好厉害！\n{PLAYER}{KUN}，你真棒！$

label: Route103_Text_MayTimeToHeadBack
source:
MAY: I think I know why my dad has
an eye out for you now.\pI mean, you just got that POKéMON,
but it already likes you.\pYou might be able to befriend any
kind of POKéMON easily.\pWell, it's time to head back to
the LAB.$
translation:
小遥：现在我明白爸爸
为什么会对你青睐有加了。\p你刚获得的宝可梦
就已经这么亲近你了。\p你一定能和任何宝可梦
成为朋友！\p好了，
我们回研究所去吧！$

label: Route103_Text_BrendanRoute103Pokemon
source: BRENDAN: Okay, so it's this one and\nthat one that live on ROUTE 103…$
translation: 小悠：好，原来103号道路上\n的宝可梦有这个和这个......$

label: Route103_Text_BrendanLetsBattle
source: Hey, it's {PLAYER}!\p…Oh, yeah, Dad gave you a POKéMON.\pSince we're here, how about a little\nbattle?\pI'll teach you what being a TRAINER's\nabout!$
translation:
嗨，{PLAYER}！\p......这样啊，
爸爸给你了一只宝可梦吗？\p这样正好，
我们来一场对战吧？\p我来教你如何
成为一位训练家！$

label: Route103_Text_BrendanDefeated
source: Huh, {PLAYER}, you're not too shabby.$
translation: 呵，{PLAYER}，你还挺厉害的嘛。$

label: Route103_Text_BrendanTimeToHeadBack
source:
BRENDAN: I think I get it.
I think I know why my dad has his eye\lout for you now.\pLook, your POKéMON already likes you,
even though you just got it.\p{PLAYER}, I get the feeling that you
could befriend any POKéMON with ease.\pWe should head back to the LAB.$
translation:
小悠：我明白了......
难怪爸爸会对你青睐有加。\p看，你刚拿到的宝可梦
就已经这么亲近你了。\p{PLAYER}，我想你说不定能和
任何宝可梦都成为朋友呢！\p我们先回研究所吧！$

label: Route103_Text_ShouldHaveBroughtPotion
source: My POKéMON is staggeringly tired…\nI should have brought a POTION…$
translation: 我的宝可梦已经很累了......\n我本该买点伤药的......$

label: Route103_Text_ShortcutToOldale
source: If you cross the sea from here,\nit'll be a shortcut to OLDALE TOWN.\pFufufu, that's useful, isn't it?$
translation: 如果从这儿渡海，\n就能到达古玫镇。\p呵呵呵，这条捷径会派上不少用场的。$

label: Route103_Text_RouteSign
source: ROUTE 103\n{DOWN_ARROW} OLDALE TOWN$
translation: 103号道路\n{DOWN_ARROW}古玫镇$

label: Route104_Text_BrineyLivesInSeasideCottage
source: That seaside cottage is where\nMR. BRINEY lives.\pHe was once a mighty sailor who never\nfeared the sea, however stormy.$
translation: 那就是哈奇老人住的海边小屋。\n他曾经是个伟大的水手，\p即使永远都是风雨交加，\n他也从未害怕过大海。$

label: Route104_Text_WhatsItLikeAtBottomOfSea
source: The sea, huh?\pI wonder what it's like at the bottom\nof the sea?$
translation: 大海，嗯？\p不知道海底\n是什么样子的？$

label: Route104_Text_ThrowBallAtWeakenedPokemon
source: If you're going to throw a POKé BALL,\nweaken the wild POKéMON first.\pIt will be easier to catch if it's been\npoisoned, burned, or lulled to sleep.$
translation: 投出精灵球之前，\n要先让野生宝可梦变弱。\p如果它中毒或被灼伤、催眠的话，\n会更容易捕捉到它。$

label: Route104_Text_OnlyThrowBallAtWildPokemon
source: You're a thief if you try to steal\nsomeone else's POKéMON.\pYou should throw POKé BALLS only at\nwild POKéMON.$
translation: 你不能偷\n别人的宝可梦，\p你只能向野生的宝可梦\n投掷精灵球。$

label: Route104_Text_ImNotATrainer
source: Oh, no, I'm not a TRAINER.\pBut that's right, if TRAINERS lock eyes,\nit's a challenge to battle.\pIf you don't want to battle, stay out\nof their sight.$
translation:
哦，不，
我不是训练家，\p但要是被训练家看见的话，
他们就会向你挑战。\p如果你不想对战，
最好躲着他们的视线。$

label: Route104_Text_LikeFillingMouthWithSeedsTakeThis
source: I like filling my mouth with seeds,\nthen spitting them out fast!\pYou can have this, so you try it out!\pUse it on a POKéMON, and it will learn\na move for firing seeds rapidly.$
translation: 我喜欢在嘴里塞满种子，\n然后飞速射出去！\p这个给你，你也可以试试！\p把它给宝可梦使用，宝可梦就能\n学会快速射出种子的招式。$

label: Route104_Text_TMsAreOneTimeUse
source: A word of advice!\pA TM, TECHNICAL MACHINE, is good only\nfor one-time use.\pOnce you use it, it's gone.\nThink twice before using it!$
translation: 要提醒你！\pTM，就是招式学习器，\n只能使用一次。\p一旦你用了，它就会消失。\n所以使用之前要三思！$

label: Route104_Text_DontNeedThisTakeIt
source:
This FLOWER SHOP started selling
saplings recently.\pIt made me so happy, I went overboard
shopping.\pI don't need this WHITE HERB anymore.
Would you take it, please?$
translation:
这间花店最近
开始卖小树，\p我太兴奋了，
买了太多的东西。\p这个白色香草我不需要了，
你想要吗？$

label: Route104_Text_FlowerShopSellingSaplings
source: This FLOWER SHOP started selling\nsaplings recently.\pIt made me so happy, I went overboard\nshopping. Where should I put them?$
translation: 这间花店最近\n开始卖小树，\p我太兴奋了，买了太多的东西。\n我该把它们放在哪儿呢？$

label: Route104_Text_MrBrineysCottage
source: MR. BRINEY'S COTTAGE$
translation: 哈奇老人的小屋$

label: Route104_Text_RouteSignPetalburg
source: ROUTE 1O4\n{RIGHT_ARROW} PETALBURG CITY$
translation: 1O4号道路\n{RIGHT_ARROW}橙华市$

label: Route104_Text_RouteSignRustboro
source: ROUTE 1O4\n{UP_ARROW} RUSTBORO CITY$
translation: 104号道路\n{UP_ARROW}卡那兹市$

label: Route104_Text_PrettyPetalFlowShop
source: PRETTY PETAL FLOWER SHOP$
translation: 圣橙华花店$

label: Route104_Text_TrainerTipsDoubleBattles
source: TRAINER TIPS\pIn the HOENN region there are pairs\nof TRAINERS who challenge others\lfor 2-on-2 POKéMON battles called\lDOUBLE BATTLES.\pIn a DOUBLE BATTLE, the TRAINER must\nsend out two POKéMON, the one at the\lleft of the list and the top one.\lWatch how POKéMON are lined up.$
translation: 有用的公告牌！\p在丰缘地区中，一些结伴的训练家会向\n别人发起2对2的挑战，称作双打对战。\p在双打对战中，\n训练家要派出2只宝可梦，\l即列表左边的和最上边的。\l一定要注意宝可梦的排列顺序。$

label: Route104_Text_MayWeShouldRegister
source: MAY: Oh, hi, {PLAYER}{KUN}!\pDEVON upgraded your POKéNAV with\nthe MATCH CALL system, huh?\pWe should register each other so we\ncan get in contact anytime.$
translation: 小遥：啊，{PLAYER}{KUN}！\p得文给你的宝可导航装了\n对战寻呼系统对吧？\p我们互相登记一下信息吧，\n这样就能随时联系了。$

label: Route104_Text_RegisteredMay
source: {PLAYER} registered MAY\nin the POKéNAV.$
translation: {PLAYER}把小遥\n登记到宝可导航里了。$

label: Route104_Text_MayHowsYourPokedex
source: MAY: Oh, by the way, {PLAYER}{KUN},\nhow's your POKéDEX coming along?$
translation: 小遥：对了，{PLAYER}{KUN}，\n你的宝可梦图鉴进展如何？$

label: Route104_Text_MayMinesDecentLetsBattle
source: Mine's looking pretty decent.\nSo…\lHow about a little battle?$
translation: 我这边已经很充实了。\n所以......\l要不要来场对战？$

label: Route104_Text_MayHaventRaisedPokemon
source: MAY: Oh, what's the matter?\pHaven't you caught or raised your\nPOKéMON very much?\pThat's not very good for a TRAINER!$
translation: 小遥：哎--为什么？\p你没有好好捕捉和培育\n宝可梦吗？\p作为训练家可不应该这样！$

label: Route104_Text_MayLetsBattle
source: MAY: So, what do you think?\nHow about a little battle here?$
translation: 小遥：所以，怎么样？\n要不要来场对战？$

label: Route104_Text_MayIntro
source: MAY: You just became a TRAINER,\n{PLAYER}{KUN}. I'm not going to lose!$
translation: 小遥：你刚刚成为训练家，\n{PLAYER}{KUN}。我可不会输哦！$

label: Route104_Text_MayDefeat
source: Yikes!\nYou're better than I expected!$
translation: 呜哇！\n比想象中厉害得多......$

label: Route104_Text_BrendanWeShouldRegister
source: BRENDAN: Oh, hey, {PLAYER}!\pCool, you had DEVON install the MATCH\nCALL system on your POKéNAV!\pLet's register each other in our\nPOKéNAVS so we can keep in touch.$
translation: 小悠：嘿，{PLAYER}！\p得文给你的宝可导航\n装了对战寻呼系统吧？\p我们互相登记一下信息吧，\n这样我们就能随时联系了。$

label: Route104_Text_BrendanHowsYourPokedex
source: BRENDAN: {PLAYER}, how's your POKéDEX?\nHave you filled in any pages yet?$
translation: 小悠：{PLAYER}，你的宝可梦图鉴进展如何？\n有几页了吗？$

label: Route104_Text_BrendanDoingGreatLetsBattle
source: Me, I'm doing great!\pWant to check out how good I am with\na battle?$
translation: 我？我这边很顺利！\p来场对战让你看看\n我的成果如何？$

label: Route104_Text_BrendanNoConfidence
source: BRENDAN: What's the matter? Don't have\nany confidence in your POKéMON?$
translation: 小悠：怎么了？\n对自己的宝可梦没信心吗？$

label: Route104_Text_BrendanLetsBattle
source: BRENDAN: What's up?\nWant to have a battle with me?$
translation: 小悠：怎样？\n想和我来场对战吗？$

label: Route104_Text_BrendanIntro
source: BRENDAN: I know you just became\na TRAINER, but I won't go easy!$
translation: 小悠：虽然你刚成为训练家，\n但我不会手下留情哦！$

label: Route104_Text_BrendanDefeat
source: Hmm…\nYou're pretty good.$
translation: 嘿......\n挺能干的嘛。$

label: Route104_Text_BrendanPostBattle
source:
BRENDAN: You've gotten pretty decent
at handling POKéMON.\pBut, you know, you shouldn't just be
making POKéMON battle.\pLike MR. BRINEY, it's important to
become friends with your POKéMON.$
translation:
小悠：你在培育宝可梦方面
很有天赋啊，\p但要知道，
你不能只顾着让宝可梦战斗。\p像哈奇老人那样，
和宝可梦做朋友也很重要。$

label: Route104_MrBrineysHouse_Text_WaitUpPeeko
source: MR. BRINEY: Hold on, lass!\nWait up, PEEKO!$
translation: 哈奇：稍等，孩子！\n等等我，小皮！$

label: Route104_MrBrineysHouse_Text_ItsYouLetsSailToDewford
source:
Hm? You're {PLAYER}{KUN}!
You saved my darling PEEKO!\lWe owe so much to you!\pWhat's that?
You want to sail with me?\pHmhm…\pYou have a LETTER bound for DEWFORD
and a package for SLATEPORT, then?\pQuite the busy life you must lead!\pBut, certainly, what you're asking is
no problem at all.\pYou've come to the right man!
We'll set sail for DEWFORD.$
translation:
嗯？你是{PLAYER}{KUN}！
是你救了我心爱的小皮！\l我们欠你的人情！\p什么？
你想要坐我的船？\p嗯......\p你要去武斗镇送信，
还要去凯那市送包裹？\p你的生活还真是忙碌啊！\p不过这点小事
包在我身上！\p你找对人了！
我们这就启航去武斗镇。$

label: Route104_MrBrineysHouse_Text_SetSailForDewford
source: MR. BRINEY: DEWFORD it is, then!\pAnchors aweigh!\nPEEKO, we're setting sail, my darling!$
translation: 哈奇：目标武斗镇！\p起锚咯！\n小皮，亲爱的，我们出海了！$

label: Route104_MrBrineysHouse_Text_DeclineDeliverySail
source: MR. BRINEY: Is that so?\nYour deliveries can wait?\pYou just go on and tell me whenever\nyou want to set sail!$
translation: 哈奇：这样吗？\n你的包裹不急吗？\p想出海随时叫我！$

label: Route104_MrBrineysHouse_Text_NeedToMakeDeliveriesSailToDewford
source:
MR. BRINEY: Ahoy!
I know exactly what you want to say!\pYou're to deliver a LETTER to DEWFORD
and a package to SLATEPORT.\pWhat you need me to do is no problem
at all--I'm the man for the job!\pFirst, we'll set sail for DEWFORD.$
translation:
哈奇：喂！
我明白你的意思！\p你想要去武斗镇送信，
还要去凯那市送包裹。\p这点小事
包在我身上！\p你找对人了！
我们这就启航去武斗镇。$

label: Route104_MrBrineysHouse_Text_NeedToDeliverPackageSailToDewford
source:
MR. BRINEY: Ahoy!
I know exactly what you want to say!\pYou're to deliver a package to
CAPT. STERN in SLATEPORT.\pWhat you need me to do is no problem
at all--I'm the man for the job!\pFirst, we'll set sail for DEWFORD.$
translation:
哈奇：喂！
我明白你的意思！\p你要送包裹给
凯那市的楠木。\p这点小事
包在我身上！\p你找对人了！
我们这就启航去武斗镇。$

label: Route104_MrBrineysHouse_Text_WhereAreWeBound
source: MR. BRINEY: Ahoy!\nFor you, I'll go out to sea anytime!\pNow, my friend, where are we bound?$
translation: 哈奇：喂！\n为了你我随时都能出海！\p说吧朋友，\n这次想去哪儿？$

label: Route104_MrBrineysHouse_Text_TellMeWheneverYouWantToSail
source: MR. BRINEY: Is that so?\nWell, PEEKO owes her life to you.\pYou just go on and tell me whenever\nyou want to set sail!$
translation: 哈奇：这样吗？\n你可是小皮的救命恩人。\p想出海随时叫我！$

label: Route104_MrBrineysHouse_Text_Peeko
source: PEEKO: Pii piihyoro!$
translation: 小皮：皮皮呦咯！$

label: Route104_Text_DadPokenavCall
source:
… … … … … …
… … … … … Beep!\pDAD: Oh, {PLAYER}?\p… … … … … …
Where are you now?\lIt sounds windy wherever you are.\pI just heard from DEVON's MR. STONE
about your POKéNAV, so I decided\lto give you a call.\pIt sounds like you're doing fine,
so that's fine with me.\pYou take care now.\p… … … … … …
… … … … … Click!$
translation:
...... ...... ......
...... ...... ......哔！\p爸爸：喂，{PLAYER}吗？\p...... ...... ......
现在到哪儿了？\l你那边风声很大啊。\p我刚刚从得文的兹伏奇社长那儿
听说了你拿到了宝可导航，\l就想着给你打个电话。\p听起来你过得不错，
那我就放心了。\p自己多保重啊。\p...... ...... ......
...... ...... ......咔哒！$

label: Route104_Text_RegisteredDadInPokenav
source: Registered DAD NORMAN\nin the POKéNAV.$
translation: 把爸爸千里\n登记到宝可导航里了。$

label: Route106_Text_TrainerTips
source: TRAINER TIPS\pAdvice on catching POKéMON with a ROD:\nPress the A Button if you get a bite.$
translation: 有用的公告牌！\p关于钓鱼的建议：\n当鱼咬钩时，按下A键。$

label: DewfordTown_Text_BrineyLandedInSlateportDeliverGoods
source: MR. BRINEY: Ahoy!\nWe've made land in SLATEPORT!\pI suppose you're going to visit CAPT.\nSTERN and deliver the DEVON GOODS?$
translation: 哈奇：好了！\n我们到凯那市了！\p我想你是要去找\n楠木馆长送得文的物品吧？$

label: Route109_Text_BrineySailToDewfordQuestion
source: MR. BRINEY: I thought you're supposed\nto deliver the DEVON GOODS.\pWould you like to sail back to\nDEWFORD, then?$
translation: 哈奇：我以为你要\n去送得文的物品。\p那么，\n你想回武斗镇去吗？$

label: Route109_Text_BrineyDewfordItIs
source: MR. BRINEY: DEWFORD it is, then!\pAnchors aweigh!\nPEEKO, we're setting sail, my darling!$
translation: 哈奇：武斗镇是吗？\p起锚咯！\n小皮，亲爱的，我们出海了！$

label: Route109_Text_BrineyDeliverDevonGoods
source: MR. BRINEY: Then you go on and deliver\nthe DEVON GOODS. I'll be waiting.$
translation: 哈奇：那么你去送得文的物品吧，\n我就在这儿等着。$

label: DewfordTown_Text_BrineyLandedInSlateport
source: MR. BRINEY: Ahoy! We've made land in\nSLATEPORT!\pYou just go on and tell me whenever\nyou want to set sail again!$
translation: 哈奇：好了！\n我们到凯那市了！\p你还想出海的话\n就来找我吧！$

label: Route109_Text_BrineyWhereAreWeBound
source: MR. BRINEY: Ahoy!\nFor you, I'll go out to sea anytime!\pNow, my friend, where are we bound?$
translation: 哈奇：嗨！\n只要你愿意，我随时可以出发！\p好了，我的朋友，你想去哪儿？$

label: Route109_Text_BrineyTellMeWhenYouNeedToSail
source: MR. BRINEY: You just tell me whenever\nyou need to set sail again!$
translation: 哈奇：想出海的话，\n随时来找我！$

label: Route109_Text_ChillAtMyPapasSpot
source: Yo, TRAINERS!\nWhether you're hot to trot,\lor cool cat not,\lchill at my papa's spot!$
translation: 哟，训练家！\n不论你是火气冲天，\l还是冷酷无边，\l都能在爸爸的店里找到个人空间！$

label: Route109_Text_LittleKidsDartAround
source: Little kids can dart around so quickly…\pYou don't dare take your eyes off them\nfor an instant. It's very taxing.\pMine are with my POKéMON, so they\nshould be okay, but…$
translation: 小孩子跑得很快......\p你得时时刻刻盯着她们，\n这真的很累人。\p我的孩子跟宝可梦在一起，\n大概没什么问题，可是......$

label: Route109_Text_SandCastleTakingLongTime
source: Our sand castle's taking a long time\nto make.$
translation: 我们用了很长时间\n才堆好沙堡。$

label: Route109_Text_YouCanHaveThis
source: You can have this!$
translation: 这个给你！$

label: Route109_Text_WereGoingToMakeBigCastle
source: We're going to get all the sand from\nthe beach and make a big castle!\pAnd then we're going to be a king and\nqueen.\pWe'll let you be a servant.$
translation: 我们要把沙滩上的沙都\n收集起来，堆一个大大的沙堡！\p我们就是城堡里的\n国王和王后。\p你可以做我们的卫兵。$

label: Route109_Text_ZigzagoonPicksUpLitter
source:
The water around these parts is clean.\pBut, I get my ZIGZAGOON to pick up
litter from the shoreline at times.\pDirty water becomes rain and joins our
rivers, which we drink from…\pIf we pollute the sea, it all comes
back to haunt us eventually.$
translation:
尽管这附近的水
很清澈，\p但我仍会带着我的蛇纹熊
来海岸捡垃圾。\p污水会升到空中形成雨，
然后落到我们汲水的小河里......\p如果我们污染了海洋，
最终受害的还是我们自己。$

label: Route109_Text_ZigzagoonCry
source: ZIGZAGOON: Guguu?$
translation: 蛇纹熊：咕呜？$

label: Route109_Text_SeashoreHouseSign
source: SEASHORE HOUSE\p“May hot battles rage on hot sands!\nThe place for hot TRAINERS!”$
translation: 大海之家\p"火热的沙滩上火热的对战！\n欢迎火热的训练家！"$

label: Route109_Text_TrainerTipsSign
source: TRAINER TIPS\pPOKéMON at the same level may not\nalways have identical stats.\pPOKéMON raised by TRAINERS are said\nto grow stronger than wild POKéMON.$
translation: 有用的公告牌！\p同样等级的宝可梦实力\n并不完全相同。\p据说训练家训练出的宝可梦\n比野生宝可梦更强。$

label: Route109_SeashoreHouse_Text_SeashoreHouseIntro
source:
I'm the owner of the SEASHORE HOUSE.
But you can call me MR. SEA!\pWhat I love above all is to see hot
POKéMON battles.\pLet me see that your heart burns hot!\pIf you can defeat all the TRAINERS
here, I'll reward your efforts.$
translation:
我是大海之家的老板，
你可以叫我大海先生！\p我最为喜欢的事情
是观看激烈的宝可梦对战。\p给我看看你的激情吧！\p如果你能打败这里的所有训练家，
我这里有奖励送给你。$

label: Route109_SeashoreHouse_Text_ShowMeSomeHotMatches
source: Show me some hot matches!\pI run this SEASHORE HOUSE just for\nthat reason alone!$
translation: 让我看看激烈的对战吧！\p我开这大海之家的\n目的就在于此！$

label: Route109_SeashoreHouse_Text_TakeTheseSodaPopBottles
source: You're scorching hot!\nThose battles blazed!\lI'm more than just satisfied!\pAs thanks for showing me your hot\nstreak, I want you to take these.\pIt's half a dozen bottles of SODA POP!$
translation: 火热的对战把人\n都要烧焦了！\l我已经无法描述我的兴奋了！\p这些送给你，当作是我\n对你的热情的谢礼，\p总共6瓶劲爽汽水！$

label: Route109_SeashoreHouse_Text_BagFull
source: Oh, but hey, your BAG's jammed full.\nI'll hang on to these for you.$
translation: 哎，但是你的包包已经满了，\n我会暂时替你保管的。$

label: Route109_SeashoreHouse_Text_WantToBuySodaPop
source: Want to buy some SODA POP?\nPOKéMON love it!\pJust ¥300 a bottle!\nBuy some!$
translation: 想买劲爽汽水吗？\n宝可梦都很喜欢它！\p只卖¥300一瓶！\n来买吧！$

label: Route109_SeashoreHouse_Text_HereYouGo
source: 给你！$

label: Route109_SeashoreHouse_Text_NotEnoughMoney
source: You don't have the money.$
translation: 钱不够。$

label: Route109_SeashoreHouse_Text_ThatsTooBad
source: No?\nThat's too bad.$
translation: 不买吗？\n真遗憾。$

label: Route109_SeashoreHouse_Text_DwayneIntro
source: If you're looking for a battle in the\nSEASHORE HOUSE, you'll find no\lhotter TRAINER than me, matey!$
translation: 伙计，知道吗，在大海之家的\n训练家之中，没有人比我\l更充满激情了！$

label: Route109_SeashoreHouse_Text_DwayneDefeated
source: That was a hot battle!\nI can accept that loss, matey!$
translation: 火热的对战！\n我心服口服了，伙计！$

label: Route109_SeashoreHouse_Text_DwaynePostBattle
source: Whenever I'm in SLATEPORT, I enjoy\nhot battles and ice-cold SODA POP!$
translation: 在凯那市就是要享受\n火热的对战和冰爽的劲爽汽水！$

label: Route109_SeashoreHouse_Text_JohannaIntro
source: Boring battles aren't worth the effort.\pFiery hot battles are what toughen up\nTRAINERS and POKéMON!$
translation: 无聊的对战不值得为之付出努力。\p只有火一般的对战才能使\n训练家和宝可梦成长起来！$

label: Route109_SeashoreHouse_Text_JohannaDefeated
source: That's hot!$
translation: 好热！$

label: Route109_SeashoreHouse_Text_JohannaPostBattle
source: Whew, I'm all thirsty.\nMaybe I'll have a SODA POP.$
translation: 呼，我渴了。\n去喝点劲爽汽水吧。$

label: Route109_SeashoreHouse_Text_SimonIntro
source: I'm going to show you how great\nmy POKéMON are, but don't cry!$
translation: 让你见识一下我的\n宝可梦的厉害。不要哭鼻子！$

label: Route109_SeashoreHouse_Text_SimonDefeated
source: …I lost, but I won't cry…$

label: Route109_SeashoreHouse_Text_SimonPostBattle
source: If one of my POKéMON knew the move\nfor carrying me across water on its\lback, I could get rid of this inner tube.$
translation: 如果我的宝可梦会那样\n背着我过海的招式，\l我就可以摆脱这个泳圈了。$

label: Route10_Text_MarkIntro
source: Wow, you came all the way here?\nMaybe you're a POKéMANIAC, too?\lWant to see my collection?$
translation: 哇，你历经磨难终于到了我这里？\n也许你也是一个怪兽狂对吗？\l想要看看我的收藏吗？$

label: Route10_Text_MarkDefeat
source: Humph.\nI'm not angry!$
translation: 啊哼。\n我不会生气的！$

label: Route10_Text_MarkPostBattle
source: I have more rare POKéMON at home!$
translation: 我还有很多稀有的宝可梦\n放在家里呢$

label: Route10_Text_ClarkIntro
source: Ha-hahah-ah-ha!$
translation: 哈哈-哈哈-啊哈哈$

label: Route10_Text_ClarkDefeat
source: Ha-haha!\nNot laughing!\lHa-hay fever! Haha-ha-choo!$
translation: 哈-啊啊！\n不准笑！\l啊啊-发烧了！啊啊-啊嚏！$

label: Route10_Text_ClarkPostBattle
source: Haha-ha-choo!\nHa-choo!\lSnort! Snivel!$
translation: 啊啊-啊嚏！\n啊嚏！\l抽鼻子，擦鼻涕。$

label: Route10_Text_HermanIntro
source: Hi, kid!\nWant to see my POKéMON?$
translation: 嘿，小子！\n想看我的宝可梦$

label: Route10_Text_HermanDefeat
source: Oh, no!\nMy POKéMON!$
translation: 喔，不！\n我的宝可梦$

label: Route10_Text_HermanPostBattle
source: I don't like you.\nI don't like anyone better than me!$
translation: 我讨厌你。\n比我强的人我都不喜欢！$

label: Route10_Text_HeidiIntro
source: I've been out at a POKéMON GYM\na few times.\p…But I always lose.$
translation: 我已经在宝可梦道馆中辗转\n奋战多时。\p...可总是输多赢少。$

label: Route10_Text_HeidiDefeat
source: Ohh!\nAfter all my training!$
translation: 烦死了！\n有事等我训练完了再说！$

label: Route10_Text_HeidiPostBattle
source: I noticed some POKéMANIACS\nprowling around.\pCan you imagine? Them?\nUp here in the mountains?$
translation: 我发现一些怪兽狂\n正在附近徘徊的踪迹。\p你想象得出来吗？\n从这山顶往下俯视的样子？$

label: Route10_Text_TrentIntro
source: Ah!\nThis mountain air is delicious!$
translation: 哈！\n这山里的空气真爽！$

label: Route10_Text_TrentDefeat
source: That cleared my head!$
translation: 它使我的心灵彻底得到了净化！$

label: Route10_Text_TrentPostBattle
source: I feel bloated on mountain air!$
translation: 这样的空气里人都像要飞起来了！$

label: Route10_Text_CarolIntro
source: I'm feeling a bit faint.\nI haven't hiked in some time.$
translation: 我现在有点头晕，\n好久都没有登山了。$

label: Route10_Text_CarolDefeat
source: I'm too tired.\nI wasn't up for it.$
translation: 我实在坚持不住了。\n都怪我没有做好充足的准备。$

label: Route10_Text_CarolPostBattle
source: The POKéMON here in the mountains\nare so chunky…\pI wish there were pink POKéMON\nwith a floral pattern!$
translation: 这座山里生活的宝可梦\n都是矮矮胖胖的那种......\p我希望能有一种宝可梦，\n它粉色的皮肤上有花瓣花纹！$

label: Route10_Text_RockTunnelDetourToLavender
source: ROCK TUNNEL\nDetour to LAVENDER TOWN$
translation: 岩山隧道\n绕道到紫苑镇$

label: Route10_Text_RockTunnel
source: ROCK TUNNEL$
translation: 岩山隧道$

label: Route10_Text_PowerPlant
source: POWER PLANT$
translation: 无人发电厂$

label: Route10_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_EveryTypeStrongerThanOthers
source: The types of POKéMON match up\ndifferently with each other.\pEvery type is stronger than some\ntypes and weaker than others.$
translation: 将宝可梦的属性\n互相不同搭配起来。\p每一种属性都比其它一些属性强，\n相对的，也比其它一些属性弱。$

label: Route10_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_NuggetUselessSoldFor5000
source: A NUGGET is totally useless.\nSo I sold it for ¥5000.$
translation: 一个金珠实在没什么用，\n因此我以5000元的价格把它卖了。$

label: Route10_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_HeardGhostsHauntLavender
source: I heard that ghosts haunt\nLAVENDER TOWN.$
translation: 我听说那个幽灵经常出没于\n紫苑镇。$

label: Route10_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_GiveEverstoneIfCaught20Mons
source:
Oh… {PLAYER}!
I've been looking for you!\pIt's me, one of the ever-present
AIDES to PROF. OAK.\pIf your POKéDEX has complete data
on twenty species, I'm supposed to\lgive you a reward from PROF. OAK.\pHe entrusted me with this
EVERSTONE.\pSo, {PLAYER}, let me ask you.\pHave you gathered data on at least
twenty kinds of POKéMON?$
translation:
哦...... {PLAYER}
我一直在找你。\p是我 你经常会看到的
大木博士的助手之一。\p如果你的宝可梦图鉴已经收集了
20个不同的宝可梦的数据，我就会把\l大木博士的奖励给你。\p他委托我给你这个
不变之石。\p那么，{PLAYER} 让我问问你吧。\p你的宝可梦图鉴已经收集到
20个宝可梦的数据吗？$

label: Route10_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_GreatHereYouGo
source: Great! You have caught or owned\n{STR_VAR_3} kinds of POKéMON!\pCongratulations!\nHere you go!$
translation: 太棒了！你已经收集了\n{STR_VAR_3}种宝可梦！\p恭喜！\n奖励，拿去吧！$

label: Route10_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_ReceivedEverstoneFromAide
source: {PLAYER} received the EVERSTONE\nfrom the AIDE.$
translation: {PLAYER}从助手那儿\n获得了不变之石。$

label: Route10_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_ExplainEverstone
source:
Making POKéMON evolve certainly
can add to the POKéDEX.\pHowever, at times, you may not
want a certain POKéMON to evolve.\pIn that case, give the EVERSTONE
to that POKéMON.\pIt will prevent evolution according
to the PROFESSOR.$
translation:
如果宝可梦进化
数据一样可以加入宝可梦图鉴。\p但有时，你也许会
不希望一个宝可梦进化。\p在那种情况下 就把不变之石
给那只宝可梦吧。\p根据博士的话所说，
它会阻止宝可梦的进化$

label: Route110_Text_WeCantTalkAboutAquaActivities
source: TEAM AQUA's activities…\nWe can't talk about them yet.$
translation: 海洋队的行动......\n我们还不能多说。$

label: Route110_Text_KickUpARuckus
source: I want to get going to SLATEPORT and\nkick up a ruckus!$
translation: 我想去凯那市\n搞出大名堂来！$

label: Route110_Text_MyFirstJobInAqua
source: This is my first job after joining\nTEAM AQUA. It's a little scary.$
translation: 这是我加入海洋队后的\n第一件工作。我有点害怕。$

label: Route110_Text_AquaActionsBringSmiles
source: TEAM AQUA's actions should bring\nsmiles to people's faces!$
translation: 海洋队的行动应会为\n所有人带来笑容！$

label: Route110_Text_MayLetsBattle
source: MAY: Hi, {PLAYER}{KUN}, long time no see!\pWhile I was searching for other\nPOKéMON, my POKéMON grew stronger.\pSo…\nHow about a little battle?$
translation: 小遥：{PLAYER}{KUN}，好久不见了！\p我寻找新宝可梦的同时，\n自己的宝可梦也变强了！\p所以......\n要不要来场对战？$

label: Route110_Text_MayDefeated
source: Yikes!\nYou're better than I expected!$
translation: 哎呀！\n比想象得更强！$

label: Route110_Text_MayTakeThis
source: MAY: {PLAYER}{KUN}, you've been busy\ntraining, too, haven't you?\pI think you deserve a reward!\nThis is from me!$
translation: 小遥：{PLAYER}{KUN}，\n你也有在努力训练吧？\p这个奖励是你应得的，\n送给你！$

label: Route110_Text_MayExplainItemfinder
