source: MAY: That's an ITEMFINDER.\pTry it out. If there is an item that's\nnot visible, it emits a sound.\pOkay, {PLAYER}{KUN}, let's meet again!\pI know it's a little silly coming from\nme, but I think you should train a lot\lharder for the next time.$
translation: 小遥：这是探宝器。\p使用时如果附近有隐藏的\n道具，它就会发出声音。\p{PLAYER}{KUN}，下次见！\p虽然由我来说有点怪，\n但我希望下次见面时你变得更强呢！$

label: Route110_Text_BrendanLetsBattle
source: BRENDAN: Hey, {PLAYER}.\nSo this is where you were.\lHow's it going?\pHave you been raising your POKéMON?\nI'll check for you.$
translation: 小悠：嘿，{PLAYER}，\n原来你也在这里。\l还顺利吗？\p你的宝可梦训练得如何？\n让我来检查看看！$

label: Route110_Text_BrendanDefeated
source: Hmm…\nYou're pretty good.$
translation: 唔......\n挺能干的嘛。$

label: Route110_Text_BrendanTakeThis
source: BRENDAN: {PLAYER}, you've trained\nwithout me noticing…\pGood enough!\nHere, take this.$
translation: 小悠：{PLAYER}，不知不觉地\n你已经变得这么强了......\p干得不错！\n这个给你。$

label: Route110_Text_BrendanExplainItemfinder
source:
BRENDAN: That's an ITEMFINDER.\pUse it to root around for items that
aren't visible.\pIf it senses something, it emits
a sound.\pAnyway, I'm off to look for new
POKéMON.$
translation:
小悠：这是探宝器。\p用它可以寻找附近
隐藏的道具。\p如果它探测到东西，
就会发出声音。\p我要继续去找新的
宝可梦了，回见！$

label: Route110_Text_RideBikeAtFullSpeed
source: Wouldn't it be great to ride a BIKE\nat full speed on CYCLING ROAD?$
translation: 在自行车道上\n风驰电掣的感觉很好吧？$

label: Route110_Text_HairStreamsBehindMe
source: How do you like the way my raven-\ncolored hair streams behind me?\pI grew my hair out just for that.$
translation: 我乌亮的头发\n飘在脑后的样子怎么样？\p我就是为此才留长发的。$

label: Route110_Text_YouGotBikeFromRydel
source:
Oh, hey, you got that BIKE from RYDEL!\pOh, it's glaringly obvious.
It says right on your bike…\pRYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL,
RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL,\pRYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL,
RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL,\pRYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL,
RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL,\pRYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL,
RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL,\pRYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL…
That name's everywhere.\pYou should ride it around all over
the place--it's good advertising!$
translation:
嘿，那是风野那儿的自行车！\p啊，这很明显，
就在你车子上写着呢......\p风野，风野，风野，风野，风野，
风野，风野，风野，风野，风野，\p风野，风野，风野，风野，风野，
风野，风野，风野，风野，风野，\p风野，风野，风野，风野，风野，
风野，风野，风野，风野，风野，\p风野，风野，风野，风野，风野，
风野，风野，风野，风野，风野，\p风野，风野，风野，风野，风野......
这名字到处都是。\p你应该骑着它四处走走--
广告效果会很可观！$

label: Route110_Text_TwoRoads
source: The two roads, one above, one below…\pA road each for people and POKéMON.\nPerhaps that is right and fair.$
translation: 两条路，一条在上，一条在下......\p一条给人，一条给宝可梦。\n也许这样是最公平的。$

label: Route110_Text_WalkOnTheLowRoad
source: I don't have a BIKE, so I'll take\na leisurely walk on the low road.$
translation: 我没有自行车，\n所以我只能走下面的路。$

label: Route110_Text_BikeTechniques
source: Learning techniques will make BIKE\nriding even more fun.\pThere are some places that you can\nreach only by using a BIKE technique.$
translation: 学些车技不只是\n为了好玩，\p有些地方只有\n用车技才能到达。$

label: Route110_Text_WhichShouldIChoose
source: Which should I choose?\pMake a beeline for MAUVILLE on\nCYCLING ROAD, or take the low road\land look for POKéMON?$
translation: 我该选哪条路？\p上自行车道走捷径去紫堇市，\n还是走下面的路找宝可梦？$

label: Route110_Text_CyclingChallengeResultSummary
source: Number of collisions:\n… … {STR_VAR_1}!\pTotal time:\n… … {STR_VAR_2}!$
translation: 碰撞次数：\n......{STR_VAR_1}次！\p总时间：\n......{STR_VAR_2}！$

label: Route110_Text_ChallengeReactionBest
source: Bravo! Splendid showing!\pYour love of cycling comes from deep\nwithin your heart.\lYou've shaken me to my very soul!$
translation: 华丽的表演！\p你从心底热爱骑车，\l这让我的灵魂也为此鼓舞！$

label: Route110_Text_ChallengeReactionGood
source: Your technique is remarkable.\pI suggest you speed up a bit while\nstill avoiding collisions.$
translation: 你的技术不错。\p但我想你还可以更快一点，\n或者再减少几次碰撞。$

label: Route110_Text_ChallengeReactionOk
source: I would consider you a work in\nprogress.\pStill, I hope you don't forget the\nsheer pleasure of cycling.$
translation: 我想你确实\n努力了。\p但我希望你不要\n忘记骑车的快感。$

label: Route110_Text_ChallengeReactionBad
source: My word… Your cycling skills border\non terrifying.\pMost certainly, you need much more\npractice riding.$
translation: 要我说......你的骑车水平\n还不行。\p很明显，你\n还得练习。$

label: Route110_Text_ChallengeReactionWorst
source: …I am aghast…\pYou're perhaps not cut out for this\nunfortunate cycling business.\pYou ought to give serious thought to\nreturning that BIKE to RYDEL.$
translation: ......我很无奈......\p你也许并不\n适合骑车。\p你该考虑考虑\n把车还给风野。$

label: Route110_Text_RatedForNumberOfCollisions
source: This is CYCLING ROAD.\pIf you were to ride from MAUVILLE to\nSLATEPORT on a MACH BIKE, you would\lbe rated for the number of collisions\land your total time.$
translation: 这里是自行车道。\p如果你骑着音速自行车\n从紫堇市到凯那市去，\l你的碰撞次数和\l总时间都会被记录下来。$

label: Route110_Text_AlwaysAimHigher
source: Regardless of the results, I count on\nseeing more challenges from you.\lAlways aim higher!$
translation: 不管结果如何，\n我想看看你挑战纪录的样子。\l向更高目标冲刺吧！$

label: Route110_Text_AcroBikesDoNotQualify
source: On this CYCLING ROAD, those riding\nMACH BIKES are rated for their number\lof collisions and their total times.\pACRO BIKES do not qualify for rating.\nThey are easy to turn, so it's not fair.$
translation: 这条自行车道上，骑音速自行车的人\n通过整条路所用的时间\l和碰撞次数都会被记录下来。\p越野自行车的成绩不会被记录，\n它们很好操控，直接比较有失公平。$

label: Route110_Text_SlateportCitySign
source: ROUTE 110\n{DOWN_ARROW} SLATEPORT CITY$
translation: 110号道路\n{DOWN_ARROW}凯那市$

label: Route110_Text_CyclingRoadSign
source: SEASIDE CYCLING ROAD$
translation: 海滨自行车道$

label: Route110_Text_AquaWasHere
source: “TEAM AQUA was here!”\pSomeone painted that onto this sign,\nbut then someone else painted over it.\p“TEAM MAGMA rules!” is what it\nsays now.$
translation: "海洋队到此一游！"\p牌子上有人涂了这样的文字，\n但后来有什么人涂掉了那些字。\p"熔岩队最高！"\n现在上面是这么写的。$

label: Route110_Text_Route103Sign
source: ROUTE 110\n{LEFT_ARROW} ROUTE 103$
translation: 110号道路\n{LEFT_ARROW}103号道路$

label: Route110_Text_SeasideParkingSign
source: SEASIDE PARKING$
translation: 海边停车场$

label: Route110_Text_MauvilleCitySign
source: ROUTE 110\n{UP_ARROW} MAUVILLE CITY$
translation: 110号道路\n{UP_ARROW}紫堇市$

label: Route110_Text_TrainerTipsPrlzSleep
source: TRAINER TIPS\pThe foe can be made helpless by\nparalyzing it or causing it to sleep.\pIt is an important technique for\nPOKéMON battles.$
translation: 有用的公告牌！\p敌人被麻痹或催眠后\n会变得束手无策。\p这类招式在对战中很重要。$

label: Route110_Text_TrainerTipsRegisterItems
source: TRAINER TIPS\pThe items in the BAG can be reorganized\nby pressing SELECT.$
translation: 有用的公告牌！\p包包里的道具可以\n按SELECT键来整理。$

label: Route110_Text_TrickHouseSign
source: “Three steps {RIGHT_ARROW} and two steps {UP_ARROW}\nto reach the wondrous TRICK HOUSE.”$
translation: "{RIGHT_ARROW}3步，{UP_ARROW}2步，\n进入奇妙的戏法屋。"$

label: Route110_Text_BestRecord
source: THE BEST RECORD TO DATE…\pNo. of collisions: {STR_VAR_1}\pElapsed time: {STR_VAR_2}$
translation: 至今为止最好的纪录......\p碰撞次数：{STR_VAR_1}\p用时：{STR_VAR_2}$

label: Route110_Text_ThereIsNoRecord
source: THE BEST RECORD TO DATE…\pNo one seems to have taken the\nchallenge. There is no record…$
translation: 至今为止最好的纪录......\p还未出现挑战者。\n没有纪录......$

label: Route110_Text_ImagineSeeingYouHere
source: PROF. BIRCH: Oh, {PLAYER}{KUN}!\nImagine seeing you here!\pAnd where might my {RIVAL} be?$
translation: 小田卷博士：哦，{PLAYER}{KUN}！\n没想到会在这儿遇见你！\p我家{RIVAL}呢？$

label: Route110_Text_HeardYouInstallMatchCall
source:
Oh, I see!
You two are running separately.\lWell, that's fine.\pOh, yes, I heard that your POKéNAV
had the MATCH CALL system installed.\pWell, then, I should register you in
my POKéNAV as well.\pThat way, even when we're apart,
I can rate your POKéDEX anytime.\p… … … … … …$
translation:
哦，原来如此！
你们两个是分开行动的。\l嗯，这样也好。\p对了，听说你的宝可导航里
装了对战寻呼系统，\p那么，我们也互相
登记信息吧。\p这样一来，即使不在一起，
我也能评估你的宝可梦图鉴进度了。\p...... ...... ......$

label: Route110_Text_RegisteredBirchInPokenav
source: Registered PROF. BIRCH\nin the POKéNAV.$
translation: 把小田卷博士\n登记到宝可导航里了。$

label: Route110_Text_KeepAnEyeOutForRival
source: PROF. BIRCH: {PLAYER}{KUN}…\pPlease keep an eye out for my {RIVAL}.\n… … … … … …\pWell, I had better get going.\nSee you again, {PLAYER}{KUN}!$
translation: 小田卷博士：{PLAYER}{KUN}......\p请替我多关照{RIVAL}！\n...... ...... ......\p好了，我得先走啦！\n再见，{PLAYER}{KUN}！$

label: Route110_SeasideCyclingRoadNorthEntrance_Text_GoAllOutOnCyclingRoad
source: On CYCLING ROAD, you can go all out\nand cycle as fast as you'd like.\pIt feels great to go that fast, but try\nnot to crash into anyone!$
translation: 在自行车道上，你可以全力以赴骑出\n你最快的速度。\p追风的感觉非常爽快，\n但千万不要撞到人！$

label: Route110_SeasideCyclingRoadNorthEntrance_Text_TooDangerousToWalk
source: Sorry, you can't walk on CYCLING\nROAD. It's too dangerous.\pPlease come back with a BIKE.$
translation: 对不起，自行车道上不能走路，\n太危险了。\p骑上自行车再回来吧。$

label: Route110_SeasideCyclingRoadSouthEntrance_Text_GoAllOutOnCyclingRoad
source: On CYCLING ROAD, you can go all out\nand cycle as fast as you'd like.\pIt feels great to go that fast, but try\nnot to crash into anyone!$
translation: 在自行车道上，你可以全力以赴骑出\n你最快的速度，\p追风的感觉非常爽快，\n但千万不要撞到人！$

label: Route110_SeasideCyclingRoadSouthEntrance_Text_TooDangerousToWalk
source: Sorry, you can't walk on CYCLING\nROAD. It's too dangerous.\pPlease come back with a BIKE.$
translation: 对不起，自行车道上不能走路，\n太危险了。\p骑上自行车再回来吧。$

label: Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_YouveMadeItToMe
source: Aak!\nYou've made it to me?\lHmmm… You're sharp!$
translation: 啊啊！\n你来了？\l嗯......了不起！$

label: Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_AllNightToPlantTrees
source: It took me all night to plant all those\ntrees…\pYou're almost my equal in greatness by\none, two, three, four, five, six places!$
translation: 我用了整整一个晚上\n种起那些树......\p你几乎与我一样伟大，不过你还差\n一、二、三、四、五、六个档次！$

label: Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_AllNightToMakeMaze
source: It took me all night to make the maze…\pYou're almost my equal in greatness by\none, two, three, four, five places!$
translation: 我用了整整一个晚上造起迷宫......\p你几乎与我一样伟大，不过你还差\n一、二、三、四、五个档次！$

label: Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_AllNightToPreparePanels
source: It took me all night to prepare\nthe wall panels…\pYou're almost my equal in greatness by\none, two, three, four places!$
translation: 我用了整整一个晚上准备好\n墙上的隔板......\p你几乎与我一样伟大，不过你还差\n一、二、三、四个档次！$

label: Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_AllNightToShoveBoulders
source: It took me all night to shove in those\nboulders…\pYou're almost my equal in greatness by\none, two, three places!$
translation: 我用了整整一个晚上把那些\n大石头推到合适的地方......\p你几乎与我一样伟大，不过你还差\n一、二、三个档次！$

label: Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_AllNightToMakeMechadolls
source: It took me all night to make MECHADOLLS\nand another to think up the quiz…\pYou're almost my equal in greatness by\none, two places!$
translation: 我用了整整一个晚上制造\n机械娃娃，设计问题......\p你几乎与我一样伟大，不过你还差\n一、二个档次！$

label: Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_AllNightToInstallDoors
source: It took me all night to install\nthe doors…\pYou're almost my equal in greatness!$
translation: 我用了整整一个晚上\n装好那些门......\p你几乎与我一样伟大！$

label: Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_AllNightSettingUpArrows
source: It took me all night setting up arrows…\pYou're my equal in greatness!$
translation: 我用了整整一个晚上设置好箭......\p你与我一样伟大！$

label: Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_AllNightPolishingFloors
source: It took me all night polishing floors…\pYou're above me in greatness!\nPossibly…$
translation: 我用了整整一个晚上抛光地板......\p你比我还要伟大！\n也许......$

label: Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_FountainOfIdeasRunDry
source: Wh-what should I do?\nMy fountain of ideas for tricks has\lrun dry…\pPerhaps it is time I toured the country\non a quest to devise new tricks…$
translation: 我......我该怎么办？\n我对谜题的灵感\l已经枯竭了......\p也许我该去环游全国\n来寻找灵感......$

label: Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_DefeatedMePreferWhichTent
source:
I hate to admit defeat, but you have
bested me!\pStill, you must have been reeled in by
my charisma for you to visit me again\land again. Yes, you must have!\pBut that has nothing to do with my
losing!\pIn recognition of the friendship
between you, the driven, and the genius\lthat is myself, I demand that you take\lthis keepsake!\pActually there are two--
a RED TENT and a BLUE TENT.\lWhich do you prefer?$
translation:
我不喜欢认输，
但你确实比我优秀！\p不过，你一定是被我的魅力
所吸引，才会一次又一次地\l来到这儿。一定是的！\p然而，这与我的失败
没有关系！\p作为拥有紧迫感的你和
拥有天才的头脑的我两个人之间\l友谊的证明，希望你能\l收下这件纪念品！\p其实，这里有两个--
红色帐篷和蓝色帐篷。\l你喜欢哪一个？$

label: Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_NoRoomInPC
source: What? No room in your PC?\nWhat am I to make of that?\pI wish I could say that, but I am much\ntoo kind and caring, so come back later!$
translation: 什么？你的电脑里没有空间了？\n我该怎么办？\p我是一个心地非常善良的人，\n你以后再来拿吧！$

label: Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_LeavingOnJourney
source: … … … … … …\pI am leaving on a journey of discovery.\nA quest in search of new tricks.\pI wish that you will one day visit and\nentertain me again.\pAnd now, farewell!$
translation: ...... ...... ......\p我要进行我的发现之旅了，\n为探索新的谜题而进行的旅程。\p希望将来的某一天你还会再来\n解答我的谜题。\p现在，先暂别了！$

label: Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_YouHaveEarnedThisReward
source: Fine!\nYou have earned this reward!$
translation: 好！\n这是给你的奖励！$

label: Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_NoRoomForThis
source: What? Have you no room for this?\nWhat manner of items do you carry?\pBut fine, since you've reached me,\nyour reward will be with me till later.$
translation: 什么？你没有地方放了？\n你都带了些什么样的东西啊？\p不过没关系，既然你走到这儿来了，\n我会替你保管奖品的。$

label: Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_MakeNewTricksToStumpYou
source:
Scrub that smug smirk from your face!
It's much too early to think you've won!\pI'll make new tricks to stump you, I will.
You may mock me only when you're done.\pCome back for the next exciting
installment!$
translation:
别把那种傻瓜似的笑挂在脸上！
你要胜利还早呢！\p我还要设计新的谜题挑战你，我会的！
想嘲笑我，等你通过了再说吧！\p下次再来进行
新的挑战吧！$

label: Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_YoureIgnoringMe
source: Now, now! You're ignoring me now?\nNow that, I consider heartbreaking!$
translation: 喂喂，你无视我？\n啊，我的心碎了！$

label: Route110_TrickHouseEntrance_Text_YoureBeingWatched
source: You're being watched…$
translation: 你被盯上了......$

label: Route110_TrickHouseEntrance_Text_ConcealedBeneathDesk
source: Hah? Grrr…\pHow did you know I concealed myself\nbeneath this desk? You're sharp!$
translation: 哈？咕......\p你怎么看出来我藏在\n桌子底下？眼睛真尖！$

label: Route110_TrickHouseEntrance_Text_ConcealedBehindTree
source: Hah? Grrr…\pHow did you know I concealed myself\nbehind this tree? You're sharp!$
translation: 哈？咕......\p你怎么看出来我藏在\n树后面？眼睛真尖！$

label: Route110_TrickHouseEntrance_Text_ConcealedInDresser
source: Hah? Grrr…\pHow did you know I concealed myself\nin this dresser? You're sharp!$
translation: 哈？咕......\p你怎么看出来我藏在\n柜子里面？眼睛真尖！$

label: Route110_TrickHouseEntrance_Text_ConealedBeyondWindow
source: Hah? Grrr…\pHow did you know I concealed myself\nbeyond this window? You're sharp!$
translation: 哈？咕......\p你怎么看出来我藏在\n窗户后面？眼睛真尖！$

label: Route110_TrickHouseEntrance_Text_ConcealedInPlanter
source: Hah? Grrr…\pHow did you know I concealed myself\nin this planter? You're sharp!$
translation: 哈？咕......\p你怎么看出来我藏在\n花盆里面？眼睛真尖！$

label: Route110_TrickHouseEntrance_Text_ConcealedInCupboard
source: Hah? Grrr…\pHow did you know I concealed myself\nin this cupboard? You're sharp!$
translation: 哈？咕......\p你怎么看出来我藏在\n碗柜里面？眼睛真尖！$

label: Route110_TrickHouseEntrance_Text_ConcealedBehindWindow
source: Hah? Grrr…\pHow did you know I concealed myself\nbehind this window? You're sharp!$
translation: 哈？咕......\p你怎么看出来我藏在\n窗户后面？眼睛真尖！$

label: Route110_TrickHouseEntrance_Text_ConcealedBeneathCushion
source: Hah? Grrr…\pHow did you know I concealed myself\nbeneath this cushion? You're sharp!$
translation: 哈？咕......\p你怎么看出来我藏在\n垫子下面？眼睛真尖！$

label: Route110_TrickHouseEntrance_Text_TheyCallMeTrickMaster
source: Behold!\pFor I am the greatest living mystery\nof a man in all of HOENN!\lThey call me…\pThe TRICK MASTER!\nWahahaha! Glad to meet you!$
translation: 看！\p我是丰缘地区\n最伟大的谜题之人！\l人称......\p戏法大王！\n哇哈哈哈！很高兴见到你！$

label: Route110_TrickHouseEntrance_Text_ComeToChallengeTrickHouse
source:
You, you've come to challenge
my TRICK HOUSE, haven't you?\pThat's why you're here, isn't it?
Yes, it is!\pConsider your challenge accepted!\pEnter through the scroll there,
and let your challenge commence!\pI shall be waiting in the back!$
translation:
你想挑战我的
戏法屋，对吗？\p所以你才会来这里，对吗？
当然没错！\p我接受你的挑战！\p现在就从那边的卷轴进去，
开始挑战吧！\p我会在后面等着你！$

label: Route110_TrickHouseEntrance_Text_ItsAScroll
source: It's a scroll.$
translation: 是卷轴。$

label: Route110_TrickHouseEntrance_Text_GoInHoleBehindScroll
source: There is a big hole behind the scroll!\pWant to go in?$
translation: 卷轴后面有一个大洞！\p要进去吗？$

label: Route110_TrickHouseEntrance_Text_LeavingOnJourneyNote
source: There is a note affixed to the scroll…\p“I am leaving on a journey.\nDon't look for me. TRICK MASTER”$
translation: 卷轴上贴着一张纸条......\p"外出旅行。不要来找我。\n戏法大王"$

label: Route110_TrickHouseEntrance_Text_NextTimeUseThisTrick
source: For the next time, I'll use this trick,\nand that scheme, and those ruses…\pMufufufu… If I may say so, it's\nbrilliantly difficult, even for me!$
translation: 下次，我就要这样，\n这样，再那样......\p噢呵呵呵......就算对我来说，\n困难的程度也是非常华丽的。$

label: Route110_TrickHouseEntrance_Text_InMidstOfDevisingNewChallenges
source:
Hah? What?!
Oh, it's you!\pI'm in the midst of devising new tricky
challenges!\pIt's not too much to ask for a bit more
time for me to think, is it now?\lYou wouldn't begrudge me that?\lCome back in a little while!$
translation:
哈？什么？！
啊，是你！\p我正在设计
新的谜题！\p给我些时间构思一下
不过分吧？\l你不会发牢骚的吧？\l稍后再回来吧！$

label: Route110_TrickHouseEntrance_Text_YoureHereToAcceptReward
source: Ah, it's you! You're here to accept the\nreward from before, isn't that right?\lYes, right I am!\pHere!\nI'll give it to you now!$
translation: 啊，是你！你是来拿之前的\n奖品的，对吧？\l当然，当然！\p给！\n我马上就给你！$

label: Route110_TrickHouseEntrance_Text_DidYouNotComeToClaimReward
source: Hah?\nDid you not come to claim your reward?$
translation: 啊？\n你不是来拿奖励的吗？$

label: Route110_TrickHouseEntrance_Text_MechadollWhichTent
source: MECHADOLL 5 I AM!\nIF REWARD IS NOT TAKEN BY YOU,\lTHEN TRICK MASTER YOU CANNOT FOLLOW.\pRED TENT OR BLUE TENT,\nWHICH DO YOU PREFER?$
translation: 我是机械娃娃5！\n不带走奖励，\l跟不上戏法大王的脚步。\p红帐篷和蓝帐篷，\n你更喜欢哪一个？$

label: Route110_TrickHouseEntrance_Text_ThenFarewell
source: THEN FAREWELL.$
translation: 那么，再见。$

label: Route110_TrickHouseEntrance_Text_PCFullAgain
source: YOUR PC STATUS: FULL AGAIN.\nMEAN, YOU ARE.$
translation: 电脑状态：满。\n你很麻烦。$

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle_Text_FoundAScroll
source: {PLAYER} found a scroll.$
translation: {PLAYER}发现卷轴。$

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle_Text_MemorizedSecretCode
source: {PLAYER} memorized the secret code\nwritten on the scroll.$
translation: {PLAYER}记下了\n卷轴上的字。$

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle_Text_SecretCodeWrittenOnIt
source: A secret code is written on it.$
translation: 上面写有密码。$

label: Route110_TrickHouseEntrance_Text_DoorLockedWriteSecretCodeHere
source: The door is locked.\p…On closer inspection, this is written\non it: “Write the secret code here.”$
translation: 门锁着。\p......仔细一看，上面写着：\n"在此写下密码。"$

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle1_Text_WroteSecretCodeLockOpened
source: {PLAYER} wrote down the secret code\non the door.\p“TRICK MASTER is fabulous.”\n… … … … … … … …\pThe lock clicked open!$
translation: {PLAYER}在门上写下\n密码。\p"戏法大王是传说般的人"\n...... ...... ...... ......\p锁"咔嗒"一声开了！$

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle1_Text_SallyIntro
source: I'll hack and slash my way to victory\nwith the CUT we just learned!$
translation: 我要用刚刚学会的居合劈\n砍出一条路！$

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle1_Text_SallyDefeat
source: Why are you so serious?$
translation: 你这么认真干什么？$

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle1_Text_SallyPostBattle
source: I never get tired of hacking\nand slashing!$
translation: 对砍树我永远\n不会厌烦！$

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle1_Text_EddieIntro
source: I wandered into this weird house\nby accident…$
translation: 我只是偶然地走进了\n这间奇怪的房屋......$

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle1_Text_EddieDefeat
source: And now I've lost…$

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle1_Text_EddiePostBattle
source: I lost my way, I lost a battle, and I'm\nnow even more lost… I can't get out…$
translation: 我迷路了，我输了对战，\n现在我越来越伤心......\l我出不去了......$

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle1_Text_RobinIntro
source: Just who is the TRICK MASTER?$
translation: 戏法大王究竟是谁？$

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle1_Text_RobinDefeat
source: I lost while I was lost in thought!$
translation: 在我出神的时候，我输掉了！$

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle1_Text_RobinPostBattle
source: You're strong!\nJust who are you?$
translation: 你真强！\n你究竟是谁？$

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle2_Text_WroteSecretCodeLockOpened
source: {PLAYER} wrote down the secret code\non the door.\p“TRICK MASTER is smart.”\n… … … … … … … …\pThe lock clicked open!$
translation: {PLAYER}在门上写下\n密码。\p"戏法大王十分聪颖"\n...... ...... ...... ......\p锁"咔嗒"一声开了！$

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle2_Text_TedIntro
source: Which switch closes which hole?$
translation: 哪个开关能填补哪个洞？$

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle2_Text_TedDefeat
source: After that battle, I'm even more\nconfused!$
translation: 对战之后，\n我更加迷茫了！$

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle2_Text_TedPostBattle
source: Can I get you to push all the buttons\nfor me?$
translation: 能请你帮我按下\n所有的开关吗？$

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle2_Text_PaulIntro
source: Oh! You're on your second TRICK HOUSE\nchallenge!$
translation: 啊，这是你第二次\n挑战戏法屋！$

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle2_Text_PaulDefeat
source: You're good at battling too?$
translation: 你也很擅长对战是吗？$

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle2_Text_PaulPostBattle
source: The TRICK MASTER rigged all the tricks\nin this house all by himself.$
translation: 这房子里的谜题都是\n戏法大王一个人做成的。$

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle2_Text_GeorgiaIntro
source: I want to make my own GYM one day.\nSo, I'm studying how to set traps.$
translation: 我希望有一天能开设自己的道馆，\n所以，我要学习怎样设计谜题。$

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle2_Text_GeorgiaDefeat
source: I didn't study battling enough!$
translation: 我对对战的学习还不足！$

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle2_Text_GeorgiaPostBattle
source: You're strong, aren't you?\nMaybe even enough to be a GYM LEADER!$
translation: 你真强，不是吗？\n也许你已经有道馆馆主的实力了！$

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle3_Text_WroteSecretCodeLockOpened
source: {PLAYER} wrote down the secret code\non the door.\p“TRICK MASTER is coveted.”\n… … … … … … … …\pThe lock clicked open!$
translation: {PLAYER}在门上写下\n密码。\p"戏法大王令人仰慕"\n...... ...... ...... ......\p锁"咔嗒"一声开了！$

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle3_Text_JustinIntro
source: I keep coming back to this same place!$
translation: 我总是会绕回相同的地方！$

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle3_Text_JustinDefeat
source: I'm already having trouble, and then\nyou have to beat me? It's not fair!$
translation: 我已经麻烦缠身了，现在还有你\n打败了我。这不公平！$

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle3_Text_JustinPostBattle
source: It's full of doors here!\nIt's too small and dark in here! Help!$
translation: 这儿到处都是门！\n太狭窄、太黑了！救命！$

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle3_Text_MarthaIntro
source: I don't know what's going on here.\nI'm starting to feel sad…$
translation: 我不知道这儿发生了什么，\n我开始感到伤心了......$

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle3_Text_MarthaDefeat
source: You… You're awful!$

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle3_Text_MarthaPostBattle
source: I know I'm weak!\nAnd, I have no sense of direction!$
translation: 我知道我很弱！\n而且我还没有方向感！$

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle3_Text_AlanIntro
source: I don't get it. What would anyone want\nwith a house this bizarre?$
translation: 我不明白，大家来这个\n稀奇古怪的房子究竟是为了什么？$

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle3_Text_AlanDefeat
source: I don't get it.\nHow did I lose?$
translation: 我不明白，\n我怎么会输？$

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle3_Text_AlanPostBattle
source: I don't get it.\nHow many traps are in this house?\pYou may be the one to solve that.$
translation: 我不明白，\n这间房子里究竟有多少陷阱？\p也许你能回答这个问题吧。$

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle4_Text_WroteSecretCodeLockOpened
source: {PLAYER} wrote down the secret code\non the door.\p“TRICK MASTER is cool.”\n… … … … … … … …\pThe lock clicked open!$
translation: {PLAYER}在门上写下\n密码。\p"戏法大王真棒"\n...... ...... ...... ......\p锁"咔嗒"一声开了！$

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle4_Text_CoraIntro
source: It's too much bother to think this out.\nI only wanted to battle!$
translation: 思考这些太麻烦了，\n我只想战斗而已！$

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle4_Text_CoraDefeat
source: Even though I lost, I still like battling\nthe best!$
translation: 就算会输，我还是喜欢\n挑战高手！$

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle4_Text_CoraPostBattle
source: Wouldn't you agree? You would go\nanywhere if TRAINERS were there.$
translation: 只要有训练家的地方，\n都是我的目的地。\l你也是这么想的吧？$

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle4_Text_YujiIntro
source: Heh! Boulders like this, I can brush\naside with one finger!$
translation: 哈！像这样的小石头，\n我用一根手指头就能推走！$

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle4_Text_YujiDefeat
source: I can push boulders, but I can't solve\nthe puzzle…$
translation: 我能推动这些小石头，但\n我解不开谜题......$

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle4_Text_YujiPostBattle
source: It's not good enough to be brawny…\nYou have to use your head. Be brainy!$
translation: 四肢发达并不完全是好事......\n你必须要动脑子！$

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle4_Text_PaulaIntro
source: The TRICK HOUSE is getting trickier,\nisn't it?$
translation: 戏法屋的谜题越来越难了，\n不是吗？$

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle4_Text_PaulaDefeat
source: Aaak!$
translation: 哇啊！$

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle4_Text_PaulaPostBattle
source: Has anyone made it to the end?$
translation: 有人成功走到头了吗？$

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle5_Text_WroteSecretCodeLockOpened
source: {PLAYER} wrote down the secret code\non the door.\p“TRICK MASTER is a genius.”\n… … … … … … … …\pThe lock clicked open!$
translation: {PLAYER}在门上写下\n密码。\p"戏法大王是天才"\n...... ...... ...... ......\p锁"咔嗒"一声开了！$

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle5_Text_Mechadoll1Intro
source: CLICKETY-CLACK…\nMECHADOLL 1 AM I!\pIF YOU ANSWER QUIZZES CORRECTLY,\nTHEN YOU WILL GO TO MECHADOLL 5.\lTHEN YOU CAN OBTAIN THE SECRET CODE.$
translation: 咔嗒、噼啪......\n我是机械娃娃1！\p正确回答问题，\n通过机械娃娃5，\l就能得到密码。$

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle5_Text_Mechadoll1Quiz1
source: MECHADOLL 1 QUIZ.\pOne of these POKéMON is not found\non ROUTE 110. Which one is it?$
translation: 机械娃娃1问答。\p下列宝可梦中哪一个不能\n在110号道路找到？$

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle5_Text_Mechadoll1Quiz2
source: MECHADOLL 1 QUIZ.\pOne of these POKéMON is not of the\nWATER type. Which one is it?$
translation: 机械娃娃1问答。\p下列宝可梦中哪一个不是\n水属性？$

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle5_Text_Mechadoll1Quiz3
source: MECHADOLL 1 QUIZ.\pOne of these POKéMON does not use\nLEECH LIFE. Which one is it?$
translation: 机械娃娃1问答。\p下列宝可梦中哪一个不能\n使用吸血？$

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle5_Text_CorrectGoThrough
source: CONGRATULATIONS. CORRECT YOU ARE.\nGO THROUGH. PLEASE.$
translation: 恭喜你，回答正确。\n请继续前进。$

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle5_Text_DisappointmentError
source: BZZZT. DISAPPOINTMENT.\nERROR.$
translation: 滋滋，很遗憾，\n错误。$

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle5_Text_Wahahahaha
source: WAHAHAHAHA! WAHAHAHAHA!\nCLICKETY-CLACK!$
translation: 哇哈哈哈哈！哇哈哈哈哈！\n咔嗒、噼啪！$

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle5_Text_WaitForNextChallenge
source: YOUR NEXT CHALLENGE WE WAIT FOR.$
translation: 我们等你再次挑战。$

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle5_Text_Mechadoll2Intro
source: CLICKETY-CLACK…\nMECHADOLL 2 AM I!\pMECHADOLL 1'S QUIZ DIFFICULTY LEVEL\nIS SET TOO LOW.$
translation: 咔嗒、噼啪......\n我是机械娃娃2！\p机械娃娃1的问答\n难度等级太低了。$

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle5_Text_Mechadoll2Quiz1
source: MECHADOLL 2 QUIZ.\pWhich of these POKéMON did WALLY\nborrow from your father?$
translation: 机械娃娃2问答。\p满充从你的父亲那里\n借来的是哪只宝可梦？$

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle5_Text_Mechadoll2Quiz2
source: MECHADOLL 2 QUIZ.\pWhich of these POKéMON was chasing\nPROF. BIRCH?$
translation: 机械娃娃2问答。\p追逐小田卷博士的\n是哪只宝可梦？$

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle5_Text_Mechadoll2Quiz3
source: MECHADOLL 2 QUIZ.\pWhich of these POKéMON did TEAM AQUA\nuse in PETALBURG FOREST?$
translation: 机械娃娃2问答。\p海洋队在橙华市森林\n里用的是哪只宝可梦？$

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle5_Text_Mechadoll3Intro
source: CLICKETY-CLACK…\nMECHADOLL 3 AM I!\pMATTERS OF MONEY ARE MY SOLE FOCUS.$
translation: 咔嗒、噼啪......\n我是机械娃娃3！\p我关心的只有价格。$

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle5_Text_Mechadoll3Quiz1
source: MECHADOLL 3 QUIZ.\pWhich costs more?\nThree HARBOR MAILS or one BURN HEAL?$
translation: 机械娃娃3问答。\p买3个港湾邮件或买1个灼伤药\n哪样花钱更多？$

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle5_Text_Mechadoll3Quiz2
source: MECHADOLL 3 QUIZ.\pSell one GREAT BALL and buy\none POTION. How much money remains?$
translation: 机械娃娃3问答。\p卖出1个超级球并买入\n1个伤药，还剩多少钱？$

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle5_Text_Mechadoll3Quiz3
source: MECHADOLL 3 QUIZ.\pDo one REPEL and SODA POP cost\nmore than one SUPER POTION?$
translation: 机械娃娃3问答。\p买1个除虫喷雾和1个劲爽汽水\n花的钱比1个厉害伤药多吗？$

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle5_Text_Mechadoll4Intro
source: CLICKETY-CLACK…\nMECHADOLL 4 THAT IS ME!\pMY QUIZ IS AN OBJECT OF BEAUTY.$
translation: 咔嗒、噼啪......\n机械娃娃4就是我！\p我的问答是关于人的。$

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle5_Text_Mechadoll4Quiz1
source: MECHADOLL 4 QUIZ.\pIn SEASHORE HOUSE, were there more men\nor women?$
translation: 机械娃娃4问答。\p大海之家里，\n男人多还是女人多？$

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle5_Text_Mechadoll4Quiz2
source: MECHADOLL 4 QUIZ.\pIn LAVARIDGE TOWN, were there more\nelderly men or elderly women?$
translation: 机械娃娃4问答。\p釜炎镇里，\n老爷爷多还是老奶奶多？$

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle5_Text_Mechadoll4Quiz3
source: MECHADOLL 4 QUIZ.\pIn the TRAINER'S SCHOOL, how many\ngirl students were there?$
translation: 机械娃娃4问答。\p训练家学校里，\n女生有多少个？$

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle5_Text_Mechadoll5Intro
source: CLICKETY-CLACK…\nMECHADOLL 5 AM I!\pTHE MASTER'S BEST AND PROUDEST\nACHIEVEMENT AM I.$
translation: 咔嗒、噼啪......\n我是机械娃娃5！\p主人最得意的作品\n就是我。$

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle5_Text_Mechadoll5Quiz1
source: MECHADOLL 5 QUIZ.\pIn SLATEPORT's POKéMON FAN CLUB,\nhow many POKéMON were there?$
translation: 机械娃娃5问答。\p在凯那市的宝可梦发烧友俱乐部里，\n一共有多少只宝可梦？$

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle5_Text_Mechadoll5Quiz2
source: MECHADOLL 5 QUIZ.\pIn FORTREE CITY, how many\ntree houses were there?$
translation: 机械娃娃5问答。\p茵郁市里一共有\n多少间树屋？$

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle5_Text_Mechadoll5Quiz3
source: MECHADOLL 5 QUIZ.\pOn the CYCLING ROAD, how many\nTRIATHLETES were there?$
translation: 机械娃娃5问答。\p在自行车道上\n一共有多少铁人三项选手？$

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle6_Text_WroteSecretCodeLockOpened
source: {PLAYER} wrote down the secret code\non the door.\p“TRICK MASTER is my life.”\n… … … … … … … …\pThe lock clicked open!$
translation: {PLAYER}在门上写下\n密码。\p"戏法大王是我的生命"\n...... ...... ...... ......\p锁"咔嗒"一声开了！$

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle6_Text_SophiaIntro
source: When I heard there was a strange\nhouse, I had to check it out.$
translation: 我听说这儿有间奇怪的房子，\n所以我就来了。$

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle6_Text_SophiaDefeat
source: I've discovered a tough TRAINER!$
translation: 我发现了一个强大的训练家！$

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle6_Text_SophiaPostBattle
source: I'm sure having a good time checking\nthis place out.\pIt's a challenge I've found worth\nrepeating!$
translation: 调查这个地方\n令我非常快乐。\p这是值得一遍遍地\n挑战的地方！$

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle6_Text_BennyIntro
source: Maybe I could get my BIRD POKéMON\nto fly over the wall…$
translation: 也许我能让我的鸟类宝可梦\n飞过这些墙去......$

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle6_Text_BennyDefeat
source: Gwaaah! I blew it!$
translation: 唔哇啊啊！计划告吹！$

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle6_Text_BennyPostBattle
source: Ehehehe… I guess I lost because\nI was trying to cheat.$
translation: 哦呵呵呵......我想我试图\n作弊才会输的。$

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle6_Text_SebastianIntro
source: I'm getting dizzy from these rotating\ndoors…$
translation: 我快要被这些\n旋转门弄晕了......$

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle6_Text_SebastianDefeat
source: Everything's spinning around and\naround. I can't take this anymore…$
translation: 周围的一切都在转啊转啊......\n我再也受不了了......$

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle6_Text_SebastianPostBattle
source: You don't seem to be affected at all.\nOr do you have your poker face on?$
translation: 你好像没受影响啊，还是说你\n只是摆出一副面无表情的样子？$

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_WroteSecretCodeLockOpened
source: {PLAYER} wrote down the secret code\non the door.\p“TRICK MASTER is huggable.”\n… … … … … … … …\pThe lock clicked open!$
translation: {PLAYER}在门上写下\n密码。\p"我想拥抱戏法大王"\n...... ...... ...... ......\p锁"咔嗒"一声开了！$

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_JoshuaIntro
source: The TRICK MASTER always vanishes\nlike smoke. How does he do it?$
translation: 戏法大王总是像一阵烟\n似的消失了，他怎么做到的？$

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_JoshuaDefeat
source: Aiyeeeh! You're much too strong!\nHow do you do it?$
translation: 啊呀！你真是太强了！\n你怎么做到的？$

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_JoshuaPostBattle
source: I wish I could appear and disappear as\nif I were smoke, too.$
translation: 我也想要像一阵烟一样\n消失或者出现。$

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_PatriciaIntro
source: Going around the same spot…\nIt begets ill fortune…$
translation: 总是在同样的地方转来转去......\n这会招致厄运的......$

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_PatriciaDefeat
source: Defeated!\nIt's a bad sign…$
translation: 败了！\n不祥的预兆......$

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_PatriciaPostBattle
source: I've circled the same spot over ten\ntimes now… It's ill fortune…$
translation: 我已经在同一个地方转了\n十多次了......真不幸......$

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_AlexisIntro
source: Whoever wins will get through here\nfirst. That's the feeling I get.$
translation: 胜利的人就会先离开这儿，\n我有这样的预感。$

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_AlexisDefeat
source: Oh!\nWell, go ahead, then!$
translation: 哦！\n好，那么，你先走吧！$

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_AlexisPostBattle
source: You're solving all the puzzles in the\nTRICK HOUSE. That's the feeling I get.$
translation: 你会解开戏法屋所有的谜题，\n我有这样的预感。$

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_MarielaIntro
source: Nufufufu, here at last!\nLet's get right with it!$
translation: 哼哼哼哼，终于来了！\n我们这就开始吧！$

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_MarielaDefeat
source: You're so casual about winning!$
translation: 你只是碰巧赢了而已！$

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_MarielaPostBattle
source: Humph! I'm not upset!\nNot me!$
translation: 哼！我一点也没有遗憾\n一点也不！$

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_AlvaroIntro
source: I ever so closely watched you coming!$
translation: 我一直看着你走了过来！$

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_AlvaroDefeat
source: This outcome I didn't see coming…$
translation: 我没有预见到这样的结果......$

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_AlvaroPostBattle
source: Well, anyway, we both picked a weird\nplace to get acquainted.\pAs one weirdo to another,\nlet's do our best!$
translation: 啊，不管怎样，\n我们在命运之地相识了。\p虽然对对方来说我们都是怪人，\n我们也都要努力啊！$

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_EverettIntro
source: It's awfully cramped in here…$
translation: 被困在这儿真讨厌......$

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_EverettDefeat
source: Oh, yes, strong you are.$
translation: 啊，你真强。$

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_EverettPostBattle
source: I was hoping to switch places with you\nwhen I beat you, but…$
translation: 我本来打算打败你之后\n和你交换位置，结果......$

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle8_Text_WroteSecretCodeLockOpened
source: {PLAYER} wrote down the secret code\non the door.\p“TRICK MASTER I love.”\n… … … … … … … …\pThe lock clicked open!$
translation: {PLAYER}在门上写下\n密码。\p"我爱戏法大王"\n...... ...... ...... ......\p锁"咔嗒"一声开了！$

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle8_Text_VincentIntro
source: Not many TRAINERS have made it\nthis far.$
translation: 没有多少训练家 \n能到达这里。$

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle8_Text_VincentDefeat
source: That must mean you're tough, too…$
translation: 这就意味着你也非常强大......$

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle8_Text_VincentPostBattle
source: You've beaten the POKéMON LEAGUE\nCHAMPION? That's too much!$
translation: 你已经打败了宝可梦联盟冠军？\n太厉害了！$

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle8_Text_KeiraIntro
source: Consider yourself lucky to be\nbattling me!$
translation: 跟我对战，\n你应该感到非常幸运！$

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle8_Text_KeiraDefeat
source: This isn't right!\nI can't lose!$
translation: 这不可能！\n我怎么会输！$

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle8_Text_KeiraPostBattle
source: It's a miracle that you beat me.\nYou can brag about it.$
translation: 你能打败我真是奇迹，\n你可以引以为傲了。$

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle8_Text_LeroyIntro
source: You've been slugging through the TRICK\nHOUSE challenge, too.$
translation: 你也在艰难地挑战这\n戏法屋啊。$

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle8_Text_LeroyDefeat
source: I see…\nYou possess an extraordinary style.$
translation: 明白了......\n你的行事风格很特别。$

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle8_Text_LeroyPostBattle
source: Seeing someone like you should please\nthe TRICK MASTER.$
translation: 见到你这样的人\n戏法大王应该会很高兴吧。$

label: Route111_Text_BattleOurFamily
source: Hello! I take it you're a traveler.\pHow's this? What do you say to taking\non our family of four in a series of\lPOKéMON battles?$
translation: 嗨！我想你是个旅行者吧？\p怎么样？跟我们家\n4个人来几场\l宝可梦对战吧？$

label: Route111_Text_IsThatSo
source: Is that so?\nDrop in, if you change your mind!$
translation: 是吗？\n你改变主意的话再来吧！$

label: Route111_Text_VictorIntro
source: That's the spirit! I like you!$
translation: 就是这样！我喜欢这种精神！$

label: Route111_Text_VictorDefeat
source: Aiyah!\nYou're a lot tougher than I expected!$
translation: 哎呀！\n你比我想象中强多了！$

label: Route111_Text_VictorPostBattle
source: Hey, all!\nI've found a pretty strong TRAINER!$
translation: 喂，大家出来！\n我碰到了个很强的训练家！$

label: Route111_Text_VictoriaIntro
source: Oh, my goodness! Aren't you young?\pYou must be quite the TRAINER to beat\nmy husband, though.\pIt's my turn to battle now!$
translation: 哦，天啊，这么年轻！\p你就是那个打败了我丈夫的\n训练家吧，\p轮到我跟你对战了！$

label: Route111_Text_VictoriaDefeat
source: Oh, gosh!\nI can't get over how strong you are!$
translation: 啊呀！\n你太厉害了！$

label: Route111_Text_VictoriaPostBattle
source: There's a strong TRAINER here!\nThis one's really strong!$
translation: 这儿有个很强的训练家！\n真的很强！$

label: Route111_Text_ViviIntro
source: You're stronger than Mommy? Wow!\pBut I'm strong, too!\nReally! Honestly!$
translation: 你比我妈妈都厉害吗？哇！\p但我也不差！\n真的！$

label: Route111_Text_ViviDefeat
source: Huh? Did I just lose?$
translation: 哎？我刚刚输了吗？$

label: Route111_Text_ViviPostBattle
source: This stinks…\p…Snivel… Grandma!$

label: Route111_Text_VickyIntro
source: How dare you make my granddaughter\ncry!\pFor that, I'm going to smack you!\nPrepare to lose!$
translation: 是你把我孙女\n惹哭了的吗？\p那么，我要打倒你！\n做好输的准备吧！$

label: Route111_Text_VickyDefeat
source: Kwah! You are strong…\nMy granddaughter was right…$
translation: 咕哇！你太厉害了......\n我孙女是对的......$

label: Route111_Text_VickyPostBattle
source: If you're not in any hurry,\nvisit with us awhile.$
translation: 如果你不是很忙，\n就进来坐会儿吧。$

label: Route111_Text_ToughToKeepWinningUpTheRanks
source: If you don't raise your POKéMON some\nmore, it could be tough to keep winning\lup through the ranks.\pI've heard the POKéMON LEAGUE's\nELITE FOUR are far stronger than\lany GYM LEADER.$
translation: 如果你不继续训练宝可梦，\n在水平越来越高的对战中\l将会难以持续获胜下去。\p我听说宝可梦联盟的\n四天王的实力\l比道馆馆主强多了。$

label: Route111_Text_WinstrateFamilyDestroyedMe
source: I challenged the WINSTRATE family,\nbut four matches in a row is tough\lgoing… They destroyed me.$
translation: 我挑战过连胜家族，\n但一连4场的对战太困难了......\l他们打败了我。$

label: Route111_Text_RouteSignMauville
source: ROUTE 111\n{DOWN_ARROW} MAUVILLE CITY$
translation: 111号道路\n{DOWN_ARROW}紫堇市$

label: Route111_Text_WinstrateHouseSign
source: “Our family's hearts beat as one!”\nTHE WINSTRATE'S HOUSE$
translation: "我们是齐心的一家！"\n连胜家族$

label: Route111_Text_RouteSign112
source: ROUTE 111\n{LEFT_ARROW} ROUTE 112$
translation: 111号道路\n{LEFT_ARROW}112号道路$

label: Route111_Text_RouteSign113
source: ROUTE 111\n{LEFT_ARROW} ROUTE 113$
translation: 111号道路\n{LEFT_ARROW}113号道路$

label: Route111_Text_OldLadysRestStopSign
source: OLD LADY'S REST STOP\n“Come in and rest your tired bones.”$
translation: 简康奶奶的家\n"欢迎进来歇脚。"$

label: Route111_Text_TrainerTipsSpAtkSpDef
source: TRAINER TIPS\pOne of the indicators of a POKéMON's\npowerfulness is SP. ATK. It stands for\l“SPECIAL ATTACK.”\pLikewise, SP. DEF stands for “SPECIAL\nDEFENSE.”$
translation: 有用的公告牌！\p表示宝可梦的数值之一是特攻，\n全称"特殊招式攻击力。"\p相似地，还有特防，\n全称"特殊招式防御力"。$

label: Route111_Text_ShouldBeMirageTowerAroundHere
source: There should be a tower made of sand\naround here somewhere.\pBut for some reason, it can be seen\nsometimes, and sometimes not.\pThat's why I call it the MIRAGE TOWER.$
translation: 这附近什么地方\n有座沙形成的塔，\p但由于某种原因，\n它却时隐时现。\p因此我叫它幻影之塔。$

label: Route111_Text_MirageTowerClearlyVisible
source:
I see it!
The tower of sand!\pThe sand tower they called a mirage
is clearly visible!\pBut it looks so fragile…
It could crumble away anytime…\pI want to go inside it, but I can't
get my courage up for it…$
translation:
我看到了！
沙形成的塔！\p那座以幻影冠名的沙塔
清清楚楚地现身了！\p但它看上去好像一推就倒......
也许随时会倒下......\p我想进里面去，
但我总提不起勇气......$

label: Route111_Text_ThatWasShockingSandRainedDown
source:
Whoa…
That was shocking.\pSand rained down in chunks all of
a sudden.\pWhat was it like inside?
Were there sandy ghosts and such?$
translation:
哇......
太惊人了，\p沙子突然哗啦啦地
都散落下来。\p里面怎么了？
有沙鬼什么的吗？$

label: Route111_Text_MirageTowerHasntBeenSeenSince
source: Since I spoke to you, the tower of sand\nhasn't been seen.\pPerhaps it really was\nthe MIRAGE TOWER…$
translation: 我跟你说话的时候，\n那座沙塔已经不见了。\p也许那真的是座\n幻想的塔......$

label: Route111_Text_ClawFossilDisappeared
source: The CLAW FOSSIL disappeared into\nthe sand…$
translation: 爪子化石沉进了\n沙里......$

label: Route111_Text_RootFossilDisappeared
source: The ROOT FOSSIL disappeared into\nthe sand…$
translation: 根状化石沉进了\n沙里......$

label: Route111_Text_MauvilleUncleToldMeToTakeRockSmash
source: Oh, no!\pMy uncle in MAUVILLE told me to take\nROCK SMASH with me if I was going to\lROUTE 111!\pMy uncle? He lives across from\nthe bike shop in MAUVILLE.$
translation: 呀，糟糕！\p叔叔在紫堇市嘱咐过我\n去111号道路要带上碎岩！\p我叔叔在哪？\n他就住在紫堇市的车店对面。$

label: Route111_Text_TrainerHillSign
source: {RIGHT_ARROW} TRAINER HILL ENTRANCE\p“Scale the heights, you hot-blooded\nTRAINERS!”$
translation: {RIGHT_ARROW}训练家之丘入口\p"努力向上攀登吧，\n充满热血的训练家！"$

label: Route111_OldLadysRestStop_Text_RestUpHere
source: Oh, dear, dear.\nAren't your POKéMON exhausted?\pIf you'd like, rest up here.\nThat's a fine idea! You should do that.$
translation: 喔，亲爱的。\n你的宝可梦太疲劳了吗？\p如果你需要，过来休息下吧。\n这是个好主意！你应该那么做。$

label: Route111_OldLadysRestStop_Text_TakeYourTimeRestUp
source: That's right.\nTake your time and rest up!$
translation: 对了。\n不要急，稍事休息吧！$

label: Route111_OldLadysRestStop_Text_StillTiredTakeAnotherRest
source: Oh, dear, dear.\nAre your POKéMON still tired?\pYou should take another rest here.\nThat's a fine idea. You should do that.$
translation: 喔，亲爱的。\n你的宝可梦还很累？\p那么在这里再休息下吧。\n这是个好主意！你应该那么做。$

label: Route111_OldLadysRestStop_Text_DontNeedToBeShy
source: Is that so?\nYou don't need to be shy about it.$
translation: 足够了？\n不要害羞哟。$

label: Route111_WinstrateFamilysHouse_Text_MySonIsStrongerThanYou
source:
You're the first TRAINER I've seen who
deploys POKéMON so masterfully.\pBut, I should tell you--my son is
stronger than you.\pHe even took the POKéMON LEAGUE
challenge, I'll have you know.$
translation:
你是我所见过的训练家中
指挥宝可梦最纯熟的。\p但是，我要告诉你--我的儿子
比你还要厉害。\p他甚至成为了宝可梦联盟
挑战者，你知道吗。$

label: Route111_WinstrateFamilysHouse_Text_LikeYouToHaveMachoBrace
source: We use this MACHO BRACE to more\neffectively strengthen our POKéMON\lin training.\pSince you've beaten all of us here,\nI don't know if you need it, but we\lwould like you to have our MACHO BRACE.$
translation: 我们使用强制锻炼器\n有效提高宝可梦\l的力量。\p你战胜了我们所有人，\n我不知道你是否需要这个\l请收下我们给你的强制锻炼器。$

label: Route111_WinstrateFamilysHouse_Text_PassionateAboutBattles
source: When it comes to POKéMON battles,\nwe tend to be pretty passionate.$
translation: 当进行宝可梦对战时，\n我们变得很激情。$

label: Route111_WinstrateFamilysHouse_Text_StrongerFamilyMembers
source: Mommy is stronger than Daddy.\pI'm stronger than Mommy.\pAnd Grandma's stronger than me!\pBut my big brother is even stronger\nthan Grandma.$
translation: 妈妈比爸爸厉害。\p我比妈妈厉害。\p奶奶比我厉害！\p但是我的哥哥\n比奶奶还要厉害哟。$

label: Route111_WinstrateFamilysHouse_Text_GrandsonStrong
source:
There's no question that you're strong.\pBut if you were to battle my grandson,
you'd end up crying in frustration.\pHe's much stronger than any TRAINER
our family knows.\pHe must be challenging the POKéMON
LEAGUE CHAMPION by now.\pKnowing my grandson, he could be the
CHAMPION already!$
translation:
显然你很厉害。\p但是如果你和我的孙子对战
你一定会输到哭泣的。\p他比我们所知道的训练家
都要厉害。\p他现在一定在挑战
联盟冠军吧。\p你会认识我的孙子的，
他应该已经是冠军了！$

label: Route111_WinstrateFamilysHouse_Text_GrandsonStrongShort
source: My grandson must be challenging the\nPOKéMON LEAGUE CHAMPION by now.\pKnowing my grandson, he could be the\nCHAMPION already!$
translation: 我的孙子现在一定\n在挑战联盟冠军。\p你会认识我的孙子的，\n他应该已经是冠军了！$

label: Route112_Text_LeaderGoingToAwakenThing
source: Hey, man, is our leader really going\nto awaken that thing?$
translation: 喂，我们老大真的\n打算唤醒那东西？$

label: Route112_Text_YeahWeNeedMeteorite
source: Sounds like it, yeah. But I heard\nwe need a METEORITE to do it.$
translation: 嗯，听上去是这样，\n但据说我们还需要一块陨石。$

label: Route112_Text_OhThatsWhyCrewWentToFallarbor
source: Oh, I get it now. That's why the rest\nof the crew went out to FALLARBOR.$
translation: 哦，我明白了，\n所以大家才会去秋叶镇。$

label: Route112_Text_CantLetAnyonePassUntilTheyreBack
source: You got it. And until they come back,\nwe're not to let anyone pass, right.$
translation: 说得没错。而且在他们回来前，\n我们不能让任何人通过这里。$

label: Route112_Text_NotEasyToGetBackToLavaridge
source: Eh, I'd like to get to MAUVILLE, but if\nI went down these ledges, it'd be no\leasy matter to get back to LAVARIDGE.$
translation: 呃，我想去紫堇市，\n但如果我从这些岩脊上走下去，\l再回到釜炎镇就没那么容易了。$

label: Route112_Text_MtChimneySign
source: MT. CHIMNEY\p“For LAVARIDGE TOWN or the summit,\nplease take the CABLE CAR.”$
translation: 烟囱山\p"去釜炎镇或山顶，\n请乘坐缆车。"$

label: Route112_Text_RouteSignLavaridge
source: ROUTE 112\n{LEFT_ARROW} LAVARIDGE TOWN$
translation: 112号道路\n{LEFT_ARROW}釜炎镇$

label: Route112_CableCarStation_Text_CableCarReadyGetOn
source: The CABLE CAR is ready to go up.\nWould you like to be on it?$
translation: 登山缆车即将发车。\n您要乘坐吗？$

label: Route112_CableCarStation_Text_StepThisWay
source: 这边请。$
translation: 这边请。$

label: Route112_CableCarStation_Text_RideAnotherTime
source: Please ride with us another time.$
translation: 欢迎再次乘坐。$

label: Route113_Text_AshCanBeFashionedIntoGlass
source: Wahahaha! Today's technology is a\nwondrous thing!\pTake this volcanic ash here.\nIt can be fashioned into glass.$
translation: 哇哈哈哈！现今的技术\n真是神奇！\p收集这里的火山灰，\n可以做成玻璃。$

label: Route113_Text_FunWalkingThroughAsh
source: It's fun walking through the volcano's\nashes on the ground and grass.\pYou can see where you walked--it's\nreally neat!$
translation: 在布满火山灰的\n草丛里走真好玩，\p回头看看走过的地方--\n哇，都干干净净了！$

label: Route113_Text_RouteSign111
source: ROUTE 113\n{RIGHT_ARROW} ROUTE 111$
translation: 113号道路\n{RIGHT_ARROW}111号道路$

label: Route113_Text_RouteSignFallarbor
source: ROUTE 113\n{LEFT_ARROW} FALLARBOR TOWN$
translation: 113号道路\n{LEFT_ARROW}秋叶镇$

label: Route113_Text_TrainerTipsRegisterKeyItems
source: TRAINER TIPS\pYou may register one of the KEY ITEMS\nin your BAG as SELECT.\pSimply press SELECT to use\nthe registered item conveniently.$
translation: 有用的公告牌！\p可以将包包中的某个重要物品\n登录到SELECT键上，\p按下SELECT键就可以\n方便地使用登录的物品了。$

label: Route113_Text_GlassWorkshopSign
source: GLASS WORKSHOP\n“Turning Volcanic Ash into Glass Items”$
translation: 琉璃工坊\n"将火山灰变成玻璃"$

label: Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_GoCollectAshWithThis
source: This area is covered in volcanic ash,\nhuff-puff!\pI'm specially gifted, huff-puff.\pI make glass out of volcanic ash\nand make items, huff-puff.\pGo collect ashes with this, huff-puff.$
translation:
这里到处是火山灰，
呼呼！\p我有个特别的才能，
呼呼，\p我能用火山灰
制作玻璃，呼呼。\p用这个去收集火山灰吧，呼呼。$

label: Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_ExplainSootSack
source:
Just take that SOOT SACK and walk
through piles of ash, huff-puff.\pAnd it will fill up with the volcanic ash,
huff-puff.\pOnce you think you've collected a good
amount, come see me, huff-puff.$
translation:
只要带上这个集灰袋在
满是火山灰的地方走，呼呼，\p它就会将火山灰收集起来，
呼呼。\p当你觉得收集了不少火山灰之后，
就回来找我吧，呼呼。$

label: Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_LetsSeeCollectedAshes
source: Have you collected ashes, huff-puff?\nLet me see, huff-puff.$
translation: 火山灰收集得怎么样了，呼呼？\n我看看，呼呼。$

label: Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_NotEnoughAshNeedX
source: Hmmm…\nThere's not enough ash here, huff-puff.\lI can't make glass with this, huff-puff.\pLet's see… {STR_VAR_1} is the number of steps\nyou'll need to walk for me to make you\la BLUE FLUTE, huff-puff.$
translation: 唔......\n不是很多啊，呼呼。\l这一点不够制造玻璃哨的，呼呼。\p嗯......再走{STR_VAR_1}步\n我就可以制造\l蓝色玻璃哨了，呼呼。$

label: Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_WhichGlassItemWoudYouLike
source: Oh!\nYou've got a lot of ashes, huff-puff!\pI'll make you a glass item, huff-puff!\nWhich one would you like, huff-puff?$
translation: 哦！\n你收集了不少火山灰了，呼呼！\p我这就给你制造玻璃，呼呼。\n你想要什么样的，呼呼？$

label: Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_IsThatTheItemForYou
source: A {STR_VAR_1}, huff-puff?\nIs that the one for you, huff-puff?$
translation: {STR_VAR_1}是吗？呼呼。\n你确定吗？呼呼。$

label: Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_WhichWouldYouLike
source: Which one would you like, huff-puff?$
translation: 你想要什么样的，呼呼？$

label: Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_IllMakeItemForYou
source: A {STR_VAR_1} it is, then, huff-puff!\pOkay! I'll make it for you, huff-puff.\nJust wait a little while, huff-puff.$
translation: 那么，是{STR_VAR_1}了，呼呼！\p好，我这就开始，呼呼。\n稍等一下就好了，呼呼。$

label: Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_NotEnoughAshToMakeItem
source:
A {STR_VAR_1}, huff-puff?\pThere's not enough ash here to make
that, though, huff-puff.\pLet's see… {STR_VAR_2} is the number of steps
you'll need to walk through volcanic ash\lfor me to make that item, huff-puff.\pWhich item would you rather have me
make instead, huff-puff?$
translation:
是{STR_VAR_1}吗？呼呼。\p做它的话，火山灰不够啊，
呼呼。\p我看看......要做这个还要再走{STR_VAR_2}步
才能收集到足够的火山灰，\l呼呼。\p那么，你还希望我
为你做什么？呼呼。$

label: Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_AllThatAshButDontWantAnything
source: You've collected all that ash, but you\ndon't want anything, huff-puff?$
translation: 收集了那么多火山灰，但\n你没有想要的东西吗？呼呼。$

label: Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_IveFinishedGlassItem
source: Ah, I've finished your {STR_VAR_1}.\nTake it, huff-puff.$
translation: 啊，你的{STR_VAR_1}做好了。\n拿去吧，呼呼。$

label: Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_NoRoomInBag
source: Oh?\nYou've no room in your BAG, huff-puff.\pI'll hold on to it, so come back later,\nhuff-puff.$
translation: 哦？\n你的包包里面没有地方了，呼呼。\p我先替你保管着，以后再来吧，\n呼呼。$

label: Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_NoRoomInPC
source: Oh?\nYou've no room in your PC, huff-puff?\pI'll hold on to it, so come back later,\nhuff-puff.$
translation: 哦？\n你的电脑里面没有地方了，呼呼。\p我先替你保管着，以后再来吧，\n呼呼。$

label: Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_HaventGotYourSootSack
source: Hah? You haven't got your SOOT SACK\nwith you, huff-puff.\pYou have to keep it with you to collect\nvolcanic ash, huff-puff.$
translation: 哎？你没带你的集灰袋啊，\n呼呼。\p要收集火山灰就一定\n要带上它，呼呼。$

label: Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_FunToBlowGlassFlute
source: It's fun to blow a glass flute while\nmy boss is talking.\pHuff-huff! Puff-puff!$
translation: 在老板说话的时候\n吹玻璃真好玩，\p呼呼！呼呼！$

label: Route114_Text_AllMyMonDoesIsRoarTakeThis
source: All my POKéMON does is ROAR…\nNo one dares to come near me…\pSigh… If you would, please take\nthis TM away…$
translation: 我的宝可梦总是吼叫......\n没什么敢接近我......\p唉......喜欢的话，\n就把这招式学习器拿走吧......$

label: Route114_Text_ExplainRoar
source: TM05 contains ROAR.\nA ROAR sends POKéMON scurrying.$
translation: 招式学习器05的内容是吼叫。\n用吼叫可以吓跑宝可梦。$

label: Route114_Text_Poochyena
source: Bow! Bowwow!$
translation: 吼！哦吼吼！$

label: Route114_Text_MeteorFallsSign
source: METEOR FALLS\nRUSTBORO CITY THROUGH HERE$
translation: 流星瀑布\n通往卡那兹市$

label: Route114_Text_FossilManiacsHouseSign
source: FOSSIL MANIAC'S HOUSE\n“Fossils gratefully accepted!”$
translation: 化石迷的家\n"欢迎带化石来！"$

label: Route114_Text_LanettesHouse
source: LANETTE'S HOUSE$
translation: 真由美的家$

label: Route114_FossilManiacsHouse_Text_HaveThisToDigLikeMyBrother
source:
My big brother's the FOSSIL MANIAC…
He's a nice guy who loves FOSSILS…\pHe loves digging holes, too…
He dug this hole by himself…\pYou can have this, so you can DIG
holes just like my big brother…$
translation:
我哥哥是化石迷......
他是喜欢化石的好人......\p他也喜欢挖洞......
这个洞是他自己挖的......\p给你这个，你也可以挖洞
就像我哥哥一样......$

label: Route114_FossilManiacsHouse_Text_DigReturnsYouToEntrance
source: If you make a POKéMON DIG inside a\ncave, you're returned to the entrance…$
translation: 如果让你的宝可梦在山洞里挖洞\n你就会回到洞的入口......$

label: Route114_FossilManiacsHouse_Text_RocksFillDisplayCase
source: Rocks in peculiar shapes fill\nthe display case…$
translation: 不同形状的石头\n在这里展示......$

label: Route114_FossilManiacsHouse_Text_CrammedWithBooks
source: THE COMPOSITION OF STRATA…\nHOW RAIN SHAPES THE LAND…\lSTONES, SOIL, AND ROCK…\pIt's crammed with books.$
translation: 地层的组成......\n雨后大陆的形状......石头，\l土壤，还有岩石是怎样的......\p这些全塞满了书。$

label: Route114_FossilManiacsTunnel_Text_LookInDesertForFossils
source:
I'm the FOSSIL MANIAC…
I'm a nice guy who loves FOSSILS…\pDo you want a FOSSIL?\pBut the FOSSILS around these parts all
belong to me… None for you…\pIf you can't bear to go without
a FOSSIL, look in a desert where there\lare boulders and sand that may hide\lFOSSILS…$
translation:
我是化石迷......
我是喜欢化石的好人......\p你想要化石？\p但是这里所有的化石
全部属于我......不能给你......\p如果你也需要化石
去沙漠里找找吧\l那里到处是沙砾\l也许会藏着化石......$

label: Route114_FossilManiacsTunnel_Text_DevonCorpRevivingFossils
source:
You found a FOSSIL, didn't you?
That's so nice… It's so dreamy…\pWhat are you going to do with that
FOSSIL?\pFrom what I've heard, DEVON is doing
research on reviving POKéMON from\lFOSSILS…\pI love my FOSSILS, so I would never
do anything like that…$
translation:
难道说你找到了化石？
太好了......不会是做梦吧......\p你想对那个化石
做什么？\p我听说，得文正在做研究
把宝可梦从\l化石中复活......\p我喜欢我的化石，
因此我不喜欢那样做......$

label: Route114_FossilManiacsTunnel_Text_FossilsAreWonderful
source: FOSSILS are so… Wonderful…\nIt's so dreamy…$
translation: 化石是那么的......迷人......\n它是那么完美......$

label: Route114_FossilManiacsTunnel_Text_NotSafeThatWay
source:
Oh…
It's not safe that way…\pI was digging away, you see…
When the whole wall collapsed…\pI think there's a giant cavern
underneath now…\pBut I've left it alone because I don't
think there are any FOSSILS there…$
translation:
哦......
那条路不安全......\p你看到了，当所有墙壁倒塌时......
我正要挖洞离开......\p我认为现在下面
有一个巨大的洞......\p但是我要走了
因为我认为那里没有化石......$

label: Route114_LanettesHouse_Text_EverythingClutteredKeepThis
source: LANETTE: Oh! {PLAYER}{KUN}!\pI'm sorry everything is so cluttered…\nWhen I get engrossed in research,\lthings end up this way…\pThis is embarrassing… Please keep\nthis a secret in exchange for this.$
translation: 真由美：哦！{PLAYER}{KUN}！\p对不起这里太乱了......\n当我全神贯注于研究时\l东西就会这样了......\p这很难为情......请帮我保守秘密\n作为交换给你这个。$

label: Route114_LanettesHouse_Text_OrganizeYourBoxes
source: May I offer advice about my POKéMON\nStorage System?\pYou should organize your BOXES so you\ncan tell which POKéMON are in them.$
translation: 关于宝可梦寄放系统\n给你一些建议吧\p你只需要整理下盒子\n就可以分辨出宝可梦存在哪。$

label: Route114_LanettesHouse_Text_ResearchNotesPage1
source: It's LANETTE's research notes.\nThere's information about BOXES.\pDesign BOXES to hold 30 POKéMON each.\pEach TRAINER should be able to store\n420 POKéMON on the PC system.\pKeep reading?$
translation: 真由美的研究注释。\n关于盒子的信息。\p每个盒子可以保管30只宝可梦。\p每个训练家可以在电脑\n系统里保管420只宝可梦。\p继续阅读吗？$

label: Route114_LanettesHouse_Text_ResearchNotesPage2
source: A marking system should be added to\nmake POKéMON easier to organize.\pThe name and wallpaper design of each\nBOX will be made changeable to please\lthe stored POKéMON.\pKeep reading?$
translation: 标记系统是为了用来\n使宝可梦更容易被管理。\p每个盒子的壁纸和名字\n都是用来使被保管的\l宝可梦更开心。\p继续阅读吗？$

label: Route114_LanettesHouse_Text_ResearchNotesPage3
source:
When storing a POKéMON, it should be
sent to the BOX inspected last.\pIf that BOX is full, the received
POKéMON is stored in the next BOX.\pIn other words, when a BOX is examined,
it is automatically selected as the BOX\lto which POKéMON are sent.$
translation:
当存放宝可梦时，它会被送往
你最后所使用的盒子里。\p如果那个盒子满了的话
宝可梦就会被送到下一个盒子。\p也就是说，检查盒子后
系统会自动选择存放\l宝可梦的盒子。$

label: Route114_LanettesHouse_Text_ClosedTheNotebook
source: {PLAYER} closed the notebook.$
translation: {PLAYER}合上了笔记本。$

label: Route114_LanettesHouse_Text_EmailFromBill
source:
There's an e-mail from someone on
the PC.\p“… … … … … … …\p“Your Storage System offers more
convenience than mine.\p“It has a lot of user-friendly features
that make it fun and useful, too.\p“It makes me proud that I played
a part in its development.\p“Here's hoping that you'll continue
research in Storage Systems.\p“From BILL
… … … … … … … …”$
translation:
通过电脑收到了
某人发来的信件。\p"...... ...... ...... ......\p"你的寄放系统比我的
更加方便。\p"而且它也有许多容易掌握的因素
使得更有用有趣。\p"在它的发展中我起到了作用
我感到很骄傲。\p"希望你会继续做出
寄放系统方面的研究。\p"来自正辉
...... ...... ...... ......"$

label: Route115_Text_NeverKnowWhenCavePokemonWillAppear
source: Exploring a cave isn't like walking\non a road.\pYou never know when wild POKéMON will\nappear. It's full of suspense.$
translation: 探索山洞不同于\n在大路上走，\p根本不知道什么时候会有\n野生宝可梦跳出来，\l所以总是提心吊胆。$

label: Route115_Text_RouteSignRustboro
source: ROUTE 115\n{DOWN_ARROW} RUSTBORO CITY$
translation: 115号道路\n{DOWN_ARROW}卡那兹市$

label: Route115_Text_MeteorFallsSign
source: METEOR FALLS\nFALLARBOR TOWN THROUGH HERE$
translation: 流星瀑布\n穿过这里到达秋叶镇$

label: Route116_Text_ScoundrelMadeOffWithPeeko
source: Ohhh, what am I to do?\pWe were on our walk, PEEKO and I, when\nwe were jumped by an odd thug…\pThe scoundrel made off with my\ndarling PEEKO!\pWrrrooooooaaaar! PEEKO!$
translation: 啊啊啊，我该怎么办？\p我和小皮散步的时候\n被一个奇怪的强盗袭击了......\p那混蛋抢走了\n我亲爱的小皮！\p哇啊啊啊啊啊啊！小皮！$

label: Route116_Text_WantToDigTunnel
source: Nnn… Roar!\pI want to dig that tunnel!$
translation: 呜......吼！\p我一定要挖通那条隧道！$

label: Route116_Text_DiggingTunnelWhenGoonOrderedMeOut
source:
Nnn… Roar!
What's going on?\pI was digging the tunnel without any
tools when some goon ordered me out!\pThat tunnel's filled with POKéMON
that react badly to loud noises.\lThey could cause an uproar.\pThat's why we stopped using heavy
equipment for tunneling…\pI'm worried that the goon will do
something stupid and startle the\lPOKéMON into an uproar.$
translation:
呜......吼！
发生什么事了？\p我正徒手挖隧道呢，
突然有个混混把我赶出来了！\p那隧道里的宝可梦
对噪音特别敏感，\l可能会引发骚乱。\p所以我们才停用了重型机械......\p就怕那混混干蠢事，
惊动宝可梦们暴动。$

label: Route116_Text_GoonHightailedItOutOfTunnel
source: Nnn… Roar!\pThat goofy goon hightailed it out of\nthe tunnel! I can go back to digging!$
translation: 呜......吼！\p那混混慌慌张张\n逃出隧道了！\l我又能继续挖啦！$

label: Route116_Text_ThankYouTokenOfAppreciation
source:
Oh! It's you!\pYou're that person who not only helped
me in PETALBURG WOODS, but also got\lback my stolen package and then even\lgraciously delivered it to SLATEPORT!\pCAPT. STERN informed us that the
package arrived, too!\pI thank you very, very much!\pWhy, if I were a rain cloud, I would
shower you with gratitude and hail\lyou as a hero!\pFor you, the most wonderful TRAINER,
I bear good news!\pRecently, our company developed
a new kind of POKé BALL.\pAs a token of our appreciation, this
is our gift to our wonderful TRAINER!$
translation:
啊，是你！\p你就是那个在
橙华森林里帮过我，\l又替我追回了被偷的包裹，\l然后好心地把它送到凯那市去的人！\p楠木馆长告诉我们
包裹已经平安到达了！\p非常非常感谢！\p在下对您的感谢如同滔滔江水连绵不绝
又如黄河泛滥一发不可收拾......\l大英雄啊！\p我给你这最优秀的训练家
带来了个好消息！\p最近我们公司开发出
一种新的精灵球，\p我们把它送给你，就当作我们对一个
杰出的训练家的感谢！$

label: Route116_Text_NewBallAvailableAtMart
source: Our new POKé BALL will be available\nat the POKéMON MART in RUSTBORO.\pPlease do try it out!\nThank you and bye-bye!$
translation: 我们的新精灵球很快\n会在卡那兹市的友好商店出售。\p到时一定要试试！\n谢谢，再见！$

label: Route116_Text_BagIsJamPacked
source: Your BAG is jam-packed.\nI can't give you this REPEAT BALL.$
translation: 你的包包满了，\n装不下这重复球。$

label: Route116_Text_TokenOfAppreciation
source: As a token of our appreciation for\nyour delivering our package, I have\la gift of a new kind of POKé BALL\lfor our most wonderful TRAINER!$
translation: 我把这种新的精灵球\n送给你，我们最优秀的训练家，\l就当作是我们对你\l为我们送包裹的谢礼！$

label: Route116_Text_CanYouHelpMeFindGlasses
source: I dropped my glasses…\nCan you help me find them?$
translation: 我的眼镜丢了......\n能帮我找找吗？$

label: Route116_Text_MayISeeThoseGlasses
source: Those glasses!\nMay I see them for a second?$
translation: 啊，那副眼镜！\n可以给我看看吗？$

label: Route116_Text_NotWhatImLookingForMaybeTheyArentHere
source: Hmm…\nThese are BLACKGLASSES.\lThey're not what I'm looking for…\pMaybe my glasses aren't around\nhere…$
translation: 唔......\n这是一副黑色眼镜，\l不是我要找的......\p也许我的眼镜\n不在这附近......$

label: Route116_Text_CantFindGlassesNotHere
source: Hmm…\nI can't find my glasses anywhere…\lMaybe they're not around here…$
translation: 唔......\n到处都找不到我的眼镜......\l也许并不在这附近......$

label: Route116_Text_NotWhatImLookingFor
source: Hmm…\nThese are BLACKGLASSES.\lThey're not what I'm looking for…$
translation: 唔......\n这是一副黑色眼镜，\l不是我要找的......$

label: Route116_Text_RouteSignRustboro
source: ROUTE 116\n{LEFT_ARROW} RUSTBORO CITY$
translation: 116号道路\n{LEFT_ARROW}卡那兹市$

label: Route116_Text_RusturfTunnelSign
source: RUSTURF TUNNEL\n“Linking RUSTBORO and VERDANTURF\p“The tunnel project has been\ncanceled.”$
translation: 卡绿隧道\n"连接卡那兹市和绿茵镇的隧道\p隧道工程现已\n终止施工"$

label: Route116_Text_TunnelersRestHouse
source: TUNNELER'S REST HOUSE$
translation: 隧道工人休息屋$

label: Route116_Text_TrainerTipsBToStopEvolution
source: TRAINER TIPS\pIf you want to stop a POKéMON from\nevolving, press the B Button while it\lis trying to evolve.\lThe startled POKéMON will stop.\pThis is called an evolution cancel.$
translation: 有用的公告牌！\p如果你不希望宝可梦进化，\n则应在它试图进化时\l按下B键，\l受惊的宝可梦会停止进化。\p这叫做进化取消。$

label: Route116_Text_TrainerTipsBagHasPockets
source: TRAINER TIPS\pYour BAG has several POCKETS.\pItems you obtain are automatically\nplaced in the appropriate POCKETS.\pNo TRAINER can afford to be without\na BAG of their own.$
translation:
有用的公告牌！\p包包由数个
口袋组成，\p得到的道具会
自动放入合适的口袋中。\p每个训练家都应
有一个自己的包包。$

label: Route116_TunnelersRestHouse_Text_WeHadToStopBoring
source:
That RUSTURF TUNNEL there…\pAt first, we had a huge work crew boring
through rock with the latest machinery.\lBut, we had to stop.\pIt turns out that we would have had
a negative effect on wild POKéMON in\lthe area.\pSo, we've got nothing to do but loll
around here doing nothing.$
translation:
那边的卡绿隧道啊......\p起初我们动用大型机械组织了
庞大的施工队开凿岩层。\l但后来不得不停工了。\p因为发现这样会严重影响到
野生宝可梦的栖息环境。\p所以现在我们只能
无所事事地闲逛了。$

label: Route116_TunnelersRestHouse_Text_ManDiggingHisWayToVerdanturf
source: There's a man digging his way to\nVERDANTURF all by his lonesome.\lHe's desperate to get through.\pHe says that if he digs little by little\nwithout using machines, he won't\ldisturb POKéMON, and he'll avoid\lharming the natural environment.\pI wonder if he made it through yet.$
translation: 有个男人正独自向\n绿茵镇方向挖掘。\l他急着想打通隧道。\p说是只要不用机械慢慢挖\n就不会惊扰宝可梦\l也能保护自然环境。\p不知道他现在挖通了没有？$

label: Route116_TunnelersRestHouse_Text_GetToVerdanturfWithoutTunnel
source: To get to VERDANTURF without using\nthis TUNNEL, you'd have to cross the\lsea to DEWFORD, sail on to SLATEPORT,\lthen travel through MAUVILLE.$
translation: 要绕开隧道去绿茵镇的话，\n得先渡海到武斗镇，\l再坐船到凯那市，\l最后穿过紫堇市才行。$

label: Route116_TunnelersRestHouse_Text_TunnelHasGoneThrough
source: Did you hear? The TUNNEL to VERDANTURF\nhas gone through!\pSometimes, if you hope strongly enough,\ndreams do come true.$
translation: 听到了吗？到绿茵镇的隧道\n已经打通了！\p看来只要怀抱足够强烈的愿望，\n梦想就真的能实现呢。$

label: Route117_Text_DayCarePokemonHadNewMove
source: I left my POKéMON at the DAY CARE.\pWhen I got it back, it had a new move\nthat I didn't teach it.\lI was really, really surprised.$
translation: 我把宝可梦寄存\n在培育屋里，\p但当我取回它时，它学会了一个\n我从未教过的招式。\l真的，我非常吃惊。$

label: Route117_Text_ArentTheseFlowersPretty
source: What do you think?\nAren't these flowers pretty?\pI planted them all!$
translation: 你怎么想？\n这些花很漂亮吧？\p都是我种的！$

label: Route117_Text_AirIsTastyHere
source: The air is tasty here!$
translation: 这的空气中有一股清香！$

label: Route117_Text_RouteSignVerdanturf
source: ROUTE 117\n{LEFT_ARROW} VERDANTURF TOWN$
translation: 117号道路\n{LEFT_ARROW}绿茵镇$

label: Route117_Text_RouteSignMauville
source: ROUTE 117\n{RIGHT_ARROW} MAUVILLE CITY$
translation: 117号道路\n{RIGHT_ARROW}紫堇市$

label: Route117_Text_DayCareSign
source: POKéMON DAY CARE\n“Let us raise your POKéMON.”$
translation: 培育屋\n"替你抚养宝可梦。"$

label: Route118_Text_StevenQuestions
source:
STEVEN: Hi, {PLAYER}{KUN}!\pIt's me, STEVEN!
We met in the cave near DEWFORD.\pHave you met many kinds of POKéMON
since I last saw you?\pThere are many, many kinds of POKéMON
in this wide world of ours.\pIf you wanted to raise only your
favorites, that's fine.\pPerhaps you find it more fun to raise
all sorts of POKéMON.\pAs a TRAINER of POKéMON,
what do you think?\pOf course, it's not any of my business.\pIt would be nice if we were to meet
again somewhere.$
translation:
大吾：嗨，{PLAYER}{KUN}！\p是我，大吾！
我们在武斗镇的洞窟里见过。\p这段时间你又遇到了
多少宝可梦呢？\p在这广阔的世界中
栖息着多种多样的宝可梦，\p专注于培养自己喜欢的
几种也不错，\p不过尝试培养各种不同的
宝可梦也许会更有趣呢。\p作为训练家，
你是怎么想的呢？\p当然，
这只是我的一己之见。\p希望我们还能再见。$

label: Route118_Text_YouAgreeGoodRodIsGood
source: Hmm!\nA GOOD ROD is really good!\pWouldn't you agree?$
translation: 嗯！\n好钓竿非常好用！\p你也这么想吧？$

label: Route118_Text_IdenticalMindsTakeThis
source: Hmm!\nWe're of identical minds!\pHmm!\nTake this GOOD ROD!$
translation: 嗯！\n我们想法一样！\p嗯！\n这个好钓竿给你！$

label: Route118_Text_TryYourLuckFishing
source: Wherever there's water, try your luck\nat fishing.$
translation: 有水的地方\n就可以钓鱼。$

label: Route118_Text_DontYouLikeToFish
source: Don't you like to fish?$
translation: 你喜欢钓鱼吗？$

label: Route118_Text_TryCatchingMonWithGoodRod
source: Try catching all sorts of POKéMON\nwith your GOOD ROD.$
translation: 努力用好钓竿钓到\n所有的宝可梦吧。$

label: Route118_Text_CanCrossRiversWithSurf
source: Even if there isn't a boat, you can\ncross rivers and the sea if you have\la POKéMON that knows SURF.\pPOKéMON can be counted on to do so\nmuch!$
translation: 就算没有船，\n也可以用学会了\l冲浪的宝可梦渡海。\p你可以依靠宝可梦\n做很多事情！$

label: Route118_Text_RouteSignMauville
source: ROUTE 118\n{LEFT_ARROW} MAUVILLE CITY$
translation: 118号道路\n{LEFT_ARROW}紫堇市$

label: Route118_Text_RouteSign119
source: ROUTE 118\n{UP_ARROW} ROUTE 119$
translation: 118号道路\n{UP_ARROW}119号道路$

label: Route119_Text_MayIntro
source:
MAY: {PLAYER}{KUN}!
Where were you? I was looking for you!\pHow much stronger have you gotten?
Let me check for you!\pReady with your POKéMON?
Of course you are! Go!$
translation:
小遥：{PLAYER}{KUN}！
你去哪儿了？我找你很久了！\p让我来看看你
变强了多少！\p准备好宝可梦了吗？
你肯定没问题的，接招吧！$

label: Route119_Text_MayDefeat
source: Achah!\n{PLAYER}{KUN}, you're strong!\pI was worried that you might be\nstruggling with your training.$
translation: 呜哇！\n{PLAYER}{KUN}变得好强！\p我之前还担心你会不会\n训练得不够呢。$

label: Route119_Text_MayPresentForYou
source: MAY: But I had absolutely nothing to\nworry about! Keep it up!\pAnd, here! I have a present for you.$
translation: 小遥：看来完全不用担心嘛！\n保持这个势头吧！\p来！\n这个送给你。$

label: Route119_Text_MayExplainFly
source:
MAY: Use FLY, and your POKéMON will
instantly carry you to any town you've\lalready visited.\pBut, to use FLY, you have to get
the GYM BADGE from FORTREE CITY.\lThat's important, so don't forget.\pYou should FLY home and visit
LITTLEROOT for a change.\pI bet your mom's worried about you,
{PLAYER}{KUN}.\pWell, let's meet again somewhere!$
translation:
小遥：使用飞翔的话，
宝可梦会瞬间带你飞回\l曾经去过的城镇，\p但必须先拿到茵郁市的
道馆徽章才能够使用，\l这很重要，不要忘了哦！\p偶尔也该飞回未白镇
回家里看看，\p你妈妈会担心你的，
{PLAYER}{KUN}。\p好了，下次再见！$

label: Route119_Text_BrendanIntro
source:
BRENDAN: {PLAYER}! So this is where
you've been looking for POKéMON?\pLet me see how good you got.
I'll test you!\pNow!
It's a battle, so battle!$
translation:
小悠：{PLAYER}！
来这里找宝可梦吗？\p让我检验下你的实力
成长得如何了！\p那么！
来对战吧！$

label: Route119_Text_BrendanDefeat
source: Hmm…\nYou've gotten pretty darn decent.$
translation: 唔......\n你进步得真快啊。$

label: Route119_Text_BrendanIllGiveYouThis
source: BRENDAN: I'd say you're good enough\nto search for POKéMON anywhere.\pHere, I'll give you this.\nTry it out.$
translation: 小悠：我想你无论去哪儿\n找宝可梦都没问题。\p这个给你，\n试试吧。$

label: Route119_Text_BrendanExplainFly
source: BRENDAN: Use FLY, and your POKéMON\ninstantly carries you to any town\lyou've already visited.\pBut you need the FORTREE GYM BADGE \nto do that.\pAnyway, I have to move along.$
translation:
小悠：使用飞翔的话，
宝可梦会瞬间带你飞回\l曾经去过的城镇，\p但必须先拿到茵郁市的
道馆徽章才能用。\p好了，
我先走一步啦！$

label: Route119_Text_ScottWayToGoBeSeeingYou
source:
SCOTT: Hahahah!
Way to go, {PLAYER}{KUN}!\pI just passed by a TRAINER riding
a BIKE.\pYou just beat that TRAINER, didn't you?
It was pretty obvious that you did.\pThe kid looked really upset with
a face all red from anger.\pI sure seem to run into you often.
Are you off to FORTREE GYM next?\pI expect that you'll do well at the GYM.
Well, I'll be seeing you!$
translation:
亚希达：哈哈哈哈！
干得漂亮，{PLAYER}{KUN}！\p我刚刚遇到了个
骑着自行车的训练家。\p你刚刚打败了那个训练家对吧？
不用想都知道是你。\p那孩子气得脸红红的，
好像很不甘心。\p我们看起来很有缘呢。
你现在要去茵郁市道馆是吗？\p相信你一定会表现出色。
好了，回头见！$

label: Route119_Text_ScottYouWonAtFortreeGym
source:
… … … … … …
… … … … … Beep!\pSCOTT: Hiya, {PLAYER}{KUN}, it's me!\pJust as I thought, you won at
the FORTREE GYM.\pYour strength…
Perhaps you really are the TRAINER\lthat I've been searching for.\pRemember, you have a fan in me.
I'll be cheering from the sidelines.\lKeep up the great work!\p… … … … … …
… … … … … Click!$
translation:
...... ...... ......
...... ...... ......哔！\p亚希达：嗨，{PLAYER}{KUN}，是我！\p你果然如我所料，
赢下了茵郁市道馆。\p你的实力......
或许正是我一直在找的训练家。\p记住我是你的头号粉丝，
我会一直默默为你加油的。\l继续加油！\p...... ...... ......
...... ...... ......咔哒！$

label: Route119_Text_StayAwayFromWeatherInstitute
source: We're standing lookout here.\pHey, you! Stay away from the WEATHER\nINSTITUTE. It's not safe.$
translation: 我们在这里放哨。\p喂，你！别接近天气研究所，\n那儿不安全。$

label: Route119_Text_DontGoNearWeatherInstitute
source: Lookout duty is surprisingly boring.\pHey, you! Please don't go near the\nWEATHER INSTITUTE.$
translation: 放哨的任务实在太无聊了。\p喂，你！\n别跑到天气研究所附近去。$

label: Route119_Text_ThoughtFlyByCatchingBirdMons
source:
I thought you FLY by catching a whole
flock of BIRD POKéMON, and then\lhanging on to them somehow.\pBut it turns out there's an HM move
called FLY!\pI wish I'd known about that a long
time ago…$
translation:
我本以为所谓飞翔是指
捉一大群鸟宝可梦，\l然后想办法挂在它们身上。\p但实际上飞翔是
一种秘传招式！\p我要是早点知道
就好了......$

label: Route119_Text_TallGrassSnaresBikeTires
source: Tch…\nIt's a no-go…\pThe tall grass snares BIKE tires.\nThere's no way you can cycle here.$
translation: 切......\n过不去......\p长草会卷进自行车的轮胎里，\n不可能骑车过去。$

label: Route119_Text_CanYourMonMakeSecretBase
source: Can your POKéMON use its SECRET POWER\non a big pile of grass and make a\lSECRET BASE?$
translation: 你的宝可梦能用秘密之力\n在一大团草中打出一个\l秘密基地吗？$

label: Route119_Text_RouteSignFortree
source: ROUTE 119\n{RIGHT_ARROW} FORTREE CITY$
translation: 119号道路\n{RIGHT_ARROW} 茵郁市$

label: Route119_Text_WeatherInstitute
source: WEATHER INSTITUTE$
translation: 天气研究所$

label: Route119_Text_TrainerTipsDecoration
source: TRAINER TIPS\pUp to sixteen decorations and\nfurniture items can be placed in\la SECRET BASE.\pPick your favorite items and create\nyour very own SECRET BASE exactly the\lway you want.$
translation: 有用的公告牌！\p秘密基地里面\n最多只能放16个\l装饰物品和家具。\p用你最喜欢的\n物品装扮出你自己的\l秘密基地吧。$

label: Route119_House_Text_RumorAboutCaveOfOrigin
source: I heard about a cave called the CAVE\nOF ORIGIN.\pPeople rumor that the spirits of\nPOKéMON are revived there. Could\lsomething like that really happen?$
translation: 我听说有一个洞窟叫做\n觉醒神殿，\p传说宝可梦的灵魂会\n在那里复生。这样的事情\l真的有可能发生吗？$

label: Route119_House_Text_Wingull
source: WINGULL: Pihyoh!$
translation: 长翅鸥：欧雷！$

label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_1F_Text_Grunt1Intro
source: The BOSS got interested in\nthe research they have going here,\lso he sent us out.\pYou quit meddling!$
translation: 老大对这儿的研究很感兴趣，\n所以派我们来这里。\p你别来碍事！$

label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_1F_Text_Grunt1Defeat
source: Blast it…\nBlasted by a kid…$

label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_1F_Text_Grunt1PostBattle
source: Our BOSS knows everything.\pBut I'm just a GRUNT. What would I know\nabout what he's thinking?$
translation: 老大无所不知。\p但我只是个小人物，\n又怎么能猜到他的想法？$

label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_1F_Text_Grunt4Intro
source: Huh?\nWhat's a kid doing here?$
translation: 嗯？\n这儿怎么有个小孩子？$

label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_1F_Text_Grunt4Defeat
source: Huh?\nI lost?!$
translation: 嗯？\n我输了？！$

label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_1F_Text_Grunt4PostBattle
source: Oh, no…\nI'll catch an earful for losing to a kid…\pI should just take a nap in the bed…$
translation: 哦，不......\n输给个小鬼，我又得被唠叨了......\p还是躲床上打盹吧......$

label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_1F_Text_EveryoneWentUpstairs
source: While I was sleeping, everyone went\nupstairs!$
translation: 我睡觉的时候\n大家都上楼去了！$

label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_1F_Text_WowYoureStrong
source: Wow, you're really strong!\pI wish I could be a POKéMON TRAINER\nlike you!$
translation: 哇，你真强！\p真想成为和你一样的\n宝可梦训练家！$

label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_1F_Text_ProfStudyingRain
source:
The PROFESSOR loves rain.
That's a fact.\pBut if it keeps raining, people will be in
trouble. That's another fact.\pAnd thus, the PROFESSOR is studying
if the rain can be put to good use.$
translation:
教授沉迷于降雨研究，
这是事实。\p但如果雨一直不停，就会给人们
带来麻烦，这也是事实。\p因此，教授在研究
如何让雨造福于人。$

label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_1F_Text_NoticingAbnormalWeather
source: On the 2nd floor of the INSTITUTE,\nwe study the weather patterns over\lthe HOENN region.\pWe've been noticing temporary and\nisolated cases of droughts and\lheavy rain lately…$
translation: 我们在研究所二楼研究丰缘地区的\n天气变化情况。\p我们发现近期频繁出现局部突发性干旱\n与强降雨的异常现象......$

label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_1F_Text_WhatWereAquasUpTo
source: Hello!\nWe've been saved by your actions!\pWhat I don't understand is what on\nearth the AQUAS were up to.$
translation: 嗨！\n谢谢你救了我们！\p但我真的想不通海洋队\n到底在打什么主意。$

label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_1F_Text_TakeRestInBed
source: There's a bed…\nLet's take a rest.$
translation: 有张床......\n休息一下吧。$

label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_Grunt2Intro
source: The INSTITUTE created a type of\nPOKéMON that has something to do with\lthe weather. We're here to take them!$
translation: 研究所制造出了一种\n与天气有关的宝可梦，\l我们要来带走它们！$

label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_Grunt2Defeat
source: Our plan's being spoiled by a kid?$
translation: 难道我们的计划被一个孩子打破了？$

label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_Grunt2PostBattle
source: If the POKéMON they made here can\ncontrol the weather freely, then we of\lTEAM AQUA definitely need it!$
translation: 如果这里制造出的宝可梦\n真能自由控制天气，\l那我们海洋队肯定需要它！$

label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_Grunt3Intro
source: We're TEAM AQUA!\nWe appear wherever anything rare is\lfound!$
translation: 我们是海洋队！\n哪里有稀有的东西，\l哪里就有我们！$

label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_Grunt3Defeat
source: You got me!$
translation: 我认输！$

label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_Grunt3PostBattle
source: You don't have any idea what we of\nTEAM AQUA are working towards!\lYou stay out of our way!$
translation: 你根本不了解我们\n海洋队的理想！\l少来碍事！$

label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_Grunt5Intro
source: Don't tell me you're looking for that\nweather POKéMON, too?\pThat's a no-no!\nWe were here to get it first!$
translation: 别告诉我你也想\n要那只天气宝可梦，\p想都别想！\n是我们先盯上的！$

label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_Grunt5Defeat
source: Oh, will you look at my POKéMON?$
translation: 唉......看看我的宝可梦？$

label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_Grunt5PostBattle
source: Humph, so what?\nWhat we want…\pWhat we really want isn't here…\nIhihihihi…$
translation: 哼，那又怎么样？\n我们想要的......\p我们真正想要的并不在这里......\n咿嘻嘻嘻嘻......$

label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_ShellyIntro
source:
Ahahahaha!\pYou're going to meddle in TEAM AQUA's
affairs?\pYou're either absolutely fearless,
simply ignorant, or both!\pYou're so cute, you're disgusting!
I'll put you down, kiddy!$
translation:
啊哈哈哈哈！\p竟敢插手我们
海洋队的行动吗？\p你是无畏，还是无知，
或是两者兼有呢？\p太可爱了，太可恶了！
我这就打倒你，小家伙！$

label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_ShellyDefeat
source: Ahahahaha!\nYou're disgustingly strong!$
translation: 啊哈哈哈哈！\n你强得让人反胃！$

label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_ShellyPostBattle
source: It's bad enough to have TEAM MAGMA\nblunder about, but now there's you!\pWhat makes you want to sniff around\nin our business, anyway?$
translation: 有熔岩队在周围瞎捣乱就够烦了，\n现在又多了个你！\p你到底为什么非要\n追着我们不放？$

label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_TeamMagmaJustPassedBy
source: We have a situation here!\pA TEAM MAGMA mob just passed\nthe WEATHER INSTITUTE.\pThey appear to be headed for\nMT. PYRE!$
translation: 紧急情况！\p有一批熔岩队的家伙刚刚\n经过天气研究所，\p他们好像是朝着\n送神山去了！$

label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_WeHaveToHurryToMtPyre
source: What?!\pWe can't waste any more time here!\nWe have to hurry to MT. PYRE, too!\pAhahahaha!\nTEAM MAGMA, just you wait!$
translation: 什么？！\p我们不能再在这里浪费时间了！\n我们也得赶紧去送神山了！\p啊哈哈哈哈！\n熔岩队，你们给我等着！$

label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_ThanksPleaseTakePokemon
source: Thanks!\nThanks to you, we're safe!\pIt might be an odd way of thanking you,\nbut take this POKéMON.$
translation: 谢谢！\n多亏你救了我们！\p也许作为谢礼有点特别，\n不过，收下这只宝可梦吧。$

label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_NoRoomForPokemon
source: Hm? You don't seem to have any room\nfor this POKéMON.$
translation: 嗯？你没有放下这只\n宝可梦的空间。$

label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_PlayerReceivedCastform
source: {PLAYER} received CASTFORM!$
translation: {PLAYER}得到了漂浮泡泡！$

label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_PokemonChangesWithWeather
source: That POKéMON changes shape according\nto the weather conditions.\pThere're plenty of them in the\nINSTITUTE--go ahead and take it.$
translation: 这种宝可梦能根据\n天气状况改变形态。\p研究所里面还有不少，\n这只就给你了。$

label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_ChangingWeatherRidiculous
source: I've been researching rain for many\nyears, but it's ridiculous to think that\lhumans can freely change the weather.$
translation: 我研究降雨数十年，\n但如果说想要随心操控天气，\n简直荒谬至极！$

label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_GroudonWeather
source:
I track weather patterns over
the HOENN region.\pPresently, a drought has been recorded
in {STR_VAR_1}.\pCould that mean, somewhere near
{STR_VAR_1}…$
translation:
我在追踪监测丰缘地区的
气候状况，\p最近，我们发现{STR_VAR_1}地区
持续异常干旱，\p难道说，
在{STR_VAR_1}附近......$

label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_KyogreWeather
source:
I track weather patterns over
the HOENN region.\pPresently, heavy rainfall has been
recorded over {STR_VAR_1}.\pCould that mean, somewhere near
{STR_VAR_1}…$
translation:
我在追踪监测丰缘地区的
气候状况，\p最近，我们发现{STR_VAR_1}地区
正遭遇特大暴雨，\p难道说，
在{STR_VAR_1}附近......$

label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_NoAbnormalWeather
source: Abnormal weather conditions are\nno longer being reported.\pThe occasional rainfall is a blessing,\nreally.$
translation: 最近没再收到异常的\n气候报告了。\p偶然下一场雨才算是\n自然的恩惠吧。$

label: Route11_EastEntrance_1F_Text_ManInLavenderRatesNames
source:
Don't you think it's hard to think
up good names for POKéMON?\pEspecially if you've caught a
whole bunch?\pIn LAVENDER TOWN, there's a man
who rates POKéMON nicknames.\pHe can even help you rename your
POKéMON, too.$
translation:
难道你不认为
给宝可梦取一个好名字很难吗？\p尤其是当你
已经有了一个队伍的时候。\p在紫苑镇 有一个
给宝可梦取名字的男人。\p他甚至也可以帮你
给宝可梦重新起名。$

label: Route11_EastEntrance_1F_Text_RockTunnelToReachLavender
source: If you're aiming to reach LAVENDER\nTOWN, take ROCK TUNNEL.\pYou can get to ROCK TUNNEL from\nCERULEAN CITY.$
translation: 如果你想去紫苑\n镇 就穿过岩山隧道吧。\p你可以从华蓝市到达\n岩山隧道。$

label: Route11_EastEntrance_2F_Text_GiveItemfinderIfCaught30
source:
Hi! Remember me?
I'm one of PROF. OAK's AIDES.\pIf your POKéDEX has complete data
on {STR_VAR_1} species, I'm supposed to\lgive you a reward.\pPROF. OAK entrusted me with the
{STR_VAR_2} for you.\pSo, {PLAYER}, let me ask you.\pHave you gathered data on at least
{STR_VAR_1} kinds of POKéMON?$
translation:
嗨！还记得我吗？
我是大木博士的助手之一。\p如果你的宝可梦图鉴已经收集了
{STR_VAR_1}个宝可梦的数据， 我就会\l给你一个奖励。\p大木博士委托我把
{STR_VAR_2}给你。\p那么{PLAYER}让我问问你。\p你已经得到了至少
{STR_VAR_1}种宝可梦了吗？$

label: Route11_EastEntrance_2F_Text_GreatHereYouGo
source: Great! You have caught or owned\n{STR_VAR_3} kinds of POKéMON!\pCongratulations!\nHere you go!$
translation: 太棒了！你已经收集了\n{STR_VAR_3}种宝可梦了！\p恭喜！\n这是奖励，拿去吧！$

label: Route11_EastEntrance_2F_Text_ReceivedItemfinderFromAide
source: {PLAYER} received the {STR_VAR_2}\nfrom the AIDE.$
translation: {PLAYER}从助手那儿\n得到了{STR_VAR_2}。$

label: Route11_EastEntrance_2F_Text_ExplainItemfinder
source:
There are items on the ground that
may be hidden from view.\pUse the ITEMFINDER to detect any
hidden items close to you.\pThe machine is a bit limited.
It can't pinpoint item locations.\pWhat it does is show the direction
where the item is.\pUse it to get your bearings, then
search the suspect area by hand.$
translation:
地面上有
隐藏的道具。\p就用寻宝机器来找出
在你周围的隐藏道具吧。\p由于这个机器机能有限，
所以它不能直接探明道具的位置。\p它所做的
只有指向道具所在的方向。\p找准方向之后，
侦察一下你认为可疑的地方。$

label: Route11_EastEntrance_2F_Text_BigMonAsleepOnRoad
source: Let's see what the binoculars have\nto show…\pA big POKéMON is asleep on a road!$
translation: 一架望远镜......\n我来看看......\p啊，一只体形巨大的宝可梦\n正在路上睡觉！$

label: Route11_EastEntrance_2F_Text_WhatABreathtakingView
source: Let's see what the binoculars have\nto show…\pWhat a breathtaking view!$
translation: 一架望远镜......\n我来看看......\p哇哦，多么壮观的美景！$

label: Route11_EastEntrance_2F_Text_RockTunnelGoodRouteToLavender
source:
Let's see what the binoculars have
to show…\pTo get to LAVENDER TOWN from
