CERULEAN CITY…\pROCK TUNNEL appears to be a good
route to take.$
translation:
一架望远镜......
我来看看......\p从华蓝市
再到紫苑镇...\p岩山隧道也许是一个
不错的路线。$

label: Route11_Text_HugoIntro
source: Win, lose, or draw!$
translation: 要么胜，要么败，否则就是平手！$

label: Route11_Text_HugoDefeat
source: Atcha!\nDidn't go my way!$
translation: 喂！\n别挡了我的路！$

label: Route11_Text_HugoPostBattle
source: POKéMON is life!\nAnd to live is to play games!$
translation: 宝可梦就是生命！\n生命在于竞技！$

label: Route11_Text_JasperIntro
source: Competition!\nI can't get enough!$
translation: 竞技！\n这一点还满足不了我！$

label: Route11_Text_JasperDefeat
source: I had a chance!$
translation: 我还有的是机会！$

label: Route11_Text_JasperPostBattle
source: You can't be a coward in the world\nof POKéMON!$
translation: 在宝可梦的世界里\n你不能做胆小鬼！$

label: Route11_Text_EddieIntro
source: Let's go, but don't cheat!$
translation: 来吧！但不许耍赖！$

label: Route11_Text_EddieDefeat
source: Huh?\nThat's not right!$
translation: 嗯？\n这不科学！$

label: Route11_Text_EddiePostBattle
source: I did my best.\nI have no regrets.$
translation: 我尽力了。\n我不遗憾。$

label: Route11_Text_BraxtonIntro
source: Careful!\nI'm laying down some cables!$
translation: 当心点！\n我正在接电线呢！$

label: Route11_Text_BraxtonDefeat
source: That was electric!$
translation: 电线可是导电的！$

label: Route11_Text_BraxtonPostBattle
source: Spread the word to save energy!$
translation: 覆盖整个世界运输能源！$

label: Route11_Text_DillonIntro
source: I just became a TRAINER.\nBut, I think I can win.$
translation: 虽然我成为训练家没多久。\n但是，这一战我坚信我能赢。$

label: Route11_Text_DillonDefeat
source: My POKéMON couldn't win…\nHaven't they grown enough?$
translation: 我的宝可梦还战胜不了你......\n它们还没成长到那个水平吗？$

label: Route11_Text_DillonPostBattle
source: What now?\nLeave me alone!$
translation: 刚才发生了什么？\n让我一个人静一静！$

label: Route11_Text_DirkIntro
source: Fwahaha!\nI have never lost!$
translation: 哇哈哈哈！\n我从来还没输过呢！$

label: Route11_Text_DirkDefeat
source: My first loss!$
translation: 这是我第一次输！$

label: Route11_Text_DirkPostBattle
source: You were just lucky, that's all.$
translation: 你只是走了狗屎运罢了。$

label: Route11_Text_DarianIntro
source: I have never won before…$
translation: 我还从来没赢过......$

label: Route11_Text_DarianDefeat
source: I saw this coming…$
translation: 我早就想到会是这样的结局了......$

label: Route11_Text_DarianPostBattle
source: I was unlucky, as always.$
translation: 我的运气还是像往常那样不好。$

label: Route11_Text_YasuIntro
source: I'm the best in my class.\nI train every morning.$
translation: 在班里我是最强的。\n每天早上我都要特训。$

label: Route11_Text_YasuDefeat
source: Darn!\nMy POKéMON need to be stronger!$
translation: 讨厌！\n我的宝可梦要变得更强！$

label: Route11_Text_YasuPostBattle
source: There's a fat POKéMON that comes\ndown from the mountains.\pI bet it'd be strong if you can\ncatch it.$
translation: 那里有一只胖乎乎的宝可梦\n是从山上下来的。\p如果你能收服它\n肯定会得到一个强力伙伴的。$

label: Route11_Text_BernieIntro
source: Watch out for live wires!$
translation: 当心电线$

label: Route11_Text_BernieDefeat
source: Whoa!\nYou spark plug!$
translation: 哇哦！\n电火花溅起来了！$

label: Route11_Text_BerniePostBattle
source: Well, better get back to work.$
translation: 唉，还是回去工作吧。$

label: Route11_Text_DaveIntro
source: I raised my POKéMON carefully.\nThey should be ready by now!$
translation: 我已经精心锻炼了我的宝可梦。\n它们早已为这一刻已做好了准备！$

label: Route11_Text_DaveDefeat
source: Bye-bye!\nThank you, and good-bye!$
translation: 拜拜！\n谢谢你，有缘再会！$

label: Route11_Text_DavePostBattle
source: Tch…\nI better go find stronger ones!$
translation: 切......\n我最好还是去找只更强的来！$

label: Route11_Text_DiglettsCave
source: 地鼠洞$
translation: 地鼠洞穴$

label: Route120_Text_StevenGreeting
source:
STEVEN: Hm? {PLAYER}{KUN}, hi.
It's been a while.\pThere's something here that you can't
see, right?\pNow, if I were to use this device on
the invisible obstacle…\pNo, no. Rather than describing it,
I should just show you.\lThat would be more fun.\p{PLAYER}{KUN}, are your POKéMON ready for
battle?$
translation:
大吾：嗯？{PLAYER}{KUN}，
好久不见。\p这里好像有什么看不见
的东西，对吧？\p对着这个看不见的障碍
使用这个道具的话......\p不，与其说明，
不如直接使用展示\l给你看更有趣。\p{PLAYER}{KUN}，
你的宝可梦准备好战斗了吗？$

label: Route120_Text_StevenIllWaitHere
source: STEVEN: No?\pI'll wait here, so you can get ready.$
translation: 大吾：还没有吗？\p那我在这里等着你，\n去准备吧。$

label: Route120_Text_StevenReadyForBattle
source: STEVEN: {PLAYER}{KUN}, are your POKéMON\nready for battle?$
translation: 大吾：{PLAYER}{KUN}，\n你的宝可梦准备好战斗了吗？？$

label: Route120_Text_StevenShowMeYourPower
source: STEVEN: {PLAYER}{KUN}, show me your true\npower as a TRAINER!$
translation: 大吾：{PLAYER}{KUN}，\n让我见识下你作为训练家的实力吧！$

label: Route120_Text_StevenUsedDevonScope
source: STEVEN used the DEVON SCOPE.\pAn invisible POKéMON became completely\nvisible!\pThe startled POKéMON attacked!$
translation: 大吾使用了得文侦测镜。\p看不见的宝可梦\n完全现形了！\p受惊的宝可梦攻击过来了！$

label: Route120_Text_StevenGiveDevonScope
source:
STEVEN: I see…
Your battle style is intriguing.\pYour POKéMON have obviously grown
since I first met you in DEWFORD.\pI'd like you to have this
DEVON SCOPE.\pWho knows, there may be other
concealed POKéMON.$
translation:
大吾：原来如此......
你的战斗方式很有趣呢。\p比起在我们在武斗镇初见时，
你的宝可梦成长了不少。\p这个得文侦测镜
送给你，\p说不定还有其他隐藏了
身形的宝可梦呢。$

label: Route120_Text_StevenGoodbye
source: STEVEN: {PLAYER}{KUN}.\pI enjoy seeing POKéMON and TRAINERS\nwho strive together.\pI think you're doing great.\pWell, let's meet again somewhere.$
translation: 大吾：{PLAYER}{KUN}，\p我很喜欢看到训练家和宝可梦\n共同努力一起成长，\p你做得很不错。\p那么，后会有期。$

label: Kecleon_Text_SomethingUnseeable
source: Something unseeable is in the way.$
translation: 有什么看不见的东西挡在路上。$

label: Kecleon_Text_WantToUseDevonScope
source: Something unseeable is in the way.\pWant to use the DEVON SCOPE?$
translation: 有什么看不见的东西挡在路上。\p要使用得文侦测镜吗？$

label: Kecleon_Text_UseDevonScopeMonAttacked
source: {PLAYER} used the DEVON SCOPE.\pAn invisible POKéMON became completely\nvisible!\pThe startled POKéMON attacked!$
translation: {PLAYER}使用了得文侦测镜。\p看不见的宝可梦\n完全现形了！\p受惊的宝可梦攻击过来了！$

label: Route120_Text_RouteSignFortree
source: ROUTE 120\n{LEFT_ARROW} FORTREE CITY$
translation: 120号道路\n{LEFT_ARROW}茵郁市$

label: Route120_Text_RouteSign121
source: {RIGHT_ARROW} ROUTE 121\n{LEFT_ARROW} ROUTE 120$
translation: {RIGHT_ARROW}121号道路\n{LEFT_ARROW}120号道路$

label: Route121_Text_OkayMoveOutToMtPyre
source: Okay!\nWe're to move out to MT. PYRE!$
translation: 好！\n向送神山出发！$

label: Route121_Text_AheadLoomsMtPyre
source: Ahead looms MT. PYRE…\pIt is a natural monument to the spirits \nof departed POKéMON…$
translation: 前方隐约可以看到送神山......\p那是自然为故去宝可梦的\n灵魂建立的坟墓......$

label: Route121_Text_MtPyrePierSign
source: MT. PYRE PIER\p…The sign is old and worn out.\nThe words are barely legible…$
translation: 送神山码头\p......牌子老旧得快要坏掉了，\n上面的字迹几乎看不清楚......$

label: Route121_Text_SafariZoneSign
source: “Filled with rare POKéMON!”\nSAFARI ZONE$
translation: "稀有宝可梦的家园！"\n狩猎地带$

label: Route123_Text_LoveGrassMonsHaveAny
source: I love GRASS-type POKéMON!\pDo you have any GRASS-type POKéMON?$
translation: 我喜欢草属性宝可梦！\p你有草属性宝可梦吗？$

label: Route123_Text_YouLikeGrassMonsTooHaveThis
source: Oh?\pYou like GRASS-type POKéMON, too,\ndon't you?\pI'm so happy, you can have this!\nIt's a token of our friendship.$
translation: 哦？\p你也喜欢草属性\n宝可梦是吗？\p太高兴了，这个给你！\n这是我们友情的象征。$

label: Route123_Text_CheckTreesWithMyGrassMon
source: I check trees with my GRASS-type\nPOKéMON. I'm like a tree doctor.$
translation: 我用草属性宝可梦\n检查树木。我就像树的医生。$

label: Route123_Text_RouteSign
source: {RIGHT_ARROW} ROUTE 123\n{LEFT_ARROW} ROUTE 118$
translation: {RIGHT_ARROW}123号道路\n{LEFT_ARROW}118号道路$

label: Route123_Text_RouteSignMtPyre
source: {UP_ARROW} MT. PYRE\n“Forbidden to the faint of heart.”$
translation: {UP_ARROW}送神山\n"胆小者禁止进入。"$

label: Route123_Text_BerryMastersHouse
source: BERRY MASTER'S HOUSE$
translation: 树果名人的家$

label: Route124_Text_HuntersHouse
source: HUNTER'S HOUSE$
translation: 寻宝者的小屋$

label: Route124_DivingTreasureHuntersHouse_Text_Greeting
source: I'm the DIVING TREASURE HUNTER!\pI'm the awesome dude who makes\ndeep-sea dives to gather treasures\lresting at the bottom.$
translation: 我是水下宝藏寻宝者！\p专门潜到深海打捞\n沉睡在海底的宝物！$

label: Route124_DivingTreasureHuntersHouse_Text_HaveYouSeenAnyShards
source: Tell me, have you seen any SHARDS of\ntools made in ancient times?$
translation: 告诉我，\n你见过古代工具的碎片吗？$

label: Route124_DivingTreasureHuntersHouse_Text_YouHaventGotAnyShards
source: You haven't got any treasures\nfor me…\pIf you see any SHARDS, like the RED\nSHARD, you've got to trade it with me!$
translation: 你手头没有宝物啊......\p如果你找到了碎片，比如红色碎片\n之类的，就来和我交换吧！$

label: Route124_DivingTreasureHuntersHouse_Text_ThatsAShardIllTradeYou
source: Oh, hey! That…\nThat's a SHARD! I'm looking for those!\pOh, man, you've got to trade that\nwith me! I'll give you something good!$
translation: 哦，哈！那个......\n那是碎片！我找的就是它们！\p啊，拜托，跟我交换吧！\n绝对给你好东西！$

label: Route124_DivingTreasureHuntersHouse_Text_WhatDoYouWantToTrade
source: What do you want to trade?$
translation: 你想换什么？$

label: Route124_DivingTreasureHuntersHouse_Text_YoullTradeShardForStone
source: You'll trade your {STR_VAR_1} for\nmy {STR_VAR_2}, then?$
translation: 要用你的{STR_VAR_1}换\n我的{STR_VAR_2}吗？$

label: Route124_DivingTreasureHuntersHouse_Text_ItsADeal
source: It's a done deal!\nUse that wisely!$
translation: 成交！\n好好使用吧！$

label: Route124_DivingTreasureHuntersHouse_Text_TradeSomethingElse
source: Do you want to trade something else?$
translation: 你还想换别的吗？$

label: Route124_DivingTreasureHuntersHouse_Text_BagFull
source: Whoops, your BAG's full.\nGet rid of some items, friend!$
translation: 啊呀，你的包包满了，\n清理掉一些东西吧，朋友！$

label: Route124_DivingTreasureHuntersHouse_Text_ComeBackIfYouChangeMind
source: No? That's a downer.\nWell, if you change your mind, come back.$
translation: 不换吗？真遗憾。\n好吧，你改变主意的话再来。$

label: Route128_Text_ArchieWhatHappened
source: ARCHIE: What happened…\nWhat is this wretched scene…\pDid I…make a horrible mistake?$
translation: 水梧桐：怎么会这样......\n这惨状......\p难道我......犯下大错了？$

label: Route128_Text_ArchieIOnlyWanted
source: I…\nI only wanted…$

label: Route128_Text_MaxieDoYouUnderstandNow
source:
MAXIE: Do you understand now,
ARCHIE?\pDo you finally see how disastrous
your dream turned out to be?\pWe have to hurry! We have to do
something before the situation goes\lcompletely out of control!$
translation:
赤焰松：现在明白了吗，
水梧桐？\p你总算明白你所谓的梦想
酿成多大的灾难了吗？\p我们得抓紧时间！
我们得在局势彻底\l失控前做些什么！$

label: Route128_Text_MaxieResposibilityFallsToArchieAndMe
source:
MAXIE: {PLAYER}, don't say anything.\pI know that I have no right to be
critical of ARCHIE…\pBut the way things are now, I doubt
that we humans will be capable of\ldoing anything about it.\pBut neither can we stand by and
just watch helplessly.\pThe responsibility for putting an end
to this falls to ARCHIE and me…$
translation:
赤焰松：{PLAYER}，不用说了......\p我知道自己没资格
批评水梧桐......\p但事已至此，以我们人类的力量而言，
恐怕已经无力回天了。\p但我们也不能只是
束手无策地旁观。\p我和水梧桐必须承担起责任
来终结我们造成的这一切......$

label: Route128_Text_MaxieThisDefiesBelief
source: MAXIE: This defies belief…\pThose super-ancient POKéMON…\pTheir power is unbelievable.\nThey've upset the balance of nature…$
translation: 赤焰松：难以置信......\p那些超古代宝可梦......\p它们的力量简直超乎想象。\n它们打破了自然的平衡......$

label: Route128_Text_StevenWhatIsHappening
source: STEVEN: {PLAYER}{KUN}!\nWhat is happening?$
translation: 大吾：{PLAYER}{KUN}！\n这究竟......？$

label: Route128_Text_StevenWholeWorldWillDrown
source:
This is terrible…\pAfter the scorching heat wave ended,
this deluge began.\pIf this doesn't stop, all of HOENN…
No, the whole world will drown.\pThis huge rain cloud is spreading
from above SOOTOPOLIS…\pWhat in the world is taking place there?\pThere's no point arguing here…
SOOTOPOLIS might provide answers…$
translation:
太糟糕了......\p足以烤干大地的热浪之后，
又是淹没一切的洪水。\p这样下去的话，整个丰缘地区......
不，是整个世界都会毁灭的。\p巨大的雨云不断
从琉璃市上空飘来......\p那里究竟发生了什么？\p没时间思考了......
答案应该就在琉璃市那里......$

label: Route128_Text_StevenImGoingToSootopolis
source: {PLAYER}{KUN}…\nI don't know what you intend to do,\lbut don't do anything reckless.\pOkay.\nI'm going to SOOTOPOLIS.$
translation: {PLAYER}{KUN}......\n我不知道你怎么打算，\l但千万不要勉强。\p好了，\n我先去琉璃市了。$

label: Route12_FishingHouse_Text_DoYouLikeToFish
source: I'm the FISHING GURU's younger\nbrother.\pI simply looove fishing!\nI can't bear to go without.\pTell me, do you like to fish?$
translation: 我是钓鱼大师的\n年轻弟弟。\p我真的很爱钓鱼！\n没有它我活不下去。\p告诉我吧，你喜欢钓鱼吗？$

label: Route12_FishingHouse_Text_TakeThisAndFish
source: Grand! I like your style.\nI think we can be friends.\pTake this and fish, young friend!$
translation: 很好！我喜欢你的态度。\n我认为我们能够成为朋友，\p带上它，去钓鱼吧年轻的朋友！$

label: Route12_FishingHouse_Text_ReceivedSuperRod
source: {PLAYER} received a SUPER ROD from\nthe FISHING GURU's brother.$
translation: {PLAYER}从钓鱼大师的弟弟那儿\n得到了超级钓竿。$

label: Route12_FishingHouse_Text_IfYouCatchBigMagikarpShowMe
source:
Fishing is a way of life!
It is like the finest poetry.\pFrom the seas to rivers, go out
and land the big one, my friend.\pNow, I have a request.\pIf you catch a big MAGIKARP 
with that ROD, I want to see it.\pAs much as I love to fish, I also
love seeing gigantic MAGIKARP.$
translation:
钓鱼是人生的一种旅途。
它就像是最美的诗歌。\p从海洋到河流 
快去吧，我的朋友，钓条大鱼给我看看！\p现在，我还有一个请求。\p如果你用破钓竿钓到了大鲤鱼王。
就给我看看吧，\p我不但喜欢钓鱼
还喜欢看大的鲤鱼王。$

label: Route12_FishingHouse_Text_OhThatsDisappointing
source: Oh…\nThat's so disappointing…$

label: Route12_FishingHouse_Text_TryFishingBringMeMagikarp
source:
Hello there, {PLAYER}!
Have you been fishing?\pTry fishing with the SUPER ROD in
any body of water.\pYou'll find different POKéMON in
different places.\pOh, and don't forget to bring me
gigantic MAGIKARP.$
translation:
嗨 {PLAYER}
你钓过鱼了吗？\p尝试用超级钓竿在不同
的地方钓鱼吧。\p在不同的地方你会
钓到不同的宝可梦。\p还有，不要忘了带
大的鲤鱼王给我看喔。$

label: Route12_FishingHouse_Text_OhMagikarpAllowMeToSee
source: Oh? {PLAYER}?\nWhy, if it isn't a MAGIKARP!\pAllow me to see it, quick!$
translation: 哦？{PLAYER}？\n给我看看 那只鲤鱼王够不够大\p给我看看 快！$

label: Route12_FishingHouse_Text_WhoaXInchesTakeThis
source:
… … …Whoa!
{STR_VAR_2} inches!\pYou have a rare appreciation for
the fine, poetic aspects of fishing!\pYou must take this.
I insist!$
translation:
......哇！
{STR_VAR_2}英寸！\p在捕鱼方面
你的技能好棒啊！\p我坚信，
这个一定会对你有用的。$

label: Route12_FishingHouse_Text_LookForwardToGreaterRecords
source: I'll look forward to seeing greater\nrecords from you!$
translation: 我希望能从你这儿\n看到更好的记录。$

label: Route12_FishingHouse_Text_HuhXInchesSameSizeAsLast
source: Huh?\n{STR_VAR_2} inches?\pThis is the same size as the one\nI saw before.$
translation: 哼？\n{STR_VAR_2}英寸？\p这和我以前看到过的\n是一个尺寸。$

label: Route12_FishingHouse_Text_HmmXInchesDoesntMeasureUp
source: Hmm…\nThis one is {STR_VAR_2} inches long.\pIt doesn't measure up to the\n{STR_VAR_3}-inch one you brought before.$
translation: 呃......\n这条只有{STR_VAR_2}英寸。\p它和你以前买的那条\n{STR_VAR_3}英寸的，完全比不了......$

label: Route12_FishingHouse_Text_DoesntLookLikeMagikarp
source: Uh… That doesn't look much like\na MAGIKARP.$
translation: 呃......这看起来不像是\n一条鲤鱼王。$

label: Route12_FishingHouse_Text_NoRoomForGift
source: Oh, no!\pI had a gift for you, but you have\nno room for it.$
translation: 哦，太不好了！\p我要给你一件礼物，\n但你身上没有足够的空间来放。$

label: Route12_FishingHouse_Text_MostGiganticMagikarpXInches
source: The most gigantic MAGIKARP\nI have ever witnessed…\p{STR_VAR_3} inches!$
translation: 我曾见过的\n最大的鲤鱼王它有......\p{STR_VAR_3}英尺！$

label: Route12_FishingHouse_Text_BlankChartOfSomeSort
source: It's a blank chart of some sort.\pIt has spaces for writing in\nrecords of some kind.$
translation: 一张空白的图表。\p空白的地方可以\n做一些记录。$

label: Route12_Text_MonSprawledOutInSlumber
source: A POKéMON is sprawled out in\na deep and comfortable slumber.$
translation: 这只宝可梦伸展着四肢\n舒舒服服地着。$

label: Text_SnorlaxWokeUp
source: SNORLAX woke up!\pIt attacked in a grumpy rage!$
translation: 卡比兽醒来了！\p它发动着狂暴的攻击扑了过来！$

label: Text_SnorlaxReturnedToMountains
source: SNORLAX calmed down.\nIt gave a huge yawn…\lAnd returned to the mountains.$
translation: 卡比兽平静了下来。\n它打了个大哈欠...\l回山上去了。$

label: Text_WantToUsePokeFlute
source: Want to use the POKé FLUTE?$
translation: 要使用宝可梦笛子吗？$

label: Text_PlayedPokeFlute
source: {PLAYER} played the POKé FLUTE.$
translation: {PLAYER}吹起了宝可梦笛子。$

label: Route12_Text_NedIntro
source: Yeah!\nI got a bite here!$
translation: 好！\n咬钩了！$

label: Route12_Text_NedDefeat
source: Tch!\nJust a small fry…$
translation: 切！\n是条小鱼......$

label: Route12_Text_NedPostBattle
source: Hang on!\nMy line's snagged!$
translation: 坚持就是胜利！\n我的鱼线有反应了！$

label: Route12_Text_ChipIntro
source: Be patient.\nFishing is a waiting game.$
translation: 心如止水。\n钓鱼就是比的耐心。$

label: Route12_Text_ChipDefeat
source: That one got away!$
translation: 那条鱼跑了！$

label: Route12_Text_ChipPostBattle
source: With a better ROD, I could catch\nbetter POKéMON…$
translation: 用这根好点的钓竿 \n就可以钓起来更好的宝可梦......$

label: Route12_Text_JustinIntro
source: I'm searching for a MOON STONE.\nHave you found one?$
translation: 我在寻找月之石。\n你有看到过吗？$

label: Route12_Text_JustinDefeat
source: Oww!$
translation: 喔啊$

label: Route12_Text_JustinPostBattle
source: I could have made my POKéMON\nevolve with a MOON STONE.\pI would have won then, I bet.$
translation: 我的宝可梦需要靠\n月之石进化。\p我打赌一定会赢的。$

label: Route12_Text_LucaIntro
source: Electricity is my specialty.\pI don't know a thing about POKéMON\nof the sea, though.$
translation: 电属性就是我的特长。\p海里的宝可梦什么的，\n我完全不懂。$

label: Route12_Text_LucaDefeat
source: Unplugged!$
translation: 忘接插座了！$

label: Route12_Text_LucaPostBattle
source: Water conducts electricity, so you\nshould zap sea POKéMON.$
translation: 水导电，\n所以电能打败海里的宝可梦。$

label: Route12_Text_HankIntro
source: The FISHING FOOL versus POKéMON\nKID!$
translation: 钓鱼白痴VS\n宝可梦小孩！$

label: Route12_Text_HankDefeat
source: Touch too much!$
translation: 太感人了！$

label: Route12_Text_HankPostBattle
source: I guess you get to be good at\nwhat you like.\pWell, you beat me at POKéMON,\nbut you can't top me at fishing.$
translation: 我猜你在你爱好的事情方面\n很在行。\p我承认你在宝可梦方面赢了我，\n但在垂钓方面你撼动不了我的王座。$

label: Route12_Text_ElliotIntro
source: I love fishing, don't get me wrong.\pBut it'd be best if I also had more\nwork.$
translation: 我热爱钓鱼，你可别冤枉了我。\p但是我如果有更多的活可干\n就更好了。$

label: Route12_Text_ElliotDefeat
source: It's not easy…$
translation: 事情没那么简单......$

label: Route12_Text_ElliotPostBattle
source: It's all right.\nLosing doesn't bug me anymore.$
translation: 没关系。\n失败不能影响我。$

label: Route12_Text_AndrewIntro
source: What's catching?\pYou never know what you could\ncatch!$
translation: 钓到了什么？\p你永远不能提前知道\n你钓到了什么！$

label: Route12_Text_AndrewDefeat
source: Lost it!$
translation: 输了！$

label: Route12_Text_AndrewPostBattle
source: What, MAGIKARP?\pI catch them all the time, sure.\nBut, boy are they wimpy.$
translation: 什么，又是鲤鱼王？\p我钓到的总是它！真的。\n可它们实在太弱了。$

label: Route12_Text_RouteSign
source: ROUTE 12 \nNorth to LAVENDER$
translation: 12号道路 \n往北到紫苑$

label: Route12_Text_SportfishingArea
source: SPORTFISHING AREA$
translation: 垂钓地带$

label: Route12_Text_JesIntro
source: JES: If I win, I'm going to\npropose to GIA.$
translation: 阿重 如果我赢了，\n我就答应阿谀的求婚。$

label: Route12_Text_JesDefeat
source: JES: Oh, please, why couldn't you\nlet us win?$
translation: 阿重 喔，拜托，\n为什么不让我们赢啊？$

label: Route12_Text_JesPostBattle
source: JES: Oh, GIA, forgive me,\nmy love!$
translation: 阿重 噢， 阿谀，原谅我，\n亲爱的！$

label: Route12_Text_JesNotEnoughMons
source: JES: GIA and I, we'll be\ntogether forever.\pWe won't battle unless you have\ntwo POKéMON of your own.$
translation: 阿重 阿谀和我，\n我们会永远在一起\p如果你没有两只宝可梦\n我们不会和你战斗。$

label: Route12_Text_GiaIntro
source: GIA: Hey, JES…\pIf we win, I'll marry you!$
translation: 阿谀嘿，阿重......\p如果我们赢了，我就要娶你！$

label: Route12_Text_GiaDefeat
source: GIA: Oh, but why?$
translation: 阿谀 喔，这是为什么！$

label: Route12_Text_GiaPostBattle
source: GIA: JES, you silly!\nYou ruined this!$
translation: 阿谀 阿重，你这个笨蛋！\n你毁了我的好事！$

label: Route12_Text_GiaNotEnoughMons
source: GIA: I can't bear to battle\nwithout my JES!\pDon't you have one more POKéMON?$
translation: 阿谀我可不能忍受\n没有我的阿重的战斗！\p你还有更多宝可梦吗？$

label: Route12_NorthEntrance_1F_Text_LookoutSpotUpstairs
source: There's a lookout spot upstairs.\nThe view is magnificent.$
translation: 上楼去看\n景色更宏伟。$

label: Route12_NorthEntrance_2F_Text_TakeTMDontNeedAnymoreMale
source: My POKéMON's ashes are stored in\nPOKéMON TOWER.\pYou can have this TM.\nI don't need it anymore…$
translation: 我宝可梦的骨灰寄存在\n宝可梦塔。\p把这个技能拿走吧。\n我不再需要它了......$

label: Route12_NorthEntrance_2F_Text_TakeTMDontNeedAnymoreFemale
source: My POKéMON's ashes are stored in\nPOKéMON TOWER.\pYou can have this TM.\nI don't need it anymore…$
translation: 我宝可梦的骨灰寄存在\n宝可梦塔。\p把这个技能拿走吧。\n我不再需要它了......$

label: Route12_NorthEntrance_2F_Text_ReceivedTM27FromLittleGirl
source: {PLAYER} received TM27\nfrom the little girl.$
translation: {PLAYER}从小女孩那儿\n得到了TM27。$

label: Route12_NorthEntrance_2F_Text_ExplainTM27
source: TM27 is a move called RETURN…\pIf you treat your POKéMON good,\nit will return your love by working\lits hardest in battle.$
translation: TM27叫做报恩......\p如果你把宝可梦照顾得很好，\n它将会在战斗中\l以最大的力量回馈你的爱。$

label: Route12_NorthEntrance_2F_Text_DontHaveRoomForThis
source: You don't have room for this.$
translation: 你身上的空间不足以存放此道具。$

label: Route12_NorthEntrance_2F_Text_TheresManFishing
source: Let's see what the binoculars have\nto show…\pThere's a man fishing!$
translation: 一架望远镜......\n我来看看......\p一个正在钓鱼的男人......！$

label: Route12_NorthEntrance_2F_Text_ItsPokemonTower
source: Let's see what the binoculars have\nto show…\pIt's POKéMON TOWER!$
translation: 一架望远镜......\n我来看看......\p那是一座宝可梦塔$

label: Route13_Text_SebastianIntro
source: My bird POKéMON want to battle\nwith you!$
translation: 我的飞行属性宝可梦\n想要和你比试！$

label: Route13_Text_SebastianDefeat
source: My PIDGEY and PIDGEOTTO combo\nlost?$
translation: 我的波波比比鸟组合\n居然输了？$

label: Route13_Text_SebastianPostBattle
source: My POKéMON look happy even though\nthey lost.$
translation: 虽然输了\n但我的宝可梦看起来很高兴。$

label: Route13_Text_SusieIntro
source: I'm told I'm good for a kid.$
translation: 我想说我肯定比一个孩子要厉害。$

label: Route13_Text_SusieDefeat
source: Ohh!\nI lost!$
translation: 喔！\n我输了！$

label: Route13_Text_SusiePostBattle
source: I want to become a good TRAINER.\nI'll train hard, just watch.$
translation: 我想要成为一名强大的训练家。\n如你所见，我很努力的训练。$

label: Route13_Text_ValerieIntro
source: Wow!\nYour BADGES are too cool!$
translation: 哇塞！\n你的徽章太酷了！$

label: Route13_Text_ValerieDefeat
source: Not enough!$
translation: 这还不够！$

label: Route13_Text_ValeriePostBattle
source: You got those BADGES from GYM\nLEADERS. I know!$
translation: 你这些徽章都是从\n道馆馆主手里得到的，我懂的！$

label: Route13_Text_GwenIntro
source: My cute POKéMON wish to make your\nacquaintance.$
translation: 我可爱的宝可梦想要和你\n亲热亲热。$

label: Route13_Text_GwenDefeat
source: Good going!\nYou totally won!$
translation: 干得漂亮！\n你赢了！$

label: Route13_Text_GwenPostBattle
source: You have to make POKéMON battle\nto toughen them up.$
translation: 要想让你的宝可梦更强大，\n就得在战斗中磨练它们。$

label: Route13_Text_AlmaIntro
source: I found CARBOS in a cave once\nwhile I was spelunking.$
translation: 有一次我去山洞探险的时候，\n捡到了一个速度增强剂。$

label: Route13_Text_AlmaDefeat
source: Oh, too bad!\nI just messed up!$
translation: 噢，太糟糕了！\n我弄得一团糟！$

label: Route13_Text_AlmaPostBattle
source: CARBOS boosted the SPEED of my\nPOKéMON.$
translation: 我的宝可梦速度之高便是\n拜速度增强剂所赐。$

label: Route13_Text_PerryIntro
source: I'm not going to lose.\nNot when the wind's blowing my way!$
translation: 风向如此之顺畅。\n我一定能赢你！$

label: Route13_Text_PerryDefeat
source: The wind turned!$
translation: 看来风向改变了！$

label: Route13_Text_PerryPostBattle
source: I'm beat.\nI guess I'll FLY home.$
translation: 我输了。\n我想我要使用飞翔回家了。$

label: Route13_Text_LolaIntro
source: Sure, I'll play with you, sweetie.$
translation: 好，那开始我们的游戏吧，小甜心。$

label: Route13_Text_LolaDefeat
source: Oh!\nYou little beast!$
translation: 哎！\n讨厌啦你！$

label: Route13_Text_LolaPostBattle
source: I wonder which is stronger, male or\nfemale POKéMON?$
translation: 我很好奇哪一种宝可梦会厉害一点？\n雄性的还是雌性的？$

label: Route13_Text_SheilaIntro
source: Do you want to battle some\nPOKéMON with me?$
translation: 你想跟我的宝可梦战斗吗？$

label: Route13_Text_SheilaDefeat
source: It's over already?$
translation: 已经结束了吗？$

label: Route13_Text_SheilaPostBattle
source: I don't know anything about\nPOKéMON actually.\pThe ones I use… I picked them\nfor their looks!$
translation: 实际上我不知道\n任何关于宝可梦的知识。\p至于我用的这些......\n我抓住它们只是因为它们好看！$

label: Route13_Text_JaredIntro
source: What're you lookin' at?$
translation: 你在看什么呢？$

label: Route13_Text_JaredDefeat
source: Dang!\nStripped gears!$
translation: 当！\n机关被卸掉了！$

label: Route13_Text_JaredPostBattle
source: Get lost!$
translation: 迷路了！$

label: Route13_Text_RobertIntro
source: I always go with bird POKéMON.\nI've dedicated myself to them.$
translation: 我经常和鸟系宝可梦一起。\n我毕生精力都倾注于此。$

label: Route13_Text_RobertDefeat
source: Out of power!$
translation: 用力！$

label: Route13_Text_RobertPostBattle
source: I wish I could fly like PIDGEY and\nPIDGEOTTO…$
translation: 我希望我能像\n波波和比比鸟一样飞翔......$

label: Route13_Text_LookToLeftOfThatPost
source: TRAINER TIPS\pLook, look!\nLook to the left of that post!$
translation: 训练家贴士\p快看！\n注意左边的公告！$

label: Route13_Text_SelectToSwitchItems
source: TRAINER TIPS\pUse SELECT to switch items in the\nITEMS window.$
translation: 训练家贴士\p在道具窗口按选择键\n设置快捷物品。$

label: Route13_Text_RouteSign
source: ROUTE 13\nNorth to SILENCE BRIDGE$
translation: 13号道路\n往北到寂静桥$

label: Route14_Text_CarterIntro
source: You need to use TMs to teach good\nmoves to POKéMON.$
translation: 要想让你的宝可梦学到更强劲\n的技能就要善用技能机。$

label: Route14_Text_CarterDefeat
source: Not good enough quite yet.$
translation: 不是很好。$

label: Route14_Text_CarterPostBattle
source: You have some HMs, right? POKéMON\ncan't forget those moves easily.$
translation: 你已经得到秘传机了吗？宝可梦不会\n轻易忘记从上面学得的技能。$

label: Route14_Text_MitchIntro
source: My bird POKéMON should be ready\nfor battle.$
translation: 我的鸟类宝可梦已经\n备战完毕。$

label: Route14_Text_MitchDefeat
source: Not ready yet!$
translation: 看来还是没准备好！$

label: Route14_Text_MitchPostBattle
source: My bird POKéMON need to learn\nbetter moves.$
translation: 我的鸟系宝可梦需要\n学习更强的技能。$

label: Route14_Text_BeckIntro
source: They have TMs on sale at the\nCELADON DEPT. STORE.\pTMs aren't really rare, but not\nmany people have HMs.$
translation: 玉虹百货大楼\n出售技能学习机。\p技能学习机并不是十分稀少，\n但是拥有它的人也不多。$

label: Route14_Text_BeckDefeat
source: Aww, bummer!$
translation: 啊，你这家伙！$

label: Route14_Text_BeckPostBattle
source: Try teaching POKéMON a move that's\nthe same type as it.\pThat apparently boosts the power\nof the move.$
translation: 让宝可梦学习与它自身属性\n相符的技能。\p这样技能的强劲会有显著提升。$

label: Route14_Text_MarlonIntro
source: Have you taught your bird POKéMON\nhow to FLY?\pYou'll be able to soar with it into\nthe sky!$
translation: 你教过你的鸟系宝可梦\n如何飞翔了吗？\p你可以跟它一同在天空中\n翱翔！$

label: Route14_Text_MarlonDefeat
source: Shot down in flames!$
translation: 在火焰中击落它！$

label: Route14_Text_MarlonPostBattle
source: Bird POKéMON are my one true love.\nI don't want to raise anything else.$
translation: 鸟系宝可梦是我最钟爱的。\n任何其他的宝可梦都让我兴趣索然。$

label: Route14_Text_DonaldIntro
source: Have you heard the legend of the\nwinged mirages?$
translation: 你听说过传说中\n飞行的幻影吗？$

label: Route14_Text_DonaldDefeat
source: Why?\nWhy'd I lose?$
translation: 为什么？\n为什么我会输？$

label: Route14_Text_DonaldPostBattle
source: Well, the winged mirages are the\nlegendary bird POKéMON.\pThere are three of them: ARTICUNO,\nZAPDOS, and MOLTRES.$
translation: 飞行的幻影指的是\n传说中的鸟系宝可梦。\p有三只：急冻鸟，\n闪电鸟和火焰鸟。$

label: Route14_Text_BennyIntro
source: I'm not into it, but okay.\nLet's go!$
translation: 我没有进去过，不过没关系。\n我们出发吧！$

label: Route14_Text_BennyDefeat
source: I knew it!$
translation: 我知道它！$

label: Route14_Text_BennyPostBattle
source: Winning, losing… It's insignificant\nunder this huge sky.$
translation: 输与赢......\n在宽广的天空下皆是浮云。$

label: Route14_Text_LukasIntro
source: C'mon, c'mon.\nLet's go, let's go, let's go!$
translation: 来吧，开战。\n擂鼓，呐喊，冲锋！$

label: Route14_Text_LukasDefeat
source: Arrg!\nLost! Get lost!$
translation: 啊啊啊！\n输了！我输掉了！$

label: Route14_Text_LukasPostBattle
source: What, what, what?\nWhat do you want still?$
translation: 啊？什么？怎么了？\n你还想干嘛？$

label: Route14_Text_IsaacIntro
source: I need to burn some time.\nShut up and battle.$
translation: 我想打发点时间。\n少废话，开打吧。$

label: Route14_Text_IsaacDefeat
source: What?\nYou!?$
translation: 什么？\n你！？$

label: Route14_Text_IsaacPostBattle
source: Raising POKéMON is a drag, man.$
translation: 培育宝可梦真是个累赘。$

label: Route14_Text_GeraldIntro
source: We ride out here because of the\nwide-open spaces.$
translation: 这里地方很宽敞，\n所以我们就骑车过来了。$

label: Route14_Text_GeraldDefeat
source: Wipeout!$
translation: 失败了！$

label: Route14_Text_GeraldPostBattle
source: It's cool you made your POKéMON so\nstrong.\pMight is right!\nAnd you know it!$
translation: 你把你的宝可梦培育得这么厉害，\n实在太酷了。\p速度即是力量！\n看来你已经领悟到了！$

label: Route14_Text_MalikIntro
source: POKéMON battle?\nCool! Rumble!$
translation: 宝可梦对战？\n太激动了！来吧！$

label: Route14_Text_MalikDefeat
source: Blown away!$
translation: 被吹走了！$

label: Route14_Text_MalikPostBattle
source: You know who'd win, you and me\none-on-one!$
translation: 你知道谁是胜者，\n不是你就是我！$

label: Route14_Text_RouteSign
source: ROUTE 14\nWest to FUCHSIA CITY$
translation: 14号道路\n往西到浅红市$

label: Route14_Text_KiriIntro
source: KIRI: JAN, let's try really,\nreally hard together.$
translation: 阿雾：惠娜，我们一起试试，\n两个人一起胜率会更高点。$

label: Route14_Text_KiriDefeat
source: KIRI: Whimper…\nWe lost, didn't we?$
translation: 阿雾：呜，呜......\n我们输了么？$

label: Route14_Text_KiriPostBattle
source: KIRI: Did we lose because of me?$
translation: 阿雾：是因为我太弱的关系么？$

label: Route14_Text_KiriNotEnoughMons
source: KIRI: We can battle if you have\ntwo POKéMON.$
translation: 阿雾：如果你有两只宝可梦\n我们就可以战斗啦。$

label: Route14_Text_JanIntro
source: JAN: KIRI, here we go!\nWe have to try hard!$
translation: 惠娜：走吧，阿雾！\n我们得再度投入修炼！$

label: Route14_Text_JanDefeat
source: JAN: Eeeeh!\nNo fair!$
translation: 惠娜：不！\n这不公平！$

label: Route14_Text_JanPostBattle
source: JAN: KIRI, don't cry!\nWe'll just try harder next time.$
translation: 惠娜：阿雾，别哭了！\n我们下次要更加努力才行。$

label: Route14_Text_JanNotEnoughMons
source: JAN: You want to battle?\nYou don't have enough POKéMON.$
translation: 惠娜：你想战斗吗？\n你没有足够的宝可梦。$

label: Route15_Text_KindraIntro
source: I just got some POKéMON in trades.\nCan I try them out on you?$
translation: 我刚刚通过交换得到了新的宝可梦。\n可以和你比试一下吗？$

label: Route15_Text_KindraDefeat
source: Not good enough!$
translation: 还差得很远！$

label: Route15_Text_KindraPostBattle
source: You can't change the nickname of\nany POKéMON you get in a trade.\pOnly the Original TRAINER can get\nthe nickname changed.$
translation: 在交换中取得的宝可梦是无法\n改变其昵称的。\p只有最初得到它的训练家\n能改变昵称。$

label: Route15_Text_BeckyIntro
source: You look gentle, so I think I can\nbeat you.\pI'll give it a go!$
translation: 你看着软绵绵的，\n所以我应该能打败你。\p我要开始了！$

label: Route15_Text_BeckyDefeat
source: No, wrong!$
translation: 不，我判断错了！$

label: Route15_Text_BeckyPostBattle
source: I'm afraid of BIKERS. They look so\nugly and mean!$
translation: 我有点怕飙车族。\n它们看起来丑陋且卑鄙！$

label: Route15_Text_EdwinIntro
source: When I whistle, I can summon bird\nPOKéMON.$
translation: 只要我吹一声口哨，\n就能召唤出鸟系宝可梦。$

label: Route15_Text_EdwinDefeat
source: Ow!\nThat's tragic!$
translation: 噢！\n真是个悲剧！$

label: Route15_Text_EdwinPostBattle
source: Maybe I'm not cut out for battles.\nI'm not the right type, I guess.$
translation: 可能我不擅长战斗。\n大概是我把属性弄错了吧。$

label: Route15_Text_ChesterIntro
source: Hmm? My birds are shivering!\nYou're good, aren't you?$
translation: 嗯？我的鸟儿们在颤抖！\n你很强，我没说错吧？$

label: Route15_Text_ChesterDefeat
source: Just as I thought!$
translation: 和我想像的一样！$

label: Route15_Text_ChesterPostBattle
source: This is so obvious, you should know\nthis, but…\pMoves like EARTHQUAKE and FISSURE\nhave no effect on bird POKéMON.$
translation: 很明显，你不会不了解的，\n其实......\p像地震和地裂这样的技能\n是不会对鸟系宝可梦造成伤害的。$

label: Route15_Text_GraceIntro
source: Oh, you're a little cutie!\nSo like a darling POKéMON!$
translation: 噢，你有一点儿讨人喜欢！\n就像一只可爱的宝可梦！$

label: Route15_Text_GraceDefeat
source: You looked so cute, too!$
translation: 你看起来也很可爱！$

label: Route15_Text_GracePostBattle
source: I forgive you.\nI can take it.\lI'm a big girl now.$
translation: 我不会怪你。\n我搞得定你的。\l我可是个成熟的女孩。$

label: Route15_Text_OliviaIntro
source: I raise POKéMON for protection\nbecause I live alone.$
translation: 我培育宝可梦是为了保护自己，\n因为我是一人军团。$

label: Route15_Text_OliviaDefeat
source: POKéMON isn't about winning or\nlosing for me.$
translation: 宝可梦对我的意义并不是\n简单的输赢。$

label: Route15_Text_OliviaPostBattle
source: I love having my POKéMON greet me\nwhen I get home.\pIt's so reassuring.$
translation: 我喜欢当我回到家时宝可梦上前\n迎接我的那种感觉。\p真的很温暖。$

label: Route15_Text_ErnestIntro
source: Hey, kid! C'mon!\nI just got these off some loser!$
translation: 嘿，小子！来吧！\n这是我从废物们手里得到的战利品！$

label: Route15_Text_ErnestDefeat
source: Why not?$
translation: 有何不可？$

label: Route15_Text_ErnestPostBattle
source: Life's too short.\nIt's cool to live as an outlaw.\lTEAM ROCKET RULES!$
translation: 人生苦短。\n当一个坏蛋是很刺激的。\l所以火箭队万岁！$

label: Route15_Text_AlexIntro
source: Fork over all your cash when you\nlose to me, kid!$
translation: 你要是输掉的话，\n就把你身上的钱都交出来，小子！$

label: Route15_Text_AlexDefeat
source: That can't be true!$
translation: 不会吧！$

label: Route15_Text_AlexPostBattle
source: I was just joking about the money.\nDon't take me all serious.$
translation: 我刚刚是开玩笑的。\n不要动我的钱呀。$

label: Route15_Text_CeliaIntro
source: What's cool and happening?\nTrading POKéMON!$
translation: 什么事又酷又刺激？\n当然交换宝可梦！$

label: Route15_Text_CeliaDefeat
source: I said trade!$
translation: 我是说交换！$

label: Route15_Text_CeliaPostBattle
source: I trade POKéMON with my friends\nall the time.$
translation: 我经常和我的朋友\n交换宝可梦。$

label: Route15_Text_YazminIntro
source: Want to play with my POKéMON?$
translation: 想和我的宝可梦战斗吗？$

label: Route15_Text_YazminDefeat
source: I was too impatient!$
translation: 我太急躁了！$

label: Route15_Text_YazminPostBattle
source: I'll go train with weaker people.$
translation: 我还是跟弱一点的人训练吧。$

label: Route15_Text_RouteSign
source: ROUTE 15\nWest to FUCHSIA CITY$
translation: 15号道路\n往西到浅红市$

label: Route15_Text_MyaIntro
source: MYA: You're perfect.\nHelp me train my little brother?$
translation: 阿力：你很棒。\n帮我训练我弟弟吧？$

label: Route15_Text_MyaDefeat
source: MYA: RON, you have to focus!\nConcentrate on what you're doing!$
translation: 阿力：阿铁，你必须集中精力！\n你要专心于你正在做的事！$

label: Route15_Text_MyaPostBattle
source: MYA: Okay, we'll turn it up.\nI'll add to our training menu!$
translation: 阿力：我们要改变它。\n我要增加我们的训练计划。$

label: Route15_Text_MyaNotEnoughMons
source: MYA: Do you want to challenge us?\nYou'll need two POKéMON, though.$
translation: 阿力：你想挑战我们吗？\n你得有两只宝可梦才行。$

label: Route15_Text_RonIntro
source: RON: My sister gets scary when we\nlose.$
translation: 阿铁：我们要是输掉了，\n姐姐她会变得很吓人。$

label: Route15_Text_RonDefeat
source: RON: Oh, no, no…\nSis, I'm sorry!$
translation: 阿铁：呃，不，不......\n对不起姐姐！$

label: Route15_Text_RonPostBattle
source: RON: Oh, bleah…\nI wish I had a nice sister…$
translation: 阿铁：呃......\n我希望我有一个温柔的姐姐......$

label: Route15_Text_RonNotEnoughMons
source: RON: Did you want to battle with\nmy sister and me?\pYou need two POKéMON, then.$
translation: 阿铁：你想和我们姐弟战斗吗？\p你得有两只宝可梦。$

label: Route15_WestEntrance_1F_Text_OaksAideCameByHere
source: Are you the kid who's working on\na POKéDEX?\pPROF. OAK's AIDE came by here.$
translation: 你就是那个正在收集\n宝可梦图鉴的孩子吗？\p大木博士的助手在这附近。$

label: Route15_WestEntrance_2F_Text_GiveItemIfCaughtEnough
source:
Hi! Remember me?
I'm one of PROF. OAK's AIDES.\pIf your POKéDEX has complete data
on {STR_VAR_1} species, I'm supposed to\lgive you a reward.\pPROF. OAK entrusted me with the
{STR_VAR_2} for you.\pSo, {PLAYER}, let me ask you.\pHave you gathered data on at least
{STR_VAR_1} kinds of POKéMON?$
translation:
嗨！还记得我吗？
我是大木博士的助手之一。\p如果你的宝可梦图鉴已经收集了
{STR_VAR_1}种数据，我就会给你\l一个奖励。\p大木博士委托我把
{STR_VAR_2}给你。\p那么{PLAYER}，让我问问你。\p你已经收集到了至少
{STR_VAR_1}种宝可梦了吗？$

label: Route15_WestEntrance_2F_Text_GreatHereYouGo
source: Great! You have caught or owned\n{STR_VAR_3} kinds of POKéMON!\pCongratulations!\nHere you go!$
translation: 太棒了！你已经拥有了\n{STR_VAR_3}宝可梦！\p恭喜！\n奖励，拿去吧。$

label: Route15_WestEntrance_2F_Text_ReceivedItemFromAide
source: {PLAYER} received the {STR_VAR_2}\nfrom the AIDE.$
translation: {PLAYER}从助手那儿\n得到了{STR_VAR_2}$

label: Route15_WestEntrance_2F_Text_ExplainExpShare
source: EXP. SHARE is an item to be held\nby a POKéMON.\pThe POKéMON will receive a share\nof the EXP. Points without having\lto battle.$
translation: 学习装置是一个可以\n被宝可梦携带的道具。\p这只宝可梦就算不战斗\n也可以分享\l一部分经验值$

label: Route15_WestEntrance_2F_Text_LargeShiningBird
source: Let's see what the binoculars have\nto show…\pA large, shining bird is flying\ntoward the sea.$
translation: 一架望远镜......\n我来看看......\p哦！一只漂亮的大鸟\n正向着大海飞去。$

label: Route15_WestEntrance_2F_Text_SmallIslandOnHorizon
source: Let's see what the binoculars have\nto show…\pIt looks like a small island on\nthe horizon!$
translation: 一架望远镜......\n我来看看......\p这......看上去地平线上\n有一座小岛！$

label: Route16_Text_LaoIntro
source: What do you want?$
translation: 你想要干什么？$

label: Route16_Text_LaoDefeat
source: Don't you dare laugh!$
translation: 你竟敢嘲笑我！$

label: Route16_Text_LaoPostBattle
source: We like just hanging here.\nWhat's it to you?$
translation: 我们喜欢在这里游荡。\n你呢？$

label: Route16_Text_KojiIntro
source: Nice BIKE!\nHand it over!$
translation: 漂亮的自行车！\n交出来！$

label: Route16_Text_KojiDefeat
source: Knockout!$
translation: 我晕了！$

label: Route16_Text_KojiPostBattle
source: Forget it, who needs your BIKE!$
translation: 刚才我啥也没说，谁想要你的自行车！$

label: Route16_Text_LukeIntro
source: Come out and play, little mouse!$
translation: 出来打一架吧，胆小鬼！$

label: Route16_Text_LukeDefeat
source: You little rat!$
translation: 你胆子有点大啊！$

label: Route16_Text_LukePostBattle
source: I hate losing!\nGet out of my face!$
translation: 输掉什么的最讨厌了！\n赶快从我眼前消失！$

label: Route16_Text_HideoIntro
source: Hey, you just bumped me!$
translation: 嘿，你刚才撞着我了！$

label: Route16_Text_HideoDefeat
source: Kaboom!$
translation: 可恶！$

label: Route16_Text_HideoPostBattle
source: We'll always be hanging around here\neven if you don't like it.\pYou can detour to VERMILION from\nFUCHSIA going along the coast.$
translation: 管你看的顺不顺眼，\n我们就爱在这儿周围转。\p你可以沿着海岸从浅红\n绕路去枯叶。$

label: Route16_Text_CamronIntro
source: I'm feeling hungry and mean!\nI need a punching bag!$
translation: 我感到又饿又心烦！\n我需要一个出气筒！$

label: Route16_Text_CamronDefeat
source: Bad, bad, bad!$
translation: 糟糕，麻烦，太颓了！$

label: Route16_Text_CamronPostBattle
source: If I'm going to have POKéMON, they\nmay as well be ferocious.\pI'd use them to leave my enemies\nin tatters.$
translation: 要是我有了宝可梦，\n他们必将成为我的凶器。\p我会用它们\n把我的敌人撕烂。$

label: Route16_Text_RubenIntro
source: Hey, there!\nLet's have ourselves a good time!$
translation: 喂，朋友！\n来玩儿一把怎么样！$

label: Route16_Text_RubenDefeat
source: Don't make me mad!$
translation: 我要疯了！$

label: Route16_Text_RubenPostBattle
source: I get my kicks by harassing people\nwith my stinking POKéMON.\pThey're great for startling people.\nAnd, they bite, too.$
translation: 我和我讨厌的宝可梦通过骚扰人们\n来获得快乐。\p它们吓唬人可是能手，\n当然了，咬人也不差。$

label: Route16_Text_MonSprawledOutInSlumber
source: A POKéMON is sprawled out in\na deep and comfortable slumber.$
translation: 一只宝可梦躺在那儿，\n睡得无比香甜。$

label: Route16_Text_CyclingRoadSign
source: Enjoy the slope!\nCYCLING ROAD$
translation: 享受斜坡吧！\n单车路$

label: Route16_Text_RouteSign
source: ROUTE 16\nCELADON CITY - FUCHSIA CITY$
translation: 16号道路\n玉虹市-浅红市$

label: Route16_Text_JedIntro
source: JED: Our love knows no bounds.\nWe're in love and we show it!$
translation: 阿神：我们的爱是无穷无尽的。\n就在此向你展示吧！$

label: Route16_Text_JedDefeat
source: JED: Oh, no!\nMy love has seen me as a loser!$
translation: 阿神：噢，不！\n我的爱见证了我的失败！$

label: Route16_Text_JedPostBattle
source: JED: Listen, LEA.\nYou need to focus less on me.$
translation: 阿神：听着，嘉穗。\n别对我白花心思了。$

label: Route16_Text_JedNotEnoughMons
source: JED: You have just one POKéMON?\nIs there no love in your heart?$
translation: 阿神：你眼里只有宝可梦？\n你心里没有爱吗？$

label: Route16_Text_LeaIntro
source: LEA: Sometimes, the intensity of\nour love scares me.$
translation: 嘉穗：有时，过于强烈的爱\n使我感到害怕。$

label: Route16_Text_LeaDefeat
source: LEA: Ohh! But JED looks cool\neven in a loss!$
translation: 嘉穗：噢！尽管输了，\n阿神还是看起来很帅！$

label: Route16_Text_LeaPostBattle
source: LEA: Ehehe, I'm sorry.\nJED is so cool.$
translation: 嘉穗：呵呵，不好意思。\n阿神太帅了。$

label: Route16_Text_LeaNotEnoughMons
source: LEA: Oh, you don't have two\nPOKéMON with you?\pDoesn't it feel lonely for you or\nyour POKéMON?$
translation: 嘉穗 哦，你没有两只宝可梦\n和你一起？\p你和你的宝可梦\n不感到孤独吗？$

label: Route16_House_Text_FoundMySecretRetreat
source: Oh, dear.\nYou've found my secret retreat.\pPlease don't tell anyone I'm here.\nI'll make it up to you with this!$
translation: 哦，天哪。\n你发现了我的秘密藏身处！\p请不要告诉任何人我在这里！\n如果你答应的话这个就给你！$

label: Route16_House_Text_ReceivedHM02FromGirl
source: {PLAYER} received HM02\nfrom the girl.$
translation: {PLAYER}从女孩那儿\n获得了HM02。$

label: Route16_House_Text_ExplainHM02
source: HM02 is FLY.\nIt's a wonderfully convenient move.\pPlease, put it to good use.$
translation: HM02是技能飞翔。\n这是一个极为的方便技能。\p请好好利用它吧。$

label: Route16_House_Text_DontHaveAnyRoomForThis
source: You don't have any room for this.$
translation: 你身上没有足够的空间存放它了。$

label: Route16_House_Text_Fearow
source: FEAROW: Kyueen!$
translation: 大嘴雀：法露$

label: Route16_NorthEntrance_1F_Text_NoPedestriansOnCyclingRoad
source: No pedestrians are allowed on\nCYCLING ROAD!$
translation: 单车路上\n禁止步行。$

label: Route16_NorthEntrance_1F_Text_CyclingRoadIsDownhillCourse
source: CYCLING ROAD is a downhill course\nby the sea. It's a great ride.$
translation: 在海边附近的单车路\n是一段下坡路，\n在那儿骑车很享受。$

label: Route16_NorthEntrance_1F_Text_ExcuseMeWaitUp
source: Excuse me!\nWait up, please!$
translation: 抱歉！\n请等一下！$

label: Route16_NorthEntrance_1F_Text_HowdYouGetInGoodEffort
source: How'd you get in?\nGood effort!$
translation: 你是怎么进来的？\n干得不赖！$

label: Route16_NorthEntrance_2F_Text_OnBikeRideWithGirlfriend
source: I'm on a relaxing ride on my new\nbike with my girlfriend.$
translation: 我正在和我的女友\n一起飙车放松呢！$

label: Route16_NorthEntrance_2F_Text_RidingTogetherOnNewBikes
source: We're going riding together on our\nnew bikes.$
translation: 我们将会骑着我们的\n新自行车一起飞驶。$

label: Route16_NorthEntrance_2F_Text_ItsCeladonDeptStore
source: Let's see what the binoculars have\nto show…\pIt's the CELADON DEPT. STORE!$
translation: 一架望远镜......\n我来看看......\p那是玉虹百货大楼！$

label: Route16_NorthEntrance_2F_Text_LongPathOverWater
source: Let's see what the binoculars have\nto show…\pThere's a long path over water far\naway.$
translation: 一家望远镜......\n我来看看......\p在水上有一条\n通往远方的路。$

label: Route16_NorthEntrance_2F_Text_GiveAmuletCoinIfCaught40
source:
Hi! Remember me?
I'm one of PROF. OAK's AIDES.\pIf your POKéDEX has complete data
on 40 species, I'm supposed to\lgive you a reward.\pPROF. OAK entrusted me with an
AMULET COIN for you.\pSo, {PLAYER}, let me ask you.\pHave you gathered data on at least
40 kinds of POKéMON?$
translation:
嗨，还记得我吗？
我是大木博士的助手之一。\p如果你的宝可梦图鉴已经收集了
40种数据 我就会\l给你奖励。\p大木博士拜托我把
护符金币给你。\p那么，{PLAYER}让我来问问你。\p你至少已经取得了
40种宝可梦了吗？$

label: Route16_NorthEntrance_2F_Text_GreatHereYouGo
source: Great! You have caught or owned\n{STR_VAR_3} kinds of POKéMON!\pCongratulations!\nHere you go!$
translation: 太棒了！你已经拥有了\n{STR_VAR_3}多种宝可梦了！\p恭喜！\n奖励，拿去吧！$

label: Route16_NorthEntrance_2F_Text_ReceivedAmuletCoinFromAide
source: {PLAYER} received the AMULET COIN\nfrom the AIDE.$
translation: {PLAYER}从助手那儿得到了\n护符金币。$

label: Route16_NorthEntrance_2F_Text_ExplainAmuletCoin
source: An AMULET COIN is an item to be\nheld by a POKéMON.\pIf the POKéMON appears in a winning\nbattle, you will earn more money.$
translation: 护符金币是一个\n由宝可梦携带的道具。\p如果这只宝可梦赢得了战斗，\n你将会得到更多钱！$

label: Route17_Text_RaulIntro
source: There's no getting rich quick in\nbattling kids.$
translation: 跟小孩战斗可不是什么赚钱\n的捷径。$

label: Route17_Text_RaulDefeat
source: Burned out!$
translation: 烧坏了！$

label: Route17_Text_RaulPostBattle
source: You can find good stuff lying\naround on CYCLING ROAD.\pThere's good money in picking them\nup and selling them.$
translation: 在单车路你会捡到\n一些好的东西。\p如果把它们拿去卖，\n能赚到不少钱。$

label: Route17_Text_IsaiahIntro
source: I'm mighty proud of my bod, kiddo.\nCome on!$
translation: 我的身体超棒的，\n对决吧！老兄。$

label: Route17_Text_IsaiahDefeat
source: Whoo!$

label: Route17_Text_IsaiahPostBattle
source: I could belly-bump you outta\nhere!$
translation: 我可以把你从这儿撞飞！$

label: Route17_Text_VirgilIntro
source: You heading to FUCHSIA?$
translation: 你想去浅红？$

label: Route17_Text_VirgilDefeat
source: Crash and burn!$
translation: 彻底失败了！$

label: Route17_Text_VirgilPostBattle
source: I love racing downhill!$
translation: 我喜欢骑下坡！$

label: Route17_Text_BillyIntro
source: We're BIKERS!\nWe rule the roads, man!$
translation: 我们是飙车族！\n这条路我们说了算，懂吗！$

label: Route17_Text_BillyDefeat
source: Smoked!$
translation: 冒烟了！$

label: Route17_Text_BillyPostBattle
source: Are you looking for adventure?$
translation: 你在寻求冒险生活吗？$

label: Route17_Text_NikolasIntro
source: Let VOLTORB electrify you!$
translation: 让霹雳电球电你一下！$

label: Route17_Text_NikolasDefeat
source: Grounded out!$
translation: 安全着陆！$

label: Route17_Text_NikolasPostBattle
source: I got my VOLTORB at the abandoned\nPOWER PLANT.$
translation: 我在废弃的无人发电厂\n遇到了我的霹雳电球。$

label: Route17_Text_ZeekIntro
source: I leveled up my POKéMON, but it\nwon't evolve. Why?$
translation: 我提升了我的宝可梦等级，\n但是它不进化，为什么？$

label: Route17_Text_ZeekDefeat
source: Why, you!$
translation: 为什么，你！$

label: Route17_Text_ZeekPostBattle
source: Maybe some POKéMON need element\nSTONES to evolve.$
translation: 也许有一些宝可梦需要用\n属性石来进化。$

label: Route17_Text_JamalIntro
source: I need a little exercise!$
translation: 我得练习练习！$

label: Route17_Text_JamalDefeat
source: Whew!\nGood workout!$
translation: 唔！\n不错的训练！$

label: Route17_Text_JamalPostBattle
source: I'm sure I lost weight there!$
translation: 我一定就是在那儿减肥的没错！$

label: Route17_Text_CoreyIntro
source: Be a rebel!$
translation: 成为一个逆反的人！$

label: Route17_Text_CoreyDefeat
source: Aaaargh!$
translation: 啊啊！$

label: Route17_Text_CoreyPostBattle
source: Be ready to fight for your beliefs!$
translation: 准备好为你的信念而战斗！$

label: Route17_Text_JaxonIntro
source: Nice BIKE!\nHow's it handle?$
translation: 漂亮的自行车！\n怎么入手的？$

label: Route17_Text_JaxonDefeat
source: Shoot!$
translation: 可恶！$

label: Route17_Text_JaxonPostBattle
source: The slope makes it hard to steer.$
translation: 在斜坡上很难掌控它啊！$

label: Route17_Text_WilliamIntro
source: Get lost, kid!\nI'm bushed!$
translation: 输了，小子！\n我太累了！$

label: Route17_Text_WilliamDefeat
source: Are you satisfied?$
translation: 你满意吗？$

label: Route17_Text_WilliamPostBattle
source: I need to catch a few z's!$
translation: 我得去打个小盹！$

label: Route17_Text_WatchOutForDiscardedItems
source: It's a notice.\pWatch out for discarded items.$
translation: 小提示。\p注意那些丢弃的物品。$

label: Route17_Text_SameSpeciesGrowDifferentRates
source: TRAINER TIPS\pAll POKéMON are unique.\pEven POKéMON of the same species\nand level grow at different rates.$
translation: 训练家贴士\p每一个宝可梦都是唯一的。\p就算是相同种类和等级的宝可梦，\n它们的能力也不是完全相同的。$

label: Route17_Text_PressBToStayInPlace
source: TRAINER TIPS\pPress the B Button to stay in place\nwhile on a slope.$
translation: 训练家贴士\p在斜坡上时按B键\n能停在原地。$

label: Route17_Text_RouteSign
source: ROUTE 17\nCELADON CITY - FUCHSIA CITY$
translation: 17号道路\n玉虹市-浅红市$

label: Route17_Text_DontThrowGameThrowBalls
source: It's a notice!\pDon't throw the game, throw POKé\nBALLS instead!$
translation: 小提示！\p不要老是逃跑，\n扔精灵球就可以了！$

label: Route17_Text_CyclingRoadSign
source: CYCLING ROAD\nSlope ends here!$
translation: 单车路\n斜坡终止了！$

label: Route18_EastEntrance_1F_Text_NeedBicycleForCyclingRoad
source: You need a BICYCLE to go out on\nCYCLING ROAD!$
translation: 你需要一辆自行车来在\n单车路前进。$

label: Route18_EastEntrance_1F_Text_CyclingRoadAllUphillFromHere
source: CYCLING ROAD is all uphill from\nhere.$
translation: 单车路从这里开始都是\n上坡路了。$

label: Route18_EastEntrance_1F_Text_ExcuseMe
source: Excuse me!$
translation: 抱歉！$

label: Route18_EastEntrance_2F_Text_PalletTownInWest
source: Let's see what the binoculars have\nto show…\pPALLET TOWN is in the west.$
translation: 一架望远镜......\n我来看看......\p真新镇在西面。$

label: Route18_EastEntrance_2F_Text_PeopleSwimming
source: Let's see what the binoculars have\nto show…\pThere are people swimming.$
translation: 一架望远镜......\n我来看看......\p看到了，是一个正在游泳的人。$

label: Route18_Text_WiltonIntro
source: I always check every grassy area\nfor new POKéMON.$
translation: 我总是踏遍每一个草丛\n来寻找新的宝可梦。$

label: Route18_Text_WiltonDefeat
source: Tch!$

label: Route18_Text_WiltonPostBattle
source: I wish I had a BIKE!$
translation: 我希望有一辆自行车！$

label: Route18_Text_RamiroIntro
source: Kurukkoo!\nHow do you like my birdcall?$
translation: 咕咕！\n你喜欢我学的鸟叫声吗？$

label: Route18_Text_RamiroDefeat
source: I had to bug you!$
translation: 我不得不打扰你！$

label: Route18_Text_RamiroPostBattle
source: I collect sea POKéMON on weekends\nbecause the sea is so close.$
translation: 我在周末喜欢收集海洋的宝可梦，\n因为大海离我太近了。$

label: Route18_Text_JacobIntro
source: This is my turf!\nGet out of here!$
translation: 这是我的草地！\n快出去！$

label: Route18_Text_JacobDefeat
source: Darn!$
translation: 见鬼！$

label: Route18_Text_JacobPostBattle
source: This is my fave area for catching\nPOKéMON.$
translation: 这是我最喜欢收服\n宝可梦的地方。$

label: Route18_Text_RouteSign
source: ROUTE 18\nCELADON CITY - FUCHSIA CITY$
translation: 18号道路\n玉虹市-浅红市$

label: Route18_Text_CyclingRoadSign
source: CYCLING ROAD\nNo pedestrians permitted!$
translation: 单车路\n不允许步行的人进入！$

label: Route19_Text_RichardIntro
source: I have to exercise and warm up\nbefore going out for a swim.$
translation: 在出去游泳前\n我必须先热身。$

label: Route19_Text_RichardDefeat
source: All warmed up!$
translation: 热身好了！$

label: Route19_Text_RichardPostBattle
source: Thanks, kid!\nI'm ready for a swim.$
translation: 谢谢你，孩子！\n我准备好去游泳了。$

label: Route19_Text_ReeceIntro
source: Wait! Slow down!\nYou'll have a heart attack!$
translation: 等等！慢慢来！\n你的心脏会受不了的！$

label: Route19_Text_ReeceDefeat
source: Ooh!\nThat's chilly!$
translation: 噢！\n真冷！$

label: Route19_Text_ReecePostBattle
source: Watch out for TENTACOOL.\nThey sting so painfully.$
translation: 注意玛瑙水母。\n被蛰到会很疼。$

label: Route19_Text_MatthewIntro
source: I love swimming!\nWhat about you?$
translation: 我喜欢游泳！\n你呢？$

label: Route19_Text_MatthewDefeat
source: Belly flop!$
translation: 失败了！$

label: Route19_Text_MatthewPostBattle
source: I can beat even marine POKéMON\nat swimming.$
translation: 在海里畅游之时即便是遇到\n海中的宝可梦我也毫无惧色。$

label: Route19_Text_DouglasIntro
source: What's beyond the horizon?$
translation: 地平线外是什么？$

label: Route19_Text_DouglasDefeat
source: Glub!$
translation: 坏了！$

label: Route19_Text_DouglasPostBattle
source: I see a couple of islands over\nyonder!$
translation: 我看见远处环绕着\n一些小岛！$

label: Route19_Text_DavidIntro
source: I tried diving for POKéMON, but it\nwas a no-go.$
translation: 我试着和宝可梦一起潜水，\n但是失败了。$

label: Route19_Text_DavidDefeat
source: Help!$
translation: 救命！$

label: Route19_Text_DavidPostBattle
source: I guess you have to fish for sea\nPOKéMON.$
translation: 我想你必须得钓上\n海里的宝可梦。$

label: Route19_Text_TonyIntro
source: I look at the sea to forget all\nthe bad things that happened.$
translation: 我凝视着大海，就为忘掉\n所有不愉快的事情。$

label: Route19_Text_TonyDefeat
source: Ooh!\nTraumatic!$
translation: 噢！\n受伤了！$

label: Route19_Text_TonyPostBattle
source: I'm looking at the sea to forget\nthe bad thing that happened!$
translation: 我正凝视着大海，\n这样就会忘掉所有的不快！$

label: Route19_Text_AnyaIntro
source: Oh, I just love your ride!\nCan I have it if I win?$
translation: 我好喜欢你的坐骑啊！\n如果我赢了能把它送给我吗？$

label: Route19_Text_AnyaDefeat
source: Oh! I lost!$
translation: 呃！我输了！$

label: Route19_Text_AnyaPostBattle
source: It's still a long way to go to\nSEAFOAM ISLANDS…\pI want to go back to FUCHSIA…$
translation: 去双子岛\n还有老远的一大段路啊......\p我还是回浅红算了......$

label: Route19_Text_AliceIntro
source: Swimming's great!\nSunburns aren't!$
translation: 游泳最棒！\n太阳什么的最讨厌了！$

label: Route19_Text_AliceDefeat
source: Shocker!$
translation: 我震惊了！$

label: Route19_Text_AlicePostBattle
source: My boyfriend wanted to swim to\nSEAFOAM ISLANDS.$
translation: 我男朋友想要游去\n双子岛。$

label: Route19_Text_AxleIntro
source: Ahoy, there!\nThese waters are treacherous!$
translation: 喂，小子！\n这儿的水流很急啊！$

label: Route19_Text_AxleDefeat
source: Ooh!\nDangerous!$
translation: 喂！\n危险！$

label: Route19_Text_AxlePostBattle
source: M-my legs! They cramped up!\nGlub, glub…$
translation: 我，我的腿！抽筋了！\n糟了......$

label: Route19_Text_ConnieIntro
source: I swam here with my friends…\nI'm tired…$
translation: 我和我的朋友一路游了过来......\n好累......$

label: Route19_Text_ConnieDefeat
source: I'm exhausted…$
translation: 我一点力气也没了......$

label: Route19_Text_ConniePostBattle
source: If I were to ride a POKéMON on\nthe sea, I'd like a LAPRAS.\pLAPRAS is so big, I bet it\nwould keep me dry on water.$
translation: 如果我要在海上骑一只宝可梦航行，\n那就是拉普拉斯啦。\p拉普拉斯好大的，\n能让我在海上不沾一点儿水。$

label: Route19_Text_RouteSign
source: SEA ROUTE 19\nFUCHSIA CITY - SEAFOAM ISLANDS$
translation: 19号航道\n浅红市-双子岛$

label: Route19_Text_LiaIntro
source: LIA: I'm looking after my brother.\nHe just became a TRAINER.$
translation: 真奈：我照顾着我的弟弟。\n他才刚成为一名训练家。$

label: Route19_Text_LiaDefeat
source: LIA: That's no way to treat my\nlittle brother!$
translation: 真奈：对我的弟弟一点\n办法都没有！$

label: Route19_Text_LiaPostBattle
source: LIA: Do you have a younger\nbrother?\pI hope you're teaching him all\nsorts of things.$
translation: 真奈：你也有弟弟吗？\p我希望你能教会他\n各种各样的东西。$

label: Route19_Text_LiaNotEnoughMons
source: LIA: I want to battle together\nwith my little brother.\pDon't you have two POKéMON?$
translation: 真奈：我想和我的弟弟\n一起战斗。\p你没有带着两只宝可梦吗？$

label: Route19_Text_LucIntro
source: LUC: My big sis taught me how\nto swim and train POKéMON.$
translation: 阿弘：我姐姐教会了我\n如何游泳和训练宝可梦。$

label: Route19_Text_LucDefeat
source: LUC: Oh, wow!\nSomeone tougher than my big sis!$
translation: 阿弘：哇，天哪！\n有人比我的姐姐还要厉害！$

label: Route19_Text_LucPostBattle
source: LUC: My big sis is strong and nice.\nI think she's awesome!$
translation: 阿弘：我的姐姐又强又漂亮。\n我觉得她太棒了！$

label: Route19_Text_LucNotEnoughMons
source: LUC: I don't want to if I can't\nbattle you with my big sis.\pDon't you have two POKéMON?$
translation: 阿弘：我不想和你单独战斗，\n我要和我姐姐一起。\p你没有带着两只宝可梦吗？$

label: Route1_Text_WorkAtPokeMartTakeSample
source:
Hi!
I work at a POKéMON MART.\pIt's part of a convenient chain
selling all sorts of items.\pPlease, visit us in VIRIDIAN CITY.\pI know, I'll give you a sample.
Here you go!$
translation:
嗨！
我是一家宝可梦商店的职员。\p宝可梦商店是可以很方便
的买到各种商品的连锁店。\p有空请去常青市的宝可梦商店看看。\p我知道，我会送你个样品。
给你！$

label: Route1_Text_ComeSeeUsIfYouNeedPokeBalls
source: Please come see us if you need\nPOKé BALLS for catching POKéMON.$
translation: 如果你想要精灵球收服宝可梦的话，\n就来我们这儿看看吧。$

label: Route1_Text_PutPotionAway
source: {PLAYER} put the POTION away in\nthe BAG's ITEMS POCKET.$
translation: {PLAYER}把伤药放进了\n背包的道具口袋里。$

label: Route1_Text_CanJumpFromLedges
source: See those ledges along the road?\pIt's a bit scary, but you can jump\nfrom them.\pYou can get back to PALLET TOWN\nquicker that way.$
translation: 看到路边那些突起的岩石吗？\p虽然有点吓人，\n但是你可以直接从那里跳下去。\p走那条路的话。\n你可以更快的回到真新镇。$

label: Route1_Text_RouteSign
source: ROUTE 1\nPALLET TOWN - VIRIDIAN CITY$
translation: 1号道路\n真新镇-常青市$

label: Route20_Text_BarryIntro
source: The water is shallow here.\nThere are many people swimming.$
translation: 这儿的水很浅。\n有很多人在这儿游泳。$

label: Route20_Text_BarryDefeat
source: Splash!$
translation: 扑通！$

label: Route20_Text_BarryPostBattle
source: I wish I could ride my POKéMON.\nI bet you're not tired.$
translation: 我希望能骑着我的宝可梦。\n你应该还不算太累。$

label: Route20_Text_ShirleyIntro
source: SEAFOAM is a quiet getaway.\nI'm vacationing here.$
translation: 双子岛是一个安静的度假场所。\n我就是正在这儿休假。$

label: Route20_Text_ShirleyDefeat
source: Quit it!$
translation: 停下来！$

label: Route20_Text_ShirleyPostBattle
source: There's a huge cavern underneath\nthis island.$
translation: 这座岛下有个巨大的洞穴。$

label: Route20_Text_TiffanyIntro
source: I love floating with the fishes\nhere among the waves.$
translation: 我喜欢和鱼儿们一起\n飘游在波浪之中。$

label: Route20_Text_TiffanyDefeat
source: Yowch!$

label: Route20_Text_TiffanyPostBattle
source: Want to float with me?$
translation: 想和我一起飘游吗？$

label: Route20_Text_IreneIntro
source: Are you on vacation, too?$
translation: 你也在度假吗？$

label: Route20_Text_IreneDefeat
source: No mercy at all!$
translation: 不会放过你！$

label: Route20_Text_IrenePostBattle
source: SEAFOAM used to be a single island\nin the distant past.$
translation: 在很久以前，\n双子岛是一座独立的小岛。$

label: Route20_Text_DeanIntro
source: Check out my buff physique!$
translation: 检查一下我充满肌肉的体格！$

label: Route20_Text_DeanDefeat
source: Wimpy!$
translation: 太没用了！$

label: Route20_Text_DeanPostBattle
source: I should've been buffing up my\nPOKéMON, not me!$
translation: 我应该让宝可梦的体格变强壮，\n而不是我的！$

label: Route20_Text_DarrinIntro
source: Why are you riding a POKéMON?\nCan't you swim?$
translation: 你为什么骑着宝可梦？\n你不会游泳吗？$

label: Route20_Text_DarrinDefeat
source: Ouch!\nTorpedoed!$
translation: 哎哟！\n完了！$

label: Route20_Text_DarrinPostBattle
source: Riding a POKéMON sure looks fun!$
translation: 骑着宝可梦看起来确实很有趣！$

label: Route20_Text_RogerIntro
source: I rode my bird POKéMON here.$
translation: 我乘着我的鸟系宝可梦来这。$

label: Route20_Text_RogerDefeat
source: Oh, no!\nNow what am I to do?$
translation: 噢，不！\n现在我该怎么办？$

label: Route20_Text_RogerPostBattle
source: My birds are exhausted.\nThey can't FLY me back!$
translation: 我的宝可梦筋疲力尽了。\n它们不能带我飞翔回去了！$

label: Route20_Text_NoraIntro
source: My boyfriend gave me big pearls.$
translation: 我的男朋友给了我大颗的珍珠。$

label: Route20_Text_NoraDefeat
source: Oh, no!\nMy pearls were in them!$
translation: 噢，不！\n我的珍珠还在里面！$

label: Route20_Text_NoraPostBattle
source: Will my pearls grow bigger inside\nCLOYSTER?$
translation: 我的珍珠放在刺甲贝\n里面会变大吗？$

label: Route20_Text_MissyIntro
source: I swam here from CINNABAR ISLAND.\nIt wasn't easy, I tell you.$
translation: 我从红莲镇游过来的。\n跟你讲，这可不轻松。$

label: Route20_Text_MissyDefeat
source: I'm so disappointed!$
translation: 我太失望了！$

label: Route20_Text_MissyPostBattle
source: POKéMON have taken over an\nabandoned mansion on CINNABAR.\pThey call it the POKéMON MANSION\nnow.$
translation: 在红莲，宝可梦占据了\n那所被遗弃的大厦。\p那儿现在叫做宝可梦屋。$

label: Route20_Text_MelissaIntro
source: CINNABAR, in the west, has a LAB\nfor POKéMON.\pMy daddy works there.$
translation: 在红莲西方，\n有一个宝可梦的研究所。\p我的爸爸在那儿工作。$

label: Route20_Text_MelissaDefeat
source: Wait!\nYou're supposed to wait!$
translation: 等等！\n你给我站住！$

label: Route20_Text_MelissaPostBattle
source: CINNABAR is a volcanic island.\pI heard it rose out of the sea\nwhen a volcano erupted.$
translation: 红莲是一个火山岛。\p我听说在某一次火山喷发时，\n它从海上生成了。$

label: Route20_Text_SeafoamIslands
source: SEAFOAM ISLANDS$
translation: 双子岛$

label: Route20_Text_MistyTrainsHere
source: Strong TRAINERS and WATER POKéMON\nare common sights in these parts.\pThey say that MISTY of the\nCERULEAN GYM trains here.$
translation: 在这儿经常能看到\n强大的训练家和强大的水属性宝可梦。\p据说华蓝道馆的小霞\n也在这儿训练。$

label: Route21_North_Text_RonaldIntro
source: You want to know if the fish are\nbiting?$
translation: 你想不想知道这儿的鱼是否咬人？$

label: Route21_North_Text_RonaldDefeat
source: Dang!$

label: Route21_North_Text_RonaldPostBattle
source: I can't catch anything good.\nNot one good POKéMON to be had!$
translation: 我什么也捉不到。\n没有一只好的宝可梦！$

label: Route21_North_Text_WadeIntro
source: I got a big haul!\nWanna go for it?$
translation: 我收服了好多好多！\n你想不想要呢？$

label: Route21_North_Text_WadeDefeat
source: Heheh, MAGIKARP just don't make\nthe grade, do they?$
translation: 呵呵，鲤鱼王不仅仅\n是以等级区分的，懂吗？$

label: Route21_North_Text_WadePostBattle
source: I seem to only catch MAGIKARP!$
translation: 我只想抓鲤鱼王！$

label: Route21_North_Text_SpencerIntro
source: The sea cleanses my body and soul!$
translation: 海洋洗涤了我的身体和灵魂！$

label: Route21_North_Text_SpencerDefeat
source: Ayah!$
translation: 妈呀！$

label: Route21_North_Text_SpencerPostBattle
source: The sea is great and all, but I\nlike the mountains, too.$
translation: 大海是很伟大的，能包容一切，\n但是我也很喜欢山。$

label: Route21_South_Text_JackIntro
source: I caught my POKéMON at sea.$
translation: 我在海里获得了我的宝可梦。$

label: Route21_South_Text_JackDefeat
source: Diver!!\nDown!!$
translation: 潜水者！！\n下去！$

label: Route21_South_Text_JackPostBattle
source: Where'd you catch your POKéMON?$
translation: 你在哪儿获得你的宝可梦？$

label: Route21_South_Text_JeromeIntro
source: Right now, I'm in a triathlon meet.$
translation: 现在，我在参加三项全能的竞赛。$

label: Route21_South_Text_JeromeDefeat
source: Pant…\nPant… Pant…$

label: Route21_South_Text_JeromePostBattle
source: I'm beat! But, I still have the\nbike race and marathon left!$
translation: 我输了！但是，我仍然可以\n进行自行车和马拉松的比赛！$

label: Route21_South_Text_RolandIntro
source: Ahh!\nFeel the sun and the wind!$
translation: 啊！\n去感受风和阳光！$

label: Route21_South_Text_RolandDefeat
source: Yow!\nI lost!$
translation: 啊！\n我输了！$

label: Route21_South_Text_RolandPostBattle
source: I'm sunburnt to a crisp!$
translation: 我被晒黑了！$

label: Route21_South_Text_ClaudeIntro
source: Hey, don't scare away the fish!$
translation: 嘿，不要把鱼吓走了！$

label: Route21_South_Text_ClaudeDefeat
source: Sorry! I'm just so frustrated from\nnot catching anything.$
translation: 对不起！我刚刚太沮丧了，\n因为我没有收服到任何东西。$

label: Route21_South_Text_ClaudePostBattle
source: Sheesh, I haven't caught a thing.\nCould this place actually be a\lgiant pool or something?$
translation: 我什么也没有收服。\n难道这个地方实际上只是\l一个大水池或是其他什么鬼地方吗？$

label: Route21_South_Text_NolanIntro
source: Keep me company till I get a hit.$
translation: 陪着我直到我游不动了为止。$

label: Route21_South_Text_NolanDefeat
source: That burned some time.$
translation: 真有些浪费时间。$

label: Route21_South_Text_NolanPostBattle
source: Oh wait!\nI got a bite! Yeah!$
translation: 噢，等等！\n我钓到一竿，耶！$

label: Route21_North_Text_LilIntro
source: LIL: Huh? A battle?\nIAN, can't you do it alone?$
translation: 千沙：呃？战斗？\n阿胜，你不能一个人去做吗？$

label: Route21_North_Text_LilDefeat
source: LIL: Oh, see?\nWe lost. Happy now?$
translation: 千沙：哼，看到了么？\n我们失败了。现在高兴了？$

label: Route21_North_Text_LilPostBattle
source: LIL: I'm tired.\nCan't we go home already?$
translation: 千沙：我累了。\n现在还不能回家吗？$

label: Route21_North_Text_LilNotEnoughMons
source: LIL: Huh? A battle?\nI can't be bothered to do it alone.\lBring two POKéMON, won't you?$
translation: 千沙：呃？战斗？\n我不能一个人战斗。\l带来两只宝可梦吧？$

label: Route21_North_Text_IanIntro
source: IAN: My sis doesn't get enough\nexercise, so I made her come.$
translation: 阿胜：我姐姐练习的太少了，\n所以我把她带到了这里。$

label: Route21_North_Text_IanDefeat
source: IAN: Awww, Sis!\nGet it together!$
translation: 阿胜：啊，妹妹！\n一起战斗吧！$

label: Route21_North_Text_IanPostBattle
source: IAN: Come on, Sis!\pYou're not going to lose weight\nlike this!$
translation: 阿胜：加油，妹妹！\p你这样是不会减肥的！$

label: Route21_North_Text_IanNotEnoughMons
source: IAN: We want a two-on-two battle.\nSo can you bring two POKéMON?$
translation: 阿胜：我们希望来一场2对2的战斗。\n所以你能带两只宝可梦来吗？$

label: Route22_Text_EarlyRivalIntro
source:
{RIVAL}: Hey! {PLAYER}!\pYou're off to the POKéMON LEAGUE?
Forget about it!\pYou probably don't have any
BADGES, do you?\pThe guard won't let you through
without them.\pBy the way, did your POKéMON get
any stronger?$
translation:
{RIVAL}：喂！{PLAYER}！\p你想要到宝可梦联盟里去？
得了吧！\p你得到的徽章
还不够吧？\p这样的话，
守卫是不会让你通过的。\p顺便问一句，
你的宝可梦变强了吗？$

label: Route22_Text_EarlyRivalDefeat
source: Awww!\nYou just lucked out!$
translation: 啊啊！\n你只是运气好罢了！$

label: Route22_Text_EarlyRivalPostBattle
source:
I heard the POKéMON LEAGUE is
crawling with tough TRAINERS.\pI have to figure out how to get
past them.\pYou should quit dawdling and get a
move on!$
translation:
我听说宝可梦联盟遍布
很厉害的训练家。\p我必须想想该怎样
战胜他们。\p你不能这样磨磨蹭蹭了，
继续前进吧！$

label: Route22_Text_LateRivalIntro
source:
{RIVAL}: What? {PLAYER}!
What a surprise to see you here!\pSo you're going to the POKéMON
LEAGUE?\pYou collected all the BADGES, too?
That's cool!\pThen I'll whip you, {PLAYER}, as a
warm-up for the POKéMON LEAGUE!\pCome on!$
translation:
{RIVAL}：什么？{PLAYER}！
在这儿碰到你真是令我惊讶！\p你是打算去宝可梦联盟吗？\p你也收集齐了全部徽章？
真是太好了！\p作为去宝可梦联盟之前的热身！
我要先击败你，{PLAYER}\p来吧！$

label: Route22_Text_LateRivalDefeat
source: What!?\pI was just careless, you!$
translation: 什么！？\p我太大意了！$

label: Route22_Text_LateRivalPostBattle
source: That loosened me up.\nI'm ready for the POKéMON LEAGUE!\p{PLAYER}, you need more practice.\pBut hey, you know that!\nI'm out of here. Smell ya!$
translation: 这下我放松多了。\n已经为宝可梦联盟做好了充分准备！\p{PLAYER}，你还得再练习练习。\p不过，你自己应该很清楚吧！\n我走了，回见！$

label: Route22_Text_LeagueGateSign
source: POKéMON LEAGUE\nFront Gate$
translation: 宝可梦联盟\n正门$

label: Route23_Text_VictoryRoadGateSign
source: VICTORY ROAD GATE -\nPOKéMON LEAGUE$
translation: 冠军之路入口处 -\n宝可梦联盟$

label: Route24_Text_JustEarnedFabulousPrize
source: Congratulations! You beat our\nfive contest TRAINERS!\pYou just earned a fabulous prize!$
translation: 祝贺你！你战胜了\n我们五个训练家！\p你获得了一份神秘大礼！$

label: Route24_Text_ReceivedNuggetFromMysteryTrainer
source: {PLAYER} received a NUGGET\nfrom the mystery TRAINER!$
translation: {PLAYER}从谜之训练家那儿\n获得了一个金珠！$

label: Route24_Text_YouDontHaveAnyRoom
source: You don't have any room!$
translation: 你没有退路了！$

label: Route24_Text_JoinTeamRocket
source:
By the way, how would you like to
join TEAM ROCKET?\pWe're a group of professional
criminals specializing in POKéMON!\pWant to join?\pAre you sure?\pCome on, join us!\pI'm telling you to join!\p…Okay, you need convincing!\pI'll make you an offer you can't
refuse!$
translation: 顺便问问，\n你想加入火箭队吗？\p我们是以抢夺宝可梦为主的\n专业犯罪组织。\p想加入吗？\p你确定？\p来吧，加入我们吧！\p我是叫你加入我们！\p好吧，看来得给你来点硬的！\p我要让你无法拒绝！$

label: Route24_Text_RocketDefeat
source: Arrgh!\nYou are good!$
translation: 啊！\n你太强了！$

label: Route24_Text_YoudBecomeTopRocketLeader
source: With your ability, you'd become\na top leader in TEAM ROCKET.\pCome on, think of the opportunity!\nDon't let this chance go to waste.$
translation: 以你的能力，\n你能成为火箭队的高级干部。\p瞧瞧，多么好的机会！\n浪费掉真是太可惜了。$

label: Route24_Text_ShaneIntro
source: I saw your feat from the grass!$
translation: 我看见了你草地上的壮举！$

label: Route24_Text_ShaneDefeat
source: I thought not!$
translation: 我想不通！$

label: Route24_Text_ShanePostBattle
source: I hid because the people on the\nbridge frightened me.$
translation: 我藏着是因为\n我害怕桥上的人们。$

label: Route24_Text_EthanIntro
source: Okay! I'm No. 5!\nI'll stomp you!$
translation: 嗯！我是5号！\n我要把你踏在脚下！$

label: Route24_Text_EthanDefeat
source: Whoa!\nToo much!$
translation: 哇！\n真厉害！$

label: Route24_Text_EthanPostBattle
source: I did my best. I have no regrets!$
translation: 我尽力了，我不后悔！$

label: Route24_Text_ReliIntro
source: I'm No. 4!\nGetting tired?$
translation: 我是4号！\n感觉累了吗？$

label: Route24_Text_ReliDefeat
source: I lost, too!$
translation: 我也失败了！$

label: Route24_Text_ReliPostBattle
source: I did my best, so I've no regrets!$
translation: 我尽力了，我不后悔！$

label: Route24_Text_TimmyIntro
source: Here's No. 3!\nI won't be easy!$
translation: 3号在这儿！\n我可没那么容易搞定！$

label: Route24_Text_TimmyDefeat
source: Ow!\nStomped flat!$
translation: 啊！\n被牵制住了！$

label: Route24_Text_TimmyPostBattle
source: I did my best. I have no regrets!$
translation: 我尽力了，我不后悔！$

label: Route24_Text_AliIntro
source: I'm second!\nNow it's serious!$
translation: 我是2号！\n现在要认真了！$

label: Route24_Text_AliDefeat
source: How could I lose?$
translation: 我是怎么输的？$

label: Route24_Text_AliPostBattle
source: I did my best. I have no regrets!$
translation: 我尽力了，我不后悔！$

label: Route24_Text_CaleIntro
source: People call this the NUGGET\nBRIDGE!\pBeat us five TRAINERS and win\na fabulous prize!\pThink you got what it takes?$
translation: 人们把这里称作\n金珠大桥！\p战胜我们五个训练家就可以\n获得一份神秘大礼！\p你能得到它吗？$

label: Route24_Text_CaleDefeat
source: Whoo!\nGood stuff!$
translation: 呼！\n好家伙！$

label: Route24_Text_CalePostBattle
source: I did my best. I have no regrets!$
translation: 我尽力了。我不后悔！$

label: Route25_Text_JoeyIntro
source: Local TRAINERS come here to\npractice.$
translation: 本地的训练家都来这儿练习。$

label: Route25_Text_JoeyDefeat
source: You're decent.$
translation: 你很厉害啊。$

label: Route25_Text_JoeyPostBattle
source: All POKéMON have weaknesses.\nEven the strongest ones.\pThat's why it's best to raise\nPOKéMON of different types.$
translation: 任何宝可梦都有弱点。\n哪怕是所谓的最强的。\p所以最好培养\n不同种类的宝可梦。$

label: Route25_Text_DanIntro
source: Dad took me to a great party on\nthe S.S. ANNE at VERMILION CITY.$
translation: 爸爸带着我在枯叶市的\n圣特安努号参加了一次大型的聚会。$

label: Route25_Text_DanDefeat
source: I'm not mad!$
translation: 我没疯！$

label: Route25_Text_DanPostBattle
source: On the S.S. ANNE, I saw TRAINERS\nfrom around the world.$
translation: 在圣特安努号，我看见了\n从世界各地来的训练家。$

label: Route25_Text_FlintIntro
source: I'm a cool guy.\nI've got a girlfriend!$
translation: 我很帅。\n我已经有女朋友了！$

label: Route25_Text_FlintDefeat
source: Aww, darn…$
translation: 唔，见鬼！$

label: Route25_Text_FlintPostBattle
source: Oh, well.\nMy girlfriend will cheer me up.$
translation: 呃，好吧。\n我女朋友会为我喝彩的。$

label: Route25_Text_KelseyIntro
source: Hi!\nMy boyfriend is cool!$
translation: 嗨！\n我男朋友很帅！$

label: Route25_Text_KelseyDefeat
source: My conditioning isn't the best…$
translation: 我的条件不是最好的......$

label: Route25_Text_KelseyPostBattle
source: I wish my boyfriend was as good\nas you.$
translation: 我希望我的男朋友\n和你一样厉害。$

label: Route25_Text_ChadIntro
source: I had this feeling…\nI knew I had to battle you!$
translation: 我有一种感觉......\n我感到我必须和你战斗！$

label: Route25_Text_ChadDefeat
source: I knew I'd lose, too!$
translation: 我知道我也是会输的！$

label: Route25_Text_ChadPostBattle
source: If your POKéMON gets confused,\nswitch it out.\pThat's a good tactic.$
translation: 如果你的宝可梦混乱了，\n就把它交换下场换上另一只。\p这是一种有名的战术。$

label: Route25_Text_HaleyIntro
source: My friend has many cute POKéMON.\nI'm so jealous!$
translation: 我的朋友拥有很多可爱的宝可梦。\n我很羡慕！$

label: Route25_Text_HaleyDefeat
source: I'm not so jealous!$
translation: 我也不是那么很羡慕！$

label: Route25_Text_HaleyPostBattle
source: You came from MT. MOON?\nMay I have a CLEFAIRY?$
translation: 你是从月见山来的？\n能给我一只皮皮吗？$

label: Route25_Text_FranklinIntro
source: I just got down from MT. MOON,\nbut I've still got gas in the tank!$
translation: 我刚刚从月见山上下来，\n但是我依然精力充沛。$

label: Route25_Text_FranklinDefeat
source: You worked hard!$
translation: 你很努力！$

label: Route25_Text_FranklinPostBattle
source: Drat!\nA ZUBAT bit me back in that cave.$
translation: 见鬼！那个洞穴中的\n一个超音蝠把我赶回来了。$

label: Route25_Text_NobIntro
source: I'm off to see a POKéMANIAC's\ncollection at the cape.$
translation: 我正打算去海角看\n怪兽狂的收藏。$

label: Route25_Text_NobDefeat
source: You done got me, and real good,\ntoo!$
translation: 你已经完成了，\n真的很了不起！$

label: Route25_Text_NobPostBattle
source: The POKéMANIAC sure lives up to\nhis name.\pHis collection includes many rare\nspecies of POKéMON.$
translation: 怪兽狂确实名副其实。\p他的收藏包括了很多\n珍贵品种的宝可梦。$

label: Route25_Text_WayneIntro
source: You're going to see BILL?\nFirst, we battle!$
translation: 你打算去看正辉？\n首先，我们战斗吧！$

label: Route25_Text_WayneDefeat
source: You're something.$
translation: 你有两下子。$

label: Route25_Text_WaynePostBattle
source: The trail below is a shortcut to\nCERULEAN CITY.$
translation: 下面的小路是去\n华蓝市的捷径。$

label: Route25_Text_SeaCottageSign
source: SEA COTTAGE\nBILL lives here!$
translation: 海角小屋\n正辉住在这儿！$

label: Route25_Text_MistyHighHopesAboutThisPlace
source: This cape is a famous date spot.\pMISTY, the GYM LEADER, has high\nhopes about this place.$
translation: 这个海角是一个著名的景点。\p道馆馆主小霞也十分\n憧憬着这儿。$

label: Route25_Text_AreYouHereAlone
source: Hello, are you here alone?\pIf you're out at CERULEAN's cape…\nWell, it should be as a couple.$
translation: 嗨，你一个人来这儿吗？\p如果你想去华蓝的海角......\n你最好找个伴和你一起去。$

label: Route25_SeaCottage_Text_ImBillHelpMeOutPal
source:
Hiya! I'm a POKéMON…
…No I'm not!\pCall me BILL!
I'm a true-blue POKéMANIAC!\pHey!
What's with that skeptical look?\pI'm not joshing you, pal.\pI screwed up an experiment and got
combined with a POKéMON!\pSo, how about it?
Help me out here!$
translation:
哈！我是一只宝可梦......
不对，我才不是！\p我是正辉！
我是一个货真价实的怪兽狂！\p嘿！
为什么要摆出一副怀疑的表情？\p朋友，我没和你开玩笑！\p我试验失败了然后和
一只宝可梦合体了！\p那么，怎么样？
帮我恢复原状吧！$

label: Route25_SeaCottage_Text_ImBillHelpMeOutLady
source:
Hiya! I'm a POKéMON…
…No I'm not!\pCall me BILL!
I'm a true-blue POKéMANIAC!\pHey!
What's with that skeptical look?\pI'm not joshing you, lady.\pI screwed up an experiment and got
combined with a POKéMON!\pSo, how about it?
Help me out here!$
translation:
哈！我是一只宝可梦......
不对，我才不是！\p我是正辉！
我是一个货真价实的怪兽狂！\p嘿！
为什么要摆出一副怀疑的表情？\p小姐，我没和你开玩笑！\p我试验失败了然后和
一只宝可梦合体了！\p那么，你觉得怎么样？
帮我恢复原状吧！$

label: Route25_SeaCottage_Text_RunCellSeparationOnPC
source: Wait till I get inside the\nTELEPORTER.\pWhen I do, go to my PC and run\nthe Cell Separation System.$
translation: 请先等我进入\n传送装置。\p等我进去了以后，去我的电脑运行\n细胞分离系统。$

label: Route25_SeaCottage_Text_NoPleaseChief
source:
No!?
Now don't be so cold!\pCome on, you gotta help a guy in
deep, deep trouble!\pWhat do you say, chief?
Please?\lOkay?\lAll right!$
translation:
不！？
你不能这么冷淡！\p拜托，你一定要帮我这个陷入了
大-大-大麻烦的人！\p怎样，帅哥？
好吧？\l行吧？\l太好了！$

label: Route25_SeaCottage_Text_NoPleaseBeautiful
source:
No!?
Now don't be so cold!\pCome on, you gotta help a guy in
deep, deep trouble!\pWhat do you say, beautiful?
Please?\lOkay?\lAll right!$
translation:
不！？
你不能这么冷淡！\p拜托，你一定要帮我这个陷入了
大-大-大麻烦的人！\p怎样，美女？
好吧？\l行吧？\l太好了！$

label: Route25_SeaCottage_Text_ThanksBudTakeThis
source:
BILL: Yeehah!
Thanks, bud! I owe you one!\pSo, did you come to see my
POKéMON collection?\pYou didn't?
That's a bummer.\pI've got to thank you…
Oh, here, maybe this'll do.$
translation:
正辉：啊呀呀呀！
谢了，兄弟！我欠你一次！\p嗯，你看过我的
宝可梦收藏了吗？\p还没有？
太可惜了。\p我该怎样表达我的谢意......
啊，这个，这个应该不错的。$

label: Route25_SeaCottage_Text_ThanksLadyTakeThis
source:
BILL: Yeehah!
Thanks, lady! I owe you one!\pSo, did you come to see my
POKéMON collection?\pYou didn't?
That's a bummer.\pI've got to thank you…
Oh, here, maybe this'll do.$
translation:
正辉：啊呀呀呀！
谢了，小姐！我欠你一次！\p嗯，你看过我的
宝可梦收藏了吗？\p还没有？
太可惜了。\p我该怎样表达我的谢意......
啊，这个，这应该不错的。$

label: Route25_SeaCottage_Text_ReceivedSSTicketFromBill
source: {PLAYER} received an S.S. TICKET\nfrom BILL.$
translation: {PLAYER}从正辉手上\n接过船票。$

label: Route25_SeaCottage_Text_YouveGotTooMuchStuff
source: You've got too much stuff!$
translation: 你身上的东西太多了！$

label: Route25_SeaCottage_Text_SSAnnePartyYouGoInstead
source:
That cruise ship S.S. ANNE is in
VERMILION CITY.\pI hear there are lots of TRAINERS
on board, too.\pThey invited me to their party, but
I can't stand fancy do's.\pWhy don't you go instead of me?
Go on and have a good time.$
translation:
这艘圣特安努号巡航船
现在停在枯叶市。\p我听说有很多训练家
都会上船。\p他们邀请过我，
不过我不习惯这种大场面。\p所以你能代替我去吗？
去好好享受吧。$

label: Route25_SeaCottage_Text_CheckOutRareMonsOnPC
source: BILL: Feel like checking out some\nof my rare POKéMON on my PC?\pGo on, check out my PC.$
translation: 正辉：想要在我的电脑上\n看我珍贵的宝可梦？\p那就请看吧。$

label: Route25_SeaCottage_Text_TeleporterIsDisplayed
source: TELEPORTER is displayed on the PC\nmonitor.$
translation: 传送装置显示在\n电脑的屏幕上。$

label: Route25_SeaCottage_Text_InitiatedTeleportersCellSeparator
source: {PLAYER} initiated the TELEPORTER's\nCell Separator.$
translation: {PLAYER}启动了传送装置的\n细胞分离器。$

label: Route25_SeaCottage_Text_BillsFavoriteMonList
source: BILL's favorite POKéMON list!$
translation: 正辉的最爱的宝可梦列表！$

label: Route25_SeaCottage_Text_SeeWhichMon
source: Which POKéMON do you want to see?$
translation: 你想看哪只宝可梦？$

label: Route2_EastBuilding_Text_GiveHM05IfSeen10Mons
source:
Hi! Remember me?
I'm one of PROF. OAK's AIDES.\pIf your POKéDEX has complete data
on ten species, I'm supposed to\lgive you a reward.\pPROF. OAK entrusted me with
HM05 for you.\pSo, {PLAYER}, let me ask you.\pHave you gathered data on at least
ten kinds of POKéMON?$
translation:
嗨！还记得我吗？
我是一个大木博士的助手。\p如果你的宝可梦图鉴收集了十个
数据，我会给你\l一个小奖品。\p大木博士委托我带
HM05给你。\p{PLAYER}，我问问你。\p你收集了十个不同
的宝可梦数据了吗？$

label: Route2_EastBuilding_Text_GreatHereYouGo
source: Great! You have caught or owned\n{STR_VAR_3} kinds of POKéMON!\pCongratulations!\nHere you go!$
translation: 太好了！你已经拥有了\n{STR_VAR_3}种宝可梦的数据！\p恭喜你！\n它是你的了！$

label: Route2_EastBuilding_Text_ReceivedHM05FromAide
source: {PLAYER} received HM05\nfrom the AIDE.$
translation: {PLAYER}从助手那里\n得到了HM05。$

label: Route2_EastBuilding_Text_ExplainHM05
source: HM05 contains the hidden move\nFLASH.\pFLASH lights up even the darkest\nof caves and dungeons.$
translation: HM05包含了隐藏技能\n闪光。\p闪光能照亮黑暗的洞穴\n和隧道。$

label: Route2_EastBuilding_Text_CanGetThroughRockTunnel
source: Once a POKéMON learns FLASH, you\ncan get through ROCK TUNNEL.$
translation: 一旦有宝可梦学会了闪光，\n你就能通过岩山隧道了。$

label: Route2_Text_RouteSign
source: ROUTE 2\nVIRIDIAN CITY - PEWTER CITY$
translation: 2号道路\n常青市-深灰市$

label: Route2_Text_DiglettsCave
source: 地鼠洞$
translation: 地鼠洞穴$

label: Route2_House_Text_FaintedMonsCanUseFieldMoves
source: A fainted POKéMON just has no\nenergy left to battle.\pIt can still use moves like CUT\noutside of battle.$
translation: 虚弱的宝可梦会没有力量\n继续战斗。\p但它仍然可以在战斗外\n使用像居合斩的这类技能。$

label: Route2_ViridianForest_NorthEntrance_Text_ManyMonsOnlyInForests
source: Many POKéMON live only in forests \nand caves.\pYou need to be persistent and look\neverywhere to get different kinds.$
translation: 很多宝可梦只生活在\n森林和洞穴里。\p你需要持续地四处搜寻\n来得到不同的种类。$

label: Route2_ViridianForest_NorthEntrance_Text_CanCutSkinnyTrees
source: Have you noticed the skinny trees\non the roadside?\pThey can be cut down by a special\nPOKéMON move, I hear.$
translation: 你有没有注意到路边\n细小的树木？\p我听说它们能被一种宝可梦的\n特殊技能斩断。$

label: Route2_ViridianForest_NorthEntrance_Text_CanCancelEvolution
source:
Do you know the evolution-cancel
technique?\pWhen a POKéMON is evolving, you
can stop the process.\pIt's a technique for raising
POKéMON the way they are.$
translation:
你知道怎么
取消进化吗？\p当一只宝可梦正在进化的时候，
你能够使它停下来。\p这个窍门是养育宝可梦
的一种方式。$

label: Route2_ViridianForest_SouthEntrance_Text_ForestIsMaze
source: Are you going to VIRIDIAN FOREST?\nIt's a natural maze in there.\lBe careful you don't get lost.$
translation: 你准备去常青森林吗？\n那里是个天然的迷宫。\l小心别迷路了。$

label: Route2_ViridianForest_SouthEntrance_Text_RattataHasWickedBite
source: RATTATA may be small, but don't\nunderestimate its wicked bite.\pHave you caught one already?$
translation: 小拉达虽小，\n但它能到处乱咬。\p你有抓到过一只吗？$

label: Route3_Text_TunnelFromCeruleanTiring
source: Whew… I better take a rest…\nGroan…\pThat tunnel from CERULEAN takes a\nlot out of you!$
translation: 呼......我最好小睡一下......\n呃......\p那条从华蓝过来的隧道\n省了你们很多事！$

label: Route3_Text_ColtonIntro
source: Hey!\nI saw you in VIRIDIAN FOREST!$
translation: 嘿！\n我在常青森林见过你！$

label: Route3_Text_ColtonDefeat
source: You beat me again!$
translation: 你又打败了我！$

label: Route3_Text_ColtonPostBattle
source: There are other kinds of POKéMON\nthan the ones you find in forests.$
translation: 除了你在森林里看到的那些宝可梦以外，\n还有很多其它的宝可梦。$

label: Route3_Text_BenIntro
source: Hi!\nI like shorts!\pThey're delightfully comfy and\neasy to wear!$
translation: 嗨！\n我喜欢短裤！\p短裤穿着很舒服让人心情很愉快，\n而且穿起来很方便！$

label: Route3_Text_BenDefeat
source: I don't believe it!$
translation: 不敢相信！$

label: Route3_Text_BenPostBattle
source: Are you using a POKéMON CENTER's\nPC for storing your POKéMON?\pEach BOX can hold up to\n30 POKéMON.$
translation: 你用过宝可梦中心的电脑\n来存放宝可梦吗？\p每个盒子最多可以存放30个宝可梦。$

label: Route3_Text_JaniceIntro
source: Excuse me!\nYou looked at me, didn't you?$
translation: 不好意思！\n你在盯着我看，我没说错吧？$

label: Route3_Text_JaniceDefeat
source: You're mean!$
translation: 你可真厉害！$

label: Route3_Text_JanicePostBattle
source: You shouldn't be staring if you\ndon't want to battle!$
translation: 如果你不想战斗的话，\n就不该盯着我看哦！$

label: Route3_Text_GregIntro
source: Are you a TRAINER?\nLet's get with it right away!$
translation: 你是一个训练家吗？\n让我们马上对战吧！$

label: Route3_Text_GregDefeat
source: If I had new POKéMON, I would've\nwon!$
translation: 要不是因为我没新的宝可梦，\n我就赢了！$

label: Route3_Text_GregPostBattle
source: If a POKéMON BOX on the PC gets\nfull, just switch to another BOX.$
translation: 如果电脑里的一个宝可梦寄存箱满了，\n就切换到另一个盒子去。$

label: Route3_Text_SallyIntro
source: That look you gave me…\nIt's so intriguing!$
translation: 似乎你总在让着我......\n这真是太有趣了！$

label: Route3_Text_SallyDefeat
source: Be nice!$
translation: 做人要厚道啊！$

label: Route3_Text_SallyPostBattle
source: You can avoid battles by not\nletting TRAINERS see you.$
translation: 你可以躲开训练家不让他们看到你，\n以此来避开战斗。$

label: Route3_Text_CalvinIntro
source: Hey! You're not wearing shorts!\nWhat's wrong with you?$
translation: 嘿！你没有短裤！\n为什么？$

label: Route3_Text_CalvinDefeat
source: Lost!\nLost! Lost!$
translation: 输了！\n输了！输了！$

label: Route3_Text_CalvinPostBattle
source: I always wear shorts, even in\nwinter. That's my policy.$
translation: 我总是穿短裤，在冬天也一样。\n这是我做人的原则。$

label: Route3_Text_JamesIntro
source: I'll battle you with the POKéMON\nI just caught.$
translation: 我要用刚收服的宝可梦\n和你对战。$

label: Route3_Text_JamesDefeat
source: Done like dinner!$
translation: 平淡无奇！$

label: Route3_Text_JamesPostBattle
source: Trained POKéMON are stronger than\nthe wild ones.$
translation: 训练过的宝可梦会比野生的更强。$

label: Route3_Text_RobinIntro
source: Eek!\nDid you touch me?$
translation: 呀！\n你刚才碰到了我的身体？$

label: Route3_Text_RobinDefeat
source: That's it?$
