translation: 结束了？$

label: Route3_Text_RobinPostBattle
source: ROUTE 4 is at the foot of\nMT. MOON.$
translation: 4号道路在月见山脚下。$

label: Route3_Text_RouteSign
source: ROUTE 3\nMT. MOON AHEAD$
translation: 3号道路\n往前走是月见山$

label: Route4_Text_TrippedOverGeodude
source: Ouch! I tripped over a rocky\nPOKéMON, GEODUDE!$
translation: 哎哟！我被一只岩石宝可梦绊倒了，\n是小拳石啊！$

label: Route4_Text_CrissyIntro
source: I came to MT. MOON in search of\nmushroom POKéMON.$
translation: 我来月见山寻找蘑菇宝可梦。$

label: Route4_Text_CrissyDefeat
source: After all I did to catch them!$
translation: 这次我一定要抓到它们！$

label: Route4_Text_CrissyPostBattle
source: There might not be any more\nmushrooms here.\pI think I got them all.$
translation: 这里应该已经没有蘑菇了。\p可能已经都被我采光了。$

label: Route4_Text_MtMoonEntrance
source: MT. MOON\nTunnel Entrance$
translation: 月见山\n山洞的入口$

label: Route4_Text_RouteSign
source: ROUTE 4\nMT. MOON - CERULEAN CITY$
translation: 4号道路\n月见山-华蓝市$

label: Text_MegaPunchTeach
source: A punch of roaring ferocity!\pPacked with destructive power!\pWhen the chips are down,\nMEGA PUNCH is the ultimate attack!\lYou agree, yes?\pNow!\nLet me teach it to your POKéMON!$
translation: 一声巨响！\p伴随着毁灭性的力量！\p在关键时刻，\n百万吨重拳就是最强悍的攻击！\l你也这么认为吧？\p现在！\n让我教你的宝可梦学会这个技能！$

label: Text_MegaPunchDeclined
source: You'll be back when you understand\nthe worth of MEGA PUNCH.$
translation: 当你知道百万吨重拳价值的时候，\n你一定会回来的。$

label: Text_MegaPunchWhichMon
source: Fine!\nWhich POKéMON will learn it?$
translation: 很好！\n想要让哪只宝可梦学习？$

label: Text_MegaPunchTaught
source: Now, we are comrades in the way of\npunching!\pYou should go before you're seen\nby the misguided fool who trains\lonly his silly kicking over there.$
translation: 现在，\n我们算是同一流派的人了！\p你得快点走，\n小心被在那边那个只知道\l一味训练攻击力的傻瓜发现。$

label: Text_MegaKickTeach
source: A kick of brutal ferocity!\pPacked with destructive power!\pWhen you get right down to it,\nMEGA KICK is the ultimate attack!\lDon't you agree?\pOkay!\nI'll teach it to your POKéMON!$
translation: 一次凶狠的踢击！\p伴随着毁灭性的力量！\p你若能善用百万吨重踢时，\n它会成为最强悍的攻击！\l你也这么认为吧？\p好的！\n让我教你的宝可梦使用这个技能！$

label: Text_MegaKickDeclined
source: You'll come crawling back when you\nrealize the value of MEGA KICK.$
translation: 当你意识到百万吨重踢的价值时，\n你一定会回来的。$

label: Text_MegaKickWhichMon
source: All right!\nWhich POKéMON wants to learn it?$
translation: 很好！\n想要让哪只宝可梦学习？$

label: Text_MegaKickTaught
source: Now, we are soul mates in the way\nof kicking!\pYou should run before you're seen\nby the deluded nitwit who trains\lonly simple punching over there.$
translation: 现在，\n我们算是同一流派的人了！\p你得快点走，\n小心被在那边那个只知道\l一味训练攻击力的傻瓜发现。$

label: Route4_Text_PeopleLikeAndRespectBrock
source:
Oh, wow, that's the BOULDERBADGE!
You got it from BROCK, didn't you?\pBROCK is cool. He's not just tough.
People like and respect him.\pI want to become a GYM LEADER
like him.$
translation:
哇，那是灰色徽章！
你从小刚那里得到的，没错吧？\p小刚不仅冷静，还很坚强。
人们都很喜欢他，尊敬他。\p我想成为像他一样的
道馆馆主。$

label: Route4_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_CanHaveSixMonsWithYou
source: Okay, set six POKé BALLS in my\nbelt…\pYeah, that'll do it. At most, you\ncan have six POKéMON with you.$
translation: 好，在我的腰带上\n放置六个精灵球......\p没错，就是这样。你最多只能\n带六只宝可梦随行。$

label: Route4_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_TeamRocketAttacksCerulean
source: TEAM ROCKET attacks CERULEAN\ncitizens…\pNot a day goes by without TEAM\nROCKET being in the news.$
translation: 火箭队袭击了华蓝市\n的居民......\p没有哪天的新闻里\n不出现火箭队。$

label: Route4_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_LaddieBuyMagikarpForJust500
source: MAN: Hello there, laddie!\nHave I got a deal just for you!\pI'll let you have a secret POKéMON\n- a MAGIKARP - for just ¥500!\pSo, you'll buy it, am I right?$
translation: 男子：看这里，少年！\n这笔好买卖我留着就等着和你做！\p神秘又强大的宝可梦鲤鱼王，\n惊喜价只要500！\p你肯定会买下它，对吧？$

label: Route4_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_SweetieBuyMagikarpForJust500
source: MAN: Hello there, sweetie pie!\nHave I got a deal just for you!\pI'll let you have a secret POKéMON\n- a MAGIKARP - for just ¥500!\pSo, you'll buy it, am I right?$
translation: 男子：看这里，少女！\n这笔好买卖我留着就等着和你做！\p神秘又强大的宝可梦鲤鱼王，\n惊喜价只要500！\p你肯定会买下它，对吧？$

label: Route4_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_PaidOutrageouslyForMagikarp
source: {PLAYER} paid an outrageous ¥500\nand bought the MAGIKARP…$
translation: {PLAYER}付了500元，\n得到了鲤鱼王......$

label: Route4_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_OnlyDoingThisAsFavorToYou
source: No? You say no? I'm only doing this\nas a favor to you!$
translation: 不？你说不？\n我已经给了你最大的优惠了！$

label: Route4_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_NoRoomForMorePokemon
source: There's no more room for any more\nPOKéMON, it looks like.$
translation: 看起来好像没有足够的空间\n来放更多的宝可梦了。$

label: Route4_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_YoullNeedMoreMoney
source: You'll need more money than that!$
translation: 你的钱不够！$

label: Route4_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_IDontGiveRefunds
source: MAN: Well, I don't give refunds.\nYou knew what you were getting!$
translation: 男子：一旦售出，绝不退款。\n买之前你就该想好！$

label: Route4_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_ShouldStoreMonsUsingPC
source: Sometimes, you'll have too many\nPOKéMON with you to add any more.\pIn that case, you should just\nstore some using any PC.$
translation: 有时，你带的宝可梦太多了\n以至于不能再增加新的。\p这样的话，你应该用任意电脑\n存放一些。$

label: Route4_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_ItsANewspaper
source: It's a newspaper.$
translation: 这是一份报纸。$

label: Route5_Text_UndergroundPathSign
source: UNDERGROUND PATH\nCERULEAN CITY - VERMILION CITY$
translation: 地下通道\n华蓝市-枯叶市$

label: Route5_PokemonDayCare_Text_WantMeToRaiseMon
source: I run the DAY-CARE service.\pWould you like me to raise one of\nyour POKéMON?$
translation: 我开着这家培育屋。\p你需要寄养一只\n你的宝可梦吗？$

label: Route5_PokemonDayCare_Text_ComeAgain
source: Come again.$
translation: 欢迎再来。$

label: Route5_PokemonDayCare_Text_WhichMonShouldIRaise
source: Which POKéMON should I raise?$
translation: 你要寄养哪只宝可梦？$

label: Route5_PokemonDayCare_Text_ComeAnytimeYouLike
source: Fine.\nCome anytime you like.$
translation: 好的。\n随时欢迎你再来。$

label: Route5_PokemonDayCare_Text_LookAfterMonForAWhile
source: Fine, I'll look after your\n{STR_VAR_1} for a while.$
translation: 好的，我会照顾你的\n{STR_VAR_1}一段时间。$

label: Route5_PokemonDayCare_Text_ComeSeeMeInAWhile
source: Come see me in a while.$
translation: 过一会儿来见我。$

label: Route5_PokemonDayCare_Text_MonNeedsToSpendMoreTime
source: You're back already?\pYour {STR_VAR_1} needs to spend\nsome more time with me.$
translation: 你回来的这么快？\p你的{STR_VAR_1}需要和我\n多呆一会儿。$

label: Route5_PokemonDayCare_Text_OweMeXForMonsReturn
source: You owe me ¥{STR_VAR_2} for the return\nof this POKéMON.$
translation: 想要取回这只宝可梦的话\n需要支付我{STR_VAR_2}元$

label: Route5_PokemonDayCare_Text_ThankYouHeresMon
source: Thank you!\nHere's your POKéMON.$
translation: 谢谢。\n这是你的宝可梦。$

label: Route5_PokemonDayCare_Text_PlayerGotMonBack
source: {PLAYER} got {STR_VAR_1} back\nfrom the DAY-CARE MAN.$
translation: {PLAYER}从培育屋爷爷那儿 \n取回了{STR_VAR_1}。$

label: Route5_PokemonDayCare_Text_OnlyHaveOneMonWithYou
source: Oh? You only have one POKéMON\nwith you.$
translation: 哦？你的身上只有\n一只宝可梦了。$

label: Route5_PokemonDayCare_Text_WhatWillYouBattleWith
source: If you leave me that POKéMON,\nwhat will you battle with?$
translation: 如果你把那只宝可梦存到我这里，\n你用什么来战斗呢？$

label: Route5_PokemonDayCare_Text_MonHasGrownByXLevels
source: Your {STR_VAR_1} has grown a lot.\nYes, quite a lot, I'd say.\pLet me see…\nBy level, it's grown by {STR_VAR_2}.\pAren't I great?$
translation: 你的{STR_VAR_1}成长了很多。\n嗯，说实话，真的很多。\p我看看......\n它的等级已经上升了{STR_VAR_2}。\p是不是很棒啊？$

label: Route5_PokemonDayCare_Text_YouveGotNoRoomForIt
source: You can't take this POKéMON back\nif you've got no room for it.$
translation: 你的身上已经没有足够的空间，\n所以你不能把这只宝可梦取回。$

label: Route5_PokemonDayCare_Text_DontHaveEnoughMoney
source: 你的钱不够。$
translation: 你的钱不够。$

label: Route5_SouthEntrance_Text_ThirstyOnGuardDuty
source: I'm on guard duty.\nGee, I'm thirsty, though!\pOh, wait there, the road's closed.$
translation: 呃，我虽然很口渴得要命。\n但我仍然在第一线执勤！\p喂，站住！那条路禁止通行！$

label: Route5_SouthEntrance_Text_ThatTeaLooksTasty
source: Oh, that TEA…\nIt looks awfully tasty…$
translation: 诶，那个茶......\n看起来很好喝的样子......$

label: Route5_SouthEntrance_Text_ThanksIllShareTeaWithGuards
source: Huh? I can have this drink?\nGee, thanks!\l… …\lGlug, glug…\l… …\lGulp…\lIf you want to go to SAFFRON\lCITY…\l… …\lYou can go on through.\pI'll share this TEA with the other\nguards!$
translation: 嗯？我能喝这个吗？\n呃，谢谢！\l......\l咕噜......咕噜......\l......\l嗯......\l如果你想去\l金黄市的话......\l......\l就去吧。\p我去和其他的警卫\n一起分了这杯茶。$

label: Route5_SouthEntrance_Text_HiHowsItGoing
source: Hi, how's it going?$
translation: 嗨，最近过得怎么样啊？$

label: Route6_Text_RickyIntro
source: Who's there?\nQuit listening in on us!$
translation: 是谁？\n竟敢偷听我们讲话！$

label: Route6_Text_RickyDefeat
source: I just can't win!$
translation: 我老是赢不了！$

label: Route6_Text_RickyPostBattle
source: Whisper…\nWhisper…$

label: Route6_Text_NancyIntro
source: Excuse me!\nThis is a private conversation!$
translation: 抱歉！\n我们在讲悄悄话！$

label: Route6_Text_NancyDefeat
source: Ugh!\nI hate losing.$
translation: 唉！\n我讨厌失败。$

label: Route6_Text_NancyPostBattle
source: Whisper…\nWhisper…$

label: Route6_Text_KeigoIntro
source: There aren't many bugs out here.$
translation: 这外面没有什么虫子。$

label: Route6_Text_KeigoDefeat
source: No!\nYou're kidding!$
translation: 不！\n你在开玩笑吧！$

label: Route6_Text_KeigoPostBattle
source: I like bugs, so I'm going back to\nVIRIDIAN FOREST.$
translation: 我喜欢虫子，\n所以我要回到常青森林。$

label: Route6_Text_JeffIntro
source: Huh?\nYou want to talk to me?$
translation: 呃？\n你想跟我谈谈？$

label: Route6_Text_JeffDefeat
source: This stinks…\nI couldn't beat your challenge…$
translation: 太糟糕了......\n我输掉了这场对决......$

label: Route6_Text_JeffPostBattle
source: I should bring more POKéMON with\nme. I'll feel safer that way.$
translation: 我要带更多的宝可梦，\n这样我才会有安全感。$

label: Route6_Text_IsabelleIntro
source: Me?\nWell, okay. I'll play!$
translation: 我？\n好的，那就来吧！$

label: Route6_Text_IsabelleDefeat
source: Things just didn't work…$
translation: 事情并没有进展......$

label: Route6_Text_IsabellePostBattle
source: I want to get stronger.\nWhat's your secret?$
translation: 我想变得更强。\n你的秘诀是什么？$

label: Route6_Text_ElijahIntro
source: I've never seen you around.\nAre you good?$
translation: 我在这附近没见过你。\n你厉害吗？$

label: Route6_Text_ElijahDefeat
source: You're too good!$
translation: 你太厉害了！$

label: Route6_Text_ElijahPostBattle
source: Are my POKéMON weak?\nOr, am I just bad?\lWhich do you think?$
translation: 是我的宝可梦很弱？\n还是我很差劲？\l你觉得是哪个？$

label: Route6_Text_UndergroundPathSign
source: UNDERGROUND PATH\nCERULEAN CITY - VERMILION CITY$
translation: 地下通道\n华蓝市-枯叶市$

label: Route6_NorthEntrance_Text_ThirstyOnGuardDuty
source: I'm on guard duty.\nGee, I'm thirsty, though!\pOh, wait there, the road's closed.$
translation: 呃，我虽然很口渴得要命。\n但我仍然在第一线执勤！\p喂，站住！那条路禁止通行！$

label: Route6_NorthEntrance_Text_ThatTeaLooksTasty
source: Oh, that TEA…\nIt looks awfully tasty…$
translation: 诶，那个茶......\n看起来很好喝的样子......$

label: Route6_NorthEntrance_Text_ThanksIllShareTeaWithGuards
source: Huh? I can have this drink?\nGee, thanks!\l… …\lGlug, glug…\l… …\lGulp…\lIf you want to go to SAFFRON\lCITY…\l… …\lYou can go on through.\pI'll share this TEA with the other\nguards!$
translation: 嗯？我能喝这个吗？\n呃，谢谢！\l......\l咕噜......咕噜......\l......\l嗯......\l如果你想去\l金黄市的话......\l......\l就去吧。\p我去和其他的警卫\n一起分了这杯茶。$

label: Route6_NorthEntrance_Text_HiHowsItGoing
source: Hi, how's it going?$
translation: 嗨，最近过得怎么样啊？$

label: Route7_EastEntrance_Text_ThirstyOnGuardDuty
source: I'm on guard duty.\nGee, I'm thirsty, though!\pOh, wait there, the road's closed.$
translation: 呃，我虽然很口渴得要命。\n但我仍然在第一线执勤！\p喂，站住！那条路禁止通行！$

label: Route7_EastEntrance_Text_ThatTeaLooksTasty
source: Oh, that TEA…\nIt looks awfully tasty…$
translation: 诶，那个茶......\n看起来很好喝的样子......$

label: Route7_EastEntrance_Text_ThanksIllShareTeaWithGuards
source: Huh? I can have this drink?\nGee, thanks!\l… …\lGlug, glug…\l… …\lGulp…\lIf you want to go to SAFFRON\lCITY…\l… …\lYou can go on through.\pI'll share this TEA with the other\nguards!$
translation: 嗯？我能喝这个吗？\n呃，谢谢！\l......\l咕噜......咕噜......\l......\l嗯......\l如果你想去\l金黄市的话......\l......\l就去吧。\p我去和其他的警卫\n一起分了这杯茶。$

label: Route7_EastEntrance_Text_HiHowsItGoing
source: Hi, how's it going?$
translation: 嗨，最近过得怎么样啊？$

label: Route7_Text_UndergroundPathSign
source: UNDERGROUND PATH\nCELADON CITY - LAVENDER TOWN$
translation: 地下通道\n玉虹市-紫苑镇$

label: Route8_Text_AidanIntro
source: You look good at POKéMON, but how\nis your chemistry grade?$
translation: 你看起来对宝可梦很擅长，\n但是你的化学成绩怎么样？$

label: Route8_Text_AidanDefeat
source: Ow!\nMeltdown!$
translation: 啊！\n都倒下了！$

label: Route8_Text_AidanPostBattle
source: I am better at school than this!$
translation: 我的学习成绩比这个要好！$

label: Route8_Text_StanIntro
source: All right!\nLet's play a game!$
translation: 很好！\n我们来玩个游戏吧！$

label: Route8_Text_StanDefeat
source: Drat!\nCame up short!$
translation: 可恶！\n来吧！$

label: Route8_Text_StanPostBattle
source: Things didn't work today.$
translation: 今天也没有事情可做。$

label: Route8_Text_GlennIntro
source: You should be informed.\nYou need strategy to win at this!$
translation: 你应该更灵通一些。\n想赢的话你得制定战术！$

label: Route8_Text_GlennDefeat
source: It's not logical!$
translation: 这不可能！$

label: Route8_Text_GlennPostBattle
source: Go with GRIMER first…and…\n…and…then…$

label: Route8_Text_PaigeIntro
source: I like NIDORAN, so I collect them!$
translation: 我喜欢尼多家族，所以我在收集它们！$

label: Route8_Text_PaigeDefeat
source: Why?\nWhy??$
translation: 为什么？\n为什么？？$

label: Route8_Text_PaigePostBattle
source: When POKéMON grow up, they get\nugly! They shouldn't evolve.$
translation: 宝可梦一进化，就完全不可爱了！\n所以还是不要进化的好。$

label: Route8_Text_LeslieIntro
source: School is fun, but so are POKéMON.$
translation: 学习很有趣，宝可梦也是如此。$

label: Route8_Text_LeslieDefeat
source: You made it clear to me that\nI should stick with school.$
translation: 你让我清楚地明白\n我应该继续坚持学习。$

label: Route8_Text_LesliePostBattle
source: I was planning on getting some\nfresh air for a change, but…\pWe're stuck here because of the\ngates at SAFFRON.$
translation: 我曾准备以一个新的面貌做出\n一些改变，但是......\p我们被卡在金黄的门口了。$

label: Route8_Text_AndreaIntro
source: MEOWTH is so cute, meow, meow,\nmeow!$
translation: 喵喵太可爱了，\n喵，喵，喵！$

label: Route8_Text_AndreaDefeat
source: Meeeeyow!$
translation: 喵呜！$

label: Route8_Text_AndreaPostBattle
source: I think PIDGEY and RATTATA are\ncute, too!$
translation: 我认为波波和小拉达也很可爱！$

label: Route8_Text_MeganIntro
source: We must look silly standing here\nlike this.$
translation: 我们像这样傻站在这儿\n一定显得很可笑。$

label: Route8_Text_MeganDefeat
source: Look what you did to my poor, cute\nPOKéMON!$
translation: 看你对我的可怜的，娇小的\n宝可梦做了什么！$

label: Route8_Text_MeganPostBattle
source: SAFFRON's gatekeeper won't let us\ngo through.\pI know he's doing his job, but I\nthink he's mean.$
translation: 金黄的门卫\n不让我们通过。\p虽然我知道这是他的职责，\n不过这也太小气了。$

label: Route8_Text_RichIntro
source: I'm a rambling, gaming dude!$
translation: 我是一个混乱又顽劣的家伙！$

label: Route8_Text_RichDefeat
source: Missed the big chance!$
translation: 我丢失了一个重大机会！$

label: Route8_Text_RichPostBattle
source: Playing games and POKéMON are like\neating peanuts! I just can't stop!$
translation: 一边赌博一边喂宝可梦吃东西！\n生活真是太美好了！$

label: Route8_Text_JuliaIntro
source: What's a cute, round, and fluffy\nPOKéMON?$
translation: 小小的，圆圆的，毛绒绒的\n是哪种宝可梦？$

label: Route8_Text_JuliaDefeat
source: Stop!\pDon't be so mean to my CLEFAIRY!$
translation: 停下！\p不要对我的皮皮这么无情！$

label: Route8_Text_JuliaPostBattle
source: I read that CLEFAIRY evolves when\nit's exposed to a MOON STONE.\pI read that in a POKéMON JOURNAL.\nI wonder if it's true?$
translation: 我在宝可梦特刊上读到，\p皮皮是靠月之石进化的。\n这是真的吗？$

label: Route8_Text_UndergroundPathSign
source: UNDERGROUND PATH\nCELADON CITY - LAVENDER TOWN$
translation: 地下通道\n玉虹市-紫苑镇$

label: Route8_Text_EliIntro
source: ELI: Twin power is fantastic.\nDid you know?$
translation: 莉娜：双胞胎的力量是很强大的，\n你知道吗？$

label: Route8_Text_EliDefeat
source: ELI: But…\nWe used our twin power…$
translation: 莉娜但是......\n这种力量已经用过了......$

label: Route8_Text_EliPostBattle
source: ELI: I caught my POKéMON with\nANNE!$
translation: 莉娜 我和卡娜一起抓住了我的宝可梦！$

label: Route8_Text_EliNotEnoughMons
source: ELI: We can't battle if you don't\nhave two POKéMON.$
translation: 莉娜如果你没有两只宝可梦，\n就不能和我们战斗。$

label: Route8_Text_AnneIntro
source: ANNE: We'll shock you with our twin\npower!$
translation: 卡娜 我们要用两个人的力量把你击垮！$

label: Route8_Text_AnneDefeat
source: ANNE: Our twin power…$
translation: 卡娜我们双胞胎的力量......$

label: Route8_Text_AnnePostBattle
source: ANNE: I'm raising POKéMON with\nELI.$
translation: 卡娜 我和莉娜一起培育宝可梦。$

label: Route8_Text_AnneNotEnoughMons
source: ANNE: Hi, hi! Let's battle!\nBut bring two POKéMON.$
translation: 卡娜嗨！和我们战斗吧！\n但是要带两只宝可梦喔。$

label: Route8_Text_RicardoIntro
source: My bike's acting up, man.$
translation: 老兄，我的自行车出毛病了。$

label: Route8_Text_RicardoDefeat
source: Aww, man.\nI'm not into this.$
translation: 啊。\n我进不去这里面。$

label: Route8_Text_RicardoPostBattle
source: I got grass caught up in my\nspokes, man.$
translation: 草卷入我自行车的辐条里面了。$

label: Route8_Text_JarenIntro
source: Clear the way, or I'll run you\ndown!$
translation: 给我让道，\n否则我把你压扁！$

label: Route8_Text_JarenDefeat
source: You for real, kid?$
translation: 你是来真的吗，小子？$

label: Route8_Text_JarenPostBattle
source: Don't think you're all special and\nall just because of this.$
translation: 不要认为你有多么特殊，\n没什么了不起的。$

label: Route8_WestEntrance_Text_ThirstyOnGuardDuty
source: I'm on guard duty.\nGee, I'm thirsty, though!\pOh, wait there, the road's closed.$
translation: 呃，我虽然很口渴得要命。\n但我仍然在第一线执勤！\p喂，站住！那条路禁止通行！$

label: Route8_WestEntrance_Text_ThatTeaLooksTasty
source: Oh, that TEA…\nIt looks awfully tasty…$
translation: 诶，那个茶......\n看起来很好喝的样子......$

label: Route8_WestEntrance_Text_ThanksIllShareTeaWithGuards
source: Huh? I can have this drink?\nGee, thanks!\l… …\lGlug, glug…\l… …\lGulp…\lIf you want to go to SAFFRON\lCITY…\l… …\lYou can go on through.\pI'll share this TEA with the other\nguards!$
translation: 嗯？我能喝这个吗？\n呃，谢谢！\l......\l咕噜......咕噜......\l......\l嗯......\l如果你想去\l金黄市的话......\l......\l就去吧。\p我去和其他的警卫\n一起分了这杯茶。$

label: Route8_WestEntrance_Text_HiHowsItGoing
source: Hi, how's it going?$
translation: 嗨，最近过得怎么样啊？$

label: Route9_Text_AliciaIntro
source: You have POKéMON with you!\nYou're mine!$
translation: 你带着宝可梦！\n你是我的了！$

label: Route9_Text_AliciaDefeat
source: You deceived me…$
translation: 你欺骗了我......$

label: Route9_Text_AliciaPostBattle
source: The tunnel coming up is pitch-black\ninside.\pYou'll need FLASH to get through\nthere.$
translation: 这个隧道里面一片漆黑。\p想要穿过山洞的话，\n你需要闪光。$

label: Route9_Text_ChrisIntro
source: Who's that walking there with those\ngood-looking POKéMON?$
translation: 和那些好看的宝可梦\n一起散步的人是谁？$

label: Route9_Text_ChrisDefeat
source: Out like a light!$
translation: 就像一束光！$

label: Route9_Text_ChrisPostBattle
source: Keep walking!$
translation: 继续走下去！$

label: Route9_Text_DrewIntro
source: I'm taking the ROCK TUNNEL to\ngo to LAVENDER…$
translation: 我正打算穿过岩山隧道去紫苑......$

label: Route9_Text_DrewDefeat
source: Can't measure up…$
translation: 无法估计啊......$

label: Route9_Text_DrewPostBattle
source: Are you off to ROCK TUNNEL, too?$
translation: 你也是去岩山隧道吗？$

label: Route9_Text_CaitlinIntro
source: Don't you dare patronize me!$
translation: 你竟敢这样对我！$

label: Route9_Text_CaitlinDefeat
source: No!\nYou're too much.$
translation: 不！\n你太过分了。$

label: Route9_Text_CaitlinPostBattle
source: You're obviously talented.\nGood luck to you!$
translation: 你真的很有天赋。\n祝你好运！$

label: Route9_Text_JeremyIntro
source: Bwahaha!\nGreat! I was bored, eh!$
translation: 啊！\n好样的！我很无聊，呃！$

label: Route9_Text_JeremyDefeat
source: Keep it coming, eh!\pOh wait.\nI'm out of POKéMON!$
translation: 来这儿吧！\p噢，等等。\n我离开了我的宝可梦！$

label: Route9_Text_JeremyPostBattle
source: You sure had guts standing up to\nme there, eh?$
translation: 你确定你有胆量和我对抗，嗯？$

label: Route9_Text_BriceIntro
source: Hahaha!\nAren't you a little toughie!$
translation: 哈哈！\n你有一点鲁莽！$

label: Route9_Text_BriceDefeat
source: What's that?$
translation: 那是什么？$

label: Route9_Text_BricePostBattle
source: Hahaha!\nKids should be tough!$
translation: 哈哈！\n小孩子应该坚强点！$

label: Route9_Text_BrentIntro
source: I got up early every day to raise\nmy POKéMON from cocoons!$
translation: 我每天都起得很早去\n训练我的宝可梦！$

label: Route9_Text_BrentDefeat
source: WHAT?\pWhat a total waste of time!$
translation: 什么\p多么浪费时间！$

label: Route9_Text_BrentPostBattle
source: I have to collect more than bugs\nto get stronger…$
translation: 我必须找到更多虫子\n来使我变得更强大......$

label: Route9_Text_AlanIntro
source: Hahahaha!\nBring it on!$
translation: 哈哈！\n把它带过来！$

label: Route9_Text_AlanDefeat
source: Hahahaha!\nYou beat me fair!$
translation: 呵呵！\n你堂堂正正地战胜了我！$

label: Route9_Text_AlanPostBattle
source: Hahahaha!\nUs hearty guys always laugh!$
translation: 哈哈哈哈哈！\n健壮的家伙总是会大笑的！$

label: Route9_Text_ConnerIntro
source: Go, my super BUG POKéMON!$
translation: 去吧，我的超级虫属性宝可梦$

label: Route9_Text_ConnerDefeat
source: My bugs…$
translation: 我的虫子们......$

label: Route9_Text_ConnerPostBattle
source: If you don't like BUG POKéMON,\nyou bug me!$
translation: 如果你不喜欢虫属性的宝可梦，\n那你就是看不起我$

label: Route9_Text_RouteSign
source: ROUTE 9\nCERULEAN CITY - ROCK TUNNEL$
translation: 9号道路\n华蓝市-岩山隧道$

label: RustboroCity_Text_WeShortenItToDevon
source: The DEVON CORPORATION…\nWe all just shorten it to DEVON.\pThat company makes all sorts of\nconvenient products.$
translation: 得文公司......\n我们简称为得文。\p那家公司发明了\n很多便利的产品。$

label: RustboroCity_Text_SneakyLookingManWentAroundCorner
source: Hm? A sneaky-looking man?\pCome to think of it, yes, a shady-\nlooking guy went around the corner.$
translation: 嗯？鬼鬼祟祟的人？\p说起来，好像的确有个\n可疑的家伙绕过那个拐角了。$

label: RustboroCity_Text_HaveYouChallengedGym
source: Have you taken the POKéMON GYM\nchallenge?\pWhen you get that shiny GYM BADGE\nin hand, I guess TRAINERS begin to\lrealize what is required of them.$
translation: 你去挑战过\n宝可梦道馆了吗？\p手中拿着那闪闪发光的\n道馆徽章时，我想训练家们\l都会意识到他们肩上负担的是什么。$

label: RustboroCity_Text_HeyThatsRustborosGymBadge
source: Hey, that's RUSTBORO's GYM BADGE!\pOut of all the POKéMON GYM BADGES,\nRUSTBORO's is the coolest, I'd say.$
translation: 呀，那是卡那兹市的道馆徽章！\p我觉得，所有宝可梦道馆徽章之中，\n卡那兹市的是最漂亮的。$

label: RustboroCity_Text_YoureNewAroundHere
source: Oh? Who might you be?\nYou're a new face around these parts.\pHave you just transferred into the\nPOKéMON TRAINER'S SCHOOL?$
translation: 哦？你是谁？\n好像在附近没看到过你。\p你是新转来\n宝可梦训练家学校的吗？$

label: RustboroCity_Text_GymLeaderIsntEasyWithFire
source: I challenged the GYM LEADER, but…\pIt's not going to be easy winning with\nmy FIRE-type POKéMON…\pFIRE-type POKéMON don't match up\nwell against ROCK-type POKéMON…$
translation: 我挑战过道馆馆主，但是......\p我的火属性宝可梦\n很难打赢他们......\p火属性宝可梦\n被岩石属性宝可梦克制......$

label: RustboroCity_Text_MrBrineyWalksInTheTunnel
source: The old sailor MR. BRINEY lives in\na cottage by the sea.\pHe goes for walks in the tunnel every\nso often.$
translation: 老水手哈奇住在\n海边的小屋里，\p他经常去\n隧道里散步。$

label: RustboroCity_Text_MrBrineyLovesPeeko
source:
The old sailor MR. BRINEY lives in
a cottage by the sea.\pHe said he was going shopping in
SLATEPORT for his pet, PEEKO.\pThat old sea dog, he must really love
that PEEKO.$
translation:
老水手哈奇住在
海边的小屋里，\p他说要去凯那市
为他的宠物小皮买些东西。\p那个老水手
一定很爱他的小皮。$

label: RustboroCity_Text_WowYouHavePokemon
source: Wow, you have POKéMON with you, too.\pWhen I get bigger, I'm going to go\nplaces with POKéMON, too.$
translation: 哇，你也带着宝可梦！\p我长大以后\n也要带宝可梦一起去旅行。$

label: RustboroCity_Text_CatchRarePokemonIfIGoToSchool
source: POKéMON TRAINER'S SCHOOL!\pIf I go to this school, will I be able\nto catch rare POKéMON easily?$
translation: 宝可梦训练家学校！\p如果我进这所学校的话，\n捕捉稀有宝可梦会更容易吗？$

label: RustboroCity_Text_PokemonCanChangeLookFromExp
source: If a POKéMON gains experience in\nbattles, it can sometimes change in\lthe way it looks.$
translation: 宝可梦在对战中获得经验后，\n到某时有可能会改变形态。$

label: RustboroCity_Text_PokemonChangeShape
source: A POKéMON changes shape?\nIf one did that, I would be shocked!$
translation: 宝可梦会改变形态？\n如果真是那样，我会大吃一惊的！$

label: RustboroCity_Text_TradePokemonGrowFast
source: A POKéMON you get in a trade from\nsomeone grows fast.\pBut if you don't have certain GYM\nBADGES, it may not obey you…$
translation: 交换得来的宝可梦\n成长会很快，\p但如果没有相应的道馆徽章，\n它有可能会不听你的话......$

label: RustboroCity_Text_OutOfTheWay
source: Get out!\nOut of the way!$
translation: 一边去！\n别挡路！$

label: RustboroCity_Text_WaitDontTakeMyGoods
source: Wait! Pleeeaaase!\pDon't take my GOODS!$
translation: 等等！等--等！\p别抢我的包裹！$

label: RustboroCity_Text_HelpMeIWasRobbed
source:
Oh, it's you!\pYou're that fantastic TRAINER who
helped me in PETALBURG WOODS!\pHelp me! I was robbed by TEAM AQUA!
I have to get the DEVON GOODS back!\pIf I don't…
I'm going to be in serious trouble.$
translation:
啊，是你！\p你是橙华森林里
帮过我的那个训练家！\p请再帮我一次吧！
海洋队抢了我的东西！\l我得把得文的物品拿回来！\p否则......
我会有大麻烦的。$

label: RustboroCity_Text_ShadyCharacterTookOffTowardsTunnel
source: That shady character, I think he took\noff towards the tunnel over there.$
translation: 那个可疑的家伙好像\n朝着那边的隧道逃跑了。$

label: RustboroCity_Text_YouGotItThankYou
source:
Oh! How did it go?
The DEVON GOODS?\pYou did!
You got them back!\pYou really are a great TRAINER!\pI know! As my thanks, I'll give you
another GREAT BALL!$
translation:
嗨！怎么样了？
得文的物品？\p太好了！
你拿回来了！\p你真是厉害的训练家！\p这些超级球就
作为我的谢礼吧！$

label: RustboroCity_Text_YoureLoadedWithItems
source: You're loaded with items.\nI can't give you this GREAT BALL.$
translation: 你背了太多东西，\n装不下这些超级球了。$

label: RustboroCity_Text_PleaseComeWithMe
source: Excuse me, please!\nPlease come with me!$
translation: 我可以占用你些时间吗？\n请跟我来！$

label: RustboroCity_Text_MayHiLetsRegister
source: MAY: Oh, hi, {PLAYER}{KUN}!\pYou had a MATCH CALL feature put\non your POKéNAV!\pLet's register each other so we can\ncontact one another anytime!\p… … … … … …$
translation: 小遥：啊，{PLAYER}{KUN}！\p你的宝可导航\n装了对战寻呼功能吧！\p我们互相登记一下信息吧，\n这样随时都能联系了！\p...... ...... ......$

label: RustboroCity_Text_RegisteredMay
source: Registered MAY\nin the POKéNAV.$
translation: 把小遥\n登记到宝可导航里了。$

label: RustboroCity_Text_MayPassedBrineyWantToBattle
source:
MAY: Oh, by the way, I passed
MR. BRINEY in PETALBURG WOODS.\pI guess he's on his way home to his
cottage by the sea.\pHow's your POKéDEX coming along,
{PLAYER}{KUN}? Mine's looking pretty decent!\pSo…
How about a little battle?$
translation:
小遥：对了，我在橙华森林
遇到哈奇老人了，\p他大概正要回
他的海边小屋吧。\p对了，你的宝可梦图鉴进度怎么样，
{PLAYER}{KUN}？我这边的进度不错哦！\p所以......
要不要来场对战？$

label: RustboroCity_Text_MayOhHaventRaisedPokemonEnough
source: MAY: Oh, what's the matter?\pHaven't you caught or raised your\nPOKéMON very much?\pThat's not very good for a TRAINER!$
translation: 小遥：哎--为什么？\p你没有好好捕捉和培育\n宝可梦吗？\p作为训练家可不应该这样！$

label: RustboroCity_Text_MayWantToBattle
source: MAY: So, what do you think?\nHow about a little battle here?$
translation: 小遥：所以，怎么样？\n要不要来场对战？$

label: RustboroCity_Text_MayImNotGoingToLose
source: MAY: You just became a TRAINER,\n{PLAYER}{KUN}. I'm not going to lose!$
translation: 小遥：你刚刚成为训练家，\n{PLAYER}{KUN}。我可不会输哦！$

label: RustboroCity_Text_MayDefeat
source: Yikes!\nYou're better than I expected!$
translation: 呜哇！\n比想象中厉害得多......$

label: RustboroCity_Text_MayMrBrineyHint
source: MAY: Oh, by the way, MR. BRINEY, who\nI just passed…\p{PLAYER}{KUN}, you just moved here so you\nmight not know this, but MR. BRINEY\lwas once a revered seafarer.$
translation: 小遥：对了，说到我刚才遇到的\n哈奇老人......\p{PLAYER}{KUN}，你刚搬过来，\n也许不知道，哈奇老人以前可是\l超级有名的水手。$

label: RustboroCity_Text_BrendanHiLetsRegister
source: BRENDAN: Oh, hey, {PLAYER}!\pYou had a MATCH CALL feature put\non your POKéNAV! Cool!\pLet's register each other so we can\nget in touch anytime!\p… … … … … …$
translation: 小悠：嘿，{PLAYER}！\p你的宝可导航装了\n对战寻呼功能啊！太棒了！\p我们互相登记一下信息吧，\n这样就能随时联系了！\p...... ...... ......$

label: RustboroCity_Text_RegisteredBrendan
source: Registered BRENDAN\nin the POKéNAV.$
translation: 把小悠\n登记到宝可导航里了。$

label: RustboroCity_Text_BrendanNoConfidenceInPokemon
source: BRENDAN: What's the matter? Don't have\nany confidence in your POKéMON?$
translation: 小悠：怎么了？\n对自己的宝可梦没信心吗？$

label: RustboroCity_Text_BrendanWantToBattle
source: BRENDAN: What's up?\nWant to have a battle with me?$
translation: 小悠：怎样？\n想和我来场对战吗？$

label: RustboroCity_Text_BrendanIWontGoEasy
source: BRENDAN: I know you just became\na TRAINER, but I won't go easy!$
translation: 小悠：虽然你刚成为训练家，\n但我不会手下留情哦！$

label: RustboroCity_Text_BrendanDefeat
source: Hmm…\nYou're pretty good.$
translation: 嘿......\n挺有两下子嘛。$

label: RustboroCity_Text_BrendanMrBrineyHint
source: BRENDAN: By the way, you know\nMR. BRINEY? The guy I just passed?\pI bet you didn't know this, since you\njust moved here, {PLAYER}, but\lMR. BRINEY was once a great sailor.$
translation: 小悠：对了，你知道我刚刚遇到的\n那个哈奇老人吗？\p我想你刚搬来不久所以还不知道，\n{PLAYER}，\l哈奇老人以前可是超级有名的水手！$

label: RustboroCity_Text_TunnelNearingCompletion
source: “Timesaving tunnel nearing\ncompletion!”\p…Is what it says on the sign, but\nthere's also a big “X” splashed\lacross it in red paint…$
translation: "便利隧道\n即将完工！"\p......牌子上这么写着，\n但上面还有个用红漆\l画了的大大的"X"......$

label: RustboroCity_Text_DevonCorpSign
source: DEVON CORPORATION\p“For all your living needs, we make\nit all.”$
translation: 得文公司\p"我们会为您提供\n一切日常必需品。"$

label: RustboroCity_Text_GymSign
source: RUSTBORO CITY POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: ROXANNE\p“The ROCK-loving honors student!”$
translation: 卡那兹市宝可梦道馆\n馆主：杜娟\p"陶醉于岩石的高材生！"$

label: RustboroCity_Text_DevonCorpBranchOfficeSign
source: DEVON CORP. BRANCH OFFICE\p“Access limited to DEVON employees\nand authorized personnel.”$
translation: 得文公司分部办公室\p"闲杂人等\n请勿入内。"$

label: RustboroCity_Text_TrainersSchoolSign
source: POKéMON TRAINER'S SCHOOL\p“We'll teach you anything about\nPOKéMON!”$
translation: 宝可梦训练家学校\p"教给你关于\n宝可梦的一切！"$

label: RustboroCity_Text_CuttersHouse
source: CUTTER'S HOUSE$
translation: 居合劈大叔的家$

label: RustboroCity_Text_DevelopedNewPokenavFeature
source: I've been developing an added feature\nfor the POKéNAV…\pAnd it turned out great!\p{PLAYER}, may I see that POKéNAV?\nThe one our PRESIDENT gave you?$
translation: 我最近一直在为宝可导航\n开发新功能......\p结果非常成功！\p{PLAYER}，能让我看看社长\n给你的宝可导航吗？$

label: RustboroCity_Text_AddedMatchCallPleaseCallMrStone
source:
There you go, {PLAYER}!\pI added a new feature named
MATCH CALL to your POKéNAV.\pUsing the MATCH CALL feature,
you can chat with people who have\lbeen registered in your POKéNAV.\p{PLAYER}, our PRESIDENT STONE should
be registered in your POKéNAV.\pTest it out.
Please give our PRESIDENT a call.$
translation:
好了，{PLAYER}！\p我给你的宝可导航
加了个对战寻呼的功能。\p你现在可以用对战寻呼与登记到你
宝可导航里的人聊天了。\p{PLAYER}，我们的社长兹伏奇已经
登记到你的宝可导航里了，\p试试看吧，
给我们社长打个电话。$

label: RustboroCity_Text_PleaseSelectPokenav
source: Please select the POKéNAV.$
translation: 请选择宝可导航。$

label: RustboroCity_Text_IdBetterGetBackToWork
source: Okay, I'd better get back to work.\nPlease take care, {PLAYER}!$
translation: 好了，我得继续工作了。\n一路顺风，{PLAYER}！$

label: RustboroCity_Text_YouCanHave2On2Battle
source:
Did you know this?\pYou can have a 2-on-2 battle even
if you're not with another TRAINER.\pIf you catch the eyes of two TRAINERS
when you have two or more POKéMON,\lthey'll both challenge you.\pDon't you think it'd be cool if you
could beat two TRAINERS by yourself?$
translation:
知道吗？\p即使你并未和其他训练家同行，
也可以进行2对2战斗。\p如果你拥有2只以上宝可梦时
被2个训练家看到，\l他们会同时向你挑战。\p你不觉得能独自打败
2个训练家很厉害吗？$

label: RustboroCity_CuttersHouse_Text_YouCanPutThisHMToGoodUse
source:
That determined expression…
That limber way you move…\lAnd your well-trained POKéMON…\pYou're obviously a skilled TRAINER!\pNo, wait, don't say a word.
I can tell just by looking at you.\pI'm sure that you can put this
HIDDEN MACHINE to good use.\pNo need to be modest or shy.
Go on, take it!$
translation:
那坚定的表情......
敏捷的行动......\l还有训练有素的宝可梦......\p你肯定是个经验丰富的训练家！\p不，别急，不用说，
我知道你想要什么。\p我想你会善加利用
这个秘传学习器的。\p不用谦虚，
这是你的了！$

label: RustboroCity_CuttersHouse_Text_ExplainCut
source:
That HIDDEN MACHINE, or HM for
short, is CUT.\pAn HM move is one that can be used
by POKéMON outside of battle.\pAny POKéMON that's learned CUT can
chop down thin trees if the TRAINER\lhas earned the STONE BADGE.\pAnd, unlike a TM, an HM can be used
more than once.$
translation:
那个秘传学习器
的内容是居合劈。\p秘传招式是可以让宝可梦
在战斗外也能使用的招式。\p如果训练家得到了
岩石徽章，那么学会居合劈的\l宝可梦就能砍倒小树。\p而且，和招式学习器不同的是，
秘传学习器可以使用很多次。$

label: RustboroCity_CuttersHouse_Text_DadHelpedClearLandOfTrees
source: When they were expanding the city of\nRUSTBORO, my dad helped out.\pHe made his POKéMON use CUT to clear\nthe land of trees.$
translation: 当初扩建卡那兹市时，\n我爸爸也帮了忙。\p他让宝可梦使用居合劈砍掉树木，\n清出了土地。$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_1F_Text_WelcomeToDevonCorp
source: Hello and welcome to the DEVON\nCORPORATION.\pWe're proud producers of items and\nmedicine that enhance your life.$
translation: 您好，欢迎来到\n得文公司。\p我们公司发明\n改变人们生活的药品和道具。$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_1F_Text_StaffGotRobbed
source: One of our research staff stupidly\ngot robbed of an important parcel.$
translation: 我们的一个调查员被人\n把很重要的包裹抢走了。$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_1F_Text_ThoseShoesAreOurProduct
source: Hey, those RUNNING SHOES!\nThey're one of our products!\pIt makes me happy when I see someone\nusing something we made.$
translation: 哎，那是跑步鞋！\n那也是我们的产品！\p每次看到别人使用我们的发明，\n我都会很高兴。$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_1F_Text_RobberWasntVeryBright
source: That stolen parcel…\pWell, sure it's important, but it's not\nanything that anyone can use.\pIn my estimation, that robber must not\nhave been very bright.$
translation: 被偷走的包裹......\p虽然确实很重要，\n但也不是所有人都会使用的东西。\p我看那个强盗\n没那么聪明。$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_1F_Text_SoundsLikeStolenGoodsRecovered
source: It sounds like they've recovered\nthe ripped-off DEVON GOODS.$
translation: 听说被抢走的得文的物品\n找回来了。$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_1F_Text_OnlyAuthorizedPeopleEnter
source: I'm sorry, only authorized people\nare allowed to enter here.$
translation: 对不起，\n无关人士请勿入内。$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_1F_Text_HowCouldWeGetRobbed
source: It's beyond stupid.\nHow could we get robbed?$
translation: 说什么傻话，\n谁会抢我们的东西？$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_1F_Text_YoureAlwaysWelcomeHere
source: Hi, there!\nYou're always welcome here!$
translation: 您好！\n随时欢迎您来参观！$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_1F_Text_RocksMetalDisplay
source:
Samples of rocks and metal are
displayed in the glass case.\pThere's a panel with some writing
on it…\p“DEVON CORPORATION got its start as
a producer of stones from quarries.\p“The company also produced iron from
filings in the sand.\p“From that humble start as a producer
of raw materials, DEVON developed.\p“DEVON is now a manufacturer of a wide
range of industrial products.”$
translation:
玻璃箱子里展示着
岩石和金属的样品，\p上面有张卡片上
写了些什么......\p"得文公司创立时
仅仅是一家以采石为业的小公司，\p同时也利用沙子中的
铁屑炼铁。\p得文从一个微小的
原材料处理公司起家，\p现在已发展成为一个开发出的产品
覆盖很多工业领域的大型制造商。"$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_1F_Text_ProductDisplay
source:
Prototypes and test products fill
the glass display case.\pThere's a panel with a description…\p“In addition to industrial products,
DEVON now markets sundries and\lpharmaceuticals for better lifestyles.\p“Recently, DEVON has begun marketing
tools for POKéMON TRAINERS, including\lPOKé BALLS and POKéNAV systems.”$
translation:
玻璃展示柜里放了些
产品的原型和试验品。\p有张卡片上写着说明......\p"除工业产品外，
得文如今也开发\l日常用品与药品。\p近年来，得文致力于
为宝可梦训练家开发包括精灵球和\l宝可导航系统等一系列工具。"$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_DeviceForTalkingToPokemon
source: We're developing a device for talking\nwith POKéMON.\pBut we haven't had much success…$
translation: 我们在开发与宝可梦\n交谈的装置，\p但进展并不理想......$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_DevelopingNewBalls
source: I'm developing new kinds of\nPOKé BALLS…\pBut I haven't made much headway…$
translation: 我在开发新型\n精灵球......\p但还没什么进展......$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_WeFinallyMadeNewBalls
source:
We finally made new kinds of
POKé BALLS!\pThe REPEAT BALL makes it easier to
catch POKéMON you've caught before.\pThe TIMER BALL gets better at catching
POKéMON the longer a battle runs.\pBoth are proudly developed by
the DEVON CORPORATION.\pPlease give them a try!$
translation:
我们终于开发出了
新型精灵球！\p用重复球捕捉曾经
捕捉过的宝可梦更容易，\p战斗拖得久的话用时间球
能很方便捕捉宝可梦。\p这都是我们
得文公司的发明，\p一定要试试啊！$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_IMadePokenav
source: I made the POKéNAV!\pAs an engineer, I feel blessed to have\nmade something so great!$
translation: 我开发了宝可导航！\p作为一个工程师，能开发出\n这么伟大的工具是我的幸运！$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_WowThatsAPokenav
source:
Oh, wow!
That's a POKéNAV!\pIt came about as a result of our
PRESIDENT's desire to learn about\lthe feelings of POKéMON.\pWould you like me to describe its
features in detail?\pNo, no. I think you'll find out just by
trying the POKéNAV out.$
translation:
哇！
那是宝可导航！\p因为我们社长想要
了解宝可梦的感受，\l才会有这东西的构想。\p你要我向你详细
讲解一下它的功能吗？\p啊，不，不，我想你会在试用我们的
宝可导航时慢慢摸索出来的。$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_DeviceToVisualizePokemonDreams
source: I'm trying to develop a device that\nvisually reproduces the dreams of\lPOKéMON…\pBut it's not going well.$
translation: 我在开发一种能\n将宝可梦的梦境\l投影出来的装置......\p但进展不理想。$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_DevelopDeviceToResurrectFossils
source: I've been trying to develop a device\nthat resurrects POKéMON from fossils…\pAnd, it's working!$
translation: 我开发了一种能使\n化石中的宝可梦复活的装置......\p现在运转良好！$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_WantToBringFossilBackToLife
source:
Wait! That thing you have there…
Is that a POKéMON fossil?\pWould you like to bring that POKéMON
back to life?\pI can with my newly developed
FOSSIL REGENERATOR.$
translation:
什么！你拿着的......
是宝可梦化石吗？\p你想复活
那只宝可梦吗？\p用我新开发的
化石重生器就能做到。$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_OhIsThatSo
source: Oh, is that so?\pDEVON's technological expertise\nis outstanding, I tell you.$
translation: 是吗？\p告诉你，得文的技术知识\n是最优秀的。$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_TwoFossilsPickOne
source:
Oh, now that's a surprise!
You have not one, but two, fossils?\pUnfortunately, my machine can only
regenerate one POKéMON at a time.\pWould you like to pick one of your
fossils for regeneration?$
translation:
啊，真令人吃惊！
你不是有1个，而是有2个化石？\p但我的机器一次
只能复活1只宝可梦，\p你想复活
其中1只吗？$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_HandedFossilToResearcher
source: Excellent!\nLet's do this right away.\p{PLAYER} handed the {STR_VAR_1} to\nthe DEVON RESEARCHER.$
translation: 太好了！\n我们这就开始。\p{PLAYER}把{STR_VAR_1}\n交给了得文研究员。$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_FossilRegeneratorTakesTime
source:
The FOSSIL REGENERATOR, which I made,
is incredible.\pBut it has one drawback--it takes
a long time to work.\pSo, uh… How about you go for a stroll
and look around for a while?$
translation:
我研发的化石重生器
极棒，\p但它有个缺点--
花的时间太久。\p所以，呃......
你可以暂时出去转转。$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_FossilizedMonBroughtBackToLife
source: Thanks for waiting!\pYour fossilized POKéMON has been\nbrought back to life!\pThe fossil was an ancient POKéMON.\n{STR_VAR_2}, it was!$
translation: 久等了！\p变成化石的宝可梦\n复活了！\p这个化石是一种古代的宝可梦，\n{STR_VAR_2}！$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_ReceivedMonFromResearcher
source: {PLAYER} received {STR_VAR_2} from\nthe DEVON RESEARCHER.$
translation: {PLAYER}从得文研究员处得到了\n{STR_VAR_2}。$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_TooManyPokemon
source: Uh-oh, you've got too many POKéMON.\nYou have no room for this one.$
translation: 噢，你带的宝可梦太多了。\n已经没有空位了。$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_DevelopNewPokenavFeature
source: I'm trying to develop a new feature\nfor the POKéNAV…\pBut it's not going well.$
translation: 我在为宝可导航\n开发新功能......\p但还没什么进展。$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_WhatToWorkOnNext
source:
Well, now what shall I work on
developing next?\pOur company allows us to make our
inspirations into reality.\pOne couldn't ask for a better
environment as an engineer.$
translation:
唔，
下面我该开发什么？\p我们公司允许我们
将自己的灵感变成现实。\p作为工程师，再也找不到
更好的工作环境了。$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_MrStoneIHaveFavor
source:
I'm MR. STONE, the PRESIDENT of
the DEVON CORPORATION.\pI'd just got word about you!\pYou saved our staff not just once,
but twice!\pI have a favor to ask of an amazing
person like you.\pI understand that you're delivering
a package to SLATEPORT's SHIPYARD.\pWell, on the way, could you stop off in
DEWFORD TOWN?\pI was hoping that you'd deliver a
LETTER to STEVEN in DEWFORD.$
translation:
我是兹伏奇，
得文公司的社长。\p刚刚听说了你的事迹！\p你不止一次，而是两次
救了我们公司的员工！\p我有件事想拜托给
你这样出色的人。\p我知道你要送包裹到
凯那市的船厂去。\p唔，在那之前，
能不能顺路去武斗镇一趟？\p我希望你能把这封信交给
武斗镇里一个叫大吾的人。$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_MrStoneWantYouToHaveThis
source: MR. STONE: Now, you should know that\nI am a great PRESIDENT.\pSo, I'd never be so cheap as to ask\na favor for nothing in return.\pThat's why I want you to have this!$
translation: 兹伏奇：你知道，\n作为一位优秀的社长，\p我绝不会吝啬到\n让人白白帮忙。\p因此我把这个送给你！$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_ReceivedPokenav
source: {PLAYER} received a POKéNAV.$
translation: {PLAYER}得到了宝可导航。$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_MrStoneExplainPokenavRestUp
source:
MR. STONE: That device…\pIt's a POKéMON NAVIGATOR, or POKéNAV
for short.\pIt's an indispensable tool for any
TRAINER on an adventure.\pIt has a map of the HOENN region.\pYou can check the locations of
DEWFORD and SLATEPORT easily!\pBy the way, I've heard that sinister
criminals--MAGMA and AQUA, I believe--\lhave been making trouble far and wide.\pI think it would be best if you rested
up before you go on your way.$
translation:
兹伏奇：那个装置......\p那是宝可梦导航器，
简称宝可导航，\p对冒险中的训练家来说
是不可或缺的工具。\p那里面有丰缘地区
的地图，\p你可以很方便地查看
武斗镇和凯那市的地点！\p对了，我听说一些邪恶的犯罪组织
--我想是熔岩队和海洋队--\l在到处惹是生非，\p建议你出发前最好
先好好休息一下。$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_MrStoneGoWithCautionAndCare
source: MR. STONE: Well, then, {PLAYER}{KUN},\ngo with caution and care!$
translation: 兹伏奇：好了，{PLAYER}{KUN}，\n路上小心！$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_CountingOnYou
source: MR. STONE: I'm counting on you!$
translation: 兹伏奇：就拜托给你了！$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_ThankYouForDeliveringLetter
source: MR. STONE: You delivered my LETTER?\nThank you kindly!\pThis is my way of thanking you.\nIt should help you, a TRAINER.$
translation: 兹伏奇：你把信送到了？\n非常感谢！\p这是我的谢礼，\n应该对你这样的训练家有所帮助。$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_NotFamiliarWithTrends
source:
MR. STONE: Since my youth, I've immersed
myself in work.\pConsequently, I'm not familiar with
trends and that sort of thing.\pBut do young people all want to be
TRAINERS in the POKéMON LEAGUE?$
translation:
兹伏奇：我从年轻时起，
就一直全身心投入工作，\p所以我也不怎么了解
流行趋势之类的东西。\p现在的年轻人们都想成为
宝可梦联盟的训练家吗？$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_ThisIs3rdFloorWaitHere
source:
This is the DEVON CORPORATION's
third floor.\pOur PRESIDENT's OFFICE is on
this floor.\pAnyway, I can't tell you how much I'm
grateful for what you've done.\pUm… By the way, that parcel
you got back for us…\pCould I get you to deliver that to
the SHIPYARD in SLATEPORT?\pIt would be awful if those robbers
tried to take it again.\pUh… Hehehe, so, uh, could I count
on you to do that for me?\pOh, that's right.
Could you wait here a second?$
translation:
这里是得文公司的3楼。\p社长办公室的
所在地。\p无论如何，我无法表明
我对你所做的事情的感谢。\p呃......另外，你帮我们
取回来的那个包裹......\p能再请你帮忙
送到凯那市的船厂吗？\p如果再让那些强盗
抢走就糟了。\p呃......哈哈哈，那，呃，
能帮我这个忙吗？\p啊，对了，
请在此稍等一下。$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_WordWithPresidentComeWithMe
source: Our PRESIDENT would like to have\na word with you.\pPlease come with me.$
translation: 我们的社长有话\n想跟你说。\p跟我来。$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_PleaseGoAhead
source: Please, go ahead.$
translation: 过来吧。$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_VisitCaptSternShipyard
source: If you visit the SHIPYARD in SLATEPORT,\nyou should go see CAPT. STERN.$
translation: 你到凯那市的船厂后，\n应该去找楠木馆长。$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_RepeatAndTimerHugelyPopular
source: DEVON's new products, the REPEAT BALL\nand TIMER BALL, have become hugely\lpopular among TRAINERS.$
translation: 得文的新产品重复球\n和时间球很快就\l在训练家之中流行起来了。$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_RareRocksDisplay
source: It's a collection of rare rocks and\nstones assembled by the PRESIDENT.$
translation: 这是社长收集的\n稀有岩石。$

label: RustboroCity_Flat1_1F_Text_EveryPokemonHasAbility
source: Every POKéMON has a special ability\nthat it can use.$
translation: 每只宝可梦都有一种\n它可以使用的特性。$

label: RustboroCity_Flat1_1F_Text_PokemonStrange
source: POKéMON are such strange creatures.$
translation: 宝可梦真是奇怪的生物。$

label: RustboroCity_Flat1_2F_Text_ComingUpWithMealsIsHard
source:
Oh, it's so hard every day…\pWhat's hard?
You need to ask?\pIt's trying to figure out what to
make for meals every day.\pIt really isn't easy coming up with
meals every day.$
translation:
唉，天天这样太难了......\p什么难？
还用问吗？\p当然是考虑一天三餐
该吃什么。\p每天都想着做什么饭
也不容易。$

label: RustboroCity_Flat1_2F_Text_HelloDoYouKnowFunnyPhrase
source:
Oh, hello!
Welcome to the PEPPER household.\pI have a question for you.
Have you ever baby-sat?\pYou see, I'm a new father, so raising
a child is all new to me.\pAnd I have a problem. My daughter
WALDA doesn't laugh enough.\pI think she'd laugh for me if I told
her something funny.\pDo you know of a funny word or
phrase you can tell me?$
translation:
哎，你好！
欢迎来到箱神家。\p问你一个问题，
你带过小孩吗？\p你看，我刚当上爸爸，
抚养孩子什么的都得从头学。\p我现在有点麻烦，
女儿文乃总是不爱笑。\p我想如果给她讲笑话
她就会笑起来的。\p你知道什么有趣的故事
或短语吗？$

label: RustboroCity_Flat1_2F_Text_BeenSayingXDoYouKnowBetterPhrase
source: I've been saying “{STR_VAR_1}”\nto amuse her lately.\pDo you know of a better word or\na phrase that might work?$
translation: 我最近试过说\n"{STR_VAR_1}"逗她笑，\p你还知道什么\n更好点的短语吗？$

label: RustboroCity_Flat1_2F_Text_WonderfulLetsHearSuggestion
source: Oh, that's wonderful.\nSo, let's hear it, your suggestion.$
translation: 哎，不错，那就听你的，\n说给她听听吧。$

label: RustboroCity_Flat1_2F_Text_OhIsThatRight
source: Oh, is that right?\pWell, if you come up with a good\nsuggestion, I'm all ears.$
translation: 唉，是吗？\p如果你想到什么好主意，\n我洗耳恭听。$

label: RustboroCity_Flat1_2F_Text_LetsGiveItATry2
source: Ah, I see.\nWell, let's give it a try, shall we?$
translation: 啊，知道了。\n来试试吧？$

label: RustboroCity_Flat1_2F_Text_OhShesLaughing
source: {STR_VAR_1}.\n{STR_VAR_1}.\pOh, yes! She's laughing!\nOh, I am as delighted as she!$
translation: {STR_VAR_1}\n{STR_VAR_1}\p啊，太好了，她笑了！\n啊，我也跟她一样开心！$

label: RustboroCity_Flat1_2F_Text_LetsGiveItATry
source: Ah, I see.\nWell, let's give it a try, shall we?$
translation: 啊，知道了。\n来试试吧？$

label: RustboroCity_Flat1_2F_Text_ShesNotSmilingAtAll
source: {STR_VAR_1}.\n{STR_VAR_1}.\pHmmm… She's not smiling at all.\nMaybe WALDA is one serious child…$
translation: {STR_VAR_1}\n{STR_VAR_1}\p唔......她根本不笑。\n也许文乃生来就很严肃......$

label: RustboroCity_Flat1_2F_Text_ThinkOfMyOwnPhrase
source: Oh, so you don't know any good words.\nI'd better think for myself, then.\pHmm…\nHow about “{STR_VAR_1}”?\lLet's see if that will work.$
translation: 唉，你也不知道什么好短语啊。\n那我只能自己想一个了。\p嗯......\n"{STR_VAR_1}"怎么样？\l我们试试看。$

label: RustboroCity_Flat1_2F_Text_ShesNotSmilingAtAll2
source: {STR_VAR_1}.\n{STR_VAR_1}.\pHmmm… She's not smiling at all.\nMaybe WALDA is one serious child…$
translation: {STR_VAR_1}\n{STR_VAR_1}\p唔......她根本不笑。\n也许文乃生来就很严肃......$

label: RustboroCity_Flat1_2F_Text_OhYouDontKnowAny
source: Oh, so you don't know any good words.\nI guess I'll try to amuse her with\lthe saying I used before.\pAnyways, if you have a good suggestion,\ndon't hesitate in telling me, okay?$
translation: 唉，你也不知道什么好短语啊。\n看来我只能用上次的短语\l逗她笑了。\p对了，如果你想到了什么，\n要赶快告诉我，好吗？$

label: RustboroCity_Flat1_2F_Text_ThankYouIllGiveYouWallpaper
source:
Thank you!\pThanks to you, my darling WALDA
laughed for me!\pActually, I may not look all that
special, but I'm one of DEVON\lCORPORATION's top researchers.\pSo, how about I do something in return
for you?\pI know, I'll add some new wallpaper
patterns for the BOXES in the PC\lPOKéMON Storage System.\pIn the wallpaper pattern menu,
select “FRIENDS.”\pThat will give you access to the new
wallpaper patterns.$
translation:
谢谢！\p多亏了你，我亲爱的文乃
开始笑了！\p实际上，虽然我看起来
很普通，但我是得文\l公司的主力研究员之一。\p我该做点什么
报答你？\p对了，我给你的
电脑宝可梦寄放系统里的\l盒子加些新的背景图片吧。\p在选择背景图案的菜单中
选择"朋友"，\p就能连接到
新的背景图片。$

label: RustboroCity_Flat1_2F_Text_ItsAPokemonPlushDoll
source: It's a POKéMON plush DOLL!$
translation: 是宝可梦毛绒玩具！$

label: RustboroCity_Flat2_1F_Text_DevonWorkersLiveHere
source: DEVON CORPORATION's workers live in\nthis building.$
translation: 这里是得文公司员工的\n宿舍楼。$

label: RustboroCity_Flat2_1F_Text_Skitty
source: SKITTY: Gyaaaah!$
translation: 向尾喵：喵呀呀！$

label: RustboroCity_Flat2_2F_Text_DevonWasTinyInOldDays
source: Way back in the old days, DEVON was just\na teeny, tiny company.$
translation: 许多年以前，得文只是个\n微不足道的小公司。$

label: RustboroCity_Flat2_2F_Text_MyDaddyMadeThisYouCanHaveIt
source: My daddy's working at the CORPORATION.\pMy daddy made this!\nBut I can't use it, so you can have it.$
translation: 我爸爸在公司里工作。\p他做了这个东西！\n但我不会用，给你吧。$

label: RustboroCity_Flat2_2F_Text_GoingToWorkAtDevonToo
source: My daddy's working at the CORPORATION.\pWhen I grow up, I'm going to work for\nDEVON, too.$
translation: 我爸爸在公司里工作。\p我长大后，\n也要去得文工作。$

label: RustboroCity_Flat2_3F_Text_PresidentCollectsRareStones
source: DEVON's PRESIDENT likes to collect\nrare stones.$
translation: 得文的社长喜欢收集\n稀有的石头。$

label: RustboroCity_Flat2_3F_Text_PresidentsSonAlsoCollectsRareStones
source: I think the PRESIDENT's son also\ncollects rare stones.$
translation: 我想社长的儿子\n也喜欢收集稀有石头。$

label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_GymGuideAdvice
source:
Yo, how's it going?\pListen, my friend!
Would you like to become the CHAMPION?\pI'm no TRAINER, not me, but I can
sure give you winning advice.\pThat's settled, then! We'll aim for the
POKéMON CHAMPIONSHIP together!\pIt's your job as a TRAINER to collect
GYM BADGES, am I right?\pBut GYM LEADERS aren't pushovers!\pAnd that's where I come in!
I'm here to provide expert advice!\pROXANNE, the GYM LEADER, is a user
of ROCK-type POKéMON.\pThe ROCK type is very durable, but
it can't stand WATER-type and\lGRASS-type moves.\pCome see me afterwards, if you beat
the GYM LEADER.\pWell, go for it!$
translation:
哟，怎么样？\p听好，朋友！
你想成为冠军吗？\p我不是训练家，但我可以
给你一些取胜的建议。\p那么说定了！我们一起朝着
宝可梦冠军的目标前进！\p作为训练家，任务之一
就是收集道馆徽章，对吗？\p但击败道馆馆主并没那么容易！\p因此我才会在这里！
我会给你专业的建议！\p道馆馆主杜娟
使用岩石属性宝可梦。\p岩石属性非常坚固，
但它抵挡不了水属性和\l草属性招式。\p你打败道馆馆主之后
再来找我吧。\p好了，加油！$

label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_GymGuidePostVictory
source:
Whoa! What a breathtaking victory!
My cheering must've worked!\pGreat!
Check your TRAINER CARD.\pThe STONE BADGE you got should be
properly recorded on it.\pIn other words…\pYou've climbed the first step on
the stairs to the CHAMPIONSHIP!\pThat's got to feel awesome!$
translation:
哇！令人心驰的胜利！
看来我的鼓励派上了用场！\p太好了！
看看你的训练家卡，\p你得到的岩石徽章
就记录在上面。\p换句话说......\p你踏上了通向冠军之路的
第一级阶梯！\p感觉不错！$

label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_JoshIntro
source: Don't take us GYM TRAINERS lightly!\nI'll show you why we're better!$
translation: 别小看我们道馆训练家！\n我会告诉你为什么我是最好的！$

label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_JoshDefeat
source: You were too good for me…$
translation: 你比我厉害多了......$

label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_JoshPostBattle
source: You haven't seen anything of the ROCK\ntype's terrifying power!$
translation: 你还没有体会过岩石属性的\n可怕力量！$

label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_TommyIntro
source: If you can't beat me, you won't stand\na chance against ROXANNE!$
translation: 如果你不能打败我，\n就不可能打败杜娟！$

label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_TommyDefeat
source: Wow! You've got some potential!$
translation: 哇！你的潜力很大！$

label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_TommyPostBattle
source: ROXANNE is stronger than me by\nseveral times.\pYou'd better be on your guard!$
translation: 杜娟可比我厉害好几倍。\p你最好提高警惕！$

label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_MarcIntro
source: We might be in the middle of town,\nbut so what?\pMy ROCK POKéMON need room to\nrampage!$
translation: 虽然这里是城镇中心，\n但那又如何？\p我的岩石宝可梦可需要\n大闹一场的空间！$

label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_MarcDefeat
source: Oh, man oh man!\nOur challenger is one feisty customer!$
translation: 哦，天哪！\n我们的挑战者这么强大！$

label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_MarcPostBattle
source: I have to hand it to our LEADER.\pIt took smarts and sense for her to\npick the ROCK type at her young age.$
translation: 只有交给我们的馆主了。\p这么年轻就培育岩石属性，\n真是辛苦她了。$

label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_RoxanneIntro
source:
Hello, I am ROXANNE, the RUSTBORO
POKéMON GYM LEADER.\pI became a GYM LEADER so that I might
apply what I learned at the POKéMON\lTRAINER'S SCHOOL in battle.\pWould you kindly demonstrate how you
battle, and with which POKéMON?$
translation:
您好，我是卡那兹市宝可梦道馆的
馆主杜娟。\p我想要把在宝可梦训练家学校中
所学到的东西都运用到宝可梦对战\l里面，所以才成为了道馆馆主。\p您要使用哪种宝可梦，
如何对战，可以告诉我吗？$

label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_RoxanneDefeat
source:
So…
I lost…\pIt seems that I still have much more
to learn…\pI understand.\pThe POKéMON LEAGUE's rules state
that TRAINERS are to be given this\lif they defeat a GYM LEADER.\pPlease accept the official POKéMON
LEAGUE STONE BADGE.$
translation:
啊......
是我输了......\p看来我还有
许多东西要学......\p我知道了。\p宝可梦联盟规定
战胜道馆馆主的训练家\l可以得到这个。\p请收下这枚宝可梦联盟
公认的岩石徽章。$

label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_ReceivedStoneBadge
source: {PLAYER} received the STONE BADGE\nfrom ROXANNE.$
translation: {PLAYER}从杜娟那里\n得到了岩石徽章。$

label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_StoneBadgeInfoTakeThis
source: The STONE BADGE heightens the ATTACK\npower of your POKéMON.\pIt also enables them to use the HM move\nCUT outside of battle.\pPlease take this with you, too.$
translation:
岩石徽章能提高您的
宝可梦的攻击力。\p有了它，您的宝可梦也能在对战外
使用秘传招式居合劈了。\p然后......
请您也收下这个。$

label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_ExplainRockTomb
source:
That TECHNICAL MACHINE, TM39,
contains ROCK TOMB.\pIt not only inflicts damage by dropping
rocks, it also lowers SPEED.\pIf you use a TM, it instantly teaches
the move to a POKéMON.\pRemember, a TM can be used only once,
so think before you use it.$
translation:
那个招式学习器39中
装着岩石封锁。\p用落石攻击对手的同时
也能降低对手的速度。\p如果您使用招式学习器，
宝可梦能立刻学会其中的招式。\p但一个招式学习器使用后就会消失，
所以使用前要仔细考虑才行呢。$

label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_RoxannePostBattle
source: Since you are so strong, you should\nchallenge other GYM LEADERS.\pBy battling many TRAINERS, you should\nlearn many things.$
translation: 像您这么强的训练家为什么不去\n其他道馆挑战看看呢？\p通过和许许多多的训练家对战，\n您能够学到很多知识哟。$

label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_GymStatue
source: RUSTBORO CITY POKéMON GYM$
translation: 卡那兹市宝可梦道馆$

label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_GymStatueCertified
source: RUSTBORO CITY POKéMON GYM\pROXANNE'S CERTIFIED TRAINERS:\n{PLAYER}$
translation: 卡那兹市宝可梦道馆\p杜娟认可的训练家：\n{PLAYER}$

label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_RoxanneRegisterCall
source:
… … … … … …
… … … … … Beep!\pROXANNE: Oh, hello, {PLAYER}?
This is ROXANNE of RUSTBORO CITY.\pI heard from BRAWLY that you're
moving up through the ranks of\lTRAINERS at an incredible clip.\pWell, I'd rather not think that
I can't beat you.\pI promise, I will shape up my GYM
so that you may challenge us again.\pI hope you'll be looking forward to
that occasion as much as me!\p… … … … … …
… … … … … Click!$
translation:
...... ...... ......
...... ...... ......哔！\p杜娟：哦，您好，是{PLAYER}吗？
我是卡那兹市的杜娟。\p我从藤树那儿听说您已经
是个小有名气的训练家了。\p但是，我认为我不会
再输给您了。\p我保证，我会提升道馆的实力，
您可以再来挑战我们。\p我希望您会像我一样期待
那个时刻的到来！\p...... ...... ......
...... ......咔哒！$

label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_RegisteredRoxanne
source: Registered GYM LEADER ROXANNE\nin the POKéNAV.$
translation: 把道馆馆主杜娟\n登记到宝可导航里了。$

label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_RoxannePreRematch
source:
ROXANNE: I'm so glad to see you again.
I'm ROXANNE, the GYM LEADER here.\pI'm sure we've both experienced many
battles since we last met.\pI would like to see how much better
we've become. Let us battle!$
translation:
杜娟：我真高兴能再见到您。
我是这个道馆的馆主杜娟。\p我相信我们可以再享受很多场
像上次那样精彩的对战。\p我想看看我们彼此都变强了多少。
让我们开始吧！$

label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_RoxanneRematchDefeat
source: Grr…\nAgain, I have lost…$

label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_RoxannePostRematch
source: ROXANNE: I still have much to learn\nwhen it comes to battling POKéMON.\pThat awareness makes me love battling\nall that much more!$
translation: 杜娟：关于宝可梦对战，\n我还有许多事要学习。\p察觉到了这一点，\n让我更喜欢宝可梦对战了！$

label: RustboroCity_Gym_Text_RoxanneRematchNeedTwoMons
source:
ROXANNE: I'm so glad to see you again.
I'm ROXANNE, the GYM LEADER here.\pI'm sure we've both experienced many
battles since we last met.\pI would like to see how much better
we've become…\pOh, no…
You only have one POKéMON with you?\pPlease return with at least one more
POKéMON.$
translation:
杜娟：我真高兴能再见到您。
我是这个道馆的馆主杜娟。\p我相信我们可以再享受很多场
像上次那样精彩的对战。\p我想看看我们彼此都变强了......\p哎，不......
您只带了1只宝可梦？\p带至少2只
宝可梦回来吧。$

label: RustboroCity_House1_Text_IllTradeIfYouWant
source:
Huh? My POKéMON is cute?
Sure, I knew that.\pBut if you really want, I'm willing
to trade it to you.\pI'll trade you my {STR_VAR_2} for
a {STR_VAR_1} if you want.$
translation:
嗯？我的宝可梦很可爱？
那是当然的。\p但你如果真的想要，
我也可以考虑跟你交换。\p愿意的话，我用我的{STR_VAR_2}
跟你换{STR_VAR_1}。$

label: RustboroCity_House1_Text_PleaseBeGoodToMyPokemon
source: Eheheh…\nPlease be good to my POKéMON.$
translation: 呵呵呵......\n要善待我的宝可梦啊。$

label: RustboroCity_House1_Text_DoesntLookLikeMonToMe
source: Huh? That doesn't look anything like\na {STR_VAR_1} to me.$
translation: 嗯？这看上去可\n不是{STR_VAR_1}。$

label: RustboroCity_House1_Text_YouDontWantToThatsOkay
source: Oh, if you don't want to, that's okay.\nBut my POKéMON is cute, you know…$
translation: 啊，如果你不想换也不要紧，\n但你知道，我的宝可梦非常可爱......$

label: RustboroCity_House1_Text_AnyPokemonCanBeCute
source: Any POKéMON can be cute if you raise\nit with care and kindness.$
translation: 如果用爱心和细心去照顾宝可梦，\n它们都会变得十分可爱。$

label: RustboroCity_House1_Text_AllSortsOfPlaces
source: In all sorts of places, there are all\nsorts of POKéMON and people.\pI find that fascinating, so I go to all\nsorts of places.$
translation: 在不同地方生活着\n不同的人和不同的宝可梦，\p我觉得很有趣，\n所以四处旅行。$

label: RustboroCity_House2_Text_TrainerSchoolExcellent
source: The TRAINER'S SCHOOL is excellent.\pIf you study there, you could even\nbecome a GYM LEADER.$
translation: 训练家学校特别好。\p在那儿学习的话，\n甚至可能成为道馆馆主。$

label: RustboroCity_House2_Text_RoxanneKnowsALot
source: ROXANNE, the GYM LEADER, really knows\na lot about POKéMON.\pShe's really strong, too!$
translation: 道馆馆主杜娟了解\n很多关于宝可梦的知识，\p而且她也很强大！$

label: RustboroCity_House3_Text_IGivePerfectlySuitedNicknames
source: For my own POKéMON, I give them\nperfectly suited nicknames!\pIt's my expression of, uh…\noriginality, yes, that's it!$
translation: 我给我的宝可梦起了\n最合适的名字！\p这是我，呃......\n创造力的表现！$

label: RustboroCity_House3_Text_NamingPikachuPekachu
source: But giving the name PEKACHU to\na PIKACHU? It seems pointless.\pI suppose it is good to use a name\nthat's easy to understand, but…$
translation: 但叫皮卡丘为\n猫卡球？这没什么意义。\p我想最好起个容易\n让人理解的名字，但是......$

label: RustboroCity_House3_Text_Pekachu
source: PEKACHU: Peka!$
translation: 猫卡球：猫球！$

label: RustboroCity_Mart_Text_BuyingHealsInCaseOfShroomish
source: I'm buying some PARLYZ HEALS and\nANTIDOTES.\pJust in case I run into SHROOMISH\nin PETALBURG WOODS.$
translation: 我得买些解麻药和\n解毒药，\p以防撞上橙华森林里的\n蘑蘑菇。$

label: RustboroCity_Mart_Text_ShouldBuySuperPotionsInstead
source: My POKéMON evolved.\nIt has a lot of HP now.\pI should buy SUPER POTIONS for it\ninstead of ordinary POTIONS.$
translation: 我的宝可梦进化了，\n它现在拥有更多体力。\p我得买些厉害伤药\n来代替普通伤药。$

label: RustboroCity_Mart_Text_GettingEscapeRopeJustInCase
source: I'm getting an ESCAPE ROPE just in\ncase I get lost in a cave.\pI just need to use it to get back to\nthe entrance.$
translation: 我要买些离洞绳，\n避免在山洞里迷路。\p这样只要用它\n就能回到入口了。$

label: RustboroCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_PokemonHavePersonalities
source: My POKéMON has a NAIVE nature, and my\nfriend's has a JOLLY nature.\pIt's fascinating how POKéMON have\npersonalities!$
translation: 我的宝可梦是天真性格，\n而我朋友的是爽朗性格。\p宝可梦也有自己的性格，\n真有趣！$

label: RustboroCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_MaleAndFemalePokemon
source: Just like people, there are male and\nfemale POKéMON.\pBut no one seems to have any idea how\nthey're different.$
translation: 就像人类一样，\n宝可梦也有性别，\p但似乎没人知道\n它们的不同点在何处。$

label: RustboroCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_HMCutNextDoor
source: The man next door gave me an HM!\pI used it to teach my POKéMON how to\nCUT down skinny trees.$
translation: 隔壁的人给了我一个\n秘传学习器！\p我用它教我的宝可梦\n怎样砍倒小树。$

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_BlackboardListsStatusChanges
source: The blackboard lists status changes\nthat may affect POKéMON in battle.$
translation: 黑板上写着可能影响\n宝可梦战斗的状态变化。$

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_ReadWhichTopic
source: Which topic do you want to read?$
translation: 想读哪一条？$

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_ExplainPoison
source:
If a POKéMON is poisoned, it will
steadily lose HP.\pThe effects of poison remain after
a battle.\pA poisoned POKéMON's HP will drop
while it is traveling.\pHeal a poisoning using an ANTIDOTE.$
translation:
宝可梦中毒后，
会慢慢损失体力，\p此效果在战斗后
依然残留。\p在探险中，中毒的宝可梦的体力P
也会不断减少。\p使用解毒药可解毒。$

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_ExplainParalysis
source:
If a POKéMON becomes paralyzed,
its SPEED drops.\pIt may also not be able to move while
it is in battle.\pParalysis remains after battle.
Cure it using a PARLYZ HEAL.$
translation:
宝可梦麻痹后，
速度会降低，\p战斗中有可能
无法使用招式。\p此效果战斗后依然残留。
使用解麻药可治愈。$

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_ExplainSleep
source: If a POKéMON falls asleep, it will be\nunable to attack.\pA POKéMON may wake up on its own,\nbut if a battle ends while it is\lsleeping, it will stay asleep.\pWake it up using an AWAKENING.$
translation: 宝可梦睡着后，\n就无法攻击了。\p宝可梦有可能自己醒来，\n但如果战斗结束后\l它还在睡觉，那么它会一直睡着。\p用解眠药叫醒它。$

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_ExplainBurn
source: A burn reduces ATTACK power, and it\nsteadily reduces the victim's HP.\pA burn lingers after battle.\nCure a burn using a BURN HEAL.$
translation: 灼伤会降低攻击，\n同时会降低伤者的体力。\p战斗后灼伤还会留下。\n用灼伤药可以治愈。$

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_ExplainFreeze
source: If a POKéMON is frozen, it becomes\ncompletely helpless.\pIt will remain frozen after battle.\nThaw it out using an ICE HEAL.$
translation: 宝可梦被冰冻后，\n它完全无法反击，\p战斗后依然会保持冻结。\n用解冻药为它解冻。$

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_StudentsWhoDontStudyGetQuickClaw
source: Students who don't study get a little\ntaste of my QUICK CLAW.\pWhether or not you are a good student \nwill be evident from the way you use\lthis item.$
translation: 对于偷懒的学生，\n我就让他们尝尝我的先制之爪。\p你是不是个好学生，\n只要看看你怎么用这件道具\l就能知道。$

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_ExplainQuickClaw
source:
A POKéMON holding the QUICK CLAW will
occasionally speed up and get to move\lbefore its opponent.\pThere are many other items that are
meant to be held by POKéMON.\pJust those alone will give you many
topics to study!$
translation:
带着先制之爪的宝可梦
偶尔会提高速度\l比对手先发动攻击。\p还有很多可以给宝可梦
携带的东西，\p只是这一点就
足够你学很久了！$

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_TradingRightNow
source: I'm trading POKéMON with my friend\nright now.$
translation: 我刚才在和朋友\n交换宝可梦。$

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_AlwaysWantedSeedot
source: I always wanted a SEEDOT, and\nI'm finally getting one!$
translation: 我一直想要一只橡实果，\n现在终于有了！$

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_PokemontCantUseManMadeItems
source: POKéMON can hold items, but they\ndon't know what to do with man-made\litems like POTION and ANTIDOTE.$
translation: 宝可梦可以带一些道具，\n但它们不会使用伤药或\l解毒药这样的人造道具。$

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_ConfusedPokemonAttacksItself
source:
You know how some POKéMON moves can
confuse a POKéMON?\pA confused POKéMON will sometimes
attack itself without meaning to.\pBut once it leaves battle, it will
return to normal.$
translation:
你知道某些宝可梦的招式
可以使对手宝可梦混乱吗？\p混乱的宝可梦有时
会不知为何攻击自己。\p但一旦它退出战斗，
它就会恢复正常。$

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_PokemonHealItselfWithBerry
source:
A POKéMON holding a BERRY will heal
itself…\pThere are many kinds of items that
POKéMON can hold…\pBoy, it sure is hard taking notes
down…$
translation:
带着树果的宝可梦
能够自我治疗......\p许多道具都可以
让宝可梦携带......\p唉，及时记下笔记
太难了......$

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_StudentsNotes
source:
It's this student's notebook…\pPOKéMON are to be caught using
POKé BALLS.\pUp to six POKéMON can accompany
a TRAINER.\pA TRAINER is someone who catches
POKéMON, raises them, and battles\lwith them.\pA TRAINER's mission is to defeat
the strong TRAINERS who await\lchallengers in POKéMON GYMS.$
translation:
这是这个学生的笔记本......\p用精灵球可以
捕捉宝可梦。\p一个训练家最多可以
同时携带6只宝可梦。\p训练家就是捕捉宝可梦，
并培育它们，\l与它们共同战斗的人。\p训练家的任务是
打败在宝可梦道馆中\l等待着的强大训练家。$

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_ScottMetAlreadyCut
source:
Hello? Didn't we meet before?
I think back in PETALBURG CITY.\pLet me introduce myself.
My name's SCOTT.\pI've been traveling everywhere in
search of outstanding TRAINERS.\pMore specifically, I'm looking for
POKéMON battle experts.\pSo, what brings you to this SCHOOL?
Are you a TRAINER, too?\pThe first thing you should do is to
have a POKéMON learn the move CUT.\pIf I remember correctly, someone in
this town has CUT.$
translation:
你好，我们以前见过面吧？
我想是在橙华市见过。\p我来自我介绍一下。
我叫亚希达，\p正为了寻找出类拔萃的
训练家而四处旅行，\p具体地说，就是寻找宝可梦对战专家。\p你为什么会来这所学校呢？
你也是训练家吗？\p那你首先要做的就是
拥有一只会居合劈的宝可梦。\p如果我没记错的话，
这城镇里就有人拥有居合劈。$

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_StudentTalentLevelUnknown
source: SCOTT: Hmm…\pThe talent levels of the students here\nare unknown. The potential's there.$
translation: 亚希达：嗯......\p这里的学生天赋还不明确，\n但潜力是有的。$

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_ScottStoneBadge
source:
SCOTT: Oh, what's that?\pIt's a STONE BADGE, isn't it?
That's pretty impressive, I'd say.\pBut, you know, I would've loved to see
you in battle.\pIt's hard to tell what you're like as
a TRAINER from a LEAGUE BADGE.$
translation:
亚希达：哦，那是什么？\p岩石徽章是吗？
真令人吃惊。\p不过，我更想看看
对战时的你。\p仅凭一枚联盟徽章
很难看出训练家的水平高低。$

label: RusturfTunnel_Text_ComeAndGetSome
source: What, are you coming?\nCome and get some, then!$
translation: 怎么，想过来？\n那就放马过来啊！$

label: RusturfTunnel_Text_Peeko
source: PEEKO: Pii pihyoh!$
translation: 小皮：皮--皮可！$

label: RusturfTunnel_Text_GruntIntro
source:
Grah, keelhaul it all!\pThat hostage POKéMON turned out to
be worthless!\pAnd to think I made a getaway…
In this tunnel to nowhere!\pHey! You!
So you want to battle me?$
translation:
该死，真见鬼！\p那只当人质的宝可梦
根本派不上用场！\p亏我还拼命逃跑......
逃进了一个死胡同隧道！\p嘿！说你呢！
你想和我打一场是吧？$

label: RusturfTunnel_Text_GruntDefeat
source: Urrrggh! My career in crime comes to\na dead end!$
translation: 呃啊啊！\n我的犯罪生涯看来要到头了！$

label: RusturfTunnel_Text_GruntTakePackage
source:
This is plain not right…\pThe BOSS told me this would be a
slick-and-easy job to pull.\pAll I had to do was steal some package
from DEVON.\pTch!
You want it back that badly, take it!$
translation:
太离谱了......\p老大明明告诉我
这任务易如反掌。\p只要从得文公司
偷个包裹就行......\p切！
这么想要就还给你！$

label: RusturfTunnel_Text_PeekoGladToSeeYouSafe
source: PEEKO!\nAm I glad to see you're safe!$
translation: 小皮！\n你平安无事真是太好了！$

label: RusturfTunnel_Text_ThankYouLetsGoHomePeeko
source:
PEEKO owes her life to you!\pThey call me MR. BRINEY.
And, you are?\p… … … … … … … …
… … … … … … … …\pAh, so you are {PLAYER}{KUN}!
I sincerely thank you!\pNow, if there's anything that troubles
you, don't hesitate to tell me!\pYou can usually find me in my cottage
by the sea near PETALBURG WOODS.\pCome, PEEKO, we should make our way
home.\pPEEKO: Pihyoh!$
translation:
你是小皮的救命恩人啊！\p大家都叫我哈奇老人。
你是......？\p...... ...... ...... ......
...... ...... ...... ......\p原来如此，是{PLAYER}{KUN}啊！
真的太感谢你了！\p以后遇到什么困难
尽管来找我！\p我平时就住在橙华森林
附近的海边小屋。\p来吧，小皮，
我们回家了。\p小皮：皮可！$

label: RusturfTunnel_Text_WhyCantTheyKeepDigging
source:
… …\pWhy can't they keep digging?
Is the bedrock too hard?\pMy beloved awaits me in VERDANTURF
TOWN just beyond here…\pIf RUSTBORO and VERDANTURF were
joined by this tunnel, I could visit\lher every day…\pBut this…
What am I to do?$
translation:
......\p为什么他们停工了？
是因为岩床太硬吗？\p我心爱的人就在隧道那头的
绿茵镇等着我......\p如果这条隧道能连通
卡那兹市和绿茵镇，\l我就能天天见到她了......\p可是现在......
我该怎么办？$

label: RusturfTunnel_Text_ToGetToVerdanturf
source: To get from RUSTBORO to VERDANTURF,\nyou need to go to DEWFORD, then pass\lthrough SLATEPORT and MAUVILLE…$
translation: 想要从卡那兹市到绿茵镇，\n你得先到武斗镇，然后穿过\l凯那市和紫堇市......$

label: RusturfTunnel_Text_YouShatteredBoulderTakeHM
source: Wow! You shattered that boulder\nblocking the way.\pTo show you how much I appreciate it,\nI'd like you to have this HM.$
translation: 哇喔！\n你打碎了挡路的大石头。\p这个秘传学习器送给你，\n就当作是我的谢礼吧。$

label: RusturfTunnel_Text_ExplainStrength
source: That HM contains STRENGTH.\pIf a muscular POKéMON were to learn\nthat, it would be able to move even\llarge boulders.$
translation: 那个秘传学习器\n里面是怪力。\p让力量大的宝可梦学会的话，\n就能够移动更大的石头了。$

label: RusturfTunnel_Text_WandaReunion
source: WANDA!\nNow I can see you anytime!\pWANDA: That's…wonderful.\pPlease, take some rest at my home.$
translation: 满盈！\n现在我可以随时看到你了！\p满盈：真的......太好了。\p请来我家好好休息吧。$

label: RusturfTunnel_Text_BoyfriendOnOtherSideOfRock
source:
On the other side of this rock…
My boyfriend is there.\pHe… He's not just digging the tunnel
to come see me.\pHe works his hands raw and rough
for the benefit of everyone.$
translation:
在岩石的另一边......
是我的男朋友。\p他......他挖隧道不只是
为了见我，\p他磨破双手、任劳任怨，
也是为了大家。$

label: RusturfTunnel_Text_MikeIntro
source: What do you call a wild man up in the\nmountains? A mountain man, right?\pSo why don't they call a POKéMON in\nthe mountains a mountain POKéMON?$
translation: 你怎么称呼住在山里的野人？\n登山男，对不对？\p为什么不把生活在山里的宝可梦\n叫作登山宝可梦呢？$

label: RusturfTunnel_Text_MikeDefeat
source: My POKéMON…\nRan out of power…$
translation: 我的宝可梦......\n耗尽力量了......$

label: RusturfTunnel_Text_MikePostBattle
source: They halted development here to\nprotect POKéMON, right?\lThere's a feel-good story!$
translation: 他们停工是为了\n保护宝可梦吧？\n真是个暖心故事！$

label: SafariZone_Center_Text_RestHouse
source: REST HOUSE$
translation: 休息屋$

label: SafariZone_Center_Text_PressStartToCheckTime
source: TRAINER TIPS\pPress START to check\nremaining time.$
translation: 训练家贴士\p按开始检查\n剩下的时间。$

label: SafariZone_Center_Text_CenterArea
source: CENTER AREA$
translation: 中部栖息地$

label: SafariZone_Center_Text_WhereDidErikGo
source: SARA: Where did my boyfriend,\nERIK, go?$
translation: 敦子：我的男朋友阿初到\n哪儿去了？$

label: SafariZone_Center_Text_CatchingMonsAsGifts
source: I'm catching POKéMON to take home\nas gifts.$
translation: 我正在抓宝可梦回家\n作为礼物。$

label: SafariZone_East_Text_RestHouse
source: REST HOUSE$
translation: 休息屋$

label: SafariZone_East_Text_TimeDeclinesOnlyWhileYouWalk
source: TRAINER TIPS\pThe remaining time declines only\nwhile you walk.$
translation: 训练家贴士\p在你走路的时候\n剩余的时间会越来越少。$

label: SafariZone_East_Text_AreaSign
source: AREA 1\nWEST: CENTER AREA$
translation: 栖息地1\n往西：中部栖息地$

label: SafariZone_East_Text_HowManyDidYouCatch
source: How many did you catch?\nI'm bushed from the effort!$
translation: 你抓了多少？\n我干得精疲力竭了！$

label: SafariZone_East_Text_CaughtChanseyAllWorthwhile
source: I caught a CHANSEY!\pThat makes this all worthwhile.$
translation: 我抓住了一只吉利蛋！\p一切努力都是值得的。$

label: SafariZone_East_Text_TiredFromAllTheFun
source: Whew!\nI'm tired from all the fun!$
translation: 哇哇！\n我终于也从兴奋中疲倦下来了！$

label: SafariZone_North_Text_RestHouse
source: REST HOUSE$
translation: 休息屋$

label: SafariZone_North_Text_SecretHouseStillAhead
source: TRAINER TIPS\pThe SECRET HOUSE is still ahead.$
translation: 训练家贴士\p神秘小屋仍在前方。$

label: SafariZone_North_Text_Area2
source: AREA 2$
translation: 栖息地2$

label: SafariZone_North_Text_ZigzagThroughTallGrass
source: TRAINER TIPS\pPOKéMON hide in tall grass.\pZigzag through grassy areas to\nflush them out.$
translation: 训练家贴士\p宝可梦隐藏在高高的草丛中。\p在草丛中区折前行，\n就能把他们找出来。$

label: SafariZone_North_Text_WinFreeHMFindSecretHouse
source: TRAINER TIPS\pWin a free HM for finding the\nSECRET HOUSE.$
translation: 训练家贴士\p找到神秘小屋就\n能获得免费的秘传机。$

label: SafariZone_East_Text_PrizeInDeepestPartOfSafariZone
source: Go to the deepest part of the\nSAFARI ZONE. You will win a prize!$
translation: 走到野生原野区的最深处。\n你就会赢得奖品！$

label: SafariZone_East_Text_MyEeveeEvolvedIntoFlareon
source: My EEVEE evolved into FLAREON.\pBut, a friend's EEVEE turned into a\nVAPOREON. I wonder why?$
translation: 我的伊布进化成了火精灵。\p但是，我一个朋友的伊布进化成了\n水精灵。我不知道这是为什么？$

label: SafariZone_SecretHouse_Text_CongratsYouveWon
source:
Ah! Finally!\pYou're the first person to reach
the SECRET HOUSE!\pAlthough I made a campaign
for our grand opening,\pI was getting worried that no one
would win our campaign prize.\pCongratulations!
You have won!$
translation:
啊！终于！\p你是来到神秘小屋的
第一个人！\p虽然我为我们这个比赛
制订了周密的计划，\p但我还是很担心会没有人
能赢走我们的比赛奖品。\p祝贺你！
你赢了！$

label: SafariZone_SecretHouse_Text_ReceivedHM03FromAttendant
source: {PLAYER} received HM03\nfrom the attendant!$
translation: {PLAYER}从服务员那里\n得到了HM03！$

label: SafariZone_SecretHouse_Text_ExplainSurf
source:
HM03 is SURF.\pPOKéMON will be able to ferry you
across water using it.\pAnd, this HM isn't disposable, so
you can use it over and over.\pYou're super lucky for winning this
fabulous prize!$
translation:
HM03是冲浪。\p宝可梦能够使用它
载着你在水面上前进。\p还有，这个HM不是一次性的，所以
你可以反复使用它。\p你非常幸运，赢得了
这个令人难以置信的奖品！$

label: SafariZone_SecretHouse_Text_DontHaveRoomForPrize
source: You don't have room for this\nfabulous prize!$
translation: 你没有空间来接受这份\n这巨大的奖品！$

label: SafariZone_West_Text_RestHouse
source: REST HOUSE$
translation: 休息屋$

label: SafariZone_West_Text_PleaseFindWardensLostTeeth
source: REQUEST NOTICE\pPlease find the SAFARI WARDEN's\nlost GOLD TEETH.\lThey're around here somewhere.\pReward offered!\nContact: WARDEN$
translation: 寻物启示\p寻找原野区园长\n丢失了的金假牙。\l它就掉在这里的某个地方。\p是有奖悬赏！\n联系人：园长$

label: SafariZone_West_Text_SearchForSecretHouse
source: TRAINER TIPS\pZone Exploration Campaign!\nThe Search for the SECRET HOUSE!$
translation: 训练家贴士\p区域性的探险活动！\n搜索神秘小屋！$

label: SafariZone_West_Text_AreaSign
source: AREA 3\nEAST: CENTER AREA$
translation: 栖息地3\n往东：中部栖息地$

label: SafariZone_West_Text_KogaPatrolsSafariEverySoOften
source:
The SAFARI ZONE's huge, wouldn't
you say?\pFUCHSIA's GYM LEADER, KOGA, 
patrols the grounds every so often.\pThanks to him, we can play here
knowing that we're safe.$
translation:
你不觉得野生原野区
实在是大得吓人吗？\p浅红的道馆馆主阿桔，
经常会在原野区里巡逻。\p我们能在这里放心地游玩
真是多亏了他呢。$

label: SafariZone_West_Text_RocksMakeMonRunButEasierCatch
source: Tossing ROCKS at POKéMON might\nmake them run, but they'll be\leasier to catch.$
translation: 向宝可梦扔石头\n也许会使他们逃跑，但它们会\l很容易地被抓到。$

label: SafariZone_West_Text_BaitMakesMonStickAround
source: Using BAIT will make POKéMON more\nlikely to stick around if they get\lbusy eating.$
translation: 使用饵食抓宝可梦会更容易驻留，\n它们可能会忙着去吃那些\l诱饵的话。$

label: SafariZone_West_Text_HikedLotsDidntSeeMonIWanted
source: I hiked a lot, but I didn't see any\nPOKéMON I wanted.$
translation: 我走了很多的路但我没有看到任何\n我想要的宝可梦。$

label: SaffronCity_CopycatsHouse_1F_Text_DaughterIsSelfCentered
source: My daughter is so self-centered.\nShe has but a few friends.$
translation: 我女儿总是以自己为中心。\n所以她几乎没有什么朋友。$

label: SaffronCity_CopycatsHouse_1F_Text_DaughterLikesToMimicPeople
source: My daughter likes to mimic people.\nIt's rather vexing.\pHer mimicry has earned her the\nnickname COPYCAT around here.$
translation: 我的女儿喜欢模仿其他人\n这确实有点令人恼火。\p这种模仿他人的行为使她在附近\n赢得了模仿少女的外号。$

label: SaffronCity_CopycatsHouse_1F_Text_Chansey
source: CHANSEY: Chaan! Sii!$
translation: 吉利蛋：琴！茜！$

label: SaffronCity_CopycatsHouse_2F_Text_MimickingFavoriteHobbyMale
source:
{PLAYER}: Hi!
Do you like POKéMON?\p{PLAYER}: Uh, no, I just asked you.\p{PLAYER}: Huh?
You're strange!\pCOPYCAT: Hmm? Quit mimicking?
But, that's my favorite hobby!$
translation:
{PLAYER}：嗨！
你喜欢宝可梦吗？\p{PLAYER}：喔，不，我只是问问你罢了。\p{PLAYER}：嗯？
你确实很厉害！\p模仿少女：嗯？快速模仿？
对，那是我的爱好！$

label: SaffronCity_CopycatsHouse_2F_Text_MimickingFavoriteHobbyFemale
source:
{PLAYER}: Hi.
You must like POKéMON.\p{PLAYER}: No, not me.
I asked you.\p{PLAYER}: Pardon?
You're weird!\l \lCOPYCAT: Hmm? Quit mimicking?\lBut that's my favorite hobby!$
translation:
{PLAYER}：嗨。
你一定热爱着宝可梦\p{PLAYER}：不，不是问我。
我是在问你。\p{PLAYER}：再说一遍？
你真古怪！\l模仿少女：嗯？快速模仿？\l那是我的最爱！$

label: Text_MimicTeach
source:
Oh wow!
A POKé DOLL!\pFor me?
Thank you!\pYou know what?
I can teach the move MIMIC.$
translation:
哇塞！
皮皮玩偶\p给我的？
谢谢你！\p你想要什么？
我能教给你模仿这个技能。$

label: Text_MimicDeclined
source: Don't you like MIMIC?$
translation: 你不喜欢模仿？$

label: Text_MimicWhichMon
source: I really love MIMIC!\nWho's going to learn it?$
translation: 我真的很喜欢模仿！\n谁想要来学会这个技能？$

label: Text_MimicTaughtMale
source:
{PLAYER}: Hi!
Thanks for earlier!\p{PLAYER}: Pardon?\p{PLAYER}: Is it that fun to mimic my
every move?\pCOPYCAT: You bet!
It's a scream!$
translation:
{PLAYER}：嗨！
首先要谢谢你！\p{PLAYER}：再说一遍？\p{PLAYER}：模仿我的动作
很有意思吗？\p模仿少女：你敢打赌的吧！
那真是太有意思了！$

label: Text_MimicTaughtFemale
source:
{PLAYER}: Hi!
Thanks for what you did for us.\p{PLAYER}: Pardon?\p{PLAYER}: Is it really that fun to
copy what I say and do?\pCOPYCAT: You bet!
It's a scream!$
translation:
{PLAYER}：嗨
谢谢你为我做的一切！\p{PLAYER}：再说一遍？\p{PLAYER}：学我说话
很有意思吗？\p模仿达人：你敢打赌吗？
那真是太有意思了！$

label: SaffronCity_CopycatsHouse_2F_Text_Doduo
source: DODUO: Giiih!\pPRETTY MIRROR LOOK AT ME,\nSEE HOW PRETTY I CAN BE?$
translation: 嘟嘟：嘻嘻！\p魔镜魔镜告诉我，\n谁是这个世界上最漂亮的人？$

label: SaffronCity_CopycatsHouse_2F_Text_RareMonOnlyDoll
source: This is a rare POKéMON!\nHuh? It's only a doll!$
translation: 这真是少见的宝可梦啊！\n嗯？这只是个玩偶！$

label: SaffronCity_CopycatsHouse_2F_Text_MarioWearingABucket
source: A game with MARIO wearing a bucket\non his head!$
translation: 游戏里马力欧\n正在用头顶蘑菇！$

label: SaffronCity_CopycatsHouse_2F_Text_MySecrets
source: …\pMy Secrets!\pSkill: Mimicry!\nHobby: Collecting dolls!\lFavorite POKéMON: CLEFAIRY!$
translation: ......\p我的秘密！\p我的特长：模仿！\n我的爱好：收集玩偶！\l我最喜欢的宝可梦：皮皮！$

label: SaffronCity_Dojo_Text_MasterKoichiIntro
source: Grunt!\pI am the KARATE MASTER!\nI am the LEADER here!\pYou wish to challenge us?\nExpect no mercy!\pFwaaa!$
translation: 哼哼！\p我就是空手大王！\n也是这里的馆主！\p你想要挑战我？\n我可不会手下留情的！\p哇哈哈！$

label: SaffronCity_Dojo_Text_MasterKoichiDefeat
source: Hwa!\nArrgh! Beaten!$
translation: 哇啊！\n哎呀！打着我了！$

label: SaffronCity_Dojo_Text_ChoosePrizedFightingMon
source: Indeed, I have lost!\pBut, I beseech you, do not take\nour emblem as your trophy!\pIn return, I will give you a prized\nFIGHTING POKéMON!\pChoose whichever one you like!$
translation: 我输了！这是事实！\p但是，我求你一件事，能不能\n别把我们的徽章作为你战利品！\p作为回报，我会送给你一只\n格斗属性宝可梦！\p选一只你喜欢的吧！$

label: SaffronCity_Dojo_Text_StayAndTrainWithUs
source: Grunt!\nStay and train at karate with us!$
translation: 哼哼！\n在那儿站好陪我练练空手道吧！$

label: SaffronCity_Dojo_Text_MikeIntro
source: Hoargh!\nTake your shoes off!$
translation: 嚯利哟根！\n格斗前先脱掉你的鞋！$

label: SaffronCity_Dojo_Text_MikeDefeat
source: I give up!$
translation: 我认输了！$

label: SaffronCity_Dojo_Text_MikePostBattle
source: You wait 'til you see our MASTER!\nI'm a small fry compared to him!$
translation: 等你见到我们的掌门再说吧！\n和他比起来我不过是个杂鱼罢了！$

label: SaffronCity_Dojo_Text_HidekiIntro
source: I hear you're good!\nShow me!$
translation: 听说你很厉害！\n展示给我看看吧！$

label: SaffronCity_Dojo_Text_HidekiDefeat
source: Judge!\nOne point!$
translation: 裁判！\n判分吧！$

label: SaffronCity_Dojo_Text_HidekiPostBattle
source: Our MASTER is a pro fighter.\nBe prepared to lose!$
translation: 我们的掌门是一位格斗专家。\n做好失败的准备吧！$

label: SaffronCity_Dojo_Text_AaronIntro
source: Hiyah!\nI have no fear for anything tough!\pI shatter boulders for training\nevery day!$
translation: 嘿呀！\n任何事情都不能吓到我！\p为了训练\n我每天都在练习击碎巨石！$

label: SaffronCity_Dojo_Text_AaronDefeat
source: Yow!\nStubbed fingers!$
translation: 哟！\n我的手指断了！$

label: SaffronCity_Dojo_Text_AaronPostBattle
source: The only thing that frightens us is\npsychic power!$
translation: 对我们格斗家来说\n最害怕的就是超能力！$

label: SaffronCity_Dojo_Text_HitoshiIntro
source: Hwaah!\pYou're trespassing in our\nFIGHTING DOJO!$
translation: 哗！\p你擅自闯入了我们的\n格斗道场$

label: SaffronCity_Dojo_Text_HitoshiDefeat
source: Oof!\nI give up!$
translation: 喔！\n我认输！$

label: SaffronCity_Dojo_Text_HitoshiPostBattle
source: The prime fighters across the land\ntrain here.$
translation: 这位祖师级的格斗大师\n跋山涉水来到这里修炼。$

label: SaffronCity_Dojo_Text_YouWantHitmonlee
source: You want the hard-kicking\nHITMONLEE?$
translation: 你想要这只擅长踢技的\n飞腿郎？$

label: SaffronCity_Dojo_Text_ReceivedMonFromKarateMaster
source: {PLAYER} received the {STR_VAR_1}\nfrom the KARATE MASTER.$
translation: {PLAYER}从空手大王那里\n得到了{STR_VAR_1}$

label: SaffronCity_Dojo_Text_YouWantHitmonchan
source: You want the piston-punching\nHITMONCHAN?$
translation: 你想要这只擅长拳击的\n快拳郎？$

label: SaffronCity_Dojo_Text_BetterNotGetGreedy
source: Better not get greedy…$

label: SaffronCity_Dojo_Text_EnemiesOnEverySide
source: Enemies on every side!$
translation: 四面楚歌$

label: SaffronCity_Dojo_Text_GoesAroundComesAround
source: What goes around comes around.$
translation: 因果报应$

label: SaffronCity_Dojo_Text_FightingDojo
source: FIGHTING DOJO$
translation: 格斗道场$

label: SaffronCity_Text_WhatDoYouWantGetLost
source: What do you want?\nGet lost!$
translation: 你想干什么？\n滚开！$

label: SaffronCity_Text_BossTakeTownForTeamRocket
source: BOSS said he'll take this town\nin the name of TEAM ROCKET!$
translation: 老大说他会把这座城镇\n命名为火箭队！$

label: SaffronCity_Text_DontGetDefiantOrIllHurtYou
source: Don't get defiant!\nOr I'll have to hurt you!$
translation: 不要惹我生气！\n否则我会狠狠地报复你的！$

label: SaffronCity_Text_SaffronBelongsToTeamRocket
source: SAFFRON belongs to TEAM ROCKET!$
translation: 金黄永远属于火箭队！$

label: SaffronCity_Text_CriminalLifeMakesMeFeelAlive
source: My life as a criminal makes me feel\nso alive!$
translation: 只有犯罪才会让我觉得\n是如此的有意义！$

label: SaffronCity_Text_WatchWhereYoureWalking
source: Ow!\nWatch where you're walking!$
translation: 噢！\n给我好好走路！$

label: SaffronCity_Text_WeCanExploitMonsAroundWorld
source: With SILPH under control, we can\nexploit POKéMON around the world!\pWe'll get stinking rich, yeahah!$
