translation: 接下来，游戏厅将会\n正常运行了。\p请一定要带你的朋友\n来玩玩啊！$

label: TwoIsland_JoyfulGameCorner_Text_PleaseShowMeYouBeingCool
source: Listen, listen!\pPlease show me you being cool\nagain!$
translation: 听着，听着！\p再向我展示一次\n你的那份冷静吧！$

label: TwoIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_HaveYouVisitedGameCorner
source: Have you visited the GAME CORNER\nalready?\pIt's no good to go alone.\nYou have to take a friend along.$
translation: 你已经去过游戏厅了？\p自己去多没意思。\n最好叫上朋友一起去。$

label: TwoIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_OldLadyLivesOutOnCape
source:
Not many people live on
TWO ISLAND.\pThere is this old lady who lives
out on the cape.\pShe's been there since I don't know
when.$
translation:
二之岛上
没有人居住。\p但有一个住在海角
的老人。\p至于她什么时候开始住在那儿的，
我也不知道。$

label: UndergroundPath_EastEntrance_Text_DoYouGoToCeladonDeptStore
source: The DEPARTMENT STORE in CELADON\nhas a great selection.\pDo you go there very often?$
translation: 玉虹的百货大楼\n那里有很多很棒的商品。\p你经常去那里吗？$

label: UndergroundPath_SouthEntrance_Text_PeopleLoseThingsInTheDarkness
source: People often lose things in the\ndarkness of the UNDERGROUND PATH.$
translation: 人们经常在黑暗的\n地下通道里丢东西。$

label: UndergroundPath_WestEntrance_Text_SleepyMonNearCeladon
source: I heard a sleepy POKéMON appeared\nout near CELADON CITY, too.$
translation: 我听说一只爱睡觉的宝可梦\n出现在玉虹市附近。$

label: Underwater_SeafloorCavern_Text_SubExplorer1
source:
“SUBMARINE EXPLORER 1” is painted
on the hull.\pThis is the submarine TEAM AQUA
stole in SLATEPORT!\pTEAM AQUA must have gone
ashore here.$
translation:
船体上涂着"海渊1号潜艇"
的字样。\p这就是那艘海洋队从凯那市
偷走的潜水艇！\p海洋队一定是在
这里靠岸的。$

label: VerdanturfTown_Text_ManDugTunnelForLove
source: There was a man who dug a tunnel for\na lady he loved.\pI don't really get it, but hey!$
translation: 听说那人挖隧道是\n为了心爱的姑娘。\p虽然不太懂，\n但真浪漫啊！$

label: VerdanturfTown_Text_AirCleanHere
source: The way the winds blow, volcanic ash\nis never blown in this direction.\pThe air is clean and delicious here.\nLiving here should do wonders for even\lfrail and sickly people.$
translation: 因风向关系，\n火山灰永远吹不到这里，\p所以这里空气非常清新。\n住在这里，就算是体弱多病的人\l也可能有奇迹般的好转。$

label: VerdanturfTown_Text_GuyTryingToBustThroughCave
source:
Did you see the cave next to the
POKéMON MART?\pThere's a guy in there who's trying to
bust up boulders so he can bust out\lthrough to the other side.\pIt'd be great if we could go through…
It'll make it easy to visit RUSTBORO.$
translation:
你看到友好商店旁边的
洞窟了吗？\p里面有个人在努力打碎岩石
来打通隧道。\p要是隧道能打通就太好了......
这样我们去卡那兹市就更容易了。$

label: VerdanturfTown_Text_EasyToGetToRustboroNow
source: That cave next to the POKéMON MART\nis now a tunnel to the other side.\pIt's great--it's easy to go shop for\nnew DEVON products in RUSTBORO now.$
translation: 友好商店旁的洞穴\n已经是连通两地的隧道啦！\p太棒了--现在去卡那兹市买得文的\n新产品方便多了。$

label: VerdanturfTown_Text_WandasHouse
source: WANDA'S HOUSE$
translation: 满盈的家$

label: VerdanturfTown_Text_BattleTentSign
source: BATTLE TENT VERDANTURF SITE\n“Feast Your Eyes on Battles!”$
translation: 对战帐篷绿茵镇分址\n"精彩对战，尽收眼底！"$

label: VerdanturfTown_Text_RusturfTunnelSign
source: RUSTURF TUNNEL\n“Linking RUSTBORO and VERDANTURF\p“The tunnel project has been\ncanceled.”$
translation: 卡绿隧道\n"连接卡那兹市和绿茵镇\p隧道工程现已\n终止施工。"$

label: VerdanturfTown_ContestHall_Text_WhichContestYouEntering
source:
Which CONTEST are you entering?
Want a piece of advice?\pIn any CONTEST, for example, a CUTE
CONTEST, I don't think they judge you\lonly on cuteness in the first round.\pYou need to work out ways for raising
POKéMON better.$
translation:
你想要参加哪个部门？
需要建议吗？\p在任一部门中，例如可爱部门
我认为裁判不仅仅\l在第一回合中判定。\p你应该努力制定出更多方法
来更好的培育你的宝可梦。$

label: VerdanturfTown_ContestHall_Text_RaisedMonToBeCute
source: I raised my POKéMON to be cute.\pI found out you can put POKéMON in\na CONTEST for cuteness!\pI'm so glad I raised my POKéMON with\nloving care…$
translation: 我培育宝可梦让它变得可爱。\p我发现你可以让宝可梦参加\n可爱部门！\p我很高兴我是用爱心来培育\n我的宝可梦。$

label: VerdanturfTown_ContestHall_Text_MyMonRules
source: My POKéMON rules!\pIt's cool, tough yet beautiful, cute,\nand smart. It's complete!\pI may as well go for wins in every\nsingle CONTEST.$
translation: 我的宝可梦法则！\p它帅气、强壮、漂亮、可爱\n并且聪明。完美！\p我不妨赢得各项\n华丽大赛。$

label: VerdanturfTown_ContestHall_Text_NormalRankStage
source: POKéMON CONTESTS\nNORMAL RANK STAGE!$
translation: 宝可梦华丽大赛\n一般级会场！$

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_MonsReluctantToUseDislikedMoves
source:
If it doesn't like a certain move,
a POKéMON will be reluctant to use it.\pIt doesn't matter how strong it is,
either.\pFor example, a POKéMON with a GENTLE
nature probably won't enjoy hurting\lits opponents.\pIf it can't seem to live up to its
potential, it's probably failing at\lusing a disliked move against its will.$
translation:
如果宝可梦不喜欢一个招式，
它就不愿使用这招式，\p无论招式多么强大
都一样。\p比如说，一只拥有温顺性格的
宝可梦很可能不想\l伤害对手。\p如果不能因材施教，
它们使用自己讨厌的招式时\l可能会失败。$

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_GentleMonsScaryIfAngry
source: My big sister is gentle usually.\nBut when she gets angry,\lshe's really, really scary!\pI bet a gentle POKéMON will be scary\nif it gets angry!$
translation: 我姐姐通常很温柔，\n但如果把她惹怒了，\l她会变得非常非常可怕！\p我敢说温顺性格的宝可梦\n生气的时候也会很可怕！$

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_AttractionRunsDeep
source:
My feelings toward my POKéMON…
The attraction runs deep…\pOh, hi, you didn't see that, did you?
Well, it doesn't matter.\pHow would you like this TM for
your POKéMON?$
translation:
我对宝可梦感到......
它那么地迷人......\p啊，你好，你没看见吧？
啊，算了，没关系，\p你想给你的宝可梦用
这个招式学习器吗？$

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_AttractionMutual
source: My feelings toward my POKéMON…\nI'm sure the attraction is mutual!\pThey battle exactly the way I want\nthem to!$
translation: 我对宝可梦感到......\n我想这吸引力一定是相互的！\p它们对战时完全按照\n我想的那样做！$

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_TaughtWhatKindsOfMoves
source: What kind of moves have you taught\nyour POKéMON?\pI think you would give yourself\nan advantage if they knew how to\lheal or protect themselves.$
translation: 你给你的宝可梦\n教了些什么招式？\p我想如果它们会回复或者\n保护自己的话，\l会让你在战斗中更有优势。$

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ScottCanMeetToughTrainers
source:
SCOTT: Hey there, {PLAYER}{KUN}!
I thought I might see you here.\pA BATTLE TENT's a place where
you can meet tough TRAINERS.\pIt doesn't matter what the rules are,
or how battles are waged, either.\p{PLAYER}{KUN}, I expect you to do
the best you can!$
translation:
亚希达：嗨，{PLAYER}{KUN}！
我就知道能在这儿遇到你，\p因为，无论规则如何，
无论战斗怎样，\p你总能在对战帐篷中
碰见强大的训练家。\p{PLAYER}{KUN}，
我希望你能全力以赴！$

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ScottVisitRegularly
source: SCOTT: I visit here regularly in hopes\nof seeing tough TRAINERS in action\lin whatever the situation.$
translation: 亚希达：我经常来这儿，\n为了能观摩强大的训练家\l在不同的处境下如何战斗。$

label: VerdanturfTown_FriendshipRatersHouse_Text_SeeHowMuchPokemonLikesYou
source: Let me see your POKéMON.\nI'll check to see how much it likes you.\pOh.\nYour POKéMON…$
translation: 让我看看你的宝可梦，\n我能看出它对你的感情如何。\p哎，\n你的宝可梦......$

label: VerdanturfTown_FriendshipRatersHouse_Text_AdoresYou
source: It adores you.\nIt can't possibly love you any more.\lI even feel happy seeing it.$
translation: 它很敬仰你，\n非常非常喜欢你。\l看着它，我也很开心。$

label: VerdanturfTown_FriendshipRatersHouse_Text_VeryHappy
source: It seems to be very happy.\nIt obviously likes you a whole lot.$
translation: 它看上去很高兴，\n明显很喜欢你。$

label: VerdanturfTown_FriendshipRatersHouse_Text_LikesYouQuiteALot
source: It likes you quite a lot.\nIt seems to want to be babied a little.$
translation: 它挺喜欢你的，\n看上去还想再被宠一些。$

label: VerdanturfTown_FriendshipRatersHouse_Text_GettingUsedToYou
source: It's getting used to you.\nIt seems to believe in you.$
translation: 它开始习惯和你相处了，\n好像已经开始相信你。$

label: VerdanturfTown_FriendshipRatersHouse_Text_NotUsedToYou
source: It's not very used to you yet.\nIt neither loves nor hates you.$
translation: 它还不太习惯和你相处，\n很难说是喜欢你还是讨厌你。$

label: VerdanturfTown_FriendshipRatersHouse_Text_VeryWary
source: It's very wary.\nIt has scary viciousness in its eyes.\lIt doesn't like you much at all.$
translation: 它的警惕心很强，\n眼神特别吓人。\l它一点也不喜欢你。$

label: VerdanturfTown_FriendshipRatersHouse_Text_DetestsYou
source: This is a little hard for me to say…\pYour POKéMON simply detests you.\nDoesn't that make you uncomfortable?$
translation: 有些遗憾......\p你的宝可梦非常厌恶你。\n这没让你感到愧疚吗？$

label: VerdanturfTown_FriendshipRatersHouse_Text_Pikachu
source: PIKACHU: Pika pika!$
translation: 皮卡丘：皮卡！皮卡！$

label: VerdanturfTown_House_Text_TrainersGatherAtPokemonLeague
source: Far away, deep in EVER GRANDE CITY,\nis the POKéMON LEAGUE.\pThe TRAINERS who gather there are\nall frighteningly well skilled.$
translation: 在遥远的彩悠市最深处，\n就是宝可梦联盟的所在地。\p聚集在那里的训练家\n都异乎寻常地强大。$

label: VerdanturfTown_House_Text_DefeatEliteFourInARow
source: In the POKéMON LEAGUE, I think the\nrules say that you have to battle the\lELITE FOUR all in a row.\pIf you lose to any of them, you have\nto begin your challenge again from the\lfirst one.$
translation: 我记得，宝可梦联盟规定\n你要连续跟四天王战斗，\p一旦输了，\n就得从第一个重新开始。$

label: VerdanturfTown_Mart_Text_XSpecialIsCrucial
source: For any POKéMON match, X SPECIAL\nis crucial.\pIt jacks up the power of some moves\neven though it's only for one battle.$
translation: 无论什么宝可梦比赛，\n特攻强化都至关重要。\p它能提升某些招式的威力，\n但只在一场战斗中有效。$

label: VerdanturfTown_Mart_Text_NoStrategyGuidesForBattleTent
source: They don't seem to sell any winning\nstrategy guides for the BATTLE TENT…\pIt seems one must rely on one's\nown wits after all…$
translation: 他们不打算卖什么\n对战帐篷战术指南......\p看来必须用自己的智慧\n来夺取胜利......$

label: VerdanturfTown_Mart_Text_NestBallOnWeakenedPokemon
source: The NEST BALL works better on\nweakened POKéMON.\pVERDANTURF is the only place you can\nbuy it.$
translation: 巢穴球对弱小的宝可梦\n非常管用，\p只有在绿茵镇这里\n才能买到。$

label: VerdanturfTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_FaithInYourPokemon
source: You can't consider yourself a real\nTRAINER if you don't have faith\lin your POKéMON.\pOnly those people who can believe\nin their battling POKéMON can win\lthrough to the very end.$
translation: 如果你不信任自己的宝可梦，\n你就不是一个真正的训练家。\p只有相信自己宝可梦的人\n才能笑到最后。$

label: VerdanturfTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_VisitForBattleTent
source:
The reason why anyone would visit
VERDANTURF…\pIt's the BATTLE TENT. It goes without
saying.\pOr is there somebody here that you
came to see?$
translation:
大家都想来
绿茵镇的原因......\p毫无疑问，
是对战帐篷。\p还是说，
你是来找朋友的？$

label: VerdanturfTown_WandasHouse_Text_StrongerSpeech
source:
WALLY: I lost to you, {PLAYER}, but I'm
not feeling down anymore.\pBecause I have a new purpose in life.
Together with my RALTS, I'm going\lto challenge POKéMON GYMS and become\la great TRAINER.\pPlease watch me, {PLAYER}.
I'm going to be stronger than you.\pWhen I do, I'm going to challenge you
to another battle.$
translation:
满充：虽然我输给了你，{PLAYER}，
但我不再消沉了，\p因为我有了新的目标--
和拉鲁拉丝一起挑战宝可梦道馆，\l成为一名厉害的训练家！\p请看着我，{PLAYER}。
总有一天我会比你更强！\p到那时，
我会再次向你挑战！$

label: VerdanturfTown_WandasHouse_Text_StrongerSpeechShort
source: WALLY: Please watch me, {PLAYER}.\nI'm going to get stronger than you.\pWhen I do, I'm going to challenge you\nto another battle.$
translation: 满充：请看着我，{PLAYER}。\n总有一天我会比你更强！\p到那时，\n我会再次向你挑战！$

label: VerdanturfTown_WandasHouse_Text_WallysNextDoor
source:
UNCLE: Oh! {PLAYER}{KUN}!
WALLY's next door.\pBut, boy, there's something I have to
tell you.\pThis natural environment is doing
wonders for WALLY's health.\pMaybe it's not just the environment.
It could be POKéMON that are giving\lthe boy hope.$
translation:
叔叔：哦，{PLAYER}{KUN}！
满充就在隔壁。\p但是，孩子，
有些事我想告诉你，\p这里的自然环境
对满充的身体有好处，\p但让他打起精神来的
并不只是环境，\l是宝可梦给了那孩子希望。$

label: VerdanturfTown_WandasHouse_Text_WallySlippedOff
source: WALLY's gone away…\nHe slipped off on his own…$
translation: 满充不在......\n他一个人溜了出去......$

label: VerdanturfTown_WandasHouse_Text_WallyGoneThatFar
source: UNCLE: Is that right?\nWALLY's gone away that far all by\lhimself…\pWell, I have to give him credit--he is\nmy little brother's son.$
translation: 叔叔：真的吗？\n满充自己一个人\l去了那么远的地方......\p我想我该称赞他一下--\n不愧是我弟弟的儿子。$

label: VerdanturfTown_WandasHouse_Text_MeetWanda
source:
WANDA: You are?
Oh, right, I get it!\pYou're the {PLAYER} who WALLY was
telling me about.\pI'm WALLY's cousin.
Glad to meet you!\pI think WALLY's become a lot more lively
and healthy since he came here.$
translation:
满盈：你是？
哦，我知道了！\p你就是满充常说的
{PLAYER}。\p我是满充的堂姐，
很高兴认识你！\p自从满充来这儿以后，
他变得活泼开朗多了。$

label: VerdanturfTown_WandasHouse_Text_DontWorryAboutWally
source: WANDA: Don't worry about WALLY.\nHe'll be just fine.\pI know my little cousin, and he has\nPOKéMON with him, too.$
translation: 满盈：别担心满充，\n他没事。\p我了解我的堂弟，\n而且还有宝可梦在他的身边。$

label: VerdanturfTown_WandasHouse_Text_CanSeeGirlfriendEveryDay
source: Thanks to you, I can see my girlfriend\nevery day.\lHappy? You bet I am!$
translation: 多亏了你，我可以天天\n跟我的女朋友相聚了。\l开心吗？当然！那还用说！$

label: VerdanturfTown_WandasHouse_Text_DaughtersBoyfriendDriven
source:
My daughter's boyfriend is a very
driven and passionate sort of person.\pHe's been digging a tunnel nonstop
just so he can see my daughter.\pMy daughter's a little concerned,
so she goes out to the tunnel a lot.$
translation:
我女儿的男友是个
充满热情和决心的人，\p他为了见我女儿
每天都不停地挖隧道。\p女儿有些担心，
所以经常跑到隧道去。$

label: VerdanturfTown_WandasHouse_Text_DaughtersBoyfriendWasDigging
source: It's amazing. My daughter's boyfriend\nwas digging the tunnel by hand!\pIt's so incredible!$
translation: 太令人吃惊了，女儿的男友\n徒手挖开了隧道！\p难以置信！$

label: VerdanturfTown_WandasHouse_Text_IfAnythingHappenedToWally
source: If anything were to happen to WALLY,\nI would never be able to look his\lparents in PETALBURG in the eye…$
translation: 要是满充出了什么事，\n我怎么该和他住在\l橙华市的父母交代......$

label: VerdanturfTown_WandasHouse_Text_WallyWasInEverGrande
source: WALLY was in EVER GRANDE?\pHis parents in PETALBURG would be\nastonished to hear that!$
translation: 满充去过彩悠市？\p他那住在橙华市的父母\n一定会大吃一惊的！$

label: VermilionCity_Text_GrimerMultipliesInSludge
source: We're careful about pollution here.\pWe've heard GRIMER multiplies in\ntoxic sludge.$
translation: 我们十分注重对环境的保护。\p我们曾经听说臭泥\n会在有毒的污泥里繁殖。$

label: VermilionCity_Text_DidYouSeeSSAnneInHarbor
source: Did you see the S.S. ANNE moored\nin the harbor?$
translation: 你看到圣特安努号\n停泊在港口了吗？$

label: VermilionCity_Text_SSAnneHasDepartedForYear
source: So, the S.S. ANNE has departed?\pShe'll be back in VERMILION about\nthis time next year.$
translation: 这样啊，圣特安努号离港了？\p她明年会回到\n枯叶来的。$

label: VermilionCity_Text_BuildingOnThisLand
source: I'm putting up a building on this\nplot of land. I own it all.\pMy POKéMON is tamping the land\nto lay the foundation.$
translation: 我在这片土地上修房子。\n你所见的这一切都是我的。\p我的宝可梦\n在夯实这里的地块作为地基。$

label: VermilionCity_Text_Machop
source: MACHOP: Guoh! Gogogoh!$
translation: 腕力 呃啊！喝啊啊啊！$

label: VermilionCity_Text_MachopStompingLandFlat
source: A MACHOP is stomping the land flat.$
translation: 腕力用脚把地面使劲地跺平。$

label: VermilionCity_Text_SSAnneVisitsOnceAYear
source: The S.S. ANNE is a famous luxury\ncruise ship.\pIt visits VERMILION once a year.$
translation: 圣特安努号是一艘\n著名的游轮。\p每年都来枯叶一次。$

label: VermilionCity_Text_CitySign
source: VERMILION CITY\nThe Port of Exquisite Sunsets$
translation: 枯叶市\n落日下美丽的港口$

label: VermilionCity_Text_SnorlaxBlockingRoute12
source: NOTICE!\pROUTE 12 may be blocked off by a\nsleeping POKéMON.\pDetour through ROCK TUNNEL to\nLAVENDER TOWN.\pVERMILION POLICE$
translation: 通知\p12号道路被一只\n熟睡着的宝可梦堵死了。\p请从岩山隧道绕道至\n紫苑镇。\p枯叶警察局$

label: VermilionCity_Text_PokemonFanClubSign
source: POKéMON FAN CLUB\nAll POKéMON fans welcome!$
translation: 宝可梦同好会\n欢迎所有的宝可梦爱好者！$

label: VermilionCity_Text_GymSign
source: VERMILION CITY POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: LT. SURGE\lThe Lightning American!$
translation: 枯叶市宝可梦道馆\n馆主：马志士\l闪电般的美国人！$

label: VermilionCity_Text_VermilionHarbor
source: VERMILION HARBOR$
translation: 枯叶海港$

label: VermilionCity_Text_WelcomeToTheSSAnne
source: Welcome to the S.S. ANNE!$
translation: 欢迎来到圣特安努号！$

label: VermilionCity_Text_DoYouHaveATicket
source: Welcome to the S.S. ANNE!\pExcuse me, do you have a ticket?$
translation: 欢迎来到圣特安努号！\p抱歉，您是否带了票？$

label: VermilionCity_Text_FlashedSSTicket
source: {FONT_NORMAL}{PLAYER} flashed the S.S. TICKET!\p{FONT_MALE}Great!\nWelcome to the S.S. ANNE!$
translation: {FONT_NORMAL}{PLAYER}出示了船票！\p{FONT_MALE}很好！\n欢迎来到圣特安努号！$

label: VermilionCity_Text_DontHaveNeededSSTicket
source: {FONT_NORMAL}{PLAYER} doesn't have the needed\nS.S. TICKET.\p{FONT_MALE}Sorry!\pYou need a ticket to get aboard.$
translation: {FONT_NORMAL}{PLAYER}没有带着要的\n船票。\p{FONT_MALE}对不起！\p想登船必须得有票。$

label: VermilionCity_Text_TheShipSetSail
source: The ship set sail.$
translation: 船顺利地航行着。$

label: VermilionCity_Text_BoardSeagallopTriPass
source: Ah, you have a TRI-PASS.\pWould you like to board\na SEAGALLOP ferry?$
translation: 啊，你带着三岛通行证。\p想坐海烈焰马号\n来此海上旅行吗？$

label: VermilionCity_Text_Seagallop7Departing
source: Okay, everything's in order.\pSEAGALLOP HI-SPEED 7 will be\ndeparting immediately.$
translation: 好，万事俱备了。\p海烈焰马号将以7被的高速\n马上起航。$

label: VermilionCity_Text_BoardSeagallopRainbowPass
source: Ah, you have a RAINBOW PASS.\pWould you like to board\na SEAGALLOP ferry?$
translation: 啊，你带着彩虹通行证。\p想坐海烈焰马号\n来次海上旅行吗？$

label: VermilionCity_Text_OhMysticTicketTakeYouToNavelRock
source: Oh! That's a MYSTICTICKET!\nNow that is rare.\pWe'll be happy to take you to\nNAVEL ROCK anytime.$
translation: 哦！是神秘的船票啊！\n这可是难得的珍稀之物。\p您要是想前往脐之岩，\n我们随时恭候大驾。$

label: VermilionCity_Text_OhAuroraTicketTakeYouToBirthIsland
source: Oh! That's an AURORATICKET!\nNow that is rare.\pWe'll be happy to take you to\nBIRTH ISLAND anytime.$
translation: 哦！是诞生之岛船票啊！\n这可是难得的珍稀之物。\p您要是想前往诞生之岛，\n我们随时恭候大驾。$

label: VermilionCity_Text_BoardSeagallopFerry
source: Would you like to board\na SEAGALLOP ferry?$
translation: 你想乘坐海烈焰马号游艇吗？$

label: VermilionCity_Text_Seagallop10Departing
source: Okay, everything's in order for you\nto board a special ferry.\pSEAGALLOP HI-SPEED 10 will be\ndeparting immediately.$
translation: 好了，您登艇的相关手续已经\n办理完毕。\p海烈焰马号将以10倍的高速\n马上起航。$

label: VermilionCity_Text_Seagallop12Departing
source: Okay, everything's in order for you\nto board a special ferry.\pSEAGALLOP HI-SPEED 12 will be\ndeparting immediately.$
translation: 好了，您登艇的相关手续已经\n办理完毕。\p海烈焰马号将以12倍的高速\n开始起航。$

label: VermilionCity_Gym_Text_LtSurgeIntro
source:
Hey, kid! What do you think you're
doing here?\pYou won't live long in combat!
Not with your puny power!\pI tell you, kid, electric POKéMON
saved me during the war!\pThey zapped my enemies into
paralysis!\pThe same as I'll do to you!{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_RG_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}$
translation:
嘿，小子，
你在这儿发什么呆呢？\p打起仗来你可活不长的！
瞧你那可怜的力量！\p我告诉你，小子，
电属性宝可梦在战争中救过我！\p它们把我的敌人电得麻痹了！\p我也要把你电成这样！{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_RG_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}$

label: VermilionCity_Gym_Text_LtSurgePostBattle
source: A little word of advice, kid!\pElectricity is sure powerful!\pBut, it's useless against GROUND-\ntype POKéMON!$
translation: 给你一点忠告，小朋友！\p电流是很强大的力量！\p但是，若是对地面属性的宝可梦\n它就毫无用处！$

label: VermilionCity_Gym_Text_ExplainThunderBadgeTakeThis
source:
The THUNDERBADGE cranks up your
POKéMON's SPEED!\pIt also lets your POKéMON FLY
lightning-quick anytime, kid!\pYou're special, kid!
Take this!$
translation: 橘色徽章能提升你宝可梦的速度！\p能让你的宝可梦飞翔得\n像闪电一样快，\p你很特别啊，小子！\n拿着这个吧！$

label: VermilionCity_Gym_Text_ReceivedTM34FromLtSurge
source: {PLAYER} received TM34\nfrom LT. SURGE.$
translation: {PLAYER}从马志士那儿得到了TM34。$

label: VermilionCity_Gym_Text_ExplainTM34
source: TM34 contains SHOCK WAVE!\pTeach it to an ELECTRIC POKéMON!$
translation: TM34是电击波！\p把它教给一只电属性宝可梦！$

label: VermilionCity_Gym_Text_MakeRoomInYourBag
source: Yo, kid, make room in your BAG!$
translation: 哟，小子，把你的背包里腾出空间来！$

label: VermilionCity_Gym_Text_LtSurgeDefeat
source: Now that's a shocker!\pYou're the real deal, kid!\pFine, then, take the THUNDERBADGE!$
translation: 真是令人吃惊！\p你有两下子嘛，小子！\p好吧，拿着这个橘色徽章！$

label: VermilionCity_Gym_Text_TuckerIntro
source: When I was in the Army, LT. SURGE\nwas my strict CO.\pHe was a hard taskmaster.$
translation: 当我在军队的时候，马志士\n是一个严厉的长官。\p他完成任务时总是很卖力。$

label: VermilionCity_Gym_Text_TuckerDefeat
source: Stop!\nYou're very good!$
translation: 停止！\n你太厉害了！$

label: VermilionCity_Gym_Text_TuckerPostBattle
source: It's not easy opening that door.\pLT. SURGE was always famous for\nhis cautious nature in the Army.$
translation: 想打开这扇门可没那么容易。\p马志士以前在军队里\n以他的谨慎而出名。$

label: VermilionCity_Gym_Text_BailyIntro
source: I'm a lightweight, but I'm good\nwith electricity!\pThat's why I joined this GYM.$
translation: 虽然我体重很轻，\n但是我擅长使用电！\p所以我加入了这个道馆。$

label: VermilionCity_Gym_Text_BailyDefeat
source: Fried!$
translation: 醉了！$

label: VermilionCity_Gym_Text_BailyPostBattle
source: Okay, I'll talk!\pLT. SURGE said he hid door\nswitches inside something.$
translation: 好了，我说我说！\p马志士说过他把开关\n藏在什么东西里了。$

label: VermilionCity_Gym_Text_DwayneIntro
source: This is no place for kids!\nNot even if you're good!$
translation: 这里不是小孩子该来的地方！\n即使你很厉害也不行！$

label: VermilionCity_Gym_Text_DwayneDefeat
source: Wow!\nSurprised me!$
translation: 哇！\n你竟然这么厉害！$

label: VermilionCity_Gym_Text_DwaynePostBattle
source:
LT. SURGE installed the traps in
the GYM himself.\pHe set up double locks everywhere.
Let me give you a hint.\pWhen you open the first lock, the
second lock is right next to it.$
translation: 训练馆的机关是马志士亲自安装的。\p他做的机关都是双层的。\n我给你点提示吧。\p如果你找到了打开第一道电锁的开关，\n第二道电锁的开关就在它的附近。$

label: VermilionCity_Gym_Text_GymGuyAdvice
source:
Yo!
Champ in the making!\pLT. SURGE has a nickname.\pPeople refer to him as the
Lightning American!\pHe's an expert on electric
POKéMON.\pBIRD/WATER-type POKéMON match
poorly against the ELECTRIC type.\pBeware of paralysis, too.\pLT. SURGE is very cautious.\pHe's locked himself in, so it won't
be easy getting to him.$
translation:
嗨！
未来的冠军！\p马志士有一个外号。\p人们把他称作"闪电般的美国人"！\p他是电属性宝可梦的专家。\p飞行属性和水属性的宝可梦
遇着电属性的会很不利。\p你也要提防别被麻痹了。\p马志士是非常谨慎小心的。\p他把自己锁在了里面，
所以你想要跟他对战可不容易。$

label: VermilionCity_Gym_Text_GymGuyPostVictory
source: Whew!\nThat match was electric!$
translation: 唔！\n这场对战真带劲！$

label: VermilionCity_Gym_Text_GymStatue
source: VERMILION POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: LT. SURGE\pWINNING TRAINERS:\n{RIVAL}$
translation: 枯叶宝可梦道馆\n馆主：马志士\p获胜训练家：\n{RIVAL}$

label: VermilionCity_Gym_Text_GymStatuePlayerWon
source: VERMILION POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: LT. SURGE\pWINNING TRAINERS:\n{RIVAL}, {PLAYER}$
translation: 枯叶宝可梦道馆\n馆主：马志士\p获胜训练家：\n{RIVAL}、{PLAYER}$

label: VermilionCity_Gym_Text_NopeOnlyTrashHere
source: Nope!\nThere's only trash here.$
translation: 什么也没有！\n里面只有一些垃圾。$

label: VermilionCity_Gym_Text_SwitchUnderTrashFirstLockOpened
source: Hey! There's a switch under the\ntrash! Turn it on!\pThe first electric lock opened!$
translation: 嘿！垃圾下面有个开关！\n打开它！\p第一道电锁打开了！$

label: VermilionCity_Gym_Text_SecondLockOpened
source: The second electric lock opened!\nThe motorized door opened!$
translation: 第二道电锁打开了！\n门开了！$

label: VermilionCity_Gym_Text_OnlyTrashLocksWereReset
source: Nope!\nThere's only trash here.\pHey!\nThe electric locks were reset!$
translation: 什么也没有！\n里边只是一些垃圾。\p嘿！\n电锁重置了！$

label: VermilionCity_House1_Text_ImFishingGuruDoYouLikeToFish
source: I'm the FISHING GURU!\pI simply looove fishing!\nI can't bear to go without.\pTell me, do you like to fish?$
translation: 我是钓鱼大师！\p我相当喜欢钓鱼。\n不钓鱼的日子我一天也受不了。\p告诉我，你喜欢钓鱼吗？$

label: VermilionCity_House1_Text_TakeThisAndFish
source: Grand! I like your style.\nI think we can be friends.\pTake this and fish, young friend!$
translation: 好极了，我喜欢你的风格。\n我想我们能成为朋友。\p拿着这个享受垂钓吧，朋友！$

label: VermilionCity_House1_Text_ReceivedOldRodFromFishingGuru
source: {PLAYER} received an OLD ROD from\nthe FISHING GURU.$
translation: {PLAYER}从钓鱼大师那儿得到了破钓竿。$

label: VermilionCity_House1_Text_FishingIsAWayOfLife
source: Fishing is a way of life!\nIt is like the finest poetry.\pFrom the seas to rivers, go out\nand land the big one, my friend.$
translation: 钓鱼是一种生活方式！\n就像是最美的诗歌。\p从海洋到河流，\n去钓上最大的那条，我的朋友。$

label: VermilionCity_House1_Text_OhThatsSoDisappointing
source: Oh…\nThat's so disappointing…$

label: VermilionCity_House1_Text_HowAreTheFishBiting
source: Hello there, {PLAYER}!\pHow are the fish biting?$
translation: 嘿，{PLAYER}！\p鱼儿是如何咬钩的？$

label: VermilionCity_House1_Text_NoRoomForNiceGift
source: Oh, no!\pI had a nice gift for you, but you\nhave no room for it!$
translation: 噢，不！\p我有个好的礼物要送给你，\n可惜你的背包满了！$

label: VermilionCity_House2_Text_DoYouHaveMonWantToTradeForMyMon
source: Hi!\nDo you have a {STR_VAR_1}?\pWant to trade it for my\n{STR_VAR_2}?$
translation: 嗨！\n你有{STR_VAR_1}吗？\p要和我的{STR_VAR_2}交换吗？$

label: VermilionCity_House2_Text_ThatsTooBad
source: That's too bad.$
translation: 太糟了。$

label: VermilionCity_House2_Text_ThisIsNoMon
source: …This is no {STR_VAR_1}.\pIf you get one, please trade it\nto me!$
translation: ......这不是{STR_VAR_1}。\p如果你得到了一只，\n请和我交换吧！$

label: VermilionCity_House2_Text_ThankYou
source: Thank you!$
translation: 谢谢你！$

label: VermilionCity_House2_Text_HowIsMyOldMon
source: How is my old {STR_VAR_2}?\pMy {STR_VAR_1} is doing great!$
translation: 我的{STR_VAR_2}怎么样了？\p我的{STR_VAR_1}现在很好！$

label: VermilionCity_House3_Text_PidgeyFlyLetterToSaffron
source: I'm getting my PIDGEY to fly a\nletter to SAFFRON in the north.$
translation: 我正让我的波波飞去北边的金黄\n送一封信。$

label: VermilionCity_House3_Text_Pidgey
source: PIDGEY: Kurukkoo!$
translation: 波波：咕噜咕！$

label: VermilionCity_House3_Text_DearPippiLetter
source: Dear PIPPI,\nI hope to see you soon.\pI heard SAFFRON has problems with\nTEAM ROCKET.\pVERMILION appears to be safe.$
translation: 亲爱的比比，\n希望能很快见到你。\p我听说火箭队在金黄制造麻烦。\p枯叶似乎还安全。$

label: VermilionCity_House3_Text_SendMyPidgeyToUnionRoom
source: I want to exchange MAIL with all\nsorts of people.\pI send my PIDGEY to a UNION ROOM\nto exchange MAIL for me.$
translation: 我想和各种各样的人通信。\p我常把波波派去联合房间\n替我传递信件。$

label: VermilionCity_Mart_Text_TeamRocketAreWickedPeople
source:
There are wicked people who will
use POKéMON for criminal acts.\pTEAM ROCKET traffics in rare
POKéMON, for example.\pThey also abandon POKéMON that
they consider unpopular or useless.\pThat's the sort of horrid people
they are, TEAM ROCKET.$
translation:
有一些邪恶的人们
用宝可梦从事犯罪活动。\p比如说，火箭队
非法交易珍贵的宝可梦。\p他们也遗弃那些他们认为
不受欢迎的或没用了的宝可梦。\p我说的就是火箭队，
他们真是一群可怕的人。$

label: VermilionCity_Mart_Text_MonsGoodOrBadDependingOnTrainer
source: I think POKéMON can be good or\nbad. It depends on the TRAINER.$
translation: 我认为宝可梦品质是好是坏。\n完全取决于它的训练家。$

label: VermilionCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_TrainerMonsStrongerThanWild
source: Even if they are the same level,\nPOKéMON can have very different\lstats and abilities.\pA POKéMON raised by a TRAINER is\nstronger than one in the wild.$
translation: 即使是相同的等级，\n宝可梦能拥有非常不同的\l技能和力量。\p训练家培育的宝可梦\n要强于野生的。$

label: VermilionCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_PoisonedMonFaintedWhileWalking
source: My POKéMON was poisoned!\nIt fainted while we were walking!$
translation: 我的宝可梦中毒了！\n我们走路的时候它会进入濒死状态！$

label: VermilionCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_AllMonWeakToSpecificTypes
source:
It is true that a higher-level
POKéMON will be more powerful…\pBut, all POKéMON will have weak
points against specific types.\pSo, there appears to be no
universally strong POKéMON.$
translation: 确实一只等级高的\n宝可梦会更厉害......\p但是，所有的宝可梦在对上\n特定的系的时候都会有弱点。\p所以，没有一只永远强大的宝可梦。$

label: VermilionCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_UrgeToBattleSomeoneAgain
source:
The urge to battle with someone
you've tangled with before…\pHave you ever had that urge?
I'm sure you have.\pI wanted to battle certain people
again over and over, too.\pSo, I've been giving these away.
Please, take one!$
translation:
对曾经战斗过的人
你有过......\p想要再次挑战的欲望吗？
我想你肯定有过。\p我也想一次又一次地
和从前的某些人战斗。\p我就是以这样的方式在战斗着。
拿着这个吧！$

label: VermilionCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_UseDeviceForRematches
source: Use that device and you'll find\nTRAINERS looking for a rematch.\pYou have to charge its battery to\nuse it, though.$
translation: 用这个装置你可以找到\n曾经战斗过的训练家再战。\p但是你在使用前得把电充好。$

label: VermilionCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_ExplainVSSeeker
source:
How do you use the VS SEEKER?
There's nothing to it.\pUse it like beep-beep-beep, and
TRAINERS around you will notice.\pIf any TRAINER wants a rematch,
it will let you know immediately.\pCharge its battery and use it
while you're on a road.$
translation:
你是怎样使用对战搜寻器的？
这没什么困难的。\p使用时会发出哔-哔-嘟的声音，
你再看看周围的训练家。\p如过任何训练家想再战，
它会让你马上知道。\p当你在室外时，
记得先充好电。$

label: VermilionCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_AdmirePikachusTail
source: Won't you admire my PIKACHU's\nadorable tail?$
translation: 你不喜欢我的皮卡丘的\n讨人爱的尾巴吗？$

label: VermilionCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_PikachuTwiceAsCute
source: Humph!\pMy PIKACHU is twice as cute as\nthat one!$
translation: 哼！\p我的皮卡丘有\n你那一只两倍的可爱！$

label: VermilionCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_AdoreMySeel
source: I just adore my SEEL!\nIt's so lovable!\pIt squeals, “Kyuuuh,” when I\nhug it!$
translation: 我非常喜欢我的小海狮！\n它太可爱啦！\p当我抱着它时，\n它会叫着，"咕呜。"$

label: VermilionCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_SeelFarMoreAttractive
source: Oh, dear!\pMy SEEL is far more attractive.\nBy double, I would say.$
translation: 噢，天哪！\p我的小海狮太有吸引力了。\n我不得不说。$

label: VermilionCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_Pikachu
source: PIKACHU: Chu! Pikachu!$
translation: 皮卡丘：丘！皮卡丘！$

label: VermilionCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_Seel
source: SEEL: Kyuoo!$
translation: 小海狮：咕呜！$

label: VermilionCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_DidYouComeToHearAboutMyMons
source:
I chair the POKéMON Fan Club!\pI raise more than a hundred
POKéMON!\pI'm very fussy when it comes to
POKéMON! I surely am!\pSo…\pDid you come visit to hear about
my POKéMON?$
translation: 我经营着宝可梦同好会！\p我培养着100多只宝可梦！\p当谈到宝可梦时我会变得很激动！\n真的是这样！\p所以......\p你是来听我的宝可梦的故事的吗？$

label: VermilionCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_ChairmansStory
source:
Good!
Then listen up!\pMy favorite RAPIDASH…\pIt's…cute…lovely…smart… 
plus…amazing…you think so?…\loh yes…it's…stunning…\lkindly…love it!\pHug it…when…sleeping…warm
and cuddly…spectacular…\lravishing…\l…Oops! Look at the time!\lI kept you too long!\pThanks for hearing me out!
I want you to have this!$
translation:
好！
听好了！\p我最喜爱的烈焰马......\p它真是漂亮......可爱......聪明......
异乎寻常......你这样认为吗？\l对......它很出色......\l友好......好喜欢它！\p抱着它......睡觉时......
感到温暖......亲切......\l迷人......\l......哎！看这时间！\l我让你呆太久了！\p谢谢你一直在听我说！
我要给你这个！$

label: VermilionCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_ReceivedBikeVoucherFromChairman
source: {PLAYER} received a BIKE VOUCHER\nfrom the CHAIRMAN.$
translation: {PLAYER}从主席那里\n得到了自行车兑换券。$

label: VermilionCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_ExplainBikeVoucher
source:
Take that BIKE VOUCHER to the
BIKE SHOP in CERULEAN CITY.\pExchange that for a BICYCLE
free of charge!\pDon't worry, my favorite FEAROW
will FLY me anywhere I need to go.\pSo, I have no need for a BICYCLE.\pI hope you like cycling!$
translation: 拿着这个自行车兑换券去\n华蓝市的自行车行。\p可以免费换到一辆自行车！\p别担心，我的大嘴雀\n会带我飞翔到任何我想去的地方。\p所以，我不需要自行车。\p我希望你喜欢骑车！$

label: VermilionCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_ComeBackToHearStory
source: Oh. Come back when you want to\nhear my story!$
translation: 噢。当你想听我的故事时\n就再回来吧！$

label: VermilionCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_DidntComeToSeeAboutMonsAgain
source: Hello, {PLAYER}!\pDid you come see me about my\nPOKéMON again?\pNo?\nToo bad!$
translation: 你好，{PLAYER}！\p你是再来听我讲我的\n宝可梦的吗？\p不是？\n太糟糕了！$

label: VermilionCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_MakeRoomForThis
source: Make room for this!$
translation: 要腾出空间来放这个！$

label: VermilionCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_ChairmanVeryVocalAboutPokemon
source: Our CHAIRMAN is very vocal about\nPOKéMON.$
translation: 我们的主席在说到\n宝可梦时口才特别好。$

label: VermilionCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_ListenPolitelyToOtherTrainers
source: Let's all listen politely to other\nTRAINERS!$
translation: 我们都很耐心地听其他\n训练家说话！$

label: VermilionCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_SomeoneBragsBragBack
source: If someone brags, brag right back!$
translation: 当有人在晒的时侯，给他晒回去！$

label: VermilionCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_ChairmanReallyAdoresHisMons
source: Our CHAIRMAN really does adore his\nPOKéMON.\pBut the person who is most liked by\nPOKéMON is DAISY, I think.$
translation: 我们的主席真的很喜欢他的宝可梦。\p但是我觉得更喜欢\n宝可梦的人是奈奈美。$

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_WallyNotGoingToLoseAnymore
source:
WALLY: Hi! {PLAYER}!\pI bet you're surprised to see me here!\pI made it all the way here, and it's
all thanks to you!\p{PLAYER}, losing to you that time
made me stronger!\pBut I'm not going to lose anymore!\pI'm going to win! For the POKéMON who
gave me courage and strength!\pOkay… Here I come!$
translation:
满充：嗨！{PLAYER}！\p没想到会在这里见到我吧！\p能走到这里都是
多亏了你！\p{PLAYER}，那次输给你
让我变得更强了......\p但这次我不会再输了！\p为了给了我勇气和力量的宝可梦们--
我一定要赢！\p那么......开始吧！$

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_WallyEntranceDefeat
source: Wow!\n{PLAYER}, you are strong, after all!$
translation: 哇！\n{PLAYER}，你果然还是更强啊！$

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_WallyPostEntranceBattle
source: WALLY: I couldn't beat you today,\n{PLAYER}, but one of these days, I'll\lcatch up to you!$
translation: 满充：{PLAYER}，\n虽然今天还是没能赢你......\l但总有一天我一定会追上你的！$

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_WallyIntro
source: WALLY: Hi! {PLAYER}!\pI've gotten stronger since that last\ntime! I wanted to show you, {PLAYER}!\pOkay… Here I come!$
translation: 满充：嗨！{PLAYER}！\p我比上一次变得更强了！\n想让你看看，{PLAYER}！\p那么......开始吧！$

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_WallyDefeat
source: Wow!\n{PLAYER}, you are strong, after all!$
translation: 哇！\n{PLAYER}，你果然还是更强啊！$

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_WallyPostBattle
source: WALLY: I couldn't beat you this time,\ntoo… But one of these days, {PLAYER},\lI'm going to catch up to you…\pAnd challenge the POKéMON LEAGUE!$
translation: 满充：这次我还是赢不了你......\n但总有一天，{PLAYER}，\l我会追上你......\p然后挑战宝可梦联盟！$

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_EdgarIntro
source: I've made it this far a couple times,\nbut the last stretch is so long…$
translation: 我花了这么长时间到达这里，\n但这最后一段路实在是太长了......$

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_EdgarDefeat
source: My dream ends here again…$
translation: 我的梦想要再次终结了吗......$

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_EdgarPostBattle
source: You've made it this far. Keep the\nmomentum going and become the\lCHAMPION! If anyone can, it's you!$
translation: 既然好不容易来到这里，\n就顺着这势头冲向冠军吧！\l要说谁能做到的话，那就是你！$

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_AlbertIntro
source: I didn't come all this way to lose now.\nThat possibility doesn't exist!$
translation: 我千里迢迢来这里可不是为了失败的。\n那是绝对不可能的事情！$

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_AlbertDefeat
source: Impossible…\nI lost?$
translation: 不可能......\n我输了？$

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_AlbertPostBattle
source: I lost here…\pThat means I lack the qualifications\nto become the CHAMPION…$
translation: 我输在了这里......\p这就是说我没有\n成为冠军的资格......$

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_HopeIntro
source: This seemingly infinite and harsh road\nlives up to its name of VICTORY.$
translation: 这条无尽却艰险的道路\n不愧于冠军之名。$

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_HopeDefeat
source: Your battle style is fantastic…$
translation: 你的战斗风格真完美......$

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_HopePostBattle
source: You seem to have the potential for\nbecoming the CHAMPION.$
translation: 看起来你有成为\n冠军的潜力。$

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_QuincyIntro
source: What is the VICTORY ROAD?\nI'll tell you if you win!$
translation: 冠军之路是什么？\n如果你赢了，我会告诉你的！$

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_QuincyDefeat
source: Okay!\nWell done!$
translation: 嘿！\n干得漂亮！$

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_QuincyPostBattle
source: Getting through here safely--that's\nthe final test for any TRAINER aiming\lto become the POKéMON CHAMPION.\pThat's why it's called the VICTORY\nROAD.$
translation: 顺利地通过这里--这是对所有想成为\n宝可梦冠军的训练家们的最终考验。\p这也是它被称作\n冠军之路的原因。$

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_KatelynnIntro
source: I have nothing to say to anyone\nthat's come this far. Come on!$
translation: 我对来到这里的人\n没有什么话可说。上吧！$

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_KatelynnDefeat
source: This is a disgrace…$

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_KatelynnPostBattle
source: Humph, go right on ahead.\nSee if I care.$
translation: 唔，继续走吧。\n我不介意。$

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_NaomiIntro
source: I wonder if you are good enough\nfor me?$
translation: 我想知道你配得上做我的对手吗？$

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_NaomiDefeat
source: I lost out…$
translation: 我输给你了......$

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_NaomiPostBattle
source: I never wanted to lose to anybody,\nespecially to a younger kid…$
translation: 我不想输给任何人，\n尤其是一个年轻的孩子......$

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_RolandoIntro
source: I can see you're good.\nLet me see exactly how good!$
translation: 我能感到你很厉害。\n让我看看你到底有多厉害！$

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_RolandoDefeat
source: I had a chance…$
translation: 我有胜算的......$

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_RolandoPostBattle
source: Tch!\nI concede, you are better than I!$
translation: 好！\n我承认，你比我强！$

label: VictoryRoad_2F_Text_DawsonIntro
source: If you can get through here,\nyou can go meet the ELITE FOUR.$
translation: 如果你能从这里通过，\n你就可以去见四天王。$

label: VictoryRoad_2F_Text_DawsonDefeat
source: No!\nUnbelievable!$
translation: 不！\n令人难以置信！$

label: VictoryRoad_2F_Text_DawsonPostBattle
source: I can beat you when it comes to\nknowledge about POKéMON!$
translation: 要是谈起宝可梦方面的知识，\n我绝对比你强！$

label: VictoryRoad_2F_Text_DaisukeIntro
source: This here is VICTORY ROAD.\nIt's the final test for TRAINERS!$
translation: 这里就是冠军之路。\n这是训练家的最终试炼！$

label: VictoryRoad_2F_Text_DaisukeDefeat
source: Atcho!$
translation: 阿嚏！$

label: VictoryRoad_2F_Text_DaisukePostBattle
source: If you get stuck, try moving some\nboulders around.$
translation: 当你被卡住的时候，\n试着移动一些在周围的巨石。$

label: VictoryRoad_2F_Text_NelsonIntro
source: Ah, so you wish to challenge the\nELITE FOUR?$
translation: 啊，你想挑战\n四天王吗？$

label: VictoryRoad_2F_Text_NelsonDefeat
source: You got me!$
translation: 我败给你了！$

label: VictoryRoad_2F_Text_NelsonPostBattle
source: {RIVAL} also came through here.$
translation: {RIVAL}到此一游。$

label: VictoryRoad_2F_Text_VincentIntro
source: Come on!\nI'll whip you!$
translation: 来吧！\n我会击垮你！$

label: VictoryRoad_2F_Text_VincentDefeat
source: I got whipped!$
translation: 我被击垮了！$

label: VictoryRoad_2F_Text_VincentPostBattle
source: You earned the right to be on\nVICTORY ROAD…$
translation: 你获得了进入\n冠军之路的权利......$

label: VictoryRoad_2F_Text_GregoryIntro
source: Is VICTORY ROAD too tough?$
translation: 冠军之路很艰难吗？$

label: VictoryRoad_2F_Text_GregoryDefeat
source: Well done!$
translation: 干得好！$

label: VictoryRoad_2F_Text_GregoryPostBattle
source: Many TRAINERS give up their\nchallenge here and go home.$
translation: 许多训练家放弃在\n这里的挑战，回老家结婚去了。$

label: Text_DoubleEdgeTeach
source:
You should be proud of yourself,
having battled your way through\lVICTORY ROAD so courageously.\pIn recognition of your feat,
I'll teach you DOUBLE-EDGE.\pWould you like me to teach that
technique?$
translation: 你应该为自己感到骄傲，\n你已经在这条冠军之路上\l勇敢的杀出了属于自己的路。\p作为对你成绩的认可\n我会教你舍身冲撞。\p你想要我教你学这个技能吗？$

label: Text_DoubleEdgeDeclined
source: I'll teach you the technique\nanytime.$
translation: 我随时都能教你这个技能的。$

label: Text_DoubleEdgeWhichMon
source: Which POKéMON should I teach\nDOUBLE-EDGE?$
translation: 我要教哪个宝可梦\n舍身冲撞$

label: Text_DoubleEdgeTaught
source: Keep that drive going for the\nPOKéMON LEAGUE!\pTake a run at them and knock 'em\nout!$
translation: 保持那股动力，\n去参加宝可梦联盟吧！\p去会会他们\n并将他们通通击败吧！$

label: VictoryRoad_3F_Text_GeorgeIntro
source: I heard rumors of a child prodigy.$
translation: 我听说关于一个神童的传闻。$

label: VictoryRoad_3F_Text_GeorgeDefeat
source: The rumors were true!$
translation: 传闻是真的！$

label: VictoryRoad_3F_Text_GeorgePostBattle
source: So, it was you who beat GIOVANNI\nof TEAM ROCKET?$
translation: 莫非，就是你击败了\n火箭队的坂木吗？$

label: VictoryRoad_3F_Text_AlexaIntro
source: TRAINERS live to seek stronger\nopponents.$
translation: 训练家的人生就是\n去寻找更强的对手。$

label: VictoryRoad_3F_Text_AlexaDefeat
source: Oh!\nSo strong!$
translation: 啊！\n这么强！$

label: VictoryRoad_3F_Text_AlexaPostBattle
source: By fighting tough battles, you get\nstronger.$
translation: 在艰难的战斗中，\n你会变得更强。$

label: VictoryRoad_3F_Text_CarolineIntro
source: I'll show you just how good you\nare. Not!$
translation: 我会让你看看你到底\n有多强......还是多弱！$

label: VictoryRoad_3F_Text_CarolineDefeat
source: I'm furious!$
translation: 我很气愤！$

label: VictoryRoad_3F_Text_CarolinePostBattle
source: You showed me just how good\nI was…$
translation: 你只不过证明了我有多强......$

label: VictoryRoad_3F_Text_ColbyIntro
source: Only the chosen can pass here!$
translation: 只有被选中的人可以通过这里！$

label: VictoryRoad_3F_Text_ColbyDefeat
source: I don't believe it!$
translation: 我不相信！$

label: VictoryRoad_3F_Text_ColbyPostBattle
source: All TRAINERS here are headed to\nthe POKéMON LEAGUE.\pDon't let down your guard.$
translation: 这里所有的训练家都以\n宝可梦联盟为目标。\p不要放松警惕。$

label: VictoryRoad_3F_Text_RayIntro
source: RAY: Together, the two of us are\ndestined for greatness!$
translation: 阿新：我们俩在一起会更强大！$

label: VictoryRoad_3F_Text_RayDefeat
source: RAY: Ludicrous!\nThis can't be!$
translation: 阿新：真可笑！\n这是不可能的！$

label: VictoryRoad_3F_Text_RayPostBattle
source: RAY: You've beaten us.\nGreatness remains elusive…$
translation: 阿新：你打败了我们。\n强大的人总是难以捉摸......$

label: VictoryRoad_3F_Text_RayNotEnoughMons
source: RAY: Together, the two of us are\nstriving for the pinnacle.\pWe need you to bring two POKéMON\ninto battle with us.$
translation: 阿新：我们俩一起着向冠军努力。\p请你带上两只宝可梦\n来跟我们战斗。$

label: VictoryRoad_3F_Text_TyraIntro
source: TYRA: We're trying to become\nchampions together.$
translation: 佳代：我们正试着一起\n变成冠军。$

label: VictoryRoad_3F_Text_TyraDefeat
source: TYRA: Oh, but…$

label: VictoryRoad_3F_Text_TyraPostBattle
source: TYRA: You've taught me that power\ncan be infinite in shape and form.$
translation: 佳代：你教会了我，\n实力有无数种形式和形态。$

label: VictoryRoad_3F_Text_TyraNotEnoughMons
source: TYRA: You can't battle with us if\nyou have only one POKéMON.$
translation: 佳代：如果你只有一只宝可梦，\n就不能和我们战斗。$

label: VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_SamuelIntro
source: The thought that I'm getting closer to\nthe POKéMON LEAGUE…\pI'm getting stage fright…$
translation: 一想到我离宝可梦联盟\n越来越近了......\p我开始有些怯场的感觉了......$

label: VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_SamuelDefeat
source: I couldn't do a thing…$
translation: 我什么也做不了......$

label: VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_SamuelPostBattle
source: The POKéMON LEAGUE became distant\nagain… What a letdown…$
translation: 宝可梦联盟又变得\n遥远了......好失望......$

label: VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_ShannonIntro
source: To win your way through the POKéMON\nLEAGUE, you need the trust of your\lPOKéMON.$
translation: 想要通过宝可梦联盟\n的考验，你必须信任你的\l宝可梦。$

label: VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_ShannonDefeat
source: Your relationship is based on\nsolid trust.$
translation: 是你们之间的信赖\n将你们紧紧联系在一起。$

label: VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_ShannonPostBattle
source: By being together all the time, trust\ngrows between POKéMON and TRAINERS.$
translation: 形影不离，患难与共，\n宝可梦和训练家的信任会逐渐增强。$

label: VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_MichelleIntro
source: This isn't the goal. It's only a place\non the way to the POKéMON LEAGUE.$
translation: 这里不是终点，这只是通向\n宝可梦联盟的道路上的一个小站。$

label: VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_MichelleDefeat
source: That's the way!$
translation: 就是这样！$

label: VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_MichellePostBattle
source: You'll do fine, for sure!\nYour POKéMON are all eager to go!$
translation: 你一定会干得很好的！\n你的宝可梦都那么渴望着胜利！$

label: VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_MitchellIntro
source: My POKéMON are cosmically\nawe inspiring!$
translation: 我的宝可梦的士气已经\n达到了顶点！$

label: VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_MitchellDefeat
source: I've never met anyone like you before.$
translation: 我从来没见过像你这样的人。$

label: VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_MitchellPostBattle
source: Even outside of battle, I sense\nincredible power emanating from you\land your POKéMON.$
translation: 就算在战斗之外，我也能感受到\n从你和你的宝可梦身上\l散发出的力量。$

label: VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_HalleIntro
source: Okay, no need to get your back up!\nRelax, let's take it easy!$
translation: 好了，别那么紧张！\n放松，放松一点！$

label: VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_HalleDefeat
source: Whoa!\nWonderful!$
translation: 哇啊！\n漂亮！$

label: VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_HallePostBattle
source: Sure, this is VICTORY ROAD.\pBut it's not all that different from\nthe path you've taken so far.\pTry to enjoy things the rest of\nthe way!$
translation:
尽管这里的确是
冠军之路，\p但它与你之前所经过的道路
并无太大不同。\p试着去享受你之后
将会遇到的一切吧！$

label: VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_VitoIntro
source: I trained together with my whole family,\nevery one of us!\lI'm not losing to anyone!$
translation: 我和我的家人一起训练，\n整个一个大家族啊！\l我不会输给任何人的！$

label: VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_VitoDefeat
source: Better than my family?!\nIs that possible?!$
translation: 比我的家人更强？！\n这可能吗？！$

label: VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_VitoPostBattle
source: I was better than everyone in my\nfamily. I've never lost before…\pI've lost my confidence…\nMaybe I'll go home…$
translation: 我比我家里的任何一个人都强，\n我之前从没输过的......\p我失去信心了......\n回家好了......$

label: VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_OwenIntro
source: I'd heard that there was a tough\nlittle kid around. Do they mean you?$
translation: 听说这附近来了一个很强的\n小孩，说的是你吗？$

label: VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_OwenDefeat
source: The little shrimp is tough!$
translation: 你这小鬼竟然这么强！$

label: VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_OwenPostBattle
source: The rumors I heard, that tough little\nkid is from PETALBURG CITY.$
translation: 传言说那个很强的小孩\n来自橙华市。$

label: VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_CarolineIntro
source: You must be getting a little tired.$
translation: 你一定有点累了吧。$

label: VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_CarolineDefeat
source: No signs of tiring at all!$
translation: 一点也看不出累来！$

label: VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_CarolinePostBattle
source: VICTORY ROAD and the POKéMON LEAGUE\nare long and grueling challenges.\lBeware of fatigue!$
translation: 冠军之路和宝可梦联盟\n的挑战都会很累人的，\l作好准备吧！$

label: VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_JulieIntro
source: You shouldn't get complacent just\nbecause you have a lot of GYM BADGES.\pThere's always going to be someone\nwho's better than you!$
translation: 有了很多道馆徽章\n就自大起来可不行，\p没听说过\n山外有山吗！$

label: VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_JulieDefeat
source: You're better than me!$
translation: 看来你比我还强！$

label: VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_JuliePostBattle
source: Gaze on your collected BADGES and\nremember the TRAINERS you've faced.$
translation: 看着自己收集的徽章，回忆一下\n那些曾与自己相逢的训练家们吧。$

label: VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_FelixIntro
source: I've come this far, but the tension's\ngiving me awful stomach pain…$
translation: 我做了这么多努力，\n但是紧张让我的肚子疼得厉害......$

label: VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_FelixDefeat
source: Ooh…\nIt hurts…$

label: VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_FelixPostBattle
source: I can't help getting all tense knowing\nthat I'm nearing the POKéMON LEAGUE.\pIt's all I can do to feign calm.$
translation: 一想到宝可梦联盟已经近在咫尺了\n我就紧张得不行。\p我只是假装冷静而已。$

label: VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_DianneIntro
source: The elite among the elite gather in\nthis cave.\pHow are you finding it?$
translation: 这个洞穴里聚集着\n精英中的精英。\p你有什么感觉？$

label: VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_DianneDefeat
source: Not rattled in the least bit!$
translation: 一点都不紧张！$

label: VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_DiannePostBattle
source: You do have guts! I like that!\nKeep it going!$
translation: 有胆量！我喜欢！\n加油吧！$

label: ViridianCity_Text_CanCarryMonsAnywhere
source: Those POKé BALLS at your waist!\nYou have POKéMON, don't you?\pIt's great that you can carry and\nuse POKéMON anytime, anywhere.$
translation: 你腰上挂着的这些精灵球！\n你有宝可梦，是吧？\p太棒了！无论何时何地，\n你都能携带并使用宝可梦。$

label: ViridianCity_Text_GymClosedWonderWhoLeaderIs
source: This POKéMON GYM is always closed.\pI wonder who the LEADER is?$
translation: 这个宝可梦道馆总是关闭着。\p我很想到底知道谁是馆主？$

label: ViridianCity_Text_ViridiansGymLeaderReturned
source: VIRIDIAN GYM's LEADER returned!$
translation: 常青道馆的馆主回来了！$

label: ViridianCity_Text_WantToKnowAboutCaterpillarMons
source: You want to know about the two\nkinds of caterpillar POKéMON?$
translation: 你想知道两种\n虫属性宝可梦的区别吗？$

label: ViridianCity_Text_OhOkayThen
source: Oh, okay then!$
translation: 噢，好吧！$

label: ViridianCity_Text_ExplainCaterpieWeedle
source: CATERPIE has no poison,\nbut WEEDLE does.\pWatch that your POKéMON aren't\nstabbed by WEEDLE's POISON STING.$
translation: 绿毛虫没有毒，\n但是独角虫有毒。\p当心你的宝可梦别被独角虫的\n毒针给刺中了。$

label: ViridianCity_Text_GrandpaHasntHadCoffeeYet
source: Oh, Grandpa!\nDon't be so mean!\pI'm so sorry.\nHe hasn't had his coffee yet.$
translation: 噢，爷爷！\n别这么任性啊！\p真的很抱歉。\n他还没喝咖啡。$

label: ViridianCity_Text_GoShoppingInPewterOccasionally
source: I go shopping in PEWTER CITY\noccasionally.\pI have to take the winding trail in\nVIRIDIAN FOREST when I go.$
translation: 我有时候会去深灰市买东西。\p我每次去的时候，都必须\n在常青森林中走一段蜿蜒的小路。$

label: ViridianCity_Text_ThisIsPrivateProperty
source: I absolutely forbid you from\ngoing through here!\pThis is private property!$
translation: 我绝不允许你通过这里！\p这里是私人领地！$

label: ViridianCity_Text_ShowYouHowToCatchMons
source:
Well, now, I've had my coffee, and
that's what I need to get going!\pHm?
What is that red box you have?\pAh, so you're working on your
POKéDEX.\pThen let me give you a word of
advice.\pWhenever you catch a POKéMON,
the POKéDEX automatically updates\lits data.\p…You don't know how to catch
a POKéMON?\pI suppose I had better show you
then!$
translation:
刚刚我喝过咖啡了。
喝咖啡可是我每天的必修课！\p嗯？
你手上拿着的那个红色盒子是什么？\p噢，你在完成你的宝可梦图鉴啊。\p那么让我给你一些建议吧。\p宝可梦图鉴会在
你收服到宝可梦时\l自动更新数据。\p......你不知道该怎么收服宝可梦？\p那我想我应该教你怎么做！$

label: ViridianCity_Text_ThatWasEducationalTakeThis
source: There! Now tell me, that was\neducational, was it not?\pAnd here, take this, too.$
translation: 怎么样？\n是不是受益匪浅啊？\p把这个也带上吧。$

label: ViridianCity_Text_WatchThatToLearnBasics
source: If there's something you don't\nunderstand, watch that.\pIt will teach you about the basics\nof being a POKéMON TRAINER.$
translation: 如果有什么你不懂的，\n一定要仔细看它。\p它将教会你如何成为\n一名合格的宝可梦训练家。$

label: ViridianCity_Text_WeakenMonsFirstToCatch
source:
Well, now, I've had my coffee, and
that's what I need to get going!\pBut I made it too strong.
It gave me a headache…\pIncidentally, are you filling your
POKéDEX?\pAt first, focus on weakening the
POKéMON before trying to catch it.$
translation:
我已经喝过咖啡了。
喝咖啡可是我每天的必修课！\p但是我泡得太浓了。
现在我头有点痛......\p顺便说一下，
你完成了你的宝可梦图鉴吗？\p首先，要使宝可梦变弱，
然后才能试图抓住它。$

label: ViridianCity_Text_HowsTeachyTVHelping
source:
Well, now, I've had my coffee, and
that's what I need to get going!\pBut I made it too strong.
It gave me a headache…\pIncidentally, is my old TEACHY TV
helping you?$
translation:
我刚刚喝过咖啡了。
喝咖啡可是我每天的必修课！\p但是我泡得太浓了，
喝得我头都痛了......\p顺便，我那台旧的教学电视机
帮到你了吗？$

label: ViridianCity_Text_MyGrandsonOnTheShow
source: Wahaha!\nIt's my grandson on the show!\pSince he's the one doing the\nteaching, you're bound to learn.$
translation: 哇哈哈！\n电视上的是我孙子！\p既然是他在教的话\n你就得好好学。$

label: ViridianCity_Text_TooBusyForTeachyTV
source: Hm… You're too busy to not even\nhave the time for TEACHY TV…\pTime is money, and neither should\nbe ill spent…$
translation: 嗯......你忙得甚至抽不出\n时间来看教学电视机了......\p时间就是金钱，这两者\n都不应当被虚耗......$

label: ViridianCity_Text_CitySign
source: VIRIDIAN CITY \nThe Eternally Green Paradise$
translation: 常青市\n永远的绿色天堂$

label: ViridianCity_Text_CatchMonsForEasierBattles
source: TRAINER TIPS\pCatch POKéMON and expand your\ncollection.\pThe more you have, the easier it\nis to battle.$
translation: 训练家贴士\p收服宝可梦\n增加你的收集数。\p你拥有得越多，\n战斗就越轻松。$

label: ViridianCity_Text_MovesLimitedByPP
source: TRAINER TIPS\pThe battle moves of POKéMON are\nlimited by their POWER POINTS, PP.\pTo replenish PP, rest your tired\nPOKéMON at a POKéMON CENTER.$
translation: 训练家贴士\p宝可梦的技能受到它们的\n技能点 也就是PP值的限制。\p想要回复PP的话将你疲惫的\n宝可梦放到宝可梦中心休息吧。$

label: ViridianCity_Text_GymSign
source: VIRIDIAN CITY POKéMON GYM$
translation: 常青市宝可梦道馆$

label: ViridianCity_Text_GymDoorsAreLocked
source: VIRIDIAN GYM's doors are locked…$
translation: 常青道馆的门锁上了......$

label: ViridianCity_Gym_Text_GiovanniIntro
source:
Fwahahaha!
Welcome to my hideout!\pIt shall be so until I can restore
TEAM ROCKET to its former glory.\pBut, you have found me again.
So be it.\lThis time, I'm not holding back!\pOnce more, you shall face
GIOVANNI, the greatest TRAINER!{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_RG_ENCOUNTER_ROCKET}$
translation:
哇哈哈哈！
欢迎来到我的藏身之处！\p在我恢复火箭队往日的荣光前，
我只能这么做。\p但是，你又找到了我。
就这样吧。\l这一次，我不会再保留实力了！\p再一次，你将要面对坂木，
那个最强大的训练家！{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_RG_ENCOUNTER_ROCKET}$

label: ViridianCity_Gym_Text_GiovanniDefeat
source: Ha!\nThat was a truly intense fight.\lYou have won!\pAs proof, here is the EARTHBADGE!\n{PAUSE_MUSIC}{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_OBTAIN_BADGE}{PAUSE 0xFE}{PAUSE 0x56}{RESUME_MUSIC}$
translation: 哈！\n真是激烈的战斗。\l你赢了！\p作为证据，这是绿色徽章！\n{PAUSE_MUSIC}{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_OBTAIN_BADGE}{PAUSE 0xFE}{PAUSE 0x56}{RESUME_MUSIC}$

label: ViridianCity_Gym_Text_GiovanniPostBattle
source:
Having lost in this fashion, 
I can't face my followers.\lI have betrayed their trust.\pAs of today, TEAM ROCKET is
finished forever!\pAs for myself, I shall dedicate
my life to training again.\pLet us meet again someday!
Farewell!$
translation:
以这种方式落败，
我没脸面对我的追随者。\l我背叛了他们对我的忠诚。\p在今天，火箭队
永远地解散了。\p对我自己而言，我会倾其一生
去再次修炼。\p也许我们将来可能会再见吧！
永别了！$

label: ViridianCity_Gym_Text_ExplainEarthBadgeTakeThis
source:
The EARTHBADGE makes POKéMON of
any level obey without question.\pIt is evidence of your mastery as
a POKéMON TRAINER.\pWith it, you can challenge the
POKéMON LEAGUE.\pAlso, take this TM.\pConsider it a gift for your POKéMON
LEAGUE challenge.$
translation:
绿色徽章能使任何级别的宝可梦
无理由地服从于你。\p这是你作为一个
优秀的宝可梦训练家的证据。\p有了它，你就能挑战
宝可梦联盟了。\p也带上这个技能。\p把它作为你挑战宝可梦联盟
的礼物。$

label: ViridianCity_Gym_Text_ReceivedTM26FromGiovanni
source: {PLAYER} received TM26\nfrom GIOVANNI.$
translation: {PLAYER}从坂木那儿得到了TM26。$

label: ViridianCity_Gym_Text_ExplainTM26
source: TM26 contains EARTHQUAKE.\pIt is a powerful attack that causes\na massive tremor.\pI made it when I ran the GYM here,\nfar too long ago… $
translation: TM26是地震。\p它能引起大地的震动，\n是一种强有力的攻击。\p很久以前我还在这儿开道馆时，\n我制造了这个技能......$

label: ViridianCity_Gym_Text_YouDoNotHaveSpace
source: You do not have space for this!$
translation: 你的背包满了！$

label: ViridianCity_Gym_Text_YujiIntro
source: Heh!\nYou must be running out of steam\lby now!$
translation: 嘿！\n现在\l喷雾一定用完了！$

label: ViridianCity_Gym_Text_YujiDefeat
source: I ran out of gas!$
translation: 我用完了喷雾！$

label: ViridianCity_Gym_Text_YujiPostBattle
source: You'll need power to keep up with\nour GYM LEADER.$
translation: 要赶上我们的道馆馆主，\n你还需要更强大的力量。$

label: ViridianCity_Gym_Text_AtsushiIntro
source: Rrrroar!\nI'm working myself into a rage!$
translation: 嗷！\n我要暴走了！$

label: ViridianCity_Gym_Text_AtsushiDefeat
source: Wargh!$

label: ViridianCity_Gym_Text_AtsushiPostBattle
source: I'm still not worthy!$
translation: 真是不值！$

label: ViridianCity_Gym_Text_JasonIntro
source: POKéMON and I, we make wonderful\nmusic together!$
translation: 我和宝可梦，一起\n创造绝妙的音乐！$

label: ViridianCity_Gym_Text_JasonDefeat
source: You are in perfect harmony!$
translation: 你们相处得非常好！$

label: ViridianCity_Gym_Text_JasonPostBattle
source: Do you know the identity of our\nGYM LEADER?$
translation: 你知道我们道馆馆主的身份吗？$

label: ViridianCity_Gym_Text_KiyoIntro
source: Karate is the ultimate form of\nmartial arts!$
translation: 空手道是武术的究极形式！$

label: ViridianCity_Gym_Text_KiyoDefeat
source: Aiyah!$
translation: 啊哈！$

label: ViridianCity_Gym_Text_KiyoPostBattle
source: If my POKéMON were as good at\nkarate as I…$
translation: 如果我的宝可梦像我一样\n擅长空手道......$

label: ViridianCity_Gym_Text_WarrenIntro
source: The truly talented win with style.$
translation: 我的风格是靠真正的实力取胜。$

label: ViridianCity_Gym_Text_WarrenDefeat
source: I lost my grip!$
translation: 我失去控制了！$

label: ViridianCity_Gym_Text_WarrenPostBattle
source: The LEADER will scold me for\nlosing this way…$
translation: 馆主会因为我就这样输了\n而责骂我的......$

label: ViridianCity_Gym_Text_TakashiIntro
source: I'm the KARATE KING!\nYour fate rests with me!$
translation: 我是空手道之王！\n你的命运取决于我！$

label: ViridianCity_Gym_Text_TakashiDefeat
source: Ayah!$

label: ViridianCity_Gym_Text_TakashiPostBattle
source: The POKéMON LEAGUE?\nYou? Don't get cocky!$
translation: 宝可梦联盟？\n你？别太狂妄了！$

label: ViridianCity_Gym_Text_ColeIntro
source: Your POKéMON will cower at the\ncrack of my whip!$
translation: 你的宝可梦会在我\n最重的打击之下颤抖！$

label: ViridianCity_Gym_Text_ColeDefeat
source: Yowch!\nWhiplash!$
translation: 啊哒！\n啪！$

label: ViridianCity_Gym_Text_ColePostBattle
source: Wait!\nI was just careless!$
translation: 等着！\n我只是太不小心了！$

label: ViridianCity_Gym_Text_SamuelIntro
source: VIRIDIAN GYM was closed for a\nlong time.\pBut now, our LEADER is back!$
translation: 常青道馆关闭了很长时间。\p但是现在，我们的馆主回来了！$

label: ViridianCity_Gym_Text_SamuelDefeat
source: I was beaten?$
translation: 我输了！$

label: ViridianCity_Gym_Text_SamuelPostBattle
source: You can go on to the POKéMON\nLEAGUE only by defeating our GYM\lLEADER!$
translation: 只有打败了我们的道馆馆主，\n你才有资格去\l宝可梦联盟！$

label: ViridianCity_Gym_Text_GymGuyAdvice
source:
Yo!
Champ in the making!\pEven I don't know the VIRIDIAN
LEADER's identity.\pBut one thing's certain.
This will be the toughest of all\lthe GYM LEADERS.\pAlso, I heard that the TRAINERS
here like GROUND-type POKéMON.$
translation:
呦！
未来的冠军！\p实际上连我也不知道
常青馆主的身份。\p但是有件事情是确定的。
他是所有道馆馆主之中\l最难对付的！\p而且，我听说这儿的训练家
都喜欢使用地面属性宝可梦。$

label: ViridianCity_Gym_Text_GymGuyPostVictory
source: Blow me away! GIOVANNI was the\nGYM LEADER of VIRIDIAN?$
translation: 难以置信！\n坂木是常青的道馆馆主？$

label: ViridianCity_Gym_Text_GymStatue
source: VIRIDIAN POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: ?\pWINNING TRAINERS:\n{RIVAL}$
translation: 常青宝可梦道馆\n馆主：？\p优胜训练家：\n{RIVAL}$

label: ViridianCity_Gym_Text_GymStatuePlayerWon
source: VIRIDIAN POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: GIOVANNI\pWINNING TRAINERS:\n{RIVAL}, {PLAYER}$
translation: 常青宝可梦道馆\n馆主：坂木\p优胜训练家：\n{RIVAL}，{PLAYER}$

label: ViridianCity_House_Text_NicknamingIsFun
source: Coming up with nicknames is fun,\nbut it's not so easy to do.\pClever names are nice, but simple\nnames are easier to remember.$
translation: 想一个昵称是很有乐趣的，\n但是这并不容易。\p一个聪明的名字很美好，\n但是简单的名字更好记。$

label: ViridianCity_House_Text_MyDaddyLovesMonsToo
source: My daddy loves POKéMON, too.$
translation: 我爸爸也喜欢宝可梦。$

label: ViridianCity_House_Text_Speary
source: SPEARY: Tetweet!$
translation: 小烈：特唔$

label: ViridianCity_House_Text_SpearowNameSpeary
source: SPEAROW\nName: SPEARY$
translation: 烈雀\n名字：小烈$

label: ViridianCity_Mart_Text_YouCameFromPallet
source: Hey!\nYou came from PALLET TOWN?$
translation: 嘿！\n你来自真新镇？$

label: ViridianCity_Mart_Text_TakeThisToProfOak
source: You know PROF. OAK, right?\pHis order came in.\nCan I get you to take it to him?$
translation: 你认识大木博士，对吗？\p他订的包裹到了。\n你能帮我捎给他吗？$

label: ViridianCity_Mart_Text_ReceivedOaksParcelFromClerk
source: {PLAYER} received OAK'S PARCEL\nfrom the POKéMON MART clerk.$
translation: {PLAYER}从宝可梦商店的店员处\n得到了大木的包裹。$

label: ViridianCity_Mart_Text_SayHiToOakForMe
source: Okay, thanks! Please say hi to\nPROF. OAK for me, too.$
translation: 谢谢！请替我向\n大木博士问好。$

label: ViridianCity_Mart_Text_ShopDoesGoodBusinessInAntidotes
source: This shop does good business in\nANTIDOTES, I've heard.$
translation: 我听说这家商店的\n解毒药卖的很好。$

label: ViridianCity_Mart_Text_GotToBuySomePotions
source: I've got to buy some POTIONS.\pYou never know when your POKéMON\nwill need quick healing.$
translation: 我要买一些伤药。\p你无法预见你的宝可梦\n什么时候需要快速恢复。$

label: ViridianCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_FeelFreeToUsePC
source: Please feel free to use that PC in\nthe corner.\pThe receptionist told me so.\nIt's so kind of her!$
translation: 接待员告诉我。\p可以随便使用角落里的电脑。\n她真是太和蔼了！$

label: ViridianCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_PokeCenterInEveryTown
source: There's a POKéMON CENTER in every\ntown ahead.\pThey charge no money, so don't\nbe shy about healing POKéMON.$
translation: 每一个镇都有宝可梦中心。\p并且都是免费的，所以\n不要不好意思去治疗你的宝可梦。$

label: ViridianCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_PokeCentersHealMons
source: POKéMON CENTERS heal your tired,\nhurt, or fainted POKéMON.\pThey make all POKéMON completely\nhealthy.$
translation: 宝可梦中心能治愈你的\n受伤的，或者濒死的宝可梦。\p他们能使你的宝可梦\n完全恢复健康。$

label: ViridianCity_School_Text_TryingToMemorizeNotes
source: Whew! I'm trying to memorize all my\nnotes.$
translation: 呜！我正尽力记住我所有的笔记。$

label: ViridianCity_School_Text_ReadBlackboardCarefully
source: Okay!\pBe sure to read what's on the\nblackboard carefully!$
translation: 好的！\p一定要仔细读黑板上\n写的东西！$

label: ViridianCity_School_Text_NotebookFirstPage
source:
Let's check out the notebook.\pFirst page…\pPOKé BALLS are used to catch
POKéMON.\pUp to six POKéMON can be carried
in your party.\pPeople who raise and battle
with POKéMON are called TRAINERS.$
translation: 我们看一下笔记本。\p第一页......\p精灵球是用来抓宝可梦的。\p你最多能带6只宝可梦。\p培养和使用宝可梦战斗的人\n被称为训练家。$

label: ViridianCity_School_Text_NotebookSecondPage
source: Second page…\pA healthy POKéMON may be hard to\ncatch, so weaken it first.\pPoison, burn, or cause another\nstatus problem to weaken it.$
translation: 第二页......\p一只健康的宝可梦很难被收服，\n所以首先要把它变弱。\p用毒，烧伤，或者用其他能造成\n异常状态的技能来削弱它。$

label: ViridianCity_School_Text_NotebookThirdPage
source:
Third page…\pPOKéMON TRAINERS seek others to
engage in POKéMON battles.\pTo TRAINERS, the taste of victory
is sweet, indeed.\pBattles are constantly waged at
POKéMON GYMS everywhere.$
translation: 第三页......\p宝可梦训练家喜欢和\n别人进行宝可梦战斗。\p对于训练家很美好的。\p战斗在宝可梦道馆，\n是每天都会发生的事情。$

label: ViridianCity_School_Text_NotebookFourthPage
source:
Fourth page…\pThe ultimate goal for all POKéMON
TRAINERS is simple.\pIt is to defeat the top eight
POKéMON GYM LEADERS.\pDo so to earn the right to face…\pThe ELITE FOUR of the POKéMON
LEAGUE!$
translation: 第四页......\p所有的宝可梦训练家\n最终的目标很简单。\p就是战胜8位宝可梦道馆馆主。\p然后就有资格去面对......\p宝可梦联盟的四天王！$

label: ViridianCity_School_Text_TurnThePage
source: Turn the page?$
translation: 翻页吗？$

label: ViridianCity_School_Text_HeyDontLookAtMyNotes
source: GIRL: Hey!\nDon't look at my notes!$
translation: 女生：喂！\n不要看我的笔记！$

label: ViridianCity_School_Text_BlackboardListsStatusProblems
source: The blackboard lists POKéMON\nSTATUS problems during battles.$
translation: 黑板上列出了在战斗中\n宝可梦状态的问题。$

label: ViridianCity_School_Text_ReadWhichTopic
source: Which topic do you want to read?$
translation: 你想读哪个？$

label: ViridianCity_School_Text_ExplainSleep
source:
A POKéMON can't attack if it's
asleep.\pPOKéMON will stay asleep even
after battles.\pUse AWAKENING to awaken one
from sleep.$
translation: 如果宝可梦睡着了，\n那么它就无法攻击了。\p甚至战斗结束以后\n也不会醒。\p用解眠药可以叫醒它。$

label: ViridianCity_School_Text_ExplainBurn
source: A burn reduces ATTACK power.\nIt also causes ongoing HP loss.\pA burn remains after a battle.\nUse BURN HEAL to cure a burn.$
translation: 烧伤会减少攻击力。\n而且会引起HP的损失。\p在战斗结束后烧伤会一直持续。\n用灼伤药可以治烧伤。$

label: ViridianCity_School_Text_ExplainPoison
source: When poisoned, a POKéMON's health\nsteadily drops.\pPoison lingers after battles.\nUse an ANTIDOTE to cure poison!$
translation: 宝可梦中毒以后，\n每回合都会损失HP。\p而且战斗结束也不会消失。\n可以用解毒药治疗中毒！$

label: ViridianCity_School_Text_ExplainFreeze
source:
A frozen POKéMON becomes
helplessly immobile.\pIt stays frozen even after the
battle ends.\pUse ICE HEAL to thaw out the
suffering POKéMON.$
translation: 被冰冻的宝可梦无法\n正常行动。\p而且战斗结束\n冰冻也会一直持续。\p用解冻药来治疗被冰冻的宝可梦。$

label: ViridianCity_School_Text_ExplainParalysis
source: Paralysis reduces SPEED and may\nprevent the POKéMON from moving.\pParalysis remains after battles.\nUse PARLYZ HEAL for treatment.$
translation: 麻痹会减少宝可梦的速度，\n而且可能使宝可梦无法行动。\p麻痹状态在战斗结束后会一直保持。\n要用解麻药来治疗。$

label: ViridianForest_Text_FriendsItchingToBattle
source: I came here with some friends to\ncatch us some BUG POKéMON!\pThey're all itching to get into\nsome POKéMON battles!$
translation: 我和朋友们来这里\n收服虫属性的宝可梦。\p他们都渴望用\n自己的宝可梦去战斗！$

label: ViridianForest_Text_RickIntro
source: Hey! You have POKéMON!\nCome on!\lLet's battle 'em!$
translation: 嘿！你有宝可梦啊！\l来吧！\l我们对战！$

label: ViridianForest_Text_RickDefeat
source: No!\nCATERPIE can't hack it!$
translation: 不！\n绿毛虫根本打不过它！$

label: ViridianForest_Text_RickPostBattle
source: Ssh! You'll scare the bugs away.\nAnother time, okay?$
translation: 嘘！你这样会把虫子吓跑的。\n下次再来打一场，怎么样？$

label: ViridianForest_Text_DougIntro
source: Yo!\nYou can't jam out if you're a\lPOKéMON TRAINER!$
translation: 嗨！\n如果你是一个宝可梦训练家，\l就不能大意！$

label: ViridianForest_Text_DougDefeat
source: Huh?\nI ran out of POKéMON!$
translation: 啥？\n我的宝可梦全倒下了！$

label: ViridianForest_Text_DougPostBattle
source: That totally stinks! I'm going to\ncatch some stronger ones!$
translation: 太糟了！\n我要去抓些更强大的！$

label: ViridianForest_Text_SammyIntro
source: Hey, wait up!\nWhat's the hurry? Why the rush?$
translation: 嘿！等一下！\n怎么了？你跑这么快干嘛？$

label: ViridianForest_Text_SammyDefeat
source: I give!\nYou're good at this!$
translation: 我服了！\n你的确很强！$

label: ViridianForest_Text_SammyPostBattle
source: Sometimes, you can find stuff on\nthe ground.\pI'm looking for the stuff I\ndropped. Can you help me?$
translation: 有的时候，\n你能找到一些掉在地上的东西。\p我正在找我掉了的东西。\n你能帮我找找吗？$

label: ViridianForest_Text_AnthonyIntro
source: I might be little, but I won't like\nit if you go easy on me!$
translation: 我身材可能很矮小，\n但我可不希望你因此对我手下留情！$

label: ViridianForest_Text_AnthonyDefeat
source: Oh, boo.\nNothing went right.$
translation: 唉，真不好。\n完全没照我的计划来。$

label: ViridianForest_Text_AnthonyPostBattle
source: I lost some of my allowance…$
translation: 我弄丢了一些零用钱......$

label: ViridianForest_Text_CharlieIntro
source: Did you know that POKéMON evolve?$
translation: 宝可梦的进化你知道多少？$

label: ViridianForest_Text_CharlieDefeat
source: Oh!\nI lost!$
translation: 噢！\n我输了！$

label: ViridianForest_Text_CharliePostBattle
source: BUG POKéMON evolve quickly.\nThey're a lot of fun!$
translation: 虫属性宝可梦进化得很快。\n和它们在一起乐趣多多！$

label: ViridianForest_Text_RanOutOfPokeBalls
source: I was throwing POKé BALLS to\ncatch POKéMON, and I ran out.\pThat's why you can never have too\nmany POKé BALLS.$
translation: 为了收服宝可梦\n我把精灵球都用光了。\p所以你需要常备\n一些精灵球在身边。$

label: ViridianForest_Text_AvoidGrassyAreasWhenWeak
source: TRAINER TIPS\pIf your POKéMON are weak and you\nwant to avoid battles, stay away\lfrom grassy areas!$
translation: 训练家贴士\p如果你的宝可梦很虚弱，\n而且你不想进行无谓的战斗的话，\l那么就避开草地吧！$

label: ViridianForest_Text_UseAntidoteForPoison
source: For poison, use ANTIDOTE!\nGet it at POKéMON MARTS!$
translation: 如果中毒了，就用解毒药！\n你可以在宝可梦商店里买到！$

label: ViridianForest_Text_ContactOakViaPCToRatePokedex
source: TRAINER TIPS\pContact PROF. OAK via a PC to\nget your POKéDEX evaluated!$
translation: 训练家贴士\p通过电脑联系大木博士，\n让他给你的宝可梦图鉴做个评价！$

label: ViridianForest_Text_CantCatchOwnedMons
source: TRAINER TIPS\pYou can't catch a POKéMON that\nbelongs to someone else.\pThrow POKé BALLS only at wild\nPOKéMON to catch them!$
translation: 训练家贴士\p你不可以收服\n别人的宝可梦。\p只有对野生的宝可梦\n才能用精灵球收服！$

label: ViridianForest_Text_WeakenMonsBeforeCapture
source: TRAINER TIPS\pWeaken POKéMON before attempting\ncapture!\pWhen healthy, they may escape!$
translation: 训练家贴士\p在收服宝可梦之前\n先削弱它们的体力！\p它们精力充沛时可能会逃跑！$

label: ViridianForest_Text_LeavingViridianForest
source: LEAVING VIRIDIAN FOREST\nPEWTER CITY AHEAD$
translation: 走出常青森林后\n深灰市就在前面$

label: gText_AbnormalWeatherEnded_Rain
source: The massive downpour appears to\nhave stopped…$
translation: 倾盆大雨似乎\n停了......$

label: gText_AbnormalWeatherEnded_Sun
source: The intense sunshine appears to\nhave subsided…$
translation: 强烈的阳光似乎\n平静了......$

label: gText_ApprenticeChallenge0
source: Um, I'm {STR_VAR_1}'s no. {STR_VAR_2} apprentice.\nSnivel… This tension is getting to me…$
translation: 嗯，我是{STR_VAR_1}的第{STR_VAR_2}号徒弟。\n抽泣......\l这种紧张感快压垮我了......$

label: gText_ApprenticeChallenge1
source: I'm {STR_VAR_1}'s no. {STR_VAR_2} apprentice!\nHere we come!$
translation: 我是{STR_VAR_1}的第{STR_VAR_2}号徒弟！\n我们来了！$

label: gText_ApprenticeChallenge2
source: I'm the no. {STR_VAR_2} apprentice of {STR_VAR_1}!\nAccept my challenge!$
translation: 我是{STR_VAR_1}的第{STR_VAR_2}号徒弟！\n接受我的挑战吧！$

label: gText_ApprenticeChallenge3
source: Um… I'm {STR_VAR_1}'s no. {STR_VAR_2} apprentice…\nDo you think someone like me can win?$
translation: 嗯......我是{STR_VAR_1}的第{STR_VAR_2}号徒弟......\n你觉得像我这样的人能赢吗？$

label: gText_ApprenticeChallenge4
source: I'm {STR_VAR_1}'s no. {STR_VAR_2} apprentice!\nI'll let you challenge me!$
translation: 我是{STR_VAR_1}的第{STR_VAR_2}号徒弟！\n我就让你挑战我吧！$

label: gText_ApprenticeChallenge5
source: I'm horribly busy, but I also happen\nto be {STR_VAR_1}'s no. {STR_VAR_2} apprentice.$
translation: 我忙得要命，但我碰巧也是\n{STR_VAR_1}的第{STR_VAR_2}号徒弟。$

label: gText_ApprenticeChallenge6
source: I'm {STR_VAR_1}'s no. {STR_VAR_2} apprentice.\nGlad to meet you!$
translation: 我是{STR_VAR_1}的第{STR_VAR_2}号徒弟。\n很高兴见到你！$

label: gText_ApprenticeChallenge7
source: I serve as {STR_VAR_1}'s no. {STR_VAR_2} apprentice.\nMay I begin?$
translation: 我担任{STR_VAR_1}的第{STR_VAR_2}号徒弟。\n我可以开始了吗？$

label: gText_ApprenticeChallenge8
source: Eek! I'm {STR_VAR_1}'s no. {STR_VAR_2} apprentice!\nI'll do my best!$
translation: 呀！我是{STR_VAR_1}的第{STR_VAR_2}号徒弟！\n我会尽力的！$

label: gText_ApprenticeChallenge9
source: Yeehaw! I'm {STR_VAR_1}'s no. {STR_VAR_2} apprentice!\nPut 'em up!$
translation: 哟吼！我是{STR_VAR_1}的第{STR_VAR_2}号徒弟！\n放马过来吧！$

label: gText_ApprenticeChallenge10
source: I'm {STR_VAR_1}'s 1,000th apprentice!\nActually, I'm no. {STR_VAR_2}! Here goes!$
translation: 我是{STR_VAR_1}的第1000个徒弟！\n其实是第{STR_VAR_2}号啦！我上了！$

label: gText_ApprenticeChallenge11
source: Yeah, I'm {STR_VAR_1}'s no. {STR_VAR_2} apprentice!\nLet's get rockin' and a-rollin'!$
translation: 没错，我是{STR_VAR_1}的第{STR_VAR_2}号徒弟！\n让我们摇滚起来吧！$

label: gText_ApprenticeChallenge12
source: Yippee-yahoo! I'm what you call\n{STR_VAR_1}'s no. {STR_VAR_2} apprentice!$
translation: 哟吼哟吼！我就是人们所说的\n{STR_VAR_1}的第{STR_VAR_2}号徒弟！$

label: gText_ApprenticeChallenge13
source: Cough! I'm {STR_VAR_1}'s no. {STR_VAR_2} apprentice.\nGood to meet you! Cough!$
translation: 咳！我是{STR_VAR_1}的第{STR_VAR_2}号徒弟。\n很高兴见到你！咳咳！$

label: gText_ApprenticeChallenge14
source: This is nerve-racking…\nI'm the no. {STR_VAR_2} apprentice of {STR_VAR_1}.$
translation: 这太紧张了......\n我是{STR_VAR_1}的第{STR_VAR_2}号徒弟。$

label: gText_ApprenticeChallenge15
source: I am {STR_VAR_1}'s no. {STR_VAR_2} apprentice,\nand that's no lie.$
translation: 我是{STR_VAR_1}的第{STR_VAR_2}号徒弟，\n这可不是骗人的。$

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach0
source:
Are you… {PLAYER}?
Oh! Sniff…sob…\pOh! S-sorry…
I'm so nervous, I can't help crying…\pI'm {STR_VAR_1}, and I really look up
to you, {PLAYER}.\pI… I had this dream of one day meeting
you and asking you about POKéMON.\pPlease, please, {PLAYER}!
Please teach me about POKéMON!$
translation:
你是......{PLAYER}吗？
哦！抽泣......呜咽......\p哦！对--对不起......
我太紧张了，忍不住哭了......\p我是{STR_VAR_1}，我真的
非常崇拜你，{PLAYER}。\p我......我一直梦想着有一天能见到你
并向你请教关于宝可梦的事。\p求求你，求求你了，{PLAYER}！
请务必教我关于宝可梦的知识！$

label: gText_ApprenticeRejectTeaching0
source: Oh… B-but…\nSnivel… Waaaaaaah!\pPlease!\nI'm begging you, please!$
translation: 哦......可--可是......\n抽泣......哇啊啊啊！\p求你了！\n我求求你了，拜托！$

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode0
source:
Oh, really? You will?
Awesome! Wicked! Awoooh!\pOh… I'm sorry…
I'm so happy, I'm crying…\pUm… Then please tell me!
It's about the BATTLE TOWER.\pWhich would be better for me: Level 50
or the Open Level?$
translation:
哦，真的吗？你答应了？
太棒了！太厉害了！嗷呜！\p哦......对不起......
我太高兴了，又哭了......\p嗯......那么请告诉我！
是关于对战塔的事。\p对我来说，Lv. 50级
还是自由等级哪个更好？$

label: gText_ApprenticeLevelModeThanks0
source:
{STR_VAR_1}?
Waaaaah!\pOh! I'm so sorry!
You've made me happy by choosing\lthe level for me, and it's made me cry…\pSnivel…
Thank you so much!\lPlease talk with me again!$
translation:
{STR_VAR_1}？
哇啊啊啊！\p哦！真对不起！
你替我选择了级别让我很高兴，\l这又让我哭了......\p抽泣......
太感谢你了！\l请再和我聊聊！$

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach1
source:
Wowee! You're {PLAYER}, aren't you?
You're awesomely strong, aren't you?\pI'm {STR_VAR_1}!
I just became a TRAINER!\pPlease, {PLAYER}!
Can you be my teacher and tell me\llots about being a TRAINER?$
translation:
哇哦！你是{PLAYER}，对吧？
你超强的，对吧？\p我是{STR_VAR_1}！
我刚成为训练家！\p求你了，{PLAYER}！
你能当我的老师，告诉我很多\l关于成为训练家的事吗？$

label: gText_ApprenticeRejectTeaching1
source: Aww, why?\nOh, please? Pretty please?\lPlease be my teacher, please!$
translation: 啊，为什么啊？\n哦，拜托？求求你了？\l请当我的老师吧，拜托！$

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode1
source: Yay! Great!\pThe first thing I wanted to ask you is\nabout the BATTLE TOWER!\pThe Level 50 and Open Level Rooms…\nWhich would be perfect for me?$
translation: 耶！太好了！\p我想问你的第一件事是\n关于对战塔的！\pLv. 50级和自由等级的房间......\n哪个最适合我？$

label: gText_ApprenticeLevelModeThanks1
source: {STR_VAR_1}, huh? That's true!\nI'll do my best there!\pIf we meet here again, please teach\nme something else, teacher!$
translation: {STR_VAR_1}，是吧？没错！\n我会在那里努力的！\p如果我们在这里再见，请再教我\n点别的，老师！$

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach2
source:
Um… Are you {PLAYER}?
My name is {STR_VAR_1}.\pI want to become a POKéMON TRAINER,
but I don't know what to do…\pSo I thought maybe I could ask you for
advice because you're so famous.\p{PLAYER}, could you give me advice?$
translation:
嗯......你是{PLAYER}吗？
我的名字是{STR_VAR_1}。\p我想成为一名宝可梦训练家，
但我不知道该怎么办......\p所以我想也许可以请教你，
因为你很有名。\p{PLAYER}，
你能给我一些建议吗？$

label: gText_ApprenticeRejectTeaching2
source: Oh, but…\pI sincerely want to become a POKéMON\nTRAINER!\pPlease, can you answer my questions?$
translation: 哦，但是......\p我是真心想成为一名宝可梦\n训练家的！\p拜托，你能回答我的问题吗？$

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode2
source:
Thank you!
Here's my first question right away!\pThe BATTLE TOWER has two levels,
Level 50 and Open Level, right?\pWhich level do you think is more
suitable for me?$
translation:
谢谢！
我马上问第一个问题！\p对战塔有2个级别，
Lv. 50级和自由等级，对吧？\p你觉得哪个级别
更适合我？$

label: gText_ApprenticeLevelModeThanks2
source: Oh, the {STR_VAR_1} challenge?\nUnderstood!\pIf I have another question, I'll come\nback here for your advice!$
translation: 哦，挑战{STR_VAR_1}？\n明白了！\p如果我有其他问题，我会\n回来寻求你的建议！$

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach3
source:
Oh? Huh? You're…
No, that can't be true.\pThere isn't any way that someone
like me could meet {PLAYER}.\p…You really are {PLAYER}?
I can't believe I'm talking to you!\pWhen something this good happens,
only terrible things will happen to me\lnow, I just know it…\p…I'm sorry…
I'm… {STR_VAR_1}…\pThere isn't anything special about
me that I can be proud of…\pI shouldn't even say anything about
myself because you'll forget…\pI had this dream that if I ever met
you, {PLAYER}, that maybe I could ask\lyou for advice as a TRAINER.\pBut I don't think you would agree
to that.\p…Or will you be so kind as to give
me advice?$
translation:
哦？啊？你是......
不，那不可能是真的。\p像我这样的人不可能
遇到{PLAYER}。\p......你真的是{PLAYER}？
真不敢相信我正在和你说话！\p当这么好的事情发生时，
我知道现在只会发生可怕的事情\l在我身上......\p......对不起......
我是......{STR_VAR_1}......\p我没什么特别之处可以
引以为豪......\p我甚至不应该说任何关于
自己的事，因为你一定会忘记......\p我曾梦想着如果我能遇到
你，{PLAYER}，也许我就能\l以训练家的身份向你寻求建议。\p但我觉得你不会同意
那样的事。\p......或者你会好心地
给我建议吗？$

label: gText_ApprenticeRejectTeaching3
source:
I knew it…\pIt had to happen because I'm such
a really boring nobody…\pBut I thought just maybe…
You won't reconsider, will you?\pBut I can't give up just like that.
I'll ask you while I'm still lucky!\pPlease, will you be so kind as to give
me advice?$
translation:
我就知道会这样......\p这一定是因为我真是个
无聊的小人物......\p但我以为也许还有机会......
你不会重新考虑一下，对吧？\p但我不能就这样放弃。
趁着我运气还在，我要问你！\p拜托，你能好心地给我
建议吗？$

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode3
source:
Really? I can't believe it!
I can't believe you'll advise me!\lI… I'm so happy…\pWhat I want to ask you is really
trivial, but I can't decide…\pAt the BATTLE TOWER, they let you
choose Level 50 or Open Level.\pWhich course do you think even I may
have a chance at?$
translation:
真的吗？我不敢相信！
真不敢相信你会给我建议！\l我......我太高兴了......\p我想问你的其实
很琐碎，但我无法决定......\p在对战塔，他们让你选择
Lv. 50级或自由等级。\p你觉得哪个级别
哪怕像我这样的人也可能有机会？$

label: gText_ApprenticeLevelModeThanks3
source:
{STR_VAR_1}? Okay!
But do you really think someone like\lme would have a chance?\pI'll do my best, even though I don't
think it will work.\pThank you very much for spending
time with someone like me.$
translation:
{STR_VAR_1}？好的！
但你真的觉得像我这样的人\l会有机会吗？\p我会尽力的，尽管我不
认为会成功。\p非常感谢你花时间
陪伴像我这样的人。$

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach4
source:
Oh! You're {PLAYER}{KUN}, aren't you?\pI've heard that you're tough at
POKéMON!\pI'm {STR_VAR_1}!
I'll be your friend!\pDid you know?\pYou can't win at the BATTLE FRONTIER
if all you know is what they teach at\lthe TRAINER'S SCHOOL.\pI'm willing to listen to your advice.
You'll agree, of course?$
translation:
哦！你是{PLAYER}{KUN}，对吧？\p我听说你在宝可梦方面很强！\p我是{STR_VAR_1}！
我会成为你的朋友！\p你知道吗？\p如果你只知道训练家学校教的东西，
你就无法在对战开拓区获胜。\p我愿意听取你的建议。
你当然会同意吧？$

label: gText_ApprenticeRejectTeaching4
source: Huh? Why are you refusing me?\nIt's me who's asking you!\lYou have to reconsider!$
translation: 嗯？你为什么要拒绝我？\n是我在问你啊！\l你必须重新考虑！$

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode4
source:
Okay, so there is this something.
I want you to decide it for me.\pYou know that the BATTLE TOWER has
Level 50 and Open Level Rooms?\pWhich do you think would be good
for me, {PLAYER}{KUN}?$
translation:
好的，所以有件事。
我想让你替我决定。\p你知道对战塔有
Lv. 50级和自由等级的房间吧？\p你觉得哪个会适合我，
{PLAYER}{KUN}？$

label: gText_ApprenticeLevelModeThanks4
source:
Okay, {STR_VAR_1} is suitable for me?
Thank you!\pKnowing that you made the decision,
{PLAYER}{KUN}, I won't be so upset if\lI lose.\pOkay, I'll look to you for advice again.
Bye!$
translation:
好的，{STR_VAR_1}适合我？
谢谢你！\p知道是你做的决定，
{PLAYER}{KUN}，就算我输了\l也不会那么难过。\p好的，我会再来向你寻求建议。
再见！$

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach5
source:
Oh, hi, there! {PLAYER}{KUN}!
I know you because you're famous!\lCall me {STR_VAR_1}! Glad to meet you!\pI'm a TRIATHLETE, so I keep myself
fit even while I raise POKéMON.\pI'm also involved with other things
like work, napping, ballroom dancing…\pBeing this busy, it's not so easy for
me to become a decent TRAINER.\pSo, I have a proposition!\pThere must be a reason why we met.
So, {PLAYER}{KUN}, how about sharing your\lwisdom with me every so often?$
translation:
哦，嗨，你好！{PLAYER}{KUN}！
我认识你，因为你很有名！\l叫我{STR_VAR_1}！很高兴见到你！\p我是个铁人三项选手，所以我即使
在培育宝可梦时也保持健康。\p我还参与其他事情，
比如工作、打盹、交谊舞......\p这么忙，对我来说
要成为一个像样的训练家\l可不容易。\p所以，我有个提议！\p我们相遇一定有原因。
所以，{PLAYER}{KUN}，不如你偶尔\l和我分享你的智慧？$

label: gText_ApprenticeRejectTeaching5
source: Oh, but, please?\nA guy like me needs someone like\lyou, {PLAYER}{KUN}!\pHonestly, I need your advice!$
translation: 哦，但是，拜托？\n像我这样的人需要你这样的\l人，{PLAYER}{KUN}！\p老实说，我需要你的建议！$

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode5
source:
Thank you! That's more like it!
So, let's start with an easy one!\pYou know about the BATTLE TOWER's
two courses, right?\lYou know, Level 50 and Open Level.\pMe being a busy guy, which one should
I gear up for?$
translation:
谢谢你！这才对嘛！
那么，我们从一个简单的问题开始！\p你知道对战塔的
2个级别，对吧？\l就是Lv. 50级和自由等级。\p像我这样的大忙人，
应该为哪个做准备？$

label: gText_ApprenticeLevelModeThanks5
source: {STR_VAR_1}, huh? Okay, gotcha.\nI'll find time somehow and give it a go!\p…Whoops, I'd better go to work!\nThanks! See you around!$
translation: {STR_VAR_1}，是吧？好的，明白了。\n我会想办法找时间试试看的！\p......哎呀，我得去上班了！\n谢谢！回头见！$

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach6
source:
No way! Uh-uh!
Are you maybe the real {PLAYER}?\pA-hah! Awesome! I'm {STR_VAR_1},
so pleased to meet you!\p{PLAYER}, you're very strong,
aren't you?\pEveryone's talking about you!\pOh! I just had this great idea!
I'll get advice off you, {PLAYER}!\lI'm sure it will make me tougher!\pIsn't it a great idea?
Please, I want your advice!$
translation:
不可能！呃--呃！
你该不会是真正的{PLAYER}吧？\p啊哈！太棒了！我是{STR_VAR_1}，
很高兴见到你！\p{PLAYER}，你很强，
对吧？\p大家都在谈论你！\p哦！我刚刚有个超棒的主意！
我要向你请教，{PLAYER}！\l我相信这能让我变强！\p这不是个好主意吗？
拜托，我想要你的建议！$

label: gText_ApprenticeRejectTeaching6
source: Ahahaha, you can pretend to be mean,\nbut you can't fool me!\lYou really mean okay, don't you?$
translation: 啊哈哈哈，你可以假装很凶，\n但你骗不了我！\l你其实是答应的意思，对吧？$

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode6
source:
Yay! I knew you'd have a big heart,
{PLAYER}!\pWhat should I ask you first?
…Oh, I thought of something!\pDrum roll, please!
The question I have is…\pIf I were to take a BATTLE TOWER
challenge, which way should I go?\pLevel 50 or Open Level?
Which suits me more?$
translation:
耶！我就知道你心胸宽广，
{PLAYER}！\p我该先问你什么呢？
......哦，我想到了！\p请鼓掌！
我的问题是......\p如果我要挑战对战塔，
我该走哪条路？\pLv. 50级还是自由等级？
哪个更适合我？$

label: gText_ApprenticeLevelModeThanks6
source:
Oh-oh-oh!
{STR_VAR_1}, you say!\lThank you for a totally cool reply!\pI guess that's about all I wanted
to ask you today.\pLet's meet here again, okay?
Thanks!$
translation: 哦--哦--哦！\n{STR_VAR_1}，你说！\l谢谢你超级酷的回答！\p我想今天要问你的就这些了。\p让我们在这里再见，好吗？\n谢谢！$

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach7
source:
I beg your pardon, but…
Are you {PLAYER}?\pI'm {STR_VAR_1}, and I am delighted to
make your acquaintance.\pI have long been an admirer
of yours…\p… … … … … …\pUm… I hope you don't find this
request too much of a burden, but…\pMay I become your apprentice,
{PLAYER}?$
translation:
打扰一下，请问......
你是{PLAYER}吗？\p我是{STR_VAR_1}，很高兴
认识你。\p我仰慕你很久了......\p...... ... ... ... ... ...\p嗯......希望你觉得这个请求
不会太麻烦，但是......\p我可以成为你的徒弟吗，
{PLAYER}？$

label: gText_ApprenticeRejectTeaching7
source:
Oh…!\p… … … … … …
… … … … … …\p…I must have fainted from shock.
I'm sorry, I must have misheard you.\pPlease! Please say that you will
accept me as your apprentice!$

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode7
source:
Oh… I'm delighted!\pI don't wish to waste your time,
so please advise me on this.\pI plan to take a BATTLE TOWER
challenge soon.\pHowever, there are two levels…\pWhich would be most suitable for me?
Level 50 or Open Level?$
translation:
哦......我很高兴！\p我不想浪费你的时间，
所以请在这件事上给我建议。\p我计划不久后参加对战塔
挑战。\p但是，有2个级别......\p哪个最适合我？
Lv. 50级还是自由等级？$

label: gText_ApprenticeRejectTeaching8
source: Waaaah!\n{PLAYER} turned me down…\lIt… It's an invaluable experience!\p{PLAYER}, please! I want to hear\nan affirmative answer this time!\pI beg you for your guidance!$
translation: 哇啊啊！\n{PLAYER}拒绝了我......\l这......这是宝贵的经验！\p{PLAYER}，拜托！这次我想听到\n肯定的回答！\p我恳求你的指导！$

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode8
source:
Hieeeeh! {PLAYER} said yes!
{PLAYER} said yes!\pI won't be able to sleep tonight…
Thank you ever so much!\pThen, here's my question!\pAt the BATTLE TOWER, what is right
for me, Level 50 or Open Level?$
translation:
咿耶！{PLAYER}说好！
