{PLAYER}说好！\p我今晚会睡不着觉了......
太感谢你了！\p那么，这是我的问题！\p在对战塔，什么适合我，
Lv. 50级还是自由等级？$

label: gText_ApprenticeLevelModeThanks8
source: {STR_VAR_1}! Perfectly understood!\nI understand perfectly!\lI'm deliriously delighted!\pI hope you'll be willing to teach me\nsome more another time.$
translation: {STR_VAR_1}！完全明白了！\n我完全明白！\l我高兴得要发狂了！\p希望下次你愿意\n再教我一些东西。$

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach9
source:
Whoa! Could you be…
Might you be… {PLAYER}{KUN}?!\lThat strong and famous TRAINER?\lWell, hello, aren't I just the luckiest!\pHello, the name's {STR_VAR_1}!\pI've been on the lookout for
a POKéMON teacher.\pAnd with impeccably good timing,
along came you, {PLAYER}{KUN}!\pSo, there you have it, {PLAYER}{KUN}!
Let me apprentice under you!$
translation:
哇！你该不会是......
难道是......{PLAYER}{KUN}？！\l那个强大又著名的训练家？\l你好，我简直太幸运了！\p你好，我叫{STR_VAR_1}！\p我一直在寻找
一位宝可梦老师。\p而你来得正是时候，
{PLAYER}{KUN}！\p所以，就是这样，{PLAYER}{KUN}！
让我拜你为师吧！$

label: gText_ApprenticeRejectTeaching9
source: Gwaaaah!\nYou're quite cool and tough…\pDon't be that way, please.\nI'm asking you!$
translation: 呱啊啊啊！\n你真是又酷又硬派......\p别这样，拜托。\n我是在请求你！$

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode9
source:
Oh, yeah! That's a solid reply!
Excellent, I might add!\pSo how about a first piece of advice
on the BATTLE TOWER?\pIf I were to go, what would be better?
Level 50 or Open Level?$
translation:
哦，耶！这是坚定的回答！
太棒了，我得说！\p那么，对战塔的第一个建议
怎么样？\p如果我要去，哪个更好？
Lv. 50级还是自由等级？$

label: gText_ApprenticeLevelModeThanks9
source: Uh-huh, {STR_VAR_1} it is!\nOK, A-OK!\lI'll go show my mettle, like, jam!\pAll right, I'll look to you as my mentor!\nAdios!$
translation: 嗯哼，{STR_VAR_1}是吧！\n好，A--OK！\l我会去展示我的实力，就像，酷炫！\p好的，我会把你当作我的导师！\n再见！$

label: gText_ApprenticeRejectTeaching10
source:
If you're going to act cold like that,
I'll show you what I'll do!\pWaaah! Waaah! Waaah!
Hiccup!\pHahaha, that was my FAKE TEARS!\pCome on, will you please be
my POKéMON master?$
translation:
如果你要表现得这么冷淡，
我就让你看看我会做什么！\p哇！哇！哇！
嗝！\p哈哈哈，那是我装的眼泪！\p来吧，拜托你当
我的宝可梦师父好吗？$

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode10
source:
Yippee!
I'll buy you a boat for that!\pOf course I'm lying again!
But… Thank you, master!\pYou know how there's Level 50 and
Open Level at the BATTLE TOWER?\pI'm having trouble deciding which
level I should challenge…\pCan you decide for me, master?$
translation:
耶比！
我会给你买艘船！\p当然我又在撒谎！
但是......谢谢你，师父！\p你知道对战塔有Lv. 50级
和自由等级吧？\p我正纠结该挑战
哪个级别......\p师父你能替我决定吗？$

label: gText_ApprenticeRejectTeaching11
source: But!\nYou have to work with me!\pDon't be such a tease!\nBecome my mentor, please!$
translation: 但是！\n你必须配合我！\p别这么逗我了！\n请当我的导师吧！$

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode11
source:
That's it!
{PLAYER}, you've got the spirit!\pSo here's my first question
that begs your suggestion!\pIt's about the BATTLE TOWER,
and it hinges on my power!\pLevel 50 and Open Level there be,
which is the one that's good for me?$
translation:
就这样！
{PLAYER}，你有这个精神！\p所以这是我的第一个问题，
需要你的建议！\p是关于对战塔的，
这取决于我的实力！\p那里有Lv. 50级和自由等级，
哪个才是我该选的级别？$

label: gText_ApprenticeLevelModeThanks11
source: Okay, {STR_VAR_1} it is, you say!\nI'll go and take it on my way!\pIf it's advice I ever need,\n{PLAYER}, your word I'll always heed!$
translation: 好的，{STR_VAR_1}，你说！\n我会去的，就在路上！\p如果我需要建议，\n{PLAYER}，你的话我永远听从！$

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode12
source:
Lucky, yeah, woohoo!
Should I pop a question to you?\pSince we're near the BATTLE TOWER,
how about a question about its power?\pOf the choices you see,
which is the right one for me?$
translation:
幸运，耶，呜呼！
我该问你个问题吗？\p既然我们在对战塔附近，
不如问个关于它实力的问题？\p在你能看到的选择中，
哪个才是我该选的？$

label: gText_ApprenticeLevelModeThanks12
source: If {STR_VAR_1} is what you suggest,\nit must be the very best!\pWell, {PLAYER}, I have to roam free,\nbut don't you forget about me.\pSee you again, my smart friend!$
translation: 如果{STR_VAR_1}是你建议的，\n那它一定是最棒的！\p嗯，{PLAYER}，我必须自由漫游，\n但你别忘了我。\p再见了，我聪明的朋友！$

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode13
source: Thank you. Mighty good of you!\n…Cough! Cough!\pOogh, I have to toughen up quick…\pI'll be heading off to the BATTLE TOWER\nright away, but what would be better\lfor me? Level 50 or Open Level?$
translation: 谢谢你。你真是太好了！\n......咳！咳！\p呃，我得快点变强......\p我马上就去对战塔，\n但对我来说哪个更好？\lLv. 50级还是自由等级？$

label: gText_ApprenticeHoldNothing0
source: Oh, really? I shouldn't make\nmy {STR_VAR_1} hold anything?$
translation: 哦，真的吗？我不该让我的\n{STR_VAR_1}携带任何东西？$

label: gText_ApprenticeThanksNoHeldItem0
source: Oh, okay! I'm delighted it's settled!\nAwesome! Wicked! Awoooh!\pThank you so much!$
translation: 哦，好的！很高兴问题解决了！\n太棒了！太厉害了！嗷呜！\p非常感谢你！$

label: gText_ApprenticeThanksHeldItem0
source: Oh, I'm so glad…\nI think I have that {STR_VAR_1}, too.\pI'm delighted it's settled!\nAwesome! Wicked! Awoooh!\pThank you so much!$
translation: 哦，我太高兴了......\n我想我也有{STR_VAR_1}呢。\p很高兴问题解决了！\n太棒了！太厉害了！嗷呜！\p非常感谢你！$

label: gText_ApprenticeItemAlreadyRecommended0
source: Waaaah! Please don't be mean!\pThat item {STR_VAR_1} was already\nrecommended to me before, sob…\pOr do you mean I shouldn't make\nmy {STR_VAR_2} hold anything?$
translation: 哇哇哇！请不要这么刻薄！\p道具{STR_VAR_1}之前已经\n有人推荐过了，呜咽......\p或者你是说我不该让\n我的{STR_VAR_2}携带任何东西？$

label: gText_ApprenticeWhatHeldItem1
source:
Yay! It's {PLAYER}!
Great! I wanted to ask you something!\pDo you make your POKéMON hold items?
I want to make mine hold items, but…\pWhat item would be good for
{STR_VAR_1} to hold?\pWhat do you think?$
translation:
耶！是{PLAYER}！
太好了！我想问你点事！\p你会让宝可梦携带道具吗？
我也想让我宝可梦携带，但是......\p什么道具适合
{STR_VAR_1}携带呢？\p你觉得呢？$

label: gText_ApprenticeHoldNothing1
source: Huh? You mean my {STR_VAR_1} doesn't\nhave to hold anything?$
translation: 嗯？你是说我的{STR_VAR_1}不用\n携带任何东西？$

label: gText_ApprenticeThanksNoHeldItem1
source: Oh, I get it! I'll do that!\nThanks for teaching me!$
translation: 哦，明白了！我会照做的！\n谢谢你教我！$

label: gText_ApprenticeThanksHeldItem1
source: Oh, wow! One {STR_VAR_1}, huh?\nOkay, I'll do that!\pThanks for teaching me!$
translation: 哦，哇！{STR_VAR_1}，是吧？\n好的，我会用那个！\p谢谢你教我！$

label: gText_ApprenticeWhatHeldItem2
source: {PLAYER}, hello!\nIt's about my {STR_VAR_1}…\pI want to make it hold a good item.\nWhat would be good for it?$
translation: {PLAYER}，你好！\n是关于我的{STR_VAR_1}......\p我想让它携带个好道具。\n什么适合它呢？$

label: gText_ApprenticeHoldNothing2
source: Oh, then my {STR_VAR_1} doesn't have\nto hold anything?$
translation: 哦，那我的{STR_VAR_1}不需要\n携带任何东西？$

label: gText_ApprenticeThanksNoHeldItem2
source: Okay, I got it!\nSee you again!$
translation: 好的，明白了！\n下次见！$

label: gText_ApprenticeThanksHeldItem2
source: Oh, the item {STR_VAR_1}?\nUnderstood!\pI'll do my best to find one!\nSee you again!$
translation: 哦，道具{STR_VAR_1}？\n明白了！\p我会尽力找一个的！\n下次见！$

label: gText_ApprenticeItemAlreadyRecommended2
source:
Somebody taught me about
the {STR_VAR_1} already.\pI want my POKéMON to hold a different
kind of item.\pOr do you think {STR_VAR_2} doesn't
have to hold anything?$
translation:
有人已经教过我关于
{STR_VAR_1}的事了。\p我想要我的宝可梦携带
不同类型的道具。\p或者你觉得{STR_VAR_2}不需要
携带任何东西？$

label: gText_ApprenticeWhatHeldItem3
source:
Hello, {PLAYER}…
I'm sorry to disturb you, but I have\lsomething else I wanted to ask you.\pI don't think I'm good enough to win
matches on my own, so I'm thinking of\lmaking my {STR_VAR_1} hold an item.\pBut I don't know what would be good.\p{PLAYER}, please, could you decide
for me?$
translation:
你好，{PLAYER}......
很抱歉打扰你，但我还有件事想问。\p我觉得自己不够强，
无法独自赢比赛，\l所以想让我的{STR_VAR_1}携带道具。\p但不知道什么才好。\p{PLAYER}，拜托，
你能替我决定吗？$

label: gText_ApprenticeHoldNothing3
source: A POKéMON belonging to someone like me\nwould be better off without an item?$
translation: 像我这样的人的宝可梦\n不带道具更好？$

label: gText_ApprenticeThanksNoHeldItem3
source: I understand…\nYou're saying I shouldn't rely on items.\lI'll do my best not to!\pThank you very much!$
translation: 我明白了......\n你是说我不该依赖道具。\l我会尽力不依赖的！\p非常感谢你！$

label: gText_ApprenticeThanksHeldItem3
source: The item {STR_VAR_1}, okay.\nI'm not sure if I can get one…\lNo! I'll do my best to get it.\pThank you very much!$
translation: 道具{STR_VAR_1}，好的。\n我不确定能不能弄到一个......\l不！我会尽力搞到的。\p非常感谢你！$

label: gText_ApprenticeItemAlreadyRecommended3
source:
Oh, but…
I think I've heard about that before…\pIs it maybe because I haven't handled
the item {STR_VAR_1} very well?\pOr do you mean I shouldn't make
my {STR_VAR_2} hold anything?$
translation:
哦，但是......
我想我以前听说过......\p是不是因为我没用好
道具{STR_VAR_1}？\p或者你是说我不该让
我的{STR_VAR_2}携带任何东西？$

label: gText_ApprenticeWhatHeldItem4
source:
Oh, {PLAYER}{KUN}.
There's something I wanted to ask you.\pYou know how you decided which
POKéMON I should have for me?\pBut I never asked you what item
it should be holding.\pSince you already gave me advice,
how about seeing this to the end?\pWhat would be good? I want to make
my {STR_VAR_1} hold something.$
translation:
哦，{PLAYER}{KUN}。
有件事我想问你。\p你知道你之前决定了我
该用哪只宝可梦吧？\p但我没问你它该
携带什么道具。\p既然你已经给了我建议，
不如有始有终？\p什么比较好？我想让
我的{STR_VAR_1}带点东西。$

label: gText_ApprenticeHoldNothing4
source: Oh! So my {STR_VAR_1} should do\nthe best it can empty-handed?$
translation: 哦！所以我的{STR_VAR_1}应该\n空手上阵做到最好？$

label: gText_ApprenticeThanksNoHeldItem4
source: If you think that's best, I'll do that.\pKnowing that you made the decision,\n{PLAYER}{KUN}, I won't be so upset if\lI lose.\pOkay, I'll look to you for advice again.\nBye!$
translation: 如果你觉得这样最好，我会照做。\p知道是你做的决定，\n{PLAYER}{KUN}，就算我输了\l也不会太难过。\p好的，我会再来向你请教。\n再见！$

label: gText_ApprenticeThanksHeldItem4
source:
The item {STR_VAR_1}, huh?
Not bad. I'll use it!\pKnowing that you made the decision,
{PLAYER}{KUN}, I won't be so upset if\lI lose.\pOkay, I'll look to you for advice again.
Bye!$
translation:
道具{STR_VAR_1}，是吧？
不错。我会用的！\p知道是你做的决定，
{PLAYER}{KUN}，就算我输了\l也不会太难过。\p好的，我会再来向你请教。
再见！$

label: gText_ApprenticeItemAlreadyRecommended4
source: Huh? What are you saying?\nYou told me about the {STR_VAR_1}\lalready before.\pOr do you mean my {STR_VAR_2} should\ndo the best it can empty-handed?$
translation: 嗯？你在说什么？\n你之前已经告诉过\l{STR_VAR_1}的事了。\p或者你是说我的{STR_VAR_2}应该\n空手上阵做到最好？$

label: gText_ApprenticeHoldNothing5
source: Oh, so me being a busy guy, you say\nmy {STR_VAR_1} doesn't need anything?$
translation: 哦，所以像我这样的大忙人，\n你说我的{STR_VAR_1}不需要任何东西？$

label: gText_ApprenticeThanksNoHeldItem5
source: Okay, gotcha.\nI won't need any time for that.\pThanks today!\nSee you around!$
translation: 好的，知道了。\n我不需要为此花时间。\p今天谢谢了！\n回头见！$

label: gText_ApprenticeThanksHeldItem5
source: Okay, gotcha.\nI'll find time somehow and find\lthat {STR_VAR_1} you recommended.\pI'm glad I met a good mentor in you.\nThanks! See you around!$
translation: 好的，知道了。\n我会想办法找时间\l找到你推荐的{STR_VAR_1}。\p我很高兴遇到你这样的好导师。\n谢谢！回头见！$

label: gText_ApprenticeItemAlreadyRecommended5
source: Huh? I already know about\nthat {STR_VAR_1}.\pOh, right, I get it.\nSo me being a busy guy, you say\lmy {STR_VAR_2} doesn't need anything?$
translation: 嗯？我已经知道\n那个{STR_VAR_1}了。\p哦，对了，我懂了。\n所以像我这样的大忙人，\l你说我的{STR_VAR_2}不需要任何东西？$

label: gText_ApprenticeHoldNothing6
source: Is that right? My {STR_VAR_1} doesn't\nneed to hold an item, you're saying.$
translation: 是吗？你是说我的{STR_VAR_1}不需要\n携带道具？$

label: gText_ApprenticeThanksNoHeldItem6
source: Okay, that's what I'll do!\pI guess that's about all I wanted\nto ask you today.\pLet's meet here again, okay?\nThanks!$
translation: 好的，我会照做的！\p我想今天要问的就这些了。\p让我们在这里再见，好吗？\n谢谢！$

label: gText_ApprenticeThanksHeldItem6
source:
Uh-huh! One {STR_VAR_1}.
What a cool choice!\lI'll definitely try that!\pI guess that's about all I wanted
to ask you today.\pLet's meet here again, okay?
Thanks!$
translation: 嗯哼！{STR_VAR_1}。\n多酷的选择！\l我一定会试试的！\p我想今天要问的就这些了。\p让我们在这里再见，好吗？\n谢谢！$

label: gText_ApprenticeItemAlreadyRecommended6
source: Ahahah! That's silly!\nYou already told me about that\l{STR_VAR_1} before!\pAre you feeling okay, {PLAYER}?\pOh, wait! My {STR_VAR_2} doesn't\nneed to hold an item, you're saying.$
translation: 啊哈哈！真傻！\n你之前已经告诉过\l{STR_VAR_1}的事了！\p你还好吗，{PLAYER}？\p哦，等等！你是说我的{STR_VAR_2}\n不需要携带任何道具？$

label: gText_ApprenticeWhatHeldItem7
source:
Hello, {PLAYER}. I hope you've been
keeping well.\pMay I approach you for advice?\pIn a recent battle, my opponent
seemed to have given his POKéMON\lan item to hold.\pAs a result, I was defeated…\pI don't wish to be left behind.
I would like to make my {STR_VAR_1}\lhold an item, too.\pIt would please me if you could decide
what would be right for my POKéMON…$
translation:
你好，{PLAYER}。希望你一切安好。\p我可以请教你吗？\p最近一次对战中，对手似乎
让他的宝可梦携带了道具。\p结果，我被打败了......\p我不想落后。
我也想让我{STR_VAR_1}携带道具。\p如果你能决定
什么适合我的宝可梦就太好了......$

label: gText_ApprenticeHoldNothing7
source: In other words… My POKéMON has\nno need to hold an item?$
translation: 换句话说......我的宝可梦\n不需要携带道具？$

label: gText_ApprenticeItemAlreadyRecommended7
source: You've already told me about that,\nand I already have it.\pOr are you saying… My POKéMON has\nno need to hold an item?$
translation: 你已经告诉过我了，\n而且我已经有了。\p或者你是说......我的宝可梦\n不需要携带道具？$

label: gText_ApprenticeWhatHeldItem8
source:
Eek! {PLAYER}!
I… I'm overjoyed to see you again!\pOh-oh-oh! There's something I just
had to ask you, {PLAYER}!\pPlease decide what my {STR_VAR_1}
should be holding!$
translation:
呀！{PLAYER}！
我......又见到你我太高兴了！\p哦--哦--哦！有件事
我一定要问你，{PLAYER}！\p请决定我的{STR_VAR_1}
该携带什么！$

label: gText_ApprenticeHoldNothing8
source: Oh, wow! I didn't expect that answer!\nSo, a hold item isn't necessary?$
translation: 哦，哇！我没想到这个回答！\n所以，携带道具不是必须的？$

label: gText_ApprenticeThanksNoHeldItem8
source: Perfectly understood!\nI'll keep at this without an item!\pI hope you'll be willing to teach me\nsome more another time.$
translation: 完全明白了！\n我会继续不用道具努力的！\p希望下次你愿意\n再教我些东西。$

label: gText_ApprenticeItemAlreadyRecommended8
source: Oh? You recommended that\n{STR_VAR_1} before, too.\pOr is it the best thing to hold?\nOr do you mean that my {STR_VAR_2}\ldoesn't need anything to hold?$
translation: 哦？你之前也推荐过\n{STR_VAR_1}。\p或者这是最好的携带物？\n还是说我的{STR_VAR_2}不需要\l携带任何东西？$

label: gText_ApprenticeHoldNothing9
source: Oh? So, you're saying my {STR_VAR_1}\ncan win without holding any item?$
translation: 哦？所以你是说我的{STR_VAR_1}不携带\n道具也能赢？$

label: gText_ApprenticeThanksNoHeldItem9
source: Si, bueno!\nI'll give it my best shot, like, slam!\pAll right, thanks, as always!\nAdios!$
translation: 好的，行！\n我会尽力而为，就像，猛击！\p好了，一如既往地感谢！\n再见！$

label: gText_ApprenticeThanksHeldItem9
source: Uh-huh, that's one {STR_VAR_1}?\nSi, bueno!\lI'll go find me one, like, bam!\pAll right, thanks, as always!\nAdios!$
translation: 嗯哼，{STR_VAR_1}？\n好的，行！\l我会去找一个，就像，砰！\p好了，一如既往地感谢！\n再见！$

label: gText_ApprenticeItemAlreadyRecommended9
source: No, no! You already told me about\nthat {STR_VAR_1} thing before.\pOh, now wait just one minute here…\nSo, you're saying my {STR_VAR_2}\lcan win without holding any item?$
translation: 不，不！你之前已经\n告诉过我{STR_VAR_1}的事了。\p哦，现在等等......\n所以你是说我的{STR_VAR_2}\l不携带道具也能赢？$

label: gText_ApprenticeHoldNothing10
source: What's that mean?\nDon't make it hold anything?$
translation: 那是什么意思？\n不让它带任何东西？$

label: gText_ApprenticeItemAlreadyRecommended10
source: Um, you told me about that before,\ndidn't you?\pIsn't there something else?\pOr do you mean, don't make\nmy {STR_VAR_2} hold anything?$
translation: 嗯，你之前告诉过我了，对吧？\p没有别的东西了吗？\p或者你是说，不让我的\n{STR_VAR_2}携带任何东西？$

label: gText_ApprenticeWhatHeldItem11
source:
A-H-O-Y!
And that spells ahoy!\pThe rappin' SAILOR am I!
I present to you a question\lthat's pretty fly!\pIt's an item question
that begs your suggestion!\pMy {STR_VAR_1} needs an item to hold,
What should it be, if I may be bold?$
translation:
A--H--O--Y！
拼出来就是Ahoy，嗨！\p说唱水手就是我！
向你提个超酷的问题！\p这是个道具问题
需要你的建议！\p我的{STR_VAR_1}需要携带道具，
该带什么好，请告诉我！$

label: gText_ApprenticeHoldNothing11
source: Is that right?\nMy {STR_VAR_1} doesn't need to be\lholding anything tight?$
translation: 是吗？\n我的{STR_VAR_1}不需要携带任何东西？$

label: gText_ApprenticeThanksNoHeldItem11
source: Okay, I hear you, sure I do!\nMy POKéMON will go empty-handed, too!\pIf it's advice I ever need,\n{PLAYER}, your word I'll always heed!$
translation: 好的，我听到了，当然！\n我的宝可梦也会空手上阵！\p如果我需要建议，\n{PLAYER}，你的话我永远听从！$

label: gText_ApprenticeThanksHeldItem11
source: Okay, one {STR_VAR_1},\nthat's what I'll use.\lI was right to make you choose!\pIf it's advice I ever need,\n{PLAYER}, your word I'll always heed!$
translation: 好的，{STR_VAR_1}，\n那就是我要用的。\l让你选是对的！\p如果我需要建议，\n{PLAYER}，你的话我永远听从！$

label: gText_ApprenticeItemAlreadyRecommended11
source: Okay, one {STR_VAR_1}, you say?\nYou told me that the other day.\lI need a new idea, a brand new way.\pOr, what, is that right?\nMy POKéMON doesn't need to hold\lanything tight?$
translation: 好的，{STR_VAR_1}，你说？\n你之前告诉过我了。\l我需要新点子，全新的方式。\p或者，什么，是吗？\n我的宝可梦不需要携带任何东西？$

label: gText_ApprenticeHoldNothing12
source: My {STR_VAR_1} needs nothing?\nDoesn't need to hold anything?$
translation: 我的{STR_VAR_1}什么都不需要？\n不需要携带任何东西？$

label: gText_ApprenticeThanksNoHeldItem12
source: If holding nothing is the best,\nI'll do as you suggest!\pWell, {PLAYER}, I have to roam free,\nbut don't you forget about me.\pSee you again, my smart friend!$
translation: 如果什么都不带是最好的，\n我会照你说的做！\p嗯，{PLAYER}，我必须自由漫游，\n但别忘了我。\p再见，我聪明的朋友！$

label: gText_ApprenticeThanksHeldItem12
source: If holding that {STR_VAR_1} is\nthe best, I'll do as you suggest!\pWell, {PLAYER}, I have to roam free,\nbut don't you forget about me.\pSee you again, my smart friend!$
translation: 如果携带{STR_VAR_1}是\n最好的，我会照你说的做！\p嗯，{PLAYER}，我必须自由漫游，\n但别忘了我。\p再见，我聪明的朋友！$

label: gText_ApprenticeItemAlreadyRecommended12
source: Haven't I heard about that\n{STR_VAR_1} before?\lI'm certain I have, that's for sure!\pI need a new something!\nOr, my {STR_VAR_2} needs nothing?\lDoesn't need to hold anything?$
translation: 我没听说过那个\n{STR_VAR_1}吗？\l我肯定听说过，那是肯定的！\p我需要新东西！\n或者我的{STR_VAR_2}什么都不需要？\l不需要携带任何东西？$

label: gText_ApprenticeWhatHeldItem13
source:
Gwah! Ouch! {PLAYER}{KUN}, my arm's broken!
Don't touch it, please!\pI must've broken it while I was trying
out different hold items with my posse\lof POKéMON.\pSo, things being this way,
I need you to decide for me.\p{PLAYER}{KUN}, what do you think would be
good for my {STR_VAR_1} to hold?$
translation:
嘎！哎哟！{PLAYER}{KUN}，我的手臂断了！
别碰它，拜托！\p一定是我在尝试不同道具
和我的宝可梦伙伴们时弄断的。\p所以，事已至此，
我需要你替我决定。\p{PLAYER}{KUN}，
你觉得我的{STR_VAR_1}携带什么好？$

label: gText_ApprenticeHoldNothing13
source: Ouch…\pSo your suggestion is my {STR_VAR_1}\ndoesn't have to hold anything?$
translation: 哎哟......\p所以你的建议是我的{STR_VAR_1}\n不需要携带任何东西？$

label: gText_ApprenticeThanksNoHeldItem13
source: Hm, all right. That would be easier\nfor me, the way things are now.\pI hope I can keep hitting you up\nfor help like this.$
translation: 嗯，好的。\n以我现在的情况，那样更容易。\p我希望我能继续\n这样向你求助。$

label: gText_ApprenticeHoldNothing14
source: Oh… Then, you think it would be better\nif my {STR_VAR_1} didn't have an item?$
translation: 哦......那么，你觉得我的{STR_VAR_1}\n不带道具更好？$

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichMonFirst0
source:
Waah, {PLAYER}!
I have a dilemma, sob…\pI want to begin battling other people,
but I don't know what to do.\pHow should I line up my POKéMON
so they'll be at their strongest?\pPlease tell me, {PLAYER}.
If you were me, which of these POKéMON\lwould you send out first?$
translation:
呜哇，{PLAYER}！
我有个两难困境，抽泣......\p我想开始和别人对战，
但不知道该怎么办。\p我该如何排列我的宝可梦
才能让它们最强？\p请告诉我，{PLAYER}。
如果你是我，这些宝可梦中\l你会先派出哪只？$

label: gText_ApprenticeMonFirstThanks0
source: My {STR_VAR_1} should go first?\nWaaaaah!\pOh! I'm so sorry!\nYou've made me happy by choosing\lmy first POKéMON, and it's made me cry…\pThank you so much!$
translation: 我的{STR_VAR_1}应该先上？\n哇啊啊！\p哦！真对不起！\n你替我选择首发宝可梦让我很高兴，\l这又让我哭了......\p太感谢你了！$

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichMonFirst1
source: Yay! It's {PLAYER}!\nGreat! I wanted to ask you something!\pUm, of my POKéMON, which do you\nthink should go out first?$
translation: 耶！是{PLAYER}！\n太好了！我想问你点事！\p嗯，在我的宝可梦中，\n你觉得哪只应该先出场？$

label: gText_ApprenticeMonFirstThanks1
source: My {STR_VAR_1}? That's true.\nOkay, I'll do that!\pThanks for teaching me!$
translation: 我的{STR_VAR_1}？没错。\n好的，我会这么做的！\p谢谢你教我！$

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichMonFirst2
source: {PLAYER}, hello!\pI think, in a battle, it's very important\nwhich POKéMON comes out first.\pOut of the POKéMON that I have,\nwhich would be good to send out first?$
translation: {PLAYER}，你好！\p我觉得在对战中，\n哪只宝可梦先出场非常重要。\p在我拥有的宝可梦中，\n哪只适合先派出去？$

label: gText_ApprenticeMonFirstThanks2
source: My {STR_VAR_1} goes first?\nOkay, I got it!\pSee you again!$
translation: 我的{STR_VAR_1}先上？\n好的，明白了！\p下次见！$

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichMonFirst3
source:
Hello, {PLAYER}…
I'm sorry to disturb you again with\lanother question.\pI have so little confidence, I don't
know what I'd do without you, {PLAYER}.\pIt may be a waste of time for me to
even worry about it, but I just can't\ldecide something…\pWhich of my POKéMON should I send
out first in a battle?$
translation:
你好，{PLAYER}......
很抱歉又打扰你问另一个问题。\p我太没自信了，没有你
{PLAYER}我都不知道该怎么办。\p可能我连担心都是浪费时间，
但我就是无法决定一件事......\p我的宝可梦中哪只应该
在对战中先出场？$

label: gText_ApprenticeMonFirstThanks3
source:
My {STR_VAR_1}?
Understood!\pI can't believe that you would bother
to answer my questions so often!\pI'm so grateful that you would even
speak with me… Thank you!$
translation:
我的{STR_VAR_1}？
明白了！\p真不敢相信你会经常
费心回答我的问题！\p我很感激你甚至愿意
和我说话......谢谢你！$

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichMonFirst4
source:
Oh, {PLAYER}{KUN}! It's me!
I'm so glad to see you because I have\lthis little problem.\pI can't decide how my POKéMON should
be lined up. Could you decide for me?\pOh, you don't need to decide the whole
party right now.\pHow about deciding just the first
POKéMON for me?$
translation:
哦，{PLAYER}{KUN}！是我！
很高兴见到你，因为我有个小问题。\p我无法决定我的宝可梦
该如何排列。你能替我决定吗？\p哦，你现在不需要决定
整个队伍。\p不如先替我决定
首发宝可梦？$

label: gText_ApprenticeMonFirstThanks4
source: My {STR_VAR_1}? That's great!\pKnowing that you made the decision,\n{PLAYER}{KUN}, I won't be so upset if\lI lose.\pOkay, I'll look to you for advice again.\nBye!$
translation: 我的{STR_VAR_1}？太好了！\p知道是你做的决定，\n{PLAYER}{KUN}，就算我输了\l也不会太难过。\p好的，我会再来向你请教。\n再见！$

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichMonFirst5
source:
Hi, my teacher {PLAYER}{KUN}!
I'm busy again today!\pI have to do some cycling, shopping,
and humming.\pI haven't even had the time to decide
how to line up my POKéMON team.\pSo, how about checking out my team?
Which one should go first?$
translation:
嗨，我的老师{PLAYER}{KUN}！
我今天又很忙！\p我得做些骑车、购物
和哼歌的事。\p我甚至没时间决定
如何排列我的宝可梦队伍。\p所以，不如看看我的队伍？
哪只应该先出场？$

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichMonFirst6
source:
Yoohoo! Hiya, {PLAYER}!
You always walk around looking tough!\pListen, I need something from you
again! It's the usual thing!\pDrum roll, please!
The question I have is about my team.\pWhich POKéMON of mine should be first
to go out in a battle?$
translation:
哟嚯！嗨，{PLAYER}！
你走路总是看起来很酷！\p听着，我又需要你帮忙了！
老样子！\p请鼓掌！
我的问题是关于我的队伍。\p我的宝可梦中哪只应该
在对战中先出场？$

label: gText_ApprenticeMonFirstThanks6
source:
Hmhm!
My {STR_VAR_1}, you say!\lThanks for a most cool answer!\pI guess that's about all I wanted
to ask you today.\pLet's meet here again, okay?
Thanks!$
translation: 嗯哼！\n你说我的{STR_VAR_1}！\l感谢这个超酷的回答！\p我想今天要问的就这些了。\p让我们在这里再见，好吗？\n谢谢！$

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichMonFirst7
source:
Thank you so much for stopping to
chat with me, {PLAYER}.\pI know I'm taking advantage of your
kindness, but may I ask for advice?\pI would like you to decide on the order
of my POKéMON team.\pIt would please me if you could decide
which POKéMON should come first.$
translation:
非常感谢你停下来
和我聊天，{PLAYER}。\p我知道我在利用你的善良，
但能请教一下吗？\p我想让你决定我的宝可梦
队伍的顺序。\p如果你能决定哪只宝可梦
应该先出场就太好了。$

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichMonFirst8
source:
Eek! {PLAYER}!
I… I'm overjoyed to see you again!\pMy POKéMON have become much
stronger!\pBut I don't always win. It seems to
depend on which POKéMON goes first.\p{PLAYER}, please, I need your help!\pPlease decide which of my POKéMON
should go out first!$
translation:
呀！我发现了{PLAYER}！
我......又见到你我太高兴了！\p我的宝可梦变得
强多了！\p但我并不总是赢。似乎
取决于哪只宝可梦先出场。\p{PLAYER}，拜托，
我需要你的帮助！\p请决定我的宝可梦中
哪只应该先出场！$

label: gText_ApprenticeMonFirstThanks8
source:
Sigh… I'm overwhelmed with happiness…\pIt's like a dream having you decide
for me, {PLAYER}.\pBut perfectly understood!
I will go with my {STR_VAR_1} first!\pI hope you'll be willing to teach me
some more another time.$
translation:
呼......我幸福得要晕过去了......\p能让你替我决定
就像做梦一样，{PLAYER}。\p但完全明白了！
我会让我的{STR_VAR_1}先上！\p希望下次你愿意
再教我些东西。$

label: gText_ApprenticeMonFirstThanks9
source: Uh-huh, my {STR_VAR_1} leads off!\nOK, A-OK!\lI'll reorder the lineup, like, wham!\pAll right, thanks, as always!\nAdios!$
translation: 嗯哼，我的{STR_VAR_1}打头阵！\nOK，A--OK！\l我会重新排序队伍，就像，砰！\p好了，一如既往地感谢！\n再见！$

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichMonFirst11
source:
A-H-O-Y!
And that spells ahoy!\pThe rappin' SAILOR am I!
I present to you a question\lthat's pretty fly!\pIt's a team lineup question
that begs your suggestion!\pOut of this lot, which should go first
as the first on the spot?$
translation:
A--H--O--Y！
拼出来就是Ahoy，嗨！\p说唱水手就是我！
向你提个超酷的问题！\p这是个队伍排序问题
需要你的建议！\p这些宝可梦中，哪只应该
首先出场？$

label: gText_ApprenticeMonFirstThanks11
source: Okay, I hear you, sure I do!\nI'll switch them up, that I'll do!\pIf it's advice I ever need,\n{PLAYER}, your word I'll always heed!$
translation: 好的，我听到了，当然！\n我会调整它们的位置，就这么办！\p如果我需要建议，\n{PLAYER}，你的话我永远听从！$

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichMonFirst12
source:
Yahoo, {PLAYER}!
How do you do?\pWhat should I do? Go ahead and ask?
Uh-huh, I have something to ask!\lAre you receiving me?\lYou are receiving me!\pYou have to decide, which of my
POKéMON is the first to ride!\lInto battle, I mean to say.$
translation:
哟嚯，{PLAYER}！
你好吗？\p我该怎么办？直接问？
嗯哼，我有事要问！\l你收到我的信号了吗？\l你收到了！\p你必须决定，我的宝可梦中
哪只是第1个上场的！\l我是说进入战斗！$

label: gText_ApprenticeMonFirstThanks12
source: My {STR_VAR_1}? Yes!\nThat'll do, there's no distress!\pWell, {PLAYER}, I have to roam free,\nbut don't you forget about me.\pSee you again, my smart friend!$
translation: 我的{STR_VAR_1}？是的！\n这样就行，没有烦恼！\p嗯，{PLAYER}，我必须自由漂泊，\n但别忘了我。\p再见，我聪明的朋友！$

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichMonFirst13
source:
…Oof…ooch… {PLAYER}{KUN}…
My stomach's hurting all of a sudden…\p…It's getting better now…\pI must've worried myself sick racking
my brains on how I should line up\lmy posse of POKéMON.\pSo, things being this way,
I need you to decide for me.\p{PLAYER}{KUN}, which of my POKéMON should
go first? So I'd win, I mean.$
translation:
......呼......哎哟......{PLAYER}{KUN}......
我的肚子突然好痛......\p......现在好些了......\p一定是我绞尽脑汁思考
如何排列我的宝可梦伙伴时\l把自己愁坏了。\p所以，事已至此，
我需要你替我决定。\p{PLAYER}{KUN}，我的宝可梦中哪只应该
先上场？我是说，才更可能赢。$

label: gText_ApprenticeMonFirstThanks13
source:
Hm, all right.
My {STR_VAR_1} goes first.\pI'll fix the lineup like that after
I have my supper.\pI hope I can keep hitting you up
for help like this.$
translation:
嗯，好的。
我的{STR_VAR_1}先上。\p等我吃完晚饭
就按那样调整顺序。\p我希望我能继续
这样向你求助。$

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichMon0
source:
Snivel…
Oh, {PLAYER}!\pWhat perfect timing!
There's something I just can't decide…\pI can't decide which POKéMON I should
be using.\pI can't decide between the POKéMON
{STR_VAR_1} and {STR_VAR_2}…\p{PLAYER}, which do you think will give
even me a chance at winning?$
translation:
抽泣......
哦，{PLAYER}！\p来得正是时候！
有件事我实在拿不定主意......\p我无法决定该用哪只宝可梦。\p在{STR_VAR_1}和{STR_VAR_2}
之间犹豫不决......\p{PLAYER}，你觉得哪只能让我
也有机会获胜？$

label: gText_ApprenticeMonThanks0
source: Snivel… I… I understand!\nOh! I'm so sorry!\lYou've made me so happy, I'm crying…\pI'll do my best to catch one\n{STR_VAR_1}!\pThank you so much!$
translation: 抽泣......我...我明白了！\n哦！真对不起！\l你让我太开心，我又哭了......\p我会努力去抓一只\n{STR_VAR_1}！\p太感谢你了！$

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichMon1
source:
Yay! It's {PLAYER}!
Yay, you came at the right time, too!\lI need your advice again!\pUm, I'm all mixed up--should I use
my {STR_VAR_1} or {STR_VAR_2}…\pWhich do you think I should raise,
{PLAYER}?$
translation: 耶！是{PLAYER}！\n来得正好！\l我又需要你的建议了！\p嗯，我完全搞混了--该用\n我的{STR_VAR_1}还是{STR_VAR_2}......\p{PLAYER}，你觉得我该培育哪只？$

label: gText_ApprenticeMonThanks1
source: Oh, so my {STR_VAR_1} is better!\nOkay, I'll do that!\pThanks for teaching me!$
translation: 哦，所以我的{STR_VAR_1}更好！\n好的，就这么办！\p谢谢你的教导！$

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichMon2
source:
{PLAYER}, hello!
I have a question I wanted to ask.\pI'm in a dilemma over whether I should
raise one {STR_VAR_1} or {STR_VAR_2}.\pWhich POKéMON do you think will
be stronger?$
translation:
{PLAYER}，你好！
有个问题想请教。\p我在纠结该培育{STR_VAR_1}
还是{STR_VAR_2}。\p你觉得哪只宝可梦
会更强？$

label: gText_ApprenticeMonThanks2
source: {STR_VAR_1} is your choice?\nOkay, I got it!\pI'll go catch a strong {STR_VAR_1}\nright away!\pSee you again!$
translation: 你选了{STR_VAR_1}？\n好的，明白了！\p我这就去抓只厉害的\n{STR_VAR_1}！\p下次见！$

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichMon3
source:
Hello, {PLAYER}…\pUm, you've probably already forgotten
about someone like me…\p…But that doesn't matter if you
could give me advice…\pI can't decide on the one kind of
POKéMON I should raise…\pI've narrowed the field to the POKéMON
{STR_VAR_1} and {STR_VAR_2}, but that's\lwhere I became stuck…\p{PLAYER}, you probably don't want to
bother, but please decide for me.$
translation:
你好，{PLAYER}......\p嗯，你可能已经忘记
我这样的人了......\p......但如果你能给我建议
那也没关系......\p我无法决定该培育
哪种宝可梦......\p范围缩小到了{STR_VAR_1}
和{STR_VAR_2}，但就在这\l卡住了......\p{PLAYER}，你可能不想费心，
但请替我决定吧。$

label: gText_ApprenticeMonThanks3
source: But will a wild {STR_VAR_1} even pay\nattention to me?\pI will try!\pBut will I even be able to catch one…\nNo! I'll do my best!\pThank you!$
translation: 但野生的{STR_VAR_1}\n会理我吗？\p我会试试的！\p但我能抓到吗......\n不！我会尽力的！\p谢谢你！$

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichMon4
source:
Oh, {PLAYER}{KUN}! I'm so glad to see you!
I was about to go looking for you!\pCan you decide what kind of POKéMON
I should use?\pFor instance…
How about the POKéMON {STR_VAR_1}\land {STR_VAR_2}?\pWhich one do you think would be
better?$
translation: 哦，{PLAYER}{KUN}！见到你真高兴！\n我正要去找你呢！\p你能决定我该用哪种宝可梦吗？\p比如......\n{STR_VAR_1}和{STR_VAR_2}\l怎么样？\p你觉得哪只更适合我？$

label: gText_ApprenticeMonThanks4
source: {STR_VAR_1}? That's great!\pKnowing that you made the decision,\n{PLAYER}{KUN}, I won't be so upset if\lI lose.\pOkay, I'll look to you for advice again.\nBye!$
translation: {STR_VAR_1}？太棒了！\p只要是你的决定，{PLAYER}{KUN}，\n就算输了我也没那么难过。\p好的，下次再向你请教。\n再见！$

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichMon5
source:
If it isn't {PLAYER}{KUN}! How's it going?
I'm busy again as always!\pI want to do good with POKéMON, too,
but I haven't been able to decide\lwhich POKéMON I should use.\pYou know how {STR_VAR_1} look strong?
But {STR_VAR_2} are tough to ignore.\p{PLAYER}{KUN}, give me some of your good
advice! Which one'd be good for me?$
translation:
这不是{PLAYER}{KUN}吗！最近怎样？
我还是老样子忙得很！\p我也想用好宝可梦，
但一直没决定该用哪只。\p你看{STR_VAR_1}好像很强？
但{STR_VAR_2}也不容忽视。\p{PLAYER}{KUN}，
给我点好建议！
哪只适合我？$

label: gText_ApprenticeMonThanks5
source: Okay, gotcha.\nI'll find time somehow and catch me\lthat {STR_VAR_1} you recommended.\pI'm glad I met a good mentor in you.\nThanks! See you around!$
translation: 好的，明白了。\n我会想办法抓一只\l你推荐的{STR_VAR_1}。\p真高兴遇到你这样的好导师。\n谢谢！回头见！$

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichMon6
source:
Oh!
Yay, it's {PLAYER}!\pI didn't waste any time boasting to
my friends about meeting you!\pI need to tap your mind again today.
It's an easy one for you!\pDrum roll, please!
The question I have is…\pIf I were to raise a POKéMON,
and the choices were one {STR_VAR_1}\lor {STR_VAR_2}, which should it be?$
translation:
哦！
是{PLAYER}！\p我立刻就跟朋友们炫耀
遇到你的事！\p今天又要借用你的智慧了。
对你来说很简单！\p请击鼓助兴！
我的问题是......\p如果要培育宝可梦，
选{STR_VAR_1}还是{STR_VAR_2}？$

label: gText_ApprenticeMonThanks6
source:
Ahhh!
{STR_VAR_1}, you say!\lThanks for a most cool answer!\pI guess that's about all I wanted
to ask you today.\pLet's meet here again, okay?
Thanks!$
translation: 啊啊！\n你说{STR_VAR_1}！\l感谢这超酷的答案！\p今天想问的就这些了。\p我们下次在这里再见，好吗？\n谢谢！$

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichMon7
source:
Oh, is it you, {PLAYER}?
I'm delighted to see you again!\pEver since I became your apprentice,
my confidence has been blooming.\pI think I'm ready to raise a POKéMON
of my own!\p{PLAYER}, may I impose on you to choose
which POKéMON I should raise?\pThe choices are the POKéMON
{STR_VAR_1} or {STR_VAR_2}…\lWhich POKéMON is right for me?$
translation:
哦，是你吗{PLAYER}？
真高兴又见到你！\p自从成为你的学徒，
我的信心越来越强了。\p我觉得准备好培育
自己的宝可梦了！\p{PLAYER}，能麻烦你帮我选
该培育哪只宝可梦吗？\p选项是{STR_VAR_1}
或{STR_VAR_2}......\l哪只适合我？$

label: gText_ApprenticeMonThanks8
source: Wow! You decided for me!\nOne {STR_VAR_1} is what I'll raise to\lthe best of my ability.\pI hope you'll be willing to teach me\nsome more another time.$
translation: 哇！你替我决定了！\n我会全力培育这只{STR_VAR_1}！\p希望下次你还能\n多教我一些。$

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichMon9
source:
Hey, hey!
My mentor, {PLAYER}{KUN}!\pHello, I've been looking for you
for some more of your sage advice!\pWhich kind of POKéMON would be right
for me, one {STR_VAR_1} or {STR_VAR_2}?\pDon't be shy now.
Let's blurt it out!$
translation:
嘿，嘿！
我的导师{PLAYER}{KUN}！\p你好，我一直在找你
想再听听你的睿智建议！\p哪种宝可梦适合我，
{STR_VAR_1}还是{STR_VAR_2}？\p别害羞，
直接说出来吧！$

label: gText_ApprenticeMonThanks9
source: Uh-huh, one {STR_VAR_1} it is!\nOK, A-OK!\lI'll get one in a BALL, like, cram!\pAll right, thanks, as always!\nAdios!$
translation: 嗯哼，就选{STR_VAR_1}！\nOK，没问题！\l我会用精灵球抓一只，就像塞进去！\p好的，一如既往地感谢！\n再见！$

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichMon10
source:
{PLAYER}{KUN}, listen! Big news!
I caught a mirage POKéMON!\pOf course I'm lying!
Wahahaha!\pThis is no lie, though.
I'm not very good at catching\lPOKéMON.\pSo, how about deciding for me which
kind of POKéMON I should catch,\lmaster?\pWhich would be better?
{STR_VAR_1} or {STR_VAR_2}?$
translation:
{PLAYER}{KUN}，听着！大新闻！
我抓到了幻影宝可梦！\p当然是骗你的！
哇哈哈哈！\p不过这不是骗人的。
我不太擅长抓宝可梦。\p所以，不如替我决定
该抓哪种宝可梦吧，师父？\p哪只更好？
{STR_VAR_1}还是{STR_VAR_2}？$

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichMon11
source:
A-H-O-Y!
And that spells ahoy!\pThe rappin' SAILOR am I!
Surely you remember who am I?\pToday, I have a POKéMON question
that begs your suggestion!\pI have the choice between this
{STR_VAR_1} and {STR_VAR_2}, you see.\lWhich is the one to catch for me?$
translation:
A--H--O--Y！
就是Ahoy的拼法！\p我就是那个说唱水手！
你肯定记得我是谁吧？\p今天有个宝可梦问题
需要你的建议！\p我可以在{STR_VAR_1}
和{STR_VAR_2}之间选择，\l哪只适合抓来陪我？$

label: gText_ApprenticeMonThanks11
source: {STR_VAR_1}, you say, hey, hey!\nI'll go get me one right away!\pIf it's advice I ever need,\n{PLAYER}, your word I'll always heed!$
translation: 你说{STR_VAR_1}，嘿，嘿！\n我这就去抓一只！\p如果需要建议，{PLAYER}，\n你的话我永远牢记！$

label: gText_ApprenticeMonThanks12
source: If that {STR_VAR_1} is the best,\nI'll do as you suggest!\pWell, {PLAYER}, I have to roam free,\nbut don't you forget about me.\pSee you again, my smart friend!$
translation: 如果{STR_VAR_1}最棒，\n我就照你说的办！\p嗯，{PLAYER}，我得自由闯荡，\n但你可别忘了我。\p再见，我聪明的朋友！$

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichMon13
source:
Oh, hi, {PLAYER}{KUN}…
I have this horrible headache…\pI must've worried too much about
the kind of POKéMON I should raise.\pSo, things being this way,
I need you to decide for me.\p{PLAYER}{KUN}, if I had to choose between
the POKéMON {STR_VAR_1} and\l{STR_VAR_2}, which should it be?$
translation:
哦，嗨，{PLAYER}{KUN}......
我头疼得厉害......\p肯定是因为太纠结
该培育哪种宝可梦了。\p所以，情况就是这样，
需要你替我决定。\p{PLAYER}{KUN}，如果必须在{STR_VAR_1}
和{STR_VAR_2}之间选择，\l该选哪只？$

label: gText_ApprenticeMonThanks13
source: Hm, one {STR_VAR_1}, all right.\nI'll go look for one when I get better.\pI hope I can keep hitting you up\nfor help like this.$
translation: 嗯，就选{STR_VAR_1}吧。\n等我好些了就去找一只。\p希望能继续这样\n向你求助。$

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichMon14
source:
Er… Um…
{PLAYER}{KUN}…?\pPlease, don't look at me that way.
I'm getting all flustered…\lI… I need your advice.\pI… I'm really embarrassed, but I can't
decide which POKéMON to use.\pIf the choices were {STR_VAR_1} or
{STR_VAR_2}, which would be better?$
translation:
呃......嗯...
{PLAYER}{KUN}......？\p拜托别那样看我。
我都慌乱了......\l我......我需要你的建议。\p我......我真的很不好意思，
但无法决定该用哪只宝可梦。\p如果选项是{STR_VAR_1}
或{STR_VAR_2}，哪只更好？$

label: gText_ApprenticeMoveThanks1
source: {STR_VAR_1} is better? I guess so!\nOkay, I'll go with that!\pIf we meet here again, please teach\nme something else, teacher!$
translation: {STR_VAR_1}更好？我想是的！\n好的，我就用那个！\p如果我们在这里再见，请再教我\n点别的，老师！$

label: gText_ApprenticeMoveThanks2
source: {STR_VAR_1} is your choice?\nOkay, I got it!\pI'll go teach {STR_VAR_1} to\nmy POKéMON right away!\pSee you again!$
translation: {STR_VAR_1}是你的选择？\n好的，明白了！\p我马上去教我的宝可梦\n{STR_VAR_1}！\p下次见！$

label: gText_ApprenticeMoveThanks3
source: I understand!\pBut will it even be willing to learn\n{STR_VAR_1} for me…\lNo! I'll do my best!\pThank you!$
translation: 我明白了！\p但它会愿意为我学\n{STR_VAR_1}吗......\l不！我会尽力的！\p谢谢你！$

label: gText_ApprenticeMoveThanks4
source: {STR_VAR_1}? That's great!\pKnowing that you made the decision,\n{PLAYER}{KUN}, I won't be so upset if\lI lose.\pOkay, I'll look to you for advice again.\nBye!$
translation: {STR_VAR_1}？太棒了！\p知道是你做的决定，\n{PLAYER}{KUN}，就算我输了\l也不会太难过。\p好的，我会再来向你请教。\n再见！$

label: gText_ApprenticeMoveThanks6
source:
Ahhh!
{STR_VAR_1}, you say!\lThanks for a most cool answer!\pI guess that's about all I wanted
to ask you today.\pLet's meet here again, okay?
Thanks!$
translation: 啊！\n{STR_VAR_1}，你说！\l感谢这个超酷的回答！\p我想今天要问的就这些了。\p让我们在这里再见，好吗？\n谢谢！$

label: gText_ApprenticeMoveThanks9
source: Uh-huh, {STR_VAR_1} it is!\nSi, bueno!\lI'll get it taught, like, ka-blam!\pAll right, thanks, as always!\nAdios!$
translation: 嗯哼，{STR_VAR_1}！\n好的，行！\l我会教它，就像，砰！\p好了，一如既往地感谢！\n再见！$

label: gText_ApprenticeMoveThanks11
source: {STR_VAR_1}, you say, hey, hey!\nI'll go teach that right away!\pIf it's advice I ever need,\n{PLAYER}, your word I'll always heed!$
translation: {STR_VAR_1}，你说，嘿，嘿！\n我马上去教那招！\p如果我需要建议，\n{PLAYER}，你的话我永远听从！$

label: gText_ApprenticeMoveThanks12
source: If that {STR_VAR_1} is the best,\nI'll do as you suggest!\pWell, {PLAYER}, I have to roam free,\nbut don't you forget about me.\pSee you again, my smart friend!$
translation: 如果{STR_VAR_1}是最好的，\n我会照你说的做！\p嗯，{PLAYER}，我必须自由漫游，\n但别忘了我。\p再见，我聪明的朋友！$

label: gText_ApprenticePickWinSpeech0
source:
Oh… {PLAYER}?
It is {PLAYER}!\lOh! Sniff…sob… Please, listen!\pI… When I battle, I get so nervous,
I can't help crying even if I win…\pI wish I could say something cool
when I win…\pPlease, please, {PLAYER}!
Could you maybe teach me something\lcool to say when I win so I don't cry?$
translation:
哦... {PLAYER}？
是{PLAYER}啊！\l哦！抽泣......呜咽... 请听我说！\p我... 在对战时，我会紧张得不得了，
就算赢了也忍不住哭出来......\p我真希望赢的时候
能说点帅气的话......\p求求你，{PLAYER}！
能不能教我一句赢了之后说的\l酷酷的话，这样我就不会哭了？$

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks0
source:
{STR_VAR_1}\pAwesome! Wicked! Awoooh!
It's really cool!\pOh… I'm sorry…
I'm so happy, I'm crying…\pSnivel… {PLAYER}!
Thank you so much for everything!\pI will battle the best I can for
your sake, {PLAYER}!\p{PLAYER}…
Next time… We should battle!$
translation:
{STR_VAR_1}\p太棒了！帅呆了！呜哦哦！
这真的很酷！\p哦......对不起......
我太高兴了，又哭了......\p抽鼻子... {PLAYER}！
真的非常感谢你为我做的一切！\p为了你，{PLAYER}，
我会尽我所能去战斗的！\p{PLAYER}......
下次... 我们来对战吧！$

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks1
source:
{STR_VAR_1}\pOh, wow! That is so cool!
Okay, I'll say that!\pThanks for teaching me all this time!
I'm going to do the best I can\lwherever I go from now on!\pWhen we meet again, it'll be for
a battle!$
translation:
{STR_VAR_1}\p哦，哇！这太酷了！
好的，我就说这句了！\p谢谢你一直以来的教导！
从今以后，无论走到哪里，\l我都会全力以赴的！\p等我们再见面时，
就来一场对战吧！$

label: gText_ApprenticePickWinSpeech2
source:
{PLAYER}, hello!\pMy POKéMON and I are ready for
anything, except for one thing.\pI think it would be good if I had
something to shout when I win.\pCould you think up something good
to say?$
translation:
{PLAYER}，你好！\p我和我的宝可梦已经准备好
迎接任何挑战了，除了一件事。\p我觉得如果我赢了之后
能喊点什么就好了。\p你能帮我想一句
适合说的话吗？$

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks2
source:
{STR_VAR_1}\p…Cool!
I will use that!\pI'm going out to battle all over
the place.\pWho knows, I may even get to battle
you one day, {PLAYER}.\pNext time, let's meet at a place
of battle!$
translation: {STR_VAR_1}\p......酷！\n我就用这句了！\p我要去各地旅行战斗了。\p说不定有一天，\n我还能和你对战呢，{PLAYER}。\p下次，我们在对战之地再见吧！$

label: gText_ApprenticePickWinSpeech3
source:
Hello, {PLAYER}…
I'm sorry to bug you, but I'm hopeless…\pEven when…
Even when I win, I don't have anything\lspecial to say…\pI know that it doesn't mean anything
to you, {PLAYER}.\pBut it means a lot to me…\pPlease, {PLAYER}, what should I say
if I win a battle?$
translation:
你好，{PLAYER}......
抱歉打扰你，但我真是没救了......\p即使是......
即使我赢了，我也说不出\l什么特别的话来......\p我知道这对你来说
可能不算什么，{PLAYER}。\p但对我来说意义重大......\p求你了，{PLAYER}，
如果我赢了比赛，该说什么好呢？$

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks3
source:
{STR_VAR_1}\pThat's inspired…\pUh… Is it okay for someone like me
to even say that?\pNo! I'll do my best!\p{PLAYER}, thank you so much for
putting up with me for so long…\pI promise to do my best from now on.\pI'm sure you'll quickly forget about
someone like me, but let's meet\lsomewhere again!$
translation:
{STR_VAR_1}\p这话真有水平......\p呃......像我这样的人
说这个真的合适吗？\p不！我会努力的！\p{PLAYER}，真的非常感谢你
一直这么包容我......\p我保证从现在开始会尽最大努力。\p我知道你大概很快就会
忘掉我这样的人，但我们一定\l要在某个地方再见面！$

label: gText_ApprenticePickWinSpeech4
source:
Oh, {PLAYER}{KUN}.
There's something I want you to hear.\pI know that I don't always sound
nice or polite…\pWhen I win a battle, I think I come
across as being arrogant.\pI don't want people to dislike me,
so I want to say something nice to\lsomeone I beat.\pBut I can't think of anything good!
Could you think something up for me?$
translation:
哦，{PLAYER}{KUN}。
有件事想请你听听。\p我知道我说话
有时听起来不太友善或礼貌......\p赢了比赛时，
我觉得自己显得有点傲慢。\p我不想让人讨厌，
所以我想对被我打败的人\l说点好话。\p但我就是想不出什么好词！
你能帮我想一句吗？$

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks4
source:
{STR_VAR_1}\pNot bad!
Yup, that's what I'll go with!\pI'm going to hit the road and do what
I can with what you taught me in\lmy head and heart.\pI'm sorry that I've been so pushy
with you!\pNext time, we battle, okay?
See you!$
translation:
{STR_VAR_1}\p不错嘛！
嗯，我就用这句了！\p我要踏上旅程，把从你那里学到的
东西记在脑海里、放在心里，\l尽我所能去做。\p很抱歉我一直对你这么缠人！\p下次，我们来对战吧，好吗？
再见！$

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks5
source:
{STR_VAR_1}\pOkay, gotcha.
I can find time to say that!\pHonestly, I'm glad I met a good mentor
like you.\pI'm going to make time somehow so
I can get into battling.\pThanks for everything, {PLAYER}{KUN}!
We have to battle, you and me, one day!$
translation:
{STR_VAR_1}\p好的，明白了。
我总能挤出时间说这句的！\p说实话，能遇到你这样的好导师
真是太好了。\p我会想办法挤出时间
去好好对战的。\p谢谢你做的一切，{PLAYER}{KUN}！
总有一天，我们一定要对战一场！$

label: gText_ApprenticePickWinSpeech6
source:
I lucked out again!
{PLAYER}! Am I glad to see you!\lLike usual, I need your advice!\pDrum roll, please!
The last question I have is…\pIf I win a battle and want to end
it with a cool flourish, what\lshould I say?$
translation:
我又走运了！
{PLAYER}！见到你太高兴了！\l和往常一样，我需要你的建议！\p请击鼓助兴！
我要问的最后一个问题是......\p如果我赢了比赛，想用一句
酷炫的结束语收尾，\l我该说什么？$

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks6
source:
{STR_VAR_1}\pThat… That's fabulous!
It's dignified and cool! I claim it!\p…Listen, I think I'm getting decent
at this, huh?\pSo, I'm thinking of challenging other
TRAINERS from now on.\p{PLAYER}, your advice really helped me.\pMaybe one day, there'll be a time when
we battle!\pThank you for everything!$
translation:
{STR_VAR_1}\p这句......这句太棒了！
既体面又帅气！我宣布这句归我了！\p......听着，我觉得我现在
还挺像样的了，对吧？\p所以，我打算从现在开始
挑战其他训练家了。\p{PLAYER}，你的建议真的帮了我大忙。\p也许有一天，
就是我们交手的时候了！\p感谢你所做的一切！$

label: gText_ApprenticePickWinSpeech7
source:
Oh, {PLAYER}.
I'm so glad I met you!\pI no longer have any concerns with
regard to my POKéMON.\pIt's myself that worries me…\pDo you know how a TRAINER says
a few things upon winning a battle?\pDefinitely, I wish I could do that,
too!\pPlease, what should I say when
I win a battle?$
translation:
哦，{PLAYER}。
真高兴能遇见你！\p关于我的宝可梦，
我已经没有任何顾虑了。\p让我担心的是我自己......\p你知道训练家赢了比赛后
会说些什么吗？\p毫无疑问，我也希望能那样做！\p求你了，赢了比赛后
我该说什么好呢？$

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks7
source:
{STR_VAR_1}\pAh! That saying! It refreshes me
and makes me feel reborn!\pI must use that right away!\pAnd now, I must take my leave,
{PLAYER}…\pI will go out to battle many others,
but never will I forget your teachings.\pPerhaps one day…
Farewell!$
translation:
{STR_VAR_1}\p啊！这句话！它让我神清气爽，
仿佛重获新生！\p我必须马上就用上这句！\p那么现在，我必须告辞了，
{PLAYER}......\p我会去和很多人对战，\l但永远不会忘记你的教导。\p也许有一天......
再会了！$

label: gText_ApprenticePickWinSpeech8
source:
Eek! I spotted {PLAYER}!
I… I'm overjoyed to see you!\pOh-oh-oh! There's something I just
had to ask you!\pA little while ago, I won a battle.
That part was giddying!\pBut it made me so overjoyed that
I choked up and couldn't say a thing!\pSo now, {PLAYER}, please, I want you to
think up an exit line for when I win!$
translation:
呀！我看到{PLAYER}了！
我......我见到你太高兴了！\p哦--哦--哦！有件事
我非问你不可！\p不久前，我赢了一场对战。
那部分让我飘飘然！\p但它让我太高兴了，
我激动得说不出话来！\p所以现在，{PLAYER}，拜托了，
我想让你帮我想一句\l赢了之后退场的台词！$

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks8
source:
{STR_VAR_1}\pWaaaaah!
I'm going to say that?!\lI… I'm delirious with joy!\pTh-th-thank you!
I have nothing left to regret now!\pI'm going to travel now and battle
all sorts of people.\pEverything, I owe it to you, {PLAYER}.
Really, really, thank you!\pI've got to go now, but let's meet
in battle one day!$
translation:
{STR_VAR_1}\p哇啊啊啊！
我要说这句？！\l我......我高兴得快疯了！\p谢--谢--谢谢你！
我现在没有遗憾了！\p我现在要去旅行了，
要和各种各样的人对战。\p这一切，都归功于你，{PLAYER}。
真的，真的，谢谢你！\p我得走了，但总有一天
我们要在战场上见！$

label: gText_ApprenticePickWinSpeech9
source:
Hola, bueno!
{PLAYER}{KUN}!\pYou know, I'm getting the itch to roam
and battle where I may.\pBut before I do, I want your advice
once again, please!\pIf I were to win a battle, what would
be a good boast I could say to my\lfallen TRAINER opponent?$
translation:
喂，你好！
{PLAYER}{KUN}！\p你知道吗，
我有点想去各地旅行对战了。\p但在那之前，我还想
再请教你一次，拜托了！\p如果我赢了比赛，
有什么好的炫耀词\l可以对战败的训练家对手说呢？$

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks9
source:
{STR_VAR_1}\pUh-huh, that's sweet!
Si, bueno!\lI'll try saying that, like, ham!\pAnd now, it's time to say good-bye!
Thanks for all sorts of things!\pGive me a battle one day, OK?
Adios!$
translation:
{STR_VAR_1}\p嗯哼，这话真棒！
Si, bueno！嗯哼，\l我会试着这么说，就像，火腿！\p那么，是时候说再见了！
感谢你为我做的一切！\p改天和我对战一场，好吗？
再见！$

label: gText_ApprenticePickWinSpeech10
source:
{PLAYER}{KUN}, there's big trouble!\pWhen I win a battle, I brag about it
for an hour at least!\pOf course I'm lying!
Wahahaha!\pThis is no lie, though.
I'm not very good at chatting.\pSo, how about deciding for me what
I should say after winning a battle,\lmaster?$
translation:
{PLAYER}{KUN}，出大麻烦了！\p我赢了比赛后，
至少要吹嘘一个小时！\p当然我是骗你的！
哇哈哈哈！\p不过这不是骗人的。
我不太擅长聊天。\p所以，不如你替我决定一下
赢了比赛后该说什么吧，\l师父？$

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks10
source:
{STR_VAR_1}\pThat's what I should say, huh?
Then, I'll stay away from that!\pJust kidding!
I'll obey your teaching, master!\pThanks for teaching me all this time,
master!\pI'm finally understanding what being
a TRAINER is about.\pI'm going to go out and win battles
against any TRAINER.\pMaybe it'll be you one day, master!\pThat's all!
Farewell, my master!$
translation:
{STR_VAR_1}\p这就是我该说的，是吗？
那么，我会远离那句的！\p开个玩笑啦！
我会遵从您的教诲的，师父！\p谢谢您一直以来的教导，
师父！\p我终于开始明白
身为训练家意味着什么了。\p我要出去和任何训练家对战
并赢得胜利。\p也许有一天会是你，师父！\p就这样吧！
再见了，我的师父！$

label: gText_ApprenticePickWinSpeech11
source:
A-H-O-Y!
And that spells ahoy!\pThe rappin' SAILOR am I!
This will be my last question,\ldon't you cry!\pIt's a saying question
that begs your suggestion!\pIf I win a match, what can I say
in a real cool way?$
translation:
A--H--O--Y！
就是Ahoy，嗨的拼法！\p我就是那个说唱水手！
这将是我最后的问题，\l你可别哭！\p这是个寻求你建议的
台词问题！\p如果我赢了比赛，
该怎么说才显得超酷？$

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks11
source:
{STR_VAR_1}\pPerfect! That's what I'll use.
I was right to make you choose!\pAnd now, I think it'd be best,
if I were to fly the nest!\pThanks for all you taught me.
I'll be off on a battle spree!\pB-O-N-V-O-Y-A-G-E!
And that spells bon voyage,\lto you this is my homage!$
translation:
{STR_VAR_1}\p完美！我就用这句了。
让你选果然是对的！\p那么现在，我想是时候
让我展翅高飞了！\p谢谢你教会我的一切。
我要出发去大干一场了！\pB--O--N--V--O--Y--
A--G--E！\l就是Bon voyage的拼法，\l以此向你致敬！$

label: gText_ApprenticePickWinSpeech12
source:
Oh, yeah, {PLAYER}!
I found you again today!\pWhat should I do? Ask you again?
Why not? I'm already asking you!\pAnyways, {PLAYER}…
Are you receiving me?\lYou are receiving me!\lI need some more advice for me!\pIt's about what I should yell.
Something cool to holler when\la battle ends well.\pCome on, I wanna hear you say it!$
translation:
哦，耶，{PLAYER}！
今天又找到你了！\p我该怎么办？再问你一次？
为什么不呢？反正我都在问了！\p总之，{PLAYER}......
你收到我的信号了吗？\l你收到了！\l我需要再要点建议！\p是关于我该喊什么的。
战斗顺利结束时\l该喊点什么酷酷的话。\p来吧，我想听你说出来！$

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks12
source:
{STR_VAR_1}\pAll right, all right!
I'll use that because it's so tight!\pI'm out of things to ask you.
Waving bye is all that's left to do.\pBut maybe one day we'll meet, with one
destined to go down in defeat.\pBut, it really is time to say farewell.\pWell, {PLAYER}, I have to roam free,
but don't you forget about me!\pTake care, {PLAYER}!
Love ya!$
translation:
{STR_VAR_1}\p好极了，好极了！
我就用这句了，因为它太赞了！\p我已经没东西问你了。
只剩下挥手告别了。\p但也许有一天我们会相遇，
其中一人注定要败北。\p不过，真的该说再见了。\p嗯，{PLAYER}，我得自由闯荡了，
但你可别忘了我！\p保重，{PLAYER}！
爱你哟！$

label: gText_ApprenticePickWinSpeech13
source:
{PLAYER}{KUN}, I'm finished…
My nose won't stop dripping…\pI was trying to think up something
cool to say when I win a battle.\pIt inspired me so much, it made me cry,
and now my nose won't stop running…\pSo, things being this way,
I need you to decide for me, {PLAYER}{KUN}.\pWhen I win a battle,
what should I say?$
translation:
{PLAYER}{KUN}，我完了......
我的鼻涕止不住地流......\p我刚才在努力想
赢了比赛时该说的酷酷台词。\p它太让我激动了，我哭了，
现在我的鼻涕就停不下来......\p所以，情况就是这样，
我需要你帮我决定，{PLAYER}{KUN}。\p我赢了比赛后，
该说什么呢？$

label: gText_ApprenticePickWinSpeech14
source:
Er… Um…
{PLAYER}{KUN}…\pPlease, don't look at me that way.
You're making me all nervous.\pI… I need your advice again.
I'll make it my last, though…\pIt's really embarrassing to ask,
but what if I win a battle?\lWhat should I say?$
translation:
呃......嗯...
{PLAYER}{KUN}......\p拜托，别那样看着我。
你让我好紧张。\p我......我又需要你的建议了。
不过这是最后一次了......\p问这个真的很不好意思，
但如果我赢了比赛呢？\l我该说什么？$

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks14
source:
{STR_VAR_1}\pOh… Okay!
I'll try to say that!\lI might be too nervous to say it…\pThank you, {PLAYER}{KUN}.
I have to say good-bye now.\pI'll obey all that you've taught me,
{PLAYER}{KUN}, and do the best I can.$
translation:
{STR_VAR_1}\p哦......好的！
我会试着说这句的！\l我可能会紧张得说不出来......\p谢谢你，{PLAYER}{KUN}。
我现在得说再见了。\p我会遵从你教给我的一切，
{PLAYER}{KUN}，尽我所能做到最好。$

label: gText_ApprenticePickWinSpeech15
source:
Hm? You appear to be {PLAYER}{KUN}…
But are you really?\lPerhaps a clever {PLAYER} DOLL?\pOh, no, no, no, don't worry!
If you really are real, please\lforget about my rudeness.\pNo need to be so angry. All I wish for
is more of your fine advice.\pIt concerns a saying.\pMore precisely, what should I say
if I win a battle?$
translation:
嗯？你好像是{PLAYER}{KUN}......
但你真的是吗？\l或许是个聪明的{PLAYER}人偶？\p哦，不不不，别担心！
如果你是真的，请忘了\l我的无礼吧。\p没必要这么生气。我所希望的
只是更多你宝贵的建议。\p是关于一句台词的。\p更确切地说，如果我赢了比赛，
我该说什么？$

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks15
source:
{STR_VAR_1}\p… … … … … …
When I win a match…\p{STR_VAR_1}\p…Are you serious?\pI see. If you are serious, that's fine.
I thank you for your time.\pI do hope even I will be able to
put that saying to good use.\pI seem to have run dry on what advice
I need.\pI do believe it's high time I bid you
farewell and strike out on my own.\pThank you, my mentor!
I apologize for my skepticism!$
translation:
{STR_VAR_1}\p...... ...... ...... ...... ...... ...
当我赢了比赛时......\p{STR_VAR_1}\p......你是认真的吗？\p我明白了。
如果你是认真的，那好吧。\l感谢你抽空帮我。\p我希望连我也能
好好利用这句台词。\p我似乎已经想不出
还需要什么建议了。\p我想是时候向你告别，
独自出发了。\p谢谢你，我的导师！
我为我的怀疑向你道歉！$

label: FallarborTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_WelcomeToBattleTent
source: I welcome you to the BATTLE TENT!\pI am your guide to the Set KO Tourney!$
translation: 欢迎来到对战帐篷\n秋叶镇分址！\p我是您的三回合定胜负\n锦标赛的向导！$

label: FallarborTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_WelcomeToBattleTent
source: I welcome you to the BATTLE TENT\nFALLARBOR SITE!\pI am your guide to the Set KO Tourney!$
translation: 欢迎来到对战帐篷\n秋叶镇分址！\p我是您的三回合定胜负\n锦标赛的向导！$

label: FallarborTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_TakeChallenge
source: Now, do you wish to take the challenge\nof a Set KO Tourney?$
translation: 要挑战三回合定胜负锦标赛吗？$

label: FallarborTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_AwaitAnotherChallenge
source: We await your challenge on\nanother occasion!$
translation: 随时恭候您再次挑战！$

label: FallarborTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_SaveBeforeChallenge
source: Before showing you to the BATTLE\nTENT, I must save. Is that okay?$
translation: 在挑战对战帐篷之前\n要先写入记录，可以吗？$

label: FallarborTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_WhichLevelMode
source: We offer two levels of challenge,\nLevel 50 and Open Level.\lWhich is your choice?$
translation: 我们提供2个级别的比赛，\nLv. 50级和自由等级\l您要参加哪个？$

label: FallarborTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_SelectThreeMons
source: Very well, now select your\nthree POKéMON, please.$
translation: 好的，请选择\n3只宝可梦。$

label: FallarborTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLvOpen
source:
My dear challenger!\pYou do not have the three POKéMON
required for entry.\pTo qualify, you must bring three
different kinds of POKéMON.\pThey also must not hold the same
kinds of items.\pEGGS{STR_VAR_1} ineligible.\pWhen you have made your preparations,
please do return.$
translation:
这位客人！\p您能够参加对战的
宝可梦不满3只。\p您需要准备3只
不同种类的宝可梦，\p且让它们分别携带不同道具
才可参加对战。\p此外，蛋{STR_VAR_1}无法参加对战！\p请在准备就绪之后，
再来参加吧！$

label: FallarborTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_GuideYouToBattleTent
source: I shall now guide you to\nthe BATTLE TENT.$
translation: 我现在带您\n进入对战帐篷。$

label: FallarborTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_DidntSaveBeforeQuitting
source:
My dear challenger!\pYou did not save the game before
shutting down, did you?\pIt is unfortunate, but that has
resulted in your disqualification\lfrom your challenge.\pYou may, of course, start with a fresh
challenge.$
translation:
这位客人！\p您在上次结束时
没有写入记录吧？\p非常遗憾，没有写入记录的
挑战我们将视其为无效。\p当然，您可以随时开始
一次新的挑战。$

label: FallarborTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_BeatThreeTrainers
source: How splendid! You have beaten\nthree TRAINERS in succession!$
translation: 太棒了！您连续打败了\n3位训练家！$

label: FallarborTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_WaitWhileSaveGame
source: Please wait while I save the game.$
translation: 正在写入记录......请稍候。$

label: FallarborTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_PresentYouWithPrize
source: In commemoration of your 3-win streak,\nwe present you with this prize.$
translation: 为纪念您取得3连胜，\n特此为您颁发这份奖品。$

label: FallarborTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ReceivedPrize
source: {PLAYER} received the prize\n{STR_VAR_1}.$
translation: {PLAYER}得到了\n{STR_VAR_1}。$

label: FallarborTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_BagFullReturnForPrize
source: Oh?\nYour BAG seems to be full.\pI urge you to clear space and\nreturn for your prize.$
translation: 哎？\n包包已经满了。\p请把包包整理好之后\n再来领取吧。$

label: FallarborTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ThankYouWaitWhileSaving
source: Thank you so much for participating!\pPlease wait while I save the game.$
translation: 辛苦了！\p正在写入记录......请稍候。$

label: FallarborTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_AwaitAnotherChallenge2
source: We await your challenge on\nanother occasion!$
translation: 随时恭候您再次挑战！$

label: FallarborTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_LookingForwardToArrival
source: We have been looking forward to\nyour arrival.\pBefore I show you to the BATTLE TENT,\nI must save the game. Please wait.$
translation: 我们一直恭候\n您的到来。\p在带您进入对战帐篷之前，\n需要先写入记录。请稍候。$

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_WelcomeToBattleTent
source: I welcome you to the BATTLE TENT!\pHere, the TRAINER's trust toward\nPOKéMON is tested.$
translation: 欢迎来到对战帐篷\n绿茵镇分址！\p训练家对宝可梦的信赖\n将在此接受考验。$

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_WelcomeToBattleTent
source: I welcome you to the BATTLE TENT\nVERDANTURF SITE!\pHere, the TRAINER's trust toward\nPOKéMON is tested.$
translation: 欢迎来到对战帐篷\n绿茵镇分址！\p训练家对宝可梦的信赖\n将在此接受考验。$

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ReturnFortified
source: When you have fortified your heart\nand POKéMON, you must return.$
translation: 当您的心灵与您的宝可梦都变得\n更强的时候，再回到这里来吧。$

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_WhichLevelMode
source: There are two levels of difficulty,\nLevel 50 and Open Level.\lWhich is your choice of a challenge?$
translation: 有2个级别，\nLv. 50级和自由等级。\l您要挑战哪个？$

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLv50
source:
Sigh…\pYou do not have the three POKéMON
required for the challenge.\pTo enter, you must provide three
different kinds of POKéMON.\pThey also must not be holding
the same kinds of items.\pEGGS{STR_VAR_1} ineligible.\pCome back when you have made
your preparations.$
translation:
唉......\p您能够参加对战的
宝可梦不满3只。\p您需要准备3只
不同种类的宝可梦，\p且让它们分别携带不同道具
才可参加对战。\p此外，蛋{STR_VAR_1}无法参加对战！\p请在准备就绪之后，
再来参加吧！$

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLvOpen
source:
Sigh…\pYou do not have the three POKéMON
required for the challenge.\pTo enter, you must provide three
different kinds of POKéMON.\pThey also must not be holding
the same kinds of items.\pEGGS{STR_VAR_1} ineligible.\pCome back when you have made
your preparations.$
translation:
唉......\p您能够参加对战的
宝可梦不满3只。\p您需要准备3只
不同种类的宝可梦，\p且让它们分别携带不同道具
才可参加对战。\p此外，蛋{STR_VAR_1}无法参加对战！\p请在准备就绪之后，
再来参加吧！$

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_SelectThreeMons
source: Good. Now, you must select your\nthree POKéMON.$
translation: 好的。现在请您选择\n3只宝可梦。$

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_SaveBeforeChallenge
source: I must save before I show you to\nthe BATTLE TENT. Is that okay?$
translation: 在进入对战帐篷之前需要\n先写入记录，可以吗？$

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_NowFollowMe
source: Good.\nNow, follow me.$
translation: 很好。\n那么，请随我来。$

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ResultsWillBeRecorded
source: I feel privileged for having seen\nyour POKéMON's exploits.\pThe results will be recorded.\nI must ask you to briefly wait.$
translation: 很荣幸能观赏到\n您的宝可梦的英姿。\p正在记录比赛成绩，\n请稍候。$

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_AchievedThreeWinStreak
source: To achieve a 3-win streak…\pThe bonds that bind your heart with\nyour POKéMON seem firm and true.$
translation: 您达成了3连胜......\p看来您的心灵与宝可梦之间的\n牵绊已经坚不可摧。$

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_FeatWillBeRecorded
source: Your feat will be recorded.\nI must ask you to briefly wait.$
translation: 正在记录比赛成绩，\n请稍候。$

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_PresentYouWithPrize
source: For the feat of your 3-win streak,\nwe present you with this prize.$
translation: 为纪念您取得3连胜，\n特此为您颁发这份奖品。$

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_WelcomeToBattleTent
source: Welcome to the BATTLE TENT!\pI am your guide to the Battle Swap\nTournament.$
translation: 欢迎来到对战帐篷\n凯那市分址！\p我是您的交换式对战\n锦标赛向导。$

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_WelcomeToBattleTent
source: Welcome to the BATTLE TENT\nSLATEPORT SITE!\pI am your guide to the Battle Swap\nTournament.$
translation: 欢迎来到对战帐篷\n凯那市分址！\p我是您的交换式对战\n锦标赛向导。$

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_TakeChallenge
source: Would you like to take the Battle\nSwap challenge?$
translation: 要挑战交换式对战\n锦标赛吗？$

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_LookForwardToNextVisit
source: We look forward to your next visit.$
translation: 我们期待您的再次光临。$

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_WhichLevelMode
source: Which level do you wish to challenge?\nLevel 50 or Level 100?$
translation: 您要挑战哪个等级？\nLv. 50级还是100级？$

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_SaveBeforeChallenge
source: Before you begin your challenge,\nI need to save data. Is that okay?$
translation: 在挑战前需要先写入记录，\n可以吗？$

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_HoldMonsForSafekeeping
source: Okay, I will hold your POKéMON for\nsafekeeping while you compete.$
translation: 好的，我会替您保管\n宝可梦。$

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_StepThisWay
source: 这边请。$
translation: 这边请。$

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_ReturnRentalMonsSaveResults
source: Thank you for participating!\pI will return your POKéMON in exchange\nfor our rental POKéMON.\pI must also save your event results.\nPlease wait.$
translation: 辛苦了！\p我将把您的宝可梦还给您\n并换回租借宝可梦。\p并且需要写入对战记录。\n请稍等。$

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_ReturnMonsExchangeRentals
source: I will return your POKéMON in exchange\nfor our rental POKéMON.$
translation: 我要将您的宝可梦还给您\n并且收回我们借给您的宝可梦。$

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_WonThreeMatchesReturnMons
source:
Congratulations!
You've won three straight matches!\pI will return your POKéMON in exchange
for our rental POKéMON.\pI must also save your event results.
Please wait.$
translation:
恭喜您！
您获得了3连胜！\p我将把您的宝可梦还给您
并换回租借宝可梦。\p并且需要写入对战记录。
请稍等。$

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_AwardYouThisPrize
source: In recognition of your 3-win streak,\nwe award you this prize.$
translation: 为纪念您取得3连胜，\n特此为您颁发这份奖品。$

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_NoRoomInBagMakeRoom
source: Oh?\nYou seem to have no room for this.\pPlease make room in your BAG and\nlet me know.$
translation: 哎？\n包包已经满了。\p请把包包整理好之后\n再来领取吧。$

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_BeenWaitingForYou
source: We've been waiting for you!\pBefore we resume your challenge,\nI must save the game.$
translation: 我们已经恭候多时了！\p在您继续战斗之前，\n需要先写入记录。$

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_ReturnPersonalMons
source: We'll return your personal POKéMON.$
translation: 我们将归还您的宝可梦。$

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_ReceivedPrize
source: {PLAYER} received the prize\n{STR_VAR_1}.$
translation: {PLAYER}得到奖品\n{STR_VAR_1}。$

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_RulesAreListed
source: The Battle Swap rules are listed.$
translation: 交换式对战规则已经列出。$

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_ReadWhichHeading
source: Which heading do you want to read?$
translation: 要读哪一部分的说明？$

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainBasicRules
source: In a Battle Swap event, you may use\nonly three POKéMON.\pWhether you are renting or swapping,\nyour team may not have two or more\lof the same POKéMON.$
translation: 在交换式对战中，\n您只能用3只宝可梦。\p无论是租借还是交换得到的，\n您的队伍中不能出现2只\l或以上相同种类的宝可梦。$

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainSwapPartnerRules
source: You may swap POKéMON only with\nthe TRAINER you have just defeated.\pYou may swap for only those POKéMON\nused by the beaten TRAINER.$
translation: 您只能与刚击败过的训练家\n交换宝可梦。\p您只能交换到该训练家\n所使用的宝可梦。$

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainSwapNumberRules
source: After every battle you win, you may\nswap for one of your defeated\lopponent's POKéMON.\pYou will not be able to swap POKéMON\nwith the third TRAINER in the event.$
translation: 每获胜1场战斗后，\n您可以选择交换对手的1只宝可梦。\p第3位训练家\n不可进行交换。$

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainSwapNotes
source:
There are two key points to be aware
of when swapping POKéMON.\pFirst, when swapping, you can't check
the stats of the POKéMON you are\labout to receive.\pSecond, the POKéMON on your team
are lined up in sequence, depending on\lthe order in which you rented them.\pThis sequence remains unchanged
even when swaps are made.$
translation:
在交换宝可梦时有2个
需要注意的地方。\p第一，交换时您无法查看目标
宝可梦的具体能力。\p第二，队伍中的宝可梦的排列顺序
按租用时的顺序固定。\p交换后该顺序仍保持不变。$

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainMonRules
source: The POKéMON of the SLATEPORT\nBATTLE TENT are all rentals.\pAll rental POKéMON are kept at\nLevel 30.$
translation: 在凯那市对战帐篷中\n使用的宝可梦都是租借的。\p所有租借的宝可梦\n等级均为30。$

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_RulesAreListed2
source: The VERDANTURF BATTLE TENT\nrules are listed.$
translation: 绿茵镇对战帐篷的\n规则已经列出$

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ReadWhichHeading
source: Which heading do you want to read?$
translation: 要读哪一部分的说明？$

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainBasicRules
source: Here at the VERDANTURF BATTLE TENT,\nPOKéMON are required to think and\lbattle by themselves.\pUnlike in the wild, POKéMON that live\nwith people behave differently\ldepending on their nature.$
translation: 在绿茵镇对战帐篷，\n宝可梦需要独立\l思考并战斗。\p不像在野外，宝可梦和人类一起生存\n由于自然环境不同\l行为也不同。$

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainNatureRules
source:
Depending on its nature, a POKéMON
may prefer to attack no matter what.\pAnother POKéMON may prefer to protect
itself from any harm.\pYet another may enjoy vexing or
confounding its foes.\pDepending on its nature, a POKéMON
will have favorite moves that it is good\lat using.\pIt may also dislike certain moves that
it has trouble using.$
translation:
由于它所处自然环境，宝可梦可能
会不知原因的攻击。\p另外的宝可梦可能会
保护自己免受伤害。\p有的还喜欢干扰
和迷惑自己的敌人。\p由于它所处的自然环境，宝可梦可能
有它所最喜欢的招式\l并且可以熟练使用。\p它也有可能存在不喜欢的招式
于是不擅长使用。$

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainMoveRules
source:
There are offensive moves that inflict
direct damage on the foe.\pThere are defensive moves that are
used to prepare for enemy attacks or\lused to heal HP and so on.\pThere are also other somewhat-odd
moves that may enfeeble the foes with\lstat problems including poison and \lparalysis.\pPOKéMON will consider using moves in
these three categories.$
translation:
有攻击招式可以
对敌人造成直接伤害。\p有防守招式
用来防御敌人的攻击\l或用来恢复HP等等。\p也有一些有点怪异的招式
可以使得敌人变得无力和带来\l其他问题，例如中毒和麻痹。\p宝可梦可能会考虑在
这3种招式中选择使用。$

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainUnderpoweredRules
source:
When not under command by its TRAINER,
a POKéMON may be unable to effectively\luse certain moves.\pA POKéMON is not good at using any
move that it dislikes.\pIf a POKéMON only knows moves that
do not match its nature, it will often\lbe unable to live up to its potential.$
translation:
当没有听从训练家的命令时
宝可梦可能不会有效的使用特定招式。\p宝可梦不擅长使用
任何它不喜欢的招式。\p如果宝可梦仅仅知道些
不符合其性格的招式，\l那么它就不会展示它的潜能。$

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainWhenInDangerRules
source: Depending on its nature, a POKéMON may\nstart using moves that don't match its\lnature when it is in trouble.\pIf a POKéMON begins behaving oddly\nin a pinch, watch it carefully.$
translation: 根据其性格，\n当陷入麻烦时，宝可梦可能会开始\l使用一些并不符合性格的招式。\p如果宝可梦开始变得行为怪异，\n您就有必要仔细查看了。$

label: BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainLevelRules
source: At this BATTLE TENT, the levels of\nyour opponents will be adjusted to\lmatch the levels of your POKéMON.\pHowever, no TRAINER you face will\nhave any POKéMON below Level 30.$
translation: 在对战帐篷中，对手的宝可梦等级会\n根据您的宝可梦等级进行调整。\p但是，训练家所持有的宝可梦\n最低不会低于等级30。$

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_RulesAreListed
source: The VERDANTURF BATTLE TENT\nrules are listed.$
translation: 上面列出了绿茵镇对战帐篷的规则。$

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_GiveEnigmaBerry
source: DAD: Hi, {PLAYER}!\pI just received a very rare BERRY.\nI'd like you to have it.$
translation: 爸爸：嘿，{PLAYER}！\p我刚刚得到了一种稀有树果，\n给你拿着吧。$

label: Route104_Text_PlantBerriesInSoilTakeThis
source: If you see BERRIES growing in loamy\nsoil, feel free to take them.\pBut make sure you plant a BERRY in the\nsame spot. That's common courtesy.\pHere, I'll share this with you.$
translation: 你可以随意取走生长在\n松软的土壤里的树果，\p但记住离开之前一定要在同一个地方\n种下一枚树果，这是约定俗成的习惯。\p这个给你吧。$

label: Route104_Text_TrainersOftenMakeMonHoldBerries
source:
The way you look, you must be a
TRAINER, no?\pTRAINERS often make POKéMON hold
BERRIES.\pIt's up to you whether to grow BERRIES
or use them.$
translation:
看上去......
你一定是训练家吧？\p训练家经常会给他们的宝可梦
携带树果。\p当然，得到树果后是种植还是使用
都取决于你自己。$

label: Route111_Text_GoingToTryToMakeDifferentColorBerries
source: I'm going to try really hard and make\nBERRIES in different colors.\pI hope you try hard, too!$
translation: 我要努力种出\n不同颜色的树果。\p你也要努力啊！$

label: Route111_Text_WhatColorBerriesToLookForToday
source: I wonder what color BERRIES I'll look\nfor today?$
translation: 今天去找什么颜色的树果呢？$

label: Route114_Text_LoveUsingBerryCrushShareBerry
source: I love using the BERRY CRUSH machine,\nso I'm collecting BERRIES.\pI'll share one with you, if you'd like.$
translation: 我喜欢玩树果粉碎，\n所以我收集了各种各样的树果。\p这个给你怎么样？$

label: Route114_Text_TryBerryCrushWithFriends
source: You should try the BERRY CRUSH\nmachine with your friends.$
translation: 我建议你和你的朋友\n一起玩树果粉碎。$

label: Route114_Text_FunToThinkAboutBerries
source: Which BERRY should be planted?\nShould you use or hoard BERRIES?\pIt's fun to think about.$
translation: 该种什么树果？得到的树果\n是使用还是收藏起来？\p考虑这些事情也是乐趣啊。$

label: Route120_Text_BerriesExpressionOfLoveIsntIt
source: BERRIES grow by soaking up sunlight.\pWe help the BERRIES grow by watering\nthem regularly.\pIt's an expression of love, isn't it?$
translation: 树果吸收了阳光，\n渐渐成长，\p而我们要经常给它们浇水，\n帮助它们长大。\p这大概就是爱的表现吧？$

label: Route120_Text_YesYouUnderstand
source: Yes, yes.\nYou understand what I mean.\pYou should take this.$
translation: 啊，没错，没错，\n看来你明白我说的话了。\p这个给你吧。$

label: Route120_Text_MakeYourOwnImpressions
source: Oh… But it is important to make your\nown impressions, I guess…\pYou can have this.$
translation: 啊......也对，有自己的想法\n才是最重要的......\p这个给你吧。$

label: Route120_Text_BerryIsRareRaiseItWithCare
source: I think that BERRY is rare.\nI hope you raise it with loving care.$
translation: 这可是个很少见的树果，\n希望你能用你的爱去照顾它成长。$

label: Route120_Text_IllGetMoreBerriesFromBerryMaster
source: I'll get more BERRIES from\nthe BERRY MASTER.$
translation: 我会从树果名人那儿\n得到更多树果。$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_BerrySuitsYou
source: When it gets right down to it…\pThe same way suits suit me perfectly,\na crisp breeze suits the sea.\pAnd you, a BERRY suits you to a “T”…\pWhy should that be so?$
translation: 要怎么说呢......\p就像我适合穿西装，\n海风适合在海边吹一样，\p你适合拥有树果......\p为什么呢？$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_BecauseYoureTrainer
source: When it gets right down to it…\pIt's because you're a TRAINER!$
translation: 要怎么说呢......\p就因为你是训练家！$

label: Route123_BerryMastersHouse_Text_YoureDeservingOfBerry
source: You may call me the BERRY MASTER.\pI dream of filling the world with\nbeautiful flowers, so I raise BERRIES\land hand them out to everyone.\pYou're deserving of one!$
translation: 你可以叫我树果名人。\p我始终梦想着让鲜花开满\n世界各地，所以我种植树果\l并把它们交托给遇见的每一个人。\p收下这个吧！$

label: Route123_BerryMastersHouse_Text_WhyBeStingyTakeAnother
source: Why be stingy?\nTake another!$
translation: 不用客气，\n这个也给你！$

label: Route123_BerryMastersHouse_Text_VisitPrettyPetalFlowerShop
source: Be sure to visit the PRETTY PETAL\nflower shop near RUSTBORO.\pLet flowers fill the world!$
translation: 记得一定要去卡那兹市附近的花店\n圣橙华看看。\p愿鲜花开满世界！$

label: Route123_BerryMastersHouse_Text_DoneForToday
source: I'm done for today.\nCome again another day.\pLet flowers fill the world!$
translation: 今天就这些了，\n以后再来吧。\p愿鲜花开满世界！$

label: Route123_BerryMastersHouse_Text_HeardAGoodSayingLately
source: The way my husband grows BERRIES,\noh, he's the best in the world.\pHe makes me proud, that he does.\pIncidentally, child, have you heard\na good saying lately?$
translation: 我家老头子是世界上\n最擅长种树果的人。\p呵呵，这是我最自豪的事情。\p话说回来，孩子，你听说过\n最近一句流行的谚语吗？$

label: Route123_BerryMastersHouse_Text_InspirationalTakeThis
source: Ah! What a remarkable saying!\nInspirational, it is!\pI want you to have this.$
translation: 啊！多棒的谚语！\n真令人感动！\p这个送给你吧。$

label: Route123_BerryMastersHouse_Text_GoodSayingTakeThis
source: Oh! A good saying it is.\nYou're quite remarkable.\pI want you to have this.$
translation: 啊！很好的谚语。\n真是了不起。\p这个送给你吧。$

label: Route123_BerryMastersHouse_Text_JoyNeverGoesOutOfMyLife
source: Our four grandchildren should become\nmore accomplished than my husband.\pJoy never goes out of my life!$
translation: 我们的四个孙子\n肯定会比老头子干得更好的。\p我的生活里始终都充满了快乐！$

label: Route123_BerryMastersHouse_Text_Ah
source: Ah…$

label: Route104_PrettyPetalFlowerShop_Text_ThisIsPrettyPetalFlowerShop
source: Hello!\pThis is the PRETTY PETAL flower shop.\nSpreading flowers all over the world!$
translation: 欢迎！\p这里是花店。\n我们的目标是让鲜花开满全世界！$

label: Route104_PrettyPetalFlowerShop_Text_LearnAboutBerries
source: {PLAYER}{KUN}, would you like to learn about\nBERRIES?$
translation: {PLAYER}{KUN}，\n想知道关于树果的事情吗？$

label: Route104_PrettyPetalFlowerShop_Text_IntroLearnAboutBerries
source: Your name is?\p{PLAYER}{KUN}.\nThat's a nice name.\p{PLAYER}{KUN}, would you like to learn about\nBERRIES?$
translation: 你的名字是？\p{PLAYER}{KUN}。\n好名字。\p{PLAYER}{KUN}，\n想知道关于树果的事情吗？$

label: Route104_PrettyPetalFlowerShop_Text_BerriesExplanation
source:
BERRIES grow on trees that thrive
only in soft, loamy soil.\pIf you take some BERRIES, be sure to
plant one in the loamy soil again.\pA planted BERRY will soon sprout,
grow into a plant, flower beautifully,\lthen grow BERRIES again.\pI want to see the whole wide world
filled with beautiful flowers.\lThat's my dream.\pPlease help me, {PLAYER}{KUN}. Plant BERRIES
and bring more flowers into the world.$
translation:
树果只有在松软的土壤中
才能健康生长。\p如果你摘了树果，
请记得在土壤中再种下一颗。\p种下的树果很快会发芽，
长出枝叶，开出美丽的花，\l最后又结出树果。\p真希望能看到整个世界
都布满了美丽的花啊。\l这可一直是我的梦想。\p来帮我们吧，{PLAYER}{KUN}，
多种些树果，\l让世界上开出更多鲜花吧。$

label: Route104_PrettyPetalFlowerShop_Text_FlowersBringHappiness
source: Flowers bring so much happiness to\npeople, don't they?$
translation: 鲜花会使人们得到幸福。$

label: Route104_PrettyPetalFlowerShop_Text_YouCanHaveThis
source: Hello!\pThe more attention you give to flowers,\nthe more beautifully they bloom.\pYou'll like tending flowers. I'm sure\nof it. You can have this.$
translation: 欢迎！\p你越是细心地照顾花朵，\n花朵就会绽放得越艳丽。\p看上去你很喜欢照顾花儿，\n这个送给你吧。$

label: Route104_PrettyPetalFlowerShop_Text_WailmerPailExplanation
source:
While BERRY plants are growing,
water them with the WAILMER PAIL.\pOh, another thing.\pIf you don't pick BERRIES for a while,
they'll drop off onto the ground.\lBut they'll sprout again.\pIsn't that awesome?
It's like they have the will to live.$
translation:
树果渐渐长大的时候，
就用吼吼鲸喷壶给它们浇水吧。\p啊，
对了，\p如果一段时间里你没摘下树果，
它们会掉进土里，\l不过很快它们又会发芽的。\p挺不错的吧？
就好像它们自己也盼望着成长一样。$

label: Route104_PrettyPetalFlowerShop_Text_ImGrowingFlowers
source: I'm trying to be like my big sisters.\nI'm growing flowers, too!\pHere you go!\nIt's for you!$
translation: 我正在向姐姐们学习种花，\n总有一天，我也会像她们那样优秀！\p给！这个送你！$

label: Route104_PrettyPetalFlowerShop_Text_MachineMixesBerries
source: You can plant a BERRY and grow it big,\nor you can make a POKéMON hold it.\pBut now they have a machine that mixes\nup different BERRIES and makes candies\lfor POKéMON.\pI want some candy, too.$
translation: 你可以把树果种到土里让它长大，\n也可以让宝可梦携带它，\p现在还有另一种选择，用一种特别的\n机器混合树果为宝可梦制作糖果。\p我也想要些糖果啊。$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_NameIsKiriHaveOneOfThese
source: Hi, what's your name?\p… … …  … … …  … … …\nOkay. That's nice!\pMy name is KIRI.\pMy mommy and daddy named me that so\nI would grow healthy and warmhearted.\lThat's what they wished.\pYou can have one of these.$
translation: 你叫什么名字啊？\p...... ...... ...... ...... ......\n嗯，真是个好名字\p我叫小桐。\p爸爸妈妈希望我健康长大且热心\n助人，所以给我起了这个名字。\p这个给你一个吧。$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_GiveYouThisBerryToo
source: KIRI will give you this BERRY, too!\nI really like it lots!$
translation: 小桐也会给你这种树果的！\n我真的很喜欢它！$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_WhatKindOfWishInYourName
source: I wonder what kind of wish is included\nin your name.$
translation: 你的名字里\n会包含了什么样的期望呢？$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_LikeSeasonBornIn
source: Spring, summer, autumn, and winter.\pIf you're born in springtime, do you like\nthe spring, and if you're born in the\lsummer, do you like the summer?$
translation: 春，夏，秋，冬......\p春天出生的人喜欢春天\n冬天出生的人喜欢冬天吗？$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_ThenILoveAutumn
source: Then KIRI was born in the autumn,\nso I love the autumn!\pWhich season do you like?$
translation: 那么，小桐是秋天出生的，\n所以一定喜欢秋天！\p你喜欢什么季节？$

label: gText_Birch_Welcome
source: Hi! Sorry to keep you waiting!\pWelcome to the world of POKéMON!\pMy name is BIRCH.\pBut everyone calls me the POKéMON\nPROFESSOR.\p$
translation: 哎呀--让你久等啦！\p欢迎来到宝可梦的世界！\p我的名字是小田卷。\p不过大家都叫我\n宝可梦博士。\p$

label: gText_Birch_MainSpeech
source:
This world is widely inhabited by
creatures known as POKéMON.\pWe humans live alongside POKéMON,
at times as friendly playmates, and\lat times as cooperative workmates.\pAnd sometimes, we band together
and battle others like us.\pBut despite our closeness, we don't
know everything about POKéMON.\pIn fact, there are many, many
secrets surrounding POKéMON.\pTo unravel POKéMON mysteries,
I've been undertaking research.\lThat's what I do.\p$
translation:
这个世界上叫做宝可梦的
生物随处可见。\p人们和宝可梦友好相处、共同生活，
有时作为玩伴一起玩耍，\l有时作为同伴协力工作。\p也有时候，我们指挥宝可梦并肩而战，
与其他人彼此对战切磋。\p尽管如此亲密，
我们仍未了解宝可梦的一切。\p事实上，宝可梦身上的秘密
依然数不胜数！\p为了揭开宝可梦的秘密，
我倾注了毕生心血进行研究。\l这就是我一直在做的事。\p$

label: gText_Birch_AndYouAre
source: And you are?$

label: gText_Birch_BoyOrGirl
source: Are you a boy?\nOr are you a girl?$
translation: 男孩？\n还是女孩？$

label: gText_Birch_WhatsYourName
source: All right.\nWhat's your name?$
translation: 好的。\n能告诉我你的名字吗？$

label: gText_Birch_SoItsPlayer
source: So it's {PLAYER}{KUN}?$
translation: 是{PLAYER}{KUN}吗？$

label: gText_Birch_YourePlayer
source: Ah, okay!\pYou're {PLAYER}{KUN} who's moving to my\nhometown of LITTLEROOT.\lI get it now!\p$
translation: ......原来如此！\p你就是即将搬到\n未白镇来的{PLAYER}{KUN}啊！\l我知道了！\p$

label: gText_Birch_AreYouReady
source:
All right, are you ready?\pYour very own adventure is about
to unfold.\pTake courage, and leap into the
world of POKéMON where dreams,\ladventure, and friendships await!\pWell, I'll be expecting you later.
Come see me in my POKéMON LAB.\p$
translation:
好，准备好了吗？\p只属于你的冒险
即将展开！\p鼓起勇气，迈进充满梦想、冒险与
邂逅的宝可梦世界吧！\p之后在研究所见吧！
我在那里等着你！\p$

label: BerryBlender_Text_BlendWithTheBlendMaster
source: BLEND MASTER: Indeed I am!\nThe BLEND MASTER am I!\pBlend with me, and you shall witness\nthe mastery I bring to blending!$
translation: 混合名人：没错！\n我就是传说中的混合名人！\p与我共舞吧，你将亲眼见证\n我登峰造极的混合技艺！$

label: BerryBlender_Text_SeeMyMasteryInAction
source: BLEND MASTER: Hmmm! So, you wish to\nsee my mastery in action?$
translation: 混合名人：嗯！你想亲眼\n见识我的独门技艺？$

label: BerryBlender_Text_TooBusyNowIsee
source: Hmmm!\pSo, you are too busy now, I see!\pBut fear not!\nI shall be here all day!\lHurry back from your errand!$
translation: 嗯！\p看来你现在很忙啊！\p不过别担心！\n我会在这里待一整天！\l快去快回吧！$

label: BerryBlender_Text_BlendMasterNoBerries
source: Hmmm!\pYou haven't got a single BERRY!\pI shall be here all day!\nHurry back with some BERRIES!$
translation: 嗯！\p你连一颗树果都没有！\p我会在这里待一整天！\n快去摘些树果回来！$

label: BerryBlender_Text_BlendMasterExplainBerryBlending
source: Hmmm!\pAh, but it is a simple process!\pWhen the BLENDER's arrow comes to\nyour marker, just press the A Button.\pThat's all you have to do.\pWhen you see how precisely I press\nthe A Button, you will understand.$
translation: 嗯！\p其实过程很简单！\p当混合器的箭头转到\n你的标记时，按下A键就行。\p就这么简单。\p等你见识到我精准按下A键的功力，\n就会明白其中奥妙了。$

label: BerryBlender_Text_BlendMasterLetsBerryBlender
source: Fine!\pLet's get started, then!\pAll together with the BLEND MASTER,\nlet's BERRY BLENDER!$
translation: 很好！\p那我们就开始吧！\p与混合名人一起，\n开始树果混合吧！$

label: BerryBlender_Text_WickedlyFast
source: Wickedly fast!$
translation: 真是快得惊人！$

label: BerryBlender_Text_WhatAnExpert
source: What an expert!$
translation: 真是专家啊！$

label: BerryBlender_Text_QualitiesOfBlendMaster
source:
Eyes that track the arrow with
machinelike intensity…\pA hand that taps the A Button
with clockwork-like precision…\pPossessing these qualities makes
the BLEND MASTER truly great.$
translation: 如机器般精准追踪箭头的双眼......\p如钟表般精确按下A键的巧手......\p拥有这些特质，\n才成就了真正的混合名人。$

label: BerryBlender_Text_MasterWorksOnSkillsInMountains
source: The BLEND MASTER's supposed to work\non his skills deep in the mountains.\pSometimes, he comes to LILYCOVE\nto blend BERRIES all day long.$
translation: 据说混合名人常年在深山中\n磨练他的技艺。\p有时他会来到水静市，\n混合树果一整天。$

“POKéMON JUMP”\pMake your POKéMON skip the VINE WHIP
rope with the A Button.\pOnly mini POKéMON around 28 inches
or less may participate.\pPOKéMON that only swim, burrow,
or fly are not good at jumping.\pAs a result, those POKéMON may not

也无法参加。\p如果大家都及时跳起，
会有好事情发生。$
