label: CableClub_Text_ExplainBattleModes
source:
There are three Battle Modes.\pSINGLE BATTLE is for two TRAINERS
with one or more POKéMON each.\pEach TRAINER can have one POKéMON
in battle at a time.\pDOUBLE BATTLE is for two TRAINERS
with two or more POKéMON each.\pEach TRAINER will send out two
POKéMON in battle at a time.\pMULTI BATTLE is for four TRAINERS
with one or more POKéMON each.\pEach TRAINER can have one POKéMON
in battle at a time.$
translation:
一共有3种不同的对战模式。\p单打模式中每位选手
至少带上1只宝可梦。\p对战开始时每位选手同时派出
1只宝可梦。\p双打模式中2位选手各自
至少带上2只宝可梦。\p对战开始时2位选手同时派出
2只宝可梦。\p混战模式中4位选手各自
至少带上1只宝可梦。\p对战开始时每位选手
同时派出1只宝可梦。$

label: CableClub_Text_ChooseGroupLeaderOfTwo
source: Please decide which of you two\nwill become the LEADER.\pThe other player must then choose\n“JOIN GROUP.”$
translation: 请协商并选出一人\n做群组的组长。\p其他人请选择"加入群组。"$

label: CableClub_Text_ChooseGroupLeaderOfFour
source: Please decide which of you four\nwill become the GROUP LEADER.\pThe other players must then choose\n“JOIN GROUP.”$
translation: 请协商并选出一人\n做群组的组长。\p其他人请选择"加入群组。"$

label: CableClub_Text_ChooseGroupLeader
source: Please decide which of you will\nbecome the GROUP LEADER.\pThe other players must then choose\n“JOIN GROUP.”$
translation: 请协商并选出一人\n做群组的组长。\p其他人请选择"加入群组。"$

label: CableClub_Text_WelcomeUnionRoomEnter
source: Welcome to the POKéMON WIRELESS\nCLUB UNION ROOM.\pYou may interact directly with\nother TRAINERS here, some of\lwhom you may not even know.\pWould you like to enter the ROOM?$
translation: 欢迎来到宝可梦无线连接俱乐部\n联盟交谊厅。\p在这里你可以直接与\n其他训练家互动，\l甚至包括一些您不认识的人。\p要进入房间吗？$

label: CableClub_Text_UnionRoomInfo
source:
The TRAINERS in the UNION ROOM
will be those players around you\lwho have also entered the ROOM.\pYou may do all sorts of things
here, such as exchanging greetings.\pYou may enter two POKéMON up to
Lv. 30 for a one-on-one battle.\pYou may take part in a chat with
two to five people.\pOr, you may register a POKéMON for
trade.\pWould you like to enter the ROOM?$
translation:
联盟交谊厅的训练家都是在您周围
并且也进入了联盟交谊厅的玩家。\p你可以在这里做各种事情，
比如互相问候。\p您可以拿出2只等级30的
宝可梦进行1对1的对战。\p您也可以和2到5个人
在这里进行聊天。\p或者您也可以登记宝可梦
进行交换。\p要进入房间吗？$

label: CableClub_Text_EnjoyUnionRoom
source: I hope you enjoy your time in\nthe UNION ROOM.$
translation: 希望您能在联盟交谊厅\n度过愉快的时光。$

label: CableClub_Text_FirstTimeRightThisWay
source:
Hello!
My name is TEALA.\pThis must be your first time
up here.\pI'll show you how the Wireless
Communication System works.\pFirst, I need to show you this
floor of our POKéMON CENTER.\pRight this way, please.$
translation:
您好！
我是青名。\p您应该是第一次
到这里来吧。\p由我来向您介绍无线连接系统
的使用方法吧。\p首先需要带您参观一下
宝可梦中心的这一层。\p这边请。$

label: CableClub_Text_ExplainWirelessClubFirstTime
source:
On the top floor, there are two
rooms.\pFirst, the room on the left.
It's the UNION ROOM.\pYou may link up with TRAINERS
around you who have also entered\lthe UNION ROOM.\pWith them, you may do things like
chat, battle, and trade.\pSecond, the room on the right is
the DIRECT CORNER.\pYou may trade or battle POKéMON
with your friends in this room.\pIf the Wireless Adapter isn't
connected, you may still link up\lusing a GBA Game Link cable.\pIf that is the case, you must go
to the DIRECT CORNER.\pI hope you enjoy the Wireless 
Communication System.$
translation:
在这层有2个房间。\p首先是左边的房间，
这是联盟交谊厅。\p您能够和那些在您周围并且也进入
该房间的训练家进行连接。\p您可以和他们一起进行
聊天、对战或交换。\p其次是右边的房间，
叫做直接连接室。\p您可以和他们进行
交换或对战。\p如果无线适配器没有连接，
您仍然可以使用GBA连接线进行连接。\p这种情况下，
您就需要进入直接连接室。\p希望您能享受无线连接系统
的乐趣。$

label: CableClub_Text_AskAboutLinking
source: Hello, {PLAYER}!\pIt's me, TEALA, the POKéMON\nCENTER 2F attendant.\pIs there something you needed to\nask me about linking?$
translation: 您好，{PLAYER}！\p我是青名，\n宝可梦中心2楼的服务员。\p您想了解关于\n连接的事情吗？$

label: CableClub_Text_HopeYouEnjoyWirelessSystem
source: I hope you enjoy the Wireless\nCommunication System.$
translation: 希望您能享受\n无线连接系统的乐趣。$

label: Text_PictureBookShelf
source: There's a set of POKéMON picture books.$
translation: 一套宝可梦画册。$

label: Text_BookShelf
source: It's filled with all sorts of books.$
translation: 装满了各种各样的书。$

label: Text_PokemonCenterBookShelf
source: POKéMON magazines!\nPOKéMON PAL…\pPOKéMON HANDBOOK…\nADORABLE POKéMON…$
translation: 是宝可梦杂志！\n宝可梦伙伴......\p宝可梦手册......\n可爱的宝可梦......$

label: Text_Vase
source: This vase looks expensive…\nPeered inside…\pBut, it was empty.$
translation: 花瓶看上去很昂贵......\n偷偷看了看里面......\p可惜，是空的。$

label: Text_EmptyTrashCan
source: It's empty.$
translation: 空的。$

label: Text_ShopShelf
source: The shelves brim with all sorts of\nPOKéMON merchandise.$
translation: 架子上满满的\n全是宝可梦商品。$

label: Text_Blueprint
source: A blueprint of some sort?\nIt's too complicated!$
translation: 是什么的设计图吗？\n好复杂！$

label: EventTicket_Text_ShowOldSeaMap
source: The ferry to SLATEPORT is…\pI beg your pardon?\nCan we sail to this place on the map?\pI know someone who will help you better.\nPlease wait.$
translation: 去凯那市的渡轮......\p嗯？什么？\n要去地图上的这个地方吗？\p我认得一个人，\n也许能帮上你。请稍等。$

label: EventTicket_Text_ThatPass
source: The ferry to SLATEPORT is…\pOh?\nThat PASS…$
translation: 去凯那市的渡轮......\p哦？\n那张船票......$

label: EventTicket_Text_ShowEonTicket
source:
Aye, mate, are you the one who brought
that mighty odd PASS?\pI'll tell you, you're trying to reach a
tiny spit of an island far in the south.\pThere's no telling what we'll encounter
once we reach there, aye.\lThat shivers my timbers!\pAll aboard!$
translation:
嘿，伙计，拿着那张
奇怪的船票的人就是你吗？\p我说，那可是南方
非常远的一个小岛，\p而且谁也不知道到那儿之后
会碰上什么东西，\l想想就激动啊！\p上船了！$

label: EventTicket_Text_SouthernIslandSailBack
source: Aye, mate, there's nothing here to\nsee or do on this forgettable island.\pWhat say we sail back to OLIVINE?$
translation: 嘿，伙计，看来这根本是个\n没什么探索价值的荒凉的岛，\p回水静市去怎么样？$

label: EventTicket_Text_SouthernIslandSailBack
source: Aye, mate, there's nothing here to\nsee or do on this forgettable island.\pWhat say we sail back to LILYCOVE?$
translation: 嘿，伙计，看来这根本是个\n没什么探索价值的荒凉的岛，\p回水静市去怎么样？$

label: EventTicket_Text_SailHome
source: Aye, right, then!\nSail home we will!$
translation: 好的！出海，回家去了！$

label: EventTicket_Text_AsYouLike
source: Aye, right, as you like, then.$
translation: 好的，你随意吧。$

label: SouthernIsland_Interior_Text_Sign
source: “All dreams are but another reality.\nNever forget…”$
translation: "所有的梦境都只是另一个现实。\n永远不要忘记......"$

label: SouthernIsland_Exterior_Text_Sign
source: “Those whose memories fade seek to\ncarve them in their hearts…”$
translation: "那些似已逝去的记忆，\n人们会将其镌刻在心的最深处......"$

label: EventTicket_Text_OldSeaMapTooFar
source:
What's up, youngster?\pWhat, it's you who's supposed to have
a tattered old map?\pLet's have a look.
… … … … … …\pBoy, this is quite a ways away.
I'm afraid I can't help you…$
translation:
你说什么，年轻人？\p什么，就是你拥有
破烂的古老地图？\p让我看看。
...... ...... ......\p好家伙......这简直是遥不可及。
我恐怕帮不了你......$

label: EventTicket_Text_BrineyHoldOnASecond
source: BRINEY: Hold on a second!\pWhat's the idea of turning down\nsomeone that I owe so much to?$
translation: 哈奇：喂！\p竟敢拒绝我恩人的请求\n这叫怎么一回事儿啊！$

label: EventTicket_Text_BrineyLetsSail
source: {PLAYER}{KUN}, I'm terribly sorry.\pYou came to me seeking my help,\nand we almost turned you away.\pWell, let me make things right.\pWe'll sail right away, of course!\pLet's find this island on\nthis OLD SEA MAP!$
translation:
{PLAYER}{KUN}，真不好意思。\p你特意来这找我帮忙，
可是我们差点把你拒之门外。\p让我来弥补
这个错误吧。\p我们这就启航！\p让我们去找古航海图
上的小岛吧！$

label: EventTicket_Text_OddTicketGetOnBoard
source:
Is it you who brought that odd
ticket?\pWhere you're trying to go is an island
that's far, far away.\pNo one knows what awaits there…\pThe very thought excites my blood
as a sailing man!\pGet on board, youngster!$
translation: 你带着船票了吗？\p你要去的小岛在\n很远很远的地方。\p没人知道那里会有什么等着我们......\p光是想想就让我这个老水手\n热血沸腾！\p上船吧，年轻人！$

label: EventTicket_Text_OddTicketsWhereTo
source:
Is it you who brought those
odd tickets?\p… … …Hm.\pThese tickets will get you to islands
that are far, far away.\pNo one knows what awaits there,
or what may happen there.\pThe very thought excites my blood
as a sailing man!\pGet on board, youngster!
Where shall we sail first?$
translation:
你带着船票了吗？\p...... ......唔。\p这些船票能带你去往
很远很远的小岛。\p没人知道那里会有什么等着我们，
抑或是可能会发生什么。\p光是想想就让我这个老水手
热血沸腾！\p上船吧，年轻人！
我们先去哪？$

label: NavelRock_Harbor_Text_SailorReturn
source: Did… Did you hear that?\nThat low growling from deep in there.\pAre you sure it's safe?\nDo you think we should leave?$
translation: 你听......听到了吗？\n从深处传出的低吼。\p你确定这里安全吗？\n我们要不要离开这儿？$

label: FarawayIsland_Entrance_Text_Sign
source: The writing is fading as if it was\nwritten a long time ago…\p“…ber, 6th day\nIf any human…sets foot here…\lagain…et it be a kindhearted pers…\l…ith that hope, I depar…”$
translation: 字迹已经模糊不清\n仿佛已经写了很久很久了......\p"......月6日\n在踏进这里的......类面前\l再次......身的话\l希望他心地......良\l在......里写下这样的愿望后\l我离开了这个......\l\l......士"$

label: FarawayIsland_Interior_Text_Mew
source: Myuu…$

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_1F_Text_ComeBackTomorrow
source: Please come back tomorrow.$
translation: 请明天再来。$

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_1F_Text_PleaseVisitAgain
source: 欢迎再来。$
translation: 欢迎下次再来。$

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_1F_Text_TicketNumberIsXPleaseWait
source: The LOTO TICKET number is {STR_VAR_1}.\pI need to run a check on this number\nto see if it matches any of your\lPOKéMON's ID numbers. Please wait.$
translation: 彩票的号码是{STR_VAR_1}，\p我需要对照一下您的\n宝可梦的ID，请稍候。$

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_1F_Text_TicketMatchesPartyMon
source: Congratulations!\pThe ID number of your team's\n{STR_VAR_1} matches your\lLOTO TICKET's number!$
translation: 恭喜！\p您携带的{STR_VAR_1}的ID与\n彩票号码相同！$

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_1F_Text_TicketMatchesPCMon
source: Congratulations!\pThe ID number of your PC-boxed\n{STR_VAR_1} matches your\lLOTO TICKET's number!$
translation: 恭喜！\p您盒子里的{STR_VAR_1}的ID与\n彩票号码相同！$

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_1F_Text_NoNumbersMatched
source: I'm sorry.\nNone of the numbers matched.$
translation: 很遗憾，\n没有找到相符的号码。$

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_1F_Text_TwoDigitsMatched
source: Two digits matched, so you win the\nthird prize!\lYou've won the {STR_VAR_1}!$
translation: 有2个数字相同，\n恭喜您获得三等奖！\l奖品是{STR_VAR_1}！$

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_1F_Text_ThreeDigitsMatched
source: Three digits matched, so you win the\nsecond prize!\lYou've won the {STR_VAR_1}!$
translation: 有3个数字相同，\n恭喜您获得二等奖！\l奖品是{STR_VAR_1}！$

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_1F_Text_FourDigitsMatched
source: Four digits matched, so you win the\nfirst prize!\lYou've won the {STR_VAR_1}!$
translation: 有4个数字相同，\n恭喜您获得一等奖！\l奖品是{STR_VAR_1}！$

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_1F_Text_AllFiveDigitsMatched
source: Oh, my goodness, all five digits\nmatched!\pYou've won the jackpot prize!\nYou've won the {STR_VAR_1}!$
translation: 啊，天哪，5个数字\n完全相同！\p恭喜您获得特等奖！\n奖品是{STR_VAR_1}！$

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_1F_Text_NoRoomForThis
source: Oh?\nYou seem to have no room for this.\pPlease make room in your BAG and\nlet me know.$
translation: 哎？\n好像您没有放奖品的地方了，\p等您的包包里腾出空间之后，\n请再来找我。$

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_1F_Text_PleaseVisitAgain2
source: 欢迎再来。$
translation: 欢迎下次再来。$

label: MatchCall_WildBattleText1
source:
Hi! {PLAYER}{KUN}, hello!
This is {STR_VAR_1}.\pI saw this {STR_VAR_2} a while back
but I couldn't catch it.\pIt was so close, too!
Well, see you again!$
translation:
嗨！{PLAYER}{KUN}，你好！
我是{STR_VAR_1}。\p刚才我遇到了{STR_VAR_2}！
但是没能捉到它。\p就差一点点！
好了，下次见！$

label: MatchCall_WildBattleText2
source:
Hello, {PLAYER}{KUN}.
It's {STR_VAR_1}.\pI tried to catch a nice {STR_VAR_2}
a little while ago.\pBut, it got away.
I was sure disappointed!\pOkay, bye!$
translation:
你好，{PLAYER}{KUN}。
我是{STR_VAR_1}。\p不久前我试着捕捉一只
很棒的{STR_VAR_2}。\p但它还是跑掉了。
真的好失望啊！\p好了，再见！$

label: MatchCall_WildBattleText3
source:
Hey there, {PLAYER}!
It's me, {STR_VAR_1}.\pI just took a shot at catching
this {STR_VAR_2}, but it took off.\pI came oh so close, too!\pIt spoiled my day…
All right, see you!$
translation:
你好啊，{PLAYER}！
是我呀，{STR_VAR_1}。\p我刚才试着捕捉这只
{STR_VAR_2}，但是给它逃掉了。\p差一点就成功了！\p今天算是倒霉......
好了，下次见！$

label: MatchCall_WildBattleText4
source:
Hey, {PLAYER}{KUN}.
{STR_VAR_1} here.\pYou know the POKéMON {STR_VAR_2}?
I came close to getting one.\pIt was just a while back.
I thought I had it but it escaped.\pIf I see it again, I'll get it for
sure, though.\pOkay, catch you later.$
translation:
嗨，{PLAYER}{KUN}。
是我，{STR_VAR_1}。\p你知道宝可梦{STR_VAR_2}吗？
我差点就捕捉到一只。\p就在刚才，
我以为已经捕捉到了，\l但它还是跑了。\p如果再让我看见它，
一定要捕捉到！\p好，回头见。$

label: MatchCall_WildBattleText5
source: Hiya, {PLAYER}{KUN}!\nIt's {STR_VAR_1}.\lCatching any POKéMON lately?\pA little while ago I came close to\nnabbing one, but it got loose.\pRight, take care!$
translation: 你好，{PLAYER}{KUN}！\n我是{STR_VAR_1}。\l最近捕捉到什么宝可梦了吗？\p刚才我差一点捕捉到一只，\n但是它逃掉了。\p好，多保重！$

label: MatchCall_WildBattleText6
source: Hey, {PLAYER}{KUN}.\n{STR_VAR_1} here.\lCaught any POKéMON lately?\pI nearly nabbed one the other day.\nBut it evaded me somehow.\pYou take care.$
translation: 嘿，{PLAYER}{KUN}。\n我是{STR_VAR_1}。\l最近有捕捉到什么宝可梦吗？\p前几天我差点捕捉到了一只。\n但是不知怎么它跑掉了。\p多保重。$

label: MatchCall_WildBattleText7
source:
…Uh, {PLAYER}{KUN}?
It's me, {STR_VAR_1}.\pOh, wait! Wait!
I can catch this {STR_VAR_2}…\pAaarrrgh! It bolted loose!
That wasn't just close!$
translation:
......嗯，{PLAYER}{KUN}？
是我，{STR_VAR_1}。\p哦，等等！等等！
我能捕捉到这只{STR_VAR_2}......\p啊啊！给他逃了！
只差一点点啊！$

label: MatchCall_WildBattleText8
source:
Oh, {PLAYER}{KUN}, how do you do?
This is {STR_VAR_1} speaking.\pHave you had success catching
POKéMON lately?\pI came very close a little while
ago, but my target got free.\pI need to try harder!
See you again!$
translation:
哦，{PLAYER}{KUN}，最近如何？
我是{STR_VAR_1}。\p你捕捉宝可梦还顺利吗？\p不久前我差点抓到一只。
但目标还是逃掉了。\p我还得再加把劲啊！
下次见！$

label: MatchCall_WildBattleText9
source:
Oh, {PLAYER}{KUN}, hi there!
This is {STR_VAR_1}!\pSo? Are you getting more POKéMON
together?\pI'm having a rotten time of it!
They all get away from me!\pSee you!$
translation:
哦，{PLAYER}{KUN}，你好！
我是{STR_VAR_1}！\p怎么样？有捕捉到
更多宝可梦吗？\p我最近好倒霉，
它们全都逃走了！\p再见！$

label: MatchCall_WildBattleText10
source:
Oh, {PLAYER}{KUN}, hello…
This is {STR_VAR_1}.\pListen, I came within a whisker of
catching this {STR_VAR_2}…\pBut, it gave me the slip…\pI need to try harder.
See you around.$
translation:
哦，{PLAYER}{KUN}，你好......
我是{STR_VAR_1}。\p听着，我几乎马上就能捉到
这只{STR_VAR_2}了......\p但是，它还是溜掉了......\p我得再加把劲。
回头见。$

label: MatchCall_WildBattleText11
source: Ah, {PLAYER}{KUN}.\nThis is {STR_VAR_1}.\lHow are things with you?\pI tried to catch a wild {STR_VAR_2}\nearlier, but it managed to flee.\pI feel defeated…$
translation: 啊，{PLAYER}{KUN}。\n我是{STR_VAR_1}。\l最近怎么样？\p我刚才想捕捉只野生的{STR_VAR_2}，\n但是它成功逃走了。\p感觉好失败......$

label: MatchCall_WildBattleText12
source: Hello, {PLAYER}{KUN}.\nIt's me, {STR_VAR_1}.\lAre you still catching POKéMON?\pI've been trying to catch them\nmyself, but it's not so easy.\pThe way of POKéMON is deep!$
translation: 你好，{PLAYER}{KUN}。\n是我，{STR_VAR_1}。\l你还在捕捉宝可梦吗？\p我自己也在试着捕捉。\n但是真的好不容易呀。\p宝可梦的世界真是深奥啊！$

label: MatchCall_WildBattleText13
source: Ah, hello, {PLAYER}{KUN}!\nThis is {STR_VAR_1}!\lHave you been catching POKéMON?\pI've been trying to catch them\nmyself, but with little success.\pThe way of POKéMON is deep!$
translation: 啊，你好，{PLAYER}{KUN}！\n我是{STR_VAR_1}！\l你捕捉到宝可梦了吗？\p我自己也努力试着捕捉，\n但没什么成果。\p宝可梦的世界真是深奥啊！$

label: MatchCall_WildBattleText14
source:
Oh, hi, {PLAYER}{KUN}, how do you do?
This is {STR_VAR_1}.\pJust now, I tried to catch a cute
{STR_VAR_2}.\pIt got away, though!
Oh, you bet I was disappointed!\pBye-bye!$
translation:
哦嗨，{PLAYER}{KUN}，你好吗？
我是{STR_VAR_1}。\p刚才我试着捕捉一只可爱的
{STR_VAR_2}。\p但它还是逃走了！
哦，我真是失望极了！\p再见！$

label: MatchCall_WildBattleText15
source:
Hey, {PLAYER}!
This is {STR_VAR_1}!\pI've been thinking about trying
to catch me some POKéMON.\pBut I can't seem to find any.
It's a real puzzler for me!\pI'm at my wit's end!
See you around!$
translation:
嘿，{PLAYER}！
我是{STR_VAR_1}！\p我正在考虑捕捉
一两只宝可梦。\p但一只都找不到。
这真是个难题啊！\p我完全想不到办法！
以后再见！$

label: MatchCall_NegativeBattleText1
source:
Hi! {PLAYER}{KUN}, hello!
This is {STR_VAR_1}.\pI tried battling another TRAINER,
but I lost.\pIt was really disappointing.
Well, see you again!$
translation:
嗨！{PLAYER}{KUN}，好啊！

......呃，{PLAYER}{KUN}？
是我{STR_VAR_1}......\l所以，你的宝可梦成长了吗？\p我的肯定变强了。
想给你看一看。\p我会在{STR_VAR_2}附近。
来找我对战吧。\p以后见。$

label: MatchCall_DifferentRouteBattleRequestText8
source:
Oh, {PLAYER}{KUN}, how do you do?
This is {STR_VAR_1} speaking.\pI hope you're doing well.
My POKéMON are very frisky.\pIf you're ever in the area, please
give me a rematch.\pI'll be around {STR_VAR_2}.
Until then, good-bye!$
translation:
哦，{PLAYER}{KUN}，你好吗？
我是{STR_VAR_1}。\p希望你一切都好。
我的宝可梦十分活跃。\p如果你在附近的话，
和我再对战一次吧。\p我就在{STR_VAR_2}。
不见不散，再见！$

label: MatchCall_DifferentRouteBattleRequestText9
source:
Oh, {PLAYER}{KUN}, hi there!
This is {STR_VAR_1}!\lHow are your POKéMON doing?\pMy POKéMON keep getting better.
I'd like to show you, {PLAYER}{KUN}.\pI'm around {STR_VAR_2} now,
so let's battle if you're close by.\pHope I see you soon!$
translation:
哦，{PLAYER}{KUN}，你好啊！
我是{STR_VAR_1}！\l你的宝可梦还好吗？\p我的宝可梦越来越强了。
想让你见识一下，{PLAYER}{KUN}。\p我现在就在{STR_VAR_2}这里，
如果你在附近的话，\l那么我们就来场对战吧。\p希望很快能见到你！$

label: MatchCall_DifferentRouteBattleRequestText10
source:
Oh, {PLAYER}{KUN}, hello…
This is {STR_VAR_1}.\lSo, how are things with you?\pMy POKéMON have grown much
stronger than before.\pI'd love another battle with you,
{PLAYER}{KUN}.\pI'll be around {STR_VAR_2}.
Come see me if you're close.$
translation:
哦，{PLAYER}{KUN}，你好......
我是{STR_VAR_1}。\l啊，最近还好吗？\p我的宝可梦可是比
以前要强得多了。\p我很想和你再对战一次，
{PLAYER}{KUN}。\p现在我在{STR_VAR_2}。
如果方便的话就来吧。$

label: MatchCall_DifferentRouteBattleRequestText11
source:
Ah, {PLAYER}{KUN}.
This is {STR_VAR_1}.\lWhere might you be now?\pMy POKéMON are full of life.
They appear to be looking forward\lto seeing your POKéMON, {PLAYER}{KUN}.\pI'm around {STR_VAR_2} now.
I hope you'll seek us out.$
translation:
啊，{PLAYER}{KUN}。
我是{STR_VAR_1}。\l你现在会在哪里呢？\p我的宝可梦现在充满活力。
它们好像很想再见一见\l你的宝可梦，{PLAYER}{KUN}。\p我现在就在{STR_VAR_2}这里。
希望你能来找我们。$

label: MatchCall_DifferentRouteBattleRequestText12
source:
Hello, {PLAYER}{KUN}.
It's me, {STR_VAR_1}.\pI should tell you, my POKéMON have
grown to be quite robust lately.\pI would like to see them in a battle
with you, {PLAYER}{KUN}.\pWe'll be around {STR_VAR_2}.
Come see us anytime!$
translation:
喂，{PLAYER}{KUN}。
是我，{STR_VAR_1}。\p我想告诉你，我的宝可梦已经
成长了很多很多。\p想看看它们和你对战的表现，
{PLAYER}{KUN}。\p我们会在{STR_VAR_2}附近。
随时欢迎来找我们！$

label: MatchCall_DifferentRouteBattleRequestText13
source:
Ah, hello, {PLAYER}{KUN}!
This is {STR_VAR_1}!\lAre your POKéMON keeping well?\pMy POKéMON have been so healthy,
they don't look capable of losing!\pI would surely love to have another
battle with you.\pIf you're near {STR_VAR_2},
do come see us.$
translation:
啊，你好，{PLAYER}{KUN}！
我是{STR_VAR_1}！\l你的宝可梦都好吗？\p我的宝可梦非常健康，
看起来不会输给你！\p我很想再和你对战一场。\p如果你在{STR_VAR_2}附近，
一定要来找我们。$

label: MatchCall_DifferentRouteBattleRequestText14
source:
Oh, hi, {PLAYER}{KUN}.
This is {STR_VAR_1}.\lKeeping well, I hope.\pOh, yes! My POKéMON are
much stronger than before.\pDon't you think we ought to have
a battle, {PLAYER}{KUN}?\pWe'll be waiting for you around
{STR_VAR_2}.\pCome see us anytime, okay?$
translation:
哦，好，{PLAYER}{KUN}。
我是{STR_VAR_1}。\l一切都好吧。\p哦，对了！我的宝可梦已经
比以前强大了不少。\p你不觉得我们应该
再战一场吗，{PLAYER}{KUN}？\p我会在{STR_VAR_2}
等着你的。\p随时来找我们，好吗？$

label: MatchCall_PersonalizedText1
source:
It's me, the mountain-loving
{STR_VAR_1}!\pWell, since we met, have you grown
to appreciate the mountains more?\pI rarely see you in the mountains…\pNext time, we'll meet somewhere
around {STR_VAR_2}.$
translation:
是我啊，热爱大山的
{STR_VAR_1}！\p那个，上次见过以后，你是不是
也开始喜欢群山了呢？\p我很少在山里看见你呀......\p下一次，让我们在
{STR_VAR_2}碰头吧。$

label: MatchCall_PersonalizedText2
source:
This is {STR_VAR_1}.
Hello.\pI was just telling a new TRAINER
about you.\pI told her about a strong TRAINER
who raises POKéMON with care.\pI hope you'll become a TRAINER
that everyone will admire.\pI hope we meet again!$
translation:
我是{STR_VAR_1}。
你好。\p我刚刚告诉了一个新人训练家
有关你的事。\p我告诉她有一个强大的训练家
用爱心培育他的宝可梦。\p我希望你能成为一个
人人称赞的训练家。\p希望能再见到你！$

label: MatchCall_PersonalizedText3
source: Hello! It's {STR_VAR_1}.\pI love where I am now.\nIt's pleasant with sweet aromas!\pI think someone planted BERRIES,\nand they burst into bloom.\pSee you again sometime!$
translation: 你好！我是{STR_VAR_1}。\p我爱上我所在的地方了。\n多么怡人的芳香！\p我想有人种下了些树果，\n它们正在开花。\p再见！$

label: MatchCall_PersonalizedText4
source:
Hello! Thirty years of exploration,
{STR_VAR_1} at your service!\pIt seems that you're energetically
traveling here and there.\pHave you discovered any new ruins?
Please tell if you have!\pNow, if you'll excuse me,
I have ruins to explore.$
translation:
你好！具有30年经验的探险家，
{STR_VAR_1}为你服务！\p看上去你正在充满干劲的
走东闯西呢。\p你发现了什么新的遗迹吗？
如果有的话要告诉我！\p现在恕我失陪，
我还要去探索遗迹。$

label: MatchCall_PersonalizedText5
source: It's {STR_VAR_1}!\pKnow what I'm doing today?\nLooking at waves from the beach!\pSigh… The waves are all sparkly.\nThe sea is the prettiest from here.\lI'm getting hungry, so bye-bye!$
translation: 我是{STR_VAR_1}！\p知道我正在做什么吗？\n我正在海边看海浪！\p啊......海浪闪闪发光。\n这里真是看海的好地方啊。\l我有点饿了，再见了！$

label: MatchCall_PersonalizedText6
source: Munch-chew…\nOh, hi, it's {STR_VAR_1}.\lI love eating on the beach.\pMy POKéMON and I have been doing\ngreat. We're fully fueled!\lI'm going for a swim. Bye!$
translation: 嗯嗯......\n哦，嗨，我是{STR_VAR_1}。\l我喜欢在海滩上吃东西。\p我的宝可梦和我都好得很。\n我们充满活力！\l我要去游个泳了。再见！$

label: MatchCall_PersonalizedText7
source:
Hello, this is {STR_VAR_1}…\pI've grown a little jaded with this
whole COOLTRAINER thing…\pEveryone thinks I'm a perfect
TRAINER, and that makes me try to\llive up to that expectation.\pBut I guess that goes with being
a COOLTRAINER.\pI'll just have to buckle down…
and grin and bear it.\pYou're the only person that I could
confide in like this.\pBut when I see you next,
don't worry, I won't whine!$
translation:
你好，我是{STR_VAR_1}......\p最近对"精英训练家"这个
头衔有点厌倦了......\p每个人都认为我是完美的训练家，
因此我不得不按照别人期望而活。\p不过这可能就是精英训练家
的宿命吧。\p我得继续咬牙坚持......
微笑着承受一切。\p这些话我只
对你一个人说。\p但下次见面时别担心，
我不会抱怨的！$

label: MatchCall_PersonalizedText8
source:
Yahoo, it's {STR_VAR_1}!
How do you do?\pI've been raising my POKéMON with
you as the target.\pI don't intend to lose when we
battle again.\pIsn't it great to have TRAINER
friends? Let's meet again!$
translation:
哟吼，我是{STR_VAR_1}！
你好吗？\p我现在正在训练我的宝可梦，
你是我的目标哦。\p下次遇见你的时候
我不会再输了。\p有个训练家朋友可真好啊！
再见啦！$

label: MatchCall_PersonalizedText9
source:
It's {STR_VAR_1}…
Right now, behind you…\lWasn't there something…?\pThe power of the POKéMON that
sleep here at MT. PYRE…\pIt's telling me about you…\pYou should walk away quickly and
never once look back…\pGiggle…
Farewell…$
translation:
我是{STR_VAR_1}......
现在，在你的身后......\l不觉得那里有东西吗......？\p那是沉睡在送神山的
宝可梦之大能......\p它正向我诉说你的一切......\p赶快离开这里，
而且千万不要回头......\p嘻嘻......
再见......$

label: MatchCall_PersonalizedText10
source:
This is {STR_VAR_1}.
How do you do?\pIsn't it convenient that we can
chat like this at a distance?\pBefore, if I wanted to speak with
anyone, I had to have my father\ldrive me…\pI should be going now.
I'm glad we had this chat.$
translation:
我是{STR_VAR_1}。
最近好吗？\p能够远距离通话
真是方便呢！\p之前如果我想和谁聊聊的话，
只能叫我爸开车载我去......\p差不多该挂啦。
很高兴和你聊天。$

label: MatchCall_PersonalizedText11
source:
It's {STR_VAR_1}!
Will you listen to this?\pI like the SAFARI ZONE a lot,
but whenever I go, I get lost!\pAll that tall grass!
And it's much too spread out!\pI feel better getting that off
my chest!\pI'm off to the SAFARI ZONE again!
Catch you!$
translation:
我是{STR_VAR_1}！
听我说个事！\p我很喜欢狩猎地带，
但每次去都会迷路！\p到处是高高的杂草！
而且地方也太大了！\p说出来舒服多啦！\p我要再次向狩猎地带出发了！
回见！$

label: MatchCall_PersonalizedText12
source:
Hello, {STR_VAR_1} here.
Yes, correct, I am rich, yes.\pI should tell you, my wealth has
grown since we last met.\pWhat's more, my POKéMON have also
grown stronger.\pI can't shake the feeling that
this world exists for me!\pOh, no need to say a word!
Everyone knows it's true!\pOh, you must excuse me, I have this
formal dinner to attend.$
translation:
你好，是我{STR_VAR_1}。
嗯，没错，我还是那么有钱。\p我要告诉你，我的财富在上次
见面后又增加了不少。\p而且，我的宝可梦
也变得更强了。\p我不得不开始怀疑
地球是围着我转的！\p哦，无需多言！
事实就在眼前！\p哦，抱歉要先失陪了，我得去
参加一场重要的晚宴了。$

label: MatchCall_PersonalizedText13
source:
Ufufufufu…
It's me, {STR_VAR_1}…\pCan you guess what I'm seeing?
A pair of {STR_VAR_2} in a battle.\pMaybe I'll try catching the winner…
Ufufufufufu…\pI… I'm kind of busy now.
I have to go.$
translation:
呼呼呼......
是我，{STR_VAR_1}......\p能猜到我在看什么吗？
一对{STR_VAR_2}正在打架。\p也许我应把胜利者捕捉了......
呼呼呼......\p我......要去忙了。
我走了。$

label: MatchCall_PersonalizedText14
source:
Oh, it's {STR_VAR_1}!\pI was just thinking I'm getting
bored of the ABANDONED SHIP.\pBut since I'm already here,
and I want to beat you once,\lI'll be sticking around a bit more.\pIf you feel compelled, why don't
you come see me?\pI think today will be the day that
I finally challenge the man next\ldoor to a match.\pBe seeing you!$
translation:
哦，我是{STR_VAR_1}！\p我已经开始觉得呆在被
遗弃的海船里有些无聊了。\p但既然我来了，
而且还想赢你一次，\l那就再多呆一会吧。\p有兴趣的话，
不妨来找我？\p我想今天终于可以和
隔壁的大叔来场对战了。\p再见！$

label: MatchCall_PersonalizedText15
source:
I'm {STR_VAR_1}!
The man of the sea!\pYou know what I think?\pThe TRAINERS out at sea are
the toughest of the tough!\pYou should learn from me and train
in the sea…\pWhoops, giant surf rising!\pIt's a great training opportunity!
Sorry, but I have to go!$
translation:
我是{STR_VAR_1}！
大海的男儿！\p你知道我在想啥吗？\p从大海中来的训练家
才是强者中的强者呀！\p你应该向我学着
在大海中修炼......\p哦哦，有巨浪涌起！\p这是多么好的训练机会啊！
抱歉，我先闪了！$

label: MatchCall_PersonalizedText16
source:
It's {STR_VAR_1}! Listen, I've been
teaching karate to my POKéMON.\pBut now they're better than me!
I've done nothing but lose to them!\pBut even though I may lose to
POKéMON, I won't lose to another\lTRAINER, no sir!\pWe have to battle again!
Ugwaah!$
translation:
在下是{STR_VAR_1}！
听着，我一直在传授空手道\l给我的宝可梦。\p它们现在已经比我厉害了！
我一直在输给它们！\p但就算输给了宝可梦，
我也绝不会输给训练家的！\p我们再战一场吧！
呜哇！$

label: MatchCall_PersonalizedText17
source:
It's me, {STR_VAR_1}.
How're your travels unwinding?\p…Whoa, is that right?
Sounds awfully stimulating!\pI think I could write a song about
one of your episodes.\p…Oh, hey, I'm feeling it.
I hear the riffs in my head.\pI'd better get this tune properly
written, so I've got to fly! Later!$
translation:
是我，{STR_VAR_1}。
旅行还顺利吗？\p......哇，真的？
听起来超刺激啊！\p我想我都能把你
的故事写成歌了。\p......哦，灵感来了。
我的脑海里已经有旋律了。\p我得赶紧把曲子记下来，
嗯，得走了！下次见！$

label: MatchCall_PersonalizedText18
source: This is {STR_VAR_1}…\nHear my new song.\pLalala, {STR_VAR_2}, {STR_VAR_2}!\nWhy are you that {STR_VAR_2}?\lWhy can't I be you, {STR_VAR_2}?\lLala, {STR_VAR_2} and {STR_VAR_1},\l{STR_VAR_1} and {STR_VAR_2}…\pRepeat chorus, fade…$
translation: 我是{STR_VAR_1}......\n听听我的新歌吧。\p啦啦啦，{STR_VAR_2}，{STR_VAR_2}！\n为什么你是{STR_VAR_2}？\l为什么我不能成为你，{STR_VAR_2}？\l啦啦，{STR_VAR_2}和{STR_VAR_1}，\l{STR_VAR_1}和{STR_VAR_2}......\p重复副歌，淡出......$

label: MatchCall_PersonalizedText19
source:
I'm {STR_VAR_1}, you know,
the camping expert!\pWhen we battled, I couldn't help
but lose to you.\pAfter all, my expertise is in
camping.\pBut win or lose, I like to battle
when I'm camping.\pBattle with us again, okay?
Oh, and let's go camping, too!$
translation:
我是{STR_VAR_1}，你知道的，
野营专家！\p上次对战输给你很正常。\p毕竟我的专长是露营。\p无论结果如何，
我都喜欢在露营时对战。\p再来对战吧，怎么样？
一起去露营也行哦！$

label: MatchCall_PersonalizedText20
source:
It's me, me, {STR_VAR_1}!\pI'd like to climb other mountains
than this one, to be honest.\pBut I'm not sure if there'd be any
ladies like on MT. CHIMNEY.\pIf you know any other mountain
with ladies around, let me know!\pEhehehe, see you around!$
translation: 是我呀，我，{STR_VAR_1}！\p说实话，我想去爬其他的山。\p但是我不确定其他山的美女\n会不会像烟囱山里的一样多。\p如果你知道哪座山美女\n多的话，记得告诉我！\p哎嘿嘿，回见啦！$

label: MatchCall_PersonalizedText21
source: … … … … … …\n… … … … … …\lIt's {STR_VAR_1}…\p… … … … … …\n… … … … … …\lThat's all today…$

label: MatchCall_PersonalizedText22
source:
This is {STR_VAR_1}. Today, I had
this feeling I would chat with you.\pMy desire to defeat you builds
by day and by night.\pYou have a rival like that, yes?
I wish it were me…\pI'm glad you heard me out.
See you!$
translation:
我是{STR_VAR_1}。
今天有预感会和你通话。\p想打败你的心情与日俱增。\p你也有这样的劲敌吧？
希望那个人是我......\p很高兴你能听我说这些。
再见！$

label: MatchCall_PersonalizedText23
source:
It's {STR_VAR_1}.\pWhen there's a strong TRAINER
nearby, I can sometimes sense that\lsomehow.\pDid you pass close by, {PLAYER}{KUN}?
Maybe it was you.\pI'll be waiting for your visit.
Bye!$
translation:
我是{STR_VAR_1}。\p附近有强大训练家时，
我总能感应到。\p刚才是你经过吗，{PLAYER}{KUN}？
说不定就是你呢。\p期待你的来访。
再见！$

label: MatchCall_PersonalizedText24
source:
Hello, this is {STR_VAR_1}.
You sound well, {PLAYER}{KUN}.\pI've traveled around the world,
but I must say I've taken a great\lshine to this region.\pI plan to stay here a while.
Perhaps we can meet again?\pI've not forgotten your dazzling
techniques.\pI do hope for a rematch.$
translation:
你好，我是{STR_VAR_1}。
听起来你还不错，{PLAYER}{KUN}。\p虽然周游了世界，
但我特别喜欢这个地区。\p我打算多待一阵子。
也许我们应该再见一见？\p我还记得你精彩的对战技巧。\p我真的希望能再切磋一次。$

label: MatchCall_PersonalizedText25
source:
Snivel… It's… {STR_VAR_1}…
…Sob…\pROXANNE chewed me out in class
today.\pBut I don't dislike her or anything.\pROXANNE tells me exactly what
I did wrong so I can learn from it.\pYou bet I'll be going to
the TRAINER'S SCHOOL tomorrow!\pSee you later!$
translation:
呜咽......我是......{STR_VAR_1}......
......吸......\p今天在课上被杜娟训了。\p但是我并讨厌她。\p杜娟直接指出了我的错误，
这样我能吃一堑长一智。\p明天我绝对还要去
训练师学校！\p回头见！$

label: MatchCall_PersonalizedText26
source:
It's {STR_VAR_1}!\pROXANNE let me battle with her
yesterday.\pThe results…
Terrible, like you needed to ask.\pBut I was delighted that ROXANNE
would even let me challenge her!\pYou wouldn't believe how much
more I admire her!\pI'm going to really focus and work!
I'd better go!$
translation: 我是{STR_VAR_1}！\p昨天，杜娟答应和我对战了。\p结果吗......\n不用问也知道很惨。\p但能挑战她我就超开心！\p我现在更崇拜她了！\p我会加倍努力的！\n先走啦！$

label: MatchCall_PersonalizedText27
source:
Hi, it's ANNA! I'm with my junior
partner MEG again today.\pI really love caring for MEG and
POKéMON. They're so cute!\pI wish I could look after them
as if they were my siblings!\pOh, hi, MEG!
Did you get the buns?\pHuh? No, no, I'm not treating you
like my personal slave!\pYou lost the match, so you have
to go buy the bread as punishment!\pI wouldn't treat you like a slave,
MEG! You're too special to me!\pI have to go now.
It's time for our snack!$
translation:
嗨，我是美穗！我今天还是和我的
后辈搭档里子在一起。\p我超喜欢照顾里子
和宝可梦。它们太可爱了！\p真希望我可以像对待
弟弟妹妹一样宠它们！\p--哦，里子！
面包买到了吗？\p什么？没有，才没有把你
当成私家仆人使唤！\p你输了对战，所以就要罚你
跑腿帮我买面包！\p我不会把你当作私家仆人的，
里子对我可是特别的存在！\p现在得走啦，
点心时间到！$

label: MatchCall_PersonalizedText29
source:
Ohoho!\pThis is {STR_VAR_1}! I can't wait to
tell you about my darling POKéMON!\pPlease, you must listen to this.
It's about my darling {STR_VAR_2}.\pWhenever anyone picks it up,
it leaps straight into my arms!\pOh… Oh… Could there be anything
more blissful?\pOh, it feels so heavenly!\pI'm so glad I could share some of
my happiness with you.\pWell, I must be going.
Bye, now!$
translation:
哦吼吼！\p我是{STR_VAR_1}！迫不及待想
分享我家可爱宝可梦的趣事！\p拜托了，一定要听我说。

我得先挂了！再见！$

label: MatchCall_Text_MrStone3
source: MR. STONE: Oh! {PLAYER}{KUN}!\pAh, so you've met STEVEN!\nI'd better reward you, then!\pWhen you visit RUSTBORO again,\ncome see me at my office.\pI'll be waiting for you!$
translation: 兹伏奇：哦！{PLAYER}{KUN}！\p你已经见过大吾了吧！\n我得给你报酬才行！\p等你下次再来卡那兹市时，\n记得来我的办公室找我。\p我等着你！$

label: MatchCall_Text_MrStone4
source:
MR. STONE: Oh! {PLAYER}{KUN}!\pDid you know that DEVON was
digging the RUSTURF TUNNEL?\pBut we shut down the operation to
protect the POKéMON in the area.\pIt's a no-brainer, really.\pIt's more important to let POKéMON
live in peace than worry about our\lown convenience.$
translation:
兹伏奇：哦！{PLAYER}{KUN}！\p你知道得文正在挖掘
卡绿隧道的事吗？\p但为了保护那里的宝可梦，
我们停止了工程。\p这是理所当然的。\p比起人类的便利，
宝可梦能安稳地生活更为重要。$

label: MatchCall_Text_MrStone5
source: MR. STONE: Hello, hello, {PLAYER}{KUN}!\pI heard from someone in PETALBURG\nthat you're NORMAN's child!\pNo wonder you're such a capable\nbeing!$
translation: 兹伏奇：你好，{PLAYER}{KUN}！\p我听从橙华市来的人说\n你是千里的孩子！\p果然是\n虎父无犬子！$

label: MatchCall_Text_MrStone6
source: MR. STONE: What's that?\pYou battled your own father and\ndefeated him?\pThat's astounding!\pI had no idea that I befriended\nsomeone so special! Wahaha!$
translation: 兹伏奇：什么？\p你和自己的父亲对战\n并获得了胜利？\p太了不起了！\p我从没想到能交到像你这样\n特别的朋友！哇哈哈！$

label: MatchCall_Text_MrStone7
source:
Hello!
This is DEVON CORPORATI…\lOh, hello, {PLAYER}!\pOur PRESIDENT was here a little
while ago, but he's gone out.\pOur PRESIDENT is busy, but you
seem to be just as busy, {PLAYER}.$
translation:
您好！
这里是得文公司......\l哦，你好，{PLAYER}！\p我们社长刚刚还在这里，
但是现在外出了。\p我们社长是很忙的，不过你好像
也一样忙啊，{PLAYER}。$

label: MatchCall_Text_MrStone8
source: …Huh? …What's that?\pGROU… Yes? …DON?\pYou're breaking up…\n…can't hear…\pBZZZZ…$

label: MatchCall_Text_MrStone9
source: …Huh? …What's that?\pSeaflo… Yes? …Caver…?\pYou're breaking up…\n…can't hear…\pBZZZZ…$

label: MatchCall_Text_MrStone10
source:
MR. STONE: {PLAYER}{KUN}! It's me!\pYou were apparently involved in all
sorts of things, but I, being busy,\lhaven't a clue exactly what!\pHowever, I urge you to take
the road you believe in and walk it.\pI'll always be in your corner!
Take care!$
translation:
兹伏奇：{PLAYER}{KUN}！是我！\p听说你经历了许多事，
但我太忙了，\l很多详情都不清楚！\p无论如何，
我希望你坚持自己相信的道路。\p我会永远支持你！
保重！$

label: MatchCall_Text_MrStone11
source:
MR. STONE: … … … … … …
Is this maybe {PLAYER}{KUN}?\pYour voice is so full of confidence,
I didn't recognize you right off!\pHm! You must come visit us at DEVON
sometime!$
translation:
兹伏奇：...... ...... ......
是{PLAYER}{KUN}吗？\p你的声音充满了自信，
我一时都没听出来！\p嗯！有空一定要再来
得文做客啊！$

label: GiddyText_SoPretty
source: so pretty!$
translation: 非常漂亮！$

label: GiddyText_SoDarling
source: so darling!$
translation: 太迷人了！$

label: GiddyText_SoRelaxed
source: so relaxed!$
translation: 太悠闲了！$

label: GiddyText_SoSunny
source: so sunny!$
translation: 太愉快了！$

label: GiddyText_SoDesirable
source: so desirable!$
translation: 太合意的了！$

label: GiddyText_SoExciting
source: so exciting!$
translation: 太令人激动！$

label: GiddyText_SoAmusing
source: so amusing!$
translation: 太有意思了！$

label: GiddyText_SoMagical
source: so magical!$
translation: 太不可思议！$

label: GiddyText_Is
source: is$
translation: 是$

label: GiddyText_DontYouAgree
source: \nDon't you agree?$
translation: \n你同意吗？$

label: GiddyText_ISoWantToGoOnAVacation
source: I so want to go on a vacation.\nWould you happen to know a nice place?$
translation: 我很想去旅行。\n你知道什么好去处吗？$

label: GiddyText_IBoughtCrayonsWith120Colors
source: I bought crayons with 120 colors!\nDon't you think that's nice?$
translation: 我买了一套120色的蜡笔！\n你不觉得很棒吗？$

label: GiddyText_WouldntItBeNiceIfWeCouldFloat
source: Wouldn't it be nice if we could float\naway on a cloud of bubbles?$
translation: 你不觉得，\n漂浮在一片泡泡云上很舒服吗？$

label: GiddyText_WhenYouWriteOnASandyBeach
source: When you write on a sandy beach,\nthey wash away. It makes me sad.$
translation: 你在沙滩上写好字，\n不久就会被冲掉的。真扫兴。$

label: GiddyText_WhatsTheBottomOfTheSeaLike
source: What's the bottom of the sea like?\nJust once I would so love to go!$
translation: 海底是个什么样子？\n我真想去一次，一次就好！$

label: GiddyText_WhenYouSeeTheSettingSunDoesIt
source: When you see the setting sun, does it\nmake you want to go home?$
translation: 当你看到夕阳的时候，\n是不是会想回家？$

label: GiddyText_LyingBackInTheGreenGrass
source: Lying back in the green grass…\nOh, it's so, so nice!$
translation: 往草地上这么一躺......\n哦，太，太棒了！$

label: GiddyText_SecretBasesAreSoWonderful
source: SECRET BASES are so wonderful!\nCan't you feel the excitement?$
translation: 秘密基地真是太棒了！\n你不觉得刺激吗？$

label: MoveRelearner_Text_LevelUpMoves
source: Level Up Moves$
translation: 升级招式$

label: MoveRelearner_Text_EggMoves
source: Egg Moves$
translation: 蛋招式$

label: MoveRelearner_Text_TMMoves
source: TM Moves$
translation: 学习器招式$

label: MoveRelearner_Text_TutormoveMoves
source: Tutor Moves$
translation: 教授招式$

label: MoveRelearner_Text_SeeYa
source: See ya!$
translation: 再见！$

label: MoveRelearner_Text_AnythingElse
source: Is there anything else I may do for you?$
translation: 还有其他要做的事吗？$

label: MoveRelearner_Text_ChoosePkmn
source: Please choose your Pokémon.$
translation: 要选择哪只宝可梦？$

label: MoveRelearner_Text_HaveNoPkmn
source: You have no Pokémon.$
translation: 你没有同行的宝可梦！$

label: MoveRelearner_Text_CantTeachMoveToPkmn
source: Sorry…\pIt doesn't appear as if I have any move\nI can teach that Pokémon.$
translation: 抱歉......\p我看来没有能够教给\n这只宝可梦的招式。$

label: MoveRelearner_Text_LevelUpMoveLWR
source: level up move$
translation: 升级招式$

label: MoveRelearner_Text_EggMoveLWR
source: egg move$
translation: 蛋招式$

label: MoveRelearner_Text_TMMoveLWR
source: TM move$
translation: 学习器招式$

label: MoveRelearner_Text_TutorMoveLWR
source: tutor move$
translation: 教授招式$

label: MoveRelearner_Text_WhichXmoveShouldTeach
source: Which {STR_VAR_3} should I teach?$
translation: 要学习哪个{STR_VAR_3}？$

label: MoveRelearner_Text_ThankYouComeAgain
source: Thank you for using our services.\nPlease come again!$
translation: 想让宝可梦学习招式时再过来吧。$

label: MoveTutor_Text_ThisMoveCanOnlyBeLearnedOnce
source: This move can be learned only\nonce. Is that okay?$
translation: 这个招式只能教你1次，\n这样可以吗？$

label: MoveTutor_Text_SwaggerTeach
source:
Heh! My POKéMON totally rules!
It's cooler than any POKéMON!\pI was lipping off with a swagger in
my step like that when the CHAIRMAN\lchewed me out.\pThat took the swagger out of my step.\pIf you'd like, I'll teach the move
SWAGGER to a POKéMON of yours.$
translation:
嗨！看我的宝可梦多完美！
它比所有其它宝可梦都酷！\p我总是像这样虚张声势，
结果被会长训了一顿。\p现在我没法虚张声势了。\p如果你愿意，我会教你的1只宝可梦
学习虚张声势。$

label: MoveTutor_Text_SwaggerDeclined
source: What, no? Can't you get into\nthe spirit of things?$
translation: 什么？不行？\n你就不能配合一下？$

label: MoveTutor_Text_SwaggerWhichMon
source: All right, which POKéMON wants to\nlearn how to SWAGGER?$
translation: 很好，想让哪只宝可梦\n学习虚张声势？$

label: MoveTutor_Text_SwaggerTaught
source: I'll just praise my POKéMON from now\non without the swagger.$
translation: 我今后不会再虚张声势地\n培育我的宝可梦了。$

label: MoveTutor_Text_RolloutTeach
source:
Did you know that you can go from
here a long way in that direction\lwithout changing direction?\pI might even be able to roll
that way.\pDo you think your POKéMON will
want to roll, too?\pI can teach one the move ROLLOUT
if you'd like.$
translation:
你知道怎样从这儿朝着一个
方向不变地走出去很远吗？\p我说不定可以滚动着
走完这段路呢。\p你觉得你的宝可梦也
很想滚动，对吗？\p如果你想学滚动
我可以教你。$

label: MoveTutor_Text_RolloutDeclined
source: You don't need to be shy about it.\nLet's roll!$
translation: 你不要害羞嘛。\n让我们滚起来！$

label: MoveTutor_Text_RolloutWhichMon
source: Ehehe, sure thing! It'd be great if\nthe POKéMON looked like me.$
translation: 哦呵呵，当然！你的宝可梦\n变得像我一样就好了。$

label: MoveTutor_Text_RolloutTaught
source: Rolling around in the grass makes me\nhappy. Come on, let's roll!$
translation: 在草里打滚使我\n非常快乐。来吧，让我们滚起来！$

label: MoveTutor_Text_FuryCutterTeach
source:
There's a move that gets stronger
when you keep using it in a row.\pIt's a BUG-type move, and it is
wickedly cool.\pIt's called FURY CUTTER.
Want me to teach it to a POKéMON?$
translation:
这是一个你连续使用
就会变得更强大的招式。\p这是一个虫属性的招式，
并且是很酷的招式。\p这个招式叫做连斩。
想让我教你的宝可梦吗？$

label: MoveTutor_Text_FuryCutterDeclined
source: We're not on the same wavelength.$
translation: 我们合不来。$

label: MoveTutor_Text_FuryCutterWhichMon
source: Yay!\nShow me which POKéMON I should teach.$
translation: 耶！\n把要学习的宝可梦交给我。$

label: MoveTutor_Text_FuryCutterTaught
source: I get a thrill watching to see if\nthe move keeps hitting in succession!$
translation: 当我连续击中对手时\n就会觉得很兴奋！$

label: MoveTutor_MimicTeach
source: Ah, young one!\pI am also a young one, but I mimic\nthe styles and speech of the elderly\lfolks of this town.\pWhat do you say, young one?\nWould you agree to it if I were to\loffer to teach the move MIMIC?$
translation: 啊，孩子！\p我也是个小孩子，\n但我在这个模仿这个镇子里的\l大人们的言谈举止。\p你说什么，小朋友？\n如果我能教你模仿\l你就能承认我？$

label: MoveTutor_MimicDeclined
source: Oh, boo! I wanted to teach MIMIC\nto your POKéMON!$
translation: 嘘！我要让你的宝可梦\n学会模仿！$

label: MoveTutor_Text_MimicWhichMon
source: Fwofwo! And so I shall!\nLet me see the POKéMON\lyou wish me to teach.$
translation: 噗噗！我当然能！\n让我看看你想要\l学会招式的宝可梦。$

label: MoveTutor_Text_MimicTaught
source: MIMIC is a move of great depth.\pCould you execute it to perfection\nas well as me…?$
translation: 模仿是个伟大而深奥的招式。\p你能像我一样\n运用自如吗......？$

label: MoveTutor_Text_MetronomeTeach
source:
I want all sorts of things!
But I used up my allowance…\pWouldn't it be nice if there were
a spell that made money appear when\lyou waggle a finger?\pIf you want, I can teach your POKéMON
the move METRONOME.\pMoney won't appear, but your POKéMON
will waggle a finger. Yes?$
translation:
我什么东西都想要！
但是我把钱都花光了......\p如果要是有个能够让你
一挥指就会出现钱的\l魔法岂不美哉？\p如果你想，我能让你的宝可梦
学会挥指。\p钱不会出现，但你的宝可梦
将会摇动手指。好吗？$

label: MoveTutor_Text_MetronomeDeclined
source: Okay. I'll be here if you change\nyour mind.$
translation: 好的。等你改变主意了\n再来找我。$

label: MoveTutor_Text_MetronomeWhichMon
source: Okay! I'll teach it!\nWhich POKéMON should I teach?$
translation: 好的！我来教你！\n想让哪只宝可梦学习？$

label: MoveTutor_Text_MetronomeTaught
source: When a POKéMON waggles its finger\nlike a METRONOME, all sorts of nice\lthings happen.\pWouldn't it be nice if we could\nuse it, too?$
translation: 当宝可梦使用\n挥指时，各种各样的好事情\l都会发生。\p我们使用它不是也很棒吗？$

label: MoveTutor_Text_SleepTalkTeach
source:
Humph! My wife relies on HIDDEN
POWER to stay awake.\pShe should just take a nap like I do,
and SLEEP TALK.\pI can teach your POKéMON how to
SLEEP TALK instead. Interested?$
translation:
嗯！我老伴依靠觉醒力量
来保持清醒。\p她明明可以像我一样打个盹，
然后说梦话的。\p我能让你的宝可梦学会梦话。
有兴趣吗？$

label: MoveTutor_Text_SleepTalkDeclined
source: Oh, fine, fine. You want to stay awake\nwith HIDDEN POWER, too…$
translation: 哦，好吧......\n你也想用觉醒力量来保持清醒......$

label: MoveTutor_Text_SleepTalkWhichMon
source: Ah, an appreciative child!\nWhich POKéMON should I teach?$
translation: 啊，多有眼光的孩子呀！\n你想让我教哪只宝可梦？$

label: MoveTutor_Text_SleepTalkTaught
source: I've never once gotten my wife's\ncoin trick right.\pI would be happy if I got it right\neven as I SLEEP TALK…$
translation: 我从来都猜不对我老伴的\n硬币把戏。\p要是我能在梦话里说中了\n感觉也挺不错的。$

label: MoveTutor_Text_SubstituteTeach
source:
When I see the wide world from up
here on the roof…\pI think about how nice it would be
if there were more than just one me\lso I could enjoy all sorts of lives.\pOf course it's not possible.
Giggle…\pI know! Would you be interested in
having a POKéMON learn SUBSTITUTE?$
translation:
当我在屋顶上看着
这广阔的世界时......\p我在想如果这个世界如果
有不止一个自己该多有趣啊，\l那样我就能体验各种各样的人生了。\p当然这是不可能的。
嘿嘿......\p明白了！
不如让你的宝可梦学习替身吧？$

label: MoveTutor_Text_SubstituteDeclined
source: Oh, no?\pA POKéMON can make a copy of\nitself using it, you know.$
translation: 噢，不？\p宝可梦可是能用这个招式\n再复制出一个自己的。$

label: MoveTutor_Text_SubstituteWhichMon
source: Giggle…\nWhich POKéMON do you want me to\lteach SUBSTITUTE?$
translation: 嘿嘿......\n你想让哪只宝可梦\l学会替身？$

label: MoveTutor_Text_SubstituteTaught
source: We human beings should enjoy our\nown lives to the utmost!\pI hope you'll get that way, too!$
translation: 我们人类更应该尽情\n享受我们自己的人生！\p我希望你能够如此！$

label: MoveTutor_Text_DynamicPunchTeach
source:
I can't do this anymore!\pIt's utterly hopeless!\pI'm a FIGHTING-type TRAINER,
so I can't win at the GYM\lno matter how hard I try!\pArgh! Punch! Punch! Punch!
Punch! Punch! Punch!\pWhat, don't look at me that way!
I'm only hitting the ground!\pOr do you want me to teach your
POKéMON DYNAMICPUNCH?$
translation:
我没办法继续！\p这一点用也没有！\p我是一名格斗属性训练家，
所以无论我怎么努力尝试\l也不能在绿岭市道馆获胜！\p啊啊啊啊！打！打！打！
打！打！打！\p什么，别那样看我！
我只是在打地面！\p还是说你想让我教你的
宝可梦学习爆裂拳？$

label: MoveTutor_Text_DynamicPunchDeclined
source: Darn! You're even making fun of me?\nPunch! Punch! Punch!$
translation: 可恶！你也来取笑我吗？\n打！打！打！$

label: MoveTutor_Text_DynamicPunchWhichMon
source: What? You do? You're a good person!\nWhich POKéMON should I teach?$
translation: 什么？你想学？你真是个好人啊！\n想要我教哪只宝可梦？$

label: MoveTutor_Text_DynamicPunchTaught
source: I want you to win at the CERULEAN GYM\nusing that DYNAMICPUNCH!$
translation: 我希望你能用爆裂拳\n在绿岭市道馆获胜！$

label: MoveTutor_Text_DoubleEdgeTeach
source:
Sigh…\pThe GYM LEADER is really
lovably admirable.\pBut that also means I have many
rivals for his attention.\pHe's got appeal with a DOUBLE-EDGE.
I couldn't even catch his eye.\pPlease, let me teach your POKéMON
the move DOUBLE-EDGE!$
translation:
唉......\p琉璃市道馆馆主可真是
太让人敬爱不已了。\p但这也意味着会有很多同样被
他吸引的人做我的竞争对手。\p他的魅力就像舍身冲撞
一样有利有弊。\l他根本都注意不到我。\p那么，让我教你的宝可梦
学习舍身冲撞！$

label: MoveTutor_Text_DoubleEdgeDeclined
source: Oh…\nEven you rejected me…$

label: MoveTutor_Text_DoubleEdgeWhichMon
source: Okay, which POKéMON should I teach\nDOUBLE-EDGE?$
translation: 好的，你希望哪只宝可梦\n能学会舍身冲撞？$

label: MoveTutor_Text_DoubleEdgeTaught
source: I won't live for love anymore!\nI'll become tough!$
translation: 我不再为爱而活着！\n我要更加坚强！$

label: MoveTutor_Text_ExplosionTeach
source:
I don't intend to be going nowhere
fast in the sticks like this forever.\pYou watch me, I'll get out to the city
and become a huge hit.\pSeriously, I'm going to cause
a huge EXPLOSION of popularity!\pIf you overheard that, I'll happily
teach EXPLOSION to your POKéMON!$
translation:
我可没打算一直呆在
这乡下一事无成。\p等着瞧吧，总有一天我会闯进大城市
成为大明星。\p说真的，我绝对会引发
一场流行大爆炸！\p既然你听到了，我就破例教你的
宝可梦学会大爆炸吧！$

label: MoveTutor_Text_ExplosionDeclined
source: Gaah! You're turning me down because\nI live in the country?$
translation: 怎么？你拒绝我是因为\n我住在乡下？$

label: MoveTutor_Text_ExplosionWhichMon
source: Fine! An EXPLOSION it is!\nWhich POKéMON wants to blow up?$
translation: 好的！这就是大爆炸！\n哪只宝可梦要学？$

label: MoveTutor_Text_ExplosionTaught
source: For a long time, I've taught POKéMON\nhow to use EXPLOSION, but I've yet\lto ignite my own EXPLOSION…\pMaybe it's because deep down,\nI would rather stay here…$
translation: 长时间以来，我一直在教宝可梦\n如何使用大爆炸，但是我自己\l还没能引发大爆炸......\p也许内心深处，\n我更想留在这儿......$

label: gText_TheBagIsFull
source: The BAG is full…$

label: gText_PutItemInPocket
source: {PLAYER} put away the {STR_VAR_2}\nin the {STR_VAR_3} POCKET.$
translation: {PLAYER}把{STR_VAR_2}\n放入了{STR_VAR_3}口袋里。$

label: gText_PlayerFoundOneItem
source: {PLAYER} found one {STR_VAR_2}!$
translation: {PLAYER}\n找到了{STR_VAR_2}！$

label: gText_TooBadBagIsFull
source: Too bad!\nThe BAG is full…$
translation: 太遗憾了！\n包包满了......$

label: gText_PlayerPutItemInBag
source: {PLAYER} put away the {STR_VAR_2}\nin the BAG.$
translation: {PLAYER}把{STR_VAR_2}\n放入了包包里。$

label: gText_ObtainedTheDecor
source: Obtained the {STR_VAR_2}!$
translation: 获得了{STR_VAR_2}！$

label: gText_NoRoomLeftForAnother
source: Too bad! There's no room left for\nanother {STR_VAR_2}…$
translation: 太遗憾了！{STR_VAR_2}的\n数量已满，没法再携带了！$

label: gText_TheDecorWasTransferredToThePC
source: The {STR_VAR_2} was transferred\nto the PC.$
translation: {STR_VAR_2}\n传送到电脑里了。$

label: gText_PlayerFoundItems
source: {PLAYER} found {STR_VAR_1} {STR_VAR_2}!$
translation: {PLAYER}\n找到了{STR_VAR_1}个{STR_VAR_2}！$

label: gText_PutCoinsAwayInCoinCase
source: {PLAYER} put the COINS away in\nthe COIN CASE.$
translation: {PLAYER}将代币放入了\n代币盒中。$

label: gText_FoundXCoins
source: {PLAYER} found\n{STR_VAR_1} {STR_VAR_2}!$
translation: {PLAYER}找到了\n{STR_VAR_1}枚{STR_VAR_2}！$

label: gText_FoundXItems
source: {PLAYER} found\n{STR_VAR_1} {STR_VAR_2}(s)!$

source: {PLAYER} obtained\nthe {STR_VAR_1}!$

label: gText_NoMoreRoomForPokemon
source: There's no more room for POKéMON!\pThe POKéMON BOXES are full and\ncan't accept any more!$
translation: 没有寄存宝可梦的空间了！\p所有宝可梦盒子都已放满，\n无法容纳新的宝可梦！$

label: gText_NicknameThisPokemon
source: Do you want to give a nickname to\nthis {STR_VAR_1}?$
translation: 要给{STR_VAR_1}\n起昵称吗？$

label: gText_WouldYouLikeToRestYourPkmn
source: Hello, and welcome to\nthe POKéMON CENTER.\pWe restore your tired POKéMON\nto full health.\pWould you like to rest your POKéMON?$
translation: 辛苦了！\n这里是宝可梦中心。\p在这里可以\n回复宝可梦的体力。\p要让您的宝可梦休息一下吗？$

label: gText_IllTakeYourPkmn
source: Okay, I'll take your POKéMON\nfor a few seconds.$
translation: 那么，就交给我吧！$

label: gText_RestoredPkmnToFullHealth
source: Thank you for waiting.\pWe've restored your POKéMON\nto full health.$
translation: 久等了！\p交给我的宝可梦们\n全都变得精力充沛了哦！$

label: gText_WeHopeToSeeYouAgain
source: 欢迎下次再来！$
translation: 欢迎下次再来！$

label: gText_WelcomeCutShort
source: Hello, and welcome to\nthe POKéMON CENTER.\pWe restore your tired POKéMON\nto full health.\pWould you like to…$
translation: 辛苦了！\n这里是宝可梦中心。\p在这里，\n可以回复宝可梦的体力。\p要让您的宝可梦......$

label: gText_IllTakeYourPkmn2
source: Okay, I'll take your POKéMON\nfor a few seconds.$
translation: 那就交给我吧！$

label: gText_ThankYouForWaiting
source: Thank you for waiting.$
translation: 让您久等了！$

label: gText_WeHopeToSeeYouAgain2
source: 欢迎下次再来！$
translation: 欢迎您随时再来！$

label: gBirchDexRatingText_AreYouCurious
source: PROF. BIRCH: Ah, {PLAYER}{KUN}!\pAre you curious about how your\nPOKéDEX is coming along?$
translation: 小田卷博士：啊，{PLAYER}{KUN}！\p你想知道你的宝可梦图鉴\n是什么水平吗？$

label: gBirchDexRatingText_Cancel
source: Hm? Oh, you haven't caught enough\nPOKéMON to make it worthwhile.$
translation: 嗯，你收集的宝可梦还不够多，\n没什么太大的价值啊。$

label: gBirchDexRatingText_SoYouveSeenAndCaught
source: Hmhm…\pSo, you've seen {STR_VAR_1} POKéMON,\nand you've caught {STR_VAR_2} POKéMON…$
translation: 唔唔......\p见过了{STR_VAR_1}只宝可梦，\n捕捉了{STR_VAR_2}只宝可梦......$

label: gBirchDexRatingText_LessThan10
source: Go into grassy areas more and look\nfor POKéMON more carefully.$
translation: 多去草丛里转转，\n仔细寻找宝可梦吧。$

label: gBirchDexRatingText_LessThan20
source: I guess you're getting the hang\nof it. But, it gets harder from here.$
translation: 看来你已经掌握诀窍了，\n但是从现在开始，收集将越来越困难。$

label: gBirchDexRatingText_LessThan30
source: Some POKéMON only appear in\ncertain areas.\lYou must be persistent.$
translation: 有些宝可梦只在\n特定的地域出现，\l你必须坚持去寻找。$

label: gBirchDexRatingText_LessThan40
source: Well, it could use more quantity,\nbut this is looking more like\la POKéDEX now.$
translation: 啊，现在看上去比较\n像一个宝可梦图鉴了，\l但还有很大的发展空间。$

label: gBirchDexRatingText_LessThan50
source: This is coming along pretty good.\nKeep up the effort.$
translation: 看起来挺好的，\n继续加油吧。$

label: gBirchDexRatingText_LessThan60
source: Are you using any RODS?\nThere are many POKéMON in the sea.$
translation: 你用过钓竿吗？\n海里有很多宝可梦的。$

label: gBirchDexRatingText_LessThan70
source: Instead of just catching POKéMON,\nhow about making them evolve, too?$
translation: 除了捕捉宝可梦，\n让它们进化也是个不错的主意。$

label: gBirchDexRatingText_LessThan80
source: This is going to be a fantastic\nPOKéDEX.\lThat's the feeling I'm getting.$
translation: 看着它，我就想说，\n真是不错的宝可梦图鉴！$

label: gBirchDexRatingText_LessThan90
source: You've collected this many…\nYour talent is remarkable!$
translation: 已经收集这么多了......\n你一定有这方面的天赋！$

label: gBirchDexRatingText_LessThan100
source: Have you visited the SAFARI ZONE?\pI hear there are some POKéMON that\ncan only be caught there.$
translation: 你去过狩猎地带了吗？\p听说有些宝可梦\n只有在那里才能捕捉到。$

label: gBirchDexRatingText_LessThan120
source: There might be POKéMON that can be\nfound using ROCK SMASH.$
translation: 使用碎岩也有可能\n找到宝可梦哦。$

label: gBirchDexRatingText_LessThan130
source: You should get some more POKéMON\nby trading with others.$
translation: 你可以和其他人交换\n来得到更多的宝可梦。$

label: gBirchDexRatingText_LessThan140
source: I've heard of POKéMON that evolve\nwhen they come to fully love their\lTRAINERS.$
translation: 听说有些宝可梦如果非常\n喜欢自己的训练家，\l它们就会进化。$

label: gBirchDexRatingText_LessThan150
source: I had no idea that there were so\nmany POKéMON species in the HOENN\lregion.$
translation: 没想到丰缘地区\n会有这么宝可梦种类。$

label: gBirchDexRatingText_LessThan170
source: One can get a very good idea about\nthe POKéMON of the HOENN region\lby looking through your POKéDEX.$
translation: 看了你的宝可梦图鉴，\n基本就可以了解丰缘地区的\l宝可梦的情况了。$

label: gBirchDexRatingText_LessThan180
source: I would say you already qualify as\na POKéMON PROFESSOR, and a good\lone, too!$
translation: 要我说，你已经可以\n被称作宝可梦专家了，\l而且是个优秀的专家！$

label: gBirchDexRatingText_LessThan190
source: With a POKéDEX this complete,\nyou're a real professional at this!$
translation: 有了这么完整的宝可梦图鉴，\n你可以成为一个真正的专家了！$

label: gBirchDexRatingText_LessThan200
source: You're very close to completing\nthis POKéDEX.\lI can feel it in my bones!$
translation: 我有很强烈的预感，\n你的宝可梦图鉴很快就能完成了！$

label: gBirchDexRatingText_DexCompleted
source: Congratulations!\nYour POKéDEX is complete!$
translation: 恭喜你！\n你做成了完美的宝可梦图鉴！$

label: gBirchDexRatingText_OnANationwideBasis
source: Hmhm…\nOn a nationwide basis…\pYou've seen {STR_VAR_1} POKéMON,\nand you've caught {STR_VAR_2} POKéMON…$
translation: 唔唔......\n从全国来看......\p见过了{STR_VAR_1}只宝可梦，\n捕捉了{STR_VAR_2}只宝可梦......$

label: gPokeNewsTextSlateport_Upcoming
source:
Greetings!
It's time for POKéMON NEWS.\pSLATEPORT's most popular kind of guy,
the ENERGY GURU, is in the news again!\pHe promises to, “Stupendously go for
it in just this many days: {STR_VAR_1}!”\pWhile he refused to elaborate on what
he will stupendously go for, the\lENERGY GURU advised, “Save up your\lmoney. That'll be good…”\pIt sounds like a trip to SLATEPORT
would be well worth your while that day.\pThat's the news on POKéMON NEWS.$
translation:
大家好！
现在是宝可梦新闻时间。\p在凯那市最受欢迎的努力家
又登上新闻头条啦！\p他承诺{STR_VAR_1}天后会有一个"惊天大活动"！\p虽然拒绝透露具体内容，
但努力家告诉我们：\l"存好钱吧，准没错......"\p听上去在那天值得
到凯那市逛一逛啊。\p以上就是宝可梦新闻的全部内容。$

label: gPokeNewsTextSlateport_Ongoing
source:
Greetings!
It's time for POKéMON NEWS.\pThis is the news you've all been
waiting for!\pSLATEPORT'S ENERGY GURU is going
for it stupendously in the MARKET!\pHe promises unbeatable bargain
prices on CALCIUM and PROTEIN!\pA trip to SLATEPORT CITY sounds
worthwhile. Why not visit and shop\lto your heart's content?\pThat's the news on POKéMON NEWS.$
translation:
大家好！
现在是宝可梦新闻时间。\p这是大家期待已久的新闻！\p凯那市的努力家
正在市场举行超级促销活动！\p他承诺商店里的特攻增强剂和
攻击增强剂优惠到难以置信！\p听上去值得到凯那市逛一逛啊。
尽情购物享受消费乐趣吧！\p以上就是宝可梦新闻的全部内容。$

label: gPokeNewsTextSlateport_Ending
source:
Greetings!
It's time for POKéMON NEWS.\pThis is the news you've all been
waiting for!\pSLATEPORT'S ENERGY GURU is going
for it stupendously in the MARKET!\pHe promises unbeatable bargain
prices on CALCIUM and PROTEIN!\pAccording to the ENERGY GURU, he
still has ample merchandise left.\pWhy not visit SLATEPORT CITY for
a most enjoyable shopping trip?\pThat's the news on POKéMON NEWS.$
translation:
大家好！
现在是宝可梦新闻时间。\p这是大家期待已久的新闻！\p凯那市的努力家
正在市场举行超级促销活动！\p他承诺商店里的特攻增强剂和
攻击增强剂优惠到难以置信！\p努力家透露，
商品库存还很充足哦！\p快去凯那市享受
愉快的购物时光吧！\p以上就是宝可梦新闻的全部内容。$

label: gPokeNewsTextGameCorner_Upcoming
source:
Greetings!
It's time for POKéMON NEWS.\pIt's approaching!
It's finally coming!\pThe GAME CORNER's service day will be
here in just this many days: {STR_VAR_1}!\pEven those who are usually unlucky
may be lucky on this particular day!\pThat's the news on POKéMON NEWS.$
translation:
大家好！
现在是宝可梦新闻时间。\p来了，
这一天终于要来了！\p游戏城的特别服务日
还有{STR_VAR_1}天就要开始了！\p即使是平常运气比较差的人
在这特别的日子里也会交上好运！\p以上就是宝可梦新闻的全部内容。$

label: gPokeNewsTextGameCorner_Ongoing
source:
Greetings!
It's time for POKéMON NEWS.\pIt's here!
It's finally arrived!\pGAME CORNER's service day has finally
arrived!\pCould you be lucky at the SLOTS 
and ROULETTE?\pThe location is MAUVILLE CITY.
This is the place!\pThat's the news on POKéMON NEWS.$
translation:
大家好！
现在是宝可梦新闻时间。\p来了！
这一天终于到来了！\p游戏城的特别服务日
就在今天开始了！\p你能在老虎机和轮盘赌中
交上好运吗？\p来吧，就在这里！
就在紫堇市！\p以上就是宝可梦新闻的全部内容。$

label: gPokeNewsTextGameCorner_Ending
source:
Greetings!
It's time for POKéMON NEWS.\pIt's here!
It's finally arrived!\pGAME CORNER's service day has finally
arrived!\pCould you be lucky at the SLOTS
and ROULETTE?\pTime is limited and has almost run out.
The location is MAUVILLE CITY.\pThat's the news on POKéMON NEWS.$
translation:
大家好！
现在是宝可梦新闻时间。\p来了！
这一天终于到来了！\p游戏城的特别服务日
就在今天开始了！\p你能在老虎机和轮盘赌中
交上好运吗？\p时间所剩不多，
就在紫堇市！\p以上就是宝可梦新闻的全部内容。$

label: gPokeNewsTextLilycove_Upcoming
source:
Greetings!
It's time for POKéMON NEWS.\pWe've just received wonderful news
from LILYCOVE DEPARTMENT STORE.\pThe DEPARTMENT STORE's clear-out sale
will be in just this many days: {STR_VAR_1}!\pThat thingamajig or that doodad that
you've always wanted could be yours!\pThat's the news on POKéMON NEWS.$
translation:
大家好！
现在是宝可梦新闻时间。\p我们刚刚从水静百货
收到了一条振奋人心的消息，\p清仓甩卖还有{STR_VAR_1}天
就要开始了！\p那些你梦寐以求的新奇商品，
在这一天，说不定都能买到哦！\p以上就是宝可梦新闻的全部内容。$

label: gPokeNewsTextBlendMaster_Ending
source:
Greetings!
It's time for POKéMON NEWS.\pIt's incredible!
Too incredible, even!\pThe BERRY BLENDER is spinning at
a dizzying pace!\pThe BLEND MASTER has lived up to
his reputation!\pThe BLEND MASTER will soon be
leaving LILYCOVE.\pIf you haven't seen the MASTER in
action, don't waste this chance!\lHead to LILYCOVE right now!\pThat's the news on POKéMON NEWS.$
translation:
大家好！
现在是宝可梦新闻时间。\p难以置信！
太难以置信了！\p树果混合器正在以令人头晕目眩
的速度旋转着！\p混合名人果然名不虚传！\p混合名人很快就要
离开水静市了。\p如果你还没有来一睹大师风采，
不要错过这个机会！\l赶快到水静市来吧！\p以上就是宝可梦新闻的全部内容。$

label: Questionnaire_Text_FillOut
source: There is a questionnaire.\nWould you like to fill it out?$
translation: 这里有张问卷调查，\n要填一下吗？$

label: Questionnaire_Text_ThankYou
source: Thank you for taking the time to\nfill out our questionnaire.\pYour feedback will be used for\nfuture reference.$
translation: 谢谢您抽出时间来\n填写我们的调查问卷，\p您的反馈将成为\n我们的参考。$

label: Questionnaire_Text_YouKnowThoseWordsGift
source:
Oh, hello!
You know those words?\pThat means you must know about
the MYSTERY GIFT.\pFrom now on, you should be
receiving MYSTERY GIFTS!$
translation:
啊，您好！
您知道这些短语吗？\p那么说您一定知道
关于神秘礼物的事情了。\p从现在起，
您将会收到神秘礼物！$

label: Questionnaire_Text_YouCanAccessMysteryGift
source: Once you save your game, you can\naccess the MYSTERY GIFT.$
translation: 您写入记录后，\n就可以接收神秘礼物了。$

label: Questionnaire_Text_YouKnowThoseWordsEvent
source: Oh, hello!\nYou know those words?\pThat means you must know about\nthe MYSTERY EVENT.$
translation: 啊，您好！\n您知道这些短语吗？\p那么说您一定知道\n关于神秘事件的事情了。$

label: Questionnaire_Text_YouCanAccessMysteryEvent
source: Once you save your game, you can\naccess the MYSTERY EVENT.$
translation: 您写入记录后，\n就可以接收神秘事件了。$

label: MysteryGift_Text_TheresATicketForYou
source: Thank you for using the MYSTERY\nEVENT System.\pYou must be {PLAYER}.\nThere is a ticket here for you.$
translation: 感谢使用神秘\n事件系统。\p您是{PLAYER}吧，\n这是给您的船票。$

label: MysteryGift_Text_TryUsingItAtLilycovePort
source: It appears to be for use at\nthe LILYCOVE CITY port.\pWhy not give it a try and see what\nit is about?$
translation: 这个看起来能在\n水静市的港口使用。\p不如去试试\n能到什么地方？$

label: Text_WouldYouLikeToMixRecords
source: Would you like to mix records with\nother TRAINERS?$
translation: 要和其他训练家\n混合记录吗？$

label: Text_WeHopeToSeeYouAgain
source: 欢迎下次再来！$
translation: 欢迎下次再来！$

label: gText_ConfirmSave
source: Would you like to save the game?$
translation: 要保存目前为止的\n冒险记录吗？$

label: gText_AlreadySavedFile
source: There is already a saved file.\nIs it okay to overwrite it?$
translation: 需要覆盖写入上次的\n保存记录，可以吗？$

label: gText_SavingDontTurnOff
source: SAVING…\nDON'T TURN OFF THE POWER.$
translation: 正在写入记录......\n请勿切断电源。$

label: gText_PlayerSavedGame
source: {PLAYER} saved the game.$
translation: {PLAYER}\n完好地写下了记录！$

label: gText_DifferentSaveFile
source:
WARNING!\pThere is a different game file that
is already saved.\pIf you save now, the other file's
adventure, including items and\lPOKéMON, will be entirely lost.\pAre you sure you want to save now
and overwrite the other save file?$
translation:
注意！！\p在"从记录继续"的选项里
已经有了一个先前保存的\l冒险进度了！\p这样做的话，先前的冒险进度
及所有已得到的宝可梦和道具\l全部都会消失......\p确定要将原来的记录
从头覆盖掉吗？$

label: gText_SaveError
source: Save error.\pPlease exchange the\nbackup memory.$
translation: 无法写入记录！\p请更换卡带的存档用\n记忆电池或电子基板！$

label: gText_SavingDontTurnOffPower
source: SAVING…\nDON'T TURN OFF THE POWER.$
translation: 正在写入记录......\n请勿切断电源。$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer0Intro
source: Have you made a SECRET BASE already?\pI went here, there, everywhere before\nchoosing this place.\pSince you're already here, how would\nyou like to battle?$
translation: 你已经做了秘密基地了吗？\p在选定这个地方之前，\n我已经走了不知多少地方。\p既然你来了，\n我们对战怎么样？$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer0AcceptBattle
source: Okay!\nHere we come!$
translation: 好！\n来吧！$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer0DeclineBattle
source: Hunh?\nOh, you can't now…$
translation: 哎？\n啊，现在不行啊......$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer0Defeated
source: Waaargh! You're too strong!\nAbout me losing… Please keep it secret!$
translation: 哇啊啊！你真强！\n我输掉的事......请帮我保密！$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer0PostBattle
source: What do you think of my SECRET BASE?\nCome visit me again tomorrow.$
translation: 我的秘密基地怎么样？\n明天也来玩吧。$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer0PreChampion
source: Have you made a SECRET BASE already?\pI went here, there, everywhere before\nchoosing this place.\pFeel free to hang out!$
translation: 你已经做了秘密基地了吗？\p在选定这个地方之前，\n我已经走了不知多少地方。\p随便转转吧！$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer5Intro
source: There're a lot of places where\nyou can make a SECRET BASE.\pBut I like this spot best.\nDon't you think it's nice?\pOh, would you like to have a battle?$
translation: 很多地方都可以\n制造秘密基地，\p但这个是我最喜欢的地方。\n你也认为这地方不错吧？\p哦，要来一次对战吗？$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer5AcceptBattle
source: Okay, here goes!$
translation: 好了，来吧！$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer5DeclineBattle
source: Oh…\nYou can't now, okay.$
translation: 啊......\n现在不行吗，也罢。$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer5Defeated
source: Hmmm… It's our loss…\nBut don't tell anyone!\lIt's a confidential secret!$
translation: 唔......我们输了......\n别告诉别人啊！\l这是一级机密！$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer5PostBattle
source: If you're in this area again,\nI hope you'll visit me.$
translation: 下次来这附近的话，\n再来我这里转转吧。$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer5PreChampion
source: There're a lot of places where you can\nmake a SECRET BASE.\pBut I like this spot best.\nDon't you think it's nice?$
translation: 很多地方都可以\n制造秘密基地，\p但这个是我最喜欢的地方。\n你也认为这地方不错吧？$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer1Intro
source:
This is a popular spot.
It's always taken.\pOh! Were you thinking about
taking this spot, too?\pI'll tell you what, you can have this
spot if you can beat me.$
translation:
这个地方非常受欢迎，
经常会有人来这里。\p啊！你也想要
这个地方吗？\p那好，如果你能打败我，
这地方就归你了。$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer1AcceptBattle
source: Okay!\nI'm going to defend my SECRET BASE!$
translation: 好的！\n我要保护我的秘密基地！$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer1DeclineBattle
source: Hunh? Is that right?\nYou're not interested in this spot?$
translation: 呃？是吗？\n你对这里不感兴趣？$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer1Defeated
source: I can't keep going!\nI surrender!$
translation: 我不行了！\n我放弃！$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer1PostBattle
source: Okay, when I move one day,\nthis place will be yours!$
translation: 好，等我有一天我搬走之后，\n这个地方就是你的了！$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer1PreChampion
source: This is a popular spot.\nIt's always taken.\pI waited a long time for it to open.\nI finally got to use it!$
translation: 这个地方非常受欢迎，\n经常会有人来这里。\p我一直在等它打开，\n我一定要得到它！$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer6AcceptBattle
source: I'm going to go all out!$
translation: 我会全力以赴的！$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer6DeclineBattle
source: Oh.\nSome other time, then!$
translation: 啊，\n那么下次吧！$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer6Defeated
source: Hmm… I've still got lots to learn.\nI have to study some more.$
translation: 嗯......我还有很多不足，\n还得继续学习啊。$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer6PostBattle
source: Thanks for battling with me.\nPlease come back again tomorrow.$
translation: 谢谢你和我对战，\n明天也来玩吧。$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer2Intro
source: A big mansion is nice, but I like this\nsort of place more.\pI like it because all kinds of people\ncome visit me.\pSo, how would you like a battle?$
translation: 拥有一座宅邸当然好，\n但我更喜欢这样的地方，\p因为各种各样的人\n都会来我这里做客。\p那么，来场对战怎么样？$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer2AcceptBattle
source: That's the way!$
translation: 就是这样！$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer2DeclineBattle
source: When you're ready, give me a shout!$
translation: 准备好的话就叫我吧！$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer2Defeated
source: Aww! Done in!\nBut it's still fun to battle!$
translation: 啊噢！挂了！\n但我还是喜欢对战！$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer2PostBattle
source: Well, anyway, I should go buy some\ndecorations and furniture.\pI want my SECRET BASE to be a place\nother people can enjoy.$
translation: 哎，不管怎么说，我还得\n去买些家具和装饰物品。\p希望我的秘密基地能成为\n大家都喜欢的地方。$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer2PreChampion
source: A big mansion is nice, but I like this\nsort of place more.\pI like it because all kinds of people\ncome visit me.$
translation: 拥有一座宅邸当然好，\n但我更喜欢这样的地方，\p因为各种各样的人\n都会来我这里做客。$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer7Intro
source:
I simply adore shopping for decorations
and furniture.\pI also love raising POKéMON just
as much.\pIf you would be so kind, will you battle
with my POKéMON?$
translation:
我非常喜欢逛商店
买家具和装饰物品，\p也同样喜欢
培育宝可梦。\p如果你愿意的话，
跟我的宝可梦对战怎么样？$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer7AcceptBattle
source: Thank you.\nShall we begin?$
translation: 谢谢，\n开始吧？$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer7DeclineBattle
source: Oh.\nHow disappointing…$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer7Defeated
source: I concede…$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer7PostBattle
source: That was all in good fun!\nI should go enjoy shopping now.$
translation: 真高兴！\n现在我该去买东西了！$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer7PreChampion
source: I simply adore shopping for decorations\nand furniture.\pI also love raising POKéMON just\nas much.$
translation: 我非常喜欢逛商店\n买家具和装饰物品，\p也同样喜欢\n培育宝可梦。$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer3Intro
source: Some people make their SECRET BASES in\nhard-to-find places.\lDo they want to just lie low?\pBut since you found me, how about we\nhave a battle?$
translation: 有些人把秘密基地\n建在别人很难找到的地方，\l是因为想低调行事吗？\p不过你找到了我这里，\n来对战如何？$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer3AcceptBattle
source: I'm not going down easily!$
translation: 我不会被你轻易打败的！$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer3DeclineBattle
source: Oh… Are you maybe tired from searching\nfor this place?$
translation: 哦......是因为你找来\n这个地方很累吗？$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer3Defeated
source: I went down…$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer3PostBattle
source: Where's your SECRET BASE?\nI should go visit you there.$
translation: 我失败了......你的秘密基地在哪儿？\n我也会去拜访你的。$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer3PreChampion
source: Some people make their SECRET BASES in\nhard-to-find places.\lDo they want to just lie low?$
translation: 有些人把秘密基地\n建在别人很难找到的地方，\l是因为想低调行事吗？$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer8Intro
source: People have told me that you can get\ndecorations in several ways.\pWe should have a race to see who can\nget nicer decorations and furniture!\pIn the meantime, want to battle?$
translation: 人们说有很多得到\n装饰物品的方式，\p我们来比赛谁能得到\n更好的家具和装饰吧！\p不过同时，想对战吗？$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer8AcceptBattle
source: This is my SECRET BASE.\nI can't lose!$
translation: 这里是我的秘密基地，\n我是不会输的！$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer8DeclineBattle
source: I'll battle with you anytime.$
translation: 我随时愿意跟你对战。$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer8Defeated
source: Huh?\nDid I just lose?$
translation: 哎？\n我刚刚输掉了？$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer8PostBattle
source: I won't lose at collecting decorations.\nCome visit again!$
translation: 收集装饰物品我是不会输给你的，\n下次再来玩！$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer8PreChampion
source: People have told me that you can get\ndecorations in several ways.\pWe should have a race to see who can\nget nicer decorations and furniture!$
translation: 人们说有很多得到\n装饰物品的方式，\p我们来比赛谁能得到\n更好的家具和装饰吧！$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer4Intro
source:
I found a spot I liked, and I did it up
with my favorite decorations.\pI raise my favorite POKéMON and grow
stronger with it.\pThat's what I do.
Want to battle with me?$
translation:
我寻找一个中意的地点，
然后用喜欢的装饰物品来装点它。\p我培育自己喜欢的宝可梦，
并与它一同成长。\p这是我的生活。
要和我对战吗？$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer4AcceptBattle
source: Show me what you're made of!$
translation: 让我看看你的本事吧！$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer4DeclineBattle
source: I guess there are times when you're not\ninto it.$
translation: 我想有时候你\n也没有兴趣。$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer4Defeated
source: I know exactly what you're made of now.$
translation: 我已经领教了你的本领了。$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer4PostBattle
source: We can both become stronger.\nLet's keep at it!$
translation: 我们都可以变得更强，\n一起加油吧！$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer4PreChampion
source: I found a spot I liked, and I did it up\nwith my favorite decorations.\pI raise my favorite POKéMON and grow\nstronger with it.\pEvery day is a great day.$
translation: 我寻找一个中意的地点，\n然后用喜欢的装饰物品来装点它。\p我培育自己喜欢的宝可梦，\n并与它一同成长。\p每一天都是最好的一天。$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer9Intro
source: You can learn a lot about the taste\nand sense of people by the kinds of\ldecorations they have, and how they\ldisplay them.\pWhat do you think of my taste?\nAre you speechless?\pWant to see my taste in battling?$
translation: 通过观察人们拥有的装饰物品的\n种类和摆放它们的方法，\l就可以了解到很多关于\l这个人的个性和品位的事情。\p你看出我的品味如何了吗？\n无话可说了吗？\p要不要再看看我的对战品味？$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer9AcceptBattle
source: There's no holding back!$
translation: 不能退缩！$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer9DeclineBattle
source: I'll be happy to demonstrate my style\nanytime.$
translation: 我很乐意随时向你\n展示我的风格。$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer9Defeated
source: You're supremely talented!\nYour power seems to be limitless…$
translation: 你拥有至高的天份！\n你的力量是无限大的......$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer9PostBattle
source: What did you think of my style?\nI'll keep on polishing it!$
translation: 觉得我的风格怎么样？\n我一直在不断完善！$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer9PreChampion
source: You can learn a lot about the taste\nand sense of people by the kinds of\ldecorations they have, and how they\ldisplay them.\pWhat do you think of my taste?\nAre you speechless?$
translation: 通过观察人们拥有的装饰物品的\n种类和摆放它们的方法，\l就可以了解到很多关于\l这个人的个性和品位的事情。\p你看出我的品味如何了吗？\n无话可说了吗？$

label: ShoalCave_LowTideEntranceRoom_Text_AreYouPlanningOnGoingInThere
source:
Are you planning on going deep
in there?\pHow about bringing me back some
SHOAL SALT and SHOAL SHELLS?\pI can make you something good if
you bring me the ingredients.$
translation: 你要向深处去吗？\p那么帮我收集一些浅滩海盐\n和浅滩贝壳怎么样？\p如果有足够的材料的话，\n我可以帮你制作点好东西。$

label: ShoalCave_LowTideEntranceRoom_Text_BringMe4ShoalSaltAndShells
source: If you bring me four each of the\nSHOAL SALT and SHOAL SHELLS,\lI can make you a SHELL BELL…\pYou can get those ingredients\nevery day.$
translation: 如果浅滩海盐和\n浅滩贝壳各有4个的话，\l我就能制作贝壳之铃......\p原材料每天都可以采到。$

label: ShoalCave_LowTideEntranceRoom_Text_WouldYouLikeShellBell
source: Oh, hey! SHOAL SALT and SHOAL SHELLS!\nAnd enough of them, too!\pWould you like me to make you\na SHELL BELL with them?$
translation: 啊，是浅滩海盐和浅滩贝壳！\n数量足够了！\p想要把它们\n做成贝壳之铃吗？$

label: ShoalCave_LowTideEntranceRoom_Text_MakeShellBellRightAway
source: All righty, then! I'll make you\na SHELL BELL right away.\p… … … … … … … …\n… … … … … … … …\pThere! Done!$

label: ShoalCave_LowTideEntranceRoom_Text_ExplainShellBell
source:
Have a POKéMON hold on to that.
It'll love it, that's for certain.\pWhy, the SHELL BELL's chime…
It's simply sublime!\pYou can get its ingredients every day,
so I can make you more.$
translation:
把这个让宝可梦携带的话，
宝可梦肯定会喜欢上它的。\p啊，贝壳之铃发出的乐声......
那是多么美妙！\p原料每天都能采到原，
想要的话我还可以做更多。$

label: ShoalCave_LowTideEntranceRoom_Text_WantedToMakeShellBell
source: Oh… Is that so…\nI wanted to make a SHELL BELL…$
translation: 哎......是吗......\n真想做一个贝壳之铃啊......$

label: ShoalCave_LowTideEntranceRoom_Text_NoSpaceInYourBag
source: You don't have space in your BAG\nif I were to make it for you.\pYou should make room and come back\nfor a SHELL BELL.$
translation: 如果我做好了的话\n你的包包里就没有空间了，\p腾出些地方再回来吧。$

label: ShoalCave_Text_WasShoalSaltNowNothing
source: There was some SHOAL SALT here.\nBut, there's nothing here now.$
translation: 这儿原来有浅滩海盐，\n但现在什么也没有了。$

label: ShoalCave_Text_WasShoallShellNowNothing
source: There was a SHOAL SHELL here.\nBut, there's nothing here now.$
translation: 这儿原来有浅滩贝壳，\n但现在什么也没有了。$

label: gText_WantToUseSurf
source: The water is dyed a deep blue…\nWould you like to SURF?$
translation: 水面呈现出一片湛蓝。\n要使用冲浪吗？$

label: gText_PlayerUsedSurf
source: {STR_VAR_1} used SURF!$
translation: {STR_VAR_1}使出了冲浪！$

label: Text_CurrentTooFast
source: The current is much too fast!\nSURF can't be used here…$
translation: 水流实在太湍急了！\n这里无法使用冲浪......$

label: Route102_Text_CalvinIntro
source: If you have POKéMON with you, then\nyou're an official POKéMON TRAINER!\lYou can't say no to my challenge!$
translation: 如果你随身带着宝可梦，\n那么你就是个正式的宝可梦训练家！\l你不能拒绝我的挑战！$

label: Route102_Text_CalvinDefeated
source: Arrgh, I lost…\nI should have trained mine more…$
translation: 呃啊，我败了......\n我还缺乏锻炼啊......$

label: Route102_Text_CalvinPostBattle
source: Listen, you. If you're strong,\nyou should have told me before!$
translation: 听着，如果你很强，\n那你应该事先告诉我！$

label: Route102_Text_CalvinRegister
source: I've been working hard at this since\nI saw you before.\pI'd like to battle you again, so can\nyou register me in your POKéNAV?$
translation: 自从上次遇见你，\n我就很努力的锻炼。\p我想再和你战一场，\n所以让我在宝可导航里登记吧？$

label: Route102_Text_CalvinRegisterShort
source: I'd like to battle you again, so can\nyou register me in your POKéNAV?$
translation: 我想和你日后再战，\n你能在宝可导航里登记我吗？$

label: Route102_Text_CalvinRematchIntro
source: Ever since I lost to you, I desperately\ntrained my POKéMON.\lYou can't say no to my challenge!$
translation: 自从上次输给你，\n我拼命地特训我的宝可梦。\l不准拒绝我的挑战！$

label: Route102_Text_CalvinRematchDefeated
source: Arrgh, I lost…\nIs my training method not right?$
translation: 呃啊，我败了......\n难道是我的训练不对吗？$

label: Route102_Text_CalvinRematchPostBattle
source: If you're going to get stronger,\nI'll get stronger, too.$
translation: 如果你要变强，\n那我也会变强的。$

label: Route102_Text_AllenIntro
source: Did you just become a TRAINER?\nWe're both beginners!$
translation: 你刚刚成为训练家吗？\n我们都是新手啊！$

label: Route102_Text_AllenDefeated
source: I called you because I thought\nI could beat you…$
translation: 我喊你过来，\n是因为我想要打败你......$

label: Route102_Text_AllenPostBattle
source: I haven't won once yet…\nI wish I would win soon…$
translation: 我还一次都没有赢过......\n真希望我能早点赢......$

label: Route102_Text_RickIntro
source: Hahah! Our eyes met!\nI'll take you on with my BUG POKéMON!$
translation: 哈哈！四目相对！\n我要用虫宝可梦打败你！$

label: Route102_Text_RickDefeated
source: Ow! Down and out!$
translation: 嗷！倒下了！$

label: Route102_Text_RickPostBattle
source: If you lock eyes with a TRAINER,\nyou have to challenge! It's a rule!$
translation: 如果你和一个训练家对视，\n那你必须挑战他！这是规矩！$

label: Route102_Text_TianaIntro
source: I'm going to keep winning and aim\nto be the best TRAINER.\pHelp me further my career!$
translation: 我要保持连胜，\n我的目标是最强训练家。\p让我的生涯再多一个战果吧！$

label: Route102_Text_TianaDefeated
source: I ended up furthering your career…$
translation: 我成了你生涯的战果......$

label: Route102_Text_TianaPostBattle
source: To keep winning my way up, I see that\nI have to catch more POKéMON.$
translation: 要想保持连胜，\n我发现得捕捉更多的宝可梦。$

label: Route103_Text_DaisyIntro
source: Did you feel the tug of our\nsoul-soothing fragrance?$
translation: 你感觉到我们抚慰心灵\n的芬芳了吗？$

label: Route103_Text_DaisyDefeated
source: You weren't led astray by our aroma…$
translation: 你并没有迷失在芳香中......$

label: Route103_Text_DaisyPostBattle
source: Aromatherapy is a form of mental\nhealing that works with fragrances.$
translation: 芳香治疗是一种用香气\n来治疗的精神疗法。$

label: Route103_Text_AmyIntro
source: AMY: I'm AMY.\nAnd this is my little sister LIV.\lWe battle together!$
translation: 久美：我是久美。\n这是我的妹妹留美。\l我们并肩战斗！$

label: Route103_Text_AmyDefeated
source: AMY: Uh-oh, we lost.$
translation: 久美：啊，我们输了。$

label: Route103_Text_AmyPostBattle
source: AMY: You have to think about all\nkinds of things when you're battling\lagainst two TRAINERS.$
translation: 久美：在同时面对两个训练家\n的时候，你必须考虑到\l所有可能发生的情况。$

label: Route103_Text_AmyNotEnoughPokemon
source: AMY: Uh-oh, you have only one\nPOKéMON with you.\lYou can't battle us like that.$
translation: 久美：啊--哦，\n你身上只带了1只宝可梦。\l你没法和我们对战。$

label: Route103_Text_LivIntro
source: LIV: We battle together as one\nteam.$
translation: 留美：我们是作为\n一个小队战斗的。$

label: Route103_Text_LivDefeated
source: LIV: Oh, we lost, big sister…$
translation: 留美：哦，姐姐，我们输了......$

label: Route103_Text_LivPostBattle
source: LIV: We work perfectly together,\nme and my big sister…\pBut we still lost…$
translation: 留美：我和我的姐姐，\n配合天衣无缝......\p但怎么还是输了......$

label: Route103_Text_AmyLivRegister
source: LIV: Really, we're a lot better…\nIt's true! We'll show you next time!$
translation: 留美：真的，我们能做得更好......\n真的！下一次你就会看到的！$

label: Route103_Text_LivNotEnoughPokemon
source: LIV: If you want to battle us,\nyou have to have two POKéMON!\lIt's not fair if you don't!$
translation: 留美：如果你想和我们对战，\n那你必须有2只宝可梦！\l否则就不公平！$

label: Route103_Text_AmyRematchIntro
source: AMY: I'm AMY.\nAnd this is my little sister LIV.\lWe battle together!$
translation: 久美：我是久美。\n这是我的妹妹留美。\l我们并肩作战！$

label: Route103_Text_AmyRematchDefeated
source: AMY: Aww, boo!\nWe couldn't win again…$
translation: 久美：啊，呜！\n我们还是赢不了......$

label: Route103_Text_AmyRematchPostBattle
source: AMY: You have to think about all\nkinds of things when you're battling\lagainst two TRAINERS.$
translation: 久美：在同时面对两个训练家\n的时候，你必须考虑到\l所有可能发生的情况。$

label: Route103_Text_AmyRematchNotEnoughPokemon
source: AMY: Uh-oh, you have only one\nPOKéMON with you.\lYou can't battle us like that.$
translation: 久美：啊哦，\n你身上只带了1只宝可梦。\l你没法和我们对战。$

label: Route103_Text_LivRematchIntro
source: LIV: We battle together as one\nteam.$
translation: 留美：我们是作为一个小队\n战斗的。$

label: Route103_Text_LivRematchDefeated
source: LIV: Awww, we lost again…\nBig sister…$
translation: 留美：啊哟喂，我们又输了......\n姐姐......$

label: Route103_Text_LivRematchPostBattle
source: LIV: We work perfectly together,\nme and my big sister…\pBut why did we lose again?$
translation: 留美：我和我的姐姐，\n配合天衣无缝......\p但是我们怎么又输了？$

label: Route103_Text_LivRematchNotEnoughPokemon
source: LIV: If you want to battle us, you\nhave to have two POKéMON!\lIt's not fair if you don't!$
translation: 留美：如果你想和我们对战\n那你必须有2只宝可梦！\l否则就不公平！$

label: Route103_Text_AndrewIntro
source: Gah! My fishing line's all snarled up!\nI'm getting frustrated and mean!\lThat's it! Battle me!$
translation: 嘎！我的钓鱼线乱成一团！\n我什么都没钓到，知道后果吗！\l没错！来对战吧！$

label: Route103_Text_AndrewDefeated
source: Gah! Lost it!\nI'm even more annoyed now!$
translation: 嘎！输了！\n我更生气了啊！$

label: Route103_Text_AndrewPostBattle
source: Gah, I'm still boiling mad…\nGrrrrr…$
translation: 嘎，我还是好生气......\n呼呼......$

label: Route103_Text_MiguelIntro
source: My POKéMON is delightfully adorable!\nDon't be shy--I'll show you!$
translation: 我的宝可梦是多么可爱啊！\n别害羞--我给你看看！$

label: Route103_Text_MiguelDefeated
source: Oh, my gosh!\nMy darling POKéMON!$
translation: 哦，天哪！\n我心爱的宝可梦！$

label: Route103_Text_MiguelPostBattle
source: My delightful POKéMON looks darling\neven when it's fainted!$
translation: 我的宝可梦啊，\n就连昏厥的样子都那么可爱！$

label: Route103_Text_MiguelRegister
source: I'll get you to come out and look in\non my delightful POKéMON again!$
translation: 一定要多来看看我的\n那些百看不厌的宝贝宝可梦呀！$

label: Route103_Text_MiguelRematchIntro
source: Hi, you! My delightfully adorable\nPOKéMON has become more darling!$
translation: 嗨，你！我那亲爱的宝贝\n宝可梦变得越来越可爱了！$

label: Route103_Text_MiguelRematchDefeated
source: Oh!\nMy darling POKéMON!$
translation: 哦！\n我心爱的宝可梦！$

label: Route103_Text_MiguelRematchPostBattle
source: The more I spend time with it,\nthe more adorable my POKéMON becomes.$
translation: 和它相处的时间越久，\n我的宝可梦就变得越来越可爱。$

label: Route103_Text_PeteIntro
source: This sort of distance…\nYou should just swim it!$
translation: 这点距离......\n游过去就行啦！$

label: Route103_Text_PeteDefeated
source: Oh, that's good going!$
translation: 哦，好极了！$

label: Route103_Text_PetePostBattle
source: Oh, I understand where you're coming\nfrom now.\pIf I had a POKéMON that trusty,\nI'd want to SURF on it, too!$
translation: 哦，\n原来如此啊。\p如果我也有那么可靠的宝可梦，\n我也想骑着它冲浪啊！$

label: Route103_Text_IsabelleIntro
source: Watch where you're going!\nWe're going to crash!$
translation: 小心前面！\n我们要相撞了！$

label: Route103_Text_IsabelleDefeated
source: Groan…$

label: Route103_Text_IsabellePostBattle
source: I'm a poor swimmer so I was practicing…\nSorry for almost crashing into you.$
translation: 我不太会游泳，所以我在练习......\n很抱歉差点撞上你。$

label: Route103_Text_RhettIntro
source: Whoa!\nHow'd you get into a space this small?$
translation: 哇！\n你怎么挤进这么点地方的？$

label: Route103_Text_RhettDefeated
source: Whoa!\nThe kid can rock!$
translation: 哇！\n这孩子真厉害！$

label: Route103_Text_RhettPostBattle
source: Do you like cramped quarters\nlike this?$
translation: 你喜欢呆在这么\n狭窄的地方吗？$

label: Route103_Text_MarcosIntro
source: Did my guitar's wailing draw you in?$
translation: 你是被我狂野的吉他声吸引来的？$

label: Route103_Text_MarcosDefeated
source: My one-man show is ruined…$
translation: 我的个人演出完蛋了......$

label: Route103_Text_MarcosPostBattle
source: I was playing my guitar where few\npeople were around, but a lot of fans\lhave gathered.\pHeh, maybe I should turn pro.$
translation: 我开始演奏的时候，\n附近几乎没有人，但是我的\l粉丝很快聚集起来了。\p嘿，也许我应该当个专业吉他手。$

label: Route104_Text_GinaIntro
source: GINA: Okay, let's battle with our\nPOKéMON!$
translation: 奈绪：好吧，和我们的\n宝可梦来场对战吧！$

label: Route104_Text_GinaDefeat
source: GINA: Losing upsets me!$
translation: 奈绪：失败让我很难过！$

label: Route104_Text_GinaPostBattle
source: GINA: You are strong!\nWe have to train lots more!$
translation: 奈绪：你很强！\n我们还要好好修行啊！$

label: Route104_Text_GinaNotEnoughMons
