source: They did take flight…$
translation: 它们的确飞走了......$

label: Route118_Text_ChesterPostBattle
source: If they'd get stronger, they'd be able\nto fly more freely…$
translation: 如果它们变得更强大的话，\n就能够自由地飞翔了......$

label: Route118_Text_BarnyIntro
source: I'm a FISHERMAN, but also a TRAINER.\nI'm raising the POKéMON I caught.$
translation: 我是垂钓者但也是训练家。\n我的宝可梦都是我自己捉的。$

label: Route118_Text_BarnyDefeat
source: I thought I was doing okay in my\ntraining…$
translation: 我原以为我的训练\n已经足够了......$

label: Route118_Text_BarnyPostBattle
source: I couldn't win by training POKéMON\nwhile I fished…\pWas I doing things in half measures?$
translation: 当我在钓鱼的时候对战\n当然会输了......\p我会半途而废吗？$

label: Route118_Text_WadeIntro
source: For FISHERMEN, equipment is the key.\pBut for TRAINERS, the key ingredients\nare POKéMON and heart, of course!$
translation: 对于一个垂钓者，装备是关键。\p但是对于训练家来说最重要的\n就是和宝可梦之间的沟通！$

label: Route118_Text_WadeDefeat
source: I was beaten in heart?$
translation: 我被打败了？$

label: Route118_Text_WadePostBattle
source: Come to think of it, fishing is a battle\nbetween a FISHERMAN and a POKéMON.$
translation: 仔细想想，钓鱼不就是垂钓者\n和宝可梦之间的战斗吗？$

label: Route118_Text_DaltonIntro
source: Let my melody rock your soul!$
translation: 让我的音乐震撼你的灵魂吧！$

label: Route118_Text_DaltonDefeat
source: La-lalala…$

label: Route118_Text_DaltonPostBattle
source: An electric guitar doesn't always\nhave to be noisy…\pIt can be strummed to squeeze out\nthis heart-stirring melody…$
translation: 一把电吉他并非\n只能制造噪音......\p它也可以弹奏出如此\n这种振奋人心的乐曲......$

label: Route118_Text_DaltonRegister
source: When I compose better melodies,\nyou have to come listen, okay?$
translation: 我创作出更好的乐曲时，\n你一定要来听听看，好吗？$

label: Route118_Text_DaltonRematchIntro
source: A melody from my POKéMON and me…\nLet us deliver it to your soul.$
translation: 来自我的宝可梦和我的旋律......\n让我们把它传递到你的心灵吧。$

label: Route118_Text_DaltonRematchDefeat
source: La-lalala…$

label: Route118_Text_DaltonPostRematch
source: When I play, my emotions should reach\nyou through my electric guitar…$
translation: 我演奏时，我的感情便会随着我的\n电吉他传达给你......$

label: Route118_Text_DeandreIntro
source: Go, go, go!\nPOKéMON 1, 2, and 3!$

label: Route118_Text_DeandreDefeat
source: Come in, POKéMON! Are you okay?\nPOKéMON 1, 2, and 3?!$
translation: 来吧，宝可梦！准备好了吗？\n宝可梦1、2、3？！$

label: Route118_Text_DeandrePostBattle
source: Isn't it cool that I have a POKéMON\nbattle team?\pYou can copy me--I don't mind!$
translation: 我有一支宝可梦战队，\n是不是很酷呢？\p你可以模仿我--我不介意！$

label: Route119_Text_BrentIntro
source: We're the MIMIC CIRCLE!\nWe MIMIC what you do!$
translation: 我们是模仿者协会的！\n你做什么，我们就模仿什么！$

label: Route119_Text_BrentDefeat
source: Whoopsie!\nI lost!$
translation: 可恶！\n我输了！$

label: Route119_Text_BrentPostBattle
source: What's so good about mimicry?\pFufufu…\nYou'll never understand…$
translation: 模仿的乐趣在哪里？\p嘿嘿嘿......\n你是永远也不会明白的......$

label: Route119_Text_DonaldIntro
source: So, we finally meet!\nMy BUG POKéMON will keep you company!$
translation: 我们终于遇上了！\n我要让你见识一下我的虫宝可梦！$

label: Route119_Text_DonaldDefeat
source: I wish we'd never met…$
translation: 真希望我们从没相遇过......$

label: Route119_Text_DonaldPostBattle
source: I want to MIMIC you some more.\nCan you hurry up and move?$
translation: 我想再模仿你一些。\n你可以快点动起来吗？$

label: Route119_Text_TaylorIntro
source: If you step forward, we step forward.\pIf you turn right, we turn, too…$
translation: 如果你向前走，我们也会向前走。\p如果你向右转，我们也会跟着转......$

label: Route119_Text_TaylorDefeat
source: But if you win, I lose…$
translation: 但如果你赢了，我就输了......$

label: Route119_Text_TaylorPostBattle
source: I can't MIMIC you winning the match.\nThat's just impossible…\lIt's burning me up…$
translation: 我没办法模仿你赢得对战。\n这根本不可能......\l这真让我觉得懊恼......$

label: Route119_Text_DougIntro
source: Yep, you've finally caught me!\nOr were you trying to avoid me?$
translation: 啊，你终于抓到我了！\n还是说你本来是要躲着我的？$

label: Route119_Text_DougDefeat
source: Whoop, that was a great match!$
translation: 啊，那是一场精彩的对战！$

label: Route119_Text_DougPostBattle
source: We're the MIMIC CIRCLE!\nI hope you enjoyed our performance.$
translation: 我们是模仿者协会！\n希望你们喜欢我们的表演。$

label: Route119_Text_GregIntro
source: You don't know who I am, do you?\pBut, I also don't know you.\nSo, we'll battle!$
translation: 你不知道我是谁吧？\p我也不认识你。\n所以，我们来对战吧！$

label: Route119_Text_GregDefeat
source: You're pretty strong!$
translation: 你真的很强！$

label: Route119_Text_GregPostBattle
source: Until you go away somewhere, we'll\nkeep on mimicking your every move.$
translation: 在你离开之前，我们一直会\n模仿你的每个动作。$

label: Route119_Text_KentIntro
source: The MIMIC CIRCLE was formed by people\nwho like to MIMIC.\pA battle starts the instant we meet!$
translation: 模仿者协会是许多\n喜欢模仿的人组成的。\p我们相遇的瞬间，对战就开始了！$

label: Route119_Text_KentDefeat
source: I give up!$
translation: 我放弃！$

label: Route119_Text_KentPostBattle
source: Won't you join our MIMIC CIRCLE?$
translation: 你不加入我们模仿者协会吗？$

label: Route119_Text_JacksonDefeat
source: I didn't have enough POKéMON\nknow-how…$
translation: 我没有足够的宝可梦\n知识......$

label: Route119_Text_JacksonPostBattle
source: To break away from civilization and\nawaken the wild spirit within!\pThat's our vision.$
translation: 脱离文明的束缚，\n唤醒内心的野性！\p那就是我们的理想。$

label: Route119_Text_JacksonRegister
source: I hope you'll give me a rematch without\nmocking my lack of knowledge.$
translation: 希望你不要嘲笑我知识匮乏，\n再跟我对战一次吧。$

label: Route119_Text_JacksonRematchIntro
source: I'm going to regain my wild spirit by\nbeing together with POKéMON.$
translation: 我要通过跟宝可梦在一起\n再重拾我内心的野性。$

label: Route119_Text_JacksonRematchDefeat
source: You've remained strong!$
translation: 你还是很强！$

label: Route119_Text_JacksonPostRematch
source: Believe in your POKéMON.\nBelieve in yourself.\pThe road will reveal itself to you.$
translation: 相信你的宝可梦。\n相信你自己。\p路就在你前方。$

label: Route119_Text_CatherineIntro
source: Oh? Look at you.\pFor someone on an adventure,\nyou're traveling awfully light.$
translation: 哦，看看你。\p对于在冒险的人来说，\n你还真是轻装旅行呢。$

label: Route119_Text_CatherineDefeat
source: Accidents happen when you're not\nprepared!$
translation: 当你还没准备好的时候，\n意外就会发生！$

label: Route119_Text_CatherinePostBattle
source: You're traveling light but you have\neverything you need.\pYou're on top of things mentally and\nphysically, too.$
translation: 虽然是轻装而行，\n你却已经拥有了所需的一切。\p无论是精神上还是身体上，\n你都已经熟练掌握了许多东西。$

label: Route119_Text_CatherineRegister
source: Do you have a POKéNAV?\nIt's a must-have tool for any TRAINER.\pOh, you do have one!\nLet's register each other, then!$
translation: 你有宝可导航吗？\n对于任何一个训练家来说，\l它都是必须的工具。\p哦，你有一个！\n那么我们互相登记吧！$

label: Route119_Text_CatherineRematchIntro
source: How's your journey with POKéMON\ngoing?$
translation: 你跟你的宝可梦\n的旅程进行得如何？$

label: Route119_Text_CatherineRematchDefeat
source: I'm still missing something…$
translation: 我好像还缺了点什么......$

label: Route119_Text_CatherinePostRematch
source: In the same way that you, as a TRAINER,\nrely on your POKéMON, your POKéMON\lrely on you.$
translation: 作为一个训练家，你依赖你的宝可梦，\n你的宝可梦也同样依赖你。$

label: Route119_Text_HughIntro
source: The vast sky holds untold promise!\pNothing can compare to the sheer\nexhilaration of flight!$
translation: 辽阔的天空有着未知的希望！\p没有什么比得上\n飞行的纯粹乐趣！$

label: Route119_Text_HughDefeat
source: Down and out!$
translation: 坠落了！$

label: Route119_Text_HughPostBattle
source: My BIRD POKéMON made my dreams of\nflying come true!$
translation: 我的鸟类宝可梦\n让我的飞行梦想成为了现实！$

label: Route119_Text_PhilIntro
source: I'll show you the true potential of me\nand my BIRD POKéMON!$
translation: 我会让你看看我真正的潜力，\n还有我的鸟类宝可梦！$

label: Route119_Text_PhilDefeat
source: We lacked potential…$
translation: 我们缺乏潜力......$

label: Route119_Text_PhilPostBattle
source: Ever since I was a little kid, I always\nadmired BIRD POKéMON…$
translation: 从我小时候开始，我就一直\n很羡慕鸟类宝可梦......$

label: Route119_Text_YasuIntro
source: To lurk in shadows, and live in\ndarkness… That is my destiny.\pI emerge to challenge you!$
translation: 躲藏在阴影里，生活在黑暗中......\n这就是我的命运。\p我出现就是要挑战你！$

label: Route119_Text_YasuDefeat
source: I admit defeat!$
translation: 我认输！$

label: Route119_Text_YasuPostBattle
source: Those defeated in battle withdraw\nquietly back into the shadows.\lThat, too, is destiny…$
translation: 那些在对战中的失败者只能\n静静地撤回到阴影里。\l那，也是命运......$

label: Route119_Text_TakashiIntro
source: If you're not on your guard,\nyou're in for some pain!$
translation: 如果你不提高警惕，\n你迟早会付出代价！$

label: Route119_Text_TakashiDefeat
source: You're surprisingly good!$
translation: 你真是出奇地强啊！$

label: Route119_Text_TakashiPostBattle
source: My surprise attack ended in\nfailure…$
translation: 我的偷袭失败了......$

label: Route119_Text_HideoIntro
source: To hide a tree, use a forest!$
translation: 想藏一棵树，就把它放到森林里！$

label: Route119_Text_HideoDefeat
source: I bow to your superiority.$
translation: 我愿承认你的优越。$

label: Route119_Text_HideoPostBattle
source: To hide a tree, use a forest!\nTo hide a POKéMON, use a POKéMON!\pThere is no deep, hidden meaning\nto that.$
translation: 想隐藏一棵树，就把它放到森林里！\n想隐藏宝可梦，就用宝可梦！\p这并没什么深刻的含义。$

label: Route119_Text_ChrisIntro
source: You spoke to me…\nSo you want to challenge me!\pSure! I'll try out the POKéMON I caught\nwhile SURFING!$
translation: 你跟我说话......\n也就是说你想挑战我！\p好啊！我也想试试在冲浪时\n捕捉到的宝可梦！$

label: Route119_Text_ChrisDefeat
source: I don't have a clue about what it\ntakes to win.$
translation: 我还是不知道胜利\n的诀窍是什么。$

label: Route119_Text_ChrisPostBattle
source: Go for a SURF on my POKéMON…\pThen fish off its back…\pIt's an indescribably luxuriant moment!$
translation: 骑上我的宝可梦去冲浪......\p然后在它的背上钓鱼......\p那真是难以形容的美妙时刻！$

label: Route119_Text_FabianIntro
source: Hit me with a power chord!\nVictory is mine!\lIt's our time to shine, whoa, yeah!$
translation: 用强烈的和弦来打我吧！\n胜利是属于我的！\l我们闪光的时候到了，哦耶！$

label: Route119_Text_FabianDefeat
source: You showed me who's the boss!\nWe'll have to take the loss, oh, no!$
translation: 你让我明白了谁才是老大！\n我们不得不接受失败。哦，不！$

label: Route119_Text_FabianPostBattle
source: Hit me with another power chord!\nLeave me alone!\lYour win you have to atone!$
translation: 再用一波强烈的和弦来打我吧！\n别管我！\l你要用胜利来偿还！$

label: Route119_Text_DaytonIntro
source: Hohoho!\nI like kid TRAINERS!\lLet's have a good one!$
translation: 吼吼吼！\n我喜欢小训练家！\l来一场精彩的对决吧！$

label: Route119_Text_DaytonDefeat
source: You're pretty amazing!\nHohoho!$
translation: 你实在太厉害了！\n吼吼吼！$

label: Route119_Text_DaytonPostBattle
source: Hohoho!\nI'll try emulating the pep of kid\lTRAINERS like you!$
translation: 吼吼吼！\n我会努力像你这样的\l小训练家一样拥有激情和活力的！$

label: Route119_Text_RachelIntro
source: Wherever and whenever I may be,\nI always have my parasol in hand.$
translation: 无论什么时候，在哪里，\n我都会带上我的小阳伞。$

label: Route119_Text_RachelDefeat
source: Oh, but…\nThat's not fair.$
translation: 哦，但是......\n那不公平。$

label: Route119_Text_RachelPostBattle
source: You're asking if my parasol is heavy?\nYour BAG is filled with more junk than\lI ever carry around.$
translation: 你问我的阳伞会不会很重？\n你包里的垃圾比我带过的\l所有东西都要重。$

label: Route120_Text_ColinIntro
source: Do you have any moves that can strike\na flying POKéMON?$
translation: 你有什么招式可以打到\n飞着的宝可梦？$

label: Route120_Text_ColinDefeat
source: You soared above me!$
translation: 你的实力远在我之上！$

label: Route120_Text_ColinPostBattle
source: The move FLY is convenient,\ndon't you think?\pWhile the POKéMON is flying,\nalmost no moves can strike it.$
translation: 飞翔这招真方便啊，\n你觉得呢？\p当宝可梦飞起来时，\n几乎没什么什么可以打中它。$

label: Route120_Text_RobertIntro
source: My POKéMON is strong!\nHow about yours?$
translation: 我的宝可梦很强的！\n你的呢？$

label: Route120_Text_RobertDefeat
source: Your POKéMON were stronger…$
translation: 你的宝可梦更强......$

label: Route120_Text_RobertPostBattle
source: A POKéMON that grows steadily is one\nyou can count on.$
translation: 你可以信赖一只\n稳定成长的宝可梦。$

label: Route120_Text_RobertRegister
source: You can be counted on to get better.\nI'd like to register you in my POKéNAV!$
translation: 你会变得更强的。\n我想把你登记到我的宝可导航上！$

label: Route120_Text_RobertRematchIntro
source: A POKéMON that grows steadily is one\nyou can count on.$
translation: 你可以信赖一只\n稳定成长的宝可梦。$

label: Route120_Text_RobertRematchDefeat
source: Your POKéMON are seriously strong.$
translation: 你的宝可梦真的很强。$

label: Route120_Text_RobertPostRematch
source: My POKéMON are growing stronger.\nI have to grow stronger, too.$
translation: 我的宝可梦越来越强了。\n我也要变得更强才行。$

label: Route120_Text_LorenzoIntro
source: I'll check your POKéMON and see if\nthey're fit for the outdoors.$
translation: 我要检查一下你的宝可梦，\n看看它们适不适合在户外活动。$

label: Route120_Text_LorenzoDefeat
source: With POKéMON that strong, you're in\nno danger of needing rescue!$
translation: 有那么强的宝可梦，\n你已经完全不需要救援了！$

label: Route120_Text_LorenzoPostBattle
source: To travel wherever your heart desires\nwith POKéMON…\lThat's the joy of being a TRAINER.$
translation: 跟宝可梦一起到所有\n心里想去的地方......\l那就是作为一个训练家的乐趣。$

label: Route120_Text_JennaIntro
source: How's your physical fitness?\nIf you're not fit, you could have a\lrough time in critical situations.$
translation: 你的身体状况如何？\n如果状况不好，\l那你很可能会陷入危机。$

label: Route120_Text_JennaDefeat
source: I'm totally fit, but…$
translation: 我完全身体状况很好，但......$

label: Route120_Text_JennaPostBattle
source: Fitness training is in my routine.\nI always run with my POKéMON.$
translation: 健身训练是我每天的习惯。\n我一直跟我的宝可梦一起跑步。$

label: Route120_Text_JeffreyIntro
source: … … … … … …\n… … … … … …\lWant to battle?$

label: Route120_Text_JeffreyDefeat
source: Lost it…$

label: Route120_Text_JeffreyPostBattle
source: … … … … … …\n… … … … … …\lI'll try harder…$

label: Route120_Text_JeffreyRegister
source: … … … … … …\n… … … … … …\lDo you have a POKéNAV…?$

label: Route120_Text_JeffreyRematchIntro
source: … … … … … …\n… … … … … …\lWant to battle again?$

label: Route120_Text_JeffreyRematchDefeat
source: … … … … … …\nI lost again…$

label: Route120_Text_JeffreyPostRematch
source: … … … … … …\n… … … … … …\lI'll try harder…\lFor my precious BUG POKéMON…$

label: Route120_Text_JenniferIntro
source: POKéMON have many special abilities.\nIf you want to become a first-class\lTRAINER, learn about them.$
translation: 宝可梦有许多特性。\n如果你想成为一流的\l训练家，就好好学吧。$

label: Route120_Text_JenniferDefeat
source: You're obviously thinking.$
translation: 你很明显是在思考。$

label: Route120_Text_JenniferPostBattle
source: The special abilities of POKéMON\nwill make battle styles change.$
translation: 宝可梦的特性\n会改变战斗的风格。$

label: Route120_Text_ChipIntro
source: Who might you be?\pAre you perhaps searching for ancient\nruins that are rumored to possibly\lexist according to legend?$
translation: 你是谁？\p你是不是在寻找传说中\n可能存在的一个\l古代遗迹？$

label: Route120_Text_ChipDefeat
source: What a disgraceful setback…$
translation: 多可耻的挫败啊......$

label: Route120_Text_ChipPostBattle
source: That giant rock… I would like to\nbelieve it may indeed contain ancient\lruins. But I see no entrance.$
translation: 那个巨大的岩石......\n我很确信那里面就是古代遗迹。\l但我没发现有入口。$

label: Route120_Text_ClarissaIntro
source: Why am I carrying this parasol?\pI'll tell you if you can win against me.$
translation: 为什么我要带着这把阳伞？\p如果你赢得了我我就告诉你。$

label: Route120_Text_ClarissaDefeat
source: A parasol can't ward off POKéMON\nattacks…$
translation: 阳伞是没办法抵抗宝可梦\n的攻击的......$

label: Route120_Text_ClarissaPostBattle
source: I don't think strong sunlight is good\nfor my POKéMON.\lSo I shield them with my parasol.$
translation: 我觉得强烈的阳光对我的\n宝可梦是没好处的。\l所以我用阳伞来帮它们遮挡。$

label: Route120_Text_AngelicaIntro
source: Me, POKéMON, and my parasol…\pIf any one of them is missing,\nthe picture of beauty will be ruined.$
translation: 我，宝可梦，和我的阳伞......\p缺少其中任何一个，\n那完美的画面就毁了。$

label: Route120_Text_AngelicaDefeat
source: You've completely ruined my beauty…$
translation: 你已经完全地毁了我的完美......$

label: Route120_Text_AngelicaPostBattle
source: A parasol wouldn't suit you at all.\pWhy, something like this would only\nget in your way.$
translation: 阳伞一点也不适合你。\p像这样的东西只会成为\n你的累赘。$

label: Route120_Text_KeigoIntro
source: I will adopt the movements of POKéMON\nand create new ninja techniques.$
translation: 我要借鉴宝可梦的动作，\n创造出新的忍术。$

label: Route120_Text_KeigoDefeat
source: The creation of new ninja techniques\nis but a distant dream…$
translation: 创造新的忍术只不过\n是一个遥远的梦想......$

label: Route120_Text_KeigoPostBattle
source: Perhaps I ought to apprentice under\na ninja sensei.$
translation: 也许我该找个忍者老师\n学习一下。$

label: Route120_Text_RileyIntro
source: We ninja conceal ourselves under our\ncamouflage cloaks.\lI bet you didn't know where I was!$
translation: 我们忍者是用伪装斗篷\n来隐藏自己的。\l我肯定你不知道我在哪里！$

label: Route120_Text_RileyDefeat
source: I lost!\nI should camouflage my shame!$
translation: 我输了！\n我应该伪装我的羞愧！$

label: Route120_Text_RileyPostBattle
source: Our camouflage cloaks are all\nhandmade.$
translation: 我们的伪装斗篷都是\n手工做的。$

label: Route120_Text_CallieIntro
source: If you don't pay attention,\nyou could get hurt!$
translation: 你要不是小心一点的话，\n你会受伤的！$

label: Route120_Text_CallieDefeat
source: Ouch!\nI was the one to get hurt.$
translation: 哎哟！\n受伤的是我。$

label: Route120_Text_CalliePostBattle
source: I wonder… Should I evolve my POKéMON?\nThey're cute the way they are, though.$
translation: 我想知道......我应该让我的宝可梦\n进化吗？他们现在都很可爱啊。$

label: Route120_Text_LeonelIntro
source: Your party POKéMON…\nDo you have different types?$
translation: 你的宝可梦同伴......\n你还有其他属性的吗？$

label: Route120_Text_LeonelDefeat
source: I've seen your policy in action!$
translation: 我知道你的策略已经奏效了！$

label: Route120_Text_LeonelPostBattle
source: I think it's awesome you're so strong\nbattling with your favorite POKéMON.$
translation: 你跟你最喜欢的宝可梦一起战斗能有\n如此实力，实在是太了不起了。$

label: Route121_Text_VanessaIntro
source: Will you play with my delightfully\npretty POKéMON?$
translation: 你能跟我这可爱漂亮的\n宝可梦一起玩玩吗？$

label: Route121_Text_VanessaDefeat
source: This isn't what I meant!$
translation: 我不是这个意思！$

label: Route121_Text_VanessaPostBattle
source: I'm going to a CONTEST in LILYCOVE.\pMy POKéMON should have no problem\nsweeping the MASTER CLASS.$
translation: 我要去参加水静市的一个华丽大赛。\p我的宝可梦要横扫大师级\n应该是没问题的。$

label: Route121_Text_WalterIntro
source: With my POKéMON, I have traveled\nto the world's four corners.\pYou might say I have some confidence\nin my abilities.$
translation: 我已经跟我的宝可梦一起\n去遍了世界的各个角落。\p我对我的能力还是有点信心的。$

label: Route121_Text_WalterDefeat
source: Ah, well played.$
translation: 啊，做的不错。$

label: Route121_Text_WalterPostBattle
source: I would like to circle the globe once\nagain with my POKéMON.$
translation: 我想再跟我的宝可梦\n环游世界一次。$

label: Route121_Text_WalterRegister
source: Your POKéMON prowess is remarkable.\nAllow me to register you as a memento.$
translation: 你的宝可梦的实力非凡。\n请允许我登记下你，以作纪念。$

label: Route121_Text_WalterRematchIntro
source: With my POKéMON, I have traveled\nto the world's four corners.\pYou might say I have some confidence\nin my abilities.$
translation: 我已经跟我的宝可梦一起\n去遍了世界的各个角落。\p我对我的能力还是有点信心的。$

label: Route121_Text_WalterRematchDefeat
source: Ah, well played.$
translation: 啊，做的不错。$

label: Route121_Text_WalterPostRematch
source: Your POKéMON and you…\pYour prowess together will be\nconsidered strong, even overseas.$
translation: 你和你的宝可梦......\p你们合在一起的力量\n即便在外国也是非常强的。$

label: Route121_Text_TammyIntro
source: There are powers beyond our\nunderstanding in the world…$
translation: 世界上有许多\n我们不知道的力量......$

label: Route121_Text_TammyDefeat
source: I have lost…$

label: Route121_Text_TammyPostBattle
source: MT. PYRE…\nThere is a mysterious power\lat work there…$
translation: 送神山......\n那里有一股神秘的力量\l在运作着......$

label: Route121_Text_KateIntro
source: KATE: Together, we're fearless!\nWe'll demonstrate how tough we are!$
translation: 真奈：只要我们在一起，就没有什么\n可怕的！我们会证明我们有多强！$

label: Route121_Text_KateDefeat
source: KATE: I blew it in front of my junior\nstudent partner…$
translation: 真奈：我竟然在我的学妹\n搭档面前输了......$

label: Route121_Text_KatePostBattle
source: KATE: When someone's relying on me,\nI get this urge to look cool in front\lof them…$
translation: 真奈：每当有人想依赖我的时候，\n我总是很想在他们面前表现得\l很酷......$

label: Route121_Text_KateNotEnoughMons
source: KATE: If you've only got one POKéMON,\nwe can't battle with you.\pThat would be bullying.$
translation: 真奈：如果你只有1只宝可梦，\n那我们不能跟你对战。\p那样太欺负人了。$

label: Route121_Text_JoyIntro
source: JOY: Together, we're fearless!\nWe'll demonstrate how tough we are!$
translation: 由依：只要我们在一起，就没有什么\n可怕的！我们会证明我们有多强！$

label: Route121_Text_JoyDefeat
source: JOY: Please forgive me, KATE!$
translation: 由依：真奈，请原谅我！$

label: Route121_Text_JoyPostBattle
source: JOY: Ehehe, I'll have to train with KATE,\nmy senior student partner, again.$
translation: 由依：呵呵，我要再跟我的\n学姐搭档真奈多练习联系了。$

label: Route121_Text_JoyNotEnoughMons
source: JOY: You need at least two POKéMON\nif you're going to challenge us!$
translation: 由依：如果你想挑战我们，\n你至少需要2只宝可梦！$

label: Route121_Text_JessicaIntro
source: Stop! Have a good look at my precious\nPOKéMON!$
translation: 站住！好好看看我珍贵的\n宝可梦！$

label: Route121_Text_JessicaDefeat
source: Oh, how dare you!\nDon't take it so seriously!$
translation: 噢，你怎么......\n别这么认真！$

label: Route121_Text_JessicaPostBattle
source: Maybe I'll go catch more POKéMON at\nthe SAFARI.$
translation: 也许我应该在狩猎地带\n多捕捉几只宝可梦。$

label: Route121_Text_JessicaRegister
source: I took it easy on you this time!\nIt won't be that way the next time!$
translation: 这次是我小看你了！\n但下次绝不会是这样了！$

label: Route121_Text_JessicaRematchIntro
source: My precious POKéMON grew!\nHave a good look!$
translation: 我宝贵的宝可梦成长了！\n仔细看看！$

label: Route121_Text_JessicaRematchDefeat
source: Oh, how dare you!\nYou still won't take it easy!$
translation: 噢，你怎么......\n你还是太认真了！$

label: Route121_Text_JessicaPostRematch
source: Maybe I'll go catch more POKéMON at\nthe SAFARI.$
translation: 也许我应该在狩猎地带\n多捕捉几只宝可梦。$

label: Route121_Text_CristinIntro
source: I have this routine.\nDefeat five TRAINERS a day.\lGuess what? You're number five!$
translation: 我有个习惯，\n就是每天打败5个训练家。\l猜到了吗？你就是第5个！$

label: Route121_Text_CristinDefeat
source: No!\nYou're horrid!$
translation: 不！\n你太可怕了！$

label: Route121_Text_CristinPostBattle
source: I didn't expect to lose this easily…\nI'll win next time!$
translation: 我从没想过会这么简单就输了......\n下次我一定会赢的！$

label: Route121_Text_CristinRegister
source: That was total humiliation!\nI won't forget you…\lHand over your POKéNAV!$
translation: 简直是奇耻大辱！\n我不会忘记你的......\l把你的宝可导航交出来！$

label: Route121_Text_CristinRematchIntro
source: I have this new routine.\nDefeat ten TRAINERS a day.\lGuess what? You're number ten!$
translation: 我有了一个新习惯，\n就是每天打败10个训练家。\l猜到了吗？你就是第10个！$

label: Route121_Text_CristinRematchDefeat
source: Wait! That's nasty!\nI demand a rematch!$
translation: 等一下！那太卑鄙了吧！\n我要求重新对战！$

label: Route121_Text_CristinPostRematch
source: An opponent I just can't beat…\nSnivel…\lI can't believe this is happening…$
translation: 一个我无法打败的对手......\n泣......\l真难以置信会这样......$

label: Route121_Text_CaleIntro
source: Can't you see that I have all this\nstuff with me?\pDespite that, you still insist that\nwe battle?$
translation: 你没看到我现在\n拿着这么多东西吗？\p即便这样，你也坚持\n要跟我对战？$

label: Route121_Text_CaleDefeat
source: Of course I lost!\nI'm holding stuff in both hands!$
translation: 当然是我输了！\n毕竟我两只手都在拿东西！$

label: Route121_Text_CalePostBattle
source: I bought too much stuff at\nthe LILYCOVE DEPT. STORE.\pIt's up the road from here.\nI wish I had a BAG like yours.$
translation: 我在水静百货买了太多东西了。\p那家店就在这条路前面。\n真想有一个像你的那样的包包。$

label: Route121_Text_MylesIntro
source: There's nothing I love more than\nchecking out other people's POKéMON!$
translation: 我最喜欢的事情莫过于\n看看别人的宝可梦了！$

label: Route121_Text_MylesDefeat
source: Super awesome!$
translation: 超级棒！$

label: Route121_Text_MylesPostBattle
source: They're great, your POKéMON!\nHow do you raise them?$
translation: 你的宝可梦太棒了！\n你是怎么培育它们的？$

label: Route121_Text_PatIntro
source: I want everybody to see the POKéMON\nI've raised!$
translation: 真想让每个人都看看\n我培育的宝可梦！$

label: Route121_Text_PatDefeat
source: Wow!\nSpectacular!$
translation: 哇！\n太妙了！$

label: Route121_Text_PatPostBattle
source: I raise every POKéMON with the same\nlove and care--I don't pick favorites.$
translation: 我对每一只宝可梦都给予了同等\n的爱和关怀。不会特别偏爱一只。$

label: Route121_Text_MarcelIntro
source: My POKéMON have never tasted defeat!\nOn their next win, I'm entering them\lin CONTESTS.$
translation: 我的宝可梦还没有尝过失败的滋味！\n它们再赢一次后，我就让它们去参加\l华丽大赛。$

label: Route121_Text_MarcelDefeat
source: Oh, now what happened here?$
translation: 发生什么事了？$

label: Route121_Text_MarcelPostBattle
source: I may have to train my gang some more\nbefore entering any CONTEST.$
translation: 也许在进入华丽大赛之前\n我该再多训练一下它们。$

label: Route123_Text_WendyIntro
source: Want to determine how strong you are?\nI'll be the test!$
translation: 想知道你有多强？\n我来帮你测试吧！$

label: Route123_Text_WendyDefeat
source: You passed with flying colors!$
translation: 你以优异的成绩通过了测试！$

label: Route123_Text_WendyPostBattle
source: To best even me…\nYour strength is marvelous!$
translation: 即便跟我比起来......\n你的实力也还是太强了！$

label: Route123_Text_BraxtonIntro
source: You seem to have a big collection\nof GYM BADGES.\pLet me see if you're actually worthy of\nthose BADGES!$
translation: 你好像收集了很多\n道馆徽章嘛。\p让我看看你是不是真的有\n和那些徽章相称的实力吧！$

label: Route123_Text_BraxtonDefeat
source: Oh, you're worthy, all right!$
translation: 哦，你的确是有实力。$

label: Route123_Text_BraxtonPostBattle
source: You did your BADGES proud in that\nmatch!$
translation: 在那样的对战中获得徽章\n是你的骄傲。$

label: Route123_Text_VioletIntro
source: They say that good times are filled\nwith good aromas.$
translation: 人们说，美好的时光总是\n充满着美好的香气。$

label: Route123_Text_VioletDefeat
source: Oh…\nI smell the bitter scent of misery…$
translation: 哦......\n我闻到了痛苦的苦涩气味......$

label: Route123_Text_VioletPostBattle
source: The BERRY MASTER's garden is filled\nwith uplifting fragrances.$
translation: 树果名人的花园充满了\n振奋人心的香气。$

label: Route123_Text_CameronIntro
source: Being a psychic is about willpower.\pI've willed myself not to lose to\nanyone. That makes me strong!$
translation: 要做超能力者需要有意志力。\p我的意志力已经不会输给任何人了。\n这让我十分强大！$

label: Route123_Text_CameronDefeat
source: I feel sad…$

label: Route123_Text_CameronPostBattle
source: Being a psychic is about willpower.\nI thought I wouldn't lose to you…$
translation: 要做超能力者需要有意志力。\n我以为我不会输给你的......$

label: Route123_Text_CameronRegister
source: I sense it!\nYou and I shall battle again!\lI can't tell if I'll win, though…\pLet's see your POKéNAV.$
translation: 我感觉到了！\n我们会再度对战的！\l虽然我没办法保证我会赢......\p把你的宝可导航拿出来吧。$

label: Route123_Text_CameronRematchIntro
source: I've convinced myself that I won't\nlose anymore. That makes me strong!$
translation: 我已经向自己保证过不会再失败了。\n这让我变得更强了！$

label: Route123_Text_CameronRematchDefeat
source: I feel sad…$

label: Route123_Text_CameronPostRematch
source: I should train at MT. PYRE…\nI'll never beat you this way…$
translation: 我应该到送神山训练......\n这样下去我永远赢不了你。$

label: Route123_Text_JackiIntro
source: Don't be too happy if your POKéMON\ndevelop psychic powers.\pYou need to refine those powers to\nmake them really useful.$
translation: 如果你的宝可梦获得了超能力，\n不要太高兴。\p要让它们派上用场，\n你还得精心培育。$

label: Route123_Text_JackiDefeat
source: Overwhelmed!$
translation: 一败涂地！$

label: Route123_Text_JackiPostBattle
source: We all have psychic powers.\nWe've just forgotten how to use them.$
translation: 我们都有超能力。\n我们只是忘了要怎么使用。$

label: Route123_Text_JackiRegister
source: I would like to face you again.\nIs that okay with you?$
translation: 我想再次面对你。\n你愿意接受吗？$

label: Route123_Text_JackiRematchIntro
source: Have you awoken the psychic powers\nwithin you?$
translation: 你已经唤醒你心中的\n超能力了吗？$

label: Route123_Text_JackiRematchDefeat
source: Astounding!$
translation: 令人震惊！$

label: Route123_Text_JackiPostRematch
source: Your power with POKéMON…\nThat could be a psychic power, too.$
translation: 你相信宝可梦的力量......\n可能也是一种超能力。$

label: Route123_Text_MiuIntro
source: MIU: Hello, TRAINER. I hope your\nPOKéMON won't cry when they lose.$
translation: 美雨：你好，训练家。\n希望你的宝可梦输了之后不会哭泣。$

label: Route123_Text_MiuDefeat
source: MIU: Uh-oh, we lost.$
translation: 美雨：呃，我们输了。$

label: Route123_Text_MiuPostBattle
source: MIU: TRAINER, your POKéMON are\nstrong because you are friends.$
translation: 美雨：训练家，你的宝可梦之所以强\n是因为你们是朋友。$

label: Route123_Text_MiuNotEnoughMons
source: MIU: It's no fun to battle if you\ndon't have two POKéMON.$
translation: 美雨：如果你没有2只以上的\n宝可梦，那就没什么对战的意思了。$

label: Route123_Text_YukiIntro
source: YUKI: Okay!\nWe're beating the TRAINER's POKéMON!$
translation: 雪：好的！\n我们会打败那个训练家的宝可梦的！$

label: Route123_Text_YukiDefeat
source: YUKI: Uh-oh, we lost.$
translation: 雪：呃，我们输了。$

label: Route123_Text_YukiPostBattle
source: YUKI: Why are you so strong?\nWe've never lost before.$
translation: 雪：你怎么会这么强？\n我们以前从没输过。$

label: Route123_Text_YukiNotEnoughMons
source: YUKI: It's no fun to battle if you\ndon't have two POKéMON.$
translation: 雪：如果你没有2只以上的\n宝可梦，那就没什么对战的意思了。$

label: Route123_Text_KindraIntro
source: MT. PYRE…\nWhere the spirits of POKéMON sleep…\lWill your POKéMON sleep?$
translation: 送神山......\n宝可梦的灵魂休眠的地方......\l你的宝可梦也会休眠吗？$

label: Route123_Text_KindraDefeat
source: Overflowing with vitality…$

label: Route123_Text_FernandoIntro
source: I'll turn your lights out while\nI rip through this tune!$
translation: 当我奏起这首曲子的时候，\n你的希望就全部落空了！$

label: Route123_Text_FernandoDefeat
source: Hey, hold it!\nI was still playing the intro!$
translation: 喂，等一下！\n我才刚开始前奏！$

label: Route123_Text_FernandoPostBattle
source: You're rock steady.\nI'd like to write a tune about you.$
translation: 你很厉害。\n我要为你写一首曲子。$

label: Route123_Text_FernandoRegister
source: The next time, lend your ears to\nthe full tune, will you?$
translation: 下一次，\n你可以听完整首曲子吗？$

label: Route123_Text_FernandoRematchIntro
source: Today's the day I'm going to do it!\nI'll turn out your lights before\lI finish singing my song!$
translation: 终于到了这一天了。\n在我唱完我的歌之前，\l我会打败你的！$

label: Route123_Text_FernandoRematchDefeat
source: Hey, hold it!\nI haven't even hit the chorus!$
translation: 喂，等一下！\n我还没到副歌呢！$

label: Route123_Text_FernandoPostRematch
source: I thought you'd be so enthralled\nby my tune, you'd lose.$
translation: 我以为你会被我的曲子迷住，\n然后输掉的。$

label: Route123_Text_DavisIntro
source: This is my awesome BUG POKéMON!\nMy big brother got it for me.$
translation: 这就是我超棒的虫宝可梦！\n我大哥帮我捕捉到的。$

label: Route123_Text_DavisDefeat
source: Waaaah!\nYou meanie!$
translation: 哇啊！\n你这坏蛋！$

label: Route123_Text_DavisPostBattle
source: Don't tell my brother I lost.\nYou have to keep it a secret!$
translation: 别告诉我哥哥我输了。\n你要把它当做秘密！$

label: Route123_Text_JazmynIntro
source: My confidence will get a boost by\nbeating someone obviously strong!$
translation: 打败一个明显很强的人之后，\n我的信心就会爆涨。$

label: Route123_Text_JazmynDefeat
source: There goes my confidence…$
translation: 我的自信就这么没了......$

label: Route123_Text_JazmynPostBattle
source: They say that you can't judge a person\nby their appearance.\pBut often, their looks don't lie…$
translation: 人们都说\n人不可貌相。\p但外貌往往不会说谎......$

label: Route123_Text_FrederickIntro
source: Hello, child!\nCan you spare some time?$
translation: 你好啊，小朋友。\n能给我点时间吗？$

label: Route123_Text_FrederickDefeat
source: Ah, a mighty capable child!\nLet me contribute to your allowance.$
translation: 啊，真是个有能力的小朋友。\n我来给你一点奖励吧。$

label: Route123_Text_FrederickPostBattle
source: Contribute to your allowance?\nWasn't the prize money enough?$
translation: 奖励？\n奖金还不够吗？$

label: Route123_Text_AlbertoIntro
source: I have to tell you, BIRD POKéMON\nare my obsession!\pBirds are cool!\nThey're the best!$
translation: 我要告诉你，我已经被\n鸟类宝可梦深深迷住了！\p鸟类宝可梦太酷了！\n它们是最棒的！$

label: Route123_Text_AlbertoDefeat
source: Even in defeat, BIRD POKéMON are cool!$
translation: 即便被打败了，\n鸟类宝可梦还是很酷！$

label: Route123_Text_AlbertoPostBattle
source: I gather BIRD POKéMON feathers that\nscatter during battles.\pI'm going to make a hat with\nBIRD POKéMON feathers.$
translation: 我一直在收集鸟类宝可梦\n在战斗中散落的羽毛。\p我想用鸟类宝可梦\n的羽毛来用一顶帽子。$

label: Route123_Text_EdIntro
source: When there are no TRAINERS around,\nI let my POKéMON battle each other.\lI watch them.$
translation: 附近没有训练家的时候，\n我就让我的宝可梦各自对打。\l然后我就在一边看着。$

label: Route123_Text_EdDefeat
source: I kind of like your POKéMON.$
translation: 我有点喜欢你的宝可梦。$

label: Route123_Text_EdPostBattle
source: Hehe, I'm swiping your battling ideas!\nI think they'll make me better.$
translation: 呵呵，我正在偷学你的战斗技巧。\n我想它们会让我有所提高的。$

label: Route123_Text_JonasIntro
source: I lay in ambush, and a TRAINER has\nlanded in my trap!$
translation: 我设了个埋伏，\n有个训练家落入了陷阱！$

label: Route123_Text_JonasDefeat
source: If you don't lose, how am I supposed\nto have fun playing ninja?$
translation: 如果你不失败，\n那我扮忍者还有什么意思？$

label: Route123_Text_JonasPostBattle
source: I'm going to ambush a weaker-looking\nTRAINER next time.$
translation: 下次我一定会埋伏一个\n看起来比较弱的训练家。$

label: Route123_Text_KayleyIntro
source: I just bought this parasol.\nMy cuteness should be up by a third!$
translation: 我刚刚买了这把阳伞。\n我的可爱也能上升3分之1了吧。$

label: Route123_Text_KayleyDefeat
source: You're better than me by about\nfive times!$
translation: 你比我厉害5倍！$

label: Route123_Text_KayleyPostBattle
source: Using accessories effectively is\nthe secret behind fashion appeal.$
translation: 巧妙搭配是流行\n时尚背后的秘密。$

label: Route124_Text_SpencerIntro
source: Hey, are you lost at sea?\pIf you can beat my POKéMON,\nI can serve as your pilot.$
translation: 你在大海里迷失方向了吗？\p如果你能赢得了我的宝可梦，\n我就帮你引路。$

label: Route124_Text_SpencerDefeat
source: I lost my bearings in battle!$
translation: 战斗中我迷失了方向！$

label: Route124_Text_SpencerPostBattle
source: Many people lose their bearings at sea.\pIf you're that sort, you should refer\nto the POKéNAV's MAP.$
translation: 很多人都会在大海里迷失方向。\p如果你也是那种类型，那你应该\n仰仗一下宝可导航的地图。$

label: Route124_Text_RolandIntro
source: Hm! You're riding a POKéMON instead\nof swimming yourself…\pI am envious!$
translation: 啊！你竟然坐在宝可梦上，\n不用自己游泳......\p太让人羡慕了！$

label: Route124_Text_RolandDefeat
source: Oh!\nI can't…$

label: Route124_Text_RolandPostBattle
source: I'm getting chilled…\nI've been in the water too long…\pI wish I could ride a POKéMON like you…$
translation: 我快被冻僵了......\n我在水里呆太久了......\p我真想像你一样骑着宝可梦......$

label: Route124_Text_JennyIntro
source: If you just float in the sea like\nthis, POKéMON come around to play.$
translation: 如果就像这样在海里漂浮着，\n宝可梦也会过来一起玩的。$

label: Route124_Text_JennyDefeat
source: Oh, darn.\nI've gone and lost.$
translation: 噢，糟糕。\n我输了。$

label: Route124_Text_JennyPostBattle
source: While swimming, I noticed that some\nPOKéMON attack, and some just watch.\pI guess POKéMON have personalities\nof their own.$
translation: 在游泳的时候，我注意到有些\n宝可梦会攻击，而有些只是旁观。\p我想宝可梦\n也有着它们自己的个性吧。$

label: Route124_Text_JennyRegister
source: It's only on a whim, but maybe I'll get\nyou to register me in your POKéNAV.$
translation: 虽然只是一时兴起，也许你可以\n把我登记到你的宝可导航里。$

label: Route124_Text_JennyRematchIntro
source: If you just float in the sea like this,\nTRAINERS challenge you!$
translation: 如果你就像这样在海里漂着，\n训练家会向你挑战的！$

label: Route124_Text_JennyRematchDefeat
source: That's strange…\nI lost again…$

label: Route124_Text_JennyPostRematch
source: This has nothing to do with anything,\nbut maybe I'll visit the TRICK HOUSE.$
translation: 虽然没什么理由，\n也许我会去戏法屋逛逛。$

label: Route124_Text_GraceIntro
source: I'm growing bored of swimming…\nHow about a battle?$
translation: 我游泳游得有些厌倦了......\n来一场对战如何？$

label: Route124_Text_GraceDefeat
source: I had no idea that you were\nthis strong!$
translation: 没想到你竟然这么强！$

label: Route124_Text_GracePostBattle
source: All the effort you put in must have\nmade you this strong.$
translation: 你会这么强，\n一定是你一直以来努力的结果。$

label: Route124_Text_ChadIntro
source: Fufufufu… I dive deep underwater\nto go deep under cover.\lPlumbing the depths is where I excel!$
translation: 嘿嘿，我可以潜到\n很深的水底下。\l深度就是我的优势！$

label: Route124_Text_ChadDefeat
source: Glub, glub, glub…\nI'm sinking…$

label: Route124_Text_ChadPostBattle
source: I have it on good authority that\nthere's a DIVE spot around here.\pIt gives me the urge to go deep\nagain…$
translation: 我绝对可以确定这附近\n有个潜水点。\p这让我又有了潜水\n的冲动了......$

label: Route124_Text_LilaIntro
source: LILA: Sigh…\pHere I am in the sea, but who's with me?\nMy little brother!\pLet's battle so I won't have to dwell\non that!$
translation: 佳子：唉......\p我来海边玩，可你猜陪我的人是谁？\n居然是我弟弟！\p我们对战一局吧，免得我总\n想着这件事！$

label: Route124_Text_LilaDefeat
source: LILA: ROY! It's your fault we lost!\nYou're in for it later!$
translation: 佳子：小勇！都是因为你才输的！\n看我回家后怎么收拾你！$

label: Route124_Text_LilaPostBattle
source: LILA: Sigh…\pIf only it wasn't my little brother\nnext to me, but a nice boyfriend…$
translation: 佳子：唉......\p如果陪在我旁边的不是我\n弟弟，而是男朋友该多好......$

label: Route124_Text_LilaNotEnoughMons
source: LILA: You're planning to battle us?\nNot unless you have two POKéMON.$
translation: 佳子：你想和我们对战？\n除非你有2只宝可梦。$

label: Route124_Text_RoyIntro
source: ROY: My big sister is tough at POKéMON!\pDon't cry when you lose!$
translation: 小勇：我姐姐可是宝可梦高手！\p输了的话可别哭鼻子！$

label: Route124_Text_RoyDefeat
source: ROY: Uh-oh…\nMy big sister will chew me out…$
translation: 小勇：啊--哦......\n我姐姐饶不了我的......$

label: Route124_Text_RoyPostBattle
source: ROY: My big sister is really scary\nwhen she gets angry.\pThat's why she doesn't have a\nboyfriend.$
translation: 小勇：我姐姐生气的时候\n真的很可怕。\p所以她才找不到\n男朋友。$

label: Route124_Text_LilaRoyRegister
source: ROY: Will you battle with us again?\nBut take it easy next time, okay?$
translation: 小勇：你下次能不能再和我们对战一局？\n但一定要手下留情，好吗？$

label: Route124_Text_RoyNotEnoughMons
source: ROY: Did you want to battle us?\nBring two POKéMON, then.$
translation: 小勇：想和我们对战？\n那就带2只宝可梦过来。$

label: Route124_Text_LilaRematchIntro
source: LILA: Sigh…\pHere I am in the sea, but who's with me?\nMy little brother!\pOh, hi, it's been a while. Let's battle\nso I won't have to dwell on things!$
translation: 佳子：唉......\p我来海边玩，可你猜陪我的人是谁？\n居然是我弟弟！\p哦，喂，好久不见了\n我们对战一局吧，\l免得我总想着这件事！$

label: Route124_Text_LilaRematchDefeat
source: LILA: ROY!\nIt's your fault we lost again!\pWe're having a training session later!$
translation: 佳子：小勇！\n这次又输了，还不都是因为你！\p过一会我们要进行一次特训！$

label: Route124_Text_LilaPostRematch
source: LILA: Sigh…\pIf I had a nice boyfriend, we'd beat\nanyone with lovely combinations…$
translation: 佳子：唉......\p如果我有个男朋友，\n爱情的力量将会战胜一切......$

label: Route124_Text_LilaRematchNotEnoughMons
source: LILA: You're planning to battle us?\nNot unless you have two POKéMON.$
translation: 佳子：你想和我们对战？\n除非你有2只宝可梦。$

label: Route124_Text_RoyRematchDefeat
source: ROY: Uh-oh…\nMy big sister will chew me out again.$
translation: 小勇：啊--哦......\n我姐姐不可能饶了我的。$

label: Route124_Text_RoyPostRematch
source: ROY: My big sister is really scary\nwhen she gets angry.\pShe's going to make me train really\nhard with POKéMON later…$
translation: 小勇：我姐姐生气的时候\n真的很可怕。\p她过一会要让我\n进行宝可梦特训......$

label: Route124_Text_RoyRematchNotEnoughMons
source: ROY: Did you want to battle us?\nBring two POKéMON, then.$
translation: 小勇：想和我们对战？\n那就带2只宝可梦过来。$

label: Route124_Text_DeclanIntro
source: Here I am swimming by my lonesome\non this wide, beautiful sea.\pThere's no other word for it.\nThis is pathetic!$
translation: 我独自一人在这片广阔优美\n的海上游泳。\p没有别的词汇形容这种感觉，\n真是太悲哀了！$

label: Route124_Text_DeclanDefeat
source: I'm feeling blue.\nBlue as the sky…$
translation: 我真的好忧郁。\n就如同这蓝天一般忧郁......$

label: Route124_Text_DeclanPostBattle
source: I should chat up lady SWIMMERS\nand invite them on a long swim.$
translation: 我应该和美女游泳者聊聊天\n并且邀请她们一同游泳。$

label: Route124_Text_IsabellaIntro
source: I'm not going to lose to some\nsurfer TRAINER.$
translation: 我不会输给漂在\n海上的训练家。$

label: Route124_Text_IsabellaDefeat
source: I've only got sweat in my eyes!\nI am not crying!$
translation: 只是汗水流进眼里了！\n我没哭！$

label: Route124_Text_IsabellaPostBattle
source: You can find pretty colored shards\nof things around here.$
translation: 你在这附近可以找到许多\n色彩鲜艳的碎片。$

label: Route125_Text_NolenIntro
source: I heard you approaching, so I hung\naround for you!$
translation: 我听到你要来了，\n于是就在附近等你！$

label: Route125_Text_NolenDefeat
source: I surrender!$
translation: 我投降！$

label: Route125_Text_NolenPostBattle
source: Sound travels faster in water than\nit does through air.$
translation: 声音在水中的传播速度\n比在空气中要快。$

label: Route125_Text_StanIntro
source: Hey, there!\nCheck out my sweet POKéMON!$
translation: 嘿，你！\n见识一下我可爱的宝可梦吧！$

label: Route125_Text_StanDefeat
source: I floundered…$

label: Route125_Text_StanPostBattle
source: I was blown away by HORSEA's charm,\nso I started swimming, too.$
translation: 我被墨海马的魅力所倾倒，\n所以也开始游泳了。$

label: Route125_Text_TanyaIntro
source: I'm tired of swimming.\nAre you up for a battle with me?$
translation: 我已经不想游泳了。\n想和我对战吗？$

label: Route125_Text_TanyaDefeat
source: You're too much!$
translation: 你太强了！$

label: Route125_Text_TanyaPostBattle
source: Whew…\nWhich way is it to MOSSDEEP CITY?$
translation: 呼......\n去绿岭市是哪条路？$

label: Route125_Text_SharonIntro
source: How would you like to take on the\nWATER-type POKéMON I raised?$
translation: 想不想和我养的\n水属性宝可梦对战？$

label: Route125_Text_SharonDefeat
source: Lost it…$

label: Route125_Text_SharonPostBattle
source: Your power… You're the real deal.\nI'm amazed!$
translation: 你的力量......你是真正的高手。\n我服了！$

label: Route125_Text_ErnestIntro
source: Ahoy! I'm a buff, tough SAILOR!\nI've braved the world's seas!$
translation: 喂！我是个强悍的水手！\n全世界的海洋我都去过！$

label: Route125_Text_ErnestDefeat
source: Gwrroooar!\nI couldn't win!$
translation: 哇啊啊啊！\n我赢不了！$

label: Route125_Text_ErnestPostBattle
source: The tide ebbs and flows inside the\nSHOAL CAVE.\pBy the way, it's about six hours from\nhigh tide to low tide. Did you know?$
translation: 在浅滩洞穴中的\n潮水时涨时退。\p顺便说一句，从涨潮到退潮要经过\n6小时的时间。你知道吗？$

label: Route125_Text_ErnestRegister
source: Register me in your POKéNAV,\nand I'll tell you something good.$
translation: 把我存入你的宝可导航，\n我会跟你讲些有趣的事。$

label: Route125_Text_ErnestRematchIntro
source: It's high time I get my payback\nfrom you! Come on, we're battling!$
translation: 该是和你算总帐的\n时候了！我们做个了断吧！$

label: Route125_Text_ErnestRematchDefeat
source: I couldn't win!\nI flat out couldn't win!$
translation: 我赢不了！\n根本就赢不了！$

label: Route125_Text_ErnestRematchPostBattle
source: The SHOAL CAVE…\pThere are places you can and can't\nget to depending on the rise and fall\lof the tide.\pBy the way, it's about six hours from\nhigh tide to low tide. Don't forget!$
translation: 浅滩洞穴......\p根据潮水的涨退\n你可以到达不同的地方。\p顺便说一句，从涨潮到退潮要经过\n6小时的时间。可别忘了！$

label: Route125_Text_KimIntro
source: KIM: A funny old man lives in the\nSHOAL CAVE. Someone told me.\lAre you going to see him, too?$
translation: 真穗：听说有一个\n怪老头住在浅滩洞穴里。\l你也想去见他吗？$

label: Route125_Text_KimDefeat
source: KIM: I thought we would win.$
translation: 真穗：我以为我们能赢的。$

label: Route125_Text_KimPostBattle
source: KIM: A funny old man lives in the\nSHOAL CAVE, doesn't he?\pLet's go see him, IRIS!$
translation: 真穗：有一个怪老头住在\n浅滩洞穴里，对不对？\p我们去见见他吧，奈穗！$

label: Route125_Text_KimNotEnoughMons
source: KIM: No, no, no! You need two POKéMON,\nor it's just no good!$
translation: 真穗：不，不，不！你需要2只宝可梦，\n不然没法打！$

label: Route125_Text_IrisIntro
source: IRIS: KIM, can you tell me what we're\nlooking for out here?$
translation: 奈穗：真穗，能说一下\n我们到底在找什么吗？$

label: Route125_Text_IrisDefeat
source: IRIS: Oh, we came sort of close.$
translation: 奈穗：哦，就差一点了。$

label: Route125_Text_IrisPostBattle
source: IRIS: KIM, are we really going into\nthe SHOAL CAVE?\lWe'll get all wet.$
translation: 奈穗：真穗，我们真的要去\n浅滩洞穴吗？\l衣服会被弄湿了。$

label: Route125_Text_IrisNotEnoughMons
source: IRIS: Oh, we could never, ever do\nanything like a 2-on-1 battle.$
translation: 奈穗：哦，我们绝对不会\n2挑1的。$

label: Route125_Text_PresleyIntro
source: Why would a BIRDKEEPER like me\ncome out to the sea?$
translation: 为什么我这种养鸟人\n会来海边？$

label: Route125_Text_PresleyDefeat
source: Okay.\nI'll tell you why I'm here.$
translation: 好吧。\n我就告诉你我为什么来这里。$

label: Route125_Text_PresleyPostBattle
source: I put a message in a bottle and put\nit out to sea.\pI'm sure that a girl SWIMMER will\nfind it!$
translation: 我把一张纸条塞进瓶子里\n扔到海中。\p我肯定一个美女游泳者\n会看到它的！$

label: Route125_Text_AuronIntro
source: Hey! Was it you throwing garbage\ninto the sea?$
translation: 嘿！是你往海里\n乱扔垃圾的吧？$

label: Route125_Text_AuronDefeat
source: Oh, you weren't throwing trash into\nthe sea.$
translation: 哦，看来垃圾\n不是你扔的。$

label: Route125_Text_AuronPostBattle
source: I found an unsightly bottle bobbing\nin the waves earlier.\pIt angers me that someone would\npollute the sea!$
translation: 刚才我在海浪中\n发现一个难看的瓶子。\p居然有人污染大海\n气死我了！$

label: Route126_Text_BarryIntro
source: Swimming is a full-body workout!\nYou will get fit!$
translation: 游泳可以锻炼身体全身的部位！\n你会变得更健康的！$

label: Route126_Text_BarryDefeat
source: I admit it!\nYou win!$
translation: 我认输！\n你赢了！$

label: Route126_Text_BarryPostBattle
source: Thanks to my daily swimming routine…\nLook! Feast your eyes on this physique!$
translation: 多亏我每天都游泳......\n瞧瞧我这身肌肉！$

label: Route126_Text_DeanIntro
source: This towering white mountain of rock\nis SOOTOPOLIS CITY.$
translation: 这座高耸的白色岩山\n就是琉璃市。$

label: Route126_Text_DeanDefeat
source: I was done in?$
translation: 我输了？$

label: Route126_Text_DeanPostBattle
source: I can't find the entrance to\nSOOTOPOLIS. Where could it be?$
translation: 我找不到通往琉璃市\n的入口。它到底在哪里？$

label: Route126_Text_NikkiIntro
source: Ufufufufu!\nI'm a mermaid!$
translation: 呵呵！\n我是美人鱼！$

label: Route126_Text_NikkiDefeat
source: My fantasy burst as if it were a bubble!\nBlub, blub, blub…$
translation: 我的幻想像泡沫一样消失了！\n像泡沫一样......$

label: Route126_Text_NikkiPostBattle
source: You thrashed me… I want to\ndisappear in a wave of despair…$
translation: 你击败了我......\n我只想在绝望的浪潮中消亡......$

label: Route126_Text_BrendaIntro
source: Hello, kiddo!\nWant a battle with me?$
translation: 嘿，小子！\n想和我对战吗？$

label: Route126_Text_BrendaDefeat
source: Oh, noooooh!$

label: Route126_Text_BrendaPostBattle
source: I love frolicking with POKéMON in\nthe sea like this!$
translation: 我很喜欢和宝可梦\n在海中嬉戏！$

label: Route126_Text_PabloIntro
source: Check out this sculpted body!\nI'm more cut than a BLACK BELT!$
translation: 瞧瞧这体格！\n我比黑带还强！$

label: Route126_Text_PabloDefeat
source: Whoops! Too strong!\nNot bad! Not bad at all!$
translation: 哇！太强了！\n不错！真不错！$

label: Route126_Text_PabloPostBattle
source: Losing to you stimulated my senses!\nI'll train myself and POKéMON harder!$
translation: 我的失败更加刺激了我！\n我要更努力地训练我和我的宝可梦！$

label: Route126_Text_PabloRegister
source: Yep, you're not bad at all!\nI'd like to get to know you more!$
translation: 嗯，你确实不错！\n我想进一步了解你！$

label: Route126_Text_PabloRematchIntro
source: Check out this beautiful body!\nI'm more shapely than a SWIMMER!$
translation: 看看这优美的体型！\n我比游泳者还要匀称！$

label: Route126_Text_PabloRematchDefeat
source: Whoops! Really too strong!\nNot bad! Not bad at all!$
translation: 哇！真的是太强了！\n不错！真不错！$

label: Route126_Text_PabloPostRematch
source: I'm going to train even harder!\nYou're a great motivator!\lYou have to come back again!$
translation: 我要更努力地锻炼自己！\n你就是我的动力！\l你以后一定要再来啊！$

label: Route126_Text_LeonardoIntro
source: I couldn't even swim last year,\nbut now I'm a decent SWIMMER.\pI think I'm capable of anything now.$
translation: 去年我都不会游泳，\n但现在我已经是一名不错的游泳者了。\p看来我什么事都能办到。$

label: Route126_Text_LeonardoDefeat
source: Sheesh, getting greedy didn't do\na thing for me.$
translation: 切，人太贪心\n就是不好啊。$

label: Route126_Text_LeonardoPostBattle
source: If you practice at something,\nyou will get better at it.\pYou're young--don't be afraid to\ntry all sorts of things!$
translation: 只要多练习，\n水平肯定会提高。\p你还年轻--\n不要害怕尝试！$

label: Route126_Text_IsobelIntro
source: If seawater gets up your nose,\ndoesn't it feel terrible?$
translation: 如果鼻子里进了海水，\n你不觉得难受吗？$

label: Route126_Text_IsobelDefeat
source: Ack! Why, you…\nGlub!$

label: Route126_Text_IsobelPostBattle
source: Ooh, I choked on some water!\nIt's bitter! It's salty!!$
translation: 哦，我被海水呛到了！\n又苦又咸！！$

label: Route126_Text_SiennaIntro
source: I'm throwing my whole heart\ninto this!$
translation: 我现在可是\n十分认真的！$

label: Route126_Text_SiennaDefeat
source: You had more heart!$
translation: 你比我更认真！$

label: Route126_Text_SiennaPostBattle
source: I need to cool down now…\nI think I'll go for a dive.$
translation: 我要冷静一下......\n还是去潜水吧。$

label: Route127_Text_CamdenIntro
source: I can see it in your face.\nYou want to challenge me.$
translation: 我从你的表情看出\n你想挑战我。$

label: Route127_Text_CamdenDefeat
source: Awawawawawa…$
translation: 啊哇哇哇哇......$

label: Route127_Text_CamdenPostBattle
source: A well-played match leaves me feeling\nrefreshed and serene.$
translation: 一场精彩的对战让我感到\n神清气爽，心绪平静。$

label: Route127_Text_DonnyIntro
source: Do you have a rival whom you just\nhate to lose against?$
translation: 你有没有什么对手\n是你不想输给的？$

label: Route127_Text_DonnyDefeat
source: Arrrgh!\nI hate losing!$
translation: 啊！\n我痛恨失败！$

label: Route127_Text_DonnyPostBattle
source: If you have a rival, don't you get the\nfeeling that you have to keep getting\lbetter?$
translation: 如果你有了对手\n你不觉得应该\l不断精进自己吗？$

label: Route127_Text_JonahIntro
source: Through fishing, I have attained a\nstate of becalmed serenity…\pPlease, allow me to demonstrate…$
translation: 通过钓鱼，\n我已经达到了心平气和的境界......\p请允许我展示一下吧......$

label: Route127_Text_JonahDefeat
source: Though I have lost, my heart remains\ncalm…$
translation: 虽然我输了，可我的心情\n依然平静......$

label: Route127_Text_JonahPostBattle
source: It matters not that I catch nothing.\nThe line remains in the water…$
translation: 钓不到东西并不要紧。\n钓鱼线始终在水里......$

label: Route127_Text_HenryIntro
source: Whoops! Don't tell me I snagged\na SURFING POKéMON?$
translation: 啊！我难道钓到了\n一只冲浪中的宝可梦？$

label: Route127_Text_HenryDefeat
source: I can't keep up!$
translation: 我撑不住了！$

label: Route127_Text_HenryPostBattle
source: It'd be a handful if I hooked\nyour tough POKéMON!$
translation: 我要是钓到了你的宝可梦\n可就麻烦了！$

label: Route127_Text_RogerIntro
source: Well, hey! This is a match between\na POKéMON fan and a fishing buff!$
translation: 嘿！这可是一场\n宝可梦迷和钓鱼迷之间的较量！$

label: Route127_Text_RogerDefeat
source: No! My line's all tangled!\nThe party's over!$
translation: 不！我的线都缠在一起了！\n全完了！$

label: Route127_Text_RogerPostBattle
source: My fishing line's doing a dance!\nThe tangle tango! Hahaha, snarl!$
translation: 我的钓鱼线在跳舞！\n多美的探戈！啊哈哈！$

label: Route127_Text_AidanIntro
source: BIRD POKéMON have excellent vision.\nThey spot prey from great heights.$
translation: 鸟类宝可梦视野比较开阔。\n它们从高处能够迅速发现猎物。$

label: Route127_Text_AidanDefeat
source: Whew… I give up.$

label: Route127_Text_AidanPostBattle
source: There're lots of diving spots in\nthe sea around here.\pYou can spot them easily from the sky\nbecause of their darker color.$
translation: 这一片海域有\n许多潜水点。\p这些潜水点的颜色较深\n你从空中一眼就能看出来。$

label: Route127_Text_KojiIntro
source: Run in your bare feet.\nThat will toughen up your soles!$
translation: 赤脚奔跑吧。\n这样可以锻炼你的脚底！$

label: Route127_Text_KojiDefeat
source: Yowch!\nI got a pebble under a toenail!$
translation: 啊！\n我的趾甲里进了一块石子！$

label: Route127_Text_KojiPostBattle
source: Going barefoot feels great.\nBut your RUNNING SHOES are cool, too.$
translation: 赤着脚走感觉确实舒服。\n不过你的跑鞋也很酷。$

label: Route127_Text_KojiRegister
source: This is what I do to people who beat me!\nI hope we can do this again.$
translation: 我向来是这样对待击败我的人！\n希望以后还能再来一次。$

label: Route127_Text_KojiRematchIntro
source: I still run in my bare feet daily.\nMy soles are tough!$
translation: 我现在仍然每天赤着脚奔跑。\n我的脚板更硬了！$

label: Route127_Text_KojiRematchDefeat
source: Yowch!\nPebbles dug into my arches!$
translation: 啊！\n石子硌到我的脚了！$

label: Route127_Text_KojiPostRematch
source: Want to go barefoot for a while?\nSo I can try your RUNNING SHOES?$
translation: 想不想赤着脚走走？\n好让我试试你的跑步鞋？$

label: Route127_Text_AthenaIntro
source: We should have a slow and methodical\nmatch.$
translation: 我们应该打一场\n具有策略性的对战。$

label: Route127_Text_AthenaDefeat
source: You didn't give me the chance to\ndo any strategizing.$
translation: 你根本就没给我\n分析局势的时间。$

label: Route127_Text_AthenaPostBattle
source: When I'm surrounded by the blue sea\nand sky, it feels as if time slows down.$
translation: 当我被大海和蓝天包围的时候，\n我感觉时间的流逝变得缓慢了。$

label: Route128_Text_IsaiahIntro
source: EVER GRANDE CITY is still a long ways\naway…$
translation: 到彩悠市还有很长\n一段距离......$

label: Route128_Text_IsaiahDefeat
source: My first victory seems to be far\naway, too…$
translation: 我的首胜离我似乎也有\n很长一段距离......$

label: Route128_Text_IsaiahPostBattle
source: My whole life has been about losing,\nbut I will never give up!$
translation: 我一生都在屡败屡战，\n但我绝不放弃！$

label: Route128_Text_IsaiahRegister
source: I know I'm not good now, but I think\nI can win eventually.\pPlease register me in your POKéNAV.$
translation: 我知道我现在还不行，\n但我最终肯定能够取得胜利。\p请在宝可导航登记我。$

label: Route128_Text_IsaiahRematchIntro
source: I'm still feeling good. I'll keep on\nswimming to EVER GRANDE CITY.$
translation: 我现在仍然感觉良好。\n我会一直游到彩悠市。$

label: Route128_Text_IsaiahRematchDefeat
source: I've yet to taste my first victory…$
translation: 我仍然没有尝到首胜的滋味......$

label: Route128_Text_IsaiahPostRematch
source: I'll eventually reach EVER GRANDE CITY\nwhere I can eventually win…$
translation: 我最终一定会到达彩悠市\n并且取得胜利......$

label: Route128_Text_KatelynIntro
source: You have to swim, cycle, and then run\na marathon in a triathlon.\pIt's a grueling race that consists\nof three events.$
translation: 铁人三项包括\n游泳，骑车和马拉松。\p这种包含三项的比赛\n十分艰难。$

label: Route128_Text_KatelynDefeat
source: A POKéMON battle is grueling, too…$
translation: 宝可梦对战也很艰难......$

label: Route128_Text_KatelynPostBattle
source: I have to ride a BIKE next, but…\nI'm about to throw in the towel…$
translation: 我接下来要骑自行车，可是......\n我想放弃了......$

label: Route128_Text_KatelynRegister
source: Well, I may as well make the best\nof this. I'd like a rematch sometime.$
translation: 嗯，我还是尽力而为吧。\n希望以后还能再比一次。$

label: Route128_Text_KatelynRematchIntro
source: A triathlon is long. But I guess the\nroad to become the POKéMON CHAMPION\lis also a long and grueling one.$
translation: 铁人三项很漫长。但我觉得\n通往宝可梦冠军的道路\l同样漫长艰辛。$

label: Route128_Text_KatelynRematchDefeat
source: A POKéMON battle really is harsh\nand unforgiving…$
translation: 宝可梦对战真的是\n残酷激烈啊......$

label: Route128_Text_KatelynPostRematch
source: You should give serious thought to\nchallenges on VICTORY ROAD.$
translation: 你应该认真考虑一下\n挑战冠军之路。$

label: Route128_Text_AlexaIntro
source: We've been working so hard to mount\na POKéMON LEAGUE challenge…\pWe can't afford to lose now!$
translation: 为了能够挑战宝可梦联盟\n我们已经十分努力了......\p怎么能在这种时候输掉呢！$

label: Route128_Text_AlexaDefeat
source: Oh!\nHow could this happen?!$
translation: 哦！\n怎么可能？！$

label: Route128_Text_AlexaPostBattle
source: After all I've done to get here,\nI won't give up after one setback.$
translation: 我已经拼到这里了，\n一个挫折不可能动摇我的决心。$

label: Route128_Text_RubenIntro
source: There is no stronger TRAINER than I!$
translation: 没有比我更强的训练家！$

label: Route128_Text_RubenDefeat
source: This can't be!$
translation: 不可能！$

label: Route128_Text_RubenPostBattle
source: There probably is no stronger TRAINER\nthan you!$
translation: 或许没有比你\n更强的训练家了！$

label: Route128_Text_WayneIntro
source: I want to visit EVER GRANDE, so I\ncaught myself a POKéMON that knows\lthe move WATERFALL to crest the falls.$
translation: 我想去彩悠，于是就捉了一只会攀瀑的\n宝可梦以便我登上瀑布。$

label: Route128_Text_WayneDefeat
source: I'm crestfallen!$
translation: 我好沮丧！$

label: Route128_Text_WaynePostBattle
source: Awww, phooey!\pMy POKéMON knows WATERFALL, but\nI don't have the SOOTOPOLIS GYM BADGE!$
translation: 啊啊啊啊！\p我的宝可梦会攀瀑，\n可是我却没有琉璃市道馆徽章！$

label: Route128_Text_HarrisonIntro
source: You're looking awfully tough.\nI wonder if I can win?$
translation: 你看上去真强。\n不知道我能不能赢。$

label: Route128_Text_HarrisonDefeat
source: Ouch!\nI guess it was impossible to win.$
translation: 哎哟！\n看来是不可能赢了。$

label: Route128_Text_HarrisonPostBattle
source: There are tough TRAINERS galore\naround EVER GRANDE.\pDo you think I may be out\nof my league?$
translation: 在彩悠市附近\n有许多很强的训练家。\p我和他们是不是不在\n一个等级上？$

label: Route128_Text_CarleeIntro
source: The sunlight seems to be more harsh\nin this area.$
translation: 这里的阳光似乎\n更强烈一些。$

label: Route128_Text_CarleeDefeat
source: I couldn't see very well because of\nthe sun's glare.$
translation: 阳光太刺眼了，\n我什么都看不清。$

label: Route128_Text_CarleePostBattle
source: I should go back soon.\nI need to reapply my sunscreen.$
translation: 我得回去了。\n我要再抹一些防晒霜。$

label: Route129_Text_ChaseIntro
source: This is my first triathlon.\nI'm all tense and nervous!$
translation: 这是我第一次参加铁人三项。\n紧张死了！$

label: Route129_Text_ChaseDefeat
source: Wroooaaar!\nI failed to win!$
translation: 啊啊啊啊！\n我没能赢！$

label: Route129_Text_ChasePostBattle
source: If I'm all tensed up, I won't be able to\ngive it my all.$
translation: 我如果太紧张的话，\n就无法发挥全部实力了。$

label: Route129_Text_AllisonIntro
source: I'm in the middle of a triathlon,\nbut, sure, why don't we battle?$
translation: 我正在参加铁人三项，\n不过我们为什么不来场对战呢？$

label: Route129_Text_AllisonDefeat
source: I was sure I'd win!$
translation: 我还以为肯定能赢呢！$

label: Route129_Text_AllisonPostBattle
source: Do you know what's the greatest thing\nabout triathlons?\pTesting the limits of your own\nstrength and endurance against\lMother Nature!$
translation: 你知道参加铁人三项\n最大的好处是什么吗？\p就是测试自己力量的\n极限以及对自然的耐力！$

label: Route129_Text_ReedIntro
source: Say hey, hey!\nLet's get on with it!$
translation: 嘿，嘿！\n我们来吧！$

label: Route129_Text_ReedDefeat
source: Beat, I'm beaten.\nThat's it, done!$
translation: 我，我输了。\n就这样结束了！$

label: Route129_Text_ReedPostBattle
source: There's nothing for a loser.\nTime for me to beat it home.$
translation: 输了的话什么都得不到。\n我该回家了。$

label: Route129_Text_TishaIntro
source: What's the hurry?\nLet's take it slow and easy.$
translation: 为什么那么急？\n不要着急，慢慢来吧。$

label: Route129_Text_TishaDefeat
source: Oh, my.\nI wanted to relax a little more…$
translation: 噢，天哪，\n我想再休息一会儿......$

label: Route129_Text_TishaPostBattle
source: Don't you hate making mistakes when\nyou're in a rush?\pThat's why I try to take things\nslowly.$
translation: 想想看，在急急忙忙做事的\n时候突然犯了点错误的话，\l就会觉得很心烦吧？\p所以我做事一直\n尽力放慢脚步。$

label: Route129_Text_ClarenceIntro
source: Surfing isn't as easy as it seems,\nisn't that right?$
translation: 冲浪并不像看上去\n那么简单，不是吗？$

label: Route129_Text_ClarenceDefeat
source: Winning sure isn't easy.$
translation: 要想赢当然没那么简单。$

label: Route129_Text_ClarencePostBattle
source: You have your sights on the POKéMON\nLEAGUE? Keep at it!$
translation: 你的目标是宝可梦\n联盟？努力加油吧！$

label: Route130_Text_RodneyIntro
source: What a surprise! I didn't expect to\nsee a TRAINER out in the sea.\pI think we should battle!$
translation: 让我吃了一惊呢！\n没想到在大海中也能碰见训练家！\p来对战吧！$

label: Route130_Text_RodneyDefeat
source: This kid's awfully tough…$
translation: 这个孩子真强啊......$

label: Route130_Text_RodneyPostBattle
source: Your eyes have that look of someone\nwho's experienced harsh challenges\land won. It suits you well!$
translation: 你的眼神看上去就像那经历过\n艰苦的试炼并最终取得胜利的人一样。\l很适合你！$

label: Route130_Text_KatieIntro
source: In the deep blue sea,\nmy shattered blue heart finds\lcomfort among waves.$
translation: 身处深邃的蓝色大海之中，\n我忧郁而破碎的心\l在海浪之间找到了归宿。$

label: Route130_Text_KatieDefeat
source: Like the vast blue sea,\nthe world of POKéMON spans\ldepths beyond belief.$
translation: 宝可梦的世界比之人们的想象\n更加广袤而邈远，\l就像这无垠的大海一样。$

label: Route130_Text_KatiePostBattle
source: The world's children dream\nof one day becoming\lthe POKéMON CHAMPION.$
translation: 世界上的孩子们都\n梦想着有一天能够成为\l宝可梦冠军。$

label: Route130_Text_SantiagoIntro
source: Floating on the open sea like this…\nIt's peaceful.$
translation: 像这样漂浮在宽广的大海上......\n心里感觉无比宁静。$

label: Route130_Text_SantiagoDefeat
source: I needed to be a little less peaceful!$
translation: 我的心过于宁静了！$

label: Route130_Text_SantiagoPostBattle
source: Swimming and battling like this…\nI'm one happy guy…$
translation: 像这个样子游泳和对战......\n心里感觉特别快乐......$

label: Route131_Text_RichardIntro
source: The sea is teeming with POKéMON.\nIt's not easy swimming, I tell you.$
translation: 大海中到处都是宝可梦。\n告诉你，在海里游泳可不容易。$

label: Route131_Text_RichardDefeat
source: POKéMON raised by TRAINERS are\nseriously tough…$
translation: 训练家培育的宝可梦\n真的非常强大......$

label: Route131_Text_HermanIntro
source: The sea… The sea… The sea…\nThe sea as far as these eyes can see!\lI'm sick and tired of the sea!$
translation: 大海......大海......大海......\n放眼望过去全都是海！\l我开始受够大海了！$

label: Route131_Text_HermanDefeat
source: Bleah!$
translation: 呀啊！$

label: Route131_Text_HermanPostBattle
source: Bored I am by the sea, but swim I must.\pI'm a born swimmer!\nThat's what I am.$
translation: 我受够了海，\n但我还会继续游下去。\p我是为了游泳而生的！\n这就是我！$

label: Route131_Text_SusieIntro
source: Hi, sweetie, wait!\nWe should battle, you and I!$
translation: 嗨，亲，稍等一下！\n来对战吧，你我两人！$

label: Route131_Text_SusieDefeat
source: You're tough in spite of the way\nyou look!$
translation: 和看上去的不一样，\n你真的很强！$

label: Route131_Text_SusiePostBattle
source: Did you see a guy over there who whines\nthat he's bored of the sea?\pThat's all talk.\nHe's hopelessly in love with the sea!$
translation: 你见到附近那个整天抱怨\n说他讨厌大海的家伙了吗？\p他只是说说，\n他已经无可救药地爱上大海了！$

label: Route131_Text_KaraIntro
source: Why do men love bathing suits so much?\pThey all ogle me!$
translation: 男人为什么都喜欢泳装？\p他们都在盯着我看！$

label: Route131_Text_KaraDefeat
source: I'm out of my depth!$
translation: 我赢不了！$

label: Route131_Text_KaraPostBattle
source: Maybe it's not my bathing suit that\nmakes men look. It must be my beauty!$
translation: 也许吸引了别人的目光的不是\n我的泳装，而是我的美貌啊！$

label: Route131_Text_ReliIntro
source: RELI: We'll work together as siblings\nto take you on!$
translation: 亚美：我们两个会\n齐心协力对付你的！$

label: Route131_Text_ReliDefeat
source: RELI: We couldn't win even though we\nworked together…$
translation: 亚美：就算齐心协力，\n我们还是赢不了......$

label: Route131_Text_ReliPostBattle
source: RELI: The people of PACIFIDLOG are\ntogether with the sea and POKéMON from\lthe time they are born.$
translation: 亚美：暮水镇的人们\n从出生的那一刻就一直跟\l大海和宝可梦为伴。$

label: Route131_Text_ReliNotEnoughMons
source: RELI: You don't have two POKéMON?\nWe can't enjoy a battle, then.$
translation: 亚美：你没带足2只宝可梦？\n真可惜，这样就不能对战了。$

label: Route131_Text_IanIntro
source: IAN: I'm doing my best together with\nmy sis!$
translation: 胜：我要努力地和姐姐\n一起战斗！$

label: Route131_Text_IanDefeat
source: IAN: I did my best with my sis,\nbut we still couldn't win…$
translation: 胜：我和姐姐都努力了，\n但我们还是输了......$

label: Route131_Text_IanPostBattle
source: IAN: You know how PACIFIDLOG is\na floating town?\pSo, wherever there is the sea,\nthat's a part of PACIFIDLOG!$
translation: 胜：你知道那个被称作\n漂浮的小镇的暮水镇吗？\p凡是有大海的地方，\n都是暮水镇的一部分！$

label: Route131_Text_IanNotEnoughMons
source: IAN: If you have two POKéMON,\nwe'll take you on!$
translation: 胜：假如你有2只宝可梦，\n我们就可以和你对战了！$

label: Route131_Text_TaliaIntro
source: If you can beat me, I'll give you some\ngreat information!$
translation: 你能打败我的话，\n我就告诉你一些好事情。$

label: Route131_Text_TaliaDefeat
source: Oh?\nDid I lose?$
translation: 哦？\n我输了？$

label: Route131_Text_TaliaPostBattle
source: There is an odd place nearby.\nThere's a huge tower there.\lWhy don't you go take a look?$
translation: 这附近有一个奇怪的地方，\n那里有一座巨大的塔。\l不想去看看吗？$

label: Route131_Text_KevinIntro
source: The people of PACIFIDLOG are\na peaceful bunch.\pThey never get angry.\nThat goes for me, too.$
translation: 暮水镇居民\n是爱好和平的。\p他们从来不生气。\n我也一样。$

label: Route131_Text_KevinDefeat
source: Oops!$
translation: 呀啊！$

label: Route131_Text_KevinPostBattle
source: Tch! …Oh, wait.\nI'm not angry. Honestly!\pBut, boy, you're strong!\nHahaha!$
translation: 嘁！......啊，不，\n我没有生气，真的！\p不过，你还真强！\n哈哈哈！$

label: Route132_Text_GilbertIntro
source: I used to catch colds all the time as\na kid, but I became totally fit after\lI started swimming.$
translation: 我小的时候经常感冒，\n但开始学习游泳之后，\l就再也没生过病。$

label: Route132_Text_GilbertDefeat
source: I crave more power…$
translation: 我的力量还不够......$

label: Route132_Text_GilbertPostBattle
source: TRAINERS travel the fields and\nmountains, so they must be fit, too.$
translation: 训练家旅行中要经常\n翻山越岭，他们一定也很健康。$

label: Route132_Text_DanaIntro
source: I try not to swim where the currents\nare too strong.$
translation: 我尽量不去海流\n比较急的地方游泳。$

label: Route132_Text_DanaDefeat
source: Oh, please, no!$
translation: 啊，不要，不！$

label: Route132_Text_DanaPostBattle
source: If I get swept away, I'll lose all my\nsense of place…$
translation: 要是被冲走的话，\n我肯定会找不到方向的......$

label: Route132_Text_RonaldIntro
source: Win or lose, you'll never know until\nyou try!$
translation: 不去尝试一下的话，\n你永远不知道你会输还是会赢！$

label: Route132_Text_RonaldDefeat
source: Waah!\nI sank in defeat!$
translation: 哇啊啊！\n我被打败了！$

label: Route132_Text_RonaldPostBattle
source: I never battle when I know I'll win.\nI like to battle at the razor's edge of\lvictory and defeat!$
translation: 我决不去打稳操胜券的对战，\n我喜欢那种胜败悬于一线间的感觉！$

label: Route132_Text_KiyoIntro
source: I contemplate POKéMON 24 hours a day.\nHow could you possibly beat me?$
translation: 我每天24小时都在\n思考关于宝可梦的事情，\l你认为你能打败我吗？$

label: Route132_Text_KiyoDefeat
source: I lose.\nI will concede defeat.$
translation: 我承认，我输了。$

label: Route132_Text_KiyoPostBattle
source: Urggh…\nYou're a POKéMON fanatic, aren't you?\pYou must contemplate POKéMON 24 hours\na day, don't you?$
translation: 呃......\n你也是个宝可梦迷吗？\p你一定也是每天24小时都在\n思考关于宝可梦的事情吧？$

label: Route132_Text_MakaylaIntro
source: I'm always with my husband,\nbut I can win even without him.$
translation: 我一直都和老头子在一起，\n但就算他不在，我也一样能赢。$

label: Route132_Text_MakaylaDefeat
source: Oh, I guess I wasn't good enough.$
translation: 啊，我想我还不够强。$

label: Route132_Text_JonathanIntro
source: Someone's been watching me intently.\nWas it you?$
translation: 好像有人一直在盯着我看，\n是你吗？$

label: Route132_Text_JonathanDefeat
source: Wow!\nThat's pretty strong, all right!$
translation: 哇！真强啊！$

label: Route132_Text_JonathanPostBattle
source: I can't shake this feeling that\nsomeone's watching me.\pI can't concentrate!$
translation: 我总是摆脱不掉那种\n被人盯着的感觉。\p没办法集中精力啊！$

label: Route132_Text_PaxtonIntro
source: Now where could my wife have gone?\nI'm always with her.\lI wonder if I can win on my own.$
translation: 老太婆去哪儿了呢？\n我一直都和她在一起的，\l不知道没有她我还能不能赢。$

label: Route132_Text_PaxtonDefeat
source: Ah, I see that I couldn't manage\nto win on my own after all.$
translation: 哎，只有我一个人\n终归是赢不了啊。$

label: Route132_Text_PaxtonPostBattle
source: My wife must be looking for me.\nI'd best go find her right away.$
translation: 老太婆一定在找我吧，\n我也得赶紧去找她了。$

label: Route132_Text_DarcyIntro
source: I liked training here by myself.\nIt's awful that all these people came!$
translation: 我喜欢自己一个人在这里训练，\n但总有人在这里转来转去！$

label: Route132_Text_DarcyDefeat
source: Okay! I won't complain about other\npeople being here.$
translation: 好吧，别人来这里\n我不抱怨就是了。$

label: Route132_Text_DarcyPostBattle
source: I suppose I can partner up with that\nold man and challenge that other team.$
translation: 我想我大概可以和那边的\n老爷爷组队一起挑战别人。$

label: Route133_Text_FranklinIntro
source: Did the currents carry you here, too?\nThis must have been fated.\lLet's battle!$
translation: 你也是被海流冲到这儿来的吗？\n这一定就是命运了。\l对战吧！$

label: Route133_Text_FranklinDefeat
source: Strong!\nToo much so!$
translation: 真强！\n我打不过你！$

label: Route133_Text_FranklinPostBattle
source: It's just my luck that a tough TRAINER\nlike you would drift here…\lI must be cursed…$
translation: 像你这么强大的训练家\n漂流到了这里，也是我的运气......\l我一定是被诅咒了吧......$

label: Route133_Text_DebraIntro
source: I've led a life of woe and misery…\nI've been cast away, and this is where\lI've drifted…$
translation: 我的一生都在痛苦与悲伤中度过......\n我一直在漂流，漂流，\l最后漂到了这里......$

label: Route133_Text_DebraDefeat
source: Another loss…$
translation: 再一次失败了......$

label: Route133_Text_DebraPostBattle
source: A life adrift…\nI don't want it anymore!$
translation: 这漂流的一生......\n我受够了！$

label: Route133_Text_LindaIntro
source: Welcome!\nI've been expecting you!$
translation: 欢迎！\n我一直在等你！$

label: Route133_Text_LindaDefeat
source: No! Please!$
translation: 啊啊，不要！$

label: Route133_Text_LindaPostBattle
source: A strong child TRAINER…\nThat's so annoying!$
translation: 这么强的孩子......\n真让人火大啊！$

label: Route133_Text_WarrenIntro
source: I want to win like everyone else, but I\nwon't raise POKéMON like everyone else.$
translation: 我和别人一样想要赢，\n但我不会和别人一样去培育宝可梦。$

label: Route133_Text_WarrenDefeat
source: Darn it!\nMy way is still too slack!$
translation: 可恶！\n太大意了！$

label: Route133_Text_WarrenPostBattle
source: It's way more fun to do things the way\nI want than to be like everybody else.\lI mean, that's obvious!$
translation: 按自己的想法做事比随波逐流\n要快乐得多，\l我觉得这显而易见！$

label: Route133_Text_BeckIntro
source: I came all the way out here with my\nBIRD POKéMON.$
translation: 我一直和我的鸟类宝可梦\n一同旅行。$

label: Route133_Text_BeckDefeat
source: You…\nYou're stunningly cool!$

label: Route133_Text_BeckPostBattle
source: I'd like to go back to FORTREE,\nbut I've grown to like this place, too.$
translation: 我差不多该回茵郁市去了，\n但我已经喜欢上了这个地方。$

label: Route133_Text_MollieIntro
source: I must have battled thousands\nof times. I've lost count.$
translation: 我大概已经对战了几千次了，\n我自己都数不清了。$

label: Route133_Text_MollieDefeat
source: I may have lost thousands of times,\nbut a loss still stings.$
translation: 我大概已经输了几千次了，\n但现在还是在输。$

label: Route133_Text_MolliePostBattle
source: Keep at this, youngster. So you can\nbecome like my husband and me.$
translation: 就这样加油吧，年轻人，总有一天\n你也会成为我们这样的高手的。$

label: Route133_Text_ConorIntro
source: Young people are too happy to go with\nthe flow. They're without direction.$
translation: 年轻人喜欢追随潮流，\n却没有自己的目标。$

label: Route133_Text_ConorDefeat
source: You have a firm sense of purpose.$
translation: 看来你有坚定的目标啊。$

label: Route133_Text_ConorPostBattle
source: Don't let others lead you astray.\nDon't lose direction as you grow older.$
translation: 不要让别人把你引离正道，\n成长的过程中不要忘记你的目标。$

label: Route134_Text_JackIntro
source: Even those POKéMON that can swim are\ncarried along by the rapid currents.$
translation: 即使会游泳的宝可梦\n也无法逆激流而行。$

label: Route134_Text_JackDefeat
source: Aiyeeeeh!$
translation: 呀啊啊啊！$

label: Route134_Text_JackPostBattle
source: I think POKéMON enjoy the fast-running\ncurrents around these parts.$
translation: 我想宝可梦大概很喜欢\n这里湍急的水流。$

label: Route134_Text_LaurelIntro
source: My LUVDISC are looking for a fun\nmatch. Will you join us?$
translation: 和我的爱心鱼们\n来一场愉快的对战吧！$

label: Route134_Text_LaurelDefeat
source: Oopsie!$
translation: 哇啊！$

label: Route134_Text_LaurelPostBattle
source: There's a collector who's after\nthe SCALES of LUVDISC.$
translation: 据说有个收藏家专门收集\n心之鳞片。$

label: Route134_Text_AlexIntro
source: Okeydokey! That's enough rest, gang!\nIt's time for a match!$
translation: 好了好了，休息够了，伙计！\n现在要开始战斗了！$

label: Route134_Text_AlexDefeat
source: Tuckered out again…$

label: Route134_Text_AlexPostBattle
source: My BIRD POKéMON get tired quickly after\na long flight…$
translation: 长途飞行的话我的鸟类宝可梦\n很快就会累......$

label: Route134_Text_HitoshiIntro
source: You're a POKéMON TRAINER.\nNo need for words. We battle now.$
translation: 你是宝可梦训练家，\n无需多言，对战吧。$

label: Route134_Text_HitoshiPostBattle
source: It was I who challenged you, and yet\nI lost. I am deeply shamed…$
translation: 是我主动发起挑战，结果却输了，\n真是惭愧......$

label: Route134_Text_AaronIntro
source: The savage tide in this area serves to\nmake us stronger than ever.$
translation: 在这汹涌的巨浪中训练\n能让我们比以前更强。$

label: Route134_Text_AaronDefeat
source: I willingly concede defeat.$
translation: 我认输。$

label: Route134_Text_AaronPostBattle
source: We will return for more training at\nMETEOR FALLS.\pIf you'd like, you should go, too.\nIt will definitely toughen you up!$
translation: 我们要回流星瀑布\n加强训练了。\p有时间的话，你也该去那里，\n肯定能让你的实力大大提升！$

label: Route134_Text_KelvinIntro
source: O-our boat!\nThe tide carried it away!$
translation: 我--我们的船！\n浪把它卷走了！$

label: Route134_Text_KelvinDefeat
source: Awawawawah!\nPlease, stop! Please!$
translation: 哇哇哇哇！\n停下，拜托，快停下！$

label: Route134_Text_KelvinPostBattle
source: If we can't SURF, how are we supposed\nto get home?\pActually, I know a fainted POKéMON\ncan still SURF, but it feels wrong.$
translation: 如果我们不会冲浪，\n该怎么回家啊。\p实际上，我知道昏厥的宝可梦\n仍然能冲浪，但感觉有点奇怪吧？$

label: Route134_Text_MarleyIntro
source: Can your POKéMON dodge our\nlightning-quick attacks?$
translation: 你的宝可梦能躲过我们\n闪电般的攻击吗？$

label: Route134_Text_MarleyDefeat
source: I never knew such a technique existed!\nYou've defeated us thoroughly.$
translation: 我从来没见过那样的技术！\n我们彻底输掉了。$

label: Route134_Text_MarleyPostBattle
source: I haven't lost my passion for speed.\nI will try harder.$
translation: 追求速度的激情还没有消失，\n我还会更努力的。$

label: Route134_Text_ReynaIntro
source: My POKéMON can't be taken down\neasily!$
translation: 我的宝可梦是不会\n被轻易打败的！$

label: Route134_Text_ReynaDefeat
source: You're kidding!\nExplain how I lost!$
translation: 开玩笑吧！\n我怎么会输！$

label: Route134_Text_ReynaPostBattle
source: Haha!\nYou won, all right!\pI'll work my way back up by taking on\nTRAINERS I happen to meet!$
translation: 哈哈！\n好吧，你赢了！\p我要打败偶遇的每个\n训练家来重新奋起！$

label: Route134_Text_HudsonIntro
source: Listen, have you seen another SAILOR\naround here?$
translation: 喂，你在这附近看到\n别的水手了吗？$

label: Route134_Text_HudsonDefeat
source: Now, that's something!$
translation: 啊，真厉害！$

label: Route134_Text_HudsonPostBattle
source: Our boat drifted out to sea.\pMy buddy's a timid fellow, so I'm\nworried about him.$
translation: 我们的船漂到海里去了。\p我的搭档比较胆小，\n现在我很担心他。$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_InterviewRequest
source:
Oh, hello! You were in a POKéMON
CONTEST, weren't you?\lIt's easy to tell from your POKéMON.\pI'm a reporter. I'm working on a story
on POKéMON CONTESTS.\pIf I may, would you be willing to answer
a few questions?$
translation:
啊，你好！
你刚参加过华丽大赛对吧？\l从你的宝可梦就能看出来呢。\p我是一名记者，正在做一篇关于
宝可梦华丽大赛的报道。\p可以请你回答
几个问题吗？？$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_DescribeContest
source: Oh, you will?\nThank you.\pBriefly, how would you describe the\nCONTEST you just entered?$
translation: 啊，愿意接受采访吗？\n太感谢了。\p简单来说，你怎么看待你刚才\n参加的华丽大赛？$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_WhatImageWhenYouHearX
source:
Ah, I see.
That's a very edifying comment.\pYou get a good feel for what
the CONTEST was like.\pI've got one last question.\pWhen you hear the word “{STR_VAR_2},”
what image do you get?$
translation:
原来如此。
真是很有启发的回答。\p让我对这场华丽大赛
有了很好的了解。\p最后还有一个问题。\p当你听到"{STR_VAR_2}"这个词时，
脑海中会浮现什么画面？$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ThatsAllForInterview
source:
I see!\pSo that's how you imagine the concept
of “{STR_VAR_2}” to be.\pThank you!
You've given me some good ideas.\pI think I can write a good story on
POKéMON CONTESTS now.\pMaybe, just maybe, this story will even
make it to television.\lI hope you'll look forward to it!$
translation:
我明白了！\p原来你是这样理解
"{STR_VAR_2}"的啊。\p非常感谢！
你给了我很多灵感。\p现在我应该能写出
一篇精彩的华丽大赛报道了。\p说不定这篇报道还能上电视呢。
敬请期待哦！$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_PleaseDoShareStoryWithMe
source: Oh, too bad…\pWell, if you come across a good story,\nplease do share it with me.$
translation: 啊，真遗憾......\p不过如果你遇到精彩的故事，\n请一定要告诉我呀。$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_LookingForwardToNextContest
source: I'll be looking forward to your next\nPOKéMON CONTEST.$
translation: 我会期待你下次的\n宝可梦华丽大赛表现。$

label: gTVBravoTrainerText00
source:
Yeah!
It's BRAVO TRAINER time!\pToday, we're going to profile a POKéMON
belonging to {STR_VAR_1}.\pNow, this POKéMON boasts a {STR_VAR_3}
Rank in the {STR_VAR_2} Category.$
translation:
太好了！
现在是BRAVO训练家时间！\p今天我们所要介绍的
主角就是{STR_VAR_1}。\p现在，这只宝可梦在{STR_VAR_2}
比赛中荣获{STR_VAR_3}优胜。$

label: gTVBravoTrainerText01
source: Introducing {STR_VAR_2} the\n{STR_VAR_1}!\pThe nickname {STR_VAR_2}…\pEven the nickname exudes an air that\nproclaims “{STR_VAR_3}”!$
translation: 现在开始介绍{STR_VAR_1}的\n{STR_VAR_2}！\p昵称是{STR_VAR_2}......\p光是昵称就散发着\n一种"{STR_VAR_3}"的气氛啊！$

label: gTVBravoTrainerText02
source: Anyway, when the TRAINER {STR_VAR_1}\nentered the POKéMON in a CONTEST,\lwe managed to get a few impassioned\lquotes about the trusty partner.$
translation: 那么，当训练家{STR_VAR_1}带着\n这只宝可梦参加华丽大赛的时候，\l我们记录了一些关于这位\l可靠的伙伴的热情发言。$

label: gTVBravoTrainerText03
source:
Asked about the CONTEST afterwards,
{STR_VAR_1} happily replied with a huge\lgrin, “{STR_VAR_2}!”\pWell, sure, {STR_VAR_1}'s POKéMON came in
number {STR_VAR_3} in the CONTEST.\pThat line perfectly suits {STR_VAR_1}
right now, I'd say!$
translation:
赛后采访时，
{STR_VAR_1}带着笑容高兴地答道：\l"{STR_VAR_2}！"\p当然了，因为{STR_VAR_1}的宝可梦在
华丽大赛中获得了第{STR_VAR_3}名嘛。\p现在来说，那个台词
确实非常适合{STR_VAR_1}！$

label: gTVBravoTrainerText04
source:
Asked about the CONTEST afterwards,
{STR_VAR_1} replied with a tinge of\lbitterness, “{STR_VAR_2}.”\pWell, sure, {STR_VAR_1}'s POKéMON came in
number {STR_VAR_3} in the CONTEST.\p{STR_VAR_1}'s disappointment comes across
loud and clear, I'd say!$
translation:
赛后采访时，
{STR_VAR_1}带着苦涩淡淡地答道：\l"{STR_VAR_2}！"\p当然了，因为{STR_VAR_1}的宝可梦在
华丽大赛中获得了第{STR_VAR_3}名嘛。\p{STR_VAR_1}的失望之情
完全表现其中了！$

label: gTVBravoTrainerText05
source:
Wouldn't you also like to know what
{STR_VAR_1} imagines {STR_VAR_2} to be?\pYou bet we did!
So we asked, of course!\pThe answer is all perfectly condensed:
“{STR_VAR_3}!”\pThat's what the concept of {STR_VAR_2}
represents to {STR_VAR_1}!$
translation:
你不想知道{STR_VAR_1}
想象中的{STR_VAR_2}是什么样子吗？\p很想知道吧！
当然，我们问了！\p答案完美地用一句话概括：
"{STR_VAR_3}！"\p这就是{STR_VAR_1}心目中
{STR_VAR_2}代表的意义！$

label: gTVBravoTrainerText06
source: The last move {STR_VAR_2} used by\nthe {STR_VAR_1} is entirely about\l“{STR_VAR_3}”!$
translation: 最后{STR_VAR_1}所使用的\n{STR_VAR_2}完全体现了\l"{STR_VAR_3}"！$

label: gTVBravoTrainerText07
source:
Bravo, {STR_VAR_1}!
Bravo, {STR_VAR_2}!\pI hope we can count on seeing
{STR_VAR_1} scale even greater heights!\pThat's all the time we have!
Until next time, see you!$
translation:
好啊，{STR_VAR_1}！
妙啊，{STR_VAR_2}！\p希望我们能看到{STR_VAR_1}
达到一个更高的水平！\p那么这次就到此为止了！
我们下次再见！$

label: gTVBravoTrainerText08
source: Introducing the TRAINER's {STR_VAR_1}!$
translation: 隆重介绍训练家的{STR_VAR_1}！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_InterviewRequest
source:
Hello! You're the TRAINER who just had
a battle, right?\pI'm gathering interviews with TRAINERS
all over the place.\pMay I get a few words from you about
your impressions on battling?$
translation:
啊！你是刚刚结束
比赛的训练家吧？\p我正在到处收集面向
训练家的采访。\p您能跟我谈一谈
有关对战的感想吗？$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_HowDidBattleTowerTurnOut
source:
You will? Really?
Thank you!\lThen, uh…\pHow did things turn out in
the BATTLE TOWER today?\pWere you satisfied with the battle?
Or are you unhappy?$
translation:
你愿意？真的？
太感谢了！\l这个......\p今天在对战塔的
战况如何？\p你对对战结果满意吗？
还是不太开心？$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_SorryWeDisturbedYou
source: Oh…\nSorry we disturbed you.\pPlease give us an interview the next\ntime you visit the BATTLE TOWER.$
translation: 哦......\n很抱歉打扰你了。\p下次来对战塔时\n请接受我们的采访吧。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_ObviousYouHadGreatBattle
source: Well, of course!\pThat unmistakable look of satisfaction\non your face…\pIt's obvious that you've had a great\nbattle.$
translation: 啊，当然啦！\p你脸上那显而易见的\n满意的表情......\p很明显你经历了一场\n精彩的对战。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_DifficultToMakeBattleTurnOutAsPlanned
source: Oh, I see…\pWell, it certainly is difficult to make a\nbattle turn out exactly as planned.$
translation: 哦，我知道了......\p想让对战完全按计划进行\n并不是件容易的事。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_DescribeYourBattle
source: Oh, oh, may I ask one more question?\pIf you were to describe your\nimpressions about this battle with\lone saying, what would it be?$
translation: 哦，能再问你个问题吗？\p如果用一句话描述\n你对这场对战的印象，\l你会说些什么？$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_ThatsGreatLine
source: Oh, that is stunningly cool!\pThat's a great line!\nI hope you'll do great next time, too.\pI hope to see you again!$
translation: 哇，太酷了！\p这句话说得真棒！\n希望你下次也能表现精彩。\p期待再次见到你！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_SilentType
source: Oh, I see…\pStill, being the silent type is also\ncool, isn't it?\pI hope you'll give me the opportunity\nto share your thoughts again!$
translation: 哦，这样啊......\p不过沉默寡言\n也很酷，对吧？\p希望下次还有机会\n听到你的想法！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_LookingForwardToNextBattle
source: I'll be looking forward to your\nnext battle!$
translation: 我会期待你的\n下一场战斗！$

label: BravoTrainerBattleTower_Text_Intro
source:
Yeah!
It's BRAVO TRAINER time!\pToday, we're going to profile {STR_VAR_1},
who took the BATTLE TOWER challenge!\pFor the challenge, {STR_VAR_1} entered
one wicked {STR_VAR_2}.$
translation:
耶！
这里是Bravo训练家时间！\p今天我们将给大家介绍{STR_VAR_1}，
一位对战塔的挑战者！\p这次挑战中，{STR_VAR_1}
使用了一只厉害的{STR_VAR_2}。$

label: BravoTrainerBattleTower_Text_NewRecord
source: The pair set a new record of {STR_VAR_2} wins\nin a row in {STR_VAR_1} competition!\lBravo, TRAINER!$
translation: 在{STR_VAR_1}的比赛中，这对组合\n创造了{STR_VAR_2}连胜的新纪录！\lBravo，训练家！$

label: BravoTrainerBattleTower_Text_Won
source:
The twosome won it all by defeating
{STR_VAR_1}'s {STR_VAR_2} thoroughly.\lBravo, TRAINER!\pKnocking off even {STR_VAR_1}…
It defies belief! Simply astounding!\pWe asked the TRAINER for impressions
on the moment of glory.$
translation:
这对组合彻底地击败了{STR_VAR_1}的

source:
