source: A nickname that perfectly complements\n{STR_VAR_1}, the TRAINER's name.\pIt suggests that you will forge a fine\npartnership with precise timing.$

The visitor is reaching for
a SAND ORNAMENT!\pOh!\pIt crumbled!
It's fallen apart!\pThe visitor looks sheepish
and guilty!$
translation: 访客伸手去拿沙制装饰品！\p啊！\p碎了！\n散架了！\p访客露出尴尬\n又愧疚的表情！$

label: TVSecretBaseSecrets_Text_UsedDesk
source:
The visitor is rubbing a desktop
with their finger!\pApparently, the visitor disapproves
of dust!\pThe visitor is surprisingly concerned
about neatness!$
translation: 访客用手指擦桌面！\p显然不喜欢灰尘！\p没想到访客\n这么爱干净！$

label: TVSecretBaseSecrets_Text_UsedBrick
source: The visitor is staring at a BRICK!\pPerhaps the visitor is thinking about\nthe object on the BRICK.$
translation: 访客盯着砖块看！\p可能在思考\n砖块上的东西。$

label: TVSecretBaseSecrets_Text_UsedSolidBoard
source: The visitor is walking across\nthe SOLID BOARD.\pThe visitor keeps looking down.\pThe visitor appears to be surprisingly\ntimid and cautious!$
translation: 访客走过结实木板！\p一直低头看。\p没想到访客\n这么胆小谨慎！$

label: TVSecretBaseSecrets_Text_UsedFence
source: The visitor is looking intently\nat a FENCE!\pHas a new idea for a trap popped\ninto the visitor's head?$
translation: 访客专注地看着栅栏！\p是不是想到了\n新的陷阱点子？$

label: TVSecretBaseSecrets_Text_UsedGlitterMat
source:
The visitor stepped on
a GLITTER MAT!\pThe visitor is striking a variety
of poses!\pThe visitor appears to be fantasizing
about being an idol!$
translation: 访客踩上闪亮地毯！\p摆出各种姿势！\p访客似乎在幻想\n自己是个偶像！$

label: TVSecretBaseSecrets_Text_UsedTire
source: The visitor is staring intently\nat a TIRE!\pCould the visitor be thinking about\nthe kind of car that would use it?$
translation: 访客盯着轮胎看！\p是不是在想\n什么车会用这种轮胎？$

label: TVSecretBaseSecrets_Text_UsedStand
source: The visitor climbed a STAND!\pThe visitor is looking out across\n{STR_VAR_1}'s BASE from high up!\pAnd…\pLets loose a roar!\nThe visitor is roaring!$
translation: 访客爬上了大平台！\p从高处俯瞰\n{STR_VAR_1}的基地！\p然后......\p发出吼叫！\n访客在咆哮！$

label: TVSecretBaseSecrets_Text_BrokeDoor
source: The visitor charged headlong into\na BREAKABLE DOOR!\pThe visitor is laughing uproariously!$
translation: 访客一头撞上了\n可以打破的门！\p正笑得前仰后合呢！$

label: TVSecretBaseSecrets_Text_UsedDoll
source: The visitor is talking to a DOLL!\p…It's a little creepy…$
translation: 访客正在和玩偶说话！\p......有点吓人......$

label: TVSecretBaseSecrets_Text_UsedSlide
source: The visitor is climbing the ladder\non a SLIDE!\pAnd…\pThe visitor slid down!\pLooks like the visitor is having\na grand old time!$
translation: 访客正在爬滑梯的\n台阶！\p然后......\p滑下来啦！\p看起来玩得\n超开心呢！$

label: TVSecretBaseSecrets_Text_UsedSlideButDidntGoDown
source: The visitor is climbing the ladder\non a SLIDE!\pAnd…\pThe visitor went back down\nthe ladder!\pDid the visitor suddenly chicken out?$
translation: 访客正在爬滑梯的\n台阶！\p然后......\p又原路返回了！\p是突然害怕了吗？$

label: TVSecretBaseSecrets_Text_UsedJumpMat
source: The visitor stepped on\na JUMP MAT!\pThe visitor jumped once!\pJumped twice!\pAnd a successful landing!\pThe visitor is clapping!\nWhat a solo performance!$
translation: 访客踩上了\n跳跃地毯！\p跳了一下！\p又跳了一下！\p完美落地！\p访客在为自己鼓掌！\n真是精彩的个人秀！$

label: gTVSafariFanClubText00
source:
SAFARI FAN CLUB!\pREPORTER: All right, mates!
Tossing them SAFARI BALLS, are you?\pYou can bet I am here in the SAFARI
ZONE chock-full of amazing POKéMON!\pLet's get with it and have a chat with
this good fellow of a SAFARI GUIDE!\pAll right, mate, how are the visiting
TRAINERS looking?$
translation:
狩猎地带粉丝俱乐部！\p记者：嗨，伙计们！
正在投掷狩猎球对吧？\p我正身处满是宝可梦的
狩猎地带！\p让我们来采访一下
这位亲切的狩猎地带向导！\p嘿老兄，来访的训练家们
表现如何？$

label: gTVSafariFanClubText01
source: GUIDE: Everyone seems to be going\nhard at it.\p{STR_VAR_1} is doing especially well.\pWhy, before, {STR_VAR_1} caught\n{STR_VAR_2} POKéMON.$
translation: 向导：大家都很努力呢。\p{STR_VAR_1}表现特别出色。\p要知道，之前{STR_VAR_1}\n抓到了{STR_VAR_2}只宝可梦呢！$

label: gTVSafariFanClubText04
source: REPORTER: Is that right, then?\pSounds like our mate {STR_VAR_1}\nis a stout SAFARI master!\pGUIDE: I hope the TRAINER comes back\nand shows us that great technique.$
translation: 记者：真的吗？\p看来我们的朋友{STR_VAR_1}\n是位厉害的狩猎大师呢！\p向导：希望这位训练家再来\n展示下那高超的技巧。$

label: gTVSafariFanClubText05
source: GUIDE: No one seems to be doing\nvery well.\p{STR_VAR_1} had it especially bad.\pWhy, before, the TRAINER only\nmanaged to catch {STR_VAR_2} POKéMON.$
translation: 向导：大家似乎都不太顺利。\p{STR_VAR_1}尤其糟糕。\p要知道，之前这位训练家\n只抓到{STR_VAR_2}只宝可梦。$

label: gTVSafariFanClubText06
source: GUIDE: No one seems to be doing\nvery well.\p{STR_VAR_1} had it especially bad.\pWhy, before, the TRAINER didn't\ncatch one POKéMON. Not a one!$
translation: 向导：大家似乎都不太顺利。\p{STR_VAR_1}尤其糟糕。\p要知道，之前这位训练家\n一只宝可梦都没抓到呢！$

label: gTVSafariFanClubText09
source: REPORTER: Is that right, then?\pSounds like our mate {STR_VAR_1}\nneeds more SAFARI seasoning.\pGUIDE: I hope the TRAINER visits\nover and over to get the hang of it.$
translation: 记者：是这样吗？\p看来我们的朋友{STR_VAR_1}\n还需要多磨练狩猎技巧呢。\p向导：希望这位训练家多来\n练习掌握诀窍。$

label: gTVSafariFanClubText10
source: REPORTER: Quite right, it is!\nFacing up to challenges is important!\pViewers, come on down to the SAFARI\nand make the challenge yourself!\pUntil next time, cheerio!$
translation: 记者：说得对！\n勇于挑战很重要！\p观众朋友们，快来狩猎地带\n亲自挑战吧！\p下次见，拜拜！$

label: ContestLiveUpdates_Text_Intro
source:
“POKéMON CONTEST LIVE UPDATES!”\pMC: Thanks for joining us!\pWe're live from the just-ended
{STR_VAR_1} site.\pThe hall is still filled with
an audience unwilling to leave.\pSpectator: {STR_VAR_2}!\pSpectator: {STR_VAR_3}!\pMC: As you've just heard, the CONTEST
was won by the POKéMON {STR_VAR_2}\lof {STR_VAR_3}.\pSpectator: {STR_VAR_2}!
You're the best!\pSpectator: {STR_VAR_3}!
Way to go!\pMC: Let's hear what the fans have
to say about this CONTEST.$
translation:
"华丽大赛现场直击！"\p主持人：感谢收看！\p我们正在刚刚结束的
{STR_VAR_1}现场。\p会场仍挤满舍不得离开的观众。\p观众：{STR_VAR_2}！\p观众：{STR_VAR_3}！\p主持人：如您所闻，本次华丽大赛
由{STR_VAR_3}的{STR_VAR_2}夺冠！\p观众：{STR_VAR_2}！
你是最棒的！\p观众：{STR_VAR_3}！
干得漂亮！\p主持人：来听听粉丝们的
赛后感想吧！$

label: ContestLiveUpdates_Text_EqualRounds
source: Spectator: The {STR_VAR_2} remained\nconsistent throughout both primary\land secondary judging.\p{STR_VAR_3} and the {STR_VAR_2},\nthey're no ordinary combo!$
translation: 观众：{STR_VAR_2}从第1轮评审到第2轮评审\n都保持稳定发挥。\p{STR_VAR_3}和{STR_VAR_2}，\n这组合可不简单！$

label: ContestLiveUpdates_Text_BetterRound1
source: Spectator: In terms of being {STR_VAR_1},\nthat {STR_VAR_2} was outstanding.\pI hope it makes better appeals\nnext time, though.$
translation: 观众：就{STR_VAR_1}类别而言，\n{STR_VAR_2}的表现堪称完美。\p不过下次表演\n可以更有创意些。$

label: ContestLiveUpdates_Text_UsedCombo
source: Spectator: That {STR_VAR_2}'s combo\nappeal was stunning!\pIt's shaken me to the core!$
translation: 观众：{STR_VAR_2}的组合招式\n表演令人震撼！\p看得我热血沸腾！$

label: ContestLiveUpdates_Text_ExcitingAppeal
source: Spectator: The winning {STR_VAR_2}'s\nappeal got my heart pounding!$
translation: 观众：冠军{STR_VAR_2}的表演\n让我心跳加速！$

label: ContestLiveUpdates_Text_WasCool
source: {STR_VAR_2}!\nYou were cool!$
translation: {STR_VAR_2}！\n你好帅气！$

label: ContestLiveUpdates_Text_WasBeautiful
source: {STR_VAR_2}!\nYou were beautiful!$
translation: {STR_VAR_2}！\n你好美丽！$

label: ContestLiveUpdates_Text_WasCute
source: {STR_VAR_2}!\nYou were cute!$
translation: {STR_VAR_2}！\n你好可爱！$

label: ContestLiveUpdates_Text_WasSmart
source: {STR_VAR_2}!\nYou were smart!$
translation: {STR_VAR_2}！\n你好聪明！$

label: ContestLiveUpdates_Text_WasTough
source: {STR_VAR_2}!\nYou were tough!$
translation: {STR_VAR_2}！\n你好强壮！$

label: ContestLiveUpdates_Text_VeryExcitingAppeal
source: Spectator: The winning {STR_VAR_2}'s\nappeal still has my heart pounding!$
translation: 观众：冠军{STR_VAR_2}的表演\n到现在还让我心跳不已！$

label: ContestLiveUpdates_Text_VeryCool
source: {STR_VAR_2}!\nYou're the last word in cool!$
translation: {STR_VAR_2}！\n你就是帅气的代名词！$

label: ContestLiveUpdates_Text_VeryBeautiful
source: {STR_VAR_2}!\nYou're the most beautiful!$
translation: {STR_VAR_2}！\n你是最美的存在！$

label: ContestLiveUpdates_Text_VeryCute
source: {STR_VAR_2}!\nYou're simply the cutest!$
translation: {STR_VAR_2}！\n你简直可爱到爆！$

label: ContestLiveUpdates_Text_VerySmart
source: {STR_VAR_2}!\nYou're the smartest among the smart!$
translation: {STR_VAR_2}！\n你是智者中的智者！$

label: ContestLiveUpdates_Text_VeryTough
source: {STR_VAR_2}!\nYou're the toughest of the tough!$
translation: {STR_VAR_2}！\n你是强者中的强者！$

label: ContestLiveUpdates_Text_TookBreak
source: Spectator: Even when the {STR_VAR_2}\ntook a break from making appeals,\lI couldn't take my eyes off it.\pI'm captivated by that {STR_VAR_2}.$
translation: 观众：即使{STR_VAR_2}\n暂停表演时，\l我的视线也无法移开。\p完全被{STR_VAR_2}迷住了！$

label: ContestLiveUpdates_Text_GotStartled
source: Spectator: When the {STR_VAR_2} was\nstartled by another POKéMON's appeal,\lI was close to tears.\p{STR_VAR_2}, you were resilient!\nWay to go!$
translation: 观众：当{STR_VAR_2}被其他\l宝可梦的表演吓到时，\l我差点哭出来。\p{STR_VAR_2}你太坚强了！\n好样的！$

label: ContestLiveUpdates_Text_MoveWonderful
source: Spectator: Oh…\nThat {STR_VAR_2}'s {STR_VAR_3}!\l{STR_VAR_2}'s {STR_VAR_3}!\l{STR_VAR_2}'s {STR_VAR_3}!\lHow could it be so wonderful?$
translation: 观众：天啊......\n{STR_VAR_2}的{STR_VAR_3}！\l{STR_VAR_2}的{STR_VAR_3}！\l{STR_VAR_2}的{STR_VAR_3}！\l怎么会这么精彩？$

label: ContestLiveUpdates_Text_TalkAboutAnotherMon
source: MC: Well, there you have it. This place\nis full of the {STR_VAR_1}'s fans!\pI should also mention that another\nPOKéMON, {STR_VAR_2}'s {STR_VAR_3}, \lcaught my eye.\p{STR_VAR_2}'s {STR_VAR_3}…$
translation: 主持人：如您所见，现场满是\n{STR_VAR_1}的粉丝！\p不过我还想特别提到\n{STR_VAR_2}的{STR_VAR_3}，\l它同样令人印象深刻。\p{STR_VAR_2}的{STR_VAR_3}......$

label: ContestLiveUpdates_Text_FailedToAppeal
source: It failed to make a single appeal during\nsecondary judging out of nervousness.\pNext time, I would like to see this\n{STR_VAR_1} make even one appeal.$
translation: 由于紧张，它在第2轮评审阶段\n一次表演都没能完成。\p希望下次至少能看到\n{STR_VAR_1}完成一次表演。$

label: ContestLiveUpdates_Text_LastInBothRounds
source: It came dead last in both primary\nand secondary judging.\pI hope that {STR_VAR_1} will retrain this\n{STR_VAR_2} and erase the shame of\lthis undisputed last-place finish.$
translation: 它在第1轮评审和第2轮评审中\n都排名垫底。\p希望{STR_VAR_1}能重新训练\n{STR_VAR_2}，洗刷这次\l惨败的耻辱。$

label: ContestLiveUpdates_Text_NotExcitingEnough
source: It failed to take advantage of\nthe audience's excitement and make\lan appropriate appeal.\pWe hope {STR_VAR_1} will learn how to get\na feel for the audience and whip their\lexcitement to a fever pitch next time.$
translation: 它没能抓住观众情绪\n做出恰当的表演。\p希望{STR_VAR_1}学会把握观众心理，\n下次能点燃全场热情。$

label: ContestLiveUpdates_Text_LostAfterWinningRound1
source:
While finishing first in the primary
judging, its appeals in the secondary\ljudging failed to click.\pIt suffered a humiliating come-from-
behind loss.\pI'm sure {STR_VAR_1} is studying how to
make more effective appeals now.$
translation:
虽然第1轮评审获得第1，
但第2轮评审表演完全失败。\p遭遇了耻辱性的
逆转败北。\p相信{STR_VAR_1}正在研究
如何提升表演效果。$

label: ContestLiveUpdates_Text_NeverExciting
source: The audience never got excited by its\nappeals during the secondary judging.\pWe hope it will stop worrying about\nother POKéMON and learn to pitch\lits appeals to the audience more.$
translation: 它的表演始终未能\n在第2轮评审阶段让观众沸腾。\p希望它能专注自身，\n学会如何向观众\l展现更好的表演。$

label: ContestLiveUpdates_Text_LostBySmallMargin
translation:
仅以微弱差距
输给了{STR_VAR_1}的{STR_VAR_2}。\p距离胜利仅一步之遥，
这种失败最令人心碎。\p{STR_VAR_3}现在可能
正在为此哭泣吧。$

label: ContestLiveUpdates_Text_RepeatedAppeals
source:
It disappointed the JUDGE by
repeating the same appeals.\pIt's an unforgivable error in any
CONTEST, and the POKéMON paid.\p{STR_VAR_1} should feel guilty for
this sorry showing.$
translation:
因重复相同表演
让评委大失所望。\p这在任何华丽大赛中
都是不可原谅的失误。\p{STR_VAR_1}该为这次
糟糕表现感到愧疚。$

label: ContestLiveUpdates_Text_ValiantEffortButLost
source: {STR_VAR_1} turned in a valiant effort,\nbut…\pIt was all for naught, finishing last.\p{STR_VAR_1} should learn from this loss\nand put the knowledge to good use.$
translation: {STR_VAR_1}虽然奋力拼搏，\n但......\p最终仍以垫底收场。\p希望{STR_VAR_1}能吸取教训，\n将经验化为成长动力。$

label: ContestLiveUpdates_Text_Outro
source:
I'd like to end this program with our
usual farewell to the winners.\pThis time, it's {STR_VAR_1} and
the {STR_VAR_2}!\pMC: Is everyone ready?
All together now!\pAudience: {STR_VAR_1}! {STR_VAR_2}!
Congratulations!\lYou're the CONTEST winner!$
translation:
节目最后，
按惯例向冠军致以祝福。\p本次的冠军是{STR_VAR_1}
和{STR_VAR_2}！\p主持人：准备好了吗？
大家一起！\p观众：{STR_VAR_1}！{STR_VAR_2}！
恭喜夺冠！\l你们是最棒的！$

label: gTVPokemonBattleUpdateText00
source: “POKéMON BATTLE UPDATE!”\pBringing you the results of POKéMON\nbattles as they come in!$
translation: 《宝可梦对战快报》！\p为您带来最新最热的\n宝可梦对战实况！$

label: gTVPokemonBattleUpdateText01
source: The TRAINERS {STR_VAR_1} and\n{STR_VAR_2} faced each other in\la {STR_VAR_3} BATTLE.\pThis match ended in victory for\n{STR_VAR_1}!$
translation: 训练家{STR_VAR_1}与\n{STR_VAR_2}展开了\l{STR_VAR_3}对战。\p最终由{STR_VAR_1}\n赢得胜利！$

label: gTVPokemonBattleUpdateText02
source: In the battle, {STR_VAR_1}'s\n{STR_VAR_2} was a formidable force\lusing {STR_VAR_3}!$
translation: 对战中{STR_VAR_1}的\n{STR_VAR_2}表现抢眼，\l凭借{STR_VAR_3}技惊四座！$

label: gTVPokemonBattleUpdateText03
source: {STR_VAR_1}'s {STR_VAR_2} had a weak\nshowing that really hurt.$
translation: {STR_VAR_1}的{STR_VAR_2}\n状态不佳，拖累了整体表现。$

label: gTVPokemonBattleUpdateText04
source:
Congratulations on your victory,
{STR_VAR_1}!\pAnd for the defeated {STR_VAR_2},
we hope for a better result next time!\pThis concludes this episode of
“POKéMON BATTLE UPDATE!”$
translation:
恭喜{STR_VAR_1}
获得胜利！\p落败的{STR_VAR_2}也请
下次继续加油！\p本期《宝可梦对战快报》
到此结束！$

label: gTVPokemonBattleUpdateText05
source: The teams of TRAINERS {STR_VAR_1} and\n{STR_VAR_2} met in a MULTI BATTLE.\pThis match ended in victory for\n{STR_VAR_1}'s team.$
translation: 训练家{STR_VAR_1}与\n{STR_VAR_2}组队进行了多人对战。\p最终由{STR_VAR_1}的队伍\n取得胜利！$

label: gTVPokemonBattleUpdateText06
source: In the battle, the {STR_VAR_2} on\n{STR_VAR_1}'s team was a formidable\lforce using {STR_VAR_3}.$
translation: 对战中{STR_VAR_1}队伍的\n{STR_VAR_2}表现出色，\l凭借{STR_VAR_3}大放异彩！$

label: gTVPokemonBattleUpdateText07
source:
The weak showing by the {STR_VAR_3}
on {STR_VAR_2}'s team really hurt.\pCongratulations on your team's
victory, {STR_VAR_1}!\pAs for the defeated {STR_VAR_2}'s team,
we hope for a better result next time!\pThis concludes this episode of
“POKéMON BATTLE UPDATE!”$
translation:
{STR_VAR_2}队伍的{STR_VAR_3}
状态低迷，影响了整体发挥。\p恭喜{STR_VAR_1}的队伍
获得胜利！\p落败的{STR_VAR_2}队伍也请
下次再接再厉！\p本期《宝可梦对战快报》
到此结束！$

label: GabbyAndTy_Text_GabbyPreFirstBattle
source: GABBY: Oh! We've just spotted a tough-\nlooking TRAINER here of all places!\pOkay, roll camera!\nLet's get this interview.$
translation: 玛莉：哇！我们在这个地方\n发现了一位实力强劲的训练家！\p好，摄像机准备！\n让我们开始采访吧！$

label: GabbyAndTy_Text_GabbyIntro
source: GABBY: Oh! You're {PLAYER}! Hi!\nDo you remember us from last time?\pCan you show us how much stronger\nyou've become? Okay, cue interview!$
translation: 玛莉：啊！是{PLAYER}！你好！\n还记得我们上次见面吗？\p能让我们看看你变得\n多强了吗？好，采访开始！$

label: GabbyAndTy_Text_GabbyDefeatFirstTime
source: GABBY: My eyes didn't lie!\nI did discover an astonishing TRAINER!$
translation: 玛莉：我的眼光没错！\n真的发现了一位惊人的训练家！$

label: GabbyAndTy_Text_WhoAreYouInterview
source:
GABBY: Awesome! Awesome!
Who are you?!\pI knew we were onto something wild
when we spotted you!\pOh, please let me explain. We travel
around everywhere interviewing all\lsorts of TRAINERS.\pSo, would you give us a bit of your time
for an interview?$
translation:
玛莉：太棒了！太棒了！
你到底是谁？！\p我就知道发现你的时候
一定会有什么惊喜！\p哦，让我解释一下。我们四处旅行
采访各种各样的训练家。\p那么，你愿意抽点时间
接受我们的采访吗？$

label: GabbyAndTy_Text_QuoteFromLastInterview
source: GABBY: “{STR_VAR_1}!”\pRemember? That's the quote you gave\nus as the battle clincher last time.\pI never, ever forget stuff like that!$
translation: 玛莉："{STR_VAR_1}！"\p记得吗？这是你上次对战结束时\n给我们的经典台词。\p我永远不会忘记这种精彩瞬间！$

label: GabbyAndTy_Text_YouStompedUsInterviewAgain
source: The last time we battled, you stomped\nus before we could brace ourselves…\pAnyway, what do you think?\nDo you want to be interviewed again?$
translation: 上次对战你直接碾压了我们\n让我们措手不及......\p那么，你觉得怎么样？\n要再接受一次采访吗？$

label: GabbyAndTy_Text_YouThrewABallAtUsInterviewAgain
source:
The last time we battled, didn't you
throw a POKé BALL at us?\pWe were shocked! So we told everyone,
just everyone, about it!\pAnyway, what do you think?
Do you want to be interviewed again?$
translation: 上次对战时，你是不是\n朝我们扔了精灵球？\p我们太震惊了！所以逢人就说！\p那么，你觉得怎么样？\n要再接受一次采访吗？$

label: GabbyAndTy_Text_CleverItemSkillsInterviewAgain
source: The last time we battled, your item\nskills cleverly did us in.\pAnyway, what do you think?\nDo you want to be interviewed again?$
translation: 上次对战，你巧妙地使用道具\n击败了我们。\p那么，你觉得怎么样？\n要再接受一次采访吗？$

label: GabbyAndTy_Text_WeLookedRespectableInterviewAgain
source: The last time we battled, we managed\nto look respectable.\pAnyway, what do you think?\nDo you want to be interviewed again?$
translation: 上次对战我们好歹\n还保住了颜面。\p那么，你觉得怎么样？\n要再接受一次采访吗？$

label: GabbyAndTy_Text_InterviewAgain
source: Anyway, what do you think?\nDo you want to be interviewed again?$
translation: 那么，你觉得怎么样？\n要再接受一次采访吗？$

label: GabbyAndTy_Text_DescribeYourFeelings
source: You will?\nThank you!\pOkay, I need you to describe your\nfeelings about our battle, but it\lhas to be short and sweet. Go!$
translation: 你愿意？\n太感谢了！\p好，现在请你简短地描述\n对这场对战的感受！开始！$

label: GabbyAndTy_Text_PerfectWellBeSeeingYou
source:
GABBY: Mmm, yeah!
That's the perfect clincher!\pI get the feeling that this will make
a great TV show.\pThere's a chance that they'll air this
on TV, so make sure to look for us!\pOkay!
We'll be seeing you!$
translation:
玛莉：嗯，没错！
这句话作为结尾太完美了！\p我有预感这期节目
一定会很精彩。\p说不定会在电视上播出，
记得关注我们哦！\p好！
下次见！$

label: GabbyAndTy_Text_DontGiveUpKeepingEyeOut
source: GABBY: Oh…\pOkay, but don't give up!\nWe'll be keeping an eye out for you!$
translation: 玛莉：哦......\p别放弃！\n我们会继续关注你的！$

label: GabbyAndTy_Text_KeepingAnEyeOutForYou
source: GABBY: We'll be keeping an eye out\nfor you!$
translation: 玛莉：我们会继续\n关注你的！$

label: GabbyAndTy_Text_GabbyNotEnoughMons
source: GABBY: Is there a strong TRAINER\nanywhere with a lot of POKéMON?$
translation: 玛莉：这附近有没有带着很多宝可梦\n的强大训练家啊？$

label: GabbyAndTy_Text_GiveUsAnInterviewThisTime
source:
GABBY: Wow, you are something!\pYou've gotten a lot stronger--a lot--
since we last battled.\pWe were right about you when we
spotted you as a hot TRAINER.\pSo, anyway, what do you think?
Are you willing to give us an interview\lthis time?$
translation:
玛莉：哇，你真是太厉害了！\p比起上次见面，
你变得强多了！\p我们当初发现你是个
潜力股果然没错！\p那么这次你愿意
接受我们的采访吗？$

label: GabbyAndTy_Text_GabbyDefeat
source: GABBY: That was an intense battle!\nDid you get all that on camera?$
translation: 玛莉：真是场激烈的对战！\n都拍下来了吗？$

label: GabbyAndTy_Text_TyPreFirstBattle
source: TY: Hey, lookie here! A tough-looking\nTRAINER here, of all places!\lCamera's rolling!$
translation: 达伊：嘿，快看！在这个地方\n发现了个厉害的训练家！\l摄像机就位！$

label: GabbyAndTy_Text_TyIntro
source: TY: Hey, lookie here!\nI remember you!\pI'll get this battle all on this\nhere camera!$
translation: 达伊：嘿，快看！\n我记得你！\p我要把这场对战\n全都拍下来！$

label: GabbyAndTy_Text_TyPostBattle
source: TY: You're a natural!\nGot me some prime footage right here!$
translation: 达伊：你真是个天才！\n这下拍到好素材了！$

label: GabbyAndTy_Text_TyNotEnoughMons
source: TY: Do you only have the one POKéMON\nand that's it?\pIf you had more POKéMON, it'd make for\nbetter footage, but…$
translation: 达伊：你就只有\n1只宝可梦吗？\p要是有更多宝可梦的话，\n拍摄效果会更好......$

label: GabbyAndTy_Text_TyDefeatFirstTime
source: TY: Yep, we sure spotted a hot TRAINER.\nThis is a huge scoop for us!$
translation: 达伊：没错，我们发现了个\n超厉害的训练家！大新闻啊！$

label: GabbyAndTy_Text_TyDefeat
source: TY: Yep, I got it all.\nThat whole battle's on camera.$
translation: 达伊：都拍下来了，\n整场对战都在这里。$

label: gTVInSearchOfTrainersText00
source:
IN SEARCH OF TRAINERS…\pGABBY: Hi! Today I'm visiting an area
near {STR_VAR_1}.\pWe're trying to spot some up-and-
coming new talent in the field.\pToday, we turned our lens on the
TRAINER {PLAYER}.\pThere's something about this TRAINER
that piqued our interest.$
translation:
《训练家追踪报道》\p玛莉：大家好！今天我们来到
{STR_VAR_1}附近地区。\p正在野外尝试寻找
冉冉升起的新星。\p今天我们的镜头聚焦在
训练家{PLAYER}身上。\p这位训练家身上有种特质
深深吸引了我们！$

label: gTVInSearchOfTrainersText01
source: We've battled {PLAYER} before, but we\ncan attest that the TRAINER has most\ldefinitely improved from before.\pI knew we were onto someone special\nwhen we spotted this TRAINER!$
translation: 虽然之前与{PLAYER}对战过，\n但可以确定这位训练家的实力\l比之前进步显著。\p当初发现这位训练家时\n我就知道是特别的存在！$

label: gTVInSearchOfTrainersText02
source:
The best way to determine how strong
a TRAINER is…\pWell, the fastest way is to battle.
And so we began our investigation!\p… …\pThat's how we ended up in battle
with {PLAYER}.\pIn a dominating performance, we were
flattened, rolled up, and tossed aside!\p{PLAYER} is ruthlessly strong…\pHere's our impressions after having
battled our featured TRAINER.$
translation:
判断训练家实力的最佳方式......\p最快的方法当然是对战。
于是我们开始了调查！\p...... ......\p就这样我们与{PLAYER}
展开了对战。\p结果被完全压制，
毫无还手之力！\p{PLAYER}强得可怕......\p以下是与本期焦点训练家
对战后的感想。$

label: gTVInSearchOfTrainersText03
source:
The combination of {STR_VAR_1} and
{STR_VAR_3} was divine!\pThe sight of them--{STR_VAR_1} and
{STR_VAR_3}--selflessly supporting\leach other in the thick of battle…\pIt was a marvelous sight to behold!\p{STR_VAR_2} was the move the TRAINER
used last in our battle.\pThe move {STR_VAR_2} is {STR_VAR_1}
and {STR_VAR_3}'s sign of friendship!$
translation:
{STR_VAR_1}与{STR_VAR_3}
的配合天衣无缝！\p看着它们--{STR_VAR_1}和
{STR_VAR_3}--在激战中无私地\l互相支援......\p真是令人叹为观止的景象！\p{STR_VAR_2}是训练家最后
使用的招式。\p{STR_VAR_2}这招正是
{STR_VAR_1}与{STR_VAR_3}友谊的见证！$

label: gTVInSearchOfTrainersText04
source:
…I lost confidence in myself as
a result of our encounter.\pWe were beaten before we could launch
a single attack.\lOhhh… Snivel…\pIn spite of that, {PLAYER}'s battles
are worth seeing.\pI recommend confident TRAINERS to
challenge {PLAYER}.$
translation:
......这次遭遇让我
失去了自信。\p我们连一次攻击都没使出
就被击败了......\l呜呜......抽泣......\p尽管如此，{PLAYER}的对战
仍然值得一看。\p我推荐有信心的训练家
来挑战{PLAYER}。$

label: gTVInSearchOfTrainersText05
source:
There's only one thing to be said.
Don't you dare throw a POKé BALL during\la TRAINER battle!\p{PLAYER} is certainly strong, but has
no clue about the basic rules.\pTo our TV audience, I have a request.\pIf you see {PLAYER}, please caution
the TRAINER!$
translation:
只有一件事必须说明。
训练家对战中禁止投掷精灵球！\p{PLAYER}确实很强，
但对基本规则毫无概念。\p想对电视观众们说：\p如果见到{PLAYER}，
请提醒这位训练家！$

label: gTVInSearchOfTrainersText06
source: {PLAYER} is adept at reading the\nopponent's actions.\pThe timing of item usage was remarkably\neffective!$
translation: {PLAYER}擅长预判\n对手的行动。\p道具使用的时机\n精准得惊人！$

label: gTVInSearchOfTrainersText07
source:
Honestly speaking, I thought that
I might even be pretty good.\pWhile we did end up losing, we did have
a hotly contested battle.\pBut if you're struggling against me,
you have a ways to go, {PLAYER}!$
translation:
说实话，我原本以为
自己还算厉害。\p虽然最终落败，
但确实进行了势均力敌的战斗。\p不过如果连和我对战都吃力，
{PLAYER}你还要继续努力啊！$

label: gTVInSearchOfTrainersText08
source:
After our battle, we asked {PLAYER} for
a succinct summary.\pThe TRAINER replied, “{STR_VAR_1}.”\p{PLAYER}'s POKéMON {STR_VAR_2} and
{STR_VAR_3}…\lAnd “{STR_VAR_1}”…\pMmm! That's deep! There's deep
significance behind that quote!\pIt's no surprise--a good TRAINER has
good things to say.\pThat's all for today!
See you again on our next broadcast!$
translation:
对战结束后，我们请{PLAYER}
用一句话总结。\p训练家回答："{STR_VAR_1}"。\p{PLAYER}的宝可梦{STR_VAR_2}与
{STR_VAR_3}......\l还有"{STR_VAR_1}"......\p嗯！意味深长！
这句话蕴含深刻意义！\p不愧是优秀训练家，
说的话也充满智慧。\p今天节目就到这里！
下期再见！$

label: ContestLadyShow_Text_Intro
source:
“POKéMON CONTEST LIVE UPDATES!”\pMC: Sorry to interrupt the regular
programming, and thanks for joining us!\pWe bring you this live from
the scene of a just-completed\l{STR_VAR_1}!\pSpectators: ?!!!!\pMC: Oh! It looks like the CONTEST
participants are headed this way!\pI'll try to get an impromptu interview
for you folks at home!\pSpectators: ?!!!!
?!!!!$
translation:
《宝可梦华丽大赛实况速递！》\p主持人：抱歉打断常规节目，
感谢各位收看！\p我们正在刚刚结束的
{STR_VAR_1}现场\l为您带来直播报道！\p观众：？！\p主持人：啊！参赛选手们
正朝这边走来！\p我将为各位观众
进行即兴采访！\p观众：？！
？！$

label: ContestLadyShow_Text_Won
source:
MC: Excuse me!
Thanks for joining us on live TV!\pMay I congratulate you on your win?\pWhat was the key factor in today's
stunning victory?\pBEAUTY: We gave it our best effort
today, my {STR_VAR_2} and I!\pBut I'm sure we wouldn't have made it
if it weren't for all the help we\lreceived leading up to the CONTEST!\pMC: Do you have a special someone
with whom you'd like to share your joy?\lLet's hear it live!\pBEAUTY: Hey, out there!\p{STR_VAR_3}! Are you watching?
We did it!\lThank you!$
translation:
主持人：打扰了！
感谢接受电视直播采访！\p恭喜您获得本次大赛冠军！\p今天取得辉煌胜利的
关键因素是什么？\p大姐姐：我和{STR_VAR_2}
今天已经全力以赴！\p但如果没有赛前得到的各种帮助，
我们肯定无法取得这样的成绩！\p主持人：有什么特别的人
想分享这份喜悦吗？\l让我们现场连线！\p大姐姐：嘿，你在看吗？\p{STR_VAR_3}！看到了吗？
我们做到了！\l谢谢你！$

label: ContestLadyShow_Text_Lost
source:
MC: Excuse me!
Thanks for joining us on live TV!\pYou must be disappointed by that turn
of events. Do you have any comments?\pBEAUTY: It's heartbreaking…
My {STR_VAR_2} and I, we did our best…\pBut I feel like I've let down everyone
who has supported us through this.\pMC: I hate to say it, but the POKéMON's
coloration is a little wanting.\pBEAUTY: {STR_VAR_3}, I'm so sorry…
I'll do better next time, I swear…\l…Sniff… Waaaaah!\pSpectators: See that?
The poor girl!\pMC: Uh… Uh-oh…\pUh… That's all the time we have today!
Thanks for tuning in!$
translation:
主持人：打扰一下！
感谢接受我们的现场采访！\p对于这样的结果
您有什么想说的吗？\p大姐姐：太让人心碎了......
我和{STR_VAR_2}明明已经竭尽全力......\p但感觉辜负了所有
支持我们的人......\p主持人：恕我直言，这只宝可梦的
毛色似乎还不够完美。\p大姐姐：{STR_VAR_3}，对不起......
下次我一定会做得更好......\l......抽泣......哇啊啊！\p观众：快看！
那女孩好可怜！\p主持人：呃......糟糕......\p呃......今天的节目就到这里！
感谢您的收看！$

label: ContestLadyShow_Text_LostBadly
source:
MC: Excuse me!
Thanks for joining us on live TV!\pHow did your CONTEST appearance go?\pBEAUTY: Nothing went right…
For some reason, my {STR_VAR_2}\lcouldn't attract any popularity.\pMC: I hate to say it, but the POKéMON's
coloration is a little wanting.\pBEAUTY: … … … … … …
…Sniff… Waaaaah!\pSpectators: See that?
The poor girl!\pMC: Uh… Uh-oh…\pUh… That's all the time we have today!
Thanks for tuning in!$
translation:
主持人：打扰一下！
感谢接受我们的现场采访！\p您对本次华丽大赛的表现
有何评价？\p大姐姐：全都搞砸了......
不知道为什么{STR_VAR_2}\l完全吸引不到人气......\p主持人：恕我直言，这只宝可梦的
毛色确实有所欠缺。\p大姐姐：...... ...... ...... ......
......抽泣......哇啊啊！\p观众：快看！
那女孩哭得好伤心！\p主持人：呃......不妙......\p呃......今天的节目时间到了！
感谢您的收看！$

label: gBattleStringsTable.STRINGID_ELECTRICTERRAINPREVENTS

source: {B_SCR_NAME_WITH_PREFIX} is not affected thanks to its {B_LAST_ITEM}!

source: {B_DEF_NAME_WITH_PREFIX} is protected by an aromatic veil!

source: Congratulations, {B_PLAYER_NAME}!
translation: 恭喜恭喜！\n{B_PLAYER_NAME}！

source: {B_DEF_NAME_WITH_PREFIX} followed {B_ATK_NAME_WITH_PREFIX2}'s instructions!
translation: 根据{B_ATK_NAME_WITH_PREFIX2}的指示，\n{B_DEF_NAME_WITH_PREFIX}使出了招式！

source: {B_SCR_NAME_WITH_PREFIX}'s {B_SCR_ABILITY} {B_BUFF2}raised its {B_BUFF1}!

label: gBattleStringsTable.STRINGID_PKNMABSORBINGPOWER

source: {B_DEF_NAME_WITH_PREFIX} fell in love because of the {B_LAST_ITEM}!

source: {B_ATK_NAME_WITH_PREFIX} became cloaked in a freezing light!

source: The effects of the {B_LAST_ITEM} held by {B_SCR_NAME_WITH_PREFIX2} prevents its stats from being lowered!

source: {B_ATK_TRAINER_NAME}'s fervent wish has reached {B_ATK_NAME_WITH_PREFIX2}!

translation: 天气的影响消失了！

source: {B_SCR_NAME_WITH_PREFIX} is radiating a fairy aura!
translation: {B_SCR_NAME_WITH_PREFIX}\n正在释放妖精气场！

source: {B_SCR_NAME_WITH_PREFIX} reversed all other Pokémon's auras!
translation: {B_SCR_NAME_WITH_PREFIX}\n压制了所有气场！

source: {B_SCR_NAME_WITH_PREFIX} is drowsing!
translation: {B_SCR_NAME_WITH_PREFIX}\n处于半梦半醒状态！

source: All screens on the field were cleansed!
translation: 双方场上的反射壁、光墙\n和极光幕消失了！

label: gBattleStringsTable.STRINGID_FETCHEDPOKEBALL
source: {B_SCR_NAME_WITH_PREFIX} found a {B_LAST_ITEM}!
translation: {B_SCR_NAME_WITH_PREFIX}\n捡来了{B_LAST_ITEM}！

source: A sandstorm kicked up!
translation: 开始刮沙暴了！

label: gBattleStringsTable.STRINGID_PKMNSWILLPERISHIN3TURNS
source: Both Pokémon will perish in three turns!
translation: 双方将在3回合后灭亡！

source: {B_SCR_NAME_WITH_PREFIX} has two Abilities!
translation: {B_SCR_NAME_WITH_PREFIX}\n同时拥有了两种特性！

source: {B_EFF_NAME_WITH_PREFIX}'s stat changes were removed!
translation: {B_EFF_NAME_WITH_PREFIX}的\n能力变化消失了！

source: {B_SCR_NAME_WITH_PREFIX} got over its infatuation!

source: {B_ATK_NAME_WITH_PREFIX}'s item cannot be removed!

label: gBattleStringsTable.STRINGID_PKMNBURNHEALED

label: gBattleStringsTable.STRINGID_REDCARDACTIVATE

source: {B_SCR_NAME_WITH_PREFIX} is switched out with the {B_LAST_ITEM}!
translation: {B_SCR_NAME_WITH_PREFIX}\n要用{B_LAST_ITEM}回去了！

label: gBattleStringsTable.STRINGID_ATKGOTOVERINFATUATION
source: {B_SCR_NAME_WITH_PREFIX} got over its infatuation!
translation: {B_SCR_NAME_WITH_PREFIX}的\n着迷状态治愈了！

label: gBattleStringsTable.STRINGID_TORMENTEDNOMORE

translation: {B_SCR_NAME_WITH_PREFIX}的\n无理取闹的效果消失了！

source: {B_SCR_NAME_WITH_PREFIX} is cured of its heal block!
translation: {B_SCR_NAME_WITH_PREFIX}的\n回复封锁的效果消失了！

label: gBattleStringsTable.STRINGID_ATTACKERBECAMEFULLYCHARGED
source: {B_ATK_NAME_WITH_PREFIX} became fully charged due to its bond with its trainer!\p
translation: {B_ATK_NAME_WITH_PREFIX}\n浑身充满了牵绊之力！\p

translation: {B_ATK_NAME_WITH_PREFIX}\n变身成了小智版甲贺忍蛙！\p

source: The sunlight turned extremely harsh!
translation: 日照变得非常强了！

translation: 日照复原了！

source: The Water-type attack evaporated in the extremely harsh sunlight!
translation: 受强日照的影响，\n水属性的攻击被蒸发了！

source: The extremely harsh sunlight was not lessened at all!

source: A heavy rain began to fall!
translation: 开始下起了暴雨！

translation: 暴雨停了！

translation: {B_SCR_NAME_WITH_PREFIX}的原始回归！\n恢复了原始的样子！

source: But {B_ATK_NAME_WITH_PREFIX2} can't use the move!
translation: 但是，{B_ATK_NAME_WITH_PREFIX2}\n无法使用！

source: But {B_ATK_NAME_WITH_PREFIX2} can't use it the way it is now!
translation: 但是，现在的{B_ATK_NAME_WITH_PREFIX2}\n无法使用！

source: {B_ATK_ABILITY} only allows the use of {B_CURRENT_MOVE}!\p
translation: 因为{B_ATK_ABILITY}的效果，\n只能使出{B_CURRENT_MOVE}！\p

source: {B_SCR_NAME_WITH_PREFIX}'s type changed to {B_BUFF1}!
translation: {B_SCR_NAME_WITH_PREFIX}\n变成了{B_BUFF1}属性！

translation: 双方的宝可梦无法逃走了！

source: {B_DEF_NAME_WITH_PREFIX} became weaker to fire!
translation: {B_DEF_NAME_WITH_PREFIX}\n变得怕火了！

source: {B_DEF_NAME_WITH_PREFIX} is about to be attacked by its {B_BUFF1}!
translation: {B_DEF_NAME_WITH_PREFIX}被\n{B_BUFF1}袭击了！

label: gBattleStringsTable.STRINGID_CANTESCAPEBECAUSEOFCURRENTMOVE
source: {B_DEF_NAME_WITH_PREFIX} can no longer escape because of Octolock!
translation: {B_DEF_NAME_WITH_PREFIX}受到\n蛸固的效果影响，变得无法逃走了......

source: Neutralizing gas filled the area!
translation: 周围充满了化学变化气体！

label: gBattleStringsTable.STRINGID_NEUTRALIZINGGASOVER
source: The effects of the neutralizing gas wore off!
translation: 化学变化气体的效果消失了！

label: gBattleStringsTable.STRINGID_TARGETTOOHEAVY
source: {B_DEF_NAME_WITH_PREFIX} is too heavy to be lifted!
translation: {B_DEF_NAME_WITH_PREFIX}\n太重了，抬不起来！

translation: {B_ATK_NAME_WITH_PREFIX}\n将{B_DEF_NAME_WITH_PREFIX2}带上了高空！

label: gBattleStringsTable.STRINGID_PKMNINSNAPTRAP
source: {B_DEF_NAME_WITH_PREFIX} got trapped by a snap trap!
translation: {B_DEF_NAME_WITH_PREFIX}\n被捕兽夹困住了！

label: gBattleStringsTable.STRINGID_METEORBEAMCHARGING
source: {B_ATK_NAME_WITH_PREFIX} is overflowing with space power!
translation: {B_ATK_NAME_WITH_PREFIX}身上\n溢出了宇宙之力！

source: {B_ATK_NAME_WITH_PREFIX} swapped the battle effects affecting each side of the field!
translation: {B_ATK_NAME_WITH_PREFIX}\n交换了双方的场地效果！

translation: {B_ATK_NAME_WITH_PREFIX}\n让Z力量笼罩了全身！

translation: 因为Z力量，{B_SCR_NAME_WITH_PREFIX}\n恢复了降低的能力！

label: gBattleStringsTable.STRINGID_ZMOVERESTOREHP
source: {B_SCR_NAME_WITH_PREFIX} restored its HP using its Z-Power!
translation: 因为Z力量，{B_SCR_NAME_WITH_PREFIX}的\n体力回复了！

label: gBattleStringsTable.STRINGID_ZMOVESTATUP
source: {B_SCR_NAME_WITH_PREFIX} boosted its stats using its Z-Power!
translation: 因为Z力量，{B_SCR_NAME_WITH_PREFIX}的\n能力提高了！

label: gBattleStringsTable.STRINGID_ZMOVEHPTRAP

translation: 裁判：判定准则其一，心！\n是否展现出斗志与勇气！\p

label: gRefereeStringsTable.B_MSG_REF_JUDGE_SKILL

translation: 裁判：判定准则其二，技！\n是否准确地使用了招式！\p

label: gRefereeStringsTable.B_MSG_REF_JUDGE_BODY

translation: 裁判：判定准则其三，体！\n是否保留了足够的体力！\p

label: gRefereeStringsTable.B_MSG_REF_PLAYER_WON
source: REFEREE: Judgment: {B_BUFF1} to {B_BUFF2}! The winner is {B_PLAYER_NAME}'s {B_PLAYER_MON1_NAME}!\p
translation: 裁判：判定结果：{B_BUFF1}比{B_BUFF2}！\n胜者是{B_PLAYER_NAME}的{B_PLAYER_MON1_NAME}！\p

label: gRefereeStringsTable.B_MSG_REF_OPPONENT_WON

label: gRefereeStringsTable.B_MSG_REF_DRAW
source: REFEREE: Judgment: 3 to 3! We have a draw!\p
translation: 裁判：判定结果：3比3！\n双方打成了平手！\p

label: ITEM_STRANGE_BALL.name
source: STRANGE BALL
translation: 奇异球

label: ITEM_STRANGE_BALL.description
source: An unusual Ball\nwarped through\nspace and time.
translation: 与众不同的球。\n穿越时空而来。

label: ITEM_POKE_BALL.name
source: POKé BALL
translation: 精灵球

label: ITEM_POKE_BALL.description
source: A tool used for\ncatching wild\nPokémon.
translation: 用于投向野生宝可\n梦并将其捕捉的球\n。

label: ITEM_GREAT_BALL.name
source: GREAT BALL
translation: 超级球

label: ITEM_GREAT_BALL.description
source: A good Ball with a\nhigher catch rate\nthan a Poké Ball.
translation: 比精灵球更容易捉\n到宝可梦的，性能\n还算不错的球。

label: ITEM_ULTRA_BALL.name
source: ULTRA BALL
translation: 高级球

label: ITEM_ULTRA_BALL.description
source: A better Ball with\na higher catch rate\nthan a Great Ball.
translation: 比超级球更容易捉\n到宝可梦的，性能\n非常不错的球。

label: ITEM_MASTER_BALL.name
source: MASTER BALL
translation: 大师球

label: ITEM_MASTER_BALL.description
source: The best Ball that\ncatches a Pokémon\nwithout fail.
translation: 必定能捉到野生宝\n可梦的，性能最好\n的球。

label: ITEM_PREMIER_BALL.name
source: PREMIER BALL
translation: 纪念球

label: ITEM_PREMIER_BALL.description
source: A rare Ball made\nin commemoration\nof some event.
translation: 有点珍贵的球。特\n制出来的某种纪念\n品。

label: ITEM_HEAL_BALL.name
source: HEAL BALL
translation: 治愈球

label: ITEM_HEAL_BALL.description
source: A remedial Ball\nthat restores\ncaught Pokémon.
translation: 有点温柔的球。能\n回复捉到宝可梦的\nHP并治愈异常。

label: ITEM_NET_BALL.name
source: NET BALL
translation: 捕网球

label: ITEM_NET_BALL.description
source: A Ball that works\nwell on Water- and\nBug-type Pokémon.
translation: 有点与众不同的球\n。能容易地捕捉水\n或虫属性宝可梦。

label: ITEM_NEST_BALL.name
source: NEST BALL
translation: 巢穴球

label: ITEM_NEST_BALL.description
source: A Ball that works\nbetter on weaker\nPokémon.
translation: 有点与众不同的球\n。野生宝可梦越弱\n越容易捕捉。

label: ITEM_DIVE_BALL.name
source: DIVE BALL
translation: 潜水球

label: ITEM_DIVE_BALL.description
source: A Ball that works\nbetter on Pokémon\non the ocean floor.
translation: 有点与众不同的球\n。容易捕捉生活在\n水世界的宝可梦。

source: DUSK BALL
translation: 黑暗球

label: ITEM_DUSK_BALL.description
source: Works well if\nused in a\ndark place.
translation: 有点与众不同的球\n。容易在夜晚或洞\n窟等捕捉宝可梦。

source: TIMER BALL
translation: 计时球

label: ITEM_TIMER_BALL.description
source: A Ball that gains\npower in battles\ntaking many turns.
translation: 有点与众不同的球\n。回合数越多会越\n容易捕捉。

label: ITEM_QUICK_BALL.name
source: QUICK BALL
translation: 先机球

label: ITEM_QUICK_BALL.description
source: Works well if\nused on the\nfirst turn.
translation: 有点与众不同的球\n。战斗开始使用容\n易捉到宝可梦。

label: ITEM_REPEAT_BALL.name
source: REPEAT BALL
translation: 重复球

label: ITEM_REPEAT_BALL.description
source: A Ball that works\nbetter on Pokémon\ncaught before.
translation: 有点与众不同的球\n。容易捕捉曾捉到\n过的宝可梦。

source: LUXURY BALL
translation: 豪华球

label: ITEM_LUXURY_BALL.description
source: A cozy Ball that\nmakes Pokémon\nmore friendly.
translation: 住着十分惬意的球\n。捉到宝可梦变得\n容易亲密。

source: LEVEL BALL
translation: 等级球

label: ITEM_LEVEL_BALL.description
source: Good for NORMAL,\nFLYING, ICE, and\nlow level POKéMON.
translation: 有点与众不同的球\n。宝可梦等级越低\n越容易捕捉。

source: LURE BALL
translation: 诱饵球

label: ITEM_LURE_BALL.description
source: Good for WATER,\nDRAGON, and fished\nup POKéMON.
translation: 有点与众不同的球\n。容易捕捉用钓竿\n钓上来的宝可梦。

source: MOON BALL
translation: 月亮球

label: ITEM_MOON_BALL.description
source: Good for DARK,\nGHOST, POISON, and\nMOON STONE users.
translation: 有点与众不同的球\n。容易捕捉用月之\n石进化的宝可梦。

label: ITEM_FRIEND_BALL.name
source: FRIEND BALL
translation: 友友球

label: ITEM_FRIEND_BALL.description
source: Good for BUG,\nGRASS, and making\nPOKéMON friendly.
translation: 有点与众不同的球\n。捉到宝可梦会立\n刻变得亲密起来。

label: ITEM_LOVE_BALL.name
source: LOVE BALL
translation: 甜蜜球

source: Good for PSYCHIC,\nFAIRY, and the\nopposite gender.
translation: 有点与众不同的球\n。容易捕捉性别不\n同的宝可梦。

source: FAST BALL
translation: 速度球

translation: 有点与众不同的球\n。容易捕捉速度很\n快的宝可梦。

source: HEAVY BALL
translation: 沉重球

label: ITEM_DREAM_BALL.name
source: DREAM BALL

source: SAFARI BALL

source: SPORT BALL

label: ITEM_TM_SHOCK_WAVE.description
source: Zaps the foe with a\njolt of electricity\nthat never misses.
translation: 向对手快速发出\n电击。攻击必定会\n命中。

label: ITEM_TM_FLAMETHROWER.name
source: TM35
translation: 招式学习器35

label: ITEM_TM_FLAMETHROWER.description
source: Looses a stream of\nfire that may burn\nthe foe.
translation: 向对手发射烈焰\n攻击。有时会让\n对手陷入灼伤。

label: ITEM_TM_SLUDGE_BOMB.name
source: TM36
translation: 招式学习器36

label: ITEM_TM_SLUDGE_BOMB.description
source: Hurls sludge at the\nfoe. It may poison\nthe foe.
translation: 用污泥投掷对手\n攻击。有时会让\n对手陷入中毒。

label: ITEM_TM_SANDSTORM.name
source: TM37
translation: 招式学习器37

label: ITEM_TM_SANDSTORM.description
source: Causes a sandstorm\nthat hits the foe\nover several turns.
translation: 在5回合内扬起沙\n暴，岩石地面钢外\n宝可梦都会受伤。

label: ITEM_TM_FIRE_BLAST.name
source: TM38
translation: 招式学习器38

label: ITEM_TM_FIRE_BLAST.description
source: A powerful fire\nattack that may\nburn the foe.
translation: 用大字形状的火焰\n烧尽对手。有时会\n让对手陷入灼伤。

label: ITEM_TM_ROCK_TOMB.name
source: TM39
translation: 招式学习器39

label: ITEM_TM_ROCK_TOMB.description
source: Stops the foe from\nmoving with rocks.\nMay lower Speed.
translation: 投掷岩石攻击。\n封住对手的行动，\n从而降低速度。

label: ITEM_TM_AERIAL_ACE.name
source: TM40
translation: 招式学习器40

label: ITEM_TM_AERIAL_ACE.description
source: An extremely fast\nattack that can't\nbe avoided.
translation: 以敏捷动作戏弄\n对手后切斩。\n攻击必定会命中。

label: ITEM_TM_TORMENT.name
source: TM41
translation: 招式学习器41

label: ITEM_TM_TORMENT.description
source: Prevents the foe\nfrom using the same\nmove in a row.
translation: 向对手无理取闹，\n令其不能连续2次\n使出相同招式。

label: ITEM_TM_FACADE.name
source: TM42
translation: 招式学习器42

label: ITEM_TM_FACADE.description
source: Raises Attack when\npoisoned, burned,\nor paralyzed.
translation: 当处于中毒、麻痹\n或灼伤时，招式威\n力会变成2倍。

label: ITEM_TM_SECRET_POWER.name
source: TM43
translation: 招式学习器43

label: ITEM_TM_SECRET_POWER.description
source: Adds an effect to\nattack depending\non the location.
translation: 使用时场所不同，\n招式的追加效果\n也会改变。

label: ITEM_TM_REST.name
source: TM44
translation: 招式学习器44

label: ITEM_TM_REST.description
source: The user sleeps for\n2 turns to restore\nhealth and status.
translation: 连续睡上2回合。\n回复全部HP以及\n治愈所有异常。

label: ITEM_TM_ATTRACT.name
source: TM45
translation: 招式学习器45

label: ITEM_TM_ATTRACT.description
source: Makes it tough to\nattack a foe of the\nopposite gender.
translation: 诱惑异性，让对\n手着迷。对手将\n很难使出招式。

label: ITEM_TM_THIEF.name
source: TM46
translation: 招式学习器46

label: ITEM_TM_THIEF.description
source: While attacking,\nit may steal the\nfoe's held item.
translation: 攻击时盗取道具。\n当自己携带道具\n时，不会去盗取。

label: ITEM_TM_STEEL_WING.name
source: TM47
translation: 招式学习器47

label: ITEM_TM_STEEL_WING.description
source: Spreads hard-\nedged wings and\nslams into the foe.
translation: 用坚硬的翅膀敲打\n对手攻击。有时会\n提高自己的防御。

label: ITEM_TM_SKILL_SWAP.name
source: TM48
translation: 招式学习器48

label: ITEM_TM_SKILL_SWAP.description
source: Switches abilities\nwith the foe on the\nturn this is used.
translation: 利用超能力互换\n自己和对手的\n特性。

label: ITEM_TM_SNATCH.name
source: TM49
translation: 招式学习器49

label: ITEM_TM_SNATCH.description
source: Steals the effects\nof the move the foe\nis trying to use.
translation: 将对手要使用的回\n复招式或能力变化\n招式夺为己用。

label: ITEM_TM_OVERHEAT.name
source: TM50
translation: 招式学习器50

label: ITEM_TM_OVERHEAT.description
source: Enables full-power\nattack, but sharply\nlowers Sp. Atk.
translation: 使出全部力量攻击\n对手。之后自己的\n特攻大幅降低。

label: ITEM_HM_CUT.name
source: HM01
translation: 秘传学习器01

label: ITEM_HM_CUT.description
source: Attacks the foe\nwith sharp blades\nor claws.
translation: 用镰刀或爪子等\n切斩对手攻击。

label: ITEM_HM_FLY.name
source: HM02
translation: 秘传学习器02

label: ITEM_HM_FLY.description
source: Flies up on the\nfirst turn, then\nattacks next turn.
translation: 第1回合飞上天空\n，第2回合攻击\n对手。

label: ITEM_HM_SURF.name
source: HM03
translation: 秘传学习器03

label: ITEM_HM_SURF.description
source: Creates a huge\nwave, then crashes\nit down on the foe.
translation: 利用大浪攻击自己\n周围所有的\n宝可梦。

label: ITEM_HM_STRENGTH.name
source: HM04
translation: 秘传学习器04

label: ITEM_HM_STRENGTH.description
source: Builds enormous\npower, then slams\nthe foe.
translation: 使出浑身力气殴打\n对手攻击。

label: ITEM_HM_FLASH.name
source: HM05
translation: 秘传学习器05

label: ITEM_HM_FLASH.description
source: Looses a powerful\nblast of light that\nreduces accuracy.
translation: 使出光芒降低对手\n的命中率。也可在\n暗窟里照亮四周。

label: ITEM_HM_ROCK_SMASH.name
source: HM06
translation: 秘传学习器06

label: ITEM_HM_ROCK_SMASH.description
source: A rock-crushingly\ntough attack that\nmay lower Defense.
translation: 用拳头攻击。\n有时会降低\n对手的防御。

label: ITEM_HM_WATERFALL.name
source: HM07
translation: 秘传学习器07

label: ITEM_HM_WATERFALL.description
source: Attacks the foe\nwith enough power\nto climb waterfalls.
translation: 以惊人的气势\n扑向对手。有时会\n使对手畏缩。

label: ITEM_HM_DIVE.name
source: HM08
translation: 秘传学习器08

label: ITEM_HM_DIVE.description
source: Dives underwater\nthe 1st turn, then\nattacks next turn.
translation: 第1回合潜入水中\n，第2回合浮上来\n攻击。

label: ITEM_OVAL_CHARM.name
source: OVAL CHARM
translation: 圆形护符

label: ITEM_OVAL_CHARM.description
source: Raises the chance\nof finding eggs\nat the daycare.
translation: 在野餐时会更容易\n找到蛋的神奇浑圆\n护符。

label: ITEM_SHINY_CHARM.name
source: SHINY CHARM
translation: 闪耀护符

label: ITEM_SHINY_CHARM.description
source: A charm that will\nraise the chance\nof Shiny Pokémon.
translation: 据说会更容易遇见\n发光宝可梦的神奇\n闪光护符。

label: ITEM_CATCHING_CHARM.name
source: CATCHING CHARM
translation: 防晃护符

label: ITEM_CATCHING_CHARM.description
source: A charm that raises\nthe chance of\nCritical Captures.
translation: 带上它就能更容易\n触发会心捕捉。

label: ITEM_EXP_CHARM.name
source: EXP. CHARM
translation: 经验护符

label: ITEM_EXP_CHARM.description
source: A charm that raises\nthe amount of Exp.\nearned in battle.
translation: 拥有后，宝可梦获\n得的经验值就会增\n加。

label: ITEM_ROTOM_CATALOG.name
source: ROTOM CATALOG
translation: 洛托姆型录

label: ITEM_ROTOM_CATALOG.description
source: A catalog full of\ndevices liked by\nRotom.
translation: 通过使用这本指南\n，可以让洛托姆潜\n入或脱离家电。

label: ITEM_GRACIDEA.name
source: GRACIDEA
translation: 葛拉西蒂亚花

label: ITEM_GRACIDEA.description
source: Bouquets made with\nit are offered as a\ntoken of gratitude.
translation: 为了表达感激之情\n，有时会将其扎成\n花束送出。

label: ITEM_REVEAL_GLASS.name
source: REVEAL GLASS
translation: 现形镜

label: ITEM_REVEAL_GLASS.description
source: This glass returns\na Pokémon back to\nits original form.
translation: 能够通过照出真实\n，让宝可梦变回原\n样的神奇镜子。

label: ITEM_DNA_SPLICERS.name
source: DNA SPLICERS
translation: 基因之楔

label: ITEM_DNA_SPLICERS.description
source: Splicer that fuses\nKyurem and a\ncertain Pokémon.
translation: 据说能让原本为一\n体的酋雷姆和某宝\n可梦合体的楔子。

label: ITEM_ZYGARDE_CUBE.name
source: ZYGARDE CUBE
translation: 基格尔德多面体

label: ITEM_ZYGARDE_CUBE.description
source: An item to store\nZygarde Cores and\nCells.
translation: 用于收集宝可梦基\n格尔德的核心和细\n胞的道具。

label: ITEM_PRISON_BOTTLE.name
source: PRISON BOTTLE
translation: 惩戒之壶

label: ITEM_PRISON_BOTTLE.description
source: A bottle used to\nseal a certain\nPokémon long ago.
translation: 据说在很久以前封\n印着某只宝可梦力\n量的壶。

label: ITEM_N_SOLARIZER.name
source: N-SOLARIZER
translation: 奈克洛索尔合体器

label: ITEM_N_SOLARIZER.description
source: A device to fuse\nand split Necrozma\nusing a Solgaleo.
translation: 用来让需求光的奈\n克洛兹玛和索尔迦\n雷欧合体的机器。

label: ITEM_N_LUNARIZER.name
source: N-LUNARIZER
translation: 奈克洛露奈合体器

label: ITEM_N_LUNARIZER.description
source: A device to fuse\nand split Necrozma\nusing a Lunala.
translation: 用来让需求光的奈\n克洛兹玛和露奈雅\n拉合体的机器。

label: ITEM_REINS_OF_UNITY.name
source: REINS OF UNITY
translation: 牵绊缰绳

label: ITEM_REINS_OF_UNITY.description
source: Reins that unite\nCalyrex with its\nbeloved steed.
translation: 拿到光下即可生辉\n的布。

label: ITEM_MEGA_RING.name
source: MEGA RING
translation: 超级环

label: ITEM_Z_POWER_RING.name
source: Z-POWER RING
translation: Z强力手环

label: ITEM_Z_POWER_RING.description
source: A strange ring\nthat enables\nZ-Move usage.
translation: 通过使用训练家来\n让宝可梦释放出Z\n力量的神奇手环。

label: ITEM_DYNAMAX_BAND.name
source: DYNAMAX BAND
translation: 极巨腕带

label: ITEM_DYNAMAX_BAND.description
source: A band carrying a\nWishing Star that\nallows Dynamaxing.
translation: 内嵌了许愿星，在\n能量点会发出光芒\n使宝可梦极巨化。

label: ITEM_BICYCLE.name
source: BIKE
translation: 自行车

label: ITEM_BICYCLE.description
source: A folding bicycle.\nPress R while still\nto change speeds.
translation: 能比跑步鞋跑得还\n快的折叠式自行车\n。

label: ITEM_MACH_BIKE.name
source: MACH BIKE
translation: 音速自行车

label: ITEM_MACH_BIKE.description
source: A folding bicycle\nthat doubles your\nspeed or better.
translation: 能以2倍以上的速\n度移动的折叠式自\n行车。

label: ITEM_ACRO_BIKE.name
source: ACRO BIKE
translation: 越野自行车

label: ITEM_ACRO_BIKE.description
source: A folding bicycle\ncapable of jumps\nand wheelies.
translation: 能做出跳跃或抬前\n轮动作的折叠式自\n行车。

label: ITEM_OLD_ROD.name
source: OLD ROD
translation: 破旧钓竿

label: ITEM_OLD_ROD.description
source: Use by any body of\nwater to fish for\nwild Pokémon.
translation: 又破又旧的钓竿。\n在有水的地方可以\n钓到宝可梦。

label: ITEM_GOOD_ROD.name
source: GOOD ROD
translation: 好钓竿

label: ITEM_GOOD_ROD.description
source: A decent fishing\nrod for catching\nwild Pokémon.
translation: 不错的新钓竿。在\n有水的地方可以钓\n到宝可梦。

label: ITEM_SUPER_ROD.name
source: SUPER ROD
translation: 厉害钓竿

label: ITEM_SUPER_ROD.description
source: The best fishing\nrod for catching\nwild Pokémon.
translation: 最新的厉害钓竿。\n在有水的地方可以\n钓到宝可梦。

label: ITEM_DOWSING_MACHINE.name
source: DOWSING MACHINE
translation: 探宝器

label: ITEM_DOWSING_MACHINE.description
source: A device that\nsignals an invisible\nitem by sound.
translation: 会对看不见的道具\n起反应的最尖端机\n器。

label: ITEM_TOWN_MAP.name
source: TOWN MAP
translation: 城镇地图

label: ITEM_TOWN_MAP.description
source: Can be viewed\nanytime. Shows your\npresent location.
translation: 可以随时轻松查看\n的便利地图。也能\n清楚自己的位置。

label: ITEM_VS_SEEKER.name
source: VS. SEEKER
translation: 对战搜寻器

label: ITEM_VS_SEEKER.description
source: A rechargeable unit\nthat flags battle-\nready Trainers.
translation: 会告诉你想对战的\n训练家在哪的机器\n。走路就能充电。

label: ITEM_TM_CASE.name
source: TM CASE
translation: 招式学习器盒

label: ITEM_TM_CASE.description
source: A convenient case\nthat holds TMs and\nHMs.
translation: 用来存放招式学习\n器的盒子，放在重\n要物品口袋里。

label: ITEM_BERRY_POUCH.name
source: BERRY POUCH
translation: 树果袋

label: ITEM_BERRY_POUCH.description
source: A convenient\ncontainer that\nholds Berries.
translation: 将树果收集起来的\n袋子，放在包包的\n重要物品口袋里。

label: ITEM_COIN_CASE.name
source: COIN CASE
translation: 代币盒

label: ITEM_COIN_CASE.description
source: A case that holds\nup to 9,999 Coins.
translation: 可以存放代币的盒\n子。最多能放入\n50000枚。

label: ITEM_POWDER_JAR.name
source: POWDER JAR
translation: 粉末收集瓶

label: ITEM_POWDER_JAR.description
source: Stores Berry\nPowder made using\na Berry Crusher.
translation: 能收纳树果碾碎器\n制作出的树果粉末\n的保存用瓶子。

label: ITEM_WAILMER_PAIL.name
source: WAILMER PAIL
translation: 吼吼鲸喷壶

label: ITEM_WAILMER_PAIL.description
source: A tool used for\nwatering Berries\nand plants.
translation: 浇水的道具。能让\n埋在土壤里的树果\n快快长大。

label: ITEM_POKE_RADAR.name
source: POKé RADAR
translation: 宝可追踪

label: ITEM_POKE_RADAR.description
source: A tool used to\nsearch out Pokémon\nhiding in grass.
translation: 能够将藏在草丛里\n的宝可梦找出来的\n道具。走路充电。

label: ITEM_SOOT_SACK.name
source: SOOT SACK
translation: 集灰袋

label: ITEM_SOOT_SACK.description
source: A sack used to\ngather and hold\nvolcanic ash.
translation: 将堆积起来的火山\n灰收集起来的袋子\n。

label: ITEM_POKE_FLUTE.name
source: POKé FLUTE
translation: 宝可梦之笛

label: ITEM_POKE_FLUTE.description
source: A sweet-sounding\nflute that awakens\nPokémon.
translation: 能吹出让睡着的宝\n可梦都会醒来的美\n妙音色的笛子。

label: ITEM_FAME_CHECKER.name
source: FAME CHECKER
translation: 声音记录器

label: ITEM_FAME_CHECKER.description
source: Stores information\non famous people\nfor instant recall.
translation: 可以重复查看打听\n到的有名人物的东\n西。

label: ITEM_TEACHY_TV.name
source: TEACHY TV
translation: 教学电视

label: ITEM_TEACHY_TV.description
source: A TV set tuned to\nan advice program\nfor Trainers.
translation: 可以收看对新手训\n练家有帮助的节目\n的电视。

label: ITEM_SS_TICKET.name
source: S.S. TICKET
translation: 船票

label: ITEM_SS_TICKET.description
source: The ticket required\nfor sailing on a\nferry.
translation: 乘坐渡轮时需要用\n到的船票。上面绘\n有船只的图案。

label: ITEM_EON_TICKET.name
source: EON TICKET
translation: 无限船票

label: ITEM_EON_TICKET.description
source: The ticket for a\nferry to a distant\nsouthern island.
translation: 前往南方孤岛的船\n票。

label: ITEM_MYSTIC_TICKET.name
source: MYSTIC TICKET
translation: 神秘船票

label: ITEM_MYSTIC_TICKET.description
source: A ticket required\nto board the ship\nto Navel Rock.
translation: 前往肚脐岩时必要\n的船票。神秘地发\n着光。

label: ITEM_AURORA_TICKET.name
source: AURORA TICKET

translation: 前往诞生之岛时必\n要的船票。美丽地\n散发着光芒。

label: ITEM_OLD_SEA_MAP.name

translation: 古航海图

label: ITEM_OLD_SEA_MAP.description
source: A faded sea chart\nthat shows the way\nto a certain island.
translation: 记录着前往某座岛\n屿的路线的一张古\n老的航海图。

label: ITEM_LETTER.name

translation: 给大吾的信

label: ITEM_GO_GOGGLES.name

translation: GOGO护目镜

label: ITEM_GO_GOGGLES.description

translation: 能在沙漠的沙暴中\n保护眼睛的出色护\n目镜。

label: ITEM_DEVON_SCOPE.name
source: DEVON SCOPE
translation: 得文侦测镜

label: ITEM_DEVON_SCOPE.description

translation: 会对看不见的宝可\n梦起反应的得文特\n制产品。

translation: 熔岩标志

translation: 与熔岩队的标志形\n状相同的徽章模样\n的东西。

label: ITEM_CONTEST_PASS.name
source: CONTEST PASS
translation: 华丽大赛参加证

label: ITEM_CONTEST_PASS.description
source: The pass required\nfor entering\nPokémon Contests.
translation: 拿着它就可以参加\n华丽大赛。上面印\n有纪念奖章。

label: ITEM_PARCEL.name
source: PARCEL
translation: 包裹

label: ITEM_PARCEL.description
source: A parcel for Prof.\nOak from a Pokémon\nMart's clerk.
translation: 常青市的友好商店\n托付的包裹。需要\n交给大木博士。

label: ITEM_SECRET_KEY.name
source: SECRET KEY
translation: 秘密钥匙

label: ITEM_SECRET_KEY.description
source: The key to the\nCinnabar Island\nGym's entrance.
translation: 能打开红莲岛上那\n座宝可梦道馆的钥\n匙。

label: ITEM_BIKE_VOUCHER.name
source: BIKE VOUCHER
translation: 兑换券

label: ITEM_BIKE_VOUCHER.description
source: A voucher for\nobtaining a bicycle\nfrom the Bike Shop.
translation: 给华蓝市的奇迹自\n行车店就能交换得\n到自行车。

label: ITEM_GOLD_TEETH.name
source: GOLD TEETH
translation: 金假牙

label: ITEM_GOLD_TEETH.description
source: Gold dentures lost\nby the Safari\nZone's Warden.
translation: 狩猎地带的园长遗\n失的金假牙。

label: ITEM_CARD_KEY.name
source: CARD KEY
translation: 钥匙卡

label: ITEM_LIFT_KEY.name
source: LIFT KEY
translation: 电梯钥匙

label: ITEM_LIFT_KEY.description
source: An elevator key\nused in Team\nRocket's Hideout.
translation: 能启动位于火箭队\n基地的电梯。

label: ITEM_SILPH_SCOPE.name
source: SILPH SCOPE
translation: 西尔佛检视镜

label: ITEM_SILPH_SCOPE.description
source: Silph Co's scope\nmakes unseeable\nPOKéMON visible.
translation: 可以看见人眼无法\n看见的东西。

label: ITEM_TRI_PASS.name
source: TRI-PASS
translation: 三岛通行船券

label: ITEM_TRI_PASS.description
source: A pass for ferries\nbetween One, Two,\nand Three Island.
translation: 能够在第1、2、\n3岛之间用渡轮移\n动的通行证。

label: ITEM_RAINBOW_PASS.name
source: RAINBOW PASS
translation: 七彩通行船券

label: ITEM_RAINBOW_PASS.description
source: For ferries serving\nVermilion and the\nSevii Islands.
translation: 能够在枯叶市和七\n之岛之间用渡轮移\n动的通行证。

label: ITEM_TEA.name
source: TEA
translation: 茶

label: ITEM_TEA.description
source: A thirst-quenching\ntea prepared by an\nold lady.
translation: 有一点点苦，却又\n芬芳宜人的香茶。

label: ITEM_RUBY.name
source: RUBY
translation: 红宝石

label: ITEM_RUBY.description
source: An exquisite, red-\nglowing gem that\nsymbolizes passion.
translation: 散发着红色光辉的\n非常漂亮的宝石。\n热情的象征。

label: ITEM_SAPPHIRE.name
source: SAPPHIRE
translation: 蓝宝石

label: ITEM_SAPPHIRE.description
source: A brilliant blue gem\nthat symbolizes\nhonesty.
translation: 散发着蓝色光辉的\n非常漂亮的宝石。\n真诚的象征。

label: ITEM_ABILITY_SHIELD.name
source: ABILITY SHIELD
translation: 特性护具

label: ITEM_ABILITY_SHIELD.description
source: Ability changes are\nprevented for this\nitems's holder.
translation: 可爱而有个性的盾\n。携带后，特性不\n会被对手改变。

label: ITEM_CLEAR_AMULET.name
source: CLEAR AMULET
translation: 清净坠饰

label: ITEM_CLEAR_AMULET.description
source: Stat lowering is\nprevented for this\nitems's holder.
translation: 光芒晶莹剔透的坠\n饰。携带后不会因\n为对手降低能力。

label: ITEM_PUNCHING_GLOVE.name
source: PUNCHING GLOVE
translation: 拳击手套

label: ITEM_PUNCHING_GLOVE.description
source: Powers up punching\nmoves and removes\ntheir contact.
translation: 携带后，拳击招式\n威力提高，且不会\n接触到对手。

label: ITEM_COVERT_CLOAK.name
source: COVERT CLOAK
translation: 密探斗篷

label: ITEM_COVERT_CLOAK.description
source: Protects holder\nfrom additional\neffects of moves.
translation: 携带后，变得不会\n受到招式的追加效\n果影响。

label: ITEM_LOADED_DICE.name
source: LOADED DICE
translation: 机变骰子

label: ITEM_LOADED_DICE.description
source: Rolls high numbers.\nMultihit strikes\nhit more times.
translation: 携带后，在使用连\n续招式时，能使出\n较多次招式。

label: ITEM_AUSPICIOUS_ARMOR.name

translation: 庆祝之铠

translation: 能让某些宝可梦进\n化的神奇铠甲。蕴\n含着祝贺的感情。

label: ITEM_BOOSTER_ENERGY.name
source: BOOSTER ENERGY
translation: 驱劲能量

label: ITEM_BOOSTER_ENERGY.description
source: Encapsuled energy\nups Pokémon with\ncertain Abilities.
translation: 让有某种特性的宝\n可梦携带后能力会\n提升的胶囊。

label: ITEM_BIG_BAMBOO_SHOOT.name
source: BIG BAMBOO SHOOT
translation: 大竹笋

label: ITEM_BIG_BAMBOO_SHOOT.description
source: A large and rare\nbamboo shoot. Best\nsold to gourmands.
translation: 大大的珍贵竹笋。\n在部分美食家中拥\n有非常高人气。

label: ITEM_GIMMIGHOUL_COIN.name
source: GIMMIGHOUL COIN
translation: 索财灵的硬币

label: ITEM_GIMMIGHOUL_COIN.description
source: Gimmighoul hoard\nand treasure these\ncurious coins.
translation: 宝可梦掉落的东西\n。索财灵珍爱有加\n地收集着它。

label: ITEM_LEADERS_CREST.name
source: LEADER'S CREST
translation: 头领凭证

label: ITEM_LEADERS_CREST.description
source: A shard of an old\nblade of some sort.\nHeld by Bisharp.
translation: 只有率领着驹刀小\n兵群体的劈斩司令\n能携带着的碎片。

label: ITEM_MALICIOUS_ARMOR.name
source: MALICIOUS ARMOR
translation: 咒术之铠

label: ITEM_MALICIOUS_ARMOR.description
source: Armor inhabited by\nmalicious will.\nCauses evolution.
translation: 能让某些宝可梦进\n化的神奇铠甲。蕴\n含着诅咒的感情。

label: ITEM_MIRROR_HERB.name
source: MIRROR HERB
translation: 模仿香草

source: Mirrors an enemy's\nstat increases\nbut only once.
translation: 仅有1次可在对手\n提高能力时，模仿\n提高同样的能力。

label: ITEM_SCROLL_OF_DARKNESS.name
source: SCROLL OF DARKNESS
translation: 恶之挂轴

translation: 能让某些宝可梦进\n化的神奇挂轴。上\n面写着恶之奥秘。

label: ITEM_SCROLL_OF_WATERS.name

translation: 能让某些宝可梦进\n化的神奇挂轴。上\n面写着水之奥秘。

label: ITEM_TERA_ORB.name
source: TERA ORB
translation: 太晶珠

label: ITEM_TERA_ORB.description
source: Energy charges can\nbe used to cause\nTerastallization.
translation: 蕴藏着结晶之力的\n宝珠。蓄能后能够\n让宝可梦太晶化。

label: ITEM_TINY_BAMBOO_SHOOT.name
source: TINY BAMBOO SHOOT
translation: 小竹笋

label: ITEM_TINY_BAMBOO_SHOOT.description
source: A small and rare\nbamboo shoot. Best\nsold to gourmands.
translation: 小小的珍贵竹笋。\n在部分美食家中拥\n有很高人气。

translation: 碎后会变得锋利似\n玻璃的黑石。某种\n宝可梦很喜欢它。

translation: 联系绳

translation: 蕴藏着不可思议能\n量的绳子。某种宝\n可梦们很喜欢它。

source: PEAT BLOCK
translation: 泥炭块

label: ITEM_PEAT_BLOCK.description

translation: 质地像是泥土的煤\n炭块。某种宝可梦\n很喜欢它。

source: BERSERK GENE
translation: 破坏基因

translation: 攻击的威力就会提\n高，但会造成混乱\n。

translation: 妖精之羽

translation: 遇光后微微发光的\n羽毛。携带后妖精\n招式威力提高。

source: SYRUPY APPLE
translation: 蜜汁苹果

source: A very syrupy apple\nthat makes certain\nPokémon evolve.
translation: 这种神奇的苹果可\n以使特定的宝可梦\n进化。富含蜜汁。

source: UNREMARKABLE TEACUP

label: ITEM_HEARTHFLAME_MASK.name

translation: 在太晶团体战中会\n获得更多太晶碎块\n的护符。

label: ITEM_METAL_ALLOY.name
source: METAL ALLOY

label: ITEM_METAL_ALLOY.description

translation: 能让某些宝可梦进\n化的神奇金属。由\n多层次叠加而成。

translation: 空手劈

label: MOVE_KARATE_CHOP.description
source: A chopping attack with a\nhigh critical-hit ratio.
translation: 用锋利的手刀劈向对手攻击。\n容易击中要害。

label: MOVE_DOUBLE_SLAP.name
source: DOUBLE SLAP
translation: 连环巴掌

label: MOVE_DOUBLE_SLAP.description
source: Repeatedly slaps the foe\n2 to 5 times.
translation: 用连环巴掌拍打对手攻击。\n连续攻击2~5次。

label: MOVE_COMET_PUNCH.name
source: COMET PUNCH
translation: 连续拳

label: MOVE_COMET_PUNCH.description
source: Repeatedly punches the foe\n2 to 5 times.
translation: 用拳头怒涛般的殴打对手攻击。\n连续攻击2~5次。

label: MOVE_MEGA_PUNCH.name
source: MEGA PUNCH
translation: 百万吨重拳

label: MOVE_MEGA_PUNCH.description
source: A strong punch thrown with\nincredible power.
translation: 用充满力量的拳头攻击对手。

label: MOVE_PAY_DAY.name
source: PAY DAY
translation: 聚宝功

label: MOVE_PAY_DAY.description
source: Throws coins at the foe.\nMoney is recovered after.
translation: 向对手投掷小金币攻击。\n战斗后可以拿到钱。

label: MOVE_FIRE_PUNCH.name
source: FIRE PUNCH
translation: 火焰拳

label: MOVE_FIRE_PUNCH.description
source: A fiery punch that may burn\nthe foe.
translation: 用充满火焰的拳头攻击对手。\n有时会让对手陷入灼伤状态。

label: MOVE_ICE_PUNCH.name
source: ICE PUNCH
translation: 冰冻拳

label: MOVE_THUNDER_PUNCH.name
source: THUNDER PUNCH
translation: 雷电拳

label: MOVE_THUNDER_PUNCH.description
source: An electrified punch that\nmay paralyze the foe.
translation: 用充满电流的拳头攻击对手。\n有时会让对手陷入麻痹状态。

label: MOVE_SCRATCH.name
source: SCRATCH
translation: 抓

label: MOVE_SCRATCH.description
source: Scratches the foe with\nsharp claws.
translation: 用坚硬且无比锋利的爪\n子抓对手攻击。

label: MOVE_VISE_GRIP.name
source: VISE GRIP
translation: 夹住

label: MOVE_VISE_GRIP.description
source: Grips the foe with large and\npowerful pincers.
translation: 将对手从两侧夹住，\n给予伤害。

label: MOVE_GUILLOTINE.name
source: GUILLOTINE
translation: 极落钳

label: MOVE_GUILLOTINE.description
source: A powerful pincer attack\nthat KOs if it hits.
translation: 用钳子或剪刀夹断对手攻击。\n只要命中就会一击昏厥。

label: MOVE_SWORDS_DANCE.name
source: SWORDS DANCE
translation: 剑舞

label: MOVE_SWORDS_DANCE.description
source: A fighting dance that\nsharply raises Attack.
translation: 激烈地跳起战舞提高气势。\n大幅提高自己的攻击。

label: MOVE_CUT.name
source: CUT
translation: 居合劈

label: MOVE_CUT.description
source: Cuts the foe with sharp\nscythes, claws, etc.
translation: 用镰刀或爪子等切斩\n对手攻击。

label: MOVE_GUST.name
source: GUST
translation: 起风

label: MOVE_GUST.description
source: Strikes the foe with a gust\nof wind whipped up by wings.
translation: 用翅膀将刮起的狂风\n袭向对手进行攻击。

label: MOVE_WING_ATTACK.name
source: WING ATTACK
translation: 翅膀攻击

label: MOVE_WING_ATTACK.description
source: Strikes the foe with wings\nspread wide.
translation: 大大地展开美丽的翅膀，\n将其撞向对手攻击。

label: MOVE_WHIRLWIND.name
source: WHIRLWIND
translation: 吹飞

label: MOVE_WHIRLWIND.description
source: Blows away the foe, switches\nit out or ends wild battle.
translation: 吹飞对手使后备宝可梦上场。\n若是野生宝可梦将结束战斗。

label: MOVE_FLY.name
source: FLY
translation: 飞翔

label: MOVE_FLY.description
source: Flies up on the first turn,\nthen strikes the next turn.
translation: 第1回合飞上天空，\n第2回合攻击对手。

label: MOVE_BIND.name
source: BIND
translation: 绑紧

label: MOVE_SLAM.name
source: SLAM
translation: 摔打

label: MOVE_SLAM.description
source: Slams the foe with a long\ntail, vine, etc.
translation: 使用长长的尾巴或藤蔓\n等摔打对手攻击。

label: MOVE_VINE_WHIP.name
source: VINE WHIP
translation: 藤鞭

label: MOVE_STOMP.name
source: STOMP
translation: 踩踏

label: MOVE_STOMP.description
source: Stomps the enemy with a big\nfoot. May cause flinching.
translation: 用大脚踩踏对手攻击。\n有时会使对手畏缩。

label: MOVE_DOUBLE_KICK.name
source: DOUBLE KICK
translation: 二连踢

label: MOVE_DOUBLE_KICK.description
source: A double-kicking attack\nthat strikes the foe twice.
translation: 用2只脚踢飞对手攻击。\n连续2次给予伤害。

label: MOVE_MEGA_KICK.name
source: MEGA KICK
translation: 百万吨重踢

label: MOVE_MEGA_KICK.description
source: An extremely powerful kick\nwith intense force.
translation: 使出力大无穷的重踢\n踢飞对手攻击。

label: MOVE_JUMP_KICK.name
source: JUMP KICK
translation: 飞踢

label: MOVE_ROLLING_KICK.name
source: ROLLING KICK
translation: 回旋踢

label: MOVE_ROLLING_KICK.description
source: A fast kick delivered from\na rapid spin. May flinch.
translation: 边快速旋转，边踢飞对手\n攻击。有时会使对手畏缩。

label: MOVE_SAND_ATTACK.name
source: SAND ATTACK
translation: 泼沙

label: MOVE_SAND_ATTACK.description
source: Reduces the foe's accuracy\nby hurling sand in its face.
translation: 向对手脸上泼沙子，\n从而降低命中率。

label: MOVE_HEADBUTT.name
source: HEADBUTT
translation: 头锤

label: MOVE_HEADBUTT.description
source: A ramming attack that may\ncause flinching.
translation: 将头伸出，笔直地扑向对手\n攻击。有时会使对手畏缩。

label: MOVE_HORN_ATTACK.name
source: HORN ATTACK
translation: 角撞

label: MOVE_HORN_ATTACK.description
source: Jabs the foe with sharp\nhorns.
translation: 用尖锐的角攻击对手。

label: MOVE_FURY_ATTACK.name
source: FURY ATTACK
translation: 乱击

label: MOVE_FURY_ATTACK.description
source: Jabs the foe 2 to 5 times\nwith sharp horns, etc.
translation: 用角或喙刺向对手攻击。\n连续攻击2~5次。

label: MOVE_HORN_DRILL.name
source: HORN DRILL
translation: 角钻

label: MOVE_HORN_DRILL.description
source: A one-hit KO attack that\nuses a horn like a drill.
translation: 用旋转的角刺入对手攻击。\n只要命中就会一击昏厥。

label: MOVE_TACKLE.name
source: TACKLE
translation: 撞击

label: MOVE_BODY_SLAM.name
source: BODY SLAM
translation: 泰山压顶

label: MOVE_BODY_SLAM.description
source: A full-body slam that may\ncause paralysis.
translation: 用整个身体压住对手攻击。\n有时会让对手陷入麻痹状态。

label: MOVE_WRAP.name
source: WRAP
translation: 紧束

label: MOVE_TAKE_DOWN.name
source: TAKE DOWN
translation: 猛撞

label: MOVE_TAKE_DOWN.description
source: A reckless charge attack\nthat also hurts the user.
translation: 以惊人的气势撞向对手攻击。\n自己也会受到少许伤害。

label: MOVE_THRASH.name
source: THRASH
translation: 大闹一番

label: MOVE_THRASH.description
source: A rampage of 2 to 3 turns\nthat confuses the user.
translation: 在2~3回合内乱打攻击对手。\n大闹一番后会陷入混乱。

label: MOVE_DOUBLE_EDGE.name
source: DOUBLE-EDGE
translation: 舍身冲撞

label: MOVE_DOUBLE_EDGE.description
source: A life-risking tackle that\nalso hurts the user.
translation: 拼命地猛撞向对手攻击。\n自己也会受到不小的伤害。

label: MOVE_TAIL_WHIP.name
source: TAIL WHIP
translation: 摇尾巴

label: MOVE_TAIL_WHIP.description
source: Wags the tail to lower the\nfoe's Defense.
translation: 可爱地左右摇尾巴，使对手\n大意。会降低对手的防御。

label: MOVE_POISON_STING.name
source: POISON STING
translation: 毒针

label: MOVE_POISON_STING.description
source: A toxic attack with barbs,\netc., that may poison.
translation: 将有毒的针刺入对手攻击。\n有时会让对手陷入中毒状态。

label: MOVE_TWINEEDLE.name
source: TWINEEDLE
translation: 双针

label: MOVE_TWINEEDLE.description
source: Foreleg stingers jab foe\ntwice. May poison.
translation: 将2根针刺入对手，连续2次\n攻击。有时使对手中毒。

label: MOVE_PIN_MISSILE.name
source: PIN MISSILE
translation: 飞弹针

label: MOVE_PIN_MISSILE.description
source: Sharp pins are fired to\nstrike 2 to 5 times.
translation: 向对手发射锐针攻击。\n连续攻击2~5次。

label: MOVE_LEER.name
source: LEER
translation: 瞪眼

label: MOVE_LEER.description
source: Frightens the foes with a\nleer to lower Defense.
translation: 用犀利的眼神使其害怕，\n从而降低对手的防御。

label: MOVE_BITE.name
source: BITE
translation: 咬住

label: MOVE_BITE.description
source: Bites with vicious fangs.\nMay cause flinching.
translation: 用尖锐的牙咬住对手攻击。\n有时会使对手畏缩。

label: MOVE_GROWL.name
source: GROWL
translation: 叫声

label: MOVE_GROWL.description
source: Growls cutely to reduce the\nfoe's Attack.
translation: 让对手听可爱的叫声，\n使其疏忽，降低攻击。

label: MOVE_ROAR.name
source: ROAR
translation: 吼叫

label: MOVE_ROAR.description
source: Switches the foe out\nor ends wild battle.
translation: 强制后备宝可梦上场。\n若为野生宝可梦结束战斗。

label: MOVE_SING.name
source: SING
translation: 唱歌

label: MOVE_SING.description
source: A soothing song lulls the\nfoe into a deep slumber.
translation: 让对手听舒适、美妙的歌声，\n从而陷入睡眠状态。

label: MOVE_SUPERSONIC.name
source: SUPERSONIC
translation: 超音波

label: MOVE_SUPERSONIC.description
source: Emits bizarre sound waves\nthat may confuse the foe.
translation: 从身体发出特殊的音波，\n从而使对手混乱。

label: MOVE_SONIC_BOOM.name
source: SONIC BOOM
translation: 音爆

label: MOVE_SONIC_BOOM.description
source: Launches shock waves that\nalways inflict 20 HP damage.
translation: 将冲击波撞向对手攻击。\n必定会给予20的伤害。

label: MOVE_DISABLE.name
source: DISABLE
translation: 定身法

label: MOVE_ACID.name
source: ACID
translation: 溶解液

label: MOVE_EMBER.name
source: EMBER
translation: 火花

label: MOVE_EMBER.description
source: A weak fire attack that may\ninflict a burn.
translation: 向对手发射小型火焰攻击。\n有时会让对手陷入灼伤状态。

label: MOVE_FLAMETHROWER.name
source: FLAMETHROWER
translation: 喷射火焰

label: MOVE_FLAMETHROWER.description
source: A powerful fire attack that\nmay inflict a burn.
translation: 向对手发射烈焰攻击。\n有时会让对手陷入灼伤状态。

label: MOVE_MIST.name
source: MIST
translation: 白雾

label: MOVE_MIST.description
source: Creates a mist that stops\nreduction of stats.
translation: 用白雾覆盖身体。在5回合内\n不会让对手降低自己的能力。

label: MOVE_WATER_GUN.name
source: WATER GUN
translation: 水枪

label: MOVE_WATER_GUN.description
source: Squirts water to attack\nthe foe.
translation: 向对手猛烈地喷射水流\n攻击。

label: MOVE_HYDRO_PUMP.name
source: HYDRO PUMP
translation: 水炮

label: MOVE_HYDRO_PUMP.description
source: Blasts water at high power\nto strike the foe.
translation: 向对手猛烈地喷射大量\n水流攻击。

label: MOVE_SURF.name
source: SURF
translation: 冲浪

label: MOVE_ICE_BEAM.name
source: ICE BEAM
translation: 冰冻光束

label: MOVE_BLIZZARD.name
source: BLIZZARD
translation: 暴风雪

label: MOVE_PSYBEAM.name
source: PSYBEAM
translation: 幻象光线

label: MOVE_PSYBEAM.description
source: Fires a peculiar ray that\nmay confuse the foe.
translation: 向对手发射神奇的光线攻击。\n有时会使对手混乱。

label: MOVE_BUBBLE_BEAM.name
source: BUBBLE BEAM
translation: 泡沫光线

label: MOVE_BUBBLE_BEAM.description
source: Forcefully sprays bubbles\nthat may lower Speed.
translation: 向对手猛烈地喷射泡沫攻击。\n有时会降低对手的速度。

label: MOVE_AURORA_BEAM.name
source: AURORA BEAM
translation: 极光束

label: MOVE_AURORA_BEAM.description
source: Fires a rainbow-colored\nbeam that may lower Attack.
translation: 向对手发射虹色光束攻击。\n有时会降低对手的攻击。

label: MOVE_HYPER_BEAM.name
source: HYPER BEAM
translation: 破坏光线

label: MOVE_PECK.name
source: PECK
translation: 啄

label: MOVE_PECK.description
source: Attacks the foe with a\njabbing beak, etc.
translation: 用尖锐的喙或角刺向对\n手攻击。

label: MOVE_DRILL_PECK.name
source: DRILL PECK
translation: 啄钻

label: MOVE_DRILL_PECK.description
source: A corkscrewing attack with\nthe beak acting as a drill.
translation: 边旋转边将尖喙，\n刺入对手攻击。

label: MOVE_SUBMISSION.name
source: SUBMISSION
translation: 深渊翻滚

label: MOVE_SUBMISSION.description
source: A reckless body slam that\nalso hurts the user.
translation: 将对手同自己一起摔向地面。\n自己也会受到少许伤害。

label: MOVE_LOW_KICK.name
source: LOW KICK
translation: 踢倒

label: MOVE_COUNTER.name
source: COUNTER
translation: 双倍奉还

label: MOVE_COUNTER.description
source: Retaliates any physical hit\nwith double the power.
translation: 从对手那里受到物理攻击\n的伤害将以2倍返还。

label: MOVE_SEISMIC_TOSS.name
source: SEISMIC TOSS
translation: 地球上投

label: MOVE_SEISMIC_TOSS.description
source: Inflicts damage identical\nto the user's level.
translation: 利用引力将对手甩飞出去。\n造成和自己等级相同的伤害。

label: MOVE_STRENGTH.name
source: STRENGTH
translation: 怪力

label: MOVE_STRENGTH.description
source: Builds enormous power,\nthen slams the foe.
translation: 使出浑身力气殴打对手\n攻击。

label: MOVE_ABSORB.name
source: ABSORB
translation: 吸取

label: MOVE_ABSORB.description
source: Attack that absorbs\nhalf the damage inflicted.
translation: 吸取对手的养分攻击。\n可以回复伤害的一半HP。

label: MOVE_MEGA_DRAIN.name
source: MEGA DRAIN
translation: 超级吸取

label: MOVE_LEECH_SEED.name
source: LEECH SEED
translation: 寄生种子

label: MOVE_LEECH_SEED.description
source: Plants a seed on the foe to\nsteal HP on every turn.
translation: 在每回合一点点吸取\n对手的HP，来回复HP。

label: MOVE_GROWTH.name
source: GROWTH
translation: 生长

label: MOVE_RAZOR_LEAF.name
source: RAZOR LEAF
translation: 飞叶快刀

label: MOVE_RAZOR_LEAF.description
source: Cuts enemies with leaves.\nHigh critical-hit ratio.
translation: 飞出叶片，切斩对手进行\n攻击。容易击中要害。

label: MOVE_SOLAR_BEAM.name
source: SOLAR BEAM
translation: 日光束

label: MOVE_SOLAR_BEAM.description
source: Absorbs light in one turn,\nthen attacks next turn.
translation: 第1回合收集满满的日光，\n第2回合发射光束攻击。

label: MOVE_POISON_POWDER.name
source: POISON POWDER
translation: 毒粉

label: MOVE_POISON_POWDER.description
source: Scatters a toxic powder\nthat may poison the foe.
translation: 撒出毒粉，\n从而让对手陷入中毒状态。

label: MOVE_STUN_SPORE.name
source: STUN SPORE
translation: 麻痹粉

label: MOVE_STUN_SPORE.description
source: Scatters a powder that may\nparalyze the foe.
translation: 撒出麻痹粉，\n从而让对手陷入麻痹状态。

label: MOVE_SLEEP_POWDER.name
source: SLEEP POWDER
translation: 催眠粉

label: MOVE_SLEEP_POWDER.description
source: Scatters a powder that may\ncause the foe to sleep.
translation: 撒出催眠粉，\n从而让对手陷入睡眠状态。

label: MOVE_PETAL_DANCE.name
source: PETAL DANCE
translation: 花瓣舞

label: MOVE_STRING_SHOT.name
source: STRING SHOT
translation: 吐丝

label: MOVE_STRING_SHOT.description
source: Binds the foe with string\nto reduce its Speed.
translation: 用口中吐出的丝缠绕对手，\n从而大幅降低对手的速度。

label: MOVE_DRAGON_RAGE.name
source: DRAGON RAGE
translation: 龙之怒

label: MOVE_DRAGON_RAGE.description
source: Launches shock waves that\nalways inflict 40 HP damage.
translation: 将愤怒冲击波撞向对手攻击。\n必定会给予40的伤害。

label: MOVE_FIRE_SPIN.name
source: FIRE SPIN
translation: 火焰旋涡

label: MOVE_THUNDER_SHOCK.name
source: THUNDER SHOCK
translation: 电击

label: MOVE_THUNDER_SHOCK.description
source: An electrical attack that\nmay paralyze the foe.
translation: 发出电流刺激对手攻击。\n有时会让对手陷入麻痹状态。

label: MOVE_THUNDERBOLT.name
source: THUNDERBOLT
translation: 十万伏特

label: MOVE_THUNDERBOLT.description
source: A strong electrical attack\nthat may paralyze the foe.
translation: 向对手发出强力电击攻击。\n有时会让对手陷入麻痹状态。

label: MOVE_THUNDER_WAVE.name
source: THUNDER WAVE
translation: 电磁波

label: MOVE_THUNDER_WAVE.description
source: A weak jolt of electricity\nthat paralyzes the foe.
translation: 向对手发出微弱的电击，\n从而让对手陷入麻痹状态。

label: MOVE_THUNDER.name
source: THUNDER
translation: 打雷

label: MOVE_THUNDER.description
source: A lightning attack that may\ncause paralysis.
translation: 向对手劈下暴雷攻击。\n有时会让对手陷入麻痹状态。

label: MOVE_ROCK_THROW.name
source: ROCK THROW
translation: 落石

label: MOVE_ROCK_THROW.description
source: Throws small rocks to\nstrike the foe.
translation: 拿起小岩石，\n投掷对手攻击。

label: MOVE_EARTHQUAKE.name
source: EARTHQUAKE
translation: 地震

label: MOVE_EARTHQUAKE.description
source: A powerful quake that\nhits all other POKéMON.
translation: 利用地震的冲击，\n攻击自己周围所有的宝可梦。

label: MOVE_FISSURE.name
source: FISSURE
translation: 地裂

label: MOVE_FISSURE.description
source: A one-hit KO move that\ndrops the foe in a fissure.
translation: 让对手掉落于地裂的裂缝中。\n只要命中就会一击昏厥。

label: MOVE_DIG.name
source: DIG
translation: 挖洞

label: MOVE_DIG.description
source: Digs underground the first\nturn and strikes next turn.
translation: 第1回合钻入地底，\n第2回合攻击对手。

label: MOVE_TOXIC.name
source: TOXIC
translation: 剧毒

label: MOVE_TOXIC.description
source: Poisons the foe with an\nintensifying toxin.
translation: 让对手陷入剧毒状态。\n中毒伤害会逐渐增加。

label: MOVE_CONFUSION.name
source: CONFUSION
translation: 念力

label: MOVE_CONFUSION.description
source: A psychic attack that may\ncause confusion.
translation: 向对手发送微弱的念力攻击。\n有时会使对手混乱。

label: MOVE_PSYCHIC.name
source: PSYCHIC
translation: 精神强念

label: MOVE_PSYCHIC.description
source: A powerful psychic attack\nthat may lower Sp. Def.
translation: 向对手发送强大的念力攻击。\n有时会降低对手的特防。

label: MOVE_HYPNOSIS.name
source: HYPNOSIS
translation: 催眠术

label: MOVE_HYPNOSIS.description
source: A hypnotizing move that\nmay induce sleep.
translation: 施以诱导睡意的暗示，\n让对手陷入睡眠状态。

label: MOVE_MEDITATE.name
source: MEDITATE
translation: 瑜伽姿势

label: MOVE_MEDITATE.description
source: Meditates in a peaceful\nfashion to raise Attack.
translation: 唤醒身体深处沉睡的力量，\n从而提高自己的攻击。

label: MOVE_AGILITY.name
source: AGILITY
translation: 高速移动

label: MOVE_AGILITY.description
source: Relaxes the body to sharply\nboost Speed.
translation: 让身体放松变轻，以高速\n移动。大幅提高自己的速度。

label: MOVE_QUICK_ATTACK.name
source: QUICK ATTACK
translation: 电光一闪

label: MOVE_QUICK_ATTACK.description
source: An extremely fast attack\nthat always strikes first.
translation: 以迅雷不及掩耳之势扑向\n对手。必定能够先制攻击。

label: MOVE_RAGE.name
source: RAGE
translation: 愤怒

label: MOVE_RAGE.description
source: Raises the user's Attack\nevery time it is hit.
translation: 如果在使出招式后受到攻击，\n会因愤怒的力量而提高攻击。

label: MOVE_TELEPORT.name
source: TELEPORT
translation: 瞬间移动

label: MOVE_NIGHT_SHADE.name
source: NIGHT SHADE
translation: 黑夜魔影

label: MOVE_NIGHT_SHADE.description
source: Inflicts damage identical\nto the user's level.
translation: 显示恐怖幻影，\n给予自己等级相同的伤害。

label: MOVE_MIMIC.name
source: MIMIC
translation: 模仿

label: MOVE_MIMIC.description
source: Copies last move used by the\nfoe during one battle.
translation: 可以将对手最后使用的招式，\n在战斗内变成自己的招式。

label: MOVE_SCREECH.name
source: SCREECH
translation: 刺耳声

label: MOVE_SCREECH.description
source: Emits a screech to sharply\nreduce the foe's Defense.
translation: 发出令人捂起耳朵的刺耳声，\n从而大幅降低对手的防御。

label: MOVE_DOUBLE_TEAM.name
source: DOUBLE TEAM
translation: 影子分身

label: MOVE_DOUBLE_TEAM.description
source: Creates illusory copies to\nraise evasiveness.
translation: 通过快速移动来制造分身，\n扰乱对手从而提高闪避率。

label: MOVE_RECOVER.name
source: RECOVER
translation: 自我再生

label: MOVE_HARDEN.name
source: HARDEN
translation: 变硬

label: MOVE_HARDEN.description
source: Stiffens the body's \nmuscles to raise Defense.
translation: 全身使劲，让身体变硬，\n从而提高自己的防御。

label: MOVE_MINIMIZE.name
source: MINIMIZE
translation: 变小

label: MOVE_SMOKESCREEN.name
source: SMOKESCREEN
translation: 烟幕

label: MOVE_SMOKESCREEN.description
source: Lowers the foe's accuracy\nusing smoke, ink, etc.
translation: 向对手喷出烟或墨汁等，\n从而降低对手的命中率。

label: MOVE_CONFUSE_RAY.name
source: CONFUSE RAY
translation: 奇异之光

label: MOVE_CONFUSE_RAY.description
source: A sinister ray that\nconfuses the foe.
translation: 显示奇怪的光，扰乱对手。\n使对手混乱。

label: MOVE_WITHDRAW.name
source: WITHDRAW
translation: 缩入壳中

label: MOVE_WITHDRAW.description
source: Withdraws the body into its\nhard shell to raise Defense.
translation: 缩入壳里保护身体，\n从而提高自己的防御。

label: MOVE_DEFENSE_CURL.name
source: DEFENSE CURL
translation: 变圆

label: MOVE_DEFENSE_CURL.description
source: Curls up to conceal weak\nspots and raise Defense.
translation: 将身体蜷曲变圆，\n从而提高自己的防御。

label: MOVE_BARRIER.name
source: BARRIER
translation: 屏障

label: MOVE_BARRIER.description
source: Creates a barrier that\nsharply raises Defense.
translation: 制造坚固的壁障，\n从而大幅提高自己的防御。

label: MOVE_LIGHT_SCREEN.name
source: LIGHT SCREEN
translation: 光墙

label: MOVE_LIGHT_SCREEN.description
source: Wall of light cuts special\ndamage for 5 turns.
translation: 利用神奇的墙壁，在5回合\n内减弱特殊攻击的伤害。

label: MOVE_HAZE.name
source: HAZE
translation: 黑雾

label: MOVE_HAZE.description
source: Creates a black haze that\neliminates all stat changes.
translation: 升起黑雾，\n将全体宝可梦能力变回原点。

label: MOVE_REFLECT.name
source: REFLECT
translation: 反射壁

label: MOVE_REFLECT.description
source: Wall of light cuts physical\ndamage for 5 turns.
translation: 利用神奇的墙壁，在5回合\n内减弱物理攻击的伤害。

label: MOVE_FOCUS_ENERGY.name
source: FOCUS ENERGY
translation: 聚气

label: MOVE_FOCUS_ENERGY.description
source: Focuses power to raise the\ncritical-hit ratio.
translation: 深深地吸口气，集中精神。\n攻击会变得容易击中要害。

label: MOVE_BIDE.name
source: BIDE
translation: 忍耐

label: MOVE_BIDE.description
source: Endures attack for 2\nturns to retaliate double.
translation: 在2回合内忍受攻击，受到的\n伤害会2倍返还给对手。

label: MOVE_METRONOME.name
source: METRONOME
translation: 挥指

label: MOVE_METRONOME.description
source: Waggles a finger to use any\nPokémon move at random.
translation: 挥动手指刺激自己的大脑，\n从许多招式中随机使出1个。

label: MOVE_MIRROR_MOVE.name
source: MIRROR MOVE
translation: 鹦鹉学舌

label: MOVE_MIRROR_MOVE.description
source: Counters the foe's attack\nwith the same move.
translation: 模仿对手使用的招式，\n自己也使用相同招式。

label: MOVE_SELF_DESTRUCT.name
source: SELF-DESTRUCT
translation: 玉石俱碎

label: MOVE_SELF_DESTRUCT.description
source: Inflicts severe damage but\nmakes the user faint.
translation: 引发爆炸，攻击周围所有的\n宝可梦。使用后陷入昏厥。

label: MOVE_EGG_BOMB.name
source: EGG BOMB
translation: 炸蛋

label: MOVE_EGG_BOMB.description
source: An egg is forcibly hurled at\nthe foe.
translation: 向对手用力投掷大大的\n蛋攻击。

label: MOVE_LICK.name
source: LICK
translation: 舌舔

label: MOVE_LICK.description
source: Licks with a long tongue to\ninjure. May also paralyze.
translation: 用长舌头舔遍对手攻击。\n有时会让对手陷入麻痹状态。

label: MOVE_SMOG.name
source: SMOG
translation: 浊雾

label: MOVE_SMOG.description
source: An exhaust-gas attack\nthat may also poison.
translation: 将肮脏的浓雾吹向对手攻击。\n有时会让对手陷入中毒状态。

label: MOVE_SLUDGE.name
source: SLUDGE
translation: 污泥攻击

label: MOVE_SLUDGE.description
source: Sludge is hurled to inflict\ndamage. May also poison.
translation: 用污泥投掷对手攻击。\n有时会让对手陷入中毒状态。

label: MOVE_BONE_CLUB.name
source: BONE CLUB
translation: 骨棒

label: MOVE_BONE_CLUB.description
source: Clubs the foe with a bone.\nMay cause flinching.
translation: 用手中的骨头殴打对手攻击。\n有时会使对手畏缩。

label: MOVE_FIRE_BLAST.name
source: FIRE BLAST
translation: 大字爆炎

label: MOVE_FIRE_BLAST.description
source: Incinerates everything it\nstrikes. May cause a burn.
translation: 用大字形状的火焰烧尽对手。\n有时会让对手陷入灼伤状态。

label: MOVE_WATERFALL.name
source: WATERFALL
translation: 攀瀑

label: MOVE_WATERFALL.description
source: Charges with speed to climb\nwaterfalls. May flinch.
translation: 以惊人的气势扑向对手。\n有时会使对手畏缩。

label: MOVE_CLAMP.name
source: CLAMP
translation: 贝壳夹击

label: MOVE_SWIFT.name
source: SWIFT
translation: 高速星星

label: MOVE_SWIFT.description
source: Sprays star-shaped rays\nthat never miss.
translation: 发射星形的光攻击对手。\n攻击必定会命中。

label: MOVE_SKULL_BASH.name
source: SKULL BASH
translation: 火箭头锤

label: MOVE_SKULL_BASH.description
source: Tucks in the head, then\nattacks on the next turn.
translation: 第1回合把头缩进去，提高\n防御。第2回合攻击对手。

label: MOVE_SPIKE_CANNON.name
source: SPIKE CANNON
translation: 尖刺加农炮

label: MOVE_SPIKE_CANNON.description
source: Launches sharp spikes that\nstrike 2 to 5 times.
translation: 向对手发射锐针攻击。\n连续攻击2~5次。

label: MOVE_CONSTRICT.name
source: CONSTRICT
translation: 缠绕

label: MOVE_CONSTRICT.description
source: Constricts to inflict pain.\nMay lower Speed.
translation: 用触手或青藤等缠绕攻击。\n有时会降低对手的速度。

label: MOVE_AMNESIA.name
source: AMNESIA
translation: 瞬间失忆

label: MOVE_AMNESIA.description
source: Forgets about something\nand sharply raises Sp. Def.
translation: 将头脑清空，瞬间忘记某事，\n从而大幅提高自己的特防。

label: MOVE_KINESIS.name
source: KINESIS
translation: 折弯汤匙

label: MOVE_KINESIS.description
source: Distracts the foe.\nMay lower accuracy.
translation: 折弯汤匙引开注意，\n从而降低对手的命中率。

label: MOVE_SOFT_BOILED.name
source: SOFT-BOILED
translation: 生蛋

label: MOVE_SOFT_BOILED.description
source: Recovers up to half the\nuser's maximum HP.
translation: 回复自己最大HP的一半。

label: MOVE_HIGH_JUMP_KICK.name
source: HIGH JUMP KICK
translation: 飞膝踢

label: MOVE_GLARE.name
source: GLARE
translation: 大蛇瞪眼

label: MOVE_DREAM_EATER.name
source: DREAM EATER
translation: 食梦

label: MOVE_DREAM_EATER.description
source: Takes one half the damage\ninflicted on a sleeping foe.
translation: 吃掉正在睡觉的对手的梦。\n回复造成伤害的一半HP。

label: MOVE_POISON_GAS.name
source: POISON GAS
translation: 毒瓦斯

label: MOVE_BARRAGE.name
source: BARRAGE
translation: 投球

label: MOVE_BARRAGE.description
source: Hurls round objects at the\nfoe 2 to 5 times.
translation: 向对手投掷圆形物体攻击。\n连续攻击2~5次。

label: MOVE_LEECH_LIFE.name
source: LEECH LIFE
translation: 吸血

label: MOVE_LEECH_LIFE.description
source: Attack that steals half\nthe damage inflicted.
translation: 吸取血液攻击对手。\n可以回复给予伤害的一半HP。

label: MOVE_LOVELY_KISS.name
source: LOVELY KISS
translation: 恶魔之吻

label: MOVE_LOVELY_KISS.description
source: Demands a kiss with a scary\nface that induces sleep.
translation: 用恐怖的脸强吻对手。\n让对手陷入睡眠状态。

label: MOVE_SKY_ATTACK.name
source: SKY ATTACK
translation: 神鸟猛击

label: MOVE_SKY_ATTACK.description
source: 2-turn attack. High critical\nhit ratio, and may flinch.
translation: 第2回合攻击对手。偶尔使对\n手畏缩。也容易击中要害。

label: MOVE_TRANSFORM.name
source: TRANSFORM
translation: 变身

label: MOVE_TRANSFORM.description
source: Alters the user's cells to\nbecome a copy of the foe.
translation: 变身成对手宝可梦的样子，\n能够使用和对手相同的招式。

label: MOVE_BUBBLE.name
source: BUBBLE
translation: 泡沫

label: MOVE_BUBBLE.description
source: Attack using bubbles.\nMay lower the foe's Speed.
translation: 向对手吹起无数泡泡攻击。\n有时会降低对手的速度。

label: MOVE_DIZZY_PUNCH.name
source: DIZZY PUNCH
translation: 迷昏拳

label: MOVE_SPORE.name
source: SPORE
translation: 蘑菇孢子
