label: MOVE_SPORE.description
source: Scatters a cloud of spores\nthat always induce sleep.
translation: 撒满具有催眠效果的孢子，\n从而让对手陷入睡眠状态。

label: MOVE_FLASH.name
source: FLASH
translation: 闪光

label: MOVE_FLASH.description
source: Looses a powerful blast of\nlight that cuts accuracy.
translation: 使出光芒降低对手的命中率。\n也可在暗窟里照亮四周。

label: MOVE_PSYWAVE.name
source: PSYWAVE
translation: 精神波

label: MOVE_PSYWAVE.description
source: Attacks with a psychic\nwave of varying intensity.
translation: 向对手发射神奇的念波攻击。\n每次使用，伤害都会改变。

label: MOVE_SPLASH.name
source: SPLASH
translation: 跃起

label: MOVE_SPLASH.description
source: It's just a splash...\nHas no effect whatsoever.
translation: 也不攻击只是一蹦一蹦\n地跳，什么都不会发生\n......

label: MOVE_ACID_ARMOR.name
source: ACID ARMOR
translation: 溶化

label: MOVE_ACID_ARMOR.description
source: Liquifies the user's body\nto sharply raise Defense.
translation: 通过细胞的变化进行液化，\n从而大幅提高自己的防御。

label: MOVE_CRABHAMMER.name
source: CRABHAMMER
translation: 蟹钳锤

label: MOVE_CRABHAMMER.description
source: Hammers with a pincer. Has a\nhigh critical-hit ratio.
translation: 用大钳子敲打对手攻击。\n容易击中要害。

label: MOVE_EXPLOSION.name
source: EXPLOSION
translation: 大爆炸

label: MOVE_EXPLOSION.description
source: Inflicts severe damage but\nmakes the user faint.
translation: 引发大爆炸攻击周围所有的\n宝可梦。使用后会陷入昏厥。

label: MOVE_FURY_SWIPES.name
source: FURY SWIPES
translation: 乱抓

label: MOVE_FURY_SWIPES.description
source: Rakes the foe with sharp\nclaws, etc., 2 to 5 times.
translation: 用爪子或镰刀等抓对手攻击。\n连续攻击2~5次。

label: MOVE_BONEMERANG.name
source: BONEMERANG
translation: 骨头回力镖

label: MOVE_BONEMERANG.description
source: Throws a bone boomerang\nthat strikes twice.
translation: 用手中的骨头投掷对手，\n来回连续2次给予伤害。

label: MOVE_REST.name
source: REST
translation: 睡觉

label: MOVE_REST.description
source: The user sleeps for 2 turns,\nrestoring HP and status.
translation: 连续睡上2回合。回复全部\nHP以及治愈所有异常状态。

label: MOVE_ROCK_SLIDE.name
source: ROCK SLIDE
translation: 岩崩

label: MOVE_HYPER_FANG.name
source: HYPER FANG
translation: 终结门牙

label: MOVE_HYPER_FANG.description
source: Attacks with sharp fangs.\nMay cause flinching.
translation: 用锋利门牙牢牢地咬住对手。\n有时会使对手畏缩。

label: MOVE_SHARPEN.name
source: SHARPEN
translation: 棱角化

label: MOVE_SHARPEN.description
source: Reduces the polygon count\nand raises Attack.
translation: 增加身体变得棱棱角角，\n从而提高自己的攻击。

label: MOVE_CONVERSION.name
source: CONVERSION
translation: 纹理

label: MOVE_TRI_ATTACK.name
source: TRI ATTACK
translation: 三重攻击

label: MOVE_SUPER_FANG.name
source: SUPER FANG
translation: 愤怒门牙

label: MOVE_SUPER_FANG.description
source: Attacks with sharp fangs\nand cuts half the foe's HP.
translation: 用锋利门牙猛烈地咬住对手。\n对手的HP减半。

label: MOVE_SLASH.name
source: SLASH
translation: 劈开

label: MOVE_SLASH.description
source: Slashes with claws, etc. Has\na high critical-hit ratio.
translation: 用爪子或镰刀劈开对手攻击。\n容易击中要害。

label: MOVE_SUBSTITUTE.name
source: SUBSTITUTE
translation: 替身

label: MOVE_SUBSTITUTE.description
source: Creates a decoy using 1/4\nof the user's maximum HP.
translation: 削减自己的HP制造分身。\n分身将成为自己的替身。

label: MOVE_STRUGGLE.name
source: STRUGGLE
translation: 挣扎

label: MOVE_SKETCH.name
source: SKETCH
translation: 写生

label: MOVE_SKETCH.description
source: Copies the foe's last move\npermanently.
translation: 将对手招式变成自己的招式。\n使用1次后写生消失。

label: MOVE_TRIPLE_KICK.name
source: TRIPLE KICK
translation: 三连踢

label: MOVE_TRIPLE_KICK.description
source: Kicks the foe 3 times in a\nrow with rising intensity.
translation: 连续3次踢对手攻击。每\n踢中一次，威力就会提高。

label: MOVE_THIEF.name
source: THIEF
translation: 小偷

label: MOVE_THIEF.description
source: While attacking, it may\nsteal the foe's held item.
translation: 攻击时盗取道具。当自己\n携带道具时，不会去盗取。

label: MOVE_SPIDER_WEB.name
source: SPIDER WEB
translation: 蛛网

label: MOVE_SPIDER_WEB.description
source: Ensnares the foe to stop it\nfrom fleeing or switching.
translation: 将黏糊糊细丝层层缠住对手，\n使其不能从战斗中逃走。

label: MOVE_MIND_READER.name
source: MIND READER
translation: 心之眼

label: MOVE_MIND_READER.description
source: Senses the foe's action to\nensure the next move's hit.
translation: 用心感受对手的行动，\n下次攻击必定会击中对手。

label: MOVE_NIGHTMARE.name
source: NIGHTMARE
translation: 恶梦

label: MOVE_NIGHTMARE.description
source: Inflicts 1/4 damage on a\nsleeping foe every turn.
translation: 让在睡眠状态的对手做恶梦，\n每回合会缓缓减少HP。

label: MOVE_FLAME_WHEEL.name
source: FLAME WHEEL
translation: 火焰轮

label: MOVE_FLAME_WHEEL.description
source: A fiery charge attack that\nmay inflict a burn.
translation: 让火焰覆盖全身，猛撞向对手。\n有时会让对手陷入灼伤状态。

label: MOVE_SNORE.name
source: SNORE
translation: 打鼾

label: MOVE_SNORE.description
source: A loud attack that can only\nbe used asleep. May flinch.
translation: 在自己睡觉时，发出噪音\n攻击。有时会使对手畏缩。

label: MOVE_CURSE.name
source: CURSE
translation: 诅咒

label: MOVE_CURSE.description
source: A move that functions\ndifferently for GHOSTS.
translation: 自身属性是幽灵属性\n或其他属性时效果会不同。

label: MOVE_FLAIL.name
source: FLAIL
translation: 抓狂

label: MOVE_FLAIL.description
source: Inflicts more damage when\nthe user's HP is down.
translation: 抓狂般乱打攻击。自己\nHP越少，招式的威力越大。

label: MOVE_CONVERSION_2.name
source: CONVERSION 2
translation: 纹理2

label: MOVE_CONVERSION_2.description
source: Makes the user resistant\nto the last attack's type.
translation: 为抵抗对手最后使用的招式，\n从而使自己的属性发生变化。

label: MOVE_AEROBLAST.name
source: AEROBLAST
translation: 气旋攻击

label: MOVE_AEROBLAST.description
source: Launches a vacuumed blast.\nHigh critical-hit ratio.
translation: 发射空气旋涡攻击。\n容易击中要害。

label: MOVE_COTTON_SPORE.name
source: COTTON SPORE
translation: 棉孢子

label: MOVE_REVERSAL.name
source: REVERSAL
translation: 绝处逢生

label: MOVE_REVERSAL.description
source: Inflicts more damage when\nthe user's HP is down.
translation: 竭尽全力攻击。自己的\nHP越少，招式的威力越大。

label: MOVE_SPITE.name
source: SPITE
translation: 怨恨

label: MOVE_POWDER_SNOW.name
source: POWDER SNOW
translation: 细雪

label: MOVE_PROTECT.name
source: PROTECT
translation: 守住

label: MOVE_MACH_PUNCH.name
source: MACH PUNCH
translation: 音速拳

label: MOVE_MACH_PUNCH.description
source: A punch is thrown at wicked\nspeed to strike first.
translation: 以迅雷不及掩耳之势出拳。\n必定能够先制攻击。

label: MOVE_SCARY_FACE.name
source: SCARY FACE
translation: 可怕面孔

label: MOVE_SCARY_FACE.description
source: Frightens with a scary face\nto sharply reduce Speed.
translation: 用恐怖表情瞪着对手使其\n害怕，大幅降低对手的速度。

label: MOVE_FEINT_ATTACK.name
source: FEINT ATTACK
translation: 出奇一击

label: MOVE_FEINT_ATTACK.description
source: Draws the foe close, then\nstrikes without fail.
translation: 能够攻击使用守住类招式的\n对手。解除其守护效果。

label: MOVE_SWEET_KISS.name
source: SWEET KISS
translation: 天使之吻

label: MOVE_SWEET_KISS.description
source: Demands a kiss with a cute\nlook. May cause confusion.
translation: 像天使般可爱地亲吻对手，\n从而使对手混乱。

label: MOVE_BELLY_DRUM.name
source: BELLY DRUM
translation: 腹鼓

label: MOVE_BELLY_DRUM.description
source: Maximizes Attack while\nsacrificing half of max HP.
translation: 削减自己HP至最大HP一半，\n从而最大限度提高自身攻击。

label: MOVE_SLUDGE_BOMB.name
source: SLUDGE BOMB
translation: 污泥炸弹

label: MOVE_SLUDGE_BOMB.description
source: Sludge is hurled to inflict\ndamage. May also poison.
translation: 用污泥投掷对手攻击。\n有时会让对手陷入中毒状态。

label: MOVE_MUD_SLAP.name
source: MUD-SLAP
translation: 掷泥

label: MOVE_MUD_SLAP.description
source: Hurls mud in the foe's face\nto reduce its accuracy.
translation: 向对手的脸等投掷泥块攻击。\n会降低对手的命中率。

label: MOVE_OCTAZOOKA.name
source: OCTAZOOKA
translation: 章鱼桶炮

label: MOVE_OCTAZOOKA.description
source: Fires a lump of ink to\ndamage and cut accuracy.
translation: 向对手的脸等喷出墨汁攻击。\n有时会降低对手的命中率。

label: MOVE_SPIKES.name
source: SPIKES
translation: 撒菱

label: MOVE_SPIKES.description
source: Sets spikes that hurt a \nfoe switching in.
translation: 在对手的脚下扔撒菱。\n对替换的宝可梦给予伤害。

label: MOVE_ZAP_CANNON.name
source: ZAP CANNON
translation: 电磁炮

label: MOVE_ZAP_CANNON.description
source: Powerful and sure to cause\nparalysis, but inaccurate.
translation: 发射大炮一样的电流攻击。\n让对手陷入麻痹状态。

label: MOVE_FORESIGHT.name
source: FORESIGHT
translation: 识破

label: MOVE_FORESIGHT.description
source: Negates the foe's efforts\nto heighten evasiveness.
translation: 对幽灵宝可梦无效的招式及\n高闪避率对手，变得能够打中。

label: MOVE_DESTINY_BOND.name
source: DESTINY BOND
translation: 同命

label: MOVE_DESTINY_BOND.description
source: If the user faints, the foe\nis also made to faint.
translation: 当陷入昏厥时，对手也会\n一同昏厥。连续使出会失败。

label: MOVE_PERISH_SONG.name
source: PERISH SONG
translation: 终焉之歌

label: MOVE_PERISH_SONG.description
source: Any Pokémon hearing this\nsong faints in 3 turns.
translation: 倾听歌声的宝可梦经过3回合\n陷入昏厥。替换后效果消失。

label: MOVE_ICY_WIND.name
source: ICY WIND
translation: 冰冻之风

label: MOVE_ICY_WIND.description
source: A chilling attack that\nlowers the foe's Speed.
translation: 将结冰的冷气吹向对手攻击。\n会降低对手的速度。

label: MOVE_DETECT.name
source: DETECT
translation: 看穿

label: MOVE_BONE_RUSH.name
source: BONE RUSH
translation: 骨棒乱打

label: MOVE_BONE_RUSH.description
source: Strikes the foe with a bone\nin hand 2 to 5 times.
translation: 用坚硬的骨头殴打对手攻击。\n连续攻击2~5次。

label: MOVE_LOCK_ON.name
source: LOCK-ON
translation: 锁定

label: MOVE_LOCK_ON.description
source: Locks on to the foe to\nensure the next move hits.
translation: 紧紧瞄准对手，\n下次攻击必定会打中。

label: MOVE_OUTRAGE.name
source: OUTRAGE
translation: 逆鳞

label: MOVE_OUTRAGE.description
source: A rampage of 2 to 3 turns\nthat confuses the user.
translation: 在2~3回合内，乱打一气地\n攻击。大闹一番后陷入混乱。

label: MOVE_SANDSTORM.name
source: SANDSTORM
translation: 沙暴

label: MOVE_SANDSTORM.description
source: Causes a sandstorm that\nrages for several turns.
translation: 在5回合内扬起沙暴，除岩石\n地面钢以外宝可梦都会受伤。

label: MOVE_GIGA_DRAIN.name
source: GIGA DRAIN
translation: 终极吸取

label: MOVE_GIGA_DRAIN.description
source: Attack that steals half\nthe damage inflicted.
translation: 吸取对手的养分攻击。\n可以回复给予伤害的一半HP。

label: MOVE_ENDURE.name
source: ENDURE
translation: 挺住

label: MOVE_ENDURE.description
source: Endures any attack for\n1 turn, leaving at least 1HP.
translation: 即使受到攻击也至会留下\n1HP。连续使出则容易失败。

label: MOVE_CHARM.name
source: CHARM
translation: 撒娇

label: MOVE_CHARM.description
source: Charms the foe and sharply\nreduces its Attack.
translation: 可爱地凝视，诱使对手大意，\n从而大幅降低对手的攻击。

label: MOVE_ROLLOUT.name
source: ROLLOUT
translation: 滚动

label: MOVE_ROLLOUT.description
source: Attack lasting 5 turns\nwith rising intensity.
translation: 在5回合内连续滚动攻击。\n招式每次击中，威力会提高。

label: MOVE_FALSE_SWIPE.name
source: FALSE SWIPE
translation: 点到为止

label: MOVE_SWAGGER.name
source: SWAGGER
translation: 虚张声势

label: MOVE_SWAGGER.description
source: Confuses the foe, but also\nsharply raises its Attack.
translation: 激怒对手使其混乱。因愤怒，\n对手的攻击会大幅提高。

label: MOVE_MILK_DRINK.name
source: MILK DRINK
translation: 喝牛奶

label: MOVE_MILK_DRINK.description
source: Recovers up to half the\nuser's maximum HP.
translation: 回复自己最大HP的一半。

label: MOVE_SPARK.name
source: SPARK
translation: 电光

label: MOVE_SPARK.description
source: An electrified tackle that\nmay paralyze the foe.
translation: 让电流覆盖全身猛撞对手。\n有时会让对手陷入麻痹状态。

label: MOVE_FURY_CUTTER.name
source: FURY CUTTER
translation: 连斩

label: MOVE_STEEL_WING.name
source: STEEL WING
translation: 钢翼

label: MOVE_STEEL_WING.description
source: Strikes the foe with hard\nwings spread wide.
translation: 用坚硬的翅膀敲打对手攻击。\n有时会提高自己的防御。

label: MOVE_MEAN_LOOK.name
source: MEAN LOOK
translation: 黑色目光

label: MOVE_MEAN_LOOK.description
source: Fixes the foe with a mean\nlook that prevents escape.
translation: 以黑色目光持续地凝视对手，\n使其不能从战斗中逃走。

label: MOVE_ATTRACT.name
source: ATTRACT
translation: 迷人

label: MOVE_ATTRACT.description
source: Makes the opposite gender\nless likely to attack.
translation: 诱惑异性，让对手着迷。\n对手将很难使出招式。

label: MOVE_SLEEP_TALK.name
source: SLEEP TALK
translation: 梦话

label: MOVE_SLEEP_TALK.description
source: Uses an available move\nrandomly while asleep.
translation: 从招式中任意使出1个。\n只能在自己睡觉时使用。

label: MOVE_HEAL_BELL.name
source: HEAL BELL
translation: 治愈铃声

label: MOVE_HEAL_BELL.description
source: Chimes soothingly to heal\nall status abnormalities.
translation: 让同伴听舒适的铃音，\n治愈我方全员的异常状态。

label: MOVE_RETURN.name
source: RETURN
translation: 报恩

label: MOVE_RETURN.description
source: Attack that increases\nin power with friendship.
translation: 为了训练家而全力攻击对手。\n亲密度越高，威力越大。

label: MOVE_PRESENT.name
source: PRESENT
translation: 礼物

label: MOVE_PRESENT.description
source: A gift in the form of a\nbomb. May restore HP.
translation: 递给对手设圈套的盒子攻击。\n也有可能回复对手HP。

label: MOVE_FRUSTRATION.name
source: FRUSTRATION
translation: 迁怒

label: MOVE_FRUSTRATION.description
source: Attack that is stronger\nif the Trainer is disliked.
translation: 为了发泄不满而全力攻击。\n亲密度越低，威力越大。

label: MOVE_SAFEGUARD.name
source: SAFEGUARD
translation: 神秘守护

label: MOVE_SAFEGUARD.description
source: Protects allies from status\nproblems for 5 turns.
translation: 在5回合内被神奇力量守护，\n从而不会陷入异常状态。

label: MOVE_PAIN_SPLIT.name
source: PAIN SPLIT
translation: 分担痛楚

label: MOVE_PAIN_SPLIT.description
source: Adds the user and foe's HP,\nthen shares them equally.
translation: 将自己的HP和对手的HP相加，\n然后自己和对手友好地平分。

label: MOVE_SACRED_FIRE.name
source: SACRED FIRE
translation: 神圣之火

label: MOVE_SACRED_FIRE.description
source: A mystical fire attack that\nmay inflict a burn.
translation: 用神秘的火焰烧尽对手攻击。\n有时会让对手陷入灼伤状态。

label: MOVE_MAGNITUDE.name
source: MAGNITUDE
translation: 震级

label: MOVE_MAGNITUDE.description
source: A ground-shaking attack\nof random intensity.
translation: 晃动地面，攻击所有宝可梦。\n招式的威力会有变化。

label: MOVE_DYNAMIC_PUNCH.name
source: DYNAMIC PUNCH
translation: 爆裂拳

label: MOVE_DYNAMIC_PUNCH.description
source: Powerful and sure to cause\nconfusion, but inaccurate.
translation: 使出浑身力气出拳攻击。\n必定会使对手混乱。

label: MOVE_MEGAHORN.name
source: MEGAHORN
translation: 超级角击

label: MOVE_MEGAHORN.description
source: A brutal ramming attack\nusing out-thrust horns.
translation: 用坚硬且华丽的角狠狠\n地刺入对手攻击。

label: MOVE_DRAGON_BREATH.name
source: DRAGON BREATH
translation: 龙息

label: MOVE_DRAGON_BREATH.description
source: Strikes the foe with a blast\nof breath. May paralyze.
translation: 将强烈的气息吹向对手攻击。\n有时会让对手陷入麻痹状态。

label: MOVE_BATON_PASS.name
source: BATON PASS
translation: 接棒

label: MOVE_BATON_PASS.description
source: Switches out the user while\nkeeping effects in play.
translation: 和后备宝可梦替换。换上的\n宝可梦能继承能力的变化。

label: MOVE_ENCORE.name
source: ENCORE
translation: 再来一次

label: MOVE_ENCORE.description
source: Makes the foe repeat its\nlast move over 3 turns.
translation: 让对手接受再来一次，\n连续3次使出最后用的招式。

label: MOVE_PURSUIT.name
source: PURSUIT
translation: 追打

label: MOVE_PURSUIT.description
source: Inflicts bad damage if used\non a foe switching out.
translation: 当对手替换宝可梦上场时，\n能够以2倍的威力攻击。

label: MOVE_RAPID_SPIN.name
source: RAPID SPIN
translation: 高速旋转

label: MOVE_SWEET_SCENT.name
source: SWEET SCENT
translation: 甜甜香气

label: MOVE_IRON_TAIL.name
source: IRON TAIL
translation: 铁尾

label: MOVE_IRON_TAIL.description
source: Attacks with a rock-hard\ntail. May lower Defense.
translation: 使用坚硬的尾巴摔打对手攻击。\n有时会降低对手的防御。

label: MOVE_METAL_CLAW.name
source: METAL CLAW
translation: 金属爪

label: MOVE_METAL_CLAW.description
source: A claw attack that may\nraise the user's Attack.
translation: 用钢铁之爪劈开对手攻击。\n有时会提高自己的攻击。

label: MOVE_VITAL_THROW.name
source: VITAL THROW
translation: 借力摔

label: MOVE_VITAL_THROW.description
source: Makes the user's move last,\nbut it never misses.
translation: 会在对手之后攻击。\n但是自己的攻击必定会命中。

label: MOVE_MORNING_SUN.name
source: MORNING SUN
translation: 晨光

label: MOVE_MORNING_SUN.description
source: Restores HP. The amount\nvaries with the weather.
translation: 回复自己的HP。根据天气不\n同，回复量也会有所变化。

label: MOVE_SYNTHESIS.name
source: SYNTHESIS
translation: 光合作用

label: MOVE_SYNTHESIS.description
source: Restores HP. The amount\nvaries with the weather.
translation: 回复自己的HP。根据天气不\n同，回复量也会有所变化。

label: MOVE_MOONLIGHT.name
source: MOONLIGHT
translation: 月光

label: MOVE_MOONLIGHT.description
source: Restores HP. The amount\nvaries with the weather.
translation: 回复自己的HP。根据天气不\n同，回复量也会有所变化。

label: MOVE_HIDDEN_POWER.name
source: HIDDEN POWER
translation: 觉醒力量

label: MOVE_CROSS_CHOP.name
source: CROSS CHOP
translation: 十字劈

label: MOVE_CROSS_CHOP.description
source: A double-chopping attack.\nHigh critical-hit ratio.
translation: 用两手呈十字劈打对手攻击。\n容易击中要害。

label: MOVE_TWISTER.name
source: TWISTER
translation: 龙卷风

label: MOVE_TWISTER.description
source: Whips up a vicious twister\nto tear at foes. May flinch.
translation: 兴起龙卷风，将对手卷入\n攻击。有时会使对手畏缩。

label: MOVE_RAIN_DANCE.name
source: RAIN DANCE
translation: 求雨

label: MOVE_RAIN_DANCE.description
source: Boosts the power of Water-\ntype moves for 5 turns.
translation: 在5回合内一直降雨，提高水\n招式威力。降低火招式威力。

label: MOVE_SUNNY_DAY.name
source: SUNNY DAY
translation: 大晴天

label: MOVE_SUNNY_DAY.description
source: Boosts the power of Fire-\ntype moves for 5 turns.
translation: 在5回合内日照强烈，提高火\n招式威力。降低水招式威力。

label: MOVE_CRUNCH.name
source: CRUNCH
translation: 咬碎

label: MOVE_MIRROR_COAT.name
source: MIRROR COAT
translation: 镜面反射

label: MOVE_MIRROR_COAT.description
source: Counters the foe's special\nattack at double the power.
translation: 从对手那里受到特殊攻击的\n伤害将以2倍返还对手。

label: MOVE_PSYCH_UP.name
source: PSYCH UP
translation: 自我暗示

label: MOVE_PSYCH_UP.description
source: Copies foe's stat changes\nand gives to the user.
translation: 向自己施以自我暗示，\n将能力变化变得和对手一样。

label: MOVE_EXTREME_SPEED.name
source: EXTREME SPEED
translation: 神速

label: MOVE_EXTREME_SPEED.description
source: An extremely fast and\npowerful attack.
translation: 以迅雷不及掩耳之势猛撞向\n对手。必定能够先制攻击。

label: MOVE_ANCIENT_POWER.name
source: ANCIENT POWER
translation: 原始之力

label: MOVE_ANCIENT_POWER.description
source: Attack that may raise\nall stats.
translation: 用原始之力攻击。\n有时会提高自己所有的能力。

label: MOVE_SHADOW_BALL.name
source: SHADOW BALL
translation: 暗影球

label: MOVE_SHADOW_BALL.description
source: Hurls a black blob that may\nlower the foe's Sp. Def.
translation: 投掷一团黑影攻击。\n有时会降低对手的特防。

label: MOVE_FUTURE_SIGHT.name
source: FUTURE SIGHT
translation: 预知未来

label: MOVE_ROCK_SMASH.name
source: ROCK SMASH
translation: 碎岩

label: MOVE_ROCK_SMASH.description
source: A rock-crushing attack\nthat may lower Defense.
translation: 用拳头攻击。\n有时会降低对手的防御。

label: MOVE_WHIRLPOOL.name
source: WHIRLPOOL
translation: 潮旋

label: MOVE_BEAT_UP.name
source: BEAT UP
translation: 围攻

label: MOVE_BEAT_UP.description
source: Summons party Pokémon to\njoin in the attack.
translation: 我方全员攻击。同行宝可梦\n越多，攻击次数越多。

label: MOVE_FAKE_OUT.name
source: FAKE OUT
translation: 击掌奇袭

label: MOVE_FAKE_OUT.description
source: Moves 1st and flinches. Only\nworks on user's 1st turn.
translation: 进行先制攻击，使对手畏缩。\n仅出场后立刻使出才能成功。

label: MOVE_UPROAR.name
source: UPROAR
translation: 吵闹

label: MOVE_STOCKPILE.name
source: STOCKPILE
translation: 蓄力

label: MOVE_STOCKPILE.description
source: Charges up power for up to\n3 turns.
translation: 积蓄力量，提高自己的防御\n和特防。最多积蓄3次。

label: MOVE_SPIT_UP.name
source: SPIT UP
translation: 喷出

label: MOVE_SPIT_UP.description
source: Releases stockpiled power\n(the more the better).
translation: 将积蓄的力量撞向对手攻击。\n积蓄得越多，威力越大。

label: MOVE_SWALLOW.name
source: SWALLOW
translation: 吞下

label: MOVE_SWALLOW.description
source: Absorbs stockpiled power\nand restores HP.
translation: 将积蓄的力量吞下从而回复\nHP。积蓄得越多，回复越多。

label: MOVE_HEAT_WAVE.name
source: HEAT WAVE
translation: 热风

label: MOVE_HEAT_WAVE.description
source: Exhales a hot breath on the\nfoes. May inflict a burn.
translation: 将炎热的气息吹向对手攻击。\n有时会让对手陷入灼伤状态。

label: MOVE_HAIL.name
source: HAIL
translation: 冰雹

label: MOVE_TORMENT.name
source: TORMENT
translation: 无理取闹

label: MOVE_TORMENT.description
source: Torments the foe and stops\nsuccessive use of a move.
translation: 向对手无理取闹，\n令其不能连续2次使出相同招式。

label: MOVE_FLATTER.name
source: FLATTER
translation: 吹捧

label: MOVE_FLATTER.description
source: Confuses the foe, but\nraises its Sp. Atk.
translation: 吹捧对手，使其混乱。同时\n还会提高对手的特攻。

label: MOVE_WILL_O_WISP.name
source: WILL-O-WISP
translation: 磷火

label: MOVE_WILL_O_WISP.description
source: Inflicts a burn on the foe\nwith intense fire.
translation: 放出怪异的火焰，\n从而让对手陷入灼伤状态。

label: MOVE_MEMENTO.name
source: MEMENTO
translation: 临别礼物

label: MOVE_MEMENTO.description
source: The user faints and harshly\nlowers foes Atk and Sp.Atk.
translation: 使自己陷入昏厥，但能\n大幅降低对手攻击和特攻。

label: MOVE_FACADE.name
source: FACADE
translation: 硬撑

label: MOVE_FACADE.description
source: Boosts power when burned,\nparalyzed, or poisoned.
translation: 当处于中毒、麻痹、灼伤时，\n招式威力会变成2倍。

label: MOVE_FOCUS_PUNCH.name
source: FOCUS PUNCH
translation: 真气拳

label: MOVE_FOCUS_PUNCH.description
source: Powerful attack, moves last.\nThe user flinches if hit.
translation: 集中精神出拳。在招式使出前\n若受到攻击则会失败。

label: MOVE_SMELLING_SALTS.name
source: SMELLING SALTS
translation: 清醒

label: MOVE_SMELLING_SALTS.description
source: Powerful against paralyzed\nfoes, but also heals them.
translation: 对于麻痹的对手，威力变成2倍。\n但对手的麻痹也会被治愈。

label: MOVE_FOLLOW_ME.name
source: FOLLOW ME
translation: 看我嘛

label: MOVE_FOLLOW_ME.description
source: Draws attention to make\nfoes attack only the user.
translation: 引起对手的注意，\n将对手攻击转移到自身上。

label: MOVE_NATURE_POWER.name
source: NATURE POWER
translation: 自然之力

label: MOVE_NATURE_POWER.description
source: The type of attack varies\ndepending on the location.
translation: 用自然之力攻击。根据\n场所不同，招式也会有所变化。

label: MOVE_CHARGE.name
source: CHARGE
translation: 充电

label: MOVE_CHARGE.description
source: Charges power to boost the\nElectric move used next.
translation: 变为充电状态，提高下次的\n电招式威力并提高自身特防。

label: MOVE_TAUNT.name
source: TAUNT
translation: 挑衅

label: MOVE_TAUNT.description
source: Taunts the foe into only\nusing attack moves.
translation: 使对手愤怒。在3回合内让\n对手只能用给予伤害的招式。

label: MOVE_HELPING_HAND.name
source: HELPING HAND
translation: 帮助

label: MOVE_HELPING_HAND.description
source: Boosts the power of ally\nrecipient's moves.
translation: 帮助伙伴。被帮助的宝可梦，\n其招式威力变得比平时大。

label: MOVE_TRICK.name
source: TRICK
translation: 戏法

label: MOVE_TRICK.description
source: Tricks the foe into trading\nheld items.
translation: 抓住对手的空隙，\n交换自己和对手的持有物。

label: MOVE_ROLE_PLAY.name
source: ROLE PLAY
translation: 扮演

label: MOVE_ROLE_PLAY.description
source: Mimics the target and\ncopies its Ability.
translation: 扮演对手，让自己的特性\n变得和对手相同。

label: MOVE_WISH.name
source: WISH
translation: 祈愿

label: MOVE_WISH.description
source: A wish that restores HP.\nIt takes time to work.
translation: 下回合回复自己或换上\n的宝可梦最大HP的一半。

label: MOVE_ASSIST.name
source: ASSIST
translation: 借助

label: MOVE_ASSIST.description
source: Attacks randomly with one\nof the partner's moves.
translation: 向同伴紧急求助，从我方\n宝可梦招式中随机使用1个。

label: MOVE_INGRAIN.name
source: INGRAIN
translation: 扎根

label: MOVE_INGRAIN.description
source: Lays roots that restore HP.\nThe user can't switch out.
translation: 在地上扎根，每回合回复\nHP。但不能替换宝可梦。

label: MOVE_SUPERPOWER.name
source: SUPERPOWER
translation: 蛮力

label: MOVE_SUPERPOWER.description
source: Boosts strength sharply,\nbut lowers abilities.
translation: 发挥惊人的力量攻击对手。\n自己的攻击和防御会降低。

label: MOVE_MAGIC_COAT.name
source: MAGIC COAT
translation: 魔法反射

label: MOVE_MAGIC_COAT.description
source: Reflects special effects\nback to the attacker.
translation: 当对手使出会变化类招式时，\n会将对手的招式反射回去。

label: MOVE_RECYCLE.name
source: RECYCLE
translation: 回收利用

label: MOVE_RECYCLE.description
source: Recycles a used item for\none more use.
translation: 使战斗中已经消耗的持有\n物再生，并可以再次使用。

label: MOVE_REVENGE.name
source: REVENGE
translation: 报复

label: MOVE_BRICK_BREAK.name
source: BRICK BREAK
translation: 劈瓦

label: MOVE_BRICK_BREAK.description
source: Destroys barriers such as\nREFLECT and causes damage.
translation: 将手刀猛烈地挥下攻击对手。\n还可以破坏光墙和反射壁等。

label: MOVE_YAWN.name
source: YAWN
translation: 哈欠

label: MOVE_YAWN.description
source: Lulls the foe into yawning,\nthen sleeping next turn.
translation: 打个大哈欠引起睡意。\n在下回合让对手睡眠。

label: MOVE_KNOCK_OFF.name
source: KNOCK OFF
translation: 拍落

label: MOVE_KNOCK_OFF.description
source: Knocks down the foe's held\nitem to prevent its use.
translation: 拍落持有物，使其不能使用。\n对手携带道具时会增加伤害。

label: MOVE_ENDEAVOR.name
source: ENDEAVOR
translation: 蛮干

label: MOVE_ENDEAVOR.description
source: Cuts foe's HP to equal\nuser's HP.
translation: 给予伤害，使对手的HP\n变得和自己的HP一样。

label: MOVE_ERUPTION.name
source: ERUPTION
translation: 喷火

label: MOVE_ERUPTION.description
source: The higher the user's HP,\nthe more damage caused.
translation: 爆发怒火攻击对手。自己HP\n越少，招式的威力越小。

label: MOVE_SKILL_SWAP.name
source: SKILL SWAP
translation: 特性互换

label: MOVE_SKILL_SWAP.description
source: The user swaps special\nabilities with the target.
translation: 利用超能力互换自己和\n对手的特性。

label: MOVE_IMPRISON.name
source: IMPRISON
translation: 封印

label: MOVE_IMPRISON.description
source: Prevents foes from using\nmoves known by the user.
translation: 如果对手有和自己相同招式，\n那么对手将无法使用该招式。

label: MOVE_REFRESH.name
source: REFRESH
translation: 焕然一新

label: MOVE_REFRESH.description
source: Heals poisoning, paralysis,\nor a burn.
translation: 让身体休息，\n治愈自己的异常状态。

label: MOVE_GRUDGE.name
source: GRUDGE
translation: 怨念

label: MOVE_GRUDGE.description
source: If the user faints, deletes\nall PP of foe's last move.
translation: 陷入昏厥时给对手施加怨念，\n让该招式的PP变成0。

label: MOVE_SNATCH.name
source: SNATCH
translation: 抢夺

label: MOVE_SNATCH.description
source: Steals the effects of the\nmove the target uses next.
translation: 将对手要使用的回复招式或\n能力变化招式夺为己用。

label: MOVE_SECRET_POWER.name
source: SECRET POWER
translation: 秘密之力

label: MOVE_SECRET_POWER.description
source: Attack with effects\nthat vary by location.
translation: 根据使用场所不同，\n招式的追加效果也会改变。

label: MOVE_DIVE.name
source: DIVE
translation: 潜水

label: MOVE_DIVE.description
source: Dives underwater the first\nturn and strikes next turn.
translation: 第1回合潜入水中，\n第2回合浮上来攻击。

label: MOVE_ARM_THRUST.name
source: ARM THRUST
translation: 猛推

label: MOVE_ARM_THRUST.description
source: Straight-arm punches that\nstrike the foe 2 to 5 times.
translation: 张开双手猛推对手攻击。\n连续攻击2~5次。

label: MOVE_CAMOUFLAGE.name
source: CAMOUFLAGE
translation: 保护色

label: MOVE_CAMOUFLAGE.description
source: Alters the Pokémon's type\ndepending on the location.
translation: 根据所在场所不同，\n可以改变自己的属性。

label: MOVE_TAIL_GLOW.name
source: TAIL GLOW
translation: 萤火

label: MOVE_LUSTER_PURGE.name
source: LUSTER PURGE
translation: 洁净光芒

label: MOVE_LUSTER_PURGE.description
source: Attacks with a burst of\nlight. May lower Sp. Def.
translation: 释放耀眼的光芒攻击。\n有时会降低对手的特防。

label: MOVE_MIST_BALL.name
source: MIST BALL
translation: 薄雾球

label: MOVE_MIST_BALL.description
source: Attacks with a flurry of\ndown. May lower Sp. Atk.
translation: 用围绕着雾状羽毛的球攻击。\n有时会降低对手的特攻。

label: MOVE_FEATHER_DANCE.name
source: FEATHER DANCE
translation: 羽毛舞

label: MOVE_FEATHER_DANCE.description
source: Envelops the foe with down\nto sharply reduce Attack.
translation: 撒出羽毛笼罩在对手周围。\n大幅降低对手的攻击。

label: MOVE_TEETER_DANCE.name
source: TEETER DANCE
translation: 摇晃舞

label: MOVE_TEETER_DANCE.description
source: Confuses all Pokémon on\nthe scene.
translation: 摇摇晃晃地跳起舞蹈，\n让周围的宝可梦陷入混乱。

label: MOVE_BLAZE_KICK.name
source: BLAZE KICK
translation: 火焰踢

label: MOVE_BLAZE_KICK.description
source: A kick with a high critical-\nhit ratio. May cause a burn.
translation: 攻击对手后，有时会使其\n灼伤。也容易击中要害。

label: MOVE_MUD_SPORT.name
source: MUD SPORT
translation: 玩泥巴

label: MOVE_MUD_SPORT.description
source: Covers the user in mud to\nweaken all Electric moves.
translation: 弄得周围到处是泥。\n在5回合内减弱电属性的招式。

label: MOVE_ICE_BALL.name
source: ICE BALL
translation: 冰球

label: MOVE_ICE_BALL.description
source: A 5-turn attack that gains\npower on successive hits.
translation: 在5回合内攻击对手。招式每\n次击中，威力就会提高。

label: MOVE_NEEDLE_ARM.name
source: NEEDLE ARM
translation: 尖刺臂

label: MOVE_NEEDLE_ARM.description
source: Attacks with thorny arms.\nMay cause flinching.
translation: 用带刺的手臂猛烈挥舞攻击。\n有时会使对手畏缩。

label: MOVE_SLACK_OFF.name
source: SLACK OFF
translation: 偷懒

label: MOVE_SLACK_OFF.description
source: Slacks off and restores\nhalf the maximum HP.
translation: 偷懒休息。\n回复自己最大HP的一半。

label: MOVE_HYPER_VOICE.name
source: HYPER VOICE
translation: 巨声

label: MOVE_HYPER_VOICE.description
source: A loud attack that uses\nsound waves to injure.
translation: 给予对手又吵又响的巨大\n震动攻击。

label: MOVE_POISON_FANG.name
source: POISON FANG
translation: 剧毒牙

label: MOVE_POISON_FANG.description
source: A sharp-fanged attack.\nMay badly poison the foe.
translation: 用有毒的牙齿咬住对手攻击。\n有时会使对手中剧毒。

label: MOVE_CRUSH_CLAW.name
source: CRUSH CLAW
translation: 撕裂爪

label: MOVE_CRUSH_CLAW.description
source: Tears at the foe with sharp\nclaws. May lower Defense.
translation: 用坚硬的锐爪劈开对手攻击。\n有时会降低对手的防御。

label: MOVE_BLAST_BURN.name
source: BLAST BURN
translation: 爆炸烈焰

label: MOVE_BLAST_BURN.description
source: Powerful, but leaves the\nuser immobile the next turn.
translation: 用爆炸的火焰烧尽对手攻击。\n下一回合自己将无法动弹。

label: MOVE_HYDRO_CANNON.name
source: HYDRO CANNON
translation: 加农水炮

label: MOVE_HYDRO_CANNON.description
source: Powerful, but leaves the\nuser immobile the next turn.
translation: 向对手喷射水炮攻击。\n下一回合自己将无法动弹。

label: MOVE_METEOR_MASH.name
source: METEOR MASH
translation: 彗星拳

label: MOVE_METEOR_MASH.description
source: Fires a meteor-like punch.\nMay raise Attack.
translation: 使出彗星般的拳头攻击对手。\n有时会提高自己的攻击。

label: MOVE_ASTONISH.name
source: ASTONISH
translation: 惊吓

label: MOVE_ASTONISH.description
source: Attack that may shock\nthe foe into flinching.
translation: 用尖叫声突然惊吓对手攻击。\n有时会使对手畏缩。

label: MOVE_WEATHER_BALL.name
source: WEATHER BALL
translation: 气象球

label: MOVE_WEATHER_BALL.description
source: The move's type and power\nchange with the weather.
translation: 根据使用时的天气，\n招式属性和威力会改变。

label: MOVE_AROMATHERAPY.name
source: AROMATHERAPY
translation: 芳香治疗

label: MOVE_AROMATHERAPY.description
source: Heals all status problems\nwith a soothing scent.
translation: 让同伴闻沁人心脾的香气，\n治愈我方全员的异常状态。

label: MOVE_FAKE_TEARS.name
source: FAKE TEARS
translation: 假哭

label: MOVE_FAKE_TEARS.description
source: Feigns crying to sharply\nlower the foe's Sp. Def.
translation: 装哭流泪。使对手不知所措，\n从而大幅降低对手的特防。

label: MOVE_AIR_CUTTER.name
source: AIR CUTTER
translation: 空气利刃

label: MOVE_AIR_CUTTER.description
source: Hacks with razorlike wind.\nHigh critical-hit ratio.
translation: 用锐利的风切斩对手攻击。\n容易击中要害。

label: MOVE_OVERHEAT.name
source: OVERHEAT
translation: 过热

label: MOVE_OVERHEAT.description
source: Allows a full-power attack,\nbut sharply lowers Sp. Atk.
translation: 使出全部力量攻击对手。\n之后自己的特攻大幅降低。

label: MOVE_ODOR_SLEUTH.name
source: ODOR SLEUTH
translation: 气味侦测

label: MOVE_ODOR_SLEUTH.description
source: Negate evasiveness and\nGhost type's immunities.
translation: 对幽灵宝可梦以及闪避率高\n对手，变得能够打中。

label: MOVE_ROCK_TOMB.name
source: ROCK TOMB
translation: 岩石封锁

label: MOVE_ROCK_TOMB.description
source: Stops the foe from moving\nwith rocks and cuts Speed.
translation: 投掷岩石攻击。封住对手\n的行动，从而降低速度。

label: MOVE_SILVER_WIND.name
source: SILVER WIND
translation: 银色旋风

label: MOVE_SILVER_WIND.description
source: A powdery attack that may\nraise abilities.
translation: 在风中掺入鳞粉攻击对手。\n有时会提高自己的全部能力。

label: MOVE_METAL_SOUND.name
source: METAL SOUND
translation: 金属音

label: MOVE_METAL_SOUND.description
source: Emits a horrible screech\nthat sharply lowers Sp. Def.
translation: 发出摩擦金属般讨厌的声音。\n大幅降低对手的特防。

label: MOVE_GRASS_WHISTLE.name
source: GRASS WHISTLE
translation: 草笛

label: MOVE_GRASS_WHISTLE.description
source: Lulls the foe into sleep\nwith a pleasant melody.
translation: 让对手听舒适的笛声，\n从而陷入睡眠状态。

label: MOVE_TICKLE.name
source: TICKLE
translation: 挠痒

label: MOVE_TICKLE.description
source: Makes the foe laugh to\nlower Attack and Defense.
translation: 给对手挠痒，使其发笑，\n降低对手的攻击和防御。

label: MOVE_COSMIC_POWER.name
source: COSMIC POWER
translation: 宇宙力量

label: MOVE_COSMIC_POWER.description
source: Raises Defense and Sp. Def\nwith a mystic power.
translation: 汲取宇宙中神秘的力量，\n从而提高自己的防御和特防。

label: MOVE_WATER_SPOUT.name
source: WATER SPOUT
translation: 喷水

label: MOVE_WATER_SPOUT.description
source: Inflicts more damage if the\nuser's HP is high.
translation: 掀起潮水攻击。自己HP\n越少，招式的威力越小。

label: MOVE_SIGNAL_BEAM.name
source: SIGNAL BEAM
translation: 信号光束

label: MOVE_SIGNAL_BEAM.description
source: A strange beam attack that\nmay confuse the foe.
translation: 发射神奇的光线攻击。\n有时会使对手混乱。

label: MOVE_SHADOW_PUNCH.name
source: SHADOW PUNCH
translation: 暗影拳

label: MOVE_SHADOW_PUNCH.description
source: An unavoidable punch that\nis thrown from shadows.
translation: 使出混影之拳。\n攻击必定会命中。

label: MOVE_EXTRASENSORY.name
source: EXTRASENSORY
translation: 神通力

label: MOVE_EXTRASENSORY.description
source: Attacks with a peculiar\npower. May cause flinching.
translation: 发出看不见的神奇力量攻击。\n有时会使对手畏缩。

label: MOVE_SKY_UPPERCUT.name
source: SKY UPPERCUT
translation: 冲天拳

label: MOVE_SKY_UPPERCUT.description
source: An uppercut thrown as if\nleaping into the sky.
translation: 用冲向天空般高高的上\n勾拳顶起对手攻击。

label: MOVE_SAND_TOMB.name
source: SAND TOMB
translation: 流沙深渊

label: MOVE_SHEER_COLD.name
source: SHEER COLD
translation: 绝对零度

label: MOVE_SHEER_COLD.description
source: A chilling attack that\ncauses fainting if it hits.
translation: 给对手一击昏厥。若冰属性\n以外宝可梦使用会难以打中。

label: MOVE_MUDDY_WATER.name
source: MUDDY WATER
translation: 浊流

label: MOVE_MUDDY_WATER.description
source: Attacks with muddy water.\nMay lower accuracy.
translation: 向对手喷射浑浊的水攻击。\n有时会降低对手的命中率。

label: MOVE_BULLET_SEED.name
source: BULLET SEED
translation: 种子机关枪

label: MOVE_BULLET_SEED.description
source: Shoots 2 to 5 seeds in a row\nto strike the foe.
translation: 向对手猛烈地发射种子攻击。\n连续攻击2~5次。

label: MOVE_AERIAL_ACE.name
source: AERIAL ACE
translation: 燕返

label: MOVE_AERIAL_ACE.description
source: An extremely speedy and\nunavoidable attack.
translation: 以敏捷动作戏弄对手后切斩。\n攻击必定会命中。

label: MOVE_ICICLE_SPEAR.name
source: ICICLE SPEAR
translation: 冰锥

label: MOVE_ICICLE_SPEAR.description
source: Attacks the foe by firing\n2 to 5 icicles in a row.
translation: 向对手发射锋利的冰柱攻击。\n连续攻击2~5次。

label: MOVE_IRON_DEFENSE.name
source: IRON DEFENSE
translation: 铁壁

label: MOVE_IRON_DEFENSE.description
source: Hardens the body's surface\nto sharply raise Defense.
translation: 将皮肤变得坚硬如铁，\n从而大幅提高自己的防御。

label: MOVE_BLOCK.name
source: BLOCK
translation: 挡路

label: MOVE_BLOCK.description
source: Blocks the foe's way and\nprevents escape.
translation: 张开双手阻挡，封住对手\n的退路，使其不能逃走。

label: MOVE_HOWL.name
source: HOWL
translation: 长嚎

label: MOVE_HOWL.description
source: Howls to raise the spirit\nand boosts Attack.
translation: 大声吼叫提高气势，\n从而提高自己和同伴的攻击。

label: MOVE_DRAGON_CLAW.name
source: DRAGON CLAW
translation: 龙爪

label: MOVE_DRAGON_CLAW.description
source: Slashes the foe with sharp\nclaws.
translation: 用尖锐的巨爪劈开对手\n攻击。

label: MOVE_FRENZY_PLANT.name
source: FRENZY PLANT
translation: 疯狂植物

label: MOVE_FRENZY_PLANT.description
source: Powerful, but leaves the\nuser immobile the next turn.
translation: 用大树摔打对手攻击。\n下一回合自己将无法动弹。

label: MOVE_BULK_UP.name
source: BULK UP
translation: 健美

label: MOVE_BULK_UP.description
source: Bulks up the body to boost\nboth Attack and Defense.
translation: 使出全身力气绷紧肌肉，\n从而提高自己的攻击和防御。

label: MOVE_BOUNCE.name
source: BOUNCE
translation: 弹跳

label: MOVE_BOUNCE.description
source: Bounces up, then down the\nnext turn. May paralyze.
translation: 弹跳到高高的空中，第2回合\n攻击，有时会让对手陷入麻痹。

label: MOVE_MUD_SHOT.name
source: MUD SHOT
translation: 泥巴射击

label: MOVE_MUD_SHOT.description
source: Hurls mud at the foe and\nreduces Speed.
translation: 向对手投掷泥块攻击。\n同时降低对手的速度。

label: MOVE_POISON_TAIL.name
source: POISON TAIL
translation: 毒尾

label: MOVE_POISON_TAIL.description
source: Has a high critical-hit\nratio. May also poison.
translation: 用尾巴拍打。有时会让对手\n中毒，也容易击中要害。

label: MOVE_COVET.name
source: COVET
translation: 渴望

label: MOVE_COVET.description
source: Cutely begs to obtain an\nitem held by the foe.
translation: 边撒娇边靠近对手攻击，\n还能夺取对手携带的道具。

label: MOVE_MAGICAL_LEAF.name
source: MAGICAL LEAF
translation: 魔法叶

label: MOVE_MAGICAL_LEAF.description
source: Attacks with a strange leaf\nthat cannot be evaded.
translation: 散落能追踪对手的神奇叶片。\n攻击必定会命中。

label: MOVE_WATER_SPORT.name
source: WATER SPORT
translation: 玩水

label: MOVE_WATER_SPORT.description
source: The user becomes soaked to\nweaken all Fire moves.
translation: 用水湿透周围。\n在5回合内减弱火属性招式。

label: MOVE_CALM_MIND.name
source: CALM MIND
translation: 冥想

label: MOVE_CALM_MIND.description
source: Raises Sp. Atk and Sp. Def\nby focusing the mind.
translation: 静心凝神，\n从而提高自己的特攻和特防。

label: MOVE_LEAF_BLADE.name
source: LEAF BLADE
translation: 叶刃

label: MOVE_LEAF_BLADE.description
source: Slashes with a sharp leaf.\nHigh critical-hit ratio.
translation: 像用剑般操纵叶片切斩对手。\n容易击中要害。

label: MOVE_DRAGON_DANCE.name
source: DRAGON DANCE
translation: 龙之舞

label: MOVE_DRAGON_DANCE.description
source: A mystical dance that ups\nAttack and Speed.
translation: 激烈地跳起神秘有力的舞蹈。\n从而提高自己的攻击和速度。

label: MOVE_ROCK_BLAST.name
source: ROCK BLAST
translation: 岩石爆击

label: MOVE_ROCK_BLAST.description
source: Hurls boulders at the foe\n2 to 5 times in a row.
translation: 向对手发射坚硬的岩石攻击。\n连续攻击2~5次。

label: MOVE_SHOCK_WAVE.name
source: SHOCK WAVE
translation: 电击波

label: MOVE_SHOCK_WAVE.description
source: A fast and unavoidable\nelectric attack.
translation: 向对手快速发出电击。\n攻击必定会命中。

label: MOVE_WATER_PULSE.name
source: WATER PULSE
translation: 水之波动

label: MOVE_WATER_PULSE.description
source: Attacks with ultrasonic\nwaves. May confuse the foe.
translation: 用水的震动攻击对手。\n有时会使对手混乱。

label: MOVE_DOOM_DESIRE.name
source: DOOM DESIRE
translation: 破灭之愿

label: MOVE_DOOM_DESIRE.description
source: Summons strong light to\nattack 2 turns later.
translation: 使用招式2回合后，\n会用无数道光束攻击对手。

label: MOVE_PSYCHO_BOOST.name
source: PSYCHO BOOST
translation: 精神突进

label: MOVE_PSYCHO_BOOST.description
source: Allows a full-power attack,\nbut sharply lowers Sp. Atk.
translation: 使出全部力量攻击对手。\n之后自己的特攻大幅降低。

label: MOVE_ROOST.name
source: ROOST
translation: 羽栖

label: MOVE_ROOST.description
source: Restores the user's HP by\nhalf of its max HP.
translation: 降到地面，使身体休息。回\n复自己最大HP的一半。

label: MOVE_GRAVITY.name
source: GRAVITY
translation: 重力

label: MOVE_GRAVITY.description
source: Gravity is intensified\nnegating levitation.
translation: 在5回合内飘浮和飞行宝可梦\n会被地招式击中，无法飞空。

label: MOVE_MIRACLE_EYE.name
source: MIRACLE EYE
translation: 奇迹之眼

label: MOVE_MIRACLE_EYE.description
source: Negate evasiveness and\nDark type's immunities.
translation: 使出后对恶宝可梦以及闪避率\n高的对手，变得能够打中。

label: MOVE_WAKE_UP_SLAP.name
source: WAKE-UP SLAP
translation: 唤醒巴掌

label: MOVE_WAKE_UP_SLAP.description
source: Powerful against sleeping\nfoes, but also wakes them.
translation: 给予睡眠对手较大的伤害。\n但对手会从睡眠中醒过来。

label: MOVE_HAMMER_ARM.name
source: HAMMER ARM
translation: 臂锤

label: MOVE_HAMMER_ARM.description
source: A swinging fist attack\nthat also lowers Speed.
translation: 挥舞强力而沉重的拳头，给予\n对手伤害。自身速度会降低。

label: MOVE_GYRO_BALL.name
source: GYRO BALL
translation: 陀螺球

label: MOVE_GYRO_BALL.description
source: A high-speed spin that does\nmore damage to faster foes.
translation: 让身体高速旋转并撞击对手。\n速度比对手越慢，威力越大。

label: MOVE_HEALING_WISH.name
source: HEALING WISH
translation: 治愈之愿

label: MOVE_BRINE.name
source: BRINE
translation: 盐水

label: MOVE_BRINE.description
source: Does double damage to foes\nwith half HP or less.
translation: 当对手的HP一半以下时，\n招式威力会变成2倍。

label: MOVE_NATURAL_GIFT.name
source: NATURAL GIFT
translation: 自然之恩

label: MOVE_NATURAL_GIFT.description
source: The effectiveness varies\nwith the held Berry.
translation: 从树果上获得力量攻击。根据\n携带树果改变招式属性威力。

label: MOVE_FEINT.name
source: FEINT
translation: 佯攻

label: MOVE_PLUCK.name
source: PLUCK
translation: 啄食

label: MOVE_TAILWIND.name
source: TAILWIND
translation: 顺风

label: MOVE_ACUPRESSURE.name
source: ACUPRESSURE
translation: 点穴

label: MOVE_ACUPRESSURE.description
source: The user sharply raises\none of its stats.
translation: 通过点穴让身体舒筋活络。\n大幅提高某1项能力。

label: MOVE_METAL_BURST.name
source: METAL BURST
translation: 金属爆炸

label: MOVE_METAL_BURST.description
source: Retaliates any hit with\ngreater power.
translation: 使出招式前，将最后受到的\n招式的伤害大力返还给对手。

label: MOVE_U_TURN.name
source: U-TURN
translation: 急速折返

label: MOVE_CLOSE_COMBAT.name
source: CLOSE COMBAT
translation: 近身战

label: MOVE_PAYBACK.name
source: PAYBACK
translation: 以牙还牙

label: MOVE_PAYBACK.description
source: Attack that gains power\nif the user moves last.
translation: 蓄力攻击。如果能在对手后\n攻击，招式威力会变成2倍。

label: MOVE_ASSURANCE.name
source: ASSURANCE
translation: 恶意追击

label: MOVE_ASSURANCE.description
source: Attack that gains power\nif the foe has been hurt.
translation: 如果此回合对手已受伤害，\n招式威力会变成2倍。

label: MOVE_EMBARGO.name
source: EMBARGO
translation: 查封

label: MOVE_EMBARGO.description
source: Prevents the foe from\nusing any items.
translation: 对手5回合内不能使用道具。\n训练家也不能对其使用道具。

label: MOVE_FLING.name
source: FLING
translation: 投掷

label: MOVE_FLING.description
source: The effectiveness varies\nwith the held item.
translation: 快速投掷携带的道具攻击。\n威力效果会根据道具改变。

label: MOVE_PSYCHO_SHIFT.name
source: PSYCHO SHIFT
translation: 精神转移

label: MOVE_PSYCHO_SHIFT.description
source: Transfers status problems\nto the foe.
translation: 利用超能力施以暗示，将自己\n的异常状态转移给对手。

label: MOVE_TRUMP_CARD.name
source: TRUMP CARD
translation: 王牌

label: MOVE_TRUMP_CARD.description
source: The less PP the move has\nthe more damage it does.
translation: 王牌招式的剩余PP越少，\n招式的威力越大。

label: MOVE_HEAL_BLOCK.name
source: HEAL BLOCK
translation: 回复封锁

label: MOVE_HEAL_BLOCK.description
source: Prevents the foes from\nrecovering HP for 5 turns.
translation: 在5回合内无法通过招式、\n特性或携带道具回复HP。

label: MOVE_WRING_OUT.name
source: WRING OUT
translation: 绞紧

label: MOVE_POWER_TRICK.name
source: POWER TRICK
translation: 力量戏法

label: MOVE_POWER_TRICK.description
source: The user swaps its Attack\nand Defense stats.
translation: 利用超能力交换自己的\n攻击和防御的力量。

label: MOVE_GASTRO_ACID.name
source: GASTRO ACID
translation: 胃液

label: MOVE_GASTRO_ACID.description
source: Stomach acid suppresses\nthe foe's Ability.
translation: 将胃液吐向对手的身体。\n沾上的胃液会消除对手特性。

label: MOVE_LUCKY_CHANT.name
source: LUCKY CHANT
translation: 幸运咒语

label: MOVE_LUCKY_CHANT.description
source: Prevents the foe from\nlanding critical hits.
translation: 向天许愿，在5回合内不会\n被对手的攻击打中要害。

label: MOVE_ME_FIRST.name
source: ME FIRST
translation: 抢先一步

label: MOVE_ME_FIRST.description
source: Executes the foe's attack\nwith greater power.
translation: 提高威力，抢先使出对手\n的招式。如果不先使出则会失败。

label: MOVE_COPYCAT.name
source: COPYCAT
translation: 仿效

label: MOVE_COPYCAT.description
source: The user mimics the last\nmove used by a foe.
translation: 模仿对手使出的招式，使出相\n同招式。对手没出招则会失败。

label: MOVE_POWER_SWAP.name
source: POWER SWAP
translation: 力量互换

label: MOVE_POWER_SWAP.description
source: Swaps changes to Attack\nand Sp. Atk with the foe.
translation: 利用超能力互换自己和对手\n的攻击以及特攻的能力变化。

label: MOVE_GUARD_SWAP.name
source: GUARD SWAP
translation: 防守互换

label: MOVE_GUARD_SWAP.description
source: Swaps changes to Defense\nand Sp. Def with the foe.
translation: 利用超能力互换自己和对手\n的防御以及特防的能力变化。

label: MOVE_PUNISHMENT.name
source: PUNISHMENT
translation: 惩罚

label: MOVE_PUNISHMENT.description
source: Does more damage the more\nthe foe has powered up.
translation: 根据能力变化，对手提高的\n力量越大，招式的威力越大。

label: MOVE_LAST_RESORT.name
source: LAST RESORT
translation: 珍藏

label: MOVE_LAST_RESORT.description
source: Can only be used if every\nother move has been used.
translation: 当其他招式全部使用过后，\n才能开始使出珍藏的招式。

label: MOVE_WORRY_SEED.name
source: WORRY SEED
translation: 烦恼种子

label: MOVE_WORRY_SEED.description
source: Plants a seed on the foe\ngiving it Insomnia.
translation: 种植心神不宁的种子。\n使对手特性变成不眠。

label: MOVE_SUCKER_PUNCH.name
source: SUCKER PUNCH
translation: 突袭

label: MOVE_TOXIC_SPIKES.name
source: TOXIC SPIKES
translation: 毒菱

label: MOVE_TOXIC_SPIKES.description
source: Sets spikes that poison a\nfoe switching in.
translation: 在对手的脚下撒毒菱。\n使对手换上的宝可梦中毒。

label: MOVE_HEART_SWAP.name
source: HEART SWAP
translation: 心灵互换

label: MOVE_HEART_SWAP.description
source: Swaps any stat changes\nwith the foe.
translation: 利用超能力互换自己和\n对手之间的能力变化。

label: MOVE_AQUA_RING.name
source: AQUA RING
translation: 水流环

label: MOVE_AQUA_RING.description
source: Forms a veil of water\nthat restores HP.
translation: 在自身体周围覆盖用水制造\n的幕。每回合回复HP。

label: MOVE_MAGNET_RISE.name
source: MAGNET RISE
translation: 电磁飘浮

label: MOVE_MAGNET_RISE.description
source: The user levitates with\nelectromagnetism.
translation: 用电气产生的磁力浮在空中。\n在5回合内可以飘浮。

label: MOVE_FLARE_BLITZ.name
source: FLARE BLITZ
translation: 闪焰冲锋

label: MOVE_FLARE_BLITZ.description
source: A charge that may burn the\nfoe. Also hurts the user.
translation: 让火焰覆盖全身猛撞。自己\n也会受伤。有时让对手灼伤。

label: MOVE_FORCE_PALM.name
source: FORCE PALM
translation: 发劲

label: MOVE_FORCE_PALM.description
source: A shock wave attack that\nmay paralyze the foe.
translation: 向对手发出冲击波攻击。\n有时会让对手陷入麻痹。

label: MOVE_AURA_SPHERE.name
source: AURA SPHERE
translation: 波导弹

label: MOVE_AURA_SPHERE.description
source: Attacks with an aura blast\nthat cannot be evaded.
translation: 从体内产生出波导之力，然\n后发出。攻击必定会命中。

label: MOVE_ROCK_POLISH.name
source: ROCK POLISH
translation: 岩石打磨

label: MOVE_ROCK_POLISH.description
source: Polishes the body to\nsharply raise Speed.
translation: 打磨自己的身体，减少空气\n阻力。大幅提高自己的速度。

label: MOVE_POISON_JAB.name
source: POISON JAB
translation: 毒击

label: MOVE_POISON_JAB.description
source: A stabbing attack that\nmay poison the foe.
translation: 用带毒触手或手臂刺入对手。\n有时会让对手陷入中毒状态。

label: MOVE_DARK_PULSE.name
source: DARK PULSE
translation: 恶之波动

label: MOVE_DARK_PULSE.description
source: Attacks with a horrible\naura. May cause flinching.
translation: 从体内发出充满恶意的恐怖\n气场。有时会使对手畏缩。

label: MOVE_NIGHT_SLASH.name
source: NIGHT SLASH
translation: 暗袭要害

label: MOVE_NIGHT_SLASH.description
source: Hits as soon as possible.\nHigh critical-hit ratio.
translation: 抓住瞬间的空隙切斩对手。\n容易击中要害。

label: MOVE_AQUA_TAIL.name
source: AQUA TAIL
translation: 水流尾

label: MOVE_AQUA_TAIL.description
source: The user swings its tail\nlike a wave to attack.
translation: 如惊涛骇浪般挥动大尾巴\n攻击对手。

label: MOVE_SEED_BOMB.name
source: SEED BOMB
translation: 种子炸弹

label: MOVE_SEED_BOMB.description
source: A barrage of hard seeds\nis fired at the foe.
translation: 将外壳坚硬的大种子，\n从上方砸下攻击对手。

label: MOVE_AIR_SLASH.name
source: AIR SLASH
translation: 空气之刃

label: MOVE_AIR_SLASH.description
source: Attacks with a blade of\nair. May cause flinching.
translation: 用也能劈开天空的空气之刃\n攻击。有时会使对手畏缩。

label: MOVE_X_SCISSOR.name
source: X-SCISSOR
translation: 十字剪

label: MOVE_X_SCISSOR.description
source: Slashes the foe with crossed\nscythes, claws, etc.
translation: 将镰刀或爪子像剪刀般地\n交叉，顺势劈开对手。

label: MOVE_BUG_BUZZ.name
source: BUG BUZZ
translation: 虫鸣

label: MOVE_BUG_BUZZ.description
source: A damaging sound wave that\nmay lower Sp. Def.
translation: 利用振动发出音波攻击。\n有时会降低对手的特防。

label: MOVE_DRAGON_PULSE.name
source: DRAGON PULSE
translation: 龙之波动

label: MOVE_DRAGON_PULSE.description
source: Generates a shock wave to\ndamage the foe.
translation: 从大大的口中掀起冲击波\n攻击对手。

label: MOVE_DRAGON_RUSH.name
source: DRAGON RUSH
translation: 龙之俯冲

label: MOVE_DRAGON_RUSH.description
source: Tackles the foe with menace.\nMay cause flinching.
translation: 释放出骇人杀气，边威慑边\n撞击对手。有时会使对手畏缩。

label: MOVE_POWER_GEM.name
source: POWER GEM
translation: 力量宝石

label: MOVE_POWER_GEM.description
source: Attacks with rays of light\nthat sparkle like diamonds.
translation: 发射如宝石般闪耀的光芒\n攻击对手。

label: MOVE_DRAIN_PUNCH.name
source: DRAIN PUNCH
translation: 吸取拳

label: MOVE_VACUUM_WAVE.name
source: VACUUM WAVE
translation: 真空波

label: MOVE_VACUUM_WAVE.description
source: Whirls its fists to send\na wave that strikes first.
translation: 挥动拳头，掀起真空波。\n必定能够先制攻击。

label: MOVE_FOCUS_BLAST.name
source: FOCUS BLAST
translation: 真气弹

label: MOVE_FOCUS_BLAST.description
source: Attacks at full power.\nMay lower Sp. Def.
translation: 提高气势，释放出全部力量。\n有时会降低对手的特防。

label: MOVE_ENERGY_BALL.name
source: ENERGY BALL
translation: 能量球

label: MOVE_ENERGY_BALL.description
source: Draws power from nature to\nattack. May lower Sp. Def.
translation: 发射从自然收集的生命力量。\n有时会降低对手的特防。

label: MOVE_BRAVE_BIRD.name
source: BRAVE BIRD
translation: 勇鸟猛攻

label: MOVE_BRAVE_BIRD.description
source: A low altitude charge that\nalso hurts the user.
translation: 收拢翅膀低空飞行突击对手。\n自己也会受到不小的伤害。

label: MOVE_EARTH_POWER.name
source: EARTH POWER
translation: 大地之力

label: MOVE_EARTH_POWER.description
source: Makes the ground erupt with\npower. May lower Sp. Def.
translation: 向对手脚下释放出大地之力。\n有时会降低对手的特防。

label: MOVE_SWITCHEROO.name
source: SWITCHEROO
translation: 掉包

label: MOVE_SWITCHEROO.description
source: Swaps items with the foe\nfaster than the eye can see.
translation: 用一闪而过的速度交换\n自己和对手的持有物。

label: MOVE_GIGA_IMPACT.name
source: GIGA IMPACT
translation: 终极冲击

label: MOVE_NASTY_PLOT.name
source: NASTY PLOT
translation: 诡计

label: MOVE_NASTY_PLOT.description
source: Thinks bad thoughts to\nsharply boost Sp. Atk.
translation: 谋划诡计，激活头脑。\n大幅提高自己的特攻。

label: MOVE_BULLET_PUNCH.name
source: BULLET PUNCH
translation: 子弹拳

label: MOVE_BULLET_PUNCH.description
source: Punches as fast as a bul-\nlet. It always hits first.
translation: 使出如子弹般快速而坚硬\n的拳头。必定能够先制攻击。

label: MOVE_AVALANCHE.name
source: AVALANCHE
translation: 雪崩

label: MOVE_ICE_SHARD.name
source: ICE SHARD
translation: 冰砾

label: MOVE_ICE_SHARD.description
source: Hurls a chunk of ice that\nalways strikes first.
translation: 瞬间制作冰块，快速扔向对\n手。必定能够先制攻击。

label: MOVE_SHADOW_CLAW.name
source: SHADOW CLAW
translation: 暗影爪

label: MOVE_SHADOW_CLAW.description
source: Strikes with a shadow claw.\nHigh critical-hit ratio.
translation: 以影子做成的锐爪，劈开\n对手。容易击中要害。

label: MOVE_THUNDER_FANG.name
source: THUNDER FANG
translation: 雷电牙

label: MOVE_THUNDER_FANG.description
source: May cause flinching or\nleave the foe paralyzed.
translation: 用蓄满电流的牙齿咬住对手。\n有时会使对手畏缩或麻痹。

label: MOVE_ICE_FANG.name
source: ICE FANG
translation: 冰冻牙

label: MOVE_FIRE_FANG.name
source: FIRE FANG
translation: 火焰牙

label: MOVE_FIRE_FANG.description
source: May cause flinching or\nleave the foe with a burn.
translation: 用覆盖着火焰的牙齿咬住对手。\n有时会使对手畏缩或灼伤。

label: MOVE_SHADOW_SNEAK.name
source: SHADOW SNEAK
translation: 影子偷袭

label: MOVE_SHADOW_SNEAK.description
source: Extends the user's shadow\nto strike first.
translation: 伸长影子，从对手背后进行\n攻击。必定能够先制攻击。

label: MOVE_MUD_BOMB.name
source: MUD BOMB
translation: 泥巴炸弹

label: MOVE_MUD_BOMB.description
source: Throws a blob of mud to\ndamage and cut accuracy.
translation: 向对手发射坚硬的泥弹攻击。\n有时会降低对手的命中率。

label: MOVE_PSYCHO_CUT.name
source: PSYCHO CUT
translation: 精神利刃

label: MOVE_PSYCHO_CUT.description
source: Tears with psychic blades.\nHigh critical-hit ratio.
translation: 用实体化的心之利刃劈开\n对手。容易击中要害。

label: MOVE_ZEN_HEADBUTT.name
source: ZEN HEADBUTT
translation: 意念头锤

label: MOVE_ZEN_HEADBUTT.description
source: Hits with a strong head-\nbutt. May cause flinching.
translation: 将思念的力量集中在前额\n攻击。有时会使对手畏缩。

label: MOVE_MIRROR_SHOT.name
source: MIRROR SHOT
translation: 镜光射击

label: MOVE_MIRROR_SHOT.description
source: Emits a flash of energy to\ndamage and cut accuracy.
translation: 抛光身体向对手释放出闪光\n之力。有时会降低对手命中率。

label: MOVE_FLASH_CANNON.name
source: FLASH CANNON
translation: 加农光炮

label: MOVE_FLASH_CANNON.description
source: Releases a blast of light\nthat may lower Sp. Def.
translation: 将身体光芒聚集在一点释放\n出去。有时会降低对手特防。

label: MOVE_ROCK_CLIMB.name
source: ROCK CLIMB
translation: 攀岩

label: MOVE_ROCK_CLIMB.description
source: A charging attack that may\nconfuse the foe.
translation: 发动猛撞攻击，\n有时会使对手混乱。

label: MOVE_DEFOG.name
source: DEFOG
translation: 清除浓雾

label: MOVE_DEFOG.description
source: Removes obstacles and\nlowers evasion.
translation: 用强风吹开对手的墙壁招式。\n也会降低对手的闪避率。

label: MOVE_TRICK_ROOM.name
source: TRICK ROOM
translation: 戏法空间

label: MOVE_TRICK_ROOM.description
source: Slower Pokémon get to move\nfirst for 5 turns.
translation: 制造出离奇空间。5回合内\n速度慢的宝可梦可以先行动。

label: MOVE_DRACO_METEOR.name
source: DRACO METEOR
translation: 流星群

label: MOVE_DRACO_METEOR.description
source: Casts comets onto the foe.\nHarshly lowers the Sp. Atk.
translation: 从天空中向对手落下陨石。\n自己的特攻会大幅降低。

label: MOVE_DISCHARGE.name
source: DISCHARGE
translation: 放电

label: MOVE_LAVA_PLUME.name
source: LAVA PLUME
translation: 喷烟

label: MOVE_LEAF_STORM.name
source: LEAF STORM
translation: 飞叶风暴

label: MOVE_LEAF_STORM.description
source: Whips up a storm of leaves.\nHarshly lowers the Sp. Atk.
translation: 用尖叶片向对手卷起风暴。\n自己的特攻会大幅降低。

label: MOVE_POWER_WHIP.name
source: POWER WHIP
translation: 强力鞭打

label: MOVE_POWER_WHIP.description
source: Violently lashes the foe\nwith vines or tentacles.
translation: 激烈地挥舞青藤或触手\n摔打对手攻击。

label: MOVE_ROCK_WRECKER.name
source: ROCK WRECKER
translation: 岩石炮

label: MOVE_CROSS_POISON.name
source: CROSS POISON
translation: 十字毒刃

label: MOVE_CROSS_POISON.description
source: A slash that may poison a\nfoe and do critical damage.
translation: 用毒刃劈开对手。有时会让\n对手中毒，也容易击中要害。

label: MOVE_GUNK_SHOT.name
source: GUNK SHOT
translation: 垃圾射击

label: MOVE_GUNK_SHOT.description
source: Shoots filthy garbage at\nthe foe. May also poison.
translation: 用肮脏的垃圾撞向对手攻击。\n有时会让对手陷入中毒状态。

label: MOVE_IRON_HEAD.name
source: IRON HEAD
translation: 铁头

label: MOVE_IRON_HEAD.description
source: Slams the foe with a hard\nhead. May cause flinching.
translation: 用钢铁般坚硬的头部攻击。\n有时会使对手畏缩。

label: MOVE_MAGNET_BOMB.name
source: MAGNET BOMB
translation: 磁铁炸弹

label: MOVE_MAGNET_BOMB.description
source: Launches a magnet that\nstrikes without fail.
translation: 发射吸住对手的钢铁炸弹。\n攻击必定会命中。

label: MOVE_STONE_EDGE.name
source: STONE EDGE
translation: 尖石攻击

label: MOVE_STONE_EDGE.description
source: Stabs the foe with stones.\nHigh critical-hit ratio.
translation: 用尖尖的岩石刺入对手攻击。\n容易击中要害。

label: MOVE_CAPTIVATE.name
source: CAPTIVATE
translation: 诱惑

label: MOVE_CAPTIVATE.description
source: Makes the opposite gender\nsharply reduce its Sp. Atk.
translation: 诱惑异性，\n从而大幅降低对手的特攻。

label: MOVE_STEALTH_ROCK.name
source: STEALTH ROCK
translation: 隐形岩

label: MOVE_STEALTH_ROCK.description
source: Sets floating stones that\nhurt a foe switching in.
translation: 将无数岩石悬浮在对手周围，\n对换上的宝可梦给予伤害。

label: MOVE_GRASS_KNOT.name
source: GRASS KNOT
translation: 打草结

label: MOVE_GRASS_KNOT.description
source: A snare attack that does\nmore damage to heavier foes.
translation: 用草缠住并绊倒对手。\n对手越重，威力越大。

label: MOVE_CHATTER.name
source: CHATTER
translation: 喋喋不休

label: MOVE_CHATTER.description
source: Attacks with a sound wave\nthat causes confusion.
translation: 用非常烦人喋喋不休\n的音波攻击对手。使对手混乱。

label: MOVE_JUDGMENT.name
source: JUDGMENT
translation: 制裁光砾

label: MOVE_JUDGMENT.description
source: The type varies with the\nkind of Plate held.
translation: 向对手放出无数的光弹。\n属性会根据携带石板而改变。

label: MOVE_BUG_BITE.name
source: BUG BITE
translation: 虫咬

label: MOVE_CHARGE_BEAM.name
source: CHARGE BEAM
translation: 充电光束

label: MOVE_CHARGE_BEAM.description
source: Fires a beam of electricity.\nMay raise Sp. Atk.
translation: 向对手发射电击光束。\n有时会提高自己的特攻。

label: MOVE_WOOD_HAMMER.name
source: WOOD HAMMER
translation: 木槌

label: MOVE_WOOD_HAMMER.description
source: Slams the body into a foe.\nThe user gets hurt too.
translation: 用坚硬的躯体撞击对手攻击。\n自己也会受到不小的伤害。

label: MOVE_AQUA_JET.name
source: AQUA JET
translation: 水流喷射

label: MOVE_AQUA_JET.description
source: Strikes first by dashing\nat the foe at a high speed.
translation: 以迅雷不及掩耳之势扑向\n对手。必定能够先制攻击。

label: MOVE_ATTACK_ORDER.name
source: ATTACK ORDER
translation: 攻击指令

label: MOVE_ATTACK_ORDER.description
source: Underlings pummel the foe.\nHigh critical-hit ratio.
translation: 召唤手下，让其朝对手发起\n攻击。容易击中要害。

label: MOVE_DEFEND_ORDER.name
source: DEFEND ORDER
translation: 防御指令

label: MOVE_DEFEND_ORDER.description
source: Raises Defense and Sp. Def\nwith a living shield.
translation: 召唤手下附在自己身体上。\n可以提高自己的防御和特防。

label: MOVE_HEAL_ORDER.name
source: HEAL ORDER
translation: 回复指令

label: MOVE_HEAL_ORDER.description
source: The user's underlings show\nup to heal half its max HP.
translation: 召唤手下疗伤。\n回复自己最大HP的一半。

label: MOVE_HEAD_SMASH.name
source: HEAD SMASH
translation: 双刃头锤

label: MOVE_HEAD_SMASH.description
source: A life-risking headbutt that\nseriously hurts the user.
translation: 拼命向对手进行头锤攻击。\n自己也会受到非常大的伤害。

label: MOVE_DOUBLE_HIT.name
source: DOUBLE HIT
translation: 二连击

label: MOVE_DOUBLE_HIT.description
source: Slams the foe with a tail\netc. Strikes twice.
translation: 使用尾巴等拍打对手攻击。\n连续2次给予伤害。

label: MOVE_ROAR_OF_TIME.name
source: ROAR OF TIME
translation: 时光咆哮

label: MOVE_ROAR_OF_TIME.description
source: Powerful, but leaves the\nuser immobile the next turn.
translation: 释放扭曲时间般的强大力量。\n下一回合自己将无法动弹。

label: MOVE_SPACIAL_REND.name
source: SPACIAL REND
translation: 亚空裂斩

label: MOVE_SPACIAL_REND.description
source: Tears the foe, and space.\nHigh critical-hit ratio.
translation: 将对手连同周围的空间一起\n撕裂。容易击中要害。

label: MOVE_LUNAR_DANCE.name
source: LUNAR DANCE
translation: 新月舞

label: MOVE_CRUSH_GRIP.name
source: CRUSH GRIP
translation: 捏碎

label: MOVE_MAGMA_STORM.name
source: MAGMA STORM
translation: 熔岩风暴

label: MOVE_DARK_VOID.name
source: DARK VOID
translation: 暗黑洞

label: MOVE_DARK_VOID.description
source: Drags the foes into total\ndarkness, inducing Sleep.
translation: 将对手强制拖入黑暗的世界，\n从而让对手陷入睡眠状态。

label: MOVE_SEED_FLARE.name
source: SEED FLARE
translation: 种子闪光

label: MOVE_SEED_FLARE.description
source: Generates a shock wave that\nsharply reduces Sp. Def.
translation: 从身体里产生冲击波。\n有时会大幅降低对手的特防。

label: MOVE_OMINOUS_WIND.name
source: OMINOUS WIND
translation: 奇异之风

label: MOVE_OMINOUS_WIND.description
source: A repulsive attack that may\nraise all stats.
translation: 突然刮起毛骨悚然的暴风。\n有时会提高自己的全部能力。

label: MOVE_SHADOW_FORCE.name
source: SHADOW FORCE
translation: 暗影潜袭

label: MOVE_HONE_CLAWS.name
source: HONE CLAWS
translation: 磨爪

label: MOVE_HONE_CLAWS.description
source: Sharpens its claws to raise\nAttack and Accuracy.
translation: 将爪子磨得更加锋利。\n提高自己的攻击和命中率。

label: MOVE_WIDE_GUARD.name
source: WIDE GUARD
translation: 广域防守

label: MOVE_WIDE_GUARD.description
source: Evades wide-ranging attacks\nfor one turn.
translation: 在1回合内防住击打\n我方全员的攻击。

label: MOVE_GUARD_SPLIT.name
source: GUARD SPLIT
translation: 防守平分

label: MOVE_GUARD_SPLIT.description
source: Averages changes to Defense\nand Sp. Def with the foe.
translation: 利用超能力将自己和对手的\n防御和特防相加再进行平分。

label: MOVE_POWER_SPLIT.name
source: POWER SPLIT
translation: 力量平分

label: MOVE_POWER_SPLIT.description
source: Averages changes to Attack\nand Sp. Atk with the foe.
translation: 利用超能力将自己和对手的\n攻击和特攻相加再进行平分。

label: MOVE_WONDER_ROOM.name
source: WONDER ROOM
translation: 奇妙空间

label: MOVE_WONDER_ROOM.description
source: Defense and Sp. Def stats\nare swapped for 5 turns.
translation: 制造出离奇空间。在5回合内\n互换所有宝可梦防御和特防。

label: MOVE_PSYSHOCK.name
source: PSYSHOCK
translation: 精神冲击

label: MOVE_VENOSHOCK.name
source: VENOSHOCK
translation: 毒液冲击

label: MOVE_VENOSHOCK.description
source: Does double damage if the\nfoe is poisoned.
translation: 将特殊的毒液泼向对手。对\n中毒的对手，威力会变成2倍。

label: MOVE_AUTOTOMIZE.name
source: AUTOTOMIZE
translation: 身体轻量化

label: MOVE_AUTOTOMIZE.description
source: Sheds additional weight to\nsharply boost Speed.
translation: 削掉身体上没用部分。大幅\n提高自身速度，并减轻体重。

label: MOVE_RAGE_POWDER.name
source: RAGE POWDER
translation: 愤怒粉

label: MOVE_RAGE_POWDER.description
source: Scatters powder to make\nfoes attack only the user.
translation: 将令人烦躁的粉末撒在自身，\n使对手的攻击全部指向自己。

label: MOVE_TELEKINESIS.name
source: TELEKINESIS
translation: 意念移物

label: MOVE_TELEKINESIS.description
source: Makes the foe float. It is\neasier to hit for 3 turns.
translation: 利用超能力使对手浮起来。\n在3回合内攻击会容易命中。

label: MOVE_MAGIC_ROOM.name
source: MAGIC ROOM
translation: 魔法空间

label: MOVE_MAGIC_ROOM.description
source: Hold items lose their\neffects for 5 turns.
translation: 制造出离奇空间。在5回合内\n所有携带道具效果都会消失。

label: MOVE_SMACK_DOWN.name
source: SMACK DOWN
translation: 击落

label: MOVE_SMACK_DOWN.description
source: Throws a rock to knock the\nfoe down to the ground.
translation: 扔石头或炮弹，击落飞行的\n对手，使其掉到地面。

label: MOVE_STORM_THROW.name
source: STORM THROW
translation: 山岚摔

label: MOVE_FLAME_BURST.name
source: FLAME BURST
translation: 烈焰溅射

label: MOVE_FLAME_BURST.description
source: A bursting flame that does\ndamage to all foes.
translation: 如果击中，爆裂的火焰会\n飞溅到旁边的对手。

label: MOVE_SLUDGE_WAVE.name
source: SLUDGE WAVE
translation: 污泥波

label: MOVE_SLUDGE_WAVE.description
source: Swamps all others with a wave\nof sludge. May also poison.
translation: 用污泥波攻击周围所有的\n宝可梦。有时会造成中毒。

label: MOVE_QUIVER_DANCE.name
source: QUIVER DANCE
translation: 蝶舞

label: MOVE_QUIVER_DANCE.description
source: Dances to raise Sp. Atk\nSp. Def and Speed.
translation: 轻巧跳起神秘而美丽的舞蹈。\n提高自己特攻、特防和速度。

label: MOVE_HEAVY_SLAM.name
source: HEAVY SLAM
translation: 重磅冲撞

label: MOVE_SYNCHRONOISE.name
source: SYNCHRONOISE
translation: 同步干扰

label: MOVE_ELECTRO_BALL.name
source: ELECTRO BALL
translation: 电球

label: MOVE_ELECTRO_BALL.description
source: Hurls an orb that does more\ndamage to slower foes.
translation: 用电气团撞向对手。自己\n比对手速度越快，威力越大。

label: MOVE_SOAK.name
source: SOAK
translation: 浸水

label: MOVE_SOAK.description
source: Sprays water at the foe,\nchanging it to Water type.
translation: 将大量的水泼向对手，\n从而使其变成水属性。

label: MOVE_FLAME_CHARGE.name
source: FLAME CHARGE
translation: 蓄能焰袭

label: MOVE_FLAME_CHARGE.description
source: Attacks in a cloak of\nflames. Raises Speed.
translation: 让火焰覆盖全身，攻击对手。\n积蓄力量提高自己的速度。

label: MOVE_COIL.name
source: COIL
translation: 盘蜷

label: MOVE_COIL.description
source: Coils up to raise Attack,\nDefense and Accuracy.
translation: 盘蜷集中精神。提高自己的\n攻击、防御和命中率。

label: MOVE_LOW_SWEEP.name
source: LOW SWEEP
translation: 下盘踢

label: MOVE_LOW_SWEEP.description
source: Attacks the foe's legs\nlowering its Speed.
translation: 以敏捷的动作瞄准对手的脚\n攻击。会降低对手的速度。

label: MOVE_ACID_SPRAY.name
source: ACID SPRAY
translation: 酸液炸弹

label: MOVE_ACID_SPRAY.description
source: Sprays a hide-melting acid.\nSharply reduces Sp. Def.
translation: 喷出能溶化对手的液体攻击。\n会大幅降低对手的特防。

label: MOVE_FOUL_PLAY.name
source: FOUL PLAY
translation: 欺诈

label: MOVE_FOUL_PLAY.description
source: The higher the foe's Attack\nthe more damage caused.
translation: 利用对手的力量攻击。\n对手攻击越高，伤害越大。

label: MOVE_SIMPLE_BEAM.name
source: SIMPLE BEAM
translation: 单纯光束

label: MOVE_SIMPLE_BEAM.description
source: A beam that changes the\nfoe's Ability to Simple.
translation: 向对手发送谜之念波。接收\n到的对手特性会变为单纯。

label: MOVE_ENTRAINMENT.name
source: ENTRAINMENT
translation: 找伙伴

label: MOVE_ENTRAINMENT.description
source: Makes the foe mimic the\nuser, gaining its Ability.
translation: 用神奇的节奏跳舞。使对手\n的特性变成一样。

label: MOVE_AFTER_YOU.name
source: AFTER YOU
translation: 您先请

label: MOVE_AFTER_YOU.description
source: Helps out the target, letting\nit move next.
translation: 支援我方或对手的行动，\n使其紧接着此招式之后行动。

label: MOVE_ROUND.name
source: ROUND
translation: 轮唱

label: MOVE_ROUND.description
source: A song that inflicts damage.\nOthers can join in too.
translation: 用歌声攻击对手。大家一起\n可以接连使用，威力也会提高。

label: MOVE_ECHOED_VOICE.name
source: ECHOED VOICE
translation: 回声

label: MOVE_ECHOED_VOICE.description
source: Does more damage every turn\nit is used.
translation: 用回声攻击对手。若每回合\n都有该招式使用威力就会提高。

label: MOVE_CHIP_AWAY.name
source: CHIP AWAY
translation: 逐步击破

label: MOVE_CLEAR_SMOG.name
source: CLEAR SMOG
translation: 清除之烟

label: MOVE_CLEAR_SMOG.description
source: Attacks with white haze that\neliminates all stat changes.
translation: 向对手投掷特殊泥块攻击。\n使其能力变回原点。

label: MOVE_STORED_POWER.name
source: STORED POWER
translation: 辅助力量

label: MOVE_STORED_POWER.description
source: The higher the user's stats\nthe more damage caused.
translation: 用蓄积起来的力量攻击对手。\n能力提高得越多威力越大。

label: MOVE_QUICK_GUARD.name
source: QUICK GUARD
translation: 快速防守

label: MOVE_QUICK_GUARD.description
source: Evades priority attacks\nfor one turn.
translation: 守护自己和同伴，\n以防对手的先制攻击。

label: MOVE_ALLY_SWITCH.name
source: ALLY SWITCH
translation: 交换场地

label: MOVE_ALLY_SWITCH.description
source: The user switches places\nwith its partner.
translation: 用神奇力量瞬间移动与同伴\n交换位置。连续使出容易失败。

label: MOVE_SCALD.name
source: SCALD
translation: 热水

label: MOVE_SCALD.description
source: Shoots boiling water at the\nfoe. May inflict a burn.
translation: 向对手喷射煮得翻滚的开水。\n有时会让对手陷入灼伤状态。

label: MOVE_SHELL_SMASH.name
source: SHELL SMASH
translation: 破壳

label: MOVE_SHELL_SMASH.description
source: Sharply raises Atk/Sp.Atk/\nSpeed, but drops Def/Sp.Def.
translation: 打破外壳降低防御和特防，\n但大幅提高攻击特攻和速度。

label: MOVE_HEAL_PULSE.name
source: HEAL PULSE
translation: 治愈波动

label: MOVE_HEAL_PULSE.description
source: Recovers up to half the\ntarget's maximum HP.
translation: 放出治愈波动，\n从而回复对手最大HP的一半。

label: MOVE_HEX.name
source: HEX
translation: 祸不单行

label: MOVE_HEX.description
source: Does double damage if the\nfoe has a status problem.
translation: 接二连三地攻击。对异常\n状态的对手给予较大的伤害。

label: MOVE_SKY_DROP.name
source: SKY DROP
translation: 自由落体

label: MOVE_SKY_DROP.description
source: Takes the foe into the sky\nthen drops it the next turn.
translation: 第1回合将对手带到空中，\n第2回合将其摔下攻击。

label: MOVE_SHIFT_GEAR.name
source: SHIFT GEAR
translation: 换档

label: MOVE_SHIFT_GEAR.description
source: Rotates its gears to raise\nAttack and Speed.
translation: 转动齿轮，不仅提高自己的\n攻击，还会大幅提高速度。

label: MOVE_CIRCLE_THROW.name
source: CIRCLE THROW
translation: 巴投

label: MOVE_INCINERATE.name
source: INCINERATE
translation: 烧净

label: MOVE_INCINERATE.description
source: Burns up Berries and Gems\npreventing their use.
translation: 用火焰攻击对手。会烧掉\n对手携带树果，使其不能使用。

label: MOVE_QUASH.name
source: QUASH
translation: 延后

label: MOVE_QUASH.description
source: Suppresses the foe, making\nit move last.
translation: 压制对手，\n从而将其行动顺序放到最后。

label: MOVE_ACROBATICS.name
source: ACROBATICS
translation: 杂技

label: MOVE_ACROBATICS.description
source: Does double damage if the\nuser has no item.
translation: 轻巧地攻击对手。自己没有\n携带道具时给予更大伤害。

label: MOVE_REFLECT_TYPE.name
source: REFLECT TYPE
translation: 镜面属性

label: MOVE_REFLECT_TYPE.description
source: The user reflects the foe's\ntype, copying it.
translation: 反射对手的属性，\n让自己也变成一样的属性。

label: MOVE_RETALIATE.name
source: RETALIATE
translation: 报仇

label: MOVE_RETALIATE.description
source: Attack that does more\ndamage if an ally fainted.
translation: 为倒下的同伴报仇。如果上\n回合有同伴倒下威力会提高。

label: MOVE_FINAL_GAMBIT.name
source: FINAL GAMBIT
translation: 搏命

label: MOVE_FINAL_GAMBIT.description
source: The user faints to damage\nthe foe equal to its HP.
translation: 拼命攻击。自己陷入昏厥，\n给予自己目前HP等量伤害。

label: MOVE_BESTOW.name
source: BESTOW
translation: 传递礼物

label: MOVE_BESTOW.description
source: The user gives its held\nitem to the foe.
translation: 当对手未携带道具时，\n能够将携带道具交给对手。

label: MOVE_INFERNO.name
source: INFERNO
translation: 烈火深渊

label: MOVE_INFERNO.description
source: Powerful and sure to inflict\na burn, but inaccurate.
translation: 用烈焰包裹住对手攻击。\n让对手陷入灼伤状态。

label: MOVE_WATER_PLEDGE.name
source: WATER PLEDGE
translation: 水之誓约

label: MOVE_WATER_PLEDGE.description
source: Attacks with a column of\nwater. May make a rainbow.
translation: 用水柱攻击。如果和火组合\n威力会提高并生成彩虹。

label: MOVE_FIRE_PLEDGE.name
source: FIRE PLEDGE
translation: 火之誓约

label: MOVE_FIRE_PLEDGE.description
source: Attacks with a column of\nfire. May burn the grass.
translation: 用火柱攻击。如果和草组合\n威力会提高并生成火海。

label: MOVE_GRASS_PLEDGE.name
source: GRASS PLEDGE
translation: 草之誓约

label: MOVE_GRASS_PLEDGE.description
source: Attacks with a column of\ngrass. May create a swamp.
translation: 用草柱攻击。如果和水组合\n威力会提高并生成湿地。

label: MOVE_VOLT_SWITCH.name
source: VOLT SWITCH
translation: 伏特替换

label: MOVE_STRUGGLE_BUG.name
source: STRUGGLE BUG
translation: 虫之抵抗

label: MOVE_STRUGGLE_BUG.description
source: Resisting, the user attacks\nthe foes. Lowers Sp. Atk.
translation: 抵抗并攻击对手。\n会降低对手的特攻。

label: MOVE_BULLDOZE.name
source: BULLDOZE
translation: 重踏

label: MOVE_BULLDOZE.description
source: Stomps down on the ground.\nHits all and lowers Speed.
translation: 用力踩踏地面并攻击所有的\n宝可梦。会降低对方的速度。

label: MOVE_FROST_BREATH.name
source: FROST BREATH
translation: 冰息

label: MOVE_DRAGON_TAIL.name
source: DRAGON TAIL
translation: 龙尾

label: MOVE_WORK_UP.name
source: WORK UP
translation: 自我激励

label: MOVE_WORK_UP.description
source: The user is roused.\nUps Attack and Sp. Atk.
translation: 激励自己，\n从而提高攻击和特攻。

label: MOVE_ELECTROWEB.name
source: ELECTROWEB
translation: 电网

label: MOVE_ELECTROWEB.description
source: Snares the foes with an\nelectric net. Lowers Speed.
translation: 用电网捉住对手攻击。\n会降低对手的速度。

label: MOVE_WILD_CHARGE.name
source: WILD CHARGE
translation: 疯狂伏特

label: MOVE_WILD_CHARGE.description
source: An electrical tackle that\nalso hurts the user.
translation: 让电流覆盖全身，撞向对手\n攻击。自己也会受少许伤害。

label: MOVE_DRILL_RUN.name
source: DRILL RUN
translation: 直冲钻

label: MOVE_DRILL_RUN.description
source: Spins its body like a drill.\nHigh critical-hit ratio.
translation: 像钢钻一样，边旋转身体边\n撞击对手。容易击中要害。

label: MOVE_DUAL_CHOP.name
source: DUAL CHOP
translation: 二连劈

label: MOVE_DUAL_CHOP.description
source: Attacks with brutal hits\nthat strike twice.
translation: 用身体坚硬的部分拍打对手。\n连续2次给予伤害。

label: MOVE_HEART_STAMP.name
source: HEART STAMP
translation: 爱心印章

label: MOVE_HEART_STAMP.description
source: A sudden blow after a cute\nact. May cause flinching.
translation: 以可爱动作使对手疏忽，并\n强力一击。有时使对手畏缩。

label: MOVE_HORN_LEECH.name
source: HORN LEECH
translation: 木角

label: MOVE_SACRED_SWORD.name
source: SACRED SWORD
translation: 圣剑

label: MOVE_RAZOR_SHELL.name
source: RAZOR SHELL
translation: 贝壳刃

label: MOVE_RAZOR_SHELL.description
source: Tears at the foe with sharp\nshells. May lower Defense.
translation: 用锋利的贝壳切斩对手攻击。\n有时会降低对手的防御。

label: MOVE_HEAT_CRASH.name
source: HEAT CRASH
translation: 高温重压

label: MOVE_LEAF_TORNADO.name
source: LEAF TORNADO
translation: 青草搅拌器

label: MOVE_LEAF_TORNADO.description
source: Circles the foe with leaves\nto damage and cut accuracy.
translation: 用锋利叶片包裹住对手攻击。\n有时会降低对手的命中率。

label: MOVE_STEAMROLLER.name
source: STEAMROLLER
translation: 疯狂滚压

label: MOVE_STEAMROLLER.description
source: Crushes the foe with its\nbody. May cause flinching.
translation: 旋转揉成团的身体压扁对手。\n有时会使对手畏缩。

label: MOVE_COTTON_GUARD.name
source: COTTON GUARD
translation: 棉花防守

label: MOVE_COTTON_GUARD.description
source: Wraps its body in cotton.\nDrastically raises Defense.
translation: 用软绵绵的绒毛包裹住自身\n守护。巨幅提高自己的防御。

label: MOVE_NIGHT_DAZE.name
source: NIGHT DAZE
translation: 暗黑爆破

label: MOVE_NIGHT_DAZE.description
source: Looses a pitch-black shock\nwave. May lower accuracy.
translation: 放出黑暗的冲击波攻击对手。\n有时会降低对手的命中率。

label: MOVE_PSYSTRIKE.name
source: PSYSTRIKE
translation: 精神击破

label: MOVE_TAIL_SLAP.name
source: TAIL SLAP
translation: 扫尾拍打

label: MOVE_TAIL_SLAP.description
source: Strikes the foe with its\ntail 2 to 5 times.
translation: 用坚硬的尾巴拍打对手攻击。\n连续攻击2~5次。

label: MOVE_HURRICANE.name
source: HURRICANE
translation: 暴风

label: MOVE_HURRICANE.description
source: Traps the foe in a fierce\nwind. May cause confusion.
translation: 用强烈的风席卷对手攻击。\n有时会使对手混乱。

label: MOVE_HEAD_CHARGE.name
source: HEAD CHARGE
translation: 爆炸头突击

label: MOVE_HEAD_CHARGE.description
source: A charge using guard hair.\nIt hurts the user a little.
translation: 用厉害的爆炸头猛撞向对手。\n自己也会受到少许伤害。

label: MOVE_GEAR_GRIND.name
source: GEAR GRIND
translation: 齿轮飞盘

label: MOVE_GEAR_GRIND.description
source: Throws two steel gears\nthat strike twice.
translation: 向对手投掷钢铁齿轮攻击。\n连续2次给予伤害。

label: MOVE_SEARING_SHOT.name
source: SEARING SHOT
translation: 火焰弹

label: MOVE_TECHNO_BLAST.name
source: TECHNO BLAST
translation: 高科技光炮

label: MOVE_TECHNO_BLAST.description
source: The type varies with the\nkind of Drive held.
translation: 向对手放出光弹。\n属性会根据卡带不同而改变。

label: MOVE_RELIC_SONG.name
source: RELIC SONG
translation: 古老之歌

label: MOVE_RELIC_SONG.description
source: Attacks with an ancient\nsong. May induce sleep.
translation: 以古老之歌打动对手的内心\n攻击。有时让对手陷入睡眠状态。

label: MOVE_SECRET_SWORD.name
source: SECRET SWORD
translation: 神秘之剑

label: MOVE_SECRET_SWORD.description
source: Cuts with a long horn that\ndoes physical damage.
translation: 用长角切斩对手攻击。角上\n的神奇力量将给予物理伤害。

label: MOVE_GLACIATE.name
source: GLACIATE
translation: 冰封世界

label: MOVE_GLACIATE.description
source: Blows very cold air at the\nfoes. It lowers their Speed.
translation: 将冰冻的冷气吹向对手攻击。\n会降低对手的速度。

label: MOVE_BOLT_STRIKE.name
source: BOLT STRIKE
translation: 雷击

label: MOVE_BOLT_STRIKE.description
source: Strikes with a great amount\nof lightning. May paralyze.
translation: 让强大电流覆盖全身，猛撞\n攻击。有时会让对手麻痹。

label: MOVE_BLUE_FLARE.name
source: BLUE FLARE
translation: 青焰

label: MOVE_BLUE_FLARE.description
source: Engulfs the foe in a blue\nflame. May inflict a burn.
translation: 用美丽而激烈的青焰包裹\n住对手。有时会让对手灼伤。

label: MOVE_FIERY_DANCE.name
source: FIERY DANCE
translation: 火之舞

label: MOVE_FIERY_DANCE.description
source: Dances cloaked in flames.\nMay raise Sp. Atk.
translation: 让火焰覆盖全身，振翅攻击。\n有时会提高自己的特攻。

label: MOVE_FREEZE_SHOCK.name
source: FREEZE SHOCK
translation: 冰冻伏特

label: MOVE_FREEZE_SHOCK.description
source: A powerful 2-turn move that\nmay paralyze the foe.
translation: 用覆盖着电流的冰块，在第2\n回合冲撞。有时会让对手麻痹。

label: MOVE_ICE_BURN.name
source: ICE BURN
translation: 极寒冷焰

label: MOVE_ICE_BURN.description
source: A powerful 2-turn move that\nmay inflict a burn.
translation: 用燃烧般强烈的冷气，在第2\n回合释放。有时会让对手灼伤。

label: MOVE_SNARL.name
source: SNARL
translation: 大声咆哮

label: MOVE_SNARL.description
source: Yells and rants at the foe\nlowering its Sp. Atk.
translation: 没完没了地大声斥责，\n从而降低对手的特攻。

label: MOVE_ICICLE_CRASH.name
source: ICICLE CRASH
translation: 冰柱坠击

label: MOVE_ICICLE_CRASH.description
source: Drops large icicles on the\nfoe. May cause flinching.
translation: 用大冰柱激烈地撞向对手。\n有时会使对手畏缩。

label: MOVE_V_CREATE.name
source: V-CREATE
translation: V热焰

label: MOVE_V_CREATE.description
source: Very powerful, but lowers\nDefense, Sp. Def and Speed.
translation: 从前额产生灼热火焰，舍身\n撞击。防御特防速度会降低。

label: MOVE_FUSION_FLARE.name
source: FUSION FLARE
translation: 交错火焰

label: MOVE_FUSION_FLARE.description
source: Summons a fireball. Works\nwell with a thunderbolt.
translation: 释放出巨大火焰。受到巨大\n闪电影响时，招式威力会提高。

label: MOVE_FUSION_BOLT.name
source: FUSION BOLT
translation: 交错闪电

label: MOVE_FUSION_BOLT.description
source: Summons a thunderbolt.\nWorks well with a fireball.
translation: 释放出巨大闪电。受到巨大\n火焰影响时，招式威力会提高。

label: MOVE_FLYING_PRESS.name
source: FLYING PRESS
translation: 飞身重压

label: MOVE_FLYING_PRESS.description
source: This attack does Fighting\nand Flying-type damage.
translation: 从空中俯冲向对手。此招式\n兼具格斗属性和飞行属性。

label: MOVE_MAT_BLOCK.name
source: MAT BLOCK
translation: 掀榻榻米

label: MOVE_MAT_BLOCK.description
source: Evades damaging moves.\nOnly works on 1st turn.
translation: 将掀起来的榻榻米当作盾牌，\n防住己方免受招式伤害。

label: MOVE_BELCH.name
source: BELCH
translation: 打嗝

label: MOVE_BELCH.description
source: Lets out a loud belch.\nMust eat a Berry to use it.
translation: 朝着对手打嗝，并给予伤害。\n如果不吃树果则无法使出。

label: MOVE_ROTOTILLER.name
source: ROTOTILLER
translation: 耕地

label: MOVE_ROTOTILLER.description
source: Ups the Attack and Sp. Atk\nof Grass-type Pokémon.
translation: 翻耕土地使草木更容易成长。\n提高草宝可梦的攻击和特攻。

label: MOVE_STICKY_WEB.name
source: STICKY WEB
translation: 黏黏网

label: MOVE_STICKY_WEB.description
source: Weaves a sticky net that\nslows foes switching in.
translation: 在对手周围围上黏黏的网，\n降低换上的对手的速度。

label: MOVE_FELL_STINGER.name
source: FELL STINGER
translation: 致命针刺

label: MOVE_FELL_STINGER.description
source: If it knocks out a foe\nthe Attack stat is raised.
translation: 如果使用此招式打倒对手，\n攻击会巨幅提高。

label: MOVE_PHANTOM_FORCE.name
source: PHANTOM FORCE
translation: 潜灵奇袭

label: MOVE_TRICK_OR_TREAT.name
source: TRICK-OR-TREAT
translation: 万圣夜

label: MOVE_TRICK_OR_TREAT.description
source: Goes trick-or-treating,\nadding Ghost type to foe.
translation: 邀请对手参加万圣夜。\n使对手被追加幽灵属性。

label: MOVE_NOBLE_ROAR.name
source: NOBLE ROAR
translation: 战吼

label: MOVE_NOBLE_ROAR.description
source: Intimidates the foe, to cut\nAttack and Sp. Atk.
translation: 发出战吼威吓对手，\n从而降低对手的攻击和特攻。

label: MOVE_ION_DELUGE.name
source: ION DELUGE
translation: 等离子浴

label: MOVE_ION_DELUGE.description
source: Electrifies Normal-type\nmoves with charged atoms.
translation: 将带电粒子扩散，使一般\n属性的招式变成电属性。

label: MOVE_PARABOLIC_CHARGE.name
source: PARABOLIC CHARGE
translation: 抛物面充电

label: MOVE_PARABOLIC_CHARGE.description
source: Damages adjacent Pokémon\nand heals up by half of it.
translation: 给周围全体宝可梦造成伤害。\n可以回复给予伤害一半HP。

label: MOVE_FORESTS_CURSE.name
source: FOREST'S CURSE
translation: 森林咒术

label: MOVE_FORESTS_CURSE.description
source: Puts a curse on the foe,\nadding the Grass type.
translation: 向对手施加森林咒术。\n中招的对手会被追加草属性。

label: MOVE_PETAL_BLIZZARD.name
source: PETAL BLIZZARD
translation: 落英缤纷

label: MOVE_PETAL_BLIZZARD.description
source: Stirs up a violent storm\nof petals to attack all.
translation: 猛烈地刮起飞雪般的落花，\n攻击所有的宝可梦并给予伤害。

label: MOVE_FREEZE_DRY.name
source: FREEZE-DRY
translation: 冷冻干燥

label: MOVE_DISARMING_VOICE.name
source: DISARMING VOICE
translation: 魅惑之声

label: MOVE_DISARMING_VOICE.description
source: Lets out a charming cry\nthat cannot be evaded.
translation: 发出魅惑的叫声，给予对手\n精神伤害。攻击必定会命中。

label: MOVE_PARTING_SHOT.name
source: PARTING SHOT
translation: 抛下狠话

label: MOVE_PARTING_SHOT.description
source: Lowers the foe's Attack and\nSp. Atk, then switches out.
translation: 抛下狠话威吓对手，降低\n攻击特攻后，和后备进行替换。

label: MOVE_TOPSY_TURVY.name
source: TOPSY-TURVY
translation: 颠倒

label: MOVE_TOPSY_TURVY.description
source: Swaps all stat changes that\naffect the target.
translation: 颠倒对手的所有能力变化，\n变成和原来相反的状态。

label: MOVE_DRAINING_KISS.name
source: DRAINING KISS
translation: 吸取之吻

label: MOVE_CRAFTY_SHIELD.name
source: CRAFTY SHIELD
translation: 戏法防守

label: MOVE_CRAFTY_SHIELD.description
source: Evades status moves for\none turn.
translation: 用神奇力量防住的变化招式。\n但无法防住伤害招式的攻击。

label: MOVE_FLOWER_SHIELD.name
source: FLOWER SHIELD
translation: 鲜花防守

label: MOVE_FLOWER_SHIELD.description
source: Raises the Defense of\nGrass-type Pokémon.
translation: 使用神奇的力量提高在场的\n所有草属性宝可梦的防御。

label: MOVE_GRASSY_TERRAIN.name
source: GRASSY TERRAIN
translation: 青草场地

label: MOVE_GRASSY_TERRAIN.description
source: The ground turns to grass\nfor 5 turns. Restores HP.
translation: 生成5回合青草场地。地上\n宝可梦缓慢回复HP并强化草。

label: MOVE_MISTY_TERRAIN.name
source: MISTY TERRAIN
translation: 薄雾场地

label: MOVE_MISTY_TERRAIN.description
source: Covers the ground with mist\nfor 5 turns. Blocks status.
translation: 生成5回合薄雾场地。地上\n宝可梦不会异常并强化妖精。

label: MOVE_ELECTRIFY.name
source: ELECTRIFY
translation: 输电

label: MOVE_ELECTRIFY.description
source: Electrifies the foe, making\nits next move Electric-type.
translation: 对手使出招式前，如果输电，\n则该回合该招式变成电属性。

label: MOVE_PLAY_ROUGH.name
source: PLAY ROUGH
translation: 嬉闹

label: MOVE_PLAY_ROUGH.description
source: Plays rough with the foe.\nMay lower Attack.
translation: 与对手嬉闹并攻击。\n有时会降低对手的攻击。

label: MOVE_FAIRY_WIND.name
source: FAIRY WIND
translation: 妖精之风

label: MOVE_FAIRY_WIND.description
source: Stirs up a fairy wind to\nstrike the foe.
translation: 刮起妖精之风，\n吹向对手攻击。

label: MOVE_MOONBLAST.name
source: MOONBLAST
translation: 月亮之力

label: MOVE_MOONBLAST.description
source: Attacks with the power of\nthe moon. May lower Sp. Atk.
translation: 借用月亮的力量攻击对手。\n有时会降低对手的特攻。

label: MOVE_BOOMBURST.name
source: BOOMBURST
translation: 爆音波

label: MOVE_BOOMBURST.description
source: Attacks everything with a\ndestructive sound wave.
translation: 通过震耳欲聋的爆炸声产生\n的破坏力，攻击所有宝可梦。

label: MOVE_FAIRY_LOCK.name
source: FAIRY LOCK
translation: 妖精之锁

label: MOVE_FAIRY_LOCK.description
source: Locks down the battlefield\npreventing escape next turn.
translation: 通过封锁，下一回合\n所有宝可梦都无法逃走。

label: MOVE_KINGS_SHIELD.name
source: KING'S SHIELD
translation: 王者盾牌

label: MOVE_KINGS_SHIELD.description
source: Evades damage, and sharply\nreduces Attack if struck.
translation: 防住攻击同时变为防御姿态。\n能够降低接触对手的攻击。

label: MOVE_PLAY_NICE.name
source: PLAY NICE
translation: 和睦相处

label: MOVE_PLAY_NICE.description
source: Befriend the foe, lowering\nits Attack without fail.
translation: 和对手和睦相处，使其失去\n战意，从而降低对手的攻击。

label: MOVE_CONFIDE.name
source: CONFIDE
translation: 密语

label: MOVE_CONFIDE.description
source: Shares a secret with the\nfoe, lowering Sp. Atk.
translation: 和对手进行密语，使其失去\n专注，从而降低对手的特攻。

label: MOVE_DIAMOND_STORM.name
source: DIAMOND STORM
translation: 钻石风暴

label: MOVE_DIAMOND_STORM.description
source: Whips up a storm of\ndiamonds. May up Defense.
translation: 掀起钻石风暴给予伤害。\n有时大幅提高自己的防御。

label: MOVE_STEAM_ERUPTION.name
source: STEAM ERUPTION
translation: 蒸汽爆炸

label: MOVE_STEAM_ERUPTION.description
source: Immerses the foe in heated\nsteam. May inflict a burn.
translation: 将滚烫的蒸汽喷向对手。\n有时会让对手灼伤。

label: MOVE_HYPERSPACE_HOLE.name
source: HYPERSPACE HOLE
translation: 异次元洞

label: MOVE_WATER_SHURIKEN.name
source: WATER SHURIKEN
translation: 飞水手里剑

label: MOVE_WATER_SHURIKEN.description
