source: Throws 2 to 5 stars that\nare sure to strike first.
translation: 用粘液制成的手里剑，连续\n攻击2~5次。必定先制攻击。

label: MOVE_MYSTICAL_FIRE.name
source: MYSTICAL FIRE
translation: 魔法火焰

label: MOVE_MYSTICAL_FIRE.description
source: Breathes a special, hot\nfire. Lowers Sp. Atk.
translation: 从口中喷出特别灼热的火焰\n攻击。降低对手的特攻。

label: MOVE_SPIKY_SHIELD.name
source: SPIKY SHIELD
translation: 尖刺防守

label: MOVE_SPIKY_SHIELD.description
source: Evades attack, and damages\nthe foe if struck.
translation: 防住对手攻击的同时，\n削减接触到的对手的体力。

label: MOVE_AROMATIC_MIST.name
source: AROMATIC MIST
translation: 芳香薄雾

label: MOVE_AROMATIC_MIST.description
source: Raises the Sp. Def of a\npartner Pokémon.
translation: 通过神奇的芳香，\n提高我方宝可梦的特防。

label: MOVE_EERIE_IMPULSE.name
source: EERIE IMPULSE
translation: 怪异电波

label: MOVE_EERIE_IMPULSE.description
source: Exposes the foe to a pulse\nthat sharply cuts Sp. Atk.
translation: 从身体放射出怪异电波，\n大幅降低对手特攻。

label: MOVE_VENOM_DRENCH.name
source: VENOM DRENCH
translation: 毒液陷阱

label: MOVE_VENOM_DRENCH.description
source: Lowers the Attack, Sp. Atk\nand Speed of poisoned foes.
translation: 将特殊毒液泼向对手。降低\n中毒对手的攻击特攻和速度。

label: MOVE_POWDER.name
source: POWDER
translation: 粉尘

label: MOVE_POWDER.description
source: Damages the foe if it uses\na Fire-type move.
translation: 如果被撒到粉尘的对手使用\n火招式，则会爆炸造成伤害。

label: MOVE_GEOMANCY.name
source: GEOMANCY
translation: 大地掌控

label: MOVE_GEOMANCY.description
source: Raises Sp. Atk, Sp. Def and\nSpeed on the 2nd turn.
translation: 第1回合吸收能量，第2回合\n大幅提高特攻、特防和速度。

label: MOVE_MAGNETIC_FLUX.name
source: MAGNETIC FLUX
translation: 磁场操控

label: MOVE_MAGNETIC_FLUX.description
source: Boosts the defenses of\nthose with Plus or Minus.
translation: 通过操控磁场，会提高特性\n为正负电宝可梦的防御特防。

label: MOVE_HAPPY_HOUR.name
source: HAPPY HOUR
translation: 欢乐时光

label: MOVE_HAPPY_HOUR.description
source: Doubles the amount of\nPrize Money received.
translation: 如果使用欢乐时光，\n战斗后得到的钱会翻倍。

label: MOVE_ELECTRIC_TERRAIN.name
source: ELECTRIC TERRAIN
translation: 电气场地

label: MOVE_ELECTRIC_TERRAIN.description
source: Electrifies the ground for\n5 turns. Prevents sleep.
translation: 生成5回合电气场地。地上\n宝可梦不会睡眠并强化电。

label: MOVE_DAZZLING_GLEAM.name
source: DAZZLING GLEAM
translation: 魔法闪耀

label: MOVE_DAZZLING_GLEAM.description
source: Damages foes by emitting\na bright flash.
translation: 向对手发射强光，\n并给予伤害。

label: MOVE_CELEBRATE.name
source: CELEBRATE
translation: 庆祝

label: MOVE_CELEBRATE.description
source: Congratulates you on your\nspecial day.
translation: 宝可梦为十分开心\n的你庆祝。

label: MOVE_HOLD_HANDS.name
source: HOLD HANDS
translation: 牵手

label: MOVE_HOLD_HANDS.description
source: The user and ally hold hands\nmaking them happy.
translation: 我方宝可梦之间牵手。\n能带来非常幸福的心情。

label: MOVE_BABY_DOLL_EYES.name
source: BABY-DOLL EYES
translation: 圆瞳

label: MOVE_BABY_DOLL_EYES.description
source: Lowers the foe's Attack\nbefore it can move.
translation: 用圆瞳凝视对手，从而降低\n其攻击。必定先制攻击。

label: MOVE_NUZZLE.name
source: NUZZLE
translation: 蹭蹭脸颊

label: MOVE_NUZZLE.description
source: Rubs its cheeks against\nthe foe, paralyzing it.
translation: 将带电的脸颊蹭蹭对手攻击。\n让对手陷入麻痹状态。

label: MOVE_HOLD_BACK.name
source: HOLD BACK
translation: 手下留情

label: MOVE_INFESTATION.name
source: INFESTATION
translation: 纠缠不休

label: MOVE_POWER_UP_PUNCH.name
source: POWER-UP PUNCH
translation: 增强拳

label: MOVE_POWER_UP_PUNCH.description
source: A hard punch that raises\nthe user's Attack.
translation: 通过反复击打对手，使拳头\n变硬。打中后攻击就会提高。

label: MOVE_OBLIVION_WING.name
source: OBLIVION WING
translation: 归天之翼

label: MOVE_THOUSAND_ARROWS.name
source: THOUSAND ARROWS
translation: 千箭齐发

label: MOVE_THOUSAND_ARROWS.description
source: Can hit Flying foes, then\nknocks them to the ground.
translation: 可以击中浮在空中的宝可梦。\n被击落后对手会掉到地面。

label: MOVE_THOUSAND_WAVES.name
source: THOUSAND WAVES
translation: 千波激荡

label: MOVE_THOUSAND_WAVES.description
source: Those hit by the wave can\nno longer escape.
translation: 从地面掀起波浪攻击。\n被掀入的对手，将无法逃走。

label: MOVE_LANDS_WRATH.name
source: LAND'S WRATH
translation: 大地神力

label: MOVE_LANDS_WRATH.description
source: Gathers the energy of the\nland to attack every foe.
translation: 聚集大地的力量，将此力量\n集中攻击对手，并给予伤害。

label: MOVE_LIGHT_OF_RUIN.name
source: LIGHT OF RUIN
translation: 破灭之光

label: MOVE_LIGHT_OF_RUIN.description
source: Fires a great beam of light\nthat also hurts the user.
translation: 借用永恒之花的力量，发射\n强力光线。自己也会受伤害。

label: MOVE_ORIGIN_PULSE.name
source: ORIGIN PULSE
translation: 根源波动

label: MOVE_ORIGIN_PULSE.description
source: Beams of glowing blue light\nblast both foes.
translation: 用无数青白色且闪耀的\n光线攻击对手。

label: MOVE_PRECIPICE_BLADES.name
source: PRECIPICE BLADES
translation: 断崖之剑

label: MOVE_PRECIPICE_BLADES.description
source: Fearsome blades of stone\nattack both foes.
translation: 将大地的力量变化为\n利刃攻击对手。

label: MOVE_DRAGON_ASCENT.name
source: DRAGON ASCENT
translation: 画龙点睛

label: MOVE_HYPERSPACE_FURY.name
source: HYPERSPACE FURY
translation: 异次元猛攻

label: MOVE_SHORE_UP.name
source: SHORE UP
translation: 集沙

label: MOVE_SHORE_UP.description
source: Restores the user's HP.\nMore HP in a sandstorm.
translation: 回复自己最大HP的一半。\n在沙暴中回复得更多。

label: MOVE_FIRST_IMPRESSION.name
source: FIRST IMPRESSION
translation: 迎头一击

label: MOVE_FIRST_IMPRESSION.description
source: Hits hard and first.\nOnly works first turn.
translation: 威力很高的招式，但仅在\n出场时，立刻使出才能成功。

label: MOVE_BANEFUL_BUNKER.name
source: BANEFUL BUNKER
translation: 碉堡

label: MOVE_BANEFUL_BUNKER.description
source: Protects user and poisons\nfoes on contact.
translation: 防住对手攻击的同时，\n让接触到自己的对手中毒。

label: MOVE_SPIRIT_SHACKLE.name
source: SPIRIT SHACKLE
translation: 缝影

label: MOVE_SPIRIT_SHACKLE.description
source: After being hit, foes can\nno longer escape.
translation: 攻击的同时，缝住对手的\n影子，使其无法逃走。

label: MOVE_DARKEST_LARIAT.name
source: DARKEST LARIAT
translation: DD金勾臂

label: MOVE_DARKEST_LARIAT.description
source: Swings the arms to strike\nIt ignores stat changes.
translation: 旋转双臂打向对手。无视\n能力变化，直接给予伤害。

label: MOVE_SPARKLING_ARIA.name
source: SPARKLING ARIA
translation: 泡影的咏叹调

label: MOVE_SPARKLING_ARIA.description
source: Sings with bubbles. Cures\nburns on contact.
translation: 随着唱歌会放出很多气球。\n受此招式攻击时会治愈灼伤。

label: MOVE_ICE_HAMMER.name
source: ICE HAMMER
translation: 冰锤

label: MOVE_ICE_HAMMER.description
source: Swings the fist to strike.\nLowers the user's Speed.
translation: 挥舞强力而沉重的拳头，\n造成伤害。自己速度会降低。

label: MOVE_FLORAL_HEALING.name
source: FLORAL HEALING
translation: 花疗

label: MOVE_FLORAL_HEALING.description
source: Restores an ally's HP.\nHeals more on grass.
translation: 回复对手最大HP的一半。在\n青草场地时，效果会提高。

label: MOVE_HIGH_HORSEPOWER.name
source: HIGH HORSEPOWER
translation: 十万马力

label: MOVE_HIGH_HORSEPOWER.description
source: Slams hard into the foe with\nits entire body.
translation: 使出全身力量，\n猛攻对手。

label: MOVE_STRENGTH_SAP.name
source: STRENGTH SAP
translation: 吸取力量

label: MOVE_STRENGTH_SAP.description
source: Saps the foe's Attack to\nheal HP, then drops Attack.
translation: 回复和对手攻击力同数值\nHP，然后降低对手攻击。

label: MOVE_SOLAR_BLADE.name
source: SOLAR BLADE
translation: 日光刃

label: MOVE_SOLAR_BLADE.description
source: Charges first turn, then\nchops with a blade of light.
translation: 第1回合收集日光，\n第2回合将力量集中在剑上攻击。

label: MOVE_LEAFAGE.name
source: LEAFAGE
translation: 树叶

label: MOVE_LEAFAGE.description
source: Attacks with a flurry of\nsmall leaves.
translation: 将叶片打向对手攻击。

label: MOVE_SPOTLIGHT.name
source: SPOTLIGHT
translation: 聚光灯

label: MOVE_SPOTLIGHT.description
source: Makes the foe attack the\nspotlighted Pokémon.
translation: 给宝可梦打上聚光灯，\n该回合只能瞄准该宝可梦。

label: MOVE_TOXIC_THREAD.name
source: TOXIC THREAD
translation: 毒丝

label: MOVE_TOXIC_THREAD.description
source: Attacks with a thread that\npoisons and drops Speed.
translation: 将混有毒的丝吐向对手。\n使其中毒并降低对手的速度。

label: MOVE_LASER_FOCUS.name
source: LASER FOCUS
translation: 磨砺

label: MOVE_LASER_FOCUS.description
source: Guarantees the next move\nwill be a critical hit.
translation: 集中精神，\n下次攻击必定会击中要害。

label: MOVE_GEAR_UP.name
source: GEAR UP
translation: 辅助齿轮

label: MOVE_GEAR_UP.description
source: Boosts the attacks of\nthose with Plus or Minus.
translation: 启动齿轮，提高特性正负电\n宝可梦的攻击和特攻。

label: MOVE_THROAT_CHOP.name
source: THROAT CHOP
translation: 深渊突刺

label: MOVE_THROAT_CHOP.description
source: Chops the throat to disable\nsound moves for 2 turns.
translation: 受击对手会因地狱般的痛苦，\n2回合内无法使出声音招式。

label: MOVE_POLLEN_PUFF.name
source: POLLEN PUFF
translation: 花粉团

label: MOVE_POLLEN_PUFF.description
source: Explodes on foes, but\nrestores ally's HP.
translation: 对敌人使用是会爆炸的团子。\n对我方使用是给予回复团子。

label: MOVE_ANCHOR_SHOT.name
source: ANCHOR SHOT
translation: 掷锚

label: MOVE_ANCHOR_SHOT.description
source: Strangles the foe with a\nchain. The foe can't escape.
translation: 将锚缠住对手攻击。\n使对手无法逃走。

label: MOVE_PSYCHIC_TERRAIN.name
source: PSYCHIC TERRAIN
translation: 精神场地

label: MOVE_PSYCHIC_TERRAIN.description
source: The ground turns weird for\n5 turns. Blocks priority.
translation: 生成5回合精神场地。地上\n宝可梦免疫先制并强化超能。

label: MOVE_LUNGE.name
source: LUNGE
translation: 猛扑

label: MOVE_LUNGE.description
source: Lunges at the foe to lower\nits Attack stat.
translation: 全力猛扑对手攻击。\n从而降低对手的攻击。

label: MOVE_FIRE_LASH.name
source: FIRE LASH
translation: 火焰鞭

label: MOVE_FIRE_LASH.description
source: Whips the foe with fire\nlowering its Defense.
translation: 用燃烧的鞭子抽打对手。\n受到攻击的对手防御会降低。

label: MOVE_POWER_TRIP.name
source: POWER TRIP
translation: 嚣张

label: MOVE_POWER_TRIP.description
source: It hits harder the more\nstat boosts the user has.
translation: 耀武扬威地攻击对手，\n能力提高得越多威力就越大。

label: MOVE_BURN_UP.name
source: BURN UP
translation: 燃尽

label: MOVE_BURN_UP.description
source: Burns out the user fully\nremoving the Fire type.
translation: 将自己全身燃烧起火焰来\n攻击。自身火属性会消失。

label: MOVE_SPEED_SWAP.name
source: SPEED SWAP
translation: 速度互换

label: MOVE_SPEED_SWAP.description
source: Swaps user's Speed with\nthe target's.
translation: 将对手和自己的速度\n进行互换。

label: MOVE_SMART_STRIKE.name
source: SMART STRIKE
translation: 修长之角

label: MOVE_SMART_STRIKE.description
source: Hits with an accurate\nhorn that never misses.
translation: 用尖尖的角刺入对手攻击。\n攻击必定会命中。

label: MOVE_PURIFY.name
source: PURIFY
translation: 净化

label: MOVE_PURIFY.description
source: Cures the foe's status\nto restore HP.
translation: 治愈对手的异常状态。\n治愈后可以回复自己的HP。

label: MOVE_REVELATION_DANCE.name
source: REVELATION DANCE
translation: 觉醒之舞

label: MOVE_REVELATION_DANCE.description
source: Dances with mystical power.\nMatches user's first type.
translation: 全力跳舞攻击。\n属性将变得和自身属性相同。

label: MOVE_CORE_ENFORCER.name
source: CORE ENFORCER
translation: 核心惩罚者

label: MOVE_CORE_ENFORCER.description
source: Hits with a ray that\nnullifies the foe's Ability.
translation: 如果给予过伤害的对手已经\n结束行动，其特性会被消除。

label: MOVE_TROP_KICK.name
source: TROP KICK
translation: 热带踢

label: MOVE_TROP_KICK.description
source: An intense kick from the\ntropics. Lowers Attack.
translation: 向对手使出来自南国的火热\n脚踢。从而降低对手的攻击。

label: MOVE_INSTRUCT.name
source: INSTRUCT
translation: 号令

label: MOVE_INSTRUCT.description
source: Orders the target to use\nits last move again.
translation: 向对手下达指示，\n让其再次使出刚才的招式。

label: MOVE_BEAK_BLAST.name
source: BEAK BLAST
translation: 鸟嘴加农炮

label: MOVE_BEAK_BLAST.description
source: Heats beak to attack last.\nBurns foe on contact.
translation: 先加热鸟嘴后再攻击。鸟嘴\n在加热时对手触碰会灼伤。

label: MOVE_CLANGING_SCALES.name
source: CLANGING SCALES
translation: 鳞片噪音

label: MOVE_CLANGING_SCALES.description
source: Makes a big noise with\nits scales. Drops Defense.
translation: 摩擦全身鳞片发出响亮声音\n攻击。之后自身防御会降低。

label: MOVE_DRAGON_HAMMER.name
source: DRAGON HAMMER
translation: 龙锤

label: MOVE_DRAGON_HAMMER.description
source: Swings its whole body\nlike a hammer to damage.
translation: 将身体当作锤子，向对手\n发动袭击，给予伤害。

label: MOVE_BRUTAL_SWING.name
source: BRUTAL SWING
translation: 狂舞挥打

label: MOVE_BRUTAL_SWING.description
source: Violently swings around\nto hurt everyone nearby.
translation: 用自己的身体狂舞挥打，\n给予对手伤害。

label: MOVE_SHELL_TRAP.name
source: SHELL TRAP
translation: 陷阱甲壳

label: MOVE_SHELL_TRAP.description
source: Sets a shell trap that\ndamages on contact.
translation: 设下甲壳陷阱。若对手使出\n物理招式，陷阱就会爆炸攻击。

label: MOVE_FLEUR_CANNON.name
source: FLEUR CANNON
translation: 花朵加农炮

label: MOVE_FLEUR_CANNON.description
source: A strong ray that harshly\nlowers Sp. Attack.
translation: 放出强力光束后，\n自己的特攻会大幅降低。

label: MOVE_PSYCHIC_FANGS.name
source: PSYCHIC FANGS
translation: 精神之牙

label: MOVE_PSYCHIC_FANGS.description
source: Chomps with psychic fangs.\nDestroys any barriers.
translation: 利用精神力量咬住对手攻击。\n还可以破坏光墙和反射壁等。

label: MOVE_STOMPING_TANTRUM.name
source: STOMPING TANTRUM
translation: 跺脚

label: MOVE_STOMPING_TANTRUM.description
source: Stomps around angrily.\nStronger after a failure.
translation: 化悔恨为力量攻击。若上回\n合招式没打中威力就会翻倍。

label: MOVE_SHADOW_BONE.name
source: SHADOW BONE
translation: 暗影之骨

label: MOVE_SHADOW_BONE.description
source: Strikes with a haunted\nbone. Might drop Defense.
translation: 用附有灵魂骨头殴打对手。\n有时会降低对手的防御。

label: MOVE_ACCELEROCK.name
source: ACCELEROCK
translation: 冲岩

label: MOVE_ACCELEROCK.description
source: Hits with a high-speed\nrock that always goes first.
translation: 迅速撞向对手攻击。\n必定能够先制攻击。

label: MOVE_LIQUIDATION.name
source: LIQUIDATION
translation: 水流裂破

label: MOVE_LIQUIDATION.description
source: Slams the foe with water.\nCan lower Defense.
translation: 用水之力量撞向对手攻击。\n有时会降低对手的防御。

label: MOVE_PRISMATIC_LASER.name
source: PRISMATIC LASER
translation: 棱镜镭射

label: MOVE_PRISMATIC_LASER.description
source: A high power laser that\nforces recharge next turn.
translation: 用棱镜的力量发射强烈光线。\n下一回合自己将无法动弹。

label: MOVE_SPECTRAL_THIEF.name
source: SPECTRAL THIEF
translation: 暗影偷盗

label: MOVE_SPECTRAL_THIEF.description
source: Steals the target's stat\nboosts, then attacks.
translation: 潜入对手的影子攻击。\n会夺取对手的能力提升。

label: MOVE_SUNSTEEL_STRIKE.name
source: SUNSTEEL STRIKE
translation: 流星闪冲

label: MOVE_SUNSTEEL_STRIKE.description
source: A sun-fueled strike that\nignores abilities.
translation: 以流星般的气势猛撞对手。\n可以无视对手的特性攻击。

label: MOVE_MOONGEIST_BEAM.name
source: MOONGEIST BEAM
translation: 暗影之光

label: MOVE_MOONGEIST_BEAM.description
source: A moon-powered beam that\nignores abilities.
translation: 放出奇怪的光线攻击对手。\n可以无视对手的特性攻击。

label: MOVE_TEARFUL_LOOK.name
source: TEARFUL LOOK
translation: 泪眼汪汪

label: MOVE_TEARFUL_LOOK.description
source: The user tears up, dropping\nAttack and Sp. Attack.
translation: 变得泪眼汪汪，让对手丧失\n斗志。降低对手的攻击特攻。

label: MOVE_ZING_ZAP.name
source: ZING ZAP
translation: 麻麻刺刺

label: MOVE_ZING_ZAP.description
source: An electrified impact that\ncan cause flinching.
translation: 撞向对手并发出强电，使其\n麻麻刺刺。有时造成畏缩。

label: MOVE_NATURES_MADNESS.name
source: NATURE'S MADNESS
translation: 自然之怒

label: MOVE_NATURES_MADNESS.description
source: Halves the foe's HP with\nthe power of nature.
translation: 向对手释放自然之怒。\n对手的HP会减半。

label: MOVE_MULTI_ATTACK.name
source: MULTI-ATTACK
translation: 多属性攻击

label: MOVE_MULTI_ATTACK.description
source: Attack that changes\nwith Memories.
translation: 覆盖高能量并撞向对手攻击。\n属性会根据携带存储碟改变。

label: MOVE_MIND_BLOWN.name
source: MIND BLOWN
translation: 惊爆大头

label: MOVE_MIND_BLOWN.description
source: It explodes the user's head\nto damage everything around.
translation: 让自己的头爆炸，来攻击\n一切。自己也会受到伤害。

label: MOVE_PLASMA_FISTS.name
source: PLASMA FISTS
translation: 等离子闪电拳

label: MOVE_PLASMA_FISTS.description
source: Hits with electrical fists.\nNormal moves turn Electric.
translation: 用覆盖着电流拳头攻击。使\n一般属性招式变成电属性。

label: MOVE_PHOTON_GEYSER.name
source: PHOTON GEYSER
translation: 光子喷涌

label: MOVE_PHOTON_GEYSER.description
source: User's highest attack stat\ndetermines its category.
translation: 用光柱来攻击。用物攻特攻\n数值更高的一项造成伤害。

label: MOVE_ZIPPY_ZAP.name
source: ZIPPY ZAP
translation: 电电加速

label: MOVE_ZIPPY_ZAP.description
source: Electric bursts always go\nfirst and land a critical hit.
translation: 迅猛无比的电击。必定能够\n先制攻击并击中要害。

label: MOVE_SPLISHY_SPLASH.name
source: SPLISHY SPLASH
translation: 滔滔冲浪

label: MOVE_SPLISHY_SPLASH.description
source: A huge electrified wave that\nmay paralyze the foes.
translation: 往巨浪中注入电能后冲撞。\n有时会让对手陷入麻痹状态。

label: MOVE_FLOATY_FALL.name
source: FLOATY FALL
translation: 飘飘坠落

label: MOVE_FLOATY_FALL.description
source: Floats in air and dives at\nangle. May cause flinching.
translation: 轻飘飘地浮起来后猛地俯冲\n攻击。有时会使对手畏缩。

label: MOVE_PIKA_PAPOW.name
source: PIKA PAPOW
translation: 闪闪雷光

label: MOVE_PIKA_PAPOW.description
source: Pikachu's love increases its\npower. It never misses.
translation: 皮卡丘越喜欢训练家，电击\n威力越强。攻击必定会命中。

label: MOVE_BOUNCY_BUBBLE.name
source: BOUNCY BUBBLE
translation: 活活气泡

label: MOVE_BUZZY_BUZZ.name
source: BUZZY BUZZ
translation: 麻麻电击

label: MOVE_BUZZY_BUZZ.description
source: Shoots a jolt of electricity\nthat always paralyzes.
translation: 放出电击攻击对手。\n让对手陷入麻痹状态。

label: MOVE_SIZZLY_SLIDE.name
source: SIZZLY SLIDE
translation: 熊熊火爆

label: MOVE_SIZZLY_SLIDE.description
source: User cloaked in fire charges.\nLeaves the foe with a burn.
translation: 用燃烧的身体猛烈地冲撞。\n让对手陷入灼伤状态。

label: MOVE_GLITZY_GLOW.name
source: GLITZY GLOW
translation: 哗哗气场

label: MOVE_GLITZY_GLOW.description
source: Telekinetic force that sets\nwall, lowering Sp. Atk damage.
translation: 利用念力强攻粉碎对方信心。\n制造能减弱特殊攻击的墙壁。

label: MOVE_BADDY_BAD.name
source: BADDY BAD
translation: 坏坏领域

label: MOVE_BADDY_BAD.description
source: Acting badly, attacks. Sets\nwall, lowering Attack damage.
translation: 恶行恶相地进行攻击。\n制造能减弱物理攻击的墙壁。

label: MOVE_SAPPY_SEED.name
source: SAPPY SEED
translation: 茁茁炸弹

label: MOVE_SAPPY_SEED.description
source: Giant stalk scatters seeds\nthat drain HP every turn.
translation: 长出巨大藤蔓播撒种子攻击。\n种子会每回合吸取对手HP。

label: MOVE_FREEZY_FROST.name
source: FREEZY FROST
translation: 冰冰霜冻

label: MOVE_FREEZY_FROST.description
source: Crystal from cold haze hits.\nEliminates all stat changes.
translation: 利用冰冷的黑雾结晶攻击。\n使全体宝可梦能力变回原点。

label: MOVE_SPARKLY_SWIRL.name
source: SPARKLY SWIRL
translation: 亮亮风暴

label: MOVE_SPARKLY_SWIRL.description
source: Wrap foe with whirlwind of\nscent. Heals party's status.
translation: 利用芬芳的龙卷风吞噬对方。\n能治愈我方宝可梦异常状态。

label: MOVE_VEEVEE_VOLLEY.name
source: VEEVEE VOLLEY
translation: 砰砰击破

label: MOVE_VEEVEE_VOLLEY.description
source: Eevee's love increases its\npower. It never misses.
translation: 伊布越喜欢训练家，冲撞的\n威力越强。攻击必定会命中。

label: MOVE_DOUBLE_IRON_BASH.name
source: DOUBLE IRON BASH
translation: 钢拳双击

label: MOVE_DOUBLE_IRON_BASH.description
source: The user spins and hits with\nits arms. May cause flinch.
translation: 以胸口的螺帽为中心旋转，\n连续2次攻击。有时造成畏缩。

label: MOVE_DYNAMAX_CANNON.name
source: DYNAMAX CANNON
translation: 极巨炮

label: MOVE_DYNAMAX_CANNON.description
source: Unleashes core energy.\n2x against Dynamaxed foes.
translation: 将凝缩在体内的能量从\n核心放出攻击。

label: MOVE_SNIPE_SHOT.name
source: SNIPE SHOT
translation: 狙击

label: MOVE_SNIPE_SHOT.description
source: The user ignores effects\nthat draw in moves.
translation: 无视吸引类特性及招式影响。\n可以向选定的对手攻击。

label: MOVE_JAW_LOCK.name
source: JAW LOCK
translation: 紧咬不放

label: MOVE_JAW_LOCK.description
source: Prevents the user and\nthe target from escaping.
translation: 直到双方之一昏厥为止无法\n替换。其中一方退场后解除。

label: MOVE_STUFF_CHEEKS.name
source: STUFF CHEEKS
translation: 大快朵颐

label: MOVE_STUFF_CHEEKS.description
source: Consumes the user's Berry,\nthen sharply raises Def.
translation: 吃掉携带的树果，\n大幅提高防御。

label: MOVE_NO_RETREAT.name
source: NO RETREAT
translation: 背水一战

label: MOVE_NO_RETREAT.description
source: Raises all of the user's\nstats but prevents escape.
translation: 提高自己的所有能力，\n但无法替换或逃走。

label: MOVE_TAR_SHOT.name
source: TAR SHOT
translation: 沥青射击

label: MOVE_TAR_SHOT.description
source: Lowers the foe's Speed and\nmakes it weak to Fire.
translation: 泼洒黏糊糊沥青，降低对手\n速度。火属性会变成弱点。

label: MOVE_MAGIC_POWDER.name
source: MAGIC POWDER
translation: 魔法粉

label: MOVE_MAGIC_POWDER.description
source: Magic powder changes the\ntarget into a Psychic type.
translation: 向对手喷洒魔法粉，\n使对手变为超能力属性。

label: MOVE_DRAGON_DARTS.name
source: DRAGON DARTS
translation: 龙箭

label: MOVE_DRAGON_DARTS.description
source: The user attacks twice. Two\ntargets are hit once each.
translation: 让多龙梅西亚进行2次攻击。\n若对手有2只则会分别攻击。

label: MOVE_TEATIME.name
source: TEATIME
translation: 茶会

label: MOVE_TEATIME.description
source: All Pokémon have teatime\nand eat their Berries.
translation: 举办一场茶会，场上的所有\n宝可梦都会吃掉携带的树果。

label: MOVE_OCTOLOCK.name
source: OCTOLOCK
translation: 蛸固

label: MOVE_OCTOLOCK.description
source: Traps the foe to lower Def\nand Sp. Def each turn.
translation: 让对手无法逃走。对手被固定\n后，每回合会降低防御特防。

label: MOVE_BOLT_BEAK.name
source: BOLT BEAK
translation: 电喙

label: MOVE_BOLT_BEAK.description
source: Double power if the user\nmoves before the target.
translation: 用带电的喙啄刺对手。如果\n先手攻击，威力会变成2倍。

label: MOVE_FISHIOUS_REND.name
source: FISHIOUS REND
translation: 鳃咬

label: MOVE_FISHIOUS_REND.description
source: Double power if the user\nmoves before the target.
translation: 用坚硬的腮咬住对手。如果\n先手攻击，威力会变成2倍。

label: MOVE_COURT_CHANGE.name
source: COURT CHANGE
translation: 换场

label: MOVE_COURT_CHANGE.description
source: The user swaps effects on\neither side of the field.
translation: 用神奇的力量交换双方\n的场地效果。

label: MOVE_CLANGOROUS_SOUL.name
source: CLANGOROUS SOUL
translation: 魂舞烈音爆

label: MOVE_CLANGOROUS_SOUL.description
source: The user uses some of its\nHP to raise all its stats.
translation: 削减少许自己的HP，\n使所有能力都提高。

label: MOVE_BODY_PRESS.name
source: BODY PRESS
translation: 扑击

label: MOVE_BODY_PRESS.description
source: Does more damage the\nhigher the user's Def.
translation: 用身体撞向对手攻击。防御\n越高，给予的伤害就越高。

label: MOVE_DECORATE.name
source: DECORATE
translation: 装饰

label: MOVE_DECORATE.description
source: The user sharply raises\nthe target's Atk and Sp.Atk.
translation: 通过装饰，\n大幅提高对方的攻击和特攻。

label: MOVE_DRUM_BEATING.name
source: DRUM BEATING
translation: 鼓击

label: MOVE_DRUM_BEATING.description
source: Plays a drum to attack.\nThe foe's Speed is lowered.
translation: 用鼓点来控制鼓的根部攻击，\n从而降低对手的速度。

label: MOVE_SNAP_TRAP.name
source: SNAP TRAP
translation: 捕兽夹

label: MOVE_SNAP_TRAP.description
source: Snares the target in a snap\ntrap for four to five turns.
translation: 使用捕兽夹，在4~5回合内，\n夹住对手攻击。

label: MOVE_PYRO_BALL.name
source: PYRO BALL
translation: 火焰球

label: MOVE_PYRO_BALL.description
source: Launches a fiery ball at the\ntarget. It may cause a burn.
translation: 点燃石子形成火球攻击对手。\n有时会使对手陷入灼伤状态。

label: MOVE_BEHEMOTH_BLADE.name
source: BEHEMOTH BLADE
translation: 巨兽斩

label: MOVE_BEHEMOTH_BLADE.description
source: Strikes as a sword. Deals 2x\ndamage to Dynamaxed foes.
translation: 以全身力气举起强大的剑，\n猛烈地劈向对手攻击。

label: MOVE_BEHEMOTH_BASH.name
source: BEHEMOTH BASH
translation: 巨兽弹

label: MOVE_BEHEMOTH_BASH.description
source: Attacks as a shield. Deals 2x\ndamage to Dynamaxed foes.
translation: 将全身变化为坚固的盾，\n猛烈地撞向对手攻击。

label: MOVE_AURA_WHEEL.name
source: AURA WHEEL
translation: 气场轮

label: MOVE_AURA_WHEEL.description
source: Raises Speed to attack. The\nType is based on its form.
translation: 用储存在颊囊里的能量攻击，\n提升速度。属性随样子改变。

label: MOVE_BREAKING_SWIPE.name
source: BREAKING SWIPE
translation: 广域破坏

label: MOVE_BREAKING_SWIPE.description
source: Swings its tail to attack.\nLowers the Atk of those hit.
translation: 用坚韧的尾巴猛扫对手攻击，\n从而降低对手的攻击。

label: MOVE_BRANCH_POKE.name
source: BRANCH POKE
translation: 木枝突刺

label: MOVE_BRANCH_POKE.description
source: The user pokes the target\nwith a pointed branch.
translation: 使用尖锐的树枝刺向\n对手攻击。

label: MOVE_OVERDRIVE.name
source: OVERDRIVE
translation: 破音

label: MOVE_OVERDRIVE.description
source: The user twangs its guitar,\ncausing strong vibrations.
translation: 奏响吉他和贝斯，释放出\n发出巨响的剧烈震动攻击。

label: MOVE_APPLE_ACID.name
source: APPLE ACID
translation: 苹果酸

label: MOVE_APPLE_ACID.description
source: Attacks with tart apple acid\nto lower the foe's Sp. Def.
translation: 使用从酸苹果中提取出来的\n液体攻击。降低对手的特防。

label: MOVE_GRAV_APPLE.name
source: GRAV APPLE
translation: 万有引力

label: MOVE_GRAV_APPLE.description
source: Drops an apple from above.\nLowers the foe's Defense.
translation: 从高处落下苹果，给予对手\n伤害。可降低对手的防御。

label: MOVE_SPIRIT_BREAK.name
source: SPIRIT BREAK
translation: 灵魂冲击

label: MOVE_SPIRIT_BREAK.description
source: Attacks with spirit-breaking\nforce. Lowers Sp. Atk.
translation: 用能让对手一蹶不振的气势\n攻击。会降低对手的特攻。

label: MOVE_STRANGE_STEAM.name
source: STRANGE STEAM
translation: 神奇蒸汽

label: MOVE_STRANGE_STEAM.description
source: Emits a strange steam to\npotentially confuse the foe.
translation: 喷出烟雾攻击对手。\n有时会使对手混乱。

label: MOVE_LIFE_DEW.name
source: LIFE DEW
translation: 生命水滴

label: MOVE_LIFE_DEW.description
source: Scatters water to restore\nthe HP of itself and allies.
translation: 喷洒出神奇的水，\n回复自己和场上同伴的HP。

label: MOVE_OBSTRUCT.name
source: OBSTRUCT
translation: 拦堵

label: MOVE_OBSTRUCT.description
source: Protects itself, harshly\nlowering Def on contact.
translation: 完全抵挡攻击。连续用容易\n失败。触碰会大幅降低防御。

label: MOVE_FALSE_SURRENDER.name
source: FALSE SURRENDER
translation: 假跪真撞

label: MOVE_FALSE_SURRENDER.description
source: Bows to stab the foe\nwith hair. It never misses.
translation: 装作低头认错的样子用凌乱\n的头发突刺。攻击必定命中。

label: MOVE_METEOR_ASSAULT.name
source: METEOR ASSAULT
translation: 流星突击

label: MOVE_METEOR_ASSAULT.description
source: Attacks with a thick leek.\nThe user must then rest.
translation: 大力挥舞粗壮的茎攻击。\n但下一回合自己将无法动弹。

label: MOVE_ETERNABEAM.name
source: ETERNABEAM
translation: 无极光束

label: MOVE_ETERNABEAM.description
source: Eternatus' strongest move.\nThe user rests next turn.
translation: 无极汰那变回原来样子攻击，\n下一回合自己将无法动弹。

label: MOVE_STEEL_BEAM.name
source: STEEL BEAM
translation: 铁蹄光线

label: MOVE_STEEL_BEAM.description
source: Fires a beam of steel from\nits body. It hurts the user.
translation: 将从全身聚集钢铁化为光束，\n激烈地发射。自己也会受伤。

label: MOVE_EXPANDING_FORCE.name
source: EXPANDING FORCE
translation: 广域战力

label: MOVE_EXPANDING_FORCE.description
source: Power goes up and damages\nall foes on Psychic Terrain.
translation: 用精神力量攻击。精神场地\n上威力提升且目标变为全体。

label: MOVE_STEEL_ROLLER.name
source: STEEL ROLLER
translation: 铁滚轮

label: MOVE_STEEL_ROLLER.description
source: Destroys terrain. Fails if\nground isn't terrain.
translation: 在破坏场地的同时攻击对手。\n脚下没有任何场地便会失败。

label: MOVE_SCALE_SHOT.name
source: SCALE SHOT
translation: 鳞射

label: MOVE_SCALE_SHOT.description
source: Shoots scales 2 to 5 times.\nUps Speed, lowers defense.
translation: 发射鳞片攻击。连续攻击2~\n5次。提高速度但降低防御。

label: MOVE_METEOR_BEAM.name
source: METEOR BEAM
translation: 流星光束

label: MOVE_METEOR_BEAM.description
source: A 2-turn move that raises\nSp. Attack before attacking.
translation: 第1回合聚集宇宙之力提高\n特攻，第2回合攻击对手。

label: MOVE_SHELL_SIDE_ARM.name
source: SHELL SIDE ARM
translation: 臂贝武器

label: MOVE_SHELL_SIDE_ARM.description
source: Deals better of physical and\nspecial damage. May poison.
translation: 用物攻特攻数值更高的一项\n攻击。有时会让对手中毒。

label: MOVE_MISTY_EXPLOSION.name
source: MISTY EXPLOSION
translation: 薄雾炸裂

label: MOVE_MISTY_EXPLOSION.description
source: Hit everything and faint.\nPowers up on Misty Terrain.
translation: 对所有宝可梦攻击后昏厥。\n在薄雾场地上威力会提高。

label: MOVE_GRASSY_GLIDE.name
source: GRASSY GLIDE
translation: 青草滑梯

label: MOVE_GRASSY_GLIDE.description
source: Gliding on ground, hits. Goes\nfirst on Grassy Terrain.
translation: 仿佛在地面上滑行般地攻击。在\n青草场地上必定能够先制。

label: MOVE_RISING_VOLTAGE.name
source: RISING VOLTAGE
translation: 电力上升

label: MOVE_RISING_VOLTAGE.description
source: This move's power doubles\nwhen on Electric Terrain.
translation: 从地面升起电击攻击。对手\n在电气场地上威力变成2倍。

label: MOVE_TERRAIN_PULSE.name
source: TERRAIN PULSE
translation: 大地波动

label: MOVE_TERRAIN_PULSE.description
source: Type and power changes\ndepending on the terrain.
translation: 借助场地的力量攻击。\n视场地改变属性和威力。

label: MOVE_SKITTER_SMACK.name
source: SKITTER SMACK
translation: 爬击

label: MOVE_SKITTER_SMACK.description
source: User skitters behind foe to\nattack. Lowers foe's Sp. Atk.
translation: 从对手背后爬近后攻击。\n会降低对手的特攻。

label: MOVE_BURNING_JEALOUSY.name
source: BURNING JEALOUSY
translation: 妒火

label: MOVE_BURNING_JEALOUSY.description
source: Foes that have stats upped\nduring the turn get burned.
translation: 用嫉妒能量攻击对手。回合\n内能力提高的宝可梦会灼伤。

label: MOVE_LASH_OUT.name
source: LASH OUT
translation: 泄愤

label: MOVE_LASH_OUT.description
source: If user's stats were lowered\nthis turn, power is doubled.
translation: 发泄恼怒情绪。若回合自身\n内能力降低，威力变成2倍。

label: MOVE_POLTERGEIST.name
source: POLTERGEIST
translation: 灵骚

label: MOVE_POLTERGEIST.description
source: Control foe's item to attack.\nFails if foe has no item.
translation: 操纵对手持有物攻击。\n当对手没有道具时会失败。

label: MOVE_CORROSIVE_GAS.name
source: CORROSIVE GAS
translation: 腐蚀气体

label: MOVE_CORROSIVE_GAS.description
source: Highly acidic gas melts items\nheld by surrounding Pokémon.
translation: 用强酸性气体包裹所有宝可\n梦，并融化其所携带的道具。

label: MOVE_COACHING.name
source: COACHING
translation: 指导

label: MOVE_COACHING.description
source: Properly coaches allies to\nup their Attack and Defense.
translation: 通过进行正确合理的指导，\n提高我方全员的攻击和防御。

label: MOVE_FLIP_TURN.name
source: FLIP TURN
translation: 快速折返

label: MOVE_FLIP_TURN.description
source: Attacks and rushes back to\nswitch with a party Pokémon.
translation: 在攻击之后急速返回，\n和后备宝可梦进行替换。

label: MOVE_TRIPLE_AXEL.name
source: TRIPLE AXEL
translation: 三旋击

label: MOVE_TRIPLE_AXEL.description
source: A 3-kick attack that gets\nmore powerful with each hit.
translation: 连续3次踢对手攻击。每\n踢中一次，威力就会提高。

label: MOVE_DUAL_WINGBEAT.name
source: DUAL WINGBEAT
translation: 双翼

label: MOVE_DUAL_WINGBEAT.description
source: User slams the target with\nwings and hits twice in a row.
translation: 将翅膀撞向对手攻击。\n连续2次给予伤害。

label: MOVE_SCORCHING_SANDS.name
source: SCORCHING SANDS
translation: 热沙大地

label: MOVE_SCORCHING_SANDS.description
source: Throws scorching sand at\nthe target. May leave a burn.
translation: 将滚烫的沙子砸向对手攻击。\n有时会让对手陷入灼伤状态。

label: MOVE_JUNGLE_HEALING.name
source: JUNGLE HEALING
translation: 丛林治疗

label: MOVE_JUNGLE_HEALING.description
source: Heals HP and status of\nitself and allies in battle.
translation: 与丛林融为一体，回复自己\n和场上同伴的HP和状态。

label: MOVE_WICKED_BLOW.name
source: WICKED BLOW
translation: 暗冥强击

label: MOVE_WICKED_BLOW.description
source: Mastering the Dark style,\nstrikes with a critical hit.
translation: 将恶之流派修炼至大成的\n猛烈一击。必定击中要害。

label: MOVE_SURGING_STRIKES.name
source: SURGING STRIKES
translation: 水流连打

label: MOVE_SURGING_STRIKES.description
source: Mastering the Water style,\nstrikes with 3 critical hits.
translation: 将水之流派修炼至大成的\n的3次连击。必定击中要害。

label: MOVE_THUNDER_CAGE.name
source: THUNDER CAGE
translation: 雷电囚笼

label: MOVE_DRAGON_ENERGY.name
source: DRAGON ENERGY
translation: 巨龙威能

label: MOVE_DRAGON_ENERGY.description
source: The higher the user's HP\nthe more damage caused.
translation: 把生命力转换为力量攻击。\n自身HP越少招式威力越小。

label: MOVE_FREEZING_GLARE.name
source: FREEZING GLARE
translation: 冰冷视线

label: MOVE_FIERY_WRATH.name
source: FIERY WRATH
translation: 怒火中烧

label: MOVE_FIERY_WRATH.description
source: Attack fueled by your\nwrath. May cause flinching.
translation: 将愤怒转化为火焰般的气场\n攻击。有时会使对手畏缩。

label: MOVE_THUNDEROUS_KICK.name
source: THUNDEROUS KICK
translation: 雷鸣蹴击

label: MOVE_THUNDEROUS_KICK.description
source: Uses a lightning-like kick\nto hit. Lowers foe's Defense.
translation: 以雷电般的动作戏耍对手并\n使出脚踢。可降低对手防御。

label: MOVE_GLACIAL_LANCE.name
source: GLACIAL LANCE
translation: 雪矛

label: MOVE_GLACIAL_LANCE.description
source: Hurls a blizzard-cloaked\nicicle lance at foes.
translation: 向对手投掷掀起暴风雪\n的冰矛攻击。

label: MOVE_ASTRAL_BARRAGE.name
source: ASTRAL BARRAGE
translation: 星碎

label: MOVE_ASTRAL_BARRAGE.description
source: Sends a frightful amount\nof small ghosts at foes.
translation: 用大量的小灵体向对手\n发起攻击。

label: MOVE_EERIE_SPELL.name
source: EERIE SPELL
translation: 诡异咒语

label: MOVE_EERIE_SPELL.description
source: Attacks with psychic power.\nFoe's last move has 3 PP cut.
translation: 用强大的精神力量攻击。让\n对手最后用的招式减少3PP。

label: MOVE_DIRE_CLAW.name
source: DIRE CLAW
translation: 克命爪

label: MOVE_DIRE_CLAW.description
source: High critical hit chance. May\nparalyze, poison or drowse.
translation: 以破灭之爪攻击。有时会\n让对手中毒、麻痹或睡眠。

label: MOVE_PSYSHIELD_BASH.name
source: PSYSHIELD BASH
translation: 屏障猛攻

label: MOVE_PSYSHIELD_BASH.description
source: Hits a foe with psychic\nenergy. May raise Defense.
translation: 让意念的能量覆盖全身撞向\n对手攻击。会提高自身防御。

label: MOVE_POWER_SHIFT.name
source: POWER SHIFT
translation: 力量转换

label: MOVE_POWER_SHIFT.description
source: The user swaps its Attack\nand Defense stats.
translation: 将自己的攻击\n与防御互相交换。

label: MOVE_STONE_AXE.name
source: STONE AXE
translation: 岩斧

label: MOVE_STONE_AXE.description
source: Sets sharp rocks that hurt\nthe foe.
translation: 用岩石之斧攻击。散落的\n岩石碎片会飘浮在对手周围。

label: MOVE_SPRINGTIDE_STORM.name
source: SPRINGTIDE STORM
translation: 阳春风暴

label: MOVE_SPRINGTIDE_STORM.description
source: Wraps a foe in fierce winds.\nVaries with the user's form.
translation: 用交织着爱与恨的烈风席卷\n对手。有时会降低对手攻击。

label: MOVE_MYSTICAL_POWER.name
source: MYSTICAL POWER
translation: 神秘之力

label: MOVE_MYSTICAL_POWER.description
source: A mysterious power strikes,\nraising the user's Sp. Atk.
translation: 放出不可思议的力量攻击。\n会提高自己的特攻。

label: MOVE_RAGING_FURY.name
source: RAGING FURY
translation: 大愤慨

label: MOVE_RAGING_FURY.description
source: A rampage of 2 to 3 turns\nthat confuses the user.
translation: 在2~3回合内放出火焰疯狂\n乱打。大闹一番后陷入混乱。

label: MOVE_WAVE_CRASH.name
source: WAVE CRASH
translation: 波动冲

label: MOVE_WAVE_CRASH.description
source: A slam shrouded in water.\nIt also hurts the user.
translation: 让水覆盖全身后撞向对手。\n自己也会受到不少伤害。

label: MOVE_CHLOROBLAST.name
source: CHLOROBLAST
translation: 叶绿爆震

label: MOVE_CHLOROBLAST.description
source: A user-hurting blast of\namassed chlorophyll.
translation: 将叶绿素凝聚后释放攻击。\n自己也会受到伤害。

label: MOVE_MOUNTAIN_GALE.name
source: MOUNTAIN GALE
translation: 冰山风

label: MOVE_MOUNTAIN_GALE.description
source: Giant chunks of ice damage\nthe foe. It may flinch.
translation: 将冰山般巨大冰块砸向对手。\n有时会使对手畏缩。

label: MOVE_VICTORY_DANCE.name
source: VICTORY DANCE
translation: 胜利之舞

label: MOVE_VICTORY_DANCE.description
source: Dances to raise Attack,\nDefense and Speed.
translation: 激烈地跳起唤来胜利的舞蹈，\n提高自己的攻击防御和速度。

label: MOVE_HEADLONG_RUSH.name
source: HEADLONG RUSH
translation: 突飞猛扑

label: MOVE_HEADLONG_RUSH.description
source: Hits with a full-body tackle.\nLowers the users's defenses.
translation: 灌注全心全力撞击对手。\n自己的防御和特防会降低。

label: MOVE_BARB_BARRAGE.name
source: BARB BARRAGE
translation: 毒千针

label: MOVE_BARB_BARRAGE.description
source: Can poison on impact. Powers\nup against poisoned foes.
translation: 用无数毒针攻击。有时造成中毒。\n攻击中毒对手威力变成2倍。

label: MOVE_ESPER_WING.name
source: ESPER WING
translation: 气场之翼

label: MOVE_ESPER_WING.description
source: High critical hit ratio.\nUps the user's Speed.
translation: 用气场强化的翅膀撕裂对手。\n容易击中要害。会提高速度。

label: MOVE_BITTER_MALICE.name
source: BITTER MALICE
translation: 冤冤相报

label: MOVE_BITTER_MALICE.description
source: A spine-chilling resentment.\nLowers the foe's Attack.
translation: 用令人毛骨悚然的怨念攻击。\n会降低对手的攻击。

label: MOVE_SHELTER.name
source: SHELTER
translation: 闭关

label: MOVE_SHELTER.description
source: The user hardens their skin,\nsharply raising its Defense.
translation: 将皮肤变得坚硬如铁盾，\n从而大幅提高自己的防御。

label: MOVE_TRIPLE_ARROWS.name
source: TRIPLE ARROWS
translation: 三连箭

label: MOVE_TRIPLE_ARROWS.description
source: High critical hit ratio.\nMay lower Defense or flinch.
translation: 使出腿技后射箭。有时降低\n防御或畏缩。容易击中要害。

label: MOVE_INFERNAL_PARADE.name
source: INFERNAL PARADE
translation: 群魔乱舞

label: MOVE_INFERNAL_PARADE.description
source: Hurts a foe harder if it has\nan ailment. May leave a burn.
translation: 用火球攻击。有时造成灼伤。\n对手异常状态威力变成2倍。

label: MOVE_CEASELESS_EDGE.name
source: CEASELESS EDGE
translation: 秘剑千重涛

label: MOVE_CEASELESS_EDGE.description
source: Sets Spikes that hurt the\nfoe.
translation: 用贝壳之剑攻击。散落碎片\n会散落在对手脚下成为撒菱。

label: MOVE_BLEAKWIND_STORM.name
source: BLEAKWIND STORM
translation: 枯叶风暴

label: MOVE_BLEAKWIND_STORM.description
source: Hits with brutal, cold winds.\nMay lower the foe's Speed.
translation: 用令人颤抖的冰冷狂风攻击。\n有时会降低对手的速度。

label: MOVE_WILDBOLT_STORM.name
source: WILDBOLT STORM
translation: 鸣雷风暴

label: MOVE_WILDBOLT_STORM.description
source: Hits with a brutal tempest.\nMay inflict paralysis.
translation: 呼唤雷云风暴，进行激烈的\n攻击。有时会让对手麻痹。

label: MOVE_SANDSEAR_STORM.name
source: SANDSEAR STORM
translation: 热沙风暴

label: MOVE_SANDSEAR_STORM.description
source: Hits with brutally hot sand.\nMay inflict a burn.
translation: 用灼热的沙和强烈的风席卷\n对手。有时会让对手灼伤。

label: MOVE_LUNAR_BLESSING.name
source: LUNAR BLESSING
translation: 新月祈祷

label: MOVE_LUNAR_BLESSING.description
source: The user heals and cures\nitself and its ally.
translation: 向新月献上祈祷，回复自己和\n场上同伴的HP和状态。

label: MOVE_TAKE_HEART.name
source: TAKE HEART
translation: 勇气填充

label: MOVE_TAKE_HEART.description
source: The user lifts its spirits to\nheal and strengthen itself.
translation: 鼓起冲劲，治愈自己的异常\n状态，同时提高特攻和特防。

label: MOVE_TERA_BLAST.name
source: TERA BLAST
translation: 太晶爆发

label: MOVE_TERA_BLAST.description
source: If the user's Terastallized,\nit hits with its Tera type.
translation: 太晶化时以太晶属性攻击。\n用攻击特攻更高的一项攻击。

label: MOVE_SILK_TRAP.name
source: SILK TRAP
translation: 线阱

label: MOVE_SILK_TRAP.description
source: Protects itself, lowering\nSpeed on contact.
translation: 用丝设置陷阱防住对方攻击，\n并能够降低接触的对手速度。

label: MOVE_AXE_KICK.name
source: AXE KICK
translation: 下压踢

label: MOVE_AXE_KICK.description
source: May miss and hurt the kicker.\nMay cause confusion.
translation: 踢起脚跟劈向对手。有时造\n成混乱。若劈偏会受到伤害。

label: MOVE_LAST_RESPECTS.name
source: LAST RESPECTS
translation: 扫墓

label: MOVE_LAST_RESPECTS.description
source: This move deals more damage\nfor each defeated ally.
translation: 为化解悔恨攻击。被打倒的\n我方宝可梦越多，威力越高。

label: MOVE_LUMINA_CRASH.name
source: LUMINA CRASH
translation: 琉光冲激

label: MOVE_LUMINA_CRASH.description
source: A mind-affecting light\nharshly lowers Sp. Def.
translation: 放出能影响精神的奇妙怪光\n攻击。会大幅降低对方特防。

label: MOVE_ORDER_UP.name
source: ORDER UP
translation: 上菜

label: MOVE_ORDER_UP.description
source: Boosts a user's stats\ndepending on Tatsugiri.
translation: 以潇洒的身手攻击。若口中\n有米立龙会按其提高能力。

label: MOVE_JET_PUNCH.name
source: JET PUNCH
translation: 喷射拳

label: MOVE_JET_PUNCH.description
source: A punch is thrown at blinding\nspeed to strike first.
translation: 拳头缠绕激流，以超越目光\n的速度拳击。必定先制攻击。

label: MOVE_SPICY_EXTRACT.name
source: SPICY EXTRACT
translation: 辣椒精华

label: MOVE_SPICY_EXTRACT.description
source: Sharply ups target's Attack,\nharshly lowers its Defense.
translation: 放出极为辛辣的精华。对手\n攻击大幅提高防御大幅降低。

label: MOVE_SPIN_OUT.name
source: SPIN OUT
translation: 疾速转轮

label: MOVE_SPIN_OUT.description
source: Furiously strains its legs.\nHarshly lowers user's Speed.
translation: 以往腿上增加负荷激烈旋转\n攻击，自身速度会大幅降低。

label: MOVE_POPULATION_BOMB.name
source: POPULATION BOMB
translation: 鼠数儿

label: MOVE_POPULATION_BOMB.description
source: The user's fellows hit one\nto ten times in a row.
translation: 伙伴们会纷纷赶来，以群体\n攻击。连续命中1~10次。

label: MOVE_ICE_SPINNER.name
source: ICE SPINNER
translation: 冰旋

label: MOVE_ICE_SPINNER.description
source: Ice-covered feet hit a foe\nand destroy the terrain.
translation: 脚上覆盖薄冰，旋转着撞击\n对手。用旋转动作破坏场地。

label: MOVE_GLAIVE_RUSH.name
source: GLAIVE RUSH
translation: 巨剑突击

label: MOVE_GLAIVE_RUSH.description
source: Foe attacks next turn can't\nmiss and do double damage.
translation: 蛮勇地舍身突击。之后对手\n攻击必中且伤害变成2倍。

label: MOVE_REVIVAL_BLESSING.name
source: REVIVAL BLESSING
translation: 复生祈祷

label: MOVE_SALT_CURE.name
source: SALT CURE
translation: 盐腌

label: MOVE_SALT_CURE.description
source: Hurts foe every turn. Double\ndamage to Steel and Water.
translation: 使对手陷入盐腌每回合受伤。\n对手为钢或水属性会更痛苦。

label: MOVE_TRIPLE_DIVE.name
source: TRIPLE DIVE
translation: 三连钻

label: MOVE_TRIPLE_DIVE.description
source: Hits target with splashes\nof water 3 times in a row.
translation: 以默契的跳跃溅起水花攻击。\n连续3次给予伤害。

label: MOVE_MORTAL_SPIN.name
source: MORTAL SPIN
translation: 晶光转转

label: MOVE_MORTAL_SPIN.description
source: Erases trap moves and Leech\nSeed. Poisons adjacent foes.
translation: 旋转攻击对手。可摆脱绑紧\n类招式。还能让对手中毒。

label: MOVE_DOODLE.name
source: DOODLE
translation: 描绘

label: MOVE_DOODLE.description
source: Changes user's and ally's\nAbility into the target's.
translation: 把握并映射出对手本质，让\n己方宝可梦变为同样的特性。

label: MOVE_FILLET_AWAY.name
source: FILLET AWAY
translation: 甩肉

label: MOVE_FILLET_AWAY.description
source: Sharply boosts offenses and\nSpeed by using its own HP.
translation: 削减自己的HP，\n大幅提高攻击特攻及速度。

label: MOVE_KOWTOW_CLEAVE.name
source: KOWTOW CLEAVE
translation: 仆刀

label: MOVE_KOWTOW_CLEAVE.description
source: User slashes the foe after\nkowtowing. It never misses.
translation: 下跪让对手大意后发起袭击\n劈向对手。攻击必定会命中。

label: MOVE_FLOWER_TRICK.name
source: FLOWER TRICK
translation: 千变万花

label: MOVE_FLOWER_TRICK.description
source: Rigged bouquet. Always gets\na critical hit, never missing.
translation: 将做了手脚的花束扔向对手\n攻击。必定命中且击中要害。

label: MOVE_TORCH_SONG.name
source: TORCH SONG
translation: 闪焰高歌

label: MOVE_TORCH_SONG.description
source: Flames scorch the target.\nBoosts the user's Sp. Atk.
translation: 如唱歌一样喷出熊熊火焰\n烧焦对手。会提高自身特攻。

label: MOVE_AQUA_STEP.name
source: AQUA STEP
translation: 流水旋舞

label: MOVE_AQUA_STEP.description
source: Hits with light, fluid dance\nsteps. Ups the user's Speed.
translation: 以盈盈欲滴的轻快步伐戏耍\n攻击。会提高自己的速度。

label: MOVE_RAGING_BULL.name
source: RAGING BULL
translation: 怒牛

label: MOVE_RAGING_BULL.description
source: Tackle that breaks barriers.\nUser's form determines type.
translation: 狂怒猛烈冲撞。属性随形态\n改变，墙壁类招式也能破坏。

label: MOVE_MAKE_IT_RAIN.name
source: MAKE IT RAIN
translation: 淘金潮

label: MOVE_MAKE_IT_RAIN.description
source: Lowers the user's Sp. Atk.\nMoney is recovered after.
translation: 抛大量硬币攻击。自身特攻\n会降低，战斗后会拿到钱。

label: MOVE_RUINATION.name
source: RUINATION
translation: 大灾难

label: MOVE_RUINATION.description
source: Summons a ruinous disaster\nand cuts half the foe's HP.
translation: 引发毁灭性的灾厄，\n使对手的HP减半。

label: MOVE_COLLISION_COURSE.name
source: COLLISION COURSE
translation: 全开猛撞

label: MOVE_COLLISION_COURSE.description
source: Prehistoric explosion that's\nstronger if super effective.
translation: 边变形边凶暴地落下，引发\n起大爆炸。克制时威力提升。

label: MOVE_ELECTRO_DRIFT.name
source: ELECTRO DRIFT
translation: 闪电猛冲

label: MOVE_ELECTRO_DRIFT.description
source: Futuristic electricity. It's\nstronger if super effective.
translation: 边变形边高速奔走，以未知\n电击贯穿。克制时威力提升。

label: MOVE_SHED_TAIL.name
source: SHED TAIL
translation: 断尾

label: MOVE_SHED_TAIL.description
source: Creates a Substitute for\nitself before switching out.
translation: 削减自己的HP，制造分身后\n会返回与后备宝可梦替换。

label: MOVE_TIDY_UP.name
source: TIDY UP
translation: 大扫除

label: MOVE_TIDY_UP.description
source: User tidies up hazards and\nraises its Attack and Speed.
translation: 将替身与撒菱等招式扫除掉。\n自己的攻击和速度会提高。

label: MOVE_POUNCE.name
source: POUNCE
translation: 虫扑

label: MOVE_POUNCE.description
source: The user pounces on the foe,\nlowering its Speed.
translation: 飞扑向对手攻击。\n会降低对手的速度。

label: MOVE_TRAILBLAZE.name
source: TRAILBLAZE
translation: 起草

label: MOVE_TRAILBLAZE.description
source: The user attacks suddenly,\nraising its Speed.
translation: 跳出草丛攻击。通过轻快\n的步伐会提高自己的速度。

label: MOVE_CHILLING_WATER.name
source: CHILLING WATER
translation: 泼冷水

label: MOVE_CHILLING_WATER.description
source: A shower with ice-cold water\nlowers the target's Attack.
translation: 泼洒冰冷得足以让对手失去\n活力的水。会降低对手攻击。

label: MOVE_HYPER_DRILL.name
source: HYPER DRILL
translation: 强力钻

label: MOVE_HYPER_DRILL.description
source: A spinning pointed part\nbypasses a foe's Protect.
translation: 急速旋转尖锐身体部位贯穿。\n可以无视守住和看穿等招式。

label: MOVE_TWIN_BEAM.name
source: TWIN BEAM
translation: 双光束

label: MOVE_TWIN_BEAM.description
source: Mystical eye-beams that hit\nthe target twice in a row.
translation: 从两眼发射出神奇光线攻击。\n连续2次给予伤害。

label: MOVE_RAGE_FIST.name
source: RAGE FIST
translation: 愤怒之拳

label: MOVE_RAGE_FIST.description
source: The more the user has been\nhit, the stronger the move.
translation: 将愤怒化为力量攻击。受到\n攻击次数越多，威力越高。

label: MOVE_ARMOR_CANNON.name
source: ARMOR CANNON
translation: 铠农炮

label: MOVE_ARMOR_CANNON.description
source: A strong attack but lowers\nthe defensive stats.
translation: 燃烧自身铠甲化作炮弹攻击，\n自己的防御和特防会降低。

label: MOVE_BITTER_BLADE.name
source: BITTER BLADE
translation: 悔念剑

label: MOVE_BITTER_BLADE.description
source: Attack that absorbs\nhalf the damage inflicted.
translation: 将世间留恋聚集于剑尖斩击。\n可以回复给予伤害一半HP。

label: MOVE_DOUBLE_SHOCK.name
source: DOUBLE SHOCK
translation: 电光双击

label: MOVE_DOUBLE_SHOCK.description
source: Discharges all electricity,\nlosing the Electric type.
translation: 将全身所有的电力放出攻击，\n自己的电属性将会消失。

label: MOVE_GIGATON_HAMMER.name
source: GIGATON HAMMER
translation: 巨力锤

label: MOVE_GIGATON_HAMMER.description
source: Swings a huge hammer. Can't\nbe used twice in a row.
translation: 连同身体转起巨大锤子攻击。\n这个招式无法连续使出2次。

label: MOVE_COMEUPPANCE.name
source: COMEUPPANCE
translation: 复仇

label: MOVE_COMEUPPANCE.description
source: Retaliates strongly against\nwho last hurt the user.
translation: 使出招式前，将最后受到的\n招式的伤害大力返还给对手。

label: MOVE_AQUA_CUTTER.name
source: AQUA CUTTER
translation: 水波刀

label: MOVE_AQUA_CUTTER.description
source: Pressurized water cut with a\nhigh critical-hit ratio.
translation: 如刀刃般喷射出加压的水\n切开对手。容易击中要害。

label: MOVE_BLAZING_TORQUE.name
source: BLAZING TORQUE
translation: 灼热暴冲

label: MOVE_WICKED_TORQUE.name
source: WICKED TORQUE
translation: 黑暗暴冲

label: MOVE_NOXIOUS_TORQUE.name
source: NOXIOUS TORQUE
translation: 剧毒暴冲

label: MOVE_COMBAT_TORQUE.name
source: COMBAT TORQUE
translation: 格斗暴冲

label: MOVE_MAGICAL_TORQUE.name
source: MAGICAL TORQUE
translation: 魔法暴冲

label: MOVE_PSYBLADE.name
source: PSYBLADE
translation: 精神剑

label: MOVE_PSYBLADE.description
source: This move's power increases\nwhen on Electric Terrain.
translation: 用无形的利刃劈开对手。\n在电气场地上招式威力提升。

label: MOVE_HYDRO_STEAM.name
source: HYDRO STEAM
translation: 水蒸气

label: MOVE_HYDRO_STEAM.description
source: This move's power increases\nunder harsh sunlight.
translation: 将沸腾的开水猛烈喷向对手。\n晴天时招式威力反而会提升。

label: MOVE_BLOOD_MOON.name
source: BLOOD MOON
translation: 血月

label: MOVE_BLOOD_MOON.description
source: Unleashes the blood moon.\nCan't be used twice in a row.
translation: 从赤红如血满月发射出全部\n气势。无法连续使出2次。

label: MOVE_MATCHA_GOTCHA.name
source: MATCHA GOTCHA
translation: 刷刷茶炮

label: MOVE_MATCHA_GOTCHA.description
source: Absorbs half the damage\ninflicted. May cause a burn.
translation: 发射茶大炮，可以回复伤害\n一半HP，有时造成灼伤。

label: MOVE_SYRUP_BOMB.name
source: SYRUP BOMB
translation: 糖浆炸弹

label: MOVE_SYRUP_BOMB.description
source: Lowers the foe's speed\neach turn for 3 turns.
translation: 引爆糖浆让对手陷入满身糖，\n在3回合内持续降低速度。

label: MOVE_IVY_CUDGEL.name
source: IVY CUDGEL
translation: 棘藤棒

label: MOVE_IVY_CUDGEL.description
source: Type changes with held mask.\nHigh critical-hit ratio.
translation: 用缠藤的棍棒殴打。属性会\n随面具改变。容易击中要害。

label: MOVE_ELECTRO_SHOT.name
source: ELECTRO SHOT
translation: 电光束

label: MOVE_ELECTRO_SHOT.description
source: Gathers electricity, then\nfires a high-voltage shot.
translation: 第1回合提高特攻，第2回合\n发射电力。下雨时立刻发射。

label: MOVE_TERA_STARSTORM.name
source: TERA STARSTORM
translation: 晶光星群

label: MOVE_TERA_STARSTORM.description
source: In Terapagos's Stellar\nForm, it hits all foes.
translation: 照射出结晶力量来驱逐敌人。\n星晶形态下能攻击所有对手。

label: MOVE_FICKLE_BEAM.name
source: FICKLE BEAM
translation: 随机光

label: MOVE_FICKLE_BEAM.description
source: Shoots a beam of light.\nSometimes twice as strong.
translation: 发射光线攻击。有时其\n他头会合力，威力变成2倍。

label: MOVE_BURNING_BULWARK.name
source: BURNING BULWARK
translation: 火焰守护

label: MOVE_BURNING_BULWARK.description
source: Evades attack, and burns\nthe foe if struck.
translation: 用超高温的体毛防住攻击，\n同时让接触的对手灼伤。

label: MOVE_THUNDERCLAP.name
source: THUNDERCLAP
translation: 迅雷

label: MOVE_MIGHTY_CLEAVE.name
source: MIGHTY CLEAVE
translation: 强刃攻击

label: MOVE_TACHYON_CUTTER.name
source: TACHYON CUTTER
translation: 迅子利刃

label: MOVE_TACHYON_CUTTER.description
source: Launches particle blades at\nthe target. Strikes twice.
translation: 接连发射出粒子刃，连续\n2次攻击。必定会命中。

label: MOVE_HARD_PRESS.name
source: HARD PRESS
translation: 硬压

label: MOVE_DRAGON_CHEER.name
source: DRAGON CHEER
translation: 龙声鼓舞

label: MOVE_DRAGON_CHEER.description
source: Increases allies' critical hit\nratio, especially if Dragons.
translation: 鼓舞士气让招式变得容易击\n中要害。对龙属性效果更强。

label: MOVE_ALLURING_VOICE.name
source: ALLURING VOICE
translation: 魅诱之声

label: MOVE_ALLURING_VOICE.description
source: Confuses foe if its stats\nwere boosted this turn.
translation: 用天使般的歌声攻击。让此\n回合能力提高的宝可梦混乱。

label: MOVE_TEMPER_FLARE.name
source: TEMPER FLARE
translation: 豁出去

label: MOVE_TEMPER_FLARE.description
source: A desperation attack. Power\ndoubles if last move failed.
translation: 以自暴自弃的气势攻击。\n若上回合未命中则威力翻倍。

label: MOVE_SUPERCELL_SLAM.name
source: SUPERCELL SLAM
translation: 闪电强袭

label: MOVE_SUPERCELL_SLAM.description
source: An electrified slam. If it\nmisses, the user is hurt.
translation: 让身体带电后压向对手。\n如果未命中则自身受伤。

label: MOVE_PSYCHIC_NOISE.name
source: PSYCHIC NOISE
translation: 精神噪音

label: MOVE_PSYCHIC_NOISE.description
source: Sound waves that damage and\nprevent healing for 2 turns.
translation: 用令对手不舒服的音波攻击。\n让对手2回合内无法回复HP。

label: MOVE_UPPER_HAND.name
source: UPPER HAND
translation: 快手还击

label: MOVE_UPPER_HAND.description
source: Makes the target flinch if\nreadying a priority move.
translation: 察觉动作后攻击让对手畏缩。\n若对手招式不是先制会失败。

label: MOVE_MALIGNANT_CHAIN.name
source: MALIGNANT CHAIN
translation: 邪毒锁链

label: MOVE_MALIGNANT_CHAIN.description
source: A corrosive chain attack\nthat may badly poison.
translation: 用毒锁链缠住对手加以侵蚀。\n有时会让对手陷入剧毒状态。

label: MOVE_BREAKNECK_BLITZ.name
source: BREAKNECK BLITZ
translation: 究极无敌大冲撞

label: MOVE_BREAKNECK_BLITZ.description
source: Builds momentum and crashes\ninto the foe. Power varies.
translation: 以Z力量猛烈地全力撞击。\n威力会根据原本招式而改变。

label: MOVE_ALL_OUT_PUMMELING.name
source: ALL-OUT PUMMELING
translation: 全力无双激烈拳

label: MOVE_ALL_OUT_PUMMELING.description
source: Rams an energy orb into\nthe target. Power varies.
translation: 以Z力量制造能量弹撞击。\n威力会根据原本招式而改变。

label: MOVE_SUPERSONIC_SKYSTRIKE.name
source: SUPERSONIC SKYSTRIKE
translation: 极速俯冲轰烈撞

label: MOVE_SUPERSONIC_SKYSTRIKE.description
source: Soars up and plummets toward\nthe target. Power varies.
translation: 以Z力量飞向天空后落下。\n威力会根据原本招式而改变。

label: MOVE_ACID_DOWNPOUR.name
source: ACID DOWNPOUR
translation: 强酸剧毒灭绝雨

label: MOVE_ACID_DOWNPOUR.description
source: Sinks the target in a poison\nswamp. Power varies.
translation: 以Z力量涌起毒沼淹没对手。\n威力会根据原本招式而改变。

label: MOVE_TECTONIC_RAGE.name
source: TECTONIC RAGE
translation: 地隆啸天大终结

label: MOVE_TECTONIC_RAGE.description
source: Burrows deep and slams into\nthe target. Power varies.
translation: 以Z力量潜入地下后撞击。\n威力会根据原本招式而改变。

label: MOVE_CONTINENTAL_CRUSH.name
source: CONTINENTAL CRUSH
translation: 毁天灭地巨岩坠

label: MOVE_CONTINENTAL_CRUSH.description
source: Drops a huge rock mountain\non the foe. Power varies.

label: SPECIES_BULBASAUR.speciesName
source: BULBASAUR
translation: 妙蛙种子

label: SPECIES_BULBASAUR.categoryName
source: Seed
translation: 种子

label: SPECIES_BULBASAUR.description
source:
Bulbasaur can be seen napping in bright
sunlight. There is a seed on its back.
By soaking up the sun's rays, the seed
grows progressively larger.
translation: 在出生后的一段时间里，\n它会从背上的种子里\n汲取营养茁壮成长。

label: SPECIES_IVYSAUR.speciesName
source: IVYSAUR
translation: 妙蛙草

label: SPECIES_IVYSAUR.categoryName
source: Seed
translation: 种子

label: SPECIES_IVYSAUR.description
source:
To support its bulb, Ivysaur's legs
grow sturdy. If it spends more time lying in
the sunlight, the bud will soon bloom into
a large flower.
translation: 当它背上的花苞开始鼓起时，\n就会飘出一股甜美的香气。\n这是大花即将盛开的前兆。

label: SPECIES_VENUSAUR.speciesName
source: VENUSAUR
translation: 妙蛙花

label: SPECIES_VENUSAUR.categoryName
source: Seed
translation: 种子

label: SPECIES_VENUSAUR.description
source:
Venusaur's flower is said to take on vivid
colors if it gets plenty of nutrition and
sunlight. The flower's aroma soothes the
emotions of people.
translation: 雨后第二天，\n它背上花朵的香味会愈加浓郁。\n宝可梦会被香味引诱而聚拢过来。

label: SPECIES_VENUSAUR_MEGA.speciesName
source: VENUSAUR
translation: 妙蛙花

label: SPECIES_VENUSAUR_MEGA.categoryName
source: Seed
translation: 种子

label: SPECIES_VENUSAUR_MEGA.description
source: In order to support its flower, which\nhas grown larger due to Mega Evolution,\nits back and legs have become stronger.
translation: 为了支撑在超级进化后\n成长得更大的花，\n它的腰腿也变得更加健壮了。

label: SPECIES_VENUSAUR_GMAX.speciesName
source: VENUSAUR
translation: 妙蛙花

label: SPECIES_VENUSAUR_GMAX.categoryName
source: Seed
translation: 种子

label: SPECIES_VENUSAUR_GMAX.description
source:
Spits big amounts of pollen like a volcano.
Breathing too much of it causes fainting.
In battle, it swings around two thick vines
that can easily topple 10-story buildings.
translation: 会用火山喷发般的气势\n播撒大量的花粉。\n如果吸入过多花粉，可是会昏倒的。

label: SPECIES_CHARMANDER.speciesName
source: CHARMANDER
translation: 小火龙

label: SPECIES_CHARMANDER.categoryName
source: Lizard
translation: 蜥蜴

label: SPECIES_CHARMANDER.description
source:
The flame that burns at the tip of its
tail is an indication of its emotions.
The flame wavers when Charmander is
happy, and blazes when it is enraged.
translation: 小火龙尾巴上的火焰\n是它生命的灯火。\n精神好的时候火焰也会烧得更旺。

label: SPECIES_CHARMELEON.speciesName
source: CHARMELEON
translation: 火恐龙

label: SPECIES_CHARMELEON.categoryName
source: Flame
translation: 火焰

label: SPECIES_CHARMELEON.description
source:
Without pity, its sharp claws destroy foes.
If it encounters a strong enemy, it
becomes agitated, and the flame on its
tail flares with a bluish white color.
translation: 如果挥舞燃烧着的尾巴，\n就能令周围温度不断上升，\n从而让对手陷入痛苦。

label: SPECIES_CHARIZARD.speciesName
source: CHARIZARD
translation: 喷火龙

label: SPECIES_CHARIZARD.categoryName
source: Flame
translation: 火焰

label: SPECIES_CHARIZARD.description
source:
A Charizard flies about in search of
strong opponents. It breathes intense
flames that can melt any material. However,
it will never torch a weaker foe.
translation: 据说经历过越多苦战的喷火龙，\n其火焰的温度就会越高。

label: SPECIES_CHARIZARD_MEGA_X.speciesName
source: CHARIZARD
translation: 喷火龙

label: SPECIES_CHARIZARD_MEGA_X.categoryName
source: Flame
translation: 火焰

label: SPECIES_CHARIZARD_MEGA_X.description
source: The overwhelming power that fills its\nentire body causes it to turn black\nand creates intense blue flames.
translation: 全身充斥着非比寻常的力量，\n这种力量染黑了它的身体，\n燃烧出炽热的蓝色火焰。

label: SPECIES_CHARIZARD_MEGA_Y.speciesName
source: CHARIZARD
translation: 喷火龙

label: SPECIES_CHARIZARD_MEGA_Y.categoryName
source: Flame
translation: 火焰

label: SPECIES_CHARIZARD_MEGA_Y.description
source:
Its bond with its Trainer is the source
of its power. It boasts speed and
maneuverability greater than that of a
jet fighter.
translation: 与训练家的牵绊是它的力量之源。\n它引以为傲的飞行能力\n完全凌驾于喷气式飞机之上。

label: SPECIES_CHARIZARD_GMAX.speciesName
source: CHARIZARD
translation: 喷火龙

label: SPECIES_CHARIZARD_GMAX.categoryName
source: Flame
translation: 火焰

label: SPECIES_CHARIZARD_GMAX.description
source:
The flame inside its body burns
hotter than 3,600 degrees Fahrenheit.
When Charizard roars, that
temperature climbs even higher.
translation: 2000度的火焰在体内形成了漩涡。\n当它咆哮的时候，\n火力还会进一步上升。

label: SPECIES_SQUIRTLE.speciesName
source: SQUIRTLE
translation: 杰尼龟

label: SPECIES_SQUIRTLE.categoryName
source: Tiny Turtle
translation: 小龟

label: SPECIES_SQUIRTLE.description
source:
Its shell is not just for protection.
Its rounded shape and the grooves on its
surface minimize resistance in water,
enabling Squirtle to swim at high speeds.
translation: 它会躲进甲壳里保护自己。\n会抓住对手的破绽，\n用喷水来反击。

label: SPECIES_WARTORTLE.speciesName
source: WARTORTLE
translation: 卡咪龟

label: SPECIES_WARTORTLE.categoryName
source: Turtle
translation: 龟

label: SPECIES_WARTORTLE.description
source:
Its large tail is covered with rich, thick
fur that deepens in color with age.
The scratches on its shell are evidence
of this Pokémon's toughness in battle.
translation: 据说它有着1万年的寿命。\n蓬松的尾巴是长寿的象征，\n深受人们的喜爱。

label: SPECIES_BLASTOISE.speciesName
source: BLASTOISE
translation: 水箭龟

label: SPECIES_BLASTOISE.categoryName
source: Shellfish
translation: 甲壳

label: SPECIES_BLASTOISE.description
source:
The waterspouts that protrude from its
shell are highly accurate. Their bullets of
water can precisely nail tin cans from
a distance of over 160 feet.
translation: 甲壳上有喷射口，\n是个会以火箭般气势\n冲向对手的厉害家伙。

label: SPECIES_BLASTOISE_MEGA.speciesName
source: BLASTOISE
translation: 水箭龟

label: SPECIES_BLASTOISE_MEGA.categoryName
source: Shellfish
translation: 甲壳

label: SPECIES_BLASTOISE_MEGA.description
source:
The cannon on its back is as powerful
as a tank gun. Its tough legs and back
enable it to withstand the recoil from
firing the cannon.
translation: 龟甲上的大炮拥有不逊于坦克的威力。\n结实的腰腿使它能在发射的\n冲击力之下用力站稳。

label: SPECIES_BLASTOISE_GMAX.speciesName
source: BLASTOISE
translation: 水箭龟

label: SPECIES_BLASTOISE_GMAX.categoryName
source: Shellfish
translation: 甲壳

label: SPECIES_BLASTOISE_GMAX.description
source:
It's not very good at precision
shooting. When attacking, it just fires
its 31 cannons over and over and
over.
translation: 从正中间的主炮发射出的水枪\n破坏力极强，可以击穿一座山，\n在山体上开出洞来。

label: SPECIES_CATERPIE.speciesName
source: CATERPIE
translation: 绿毛虫

label: SPECIES_CATERPIE.categoryName
source: Worm
translation: 虫宝宝

label: SPECIES_CATERPIE.description
source:
Its voracious appetite compels it to
devour leaves bigger than itself without
hesitation. It releases a terribly strong
odor from its antennae.
translation: 从红色触角释放出臭气，\n以此赶走敌人。\n通过不断蜕皮来长大。

label: SPECIES_METAPOD.speciesName
source: METAPOD
translation: 铁甲蛹

label: SPECIES_METAPOD.categoryName
source: Cocoon
translation: 蛹

label: SPECIES_METAPOD.description
source:
Its shell is as hard as an iron slab.
A Metapod does not move very much
because it is preparing its soft innards
for evolution inside the shell.
translation: 会用钢铁般坚硬的外壳\n保护里面柔软的身体。\n在进化之前会一直默默地忍受。

label: SPECIES_BUTTERFREE.speciesName
source: BUTTERFREE
translation: 巴大蝶

label: SPECIES_BUTTERFREE.categoryName
source: Butterfly
translation: 蝴蝶

label: SPECIES_BUTTERFREE.description
source:
It has a superior ability to search for
delicious honey from flowers. It can seek,
extract, and carry honey from flowers
blooming over six miles away.
translation: 最喜欢吃花蜜。\n只靠一点花粉\n就能找出花圃的位置。

label: SPECIES_BUTTERFREE_GMAX.speciesName
source: BUTTERFREE
translation: 巴大蝶

label: SPECIES_BUTTERFREE_GMAX.categoryName
source: Butterfly
translation: 蝴蝶

label: SPECIES_BUTTERFREE_GMAX.description
source:
Once it has opponents trapped in a
tornado that could blow away a 10-
ton truck, it finishes them off with
its poisonous scales.
translation: 会将敌人卷入甚至能吹飞\n10吨卡车的龙卷风里，\n同时用剧毒的鳞粉给予致命一击。

label: SPECIES_WEEDLE.speciesName
source: WEEDLE
translation: 独角虫

label: SPECIES_WEEDLE.categoryName
source: Hairy Bug
translation: 毛毛虫

label: SPECIES_WEEDLE.description
source:
A Weedle has an extremely acute sense
of smell. It distinguishes its favorite
kinds of leaves from those it dislikes by
sniffing with its big red nose.
translation: 每天都要吃下\n与自己体重相当的叶子。\n用头上的尖针击退来袭的敌人。

label: SPECIES_KAKUNA.speciesName
source: KAKUNA
translation: 铁壳蛹

label: SPECIES_KAKUNA.categoryName
source: Cocoon
translation: 蛹

label: SPECIES_KAKUNA.description
source:
It remains virtually immobile while it
clings to a tree. However, on the inside,
it busily prepares for evolution. This is
evident from how hot its shell becomes.
translation: 为了不被天敌发现，\n会躲在叶子的背后或树枝的间隙中，\n等待进化时刻的到来。

label: SPECIES_BEEDRILL.speciesName
source: BEEDRILL
translation: 大针蜂

label: SPECIES_BEEDRILL.categoryName
source: Poison Bee
translation: 毒蜂

label: SPECIES_BEEDRILL.description
source:
A Beedrill is extremely territorial.
For safety reasons, no one should ever
approach its nest. If angered, they will
attack in a swarm.
translation: 能以极快的速度飞来飞去，\n用毒针攻击后迅速飞离的战法\n是它的拿手绝招。

label: SPECIES_BEEDRILL_MEGA.categoryName
source: Poison Bee
translation: 毒蜂

label: SPECIES_BEEDRILL_MEGA.description
source:
Its legs have become poison stingers.
It stabs its prey repeatedly with the
stingers on its limbs, dealing the final
blow with the stinger on its rear.
translation: 双脚也变化为毒针。\n用手脚的针猛刺之后，\n以尾部的毒针给出最后一击。

label: SPECIES_PIDGEY.speciesName
source: PIDGEY
translation: 波波

label: SPECIES_PIDGEY.categoryName
source: Tiny Bird
translation: 小鸟

label: SPECIES_PIDGEY.description
source:
It has an extremely sharp sense of
direction. It can unerringly return home to
its nest, however far it may be removed
from its familiar surroundings.
translation: 虽然它性情温和不喜战斗，\n但要是随意对它出手的话，\n就会受到它强烈的反击。

label: SPECIES_PIDGEOTTO.speciesName
source: PIDGEOTTO
translation: 比比鸟

label: SPECIES_PIDGEOTTO.categoryName
source: Bird
translation: 鸟

label: SPECIES_PIDGEOTTO.description
source:
This Pokémon flies around, patrolling its
large territory. If its living space is
violated, it shows no mercy in thoroughly
punishing the foe with its sharp claws.
translation: 在自己广阔的领地上空\n四处飞翔并寻找猎物，\n然后用发达的脚爪将其解决。

label: SPECIES_PIDGEOT.speciesName
source: PIDGEOT
translation: 大比鸟

label: SPECIES_PIDGEOT.categoryName
source: Bird
translation: 鸟

label: SPECIES_PIDGEOT.description
source:
This Pokémon has gorgeous, glossy
feathers. Many Trainers are so captivated
by the beautiful feathers on its head that
they choose Pidgeot as their Pokémon.
translation: 大比鸟全力振翅时所刮起的\n强风连大树都能压弯。

label: SPECIES_PIDGEOT_MEGA.speciesName
source: PIDGEOT
translation: 大比鸟

label: SPECIES_PIDGEOT_MEGA.categoryName
source: Bird
translation: 鸟

label: SPECIES_PIDGEOT_MEGA.description
source: With its muscular strength now greatly\nincreased, it can fly continuously\nfor two weeks without resting.
translation: 肌肉的力量大幅提升。\n能够连续2个星期\n不眠不休地持续飞行。

label: SPECIES_RATTATA.speciesName
source: RATTATA
translation: 小拉达

label: SPECIES_RATTATA.categoryName
source: Mouse
translation: 鼠

label: SPECIES_RATTATA.description
source:
A Rattata is cautious in the extreme.
Even while it is asleep, it constantly
moves its ears and listens for danger.
It will make its nest anywhere.
translation: 生命力非常顽强，\n不管住在哪里都能够生存。\n拥有很强的戒备心。

label: SPECIES_RATICATE.speciesName
source: RATICATE
translation: 拉达

label: SPECIES_RATICATE.categoryName
source: Mouse
translation: 鼠

label: SPECIES_RATICATE.description
source:
A Raticate's sturdy fangs grow steadily.
To keep them ground down, it gnaws on
rocks and logs. It may even chew on the
walls of houses.
translation: 为了磨平不断生长的门牙，\n它有着啃咬硬物的习性。\n连水泥围墙也能咬坏。

label: SPECIES_RATTATA_ALOLA.speciesName
source: RATTATA
translation: 小拉达

label: SPECIES_RATTATA_ALOLA.description
source:
With its incisors, it gnaws through doors
and infiltrates people's homes.
Then, with a twitch of its whiskers,
it steals whatever food it finds.
translation: 胡子造就了它敏锐的嗅觉。\n靠闻气味就能马上发现\n被藏起来的食物放在何处。

label: SPECIES_RATICATE_ALOLA.speciesName
source: RATICATE
translation: 拉达

label: SPECIES_RATICATE_ALOLA_TOTEM.speciesName
source: RATICATE
translation: 拉达

label: SPECIES_SPEAROW.speciesName
source: SPEAROW
translation: 烈雀

label: SPECIES_SPEAROW.categoryName
source: Tiny Bird
translation: 小鸟

label: SPECIES_SPEAROW.description
source:
Its loud cry can be heard over half a mile
away. If its high, keening cry is heard
echoing all around, it is a sign that they
are warning each other of danger.
translation: 会频繁拍打它短短的翅膀来飞行，\n用鸟嘴找出在草丛里的猎物。

label: SPECIES_FEAROW.speciesName
source: FEAROW
translation: 大嘴雀

label: SPECIES_FEAROW.categoryName
source: Beak
translation: 鸟嘴

label: SPECIES_FEAROW.description
source:
Its long neck and elongated beak are
ideal for catching prey in soil or water.
It deftly moves this extended and skinny
beak to pluck prey.
translation: 有着可以用大大的翅膀\n来回飞上一整天的体力。\n会用锋利的鸟嘴战斗。

label: SPECIES_EKANS.speciesName
source: EKANS
translation: 阿柏蛇

label: SPECIES_EKANS.categoryName
source: Snake
translation: 蛇

label: SPECIES_EKANS.description
source:
An Ekans curls itself up in a spiral while
it rests. This position allows it to quickly
respond to an enemy from any direction
with a threat from its upraised head.
translation: 能够在草地上悄声无息地前进。\n从背后向失去警觉的\n猎物发起袭击。

label: SPECIES_ARBOK.speciesName
source: ARBOK
translation: 阿柏怪

label: SPECIES_ARBOK.categoryName
source: Cobra
translation: 眼镜蛇

label: SPECIES_ARBOK.description
source:
This Pokémon has a terrifically strong
constricting power. It can even flatten
steel oil drums. Once it wraps its body
around its foe, escaping is impossible.
translation: 腹部的花纹看起来像一张可怕的脸。\n弱小的敌人只要看到\n这个花纹就会被吓跑。

label: SPECIES_PIKACHU_ORIGINAL.description
source:
This Pikachu wears its partner's cap, which
is proof of the strong bond Pikachu and
its partner formed during adventures
across many different regions.
translation: 它所戴的这顶伙伴的帽子，\n是它与伙伴在许多地区冒险\n而加深了牵绊的证明。

label: SPECIES_PIKACHU_PARTNER.categoryName

translation: 鼠

label: SPECIES_PIKACHU_PARTNER.description

This Pikachu wears its partner's cap, which
is proof of the strong bond Pikachu and

many hardships together.
translation: 它所戴的这顶伙伴的帽子，\n是它与伙伴在世界各地冒险\n而加深了牵绊的证明。

translation: 皮卡丘

label: SPECIES_PIKACHU_WORLD.categoryName

label: SPECIES_PIKACHU_WORLD.description
source:
This Pikachu wears its partner's cap, which
is proof of the strong bond Pikachu and
its partner formed during adventures
across the world together.
translation: 它所戴的这顶伙伴的帽子，\n是它与伙伴共同克服困难\n而加深了牵绊的证明。

label: SPECIES_PIKACHU_GMAX.speciesName
source: PIKACHU
translation: 皮卡丘

label: SPECIES_PIKACHU_GMAX.categoryName
source: Mouse
translation: 鼠

label: SPECIES_PIKACHU_GMAX.description
source:
When it smashes its opponents with
its bolt-shaped tail, it delivers a
surge of electricity equivalent to a
lightning strike.
translation: 膨胀的超极巨化之力\n使得它的身体变大，\n尾巴也变得高耸入云。

label: SPECIES_PIKACHU_STARTER.speciesName
source: PIKACHU
translation: 皮卡丘

label: SPECIES_PIKACHU_STARTER.categoryName
source: Mouse
translation: 鼠

label: SPECIES_RAICHU.speciesName
source: RAICHU
translation: 雷丘

label: SPECIES_RAICHU.categoryName
source: Mouse
translation: 鼠

label: SPECIES_RAICHU.description
source:
If it stores too much electricity, its
behavior turns aggressive. To avoid this,
it occasionally discharges excess energy
and calms itself down.
translation: 尾巴会发挥接地线的\n作用把电导入地面，\n因此自己不会被电到。

label: SPECIES_RAICHU_ALOLA.speciesName
source: RAICHU
translation: 雷丘

label: SPECIES_RAICHU_ALOLA.description
source:
It uses psychokinesis to control
electricity. It focuses psychic energy
into its tail and rides it like it's surfing.
Another name for this Pokémon is 'hodad'.
translation: 它会站在自己的尾巴上，\n用精神力量飘浮在空中，\n同时用做成星形的十万伏特攻击对手。

label: SPECIES_RAICHU_MEGA_X.speciesName
source: RAICHU
translation: 雷丘

label: SPECIES_RAICHU_MEGA_X.categoryName
source: Mouse
translation: 鼠

label: SPECIES_RAICHU_MEGA_X.description
source:
It resembles an X as it flies through
the air with 50 million volts of
electricity sparking from its ears and
forked tail.
translation: 从双耳和分叉的尾巴发出\n5000万伏特的电光，\n并以X字的样子飞翔。

label: SPECIES_RAICHU_MEGA_Y.speciesName
source: RAICHU
translation: 雷丘

label: SPECIES_RAICHU_MEGA_Y.categoryName
source: Mouse
translation: 鼠

label: SPECIES_RAICHU_MEGA_Y.description
source:
It fires bolts of electricity from the
tip of its tail and from the spiky tufts
of fur growing out of its temples. This
electricity forms the letter Y.
translation: 从太阳穴伸展出来的\n锯齿状体毛和尾巴尖端\n会放出Y字轨迹的电击。

label: SPECIES_SANDSHREW.speciesName
source: SANDSHREW
translation: 穿山鼠

label: SPECIES_SANDSHREW.categoryName
source: Mouse
translation: 鼠

label: SPECIES_SANDSHREW.description
source:
When it curls up in a ball, it can make any
attack bounce off harmlessly. Its hide has
turned tough and solid as a result of
living in the desert.
translation: 无论从多高的地方掉下来，\n只要将身体蜷成一团\n便能反弹起来得救。

label: SPECIES_SANDSLASH.speciesName
source: SANDSLASH
translation: 穿山王

label: SPECIES_SANDSLASH.categoryName
source: Mouse
translation: 鼠

label: SPECIES_SANDSLASH.description
source:
It curls up in a ball to protect itself from
enemy attacks. It also curls up to prevent
heatstroke during the daytime when
temperatures rise sharply.
translation: 会敏捷地跑来跑去，\n擅长用背上的针\n和尖锐的爪进行攻击。

label: SPECIES_SANDSHREW_ALOLA.description
source:
Life on mountains covered with deep snow
has granted this Pokémon a body of ice
that's as hard as steel.
Predators go after its soft belly.
translation: 让穿山鼠在冰上滑行，\n比赛滑行的距离。\n这是自古就有的阿罗拉的庆典之一。

label: SPECIES_SANDSLASH_ALOLA.description
source:
It uses large, hooked claws to cut a path
through deep snow as it runs.
On snowy mountains, this Sandslash
is faster than any other Pokémon.
translation: 很久以前曾栖息在沙漠里。\n会用利爪牢牢地插入山体，\n即便是攀爬冰山也不会滑落。

label: SPECIES_NIDORAN_F.speciesName
source: NIDORAN♀
translation: 尼多兰

label: SPECIES_NIDORAN_F.categoryName
source: Poison Pin
translation: 毒针

label: SPECIES_NIDORAN_F.description
source:
Its highly toxic barbs are thought to have
developed as protection for this small-
bodied Pokémon. When enraged, it releases
a horrible toxin from its horn.
translation: 性格温顺不喜争斗。\n从毒针里分泌出的毒液\n只要一滴就能致命。

label: SPECIES_NIDORINA.speciesName
source: NIDORINA
translation: 尼多娜

label: SPECIES_NIDORINA.categoryName
source: Poison Pin
translation: 毒针

label: SPECIES_NIDORINA.description
source:
When it is with its friends or
family, its barbs are tucked away to
prevent injury. It appears to become
nervous if separated from the others.
translation: 察觉到危险时\n全身的刺会倒竖起来。\n身上的刺比尼多力诺成长得慢。

label: SPECIES_NIDOQUEEN.speciesName
source: NIDOQUEEN
translation: 尼多后

label: SPECIES_NIDOQUEEN.categoryName
source: Drill
translation: 钻锥

label: SPECIES_NIDOQUEEN.description
source:
It is adept at sending foes flying with
harsh tackles using its tough, scaly body.
This Pokémon is at its strongest when
it is defending its young.
translation: 坚硬的鳞片像铠甲一样\n包裹着全身。\n会拼命保护巢穴里的幼崽。

label: SPECIES_NIDORAN_M.speciesName
source: NIDORAN♂
translation: 尼多朗

label: SPECIES_NIDORAN_M.categoryName
source: Poison Pin
translation: 毒针

label: SPECIES_NIDORAN_M.description
source:
The male Nidoran has developed muscles
that freely move its ears in any direction.
Even the slightest sound does not escape
this Pokémon's notice.
translation: 会躲在草丛里只露出耳朵\n来探察周围的情况。\n能用有剧毒的角来保护自己。

label: SPECIES_NIDORINO.speciesName
source: NIDORINO
translation: 尼多力诺

label: SPECIES_NIDORINO.categoryName
source: Poison Pin
translation: 毒针

label: SPECIES_NIDORINO.description
source:
Its horn is harder than a diamond.
If it senses a hostile presence, all the
barbs on its back bristle up at once, and it
challenges the foe with all its might.
translation: 性情粗暴的宝可梦。\n在刺中对手后，\n角会因受到冲击而渗出剧毒。

label: SPECIES_NIDOKING.speciesName
source: NIDOKING
translation: 尼多王

label: SPECIES_NIDOKING.categoryName
source: Drill
translation: 钻锥

label: SPECIES_NIDOKING.description
source:
A Nidoking's thick tail packs enormously
destructive power capable of toppling
a metal transmission tower. Once it goes
on a rampage, there is no stopping it.
translation: 尾巴只要一击就能将电线杆\n像折火柴棍一样折成两段。

label: SPECIES_CLEFFA.speciesName
source: CLEFFA
translation: 皮宝宝

label: SPECIES_CLEFFA.categoryName
source: Star Shape
translation: 星形

label: SPECIES_CLEFFA.description
source:
On nights with many shooting stars,
Cleffa can be seen dancing in a ring.
They dance until daybreak, when they
quench their thirst with the morning dew.
translation: 有着星星一样的轮廓。\n由于那外形，\n人们相信它是乘着流星而来的。

label: SPECIES_CLEFAIRY.speciesName
source: CLEFAIRY
translation: 皮皮

label: SPECIES_CLEFAIRY.categoryName
source: Fairy
translation: 妖精

label: SPECIES_CLEFAIRY.description
source:
On every night of a full moon, they come
out to play. When dawn arrives, the tired
Clefairy go to sleep nestled up against
each other in deep and quiet mountains.
translation: 据说在满月的夜晚，\n如果能看到皮皮们聚在一起跳舞，\n就能得到幸福。

label: SPECIES_CLEFABLE.speciesName
source: CLEFABLE
translation: 皮可西

label: SPECIES_CLEFABLE.categoryName
source: Fairy
translation: 妖精

label: SPECIES_CLEFABLE.description
source:
A Clefable uses its wings to skip lightly 
as if it were flying. Its bouncy step
lets it even walk on water. On quiet,
moonlit nights, it strolls on lakes.
translation: 妖精的一种，极少出现在人前。\n察觉到有人存在后，\n好像就会立刻逃走。

label: SPECIES_CLEFABLE_MEGA.categoryName
source: Fairy
translation: 妖精

label: SPECIES_CLEFABLE_MEGA.description
source: It flies by using the power of\nmoonlight to control gravity within\na radius of over 32 feet around it.
translation: 利用月光的力量，\n自如地控制周围20米\n的重力来四处飞行。

label: SPECIES_VULPIX.speciesName
source: VULPIX
translation: 六尾

label: SPECIES_VULPIX.categoryName
source: Fox
translation: 狐狸

label: SPECIES_VULPIX.description
source:
It can freely control fire, making fiery
orbs fly like will-o'-the-wisps. Just
before evolution, its six tails grow hot 
as if on fire.
translation: 虽然还是幼崽，\n却有着6根美丽的尾巴。\n长大后，尾巴会变得更多。

label: SPECIES_NINETALES.speciesName
source: NINETALES
translation: 九尾

label: SPECIES_NINETALES.categoryName
source: Fox
translation: 狐狸

label: SPECIES_NINETALES.description
source:
It has long been said that each of the
nine tails embody an enchanted power.
A long-lived Ninetales will have fur that
shines like gold.
translation: 拥有金光灿灿的体毛\n以及9条长长的尾巴。\n据说它可以活上1000年。

label: SPECIES_VULPIX_ALOLA.description
source:
They live together in a skulk, helping
one another. In hot weather, this Pokémon
makes ice shards with its six tails and
sprays them around to cool itself off.
translation: 在炎热的时候，\n用6根尾巴制作冰砾在周围挥洒，\n让身体冷却下来。

label: SPECIES_NINETALES_ALOLA.description
source:
While it will guide travelers who get lost
on a snowy mountain down to the
mountain's base, it won't forgive anyone
who harms nature.
translation: 从体毛中生出冰粒，\n泼向敌人。\n如果惹恼它，一瞬间就会被冰镇。

label: SPECIES_IGGLYBUFF.speciesName
source: IGGLYBUFF
translation: 宝宝丁

label: SPECIES_IGGLYBUFF.categoryName
source: Balloon
translation: 气球

label: SPECIES_IGGLYBUFF.description
source:
Its soft and pliable body is very bouncy.
When it sings continuously with all its
might, its body steadily turns a deepening
pink color.
translation: 身体非常的柔软。\n一旦滚起来后就会弹来弹去，\n完全停不下来。

label: SPECIES_JIGGLYPUFF.speciesName
source: JIGGLYPUFF
translation: 胖丁

label: SPECIES_JIGGLYPUFF.categoryName
source: Balloon
translation: 气球

label: SPECIES_JIGGLYPUFF.description
source:
Nothing can avoid falling asleep hearing a
Jigglypuff's song. The sound waves of its
singing voice match the brain waves of
someone in a deep sleep.
translation: 身体胀大后唱出的摇篮曲\n会比平时持续的时间更长，\n绝对会让对方变得昏昏欲睡。

label: SPECIES_WIGGLYTUFF.speciesName
source: WIGGLYTUFF
translation: 胖可丁

label: SPECIES_WIGGLYTUFF.categoryName
source: Balloon
translation: 气球

label: SPECIES_WIGGLYTUFF.description
source:
Its fur is the ultimate in luxuriousness.
Sleeping alongside a Wigglytuff is simply
divine. Its body expands seemingly without
end when it inhales.
translation: 拥有细腻的毛皮。\n注意别惹它生气，\n否则它会不断膨胀并向你压过来。

label: SPECIES_ZUBAT.speciesName
source: ZUBAT
translation: 超音蝠

label: SPECIES_ZUBAT.categoryName
source: Bat
translation: 蝙蝠

label: SPECIES_ZUBAT.description
source:
While living in pitch-black caverns, their
eyes gradually grew shut and deprived
them of vision. They use ultrasonic waves
to detect obstacles.
translation: 即使没有双眼，\n也能靠嘴里发出的超音波\n探察周围的障碍物。

label: SPECIES_GOLBAT.speciesName
source: GOLBAT
translation: 大嘴蝠

label: SPECIES_GOLBAT.categoryName
source: Bat
translation: 蝙蝠

label: SPECIES_GOLBAT.description
source:
Its fangs easily puncture even thick
animal hide. It loves to feast on the blood
of people and Pokémon. It flits about in
darkness and strikes from behind.
translation: 一旦开始吸血，\n在吸饱之前是不会停下来的。\n会在黑暗中飞着寻找猎物。

label: SPECIES_CROBAT.speciesName
source: CROBAT
translation: 叉字蝠

label: SPECIES_CROBAT.categoryName
source: Bat
translation: 蝙蝠

label: SPECIES_CROBAT.description
source:
Over the course of evolution, its hind legs
turned into wings. By alternately resting
its front and rear wings, it can fly all day
without having to stop.
translation: 会用增加到2对的翅膀\n在黑暗中静静飞行。\n就算它从身旁飞过也不会察觉。

label: SPECIES_ODDISH.speciesName
source: ODDISH
translation: 走路草

label: SPECIES_ODDISH.categoryName
source: Weed
translation: 杂草

label: SPECIES_ODDISH.description
source:
This Pokémon grows by absorbing moonlight.
During the daytime, it buries itself in the
ground, leaving only its leaves exposed to
avoid detection by its enemies.
translation: 别名谜行草。\n据说到了晚上，会用2条根走上\n长达300米的距离。

label: SPECIES_GLOOM.speciesName
source: GLOOM
translation: 臭臭花

label: SPECIES_GLOOM.categoryName
source: Weed
translation: 杂草

label: SPECIES_GLOOM.description
source:
A horribly noxious honey drools from its
mouth. One whiff of the honey can result
in memory loss. Some fans are said to
enjoy this overwhelming stink, however.
translation: 从嘴里流出来的蜜有着\n就算在2公里外也能把鼻子\n熏歪的强烈臭味。

label: SPECIES_VILEPLUME.speciesName
source: VILEPLUME
translation: 霸王花

label: SPECIES_VILEPLUME.categoryName
source: Flower
translation: 花

label: SPECIES_VILEPLUME.description
source:
In seasons when it produces more pollen,
the air around a Vileplume turns yellow
with the powder as it walks. The pollen is
highly toxic and causes paralysis.
translation: 它的花瓣是世界上最大的。\n走路时会散播引起严重\n过敏反应的毒花粉。

label: SPECIES_BELLOSSOM.speciesName
source: BELLOSSOM
translation: 美丽花

label: SPECIES_BELLOSSOM.categoryName
source: Flower
translation: 花

label: SPECIES_BELLOSSOM.description
source:
Its flower petals deepen in color through
exposure to sunlight. When cloudy weather
persists, it does a dance that is thought
to be a ritual for summoning the sun.
translation: 大雨的季节结束后，\n受到温暖阳光吸引的美丽花\n就会开始跳舞。

label: SPECIES_PARAS.speciesName
source: PARAS
translation: 派拉斯

label: SPECIES_PARAS.categoryName
source: Mushroom
translation: 蘑菇

label: SPECIES_PARAS.description
source:
A Paras has parasitic tochukaso
mushrooms growing on its back. They grow
by drawing nutrients from the host. They
are valued as a medicine for long life.
translation: 背上长着一种\n名为冬虫夏草的蘑菇。\n蘑菇会和派拉斯一起长大。

label: SPECIES_PARASECT.speciesName
source: PARASECT
translation: 派拉斯特

label: SPECIES_PARASECT.categoryName
source: Mushroom
translation: 蘑菇

label: SPECIES_PARASECT.description
source:
Parasect are known to infest the roots of
large trees en masse and drain nutrients.
When an infested tree dies, they move
onto another tree all at once.
translation: 操纵派拉斯特的是\n比身体还大的蘑菇。\n会播撒有毒的孢子。

label: SPECIES_VENONAT.speciesName
source: VENONAT
translation: 毛球

label: SPECIES_VENONAT.categoryName
source: Insect
translation: 昆虫

label: SPECIES_VENONAT.description
source:
Its coat of thin, stiff hair that covers
its entire body is said to have evolved
for protection. Its large eyes never fail
to spot even miniscule prey.
translation: 大大的眼睛是由许多\n小眼睛汇聚在一起形成的。\n到了晚上会聚集在亮光下。

label: SPECIES_VENOMOTH.speciesName
source: VENOMOTH
translation: 摩鲁蛾

label: SPECIES_VENOMOTH.categoryName
source: Poison Moth
translation: 毒蛾

label: SPECIES_VENOMOTH.description
source:
Venomoth are nocturnal--they are only
active at night. Their favorite prey are
insects that gather around streetlights,
attracted by the light in the darkness.
translation: 翅膀上附着着鳞粉，\n每次翩翩扇动翅膀，\n就会播撒剧毒的粉末。

label: SPECIES_DIGLETT.speciesName
source: DIGLETT
translation: 地鼠

label: SPECIES_DIGLETT.categoryName
source: Mole
translation: 鼹鼠

label: SPECIES_DIGLETT.description
source:
Diglett are raised in most farms.
The reason is simple--wherever they
burrow, the soil is left perfectly tilled
for growing delicious crops.
translation: 皮肤非常薄，\n所以被光照射后，\n就会因血液升温而变得虚弱。

label: SPECIES_DUGTRIO.speciesName
source: DUGTRIO
translation: 三地鼠

label: SPECIES_DUGTRIO.categoryName
source: Mole
translation: 鼹鼠

label: SPECIES_DUGTRIO.description
source:
Because the triplets originally split from
one body, they think exactly alike.
They work cooperatively to burrow
endlessly through the ground.
translation: 在地下挖洞前进，\n会趁对手不注意的时候，\n从其他地方发动攻击。

label: SPECIES_DIGLETT_ALOLA.description
source:
The metal-rich geology of its habitat
caused it to develop steel whiskers on its
head that change shape depending on its
mood and when communicating with others.
translation: 金色的胡子拥有感应器的功能。\n从洞里伸出，\n查探周围的状态。

label: SPECIES_DUGTRIO_ALOLA.description
source:
Their beautiful, metallic whiskers create
a sort of protective helmet on
heir heads, and they also function
as highly precise sensors.
translation: 金属材质的胡须很重，\n所以速度不怎么快，\n但有着能挖穿坚硬岩盘的力量。

label: SPECIES_MEOWTH.speciesName
source: MEOWTH
translation: 喵喵

label: SPECIES_MEOWTH.categoryName
source: Scratch Cat
translation: 妖怪猫

label: SPECIES_MEOWTH.description
source:
Meowth withdraw their sharp claws into
their paws to silently sneak about.
For some reason, this Pokémon loves
shiny coins that glitter with light.
translation: 有着半夜活动的习性。\n找到闪闪发亮的东西时，\n眼睛也会毫不逊色地闪闪发光。
