label: SPECIES_PERSIAN.speciesName
source: PERSIAN
translation: 猫老大

label: SPECIES_PERSIAN.categoryName
source: Classy Cat
translation: 暹罗猫

label: SPECIES_PERSIAN.description
source:
A Persian's six bold whiskers sense air
movements to determine what is in its
vicinity. It becomes docile if grabbed
by the whiskers.
translation: 有着漂亮的毛色，\n很多人想把它当宠物养，\n但它很爱乱抓，所以很难养熟。

label: SPECIES_MEOWTH_ALOLA.speciesName
source: MEOWTH
translation: 喵喵

label: SPECIES_MEOWTH_ALOLA.description
source:
It's accustomed to luxury because it used
to live with Alolan royalty. Highly smart
and proud, it's famously difficult to
handle, but that also makes it popular.
translation: 额头上的金币越黑就越硬，\n也越能受到伙伴的尊敬。\n性格勇猛，什么都不怕。

label: SPECIES_PERSIAN_ALOLA.description
source:
It looks down on everyone other than
itself. In contrast to its lovely face, it
is so brutal that it tortures its weakened
prey rather than finishing them off.
translation: 自尊心和智商都很高。\n会狡猾地应战，\n反复攻击敌人的弱点。

label: SPECIES_MEOWTH_GALAR.speciesName
source: MEOWTH
translation: 喵喵

label: SPECIES_MEOWTH_GALAR.description
source:
Living with a savage, seafaring people has
hardened its body so much that parts of it
turned to iron. Darker coins are harder
and garner more respect among Meowth.
translation: 不但拥有优秀的体能，\n还擅长卑鄙的战斗方式，\n非常不好对付。

label: SPECIES_PERRSERKER.speciesName
source: PERRSERKER
translation: 喵头目

label: SPECIES_PERRSERKER.categoryName
source: Viking
translation: 维京

label: SPECIES_PERRSERKER.description
source: What appears to be an iron helmet is\nactually hardened hair. This Pokémon\nlives for the thrill of battle.
translation: 在日复一日的战斗中得以进化。\n进化的结果是那危险的指甲，\n留长后能当作短剑来用。

label: SPECIES_MEOWTH_GMAX.speciesName
source: MEOWTH
translation: 喵喵

label: SPECIES_MEOWTH_GMAX.categoryName
source: Scratch Cat
translation: 妖怪猫

label: SPECIES_MEOWTH_GMAX.description
source:
The pattern that has appeared on
its giant coin is thought to be the
key to unlocking the secrets of the
Dynamax phenomenon.
translation: 受超极巨化之力的影响，\n身体越长越高，\n额头上的金币也变成了大金币。

label: SPECIES_PSYDUCK.speciesName
source: PSYDUCK
translation: 可达鸭

label: SPECIES_PSYDUCK.categoryName
source: Duck
translation: 鸭

label: SPECIES_PSYDUCK.description
source:
When its headache intensifies, it starts
using strange powers. However, it has no
recollection of its powers, so it always
looks befuddled and bewildered.
translation: 一直受到头痛的困扰。\n在头痛欲裂时，\n就会开始使用神奇的力量。

label: SPECIES_GOLDUCK.speciesName
source: GOLDUCK
translation: 哥达鸭

label: SPECIES_GOLDUCK.categoryName
source: Duck
translation: 鸭

label: SPECIES_GOLDUCK.description
source:
A Golduck is an adept swimmer.
It sometimes joins competitive swimmers
in training. It uses psychic powers when
its forehead shimmers with light.
translation: 当它靠着带有蹼的\n修长手脚全力游泳时，\n不知为何额头会闪闪发光。

label: SPECIES_MANKEY.speciesName
source: MANKEY
translation: 猴怪

label: SPECIES_MANKEY.categoryName
source: Pig Monkey
translation: 猪猴

label: SPECIES_MANKEY.description
source:
When it starts shaking and its nasal
breathing turns rough, it's a sure sign
of anger. However, since this happens
instantly, there is no time to flee.
translation: 在树上生活。\n如果群体中有1只发起火来，\n整个群体都会无缘无故地暴怒起来。

label: SPECIES_PRIMEAPE.speciesName
source: PRIMEAPE
translation: 火暴猴

label: SPECIES_PRIMEAPE.categoryName
source: Pig Monkey
translation: 猪猴

label: SPECIES_PRIMEAPE.description
source:
When it becomes furious, its blood
circulation becomes more robust, and
its muscles are made stronger. But it
also becomes much less intelligent.
translation: 只要视线对上它就会发怒，\n如果转身逃跑它还会发怒，\n就算打扁了对方，它仍然会发怒。

label: SPECIES_ANNIHILAPE.speciesName
source: ANNIHILAPE
translation: 弃世猴

label: SPECIES_ANNIHILAPE.categoryName
source: Rage Monkey
translation: 愤怒猴

label: SPECIES_ANNIHILAPE.description
source:
When its anger rose beyond a
critical point, this Pokémon gained power
that is unfettered by the limits of
its physical body.
translation: 会将隐藏在心里的\n愤怒之情凝聚在拳头里，\n其威力能深入对手骨髓，使其粉碎。

label: SPECIES_GROWLITHE.speciesName
source: GROWLITHE
translation: 卡蒂狗

label: SPECIES_GROWLITHE.categoryName
source: Puppy
translation: 小狗

label: SPECIES_GROWLITHE.description
source:
Its superb sense of smell ensures that
this Pokémon won't forget any scent,
no matter what. It uses its sense of smell
to detect the emotions of others.
translation: 能毫无畏惧地去对抗\n比自己更强更大的对手。\n性格勇敢非常可靠。

label: SPECIES_ARCANINE.speciesName
source: ARCANINE
translation: 风速狗

label: SPECIES_ARCANINE.categoryName
source: Legendary
translation: 传说

label: SPECIES_ARCANINE.description
source:
This fleet-footed Pokémon is said to run
over 6,200 miles in a single day and night.
The fire that blazes wildly within its body
is its source of power.
translation: 威风凛凛的叫声充满威严，\n不管是谁听到后，\n都会不由自主地跪倒下去。

label: SPECIES_GROWLITHE_HISUI.description
source:
They patrol their territory in pairs.
It's believed the igneous rock components
in the fur of this species are the result
of volcanic activity in its habitat.
translation: 两只一组共同负责地盘的警卫工作。\n体毛中混有火成岩的成分，\n可以推想这是受到火山活动的影响。

label: SPECIES_ARCANINE_HISUI.description
source:
Snaps at its foes with fangs cloaked in
blazing flame. Despite its bulk, it deftly
feints every which way, leading opponents
on a deceptively merry chase.
translation: 将猛烈燃烧的火焰缠绕在牙齿上\n扑向猎物。虽然体型很大，却能以\n舞蹈般的假动作戏弄敌手。

label: SPECIES_POLIWAG.speciesName
source: POLIWAG
translation: 蚊香蝌蚪

label: SPECIES_POLIWAG.categoryName
source: Tadpole
translation: 蝌蚪

label: SPECIES_POLIWAG.description
source:
It is possible to see this Pokémon's spiral
innards right through its thin skin.
However, the skin is also very flexible.
Even sharp fangs bounce right off it.
translation: 皮肤薄得能看到里面的内脏。\n因为刚刚长出两条腿来，\n所以它还不擅长走路。

label: SPECIES_POLIWHIRL.speciesName
source: POLIWHIRL
translation: 蚊香君

label: SPECIES_POLIWHIRL.categoryName
source: Tadpole
translation: 蝌蚪

label: SPECIES_POLIWHIRL.description
source:
Its body surface is always wet and slick
with an oily fluid. Because of this greasy
covering, it can easily slip and slide out
of the clutches of any enemy in battle.
translation: 2条腿很发达，\n虽然可以在地上生活，\n但不知为何更喜欢生活在水里。

label: SPECIES_POLIWRATH.speciesName
source: POLIWRATH
translation: 蚊香泳士

label: SPECIES_POLIWRATH.categoryName
source: Tadpole
translation: 蝌蚪

label: SPECIES_POLIWRATH.description
source:
Its highly developed muscles never grow
fatigued, however much it exercises.
This Pokémon can swim back and forth
across the Pacific Ocean without effort.
translation: 拥有强韧的肌肉。\n可以中途无休地游泳穿越太平洋。

label: SPECIES_POLITOED.speciesName
source: POLITOED
translation: 蚊香蛙皇

label: SPECIES_POLITOED.categoryName
source: Frog
translation: 蛙

label: SPECIES_POLITOED.description
source:
The curled hair on its head proves its
status as a king. It is said that the
longer and curlier the hair, the more
respect it earns from its peers.
translation: 以蚊香蛙皇为头领组成团队。\n蚊香蛙皇的叫声能让\n蚊香蝌蚪们都对它服服帖帖。

label: SPECIES_ABRA.speciesName
source: ABRA
translation: 凯西

label: SPECIES_ABRA.categoryName
source: Psi
translation: 念力

label: SPECIES_ABRA.description
source:
A Pokémon that sleeps 18 hours a day.
Observation revealed that it uses
Teleport to change its location once
every hour.
translation: 能察觉攻击的苗头，\n在受到袭击前便会迅速地\n使用瞬间移动离开原地。

label: SPECIES_KADABRA.speciesName
source: KADABRA
translation: 勇基拉

label: SPECIES_KADABRA.categoryName
source: Psi
translation: 念力

label: SPECIES_KADABRA.description
source:
It is rumored that a boy with psychic
abilities suddenly transformed into
Kadabra while he was assisting research
into extrasensory powers.
translation: 发挥超能力时发出的\n强烈阿尔法波会损坏精密器械。

label: SPECIES_ALAKAZAM.speciesName
source: ALAKAZAM
translation: 胡地

label: SPECIES_ALAKAZAM.categoryName
source: Psi
translation: 念力

label: SPECIES_ALAKAZAM.description
source:
While it has strong psychic abilities and
high intelligence, an Alakazam's muscles
are very weak. It uses psychic power to
move its body.
translation: 有着比超级计算机的\n计算速度更快的头脑。\n其智商大概是5000。

label: SPECIES_ALAKAZAM_MEGA.categoryName
source: Psi
translation: 念力

label: SPECIES_ALAKAZAM_MEGA.description
source: Having traded away its muscles, Alakazam's\ntrue power has been unleashed. With its\npsychic powers, it can foresee all things.
translation: 胡地擅长预测未来。\n当你在战斗中无法击中它时，\n就说明它正在品读你的未来。

label: SPECIES_MACHOP.speciesName
source: MACHOP
translation: 腕力

label: SPECIES_MACHOP.categoryName
source: Superpower
translation: 怪力

label: SPECIES_MACHOP.description
source:
It continually undertakes strenuous
training to master all forms of martial
arts. Its strength lets it easily hoist
a sumo wrestler onto its shoulders.
translation: 全身都是肌肉，\n虽然只有小孩那么大，\n却可以扔飞100个成年人。

label: SPECIES_MACHOKE.speciesName
source: MACHOKE
translation: 豪力

label: SPECIES_MACHOKE.categoryName
source: Superpower
translation: 怪力

label: SPECIES_MACHOKE.description
source:
A belt is worn by a Machoke to keep its
overwhelming power under control.
Because it is so dangerous, no one has
ever removed the belt.
translation: 因为肉体非常强韧，\n所以戴着力量限制腰带来控制力量。

label: SPECIES_MACHAMP.speciesName
source: MACHAMP
translation: 怪力

label: SPECIES_MACHAMP.categoryName
source: Superpower
translation: 怪力

label: SPECIES_MACHAMP.description
source:
It is impossible to defend against punches
and chops doled out by its four arms.
Its fighting spirit flares up when it faces
a tough opponent.
translation: 能够迅速活动4只手臂，\n从各个角度毫不停歇地\n使出拳击或手刀。

label: SPECIES_MACHAMP_GMAX.speciesName
source: MACHAMP
translation: 怪力

label: SPECIES_MACHAMP_GMAX.categoryName
source: Superpower
translation: 怪力

label: SPECIES_MACHAMP_GMAX.description
source:
One of these Pokémon once used
its immeasurable strength to lift a
large ship that was in trouble. It
then carried the ship to port.
translation: 怪力提升到了惊人境界，\n甚至曾经把受困的大型船只\n整艘扛到了港口。

label: SPECIES_BELLSPROUT.speciesName
source: BELLSPROUT
translation: 喇叭芽

label: SPECIES_BELLSPROUT.categoryName
source: Flower
translation: 花

label: SPECIES_BELLSPROUT.description
source:
A Bellsprout's thin and flexible body lets
it bend and sway to avoid any attack,
however strong it may be. From its mouth,
it leaks a fluid that melts even iron.
translation: 喜欢高温多湿的土地。\n伸长藤蔓捕捉猎物时的动作非常迅速。

label: SPECIES_WEEPINBELL.speciesName
source: WEEPINBELL
translation: 口呆花

label: SPECIES_WEEPINBELL.categoryName
source: Flycatcher
translation: 捕蝇

label: SPECIES_WEEPINBELL.description
source:
At night, a Weepinbell hangs on to a tree
branch with its hooked rear and sleeps.
If it moves around in its sleep, it may
wake up to find itself on the ground.
translation: 叶子部分会变成刀刃切割对手。\n嘴里会吐出可溶化万物的液体。

label: SPECIES_VICTREEBEL.speciesName
source: VICTREEBEL
translation: 大食花

label: SPECIES_VICTREEBEL.categoryName
source: Flycatcher
translation: 捕蝇

label: SPECIES_VICTREEBEL.description
source:
The long vine extending from its head is
waved about as if it were a living thing to
attract prey. When an unsuspecting victim
approaches, it is swallowed whole.
translation: 嘴里积蓄的液体虽然\n散发着蜜一般的香气，\n却是可溶化一切的溶解液。

label: SPECIES_VICTREEBEL_MEGA.categoryName
source: Flycatcher
translation: 捕蝇

label: SPECIES_VICTREEBEL_MEGA.description
source:
The volume of this Pokémon's acid
has increased due to Mega Evolution,
filling its mouth. If not careful,
the acid will overflow and spill out.
translation: 口中充满因超级进化\n而增加的溶解液。一不留神\n就会从嘴里溢出。

label: SPECIES_TENTACOOL.speciesName
source: TENTACOOL
translation: 玛瑙水母

label: SPECIES_TENTACOOL.categoryName
source: Jellyfish
translation: 水母

label: SPECIES_TENTACOOL.description
source:
Its body is almost entirely composed of
water. It ensnares its foe with its two
long tentacles, then stabs with the poison
stingers at their tips.
translation: 会从水晶般晶莹剔透的眼珠里\n发射带有神奇光芒的光束。

label: SPECIES_TENTACRUEL.speciesName
source: TENTACRUEL
translation: 毒刺水母

label: SPECIES_TENTACRUEL.categoryName
source: Jellyfish
translation: 水母

label: SPECIES_TENTACRUEL.description
source:
It lives in complex rock formations on
the ocean floor and traps prey using its
80 tentacles. Its red orbs glow when it
grows excited or agitated.
translation: 战斗时会将80根触手全部伸出，\n制成有毒的包围网。

label: SPECIES_GEODUDE.speciesName
source: GEODUDE
translation: 小拳石

label: SPECIES_GEODUDE.categoryName
source: Rock
translation: 岩石

label: SPECIES_GEODUDE.description
source:
It climbs mountain paths using only the
power of its arms. Because they look just
like boulders lining paths, hikers may step
on them without noticing.
translation: 不动的时候怎么看都是颗小石头。\n要是因此不小心踩到它，\n它就会挥舞拳头大发雷霆。

label: SPECIES_GRAVELER.speciesName
source: GRAVELER
translation: 隆隆石

label: SPECIES_GRAVELER.categoryName
source: Rock
translation: 岩石

label: SPECIES_GRAVELER.description
source:
They descend from mountains by tumbling
down steep slopes. They are so brutal,
they smash aside obstructing trees and
massive boulders with thunderous tackles.
translation: 因为走路很慢，\n所以靠滚来移动。\n途中遇到什么都不会在意。

label: SPECIES_GOLEM.speciesName
source: GOLEM
translation: 隆隆岩

label: SPECIES_GOLEM.categoryName
source: Megaton
translation: 重量级

label: SPECIES_GOLEM.description
source:
It is said to live in volcanic craters
on mountain peaks. Once a year, it sheds
its hide and grows larger. The shed hide
crumbles and returns to the soil.
translation: 它的身体像岩石一样坚硬，\n即使是炸药也无法伤其分毫。\n1年只蜕皮1次。

label: SPECIES_GEODUDE_ALOLA.speciesName
source: GEODUDE
translation: 小拳石

label: SPECIES_GEODUDE_ALOLA.description
source:
Its body is a magnetic stone. Iron sand
attach to parts of its body with stronger
magnetism. If you carelessly step on one,
it will headbutt and shock you in anger.
translation: 如果踩到在地面睡觉的小拳石，\n就会发出叮--的响声，\n一下子全身都麻痹了。

label: SPECIES_GRAVELER_ALOLA.speciesName
source: GRAVELER
translation: 隆隆石

label: SPECIES_GRAVELER_ALOLA.description
source:
When two Graveler smash each other over
dravite, their favorite food, they cause
flashes of light and booming noises.
People call them “fireworks of the earth.”
translation: 受到喜欢吃的石头影响，\n它全身都带着电。\n性格非常好斗。

label: SPECIES_GOLEM_ALOLA.speciesName
source: GOLEM
translation: 隆隆岩

label: SPECIES_GOLEM_ALOLA.description
source:
It fires rocks charged with electricity.
Even if the rock isn't fired that
accurately, just grazing an opponent
will cause numbness and fainting.
translation: 发射出带着电的岩石。\n哪怕没有命中，只是擦到，\n对手也会麻痹而失去意识。

label: SPECIES_PONYTA.speciesName
source: PONYTA
translation: 小火马

label: SPECIES_PONYTA.categoryName
source: Fire Horse
translation: 火马

label: SPECIES_PONYTA.description
source:
A Ponyta is very weak at birth. It can
barely stand up. Its legs become stronger
as it stumbles and falls while trying to
keep up with its parent.
translation: 刚出生时连站起来都十分不易。\n但跑得越多，腰腿就会被锻炼得\n越多，速度也会随之增加。

label: SPECIES_RAPIDASH.speciesName
source: RAPIDASH
translation: 烈焰马

label: SPECIES_RAPIDASH.categoryName
source: Fire Horse
translation: 火马

label: SPECIES_RAPIDASH.description
source:
It usually canters casually in the fields
and plains. But once a Rapidash turns
serious, its fiery manes flare and blaze
as it gallops its way up to 150 mph.
translation: 奔跑时速为240公里。\n鬃毛上的火焰会剧烈燃烧，\n能像箭一样地飞驰而去。

label: SPECIES_PONYTA_GALAR.speciesName
source: PONYTA
translation: 小火马

label: SPECIES_PONYTA_GALAR.description
source:
Its small horn hides a healing power.
This Pokémon will look into your eyes and
read the contents of your heart. If it
finds evil there, it promptly hides away.
translation: 能从眼神中读取对方的内心。\n如果发现了邪恶的想法，\n就会在转眼间消失不见。

label: SPECIES_RAPIDASH_GALAR.speciesName
source: RAPIDASH
translation: 烈焰马

label: SPECIES_RAPIDASH_GALAR.description
source:
Little can stand up to its psycho cut.
Unleashed from this Pokémon's horn,
the move will punch a hole right
through a thick metal sheet.
translation: 勇猛果敢，自尊心强。\n会在蹄子上的毛里储存精神力量，\n在森林中轻快地奔跑。

label: SPECIES_SLOWPOKE.speciesName
source: SLOWPOKE
translation: 呆呆兽

label: SPECIES_SLOWPOKE.categoryName
source: Dopey
translation: 憨憨

label: SPECIES_SLOWPOKE.description
source:
It catches prey by dipping its tail in
water at the side of a river. But it often
forgets what it is doing and spends entire
days just loafing at water's edge.
translation: 总是在发呆，\n不知道它在想些什么。\n很擅长用尾巴来钓食物。

label: SPECIES_SLOWBRO.speciesName
source: SLOWBRO
translation: 呆壳兽

label: SPECIES_SLOWBRO.categoryName
source: Hermit Crab
translation: 寄居蟹

label: SPECIES_SLOWBRO.description
source:
Its tail has a Shellder firmly attached
with a bite. As a result, the tail can't be
used for fishing anymore. This forces it
to reluctantly swim and catch prey.
translation: 呆呆兽去海里捕食时，\n由于被大舌贝咬住尾巴\n而变成了呆壳兽。

label: SPECIES_SLOWKING.speciesName
source: SLOWKING
translation: 呆呆王

label: SPECIES_SLOWKING.categoryName
source: Royal
translation: 王者

label: SPECIES_SLOWKING.description
source:
It undertakes research every day to
solve the mysteries of the world.
However, it apparently forgets everything
if the Shellder on its head comes off.
translation: 有着非凡的智慧和灵感。\n不论何时都会不慌不忙，\n一副悠然自得的样子。

label: SPECIES_SLOWBRO_MEGA.speciesName
source: SLOWBRO
translation: 呆壳兽

label: SPECIES_SLOWBRO_MEGA.categoryName
source: Hermit Crab
translation: 寄居蟹

label: SPECIES_SLOWBRO_MEGA.description
source:
When bathed in the energy of Mega
Evolution, Shellder converts into
impregnable armor. There is virtually no
change in Slowpoke.
translation: 沉浸在大舌贝的消化液里\n成功觉醒的呆呆兽。\n获得了一丁点干劲和非常多的能量。

label: SPECIES_SLOWPOKE_GALAR.speciesName
source: SLOWPOKE
translation: 呆呆兽

label: SPECIES_SLOWPOKE_GALAR.description
source:
Although it is normally zoned out, its
expression abruptly sharpens on occasion.
The cause seems to lie in Slowpoke's diet,
which also give their tails a spicy flavor.
translation: 虽然会用尾巴来垂钓，\n但渗出的香料味却害得\n它总是成果一般。

label: SPECIES_SLOWBRO_GALAR.speciesName
source: SLOWBRO
translation: 呆壳兽

label: SPECIES_SLOWBRO_GALAR.description
source:
A Shellder bite set off a chemical reaction
with the spices inside Slowbro's body,
causing Slowbro to become a
Poison-type Pokémon.
translation: 大舌贝为了吸取更多手臂的毒素\n会用力咬它，而这似乎会让它发痒，\n所以它偶尔会发狂。

label: SPECIES_SLOWKING_GALAR.speciesName
source: SLOWKING
translation: 呆呆王

label: SPECIES_SLOWKING_GALAR.description
source:
A combination of toxins and the shock of
evolving has increased Shellder's
intelligence to the point that Shellder
now controls Slowking.
translation: 虽然会混合吃掉的东西\n和毒液来制造药物，\n但其效果连呆呆王自己也不知道。

label: SPECIES_MAGNEMITE.speciesName
source: MAGNEMITE
translation: 小磁怪

label: SPECIES_MAGNEMITE.categoryName
source: Magnet
translation: 磁铁

label: SPECIES_MAGNEMITE.description
source:
The units at its sides are extremely
powerful magnets. They generate enough
magnetism to draw in iron objects from
over 300 feet away.
translation: 会浮在空中移动，\n并从左右的组件里发射电磁波什么的。

label: SPECIES_MAGNETON.speciesName
source: MAGNETON
translation: 三合一磁怪

label: SPECIES_MAGNETON.categoryName
source: Magnet
translation: 磁铁

label: SPECIES_MAGNETON.description
source:
It is actually three Magnemite linked
by magnetism. It generates powerful radio
waves that raise temperatures by 3.6
degrees F within a 3,300-foot radius.
translation: 听说这种连在一起的小磁怪\n会在太阳黑子多的时候大量地出现。

label: SPECIES_MAGNEZONE.speciesName
source: MAGNEZONE
translation: 自爆磁怪

label: SPECIES_MAGNEZONE.categoryName
source: Magnet Area
translation: 磁场

label: SPECIES_MAGNEZONE.description
source:
As it zooms through the sky, this
Pokémon seems to be receiving signals
of unknown origin, while transmitting its
own signals of unknown purpose.
translation: 由受到特殊磁场影响的\n三合一磁怪进化而来。\n从3个组件中放出磁力。

label: SPECIES_FARFETCHD.speciesName
source: FARFETCH'D
translation: 大葱鸭

label: SPECIES_FARFETCHD.categoryName
source: Wild Duck
translation: 黄嘴鸭

label: SPECIES_FARFETCHD.description
source:
It is always seen with a stick from a plant.
Apparently, there are good sticks and bad
sticks. This Pokémon occasionally fights
with others over choice sticks.
translation: 如果没有了茎就无法生存。\n所以会拼命与想要抢夺茎的对手战斗。

label: SPECIES_FARFETCHD_GALAR.description
source:
The stalks of leeks are thicker and longer
in the Galar region. Brave Farfetch'd
warriors that adapted to these stalks
took on a unique form.
translation: 在不断活用又粗又长的\n伽勒尔大葱的过程中，\n大葱鸭演化成了独特的样子。

label: SPECIES_SIRFETCHD.speciesName
source: SIRFETCH'D
translation: 葱游兵

label: SPECIES_SIRFETCHD.categoryName
source: Wild Duck
translation: 黄嘴鸭

label: SPECIES_SIRFETCHD.description
source:
Only Farfetch'd that have survived many
battles can attain this evolution. When
this Pokémon's leek withers, it will
retire from combat.
translation: 会用坚硬的葱叶抵挡攻击，\n接着用锋利的茎反击。\n它的葱既是武器也是食材。

label: SPECIES_DODUO.speciesName
source: DODUO
translation: 嘟嘟

label: SPECIES_DODUO.categoryName
source: Twin Bird
translation: 两头鸟

label: SPECIES_DODUO.description
source:
Even while eating or sleeping, one of the
heads remains always vigilant for any sign
of danger. When threatened, it flees at
over 60 miles per hour.
translation: 2个脑袋好像能用类似\n心灵感应的力量来互通想法。

label: SPECIES_DODRIO.speciesName
source: DODRIO
translation: 嘟嘟利

label: SPECIES_DODRIO.categoryName
source: Triple Bird
translation: 三头鸟

label: SPECIES_DODRIO.description
source:
A peculiar Pokémon species with three
heads. It vigorously races across grassy
plains even in arid seasons with little
rainfall.
translation: 在进化时嘟嘟的某个头\n分裂后形成的珍稀物种。\n能以时速60公里以上的速度奔跑。

label: SPECIES_SEEL.speciesName
source: SEEL
translation: 小海狮

label: SPECIES_SEEL.categoryName
source: Sea Lion
translation: 海狮

label: SPECIES_SEEL.description
source:
Seel hunt for prey in frigid, ice-covered
seas. When it needs to breathe, it punches
a hole through the ice with the sharply
protruding section of its head.
translation: 生活在冰山上的宝可梦。\n会用头上尖锐的突起部分\n破开冰层在海里游泳。

label: SPECIES_DEWGONG.speciesName
source: DEWGONG
translation: 白海狮

label: SPECIES_DEWGONG.categoryName
source: Sea Lion
translation: 海狮

label: SPECIES_DEWGONG.description
source:
It loves to snooze on bitterly cold ice.
The sight of this Pokémon sleeping on
a glacier was mistakenly thought to be
a mermaid by a mariner long ago.
translation: 为了战胜寒冷而在体内储存热能。\n即使在寒冷的大海也\n能以8节的速度前进。

label: SPECIES_GRIMER.speciesName
source: GRIMER
translation: 臭泥

label: SPECIES_GRIMER.categoryName
source: Sludge
translation: 污泥

label: SPECIES_GRIMER.description
source:
Born from polluted sludge in the sea,
Grimer's favorite food is anything filthy.
They feed on wastewater pumped out from
factories.
translation: 污水河的污泥受到来自月亮的\nX射线照射后变成了臭泥。\n会出现在肮脏的地方。

label: SPECIES_MUK.speciesName
source: MUK
translation: 臭臭泥

label: SPECIES_MUK.categoryName
source: Sludge
translation: 污泥

label: SPECIES_MUK.description
source:
It prefers warm and humid habitats.
In the summertime, the toxic substances
in its body intensify, making Muk reek like
putrid kitchen garbage.
translation: 从身体里会渗出有剧毒的体液。\n草木一沾上那液体就会瞬间枯萎。

label: SPECIES_GRIMER_ALOLA.categoryName
source: Sludge
translation: 污泥攻击

label: SPECIES_GRIMER_ALOLA.description
source:
There are a hundred or so of them living
in Alola's waste-disposal site. They're all
hard workers who eat a lot of trash. Grimer
seems to relish any and all kinds of trash.
translation: 任何垃圾都能吃得很美味，\n因此在处理垃圾的地方它能大显身手，\n十分受欢迎。

label: SPECIES_MUK_ALOLA.categoryName
source: Sludge
translation: 污泥攻击

label: SPECIES_MUK_ALOLA.description
source:
While it's unexpectedly quiet and friendly,
if it's not fed any trash for a while,,
it will smash its Trainer's furnishings,
and eat up the fragments.
translation: 看上去像牙齿或爪子的东西其实是\n毒素的结晶。只要碰到就会中毒，\n所以靠近它很危险。

label: SPECIES_SHELLDER.speciesName
source: SHELLDER
translation: 大舌贝

label: SPECIES_SHELLDER.categoryName
source: Bivalve
translation: 双壳贝

label: SPECIES_SHELLDER.description
source:
At night, it burrows a hole in the seafloor
with its broad tongue to make a place to
sleep. While asleep, it closes its shell,
but leaves its tongue hanging out.
translation: 通过2片贝壳的不断开合\n来向后方游动。不管什么时候\n大大的舌头都一直露在外面。

label: SPECIES_CLOYSTER.speciesName
source: CLOYSTER
translation: 刺甲贝

label: SPECIES_CLOYSTER.categoryName
source: Bivalve
translation: 双壳贝

label: SPECIES_CLOYSTER.description
source:
It swims in the sea by swallowing water,
then jetting it out toward the rear.
The Cloyster shoots spikes from its
shell using the same system.
translation: 会使用一边紧闭外壳保护自身，\n一边发射尖刺击退敌人的战法。

label: SPECIES_GASTLY.speciesName
source: GASTLY
translation: 鬼斯

label: SPECIES_GASTLY.categoryName
source: Gas
translation: 气体状

label: SPECIES_GASTLY.description
source:
When exposed to a strong wind, a Gastly's
gaseous body quickly dwindles away.
They cluster under the eaves of houses
to escape the ravages of wind.
translation: 从气体中诞生的生命体。\n如果被含毒的气体状身体裹住的话，\n不管是谁都会昏迷过去。

label: SPECIES_HAUNTER.speciesName
source: HAUNTER
translation: 鬼斯通

label: SPECIES_HAUNTER.categoryName
source: Gas
translation: 气体状

label: SPECIES_HAUNTER.description
source:
If a Haunter beckons you while it is
floating in darkness, don't approach it.
This Pokémon will try to lick you with its
tongue and steal your life away.
translation: 喜欢隐匿在黑暗中伸出\n气体状的手去拍人的肩膀。\n若被它碰到，身体就会抖个不停。

label: SPECIES_GENGAR.speciesName
source: GENGAR
translation: 耿鬼

label: SPECIES_GENGAR.categoryName
source: Shadow
translation: 影子

label: SPECIES_GENGAR.description
source:
Deep in the night, your shadow cast by
a streetlight may suddenly overtake you.
It is actually a Gengar running past
you, pretending to be your shadow.
translation: 会在半夜潜入人的影子，\n一点点地夺走人的体温。\n如果被它盯上，就会全身不停地发冷。

label: SPECIES_GENGAR_MEGA.speciesName
source: GENGAR
translation: 耿鬼

label: SPECIES_GENGAR_MEGA.categoryName
source: Shadow
translation: 影子

label: SPECIES_GENGAR_MEGA.description
source:
Gengar's relationships are warped. It
tries to take the lives of anyone and
everyone. It will even try to curse the
Trainer who is its master!
translation: 能穿过异次元前往任何地方。\n当它从墙壁里伸出一只脚的时候，\n周围的人都乱成了一团。

label: SPECIES_GENGAR_GMAX.speciesName
source: GENGAR
translation: 耿鬼

label: SPECIES_GENGAR_GMAX.categoryName
source: Shadow
translation: 影子

label: SPECIES_GENGAR_GMAX.description
source:
Rumor has it that its gigantic
mouth leads not into its body, filled
with cursed energy, but instead
directly to the afterlife.
translation: 会设下致命的陷阱。\n如果站在它的嘴巴前面，\n就会听见心爱之人呼唤自己的声音。

label: SPECIES_ONIX.speciesName
source: ONIX
translation: 大岩蛇

label: SPECIES_ONIX.categoryName
source: Rock Snake
translation: 岩蛇

label: SPECIES_ONIX.description
source:
There is a magnet in its brain that
prevents an Onix from losing direction
while tunneling. As it grows older, its body
becomes steadily rounder and smoother.
translation: 弯曲扭动巨大结实的身体，\n以时速80公里的猛烈劲头向前挖进。

label: SPECIES_STEELIX.speciesName
source: STEELIX
translation: 大钢蛇

label: SPECIES_STEELIX.categoryName
source: Iron Snake
translation: 铁蛇

label: SPECIES_STEELIX.description
source:
Steelix live even further underground
than Onix. This Pokémon is known to dig
toward the earth's core, reaching a depth
of over six-tenths of a mile underground.
translation: 据说当大岩蛇活到了100年以上，\n身体的成分就会变得如同钻石一般。

label: SPECIES_STEELIX_MEGA.speciesName
source: STEELIX
translation: 大钢蛇

label: SPECIES_STEELIX_MEGA.categoryName
source: Iron Snake
translation: 铁蛇

label: SPECIES_STEELIX_MEGA.description
source:
The cells within its body, crystallized by
the energy produced from Mega Evolution,
are stronger than any mineral and able
to withstand any temperature.
translation: 它体内的细胞是由超级进化产生的\n能量结晶而成，比任何矿物都坚固，\n能够承受任何温度。

label: SPECIES_DROWZEE.speciesName
source: DROWZEE
translation: 催眠貘

label: SPECIES_DROWZEE.categoryName
source: Hypnosis
translation: 催眠

label: SPECIES_DROWZEE.description
source:
If your nose becomes itchy while you are
sleeping, it's a sure sign that a Drowzee is
standing above your pillow and trying to
eat your dream through your nostrils.
translation: 据说它那突出的鼻子在抽动时，\n可以知晓对方正在做的梦的内容。\n最喜欢吃愉快的梦。

label: SPECIES_HYPNO.speciesName
source: HYPNO
translation: 引梦貘人

label: SPECIES_HYPNO.categoryName
source: Hypnosis
translation: 催眠

label: SPECIES_HYPNO.description
source:
The arcing movement and glitter of the
pendulum in a Hypno's hand lull the foe
into deep hypnosis. While searching for
prey, it polishes the pendulum.
translation: 如果被它拿着钟摆在眼前晃悠，\n就算是刚睡醒的人，\n也会在3秒后睡着。

label: SPECIES_KRABBY.speciesName
source: KRABBY
translation: 大钳蟹

label: SPECIES_KRABBY.categoryName
source: River Crab
translation: 清水蟹

label: SPECIES_KRABBY.description
source:
Krabby live in holes dug into beaches.
On sandy shores with little in the way
of food, they can be seen squabbling with
each other over territory.
translation: 生活在沙滩上挖的洞里面。\n钳子即使在战斗中脱落，\n也会再长出一模一样的来。

label: SPECIES_KINGLER.speciesName
source: KINGLER
translation: 巨钳蟹

label: SPECIES_KINGLER.categoryName
source: Pincer
translation: 钳子

label: SPECIES_KINGLER.description
source:
It waves its huge, oversized claw in the
air to communicate with others.
But since the claw is so heavy, this
Pokémon quickly tires.
translation: 大的钳子拥有1万马力的力量。\n但由于太重了，\n导致很难瞄准目标。

label: SPECIES_KINGLER_GMAX.speciesName
source: KINGLER
translation: 巨钳蟹

label: SPECIES_KINGLER_GMAX.categoryName
source: Pincer
translation: 钳子

label: SPECIES_KINGLER_GMAX.description
source:
The flow of Gigantamax energy has
spurred this Pokémon's left pincer
to grow to an enormous size. That
claw can pulverize anything.
translation: 会吐出强碱性的泡沫，\n对手一旦被泡沫沾上，\n身体就会立刻溶化。

label: SPECIES_VOLTORB.speciesName
source: VOLTORB
translation: 霹雳电球

label: SPECIES_VOLTORB.categoryName
source: Ball
translation: 球

label: SPECIES_VOLTORB.description
source:
It bears an uncanny and unexplained
resemblance to a Poké Ball. Because it
explodes at the slightest shock, even
veteran Trainers treat it with caution.
translation: 会出现在发电厂等地方。\n很多人都会把它错当成\n精灵球去触碰而被电麻。

label: SPECIES_ELECTRODE.speciesName
source: ELECTRODE
translation: 顽皮雷弹

label: SPECIES_ELECTRODE.categoryName
source: Ball
translation: 球

label: SPECIES_ELECTRODE.description
source:
They appear in great numbers at electric
power plants. Because they feed on
electricity, they cause massive and
chaotic blackouts in nearby cities.
translation: 稍微受点刺激就会爆炸。\n有着炸弹球的外号而令人恐惧。

label: SPECIES_VOLTORB_HISUI.description
source:
It resembles an ancient Poké Ball design.
When excited, it discharges the electric
current it has stored in its belly, then
lets out a great, uproarious laugh.
translation: 形状颇似精灵球的奇异宝可梦。\n当情绪高涨时，积蓄在腹部的\n电流就会放出，同时发出大笑。

label: SPECIES_ELECTRODE_HISUI.description
source:
The tissue on the surface of its body is
similar in composition to an Apricorn.
When irritated, it lets loose an electric
current equal to 20 lightning bolts.
translation: 体表的组织与球果的成分极为接近，\n不可思议。当它情绪焦躁时所放出\n的电流，能量足以匹敌20次的落雷。

label: SPECIES_EXEGGCUTE.speciesName
source: EXEGGCUTE
translation: 蛋蛋

label: SPECIES_EXEGGCUTE.categoryName
source: Egg
translation: 蛋

label: SPECIES_EXEGGCUTE.description
source:
It consists of six eggs that care for each
other. The eggs attract each other and
spin around. When cracks increasingly
appear, it is close to evolution.
translation: 由于会通过心灵感应进行对话，\n因此就算把这6只蛋蛋分开，\n它们也会马上重新聚在一起。

label: SPECIES_EXEGGUTOR.speciesName
source: EXEGGUTOR
translation: 椰蛋树

label: SPECIES_EXEGGUTOR.categoryName
source: Coconut
translation: 椰子

label: SPECIES_EXEGGUTOR.description
source:
Originally from the tropics, Exeggutor's
heads grow larger from exposure to strong
sunlight. It is said that when the heads
fall, they group to form an Exeggcute.
translation: 被称为会走路的热带雨林。\n其中一个头长大后掉落到\n地面就会变成蛋蛋。

label: SPECIES_EXEGGUTOR_ALOLA.description
source:
Alola is the best environment for
this Pokémon. Local people take pride
in its appearance, saying this is how
Exeggutor ought to look.
translation: 悠然惬意地长大之后，\n它便不再需要原来的精神力量，\n沉睡于体内的龙之力量已经觉醒。

label: SPECIES_CUBONE.speciesName
source: CUBONE
translation: 卡拉卡拉

label: SPECIES_CUBONE.categoryName
source: Lonely
translation: 孤独

label: SPECIES_CUBONE.description
source:
It pines for the mother it will never see
again. Seeing a likeness of its mother in
the full moon, it cries. The stains on the
skull it wears are from its tears.
translation: 想起与自己永别了的母亲而哭泣时，\n戴在头上的头骨会\n发出咔啦咔啦的响声。

label: SPECIES_MAROWAK.speciesName
source: MAROWAK
translation: 嘎啦嘎啦

label: SPECIES_MAROWAK.categoryName
source: Bone Keeper
translation: 爱骨

label: SPECIES_MAROWAK.description
source:
A Marowak is the evolved form of a Cubone
that has grown tough by overcoming the
grief of losing its mother. Its tempered
and hardened spirit is not easily broken.
translation: 能够熟练使用自出生起\n就拿在手上的骨头。\n性情很凶暴。

label: SPECIES_TYROGUE.speciesName
source: TYROGUE
translation: 无畏小子

label: SPECIES_TYROGUE.categoryName
source: Scuffle
translation: 打斗

label: SPECIES_TYROGUE.description
source:
Tyrogue become stressed out if they do
not get to train every day. When raising
this Pokémon, the Trainer must establish
a regular training schedule.
translation: 永远都是精力充沛的样子。\n为了变强，就算输了一次又一次，\n也会不断地站起来迎战对手。

label: SPECIES_HITMONLEE.speciesName
source: HITMONLEE
translation: 飞腿郎

label: SPECIES_HITMONLEE.categoryName
source: Kicking
translation: 踢腿

label: SPECIES_HITMONLEE.description
source:
Its legs freely stretch and contract.
Using these springlike limbs, it bowls over
foes with devastating kicks. After battle,
it rubs down its tired legs.
translation: 腿能够伸长至2倍。\n初次与它对战的对手都会为\n其攻击范围之广而吃惊。

label: SPECIES_HITMONCHAN.speciesName
source: HITMONCHAN
translation: 快拳郎

label: SPECIES_HITMONCHAN.categoryName
source: Punching
translation: 拳击

label: SPECIES_HITMONCHAN.description
source:
A Hitmonchan is said to possess the
spirit of a boxer who aimed to become the
world champion. Having an indomitable
spirit means that it will never give up.
translation: 会扭转着手臂出拳，\n就连混凝土也能打碎。\n每战斗3分钟就要休息一下。

label: SPECIES_HITMONTOP.speciesName
source: HITMONTOP
translation: 战舞郎

label: SPECIES_HITMONTOP.categoryName
source: Handstand
translation: 倒立

label: SPECIES_HITMONTOP.description
source:
Its technique of kicking while spinning is
a remarkable mix of both offense and
defense. Hitmontop travel faster
spinning than they do walking.
translation: 会像陀螺一样旋转着战斗。\n由于离心力的作用，\n破坏力可达到原来的10倍。

label: SPECIES_LICKITUNG.speciesName
source: LICKITUNG
translation: 大舌头

label: SPECIES_LICKITUNG.categoryName
source: Licking
translation: 舔舔

label: SPECIES_LICKITUNG.description
source:
Whenever it sees something unfamiliar,
it always licks the object because it
memorizes things by texture and taste.
It is somewhat put off by sour things.
translation: 舌头有身体的2倍长，\n并能像手一样活动自如，\n能用它来代替手拿取食物或攻击。

label: SPECIES_LICKILICKY.speciesName
source: LICKILICKY
translation: 大舌舔

label: SPECIES_LICKILICKY.categoryName
source: Licking
translation: 舔舔

label: SPECIES_LICKILICKY.description
source:
The long tongue is always soggy with
slobber. The saliva contains a solvent
that causes numbness. Getting too close
to it will leave you soaked with drool.
translation: 不断伸出的舌头会卷住任何东西。\n一不留神靠近的话，\n就会被唾液弄得黏糊糊的。

label: SPECIES_KOFFING.speciesName
source: KOFFING
translation: 瓦斯弹

label: SPECIES_KOFFING.categoryName
source: Poison Gas
translation: 毒气

label: SPECIES_KOFFING.description
source:
Getting up close to a Koffing will give
you a chance to observe, through its thin
skin, the toxic gases swirling inside. It
blows up at the slightest stimulation.
translation: 会通过往体内储存\n比空气还轻的瓦斯浮在空中。\n瓦斯不但很臭还会爆炸。

label: SPECIES_WEEZING.speciesName
source: WEEZING
translation: 双弹瓦斯

label: SPECIES_WEEZING.categoryName
source: Poison Gas
translation: 毒气

label: SPECIES_WEEZING.description
source:
By diluting its toxic gases with a special
process, the highest grade of perfume can
be extracted. To Weezing, gases emanating
from garbage are the ultimate feast.
translation: 将它体内所含的毒瓦斯稀释到极限，\n就能做出最高级的香水。

label: SPECIES_WEEZING_GALAR.description
source:
Long ago, when droves of factories fouled
the air with pollution, it changed into this
form for some reason. It consumes air
pollutant particles, expelling clean air.
translation: 在往昔工厂林立，空气严重污染\n的时代，双弹瓦斯不知道为什么\n变成了这个样子。

label: SPECIES_RHYHORN.speciesName
source: RHYHORN
translation: 独角犀牛

label: SPECIES_RHYHORN.categoryName
source: Spikes
translation: 尖尖

label: SPECIES_RHYHORN.description
source:
Once it starts running, it doesn't stop.
Its tiny brain makes it so stupid that it
can't remember why it started running in
the first place.
translation: 虽然头脑很差但力气很大，\n可以用撞击把高楼大厦撞得粉粹。

label: SPECIES_RHYDON.speciesName
source: RHYDON
translation: 钻角犀兽

label: SPECIES_RHYDON.categoryName
source: Drill
translation: 钻锥

label: SPECIES_RHYDON.description
source:
Its horn, which rotates like a drill,
destroys tall buildings with one strike.
It stands on its hind legs, and its brain
is well developed.
translation: 全身被铠甲般的皮肤保护着。\n甚至能在2000度的熔岩里生存。

label: SPECIES_RHYPERIOR.speciesName
source: RHYPERIOR
translation: 超甲狂犀

label: SPECIES_RHYPERIOR.categoryName
source: Drill
translation: 钻锥

label: SPECIES_RHYPERIOR.description
source:
It can launch a rock held in its hand
like a missile by tightening and then
expanding its muscles instantaneously.
Geodude are shot at rare times.
translation: 从手掌的洞里发射出小拳石。\n全身的护具连火山喷发都能经受住。

label: SPECIES_HAPPINY.speciesName
source: HAPPINY
translation: 小福蛋

label: SPECIES_HAPPINY.categoryName
source: Playhouse
translation: 家家酒

label: SPECIES_HAPPINY.description
source:
It carries a round white rock in its
belly pouch. If it gets along well with
someone, it will sometimes give that
person the rock.
translation: 深信白白圆圆的石头是蛋，\n很小心翼翼地拿着。\n很在意自己卷毛的形状。

label: SPECIES_CHANSEY.speciesName
source: CHANSEY
translation: 吉利蛋

label: SPECIES_CHANSEY.categoryName
source: Egg
translation: 蛋

label: SPECIES_CHANSEY.description
source:
Chansey lay nutritionally excellent eggs
every day. The eggs are so delicious, they
are eagerly devoured by even those people
who have lost their appetite.
translation: 性格温柔的宝可梦，\n会生出营养丰富的蛋分\n给受伤的宝可梦和人类。

label: SPECIES_BLISSEY.speciesName
source: BLISSEY
translation: 幸福蛋

label: SPECIES_BLISSEY.categoryName
source: Happiness
translation: 幸福

label: SPECIES_BLISSEY.description
source:
If it senses sadness with its fluffy fur,
a Blissey will rush over to the sad person,
however far away, to share an egg of
happiness that brings a smile to any face.
translation: 幸福蛋生的蛋里饱含幸福，\n只要吃上一口，\n不管是谁都会笑逐颜开。

label: SPECIES_TANGELA.speciesName
source: TANGELA
translation: 蔓藤怪

label: SPECIES_TANGELA.categoryName
source: Vine
translation: 藤蔓状

label: SPECIES_TANGELA.description
source:
Its vines snap off easily and painlessly
if they are grabbed, allowing it to make a
quick getaway. The lost vines are replaced
by new growth the very next day.
translation: 能用藤蔓缠住会动的东西。\n因为藤蔓会微妙地晃动，\n所以被缠住后会感觉很痒。

label: SPECIES_TANGROWTH.speciesName
source: TANGROWTH
translation: 巨蔓藤

label: SPECIES_TANGROWTH.categoryName
source: Vine
translation: 藤蔓状

label: SPECIES_TANGROWTH.description
source:
It ensnares prey by extending arms made
of vines. Even if one of its arms is eaten,
it's fine. The Pokémon regenerates quickly
and will go right back to normal.
translation: 伸出由植物的藤蔓\n长成的手臂缠住猎物。\n即便手臂被吃掉也毫不在意。

label: SPECIES_KANGASKHAN.speciesName
source: KANGASKHAN
translation: 袋兽

label: SPECIES_KANGASKHAN.categoryName
source: Parent
translation: 亲子

label: SPECIES_KANGASKHAN.description
source:
If you come across a young Kangaskhan
playing by itself, never try to catch it.
The baby's parent is sure to be in the area,
and it will become violently enraged.
translation: 会在腹袋中抚育孩子。\n只有在安全的时候，\n才会让孩子从袋中出来玩。

label: SPECIES_KANGASKHAN_MEGA.speciesName
source: KANGASKHAN
translation: 袋兽

label: SPECIES_KANGASKHAN_MEGA.categoryName
source: Parent
translation: 亲子

label: SPECIES_KANGASKHAN_MEGA.description
source:
When the mother sees the back of her
Mega-Evolved child, it makes her think
of the day when her child will inevitably
leave her.
translation: 它的孩子因受到超级进化的\n能量影响而急速成长。\n亲子二人的合作搭配不容小觑。

label: SPECIES_HORSEA.speciesName
source: HORSEA
translation: 墨海马

label: SPECIES_HORSEA.categoryName
source: Dragon
translation: 龙

label: SPECIES_HORSEA.description
source:
By cleverly flicking the fins on its back
side to side, it moves in any direction
while facing forward. It spits ink to
escape if it senses danger.
translation: 会在珊瑚的阴影处安家。\n如果感到危险，\n就会从嘴里吐出漆黑的墨汁逃跑。

label: SPECIES_SEADRA.speciesName
source: SEADRA
translation: 海刺龙

label: SPECIES_SEADRA.categoryName
source: Dragon
translation: 龙

label: SPECIES_SEADRA.description
source:
The poisonous barbs all over its body are
highly valued as ingredients for making
traditional herbal medicine. It shows no
mercy to anything approaching its nest.
translation: 身上的刺能够帮它抵御外敌。\n鳍和骨头是好用的中药材。

label: SPECIES_KINGDRA.speciesName
source: KINGDRA
translation: 刺龙王

label: SPECIES_KINGDRA.categoryName
source: Dragon
translation: 龙

label: SPECIES_KINGDRA.description
source:
It sleeps quietly, deep on the seafloor.
When it comes up to the surface, it
creates a huge whirlpool that can swallow
even ships.
translation: 似乎会为了积蓄力量\n而在深深的海底沉睡。\n据说醒来时会刮起龙卷风。

label: SPECIES_GOLDEEN.speciesName
source: GOLDEEN
translation: 角金鱼

label: SPECIES_GOLDEEN.categoryName
source: Goldfish
translation: 金鱼

label: SPECIES_GOLDEEN.description
source:
In the springtime, schools of Goldeen
can be seen swimming up falls and rivers.
It metes out staggering damage with its
single horn.
translation: 会优雅地摇摆背鳍、胸鳍和尾鳍，\n所以被称之为水中的舞者。

label: SPECIES_SEAKING.speciesName
source: SEAKING
translation: 金鱼王

label: SPECIES_SEAKING.categoryName
source: Goldfish
translation: 金鱼

label: SPECIES_SEAKING.description
source:
It punches holes in boulders on stream-
beds. This is a clever innovation that
prevents its eggs from being attacked or
washed away by the current.
translation: 到了秋天，\n体内的脂肪会因为要去求偶而增加，\n颜色也会变得非常漂亮。

label: SPECIES_STARYU.speciesName
source: STARYU
translation: 海星星

label: SPECIES_STARYU.categoryName
source: Star Shape
translation: 星形

label: SPECIES_STARYU.description
source:
It gathers with others in the night and
makes its red core glow on and off with
the twinkling stars. It can regenerate
limbs if they are severed from its body.
translation: 只要红色的核心部分还在，\n就算身体被切碎也会立刻再生。\n核心部分会在深夜里闪烁。

label: SPECIES_STARMIE.speciesName
source: STARMIE
translation: 宝石海星

label: SPECIES_STARMIE.categoryName
source: Mysterious
translation: 谜

label: SPECIES_STARMIE.description
source:
People in ancient times imagined that
Starmie were transformed from the
reflections of stars that twinkled on
gentle waves at night.
translation: 它会从位于身体中间的红色核心\n那里向夜空发射神秘的电波。

label: SPECIES_STARMIE_MEGA.speciesName
source: STARMIE
translation: 宝石海星

label: SPECIES_STARMIE_MEGA.categoryName
source: Mysterious
translation: 谜

label: SPECIES_STARMIE_MEGA.description
source:
Its movements have become more
humanlike. Whether it's simply
trying to communicate or wants to
supplant humanity is unclear.
translation: 动作变得越来越像人。\n它是试图沟通，还是打算代替\n人类，仍是未解之谜。

label: SPECIES_MIME_JR.speciesName
source: MIME JR.
translation: 魔尼尼

label: SPECIES_MIME_JR.categoryName
source: Mime
translation: 默剧

label: SPECIES_MIME_JR.description
source:
In an attempt to confuse its enemy,
it mimics the enemy's movements.
Once mimicked, the foe cannot take
its eyes off this Pokémon.
translation: 有着模仿对手动作的习性。\n据说被模仿的对手会目不转睛。

label: SPECIES_MR_MIME.speciesName
source: MR. MIME
translation: 魔墙人偶

label: SPECIES_MR_MIME.categoryName
source: Barrier
translation: 屏障

label: SPECIES_MR_MIME.description
source:
A Mr. Mime is a master of pantomime. It can
convince others that something unseeable
actually exists. Once believed, the
imaginary object does become real.
translation: 从指尖发出的波动\n可以硬化空气制造墙壁。\n即便是强烈的攻击也能弹开。

label: SPECIES_MR_MIME_GALAR.speciesName
source: MR. MIME
translation: 魔墙人偶

label: SPECIES_MR_MIME_GALAR.description
source:
Its talent is tap-dancing. It can radiate
chilliness from the bottoms of its feet to
to create a floor of ice, which this
Pokémon can kick up to use as a barrier.
translation: 会从脚底释放出冷气。\n一整天都会在自己冻住的\n地板上努力练习踢踏舞。

label: SPECIES_MR_RIME.speciesName
source: MR. RIME
translation: 踏冰人偶

label: SPECIES_MR_RIME.categoryName
source: Comedian
translation: 喜剧演员

label: SPECIES_MR_RIME.description
source: It's highly skilled at tap-dancing. It\nwaves its cane of ice in time with its\ngraceful movements.
translation: 幽默的动作使它获得了众人的喜爱。\n能从腹部的图案释放出精神力量。

label: SPECIES_SCYTHER.speciesName
source: SCYTHER
translation: 飞天螳螂

label: SPECIES_SCYTHER.categoryName
source: Mantis
translation: 螳螂

label: SPECIES_SCYTHER.description
source:
Its blindingly fast speed adds to the
sharpness of its twin forearm scythes.
The scythes can slice through thick logs
in one wicked stroke.
translation: 双手的镰刀锋利无比，\n砍断越多坚硬的东西，\n锋利的程度就越能得到提升。

label: SPECIES_SCIZOR.speciesName
source: SCIZOR
translation: 巨钳螳螂

label: SPECIES_SCIZOR.categoryName
source: Pincer
translation: 钳子

label: SPECIES_SCIZOR.description
source:
A Scizor has a body with the hardness of
steel. It is not easily fazed by ordinary
sorts of attacks. It flaps its wings to
regulate its body temperature.
translation: 当它举起带有眼珠花纹的\n钳子威吓对手时，\n看起来就像是拥有3颗头一样。

label: SPECIES_SCIZOR_MEGA.speciesName
source: SCIZOR
translation: 巨钳螳螂

label: SPECIES_SCIZOR_MEGA.categoryName
source: Pincer
translation: 钳子

label: SPECIES_SCIZOR_MEGA.description
source:
The excess energy that bathes this
Pokémon keeps it in constant danger of
overflow. It can't sustain a battle over
long periods of time.
translation: 比起夹击，它更擅长用钳子抡打对手。\n长时间战斗后，\n它就会变得无法承受钳子的重量。

label: SPECIES_KLEAVOR.speciesName
source: KLEAVOR
translation: 劈斧螳螂

label: SPECIES_KLEAVOR.categoryName
source: Axe
translation: 斧钺

label: SPECIES_KLEAVOR.description
source:
A violent creature that fells trees with
its crude axes and shields itself with hard
stone. Should one encounter this Pokémon
in the wild, one's only recourse is to flee.
translation: 野蛮、粗鲁又狂暴的家伙。\n通过挥舞巨大沉重的\n岩石斧头来干掉猎物。

label: SPECIES_SMOOCHUM.speciesName
source: SMOOCHUM
translation: 迷唇娃

label: SPECIES_SMOOCHUM.categoryName
source: Kiss
translation: 亲吻

label: SPECIES_SMOOCHUM.description
source:
It actively runs about, but also falls
often. Whenever it falls, it will check its
reflection on a lake's surface to make
sure its face hasn't become dirty.
translation: 不管是什么都会试着\n用嘴唇去触碰确认。\n能用嘴唇记住自己喜欢和讨厌的东西。

label: SPECIES_JYNX.speciesName
source: JYNX
translation: 迷唇姐

label: SPECIES_JYNX.categoryName
source: Human Shape
translation: 人形

label: SPECIES_JYNX.description
source:
A Jynx sashays rhythmically as if it were
dancing. Its motions are so bouncingly
alluring, people seeing it are compelled to
shake their hips without noticing.
translation: 虽然它的叫声听上去很像人类的语言，\n但完全不知道它在说些什么。

label: SPECIES_ELEKID.speciesName
source: ELEKID
translation: 电击怪

label: SPECIES_ELEKID.categoryName
source: Electric
translation: 电气

label: SPECIES_ELEKID.description
source:
If it touches metal and discharges the
electricity it has stored in its body, an
Elekid begins swinging its arms in circles
to recharge itself.
translation: 会一圈圈抡动双臂产生电力，\n但很快就会感到疲惫，\n因此只能储存少量电力。

label: SPECIES_ELECTABUZZ.speciesName
source: ELECTABUZZ
translation: 电击兽

label: SPECIES_ELECTABUZZ.categoryName
source: Electric
translation: 电击

label: SPECIES_ELECTABUZZ.description
source:
When a storm approaches, it competes with
others to scale heights that are likely to
be stricken by lightning. Some towns use
Electabuzz in place of lightning rods.
translation: 全身总是在放电，\n因此接近它的话，\n头发就会竖起来。

label: SPECIES_ELECTIVIRE.speciesName
source: ELECTIVIRE
translation: 电击魔兽

label: SPECIES_ELECTIVIRE.categoryName
source: Thunderbolt
translation: 雷电

label: SPECIES_ELECTIVIRE.description
source:
When it gets excited, it thumps its chest.
With every thud, thunder roars, electric
sparks shower all around and blue sparks
begin to crackle between its horns.
translation: 用2根尾巴的尖端按住对手，\n并放出超过2万伏特的电来进行攻击。

label: SPECIES_MAGBY.speciesName
source: MAGBY
translation: 鸭嘴宝宝

label: SPECIES_MAGBY.categoryName
source: Live Coal
translation: 火种

label: SPECIES_MAGBY.description
source:
If a Magby is spouting yellow flames from
its mouth, it is in good health. When it is
fatigued, black smoke will be mixed in with
the flames.
translation: 由于体内流淌着熔岩一样的血液，\n因此体温可达600度。

label: SPECIES_MAGMAR.speciesName
source: MAGMAR
translation: 鸭嘴火兽

label: SPECIES_MAGMAR.categoryName
source: Spitfire
translation: 吐火

label: SPECIES_MAGMAR.description
source:
In battle, it blows out intense flames from
all over its body to intimidate its foe.
These fiery bursts create heat waves that
ignite grass and trees in the area.
translation: 它是在火山口附近被发现的。\n会从嘴里吐出火焰。\n体温高达1200度。

label: SPECIES_MAGMORTAR.speciesName
source: MAGMORTAR
translation: 鸭嘴炎兽

label: SPECIES_MAGMORTAR.categoryName
source: Blast
translation: 爆炎

label: SPECIES_MAGMORTAR.description
source:
According to what is known, a single pair
of male and female Magmortar lives in
one volcano. From its arm, it launches
fireballs hotter than 3,600ºF.
translation: 从手臂前端发射出\n摄氏2000度的火球。\n以火山口作为自己的住所。

label: SPECIES_PINSIR.speciesName
source: PINSIR
translation: 凯罗斯

label: SPECIES_PINSIR.categoryName
source: Stag Beetle
translation: 锹形虫

label: SPECIES_PINSIR.description
source:
Their pincers are strong enough to
shatter thick logs. Because they dislike
cold, Pinsir burrow and sleep under
the ground on chilly nights.
translation: 会用2只角夹住猎物，\n在撕碎猎物前不会松开。\n无法撕碎时就会把猎物扔到天边去。

label: SPECIES_PINSIR_MEGA.speciesName
source: PINSIR
translation: 凯罗斯

label: SPECIES_PINSIR_MEGA.categoryName
source: Stag Beetle
translation: 锹形虫

label: SPECIES_PINSIR_MEGA.description
source:
The influence of Mega Evolution leaves it
in a state of constant excitement.
It pierces enemies with its two large
horns before shredding them.
translation: 用自豪的犄角轻巧地\n抬着比自己重10倍的对手飞来飞去。

label: SPECIES_TAUROS.speciesName
source: TAUROS
translation: 肯泰罗

label: SPECIES_TAUROS.categoryName
source: Wild Bull
translation: 暴牛

label: SPECIES_TAUROS.description
source:
It is not satisfied unless it is rampaging
at all times. If there is no opponent for
Tauros to battle, it will charge at thick
trees and knock them down to calm itself.
translation: 瞄准猎物后就会笔直冲撞过去。\n因其暴躁的性格而闻名。

label: SPECIES_TAUROS_PALDEA_COMBAT.speciesName
source: TAUROS
translation: 肯泰罗

label: SPECIES_TAUROS_PALDEA_COMBAT.description
source:
This Pokémon has a muscular body
and excels at close-quarters combat.
It uses its short horns to strike
the opponent’s weak spots.
translation: 特征是厚实有力的肌肉\n以及粗鲁暴躁的性格。\n这种样子被称为斗战种。

label: SPECIES_TAUROS_PALDEA_BLAZE.speciesName
source: TAUROS
translation: 肯泰罗

label: SPECIES_TAUROS_PALDEA_BLAZE.description
source:
When heated by fire energy, its horns can
get hotter than 1,800 degrees Fahrenheit.
Those gored by them will suffer
both wounds and burns.
translation: 会喷出高温的鼻息，\n因此被命名为火炽种。\n3根尾巴总是拧在一起。

label: SPECIES_TAUROS_PALDEA_AQUA.speciesName
source: TAUROS
translation: 肯泰罗

label: SPECIES_TAUROS_PALDEA_AQUA.description
source:
This Pokémon blasts water from holes on
the tips of its horns--the high-pressure
jets pierce right through
Tauros’s enemies.
translation: 会从角喷出水来游泳。\n因脂肪含量高而容易浮在水面上，\n这是水澜种的特征。

label: SPECIES_MAGIKARP.speciesName
source: MAGIKARP
translation: 鲤鱼王

label: SPECIES_MAGIKARP.categoryName
source: Fish
translation: 鱼

label: SPECIES_MAGIKARP.description
source:
Its swimming muscles are weak, so it is
easily washed away by currents. In places
where water pools, you can see many
Magikarp deposited there by the flow.
translation: 很久以前的鲤鱼王\n好像要比现在强上一些。\n但是现在却弱得可怜。

label: SPECIES_GYARADOS.speciesName
source: GYARADOS
translation: 暴鲤龙

label: SPECIES_GYARADOS.categoryName
source: Atrocious
translation: 凶恶

label: SPECIES_GYARADOS.description
source:
It is an extremely vicious and violent
Pokémon. When humans begin to fight,
it will appear and burn everything to the
ground with intensely hot flames.
translation: 一旦发狂的暴鲤龙出现，\n就算狂风暴雨也会把\n任何东西烧毁殆尽。

label: SPECIES_GYARADOS_MEGA.speciesName
source: GYARADOS
translation: 暴鲤龙

label: SPECIES_GYARADOS_MEGA.categoryName
source: Atrocious
translation: 凶恶

label: SPECIES_GYARADOS_MEGA.description
source:
Although it obeys its instinctive drive to
destroy everything within its reach, it
will respond to orders from a Trainer it
truly trusts.
translation: 虽然本能会驱使它破坏一切，\n但也会听命于自己真正信任的训练家。

label: SPECIES_LAPRAS.speciesName
source: LAPRAS
translation: 拉普拉斯

label: SPECIES_LAPRAS.categoryName
source: Transport
translation: 乘载

label: SPECIES_LAPRAS.description
source:
People have driven Lapras almost to the
point of extinction. In the evenings,
it is said to sing plaintively as it seeks
what few others of its kind still remain.
translation: 会让人坐在自己的背上畅游大海。\n据说当它心情好的时候，\n有时还会用悦耳的叫声来唱歌。

label: SPECIES_LAPRAS_GMAX.speciesName
source: LAPRAS
translation: 拉普拉斯

label: SPECIES_LAPRAS_GMAX.categoryName
source: Transport
translation: 乘载

label: SPECIES_LAPRAS_GMAX.description
source:
Over 5,000 people can ride on its
shell at once. And it's a very
comfortable ride, without the slightest
shaking or swaying.
translation: 冰粒集中在身体周围，\n形成巨大的圆环。会一边用圆环\n击碎冰山，一边悠然地游泳。

label: SPECIES_DITTO.speciesName
source: DITTO
translation: 百变怪

label: SPECIES_DITTO.categoryName
source: Transform
translation: 变身

label: SPECIES_DITTO.description
source:
A Ditto rearranges its cell structure to
transform itself. However, if it tries to
change based on its memory, it will get
details wrong.
translation: 会自己重组身体细胞的结构，\n变身成其他的生命体。

label: SPECIES_EEVEE.speciesName
source: EEVEE
translation: 伊布

label: SPECIES_EEVEE.categoryName
source: Evolution
translation: 进化

label: SPECIES_EEVEE_GMAX.speciesName
source: EEVEE
translation: 伊布

label: SPECIES_EEVEE_GMAX.categoryName
source: Evolution
translation: 进化

label: SPECIES_EEVEE_GMAX.description
source:
Having gotten even friendlier and
more innocent, Eevee tries to play
with anyone around, only to end up
crushing them with its immense body.
translation: 性格变得更加天真无邪。\n不管遇到谁都会扑上去玩耍，\n但巨大的身体往往会把对方压垮。

label: SPECIES_EEVEE_STARTER.speciesName
source: EEVEE
translation: 伊布

label: SPECIES_EEVEE_STARTER.categoryName
source: Evolution
translation: 进化

label: SPECIES_VAPOREON.speciesName
source: VAPOREON
translation: 水伊布

label: SPECIES_VAPOREON.categoryName
source: Bubble Jet
translation: 吐泡

label: SPECIES_VAPOREON.description
source:
Vaporeon underwent a spontaneous
mutation and grew fins and gills that
allow them to live underwater. They have
the ability to freely control water.
translation: 虽然栖息在水边，\n但由于尾巴上有像鱼的鳍，\n因此也有人会把它错认为人鱼。

label: SPECIES_JOLTEON.speciesName
source: JOLTEON
translation: 雷伊布

label: SPECIES_JOLTEON.categoryName
source: Lightning
translation: 雷

label: SPECIES_JOLTEON.description
source:
Its cells generate weak power that is
amplified by its fur's static electricity
to drop thunderbolts. The bristling fur is
made of electrically charged needles.
translation: 能够吸入空气中的负离子，\n有时会吐出大约\n有10000伏特的高压电。

label: SPECIES_FLAREON.speciesName
source: FLAREON
translation: 火伊布

label: SPECIES_FLAREON.categoryName
source: Flame
translation: 火

label: SPECIES_FLAREON.description
source:
Flareon's fluffy fur releases heat into
the air so that its body does not get
excessively hot. Its body temperature can
rise to a maximum of 1,650 degrees F.
translation: 展开颈部蓬松的体毛，\n使上升到900度的体温冷却下来。

label: SPECIES_ESPEON.speciesName
source: ESPEON
translation: 太阳伊布

label: SPECIES_ESPEON.categoryName
source: Sun
translation: 太阳

label: SPECIES_ESPEON.description
source:
An Espeon is extremely loyal to any
Trainer it considers to be worthy. It is
said to have developed precognitive
powers to protect its Trainer from harm.
translation: 会用全身纤细的体毛\n来感受空气的流动，\n以此来预测对手的行动。

label: SPECIES_UMBREON.speciesName
source: UMBREON
translation: 月亮伊布

label: SPECIES_UMBREON.categoryName
source: Moonlight
translation: 月光

label: SPECIES_UMBREON.description
source:
Umbreon evolved from exposure to the
moon's energy pulses. It lurks in darkness
and waits for its foes to move. The rings
on its body glow when it leaps to attack.
translation: 为了使靠近它的家伙感到害怕，\n它身上圆圈形的花纹会在天色\n变暗时自然地发出光芒。

label: SPECIES_LEAFEON.speciesName
source: LEAFEON
translation: 叶伊布

label: SPECIES_LEAFEON.categoryName
source: Verdant
translation: 新绿

label: SPECIES_LEAFEON.description
source:
Its cellular composition is closer to
that of a plant than an animal. It uses
photosynthesis to produce its energy
supply without eating food.
translation: 在晴朗的日子里睡着的\n叶伊布会进行光合作用，\n制造出新鲜的空气。

label: SPECIES_GLACEON.speciesName
source: GLACEON
translation: 冰伊布

label: SPECIES_GLACEON.categoryName
source: Fresh Snow
translation: 新雪

label: SPECIES_GLACEON.description
source:
It can control its body temperature
at will. This enables it to freeze the
moisture in the atmosphere, creating
flurries of diamond dust.
translation: 通过降低体温让全身的体毛\n冻得像锐利的尖针一样，\n然后射出。

label: SPECIES_SYLVEON.speciesName
source: SYLVEON
translation: 仙子伊布

label: SPECIES_SYLVEON.categoryName
source: Intertwine
translation: 连结

label: SPECIES_SYLVEON.description
source:
Its ribbonlike feelers give off an aura
that weakens hostility in its prey, causing
them to let down their guard. A moment
later, it pounces.
translation: 用缎带般的触角挽住\n非常喜爱的训练家的手臂，\n一起步行。

label: SPECIES_PORYGON.speciesName
source: PORYGON
translation: 多边兽

label: SPECIES_PORYGON.categoryName
source: Virtual
translation: 虚拟

label: SPECIES_PORYGON.description
source:
It is capable of reverting itself entirely
back to program data in order to enter
cyberspace. A Porygon is copy-
protected so it cannot be duplicated.
translation: 利用最顶尖的科学力量\n创造出的人工宝可梦。\n能够在电子空间移动。

label: SPECIES_PORYGON2.speciesName
source: PORYGON2
translation: 多边兽2型

label: SPECIES_PORYGON2.categoryName
source: Virtual
translation: 虚拟

label: SPECIES_PORYGON2.description
source:
It was created by humans using the power
of science. It has been given artificial
intelligence that enables it to learn new
gestures and emotions on its own.
translation: 为了能够开发行星\n而将多边兽升级而成，\n但连飞上空中都还做不到。

label: SPECIES_PORYGON_Z.speciesName
source: PORYGON-Z
translation: 多边兽乙型

label: SPECIES_PORYGON_Z.categoryName
source: Virtual
translation: 虚拟

label: SPECIES_PORYGON_Z.description
source:
In order to create a more advanced
Pokémon, an additional program was
installed, but apparently it contained a
defect that made it move oddly.
translation: 为了让它在异次元也能\n大显身手而修改了程序，\n但没有达到预期目标。

label: SPECIES_OMANYTE.speciesName
source: OMANYTE
translation: 菊石兽

label: SPECIES_OMANYTE.categoryName
source: Spiral
translation: 漩涡

label: SPECIES_OMANYTE.description
source:
One of the ancient and long-since-extinct
Pokémon that have been regenerated
from fossils by humans. If attacked,
it withdraws into its hard shell.
translation: 用先进的现代科技\n从化石中复活的宝可梦。\n曾经遨游在古代的海洋里。

label: SPECIES_OMASTAR.speciesName
source: OMASTAR
translation: 多刺菊石兽

label: SPECIES_OMASTAR.categoryName
source: Spiral
translation: 漩涡

label: SPECIES_OMASTAR.description
source:
An Omastar uses its tentacles to capture
its prey. It is believed to have become
extinct because its shell grew too large,
making its movements slow and ponderous.
translation: 人们认为这种宝可梦灭绝的\n原因是螺旋状的壳长得太大了。

label: SPECIES_KABUTO.speciesName
source: KABUTO
translation: 化石盔

label: SPECIES_KABUTO.categoryName
source: Shellfish
translation: 甲壳

label: SPECIES_KABUTO.description
source:
It is a Pokémon that has been regenerated
from a fossil. However, in rare cases, living
examples have been discovered. Kabuto
have not changed for 300 million years.
translation: 人们认为它生活在3亿年前的沙滩上。\n会用坚硬的壳来保护自己。

label: SPECIES_KABUTOPS.speciesName
source: KABUTOPS
translation: 镰刀盔

label: SPECIES_KABUTOPS.categoryName
source: Shellfish
translation: 甲壳

label: SPECIES_KABUTOPS.description
source:
Kabutops once swam underwater to hunt 
for prey. It was apparently evolving from
being a water dweller to living on land as
evident from changes in its gills and legs.
translation: 人们认为镰刀盔之所以上岸\n是因为它的猎物开始在陆地上生活。

label: SPECIES_AERODACTYL.speciesName
source: AERODACTYL
translation: 化石翼龙

label: SPECIES_AERODACTYL.categoryName
source: Fossil
translation: 化石

label: SPECIES_AERODACTYL.description
source:
Aerodactyl is a Pokémon from the age
of dinosaurs. It was regenerated from DNA
extracted from amber. It is imagined to
have been the king of the skies.
translation: 翱翔于恐龙时代天空的宝可梦。\n拥有锯齿状的利牙。

label: SPECIES_AERODACTYL_MEGA.categoryName
source: Fossil
translation: 化石

label: SPECIES_AERODACTYL_MEGA.description
source: The power of Mega Evolution has\ncompletely restored its genes. The rocks\non its body are harder than diamond.
translation: 超级进化的力量使它的\n遗传基因完全复活。\n身上的岩石比钻石还要坚硬。

label: SPECIES_MUNCHLAX.speciesName
source: MUNCHLAX
translation: 小卡比兽

label: SPECIES_MUNCHLAX.categoryName
source: Big Eater
translation: 大胃王

label: SPECIES_MUNCHLAX.description
source:
When it finds something that looks like
it might be edible, it goes right ahead
and swallows it whole. That's why it gets
fatter day by day.
translation: 会在拼命进食的途中\n忘记藏到体毛下的食物。

label: SPECIES_SNORLAX.speciesName
source: SNORLAX
translation: 卡比兽

label: SPECIES_SNORLAX.categoryName
source: Sleeping
translation: 瞌睡

label: SPECIES_SNORLAX.description
source:
Snorlax's typical day consists of nothing
more than eating and sleeping. It is such
a docile Pokémon that there are children
who use its big belly as a place to play.
translation: 每天不吃上400公斤的\n食物心里就不畅快。\n吃饱了就会开始睡觉。

label: SPECIES_SNORLAX_GMAX.speciesName
source: SNORLAX
translation: 卡比兽

label: SPECIES_SNORLAX_GMAX.categoryName
source: Sleeping
translation: 瞌睡

label: SPECIES_SNORLAX_GMAX.description
source:
Gigantamax energy has affected
stray seeds and even pebbles that
got stuck to Snorlax, making them grow
to a huge size.
translation: 拥有骇人的力量。\n体型像山一样巨大，\n而且不动如山。

label: SPECIES_ARTICUNO.speciesName
source: ARTICUNO
translation: 急冻鸟

label: SPECIES_ARTICUNO.categoryName
source: Freeze
translation: 冰冻

label: SPECIES_ARTICUNO.description
source:
Articuno is a legendary bird Pokémon that
can control ice. The flapping of its wings
chills the air. As a result, it is said that
when this Pokémon flies, snow will fall.
translation: 传说的鸟宝可梦。\n能冻结空气中的水分，\n制造出暴风雪。

label: SPECIES_ARTICUNO_GALAR.speciesName
source: ARTICUNO
translation: 急冻鸟

label: SPECIES_ARTICUNO_GALAR.description
source:
It fires beams that immobilize opponents
as if they had been frozen solid.
Its feather-like blades of psychic energy
rip through thick iron sheets like paper.
translation: 拥有急冻鸟之名的宝可梦。\n发射出的光束能让对方的身体\n像结冰一样失去自由。

label: SPECIES_ZAPDOS.speciesName
source: ZAPDOS
translation: 闪电鸟

label: SPECIES_ZAPDOS.categoryName
source: Electric
translation: 电击

label: SPECIES_ZAPDOS.description
source:
Zapdos is a legendary bird Pokémon that
has the ability to control electricity.
It usually lives in thunderclouds. It gains
power if it is stricken by lightning bolts.
translation: 据说是在雷云中的传说的宝可梦。\n能够随心所欲地操纵雷电。

label: SPECIES_ZAPDOS_GALAR.speciesName
source: ZAPDOS
translation: 闪电鸟

label: SPECIES_ZAPDOS_GALAR.description
source:
When its feathers rub together, they
produce a crackling sound like the
zapping of electricity. Apparently, it runs
through the mountains at over 180 mph.
translation: 脚力强劲，仅凭一脚就能把\n翻斗车踢得粉碎。据说能以300公里\n的时速在山中奔驰。

label: SPECIES_MOLTRES.speciesName
source: MOLTRES
translation: 火焰鸟

label: SPECIES_MOLTRES.categoryName
source: Flame
translation: 火焰

label: SPECIES_MOLTRES.description
source:
Moltres is a legendary bird Pokémon
that can control fire. If injured, it is said
to dip its body in the molten magma of
a volcano to burn and heal itself.
translation: 传说的鸟宝可梦中的1只。\n据说只要火焰鸟现身，\n春天就会到来。

label: SPECIES_MOLTRES_GALAR.speciesName
source: MOLTRES
translation: 火焰鸟

label: SPECIES_MOLTRES_GALAR.description
source:
This Pokémon's sinister, flame-like aura
will consume the spirit of any creature
it hits. Victims become burned-out
shadows of themselves.
translation: 能像燃起烈火一般燃起邪恶的气场。\n因为这样的外表而被命名为火焰鸟。

label: SPECIES_DRATINI.speciesName
source: DRATINI
translation: 迷你龙

label: SPECIES_DRATINI.categoryName
source: Dragon
translation: 龙

label: SPECIES_DRATINI.description
source:
A Dratini continually molts and sloughs
off its old skin. It does so because the
life energy within its body steadily builds
to reach uncontrollable levels.
translation: 因为目击者非常少，\n所以过去它被称为幻之宝可梦。\n现在还找到过它蜕下的皮。

label: SPECIES_DRAGONAIR.speciesName
source: DRAGONAIR
translation: 哈克龙

label: SPECIES_DRAGONAIR.categoryName
source: Dragon
translation: 龙

label: SPECIES_DRAGONAIR.description
source:
A Dragonair stores an enormous amount of
energy inside its body. It is said to alter
the weather around it by loosing energy
from the crystals on its neck and tail.
translation: 全身被气场所笼罩时，\n周围的天气会发生突变。\n据说栖息在海洋或湖泊里。

label: SPECIES_DRAGONITE.speciesName
source: DRAGONITE
translation: 快龙

label: SPECIES_DRAGONITE.categoryName
source: Dragon
translation: 龙

label: SPECIES_DRAGONITE.description
source:
It can circle the globe in just 16 hours.
It is a kindhearted Pokémon that leads
lost and foundering ships in a storm
to the safety of land.
translation: 据说它的住处就在这广阔大海的某处。\n会将遇难的船只引导到陆地边上。

label: SPECIES_DRAGONITE_MEGA.speciesName
source: DRAGONITE
translation: 快龙

label: SPECIES_DRAGONITE_MEGA.categoryName
source: Dragon
translation: 龙

label: SPECIES_DRAGONITE_MEGA.description
source:
Mega Evolution has excessively
powered up this Pokémon's feelings
of kindness. It finishes off its
opponents with mercy in its heart.
translation: 超级进化的能量让它的\n情感变得过于温柔。\n会以慈悲之心终结敌人。

label: SPECIES_MEWTWO.speciesName
source: MEWTWO
translation: 超梦

label: SPECIES_MEWTWO.categoryName
source: Genetic
translation: 基因

label: SPECIES_MEWTWO.description
source:
A Pokémon that was created by genetic
manipulation. However, even though the
scientific power of humans made its body,
they failed to give it a warm heart.
translation: 因重组了梦幻的遗传基因而诞生。\n据说有着所有宝可梦中最残暴的心。

label: SPECIES_MEWTWO_MEGA_X.speciesName
source: MEWTWO
translation: 超梦

label: SPECIES_MEWTWO_MEGA_X.categoryName
source: Genetic
translation: 基因

label: SPECIES_MEWTWO_MEGA_X.description
source:
Psychic power has augmented its muscles.
It has a grip strength of one ton and can
sprint a hundred meters in two seconds
flat!
translation: 身体上的肌肉因精神力量而增强。\n它的握力为1吨。\n只要2秒就可以跑完100米！

label: SPECIES_MEWTWO_MEGA_Y.speciesName
source: MEWTWO
translation: 超梦

label: SPECIES_MEWTWO_MEGA_Y.categoryName
source: Genetic
translation: 基因

label: SPECIES_MEWTWO_MEGA_Y.description
source:
Despite its diminished size, its mental
power has grown phenomenally. With a mere
thought, it can smash a skyscraper to
smithereens.
translation: 虽然身体变小了，力量却大到\n无法计算。只要稍稍使用念力，\n哪怕是高楼大厦也会化为灰烬。

label: SPECIES_MEW.speciesName
source: MEW
translation: 梦幻

label: SPECIES_MEW.categoryName
source: New Species
translation: 新种

label: SPECIES_MEW.description
source:
A Mew is said to possess the genes of all
Pokémon. It is capable of making itself
invisible at will, so it entirely avoids
notice even if it approaches people.
translation: 因为能使用所有的招式，\n所以有很多学者认为\n它是宝可梦的祖先。

label: SPECIES_CHIKORITA.speciesName
source: CHIKORITA
translation: 菊草叶

label: SPECIES_CHIKORITA.categoryName
source: Leaf
translation: 叶子

label: SPECIES_CHIKORITA.description
source:
It waves its leaf around to keep foes
at bay. However, a sweet fragrance also
wafts from the leaf, creating a friendly
atmosphere that becalms the battlers.
translation: 会用头上的叶子来感知\n周围的温度和湿度。\n非常喜欢沐浴阳光。

label: SPECIES_BAYLEEF.speciesName
source: BAYLEEF
translation: 月桂叶

label: SPECIES_BAYLEEF.categoryName
source: Leaf
translation: 叶子

label: SPECIES_BAYLEEF.description
source:
A Bayleef's neck is ringed by curled-up
leaves. Inside each leaf is a small tree
shoot. The fragrance of this shoot
makes people peppy.
translation: 从脖子周围的花苞中散发出的\n像香辛料一样的香味，\n会让闻到的人焕发活力。

label: SPECIES_MEGANIUM.speciesName
source: MEGANIUM
translation: 大竺葵

label: SPECIES_MEGANIUM.categoryName
source: Herb
translation: 芳草

label: SPECIES_MEGANIUM.description
source:
The fragrance of a Meganium's flower
soothes and calms emotions. In battle,
it gives off more of its becalming scent
to blunt the foe's fighting spirit.
translation: 大竺葵呼出的气息中蕴含着\n能让枯萎的草木复苏的力量。

label: SPECIES_MEGANIUM_MEGA.speciesName
source: MEGANIUM
translation: 大竺葵

label: SPECIES_MEGANIUM_MEGA.categoryName
source: Herb
translation: 芳草

label: SPECIES_MEGANIUM_MEGA.description
source:
This Pokémon can fire a tremendously
powerful Solar Beam from its four
flowers. Another name for this is
Mega Sol Cannon.
translation: 从4朵花中放出的日光束\n威力巨大。别名超级日光炮。

label: SPECIES_CYNDAQUIL.speciesName
source: CYNDAQUIL
translation: 火球鼠

label: SPECIES_CYNDAQUIL.categoryName
source: Fire Mouse
translation: 火鼠

label: SPECIES_CYNDAQUIL.description
source:
It flares flames from its back to protect
itself. The fire burns vigorously if the
Pokémon is angry. When it is tired,
it sputters with incomplete combustion.
translation: 性格胆小怯懦。\n受到惊吓时，\n背上的火焰就会燃烧得更加强烈。

label: SPECIES_QUILAVA.speciesName
source: QUILAVA
translation: 火岩鼠

label: SPECIES_QUILAVA.categoryName
source: Volcano
translation: 火山

label: SPECIES_QUILAVA.description
source:
It intimidates foes with intense gusts of
flames and superheated air. Its quick
nimbleness lets it dodge attacks even
while scorching an enemy.
translation: 覆盖身体的皮毛绝不会被点燃。\n受到任何火焰攻击它都能安然无恙。

label: SPECIES_TYPHLOSION.speciesName
source: TYPHLOSION
translation: 火暴兽

label: SPECIES_TYPHLOSION.categoryName
source: Volcano
translation: 火山

label: SPECIES_TYPHLOSION.description
source:
It can hide behind a shimmering heat haze
that it creates using its intense flames.
Typhlosion create blazing explosive
blasts that burn everything to cinders.
translation: 愤怒到极点时，\n它热得能将碰到的所有东西瞬间点燃。

label: SPECIES_TYPHLOSION_HISUI.speciesName
source: TYPHLOSION
translation: 火暴兽

label: SPECIES_TYPHLOSION_HISUI.description
source:
Said to purify lost, forsaken souls with
its flames and guide them to the afterlife.
It's believed its form was influenced by
the energy of Mt. Coronet in ancient times.
translation: 据说它是受到洗翠的灵山之气影响，\n才形成了现在的模样。\n据说会用火焰净化并超渡灵魂。

label: SPECIES_TOTODILE.speciesName
source: TOTODILE
translation: 小锯鳄

label: SPECIES_TOTODILE.categoryName
source: Big Jaw
translation: 大颚

label: SPECIES_TOTODILE.description
source:
Despite its small body, Totodile's jaws
are very powerful. While it may think it is
just playfully nipping, its bite has enough
strength to cause serious injury.
translation: 因为它发达的颚充满了力量，\n不管是什么都能咬碎，\n所以就算是它的训练家也要当心。

label: SPECIES_CROCONAW.speciesName
source: CROCONAW
translation: 蓝鳄

label: SPECIES_CROCONAW.categoryName
source: Big Jaw
translation: 大颚

label: SPECIES_CROCONAW.description
source:
Once its jaws clamp down on its foe, it will
absolutely not let go. Because the tips of
its fangs are forked back like fishhooks,
they become irremovably embedded.
translation: 一旦咬住，除非牙齿脱落，\n否则绝不会松口。\n脱落的牙齿马上就能再长出来。

label: SPECIES_FERALIGATR.speciesName
source: FERALIGATR
translation: 大力鳄

label: SPECIES_FERALIGATR.categoryName
source: Big Jaw
translation: 大颚

label: SPECIES_FERALIGATR.description
source:
It opens its huge mouth to intimidate
enemies. In battle, it runs using its thick
and powerful hind legs to charge the
foe with incredible speed.
translation: 会用大而有力的颚咬住对手，\n然后就那样甩动脖子将对手撕得粉碎。

label: SPECIES_FERALIGATR_MEGA.speciesName
source: FERALIGATR
translation: 大力鳄

label: SPECIES_FERALIGATR_MEGA.categoryName
source: Double Jaw
translation: 双颚

label: SPECIES_FERALIGATR_MEGA.description
source:
With its arms and hoodlike fin, this
Pokémon forms a gigantic set of jaws
with a bite 10 times as powerful
as Mega Feraligatr's actual jaws.
translation: 用兜帽般的鳍和双臂\n构成一个巨大的颚，\n咬合的威力提升为10倍。

label: SPECIES_SENTRET.speciesName
source: SENTRET
translation: 尾立

label: SPECIES_SENTRET.categoryName
source: Scout
translation: 放哨

label: SPECIES_SENTRET.description
source:
They take turns standing guard when it
is time to sleep. The sentry awakens the
others if it senses danger. If one becomes
separated, it turns sleepless with fear.
translation: 性格非常神经质。\n为了能看到远处的情况，\n它会用尾巴让自己站得更高。

label: SPECIES_FURRET.speciesName
source: FURRET
translation: 大尾立

label: SPECIES_FURRET.categoryName
source: Long Body
translation: 长躯干

label: SPECIES_FURRET.description
source:
A Furret has a very slim build. When under
attack, it can squirm through narrow
spaces and get away. In spite of its short
limbs, it is very nimble and fleet.
translation: 母亲会用细长的身体\n裹住孩子使其入睡。\n能用快速的动作追赶敌人。

label: SPECIES_HOOTHOOT.speciesName
source: HOOTHOOT
translation: 咕咕

label: SPECIES_HOOTHOOT.categoryName
source: Owl
translation: 猫头鹰

label: SPECIES_HOOTHOOT.description
source:
It has an internal organ that senses
the earth's rotation. Using this special
organ, a Hoothoot begins hooting at
precisely the same time every day.
translation: 不管在什么时候，\n体内的生物钟都准确无比，\n会用固定的节奏倾斜头部。

label: SPECIES_NOCTOWL.speciesName
source: NOCTOWL
translation: 猫头夜鹰

label: SPECIES_NOCTOWL.categoryName
source: Owl
translation: 猫头鹰

label: SPECIES_NOCTOWL.description
source:
It unfailingly catches prey in darkness.
Noctowl owe their success to superior
vision that allows them to see in minimal
light, and to their supple and silent wings.
translation: 双眼有着特殊的构造。\n只要接收到一点点光线，\n即使是在黑暗中也能分辨四周的情况。

label: SPECIES_LEDYBA.speciesName
source: LEDYBA
translation: 芭瓢虫

label: SPECIES_LEDYBA.categoryName
source: Five Star
translation: 五星

label: SPECIES_LEDYBA.description
source:
Ledyba communicate using a fluid that
they secrete from where the legs join the
body. They are said to convey feelings to
others by altering the fluid's scent.
translation: 非常胆小，\n不聚集成群就会因不安而无法动弹。\n用气味与伙伴互传心情。

label: SPECIES_LEDIAN.speciesName
source: LEDIAN
translation: 安瓢虫

label: SPECIES_LEDIAN.categoryName
source: Five Star
translation: 五星

label: SPECIES_LEDIAN.description
source:
It is said that in lands with clean air,
where the stars fill the sky, there live
many Ledian. For good reason, they use
the light of the stars as energy.
translation: 以星光作为能量。\n夜空中星星的数量变多时，\n背上的花纹就会变大。

label: SPECIES_SPINARAK.speciesName
source: SPINARAK
translation: 圆丝蛛

label: SPECIES_SPINARAK.categoryName
source: String Spit
translation: 吐丝

label: SPECIES_SPINARAK.description
source:
The web it spins can be considered its
second nervous system. It is said that a
Spinarak determines its prey by the tiny
vibrations it feels through the web.
translation: 用又细又结实的丝布下陷阱后，\n会一动不动地等待猎物落网。

label: SPECIES_ARIADOS.speciesName
source: ARIADOS
translation: 阿利多斯

label: SPECIES_ARIADOS.categoryName
source: Long Leg
translation: 长腿

label: SPECIES_ARIADOS.description
source:
Its feet are tipped with tiny hooked claws
that enable it to scuttle on ceilings and
vertical walls. It constricts its foe with
thin and strong silk webbing.
translation: 会将丝缠在猎物身上，然后故意放走。\n只要沿着丝就能把猎物\n和它的伙伴一网打尽。

label: SPECIES_CHINCHOU.speciesName
source: CHINCHOU
translation: 灯笼鱼

label: SPECIES_CHINCHOU.categoryName
source: Angler
translation: 琵琶鱼

label: SPECIES_CHINCHOU.description
source:
When it senses danger, it discharges
positive and negative electricity from its
two antennae. It lives in depths beyond
sunlight's reach.
translation: 会从2根触手的前端释放\n正负电来电麻对手。

label: SPECIES_LANTURN.speciesName
source: LANTURN
translation: 电灯怪

label: SPECIES_LANTURN.categoryName
source: Light
translation: 灯

label: SPECIES_LANTURN.description
source:
The light-emitting orbs on its back are
very bright. They are formed from a part of
its dorsal fin. This Pokémon illuminates
the inky darkness of deep seas.
translation: 会放出刺眼的亮光眩晕对手，\n然后趁对手无法动弹时将其整个吞下。

label: SPECIES_TOGEPI.speciesName
source: TOGEPI
translation: 波克比

label: SPECIES_TOGEPI.categoryName
source: Spike Ball
translation: 针球

label: SPECIES_TOGEPI.description
source:
As its energy, it uses the feelings of
compassion and pleasure exuded by
people and Pokémon. It stores up happy
feelings in its shell, then shares them out.
translation: 壳内好像塞满了很多幸福，\n据说如果能温柔对待它，\n它就会把幸运分给对方。

label: SPECIES_TOGETIC.speciesName
source: TOGETIC
translation: 波克基古

label: SPECIES_TOGETIC.categoryName
source: Happiness
translation: 幸福

label: SPECIES_TOGETIC.description
source:
It is said to be a Pokémon that brings good
fortune. When it spots someone who is pure
of heart, a Togetic appears and shares its
happiness with that person.
translation: 不待在温柔的人身边\n就会变得没有精神。\n不挥动翅膀也能浮在空中。

label: SPECIES_TOGEKISS.speciesName
source: TOGEKISS
translation: 波克基斯

label: SPECIES_TOGEKISS.categoryName
source: Jubilee
translation: 祝福

label: SPECIES_TOGEKISS.description
source:
As everyone knows, it visits peaceful
regions, bringing them gifts of kindness
and sweet blessings. It will never appear
where there is strife.
translation: 会给那些彼此认同对方且不做\n无端争斗的人们带去各种各样的恩惠。

label: SPECIES_NATU.speciesName
source: NATU
translation: 天然雀

label: SPECIES_NATU.categoryName
source: Tiny Bird
translation: 小鸟

label: SPECIES_NATU.description
source:
It runs up short trees that grow on the
savanna to peck at new shoots.
A Natu's eyes look as if they are
always observing something.
translation: 由于羽翼未丰，\n所以会跳着移动。\n一直在注视着什么。

label: SPECIES_XATU.speciesName
source: XATU
translation: 天然鸟

label: SPECIES_XATU.categoryName
source: Mystic
translation: 神秘

label: SPECIES_XATU.description
source:
It has the enigmatic power of foreseeing
the future. Some people in different lands
have long believed that Xatu are
emissaries from another world.
translation: 能够看穿过去和未来。\n日复一日注视着太阳\n动向的奇异宝可梦。

label: SPECIES_MAREEP.speciesName
source: MAREEP
translation: 咩利羊

label: SPECIES_MAREEP.categoryName
source: Wool
translation: 绵毛

label: SPECIES_MAREEP.description
source:
Its fluffy wool rubs together and builds
a static charge. The more energy is
charged, the more brightly the lightbulb
at the tip of its tail glows.
translation: 体毛会不断变长。\n即使到了夏天会全部掉光，\n也会在1周后恢复原样。

label: SPECIES_FLAAFFY.speciesName
source: FLAAFFY
translation: 茸茸羊

label: SPECIES_FLAAFFY.categoryName
source: Wool
translation: 绵毛

label: SPECIES_FLAAFFY.description
source:
Its fleece quality changes to generate
strong static electricity with a small
amount of wool. The bare, slick parts of its
hide are shielded against electricity.
translation: 由于储存了过多电力，\n造成它身体表面有些部分\n连绒毛都长不出来了。

label: SPECIES_AMPHAROS.speciesName
source: AMPHAROS
translation: 电龙

label: SPECIES_AMPHAROS.categoryName
source: Light
translation: 灯

label: SPECIES_AMPHAROS.description
source:
It gives off so much light that it can be
seen even from space. People in the old
days used its light to send signals back
and forth with others far away.
translation: 尾巴的前端闪耀着光芒。\n这光能传播到很远的地方，\n成为迷途者的路标。

label: SPECIES_AMPHAROS_MEGA.speciesName
source: AMPHAROS
translation: 电龙

label: SPECIES_AMPHAROS_MEGA.categoryName
source: Light
translation: 灯

label: SPECIES_AMPHAROS_MEGA.description
source:
Massive amounts of energy intensely
stimulated Ampharos's cells, apparently
awakening its long-sleeping dragon's
blood.
translation: 庞大的能量会激烈地刺激细胞。\n体内沉睡着的龙血好像觉醒了。

label: SPECIES_AZURILL.speciesName
source: AZURILL
translation: 露力丽

label: SPECIES_AZURILL.categoryName
source: Polka Dot
translation: 水珠

label: SPECIES_AZURILL.description
source:
Its tail, which is packed with nutrition,
is very bouncy like a rubber ball. On sunny
days they gather at the edge of water and
splash about for fun.
translation: 像皮球一般弹性十足。\n会挥舞尾巴来对抗\n体形比自己还大的对手。

label: SPECIES_MARILL.speciesName
source: MARILL
translation: 玛力露

label: SPECIES_MARILL.categoryName
source: Aqua Mouse
translation: 水鼠

label: SPECIES_MARILL.description
source:
Its body is covered with water-repellent
fur. Because of the fur, it can swim
through water at high speed without being
slowed by the water's resistance.
translation: 全身的体毛有着能将水弹开的特性，\n所以就算碰到水也不会弄湿。

label: SPECIES_AZUMARILL.speciesName
source: AZUMARILL
translation: 玛力露丽

label: SPECIES_AZUMARILL.categoryName
source: Aqua Rabbit
translation: 水兔

label: SPECIES_AZUMARILL.description
source:
It lives in water virtually all day long.
Its body color and pattern act as
camouflage that makes it tough for
enemies to spot in water.
translation: 只要静静地聆听，\n就能分辨出湍急的河流中有些什么。

label: SPECIES_BONSLY.speciesName
source: BONSLY
translation: 盆才怪

label: SPECIES_BONSLY.categoryName
source: Bonsai
translation: 盆栽

label: SPECIES_BONSLY.description
source:
Bonsly prefers an arid atmosphere.
In order to adjust the level of fluids
in its body, it exudes water from its eyes.
This makes it appear to be crying.
translation: 喜欢干燥的空气。\n调节水分时流出来的水\n看起来就像眼泪一样。

label: SPECIES_SUDOWOODO.speciesName
source: SUDOWOODO
translation: 树才怪

label: SPECIES_SUDOWOODO.categoryName
source: Imitation
translation: 模仿

label: SPECIES_SUDOWOODO.description
source:
It mimics a tree to avoid being attacked
by enemies. But since its forelegs
remain green throughout the year, it is
easily identified as a fake in the winter.
