translation: 总是伪装成树的样子。\n身体构造比起植物来，\n好像更接近石头或岩石一类的东西。

label: SPECIES_HOPPIP.speciesName
source: HOPPIP
translation: 毽子草

label: SPECIES_HOPPIP.categoryName
source: Cottonweed
translation: 棉草

label: SPECIES_HOPPIP.description
source:
This Pokémon drifts and floats with the
wind. If it senses the approach of strong
winds, a Hoppip links leaves with others
to prepare against being blown away.
translation: 会随风飘荡。\n据说如果毽子草集中出现在山野上，\n就说明春天快要到了。

label: SPECIES_SKIPLOOM.speciesName
source: SKIPLOOM
translation: 毽子花

label: SPECIES_SKIPLOOM.categoryName
source: Cottonweed
translation: 棉草

label: SPECIES_SKIPLOOM.description
source:
It blossoms when the temperature rises
above 64 degrees F. Because its flower's
blooming changes with the temperature,
it is sometimes used as a thermometer.
translation: 气温变高就会开花。\n为了沐浴更多阳光而飘浮在空中。

label: SPECIES_JUMPLUFF.speciesName
source: JUMPLUFF
translation: 毽子棉

label: SPECIES_JUMPLUFF.categoryName
source: Cottonweed
translation: 棉草

label: SPECIES_JUMPLUFF.description
source:
Jumpluff ride warm southern winds to
cross the sea and fly to foreign lands.
This Pokémon lands when it encounters
cold air while it is floating.
translation: 会随季风环绕世界1周。\n途中会播撒棉孢子。

label: SPECIES_AIPOM.speciesName
source: AIPOM
translation: 长尾怪手

label: SPECIES_AIPOM.categoryName
source: Long Tail
translation: 长尾

label: SPECIES_AIPOM.description
source:
Its tail ends with a dexterous, handlike
appendage. However, because it uses the
tail so much, Aipom's real hands have
become rather clumsy.
translation: 生活在高高的树上。\n在树枝间跳跃移动时，\n会用尾巴巧妙地保持平衡。

label: SPECIES_AMBIPOM.speciesName
source: AMBIPOM
translation: 双尾怪手

label: SPECIES_AMBIPOM.categoryName
source: Long Tail
translation: 长尾

label: SPECIES_AMBIPOM.description
source:
They live on large trees. Split into two,
the tails are so adept at handling and
doing things, Ambipom rarely uses
its hands now.
translation: 因为分成2条的尾巴\n能灵巧地处理各种事情，\n所以变得几乎不会使用手。

label: SPECIES_SUNKERN.speciesName
source: SUNKERN
translation: 向日种子

label: SPECIES_SUNKERN.categoryName
source: Seed
translation: 种子

label: SPECIES_SUNKERN.description
source:
Sunkern try to minimize movement to
conserve the nutrients they have stored
in their bodies for evolution. They will
not eat, subsisting only on morning dew.
translation: 仅靠饮用叶子背面储存的朝露生活。\n据说除此之外什么都不吃。

label: SPECIES_SUNFLORA.speciesName
source: SUNFLORA
translation: 向日花怪

label: SPECIES_SUNFLORA.categoryName
source: Sun
translation: 太阳

label: SPECIES_SUNFLORA.description
source:
Sunflora convert solar energy into
nutrition. They are highly active in the
warm daytime but suddenly stop moving as
soon as the sun sets.
translation: 白天总是精力充沛，\n随心所欲地到处活动，\n但太阳下山后却一动不动。

label: SPECIES_YANMA.speciesName
source: YANMA
translation: 蜻蜻蜓

label: SPECIES_YANMA.categoryName
source: Clear Wing
translation: 薄翼

label: SPECIES_YANMA.description
source:
It can see 360 degrees without moving
its eyes. It is a great flier capable of
making sudden stops and turning midair to
quickly chase down targeted prey.
translation: 如果高速挥动翅膀，\n就会产生冲击波依次\n震碎周围的玻璃窗。

label: SPECIES_YANMEGA.speciesName
source: YANMEGA
translation: 远古巨蜓

label: SPECIES_YANMEGA.categoryName
source: Ogre Darner
translation: 勾蜓

label: SPECIES_YANMEGA.description
source:
This six-legged Pokémon is easily capable
of transporting an adult in flight. It is
adept at biting apart foes while flying
by at high speed.
translation: 颚部的力量异常强大。\n擅长在高速飞行中咬碎\n与自己擦身而过的对手。

label: SPECIES_WOOPER.speciesName
source: WOOPER
translation: 乌波

label: SPECIES_WOOPER.categoryName
source: Water Fish
translation: 水鱼

label: SPECIES_WOOPER.description
source:
Wooper usually live in water but come
out onto land seeking food occasionally.
On land, they coat their bodies with a
gooey, toxic film.
translation: 性格悠闲自得。\n随心所欲游动时，\n头总会撞到船底。

label: SPECIES_QUAGSIRE.speciesName
source: QUAGSIRE
translation: 沼王

label: SPECIES_QUAGSIRE.categoryName
source: Water Fish
translation: 水鱼

label: SPECIES_QUAGSIRE.description
source:
A Quagsire hunts by leaving its mouth wide
open in water and waiting for its prey to
blunder in. Because it doesn't move, it
does not get very hungry.
translation: 在冰冷的水中生活。\n附近天气变凉之后，\n也会来到地上觅食。

label: SPECIES_WOOPER_PALDEA.speciesName
source: WOOPER
translation: 乌波

label: SPECIES_WOOPER_PALDEA.description
source:
After losing a territorial struggle,
Wooper began living on land.
The Pokémon changed over time, developing
a poisonous film to protect its body.
translation: 由于单独行动很危险，\n因此在沼地里行走时会\n3、4只排成一列来彼此协助。

label: SPECIES_CLODSIRE.speciesName
source: CLODSIRE
translation: 土王

label: SPECIES_CLODSIRE.categoryName
source: Spiny Fish
translation: 刺鱼

label: SPECIES_CLODSIRE.description
source:
When attacked, this Pokémon will
retaliate by sticking thick spines out
from its body. It's a risky move
that puts everything on the line.
translation: 栖息在池塘或沼泽的底部。\n会让乌波坐在自己背上，\n然后游着泳把它送到对岸去。

label: SPECIES_MURKROW.speciesName
source: MURKROW
translation: 黑暗鸦

label: SPECIES_MURKROW.categoryName
source: Darkness
translation: 黑暗

label: SPECIES_MURKROW.description
source:
Murkrow were feared as the alleged
bearers of ill fortune. It shows strong
interest in anything that sparkles. It will
even try to steal rings from women.
translation: 人们相信晚上看到它\n就会发生不吉利的事。\n因此，它是受人忌讳的宝可梦。

label: SPECIES_HONCHKROW.speciesName
source: HONCHKROW
translation: 乌鸦头头

label: SPECIES_HONCHKROW.categoryName
source: Big Boss
translation: 大头目

label: SPECIES_HONCHKROW.description
source:
Becoming active at night, it is known
to swarm with numerous Murkrow in tow.
It is said that it never forgives the
mistakes of its cronies.
translation: 乌鸦头头低声鸣叫的话，\n黑暗鸦就会立即聚集起来，\n因此也被称为黑夜召唤者。

label: SPECIES_MISDREAVUS.speciesName
source: MISDREAVUS
translation: 梦妖

label: SPECIES_MISDREAVUS.categoryName
source: Screech
translation: 夜啼

label: SPECIES_MISDREAVUS.description
source:
A Misdreavus frightens people with a
creepy, sobbing cry. It apparently uses
its red spheres to absorb the fear of foes
as its nutrition.
translation: 会突然咬住或是拉扯人的头发，\n然后看着对方大吃一惊的样子来取乐。

label: SPECIES_MISMAGIUS.speciesName
source: MISMAGIUS
translation: 梦妖魔

label: SPECIES_MISMAGIUS.categoryName
source: Magical
translation: 魔法

label: SPECIES_MISMAGIUS.description
source:
Its cries sound like incantations.
Those hearing it are tormented by
headaches and hallucinations.
It appears where you least expect it.
translation: 用咒语般的怪异叫声折磨对手。\n是神出鬼没的宝可梦。

label: gSpeciesInfoGen2.speciesName
source: UNOWN
translation: 未知图腾

label: gSpeciesInfoGen2.categoryName
source: Symbol
translation: 象征

label: SPECIES_WYNAUT.speciesName
source: WYNAUT
translation: 小果然

label: SPECIES_WYNAUT.categoryName
source: Bright
translation: 开朗

label: SPECIES_WYNAUT.description
source:
A Wynaut loves to eat sweet fruits.
It cleverly picks fruits using its earlike
arms. They gather in fruit gardens, drawn
by the fragrance.
translation: 通过与伙伴们进行互推游戏，\n练就了很强的忍耐力。\n非常喜欢吃甘甜的水果。

label: SPECIES_WOBBUFFET.speciesName
source: WOBBUFFET
translation: 果然翁

label: SPECIES_WOBBUFFET.categoryName
source: Patient
translation: 忍耐

label: SPECIES_WOBBUFFET.description
source:
Usually docile, a Wobbuffet strikes back
ferociously if its black tail is attacked.
It makes its lair in caves where it waits
for nightfall.
translation: 为了隐藏漆黑的尾巴\n而悄悄地生活在黑暗之中。\n不会主动发起攻击。

label: SPECIES_GIRAFARIG.speciesName
source: GIRAFARIG
translation: 麒麟奇

label: SPECIES_GIRAFARIG.categoryName
source: Long Neck
translation: 长颈

label: SPECIES_GIRAFARIG.description
source:
A Girafarig is an herbivore--it eats
grass and tree shoots. While it is eating,
its tail makes chewing and swallowing
motions as if it were also eating.
translation: 尾巴上也有着小小的大脑。\n如果有谁靠近的话，它就会对其气味\n产生反应并一口咬过来，需要注意。

label: SPECIES_FARIGIRAF.speciesName
source: FARIGIRAF
translation: 奇麒麟

label: SPECIES_FARIGIRAF.categoryName
source: Long Neck
translation: 长颈

label: SPECIES_FARIGIRAF.description
source:
Now that the brain waves from the
head and tail are synced up, the
psychic power of this Pokémon is 10
times stronger than Girafarig's.
translation: 以坚硬的尾巴头保护着本体的头，\n并甩动长长的脖子\n让对手吃它一记头槌。

label: SPECIES_PINECO.speciesName
source: PINECO
translation: 榛果球

label: SPECIES_PINECO.categoryName
source: Bagworm
translation: 蓑衣虫

label: SPECIES_PINECO.description
source:
A Pineco hangs from a tree branch and
waits for prey. While eating, if it is
disturbed by someone shaking its tree, it
falls on the ground and suddenly explodes.
translation: 非常喜欢把树皮叠在身上加厚外壳。\n就算变重了也不会在意。

label: SPECIES_FORRETRESS.speciesName
source: FORRETRESS
translation: 佛烈托斯

label: SPECIES_FORRETRESS.categoryName
source: Bagworm
translation: 蓑衣虫

label: SPECIES_FORRETRESS.description
source:
It keeps itself inside its steel shell.
The shell is opened when it is catching
prey, but it is so quick that the shell's
inside cannot be seen.
translation: 被钢铁外壳保护着。\n虽然眼睛会从缝隙里向外窥视，\n但里面的正身是什么仍是个谜。

label: SPECIES_DUNSPARCE.speciesName
source: DUNSPARCE
translation: 土龙弟弟

label: SPECIES_DUNSPARCE.categoryName
source: Land Snake
translation: 地蛇

label: SPECIES_DUNSPARCE.description
source:
Its drill-tipped tail is used to burrow into
the ground backwards. This Pokémon is
known to make its nest in complex shapes
deep under the ground.
translation: 一旦被谁看见了它的身影，\n就会用尾巴挖洞逃走。\n能用翅膀稍微浮在空中。

label: SPECIES_DUDUNSPARCE_TWO_SEGMENT.speciesName
source: DUDUNSPARCE
translation: 土龙节节

label: SPECIES_DUDUNSPARCE_TWO_SEGMENT.categoryName
source: Land Snake
translation: 地蛇

label: SPECIES_DUDUNSPARCE_TWO_SEGMENT.description
source:
This Pokémon uses its hard tail to
make its nest by boring holes into
bedrock deep underground. The nest
can reach lengths of over six miles.
translation: 最近的研究发现，\n它的身体会有多少节是由基因决定的。

label: SPECIES_DUDUNSPARCE_THREE_SEGMENT.speciesName
source: DUDUNSPARCE
translation: 土龙节节

label: SPECIES_DUDUNSPARCE_THREE_SEGMENT.categoryName
source: Land Snake
translation: 地蛇

label: SPECIES_DUDUNSPARCE_THREE_SEGMENT.description
source:
A recent study uncovered that the
number of segments a Dudunsparce's
body has is determined by the
Pokémon's genes.
translation: 会吸进空气充满细长的肺部，\n然后掀起强烈的爆炸气浪，\n将敌人赶出自己的巢穴。

label: SPECIES_GLIGAR.speciesName
source: GLIGAR
translation: 天蝎

label: SPECIES_GLIGAR.categoryName
source: Fly Scorpion
translation: 飞蝎

label: SPECIES_GLIGAR.description
source:
It glides without making a single sound.
It grasps the face of its foe using its
hind and large front claws, then stabs
with its poison barb.
translation: 会迎面飞来，\n然后趁着被缠上的猎物\n惊慌失措时刺入毒针。

label: SPECIES_GLISCOR.speciesName
source: GLISCOR
translation: 天蝎王

label: SPECIES_GLISCOR.categoryName
source: Fang Scorp
translation: 牙蝎

label: SPECIES_GLISCOR.description
source:
Gliscor observes prey while hanging
upside down from branches. Its flight is
soundless. When the chance presents
itself, it swoops!
translation: 可以不发出振翅声而在空中飞行。\n用长长的尾巴捕捉猎物，\n再用牙齿一击刺中要害。

label: SPECIES_SNUBBULL.speciesName
source: SNUBBULL
translation: 布鲁

label: SPECIES_SNUBBULL.categoryName
source: Fairy
translation: 妖精

label: SPECIES_SNUBBULL.description
source:
By baring its fangs and making a scary
face, it sends smaller Pokémon scurrying
in terror. The Snubbull does seem a
little sad at making its foes flee.
translation: 它是受女性欢迎的宝可梦。\n因为女性反倒会认为它那会\n吓跑小型宝可梦的鬼面很可爱。

label: SPECIES_GRANBULL.speciesName
source: GRANBULL
translation: 布鲁皇

label: SPECIES_GRANBULL.categoryName
source: Fairy
translation: 妖精

label: SPECIES_GRANBULL.description
source:
It has a particularly well-developed lower
jaw. The huge fangs are heavy, causing
it to tilt its head. Unless it is startled,
it will not try to bite.
translation: 面相虽凶，内心却很胆小。\n然而一旦开始发怒，\n就会用大牙齿来反击。

label: SPECIES_QWILFISH.speciesName
source: QWILFISH
translation: 千针鱼

label: SPECIES_QWILFISH.categoryName
source: Balloon
translation: 气球

label: SPECIES_QWILFISH.description
source:
A Qwilfish uses the pressure of water
it swallows to shoot toxic quills all at
once from all over its body. It finds
swimming to be somewhat challenging.
translation: 全身上下的小针都是\n由鳞片变化而来的。\n如果被刺中的话，就会因中毒而昏迷。

label: SPECIES_QWILFISH_HISUI.speciesName
source: QWILFISH
translation: 千针鱼

label: SPECIES_QWILFISH_HISUI.description
source:
A form of Qwilfish from the distant past.
Fishers detest this troublesome Pokémon
because it sprays poison from its spines,
getting it everywhere.
translation: 会从食物摄取毒素。\n突显紫色的针是它充满剧毒的证据。

label: SPECIES_OVERQWIL.speciesName
source: OVERQWIL
translation: 万针鱼

label: SPECIES_OVERQWIL.categoryName
source: Pin Cluster
translation: 剑山

label: SPECIES_OVERQWIL.description
source:
Its lancelike spikes and savage
temperament have earned it the
nickname “Sea Fiend”.
It slurps up poison to nourish itself.
translation: 个性凶悍，性情粗暴。\n毒针尖端呈锯齿状，\n被刺中时无法轻易拔出。

label: SPECIES_SHUCKLE.speciesName
source: SHUCKLE
translation: 壶壶

label: SPECIES_SHUCKLE.categoryName
source: Mold
translation: 发酵

label: SPECIES_SHUCKLE.description
source:
A Shuckle hides under rocks, keeping its
body concealed inside its shell while
eating stored berries. The berries mix with
its body fluids to become a juice.
translation: 甲壳里储存着树果。\n为了避免受到袭击，\n它会一动不动地躲在岩石下面。

label: SPECIES_HERACROSS.speciesName
source: HERACROSS
translation: 赫拉克罗斯

label: SPECIES_HERACROSS.categoryName
source: Single Horn
translation: 独角

label: SPECIES_HERACROSS.description
source:
They gather in forests seeking the sweet
sap of trees. It is completely clad in a
steel-hard shell. It is proud of its horn,
which it uses to fling foes.
translation: 能将引以为豪的角强行顶入\n对手的腹部下方，然后将其一口气\n举起并扔出去的大力士。

label: SPECIES_HERACROSS_MEGA.speciesName
source: HERACROSS
translation: 赫拉克罗斯

label: SPECIES_HERACROSS_MEGA.categoryName
source: Single Horn
translation: 独角

label: SPECIES_HERACROSS_MEGA.description
source:
A tremendous influx of energy builds it up,
but when Mega Evolution ends, Heracross
is bothered by terrible soreness in its
muscles.
translation: 超级进化结束后，\n它就会受苦于强烈的肌肉疼痛。

label: SPECIES_SNEASEL.speciesName
source: SNEASEL
translation: 狃拉

label: SPECIES_SNEASEL.categoryName
source: Sharp Claw
translation: 钩爪

label: SPECIES_SNEASEL.description
source:
A Sneasel scales trees by punching its
hooked claws into the bark. It seeks out
unguarded nests and steals eggs for food
while the parents are away.
translation: 手指中藏有锋利的爪子。\n会突然伸出那利爪，\n让袭击过来的对手心生怯意。

label: SPECIES_WEAVILE.speciesName
source: WEAVILE
translation: 玛狃拉

label: SPECIES_WEAVILE.categoryName
source: Sharp Claw
translation: 钩爪

label: SPECIES_WEAVILE.description
source:
They travel in groups of four or five,
leaving signs for one another on trees
and rocks. They bring down their prey
with coordinated attacks.
translation: 生活在寒冷地方的宝可梦。\n4到5只组成一个团队，\n以出色的合作来追捕猎物。

label: SPECIES_SNEASEL_HISUI.speciesName
source: SNEASEL
translation: 狃拉

label: SPECIES_SNEASEL_HISUI.description
source:
Its sturdy, curved claws are ideal for
traversing precipitous cliffs. From the
tips of these claws drips a venom that
infiltrates the nerves of any prey caught.
translation: 强健的爪子形状有助于在断崖绝壁\n上行动自如。爪子尖端滴出的毒液\n会在捉住猎物时侵袭其神经。

label: SPECIES_SNEASLER.speciesName
source: SNEASLER
translation: 大狃拉

label: SPECIES_SNEASLER.categoryName
source: Free Climb
translation: 攀崖

label: SPECIES_SNEASLER.description
source:
Because of its wicked poison and daunting
physical prowess, no other species could
hope to best it on frozen highlands. It
prefers solitude and doesn't form packs.
translation: 拥有凌驾其他物种之上的身体能力\n以及剧毒。在寒冷的高地上所向无敌。\n偏好独自行动而不会集结成群。

label: SPECIES_TEDDIURSA.speciesName
source: TEDDIURSA
translation: 熊宝宝

label: SPECIES_TEDDIURSA.categoryName
source: Little Bear
translation: 小熊

label: SPECIES_TEDDIURSA.description
source:
It licks its palms that are sweetened by
being soaked in honey. A Teddiursa makes
its own honey by blending fruits and pollen
collected by Beedrill.
translation: 会把甜甜的蜜渗入手掌里，\n然后舔个不停。\n每只熊宝宝的蜜味道都不一样。

label: SPECIES_URSARING.speciesName
source: URSARING
translation: 圈圈熊

label: SPECIES_URSARING.categoryName
source: Hibernator
translation: 冬眠

label: SPECIES_URSARING.description
source:
In forests, it is said that there are many
streams and towering trees where an
Ursaring gathers food. It walks through
its forest collecting food every day.
translation: 会用爪子在领地里能结出\n美味树果或水果的树上留下爪痕。

label: SPECIES_URSALUNA.speciesName
source: URSALUNA
translation: 月月熊

label: SPECIES_URSALUNA.categoryName
source: Peat
translation: 泥炭

label: SPECIES_URSALUNA.description
source: Swampy terrain gives Ursaluna its burly\nphysique and newfound capacity to\nmanipulate peat at will.
translation: 考察结果显示，正是遍布在洗翠大地\n上的湿地土壤，造就了它坚实的躯体\n和自在运用泥炭的新能力。

label: SPECIES_URSALUNA_BLOODMOON.speciesName
source: URSALUNA
translation: 月月熊

label: SPECIES_URSALUNA_BLOODMOON.categoryName
source: Peat
translation: 泥炭

label: SPECIES_URSALUNA_BLOODMOON.description
source:
It crossed the sea and drifted
ashore in a new land. Surviving in this
place led it to take on a unique
appearance and gain special powers.
translation: 很特别的月月熊，\n会用如铁般坚硬的泥土保护身体，\n并拥有能看穿黑暗的左眼。

label: SPECIES_SLUGMA.speciesName
source: SLUGMA
translation: 熔岩虫

label: SPECIES_SLUGMA.categoryName
source: Lava
translation: 熔岩

label: SPECIES_SLUGMA.description
source:
It is a species of Pokémon that lives in
volcanic areas. If its body cools, its skin
hardens and immobilizes it. To avoid that,
it sleeps near magma.
translation: 有着由熔岩构成的身体。\n如果不持续运动，\n身体就会因变冷而凝固。

label: SPECIES_MAGCARGO.speciesName
source: MAGCARGO
translation: 熔岩蜗牛

label: SPECIES_MAGCARGO.categoryName
source: Lava
translation: 熔岩

label: SPECIES_MAGCARGO.description
source:
The shell on its back is made of hardened
magma. Tens of thousands of years spent
living in volcanic craters have turned
Magcargo's bodies into magma.
translation: 体温约有1万度。\n火焰会从岩浆凝固后\n形成的壳的缝隙处喷出。

label: SPECIES_SWINUB.speciesName
source: SWINUB
translation: 小山猪

label: SPECIES_SWINUB.categoryName
source: Pig
translation: 小猪

label: SPECIES_SWINUB.description
source:
It roots for food by rubbing its snout
against the ground. Its favorite food is a
mushroom that grows under dried grass.
It occasionally roots out hot springs.
translation: 嗅到诱人的香味时，\n便会不顾一切地朝着\n气味的方向飞奔过去。

label: SPECIES_PILOSWINE.speciesName
source: PILOSWINE
translation: 长毛猪

label: SPECIES_PILOSWINE.categoryName
source: Swine
translation: 野猪

label: SPECIES_PILOSWINE.description
source:
A Piloswine is covered by a thick coat
of long hair for enduring freezing cold.
It uses its tusks to dig up food that has
been buried under ice.
translation: 朝着对手冲过去时，\n背上的体毛会倒竖起来。\n对声音极度敏感。

label: SPECIES_MAMOSWINE.speciesName
source: MAMOSWINE
translation: 象牙猪

label: SPECIES_MAMOSWINE.categoryName
source: Twin Tusk
translation: 双牙

label: SPECIES_MAMOSWINE.description
source:
A frozen Mamoswine was dug from ice
dating back 10,000 years. It woke up to
much amazement. This Pokémon has been
around for a long, long, long time.
translation: 从遥远的过去就存在的宝可梦，\n甚至在1万年前的冰层中也发现过它。

label: SPECIES_CORSOLA.speciesName
source: CORSOLA
translation: 太阳珊瑚

label: SPECIES_CORSOLA.categoryName
source: Coral
translation: 珊瑚

label: SPECIES_CORSOLA.description
source:
Corsola live in warm southern seas.
If the sea becomes polluted, the beautiful
coral stalks become discolored and crumble
away in tatters.
translation: 因为头部的前端会不断生长并脱落，\n而新长出来的头部前端又十分好看，\n所以作为宝物很受欢迎。

label: SPECIES_CORSOLA_GALAR.speciesName
source: CORSOLA
translation: 太阳珊瑚

label: SPECIES_CORSOLA_GALAR.description
source:
Sudden climate change wiped out this
ancient kind of Corsola. With its branches,
it absorbs others' life-force. It curses
those unaware that kick it by accident.
translation: 它是因急遽环境变化\n而死去的远古太阳珊瑚。\n会用珊瑚枝吸取人的精气。

label: SPECIES_CURSOLA.speciesName
source: CURSOLA
translation: 魔灵珊瑚

label: SPECIES_CURSOLA.categoryName
source: Coral
translation: 珊瑚

label: SPECIES_CURSOLA.description
source:
Its shell is overflowing with its
heightened otherworldly energy. The
ectoplasm serves as protection for this
Pokémon's core spirit.
translation: 一定要小心它那包覆着灵魂的灵体。\n如果触摸到，\n就会像石头一样动弹不得。

label: SPECIES_REMORAID.speciesName
source: REMORAID
translation: 铁炮鱼

label: SPECIES_REMORAID.categoryName
source: Jet
translation: 喷射

label: SPECIES_REMORAID.description
source:
A Remoraid uses its abdominal muscles
to forcefully expel swallowed water, then
shoot down flying prey. When evolution
approaches, it travels down rivers.
translation: 会用变成吸盘状的\n背鳍吸附在巨翅飞鱼身上，\n让它分一点吃剩的东西给自己吃。

label: SPECIES_OCTILLERY.speciesName
source: OCTILLERY
translation: 章鱼桶

label: SPECIES_OCTILLERY.categoryName
source: Jet
translation: 喷射

label: SPECIES_OCTILLERY.description
source:
It ensnares its foe with its suction-
cupped tentacles before delivering the
finishing blow. If the foe turns out to be
too strong, it spews ink to escape.
translation: 有着结实的坚硬脑袋。\n会用带吸盘的脚缠住对手，\n然后再一个劲地用头猛撞。

label: SPECIES_DELIBIRD.speciesName
source: DELIBIRD
translation: 信使鸟

label: SPECIES_DELIBIRD.categoryName
source: Delivery
translation: 搬运

label: SPECIES_DELIBIRD.description
source:
It carries food bundled up in its tail.
There was a famous explorer who
managed to scale Mt. Everest thanks
to a Delibird sharing its food.
translation: 一整天都在搬运食物。\n据说曾有遇险的人\n因为信使鸟的食物而得救。

label: SPECIES_MANTYKE.speciesName
source: MANTYKE
translation: 小球飞鱼

label: SPECIES_MANTYKE.categoryName
source: Kite
translation: 风筝

label: SPECIES_MANTYKE.description
source:
When it swims close to the surface
of the ocean, people aboard ships are
able to observe the pattern on its back.
It often swims in a school of Remoraid.
translation: 因为游在接近海面的地方，\n所以可以从船上观察到它背上的花纹。

label: SPECIES_MANTINE.speciesName
source: MANTINE
translation: 巨翅飞鱼

label: SPECIES_MANTINE.categoryName
source: Kite
translation: 风筝

label: SPECIES_MANTINE.description
source:
On sunny days, schools of Mantine can be
seen elegantly leaping over the waves.
It is not bothered by the Remoraid that
hitches rides.
translation: 悠然地畅游在大海中。\n就算有觊觎食物残渣的铁炮鱼\n吸附在自己身上也毫不在意。

label: SPECIES_SKARMORY.speciesName
source: SKARMORY
translation: 盔甲鸟

label: SPECIES_SKARMORY.categoryName
source: Armor Bird
translation: 钢甲鸟

label: SPECIES_SKARMORY.description
source:
A Pokémon that has a body and wings of
steel. People in the past used feathers
fallen from Skarmory to make swords and
knives.
translation: 全身覆盖着铁一般坚硬的铠甲。\n会以时速300公里的速度\n在空中飞来飞去。

label: SPECIES_SKARMORY_MEGA.speciesName
source: SKARMORY
translation: 盔甲鸟

label: SPECIES_SKARMORY_MEGA.categoryName
source: Armor Bird
translation: 钢甲鸟

label: SPECIES_SKARMORY_MEGA.description
source:
Due to the effects of Mega Evolution,
its pincers have taken a more
diabolical form, ripping anything
they pierce to shreds.
translation: 飞行速度超过音速。\n会掀起冲击波吹飞敌人，\n并用爪子给予致命一击。

label: SPECIES_HOUNDOUR.speciesName
source: HOUNDOUR
translation: 戴鲁比

label: SPECIES_HOUNDOUR.categoryName
source: Dark
translation: 阴暗

label: SPECIES_HOUNDOUR.description
source:
Houndour communicate with each other
using a variety of cries to corner their
prey. This Pokémon's remarkable teamwork
is simply unparalleled.
translation: 在联络伙伴和追赶猎物的时候，\n会分别发出不同种类的叫声。

label: SPECIES_HOUNDOOM.speciesName
source: HOUNDOOM
translation: 黑鲁加

label: SPECIES_HOUNDOOM.categoryName
source: Dark
translation: 阴暗

label: SPECIES_HOUNDOOM.description
source:
In a Houndoom pack, the one with its horns
raked sharply back serves a leadership
role. They choose their leader by fighting
among themselves.
translation: 听到它恐怖的长嚎后，\n宝可梦会浑身发抖，\n一溜烟地回到自己的巢里。

label: SPECIES_HOUNDOOM_MEGA.speciesName
source: HOUNDOOM
translation: 黑鲁加

label: SPECIES_HOUNDOOM_MEGA.categoryName
source: Dark
translation: 阴暗

label: SPECIES_HOUNDOOM_MEGA.description
source:
Its red claws and the tips of its tail are
melting from high internal temperatures
that are painful to Houndoom itself.
translation: 全身会因超级进化而发热。\n能喷出烈焰吐息，\n将对手烧成焦炭。

label: SPECIES_PHANPY.speciesName
source: PHANPY
translation: 小小象

label: SPECIES_PHANPY.categoryName
source: Long Nose
translation: 长鼻

label: SPECIES_PHANPY.description
source:
Phanpy's big ears serve as broad fans.
When it becomes hot, it flaps the ears
busily to cool down. Even the young are
very strong.
translation: 身体虽小却充满了力量。\n能轻轻松松地将成年人驮在背上行走。

label: SPECIES_DONPHAN.speciesName
source: DONPHAN
translation: 顿甲

label: SPECIES_DONPHAN.categoryName
source: Armor
translation: 铠甲

label: SPECIES_DONPHAN.description
source:
A Donphan is so strong it can easily haul
a dump truck. Its hide has toughened to a
rock-hard state. An ordinary sort of
attack won't even leave a scratch.
translation: 会使出把身体蜷成一团，\n边滚边猛撞过去的攻击。\n只要一击就能把房屋撞得散架。

label: SPECIES_STANTLER.speciesName
source: STANTLER
translation: 惊角鹿

label: SPECIES_STANTLER.categoryName
source: Big Horn
translation: 大角

label: SPECIES_STANTLER.description
source:
Stantler's magnificent antlers were
once traded at high prices as works of art.
As a result, this Pokémon was hunted
close to extinction.
translation: 如果盯着它的角看，\n就会产生一种似乎要\n被吸入圆心的神奇感觉。

label: SPECIES_WYRDEER.speciesName
source: WYRDEER
translation: 诡角鹿

label: SPECIES_WYRDEER.categoryName
source: Big Horn
translation: 大角

label: SPECIES_WYRDEER.description
source:
The black orbs shine with an uncanny light
when it is erecting invisible barriers.
The fur shed from its beard retains heat
and is useful for winter clothing.
translation: 制造肉眼不可见的障壁时，黑珠会\n发出妖异的光辉。从它身上脱落的胡须\n是用来制作温暖冬衣的实用原料。

label: SPECIES_SMEARGLE.speciesName
source: SMEARGLE
translation: 图图犬

label: SPECIES_SMEARGLE.categoryName
source: Painter
translation: 画画

label: SPECIES_SMEARGLE.description
source:
A Smeargle marks its territory using a
fluid that leaks out from the tip of its
tail. About 5,000 different marks left by
this Pokémon have been found.
translation: 有着成年后让伙伴在自己\n背上画下脚印标记的习性。

label: SPECIES_MILTANK.speciesName
source: MILTANK
translation: 大奶罐

label: SPECIES_MILTANK.categoryName
source: Milk Cow
translation: 奶牛

label: SPECIES_MILTANK.description
source:
It gives over five gallons of milk daily.
Its sweet milk is enjoyed by children and
grown-ups alike. People who can't drink
milk turn it into yogurt and eat it instead.
translation: 都说喝着大奶罐的奶长大的孩子，\n会变得健康又强壮。

label: SPECIES_RAIKOU.speciesName
source: RAIKOU
translation: 雷公

label: SPECIES_RAIKOU.categoryName
source: Thunder
translation: 天雷

label: SPECIES_RAIKOU.description
source:
Raikou embodies the speed of lightning.
Its roars send shock waves shuddering
through the air and ground as if
lightning bolts were crashing down.
translation: 据说是和雷电一同降临的宝可梦。\n能够从背上的雨云放射出雷电。

label: SPECIES_ENTEI.speciesName
source: ENTEI
translation: 炎帝

label: SPECIES_ENTEI.categoryName
source: Volcano
translation: 火山

label: SPECIES_ENTEI.description
source:
Entei embodies the passion of magma.
It is thought to have been born in the
eruption of a volcano. It blasts fire that
consumes all that it touches.
translation: 据说如果炎帝吼叫的话，\n世界上的某处火山就会喷发。

label: SPECIES_SUICUNE.speciesName
source: SUICUNE
translation: 水君

label: SPECIES_SUICUNE.categoryName
source: Aurora
translation: 极光

label: SPECIES_SUICUNE.description
source:
Suicune embodies the compassion of
a pure spring of water. It runs across
the land with gliding elegance. It has the
power to purify dirty water.
translation: 在全世界四处奔跑，\n让污水重回清澈。\n会随北风奔跑着离去。

label: SPECIES_LARVITAR.speciesName
source: LARVITAR
translation: 幼基拉斯

label: SPECIES_LARVITAR.categoryName
source: Rock Skin
translation: 岩石肤

label: SPECIES_LARVITAR.description
source:
A Larvitar is born deep under the ground.
It must eat its way through the soil above
and reach the surface for it to see its
parents' faces.
translation: 以吃土为生。\n吃掉一座大山后，\n就会为了成长而开始沉睡。

label: SPECIES_PUPITAR.speciesName
source: PUPITAR
translation: 沙基拉斯

label: SPECIES_PUPITAR.categoryName
source: Hard Shell
translation: 子弹

label: SPECIES_PUPITAR.description
source:
A Pupitar creates a gas inside its body
that it ejects under compression to propel
itself like a jet. Its body can withstand
a collision with solid steel.
translation: 虽然全身覆盖着岩盘一样的硬壳，\n但它力量强大，\n发狂后连山都会崩塌。

label: SPECIES_TYRANITAR.speciesName
source: TYRANITAR
translation: 班基拉斯

label: SPECIES_TYRANITAR.categoryName
source: Armor
translation: 铠甲

label: SPECIES_TYRANITAR.description
source:
A Tyranitar is so overwhelmingly powerful,
it can bring down a whole mountain to make
its nest. It roams in mountains seeking
new opponents to fight.
translation: 由于班基拉斯发狂会导致山崩地裂，\n河流填平，\n所以到时需要重新绘制地图。

label: SPECIES_TYRANITAR_MEGA.speciesName
source: TYRANITAR
translation: 班基拉斯

label: SPECIES_TYRANITAR_MEGA.categoryName
source: Armor
translation: 铠甲

label: SPECIES_TYRANITAR_MEGA.description
source:
Due to the colossal power poured into it,
this Pokémon's back split right open. Its
destructive instincts are the only thing
keeping it moving.
translation: 因超级进化的影响，\n它变得更加粗暴了。\n不清楚它是否还会听从训练家的命令。

label: SPECIES_LUGIA.speciesName
source: LUGIA
translation: 洛奇亚

label: SPECIES_LUGIA.categoryName
source: Diving
translation: 潜水

label: SPECIES_LUGIA.description
source:
Lugia is so powerful even a light
fluttering of its wings can blow apart
houses. As a result, it chooses to live out
of sight deep under the sea.
translation: 沉睡在很深的海沟底部。\n据说洛奇亚挥动翅膀的话，\n就会引起长达40天的暴风雨。

label: SPECIES_HO_OH.speciesName
source: HO-OH
translation: 凤王

label: SPECIES_HO_OH.categoryName
source: Rainbow
translation: 虹色

label: SPECIES_HO_OH.description
source:
Its feathers--which glow in seven colors
depending on the angle at which they are
struck by light--are thought to bring joy.
It is said to live at the foot of a rainbow.
translation: 其翅膀闪耀着七种色彩。\n传说见到凤王的人\n能够拥有永远的幸福。

label: SPECIES_CELEBI.speciesName
source: CELEBI
translation: 时拉比

label: SPECIES_CELEBI.categoryName
source: Time Travel
translation: 时空穿越

label: SPECIES_CELEBI.description
source:
This Pokémon came from the future by
crossing over time. It is thought that so
long as Celebi appears, a bright and
shining future awaits us.
translation: 能够使用穿越时光的力量。\n据说只会出现在和平的时代。

label: SPECIES_TREECKO.speciesName
source: TREECKO
translation: 木守宫

label: SPECIES_TREECKO.categoryName
source: Wood Gecko
translation: 林蜥

label: SPECIES_TREECKO.description
source:
It makes its nest in a giant tree in the
forest. It ferociously guards against
anything nearing its territory. It is said
to be the protector of the forest's trees.
translation: 脚底长有许多小刺，\n所以能够在墙壁和天花板上行走。

label: SPECIES_GROVYLE.speciesName
source: GROVYLE
translation: 森林蜥蜴

label: SPECIES_GROVYLE.categoryName
source: Wood Gecko
translation: 林蜥

label: SPECIES_GROVYLE.description
source:
Leaves grow out of this Pokémon's body.
They help obscure a Grovyle from the eyes
of its enemies while it is in a thickly
overgrown forest.
translation: 栖息在密林里。\n会在枝头间跳跃移动着接近猎物。

label: SPECIES_SCEPTILE.speciesName
source: SCEPTILE
translation: 蜥蜴王

label: SPECIES_SCEPTILE.categoryName
source: Forest
translation: 密林

label: SPECIES_SCEPTILE.description
source:
In the jungle, its power is without equal.
This Pokémon carefully grows trees and
plants. It regulates its body temperature
by basking in sunlight.
translation: 会轻快地在丛林里跑来跑去，\n并用手臂上长出的锋利叶子解决猎物。

label: SPECIES_SCEPTILE_MEGA.categoryName
source: Forest
translation: 密林

label: SPECIES_SCEPTILE_MEGA.description
source:
Thanks to the power in its quick legs,
Mega Sceptile can be on its opponent in a
flash. It can cut off a portion of its tail
to fire it like a missile at an opponent.
translation: 会运用高速的脚力快速接近对手。\n切断巨大的尾巴，\n可以像导弹一般发射攻击对手。

label: SPECIES_TORCHIC.speciesName
source: TORCHIC
translation: 火稚鸡

label: SPECIES_TORCHIC.categoryName
source: Chick
translation: 雏鸡

label: SPECIES_TORCHIC.description
source:
If attacked, it strikes back by spitting
balls of fire it forms in its stomach.
A Torchic dislikes darkness because it
can't see its surroundings.
translation: 因为体内燃烧着火焰，\n所以抱在怀里非常温暖。\n可以喷出1000度的火球。

label: SPECIES_COMBUSKEN.speciesName
source: COMBUSKEN
translation: 力壮鸡

label: SPECIES_COMBUSKEN.categoryName
source: Young Fowl
translation: 幼鸡

label: SPECIES_COMBUSKEN.description
source:
It lashes out with 10 kicks per second.
Its strong fighting instinct compels it
to keep up its offensive until the
opponent gives up.
translation: 有着1秒内连踢10次的腿技。\n会用尖锐的叫声威吓对手。

label: SPECIES_BLAZIKEN.speciesName
source: BLAZIKEN
translation: 火焰鸡

label: SPECIES_BLAZIKEN.categoryName
source: Blaze
translation: 猛火

label: SPECIES_BLAZIKEN.description
source:
It learns martial arts that use punches
and kicks. Every several years, its old
feathers burn off, and new, supple
feathers grow back in their place.
translation: 从手腕喷出的火焰包裹住整个\n拳头后使出的拳击能把对手烧成焦炭。

label: SPECIES_BLAZIKEN_MEGA.categoryName
source: Blaze
translation: 猛火

label: SPECIES_BLAZIKEN_MEGA.description
source:
As it unleashes a flurry of savage kicks,
its legs can begin to burn from the
friction of the surrounding atmosphere.
They're always a source of pride to it.
translation: 引以为傲的飞脚变得更强。\n当它重复使出飞脚时，\n脚会因为和空气的磨擦燃烧。

label: SPECIES_MUDKIP.speciesName
source: MUDKIP
translation: 水跃鱼

label: SPECIES_MUDKIP.categoryName
source: Mud Fish
translation: 沼鱼

label: SPECIES_MUDKIP.description
source:
On land, it can powerfully lift large
boulders by planting its four feet and
heaving. It sleeps by burying itself in soil
at the water's edge.
translation: 会用头上的鳍感知水流，\n从而了解周围的情况。\n有着能举起岩石的力量。

label: SPECIES_MARSHTOMP.speciesName
source: MARSHTOMP
translation: 沼跃鱼

label: SPECIES_MARSHTOMP.categoryName
source: Mud Fish
translation: 沼鱼

label: SPECIES_MARSHTOMP.description
source:
Its toughened hind legs enable it to stand
upright. Because it weakens if its skin
dries out, it replenishes fluids by playing
in mud.
translation: 腰腿十分结实，\n即使是在泥泞的地上也能稳步前进。\n会把身体埋进泥里睡觉。

label: SPECIES_SWAMPERT.speciesName
source: SWAMPERT
translation: 巨沼怪

label: SPECIES_SWAMPERT.categoryName
source: Mud Fish
translation: 沼鱼

label: SPECIES_SWAMPERT.description
source:
If it senses the approach of a storm and
a tidal wave, it protects its seaside nest
by piling up boulders. It swims as fast as
a jet ski.
translation: 拥有能拖着大型船只游动的力量。\n只要挥一挥粗壮的手臂就能打倒对手。

label: SPECIES_SWAMPERT_MEGA.categoryName
source: Mud Fish
translation: 沼鱼

label: SPECIES_SWAMPERT_MEGA.description
source:
When it Mega Evolves, the strength that it
needs to act in the water is increased.
It can use its tenacious power
both on land and in the water.
translation: 当它超级进化时，\n在水中行动的力量会增加。\n能在陆地和水中发挥其顽强的力量。

label: SPECIES_POOCHYENA.speciesName
source: POOCHYENA
translation: 土狼犬

label: SPECIES_POOCHYENA.categoryName
source: Bite
translation: 紧咬

label: SPECIES_POOCHYENA.description
source:
It savagely threatens foes with bared
fangs. It chases after fleeing targets
tenaciously. It turns tail and runs,
however, if the foe strikes back.
translation: 性格执着的宝可梦。\n一旦盯上某个猎物，\n就会追到对方精疲力尽。

label: SPECIES_MIGHTYENA.speciesName
source: MIGHTYENA
translation: 大狼犬

label: SPECIES_MIGHTYENA.categoryName
source: Bite
translation: 紧咬

label: SPECIES_MIGHTYENA.description
source:
In the wild, Mightyena live in a pack.
They never defy their leader's orders.
They defeat foes with perfectly
coordinated teamwork.
translation: 在追捕猎物时会群体行动。\n绝对不会违背优秀训练家的命令。

label: SPECIES_ZIGZAGOON.speciesName
source: ZIGZAGOON
translation: 蛇纹熊

label: SPECIES_ZIGZAGOON.categoryName
source: Tiny Raccoon
translation: 豆狸

label: SPECIES_ZIGZAGOON.description
source:
Rubbing its nose against the ground, it
always wanders about back and forth in
search of something. It is distinguished
by the zigzag footprints it leaves.
translation: 此宝可梦会以之字形走路。\n擅长发现埋藏在草丛或地里的宝物。

label: SPECIES_LINOONE.speciesName
source: LINOONE
translation: 直冲熊

label: SPECIES_LINOONE.categoryName
source: Rushing
translation: 猛冲

label: SPECIES_LINOONE.description
source:
It is exceedingly fast if it only has to run
in a straight line. When it spots pond-
dwelling prey underwater, it quickly leaps
in and catches it with its sharp claws.
translation: 能以100公里的时速扑向猎物，\n但因为只能沿直线奔跑，\n所以扑空次数比较多。

label: SPECIES_ZIGZAGOON_GALAR.description
source:
Its restlessness has it constantly moving
in zigzags. It will purposely run into other
Pokémon to start fights. It's thought to
be the oldest form of Zigzagoon.
translation: 这似乎是蛇纹熊最古老的样子。\n会之字形乱走，\n把周围弄得一团糟。

label: SPECIES_LINOONE_GALAR.description
source:
This very aggressive Pokémon will
recklessly challenge opponents stronger
than itself. It uses its long tongue to
taunt them to then tackle forcefully.
translation: 有着十分好战的性情。\n即使是比自己强的对手\n也会鲁莽地发起挑战。

label: SPECIES_OBSTAGOON.speciesName
source: OBSTAGOON
translation: 堵拦熊

label: SPECIES_OBSTAGOON.categoryName
source: Blocking
translation: 停止

label: SPECIES_OBSTAGOON.description
source:
Its voice is staggering in volume.
Obstagoon has a tendency to take on a
threatening posture and shout--this move
is known as Obstruct.
translation: 在不断的斗争中得到了进化。\n它交叉着双臂发出的怒吼\n能让一切对手都为之胆怯。

label: SPECIES_WURMPLE.speciesName
source: WURMPLE
translation: 刺尾虫

label: SPECIES_WURMPLE.categoryName
source: Worm
translation: 虫宝宝

label: SPECIES_WURMPLE.description
source:
It sticks to tree branches and eats
leaves. The thread it spits from its mouth,
which becomes gooey when it touches
air, slows the movement of its foes.
translation: 非常喜欢吃叶子。\n受到姆克儿的袭击时，\n会用尾部的刺击退对方。

label: SPECIES_SILCOON.speciesName
source: SILCOON
translation: 甲壳茧

label: SPECIES_SILCOON.categoryName
source: Cocoon
translation: 蛹

label: SPECIES_SILCOON.description
source:
It prepares for evolution using the
energy it stored while it was a Wurmple.
It keeps watch over the surroundings with
its two eyes.
translation: 会将丝线缠在树枝上。\n一边喝着丝线上挂着的雨水，\n一边等待着进化的那一刻。

label: SPECIES_BEAUTIFLY.speciesName
source: BEAUTIFLY
translation: 狩猎凤蝶

label: SPECIES_BEAUTIFLY.categoryName
source: Butterfly
translation: 蝴蝶

label: SPECIES_BEAUTIFLY.description
source:
Its colorfully patterned wings are its
most prominent feature. It flies through
flower-covered fields collecting pollen.
It attacks ferociously when angered.
translation: 会用细长的嘴巴刺向对手，\n并吸取对手的体液。\n生性好斗。

label: SPECIES_CASCOON.speciesName
source: CASCOON
translation: 盾甲茧

label: SPECIES_CASCOON.categoryName
source: Cocoon
translation: 蛹

label: SPECIES_CASCOON.description
source:
To avoid detection by its enemies, it hides
motionlessly beneath large leaves and in
the gaps of branches. It also attaches
dead leaves to its body for camouflage.
translation: 就算进化了也不会忘记\n待在茧中时受到的攻击。\n一定会想方设法进行报复。

label: SPECIES_DUSTOX.speciesName
source: DUSTOX
translation: 毒粉蛾

label: SPECIES_DUSTOX.categoryName
source: Poison Moth
translation: 毒蛾

label: SPECIES_DUSTOX.description
source:
It is a nocturnal Pokémon that flies from
fields and mountains to the attraction of
streetlights at night. It looses highly
toxic powder from its wings.
translation: 受到袭击时会猛烈地\n扇动翅膀撒出剧毒的粉末。\n太阳下山后就会开始活动。

label: SPECIES_LOTAD.speciesName
source: LOTAD
translation: 莲叶童子

label: SPECIES_LOTAD.categoryName
source: Water Weed
translation: 浮萍

label: SPECIES_LOTAD.description
source:
This Pokémon lives in ponds with clean
water. It is known to ferry small Pokémon
across ponds by carrying them on the
broad leaf on its head.
translation: 酷似水草的宝可梦。\n会把不会游泳的宝可梦\n放在叶子上送至对岸。

label: SPECIES_LOMBRE.speciesName
source: LOMBRE
translation: 莲帽小童

label: SPECIES_LOMBRE.categoryName
source: Jolly
translation: 爽朗

label: SPECIES_LOMBRE.description
source:
In the evening, it takes great delight in
popping out of rivers and startling people.
It feeds on aquatic moss that grows on
rocks in the riverbed.
translation: 它是一个如果遇到垂钓者，\n就会从水中扯线捣乱\n并引以为乐的捣蛋鬼。

label: SPECIES_LUDICOLO.speciesName
source: LUDICOLO
translation: 乐天河童

label: SPECIES_LUDICOLO.categoryName
source: Carefree
translation: 乐天

label: SPECIES_LUDICOLO.description
source:
When it hears festive music, all the cells
in its body become stimulated, and it
begins moving in rhythm. It does not
quail even when it faces a tough opponent.
translation: 如果听到欢快的音乐，\n体内就会充满力量，\n会情不自禁地跳起舞来。

label: SPECIES_SEEDOT.speciesName
source: SEEDOT
translation: 橡实果

label: SPECIES_SEEDOT.categoryName
source: Acorn
translation: 橡实

label: SPECIES_SEEDOT.description
source:
It hangs off branches and absorbs
nutrients. When it finishes eating, its
body becomes so heavy that it drops to
the ground with a thump.
translation: 悬挂在树枝上时，\n看起来就和树果一模一样。\n会以吓唬想要啄食它的宝可梦为乐。

label: SPECIES_NUZLEAF.speciesName
source: NUZLEAF
translation: 长鼻叶

label: SPECIES_NUZLEAF.categoryName
source: Wily
translation: 捉弄

label: SPECIES_NUZLEAF.description
source:
A forest-dwelling Pokémon that is skilled
at climbing trees. Its long and pointed
nose is its weak point. It loses power if
the nose is gripped.
translation: 吹奏出的草笛声会让人感到不安。\n它居住在森林的深处。

label: SPECIES_SHIFTRY.speciesName
source: SHIFTRY
translation: 狡猾天狗

label: SPECIES_SHIFTRY.categoryName
source: Wicked
translation: 邪恶

label: SPECIES_SHIFTRY.description
source:
It is said to arrive on chilly, wintry winds.
Feared from long ago as the guardian of
forests, this Pokémon lives in a deep
forest where people do not venture.
translation: 如果扇起叶子团扇，\n就会掀起风速30米的瞬时强风，\n吹跑民房。

label: SPECIES_TAILLOW.speciesName
source: TAILLOW
translation: 傲骨燕

label: SPECIES_TAILLOW.categoryName
source: Tiny Swallow
translation: 幼燕

label: SPECIES_TAILLOW.description
source:
Although it is small, it is very courageous.
It will take on a larger Skarmory on an
equal footing. However, its will weakens if
it becomes hungry.
translation: 有着不管是怎样强大的对手\n都敢于前去迎战的毅力。\n会向着温暖的土地飞行。

label: SPECIES_SWELLOW.speciesName
source: SWELLOW
translation: 大王燕

label: SPECIES_SWELLOW.categoryName
source: Swallow
translation: 燕子

label: SPECIES_SWELLOW.description
source:
A Swellow dives upon prey from far above.
It never misses its targets. It takes to
the skies in search of lands with a warm
climate.
translation: 边在高空盘旋边搜寻猎物，\n发现猎物后会头朝下\n急速俯冲将其捕获。

label: SPECIES_WINGULL.speciesName
source: WINGULL
translation: 长翅鸥

label: SPECIES_WINGULL.categoryName
source: Seagull
translation: 海鸥

label: SPECIES_WINGULL.description
source:
It makes its nest on a sheer cliff at the
edge of the sea. It has trouble keeping
its wings flapping in flight. Instead, it
soars on updrafts.
translation: 能乘着上升气流像滑翔机\n一样在空中飞翔，\n搬运鸟嘴中衔着的食物。

label: SPECIES_PELIPPER.speciesName
source: PELIPPER
translation: 大嘴鸥

label: SPECIES_PELIPPER.categoryName
source: Water Bird
translation: 水鸟

label: SPECIES_PELIPPER.description
source:
It skims the tops of waves as it flies.
When it spots prey, it uses its large beak
to scoop up the victim with water.
It protects its eggs in its beak.
translation: 把小型宝可梦和蛋放进嘴里，\n并运送到安全地方的空中运送员。

label: SPECIES_RALTS.speciesName
source: RALTS
translation: 拉鲁拉丝

label: SPECIES_RALTS.categoryName
source: Feeling
translation: 心情

label: SPECIES_RALTS.description
source:
A Ralts has the power to sense the
emotions of people and Pokémon with the
horns on its head. It takes cover if it
senses any hostility.
translation: 用红色的角捕捉到\n人和宝可梦的温情后，\n全身也会稍稍变暖起来。

label: SPECIES_KIRLIA.speciesName
source: KIRLIA
translation: 奇鲁莉安

label: SPECIES_KIRLIA.categoryName
source: Emotion
translation: 感情

label: SPECIES_KIRLIA.description
source:
A Kirlia has the psychic power to create 
a rip in the dimensions and see into the
future. It is said to dance with pleasure
on sunny mornings.
translation: 可以通过操纵精神力量\n扭曲周围的空间来看清未来。

label: SPECIES_GARDEVOIR.speciesName
source: GARDEVOIR
translation: 沙奈朵

label: SPECIES_GARDEVOIR.categoryName
source: Embrace
translation: 包容

label: SPECIES_GARDEVOIR.description
source:
It apparently does not feel the pull of
gravity because it supports itself with
psychic power. It will give its life to
protect its Trainer.
translation: 如果是为了保护训练家，\n它就会用尽自己的精神力量\n制造出小型黑洞。

label: SPECIES_GARDEVOIR_MEGA.categoryName
source: Embrace
translation: 包容

label: SPECIES_GARDEVOIR_MEGA.description
source:
By opening its heart, Mega Gardevoir
becomes able to use tremendous psychic
power. The red plate in its chest is said to
be a physical manifestation of its heart.
translation: 解放了自己的心之后，\n就可以释放出强大的超能力。据说其\n胸口的红色结构是它实体化的内心。

label: SPECIES_GALLADE.speciesName
source: GALLADE
translation: 艾路雷朵

label: SPECIES_GALLADE.categoryName
source: Blade
translation: 利刃

label: SPECIES_GALLADE.description
source:
A master of courtesy and swordsmanship,
it fights using extending swords on its
elbows when trying to protect someone.
It can sense what its foe is thinking.
translation: 因为有着能敏锐感知对手想法的能力，\n所以可以率先攻击。

label: SPECIES_GALLADE_MEGA.categoryName
source: Blade
translation: 利刃

label: SPECIES_GALLADE_MEGA.description
source:
Mega Gallade has a knightly appearance.
It can use its psychic power to reshape
both arms into blades simultaneously and
fight using a dual-wielding style.
translation: 超级艾路雷朵具有骑士般的外表。\n能用精神力量将双臂化为刀刃，\n并运用双刀战斗。

label: SPECIES_SURSKIT.speciesName
source: SURSKIT
translation: 溜溜糖球

label: SPECIES_SURSKIT.categoryName
source: Pond Skater
translation: 水黾

label: SPECIES_SURSKIT.description
source:
They gather on puddles after evening
downpours, gliding across the surface
of water as if sliding. It secretes honey
with a sweet aroma from its head.
translation: 能在水面上像滑行一样行走。\n会从头顶释放出甜甜的气味引诱猎物。

label: SPECIES_MASQUERAIN.speciesName
source: MASQUERAIN
translation: 雨翅蛾

label: SPECIES_MASQUERAIN.categoryName
source: Eyeball
translation: 眼珠

label: SPECIES_MASQUERAIN.description
source:
It intimidates foes with the large eyelike
patterns on its antennae. Because it can't
fly if its wings get wet, it shelters itself
from rain under large trees and eaves.
translation: 有着长有眼珠花纹的触角。\n能用4根翅膀浮在空中，\n并向前后左右移动。

label: SPECIES_SHROOMISH.speciesName
source: SHROOMISH
translation: 蘑蘑菇

label: SPECIES_SHROOMISH.categoryName
source: Mushroom
translation: 蘑菇

label: SPECIES_SHROOMISH.description
source:
It loves to eat damp, composted soil in
forests. If you enter a forest after a
long rain, you can see many Shroomish
feasting on composted soil.
translation: 会从头顶上喷出毒孢子。\n如果不小心吸入了孢子，\n身上的每处关节都会开始疼痛。

label: SPECIES_BRELOOM.speciesName
source: BRELOOM
translation: 斗笠菇

label: SPECIES_BRELOOM.categoryName
source: Mushroom
translation: 蘑菇

label: SPECIES_BRELOOM.description
source:
It scatters spores from holes in the cap
on its head. It loves warm and humid
climates. It feeds on trees and plants in
fields and forests.
translation: 短短的手臂在出拳时会猛地一下伸长。\n有着能令职业拳击手汗颜的技术。

label: SPECIES_SLAKOTH.speciesName
source: SLAKOTH
translation: 懒人獭

label: SPECIES_SLAKOTH.categoryName
source: Slacker
translation: 懒人

label: SPECIES_SLAKOTH.description
source:
It sleeps virtually all day and night long.
It doesn't change its nest its entire life,
but it sometimes travels great distances
by swimming in rivers.
translation: 懒人獭慵懒的样子会深深地\n刺激看着它的人的懒惰之心。

label: SPECIES_VIGOROTH.speciesName
source: VIGOROTH
translation: 过动猿

label: SPECIES_VIGOROTH.categoryName
source: Wild Monkey
translation: 暴猿

label: SPECIES_VIGOROTH.description
source:
It can't keep still because its blood boils
with energy. It runs through the fields
and mountains all day to calm itself. If it
doesn't, it can't sleep at night.
translation: 如果不活动活动身体，\n压力就会堆积过度，\n使身体状况变糟。

label: SPECIES_SLAKING.speciesName
source: SLAKING
translation: 请假王

label: SPECIES_SLAKING.categoryName
source: Lazy
translation: 怕麻烦

label: SPECIES_SLAKING.description
source:
Hordes of Slaking gather around trees
when fruits come into season. They wait
around patiently for ripened fruits to fall
out of the trees.
translation: 虽然是世界上最吊儿郎当的宝可梦，\n但能通过把积蓄的能量一次放出，\n从而发挥出惊人的力量。

label: SPECIES_NINCADA.speciesName
source: NINCADA
translation: 土居忍士

label: SPECIES_NINCADA.categoryName
source: Trainee
translation: 入门

label: SPECIES_NINCADA.description
source:
It makes its nest at the roots of a mighty
tree. Using its whiskerlike antennae, it
probes its surroundings in the
pitch-black darkness of soil.
translation: 在地下成长。\n会用触角代替几乎看不到\n东西的眼睛来探察周围的情况。

label: SPECIES_NINJASK.speciesName
source: NINJASK
translation: 铁面忍者

label: SPECIES_NINJASK.categoryName
source: Ninja
translation: 忍者

label: SPECIES_NINJASK.description
source:
Because it darts about vigorously at high
speed, it is very difficult to see. Hearing
its distinctive cries for too long induces
a headache.
translation: 由于移动的速度过快，\n有时很难看到它的身影。\n会聚集在树液周围。

label: SPECIES_SHEDINJA.speciesName
source: SHEDINJA
translation: 脱壳忍者

label: SPECIES_SHEDINJA.categoryName
source: Shed
translation: 空壳

label: SPECIES_SHEDINJA.description
source:
A peculiar Pokémon that floats in air even
though its wings remain completely still.
The inside of its body is hollow and
utterly dark.
translation: 蜕下的壳有了灵魂。\n从它背上的缝隙向里面窥视的话，\n灵魂好像就会被吸走。

label: SPECIES_WHISMUR.speciesName
source: WHISMUR
translation: 咕妞妞

label: SPECIES_WHISMUR.categoryName
source: Whisper
translation: 细语

label: SPECIES_WHISMUR.description
source:
Its cries equal a jet plane in volume.
It inhales through its ear canals. Because
of this system, it can cry continually
without having to catch its breath.
translation: 平时叫起来细声细气。\n一旦觉得不安，就会用等同\n喷气式飞机的音量叫个不停。

label: SPECIES_LOUDRED.speciesName
source: LOUDRED
translation: 吼爆弹

label: SPECIES_LOUDRED.categoryName
source: Big Voice
translation: 大声

label: SPECIES_LOUDRED.description
source:
It positions the round speakers on its
head to assail foes with ultrasonic waves
at massive volume. It builds power by
stomping the ground.
translation: 大叫所产生的冲击波会掀翻卡车。\n会通过跺脚来提高威力。

label: SPECIES_EXPLOUD.speciesName
source: EXPLOUD
translation: 爆音怪

label: SPECIES_EXPLOUD.categoryName
source: Loud Noise
translation: 噪音

label: SPECIES_EXPLOUD.description
source:
It has sound-generating organs all over
its body. It communicates with others by
adjusting the tone and volume of the cries
it emits.
translation: 爆音怪的长嚎能传至10公里之外。\n会从身上的多个洞里发出各种声音。

label: SPECIES_MAKUHITA.speciesName
source: MAKUHITA
translation: 幕下力士

label: SPECIES_MAKUHITA.categoryName
source: Guts
translation: 毅力

label: SPECIES_MAKUHITA.description
source:
It loves to toughen up its body above all
else. If you hear quaking rumbles in a cave,
it is the sound of Makuhita undertaking
strenuous training.
translation: 会撞击粗壮的树干来锻炼身体。\n住处附近随处可见折断的树木。

label: SPECIES_HARIYAMA.speciesName
source: HARIYAMA
translation: 铁掌力士

label: SPECIES_HARIYAMA.categoryName
source: Arm Thrust
translation: 猛推

label: SPECIES_HARIYAMA.description
source:
It has the habit of challenging others
without hesitation to tests of strength.
It's been known to stand on train tracks
and stop trains using forearm thrusts.
translation: 非常喜欢和体型很大的\n宝可梦们比试力气。\n一巴掌就能打飞卡车。

label: SPECIES_NOSEPASS.speciesName
source: NOSEPASS
translation: 朝北鼻

label: SPECIES_NOSEPASS.categoryName
source: Compass
translation: 罗盘

label: SPECIES_NOSEPASS.description
source:
Its body emits a powerful magnetism.
It feeds on prey that is pulled in by the
force. Its magnetism is stronger in cold
seasons.
translation: 遇到危机时，\n它有时会增强磁力吸引\n周围的铁块来保护自身。

label: SPECIES_PROBOPASS.speciesName
source: PROBOPASS
translation: 大朝北鼻

label: SPECIES_PROBOPASS.categoryName
source: Compass
translation: 罗盘

label: SPECIES_PROBOPASS.description
source:
It freely controls three units called
Mini-Noses using magnetic force.
With them, it can attack its foes from
three directions.
translation: 从全身放出强大的磁力。\n操纵被称为小朝北鼻的3个部件。

label: SPECIES_SKITTY.speciesName
source: SKITTY
translation: 向尾喵

label: SPECIES_SKITTY.categoryName
source: Kitten
translation: 小猫

label: SPECIES_SKITTY.description
source:
A Skitty's adorably cute behavior makes it
highly popular. In battle, it makes its tail
puff out. It threatens foes with a sharp
growl.
translation: 不由自主地就会去追动的东西。\n会追着自己的尾巴，\n一圈圈地原地打转。

label: SPECIES_DELCATTY.speciesName
source: DELCATTY
translation: 优雅猫

label: SPECIES_DELCATTY.categoryName
source: Prim
translation: 清高

label: SPECIES_DELCATTY.description
source:
Rather than keeping a permanent lair,
it habitually seeks comfortable spots and
sleeps there. It is nocturnal and becomes
active at dusk.
translation: 有着美丽的毛发，\n非常受女性训练家的欢迎。\n没有固定的住所。

label: SPECIES_SABLEYE.speciesName
source: SABLEYE
translation: 勾魂眼

label: SPECIES_SABLEYE.categoryName
source: Darkness
translation: 黑暗

label: SPECIES_SABLEYE.description
source:
It digs branching holes in caves using its
sharp claws in search of food--raw gems.
A Sableye lurks in darkness and is seen
only rarely.
translation: 潜伏于洞窟的阴暗处。\n在吃宝石的过程中，\n眼睛变成了宝石。

label: SPECIES_SABLEYE_MEGA.categoryName
source: Darkness
translation: 黑暗

label: SPECIES_SABLEYE_MEGA.description
source: Bathed in the energy of Mega Evolution,\nthe gemstone on its chest expands, rips\nthrough its skin, and falls out.
translation: 巨大化的宝石可以防御住所有攻击。\n但是因为特别重，\n不擅长移动。

label: SPECIES_MAWILE.speciesName
source: MAWILE
translation: 大嘴娃

label: SPECIES_MAWILE.categoryName
source: Deceiver
translation: 欺骗

label: SPECIES_MAWILE.description
source:
Its giant jaws are actually steel horns
that transformed. It fools foes into
complacency with its adorable gestures,
then chomps them with its huge jaws.
translation: 头上长着由角变化而来的大颚。\n连工字钢都可以咬断。

label: SPECIES_MAWILE_MEGA.categoryName
source: Deceiver
translation: 欺骗

label: SPECIES_MAWILE_MEGA.description
source:
Its two sets of jaws thrash about
violently as if they each had a will of
their own. One gnash from them can turn a
boulder to dust.
translation: 2个颚部像是有意识一样，\n猛烈地大闹着。\n只要咬一口，连岩石都能粉碎。

label: SPECIES_ARON.speciesName
source: ARON
translation: 可可多拉

label: SPECIES_ARON.categoryName
source: Iron Armor
translation: 铁铠

label: SPECIES_ARON.description
source:
A Pokémon that is clad in steel armor.
A new suit of armor is made when it evolves.
The old, discarded armor is salvaged as
metal for making iron products.
translation: 虽然平时住在深山里，\n但肚子饿了就会出现在山脚下，\n吃铁轨或者车辆。

label: SPECIES_LAIRON.speciesName
source: LAIRON
translation: 可多拉

label: SPECIES_LAIRON.categoryName
source: Iron Armor
translation: 铁铠

label: SPECIES_LAIRON.description
source:
When two Lairon meet in the wild, they
fight for territory by bashing into each
other with their steel bodies. The sound
of their collision carries for miles.
translation: 挖掘铁矿石作为食物。\n有着用钢铁之躯互相撞击\n以争夺领地的习性。

label: SPECIES_AGGRON.speciesName
source: AGGRON
translation: 波士可多拉

label: SPECIES_AGGRON.categoryName
source: Iron Armor
translation: 铁铠

label: SPECIES_AGGRON.description
source:
Its iron horns grow longer a little at
a time. They are used to determine the
Aggron's age. The gouges in its armor are
worn with pride as mementos from battles.
translation: 会一边用钢角撞毁坚硬的岩盘，\n一边挖隧道寻找铁矿\n来作为自己的食物。

label: SPECIES_AGGRON_MEGA.categoryName
source: Iron Armor
translation: 铁铠

label: SPECIES_AGGRON_MEGA.description
source:
When Aggron Mega Evolves into
Mega Aggron, the destructive ability of
its fearsome horns can turn a steel-clad
tank into so much scrap metal.
translation: 超级进化后的波士可多拉\n头上的角的可怕的破坏力足以将\n一辆全副武装的坦克变成一坨废铁。

label: SPECIES_MEDITITE.speciesName
source: MEDITITE
translation: 玛沙那

label: SPECIES_MEDITITE.categoryName
source: Meditate
translation: 冥想

label: SPECIES_MEDITITE.description
source:
It continually meditates for hours every
day. As a result of rigorous and dedicated
yoga training, it has tempered its
spiritual power so much it can fly.
translation: 总是在深山里修行。\n通过冥想提高精神力后，\n身体就会飘浮起来。

label: SPECIES_MEDICHAM.speciesName
source: MEDICHAM
translation: 恰雷姆

label: SPECIES_MEDICHAM.categoryName
source: Meditate
translation: 冥想

label: SPECIES_MEDICHAM.description
source:
Through crushingly harsh yoga training, it
gained the power to foretell its foe's
actions. It battles with elegant, dance-
like movement.
translation: 会用跳舞一般的优雅动作\n一边躲避攻击，\n一边向对手施展强烈的一击。

label: SPECIES_MEDICHAM_MEGA.categoryName
source: Meditate
translation: 冥想

label: SPECIES_MEDICHAM_MEGA.description
source:
It uses its amped-up willpower to create
additional arms for itself. The more it
has trained its spirit, the more realistic
and dexterous these arms become.
translation: 能用增强的精神力量为自己创造\n额外的手臂。 它的精神训练得越多，\n这些手臂就会变得愈发真实和灵巧。

label: SPECIES_ELECTRIKE.speciesName
source: ELECTRIKE
translation: 落雷兽

label: SPECIES_ELECTRIKE.categoryName
source: Lightning
translation: 闪电

label: SPECIES_ELECTRIKE.description
source:
It generates electricity using friction
from the atmosphere. In seasons with
especially arid air, its entire body blazes
with violent showers of sparks.
translation: 会使用体毛中积蓄的电来刺激肌肉，\n并以此来提高自己的瞬间爆发力。

label: SPECIES_MANECTRIC.speciesName
source: MANECTRIC
translation: 雷电兽

label: SPECIES_MANECTRIC.categoryName
source: Discharge
translation: 放电

label: SPECIES_MANECTRIC.description
source:
Because lightning falls in their vicinities,
Manectric were thought to have been born
from lightning. In battle, they create
thunderclouds.
translation: 一直在从鬃毛中放电。\n会在自己头上制造雷云，\n然后劈下闪电进行攻击。

label: SPECIES_MANECTRIC_MEGA.categoryName
source: Discharge
translation: 放电

label: SPECIES_MANECTRIC_MEGA.description
source: Too much electricity has built up in its\nbody, irritating Manectric. Its explosive\nspeed is equal to that of a lightning bolt.
translation: 因身体里储存着过多的电而焦躁不安。\n有着与落雷相同速度的瞬间爆发力。

label: SPECIES_PLUSLE.speciesName
source: PLUSLE
translation: 正电拍拍

label: SPECIES_PLUSLE.categoryName
source: Cheering
translation: 加油

label: SPECIES_PLUSLE.description
source:
It has the trait of cheering on its fellow
Pokémon. By shorting out the electricity
it releases from its paws, it creates
pom-poms for cheering.
translation: 会制造火花拉拉球来给伙伴加油。\n能从电线杆上吸取电力。

label: SPECIES_MINUN.speciesName
source: MINUN
translation: 负电拍拍

label: SPECIES_MINUN.categoryName
source: Cheering
translation: 加油

label: SPECIES_MINUN.description
source:
At a meeting of Pokémon academics, it was
announced that simultaneous exposure to
electricity from a Plusle and Minun will
promote circulation and boost vitality.
translation: 有给伙伴加油的习性。\n如果伙伴快要输掉的话，\n体内迸发出的火花数量就会不断增多。

label: SPECIES_VOLBEAT.speciesName
source: VOLBEAT
translation: 电萤虫

label: SPECIES_VOLBEAT.categoryName
source: Firefly
translation: 萤火虫

label: SPECIES_VOLBEAT.description
source:
With their taillights lit, Volbeat fly in
a swarm, drawing geometric designs in the
night sky. They move their nests if their
pond water becomes dirty.
translation: 到了晚上会亮起臀部与伙伴交流。\n非常喜欢甜甜萤放出的甜甜香气。

label: SPECIES_ILLUMISE.speciesName
source: ILLUMISE
translation: 甜甜萤

label: SPECIES_ILLUMISE.categoryName
source: Firefly
translation: 萤火虫

label: SPECIES_ILLUMISE.description
source:
A nocturnal Pokémon that becomes active
upon nightfall. It leads a Volbeat swarm
to draw patterns in the night sky. Over 200
different patterns have been confirmed.
translation: 会利用甜甜的香气诱导电萤虫\n在夜空中描绘发光的记号。

label: SPECIES_BUDEW.speciesName
source: BUDEW
translation: 含羞苞

label: SPECIES_BUDEW.categoryName
source: Bud
translation: 花苞

label: SPECIES_BUDEW.description
source:
Over the winter, it closes its bud and
endures the cold. Sensitive to changing
temperature, the bud is said to bloom
when it feels the sun's warm touch.
translation: 冬季会合上花苞忍受严寒。\n春天到来时就会打开花苞，\n飞散出花粉。

label: SPECIES_ROSELIA.speciesName
source: ROSELIA
translation: 毒蔷薇

label: SPECIES_ROSELIA.categoryName
source: Thorn
translation: 荆棘

label: SPECIES_ROSELIA.description
source:
A Roselia that drinks nutritionally rich
springwater blooms with lovely flowers.
The fragrance of its flowers has the
effect of making its foes careless.
translation: 会用右手和左手分别放出\n2种不同的毒来进行攻击。\n香气越浓越有精神。

label: SPECIES_ROSERADE.speciesName
source: ROSERADE
translation: 罗丝雷朵

label: SPECIES_ROSERADE.categoryName
source: Bouquet
translation: 花束

label: SPECIES_ROSERADE.description
source:
Its sweet aroma attracts prey.
With the movements of a dancer,
it strikes with whips that are densely
lined with poison thorns.
translation: 用舞者般的身体动作挥动\n毒刺密布的鞭子进行攻击。

label: SPECIES_GULPIN.speciesName
source: GULPIN
translation: 溶食兽

label: SPECIES_GULPIN.categoryName
source: Stomach
translation: 胃袋

label: SPECIES_GULPIN.description
source:
This Pokémon's stomach fluid can even
digest scrap iron. In one gulp, it can
swallow something that is as large as
itself.
translation: 整个身体几乎都是胃。\n吞下的东西会立刻\n被强力的胃液消化掉。

label: SPECIES_SWALOT.speciesName
source: SWALOT
translation: 吞食兽

label: SPECIES_SWALOT.categoryName
source: Poison Bag
translation: 毒袋

label: SPECIES_SWALOT.description
source:
Its powerful stomach acid is capable of
digesting almost anything. The one thing
in the whole world a Swalot can't digest is
its own stomach.
translation: 不管是什么都会整个吞掉。\n会将毛孔中分泌出的\n剧毒体液撒向敌人。

label: SPECIES_CARVANHA.speciesName
source: CARVANHA
translation: 利牙鱼

label: SPECIES_CARVANHA.categoryName
source: Savage
translation: 凶猛

label: SPECIES_CARVANHA.description
source:
Carvanha attack ships in swarms, making
them sink. Although it is said to be a very
vicious Pokémon, it timidly flees as soon
as it finds itself alone.
translation: 会成群结队攻击进入自己领地的对手。\n尖锐的牙齿连船的底部也能咬穿。

label: SPECIES_SHARPEDO.speciesName
source: SHARPEDO
translation: 巨牙鲨

label: SPECIES_SHARPEDO.categoryName
source: Brutal
translation: 凶暴

label: SPECIES_SHARPEDO.description
source:
The vicious and sly gangster of the sea.
Its skin is specially textured to minimize
drag in water. Its speed tops out at over
75 miles per hour.
translation: 有着连铁板都能咬碎的牙齿，\n游动时，时速可达120公里。\n它的别名是大海恶霸。

label: SPECIES_SHARPEDO_MEGA.categoryName
source: Brutal
translation: 凶暴

label: SPECIES_SHARPEDO_MEGA.description
source:
The yellow patterns it bears are old scars.
The energy from Mega Evolution runs
through them, causing it sharp pain and
suffering.
translation: 在猛撞的瞬间，\n会从头上射出尖刺，\n给对手的身体造成很深的伤。

label: SPECIES_WAILMER.speciesName
source: WAILMER
translation: 吼吼鲸

label: SPECIES_WAILMER.categoryName
source: Ball Whale
translation: 球鲸

label: SPECIES_WAILMER.description
source:
While this Pokémon usually lives in the sea,
it can survive on land, although not too
long. It loses vitality if its body becomes
dried out.
translation: 天晴时会游上沙滩，\n像球一样弹跳着玩耍。\n通过鼻子把水喷得很高。

label: SPECIES_WAILORD.speciesName
source: WAILORD
translation: 吼鲸王

label: SPECIES_WAILORD.categoryName
source: Float Whale
translation: 浮鲸

label: SPECIES_WAILORD.description
source:
It breathes through nostrils that it
raises above the sea. By inhaling to its
maximum capacity, a Wailord can dive close
to 10,000 feet beneath the waves.
translation: 最大的宝可梦。\n不换气就可以下潜\n到3000米的深度。

label: SPECIES_NUMEL.speciesName
source: NUMEL
translation: 呆火驼

label: SPECIES_NUMEL.categoryName
source: Numb
translation: 迟钝

label: SPECIES_NUMEL.description
source:
A Numel stores boiling magma in the hump
on its back. It is a hardy Pokémon that can
transport a 220-pound load. It has served
humans at work since long ago.
translation: 会把灼热的熔岩储存在背上的驼峰里。\n一旦淋了雨，熔岩就会冷却，\n动作也会变得迟缓。

label: SPECIES_CAMERUPT.speciesName
source: CAMERUPT
translation: 喷火驼

label: SPECIES_CAMERUPT.categoryName
source: Eruption
translation: 喷火

label: SPECIES_CAMERUPT.description
source:
A Pokémon that lives in the crater of
a volcano. Every 10 years, the volcanoes
on its back erupt violently. Research is
under way on the cause of eruption.
translation: 发怒后会从背上的驼峰里\n喷出灼热的熔岩。\n在火山口有它的住所。

label: SPECIES_CAMERUPT_MEGA.categoryName
source: Eruption
translation: 喷火

label: SPECIES_CAMERUPT_MEGA.description
source:
The humps on its back have transformed
into one large and very active volcano. It
has a deep hatred of water or any moisture
and has an explosive personality.
translation: 它背上的驼峰已经变成了一座\n巨大且非常活跃的火山。 十分厌恶\n水分和潮湿，性格十分火爆。

label: SPECIES_TORKOAL.speciesName
source: TORKOAL
translation: 煤炭龟

label: SPECIES_TORKOAL.categoryName
source: Coal
translation: 煤炭

label: SPECIES_TORKOAL.description
source:
It battles using energy it gets from
burning coal. When loosing smoke from its
nostrils, it lets off a sound that is
similar to a locomotive's horn.
translation: 会在甲壳中燃烧煤炭产生能量。\n危急关头会喷出黑色的煤烟。

label: SPECIES_SPOINK.speciesName
source: SPOINK
translation: 跳跳猪

label: SPECIES_SPOINK.categoryName
source: Bounce
translation: 弹跳

label: SPECIES_SPOINK.description
source:
A Pokémon that manipulates psychic power
at will. It doesn't stop bouncing even when
it is asleep. It loves eating mushrooms
that grow underground.
translation: 会用尾巴代替弹簧，\n一直在跳来跳去。\n靠跳跃时的震动来使心脏跳动。

label: SPECIES_GRUMPIG.speciesName
source: GRUMPIG
translation: 噗噗猪

label: SPECIES_GRUMPIG.categoryName
source: Manipulate
translation: 操纵

label: SPECIES_GRUMPIG.description
source:
It stores power in the black pearls on its
forehead. When it uses psychic power, it
performs an odd dance step. Its style of
dancing became hugely popular overseas.
translation: 能用黑珍珠增强自己的精神力量。\n会用神奇的舞步操纵对手的心。

label: SPECIES_SPINDA.speciesName
source: SPINDA
translation: 晃晃斑

label: SPECIES_SPINDA.categoryName
source: Spot Panda
translation: 斑点熊猫

label: SPECIES_SPINDA.description
source:
It is distinguished by a pattern of
spots that is always different. Its
unsteady, tottering walk has the
effect of fouling its foe's aim.
translation: 世上没有斑点花纹相同的晃晃斑。\n会用晃晃悠悠的步伐\n来避开对手的瞄准。

label: SPECIES_TRAPINCH.speciesName
source: TRAPINCH
translation: 大颚蚁

label: SPECIES_TRAPINCH.categoryName
source: Ant Pit
translation: 蚁狮

label: SPECIES_TRAPINCH.description
source:
Its big jaws crunch through boulders.
Because its head is so big, it has a hard
time getting back upright if it tips over
onto its back.
translation: 栖息在干燥的沙漠里。\n会待在捣蒜钵状的巢穴中，\n一动不动地持续等着猎物出现。

label: SPECIES_VIBRAVA.speciesName
source: VIBRAVA
translation: 超音波幼虫

label: SPECIES_VIBRAVA.categoryName
source: Vibration
translation: 震动

label: SPECIES_VIBRAVA.description
source:
It looses ultrasonic waves by rubbing its
wings together. Since a Vibrava's wings
are still in the process of growing, it can
only fly short distances.
translation: 会剧烈地振动翅膀来产生超音波。\n能用消化液来溶化昏迷的猎物。

label: SPECIES_FLYGON.speciesName
source: FLYGON
translation: 沙漠蜻蜓

label: SPECIES_FLYGON.categoryName
source: Mystic
translation: 神秘

label: SPECIES_FLYGON.description
source:
The flapping of its wings sounds like
singing. To prevent detection by enemies,
it hides itself by flapping up a cloud of
desert sand.
translation: 被称为沙漠精灵。\n隐藏在挥动翅膀掀起的沙暴中。

label: SPECIES_CACNEA.speciesName
source: CACNEA
translation: 刺球仙人掌

label: SPECIES_CACNEA.categoryName
source: Cactus
translation: 仙人掌

label: SPECIES_CACNEA.description
source:
Cacnea live in deserts with virtually no
rainfall. It battles by swinging its thick,
spiked arms. Once a year, a yellow flower
blooms.
translation: 栖息在沙漠之中。\n将水分储存在体内，\n即使滴水不喝也可以生存30天。

label: SPECIES_CACTURNE.speciesName
source: CACTURNE
translation: 梦歌仙人掌

label: SPECIES_CACTURNE.categoryName
source: Scarecrow
translation: 稻草人

label: SPECIES_CACTURNE.description
source:
After spending thousands of years in
harsh deserts, its blood transformed into
the same substances as sand. It is
nocturnal, so it hunts at night.
translation: 到了夜间会开始活动。\n会找出并捉住那些因受不了\n沙漠炎热而精疲力竭的猎物。

label: SPECIES_SWABLU.speciesName
source: SWABLU
translation: 青绵鸟

label: SPECIES_SWABLU.categoryName
source: Cotton Bird
translation: 绵鸟

label: SPECIES_SWABLU.description
source:
A Pokémon that has wings like cottony
clouds. After enduring winter, in which
little food is available, Swablu flocks
move closer to towns in the spring.
translation: 如果自己和周围不干净，\n就无法静下心来的性格。\n见到脏东西就会用羽毛擦掉。

label: SPECIES_ALTARIA.speciesName
source: ALTARIA
translation: 七夕青鸟

label: SPECIES_ALTARIA.categoryName
source: Humming
translation: 哼唱

label: SPECIES_ALTARIA.description
source:
It hums in a beautiful soprano voice.
It flies among white clouds in the blue
sky. It launches intensely hot fireballs
from its mouth.
translation: 在晴朗日子里会混在棉花云里\n自由地在空中飞来飞去，\n会用优美的高音歌唱。

label: SPECIES_ALTARIA_MEGA.categoryName
source: Humming
translation: 哼唱

label: SPECIES_ALTARIA_MEGA.description
source:
It sings with a voice that is even more
beautiful than before it Mega Evolved.
Its feathers became larger for protection
and glimmer with an iridescent sheen.
translation: 它的歌声比超级进化前更加动听。\n用于保护自身的羽毛变得更大，\n并闪烁着彩虹般的光泽。

label: SPECIES_ZANGOOSE.speciesName
source: ZANGOOSE
translation: 猫鼬斩

label: SPECIES_ZANGOOSE.categoryName
source: Cat Ferret
translation: 猫鼬

label: SPECIES_ZANGOOSE.description
source:
When it battles, it stands on its hind legs
and attacks with its sharply clawed
forelegs. Its fur bristles if it encounters
any Seviper.
translation: 好以来一直在与饭匙蛇战斗。\n锋利的爪子是它最强的武器。

label: SPECIES_SEVIPER.speciesName
source: SEVIPER
translation: 饭匙蛇

label: SPECIES_SEVIPER.categoryName
source: Fang Snake
translation: 牙蛇

label: SPECIES_SEVIPER.description
source:
Seviper and Zangoose are eternal rivals.
It counters a Zangoose's dazzling agility
with its swordlike tail, which also oozes
a horrible poison.
translation: 因为一直在用岩石打磨尾巴上的刀刃，\n所以异常锋利。\n和猫鼬斩是死对头。

label: SPECIES_LUNATONE.speciesName
source: LUNATONE
translation: 月石

label: SPECIES_LUNATONE.categoryName
source: Meteorite
translation: 陨石

label: SPECIES_LUNATONE.description
source:
It becomes very active on the night of
a full moon. This Pokémon was first
discovered 40 years ago at the site of
a meteor strike.
translation: 满月之夜会变得特别活跃，\n因此它的这一习性\n据说和月亮的圆缺有关。

label: SPECIES_SOLROCK.speciesName
source: SOLROCK
translation: 太阳岩

label: SPECIES_SOLROCK.categoryName
source: Meteorite
translation: 陨石

label: SPECIES_SOLROCK.description
source:
Solar energy is the source of this 
Pokémon's power. On sunny days, groups of
Solrock line up facing the sun and absorb
its light.
translation: 据传是太阳分身的新品种宝可梦。\n会通过旋转身体放出光芒。

label: SPECIES_BARBOACH.speciesName
source: BARBOACH
translation: 泥泥鳅

label: SPECIES_BARBOACH.categoryName
source: Whiskers
translation: 须鱼

label: SPECIES_BARBOACH.description
source:
Its body is covered with a slimy film.
The film acts as a barrier to prevent germs
in muddy water from entering the
Barboach's body.
translation: 身体滑溜溜的很难抓住。\n某个地区流传着泥泥鳅\n是由泥土凝结而成的说法。

label: SPECIES_WHISCASH.speciesName
source: WHISCASH
translation: 鲶鱼王

label: SPECIES_WHISCASH.categoryName
source: Whiskers
translation: 须鱼

label: SPECIES_WHISCASH.description
source:
Mysteriously, it can foretell earthquakes.
In the daytime, it sleeps in mud at the
bottom of a pond. When it awakens, it
continually feeds throughout the night.
translation: 领地意识非常强烈。\n如果有外敌接近，\n就会剧烈摇晃地面并发动袭击。

label: SPECIES_CORPHISH.speciesName
source: CORPHISH
translation: 龙虾小兵

label: SPECIES_CORPHISH.categoryName
source: Ruffian
translation: 无赖

label: SPECIES_CORPHISH.description
source:
Once it grips prey with its large pincers,
it will never let go, no matter what.
It is a hardy Pokémon that can thrive
in any environment.
translation: 可以适应任何环境，\n有着强大生命力的宝可梦。\n不会放开夹到的猎物。

label: SPECIES_CRAWDAUNT.speciesName
source: CRAWDAUNT
translation: 铁螯龙虾

label: SPECIES_CRAWDAUNT.categoryName
source: Rogue
translation: 流氓

label: SPECIES_CRAWDAUNT.description
source:
A brutish Pokémon that loves to battle.
A veteran Crawdaunt that has prevailed in
hundreds of battles has giant pincers
marked with countless scars.
translation: 它是个粗暴的家伙。\n会用钳子把住在池塘里的其他\n宝可梦夹起来扔到外面去。

label: SPECIES_BALTOY.speciesName
source: BALTOY
translation: 天秤偶

label: SPECIES_BALTOY.categoryName
source: Clay Doll
translation: 泥偶

label: SPECIES_BALTOY.description
source:
A Baltoy moves by spinning on its single
foot. It has been depicted in murals 
adorning the walls of a once-bustling city
in an ancient age.
translation: 会用单脚旋转着移动。\n是在古代遗迹中发现的珍奇宝可梦。

label: SPECIES_CLAYDOL.speciesName
source: CLAYDOL
translation: 念力土偶

label: SPECIES_CLAYDOL.categoryName
source: Clay Doll
translation: 泥偶

label: SPECIES_CLAYDOL.description
source:
A Claydol sleeps while hovering in midair.
Its arms are separate from its body.
They are kept floating by the Pokémon's
manipulation of psychic power.
translation: 因为受到怪异光线的照射，\n所以古代的泥偶附有了生命，\n变成了宝可梦。

label: SPECIES_LILEEP.speciesName
source: LILEEP
translation: 触手百合

label: SPECIES_LILEEP.categoryName
source: Sea Lily
translation: 海百合

label: SPECIES_LILEEP.description
source:
It disguises itself as seaweed by making
its tentacles sway. Unsuspecting prey
that come too close are swallowed whole.
It became extinct 100 million years ago.
translation: 生活在约1亿年前海底的古代宝可梦。\n被科学的力量复活了。

label: SPECIES_CRADILY.speciesName
source: CRADILY
translation: 摇篮百合

label: SPECIES_CRADILY.categoryName
source: Barnacle
translation: 藤壶

label: SPECIES_CRADILY.description
source:
It drags its heavy body along the
seafloor. It makes its nest in the shallows
of warm seas. Cradily can be seen on
beaches when the tide goes out.
translation: 会待在温暖的海洋浅滩上。\n退潮后就会去把那些藏在\n沙滩里的猎物挖出来吃掉。

label: SPECIES_ANORITH.speciesName
source: ANORITH
translation: 太古羽虫

label: SPECIES_ANORITH.categoryName
source: Old Shrimp
translation: 古虾

label: SPECIES_ANORITH.description
source:
It was resurrected from a fossil using the
power of science. It swims by undulating
the eight wings at its sides. They were
feet that adapted to life in the sea.
translation: 从化石中复活的，\n宝可梦的某个先祖。\n在海中生活，会用爪子捕捉猎物。

label: SPECIES_ARMALDO.speciesName
source: ARMALDO
translation: 太古盔甲

label: SPECIES_ARMALDO.categoryName
source: Plate
translation: 甲胄

label: SPECIES_ARMALDO.description
source:
Armaldo usually lives on land. However,
when it hunts for prey, it dives beneath
the ocean. It swims around using its two
large wings.
translation: 通过进化适应了陆地上的生活。\n全身被坚固的铠甲所覆盖。

label: SPECIES_FEEBAS.speciesName
source: FEEBAS
translation: 丑丑鱼

label: SPECIES_FEEBAS.categoryName
source: Fish
translation: 鱼

label: SPECIES_FEEBAS.description
source:
Feebas live in ponds that are heavily
infested with weeds. Because of its
hopelessly shabby appearance, it
seems as if few Trainers raise it.
translation: 虽然外表丑陋，\n但拥有顽强的生命力，\n只要少量的水就能存活。

label: SPECIES_MILOTIC.speciesName
source: MILOTIC
translation: 美纳斯

label: SPECIES_MILOTIC.categoryName
source: Tender
translation: 慈爱

label: SPECIES_MILOTIC.description
source:
It is said to live at the bottom of
large lakes. Considered to be the most
beautiful of all Pokémon, it has been
depicted in paintings and statues.
translation: 号称彩虹色的美丽鳞片\n只要从不同的方向观看，\n就会变化为各种颜色。

label: SPECIES_CASTFORM_NORMAL.speciesName
source: CASTFORM
translation: 飘浮泡泡

label: SPECIES_CASTFORM_NORMAL.categoryName
source: Weather
translation: 天气

label: SPECIES_CASTFORM_NORMAL.description
source:
It alters its form depending on the
weather. Changes in the climate such as
the temperature and humidity appear to
affect its cellular structure.
translation: 样子会随天气而改变。\n最近的研究发现它与水分子极其相似。

label: SPECIES_CASTFORM_SUNNY.speciesName
source: CASTFORM
translation: 飘浮泡泡

label: SPECIES_CASTFORM_SUNNY.categoryName
source: Weather
translation: 天气

label: SPECIES_CASTFORM_SUNNY.description
source:
Castform takes this form on bright days.
In an experiment where is was placed in
front of a heater, it didn't change to this
form. Its body is warm and toasty.
translation: 如果在烈日下暴晒，\n就会变成这个样子。如果碰到它\n热烘烘的身体，会感觉干巴巴的。

label: SPECIES_CASTFORM_RAINY.speciesName
source: CASTFORM
translation: 飘浮泡泡

label: SPECIES_CASTFORM_RAINY.categoryName
source: Weather
translation: 天气

label: SPECIES_CASTFORM_RAINY.description
source:
This is Castform's form while it's raining.
In an experiment where it was placed in a
shower, it didn't change to this form. Its
body is soft, slightly swollen with water.
translation: 被雨淋到时飘浮泡泡的样子。\n在让它淋浴的实验里，\n没有变成这个形态。

label: SPECIES_CASTFORM_SNOWY.speciesName
source: CASTFORM
translation: 飘浮泡泡

label: SPECIES_CASTFORM_SNOWY.categoryName
source: Weather
translation: 天气

label: SPECIES_CASTFORM_SNOWY.description
source:
This is Castform's form in a hailstorm.
In an experiment where it was placed
in a freezer, it didn't change to this form.
Its cold skin is as smooth as ice.
translation: 如果被冰雹打到，\n就会变成这个样子。\n全身冷冷的，皮肤有点儿冻住。

label: SPECIES_KECLEON.speciesName
source: KECLEON
translation: 变隐龙

label: SPECIES_KECLEON.categoryName
source: Color Swap
translation: 变色

label: SPECIES_KECLEON.description
source:
A Pokémon that has the ability to alter its
body colors to match its surroundings.
A Kecleon reverts to its original colors if
it is startled.
translation: 拥有能自由改变身体颜色的能力。\n只有位于腹部的锯齿状\n花纹不会发生改变。

label: SPECIES_SHUPPET.speciesName
source: SHUPPET
translation: 怨影娃娃

label: SPECIES_SHUPPET.categoryName
source: Puppet
translation: 人偶

label: SPECIES_SHUPPET.description
source:
This Pokémon roams about deep in the
night seeking such negative emotions as
grudges and envy. It retreats to its nest
when the sun begins to rise.
translation: 非常喜欢怨恨的感情。\n会成排地悬挂在心怀\n怨恨的人的屋檐下。

label: SPECIES_BANETTE.speciesName
source: BANETTE
translation: 诅咒娃娃

label: SPECIES_BANETTE.categoryName
source: Marionette
translation: 布偶

label: SPECIES_BANETTE.description
source:
An abandoned plush doll became this
Pokémon. They are said to live in garbage
dumps and wander about in search of the
children that threw them away.
translation: 怨念附在被丢弃的玩偶身上，\n变成了宝可梦。\n会一直寻找丢弃自己的孩子。

label: SPECIES_BANETTE_MEGA.categoryName
source: Marionette
translation: 布偶

label: SPECIES_BANETTE_MEGA.description
source: Extraordinary energy amplifies its\ncursing power to such an extent that it\ncan't help but curse its own Trainer.
translation: 因为超级进化，\n怨念增强。\n拉链里面收纳着的诅咒之力满溢出来。

label: SPECIES_DUSKULL.speciesName
source: DUSKULL
translation: 夜巡灵

label: SPECIES_DUSKULL.categoryName
source: Requiem
translation: 渡魂

label: SPECIES_DUSKULL.description
source:
A glare from its single scarlet eye makes
even burly grown-ups freeze in utter fear.
It is a nocturnal Pokémon that roams
about under the cloak of darkness.
translation: 会无止境地追逐猎物。\n性格十分执着，\n但是太阳升起后就会放弃。

label: SPECIES_DUSCLOPS.speciesName
source: DUSCLOPS
translation: 彷徨夜灵

label: SPECIES_DUSCLOPS.categoryName
source: Beckon
translation: 招手

label: SPECIES_DUSCLOPS.description
source:
It is thought that its body is hollow with
only a spectral ball of fire burning inside.
However, no one has been able to
confirm this theory as fact.
translation: 寻找游走的灵魂，\n吸入自己空洞的身体里。\n没人知道被吸入后会发生什么事。

label: SPECIES_DUSKNOIR.speciesName
source: DUSKNOIR
translation: 黑夜魔灵

label: SPECIES_DUSKNOIR.categoryName
source: Gripper
translation: 抓握

label: SPECIES_DUSKNOIR.description
source:
This feared Pokémon is said to travel to
worlds unknown. Some even believe that
it takes lost spirits into its pliant body
and guides them home.
translation: 据说，会把无处可去的魂魄\n吸入它那具有弹力的身体中，\n并带往另一个世界。

label: SPECIES_TROPIUS.speciesName
source: TROPIUS
translation: 热带龙

label: SPECIES_TROPIUS.categoryName
source: Fruit
translation: 水果

label: SPECIES_TROPIUS.description
source:
It flies by flapping its broad leaves.
The bunch of fruit that grows around its
neck is deliciously sweet. In the spring,
it scatters pollen from its neck.
translation: 平时总是吃同样的水果，\n以至于自己的喉咙上\n都结出了非常美味的水果。

label: SPECIES_CHINGLING.speciesName
source: CHINGLING
translation: 铃铛响

label: SPECIES_CHINGLING.categoryName
source: Bell
translation: 铃铛

label: SPECIES_CHINGLING.description
source:
There is an orb inside its mouth.
When it hops, the orb bounces all
over and makes a ringing sound.
It can cry for an awfully long time.
translation: 如果跳起来，\n嘴里的珠子就会弹来弹去，\n发出铃铛一般的音色。

label: SPECIES_CHIMECHO.speciesName
source: CHIMECHO
translation: 风铃铃

label: SPECIES_CHIMECHO.categoryName
source: Wind Chime
translation: 风铃

label: SPECIES_CHIMECHO.description
source:
They fly about very actively when the hot
season arrives. They communicate among
themselves using seven different and
distinguishing cries.
translation: 叫声会在身体的空洞中\n回响并化为美丽的音色，\n它会以此将敌人吓跑。

label: SPECIES_CHIMECHO_MEGA.categoryName
source: Wind Chime
translation: 风铃

label: SPECIES_CHIMECHO_MEGA.description
source:
It vibrates its entire body to attack in
all directions using sound waves. Any who
hear the vibrations get so confused, they
forget who they are.
translation: 振动全身，通过音波对所有\n方向发动攻击。听着听着\n就会迷失自我。

label: SPECIES_ABSOL.speciesName
source: ABSOL
translation: 阿勃梭鲁

label: SPECIES_ABSOL.categoryName
source: Disaster
translation: 灾祸

label: SPECIES_ABSOL.description
source:
It sharply senses even subtle changes in
the sky and the land to predict natural
disasters. It is a long-lived Pokémon that
has a life-span of 100 years.
translation: 能够预知灾害的到来。\n据说只有在通知危险的时候\n才会出现在人们面前。

label: SPECIES_ABSOL_MEGA.categoryName
source: Disaster
translation: 灾祸

label: SPECIES_ABSOL_MEGA.description
source:
As the energy of Mega Evolution fills it,
its fur bristles. What you see on its back
are not true wings, and this Pokémon isn't
able to fly.
translation: 超级进化的能量变作威慑的气场，\n四散播撒。\n胆怯的人会被惊吓致死。

label: SPECIES_ABSOL_MEGA_Z.categoryName
source: Disaster
translation: 灾祸

label: SPECIES_ABSOL_MEGA_Z.description
source:
Using fur that it has made into sharp,
