clawlike shapes, it cuts down foes with
a single blow. This is an act of kindness
to keep them from suffering.
translation: 用变得像爪子般尖锐的体毛\n在一击之下便将对手撕碎，\n是为了不让其受苦的温柔。

label: SPECIES_SNORUNT.speciesName
source: SNORUNT
translation: 雪童子

label: SPECIES_SNORUNT.categoryName
source: Snow Hat
translation: 雪笠

label: SPECIES_SNORUNT.description
source:
They tend to move about in groups of
around five Snorunt. In snowy regions,
it is said that when they are seen late at
night, snowfall will arrive by morning.
translation: 据说，好几只雪童子\n会聚集在大大的叶片底下，\n融洽地生活在一起。

label: SPECIES_GLALIE.speciesName
source: GLALIE
translation: 冰鬼护

label: SPECIES_GLALIE.categoryName
source: Face
translation: 脸面

label: SPECIES_GLALIE.description
source:
A Glalie has the power to instantaneously
freeze moisture in the atmosphere.
A dazzling cloud of diamondlike ice
crystals forms around its body.
translation: 通过一瞬间冻住空气中的水分，\n让猎物无处可逃。

label: SPECIES_GLALIE_MEGA.categoryName
source: Face
translation: 脸面

label: SPECIES_GLALIE_MEGA.description
source: The power of Mega Evolution was so strong\nthat it smashed Glalie's jaw. Its inability\nto eat very well leaves Glalie irritated.
translation: 超级进化的力量过强，\n颚部都碎掉了。\n因没法好好吃东西而焦躁。

label: SPECIES_FROSLASS.speciesName
source: FROSLASS
translation: 雪妖女

label: SPECIES_FROSLASS.categoryName
source: Snow Land
translation: 雪国

label: SPECIES_FROSLASS.description
source:
When it finds people or Pokémon it likes,
it freezes them and takes them to its
chilly den, where they become its
decorations.
translation: 据说它会吐出零下50度的\n气息冻结猎物，\n然后将其带到秘密的地方装饰起来。

label: SPECIES_FROSLASS_MEGA.categoryName
source: Snow Land
translation: 雪国

label: SPECIES_FROSLASS_MEGA.description
source:
This Pokémon can use eerie cold
air imbued with ghost energy to
freeze even insubstantial things,
such as flames or the wind.
translation: 散发出带有幽灵能量的\n诡异冷气，连火和风等没有\n形状的东西也能冻住。

label: SPECIES_SPHEAL.speciesName
source: SPHEAL
translation: 海豹球

label: SPECIES_SPHEAL.categoryName
source: Clap
translation: 拍手

label: SPECIES_SPHEAL.description
source:
It is completely covered with plushy fur.
As a result, it never feels the cold even
when it is rolling about on ice floes or
diving in the sea.
translation: 会在浮冰上一直骨碌骨碌地\n翻滚到海岸边。\n它的体型不是很适合游泳。

label: SPECIES_SEALEO.speciesName
source: SEALEO
translation: 海魔狮

label: SPECIES_SEALEO.categoryName
source: Ball Roll
translation: 滚球

label: SPECIES_SEALEO.description
source:
Sealeo live in herds on ice floes. Using its
powerful flippers, it shatters ice.
It dives into the sea to hunt prey five
times a day.
translation: 习惯把什么东西都顶在鼻子上转。\n一边转一边记住气味和触感。

label: SPECIES_WALREIN.speciesName
source: WALREIN
translation: 帝牙海狮

label: SPECIES_WALREIN.categoryName
source: Ice Break
translation: 破冰

label: SPECIES_WALREIN.description
source:
To protect its herd, the leader battles
anything that invades its territory, even
at the cost of its life. Its tusks may snap
off in battle.
translation: 能用獠牙咬碎巨大的冰块。\n厚厚的脂肪不仅能抵御严寒，\n还能反弹敌人的攻击。

label: SPECIES_CLAMPERL.speciesName
source: CLAMPERL
translation: 珍珠贝

label: SPECIES_CLAMPERL.categoryName
source: Bivalve
translation: 双壳贝

label: SPECIES_CLAMPERL.description
source:
A Clamperl slams its shell closed on prey
to prevent escape. The pearl it creates
upon evolution is said to be infused with
a mysterious energy.
translation: 一生只能生成1颗珍珠。\n据说这颗珍珠有着增强\n精神力量的作用。

label: SPECIES_HUNTAIL.speciesName
source: HUNTAIL
translation: 猎斑鱼

label: SPECIES_HUNTAIL.categoryName
source: Deep Sea
translation: 深海

label: SPECIES_HUNTAIL.description
source:
To withstand the crushing pressure of
water deep under the sea, its spine is very
thick and sturdy. Its tail, which is shaped
like a small fish, has eyes that light up.
translation: 栖息在深海中的宝可梦。\n用形如小鱼的尾巴\n引诱猎物靠近并捕捉。

label: SPECIES_GOREBYSS.speciesName
source: GOREBYSS
translation: 樱花鱼

label: SPECIES_GOREBYSS.categoryName
source: South Sea
translation: 南海

label: SPECIES_GOREBYSS.description
source:
A Gorebyss siphons the body fluids of prey
through its thin, tubular mouth. Its light
pink body color turns vivid when it
finishes feeding.
translation: 生活在海底，\n但不知为何，\n到了春天身上的粉红色会变得鲜艳。

label: SPECIES_RELICANTH.speciesName
source: RELICANTH
translation: 古空棘鱼

label: SPECIES_RELICANTH.categoryName
source: Longevity
translation: 长寿

label: SPECIES_RELICANTH.description
source:
A Pokémon that was once believed to have
been extinct. The species has not changed
its form for 100 million years. It walks on
the seafloor using its pectoral fins.
translation: 在深海调查中被发现的珍奇宝可梦。\n1亿年间样子都没变化过。

label: SPECIES_LUVDISC.speciesName
source: LUVDISC
translation: 爱心鱼

label: SPECIES_LUVDISC.categoryName
source: Rendezvous
translation: 相随

label: SPECIES_LUVDISC.description
source:
Luvdisc make the branches of Corsola
their nests. There is a custom from long
ago of giving a Luvdisc as a gift to
express one's feelings of love.
translation: 在温暖的海里栖息。\n据说发现爱心鱼的情侣会永远相爱。

label: SPECIES_BAGON.speciesName
source: BAGON
translation: 宝贝龙

label: SPECIES_BAGON.categoryName
source: Rock Head
translation: 坚硬脑袋

label: SPECIES_BAGON.description
source:
Although it is small, this Pokémon is very
powerful because its body is a bundle of
muscles. It launches head-butts with its
ironlike skull.
translation: 梦想着在天空翱翔，\n每天为了练习飞行而从悬崖上跳下来。

label: SPECIES_SHELGON.speciesName
source: SHELGON
translation: 甲壳龙

label: SPECIES_SHELGON.categoryName
source: Endurance
translation: 耐力

label: SPECIES_SHELGON.description
source:
It hardly eats while it awaits evolution.
It becomes hardier by enduring hunger.
Its shell peels off the instant it begins
to evolve.
translation: 在坚硬的壳中，\n细胞开始发生变化。\n壳会在进化的瞬间脱落。

label: SPECIES_SALAMENCE.speciesName
source: SALAMENCE
translation: 暴飞龙

label: SPECIES_SALAMENCE.categoryName
source: Dragon
translation: 龙

label: SPECIES_SALAMENCE.description
source:
After many long years, its cellular
structure underwent a sudden mutation to
grow wings. When angered, it loses all
thought and rampages out of control.
translation: 因为不断祈求能够飞上天空，\n结果导致体内的细胞发生了变化，\n从而长出了翅膀。

label: SPECIES_SALAMENCE_MEGA.categoryName
source: Dragon
translation: 龙

label: SPECIES_SALAMENCE_MEGA.description
source:
Mega Evolution fuels its brutality, and it
may even turn on the Trainer who raised it.
It's been dubbed the blood-soaked.
crescent.
translation: 会将前脚收拢在外壳的间隙中，\n变为飞行的姿势。即使是复杂的地形\n也能以高速飞来飞去。

label: SPECIES_BELDUM.speciesName
source: BELDUM
translation: 铁哑铃

label: SPECIES_BELDUM.categoryName
source: Iron Ball
translation: 铁球

label: SPECIES_BELDUM.description
source:
When Beldum gather in a swarm, they move
in perfect unison as if they were but one
Pokémon. They communicate with each other
using brain waves.
translation: 通过磁力的波动和伙伴对话。\n成群的铁哑铃会有条不紊地进行行动。

label: SPECIES_METANG.speciesName
source: METANG
translation: 金属怪

label: SPECIES_METANG.categoryName
source: Iron Claw
translation: 铁爪

label: SPECIES_METANG.description
source:
The claws tipping its arms pack the
destructive power to tear through thick
iron sheets as if they were silk. It flies
at over 60 miles per hour.
translation: 由2只铁哑铃组合而成。\n钢铁的身躯即使和喷气式飞机\n相撞也不会受伤。

label: SPECIES_METAGROSS.speciesName
source: METAGROSS
translation: 巨金怪

label: SPECIES_METAGROSS.categoryName
source: Iron Leg
translation: 铁足

label: SPECIES_METAGROSS.description
source:
Metagross has four brains that are joined
by a complex neural network. As a result of
integration, this Pokémon is smarter than
a supercomputer.
translation: 由金属怪组合生成。\n拥有4个大脑的巨金怪有着\n堪比超级计算机的智商。

label: SPECIES_METAGROSS_MEGA.categoryName
source: Iron Leg
translation: 铁足

label: SPECIES_METAGROSS_MEGA.description
source: When it knows it can't win, it digs the\nclaws on its legs into its opponent and\nstarts the countdown to a big explosion.
translation: 如果判断自己无法战胜，\n就会用爪子抓住对手，\n开始大爆炸的倒计时。

label: SPECIES_REGIROCK.speciesName
source: REGIROCK
translation: 雷吉洛克

label: SPECIES_REGIROCK.categoryName
source: Rock Peak
translation: 岩山

label: SPECIES_REGIROCK.description
source:
A Pokémon that is made entirely of rocks
and boulders. If parts of its body chip off
in battle, Regirock repairs itself by
adding new rocks.
translation: 全身由岩石构成。\n即使在战斗中身体受损\n也能通过贴上岩石来治愈。

label: SPECIES_REGICE.speciesName
source: REGICE
translation: 雷吉艾斯

label: SPECIES_REGICE.categoryName
source: Iceberg
translation: 冰山

label: SPECIES_REGICE.description
source:
Its entire body is made of Antarctic ice.
After extensive studies, researchers
believe the ice was formed during an
ice age.
translation: 身体是用冰河时期形成的冰制作而成。\n能操控零下200度的冷气。

label: SPECIES_REGISTEEL.speciesName
source: REGISTEEL
translation: 雷吉斯奇鲁

label: SPECIES_REGISTEEL.categoryName
source: Iron
translation: 黑金

label: SPECIES_REGISTEEL.description
source:
Its body is harder than any other kind of
metal. The body metal is composed of a
mysterious substance. Not only is it hard,
it shrinks and stretches flexibly.
translation: 经过长达几万年地下压力的锤炼，\n金属的身躯变得刀枪不入。

label: SPECIES_LATIAS.speciesName
source: LATIAS
translation: 拉帝亚斯

label: SPECIES_LATIAS.categoryName
source: Eon
translation: 无限

label: SPECIES_LATIAS.description
source:
They make a small herd of only several
members. They rarely make contact with
people or other Pokémon. They disappear
if they sense enemies.
translation: 用能令光发生折射的羽毛包裹全身，\n以此让自己隐去身形。

label: SPECIES_LATIAS_MEGA.categoryName
source: Eon
translation: 无限

label: SPECIES_LATIAS_MEGA.description
source:
Its body is smaller than Mega Latios's
body. It is more agile and can make very
sharp turns. When it Mega Evolves, its
defensive strength grows substantially.
translation: 超级进化后更加善于旋转，\n能迅速紧急进行地回旋转弯，\n在宝可梦里拥有最高级别的速度。

label: SPECIES_LATIOS.speciesName
source: LATIOS
translation: 拉帝欧斯

label: SPECIES_LATIOS.categoryName
source: Eon
translation: 无限

label: SPECIES_LATIOS.description
source:
Even in hiding, it can detect the locations
of others and sense their emotions since
it has telepathy. Its intelligence allows
it to understand human languages.
translation: 拥有很高智商的宝可梦。\n收起前肢飞行的话，\n速度能超越喷气式飞机。

label: SPECIES_LATIOS_MEGA.categoryName
source: Eon
translation: 无限

label: SPECIES_LATIOS_MEGA.description
source:
It's larger than Mega Latias, and can
achieve higher speeds in flight.
This Pokémon can use its speed in battle
to unleash a flurry of attacks.
translation: 超级进化后更加善于飞行，\n它能以 4马赫的速度在天空飞，\n在宝可梦里拥有最高级别的速度。

label: SPECIES_KYOGRE.speciesName
source: KYOGRE
translation: 盖欧卡

label: SPECIES_KYOGRE.categoryName
source: Sea Basin
translation: 海底

label: SPECIES_KYOGRE.description
source:
Kyogre has appeared in mythology as the
creator of the sea. After long years of
feuding with Groudon, it took to sleep at
the bottom of the sea.
translation: 据说能用下大雨的能力扩张海洋。\n一直沉睡在海沟的底部。

label: SPECIES_KYOGRE_PRIMAL.speciesName
source: KYOGRE
translation: 盖欧卡

label: SPECIES_KYOGRE_PRIMAL.categoryName
source: Sea Basin
translation: 海底

label: SPECIES_KYOGRE_PRIMAL.description
source:
When Kyogre roared, water poured forth
and the seas spread outward.
Dark clouds enshrouded the world,
and the deluge fell upon all…
translation: 通过自然的能量进行原始回归，\n恢复原本的样子。\n其力量可以呼风唤雨扩张海洋。

label: SPECIES_GROUDON.speciesName
source: GROUDON
translation: 固拉多

label: SPECIES_GROUDON.categoryName
source: Continent
translation: 大陆

label: SPECIES_GROUDON.description
source:
Groudon has appeared in mythology as the
creator of the land. It sleeps in magma
underground and is said to make volcanoes
erupt on awakening.
translation: 很久以前与盖欧卡殊死搏斗后，\n一直在地下岩浆里沉睡的宝可梦。

label: SPECIES_GROUDON_PRIMAL.speciesName
source: GROUDON
translation: 固拉多

label: SPECIES_GROUDON_PRIMAL.categoryName
source: Continent
translation: 大陆

label: SPECIES_GROUDON_PRIMAL.description
source:
When Groudon howled, the earth swelled and
the land grew wide. The sun blazed atop
and all the world around the creature
was enveloped in incandescent heat.
translation: 通过自然的能量进行原始回归，\n恢复原本的样子。\n其力量可以产生熔岩扩张大地。

label: SPECIES_RAYQUAZA.speciesName
source: RAYQUAZA
translation: 烈空坐

label: SPECIES_RAYQUAZA.categoryName
source: Sky High
translation: 天空

label: SPECIES_RAYQUAZA.description
source:
A Pokémon that flies endlessly in the
ozone layer. It is said it would descend
to the ground if Kyogre and Groudon
were to fight.
translation: 因为栖息在高高的云层之上的臭氧层，\n所以从地面无法看见它的样子。

label: SPECIES_RAYQUAZA_MEGA.speciesName
source: RAYQUAZA
translation: 烈空坐

label: SPECIES_RAYQUAZA_MEGA.categoryName
source: Sky High
translation: 天空

label: SPECIES_RAYQUAZA_MEGA.description
source:
Particles stream from the filaments that
extend from its jaw. They can control the
density and humidity of the air, allowing
Rayquaza to manipulate the weather.
translation: 从突出下颚伸出的长触须放出粒子。\n这些粒子能控制气体的浓度\n和湿度，操纵天气。

label: SPECIES_JIRACHI.speciesName
source: JIRACHI
translation: 基拉祈

label: SPECIES_JIRACHI.categoryName
source: Wish
translation: 祈愿

label: SPECIES_JIRACHI.description
source:
Jirachi is said to make wishes come true.
While it sleeps, a tough crystalline shell
envelops the body to protect it from
enemies.
translation: 据说它在1000年之中\n醒来的时间只有7天，\n醒来后可使用能实现任何愿望的力量。

label: SPECIES_DEOXYS_NORMAL.speciesName
source: DEOXYS
translation: 代欧奇希斯

label: SPECIES_DEOXYS_NORMAL.description
source:
Deoxys emerged from a virus that came
from space. It is highly intelligent and
can shoot lasers from the crystalline
organ on its chest.
translation: 它是宇宙病毒的DNA受到激光照射后，\n发生突变而生成的宝可梦。\n胸部的水晶体好像是它的大脑。

label: SPECIES_DEOXYS_ATTACK.speciesName
source: DEOXYS
translation: 代欧奇希斯

label: SPECIES_DEOXYS_ATTACK.description
source: This Deoxys has transformed into its\naggressive guise. It can fool enemies\nby altering its appearance.
translation: 变化为攻击形态的代欧奇希斯\n能够变换形态来迷惑对手。

label: SPECIES_DEOXYS_DEFENSE.speciesName
source: DEOXYS
translation: 代欧奇希斯

label: SPECIES_DEOXYS_DEFENSE.description
source: When it changes form, an aurora\nappears. It absorbs attacks by\naltering its cellular structure.
translation: 变化形态的时候会出现极光。\n通过变化细胞形态来吸取攻击。

label: SPECIES_DEOXYS_SPEED.speciesName
source: DEOXYS
translation: 代欧奇希斯

label: SPECIES_DEOXYS_SPEED.description
source:
A Pokémon that mutated from an
extraterrestrial virus exposed to a laser
beam. Its body is configured for superior 
agility and speed.
translation: 当宇宙病毒被激光照射时，\n发生突变而形成的宝可梦。\n身体的形状很适合快速移动。

label: SPECIES_TURTWIG.speciesName
source: TURTWIG
translation: 草苗龟

label: SPECIES_TURTWIG.categoryName
source: Tiny Leaf
translation: 嫩叶

label: SPECIES_TURTWIG.description
source:
The shell on its back is made of soil. 
On a very healthy Turtwig, the shell 
should feel moist. The leaf on its head
wilts if it is thirsty.
translation: 沐浴着阳光，\n用全身进行光合作用。\n甲壳是泥土变硬后形成的。

label: SPECIES_GROTLE.speciesName
source: GROTLE
translation: 树林龟

label: SPECIES_GROTLE.categoryName
source: Grove
translation: 树丛

label: SPECIES_GROTLE.description
source:
A Grotle that lives in the forest is said
to have its own secret springwater well. 
It carries fellow Pokémon there on 
its back.
translation: 知道哪里会涌出清澈的水，\n会让伙伴宝可梦骑在它背上，\n将其运到那个地方。

label: SPECIES_TORTERRA.speciesName
source: TORTERRA
translation: 土台龟

label: SPECIES_TORTERRA.categoryName
source: Continent
translation: 大陆

label: SPECIES_TORTERRA.description
source:
Some Pokémon are born on a Torterra's
back and spend their entire life there.
Ancient people imagined that beneath 
the ground, a gigantic Torterra dwelled.
translation: 有的宝可梦会在土台龟背上出生，\n并在此度过一生。

label: SPECIES_CHIMCHAR.speciesName
source: CHIMCHAR
translation: 小火焰猴

label: SPECIES_CHIMCHAR.categoryName
source: Chimp
translation: 小猴

label: SPECIES_CHIMCHAR.description
source:
Its fiery rear end is fueled by gas made
in its belly. Before going to sleep,
Chimchar extinguish the flame on their
tails to prevent fires.
translation: 腹部产生的瓦斯在屁屁燃烧着。\n身体状况不好的话，\n火焰会变弱。

label: SPECIES_MONFERNO.speciesName
source: MONFERNO
translation: 猛火猴

label: SPECIES_MONFERNO.categoryName
source: Playful
translation: 顽皮

label: SPECIES_MONFERNO.description
source:
It carefully controls the intensity of
the flame on its tail, so as to keep its
foes at an adequate distance.
Its fiery tail is but one weapon.
translation: 能熟练控制尾部火焰的大小，\n以自己擅长的距离进行战斗。

label: SPECIES_INFERNAPE.speciesName
source: INFERNAPE
translation: 烈焰猴

label: SPECIES_INFERNAPE.categoryName
source: Flame
translation: 火焰

label: SPECIES_INFERNAPE.description
source:
Its crown of fire is indicative of its
fiery nature. It uses a special kind of
martial arts involving all of its limbs to
take on any opponent.
translation: 会使用手脚缠绕着火焰的独特格斗技，\n无论什么样的对手都会勇敢对抗。

label: SPECIES_PIPLUP.speciesName
source: PIPLUP
translation: 波加曼

label: SPECIES_PIPLUP.categoryName
source: Penguin
translation: 企鹅

label: SPECIES_PIPLUP.description
source:
A poor walker, it often falls down. However,
its strong pride makes it puff up its chest
without a care. It's difficult to bond with
since it won't listen to its Trainer.
translation: 不擅长走路，有时还会跌到，\n但波加曼强烈的自尊心会让\n它挺起胸膛，毫不在意。

label: SPECIES_PRINPLUP.speciesName
source: PRINPLUP
translation: 波皇子

label: SPECIES_PRINPLUP.categoryName
source: Penguin
translation: 企鹅

label: SPECIES_PRINPLUP.description
source:
Because every Prinplup considers itself
to be the most important, they can never
form a group. It searches for prey in
icy seas.
translation: 每一只波皇子都认为自己\n是最了不起的，\n因此它们无法形成群体。

label: SPECIES_EMPOLEON.speciesName
source: EMPOLEON
translation: 帝王拿波

label: SPECIES_EMPOLEON.categoryName
source: Emperor
translation: 皇帝

label: SPECIES_EMPOLEON.description
source:
The three horns that extend from its
beak attest to its power. It avoids
unnecessary disputes, but it will decimate
anything that threatens its pride.
translation: 伤害到它自尊心的家伙，\n会被它用能切断浮冰的翅膀一分为二。

label: SPECIES_STARLY.speciesName
source: STARLY
translation: 姆克儿

label: SPECIES_STARLY.categoryName
source: Starling
translation: 椋鸟

label: SPECIES_STARLY.description
source:
They flock around mountains and fields,
chasing after bug Pokémon. However,
they bicker if the group grows too big.
Their singing is noisy and annoying.
translation: 会成群结队来弥补单枪匹马的弱小，\n然而群体一旦变大又会起争执。

label: SPECIES_STARAVIA.speciesName
source: STARAVIA
translation: 姆克鸟

label: SPECIES_STARAVIA.categoryName
source: Starling
translation: 椋鸟

label: SPECIES_STARAVIA.description
source:
Recognizing their own weakness, they
maintain huge flocks. Fierce scuffles
break out between various flocks.
When alone, a Staravia cries noisily.
translation: 有组成庞大的团队来行动的习性。\n各个团队之间的争斗很激烈。

label: SPECIES_STARAPTOR.speciesName
source: STARAPTOR
translation: 姆克鹰

label: SPECIES_STARAPTOR.categoryName
source: Predator
translation: 猛禽

label: SPECIES_STARAPTOR.description
source:
When Staravia evolve into Staraptor,
they leave the flock to live alone. It has
a savage nature. It will courageously
challenge foes that are much larger.
translation: 即使自己的身体受了伤\n也不会停止攻击。\n很在意自己头冠的形状。

label: SPECIES_STARAPTOR_MEGA.categoryName
source: Predator
translation: 猛禽

label: SPECIES_STARAPTOR_MEGA.description
source:
Mega Staraptor is a top-class flier.
It can easily soar through the sky while
gripping a Steelix that weighs more than
880 lbs.
translation: 拥有顶级的飞行能力。\n能抓着超过400公斤的\n大钢蛇轻轻松松地飞翔。

label: SPECIES_BIDOOF.speciesName
source: BIDOOF
translation: 大牙狸

label: SPECIES_BIDOOF.categoryName
source: Plump Mouse
translation: 圆鼠

label: SPECIES_BIDOOF.description
source:
A comparison revealed that Bidoof's front
teeth grow at the same rate as Rattata's.
It constantly gnaws on logs and rocks to
whittle down its front teeth.
translation: 总是啃大树和石头来磨结实的门牙。\n在水边筑巢生活。

label: SPECIES_BIBAREL.speciesName
source: BIBAREL
translation: 大尾狸

label: SPECIES_BIBAREL.categoryName
source: Beaver
translation: 河狸

label: SPECIES_BIBAREL.description
source:
It makes its nest by damming streams
with bark and mud. A river dammed by
Bibarel will never overflow its banks,
which is appreciated by people nearby.
translation: 用树干和泥巴筑坝堵住河流，\n建造住所。\n以勤劳而闻名。

label: SPECIES_KRICKETOT.speciesName
source: KRICKETOT
translation: 圆法师

label: SPECIES_KRICKETOT.categoryName
source: Cricket
translation: 蟋蟀

label: SPECIES_KRICKETOT.description
source:
It shakes its head back to front,
causing its antennae to hit each other
and sound like a xylophone.
These sounds are fall hallmarks.
translation: 触角之间互相碰撞的话，\n就会奏出叮叮咚咚\n如同木琴一般的音色。

label: SPECIES_KRICKETUNE.speciesName
source: KRICKETUNE
translation: 音箱蟀

label: SPECIES_KRICKETUNE.categoryName
source: Cricket
translation: 蟋蟀

label: SPECIES_KRICKETUNE.description
source:
It signals its emotions with its melodies.
There is a village that hosts a contest
based on the amazingly variable cries
of this Pokémon.
translation: 有村子会让它们互相\n比拼变化多端的叫声，\n当成娱乐活动。

label: SPECIES_SHINX.speciesName
source: SHINX
translation: 小猫怪

label: SPECIES_SHINX.categoryName
source: Flash
translation: 闪光

label: SPECIES_SHINX.description
source:
It rapidly contracts and relaxes its
muscles to generate electricity. Its
body shines if endangered. It flees
while the foe is momentarily blinded.
translation: 每当活动身体时，\n肌肉就会伸缩产生电。\n危机时刻，身体会发光。

label: SPECIES_LUXIO.speciesName
source: LUXIO
translation: 勒克猫

label: SPECIES_LUXIO.categoryName
source: Spark
translation: 电光

label: SPECIES_LUXIO.description
source:
Strong electricity courses through the
tips of its sharp claws. A light scratch
has enough amperage to cause fainting
in foes.
translation: 在锐利的爪子尖端有强烈的电流流过，\n只要稍稍碰擦到，\n就能让对手晕厥。

label: SPECIES_LUXRAY.speciesName
source: LUXRAY
translation: 伦琴猫

label: SPECIES_LUXRAY.categoryName
source: Gleam Eyes
translation: 目光

label: SPECIES_LUXRAY.description
source:
It has eyes which can see through
anything. Luxray's ability to see
through objects comes in handy when
it's scouting for danger.
translation: 伦琴猫的透视能力对于\n发现危险的事物非常有帮助。

label: SPECIES_CRANIDOS.speciesName
source: CRANIDOS
translation: 头盖龙

label: SPECIES_CRANIDOS.categoryName
source: Head Butt
translation: 头锤

label: SPECIES_CRANIDOS.description
source:
A lifelong jungle dweller from 100 million
years ago, its skull is as hard as iron. 
It would snap obstructing trees with
headbutts.
translation: 大约1亿年前的宝可梦。\n在丛林中出生长大，\n会用头锤把阻挡它的树木撞断。

label: SPECIES_RAMPARDOS.speciesName
source: RAMPARDOS
translation: 战槌龙

label: SPECIES_RAMPARDOS.categoryName
source: Head Butt
translation: 头锤

label: SPECIES_RAMPARDOS.description
source:
The result of repeated headbutts
is a skull grown thick and hard.
However, its brain has shrunk in size
compared with Cranidos's.
translation: 因为头盖骨厚达30厘米，\n所以即使用头激烈对撞\n也绝对不会晕倒。

label: SPECIES_SHIELDON.speciesName
source: SHIELDON
translation: 盾甲龙

label: SPECIES_SHIELDON.categoryName
source: Shield
translation: 护盾

label: SPECIES_SHIELDON.description
source:
This Pokémon lived in primeval jungles.
Few enemies would have been willing to
square off against its heavily armored
face, so it's thought.
translation: 拥有超群的防御力，\n因此不会惹上什么争斗，\n能够安稳吃草和树果度日。

label: SPECIES_BASTIODON.speciesName
source: BASTIODON
translation: 护城龙

label: SPECIES_BASTIODON.categoryName
source: Shield
translation: 护盾

label: SPECIES_BASTIODON.description
source:
Their rock-hard faces serve to protect
them from any frontral attacks.
When attacked, they form a wall.
They shielded their young in that way.
translation: 如果横着排成一排，\n无论什么宝可梦都无法突破。\n就这样保护着自己的孩子。

label: SPECIES_BURMY_PLANT.speciesName
source: BURMY
translation: 结草儿

label: SPECIES_BURMY_PLANT.categoryName
source: Bagworm
translation: 蓑衣虫

label: SPECIES_BURMY_PLANT.description
source:
If its cloak is even slightly damaged, it
will immediately repair it with whatever is
near at hand. The Pokémon within the cloak
is scrawny and vulnerable to the cold.
translation: 蓑衣只要稍有缺损，\n就会立即用身边的材料加以修补。\n蓑衣内的身体十分细瘦且畏惧寒冷。

label: SPECIES_BURMY_SANDY.speciesName
source: BURMY
translation: 结草儿

label: SPECIES_BURMY_SANDY.categoryName
source: Bagworm
translation: 蓑衣虫

label: SPECIES_BURMY_SANDY.description
source:
It weaves a cloak together with sand, mud,
and silk it spits out. This earthen cloak
is ruined by wind and rain, so the Pokémon
hides away in caves and other such places.
translation: 将吐出的丝揉合泥沙制成蓑衣。\n泥沙所制的蓑衣不耐风雨，\n因此它会躲藏在洞穴等处。

label: SPECIES_BURMY_TRASH.speciesName
source: BURMY
translation: 结草儿

label: SPECIES_BURMY_TRASH.categoryName
source: Bagworm
translation: 蓑衣虫

label: SPECIES_BURMY_TRASH.description
source:
When confronted by a lack of other
materials, Burmy will create its cloak
using dust and refuse. The cloak seems to
be more comfortable than one would think.
translation: 当身边找不到适合的材料时，\n会用尘土草芥等垃圾来做蓑衣。\n裹起来的感觉似乎意外地还不坏。

label: SPECIES_WORMADAM_PLANT.speciesName
source: WORMADAM
translation: 结草贵妇

label: SPECIES_WORMADAM_PLANT.categoryName
source: Bagworm
translation: 蓑衣虫

label: SPECIES_WORMADAM_PLANT.description
source:
Its appearance changes depending
on where Burmy evolved. The materials
on hand become a part of its body.
The cloak is never shed.
translation: 草木制成的蓑衣与躯体融合，\n如体毛皮肤般成为了身体的一部分。\n据考察这乃是进化能量带来的作用。

label: SPECIES_WORMADAM_SANDY.speciesName
source: WORMADAM
translation: 结草贵妇

label: SPECIES_WORMADAM_SANDY.categoryName
source: Bagworm
translation: 蓑衣虫

label: SPECIES_WORMADAM_SANDY.description
source:
Its earthen skin is reasonably hard, it has
no problem repelling a Starly's pecking.
It is said that a Wormadam that evolves
on a cold day will have a thicker cloak.
translation: 泥沙形成的皮肤有相当的硬度。\n若是姆克儿的嘴喙程度的攻击，\n轻而易举就可以反弹回去。

label: SPECIES_WORMADAM_TRASH.speciesName
source: WORMADAM
translation: 结草贵妇

label: SPECIES_WORMADAM_TRASH.categoryName
source: Bagworm
translation: 蓑衣虫

label: SPECIES_WORMADAM_TRASH.description
source:
Its body, composed of refuse, blends in to
the scenery enough to be inconspicuous.
This seems to be the perfect way for it to
evade the detection of predators.
translation: 尘土草芥等垃圾构成的身体\n能毫不起眼地融入周围景色之中，\n正好适合用来躲避天敌袭击。

label: gSpeciesInfoGen4.speciesName
source: MOTHIM
translation: 绅士蛾

label: gSpeciesInfoGen4.categoryName
source: Moth
translation: 蓑衣蛾

label: SPECIES_COMBEE.speciesName
source: COMBEE
translation: 三蜜蜂

label: SPECIES_COMBEE.categoryName
source: Tiny Bee
translation: 幼蜂

label: SPECIES_COMBEE.description
source:
A Pokémon formed by three others.
It constantly gathers honey from flowers
to please Vespiquen. At night, they
cluster to form a beehive and sleep.
translation: 从出生时起就是3只一起。\n为了取悦蜂女王，\n一直都在采集着花蜜。

label: SPECIES_VESPIQUEN.speciesName
source: VESPIQUEN
translation: 蜂女王

label: SPECIES_VESPIQUEN.categoryName
source: Beehive
translation: 蜂巢

label: SPECIES_VESPIQUEN.description
source:
It houses its colony in cells in its body
and releases various pheromones to
make those grubs do its bidding.
There is only one in a colony.
translation: 躯体是孩子们的巢穴。\n释放出各种各样的费洛蒙，\n自由地控制孩子们。

label: SPECIES_PACHIRISU.speciesName
source: PACHIRISU
translation: 帕奇利兹

label: SPECIES_PACHIRISU.categoryName
source: EleSquirrel
translation: 电松鼠

label: SPECIES_PACHIRISU.description
source:
A pair may be seen rubbing their cheek
pouches together in an effort to share
stored electricity. It stores them with
berries in tree holes.
translation: 有时候也会发现为了\n将储存的电分给同伴而互相\n摩擦颊囊的帕奇利兹。

label: SPECIES_BUIZEL.speciesName
source: BUIZEL
translation: 泳圈鼬

label: SPECIES_BUIZEL.categoryName
source: Sea Weasel
translation: 海鼬

label: SPECIES_BUIZEL.description
source:
It inflates its flotation sac, keeping its
face above water in order to watch for
prey movement. It swims by rotating its
two tails like a screw.
translation: 会像螺旋桨一样旋转2条尾巴来游泳。\n潜水的时候浮囊会瘪掉。

label: SPECIES_FLOATZEL.speciesName
source: FLOATZEL
translation: 浮潜鼬

label: SPECIES_FLOATZEL.categoryName
source: Sea Weasel
translation: 海鼬

label: SPECIES_FLOATZEL.description
source:
Its flotation sac developed as a result
of pursuing aquatic prey. It can double
as a rubber raft. It assists in the rescues
of drowning people.
translation: 大量栖息在渔村，\n不仅会去帮助溺水的人，\n还会帮忙搬运捕获的猎物。

label: SPECIES_CHERUBI.speciesName
source: CHERUBI
translation: 樱花宝

label: SPECIES_CHERUBI.categoryName
source: Cherry
translation: 樱桃

label: SPECIES_CHERUBI.description
source:
The small ball holds the nutrients needed
for evolution. Apparently, it is also very
sweet and tasty. Pokémon like Starly and
Taillow try to peck it off.
translation: 在阳光下会渐渐变红。\n吸收养分，小球瘪掉的话，\n就是说快要进化了。

label: SPECIES_CHERRIM_OVERCAST.speciesName
source: CHERRIM
translation: 樱花儿

label: SPECIES_CHERRIM_OVERCAST.categoryName
source: Blossom
translation: 樱花

label: SPECIES_CHERRIM_OVERCAST.description
source:
It's motionless, save for the occasional
quiver. A rich array of Pokémon can be
found gathered around it, drawn by the
scent exuded from Cherrim's folded petals.
translation: 除了偶尔颤动之外几乎动也不动。\n从紧闭的花瓣中泄漏而出的香气\n会吸引多种宝可梦聚集而来。

label: SPECIES_CHERRIM_SUNSHINE.speciesName
source: CHERRIM
translation: 樱花儿

label: SPECIES_CHERRIM_SUNSHINE.categoryName
source: Blossom
translation: 樱花

label: SPECIES_CHERRIM_SUNSHINE.description
source:
Cherrim takes this form on sunny days.
Its faint scent entices bug Pokémon to it.
It immediately closes its petals and
becomes immobile once the sun hides.
translation: 一到了晴天就会非常积极地活动起来，\n但只要太阳被遮住，\n就会立刻闭上花瓣停止动作。

label: SPECIES_SHELLOS_WEST.speciesName
source: SHELLOS
translation: 无壳海兔

label: SPECIES_SHELLOS_WEST.categoryName
source: Sea Slug
translation: 海兔

label: SPECIES_SHELLOS_WEST.description
source:
It oozes a purple fluid to deter enemies.
While harmless, the fluid is awfully sticky.
Apparently, there are more West Sea
Shellos now than there were in the past.
translation: 会渗透出紫色的汁液来威吓敌人。\n跟过去相比，\n这个样子的群体似乎更多了。

label: SPECIES_SHELLOS_EAST.speciesName
source: SHELLOS
translation: 无壳海兔

label: SPECIES_SHELLOS_EAST.categoryName
source: Sea Slug
translation: 海兔

label: SPECIES_SHELLOS_EAST.description
source:
It's capable of spending a limited amount
of time on land until their skin dries out.
One theory suggests that living in cold
seas causes Shellos to take on this form.
translation: 经常能在岩岸发现它的身影。\n如果只是一定程度的时间，\n它也能在陆地上活动。

label: SPECIES_GASTRODON_WEST.speciesName
source: GASTRODON
translation: 海兔兽

label: SPECIES_GASTRODON_WEST.categoryName
source: Sea Slug
translation: 海兔

label: SPECIES_GASTRODON_WEST.description
source:
It appears on shallow-water beaches to
eat sand for nourishment. Should one
Gastrodon encounter another of a
different color, a fierce battle will ensue.
translation: 能在岩岸发现它的踪影。\n会用黏液慢慢溶解\n并吸食捕捉到的猎物。

label: SPECIES_GASTRODON_EAST.speciesName
source: GASTRODON
translation: 海兔兽

label: SPECIES_GASTRODON_EAST.categoryName
source: Sea Slug
translation: 海兔

label: SPECIES_GASTRODON_EAST.description
source:
Found more often on land than in the sea.
They normally live in rocky seashores, but
when cloudy or rainy, they can sometimes
be found on mountains, far from the sea.
translation: 渔夫说道，\n虽然曾经很少遇见这个样子的海兔兽，\n但现在它们有增加的倾向。

label: SPECIES_DRIFLOON.speciesName
source: DRIFLOON
translation: 飘飘球

label: SPECIES_DRIFLOON.categoryName
source: Balloon
translation: 气球

label: SPECIES_DRIFLOON.description
source:
Because of the way it floats aimlessly,
an old folktale calls it a “Signpost for
Wandering Spirits.” Children holding
them sometimes vanish.
translation: 人或宝可梦的魂魄聚集\n在一起后生成的宝可梦。\n非常喜欢湿哒哒的季节。

label: SPECIES_DRIFBLIM.speciesName
source: DRIFBLIM
translation: 随风球

label: SPECIES_DRIFBLIM.categoryName
source: Blimp
translation: 热气球

label: SPECIES_DRIFBLIM.description
source:
Even while under careful observation,
large flocks of Drifblim flying at dusk
will inexplicably disappear from view.
No one knows where they go.
translation: 能让人或宝可梦乘着飞行，\n但因为只能跟着风向飘，\n所以不知道会飞到哪里去。

label: SPECIES_BUNEARY.speciesName
source: BUNEARY
translation: 卷卷耳

label: SPECIES_BUNEARY.categoryName
source: Rabbit
translation: 兔子

label: SPECIES_BUNEARY.description
source:
You can tell how it feels by the way
it rolls its ears. When it's scared,
both ears are rolled up. When it senses
danger, it perks them up.
translation: 如果感觉到有危险，\n就会竖起双耳保持警觉。\n在寒冷的夜里把脸埋在毛皮里睡觉。

label: SPECIES_LOPUNNY.speciesName
source: LOPUNNY
translation: 长耳兔

label: SPECIES_LOPUNNY.categoryName
source: Rabbit
translation: 兔子

label: SPECIES_LOPUNNY.description
source:
An extremely cautious Pokémon.
It is very conscious of its looks and
never fails to groom its ears.
It runs with sprightly jumps.
translation: 耳朵似乎非常敏感，\n触摸时要温柔小心，\n否则会被它用柔软的脚狠踹。

label: SPECIES_LOPUNNY_MEGA.categoryName
source: Rabbit
translation: 兔子

label: SPECIES_LOPUNNY_MEGA.description
source:
Mega Evolution awakens its combative
instincts. It has shed any fur that got in
the way of its attacks.
crescent.
translation: 战斗的本能因超级进化而觉醒。\n会舍弃干扰它攻击的毛发。

label: SPECIES_GLAMEOW.speciesName
source: GLAMEOW
translation: 魅力喵

label: SPECIES_GLAMEOW.categoryName
source: Catty
translation: 装乖

label: SPECIES_GLAMEOW.description
source:
It is a very fickle Pokémon, which is 
very popular among some. It claws its
Trainer's nose if it isn't fed and
purrs when affectionate.
translation: 一不称心，就会竖起爪子。\n但偶尔会从喉咙里发出声响来撒娇，\n这样的性格很受部分人喜爱。

label: SPECIES_PURUGLY.speciesName
source: PURUGLY
translation: 东施喵

label: SPECIES_PURUGLY.categoryName
source: Tiger Cat
translation: 虎斑猫

label: SPECIES_PURUGLY.description
source:
It is a brazen brute that barges its way
into another Pokémon's nest and claims
it as its own. It binds its body with its
tails to make itself look bigger.
translation: 为了让自己的身体看起来大些，\n以此威吓对手，\n会把分叉的尾巴紧紧缠在腰上。

label: SPECIES_STUNKY.speciesName
source: STUNKY
translation: 臭鼬噗

label: SPECIES_STUNKY.categoryName
source: Skunk
translation: 臭鼬

label: SPECIES_STUNKY.description
source:
It protects itself by spraying a
nose-curling, stinky fluid from its rear
to repel attackers. The stench lingers
for 24 hours.
translation: 从屁屁喷出的臭液的气味\n会扩散到半径2公里的范围，\n周围的宝可梦都会逃得无影无踪。

label: SPECIES_SKUNTANK.speciesName
source: SKUNTANK
translation: 坦克臭鼬

label: SPECIES_SKUNTANK.categoryName
source: Skunk
translation: 臭鼬

label: SPECIES_SKUNTANK.description
source:
It attacks by spraying a horribly smelly
fluid from the tip of its tail. The fluid
smells worse the longer it is allowed
to fester.
translation: 会从尾巴尖端喷出奇臭无比的\n液体进行攻击，然而面对来自\n上方的攻击时会不知所措。

label: SPECIES_BRONZOR.speciesName
source: BRONZOR
translation: 铜镜怪

label: SPECIES_BRONZOR.categoryName
source: Bronze
translation: 青铜

label: SPECIES_BRONZOR.description
source:
Implements shaped like it were discovered
in ancient tombs. There are researchers
who believe this Pokémon reflected like a
mirror in the distant past.
translation: 过去的人们相信，\n铜镜怪背上的花纹里\n蕴藏着神秘的力量。

label: SPECIES_BRONZONG.speciesName
source: BRONZONG
translation: 青铜钟

label: SPECIES_BRONZONG.categoryName
source: Bronze Bell
translation: 铜钟

label: SPECIES_BRONZONG.description
source:
In ages past, this Pokémon was revered as
a bringer of rain. One caused a news stir
when it was dug up at a construction site
after a 2000-year sleep.
translation: 从遥远的过去开始就作为\n能召唤雨云的宝可梦被供奉着。\n时不时会被埋入地下。

label: SPECIES_CHATOT.speciesName
source: CHATOT
translation: 聒噪鸟

label: SPECIES_CHATOT.categoryName
source: Music Note
translation: 音符

label: SPECIES_CHATOT.description
source:
It mimics the cries of other Pokémon to
trick them into thinking it's one of them.
This way they won't attack it. It can
also learn and speak human words.
translation: 学习人类的语言来鸣叫。\n当伙伴们聚集在同一个地方时，\n大家就会学习到同样的词汇。

label: SPECIES_SPIRITOMB.speciesName
source: SPIRITOMB
translation: 花岩怪

label: SPECIES_SPIRITOMB.categoryName
source: Forbidden
translation: 封印

label: SPECIES_SPIRITOMB.description
source:
A Pokémon that was formed by 108 spirits.
Its constant mischief and misdeeds
resulted in it being bound to an
Odd Keystone by a mysterious spell.
translation: 总是作恶多端，\n不料有一天本体被神奇的\n法术绑缚在了楔石上。

label: SPECIES_GIBLE.speciesName
source: GIBLE
translation: 圆陆鲨

label: SPECIES_GIBLE.categoryName
source: Land Shark
translation: 陆鲨

label: SPECIES_GIBLE.description
source:
It nests in horizontal holes warmed by
geothermal heat. Foes who stray too
close can expect to be pounced on
and bitten.
translation: 生活在被地热加温的横洞里。\n如果有敌人靠近，\n就会从洞里扑出来大口咬住。

label: SPECIES_GABITE.speciesName
source: GABITE
translation: 尖牙陆鲨

label: SPECIES_GABITE.categoryName
source: Cave
translation: 洞穴

label: SPECIES_GABITE.description
source:
Shiny objects are its passion. It can be
found in its cave, scarcely moving,
its gaze fixed on the jewels it's amassed
or Carbink it has caught.
translation: 最喜欢闪闪发光的东西，\n所以会把在洞窟里找到的宝贝\n都积存到自己的巢穴中。

label: SPECIES_GARCHOMP.speciesName
source: GARCHOMP
translation: 烈咬陆鲨

label: SPECIES_GARCHOMP.categoryName
source: Mach
translation: 音速

label: SPECIES_GARCHOMP.description
source:
When it folds up its body and extends its
wings, it looks like a jet plane. It is
covered in fine scales that reduce drag,
enabling it to fly at high speeds.
translation: 在高速穿梭时，\n翅膀会生成空气之刃，\n使周围的树木都被切断。

label: SPECIES_GARCHOMP_MEGA.categoryName
source: Mach
translation: 音速

label: SPECIES_GARCHOMP_MEGA.description
source:
Excess energy melted its arms and wings
into giant scythes, sending it mad with
rage. It swings its scythes wildly and
slices the ground to pieces.
translation: 性格比超级进化前更粗暴。\n会用双臂的镰刀把敌人割得粉碎。

label: SPECIES_GARCHOMP_MEGA_Z.categoryName
source: Mach
translation: 音速

label: SPECIES_GARCHOMP_MEGA_Z.description
source:
Garchomp has gained a new Mega-Evolved
form. It flies around foes at Mach speed
and cuts them to shreds with its sinister
wing claws.
translation: 新的超级进化的样子。\n它会以音速四处飞行，\n用翅膀上骇人的爪子撕裂敌人。

label: SPECIES_RIOLU.speciesName
source: RIOLU
translation: 利欧路

label: SPECIES_RIOLU.categoryName
source: Emanation
translation: 波纹

label: SPECIES_RIOLU.description
source:
It can discern the physical and emotional
states of people, Pokémon, and other
natural things from the shape of their
aura waves.
translation: 从体内发出的波导会\n在害怕或悲伤时变强，\n并向伙伴传递危险的信号。

label: SPECIES_LUCARIO.speciesName
source: LUCARIO
translation: 路卡利欧

label: SPECIES_LUCARIO.categoryName
source: Aura
translation: 波导

label: SPECIES_LUCARIO.description
source:
It understands human speech.
It is said that no foe can remain invisible
to Lucario, since it can detect Auras.
Even foes it could not otherwise see.
translation: 通过侦测对方发出的波导，\n就能读取其想法和行动。

label: SPECIES_LUCARIO_MEGA.categoryName
source: Aura
translation: 波导

label: SPECIES_LUCARIO_MEGA.description
source:
It readies itself to face its enemies by
focusing its mental energies. Its fighting
style can be summed up in a single word:
heartless.
translation: 沐浴在爆发性的能量中，\n使得斗争的本能觉醒了。\n对于敌人，毫不留情。

label: SPECIES_LUCARIO_MEGA_Z.categoryName
source: Aura
translation: 波导

label: SPECIES_LUCARIO_MEGA_Z.description
source:
By completely cloaking itself in its aura,
Mega Lucario Z can parry all manner of
attacks, battling as if it were gracefully
dancing.
translation: 让波导包裹全身来\n化解任何攻击，\n仿佛跳舞般地战斗。

label: SPECIES_HIPPOPOTAS.speciesName
source: HIPPOPOTAS
translation: 沙河马

label: SPECIES_HIPPOPOTAS.categoryName
source: Hippo
translation: 河马

label: SPECIES_HIPPOPOTAS.description
source:
Hippopotas shuts its nostrils tight when
travelling through sand. Instead of
perspiration, it expels grains of sand
from its body.
translation: 会紧紧闭上鼻孔，\n然后在沙子里如同步行般地前进。\n组成约10只的群体一起生活。

label: SPECIES_HIPPOWDON.speciesName
source: HIPPOWDON
translation: 河马兽

label: SPECIES_HIPPOWDON.categoryName
source: Heavyweight
translation: 重量

label: SPECIES_HIPPOWDON.description
source:
It is surprisingly quick to anger.
It brandishes its gaping mouth in a
display of fearsome strength and raises
vast quantities of sand while attacking.
translation: 嘴巴张得大大的，\n炫耀自己的强大。\n向上卷起大量的沙子进行攻击。

label: SPECIES_SKORUPI.speciesName
source: SKORUPI
translation: 钳尾蝎

label: SPECIES_SKORUPI.categoryName
source: Scorpion
translation: 蝎子

label: SPECIES_SKORUPI.description
source:
It grips prey with its tail claws and
injects poison. It tenaciously hangs
on until the poison takes.
It can survive a year without food.
translation: 用尾巴上的钩爪夹住猎物并注入毒素。\n很执着，\n毒不发作就绝不松开。

label: SPECIES_DRAPION.speciesName
source: DRAPION
translation: 龙王蝎

label: SPECIES_DRAPION.categoryName
source: Ogre Scorp
translation: 蝎怪

label: SPECIES_DRAPION.description
source:
Possessing a sturdy build, it takes
pride in its strength. It has the power
in its clawed arms to make scrap
out of a car.
translation: 双臂的钩爪有着能把\n汽车扯成废铁的破坏力。\n会从钩爪的前端放出毒素。

label: SPECIES_CROAGUNK.speciesName
source: CROAGUNK
translation: 不良蛙

label: SPECIES_CROAGUNK.categoryName
source: Toxic Mouth
translation: 毒击

label: SPECIES_CROAGUNK.description
source:
Croagunk rarely fights fairly. Inflating
its poison sacs, it fills the area with
an odd sound and hits flinching
opponents with a poison jab.
translation: 鼓起毒囊鸣叫，\n让周围响起诡异的声音，\n如果对手畏缩了，便施以毒击。

label: SPECIES_TOXICROAK.speciesName
source: TOXICROAK
translation: 毒骷蛙

label: SPECIES_TOXICROAK.categoryName
source: Toxic Mouth
translation: 毒击

label: SPECIES_TOXICROAK.description
source:
Swaying and dodging the attacks
of its foes, it weaves its flexible body
in close, then lunges out with its
poisonous claws.
translation: 喉咙里带有毒囊。\n如果从喉咙发出声响，\n储存的毒素会被炼制得更强劲。

label: SPECIES_CARNIVINE.speciesName
source: CARNIVINE
translation: 尖牙笼

label: SPECIES_CARNIVINE.categoryName
source: Bug Catcher
translation: 捕虫

label: SPECIES_CARNIVINE.description
source:
Hanging from branches using its
tentacles, it looks like a plant.
It attracts prey with its sweet-smelling
saliva, then chomps down.
translation: 先用甜香的唾液引诱猎物，\n然后用大颚大口地嚼。\n要花1整天吃掉猎物。

label: SPECIES_FINNEON.speciesName
source: FINNEON
translation: 荧光鱼

label: SPECIES_FINNEON.categoryName
source: Wing Fish
translation: 飞翅鱼

label: SPECIES_FINNEON.description
source:
Its double tail fins propel its energetic
jumps. When it breaks the surface of the
sea, Wingull swoop down to grab it on
the fly.
translation: 身体侧面的线条会储存太阳光。\n到了夜里就会鲜亮闪烁。

label: SPECIES_LUMINEON.speciesName
source: LUMINEON
translation: 霓虹鱼

label: SPECIES_LUMINEON.categoryName
source: Neon
translation: 霓虹

label: SPECIES_LUMINEON.description
source:
Lumineon swimming in the darkness
of the deep sea look like stars shining
in the night sky. It competes for food
with Lanturn.
translation: 为了不被天敌发现，\n会用胸部的2片鳍在海底爬行。

label: SPECIES_SNOVER.speciesName
source: SNOVER
translation: 雪笠怪

label: SPECIES_SNOVER.categoryName
source: Frost Tree
translation: 树冰

label: SPECIES_SNOVER.description
source:
During cold seasons, it migrates to the
mountain's lower reaches. Seemingly
curious about people, they gather around
footsteps they find on snowy mountains.
translation: 或许是对人类感兴趣，\n只要在雪山发现了脚印，\n就会聚集到那周围去。

label: SPECIES_ABOMASNOW.speciesName
source: ABOMASNOW
translation: 暴雪王

label: SPECIES_ABOMASNOW.categoryName
source: Frost Tree
translation: 树冰

label: SPECIES_ABOMASNOW.description
source:
It lives a quiet life on mountains that
are perpetually covered in snow. It hides
itself by whipping up blizzards.
It is also known as “The Ice Monster.”
translation: 雪花盛开之时会从某处现身，\n雪花凋零之时则会再度\n前往某处并隐藏自己的身影。

label: SPECIES_ABOMASNOW_MEGA.categoryName
source: Frost Tree
translation: 树冰

label: SPECIES_ABOMASNOW_MEGA.description
source:
The sprouts on Abomasnow's back grow into
great shafts of ice when it Mega Evolves.
Dislikes associating with others and
chooses to live quietly deep in mountains.
translation: 背后的四颗新芽会长成巨大的冰柱，\n不喜欢与他人交往，\n选择在深山里安静地生活。

label: SPECIES_ROTOM.speciesName
source: ROTOM
translation: 洛托姆

label: SPECIES_ROTOM.categoryName
source: Plasma
translation: 等离子

label: SPECIES_ROTOM.description
source:
Its body is composed of plasma and loves
to surprise others. One boy's invention led
to the development of many machines that
can use of Rotom's unique capabilities.
translation: 作为驱动特殊马达的动力能源\n而被长期研究的宝可梦。

label: SPECIES_ROTOM_HEAT.speciesName
source: ROTOM
translation: 洛托姆

label: SPECIES_ROTOM_HEAT.categoryName
source: Plasma
translation: 等离子

label: SPECIES_ROTOM_HEAT.description
source:
If the convection microwave oven is
not working properly, then the Rotom
inhabiting it will become lethargic. It
makes mischief by turning up the heat.
translation: 钻进了烤箱微波炉的样子。\n会用高温将周围烤得焦黑，\n然后开心地大笑。

label: SPECIES_ROTOM_WASH.speciesName
source: ROTOM
translation: 洛托姆

label: SPECIES_ROTOM_WASH.categoryName
source: Plasma
translation: 等离子

label: SPECIES_ROTOM_WASH.description
source:
It enjoys coming up with water-based
pranks. The model of washing machine that
Rotom can inspirit has been discontinued,
so they are now traded at high prices.
translation: 由于已经停止生产，\n能让洛托姆钻进去的洗衣机\n在市场上被高价买卖。

label: SPECIES_ROTOM_FROST.speciesName
source: ROTOM
translation: 洛托姆

label: SPECIES_ROTOM_FROST.categoryName
source: Plasma
translation: 等离子

label: SPECIES_ROTOM_FROST.description
source:
In this form, Rotom likes to play freezing
cold pranks. You may find it's turned the
bath you just filled to solid ice!
It battles by spewing cold air.
translation: 装在冰箱里的特殊马达是让\n洛托姆发生形态变化的关键。

label: SPECIES_ROTOM_FAN.speciesName
source: ROTOM
translation: 洛托姆

label: SPECIES_ROTOM_FAN.categoryName
source: Plasma
translation: 等离子

label: SPECIES_ROTOM_FAN.description
source:
The first appliance developed that Rotom
coud inspirit was the electric fan. It uses
its power over wind in its pranks, happily
blowing any important documents it finds.
translation: 虽然能让洛托姆钻进去的\n家电产品有好几种，\n但最先被研发出来的是电风扇。

label: SPECIES_ROTOM_MOW.speciesName
source: ROTOM
translation: 洛托姆

label: SPECIES_ROTOM_MOW.categoryName
source: Plasma
translation: 等离子

label: SPECIES_ROTOM_MOW.description
source:
The lawn mower is an appliance that led to
the development of the Rotom Dex. It will
mow down grass and flowers, then swagger
around with pride at its accomplishments.
translation: 钻进割草机的样子。\n砍倒花草后，\n它会自信满满地耀武扬威。

label: SPECIES_UXIE.speciesName
source: UXIE
translation: 由克希

label: SPECIES_UXIE.categoryName
source: Knowledge
translation: 知识

label: SPECIES_UXIE.description
source:
Known as ”The Being of Knowledge,”
according to some sources, this Pokémon
provided people with the intelligence
necessary to solve various problems.
translation: 据说，\n由克希的诞生给人类带来了\n令生活变得丰富多彩的智慧。

label: SPECIES_MESPRIT.speciesName
source: MESPRIT
translation: 艾姆利多

label: SPECIES_MESPRIT.categoryName
source: Emotion
translation: 感情

label: SPECIES_MESPRIT.description
source:
Although it slumbers at the bottom of a
lake, its spirit is said to leave its body
and flitter on the water surface. It
taught humans of sorrow, pain, and joy.
translation: 沉睡在湖底，\n但据说会灵魂出窍，\n在水面上飞来飞去。

label: SPECIES_AZELF.speciesName
source: AZELF
translation: 亚克诺姆

label: SPECIES_AZELF.categoryName
source: Willpower
translation: 意志

label: SPECIES_AZELF.description
source:
This Pokémon is said to have endowed
humans with the determination needed to
do things. It is thought that Uxie, Mesprit
and Azelf all came from the same egg.
translation: 人们认为，\n由克希、艾姆利多和亚克诺姆\n是从同一个蛋里出生的宝可梦。

label: SPECIES_DIALGA.speciesName
source: DIALGA
translation: 帝牙卢卡

label: SPECIES_DIALGA.categoryName
source: Temporal
translation: 时间

label: SPECIES_DIALGA.description
source:
A Pokémon spoken of in legend.
It completely controls the flow of time.
It uses its power to travel at will
through the past and future.
translation: 由于帝牙卢卡的诞生，\n时间才开始流动。\n是有着这样传说的宝可梦。

label: SPECIES_DIALGA_ORIGIN.speciesName
source: DIALGA
translation: 帝牙卢卡

label: SPECIES_DIALGA_ORIGIN.categoryName
source: Temporal
translation: 时间

label: SPECIES_DIALGA_ORIGIN.description
source:
Radiant light caused Dialga to take on a
form bearing a striking resemblance to the
creator Pokémon. It wields such a colossal
strength that this might be its true form.
translation: 光明乃是促使形态变化的导火线。\n其强大力量令人不得不认为\n如此酷似创造神的姿态才是其真身。

label: SPECIES_PALKIA.speciesName
source: PALKIA
translation: 帕路奇亚

label: SPECIES_PALKIA.categoryName
source: Spatial
translation: 空间

label: SPECIES_PALKIA.description
source:
Palkia has the ability to distort space.
Its total control over the boundaries of
space enable it to transport itself to
faraway places and other dimensions.
translation: 据说居住在平行排列的空间狭缝中，\n是出现在神话中的宝可梦。

label: SPECIES_PALKIA_ORIGIN.speciesName
source: PALKIA
translation: 帕路奇亚

label: SPECIES_PALKIA_ORIGIN.categoryName
source: Spatial
translation: 空间

label: SPECIES_PALKIA_ORIGIN.description
source:
It soars across the sky in a form that
resembles the creator of all things.
Perhaps this imitation of appearance is a
strategy for gaining Arceus's powers.
translation: 翱翔天际的姿态令人联想起\n万物的创造主。据推测，模仿创造主\n的模样正是将其力化为己有的方法。

label: SPECIES_HEATRAN.speciesName
source: HEATRAN
translation: 席多蓝恩

label: SPECIES_HEATRAN.categoryName
source: Lava Dome
translation: 火山口

label: SPECIES_HEATRAN.description
source:
Boiling blood, like magma, circulates
through its body. It dwells in volcanic
caves, using its cross-shaped feet
to crawl on ceilings and walls.
translation: 栖息在火山的洞穴里。\n用十字形的爪子钩住\n墙壁和洞顶爬来爬去。

label: SPECIES_HEATRAN_MEGA.categoryName
source: Lava Dome
translation: 火山口

label: SPECIES_HEATRAN_MEGA.description
source:
It's said that if it goes all out, it
can heat its body up to temperatures
over 1.8 million degrees Fahrenheit.
This heat keeps enemies at bay.
translation: 据说它在火力全开时\n体温会升高到100万度，\n决不允许敌人靠近。

label: SPECIES_REGIGIGAS.speciesName
source: REGIGIGAS
translation: 雷吉奇卡斯

label: SPECIES_REGIGIGAS.categoryName
source: Colossal
translation: 巨大

label: SPECIES_REGIGIGAS.description
source:
There is an enduring legend that
states this Pokémon shaped Regirock,
Regice, and Registeel out of clay, ice,
and magma.
translation: 据说用特殊的冰山、岩石和熔岩\n制作出了形似自己的宝可梦。

label: SPECIES_GIRATINA_ALTERED.speciesName
source: GIRATINA
translation: 骑拉帝纳

label: SPECIES_GIRATINA_ALTERED.categoryName
source: Renegade
translation: 反抗

label: SPECIES_GIRATINA_ALTERED.description
source:
This Pokémon is said to live in a world
on the reverse side of ours, where common
knowledge is distorted and strange.
It was banished for its violence.
translation: 因为性格粗暴而被驱逐，\n一直待在毁坏的世界里，\n静静地看着原来的世界。

label: SPECIES_GIRATINA_ORIGIN.speciesName
source: GIRATINA
translation: 骑拉帝纳

label: SPECIES_GIRATINA_ORIGIN.categoryName
source: Renegade
translation: 反抗

label: SPECIES_GIRATINA_ORIGIN.description
source:
Giratina loses its legs upon changing into
this form. It's believed it hails from a
world where the heavens and the earth
are as one.
translation: 脚部随着形态变化而消失。\n据推测，此宝可梦栖息于没有天地\n之分的世界，然而没有手段能证明。

label: SPECIES_CRESSELIA.speciesName
source: CRESSELIA
translation: 克雷色利亚

label: SPECIES_CRESSELIA.categoryName
source: Lunar
translation: 新月

label: SPECIES_CRESSELIA.description
source:
Those who sleep holding one of
Cresselia's feathers are assured of
joyful dreams. It is said to represent
the crescent moon.
translation: 飞行的时候，\n会从薄纱一样的翅膀中发出闪光粒子。\n被称为新月的化身。

label: SPECIES_PHIONE.speciesName
source: PHIONE
translation: 霏欧纳

label: SPECIES_PHIONE.categoryName
source: Sea Drifter
translation: 海洋

label: SPECIES_PHIONE.description
source:
When the water warms, they inflate the
flotation sac on their heads and drift
languidly on the sea in packs.
It always returns to where it was born.
translation: 漂浮在温暖的海上。\n无论漂得多远，\n都一定会回到出生的地方。

label: SPECIES_MANAPHY.speciesName
source: MANAPHY
translation: 玛纳霏

label: SPECIES_MANAPHY.categoryName
source: Seafaring
translation: 回游

label: SPECIES_MANAPHY.description
source:
Water makes up 80% of its body.
It starts its life with a wondrous power
that permits it to bond with any kind
of Pokémon.
translation: 如果使用与生俱来的神奇力量，\n就可以和任何宝可梦心意相通。

label: SPECIES_DARKRAI.speciesName
source: DARKRAI
translation: 达克莱伊

label: SPECIES_DARKRAI.categoryName
source: Pitch-Black
translation: 暗黑

label: SPECIES_DARKRAI.description
source:
It chases people and Pokémon from its
territory by causing them to experience
deep, nightmarish slumbers. However,
it means no harm.
translation: 拥有诱使人们进入\n深度睡眠并做梦的能力。\n在朔月的夜晚活动。

label: SPECIES_DARKRAI_MEGA.categoryName
source: Pitch-Black
translation: 梦魇

label: SPECIES_DARKRAI_MEGA.description
source:
Its dark power blocks out the sun,
plunging the surrounding area into
darkness. There is no escaping its
evil eye.
translation: 黑暗力量会遮蔽太阳，\n使周围全部陷入黑暗。\n谁都无法逃离它的邪眼。

label: SPECIES_SHAYMIN_LAND.speciesName
source: SHAYMIN
translation: 谢米

label: SPECIES_SHAYMIN_LAND.categoryName
source: Gratitude
translation: 感谢

label: SPECIES_SHAYMIN_LAND.description
source:
The flowers all over its body bloom if it is
lovingly hugged and senses gratitude. It
dissolves toxins in the air to transform
ruined land into a lush field of flowers.
translation: 当人们欣喜于严冬随季节更替终结，\n向上天奉献感谢之意时，此宝可梦\n就会现身，令荒寂的大地开满鲜花。

label: SPECIES_SHAYMIN_SKY.speciesName
source: SHAYMIN
translation: 谢米

label: SPECIES_SHAYMIN_SKY.categoryName
source: Gratitude
translation: 感谢

label: SPECIES_SHAYMIN_SKY.description
source:
Upon taking in the scent of a particular
rare flower, Shaymin is enveloped in light
and its tiny body transforms, confering
the power of flight upon it.
translation: 当嗅闻珍奇之花的香味时，\n娇小的身体将在光辉中变成此形貌。

label: gSpeciesInfoGen4.speciesName
source: ARCEUS
translation: 阿尔宙斯

label: gSpeciesInfoGen4.categoryName
source: Alpha
translation: 创造

label: SPECIES_VICTINI.speciesName
source: VICTINI
translation: 比克提尼

label: SPECIES_VICTINI.categoryName
source: Victory
translation: 胜利

label: SPECIES_VICTINI.description
source:
This Pokémon brings victory.
It is said that Trainers with Victini
always win, regardless of the type
of encounter.
translation: 如果获得了比克提尼所分享的\n无限生成的能量，\n就会全身充满力量。

label: SPECIES_SNIVY.speciesName
source: SNIVY
translation: 藤藤蛇

label: SPECIES_SNIVY.categoryName
source: Grass Snake
translation: 草蛇

label: SPECIES_SNIVY.description
source:
It is very intelligent and calm.
Being exposed to lots of sunlight makes
its movements swifter. When they are
not feeling well, their tails droop.
translation: 用尾巴沐浴着阳光进行光合作用。\n如果没有精神，\n尾巴就会垂下来。

label: SPECIES_SERVINE.speciesName
source: SERVINE
translation: 青藤蛇

label: SPECIES_SERVINE.categoryName
source: Grass Snake
translation: 草蛇

label: SPECIES_SERVINE.description
source:
When it gets dirty, its leaves can't be
used in photosynthesis, so it always keeps
clean. They avoid attacks by sinking into
the shadows of thick foliage.
translation: 如果身体变脏，\n就没法用叶子进行光合作用，\n所以它总是保持自身的清洁。

label: SPECIES_SERPERIOR.speciesName
source: SERPERIOR
translation: 君主蛇

label: SPECIES_SERPERIOR.categoryName
source: Regal
translation: 皇家

label: SPECIES_SERPERIOR.description
source:
They raise their heads to intimidate foes,
but only give it their all when fighting
powerful opponents who are not fazed
by the glare from its noble eyes.
translation: 仅仅是盯着，\n就能令对手动弹不得。\n能让太阳能量在体内增强。

label: SPECIES_TEPIG.speciesName
source: TEPIG
translation: 暖暖猪

label: SPECIES_TEPIG.categoryName
source: Fire Pig
translation: 火猪

label: SPECIES_TEPIG.description
source:
It loves to eat roasted berries, but
sometimes it gets too excited and burns
them to a crisp. It blows fire through
its nose.
translation: 非常喜欢吃烤过的树果，\n但因为太兴奋而时常烤得焦黑。

label: SPECIES_PIGNITE.speciesName
source: PIGNITE
translation: 炒炒猪

label: SPECIES_PIGNITE.categoryName
source: Fire Pig
translation: 火猪

label: SPECIES_PIGNITE.description
source:
The more it eats, the more fuel it has
to make the fire in its stomach stronger.
When it is angered, the intensity of the
flame increases.
translation: 如果体内的火焰燃起，\n动作就会变得非常敏捷。\n危机时刻会喷出烟雾。

label: SPECIES_EMBOAR.speciesName
source: EMBOAR
translation: 炎武王

label: SPECIES_EMBOAR.categoryName
source: Fire Pig
translation: 大火猪

label: SPECIES_EMBOAR.description
source:
It is adept at using many different moves.
It can throw a fire punch by setting its
fists on fire with its fiery chin.
It cares deeply about its friends.
translation: 一直蓄着火焰的胡须。\n身怀兼具力量与速度的格斗招式。

label: SPECIES_EMBOAR_MEGA.categoryName
source: Fire Pig
translation: 大火猪

label: SPECIES_EMBOAR_MEGA.description
source:
Brandishing a blazing flame
shaped like a serpentine spear,
it rushes in to save its
imperiled allies.
translation: 会高举熊熊燃烧的蛇矛状\n火焰，火速赶去援救陷入\n困境的伙伴。

label: SPECIES_OSHAWOTT.speciesName
source: OSHAWOTT
translation: 水水獭

label: SPECIES_OSHAWOTT.categoryName
source: Sea Otter
translation: 海獭

label: SPECIES_OSHAWOTT.description
source:
The scalchop on its stomach isn't just
used for battle, it can be used to break
open hard berries as well. It is made
from the same element as its claws.
translation: 用腹部的扇贝贝战斗。\n抵挡住攻击后，\n会立马切斩反击。

label: SPECIES_DEWOTT.speciesName
source: DEWOTT
translation: 双刃丸

label: SPECIES_DEWOTT.categoryName
source: Discipline
translation: 修行

label: SPECIES_DEWOTT.description
source:
Strict training and disclipine leads it
to master its flowing double-scalchop
technique. Scalchop techniques differ
from one Dewott to another.
translation: 经过严格的修炼后，\n每只双刃丸都会学会\n不同套路的扇贝贝刀法。

label: SPECIES_SAMUROTT.speciesName
source: SAMUROTT
translation: 大剑鬼

label: SPECIES_SAMUROTT.categoryName
source: Formidable
translation: 威严

label: SPECIES_SAMUROTT.description
source:
One swing of the seamitars attached
to its armor can fell an opponent.
A simple glare from one of them is
enough to intimidate most enemies.
translation: 用收在铠甲里的剑攻击敌人，\n一挥就能将对手打倒。\n瞪一眼就能让敌人不敢出声。

label: SPECIES_SAMUROTT_HISUI.description
source:
Hard of heart and deft of blade,
this rare form of Samurott is a
product of the Pokémon's evolution in the
region of Hisui.
translation: 性情与刀路皆是残酷无情。\n连绵不断的攻击彷如千层浪涛。\n此乃只在洗翠进化而成的稀有姿态。

label: SPECIES_PATRAT.speciesName
source: PATRAT
translation: 探探鼠

label: SPECIES_PATRAT.categoryName
source: Scout
translation: 放哨

label: SPECIES_PATRAT.description
source:
Extremely cautious, they take shifts to
maintain a constant watch of their nest.
Using food stored in cheek pouches,
they can keep watch for days.
translation: 戒备心很强，\n必定有1只在负责放哨，\n但不会注意到后方来的敌人。

label: SPECIES_WATCHOG.speciesName
source: WATCHOG
translation: 步哨鼠

label: SPECIES_WATCHOG.categoryName
source: Lookout
translation: 警戒

label: SPECIES_WATCHOG.description
source:
Using luminescent matter, it makes its
eyes and body glow and stuns attacking
opponents. Keen eyesight lets them see
in the dark.
translation: 射出藏在颊囊里的树果种子进行攻击。\n一旦发现敌人，\n尾巴会竖起来。

label: SPECIES_LILLIPUP.speciesName
source: LILLIPUP
translation: 小约克

label: SPECIES_LILLIPUP.categoryName
source: Puppy
translation: 小狗

label: SPECIES_LILLIPUP.description
source:
It faces strong opponents with great
courage. Because it doesn't yelp, it's
extremely popular with Trainers who live
in apartment buildings.
translation: 虽说是勇猛的宝可梦，\n但也有很聪明的一面，\n会在认清对手的实力后避开战斗。

label: SPECIES_HERDIER.speciesName
source: HERDIER
translation: 哈约克

label: SPECIES_HERDIER.categoryName
source: Loyal Dog
translation: 忠犬

label: SPECIES_HERDIER.description
source:
Its dense black fur grows continuously.
The high cost of keeping its hard fur
properly groomed makes this a
troublesome Pokémon to train.
translation: 像斗篷一样覆盖在身上的\n黑色体毛非常坚硬。\n可以让它减少受到的伤害。

label: SPECIES_STOUTLAND.speciesName
source: STOUTLAND
translation: 长毛狗

label: SPECIES_STOUTLAND.categoryName
source: Big-Hearted
translation: 宽大

label: SPECIES_STOUTLAND.description
source:
Intelligent, good-natured, and valiant,
there could be no concern that it would
ever attack people. Some parents even
trust it to babysit.
translation: 如果被它长长的体毛包裹着，\n就会变得温暖又舒适，即使是在冬天\n的山上也能淡定地度过一晚。

label: SPECIES_PURRLOIN.speciesName
source: PURRLOIN
translation: 扒手猫

label: SPECIES_PURRLOIN.categoryName
source: Devious
translation: 坏心眼

label: SPECIES_PURRLOIN.description
source:
Their deceptively cute act is the
perfect ruse. They steal from people for
fun, but their victims can't help but
forgive them.
translation: 出于好玩偷盗人的物品。\n被偷的人也因其逗人喜爱的\n动作而不自觉地原谅它。

label: SPECIES_LIEPARD.speciesName
source: LIEPARD
translation: 酷豹

label: SPECIES_LIEPARD.categoryName
source: Cruel
translation: 冷酷

label: SPECIES_LIEPARD.description
source:
Many Trainers are drawn to their
beautiful form and fur. These Pokémon
vanish and appear unexpectedly.
They run silently in the night.
translation: 隐藏气息悄悄接近。\n在对手发觉前，\n从背后偷偷靠近并了结它。

label: SPECIES_PANSAGE.speciesName
source: PANSAGE
translation: 花椰猴

label: SPECIES_PANSAGE.categoryName
source: Grass Monkey
translation: 草猴

label: SPECIES_PANSAGE.description
source:
This Pokémon dwells deep in the forest.
It's good at finding berries and gathers
them from all over. It's kind enough to
share them with friends.
translation: 擅长寻找树果，\n有着到处搜集树果分给伙伴的善心。

label: SPECIES_SIMISAGE.speciesName
source: SIMISAGE
translation: 花椰猿

label: SPECIES_SIMISAGE.categoryName
source: Thorn Monkey
translation: 刺猴

label: SPECIES_SIMISAGE.description
source:
Ill tempered, it attacks enemies by
swinging its barbed tail around wildly.
The leaf growing on its head is
very bitter.
translation: 性格粗暴，\n会挥动着带有尖刺的尾巴战斗。\n头上的叶子非常苦。

label: SPECIES_PANSEAR.speciesName
source: PANSEAR
translation: 爆香猴

label: SPECIES_PANSEAR.categoryName
source: High Temp
translation: 高温

label: SPECIES_PANSEAR.description
source:
The fire within the tuft on its head can
reach up to 600ºF. Very intelligent,
it roasts berries before eating them.
It likes to help people.
translation: 生活在火山的洞穴里。\n头上的那丛毛发熊熊燃烧着，\n温度高达300度。

label: SPECIES_SIMISEAR.speciesName
source: SIMISEAR
translation: 爆香猿

label: SPECIES_SIMISEAR.categoryName
source: Ember
translation: 火花

label: SPECIES_SIMISEAR.description
source:
It loves sweets because they become
energy for the fire burning inside its
body. It scatters embers from its head
and tail to sear its opponents.
translation: 兴奋的时候，从头和尾巴飞扬起\n火花，身体变热。\n不知为何很喜欢吃甜的东西。

label: SPECIES_PANPOUR.speciesName
source: PANPOUR
translation: 冷水猴

label: SPECIES_PANPOUR.categoryName
source: Spray
translation: 泼水

label: SPECIES_PANPOUR.description
source:
The water stored inside the tuft of its
head is rich in nutrients. It waters
plants using its tail, plants that
receive its water grow large.
translation: 头上的毛发丛里储藏的水充满了营养。\n如果给植物浇了，\n就会茁壮成长。

label: SPECIES_SIMIPOUR.speciesName
source: SIMIPOUR
translation: 冷水猿

label: SPECIES_SIMIPOUR.categoryName
source: Geyser
translation: 放水

label: SPECIES_SIMIPOUR.description
source:
It can shoot highly-pressurised water
from its tail with enough power to
break through a solid concrete wall.
It prefers places with clean water.
translation: 喜欢水很干净的地方。\n一旦头上储藏的水减少，\n就会用尾巴吸水来补充。

label: SPECIES_MUNNA.speciesName
source: MUNNA
translation: 食梦梦

label: SPECIES_MUNNA.categoryName
source: Dream Eater
translation: 食梦

label: SPECIES_MUNNA.description
source:
This Pokémon appears before people
and Pokémon who are having nightmares
and eats those dreams. Munna always
float in the air.
translation: 会吃掉人和宝可梦做的梦。\n如果吃了快乐的梦，\n就会吐出粉红色的烟雾来。

label: SPECIES_MUSHARNA.speciesName
source: MUSHARNA
translation: 梦梦蚀

label: SPECIES_MUSHARNA.categoryName
source: Drowsing
translation: 半梦半醒

label: SPECIES_MUSHARNA.description
source:
The mist emanating from their foreheads
is packed with the dreams of people and
Pokémon. It changes into different colors
depending on the dream that was eaten.
translation: 从额头冒出的梦的烟雾，\n会根据所吃梦的内容，\n变成各种各样的颜色。

label: SPECIES_PIDOVE.speciesName
source: PIDOVE
translation: 豆豆鸽

label: SPECIES_PIDOVE.categoryName
source: Tiny Pigeon
translation: 小鸽

label: SPECIES_PIDOVE.description
source:
This very forgetful Pokémon will wait for
a new order from its Trainer even though
it already has one. Flocks often gather
in parks and plazas.
translation: 生活在街道上的宝可梦。\n因为不怎么怕人，\n所以会大量聚集在公园或广场。

label: SPECIES_TRANQUILL.speciesName
source: TRANQUILL
translation: 咕咕鸽

label: SPECIES_TRANQUILL.categoryName
source: Wild Pigeon
translation: 野鸽

label: SPECIES_TRANQUILL.description
source:
No matter where in the world it goes,
it knows where its nest is, so it can
always return to its Trainer's location
regardless of the distance.
translation: 无论身在世界的哪个角落，\n都会知道自己的巢在哪里，\n所以也不会和训练家走散。

label: SPECIES_UNFEZANT.speciesName
source: UNFEZANT
translation: 高傲雉鸡

label: SPECIES_UNFEZANT.categoryName
source: Proud
translation: 自尊心

label: SPECIES_UNFEZANT.description
source:
Males have plumage on their heads.
The females' flying abilities surpass
those of the males. They will only let
themselves feel close to their Trainers.
translation: 雄性的头上有冠羽。\n绝对不会亲近训练家以外的人。

label: SPECIES_BLITZLE.speciesName
source: BLITZLE
translation: 斑斑马

label: SPECIES_BLITZLE.categoryName
source: Electrified
translation: 带电

label: SPECIES_BLITZLE.description
source:
Its mane shines when it discharges
electricity. They use the frequency and
rhythm of these flashes to communicate
with one another.
translation: 如果放电，鬃毛就会发光。\n通过鬃毛闪耀的次数\n和节奏与伙伴对话。

label: SPECIES_ZEBSTRIKA.speciesName
source: ZEBSTRIKA
translation: 雷电斑马

label: SPECIES_ZEBSTRIKA.categoryName
source: Thunderbolt
translation: 雷电

label: SPECIES_ZEBSTRIKA.description
source:
When Zebstrika run at full speed, the
sound of thunder reverberates. It is
dangerous when it's angry as it shoots
lightning from its mane in all directions.
translation: 有着闪电般的瞬间爆发力。\n如果雷电斑马以全速奔跑，\n就会雷声轰鸣。

label: SPECIES_ROGGENROLA.speciesName
source: ROGGENROLA
translation: 石丸子

label: SPECIES_ROGGENROLA.categoryName
source: Mantle
translation: 地幔

label: SPECIES_ROGGENROLA.description
source:
The hexagonal cavity is its ear.
It walks in the direction of sounds it
hears, but if the sounds cease, it panics
and topples over.
translation: 100年前的大地震时，\n从地裂中被发现。\n体内拥有能量核心。

label: SPECIES_BOLDORE.speciesName
source: BOLDORE
translation: 地幔岩

label: SPECIES_BOLDORE.categoryName
source: Ore
translation: 矿石

label: SPECIES_BOLDORE.description
source:
Its orange crystal is a mass of energy.
Just one crystal fragment would provide
enough fuel for a hundred dump trucks.
When it is healthy, its core sticks out.
translation: 如果精神好，核心就会凸出。\n无需改变身体的朝向，\n就能前后左右迅速移动。

label: SPECIES_GIGALITH.speciesName
source: GIGALITH
translation: 庞岩怪

label: SPECIES_GIGALITH.categoryName
source: Compressed
translation: 高压

label: SPECIES_GIGALITH.description
source:
The blasts of energy it makes from
sunbeams have terrifying power.
However, it's not able to fire its blasts
at night or on rainy days.
translation: 用体内的核心将能量压缩后\n再将其射出进行攻击，\n威力足以吹飞山岳。

label: SPECIES_WOOBAT.speciesName
source: WOOBAT
translation: 滚滚蝙蝠

label: SPECIES_WOOBAT.categoryName
source: Bat
translation: 蝙蝠

label: SPECIES_WOOBAT.description
source:
Its habitat is dark forests and caves.
Suction from its nostrils enables it
to stick to cave walls during sleep.
It leaves a heart-shaped mark behind.
translation: 据说如果按住滚滚蝙蝠的鼻子，\n接触到它鼻子的地方留下\n心形痕迹的话，就会有好事发生。

label: SPECIES_SWOOBAT.speciesName
source: SWOOBAT
translation: 心蝙蝠

label: SPECIES_SWOOBAT.categoryName
source: Courting
translation: 求爱

label: SPECIES_SWOOBAT.description
source:
Anyone who comes into contact with
the ultrasonic waves emitted by a
courting male experiences a positive
mood shift.
translation: 如果被雄性向雌性求爱时\n发出的超音波照到，\n心情就会变得非常快乐。

label: SPECIES_DRILBUR.speciesName
source: DRILBUR
translation: 螺钉地鼠

label: SPECIES_DRILBUR.categoryName
source: Mole
translation: 鼹鼠

label: SPECIES_DRILBUR.description
source:
It can dig through the ground at a
speed of 30 mph by spinning its body.
It could give a car running aboveground
a good race.
translation: 将双掌上的爪子并拢，\n并让身体高速旋转的话，\n就会以迅猛的速度在地里前进。

label: SPECIES_EXCADRILL.speciesName
source: EXCADRILL
translation: 龙头地鼠

label: SPECIES_EXCADRILL.categoryName
source: Subterrene
translation: 地底

label: SPECIES_EXCADRILL.description
source:
More than 300 feet below the surface,
they build mazelike nests. Their activity
can be destructive to subway tunnels,
but it can also help with construction.
translation: 进化成钢的钻头拥有\n穿透铁板的破坏力。\n在隧道工程里非常活跃。

label: SPECIES_EXCADRILL_MEGA.categoryName
source: Subterrene
translation: 地底

label: SPECIES_EXCADRILL_MEGA.description
source:
If this Pokémon brings its arms and
head together to form a streamlined
shape and spins at high speeds,
it can destroy anything.
translation: 只要把头和双手合在一起\n形成流线型，再高速旋转\n就能破坏一切。

label: SPECIES_AUDINO.speciesName
source: AUDINO
translation: 差不多娃娃

label: SPECIES_AUDINO.categoryName
source: Hearing
translation: 听力

label: SPECIES_AUDINO.description
source:
Its auditory sense is astounding.
Using the feelers on its ears, it can tell
how someone is feeling or when an egg
might hatch.
translation: 用耳朵上的触角碰到对方的话，\n就能通过心跳声了解\n对方的身体状况和情绪。

label: SPECIES_AUDINO_MEGA.categoryName
source: Hearing
translation: 听力

label: SPECIES_AUDINO_MEGA.description
source:
Mega Audino emits a soothing pulse from
its body that reduces hostility in others.
Anything that comes into contact with its
second feelers will fall into a deep sleep.
translation: 强力的治愈波动能将任何生物\n的情绪稳定下来。无论是谁碰触\n到它胸口的第二触角，都会陷入沉睡。

label: SPECIES_TIMBURR.speciesName
source: TIMBURR
translation: 搬运小匠

label: SPECIES_TIMBURR.categoryName
source: Muscular
translation: 筋骨

label: SPECIES_TIMBURR.description
source:
These Pokémon appear at building
sites and help out with construction.
They always carry squared logs.
As they grow, they carry bigger logs.
translation: 经常拿着方材走，\n帮忙做土木工程。\n长大后会换大的方材拿。

label: SPECIES_GURDURR.speciesName
source: GURDURR
translation: 铁骨土人

label: SPECIES_GURDURR.categoryName
source: Muscular
translation: 筋骨

label: SPECIES_GURDURR.description
source:
They strengthen their bodies by carrying
steel beams. This Pokémon is so muscular
and strongly built that even a group of
wrestlers could not make it budge an inch.
translation: 身体经过锻炼充满了肌肉，\n即使是职业摔角手一拥而上进行攻击，\n也是纹丝不动。

label: SPECIES_CONKELDURR.speciesName
source: CONKELDURR
translation: 修建老匠

label: SPECIES_CONKELDURR.categoryName
source: Muscular
translation: 筋骨

label: SPECIES_CONKELDURR.description
source:
They use concrete pillars as walking
canes. Rather than rely solely on force,
they master moves that utilize the
centrifugal force of spinning concrete.
translation: 制作混凝土的技术，\n被认为是2000年前\n从修建老匠那儿学来的。

label: SPECIES_TYMPOLE.speciesName
source: TYMPOLE
translation: 圆蝌蚪

label: SPECIES_TYMPOLE.categoryName
source: Tadpole
translation: 蝌蚪

label: SPECIES_TYMPOLE.description
source:
By vibrating its cheeks, it emits sound
waves imperceptible to humans. It uses
the rhythm of these sounds to talk and
warns others of danger.
translation: 振动脸颊发出人类无法听见的音波。\n通过音波的节奏对话。

label: SPECIES_PALPITOAD.speciesName
source: PALPITOAD
translation: 蓝蟾蜍

label: SPECIES_PALPITOAD.categoryName
source: Vibration
translation: 震动

label: SPECIES_PALPITOAD.description
source:
It lives in the water and on land.
When they vibrate the bumps on their
heads, they can make waves in water
or earthquake-like vibrations on land.
translation: 生活在水中和陆地。\n使用黏糊糊的长舌头封锁对手的行动。

label: SPECIES_SEISMITOAD.speciesName
source: SEISMITOAD
translation: 蟾蜍王

label: SPECIES_SEISMITOAD.categoryName
source: Vibration
translation: 震动

label: SPECIES_SEISMITOAD.description
source:
It increases the power of its punches
by vibrating the bumps on its fists.
They can also shoot paralyzing liquid
from their head bumps.
translation: 从头上的瘤里喷出令神经麻痹的液体。\n通过震动折磨对手。

label: SPECIES_THROH.speciesName
source: THROH
translation: 投摔鬼

label: SPECIES_THROH.categoryName
source: Judo
translation: 柔道

label: SPECIES_THROH.description
source:
When it tightens its belt, it becomes
stronger. Wild Throh use vines to weave
their own belts. It changes belts as it
gets more powerful.
translation: 如果遇到比自己大的对手，\n就忍不住极度想要投摔。\n变强后就会替换带子。

label: SPECIES_SAWK.speciesName
source: SAWK
translation: 打击鬼

label: SPECIES_SAWK.categoryName
source: Karate
translation: 空手道

label: SPECIES_SAWK.description
source:
The sound of Sawk punching boulders
and trees can be heard all the way from
the mountains where they train.
Disturbing their training angers them.
translation: 系紧带子后会很振奋，\n拳击的破坏力得到提升。\n如果打扰它修行就会发怒。

label: SPECIES_SEWADDLE.speciesName
source: SEWADDLE
translation: 虫宝包

label: SPECIES_SEWADDLE.categoryName
source: Sewing
translation: 裁缝

label: SPECIES_SEWADDLE.description
source:
It chews up leaves and sews them with
sticky thread extruded from its mouth.
Since this Pokémon makes its own clothes,
it is a mascot for fashion designers.
translation: 因为会用叶子做衣服，\n所以作为吉祥物而受到\n时尚设计师的喜爱。

label: SPECIES_SWADLOON.speciesName
source: SWADLOON
translation: 宝包茧

label: SPECIES_SWADLOON.categoryName
source: Leaf-Wrapped
translation: 足不出叶

label: SPECIES_SWADLOON.description
source:
Forests where Swadloon live have
superb foliage because the nutrients
they make from fallen leaves nourish
the plant life.
translation: 用叶子包裹着身体抵御寒冷。\n一边吃着手边的落叶，\n一边在森林里移动。

label: SPECIES_LEAVANNY.speciesName
source: LEAVANNY
translation: 保姆虫

label: SPECIES_LEAVANNY.categoryName
source: Nurturing
translation: 育儿

label: SPECIES_LEAVANNY.description
source:
It keeps its eggs warm with heat from
fermenting leaves. It also uses leaves to
weave warm wrappings for Sewaddle by
using the silk secreted from its mouth.
translation: 利用落叶发酵的热量温暖蛋。\n用叶子给虫宝包制作襁褓。

label: SPECIES_VENIPEDE.speciesName
source: VENIPEDE
translation: 百足蜈蚣

label: SPECIES_VENIPEDE.categoryName
source: Centipede
translation: 蜈蚣

label: SPECIES_VENIPEDE.description
source:
Using the feelers on its head and tail,
it picks up vibrations in the air to
determine its prey's location and state.
It is brutally aggressive.
translation: 会咬住对手施以剧毒。\n就连它的天敌大型鸟宝可梦\n也会身体麻痹，动弹不得。

label: SPECIES_WHIRLIPEDE.speciesName
source: WHIRLIPEDE
translation: 车轮球

label: SPECIES_WHIRLIPEDE.categoryName
source: Curlipede
translation: 茧蜈蚣

label: SPECIES_WHIRLIPEDE.description
source:
Storing energy for evolution, it sits.
But when attacked, it spins its body at
high speed like a wheel and then
crashes furiously into its opponent.
translation: 平时一动不动，\n可一旦受袭就会高速旋转奔跑，\n并用撞击来反击。

label: SPECIES_SCOLIPEDE.speciesName
source: SCOLIPEDE
translation: 蜈蚣王

label: SPECIES_SCOLIPEDE.categoryName
source: Megapede
translation: 巨蜈蚣

label: SPECIES_SCOLIPEDE.description
source:
With quick movements, it chases down
its foes, attacking relentlessly with its
horns until it prevails. Then it finishes
them off with deadly poison.
translation: 以敏捷的动作穷追敌人，\n用头上的角进行攻击。\n在敌人毙命前绝不罢手。

label: SPECIES_SCOLIPEDE_MEGA.categoryName
source: Megapede
translation: 巨蜈蚣

label: SPECIES_SCOLIPEDE_MEGA.description
source: Its deadly venom gives off a faint\nglow. The venom affects Scolipede's\nmind, honing its viciousness.
translation: 闪烁暗淡光芒的剧毒会\n作用于蜈蚣王的精神，\n让它变得更加凶暴。

label: SPECIES_COTTONEE.speciesName
source: COTTONEE
translation: 木棉球

label: SPECIES_COTTONEE.categoryName
source: Cotton Puff
translation: 棉球

label: SPECIES_COTTONEE.description
source:
When it finds others of its kind, they all
stick together. When enough of them
have collected, the mass resembles a
cumulonimbus cloud.
translation: 一旦被袭击就会从体内喷出棉花。\n趁着敌人把棉花错认为\n木棉球时逃之夭夭。

label: SPECIES_WHIMSICOTT.speciesName
source: WHIMSICOTT
translation: 风妖精

label: SPECIES_WHIMSICOTT.categoryName
source: Windveiled
translation: 风隐

label: SPECIES_WHIMSICOTT.description
source:
It rides on the wind and slips into
people's homes. After it has turned a
room into a cotton-filled mess, it giggles
to itself and takes off.
translation: 像风一样无孔不入，\n无论多细小的缝隙都能穿过。\n会留下白色的毛球。

label: SPECIES_PETILIL.speciesName
source: PETILIL
translation: 百合根娃娃

label: SPECIES_PETILIL.categoryName
source: Bulb
translation: 根茎

label: SPECIES_PETILIL.description
source:
By pruning the leaves on its head with
regularity, this Pokémon can be grown
into a fine plump shape. These bitter
leaves refresh those who eat them.
translation: 因为非常喜欢水分和营养充足的土壤，\n所以百合根娃娃居住的土地，\n作物生长旺盛。

label: SPECIES_LILLIGANT.speciesName
source: LILLIGANT
translation: 裙儿小姐

label: SPECIES_LILLIGANT.categoryName
source: Flowering
translation: 花饰

label: SPECIES_LILLIGANT.description
source:
Even veteran Trainers face a challenge
in getting its beautiful flower to bloom.
It withers away if a trainer does not
take good care of it.
translation: 即便是资深训练家，\n要让它开出美丽的花也很难。\n是很受名流喜爱的宝可梦。

label: SPECIES_LILLIGANT_HISUI.description
source:
Its well-developed legs are the result of
a life spent on mountains covered in deep
snow. The scent it exudes from its flower
crown heartens those in proximity.
translation: 据考察，雪山深处的栖息环境为其\n带来了发达的脚力。会从头冠般的\n花中发出鼓舞周围伙伴的香气。

label: SPECIES_BASCULIN_RED_STRIPED.speciesName
source: BASCULIN
translation: 野蛮鲈鱼

label: SPECIES_BASCULIN_RED_STRIPED.categoryName
source: Hostile
translation: 粗暴

label: SPECIES_BASCULIN_RED_STRIPED.description
source:
It used to be a common food source. The
meat of red Basculin is on the fatty side
and it's more popular with the youth.
Its temperament is vicious and aggressive.
translation: 性情凶恶，甚至被称为河里的\n小混混，其实它是吃吼霸和\n下石鸟等的袭击目标。

label: SPECIES_BASCULIN_BLUE_STRIPED.speciesName
source: BASCULIN
translation: 野蛮鲈鱼

label: SPECIES_BASCULIN_BLUE_STRIPED.categoryName
source: Hostile
translation: 粗暴

label: SPECIES_BASCULIN_BLUE_STRIPED.description
source:
They form schools with others of the same
color. The greatest foe of a school of blue
Basculin is a school of red Basculin.
Its flavor is light and inoffensive.
translation: 颚部的力道强大无比，\n连铁板都能留下齿痕。\n性格也是非常地凶猛。

label: SPECIES_BASCULIN_WHITE_STRIPED.speciesName
source: BASCULIN
translation: 野蛮鲈鱼

label: SPECIES_BASCULIN_WHITE_STRIPED.categoryName
source: Mellow
translation: 温厚

label: SPECIES_BASCULIN_WHITE_STRIPED.description
source:
While this ancient form of Basculin shares
a vast array of qualities with other forms,
it differs in several respects, including
demeanor, being much gentler than others.
translation: 与野蛮鲈鱼的生态相差甚远，\n因此它们是不同种类的\n说法在近年以来备受支持。

label: SPECIES_BASCULEGION_M.speciesName
source: BASCULEGION
translation: 幽尾玄鱼

label: SPECIES_BASCULEGION_M.categoryName
source: Big Fish
translation: 大鱼

label: SPECIES_BASCULEGION_M.description
source:
Clads itself in the souls of comrades that
perished before fulfilling their goals of
journeying upstream. No other species in
all Hisui's rivers is Basculegion's equal.
translation: 拥有惊人的弹跳力。\n死去的伙伴的怒火染红了它的身体。

label: SPECIES_BASCULEGION_F.speciesName
source: BASCULEGION
translation: 幽尾玄鱼

label: SPECIES_BASCULEGION_F.categoryName
source: Big Fish
translation: 大鱼

label: SPECIES_BASCULEGION_F.description
source: The souls of its comrades cloak its\nbody and propel it effortlessly\nthrough even raging rapids.
translation: 能操控恐怖的幻觉。\n伙伴的灵魂的悲痛越深，\n它的身体就会变得越白。

label: SPECIES_SANDILE.speciesName
source: SANDILE
translation: 黑眼鳄

label: SPECIES_SANDILE.categoryName
source: Desert Croc
translation: 沙漠鳄鱼

label: SPECIES_SANDILE.description
source:
It conceals itself in the sand and
chomps down on the legs of any prey
that unwarily walk over it. Its favorite
food is Trapinch.
translation: 在沙漠的沙子里生活。\n被太阳烘得暖暖的沙子\n会防止体温降低。

label: SPECIES_KROKOROK.speciesName
source: KROKOROK
translation: 混混鳄

label: SPECIES_KROKOROK.categoryName
source: Desert Croc
translation: 沙漠鳄鱼

label: SPECIES_KROKOROK.description
source:
They move in groups of a few individuals.
Thanks to the special membrane covering
its eyes, it can see its surroundings
clearly, even in the dead of night.
translation: 覆盖着眼球的特殊膜\n可以感知物体的热度，\n因此即便在黑暗中也能看见周围。

label: SPECIES_KROOKODILE.speciesName
source: KROOKODILE
translation: 流氓鳄

label: SPECIES_KROOKODILE.categoryName
source: Intimidate
translation: 威吓

label: SPECIES_KROOKODILE.description
source:
Very violent Pokémon, they never allow
their prey to escape. Their jaws are so
powerful, they can crush the body of
an automobile.
translation: 遇见它的猎物无处可逃。\n拥有可以咬烂汽车车身的强力颚部。

label: SPECIES_DARUMAKA.speciesName
source: DARUMAKA
translation: 火红不倒翁

label: SPECIES_DARUMAKA.categoryName
source: Zen Charm
translation: 不倒翁

label: SPECIES_DARUMAKA.description
source:
When its internal fire is burning, it
cannot calm down and it runs around.
When the fire diminishes, it pulls its
limbs into its body and falls asleep.
translation: 在它睡觉的时候，\n无论是推是拉，它都不会倒下。\n因为象征着吉利而大受欢迎。

label: SPECIES_DARMANITAN_STANDARD.speciesName
source: DARMANITAN
translation: 达摩狒狒

label: SPECIES_DARMANITAN_STANDARD.categoryName
source: Blazing
translation: 爆燃

label: SPECIES_DARMANITAN_STANDARD.description
source:
When one is injured in a fierce battle,
it transforms into a stone statue.
Then it meditates and sharpens its
mind and fights on mentally.
translation: 通过在体内燃起1400度的火焰，\n可以制造出足以赤手空拳\n破坏翻斗车的力量。

label: SPECIES_DARMANITAN_ZEN.speciesName
source: DARMANITAN
translation: 达摩狒狒

label: SPECIES_DARMANITAN_ZEN.categoryName
source: Blazing
translation: 不倒翁

label: SPECIES_DARMANITAN_ZEN.description
source: When wounded, it stops moving. It\ngoes as still as stone to meditate,\nsharpening its mind and spirit.
translation: 受伤之后会像岩石一样动也不动。\n那其实是它在用沉思来磨练内心。

label: SPECIES_DARUMAKA_GALAR.description
source:
The colder they get, the more
energetic they are. They freeze their
breath to make snowballs, using them
as ammo for playful snowball fights.
