translation: 由于居住在积雪深厚的地域，\n火囊也因受到冷却而退化了。\n取而代之的是制造冷气的器官。

label: SPECIES_DARMANITAN_GALAR_STANDARD.description
source:
On days when blizzards blow
through, it comes down to where people
live. It stashes food in the snowball on
its head, taking it home for later.
translation: 性格敦厚的大力士。\n会一口气冻住头上的雪球，\n然后用头锤撞击对手。

label: SPECIES_DARMANITAN_GALAR_ZEN.description
source:
Darmanitan takes this form when
enraged. It won't stop spewing flames
until its rage has settled, even if
its body starts to melt.
translation: 达摩狒狒情绪激昂的样子。\n在怒气平息之前，\n即使身体融化也会不断喷出火焰。

label: SPECIES_MARACTUS.speciesName
source: MARACTUS
translation: 沙铃仙人掌

label: SPECIES_MARACTUS.categoryName
source: Cactus
translation: 仙人掌

label: SPECIES_MARACTUS.description
source:
Arid regions are their habitat.
When it moves rhythmically, it makes a
sound similar to maracas, making the
surprised Pokémon flee.
translation: 生活在干燥的土地上。\n如果身体有节奏地动起来，\n就会奏出沙铃那样的声音。

label: SPECIES_DWEBBLE.speciesName
source: DWEBBLE
translation: 石居蟹

label: SPECIES_DWEBBLE.categoryName
source: Rock Inn
translation: 石居

label: SPECIES_DWEBBLE.description
source:
It makes a hole in a stone of a suitable
size. If that rock breaks, the Pokémon
remains agitated until it locates
a replacement.
translation: 如果有大小合适的石头，\n就会从嘴里分泌液体，\n开出一个可以进入的洞。

label: SPECIES_CRUSTLE.speciesName
source: CRUSTLE
translation: 岩殿居蟹

label: SPECIES_CRUSTLE.categoryName
source: Stone Home
translation: 岩居

label: SPECIES_CRUSTLE.description
source:
Competing for territory, Crustle fight
viciously. The one whose boulder is
broken is the loser of the battle and
begins to weaken.
translation: 为了争夺领地，\n岩殿居蟹之间会展开激烈的战斗。\n岩石被破坏的一方就算输。

label: SPECIES_SCRAGGY.speciesName
source: SCRAGGY
translation: 滑滑小子

label: SPECIES_SCRAGGY.categoryName
source: Shedding
translation: 蜕皮

label: SPECIES_SCRAGGY.description
source:
Its skin has a rubbery elasticity, so it
can reduce damage by defensively
pulling its skin up to its neck.
Its skull is massively thick.
translation: 以结实的头盖骨自豪。\n会冷不防给对方一记头锤，\n但自己也会因为重量而站立不稳。

label: SPECIES_SCRAFTY.speciesName
source: SCRAFTY
translation: 头巾混混

label: SPECIES_SCRAFTY.categoryName
source: Hoodlum
translation: 恶党

label: SPECIES_SCRAFTY.description
source:
Groups of them beat up anything that
enters their territory. The one with the
biggest crest is the group leader, and
is the most respected.
translation: 按头上冠的大小来决定团队领袖。\n用脚踢攻击破坏混凝土块。

label: SPECIES_SCRAFTY_MEGA.categoryName
source: Hoodlum
translation: 恶党

label: SPECIES_SCRAFTY_MEGA.description
source:
Mega Evolution has caused Scrafty's
shed skin to turn white, growing
tough and supple. Of course, this
Pokémon is still as feisty as ever.
translation: 在超级进化的影响下，\n皮肤变得又白又硬且有弹性。\n气势当然是十足的。

label: SPECIES_SIGILYPH.speciesName
source: SIGILYPH
translation: 象征鸟

label: SPECIES_SIGILYPH.categoryName
source: Avianoid
translation: 似鸟

label: SPECIES_SIGILYPH.description
source:
The guardians of an ancient city, they
always fly the same route while keeping
watch for invaders. They use their
psychic power to attack enemies.
translation: 古代都市的守护神。\n过去一直以相同路线巡视，\n警戒着入侵者。

label: SPECIES_YAMASK.speciesName
source: YAMASK
translation: 哭哭面具

label: SPECIES_YAMASK.categoryName
source: Spirit
translation: 魂

label: SPECIES_YAMASK.description
source:
These Pokémon arose from the spirits
of people interred in graves in past ages.
Each of them carries a mask that used
to be its face when it was human.
translation: 拿着的面具是哭哭面具\n还是人类时的脸。\n偶尔会注视着面具哭泣。

label: SPECIES_COFAGRIGUS.speciesName
source: COFAGRIGUS
translation: 迭失棺

label: SPECIES_COFAGRIGUS.categoryName
source: Coffin
translation: 棺木

label: SPECIES_COFAGRIGUS.description
source:
Grave robbers who mistake them for
real coffins and get too close end up
trapped inside their bodies. Their bodies
are covered in pure gold.
translation: 会把将它误认为是真正的棺材\n而接近的盗墓贼关在自己体内。

label: SPECIES_YAMASK_GALAR.description
source:
A clay slab with cursed engravings
took possession of a Yamask. The
slab is said to be absorbing the
Yamask's dark power.
translation: 据说它是古代黏土板被带有\n强烈怨念的灵魂吸引后诞生的宝可梦。

label: SPECIES_RUNERIGUS.speciesName
source: RUNERIGUS
translation: 迭失板

label: SPECIES_RUNERIGUS.categoryName
source: Grudge
translation: 怨念

label: SPECIES_RUNERIGUS.description
source: A powerful curse was woven into an ancient\npainting. After absorbing the spirit of\na Yamask, the painting began to move.
translation: 绝对不能触摸它影子般的身体，\n否则它会让你看到印刻\n在它画中的恐怖记忆。

label: SPECIES_TIRTOUGA.speciesName
source: TIRTOUGA
translation: 原盖海龟

label: SPECIES_TIRTOUGA.categoryName
source: Prototurtle
translation: 古代龟

label: SPECIES_TIRTOUGA.description
source:
Reputed to be the ancestor of most
turtle Pokémon, it lived in warm seas
about a hundred million years ago.
It was restored from a fossil.
translation: 由古代的化石复活而来。\n能潜水到1000米的深度。

label: SPECIES_CARRACOSTA.speciesName
source: CARRACOSTA
translation: 肋骨海龟

label: SPECIES_CARRACOSTA.categoryName
source: Prototurtle
translation: 古代龟

label: SPECIES_CARRACOSTA.description
source:
They can live both in the ocean and
on land. Incredible jaw strength enables
them to chew up steel beams and rocks
along with their prey.
translation: 用发达的前肢将对手揍到昏厥，\n然后连壳带骨整个嚼碎。

label: SPECIES_ARCHEN.speciesName
source: ARCHEN
translation: 始祖小鸟

label: SPECIES_ARCHEN.categoryName
source: First Bird
translation: 远古鸟

label: SPECIES_ARCHEN.description
source:
Said to be the ancestor of all bird
Pokémon, Archen itself could not actually
fly but moved by hopping from treetop
to treetop.
translation: 据说是鸟宝可梦的祖先。\n不能飞行，\n好像会在枝条间跳来跳去生活。

label: SPECIES_ARCHEOPS.speciesName
source: ARCHEOPS
translation: 始祖大鸟

label: SPECIES_ARCHEOPS.categoryName
source: First Bird
translation: 远古鸟

label: SPECIES_ARCHEOPS.description
source:
They are intelligent and will cooperate
to catch prey. When one Archeops
had the prey cornered, another would
swoop on it.
translation: 比起飞行，更擅长奔跑。\n以时速40公里飞奔的势头\n朝着天空展翅飞翔。

label: SPECIES_TRUBBISH.speciesName
source: TRUBBISH
translation: 破破袋

label: SPECIES_TRUBBISH.categoryName
source: Trash Bag
translation: 垃圾袋

label: SPECIES_TRUBBISH.description
source:
It gorges on trash until its stomach
is full. Then it belches toxic gas.
An unlucky whiff of this gas will put
a person in the hospital.
translation: 喜欢不卫生的地方。\n如果吸入它像打嗝那样吐出的瓦斯，\n会整整1个星期卧病不起。

label: SPECIES_GARBODOR.speciesName
source: GARBODOR
translation: 灰尘山

label: SPECIES_GARBODOR.categoryName
source: Trash Heap
translation: 垃圾场

label: SPECIES_GARBODOR.description
source:
Beware the poisonous liquid it shoots
from its right arm. If even a little of it
gets on you, you'll experience the full
effects of this unidentified toxin.
translation: 不断吸入垃圾，\n在体内产生出新种类的毒瓦斯和毒液。

label: SPECIES_GARBODOR_GMAX.speciesName
source: GARBODOR
translation: 灰尘山

label: SPECIES_GARBODOR_GMAX.categoryName
source: Trash Heap
translation: 垃圾场

label: SPECIES_GARBODOR_GMAX.description
source:
It sprays toxic gas from its mouth
and fingers. If the gas engulfs you,
the toxins will seep in all the way
down to your bones.
translation: 如果沾到它从嘴和手指\n喷射出来的毒气，\n毒素会蔓延到你的骨髓里。

label: SPECIES_ZORUA.speciesName
source: ZORUA
translation: 索罗亚

label: SPECIES_ZORUA.categoryName
source: Tricky Fox
translation: 恶狐

label: SPECIES_ZORUA.description
source:
To protect themselves from danger, they
hide their true identities by transforming
into people and Pokémon. Apparently, it
often transforms into a silent child.
translation: 会幻化成人类或其他宝可梦。\n通过隐藏自己的本来面貌\n来保护自己不受危险侵害。

label: SPECIES_ZOROARK.speciesName
source: ZOROARK
translation: 索罗亚克

label: SPECIES_ZOROARK.categoryName
source: Illusion Fox
translation: 妖狐

label: SPECIES_ZOROARK.description
source:
Bonds between these Pokémon are very
strong. It protects the safety of its
pack by tricking its opponents. They
defend their lair with illusory scenery.
translation: 拥有一下子迷惑许多人的力量。\n展现出虚幻的景色来保护自己的住所。

label: SPECIES_ZORUA_HISUI.description
source:
Derives power from resentment,
which rises as energy atop its head and
takes on the forms of foes. In this
way, Zorua vents lingering malice.
translation: 死后灵魂在洗翠地区复苏。\n怨恨化为力量，从其头部冉冉飘升。\n会化成对手的样貌去洗刷仇恨。

label: SPECIES_ZOROARK_HISUI.description
source:
Heedless of its own safety,
Zoroark attacks its nemeses with a bitter
energy so intense, it lacerates
Zoroark's own body.
translation: 疯狂舞动白发的姿态如同死神。\n在足以撕裂自身的深刻仇怨驱使下，\n抱定同归于尽之心袭杀仇敌。

label: SPECIES_MINCCINO.speciesName
source: MINCCINO
translation: 泡沫栗鼠

label: SPECIES_MINCCINO.categoryName
source: Chinchilla
translation: 栗鼠

label: SPECIES_MINCCINO.description
source:
These Pokémon prefer a tidy habitat.
They greet one another by rubbing each
other with their tails, which are always
kept well groomed and clean.
translation: 是喜爱干净的宝可梦。\n总是把尾巴当做扫帚，\n来清扫住所的灰尘。

label: SPECIES_CINCCINO.speciesName
source: CINCCINO
translation: 奇诺栗鼠

label: SPECIES_CINCCINO.categoryName
source: Scarf
translation: 围巾

label: SPECIES_CINCCINO.description
source:
Their white fur feels amazing to touch.
Cinccino's body is coated in a special
oil that repels dust and helps it deflect
attacks, such as punches.
translation: 奇诺栗鼠的身上覆盖着特别的油脂，\n可以卸掉拳击等来自对手的攻击。

label: SPECIES_GOTHITA.speciesName
source: GOTHITA
translation: 哥德宝宝

label: SPECIES_GOTHITA.categoryName
source: Fixation
translation: 凝视

label: SPECIES_GOTHITA.description
source:
They intently observe both Trainers and
Pokémon. Apparently, Gothita are looking
at something that only they can see. Their
ribbonlike feelers increase their power.
translation: 目不转睛地观察宝可梦和训练家。\n好像正盯着某样只有\n哥德宝宝才能看见的东西。

label: SPECIES_GOTHORITA.speciesName
source: GOTHORITA
translation: 哥德小童

label: SPECIES_GOTHORITA.categoryName
source: Manipulate
translation: 操纵

label: SPECIES_GOTHORITA.description
source:
Starlight is the source of their power.
They use hypnosis to control people and
Pokémon. Tales of Gothorita leading them
astray are told in every corner.
translation: 世间流传着很多这样的说法，\n它们会在星光闪烁的夜晚，\n操纵睡着的孩子，耍着玩。

label: SPECIES_GOTHITELLE.speciesName
source: GOTHITELLE
translation: 哥德小姐

label: SPECIES_GOTHITELLE.categoryName
source: Astral Body
translation: 天体

label: SPECIES_GOTHITELLE.description
source:
Starry skies thousands of light-years
away are visible in the space distorted by
their intense psychic power. When it learns
its Trainer's life span, it cries in sadness.
translation: 拥有根据星星的分布和动向\n来预知未来的能力。\n训练家的寿命也能看见。

label: SPECIES_SOLOSIS.speciesName
source: SOLOSIS
translation: 单卵细胞球

label: SPECIES_SOLOSIS.categoryName
source: Cell
translation: 细胞

label: SPECIES_SOLOSIS.description
source:
Because their bodies are enveloped
in a special liquid, they are fine in any
environment, no matter how severe. They
can use telepathy to talk with others.
translation: 放出精神力量击退来袭的敌人。\n用心灵感应和伙伴对话。

label: SPECIES_DUOSION.speciesName
source: DUOSION
translation: 双卵细胞球

label: SPECIES_DUOSION.categoryName
source: Mitosis
translation: 分割

label: SPECIES_DUOSION.description
source:
When their brains, now divided in two,
are thinking the same thoughts,
these Pokémon exhibit their maximized
psychic power.
translation: 因为有着一分为二的大脑，\n所以有时会突然采取不同的行动。

label: SPECIES_REUNICLUS.speciesName
source: REUNICLUS
translation: 人造细胞卵

label: SPECIES_REUNICLUS.categoryName
source: Multiplying
translation: 增幅

label: SPECIES_REUNICLUS.description
source:
They use psychic power to control their
arms, which are made of a special liquid.
When Reuniclus shake hands, a network
forms between their brains.
translation: 如果人造细胞卵互相握住手，\n大脑就像通过网络连接一样，\n精神力量得以增强。

label: SPECIES_DUCKLETT.speciesName
source: DUCKLETT
translation: 鸭宝宝

label: SPECIES_DUCKLETT.categoryName
source: Water Bird
translation: 水鸟

label: SPECIES_DUCKLETT.description
source:
These bird Pokémon are excellent divers.
They are better at swimming than flying,
and they happily eat their favorite food,
peat moss, as they dive underwater.
translation: 比起飞行，更擅长游泳。\n会潜入水中，\n开心地吃非常喜欢的水青苔。

label: SPECIES_SWANNA.speciesName
source: SWANNA
translation: 舞天鹅

label: SPECIES_SWANNA.categoryName
source: White Bird
translation: 白鸟

label: SPECIES_SWANNA.description
source:
Despite their elegant appearance, they
can flap their wings strongly and fly for
thousands of miles. The one in the middle
is the leader of the flock.
translation: 随着黎明的来临，\n舞天鹅们开始跳舞。\n在正中间跳的是群体的首领。

label: SPECIES_VANILLITE.speciesName
source: VANILLITE
translation: 迷你冰

label: SPECIES_VANILLITE.categoryName
source: Fresh Snow
translation: 新雪

label: SPECIES_VANILLITE.description
source:
The temperature of their breath is -58ºF.
They create snow crystals and make snow
fall in the areas around them. Vanillite is
treasured by households in warm regions.
translation: 冰柱沐浴了朝阳的能量之后，\n变成了宝可梦。\n会把身体埋在雪里睡觉。

label: SPECIES_VANILLISH.speciesName
source: VANILLISH
translation: 多多冰

label: SPECIES_VANILLISH.categoryName
source: Icy Snow
translation: 冰雪

label: SPECIES_VANILLISH.description
source:
Vanillish has existed since the Ice Age.
It controls particles of ice, freezes its
opponents, and then shatters them with
a headbutt.
translation: 栖息在雪山的宝可梦。\n在遥远过去的冰河时期\n迁移到了南方的土地。

label: SPECIES_VANILLUXE.speciesName
source: VANILLUXE
translation: 双倍多多冰

label: SPECIES_VANILLUXE.categoryName
source: Snowstorm
translation: 暴风雪

label: SPECIES_VANILLUXE.description
source:
Each of its two heads has a brain, and
when they are in agreement, it attacks
its enemies by exhaling a violent blizzard.
It makes snow clouds inside its body.
translation: 喝入大量水后，\n在体内变成雪云。\n如果生气，就会卷起猛烈的暴风雪。

label: SPECIES_DEERLING_SPRING.speciesName
source: DEERLING
translation: 四季鹿

label: SPECIES_DEERLING_SPRING.categoryName
source: Season
translation: 季节

label: SPECIES_DEERLING_SPRING.description
source:
Deerling have different scents
depending on the season. In early
spring, these Pokémon give off a
delicate, sweet, and calming scent.
translation: 虽然外形很可爱，\n却因为喜爱吃草木的新芽\n而被农民们疏远。

label: SPECIES_DEERLING_SUMMER.speciesName
source: DEERLING
translation: 四季鹿

label: SPECIES_DEERLING_SUMMER.categoryName
source: Season
translation: 季节

label: SPECIES_DEERLING_SUMMER.description
source:
To prevent Deerling from entering
their fields, many farmers will have
several Lycanroc stand guard, as
they are its natural enemy.
translation: 随着季节流动，气味也会变化。\n如果它身上散发出了独特的青草味，\n那就代表夏天到了。

label: SPECIES_DEERLING_AUTUMN.speciesName
source: DEERLING
translation: 四季鹿

label: SPECIES_DEERLING_AUTUMN.categoryName
source: Season
translation: 季节

label: SPECIES_DEERLING_AUTUMN.description
source:
Deerling have different scents
depending on the season. In this form,
Deerling have a softly sweet scent
that lingers in the nose.
translation: 随着季节流动，气味也会变化。\n这个样子的四季鹿散发的\n气味柔和香甜，会残留在鼻腔中。

label: SPECIES_DEERLING_WINTER.speciesName
source: DEERLING
translation: 四季鹿

label: SPECIES_DEERLING_WINTER.categoryName
source: Season
translation: 季节

label: SPECIES_DEERLING_WINTER.description
source:
Deerling's scent changes with the
seasons, but when the Pokémon is in
its Winter Form, it has hardly any
scent at all.
translation: 感情变好后会用头锤闹着玩。\n它的角藏在花朵里难以发现，\n被顶到还是会蛮痛的。

label: SPECIES_SAWSBUCK_SPRING.speciesName
source: SAWSBUCK
translation: 萌芽鹿

label: SPECIES_SAWSBUCK_SPRING.categoryName
source: Season
translation: 季节

label: SPECIES_SAWSBUCK_SPRING.description
source:
Some people call Sawsbuck the harbingers
of spring because the plants growing on
its horns change according to the season.
The leader possesses magnificent horns.
translation: 拥有许多爱好者的宝可梦。\n人们认为它角上绽放的淡红色花朵\n颜色越淡就代表越美丽。

label: SPECIES_SAWSBUCK_SUMMER.speciesName
source: SAWSBUCK
translation: 萌芽鹿

label: SPECIES_SAWSBUCK_SUMMER.categoryName
source: Season
translation: 季节

label: SPECIES_SAWSBUCK_SUMMER.description
source:
The thicker and larger the
branches and leaves on its antlers, the
more majestic the Sawsbuck is thought
to be.
translation: 它的叶子能用来做成红茶。\n根据产地会有不同的风味，\n某地区香气浓郁的叶子备受喜爱。

label: SPECIES_SAWSBUCK_AUTUMN.speciesName
source: SAWSBUCK
translation: 萌芽鹿

label: SPECIES_SAWSBUCK_AUTUMN.categoryName
source: Season
translation: 季节

label: SPECIES_SAWSBUCK_AUTUMN.description
source:
Sawsbuck in their Autumn Form are
known for having very short
tempers. The males fight each other
incessantly.
translation: 秋天的样子的萌芽鹿\n以性情凶暴而闻名。\n雄性之间总是打架不断。

label: SPECIES_SAWSBUCK_WINTER.speciesName
source: SAWSBUCK
translation: 萌芽鹿

label: SPECIES_SAWSBUCK_WINTER.categoryName
source: Season
translation: 季节

label: SPECIES_SAWSBUCK_WINTER.description
source:
Though there are many enthusiasts
for Sawsbuck as a species, this
seasonal form in particular is not
very popular.
translation: 这种宝可梦虽然拥有很多爱好者，\n但唯独这个季节的样子\n却没什么人喜欢。

label: SPECIES_EMOLGA.speciesName
source: EMOLGA
translation: 电飞鼠

label: SPECIES_EMOLGA.categoryName
source: Sky Squirrel
translation: 飞鼠

label: SPECIES_EMOLGA.description
source:
It glides using its cape-like membrane.
It grills berries and bug Pokémon with
electric shocks from the pouches on its
cheeks and makes a meal of them.
translation: 将脸颊的电力袋制造出的\n电储藏在膜的内侧，\n一边滑翔一边放电。

label: SPECIES_KARRABLAST.speciesName
source: KARRABLAST
translation: 盖盖虫

label: SPECIES_KARRABLAST.categoryName
source: Clamping
translation: 啃咬

label: SPECIES_KARRABLAST.description
source:
When they feel threatened, they spit an
acidic liquid to drive attackers away.
For some reason they evolve while they
are in the same place as Shelmet.
translation: 袭击小嘴蜗时，\n如果沐浴在电能下，\n不知为何就会进化。

label: SPECIES_ESCAVALIER.speciesName
source: ESCAVALIER
translation: 骑士蜗牛

label: SPECIES_ESCAVALIER.categoryName
source: Cavalry
translation: 骑兵

label: SPECIES_ESCAVALIER.description
source:
Wearing the shell covering they stole
from Shelmet, they defend themselves and
attack with two lances. The steel armor
protects their whole body.
translation: 通过穿上小嘴蜗的壳\n进化而成的宝可梦。\n钢铁的铠甲保护着它的全身。

label: SPECIES_FOONGUS.speciesName
source: FOONGUS
translation: 哎呀球菇

label: SPECIES_FOONGUS.categoryName
source: Mushroom
translation: 蘑菇

label: SPECIES_FOONGUS.description
source:
It lures Pokémon in with its pattern that
looks just like a Poké Ball, then releases
its poison spores. Why it resembles a
Poké Ball is unknown.
translation: 以精灵球一样的花纹引诱宝可梦过来，\n然后向其喷出有毒的孢子。

label: SPECIES_AMOONGUSS.speciesName
source: AMOONGUSS
translation: 败露球菇

label: SPECIES_AMOONGUSS.categoryName
source: Mushroom
translation: 蘑菇

label: SPECIES_AMOONGUSS.description
source:
It lures prey close by dancing and waving
its arm caps, which resemble Poké Balls,
in a swaying motion, but very few Pokémon
are fooled by this.
translation: 摇晃着双臂酷似精灵球的菌伞，\n跳起引诱猎物的舞蹈。

label: SPECIES_FRILLISH.speciesName
source: FRILLISH
translation: 轻飘飘

label: SPECIES_FRILLISH.categoryName
source: Floating
translation: 漂浮

label: SPECIES_FRILLISH.description
source:
If its veil-like arms stun and wrap an
opponent, that foe will be dragged
five miles below the surface to its lair,
never to return.
translation: 用薄纱般的手脚缠绕对手，\n使其麻痹后，\n就会拖到8000米的深海捕杀。

label: SPECIES_JELLICENT.speciesName
source: JELLICENT
translation: 胖嘟嘟

label: SPECIES_JELLICENT.categoryName
source: Floating
translation: 漂浮

label: SPECIES_JELLICENT.description
source:
They propel themselves by expelling
absorbed seawater from their bodies.
It's said there's a castle of ships
Jellicent have sunk on the seafloor.
translation: 误入胖嘟嘟住所的船会沉没，\n船员们的生命也会被吸走。

label: SPECIES_ALOMOMOLA.speciesName
source: ALOMOMOLA
translation: 保姆曼波

label: SPECIES_ALOMOMOLA.categoryName
source: Caring
translation: 看护

label: SPECIES_ALOMOMOLA.description
source:
When they find a wounded Pokémon,
they embrace it and bring it to shore.
The special membrane enveloping
Alomomola has the ability to heal wounds.
translation: 会用鱼鳍温柔地抱住受伤\n的或是虚弱的宝可梦，\n然后用特殊的粘膜治疗。

label: SPECIES_JOLTIK.speciesName
source: JOLTIK
translation: 电电虫

label: SPECIES_JOLTIK.categoryName
source: Attaching
translation: 吸附

label: SPECIES_JOLTIK.description
source:
Since they can't generate their own
electricity, they attach themselves to
large-bodied Pokémon and absorb static
electricity, which they store in a pouch.
translation: 因为自己不能制造电，\n所以会附在其它大型宝可梦\n身上吸取静电。

label: SPECIES_GALVANTULA.speciesName
source: GALVANTULA
translation: 电蜘蛛

label: SPECIES_GALVANTULA.categoryName
source: EleSpider
translation: 电蜘蛛

label: SPECIES_GALVANTULA.description
source:
It creates barriers from electrified silk
that stun foes. This works as a weapon as
well as a defense. While it is immobilized
by shock, they leisurely consume it.
translation: 被敌人袭击的话，\n会吐出大量带电的丝，\n制作成电的屏障。

label: SPECIES_FERROSEED.speciesName
source: FERROSEED
translation: 种子铁球

label: SPECIES_FERROSEED.categoryName
source: Thorn Seed
translation: 刺果

label: SPECIES_FERROSEED.description
source:
It absorbs the iron it finds in the rock
while clinging to the ceiling of caves.
When threatened, it attacks by shooting
a barrage of spikes.
translation: 刺入洞顶，\n吸取岩石中的铁质。\n当危险逼近，就会射出尖刺。

label: SPECIES_FERROTHORN.speciesName
source: FERROTHORN
translation: 坚果哑铃

label: SPECIES_FERROTHORN.categoryName
source: Thorn Pod
translation: 刺球

label: SPECIES_FERROTHORN.description
source:
It fights by swinging around its three
spiky feelers and shooting spikes.
A hit from these steel spikes can reduce
a boulder to rubble.
translation: 贴在洞顶上，\n朝下方经过的猎物射出铁刺进行袭击。

label: SPECIES_KLINK.speciesName
source: KLINK
translation: 齿轮儿

label: SPECIES_KLINK.categoryName
source: Gear
translation: 齿轮

label: SPECIES_KLINK.description
source:
Two bodies comprise a fixed pair.
The two minigears that mesh together
are predetermined. Each will rebound from
other minigears without meshing.
translation: 2个身体的组合是定好了的。\n和别的身体不会咬合会分离。

label: SPECIES_KLANG.speciesName
source: KLANG
translation: 齿轮组

label: SPECIES_KLANG.categoryName
source: Gear
translation: 齿轮

label: SPECIES_KLANG.description
source:
A minigear and big gear comprise its
body. Spinning minigears are rotated
at high speed and repeatedly fired away.
It is dangerous if the gears don't return.
translation: 身体分为大齿轮和小齿轮。\n如果攻击时发射出去的\n小齿轮回不来的话，就会死去。

label: SPECIES_KLINKLANG.speciesName
source: KLINKLANG
translation: 齿轮怪

label: SPECIES_KLINKLANG.categoryName
source: Gear
translation: 齿轮

label: SPECIES_KLINKLANG.description
source:
Its red core functions as an energy tank.
It is rotated at high speed for a rapid
energy charge. It fires the charged energy
through its spikes into an area.
translation: 红色核心担当着能量罐的角色。\n填充好的能量会从尖刺射向周围。

label: SPECIES_TYNAMO.speciesName
source: TYNAMO
translation: 麻麻小鱼

label: SPECIES_TYNAMO.categoryName
source: EleFish
translation: 电鱼

label: SPECIES_TYNAMO.description
source:
These Pokémon move in schools.
One alone can emit only a trickle of
electricity, so a group of them gathers
to unleash a powerful electric shock.
translation: 1条的电力虽小，\n但是许多麻麻小鱼聚在一起，\n其威力可以比得上雷电。

label: SPECIES_EELEKTRIK.speciesName
source: EELEKTRIK
translation: 麻麻鳗

label: SPECIES_EELEKTRIK.categoryName
source: EleFish
translation: 电鱼

label: SPECIES_EELEKTRIK.description
source:
These Pokémon have a big appetite.
It wraps itself around its prey and
paralyzes it with electricity from the
round spots on its sides. Then it chomps.
translation: 是食欲旺盛的宝可梦。\n一旦发现猎物就会发动袭击，\n将对方用电麻痹后再吃掉。

label: SPECIES_EELEKTROSS.speciesName
source: EELEKTROSS
translation: 麻麻鳗鱼王

label: SPECIES_EELEKTROSS.categoryName
source: EleFish
translation: 电鱼

label: SPECIES_EELEKTROSS.description
source:
They crawl out of the ocean using their
arms. They will attack prey on shore and
immediately drag it into the ocean, with
their sucker mouths.
translation: 用手臂的力量从海里爬出，\n袭击水边的猎物。\n在一瞬间将对方拖入海中。

label: SPECIES_EELEKTROSS_MEGA.categoryName
source: EleFish
translation: 电鱼

label: SPECIES_EELEKTROSS_MEGA.description
source:
It now generates 10 times the
electricity it did before Mega
Evolving. It discharges this energy
from its false Eelektrik made of mucus.
translation: 发电量是超级进化前的10倍。\n会从由粘液构成的假麻麻鳗\n那里放电。

label: SPECIES_ELGYEM.speciesName
source: ELGYEM
translation: 小灰怪

label: SPECIES_ELGYEM.categoryName
source: Cerebral
translation: 脑

label: SPECIES_ELGYEM.description
source:
It psychically squeezes the brain of
its foe, causing unendurable headaches.
Rumors of its origin are linked to a UFO
crash site in the desert 50 years ago.
translation: 据说它是来自于传闻50年前\n有UFO坠落的沙漠里。

label: SPECIES_BEHEEYEM.speciesName
source: BEHEEYEM
translation: 大宇怪

label: SPECIES_BEHEEYEM.categoryName
source: Cerebral
translation: 脑

label: SPECIES_BEHEEYEM.description
source:
It can manipulate an opponent's memory.
Apparently, it communicates by flashing
its three fingers, but those patterns
haven't been decoded.
translation: 用精神力量操纵对手的大脑，\n并改写其大脑里的记忆影像。

label: SPECIES_LITWICK.speciesName
source: LITWICK
translation: 烛光灵

label: SPECIES_LITWICK.categoryName
source: Candle
translation: 蜡烛

label: SPECIES_LITWICK.description
source:
While Litwick shines a light and pretends
to be a guide, it absorbs the life force of
any who follow it, which becomes the fuel
that it burns.
translation: 假装点亮烛光，\n指引道路，\n实际上是在吸取对方的生命力。

label: SPECIES_LAMPENT.speciesName
source: LAMPENT
translation: 灯火幽灵

label: SPECIES_LAMPENT.categoryName
source: Lamp
translation: 油灯

label: SPECIES_LAMPENT.description
source:
This ominous Pokémon is feared.
Through cities it wanders, searching
for the spirits of the fallen. The spirits
it absorbs fuel its baleful fire.
translation: 吸取灵魂来点亮灯火。\n为了等待人类死去，\n而在医院里彷徨游荡。

label: SPECIES_CHANDELURE.speciesName
source: CHANDELURE
translation: 水晶灯火灵

label: SPECIES_CHANDELURE.categoryName
source: Luring
translation: 引诱

label: SPECIES_CHANDELURE.description
source:
Being consumed in Chandelure's flame burns
up the spirit, leaving the body behind.
By waving the flames on its arms, it puts
its foes into a hypnotic trance.
translation: 被怪异的火焰燃烧过的灵魂无处可去，\n只能永远游荡在这个世界上。

label: SPECIES_CHANDELURE_MEGA.categoryName
source: Luring
translation: 引诱

label: SPECIES_CHANDELURE_MEGA.description
source:
One of its eyes is a window linking
our world with the afterlife.
This Pokémon draws in hatred and
converts it into power.
translation: 两只眼睛中的一只是连接这个世界\n和另一个世界的窗口。\n会吸取怨念并将其化为力量。

label: SPECIES_AXEW.speciesName
source: AXEW
translation: 牙牙

label: SPECIES_AXEW.categoryName
source: Tusk
translation: 牙

label: SPECIES_AXEW.description
source:
They mark their territory by leaving
gashes in trees with their tusks. If a
tusk breaks, a new one grows in quickly,
harder and sturdier than the last.
translation: 用牙齿在树木上留下伤痕，\n作为领地的标记。\n牙齿即使折断也会马上长出来。

label: SPECIES_FRAXURE.speciesName
source: FRAXURE
translation: 斧牙龙

label: SPECIES_FRAXURE.categoryName
source: Axe Jaw
translation: 颚斧

label: SPECIES_FRAXURE.description
source:
Their tusks can shatter rocks.
A broken tusk will not grow back,
so it diligently sharpens its tusks on
river rocks after the end of a battle.
translation: 牙齿不会再次生长，\n因此战斗结束后就会使用\n河滩的岩石仔细地磨牙。

label: SPECIES_HAXORUS.speciesName
source: HAXORUS
translation: 双斧战龙

label: SPECIES_HAXORUS.categoryName
source: Axe Jaw
translation: 颚斧

label: SPECIES_HAXORUS.description
source:
They are kind but can be relentless
when defending territory. Their sturdy
tusks will stay sharp even if used to cut
steel beams.
translation: 有着即使切斩工字钢\n也不会伤刃的坚固牙齿。\n全身被坚硬的铠甲覆盖着。

label: SPECIES_CUBCHOO.speciesName
source: CUBCHOO
translation: 喷嚏熊

label: SPECIES_CUBCHOO.categoryName
source: Chill
translation: 结冰

label: SPECIES_CUBCHOO.description
source:
Its nose is always running.
Their snot is a barometer of health.
When healthy, their snot is sticky and
the power of their ice moves increases.
translation: 鼻涕是健康的晴雨表。\n身体状况好，粘性就变强，\n冰的招式威力也会增强。

label: SPECIES_BEARTIC.speciesName
source: BEARTIC
translation: 冻原熊

label: SPECIES_BEARTIC.categoryName
source: Freezing
translation: 冻结

label: SPECIES_BEARTIC.description
source:
It freezes its breath to create fangs
and claws of ice to fight with.
Very able in the water, it swims around
in northern seas and catches prey.
translation: 让吐出的气息冻结，\n制造冰牙和冰爪进行战斗。\n生活在北方的寒冷土地上。

label: SPECIES_CRYOGONAL.speciesName
source: CRYOGONAL
translation: 几何雪花

label: SPECIES_CRYOGONAL.categoryName
source: Crystallize
translation: 结晶

label: SPECIES_CRYOGONAL.description
source:
They are born in snow clouds. When
its body temperature goes up, it turns
into steam and vanishes. When its
temperature lowers, it returns to ice.
translation: 使用冰的结晶所形成的锁绑住猎物，\n使其冻结到零下100度。

label: SPECIES_SHELMET.speciesName
source: SHELMET
translation: 小嘴蜗

label: SPECIES_SHELMET.categoryName
source: Snail
translation: 蜗牛

label: SPECIES_SHELMET.description
source:
When attacked, it defends itself by
closing the lid of its shell. It evolves
when bathed in an electric-like energy
along with Karrablast.
translation: 如果与盖盖虫一起沐浴在电能下，\n就会进化。\n其原因尚且不明。

label: SPECIES_ACCELGOR.speciesName
source: ACCELGOR
translation: 敏捷虫

label: SPECIES_ACCELGOR.categoryName
source: Shell Out
translation: 脱壳

label: SPECIES_ACCELGOR.description
source:
When its body dries out, it weakens. So, to
prevent dehydration, it wraps itself in
layers of thin membrane. It is very light
and fights with ninja-like movements.
translation: 身体干燥的话就会变弱。\n身上卷着一层又一层的薄膜，\n用来防止干燥。

label: SPECIES_STUNFISK.speciesName
source: STUNFISK
translation: 泥巴鱼

label: SPECIES_STUNFISK.categoryName
source: Trap
translation: 陷阱

label: SPECIES_STUNFISK.description
source:
It conceals itself in the mud of the
seashore. Then it waits. When prey touch
it, it delivers a jolt of electricity.
It smiles when transmitting electricity.
translation: 会埋进海边的泥里等待猎物。\n猎物一旦碰到，\n就会放出电来使其麻痹。

label: SPECIES_STUNFISK_GALAR.description
source:
Its conspicuous lips lure prey in
as it lies in wait in the mud. When
prey gets close, Stunfisk clamps its
jagged steel fins down on them.
translation: 会藏在泥巴里，\n用显眼的嘴唇吸引猎物接近自己，\n接着用锯齿般的钢鳍紧紧将对手夹住。

label: SPECIES_MIENFOO.speciesName
source: MIENFOO
translation: 功夫鼬

label: SPECIES_MIENFOO.categoryName
source: Martial Arts
translation: 武术

label: SPECIES_MIENFOO.description
source:
They have mastered elegant combos.
As they concentrate, their battle moves
become swifter and more precise. What it
lacks in power, it makes up for in quantity.
translation: 使出行云流水般的连续攻击压倒敌人。\n用锋利的爪子将敌人撕裂。

label: SPECIES_MIENSHAO.speciesName
source: MIENSHAO
translation: 师父鼬

label: SPECIES_MIENSHAO.categoryName
source: Martial Arts
translation: 武术

label: SPECIES_MIENSHAO.description
source:
They use the long fur on their arms as
a whip to strike their opponents. Its arm
attacks come with such rapidity that they
cannot even be seen.
translation: 双臂上的体毛使用得像鞭子一样熟练。\n一旦开始连续攻击，\n谁也无法阻止。

label: SPECIES_DRUDDIGON.speciesName
source: DRUDDIGON
translation: 赤面龙

label: SPECIES_DRUDDIGON.categoryName
source: Cave
translation: 洞穴

label: SPECIES_DRUDDIGON.description
source:
It warms its body by absorbing sunlight
with its wings. When its body temperature
falls, it can no longer move. It uses its
sharp claws to catch prey.
translation: 用翅膀接收阳光，\n温暖身体。\n如果体温下降就会变得无法动弹。

label: SPECIES_GOLETT.speciesName
source: GOLETT
translation: 泥偶小人

label: SPECIES_GOLETT.categoryName
source: Automaton
translation: 魔像

label: SPECIES_GOLETT.description
source:
These Pokémon are thought to have
been created by the science of an
ancient and mysterious civilization.
It's been active for thousands of years.
translation: 根据古代的科学力量\n由黏土制成的宝可梦。\n能持续活动数千年。

label: SPECIES_GOLURK.speciesName
source: GOLURK
translation: 泥偶巨人

label: SPECIES_GOLURK.categoryName
source: Automaton
translation: 魔像

label: SPECIES_GOLURK.description
source:
Golurk were created to protect people
and Pokémon by an ancient civilisation.
Removing the seal on its chest makes its
internal energy go out of control.
translation: 以音速在天空飞行。\n如果解开胸口的封印，\n能量就会失控。

label: SPECIES_GOLURK_MEGA.categoryName
source: Automaton
translation: 魔像

label: SPECIES_GOLURK_MEGA.description
source: The energy within Golurk has been\nstimulated by Mega Evolution.\nThe Pokémon could explode at any moment.
translation: 体内的能量因为超级进化\n而活性化，不论何时爆炸\n都不奇怪。

label: SPECIES_PAWNIARD.speciesName
source: PAWNIARD
translation: 驹刀小兵

label: SPECIES_PAWNIARD.categoryName
source: Sharp Blade
translation: 利器

label: SPECIES_PAWNIARD.description
source:
Ignoring their injuries, groups attack by
sinking the blades that cover their bodies
into their prey. If battling dulls them, it
sharpens them on stones by the river.
translation: 即使自己受伤也毫不在意，\n整个群体一起将全身的刀\n刺入对手进行攻击。

label: SPECIES_BISHARP.speciesName
source: BISHARP
translation: 劈斩司令

label: SPECIES_BISHARP.categoryName
source: Sword Blade
translation: 刀刃

label: SPECIES_BISHARP.description
source:
This pitiless Pokémon commands a group
of Pawniard to hound prey into immobility.
It battles to become the boss, but will be
driven from the group if it loses.
translation: 率领一大群驹刀小兵，\n成群地穷追猎物。\n劈斩司令会给予致命一击。

label: SPECIES_KINGAMBIT.speciesName
source: KINGAMBIT
translation: 仆刀将军

label: SPECIES_KINGAMBIT.categoryName
source: Big Blade
translation: 大刀

label: SPECIES_KINGAMBIT.description
source:
Though it commands a massive army
in battle, it's not skilled at
devising complex strategies. It just uses
brute strength to keep pushing.
translation: 会引领大军来战斗，\n却不擅长困难的战术，\n只会用蛮力来压制对手。

label: SPECIES_BOUFFALANT.speciesName
source: BOUFFALANT
translation: 爆炸头水牛

label: SPECIES_BOUFFALANT.categoryName
source: Bash Buffalo
translation: 头锤牛

label: SPECIES_BOUFFALANT.description
source:
Their fluffy fur absorbs damage, even
if they strike foes with a fierce headbutt.
Their headbutts have enough destructive
force to derail a train.
translation: 即使使出猛烈的头锤，\n蓬松的体毛也会将伤害都吸收掉。

label: SPECIES_RUFFLET.speciesName
source: RUFFLET
translation: 毛头小鹰

label: SPECIES_RUFFLET.categoryName
source: Eaglet
translation: 雏鹰

label: SPECIES_RUFFLET.description
source:
With its sharp claws, this Pokémon pierces
its prey, and then it pecks at them.
Although it also consumes berries, it's a
carnivore at heart.
translation: 面对强劲的对手也\n会不由分说地挑起战斗。\n通过反复战斗变得更强。

label: SPECIES_BRAVIARY.speciesName
source: BRAVIARY
translation: 勇士雄鹰

label: SPECIES_BRAVIARY.categoryName
source: Valiant
translation: 勇猛

label: SPECIES_BRAVIARY.description
source:
For the sake of its friends, this brave
warrior of the sky will not stop battling,
even if it is injured. One can carry a car
while flying.
translation: 为了伙伴的话，\n无论受多重的伤都不会放弃战斗，\n是勇敢的天空战士。

label: SPECIES_BRAVIARY_HISUI.description
source: Screaming a bloodcurdling battle\ncry, this huge and ferocious bird\nPokémon goes out on the hunt.
translation: 勇猛的大鸟。狩猎时会发出气势\n骇人的战吼，朝湖水发出冲击波，\n捕捉浮出水面的猎物。

label: SPECIES_VULLABY.speciesName
source: VULLABY
translation: 秃鹰丫头

label: SPECIES_VULLABY.categoryName
source: Diapered
translation: 尿布

label: SPECIES_VULLABY.description
source:
It can't fly yet and must wait until its
wings have developed more. They guard
their posteriors with bones that were
gathered by Mandibuzz.
translation: 翅膀很小，\n还不能飞。\n用秃鹰娜收集来的骸骨保护着臀部。

label: SPECIES_MANDIBUZZ.speciesName
source: MANDIBUZZ
translation: 秃鹰娜

label: SPECIES_MANDIBUZZ.categoryName
source: Bone Vulture
translation: 骨鹰

label: SPECIES_MANDIBUZZ.description
source:
They adorn themselves beautifully with
bones. This is supposedly an effort to
attract males, but no male Mandibuzz
have ever been found.
translation: 从空中观察地面情况，\n袭击弱小的猎物。\n有用骨头做装饰的习性。

label: SPECIES_HEATMOR.speciesName
source: HEATMOR
translation: 熔蚁兽

label: SPECIES_HEATMOR.categoryName
source: Anteater
translation: 食蚁兽

label: SPECIES_HEATMOR.description
source:
It draws in air through its tail,
transforms it into fire, and uses it like
a tongue. They burn through Durant's steel
bodies and consume their insides.
translation: 把从尾部吸入的空气变成火焰，\n像舌头一样使用，\n熔化铁蚁后吃掉。

label: SPECIES_DURANT.speciesName
source: DURANT
translation: 铁蚁

label: SPECIES_DURANT.categoryName
source: Iron Ant
translation: 铁蚁

label: SPECIES_DURANT.description
source:
Durant dig nests in mountains.
Individuals each play different roles in
driving Heatmor, their natural predator,
away from their colony.
translation: 身上裹着钢铁的铠甲。\n以群体之力防御并反击\n天敌熔蚁兽的攻击。

label: SPECIES_DEINO.speciesName
source: DEINO
translation: 单首龙

label: SPECIES_DEINO.categoryName
source: Irate
translation: 粗鲁

label: SPECIES_DEINO.description
source:
Lacking sight, it's unaware of its
surroundings, so it bumps into things and
eats anything that moves. Approaching
it carelessly is dangerous.
translation: 因为不了解周围的情形，\n所以会不断地到处乱撞，\n撞到活物时就咬住吃。

label: SPECIES_ZWEILOUS.speciesName
source: ZWEILOUS
translation: 双首暴龙

label: SPECIES_ZWEILOUS.categoryName
source: Hostile
translation: 粗暴

label: SPECIES_ZWEILOUS.description
source:
After it has eaten up all the food in its
territory, it moves on to another area.
Whichever head eats more than the other
gets to be the leader.
translation: 如果吃光了领地内的食物，\n就会向其他土地移动。\n2个头之间关系恶劣。

label: SPECIES_HYDREIGON.speciesName
source: HYDREIGON
translation: 三首恶龙

label: SPECIES_HYDREIGON.categoryName
source: Brutal
translation: 凶暴

label: SPECIES_HYDREIGON.description
source:
This brutal Pokémon travels the skies on
its six wings. The heads on their arms do
not have brains. They use all three heads
to consume and destroy everything.
translation: 对活动物体发生反应并展开袭击，\n用3个头吃光一切的恐怖宝可梦。

label: SPECIES_LARVESTA.speciesName
source: LARVESTA
translation: 燃烧虫

label: SPECIES_LARVESTA.categoryName
source: Torch
translation: 火炬

label: SPECIES_LARVESTA.description
source:
This Pokémon was believed to have
been born from the sun. It spews fire from
its horns and encases itself in a cocoon
of fire when it evolves.
translation: 栖息在火山脚下。\n从5只角喷出火焰，\n击退来袭的敌人。

label: SPECIES_VOLCARONA.speciesName
source: VOLCARONA
translation: 火神蛾

label: SPECIES_VOLCARONA.categoryName
source: Sun
translation: 太阳

label: SPECIES_VOLCARONA.description
source:
When volcanic ash darkened the
atmosphere, it appeared and saved Pokémon
from freezing, Volcarona's fire provided a
replacement for the sun.
translation: 据说，\n当地面因火山灰而变得一片漆黑时，\n火神蛾的火焰就会代替太阳的作用。

label: SPECIES_COBALION.speciesName
source: COBALION
translation: 勾帕路翁

label: SPECIES_COBALION.categoryName
source: Iron Will
translation: 铁心

label: SPECIES_COBALION.description
source:
It has a body and heart of steel. This
legendary Pokémon battled against humans
to protect Pokémon. Its personality
is calm and composed.
translation: 拥有钢铁的心灵和身体。\n当人类伤害到宝可梦时，\n就会和伙伴一起惩戒人类。

label: SPECIES_TERRAKION.speciesName
source: TERRAKION
translation: 代拉基翁

label: SPECIES_TERRAKION.categoryName
source: Cavern
translation: 岩窟

label: SPECIES_TERRAKION.description
source:
Spoken of in legend, this Pokémon used
its phenomenal power to destroy a castle
in its effort to protect Pokémon that had
lost their homes in a war among humans.
translation: 是传说中所描述的宝可梦。\n为了保护宝可梦，\n会用引以为豪的力量破坏城堡。

label: SPECIES_VIRIZION.speciesName
source: VIRIZION
translation: 毕力吉翁

label: SPECIES_VIRIZION.categoryName
source: Grassland
translation: 草原

label: SPECIES_VIRIZION.description
source:
Its head sprouts horns as sharp as blades.
Legends say this Pokémon used
whirlwind-like movements to confound
and swiftly cut its opponents.
translation: 传说中，\n以敏捷的身手戏弄对手，\n保护宝可梦。

label: SPECIES_TORNADUS_INCARNATE.speciesName
source: TORNADUS
translation: 龙卷云

label: SPECIES_TORNADUS_INCARNATE.categoryName
source: Cyclone
translation: 旋风

label: SPECIES_TORNADUS_INCARNATE.description
source:
Tornadus expels massive energy from
its tail, causing severe storms.
Its power can blow entire houses away.
It zooms through the sky at 200 mph.
translation: 从龙卷云的尾部喷出的能量\n会引起猛烈的暴风雨。\n有着吹飞民宅的力量。

label: SPECIES_TORNADUS_THERIAN.speciesName
source: TORNADUS
translation: 龙卷云

label: SPECIES_TORNADUS_THERIAN.categoryName
source: Cyclone
translation: 旋风

label: SPECIES_TORNADUS_THERIAN.description
source:
An example of what is known as a
“form change”. Tornadus has been
sighted crossing the ocean while in this
form.
translation: 此乃被称为形态变化的现象。据考察，\n此一形同怪鸟的姿态才是其真正样貌。\n曾被目击以此姿态横越大海。

label: SPECIES_THUNDURUS_INCARNATE.speciesName
source: THUNDURUS
translation: 雷电云

label: SPECIES_THUNDURUS_INCARNATE.categoryName
source: Bolt Strike
translation: 雷击

label: SPECIES_THUNDURUS_INCARNATE.description
source:
The spikes on its tail discharge immense
bolts of lightning. Countless charred
remains mar the landscape of places
through which Thundurus has passed.
translation: 一边在天空飞来飞去，\n一边到处打雷引发山火，\n因此被人嫌弃。

label: SPECIES_THUNDURUS_THERIAN.speciesName
source: THUNDURUS
translation: 雷电云

label: SPECIES_THUNDURUS_THERIAN.categoryName
source: Bolt Strike
translation: 雷击

label: SPECIES_THUNDURUS_THERIAN.description
source:
It pulverizes foes into nothingness
with showers of devastatingly
powerful lightning bolts launched
from the string of orbs on its tail.
translation: 在闪电霹雳中现身。会自尾部的\n连串珠子降下雷击扫荡敌手。\n惊人的威力足以令敌手片甲不留。

label: SPECIES_RESHIRAM.speciesName
source: RESHIRAM
translation: 莱希拉姆

label: SPECIES_RESHIRAM.categoryName
source: Vast White
translation: 白阳

label: SPECIES_RESHIRAM.description
source:
This Pokémon appears in legends. It
sends flames into the air from its tail,
burning up everything around it. It helps
those who want to build a world of truth.
translation: 莱希拉姆的尾部燃烧的话，\n就会产生热能令大气运动，\n让世界的天气发生变化。

label: SPECIES_ZEKROM.speciesName
source: ZEKROM
translation: 捷克罗姆

label: SPECIES_ZEKROM.categoryName
source: Deep Black
translation: 黑阴

label: SPECIES_ZEKROM.description
source:
This legendary Pokémon can scorch the
world with lightning. It has a generator
that creates electricity in its tail. It
assists those with strong ideals.
translation: 用尾巴制造出电。\n把全身隐藏在雷云里，\n在合众地区的空中飞行。

label: SPECIES_LANDORUS_INCARNATE.speciesName
source: LANDORUS
translation: 土地云

label: SPECIES_LANDORUS_INCARNATE.categoryName
source: Abundance
translation: 丰饶

label: SPECIES_LANDORUS_INCARNATE.description
source:
The energy that comes pouring from its
tail increases the nutrition in the soil,
granting bountiful crops. It has been
hailed as “The Guardian of the Fields.”
translation: 吸收风和雷后变成能量，\n会给予土壤营养，\n令大地丰饶。

label: SPECIES_LANDORUS_THERIAN.speciesName
source: LANDORUS
translation: 土地云

label: SPECIES_LANDORUS_THERIAN.categoryName
source: Abundance
translation: 丰饶

label: SPECIES_LANDORUS_THERIAN.description
source:
Landorus soars through the sky in
this form, bestowing plentiful
harvests upon the land and earning the
people's reverence.
translation: 以灵兽之姿翱翔天际时，会为大地\n带来丰收，因而受到众人崇敬。\n只需一刻光阴便能纵断洗翠大地。

label: SPECIES_KYUREM.speciesName
source: KYUREM
translation: 酋雷姆

label: SPECIES_KYUREM.categoryName
source: Boundary
translation: 境界

label: SPECIES_KYUREM.description
source:
This legendary ice Pokémon waits for a
hero to fill in the missing parts of its
body with truth or ideals. Its body became
frozen when its energy leaked out.
translation: 在体内制造出强力的冰冻能量，\n但身体因为泄漏的冷气而冻住了。

label: SPECIES_KYUREM_WHITE.speciesName
source: KYUREM
translation: 酋雷姆

label: SPECIES_KYUREM_WHITE.categoryName
source: Boundary
translation: 境界

label: SPECIES_KYUREM_WHITE.description
source:
The sameness of Reshiram's and
Kyurem's genes allowed Kyurem to
absorb Reshiram. Kyurem can now use the
power of both fire and ice.
translation: 吸收了与自己拥有\n相同基因的莱希拉姆，\n因此能使用火与冰的能量。

label: SPECIES_KYUREM_BLACK.speciesName
source: KYUREM
translation: 酋雷姆

label: SPECIES_KYUREM_BLACK.categoryName
source: Boundary
translation: 境界

label: SPECIES_KYUREM_BLACK.description
source:
The sameness of Zekrom's and
Kyurem's genes allowed Kyurem to absorb
Zekrom. Kyurem can now use the
power of both electricity and ice.
translation: 吸收了与自己拥有\n相同基因的捷克罗姆，\n因此能使用电与冰的能量。

label: SPECIES_KELDEO_ORDINARY.speciesName
source: KELDEO
translation: 凯路迪欧

label: SPECIES_KELDEO_ORDINARY.categoryName
source: Colt
translation: 幼马

label: SPECIES_KELDEO_ORDINARY.description
source:
When it is resolute, its body fills with
power and it becomes swifter. It crosses
the world, running over the surfaces of
oceans and rivers.
translation: 据说当它挺过了艰难的战斗，\n额头上的角就能得到锻炼，\n从而激发出自己真正的力量。

label: SPECIES_KELDEO_RESOLUTE.speciesName
source: KELDEO
translation: 凯路迪欧

label: SPECIES_KELDEO_RESOLUTE.categoryName
source: Colt
translation: 幼马

label: SPECIES_KELDEO_RESOLUTE.description
source:
The power that lay hidden in its
body now covers its horn, turning it
into a sword that can slice through
anything.
translation: 沉睡在身体深处的力量\n包裹住了它额头上的角，\n形成了能撕裂一切的剑。

label: SPECIES_MELOETTA_ARIA.speciesName
source: MELOETTA
translation: 美洛耶塔

label: SPECIES_MELOETTA_ARIA.categoryName
source: Melody
translation: 旋律

label: SPECIES_MELOETTA_ARIA.description
source:
The melodies sung by Meloetta have the
power to make Pokémon that hear them
happy or sad. Many famous songs have been
inspired by the tunes that Meloetta plays.
translation: 用特殊的发声法唱出的旋律\n可以自由地操纵听者的情绪。

label: SPECIES_MELOETTA_PIROUETTE.speciesName
source: MELOETTA
translation: 美洛耶塔

label: SPECIES_MELOETTA_PIROUETTE.categoryName
source: Melody
translation: 旋律

label: SPECIES_MELOETTA_PIROUETTE.description
source: Meloetta's melodies are sung with\na special vocalization method that can\ncontrol the feelings of those who hear it.
translation: 使用古代之歌切换形态后的样子，\n能够跳出十分优雅的舞步

label: gSpeciesInfoGen5.speciesName
source: GENESECT
translation: 盖诺赛克特

label: gSpeciesInfoGen5.categoryName
source: Paleozoic
translation: 古生代

label: SPECIES_CHESPIN.speciesName
source: CHESPIN
translation: 哈力栗

label: SPECIES_CHESPIN.categoryName
source: Spiny Nut
translation: 刺栗

label: SPECIES_CHESPIN.description
source:
The quills on its head are usually soft.
When it flexes them, the points become
so hard and sharp that they can pierce
rock without any effort.
translation: 头和背部用坚硬的木壳覆盖着，\n所以即使被卡车撞到也安然无恙。

label: SPECIES_QUILLADIN.speciesName
source: QUILLADIN
translation: 胖胖哈力

label: SPECIES_QUILLADIN.categoryName
source: Spiny Armor
translation: 刺铠

label: SPECIES_QUILLADIN.description
source:
They strengthen the sturdy shell covering
their bodies by running into one another.
They are very kind and won't start fights,
but will counterattack with sharp quills.
translation: 一记撞击就能撞飞拖车。\n由于它的痛觉很迟钝，\n因此撞得很猛也没问题。

label: SPECIES_CHESNAUGHT.speciesName
source: CHESNAUGHT
translation: 布里卡隆

label: SPECIES_CHESNAUGHT.categoryName
source: Spiny Armor
translation: 刺铠

label: SPECIES_CHESNAUGHT.description
source:
It shields its allies from danger with
its own body. When it takes a defensive
posture with its fists guarding its face,
it can withstand a bomb blast.
translation: 性格温和，不爱争斗，\n但只要到了紧要关头，\n就会用带刺的拳头击溃对手。

label: SPECIES_CHESNAUGHT_MEGA.categoryName
source: Spiny Armor
translation: 刺铠

label: SPECIES_CHESNAUGHT_MEGA.description
source: It has fortified armor and a\nwill to defend at all costs.\nBoth are absurdly strong.
translation: 拥有防守至上的意志以及\n经过强化的装甲。\n两者都坚不可摧。

label: SPECIES_FENNEKIN.speciesName
source: FENNEKIN
translation: 火狐狸

label: SPECIES_FENNEKIN.categoryName
source: Fox
translation: 狐狸

label: SPECIES_FENNEKIN.description
source:
As it walks, it munches on a twig to fill
itself with energy in place of a snack.
It intimidates opponents by puffing hot
air out of its roomy ears.
translation: 随身带着小树枝，\n嘎吱嘎吱地当零食吃。\n从耳朵里喷出热气威吓对手。

label: SPECIES_BRAIXEN.speciesName
source: BRAIXEN
translation: 长尾火狐

label: SPECIES_BRAIXEN.categoryName
source: Fox
translation: 狐狸

label: SPECIES_BRAIXEN.description
source:
Braixen has a twig stuck in its tail.
When the twig is plucked from its tail,
friction sets the twig alight. The flame
is used to send signals to its allies.
translation: 将树枝从尾巴上拔出时，\n会因为摩擦而起火。\n挥动树枝的火焰向伙伴传递信号。

label: SPECIES_DELPHOX.speciesName
source: DELPHOX
translation: 妖火红狐

label: SPECIES_DELPHOX.categoryName
source: Fox
translation: 狐狸

label: SPECIES_DELPHOX.description
source:
It gazes into the flame at the tip of its
branch to achieve a focused state, which
allows it to see into the future. It uses
psychic power to incinerate its foes.
translation: 用超能力操纵摄氏\n3000度的火焰旋涡。\n用旋涡包住敌人后烧得精光。

label: SPECIES_DELPHOX_MEGA.categoryName
source: Fox
translation: 狐狸

label: SPECIES_DELPHOX_MEGA.description
source:
It wields flaming branches to
dazzle its opponents before
incinerating them with a
huge fireball.
translation: 会操控燃起火焰的枝条让\n对手变得神魂颠倒，\n再用大火球将其燃烧殆尽。

label: SPECIES_FROAKIE.speciesName
source: FROAKIE
translation: 呱呱泡蛙

label: SPECIES_FROAKIE.categoryName
source: Bubble Frog
translation: 泡蛙

label: SPECIES_FROAKIE.description
source:
It protects its skin by covering its body
in bubbles it secretes from its chest and
back. Beneath its happy-go-lucky air, it
keeps a watchful eye on its surroundings.
translation: 用细腻的泡泡包住身体，\n保护皮肤。装得无忧无虑的，\n实则很精明地窥视着四周。

label: SPECIES_FROGADIER.speciesName
source: FROGADIER
translation: 呱头蛙

label: SPECIES_FROGADIER.categoryName
source: Bubble Frog
translation: 泡蛙

label: SPECIES_FROGADIER.description
source:
It can throw bubble-covered pebbles with
precise control, hitting empty cans up to
a hundred feet away. Frogadier's swiftness
is unparalleled.
translation: 灵巧的身体不输给任何人。\n只需1分钟就能登上\n超过600米高的塔顶。

label: SPECIES_GRENINJA.speciesName
source: GRENINJA
translation: 甲贺忍蛙

label: SPECIES_GRENINJA.categoryName
source: Ninja
translation: 忍者

label: SPECIES_GRENINJA_BATTLE_BOND.speciesName
source: GRENINJA
translation: 甲贺忍蛙

label: SPECIES_GRENINJA_BATTLE_BOND.categoryName
source: Ninja
translation: 忍者

label: SPECIES_GRENINJA_ASH.speciesName
source: GRENINJA
translation: 甲贺忍蛙

label: SPECIES_GRENINJA_ASH.categoryName
source: Ninja
translation: 忍者

label: SPECIES_GRENINJA_MEGA.categoryName
source: Ninja
translation: 忍者

label: SPECIES_GRENINJA_MEGA.description
source:
This Pokémon spins a giant
shuriken at high speed to make it
float, then clings to it upside
down to catch opponents unawares.
translation: 会高速旋转巨大的手里剑\n使其浮空，倒贴在上面\n打对手一个出其不意。

label: SPECIES_BUNNELBY.speciesName
source: BUNNELBY
translation: 掘掘兔

label: SPECIES_BUNNELBY.categoryName
source: Digging
translation: 挖洞

label: SPECIES_BUNNELBY.description
source:
It has ears like shovels. Digging holes
strengthens its ears so much that they
can sever thick roots effortlessly.
Bunnelby dig the whole night through.
translation: 拥有铁锹一样的耳朵。\n因挖洞而锻炼过的耳朵威力\n大得可以切断粗粗的树根。

label: SPECIES_DIGGERSBY.speciesName
source: DIGGERSBY
translation: 掘地兔

label: SPECIES_DIGGERSBY.categoryName
source: Digging
translation: 挖洞

label: SPECIES_DIGGERSBY.description
source:
With its powerful ears it reduces dense
bedrock to rubble. It can be a big help
at construction sites. When it's finished
digging, it lounges about lazily.
translation: 耳朵的力量可以媲美铲车，\n连坚硬的岩盘也能被它粉碎。\n挖洞结束后，就会悠哉地生活。

label: SPECIES_FLETCHLING.speciesName
source: FLETCHLING
translation: 小箭雀

label: SPECIES_FLETCHLING.categoryName
source: Tiny Robin
translation: 知更鸟

label: SPECIES_FLETCHLING.description
source:
This amiable Pokémon is easy to train.
But when battle is joined, it shows its
ferocious side. It's merciless to
intruders that enter its territory.
translation: 婉转的叫声很美，\n但对于进入领地的对手毫不留情，\n非常粗暴。

label: SPECIES_FLETCHINDER.speciesName
source: FLETCHINDER
translation: 火箭雀

label: SPECIES_FLETCHINDER.categoryName
source: Ember
translation: 火花

label: SPECIES_FLETCHINDER.description
source:
From its beak, it expels embers that set
the tall grass on fire. Then it pounces on
any bewildered Pokémon that pop out of
the grass.
translation: 腹部火袋的火力越强，\n飞得越快。\n但是点着火需要花些时间。

label: SPECIES_TALONFLAME.speciesName
source: TALONFLAME
translation: 烈箭鹰

label: SPECIES_TALONFLAME.categoryName
source: Scorching
translation: 烈火

label: SPECIES_TALONFLAME.description
source:
In the fever of an exciting battle, it
showers embers from the gaps between its
feathers and takes to the air. It finishes
its prey off with a colossal kick.
translation: 袭击猎物的时候，\n时速达到500公里。\n用猛烈的脚踢了结对手。

label: gSpeciesInfoGen6.speciesName
source: SCATTERBUG
translation: 粉蝶虫

label: gSpeciesInfoGen6.categoryName
source: Scatterdust
translation: 喷粉

label: gSpeciesInfoGen6.speciesName
source: SPEWPA
translation: 粉蝶蛹

label: gSpeciesInfoGen6.categoryName
source: Scatterdust
translation: 喷粉

label: gSpeciesInfoGen6.speciesName
source: VIVILLON
translation: 彩粉蝶

label: gSpeciesInfoGen6.categoryName
source: Scale
translation: 鳞粉

label: SPECIES_VIVILLON_ICY_SNOW.description
source:
Its pattern depends on the climate and
topography of the land it was born in.
This form is from frigid lands.
It scatters toxic color scales in battle.
translation: 诞生在极为寒冷的地方。\n会从翅膀撒出色彩艳丽的\n毒鳞粉来战斗。

label: SPECIES_VIVILLON_POLAR.description
source:
Its pattern depends on the climate and
topography of the land it was born in.
This form is from snowy lands.
It scatters toxic color scales in battle.
translation: 诞生在多雪的地方。\n会从翅膀撒出色彩艳丽的\n毒鳞粉来战斗。

label: SPECIES_VIVILLON_TUNDRA.description

This form is from lands of severe cold.
It scatters toxic color scales in battle.
translation: 诞生在气候严寒的地方。\n会从翅膀撒出色彩艳丽的\n毒鳞粉来战斗。

translation: 诞生在辽阔的地方。\n会从翅膀撒出色彩艳丽的\n毒鳞粉来战斗。

Its pattern depends on the climate and

This form is from verdant lands.

translation: 诞生在绿意盎然的地方。\n会从翅膀撒出色彩艳丽的\n毒鳞粉来战斗。

Its pattern depends on the climate and
topography of the land it was born in. This
form is from lands with distinct seasons.
It scatters toxic color scales in battle.
translation: 诞生在四季分明的地方。\n会从翅膀撒出色彩艳丽的\n毒鳞粉来战斗。

Its pattern depends on the climate and
topography of the land it was born in. This

It scatters toxic color scales in battle.
translation: 诞生在花朵盛开的地方。\n会从翅膀撒出色彩艳丽的\n毒鳞粉来战斗。

It scatters toxic color scales in battle.
translation: 诞生在日照强烈的地方。\n会从翅膀撒出色彩艳丽的\n毒鳞粉来战斗。

Its pattern depends on the climate and
topography of the land it was born in. This
form is from lands with ocean breezes.
It scatters toxic color scales in battle.
translation: 诞生在海风吹拂的地方。\n会从翅膀撒出色彩艳丽的\n毒鳞粉来战斗。

Its pattern depends on the climate and
topography of the land it was born in.
This form is from places with many islands.
It scatters toxic color scales in battle.
translation: 诞生在岛屿群集的地方。\n会从翅膀撒出色彩艳丽的\n毒鳞粉来战斗。

Its pattern depends on the climate and

This form is from lands with little rain.

translation: 诞生在少雨的地方。\n会从翅膀撒出色彩艳丽的\n毒鳞粉来战斗。

Its pattern depends on the climate and

This form is from parched lands.

translation: 诞生在极为干旱的地方。\n会从翅膀撒出色彩艳丽的\n毒鳞粉来战斗。

label: SPECIES_VIVILLON_RIVER.description
source:
Its pattern depends on the climate and
topography of the land it was born in. This
form is from lands where large rivers flow.
It scatters toxic color scales in battle.
translation: 诞生在大河流淌的地方。\n会从翅膀撒出色彩艳丽的\n毒鳞粉来战斗。

label: SPECIES_VIVILLON_MONSOON.description

Its pattern depends on the climate and
topography of the land it was born in. This
form is from lands with intense rainfall.
It scatters toxic color scales in battle.
translation: 诞生在雨势激烈的地方。\n会从翅膀撒出色彩艳丽的\n毒鳞粉来战斗。

label: SPECIES_VIVILLON_SAVANNA.description

Its pattern depends on the climate and
topography of the land it was born in. This
form is from lands with a tropical climate.
It scatters toxic color scales in battle.
translation: 诞生在热带气候的地方。\n会从翅膀撒出色彩艳丽的\n毒鳞粉来战斗。

Its pattern depends on the climate and

This form is from lands bathed in light.
It scatters toxic color scales in battle.
translation: 诞生在光线充足的地方。\n会从翅膀撒出色彩艳丽的\n毒鳞粉来战斗。

Its pattern depends on the climate and
topography of the land it was born in. This
form is from lands of perpetual summer.
It scatters toxic color scales in battle.
translation: 诞生在四季如夏的地方。\n会从翅膀撒出色彩艳丽的\n毒鳞粉来战斗。

label: SPECIES_VIVILLON_JUNGLE.description

Its pattern depends on the climate and
topography of the land it was born in. This
form is from lands of tropical rainforests.
It scatters toxic color scales in battle.
translation: 诞生在热带雨林的地方。\n会从翅膀撒出色彩艳丽的\n毒鳞粉来战斗。

label: SPECIES_VIVILLON_FANCY.description
source:
Its pattern depends on the climate and
topography of the land it was born in.
This form is from a mysterious land.
It scatters toxic color scales in battle.
translation: 诞生在神奇的地方。\n会从翅膀撒出色彩艳丽的\n毒鳞粉来战斗。

label: SPECIES_VIVILLON_POKEBALL.description
source:
Its pattern depends on the climate and
topography of the land it was born in.
This form is from a special land.
It scatters toxic color scales in battle.
translation: 诞生在特别的地方。\n会从翅膀撒出色彩艳丽的\n毒鳞粉来战斗。

label: SPECIES_LITLEO.speciesName
source: LITLEO
translation: 小狮狮

label: SPECIES_LITLEO.categoryName
source: Lion Cub
translation: 幼狮

label: SPECIES_LITLEO.description
source:
They set off on their own from their pride
and live by themselves to become stronger.
These hot-blooded Pokémon are quick
to start a fight.
translation: 为了变强而开始离开群体，\n独自生活。\n血气旺盛，很冲动。

label: SPECIES_PYROAR.speciesName
source: PYROAR
translation: 火炎狮

label: SPECIES_PYROAR.categoryName
source: Royal
translation: 王者

label: SPECIES_PYROAR.description
source:
The male with the largest mane of fire
is the leader of the pride. The females
protect the pride's cubs. They viciously
threaten any challenger.
translation: 在战斗时，\n雄性的鬃毛会提升到摄氏2000度。\n光是靠近都会造成重度灼伤。

label: SPECIES_PYROAR_MEGA.categoryName
source: Royal
translation: 王者

label: SPECIES_PYROAR_MEGA.description
source:
This Pokémon spews flames hotter
than 18,000 degrees Fahrenheit.
It swings around its grand, blazing
mane as it protects its allies.
translation: 能吐出超过1万度的火焰。\n会一边乱摆熊熊燃烧的鬃毛，\n一边保护伙伴。

label: gSpeciesInfoGen6.speciesName
source: FLABéBé
translation: 花蓓蓓

label: gSpeciesInfoGen6.categoryName
source: Single Bloom
translation: 单朵

label: SPECIES_FLABEBE_RED.description
source:
This Flabébé rides a red flower.
Immediately after birth, this Pokémon
begins flying around in search of a
flower it likes.
translation: 乘着红花的花蓓蓓。\n从出生那一刻起就会为了寻找\n喜欢的花而四处飞行。

label: SPECIES_FLABEBE_YELLOW.description
source:
It unleashes a variety of moves by
drawing forth the power hidden
within flowers. This Pokémon is
particularly fond of yellow flowers.
translation: 激发花的力量，\n以此来使出各种各样的招式。\n尤其喜欢黄花。

label: SPECIES_FLABEBE_ORANGE.description
source:
It receives strength from flowers
and gives them some of its energy in
return. This Pokémon likes orange
flowers best of all.
translation: 由于从花那里得到力量，\n因此相应地会分出能量给花。\n它最喜欢的是橙花。

label: SPECIES_FLABEBE_BLUE.description
source:
This Pokémon likes blue flowers
best of all. It floats upward using the
power emanating from its flower
and bobs along lightly through the air.
translation: 它最喜欢的是蓝花。\n靠由花朵散发出的力量浮在空中，\n轻轻地飘来飘去。

label: SPECIES_FLABEBE_WHITE.description
source:
When evening falls, it searches out
a place blooming with flowers of
the same white color as itself, and
then it goes to sleep.
translation: 一到黄昏，\n它就会去找和自己一样绽放着\n白花的地方睡觉。

label: gSpeciesInfoGen6.speciesName
source: FLOETTE
translation: 花叶蒂

label: gSpeciesInfoGen6.categoryName
source: Single Bloom
translation: 单朵

label: SPECIES_FLOETTE_RED.description
source:
This Pokémon uses red wavelengths
of light to pour its own energy
into flowers and draw forth their
latent potential.
translation: 会通过红色的波长把自己的\n能量传递给花，\n以激发花的潜在能力。

label: SPECIES_FLOETTE_YELLOW.description
source:
This Pokémon can draw forth the
power hidden within yellow flowers.
This power then becomes the moves
Floette uses to protect itself.
translation: 能够激发草属性的宝可梦的潜在能力。\n与黄花的波长很契合。

label: SPECIES_FLOETTE_ORANGE.description
source:
This Pokémon can draw forth the
most power when in sync with orange
flowers, compared to flowers of other
colors.
translation: 单靠自己无法使出招式。\n通过与花同步波长，\n就能使出草属性的招式。

label: SPECIES_FLOETTE_BLUE.description
source:
Whenever this Pokémon finds
flowering plants that are withering, it
will bring them back to its territory
and care for them.
translation: 能通过颜色的波长与花交换力量。\n这个样子是能与蓝色的\n波长结合的个体。

label: SPECIES_FLOETTE_WHITE.description
source:
If it finds someone messing up a
flower bed, it will attack them
without mercy. This Floette takes
particularly good care of white flowers.
translation: 如果发现有谁破坏了花坛，\n就会毫不留情地发动攻击。\n非常珍惜白花。

label: SPECIES_FLOETTE_ETERNAL.description
source:
The flower it's holding can no
longer be found blooming anywhere. It's
also thought to contain terrifying
power.
translation: 那朵不祥的花里蕴藏着恐怖的能量，\n但它却天真地挥舞着那花。

label: gSpeciesInfoGen6.speciesName
source: FLORGES
translation: 花洁夫人

label: gSpeciesInfoGen6.categoryName
source: Garden
translation: 花园

label: SPECIES_FLORGES_RED.description
source:
This Pokémon creates an impressive
flower garden in its territory. It
draws forth the power of the red
flowers around its neck.
translation: 据说由花洁夫人打造的花园中\n会源源不断地倾注着\n能够治愈身心的力量。

label: SPECIES_FLORGES_YELLOW.description
source:
This Pokémon battles by drawing
forth the power of yellow flowers. It
ruthlessly punishes anyone who
tramples on flowering plants.
translation: 能激发出黄花的力量来战斗。\n会狠狠地教训糟蹋花草的家伙，\n绝不会手下留情。

label: SPECIES_FLORGES_ORANGE.description
source:
In times long past, castle
governors would lovingly raise Florges to
care for their castles' exquisite
gardens.
translation: 过去的城主们为了维护\n城堡庭院的美观，\n会精心培育花洁夫人。

label: SPECIES_FLORGES_BLUE.description
source: Blue pigments were tremendously\nexpensive in the past, so paintings\nof blue Florges are highly valuable.
translation: 过去蓝色的颜料价格十分昂贵，\n因此画有蓝色个体的\n绘画拥有极高的价值。

label: SPECIES_FLORGES_WHITE.description
source:
A flower garden made by a white-
flowered Florges will be beautifully
decorated with flowering plants of
many different colors.
translation: 由白花装饰的个体也能与各种\n不同的颜色同步波长，激发力量。

label: SPECIES_FLOETTE_MEGA.categoryName
source: Single Bloom
translation: 单朵

label: SPECIES_FLOETTE_MEGA.description
source:
The Eternal Flower has absorbed
all the energy from Mega
Evolution. The flower now attacks
enemies on its own.
translation: 永恒之花会将超级进化的能量吸尽。\n花可以独自袭击敌人。

label: SPECIES_SKIDDO.speciesName
source: SKIDDO
translation: 坐骑小羊

label: SPECIES_SKIDDO.categoryName
source: Mount
translation: 坐骑

label: SPECIES_SKIDDO.description
source:
If it has sunshine and water, it doesn't
need to eat, because it can generate
energy from the leaves on its back.
It has a placid disposition.
translation: 如果有水和阳光，\n就能用背上的叶子制造能量，\n所以即使不吃食物也没事。

label: SPECIES_GOGOAT.speciesName
source: GOGOAT
translation: 坐骑山羊

label: SPECIES_GOGOAT.categoryName
source: Mount
translation: 坐骑

label: SPECIES_GOGOAT.description
source:
It can tell how its trainer is feeling by
subtle shifts in the grip on its horns. This
empathetic sense lets them run as if one
being. They inhabit mountainous regions.
translation: 在山岳地带生活。\n互相撞角比力气的胜利者\n就是群体的首领。

label: SPECIES_PANCHAM.speciesName
source: PANCHAM
translation: 顽皮熊猫

label: SPECIES_PANCHAM.categoryName
source: Playful
translation: 顽皮

label: SPECIES_PANCHAM.description
source:
There's no point to the leaf in its mouth,
aside from an effort to look cool. It's
mischievous, so it's not well suited to
inexperienced Trainers.
translation: 拼命做出可怕的表情瞪着对手，\n但只要被摸到头，\n就会忍不住一下子笑起来。

label: SPECIES_PANGORO.speciesName
source: PANGORO
translation: 霸道熊猫

label: SPECIES_PANGORO.categoryName
source: Daunting
translation: 恶颜

label: SPECIES_PANGORO.description
source:
It boasts superb physical strength.
Those who wish to become Pangoro's
Trainer have no choice but to converse
with their fists.
translation: 即使受到攻击也不会畏缩，\n而是猛冲上去，\n用能将电线杆折断的臂力击垮对手。

label: gSpeciesInfoGen6.speciesName
source: FURFROU
translation: 多丽米亚

label: gSpeciesInfoGen6.categoryName
source: Poodle
translation: 贵宾犬

label: SPECIES_ESPURR.speciesName
source: ESPURR
translation: 妙喵

label: SPECIES_ESPURR.categoryName
source: Restraint
translation: 自制

label: SPECIES_ESPURR.description
source:
It has enough psychic energy to blast
everything within 300 feet of itself.
The organ that emits its intense psychic
power is sheltered by its ears.
translation: 拥有足以把100米内的东西\n全都吹飞的精神力量，\n但却控制不好它。

label: SPECIES_MEOWSTIC_M.speciesName
source: MEOWSTIC
translation: 超能妙喵

label: SPECIES_MEOWSTIC_M.categoryName
source: Constraint
translation: 抑制

label: SPECIES_MEOWSTIC_M.description
source:
The defensive instinct of the
males is strong. It's when they're
protecting themselves or their partners
that they unleash their full power.
translation: 如果持续释放强大的精神力量，\n那么自身的肉体也会受到伤害。

label: SPECIES_MEOWSTIC_F.speciesName
source: MEOWSTIC
translation: 超能妙喵

label: SPECIES_MEOWSTIC_F.categoryName
source: Constraint
translation: 抑制

label: SPECIES_MEOWSTIC_F.description
source:
Females are a bit more selfish and
aggressive than males. If they
don't get what they want, they will
torment you with their psychic abilities.
translation: 一旦察觉到危险就\n会以最大输出释放精神力量。\n它可不会在意对手的事情。

label: SPECIES_MEOWSTIC_M_MEGA.categoryName
source: Constraint
translation: 千里眼

label: SPECIES_MEOWSTIC_M_MEGA.description
source:
Mega Meowstic can use its psychic power
to compress or expand anything. It
overwhelms foes by contorting space
itself.
translation: 能凭借精神力量让万物\n膨胀或收缩。甚至能扭曲\n空间，压制敌人。

label: SPECIES_MEOWSTIC_F_MEGA.categoryName
source: Constraint
translation: 千里眼

label: SPECIES_MEOWSTIC_F_MEGA.description
source:
Mega Meowstic can use its psychic power
to compress or expand anything. It
overwhelms foes by contorting space
itself.
translation: 能凭借精神力量让万物\n膨胀或收缩。甚至能扭曲\n空间，压制敌人。

label: SPECIES_HONEDGE.speciesName
source: HONEDGE
translation: 独剑鞘

label: SPECIES_HONEDGE.categoryName
source: Sword
translation: 刀剑

label: SPECIES_HONEDGE.description
source:
If anyone dares to grab its hilt, it
wraps a blue cloth around that person's
arm and drains that person's life
energy completely.
translation: 用蓝布卷住握剑柄之人的手臂，\n吸取生命直至其倒下。

label: SPECIES_DOUBLADE.speciesName
source: DOUBLADE
translation: 双剑鞘

label: SPECIES_DOUBLADE.categoryName
source: Sword
translation: 刀剑

label: SPECIES_DOUBLADE.description
source:
When Honedge evolves, it divides into
two swords. The complex attack patterns
of its two swords are unstoppable, even
against those skilled at swordplay.
translation: 要抵挡住2把剑发出的\n复杂的连续攻击，\n即便是用剑高手也不可能。

label: SPECIES_AEGISLASH_SHIELD.speciesName
source: AEGISLASH
translation: 坚盾剑怪

label: SPECIES_AEGISLASH_SHIELD.categoryName
source: Royal Sword
translation: 王剑

label: SPECIES_AEGISLASH_SHIELD.description
source:
In this defensive stance,
Aegislash uses its steel body and a force
field of spectral power to reduce the
damage of any attack.
translation: 坚盾剑怪曾经用强大的\n灵力控制人和宝可梦，\n建立了适合自己生活的国家。

label: SPECIES_AEGISLASH_BLADE.speciesName
source: AEGISLASH
translation: 坚盾剑怪

label: SPECIES_AEGISLASH_BLADE.categoryName
source: Royal Sword
translation: 王剑

label: SPECIES_AEGISLASH_BLADE.description
source:
Once upon a time, a king with an
Aegislash reigned over the land. His
Pokémon eventually drained him of
life, and his kingdom fell with him.
translation: 虽然带着坚盾剑怪的国王曾经\n支配了整个国家，最后却被它吸走了\n精气，国家也灭亡了。

label: SPECIES_SPRITZEE.speciesName
source: SPRITZEE
translation: 粉香香

label: SPECIES_SPRITZEE.categoryName
source: Perfume
translation: 香水

label: SPECIES_SPRITZEE.description
source:
In the past, rather than using perfume,
royal ladies carried a Spritzee that would
waft a fragrance they liked. Its fragrance
changes depending on what it has eaten.
translation: 听说过去的贵妇们会带着能散发\n自己喜欢的香气的粉香香来代替香水。

label: SPECIES_AROMATISSE.speciesName
source: AROMATISSE
translation: 芳香精

label: SPECIES_AROMATISSE.categoryName
source: Fragrance
translation: 芳香

label: SPECIES_AROMATISSE.description
source:
Its scent is so overpowering that,
unless a Trainer happens to really enjoy
the smell, he or she will have a hard time
walking alongside it.
translation: 因为气味过于强烈，\n如果不是相当喜爱它的训练家，\n要带着走路都相当困难。

label: SPECIES_SWIRLIX.speciesName
source: SWIRLIX
translation: 绵绵泡芙

label: SPECIES_SWIRLIX.categoryName
source: Cotton Candy
translation: 棉花糖

label: SPECIES_SWIRLIX.description
source:
Because it eats nothing but sweets, its
fur is as sticky sweet as cotton candy.
To entangle its opponents in battle, it
extrudes sticky white threads.
translation: 因为净吃些甜甜的东西，\n体毛也变得像棉花糖一样\n又甜又黏糊糊的了。

label: SPECIES_SLURPUFF.speciesName
source: SLURPUFF
translation: 胖甜妮

label: SPECIES_SLURPUFF.categoryName
source: Meringue
translation: 泡沫奶油

label: SPECIES_SLURPUFF.description
source:
Slurpuff can distinguish even the
faintest of scents. It puts its sensitive
sense of smell to use by helping pastry
chefs in their work.
translation: 嗅觉比人类灵敏1亿倍以上。\n通过空气中飘浮的细微气味\n就能完全了解周围的情形。

label: SPECIES_INKAY.speciesName
source: INKAY
translation: 好啦鱿

label: SPECIES_INKAY.categoryName
source: Revolving
translation: 回转

label: SPECIES_INKAY.description
source:
It flashes the light-emitting spots on its
body, which drains its opponent's will
to fight. It takes the opportunity to
scuttle away and hide.
translation: 通过光的闪烁让\n来袭击的敌人战意全消。\n就在那空当隐藏自己的身体。

label: SPECIES_MALAMAR.speciesName
source: MALAMAR
translation: 乌贼王

label: SPECIES_MALAMAR.categoryName
source: Overturning
translation: 倒转

label: SPECIES_MALAMAR.description
source:
It lures prey close with hypnotic motions,
then wraps its tentacles around it before
finishing it off with digestive fluids. It
forces others to do whatever it wants.
translation: 用催眠术引诱对手靠近，\n再用头部的触手缠住它，\n然后泼洒消化液将其了结。

label: SPECIES_MALAMAR_MEGA.categoryName
source: Overturning
translation: 倒转

label: SPECIES_MALAMAR_MEGA.description
source:
It uses its colorful lights to
overwrite the personality and
memories of others-and to
control them.
translation: 会用颜色鲜艳的光覆盖\n对手的人格和记忆，\n将其按自己的意愿操纵。

label: SPECIES_BINACLE.speciesName
source: BINACLE
translation: 龟脚脚

label: SPECIES_BINACLE.categoryName
source: Two-Handed
translation: 双手

label: SPECIES_BINACLE.description
source:
They stretch and then contract, yanking
their rocks along with them in bold hops.
They eat seaweed that washes up on
the shoreline.
translation: 利用拉伸身体的\n反作用力提着岩石走路。\n在波浪拍打的海滩上吃冲上来的海藻。

label: SPECIES_BARBARACLE.speciesName
source: BARBARACLE
translation: 龟足巨铠

label: SPECIES_BARBARACLE.categoryName
source: Collective
translation: 集合

label: SPECIES_BARBARACLE.description
source:
Barbaracle's legs and hands have minds
of their own, and they will move
independently. But they usually follow
the head's orders.
translation: 手脚也有大脑，\n可以随意活动。\n但通常会听从头部龟足巨铠的命令。

label: SPECIES_BARBARACLE_MEGA.categoryName
source: Collective
translation: 集合

label: SPECIES_BARBARACLE_MEGA.description
source: It uses its many arms to toy\nwith its opponents. This\nkeeps the head extremely busy.
translation: 虽然能用很多胳膊将对手\n耍得团团转，但头部的\n龟足巨铠会相当忙。

label: SPECIES_SKRELP.speciesName
source: SKRELP
translation: 垃垃藻

label: SPECIES_SKRELP.categoryName
source: Mock Kelp
translation: 似草

label: SPECIES_SKRELP.description
source:
Camouflaged as rotten kelp, it hides
from foes while storing up power for its
evolution. They spray liquid poison on
prey that approach unawares.
translation: 和腐烂的海藻一模一样。\n一边骗过敌人的眼睛，\n一边积蓄进化的力量。

label: SPECIES_DRAGALGE.speciesName
source: DRAGALGE
translation: 毒藻龙

label: SPECIES_DRAGALGE.categoryName
source: Mock Kelp
translation: 似草

label: SPECIES_DRAGALGE.description
source:
Their poison is strong enough to eat
through the hull of a tanker. Tales are
told of ships that wander into seas where
Dragalge live, never to return.
translation: 据说，\n误入毒藻龙居住海域的船\n是无法平安回来的。

label: SPECIES_DRAGALGE_MEGA.categoryName
source: Mock Kelp
translation: 似草

label: SPECIES_DRAGALGE_MEGA.description
source:
It spits a liquid that causes the
regenerative power of cells to run
wild. The liquid is deadly poison
to everything other than itself.
translation: 会吐出能让细胞的再生力\n失控的液体。除了自己，\n对谁都是剧毒。

label: SPECIES_CLAUNCHER.speciesName
source: CLAUNCHER
translation: 铁臂枪虾

label: SPECIES_CLAUNCHER.categoryName
source: Water Gun
translation: 水枪

label: SPECIES_CLAUNCHER.description
source:
Through controlled expulsions of internal
gas, it can expel water like a pistol shot.
At close distances, it can even shatter
large rocks.
translation: 通过体内气体的爆炸，\n像手枪一样发射水。\n极近距离的话，能击碎岩石。

label: SPECIES_CLAWITZER.speciesName
source: CLAWITZER
translation: 钢炮臂虾

label: SPECIES_CLAWITZER.categoryName
source: Howitzer
translation: 发射器

label: SPECIES_CLAWITZER.description
source:
By expelling water from the nozzle in the
back of its enormous claw, it can move
at a speed of 60 knots. They launch
cannonballs made of water.
translation: 从钳子后面的喷管里喷出水，\n利用这个推进力以60节的速度前进。

label: SPECIES_HELIOPTILE.speciesName
source: HELIOPTILE
translation: 伞电蜥

label: SPECIES_HELIOPTILE.categoryName
source: Generator
translation: 发电

label: SPECIES_HELIOPTILE.description
source:
They make their home in deserts.
They can generate their own energy from
basking in the sun, so eating food is not
a requirement.
translation: 在头部两侧的褶边里，\n有沐浴阳光来发电的细胞。

label: SPECIES_HELIOLISK.speciesName
source: HELIOLISK
translation: 光电伞蜥

label: SPECIES_HELIOLISK.categoryName
source: Generator
translation: 发电

label: SPECIES_HELIOLISK.description
source:
A single Heliolisk can generate sufficient
electricity to power a skyscraper. It can
stimulate its muscles with electricity,
boosting the strength in its legs.
translation: 如果用电刺激肌肉，\n脚力就会提升至5秒内跑100米。

label: SPECIES_TYRUNT.speciesName
source: TYRUNT
translation: 宝宝暴龙

label: SPECIES_TYRUNT.categoryName
source: Royal Heir
translation: 幼君

label: SPECIES_TYRUNT.description
source:
Its immense jaws have enough destructive
force that it can chew up a car. If
something happens that it doesn't like,
it throws a tantrum and runs wild.
translation: 大颚的破坏力可以\n嘎嘣嘎嘣地嚼坏汽车。\n栖息在1亿年前。

label: SPECIES_TYRANTRUM.speciesName
source: TYRANTRUM
translation: 怪颚龙

label: SPECIES_TYRANTRUM.categoryName
source: Despot
translation: 暴君

label: SPECIES_TYRANTRUM.description
source:
Thanks to its gargantuan jaws, which could
shred thick metal plates as if they were
paper, it was invincible in the ancient
world it once inhabited.
translation: 在1亿年前的世界里，\n以无敌而自豪，\n像国王一样行动的宝可梦。

label: SPECIES_AMAURA.speciesName
source: AMAURA
translation: 冰雪龙

label: SPECIES_AMAURA.categoryName
source: Tundra
translation: 冻原

label: SPECIES_AMAURA.description
source:
This ancient Pokémon was restored from
part of its body that had been frozen in
ice for over 100 million years. It lived in a
cold land where there were no predators.
translation: 性格慢吞吞的宝可梦。\n居住在没有怪颚龙等\n粗暴敌人的寒冷土地上。

label: SPECIES_AURORUS.speciesName
source: AURORUS
translation: 冰雪巨龙

label: SPECIES_AURORUS.categoryName
source: Tundra
translation: 冻原

label: SPECIES_AURORUS.description
source:
Using the diamond-shaped crystals on its
body it can instantly create a wall of ice
to block an opponent's attack, or encase
them in ice.
translation: 用身上的菱形结晶瞬间制成冰墙，\n抵御敌人的攻击。

label: SPECIES_HAWLUCHA.speciesName
source: HAWLUCHA
translation: 摔角鹰人

label: SPECIES_HAWLUCHA.categoryName
source: Wrestling
translation: 摔角

label: SPECIES_HAWLUCHA.description
source:
With its wings, it controls its position in
the air. Its proficient fighting skills
enable it to keep up with big bruisers
like Machamp and Hariyama.
translation: 使用翅膀控制在空中的姿势。\n会从很难防御的头顶发起攻击。

label: SPECIES_HAWLUCHA_MEGA.categoryName
source: Wrestling
translation: 摔角

label: SPECIES_HAWLUCHA_MEGA.description
source: Mega Evolution has pumped up all\nits muscles. Hawlucha flexes to\nshow off its strength.
translation: 会利用因超级进化而\n激增的浑身肌肉\n炫耀自己强而有力。

label: SPECIES_DEDENNE.speciesName
source: DEDENNE
translation: 咚咚鼠

label: SPECIES_DEDENNE.categoryName
source: Antenna
translation: 天线

label: SPECIES_DEDENNE.description
source:
Its whiskers serve as antennas.
By sending and receiving electrical
waves, it can communicate with others
over vast distances.
translation: 用尾巴从发电厂\n或民宅的插座上吸取电，\n然后从胡子射出电击来。

label: SPECIES_CARBINK.speciesName
source: CARBINK
translation: 小碎钻

label: SPECIES_CARBINK.categoryName
source: Jewel
translation: 宝石

label: SPECIES_CARBINK.description
source:
Born from the high temperatures and
pressures deep underground, it defends
itself by firing beams from the jewel part
of its body.
translation: 从出生开始，\n数亿年间一直都沉睡在地底。\n挖掘洞窟的话，偶尔会挖出它。

label: SPECIES_GOOMY.speciesName
source: GOOMY
translation: 黏黏宝

label: SPECIES_GOOMY.categoryName
source: Soft Tissue
translation: 软体生物

label: SPECIES_GOOMY.description
source:
Its source of protection is its slimy,
germ-laden mucous membrane. Anyone
who touches it will need some thorough
hand-washing.
translation: 被滑腻腻的粘膜覆盖着的身体\n可以让敌人的拳击和脚踢\n哧溜一下滑开。

label: SPECIES_SLIGGOO.speciesName
source: SLIGGOO
translation: 黏美儿

label: SPECIES_SLIGGOO.categoryName
source: Soft Tissue
translation: 软体生物

label: SPECIES_SLIGGOO.description
source:
This Pokémon's mucous can dissolve
anything. Toothless, it sprays mucous
on its prey. Once they're nicely dissolved,
it slurps them up.
translation: 4只角是高性能的雷达。\n取代耳朵和鼻子，\n感知声音和气味。

label: SPECIES_GOODRA.speciesName
source: GOODRA
translation: 黏美龙

label: SPECIES_GOODRA.categoryName
source: Dragon
translation: 龙

label: SPECIES_GOODRA.description
source:
It gets picked on because it's meek.
But then, whoever teased it gets to feel
the full force of its horns and a good
swatting from its thick tail.
translation: 用伸缩的角进行攻击。\n威力相当于100名职业\n拳击手出拳的力量。

label: SPECIES_SLIGGOO_HISUI.description
source:
A creature given to melancholy.
Its metallic shell developed as a
result of the mucus on its skin reacting
with the iron in Hisui's water.
translation: 性情阴沉。据考察，洗翠地区的水中\n含有的铁质对皮肤的黏液产生作用，\n使其变化成了金属外壳。

label: SPECIES_GOODRA_HISUI.description
source:
It loathes solitude and is extremely
clingy--it will fume and run riot if
those dearest to it ever leave its
side.
translation: 能自在操纵可刚可柔的金属外壳。\n性情执着且厌恶孤独，一旦喜爱的\n对象离开自己便会怒不可遏。

label: SPECIES_KLEFKI.speciesName
source: KLEFKI
translation: 钥圈儿

label: SPECIES_KLEFKI.categoryName
source: Key Ring
translation: 钥匙串

label: SPECIES_KLEFKI.description
source:
These key collectors threaten any
attackers by fiercely jingling their keys
at them. It will sneak into people's homes
to steal their keys.
translation: 对于喜欢的钥匙绝对不放手，\n所以为了防止盗窃，\n会让它拿着金库的钥匙。

label: SPECIES_PHANTUMP.speciesName
source: PHANTUMP
translation: 小木灵

label: SPECIES_PHANTUMP.categoryName
source: Stump
translation: 树桩

label: SPECIES_PHANTUMP.description
source:
According to legend, medicine to cure
any illness can be made by plucking the
green leaves on its head, brewing them,
and boiling down the liquid.
translation: 据说，\n在森林中迷路死去的孩子的\n魂魄寄生在树桩上，变成了宝可梦。

label: SPECIES_TREVENANT.speciesName
source: TREVENANT
translation: 朽木妖

label: SPECIES_TREVENANT.categoryName
source: Elder Tree
translation: 老树

label: SPECIES_TREVENANT.description
source:
Through its roots, it exerts control over
other trees. A deadly curse falls upon
anyone cutting down trees in forests
where Trevenant dwell.
translation: 用根茎代替神经操纵森林里的树木。\n对住在它身体里的宝可梦很亲切。

label: SPECIES_PUMPKABOO_AVERAGE.speciesName
source: PUMPKABOO
translation: 南瓜精

label: SPECIES_PUMPKABOO_AVERAGE.categoryName
source: Pumpkin
translation: 南瓜

label: SPECIES_PUMPKABOO_AVERAGE.description
source:
The light that streams out from
the holes in the pumpkin can
hypnotize and control the people and
Pokémon that see it.
translation: 南瓜的洞里发出的光会催眠\n并控制看到它的人和宝可梦。

label: SPECIES_PUMPKABOO_SMALL.speciesName
source: PUMPKABOO
translation: 南瓜精

label: SPECIES_PUMPKABOO_SMALL.categoryName
source: Pumpkin
translation: 南瓜

label: SPECIES_PUMPKABOO_SMALL.description
source: When taking spirits to the\nafterlife, small Pumpkaboo prefer the\nspirits of children to those of adults.
translation: 据说是因为生活在游荡的\n灵魂不太多的地方，\n所以身体变小了。

label: SPECIES_PUMPKABOO_LARGE.speciesName
source: PUMPKABOO
translation: 南瓜精

label: SPECIES_PUMPKABOO_LARGE.categoryName
source: Pumpkin
translation: 南瓜

label: SPECIES_PUMPKABOO_LARGE.description
source: When taking spirits to the\nafterlife, large Pumpkaboo prefer the\nspirits of adults to those of children.
translation: 据说是因为生活在游荡的\n灵魂比较多的地方，\n所以身体变大了。

label: SPECIES_PUMPKABOO_SUPER.speciesName
source: PUMPKABOO
translation: 南瓜精

label: SPECIES_PUMPKABOO_SUPER.categoryName
source: Pumpkin
translation: 南瓜

label: SPECIES_PUMPKABOO_SUPER.description
source: Supersized Pumpkaboo are very\npartial to the spirits of people who\nwere of similarly superior proportions.
translation: 据说是因为生活在游荡的\n灵魂特别多的地方，\n所以身体变得特别大。

label: SPECIES_GOURGEIST_AVERAGE.speciesName
source: GOURGEIST
translation: 南瓜怪人

label: SPECIES_GOURGEIST_AVERAGE.categoryName
source: Pumpkin
translation: 南瓜

label: SPECIES_GOURGEIST_AVERAGE.description
source:
Eerie cries emanate from its body
in the dead of night. The sounds are
said to be the wails of spirits who
are suffering in the afterlife.
translation: 南瓜怪人会在朔月的夜里\n去别人家门口敲门。\n开了门的人会被它带往另一个世界。

label: SPECIES_GOURGEIST_SMALL.speciesName
source: GOURGEIST
translation: 南瓜怪人

label: SPECIES_GOURGEIST_SMALL.categoryName
source: Pumpkin
translation: 南瓜

label: SPECIES_GOURGEIST_SMALL.description
source:
A small-sized Pumpkaboo evolves
into a small-sized Gourgeist. Its
bodily proportions also get passed on
to its descendants.
translation: 身体偏小的南瓜精进化之后的样子。\n身体的大小会遗传。

label: SPECIES_GOURGEIST_LARGE.speciesName
source: GOURGEIST
translation: 南瓜怪人

label: SPECIES_GOURGEIST_LARGE.categoryName
