source: Pumpkin
translation: 南瓜

label: SPECIES_GOURGEIST_LARGE.description
source:
A large-sized Pumpkaboo evolves
into a large-sized Gourgeist. Its
bodily proportions also get passed on
to its descendants.
translation: 身体偏大的南瓜精进化之后的样子。\n身体的大小会遗传。

label: SPECIES_GOURGEIST_SUPER.speciesName
source: GOURGEIST
translation: 南瓜怪人

label: SPECIES_GOURGEIST_SUPER.categoryName
source: Pumpkin
translation: 南瓜

label: SPECIES_GOURGEIST_SUPER.description
source:
A supersized Pumpkaboo evolves
into a supersized Gourgeist. Its
bodily proportions also get passed on to
its descendants.
translation: 身体特别大的南瓜精进化之后的样子。\n身体的大小会遗传。

label: SPECIES_BERGMITE.speciesName
source: BERGMITE
translation: 冰宝

label: SPECIES_BERGMITE.categoryName
source: Ice Chunk
translation: 冰块

label: SPECIES_BERGMITE.description
source:
It blocks opponents' attacks with the ice
that shields its body. It uses cold air to
repair any cracks with new ice. They live
in herds on snowy mountains.
translation: 用零下100度的冷气\n把敌人冰封起来。\n在被万年积雪覆盖的山里集结成群。

label: SPECIES_AVALUGG.speciesName
source: AVALUGG
translation: 冰岩怪

label: SPECIES_AVALUGG.categoryName
source: Iceberg
translation: 冰山

label: SPECIES_AVALUGG.description
source:
The way several Bergmite huddle on its
back make it look like an aircraft carrier
made of ice. Its cumbersome frame crushes
anything that stands in its way.
translation: 背上驮着几只冰宝生活的样子，\n简直就像是冰之航空母舰。

label: SPECIES_AVALUGG_HISUI.description
source: The armor of ice covering its lower\njaw puts steel to shame and can\nshatter rocks with ease.
translation: 包覆下颚的冰块装甲硬度更胜钢铁，\n能轻易地击碎岩石。它会借此铲开\n厚重积雪，在险峻的山路上猛冲。

label: SPECIES_NOIBAT.speciesName
source: NOIBAT
translation: 嗡蝠

label: SPECIES_NOIBAT.categoryName
source: Sound Wave
translation: 音波

label: SPECIES_NOIBAT.description
source:
They live in pitch-black caves. Even a
robust wrestler will become dizzy and
unable to stand when exposed to its
200,000-hertz ultrasonic waves.
translation: 如果被20万赫兹的超音波照到，\n连强壮的摔角手也会头晕目眩，\n无法站立。

label: SPECIES_NOIVERN.speciesName
source: NOIVERN
translation: 音波龙

label: SPECIES_NOIVERN.categoryName
source: Sound Wave
translation: 音波

label: SPECIES_NOIVERN.description
source:
They fly around on moonless nights and
attack careless prey. The ultrasonic
waves it emits from its ears can reduce
a large boulder to pebbles.
translation: 用耳朵发出的超音波\n连巨大的岩石都能粉碎。\n混在黑暗中发动袭击。

label: SPECIES_XERNEAS_NEUTRAL.speciesName
source: XERNEAS
translation: 哲尔尼亚斯

label: SPECIES_XERNEAS_NEUTRAL.categoryName
source: Life
translation: 生命

label: SPECIES_XERNEAS_ACTIVE.speciesName
source: XERNEAS
translation: 哲尔尼亚斯

label: SPECIES_XERNEAS_ACTIVE.categoryName
source: Life
translation: 生命

label: SPECIES_YVELTAL.speciesName
source: YVELTAL
translation: 伊裴尔塔尔

label: SPECIES_YVELTAL.categoryName
source: Destruction
translation: 破坏

label: SPECIES_YVELTAL.description
source:
When its life comes to an end, its wings
and tail spread wide and glow red, and
it absorbs the life energy of every living
thing and turns into a cocoon.
translation: 听说，寿命终结时，\n会吸光所有生物的生命，\n返回到茧的样子。

label: SPECIES_ZYGARDE_50.speciesName
source: ZYGARDE
translation: 基格尔德

label: SPECIES_ZYGARDE_50.categoryName
source: Order
translation: 秩序

label: SPECIES_ZYGARDE_50_POWER_CONSTRUCT.speciesName
source: ZYGARDE
translation: 基格尔德

label: SPECIES_ZYGARDE_50_POWER_CONSTRUCT.categoryName
source: Order
translation: 秩序

label: SPECIES_ZYGARDE_10_AURA_BREAK.speciesName
source: ZYGARDE
translation: 基格尔德

label: SPECIES_ZYGARDE_10_AURA_BREAK.categoryName
source: Order
translation: 秩序

label: SPECIES_ZYGARDE_10_POWER_CONSTRUCT.speciesName
source: ZYGARDE
translation: 基格尔德

label: SPECIES_ZYGARDE_10_POWER_CONSTRUCT.categoryName
source: Order
translation: 秩序

label: SPECIES_ZYGARDE_COMPLETE.speciesName
source: ZYGARDE
translation: 基格尔德

label: SPECIES_ZYGARDE_COMPLETE.categoryName
source: Order
translation: 秩序

label: SPECIES_ZYGARDE_COMPLETE.description
source:
This is Zygarde's perfected form.
From the orifice on its chest, it
radiates high-powered energy that
eliminates everything.
translation: 所有基格尔德细胞聚集后诞生而成。\n会用武力镇压破坏生态系统者。

label: SPECIES_ZYGARDE_MEGA.categoryName
source: Order
translation: 秩序

label: SPECIES_ZYGARDE_MEGA.description
source:
In response to people's emotions
during an unprecedented crisis,
Zygarde Mega Evolves and calms the
situation with its unmatched power.
translation: 当空前的危机来临时，\n感受人类的思绪而超级进化。\n能用无双之力将事态平息。

label: SPECIES_DIANCIE.speciesName
source: DIANCIE
translation: 蒂安希

label: SPECIES_DIANCIE.categoryName
source: Jewel
translation: 宝石

label: SPECIES_DIANCIE.description
source:
A sudden transformation of Carbink,
its pink, glimmering body is said to be
the loveliest sight in the whole world.
It creates diamonds between its hands.
translation: 将空气中的碳元素压缩在两手之间，\n一瞬间制造出许多的钻石。

label: SPECIES_DIANCIE_MEGA.categoryName
source: Jewel
translation: 宝石

label: SPECIES_DIANCIE_MEGA.description
source:
The impurities upon its body's surface
have fallen away, sparkling so brilliantly
that cannot be observed directly.
It is known as “the Royal Pink Princess”.
translation: 当体表的杂质剥落，\n沐浴在光芒中时，\n耀眼得无法直视。

label: SPECIES_HOOPA_CONFINED.speciesName
source: HOOPA
translation: 胡帕

label: SPECIES_HOOPA_CONFINED.categoryName
source: Mischief
translation: 顽童

label: SPECIES_HOOPA_CONFINED.description
source:
In its true form, it possess a huge amount
of power. When its powers are sealed away,
it is transformed into a much smaller form.
It teleports things to a secret place.
translation: 据说会用6个圆环和6个巨大的\n手臂夺走一切东西。\n被封印了力量而变成了小小的样子。

label: SPECIES_HOOPA_UNBOUND.speciesName
source: HOOPA
translation: 胡帕

label: SPECIES_HOOPA_UNBOUND.categoryName
source: Djinn
translation: 魔神

label: SPECIES_HOOPA_UNBOUND.description
source:
It is the true form of Hoopa, which has had
its power sealed away. The rings it carries
have the power to bend dimensions and are
able to seize anything in the world.
translation: 拥有着巨大的力量的真正的样子。\n传说，因为对财宝的欲望，曾将藏着\n财宝的整个城堡连根拔起夺走。

label: SPECIES_VOLCANION.speciesName
source: VOLCANION
translation: 波尔凯尼恩

label: SPECIES_VOLCANION.categoryName
source: Steam
translation: 蒸汽

label: SPECIES_VOLCANION.description
source:
It lets out billows of steam from the arms
on its back and disappears into the dense
fog. It's said to live in mountains where
humans do not tread.
translation: 从背上的手臂里喷射出体内的水蒸气。\n有着把整座山一下子吹飞的威力。

label: SPECIES_ROWLET.speciesName
source: ROWLET
translation: 木木枭

label: SPECIES_ROWLET.categoryName
source: Grass Quill
translation: 草羽

label: SPECIES_ROWLET.description
source:
This wary Pokémon uses photosynthesis
to store up energy during the day, while
becoming active at night. Silently it
glides, drawing near to its target.
translation: 在狭窄黑暗的地方会很平静。\n有时候也会用训练家的\n怀抱或包包代替巢穴。

label: SPECIES_DARTRIX.speciesName
source: DARTRIX
translation: 投羽枭

label: SPECIES_DARTRIX.categoryName
source: Blade Quill
translation: 刃羽

label: SPECIES_DARTRIX.description
source:
A bit of a dandy, it spends its free time
preening its wings. Its preoccupation
with any dirt on its plumage can leave
it unable to battle.
translation: 将被称为刃羽的锐利\n羽毛投向敌人和猎物。\n基本上百发百中。

label: SPECIES_DECIDUEYE.speciesName
source: DECIDUEYE
translation: 狙射树枭

label: SPECIES_DECIDUEYE.categoryName
source: Arrow Quill
translation: 箭羽

label: SPECIES_DECIDUEYE.description
source:
Decidueye is cool and cautious.
It fires arrow quills from its wings with
such precision, they can pierce a pebble
at distances of over a hundred yards.
translation: 会搭上箭羽射向对手。\n在绝对不想射偏时，\n会拉紧头上的藤蔓集中精神。

label: SPECIES_DECIDUEYE_HISUI.description
source:
The air stored inside the rachises
of Decidueye's feathers insulates
the Pokémon against Hisui's extreme
cold.
translation: 为抵抗洗翠的严寒气候，\n羽毛的芯中含有空气，因而能够防寒。\n由此可见环境会对进化产生影响。

label: SPECIES_LITTEN.speciesName
source: LITTEN
translation: 火斑喵

label: SPECIES_LITTEN.categoryName
source: Fire Cat
translation: 火猫

label: SPECIES_LITTEN.description
source:
While grooming itself, it builds up fur
inside its stomach. It sets the fur alight
and spews fiery attacks, which change
based on how it coughs.
translation: 通过理毛然后将积在腹中的落毛燃烧，\n喷出火焰。根据吐毛的方式不同，\n火焰也会变化。

label: SPECIES_TORRACAT.speciesName
source: TORRACAT
translation: 炎热喵

label: SPECIES_TORRACAT.categoryName
source: Fire Cat
translation: 火猫

label: SPECIES_TORRACAT.description
source:
At its throat, it bears a bell of fire. The
bell rings brightly whenever this Pokémon
spits fire. With a single punch, it can bend
an iron bar right over.
translation: 如果亲近了，也会对训练家撒娇，\n但是力量很强且爪子也很锋利，\n所以会被弄得全身是伤。

label: SPECIES_INCINEROAR.speciesName
source: INCINEROAR
translation: 炽焰咆哮虎

label: SPECIES_INCINEROAR.categoryName
source: Heel
translation: 反派

label: SPECIES_INCINEROAR.description
source:
This Pokémon has a violent, selfish
disposition. If it's not in the mood to
listen, it will ignore its Trainer's orders
with complete nonchalance.
translation: 在使出猛烈的拳击或脚踢后，\n会从肚脐周围喷出火焰，\n将敌人一击毙命。

label: SPECIES_POPPLIO.speciesName
source: POPPLIO
translation: 球球海狮

label: SPECIES_POPPLIO.categoryName
source: Sea Lion
translation: 海狮

label: SPECIES_POPPLIO.description
source:
This Pokémon snorts body fluids from
its nose, blowing balloons to smash into
its foes. It practices diligently so it can
learn to make big bubbles.
translation: 通过每天不断地重复练习，\n用鼻子吹起来的气球\n一点点地变大起来。

label: SPECIES_BRIONNE.speciesName
source: BRIONNE
translation: 花漾海狮

label: SPECIES_BRIONNE.categoryName
source: Pop Star
translation: 偶像

label: SPECIES_BRIONNE.description
source:
It cares deeply for its companions.
When its Trainer is feeling down, it
performs a cheery dance with a sequence
of water balloons  to try and help.
translation: 非常关心自己的伙伴。\n训练家如果情绪低落，\n就会跳舞给予鼓励。

label: SPECIES_PRIMARINA.speciesName
source: PRIMARINA
translation: 西狮海壬

label: SPECIES_PRIMARINA.categoryName
source: Soloist
translation: 独唱者

label: SPECIES_PRIMARINA.description
source:
It controls its water balloons with song.
The melody is learned from others of
its kind and is passed down from one
generation to the next.
translation: 拥有歌姬这个别名。\n在月夜率领群体唱歌的\n样子充满了幻想色彩。

label: SPECIES_PIKIPEK.speciesName
source: PIKIPEK
translation: 小笃儿

label: SPECIES_PIKIPEK.categoryName
source: Woodpecker
translation: 啄木鸟

label: SPECIES_PIKIPEK.description
source:
This Pokémon feeds on berries, whose
leftover seeds become the ammunition for
the attacks it fires off from its mouth.
It uses holes in trees for nesting.
translation: 颈部的肌肉很强壮，\n因此即使激烈摇晃头部，\n也完全不会有损伤。

label: SPECIES_TRUMBEAK.speciesName
source: TRUMBEAK
translation: 喇叭啄鸟

label: SPECIES_TRUMBEAK.categoryName
source: Bugle Beak
translation: 喇叭喙

label: SPECIES_TRUMBEAK.description
source:
By bending its beak, it can produce a
variety of calls and brand itself a noisy
nuisance for its neighbors. It eats
berries and stores their seeds in its beak.
translation: 遇到敌人时，\n会把大量储藏在鸟嘴里的\n树果种子呈放射状地发射出去。

label: SPECIES_TOUCANNON.speciesName
source: TOUCANNON
translation: 铳嘴大鸟

label: SPECIES_TOUCANNON.categoryName
source: Cannon
translation: 铳炮

label: SPECIES_TOUCANNON.description
source:
When it battles, within its beak, its
internal gases ignite, explosively
launching seeds with enough power to
pulverize boulders.
translation: 成双成对的铳嘴大鸟会通过\n提高鸟嘴的温度来互相取暖，\n因此被视为是感情好的象征。

label: SPECIES_YUNGOOS.speciesName
source: YUNGOOS
translation: 猫鼬少

label: SPECIES_YUNGOOS.categoryName
source: Loitering
translation: 巡回

label: SPECIES_YUNGOOS.description
source:
With its sharp fangs, it will bite anything.
It wanders around in a never-ending
search for food. At dusk, it collapses
and falls asleep on the spot.
translation: 醒着的时候总是在持续觅食。\n一旦肚子饿了就会变得更加地凶暴。

label: SPECIES_GUMSHOOS.speciesName
source: GUMSHOOS
translation: 猫鼬探长

label: SPECIES_GUMSHOOS.categoryName
source: Stakeout
translation: 蹲守

label: SPECIES_GUMSHOOS_TOTEM.speciesName
source: GUMSHOOS
translation: 猫鼬探长

label: SPECIES_GUMSHOOS_TOTEM.categoryName
source: Stakeout
translation: 蹲守

label: SPECIES_GRUBBIN.speciesName
source: GRUBBIN
translation: 强颚鸡母虫

label: SPECIES_GRUBBIN.categoryName
source: Larva
translation: 幼虫

label: SPECIES_GRUBBIN.description
source:
They often gather near places frequented
by electric Pokémon in order to avoid being
attacked by bird Pokémon, though it
normally lives underground.
translation: 会吐出黏黏的丝缠住树枝，\n并摇摆身躯在树木之间\n轻巧地飞跃移动。

label: SPECIES_CHARJABUG.speciesName
source: CHARJABUG
translation: 虫电宝

label: SPECIES_CHARJABUG.categoryName
source: Battery
translation: 蓄电池

label: SPECIES_CHARJABUG.description
source:
From the food it digests, it generates
electricity, and it stores this energy in
its electric sac. On camping trips, people
are grateful to have one around.
translation: 虫电宝消化吃掉的落叶时\n能产生电能并将其储蓄。\n会从颚部的尖端放出电流。

label: SPECIES_VIKAVOLT.speciesName
source: VIKAVOLT
translation: 锹农炮虫

label: SPECIES_VIKAVOLT.categoryName
source: Stag Beetle
translation: 锹形虫

label: SPECIES_VIKAVOLT_TOTEM.speciesName
source: VIKAVOLT
translation: 锹农炮虫

label: SPECIES_VIKAVOLT_TOTEM.categoryName
source: Stag Beetle
translation: 锹形虫

label: SPECIES_CRABRAWLER.speciesName
source: CRABRAWLER
translation: 好胜蟹

label: SPECIES_CRABRAWLER.categoryName
source: Boxing
translation: 拳斗

label: SPECIES_CRABRAWLER.description
source:
While guarding its weak points with its
pincers, it looks for an opening and
unleashes punches. When it loses, it
foams at the mouth and faints.
translation: 钳子即使脱落也会马上长出来。\n外壳可以提取出美味的汤头，\n是很受欢迎的海鲜炖饭食材。

label: SPECIES_CRABOMINABLE.speciesName
source: CRABOMINABLE
translation: 好胜毛蟹

label: SPECIES_CRABOMINABLE.categoryName
source: Woolly Crab
translation: 毛蟹

label: SPECIES_CRABOMINABLE.description
source:
It aimed for the top but got lost and
ended up on a snowy mountain. Being forced
to endure the cold, this Pokémon evolved
and grew thick fur.
translation: 拳击虽强，动作却慢。\n会从口里喷出结冰的泡沫\n来封住对手的行动。

label: SPECIES_CRABOMINABLE_MEGA.categoryName
source: Woolly Crab
translation: 毛蟹

label: SPECIES_CRABOMINABLE_MEGA.description
source: It can pulverize reinforced concrete with\na light swing of one of its fists, each of\nwhich is covered in a thick layer of ice.
translation: 被厚厚的冰所包覆的\n拳头只需要轻轻一挥，\n连钢筋混凝土都能粉碎。

label: SPECIES_ORICORIO_BAILE.speciesName
source: ORICORIO
translation: 花舞鸟

label: SPECIES_ORICORIO_BAILE.categoryName
source: Dancing
translation: 舞蹈

label: SPECIES_ORICORIO_BAILE.description
source:
It wins the hearts of its enemies
with its passionate dancing and then
uses the opening it creates to
burn them up with blazing flames.
translation: 吸食了朱红色花蜜的样子。\n会踩着热情的舞步，\n卷起猛烈的火焰。

label: SPECIES_ORICORIO_POM_POM.speciesName
source: ORICORIO
translation: 花舞鸟

label: SPECIES_ORICORIO_POM_POM.categoryName
source: Dancing
translation: 舞蹈

label: SPECIES_ORICORIO_POM_POM.description
source:
This form of Oricorio has sipped
yellow nectar. It uses nimble steps to
approach opponents, then knocks
them out with electric punches.
translation: 吸食了桃粉色花蜜的样子。\n会踏着缓慢的舞步来集中精神，\n然后释放精神力量。

label: SPECIES_ORICORIO_PAU.speciesName
source: ORICORIO
translation: 花舞鸟

label: SPECIES_ORICORIO_PAU.categoryName
source: Dancing
translation: 舞蹈

label: SPECIES_ORICORIO_PAU.description
source:
This form of Oricorio has sipped
pink nectar. It elevates its mind with
the gentle steps of its dance, then
unleashes its psychic energy.
translation: 吸食了金黄色花蜜的样子。\n会以轻快的舞步靠近对手并用\n电击拳头将其 KO。

label: SPECIES_ORICORIO_SENSU.speciesName
source: ORICORIO
translation: 花舞鸟

label: SPECIES_ORICORIO_SENSU.categoryName
source: Dancing
translation: 舞蹈

label: SPECIES_ORICORIO_SENSU.description
source:
It charms its opponents with its
refined dancing. When they let their
guard down, it places a curse on
them that will bring on their demise.
translation: 吸食了兰紫色花蜜的样子。\n会通过奇幻的舞步\n召唤出死者的灵魂。

label: SPECIES_CUTIEFLY.speciesName
source: CUTIEFLY
translation: 萌虻

label: SPECIES_CUTIEFLY.categoryName
source: Bee Fly
translation: 蜂虻

label: SPECIES_CUTIEFLY.description
source:
Myriads of Cutiefly flutter above the
heads of people who have auras resembling
those of flowers. It can identify which
flowers are about to bloom.
translation: 会用长长的嘴吸取花粉和蜜。\n吃不完的花粉则会\n被它储蓄在体毛的缝隙间。

label: SPECIES_RIBOMBEE.speciesName
source: RIBOMBEE
translation: 蝶结萌虻

label: SPECIES_RIBOMBEE.categoryName
source: Bee Fly
translation: 蜂虻

label: SPECIES_RIBOMBEE_TOTEM.speciesName
source: RIBOMBEE
translation: 蝶结萌虻

label: SPECIES_RIBOMBEE_TOTEM.categoryName
source: Bee Fly
translation: 蜂虻

label: SPECIES_ROCKRUFF.speciesName
source: ROCKRUFF
translation: 岩狗狗

label: SPECIES_ROCKRUFF.categoryName
source: Puppy
translation: 小狗

label: SPECIES_ROCKRUFF_OWN_TEMPO.speciesName
source: ROCKRUFF
translation: 岩狗狗

label: SPECIES_ROCKRUFF_OWN_TEMPO.categoryName
source: Puppy
translation: 小狗

label: SPECIES_LYCANROC_MIDDAY.speciesName
source: LYCANROC
translation: 鬃岩狼人

label: SPECIES_LYCANROC_MIDDAY.categoryName
source: Wolf
translation: 狼

label: SPECIES_LYCANROC_MIDDAY.description
source:
It has a calm and collected
demeanor. It swiftly closes in on its prey,
then slices them with the rocks in
its mane.
translation: 性情沉着冷静。\n会迅速地接近猎物，\n然后用鬃毛岩石将其击碎。

label: SPECIES_LYCANROC_MIDNIGHT.speciesName
source: LYCANROC
translation: 鬃岩狼人

label: SPECIES_LYCANROC_MIDNIGHT.categoryName
source: Wolf
translation: 狼

label: SPECIES_LYCANROC_MIDNIGHT.description
source:
This Pokémon uses its rocky mane
to slash any who approach. It will
even disobey its Trainer if it dislikes
the orders it was given.
translation: 性情十分粗暴。\n只要是为了解决掉对手，\n就算会伤害到自己也无所谓。

label: SPECIES_LYCANROC_DUSK.speciesName
source: LYCANROC
translation: 鬃岩狼人

label: SPECIES_LYCANROC_DUSK.categoryName
source: Wolf
translation: 狼

label: SPECIES_LYCANROC_DUSK.description
source:
These Pokémon have both calm and
ferocious qualities. It's said that
this form of Lycanroc is the most
troublesome to raise.
translation: 性情冷静又凶猛。\n据说这个样子的鬃岩狼人\n培育起来最费工夫。

label: SPECIES_WISHIWASHI_SOLO.speciesName
source: WISHIWASHI
translation: 弱丁鱼

label: SPECIES_WISHIWASHI_SOLO.categoryName
source: Small Fry
translation: 小鱼

label: SPECIES_WISHIWASHI_SOLO.description
source:
Individually, they're incredibly
weak. It's by gathering up into
schools that they're able to confront
opponents.
translation: 感觉到危险时眼睛就会变得湿润。\n眼泪的光亮会成为召集伙伴的信号，\n让许多的弱丁鱼聚在一起。

label: SPECIES_WISHIWASHI_SCHOOL.speciesName
source: WISHIWASHI
translation: 弱丁鱼

label: SPECIES_WISHIWASHI_SCHOOL.categoryName
source: Small Fry
translation: 小鱼

label: SPECIES_WISHIWASHI_SCHOOL.description
source:
When facing tough opponents, they
get into formation. But if they get
wounded in battle, they'll scatter
and become solitary again.
translation: 组成阵形来对抗强大的敌人。\n如果在战斗中受伤，\n便会散开回到一只一只的样子。

label: SPECIES_MAREANIE.speciesName
source: MAREANIE
translation: 好坏星

label: SPECIES_MAREANIE.categoryName
source: Brutal Star
translation: 非星

label: SPECIES_MAREANIE.description
source:
It's found crawling on beaches and
seafloors. The coral that grows on
Corsola's head is as good as a five-star
banquet to this Pokémon.
translation: 它的再生能力非常强大。\n断掉的脚有着强烈的苦味和涩味，\n不适合用作食材。

label: SPECIES_TOXAPEX.speciesName
source: TOXAPEX
translation: 超坏星

label: SPECIES_TOXAPEX.categoryName
source: Brutal Star
translation: 非星

label: SPECIES_TOXAPEX.description
source:
Those attacked by Toxapex's poison will
suffer intense pain for three days and
three nights. Post-recovery, there will be
some aftereffects.
translation: 虽然会为了争夺暖流的流向之处\n而跟磨牙彩皮鱼展开激战，\n但胜算不高。

label: SPECIES_MUDBRAY.speciesName
source: MUDBRAY
translation: 泥驴仔

label: SPECIES_MUDBRAY.categoryName
source: Donkey
translation: 驴

label: SPECIES_MUDBRAY.description
source:
The mud stuck to Mudbray's hooves
enhances its grip and its powerful running
gait. Eating dirt, making mud, and playing
in the mire form its daily routine.
translation: 走路虽慢，力气却很大。\n即使背着比自己重50倍的行李，\n走路速度也不会有变化。

label: SPECIES_MUDSDALE.speciesName
source: MUDSDALE
translation: 重泥挽马

label: SPECIES_MUDSDALE.categoryName
source: Draft Horse
translation: 挽马

label: SPECIES_MUDSDALE.description
source:
Its heavy, mud-covered kicks are its
best means of attack, and it can reduce
large trucks to scrap without breaking
a sweat.
translation: 泥巴使它的蹄子变得比岩石还要坚硬，\n只要一记踢击就能\n让大型卡车变成废铁。

label: SPECIES_DEWPIDER.speciesName
source: DEWPIDER
translation: 滴蛛

label: SPECIES_DEWPIDER.categoryName
source: Water Bubble
translation: 水泡

label: SPECIES_DEWPIDER.description
source:
It crawls onto the land in search of food.
When it comes across enemies or potential
prey, this Pokémon smashes its
water-bubble-covered head into them.
translation: 用3条腿支撑包裹头部的水泡。\n有时会偷偷地换腿。

label: SPECIES_ARAQUANID.speciesName
source: ARAQUANID
translation: 滴蛛霸

label: SPECIES_ARAQUANID.categoryName
source: Water Bubble
translation: 水泡

label: SPECIES_ARAQUANID_TOTEM.speciesName
source: ARAQUANID
translation: 滴蛛霸

label: SPECIES_ARAQUANID_TOTEM.categoryName
source: Water Bubble
translation: 水泡

label: SPECIES_FOMANTIS.speciesName
source: FOMANTIS
translation: 伪螳草

label: SPECIES_FOMANTIS.categoryName
source: Sickle Grass
translation: 镰草

label: SPECIES_FOMANTIS.description
source:
During the day, it sleeps and soaks up
light. They give off a sweet and refreshing
scent. Cutiefly often gather near the tall
grass where Fomantis are hiding.
translation: 有很多训练家会\n给伪螳草它专用的花盆，\n好让它能平静地享受日光浴。

label: SPECIES_LURANTIS.speciesName
source: LURANTIS
translation: 兰螳花

label: SPECIES_LURANTIS.categoryName
source: Bloom Sickle
translation: 花镰

label: SPECIES_LURANTIS_TOTEM.speciesName
source: LURANTIS
translation: 兰螳花

label: SPECIES_LURANTIS_TOTEM.categoryName
source: Bloom Sickle
translation: 花镰

label: SPECIES_MORELULL.speciesName
source: MORELULL
translation: 睡睡菇

label: SPECIES_MORELULL.categoryName
source: Illuminate
translation: 发光

label: SPECIES_MORELULL.description
source:
As it drowses the day away, it nourishes
itself by sucking from tree roots.
It wakens at the fall of night, wandering
off in search of a new tree.
translation: 白天也生活在昏暗的森林里。\n会一边闪烁一边散播发光的\n孢子来让敌人陷入沉睡。

label: SPECIES_SHIINOTIC.speciesName
source: SHIINOTIC
translation: 灯罩夜菇

label: SPECIES_SHIINOTIC.categoryName
source: Illuminate
translation: 发光

label: SPECIES_SHIINOTIC.description
source:
Forests where Shiinotic live are
treacherous to enter at night.
People confused by its strange lights
can never find their way home again.
translation: 如果大半夜在森林的深处看见光亮，\n记住千万不要接近。\n灯罩夜菇会让你睡着的。

label: SPECIES_SALANDIT.speciesName
source: SALANDIT
translation: 夜盗火蜥

label: SPECIES_SALANDIT.categoryName
source: Toxic Lizard
translation: 毒蜥

label: SPECIES_SALANDIT.description
source:
It burns its bodily fluids to create a
sweet-smelling poisonous gas. When its
enemies become disoriented from inhaling
the gas, it attacks them.
translation: 唯有雌性造出的气体会释放费洛蒙。\n被迷得神魂颠倒的\n雄性会对雌性唯命是从。

label: SPECIES_SALAZZLE.speciesName
source: SALAZZLE
translation: 焰后蜥

label: SPECIES_SALAZZLE.categoryName
source: Toxic Lizard
translation: 毒蜥

label: SPECIES_SALAZZLE_TOTEM.speciesName
source: SALAZZLE
translation: 焰后蜥

label: SPECIES_SALAZZLE_TOTEM.categoryName
source: Toxic Lizard
translation: 毒蜥

label: SPECIES_STUFFUL.speciesName
source: STUFFUL
translation: 童偶熊

label: SPECIES_STUFFUL.categoryName
source: Flailing
translation: 抓狂

label: SPECIES_STUFFUL.description
source:
Despite its adorable appearance, when it
gets angry and flails about, its arms and
legs could knock a pro wrestler sprawling.
It's an incredibly dangerous Pokémon.
translation: 为了保护自己的身体而\n胡乱挥舞前脚的样子虽然可爱，\n威力却大到能将大树折断。

label: SPECIES_BEWEAR.speciesName
source: BEWEAR
translation: 穿着熊

label: SPECIES_BEWEAR.categoryName
source: Strong Arm
translation: 强臂

label: SPECIES_BEWEAR.description
source:
This Pokémon has the habit of hugging its
companions. Many Trainers have left this
world after their spines were squashed
by its hug.
translation: 会用令格斗家都无地自容的\n技术把逮住的猎物夹在腋下，\n带回自己的住处。

label: SPECIES_BOUNSWEET.speciesName
source: BOUNSWEET
translation: 甜竹竹

label: SPECIES_BOUNSWEET.categoryName
source: Fruit
translation: 水果

label: SPECIES_BOUNSWEET.description
source:
A delectable aroma pours from its body. 
Bounsweet's sweat can be watered down
into a juice with just the right amount
of sweetness.
translation: 被它甜甜的香气吸引而来的藏饱栗鼠\n会用尾巴将它和树果一起裹起来带走。

label: SPECIES_STEENEE.speciesName
source: STEENEE
translation: 甜舞妮

label: SPECIES_STEENEE.categoryName
source: Fruit
translation: 水果

label: SPECIES_STEENEE.description
source:
The sepals on its head developed to
protect its body. These are quite hard, so
even if pecked by bird Pokémon, this
Pokémon is totally fine.
translation: 在森林里活力四射地蹦跳。\n磨碎它脱落的皮，\n就可以用来当作治疗肚子疼的药。

label: SPECIES_TSAREENA.speciesName
source: TSAREENA
translation: 甜冷美后

label: SPECIES_TSAREENA.categoryName
source: Fruit
translation: 水果

label: SPECIES_TSAREENA.description
source:
Its long, striking legs aren't just for
show but to be used to kick with skill.
In victory, it shows off by kicking the
defeated, laughing boisterously.
translation: 用苗条的双腿施展优雅而猛烈的踢技。\n敌视狂欢浪舞鸭。

label: SPECIES_COMFEY.speciesName
source: COMFEY
translation: 花疗环环

label: SPECIES_COMFEY.categoryName
source: Posy Picker
translation: 摘花

label: SPECIES_COMFEY.description
source:
It attaches flowers to its nutritious
vine. Baths prepared with the flowers
from its vine have a relaxing effect, so
this Pokémon is a hit with many people.
translation: 身上附着花时会很开心，\n并发挥出治愈的效果。\n喜欢有很多花的地方。

label: SPECIES_ORANGURU.speciesName
source: ORANGURU
translation: 智挥猩

label: SPECIES_ORANGURU.categoryName
source: Sage
translation: 贤者

label: SPECIES_ORANGURU.description
source:
Deep in the jungle, high in the lofty
canopy, this Pokémon abides. On rare
occasions, it shows up at the beach to
match wits with Slowking.
translation: 在森林深处过着安静的生活。\n如同斗篷般的紫色体毛\n会随着年龄越来越长。

label: SPECIES_PASSIMIAN.speciesName
source: PASSIMIAN
translation: 投掷猴

label: SPECIES_PASSIMIAN.categoryName
source: Teamwork
translation: 配合

label: SPECIES_PASSIMIAN.description
source:
They battle with hard berries for weapons.
They form groups of about 20 individuals.
Their techniques are passed from the boss
to the group, generation upon generation.
translation: 老大会选出10只外出狩猎，\n并把它们带回来的食物平均\n分配给群体中的伙伴。

label: SPECIES_WIMPOD.speciesName
source: WIMPOD
translation: 胆小虫

label: SPECIES_WIMPOD.categoryName
source: Turn Tail
translation: 疾行

label: SPECIES_WIMPOD.description
source:
This Pokémon is a coward. As it desperately
dashes off, the flailing of its many legs
leaves a sparkling clean path in its wake.
It lives on beaches and seabeds.
translation: 成群聚集，随时提高警惕。\n只要察觉到有敌人，\n就会分散开来四处逃窜。

label: SPECIES_GOLISOPOD.speciesName
source: GOLISOPOD
translation: 具甲武者

label: SPECIES_GOLISOPOD.categoryName
source: Hard Scale
translation: 装甲

label: SPECIES_GOLISOPOD.description
source:
It battles skillfully with its six arms,
with a flashing slash of its giant sharp
claws, it cleaves seawater--or even
air--right in two.
translation: 生活在海底的洞窟或沉船里。\n会去和八爪武师决战，\n输掉的一方便会成为对方的食物。

label: SPECIES_GOLISOPOD_MEGA.categoryName
source: Hard Scale
translation: 装甲

label: SPECIES_GOLISOPOD_MEGA.description
source:
It uses four of its arms to fiercely
assail its foes. Once they've been pushed
to the brink of defeat, it finishes them
off with the arms it kept hidden.
translation: 用4根臂膀猛烈地攻击，\n将对手逼入绝境后，就会用\n隐藏的臂膀给予致命一击。

label: SPECIES_SANDYGAST.speciesName
source: SANDYGAST
translation: 沙丘娃

label: SPECIES_SANDYGAST.categoryName
source: Sand Heap
translation: 沙丘

label: SPECIES_SANDYGAST.description
source:
It takes control of anyone who puts a
hand in its mouth, to add to the pile
of its sand-mound body. This Pokémon
embodies the grudges of the departed.
translation: 会用沙子攻击猎物的眼睛后趁机接近，\n但却总是因为行动缓慢而让猎物逃走。

label: SPECIES_PALOSSAND.speciesName
source: PALOSSAND
translation: 噬沙堡爷

label: SPECIES_PALOSSAND.categoryName
source: Sand Castle
translation: 沙堡

label: SPECIES_PALOSSAND.description
source:
Possessed people controlled by this
Pokémon transformed its sand mound into
a castle. As it evolved, its power to curse
grew ever stronger.
translation: 会把对手的生命能量吸个精光。\n然后从手臂的凹陷处把骸骨发射出去。

label: SPECIES_PYUKUMUKU.speciesName
source: PYUKUMUKU
translation: 拳海参

label: SPECIES_PYUKUMUKU.categoryName
source: Sea Cucumber
translation: 海参

label: SPECIES_PYUKUMUKU.description
source:
It lives in shallow seas, such as areas
near a beach. The sticky mucous that
covers their bodies can be used to soothe
sunburned skin. How convenient!
translation: 覆盖着皮肤的粘液\n具有出众的保湿效果，\n即使在陆地上待好几天也不会干掉。

label: SPECIES_TYPE_NULL.speciesName
source: TYPE: NULL
translation: 属性：空

label: SPECIES_TYPE_NULL.categoryName
source: Synthetic
translation: 人工

label: SPECIES_TYPE_NULL.description
source:
Due to the danger that this synthetic
Pokémon may go on a rampage, it wears a
control mask to restrain its capabilities.
It has some hidden special power.
translation: 以神话中的宝可梦为原型\n所创造出的宝可梦，\n被戴上了抑制力量失控的面罩。

label: gSpeciesInfoGen7.speciesName
source: SILVALLY
translation: 银伴战兽

label: gSpeciesInfoGen7.categoryName
source: Synthetic
translation: 人工

label: gSpeciesInfoGen7.speciesName
source: MINIOR
translation: 小陨星

label: gSpeciesInfoGen7.categoryName
source: Meteor
translation: 流星

label: SPECIES_KOMALA.speciesName
source: KOMALA
translation: 树枕尾熊

label: SPECIES_KOMALA.categoryName
source: Drowsing
translation: 半梦半醒

label: SPECIES_KOMALA.description
source:
It is born asleep, and it dies asleep.
All its movements are apparently no more
than the results of it tossing and turning
in its dreams.
translation: 树枕尾熊的口水经过稀释后，\n就会变成强效的麻醉药。\n过去曾被用在手术上。

label: SPECIES_TURTONATOR.speciesName
source: TURTONATOR
translation: 爆焰龟兽

label: SPECIES_TURTONATOR.categoryName
source: Blast Turtle
translation: 爆炸龟

label: SPECIES_TURTONATOR.description
source:
The shell on its back is chemically
unstable and explodes violently if struck.
The hole in its stomach is its weak point.
It gushes fire from its nostrils.
translation: 在火山上生活，吃下的硫磺就是\n甲壳上炸药的原料。\n连粪便也会爆炸，十分危险。

label: SPECIES_TOGEDEMARU.speciesName
source: TOGEDEMARU
translation: 托戈德玛尔

label: SPECIES_TOGEDEMARU.categoryName
source: Roly-Poly
translation: 蜷缩

label: SPECIES_TOGEDEMARU_TOTEM.speciesName
source: TOGEDEMARU
translation: 托戈德玛尔

label: SPECIES_TOGEDEMARU_TOTEM.categoryName
source: Roly-Poly
translation: 蜷缩

label: SPECIES_MIMIKYU_DISGUISED.speciesName
source: MIMIKYU
translation: 谜拟丘

label: SPECIES_MIMIKYU_DISGUISED.categoryName
source: Disguise
translation: 画皮

label: SPECIES_MIMIKYU_BUSTED.speciesName
source: MIMIKYU
translation: 谜拟丘

label: SPECIES_MIMIKYU_BUSTED.categoryName
source: Disguise
translation: 画皮

label: SPECIES_MIMIKYU_TOTEM_DISGUISED.speciesName
source: MIMIKYU
translation: 谜拟丘

label: SPECIES_MIMIKYU_TOTEM_DISGUISED.categoryName
source: Disguise
translation: 画皮

label: SPECIES_MIMIKYU_BUSTED_TOTEM.speciesName
source: MIMIKYU
translation: 谜拟丘

label: SPECIES_MIMIKYU_BUSTED_TOTEM.categoryName
source: Disguise
translation: 画皮

label: SPECIES_BRUXISH.speciesName
source: BRUXISH
translation: 磨牙彩皮鱼

label: SPECIES_BRUXISH.categoryName
source: Gnash Teeth
translation: 磨牙

label: SPECIES_BRUXISH.description
source:
It stuns its prey with its psychic powers
and then grinds them to mush with its
strong teeth. Even Shellder's shell is no
match for it.
translation: 磨牙时会泛起波纹。\n当阳光反射在上面，\n周围的水会闪起令人目眩的亮光。

label: SPECIES_DRAMPA.speciesName
source: DRAMPA
translation: 老翁龙

label: SPECIES_DRAMPA.categoryName
source: Placid
translation: 悠游

label: SPECIES_DRAMPA.description
source:
This Pokémon is friendly to people and
loves children most of all. It comes from
deep in the mountains to play with
children it likes in town.
translation: 心地善良爱亲近人，\n但只要生气就会刮起强风吹倒一切。

label: SPECIES_DRAMPA_MEGA.categoryName
source: Imposing
translation: 堂堂

label: SPECIES_DRAMPA_MEGA.description
source:
Drampa's cells have been
invigorated, allowing it to regain
its youth. It manipulates the
atmosphere to summon storms.
translation: 激活全身细胞，\n恢复青春后的模样。\n能操控大气，呼风唤雨。

label: SPECIES_DHELMISE.speciesName
source: DHELMISE
translation: 破破舵轮

label: SPECIES_DHELMISE.categoryName
source: Sea Creeper
translation: 碎藻

label: SPECIES_DHELMISE.description
source:
The soul of seaweed adrift in the waves
became reborn as this Pokémon.
It maintains itself with new infusions of
seabed detritus and seaweed.
translation: 把锚抛到海里，伏击猎物。\n会去捕捉巨大的吼鲸王，\n吸取它们的精气。

label: SPECIES_JANGMO_O.speciesName
source: JANGMO-O
translation: 心鳞宝

label: SPECIES_JANGMO_O.categoryName
source: Scaly
translation: 鳞片

label: SPECIES_JANGMO_O.description
source:
It expresses its feelings by smacking its
scales. Metallic sounds echo through the
tall mountains where Jangmo-o live. They
grow little by little battling one another.
translation: 通过敲击鳞片的声音来和伙伴交流。\n聚在一起时就会非常吵。

label: SPECIES_HAKAMO_O.speciesName
source: HAKAMO-O
translation: 鳞甲龙

label: SPECIES_HAKAMO_O.categoryName
source: Scaly
translation: 鳞片

label: SPECIES_HAKAMO_O.description
source:
It sheds and regrows its scales on a
continuous basis. The scales become
harder each time they're regrown. Its
scaly punches tear its foes to shreds.
translation: 会大力敲打鳞片并跳起舞来鼓舞自己。\n战吼是战斗的信号。

label: SPECIES_KOMMO_O.speciesName
source: KOMMO-O
translation: 杖尾鳞甲龙

label: SPECIES_KOMMO_O.categoryName
source: Scaly
translation: 鳞片

label: SPECIES_KOMMO_O_TOTEM.speciesName
source: KOMMO-O
translation: 杖尾鳞甲龙

label: SPECIES_KOMMO_O_TOTEM.categoryName
source: Scaly
translation: 鳞片

label: SPECIES_TAPU_KOKO.speciesName
source: TAPU KOKO
translation: 卡璞・鸣鸣

label: SPECIES_TAPU_KOKO.categoryName
source: Land Spirit
translation: 土地神

label: SPECIES_TAPU_KOKO.description
source:
It confuses its enemies by flying too
quickly for the eye to follow. It has a
hair-trigger temper but forgets what
made it angry an instant later.
translation: 操纵雷的美乐美乐的守护神。\n好奇心旺盛，\n会时不时在人们面前现身。

label: SPECIES_TAPU_LELE.speciesName
source: TAPU LELE
translation: 卡璞・蝶蝶

label: SPECIES_TAPU_LELE.categoryName
source: Land Spirit
translation: 土地神

label: SPECIES_TAPU_LELE.description
source:
A fragrant aroma of flowers follows it.
As it flutters about, it scatters its
strangely glowing scales. Touching them
is said to restore good health.
translation: 会到处撒着闪闪发光的鳞粉，\n治愈人类和宝可梦的伤。\n是阿卡拉所供奉的守护神。

label: SPECIES_TAPU_BULU.speciesName
source: TAPU BULU
translation: 卡璞・哞哞

label: SPECIES_TAPU_BULU.categoryName
source: Land Spirit
translation: 土地神

label: SPECIES_TAPU_BULU.description
source:
It causes vegetation to grow, and then
it absorbs energy from the growth.
It pulls large trees up by the roots and
swings them around at its enemies.
translation: 会鸣响尾巴，告知自己的居所，\n以避免不必要的战争。\n是操纵草木的乌拉乌拉的守护神。

label: SPECIES_TAPU_FINI.speciesName
source: TAPU FINI
translation: 卡璞・鳍鳍

label: SPECIES_TAPU_FINI.categoryName
source: Land Spirit
translation: 土地神

label: SPECIES_TAPU_FINI.description
source:
People say it can create pure water that
will wash away any corruption. The dense
fog it creates brings the downfall and
destruction of its confused enemies.
translation: 栖息在浓雾深处而被人们敬畏着。\n是操纵着水的波尼的守护神。

label: SPECIES_COSMOG.speciesName
source: COSMOG
translation: 科斯莫古

label: SPECIES_COSMOG.categoryName
source: Nebula
translation: 星云

label: SPECIES_COSMOG.description
source:
In ages past, it was called the child of
the stars. It's said to be a Pokémon from
another world, but no specific details
are known.
translation: 没有警戒心且好奇心强，\n所以经常会遇到麻烦。\n危急时会用瞬间移动来逃跑。

label: SPECIES_COSMOEM.speciesName
source: COSMOEM
translation: 科斯莫姆

label: SPECIES_COSMOEM.categoryName
source: Protostar
translation: 原始星

label: SPECIES_COSMOEM.description
source:
Motionless as if dead, its body is faintly
warm to the touch. There's something
accumulating around the black core
within its hard shell.
translation: 以惊人的气势吸入大气中的尘埃，\n努力用内核制造着进化的能源。

label: SPECIES_SOLGALEO.speciesName
source: SOLGALEO
translation: 索尔迦雷欧

label: SPECIES_SOLGALEO.categoryName
source: Sunne
translation: 日轮

label: SPECIES_SOLGALEO.description
source:
It is said to live in another world.
The intense light it radiates from the
surface of its body can make the darkest
of nights light up like midday.
translation: 当它全身放出猛烈的光芒，\n变成如同太阳一般的身姿时，\n便会抹去黑暗，照亮世界。

label: SPECIES_LUNALA.speciesName
source: LUNALA
translation: 露奈雅拉

label: SPECIES_LUNALA.categoryName
source: Moone
translation: 月轮

label: SPECIES_LUNALA.description
source:
When its third eye activates, away it flies
to another world. This Pokémon devours
light, drawing the moonless dark veil of
night over the brightness of day.
translation: 夺走四周所有的光，\n自己则变身为满月的模样，\n在黑夜中散发出光芒。

label: SPECIES_NIHILEGO.speciesName
source: NIHILEGO
translation: 虚吾伊德

label: SPECIES_NIHILEGO.categoryName
source: Parasite
translation: 寄生

label: SPECIES_NIHILEGO.description
source:
One of several mysterious Ultra Beasts.
It's unclear whether or not this Pokémon
is sentient, but sometimes it can be
observed behaving like a young girl.
translation: 从究极之洞出现，来到这个世界。\n好像会寄生在宝可梦\n或人类的身上生存下去。

label: SPECIES_BUZZWOLE.speciesName
source: BUZZWOLE
translation: 爆肌蚊

label: SPECIES_BUZZWOLE.categoryName
source: Swollen
translation: 膨胀

label: SPECIES_BUZZWOLE.description
source:
This life-form called an Ultra Beast
appeared from another world. It shows
off its body, but whether that display
is a boast or a threat remains unclear.
translation: 会炫耀膨胀到异常程度的肌肉。\n是究极异兽中的一种。

label: SPECIES_PHEROMOSA.speciesName
source: PHEROMOSA
translation: 费洛美螂

label: SPECIES_PHEROMOSA.categoryName
source: Lissome
translation: 美艳

label: SPECIES_PHEROMOSA.description
source:
One of the dangerous Ultra Beasts,
it refuses to touch anything, perhaps
because it senses some uncleanness
in this world.
translation: 栖息在其他世界的生命体。\n身体纤细柔软，\n但是看起来蕴藏着强大的力量。

label: SPECIES_XURKITREE.speciesName
source: XURKITREE
translation: 电束木

label: SPECIES_XURKITREE.categoryName
source: Glowing
translation: 灯饰

label: SPECIES_XURKITREE.description
source:
One of the mysterious life-forms known
as Ultra Beasts. Astonishing electric
shocks emanate from its entire body,
according to witnesses.
translation: 被称为究极异兽。\n也有像树木一样将手脚\n插入地面后一动不动的。

label: SPECIES_CELESTEELA.speciesName
source: CELESTEELA
translation: 铁火辉夜

label: SPECIES_CELESTEELA.categoryName
source: Launch
translation: 发射

label: SPECIES_CELESTEELA.description
source:
It appeared from the Ultra Wormhole.
One kind of Ultra Beast, witnesses saw
it flying across the sky by expelling gas
from its two arms.
translation: 是危险的究极异兽中的一种。\n从它巨大的双臂中检测出来\n很高的能量反应。

label: SPECIES_KARTANA.speciesName
source: KARTANA
translation: 纸御剑

label: SPECIES_KARTANA.categoryName
source: Drawn Sword
translation: 拔刀

label: SPECIES_KARTANA.description
source:
This Ultra Beast came from the
Ultra Wormhole. It seems not to attack
enemies on its own, but its sharp body is
a dangerous weapon in itself.
translation: 从纸一样薄的身体上能感觉到\n像磨过的刀刃一般的锋利度。\n是一种究极异兽。

label: SPECIES_GUZZLORD.speciesName
source: GUZZLORD
translation: 恶食大王

label: SPECIES_GUZZLORD.categoryName
source: Junkivore
translation: 异食

label: SPECIES_GUZZLORD.description
source:
A dangerous Ultra Beast, it has gobbled
mountains and swallowed whole buildings,
according to reports. But for some reason
its droppings have never been found.
translation: 被称为究极异兽的未知生命。\n不知是不是经常觉得肚子饿，\n一直都在吃着什么东西。

label: SPECIES_NECROZMA.speciesName
source: NECROZMA
translation: 奈克洛兹玛

label: SPECIES_NECROZMA.categoryName
source: Prism
translation: 棱镜

label: SPECIES_NECROZMA.description
source:
Reminiscent of the Ultra Beasts, this
life-form, apparently asleep underground,
is thought to have come from another
world in ancient times.
translation: 为生存而发狂般地寻找着光。\n会发射出激光，\n将所有东西切成碎片。

label: SPECIES_NECROZMA_DUSK_MANE.speciesName
source: NECROZMA
translation: 奈克洛兹玛

label: SPECIES_NECROZMA_DUSK_MANE.categoryName
source: Prism
translation: 棱镜

label: SPECIES_NECROZMA_DUSK_MANE.description
source:
This is its form while it is devouring
the light of Solgaleo. It pounces on
foes and then slashes them with the
claws on its four limbs and back.
translation: 附在索尔迦雷欧身上，\n强行吸取它无限涌出的能量，\n四处造成破坏。

label: SPECIES_NECROZMA_DAWN_WINGS.speciesName
source: NECROZMA
translation: 奈克洛兹玛

label: SPECIES_NECROZMA_DAWN_WINGS.categoryName
source: Prism
translation: 棱镜

label: SPECIES_NECROZMA_DAWN_WINGS.description
source:
This is its form while it's
devouring the light of Lunala. It grasps
foes in its giant claws and rips them
apart with brute force.
translation: 附在露奈雅拉身上的样子。\n变得更加凶暴，将万物视为敌人，\n会用激光烧尽一切。

label: SPECIES_NECROZMA_ULTRA.speciesName
source: NECROZMA
translation: 奈克洛兹玛

label: SPECIES_NECROZMA_ULTRA.categoryName
source: Prism
translation: 棱镜

label: SPECIES_NECROZMA_ULTRA.description
source:
The light pouring out from all over
its body affects living things and
nature, impacting them in various
ways.
translation: 全身放出的光会对生物和自然\n发生作用，造成各种各样的影响。

label: SPECIES_MAGEARNA.speciesName
source: MAGEARNA
translation: 玛机雅娜

label: SPECIES_MAGEARNA.categoryName
source: Artificial
translation: 人造

label: SPECIES_MAGEARNA.description
source:
This artificial Pokémon, constructed more
than 500 years ago, can understand human
speech but cannot itself speak. Its true
self is its Soul-Heart, an artificial soul.
translation: 用人造的魂魄来运转。\n鲜艳的装饰证明了\n它是献给王室的贡品。

label: SPECIES_MAGEARNA_ORIGINAL.speciesName
source: MAGEARNA
translation: 玛机雅娜

label: SPECIES_MAGEARNA_ORIGINAL.categoryName
source: Artificial
translation: 人造

label: SPECIES_MAGEARNA_ORIGINAL.description
source:
This is its form from almost 500
years ago. Its body is nothing more
than a container-its artificial heart
is the actual life-form.
translation: 大约500年前由科学家制作而成。\n被称为魂心的部分是它的本体。

label: SPECIES_MAGEARNA_MEGA.categoryName
source: Artificial
translation: 人造

label: SPECIES_MAGEARNA_MEGA.description
source:
This artificial Pokémon, constructed more
than 500 years ago, can understand human
speech but cannot itself speak. Its true
self is its Soul-Heart, an artificial soul.
translation: 启动了隐藏模式的样子。\n会将萌生的感情藏匿起来，\n不停地打倒眼前的敌人。

label: SPECIES_MAGEARNA_ORIGINAL_MEGA.categoryName
source: Artificial
translation: 人造

label: SPECIES_MAGEARNA_ORIGINAL_MEGA.description
source:
A mechanism to remove Magearna's
limitations has lain secretly within
Magearna for 500 years. This mechanism
is triggered by a Mega Stone.
translation: 早在500年前，就被暗中\n装上了以超级石为钥匙\n来解除限制的机关。

label: SPECIES_MARSHADOW.speciesName
source: MARSHADOW
translation: 玛夏多

label: SPECIES_MARSHADOW.categoryName
source: Gloomdwellr
translation: 栖影

label: SPECIES_MARSHADOW.description
source:
Able to conceal itself in the shadows of
others, it never appears before humans,
so its very existence is the stuff of myth.
This Pokémon is craven and cowering.
translation: 拥有潜入一切影子里的能力，\n所以在很长一段时间里\n都没有任何人发现它。

label: SPECIES_POIPOLE.speciesName
source: POIPOLE
translation: 毒贝比

label: SPECIES_POIPOLE.categoryName
source: Poison Pin
translation: 毒针

label: SPECIES_POIPOLE.description
source: This Ultra Beast is well enough\nliked to be chosen as a\nfirst partner in its own world.
translation: 栖息在异世界的究极异兽。\n会从头部的毒针朝对手喷出毒液，\n咯咯咯大笑。

label: SPECIES_NAGANADEL.speciesName
source: NAGANADEL
translation: 四颚针龙

label: SPECIES_NAGANADEL.categoryName
source: Poison Pin
translation: 毒针

label: SPECIES_NAGANADEL.description
source: It stores hundreds of liters of poisonous\nliquid inside its body. It is one of the\norganisms known as UBs.
translation: 究极异兽中的一种。\n会从毒针发射出黏性\n很大又发光的毒液。

label: SPECIES_STAKATAKA.speciesName
source: STAKATAKA
translation: 垒磊石

label: SPECIES_STAKATAKA.categoryName
source: Rampart
translation: 石墙

label: SPECIES_STAKATAKA.description
source: It appeared from an Ultra Wormhole. Each\none appears to be made up of many life-\nforms stacked one on top of each other.
translation: 像是究极异兽的谜一般的生命体。\n突然动起来并展开袭击的石墙，\n正身就是这家伙。

label: SPECIES_BLACEPHALON.speciesName
source: BLACEPHALON
translation: 砰头小丑

label: SPECIES_BLACEPHALON.categoryName
source: Fireworks
translation: 烟火

label: SPECIES_BLACEPHALON.description
source: It slithers toward people and explode\nits head without warning. It is\none kind of Ultra Beast.
translation: 从究极之洞里出现的究极异兽。\n用爆炸吓唬对手，\n趁那空当夺走对方的生命气息。

label: SPECIES_ZERAORA.speciesName
source: ZERAORA
translation: 捷拉奥拉

label: SPECIES_ZERAORA.categoryName
source: Thunderclap
translation: 奔雷

label: SPECIES_ZERAORA.description
source: It approaches its enemies at the speed\nof lightning, then tears them limb from\nlimb with its sharp claws.
translation: 从手脚的肉球放电。\n当捷拉奥拉奔驰而过时，\n周围将充斥着电闪雷鸣。

label: SPECIES_ZERAORA_MEGA.categoryName
source: Thunderclap
translation: 奔雷

label: SPECIES_ZERAORA_MEGA.description
source:
It stores up 10 lightning strikes' worth
of electricity. When it stops limiting
itself, it's in the strongest class of
electric Pokémon.
translation: 能储存相当于10个雷的电力。\n解除限制后是电气宝可梦\n中最强的级别。

label: SPECIES_MELTAN.speciesName
source: MELTAN
translation: 美录坦

label: SPECIES_MELTAN.categoryName
source: Hex Nut
translation: 螺帽

label: SPECIES_MELTAN.description
source: It melts particles of iron and other metals\nfound in the subsoil, so it can absorb them\ninto its body of molten steel.
translation: 美录坦们虽然聚在一起生活，\n但当时机到来，会由最强的那1只\n吸收其他的伙伴来进化。

label: SPECIES_MELMETAL.speciesName
source: MELMETAL
translation: 美录梅塔

label: SPECIES_MELMETAL.categoryName
source: Hex Nut
translation: 螺帽

label: SPECIES_MELMETAL.description
source: Revered long ago for its capacity to\ncreate iron from nothing, for some reason\nit has come back to life after 3,000 years.
translation: 美录梅塔利用离心力带动沉重的\n螺帽挥出的拳击被认为是\n宝可梦界之最。

label: SPECIES_MELMETAL_GMAX.speciesName
source: MELMETAL
translation: 美录梅塔

label: SPECIES_MELMETAL_GMAX.categoryName
source: Hex Nut
translation: 螺帽

label: SPECIES_MELMETAL_GMAX.description
source:
In a distant land, there are
legends about a cyclopean giant. In fact,
the giant was a Melmetal that was
flooded with Gigantamax energy.
translation: 会从腹部的孔洞里\n发出电力强大的光束，\n只需一击就能让对手蒸发。

label: SPECIES_GROOKEY.speciesName
source: GROOKEY
translation: 敲音猴

label: SPECIES_GROOKEY.categoryName
source: Chimp
translation: 小猴

label: SPECIES_GROOKEY.description
source:
When it uses its special stick to strike up
a beat, the sound waves produced carry
revitalizing energy to the plants and
flowers in the area.
translation: 在用木棒敲打各种东西的\n过程中变得越来越愉快，\n节奏也会变得越来越好。

label: SPECIES_THWACKEY.speciesName
source: THWACKEY
translation: 啪咚猴

label: SPECIES_THWACKEY.categoryName
source: Beat
translation: 节拍

label: SPECIES_THWACKEY.description
source: The faster a Thwackey can beat out\na rhythm with its two sticks, the more\nrespect it wins from its peers.
translation: 有时会过于忘我地敲打激烈的节拍，\n以致于不听训练家的指示。

label: SPECIES_RILLABOOM.speciesName
source: RILLABOOM
translation: 轰擂金刚猩

label: SPECIES_RILLABOOM.categoryName
source: Drummer
translation: 鼓手

label: SPECIES_RILLABOOM.description
source: By drumming, it taps into the power of\nits special tree stump. The roots of the\nstump follow its direction in battle.
translation: 当首领遇到挑战者时，\n就会开始打鼓对决，\n胜者会成为族群的首领。

label: SPECIES_RILLABOOM_GMAX.speciesName
source: RILLABOOM
translation: 轰擂金刚猩

label: SPECIES_RILLABOOM_GMAX.categoryName
source: Drummer
translation: 鼓手

label: SPECIES_RILLABOOM_GMAX.description
source: Rillaboom has become one with its\nforest of drums and continues to lay\ndown beats that shake all of Galar.
translation: 轰擂金刚猩会与森林之鼓合而为一，\n不断击打出能撼动伽勒尔全境的节拍。

label: SPECIES_SCORBUNNY.speciesName
source: SCORBUNNY
translation: 炎兔儿

label: SPECIES_SCORBUNNY.categoryName
source: Rabbit
translation: 兔子

label: SPECIES_SCORBUNNY.description
source:
A warm-up of running around gets fire
energy coursing through this Pokémon's
body. Once that happens, it's ready to
fight at full power.
translation: 能集中火之能量的脚底\n肉球会升至高温，\n给予对手巨大的伤害。

label: SPECIES_RABOOT.speciesName
source: RABOOT
translation: 腾蹴小将

label: SPECIES_RABOOT.categoryName
source: Rabbit
translation: 兔子

label: SPECIES_RABOOT.description
source: Its thick and fluffy fur protects it\nfrom the cold and enables it to use\nhotter fire moves.
translation: 擅长丰富多彩的踢技，\n但利用因火焰而变热的额头\n使出的头锤也十分强劲。

label: SPECIES_CINDERACE.speciesName
source: CINDERACE
translation: 闪焰王牌

label: SPECIES_CINDERACE.categoryName
source: Striker
translation: 前锋

label: SPECIES_CINDERACE.description
source:
It juggles a pebble with its feet,
turning it into a burning soccer ball.
Its shots strike opponents hard and
leave them scorched.
translation: 会通过控制由火焰\n制成的球来牵制对手，\n或将球用在障眼法上。

label: SPECIES_CINDERACE_GMAX.speciesName
source: CINDERACE
translation: 闪焰王牌

label: SPECIES_CINDERACE_GMAX.categoryName
source: Striker
translation: 前锋

label: SPECIES_CINDERACE_GMAX.description
source:
Infused with Cinderace's fighting
spirit, the gigantic Pyro Ball never
misses its targets and completely
roasts opponents.
translation: 因着超极巨化的力量，\n火焰球的直径有时\n甚至会超过100米。

label: SPECIES_SOBBLE.speciesName
source: SOBBLE
translation: 泪眼蜥

label: SPECIES_SOBBLE.categoryName
source: Water Lizard
translation: 水蜥

label: SPECIES_SOBBLE.description
source:
When scared, this Pokémon cries.
Its tears pack the chemical punch of 100
onions, and attackers won't be
able to resist weeping.
translation: 警戒心十分强，\n当实在不得不战斗时，\n会先隐藏身影再进行攻击。

label: SPECIES_DRIZZILE.speciesName
source: DRIZZILE
translation: 变涩蜥

label: SPECIES_DRIZZILE.categoryName
source: Water Lizard
translation: 水蜥

label: SPECIES_DRIZZILE.description
source: A clever combatant, this Pokémon battles\nusing water balloons created with\nmoisture secreted from its palms.
translation: 虽然性格上很怕麻烦，\n但智商很高，\n会设置陷阱来保护自己的住所。

label: SPECIES_INTELEON.speciesName
source: INTELEON
translation: 千面避役

label: SPECIES_INTELEON.categoryName
source: Secret Agent
translation: 特工

label: SPECIES_INTELEON.description
source:
It has many hidden capabilities, such as
fingertips that can shoot water and a
membrane on its back that it can use to
glide through the air.
translation: 虽然表现得很有绅士风度，\n但它的本性仍然很懒惰，\n没有训练家盯着就会偷懒。

label: SPECIES_INTELEON_GMAX.speciesName
source: INTELEON
translation: 千面避役

label: SPECIES_INTELEON_GMAX.categoryName
source: Secret Agent
translation: 特工

label: SPECIES_INTELEON_GMAX.description
source:
Gigantamax Inteleon's Water Gun
move fires at Mach 7. As the Pokémon
takes aim, it uses the crest on its
head to gauge wind and temperature.
translation: 狙击技巧超群。\n打穿掉落在15公里以外地面\n上的树果对它来说也是小菜一碟。

label: SPECIES_SKWOVET.speciesName
source: SKWOVET
translation: 贪心栗鼠

label: SPECIES_SKWOVET.categoryName
source: Cheeky
translation: 贪吃

label: SPECIES_SKWOVET.description
source: Found throughout the Galar region, this\nPokémon becomes uneasy if its cheeks are\never completely empty of berries.
translation: 不管吃得再怎么饱都\n还是会担心肚子饿，\n因此会往脸颊和尾巴里储存树果。

label: SPECIES_GREEDENT.speciesName
source: GREEDENT
translation: 藏饱栗鼠

label: SPECIES_GREEDENT.categoryName
source: Greedy
translation: 贪欲

label: SPECIES_GREEDENT.description
source:
It stashes berries in its tail--so many
berries that they fall out constantly.
But this Pokémon is a bit slow-witted,
so it doesn't notice the loss.
translation: 会用约有身体2倍长的尾巴\n把树上掉下来的树果全部裹起来带走。

label: SPECIES_ROOKIDEE.speciesName
source: ROOKIDEE
translation: 稚山雀

label: SPECIES_ROOKIDEE.categoryName
source: Tiny Bird
translation: 小鸟

label: SPECIES_ROOKIDEE.description
source:
It will bravely challenge any opponent,
no matter how powerful. This Pokémon
benefits from every battle--even a
defeat increases its strength a bit.
translation: 雌性比雄性更加神经质。\n一旦羽毛被弄脏了，\n就会怒火中烧地用鸟嘴猛啄。

label: SPECIES_CORVISQUIRE.speciesName
source: CORVISQUIRE
translation: 蓝鸦

label: SPECIES_CORVISQUIRE.categoryName
source: Raven
translation: 乌鸦

label: SPECIES_CORVISQUIRE.description
source:
Smart enough to use tools in battle,
these Pokémon have been seen picking up
rocks and flinging them or using ropes
to wrap up enemies.
translation: 头脑聪明，\n凡是靠鸟嘴和爪子能够操控的工具，\n它都可以轻易地学会用法。

label: SPECIES_CORVIKNIGHT.speciesName
source: CORVIKNIGHT
translation: 钢铠鸦

label: SPECIES_CORVIKNIGHT.categoryName
source: Raven
translation: 乌鸦

label: SPECIES_CORVIKNIGHT.description
source:
This Pokémon reigns supreme in the skies
of the Galar region. The black luster of
its steel body could drive terror into
the heart of any foe.
translation: 羽毛的一部分变成了钢铁。\n即使翅膀沉重也能悠然地飞在空中。

label: SPECIES_CORVIKNIGHT_GMAX.speciesName
source: CORVIKNIGHT
translation: 钢铠鸦

label: SPECIES_CORVIKNIGHT_GMAX.categoryName
source: Raven
translation: 乌鸦

label: SPECIES_CORVIKNIGHT_GMAX.description
source:
Imbued with Gigantamax energy, its
wings can whip up winds more
forceful than any a hurricane could
muster. The gusts blow everything away.
translation: 能让背部被称为"刃鸟"的\n8根羽毛脱离身体，\n各自独立去袭击敌人。

label: SPECIES_BLIPBUG.speciesName
source: BLIPBUG
translation: 索侦虫

label: SPECIES_BLIPBUG.categoryName
source: Larva
translation: 幼虫

label: SPECIES_BLIPBUG.description
source: A constant collector of information,\nthis Pokémon is very smart. Very strong\nis what it isn't.
translation: 经常出现在田地里的宝可梦。\n会通过长在身体上的毛\n来感应周围发生的事。

label: SPECIES_DOTTLER.speciesName
source: DOTTLER
translation: 天罩虫

label: SPECIES_DOTTLER.categoryName
source: Radome
translation: 天线罩

label: SPECIES_DOTTLER.description
source:
It barely moves, but it's still alive.
Hiding in its shell without food or
water seems to have awakened its
psychic powers.
translation: 正在壳里成长着。\n用精神力量掌握外界的状况，\n做好进化的准备。

label: SPECIES_ORBEETLE.speciesName
source: ORBEETLE
translation: 以欧路普

label: SPECIES_ORBEETLE.categoryName
source: Seven Spot
translation: 七星

label: SPECIES_ORBEETLE.description
source:
It's famous for its high level of
intelligence, and the large size of its
brain is proof that it also possesses
immense psychic power.
translation: 释放出精神力量来调查周围的情况。\n它的侦测范围甚至\n可以达到方圆10公里。

label: SPECIES_ORBEETLE_GMAX.speciesName
source: ORBEETLE
translation: 以欧路普

label: SPECIES_ORBEETLE_GMAX.categoryName
source: Seven Spot
translation: 七星

label: SPECIES_ORBEETLE_GMAX.description
source:
Its brain has grown to a gargantuan
size, as has the rest of its body.
This Pokémon's intellect and
psychic abilities are overpowering.
translation: 在它竭尽全力时，\n能够操纵自己周围一切生物的心灵。

label: SPECIES_NICKIT.speciesName
source: NICKIT
translation: 狡小狐

label: SPECIES_NICKIT.categoryName
source: Fox
translation: 狐狸

label: SPECIES_NICKIT.description
source:
Aided by the soft pads on its feet, it
silently raids the food stores of other
Pokémon. It survives off its
ill-gotten gains.
translation: 性格谨慎且狡猾。\n在偷盗食物逃走的时候\n会用尾巴擦掉自己的足迹。

label: SPECIES_THIEVUL.speciesName
source: THIEVUL
translation: 猾大狐

label: SPECIES_THIEVUL.categoryName
source: Fox
translation: 狐狸

label: SPECIES_THIEVUL.description
source:
It secretly marks potential targets with
a scent. By following the scent, it
stalks its targets and steals from them
when they least expect it.
translation: 靠着轻盈的身体和锐利的\n爪子到处去偷食物和蛋。\n逐电犬是它的天敌。

label: SPECIES_GOSSIFLEUR.speciesName
source: GOSSIFLEUR
translation: 幼棉棉

label: SPECIES_GOSSIFLEUR.categoryName
source: Flowering
translation: 花饰

label: SPECIES_GOSSIFLEUR.description
source:
It anchors itself in the ground with its
single leg, then basks in the sun. After
absorbing enough sunlight, its petals
spread as it blooms brilliantly.
translation: 会随着微风一边转圈圈\n一边愉快地唱歌。许多人因为喜欢\n这可爱的模样而培育它。

label: SPECIES_ELDEGOSS.speciesName
source: ELDEGOSS
translation: 白蓬蓬

label: SPECIES_ELDEGOSS.categoryName
source: Cotton Bloom
translation: 棉饰

label: SPECIES_ELDEGOSS.description
source:
The seeds attached to its cotton fluff
are full of nutrients. It spreads them
on the wind so that plants and other
Pokémon can benefit from them.
translation: 用它头上的棉絮制成的线有着\n十分美丽动人的光泽，\n是伽勒尔地区的名产。

label: SPECIES_WOOLOO.speciesName
source: WOOLOO
translation: 毛辫羊

label: SPECIES_WOOLOO.categoryName
source: Sheep
translation: 绵羊

label: SPECIES_WOOLOO.description
source:
Its curly fleece is such an effective
cushion that this Pokémon could fall off
a cliff and stand right back up at the
bottom, unharmed.
translation: 要是身上的毛长得太长就会不能动弹。\n用毛辫羊的体毛织成\n的布结实得让人吃惊。

label: SPECIES_DUBWOOL.speciesName
source: DUBWOOL
translation: 毛毛角羊

label: SPECIES_DUBWOOL.categoryName
source: Sheep
translation: 绵羊

label: SPECIES_DUBWOOL.description
source:
Weave a carpet from its springy wool,
and you end up with something closer to
a trampoline. You'll start to bounce the
moment you set foot on it.
translation: 长得长长的角是为了\n向异性求爱而存在的。\n它从不会把角当做武器。

label: SPECIES_CHEWTLE.speciesName
source: CHEWTLE
translation: 咬咬龟

label: SPECIES_CHEWTLE.categoryName
source: Snapping
translation: 咬住

label: SPECIES_CHEWTLE.description
source: Apparently the itch of its teething\nimpels it to snap its jaws at anything\nin front of it.
translation: 拿起咬咬龟咬着的树枝，\n比赛哪只咬咬龟咬住不放的时间最久，\n是种在孩童之间很流行的游戏。

label: SPECIES_DREDNAW.speciesName
source: DREDNAW
translation: 暴噬龟

label: SPECIES_DREDNAW.categoryName
source: Bite
translation: 紧咬

label: SPECIES_DREDNAW.description
source: With jaws that can shear through steel\nrods, this highly aggressive Pokémon\nchomps down on its unfortunate prey.
translation: 会潜伏在岸边，\n趁猎物来喝水时伸长脖子，\n将其一口紧紧咬住。

label: SPECIES_DREDNAW_GMAX.speciesName
source: DREDNAW
translation: 暴噬龟

label: SPECIES_DREDNAW_GMAX.categoryName
source: Bite
translation: 紧咬

label: SPECIES_DREDNAW_GMAX.description
source:
In the Galar region, there's a tale
about this Pokémon chewing up a
mountain and using the rubble to stop a
flood.
translation: 古时候它咬崩一座山阻止洪水漫延的\n故事在伽勒尔地区代代相传。

label: SPECIES_YAMPER.speciesName
source: YAMPER
translation: 来电汪

label: SPECIES_YAMPER.categoryName
source: Puppy
translation: 小狗

label: SPECIES_YAMPER.description
source:
This Pokémon is very popular as a
herding dog in the Galar region. As it
runs, it generates electricity from the
base of its tail.
translation: 因为想要得到零食而\n帮助人类工作的贪吃鬼。\n总是带着电火花跑来跑去。

label: SPECIES_BOLTUND.speciesName
source: BOLTUND
translation: 逐电犬

label: SPECIES_BOLTUND.categoryName
source: Dog
translation: 狗

label: SPECIES_BOLTUND.description
source:
This Pokémon generates electricity and
channels it into its legs to keep them
going strong. Boltund can run nonstop
for three full days.
translation: 电力增强了它的脚力。\n当以最高速度奔跑时，\n时速可以轻易超过90公里。

label: SPECIES_ROLYCOLY.speciesName
source: ROLYCOLY
translation: 小炭仔

label: SPECIES_ROLYCOLY.categoryName
source: Coal
translation: 煤炭

label: SPECIES_ROLYCOLY.description
source:
Most of its body has the same composition
as coal. Fittingly, this Pokémon was
first discovered in coal mines about
400 years ago.
translation: 脱落的老旧体表一直以来\n都被当成燃料来代替煤炭使用。

label: SPECIES_CARKOL.speciesName
source: CARKOL
translation: 大炭车

label: SPECIES_CARKOL.categoryName
source: Coal
translation: 煤炭

label: SPECIES_CARKOL.description
source: It forms coal inside its body. Coal\ndropped by this Pokémon once helped fuel\nthe lives of people in the Galar region.
translation: 由于内部在制造煤焦油，\n因此就算它跑得再快，\n背上的煤炭山也不会崩塌。

label: SPECIES_COALOSSAL.speciesName
source: COALOSSAL
translation: 巨炭山

label: SPECIES_COALOSSAL.categoryName
source: Coal
translation: 煤炭

label: SPECIES_COALOSSAL.description
source:
It's usually peaceful, but the vandalism
of mines enrages it. Offenders will be
incinerated with flames that reach
2,700 degrees Fahrenheit.
translation: 性情温厚，发怒时却十分可怕。\n它会用燃烧到1500度的躯体压住\n对手，将其烧成灰烬。

label: SPECIES_COALOSSAL_GMAX.speciesName
source: COALOSSAL
translation: 巨炭山

label: SPECIES_COALOSSAL_GMAX.categoryName
source: Coal
translation: 煤炭

label: SPECIES_COALOSSAL_GMAX.description
source:
Its body is a colossal stove. With
Gigantamax energy stoking the fire,
this Pokémon's flame burns hotter
than 3,600 degrees Fahrenheit.
translation: 据说在大寒流席卷伽勒尔时，\n是它变成巨大的火炉\n拯救了许许多多的生命。

label: SPECIES_APPLIN.speciesName
source: APPLIN
translation: 啃果虫

label: SPECIES_APPLIN.categoryName
source: Apple Core
translation: 苹果居

label: SPECIES_APPLIN.description
source:
It spends its entire life inside an
apple. It hides from its natural enemies,
bird Pokémon, by pretending it's just an
apple and nothing more.
translation: 平时生活在苹果中。\n如果失去了苹果，身体的水分\n就会流失，从而逐渐虚弱。

label: SPECIES_FLAPPLE.speciesName
source: FLAPPLE
translation: 苹裹龙

label: SPECIES_FLAPPLE.categoryName
source: Apple Wing
translation: 苹果翅

label: SPECIES_FLAPPLE.description
source: It ate a sour apple, and that induced its\nevolution. In its cheeks, it stores an acid\ncapable of causing chemical burns.
translation: 会用体液修补苹果。\n身经百战的强者的苹果\n会整体呈现出黏土色。

label: SPECIES_FLAPPLE_GMAX.speciesName
source: FLAPPLE
translation: 苹裹龙

label: SPECIES_FLAPPLE_GMAX.categoryName
source: Apple Wing
translation: 苹果翅

label: SPECIES_FLAPPLE_GMAX.description
source:
Under the influence of Gigantamax
energy, it produces much more sweet
nectar, and its shape has changed
to resemble a giant apple.
translation: 当它把脖子伸长时，\n会散发出强烈的蜜汁甜味，\n让闻到的宝可梦失去知觉。

label: SPECIES_APPLETUN.speciesName
source: APPLETUN
translation: 丰蜜龙

label: SPECIES_APPLETUN.categoryName
source: Apple Nectar
translation: 苹果汁

label: SPECIES_APPLETUN.description
source: Eating a sweet apple caused its evolution.\nA nectarous scent wafts from its body,\nluring in the bug Pokémon it preys on.
translation: 当有爱吃豚来舔食自己\n背上的甜甜蜜时，\n会吐出黏糊糊的蜜汁来将其击退。

label: SPECIES_APPLETUN_GMAX.speciesName
source: APPLETUN
translation: 丰蜜龙

label: SPECIES_APPLETUN_GMAX.categoryName
source: Apple Nectar
translation: 苹果汁

label: SPECIES_APPLETUN_GMAX.description
source:
Due to Gigantamax energy, this
Pokémon's nectar has thickened. The
increased viscosity lets the nectar
absorb more damage than before.
translation: 在超极巨化之力的影响下，\n蜜汁的黏度进一步提升，\n能够吸收受到的伤害。

label: SPECIES_DIPPLIN.speciesName
source: DIPPLIN
translation: 裹蜜虫

label: SPECIES_DIPPLIN.categoryName
source: Candy Apple
translation: 糖苹果

label: SPECIES_DIPPLIN.description
source: Dipplin is two creatures in one Pokémon.\nIts evolution was triggered by a special\napple grown only in one place.
translation: 露出脑袋的外头虫与露出尾巴的\n里头虫互相帮助，\n一起生活在苹果里面。

label: SPECIES_HYDRAPPLE.speciesName
source: HYDRAPPLE
translation: 蜜集大蛇

label: SPECIES_HYDRAPPLE.categoryName
source: Apple Hydra
translation: 苹果大蛇

label: SPECIES_HYDRAPPLE.description
source:
These capricious syrpents have
banded together. On the rare
occasion that their moods align,
their true power is unleashed.
translation: 由善变的蛇虫虫们聚集而成。\n当它们偶尔心意相通时，\n就会发挥出真正的力量。

label: SPECIES_SILICOBRA.speciesName
source: SILICOBRA
translation: 沙包蛇

label: SPECIES_SILICOBRA.categoryName
source: Sand Snake
translation: 沙蛇

label: SPECIES_SILICOBRA.description
source: As it digs, it swallows sand and stores\nit in its neck pouch. The pouch can hold\nmore than 17 pounds of sand.
translation: 它大大的鼻孔是专门为了\n喷射沙子而特别进化的，\n因此很不擅长分辨气味。

label: SPECIES_SANDACONDA.speciesName
source: SANDACONDA
translation: 沙螺蟒

label: SPECIES_SANDACONDA.categoryName
source: Sand Snake
translation: 沙蛇

label: SPECIES_SANDACONDA.description
source:
When it contracts its body, over 220
pounds of sand sprays from its nose. If
it ever runs out of sand, it becomes
disheartened.
translation: 喷出的沙子里混着尖锐的沙砾，\n那是它用唾液凝固了沙子而成的，\n形状千奇百怪。

label: SPECIES_SANDACONDA_GMAX.speciesName
source: SANDACONDA
translation: 沙螺蟒

label: SPECIES_SANDACONDA_GMAX.categoryName
source: Sand Snake
translation: 沙蛇

label: SPECIES_SANDACONDA_GMAX.description
source:
Its sand pouch has grown to tremendous
proportions. More than 1,000,000 tons of
sand now swirl around its body with enough
speed and power to pulverize a skyscraper.
translation: 在它身体四周高速旋转着的\n沙子拥有极强的破坏力，\n甚至连高楼大厦都能粉碎。

label: SPECIES_CRAMORANT.speciesName
source: CRAMORANT
translation: 古月鸟

label: SPECIES_CRAMORANT.categoryName
source: Gulp
translation: 一口吞

label: SPECIES_CRAMORANT.description
source: It's so strong that it can knock out some\nopponents in a single hit, but it also may\nforget what it's battling midfight.
translation: 记性相当差，\n会把大部分能量分配在战斗上，\n只留最低限度的能量给大脑。

label: SPECIES_CRAMORANT_GULPING.speciesName
source: CRAMORANT
translation: 古月鸟

label: SPECIES_CRAMORANT_GULPING.categoryName
source: Gulp
translation: 一口吞

label: SPECIES_CRAMORANT_GULPING.description
source:
Cramorant's gluttony led it to try
to swallow an Arrokuda whole, which
in turn led to Cramorant getting an
Arrokuda stuck in its throat.
translation: 利用卡在喉咙中的刺梭鱼\n活蹦乱跳的力量将其高速吐出。

label: SPECIES_CRAMORANT_GORGING.speciesName
source: CRAMORANT
translation: 古月鸟

label: SPECIES_CRAMORANT_GORGING.categoryName
source: Gulp
translation: 一口吞

label: SPECIES_CRAMORANT_GORGING.description
source:
This Cramorant has accidentally
gotten a Pikachu lodged in its gullet.
Cramorant is choking a little, but it
isn't really bothered.
translation: 借助卡在喉咙中的皮卡丘\n酥酥麻麻的电力让对手触电。

label: SPECIES_ARROKUDA.speciesName
source: ARROKUDA
translation: 刺梭鱼

label: SPECIES_ARROKUDA.categoryName
source: Rush
translation: 突击

label: SPECIES_ARROKUDA.description
source:
If it sees any movement around it, this
Pokémon charges for it straightaway,
leading with its sharply pointed jaw.
It's very proud of that jaw.
translation: 会用又硬又尖的下巴\n发动突击捕杀猎物。视力很差，\n因此成功率很低。

label: SPECIES_BARRASKEWDA.speciesName
source: BARRASKEWDA
translation: 戽斗尖梭

label: SPECIES_BARRASKEWDA.categoryName
source: Skewer
translation: 穿刺

label: SPECIES_BARRASKEWDA.description
source:
This Pokémon has a jaw that's as sharp
as a spear and as strong as steel.
Apparently Barraskewda's flesh is
surprisingly tasty, too.
translation: 以超过100节的速度游泳。\n会为了争夺食物和波普海豚的\n群体展开激烈的斗争。

label: SPECIES_TOXEL.speciesName
source: TOXEL
translation: 电音婴

label: SPECIES_TOXEL.categoryName
source: Baby
translation: 婴儿

label: SPECIES_TOXEL.description
source:
It stores poison in an internal poison
sac and secretes that poison through its
skin. If you touch this Pokémon, a
tingling sensation follows.
translation: 任性且非常爱撒娇。\n体内的两个囊袋分别储存毒和电。

label: SPECIES_TOXTRICITY_AMPED.speciesName
source: TOXTRICITY
translation: 颤弦蝾螈

label: SPECIES_TOXTRICITY_AMPED.categoryName
source: Punk
translation: 庞克

label: SPECIES_TOXTRICITY_AMPED.description
source:
When this Pokémon sounds as if it's
strumming a guitar, it's actually clawing
at the protrusions on its chest to
generate electricity.
translation: 会凶暴地弹奏胸部的突起物。\n弹奏时释放出的电击\n可轻易超过15000伏特。

label: SPECIES_TOXTRICITY_AMPED_GMAX.speciesName
source: TOXTRICITY
translation: 颤弦蝾螈

label: SPECIES_TOXTRICITY_AMPED_GMAX.categoryName
source: Punk
translation: 庞克

label: SPECIES_TOXTRICITY_LOW_KEY.speciesName
source: TOXTRICITY
translation: 颤弦蝾螈

label: SPECIES_TOXTRICITY_LOW_KEY.categoryName
source: Punk
translation: 庞克

label: SPECIES_TOXTRICITY_LOW_KEY.description
source: Capable of generating 15,000 volts\nof electricity, this Pokémon looks\ndown on all that would challenge it.
translation: 当它大口喝下淤水，\n并在体内制造电气的时候，\n会响起仿佛像是贝斯的节拍。

label: SPECIES_TOXTRICITY_LOW_KEY_GMAX.speciesName
source: TOXTRICITY
translation: 颤弦蝾螈

label: SPECIES_TOXTRICITY_LOW_KEY_GMAX.categoryName
source: Punk
translation: 庞克

label: SPECIES_SIZZLIPEDE.speciesName
source: SIZZLIPEDE
translation: 烧火蚣

label: SPECIES_SIZZLIPEDE.categoryName
source: Radiator
translation: 发热

label: SPECIES_SIZZLIPEDE.description
source: It stores flammable gas in its body and\nuses it to generate heat. The yellow\nsections on its belly get particularly hot.
translation: 会用滚烫的身体勒紧猎物，\n等到烤得恰到好处之时，\n就把它们大口大口地吃掉。

label: SPECIES_CENTISKORCH.speciesName
source: CENTISKORCH
translation: 焚焰蚣

label: SPECIES_CENTISKORCH.categoryName
source: Radiator
translation: 发热

label: SPECIES_CENTISKORCH.description
source:
When it heats up, its body temperature
reaches about 1,500 degrees Fahrenheit.
It lashes its body like a whip and
launches itself at enemies.
translation: 性格极具攻击性。\n危险的不只是它烧烫的身体，\n大大的獠牙也锐利无比。

label: SPECIES_CENTISKORCH_GMAX.speciesName
source: CENTISKORCH
translation: 焚焰蚣

label: SPECIES_CENTISKORCH_GMAX.categoryName
source: Radiator
translation: 发热

label: SPECIES_CENTISKORCH_GMAX.description
source:
The heat that comes off a
Gigantamax Centiskorch may
destabilize air currents. Sometimes
it can even cause storms.
translation: 超极巨化的焚焰蚣\n释放出的热辐射会扰乱气流，\n有时甚至还会引发暴风雨。

label: SPECIES_CLOBBOPUS.speciesName
source: CLOBBOPUS
translation: 拳拳蛸

label: SPECIES_CLOBBOPUS.categoryName
source: Tantrum
translation: 缠人

label: SPECIES_CLOBBOPUS.description
source:
It's very curious, but its means of
investigating things is to try to punch
them with its tentacles. The search for
food is what brings it onto land.
translation: 智商大致相当于3岁的儿童。\n虽然触手经常断掉，但因为能再生，\n所以它并不在意。

label: SPECIES_GRAPPLOCT.speciesName
source: GRAPPLOCT
translation: 八爪武师

label: SPECIES_GRAPPLOCT.categoryName
source: Jujitsu
translation: 柔术

label: SPECIES_GRAPPLOCT.description
source: A body made up of nothing but muscle makes\nthe grappling moves this Pokémon performs\nwith its tentacles tremendously powerful.
translation: 会为了试自己的身手\n而登上陆地寻找对手。\n战斗结束后就会回到海里。

label: SPECIES_SINISTEA_PHONY.speciesName
source: SINISTEA
translation: 来悲茶

label: SPECIES_SINISTEA_PHONY.categoryName
source: Black Tea
translation: 红茶

label: SPECIES_SINISTEA_PHONY.description
source: This Pokémon is said to have been born\nwhen a lonely spirit possessed a cold,\nleftover cup of tea.
translation: 趁着自己被喝掉时进入对方身体里，\n从内部夺走对方的生物能量。\n味道很糟糕。

label: SPECIES_SINISTEA_ANTIQUE.speciesName
source: SINISTEA
translation: 来悲茶

label: SPECIES_SINISTEA_ANTIQUE.categoryName
source: Black Tea
translation: 红茶

label: SPECIES_SINISTEA_ANTIQUE.description
source:
The swirl pattern in this Pokémon's
body is its weakness. If it gets
stirred, the swirl loses its shape, and
Sinistea gets dizzy.
translation: 住在古董茶杯里的样子。\n虽然十分贵重，\n但来悲茶还是一如既往地不好喝。

label: SPECIES_POLTEAGEIST_PHONY.speciesName
source: POLTEAGEIST
translation: 怖思壶

label: SPECIES_POLTEAGEIST_PHONY.categoryName
source: Black Tea
translation: 红茶

label: SPECIES_POLTEAGEIST_PHONY.description
source: This species lives in antique teapots.\nMost pots are forgeries, but on rare\noccasions, an authentic work is found.
translation: 会潜入茶壶里，\n然后把自己倒进喝到\n一半的红茶里来增加份量。

label: SPECIES_POLTEAGEIST_ANTIQUE.speciesName
source: POLTEAGEIST
translation: 怖思壶

label: SPECIES_POLTEAGEIST_ANTIQUE.categoryName
source: Black Tea
translation: 红茶

label: SPECIES_POLTEAGEIST_ANTIQUE.description
source:
Trainers Polteageist trusts will be
allowed to experience its
distinctive flavor and aroma firsthand by
sampling just a tiny bit of its tea.
translation: 虽然喝下它会有危险，\n但味道很好。\n不怕危险的美食家们每天都喝怖思壶。

label: SPECIES_HATENNA.speciesName
source: HATENNA
translation: 迷布莉姆

label: SPECIES_HATENNA.categoryName
source: Calm
translation: 宁静

label: SPECIES_HATENNA.description
source:
Via the protrusion on its head, it senses
other creatures' emotions. If you don't
have a calm disposition, it will never
warm up to you.
translation: 能够捕捉生物的心情。\n如果持续接收强烈的情感就会累坏，\n因此要当心。

label: SPECIES_HATTREM.speciesName
source: HATTREM
translation: 提布莉姆

label: SPECIES_HATTREM.categoryName
source: Serene
translation: 肃静

label: SPECIES_HATTREM.description
source: No matter who you are, if you bring strong\nemotions near this Pokémon, it will silence\nyou violently.
translation: 一旦发现了情绪激昂的对象，\n就会用辫子毒打，\n直到对方失去意识而沉默下来为止。

label: SPECIES_HATTERENE.speciesName
source: HATTERENE
translation: 布莉姆温

label: SPECIES_HATTERENE.categoryName
source: Silent
translation: 寂静

label: SPECIES_HATTERENE.description
source: It emits psychic power strong enough to\ncause headaches as a deterrent to the\napproach of others.
translation: 要小心没有任何生物气息的森林，\n因为那代表你可能\n进入了布莉姆温的地盘。

label: SPECIES_HATTERENE_GMAX.speciesName
source: HATTERENE
translation: 布莉姆温

label: SPECIES_HATTERENE_GMAX.categoryName
source: Silent
translation: 寂静

label: SPECIES_HATTERENE_GMAX.description
source:
This Pokémon can read the
emotions of creatures over 30 miles away.
The minute it senses hostility, it
goes on the attack.
translation: 能从触手释放出如同闪电一般的光束。\n也被称为是狂暴的女神。

label: SPECIES_IMPIDIMP.speciesName
source: IMPIDIMP
translation: 捣蛋小妖

label: SPECIES_IMPIDIMP.categoryName
source: Wily
translation: 捉弄

label: SPECIES_IMPIDIMP.description
source:
Through its nose, it sucks in the
emanations produced by people and
Pokémon when they feel annoyed. It
thrives off this negative energy.
translation: 成群结队地生活。\n彼此之间会恶作剧和找不痛快，\n以此来磨炼制造麻烦的技能。

label: SPECIES_MORGREM.speciesName
source: MORGREM
translation: 诈唬魔

label: SPECIES_MORGREM.categoryName
source: Devious
translation: 坏心眼

label: SPECIES_MORGREM.description
source:
When it gets down on all fours as if to
beg for forgiveness, it's trying to lure
opponents in so that it can stab them
with its spear-like hair.
translation: 吸收负面情绪来转换\n成自身能量的宝可梦。\n思考方式消极的人群很喜欢它。

label: SPECIES_GRIMMSNARL.speciesName
source: GRIMMSNARL
translation: 长毛巨魔

label: SPECIES_GRIMMSNARL.categoryName
source: Bulk Up
translation: 健美

label: SPECIES_GRIMMSNARL.description
source: With the hair wrapped around its body\nhelping to enhance its muscles, this\nPokémon can overwhelm even Machamp.
translation: 生活在森林深处。\n即使进化后变得挺拔强壮，\n还是会继续做无聊的坏事和恶作剧。

label: SPECIES_GRIMMSNARL_GMAX.speciesName
source: GRIMMSNARL
translation: 长毛巨魔

label: SPECIES_GRIMMSNARL_GMAX.categoryName
source: Bulk Up
translation: 健美

label: SPECIES_GRIMMSNARL_GMAX.description
source:
Gigantamax energy has caused more
hair to sprout all over its body.
With the added strength, it can jump
over the world's tallest building.
translation: 全身的毛因超极巨化而增多。\n即使是全世界最高的\n建筑也能一跃而过。

label: SPECIES_MILCERY.speciesName
source: MILCERY
translation: 小仙奶

label: SPECIES_MILCERY.categoryName
source: Cream
translation: 鲜奶油

label: SPECIES_MILCERY.description
source: This Pokémon was born from sweet-smelling\nparticles in the air. Its body is made\nof cream.
translation: 遭到敌人袭击时会使出撞击，\n或是令敌人沾满奶油而封住视线，\n或是趁敌人惊叹美味时逃之夭夭。

label: gSpeciesInfoGen8.speciesName
source: ALCREMIE
translation: 霜奶仙

label: gSpeciesInfoGen8.categoryName
source: Cream
translation: 鲜奶油

label: SPECIES_ALCREMIE_GMAX.speciesName
source: ALCREMIE
translation: 霜奶仙

label: SPECIES_ALCREMIE_GMAX.categoryName
source: Cream
translation: 鲜奶油

label: SPECIES_ALCREMIE_GMAX.description
source:
It launches swarms of missiles,
each made of cream and loaded with
100,000 kilocalories. Get hit by one of
these, and your head will swim.
translation: 会胡乱发射1发10万\n千卡的鲜奶油飞弹。\n如果被击中就会头昏眼花。

label: SPECIES_FALINKS.speciesName
source: FALINKS
translation: 列阵兵

label: SPECIES_FALINKS.categoryName
source: Formation
translation: 阵形

label: SPECIES_FALINKS.description
source: Five of them are troopers, and one is the\nbrass. The brass's orders are absolute.
translation: 被称为头头的队长会用可伸缩的\n角做出变换阵型的指令。

label: SPECIES_FALINKS_MEGA.categoryName
source: Formation
translation: 阵形

label: SPECIES_FALINKS_MEGA.description
source:
Mega Falinks has taken on the
ultimate battle formation, which
can be achieved only if the troopers
and brass have the strongest of bonds.
translation: 仅限拥有牢固牵绊的头头和\n跟班才能组成的究极阵形。

label: SPECIES_PINCURCHIN.speciesName
source: PINCURCHIN
translation: 啪嚓海胆

label: SPECIES_PINCURCHIN.categoryName
source: Sea Urchin
translation: 海胆

label: SPECIES_PINCURCHIN.description
source: It feeds on seaweed, using its teeth to\nscrape it off rocks. Electric current\nflows from the tips of its spines.
translation: 性情胆小，\n光是碰到碎藻就能让它吓到放电。\n嘴唇不会导电。

label: SPECIES_SNOM.speciesName
source: SNOM
translation: 雪吞虫

label: SPECIES_SNOM.categoryName
source: Worm
translation: 虫宝宝

label: SPECIES_SNOM.description
source:
It spits out thread imbued with a frigid
sort of energy and uses it to tie its body
to branches, disguising itself as an
icicle while it sleeps.
translation: 会吃掉雪来获得寒气，\n并利用体内的器官加强冰冷的程度，\n以此来制作如冰柱般的尖刺。

label: SPECIES_FROSMOTH.speciesName
source: FROSMOTH
translation: 雪绒蛾

label: SPECIES_FROSMOTH.categoryName
source: Frost Moth
translation: 冰蛾

label: SPECIES_FROSMOTH.description
source:
Icy scales fall from its wings like snow
as it flies over fields and mountains.
The temperature of its wings is less than
-290 degrees Fahrenheit.
translation: 会用能释放寒气的巨大翅膀飞来飞去，\n引发暴风雪。\n喜欢干净的雪融水。

label: SPECIES_STONJOURNER.speciesName
source: STONJOURNER
translation: 巨石丁

label: SPECIES_STONJOURNER.categoryName
source: Big Rock
translation: 巨石

label: SPECIES_STONJOURNER.description
source:
It stands in grasslands, watching the
sun's descent from zenith to horizon. This
Pokémon has a talent for delivering
dynamic kicks.
translation: 每天眺望着日升日落。\n会用超过200公斤的双脚\n悠然自得地在草原上阔步。

label: SPECIES_EISCUE_ICE.speciesName
source: EISCUE
translation: 冰砌鹅

label: SPECIES_EISCUE_ICE.categoryName
source: Penguin
translation: 企鹅

label: SPECIES_EISCUE_ICE.description
source:
It drifted in on the flow of ocean waters
from a frigid place. It keeps its head
iced constantly to make sure it stays
nice and cold.
translation: 脸部的冰块舔起来略带咸味。\n它是乘着海流从遥远的\n寒冷地带来到这里的。

label: SPECIES_EISCUE_NOICE.speciesName
source: EISCUE
translation: 冰砌鹅

label: SPECIES_EISCUE_NOICE.categoryName
source: Penguin
translation: 企鹅

label: SPECIES_EISCUE_NOICE.description
source:
The hair on its head connects to
the surface of its brain. When this
Pokémon has something on its mind,
its hair chills the air around it.
translation: 与外表相反，\n不擅长游泳。\n在发梢做出冰球来吸引并钓起猎物。

label: SPECIES_INDEEDEE_M.speciesName
source: INDEEDEE
translation: 爱管侍

label: SPECIES_INDEEDEE_M.categoryName
source: Emotion
translation: 感情

label: SPECIES_INDEEDEE_M.description
source:
It uses the horns on its head to sense the
emotions of others. Males will act as
valets for those they serve, looking
after their every need.
translation: 时时刻刻都待在训练家身边。\n它会用精神力量来预知训练家的行动，\n并照顾其日常起居。

label: SPECIES_INDEEDEE_F.speciesName
source: INDEEDEE
translation: 爱管侍

label: SPECIES_INDEEDEE_F.categoryName
source: Emotion
translation: 感情

label: SPECIES_INDEEDEE_F.description
source:
They diligently serve people and
Pokémon so they can gather feelings
of gratitude. The females are
particularly good at babysitting.
translation: 为了寻求喜悦和感谢等快乐的心情，\n会勤快地到处照顾人和宝可梦。

label: SPECIES_MORPEKO_FULL_BELLY.speciesName
source: MORPEKO
translation: 莫鲁贝可

label: SPECIES_MORPEKO_FULL_BELLY.categoryName
source: Two-Sided
translation: 双面

label: SPECIES_MORPEKO_FULL_BELLY.description
source:
As it eats the seeds stored up in its
pocket-like pouches, this Pokémon is not
just satisfying its constant hunger. It's
also generating electricity.
translation: 胃很小，\n所以不常吃袋子里的种子的话，\n肚子马上就会饿。

label: SPECIES_MORPEKO_HANGRY.speciesName
source: MORPEKO
translation: 莫鲁贝可

label: SPECIES_MORPEKO_HANGRY.categoryName
source: Two-Sided
translation: 双面

label: SPECIES_MORPEKO_HANGRY.description
source:
Intense hunger drives it to
extremes of violence, and the electricity
in its cheek sacs has converted into
a Dark-type energy.
translation: 因饥饿导致荷尔蒙失衡，\n使颊囊中的电能转化\n成了恶属性的能量。

label: SPECIES_CUFANT.speciesName
source: CUFANT
translation: 铜象

label: SPECIES_CUFANT.categoryName
source: Copperderm
translation: 像铜

label: SPECIES_CUFANT.description
source:
It digs up the ground with its trunk.
It's also very strong, being able to
carry loads of over five tons without any
problem at all.
translation: 能够举起5吨的货物。\n天一亮就会成群结队地\n去洞窟找矿石来吃。

label: SPECIES_COPPERAJAH.speciesName
source: COPPERAJAH
translation: 大王铜象

label: SPECIES_COPPERAJAH.categoryName
source: Copperderm
translation: 像铜

label: SPECIES_COPPERAJAH.description
source: They came over from another region long\nago and worked together with humans.\nTheir green skin is resistant to water.
translation: 自尊心强，脾气刁钻。\n绿色的皮肤越是鲜艳，\n就越受到同伴的尊敬。

label: SPECIES_COPPERAJAH_GMAX.speciesName
source: COPPERAJAH
translation: 大王铜象

label: SPECIES_COPPERAJAH_GMAX.categoryName
source: Copperderm
translation: 像铜

label: SPECIES_COPPERAJAH_GMAX.description
source:
After this Pokémon has Gigantamaxed,
its massive nose can utterly demolish
large structures with a single
smashing blow.
translation: 超极巨化后，\n只要用巨大的象鼻攻击一次，\n就能拆毁高大的建筑。

label: SPECIES_DRACOZOLT.speciesName
source: DRACOZOLT
translation: 雷鸟龙

label: SPECIES_DRACOZOLT.categoryName
source: Fossil
translation: 化石

label: SPECIES_DRACOZOLT.description
source:
In ancient times, it was unbeatable thanks
to its powerful lower body, but it went
extinct anyway after it depleted all its
plant-based food sources.
translation: 会用尾部结实的肌肉发电。\n与下半身相比，\n上半身真的太小了。

label: SPECIES_ARCTOZOLT.speciesName
source: ARCTOZOLT
translation: 雷鸟海兽

label: SPECIES_ARCTOZOLT.categoryName
source: Fossil
translation: 化石

label: SPECIES_ARCTOZOLT.description
source: The shaking of its freezing upper half is\nwhat generates its electricity. It has a\nhard time walking around.
translation: 曾经生活在古代的海边，\n能用身体的冰来保存食物，\n但由于动作太迟缓而灭绝了。

label: SPECIES_DRACOVISH.speciesName
source: DRACOVISH
translation: 鳃鱼龙

label: SPECIES_DRACOVISH.categoryName
source: Fossil
translation: 化石

label: SPECIES_DRACOVISH.description
source:
Powerful legs and jaws made it the apex
