predator of its time. Its own overhunting
of its prey was what drove it to
extinction.
translation: 虽然能用自豪的脚力\n以60公里的时速奔跑，\n但是只能在水中呼吸。

label: SPECIES_ARCTOVISH.speciesName
source: ARCTOVISH
translation: 鳃鱼海兽

label: SPECIES_ARCTOVISH.categoryName
source: Fossil
translation: 化石

label: SPECIES_ARCTOVISH.description
source:
Though it's able to capture prey by
freezing its surroundings, it has trouble
eating the prey afterward because its
mouth is on top of its head.
translation: 面部的皮肤无论受到\n什么攻击都不会受伤，\n但由于呼吸起来不方便而灭绝了。

label: SPECIES_DURALUDON.speciesName
source: DURALUDON
translation: 铝钢龙

label: SPECIES_DURALUDON.categoryName
source: Alloy
translation: 合金

label: SPECIES_DURALUDON.description
source: Its body resembles polished metal, and\nit's both lightweight and strong. The only\ndrawback is that it rusts easily.
translation: 金属的身体虽然坚固，\n但由于会封闭热量，\n因此会从尾巴缝隙排热。

label: SPECIES_DURALUDON_GMAX.speciesName
source: DURALUDON
translation: 铝钢龙

label: SPECIES_DURALUDON_GMAX.categoryName
source: Alloy
translation: 合金

label: SPECIES_DURALUDON_GMAX.description
source:
The hardness of its cells is
exceptional, even among Steel types. It
also has a body structure that's
resistant to earthquakes.
translation: 细胞的硬度在钢属性\n宝可梦之中也是顶级的。\n拥有抗震的构造。

label: SPECIES_ARCHALUDON.speciesName
source: ARCHALUDON
translation: 铝钢桥龙

label: SPECIES_ARCHALUDON.categoryName
source: Alloy
translation: 合金

label: SPECIES_ARCHALUDON.description
source:
It gathers static electricity
from its surroundings. The beams
it launches when down on all fours
are tremendously powerful.
translation: 会在山里挖洞寻找食物。\n身体坚硬，\n即使遇到塌方也毫无问题。

label: SPECIES_DREEPY.speciesName
source: DREEPY
translation: 多龙梅西亚

label: SPECIES_DREEPY.categoryName
source: Lingering
translation: 哀怨

label: SPECIES_DREEPY.description
source:
After being reborn as a ghost Pokémon,
Dreepy wanders the areas it used to
inhabit back when it was alive in
prehistoric seas.
translation: 明明不吃却又会咬住铁臂枪虾不放。\n听说这是它生前遗留下来的活动习性。

label: SPECIES_DRAKLOAK.speciesName
source: DRAKLOAK
translation: 多龙奇

label: SPECIES_DRAKLOAK.categoryName
source: Caretaker
translation: 保姆

label: SPECIES_DRAKLOAK.description
source: It's capable of flying faster than 120 mph.\nIt battles alongside Dreepy and dotes\non them until they successfully evolve.
translation: 会在肺部储存能量并进行攻击。\n在多龙梅西亚能独当一面之前，\n会和它一起战斗并照顾它。

label: SPECIES_DRAGAPULT.speciesName
source: DRAGAPULT
translation: 多龙巴鲁托

label: SPECIES_DRAGAPULT.categoryName
source: Stealth
translation: 隐形

label: SPECIES_DRAGAPULT.description
source:
When it isn't battling, it keeps Dreepy
in the holes on its horns. Once a fight
starts, it launches the Dreepy like
supersonic missiles.
translation: 群体里飞得最快的个体总是被想要\n体验音速飞行的多龙梅西亚包围。

label: SPECIES_ZACIAN_HERO.speciesName
source: ZACIAN
translation: 苍响

label: SPECIES_ZACIAN_HERO.categoryName
source: Warrior
translation: 强者

label: SPECIES_ZACIAN_HERO.description
source: Known as a legendary hero, this Pokémon\nabsorbs metal particles, transforming\nthem into a weapon it uses to battle.
translation: 这只宝可梦被认为是沉睡已久的\n藏玛然特的姐姐，\n也有人认为它们之间是劲敌关系。

label: SPECIES_ZACIAN_CROWNED.speciesName
source: ZACIAN
translation: 苍响

label: SPECIES_ZACIAN_CROWNED.categoryName
source: Warrior
translation: 强者

label: SPECIES_ZACIAN_CROWNED.description
source:
Able to cut down anything with a
single strike, it became known as the
Fairy King's Sword, and it inspired
awe in friend and foe alike.
translation: 能斩断世间万物，\n因此被称为妖精王之剑，\n让敌友都对其敬畏不已。

label: SPECIES_ZAMAZENTA_HERO.speciesName
source: ZAMAZENTA
translation: 藏玛然特

label: SPECIES_ZAMAZENTA_HERO.categoryName
source: Warrior
translation: 强者

label: SPECIES_ZAMAZENTA_HERO.description
source:
In times past, it worked together with a
king of the people to save the Galar
region. It absorbs metal that it then
uses in battle.
translation: 以石像般的姿态陷入\n长久沉眠的宝可梦。\n几乎就要被人们所遗忘。

label: SPECIES_ZAMAZENTA_CROWNED.speciesName
source: ZAMAZENTA
translation: 藏玛然特

label: SPECIES_ZAMAZENTA_CROWNED.categoryName
source: Warrior
translation: 强者

label: SPECIES_ZAMAZENTA_CROWNED.description
source:
Its ability to deflect any attack
led to it being known as the Fighting
Master's Shield. It was feared and
respected by all.
translation: 全副武装的样子。\n即使是极巨化宝可梦的\n攻击也能轻易抵挡。

label: SPECIES_ETERNATUS.speciesName
source: ETERNATUS
translation: 无极汰那

label: SPECIES_ETERNATUS.categoryName
source: Gigantic
translation: 超极巨

label: SPECIES_ETERNATUS.description
source:
The core on its chest absorbs energy
emanating from the lands of the Galar
region. This energy is what allows
Eternatus to stay active.
translation: 来自于2万年前坠落到\n地上的陨石之中。\n似乎与极巨化之谜有所关联。

label: SPECIES_ETERNATUS_ETERNAMAX.speciesName
source: ETERNATUS
translation: 无极汰那

label: SPECIES_ETERNATUS_ETERNAMAX.categoryName
source: Gigantic
translation: 超极巨

label: SPECIES_ETERNATUS_ETERNAMAX.description
source:
As a result of Rose's meddling,
Eternatus absorbed all the energy in
the Galar region. It's now in a state
of power overload.
translation: 巨大化的核心释放出无限的能量，\n扭曲了周围的时空。

label: SPECIES_KUBFU.speciesName
source: KUBFU
translation: 熊徒弟

label: SPECIES_KUBFU.categoryName
source: Wushu
translation: 拳法

label: SPECIES_KUBFU.description
source: Kubfu trains hard to perfect its moves.\nThe moves it masters will determine which\nform it takes when it evolves.
translation: 拉紧头上又白又长的体毛，\n就会变得斗气势高昂，\n并从丹田涌出力量。

label: SPECIES_URSHIFU_SINGLE_STRIKE.speciesName
source: URSHIFU
translation: 武道熊师

label: SPECIES_URSHIFU_SINGLE_STRIKE.categoryName
source: Wushu
translation: 拳法

label: SPECIES_URSHIFU_SINGLE_STRIKE.description
source:
This form of Urshifu is a strong believer
in the one-hit KO. Its strategy is to leap
in close to foes and land a devastating
blow with a hardened fist.
translation: 生活在遥远地区的山岳地带。\n通过在断崖绝壁上奔跑来锻炼腰腿，\n磨炼招式。

label: SPECIES_URSHIFU_SINGLE_STRIKE_GMAX.speciesName
source: URSHIFU
translation: 武道熊师

label: SPECIES_URSHIFU_SINGLE_STRIKE_GMAX.categoryName
source: Wushu
translation: 拳法

label: SPECIES_URSHIFU_SINGLE_STRIKE_GMAX.description
source:
People call it the embodiment of
rage. It's said that this Pokémon's
terrifying expression and shout will
rid the world of malevolence.
translation: 把多击制胜作为自己的信条。\n会像水流一样毫不停息地\n用打击招式攻击对手。

label: SPECIES_URSHIFU_RAPID_STRIKE.speciesName
source: URSHIFU
translation: 武道熊师

label: SPECIES_URSHIFU_RAPID_STRIKE.categoryName
source: Wushu
translation: 拳法

label: SPECIES_URSHIFU_RAPID_STRIKE.description
source:
This form of Urshifu is a strong
believer in defeating foes by raining
many blows down on them. Its
strikes are nonstop, flowing like a river.
translation: 从拳头放出的能量变成了冲击波，\n能一击打飞极巨化的宝可梦。

label: SPECIES_URSHIFU_RAPID_STRIKE_GMAX.speciesName
source: URSHIFU
translation: 武道熊师

label: SPECIES_URSHIFU_RAPID_STRIKE_GMAX.categoryName
source: Wushu
translation: 拳法

label: SPECIES_URSHIFU_RAPID_STRIKE_GMAX.description
source:
As it waits for the right moment to
unleash its Gigantamax power, this
Pokémon maintains a perfect one-
legged stance. It won't even twitch.
translation: 据说内心邪恶的家伙只是被它\n暗藏愤怒的眼睛瞪着就会一命呜呼。

label: SPECIES_ZARUDE.speciesName
source: ZARUDE
translation: 萨戮德

label: SPECIES_ZARUDE.categoryName
source: Rogue Monkey
translation: 恶猿

label: SPECIES_ZARUDE.description
source:
Within dense forests, this Pokémon lives
in a pack with others of its kind. It's
incredibly aggressive, and the other
Pokémon of the forest fear it.
translation: 长在身上的藤蔓断掉\n之后会变成土壤的养分，\n帮助森林中的植物成长。

label: SPECIES_ZARUDE_DADA.speciesName
source: ZARUDE
translation: 萨戮德

label: SPECIES_ZARUDE_DADA.categoryName
source: Rogue Monkey
translation: 恶猿

label: SPECIES_ZARUDE_DADA.description
source:
This Zarude's special strength
stems from its love and care for an
orphaned human child that the Pokémon
has raised.
translation: 对于由自己捡来并抚养长大的\n人类小孩怀有深厚的感情。\n这份感情带给它一种特别的力量。

label: SPECIES_REGIELEKI.speciesName
source: REGIELEKI
translation: 雷吉艾勒奇

label: SPECIES_REGIELEKI.categoryName
source: Electron
translation: 电子

label: SPECIES_REGIELEKI.description
source:
This Pokémon is a cluster of electrical
energy. It's said that removing the rings
on Regieleki's body will unleash the
Pokémon's latent power.
translation: 整个身体是制造电能的器官。\n可以制造出伽勒尔全域所需的电力。

label: SPECIES_REGIDRAGO.speciesName
source: REGIDRAGO
translation: 雷吉铎拉戈

label: SPECIES_REGIDRAGO.categoryName
source: Dragon Orb
translation: 龙玉

label: SPECIES_REGIDRAGO.description
source:
An academic theory proposes that
Regidrago's arms were once the head of an
ancient dragon Pokémon. The theory
remains unproven.
translation: 整个身体是龙之能量的结晶。\n据说它拥有所有龙宝可梦的能力。

label: SPECIES_GLASTRIER.speciesName
source: GLASTRIER
translation: 雪暴马

label: SPECIES_GLASTRIER.categoryName
source: Wild Horse
translation: 烈马

label: SPECIES_GLASTRIER.description
source: Glastrier emits intense cold from its\nhooves. It's also a belligerent Pokémon--\nanything it wants, it takes by force.
translation: 拥有十分惊人的怪力。\n戴在脸上的冰之面罩\n硬度是钻石的100倍。

label: SPECIES_SPECTRIER.speciesName
source: SPECTRIER
translation: 灵幽马

label: SPECIES_SPECTRIER.categoryName
source: Swift Horse
translation: 骏马

label: SPECIES_SPECTRIER.description
source:
It probes its surroundings with all its
senses save one--it doesn't use its sense
of sight. Spectrier's kicks are said to
separate soul from body.
translation: 在黑暗的夜晚中奔跑，\n吸取正在睡觉的生物的生命能量。\n喜欢孤独和静寂。

label: SPECIES_CALYREX.speciesName
source: CALYREX
translation: 蕾冠王

label: SPECIES_CALYREX.categoryName
source: King
translation: 国王

label: SPECIES_CALYREX.description
source:
Calyrex is a merciful Pokémon, capable of
providing healing and blessings. It
reigned over the Galar region in times
of yore.
translation: 曾经在很久以前统治着\n伽勒尔的传说之王。\n拥有治愈心灵和让草木发芽的能力。

label: SPECIES_CALYREX_ICE.speciesName
source: CALYREX
translation: 蕾冠王

label: SPECIES_CALYREX_ICE.categoryName
source: High King
translation: 帝皇

label: SPECIES_CALYREX_ICE.description
source:
According to lore, this Pokémon
showed no mercy to those who got in
its way, yet it would heal its
opponents' wounds after battle.
translation: 据说它用一个晚上把广阔的森林\n和栖息在其中的生物转移\n到了其他的地方。

label: SPECIES_CALYREX_SHADOW.speciesName
source: CALYREX
translation: 蕾冠王

label: SPECIES_CALYREX_SHADOW.categoryName
source: High King
translation: 帝皇

label: SPECIES_CALYREX_SHADOW.description
source:
It's said that Calyrex and a
Pokémon that had bonded with it ran all
across the Galar region to bring green
to the wastelands.
translation: 据说它用能够看透过去与未来\n所有事件的能力从陨石掉落的\n危机中拯救了森林中的生物。

label: SPECIES_ENAMORUS_INCARNATE.speciesName
source: ENAMORUS
translation: 眷恋云

label: SPECIES_ENAMORUS_INCARNATE.categoryName
source: Love-Hate
translation: 爱憎

label: SPECIES_ENAMORUS_INCARNATE.description
source:
Its arrival brings an end to the winter.
According to legend, this Pokémon's love
gives rise to the budding of fresh life
across the land.
translation: 当它越过大海飞来，便代表严寒\n的冬季即将终结。传说中其慈爱将\n使新的生命在洗翠大地上萌芽。

label: SPECIES_ENAMORUS_THERIAN.speciesName
source: ENAMORUS
translation: 眷恋云

label: SPECIES_ENAMORUS_THERIAN.categoryName
source: Love-Hate
translation: 爱憎

label: SPECIES_ENAMORUS_THERIAN.description
source:
From the clouds, it descends upon
those who treat any form of life
with disrespect and metes out
wrathful, ruthless punishment.
translation: 自女人的姿态变化而成。若有谁做出\n糟蹋生命之事，便会从云海中现身，\n愤怒地降下无情的惩罚。

label: SPECIES_SPRIGATITO.speciesName
source: SPRIGATITO
translation: 新叶喵

label: SPECIES_SPRIGATITO.categoryName
source: Grass Cat
translation: 草猫

label: SPECIES_SPRIGATITO.description
source:
The sweet scent its body gives off
mesmerizes those around it. The
scent grows stronger when this
Pokémon is in the sun.
translation: 通过身体发出的甜甜香气\n来让周围的一切为之倾倒。\n晒到阳光后香气会更加浓郁。

label: SPECIES_FLORAGATO.speciesName
source: FLORAGATO
translation: 蒂蕾喵

label: SPECIES_FLORAGATO.categoryName
source: Grass Cat
translation: 草猫

label: SPECIES_FLORAGATO.description
source:
Floragato deftly wields the vine
hidden beneath its long fur, slamming
the hard flower bud against its
opponents.
translation: 体毛的硬度随心情而变。\n进入迎战状态时，\n体毛会变得如针一般尖锐。

label: SPECIES_MEOWSCARADA.speciesName
source: MEOWSCARADA
translation: 魔幻假面喵

label: SPECIES_MEOWSCARADA.categoryName
source: Magician
translation: 魔术师

label: SPECIES_MEOWSCARADA.description
source:
This Pokémon uses the reflective
fur lining its cape to camouflage the
stem of its flower, creating the
illusion that the flower is floating.
translation: 会巧妙地引开敌人的注意力，\n然后引爆它在神不知鬼不觉间\n设置好的装满花粉的花炸弹。

label: SPECIES_FUECOCO.speciesName
source: FUECOCO
translation: 呆火鳄

label: SPECIES_FUECOCO.categoryName
source: Fire Croc
translation: 火鳄

label: SPECIES_FUECOCO.description
source:
Its flame sac is small, so energy is
always leaking out. This energy is
released from the dent atop
Fuecoco's head and flickers to and fro.
translation: 火囊很小，\n因此能量会从头部的凹陷处溢出来，\n并摇曳晃动着。

label: SPECIES_CROCALOR.speciesName
source: CROCALOR
translation: 炙烫鳄

label: SPECIES_CROCALOR.categoryName
source: Fire Croc
translation: 火鳄

label: SPECIES_CROCALOR.description
source:
The combination of Crocalor's fire
energy and overflowing vitality has
caused an egg-shaped fireball to
appear on the Pokémon's head.
translation: 声带和火囊的阀紧邻在一起。\n会一边发出嘶哑的声音，\n一边喷洒火焰。

label: SPECIES_SKELEDIRGE.speciesName
source: SKELEDIRGE
translation: 骨纹巨声鳄

label: SPECIES_SKELEDIRGE.categoryName
source: Singer
translation: 歌手

label: SPECIES_SKELEDIRGE.description
source:
Skeledirge's gentle singing
soothes the souls of all that hear it. It
burns its enemies to a crisp with
flames of over 5,400 degrees Fahrenheit.
translation: 温柔的歌声能治愈听者的灵魂。\n会使用3000度的火焰\n将敌人烧成灰烬。

label: SPECIES_QUAXLY.speciesName
source: QUAXLY
translation: 润水鸭

label: SPECIES_QUAXLY.categoryName
source: Duckling
translation: 小鸭

label: SPECIES_QUAXLY.description
source:
Its strong legs let it easily swim
around in even fast-flowing rivers.
It likes to keep things tidy and is
prone to overthinking things.
translation: 脚力之强，\n即使在水流湍急的河川也能自在游动。\n爱干净，性格有些顽固。

label: SPECIES_QUAXWELL.speciesName
source: QUAXWELL
translation: 涌跃鸭

label: SPECIES_QUAXWELL.categoryName
source: Practicing
translation: 习艺

label: SPECIES_QUAXWELL.description
source:
The hardworking Quaxwell observes
people and Pokémon from various
regions and incorporates their
movements into its own dance routines.
translation: 性情勤奋。\n会观察各个地区的人和宝可梦的\n动作来吸取到自己的舞蹈里。

label: SPECIES_QUAQUAVAL.speciesName
source: QUAQUAVAL
translation: 狂欢浪舞鸭

label: SPECIES_QUAQUAVAL.categoryName
source: Dancer
translation: 舞者

label: SPECIES_QUAQUAVAL.description
source:
A single kick from a Quaquaval can
send a truck rolling. This Pokémon
uses its powerful legs to perform
striking dances from far-off lands.
translation: 会用充满异国风情的舞蹈来迷倒看者，\n然后挥舞以水构成的羽饰将其劈裂。

label: SPECIES_LECHONK.speciesName
source: LECHONK
translation: 爱吃豚

label: SPECIES_LECHONK.categoryName
source: Hog
translation: 猪

label: SPECIES_LECHONK.description
source:
It searches for food all day. It
possesses a keen sense of smell but
doesn't use it for anything other
than foraging.
translation: 只吃精挑细选过的食物。\n虫宝可梦很讨厌它身上散发的\n那种仿佛香草的气味。

label: SPECIES_OINKOLOGNE_M.speciesName
source: OINKOLOGNE
translation: 飘香豚

label: SPECIES_OINKOLOGNE_M.categoryName
source: Hog
translation: 猪

label: SPECIES_OINKOLOGNE_M.description
source: Oinkologne is proud of its fine,\nglossy skin. It emits a concentrated\nscent from the tip of its tail.
translation: 会从全身散发出香甜妖艳的气味，\n令雌性的宝可梦为它神魂颠倒。

label: SPECIES_OINKOLOGNE_F.speciesName
source: OINKOLOGNE
translation: 飘香豚

label: SPECIES_OINKOLOGNE_F.categoryName
source: Hog
translation: 猪

label: SPECIES_OINKOLOGNE_F.description
source:
This is a meticulous Pokémon that
likes to keep things tidy. It
shrouds itself in a floral aroma that
soothes the Pokémon around it.
translation: 喜欢干净，个性一丝不苟。\n会让花香包裹全身\n来治愈周围的宝可梦们。

label: SPECIES_TAROUNTULA.speciesName
source: TAROUNTULA
translation: 团珠蛛

label: SPECIES_TAROUNTULA.categoryName
source: String Ball
translation: 线球

label: SPECIES_TAROUNTULA.description
source:
The thread it secretes from its
rear is as strong as wire. The secret
behind the thread's strength is the
topic of ongoing research.
translation: 从臀部射出的丝线的\n强度可以匹敌金属丝。\n强度的秘密至今仍在被研究中。

label: SPECIES_SPIDOPS.speciesName
source: SPIDOPS
translation: 操陷蛛

label: SPECIES_SPIDOPS.categoryName
source: Trap
translation: 陷阱

label: SPECIES_SPIDOPS.description
source:
It clings to branches and ceilings
using its threads and moves without
a sound. It takes out its prey
before the prey even notices it.
translation: 会在自己的地盘里布下\n坚固又黏糊糊的丝线，\n来当做捕捉入侵者的陷阱。

label: SPECIES_NYMBLE.speciesName
source: NYMBLE
translation: 豆蟋蟀

label: SPECIES_NYMBLE.categoryName
source: Grasshopper
translation: 蝗虫

label: SPECIES_NYMBLE.description
source:
It has its third set of legs folded
up. When it's in a tough spot, this
Pokémon jumps over 30 feet using the
strength of its legs.
translation: 活用跳跃力来闪避攻击，\n并同时给予对手伤害，\n是它很擅长的战斗方式。

label: SPECIES_LOKIX.speciesName
source: LOKIX
translation: 烈腿蝗

label: SPECIES_LOKIX.categoryName
source: Grasshopper
translation: 蝗虫

label: SPECIES_LOKIX.description
source:
When it decides to fight all out, it
stands on its previously folded
legs to enter Showdown Mode. It
neutralizes its enemies in short order.
translation: 进入决战模式时会使用折叠起来的\n第3双脚，这会给它身体造成很大的\n负担，因此无法久战。

label: SPECIES_PAWMI.speciesName
source: PAWMI
translation: 布拨

label: SPECIES_PAWMI.categoryName
source: Mouse
translation: 鼠

label: SPECIES_PAWMI.description
source:
The pads of its paws are electricity-
discharging organs. Pawmi fires
electricity from its forepaws while
standing unsteadily on its hind legs.
translation: 手部的肉球是放电器官。\n努力用后脚站立起来，\n然后从手掌释放出电击。

label: SPECIES_PAWMO.speciesName
source: PAWMO
translation: 布土拨

label: SPECIES_PAWMO.categoryName
source: Mouse
translation: 鼠

label: SPECIES_PAWMO.description
source:
When its group is attacked, Pawmo
is the first to leap into battle,
defeating enemies with a fighting
technique that utilizes electric shocks.
translation: 使用的格斗技非常独特。\n会一边用手掌给予打击，\n一边用肉球释放电击。

label: SPECIES_PAWMOT.speciesName
source: PAWMOT
translation: 巴布土拨

label: SPECIES_PAWMOT.categoryName
source: Hands-On
translation: 押掌

label: SPECIES_PAWMOT.description
source:
This Pokémon normally is slow to
react, but once it enters battle, it
will strike down its enemies with
lightning-fast movements.
translation: 蓬松的体毛是蓄电池。\n可以储存与电动汽车等量的电力。

label: SPECIES_TANDEMAUS.speciesName
source: TANDEMAUS
translation: 一对鼠

label: SPECIES_TANDEMAUS.categoryName
source: Couple
translation: 成对

label: SPECIES_TANDEMAUS.description
source:
Exhibiting great teamwork, they
use their incisors to cut pieces out
of any material that might be useful
for a nest, then make off with them.
translation: 无论何时2只待都在一起。\n会把寻获的食物均分成两半，\n亲密无间地一起进食。

label: SPECIES_MAUSHOLD_THREE.speciesName
source: MAUSHOLD
translation: 一家鼠

label: SPECIES_MAUSHOLD_THREE.categoryName
source: Family
translation: 家族

label: SPECIES_MAUSHOLD_THREE.description
source:
The little one just appeared one
day. They all live together like a
family, but the relationship between
the three is still unclear.
translation: 不知不觉之间多了个小孩。\n虽然像一家子一样生活，\n但3只的关系仍是个迷。

label: SPECIES_MAUSHOLD_FOUR.speciesName
source: MAUSHOLD
translation: 一家鼠

label: SPECIES_MAUSHOLD_FOUR.categoryName
source: Family
translation: 家族

label: SPECIES_MAUSHOLD_FOUR.description
source:
The larger pair protects the little
ones during battles. When facing
strong opponents, the whole group
will join the fight.
translation: 身型大的2只会一边\n保护孩子一边战斗。\n对抗强大的对手时会集体出阵。

label: SPECIES_FIDOUGH.speciesName
source: FIDOUGH
translation: 狗仔包

label: SPECIES_FIDOUGH.categoryName
source: Puppy
translation: 小狗

label: SPECIES_FIDOUGH.description
source:
This Pokémon is smooth and moist
to the touch. Yeast in Fidough's
breath induces fermentation in the
Pokémon's vicinity.
translation: 吐出的气息中所含有的酵母\n能在制作料理时派上用场，\n因此自古以来都受到人们的保护。

label: SPECIES_DACHSBUN.speciesName
source: DACHSBUN
translation: 麻花犬

label: SPECIES_DACHSBUN.categoryName
source: Dog
translation: 狗

label: SPECIES_DACHSBUN.description
source:
The pleasant aroma that emanates
from this Pokémon's body helps
wheat grow, so Dachsbun has been
treasured by farming villages.
translation: 它的皮肤表面拥有遇到\n高温就变硬的性质。\n身体散发着香香的气味。

label: SPECIES_SMOLIV.speciesName
source: SMOLIV
translation: 迷你芙

label: SPECIES_SMOLIV.categoryName
source: Olive
translation: 橄榄

label: SPECIES_SMOLIV.description
source:
This Pokémon converts nutrients
into oil, which it stores in the fruit
on its head. It can easily go a whole
week without eating or drinking.
translation: 会把营养转换成油，\n并储存在头部的果实里。\n1个星期不吃不喝也无所谓。

label: SPECIES_DOLLIV.speciesName
source: DOLLIV
translation: 奥利纽

label: SPECIES_DOLLIV.categoryName
source: Olive
translation: 橄榄

label: SPECIES_DOLLIV.description
source:
Dolliv shares its tasty, fresh-
scented oil with others. This species
has coexisted with humans since
times long gone.
translation: 当头上的果实沐浴了充足的\n阳光而开始成熟时，\n它就会远离人烟，踏上旅途。

label: SPECIES_ARBOLIVA.speciesName
source: ARBOLIVA
translation: 奥利瓦

label: SPECIES_ARBOLIVA.categoryName
source: Olive
translation: 橄榄

label: SPECIES_ARBOLIVA.description
source:
This Pokémon drives back enemies
by launching its rich, aromatic oil at
them with enough force to smash a
boulder.
translation: 会以连岩石都能粉碎的力道\n把香醇浓郁的油发射出去，\n击退敌人。

label: SPECIES_SQUAWKABILLY_GREEN.speciesName
source: SQUAWKABILLY
translation: 怒鹦哥

label: SPECIES_SQUAWKABILLY_GREEN.categoryName
source: Parrot
translation: 鹦鹉

label: SPECIES_SQUAWKABILLY_GREEN.description
source:
Green-feathered flocks hold the
most sway. When they're out
searching for food in the mornings and
evenings, it gets very noisy.
translation: 拥有绿色羽毛的怒鹦哥势力最为庞大。\n在觅食时段的早晨和夜晚会非常吵。

label: SPECIES_SQUAWKABILLY_BLUE.speciesName
source: SQUAWKABILLY
translation: 怒鹦哥

label: SPECIES_SQUAWKABILLY_BLUE.categoryName
source: Parrot
translation: 鹦鹉

label: SPECIES_SQUAWKABILLY_BLUE.description
source:
The largest of their flocks can
contain more than 50 individuals. They
fly around towns and forests,
searching for food and making a racket.
translation: 蓝色羽毛的群体把势力最大的\n绿色羽毛的群体视为竞争对手。

label: SPECIES_SQUAWKABILLY_YELLOW.speciesName
source: SQUAWKABILLY
translation: 怒鹦哥

label: SPECIES_SQUAWKABILLY_YELLOW.categoryName
source: Parrot
translation: 鹦鹉

label: SPECIES_SQUAWKABILLY_YELLOW.description
source:
These Squawkabilly are hotheaded,
and their fighting style is vicious.
They'll leap within reach of their
foes to engage in close combat.
translation: 黄色的怒鹦哥最为粗暴。\n有时还会把其他鸟宝可梦赶出城镇。

label: SPECIES_SQUAWKABILLY_WHITE.speciesName
source: SQUAWKABILLY
translation: 怒鹦哥

label: SPECIES_SQUAWKABILLY_WHITE.categoryName
source: Parrot
translation: 鹦鹉

label: SPECIES_SQUAWKABILLY_WHITE.description
source:
Though these Squawkabilly are the
fewest in number, they have no
trouble living in towns since they blend
in with the white buildings.
translation: 虽然这种颜色的数量最少，\n但由于能融入建筑物的颜色里，\n因此在城镇中生活起来很容易。

label: SPECIES_NACLI.speciesName
source: NACLI
translation: 盐石宝

label: SPECIES_NACLI.categoryName
source: Rock Salt
translation: 岩盐

label: SPECIES_NACLI.description
source:
The ground scrapes its body as it
travels, causing it to leave salt
behind. Salt is constantly being created
and replenished inside Nacli's body.
translation: 身体会受到地面磨损，\n因此只要走过就会留下盐迹。\n体内会随时制造出盐来补充。

label: SPECIES_NACLSTACK.speciesName
source: NACLSTACK
translation: 盐石垒

label: SPECIES_NACLSTACK.categoryName
source: Rock Salt
translation: 岩盐

label: SPECIES_NACLSTACK.description
source:
It compresses rock salt inside its
body and shoots out hardened salt
pellets with enough force to
perforate an iron sheet.
translation: 在体内压缩岩盐，\n以此形成坚硬的盐弹，\n发射后的威力连铁板都能贯穿。

label: SPECIES_GARGANACL.speciesName
source: GARGANACL
translation: 盐石巨灵

label: SPECIES_GARGANACL.categoryName
source: Rock Salt
translation: 岩盐

label: SPECIES_GARGANACL.description
source:
Garganacl will rub its fingertips
together and sprinkle injured
Pokémon with salt. Even severe wounds will
promptly heal afterward.
translation: 盐石巨灵的周围总会有\n大量的宝可梦聚集而来，\n为了一舔它那富含矿物质的盐。

label: SPECIES_CHARCADET.speciesName
source: CHARCADET
translation: 炭小侍

label: SPECIES_CHARCADET.categoryName
source: Fire Child
translation: 小火星

label: SPECIES_CHARCADET.description
source:
Burnt charcoal came to life and
became a Pokémon. Possessing a fiery
fighting spirit, Charcadet will
battle even tough opponents.
translation: 一旦进入战斗状态，\n火力就会上升至摄氏1000度。\n喜欢吃油脂含量高的树果。

label: SPECIES_ARMAROUGE.speciesName
source: ARMAROUGE
translation: 红莲铠骑

label: SPECIES_ARMAROUGE.categoryName
source: Fire Warrior
translation: 火战士

label: SPECIES_ARMAROUGE.description
source:
Armarouge evolved through the use
of a set of armor that belonged to
a distinguished warrior. This
Pokémon is incredibly loyal.
translation: 身上包裹着通过超能力\n和火焰的能量而得到强化的铠甲。\n会释放灼热的火球。

label: SPECIES_CERULEDGE.speciesName
source: CERULEDGE
translation: 苍炎刃鬼

label: SPECIES_CERULEDGE.categoryName
source: Fire Blades
translation: 火剑士

label: SPECIES_CERULEDGE.description
source:
The fiery blades on its arms burn
fiercely with the lingering
resentment of a sword wielder who fell
before accomplishing their goal.
translation: 渗进了怨念的旧盔甲进化而成的样子。\n会毫不留情地斩断敌人。

label: SPECIES_TADBULB.speciesName
source: TADBULB
translation: 光蚪仔

label: SPECIES_TADBULB.categoryName
source: EleTadpole
translation: 电蝌蚪

label: SPECIES_TADBULB.description
source:
Tadbulb shakes its tail to
generate electricity. If it senses danger,
it will make its head blink on and off
to alert its allies.
translation: 会靠储存在体内的电力来浮在空中。\n出现雷云时能比平时浮得更高。

label: SPECIES_BELLIBOLT.speciesName
source: BELLIBOLT
translation: 电肚蛙

label: SPECIES_BELLIBOLT.categoryName
source: EleFrog
translation: 电蛙

label: SPECIES_BELLIBOLT.description
source:
When this Pokémon expands and
contracts its wobbly body, the belly-
button dynamo in its stomach
produces a huge amount of electricity.
translation: 看似眼球的部位其实是放电器官，\n能够用来发射腹部的\n发电脐所制造的电力。

label: SPECIES_WATTREL.speciesName
source: WATTREL
translation: 电海燕

label: SPECIES_WATTREL.categoryName
source: Storm Petrel
translation: 海燕

label: SPECIES_WATTREL.description
source:
When its wings catch the wind, the
bones within produce electricity.
This Pokémon dives into the ocean,
catching prey by electrocuting them.
translation: 在海岸的悬崖上筑巢。\n它的巢具有在嘴里蹦跳的神奇口感，\n因此是受欢迎的珍味佳肴。

label: SPECIES_KILOWATTREL.speciesName
source: KILOWATTREL
translation: 大电海燕

label: SPECIES_KILOWATTREL.categoryName
source: Frigatebird
translation: 军舰鸟

label: SPECIES_KILOWATTREL.description
source:
It uses its throat sac to store
electricity generated by its wings.
There's hardly any oil in its feathers,
so it is a poor swimmer.
translation: 会把翅膀制造的电储存到喉囊里。\n由于羽毛所含的油脂非常少，\n因此它不是很擅长游泳。

label: SPECIES_MASCHIFF.speciesName
source: MASCHIFF
translation: 偶叫獒

label: SPECIES_MASCHIFF.categoryName
source: Rascal
translation: 小辈

label: SPECIES_MASCHIFF.description
source:
Its well-developed jaw and fangs
are strong enough to crunch through
boulders, and its thick fat makes
for an excellent defense.
translation: 发达的颚部和獠牙拥有\n能咬碎岩石的强大威力。\n厚厚脂肪的防御力相当突出。

label: SPECIES_MABOSSTIFF.speciesName
source: MABOSSTIFF
translation: 獒教父

label: SPECIES_MABOSSTIFF.categoryName
source: Boss
translation: 大佬

label: SPECIES_MABOSSTIFF.description
source:
Mabosstiff loves playing with
children. Though usually gentle, it
takes on an intimidating look when
protecting its family.
translation: 非常喜欢和小孩玩耍。\n平时性情温和，\n但在保护家人时表情会发生改变。

label: SPECIES_SHROODLE.speciesName
source: SHROODLE
translation: 滋汁鼹

label: SPECIES_SHROODLE.categoryName
source: Toxic Mouse
translation: 毒鼠

label: SPECIES_SHROODLE.description
source:
To keep enemies away from its
territory, it paints markings around its
nest using a poisonous liquid that
has an acrid odor.
translation: 为了不让敌人靠近地盘，\n会用带着刺鼻臭味的毒液\n在巢的周围画出图形。

label: SPECIES_GRAFAIAI.speciesName
source: GRAFAIAI
translation: 涂标客

label: SPECIES_GRAFAIAI.categoryName
source: Toxic Monkey
translation: 毒猴

label: SPECIES_GRAFAIAI.description
source:
Each Grafaiai paints its own
individual pattern, and it will paint that
same pattern over and over again
throughout its life.
translation: 涂标客画出的图案\n会随个体而有所不同。\n一生都持续画着相同的图案。

label: SPECIES_BRAMBLIN.speciesName
source: BRAMBLIN
translation: 纳噬草

label: SPECIES_BRAMBLIN.categoryName
source: Tumbleweed
translation: 滚草

label: SPECIES_BRAMBLIN.description
source:
A soul unable to move on to the
afterlife was blown around by the wind
until it got tangled up with dried
grass and became a Pokémon.
translation: 随着风在荒野之间滚动，\n自己也不知道会滚到哪里去。\n最讨厌身体被弄得湿答答的。

label: SPECIES_BRAMBLEGHAST.speciesName
source: BRAMBLEGHAST
translation: 怖纳噬草

label: SPECIES_BRAMBLEGHAST.categoryName
source: Tumbleweed
translation: 滚草

label: SPECIES_BRAMBLEGHAST.description
source:
It will open the branches of its
head to envelop its prey. Once it
absorbs all the life energy it needs, it
expels the prey and discards it.
translation: 会在干燥地带流浪。\n有极低的概率会大量出现，\n把一座城镇塞得满满当当。

label: SPECIES_TOEDSCOOL.speciesName
source: TOEDSCOOL
translation: 原野水母

label: SPECIES_TOEDSCOOL.categoryName
source: Woodear
translation: 木耳

label: SPECIES_TOEDSCOOL.description
source:
Though it looks like Tentacool,
Toedscool is a completely different
species. Its legs may be thin, but it
can run at a speed of 30 mph.
translation: 看起来像玛瑙水母，其实是\n截然不同的种类。虽然脚很细，\n但是跑起来能达到时速50公里。

label: SPECIES_TOEDSCRUEL.speciesName
source: TOEDSCRUEL
translation: 陆地水母

label: SPECIES_TOEDSCRUEL.categoryName
source: Woodear
translation: 木耳

label: SPECIES_TOEDSCRUEL.description
source:
These Pokémon gather into groups
and form colonies deep within
forests. They absolutely hate it when
strangers approach.
translation: 会用10根触手缠住敌人\n并吸取养分来折磨对方。\n下摆的褶皱是很受欢迎的珍味佳肴。

label: SPECIES_KLAWF.speciesName
source: KLAWF
translation: 毛崖蟹

label: SPECIES_KLAWF.categoryName
source: Ambush
translation: 埋伏

label: SPECIES_KLAWF.description
source:
Klawf hangs upside-down from
cliffs, waiting for prey. But Klawf can't
remain in this position for long
because its blood rushes to its head.
translation: 生活在陡峭的悬崖上。\n会通过侧步来闪避攻击，\n然后用钳子瞄准对手的要害。

label: SPECIES_CAPSAKID.speciesName
source: CAPSAKID
translation: 热辣娃

label: SPECIES_CAPSAKID.categoryName
source: Spicy Pepper
translation: 热辣

label: SPECIES_CAPSAKID.description
source:
The more sunlight this Pokémon
bathes in, the more spicy chemicals are
produced by its body, and thus the
spicier its moves become.
translation: 帕底亚的当地特色菜会用\n热辣娃掉落的门牙来做料理，\n因此味道极其辛辣。

label: SPECIES_SCOVILLAIN.speciesName
source: SCOVILLAIN
translation: 狠辣椒

label: SPECIES_SCOVILLAIN.categoryName
source: Spicy Pepper
translation: 热辣

label: SPECIES_SCOVILLAIN.description
source:
The green head has turned vicious
due to the spicy chemicals
stimulating its brain. Once it goes on a
rampage, there is no stopping it.
translation: 绿色的头会变得凶暴，\n是因为脑部受到了辣味成分的刺激。\n一旦暴怒起来就会一发不可收拾。

label: SPECIES_SCOVILLAIN_MEGA.categoryName
source: Spicy Pepper
translation: 热辣

label: SPECIES_SCOVILLAIN_MEGA.description
source: Mega Evolution has dialed up this\nPokémon's spiciness. It swings its\n“necktie” around to wallop its foes.
translation: 超级进化后辣味更强了。\n会挥舞变得像领带的部分\n狠狠地殴打对手。

label: SPECIES_RELLOR.speciesName
source: RELLOR
translation: 虫滚泥

label: SPECIES_RELLOR.categoryName
source: Rolling
translation: 滚动

label: SPECIES_RELLOR.description
source:
This Pokémon creates a mud ball by
mixing sand and dirt with psychic
energy. It treasures its mud ball more
than its own life.
translation: 会一边滚着泥巴球，\n一边让进化所需的能量成熟。\n最终迎接进化的时刻。

label: SPECIES_RABSCA.speciesName
source: RABSCA
translation: 虫甲圣

label: SPECIES_RABSCA.categoryName
source: Rolling
translation: 滚动

label: SPECIES_RABSCA.description
source:
The body that supports the ball
barely moves. Therefore, it is thought
that the true body of this Pokémon
is actually inside the ball.
translation: 为了能让睡在球里面的\n宝宝睡得更香甜，\n会用脚转动球，让宝宝感到安心。

label: SPECIES_FLITTLE.speciesName
source: FLITTLE
translation: 飘飘雏

label: SPECIES_FLITTLE.categoryName
source: Frill
translation: 褶边

label: SPECIES_FLITTLE.description
source:
Flittle's toes levitate about half
an inch above the ground because of
the psychic power emitted from the
frills on the Pokémon's belly.
translation: 会在荒地跑来跑去来度过时间。\n如果最喜欢的树果被拿走，\n就会穷追不舍地展开报复。

label: SPECIES_ESPATHRA.speciesName
source: ESPATHRA
translation: 超能艳鸵

label: SPECIES_ESPATHRA.categoryName
source: Ostrich
translation: 鸵鸟

label: SPECIES_ESPATHRA.description
source:
It immobilizes opponents by
bathing them in psychic power from its
large eyes. Despite its appearance, it
has a vicious temperament.
translation: 会从彩色的褶边的缝隙间\n释放出精神力量，\n借此以时速200公里的速度狂奔。

label: SPECIES_TINKATINK.speciesName
source: TINKATINK
translation: 小锻匠

label: SPECIES_TINKATINK.categoryName
source: Metalsmith
translation: 锤炼

label: SPECIES_TINKATINK.description
source:
This Pokémon pounds iron scraps
together to make a hammer. It will
remake the hammer again and again until
it's satisfied with the result.
translation: 敲打铁屑来制作锤子。\n直到做出满意的作品前，\n会一遍又一遍地重做。

label: SPECIES_TINKATUFF.speciesName
source: TINKATUFF
translation: 巧锻匠

label: SPECIES_TINKATUFF.categoryName
source: Hammer
translation: 锤子

label: SPECIES_TINKATUFF.description
source:
These Pokémon make their homes in
piles of scrap metal. They test the
strength of each other's hammers by
smashing them together.
translation: 栖息在堆满破铜烂铁的地方。\n为了测试锤子的强度，\n会和伙伴们激烈地敲打彼此。

label: SPECIES_TINKATON.speciesName
source: TINKATON
translation: 巨锻匠

label: SPECIES_TINKATON.categoryName
source: Hammer
translation: 锤子

label: SPECIES_TINKATON.description
source:
The hammer tops 220 pounds, yet it
gets swung around easily by
Tinkaton as it steals whatever it pleases
and carries its plunder back home.
translation: 会轻松地挥舞超过100公斤的\n锤子来夺取想要的东西，\n然后带回自己的住处。

label: SPECIES_WIGLETT.speciesName
source: WIGLETT
translation: 海地鼠

label: SPECIES_WIGLETT.categoryName
source: Garden Eel
translation: 糯鳗

label: SPECIES_WIGLETT.description
source: This Pokémon can pick up the scent\nof a Veluza just over 65 feet away\nand will hide itself in the sand.
translation: 虽与地鼠相似，却是完全不同的种类。\n据说是为了适应生活环境，\n才偶然变得相似。

label: SPECIES_WUGTRIO.speciesName
source: WUGTRIO
translation: 三海地鼠

label: SPECIES_WUGTRIO.categoryName
source: Garden Eel
translation: 糯鳗

label: SPECIES_WUGTRIO.description
source: A variety of fish Pokémon, Wugtrio\nwas once considered to be a\nregional form of Dugtrio.
translation: 鱼宝可梦的一种。\n曾经也有人认为它是\n三地鼠的地区形态。

label: SPECIES_BOMBIRDIER.speciesName
source: BOMBIRDIER
translation: 下石鸟

label: SPECIES_BOMBIRDIER.categoryName
source: Item Drop
translation: 掉东西

label: SPECIES_BOMBIRDIER.description
source:
Bombirdier uses the apron on its
chest to bundle up food, which it
carries back to its nest. It enjoys
dropping things that make loud noises.
translation: 会用胸口的袋子包住食物，\n然后带回巢里。\n以弄掉会发出响亮声音的东西为乐。

label: SPECIES_FINIZEN.speciesName
source: FINIZEN
translation: 波普海豚

label: SPECIES_FINIZEN.categoryName
source: Dolphin
translation: 海豚

label: SPECIES_FINIZEN.description
source: Its water ring is made from\nseawater mixed with a sticky fluid that\nFinizen secretes from its blowhole.
translation: 水环是由从头部的洞冒出的黏胶\n与海水混合之后制作而成的。

label: SPECIES_PALAFIN_ZERO.speciesName
source: PALAFIN
translation: 海豚侠

label: SPECIES_PALAFIN_ZERO.categoryName
source: Dolphin
translation: 海豚

label: SPECIES_PALAFIN_ZERO.description
source:
This Pokémon changes its appearance
if it hears its allies calling for
help. Palafin will never show
anybody its moment of transformation.
translation: 体能与波普海豚差不多，\n可一旦伙伴陷入了危机，\n就会变身来提高自己的力量。

label: SPECIES_PALAFIN_HERO.speciesName
source: PALAFIN
translation: 海豚侠

label: SPECIES_PALAFIN_HERO.categoryName
source: Hero
translation: 英雄

label: SPECIES_PALAFIN_HERO.description
source:
This Pokémon's ancient genes have
awakened. It is now so extraordinarily
strong that it can easily lift a
cruise ship with one fin.
translation: 会以50节的游泳速度\n去救助溺水的人类和宝可梦。\n是大海的英雄。

label: SPECIES_VAROOM.speciesName
source: VAROOM
translation: 噗隆隆

label: SPECIES_VAROOM.categoryName
source: Single-Cyl
translation: 单汽缸

label: SPECIES_VAROOM.description
source:
The steel section is Varoom's
actual body. This Pokémon clings to
rocks and converts the minerals within
into energy to fuel its activities.
translation: 钢铁的身躯才是本体。\n会贴在岩石上将其成分\n转换为活动所需的能量。

label: SPECIES_REVAVROOM.speciesName
source: REVAVROOM
translation: 普隆隆姆

label: SPECIES_REVAVROOM.categoryName
source: Multi-Cyl
translation: 多汽缸

label: SPECIES_REVAVROOM.description
source:
It creates a gas out of poison and
minerals from rocks. It then
detonates the gas in its cylinders- now
numbering eight-to generate energy.
translation: 用排气的声音猛烈地威吓对手。\n会从圆筒形的嘴巴吐出\n舌头并喷洒毒液。

label: SPECIES_CYCLIZAR.speciesName
source: CYCLIZAR
translation: 摩托蜥

label: SPECIES_CYCLIZAR.categoryName
source: Mount
translation: 坐骑

label: SPECIES_CYCLIZAR.description
source:
It can sprint at over 70 mph while
carrying a human. The rider's body
heat warms Cyclizar's back and lifts
the Pokémon's spirit.
translation: 以时速120公里载着人飞驰。\n它可以借由人类的体温来温暖背部，\n恢复活力。

label: SPECIES_ORTHWORM.speciesName
source: ORTHWORM
translation: 拖拖蚓

label: SPECIES_ORTHWORM.categoryName
source: Earthworm
translation: 蚯蚓

label: SPECIES_ORTHWORM.description
source:
When attacked, this Pokémon will
wield the tendrils on its body like
fists and pelt the opponent with a
storm of punches.
translation: 栖息在干燥的沙地上。\n会以土中铁质为食，\n来维持由金属构成的身体。

label: SPECIES_GLIMMET.speciesName
source: GLIMMET
translation: 晶光芽

label: SPECIES_GLIMMET.categoryName
source: Ore
translation: 矿石

label: SPECIES_GLIMMET.description
source:
Glimmet's toxic mineral crystals
look just like flower petals. This
Pokémon scatters poisonous powder like
pollen to protect itself.
translation: 成分为毒的结晶看起来就像是花瓣。\n会像撒花粉一样撒出毒粉\n来保护自身安全。

label: SPECIES_GLIMMORA.speciesName
source: GLIMMORA
translation: 晶光花

label: SPECIES_GLIMMORA.categoryName
source: Ore
translation: 矿石

label: SPECIES_GLIMMORA.description
source:
Glimmora's petals are made of
crystallized poison energy. It has
recently become evident that these
petals resemble Tera Jewels.
translation: 最近发现它的毒之能量结晶化\n之后所形成的花瓣与太晶的宝石类似。

label: SPECIES_GLIMMORA_MEGA.categoryName
source: Ore
translation: 矿石

label: SPECIES_GLIMMORA_MEGA.description
source:
Glimmora's petals-now larger and
separated from its main body-rotate
around it to provide defense while
cattering poisonous fragments.
translation: 花瓣变大并分离开来。\n会一边保护本体并旋转，\n一边播撒有毒的碎片。

label: SPECIES_GREAVARD.speciesName
source: GREAVARD
translation: 墓仔狗

label: SPECIES_GREAVARD.categoryName
source: Ghost Dog
translation: 鬼犬

label: SPECIES_GREAVARD.description
source:
This friendly Pokémon doesn't like
being alone. Pay it even the
slightest bit of attention, and it will
follow you forever.
translation: 爱亲近人，害怕寂寞。\n即使只和它玩了一小会儿，\n它也会一直跟在身后。

label: SPECIES_HOUNDSTONE.speciesName
source: HOUNDSTONE
translation: 墓扬犬

label: SPECIES_HOUNDSTONE.categoryName
source: Ghost Dog
translation: 鬼犬

label: SPECIES_HOUNDSTONE.description
source:
Houndstone spends most of its
time sleeping in graveyards. Among all
the dog Pokémon, this one is most
loyal to its master.
translation: 被深深悼念的宝可梦转生而成的样子。\n不喜欢被摸到头上的突起物。

label: SPECIES_FLAMIGO.speciesName
source: FLAMIGO
translation: 缠红鹤

label: SPECIES_FLAMIGO.categoryName
source: Synchronize
translation: 同步

label: SPECIES_FLAMIGO.description
source:
Thanks to a behavior of theirs
known as “synchronizing,” an entire
flock of these Pokémon can attack
simultaneously in perfect harmony.
translation: 拥有被称为同步的习性，\n因此会整个群体一起\n有条不紊地发动攻击。

label: SPECIES_CETODDLE.speciesName
source: CETODDLE
translation: 走鲸

label: SPECIES_CETODDLE.categoryName
source: Terra Whale
translation: 陆鲸

label: SPECIES_CETODDLE.description
source:
This species left the ocean and
began living on land a very long time
ago. It seems to be closely related
to Wailmer.
translation: 在寒冷地带会组成\n约5只的群体来生活。\n喜欢雪或冰所包含的矿物质。

label: SPECIES_CETITAN.speciesName
source: CETITAN
translation: 浩大鲸

label: SPECIES_CETITAN.categoryName
source: Terra Whale
translation: 陆鲸

label: SPECIES_CETITAN.description
source:
Ice energy builds up in the horn on
its upper jaw, causing the horn to
reach cryogenic temperatures that
freeze its surroundings.
translation: 上颚的角集中了冰之能量，\n会使其变得超低温，\n以此来将自己的周围冻结。

label: SPECIES_VELUZA.speciesName
source: VELUZA
translation: 轻身鳕

label: SPECIES_VELUZA.categoryName
source: Jettison
translation: 卸除

label: SPECIES_VELUZA.description
source:
Veluza has excellent regenerative
capabilities. It sheds spare flesh
from its body to boost its agility,
then charges at its prey.
translation: 拥有强大的再生能力。\n会丢弃身上的赘肉来让自己\n变得轻盈后再去突击猎物。

label: SPECIES_DONDOZO.speciesName
source: DONDOZO
translation: 吃吼霸

label: SPECIES_DONDOZO.categoryName
source: Big Catfish
translation: 大鲶

label: SPECIES_DONDOZO.description
source:
It treats Tatsugiri like its boss
and follows it loyally. Though
powerful, Dondozo is apparently not very
smart.
translation: 把米立龙当作头领般敬重。\n虽然是个大力士，\n但头脑似乎不是很聪明。

label: SPECIES_TATSUGIRI_CURLY.speciesName
source: TATSUGIRI
translation: 米立龙

label: SPECIES_TATSUGIRI_CURLY.categoryName
source: Mimicry
translation: 拟态

label: SPECIES_TATSUGIRI_CURLY.description
source:
This is a small dragon Pokémon. It
lives inside the mouth of Dondozo to
protect itself from enemies on the
outside.
translation: 非常狡猾奸诈的宝可梦。\n会假装虚弱来吸引猎物接近，\n接着让自己同伙的宝可梦发动攻击。

label: SPECIES_TATSUGIRI_DROOPY.speciesName
source: TATSUGIRI
translation: 米立龙

label: SPECIES_TATSUGIRI_DROOPY.categoryName
source: Mimicry
translation: 拟态

label: SPECIES_TATSUGIRI_DROOPY.description
source: This Pokémon tricks its opponents\nby playing dead. It is small and\nweak, but it uses its smarts to survive.
translation: 会装死来欺骗对手。\n虽然体型小又没力气，\n却懂得运用智慧来求生。

label: SPECIES_TATSUGIRI_STRETCHY.speciesName
source: TATSUGIRI
translation: 米立龙

label: SPECIES_TATSUGIRI_STRETCHY.categoryName
source: Mimicry
translation: 拟态

label: SPECIES_TATSUGIRI_STRETCHY.description
source: It's one of the most intelligent\ndragon Pokémon. It camouflages itself\nby inflating its throat sac.
translation: 即使在龙宝可梦当中，\n它的智商也是名列前茅。\n会膨胀喉囊来拟态。

label: SPECIES_TATSUGIRI_CURLY_MEGA.categoryName
source: Mimicry
translation: 拟态

label: SPECIES_TATSUGIRI_CURLY_MEGA.description
source:
Tatsugiri's brain has been invigorated
by Mega Evolution, making it even
wilier. It can create and command
copies of itself.
translation: 超级进化使大脑活性化，\n让它变得更加精明狡猾。\n会制造并熟练使用分身。

label: SPECIES_TATSUGIRI_DROOPY_MEGA.categoryName
source: Mimicry
translation: 拟态

label: SPECIES_TATSUGIRI_DROOPY_MEGA.description
source:
It solidifies the energy of Mega Evolution,
building up an overflowing pile to launch
as projectiles. These projectiles explode
on contact.
translation: 会凝聚超级进化的能量\n作为溢出的能量射出，\n一碰到东西就会发生大爆炸。

label: SPECIES_TATSUGIRI_STRETCHY_MEGA.categoryName
source: Mimicry
translation: 拟态

label: SPECIES_TATSUGIRI_STRETCHY_MEGA.description
source:
Using the energy of Mega Evolution, it
creates a dish to ride upon, allowing it
to move with total freedom-even through
the air.
translation: 会用超级进化的能量制成像盘子\n一样的东西，乘上去后在空中\n也能自由自在地移动。

label: SPECIES_GREAT_TUSK.speciesName
source: GREAT TUSK
translation: 雄伟牙

label: SPECIES_GREAT_TUSK.categoryName
source: Paradox
translation: 悖谬

label: SPECIES_GREAT_TUSK.description
source:
Sightings of this Pokémon have
occurred in recent years. The name
Great Tusk was taken from a creature
listed in a certain book.
translation: 长得就像是超自然杂志曾介绍的\n自太古以来就存活至今的神秘宝可梦。

label: SPECIES_SCREAM_TAIL.speciesName
source: SCREAM TAIL
translation: 吼叫尾

label: SPECIES_SCREAM_TAIL.categoryName
source: Paradox
translation: 悖谬

label: SPECIES_SCREAM_TAIL.description
source:
There has been only one reported
sighting of this Pokémon. It
resembles a mysterious creature depicted
in an old expedition journal.
translation: 超自然杂志曾将某只神秘的\n宝可梦介绍为10亿年前的胖丁，\n该宝可梦与它长得很相似。

label: SPECIES_BRUTE_BONNET.speciesName
source: BRUTE BONNET
translation: 猛恶菇

label: SPECIES_BRUTE_BONNET.categoryName
source: Paradox
translation: 悖谬

label: SPECIES_BRUTE_BONNET.description
source:
It bears a slight resemblance to a
Pokémon described in a dubious
magazine as a cross between a dinosaur
and a mushroom.
translation: 可疑的杂志曾介绍过\n某种恐龙与蘑菇合成的宝可梦，\n该宝可梦与它有些相似。

label: SPECIES_FLUTTER_MANE.speciesName
source: FLUTTER MANE
translation: 振翼发

label: SPECIES_FLUTTER_MANE.categoryName
source: Paradox
translation: 悖谬

label: SPECIES_FLUTTER_MANE.description
source:
It has similar features to a
ghostly pterosaur that was covered in a
paranormal magazine, but the two
have little else in common.
translation: 它只有特征的部分与超自然杂志\n曾报道的翼龙的幽灵相似。

label: SPECIES_SLITHER_WING.speciesName
source: SLITHER WING
translation: 爬地翅

label: SPECIES_SLITHER_WING.categoryName
source: Paradox
translation: 悖谬

label: SPECIES_SLITHER_WING.description
source: This mysterious Pokémon has some\nsimilarities to a creature that an\nold book introduced as Slither Wing.
translation: 这只宝可梦与可疑的杂志曾介绍的\n火神蛾太古时代的样子长得有点像。

label: SPECIES_SANDY_SHOCKS.speciesName
source: SANDY SHOCKS
translation: 沙铁皮

label: SPECIES_SANDY_SHOCKS.categoryName
source: Paradox
translation: 悖谬

label: SPECIES_SANDY_SHOCKS.description
source:
It slightly resembles a Magneton
that lived for 10,000 years and was
featured in an article in a
paranormal magazine.
translation: 它与超自然杂志曾报道的活了1万年的\n三合一磁怪长得稍微有些相似。

label: SPECIES_IRON_TREADS.speciesName
source: IRON TREADS
translation: 铁辙迹

label: SPECIES_IRON_TREADS.categoryName
source: Paradox
translation: 悖谬

label: SPECIES_IRON_TREADS.description
source:
Sightings of this Pokémon have
occurred in recent years. It resembles
a mysterious object described in an
old expedition journal.
translation: 近年有人目击到它。\n是与古老的探险记中记载的\n不明物体长得很像的宝可梦。

label: SPECIES_IRON_BUNDLE.speciesName
source: IRON BUNDLE
translation: 铁包袱

label: SPECIES_IRON_BUNDLE.categoryName
source: Paradox
translation: 悖谬

label: SPECIES_IRON_BUNDLE.description
source:
Its shape is similar to a robot
featured in a paranormal magazine
article. The robot was said to have been
created by an ancient civilization.
translation: 与古老的书籍中记载的\n神秘物体相似的宝可梦。\n过去只被目击过2次。

label: SPECIES_IRON_HANDS.speciesName
source: IRON HANDS
translation: 铁臂膀

label: SPECIES_IRON_HANDS.categoryName
source: Paradox
translation: 悖谬

label: SPECIES_IRON_HANDS.description
source:
It is very similar to a cyborg
covered exclusively by a paranormal
magazine. The cyborg was said to be the
modified form of a certain athlete.
translation: 这种宝可梦与某本探险记中记载的\n一种叫做铁臂膀的物体\n有许多相似之处。

label: SPECIES_IRON_JUGULIS.speciesName
source: IRON JUGULIS
translation: 铁脖颈

label: SPECIES_IRON_JUGULIS.categoryName
source: Paradox
translation: 悖谬

label: SPECIES_IRON_JUGULIS.description
source:
It resembles a certain Pokémon
introduced in a paranormal magazine,
described as the offspring of a
Hydreigon that fell in love with a robot.
translation: 古老的书籍中所记载的\n叫做铁脖颈的物体说不定\n就是这只宝可梦。

label: SPECIES_IRON_MOTH.speciesName
source: IRON MOTH
translation: 铁毒蛾

label: SPECIES_IRON_MOTH.categoryName
source: Paradox
translation: 悖谬

label: SPECIES_IRON_MOTH.description
source:
No records exist of this species
being caught. Data is lacking, but
the Pokémon's traits match up with an
object described in an old book.
translation: 与超自然杂志中所介绍的监视人类的\nUFO这种未知物体很相似。

label: SPECIES_IRON_THORNS.speciesName
source: IRON THORNS
translation: 铁荆棘

label: SPECIES_IRON_THORNS.categoryName
source: Paradox
translation: 悖谬

label: SPECIES_IRON_THORNS.description
source:
It has some similarities to a
Pokémon introduced in a dubious magazine
as a Tyranitar from one billion
years into the future.
translation: 它有一部分特征与某本探险记中\n介绍的名为铁荆棘的物体一致。

label: SPECIES_FRIGIBAX.speciesName
source: FRIGIBAX
translation: 凉脊龙

label: SPECIES_FRIGIBAX.categoryName
source: Ice Fin
translation: 冰鳍

label: SPECIES_FRIGIBAX.description
source:
This Pokémon lives in forests and
craggy areas. Using the power of its
dorsal fin, it cools the inside of its
nest like a refrigerator.
translation: 栖息在岩石地带或森林里。\n会用背鳍的力量将巢穴里的\n温度降到如冷冻库般寒冷。

label: SPECIES_ARCTIBAX.speciesName
source: ARCTIBAX
translation: 冻脊龙

label: SPECIES_ARCTIBAX.categoryName
source: Ice Fin
translation: 冰鳍

label: SPECIES_ARCTIBAX.description
source:
Arctibax freezes the air around it,
protecting its face with an ice
mask and turning its dorsal fin into a
blade of ice.
translation: 冻住背鳍，并使其形成剑，\n再使出前空翻来攻击对手。\n完成此举需要强健的腰腿。

label: SPECIES_BAXCALIBUR.speciesName
source: BAXCALIBUR
translation: 戟脊龙

label: SPECIES_BAXCALIBUR.categoryName
source: Ice Dragon
translation: 冰龙

label: SPECIES_BAXCALIBUR.description
source:
It launches itself into battle by
flipping upside down and spewing
frigid air from its mouth. It finishes
opponents off with its dorsal blade.
translation: 会倒转身体并从口中吐出冷气，\n然后靠吐气的作用力猛冲，\n用背鳍的剑给予敌人致命一击。

label: SPECIES_BAXCALIBUR_MEGA.categoryName
source: Ice Dragon
translation: 冰龙

label: SPECIES_BAXCALIBUR_MEGA.description
source:
Baxcalibur's dorsal blade has grown even
more massive thanks to Mega Evolution.
This Pokémon fires beams from the hilt
at its solar plexus.
translation: 背鳍的剑因超级进化而变得更加\n巨大。它会从上腹部的剑柄发射\n光束招式进行攻击。

label: SPECIES_GIMMIGHOUL_CHEST.speciesName
source: GIMMIGHOUL
translation: 索财灵

label: SPECIES_GIMMIGHOUL_CHEST.categoryName
source: Coin Chest
translation: 宝箱

label: SPECIES_GIMMIGHOUL_CHEST.description
source:
It lives inside an old treasure
chest. Sometimes it gets left in shop
corners since no one realizes it's
actually a Pokémon.
translation: 栖息在老旧的宝箱中。\n有时会因没人注意到自己是宝可梦，\n而被搁置在道具店的角落。

label: SPECIES_GIMMIGHOUL_ROAMING.speciesName
source: GIMMIGHOUL
translation: 索财灵

label: SPECIES_GIMMIGHOUL_ROAMING.categoryName
source: Coin Hunter
translation: 寻宝

label: SPECIES_GIMMIGHOUL_ROAMING.description
source:
It wanders around, carrying an old
coin on its back. It survives by
draining the life-force from humans who
try to pick up its coin.
translation: 背着古老的硬币四处徘徊。\n会吸取试图捡起硬币的\n人的生命力来维生。

label: SPECIES_GHOLDENGO.speciesName
source: GHOLDENGO
translation: 赛富豪

label: SPECIES_GHOLDENGO.categoryName
source: Coin Entity
translation: 宝者

label: SPECIES_GHOLDENGO.description
source:
It has a sturdy body made up of
stacked coins. Gholdengo overwhelms
its enemies by firing coin after coin
at them in quick succession.
translation: 硬币堆叠起来而形成的身体非常结实。\n会连续发射硬币来压制敌人。

label: SPECIES_WO_CHIEN.speciesName
source: WO-CHIEN
translation: 古简蜗

label: SPECIES_WO_CHIEN.categoryName
source: Ruinous
translation: 灾厄

label: SPECIES_WO_CHIEN.description
source:
The grudge of a person punished
for writing the king's evil deeds upon
wooden tablets has clad itself in
dead leaves to become a Pokémon.
translation: 吸取草木的能量，\n使周围的森林瞬间干枯，\n田地的农作物歉收。

label: SPECIES_CHIEN_PAO.speciesName
source: CHIEN-PAO
translation: 古剑豹

label: SPECIES_CHIEN_PAO.categoryName
source: Ruinous
translation: 灾厄

label: SPECIES_CHIEN_PAO.description
source:
This Pokémon can control 100 tons
of fallen snow. It plays around
innocently by leaping in and out of
avalanches it has caused.
translation: 很久以前，\n丧命于剑下者的憎恨之情缠绕在雪上，\n变成了宝可梦。

label: SPECIES_TING_LU.speciesName
source: TING-LU
translation: 古鼎鹿

label: SPECIES_TING_LU.categoryName
source: Ruinous
translation: 灾厄

label: SPECIES_TING_LU.description
source:
It slowly brings its exceedingly
heavy head down upon the ground,
splitting the earth open with huge
fissures that run over 160 feet deep.
translation: 当它缓缓挥下自己笨重的头部时，\n会让地面出现深度达\n50米的巨大裂缝。

label: SPECIES_CHI_YU.speciesName
source: CHI-YU
translation: 古玉鱼

label: SPECIES_CHI_YU.categoryName
source: Ruinous
translation: 灾厄

label: SPECIES_CHI_YU.description
source:
It controls flames burning at over
5,400 degrees Fahrenheit. It
casually swims through the sea of lava it
creates by melting rock and sand.
translation: 曾引起无数斗争的勾玉\n聚集了嫉妒之情。这些嫉妒\n缠绕了火焰，变成了宝可梦。

label: SPECIES_ROARING_MOON.speciesName
source: ROARING MOON
translation: 轰鸣月

label: SPECIES_ROARING_MOON.categoryName
source: Paradox
translation: 悖谬

label: SPECIES_ROARING_MOON.description
source:
According to an article in a
dubious magazine, this Pokémon has some
connection to Mega Evolution that
occurs in Hoenn.
translation: 根据可疑杂志的报道所说，\n这种宝可梦好像跟某个地区\n会发生的现象有关联。

label: SPECIES_IRON_VALIANT.speciesName
source: IRON VALIANT
translation: 铁武者

label: SPECIES_IRON_VALIANT.categoryName
source: Paradox
translation: 悖谬

label: SPECIES_IRON_VALIANT.description
source: It has some similarities to a mad\nscientist's invention covered in a\nparanormal magazine.
translation: 它有可能就是某本探险记中\n记载的名为铁武者的物体。

label: SPECIES_KORAIDON.speciesName
source: KORAIDON
translation: 故勒顿

label: SPECIES_KORAIDON.categoryName
source: Paradox
translation: 悖谬

label: SPECIES_KORAIDON.description
source:
This Pokémon resembles Cyclizar,
but it is far burlier and more
ferocious. Nothing is known about its
ecology or other features.
translation: 虽然外观与摩托蜥相似，\n但却远比后者更为顽强凶暴。\n有关它的生态等信息一切未明。

label: SPECIES_MIRAIDON.speciesName
source: MIRAIDON
translation: 密勒顿

label: SPECIES_MIRAIDON.categoryName
source: Paradox
translation: 悖谬

label: SPECIES_MIRAIDON.description
source:
This seems to be the Iron Serpent
mentioned in an Violet Book. The
Iron Serpent is said to have turned the
land to ash with its lightning.
translation: 它似乎就是古老的书籍中\n提及的铁大蛇。\n传说它曾用雷电将大地变为灰烬。

label: SPECIES_WALKING_WAKE.speciesName
source: WALKING WAKE
translation: 波荡水

label: SPECIES_WALKING_WAKE.categoryName
source: Paradox
translation: 悖谬

label: SPECIES_WALKING_WAKE.description
source: This ferocious creature is shrouded in\nmystery. It's named after an aquatic\nmonster mentioned in an old journal.
translation: 样子与超自然杂志所刊登的\n插图中的超古代水君很相似。

label: SPECIES_IRON_LEAVES.speciesName
source: IRON LEAVES
translation: 铁斑叶

label: SPECIES_IRON_LEAVES.categoryName
source: Paradox
translation: 悖谬

label: SPECIES_IRON_LEAVES.description
source: According to the few eyewitness accounts\nthat exist, it used its shining blades\nto julienne large trees and boulders.
translation: 根据极少的目击报告，\n它用散发着光辉的剑\n将大树和大石头切成了丝。

label: SPECIES_POLTCHAGEIST_COUNTERFEIT.speciesName
source: POLTCHAGEIST
translation: 斯魔茶

label: SPECIES_POLTCHAGEIST_COUNTERFEIT.categoryName
source: Matcha
translation: 抹茶

label: SPECIES_POLTCHAGEIST_COUNTERFEIT.description
source:
Supposedly, the regrets of a tea
ceremony master who died before
perfecting his craft lingered in some
matcha and became a Pokémon.
translation: 看似是来悲茶的地区形态，\n但最近被发现其实两者之间毫无关系。

label: SPECIES_POLTCHAGEIST_ARTISAN.speciesName
source: POLTCHAGEIST
translation: 斯魔茶

label: SPECIES_POLTCHAGEIST_ARTISAN.categoryName
source: Matcha
translation: 抹茶

label: SPECIES_POLTCHAGEIST_ARTISAN.description
source:
It has taken up residence in a very
expensive tea caddy. It takes an
expert to distinguish the expensive
tea caddies from the cheap ones.
translation: 住在昂贵茶罐中的样子。\n虽然与便宜货不同，\n但外行人分辨不出来。

label: SPECIES_SINISTCHA_UNREMARKABLE.speciesName
source: SINISTCHA
translation: 来悲粗茶

label: SPECIES_SINISTCHA_UNREMARKABLE.categoryName
source: Matcha
translation: 抹茶

label: SPECIES_SINISTCHA_UNREMARKABLE.description
source:
It pretends to be tea, trying to fool
people into drinking it so it can
drain their life-force. Its ruse is
generally unsuccessful.
translation: 喜欢待在民宅的地板下\n和架子深处等阴凉的地方。\n日落后会四处徘徊寻找猎物。

label: SPECIES_SINISTCHA_MASTERPIECE.speciesName
source: SINISTCHA
translation: 来悲粗茶

label: SPECIES_SINISTCHA_MASTERPIECE.categoryName
source: Matcha
translation: 抹茶

label: SPECIES_SINISTCHA_MASTERPIECE.description
source:
The more stirring it does with the
tea whisk on its head, the more
energy it builds up. It does this to
prepare for battle.
translation: 会住到由著名烧制技艺大师\n所制作的精美茶碗中。\n是让爱好者痴迷不已的宝可梦。

label: SPECIES_OKIDOGI.speciesName
source: OKIDOGI
translation: 够赞狗

label: SPECIES_OKIDOGI.categoryName
source: Retainer
translation: 随从

label: SPECIES_OKIDOGI.description
source:
After all its muscles were stimulated
by the toxic chain around its neck,
Okidogi transformed and gained
a powerful physique.
translation: 很容易失去冷静的粗暴家伙。\n会甩动脖子上的锁链击碎一切。

label: SPECIES_MUNKIDORI.speciesName
source: MUNKIDORI
translation: 愿增猿

label: SPECIES_MUNKIDORI.categoryName
source: Retainer
translation: 随从

label: SPECIES_MUNKIDORI.description
source:
The chain is made from toxins that
enhance capabilities. It stimulated
Munkidori's brain and caused the
Pokémon's psychic powers to bloom.
translation: 会从安全的地方释放出\n能引起强烈头晕的念力，\n将敌人玩弄于股掌之间。

label: SPECIES_FEZANDIPITI.speciesName
source: FEZANDIPITI
translation: 吉雉鸡

label: SPECIES_FEZANDIPITI.categoryName
source: Retainer
translation: 随从

label: SPECIES_FEZANDIPITI.description
source:
Fezandipiti owes its beautiful looks and
lovely voice to the toxic stimulants
emanating from the chain wrapped around
its body.
translation: 扇动艳丽的翅膀抛撒\n费洛蒙让人和宝可梦为其神魂颠倒。

label: gSpeciesInfoGen9.speciesName
source: OGERPON
translation: 厄诡椪

label: gSpeciesInfoGen9.categoryName
source: Mask
translation: 面具

label: SPECIES_GOUGING_FIRE.speciesName
source: GOUGING FIRE
translation: 破空焰

label: SPECIES_GOUGING_FIRE.categoryName
source: Paradox
translation: 悖谬

label: SPECIES_GOUGING_FIRE.description
source:
There are scant few reports of
this creature being sighted.
One short video shows it rampaging,
and spouting pillars of flame.
translation: 与超自然杂志所刊登的\n可疑的宝可梦很相似。\n该杂志声称那是从化石中复原的炎帝。

label: SPECIES_RAGING_BOLT.speciesName
source: RAGING BOLT
translation: 猛雷鼓

label: SPECIES_RAGING_BOLT.categoryName
source: Paradox
translation: 悖谬

label: SPECIES_RAGING_BOLT.description
source:
It bears resemblance to a Pokémon
that became a hot topic for a short
while after a paranomal magazine
touted it as Raikou's ancestor.
translation: 与超自然杂志报道的曾短暂\n引起一阵话题的雷公的祖先长得很像。

label: SPECIES_IRON_BOULDER.speciesName
source: IRON BOULDER
translation: 铁磐岩

label: SPECIES_IRON_BOULDER.categoryName
source: Paradox
translation: 悖谬

label: SPECIES_IRON_BOULDER.description
source: It was named after a mysterious\nobject recorded in an old book.\nIts body seems to be metallic.
translation: 身体似乎是金属质地。\n名字来自古书中所记载的神秘物体。

label: SPECIES_IRON_CROWN.speciesName
source: IRON CROWN
translation: 铁头壳

label: SPECIES_IRON_CROWN.categoryName
source: Paradox
translation: 悖谬

label: SPECIES_IRON_CROWN.description
source:
It resembles a mysterious object
introduced in a paranormal magazine
as a cutting-edge weapon
shaped like Cobalion.
translation: 据说它曾经射出发光的\n刀刃砍断了周围的一切，\n但无其他信息，身份不明。

label: SPECIES_TERAPAGOS_NORMAL.speciesName
source: TERAPAGOS
translation: 太乐巴戈斯

label: SPECIES_TERAPAGOS_NORMAL.categoryName
source: Tera
translation: 太晶

label: SPECIES_TERAPAGOS_NORMAL.description
source:
Terapagos protects itself using its
power to transform energy into hard
crystals. This Pokémon is the source
of the Terastal phenomenon.
translation: 人们以前一直认为它们\n曾生活在古代帕底亚，\n但因地壳变动影响而灭绝。

label: SPECIES_TERAPAGOS_TERASTAL.speciesName
source: TERAPAGOS
translation: 太乐巴戈斯

label: SPECIES_TERAPAGOS_TERASTAL.categoryName
source: Tera
translation: 太晶

label: SPECIES_TERAPAGOS_TERASTAL.description
source:
The shell is made of crystallized
Terastal energy. When struck by a move,
this shell absorbs the move's energy
and transfers it to Terapagos.
translation: 若太晶的甲壳受到对手招式的攻击，\n就会将其能量吸收，\n供自己使用。

label: SPECIES_TERAPAGOS_STELLAR.speciesName
source: TERAPAGOS
translation: 太乐巴戈斯

label: SPECIES_TERAPAGOS_STELLAR.categoryName
source: Tera
translation: 太晶

label: SPECIES_TERAPAGOS_STELLAR.description
source:
An old expedition journal describes the
sight of this Pokémon buried in the,
depths of the earth as resembling a
planet floating in space.
translation: 跟据古老的探险记记载，\n它被掩埋在地底的样子\n就像浮在宇宙的星星一样。

label: SPECIES_PECHARUNT.speciesName
source: PECHARUNT
translation: 桃歹郎

label: SPECIES_PECHARUNT.categoryName
source: Subjugation
translation: 支配

label: SPECIES_PECHARUNT.description
source:
It feeds others toxic mochi that
draw out desires and capabilities.
Those who eat the mochi fall under
Pecharunt's control, chained to its will.
translation: 桃形的壳是剧毒的储存库。\n会制作毒粘糕来款待人和宝可梦。

label: gFallbackPokedexText
source:
This is a newly discovered Pokémon.
It is currently under investigation.
No detailed information is available
at this time.
translation: 这是一只新型宝可梦，\n目前它仍然被调查中。\n暂时还无法提供详细的资料。

label: gRaticateAlolaPokedexText
source:
It forms a group of Rattata, which it 
assumes command of. Each group
has its own territory, and disputes
over food happen often.
translation: 让自己手下的小拉达们收集食物，\n却只挑里面营养丰富\n并且美味的东西来吃。

label: gPichuPokedexText
source:
It is still inept at retaining electricity.
When it is startled, it discharges power
accidentally. It gets better at holding
power as it grows older.
translation: 不擅长存储电力。\n只要受到什么惊吓，\n就会立马放电。

label: gPikachuPokedexText
source:
It stores electricity in the electric sacs
on its cheeks. When it releases pent-up
energy in a burst, the electric power is
equal to a lightning bolt.
translation: 据说当好几只聚在一起时，\n那里就会凝聚强烈的电力，\n还可能会落下闪电。

label: gMarowakAlolaPokedexText
source:
The cursed flames that light up the bone
carried by this Pokémon are said
to cause both mental and physical
pain that will never fade.
translation: 据说，它手中的骨头上\n燃烧的诅咒之火，会给它的身心留下\n永远无法治愈的痛楚。

label: gEeveePokedexText
source:
An Eevee has an unstable genetic makeup
that suddenly mutates due to its
environment. Radiation from various
Stones causes this Pokémon to evolve.
translation: 拥有不规则的基因。\n石头散发出的射线\n会让它的身体发生突变。

label: gUnownPokedexText
source:
This Pokémon is shaped like ancient text
characters. Although research is ongoing,
it is a mystery as to which came first,
the ancient writings or the various Unown.
translation: 身体很薄，\n会一直贴在墙上。\n它的外形好像有着某种含义。

label: gMothimPokedexText
source:
It does not keep a nest. While it
loves floral honey, it won't gather
any itself. Instead, it plots to steal
honey collected by Combee.
translation: 非常喜欢吃花蜜。\n会抢夺三蜜蜂采集到的蜜，\n然后自己吃掉。

label: gArceusPokedexText
source:
It is told in mythology that this Pokémon
emerged from an egg and shaped all there
is in this world, before the universe
even existed.
translation: 在神话里，\n它被描述为宇宙尚未存在时，\n就诞生的最早的宝可梦。

label: gGenesectPokedexText
source:
Over 300 million years ago, it was
feared as the strongest of hunters.
Team Plasma altered it and attached
a cannon to its back.
translation: 3亿年前就存在的宝可梦。\n被等离子队改造，\n背上安装了炮台。

label: gGreninjaPokedexText
source:
It appears and vanishes with a ninja's
grace. It toys with its enemies using
swift movements, while slicing them with
throwing stars made of compressed water.
translation: 像忍者般神出鬼没。\n以敏捷的动作玩弄对手，\n再用水之手里剑将对方劈开。

label: gScatterbugPokedexText
source:
When under attack from bird Pokémon,
it spews a poisonous black powder that
causes paralysis on contact. Scatterbug
can live in any region or climate.
translation: 覆盖身体的粉末能调节体温，\n所以无论在什么地域\n和气候下都能生活。

label: gSpewpaPokedexText
source:
It lives hidden within thicket shadows.
When predators attack, it quickly bristles
the fur covering its body in an effort to
threaten them.
translation: 身体很坚硬，\n即便是鸟嘴也伤不了它分毫。\n挥撒粉末进行防守。

label: gFurfrouPokedexText
source:
Trimming its fluffy fur not only makes
it more elegant but also increases the
swiftness of its movements. These
Pokémon were the guardians of kings.
translation: 在遥远过去的卡洛斯地区，\n被授予了护卫国王职责的宝可梦。

label: gXerneasPokedexText
source:
Legends say that when the horns on
its head shine in seven colors, it is
sharing everlasting life. It slept for a
thousand years in the form of a tree
translation: 据说，当头上的角闪着\n七色光时，会分享永恒的生命。

label: gZygarde50PokedexText
source:
It's said to be monitoring the ecosystem
from deep in the caves where it lives.
There are rumors that even greater power
lies hidden within its cells.
translation: 传说，在与威胁到生态\n系统者战斗时，\n它会变化为更强大的样子。

label: gZygarde10PokedexText
source:
This is Zygarde when about 10% of
its pieces have been assembled. It
leaps at its opponent's chest and
sinks its sharp fangs into them.
translation: 在各地的基格尔德细胞聚集到10%时诞生。\n擅长近战。

label: gGumshoosPokedexText
source:
When it finds a trace of its prey, it
patiently stakes out the location...
but as it's diurnal, it's always snoozing
by nightfall.
translation: 擅长专心致志地追寻猎物的足迹。\n然而它似乎觉得个性单纯的\n贪心栗鼠追起来不够过瘾。

label: gVikavoltPokedexText
source:
It concentrates electrical energy within
its large jaws and uses it to zap its foes.
It overwhelms bird Pokémon with shocking
beams of electrical energy.
translation: 会抱住虫电宝吸收电能，\n并从巨大的颚部连续\n发射强力的电磁光束。

label: gRibombeePokedexText
source:
Ribombee rolls up pollen into puffs.
It makes many different varieties, some
used as food and others used in battle.
They are sometimes sold as supplements.
translation: 被称为高手的蝶结萌虻所制作的\n花粉团能消除疲倦，\n因此是很受欢迎的商品。

label: gRockruffPokedexText
source:
This Pokémon has lived with people since
times long ago. It can sense when its
Trainer is in the dumps and will stick
close by its Trainer's side.
translation: 在长大之前会集体行动。\n一旦心情变差，\n就会开始用脖子上的岩石敲打地面。

label: gAraquanidPokedexText
source:
Despite what its appearance suggests,
it cares for others. If it finds vulnerable,
weak Pokémon, it protectively brings
them into its water bubble.
translation: 会发射黏糊糊的水泡。\n当被它困住的敌人昏掉后，\n它就会用大颚将其咬碎。

label: gLurantisPokedexText
source:
It requires a lot of effort to maintain
Lurantis's vivid coloring, but some
collectors enjoy this work and treat it
as their hobby.
translation: 为保存它鲜艳的花色，\n需要下很多工夫。\n是很考验训练家细心程度的宝可梦。

label: gSalazzlePokedexText
source:
For some reason, only females have
been found. It creates a reverse harem of
male Salandit to live with. Its poisonous
gas is filled with pheromones.
translation: 焰后蜥的群体之间一旦碰上彼此，\n就会利用费洛蒙气体\n来展开雄性争夺战。

label: gSilvallyNormalPokedexText
source:
Its trust in its partner awakens it.
This Pokémon is capable of changing its
type by equipping special memories, a
trait that is well displayed in battle.
translation: 与所信赖的训练家之间\n的牵绊是解放它真正\n力量的最后一个要素。

label: gSilvallyMemoryPokedexText
source:
Upon awakening, its RKS System is
activated. By employing specific
memories, this Pokémon can adapt its
type to confound its enemies.
translation: 有着依所装备的存储碟\n改变自身属性的能力。\n这是它装备了属性存储碟的样子。

label: gMiniorMeteorPokedexText
source:
Originally making its home in the ozone
layer, it hurtles to the ground when the
shell encasing its body grows too heavy.
It was born from mutated nanoparticles.
translation: 摸它叫它，它都会作出些什么反应，\n但并不清楚这些反应是否\n出自它自身的意志。

label: gMiniorCorePokedexText
source:
If its core stays exposed, it will
soon die off. It's possible that it
may survive if it's put into a Poké Ball
quickly enough.
translation: 以大气中的尘埃为食物。\n据说核心的颜色是根据\n尘埃含有的成分而定。

label: gTogedemaruPokedexText
source:
The spiny fur on its back is normally
at rest. When this Pokémon becomes
agitated, its fur stands on end and stabs
into its attackers.
translation: 在危急时刻会把身体卷成一团，\n倒竖起背上的尖刺，\n不分青红皂白地发出电击。

label: gMimikyuDisguisedPokedexText
source:
A lonely Pokémon, it hides its terrifying
appearance beneath an old rag so it can
get closer to people and other Pokémon.
Its actual appearance is unknown.
translation: 最近才被认定为宝可梦。\n在这之前，\n大家一直以为它是穿着布的幽灵。

label: gMimikyuBustedPokedexText
source:
After going to all the effort of
disguising itself, its neck was
broken. Whatever is inside is probably
unharmed, but it's still feeling sad.
translation: 受到伤害而无法再支撑起布料的头。\n它一辈子都不会忘记\n攻击了自己的对手。

label: gKommoOPokedexText
source:
Its rigid scales function as offense and
defense. In the past, its scales were
processed and used to make weapons
and other valuable commodities.
translation: 会敲响鳞片来测试对手胆量。\n弱小的家伙会被那声音吓跑。

label: gAlcremieVanillaCreamPokedexText
source:
If Alcremie is content, the secreted cream
from its hands becomes sweeter and richer.
When it trusts a Trainer, it will treat
them to berries it's decorated with cream.
translation: 备受照料的霜奶仙\n产出的鲜奶油可谓极品，\n因此训练家都会温柔地培育它。

label: gAlcremieRubyCreamPokedexText
source:
The moment it evolved, it took on a
sweet and tart flavor. This is
because of the way its cells
spontaneously shifted during evolution.
translation: 一旦遭到敌人袭击，\n就会投掷突出了酸甜风味的\n鲜奶油进行反击。

label: gAlcremieMatchaCreamPokedexText
source:
The moment it evolved, it took on
an aromatic flavor. This is because
of the way its cells spontaneously
shifted during evolution.
translation: 一旦遭到敌人袭击，\n就会投掷突出了芳香风味的\n鲜奶油进行反击。

label: gAlcremieMintCreamPokedexText
source:
The moment it evolved, it took on a
refreshing flavor. This is because
of the way its cells spontaneously
shifted during evolution.
translation: 一旦遭到敌人袭击，\n就会投掷突出了清爽风味的\n鲜奶油进行反击。

label: gAlcremieLemonCreamPokedexText
source:
The moment it evolved, it took on a
sour flavor. This is because of the
way its cells spontaneously shifted
during evolution.
translation: 一旦遭到敌人袭击，\n就会投掷突出了酸酸风味的\n鲜奶油进行反击。

label: gAlcremieSaltedCreamPokedexText
source:
The moment it evolved, it took on a
salty flavor. This is because of the
way its cells spontaneously shifted
during evolution.
translation: 一旦遭到敌人袭击，\n就会投掷突出了咸咸风味的\n鲜奶油进行反击。

label: gAlcremieRubySwirlPokedexText
source:
The moment it evolved, it took on a
mixed flavor. This is because of the
way its cells spontaneously shifted
during evolution.
translation: 一旦遭到敌人袭击，\n就会投掷突出了缤纷风味的\n鲜奶油进行反击。

label: gAlcremieCaramelSwirlPokedexText
source:
The moment it evolved, it took on a
bitter flavor. This is because of
the way its cells spontaneously
shifted during evolution.
translation: 一旦遭到敌人袭击，\n就会投掷突出了偏苦风味的\n鲜奶油进行反击。

label: gAlcremieRainbowSwirlPokedexText
source:
The moment it evolved, it took on a
complex flavor. This is because of
the way its cells spontaneously
shifted during evolution.
translation: 一旦遭到敌人袭击，\n就会投掷突出了复杂风味的\n鲜奶油进行反击。

label: gToxtricityGigantamaxPokedexText
source:
Out of control after its own
poison penetrated its brain, it tears
across the land in a rampage,
contaminating the earth with toxic sweat.
translation: 因毒素蔓延到了大脑\n而失去控制。发狂的时候会排泄出\n毒汗污染大地。

label: gOgerponTealMaskPokedexText
source:
This Pokémon's type changes based on
which mask it's wearing. It confounds
its enemies with nimble movements
and kicks.
translation: 喜欢恶作剧，好奇心旺盛。\n会释出蕴藏在面具内的\n属性的能量战斗。

label: gOgerponWellspringMaskPokedexText
source: This form excels in both attack\nand defense. It ceaselessly unleashes\nmoves like a spring gushes water.
translation: 激发出水之力量的样子。\n会以踢技和藤蔓\n发起无间断的打击。

label: gOgerponHearthflameMaskPokedexText
source: This form is the most aggressive,\nbombarding enemies with the intensity\nof flames blazing within a hearth.
translation: 激发出火之力量的样子。\n会像挥动长枪一样操控\n带刺的藤蔓贯穿敌人。

label: gOgerponCornerstoneMaskPokedexText
source:
In this form, it draws on the power
of stone. Its body is rock-solid,
protecting it from all manner of
attacks.
translation: 激发出岩石之力量的样子。\n能以坚固的岩石身躯\n抵挡任何攻击，守护自身。

label: gText_Oak_Welcome
source: Hi! Sorry to keep you waiting!\pWelcome to the world of POKéMON!\pMy name is OAK.\pPeople call me the POKéMON\nPROFESSOR.\p$
translation: 让你久等了！\p欢迎来到宝可梦的世界！\p我叫大木。\p大家都叫我\n宝可梦博士。\p$

label: gText_Oak_Pokemon
source: This is what we call a “POKéMON.”\p\n$
translation: 这就是我们所说的"宝可梦"。\p\n$

label: gText_Oak_MainSpeech
source:
This world is widely inhabited by
creatures known as POKéMON.\pPeople and POKéMON live together,
by supporting each other.\pSome people play with POKéMON,
some battle with them. \pBut we don't know everything about
POKéMON yet. \pThere are still many mysteries
to solve. That's why I study\lPOKéMON every day.\p$
translation:
这个世界上广泛生活着
被称为宝可梦的生物。\p人类和宝可梦互相支持，
生活在一起。\p有人和宝可梦玩耍，
有人和它们一起对战。\p但关于宝可梦，
我们还未全知全晓。\p还有许多未解之谜
等待解开。这就是我每天\l研究宝可梦的原因。\p$

label: gText_Oak_AndYouAre
source: And you are?$
translation: 那么你是？$

label: gText_Oak_BoyOrGirl
source: Are you a boy?\nOr are you a girl?$
translation: 你是男孩？\n还是女孩？$

label: gText_Oak_WhatChallenge
source: What challenge are you\nexpecting?$
translation: 你期待怎样的\n挑战？$

label: gText_Oak_ChallengeSelected
source: That sounds like the right\nlevel of challenge to me!$
translation: 听起来是个很适合你的\n挑战难度！$

label: gText_Oak_WhatsYourName
source: And what's your name?$
translation: 你叫什么名字？$

label: gText_Oak_SoItsPlayer
source: Oh! So you're {PLAYER}{KUN}?$
translation: 哦！所以你是{PLAYER}{KUN}？$

label: gText_Oak_YourePlayer
source: {PLAYER}{KUN}, are you ready?\pYour very own adventure is about\nto unfold.\p$
translation: {PLAYER}{KUN}，准备好了吗？\p属于你自己的冒险之旅\n即将展开。\p$

label: gText_Oak_AreYouReady
source: You'll face fun times and tough\nchallenges.\pA world of dreams and adventures\nwith POKéMON awaits! Let's go!\pI'll be seeing you later!\p$
translation: 你将经历欢乐的时光\n与严峻的挑战。\p与宝可梦共度的梦想与冒险之旅\n在等着你！出发吧！\p待会儿见！\p$

label: NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_ElmAideIsWaiting
source: {PLAYER}!\pWhat are you doing here?\pMy aide is still waiting for you\nIn VIOLET CITY!$
translation: {PLAYER}！\p你在这里做什么？\p我的助手还在等着\n给你精灵球呢！$

label: NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_ShouldntTouch
source: Probably shouldn't touch!$
translation: 最好不要随便乱碰！$

label: NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_ElmAccepted
source: Thanks, {PLAYER}!\nYou're a great help!$
translation: 谢谢你，{PLAYER}！\n帮了我大忙了！$

label: NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_ElmRefused
source: But… Please, I need your\nhelp!$
translation: 可是......拜托了，我真的很需要\n你的帮助！$

label: NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_ElmResearchAmbitions
source: When I announce my findings,\nI'm sure we'll delve deeper\pinto the many mysteries of\nPOKéMON.\pYou can count on it!$
translation: 当我公布我的研究成果时，\n我相信我们一定能更深入地\p了解宝可梦进化的诸多\n未解之谜！\p相信我准没错！$

label: NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_ElmGotAnEmail
source: Oh, hey! I got an e-mail!\p… … … … … … … …\nHm… Uh-huh…\pOkay…$

label: NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_ElmMissionFromMrPokemon
source:
Hey, listen.\pI have an acquaintance called
MR. POKéMON.\pHe keeps finding weird things and
raving about his discoveries.\pAnyway, I just got an e-mail
from him saying that this\ltime it's real.\pIt is intriguing, but we're
busy with our POKéMON research...\pWait!
I know!\p{PLAYER}, can you go in our
place?$
translation:
嘿，听我说。\p我有一个熟人，大家都叫他
宝可梦爷爷。\p他经常在各地跑，能发现
各种奇特的珍贵之物。\p就在刚才，他又发邮件过来说
这次发现的绝对是真家伙，\l肯定不会有假。\p这很不可思议，但我们现在
忙着进行宝可梦的研究......\p等等！
我想到了！\p{PLAYER}，能不能替我
走这一趟？$

label: NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_ElmChooseAPokemon
source: I want you to raise one of\nthe POKéMON contained in these BALLS.\pYou'll be that POKéMON's\nfirst partner, {PLAYER}!\pGo on. Pick one!$
translation: 我想请你带上一只精灵球里的宝可梦\n作为同伴！\p你将成为它的\n第一位伙伴，{PLAYER}！\p去吧，挑一只你最中意的吧！$

label: NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_ReceivedStarter
source: {PLAYER} received {STR_VAR_1}!$
translation: {PLAYER}获得了{STR_VAR_1}！$

label: NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_Nickname
source: Would you like to give your\n{STR_VAR_1} a nickname?$
translation: 想给你的{STR_VAR_1}\n起一个昵称吗？$

label: NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_RegisteredElm
source: Registered PROF.ELM\nin the POKéGEAR.$
translation: 在宝可梦齿轮中\n登记了空木博士。$

label: NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_ElmLetYourMonBattle
source: If a wild POKéMON appears,\nlet your POKéMON battle it!$
translation: 如果有野生宝可梦出现，\n就让你的宝可梦去对战吧！$

label: NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_GotElmsNumber
source: {PLAYER} got ELM's phone\nnumber.$
translation: {PLAYER}记下了空木博士的\n电话号码。$

label: NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_AideSave
source: Don't forget to save your game\nregularly!\pPress the START button, then\nSAVE the game!$
translation: 平时一定要记得\n多存档！\p按下START键打开菜单，\n然后选择"记录"即可保存游戏！$

label: NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_AideGiveBalls
source: {PLAYER}!\pUse these on your POKéDEX\nquest!$
translation: {PLAYER}！\p这些给你，在你的宝可梦图鉴\n冒险路上一定会用得上的！$

label: NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_AideExplainBalls
source: To add to your POKéDEX, you\nhave to catch POKéMON.\pThrow POKé BALLS at wild\nPOKéMON to get them.$
translation: 要完成宝可梦图鉴，\n你就必须去捕捉宝可梦。\p在遇到野生宝可梦时，\n向它们投掷精灵球就能捉到它们。$

label: NewBarkTown_PlayersHouse_1F_Text_ElmsLookingForYou
source:
Oh, {PLAYER}…! Our neighbor,
PROF.ELM, was looking for you.\pHe said he wanted you to do
something for him.\pOh! I almost forgot! Your POKéGEAR
is back from the repair shop.\pHere you go!$
translation:
哎呀，{PLAYER}！邻居
空木博士正在找你呢。\p他说有件事想拜托你
帮个忙。\p啊！差点忘了！你的宝可梦齿轮
已经从修理店送回来了。\p给你！$

label: NewBarkTown_PlayersHouse_1F_Text_ObtainedPokeGear
source: {PLAYER} obtained the POKéGEAR.$
translation: {PLAYER}获得了宝可梦齿轮。$

label: NewBarkTown_PlayersHouse_1F_Text_ExplainPokeGear
source: MOM: Phone numbers are stored\nin memory.\pJust choose a name you want to call.\nI've already registered my number.\pGee, isn't that convenient?$
translation: 妈妈：电话号码都储存在\n内存里面。\p只要选你想联系的名字就行。\n我已经把我的号码存进去了。\p哎呀，真是太方便了不是吗？$

label: NewBarkTown_PlayersHouse_1F_Text_WearTheseRunningShoes
source: Oh, and don't forget your\nRUNNING SHOES!$
translation: 哦，还有别忘了带上\n跑步鞋！$

label: NewBarkTown_PlayersHouse_1F_Text_SwitchShoesWithRunningShoes
source: {PLAYER} switched shoes with the\nRUNNING SHOES.$
translation: {PLAYER}换上了\n跑步鞋。$

label: NewBarkTown_PlayersHouse_1F_Text_ExplainRunningShoes
source: MOM: {PLAYER}, press the B Button\nwhile wearing these to run fast!$
translation: 妈妈：{PLAYER}，穿上这双鞋按住B键\n就可以飞快地奔跑了！$

label: NewBarkTown_PlayersHouse_1F_Text_MomHurryUpElmIsWaiting
source: MOM: PROF.ELM is waiting for you.\pHurry up, baby!$
translation: 妈妈：空木博士还在等你呢。\p快去吧，宝贝！$

label: NewBarkTown_PlayersHouse_1F_Text_MomLeaving
source:
MOM: Wow, that's a cute POKéMON.
Where did you get it?\p…\pSo, you're leaving on an adventure...
That does sound challenging...\pJust be careful.\pPOKéMON are your friends.
You need to work as a team.\pNow, go on!
I'm behind you all the way!$
translation:
妈妈：哇，好可爱的宝可梦。
是从哪里得到的？\p......\p所以，你准备出发去冒险了......
听起来真的很有挑战性呢......\p路上一定要小心。\p宝可梦是你的伙伴。
你们必须像团队一样互相合作。\p好了，快出发吧！
妈妈会一直支持你的！$

label: Alola_Akala_BattleSandygast_Text_0
source: Coorr!$

label: Alola_Akala_Sign_Text_0
source: AKALA ISLE$
translation: 阿卡拉岛$

label: Alola_Akala_House_Sign_Text_0
source: AKALA VILLA\pA place for visitors to stay while\non AKALA ISLE.$
translation: 阿卡拉度假别庄\p专供造访阿卡拉岛的\n游客住宿的地方。$

label: Alola_Akala_Natu_Text_0
source: NATU: TUUUUU!$
translation: 天然雀：嘟--！$

label: Alola_Akala_OldManOnBench_Text_0
source: Ah the weather is so nice today,\nisn't it?\pI was just feeding the NATU and this\none decided to join me on my bench!$
translation: 啊，今天天气真好，\n不是吗？\p我刚刚正在喂天然雀，\n这只就跑来长椅上陪我了！$

label: Alola_Akala_TotemBattle_Text_0
source: Mortaar!$

label: Alola_Akala_TotemBattle_Text_1
source: Totem MAGMORTAR was defeated!\nIt scampered off somewhere…$
translation: 霸主鸭嘴炎兽被击败了！\n它不知道逃往哪里去了......$

label: Alola_Akala_TotemBattle_Text_2
source: Prrrob!$

label: Alola_Akala_TotemBattle_Text_3
source: Totem PROBOPASS was defeated!\nIt scampered off somewhere…$
translation: 霸主大朝北鼻被击败了！\n它不知道逃往哪里去了......$

label: Alola_Akala_Totem_sign_Text_0
source: The totem is emanating a strong\nenergy…\pTouch the totem to teleport to another\nIsle?$
translation: 图腾正散发出一股强烈的能量......\p要触碰图腾传送至其他岛屿吗？$

label: Alola_Akala_Totem_sign_Text_1
source: MELEMELE ISLE$
translation: 美乐美乐岛$

label: Alola_Akala_Totem_sign_Text_2
source: ULA'ULA ISLE$
translation: 乌拉乌拉岛$

label: Alola_Akala_Totem_sign_Text_3
source: PONI ISLE$
translation: 波尼岛$

label: Alola_Akala_Totem_sign_Text_4
source: 取消$
translation: 取消$

label: Alola_Akala_Totem_sign_Text_5
source: A strange totem stands here,\npower is emanating from it…$
translation: 这里伫立着一个奇异的图腾，\n正散发出一股能量......$

label: Alola_Akala_BattleVsTapuLele_Text_0
source: Le-Lele!$
translation: 哩--哩哩！$

label: Alola_Akala_TrainerBattleHiker_Text_0
source: I came to the ISLES to hike the\nmountains!$
translation: 我来到这些岛屿是为了登山！$

label: Alola_Akala_TrainerBattleHiker_Text_1
source: And down I tumble…$
translation: 结果我摔倒了......$

label: Alola_Akala_TrainerBattleHiker_Text_2
source: AKALA ISLE has the best hiking!\nIt's got lush forests and rugged trails!$
translation: 阿卡拉岛最适合登山了！\n这里有茂密的森林和险峻的山路！$

label: Alola_Akala_TrainerBattlePicnicker_Text_0
source: Ha! Didn't see me, did you?$
translation: 哈！没看到我吧？$

label: Alola_Akala_TrainerBattlePicnicker_Text_1
source: I guess the element of surprise isn't\nalways super effective…$
translation: 看来出其不意也不是\n每次都效果绝佳啊......$

label: Alola_Akala_TrainerBattlePicnicker_Text_2
source: It's so lush on AKALA ISLE,\nI can easily hide in the trees!$
translation: 阿卡拉岛草木郁郁葱葱，\n我可以轻松躲在树林里！$

label: Alola_Akala_TrainerBattleCamper_Text_0
source: I want to be the first to prove myself\nto the Totem POKéMON!$
translation: 我想成为第一个向\n霸主宝可梦证明自己实力的人！$

label: Alola_Akala_TrainerBattleCamper_Text_1
source: Drat,\nthat's not going to help my case.$
translation: 可恶，\n这样可证明不了我的实力啊。$

label: Alola_Akala_TrainerBattleCamper_Text_2
source: There's a weird Totem further ahead but\nI haven't seen a Totem POKéMON.$
translation: 前面有一个奇怪的图腾，\n但我还没见到霸主宝可梦。$

label: Alola_Akala_TrainerBattleSwimmerLand_Text_0
source: Hey! No shoes on the beach!$
translation: 喂！沙滩上可不能穿鞋！$

label: Alola_Akala_TrainerBattleSwimmerLand_Text_1
source: Ouch,\nwhere's a lifeguard when you need one…$
