translation: 哎哟，\n需要救生员的时候他们都去哪儿了......$

label: Alola_Akala_TrainerBattleSwimmerLand_Text_2
source: AKALA ISLE has the best beaches!\nIt's got soft sand and clear waters!$
translation: 阿卡拉岛的海滩最棒了！\n沙子又软，海水又清澈！$

label: Alola_Akala_TrainerBattleSwimmerWater_Text_0
source: Out of my way!\nI'm swimming laps!$
translation: 借过借过！\n我正在折返游呢！$

label: Alola_Akala_TrainerBattleSwimmerWater_Text_1
source: Not the break I was looking for…$
translation: 我想要的休息可不是这种啊......$

label: Alola_Akala_TrainerBattleSwimmerWater_Text_2
source: ULA'ULA ISLE has the best beaches!\nIgnore anyone who says otherwise!$
translation: 乌拉乌拉岛的海滩才是最棒的！\n别听其他人胡说八道！$

label: Alola_Akala_TrainerBattleSwimmerWaterM_Text_0
source: Hah!\nYou need to ride a POKéMON to surf?$
translation: 哈！\n你冲浪居然还要骑宝可梦？$

label: Alola_Akala_TrainerBattleSwimmerWaterM_Text_1
source: If I hadn't swam myself\nmaybe I would've had the energy to win…$
translation: 如果不是我自己游过来，\n也许还有力气能赢呢......$

label: Alola_Akala_TrainerBattleSwimmerWaterM_Text_2
source: The current out here is strong!\nA POKéMON must be really powerful to\lmigrate all the way out to the ISLES!$
translation: 这里的洋流很急！\n能一路迁徙到这些岛屿上的宝可梦，\l一定非常强壮吧！$

label: Alola_Akala_Bench_Heal_Text_0
source: Would you like to take a rest on this\nbench?$
translation: 你想在这张长椅上\n休息一下吗？$

label: Alola_Melemele_BattleMarowak_Text_0
source: Raah!$

label: Alola_Melemele_BattleDugtrio_Text_0
source: Cha-Cha!$

label: Alola_AkalaCave_TrainerBattleHiker_Text_0
source: You must be tough if you made it all the\nway up here!$
translation: 能一路爬到这里，\n你一定很厉害吧！$

label: Alola_AkalaCave_TrainerBattleHiker_Text_1
source: Tougher than me!$
translation: 比我还厉害！$

label: Alola_AkalaCave_TrainerBattleHiker_Text_2
source: I had to stop climbing because it was\ngetting far too hot.\pIt's like someone's got a fire going\nup on the peak…$
translation: 太热了，我不得不放弃登山。\p山顶简直就像有人在\n生着大火一样......$

label: Alola_AkalaCave_TrainerBattlePicnicker_Text_0
source: I'm tired from all this walking,\nlet's have a battle!$
translation: 走了这么久我都累了，\n来场对战提提神吧！$

label: Alola_AkalaCave_TrainerBattlePicnicker_Text_1
source: Well that was refreshing!$
translation: 哎呀，真是神清气爽！$

label: Alola_AkalaCave_TrainerBattlePicnicker_Text_2
source: I'm usually not this tired but\nthe heat in this cave is exhausting!$
translation: 我平时不会这么容易累的，\n可这个洞窟里的闷热实在让人吃不消！$

label: Alola_AkalaCave_TrainerBattleCamper_Text_0
source: Check me out!\nI caught some strong POKéMON!$
translation: 瞧瞧我！\n我抓到了好厉害的宝可梦！$

label: Alola_AkalaCave_TrainerBattleCamper_Text_1
source: Not bad,\nbut not good enough!$
translation: 打得不错，\n但我还不够强！$

label: Alola_AkalaCave_TrainerBattleCamper_Text_2
source: Is it warm in here or is it just me?$
translation: 这里真的很热，还是只有我这么觉得？$

label: Alola_AkalaForest_TrainerBattleBugCatcher1_Text_0
source: Look at all the cool bugs here on the \nISLES!$
translation: 快看这些岛上有好多酷炫的虫子！$

label: Alola_AkalaForest_TrainerBattleBugCatcher1_Text_1
source: Ouch, that stung!$
translation: 哎哟，蜇到我了！$

label: Alola_AkalaForest_TrainerBattleBugCatcher1_Text_2
source: The ISLES are far away from other land,\nso Bug-type POKéMON here must have\ladapted to the environment.$
translation: 这些岛屿远离其他陆地，\n所以这里的虫属性宝可梦\l一定适应了独特的情境。$

label: Alola_AkalaForest_TrainerBattleBugCatcher2_Text_0
source: Look at what I caught!$
translation: 看看我抓到了什么！$

label: Alola_AkalaForest_TrainerBattleBugCatcher2_Text_1
source: Awh, that bites!$
translation: 哎呀，真倒霉！$

label: Alola_AkalaForest_TrainerBattleBugCatcher2_Text_2
source: The climate is a bit different on the\nALOLA ISLES…\pI'm sure that's why there are some\nunique Bug-type POKéMON here.$
translation: 阿罗拉群岛的气候有点不一样......\p难怪这里会有一些\n独特的虫属性宝可梦。$

label: Alola_Akala_BattleRaichu_Text_0
source: Gaaah!$
translation: 哇啊啊！$

label: Alola_Akala_House_OldWoman_Text_0
source: I tell my husband everyday not to feed\nthe NATU, but he never listens!\pOne day he'll bring one of those darn\nthings home, I just know it!$
translation: 我每天都跟我丈夫说别喂天然雀，但他就是不听！\p总有一天他会把那种讨厌的家伙带回家的，我敢肯定！$

label: Alola_MelemeleSea_TrainerBattleSwimmer_Text_0
source: So much open water here!$
translation: 这里的水域好开阔啊！$

label: Alola_MelemeleSea_TrainerBattleSwimmer_Text_1
source: Ouch,\npulled a hamstring…$
translation: 哎哟，\n大腿抽筋了......$

label: Alola_MelemeleSea_TrainerBattleSwimmer_Text_2
source: There are some strong currents here.\nI think it attracts strong POKéMON!$
translation: 这里的激流很急。\n我觉得会吸引来强大的宝可梦！$

label: AzaleaTown_Gym_Text_GymStatue
source: AZALEA POKéMON GYM$
translation: 桧皮宝可梦道馆$

label: AzaleaTown_Gym_Text_GymStatueCertified
source: AZALEA TOWN POKéMON GYM\pBUGSY'S CERTIFIED TRAINERS:\n{PLAYER}$
translation: 桧皮镇宝可梦道馆\p阿笔认定的合格训练家：\n{PLAYER}$

label: AzaleaTown_Gym_Text_BugsyIntro
source:
I'm BUGSY!\pI never lose when it comes
to bug POKéMON.\pMy research is going to make me the
authority on bug POKéMON!\pLet me demonstrate all I've
learned from my studies.$
translation:
我是阿笔！\p在虫属性宝可梦方面，
我是绝对不会输给任何人的。\p我的研究总有一天会让我成为
虫属性宝可梦的权威！\p就让你见识一下
我平时的钻研成果吧。$

label: AzaleaTown_Gym_Text_BugsyBeaten
source:
Whoa, amazing! You're an
expert on POKéMON!\pMy research isn't complete
yet.\pOK, you win. Take this
BADGE.$
translation:
哇--好厉害！
你真是宝可梦的高手啊！\p我的研究
还远远不够呢。\p好吧，我认输了。
把这个徽章拿去吧。$

label: AzaleaTown_Gym_Text_ReceivedHiveBadge
source: {PLAYER} received HIVEBADGE.$
translation: {PLAYER}获得了昆虫徽章。$

label: AzaleaTown_Gym_Text_HiveBadgeSpeech
source:
Do you know the benefits
of HIVEBADGE?\pIf you have it, POKéMON up
to L30 will obey you,\leven traded ones.\pPOKéMON that know CUT will be able
to use it outside of battle too.\pHere, I also want you to
have this.$
translation:
你知道昆虫徽章的
效果吗？\p有了它，包括交换来的在内，
30级以下的宝可梦都会听你的话，\p而且在战斗外也可以使用学会的"居合斩"了。\p还有，我也把这个
送给你吧。$

label: AzaleaTown_Gym_Text_FuryCutterSpeech
source: TM89 contains U-TURN.\pU-TURN lets you do damage and\nswitch your POKéMON in the same\lturn!\pIsn't that great?\nI discovered it!$
translation: 招式学习器89里面是"急速折返"。\p"急速折返"能在给予伤害的同时，\n在同一回合内替换宝可梦出场！\p很厉害吧？\n这可是我的重大发现！$

label: AzaleaTown_Gym_Text_BugsyAdvice
source: Bug POKéMON are deep. There are\nmany mysteries to be explored.\pStudy your favorites thoroughly.$
translation: 虫属性宝可梦非常深奥。\n还有许多谜团等待探索。\p好好彻底研究你喜欢的宝可梦吧。$

label: AzaleaTown_Gym_Text_BugsyRematch
source: Wow, you're the JOHTO CHAMPION now!\pYour skills are truly impressive!\pI've been busy with my research.\pI'm ready to show you my new\nfindings.\pWant to have a rematch with me?$
translation: 哇，你现在已经是城都冠军了！\p你的实力真的很令人惊叹！\p我也一直在忙着做研究呢。\p我已经准备好向你展示我的新发现了。\p想和我再来对战一次吗？$

label: AzaleaTown_Gym_Text_BugsyRematchDefeat
source: Wow, you must be an expert trainer.\nMy research must not be complete...$
translation: 哇，你真是一位厉害的训练家。\n看来我的研究还不够透彻......$

label: AzaleaTown_Gym_Text_BugCatcherBennySeen
source: Bug POKéMON evolve young. So they\nget stronger that much faster.$
translation: 虫属性宝可梦在早期就会进化。\n所以变强的速度也格外快。$

label: AzaleaTown_Gym_Text_BugCatcherBennyBeaten
source: Just evolving isn't enough!$
translation: 光是进化还不够啊！$

label: AzaleaTown_Gym_Text_BugCatcherBennyAfter
source: POKéMON become stronger\nif they evolve. Really!$
translation: 宝可梦进化之后就会变强。\n真的！$

label: AzaleaTown_Gym_Text_BugCatcherAlSeen
source: Bug POKéMON are cool and tough!\nI'll prove it to you!$
translation: 虫属性宝可梦又帅气又强悍！\n我这就证明给你看！$

label: AzaleaTown_Gym_Text_BugCatcherAlBeaten
source: You proved how tough you are…$
translation: 你证明了你有多强悍......$

label: AzaleaTown_Gym_Text_BugCatcherAlAfter
source: They're so cool, but most girls\ndon't like bug POKéMON.\pI don't know why…$
translation: 明明那么帅气，但大多数女孩子\n都不喜欢虫属性宝可梦呢。\p不知道为什么......$

label: AzaleaTown_Gym_Text_BugCatcherJoshSeen
source: You saved all the SLOWPOKE?\nWhew, you're mighty!\pBut my grown-up POKéMON are\npretty tough too!$
translation: 是你拯救了所有的呆呆兽？\n哇，你真厉害！\p不过我培育长大的宝可梦\n也是很厉害的！$

label: AzaleaTown_Gym_Text_BugCatcherJoshBeaten
source: Urrgggh!$
translation: 呃啊啊啊！$

label: AzaleaTown_Gym_Text_BugCatcherJoshAfter
source: I guess I should teach them\nbetter moves…$
translation:
看来我得教它们
更厉害的招式才行......$

label: AzaleaTown_Gym_Text_TwinsAmyMay1Seen
source: AMY: Hi! Are you challenging\nthe LEADER? No way!$
translation:
艾咪：嗨！你想要挑战
馆主？别做梦了！$

label: AzaleaTown_Gym_Text_TwinsAmyMay1Beaten
source: AMY & MAY: Oh, double\ngoodness!$
translation:
艾咪&美依：哎呀，
这下惨了！$

label: AzaleaTown_Gym_Text_TwinsAmyMay1After
source: AMY: You're really strong!\pBut BUGSY's even stronger!\nHis SCYTHER's CUT almost\lalways makes critical hits!$
translation:
艾咪：你真厉害！\p不过阿笔还要更强！
他的飞天螳螂使出的居合斩\l几乎招招命中要害！$

label: AzaleaTown_Gym_Text_TwinsAmyMay2Seen
source: MAY: You want to see the\nLEADER? Good luck!\pBUGSY is so strong!\nHis SCYTHER's CUT always\lseems to crit!$
translation:
美依：你想见馆主？
祝你好运吧！\p阿笔可是很强的！
他的飞天螳螂使出的居合斩\l似乎总能命中要害！$

label: AzaleaTown_Gym_Text_TwinsAmyMay2Beaten
source: AMY & MAY: Oh, double\ngoodness!$
translation:
艾咪&美依：哎呀，
这下惨了！$

label: AzaleaTown_Gym_Text_TwinsAmyMay2After
source: MAY: Our bug POKéMON lost!\nOh, what a shame.\pBUGSY's won't lose though!\pHis PINECO makes short work\nof ROCK-type POKéMON!$
translation:
美依：我们的虫属性宝可梦输了！
唉，真遗憾。\p不过阿笔的可不会输！\p他的榛果球能轻而易举地
收拾掉岩石属性宝可梦！$

label: AzaleaTown_Gym_Text_GymGuide
source:
Yo, challenger!\pBUGSY's young, but his knowledge
of bug POKéMON is for real.\pIt's going to be tough
without my advice.\pLet's see… BUGSY's bagworm POKéMON
knows a move that covers its\lROCK-type weakness.\pOh, and don't forget about those
nasty critical hits! Good luck!$
translation:
哟，挑战者！\p阿笔虽然年轻，但他对虫属性
宝可梦的了解可是货真价实的。\p如果没有我的建议，
挑战会很艰难哦。\p让我想想......阿笔的蓑衣虫宝可梦
学会了能弥补其岩石属性弱点的招式。\p对了，可别忘了那些
棘手的要害击中！祝你好运！$

label: AzaleaTown_Gym_Text_GymGuideWin
source: Well done! That was a great\nclash of talented young trainers.\pWith people like you, the\nfuture of POKéMON is bright!$
translation:
干得漂亮！真是一场才华横溢的
年轻训练家之间的精彩对决。\p有了像你们这样的人，
宝可梦的未来一片光明！$

label: AzaleaTown_Text_RivalBefore
source:
…Tell me something.\pIs it true that TEAM ROCKET
has returned?\pWhat? You beat them? Hah! Quit
lying.\pYou're not joking?
Then let's see how good you are.$
translation:
......告诉我一件事。\p火箭队复活了，
这是真的吗？\p什么？你打败了他们？哈！
少吹牛了。\p你没开玩笑？
那就让我看看你有多大本事。$

label: AzaleaTown_Text_RivalWin
source: …Humph! Useless POKéMON!\pListen, you. You only won because\nmy POKéMON were weak.$
translation:
......哼！没用的宝可梦！\p听好了。你赢只是因为
我的宝可梦太弱了。$

label: AzaleaTown_Text_RivalAfter
source:
I hate the weak.\pPOKéMON, trainers. It doesn't
matter who or what.\pI'm going to be strong and wipe
out the weak.\pThat goes for TEAM ROCKET too.\pThey act big and tough in a group.\pBut get them alone, and they're weak.
I hate them all.\pYou stay out of my way. A weakling
like you is only a distraction.$
translation:
我讨厌弱者。\p不管是宝可梦，还是训练家，
什么都一样。\p我要变强，然后把弱者
全部消灭。\p火箭队也是一样。\p聚在一起的时候人多势众，
神气活现。\p落单之后就弱得不堪一击。
我讨厌他们所有人。\p别挡我的路。像你这样的弱者
只会碍手碍脚。$

label: AzaleaTown_Text_RivalLoss
source: …Humph! I knew you were lying.$
translation: ......哼！我就知道你在说谎。$

label: AzaleaTown_Text_Rocket1
source: It's unsafe to go in there,\nso I'm standing guard.\pAren't I a good Samaritan?$
translation:
里面很危险，
所以我在站岗。\p我是不是很热心肠？$

label: AzaleaTown_Text_Rocket2
source: Do you know about SLOWPOKETAIL?\nI heard it's tasty!\pAren't you glad I told you that?$
translation:
你知道呆呆兽之尾吗？
听说非常美味哦！\p听到这个很开心吧？$

label: AzaleaTown_Text_GrampsBefore
source: The SLOWPOKE have disappeared\nfrom town…\pI heard their TAILS are being\nsold somewhere.$
translation:
镇上的呆呆兽都消失了......\p听说有人在某个地方
贩卖它们的尾巴。$

label: AzaleaTown_Text_GrampsAfter
source: The SLOWPOKE have returned.\pKnowing them, they could've just\nbeen goofing off somewhere.$
translation:
呆呆兽们回来了。\p就凭它们的性子，说不定
刚才只是在哪儿偷懒发呆呢。$

label: AzaleaTown_Text_Teacher
source: Did you come to get KURT to make\nsome BALLS?\pA lot of people do just that.$
translation: 你是来找钢铁制作精灵球的吗？\p很多人都是为此而来的。$

label: AzaleaTown_Text_Youngster
source:
Cut through AZALEA and you'll be
in ILEX FOREST.\pBut these skinny trees make it
impossible to get through.\pThe CHARCOAL MAN's POKéMON
can CUT down trees.$
translation:
穿过桧皮镇，你就会到达
栎树林。\p但是那些细树让人
根本过不去。\p炭窑师傅的宝可梦
能用居合斩砍倒那些树。$

label: AzaleaTown_Text_Kurt1
source: ILEX FOREST is restless!\pWhat is going on?$
translation: 栎树林骚动不安！\p到底发生什么事了？$

label: AzaleaTown_Text_Kurt2
source: {PLAYER}, here's your GS BALL back!$
translation: {PLAYER}，把GS球还给你！$

label: AzaleaTown_Text_Kurt3
source: Could you go see why ILEX FOREST\nis so restless?$
translation:
你能去看看栎树林
为什么骚动不安吗？$

label: AzaleaTown_Text_Sign
source: AZALEA TOWN\nWhere People and POKéMON Live in\lHappy Harmony.$
translation:
桧皮镇
人与宝可梦\l亲密共存的城镇。$

label: AzaleaTown_Text_KurtsHouseSign
source: KURT'S HOUSE$
translation: 钢铁的家$

label: AzaleaTown_Text_GymSign
source: AZALEA TOWN\nPOKéMON GYM\pLEADER: BUGSY\pThe Walking Bug POKéMON\nEncyclopedia$
translation:
桧皮镇
宝可梦道馆\p馆主：阿笔\p会行走的虫属性宝可梦百科全书$

label: AzaleaTown_Text_SlowpokeWellSign
source: SLOWPOKE WELL\pAlso known as the RAINMAKER WELL.\pLocals believe that a SLOWPOKE's\nyawn summons rain.\pRecords show that a SLOWPOKE's\nyawn ended a drought 400 years ago.$
translation: 呆呆兽之井\p别名：祈雨之井。\p当地的人们相信呆呆兽\n打哈欠就会降雨。\p据记载，在400年前，\n呆呆兽的哈欠终结了一场大旱。$

label: AzaleaTown_Text_CharcoalKilnSign
source: CHARCOAL KILN$
translation: 炭窑$

label: AzaleaTown_Text_IlexForestSign
source: ILEX FOREST\pEnter through the gate.$
translation: 桐树林\p穿过大门即是。$

label: CharcoalKiln_Text_Boss1
source:
All the SLOWPOKE have disappeared
from the town.\pThe forest's protector may be
angry with us…\pIt may be a bad omen. We should
stay in.$
translation: 镇上的呆呆兽全都消失了。\p森林的守护神\n可能在生我们的气......\p这恐怕是不祥之兆。\n我们还是待在屋里吧。$

label: CharcoalKiln_Text_Boss2
source: The SLOWPOKE have returned…$
translation: 呆呆兽们回来了......$

label: CharcoalKiln_Text_Boss3
source: The SLOWPOKE have returned…\pBut my APPRENTICE hasn't come back\nfrom ILEX FOREST.\pWhere in the world is that lazy guy?$
translation: 呆呆兽们回来了......\p但我那学徒还没从\n桐树林回来。\p那个懒鬼到底跑哪儿去了？$

label: CharcoalKiln_Text_Boss4
source: You chased off TEAM ROCKET and\nwent to ILEX FOREST alone?\pThat takes guts! I like that.\nCome train with us.$
translation: 你赶跑了火箭队，\n还独自一人去了桐树林？\p真有种！我喜欢。\n来和我们一起修行吧。$

label: CharcoalKiln_Text_Apprentice1
source: Where have all the SLOWPOKE gone?\pAre they out playing somewhere?$
translation: 呆呆兽们都去哪儿了？\p是去哪里玩了吗？$

label: CharcoalKiln_Text_Apprentice2
source: The SLOWPOKE came back!$
translation: 呆呆兽们回来了！$

label: CharcoalKiln_Text_Apprentice3
source: I'm sorry--I forgot to thank you.\pThis is CHARCOAL that I made.\pFIRE-type POKéMON would be happy\nto hold that.$
translation: 不好意思--我都忘了向你道谢。\p这是我自己烧制的木炭。\p让火属性的宝可梦携带，\n它一定会很高兴的。$

label: CharcoalKiln_Text_Apprentice4
source: The SLOWPOKE came back, and you even\nfound FARFETCH'D.\pYou're the coolest, man!$
translation: 呆呆兽们回来了，\n你甚至还找回了大葱鸭。\p你太帅了，伙计！$

label: CharcoalKiln_Text_Farfetchd
source: FARFETCH'D: Kwaa!$
translation: 大葱鸭：嘎啊！$

label: KurtsHouse_Text_BallAnyway
source: Anyway, can I make you some BALLS?$
translation: 话说回来，要我帮你做几个球吗？$

label: KurtsHouse_Text_KurtGetStarted
source: KURT: I'll get started right now!$
translation: 钢铁：我马上开工！$

label: KurtsHouse_Text_KurtMakingBallsMustWait
source:
Hm? Who are you?\p{PLAYER}, eh? You want me to make
some BALLS?\pSorry, but that'll have to wait.\pDo you know TEAM ROCKET?
Ah, don't worry.\pI'll tell you anyhow.\pTEAM ROCKET's an evil gang that
uses POKéMON for their dirty work.\pThey're supposed to have disbanded
three years ago.\pAnyway, they're at the WELL,
cutting off SLOWPOKETAILS to sell!\pSo I'm going to go give them a
lesson in pain!\pHang on, SLOWPOKE! Old KURT
is on his way!$
translation:
嗯？你是谁？\p是{PLAYER}啊？你想让我
帮你做几个球？\p抱歉，那得等一等了。\p你听说过火箭队吗？
啊，不要紧。\p反正我也会告诉你的。\p火箭队是个利用宝可梦
干尽坏事的邪恶组织。\p他们本应在3年前就解散了。\p可现在他们竟然在井里，
割下呆呆兽之尾拿去卖！\p所以我要去给他们一点苦头尝尝！\p撑住啊，呆呆兽！
钢铁老头马上就来！$

label: KurtsHouse_Text_KurtHonoredToMakeBalls
source:
KURT: Hi, {PLAYER}!\pYou handled yourself like a
real hero at the WELL.\pI like your style!\pI would be honored to make
BALLS for a trainer like you.\pThis is all I have now, 
but take it.$
translation: 钢铁：嗨，{PLAYER}！\p你在井里的表现就像个真正的英雄。\p我很欣赏你的作风！\p能为你这样的训练家做球，\n是我的荣幸。\p虽然我现在只有这个，\n但也请收下吧。$

label: KurtsHouse_Text_KurtBallsFromApricorns
source: KURT: I make BALLS from BERRIES.\pCollect them from trees and bring\n'em to me.\pI'll make POKé BALLS out of them.$
translation: 钢铁：我能用树果来制作球。\p从树上采摘下来带给我吧。\p我会用它们做成精灵球。$

label: KurtsHouse_Text_KurtAskYouHaveAnApricorn
source: KURT: You have BERRIES for me?\pFine! I'll turn them into POKé BALLS.$
translation: 钢铁：你有树果要给我吗？\p好！我会把它们做成精灵球。$

label: KurtsHouse_Text_KurtThatsALetdown
source: KURT: I don't see any {STR_VAR_1}s!$
translation: 钢铁：我没看到有{STR_VAR_1}啊！$

label: KurtsHouse_Text_KurtFinishedPlural
source: KURT: {PLAYER}!\nYour {STR_VAR_1}s are done. Here!$
translation: 钢铁：{PLAYER}！\n你的{STR_VAR_1}做好了。给你！$

label: KurtsHouse_Text_KurtObtainedPlural
source: {PLAYER} obtained\n{STR_VAR_2} {STR_VAR_1}s!$
translation: {PLAYER}获得了\n{STR_VAR_2}个{STR_VAR_1}！$

label: KurtsHouse_Text_KurtFinishedSingular
source: KURT: {PLAYER}!\nYour {STR_VAR_1} is done. Here!$
translation: 钢铁：{PLAYER}！\n你的{STR_VAR_1}做好了。给你！$

label: KurtsHouse_Text_KurtObtainedSingular
source: {PLAYER} obtained\nthe {STR_VAR_1}!$
translation: {PLAYER}获得了\n{STR_VAR_1}！$

label: KurtsHouse_Text_KurtTurnedOutGreat
source: KURT: That turned out great.\pTry catching POKéMON with it.$
translation: 钢铁：成果相当不错。\p试着用它去捕捉宝可梦吧。$

label: KurtsHouse_Text_KurtWhatIsThat
source: Wh-what is that?\pI've never seen one before.\pIt looks a like a POKé BALL, but\nit appears to be something else.\pLet me check it for you.$
translation: 这、这是什么？\p我以前从没见过这东西。\p虽然看起来像个精灵球，\n但似乎又有些不同。\p让我帮你检查一下吧。$

label: KurtsHouse_Text_KurtImCheckingItNow
source: I'm checking it now.$
translation: 我现在正在调查呢。$

label: KurtsHouse_Text_KurtAhHaISee
source: Ah-ha! I see! So…$
translation: 啊哈！原来如此！这么说......$

label: KurtsHouse_Text_KurtThisBallStartedToShake
source: {PLAYER}!\pThis BALL started to shake\nwhile I was checking it.\pThere must be something to this!$
translation: {PLAYER}！\p在我调查的时候，\n这个球突然摇晃了起来。\p这里面一定有什么秘密！$

label: KurtsHouse_Text_Kurt_Whatwasthat
source: What was that sound?!\pLet's go outside to investigate!$
translation: 刚才那是什么声音？！\p我们去外面看看吧！$

label: KurtsHouse_Text_GranddaughterSlowpokeGone
source: The SLOWPOKE are gone… \nWere they taken away by bad people?$
translation: 呆呆兽们都不见了......\n是被坏人抓走了吗？$

label: KurtsHouse_Text_GranddaughterLonely
source: Grandpa's gone… I'm so lonely…$
translation: 爷爷不在家......好寂寞啊......$

label: KurtsHouse_Text_GranddaughterSlowpokeBack
source: The SLOWPOKE my dad gave me came back!\pIts TAIL is growing back too!$
translation: 爸爸送我的呆呆兽回来啦！\p它的尾巴也长回来了！$

label: KurtsHouse_Text_GranddaughterDad
source: Dad works at SILPH where\nhe studies POKé BALLS.\pI have to stay home\nwith Grandpa and SLOWPOKE.$
translation: 爸爸在西尔佛公司\n研究精灵球。\p我要留在家里\n陪爷爷和呆呆兽。$

label: KurtsHouse_Text_GranddaughterHelp
source: I get to help Grandpa now!\pWe'll make good BALLS\nfor you, so please wait!$
translation: 我现在也可以帮爷爷的忙了！\p我们会为你制作好球的，\n请稍等一下哦！$

label: KurtsHouse_Text_GranddaughterFun
source: It's fun to make BALLS!$
translation: 做球真好玩！$

label: KurtsHouse_Text_GranddaughterSound
source: Did that sound come from\nILEX FOREST????$
translation: 刚才的声音是从\n栎树林传来的吗？？？？$

label: KurtsHouse_Text_Forest
source: Did you check ILEX FOREST yet?\nIt sounds very restless.$
translation: 你去栎树林看过了吗？\n听起来那边很不安宁。$

label: KurtsHouse_Text_Slowpoke
source: SLOWPOKE: … Yawn?$

label: KurtsHouse_Text_OakPhoto
source: …A young PROF. OAK?$
translation: ......年轻的大木博士？$

label: KurtsHouse_Text_CelebiStatue
source: It's a statue of the forest's\nprotector.$
translation: 这是森林守护神的石像。$

label: AzaleaMart_Text_CooltrainerM
source:
Are you able to buy a GREAT BALL?
All I can buy are POKé BALLS.\pI heard that more items become
available to buy when you earn\lGYM BADGES!\pI wish KURT would make me some
of his custom BALLS.$
translation:
你能买到超级球吗？
我能买到的只有精灵球。\p听说赢得道馆徽章后，
店里能买到的道具就会变多！\p真希望钢铁先生能为我做一些
他特制的球啊。$

label: AzaleaMart_Text_BugCatcher
source: A GREAT BALL is better for catch-\ning POKéMON than a POKé BALL.\pBut KURT's might be better some-\ntimes.$
translation: 超级球比精灵球更\n容易捉到宝可梦。\p不过有时钢铁先生做的球\n效果会更好呢。$

label: AzaleaPokecenter_Text_Gentleman
source: Do your POKéMON know HM moves?\pThose moves can be used even if\nyour POKéMON has fainted.$
translation: 你的宝可梦学会秘传招式了吗？\p即使宝可梦陷入了濒死状态，\n也可以使用那些招式哦。$

label: AzaleaPokecenter_Text_UnusedPCExplanation
source: This BILL guy created the system\nfor storing POKéMON in a PC.\pBILL's PC can store up to 30\nPOKéMON per BOX.$
translation: 那个叫正辉的人开发了\n在电脑里寄放宝可梦的系统。\p正辉的电脑里，每个盒子\n最多可以存30只宝可梦。$

label: AzaleaPokecenter_Text_FishingGuru
source: BILL's PC can store up to 30\nPOKéMON per BOX.$
translation: 正辉的电脑里，每个盒子\n最多可以存30只宝可梦。$

label: AzaleaPokecenter_Text_PokefanF
source: Do you know about BERRIES?\pCrack one open, hollow it out and\nfit it with a special device.\pThen you can catch POKéMON with it.\pBefore POKé BALLS were invented,\neveryone used BERRIES.$
translation: 你知道树果吗？\p把它敲开，掏空果肉，\n再装上特殊的装置，\p就能用它来捉宝可梦了。\p在精灵球发明出来之前，\n大家都是用树果的。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_PlayerStepForward_hns
source: REFEREE: TRAINER {PLAYER}!\nStep forward, please!$
translation: 裁判：训练家{PLAYER}！\n请上前一步！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_OpponentStepForward_hns
source: REFEREE: TRAINER {STR_VAR_1}!\nStep forward, please!$
translation: 裁判：训练家{STR_VAR_1}！\n请上前一步！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_SetKOTourneyBegin_hns
source: REFEREE: Set KO Tourney!\nBegin!$
translation: 裁判：击倒淘汰赛！\n开始！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_WinnerIsPlayer_hns
source: REFEREE: The winner is {PLAYER}!$
translation: 裁判：胜者是{PLAYER}！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_WinnerIsOpponent_hns
source: REFEREE: The winner is {STR_VAR_1}!$
translation: 裁判：胜者是{STR_VAR_1}！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_MonsWillBeRestored_hns
source: Your POKéMON will be restored to\nfull health.$
translation: 你的宝可梦已经\n完全恢复活力了。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_ReadyFor2ndOpponent_hns
source: Next up, your second opponent!\nAre you ready to move on?$
translation: 接下来是第2位对手！\n准备好继续了吗？$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_ReadyFor3rdOpponent_hns
source: Next up, your third opponent!\nAre you ready to move on?$
translation: 接下来是第3位对手！\n准备好继续了吗？$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_ReadyFor4thOpponent_hns
source: Next up, your fourth opponent!\nAre you ready to move on?$
translation: 接下来是第4位对手！\n准备好继续了吗？$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_ReadyFor5thOpponent_hns
source: Next up, your fifth opponent!\nAre you ready to move on?$
translation: 接下来是第5位对手！\n准备好继续了吗？$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_ReadyFor6thOpponent_hns
source: Next up, your sixth opponent!\nAre you ready to move on?$
translation: 接下来是第6位对手！\n准备好继续了吗？$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_ReadyFor7thOpponent_hns
source: Next up, your seventh opponent!\nAre you ready to move on?$
translation: 接下来是第7位对手！\n准备好继续了吗？$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_SaveAndShutDown_hns
source: Would you like to save the game and\nshut down now?$
translation: 要保存游戏进度，\n并在此结束吗？$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_RetireFromChallenge_hns
source: Would you like to retire from your\nSet KO Tourney challenge?$
translation: 要退出判定淘汰赛的挑战吗？$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_SavingPleaseWait_hns
source: I am saving your game data.\nPlease wait.$
translation: 正在保存游戏数据，\n请稍候。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_RecordLastBattle_hns
source: Would you like to record your last\nbattle on your FRONTIER PASS?$
translation: 要将刚才的对战\n记录在开拓通行证上吗？$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_NowFaceTycoon_hns
source: My dear challenger!\pYour skill level is truly astounding!\pWe now would like you to face our\nleader, the ARENA TYCOON!$
translation: 尊敬的挑战者！\p你的实力真是令人惊叹！\p接下来，有请迎战我们的首领，\n竞技场主将！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_PreparedForTycoon_hns
source: A battle with the ARENA TYCOON!\nAre you prepared?$
translation: 与竞技场主将的对战！\n你准备好了吗？$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_MakeWayForGreta_hns
source: REFEREE: The ARENA TYCOON!\nMake way for GRETA!$
translation: 裁判：竞技场主将！\n黄瓜香登场！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_GretaYoureChallenger_hns
source: GRETA: Hey!\nHowdy!\p…Wait, are you the challenger?$
translation: 黄瓜香：嗨！\n你好呀！\p......咦，你就是挑战者吗？$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_IsThatRight_hns
source: Is that right? Hmm…\nHmhm…$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_YouLookWeakTakeThingsEasy_hns
source: I don't know how to say it, but…\nTo put it bluntly, you look pretty weak.\lAre you sure you're up for me?\pHmm…\pWell, all right!\nWe'll take things easy to start with!$
translation: 该怎么说呢......\n直白点讲，你看起来挺弱的。\l你真的有把握对付我吗？\pHmm......\p嘛，算了！\n一开始我就先放点水吧！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_IgniteMyPassionForBattle_hns
source: Okay! Let's see you ignite my passion\nfor battle!$
translation: 好啦！让我看看你能不能\n点燃我的对战热情！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_GretaYoureToughAfterAll_hns
source: GRETA: Ow, wait a second!\nYou are tough after all!\pI like you!\nLet's see your FRONTIER PASS.$
translation: 黄瓜香：哎呀，等等！\n你其实很强嘛！\p我中意你！\n把你的开拓通行证拿来吧。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_ReceivedGutsSymbol_hns
source: The Guts Symbol was embossed on\nthe FRONTIER PASS!$
translation: 开拓通行证上\n被印上了毅力象征！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_GoingToBeFunNextTime_hns
source: Hmm…\pIt's going to be fun the next time!\nI'm looking forward to it!$
translation: 嗯......\p下次一定会更有趣！\n我很期待哦！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_GretaLookingForwardToSeeingAgain_hns
source: GRETA: Hey! Howdy!\nYou finally won your way up to me!\pI was getting worried waiting for you!\nI was really looking forward to seeing\lyou again!$
translation: 黄瓜香：嗨！你好呀！\n你终于一路赢到我面前了！\p我等你等得都快着急了！\n我一直很期待能再次\l见到你呢！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_SoAreYouReady_hns
source: … … …\nSo, are you ready?$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_WontAllowHalfheartedEffort_hns
source: I won't allow a halfhearted effort!\nBe ready for a thrashing!$
translation: 我可不会手下留情！\n做好被狠狠痛扁的准备吧！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_LetsGetThisStarted_hns
source: Come on, REFEREE!\nLet's get this started!$
translation: 喂，裁判！\n快点开始吧！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_GretaBlownAway_hns
source: GRETA: Gaaah! Blown away!\nLet's see your FRONTIER PASS!$
translation: 黄瓜香：啊啊啊！被打得落花流水！\n让我看看你的开拓对战手账！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_GutsSymbolTookGoldenShine_hns
source: The Guts Symbol took on\na golden shine!$
translation: 毅力象征发出了\n金色的光芒！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_IfWeBattleAgainWontLose_hns
source: Arrrgh!\nThis is so infuriating!\pIf we ever battle again, I won't lose!\nDon't you forget it! Bye-bye!$
translation: 啊啊啊！\n真是气死我了！\p下次要是再战，我可绝对不会输！\n你给我记住了！拜拜！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaCorridor_Text_PleaseStepIn_hns
source: Your battles shall be waged in\nthe next room. Please step in!$
translation: 您的对战将在隔壁房间进行。\n请进！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsEnd
source: When you have made your preparations,\nplease do return.$
translation: 等您准备周全之后，\n请务必再来。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLv50
source:
My dear challenger!\pYou do not have the three POKéMON
required for entry.\pTo qualify, you must bring three
different kinds of POKéMON.\pThe three different POKéMON
must all be Level 50 or lower.\pThey also must not hold the same
kinds of items.\pEGGS{STR_VAR_1}.$
translation:
尊敬的挑战者！\p您没有带齐参加挑战所需的
3只宝可梦。\p参加的条件是，必须携带3只
不同种类的宝可梦。\p而且这3只不同的宝可梦
等级都必须在50级或以下。\p它们也不能携带相同种类的道具。\p蛋{STR_VAR_1}。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_WelcomeToBattleArena_hns
source: Where the battling spirit of TRAINERS\nis put to the test!\pI welcome you to the BATTLE ARENA!\pI am your guide to the Set KO Tourney!$
translation: 这里是考验训练家斗志的舞台！\p欢迎来到对战竞技场！\p我负责为您介绍判决淘汰赛！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_WishToTakeChallenge_hns
source: Now, do you wish to take\nthe BATTLE ARENA challenge?$
translation: 那么，您要挑战\n对战竞技场吗？$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_AwaitAnotherChallenge_hns
source: We await your challenge on\nanother occasion!$
translation: 期待您的下次挑战！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ExplainChallenge_hns
source:
In the BATTLE ARENA, we undertake
the Set KO Tourney.\pAll participants enter with a team of
three POKéMON.\pThe three POKéMON must be lined up in
the order in which they are to appear.\pDuring battle, the POKéMON will appear
one at a time in the preset order.\pOnce a POKéMON enters battle, it must
remain out until the match is decided.\pIf a match remains undecided in
three turns, it goes to judging.\pIf you wish to interrupt your challenge,
please save the game.\pIf you don't save, you will not be able
to continue with your challenge.\pIf you pull off the feat of beating
seven TRAINERS in succession,\lwe will present you with Battle Points.$
translation:
在对战竞技场中，我们将进行
判决淘汰赛。\p所有参赛者需携带3只宝可梦
组成的队伍出战。\p这3只宝可梦必须按出场顺序
排好队伍。\p在对战中，宝可梦将按照预设的
顺序一只一只出场。\p宝可梦一旦上场对战，
就必须一直战斗直至分出胜负。\p如果在3个回合内未能分出胜负，
就会由裁判进行判决。\p如果您想中断挑战，
请保存记录。\p如果不保存，就无法
继续进行挑战。\p如果您成功达成了
连胜7名训练家的壮举，\l我们就会向您赠送对战点数。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_OkayToSave_hns
source: Before showing you to the BATTLE\nARENA, you must save. Is that okay?$
translation: 在带您前往对战竞技场之前，\n需要保存记录。这样可以吗？$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_WhichLevelMode_hns
source: The BATTLE ARENA offers two levels\nof challenge, Level 50 and Open Level.\lWhich is your choice?$
translation: 对战竞技场提供两种挑战等级：\n50级挑战和公开等级。\l您选择哪一种？$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_SelectThreeMons_hns
source: Very well, now select your\nthree POKéMON, please.$
translation: 好的，那么请选择\n您要参赛的3只宝可梦。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLvOpen_hns
source:
My dear challenger!\pYou do not have the three POKéMON
required for entry.\pTo qualify, you must bring three
different kinds of POKéMON.\pThey also must not hold the same
kinds of items.\pEGGS{STR_VAR_1}.$
translation: 尊敬的挑战者！\p您没有带齐参加挑战所需的\n3只宝可梦。\p参加的条件是，必须携带3只\n不同种类的宝可梦。\p它们也不能携带相同种类的道具。\p蛋{STR_VAR_1}。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsEnd_hns
source: When you have made your preparations,\nplease do return.$
translation: 等您准备周全之后，\n请务必再来。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLv50_hns
source:
My dear challenger!\pYou do not have the three POKéMON
required for entry.\pTo qualify, you must bring three
different kinds of POKéMON.\pThe three different POKéMON
must all be Level 50 or lower.\pThey also must not hold the same
kinds of items.\pEGGS{STR_VAR_1}.$
translation:
尊敬的挑战者！\p您没有带齐参加挑战所需的
3只宝可梦。\p参加的条件是，必须携带3只
不同种类的宝可梦。\p而且这3只不同的宝可梦
等级都必须在50级或以下。\p它们也不能携带相同种类的道具。\p蛋{STR_VAR_1}。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_GuideYouToArena_hns
source: I shall now guide you to\nthe BATTLE ARENA.$
translation: 那么现在就由我带您前往\n对战竞技场。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_DidntSaveBeforeShuttingDown_hns
source:
My dear challenger!\pYou did not save the game before
shutting down, did you?\pIt is unfortunate, but that has
resulted in your disqualification\lfrom your challenge.\pYou may, of course, start with a fresh
challenge.$
translation:
尊敬的挑战者！\p您在关机前没有保存记录，
对不对？\p很遗憾，由于未保存记录，
您已被取消了挑战资格。\p当然，您可以重新开始
一场全新的挑战。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_CongratsOnSevenWins_hns
source: We congratulate you for your splendid\nstring of wins over seven TRAINERS!$
translation: 恭喜您达成连胜7名训练家的\n辉煌战绩！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_RecordAchievement_hns
source: Your achievement will be recorded.\nPlease wait while I save the game.$
translation: 我们正在记录您的战绩。\n正在保存记录，请稍候。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_PresentYouWithPrize_hns
source: In commemoration of your 7-win streak,\nwe present you with this prize.$
translation: 为纪念您的7连胜，\n我们向您颁发这份奖品。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ReceivedPrize_hns
source: {PLAYER} received the prize\n{STR_VAR_1}.$
translation: {PLAYER}获得了奖品\n{STR_VAR_1}。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_BagFullReturnForPrize_hns
source: Oh?\nYour BAG seems to be full.\pI urge you to clear space and\nreturn for your prize.$
translation: 哎呀？\n您的背包好像满了。\p请整理出空间后再来\n领取您的奖品。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ThankYouWaitWhileSave_hns
source: Thank you so much for participating!\pPlease wait while I save the game.$
translation: 非常感谢您的参与！\p正在保存记录，请稍候。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_AwaitAnotherChallenge_hns2_hns
source: We await your challenge on\nanother occasion!$
translation: 期待您的下次挑战！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_LookingForwardToArrivalSaveGame_hns
source: We have been looking forward to\nyour arrival.\pBefore I show you to the BATTLE\nARENA, I must save the game.\lPlease wait.$
translation: 我们一直期待着您的到来。\p在带您前往对战竞技场之前，\n需要保存记录。\l请稍候。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_RecordLastMatch_hns
source: Shall I record your last BATTLE ARENA\nmatch on your FRONTIER PASS?$
translation: 要把您在对战竞技场的最后一场\n对战记录在开拓对战手账上吗？$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_BadIdeaToNotAttack_hns
source: I lost on the REFEREE's decision…\pI don't think it was a good idea to only\nuse defensive moves and not attack…$
translation: 我在裁判的判定中输了......\p光用防御招式而不去攻击，\n看来真的不是个好策略啊......$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_LandingHitsWorked_hns
source: I won in judging!\pLanding hits consistently on\nthe opponent's POKéMON worked!$
translation: 我靠裁判判定赢了！\p不断给对手的宝可梦造成有效打击，\n果然起作用了！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_MatchWasDeclaredDraw_hns
source: Our match was declared a draw.\pWhen we ran out of time, both my\nPOKéMON and the opponent's had about\lthe same amount of HP left.$
translation: 我们的比赛被判定为平局。\p时间到了的时候，\n我和对手宝可梦剩下的HP\l几乎完全一样多。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_OrderOfMonsImportant_hns
source:
In the BATTLE ARENA, the order of
POKéMON is totally important.\pFor example, if your first POKéMON
has certain type disadvantages,\ltry making your second POKéMON one\lwith moves that are super effective\lagainst the first one.\pI think that will be a good way of
making an effective team.$
translation:
在对战竞技场，
宝可梦的出场顺序是至关重要的。\p举个例子，如果你的首发宝可梦
在属性上处于劣势，\l那就尽量让第二只宝可梦掌握\l能克制前者的属性招式。\p我觉得这是构建强力队伍的
一个好方法。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_RulesAreListed_hns
source: The Set KO Tourney's rules are listed.$
translation: 上面写着连胜淘汰赛的规则。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ReadWhichHeading_hns
source: Which heading do you want to read?$
translation: 想了解哪一项？$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ExplainBattleRules_hns
source:
The Set KO Tourney has special rules,
unlike standard battles.\pFirst, one battle lasts only
three turns.\pIf the outcome is not decided after
three turns, it goes to judging.\pThe REFEREE will choose the winner
based on how the POKéMON battled.\pAlso, a POKéMON cannot be switched out
until its battle's outcome is decided.$
translation:
连胜淘汰赛有着不同于普通对战的
特殊规则。\p首先，一场对战只持续3个回合。\p如果3个回合后仍未分出胜负，
就会进入裁判判定环节。\p裁判将根据宝可梦在对战中的表现
来裁定胜者。\p此外，在对战分出胜负之前，
宝可梦是无法被换下场的。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ExplainMindRules_hns
source: The first judging factor is “Mind.”\nThis factor evaluates how aggressive\lthe battlers were.\pThe judging is based on how often\nthe TRAINERS ordered the use of\loffensive moves.$
translation: 第1个判定标准是"心"。\n这一项用来评估对战双方的积极程度。\p裁判会根据训练家指示使用\n攻击招式的频率来进行评判。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ExplainSkillRules_hns
source:
The second judging factor is “Skill.”
This factor evaluates how effectively\lPOKéMON moves were used.\pIf a move worked successfully,
the Skill rating goes up.\pIf a move failed, the Skill rating
is lowered.\pIf it was an offensive move, the Skill
rating goes up if the move was “super\leffective” and goes down if it was\l“not very effective.”\pThe Skill rating will not go up for
moves such as PROTECT and DETECT.\pIf the opponent used PROTECT or
DETECT, and your POKéMON failed to\lhit with a move, its Skill rating will not\lgo down.$
translation:
第2个判定标准是"技"。
这一项用来评估宝可梦招式运用的有效程度。\p如果招式成功生效，
"技"的评分就会上升。\p如果招式落空或失败，评分就会下降。\p若是攻击招式，击中时如果"效果绝佳"，
评分会上升;若"效果不好"，\l评分则会下降。\p使用"守住"或"看穿"等招式
不会增加"技"的评分。\p如果对手使用了"守住"或"看穿"
导致你的招式未击中，评分并不会因此降低。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ExplainBodyRules_hns
source: The third judging factor is “Body.”\nThis factor is based on how much HP\lremained at the end of a battle.\pThe rating takes into account how much\nHP a POKéMON had at the start of\lbattle, and what remained at the end.$
translation: 第3个判定标准是"体"。\n这一项基于对战结束时所剩的HP多少进行判定。\p评分会综合考量宝可梦在对战开始时的HP，\n以及在结束时所剩余的HP比例。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_CongratsOnDefeatingTycoon_hns
source: A victory snatched from the ARENA\nTYCOON, and a seven-TRAINER sweep!\pWe congratulate you on your most\nsplendid challenge!$
translation: 从竞技场主将手中夺得胜利，\n完成了连克7名训练家的壮举！\p恭喜你达成了如此辉煌的挑战！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_PleaseAcceptBattlePoints_hns
source: My dear challenger, in recognition of\nyour indefatigable spirit, please\laccept these Battle Point(s).$
translation: 了不起的挑战者，为表彰你坚韧不拔的精神，\n请收下这些对战点数。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_RefereesDecidedWinnerTrainer
source: The REFEREES have reached\na decision!\pThe winner is…\nOh, my goodness!\lThe winner is {STR_VAR_1}!\lCongratulations!$
translation: 裁判们做出了判定！\p胜者是......\n噢，天哪！\l胜者是{STR_VAR_1}！\l恭喜！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_RefereesDecidedWinnerPlayer
source: The REFEREES have reached\na decision!\pThe winner is…\nOh, my goodness!\lThe winner is {PLAYER}!\lCongratulations!$
translation: 裁判们做出了判定！\p胜者是......\n噢，天哪！\l胜者是{PLAYER}！\l恭喜！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_PlayerHasEnteredDome_hns
source: {PLAYER} has entered the BATTLE DOME!$
translation: {PLAYER}进入了对战巨蛋！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_PlayerVersusTrainer_hns
source: {STR_VAR_1}\nmatch!\p{PLAYER} versus {STR_VAR_2}!\pLet the battle begin!$
translation: {STR_VAR_1}！\p{PLAYER} 对战 {STR_VAR_2}！\p对战开始！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_PlayerIsWinner_hns
source: {PLAYER} is the winner!\nCongratulations!$
translation: {PLAYER}获胜了！\n恭喜！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_TrainerIsWinner_hns
source: {STR_VAR_2} is the winner!\nCongratulations!$
translation: {STR_VAR_2}获胜了！\n恭喜！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_PlayerIsLv50Champ_hns
source: {PLAYER} is the Level 50\nBattle Tournament Champion!\pCongratulations!$
translation: {PLAYER}成为了\n50级锦标赛的冠军！\p恭喜！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_PlayerIsLvOpenChamp_hns
source: {PLAYER} is the Open Level\nBattle Tournament Champion!\pCongratulations!$
translation: {PLAYER}成为了\n公开级别锦标赛的冠军！\p恭喜！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_RefereeDecisionPleaseWait_hns
source:
What an unbelievable finish!
We have a double knockout!\pIn this event, the Battle Tournament
rules call for a REFEREE'S decision.\pPlease wait while the judging
is under way.$
translation: 多么难以置信的结局！\n双方宝可梦同时倒下了！\p在这种情况下，根据锦标赛规则，\n将由裁判进行判定。\p请大家稍候，判定正在进行中。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_RefereesDecidedWinnerTrainer_hns
source: The REFEREES have reached\na decision!\pThe winner is…\nOh, my goodness!\lThe winner is {STR_VAR_1}!\lCongratulations!$
translation: 裁判们做出了判定！\p胜者是......\n噢，天哪！\l胜者是{STR_VAR_1}！\l恭喜！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_RefereesDecidedWinnerPlayer_hns
source: The REFEREES have reached\na decision!\pThe winner is…\nOh, my goodness!\lThe winner is {PLAYER}!\lCongratulations!$
translation: 裁判们做出了判定！\p胜者是......\n噢，天哪！\l胜者是{PLAYER}！\l恭喜！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_BrightNewHope_hns
source: The bright new hope!\p$
translation: 闪耀的新希望！\p$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_RisingStar_hns
source: The rising star!\p$
translation: 冉冉升起的新星！\p$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_WillTheyRaceToChampionship_hns
source: Will this TRAINER race to\nthe championship?\p$
translation: 这位训练家能否一路冲向冠军呢？\p$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_CanAchieveChampionFirstTry_hns
source: Can the feat of a championship\non the first try be achieved?\p$
translation: 初次登场就夺得冠军的壮举\n能否实现呢？\p$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_CanLossBeAvenged_hns
source: Can the loss of the last match\nbe avenged?\p$
translation: 上一场比赛的败绩\n能否在此雪耻呢？！\p$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_OnFireForChampionship_hns
source: The TRAINER is on fire for\nthe first championship try!\p$
translation: 迎战首次冠军争夺战，\n这位训练家斗志昂扬！\p$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_WinHereAdvancesToFinal_hns
source: A win here means this TRAINER\nadvances to the final!\p$
translation: 只要赢下这场比赛，\n这位训练家就将挺进决赛！\p$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_WillLongHeldDreamComeTrue_hns
source: Will the long-held dream of\na championship finally come true?\p$
translation: 梦寐以求的冠军梦想，\n终于要实现了吗？！\p$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_TheInvincibleChampion_hns
source: The invincible champion!\p$
translation: 所向披靡的常胜冠军！\p$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_CanAnyoneHopeToBeatTrainer_hns
source: Can anyone hope to beat this\nTRAINER?\p$
translation: 究竟有没有人能够\n击败这位训练家呢？！\p$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_DoBattlesExistSolelyForTrainer_hns
source: Do battles exist solely for\nthis TRAINER?\p$
translation: 对战难道只为了\n这位训练家而存在吗？！\p$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_CurrentChampAimingToRetainTitle_hns
source: The current champion aiming to\nretain the title!\p$
translation: 现任冠军志在卫冕！\p$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_FormerChampHasReturned_hns
source: The former champion has returned!\p$
translation: 前任冠军王者归来！\p$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_FormerToughnessReturned_hns
source: The former toughness has returned!\p$
translation: 曾经的强劲势头再次重现！\p$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_WillDoExpectedAdvanceToFinals_hns
source: Will this TRAINER do as expected\nand advance to the finals?\p$
translation: 这位训练家能否如众人所料\n顺利晋级决赛呢？！\p$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_WillFormerChampRegainGlory_hns
source: Will the former champ regain\nlost glory?\p$
translation: 前任冠军能否重夺\n往日的荣耀呢？！\p$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_FeelGlowOfTrueMaster_hns
source: Feel the glow of a true master!$
translation: 感受真正大师的光芒吧！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_MakeWayForDomeAceTucker_hns
source: And now… The TRAINER standing in\n{PLAYER}'s record-setting path…\pYes! The one and only!\nThe BATTLE DOME COMMISSIONER!\lOur very own DOME ACE!\lMake way for TUCKER!$
translation: 接下来......挡在\n{PLAYER}创纪录之路上的训练家是......\p没错！独一无二的！\n对战巨蛋的主宰！\l我们的巨蛋超级巨星！\l有请希尔斯闪亮登场！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_SpectatorTuckerChant_hns
source: Spectators: TUCKER! TUCKER!\nTUCKER! TUCKER! TUCKER!$
translation: 观众们：希尔斯！希尔斯！\n希尔斯！希尔斯！希尔斯！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_TuckerSilverIntro_hns
source:
TUCKER: Ahahah!\pDo you hear it? This crowd!
They're all itching to see our match!\pAhahah!\pI bet you're twitching all over from
the tension of getting to battle me!\pBut don't you worry about a thing!\pI'm the no. 1 star of the BATTLE DOME!
I, TUCKER the DOME ACE, will bathe you\lin my brilliant glow!$
translation:
希尔斯：啊哈哈！\p听到了吗？这欢呼声！
大家可都迫不及待想看我们的对决了！\p啊哈哈！\p能和我交手，
你一定紧张得浑身发抖了吧！\p不过，完全不用担心！\p我可是对战巨蛋的头号巨星！
我，巨蛋超级巨星希尔斯，\l将用耀眼的光芒将你彻底笼罩！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_LetsSeeYourStrategy_hns
source: Your strategy!\nLet's see it!$
translation: 你的战术！\n就让我见识一下吧！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_IncredibleVictorIsPlayer_hns
source: Unbelievable! It's incredible!\nThe victor is {PLAYER}!$
translation: 难以置信！太不可思议了！\n胜者是{PLAYER}！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_WinnerIsTucker_hns
source: The winner is TUCKER!\nThe DOME ACE has prevailed!\pCongratulations, TUCKER!$
translation: 胜者是希尔斯！\n巨蛋超级巨星大获全胜！\p恭喜你，希尔斯！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_SeeYourFrontierPass_hns
source: TUCKER: Rules are rules!\nLet me see your FRONTIER PASS.$
translation: 希尔斯：规矩就是规矩！\n把你的开拓区通行证拿出来吧。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_ReceivedTacticsSymbol_hns
source: The Tactics Symbol was embossed on\nthe FRONTIER PASS!$
translation: 战术象征被印在了\n开拓区通行证上！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_WontUnderestimateYouNextTime_hns
source: … … … … … …\pI sorely underestimated you. I won't\nmake the same mistake next time…$
translation: ..................\p我真是大大低估了你。下次\n我可不会再犯同样的错误了......$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_CanWinStreakBeStretched_hns
source: Can the win streak be stretched?\nThe confidence is there!$
translation: 连胜纪录能否继续延续？\n自信心已经满溢而出！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_LegendHasReturnedDomeAceTucker_hns
source:
Ladies and gentlemen!
Boys, girls, and POKéMON!\pFinally!
Finally, the legend has returned!\pYes, the name of that legend!
Our very own DOME ACE!\lIt's none other than TUCKER!$
translation:
女士们，先生们！
男孩们，女孩们，还有宝可梦们！\p终于！
传奇终于归来了！\p是的，那位传奇的名字！
我们引以为傲的巨蛋超级巨星！\l正是希尔斯！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_TuckerGoldIntro_hns
source:
TUCKER: Ah…
The pummeling roar of the crowd…\lTheir furnace-like heat of excitement…\lThis is a wonderful place…\pTo the crowd, I am the DOME ACE…
I represent their hopes and dreams…\lI must never fade from their sight…\pI must burn!
Brighter and more brilliant!\lI must light all that gather here!$
translation:
希尔斯：啊......
观众席震耳欲聋的咆哮......\l宛如熔炉般沸腾的热情......\l这里真是个美妙的地方......\p对大家来说，我就是巨蛋超级巨星......
我承载着他们的希望与梦想......\l我绝不能从他们的视线中褪色......\p我要燃烧！
更加耀眼、更加璀璨地燃烧！\l照亮聚集在这里的每一个人！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_UnleashAllPowerIPossess_hns
source: I will unleash all the power that\nI possess! Right here and now!$
translation: 我要在此刻释放出我所拥有的\n全部力量！就在此时，就在此地！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_NeverLostWhenPowerUnleashed_hns
source: TUCKER: You're genuinely fantastic!\pNever before! I haven't ever lost in the\ntimes I've had to unleash my power.\pYes, quite fantastic!\nYour FRONTIER PASS, please?$
translation: 达克希德：太精彩了！\p前所未有！在我拿出全部力量之后，\n还从来没有输过呢。\p是的，相当精彩！\n请出示你的开拓通行证。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_TacticsSymbolTookGoldenShine_hns
source: The Tactics Symbol took on\na golden shine!$
translation: 战术象征绽放出了\n金色的光芒！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_LookForwardToNextEncounter_hns
source:
You're strong, but above all,
you have a unique charm!\pIn you, I see a definite potential for
a superstar like me.\pI will very much look forward to
our next encounter!$
translation:
你很强，但更重要的是，
你拥有一种独特的魅力！\p从你身上，我看到了成为像我一样的
超级巨星的无限潜力。\p我非常期待
与你的下次相遇！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_PlayerIsLv50Champ_hns2_hns
source: {PLAYER} is the Level 50\nBattle Tournament Champion!\pCongratulations!$
translation: {PLAYER}成为了\n50级锦标赛的冠军！\p恭喜！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_PlayerIsLvOpenChamp_hns2_hns
source: {PLAYER} is the Open Level\nBattle Tournament Champion!\pCongratulations!$
translation: {PLAYER}成为了\n公开级别锦标赛的冠军！\p恭喜！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_PlayerVersusTucker_hns
source: The final match!\p{PLAYER} versus the DOME ACE, TUCKER!\pLet the battle begin!$
translation: 决赛开始！\p{PLAYER} 对战 巨蛋头目达克希德！\p对战开始！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_RefereesDecidedWinnerTucker_hns
source:
The REFEREES have reached
a decision!\pThe winner is…
Oh, my goodness!\lThe winner is our very own DOME ACE!\lIt's TUCKER!\pCongratulations! And thank you!
Let's hear it for the DOME ACE, TUCKER!$
translation: 裁判们做出了判定！\p胜者是......\n天哪！\l胜者正是我们的巨蛋头目！\l就是达克希德！\p恭喜！也非常感谢！\n让我们为巨蛋头目达克希德喝彩吧！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLvOpen
source: Excuse me!\pYou don't have three eligible POKéMON.\pAlso, the POKéMON must be holding\ndifferent kinds of items.\pEGGS{STR_VAR_1}.$
translation: 不好意思！\p您没有3只符合参赛资格的宝可梦。\p此外，宝可梦所携带的道具种类\n必须各不相同。\p蛋{STR_VAR_1}。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeLobby_Text_WelcomeSingleBattle_hns
source: Where the strategies of TRAINERS\nare put to the test!\pWelcome to the BATTLE DOME!\pI am your guide to the SINGLE BATTLE\nTournament.$
translation: 这里是考验训练家战略的舞台！\p欢迎来到对战巨蛋！\p我是单打锦标赛的引导人员。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeLobby_Text_TakeSinglesChallenge_hns
source: Would you like to challenge\nthe SINGLE BATTLE Tournament?$
translation: 您想要挑战\n单打锦标赛吗？$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeLobby_Text_HopeToSeeYouAgain_hns
source: We hope to see you again.$
translation: 期待您的再次光临。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeLobby_Text_ExplainSinglesChallenge_hns
source:
The SINGLE BATTLE Tournament
is exactly as the name suggests--\la tournament of SINGLE BATTLES.\pAll participating TRAINERS must
enter three POKéMON each.\pIn each battle, one of the three
POKéMON must be held in reserve.\pThe other two POKéMON can battle
one at a time.\pChoose the two battling POKéMON after
examining the opponent's trio.\pYou win the tournament by defeating
four TRAINERS.\pBattle Points are awarded to
the tournament winner.\pIf you want to interrupt your
tournament, please save the game.\pIf you don't save before interrupting,
you will be disqualified.$
translation:
单打锦标赛正如其名，
是一场单打对战的锦标赛。\p所有参赛的训练家
必须各自派出3只宝可梦。\p在每场对战中，必须将3只中的
1只宝可梦作为候补。\p另外2只宝可梦
将依次进行对战。\p在确认对手的3只宝可梦后，
再决定出场的2只宝可梦。\p击败4位训练家
即可赢得锦标赛。\p锦标赛的获胜者
将获得对战点数。\p如果您想中途暂停锦标赛，
请保存游戏记录。\p如果未保存记录就中断挑战，
您将被取消参赛资格。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeLobby_Text_OkayToSaveBeforeChallenge_hns
source: Before I show you to the BATTLE DOME,\nI must save the data. Is that okay?$
translation: 在带您前往对战巨蛋前，\n需要先保存记录。这样可以吗？$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeLobby_Text_WhichLevelMode_hns
source: The tournament offers two levels\nof challenge, Level 50 and Open Level.\lWhich is your choice?$
translation: 锦标赛分为50级和自由等级\n两个组别。\l您要选择哪一个？$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeLobby_Text_SelectThreeMons_hns
source: Now select the three POKéMON that\nyou wish to enter, please.$
translation: 那么请选择\n您想要参赛的3只宝可梦。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLvOpen_hns
source: Excuse me!\pYou don't have three eligible POKéMON.\pAlso, the POKéMON must be holding\ndifferent kinds of items.\pEGGS{STR_VAR_1}.$
translation: 不好意思！\p您没有3只符合参赛资格的宝可梦。\p此外，宝可梦所携带的道具种类\n必须各不相同。\p蛋{STR_VAR_1}。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsEnd_hns
source: Please come see me when you are ready.$
translation: 准备好之后请再来找我。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLv50_hns
source: Excuse me!\pYou don't have three eligible POKéMON.\pYou must have three different POKéMON\nof Level 50 or less to enter.\pThey also must be holding different\nkinds of items.\pEGGS{STR_VAR_1}.$
translation: 不好意思！\p您没有3只符合参赛资格的宝可梦。\p参赛必须拥有3只不同的、\n等级在50级以下的宝可梦。\p并且它们所携带的道具种类\n也必须各不相同。\p蛋{STR_VAR_1}。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeLobby_Text_ShowYouToBattleDome_hns
source: I will now show you to\nthe BATTLE DOME.$
translation: 我现在就带您前往\n对战巨蛋。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeLobby_Text_DidntSaveBeforeQuitting_hns
source: Excuse me!\pYou didn't save before you quit your\nchallenge last time.\pBecause of that, your challenge so far\nhas been disqualified. Sorry!$
translation: 不好意思！\p您上次结束挑战时没有保存记录。\p因此，您之前的挑战已被取消资格。\n非常抱歉！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeLobby_Text_CongratsForWinningTourney_hns
source: Congratulations for winning\nyour Battle Tournament!$
translation: 恭喜您赢得\n对战锦标赛！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeLobby_Text_HereIsYourPrize_hns
source: Here is your prize for your Battle\nTournament victory.$
translation: 这是您赢得对战锦标赛的奖品。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeLobby_Text_ReceivedPrize_hns
source: {PLAYER} received the prize\n{STR_VAR_1}.$
translation: {PLAYER}获得了奖品\n{STR_VAR_1}。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeLobby_Text_BagFullMakeRoom_hns
source: Oh, your BAG appears to be full.\pPlease make room in your BAG, then come\nsee me.$
translation: 哎呀，您的背包好像已经满了。\p请整理好背包腾出空间后，\n再来找我吧。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeLobby_Text_ThankYouForPlaying_hns
source: 感谢您的游玩！$
translation: 感谢您的游玩！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeLobby_Text_RecordWillBeSaved_hns
source: Your record will be saved.\nPlease wait.$
translation: 正在保存您的记录。\n请稍候。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeLobby_Text_WeveBeenWaitingForYou_hns
source: We've been waiting for you!$
translation: 我们恭候您多时了！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeLobby_Text_OkayToSaveBeforeChallenge_hns2_hns
source: Before I show you to the BATTLE DOME,\nI must save the data. Is that okay?$
translation: 在带您前往对战巨蛋前，\n需要先保存记录。这样可以吗？$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeLobby_Text_WelcomeDoubleBattle_hns
source: Where the strategies of TRAINERS\nare put to the test!\pWelcome to the BATTLE DOME!\pI am your guide to the DOUBLE BATTLE\nTournament.$
translation: 这里是考验训练家战略的舞台！\p欢迎来到对战巨蛋！\p我是双打锦标赛的引导人员。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeLobby_Text_TakeDoublesChallenge_hns
source: Would you like to challenge\nthe DOUBLE BATTLE Tournament?$
translation: 要挑战双打对战锦标赛吗？$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeLobby_Text_ExplainDoublesChallenge_hns
source:
The DOUBLE BATTLE Tournament
is exactly as the name suggests--\la tournament of DOUBLE BATTLES.\pAll participating TRAINERS must
enter three POKéMON each.\pIn each battle, one of the three
POKéMON must be held in reserve.\pThe remaining two POKéMON must take
part in a DOUBLE BATTLE.\pChoose the two battling POKéMON after
examining the opponent's trio.\pYou win the tournament by defeating
four TRAINERS.\pBattle Points are awarded to
the tournament winner.\pIf you want to interrupt your
tournament, please save the game.\pIf you don't save before interrupting,
you will be disqualified.$
translation:
双打对战锦标赛顾名思义，
就是以双打对战进行的锦标赛。\p所有参赛的训练家
必须各自派出3只宝可梦。\p在每场对战中，3只宝可梦中
必须有1只作为后备留在场下。\p剩下的2只宝可梦
将参加双打对战。\p在查看对手的3只宝可梦后，
选择出场的2只宝可梦。\p击败4位训练家
即可赢得锦标赛冠军。\p锦标赛冠军将获得对战点数奖励。\p如果想中途暂停锦标赛，
请保存游戏记录。\p若未保存就退出，
将会被取消参赛资格。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeLobby_Text_PrevTourneyResultsSinglesLv50_hns
source: They're the results of the last\nLevel 50 SINGLE BATTLE Tournament.$
translation: 这是上一届\n50级单打对战锦标赛的结果。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeLobby_Text_PrevTourneyResultsDoublesLv50_hns
source: They're the results of the last\nLevel 50 DOUBLE BATTLE Tournament.$
translation: 这是上一届\n50级双打对战锦标赛的结果。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeLobby_Text_PrevTourneyResultsSinglesLvOpen_hns
source: They're the results of the last\nOpen Level SINGLE BATTLE Tournament.$
translation: 这是上一届\n公开等级单打对战锦标赛的结果。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeLobby_Text_PrevTourneyResultsDoublesLvOpen_hns
source: They're the results of the last\nOpen Level DOUBLE BATTLE Tournament.$
translation: 这是上一届\n公开等级双打对战锦标赛的结果。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeLobby_Text_LastWinnerWasTough_hns
source:
Did you see it?
The last Battle Tournament?\pThe winner, {STR_VAR_1}, was seriously
tough.\pYou should check out the results
on the monitor beside the PC.$
translation: 你看了吗？\n上一届的对战锦标赛？\p冠军{STR_VAR_1}真的超强啊。\p你应该去电脑旁边的显示屏上\n看看比赛结果。$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_LongDreamedAboutBattleFrontier_hns
source: The BATTLE FRONTIER…\nI've long dreamed about a place like it.$
translation: 对战开拓区......\n我一直梦想着有这样一个地方。$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_BattleDomeSign2_hns
source: The BATTLE DOME\nBecome the Unbeatable Superstar!$
translation: 对战巨蛋\n成为战无不胜的超级巨星吧！$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_QuestionMarkUnderConstruction_hns
source: The ??????\nUnder Construction!$
translation: ？？？？？？\n正在施工中！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeLobby_Text_WinnersGainReputation_hns
source:
When a TRAINER chains tournament
wins at the BATTLE DOME, he or she\lgains a reputation as a star.\pTough TRAINERS are drawn by that
reputation to the BATTLE DOME.\pA true superstar is a TRAINER who
can keep winning tournaments.$
translation:
当训练家在对战巨蛋连续赢得
锦标赛冠军时，就会名声大噪成为明星。\p强劲的训练家会被那份名声
吸引到对战巨蛋来。\p真正的超级巨星，是能够
持续赢得锦标赛冠军的训练家。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeLobby_Text_TrashedInFirstRound_hns
source: I ran into one of the tournament\nfavorites in the very first round.\pOf course I got trashed…$
translation: 我在第一轮就碰上了夺冠大热门。\p结果当然是被打得落花流水......$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeLobby_Text_NeedToCheckOpponentCarefully_hns
source: I would've won if I'd kept this POKéMON\nheld in reserve.\pYou need to check your opponent's\nPOKéMON carefully before choosing\lyour battling POKéMON.$
translation: 要是当时我把这只宝可梦\n作为后备留着就好了。\p在选择出战的宝可梦之前，\n一定要仔细看清对手的宝可梦。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeLobby_Text_CongratsDefeatedTucker_hns
source: Congratulations!\pYou defeated the DOME ACE and won\nthe Battle Tournament!$
translation: 恭喜你！\p你战胜了巨蛋超级巨星，\n赢得了对战锦标赛的冠军！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeLobby_Text_AwardTheseBattlePoints_hns
source: In recognition of your strategy--\na thing of beauty it was, too--\lwe award you these Battle Point(s)!$
translation: 为了表彰你精彩绝伦的战术，\n特此授予你对战点数！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeLobby_Text_RecordLastMatch_hns
source: Would you like to record your\nlast BATTLE DOME match on your\lFRONTIER PASS?$
translation: 要将刚刚这场对战巨蛋的对战\n记录在开拓通行证上吗？$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeLobby_Text_RulesAreListed_hns
source: The Battle Tournament rules\nare listed.$
translation: 这里写着对战锦标赛的规则。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeLobby_Text_ReadWhichHeading_hns
source: Which heading do you want to read?$
translation: 想了解哪一项？$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeLobby_Text_ExplainMatchupRules_hns
source: The tournament matchups are drawn up\nbased on the toughness of POKéMON\lheld by TRAINERS.\pThe matchups avoid having tough\nTRAINERS face each other right away.$
translation: 锦标赛的对阵表是根据训练家\n所携带宝可梦的实力排定的。\p对阵表会避免让强劲的训练家\n在首轮就过早相遇。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeLobby_Text_ExplainTourneyTree_hns
source:
The tournament chart, or as we call it,
the “Tree,” is available for viewing\lin the Waiting Room from any guide.\pThe Tournament Tree will provide
several kinds of data.\pThe data on view includes the previous
tournament's results, the POKéMON held\lby TRAINERS, and the battle styles of\lTRAINERS.$
translation:
锦标赛对阵表，也就是我们说的"树状图"，
可以在候赛室找任意导览员查看。\p锦标赛对阵表会提供多种数据。\p可查看的数据包括上届锦标赛结果、
训练家携带的宝可梦以及
训练家的对战风格等。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeLobby_Text_ExplainDoubleKORules_hns
source: If battling POKéMON faint at the same\ntime--a double KO--in a tournament\lmatch, the REFEREES will review\lthe match and declare the winner.$
translation: 如果在锦标赛对战中，双方宝可梦\n同时倒下--即出现同归于尽的情况，\l裁判将对比赛进行裁决并宣布胜者。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomePreBattleRoom_Text_ReadyForRound1_hns
source: Your 1st-round match is next.\nAre you ready?$
translation: 接下来是你的第1轮对战。\n准备好了吗？$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomePreBattleRoom_Text_ReadyForRound2_hns
source: Your 2nd-round match is next.\nAre you ready?$
translation: 接下来是你的第2轮对战。\n准备好了吗？$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomePreBattleRoom_Text_ReadyForSemifinals_hns
source: Your semifinal match is next.\nAre you ready?$
translation: 接下来是你的半决赛对战。\n准备好了吗？$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomePreBattleRoom_Text_ReadyForFinals_hns
source: Your final match is next.\nAre you ready?$
translation: 接下来是你的决赛对战。\n准备好了吗？$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomePreBattleRoom_Text_ChooseTwoMons_hns
source: Please choose the two POKéMON\nthat are to appear in battle.$
translation: 请选择出场对战的\n2只宝可梦。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomePreBattleRoom_Text_RightThisWay_hns
source: Right this way, please.$
translation: 请往这边走。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomePreBattleRoom_Text_RestoreMonsToFullHealth_hns
source: Thank you for competing!\pI'll restore your POKéMON to\nfull health.$
translation: 辛苦了！\p现在为您的宝可梦\n恢复全部活力。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomePreBattleRoom_Text_Round1Complete_hns
source: All 1st-round matches have been\ncompleted.\pThese are the teams that advanced!$
translation: 第1轮的所有比赛已全部结束。\p晋级的选手是这几组！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomePreBattleRoom_Text_Round2Complete_hns
source: All 2nd-round matches have been\ncompleted.\pThese are the teams that advanced!$
translation: 第2轮的所有比赛已全部结束。\p晋级的选手是这几组！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomePreBattleRoom_Text_SemifinalsComplete_hns
source: All semifinal matches have been\ncompleted.\pThese are the teams that advanced!$
translation: 半决赛的所有比赛已全部结束。\p晋级的选手是这几组！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomePreBattleRoom_Text_CongratsReadyForRound2_hns
source: Congratulations for getting through\nthe 1st round.\pThe 2nd round is next.\nAre you ready?$
translation: 恭喜通过第1轮。\p接下来是第2轮比赛。\n准备好了吗？$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomePreBattleRoom_Text_CongratsReadyForSemifinals_hns
source: Congratulations for advancing\nto the semifinals.\pThe best four teams meet in this round.\nAre you ready?$
translation: 恭喜晋级半决赛。\p本轮将进行4强选手的角逐。\n准备好了吗？$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomePreBattleRoom_Text_CongratsReadyForFinals_hns
source: Congratulations for advancing\nto the final match.\pYou're one win from the championship.\nAre you ready?$
translation: 恭喜晋级决赛。\p距离冠军只差最后1胜。\n准备好了吗？$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomePreBattleRoom_Text_PlayersNextOpponentIsTrainer_hns
source: {PLAYER}'s next opponent\nis this TRAINER.$
translation: {PLAYER}选手的下一位对手\n是这位训练家。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomePreBattleRoom_Text_TourneyInRound1_hns
source: The tournament is in the 1st round.$
translation: 锦标赛目前正在进行第1轮。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomePreBattleRoom_Text_TourneyInRound2_hns
source: The tournament is in the 2nd round.$
translation: 锦标赛目前正在进行第2轮。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomePreBattleRoom_Text_TourneyInSemifinals_hns
source: The tournament is in the semifinals.$
translation: 锦标赛目前正在进行半决赛。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomePreBattleRoom_Text_TourneyInFinals_hns
source: The tournament is up to the final.$
translation: 锦标赛目前已进行到决赛。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomePreBattleRoom_Text_SaveAndQuitGame_hns
source: Would you like to save and\nquit the game?$
translation: 要保存记录并\n结束游戏吗？$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomePreBattleRoom_Text_RetireYourChallenge_hns
source: Would you like to retire from your\nBattle Tournament challenge?$
translation: 要放弃对战锦标赛的挑战吗？$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomePreBattleRoom_Text_SavingDataPleaseWait_hns
source: I am saving your data.\nPlease wait.$
translation: 正在保存记录。\n请稍候。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomePreBattleRoom_Text_RecordLastMatch_hns
source: Should I record your last match\non your FRONTIER PASS?$
translation: 要将刚才的比赛\n记录在开拓区通行证上吗？$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomePreBattleRoom_Text_ReadyForTuckerSilver_hns
source: Congratulations for advancing\nto the final match.\pFor the final match, you will challenge\nthe DOME ACE TUCKER.\pAre you ready?$
translation: 恭喜晋级决赛。\p在决赛中，您将挑战\n巨蛋超级巨星希尔斯。\p准备好了吗？$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomePreBattleRoom_Text_ReadyForTuckerGold_hns
source: Congratulations for advancing\nto the final match.\pFor the final match, you will challenge\nthe DOME ACE TUCKER.\pAre you ready?$
translation: 恭喜晋级决赛。\p在决赛中，您将挑战\n巨蛋超级巨星希尔斯。\p准备好了吗？$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomePreBattleRoom_Text_ReadyForTuckerSilver_hnsShort_hns
source: Your final battle against TUCKER is\nnext. Are you ready?$
translation: 接下来就是与希尔斯的决赛。\n准备好了吗？$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomePreBattleRoom_Text_ReadyForTuckerGold_hnsShort_hns
source: Your final battle against TUCKER is\nnext. Are you ready?$
translation: 接下来就是与希尔斯的决赛。\n准备好了吗？$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryBattleRoom_Text_GetAMoveOn_hns
source: Hey, hey!\nGet a move on!$
translation: 喂、喂！\n动作快点！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryBattleRoom_Text_NolandImFactoryHead_hns
source:
Hey, my name's NOLAND!
I'm basically in charge of this place,\lwhich is why I'm the FACTORY HEAD!\pI had a look at your Battle Swap data.\pYou seem to have the right idea,
but you're still square in your head!\pListen up, okay? Knowledge isn't only
about reading books or doing desk work.\pJust doing that sort of thing…
It may as well be useless!\pYou have to experience things with
your heart and your body, understand?\pI'll take you on under the same
conditions as you.\pI'll be using rental POKéMON, too!$
translation:
嘿，我叫达拉！
基本上这里由我管辖，\l所以我是这里的工厂头目！\p我看过你的交换对战记录了。\p虽然能看出你的思路，
但你的脑子还是太死板了！\p听好了，懂吗？知识可不光是
看书或是死做案头工作。\p光做那些事情......
根本就毫无用处！\p你得用心和身体去亲身体会，明白吗？\p我和你一样，在相同的条件下跟你对决。\p我也会使用租借的宝可梦！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryBattleRoom_Text_ShakeOutKnowledgeBringItOn_hns
source: Shake out every last bit of your\nknowledge and bring it on!$
translation: 把你所有的知识都抖落出来，\n尽管放马过来吧！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryBattleRoom_Text_NolandLetsSeeFrontierPass_hns
source: NOLAND: Smart going!\nLet's see your FRONTIER PASS.$
translation: 达拉：干得漂亮！\n把你的开拓区通行证拿出来看看。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryBattleRoom_Text_ReceivedKnowledgeSymbol_hns
source: The Knowledge Symbol was embossed\non the FRONTIER PASS!$
translation: 知识象征被刻在了\n开拓区通行证上！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryBattleRoom_Text_NextTimeNoHoldsBarred_hns
source: Heh…\nYou're a pretty bright spark…\pNext time, I'll come after you hard.\nNo holds barred, understand?\pYou keep up your studies!$
translation: 嘿......\n你这小子还挺机灵的嘛......\p下次我可要动真格的了。\n绝不留情，懂吗？\p你可要好好保持钻研啊！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryBattleRoom_Text_HarderLookThanLastTime_hns
source:
NOLAND: Hey, hey! How's it going?
You keeping up with your studies?\p…Oh?\pYou've taken on a harder look than
the last time I saw you.\pNow, this should be fun!
I'm getting excited, hey!$
translation:
达拉：喂，喂！最近怎么样？
有在好好钻研吗？\p......哦？\p看起来比上次见你时
还要精悍成熟了呢。\p这下可有意思了！
我都开始兴奋起来了，喂！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryBattleRoom_Text_AllRightBringItOn_hns
source: All right!\nBring it on!$
translation: 好嘞！\n放马过来吧！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryBattleRoom_Text_OutOfMyLeagueLetsSeePass_hns
source: NOLAND: What the…\nYou're getting out of my league!\pSheesh!\nLet's see that FRONTIER PASS!$
translation: 达拉：搞什么......\n你已经远远超出我的水平了啊！\p真是的！\n把开拓通行证拿来让我看看！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryBattleRoom_Text_KnowledgeSymbolTookGoldenShine_hns
source: The Knowledge Symbol took on\na golden shine!$
translation: 知识象征闪耀起\n金色的光芒！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryBattleRoom_Text_LastTimeILoseToYou_hns
source: Pfft, man!\pThat's absolutely the last time\nI lose to you!\pWe have to do this again, hey?$
translation: 切，真是的！\p我保证这是我最后一次\n输给你了！\p我们一定要再战一场啊，喂！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_DidntSaveBeforeQuitting
source: I'm sorry to say this, but you didn't\nsave before you quit playing last time.\pAs a result, you have been disqualified\nfrom your challenge.$
translation: 非常遗憾，您上次在退出游戏前\n没有保存记录。\p因此，您本次的挑战\n已被判定为取消资格。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_WelcomeForSingleBattle_hns
source: Where the intelligence of TRAINERS\nis put to the test!\pWelcome to the BATTLE FACTORY!\pI am your guide to the Battle Swap\nSingle Tournament.$
translation: 考验训练家智慧的地方！\p欢迎来到对战工厂！\p我是单打交换战赛事的引导员。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_TakeSinglesChallenge_hns
source: Would you like to take the Battle\nSwap Single challenge?$
translation: 您要挑战单打交换战吗？$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_ExplainSinglesChallenge_hns
source:
The Battle Swap Single Tournament
is a SINGLE BATTLE competition using\lonly rental POKéMON.\pFirst, you will be loaned three
POKéMON specifically for this event.\pUsing the supplied rental POKéMON,
you must conduct a SINGLE BATTLE.\pIf you win, you are permitted to trade
one of your rental POKéMON.\pRepeat this cycle of battling and
trading--if you win seven times in\la row, you will earn Battle Points.\pIf you want to interrupt your
challenge, please save the game.\pIf you don't save, you will be
disqualified from your challenge.$
translation:
单打交换战是一项
仅使用租借宝可梦进行的单打对战比赛。\p首先，我们会为本次比赛
借给您3只宝可梦。\p您需要使用租借来的宝可梦
来进行单打对战。\p获胜后，您可以更换
其中的1只租借宝可梦。\p重复进行对战与更换--如果能连胜7场，
就能赢得对战点数。\p若想中断挑战，请保存记录。\p如果没有保存，
挑战资格将会被取消。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_LookForwardToNextVisit_hns
source: We look forward to your next visit.$
translation: 期待您的下次光临。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_WhichLevelMode_hns
source: Which level do you wish to challenge?\nLevel 50 or Open Level?$
translation: 您想挑战哪个级别的比赛？\n50级还是公开等级？$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_OkayToSaveBeforeChallenge_hns
source: Before you begin your challenge,\nI need to save the game. Is that okay?$
translation: 在开始挑战前，\n需要保存记录。这样可以吗？$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_WillHoldMonsForSafekeeping_hns
source: Okay, I will hold your POKéMON for\nsafekeeping while you compete.$
translation: 好的，在您比赛期间，\n您的宝可梦将由我们代为保管。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_StepThisWay_hns
source: 这边请。$
translation: 这边请。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_ReturnMons_hnsSaveResults_hns
source: Thank you for participating!\pI will return your POKéMON in exchange\nfor our rental POKéMON.\pI must also save the event results.\nPlease wait.$
translation: 感谢您的参与！\p现在回收租借宝可梦，\n并将您寄放的宝可梦归还给您。\p接下来需要保存比赛结果，\n请稍候。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_ReturnMons_hns
source: I will return your POKéMON in exchange\nfor our rental POKéMON.$
translation: 现在回收租借宝可梦，\n并将您寄放的宝可梦归还给您。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_CongratsSevenWins_hns
source: Congratulations! You've won seven\nstraight Battle Swap matches!$
translation: 恭喜！您已经在交换战中\n获得了7连胜！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_AwardBattlePoints_hnsForStreak_hns
source: In recognition of your 7-win streak,\nwe award you these Battle Point(s).$
translation: 为了表彰您的7连胜，\n特此奖励您对战点数。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_MaxBattlePoints_hns
source: Oh, oh, oh!\pYour Battle Points are maxed.\pPlease come back after using\nsome Battle Points.$
translation: 哎呀呀！\p您的对战点数已经达到上限了。\p请在消费一些对战点数后\n再来领取吧。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_WaitingForYouToResume_hns
source: We've been waiting for you!\pBefore we resume your challenge,\nI must save the game.$
translation: 我们一直在恭候您！\p在继续挑战之前，\n我需要为您保存记录。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_DidntSaveBeforeQuitting_hns
source: I'm sorry to say this, but you didn't\nsave before you quit playing last time.\pAs a result, you have been disqualified\nfrom your challenge.$
translation: 非常遗憾，您上次在退出游戏前\n没有保存记录。\p因此，您本次的挑战\n已被判定为取消资格。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_WellReturnMons_hns
source: We'll return your personal POKéMON.$
translation: 这就归还您寄放的宝可梦。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_ReceivedPrizeItem_hns
source: {PLAYER} received the prize\n{STR_VAR_1}.$
translation: {PLAYER}获得了奖品\n{STR_VAR_1}。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_WelcomeForDoubleBattle_hns
source: Where the intelligence of TRAINERS\nis put to the test!\pWelcome to the BATTLE FACTORY!\pI am your guide to the Battle Swap\nDouble Tournament.$
translation: 考验训练家智慧的地方！\p欢迎来到对战工厂！\p我是双打交换战赛事的引导员。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_TakeDoublesChallenge_hns
source: Would you like to take the Battle\nSwap Double challenge?$
translation: 您要挑战双打交换战吗？$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_ExplainDoublesChallenge_hns
source:
The Battle Swap Double Tournament
is a DOUBLE BATTLE competition using\lonly rental POKéMON.\pFirst, you will be loaned three
POKéMON specifically for this event.\pUsing the supplied rental POKéMON,
you must conduct a DOUBLE BATTLE.\pIf you win, you are permitted to trade
one of your rental POKéMON.\pRepeat this cycle of battling and
trading--if you win seven times in\la row, you will earn Battle Points.\pIf you want to interrupt your
challenge, please save the game.\pIf you don't save before interrupting,
you will be disqualified.$
translation:
双打交换战是一项
仅使用租借宝可梦进行双打对战的比赛。\p首先，我们会为本次比赛
借给您3只宝可梦。\p您需要使用租借来的宝可梦
来进行双打对战。\p获胜后，您可以更换
其中的1只租借宝可梦。\p重复进行对战与更换--如果能连胜7场，
就能赢得对战点数。\p若想中断挑战，请保存记录。\p如果没有保存就中断，
挑战资格将会被取消。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_CongratsForDefeatingHead_hns
source: Congratulations for defeating\nthe FACTORY HEAD and winning\lseven matches in a row!$
translation: 恭喜您战胜工厂头目，\n并达成了7连胜！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_AwardBattlePoints_hns
source: In recognition of your wealth of\nknowledge and keen intelligence,\lwe award you these Battle Point(s).$
translation: 为了表彰你丰富的知识\n与敏锐的智慧，\l特此授予你这些对战点数。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_ExchangeMonsAndSave_hns
source: Let me exchange your POKéMON\nfor our rental POKéMON.\pI need to save the battle data,\nso please wait.$
translation: 现在将用租借宝可梦\n换回你的宝可梦。\p需要保存对战数据，\n请稍候。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_RecordLastMatch_hns
source: Would you like to record your last\nBATTLE FACTORY match on your\lFRONTIER PASS?$
translation: 要把刚才对战工厂的\n比赛记录在\l开拓通行证上吗？$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_NeedKnowledgeOfMonsMoves_hns
source:
Hi!
You, there!\pAre you thinking that the events here
are easy since you don't need to have\la raised team of POKéMON?\pI wouldn't be too sure about winning
that easily.\pIf you don't have thorough knowledge
about POKéMON and their moves,\lit will be tough to keep winning.$
translation:
嗨！
那边那位！\p你是不是觉得这里不需要
自己培育宝可梦，\l挑战起来就很轻松？\p想要赢可没那么容易哦。\p要是对宝可梦和招式
没有彻底的了解，\l是很难一路赢下去的。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_SwappedForWeakMon_hns
source: I swapped for a weak POKéMON…\nI thought it was a good kind to have…\pThey wiped the floor with us…$
translation: 我换了只很弱的宝可梦......\n我本来还以为它很强呢......\p结果被打得落花流水......$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_NeedToCheckOpponentsMons_hns
source: Things haven't been going my way\nat all.\pYou need to check your opponent's\nPOKéMON during battle to see if\lthey're any good.$
translation: 事情完全没按我的设想发展。\p你必须在对战中观察\n对手的宝可梦，\l看看它们到底强不强。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_CantFigureOutStaffHints_hns
source: You know how the staff here give you\na few hints about your next opponent?\pWell, I'm a full-grown man, but I have\ntrouble figuring out their hints.$
translation: 你知道这里的工作人员会给你\n一些关于下一位对手的提示吧？\p哎，虽然我是个成年人了，\n但还是很难参透他们的提示。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_RentalMonsAreVaried_hns
source: Like, I'm really tough, but I get bored\nreally easily, so I just kept swapping\land battling over and over.\pSo anyway, when I kept entering\nBattle Swap events, I noticed they\lvaried the rental POKéMON.$
translation: 我很强，但我很容易觉得无聊，\n所以就一直不停地交换并对战。\p然后呢，在不断参加\n交换对战的过程中，我发现\l他们提供的租借宝可梦变了。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_RulesAreListed_hns
source: The Battle Swap rules are listed.$
translation: 上面写着交换对战的规则。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_ReadWhichHeading_hns
source: Which heading do you want to read?$
translation: 想了解哪一项？$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_ExplainBasicRules_hns
source: In a Battle Swap event, you may use\nonly three POKéMON.\pWhether you are renting or swapping,\nyour team may not have two or more\lof the same POKéMON.$
translation:
在交换对战中，
你只能使用3只宝可梦。\p无论是租借还是交换，
队伍中都不能有2只或以上
相同的宝可梦。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_ExplainSwapPartnerRules_hns
source: You may swap POKéMON only with\nthe TRAINER you have just defeated.\pYou may swap for only those POKéMON\nused by the beaten TRAINER.$
translation: 你只能与刚刚击败的\n训练家交换宝可梦。\p而且只能交换\n被击败的训练家所使用的宝可梦。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_ExplainSwapNumberRules_hns
source: After every battle you win, you may\nswap for one of your defeated\lopponent's POKéMON.\pYou will not be able to swap POKéMON\nwith the seventh TRAINER in the event.$
translation: 每赢得一场对战，你都可以\n换来被击败的对手的1只宝可梦。\p不过，你无法与\n第7位训练家交换宝可梦。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_ExplainSwapNotesRules_hns
source:
There are two key points to be aware
of when swapping POKéMON.\pFirst, when swapping, you can't check
the stats of the POKéMON you are\labout to receive.\pSecond, the POKéMON on your team
are lined up in sequence, depending on\lthe order in which you rented them.\pThis sequence remains unchanged
even when swaps are made.$
translation:
交换宝可梦时
有2个关键点需要注意。\p第一，交换时你无法查看
即将换来的宝可梦的能力。\p第二，你队伍中的宝可梦
是按照你租借它们的顺序排列的。\p即使进行了交换，
这个顺序也不会改变。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_ExplainOpenLvRules_hns
source: In the Open Level, the rental POKéMON\nand the opposing TRAINERS' POKéMON\lare all Level 100.$
translation: 在自由等级中，租借宝可梦\n和对手训练家的宝可梦\n等级全部都是100级。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryPreBattleRoom_Text_HoldMonsChooseFromSelection_hns
source: First, we will hold your POKéMON for\nsafekeeping.\pYou may then choose from our\nselection of POKéMON.$
translation: 首先，我们将暂时保管\n你的宝可梦。\p然后，请从我们准备的宝可梦中\n挑选你要租借的宝可梦。$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryPreBattleRoom_Text_LetUsRestoreMons_hns
source: Thank you for competing!\nLet us restore your POKéMON!$
translation: 辛苦了！\n这就为你的宝可梦进行回复！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryPreBattleRoom_Text_ReadyFor2ndOpponent_hns
source: The 2nd match is next!\nAre you ready?$
translation: 接下来是第2场对战！\n准备好了吗？$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryPreBattleRoom_Text_ReadyFor3rdOpponent_hns
source: The 3rd match is next!\nAre you ready?$
translation: 接下来是第3场对战！\n准备好了吗？$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryPreBattleRoom_Text_ReadyFor4thOpponent_hns
source: The 4th match is next!\nAre you ready?$
translation: 接下来是第4场对战！\n准备好了吗？$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryPreBattleRoom_Text_ReadyFor5thOpponent_hns
source: The 5th match is next!\nAre you ready?$
translation: 接下来是第5场对战！\n准备好了吗？$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryPreBattleRoom_Text_ReadyFor6thOpponent_hns
source: The 6th match is next!\nAre you ready?$
translation: 接下来是第6场对战！\n准备好了吗？$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryPreBattleRoom_Text_ReadyFor7thOpponent_hns
source: Finally, the 7th match is next!\nAre you ready?$
translation: 终于要迎来第7场对战了！\n准备好了吗？$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryPreBattleRoom_Text_SaveAndQuitGame_hns
source: Would you like to save and quit\nthe game?$
translation: 要保存并结束游戏吗？$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryPreBattleRoom_Text_RetireFromChallenge_hns
source: Would you like to retire from your\nBattle Swap challenge?$
translation: 要放弃本次\n交换对战的挑战吗？$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryPreBattleRoom_Text_InvestigatedUpcomingOpponent_hns
source: I've conducted a little investigation\nabout your upcoming opponent.$
