source: one {STR_VAR_2} with {STR_VAR_1}!\pSweet, huh?\nIt'd be sweet to form a team, too!$
translation: 一只学会了{STR_VAR_1}的{STR_VAR_2}！\p很棒吧？\n要是能组个队就更棒了！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerMultiPartnerRoom_Text_SwimmerMAccept_hns
source: Much obliged!\nI'll get this registration thing done!$
translation: 非常感谢！\n我这就去把登记办妥！$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerMultiPartnerRoom_Text_SwimmerMReject_hns
source: If we meet again, you have to team up\nwith me. You'll do that, right?$
translation: 如果下次再遇到，你可得和我组队。\n会和我组队的，对吧？$

label: BattleFrontier_ExchangeServiceCorner_Text_WelcomePleaseChoosePrize_hns
source: Hello, this is the EXCHANGE SERVICE\nCORNER.\pWe exchange the Battle Points you\nhave collected for lovely prizes.\pPlease choose a prize from this list.$
translation: 你好，这里是兑换服务处。\p我们可以将您收集的对战点数\n兑换成精美的奖品。\p请从这张清单中选择奖品。$

label: BattleFrontier_ExchangeServiceCorner_Text_WishIHadAllDolls_hns
source: Oh, they're so nice!\nI wish I had them!\lCute cushions!\lBig plush DOLLS!\lLittle plush DOLLS!\lI wish I had them all!$
translation: 哇，它们太棒了！\n真想全部拥有！\l可爱的靠垫！\l大毛绒玩偶！\l小毛绒玩偶！\l真希望我能全部带回家！$

label: BattleFrontier_ExchangeServiceCorner_Text_GetYouAnythingYouWant_hns
source: Leave it to your mommy!\pIf it's anything you want, I'll go\nthrough anything to get it, honey!$
translation: 包在妈妈身上！\p只要是宝贝想要的，无论怎样\n妈妈都会给你弄到手的！$

label: BattleFrontier_ExchangeServiceCorner_Text_ItemsWillGetMonTougher_hns
source: If I can get hold of the items here,\nmy POKéMON will get tougher.\pYou bet they will!\nNo question about it!$
translation: 只要能拿到这里的道具，\n我的宝可梦就会变得更强。\p绝对会变强！\n毫无疑问！$

label: BattleFrontier_ExchangeServiceCorner_Text_GoGetYourOwnDoll_hns
source:
Hah?
What are you gawking at?\pI don't like you staring at my plush
doll like that.\pIf you want it, go get one yourself!
Isn't that right, SMOOCHUM?$
translation: 哈？\n你发什么呆地看着我？\p我很讨厌你那样盯着我的毛绒玩偶看。\p想要的话，自己去拿一个啊！\n对吧，迷唇娃？$

label: BattleFrontier_ExchangeServiceCorner_Text_MoreBattlePointsForRecord_hns
source: Did you know?\pIf you stretch your record at any of\nthe BATTLE facilities, they start\lgiving you more and more Battle Points.$
translation: 你知道吗？\p只要在任何对战设施里连胜延长纪录，\n他们给你的对战点数就会越来越多。$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge1_Text_PokemonBreederIntro_hns
source:
For 70 years I have raised POKéMON!
I am the man they revere as\lthe legendary top POKéMON BREEDER!\pIf you ever become as seasoned as me,
you'll see the abilities of POKéMON\lat a glance.\pYou're a TRAINER. Doesn't it interest
you to know your own POKéMON's\labilities?\pHere!
Let's have a look at your POKéMON!$
translation:
我培育宝可梦已有70年！
我就是人们尊称为\l传说的顶级宝可梦培育家的人！\p只要到了我这个资历，
一眼就能看穿宝可梦的能力。\p你也是个训练家，难道不想知道
自己的宝可梦的能力吗？\p来吧！
让我看看你的宝可梦！$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge1_Text_AverageAbility_hns
source: …Hmm…\pThis one, overall, I would describe\nas being of average ability.$
translation: ......唔......\p这只总体来看，\n能力的评价算是比较普通。$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge1_Text_BetterThanAverageAbility_hns
source: …Hmm…\pThis one, overall, I would describe as\nhaving better-than-average ability.$
translation: ......唔......\p这只总体来看，\n能力的评价算是相当不错。$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge1_Text_ImpressiveAbility_hns
source: …Hmm…\pThis one, overall, I would say is\nquite impressive in ability!$
translation: ......唔......\p这只总体来看，\n拥有相当出色的能力！$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge1_Text_OutstandingAbility_hns
source: …Hmm…\pThis one, overall, I would say is\nwonderfully outstanding in ability!$
translation: ......唔......\p这只总体来看，\n拥有非常了不起的卓越能力！$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge1_Text_BestAspectHP_hns
source: Incidentally, the best aspect of it,\nI would say, is its HP…$
translation: 顺便一提，我觉得它最优秀的方面\n应该是HP......$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge1_Text_BestAspectAtk_hns
source: Incidentally, the best aspect of it,\nI would say, is its ATTACK…$
translation: 顺便一提，我觉得它最优秀的方面\n应该是攻击......$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge1_Text_BestAspectDef_hns
source: Incidentally, the best aspect of it,\nI would say, is its DEFENSE…$
translation: 顺便一提，我觉得它最优秀的方面\n应该是防御......$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge1_Text_BestAspectSpAtk_hns
source: Incidentally, the best aspect of it,\nI would say, is its SPECIAL ATTACK…$
translation: 顺便一提，我觉得它最优秀的方面\n应该是特攻......$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge1_Text_BestAspectSpDef_hns
source: Incidentally, the best aspect of it,\nI would say, is its SPECIAL DEFENSE…$
translation: 顺便一提，我觉得它最优秀的方面\n应该是特防......$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge1_Text_BestAspectSpeed_hns
source: Incidentally, the best aspect of it,\nI would say, is its SPEED…$
translation: 顺便一提，我觉得它最优秀的方面\n应该是速度......$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge1_Text_StatRelativelyGood_hns
source: That stat is relatively good.\n…Hm… That's how I call it.$
translation: 这项能力挺不错的。\n......嗯......我是这么认为的。$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge1_Text_StatImpressive_hns
source: That stat is quite impressive.\n…Hm… That's how I call it.$
translation: 这项能力相当出色。\n......嗯......我是这么认为的。$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge1_Text_StatOutstanding_hns
source: That stat is outstanding!\n…Hm… That's how I call it.$
translation: 这项能力极其优秀！\n......嗯......我是这么认为的。$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge1_Text_StatFlawless_hns
source: It's flawless! A thing of perfection!\n…Hm… That's how I call it.$
translation: 简直无可挑剔！完美无瑕！\n......嗯......我是这么认为的。$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge1_Text_NoTimeForMyAdvice_hns
source: What?\nYou have no time for my advice?\pYou should always be eager to learn\nfrom the experiences of your elders!$
translation: 什么？\n你没时间听我的建议？\p你应该时刻虚心地向长辈学习经验才对！$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge1_Text_HaveBusinessNeedsTending_hns
source: Yes, what is it now?\pI have business that needs tending!\nSave it for next time!$
translation: 怎么，现在又有什么事？\p我手头还有正经事要忙呢！\n留到下次再说吧！$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge1_Text_LetsLookAtYourPokemon_hns
source: Ah, youngster! Do your POKéMON's\nabilities intrigue you?\pHere, here!\nLet's have a look at your POKéMON!$
translation: 啊，年轻人！对宝可梦的\n能力感兴趣了吗？\p来来来！\n让我看看你的宝可梦！$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge1_Text_EvenICantTell_hns
source: An expert I am, but even I can't tell\nanything about an unhatched POKéMON!\pShow me a POKéMON!\nA POKéMON is what I need to see!$
translation: 我虽然是专家，但还没孵化的宝可梦我可看不出来！\p快拿宝可梦给我看！\n我要看的是宝可梦！$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge1_Text_SaidMyMonIsOutstanding_hns
source: He said my POKéMON is outstanding!\nI'm glad I raised it carefully!$
translation: 他说我的宝可梦非常优秀！\n真高兴我平时悉心培育了它！$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge1_Text_DidntDoAnythingSpecialRaisingIt_hns
source: He said my POKéMON is outstanding!\nBut I didn't do anything special\lraising it…$
translation: 他说我的宝可梦非常优秀！\n但我其实并没有特意\l做过什么培育啊......$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_FrontierManiacIntro_hns
source:
Howdy! When it comes to news about
the BATTLE FRONTIER, I'm no. 1.\pYou can think of me as
the FRONTIER MANIAC.\pJust checking, but you are a TRAINER,
isn't that right?\pI'll happily share the hottest news
I gathered about the BATTLE FRONTIER.$
translation:
你好！说到关于对战开拓区的情报，
我可是首屈一指的。\p你可以称呼我为
开拓区狂人。\p顺便确认一下，
你也是训练家对吧？\p我很乐意和你分享
我收集到的对战开拓区最新情报。$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_SwingByForTheLatestWord_hns
source: Howdy! Did you swing by to grill me\nabout the latest word? Oh, all right!$
translation: 你好！你是顺道过来向我打听\n最新消息的吗？好吧，没问题！$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_MyInformationsBeenUsefulRight_hns
source: Well? Well? Well?\pI'm sure my information's been\nseriously useful to you, right?$
translation: 怎么样？怎么样？怎么样？\p我的情报对你\n肯定超级有帮助吧？$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_FacilityIsHottest_hns
source: Let's see now…\pIt sounds like the {STR_VAR_1}\nis the hottest place going.$
translation: 让我想想......\p听起来现在最热门的设施\n是{STR_VAR_1}。$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_BattleTowerIsHottest_hns
source: Let's see now…\pIt sounds like BATTLE TOWER\n{STR_VAR_1} is the hottest.$
translation: 让我想想......\p听起来对战塔的\n{STR_VAR_1}最受瞩目。$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_SalonMaidenIsThere_hns
source: Bet you didn't know this!\pOne of those top TRAINERS that SCOTT\ncalls the FRONTIER BRAINS is there.\pIt's this mysterious TRAINER called\nthe SALON MAIDEN that runs the place.$
translation: 你一定不知道这个吧！\p被亚希达先生称为开拓之脑的\n顶尖训练家就在那里。\p掌管那里的，是被称为\n大君的神秘训练家。$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_SalonMaidenSilverMons_hns
source: Have you battled the SALON MAIDEN?\pWhen she's measuring up her opponent,\nshe apparently uses these POKéMON:\pA PSYCHIC-type PSI POKéMON,\na FIRE-type VOLCANO POKéMON,\land a NORMAL-type SLEEPING POKéMON.$
translation: 你和大君交过手了吗？\p她在试探对手实力时，\n据说会使用这几只宝可梦：\p超能力属性的念力宝可梦、\n火属性的火山宝可梦，\l以及一般属性的瞌睡宝可梦。$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_SalonMaidenGoldMons_hns
source:
Have you battled the SALON MAIDEN
when she's serious?\pWhen she's battling flat out,
she apparently uses these POKéMON:\pA DRAGON & PSYCHIC EON POKéMON,
an ELECTRIC-type THUNDER POKéMON,\land a NORMAL-type SLEEPING POKéMON.$
translation: 你和大君认真对战过了吗？\p当她全力以赴战斗时，\n据说会使用这几只宝可梦：\p龙与超能力属性的无限宝可梦、\n电属性的雷电宝可梦，\l以及一般属性的瞌睡宝可梦。$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_DomeAceIsThere_hns
source: Bet you didn't know this!\pOne of those top TRAINERS that SCOTT\ncalls the FRONTIER BRAINS is there.\pIt's this flamboyant TRAINER called\nthe DOME ACE that runs the place.$
translation: 你一定不知道这个吧！\p被亚希达先生称为开拓之脑的\n顶尖训练家就在那里。\p掌管那里的，是被称为\n超巨星的华丽训练家。$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_DomeAceSilverMons_hns
source: Have you battled the DOME ACE?\pWhen he's treating the opponent\nlightly, he uses these three POKéMON:\pA DRAGON & FLYING DRAGON POKéMON,\na WATER & GROUND MUD FISH POKéMON,\land a FIRE & FLYING FLAME POKéMON.$
translation: 你和超巨星交过手了吗？\p当他不把对手放在心上时，\n会使用这三只宝可梦：\p龙与飞行属性的龙宝可梦、\n水与地面属性的沼鱼宝可梦，\l以及火与飞行属性的火焰宝可梦。$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_DomeAceGoldMons_hns
source:
Have you battled the DOME ACE
when he's serious?\pWhen he's demonstrating his strategy,
he uses these three POKéMON:\pA DRAGON & FLYING EON POKéMON,
a WATER & GROUND MUD FISH POKéMON,\land a STEEL- & PSYCHIC-type IRON LEG\lPOKéMON.$
translation: 你和认真的超巨星交过手了吗？\p当他展现真正的战术时，\n会使用这三只宝可梦：\p龙与飞行属性的无限宝可梦、\n水与地面属性的沼鱼宝可梦，\l以及钢与超能力属性的铁足\l宝可梦。$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_FactoryHeadIsThere_hns
source: Bet you didn't know this!\pOne of those top TRAINERS that SCOTT\ncalls the FRONTIER BRAINS is there.\pIt's this freaky TRAINER called\nthe FACTORY HEAD that runs the place.$
translation: 你一定不知道这个吧！\p被亚希达先生称为开拓之脑的\n顶尖训练家就在那里。\p掌管那里的，是被称为\n工厂首领的怪人训练家。$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_FactoryHeadSilverMons_hns
source:
Have you battled the FACTORY HEAD
already?\pLet me think… When he goes to battle,
he just gets three rental POKéMON.\pHe battles under pretty much the same
conditions as you.$
translation: 你已经和工厂首领交过手了吗？\p让我想想......他进行对战时，\n也只是获得三只租用的宝可梦。\p他的对战条件和你几乎完全相同。$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_FactoryHeadGoldMons_hns
source:
Have you battled the FACTORY HEAD
when he's serious?\pWhen he goes seriously to battle,
he still gets three rental POKéMON.\pHe battles under virtually the same
conditions as you.$
translation: 你和认真的工厂首领交过手了吗？\p即使他动真格去对战，\n也同样是获得三只租用的宝可梦。\p他的对战条件实质上和你完全相同。$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_PikeQueenIsThere_hns
source: Bet you didn't know this!\pOne of those top TRAINERS that SCOTT\ncalls the FRONTIER BRAINS is there.\pIt's this scary TRAINER called\nthe PIKE QUEEN that runs the place.$
translation: 你一定不知道这个吧！\p被亚希达先生称为开拓之脑的\n顶尖训练家就在那里。\p掌管那里的，是被称为\n管道皇后的可怕训练家。$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_PikeQueenSilverMons_hns
source:
Have you battled the PIKE QUEEN
before?\pWhen she's in a good mood, they say
she uses these three POKéMON:\pA POISON-type FANG SNAKE POKéMON,
a BUG & ROCK MOLD POKéMON,\land a WATER-type TENDER POKéMON.$
translation: 你以前和管道皇后交过手吗？\p听说当她心情不错时，\n会使用这三只宝可梦：\p毒属性的牙蛇宝可梦、\n虫与岩石属性的发酵宝可梦，\l以及水属性的慈爱宝可梦。$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_PikeQueenGoldMons_hns
source:
Have you battled the PIKE QUEEN
when she's serious?\pWhen she's seriously annoyed, they say
she uses these three POKéMON:\pA POISON-type FANG SNAKE POKéMON,
a STEEL & GROUND IRON SNAKE POKéMON,\land a WATER- & FLYING-type ATROCIOUS\lPOKéMON.$
translation: 你和认真的管道皇后交过手了吗？\p听说当她真正动怒时，\n会使用这三只宝可梦：\p毒属性的牙蛇宝可梦、\n钢与地面属性的铁蛇宝可梦，\l以及水与飞行属性的凶恶\l宝可梦。$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_ArenaTycoonIsThere_hns
source: Bet you didn't know this!\pOne of those top TRAINERS that SCOTT\ncalls the FRONTIER BRAINS is there.\pIt's this cute TRAINER called\nthe ARENA TYCOON that runs the place.$
translation: 你一定不知道这个吧！\p被亚希达先生称为开拓之脑的\n顶尖训练家就在那里。\p掌管那里的，是被称为\n竞技场主将的可爱训练家。$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_ArenaTycoonSilverMons_hns
source:
Have you battled the ARENA TYCOON
before?\pWhen she's assessing the foe's ability,
she supposedly uses these POKéMON:\pA BUG & FIGHTING SINGLE HORN POKéMON,
a DARK-type MOONLIGHT POKéMON,\land a BUG & GHOST SHED POKéMON.$
translation: 你以前和竞技场主将交过手吗？\p她在试探对手的能力时，\n据说是使用这几只宝可梦：\p虫与格斗属性的独角宝可梦、\n恶属性的月光宝可梦，\l以及虫与幽灵属性的脱壳宝可梦。$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_ArenaTycoonGoldMons_hns
source:
Have you battled the ARENA TYCOON
when she's serious?\pWhen she battles for keeps,
she supposedly uses these POKéMON:\pA DARK-type MOONLIGHT POKéMON,
a GHOST & POISON SHADOW POKéMON\land a GRASS- & FIGHTING-type\lMUSHROOM POKéMON.$
translation: 你和认真的竞技场主将交过手了吗？\p当她动真格战斗时，\n据说是使用这几只宝可梦：\p恶属性的月光宝可梦、\n幽灵与毒属性的影子宝可梦，\l以及草与格斗属性的\l蘑菇宝可梦。$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_PalaceMavenIsThere_hns
source: Bet you didn't know this!\pOne of those top TRAINERS that SCOTT\ncalls the FRONTIER BRAINS is there.\pIt's this sinister TRAINER called\nthe PALACE MAVEN that runs the place.$
translation: 你一定不知道这个吧！\p被亚希达先生称为开拓之脑的\n顶尖训练家就在那里。\p掌管那里的，是被称为\n宫殿守护者的阴沉训练家。$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_PalaceMavenSilverMons_hns
source:
Have you battled the PALACE MAVEN
before?\pWhen he's testing the opponent's
spirit, he's said to use these POKéMON:\pA POISON & FLYING-type BAT POKéMON,
a NORMAL-type LAZY POKéMON, and a\lWATER- & ICE-type TRANSPORT POKéMON.$
translation: 你以前和宫殿守护者交过手吗？\p当他试探对手的气魄时，\n据说会使用这几只宝可梦：\p毒与飞行属性的蝙蝠宝可梦、\n一般属性的偷懒宝可梦，以及\l水与冰属性的乘载宝可梦。$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_PalaceMavenGoldMons_hns
source:
Have you battled the PALACE MAVEN
when he's serious?\pWhen he throws his entire might into
battle, he's said to use these POKéMON:\pA FIRE-type LEGENDARY POKéMON,
a NORMAL-type LAZY POKéMON,\land a WATER-type AURORA POKéMON.$
translation: 你和认真的宫殿守护者交过手了吗？\p当他倾尽全力投入对战时，\n据说会使用这几只宝可梦：\p火属性的传说宝可梦、\n一般属性的偷懒宝可梦，\l以及水属性的极光宝可梦。$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_PyramidKingIsThere_hns
source: Bet you didn't know this!\pOne of those top TRAINERS that SCOTT\ncalls the FRONTIER BRAINS is there.\pIt's this fiery-hot TRAINER called\nthe PYRAMID KING that runs the place.$
translation: 你一定不知道这个吧！\p被亚希达先生称为开拓之脑的\n顶尖训练家就在那里。\p掌管那里的，是被称为\n金字塔法老的热血训练家。$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_PyramidKingSilverMons_hns
source:
Have you battled the PYRAMID KING
before?\pWhen he's checking the foe's power,
he apparently uses these POKéMON:\pA ROCK-type ROCK PEAK POKéMON,
an ICE-type ICEBERG POKéMON,\land a STEEL-type IRON POKéMON.$
translation: 你以前和金字塔法老交过手吗？\p当他测试对手的力量时，\n据说会使用这几只宝可梦：\p岩石属性的岩峰宝可梦、\n冰属性的冰山宝可梦，\l以及钢属性的黑铁宝可梦。$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_PyramidKingGoldMons_hns
source:
Have you battled the PYRAMID KING
when he's serious?\pWhen he's pumped with hot power,
he apparently uses these POKéMON:\pAn ICE & FLYING FREEZE POKéMON, an
ELECTRIC & FLYING ELECTRIC POKéMON,\land a FIRE- & FLYING-type FLAME\lPOKéMON.$
translation:
你和认真起来的
金字塔法老对战过吗？\p当他充满热情的力量时，\n据说会使用这些宝可梦：\p冰与飞行属性的冻结宝可梦，\n电与飞行属性的电气宝可梦，\l以及火与飞行属性的火焰宝可梦。$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_DoubleBattleAdvice1_hns
source:
Sure, there are several places where
you can enter DOUBLE BATTLES.\pBut the DOUBLE BATTLE ROOMS of
the BATTLE TOWER are, like, basic!\pThey're where you should learn about
how DOUBLE BATTLES are played here\lin the BATTLE FRONTIER.$
translation:
确实，有几个地方
可以进行双打对战。\p但对战塔的双打对战室，
可以说是基础中的基础！\p你应该在那里学习
对战开拓区的双打对战规则。$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_DoubleBattleAdvice2_hns
source: Watch yourself in the battles here.\pI hear there are TRAINERS that have\nstrategies they developed just for\lDOUBLE BATTLES.$
translation: 在这里对战要多加小心。\p听说有些训练家专门\n针对双打对战开发了战术。$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_DoubleBattleAdvice3_hns
source: Once you're confident and comfortable\nwith DOUBLE BATTLES here, you should\lthink about challenging other places\loffering DOUBLE BATTLES.$
translation: 只要你在这里的双打对战中\n积累了信心并游刃有余，\l就可以考虑去挑战其他\n提供双打对战的设施了。$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_MultiBattleAdvice_hns
source: All sorts of TRAINERS gather in\nthe BATTLE SALON.\pJust think--you may run into your\nfriends or followers!\lYou should look carefully!$
translation: 形形色色的训练家都会聚集在\n对战沙龙里。\p想想看--你可能会遇到你的\n朋友或崇拜者哦！\l仔细找找看吧！$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_LinkMultiBattleAdvice_hns
source: If you're with a friend, head for the\nLINK MULTI BATTLE ROOM.\pIf you play with a strong friend,\nyou can expect to see tough foes!$
translation: 如果你和朋友在一起，\n就去通信多人对战室吧。\p要是和一个强大的朋友联手，\n就能遇到实力强劲的对手哦！$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_NewsGatheringPower_hns
source: What amazing news-gathering power!\nMy mentor's like none other!$
translation: 多么惊人的情报收集能力！\n我师父真是无与伦比！$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_AmazingPowersOfObservation_hns
source: What amazing powers of observation!\nMy mentor's like none other!$
translation: 多么惊人的观察力！\n我师父真是无与伦比！$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_AmazingPowerOfPersuasion_hns
source: What amazing power of persuasion!\nMy mentor's like none other!$
translation: 多么惊人的说服力！\n我师父真是无与伦比！$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_ThisPlaceIsScaringMe_hns
source: …What is this place?\nIt's scaring me…$
translation: ......这是什么地方啊？\n好可怕......$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge3_Text_CantYouSeeWereBusyHere_hns
source: …What's that you want?\pCan't you see we're kind of busy here?\nCan't your business wait till later?$
translation: ......你想要干什么？\p没看到我们正忙着吗？\n你的事情不能等会儿再说吗？$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge3_Text_YouLookToughExplainGambling_hns
source:
…Huh?
You look to me like a tough TRAINER.\pHeheh…
Listen, I have this proposition.\pWe have a little group going here,
and we play a little game with what\lgoes on in the BATTLE FRONTIER.\pThe rules are really simple.\pFirst, we pick one of the facilities
in the BATTLE FRONTIER.\pThen, we each pick a different TRAINER
who's taking that facility's challenge,\land bet with our Battle Points.\pThe guy who bet on the TRAINER with
the best record takes all the Battle\lPoints in the pool.\pSounds simple, huh?
So, anyway…$
translation:
......嗯？
我看你像个厉害的训练家。\p嘿嘿......
听着，我有个提议。\p我们在这里建了个小团体，
拿对战开拓区里发生的事\l来玩个小游戏。\p规则非常简单。\p首先，我们选出
对战开拓区里的一个设施。\p然后，我们各自挑选一名
去挑战该设施的训练家，\l并押上我们的对战点数。\p谁押的训练家战绩最好，
谁就能拿走奖池里所有的对战点数。\p听起来很简单吧？
所以说呢......$

translation: 嘿嘿！多谢啦！\n那么，快出发吧！$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge3_Text_NiceTryCantReturnPoints_hns
source:
Oh, it's you…
Nice try…\pI hate to break it to you, but I can't
return your Battle Points…\pI guess we'll have to let it motivate
us to try harder next time!$
translation:
唉，是你啊......
你尽力了......\p虽然很遗憾，但我没法
退还你的对战点数了......\p就当是激励我们下次
更加努力吧！$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge3_Text_HelloChampHeresYourPoints_hns
source:
Oh, yes!
Hello there, champ!\pI knew you could!
I knew you would!\lWe're both big winners!\pI'll return your Battle Points and,
of course, a little extra from me!$
translation:
噢，太棒了！
你好啊，大赢家！\p我就知道你能行！
我就知道你办得到！\l我们都是大赢家啦！\p这是还你的对战点数，
当然，还有我的一点额外心意！$

translation: {PLAYER}获得了\n{STR_VAR_1}点对战点数。$

translation: 要是你还想再次挑战，\n可一定要想着我啊！$

translation: 没兴趣？！你可不能\n这么害怕冒险啊！$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge3_Text_TrainerGoodButRattled_hns
source: That TRAINER…\pHe's good, but he gets rattled too\neasily to survive the BATTLE DOME…$
translation: 那个训练家......\p实力是不错，但他太容易慌乱了，\n在对战巨蛋是走不远的......$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge3_Text_KnowWinnerWhenISeeOne_hns
source: Giggle!\nI know a winner when I see one!$
translation: 嘻嘻！\n谁能赢，我一眼就能看出来！$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge3_Text_ShouldBeTakingChallenges_hns
source: Those TRAINERS…\nWhat are they doing?\lThey should be taking challenges.$
translation: 那些训练家......\n他们到底在做什么啊？\l明明应该去接受挑战的。$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge4_Text_WonderIfInterviewsAiring_hns
source: I wonder if they'll be airing interviews\nwith tough TRAINERS today?$
translation: 不知道今天会不会播出\n对强力训练家的采访呢？$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge4_Text_IfIOpenedRestaurantHere_hns
source: If I opened a restaurant here,\nit'd make money for sure.$
translation: 要是我在这里开家餐厅，\n绝对能大赚一笔。$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge4_Text_NeedBreatherAfterBattles_hns
source: Whew…\pI need to take a breather after\nsome intense battles…\pBut even now, I never take a break\nfrom plotting strategy and combos.$
translation: 呼......\p在经历了几场激烈的对战后，\n我得先喘口气......\p但即便在休息，\n我的脑子也一刻不停地在构思战术与连招。$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge5_Text_NatureGirlGreeting_hns
source: Ehehe!\nI can tell what POKéMON are thinking!\pPlease!\nCan I see your POKéMON?$
translation: 嘿嘿！\n我能知道宝可梦心里在想什么哦！\p拜托！\n能让我看看你的宝可梦吗？$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge5_Text_NatureGirlNoneShown_hns
source: Boo!\nCheapie!$
translation: 切--！\n小气鬼！$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge5_Text_NatureGirlAttackHighAttackLow_hns
source: Hmhm…\pThis one says it likes to battle!\nIt will battle even if it has a lot\lof ouchies!$
translation: 嗯嗯......\p它说它喜欢战斗！\n即使受了很痛很痛的伤，\l它也还是会继续战斗！$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge5_Text_NatureGirlAttackHighDefenseLow_hns
source: Hmhm…\pThis one says it likes to battle!\nBut if it gets enough ouchies,\lit will worry about itself!$
translation: 嗯嗯......\p它说它喜欢战斗！\n但要是受了很痛很痛的伤，\l它就会先顾着保护自己！$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge5_Text_NatureGirlAttackHighSupportLow_hns
source: Hmhm…\pThis one says it likes to battle!\nBut if it gets enough ouchies,\lit will turn sneaky!$
translation: 嗯嗯......\p它说它喜欢战斗！\n但要是受了很痛很痛的伤，\l它就会变得爱耍小花招！$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge5_Text_NatureGirlDefenseHighAttackLow_hns
source: Hmhm…\pThis one says it looks after itself!\nBut if it gets enough ouchies,\lit will hit back!$
translation: 嗯嗯......\p它说它很懂得照顾自己！\n但要是受了很痛很痛的伤，\l它就会全力反击回去！$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge5_Text_NatureGirlDefenseHighDefenseLow_hns
source: Hmhm…\pThis one says it looks after itself!\nIt says it worries about itself whether\lor not it has a lot of ouchies!$
translation: 嗯嗯......\p它说它很懂得照顾自己！\n它说不管受没受很痛的伤，\l它都总是在担心自己！$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge5_Text_NatureGirlDefenseHighSupportLow_hns
source: Hmhm…\pThis one says it looks after itself!\nBut if it gets enough ouchies,\lit will turn sneaky!$
translation: 嗯嗯......\p它说它很懂得照顾自己！\n但要是受了很痛很痛的伤，\l它就会变得爱耍小花招！$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge5_Text_NatureGirlSupportHighAttackLow_hns
source: Hmhm…\pThis one says it likes to be sneaky!\nBut if it gets enough ouchies,\lit will hit back!$
translation: 嗯嗯......\p它说它喜欢耍小花招！\n但要是受了很痛很痛的伤，\l它就会全力反击回去！$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge5_Text_NatureGirlSupportHighDefenseLow_hns
source: Hmhm…\pThis one says it likes to be sneaky!\nBut if it gets enough ouchies,\lit will worry about itself!$
translation: 嗯嗯......\p它说它喜欢耍小花招！\n但要是受了很痛很痛的伤，\l它就会先顾着保护自己！$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge5_Text_NatureGirlSupportHighSupportLow_hns
source: Hmhm…\pThis one says it likes to be sneaky!\nIt says it likes to be sneaky even\lif it has a lot of ouchies!$
translation: 嗯嗯......\p它说它喜欢耍小花招！\n它说即使受了很痛很痛的伤，\l它也还是最喜欢耍小花招！$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge5_Text_NatureGirlEgg_hns
source: That's silly! An EGG is asleep!\nI can't talk to it!$
translation: 真傻！蛋还在睡觉呢！\n我没法跟它说话！$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge5_Text_LadyClaimsSheUnderstandsPokemon_hns
source: How charming!\nThat little lady claims she can\lunderstand POKéMON!$
translation: 真有意思！\n那个小女孩竟然声称\l自己能听懂宝可梦的心声！$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge5_Text_GirlSayingSomethingProfound_hns
source: I have this feeling that the little girl\nis saying something profound.$
translation: 我总觉得那个小女孩\n说的话其实大有深意。$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge5_Text_GirlPlaysAtRedHouseALot_hns
source: I know something!\pThat little girl plays at the red house\na lot!$
translation: 我知道一个秘密！\p那个小女孩经常\n在那座红色的房子里玩！$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge6_Text_WouldYouLikeToTrade_hns
source:
My POKéMON is a {STR_VAR_2}.
Do you know it?\lIt's quite cute and rather nice.\pThis little one, I could trade with
pride!\pWould you like to trade me a {STR_VAR_1}
for my {STR_VAR_2}?$
translation: 我的宝可梦是{STR_VAR_2}。\n你认识它吗？\l它长得可爱，性格也很乖巧。\p这小家伙，我可是能自豪地拿来交换的！\p你愿意用你的{STR_VAR_1}\n换我的{STR_VAR_2}吗？$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge6_Text_PromiseIllBeGoodToIt_hns
source: Oh, it's adorable!\nThank you!\lI promise I'll be good to it!\pOh! I hope you'll be good to\nmy {STR_VAR_2}, too!$
translation: 哎呀，太招人喜欢了！\n谢谢你！\l我保证会好好待它的！\p对了！也希望你能善待\n我的{STR_VAR_2}哦！$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge6_Text_DontTradeForAnythingButMon_hns
source: Oh, I'm sorry!\nI don't intend to trade for anything\lbut a {STR_VAR_1}.$
translation: 啊，真遗憾！\n除了{STR_VAR_1}以外，\l我并不打算换别的宝可梦。$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge6_Text_WellThatsFineToo_hns
source: Oh, you won't?\nWell, that's fine, too.\lPlease come visit us again.$
translation: 啊，你不换吗？\n那也没关系。\l欢迎下次再来找我们玩。$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge6_Text_SkittySoMuchCuterThanImagined_hns
source: Giggle!\nA SKITTY is so much cuter than I had\limagined. I'm delighted!$
translation: 嘻嘻！\n向尾喵比我想象中的还要可爱得多。\l我太开心了！$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_LeftTutorIntro_hns
source:
Buhahaha!\pYou couldn't tell it from looking now,
but I used to be one tough TRAINER.\pI had a reputation as the toughest
BEAUTY around, I tell you!\p… … … … … …\pWhat is it now?
You don't believe me.\pI'm not like that blowhard woman over
there. I'm actually talented!\pLet me prove it to you.
I can teach your POKéMON special and\lyet cute moves.\pBut my lessons don't come free.
How about paying for the moves I teach\lwith a wee bit of Battle Points?$
translation:
唔哈哈哈！\p虽然现在从外表看不出来，
但我以前可是个很厉害的训练家。\p我当时可是出了名的实力最强的大姐姐呢！\p...... ...... ...... ...... ...... ......\p怎么啦？
你还不相信我啊。\p我可不像那边那个爱吹牛的女人，我可是很有真本事的！\p就让我证明给你看吧。
我可以传授你的宝可梦既特别又可爱的招式哦。\p不过我可不能免费教你。
用一点点对战点数来换我教的招式，你觉得如何？$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_LeftTutorWelcomeBack_hns
source: Buhahaha!\pAre you back to learn special and\nyet cute POKéMON moves?$
translation: 哇哈哈哈！\p又想来学特别而\n可爱的宝可梦招式了吗？$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_TeachWhichMove_hns
source: Fine, fine, look here!\nWhich move should I teach?$
translation: 好好，看这里！\n要学哪个招式呢？$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_MoveWillBeXBattlePoints_hns
source: The move {STR_VAR_1}, is it?\nThat will be {STR_VAR_2} Battle Points, okay?$
translation: 是招式{STR_VAR_1}对吧？\n需要{STR_VAR_2}点对战点数，可以吗？$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_TeachMoveToWhichMon_hns
source: Fine, fine, now pick the POKéMON\nI should teach the move to.$
translation: 很好很好，选一只\n要学这个招式的宝可梦吧。$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_HaventGotEnoughPoints_hns
source: What the…\nYou haven't got enough Battle Points!$
translation: 什么啊......\n你的对战点数不够啊！$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_IllTakeBattlePoints_hns
source: Do you see how skilled I am now?\nI'll take your Battle Points, thanks!$
translation: 见识到我的厉害了吧？\n那对战点数我就收下啦，多谢！$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_YouDontWantTo_hns
source: What's that?\nYou don't want to…\pIf you want to see how skilled I am,\nyou come see me anytime!$
translation: 什么嘛？\n你不想学啊......\p要是想见识我的本领，\n随时都可以来找我！$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_RightTutorIntro_hns
source:
Ihihihi!\pI know it's hard to see now, but I used
to be one fantastic TRAINER.\pI had a reputation as the most
invincible SWIMMER around, I tell you!\p… … … … … …\pWhat's wrong?
You don't believe me.\pI'm not like that buffoonish woman over
there. I'm actually experienced!\pI can prove it to you.
I can teach your POKéMON hard and\lyet pretty moves.\pBut my lessons don't come free.
How about paying for the moves I teach\lwith a wee bit of Battle Points?$
translation:
嘻嘻嘻！\p虽然现在看不太出来，
但我以前可是个非常出色的训练家呢。\p我当时可是人称最强
无敌的游泳健将，没骗你吧！\p...... ...... ...... ...... ...... ......\p怎么了？
你不信我吗？\p我和那边那个滑稽的女人可不一样。
我可是身经百战的！\p我可以证明给你看。
我能传授你的宝可梦强力\l而优美的招式。\p不过我的教学可不是免费的。
用一点点对战点数来支付招式学费，\l怎么样啊？$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_RightTutorWelcomeBack_hns
source: Ihihihi!\pHave you come to learn hard and\nyet pretty POKéMON moves?$
translation: 嘻嘻嘻！\p你是来学强力而\n优美的宝可梦招式的吗？$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_ThinkLadiesDontGetAlong_hns
source: Those ladies, the way they bad-mouth\neach other, you probably think that\lthey don't get along.\pBut if that were true, they wouldn't\nstay out here together, would they?$
translation: 看那两位老太太互相挖苦的样子，\n你可能会觉得她们关系不好吧。\p但如果真是那样，\n她们也不会一起待在这儿了，对吧？$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_LadiesWereStrongAndBeautiful_hns
source:
When I was just a wee YOUNGSTER,
those ladies were strong and beautiful.\pThey were idols among us TRAINERS.\pEven now, age hasn't dulled their
abilities.\pIn fact, their POKéMON moves have
grown even more polished.\pBut… For some reason, I can't help
but feel this…\pTime is so cruel…$
translation:
我还是个小小的短裤小子时，
那两位女士既强大又美丽。\p她们曾是我们训练家之中的偶像。\p即使到现在，岁月也没有磨灭
她们的实力。\p甚至，她们传授的宝可梦招式
变得更加精妙了。\p但是......不知为何，
我总忍不住感慨......\p岁月真是太残酷了......$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_SoftboiledDesc_hns
source: Recovers up to\nhalf the user's\nmaximum HP.$
translation: 回复自己\n最大HP的\n一半。$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_SeismicTossDesc_hns
source: Inflicts damage\nidentical to the\nuser's level.$
translation: 给予对手和\n自己等级相同的\n伤害。$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_DreamEaterDesc_hns
source: Recovers half the\ndamage inflicted\non a sleeping foe.$
translation: 回复给予\n睡眠中对手的\n伤害的一半HP。$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_MegaPunchDesc_hns
source: A strong punch\nthrown with\nincredible power.$
translation: 充满惊人\n力量的\n强力一拳。$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_MegaKickDesc_hns
source: An extremely\npowerful kick with\nintense force.$
translation: 使出充满\n极大力道的\n强力重踢。$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_BodySlamDesc_hns
source: A full-body slam\nthat may cause\nparalysis.$
translation: 用整个身体压住\n对手进行攻击。\n有时会让对手麻痹。$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_RockSlideDesc_hns
source: Large boulders\nare hurled. May\ncause flinching.$
translation: 投掷巨大的\n岩石进行攻击。\n有时会使对手畏缩。$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_CounterDesc_hns
source: Retaliates any\nphysical hit with\ndouble the power.$
translation: 将受到的物理攻击\n伤害加倍返还\n给对手。$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_ThunderWaveDesc_hns
source: A weak jolt of\nelectricity that\nparalyzes the foe.$
translation: 向对手发出微弱的\n电击，从而让对手\n陷入麻痹状态。$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_SwordsDanceDesc_hns
source: A fighting dance\nthat sharply\nraises ATTACK.$
translation: 跳起战斗之舞，\n大幅提高\n自己的攻击。$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_DefenseCurlDesc_hns
source: Curls up to con-\nceal weak spots\nand raise DEFENSE.$
translation: 蜷缩身体遮挡\n弱点，从而提高\n自己的防御。$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_SnoreDesc_hns
source: A loud attack\nthat can be used\nonly while asleep.$
translation: 在睡眠状态下\n发出巨大的噪音\n进行攻击。$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_MudSlapDesc_hns
source: Hurls mud in the\nfoe's face to re-\nduce its accuracy.$
translation: 向对手的面部\n投掷泥块，从而\n降低其命中率。$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_SwiftDesc_hns
source: Sprays star-\nshaped rays\nthat never miss.$
translation: 发射星形\n光线进行攻击。\n攻击必定会命中。$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_IcyWindDesc_hns
source: A chilling attack\nthat lowers the\nfoe's SPEED.$
translation: 冰冷的攻击，\n会降低对手的速度。$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_EndureDesc_hns
source: Endures any at-\ntack for 1 turn,\nleaving 1HP.$
translation: 在1回合内挺住任何攻击，\n必定剩下1点HP。$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_PsychUpDesc_hns
source: Copies the foe's\neffect(s) and\ngives to the user.$
translation: 复制对手的能力变化效果\n并施加在自己身上。$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_IcePunchDesc_hns
source: An icy punch\nthat may\nfreeze the foe.$
translation: 充满寒气的拳击，\n有时会让对手陷入冰冻状态。$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_ThunderPunchDesc_hns
source: An electrified\npunch that may\nparalyze the foe.$
translation: 充满电气的拳击，\n有时会让对手陷入麻痹状态。$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_FirePunchDesc_hns
source: A fiery punch\nthat may burn\nthe foe.$
translation: 充满火焰的拳击，\n有时会让对手陷入灼伤状态。$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_ElementalTutorIntro
source: Zzzzzz…\pWhat, how, what?\pOh, sorry, I was snoozing a bit.\pI'm the ELEMENTAL TUTOR.\pI have the power to teach the most\npowerful moves to GRASS, FIRE and\lWATER TYPE POKéMON.\pDid you come to learn such a strong\npower?$
translation: 呼......呼......\p什、什么、怎么了？\p啊，抱歉，我打了个瞌睡。\p我是终极招式传授家。\p我拥有向草属性、火属性和\l水属性宝可梦传授最强招式的力量。\p你是来学习这种强大的力量的吗？$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_ElementalTutorWelcomeBack
source: Zzzzzz…\pWhat, how, what, who?\pOh, did you come to learn the\npower of my strongest moves?$
translation: 呼......呼......\p什、什么、怎么了、谁？\p哦，你是来学习我那最强招式的\n力量的吗？$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_TeachWhichMoveElemental
source: Which move do you think is suitable\nfor your POKéMON?$
translation: 你觉得哪个招式适合你的宝可梦？$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_StrongElementalMoveDesc
source: Powerful, but\nleaves the user\nimmobile one turn.$
translation: 威力巨大，\n但下一回合自己将无法动弹。$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge8_Text_WhatATrainerNeeds_hns
source:
What a TRAINER needs…\pKnowledge…
Strategy…\lLuck…\lGuts…\lSpirit…\lBravery…\lAnd ability…\pWell, I'm all set in every way!
I'll be unstoppable at every building!\pHuh? POKéMON?
What's that?$
translation:
训练家所需要的......\p知识......
策略......\l运气......\l毅力......\l心灵......\l勇气......\l还有才能......\p好，我已经全都具备了！
我在每座设施里都会所向披靡！\pHuh？宝可梦？
那是啥？$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge8_Text_KnowAboutFrontierBrains_hns
source: Do you know about the FRONTIER\nBRAINS?\pThat's what SCOTT calls the seven\nspecial TRAINERS that run the seven\lfacilities in the BATTLE FRONTIER.$
translation: 你知道对战开拓区首领吗？\p那是亚希达对管理对战开拓区\l7处设施的7位特别训练家的称呼。$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge8_Text_ToldMeIHaveTalentForBattling_hns
source: At the BATTLE TOWER, an older girl\ntold me that I have a lot of talent\lfor battling!\pI like POKéMON CONTESTS more!\pBut I'm no good at CONTESTS!\pI guess having talent and liking\nsomething aren't the same.$
translation: 在对战塔，有个大姐姐夸我\n很有对战的天赋呢！\p但我更喜欢宝可梦华丽大赛！\p可我一点也不擅长华丽大赛！\p看来有天赋和喜欢并不是一回事啊。$

label: BattleFrontier_Mart_Text_ChaperonGrandson_hns
source: We came here to chaperon our\ngrandson.\pBut since we're here, we thought\nwe should get some souvenirs.$
translation: 我们是陪孙子一起来的。\p不过既然都来了，\n就想着顺便买点纪念品回去。$

label: BattleFrontier_Mart_Text_ProteinMakeNiceGift_hns
source: Dear, what do you think of this?\nWouldn't this make a nice gift?\pIt's…PRO…TE…IN?\nIt sounds delicious, doesn't it?$
translation: 老头子，你觉得这个怎么样？\n拿来当礼物不是很棒吗？\p这是......蛋......白......质？\n听起来很好吃对吧？$

label: BattleFrontier_Mart_Text_FacilitiesDontAllowItems_hns
source: A lot of the BATTLE FRONTIER's\nfacilities don't allow the use of items\lduring battles.\pThat rule makes things tougher than\nthey already are!$
translation: 对战开拓区的许多设施在对战中\n都是禁止使用道具的。\p这一规则让挑战变得更加艰难了！$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_BattleTowerSign_hns
source: This is the BATTLE TOWER!\nKeep the win streak as the toughest\lTRAINER!$
translation: 这里是对战塔！\n以最强训练家为目标保持连胜吧！$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_BattlePalaceSign_hns
source: This is the BATTLE PALACE!\nKeep your eyes on POKéMON battles!$
translation: 这里是对战宫殿！\n目不转睛地注视宝可梦的战斗吧！$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_BattleArenaSign_hns
source: This is the BATTLE ARENA!\nLet the toughest teams gather!$
translation: 这里是对战竞技场！\n最强的队伍聚集于此吧！$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_BattlePyramidSign_hns
source: This is the BATTLE PYRAMID!\nAdvance through the Battle Quest!$
translation: 这里是对战金字塔！\n在对战探险中勇往直前吧！$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_RankingHallSign_hns
source: BATTLE FRONTIER RANKING HALL\nSet your sights on new records!$
translation: 对战开拓区排名大厅\n瞄准新纪录发起冲击吧！$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_ExchangeCornerSign_hns
source: BATTLE POINT EXCHANGE SERVICE CORNER\nExchange your Battle Points!$
translation: 对战点数兑换处\n兑换你的对战点数吧！$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_BattleTowerFeelsSpecial_hns
source: Wow!\nIt's huge!\pThe BATTLE TOWER feels special.\nIt's different from the others.$
translation: 哇！\n好大啊！\p对战塔感觉格外特别呢。\n和其他设施都不一样。$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_ConquerLeagueAndFrontier_hns
source: My grand ambition is to conquer both\nthe BATTLE FRONTIER and the POKéMON\lLEAGUE.\pAnd if my dream comes true…\pI… I'm going to ask MIMI next door\nif she will be friends with me!$
translation: 我的宏伟抱负就是制霸\n对战开拓区和宝可梦联盟。\p如果我的梦想实现了......\p我......我就去问隔壁的美美\n愿不愿意和我做朋友！$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_PyramidTooHarsh_hns
source: The BATTLE PYRAMID's too harsh!\nI just can't make it to the top!\pSince I'm out of options, maybe I can\nclimb the outside…$
translation: 对战金字塔太残酷了！\n我根本到不了顶层！\p既然已经无计可施了，\n也许我能从外面爬上去......$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_ThriveInDarkness_hns
source: I thrive in darkness…\nYes… What is worthy of me?\lNone other than the BATTLE PYRAMID…\pWhat say you to wandering in darkness\nand in utter and total desperation?$
translation: 我在黑暗中茁壮成长......\n是的......有什么配得上我？\l非对战金字塔莫属......\p在彻头彻尾的绝望黑暗中漫步，\n你觉得如何？$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_PutTogetherUltimateTeam_hns
source: I didn't sleep for a week, but then\nI put together the ultimate team!\pI can't see myself losing, no joke.\nWe're storming the BATTLE ARENA!$
translation: 我一个星期没睡觉，但终于\n组建出了究极队伍！\p不夸张地说，我都不知道自己怎么输。\n我们要横扫对战竞技场！$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_DidScottBringYouHere_hns
source:
Did SCOTT bring you here, too?
What is it with that guy?\pIt sounds like he really does know
how to spot talented TRAINERS, but…\pI've never seen him battling in person
ever.$
translation:
也是亚希达带你来的吗？
那家伙到底是怎么回事？\p虽然听上去他确实挺有
发掘优秀训练家的眼光，但是......\p我从没亲眼见过他
亲自对战过。$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_BelieveInYouBuddy_hns
source: ZIGG!\nI believe in you, little buddy!\pI'll make my little ZIGG any favorite\ntasty treats you like if you win!$
translation: 蛇蛇！\n我相信你，小搭档！\p要是赢了，无论什么你爱吃的\n美味零食，我都给你做！$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_ZigzagoonLooksVacant_hns
source: ZIGZAGOON looks vacant…$
translation: 蛇纹熊一脸茫然......$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_PeopleCallMeBusybody_hns
source:
People call me a busybody,
but I can't help it.\pYour hat's on crooked!
Oh, no, trash on the ground!\lOops, it's almost dinnertime!\pI don't know if I can stand to just
watch at the BATTLE PALACE…$
translation:
人们都说我是个爱管闲事的人，
但我就是忍不住嘛。\p你的帽子戴歪了！
哎呀不行，地上有垃圾！\l糟了，快到吃晚饭的时间了！\p在对战宫殿只能在旁边看着，
我都不知道自己忍不忍得住......$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_OnceBeatGymLeader_hns
source: I may not look that impressive now,\nbut I once beat a GYM LEADER.\pWho knows, maybe I should give it\nanother shot at glory.$
translation: 我现在看着可能不起眼，\n但我曾经打败过道馆馆主哦。\p谁知道呢，说不定我应该\n再去重温一下当年的荣耀。$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_FastOnBikeAndBattles_hns
source: I'm fast on my BIKE, and that goes for\nthe way I battle, too.\pI win matches in the blink of\nan eye!$
translation: 我骑自行车飞快，\n我的对战风格也是如此。\p我眨眼之间就能\n赢得比赛！$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_BetterThanDaddyAtPokemon_hns
source: I'm better than my daddy\nat POKéMON.$
translation: 我玩宝可梦比我爸爸还厉害！$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_GoRackUpSomeWinsForDaddy_hns
source: Go on, my baby sweetie!\nGo rack up some wins for Daddy!\pYou're just like your mother,\nso you'll be dominating!$
translation: 去吧，我的小宝贝！\n去给爸爸多拿几场胜利回来！\p你跟你妈妈一模一样，\n绝对能所向披靡！$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_HeardPrettyGirlAtBattleArena_hns
source:
It wasn't easy getting here,
but I'd heard about this knockout\lpretty girl at the BATTLE ARENA.\pInstead of her, do you know what
I found?\pA whole teeming mob of sweaty,
stinky, and primitive martial artists!$
translation: 来到这里可不容易，\n因为我听说在对战竞技场\l有个倾国倾城的大美女。\p结果呢，你猜我看到了什么？\p一大群浑身臭汗、\n粗鲁又野蛮的格斗家！$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_SometimesImportantOldManInThere_hns
source: I sometimes see this really important-\nlooking old man going in there.\pHe has these really awesome POKéMON.\nHe seems really nice, though.$
translation: 我有时会看到一个看起来很有威望的\n老人走进去。\p他的宝可梦非常厉害，\n不过他人看起来非常和善。$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_LegendOfBattlePyramid_hns
source:
Do you know it?
The legend of the BATTLE PYRAMID?\pWhen there comes a confident TRAINER
reaching for the golden pinnacle,\lthere shall appear a man among men.\pDon't know that legend?
Well, of course not!\lI just made it up!\pWhat's it supposed to mean?
That, my friend, I can't say!$
translation:
你知道吗？
关于对战金字塔的传说？\p"当自信满满的训练家
踏上金色的顶峰之时，\l人中豪杰便将现身。"\p没听说过这个传说？
哎呀，那是当然的啦！\l这可是我刚刚现编的！\p到底是什么意思？
这我就无可奉告了，朋友！$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_GotWipedOut_hns
source:
Man! Oh man!
I've never lost once before!\pBut I got wiped out with no saving
grace at all!\pAnd then I'm told I don't have any
talent?! Man!$
translation:
天哪！天哪！
我以前可是一次都没输过！\p结果被毫无悬念地
全灭了！\p然后居然还被说毫无才能？！
搞什么啊！$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_ToughTrainerInBattleTower_hns
source: This guy ran into a horribly tough\nTRAINER while he was on the BATTLE\lTOWER challenge.\pNow look at him…\pYou need to be cautious if you ever\ndecide to go to the BATTLE TOWER.$
translation: 这家伙在挑战对战塔的时候，\n遇到了一个强得可怕的训练家。\p现在看看他成了什么样......\p如果你想去对战塔，\n可一定要小心谨慎。$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_EnoughBattlePointsForDoll_hns
source: Yes!\nI've finally got enough Battle Points!\pI guess I'll trade for another giant\nplush DOLL!$
translation: 太好了！\n我的对战点数终于攒够了！\p这就去再换一个\n超大的毛绒玩偶吧！$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_LikeToHaveNameRecordedHere_hns
source: Oh, yeah, okay!\nSo this is the RANKING HALL!\pI'd like to go down in history as\na super champ and have my name\lrecorded here for posterity.$
translation: 噢，原来如此！\n这里就是排行大厅啊！\p我想作为超级冠军名垂青史，\n把名字永远刻在这里供后人瞻仰。$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_CanDoAnythingWithYou_hns
source: With you by my side, I can do anything.$
translation: 只要有你在我身边，我什么都做得到。$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_PowerOfOurLoveWillOvercome_hns
source:
Ooh, darling, you are so wonderful!\pOoh, I just can't wait anymore!\pLet's go to a MULTI BATTLE ROOM
right this instant!\pIf we get together in the BATTLE SALON,
the power of our love will overcome\leveryone we meet.\pWhy, before us, darling, everything
will topple like dominoes!$
translation: 噢，亲爱的，你太棒了！\p噢，我真是一刻也等不及了！\p我们马上就去多人对战室吧！\p只要我们在对战沙龙携手，\n我们爱的力量就能战胜\l遇到的所有人。\p哎呀亲爱的，在我们面前，一切都会\n像多米诺骨牌一样应声倒下！$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_FrontierNotExclusivelyForToughTrainers_hns
source:
The BATTLE FRONTIER isn't exclusively
for tough TRAINERS.\pMany people with special abilities
have been invited, it seems.\pThat man SCOTT…\pHe may have built this place to serve
a bigger objective…$
translation:
对战开拓区可不只是
为强大的训练家准备的。\p看起来，许多身怀绝技的人
也都受到了邀请。\p亚希达那个人......\p建造这个地方，
也许是为了更大的目标......$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_OddTreeHereSeemsToWiggle_hns
source: Excuse me, young one.\nHave you good eyesight?\pThere is an odd tree past here, and to\nmy tired eyes it seems to wiggle.$
translation: 打扰一下，年轻人。\n你的视力好吗？\p前面有一棵奇怪的树，\n在我这双老花眼里，它好像在晃动。$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_OnceAnOddTreePastHere_hns
source: Excuse me, young one.\nHave you a good memory?\pI have this feeling there once was\nan odd tree past here.$
translation: 打扰一下，年轻人。\n你的记性好吗？\p我总觉得过去这里曾经有棵奇怪的树。$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_StickyMonWithLongTail_hns
source:
I…
I saw it!\pThere was a sticky sort of a POKéMON
with a long tail up ahead!\pIt was hiding under a boulder, and
it kept staring at me!$
translation:
我......
我看见了！\p前面有一只黏糊糊的、
长着长尾巴的宝可梦！\p它藏在一块巨石下面，
还一直死死盯着我看！$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_MetOlderGirlAtPike
source:
Crunch, munch…\pA while back, I met this older girl
at the BATTLE PIKE.\pShe had these eyes that were scary
in a real ornery way.\pCrunch, munch…\pShe got all furious: “Will you quit
eating!” Then she whaled on me.\pIt was a hair-raising kind of
scary experience, sure enough.\pCrunch, munch…$
translation:
咔嚓，嚼嚼......\p前阵子，我在对战管子
遇到了一位大姐姐。\p她的眼神非常凶恶，
透着一股狠劲。\p咔嚓，嚼嚼......\p她气得大喊："你给我别吃了！"
然后就把我暴揍了一顿。\p那可真是一段让人毛骨悚然的恐怖经历啊。\p咔嚓，嚼嚼......$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_BattleDomeSign_hns
source: This is the BATTLE DOME!\nYour path to the invincible superstar!$
translation: 这里是对战巨蛋！\n通往无敌超级巨星之路！$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_BattleFactorySign_hns
source: This is the BATTLE FACTORY!\nSeek out the toughest POKéMON!$
translation: 这里是对战工厂！\n寻找最强的宝可梦吧！$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_BattlePikeSign_hns
source: This is the BATTLE PIKE!\nChoose one of three paths!$
translation: 这里是对战管道！\n在三条路中选择一条前进吧！$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_ThisIsBattleTower_hns
source: This is the BATTLE TOWER.\pTRAINERS bring their best-raised\nPOKéMON for elimination-style matches.$
translation: 这里是对战塔。\p训练家们会带着精心培育的\n宝可梦前来参加淘汰赛。$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_MayISeeYourTicket_hns
source: Hello, are you here for the ferry?\nMay I see your TICKET?$
translation: 您好，您是要乘渡轮吗？\n请出示您的船票。$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_MustHaveTicketToBoard_hns
source: {PLAYER} doesn't have the TICKET…\pI'm terribly sorry.\pYou must have a TICKET to board\nthe ferry.$
translation: {PLAYER}没有船票......\p非常抱歉。\p必须持有船票才能乘渡轮。$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_WhereWouldYouLikeToGo_hns
source: {PLAYER} flashed the TICKET.\pPerfect! That's all you need!\pAnd where would you like to go?$
translation: {PLAYER}出示了船票。\p很好！这就没问题了！\p请问您想去哪里呢？$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_SlateportItIs_hns
source: SLATEPORT CITY it is, then!$
translation: 那么，就前往凯那市！$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_LilycoveItIs_hns
source: LILYCOVE CITY it is, then!$
translation: 那么，就前往水静市！$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_SailWithUsAnotherTime_hns
source: Please sail with us another time!$
translation: 欢迎下次再度光临！$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_PleaseBoardFerry_hns
source: Please board the ferry and wait for\ndeparture.$
translation: 请登上渡轮，等待出发。$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_ThenWhereWouldYouLikeToGo_hns
source: Then, where would you like to go?$
translation: 那么，您想去哪里呢？$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_BestOutOfAllMyFriends_hns
source: I'm the best out of all my friends.\nBut here…\lI've been useless!$
translation: 我在朋友当中明明是最强的，\n可在这里......\l根本不堪一击！$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_CantFindBattleTower_hns
source: I want to go to the BATTLE TOWER,\nbut I can't find it even though I have\la map of the BATTLE FRONTIER.\pThis place is just too big!$
translation: 我想去对战塔，\n可哪怕拿着对战开拓区的地图，\l也还是找不到。\p这里实在太大了！$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_GotSeasickOnWayHere_hns
source: I wanted to take a challenge as soon\nas I arrived here.\pBut on the way, I got seasick…\nUrrrrp…$
translation: 我本来打算一到这里就去挑战的。\p可路上晕船晕得厉害......\n呕......$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_OnlyToughTrainersBroughtHere_hns
source:
It's not as if just anyone can come
here, you know?\pOnly those TRAINERS who've been
recognized as tough are brought here.\pThat's why many TRAINERS don't even
know about the BATTLE FRONTIER.$
translation: 可不是谁都能来这里的，知道吗？\p只有被认可为强者的训练家\n才会被带到这里来。\p正因如此，很多训练家甚至\n连对战开拓区都不知道呢。$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_SureWeCanChallengeWithNoMons_hns
source: Hey, bro…\pAre you sure we can make challenges\neven if we don't have any POKéMON?$
translation: 喂，哥......\p就算一只宝可梦都没有，\n真的也能挑战吗？$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_BigGuySaidIllLendYouMons_hns
source: Uh…\nI'm sure it'll be okay.\pI think…\pBut remember that big scary guy?\nHe said, “I'll lend you POKéMON!”$
translation: 呃......\n应该没问题的吧。\p大概......\p不过你还记得那个很凶的大叔吗？\n他说："我可以借你们宝可梦！"$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_WhosRaisingThoseRentalMons_hns
source: That's the BATTLE FACTORY.\nYou can rent strong POKéMON there.\pBut it makes me wonder.\nWho's raising those rental POKéMON?$
translation: 那是对战工厂。\n在那里可以租借到强大的宝可梦。\p不过真让人好奇，\n那些供租借的宝可梦到底是谁培育的呢？$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_ScaredOfPikeBecauseSeviper_hns
source: I'm scared of going into the BATTLE\nPIKE because of SEVIPER…\pB-but I came all the way here, so I will\ntry to conquer everything!\l…Shudder…$
translation: 因为饭匙蛇的关系，\n我很害怕进对战管道......\p但、但我大老远来了这里，\n就一定要制霸所有设施！\l......瑟瑟发抖......$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_LetsPlayRockPaperScissors_hns
source: Let's play rock, paper, scissors!\nOne, two, three!\p… … … … … …$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_WonIllTakePikeChallenge_hns
source: Yay! I won!\nI will take the BATTLE PIKE challenge!$
translation: 好耶！我赢了！\n我去挑战对战管道咯！$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_LostIllPutOffPikeChallenge_hns
source: Oh, no…\nI lost.\pI guess I'm not very lucky today.\nI'll put off my BATTLE PIKE challenge\luntil tomorrow.$
translation: 哎呀......\n我输了。\p看来我今天的运气不怎么样。\n挑战对战管道的事，\l还是推迟到明天吧。$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_ChooseFishingOverBattling_hns
source: I believe I'm the only person here who,\nfor some unknown reason, would choose\lfishing over battling.\pHuh? You can't catch anything here?\nThat's disappointing…$
translation: 不知为何，我大概是这里唯一一个\n比起对战更喜欢钓鱼的人吧。\p咦？这里什么都钓不到？\n真叫人失望......$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_KeepBattlingUntilIGetSymbol_hns
source: Today, I'm going to keep battling, no\nmatter what, until I get a Symbol.$
translation: 今天无论如何我都要一直对战下去，\n直到拿到开拓象征为止。$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_YoureOffToChallengeDome_hns
source: Oh? You're off to challenge\nthe BATTLE DOME?\pI'll wish you the best of luck.\nLet us both win our way up and meet\lin challenges.$
translation:
哦？你正打算去挑战
对战巨蛋吗？\p祝你好运。
让我们一路赢下去，
在对战中相会吧。$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_DomeIsHereGrandpa_hns
source: Grandpa, over here!\nThe BATTLE DOME is here!\lGo get 'em, Grandpa!$
translation: 爷爷，这边！\n对战巨蛋在这里！\l加油啊，爷爷！$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_WontLetGentlemenBeatMe_hns
source: Ah, so this here is the BATTLE DOME?\nI won't let GENTLEMEN beat me!\pBut where is the entrance?$
translation: 哦，这里就是对战巨蛋吗？\n我可不会输给那些绅士！\p不过入口在哪里呢？$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_NothingHereNotLongAgo_hns
source: There used to be nothing here not all\nthat long ago.\pBut, now look at this place! Amazing!\nI'll bring my mother out to see this.$
translation: 不久之前这里还什么都没有呢。\p可现在看看这里！真了不起！\n我也要带妈妈来看看。$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_FinallyArrivedAtFrontier_hns
source: I've finally arrived at the BATTLE\nFRONTIER!\pI'm sure to grab attention with\nmy looks and ability!$
translation: 终于来到对战开拓区了！\p凭我的美貌和实力，\n一定会大受瞩目的！$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_SquareFilledWithToughPeople_hns
source: Munch, munch…\pIt looks like this square's filled with\ntough people.\pMunch, munch…$
translation: 嚼，嚼......\p这个广场上看起来\n满是厉害的家伙啊。\p嚼，嚼......$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_MetOlderGirlAtPike_hns
source:
Crunch, munch…\pA while back, I met this older girl
at the BATTLE PIKE.\pShe had these eyes that were scary
in a real ornery way.\pCrunch, munch…\pShe got all furious: “Will you quit
eating!” Then she whaled on me.\pIt was a hair-raising kind of
scary experience, sure enough.\pCrunch, munch…$
translation:
咔嚓，嚼嚼......\p前阵子，我在对战管子
遇到了一位大姐姐。\p她的眼神非常凶恶，
透着一股狠劲。\p咔嚓，嚼嚼......\p她气得大喊："你给我别吃了！"
然后就把我暴揍了一顿。\p那可真是一段让人毛骨悚然的恐怖经历啊。\p咔嚓，嚼嚼......$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_LastTimeOurEyesMet_hns
source: Huh? Will you listen to yourself?\nThat's nothing!\pWhy, the last time I cheered for him,\nour eyes met and sparks flew!$
translation: 哈？听听你说的什么话！\n那根本不算什么！\p我上次为他加油时，\n我们可是四目相对，火花四溅呢！$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_DomeAceLookedBecauseOfMyCheering_hns
source:
Whaaaaaat?!
Pfft!\pThat only happened because
I happened to be sitting next to you!\pThe DOME ACE only looked our way
because my cheering was so loud!$
translation: 什--么？！\n切！\p那不过是因为我碰巧坐在你旁边罢了！\p巨蛋巨星会往我们这边看，\n全是因为我的加油声最大！$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_DomeAceIsMine_hns
source:
Oh, shush!
Keep that racket down!\pYou fair-weather fans should stick
to cheering for some GYM LEADER!\pThe DOME ACE is mine!
The only idol for me!$
translation: 哼，吵死了！\n小声点！\p你们这种跟风粉丝还是去给道馆馆主加油吧！\p巨蛋巨星是属于我的！\n是我唯一的偶像！$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_FansOverThereUsedToBeTrainers_hns
source:
Those people squabbling over there…\pIt's hard to believe, but they once
were TRAINERS, and good ones, too.\pThey used to be incredibly tough,
and they were famous, too.\pBut they were obliterated by this
certain TRAINER at a tournament.\pThey were so thoroughly whipped,
they became smitten by the TRAINER.\pNow they're just fans of the TRAINER.
They go cheer for their idol at the\lBATTLE DOME every day now.$
translation: 在那边吵架的那些人......\p虽然难以置信，但她们以前也是训练家，而且相当厉害呢。\p曾经不仅实力超强，还很有名气。\p但是在一场锦标赛中，她们被某个训练家彻底击溃了。\p因为输得太惨，她们反而被那个训练家迷得神魂颠倒。\p现在就只是那个训练家的粉丝了。\n每天都去对战巨蛋为她们的偶像加油助威。$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_MonWithLongTailInFrontier_hns
source: I heard a rumor that someone saw\na POKéMON with an unusually long tail\lsomewhere in the BATTLE FRONTIER.\pIt must be adorable. I'm sure of it…\pOh, challenges can wait. I feel driven\nto find the delightful creature!$
translation: 我听到传闻，说有人在对战开拓区的某个地方\n见到了尾巴特别长的宝可梦。\p肯定非常可爱。我敢肯定......\p哎呀，挑战的事先放一边。我忍不住\n想要去找找那个惹人怜爱的家伙了！$

label: BattleFrontier_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_NeverSeenPokemon_hns
source:
There was someone here using a 
POKéMON I've never seen before.\pI never learned about it at
TRAINER'S SCHOOL at least.\pI wonder where you can catch POKéMON
like that.$
translation: 这里有人用着我从没见过的宝可梦。\p至少在训练家学校里从没学过。\p真不知道在哪里能捉到那样的宝可梦。$

label: BattleFrontier_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_NextStopBattleArena_hns
source: Okay! Next stop, the BATTLE ARENA!\nI'd better get the right POKéMON from\lthe PC Storage System.$
translation: 好！下一站是对战竞技场！\n我得先去宝可梦储存系统里\l取出合适的宝可梦才行。$

label: BattleFrontier_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_GoingThroughEveryChallenge_hns
source: Giggle… I'm going to go through every\nchallenge with just this baby!$
translation: 咯咯......我就带着这孩子\n去通关所有挑战！$

label: BattleFrontier_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Skitty_hns
source: SKITTY: Mya myaaah!$
translation: 向尾喵：喵~呜！$

label: BattleFrontier_RankingHall_Text_ExplainRankingHall_hns
source: This is the RANKING HALL.\pThis is where we recognize the immortal\nTRAINERS who left great records in\lBATTLE FRONTIER events.$
translation: 这里是名誉殿堂。\p这里表彰着在对战开拓区\n创下伟大记录的传奇训练家们。$

label: BattleFrontier_RankingHall_Text_DomePikeFactoryRecords_hns
source: BATTLE DOME, BATTLE PIKE,\nand BATTLE FACTORY Records$
translation: 对战巨蛋、对战管子\n与对战工厂的记录$

label: BattleFrontier_RankingHall_Text_PalaceArenaPyramidRecords_hns
source: BATTLE PALACE, BATTLE ARENA,\nand BATTLE PYRAMID Records$
translation: 对战宫殿、对战竞技场\n与对战金字塔的记录$

label: BattleFrontier_RankingHall_Text_IsYourNameOnThisList_hns
source: Hi, is your name on this list?$
translation: 你好，这名单上有你的名字吗？$

label: BattleFrontier_RankingHall_Text_WowThatsSuper_hns
source: Wow, that's super!\nI'll have to try harder, too!$
translation: 哇，太厉害了！\n我也得更加努力才行！$

label: BattleFrontier_RankingHall_Text_WorkHarderIfYouSawFriendsName_hns
source: Oh, is that right?\pIf you saw your friend's name up here,\nI bet it would make you work harder!$
translation: 哎，是吗？\p如果在这里看到朋友的名字，\n一定会激励你更加努力吧！$

label: BattleFrontier_RankingHall_Text_MyNamesNotUpThere_hns
source: Hmm…\nMy name's not up there…\pWell, it's only natural since I haven't\ntaken any challenges yet.$
translation: 嗯......\n上面没有我的名字......\p嘛，毕竟我还没参加过挑战，这也理所当然啦。$

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_FirstTimeHereThisWay_hns
source: Is it your first time here?\nPlease step this way!$
translation: 您是第一次来这里吗？\n请往这边走！$

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_WelcomeToBattleFrontier_hns
source: The front lines of POKéMON battling!\nWelcome to the BATTLE FRONTIER!$
translation: 宝可梦对战的最前线！\n欢迎来到对战开拓区！$

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_IssueFrontierPass_hns
source: For a first-time visitor, we issue\nthe FRONTIER PASS.\pIt's for use at all the facilities\nin the BATTLE FRONTIER.\pHere you are!$
translation: 我们会为初次来访的客人\n发放开拓通行证。\p它适用于对战开拓区内的所有设施。\p给您！$

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_ObtainedFrontierPass_hns
source: {PLAYER} obtained\nthe FRONTIER PASS.$
translation: {PLAYER}获得了\n开拓通行证。$

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_PlacedTrainerCardInFrontierPass_hns
source: {PLAYER} placed the TRAINER CARD\nin the FRONTIER PASS.$
translation: {PLAYER}将训练家卡\n放入了开拓区通行证。$

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_EnjoyBattleFrontier_hns
source: We hope you enjoy all that the BATTLE\nFRONTIER has to offer!$
translation: 希望您能尽情享受对战开拓区\n提供的一切乐趣！$

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_IfItIsntPlayerYouCame_hns
source: ???: Well, if it isn't {PLAYER}{KUN}!\nYou came out here!$
translation: ？？？：哎呀，这不是{PLAYER}{KUN}吗！\n你果然来这里了啊！$

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_OhMrScottGoodDay_hns
source: GUIDE: Oh! MR. SCOTT, sir!\nGood day to you, sir!$
translation: 向导：啊！亚希达先生！\n您好，先生！$

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_ScottGreatToSeeYouHere_hns
source:
SCOTT: It's great to see you here,
it really is!\pI hope you'll take your time and
explore everywhere.\pNaturally, I hope you'll also experience
the pure essence of battling.\pI also have my quarters here, so feel
free to visit if you have time.$
translation:
亚希达：能在这里见到你，
真是太棒了！\p希望你能慢慢逛，
走遍这里的每一个角落。\p当然，我也希望你能体验到
对战的最纯粹的魅力。\p我的住处也在这里，有空的话
随时欢迎来坐坐。$

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_YourGuideToFacilities_hns
source: I'm your guide to the various facilities\nhere in the BATTLE FRONTIER.$
translation: 我是对战开拓区各处设施的向导。$

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_LearnAboutWhich2_hns
source: Which would you like to learn about?$
translation: 您想了解哪处设施呢？$

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_BattleTowerInfo_hns
source: It is the gigantic tower considered\nto be the BATTLE FRONTIER's symbol.\pThere are four kinds of BATTLE ROOMS\nin the tower for SINGLE, DOUBLE, MULTI,\land LINK MULTI BATTLES.$
translation: 那是被视为对战开拓区象征的\n巨大高塔。\p塔内有4种对战室，分别用于\n单打、双打、多人以及\l通信多人对战。$

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_BattleDomeInfo_hns
source:
The BATTLE DOME is the large building
shaped like a huge egg.\pEvents named Battle Tourneys are held
in this facility.\pThe Battle Tourneys are offered in
two courses--for SINGLE and DOUBLE\lBATTLES.$
translation: 对战巨蛋是一座\n外形酷似巨蛋的大型建筑。\p在这里举办名为锦标赛的活动。\p锦标赛分为单打对战和双打对战\n两种比赛模式。$

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_BattlePalaceInfo_hns
source: The BATTLE PALACE is the red building\non the right of the BATTLE FRONTIER.\pThere are two kinds of BATTLE HALLS\nfor SINGLE and DOUBLE BATTLES.$
translation: 对战宫殿是对战开拓区\n右侧的红色建筑。\p里面设有单打对战和双打对战\n两种对战大厅。$

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_BattleArenaInfo_hns
source: The BATTLE ARENA is the dojo-like\nbuilding at the center-right of\lthe BATTLE FRONTIER.\pAn event called the Set KO Tourney\ntakes place at the BATTLE ARENA.$
translation: 对战竞技场是对战开拓区\n中右侧类似道场的建筑。\p对战竞技场举办名为\n胜负判定淘汰赛的活动。$

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_BattleFactoryInfo_hns
source:
The BATTLE FACTORY is the large
building that is the closest to us.\pAn event called the Battle Swap
is conducted there.\pThe Battle Swap event is offered in
two courses for SINGLE and DOUBLE\lBATTLES.$
translation: 对战工厂是离我们\n最近的一座大型建筑。\p那里举办名为交换对战的活动。\p交换对战活动分为\n单打对战和双打对战两种模式。$

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_BattlePikeInfo_hns
source: The BATTLE PIKE is the building shaped\nlike a POKéMON at the center-left of\lthe BATTLE FRONTIER.\pAn event called the Battle Choice\nis conducted there.$
translation: 对战水管是对战开拓区\n中左侧外形似宝可梦的建筑。\p那里举办名为选择对战的活动。$

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_BattlePyramidInfo_hns
source: The BATTLE PYRAMID is the enormous\npyramid.\pAn event called the Battle Quest\nis conducted there.$
translation: 对战金字塔是那座巨大的金字塔。\p那里举办名为探险对战的活动。$

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_RankingHallInfo_hns
source: The RANKING HALL is located near\nthe BATTLE TOWER.\pThere, you may see the most fantastic\nrecords left by the TRAINERS that\ltook on the many challenges of\lthe BATTLE FRONTIER.$
translation: 纪录大厅位于对战塔附近。\p在那里，你可以看到前来挑战\n对战开拓区诸多项目的训练家们\l所留下的辉煌纪录。$

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_ExchangeCornerInfo_hns
source: The EXCHANGE SERVICE CORNER is near\nthe BATTLE TOWER.\pThe Battle Points you have earned in\nthe BATTLE FRONTIER may be exchanged\lfor fabulous prizes there.$
translation: 兑换服务角位于对战塔附近。\p你在对战开拓区获得的对战点数，\n可以在那里兑换丰厚的奖品。$

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_YourGuideToRules_hns
source: I'm your guide to the basic rules that\nare common to all the challenges\loffered by the facilities in the BATTLE\lFRONTIER.$
translation: 我是为您介绍对战开拓区各设施\n共通基础规则的向导。$

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_LearnAboutWhat_hns
source: What would you like to learn about?$
translation: 您想了解哪方面的规则？$

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_LevelModeInfo_hns
source: All the challenges at the BATTLE\nFRONTIER's facilities come in\ltwo courses--Level 50 and Open Level.$
translation: 对战开拓区所有设施的挑战\n都分为两种模式--\l50级与公开级别。$

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_Level50Info_hns
source:
The Level 50 course is open to POKéMON
up to and including Level 50.\pPlease keep in mind, however, that
no TRAINER you face will have any\lPOKéMON below Level 50.\pThis course is the entry level for
battles at the BATTLE FRONTIER.\pTo begin, we hope you will challenge
this course.$
translation: 50级模式允许不超过50级的\n宝可梦参加挑战。\p但是请注意，你面对的对手\n绝对不会派出低于50级的宝可梦。\p这个模式是对战开拓区的入门级别。\p建议您先从挑战这个模式开始。$

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_OpenLevelInfo_hns
source:
The Open Level course places no limit
on the levels of POKéMON entering\lchallenges.\pThe levels of your opponents will
be adjusted to match the levels of\lyour POKéMON.\pHowever, no TRAINER you face will
have any POKéMON below Level 60.$
translation:
公开级别模式对参赛宝可梦的
等级没有任何限制。\p对手的宝可梦等级会调整为
与你出战的宝可梦等级相同。\p但是，你面对的对手绝对不会
派出低于60级的宝可梦。$

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_MonEntryInfo_hns
source:
Virtually any kind of POKéMON may take
on the challenges at all facilities.\pEGGS and certain kinds of POKéMON,
however, are not permitted.\pThe numbers of POKéMON required for
challenges will depend on the facility.\pAt all facilities, however, two or more
of the same kind of POKéMON are not\lpermitted.$
translation:
几乎所有的宝可梦都可以参加
所有设施的挑战。\p但是，蛋以及某些特定的宝可梦
是不能参加的。\p挑战所需的宝可梦数量
因设施而异。\p但是，所有设施都禁止携带
两只或以上同种类的宝可梦参加。$

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_HoldItemsInfo_hns
source: When entering a challenge at a BATTLE\nFRONTIER facility, POKéMON may not\lbe holding the same kind of item.\pPlease make sure that all POKéMON\nentering a challenge are holding\ldifferent items.$
translation: 参加对战开拓区设施的挑战时，\n宝可梦不能携带同一种道具。\p请确保所有参赛的宝可梦\n携带的道具各不相同。$

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_YourGuideToFrontierPass_hns
source: I'm your guide to the FRONTIER PASS.$
translation: 我是开拓区通行证的向导。$

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_LearnAboutWhich1_hns
source: Which would you like to learn about?$
translation: 您想了解哪处设施呢？$

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_SymbolsInfo_hns
source:
There are seven facilities at
the BATTLE FRONTIER.\pTRAINERS who gain recognition for
their abilities may be rewarded with\lsymbols from each of the facilities.\pTo earn a symbol, TRAINERS may need
to defeat other TRAINERS in a row,\land may need to win events repeatedly.\pIt's certainly not easy to win symbols.
I wish you the best of luck!$
translation:
对战开拓区一共有7处设施。\p实力得到认可的训练家
可以在各个设施中获得象征。\p想要获得象征，训练家需要
连续击败其他训练家，\l并且可能需要多次赢得比赛。\p获得象征绝非易事。
祝您好运！$

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_RecordedBattleInfo_hns
source:
It is possible to record one battle
on your FRONTIER PASS.\pYou may record a battle you had with
a friend or friends.\pOr you may record a battle conducted
at the BATTLE FRONTIER excluding\lmatches at the BATTLE PIKE or\lthe BATTLE PYRAMID.\pYou may choose to record your match
at the end of a battle.$
translation: 在开拓区通行证上\n可以记录一场对战。\p你可以记录一场与朋友进行的对战。\p或者记录在对战开拓区进行的对战，\n但对战管道和对战金字塔的\l比赛除外。\p你可以在对战结束后选择保存比赛录像。$

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_BattlePointsInfo_hns
source: Battle Points are rewards given to\nTRAINERS who battled outstandingly\lat the BATTLE FRONTIER.\pYou may trade in your Battle Points\nfor prizes at the EXCHANGE SERVICE\lCORNER.$
translation: 对战点数是奖励给在对战开拓区\n表现出色的训练家的报酬。\p你可以在兑换服务角用对战点数\n兑换奖品。$

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_WelcomeToBattleFrontier_hns
source:
SCOTT: Well, hello and welcome!
Heheh… Sorry about the cramped space.\pAnyway, {PLAYER}{KUN}, let me formally
welcome you to the BATTLE FRONTIER.\pThis is my dream come true.
It took me years and years, but I've\lfinally given shape to my dream.$
translation:
亚希达：哎呀，欢迎欢迎！
嘿嘿......地方有点窄，别介意啊。\p不管怎样，{PLAYER}{KUN}，让我正式
欢迎你来到对战开拓区。\p这里是实现我梦想的地方。
虽然花了我好多年好多年，但我终于\l把梦想变成了现实。$

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_HowMuchEffortItTookToMakeReal_hns
source:
On reflection, it was a terribly long
journey…\pI left home alone on a quest to find
strong TRAINERS.\pNo one can imagine how much effort
or time it took to make this real.$
translation: 回想起来，那真是一段漫长的旅途啊......\p我独自离开家乡，踏上寻找强大训练家的旅程。\p没有人能想象为了将它实现，\n我付出了多少心血和时间。$

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_HaveThisAsMementoOfOurPathsCrossing_hns
source:
But that's all in the past.
No point dwelling on that!\pAll I want for you is to enjoy battling
to your heart's content here.\p{PLAYER}{KUN}, I want you to have this
as a memento for all the time our\lpaths crossed on our journeys.$
translation: 不过那都是过去的事了，\n提这些也没意思！\p我只想让你在这里尽情享受对战的乐趣。\p{PLAYER}{KUN}，这个送给你，\n作为我们旅途中多次相遇的纪念吧。$

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_ObtainedXBattlePoints_hns
source: {PLAYER} obtained\n{STR_VAR_1} Battle Point(s).$
translation: {PLAYER}获得了\n{STR_VAR_1}点对战点数。$

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_ExplainBattlePoints_hns
source:
SCOTT: You can check your Battle
Points on your FRONTIER PASS.\pThe more success you have here at
the BATTLE FRONTIER, the more Battle\lPoints you will collect.\pUse your Battle Points the way you
see fit, like trading them for items.$
translation:
亚希达：你可以在开拓区通行证上
查看你的对战点数。\p你在对战开拓区取得的胜利越多，
就能积攒越多的对战点数。\p按照你喜欢的方式使用对战点数吧，
比如拿去兑换道具。$

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_ExpectingGreatThings_hns
source: I'm expecting great things from you!$
translation: 我非常期待你的精彩表现哦！$

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_WhyIGoSeekingTrainers_hns
source:
SCOTT: Every TRAINER is an individual.
They all lead lives of their own.\pBut when they're in a battle,
it doesn't matter who they are.\pThey're all the same!\pI love the purity of battle,
where everyone is equal.\pThat's why I go everywhere seeking
TRAINERS who are serious about\lbattling, and invite them here.$
translation:
亚希达：每个训练家都是独特的个体，
各自过着属于自己的人生。\p但是，一旦站上对战场地，
他们是谁就都不重要了。\p大家全都是平等的！\p我喜欢对战的那份纯粹，
在对战中人人平等。\p正因如此，我才会四处寻找
对战斗充满热忱的训练家，\l并邀请他们来到这里。$

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_HaveYouMetFrontierBrain_hns
source:
SCOTT: Have you met any of
the FRONTIER BRAINS?\pBetter yet, have you obtained any
symbols from them?\pI handpicked the FRONTIER BRAINS
as the toughest TRAINERS anywhere.\pBut I'm sure that seeing how tough
you are will startle even them!$
translation:
亚希达：你见过开拓之脑了吗？\p或者更进一步，
拿到他们手中的象征了吗？\p那些开拓之脑可是我从各地
精挑细选出来的顶尖强者。\p但我相信，只要见识了你的强大，
连他们也一定会大吃一惊的！$

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_MayFindWildMonsInFrontier_hns
source:
SCOTT: You don't just train for battle,
right?\pI think I remember you working on
a POKéDEX as well.\pWell, guess what?\pYou may run into wild POKéMON in
the BATTLE FRONTIER somewhere…\lFufufu!$
translation: 亚希达：你并不只是为了对战而特训，\n对吧？\p我记得你好像也在收集宝可梦图鉴呢。\p那，你猜怎么着？\p在对战开拓区的某个角落，\n你也许会遇到野生宝可梦哦......\l呼呼呼！$

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_YouveCollectedAllSilverSymbols_hns
source:
SCOTT: Are you enjoying things in
the BATTLE FRONTIER?\p…Wait a second…
Oh!\pYour FRONTIER PASS!
You've collected the full set\lof silver symbols!\pThat's more than impressive!
You are tough, just as I suspected!\pNormally, I wouldn't do something
like this, but this is a special time!\pI want you to have this.
I'm sure you can put it to proper use.$
translation:
亚希达：在对战开拓区玩得开心吗？\p......等等......
噢！\p你的开拓区通行证！
你已经集齐了全部的银色象征？！\p这简直太让人惊叹了！
你果然很强，和我料想的一样！\p平时我可不会这么做，
但现在是个特别的时刻！\p这个送给你。
我相信你一定能物尽其用的。$

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_YouveCollectedAllGoldSymbols_hns
source:
SCOTT: I hope you're enjoying
everything in the BATTLE FRONTIER.\p…Wait a second…
Oh, my disbelieving eyes!\pYour FRONTIER PASS!
You've gathered up the full set\lof gold symbols!\pThat's more than stupendous!
You're incredible, just as I suspected!\p… … … … … …\p{PLAYER}, you've got to accept this!\pI think you will be able to
appreciate the value of my gift!$
translation:
亚希达：希望你在对战开拓区
一切都过得开心。\p......等等......
天哪，我简直不敢相信自己的眼睛！\p你的开拓区通行证！
你竟然集齐了全部的金色象征？！\p这简直强得令人难以置信！
你真是太不可思议了，不出我所料！\p..................\p{PLAYER}，你一定要收下这个！\p我相信唯有你，
才能明白这份礼物的真正价值！$

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_SoGladIBroughtYouHere_hns
source: I must say I have the gift of knowing\na good TRAINER when I see one.\pI'm so glad I had the foresight to\nbring you here!$
translation: 不得不说，我在识别人才训练家方面\n确实很有天赋呢。\p真庆幸我有先见之明把你带到了这里！$

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_BerryPocketStuffed_hns
source: Your BERRY POCKET seems to\nbe stuffed.$
translation: 你的树果口袋\n好像已经装满了。$

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_Beat50TrainersInARow_hns
source: SCOTT: Oh, I heard about you!\nHow you ruled the BATTLE TOWER!\lYou beat over 50 TRAINERS in a row?\pThat's fantastic!\nI want you to have this!$
translation: 亚希达：噢，我都听说了！\n你在对战塔大展神威的事迹！\l你连续击败了超过50名训练家？\p太不可思议了！\n这个请你收下！$

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_Beat100TrainersInARow_hns
source: SCOTT: Oh, my! I heard about you!\nHow you overwhelmed the BATTLE TOWER!\lYou beat over 100 TRAINERS in a row?\pThat's ridiculously spectacular!\nYou've got to have this!$
translation: 亚希达：天哪！我都听说了！\n你彻底制霸了对战塔！\l你竟然连续击败了超过100名训练家？！\p这简直是神乎其技的壮举！\n你一定要收下这个！$

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_ExpectingToHearEvenGreaterThings_hns
source: I'll be expecting to hear even greater\nthings about you now!$
translation: 我今后会期待听到你更加惊人的传闻！$

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_ComeBackForThisLater_hns
source: Oops, well, if you have too much\nstuff, come back for this later.$
translation: 哎呀，既然你带的东西太多了，\n那就等以后再来拿吧。$

label: BellchimeTrail_Text_Morty
source:
MORTY: The legendary POKéMON
did not choose me...\pBut that does not mean that I
have lost out on my future.\pI will continue my training until I
I discover a new future for me.\pIf you seek another battle, find
me at the FIGHTING DOJO.$
translation:
小松：传说的宝可梦
没有选择我......\p但这并不代表
我就此失去了未来。\p我会继续修行，
直到寻找到属于自己的崭新未来。\p如果你还想与我对战，
就去格斗道场找我吧。$

label: BlackthornGym_Text_ClairIntroText
source: I am CLAIR.\pThe world's best dragon master.\pI can hold my own against even the\nPOKéMON LEAGUE's ELITE FOUR.\pDo you still want to take me on?\p…Fine. Let's do it!\pAs a GYM LEADER, I will use my full\npower against any opponent!$
translation: 我是小椿。\p世界第一的龙属性使者！\p哪怕是面对宝可梦联盟的四天王，\n我也绝不会落下风。\p即使如此，你还打算向我挑战吗？\p......好啊，那就来吧！\p身为道馆馆主，\n面对任何对手我都会全力以赴！$

label: BlackthornGym_Text_ClairWinText
source: I lost?\pI don't believe it. There must be\nsome mistake…$
translation: 我输了？\p难以置信。一定是有什么地方搞错了......$

label: BlackthornGym_Text_ClairText_GoToDragonsDen
source:
I won't admit this.\pI may have lost, but you're still
not ready for the POKéMON LEAGUE.\pI know. You should take the dragon-
user challenge.\pBehind this GYM is a place called
DRAGON'S DEN.\pThere is a small shrine at its
center. Go there.\pIf you can prove that you've lost
your lazy ideals, I will recognize\lyou as a trainer worthy of a GYM\lBADGE!$
translation: 我才不承认呢。\p就算是我输了，但现在的你\n还是没资格挑战宝可梦联盟。\p对了，你去接受龙使者的考验吧。\p在道馆后面有一个叫龙穴的地方。\p其中心有一座小祠堂，去那里吧。\p只要你能证明自己没有怠惰虚浮的杂念，\n我就会认可你是有资格获得\l道馆徽章的训练家！$

label: BlackthornGym_Text_ClairText_TooMuchToExpect
source: What's the matter?\pIs it too much to expect of you?$
translation: 怎么了？\p难道是我对你抱的期望太高了吗？$

label: BlackthornGym_Text_ClairText_YouKeptMeWaiting
source: You've kept me waiting!\pHere! Take this!$
translation: 让我好等啊！\p拿去！把这个收下！$

label: BlackthornGym_Text_ClairText_DescribeTM
source: That contains DRAGON CLAW.\pYou can figure out what it does.$
translation: 里面装的是"龙爪"。\p效果你自己看看就明白了。$

label: BlackthornGym_Text_ClairText_League
source:
What's the matter?\pAren't you headed to the POKéMON
LEAGUE?\pDon't you know where it is?\pFrom here, go to NEW BARK TOWN.\pThen SURF east. The route there is
very tough.\pDon't you dare lose at the POKéMON
LEAGUE!\pIf you do, I'll feel even worse
about having lost to you!\pGive it everything you've got.$
translation: 怎么啦？\p你不是要去宝可梦联盟吗？\p不知道路怎么走吗？\p从这里先回若叶镇，\p然后向东冲浪过去。那条路可不好走呢。\p你可千万别在宝可梦联盟输掉啊！\p要是你输了，输给你的我岂不是更丢脸！\p给我全力以赴地上吧！$

label: BlackthornGym_Text_ClairAfterLeague
source: You did it, huh?\pYou are now the JOHTO CHAMP.$
translation: 你做到了啊。\p现在你已经是城都的冠军了。$

label: BlackthornGym_Text_ClairRematchText
source: You did it, huh?\pYou are now the JOHTO CHAMP.\pYou've proven your strength but can\nyou handle me again?\pAs a Dragon Master, I won't hold\nback.\pNot this time.\pWant to have a rematch with me?$
translation: 你做到了啊。\p现在你已经是城都的冠军了。\p你证明了自己的实力，但你还能赢得了我吗？\p身为龙之大师，我绝不会手下留情。\p这一次绝不放水。\p要跟我再来对战一场吗？$

label: BlackthornGym_Text_ClairRematchDefeatText
source: I lost?\pAgain?\pI don't believe it. There must be\nsome mistake…$
translation: 我输了？\p又输了？\p真不敢相信。一定是哪里搞错了......$

label: BlackthornGym_Text_CooltrainermCodySeenText
source: I just got access to use DRAGON-\ntype POKéMON!$
translation: 我才刚被允许使用龙属性宝可梦呢！$

label: BlackthornGym_Text_CooltrainermCodyBeatenText
source: Rats! If only I had a DRAGONITE!$
translation: 可恶！要是我有一只快龙就好了！$

label: BlackthornGym_Text_CooltrainermCodyAfterBattleText
source: Members of our dragon-user clan\ncan use dragon POKéMON only after\lour MASTER allows it.$
translation: 我们驯龙一族的成员，只有在得到师父的许可后\l才能使用龙宝可梦。$

label: BlackthornGym_Text_CooltrainerfFranSeenText
source: I can't allow a nameless trainer\npast me!\pCLAIR would be livid if I did!$
translation: 我可不能让无名训练家从我这里过去！\p要是放你过去，小椿大人会暴跳如雷的！$

label: BlackthornGym_Text_CooltrainerfFranBeatenText
source: Awww… I lost…$

label: BlackthornGym_Text_CooltrainerfFranAfterBattleText
source: Uh-oh… CLAIR is going to be mad…$
translation: 哎呀......小椿大人要生气了......$

label: BlackthornGym_Text_CooltrainermPaulSeenText
source: Your first battle against dragons?\pI'll show you how tough they are!$
translation: 第一次跟龙交手吗？\p就让你见识一下它们有多强悍！$

label: BlackthornGym_Text_CooltrainermPaulBeatenText
source: My dragon POKéMON lost?$
translation: 我的龙宝可梦竟然输了？$

label: BlackthornGym_Text_CooltrainermPaulAfterBattleText
source: LANCE told you that he'd like to\nsee you again?\pNot a chance!$
translation: 阿渡大人说想再见到你？\p怎么可能！$

label: BlackthornGym_Text_CooltrainermMikeSeenText
source: My chance of losing? Not even one\npercent!$
translation: 我输掉的几率？连百分之一都不到！$

label: BlackthornGym_Text_CooltrainermMikeBeatenText
source: That's odd.$
translation: 真奇怪。$

label: BlackthornGym_Text_CooltrainermMikeAfterBattleText
source: I know my short-comings now.\pThanks for showing me!$
translation: 我知道自己的不足了。\p谢谢你让我看清！$

label: BlackthornGym_Text_CooltrainerfLolaSeenText
source: Dragons are sacred POKéMON.\pThey are full of life energy.\pIf you're not serious, you won't\nbe able to beat them.$
translation: 龙是神圣的宝可梦。\p它们体内充盈着生命能量。\p若是不动真格，你根本不可能赢得了它们。$

label: BlackthornGym_Text_CooltrainerfLolaBeatenText
source: Way to go!$
translation: 干得漂亮！$

label: BlackthornGym_Text_CooltrainerfLolaAfterBattleText
source: Dragons are weak against DRAGON-\ntype moves.$
translation: 龙宝可梦对龙属性招式很脆弱。$

label: BlackthornGym_Text_GuideText
source:
Yo! CHAMP in making!\pIt's been a long journey, but we
are almost done! Count on me!\pWhile CLAIR looks up to the Dragon
Master, LANCE, she's managed to\lcreate her own identity with a\lteam consisting of dragons from\lthe sea.\pDragons are supposed to be
weak against ICE-type moves,\lbut you'll need some DRAGON-type\lor FAIRY-type moves of your own if\lyou want to win.$
translation: 哟！未来的冠军！\p漫长的旅程终于快走到终点了！看我的吧！\p虽说小椿十分憧憬龙之大师阿渡，\l但她也凭借来自大海的龙系伙伴，\l组建起了自己独具风格的队伍。\p按理说龙宝可梦害怕冰属性招式，\l但要想拿下胜利，\l你自己最好也准备一些龙属性或妖精属性的招式。$

label: BlackthornGym_Text_GuideText
source: You got this!$
translation: 加油，你行的！$

label: BlackthornGym_Text_GuideGotoDragonsDen
source: You were great to beat CLAIR!\pShe can be a bit of a sore loser,\nthough\pSounds like you need to head to the\nDRAGON'S DEN if you want that GYM BADGE!$
translation: 能打赢小椿，你真是太棒了！\p不过，她输了以后脾气有点倔......\p看来要想拿到道馆徽章，\n你得去一趟龙穴才行了！$

label: BlackthornGym_Text_GuideWinText
source: You were great to beat CLAIR!\pAll that's left is the POKéMON\nLEAGUE challenge.\pYou're on the way to becoming the\nPOKéMON CHAMPION!$
translation: 你能打败小椿真是太厉害了！\p接下来就只剩下\n挑战宝可梦联盟了。\p你离成为宝可梦冠军\n只差一步之遥了！$

label: BlackthornGym_Text_GymStatue
source: BLACKTHORN CITY POKéMON GYM$
translation: 烟墨市宝可梦道馆$

label: BlackthornGym_Text_GymStatueCertified
source: BLACKTHORN CITY POKéMON GYM\pCLAIR'S CERTIFIED TRAINERS:\n{PLAYER}$
translation: 烟墨市宝可梦道馆\p小椿认可的训练家：\n{PLAYER}$

label: BlackthornCity_Text_ElmName
source: 空木博士$
translation: 空木博士$

label: BlackthornCity_Text_BaobaCall
source: WARDEN BAOBA: {PLAYER}!\pThis is WARDEN BAOBA.\pI'm calling to tell you that\nthe SAFARI ZONE has expanded!\pPlease come visit!$
translation: 巴奥巴园长：{PLAYER}！\p我是巴奥巴园长。\p我打电话是想通知你，\n狩猎地带扩建了！\p请一定要来看看哦！$

label: BlackthornCity_Text_ElmCall
source: PROF.ELM: Hello, {PLAYER}?\pI have something here for you.\nCould you swing by my LAB?\pSee you later!$
translation: 空木博士：喂喂，是{PLAYER}吗？\p我有样东西想交给你，\n你能来一趟研究所吗？\p待会儿见啦！$

label: BlackthornCity_Text_ClairNotReady
source: CLAIR, our GYM LEADER, has been\nfollowing your progress.\pHowever, she only battles trainers\nwho already have 7 badges.$
translation: 我们的道馆馆主小椿，\n一直在关注你的表现。\p不过，她只会与已经收集了\n7枚徽章的训练家对战。$

label: BlackthornCity_Text_ClairIsIn
source: CLAIR, our GYM LEADER, is waiting\nfor you.\pHowever, it would be impossible for\na run-of-the-mill trainer to win.$
translation: 我们的道馆馆主小椿正在等你。\p不过，泛泛之辈的训练家\n是绝对赢不了她的。$

label: BlackthornCity_Text_ClairIsBeaten
source: You defeated CLAIR?\pThat's amazing!\pI've never heard of her losing to\nanyone other than LANCE.$
translation: 你打赢了小椿？！\p太不可思议了！\p除了阿渡先生之外，\n我还没听说过有谁能赢过她。$

label: BlackthornGrampsRefusesEntryText
source: No. Only chosen trainers may train\nhere.\pPlease leave.$
translation: 不行，只有被选中的训练家\n才能在这里修行。\p请回吧。$

label: BlackthornGrampsGrantsEntryText
source: If CLAIR allows it, her grand-\nfather--our MASTER--will also.\pYou may enter.$
translation: 既然小椿允许了，\n她的祖父--也就是我们的长老想必也是。\p你可以进去了。$

label: BlackBeltText_VoicesInMyHead
source: Arooo! Voices in my head!\pHuh? I'm listening to my radio!$
translation: 哇啊--！脑子里有声音！\p咦？原来是我在听收音机啊！$

label: BlackthornCooltrainerF1Text
source: Are you going to make your POKéMON\nremember some moves?$
translation: 你是打算让你的宝可梦\n回忆起招式吗？$

label: BlackthornYoungsterText
source: Dragon masters all come from the city\nof BLACKTHORN.$
translation: 所有的龙属性大师，\n都是出自烟墨市哦。$

label: BlackthornCity_MeetSantosText
source: SANTOS: …\pI'm SANTOS of the weekday family.\pTake a guess.$
translation: 土夫：......\p我是星期兄弟姐妹里的土夫。\p猜猜看是星期几......$

label: BlackthornCity_SantosGivesGiftText
source: You can have this…$

label: BlackthornCity_SantosGaveGiftText
source: SANTOS: …\pSPELL TAG…\pGHOST-type moves get stronger…\pIt will frighten you…$
translation: 土夫：......\p诅咒之符......\p能提升幽灵属性招式的威力......\p可别被吓到了......$

label: BlackthornCity_SantosSaturdayText
source: SANTOS: …\pSee you again on another Saturday…\pI won't have any more gifts…$
translation: 土夫：......\p等下个星期六再见吧......\p不过我不会再送礼物了......$

label: BlackthornCity_SantosNopeText
source: SANTOS: No.$
translation: 土夫：不是。$

label: BlackthornCooltrainerF2Text
source: Wow, you came through the ICE PATH?\pYou must be a real hotshot trainer!$
translation: 哇，你是穿过冰之通路过来的吗？\p那你一定是个身手不凡的训练家！$

label: BlackthornCitySignText
source: BLACKTHORN CITY\pA Quiet Mountain Retreat$
translation: 烟墨市\p群山环抱的静谧山居$

label: BlackthornGymSignText
source: BLACKTHORN CITY POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: CLAIR\pThe Blessed User of Dragon POKéMON$
translation: 烟墨市宝可梦道馆\n馆主：小椿\p圣洁的龙属性宝可梦使者$

label: BlackthornCity_Text_MoveDeletersHouseSign
source: MOVE BROS' HOUSE$
translation: 招式专家之家$

label: BlackthornCity_Text_DragonDenSign
source: DRAGON'S DEN AHEAD$
translation: 前方 龙之穴$

label: BlackthornCity_House1_Text_Granny
source: A clan of trainers who can freely\ncommand dragons live right here in\lBLACKTHORN.\pAs a result, there are many legends\nabout dragons in this town.$
translation: 能够随心驾驭巨龙的一族，\n就生活在烟墨市。\p因此，这座城镇里流传着\n许多与龙相关的传说。$

label: BlackthornCity_House1_Text_Dratini
source: DRATINI: Draa!$
translation: 迷你龙：咪呜--！$

label: BlackthornCity_House2_Text_YouWillTradeWontYou
source: I collect POKéMON!\nDo you have a {STR_VAR_1}?\pWant to trade it for my\n{STR_VAR_2}?$
translation: 我正在收集宝可梦！\n你有{STR_VAR_1}吗？\p想用它来交换我的\n{STR_VAR_2}吗？$

label: BlackthornCity_House2_Text_MonYouTakeCare
source: Yay! I got myself {STR_VAR_1}!\p{STR_VAR_2}, you take care!$
translation: 太好啦！我得到{STR_VAR_1}了！\p{STR_VAR_2}，你要保重哦！$

label: BlackthornCity_House2_Text_ThisIsntAMon
source: Uh, no, I don't think so.\nThat isn't a {STR_VAR_1}.$
translation: 呃，不对吧。\n这并不是{STR_VAR_1}啊。$

label: BlackthornCity_House2_Text_YouWontTradeMe
