translation: 把做好的{POKEBLOCK}放进盒子里吧。\p做{POKEBLOCK}的时候，每个人\n都要放入不同种类的树果才行。$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_YourPokemonSpurredMeToPaint_hns
source: Congratulations!\pI did a painting of your POKéMON to\ncommemorate its victory…\pWell, your POKéMON's appeals were\nso fantastic, it spurred me into\lpainting better than I usually do.\lLook, see?$
translation: 恭喜你！\p为了纪念获胜，我给你的宝可梦\n画了一幅画......\p哎呀，你的宝可梦展现的精彩表演，\n激发了我的灵感，\l让我画得比平时还要出色呢。\l看，瞧瞧吧？$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ShouldITakePaintingToMuseum_hns
source:
What do you think? I'm confident in
what I've done, but do you like it?\pA work of this caliber, it wouldn't look
out of place in an art museum.\pHuh? An art museum really is looking
for paintings?\pDo you think I should take this there?$
translation: 你觉得怎么样？我自己是很有信心，\n不过你喜欢吗？\p这种水准的杰作，\n就算挂在美术馆里也毫不逊色呢。\p咦？美术馆真的在征集画作吗？\p你觉得我应该送去那里吗？$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_IllTakePaintingToMuseum_hns
source:
What, really? Then, sure, I will take
this painting there right now.\pI'll give it a proper title, too.\pI hope they'll like it and consider
exhibiting this.\pPlease check if they did accept this.
Thank you!$
translation:
咦，真的吗？那我这就把这幅画
送去那里。\p我还会给它起一个相称的名字。\p希望他们会喜欢，
并愿意展出这幅画。\p请你之后去看看他们有没有收下吧。
谢谢你！$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_TakeMementoOfPainting_hns
source: Oh, that's right!\pAs a memento of me painting your\nPOKéMON, please take this.$
translation: 啊，对了！\p为了纪念我给你的宝可梦画了肖像，\n请收下这个吧。$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ReceivedARibbon_hns
source: {PLAYER} received a RIBBON.$
translation: {PLAYER}获得了奖章。$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_PutTheRibbonOnMon_hns
source: {PLAYER} put the RIBBON on\n{STR_VAR_1}.$
translation: {PLAYER}将奖章戴在了\n{STR_VAR_1}身上。$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_OkaySeeYou_hns
source: Okay, see you!$
translation: 好啦，再见！$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_TakeHomeButIdLikeToTakeToMuseum_hns
source: Oh… Then, I guess I'll just take\nthis home with me…\pBut, you know, I would like to take\nthis to the art museum… Okay?$
translation: 啊......那我还是把它带回家去吧......\p不过说真的，我还是想送去美术馆呢......\n好不好嘛？$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_FineThatsTheWayItIs_hns
source: Oh, fine, that's the way it is.\nI will hang this in my own house.\pI'll just have to try harder next time.\nWell, be seeing you.$
translation: 哎，好吧，既然如此，\n我就把它挂在自己家里吧。\p下次我再加把劲就是了。\n那么，再见啦。$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_MasterRankHereICome_hns
source: Hoo, boy… Master Rank CONTESTS,\nhere I come.\pThe world will know that my dearest\nPOKéMON is the cutest being in all\lexistence. The time has come!\lUheheheh.$
translation: 呼......大师级华丽大赛，\n我来啦！\p我要让全世界都知道，我最心爱的宝可梦\n是全天下最可爱的存在。\l时机已经成熟！\l唔嘿嘿嘿。$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_WholeVarietyOfPokemonHere_hns
source: You can see a whole variety of\nPOKéMON here.\pThat's why I make this place a regular\npart of my daily stroll.$
translation: 在这里能看到各种各样的宝可梦呢。\p所以我每天散步\n都会顺道来这里看看。$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ContestFeastForEyes_hns
source: Wow, coming out to a CONTEST is\na feast for these eyes!\pWould you look at all the POKéMON\nthat just scream to be painted?$
translation: 哇，来看华丽大赛真是大饱眼福啊！\p你看看那些宝可梦，\n全都在迫不及待地等着被画下来呢！$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ToughContestIsExtreme_hns
source: The TOUGHNESS CONTEST is like\nextreme, man!\pThose muscular appeals…\nCascading sweat… I swoon!$
translation: 强壮组华丽大赛真是燃爆了，伙计！\p那一块块隆起的肌肉展示......\n那挥洒如雨的汗水......太迷人了！$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_LavishedCareOnMon_hns
source: Day in and day out, I lavished my care\non this POKéMON.\pIts condition is peaking.\nToday, victory is mine!$
translation: 日复一日，我倾注心血\n悉心照料这只宝可梦。\p它的状态如今已达到顶峰。\n今天的胜利非我莫属！$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_MadePokeblocksWithFamily_hns
source: I made {POKEBLOCK}S with Mom, Dad, and\nBig Sister. They turned out great!\pI bet you can make smoother, better\n{POKEBLOCK}S if you have more people.$
translation: 我和爸爸、妈妈还有姐姐一起做了\n{POKEBLOCK}。做得很成功哦！\p人越多的话，做出来的{POKEBLOCK}\n肯定会越细腻、越高级！$

label: LilycoveCity_House3_Text_LearnFromMasterOfPokeblocks
source:
Oh, my, my! Are you traveling alone?
But you're so young! Good for you!\pI'm sure my kids could learn a thing
or two from you!\pMe? I'm a master of {POKEBLOCK}S.\pIf I get serious just a little, why,
I can concoct great {POKEBLOCK}S.\pWould you like to learn from me,
a master of {POKEBLOCK}S?$
translation:
哎呀呀！你一个人在旅行吗？
年纪轻轻真了不起！好样的！\p我家那几个孩子真该向你好好学学！\p我？我可是个{POKEBLOCK}达人。\p只要我稍微认真一点，
就能调配出绝妙的{POKEBLOCK}哦。\p要不要向我这个{POKEBLOCK}达人
讨教两招呀？$

label: LilycoveCity_House3_Text_ExplainPokeblocks
source:
Oh, good! You're a smart soul!
This is a bit long, so listen up!\pAre you ready?\pIf you look at {POKEBLOCK}S, you should see
that they are rated on how they feel.\pThe lower the feel rating,
the better it is. Don't forget this!\pA good {POKEBLOCK} has a low feel
rating and a high level.\pA POKéMON can eat more good
{POKEBLOCK}S than ordinary ones, too.\pAnd this is important.\pIf you want to make smooth {POKEBLOCK}S,
use different kinds of BERRIES.\pDon't be stingy--the kinds of BERRIES
affect the smoothness of {POKEBLOCK}S.\pAnd another thing.\pThe more people blending BERRIES,
the smoother the {POKEBLOCK}S.\pThat's why you should talk to other
people and make {POKEBLOCK}S together.\pThat's about all you need to know to
make good {POKEBLOCK}S.\pIf everyone had POKéMON they love,
smooth {POKEBLOCK}S, and a loving family,\lthe world would be a happier place.\pDon't give up, dear!$
translation:
哎呀，太好了！你真机灵！
话有点长，可要听仔细咯！\p准备好了吗？\p查看{POKEBLOCK}时，你应该能看到
上面标有光滑度。\p光滑度数值越低，品质就越好。
可千万别忘了这点！\p优秀的{POKEBLOCK}，
光滑度低，而等级高。\p而且相比普通的，宝可梦能吃下
更多优秀的{POKEBLOCK}。\p接下来这句很关键。\p如果你想做出更细腻的{POKEBLOCK}，
就要使用不同种类的树果。\p可别舍不得--树果的种类
会直接影响{POKEBLOCK}的光滑度。\p还有一件事。\p一起混合树果的人越多，
做出来的{POKEBLOCK}就越细腻。\p所以呀，去多找其他人聊聊，
大家一起制作{POKEBLOCK}吧。\p制作优质{POKEBLOCK}的诀窍，
差不多就这些啦。\p如果大家都有心爱的宝可梦、
细腻的{POKEBLOCK}和温馨的家庭，\l这个世界一定会变得更加幸福吧。\p加油哦，孩子！$

label: LilycoveCity_House3_Text_MakePokeblocksWithBerryBlender
source: We're going to make super {POKEBLOCK}S\nwith a BERRY BLENDER!$
translation: 我们要用树果混合器\n做出超棒的{POKEBLOCK}！$

label: LilycoveCity_MoveDeletersHouse_Text_ICanMakeMonForgetMove
source: Uh…\nOh, yes, I'm the MOVE DELETER.\pI can make POKéMON forget their moves.\pWould you like me to do that?$
translation: 呃......\n噢，对了，我是招式遗忘爷爷。\p我能让宝可梦忘记它们学会的招式。\p需要我帮忙吗？$

label: RivalsHouse_1F_Text_MayWhoAreYou
source:
Huh?
Who… Who are you?\p… … … … … … … …
… … … … … … … …\pOh, you're {PLAYER}{KUN}.
So your move was today.\pUm… I'm MAY.
Glad to meet you!\pI…
I have this dream of becoming friends\lwith POKéMON all over the world.\pI… I heard about you, {PLAYER}{KUN}, from
my dad, PROF. BIRCH.\pI was hoping that you would be nice,
{PLAYER}{KUN}, and that we could be friends.\pOh, this is silly, isn't it?
I… I've just met you, {PLAYER}{KUN}.\pEheheh…\pOh, no! I forgot!\pI was supposed to go help Dad catch
some wild POKéMON!\p{PLAYER}{KUN}, I'll catch you later!$
translation:
咦？
你......你是谁？\p...... ...... ...... ......
...... ...... ...... ......\p啊，你是{PLAYER}{KUN}呀。
原来搬家就是今天啊。\p那个......我是小遥。
很高兴认识你！\p我......
我的梦想是和全世界的\l宝可梦都成为好朋友。\p我听爸爸小田卷博士
提起过你呢，{PLAYER}{KUN}。\p我一直希望{PLAYER}{KUN}是个好相处的人，
我们可以成为朋友呢。\p啊，我是不是有点傻呀？
我......我们才刚认识呢，{PLAYER}{KUN}。\p诶嘿嘿......\p糟糕！我都给忘了！\p我本来得去帮爸爸捕捉野生宝可梦的！\p{PLAYER}{KUN}，那我们回头见咯！$

label: RivalsHouse_1F_Text_BrendanWhoAreYou
source:
Hey!
You…\pWho are you?\pOh, you're {PLAYER}, aren't you?
Moved in next door, right?\pI didn't know that you're a girl.\pDad, PROF. BIRCH, said that our new
next-door neighbor is a GYM LEADER's\lkid, so I assumed you'd be a guy.\pMy name's BRENDAN.
So, hi, neighbor!\pHuh? Hey, {PLAYER}, don't you have
a POKéMON?\pDo you want me to go catch you one?\pAw, darn, I forgot…\pI'm supposed to go help my dad catch
some wild POKéMON.\pSome other time, okay?$
translation:
喂！
你......\p是谁啊？\p哦，你就是{PLAYER}吧？
搬到隔壁的就是你对吧？\p没想到你是个女孩子。\p我爸小田卷博士说，隔壁新搬来的是
道馆馆主的孩子，我还以为是个男生呢。\p我叫佑树。
嗨，新邻居！\p咦？喂，{PLAYER}，你还没有
宝可梦吗？\p要我帮你去捉一只吗？\p啊，糟了，我都给忘了......\p我还得去帮我爸捉野生宝可梦呢。\p下次再说吧，好吗？$

source:
Huh?
Who… Who are you?\p… … … … … … … …
… … … … … … … …\pOh, you're {PLAYER}{KUN}.
So your move was today.\pUm… I'm MAY.
Glad to meet you!\pI…

你......你是谁？\p...... ...... ...... ......

You…\pWho are you?\pOh, you're {PLAYER}, aren't you?

你......\p是谁啊？\p哦，你就是{PLAYER}吧？
搬到隔壁的就是你对吧？\p没想到你是个女孩子。\p我爸小田卷博士说，隔壁新搬来的是

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_CompletedDexChoosePokemon
source:
PROF. BIRCH: Oh, {PLAYER}{KUN}!
Let's have a look at your POKéDEX.\p… … … … … …
… … … … … …\pYes, there's no doubt about it.\pYou really have completed the HOENN
region's POKéDEX.\pThat's more than just impressive.\pI have a gift for you.\pConsider it my show of appreciation
for the fantastic work you've done.\pMy gift is a rare POKéMON only found
in another region!\pYou can have any one of these
three POKéMON!$
translation:
小田卷博士：哦，{PLAYER}{KUN}！
来让我看看你的宝可梦图鉴吧。\p...... ...... ......
...... ...... ......\p嗯，毫无疑问。\p你确实已经完成了丰缘地区的宝可梦图鉴。\p这可不仅仅是令人赞叹了。\p我有一份礼物要送给你。\p就算是我对你这份出色成果的谢礼吧。\p我的礼物是只能在其他地区见到的稀有宝可梦！\p这三只宝可梦里，
你可以任选一只！$

label: MahoganyTown_Gym_Text_GymStatue
source: MAHOGANY TOWN POKéMON GYM$
translation: 卡吉镇宝可梦道馆$

label: MahoganyTown_Gym_Text_GymStatueCertified
source: MAHOGANY TOWN POKéMON GYM\pPRYCE'S CERTIFIED TRAINERS:\n{PLAYER}$
translation: 卡吉镇宝可梦道馆\p柳伯认可的训练家：\n{PLAYER}$

label: MahoganyTown_Gym_Text_PryceIntro
source:
POKéMON have many experiences
in their lives, just like we do.\pI, too, have seen and suffered
much in my life.\pSince I am your elder, let me
show you what I mean.\pI have been with POKéMON since
before you were born.\pI do not lose easily.\pI, PRYCE--the winter trainer--
shall demonstrate my power!$
translation:
宝可梦的一生中，也会和我们一样
经历各种各样的事情。\p老夫在漫长的人生中，
也经历过许多风浪与磨难。\p既然老夫年长于你，
就让你见识一下其中的深意吧。\p早在你出生之前，
老夫便一直与宝可梦相伴至今。\p老夫可不会轻易言败。\p就由我冬之训练家--柳伯，
来向你展示我的实力！$

label: MahoganyTown_Gym_Text_PryceImpressed
source: Ah, I am impressed by your\nprowess.\pWith your strong will, I know you\nwill overcome all life's obstacles.\pYou are worthy of this BADGE!$
translation: 嗯，你的精湛实力让老夫深感佩服。\p凭借你那坚强的意志，\n定能跨越人生中的所有阻碍。\p这枚徽章非你莫属！$

label: MahoganyTown_Gym_Text_ReceivedBadge
source: {PLAYER} received GLACIERBADGE.$
translation: {PLAYER}获得了冰之徽章！$

label: MahoganyTown_Gym_Text_GlacierBadgeSpeech
source: That BADGE will raise the SPECIAL\nATTACK of POKéMON.\pIt also lets your POKéMON use\nWHIRLPOOL to get across\lreal whirlpools.\pAnd this… This is a gift from me!$
translation: 那枚徽章能提高宝可梦的特攻。\p它还能让你的宝可梦使用"潮旋"，\n穿过现实中的旋涡。\p还有这个......这是老夫送你的礼物！$

label: MahoganyTown_Gym_Text_HailSpeech
source: That TM contains HAIL.\pIt inflicts damage every\nturn for 5 turns.\pIt demonstrates the harshness\nof winter.$
translation: 那张招式学习器里面是"冰雹"。\p它能在5回合内，\n每回合都对对手造成伤害。\p充分展现了冬天的严苛与无情。$

label: MahoganyTown_Gym_Text_CherishPokemon
source: When the ice and snow melt,\nspring arrives.\pYou and your POKéMON will be\ntogether for many years to come.\pCherish your time together!$
translation: 当冰雪消融，\n春天就会来临。\p你和你的宝可梦在未来的漫长岁月里，\n也将一直相伴相随。\p好好珍惜你们在一起的时光吧！$

label: MahoganyTown_Gym_Text_PryceRematch
source:
Ah, JOHTO CHAMPION!\pYour skills are indeed
remarkable.\pI am impressed.\pBut even now, there is much to
learn from each other.\pI, PRYCE--the winter trainer--
still have a few tricks left.\pWant to have a rematch with me?$
translation:
啊，城都的冠军！\p你的实力的确
非同凡响。\p令老夫深感钦佩。\p不过即使到了现在，
我们彼此之间也仍有许多可以切磋学习的地方。\p老夫柳伯--这位冬之训练家--
可还有几手绝活没亮出来呢。\p要和老夫再战一场吗？$

label: MahoganyTown_Gym_Text_PryceRematchDefeat
source: Ah, yet again I'm impressed by\nyour prowess.\pWith your strong will, I know you\nwill overcome all life's obstacles.$
translation: 啊，老夫又一次\n被你的高超实力所折服。\p凭着你那坚强的意志，\n必定能克服人生中的一切艰难险阻。$

label: MahoganyTown_Gym_Text_Guide
source:
PRYCE is a veteran who has
trained POKéMON for some 50 years.\pHe's got a solid lineup of
POKéMON to cover whatever\lyou bring his way.\pFire is a good place to start,
but watch out for the rain!$
translation:
柳伯是位培育宝可梦
长达50年之久的泰斗级老将。\p无论你派出怎样的宝可梦，
他都有万全的阵容来应对。\p虽然火属性是不错的突破口，
但千万要当心下雨天哦！$

label: MahoganyTown_Gym_Text_GuideWin
source: PRYCE is something, but you're\nsomething else!\pThat was a hot battle that\nbridged the generation gap!$
translation: 柳伯实力非凡，\n但你更是技高一筹！\p那场跨越世代代沟的对决，\n真是让人热血沸腾啊！$

label: MahoganyTown_Gym_Text_BoarderRonaldSeen
source: I'll freeze your POKéMON,\nso you can't do a thing!$
translation: 我要把你的宝可梦冻成冰块，\n让你动弹不得！$

label: MahoganyTown_Gym_Text_BoarderRonaldBeaten
source: Darn. I couldn't do a thing.$
translation: 可恶，动弹不得的反而是我。$

label: MahoganyTown_Gym_Text_BoarderRonaldAfter
source: I think there's a move a\nPOKéMON can use while it's\lfrozen.$
translation: 我记得宝可梦就算被冻住了，\n好像也有招式可以使用呢。$

label: MahoganyTown_Gym_Text_BoarderBradSeen
source: This GYM has a slippery floor.\pIt's fun, isn't it?\pBut hey--we're not playing\ngames here!$
translation: 这家道馆的地面很滑吧。\p滑起来很过瘾，对不对？\p不过听好了--\n我们可不是在闹着玩的！$

label: MahoganyTown_Gym_Text_BoarderBradBeaten
source: Do you see how serious we are?$
translation: 见识到我们有多认真了吧？$

label: MahoganyTown_Gym_Text_BoarderBradAfter
source: This GYM is great.\nI love boarding with my\lPOKéMON!$
translation: 这家道馆太棒了。\n我最喜欢和我的宝可梦\l一起滑雪板了！$

label: MahoganyTown_Gym_Text_BoarderDouglasSeen
source: I know PRYCE's secret.$
translation: 我知道柳伯的秘密哦。$

label: MahoganyTown_Gym_Text_BoarderDouglasBeaten
source: OK. I'll tell you PRYCE's secret.$
translation: 好吧，我就把柳伯的秘密告诉你。$

label: MahoganyTown_Gym_Text_BoarderDouglasAfter
source: The secret behind PRYCE's power…\pHe meditates under a waterfall\ndaily to strengthen his mind\land body.$
translation: 柳伯强大的秘密就是......\p他每天都会在瀑布下冥想，\n以此来锻炼自己的身心。$

label: MahoganyTown_Gym_Text_SkierRoxanneSeen
source: To get to PRYCE, our GYM LEADER,\nyou need to think before you skate.$
translation: 想见到我们的道馆馆主柳伯，\n滑冰前可得先动动脑筋。$

label: MahoganyTown_Gym_Text_SkierRoxanneBeaten
source: I wouldn't lose to you in skiing!$
translation: 要是比滑雪，我才不会输给你！$

label: MahoganyTown_Gym_Text_SkierRoxanneAfter
source: If you don't skate with precision,\nyou won't get far in this GYM.$
translation: 滑冰时如果不精准掌控方向，\n在这家道馆可寸步难行哦。$

label: MahoganyTown_Gym_Text_SkierClarissaSeen
source: Check out my parallel turn!$
translation: 来见识一下我的平行转弯吧！$

label: MahoganyTown_Gym_Text_SkierClarissaBeaten
source: No! You made me wipe out!$
translation: 哇啊！你害我摔了个大跟头！$

label: MahoganyTown_Gym_Text_SkierClarissaAfter
source: I shouldn't have been bragging\nabout my skiing…$
translation: 我真不该吹嘘自己的滑雪技术......$

label: MahoganyTown_Text_RageCandyBarMerchantTryOne
source: Hiya, kid!\pI see you're new in MAHOGANY TOWN.\pSince you're new, you should try a\nyummy RAGECANDYBAR!\pRight now, it can be yours for just\n¥300! Want one?$
translation: 嗨，小朋友！\p看样子你是第一次来卡吉镇吧。\p既然是新来的，那就该尝尝\n美味的愤怒馒头！\p现在只要300日元就能买到一个！\n要来一个吗？$

label: MahoganyTown_Text_RageCandyBarMerchantSavorIt
source: Good! Savor it!$
translation: 好嘞！好好品尝吧！$

label: MahoganyTown_Text_RageCandyBarMerchantNotEnoughMoney
source: 你的钱不够。$
translation: 你的钱不够。$

label: MahoganyTown_Text_RageCandyBarMerchantRefused
source: Oh, fine then…$
translation: 哎，那就算了吧......$

label: MahoganyTown_Text_RageCandyBarMerchantSoldOut
source: RAGECANDYBAR's sold out.\pI'm packing up. Don't bother me,\nkiddo.$
translation:
愤怒之馒头卖光了。\p我正在收摊呢。别来烦我，
小鬼头。$

label: MahoganyTown_Text_Gramps
source: Are you off to see the GYARADOS\nrampage at the LAKE?$
translation:
你也是去湖里看
狂暴的暴鲤龙吗？$

label: MahoganyTown_Text_GrampsClearedRocketHideout
source: MAGIKARP have returned to LAKE\nOF RAGE.\pThat should be good news for the\nanglers there.$
translation:
鲤鱼王回到愤怒之湖了。\p这对那里的钓鱼者来说
应该是个好消息吧。$

label: MahoganyTown_Text_Fisher
source: Since you came this far, take the\ntime to do some sightseeing.\pYou should head north and check\nout LAKE OF RAGE right now.$
translation:
既然好不容易来了一趟，
就顺便观光一下吧。\p你现在应该往北去
愤怒之湖看看。$

label: MahoganyTown_Text_Lass
source: Visit Grandma's shop. She sells\nstuff that nobody else has.$
translation:
去老奶奶的店里逛逛吧。
她卖的东西别处可买不到呢。$

label: MahoganyTown_Text_Sign
source: MAHOGANY TOWN\pWelcome to the Home of the Ninja$
translation: 卡吉镇\p欢迎来到忍者之里$

label: MahoganyTown_Text_RagecandybarSign
source: While visiting MAHOGANY TOWN, try\na RAGECANDYBAR!$
translation:
来到卡吉镇，
别忘了尝尝愤怒之馒头！$

label: MahoganyTown_Text_GymSign
source: MAHOGANY TOWN POKéMON GYM\pLEADER: PRYCE\pThe Teacher of Winter's Harshness$
translation: 卡吉镇宝可梦道馆\p馆主：柳伯\p传授冬之严冬的老师$

label: MahoganyRedGyaradosHouse_Text_BlackBelt
source: I heard that a red GYARADOS appeared\nat the LAKE.\pThat's odd, since even ordinary\nGYARADOS are rare in that lake…$
translation:
我听说湖里出现了红色的暴鲤龙。\p这可真奇怪，因为那个湖里
就连普通的暴鲤龙都很少见呢......$

label: MahoganyRedGyaradosHouse_Text_Teacher
source: My favorite radio program? I'd say\nPOKéMON MUSIC.$
translation:
我最喜欢的广播节目？
那当然是宝可梦音乐了。$

label: MahoganyRedGyaradosHouse_Text_Teacher_Rockets
source: I've been hearing laughter on the\nradio…\pIt's creepy.$
translation: 我刚才在收音机里听到了笑声......\p真叫人毛骨悚然。$

label: MahoganyTown_PokemonCenter_Text_PokefanM
source: What's this? TEAM ROCKET has come\nback?\pI saw some men in black at LAKE OF\nRAGE…$
translation: 怎么回事？火箭队卷土重来了？\p我在愤怒之湖看到了几个黑衣人......$

label: MahoganyTown_PokemonCenter_Text_Youngster
source: I stop my POKéMON from evolving too\nearly.\pI make them learn certain moves\nbefore I let them evolve.$
translation:
我不会让我的宝可梦太早进化。\p我会让它们先学会某些招式，
然后再让它们进化。$

label: MahoganyTown_PokemonCenter_Text_CooltrainerF
source: POKéMON do become stronger when they\nevolve,\pbut they also learn moves more\nslowly.$
translation: 宝可梦进化后确实会变强，\p但学习新招式的速度也会变慢。$

label: MahoganyTown_Shop_Text_Granny
source: Please come back another time.\nThe store is... closed\lright now.$
translation:
请改天再来吧。
本店......现在已经打烊了。$

label: MahoganyMart1F_Text_Pharmacist_Lance
source: ROCKETS have hijacked my basement!$
translation: 火箭队霸占了我的地下室！$

label: MahoganyMart1F_Text_BlackBelt
source: Heheh! The experi- ment worked like\na charm.\pMAGIKARP are just worthless, but\nGYARADOS are big moneymakers.$
translation:
嘿嘿！实验进行得太顺利了。\p鲤鱼王一文不值，
但暴鲤龙可是能赚大钱的摇钱树啊。$

label: MahoganyMart1F_Text_BlackBelt_Lance
source: Urrgh…\pThat guy's POKéMON are tough…$
translation: 唔呃......\p那家伙的宝可梦太强了......$

label: MahoganyMart1F_Text_Lance_HyperBeam
source: LANCE: DRAGONITE, HYPER BEAM.$
translation: 阿渡：快龙，破坏光线。$

label: MahoganyMart1F_Text_Lance_Radio
source: What took you, {PLAYER}?\pJust as we thought, that strange\nradio signal is coming from here.$
translation:
你可算来了，{PLAYER}。\p果然不出所料，那段奇怪的
电波就是从这里发出的。$

label: MahoganyMart1F_Text_Lance_Stairs
source: Excellent work finding the stairs,\nDRAGONITE!$
translation:
干得漂亮，快龙！
多亏你找到了楼梯！$

label: MahoganyMart1F_Text_Lance_SplitUp
source: LANCE: {PLAYER}, we should split up\nto check this place.\pI'll go first.$
translation:
阿渡：{PLAYER}，我们分头
调查这里吧。\p我先走一步。$

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_DontHaveEnoughMoneyFor50
source: Um… You don't appear to have\nenough money to buy COINS…\pPlease come back when you have\nat least ¥1000!$
translation:
那个......你的钱似乎不够
购买代币呢......\p请带上至少1000日元再来吧！$

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_NoRoomFor50Coins
source: Oh! Your COIN CASE is too full to buy\nany more COINS!\pEnjoy the GOLDENROD GAME CORNER or\nexchange your COINS for prizes before\lcoming back!$
translation:
哎呀！你的代币盒已经装满了，
不能再购买代币了！\p去满金游戏城玩一玩，
或者兑换些奖品后再来吧！$

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_NoRoomForCoins
source: Oh?\nYour COIN CASE can't fit those COINS...$
translation: 咦？\n你的代币盒装不下那么多代币呢......$

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_ThanksBuyCoins
source: Thank you for buying some COINS!\nGood luck on your adventure!$
translation: 感谢购买代币！\n祝你的冒险一切顺利！$

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_WattsonIntro
source:
I've given up on my plans to convert
the city, I have.\pAnd so, I put my time into making
door traps in my GYM.\pOh? Now, what are you doing here?\pWhat's that? You say you've gotten
past all my rigged doors?\pWahahahah!
Now, that is amusing!\pThen, I, WATTSON, the LEADER of
MAUVILLE GYM, shall electrify you!$
translation:
改造城市的计划我早就放弃啦。\p所以我把时间都花在
道馆的机关门上了。\p哦？那你在这里做什么？\p你说什么？
你说你破解了我所有的机关门？\p哇哈哈哈哈！
真是有意思！\p那么，就让我紫堇道馆的馆主铁旋，
给你来点电击的刺激吧！$

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_ExplainShockWave
source: That TM34 there contains SHOCK WAVE.\pIt's a trustworthy move that never\nmisses! You can count on it!\p… … … … … …$
translation: 那张招式学习器34里装的是"电击波"。\p这招绝对命中，非常可靠！\n信它准没错！\p..................$

label: Alola_Melemele_GetOffBoat_Text_0
source: Welcome back to the ISLES!\pCome back if you'd like to take a trip\nto mainland KANTO!$
translation: 欢迎回到群岛！\p如果想去关都大陆旅行，\n随时再来找我！$

label: Alola_Melemele_TravelToKanto_Text_0
source: Ahoy!\pWould you like to travel to mainland\nKANTO?$
translation: 嗨！\p想去关都大陆吗？$

label: Alola_Melemele_TravelToKanto_Text_1
source: Ahoy! Let's get you on board!$
translation: 嗨！这就带你上船！$

label: Alola_Melemele_TravelToKanto_Text_2
source: Ahoy!\nCome back when you'd like to set sail.$
translation: 嗨！\n想启航的时候随时再来。$

label: Alola_Melemele_Mailbox_Text_0
source: SAMSON OAK's VILLA$
translation: 成也・大木的别墅$

label: Alola_Melemele_Melemele_Sign_Text_0
source: Welcome to MELEMELE ISLE!$
translation: 欢迎来到美乐美乐岛！$

label: Alola_Melemele_Pokecenter_Sign_Text_0
source: Welcome to the MELEMELE ISLE\nPOKéMON CENTER!\pThis is the only POKéMON CENTER on the\nALOLA ISLES but you can rest on\lbenches around the ISLES.$
translation: 欢迎来到美乐美乐岛的\n宝可梦中心！\p这里是阿罗拉群岛上唯一的宝可梦中心，\n不过你也可以在群岛各处的长椅上休息。$

label: Alola_Melemele_MelemeleMart_Sign_Text_0
source: MELEMELE ISLE MART$
translation: 美乐美乐岛 友好商店$

label: Alola_Melemele_BattleSandygast_Text_0
source: Coorr!$

label: Alola_Melemele_SamsonOak_Trigger_Beginning_Text_0
source: ALOLA!$
translation: 阿罗拉！$

label: Alola_Melemele_SamsonOak_Trigger_Beginning_Text_1
source: Welcome to the ALOLA ISLES!$
translation: 欢迎来到阿罗拉群岛！$

label: Alola_Melemele_SamsonOak_Trigger_Beginning_Text_2
source: My name is SAMSON OAK!\nI'm a POKéMON PROFESSOR.\pWhat's your name?$
translation: 我叫成也・大木！\n是一名宝可梦博士。\p你叫什么名字？$

label: Alola_Melemele_SamsonOak_Trigger_Beginning_Text_3
source: Ah, {PLAYER}.\nA fine name!\pYou may know my cousin, PROFESSOR OAK,\nfrom the KANTO region.\pLet me show you to town!$
translation: 啊，{PLAYER}。\n真是个好名字！\p你可能认识我在关都地区的堂兄--\n大木博士吧。\p来，我带你去镇上！$

label: Alola_Melemele_SamsonOak_Trigger_Beginning_Text_4
source: This is the main town on these islands.\pIt's eerily similar to HAU'OLI CITY in\nALOLA… {PAUSE 30}And when I think about it…\pThis whole island reminds me of MELEMELE\nISLAND…$
translation: 这里是群岛的主要城镇。\p它和阿罗拉的好奥乐市惊人地相似......\n{PAUSE 30}这么一想......\p这整座岛也让我联想到了美乐美乐岛......$

label: Alola_Melemele_SamsonOak_Trigger_Beginning_Text_5
source:
Well, anyways!\pI research variations of POKéMON that 
can be found in different regions!\pOn my way back from the ALOLA region,
I stumbled across these isles…\pSurprisingly, many of the POKéMON I saw
in ALOLA were here as well, so I've\lcalled this place… {PAUSE 30}the ALOLA ISLES!$
translation: 哎呀，不管怎么说！\p我致力于研究不同地区的宝可梦形态！\p在从阿罗拉地区回来的路上，\n我偶然发现了这些岛屿......\p令人惊讶的是，我在阿罗拉见过的许多宝可梦\n这里居然也有，所以我把这里称为......\l{PAUSE 30}阿罗拉群岛！$

label: Alola_Melemele_SamsonOak_Trigger_Beginning_Text_6
source:
Now I haven't completely explored the
ISLES yet… {PAUSE 30}I just landed here myself.\pI'd like to know if all of the variants
native to ALOLA are here.\pIf you happen to come across any,
please come by my villa on the east side\lof the ISLE and show them to me!\pOh. And feel free to explore the ISLE
while on your way!\pSee you there!$
translation: 虽说我还没把群岛彻底调查一遍......\n{PAUSE 30}毕竟我也是刚登岛不久。\p我想知道阿罗拉独有的形态是否都在这里。\p要是你碰巧遇到了，\n请顺路来岛东侧的别墅给我瞧瞧！\p哦，去别墅的路上也别忘了好好探索这座岛屿！\p回头见啦！$

label: Alola_Melemele_NeedToTalkToSamsonOak_Text_0
source: SAMSON is waiting for you at his villa…\n{PAUSE 30}best not make him wait too long!$
translation: 成也博士正在别墅等你呢......\n{PAUSE 30}最好别让他等太久！$

label: Alola_Melemele_TotemBattle_Text_0
source: Leee!$

label: Alola_Melemele_TotemBattle_Text_1
source: Totem LEAFEON was defeated!\nIt scampered off somewhere…$
translation: 霸主叶伊布被击溃了！\n它不知道逃窜到哪里去了......$

label: Alola_Melemele_TotemBattle_Text_2
source: Thhhh!$

label: Alola_Melemele_TotemBattle_Text_3
source: Totem RATICATE was defeated!\nIt scampered off somewhere…$
translation: 霸主拉达被打倒了！\n它不知逃窜到哪里去了......$

label: Alola_Melemele_Totem_sign_Text_0
source: The totem is emanating a strong\nenergy…\pTouch the totem to teleport to another\nIsle?$
translation: 图腾正散发出一股强烈的能量......\p要触碰图腾传送至其他岛屿吗？$

label: Alola_Melemele_Totem_sign_Text_1
source: MELEMELE ISLE$
translation: 美乐美乐岛$

label: Alola_Melemele_Totem_sign_Text_2
source: AKALA ISLE$
translation: 阿卡拉岛$

label: Alola_Melemele_Totem_sign_Text_3
source: ULA'ULA ISLE$
translation: 乌拉乌拉岛$

label: Alola_Melemele_Totem_sign_Text_4
source: PONI ISLE$
translation: 波尼岛$

label: Alola_Melemele_Totem_sign_Text_5
source: 取消$
translation: 取消$

label: Alola_Melemele_Totem_sign_Text_6
source: A strange totem stands here,\npower is emanating from it…$
translation: 这里伫立着一个奇异的图腾，\n正散发出一股能量......$

label: Alola_Melemele_BattleVsTapuKoko_Text_0
source: Ko-Ko-Kooo!$

label: Alola_Melemele_TrainerBattleSwimmer_Text_0
source: The waters are warm here by the ISLES!$
translation: 群岛这边的海水真暖和啊！$

label: Alola_Melemele_TrainerBattleSwimmer_Text_1
source: Maybe I should dry off on land for\na bit…$
translation: 也许我该上岸晒干一下身体......$

label: Alola_Melemele_TrainerBattleSwimmer_Text_2
source: There are plenty of neat POKéMON in\nthe water, try all your fishing rods!$
translation: 水里有好多很棒的宝可梦，\n把你所有的钓竿都试一遍吧！$

label: Alola_Melemele_Bugcatcher_Text_0
source: The bug POKéMON on the ALOLA ISLES\nare much bigger than those in KANTO!$
translation: 阿罗拉群岛上的虫属性宝可梦，\n可比关都的大得多呢！$

label: Alola_Melemele_camper_Text_0
source: I traveled all the way from KANTO to see\na variant of my favorite cat POKéMON,\lMEOWTH!$
translation: 我大老远从关都赶来，就是为了见识一下\n我最喜欢的猫猫宝可梦--喵喵\l的其他形态！$

label: Alola_Melemele_Picnicker_Text_0
source: These ISLES are chock full of unique\nPOKéMON!\pI need to stock up on POKé BALLS so I\ncan catch them all!$
translation: 这些群岛上到处都是与众不同的宝可梦！\p我得多备点精灵球，\n把它们全部收服才行！$

label: Alola_Pokemart_Cook_Text_0
source: The MALASADAS here are delicious.\nJust like the real ones in ALOLA!$
translation: 这里的马拉萨达真好吃。\n简直和阿罗拉当地的一模一样！$

label: Alola_Pokemart_BaldMan_Text_0
source: I'm looking for some sunscreen!\pIt's sunnier here on the ISLES!$
translation: 我在找防晒霜呢！\p这群岛上的太阳可毒辣多了！$

label: Melemele_House3_Woman_Text_0
source: Island life here is so peaceful!\pAnd it's nice that my grandkids are just\na quick boat ride away in KANTO!$
translation: 这里的海岛生活真惬意！\p而且我的孙辈们都在关都，\n坐一小会儿船就能见到，太棒了！$

label: Melemele_House3_Man_Text_0
source: Dang tourists!\pMy realtor said this place would be\nquiet… but I guess its cheaper to \ltravel here than all the way to ALOLA.$
translation: 讨厌的游客！\p房产中介明明跟我说这里很清静的......\n不过比起大老远去阿罗拉，\l来这儿旅游确实便宜得多。$

label: Melemele_House4_Man_Text_0
source: We're vacationing on the ALOLA ISLES!\pIt's just like the ALOLA region,\nbut closer to KANTO!\pI saved so much on travel expenses!$
translation: 我们正在阿罗拉群岛度假呢！\p这里就像阿罗拉地区一样，\n而且离关都更近！\p省下了一大笔路费呢！$

label: Melemele_House4_Woman_Text_0
source: My boyfriend told me we were going to\nALOLA…\pI had assumed it would be the ALOLA\nregion, not the small isles off the\lcoast of KANTO.$
translation: 我男朋友跟我说我们要去阿罗拉......\p我还以为是阿罗拉地区呢，\n没想到只是关都沿海的这些小岛。$

label: Melemele_House5_Mom_Text_0
source: I'm thinking of moving to the ALOLA\nregion with my son, ELIO.\pWe're just getting a little taste here\non the ISLES!$
translation: 我正考虑带我儿子朗日搬去阿罗拉地区。\p我们先在这座群岛上提前体验一下！$

label: Melemele_House5_Son_Text_0
source: Hehe... tag is so fun!$
translation: 嘿嘿......抓人游戏太好玩啦！$

label: Melemele_House5_Son_Text_1
source: Try to catch me MEOWTH!$
translation: 来抓我呀，喵喵！$

label: Melemele_House5_Cat_Text_0
source: Mwaaawwwrrrrrrrr!!!$
translation: 喵嗷呜呜呜呜呜！！！$

label: Melemele_House6_Hiker_Text_0
source: I bought this place so that my son\nand I could explore the outdoors…\pAll he wants to do is play on that\nGame Boy Advance.$
translation: 我买下这栋房子本是想带儿子\n好好探索一下大自然的......\p结果他满脑子就只想捧着那台\nGame Boy Advance玩个不停。$

label: Melemele_House6_GameboyKid_Text_0
source:
I have a game on my Game Boy Advance
that lets me explore the ALOLA Region!\pIt's just like the real thing.\pIt's called ULTRA ECLIPSE,
by PHANTONOMY!\pHaha, look!
I'm riding an icy NOIVERN!$
translation:
我的Game Boy Advance里有个游戏，
可以在里面探索阿罗拉地区！\p跟真的一模一样呢。\p名字叫《究极日蚀》，
是PHANTONOMY制作的！\pHaha，快看！
我正骑着一只冰属性的音波龙呢！$

label: Alola_Melemele_Pokecenter_Text_Swimmer
source: Ah, it's so hard to keep these\nisles straight!\pI always seem to mix them up!\pThank goodness for this map!$
translation: 哎呀，这些岛屿真是让人分不清！\p我总是会把它们搞混！\p多亏有这张地图在！$

label: Alola_Melemele_Pokecenter_AceTrainer_Text_0
source: There are so many unique POKéMON here!\nI'm gonna catch 'em all!$
translation: 这里有好多特别的宝可梦！\n我要把它们全部收服！$

label: Alola_Melemele_Pokecenter_BugCatcher_Text_0
source: I found some brand new POKéMON\nhere on the ISLES!\pLike my new friend RATTATA here!$
translation: 我在群岛上发现了一些全新的宝可梦！\p比如我的新朋友--这只小拉达！$

label: Alola_Melemele_Pokecenter_Grubbin_Text_0
source: Grrr!$
translation: 咕噜噜！$

label: Alola_Melemele_Pokecenter_Jessica_Text_WantToTrade
source: The {STR_VAR_2} out here aren't like\nthe ones on the mainland.\pWant to trade for my {STR_VAR_2}?$
translation: 这里的{STR_VAR_2}和大陆上的不大一样。\p想拿你的宝可梦来换我的{STR_VAR_2}吗？$

label: Alola_Melemele_Pokecenter_Jessica_Text_TakeCare
source: Thanks!\nTORY, you take care!$
translation: 谢谢你！\n托里，你要多保重啊！$

label: Alola_Melemele_Pokecenter_Jessica_Text_DeclineTrade
source: You don't want to trade? Aww...$
translation: 不想交换吗？好吧......$

label: Alola_Melemele_Pokecenter_Jessica_Text_TradeCompleted
source: Hi, how's my old TORY doing?$
translation: 嗨，我的老托里过得怎么样？$

label: Alola_Melemele_Pokecenter_Map_Text_0
source: {PLAYER} took a closer look at the\nALOLA ISLES map.$
translation: {PLAYER}仔细查看了\n阿罗拉群岛的地图。$

label: Alola_Melemele_SamsonOakVillaIntro_Trigger_Text_0
source: Alola, {PLAYER}!$
translation: 阿罗拉，{PLAYER}！$

label: Alola_Melemele_SamsonOakVillaIntro_Trigger_Text_1
source:
I'm glad you're here!
Welcome to my villa!\pI'm staying here while I research the
ALOLA ISLES for their similarity to\lthe ALOLA region.\pI'm particularly interested in the
phenomenon of “Regional Variants”.$
translation: 太好了，你来啦！\n欢迎来到我的别庄！\p我正住在这里调查阿罗拉群岛，\n研究它与阿罗拉地区的相似之处呢。\p我尤其对"地区形态"的现象很感兴趣。$

label: Alola_Melemele_SamsonOakVillaIntro_Trigger_Text_2
source:
You seem quite capable.\pYou'd be perfect to help with my survey
of the ALOLA ISLES!\pExplore all the ISLES have to offer,
and if you find any familiar POKéMON\lthat resemble those from KANTO…\lcome back and show me your POKéDEX!\pI'll be here patiently waiting to hear
about your progress!$
translation: 你看上去实力相当不错呢。\p如果是你，来协助我调查阿罗拉群岛\n绝对再合适不过了！\p去探索所有岛屿吧，\n要是发现了长得像关都地区\l那些眼熟的宝可梦......\l就回来把宝可梦图鉴展示给我看！\p我会在这里耐心等待你的好消息！$

label: Alola_Melemele_SamsonOakVilla_Dialogue_Text_0
source: Wow!\nYou saw the Guardian Deities!\pIncredible work, {PLAYER}.\pI found this while wandering about.\pI'm not entirely sure what it's for,\nbut you should take it.$
translation: 哇！\n你见到守护神了？！\p干得太漂亮了，{PLAYER}。\p这是我四处闲逛时捡到的。\p我也不太清楚这有什么用，\n不过你收下吧。$

label: Alola_Melemele_SamsonOakVilla_Dialogue_Text_1
source: The ALOLA ISLES must truly be special if\nthe Guardians themselves visited!$
translation: 既然守护神们都亲自现身了，\n这阿罗拉群岛一定非同寻常！$

label: Alola_Melemele_SamsonOakVilla_Dialogue_Text_2
source:
Thanks for your help with my research,
{PLAYER}!\pOur understanding of the ALOLA ISLES
has greatly improved thanks to you!\pI hope you continue to explore the
ISLES to find all the secrets that\lthey hold!$
translation:
多亏有你协助我的研究，
{PLAYER}！\p托你的福，我们对阿罗拉群岛的
了解有了极大的进展！\p希望你能继续探索这些岛屿，
揭开它们所隐藏的所有秘密！$

label: Alola_Melemele_SamsonOakVilla_Dialogue_Text_3
source: Alola {PLAYER}!\pSo you managed to defeat all of the\nTotem POKéMON on the ISLES, did you?\pThat's quite an accomplishment!\pIt's been long enough…\pI think it's about time we had a battle,\ndon't you?$
translation: 阿罗拉，{PLAYER}！\p这么说，你把群岛上所有的霸主宝可梦\n都打败了，是吗？\p这可是一项相当了不起的成就！\p我们认识也很久了......\p差不多是时候来一场宝可梦对战了，\n你觉得呢？$

label: Alola_Melemele_SamsonOakVilla_Dialogue_Text_4
source: Great!\nI won't be taking it easy on you!$
translation: 太棒了！\n我可不会手下留情哦！$

label: Alola_Melemele_SamsonOakVilla_Dialogue_Text_5
source: Incredible, {PLAYER}!$
translation: 太不可思议了，{PLAYER}！$

label: Alola_Melemele_SamsonOakVilla_Dialogue_Text_6
source:
Wow, {PLAYER}!
You really are a powerful Trainer!\pYou've proven worthy of a secret
I've been keeping about these ISLES…\pI'm not the only one who's noticed a
striking resemblance between the ALOLA\lISLES and the ALOLA region…\pIt seems the Tapu Guardians themselves
have been visiting the ISLES.\pIf you see them fly over the ISLES, head
to the totems… They may be there \lwaiting for you!$
translation:
哇，{PLAYER}！
你真是一位强大的训练家！\p你已经证明了自己有资格知晓
我一直保守的关于这些岛屿的秘密......\p并不是只有我注意到了阿罗拉群岛
与阿罗拉地区之间的惊人相似之处......\p卡璞守护神们似乎也亲自造访了这些岛屿。\p如果你看到它们飞过岛屿，就前往图腾柱......
它们也许正在那里等着你呢！$

label: Alola_Melemele_SamsonOakVilla_Dialogue_Text_7
source: What are you waiting for, {PLAYER}?\nGo out there and explore!$
translation: 还在等什么呢，{PLAYER}？\n快去外面探索吧！$

label: Alola_Melemele_SamsonOakVilla_Dialogue_Text_8
source: No worries, {PLAYER}!\pTake your time to prepare for the\nbattle, and come back when you're\lready!$
translation: 没关系，{PLAYER}！\p慢慢做好对战的准备，\n准备好了再来找我吧！$

label: Alola_Melemele_SamsonOakVilla_Dialogue_Text_9
source: Alola {PLAYER}!\pSo you've found all the Alolan variants\non the ISLES, but have you defeated all\lthe Totem POKéMON yet?\pYou should look for a strange pillar on\neach isle, the Totem POKéMON will be\lguarding it!$
translation: 阿罗拉，{PLAYER}！\p虽然你已经找到了群岛上所有的阿罗拉形态，\n不过你打败所有的霸主宝可梦了吗？\p你应该去每座岛上寻找奇异的石柱，\n霸主宝可梦就在那里守卫着它！$

label: Alola_Melemele_SamsonOakVilla_Dialogue_Text_10
source: Hello again, {PLAYER}!\pHow's your research on the ALOLA ISLES\ncoming along?\pWould you like to share your progress\nabout a specific isle with me?$
translation: 又见面了，{PLAYER}！\p你对阿罗拉群岛的调查进展如何了？\p想和我分享某一特定岛屿的调查成果吗？$

label: Alola_Melemele_SamsonOakVilla_Dialogue_Text_11
source: MELEMELE ISLE$
translation: 美乐美乐岛$

label: Alola_Melemele_SamsonOakVilla_Dialogue_Text_12
source: AKALA ISLE$
translation: 阿卡拉岛$

label: Alola_Melemele_SamsonOakVilla_Dialogue_Text_13
source: ULA'ULA ISLE$
translation: 乌拉乌拉岛$

label: Alola_Melemele_SamsonOakVilla_Dialogue_Text_14
source: PONI ISLE$
translation: 波尼岛$

label: Alola_Melemele_SamsonOakVilla_Dialogue_Text_15
source: Not right now.$
translation: 现在先不用。$

label: Alola_Melemele_SamsonOakVilla_Dialogue_Text_16
source: Let me take a look at your POKéDEX{PAUSE 15}.{PAUSE 15}.{PAUSE 15}.$
translation: 让我看一下你的宝可梦图鉴吧{PAUSE 15}......{PAUSE 15}......{PAUSE 15}。$

label: Alola_Melemele_SamsonOakVilla_Dialogue_Text_17
source: Wow, {PLAYER}!$
translation: 哇，{PLAYER}！$

label: Alola_Melemele_SamsonOakVilla_Dialogue_Text_18
source: You found all the Alolan variants living\non MELEMELE ISLE!$
translation: 你找到了生活在美乐美乐岛上的\n所有阿罗拉形态！$

label: Alola_Melemele_SamsonOakVilla_Dialogue_Text_19
source: And it looks like you've found all the\nAlolan variants on the other ISLES too!\pThat's amazing, {PLAYER}!\pYou should be very proud of yourself!$
translation: 而且看起来你也找齐了\n其他岛屿上的所有阿罗拉形态！\p太不可思议了，{PLAYER}！\p你真该为自己感到骄傲！$

label: Alola_Melemele_SamsonOakVilla_Dialogue_Text_20
source:
You've helped me validate that all
of the Alolan variants are present on\lthe ALOLA ISLES!\pI'd like you to help me with one more
thing…\pCould you help me investigate the Totem
POKéMON that are said to be guarding\lthe totems on each ISLE?\pBut beware! These Totem POKéMON are
said to be much stronger than their\lnormal counterparts…\pYou never know who might be watching
to see if you are a worthy opponent!$
translation:
多亏了你，我得以证实所有的阿罗拉形态
都在阿罗拉群岛上生活着！\p我还想请你帮我做一件事......\p你能帮我调查一下据守在各岛图腾处
的霸主宝可梦吗？\p但千万要小心！据说这些霸主宝可梦
比同类的普通宝可梦强大得多......\p说不定正有谁在暗中观察，
看你是否配做真正的对手呢！$

label: Alola_Melemele_SamsonOakVilla_Dialogue_Text_21
source: Keep exploring the other ISLES and\nreport your progress to me!$
translation: 继续探索其他岛屿，\n并向我汇报你的进展吧！$

label: Alola_Melemele_SamsonOakVilla_Dialogue_Text_22
source: It seems you've already found all the\nAlolan variants on MELEMELE ISLE!\pGreat job!\pKeep exploring the other ISLES and\nreport your progress to me!$
translation: 看来你已经找齐了美乐美乐岛上的\n所有阿罗拉形态！\p干得好！\p继续探索其他岛屿，\n并向我汇报你的进展吧！$

label: Alola_Melemele_SamsonOakVilla_Dialogue_Text_23
source:
Let me take a look at your POKéDEX{PAUSE 15}.{PAUSE 15}.{PAUSE 15}.\pIt seems you haven't quite found all of
the Alolan variants on MELEMELE ISLE\ljust yet.\pI've heard MELEMELE ISLE has {COLOR RED}4 {COLOR DARK_GRAY}Alolan
variants for you to find…\p{COLOR RED}RATTATA{COLOR DARK_GRAY}, {COLOR RED}RATICATE{COLOR DARK_GRAY}, {COLOR RED}MEOWTH{COLOR DARK_GRAY}, and
{COLOR RED}PERSIAN{COLOR DARK_GRAY}.\pKeep on searching and come back when
you've caught them all!$
translation:
让我看看你的宝可梦图鉴{PAUSE 15}......{PAUSE 15}......{PAUSE 15}......\p看来你还没有找齐美乐美乐岛上
所有的阿罗拉样子的宝可梦呢。\p我听说美乐美乐岛上有{COLOR RED}4{COLOR DARK_GRAY}种阿罗拉样子
的宝可梦等着你去发现......\p分别是{COLOR RED}小拉达{COLOR DARK_GRAY}、{COLOR RED}拉达{COLOR DARK_GRAY}、
{COLOR RED}喵喵{COLOR DARK_GRAY}和{COLOR RED}猫老大{COLOR DARK_GRAY}。\p继续探索吧，
等把它们都捉齐了再来找我！$

label: Alola_Melemele_SamsonOakVilla_Dialogue_Text_24
source: You found all the Alolan variants living\non AKALA ISLE!$
translation: 你找到了生活在阿卡拉岛上的\n所有阿罗拉样子的宝可梦！$

label: Alola_Melemele_SamsonOakVilla_Dialogue_Text_25
source:
Now that you've helped me validate that
all of the Alolan variants are present\lon the ALOLA ISLES.\pI'd like you to help me with one more
thing…\pCould you help me investigate the Totem
POKéMON that are said to be guarding\lthe totems on each isle?\pBut beware! These Totem POKéMON are
said to be much stronger than their\lnormal counterparts…\pYou never know who might be watching
to see if you are a worthy opponent!$
translation:
多亏了你，我终于确认了阿罗拉群岛上
栖息的所有阿罗拉样子的宝可梦。\p不过，我还想请你帮我一个忙......\p你能帮我去调查一下传说中守护着
各岛屿霸主之证的"霸主宝可梦"吗？\p千万要当心！据说那些霸主宝可梦
比通常形态的要强大得多......\p说不定正有谁在暗中观察，
看你是否具备挑战的资格呢！$

label: Alola_Melemele_SamsonOakVilla_Dialogue_Text_26
source: It seems you've already found all the\nAlolan variants on AKALA ISLE!\pGreat job!\pKeep exploring the other ISLES and\nreport your progress to me!$
translation: 看来你已经找齐阿卡拉岛上\n所有阿罗拉样子的宝可梦了！\p干得漂亮！\p继续探索其他岛屿，\n随时来向我汇报进展吧！$

label: Alola_Melemele_SamsonOakVilla_Dialogue_Text_27
source:
Let me take a look at your POKéDEX{PAUSE 15}.{PAUSE 15}.{PAUSE 15}.\pIt seems you haven't quite found all of
the Alolan variants on AKALA ISLE\ljust yet.\pI've heard AKALA ISLE has {COLOR RED}4 {COLOR DARK_GRAY}Alolan
variants for you to find…\p{COLOR RED}RAICHU{COLOR DARK_GRAY}, {COLOR RED}MAROWAK{COLOR DARK_GRAY}, {COLOR RED}DIGLETT{COLOR DARK_GRAY}, and {COLOR RED}DUGTRIO{COLOR DARK_GRAY}.\pKeep on searching and come back when
you've caught them all!$
translation:
让我看看你的宝可梦图鉴{PAUSE 15}......{PAUSE 15}......{PAUSE 15}......\p看来你还没有找齐阿卡拉岛上
所有的阿罗拉样子的宝可梦呢。\p我听说阿卡拉岛上有{COLOR RED}4{COLOR DARK_GRAY}种阿罗拉样子
的宝可梦等着你去发现......\p分别是{COLOR RED}雷丘{COLOR DARK_GRAY}、{COLOR RED}嘎啦嘎啦{COLOR DARK_GRAY}、
{COLOR RED}地鼠{COLOR DARK_GRAY}和{COLOR RED}三地鼠{COLOR DARK_GRAY}。\p继续探索吧，
等把它们都捉齐了再来找我！$

label: Alola_Melemele_SamsonOakVilla_Dialogue_Text_28
source: You found all the Alolan variants living\non ULA'ULA ISLE!$
translation: 你找到了生活在乌拉乌拉岛上的\n所有阿罗拉样子的宝可梦！$

label: Alola_Melemele_SamsonOakVilla_Dialogue_Text_29
source: It seems you've already found all the\nAlolan variants on ULA'ULA ISLE!\pGreat job!\pKeep exploring the other ISLES and\nreport your progress to me!$
translation: 看来你已经找齐乌拉乌拉岛上\n所有阿罗拉样子的宝可梦了！\p干得漂亮！\p继续探索其他岛屿，\n随时来向我汇报进展吧！$

label: Alola_Melemele_SamsonOakVilla_Dialogue_Text_30
source:
Let me take a look at your POKéDEX{PAUSE 15}.{PAUSE 15}.{PAUSE 15}.\pIt seems you haven't quite found all of
the Alolan variants on ULA'ULA ISLE\ljust yet.\pI've heard ULA'ULA ISLE has {COLOR RED}6 {COLOR DARK_GRAY}Alolan
variants for you to find…\p{COLOR RED}VULPIX{COLOR DARK_GRAY}, {COLOR RED}NINETALES{COLOR DARK_GRAY}, {COLOR RED}SANDSHREW{COLOR DARK_GRAY}, {COLOR RED}SANDSLASH{COLOR DARK_GRAY},
{COLOR RED}GRIMER{COLOR DARK_GRAY}, and {COLOR RED}MUK{COLOR DARK_GRAY}.\pKeep on searching and come back when
you've caught them all!$
translation:
让我看看你的宝可梦图鉴{PAUSE 15}......{PAUSE 15}......{PAUSE 15}......\p看来你还没有找齐乌拉乌拉岛上
所有的阿罗拉样子的宝可梦呢。\p我听说乌拉乌拉岛上有{COLOR RED}6{COLOR DARK_GRAY}种阿罗拉样子
的宝可梦等着你去发现......\p分别是{COLOR RED}六尾{COLOR DARK_GRAY}、{COLOR RED}九尾{COLOR DARK_GRAY}、
{COLOR RED}穿山鼠{COLOR DARK_GRAY}、{COLOR RED}穿山王{COLOR DARK_GRAY}、\l{COLOR RED}臭泥{COLOR DARK_GRAY}和{COLOR RED}臭臭泥{COLOR DARK_GRAY}。\p继续探索吧，
等把它们都捉齐了再来找我！$

label: Alola_Melemele_SamsonOakVilla_Dialogue_Text_31
source: You found all the Alolan variants living\non PONI ISLE!$
translation: 你找到了生活在波尼岛上的\n所有阿罗拉样子的宝可梦！$

label: Alola_Melemele_SamsonOakVilla_Dialogue_Text_32
source: It seems you've already found all the\nAlolan variants on PONI ISLE!\pGreat job!\pKeep exploring the other ISLES and\nreport your progress to me!$
translation: 看来你已经找齐波尼岛上\n所有阿罗拉样子的宝可梦了！\p干得漂亮！\p继续探索其他岛屿，\n随时来向我汇报进展吧！$

label: Alola_Melemele_SamsonOakVilla_Dialogue_Text_33
source:
Let me take a look at your POKéDEX{PAUSE 15}.{PAUSE 15}.{PAUSE 15}.\pIt seems you haven't quite found all of
the Alolan variants on PONI ISLE\ljust yet.\pI've heard PONI ISLE has {COLOR RED}4 {COLOR DARK_GRAY}Alolan
variants for you to find…\p{COLOR RED}GEODUDE{COLOR DARK_GRAY}, {COLOR RED}GRAVELER{COLOR DARK_GRAY}, {COLOR RED}GOLEM{COLOR DARK_GRAY}, and
{COLOR RED}EXEGGUTOR{COLOR DARK_GRAY}.\pKeep on searching and come back when
you've caught them all!$
translation:
让我看看你的宝可梦图鉴{PAUSE 15}......{PAUSE 15}......{PAUSE 15}......\p看来你还没有找齐波尼岛上
所有的阿罗拉样子的宝可梦呢。\p我听说波尼岛上有{COLOR RED}4{COLOR DARK_GRAY}种阿罗拉样子
的宝可梦等着你去发现......\p分别是{COLOR RED}小拳石{COLOR DARK_GRAY}、{COLOR RED}隆隆石{COLOR DARK_GRAY}、
{COLOR RED}隆隆岩{COLOR DARK_GRAY}和{COLOR RED}椰蛋树{COLOR DARK_GRAY}。\p继续探索吧，
等把它们都捉齐了再来找我！$

label: Alola_Melemele_SamsonOakVilla_Dialogue_Text_34
source: No worries, {PLAYER}!\pCome back when you'd like to share your\nfindings about the ALOLA ISLES!$
translation: 没关系，{PLAYER}！\p什么时候想和我分享阿罗拉群岛的\n新发现，随时再来找我吧！$

label: MossdeepCity_House1_Text_DoesntLikeOrDislikePokeblocks
source: It doesn't appear to like or dislike\nany {POKEBLOCK}S.$
translation: 它看起来对任何{POKEBLOCK}\n都无所谓喜不喜欢。$

label: MossdeepCity_House1_Text_HusbandCanTellPokeblockMonLikes
source: My husband can tell what kind of\n{POKEBLOCK}S a POKéMON likes at a glance.$
translation: 我丈夫只要看一眼，\n就能知道宝可梦喜欢什么样的{POKEBLOCK}。$

label: MtChimney_Text_MetoriteFittedOnMachine
source: A METEORITE is fitted on a mysterious\nmachine…\pThe machine seems to be storing\nenergy in the METEORITE.$
translation: 一台神秘的机器上嵌着一块陨石......\p这台机器似乎正在将能量储存在陨石中。$

label: MtMoon_Cave_Text_Rival_Before
source: ..................................\pIt's been a while, {PLAYER}.\p…Since I lost to you, I thought about\nwhat I was lacking with my POKéMON…\pAnd we came up with an answer.\p{PLAYER}, now we'll show you!$
translation: ..........................................\p好久不见了，{PLAYER}。\p......自从败给你之后，我就一直在思考\n我和我的宝可梦到底缺少了什么......\p现在，我们已经找到了答案。\p{PLAYER}，就让你见识一下我们的成果！$

label: MtMoon_Cave_Text_Rival_Win
source: ..................................\pI thought I raised my POKéMON to be the\nbest they could be…\p…But it still wasn't enough…$

label: MtMoon_Cave_Text_Rival_Loss
source: ..................................\pI've repaid my debt to you.\pWith my POKéMON, I'm going to beat the\nCHAMPION and become the world's greatest\ntrainer.$
translation: ..........................................\p上次欠你的人情我已经还清了。\p接下来，我和我的宝可梦会去打倒冠军，\n成为世界第一的训练家。$

label: MtMoon_Cave_Text_Sign
source: MT MOON SQUARE ->$
translation: 月见山广场 ->$

label: MtMoon_Outside_Text_WhiteRockTouchIt
source: An unusual white rock.\nThe color reminds you of the moon.\pTouch it?$
translation: 一块奇特的白色岩石。\n颜色让人联想到皎洁的月亮。\p要摸摸看吗？$

label: MtMoon_Outside_Text_WhiteRockTouchDay
source: {PLAYER} touched the unusual rock.\n..........................\l..........................\lBut nothing happened.$

label: MtMoon_Outside_Text_DontLitterSign
source: MT.MOON SQUARE\nDON'T LITTER$
translation: 月见山广场\n请勿乱扔垃圾$

label: MtMoon_Outside_Text_Jirachi
source: JIRACHI: Chi!$
translation: 基拉祈：奇！$

label: MtMoon_Outside_Text_Clefairy
source: CLEFAIRY: Pi pippippi!$
translation: 皮皮：皮，皮匹匹！$

label: MtMoon_Shop_Text_GiftShopLass
source: When the sun goes down, CLEFAIRY\ncome out to play.$
translation:
太阳落山后，皮皮们
就会出来玩耍。$

label: MountMortar2_Text_PokemaniacMillerSeen
source: I'm not losing this time!$
translation: 这次我可不会输！$

label: MountMortar2_Text_PokemaniacMillerBeaten
source: I lost to some kid...?$
translation: 我居然输给了一个小鬼......？$

label: MountMortar2_Text_PokemaniacMillerAfter
source:
A while back, this karate dude
wanted to battle.\pHe was ridiculously good.
He just thrashed us silly.\pHe went in deeper saying it
was for his training.\pI wonder how he is?$
translation:
不久前，有个练空手道的家伙
向我们发起挑战。\p他强得不可思议，
把我们揍得落花流水。\p他说为了修行，
又往更深处去了。\p不知道他现在怎么样了？$

label: MountMortar2_Text_SupernerdMarkusSeen
source: Hey! HUGH!$
translation: 喂！修！$

label: MountMortar2_Text_SupernerdMarkusBeaten
source: I mistook you for someone\nelse…$
translation: 我认错人了......$

label: MountMortar2_Text_SupernerdMarkusAfter
source: I came to explore MT.MORTAR,\nbut I got separated from my\lpartner…\pDid you run into a trainer\nwho uses a SEADRA that knows\lWATERFALL?$
translation:
我是来擂钵山探险的，
但跟搭档走散了......\p你有没有碰到带着
学会"攀瀑"的海刺龙的训练家？$

label: MtMortar_2F_Text_SupernerdHughSeen
source: Yo! MARKUS!$
translation: 哟！马库斯！$

label: MtMortar_2F_Text_SupernerdHughBeaten
source: Sorry, my mistake.\nI misjudged you.$
translation:
抱歉，我看走眼了。
认错人了。$

label: MtMortar_2F_Text_SupernerdHughAfter
source: I'm investigating MT.MORTAR,\nbut my pal's gone AWOL.\pHave you seen a trainer who\nhas a SLOWPOKE that can use\lSTRENGTH?$
translation:
我正在调查擂钵山，
但我的同伴不见踪影了。\p你有没有见过带着
会用"怪力"的呆呆兽的训练家？$

label: MountMortar4_Text_KiyoIntro
source: Hey!\pI am the KARATE KING!\nI train alone here in the dark!\pYou! Battle with me!\nHwaaarggh!$
translation:
嘿！\p我就是空手道大王！
在这黑暗中独自修行！\p你！跟我对决吧！
哇啊啊啊！$

label: MountMortar4_Text_KiyoWin
source: Waaaarggh!\nI'm beaten!$
translation:
哇啊啊啊！
我甘拜下风！$

label: MountMortar4_Text_KiyoTyrogueReward
source:
I... I'm crushed...\pMy training is still not
enough...\pBut a loss is a loss.
I admit it.\pAs proof that you defeated me,
I'll give you a rare fighting\lPOKéMON.$
translation:
我......我居然输得这么彻底......\p看来我的修行还远远不够......\p但输了就是输了，
我认输。\p作为击败我的证明，
我送你一只稀有的格斗属性宝可梦吧。$

label: MountMortar4_Text_ReceiveTyrogue
source: {PLAYER} received TYROGUE.$
translation: {PLAYER}收到了无畏小子。$

label: MountMortar4_Text_KiyoGotTyrogue
source: TYROGUE is a FIGHTING-type.\pIt evolves into a tougher\nPOKéMON.\pKeep up the hard work.\nI'll keep training too.\pFarewell!$
translation:
无畏小子是格斗属性的。\p它能进化成更强劲的宝可梦。\p继续努力吧，
我也要继续修行了。\p后会有期！$

label: MountMortar4_Text_KiyoFullParty
source: You have no room in your party!$
translation: 你的同行宝可梦已经满了！$

label: MtSilver_1F_WaterfallRoom_Text_Scientist
source: This is the entrance to the\nunexplored branch... {PAUSE 0x0F}{PAUSE 0x0F}{PAUSE 0x0F}\pDoes it feel cold here to you?\pOkay, I'm going to leave now.\pGood luck!$
translation: 这里就是未探索分支区域的入口了......{PAUSE 0x0F}{PAUSE 0x0F}{PAUSE 0x0F}\p你有没有觉得这里有点冷？\p好了，我要先走了。\p祝你好运！$

label: MtSilver_Outside_Text_Sign
source: MT. SILVER$
translation: 白银山$

label: MtSilver_PokemonCenter_Text_Meara1
source:
I'm a researcher from... Uhh...
the PEWTER CITY museum!\pAn unusual amount of artifacts have
been discovered in this area, so\lI've come here to investigate.\pHave you found anything strange
in the mountain?\pMaybe something like a FLUTE?\pIf you do, please show me.$
translation:
我是来自......呃......
深灰科学博物馆的研究员！\p这一带发现了异乎寻常的大量古代遗物，
所以我来这里调查。\p你在山里有找到什么奇怪的东西吗？\p比如像是笛子之类的？\p如果找到了，请务必拿给我看看。$

label: MtSilver_PokemonCenter_Text_Meara2
source:
That flute!\pYou have the spirit of a true
archaeologist!\pThere's a branch of the cave
where the POKéMON are too strong\lfor me to safely explore.\pIf I take you there, would you
explore it for more artifacts?$
translation:
那支笛子！\p你拥有真正的考古学家的精神！\p洞窟深处有一处岔道，那里的宝可梦
太强了，我一个人去探索太危险。\p如果我带你过去，
你愿意去寻找更多遗物吗？$

label: MtSilver_PokemonCenter_Text_Prompt
source: If I take you there, would you\nexplore it for more artifacts?$
translation:
如果我带你过去，
你愿意去寻找更多遗物吗？$

label: MtSilver_PokemonCenter_Text_Meara3
source: Ready to search for more artifacts?$
translation: 准备好去寻找更多遗物了吗？$

label: NationalPark_BugContest_Text_Trash
source: Nothing here.$
translation: 这里什么都没有。$

label: NationlParkBugContest_Text_EnjoyTheContest
source: ATTENDANT: Enjoy the Contest!$
translation: 接待员：请尽情享受大赛吧！$

label: NationalParkBugContest_Text_Attendant
source: ATTENDANT: Would you like to end\nthe contest?$
translation:
接待员：你要结束
本次大赛吗？$

label: NationalParkBugContest_Text_ContestantBelinda
source: BELINDA: I'm going to win!\nDon't bother me.$
translation:
贝琳达：优胜一定是我的！
别来打扰我。$

label: NationalParkBugContest_Text_Contestant2A
source: ED: My PARASECT puts POKéMON to\nsleep with SPORE.$
translation:
艾德：我的派拉斯特会用"蘑菇孢子"
让宝可梦睡着。$

label: NationalParkBugContest_Text_ContestantShaun
source: SHAUN: I'm not concerned about\nwinning.\pI'm just looking for rare POKéMON.$
translation: 肖恩：我不在乎拿不拿优胜。\p我只是想找稀有的宝可梦。$

label: NationalParkBugContest_Text_Contestant6A
source: BARRY: You should weaken bug\nPOKéMON first,\pthen throw a BALL.$
translation: 巴里：先削弱虫宝可梦的体力，\p然后再扔精灵球比较好哦。$

label: NationalParkBugContest_Text_Contestant7A
source: CINDY: I love bug POKéMON.\pI guess you must like them too.$
translation: 辛迪：我最喜欢虫属性宝可梦了。\p想必你也一定很喜欢吧？$

label: NationalParkBugContest_Text_Contestant8A
source: JOSH: I've been collecting bug\nPOKéMON since I was just a baby.\pThere's no way I'm going to lose!$
translation: 乔希：我从小婴儿时就在收集虫宝可梦了。\p我绝对不可能输给别人的！$

label: NationalParkBugContest_Text_Contestant9A
source: SAMUEL: If you've got the time to\nchat, go find some bug POKéMON.$
translation:
萨缪尔：有闲工夫在这里聊天，
还不如快点去抓虫宝可梦。$

label: NationalParkBugContest_Text_Contestant10A
source: KIPP: I've studied about bug\nPOKéMON a lot.\pI'm going to win for sure.$
translation: 基普：我可是好好研究过虫宝可梦的。\p这次赢的人一定是我。$

label: NationalParkBugContest_Text_Sign_RelaxationSquare
source: RELAXATION SQUARE\nNATIONAL PARK$
translation:
休闲广场
自然公园$

label: NationalParkBugContest_Text_Sign_BattleNotice
source: What is this notice?\pPlease battle only in the grass.\pNATIONAL PARK WARDEN'S OFFICE$
translation: 这是什么告示？\p"宝可梦对战请只在草丛中进行。"\p--自然公园管理处$

label: NationalParkBugContest_Text_TrainerTips
source: The NATIONAL PARK has different\nPOKéMON during the BUG-CATCHING\lCONTEST.$
translation:
自然公园在举办捕虫大会期间，
出现的宝可梦会有所不同。$

label: NationalPark_Normal_Text_Lass
source: Look! Check out my bag!\pI printed out my favorites from my\nPOKéDEX and stuck them on my bag.$
translation:
看！瞧瞧我的包包！\p我从宝可梦图鉴打印出喜欢的宝可梦，
把它们全贴在包上了。$

label: NationalPark_Normal_Text_PokefanF
source: This is MAIL I got from my daughter.\nIt cheers me up.$
translation:
这是我女儿寄来的邮件。
读了就让我精神百倍。$

label: NationalPark_Normal_Text_Teacher1
source: Pay attention, please!\p…Oops, I have to quit thinking like\na teacher all the time.\pYou must be a POKéMON trainer.\pSince you're working so hard, I\nwant you to have this.$
translation:
请注意听讲！\p......哎呀，职业病又犯了，
总觉得自己还在当老师呢。\p你一定是一位宝可梦训练家吧。\p看你这么努力，这个就送给你吧。$

label: NationalPark_Normal_Text_Teacher1_QuickClaw
source: Let a POKéMON hold that QUICK CLAW.\pSometimes it will strike first\nduring battle.$
translation: 让宝可梦携带那个"先制之爪"吧。\p在战斗中有时能够先发制人哦。$

label: NationalPark_Normal_Text_Youngster1
source: I'm playing with stickers I printed\nfrom my POKéDEX.$
translation: 我在玩从宝可梦图鉴里打印出来的贴纸呢。$

label: NationalPark_Normal_Text_Youngster2
source: I get the other guy's POKéDEX sticker\nif I win.$
translation:
如果我赢了，
就能拿走对方的图鉴贴纸。$

label: NationalPark_Normal_Text_Teacher2
source: I take walks in the PARK, but I\nnever go into the grass.\pTrainers always want to battle…\pYou must have been in many battles.\nLet me heal your POKéMON for you.$
translation:
我常在公园里散步，但从不走进草丛。\p因为训练家们总想着找人对战......\p你一路走来经历了不少战斗吧？
让我来为你的宝可梦恢复一下吧。$

label: NationalPark_Normal_Text_Persian
source: PERSIAN: Fufushaa!$
translation: 猫老大：呜喵--！$

label: NationalPark_Normal_Text_SchoolboyJack1_Seen
source: The world of POKéMON is deep.\pThere are still lots of things we\ndon't know.\pBut I know more than you do!$
translation: 宝可梦的世界可是奥妙无穷的。\p还有很多很多我们不知道的事情呢。\p不过，我知道的肯定比你多！$

label: NationalPark_Normal_Text_SchoolboyJack1_Beaten
source: Wha-wha-what?$
translation: 什、什、什么？！$

label: NationalPark_Normal_Text_SchoolboyJack_After
source: There is a lot to learn.\pFor example…\pThere are 92 kinds of TMs.\pTraded POKéMON level up faster.$
translation: 要学习的东西还多着呢。\p比如说......\p招式学习器一共有92种。\p通过连接交换来的宝可梦升级更快。$

label: NationalPark_Normal_Text_JackRegister
source: There is a lot to learn.\pFor example…\pThere are 92 kinds of TMs.\pTraded POKéMON level up faster.$
translation: 要学习的东西还多着呢。\p比如说......\p招式学习器一共有92种。\p通过连接交换来的宝可梦升级更快。$

label: NationalPark_Normal_Text_JackRematchDefeat
source: Wha-wha-what?$
translation: 什、什、什么？！$

label: NationalPark_Normal_Text_JackPostRematch
source: There is a lot to learn.\pFor example…\pThere are 92 kinds of TMs.\pTraded POKéMON level up faster.$
translation: 要学习的东西还多着呢。\p比如说......\p招式学习器一共有92种。\p通过连接交换来的宝可梦升级更快。$

label: NationalPark_Normal_Text_Sign_RelaxationSquare
source: RELAXATION SQUARE\nNATIONAL PARK$
translation:
休闲广场
自然公园$

label: NationalPark_Normal_Text_Sign_BattleNotice
source: What is this notice?\pPlease battle only in the grass.\pNATIONAL PARK WARDEN'S OFFICE$
translation: 这是什么告示？\p"宝可梦对战请只在草丛中进行。"\p--自然公园管理处$

label: NewBarkTown_Text_ElmName
source: 空木博士$
translation: 空木博士$

label: NewBarkTown_Text_Sign
source: NEW BARK TOWN\pThe Town Where the Winds of\na New Beginning Blow$
translation: 若叶镇\p吹拂着昭示起始之风的小镇$

label: NewBarkTown_Text_PlayersHouse
source: {PLAYER}'S HOUSE$
translation: {PLAYER}的家$

label: NewBarkTown_Text_ElmsHouse
source: PROF.ELM'S HOUSE$
translation: 空木博士的研究所$

label: NewBarkTown_House1_Text_NeighborsDaughter
source:
PIKACHU is an evolved POKéMON.\pI was amazed by PROF.ELM's
findings.\pHe's so famous for his research
on POKéMON evolution.\p…sigh…\pI wish I could be a researcher
like him…$
translation: 皮卡丘是进化后的宝可梦。\p空木博士的发现真是令我大吃一惊。\p他在宝可梦进化方面的研究非常出名。\p......唉......\p真希望我也能成为像他一样的研究员啊......$

label: NewBarkTown_House1_Text_Neighbor
source: My daughter is adamant about\nbecoming PROF.ELM's assistant.\pShe really loves POKéMON!\pBut then, so do I!$
translation: 我女儿铁了心要当空木博士的助手。\p她真的很喜欢宝可梦！\p不过话说回来，我也一样喜欢！$

label: NewBarkTown_House2_Text_ElmsWife
source: Hi, {PLAYER}! My husband's always\nso busy--I hope he's OK.\pWhen he's caught up in his\nPOKéMON research, he even\lforgets to eat.$
translation: 嗨，{PLAYER}！我丈夫总是那么忙，真希望他身体没事。\p只要一沉迷于宝可梦的研究，他甚至连饭都会忘记吃呢。$

label: NewBarkTown_House2_Text_ElmsSon
source: When I grow up, I'm going to\nhelp my dad!\pI'm going to be a great\nPOKéMON professor!$
translation: 等我长大以后，我也要帮爸爸的忙！\p我要成为一名了不起的宝可梦博士！$

label: NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_ElmIntro
source:
空木：{PLAYER}！你来啦！\p我有件事想拜托你。\p我正在做新的宝可梦研究，想请你帮
帮忙，{PLAYER}。\p你看……\p我正在写一篇论文，想在学会上发表
。\p但还有些地方我怎么也想不明白。\p所以！\p我想请你培育一只我最近刚捉到的宝
可梦。$
translation:
空木：{PLAYER}！你来啦！\p我有件事想拜托你。\p我正在做新的宝可梦研究，想请你帮
帮忙，{PLAYER}。\p你看......\p我正在写一篇论文，想在学会上发表
。\p但还有些地方我怎么也想不明白。\p所以！\p我想请你培育一只我最近刚捉到的宝
可梦。$

label: NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_ElmWhereGoing
source: 空木：等等！你要去哪里？$
translation: 空木：等等！你要去哪里？$

label: NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_ChooseCyndaquil
source: 空木：你要选\n{STR_VAR_1}，那只\l{STR_VAR_2}宝可梦吗？$
translation: 空木：你要选\n{STR_VAR_1}，那只\l{STR_VAR_2}宝可梦吗？$

label: NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_ChooseTotodile
source: 空木：你想要\n{STR_VAR_1}，那只\l{STR_VAR_2}宝可梦吗？$
translation: 空木：你想要\n{STR_VAR_1}，那只\l{STR_VAR_2}宝可梦吗？$

label: NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_ChooseChikorita
source: 空木：这么说，你喜欢\n{STR_VAR_1}，那只\l{STR_VAR_2}宝可梦？$
translation: 空木：这么说，你喜欢\n{STR_VAR_1}，那只\l{STR_VAR_2}宝可梦？$

label: NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_DidntChooseStarter
source: 空木：好好考虑吧。\p你的伙伴很重要。$
translation: 空木：好好考虑吧。\p你的伙伴很重要。$

label: NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_ChoseStarter
source: 空木：我觉得那只宝可梦也很棒！$
translation: 空木：我觉得那只宝可梦也很棒！$

label: NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_ElmDirections1
source:
MR. POKéMON lives a little bit
beyond CHERRYGROVE, the next\lcity over.\pIt's almost a direct route
there, so you can't miss it.\pBut just in case, you have my
phone number. Call me if\lanything comes up!$
translation: 宝可梦爷爷住在吉花市再往前一点的地方。\p顺着路一直走就能到，你绝不会迷路的。\p不过以防万一，你有我的电话号码。\n遇到什么事就给我打电话吧！$

label: NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_ElmDirections1_Register
source:
MR. POKéMON lives a little bit
beyond CHERRYGROVE, the next\lcity over.\pIt's almost a direct route
there, so you can't miss it.\pBut just in case, here's my
phone number. Call me if\lanything comes up!$
translation: 宝可梦爷爷住在吉花市再往前一点的地方。\p顺着路一直走就能到，你绝不会迷路的。\p不过以防万一，这是我的电话号码。\n遇到什么事就给我打电话吧！$

label: NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_ElmDirections2
source: If a wild POKéMON appears, let\nyour POKéMON battle it!\pIf your POKéMON is hurt, you\nshould heal it with the machine\lto my right, or at the POKéCENTER.\pI'm counting on you!$
translation: 如果遇到野生宝可梦，就让你的宝可梦去战斗吧！\p要是宝可梦受伤了，可以用我右手边的机器，或者去宝可梦中心治疗。\p拜托你啦！$

label: NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_ElmDescribesMrPokemon
source: MR. POKéMON goes everywhere and\nfinds rarities.\pToo bad they're just rare and\nnot very useful…$
translation: 宝可梦爷爷总是到处跑，收集各种稀奇古怪的东西。\p可惜大多只是罕见，并没有什么用处......$

label: NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_ElmPokeBall
source: It contains a POKéMON caught\nby PROF.ELM.$
translation: 里面装着空木博士捕获的宝可梦。$

label: NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_ElmAfterTheft1
source: ELM: {PLAYER}, this is terrible…\pOh, yes, what was MR. POKéMON's\nbig discovery?$
translation: 空木：{PLAYER}，出大事了......\p啊，对了，宝可梦爷爷的大发现到底是什么？$

label: NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_ElmAfterTheft2
source: {PLAYER} handed the MYSTERY EGG\nto PROF.ELM.$
translation: {PLAYER}将不可思议的蛋\n交给了空木博士。$

label: NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_ElmAfterTheft3
source: 空木：这个？$
translation: 空木：这个？$

label: NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_ElmAfterTheft4
source:
But… Is it a POKéMON EGG?\pIf it is, it is a great
discovery!\pELM: What?!?\pPROF.OAK gave you a POKéDEX?\p{PLAYER}, is that true?
Th-that's incredible!\pHe is superb at seeing the
potential of people as trainers.\pWow, {PLAYER}. You may have what
it takes to become the CHAMPION.\pYou seem to be getting on
great with POKéMON too.\pYou should take the POKéMON
GYM challenge.\pThe closest GYM would be the
one in VIOLET CITY.\p…{PLAYER}. The road to the
championship will be a long one.\pBefore you leave, make sure
that you talk to your mom.$
translation: 但是......这难道是宝可梦的蛋？\p如果真是这样，那可是一项重大发现啊！\p空木：什么！？！？\p大木博士给了你宝可梦图鉴？\p{PLAYER}，这是真的吗？\n这也太难以置信了！\p大木博士看穿训练家潜能的眼光可是顶尖的。\p哇，{PLAYER}。你可能真的具备成为冠军的资质呢。\p而且看来你和宝可梦也相处得非常融洽。\p你应该去挑战宝可梦道馆看看。\p最近的道馆就在桔梗市。\p......{PLAYER}。通往冠军之路可是很漫长的。\p出发之前，记得一定要去跟你妈妈打声招呼。$

label: NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_ElmStudyingEgg
source: 空木：别放弃！那枚蛋要是有什么消\n息，我会打电话给你的！$
translation: 空木：别放弃！那枚蛋要是有什么消\n息，我会打电话给你的！$

label: NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_ElmAideHasEgg
source:
ELM: {PLAYER}? Didn't you meet
my assistant?\pHe should have met you with
the EGG at VIOLET CITY's\pPOKéMON CENTER.\pYou must have just missed him.
Try to catch him there.$
translation: 空木：{PLAYER}？你没遇到我的助手吗？\p他应该带着那枚蛋在桔梗市的\p宝可梦中心等你才对啊。\p你们肯定是错过了。\n去那里找找他看吧。$

label: NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_ElmWaitingEggHatch
source: 空木：那枚蛋有什么变化吗？$
translation: 空木：那枚蛋有什么变化吗？$

label: NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_ElmThoughtEggHatched
source: {PLAYER}? I thought the EGG\nhatched.\pWhere is the POKéMON?$
translation:
{PLAYER}？我听说蛋
已经孵化了呀。\p那只宝可梦在哪里呢？$

label: NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_ShowTogepi1
source: ELM: {PLAYER}, you look great!$
translation: 空木：{PLAYER}，你看起来很有精神嘛！$

label: NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_ShowTogepi2
source: What? That POKéMON!?!$
translation: 什么？那只宝可梦是！？！$

label: NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_ShowTogepi3
source:
The EGG hatched! So, POKéMON
are born from EGGS…\pNo, perhaps not all POKéMON
are.\pWow, there's still a lot of
research to be done.$
translation:
蛋孵化了！原来宝可梦
真的是从蛋里生出来的......\p不对，也许并不是所有的
宝可梦都这样。\p哇，还有好多好多的课题
需要去研究啊。$

label: NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_ElmGiveEverstone1
source: Thanks, {PLAYER}! You're helping\nunravel POKéMON mysteries for us!\pI want you to have this as a\ntoken of our appreciation.$
translation:
谢谢你，{PLAYER}！你帮我们解开了
宝可梦身上的未解之谜！\p这个请你收下，
算是我的一点心意。$

label: NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_ElmGiveEverstone2
source:
That's an EVERSTONE.\pSome species of POKéMON evolve
when they grow to certain levels.\pA POKéMON holding the EVERSTONE
won't evolve.\pGive it to a POKéMON you don't
want to evolve.$
translation:
那是"不变之石"。\p有些宝可梦成长到一定等级后
就会进化。\p携带着不变之石的宝可梦
是不会进化的。\p把它交给你不想让它
进化的宝可梦带上吧。$

label: NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_ElmCallYou
source: ELM: {PLAYER}, I'll call you if\nanything comes up.$
translation:
空木：{PLAYER}，要是发生什么事，
我会给你打电话的。$

label: NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_AideAfterTheft
source: …sigh… That stolen POKéMON.\pI wonder how it's doing.\pThey say a POKéMON raised by a\nbad person turns bad itself.$
translation:
......唉......被偷走的那只宝可梦，\p不知道现在怎么样了。\p听说被坏人抚养长大的宝可梦，
性格也会变坏呢。$

label: NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_ElmGiveMasterBall1
source: ELM: Hi, {PLAYER}!\pThanks to you, my research is\ngoing great!\pTake this as a token of my\nappreciation.$
translation:
空木：嗨，{PLAYER}！\p多亏了你，我的研究
进行得非常顺利！\p这个就当作我的一点谢意，
请收下吧。$

label: NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_ElmGiveMasterBall2
source:
The MASTER BALL is the best!\pIt's the ultimate BALL! It'll
catch any POKéMON without fail.\pIt's given only to recognized
POKéMON researchers.\pI think you can make much better
use of it than I can, {PLAYER}!$
translation:
大师球可是最棒的！\p那是究极的精灵球！无论什么宝可梦
都能百分之百捕捉成功。\p这可是只有获得认可的宝可梦研究员
才能拿到的稀罕物。\p不过我想，它在你的手里
能发挥出比我更大的作用，{PLAYER}！$

label: NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_KimonoGirls
source:
By the way...
A group of beautiful KIMONO\lGIRLS were looking for you.\pThey told me they are
waiting for you at the\lECRUTEAK DANCE THEATER.\pI know you've gone through many
things since that EGG got you\linvolved in all this...\pI hope you'll carry through it.$
translation:
顺便说一下......
有一群漂亮的舞妓小姐\l刚才一直在找你呢。\p她们说会在缘朱市的
缘朱舞场等你。\p我知道，自从卷入了那枚蛋的事情之后，
你经历了很多波折......\p但我相信你一定能坚持到底的。$

label: NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_KimonoWaiting
source: PROF.ELM: The KIMONO\nGIRLS are waiting for you at\lthe ECRUTEAK DANCE THEATER.$
translation:
空木博士：舞妓小姐们
正在缘朱舞场等你呢。$

label: NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_League
source:
PROF.ELM: Hahaha...
Good job!\pThat rare EGG has brought you
a lot of trouble, huh?\pThe KIMONO GIRLS said something
about me?\pI have nothing to do with it.\pYou made your decision and went
through with it.\pHaving done so much, you should
be able to face the LEAGUE now!\pYou should head for INDIGO
PLATEAU!\pDo you know how to get there?
Follow ROUTE 27 to ROUTE 26.\pOnce there, go straight north!$
translation:
空木博士：哈哈哈哈......
干得漂亮！\p那枚稀有的蛋给你添了
不少麻烦吧？\p舞妓小姐们提到了我？\p其实我可什么都没做哦。\p都是你自己做出了决定，
并且坚持完成了这一切。\p既然已经做到了这一步，
你现在应该有资格挑战联盟了！\p去石英高原吧！\p你知道怎么去吗？
沿着27号道路走，接上26号道路。\p到了那里之后，一直往北走就行了！$

label: NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_ElmGiveTicket1
source: ELM: {PLAYER}! There you are!\pI called because I have\nsomething for you.\pSee? It's an S.S.TICKET.\pNow you can catch POKéMON in\nKANTO.$
translation:
空木：{PLAYER}！你来啦！\p我打电话叫你来，是有东西
要交给你。\p看，这是船票。\p这样你就能去关都地区
捕捉那里的宝可梦了。$

label: NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_ElmGiveTicket2
source:
The ship departs from OLIVINE
CITY.\pBut you knew that already,
{PLAYER}.\pAfter all, you've traveled all
over with your POKéMON.\pGive my regards to PROF.OAK in
KANTO!$
translation:
船会从浅黄市出发。\p不过这事你早就知道了对吧，
{PLAYER}。\p毕竟你已经和你的宝可梦一起
走过了这么多地方。\p到了关都替我向大木博士
问个好！$

label: NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_LabMonEgg
source: It's the POKéMON EGG being\nstudied by PROF.ELM.$
translation:
这是空木博士正在研究的
宝可梦蛋。$

label: NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_AideGivePotion
source: {PLAYER}, I want you to have\nthis for your errand.$
translation:
{PLAYER}，出门前把这个
带上吧。$

label: NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_AideAlwaysBusy
source: There are only three of us, so\nwe're always busy.$
translation:
我们研究所只有三个人，
所以总是忙得不可开交。$

label: NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_AideTheftTestimony
source:
There was a loud noise
outside…\pWhen we went to look,
someone stole a POKéMON.\pIt's unbelievable that anyone
would do that!\p…sigh… That stolen POKéMON.\pI wonder how it's doing.\pThey say a POKéMON raised by a
bad person turns bad itself.$
translation:
刚才外面传来好大一声巨响......\p我们跑出去看的时候，
发现有人偷走了宝可梦。\p竟然会有人干出这种事，
真是不可思议！\p......唉......被偷走的那只宝可梦，\p不知道现在怎么样了。\p听说被坏人抚养长大的宝可梦，
性格也会变坏呢。$

label: NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_Officer1
source:
I heard a POKéMON was stolen
here…\pI was just getting some
information from PROF.ELM.\pApparently, it was a young
male with long, red hair…\pWhat?\pYou battled a trainer like
that?\pDid you happen to get his
name?$
translation:
我听说这里有宝可梦被盗了......\p刚才正向空木博士
了解情况呢。\p据说嫌疑人是一个
留着红色长发的年轻男子......\p什么？\p你跟那样的训练家交过手？\p那你碰巧知道他的名字吗？$

label: NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_Officer2_1
source: OK! So {RIVAL} was his name?$
translation: 好！原来他的名字叫{RIVAL}啊？$

label: NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_Officer2
source: Thanks for helping my\ninvestigation!$
translation:
谢谢你协助我们
调查！$

label: NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_OfficerNo
source: Surely you got his name?!$
translation: 你肯定知道他的名字吧？！$

label: NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_Elm_CallMe
source: Ah, {PLAYER}!\pHow's your POKéDEX coming along?\nI'm busy now, but call me sometime\land I can check your progress!$
translation:
啊，{PLAYER}！\p宝可梦图鉴收集得怎么样啦？
我现在有点忙，记得抽空给我打电话，\l我可以帮你评估图鉴的进度哦！$

label: NewBarkTown_PlayersHouse_1F_Text_MomAnythingElse
source: Is there anything else I can\nhelp you with, sweetie?$
translation: 还有什么妈妈能帮你的吗，宝贝？$

label: NewBarkTown_PlayersHouse_1F_Text_CurrentSavings
source: I'm holding {STR_VAR_2}\nfor you right now.$
translation: 我现在帮你存了{STR_VAR_2}哦。$

label: NewBarkTown_PlayersHouse_1F_Text_EnableSaving
source: Do you want me to save some of the\nmoney you earn?$
translation: 要让妈妈帮你存一部分赚到的钱吗？$

label: NewBarkTown_PlayersHouse_1F_Text_SavingEnabled
source: Okay! I'll save 25% of\nthe money you earn from battles.$
translation: 好的！那对战赚到的奖金，\n妈妈就帮你存上25%啦。$

label: NewBarkTown_PlayersHouse_1F_Text_DisableSaving
source: Would you like me to stop\nsaving for you?$
translation: 你想暂停存钱吗？$

label: NewBarkTown_PlayersHouse_1F_Text_SavingDisabled
source: Okay, I'll stop saving for now.$
translation: 好的，那妈妈先不帮你存了。$

label: NewBarkTown_PlayersHouse_1F_Text_Goodbye
source: Take care, sweetie!$
translation: 路上小心哦，宝贝！$

label: NewBarkTown_PlayersHouse_1F_Text_DepositSuccess
source: MOM: Sounds good! I'll put that in\nsavings for you.$
translation: 妈妈：好嘞！妈妈帮你存起来。$

label: NewBarkTown_PlayersHouse_1F_Text_WithdrawSuccess
source: MOM: Here you go!$
translation: 妈妈：给你，拿好哦！$

label: NewBarkTown_PlayersHouse_1F_Text_NoMoneyToDeposit
source: MOM: You don't have any money to\ndeposit right now, sweetie.$
translation: 妈妈：宝贝，你现在没有钱可以存呢。$

label: NewBarkTown_PlayersHouse_1F_Text_NoMoneyToWithdraw
source: MOM: I haven't saved any money\nfor you yet, honey.$
translation: 妈妈：亲爱的，妈妈这里还没帮你存钱呢。$

label: NewBarkTown_PlayersHouse_1F_Text_MomsFriend
source: Hi, {PLAYER}!\pI'm visiting!\pHave you heard?\pMy daughter is adamant about\nbecoming PROF.ELM's assistant.\pShe really loves POKéMON!$
translation: 嗨，{PLAYER}！\p我来串门啦！\p你听说了吗？\p我女儿一心想去当空木博士的助手呢。\p她真的很喜欢宝可梦！$

label: NewBarkTown_PlayersHouse_2F_Text_NES
source: {PLAYER} played with the NES.\p…Okay!\nIt's time to go!$
translation: {PLAYER}玩了一会儿FC游戏机。\p......好啦！\n该出发了！$

label: NewSinjoh_Text_TriggerNorthGate
source: Better not leave the Kimono\ngirls waiting.$
translation: 最好别让艺裳少女们久等了。$

label: NewSinjoh_Text_Stantler_Cry
source: Lerrrrr!$
translation: 嘞噜噜噜--！$

label: NewSinjoh_Text_Steven
source: STEVEN: Ma'am, may I help you to\nthe spring over there?\pIt seems there is plenty of room.$
translation: 大吾：这位女士，需要我带您去那边的温泉吗？\p那里看起来还有很多空位。$

label: NewSinjoh_MilkMan_text_BuyMilk
source: I am the Milkman.\pMy milk is delicious.\pIf you would like some today, it'll be\n¥500.$
translation: 我是牛奶工。\p我的牛奶很美味。\p今天如果想来一瓶的话，只要500日元。$

label: NewSinjoh_MilkMan_GotMilk
source: Here ya go!\nIt's fortified with what the world wants.$
translation: 拿好！\n里面添加了这个世界所渴求的滋味。$

label: NewSinjoh_MilkMan_NoMoney
source: Sorry.\nGet some cash, then you will get a sale!$
translation: 抱歉啦。\n带够钱再来买吧！$

label: NewSinjoh_MilkMan_NoRoom
source: Look's like your PACK's full.$
translation: 你的背包好像已经装满了。$

label: NewSinjoh_MilkMan_NoSale
source: Don't you want it?\nIt gots what the world deserves.$
translation: 你真的不想要吗？\n这里面可饱含了这个世界应得的一切。$

label: NewSinjoh_MilkMan_Text_WouldYouLikeAnother
source: How bout another?$
translation: 要不再来一瓶？$

label: NewSinjoh_Text_GotMilk
source: {PLAYER} got MOOMOO MILK.$
translation: {PLAYER}获得了哞哞鲜奶。$

label: MilkMan_Battle_text
source: I am the MilkMan,\pMy milk is delicious.\pSpecial delivery today!$
translation: 我是牛奶工，\p我的牛奶很美味。\p今天可是特别派送！$

label: NewSinjoh_MilkMan_text_Lose
source: This world is perfect.\nisn't it?$
translation: 这个世界很完美，\n不是吗？$

label: NewSinjoh_Text_TravelShopGreeting
source: Welcome to My little Supply Shop.\nHow can I help you?$
translation: 欢迎光临我的杂货小铺。\n请问有什么需要吗？$

label: NewSinjoh_Text_TravelShopEnd
source: Do come back.$
translation: 欢迎下次光临。$

label: NewSinjoh_Text_TravelBrother_Greeting
source: All our goods are homemade\nand grown locally!\pMy big sister opened up this shop,\nbecause the POKéMART company\lwon't open a location\lthis far out from a major town.$
translation: 店里的所有商品都是纯手工制作\n和本地采摘的哦！\p我姐姐之所以开这家店，\n是因为友好商店根本不肯\l在离大城镇这么远的地方开分店。$

label: NewSinjoh_Text_Josh
source: This place is sick!\pHiding these hot springs\nfrom the world is a travesty.\pI'm gonna tell all my friends!$
translation: 这地方简直太棒了！\p这么好的温泉藏着不让世人知道，\n实在太暴殄天物了。\p我一定要把这里推荐给所有朋友！$

label: NewSinjoh_Text_Janice
source: These springs are magical,\nbut I feel like the locals\lare giving us dirty looks.$
translation: 这里的温泉太神奇了，\n但我总觉得当地人\l一直在用白眼瞪我们。$

label: NewSinjoh_Text_JaniceAfter
source: These springs are magical,\nand the locals are so kind\lwhen you get to know them!$
translation: 这里的温泉太神奇了，\n而且只要混熟了之后，\l就会发现当地人特别亲切！$

label: NewSinjoh_Text_OldLady1
source: There's nothing like a nice view to\ninvigorate this old soul.$
translation: 没什么比这绝美的风景\n更能让我这把老骨头焕发生机的了。$

label: NewSinjoh_Text_OldLady2
source: Great, now these tourists\nare hogging our hot springs!\pIt's been one bad thing after\nanother lately!$
translation: 好极了，现在这帮游客\n把咱们的温泉给霸占了！\p最近真是一件顺心的事都没有！$

label: NewSinjoh_Text_OldLady2Steven
source: What a handsome young man!\pMaybe these tourists aren't\nso bad after all.$
translation: 真是个俊俏的小伙子！\p看来这些游客倒也\n没那么讨厌嘛。$

label: NewSinjoh_Text_OldLady3
source:
How can that woman
be so rude to our guests?\pShe needs to take a dip
in the springs. \pThere is plenty of space
for everyone.$
translation: 那个女人怎么能对客人\n这么无礼呢？\p她真该去温泉里泡泡降降火。\p这池子这么大，\n完全容得下所有人呀。$

label: NewSinjoh_Text_OldLady3After
source: It seems everybody is getting\nused to each other around here.\pGood!$
translation: 看来这里的大家\n都已经开始接纳彼此了。\p真好！$

label: NewSinjoh_Text_SpringsSage
source:
There has been much division
and strife in our community\lsince the newcomers arrived.\pRegardless of your perspective,
it is clear that the balance has\lbeen disturbed.\pPlease be kind to locals and
tourists alike.$
translation: 自从新居民来到之后，\n我们村落里就产生了\l很多隔阂与纷争。\p无论持何种立场，\n原有的平衡显然已经被打破了。\p请善待当地人，也请善待游客。$

label: NewSinjoh_Text_SpringsSageAfter
source: Things have been better since\nthe legendary POKéMON were quelled.\pBalance has returned to SINJOH.$
translation: 自从传说的宝可梦平息下来之后，\n情况就慢慢好转了。\p平衡又重新回到了神都。$

label: NewSinjoh_Text_Sage2
source: Times change, but the STANTLER\nstill gather. For that, we can\lbe thankful.$
translation: 时代虽在变迁，但惊角鹿\n依然会在此聚集。光是这一点，\l就值得我们心怀感激了。$

label: NewSinjoh_Text_Daughter
source: Wheeeeee!!\pLook, Mommy!\nNo hands!\pJust like the snowboarders!$
translation: 哇咿--！！\p妈妈快看！\n我没用手扶哦！\p就和单板滑雪选手一样！$

label: NewSinjoh_Text_Mother
source: Look at my adorable baby go!\pThis rink has been here\nfor generations, but the children\lnever used it until the newcomers\larrived.$
translation: 看我家宝贝滑得多棒呀！\p这个冰场代代相传至今，\n但在新居民搬来之前，\l孩子们可从没来这里玩过呢。$

label: NewSinjoh_Text_Welcome_Sign
source: NEW SINJOH$
translation: 新神都$

label: NewSinjoh_Text_Resturant_Sign
source: FAMILY CAFE$
translation: 家庭咖啡馆$

label: NewSinjoh_Text_Cave_Sign
source: HOT SPRINGS CAVE$
translation: 温泉洞窟$

label: NewSinjoh_Text_Hiker
source: Business is booming!\nBut prices have gone up since\lthe city folk became interested\lin our little town.$
translation: 生意可红火了！\n不过自从城里人\l对我们这个小镇产生兴趣后，\l物价也跟着涨起来了。$

label: NewSinjoh_Text_HikerAfter
source: Business is booming!\pAnd with how much that silver haried\nguy tips, prices have come down!$
translation: 生意可红火了！\p而且那位银发先生给的小费特别丰厚，\n物价总算降下来啦！$

label: NewSinjoh_Text_OldLady4
source: I only sell to locals!$
translation: 我只卖给本地人！$

label: NewSinjoh_Text_OldLady4After
source: I STILL only sell to locals!$
translation: 我说了，依然只卖给本地人！$

label: NewSinjoh_HotSprings_Text_MualaniBefore
source:
Am I a local or a visitor?
What a rude question!\pIf you must know, I'm a local.\pMy family was among the first to
enjoy these springs.\pSee, I even have this SPLASH PLATE
to prove it.$
translation: 问我是本地人还是游客？\n真没礼貌！\p非要问的话，我是本地人。\p我的家族可是最早享用这片温泉的。\p你看，我甚至有这块水滴石板为证呢。$

label: NewSinjoh_HotSprings_Text_MualaniBeforeBattle
source:
Wait...\pYou need the SPLASH PLATE
to tame the legendary POKéMON?\pIf the KIMONO GIRLS think you
are worthy, then so do I.\pBut you'll still need to earn
it.$
translation: 等等......\p你需要用水滴石板\n去平息传说的宝可梦？\p既然舞姬们都认可了\n你的实力，那我也不多说了。\p不过，你还是得靠本事来赢取它。$

label: NewSinjoh_HotSprings_Text_MualaniDefeat
source: Well earned.$
translation: 这是你应得的。$

label: NewSinjoh_HotSprings_Text_MualaniAfter
source: It is hard for me to let that\nplate go.\pBut when the situation changes,\nit is important for us to change\ltoo.\pThe plate is yours.$
translation: 要割舍那块石板，\n对我来说确实不易。\p但世事变迁，\n我们自身也必须顺应改变才行。\p这块石板就归你了。$

label: NewSinjoh_HotSprings_Text_Sign1
source: NEW SINJOH\nHOT SPRINGS$
translation: 新神都\n温泉$

label: NewSinjoh_HotSprings_Text_Sign2
source: DANGER\nWILD HIBERNATION DEN$
translation: 危险\n野生宝可梦冬眠巢穴$

label: NewSinjoh_HotSprings_Text_SkierF
source: I hate the cold!\pI'm just here for the hot springs!$
translation: 我最讨厌冷天了！\p我来这儿完全就是为了泡温泉！$

label: NewSinjoh_HotSprings_Text_SkierM
source: I came here to snowboard\nbut all my girlfriend wants to do\lis sit in the springs all day!$
translation: 我本来是想来滑雪板的，\n可我女朋友却只想一整天\n都泡在温泉里！$

label: NewSinjoh_HotSprings_Text_OldLady
source: Ignore my husband.\pLet your worries melt away.$
translation: 别理我丈夫。\p让所有的烦恼都随温水消散吧。$

label: NewSinjoh_HotSprings_Text_CreepyMan
source: Ouughh...\pThis water feels magical on my back.\pIf you have back pain too,\nyou should stay here with me...$
translation: 呼啊......\p这泉水泡得我后背太舒服了，简直像有魔力一样。\p要是你也腰酸背痛的话，\n不妨留下来和我一起多泡泡......$

label: NewSinjoh_HotSprings_Text_PLATutorIntro
source: The ancient power flows\nthrough these springs.\pI can teach your POKeMON moves\nfrom a forgotten age.\pInterested?$
translation: 远古的力量在这些泉水中流淌。\p我可以传授你的宝可梦来自\n那个被遗忘时代的古老招式。\p有兴趣吗？$

label: NewSinjoh_HotSprings_Text_PLATutorChoose
source: Which move would you like?$
translation: 你想学哪个招式？$

label: NewSinjoh_HotSprings_Text_PLATutorConfirm
source: You'd like to learn {STR_VAR_1}?$
translation: 想要学习{STR_VAR_1}吗？$

label: NewSinjoh_HotSprings_Text_PLATutorWhichMon
source: Which POKeMON should learn it?$
translation: 要让哪只宝可梦学习呢？$

label: NewSinjoh_HotSprings_Text_PLATutorDone
source: Done! Your POKeMON has mastered\nthe ancient technique.$
translation: 搞定！你的宝可梦已经掌握了\n这门古老的秘技。$

label: NewSinjoh_HotSprings_Text_PLATutorComeBack
source: Come back anytime.$
translation: 欢迎随时再来。$

label: NewSinjoh_HotSprings_Text_PLAMove_VictoryDance
source: VICTORY DANCE$
translation: 胜利之舞$

label: NewSinjoh_HotSprings_Text_PLAMove_MountainGale
source: MOUNTAIN GALE$
translation: 冰山风$

label: NewSinjoh_HotSprings_Text_PLAMove_BitterMalice
source: BITTER MALICE$
translation: 冤冤相报$

label: NewSinjoh_HotSprings_Text_PLAMove_SpringtideStorm
source: SPRINGTIDE STORM$
translation: 阳春风暴$

label: NewSinjoh_HotSprings_Text_PLAMove_LunarBlessing
source: LUNAR BLESSING$
translation: 新月祈祷$

label: NewSinjoh_HotSprings_Text_PLAMove_BleakwindStorm
source: BLEAKWIND STORM$
translation: 枯叶风暴$

label: NewSinjoh_HotSprings_Text_PLAMove_WildboltStorm
source: WILDBOLT STORM$
translation: 鸣雷风暴$

label: NewSinjoh_HotSprings_Text_PLAMove_SandsearStorm
source: SANDSEAR STORM$
translation: 热沙风暴$

label: NewSinjoh_HotSprings_Text_PLAMove_Shelter
source: SHELTER$
translation: 闭关$

label: NewSinjoh_HotSprings_Text_PLAMove_EsperWing
source: ESPER WING$
translation: 气场之翼$

label: NewSinjoh_HotSprings_Text_PLAMove_TakeHeart
source: TAKE HEART$
translation: 振奋$

label: NewSinjoh_HotSprings_Text_PLAMove_MysticalPower
source: MYSTICAL POWER$
translation: 神奇之力$

label: NewSinjoh_HotSprings_Text_PLAMove_WaveCrash
source: WAVE CRASH$
translation: 波动冲$

label: NewSinjoh_HotSprings_Text_PLAMove_PowerShift
source: POWER SHIFT$
translation: 力量转换$

label: NewSinjoh_HotSprings_Text_PLAMove_Cancel
source: 取消$
translation: 取消$

label: NewSinjoh_House1_Text_Looking4Celebi
source:
Hey there, Trainer!\pYou came all the way from
NEW BARK TOWN?\pI have a request for someone as
well traveled as you are.\lYou see, my favorite POKEMON in the\lwhole world just so happens to be\lthe mythical POKEMON known as CELEBI.\pIf you happen to have one, would
you mind showing it to me?$
translation: 训练家，你好呀！\p你是一路从若叶镇\n远道而来的吗？\p我有件事想拜托像你这样\l见多识广的旅行者。\l其实呢，我在这世界上最喜欢的宝可梦，\l正好就是被称为幻之宝可梦的时拉比。\p如果你正好收服了它，\n能不能借我瞧一眼呢？$

label: NewSinjoh_House1_Text_NicePokemonButNotCelebi
source: That's a very wonderful POKEMON\nyou have there but that's\lnot exactly what I was looking for..$
translation: 你的这只宝可梦真是太棒了，\n不过这并不是我想见的那一只呢......$

label: NewSinjoh_House1_OffersWooper
source:
That's it! That's a real living CELEBI!!\pThank you show much for bringing it
all the way up north for me to see.\pHere, my girlfriend happened to
catch a few too many of these during\lher trip to a far away region..\pPlease take this special WOOPER as
thanks, {PLAYER}.$
translation:
就是它！是活生生的时拉比！！\p太感谢你了，居然特地把它
带到遥远的北方来给我看。\p拿去吧，我女朋友去遥远地区
旅行时抓了太多这种宝可梦......\p这个特别的乌波就送给你当做谢礼吧，
{PLAYER}。$

label: NewSinjoh_House1_Text_Decline
source: That's too bad. I really wanted\nto see one.$
translation: 真遗憾啊。\n我真的很想亲眼见见它呢。$

label: NewSinjoh_House1_Text_TakeCareOfWooper
source: Take good care of that WOOPER\nfor me okay?$
translation: 一定要替我好好照顾那只乌波哦？$

label: NewSinjoh_House1_Text_GoodToSeeYouAgain
source: It's good to see you again,\n{PLAYER}.\pHow have you been treating that\nthat WOOPER?$
translation: 又见面了呢，\n{PLAYER}。\p你和那只乌波相处得怎么样了？$

label: NewSinjoh_House1_Bookshelf_Text
source: It's a shelf packed full of\ncomputer games and graphic novels!$
translation: 书架上塞满了\n电脑游戏和漫画书！$

label: NewSinjoh_House1_Text_Eevee_Cry
source: Vee Vee?$

label: NewSinjoh_House2_DeskLady_Text
source: Hello, little one..\pWelcome to New Sinjoh's...\nWell, you might call it a library.\pReally, this is where we keep all\nthe records of our town's history,\las well as any literature we\limport from other regions..$
translation: 你好啊，小朋友......\p欢迎来到新神都的......\n嗯，你可以称这里为图书馆。\p其实呢，这里保存着我们镇上所有的\l历史记录，以及从其他地区\l引进来的各类文献......$

label: NewSinjoh_Hosue2_Text_CryTorkoal
source: Tooor?$

label: NewSinjoh_House2_Text_Bookshelf_North
source: It's crammed full of ancient\nleather-bound books.\pThe language is unrecognizeable.$
translation: 里面塞满了古老的\n皮革封面书籍。\p上面的文字完全无法辨认。$

label: NewSinjoh_House2_Text_Bookshelf_South
source: It's crammed full of POKéMON\nbooks.\pThese look newer and more familiar.$
translation: 里面塞满了宝可梦的书籍。\p这些看起来比较新，\n内容也更熟悉一些。$

label: NewSinjoh_HauntedHouse_Text_TooEarlyNoReaction
source: You sense an odd presence...\pBut there is no reaction.$
translation: 你感觉到了一股奇异的气息......\p但并没有任何反应。$

label: NewSinjoh_HauntedHouse_Text_StartScary
source: You sense an odd presence...\pAre you being watched?$
translation: 你感觉到了一股奇异的气息......\p似乎有谁正在注视着你？$

label: NewSinjoh_HauntedHouse_Text_Log1
source:
Research Log 9:  September 20, 1975\pThe days are getting shorter now
and the wind is becoming harsh.\pThe villagers were quite welcoming.\pThey are allowing me to stay here
in this cabin for the winter.\pIt seems a family used to live here.
I often think about my family.\pMaybe I will have the courage to
return to them in the spring.$
translation:
调查日志 9：1975年9月20日\p白昼越来越短了，
寒风也愈发刺骨。\p村民们非常热情好客。\p他们允许我整个冬天
都暂住在这间小屋里。\p以前似乎曾有一家人住在这里。
我不禁经常想起我的家人。\p或许等到春天来临，
我就有勇气回到他们身边了。$

label: NewSinjoh_HauntedHouse_Text_Log2
source:
Research Log 10: October 20, 1975\pMy thoughts have turned dark.\pPerhaps it is the changing of the
seasons.\pThe villagers continue to treat me
as one of their own.\pBut the guilt I carry prevents me from
returning the sentiment.\pI rarely leave the cabin now.\pAnd when I think of my family...
Their faces have changed...\lI only see the faces of the POKéMON\lthat were lost at the ruins...\pSometimes I think the POKéMON are
