here with me. I see them in\lreflections, I feel their gaze.\pThings will be better in the spring.$
translation:
调查日志 10：1975年10月20日\p我的心思变得愈发阴暗沉重。\p也许是因为换季的缘故吧。\p村民们依旧待我如家人一般。\p但我心中的负罪感，
让我无法坦然接受这份善意。\p我现在几乎不出小屋的门了。\p而每当我想起家人时......
他们的面容竟渐渐变了样......\l我脑海中浮现的，只有在遗迹中\l丧命的那些宝可梦的面孔......\p有时我甚至觉得，那些宝可梦就在我身边。
我在倒影中看到它们，感受到它们的注视。\p等到春天，一切都会好起来的。$

label: NewSinjoh_HauntedHouse_Text_Log3
source:
Research Log 10: November 1, 1975\pI am not alone here.
Maybe I never was.\pThe POKéMON are with me...\pThey are angry with me, I think.\pObjects are thrown, doors slam.\pHeavy boxes block the front door.\pBut truthfully, I could leave
if I wanted to.\pThere is nothing else for me now.\pI've written of a family before,
but the POKéMON are the only family\lI can remember...\pI am running out of food, but my
guilt outpaces my hunger.\pI think I will stay here a while...$
translation:
调查日志 10：1975年11月1日\p我在这里并不是孤身一人。
或许从来都不是。\p那些宝可梦就在我身边......\p我想，它们是在生我的气。\p物品被胡乱掷出，房门砰然关上。\p沉重的箱子堵住了大门。\p但说实话，如果我想走，
我随时都可以离开。\p可如今的我已一无所有。\p我之前写过家人，
但我唯一能记起的家人，\l却只有那些宝可梦......\p食物快吃完了，
但愧疚感彻底盖过了饥饿。\p我想，我还是在这里多待一阵子吧......$

label: NewSinjoh_Cafe_Text_ResturantGreeting
source: H-hello! Welcome to our Cafe!\nHow can I help you today?$
translation: 你、你好！欢迎光临咖啡馆！\n今天想点些什么呢？$

label: NewSinjoh_Cafe_Text_ResturantEnd
source: Please come again!$
translation: 欢迎下次再来！$

label: NewSinjoh_Cafe_Text_BaldingMan
source: A local family has run this\ncafe for as long as anyone\lcan remember.\pTheir youngest girl over there\nisn't used to serving so many\lstrangers.$
translation: 从大家有记忆起，这间咖啡馆\n就一直由当地的一户人家经营着。\p那边那个小女孩\n还不习惯招待这么多生面孔呢。$

label: NewSinjoh_Cafe_Text_ScientistF
source: This drink is so goo--ood!\n.......\p.......\pHahaha\p.......$

label: NewSinjoh_Cafe_Text_ScientistM
source:
Please forgive my colleague...\pThe drinks here are stronger than
what we're used to in HOENN.\pI tried to warn her, but she said
she needed to unwind.\pThis research expedition has been
hard on us all.$
translation: 请原谅我这位同事的失态......\p这里的饮品后劲比我们在丰缘\n平时喝的烈得多。\p我试过劝她，但她说她想放松一下。\p这次学术考察对我们所有人来说\n都太不容易了。$

label: NewSinjoh_Cafe_Text_Gentleman
source: What are you staring at, kid?\pNothin' wrong with a man and his\nPOKéMON eating at the same table.$
translation: 你看什么看，小鬼？\p大老爷们儿和自己的宝可梦\n坐在同一张桌子前吃饭，有什么不可以的！$

label: NewSinjoh_Text_Scyther
source: Scyyy!$

label: NewSinjoh_KimonoHideout_Text_PlayerMeetsKimonos
source: {PLAYER}.\pPlease, approach.$
translation: {PLAYER}。\p请到跟前来。$

label: NewSinjoh_KimonoHideout_Text_PlayerMeetsMiharu
source:
MIHARU: Welcome to NEW SINJOH, 
{PLAYER}.\pFor generations, this village has
peacefully coexisted with immensely\lpowerful POKéMON, in isolation from\lthe prying eyes of outsiders.\pRecent events at our sacred temple
and a subsequent influx of uninvited\lguests now threaten to disrupt the\lcareful balance we have long\lprotected.$
translation:
美晴：欢迎来到新神都，
{PLAYER}。\p世世代代以来，这个村落一直
远离外界探寻的目光，\l与无比强大的宝可梦和平共处。\p然而最近神圣神殿中发生的事，
以及随之涌入的不速之客，\l正威胁并打破着我们守护已久的脆弱平衡。$

label: NewSinjoh_KimonoHideout_Text_PlayerMeetsShizuko
source: SHIZUKO: Our cousins in ECRUTEAK\nCITY made us aware of your\lconnection to the LEGENDARY POKéMON\lof the JOHTO REGION, and your\lprowess as a trainer.\pWe believe you can help us in these\ntrying times.$
translation: 静子：我们在圆朱市的姐妹们\n已经告诉我们，你与城都地区的\l传说中的宝可梦有着深厚羁绊，\l并且是一名身手不凡的训练家。\p我们相信，在这个多事之秋，\n你能够助我们一臂之力。$

label: NewSinjoh_KimonoHideout_Text_PlayerMeetsYouko
source:
YOUKO: Go to the SINJOH RUINS, to
the north of ROUTE 50.\pMeet with the scientists there, and
investigate the events that invoked\ltheir presence.\pIt is imperative that the LEGENDARY
POKéMON there are not disturbed\lby the unworthy.$
translation:
洋子：请前往50号道路以北的
神都遗迹。\p去见见那里的研究员，
并调查引发他们前来的事件。\p绝对不能让平庸之辈惊扰了
那里的传说中的宝可梦。$

label: NewSinjoh_KimonoHideout_Text_MiharuBeforeBattle
source:
MIHARU: Just as we predicted.\pThe champion of stone sent you
to collect the PLATES.\pOur order has guarded these
PLATES for centuries.\pWe will not part with them
readily.$
translation: 美晴：正如我们所料。\p那位痴迷石头的冠军派你\n来收集石板对吧。\p我们一门数百年来看守着这些石板。\p可不会轻易就将它们拱手相让。$

label: NewSinjoh_KimonoHideout_Text_MiharuAfter
source: MIHARU: You are worthy.$
translation: 美晴：你确实有此资格。$

label: NewSinjoh_KimonoHideout_Text_MiharuFinal
source: MIHARU: You have done our village\na great service, {PLAYER}.\pWe will not forget this.$
translation: 美晴：你为我们的村子立下了大功，\n{PLAYER}。\p我们绝不会忘记这份恩情。$

label: NewSinjoh_KimonoHideout_Text_YoukoBeforeBattle
source: YOUKO: Our cousins speak so\nhighly of you.\pIs it true?\pI will find out.$
translation: 洋子：姐妹们把你夸得神乎其神。\p到底是不是真的呢？\p就让我亲自来见识一下吧。$

label: NewSinjoh_KimonoHideout_Text_YoukoAfter
source: YOUKO: Our cousins were right\nabout you.$
translation: 洋子：姐妹们果然没有看错你。$

label: NewSinjoh_KimonoHideout_Text_YoukoFinal
source: YOUKO: I had my doubts, at first.\pBut after what you've done, it\ncannot be denied.$
translation: 洋子：起初我还有所怀疑。\p但看到你的所作所为，\n已经毋庸置疑了。$

label: NewSinjoh_KimonoHideout_Text_ShizukoBeforeBattle
source: SHIZUKO: We are trained in\nbattle as well as dance.\pObtaining the PLATEs will\nrequire strength and determination.$
translation: 静子：我们不仅精通舞蹈，\n在对战方面也受过严苛的训练。\p想要获得石板，\n必须具备强大的实力与坚定的意志。$

label: NewSinjoh_KimonoHideout_Text_ShizukoAfter
source: SHIZUKO: The bond you share\nwith your POKéMON is quite strong.\pYou have earned this PLATE.$
translation: 静子：你与宝可梦之间的羁绊十分深厚。\p这块石板你受之无愧。$

label: NewSinjoh_KimonoHideout_Text_ShizukoFinal
source: SHIZUKO: Few trainers in all\nof SINJOH's storied history have\lmanaged what you've just done.\pQuite impressive, {PLAYER}.$
translation: 静子：在神都漫长的历史长河中，\n鲜有训练家能达成你这样的壮举。\p真是令人赞叹，{PLAYER}。$

label: NewSinjoh_KimonoHideout_Text_OldMan
source:
The KIMONO GIRLS have watched
over our village since its founding.\pThey have sacrificed much.\pBlessed by the Gods themselves,
they have powers beyond that\lof any normal trainer!\pThat is to say, be prepared
if you ever fight them, young one.$
translation: 舞姬们从建村之初就一直守护着我们的村落。\p她们付出了很多牺牲。\p受到神明眷顾的她们，\n所拥有的力量远超普通训练家！\p也就是说，年轻人，\n如果要和她们交手，一定要做好万全准备。$

label: NewSinjoh_KimonoHideout_Text_OldManAfter
source: You have bested the champions of\nour village.\pWhat does that make you, young one?$
translation: 你竟然击败了我们村子的守护者。\p年轻人，你究竟是何方神圣？$

label: NewSinjoh_PokemonCenter_Text_Skiier
source: The snow makes it hard to navigate\nthis place.\pIt all looks the same.\pSo this map is a big help!\pWhat a beautiful region!$
translation: 大雪让人很难在这里辨别方向。\p到处看起来都一模一样。\p所以这幅地图帮了大忙！\p这真是一片美丽的地区啊！$

label: NewSinjoh_Text_Artist
source: I've found great inspiration in\nthis hidden town!\pDon't you think the landscape\nis breathtaking?$
translation: 我在这座隐秘的城镇里获得了极大的灵感！\p你不觉得这里的景色美得令人屏息吗？$

label: Text_ItemGiveaway
source: I see!\nYou must be an artist as well!\pI happen to have an extra something\nthat'll help you notice the tiny\ldetails of life!$
translation: 原来如此！\n你肯定也是一名艺术家吧！\p我刚好有多余的东西，\n可以帮你捕捉生活中微小的细节！$

label: NewSinjoh_Text_Artist_No
source: You aren't one of those anti-tourist\ntypes are you?\nBeauty is meant to be shared.$
translation: 你该不会是那种排斥游客的人吧？\n美丽的事物本就该与人分享嘛。$

label: Text_WasGiven_ZoomLensAlready
source: I hope you enjoy that lens!$
translation: 希望你能喜欢那个镜片！$

label: NewSinjoh_Text_FemAce
source: We don't have many modern\ncommodities in NEW SINJOH.\pBut at least we have this\nPOKéMON CENTER.$
translation: 在新神都并没有多少现代化的便利设施。\p但好在至少还有这家宝可梦中心。$

label: NewSinjoh_PokemonCenter_hns_Text_0
source: {PLAYER} took a closer look at the\nSINJOH map.$
translation: {PLAYER}仔细端详了神都地图。$

label: OlivineCity_Cafe_Text_Jasmine
source:
Oh... Hello, {PLAYER}.\pThese dishes in front of me are
not all mine...\pUh...\pActually, the person who sat here
before me ate a lot...\pIf you'd like to battle again,
please visit me at the FIGHTING\lDOJO in SAFFRON CITY.$
translation: 哎呀......你好啊，{PLAYER}。\p我面前的这些空盘子，\n其实不全是我吃剩下的啦......\p呃......\p其实是之前坐在这里的人吃得太多了......\p如果你还想再和我对战的话，\n请来金黄市的格斗道场找我吧。$

label: OlivineCity_Text_CafeSailorStrength
source:
Hah! Your POKéMON sure look like
lightweights!\pThey don't have the power to
move boulders aside.\pHere, use this and teach them
STRENGTH!$
translation:
哈哈！你的宝可梦看起来
身板还挺轻飘飘的嘛！\p凭这种力气可推不动
路上的大石头哦。\p来，拿上这个，让它们学会
"怪力"吧！$

label: OlivineCity_Text_CafeSailorGotStrength
source: On the sea, the only thing you\ncan count on is your own self!\pI'm so proud of my buff bod!\nYou should train like me!$
translation: 在茫茫大海上，唯一能依靠的\n就只有你自己！\p我这身结实的肌肉可是我的骄傲！\n你也该像我一样好好锻炼！$

label: OlivineCity_Text_CafeFishingGuru
source: OLIVINE CAFE's menu is packed\nwith hearty fare for beefy\lSAILORS like me!$
translation: 浅葱咖啡馆的菜单上，\n满是为我们这种健壮的水手量身准备的\l丰盛大餐！$

label: OlivineCity_Text_CafeSailor
source: Whenever I roll into this town,\nI always visit the OLIVINE CAFE.\pEverything on the menu makes me\nfeel stronger. I can't stop eating!$
translation: 每次来到这个城镇，\n我都一定要光顾浅葱咖啡馆。\p菜单上的每道菜都能让我精神百倍。\n根本停不下来啊！$

label: OlivineCity_Gym_Text_Gent
source: I knew you'd come here.\pThank you for helping the GYM LEADER,\nbut battle is a separate matter.\pGo for it!$
translation: 我就知道你会来这里。\p虽然很感谢你救助了道馆馆主，\n不过对战可就是另一码事了。\p全力以赴上吧！$

label: OlivineCity_Gym_Text_Gent2
source: Impressive!\nYou should continue your journey to\ldifferent places.\pSince you can use SURF, why don't you\ntry it on the LAKE OF RAGE?$
translation: 真厉害！\n你接下来也应该继续去各处旅行。\p既然你已经能使用冲浪了，\n不妨去愤怒之湖试试看吧？$

label: OlivineCity_Gym_Text_Lass
source: Giggle...\nI know how capable you are\lfrom the LIGHTHOUSE.\pIt's time you showed that side of\nyourself to JASMINE! Good luck!$
translation: 嘻嘻......\n在灯塔那时，我就已经\l见识过你的实力了。\p现在就去向阿蜜展示\n你真正的实力吧！祝你好运！$

label: OlivineCity_Gym_Text_Lass2
source: You are amazing...\nYou should aim even higher, since\lyou have such potential.\pHave you been to MAHOGANY TOWN?$
translation: 你真厉害......\n既然有这等潜力，就应该向着更高的目标迈进。\p你去过卡吉镇了吗？$

label: OlivineCity_Gym_Text_GymGuideText
source:
JASMINE uses the newly discovered
STEEL-type.\pShe's known for having not one,
but two aces.\pThe first is a metal bug that can
use a technique to boost its ATTACK.\pWhile fire will hurt it, it can
sometimes endure powerful blows.\pThe second is a giant iron snake
with lots of powerful moves.\pApproach it with caution.\pIt may look slow, but I've seen it
strike first with shocking displays\lof SPEED.$
translation:
阿蜜使用的是新发现的
钢属性。\p她可是以拥有两只王牌宝可梦
而闻名的。\p第一只是钢铁甲虫，
会使用提升攻击的招式。\p虽然火属性克制它，
但它有时却能硬撑下强力的攻击。\p第二只则是巨大的铁蛇，
掌握着许多强力的招式。\p一定要谨慎应对。\p它看似行动迟缓，但我曾见过它
展现出令人震惊的速度先发制人。$

label: OlivineCity_Gym_Text_GymGuideWinText
source: That was awesome.\pThe STEEL-type, huh?\pThat was a close encounter of an\nunknown kind!$
translation: 太精彩了！\p那就是钢属性吗？\p真是一场与未知事物的\n亲密接触啊！$

label: OlivineCity_Gym_Text_GymGuidePreText
source: JASMINE, the GYM LEADER, is at the\nLIGHTHOUSE.\pShe's been tending to a sick POKéMON.\pA strong trainer has to be\ncompassionate.$
translation: 道馆馆主阿蜜在灯塔那里。\p她一直在照顾一只生病的宝可梦。\p优秀的训练家必须\n拥有一颗慈爱的心啊。$

label: OlivineCity_Gym_Text_JasmineBetterTrainer
source: …You are a better trainer than me,\nin both skill and kindness.\pIn accordance with LEAGUE rules,\nI confer upon you this BADGE.$
translation: ......无论是实力还是温柔的心，\n你都比我更胜一筹。\p依照联盟的规则，\n我将这枚徽章授予你。$

label: OlivineCity_Gym_Text_ReceivedMineralBadge
source: {PLAYER} received MINERALBADGE.$
translation: {PLAYER}获得了钢铁徽章。$

label: OlivineCity_Gym_Text_JasmineBadgeSpeech
source: MINERALBADGE raises POKéMON's \nSPECIAL DEFENSE.\p…Um… Please take this too…$
translation: 钢铁徽章能提升宝可梦的\n特防。\p......那个......这个也请收下吧......$

label: OlivineCity_Gym_Text_JasmineIronTailSpeech
source: …You could use that TM to teach\nIRON TAIL.$
translation: ......使用那张招式学习器，\n可以学会"铁尾"。$

label: OlivineCity_Gym_Text_JasmineGoodLuck
source: Um… I don't know how to say this,\nbut good luck…$
translation: 那个......虽然不知道该怎么说，\n但请加油哦......$

label: OlivineCity_Gym_Text_JasmineRematchDefeatText
source: …You are a better trainer than me,\nin both skill and kindness.$
translation: ......无论是实力还是温柔的心，\n你都比我更胜一筹。$

label: OlivineCity_Gym_Text_GymStatue
source: OLIVINE CITY POKéMON GYM$
translation: 浅葱市宝可梦道馆$

label: OlivineCity_Gym_Text_JasmineWantToTrade
source:
…Um, {PLAYER}…
I have something to ask you.\pI've raised this STEELIX since it
was a little ONIX.\pBut I think RUSTY would be happier
with a trainer like you.\pWould you trade any of your
POKéMON for my RUSTY?$
translation:
......那个，{PLAYER}......
我有件事想拜托你。\p这只大钢蛇，是从它还是
大岩蛇的时候我就一直培育着的。\p不过我想，如果能跟随像你这样的训练家，
小铁它一定会更开心的。\p你愿意用你的宝可梦，
来交换我的小铁吗？$

label: OlivineCity_Gym_Text_JasmineTakeCare
source: …Thank you.\nPlease be kind to RUSTY…$
translation: ......谢谢你。\n请好好善待小铁......$

label: OlivineCity_Gym_Text_JasmineDeclineTrade
source: …Oh… That's okay.\nI understand…$

label: OlivineCity_Gym_Text_JasmineTradeCompleted
source: …How is RUSTY doing?\nI hope you're taking good care…$
translation: ......小铁它过得还好吗？\n希望能得到你的悉心照料......$

label: OlivineCity_Text_BaobaName
source: BAOBA$
translation: 巴奥巴$

label: OlivineCity_Text_Baoba
source:
{PLAYER}!\pThis is WARDEN BAOBA.\pSorry to have kept you waiting.
We've finally opened the\lSAFARI ZONE!\pDo you know where it is?\pYou know the GATE inside the cavern
in CIANWOOD CITY?\pIf you go through there and walk for
a short while, you should soon see\lthe SAFARI ZONE!\pWe're a little out of the way, but
please come visit!$
translation:
{PLAYER}！\p我是巴奥巴园长。\p让你久等啦。
我们的狩猎地带终于开业了！\p你知道在哪里吗？\p湛蓝市洞窟里面的那个大门，
你还记得吧？\p从那里穿过去走上一小段路，
马上就能看到狩猎地带了！\p虽然路途有点偏远，
但请一定要来玩哦！$

label: OlivineCity_Text_SilverEncounter
source:
You again?
There's no need to be alert.\pI don't bother with wimps
like you.\pSpeaking of weaklings, the
city's GYM LEADER isn't here,\land is supposedly taking care\lof a sick POKéMON at the\lLIGHTHOUSE.\pHumph! Boo-hoo!
Just let sick POKéMON go!\pA POKéMON that can't battle
is worthless!\pWhy don't you go train at the
LIGHTHOUSE?\pWho knows? It may make you a
bit of a better Trainer!$
translation:
又是你？
别那么提心吊胆的。\p我才没闲工夫理会
像你这样的弱者。\p说到弱者......这座城市的
道馆馆主根本不在这里。\l听说是在灯塔照料
生病的宝可梦呢。\p哼！真是笑话！
生病的宝可梦丢掉不就行了！\p不能战斗的宝可梦
根本毫无价值！\p你也去灯塔特训一下如何？\p谁知道呢，说不定能让你
稍微变强那么一点点！$

label: OlivineCity_Text_CafeSign
source: OLIVINE CAFE\nWHERE STRONG SAILORS ENJOY\lHEARTY MEALS OF STRENGTH$
translation: 浅黄咖啡厅\n让强壮水手\l大快朵颐长力气的地方$

label: OlivineCity_Text_EonTicketWoman1
source: My name is MARY!\pJust kidding, but I love MARY's\nradio show!$
translation: 我叫玛丽！\p开个玩笑啦，不过我真的很喜欢\n玛丽主持的广播节目！$

label: OlivineCity_Text_EonTicketWoman2
source: You must be {PLAYER}!!!\pOh my goodness! The champion!\pI heard about you on MARY's\nradio show!\pHere, take this!$
translation: 你一定就是{PLAYER}吧！！！\p天哪！是冠军本人！\p我在玛丽的广播节目里\n听到过你的事迹！\p来，这个送给你！$

label: OlivineCity_Text_EonTicketWoman3
source: I can't believe I met the\nchampion!!!$
translation: 真不敢相信我竟然见到了冠军！！！$

label: OlivineCity_Text_YoungsterPokegear
source: That thing you have--\nit's a POKéGEAR, right?\lWow, that's cool.$
translation: 你拿的那个--\n是宝可梦齿轮吧？\l哇，真酷啊。$

label: OlivineCity_Text_YoungsterPokedex
source: Wow, you have a POKéDEX!\pThat is just so awesome.$
translation: 哇，你有宝可梦图鉴！\p这也太厉害了吧。$

label: OlivineCity_Text_Sailor2
source:
The league has JASMINE
pegged as the sixth\lstrongest GYM LEADER!\pHah! That's a load of crud.\pThere's no way PRYCE could
hurt JASMINE's STEEL-type\lPOKéMON!\pBureaucracy if you ask me.\pShe's something to be feared,
that's for sure!$
translation:
联盟居然把阿蜜评为
第六强的道馆馆主！\pHah! 简直是一派胡言。\p柳伯根本不可能伤到
阿蜜的钢属性宝可梦好吗！\p依我看纯粹是官僚做派。\p她的实力绝对令人畏惧，
这是毫无疑问的！$

label: OlivineCity_Text_Sign
source: OLIVINE CITY\pThe Port Closest to Foreign Lands$
translation: 浅黄市\p散发异国情调的港口$

label: OlivineCity_Text_PortSign
source: OLIVINE PORT\nFAST SHIP PIER$
translation: 浅黄港\n高速船码头$

label: OlivineCity_Text_GymSign
source: OLIVINE CITY POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: JASMINE\pThe Steel-Clad Defense Girl$
translation: 浅黄市宝可梦道馆\n馆主：阿蜜\p铁壁防守的少女$

label: OlivineCity_Text_LighthouseSign
source: OLIVINE LIGHTHOUSE\nAlso known as the GLITTER\lLIGHTHOUSE$
translation: 浅黄灯塔\n别名 光辉灯塔$

label: OlivineCity_Text_BattleTowerSign
source: TRAINER HILL and\nBATTLE TENTS AHEAD.\pOpening Now!$
translation: 前方为训练家之丘与\n对战帐篷。\p现已开放！$

label: OlivineCity_Text_Machoke
source: MACHOKE: CHO!$
translation: 豪力：巧！$

label: OlivineCity_House1_Text_YouWillTradeWontYou
source: I collect POKéMON!\nDo you have a {STR_VAR_1}?\pWant to trade it for my\n{STR_VAR_2}?$
translation: 我正在收集宝可梦！\n你有{STR_VAR_1}吗？\p想用它来交换我的\n{STR_VAR_2}吗？$

label: OlivineCity_House1_Text_MonYouTakeCare
source: Yay! I got myself {STR_VAR_1}!\p{STR_VAR_2}, you take care!$
translation: 太好啦！我得到{STR_VAR_1}了！\p{STR_VAR_2}，你要保重哦！$

label: OlivineCity_House1_Text_ThisIsntAMon
source: Uh, no, I don't think so.\nThat isn't a {STR_VAR_1}.$
translation: 呃，不对吧。\n这并不是{STR_VAR_1}啊。$

label: OlivineCity_House1_Text_YouWontTradeMe
source: You don't want to trade? Aww...$
translation: 不想交换吗？好吧......$

label: OlivineCity_House1_Text_After
source: Hi, how's my old VOLTORB doing?$
translation: 嗨，我以前的那只霹雳电球\n过得怎么样啦？$

label: OlivineCity_Text_PunishmentBro
source: Along the way to CIANWOOD,\nthere are four deserted islands.\pBad kids are taken to those\nislands as punishment!$
translation: 去往湛蓝市的路上，\n有四座荒岛。\p不听话的坏孩子会被带去\n那些岛上受惩罚呢！$

label: OlivineCity_Text_PunishmentBoy
source: Whenever I get in trouble,\nbig bro always scares me.$
translation: 只要我一闯祸，\n哥哥就会拿这个吓唬我。$

label: OlivineCity_Text_OfferGoodRod
source: OLIVINE is on the sea!\pAnd if it's on the sea, there\nare bound to be fish!\pI've fished here for 30 years.\pWould you like to face the sea\nand try your hand at fishing?$
translation: 浅黄市临海！\p既然临海，那就少不了鱼！\p我在这里钓鱼钓了30年。\p怎么样？你也想面向大海，\n试试钓鱼的身手吗？$

label: OlivineCity_Text_GiveGoodRod
source: Ah, hahah! We have ourselves\na new angler in the making!$
translation: 啊哈哈！看来又有一位\n新钓手诞生了！$

label: OlivineCity_Text_GaveGoodRod
source:
Fish aren't only found in the
sea--they're wherever there's\lwater.\pBy the way, your POKéDEX shows
fishing groups for POKéMON.\pDifferent spots may contain
similar fish types.$
translation:
鱼儿不仅生活在大海里--
只要有水的地方就有它们。\p顺便一提，你的宝可梦图鉴会
显示宝可梦的钓鱼分类群。\p不同的钓点可能会栖息着
相似种类的鱼。$

label: OlivineCity_Text_DontWantGoodRod
source: Whaaat? You don't like to fish!?\nThat's incomprehensible!$
translation: 什--么？你居然不喜欢钓鱼！？\n真不可理喻！$

label: OlivineCity_Text_HaveGoodRod
source: How are things?\nDid you land the big one?$
translation: 战况如何？\n钓到大鱼了吗？$

label: OlivineLighthouse_Text_1FSailor
source: People train at this LIGHTHOUSE.\pIt's not easy to climb with all\nthe trainers waiting inside.$
translation: 大家都会在这座灯塔里特训。\p里面有那么多训练家等着发起挑战，\n想登上去可不容易呢。$

label: OlivineLighthouse_Text_1FPokefanF
source: In the past, POKéMON used to light\nthe sea around OLIVINE at night.\pThe LIGHTHOUSE was built in honor\nof those noble POKéMON.$
translation:
在过去，夜晚浅葱市周围的海面
全靠宝可梦们来照亮。\p这座灯塔就是为了纪念
那些崇高的宝可梦而建造的。$

label: OlivineLighthouse_Text_SailorHueySeen
source: Men of the sea are always\nspoiling for a good fight!$
translation:
大海的男儿随时都渴望
来一场痛快的战斗！$

label: OlivineLighthouse_Text_SailorHueyBeaten
source: Urf!\nI lose!$
translation:
唔呃！
我认输！$

label: OlivineLighthouse_Text_SailorHueyAfter
source: What power! How would you like\nto sail the seas with me?$
translation:
好强的力量！你愿意
和我一起扬帆出海吗？$

label: OlivineLighthouse_Text_HueyRegister
source: What power! How would you like\nto sail the seas with me?$
translation:
好强的力量！你愿意
和我一起扬帆出海吗？$

label: OlivineLighthouse_Text_HueyRematchIntro
source: Men of the sea are always\nspoiling for a good fight!$
translation:
大海的男儿随时都渴望
来一场痛快的战斗！$

label: OlivineLighthouse_Text_HueyRematchDefeat
source: Urf!\nI lose!$
translation:
唔呃！
我认输！$

label: OlivineLighthouse_Text_HueyPostRematch
source: What power! How would you like\nto sail the seas with me?$
translation:
好强的力量！你愿意
和我一起扬帆出海吗？$

label: OlivineLighthouse_Text_GentlemanAlfredSeen
source: Hm? This is no place\nfor playing.$
translation:
嗯？这里可不是
小孩子玩耍的地方。$

label: OlivineLighthouse_Text_GentlemanAlfredBeaten
source: Ah! I can see that you're\nserious.$
translation:
啊！看来你是
认真的啊。$

label: OlivineLighthouse_Text_GentlemanAlfredAfter
source: Up top is a POKéMON that keeps\nthe LIGHTHOUSE lit.\pBut I hear that it's sick now,\nand can't be cured normally.$
translation:
灯塔顶上有一只宝可梦
在维持着灯火长明。\p但我听说它现在病倒了，
普通的药物根本治不好它。$

label: OlivineLighthouse_Text_BirdKeeperTheoSeen
source: Why are you here? Are you just\ngoing to gawk? I suggest you leave!$
translation:
你来这儿干什么？纯粹来看热闹的吗？
我劝你还是赶紧离开吧！$

label: OlivineLighthouse_Text_BirdKeeperTheoBeaten
source: You really are concerned about\nthe sick POKéMON…$
translation:
原来你真的很担心
那只生病的宝可梦啊......$

label: OlivineLighthouse_Text_BirdKeeperTheoAfter
source: How the heck do you go up?\pI want to visit the sick POKéMON,\nbut I can't get up there…$
translation:
到底要怎么才能爬上去啊？\p我想去探望那只生病的宝可梦，
可怎么也上不去......$

label: OlivineLighthouse_Text_SailorTerrellSeen
source: Sailors are both kind and strong.\nHow about you?$
translation:
水手既温柔又强壮。
那你呢？$

label: OlivineLighthouse_Text_SailorTerrellBeaten
source: You are both kind and strong…$
translation: 你也是既温柔又强大啊......$

label: OlivineLighthouse_Text_SailorTerrellAfter
source: Every time I return to OLIVINE,\nI visit the GYM.\pThe GYM LEADER’s POKéMON type\nchanged without me noticing.$
translation:
每次回到浅葱市，
我都会去拜访道馆。\p没想到在我没留意的时候，
馆主擅长的属性都已经变了。$

label: OlivineLighthouse_Text_GentlemanPrestonSeen
source: I travel the world to train my\nPOKéMON. I wish to battle you.$
translation:
我周游世界来训练宝可梦。
我想和你对战一场。$

label: OlivineLighthouse_Text_GentlemanPrestonBeaten
source: …sigh… I must train some more…$

label: OlivineLighthouse_Text_GentlemanPrestonAfter
source: JASMINE used to use ROCK-type\nPOKéMON like ONIX.$
translation:
阿蜜以前使用的是
大岩蛇之类的岩石属性宝可梦。$

label: OlivineLighthouse_Text_SailorKentSeen
source: JASMINE must be worried sick about\nthe POKéMON here.\pShe won't even smile these days.$
translation: 阿蜜现在一定非常担心这里的宝可梦吧。\p她这几天连笑容都见不到了。$

label: OlivineLighthouse_Text_SailorKentBeaten
source: I can't manage a smile either…$
translation: 我也完全笑不出来了......$

label: OlivineLighthouse_Text_SailorKentAfter
source: Speaking of sick, I've heard there's\na good PHARMACY in CIANWOOD.$
translation:
说起生病，我听说湛蓝市
有一家很棒的药房。$

label: OlivineLighthouse_Text_LassConnieSeen
source: JASMINE is this city's GYM LEADER.\pI mean to bring her back with me.\pNobody had better get in my way!$
translation: 阿蜜是这座城市的道馆馆主。\p我打算把她劝回道馆去。\p谁也别想来碍我的事！$

label: OlivineLighthouse_Text_LassConnieBeaten
source: Aaack! My POKéMON!$
translation: 啊啊啊！我的宝可梦！$

label: OlivineLighthouse_Text_LassConnieAfter
source: Right. Anybody would be worried if\nhis or her own POKéMON were hurt.\pI'll pray for the POKéMON here, so\nJASMINE can come back to the GYM.$
translation:
说得也是。如果是自己的宝可梦生病了，
任谁都会心急如焚的。\p我会为这里的宝可梦祈祷的，
好让阿蜜能早日重返道馆。$

label: OlivineLighthouse_Text_SailorErnestSeen
source: I wanted to battle JASMINE, but she's\nnot up to it now.\pSo, how about you?$
translation: 我本想找阿蜜挑战，但她现在完全没那份心思。\p那么，换你来陪我过两招怎么样？$

label: OlivineLighthouse_Text_SailorErnestBeaten
source: Whoa, whoa. You're overwhelming!$
translation: 哇啊，哇啊。你的实力简直深不可测！$

label: OlivineLighthouse_Text_SailorErnestAfter
source: A GYM LEADER isn't just about being\nstrong.\pA LEADER also needs to be\ncompassionate.$
translation:
道馆馆主可不仅仅只要实力强大。\p馆主同时还要拥有一颗
体贴温柔的心才行。$

label: OlivineLighthouse_Text_BirdKeeperDenisSeen
source: We're pretty high up here. My bird\nPOKéMON are in prime form.$
translation: 这里地势挺高的呢。\n我的鸟宝可梦状态正佳！$

label: OlivineLighthouse_Text_BirdKeeperDenisBeaten
source: Oops… They crashed…$

label: OlivineLighthouse_Text_BirdKeeperDenisAfter
source: My POKéMON learned how to use FLY in\nCIANWOOD.\pWell, since I'm a loser, I'll FLY\nacross the sea…$
translation: 我的宝可梦是在湛蓝市\n学会"飞翔"的。\p唉，既然输了，那我就\n"飞翔"渡海回去吧......$

label: OlivineLighthouse_Text_JasmineCianwoodPharmacy
source:
JASMINE: …This POKéMON always kept
the sea lit at night.\p…But it suddenly got sick… It's
gasping for air…\p…I understand that there is a
wonderful PHARMACY in CIANWOOD…\pBut that's across the sea…
And I can't leave AMPHY unattended…$
translation:
阿蜜：......这只宝可梦每到夜晚，
都会照亮海面。\p......可是它突然病倒了......
现在呼吸非常微弱痛苦......\p......我听说湛蓝市
有一家很棒的药房......\p可是那边隔着大海......
我又不能丢下阿利不管......$

label: OlivineLighthouse_Text_JasmineGetMedicine
source: …May I ask you to get some medicine\nfor me? Please?$
translation: ......能拜托你替我\n去取一些药来吗？求求你了。$

label: OlivineLighthouse_Text_JasmineGetMedicine2
source:
There is a wonderful PHARMACY
in CIANWOOD…\pBut that's across the sea…
And I can't leave AMPHY unattended…\p…May I ask you to get some medicine
for me? Please?$
translation: 湛蓝市有一家很棒的药房......\p可是那边隔着大海......\n我又不能丢下阿利不管......\p......能拜托你替我\n去取一些药来吗？求求你了。$

label: OlivineLighthouse_Text_JasmineCureAmphy
source: JASMINE: …Will that medicine cure\nAMPHY?$
translation: 阿蜜：......那种药能治好\n阿利吗？$

label: OlivineLighthouse_Text_PlayerHandedSecretpotion
source: {PLAYER} handed the SECRET POTION to\nJASMINE.$
translation: {PLAYER}把秘传药\n交给了阿蜜。$

label: OlivineLighthouse_Text_JasmineDontBeOffended
source: JASMINE: …Um, please don't be\noffended…\p…AMPHY will not take anything from\nanyone but me…$
translation: 阿蜜：......那个，请不要见怪......\p......阿利除了我给的东西，\n谁喂的都不肯吃......$

label: OlivineLighthouse_Text_JasmineAmphyHowFeeling
source: JASMINE: …\pAMPHY, how are you feeling?$
translation: 阿蜜：......\p阿利，感觉好些了吗？$

label: OlivineLighthouse_Text_JasmineThankYou
source: JASMINE: …Oh, I'm so relieved…\pThis is just so wonderful…\pThank you so very, very much.\p…I will return to the GYM…\pI'll also warn you, STEEL types\nare powerful.$
translation: 阿蜜：......太好了，真是松了一口气......\p这真是太好了......\p真的、非常感谢你。\p......我要回道馆去了......\p顺便提醒你一句，\n钢属性可是很厉害的哦。$

label: OlivineLighthouse_Text_JasmineISee
source: JASMINE: …I see…\n…AMPHY, hang on!$

label: OlivineLighthouse_Text_AmphyPalPaloo
source: AMPHY: …\n…Pa… paloo…$

label: OlivineLighthouse_Text_AmphyBreathingLabored
source: Its breathing is terribly\nlabored…$
translation: 它的呼吸看起来\n非常痛苦......$

label: OlivineLighthouse_Text_AmphyPaluPalulu
source: AMPHY: Palu! Palulu!$
translation: 阿利：帕噜！帕噜噜！$

label: OlivineCity_Text_MartCooltrainerF
source: Do your POKéMON already know\nthe move for carrying people\lacross water?$
translation: 你的宝可梦已经学会\n带人渡海的招式了吗？$

label: OlivineCity_Text_MartLass
source: My BUTTERFREE came from my\nboyfriend overseas.\pIt carried some MAIL from him.\pWant to know what it says?\pLet's see... Nope! It's a\nsecret!$
translation: 我的巴大蝶是我在海外的\n男朋友送给我的。\p它还带来了他写的信呢。\p想知道上面写了什么吗？\p让我想想......不行！这是秘密！$

label: OlivineCity_Text_PokecenterFisher
source: The SAILOR in the OLIVINE CAFE\nnext door is really generous.\pHe taught my POKéMON STRENGTH.\pNow it can move big boulders\nwithout breaking a sweat.$
translation: 隔壁浅黄咖啡馆的水手大叔\n人可大方了。\p他教了我的宝可梦"劲力"。\p现在它轻轻松松就能推动大圆石了。$

label: OlivineCity_Text_PokecenterTeacher
source: There's a person in CIANWOOD\nCITY across the sea.\pI heard him bragging about his\nrare POKéMON all the time.$
translation: 大海对面的湛蓝市有个人，\p听说他整天到处吹嘘\n自己拥有稀有的宝可梦呢。$

label: OlivineCity_PortInside_Text_Nationaldex1
source:
PROF.OAK: Hello!
You are starting to have the\lattitude of a CHAMPION, {PLAYER}!\pIt's time for your POKéDEX to
match who you are.\pLet me see your POKéDEX for a
second.\pI'll upgrade your POKéDEX with the
NATIONAL MODE.$
translation: 大木博士：你好啊！\n{PLAYER}，你现在越来越有\l冠军的架势了呢！\p是时候让你的图鉴也配得上现在的你了。\p把你的宝可梦图鉴借我看一下。\p我来帮你的宝可梦图鉴\n升级为全国图鉴模式。$

label: OlivineCity_PortInside_Text_Nationaldex2
source: {PLAYER}'s POKéDEX was upgraded\nwith the NATIONAL MODE!$
translation: {PLAYER}的宝可梦图鉴升级为\n全国图鉴模式！$

label: OlivineCity_PortInside_Text_Nationaldex3
source: PROF.OAK: It won't be easy to\ncomplete the NATIONAL POKéDEX...\pHowever, I'm sure you will make\nhonest attempt on our behalf!$
translation: 大木博士：想要完成全国图鉴\n可不是件容易的事......\p不过，我相信你一定会\n全力以赴去挑战的！$

label: OlivineCity_PortInside_Text_Nationaldex4
source: Oh, time flies!\pI have a radio show to record at\nGOLDENROD RADIO TOWER.\pYou must be heading for KANTO.\pIf you come near PALLET TOWN, do\ndrop by my POKéMON RESEARCH LAB!$
translation: 哎呀，时间过得真快！\p我还要去满金广播电台\n录制广播节目呢。\p你接下来肯定是要去关都了吧。\p如果路过真新镇的话，\n一定要来我的宝可梦研究所坐坐啊！$

label: OlivinePort_Text_NoPass
source: {PLAYER} tried to show the\n{STR_VAR_1}…\p…But no {STR_VAR_1}!\pSorry!\nYou may board only if you have an\l{STR_VAR_1}.$
translation: {PLAYER}想要出示\n{STR_VAR_1}......\p......但是没有找到{STR_VAR_1}！\p非常抱歉！\n必须持有{STR_VAR_1}\l才能登船。$

label: OlivinePort_Text_SailorGetOnBoard
source: We're departing soon.\nPlease get on board.$
translation: 马上就要启航了。\n请抓紧时间登船。$

label: OlivinePort_Text_CantBoard
source: Sorry. You can't board now.$
translation: 很抱歉，现在还不能登船。$

label: OlivinePort_Text_WhereSail
source: Where would you like to sail?$
translation: 请问您想航行到哪里？$

label: OlivinePort_Text_AskBoard
source: Welcome to FAST SHIP S.S.AQUA.\pWill you be boarding today?$
translation: 欢迎乘坐高速船阿库号。\p您今天要登船吗？$

label: OlivinePort_Text_AskTicket
source: May I see your S.S.TICKET?$
translation: 请出示您的船票。$

label: OlivinePort_Text_ComeAgain
source: 欢迎下次再来！$
translation: 欢迎下次再来！$

label: OlivinePort_Text_FlashTicket
source: {PLAYER} flashed the S.S.TICKET.\pThat's it. Thank you!$
translation: {PLAYER}出示了船票。\p确认无误。非常感谢！$

label: OlivinePort_Text_NoTicket
source: {PLAYER} tried to show the\nS.S.TICKET…\p…But no TICKET!\pSorry!\nYou may board only\lif you have an S.S.TICKET.$
translation: {PLAYER}正准备出示\n船票......\p......但是没有船票！\p很抱歉！\n只有持有船票的乘客\l才可以登船。$

label: OlivinePort_Text_FishingGuru1
source: SHELLDER are easy to catch here.\pThey're kind of rare elsewhere.$
translation: 在这里很容易钓到大舌贝呢。\p在别的地方可挺少见的。$

label: OlivinePort_Text_FishingGuru2
source: How many RODS do you have?\pDifferent RODS catch different\nPOKéMON.$
translation: 你有几种钓竿呢？\p不同的钓竿能钓到\n不同的宝可梦哦。$

label: OlivinePort_Text_Youngster
source: S.S.AQUA uses jets to skim\nover the waves!$
translation: 高速船阿库号是靠喷射水流\n破浪前行的哦！$

label: OlivinePort_Text_CooltrainerF
source: There are lots of POKéMON in KANTO.\pI wish I could go…$
translation: 关都地区有很多宝可梦呢。\p真想去看看啊......$

label: OlivinePort_Text_SailorBeforeHOF
source: We don't want you to fall into the\nsea, so you're not allowed in.$
translation: 掉进海里可就危险了，\n所以禁止入内哦。$

label: OlivineCity_PortOutside_Text_Sabrina
source: SABRINA: Out of the blue,\nI get the urge to see the ocean.\pI'll see you at the FIGHTING\nDOJO.$
translation: 娜姿：不知怎么的，\n突然很想来看看大海呢。\p我们格斗道场见吧。$

label: OlivineCity_PortOutside_Text_PortFisherman1
source: FAST SHIP S.S.AQUA used to sail to\nKANTO on Mondays and Fridays. But\lnow, it sails almost constantly!$
translation: 高速船阿库号以前只有在\n周一和周五才会开往关都。\l不过现在几乎随时都在航行呢！$

label: OlivineCity_PortOutside_Text_Fisherman2
source: Aw yeah, I'm fishin'.$
translation: 哈，我正在钓鱼呢！$

label: OneIsland_Text_ReturnToCinnabar
source: グレンタウンに　もどりますか？$
translation: 要回红莲镇吗？$

label: PacifidlogTown_Text_TownSign
source: PACIFIDLOG TOWN\p“Where the morning sun smiles upon\nthe waters.”$
translation: 暮水镇\p"朝阳微笑洒水面的小镇。"$

label: PalletTown_Text_HmmIsThatRight
source: Hmm…\nIs that right…$

label: PalletTown_Text_OhLookLook
source: Oh!\nLook, look!$
translation: 哇！\n看呀看呀！$

label: PalletTown_Text_ReadItReadIt
source: Read it, read it!$
translation: 读一下，快读一下！$

label: PalletTown_Text_PressStartToOpenMenu
source: TRAINER TIPS\pPress START to open the MENU!$
translation: 宝可梦指南\p按下START键可以打开菜单！$

label: PalletTown_Text_SignsAreUsefulArentThey
source: Signs are useful, aren't they?$
translation: 告示牌很管用吧？$

label: PalletTown_Text_LookCopiedTrainerTipsSign
source: Look, look!\pI copied what it said on one of\nthose TRAINER TIPS signs!$
translation: 看呀看呀！\p我把宝可梦指南告示牌上的内容\n抄下来了哦！$

label: PalletTown_Text_PressStartToOpenMenuCopy
source: TRAINER TIPS!\pPress START to open the MENU!$
translation: 宝可梦指南！\p按下START键可以打开菜单！$

label: PalletTown_Text_Teacher
source: I'm raising POKéMON too.\pThey serve as my private\nguards.$
translation: 我也在培育宝可梦呢。\p它们是我的私人保镖。$

label: PalletTown_Text_Fisher
source: Technology is incredible!\pYou can now trade POKéMON\nacross time like e-mail.$
translation: 科技的力量真厉害！\p现在的宝可梦竟然能\n像发电子邮件一样跨越时空进行交换！$

label: PalletTown_Text_Sign
source: PALLET TOWN\pA Tranquil Setting of Peace\n& Purity$
translation: 真新镇\p象征和平与纯净的\n静谧之地$

label: PalletTown_Text_RedsHouseSign
source: RED'S HOUSE$
translation: 赤红的家$

label: PalletTown_Text_OaksLabSign
source: 大木宝可梦研究所$
translation: 大木宝可梦研究所$

label: PalletTown_Text_BluesHouseSign
source: BLUE'S HOUSE$
translation: 青绿的家$

label: PalletTown_House2_Text_Hello
source: DAISY: Hi! My kid brother is the\nGYM LEADER in VIRIDIAN CITY.\pBut he goes out of town so\noften, it causes problems for\lthe trainers.$
translation: 奈奈美：嗨！我弟弟是常青市的道馆馆主。\p但他总喜欢往外跑，\n让不少挑战的训练家都很困扰呢。$

label: PalletTown_House2_Text_OfferGrooming
source: DAISY: Hi! Good timing. I'm about\nto have some tea.\pWould you like to join me?\pOh, your POKéMON are a bit dirty.\pWould you like me to groom one?$
translation: 奈奈美：嗨！来得正好，我正打算喝杯下午茶呢。\p要和我一起喝点吗？\p哎呀，你的宝可梦身上有点脏兮兮的呢。\p要让我帮你给其中一只梳毛美容一下吗？$

label: PalletTown_House2_Text_WhichMon
source: DAISY: Which one should I groom?$
translation: 奈奈美：要给哪一只美容呢？$

label: PalletTown_House2_Text_Alright
source: DAISY: OK, I'll get it looking\nnice in no time.$
translation: 奈奈美：好的，马上就把它\n打扮得漂漂亮亮的。$

label: PalletTown_House2_Text_AllDone
source: DAISY: There you go! All done.\pSee? Doesn't {STR_VAR_1} look\nnice?\pIt's such a cute POKéMON.$
translation: 奈奈美：好啦！大功告成！\p你看，{STR_VAR_1}是不是变得漂亮多了？\p真是只可爱的宝可梦呢。$

label: PalletTown_House2_Text_AlreadyGroomed
source: DAISY: I always have tea around\nthis time. Come join me.$
translation: 奈奈美：我每天这个时间都会喝下午茶。\n你也一起来吧。$

label: PalletTown_House2_Text_Refused
source: DAISY: You don't want to have one\ngroomed?\pOK, we'll just have tea.$
translation: 奈奈美：不需要美容吗？\p好的，那我们就只喝茶吧。$

label: PalletTown_House2_Text_CantGroomEgg
source: DAISY: Oh, sorry. I honestly can't\ngroom an EGG.$
translation: 奈奈美：哎呀，抱歉呢。蛋实在没法梳毛美容啊。$

label: PalletTown_Lab_Text_OakLabDexCheck
source: How is your POKéDEX coming?$
translation: 你的宝可梦图鉴进展如何了？$

label: PalletTown_Lab_Text_OakWelcomeKanto
source: OAK: Ah, {PLAYER}!\nIt's good of you to come all this\lway to KANTO.\pWhat do you think of the trainers\nout here? Pretty tough, huh?$
translation: 大木：啊，{PLAYER}！\n你大老远赶到关都来，真是辛苦你了。\p你觉得这边的训练家怎么样？\n相当厉害吧？$

label: PalletTown_Lab_Text_OakLabGoodbye
source: If you're in the area, I hope you\ncome visit again.$
translation: 如果你在附近的话，随时欢迎再来看看我。$

label: PalletTown_Lab_Text_OakOpenMtSilver
source:
OAK: Wow! That's excellent!\pYou collected the BADGES of GYMS
in KANTO. Well done!\pI was right in my assessment of
you.\pTell you what, {PLAYER}. I'll make
arrangements so that you can go\lto MT.SILVER.\pMT.SILVER is a big mountain that
is home to many wild POKéMON.\pIt's too dangerous for your average
trainer, so it's off limits. But\lwe can make an exception in your\lcase, {PLAYER}.\pGo up to INDIGO PLATEAU. You can
reach MT.SILVER from there.$
translation:
大木：哇！太棒了！\p你集齐了关都的所有道馆徽章！
干得真漂亮！\p我果然没有看错你。\p这样吧，{PLAYER}。我会去打个招呼，
让你能够前往白银山。\p白银山是一座巨大的高山，
栖息着很多野生的宝可梦。\p对一般的训练家来说那里太危险了，
所以平常是禁止进入的。
不过对你来说就可以破例了，{PLAYER}。\p前往石英高原吧。从那里就可以
出发前往白银山了。$

label: PalletTown_Lab_Text_OakOpenIndigoPlateau
source: Oh, and speaking of the INDIGO\nPLATEAU, now that you've earned\l16 badges, the KANTO LEAGUE\lwill be ready to accept\lyour challenge once again.\pBut be warned, LANCE and his\nELITE FOUR won't go easy on you\lthis time.\pGood luck, {PLAYER}!$
translation:
对了，说到石英高原，
既然你已经拿到了全部16枚徽章，\l关都联盟也准备好
再次接受你的挑战了。\p不过要小心，阿渡和他的四天王
这次可绝对不会手下留情哦。\p祝你好运，{PLAYER}！$

label: PalletTown_Lab_Text_OakNoKantoBadges
source: OAK: Hmm? You're not collecting\nKANTO GYM BADGES?\pThe GYM LEADERS in KANTO are as\ntough as any you battled in JOHTO.\pI recommend that you challenge them.$
translation: 大木：嗯？你没在收集关都的道馆徽章吗？\p关都的道馆馆主们，\n可不输给城都地方的任何强敌啊。\p我建议你去向他们挑战看看。$

label: PalletTown_Lab_Text_OakYesKantoBadges
source: OAK: Ah, you're collecting KANTO\nGYM BADGES.\pI imagine that it's hard, but the\nexperience is sure to help you.\pCome see me when you get them all.\pI'll have a gift for you.\pKeep trying hard, {PLAYER}!$
translation: 大木：啊，你正在收集关都的道馆徽章啊。\p虽然一路肯定很不容易，\n但这段经历一定会成为你的宝贵财富。\p等你全部收集齐了，就来找我吧。\p我会准备一份礼物送给你的。\p继续加油哦，{PLAYER}！$

label: PalletTown_Lab_Text_OaksAssistant1
source: The PROF's POKéMON TALK radio\nprogram isn't aired here in KANTO.\pIt's a shame--I'd like to hear it.$
translation: 关都这边收不到大木博士的\n《宝可梦讲座》广播呢。\p真可惜，我也好想听听看啊。$

label: PalletTown_Lab_Text_OaksAssistant2
source: Thanks to your work on the POKéDEX,\nthe PROF's research is coming along\lgreat.$
translation: 多亏了你在图鉴上的努力，\n博士的研究进展得非常顺利呢。$

label: PalletTown_Lab_Text_OaksAssistant3
source: Don't tell anyone, but PROF.OAK'S\nPOKéMON TALK isn't a live broadcast.$
translation: 这事可别告诉别人，大木博士的\n《宝可梦讲座》其实不是现场直播的。$

label: PalletTown_Lab_Text_OaksLabPC
source: There's an e-mail message on the PC.\p…\pPROF.OAK, how is your research\ncoming along?\pI'm still plugging away.\pI heard rumors that {PLAYER} is\ngetting quite a reputation.\pI'm delighted to hear that.\pELM in NEW BARK TOWN 8-)$
translation: 电脑上有一封电子邮件。\p......\p大木博士，您的研究进展得怎么样了？\p我这边还在埋头苦干呢。\p我听说{PLAYER}现在名气越来越大了。\p听到这个消息我真替TA高兴。\p若叶镇 空木 8-)$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_EmailMessage
source:
There's an e-mail message here.\p…\pFinally!
The ultimate TRAINERS of the\lPOKéMON LEAGUE are ready to\ltake on all comers!\pBring your best POKéMON and see
how you rate as a TRAINER!\pPOKéMON LEAGUE HQ
INDIGO PLATEAU\pPROF. OAK, please visit us!
…$
translation:
这里有一封电子邮件。\p......\p终于！
宝可梦联盟的最强训练家们\l已经准备好迎接所有挑战者！\p带上你最强的宝可梦，来测试
你作为训练家的真正实力吧！\p宝可梦联盟本部
石英高原\p大木博士，请务必光临！
......$

label: RedsHouse_Text_Mom1
source: Hi!\pRED's been away for a long time.\pHe hasn't called either, so I have\nno idea where he is or what he's\lbeen doing.\pThey say that no word is proof that\nhe's doing fine, but I do worry\labout him.$
translation:
你好呀！\p赤红已经出门好久了。\p他也没打过电话，我完全不知道
他现在在哪儿，在做些什么。\p虽说没有消息就是好消息，
可我还是会担心他呀。$

label: RedsHouse_Text_Mom2
source: I worry about RED getting hurt or\nsick, but he's a boy.\pI'm proud that he is doing what he\nwants to do.$
translation:
我总担心赤红会不会受伤或是生病，
不过他毕竟是个男孩子。\p能去做自己想做的事，
我为他感到骄傲。$

label: RedsHouse_Text_TV
source: They have programs that aren't\nshown in JOHTO…$
translation:
正在播放城都地区
看不到的电视节目......$

label: RedsHouse_Text_NES
source: {PLAYER} played the NES.\pBetter get going--no time to lose!$
translation: {PLAYER}玩了一会儿FC游戏机。\p该出发了--可没时间磨蹭了！$

label: RedsHouse_Text_PC
source: It looks like it hasn't been used\nin a long time…$
translation: 看来已经很久没有人用过了......$

label: PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_ThereYouGoAllDone
source: {COLOR DARK_GRAY}{STR_VAR_1} looks dreamily content…\p{COLOR RED}DAISY: There you go! All done.\n
translation: {COLOR DARK_GRAY}{STR_VAR_1}看起来非常满足，陶醉其中......\p{COLOR RED}奈奈美：好啦！大功告成。

label: PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_ThereYouGoAllDone
source: {FONT_NORMAL}{STR_VAR_1} looks dreamily content…\p{FONT_FEMALE}DAISY: There you go! All done.\n
translation: {FONT_NORMAL}{STR_VAR_1}看起来非常满足，陶醉其中......\p{FONT_FEMALE}奈奈美：好啦！大功告成。

label: PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_ThereYouGoAllDone
source: See? Doesn't it look nice?\pGiggle…\nIt's such a cute POKéMON.$
translation:
看，是不是变漂亮了？\p嘻嘻......
真是只可爱的宝可梦。$

label: PewterCity_Gym_Text_Brock_Intro
source: BROCK: Wow, it's not often that we get a\nchallenger from JOHTO.\pI'm BROCK, the PEWTER GYM LEADER.\pI'm an expert on ROCK-type POKéMON.\pMy POKéMON are impervious to most\nphysical attacks. You'll have a hard\ltime inflicting any damage.\pCome on!$
translation:
小刚：哎呀，来自城都的挑战者
还真是少见呢。\p我是深灰道馆的馆主小刚。\p我是岩石属性宝可梦的专家。\p我的宝可梦对大多数物理攻击
都不屑一顾。你可很难给它们造成伤害哦。\p放马过来吧！$

label: PewterCity_Gym_Text_Brock_WinLoss
source: BROCK: Your POKéMON's powerful attacks\novercame my rock-hard defense…\pYou're stronger than I expected…\pGo ahead--take this BADGE.$
translation:
小刚：你的宝可梦用强力的攻击
突破了我如岩石般坚固的防御......\p你比我想象的还要强......\p收下吧--这是你的徽章。$

label: PewterCity_Gym_Text_ReceivedBoulderBadge
source: {PLAYER} received BOULDERBADGE.$
translation: {PLAYER}获得了灰色徽章。$

label: PewterCity_Gym_Text_Brock_GiveTM
source: Here, take this TM with you.$
translation: 来，把这个招式学习器也带上吧。$

label: PewterCity_Gym_Text_Brock_ExplainTM
source: It contains ROCK SLIDE.\pIt drops rocks on your opponents\nwith a chance to cause flinching.\pUse it to stop them in their tracks.$
translation:
里面是"岩崩"。\p将岩石砸向对手，
有时还能使对手畏缩。\p用它来让对手寸步难行吧。$

label: PewterCity_Gym_Text_Brock_BoulderBadge
source: BROCK: {PLAYER}, thanks. I enjoyed\nbattling you, even though I am a bit\lupset.\pThat BOULDERBADGE will make your\nPOKéMON even more powerful.$
translation:
小刚：{PLAYER}，谢谢你。虽然有点不甘心，
但我很享受这场对战。\p有了灰色徽章，
你的宝可梦会变得更加强大。$

label: PewterCity_Gym_Text_Brock_FightDone
source: BROCK: The world is huge. There are\nstill many strong trainers like you.\pJust wait and see. I'm going to become\na lot stronger too.$
translation:
小刚：世界真的很宽广。还有很多像你一样
强大的训练家。\p走着瞧吧，
我也会变得更加强大的。$

label: PewterCity_Gym_Text_CamperJerry_Seen
source: The trainers of this GYM use ROCK-type\nPOKéMON.\pThe ROCK-type has high DEFENSE.\pBattles could end up going a long time.\nAre you ready for this?$
translation:
这个道馆的训练家都使用岩石属性宝可梦。\p岩石属性的防御力很高。\p对战可能会演变成持久战。
你准备好了吗？$

label: PewterCity_Gym_Text_CamperJerry_Beaten
source: I have to win these battles…$
translation: 我一定要赢下这些对战才行......$

label: PewterCity_Gym_Text_CamperJerry_AfterBattle
source: Hey, you! Trainer from JOHTO! BROCK is\ntough. He'll punish you if you don't\ltake him seriously.$
translation:
喂，你！城都来的训练家！小刚馆主
可强着呢。你要是不认真对待，\l可有你吃苦头的！$

label: PewterCity_Gym_Text_Guide
source:
Yo! CHAMP in making! You're really
rocking.\pAre you battling the GYM LEADERS of
KANTO?\pThey're strong and dedicated people,
just like JOHTO's GYM LEADERS.$
translation:
哟！未来的冠军！你真是势不可挡啊。\p你正在挑战关都的道馆馆主吗？\p他们和城都的道馆馆主一样，
既强大又全心全意投入哦。$

label: PewterCity_Gym_Text_Guide_Win
source: Yo! CHAMP in making! That GYM didn't\ngive you much trouble.\pThe way you took charge was really\ninspiring. I mean that seriously.$
translation:
哟！未来的冠军！这个道馆对你来说
根本不在话下嘛。\p你掌控全局的英姿真是太让人振奋了。
我这话可是认真的哦。$

label: PewterCity_Gym_Text_GymStatue
source: PEWTER POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: BROCK\pWINNING TRAINERS:\nBLUE, RED$
translation:
深灰宝可梦道馆
馆主：小刚\p胜出训练家：
青绿、赤红$

label: PewterCity_Gym_Text_GymStatuePlayerWon
source: PEWTER POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: BROCK\pWINNING TRAINERS:\nBLUE, RED, {PLAYER}$
translation:
深灰宝可梦道馆
馆主：小刚\p胜出训练家：
青绿、赤红、{PLAYER}$

label: PewterCity_Gym_Text_BrockWantToTrade
source:
BROCK: Hey, {PLAYER}. I found this
little BONSLY while training in the\lmountains.\pIt's cute, but I think it needs
a different kind of trainer.\pWould you trade a {STR_VAR_1}
for my {STR_VAR_2}?$
translation:
小刚：嗨，{PLAYER}。我在深山修行的时候
遇到了这只小小的盆才怪。\p它很可爱，但我觉得它需要
另一种风格的训练家。\p你愿意用{STR_VAR_1}
来交换我的{STR_VAR_2}吗？$

label: PewterCity_Gym_Text_BrockTakeCare
source: BROCK: Thanks! Take good care of\nWOODY for me!$
translation:
小刚：谢谢你！要替我好好照顾
伍迪哦！$

label: PewterCity_Gym_Text_BrockDeclineTrade
source: BROCK: No? That's okay.\nWOODY and I will keep training.$
translation:
小刚：不愿意吗？没关系。
我和伍迪会继续修行的。$

label: PewterCity_Gym_Text_BrockNotRequestedMon
source: BROCK: That's not a {STR_VAR_1}.\nThat's not what I'm after.$
translation:
小刚：那不是{STR_VAR_1}。
不是我要找的那只宝可梦。$

label: PewterCity_Gym_Text_BrockTradeCompleted
source: BROCK: How's WOODY doing?\nBONSLY are tougher than they look!$
translation:
小刚：小树最近过得怎么样？
盆才怪可比看起来结实多啦！$

label: PewterCity_Text_CooltrainerF
source: Have you visited PEWTER GYM?\pThe LEADER uses ROCK-type POKéMON.$
translation: 你去过深灰道馆了吗？\p馆主使用的是岩石属性的宝可梦。$

label: PewterCity_Text_BugCatcher
source: At night, CLEFAIRY come out to play at\nMT.MOON.\pBut not every night.$
translation:
到了晚上，皮皮们会出来在
月见山玩耍呢。\p不过并不是每天晚上都会出来。$

label: PewterCity_Text_Gramps
source:
Ah, you came all the way out here from
JOHTO?\pThat brings back memories. When I was
young, I went to JOHTO to train.\pYou remind me so much of what I was like
as a young man.\pHere. I want you to have this item I
found in JOHTO.$
translation:
啊，你大老远从城都地区过来吗？\p真让人怀念啊。我年轻的时候，
也去城都修行过呢。\p看到你，就让我想起自己年轻时的模样。\p来，这个给你。这是我在城都找到的道具。$

label: PewterCity_Text_Gramps_GotSilverWing
source: Going to new, unknown places and seeing\nnew people…\pThose are the joys of travel.$
translation: 去往未知的崭新之地，邂逅形形色色的人......\p这就是旅行的乐趣所在啊。$

label: PewterCity_Text_Sign
source: PEWTER CITY\nA Stone Gray City$
translation:
深灰市
坚若磐石的灰色之城$

label: PewterCity_Text_GymSign
source: PEWTER CITY POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: BROCK\pThe Rock Solid POKéMON Trainer$
translation:
深灰市宝可梦道馆
馆主：小刚\p坚如磐石的宝可梦训练家$

label: PewterCity_Text_MuseumSign
source: There's a notice here…\pPEWTER MUSEUM OF SCIENCE is closed for\nrenovations…$
translation:
这里贴着一张告示......\p深灰科学博物馆因进行内部改装，
现暂停开放......$

label: PewterCity_Text_MtMoonGiftShopSign
source: There's a notice here…\pMT.MOON GIFT SHOP NOW OPEN!$
translation: 这里贴着一张告示......\p月见山纪念品商店现已开业！$

label: PewterCity_Text_WelcomeSign
source: WELCOME TO PEWTER CITY!$
translation: 欢迎来到深灰市！$

label: PewterCity_House1_Text_SuperNerd
source: NIDORAN, shake!$
translation: 尼多朗，握手！$

label: PewterCity_House1_Text_Nidoran
source: NIDORAN: Gau gau!$
translation: 尼多朗：嘎唔嘎唔！$

label: PewterCity_House2_Text_Gramps
source: I like snoozing with the radio on…\n…Zzzz…$
translation:
我喜欢开着收音机打瞌睡......
......呼噜噜......$

label: PewterCity_Mart_Text_Youngster
source: Hi! Check out my GYARADOS!\pI raised it from a MAGIKARP. I can't\nbelieve how strong it has become.$
translation:
嗨！瞧瞧我的暴鲤龙！\p它可是我从鲤鱼王一手养大的。
真不敢相信它现在变得这么强。$

label: PewterCity_Mart_Text_SuperNerd
source: There once was a weird old man who sold\nMAGIKARP.\pHe was saying the MAGIKARP from the\nLAKE OF RAGE were excellent.$
translation:
以前有个卖鲤鱼王的古怪大叔。\p他逢人就说愤怒之湖的鲤鱼王
品质极其出众呢。$

label: PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_PleaseGoAround
source: あちらへ　おまわりください$
translation: 请绕到那边。$

label: PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_Recptionist
source: Welcome!\pJust to let you know, all the large\nspecimens have been taken to the\lother museums for display.\pSo for now, admission is free of\ncharge!\pPlease go ahead.$
translation:
欢迎光临！\p向您说明一下，由于所有大型标本
都被借调到其他博物馆展出了，\p因此目前本馆免费参观！\p请随意参观吧。$

label: PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_FossilWoman
source: You must be a strong trainer.\pWe don't have much use for the\nfossils on the counter over there.\pA strange man with silver hair\ndropped a ton of them off here.\pGo ahead and take them if you like.$
translation:
你一定是一位很厉害的训练家吧。\p那边柜台上的化石，我们留着也没什么用。\p是一位留着银色头发的奇怪男子
送了一大堆过来的。\p如果你想要的话，尽管拿去吧。$

label: PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_FossilWomanAfter
source: We often share research with the\nRUINS OF ALPH researchers.\pWe even share fossils with them\nthrough the PC!$
translation:
我们经常和阿露福遗迹的研究员们
共享研究成果。\p甚至还能通过电脑与他们共享化石呢！$

label: PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_Oldman
source: I should be grateful for my long\nlife.\pNever did I think I would get to\nsee the bones of a dragon!$
translation:
活得久真是一件值得感激的事啊。\p做梦也没想到，我这辈子竟然能
亲眼看到龙的骨骼！$

label: PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_Bones
source: Bones of an ancient dragon\nPOKéMON.$
translation: 古代龙宝可梦的骨骼。$

label: PewterCity_Museum_2F_Text_Nerd
source:
They say that meteorites struck
BIRTH ISLAND.\pWe would love to display them here
in our museum, but...\pThese meteorites are said to emit
strange energy and cannot be\lcarried away...$
translation:
据说曾有陨石坠落在诞生之岛。\p我们原本很想把它们陈列在博物馆里，
可是......\p据说那些陨石散发着奇特的能量，
根本无法搬走......$

label: PewterCity_Museum_2F_Text_AskedDaddyToCatchPikachu
source: I want a PIKACHU!\nIt's so cute!\pI asked my daddy to catch me one!$
translation:
我想要一只皮卡丘！
它太可爱啦！\p我已经让爸爸帮我抓一只了！$

label: PewterCity_Museum_2F_Text_PikachuSoonIPromise
source: Yeah, a PIKACHU soon, I promise!$
translation: 好好好，很快就给你抓皮卡丘，我保证！$

label: PewterCity_Museum_2F_Text_SpaceShuttle
source: Space Shuttle$
translation: 航天飞机$

label: PewterCity_Museum_2F_Text_MeteoriteThatFellOnMtMoon
source: A meteorite that fell on MT. MOON.\nIt is thought to be a MOON STONE.$
translation: 落在月见山上的陨石。\n被认为是一块月之石。$

label: PewterCity_PokemonCenter1F_Text_Teacher
source: …Yeah, and the GYM in CINNABAR's gone.\pI was really amazed.\p…Yes? I'm on the phone. Go away!$
translation: ...对啊，而且红莲岛的道馆也没了。\p我当时真是惊呆了。\p...嗯？我正在打电话呢。走开啦！$

label: PewterCity_PokemonCenter1F_Text_Jigglypuff
source: JIGGLYPUFF: Puu pupuu.$
translation: 胖丁：波~波哩哩。$

label: PewterCity_PokemonCenter_Text_WantToTrade
source: I've been traveling all over, looking\nfor a good {STR_VAR_1}.\pWould you trade one for my\n{STR_VAR_2}?$
translation: 我四处旅行，一直在寻找\n优秀的{STR_VAR_1}。\p你愿意用它来交换\n我的{STR_VAR_2}吗？$

label: PewterCity_PokemonCenter_Text_TakeCare
source: Thanks a bunch!\nTake good care of my {STR_VAR_1}!$
translation: 太感谢啦！\n要好好照顾我的{STR_VAR_1}哦！$

label: PewterCity_PokemonCenter_Text_DeclineTrade
source: No? That's too bad…\nI think you'd like my HAUNTER.$
translation: 不行吗？真遗憾......\n我觉得你应该会喜欢我的鬼斯通呢。$

label: PewterCity_PokemonCenter_Text_NotRequestedMon
source: Hmm, that's not a {STR_VAR_1}.\nThat's not what I'm looking for.$
translation: 唔，这不是{STR_VAR_1}啊。\n不是我要找的那种。$

label: PewterCity_PokemonCenter_Text_TradeCompleted
source: How's that HAUNTER treating you?\nIt's a real trickster!$
translation: 那只鬼斯通跟你相处得怎么样？\n它可是个不折不扣的淘气鬼呢！$

label: PewterCity_PokemonCenter1F_Text_BugCatcher
source: Most POKéMON get drowsy if they hear a\nJIGGLYPUFF singing.\pThere are several moves that can be\nused only while a POKéMON is asleep.$
translation: 大部分宝可梦听了胖丁的歌声\n都会犯困。\p有些招式只有在宝可梦\n睡着时才能使用哦。$

label: PokemonLeague_BrunosRoom_Text_RematchBefore
source:
BRUNO: Welcome back, young
warrior.\pThrough rigorous training, we have
grown stronger.\pMy rock-hard will is even more firm
and unyielding.\pAre you prepared to face an even
greater challenge?\pShow me the results of your
training.\pHoo hah!$
translation:
希巴：欢迎回来，
年轻的战士。\p经过严苛的修行，
我们变得更加强大了。\p我那坚如磐石的意志，
如今更加不可动摇。\p你做好迎接更强大挑战的准备了吗？\p让我见识一下你的修行成果吧。\p喝啊--！$

label: PokemonLeague_BrunosRoom_Text_Before
source:
I am BRUNO of the ELITE FOUR.\pI always train to the extreme be-
cause I believe in our potential.\pThat is how we became strong.\pCan you withstand our power?\pHm? I see no fear in you. You look
determined. Perfect for battle!\pReady, {PLAYER}? You will bow down
to our overwhelming power!\pHoo hah!$
translation: 我是四天王希巴！\p我总是将修行贯彻至极限，\n因为我相信我和宝可梦的无限潜能。\p这就是我们变强的秘诀！\p你能承受得住我们的威力吗？\p嗯？我在你的眼中看不到恐惧。你的目光充满决心，太适合战斗了！\p准备好了吗，{PLAYER}？\n屈服于我们压倒性的力量吧！\p喝啊--！$

label: PokemonLeague_BrunosRoom_Text_Beaten
source: Why? How could we lose?$
translation: 为什么？我们怎么会输？！$

label: PokemonLeague_BrunosRoom_Text_Defeat
source: Having lost, I have no right to\nsay anything…\pGo face your next challenge!$
translation: 既然输了，我就没有资格再说什么......\p去迎接你接下来的挑战吧！$

label: PokemonLeague_ChampionsRoom_Text_Victory
source:
はーはッ！
かった！　かった！　かった！\p{PLAYER}に　まける　ような
おれさま　では　なーい！\pま！　ポケモンの
てんさい　{RIVAL}さま　あいてに\lここまで　よく　がんばった！\pほめて　つかわす！
はーッ！　はーはッはッ！$
translation:
哈-哈！
赢了！赢了！本大爷赢了！\p本大爷怎么可能会
输给{PLAYER}呢！\p嘛！作为宝可梦天才
{RIVAL}大人的对手，\l你能撑到现在已经很努力了！\p就好好夸奖你一下吧！
哈-！哈哈-哈！$

label: PokemonLeague_ChampionsRoom_Text_BattleIntro
source:
LANCE: I've been waiting for you.\p{PLAYER}!\pI knew that you, with your skills,
would eventually reach me here.\pThere's no need for words now.\pWe will battle to determine who is
the stronger of the two of us.\pAs the most powerful trainer and as
the POKéMON LEAGUE CHAMPION…\pI, LANCE the dragon master, accept
your challenge!$
translation:
阿渡：我一直在等你。\p{PLAYER}！\p以你的实力，我就知道
你终究会来到我面前。\p现在无需多言。\p就用对战来分出我们谁更强吧。\p作为最强大的训练家，
作为宝可梦联盟冠军......\p我，驯龙使者阿渡，
接受你的挑战！$

label: PokemonLeague_ChampionsRoom_Text_BattleWin
source: …It's over.\pBut it's an odd feeling.\pI'm not angry that I lost. In fact,\nI feel happy.\pHappy that I witnessed the rise\nof a great new CHAMPION!$
translation: ......结束了。\p但我有一种奇妙的感觉。\p输掉对战，我并不感到懊恼。相反，\n我甚至感到欣慰。\p因为我亲眼见证了一位\n伟大的新冠军的诞生！$

label: PokemonLeague_ChampionsRoom_Text_BattleAfter
source:
…Whew.\pYou have become truly powerful,
{PLAYER}.\pYour POKéMON have responded to your
strong and upstanding nature.\pAs a trainer, you will continue to
grow strong with your POKéMON.$
translation:
......呼。\p你真的变得非常强大了，
{PLAYER}。\p你的宝可梦们回应了
你坚强而正直的心灵。\p作为一名训练家，今后你也会
与宝可梦一同变得更强吧。$

label: PokemonLeague_ChampionsRoom_Text_MaryOhNoOak
source: MARY: Oh, no! It's all over!\pPROF.OAK, if you weren't so slow…$
translation: 胡桃：哎呀，怎么这样！全都结束了啦！\p大木博士，都怪您动作太慢了......$

label: PokemonLeague_ChampionsRoom_Text_OakCongratulations
source:
PROF.OAK: Ah, {PLAYER}!\pIt's been a long while.\pYou certainly look more impressive.\pYour conquest of the JOHTO LEAGUE
is just fantastic!\pYour dedication, trust and love for
your POKéMON made this happen.\pYour POKéMON were outstanding too.\pBecause they believed in you as a
trainer, they persevered.\pCongratulations, {PLAYER}!$
translation:
大木博士：哎呀，{PLAYER}！\p真是好久不见了。\p你看起来确实威风多了啊。\p制霸城都联盟，
真是太精彩了！\p正是你对宝可梦的付出、信任与爱，
造就了这一刻。\p你的宝可梦们表现也极为出色。\p正因为它们深信着你这位训练家，
才能够坚持到底。\p恭喜你，{PLAYER}！$

label: PokemonLeague_ChampionsRoom_Text_RematchOakCongratulations
source:
PROF.OAK: Ah, {PLAYER}!\pI've been following your progress
since PROF.ELM sent you on your\lway.\pYou've certainly become more
impressive.\pConquering both the JOHTO and now
the KANTO LEAGUE is no small feat.\pYou've truly outdone yourself!\pIt's clear that your POKéMON trust
you immensely,\pand that trust has been the
foundation of your success.\pBut remember, a trainer's journey
is never truly over.\pCongratulations on your victory,
{PLAYER}!$
translation:
大木博士：哎呀，{PLAYER}！\p自空木博士送你踏上旅程以来，
我便一直在关注着你的成长。\p你确实变得令人刮目相看了啊。\p先后制霸了城都联盟，
如今又制霸了关都联盟，真是不简单。\p你真正超越了自我！\p显而易见，你的宝可梦们
极度信任着你，\p正是这份信任成就了你今天的胜利。\p不过要记住，训练家的旅程
是永远没有终点的。\p恭喜你赢得胜利，
{PLAYER}！$

label: PokemonLeague_ChampionsRoom_Text_MaryInterview
source: MARY: Let's interview the brand new\nJOHTO CHAMPION!$
translation: 胡桃：让我们来采访一下新出炉的\n城都冠军吧！$

label: PokemonLeague_ChampionsRoom_Text_RematchMaryInterview
source: MARY: Let's interview the brand new\nKANTO CHAMPION!$
translation: 胡桃：让我们来采访一下新出炉的\n关都冠军吧！$

label: PokemonLeague_ChampionsRoom_Text_Noisy
source: LANCE: This is getting to be a bit\ntoo noisy…\p{PLAYER}, could you come with me?$
translation: 阿渡：这里开始变得有点吵闹了......\p{PLAYER}，能跟我来一下吗？$

label: PokemonLeague_ChampionsRoom_Text_MaryNoInterview
source: MARY: Oh, wait! We haven't done\nthe interview!$
translation: 玛莉：哎，等等！我们还没做\n采访呢！$

label: PokemonLeague_ChampionsRoom_Text_RematchMaryNoInterview
source: MARY: Come on! You can't blow off\nthe interview AGAIN!$
translation: 玛莉：真是的！你可不能"又"把\n采访晾在一边啊！$

label: PokemonLeague_HallOfFame_LanceText
source:
LANCE: It's been a long time since I
last came here.\pThis is where we honor the LEAGUE
CHAMPIONS for all eternity.\pTheir courageous POKéMON are also
inducted.\pHere today, we witnessed the rise
of a new LEAGUE CHAMPION--a\ptrainer who feels compassion for,
and trust toward, all POKéMON.\pA trainer who succeeded through
perseverance and determination.\pThe new LEAGUE CHAMPION who has
all the makings of greatness!\p{PLAYER}, allow me to register you
and your partners as CHAMPIONS!$
translation:
阿渡：好久没有来到这里了。\p这里是让联盟冠军的荣耀
永世流传的神圣殿堂。\p与冠军并肩作战的勇敢宝可梦们，
也会一同名列于此。\p今天，在这里，我们见证了
新联盟冠军的诞生--\p一位关爱并信任所有宝可梦的训练家，\p一位凭借毅力与决心走向成功的训练家，\p一位具备伟大资质的新联盟冠军！\p{PLAYER}，请允许我将你与你的伙伴们
作为冠军铭刻于此！$

label: PokemonLeague_KarensRoom_Text_RematchBefore
source:
KAREN: Ah, it's you again.\pI trust you haven't forgotten
my belief:\pTrue strength arises from trust
in one's POKéMON.\pSince our last encounter, my
bond with my POKéMON has\ldeepened further.\pAre you ready to face a team
united by an unbreakable bond?\pShow me the power of the bond
with your POKéMON.$
translation:
梨花：啊，又是你啊。\p我相信你还没有忘记我的信念吧：\p真正的强大，源自对宝可梦的信赖。\p自我们上次相遇以来，
我和我的宝可梦之间的羁绊变得更加深厚了。\p你准备好面对这支由坚不可摧的
羁绊所维系的队伍了吗？\p让我见识一下你与宝可梦之间
羁绊的力量吧。$

label: PokemonLeague_KarensRoom_Text_Before
source: I am KAREN of the ELITE FOUR.\pYou're {PLAYER}? How amusing.\pI love DARK-type POKéMON.\pI find their wild, tough image\nto be so appealing. And they're\lso strong.\pThink you can take them?\nJust try to entertain me.\pLet's go.$
translation: 我是四天王之一的梨花。\p你就是{PLAYER}？真有趣。\p我最喜欢恶属性的宝可梦了。\p它们那狂野又强悍的形象\n深深吸引着我。而且还那么强大。\p你觉得自己能对付它们吗？\n可要好好取悦我一下哦。\p来吧。$

label: PokemonLeague_KarensRoom_Text_Beaten
source: Well, aren't you good. I like that\nin a trainer.$
translation: 哎呀，挺厉害的嘛。\n我很欣赏你这样的训练家。$

label: PokemonLeague_KarensRoom_Text_Defeat
source:
Strong POKéMON.\pWeak POKéMON.\pThat is only the selfish
perception of people.\pTruly skilled trainers should
try to win with their favorites.\pI like your style. You understand
what's important.\pGo on--the CHAMPION is waiting.$
translation: 强力的宝可梦、\p弱小的宝可梦，\p那都只是人任性的想法。\p真正优秀的训练家，\n应该为了让自己喜欢的宝可梦获胜而努力。\p我很喜欢你的风格。你明白什么才是最重要的。\p走吧--冠军正在等着你呢。$

label: PokemonLeague_KogasRoom_Text_RematchBefore
source: KOGA: Fwahahahaha!\pYou return, brave challenger.\pMy ninja skills have sharpened.\pNew sinister traps await you.\pPoison, sleep, and more...\nBe ready!\pFwahahahaha!\pShow me how you've grown!$
translation: 阿桔：哈哈哈哈！\p勇敢的挑战者，你又回来了啊。\p吾之忍者秘术已磨砺得愈发凌厉。\p阴险的新陷阱正在等待着你。\p剧毒、睡眠，还有更多......\n准备接招吧！\p哈哈哈哈！\p让吾看看你成长了多少！$

label: PokemonLeague_KogasRoom_Text_Before
source:
Fwahahahaha!\pI am KOGA of the ELITE FOUR.\pI live in shadows, a ninja!\pMy intricate style will confound
and destroy you!\pConfusion, sleep, poison…\pPrepare to be the victim of my
sinister technique!\pFwahahahaha!\pPOKéMON is not merely about brute
force--you shall see soon enough!$
translation: 哈哈哈哈！\p吾乃四天王之一的阿桔！\p潜伏于暗影之中的忍者！\p吾那精妙复杂的战术会将你玩弄并毁灭！\p混乱、睡眠、剧毒......\p准备成为吾阴险秘术的牺牲品吧！\p哈哈哈哈！\p宝可梦对战可不仅仅是蛮力比拼--\n你马上就会领教到的！$

label: PokemonLeague_KogasRoom_Text_Beaten
source: Ah!\nYou have proven your worth!$
translation: 啊！\n你证明了自己的能耐！$

label: PokemonLeague_KogasRoom_Text_Defeat
source:
I subjected you to everything I
could muster.\pBut my efforts failed. I must hone
my skills.\pGo on to the next room, and put
your abilities to test!$
translation: 吾已竭尽所能倾囊相授。\p然而依然落败。吾必须继续磨砺身手。\p前往下一个房间吧，去考验你的实力！$

label: PokemonLeague_WillsRoom_Text_Before
source:
Welcome to POKéMON LEAGUE,
{PLAYER}.\pAllow me to introduce myself.
I am WILL.\pI have trained all around the
world, making my psychic\lPOKéMON powerful.\pAnd, at last, I've been accepted
into the ELITE FOUR.\pI can only keep getting better!\pLosing is not an option!$
translation:
欢迎来到宝可梦联盟，
{PLAYER}。\p容我自我介绍一下。
我是一树。\p我在世界各地修行，
培育出了强大的超能力属性宝可梦。\p终于，我获得了认可，跻身四天王之列。\p我只会不断变得更强！\p输掉是绝不可能的！$

label: PokemonLeague_WillsRoom_Text_Beaten
source: I… I can't… believe it…$

label: PokemonLeague_WillsRoom_Text_Defeat
source:
Even though I was defeated, I
won't change my course.\pI will continue battling until I
stand above all trainers!\pNow, {PLAYER}, move on and
experience the true ferocity of\lthe ELITE FOUR.$
translation: 即使被击败了，我也不会改变前进的方向。\p我会继续战斗，直到立于所有训练家之巅！\p去吧，{PLAYER}，继续前进，\n去见识四天王真正的可怕之处吧。$

label: PokemonLeague_WillsRoom_Text_RematchBefore
source:
WILL: Ah, welcome back.\pI have foreseen this encounter.\pMy psychic POKéMON and
I have evolved, developing\lnew tactics.\pPrepare yourself for a battle of
enhanced strategy and might.\pLet us see if your foresight
matches mine.$
translation: 一树：啊，欢迎回来。\p我早已预见到了这次重逢。\p我和我的超能力宝可梦都已脱胎换骨，\n研发出了全新的战术。\p准备迎接一场策略与力量皆大幅升级的决战吧。\p让我看看你的预见力是否能与我匹敌。$

label: Alola_Poni_BattleExeggutor_Text_0
source: Gaah-aah!$

label: Alola_Poni_Island_Sign_Text_0
source: PONI ISLE$
translation: 波尼岛$

label: Alola_Poni_TotemBattle_Text_0
source: Buzz!!$

label: Alola_Poni_TotemBattle_Text_1
source: Totem ELECTIVIRE was defeated!\nIt scampered off somewhere…$
translation: 霸主电击魔兽倒下了！\n它不知道逃窜到哪里去了......$

label: Alola_Poni_Totem_sign_Text_0
source: The totem is emanating a strong\nenergy…\pTouch the totem to teleport to another\nIsle?$
translation: 图腾正散发出一股强烈的能量......\p要触碰图腾传送至其他岛屿吗？$

label: Alola_Poni_Totem_sign_Text_1
source: MELEMELE ISLE$
translation: 美乐美乐岛$

label: Alola_Poni_Totem_sign_Text_2
source: AKALA ISLE$
translation: 阿卡拉岛$

label: Alola_Poni_Totem_sign_Text_3
source: ULA'ULA ISLE$
translation: 乌拉乌拉岛$

label: Alola_Poni_Totem_sign_Text_4
source: 取消$
translation: 取消$

label: Alola_Poni_Totem_sign_Text_5
source: A strange totem stands here,\npower is emanating from it…$
translation: 这里伫立着一个奇异的图腾，\n正散发出一股能量......$

label: Alola_Poni_BattleVsTapuFini_Text_0
source: Fiiin!$

label: Alola_Poni_TrainerBattleSwimmer1_Text_0
source: Warmer water, no problem!$
translation: 水温变暖了，完全没问题！$

label: Alola_Poni_TrainerBattleSwimmer1_Text_1
source: Gah, I forgot my sunscreen…$
translation: 哎呀，我忘了涂防晒霜......$

label: Alola_Poni_TrainerBattleSwimmer1_Text_2
source: I've swam into so many cool POKéMON!\nIt must be something in the water.$
translation: 我游泳时遇到了好多超棒的宝可梦！\n这水质一定有什么特别之处。$

label: Alola_Poni_TrainerBattleSwimmer2_Text_0
source: Hey, don't block my current!$
translation: 喂，别挡着我的水流路线！$

label: Alola_Poni_TrainerBattleSwimmer2_Text_1
source: Ugh, fine,\njust let me swim…$
translation: 呃，好吧，\n就让我好好游泳吧......$

label: Alola_Poni_TrainerBattleSwimmer2_Text_2
source: The current is great for tubing.\nI don't think I'll tube anywhere else!$
translation: 这里的激流太适合玩轮胎漂流了。\n我觉得我再也不想去别处漂了！$

label: Alola_Poni_NPC_girl_Text_0
source: PONI ISLE is my favorite.\nThe wilderness just speaks for itself!$
translation: 波尼岛是我的最爱。\n大自然原生态的魅力无可比拟！$

label: Alola_Poni_Bench_Heal_Text_0
source: Would you like to take a rest on this\nbench?$
translation: 你想在这张长椅上\n休息一下吗？$

label: Alola_Poni_BattleGolem_Text_0
source: Gaaah!$
translation: 哇啊啊！$

label: ReceptionGate_Text_Janine
source:
JANINE: I'm on the way to my dad's
house to give him his lunch.\pThe ELITE FOUR has no time to rest
day or night. It's such hard work,\lyou know?\pIf you're ready for another battle,
I'll be at the DOJO later.$
translation:
阿杏：我正要去我老爸那里
给他送午餐呢。\p四天王不分昼夜地忙碌，
根本没有休息时间，真的很辛苦呢。\p如果你想再和我对战一场，
我待会儿会去道场。$

label: VictoryRoadGate_Text_Officer
source: Only trainers who have proven\nthemselves may pass.$
translation: 只有证明过自己实力的训练家\n方可通过。$

label: VictoryRoadGate_Text_Kimono
source: Sorry kid, this way is closed until\nsomeone deals with that LEGENDARY\lPOKéMON...$
translation: 抱歉啊小朋友，在有人解决掉\n那只传说中的宝可梦之前，\l这里暂时封路了......$

label: VictoryRoadGate_Text_NotEnoughBadges
source: You don't have all the GYM BADGES\nof JOHTO.\pI'm sorry, but I can't let you go\nthrough.$
translation: 你还没有集齐城都地区的\n全部道馆徽章。\p很抱歉，我不能让你通过。$

label: VictoryRoadGate_Text_EightBadges
source: Oh! The eight BADGES of JOHTO!\pPlease, go right on through!$
translation: 哦！城都地区的8枚徽章！\p请进，直接过去吧！$

label: VictoryRoadGate_Text_LeftBlackBelt
source: This way leads to MT.SILVER.\pYou'll see scary-strong POKéMON out\nthere.$
translation: 这条路通往白银山。\p那里的宝可梦可是强得吓人哦。$

label: VictoryRoadGate_Text_RightBlackBelt
source: Off to the POKéMON LEAGUE, are you?\pThe ELITE FOUR are so strong it's\nscary, and they're ready for you!$
translation: 准备前往宝可梦联盟，对吗？\p四天王的实力可是强得吓人，\n他们已经严阵以待了！$

label: RocketHideout_B1F_Text_CameraGrunt1Seen
source: Hey!\nIntruder alert!$
translation: 喂！\n有入侵者！$

label: RocketHideout_B1F_Text_CameraGrunt1Beaten
source: Dang… I failed…$

label: RocketHideout_B1F_Text_CameraGrunt2Seen
source: It's my turn! There's no escape!$
translation: 轮到我了！休想逃跑！$

label: RocketHideout_B1F_Text_CameraGrunt2Beaten
source: Surveillance cams are in the\nPOKéMON statues.\pWe'll keep appearing until you\ntrip a secret switch.$
translation: 宝可梦雕像里装有监控摄像头。\p只要你没踩下隐秘开关，\n我们就会源源不断地冒出来。$

label: RocketHideout_B1F_Text_ScientistJedSeen
source: This was once a ninja hideout.\pThere are traps to confound\nintruders like you.$
translation: 这里曾经是忍者的隐秘据点。\p里面布满了机关陷阱，\n专门用来迷惑你这种入侵者。$

label: RocketHideout_B1F_Text_ScientistJedBeaten
source: I get it…$

label: RocketHideout_B1F_Text_ScientistJedAfter
source:
All right. I'll divulge a secret
about our hideout.\pThat thing on the floor up ahead
is a warp panel.\pIf you step on it, you'll be
warped back to the entrance.$
translation:
好吧，我就透露一个
关于我们据点的秘密给你。\p前方地板上的那个东西
其实是传送地砖。\p只要踩上去，
就会被立刻传回入口处。$

label: RocketHideout_B1F_Text_GruntM16Seen
source: Heheh. Feeling lucky, punk?$
translation: 嘿嘿。小鬼，觉得自己运气够好吗？$

label: RocketHideout_B1F_Text_GruntM16Beaten
source: Kaboom!$
translation: 轰隆！$

label: RocketHideout_B1F_Text_GruntM16After
source: I don't even know where the traps\nare planted.\pYou'll just have to collect your\ncourage and walk.$
translation: 连我都不知道机关具体设在哪里。\p你只能鼓足勇气硬着头皮往前走了。$

label: RocketHideout_B1F_Text_SecurityCameraStatue
source: It's a PERSIAN statue…$
translation: 这是一座猫老大雕像......$

label: RocketHideout_B1F_Text_NothingThere
source: A strange panel... Nothing here.$
translation: 一块奇怪的地砖......\n什么也没有。$

label: RocketHideout_B1F_Text_SecretSwitch
source: A secret switch! Better press it.$
translation: 发现了一个隐秘开关！按下去看看吧。$

label: RocketHideout_B1F_Text_SwitchOff
source: The switch is turned off.$
translation: 开关已经关掉了。$

label: RocketHideout_B2F_Text_MurkrowUnlock
source: MURKROW screamed the password,\nmimicking the voice of PETREL.\p..................\nThe voice-recognition system\lunlocked the door!$
translation: 黑暗鸦模仿拉姆达的声音\n喊出了密码。\p..................\n声纹识别系统解锁了大门！$

label: RocketHideout_B2F_Text_ArianaHoldIt
source: ARIANA: Hold it right there!$
translation: 雅典娜：给我站住！$

label: RocketHideout_B2F_Text_ArianaChallenge
source:
ARIANA: We can't let a brat like you
do as you please forever.\pIt'll hurt Team Rocket's pride over
and over again. Making it lessen,\lyou see.\p...So, it's time to finish you.
However strong you may be,\pif the two of us fight at the same
time, you'll have no chance of\lwinning. Don't you agree?\pHee hee hee! Sorry, baby.
Now, get ready to be thrashed.$
translation:
雅典娜：我们可不能任由你这种小鬼
一直胡作非为下去。\p这样下去，火箭队的威信
迟早会被一点点消磨殆尽的，\l你明白吗？\p......所以，是时候做个了结了。
不管你有多强，\p要是我们两个一起上的话，
你可就没有半分胜算了哦。对吧？\pHee hee hee！抱歉啦，小宝贝。
乖乖准备挨揍吧。$

label: RocketHideout_B2F_Text_LanceInterrupt
source: LANCE: Hold it!\nA two-on-one battle?\pThat is so unfair!\nTypical of Team Rocket to be so\lsneaky.\pAllow me to join the battle!$
translation:
渡：住手！
二对一的战斗？\p这也太卑鄙了！
果然是火箭队一贯的阴险作风。\p我也来加入这场战斗！$

label: RocketHideout_B2F_Text_ArianaOutraged
source: ARIANA: What? You had an accomplice?\nWhere is your sense of dignity?\pAs interim boss in place of GIOVANNI,\nI'll show you how wrong it is to meddle\lwith Team Rocket!$
translation:
雅典娜：什么？居然还有同伙？
你的自尊心都丢到哪里去了？\p作为代行坂木老大职务的代理首领，
我要让你们明白，招惹火箭队\l会付出怎样沉重的代价！$

label: RocketHideout_B2F_Text_LanceChooseMons
source: LANCE: Quickly {PLAYER}, choose\nyour POKéMON!$
translation:
渡：快，{PLAYER}，
选出你的宝可梦！$

label: RocketHideout_B2F_Text_ArianaLoss
source: Tch, you really are strong.\nIt's too bad.\pIf you were to join Team Rocket,\nyou could become an Executive.$
translation:
切，你果然很强啊。
真遗憾。\p要是你能加入火箭队的话，
绝对能当上干部的。$

label: RocketHideout_Text_ArianaRetreat
source:
ARIANA: But that's fine.
The broadcast experiment was a\ltotal success.\pIt doesn't matter what happens to
this hideout now.\pWe have much bigger plans.
You'll come to appreciate Team\lRocket's true power soon enough.\pEnjoy yourself while you can...
Hee hee hee...$
translation:
雅典娜：不过无所谓了。
电波实验已经大获成功。\p这个基地会变成怎样，
我们已经不在乎了。\p我们有更加宏大的计划。
火箭队真正的可怕之处，\l你们很快就会切身体会到了。\p趁现在好好得意一阵吧......
嘻嘻嘻......$

label: RocketHideout_Text_LanceStepBack
source: Sorry, {PLAYER}. I saw how well you\nwere doing, so I just hung back.\pNow all there is left to do is to turn\noff that odd radio signal.$
translation:
抱歉啊，{PLAYER}。我看你应对自如，
不知不觉就退到一旁观战了。\p现在剩下的事，就是切断
这股诡异的电波了。$

label: RocketHideout_B2F_Text_LanceElectrodeFaint
source:
It's this machine that's causing
all the problems.\pI don't see a switch on it…\pWe have no choice. We have to
make all the ELECTRODE faint.\pThat should stop this machine
from transmitting that strange\lsignal.\pIt's no fault of the POKéMON, so
it makes me feel guilty.\p{PLAYER}, let's split the job.$
translation:
引发一切问题的就是这台机器。\p上面好像没有电源开关......\p没办法了，看来我们只能
把所有的顽皮雷弹都打倒才行。\p这样应该就能阻止这台机器
继续发射诡异的电波了。\p虽说宝可梦本身并没有错，
这么做实在让人过意不去......\p{PLAYER}，我们分头行动吧。$

label: RocketHideout_B2F_Text_LanceSide
source: LANCE: Leave this side to me.$
translation: 渡：这边就交给我吧。$

label: RocketHideout_B2F_Text_LanceElectrodeDone
source:
LANCE: That odd signal has
finally stopped.\pThe LAKE should be back to
normal.\pYou're the hero! Let me thank
you on behalf of all the\lPOKéMON.\pOh, yes. You should take this.
I found it here, but I don't\lhave any need for it.$
translation:
渡：那股诡异的电波
终于彻底停止了。\p愤怒之湖应该也能恢复原样了。\p你可是大功臣！请允许我
代表所有的宝可梦向你道谢。\p对了，这个你收下吧。
是我在这附近捡到的，\l我留着也没什么用。$

label: RocketHideout_B2F_Text_LanceWhirlpool
source: That's WHIRLPOOL. Teach it to a\nPOKéMON to get across wild water.\pBut keep this in mind.\pYou can use that out of battle\nonly with the BADGE from\lMAHOGANY GYM.$
translation:
那是"潮旋"。让宝可梦学会的话，
就能穿过汹涌的漩涡了。\p不过请记住这一点。\p只有拥有卡吉道馆的徽章，
才能在对战之外使用它。$

label: RocketHideout_B2F_Text_LanceMonMaster
source:
{PLAYER}…\pThe journey to becoming the
POKéMON MASTER is long and\ldifficult.\pKnowing that, will you keep
going?\p…\pI see. No, you're right.\pIf you would give up that easily,
you would have never chased that\ldream in the first place.\pI look forward to seeing you
again!$
translation:
{PLAYER}......\p成为宝可梦大师的道路
既漫长又充满艰险。\p即便如此，你也会继续前进吗？\p......\p这样啊。是啊，你说得对。\p如果会轻易放弃的话，
你当初根本就不会去追逐那个梦想。\p我很期待与你的再次相遇！$

label: RocketHideout_B2F_Text_B2FTransmitter
source: It's the radio transmitter that's\nsending the sinister signal.\pIt's working at full capacity.$
translation: 这是一台正在发射不祥电波的发射装置。\p它正在全负荷运转。$

label: RocketHideout_B2F_Text_B2FDeactivateTransmitter
source: The radio transmitter has finally\nstopped its evil broadcast.$
translation:
发射装置终于停止了
恶毒电波的传送。$

label: RocketHideout_B2F_Text_LanceHeals1
source: LANCE: Are you all right?\pYour POKéMON are hurt and tired.\pHere, give them some of my\nmedicine.$
translation: 渡：你没事吧？\p你的宝可梦都受了伤，很疲惫了。\p来，给它们用一下我的伤药吧。$

label: RocketHideout_B2F_Text_LanceHeals2
source: LANCE: {PLAYER}, let's give it\nour best for POKéMON.$
translation:
渡：{PLAYER}，为了宝可梦，
我们一起全力以赴吧。$

label: RocketHideout_B2F_Text_GruntM17Seen
source: The door won't open?\pWell, duh. It has to have a\npassword that only TEAM ROCKET\lknows.$
translation:
门打不开？\p废话！那扇门可是设有只有火箭队
才知道的密码啊。$

label: RocketHideout_B2F_Text_GruntM17Beaten
source: What? I lost?$
translation: 什么？我输了？！$

label: RocketHideout_B2F_Text_GruntM17After
source: Heh, I'm just a GRUNT.\pI don't know the password.\nToo bad for you.$
translation:
哼，我不过是个基层手下。\p我怎么可能知道密码。
算你倒霉喽。$

label: RocketHideout_B2F_Text_GruntM18Seen
source: Oh, a kid? I don't really like\nthis, but eliminate you I must.$
translation:
哦，是个小鬼？虽然我也不想这样，
但不得不把你彻底收拾掉了。$

label: RocketHideout_B2F_Text_GruntM18Beaten
source: I knew I'd lose…$
translation: 我就知道会输......$

label: RocketHideout_B2F_Text_GruntM18After
source: I got wiped out on the last\nmission by a kid too.\pWhen we were abducting POKéMON,\nthis kid with long red hair and\lmean-looking eyes just\lcreamed me…$
translation:
我上次出任务的时候，也是被一个小鬼
给狠狠痛扁了一顿。\p当时我们在强抢宝可梦，
一个留着红长发、眼神凶恶的小鬼\l直接把我给收拾了......$

label: RocketHideout_B2F_Text_GruntM19Seen
source: You rotten little pest!$
translation: 你这个可恶的讨厌鬼！$

label: RocketHideout_B2F_Text_GruntM19Beaten
source: Grrrr…$

label: RocketHideout_B2F_Text_GruntM19After
source: Heh, only the boss knows the\npassword for that door.\pWhere's the boss? Who knows?\nGo look for yourself.$
translation:
哼，只有头领才知道那扇门的密码。\p头领在哪？谁知道呢！
你自己去找吧。$

label: RocketHideout_B3F_Text_LanceGetPassword
source:
LANCE: It takes two passwords
to get into the boss' quarters.\pThose passwords are known only
to a few ROCKETS.\pThat ROCKET there very graciously
told me so.\p{PLAYER}, let's go get the
passwords.$
translation:
阿渡：想要进到老大的房间，
需要两个密码。\p只有极少数的火箭队成员
才知道这些密码。\p那边那个火箭队队员
非常"客气"地告诉了我。\p{PLAYER}，我们去找密码吧。$

label: RocketHideout_B3F_Text_B3FRocket
source: Urrggh… The guy in the cape is\nincredibly tough…$
translation: 呜呃......那个穿披风的家伙\n强得离谱......$

label: RocketHideout_B3F_Text_B3FLockedDoorNeedsPassword
source: The door's closed…\pIt needs two passwords to open.$
translation: 门紧闭着......\p需要两个密码才能打开。$

label: RocketHideout_B3F_Text_B3FLockedDoorOpenSesame
source: The door's closed…\p{PLAYER} entered the two passwords.\pThe door opened!$
translation: 门紧闭着......\p{PLAYER}输入了两个密码。\p门打开了！$

label: RocketHideout_B3F_Text_Rival
source:
…\pDidn't I tell you that I was
going to destroy TEAM ROCKET?\p…Tell me, who was the guy in the
cape who used dragon POKéMON?\pMy POKéMON were no match at all.\pIt's what he said that bothers
me…\pHe told me that I don't love and
trust my POKéMON enough.\pIt's not my fault my team is so
useless.\pI'm furious that I lost to a
bleeding heart like him.\pBut it makes me question myself.\pIs there something I'm doing
wrong?\pCould it be that love made his
team so powerful?$
translation:
......\p我不是告诉过你，
我要彻底摧毁火箭队吗？\p......告诉我，那个带着龙宝可梦、
披着披风的家伙到底是谁？\p我的宝可梦完全不是他的对手。\p可最让我介意的是他说的话......\p他说我对自己的宝可梦
缺乏足够的爱与信任。\p这帮没用的家伙自己不中用，
凭什么怪我？\p输给那种滥好人，
真让人火大。\p但我忍不住怀疑自己。\p难道真是我做错了什么吗？\p难道真的是所谓的"爱"，
让他的队伍变得如此强大吗？$

label: RocketHideout_B3F_Text_PetrelIntro
source:
Muhahaha, we've been waiting
for you. So, you are {PLAYER}...\pMe? You don't know who I am?
It is me, GIOVANNI.\pThe majestic GIOVANNI himself!
Wahahaha!$
translation:
桀桀桀，我们等你好久了。
原来你就是{PLAYER}......\p我？你不认得我是谁吗？
就是我啊，坂木！\p大名鼎鼎的坂木老大本尊！
哇哈哈哈哈！$

label: RocketHideout_B3F_Text_PetrelDisbelief
source: ...Huh?\nI don't sound anything like\lGIOVANNI?\pI don't even look like GIOVANNI?\nHow come? I've worked so hard\lto mimic him!$
translation: ......咦？\n声音一点都不像坂木老大？\p连长相都完全不像？\n怎么会？！我明明那么努力\l去模仿他了！$

label: RocketHideout_B3F_Text_PetrelReveal
source:
PETREL: I am a Team Rocket
Executive!\pYou must be trying to sneak into
the radio-transmitter room.\pWell, that's not going to happen.
That room is protected with a\lspecial password.\pThe password is “Hail GIOVANNI.”
Surprised to hear it from me?\pKnowing the password won't help
you though.\pThe door won't open unless I say
the password. It only reacts to\lmy voice.$
translation:
拉姆达：我可是火箭队的干部！\p你肯定是想偷偷溜进
广播发射机室吧。\p哼，别做梦了。
那个房间受特殊密码保护。\p密码就是"坂木老大万岁"。
没想到我会直接告诉你吧？\p不过就算知道了密码也无济于事。\p那扇门只有在我亲口念出密码时
才会打开。它只认我的声音！$

label: RocketHideout_B3F_Text_PetrelBeaten
source: I… I couldn't do a thing…\pGIOVANNI, please forgive me…$
translation: 我......我竟然毫无还手之力......\p坂木老大，请原谅我......$

label: RocketHideout_B3F_Text_PetrelAfterBattle
source:
PETREL: Since disbanding Team
Rocket three years ago, our\lGIOVANNI has been missing.\pBut we're certain he's been
waiting for the right time for\lour revival... Wahahaha!\pLosing to you won't change the
fact that you are unable to get\lin the radio-transmitter room!\pYou need my voice to unlock it!$
translation:
拉姆达：自从三年前解散火箭队之后，
我们的坂木老大就一直下落不明。\p但我们坚信，他一定是在等待
让我们东山再起的最佳时机......哇哈哈哈！\p虽然输给了你，但这改变不了
你根本进不去发射机室的事实！\p想开门就必须得有我的声音！$

label: RocketHideout_B3F_Text_MurkrowSpeak1
source: MURKROW: Hail GIOVANNI.$
translation: 黑暗鸦：坂木老大万岁。$

label: RocketHideout_B3F_Text_MurkrowMimic
source: MURKROW is mimicking\nthe voice of PETREL!\pYou may be able to...!?$
translation: 黑暗鸦正在模仿拉姆达的声音！\p这样说不定就能......！？$

label: RocketHideout_B3F_Text_Murkrow
source: MURKROW: The password is…\pHAIL GIOVANNI.$
translation: 黑暗鸦：密码是......\p坂木老大万岁。$

label: RocketHideout_B3F_Text_GruntF5Seen
source: Do I know the password?\pMaybe.\pBut no weakling's going to get\nit!$
translation: 问我知不知道密码？\p也许吧。\p但我可不会平白便宜了弱者！$

label: RocketHideout_B3F_Text_GruntF5Beaten
source: All right. Stop. I'll tell you.$
translation: 好啦好啦！快住手！我招就是了！$

label: RocketHideout_B3F_Text_GruntF5After
source: The password to the boss' room\nis SLOWPOKETAIL.\pBut it's useless unless you have\ntwo passwords.$
translation: 老大房间的密码是呆呆兽之尾。\p不过要是凑不齐两个密码，\n知道了也没用。$

label: RocketHideout_B3F_Text_GruntM28Beaten
source: Hyuck-hyuck-hyuck! You're good!$
translation: 哎嘿嘿嘿！真有两下子！$

label: RocketHideout_B3F_Text_GruntM28After
source: Hyuck-hyuck-hyuck!\pThe password to the boss' room…\pUh…, I think it is RATICATE TAIL.$
translation: 哎嘿嘿嘿！\p老大房间的密码嘛......\p呃......我想想，好像是拉达之尾。$

label: RocketHideout_B3F_Text_ScientistRossSeen
source: I used to work for SILPH, but now\nI run research for TEAM ROCKET.\pA meddlesome child like you needs\nto be punished.$
translation: 我以前在西尔佛公司工作，\n但现在负责为火箭队进行研究。\p像你这种爱管闲事的小鬼，\n就得好好教训一下。$

label: RocketHideout_B3F_Text_ScientistRossBeaten
source: A mere tactical error cost me…$
translation: 只是战术上的失误才让我输了......$

label: RocketHideout_B3F_Text_ScientistRossAfter
source:
A radio signal that drives
POKéMON mad…\pMy experiment is a complete
success.\pMy promotion is assured. This
loss means absolutely nothing.$
translation: 能让宝可梦陷入狂躁的电波......\p我的实验取得了彻底的成功。\p我的升职已成定局。\n输掉这一场根本就无关紧要。$

label: RocketHideout_B3F_Text_ScientistMitchSeen
source: I don't care that POKéMON are hurt\nby our experiment.$
translation: 宝可梦因为实验受伤，\n我可一点都不在乎。$

label: RocketHideout_B3F_Text_ScientistMitchBeaten
source: Thinking is my strong suit, not\nbattling.$
translation: 动脑筋才是我的强项，\n可不是对战。$

label: RocketHideout_B3F_Text_ScientistMitchAfter
source: If we turn up the power of our\nradio signal for broadcast\lnationwide…\pThe very thought excites me!$
translation: 要是把我们电波的功率调大，\n在全国范围内进行广播......\p光是想象一下就让人兴奋不已！$

label: Route104_Text_MayPostBattle
source:
MAY: I can tell you've gotten pretty
good with the way you handle POKéMON.\pBut instead of only making them
battle, you should be like MR. BRINEY.\pIt's important to become friends with
POKéMON, too.$
translation:
小遥：看得出来，你培育宝可梦的手法
已经相当熟练了呢。\p不过，可不能光让它们去战斗，
也要向哈奇老人多多学习呀。\p与宝可梦成为心灵相通的朋友
也是非常重要的哦！$

label: Route104_Text_RegisteredBrendan
source: {PLAYER} registered BRENDAN\nin the POKéNAV.$
translation: {PLAYER}将佑树\n登记到了宝可梦领航员。$

label: Route10_Text_Surge
source: Hey, kid!\pKeep your guard up out here,\nthis place is cracklin' with power!\pIf you want a rematch, report to\nthe FIGHTING DOJO!$
translation: 嘿，小鬼！\p在这儿可别放松警惕，\n这地方正噼里啪啦地充满着电劲呢！\p如果想和我再打一场，\n就去格斗道馆找我吧！$

label: Route10_Text_HikerJimSeen
source: Hahahah!$
translation: 哈哈哈哈！$

label: Route10_Text_HikerJimBeaten
source: Hahaha-hachoo!$
translation: 哈哈哈哈--阿嚏！$

label: Route10_Text_HikerJimAfter
source: Hay fever is making me sneeze!\nAhahah-CHOO!$
translation: 花粉症让我喷嚏打个不停！\n啊哈哈--阿嚏！$

label: Route10_Text_PokefanmRobertSeen
source: You like POKéMON, don't you?\pMe too!$
translation: 你很喜欢宝可梦，对吧？\p我也喜欢！$

label: Route10_Text_PokefanmRobertBeaten
source: I'd have to say that's my loss.$
translation: 不得不承认是我输了。$

label: Route10_Text_PokefanmRobertAfter
source: Look what you did to my POKéMON…\pI won't forget this…$
translation: 看你把我的宝可梦伤成什么样了......\p我可不会忘记这笔账的......$

label: Route10_Text_PowerPlant
source: POWER PLANT$
translation: 发电厂$

label: Route10_Text_Sign
source: ROUTE 10\pCERULEAN CITY - LAVENDER TOWN$
translation: 10号道路\p华蓝市 - 紫苑镇$

label: Route10_PowerPlantBackRoom_Text_ManagerWhoWouldRuinMyGenerator
source:
MANAGER: I, I, I'm ready to blast
someone!\pWho would dare ruin my
generator?\pI spent so much time on it!\pIf I catch him, he's going to
get a taste of my ZAP CANNON!$
translation: 所长：我、我、我现在气得快要爆炸了！\p到底是谁敢破坏我的发电机？！\p那可是我花了好多心血造出来的！\p要是让我逮到那家伙，\n一定要让他尝尝我电磁炮的厉害！$

label: Route10_PowerPlantBackRoom_Text_ManagerIWontForgiveCulprit
source: MANAGER: I won't forgive him!\pThe culprit can cry and\napologize,\pbut I'll still hammer him!\pGahahahah!$
translation: 所长：我绝不饶他！\p就算那个犯人哭着向我赔礼道歉，\p我也要狠狠痛扁他一顿！\p嘎哈哈哈哈！$

label: Route10_PowerPlantBackRoom_Text_ManagerThatsThePart
source: MANAGER: Ah! Yeah!\pThat's the missing PART from my\nbeloved generator! You found it?$
translation: 所长：啊！没错！\p这就是我心爱的发电机上\n缺少的零件！被你找到了吗？$

label: Route10_PowerPlantBackRoom_Text_ManagerTakeThisTM
source: Wahah! Thanks!\pHere! Take this TM as a reward!$
translation: 哇哈哈！太感谢了！\p来！收下这个招式学习器作为谢礼吧！$

label: Route10_PowerPlantBackRoom_Text_ManagerTM07IsZapCannon
source: MANAGER: That TM is THUNDER.\pIt's a powerful technique!\pIt's not what anyone would\nconsider accurate, but it packs a\lwallop!$
translation: 所长：那个招式学习器是"打雷"。\p威力相当惊人哦！\p虽说命中率稍微差了点，\n但砸下去的威力可是非同小可的！$

label: Route10_PowerPlantBackRoom_Text_ManagerMyBelovedGenerator
source: MANAGER: My beloved generator!\pKeep pumping the electricity out!$
translation: 所长：我心爱的发电机啊！\p继续源源不断地产出电力吧！$

label: Route10_PowerPlantBackRoom_Text_Engineer
source: This door is unsafe without power.$
translation: 在没有通电的情况下，这扇门很不安全。$

label: Route10_PowerPlantEntrance_Text_Officer1AThiefBrokeIn
source: A thief broke into the POWER\nPLANT…\pWhat is the world coming to?$
translation: 竟然有贼潜入了发电厂......\p这世道到底是怎么了？$

label: Route10_PowerPlantEntrance_Text_Officer1CeruleanShadyCharacter
source: I just got word from CERULEAN.\pIt appears that a shady\ncharacter has been loitering\laround.$
translation: 我刚收到来自华蓝市的消息。\p据说有个形迹可疑的家伙\n在那一带鬼鬼祟祟地游荡。$

label: Route10_PowerPlantEntrance_Text_Officer1CouldIAskForYourCooperation
source: Could I ask for your\ncooperation?$
translation: 能请你协助我们调查吗？$

label: Route10_PowerPlantEntrance_Text_Officer1HaveToBeefUpSecurity
source: We'll have to beef up our\nsecurity presence.$
translation: 看来我们必须加强安保力量了。$

label: Route10_PowerPlantEntrance_Text_Engineer1SomeoneStoleAPart
source: Someone made off with a part\nthat's essential for the\lgenerator.\pWithout it, the new generator's\nuseless!$
translation: 有人偷走了发电机所必需的重要零件。\p要是没有那个，\n新发电机就根本无法运转！$
