label: Route10_PowerPlantEntrance_Text_Engineer1GeneratorUpAndRunning
source: The generator's up and running.\nIt's making electricity to spare.$
translation: 发电机已经顺利运转起来了。\n现在电力充沛，甚至绰绰有余呢。$

label: Route10_PowerPlantEntrance_Text_Engineer2PowerPlantUpAndRunning
source: This POWER PLANT had been\nabandoned in the past.\pWe got it back up and running to\nprovide power to the MAGNET\lTRAIN.$
translation: 这座发电厂过去曾经被废弃过。\p为了给磁浮列车供电，\n我们才让它重新恢复运转。$

label: Route10_PowerPlantEntrance_Text_Engineer2GeneratorIsRunningAgain
source: The generator's running again!$
translation: 发电机又重新运转了！$

label: Route10_PowerPlantEntrance_Text_Officer2ManagerHasBeenSadAndFurious
source: The POWER PLANT's MANAGER is in\nthe back room with the generator.\pBut since someone wrecked the\ngenerator, he's been both sad and\lfurious…$
translation: 发电厂的厂长在后面的\n发电机机房里。\p不过自从有人破坏了发电机之后，\n他就又伤心又愤怒......$

label: Route10_PowerPlantEntrance_Text_Officer2ManagerHasBeenCheerful
source: Since the generator's been fixed,\nthe MANAGER has been cheerful.$
translation: 自从发电机修好之后，\n厂长的心情就变得特别好。$

label: Route10_PowerPlantEntrance_Text_Engineer4MagnetTrainConsumesElectricity
source: The MAGNET TRAIN consumes a lot\nof electricity.\pIt can't move if the new\ngenerator isn't operating.$
translation: 磁浮列车要消耗大量的电力。\p要是新发电机不运转的话，\n列车根本就动不了。$

label: Route10_PowerPlantEntrance_Text_WantToTrade
source:
I work here at the POWER PLANT.
My MAGNETON's been my partner\lfor years.\pBut I've always wanted a
{STR_VAR_1}.\pWould you trade one for my
{STR_VAR_2}?$
translation: 我在这家发电厂工作。\n我的三合一磁怪伴随我好多年了。\p但我一直很想要一只{STR_VAR_1}。\p你愿意用它来交换我的\n{STR_VAR_2}吗？$

label: Route10_PowerPlantEntrance_Text_TakeCare
source: Thanks! Take good care of\nMAGGIE for me!$
translation: 谢谢你！\n请替我好好照顾小磁！$

label: Route10_PowerPlantEntrance_Text_DeclineTrade
source: No? That's a shame.\nMy MAGNETON's a hard worker.$
translation: 不行吗？那可真遗憾。\n我的三合一磁怪工作可卖力了。$

label: Route10_PowerPlantEntrance_Text_NotRequestedMon
source: Hmm, that's not a {STR_VAR_1}.\nThat's not what I had in mind.$
translation: 唔，这不是{STR_VAR_1}呀。\n不是我想要的宝可梦呢。$

label: Route10_PowerPlantEntrance_Text_TradeCompleted
source: How's MAGGIE doing?\nShe loves magnetic fields!$
translation: 小磁过得还好吗？\n它可喜欢磁场了！$

label: Route10_PowerPlantEntrance_Text_Engineer4WeCanGetMagnetTrainRunning
source: All right! We can finally get the\nMAGNET TRAIN running again.$
translation: 太好了！磁浮列车终于\n可以重新运行了。$

label: Route112_Text_MtChimneyCableCarSign
source: MT. CHIMNEY CABLE CAR\n“A short walk {UP_ARROW} way!”$
translation: 烟囱山缆车\n"朝此处走一小段路 {UP_ARROW}"$

label: Route11_EastEntrance_1F_Text_BagIsFull
source: {PLAYER}{KUN}の　バッグ\nいっぱい　みたい　だね$
translation: {PLAYER}{KUN}的背包\n好像已经装满了呢。$

label: Route11_Text_Engineer
source: I saw a strange POKéMON climbing\nin the trees, but it didn't\llook like MANKEY...$
translation: 我看见树上有只奇怪的宝可梦爬来爬去，\n不过看起来不像猴怪......$

label: Route11_Text_YoungsterOwenSeen
source: There's no cheating in POKéMON.\pLet's keep it fair and square!$
translation: 宝可梦对战中可不能耍小聪明。\p让我们堂堂正正地比一场吧！$

label: Route11_Text_YoungsterOwenBeaten
source: Huh? How did this happen?$
translation: 咦？怎么会这样？！$

label: Route11_Text_YoungsterOwenAfterBattle
source: I fought fair and square with\nhonor.\pI don't regret this at all.$
translation: 我光明磊落、问心无愧地战斗了。\p我一点都不后悔。$

label: Route11_Text_YoungsterJasonSeen
source: It itches and tickles a bit when\nI wear shorts in the grass.$
translation: 穿着短裤走在草丛里，\n腿上总是痒痒的。$

label: Route11_Text_YoungsterJasonBeaten
source: Aiyaaah! I got stomped!$
translation: 哎呀--！我被打得落花流水！$

label: Route11_Text_YoungsterJasonAfterBattle
source: I'm going to catch more POKéMON in\nthe grass.$
translation: 我要去草丛里捉更多宝可梦！$

label: Route11_Text_PsychicHermanAfterBattle
source: …\pI lost while I had my eyes closed…$
translation: ......\p我闭着眼睛的时候居然输了......$

label: Route11_Text_PsychicFidelSeen
source: I can see it…\pEverything to see about you…$
translation: 我看见了......\p关于你的一切，我都看透了......$

label: Route11_Text_PsychicFidelBeaten
source: I couldn't foresee your power…$
translation: 我竟然无法预见你的力量......$

label: Route11_Text_PsychicFidelAfterBattle
source: Strength in conviction…\pYou're strong because you believe\nin your POKéMON.$
translation: 信念的力量......\p你之所以强大，是因为你全心信任着自己的宝可梦。$

label: Route11_Text_Sign
source: ROUTE 11$
translation: 11号道路$

label: Route12_Text_Magikarp
source: MAGIKARP: Kaaaarp.$
translation: 鲤鱼王：咔噜--。$

label: Route12_Text_NewFisher
source: Careful, something vicious lives in\nthese waters.$
translation:
小心点，这片水域里
可是生活着很凶暴的家伙。$

label: Route12_Text_FisherMartinSeen
source: Patience is the key to both\nfishing and POKéMON.$
translation:
无论是钓鱼还是培育宝可梦，
耐心都是最关键的秘诀。$

label: Route12_Text_FisherMartinBeaten
source: Gwaaah!$

label: Route12_Text_FisherMartinAfterBattle
source: I'm too impatient for fishing…$
translation: 我太性急了，果然不适合钓鱼......$

label: Route12_Text_FisherStephenSeen
source: I feel so content, fishing while\nlistening to some tunes on my\lradio.$
translation:
一边用收音机听着音乐，
一边悠闲地钓鱼，
真是太惬意了。$

label: Route12_Text_FisherStephenBeaten
source: My stupid radio distracted me!$
translation: 都是这破收音机让我分心了！$

label: Route12_Text_FisherStephenAfterBattle
source: Have you checked out KANTO's radio\nprograms? We get a good variety\lhere.$
translation:
你收听过关都的广播节目吗？
这里的节目类型可丰富了。$

label: Route12_Text_FisherBarneySeen
source: What's most important in our\neveryday lives?$
translation:
在我们日常生活中，
最重要的东西是什么？$

label: Route12_Text_FisherBarneyBeaten
source: The answer is coming up next!$
translation: 答案马上揭晓！$

label: Route12_Text_FisherBarneyAfterBattle
source: I think electricity is the most\nimportant thing in our daily\llives.\pIf it weren't, people wouldn't\nhave made such a fuss when the\lPOWER PLANT went out of\lcommission.$
translation:
我觉得电力才是我们日常生活中
最重要的东西。\p如果不是这样，之前发电厂
发生故障停运的时候，大家也不会
闹得那么沸沸扬扬了。$

label: Route12_Text_KyleRegister
source: I'll remember this.\nGive me your number!$
translation:
我记住你了。
把你的电话号码告诉我吧！$

label: Route12_Text_KyleRematchIntro
source: Did you forget?\nLet's see!$
translation:
你忘了吗？
让我瞧瞧！$

label: Route12_Text_KyleRematchDefeat
source: You remembered.$
translation: 原来你还记得啊。$

label: Route12_Text_KylePostRematch
source: The thrill of battle is almost\nas good as a big catch!$
translation:
对战带来的刺激感，
完全不亚于钓到大鱼呢！$

label: Route12_Text_FisherKyleSeen
source: Do you remember?$
translation: 你还记得吗？$

label: Route12_Text_FisherKyleBeaten
source: You do remember?$
translation: 你真的记得吗？$

label: Route12_Text_FisherKyleAfterBattle
source: The tug you feel on the ROD when\nyou hook a POKéMON…\pThat's the best feeling ever for\nan angler like me.$
translation:
当宝可梦咬钩时，
鱼竿上传来的那股拉力......\p对我们钓客来说，
简直是世界上最棒的感觉了。$

label: Route12_Text_Sign
source: ROUTE 12\pNORTH TO LAVENDER TOWN$
translation: 12号道路\p北至紫苑镇$

label: Route12_Text_FishingSpotSign
source: FISHING SPOT$
translation: 垂钓圣地$

label: Route12_House_Text_OfferSuperRod
source: I'm the FISHING GURU's younger\nbrother.\pI can see that you like fishing.\pThere's no doubt in my mind at\nall!\pSo? I know I'm right.$
translation: 我是钓鱼名人的弟弟。\p我一眼就能看出来，你很喜欢钓鱼。\p我对此深信不疑！\p怎么样？我没说错吧。$

label: Route12_House_Text_GiveSuperRod
source: Yes, yes. Just as I thought!\pHere, fishing fan! Take this--\nit's a SUPER ROD.$
translation:
对嘛对嘛！果然不出我所料！\p来，钓鱼迷！收下这个--
这是厉害钓竿。$

label: Route12_House_Text_GaveSuperRod
source: Try your hand at fishing wherever\nthere is water.\pRemember--you can catch different\nPOKéMON using different RODS.$
translation:
只要是有水的地方，
就去挥竿试试看吧。\p记住了--使用不同的钓竿，
钓到的宝可梦也是不一样的哦。$

label: Route12_House_Text_DontWantSuperRod
source: Huh? My own eyes deceived me?$
translation: 咦？难道是我看走眼了？$

label: Route13_Text_PokefanmAlexSeen
source: Bow down before my regal POKéMON!$
translation: 拜倒在我高贵的宝可梦面前吧！$

label: Route13_Text_PokefanmAlexBeaten
source: How… How dare you mock royalty!$
translation: 怎......怎么敢对王室无礼！$

label: Route13_Text_PokefanmAlexAfterBattle
source: Doesn't everyone wish to someday\nbe a king?$
translation: 难道不是每个人都梦想着\n有朝一日成为国王吗？$

label: Route13_Text_AlexRegister
source: You're not royalty but you're good.\nLet me get your number.$
translation: 虽然你不是王室，但实力确实很强。\n能把电话号码告诉我吗？$

label: Route13_Text_AlexRematchIntro
source: I've added knights to my court!\nLet's battle!$
translation: 我的宫廷里又添了新的骑士！\n来对战吧！$

label: Route13_Text_AlexRematchDefeat
source: Dethroned again…$
translation: 又被拉下王座了......$

label: Route13_Text_AlexPostRematch
source: Maybe I'm just a pawn after all.$
translation: 或许我终究不过是一枚小卒罢了。$

label: Route13_Text_PokefanmJoshuaSeen
source: Nihihi! Would you like to battle\nmy PIKACHU gang?$
translation: 嘻嘻嘻！想挑战一下\n我的皮卡丘军团吗？$

label: Route13_Text_PokefanmJoshuaBeaten
source: PI-PIKACHU!$
translation: 皮--皮卡丘！$

label: Route13_Text_PokefanmJoshuaAfterBattle
source: You look like you have many\nPOKéMON, but PIKACHU\lis still the best.$
translation: 虽然你的宝可梦看起来很多，\n但还是皮卡丘最棒了！$

label: Route13_Text_BirdKeeperPerrySeen
source: Agility is the key attribute of\nbird POKéMON.$
translation: 速度可是鸟宝可梦的\n关键属性！$

label: Route13_Text_BirdKeeperPerryBeaten
source: You beat me with your speed…$
translation: 竟然在速度上输给了你......$

label: Route13_Text_BirdKeeperPerryAfterBattle
source: Your POKéMON are remarkably well-\ntrained.$
translation: 你的宝可梦训练得真出色。$

label: Route13_Text_BirdKeeperBretSeen
source: Check out my POKéMON. Just look\nat their coloring and their\lplumage.$
translation: 看看我的宝可梦吧。\n瞧瞧它们这鲜艳的色泽\n和美丽的羽毛！$

label: Route13_Text_BirdKeeperBretBeaten
source: Shoot! Not good enough!$
translation: 可恶！还差得远呢！$

label: Route13_Text_BirdKeeperBretAfterBattle
source: If you groom them, POKéMON get\nhappy.$
translation: 只要好好梳理毛发，\n宝可梦就会很开心哦。$

label: Route13_Text_HikerKennySeen
source: I should go to ROCK TUNNEL to get\nmyself an ONIX.$
translation: 我该去岩山隧道\n抓一只大岩蛇才对。$

label: Route13_Text_HikerKennyBeaten
source: I lost…$

label: Route13_Text_HikerKennyAfterBattle
source: Geological features don't appear\nto change.\pBut they actually change, little\nby little.$
translation: 地质地貌看起来毫无变化，\p但实际上，\n一直都在一点一点地改变呢。$

label: Route13_Text_KennyRegister
source: Maybe POKéMON change over time too.\nLet's battle again sometime!$
translation: 宝可梦或许也会随着岁月改变吧。\n改天再来对战吧！$

label: Route13_Text_KennyRematchIntro
source: I've learned from geology!\nLet's go!$
translation: 我从地质学中领悟到了新战术！\n上吧！$

label: Route13_Text_KennyRematchDefeat
source: Still not enough…$
translation: 还是差了点吗......$

label: Route13_Text_KennyPostRematch
source: The power of POKéMON is like\nerosion. We will persevere!$
translation: 宝可梦的力量就如同流水侵蚀一般。\n我们绝不会放弃！$

label: Route13_Text_TrainerTips
source: TRAINER TIPS\pLook! Right there, at the left\nside of the post.$
translation: 训练家指南\p快看！就在路牌的左边。$

label: Route13_Text_Sign
source: ROUTE 13\pNORTH TO SILENCE BRIDGE$
translation: 13号道路\p北：静止桥$

label: Route13_Text_DirectionsSign
source: NORTH TO LAVENDER TOWN\pWEST TO FUCHSIA CITY$
translation: 北：紫苑镇\p西：浅红市$

label: Route13_GetOffBoat_Text_0
source: Welcome back to mainland Kanto!\pCome back if you'd like to take a trip\nto the ALOLA ISLES!$
translation: 欢迎回到关都大陆！\p如果还想去阿罗拉群岛旅行，\n随时欢迎再来哦！$

label: Route13_TravelToAlola_Text_0
source: Ahoy there!\pThat's one strange souvenir.\nYou must be from the ISLES!$
translation: 嗨，你好啊！\p那可真是一个奇特的纪念品。\n你一定是从群岛来的吧！$

label: Route13_TravelToAlola_Text_0_5
source: Would you like to take the next ship?\nIt departs shortly!$
translation: 你想乘下一班船吗？\n马上就要启航了哦！$

label: Route13_TravelToAlola_Text_1
source: Ahoy! Let's get you on board!$
translation: 嗨！这就带你上船！$

label: Route13_TravelToAlola_Text_2
source: Ahoy!\nCome back when you'd like to set sail.$
translation: 嗨！\n想启航的时候随时再来。$

label: Route13_TravelToAlola_Text_3
source: Ah, it's you again!\nDo you want to go to the ALOLA ISLES?$
translation: 啊，又是你呀！\n你想去阿罗拉群岛吗？$

label: Route13_TravelToAlola_Text_4
source:
Ahoy!
This port is for residents only.\pAll of the residents of these ISLES
carry some… {PAUSE 30}strange souvenirs.\pIt makes them so easy to identify,
I don't even need to check tickets!$
translation:
嗨！
这个港口只限当地居民使用。\p这片群岛的所有居民
都会随身带着一些......{PAUSE 30}奇特的纪念品。\p只要看那个就能一眼认出来，
我连船票都用不着查呢！$

label: Route14_Text_Eusine
source:
EUSINE: {PLAYER}! Not again!
I'll be there first next time!\pHaving followed it here, I'm
starting to understand what SUICUNE\lis after.\pTo be honest, I would like to keep
this information to myself.\pBut I want to be an honest trainer
in front of SUICUNE!\pThat's why I am sharing a clue with
you.\pIt seems that...
SUICUNE prefers a hilly place...\lNear water...\lSomewhere north...\pI don't know exactly where yet.
It will just be you and me!\pWho'll find it first?
I challenge you!$
translation:
米那君：{PLAYER}！又慢了一步！
下次我一定会先赶到的！\p一路追踪到这里，
我开始明白水君在追求什么了。\p说实话，这个情报
我原本是想藏私的。\p但在水君面前，
我想做个光明磊落的训练家！\p所以，我就把线索也分享给你吧。\p据说......
水君喜欢高地......\l靠近水边......\l而且在北方某个地方......\p具体在哪里我现在还不知道。
只有我和你！\p看谁能先找到它！
我要向你发起挑战！$

label: Route14_Text_PokefanmTrevorSeen
source: Hi. Did you know…?\pPOKéMON get more friendly if you\ntrain them in a place that they\lremember.$
translation: 你好。你知道吗......？\p如果带宝可梦在它们有记忆的地方\n培育，它们会变得更加亲密哦。$

label: Route14_Text_PokefanmTrevorBeaten
source: Where did I meet this SCIZOR?$
translation: 我是在哪里遇到这只巨钳螳螂的来着？$

label: Route14_Text_PokefanmTrevorAfterBattle
source: If only there were an easy way to\nidentify where I got my POKéMON…$
translation: 要是有个能轻松查出宝可梦\n是在哪儿捕获的方法就好了......$

label: Route14_Text_TrevorRegister
source: You're interesting!\nCan I have your number?$
translation: 你真有意思！\n能把电话号码告诉我吗？$

label: Route14_Text_TrevorRematchIntro
source: I've been training with my\nPOKéMON in familiar places!$
translation: 我一直在宝可梦熟悉的地方\n和它们一起特训呢！$

label: Route14_Text_TrevorRematchDefeat
source: Maybe I need new places…$
translation: 也许我该去些新地方了......$

label: Route14_Text_TrevorPostRematch
source: Friendship makes POKéMON\nstronger. I'm sure of it!$
translation: 亲密度能让宝可梦变得更强。\n我对此坚信不疑！$

label: Route14_Text_PokefanmCarterSeen
source: Let me tell you, I had a hard time\ncatching my prized POKéMON.$
translation: 我跟你说，我为了捉到\n我最宝贝的宝可梦，可吃了不少苦头呢。$

label: Route14_Text_PokefanmCarterBeaten
source: Awaaah!$
translation: 哇啊啊啊！$

label: Route14_Text_PokefanmCarterAfterBattle
source: TOTODILE, CYNDAQUIL, CHIKORITA…\pI think that's a well-balanced mix.$
translation: 小锯鳄、火球鼠、菊草叶......\p我觉得这是个搭配很均衡的组合。$

label: Route14_Text_CarterRegister
source: You know your starters!\nLet me get your number!$
translation: 你很懂最初的伙伴嘛！\n把电话号码留给我吧！$

label: Route14_Text_CarterRematchIntro
source: I've found even more rare starters\nto show off! Battle me!$
translation: 我又找到了更多稀有的最初伙伴\n来炫耀了！来对战吧！$

label: Route14_Text_CarterRematchDefeat
source: My precious starters…$
translation: 我宝贝的最初伙伴们......$

label: Route14_Text_CarterPostRematch
source: There are so many starters from\ndifferent regions to collect!$
translation: 不同地区有好多最初的伙伴\n可以收集呢！$

label: Route14_Text_BirdKeeperRoySeen
source: My dream is to fly with my beloved\nbird POKéMON.$
translation: 我的梦想是和我心爱的鸟宝可梦\n一起在天空中翱翔。$

label: Route14_Text_BirdKeeperRoyBeaten
source: I can dream, but I can't ever fly…$
translation: 做梦归做梦，可我根本飞不起来啊......$

label: Route14_Text_BirdKeeperRoyAfterBattle
source: You have POKéMON that know the HM\nmove FLY, don't you? I envy you.$
translation: 你有学会秘传学习器招式\n"飞翔"的宝可梦对吧？真羡慕你啊。$

label: Route14_Text_Pidgeotto
source: PIDGEOTTO: Kaaaaa!$
translation: 比比鸟：嘎啊啊--！$

label: Route14_Text_PidgeottoBerry
source: Give the PIDGEOTTO a BERRY?$
translation: 要给比比鸟树果吗？$

label: Route14_Text_PidgeottoAteBerry
source: PIDGEOTTO enjoyed the QUALOT BERRY!$
translation: 比比鸟很开心地吃了蜜柚果！$

label: Route14_Text_PidgeottoTurnedAway
source: PIDGEOTTO doesn't like it!$
translation: 比比鸟不喜欢这个！$

label: Route15_Text_TeacherColetteSeen
source: Have you forgotten anything?$
translation: 你有没有落下什么东西？$

label: Route15_Text_TeacherColetteBeaten
source: Kyaaah!$

label: Route15_Text_TeacherColetteAfterBattle
source: Before I became a teacher, I used\nto forget a lot of things.$
translation: 在当老师之前，我也经常\n丢三落四的。$

label: Route15_Text_TeacherHillarySeen
source: On sunny days, I think that the\nkids would rather be playing in the\lschoolyard than studying in class.$
translation: 大晴天的时候，孩子们比起在教室里学习，\n应该更想在操场上奔跑玩耍吧。$

label: Route15_Text_TeacherHillaryBeaten
source: I didn't want to lose…$
translation: 我本来不想输的......$

label: Route15_Text_TeacherHillaryAfterBattle
source: Studying is important, but\nexercise is just as vital.$
translation: 学习固然重要，\n但体育锻炼也同样不可或缺哦。$

label: Route15_Text_HillaryRegister
source: You've taught me a lesson!\nMay I have your number?$
translation: 你可真给我上了一课！\n能告诉我你的电话号码吗？$

label: Route15_Text_HillaryRematchIntro
source: I'll school you this time!$
translation: 这次由我来给你上一课！$

label: Route15_Text_HillaryRematchDefeat
source: Back to the drawing board…$
translation: 得从头再学起啦......$

label: Route15_Text_HillaryPostRematch
source: Teaching POKéMON is just like\nteaching children. Patience!$
translation: 培育宝可梦就跟教导小孩子一样，\n必须要有耐心！$

label: Route15_Text_SchoolboyKippSeen
source: Hang on. I have to phone my mom.$
translation: 等等，我得先给我妈妈打个电话。$

label: Route15_Text_SchoolboyKippBeaten
source: Sorry, Mom! I was beaten!$
translation: 对不起，妈妈！我打输了！$

label: Route15_Text_SchoolboyKippAfterBattle
source: My mom worries so much about me, I\nhave to phone her all the time.$
translation: 我妈妈总是特别担心我，\n所以我随时都得跟她通个电话。$

label: Route15_Text_SchoolboyTommySeen
source: Let's battle. I won't lose!$
translation: 来对战吧！我可不会输！$

label: Route15_Text_SchoolboyTommyBeaten
source: I forgot to do my homework!$
translation: 我忘了写作业啦！$

label: Route15_Text_SchoolboyTommyAfterBattle
source: Sayonara! I just learned that in\nmy Japanese class.$
translation: "撒哟哪啦"！\n这可是我刚在日语课上学到的！$

label: Route15_Text_SchoolboyJohnnySeen
source: We're on a field trip to LAVENDER\nRADIO TOWER for social studies.$
translation: 我们的社会实践课是要去\n紫苑广播电台参观哦。$

label: Route15_Text_SchoolboyJohnnyBeaten
source: You're wickedly tough!$
translation: 你也太强了吧！$

label: Route15_Text_SchoolboyJohnnyAfterBattle
source: I'm tired of walking. I need to\ntake a break.$
translation: 走得累死我了。\n我得歇一会儿。$

label: Route15_Text_SchoolboyBillySeen
source: My favorite class is Gym!$
translation: 我最喜欢的课就是体育课！$

label: Route15_Text_SchoolboyBillyBeaten
source: Oh, no! How could I lose?$
translation: 天啊！我怎么会输？$

label: Route15_Text_SchoolboyBillyAfterBattle
source: If POKéMON were a subject at\nschool, I'd be the best!$
translation: 如果学校里有宝可梦这一门课，\n我肯定是第一名！$

label: Route15_Text_BillyRegister
source: I should've paid more attention in class.\nCan I have your number?$
translation: 看来我上课得多听讲才行了。\n能把你的电话号码告诉我吗？$

label: Route15_Text_BillyRematchIntro
source: I've been studying hard!\nLet me show you what I learned!$
translation: 我一直都在用功学习！\n让你见识一下我的学习成果！$

label: Route15_Text_BillyRematchDefeat
source: I need to study more…$
translation: 我还得多多用功才行......$

label: Route15_Text_BillyPostRematch
source: Book smarts aren't everything.\nI need battle experience too!$
translation: 光读死书可不行，\n我还欠缺对战经验啊！$

label: Route15_Text_Sign
source: ROUTE 15\pFUCHSIA CITY - LAVENDER TOWN$
translation: 15号道路\p浅红市 - 紫苑镇$

label: Route16_Text_Sign
source: CYCLING ROAD\nDOWNHILL COASING\lALL THE WAY DOWN!$
translation: 自行车道\n下坡兜风\l一路滑行到底！$

label: Route16FuchsiaSpeechHouse_Text_SuperNerd
source: A celebrity used to live here.$
translation: 以前这里住过一位名人。$

label: Route16FuchsiaSpeechHouse_Text_SuperNerdOld
source: If you cruise down CYCLING ROAD,\nyou will end up in FUCHSIA CITY.$
translation: 如果顺着自行车道一路滑下去，\n就能到达浅红市。$

label: Route17_Text_BikerRileySeen
source: Hey, you! You're from JOHTO, huh?$
translation: 喂，你！你是从城都来的吧？$

label: Route17_Text_BikerRileyBeaten
source: Whoa, you kick!$
translation: 哇，真有两下子！$

label: Route17_Text_BikerRileyAfterBattle
source: Don't get cocky, you JOHTO punk!$
translation: 别太得意了，你这城都来的小鬼！$

label: Route17_Text_BikerJoelSeen
source: Wow. That's a cool BICYCLE!$
translation: 哇，那辆自行车真帅！$

label: Route17_Text_BikerJoelBeaten
source: But you don't just look cool…$
translation: 但你不光是看起来帅而已......$

label: Route17_Text_BikerJoelAfterBattle
source: I look cool, but I'm weak, so I'm\nnot really cool.\pI have to train harder…$
translation: 我看起来很酷，但实力太弱，\n所以根本算不上真帅。\p我必须更加努力特训才行......$

label: Route17_Text_BikerGlennSeen
source: Hey! Want to have a speed battle?$
translation: 喂！想来一场速度的对决吗？$

label: Route17_Text_BikerGlennBeaten
source: Yikes! You've got awesome torque!$
translation: 哇呀！你的冲劲真猛！$

label: Route17_Text_BikerGlennAfterBattle
source: Hands-free riding is considered\ncool on CYCLING ROAD.$
translation: 在自行车道上，\n双手脱把骑行才叫帅气。$

label: Route17_Text_BikerCharlesSeen
source: We're fearless highway stars!$
translation: 我们可是无所畏惧的公路之星！$

label: Route17_Text_BikerCharlesBeaten
source: Arrrgh! Crash and burn!$
translation: 啊啊啊！彻底翻车啦！$

label: Route17_Text_BikerCharlesAfterBattle
source: Reckless driving causes accidents!\nTake it easy!$
translation: 危险驾驶会导致事故的！\n骑慢点悠着点！$

label: Route17_Text_RileyRegister
source: Not bad for a JOHTO kid!$
translation: 对城都的小鬼来说，算不错了！$

label: Route17_Text_RileyRematchIntro
source: JOHTO punks can only win once!$
translation: 城都小鬼也就只能赢这么一回！$

label: Route17_Text_RileyRematchDefeat
source: I got kicked...$

source:
Sorry. This road is closed for

you'd better go south from PALLET
TOWN.$
translation: 不好意思。这条路因为施工而封闭了。\p如果你想去红莲岛，\n最好从真新镇往南走。$

source: KINGLER: KEEEEEEEEEEEE$

source: I'm all sweaty. Time for a swim!$
translation: 出了一身汗。该去游个泳啦！$

translation: 真倒霉，巨钳蟹把海滩给堵住了。$

source: If trainers meet, the first\nthing to do is battle.$
translation: 训练家相遇，\n第一件事当然是对战！$

source: You're strong.\pYou obviously must have trained\nhard.$
translation: 你真强。\p显然是经过了刻苦的特训吧。$

I've been fishing here for hours!$

translation: 你的宝可梦游得真快！\n告诉我你的电话号码吧！$

source: All this swimming has made my\nPOKéMON stronger! Let's battle!$
translation: 游了这么久，我的宝可梦更强健了！\n来对战吧！$

translation: 游泳能锻炼到全身肌肉。\p对身体真的特别好呢。$

source: Besides the sea, I can also swim\nin ponds and rivers.$

translation: {RIVAL}：你明明说过......\n自己要成为世界第一的！\p你就这么放弃了吗？\p那你接下来打算怎么办？$

........................\p坂木：如果不先承认失败，

translation:
{RIVAL}：你算哪门子的

source:
GIOVANNI: Putting together the
potential of many is how you\lproduce a huge power...\lThat's what an organization is...\lThat's the strength of organization\pI failed... to make the best use of
my subordinates' potential...!\pBut you shall witness one day the
revival of me and my TEAM ROCKET!$
translation:
坂木：聚集众人的潜能，
才能汇聚出庞大的力量......\l这就是组织......\l这就是组织的力量......\p是我没能......
完全发挥出手下的潜力......！\p但总有一天，你会亲眼见证

source: {RIVAL}: I don't understand you!\pYou don't make any sense!$
translation: {RIVAL}：我才听不懂你在说什么！\p你说的根本就莫名其妙！$

label: Route22_Text_Giovanni3

label: Route22_Text_Silver4
source:
{RIVAL}: I don't want to
understand you!\pI will never become someone like
you.\pA coward when you're alone and
acting like a tyrant when you're\lin front of other cowards!\pI will become strong!\pI will become a stronger man all

translation:
{RIVAL}：我才不想明白！\p我绝对不要变成
你这种人。\p一个人时就是个胆小鬼，
只敢在一群懦夫面前耀武扬威！\p我会变强的！\p只凭我一个人，

translation: {RIVAL}：......你看什么看？$

Hey, kid! Me am a TEAM ROCKET

嗨，小鬼！我，是火箭队的
成员是也！\p从外国来的，超级厉害的

哎呀呀！不、不、不能相信，

OK. Tell you mine secret will I?
MACHINE PART steal by me, hide it\lI did in GYM of the CERULEAN.\pInside water put it I did. Look

好吧。我的秘密，告诉你吧。
被我偷走的机械零件，藏在华蓝道馆里了！\p在水里面放着。去道馆中央的
水池里找找看吧。\p但是，你可别忘了我！\p火箭队，一定会打飞你的！\p城都的同伴们会赶过来，
没错。复仇，他们一定会来复仇的！$

translation: 我孙子正辉曾跟我提过一种宝可梦，\n它有着锋利的爪子，额头上贴着小判金币，\p据说还会带来财运呢。$

label: Route25_BillsHouse_Text_GrampsZigzagoon
source: BILL mentioned a POKéMON that\nruns around in a zigzag\lpattern.\pIt's quite the little\nscavenger, I hear.$
translation: 正辉跟我提过一种\n总是走之字形路线的宝可梦。\p听说它还是个很擅长到处捡东西的小家伙呢。$

label: Route25_BillsHouse_Text_GrampsPonyta
source: Do you know of a POKéMON with\na fiery mane?\pI hear it can run faster than\nmost trains.$
translation: 你知道一种长着火焰鬃毛的\n宝可梦吗？\p听说它跑起来比大多数列车还要快呢。$

label: Route25_BillsHouse_Text_GrampsFarfetchd
source: BILL told me about a POKéMON\nthat always carries a stalk\lof leek with it.\pQuite the peculiar creature.$
translation: 正辉跟我提过一种\n总是拿着一根大葱的宝可梦。\p真是个奇特的家伙啊。$

label: Route25_BillsHouse_Text_GrampsSlowpoke
source: Do you know the POKéMON that\nis always staring blankly?\pIts tail is often sold on the\nblack market.$
translation: 你知道那种总是呆呆地\n发愣的宝可梦吗？\p听说它的尾巴经常在黑市上被贩卖呢。$

label: Route25_BillsHouse_Text_TeleporterUnlocked
source:
Oh, one more thing!\pBILL's TELEPORTER.
That's the big machine over there.\pHe never quite got it working.\pBut it does curious things to
POKéMON.\pYou're welcome to try it, if
you'd like!\pJust use that computer over there.$
translation: 哦，还有一件事！\p正辉的传送机，\n就是那边那个大机器。\p他其实一直没能把它彻底搞好。\p不过它对宝可梦好像会有些奇妙的作用。\p如果你想试试的话，随时欢迎！\p只要操作那边的那台电脑就行了。$

label: Route25_BillsHouse_Text_AskToSeeMon
source: If you have that POKéMON, may I\nsee it, please?$
translation: 如果你有那只宝可梦，能让我\n看一看吗？$

label: Route25_BillsHouse_Text_ExcitedToSee
source: You will show me? How good of\nyou!$
translation: 你愿意给我看吗？那真是太好了！$

label: Route25_BillsHouse_Text_YouDontHaveIt
source: You don't have it?\nThat's too bad…$
translation: 你身上没有吗？\n那可真遗憾......$

label: Route25_BillsHouse_Text_ShownPokemon
source: Ah, so that is {STR_VAR_1}?\pIsn't it cute! That's so kind\nof you.$
translation: 啊，这就是{STR_VAR_1}吗？\p真可爱啊！你人真好。$

label: Route25_BillsHouse_Text_Appreciation
source: Thanks!\pThis is a token of my\nappreciation.$
translation: 谢谢你！\p这点小心意请收下吧。$

label: Route25_BillsHouse_Text_ComeAgain
source: Come visit again sometime.$
translation: 有空再来玩啊。$

label: Route25_BillsHouse_Text_ShownAll
source:
Thanks for showing me so many
cute POKéMON.\pI really enjoyed myself. I'm
glad I've lived such a long life.\pFeel free to use the TELEPORTER
whenever you like.$
translation: 谢谢你给我看了这么多\n可爱的宝可梦。\p我真的很开心。活了这么大把年纪，\n真是一件幸事啊。\p传送机你想用的时候随时都可以用。$

label: Route25_BillsHouse_Text_WrongPokemon
source: Hm?\pThat's not the POKéMON that I\nwas told about.$
translation: 嗯？\p这不是我听说的那只宝可梦啊。$

label: Route25_Text_Misty
source: MISTY: I love the sunset here!\nIt gives me the courage to go on,\lyou know?\pRight!\pIf you're ready for a real splash,\nmeet me at the FIGHTING DOJO!$
translation: 小霞：我很喜欢这里的落日！\n能让我充满向前迈进的勇气，\l你懂这种感觉吗？\p好啦！\p如果你想来一场真正的浪花飞溅对战，\n就来格斗道场找我吧！$

label: Route25_Text_Eusine1
source:
EUSINE: Puff, puff...
I am... no match for you.\p...As I predicted.
..........................\l... Go ahead.\pSince I met you in the BURNED TOWER
at ECRUTEAK CITY, I've sort of\lknown that SUICUNE would choose\lyou.$
translation:
米那君：呼，呼......
我......不是你的对手啊。\p......果然不出我所料。
....................................\l......你去吧。\p自从在圆朱市的烧焦塔
遇见你起，我就隐约预感到，\l水君一定会选择你。$

label: Route25_Text_Eusine2
source: Take a look at it!\pSUICUNE is waiting for you!\nIt has been waiting for a battle\lwith a worthy trainer to whom it\lcan entrust itself.$
translation: 快看啊！\p水君正在等着你呢！\n它一直在期待着能与一位\l足以托付身心的训练家交手。$

label: Route25_Text_Eusine3
source:
{PLAYER}...
You two are truly amazing...\pI have never seen a battle this
intense!\lI have no regrets...\pFarewell, SUICUNE!
Farewell... {PLAYER}!$
translation: {PLAYER}......\n你们两个真是太棒了......\p我从没见过如此激烈的对战！\l我已经毫无遗憾了......\p再见了，水君！\n再见了......{PLAYER}！$

label: Route25_Text_MistyDate
source:
MISTY: Aww! Why did you have to
show up and bug us now?\pDo you know what they call
people like you?\pPests! You heard me right,
pest!\p…\p…Oh? Those BADGES you have…
Are they JOHTO GYM BADGES?\pIf you have eight, you must be
good.\pOK, then. Come to CERULEAN GYM.\pI'll be happy to take you on.\pI'm MISTY, the GYM LEADER in
CERULEAN.$
translation:
小霞：啊--！你怎么偏偏挑这个时候
跑出来打扰别人啊？\p你知道大家管你这种人
叫什么吗？\p电灯泡！你没听错，
就是讨人嫌的电灯泡！\p......\p......咦？你身上的那些徽章......
是城都地区的道馆徽章吗？\p既然集齐了8枚，想必还挺有两下子的嘛。\p好吧。那就来华蓝道馆找我吧。\p我很乐意做你的对手。\p我就是华蓝道馆的馆主小霞。$

label: Route25_Text_SchoolboyDudleySeen
source: Beat the six of us trainers to\nwin a fabulous prize!\pThink you've got what it takes?$
translation: 只要战胜我们6位训练家，\n就能赢得豪华大奖！\p有胆量就来试试看吧？$

label: Route25_Text_SchoolboyDudleyBeaten
source: Whoo! Good stuff.$
translation: 哇哦！真厉害。$

label: Route25_Text_SchoolboyDudleyAfter
source: I did my best.\nI have no regrets.$
translation: 我已经尽力了。\n毫无遗憾。$

label: Route25_Text_LassEllenSeen
source: I'm second.\nNow it's serious!$
translation: 我是第2位！\n接下来可要动真格的了！$

label: Route25_Text_LassEllenBeaten
source: How could I lose?$
translation: 我怎么可能会输？！$

label: Route25_Text_LassEllenAfter
source: I did my best.\nI have no regrets.$
translation: 我已经尽力了。\n毫无遗憾。$

label: Route25_Text_SchoolboyJoeSeen
source: Here's No. 3!\nI won't be easy.$
translation: 第3位登场！\n我可没那么好对付。$

label: Route25_Text_SchoolboyJoeBeaten
source: Ow! Stomped flat!$
translation: 哎呀！被彻底打垮了！$

label: Route25_Text_SchoolboyJoeAfter
source: I did my best.\nI have no regrets.$
translation: 我已经尽力了。\n毫无遗憾。$

label: Route25_Text_LassLauraSeen
source: I'm No. 4!\nGetting tired?$
translation: 我是第4位！\n开始觉得累了吗？$

label: Route25_Text_LassLauraBeaten
source: I lost too…$
translation: 连我也输了......$

label: Route25_Text_LassLauraAfter
source: I did my best.\nI have no regrets.$
translation: 我已经尽力了。\n毫无遗憾。$

label: Route25_Text_CamperLloydSeen
source: OK! I'm No. 5.\nI'll stomp you!$
translation: 好嘞！我是第5位！\n看我把你狠狠打趴下！$

label: Route25_Text_CamperLloydBeaten
source: Whoa! Too much.$
translation: 哇！太强了吧。$

label: Route25_Text_CamperLloydAfter
source: I did my best.\nI have no regrets.$
translation: 我已经尽力了。\n毫无遗憾。$

label: Route25_Text_LassShannonSeen
source: I'm the last in line, but I tell\nyou, I'm tough!$
translation: 虽然我是最后一位，\n但我告诉你，我可是很强的！$

label: Route25_Text_LassShannonBeaten
source: You're kidding.$
translation: 开玩笑的吧......$

label: Route25_Text_LassShannonAfter
source: I did my best.\nI have no regrets.$
translation: 我已经尽力了。\n毫无遗憾。$

label: Route25_Text_SupernerdPatSeen
source: Mufufufu…\pI have nothing to do with the\nsix-pack trainers.\pI waited here to beat you when\nyou were tired out by all the\lbattles.$
translation: 哼哼哼......\p我可跟那6个训练家\n不是一伙的。\p我一直埋伏在这里，就等你在\n连番激战后筋疲力尽，再把你收拾掉！$

label: Route25_Text_SupernerdPatBeaten
source: Aren't you tired at all?$
translation: 难道你一点都不累吗？！$

label: Route25_Text_SupernerdPatAfter
source: I'm sorry… I won't cheat\nanymore…$
translation: 对不起......我再也不耍诈了......$

label: Route25_Text_CooltrainerKevinNugget
source: You took on one more battle than\nyou expected, but you won\lanyway.\pAs promised, you win a prize.$
translation: 虽然多打了一场意料之外的对战，\n但你还是漂亮地赢了。\p按照约定，这是你的奖品。$

label: Route25_Text_CooltrainerKevinSeen
source: But after seeing how you battle,\nI want to see how I'll fare.\pHow about it? Let me take you\non.$
translation: 不过在见识了你的对战风采之后，\n我也想看看自己的斤两。\p怎么样？跟我过两招吧！$

label: Route25_Text_CooltrainerKevinBeaten
source: I've never had a battle this\ngood!$
translation: 好久没经历过这么痛快的对战了！$

label: Route25_Text_CooltrainerKevinAfter
source: That was a great battle!\pYou and your POKéMON are truly\noutstanding!$
translation: 真是一场精彩绝伦的对战！\p你和你的宝可梦都非常出色！$

label: Route25_Text_BillsHouseSign
source: SEA COTTAGE\nBILL'S HOUSE$
translation: 海边小屋\n正辉的家$

label: Route26_Text_CooltrainermJakeSeen
source: I'm making my final preparations\nfor the POKéMON LEAGUE.$
translation: 我正在为挑战宝可梦联盟\n做最后的准备呢。$

label: Route26_Text_CooltrainermJakeBeaten
source: I blew it!$
translation: 搞砸了！$

label: Route26_Text_CooltrainermJakeAfter
source: It's going to be tough to win at\nthe LEAGUE.\pI need to do some more training.\pI hear that the LEAGUE's ELITE\nFOUR are tougher than GYM LEADERS.$
translation: 想要在联盟获胜可真不容易。\p我得再多修行修行才行。\p听说联盟的四天王\n比道馆馆主还要厉害呢。$

label: Route26_Text_CooltrainermGavenSeen
source: By experiencing tough battles, you\ngain power.$
translation: 经历过艰难的对战，\n才能获得强大的力量。$

label: Route26_Text_CooltrainermGavenBeaten
source: Gaah! Life is even tougher!$
translation: 哇啊！人生可比这还要艰难啊！$

label: Route26_Text_CooltrainermGavenAfter
source: To get to POKéMON LEAGUE, you have\nto get through VICTORY ROAD.\pBut VICTORY ROAD is tough.\pPractically nobody goes there!$
translation: 要想前往宝可梦联盟，\n就必须穿过冠军之路。\p但是冠军之路非常艰险。\p几乎没有人能去那里！$

label: Route26_Text_GavenRegister
source: To get to POKéMON LEAGUE, you have\nto get through VICTORY ROAD.\pBut VICTORY ROAD is tough.\pPractically nobody goes there!$
translation: 要想前往宝可梦联盟，\n就必须穿过冠军之路。\p但是冠军之路非常艰险。\p几乎没有人能去那里！$

label: Route26_Text_GavenRematchIntro
source: By experiencing tough battles, you\ngain power.$
translation: 经历过艰难的对战，\n才能获得强大的力量。$

label: Route26_Text_GavenRematchDefeat
source: Gaah! Life is even tougher!$
translation: 哇啊！人生可比这还要艰难啊！$

label: Route26_Text_GavenPostRematch
source: To get to POKéMON LEAGUE, you have\nto get through VICTORY ROAD.\pBut VICTORY ROAD is tough.\pPractically nobody goes there!$
translation: 要想前往宝可梦联盟，\n就必须穿过冠军之路。\p但是冠军之路非常艰险。\p几乎没有人能去那里！$

label: Route26_Text_CooltrainerfJoyceSeen
source: Since you've come this far,\nyou must be good.\pI'm going to give this battle\neverything I've got!$
translation: 既然你能走到这里，\n实力一定非同小可。\p这场对战我也会全力以赴的！$

label: Route26_Text_CooltrainerfJoyceBeaten
source: No! I don't believe this!$
translation: 不！这不可能！$

label: Route26_Text_CooltrainerfJoyceAfter
source: I've defeated eight GYM LEADERS,\nso I was feeling confident.\pI'll have to try harder next time.$
translation: 我已经打赢了8位道馆馆主，\n本来还挺有自信的。\p看来下次得更加努力才行了。$

label: Route26_Text_CooltrainerfBethSeen
source: I lost to a trainer named {RIVAL}.\pHe was really strong, but…\pIt was as if he absolutely had to\nwin at any cost.\pI felt sorry for his POKéMON.$
translation: 我输给了一个叫{RIVAL}的训练家。\p他确实很强，但是......\p他给人的感觉就像是不择手段也一定要赢似的。\p真替他的宝可梦感到难过。$

label: Route26_Text_CooltrainerfBethBeaten
source: POKéMON aren't tools of war.$
translation: 宝可梦可不是争斗的工具。$

label: Route26_Text_CooltrainerfBethAfter
source: POKéMON are in-valuable, lifelong\npartners.$
translation: 宝可梦是无比珍贵、相伴一生的伙伴。$

label: Route26_Text_BethRegister
source: POKéMON are invaluable, lifelong\npartners.$
translation: 宝可梦是无比珍贵、相伴一生的伙伴。$

label: Route26_Text_BethRematchIntro
source: I lost to a trainer named {RIVAL}.\pBut I won't lose to you!$
translation: 我输给了一个叫{RIVAL}的训练家。\p但我可不会再输给你！$

label: Route26_Text_BethRematchDefeat
source: POKéMON aren't tools of war.$
translation: 宝可梦可不是争斗的工具。$

label: Route26_Text_BethPostRematch
source: POKéMON are invaluable, lifelong\npartners.$
translation: 宝可梦是无比珍贵、相伴一生的伙伴。$

label: Route26_Text_PsychicRichardSeen
source: Wow, look at all those BADGES!\nI'm impressed.\pBut you're not satisfied by just\ncollecting them, right?$
translation: 哇，瞧瞧你身上这一排徽章！\n真让人佩服。\p不过你不会光收集到徽章就满足了吧？$

label: Route26_Text_PsychicRichardBeaten
source: Good battle!$
translation: 精彩的对战！$

label: Route26_Text_PsychicRichardAfter
source: People and POKéMON grow from their\nexperiences.\pDon't get lazy and complacent.$
translation: 人和宝可梦都是从经验中成长的。\p可千万别懈怠自满哦。$

label: Route26_Text_Sign
source: ROUTE 26\pPOKéMON LEAGUE\nRECEPTION GATE$
translation: 26号道路\p宝可梦联盟\n接待大门$

label: Route26_Text_HealHouseRest
source: Your POKéMON look a little tired.\pYou should rest them a while.$
translation: 你的宝可梦看起来有点累了。\p在这里休息一会儿吧。$

label: Route26_Text_HealHouseKeepAtIt
source: There!\pYour POKéMON are looking good!\pKeep at it!$
translation: 好啦！\p你的宝可梦都恢复精神了！\p继续加油吧！$

label: DayOfWeekSiblingsHouse_Text_Pokedex1
source: There's something written here.\pRead it?$
translation: 这里写着一些字。\p要读一下吗？$

label: DayOfWeekSiblingsHouse_Text_Pokedex2
source:
To my brothers and sisters:\pWe take pride in serving POKéMON
trainers.\pWhen trainers talk to you, give
them something useful.\pLove,
MONICA\pKeep reading?$
translation:
致我的兄弟姐妹们：\p能为各位宝可梦训练家提供帮助，
我们倍感自豪。\p当有训练家和你们搭话时，
送给他们一些有用的东西吧。\p爱你们的
月美\p要接着往下读吗？$

label: DayOfWeekSiblingsHouse_Text_Pokedex3
source:
Monday, MONICA
ROUTE 40\pTuesday, TUSCANY
ROUTE 29\pWednesday, WESLEY
LAKE OF RAGE\pThursday, ARTHUR
ROUTE 36\pFriday, FRIEDA
ROUTE 32\pSaturday, SANTOS
BLACKTHORN CITY\pSunday, SUNNY
ROUTE 37$
translation:
周一：月美
40号水路\p周二：火美
29号道路\p周三：水夫
愤怒之湖\p周四：木夫
36号道路\p周五：金美
32号道路\p周六：土夫
烟墨市\p周日：日夫
37号道路$

label: Route27_Text_BaobaName
source: BAOBA$
translation: 巴奥巴$

label: Route27_Text_FisherHey
source: Hey!$

label: Route27_Text_CooltrainermBlakeSeen
source: You look pretty strong.\nLet me battle you!$
translation: 你看上去挺强的嘛。\n来和我对战一场吧！$

label: Route27_Text_CooltrainermBlakeBeaten
source: Yow!$
translation: 哇啊！$

label: Route27_Text_CooltrainermBlakeAfter
source: If you prevail on this harsh trek,\nthe truth will be revealed!\pHeh, sorry, I just wanted to say\nsomething cool.$
translation: 若你能挺过这严酷的旅程，\n真相终将大白！\p嘿嘿，不好意思，\n我只是想说句帅气的话而已。$

label: Route27_Text_CooltrainermBrianSeen
source: Hm? You're good, aren't you?$
translation: 嗯？你挺厉害的嘛？$

label: Route27_Text_CooltrainermBrianBeaten
source: Just as I thought!$
translation: 果然不出我所料！$

label: Route27_Text_CooltrainermBrianAfter
source: A good trainer can recognize other\ngood trainers.$
translation: 优秀的训练家一眼就能看出\n对方是不是顶尖高手。$

label: Route27_Text_CooltrainerfReenaSeen
source: You shouldn't underestimate the\nwild POKéMON in these parts.$
translation: 你可千万别小看\n这一带的野生宝可梦啊。$

label: Route27_Text_CooltrainerfReenaBeaten
source: Oh! You're much too strong!$
translation: 哎呀！你也太强了吧！$

label: Route27_Text_CooltrainerfReenaAfter
source: You're just a kid, but you're not\nto be underestimated either.$
translation: 虽然你年纪还小，\n但也绝对是个不可小觑的对手啊。$

label: Route27_Text_ReenaRegister
source: You're just a kid, but you're not\nto be underestimated either.$
translation: 虽然你年纪还小，\n但也绝对是个不可小觑的对手啊。$

label: Route27_Text_ReenaRematchIntro
source: You shouldn't underestimate the\nwild POKéMON in these parts.$
translation: 你可千万别小看\n这一带的野生宝可梦啊。$

label: Route27_Text_ReenaRematchDefeat
source: Oh! You're much too strong!$
translation: 哎呀！你也太强了吧！$

label: Route27_Text_ReenaPostRematch
source: You're just a kid, but you're not\nto be underestimated either.$
translation: 虽然你年纪还小，\n但也绝对是个不可小觑的对手啊。$

label: Route27_Text_CooltrainerfMeganSeen
source: It's rare to see anyone come here.\pAre you training on your own?$
translation: 真少见有人会来这里呢。\p你是一个人在这里特训吗？$

label: Route27_Text_CooltrainerfMeganBeaten
source: Oh! You're really strong!$
translation: 哇！你真的好强！$

label: Route27_Text_CooltrainerfMeganAfter
source:
I'm checking out pre- and post-
evolution POKéMON.\pEvolution really does make
POKéMON stronger.\pBut evolved forms also learn
moves later on.$
translation: 我正在观察宝可梦进化前后的区别。\p进化确实能让宝可梦变得更强，\p但进化之后的宝可梦\n学会招式的等级也会变晚呢。$

label: Route27_Text_PsychicGilbertSeen
source: Don't say a thing!\pLet me guess what you're thinking.\pMmmmmmm…\pI got it! You're on the POKéMON\nLEAGUE challenge!$
translation: 什么都别说！\p让我来猜猜你在想什么。\p嗯----......\p我知道了！你正在挑战\n宝可梦联盟吧！$

label: Route27_Text_PsychicGilbertBeaten
source: You're too much!$
translation: 你也太强了吧！$

label: Route27_Text_PsychicGilbertAfter
source: With your skills, you'll do well at\nthe LEAGUE.\pThat's what my premonition says.$
translation: 凭你的实力，在联盟一定能大放异彩。\p我的预知就是这么说的。$

label: Route27_Text_BirdKeeperJoseSeen
source: Tweet! Tweet! Tetweet!$
translation: 啾！啾！啾啾啾！$

label: Route27_Text_BirdKeeperJoseBeaten
source: Tweet!$

label: Route27_Text_BirdKeeperJoseAfter
source: BIRD KEEPERS like me mimic bird\nwhistles to command POKéMON.$
translation: 像我们养鸟人都是通过\n模仿真鸟鸣声来指挥宝可梦的。$

label: Route27_Text_JoseRegister
source: BIRD KEEPERS like me mimic bird\nwhistles to command POKéMON.$
translation: 像我们养鸟人都是通过\n模仿真鸟鸣声来指挥宝可梦的。$

label: Route27_Text_JoseRematchIntro
source: Tweet! Tweet! Tetweet!$
translation: 啾！啾！啾啾啾！$

label: Route27_Text_JoseRematchDefeat
source: Tweet!$

label: Route27_Text_JosePostRematch
source: BIRD KEEPERS like me mimic bird\nwhistles to command POKéMON.$
translation: 像我们养鸟人都是通过\n模仿真鸟鸣声来指挥宝可梦的。$

label: Route27_Text_JoseHasItem
source: Hey! I found something\nshiny while bird-watching!\pHere, you can have it!$
translation: 嗨！我刚才观鸟的时候\n捡到了一个闪闪发亮的东西！\p喏，送给你吧！$

label: Route27_Text_JoseGaveItem
source: I find all sorts of things\nout here on ROUTE 27.\pI'll let you know if I find\nanything else!$
translation: 我在27号道路上总能捡到各种东西。\p要是再发现什么好东西，\n我会通知你的！$

label: TohjoFalls_Text_Sign
source: TOHJO FALLS\pTHE LINK BETWEEN KANTO AND JOHTO$
translation: 都城瀑布\p连接关都与城都之瀑布$

label: Route27_Text_FisherScottSeen
source: I'm feeling great today!\pI feel like I could boot even the\nLEAGUE CHAMP!$
translation: 我今天状态绝佳！\p感觉就算是联盟冠军\n我也能一脚踹翻！$

label: Route27_Text_FisherScottBeaten
source: No! Not in this battle!$
translation: 怎么会！居然输在这场对战！$

label: Route27_Text_FisherScottAfter
source: Just like in fishing, it's all over\nin POKéMON if you give up.$
translation: 和钓鱼一样，\n宝可梦对战中一旦放弃就彻底完了。$

label: SandstormHouse_Text_LoyalMon
source: Ah! Your POKéMON trusts you very\nmuch.\pIt's nice to see a good trainer.\pHere. A gift for your journey.$
translation: 啊！你的宝可梦非常信任你呢。\p能见到优秀的训练家真让人高兴。\p来，送你一件旅途的礼物。$

label: SandstormHouse_Text_TM37Description
source: TM37 happens to be SANDSTORM.\pIt's a move that inflicts damage\non both battlers.\pIt's for advanced trainers only.\pUse it if you dare. Good luck!$
translation: 招式学习器37是"沙暴"。\p这是个会对对战双方\n都造成伤害的招式。\p只有高水平的训练家才能驾驭它。\p有胆识的话就试试看吧。祝你好运！$

label: SandstormHouse_Text_DisloyalMon
source: If it doesn't come to trust you\nsome more, it could be tough going.\pTrust is the tie that binds POKéMON\nand trainers.$
translation: 如果它不能更信任你的话，\n接下来可就难办了。\p信任是维系宝可梦与训练家的纽带。$

label: Route28_Text_Sign
source: ROUTE 28$
translation: 28号道路$

label: Route28_Text_Scientist
source: Hiya, Boss.\pYes, I've found several artifacts,\nbut no sign of the AZURE FLUTE.\pIt may be inside the MOUNTAIN, but\nthe wild POKéMON here are strong,\land my team needs some rest...\p..................\pYou're breaking up...\lBoss....?\pI'm going to the POKéMON CENTER.\pI'll call back if I find the FLUTE.$
translation: 喂，老大。\p是的，我找到了几件遗物，\n但完全没有天界之笛的踪影。\p它可能在山里面，不过这里的\n野生宝可梦实力很强，\l我的队伍需要休息一下......\p..................\p听不清你在说什么......\l老大......？\p我要去一趟宝可梦中心。\p等我找到笛子再打给您。$

label: Route28_Text_Scientist2
source: .......CLICK\pThe signal in SINJOH sucks...$
translation: ......嘟--\p神都的信号真是烂透了......$

label: Route28House_Text_Celebrity1
source: Oh, dear. You've found me.\pPlease don't tell anyone about me.\pI'll give you this for keeping my\nsecret. Please?$
translation: 哎呀。被你发现了。\p请千万别告诉别人我在这里。\p送你这个作为保密的谢礼，好吗？$

label: Route28House_Text_Celebrity2
source: It's tough being a top celebrity.\pEverywhere I go, people chase me.\pI just want to be left alone…$
translation: 当超级大明星真辛苦啊。\p无论我走到哪里，都有人追着我跑。\p我只想一个人静静......$

label: Route28House_Text_Fearow
source: FEAROW: Feero!$
translation: 大嘴雀：嘎啊！$

label: Route29_Text_PressAorB
source: Press A or B to stop viewing.$
translation: 按A键或B键退出查看。$

label: Route29_Text_OldMan1
source: POKéMON hide in the grass.\nWho knows when they'll pop out…$
translation: 宝可梦就藏在草丛里。\n天知道它们什么时候会跳出来......$

label: Route29_Text_OldMan2
source: I've seen you a couple times.\nHow many POKéMON have you caught?\pWould you like me to tell you\nhow to catch POKéMON?$
translation: 我见过你几次了呢。\n你抓到了多少只宝可梦？\p需要我教你\n怎么捕捉宝可梦吗？$

label: Route29_Text_OldManExplanation
source:
If you weaken them first,
POKéMON are easier to catch.\pThen, throw a ball at them from
your bag! Any ball will do.\pIf you want to learn more,
go to the ACADEMY in VIOLET CITY!\pThe students there know a lot
about POKéMON.$
translation: 如果先削弱它们的体力，\n宝可梦就会更容易被收服。\p接着从包包里对它们扔出精灵球！任何球都行。\p如果想了解更多技巧，\n就去桔梗市的学院看看吧！\p那里的学生们对宝可梦可了解了。$

label: Route29_Text_OldManDeclined
source:
Oh. Fine, then.\pCheck every route to find
different types of POKéMON.\pYour POKéDEX shows where you can
find them too!\pIf you want to learn more,
go to the ACADEMY in VIOLET CITY!\pThe students know a lot about
POKéMON.$
translation:
哦，那好吧。\p去不同的道路上探索，
能发现各种各样的宝可梦哦。\p你的宝可梦图鉴上也会显示
它们的栖息地！\p如果想了解更多技巧，
就去桔梗市的学院看看吧！\p学生们对宝可梦可了解了。$

label: Route29_Text_Youngster
source: Yo. How are your POKéMON?\pIf they're weak and not ready\nfor battle, keep out of the grass.$
translation: 哟，你的宝可梦状态如何？\p要是它们体力不支，还没准备好战斗，\n就离草丛远一点。$

label: Route29_Text_Lass
source: See those ledges?\nIt's scary to jump off them.\pBut you can go to NEW BARK\nwithout walking through the grass.$
translation: 看到那些台阶了吗？\n跳下去感觉还挺吓人的。\p不过这样你不用穿过草丛\n就能回到若叶镇了。$

label: Route29_Text_Girl
source: I wanted to take a break,\nso I saved to record my progress.$
translation: 我想休息一下，\n所以存了个档记录冒险进度。$

label: Route29_Text_Boy_WaitingForDay
source: I'm waiting for POKéMON that\nappear only later in the day.$
translation: 我在等那些只有在天色渐晚时\n才会出现的宝可梦。$

label: Route29_Text_Boy_WaitingForNight
source: I'm waiting for POKéMON that\nappear only at night.$
translation: 我在等那些只有在夜晚\n才会出现的宝可梦。$

label: Route29_Text_MeetTuscany
source: TUSCANY: I do believe that this\nis the first time we've met?\pI'm TUSCANY of the WEEKDAY FAMILY.\pIf you can guess my favorite day,\nI'll give you a reward.$
translation: 蜜儿：我们应该是\n第一次见面吧？\p我是星期家族的蜜儿。\p要是你能猜出我最喜欢星期几，\n我就给你一份奖励。$

label: Route29_Text_TuscanyNope
source: Not quite!$
translation: 不对哦！$

label: Route29_Text_TuscanyGivesGift
source: Yes! By way of introduction,\nplease accept this gift, a SILK\lSCARF.$
translation: 答对啦！初次见面，\n请收下这份礼物--丝绸围巾。$

label: Route29_Text_TuscanyGaveGift
source: TUSCANY: Wouldn't you agree\nthat it is most adorable?\pIt strengthens NORMAL-type\nmoves.\pI am certain it will be of use.$
translation: 蜜儿：你不觉得它\n非常可爱吗？\p它能增强一般属性招式的威力。\p我相信它一定能派上用场。$

label: Route29_Text_TuscanyTuesday
source: TUSCANY: Have you met MONICA,\nmy older sister?\pOr my younger brother, WESLEY?\pI am the third of seven\nchildren.$
translation: 蜜儿：你见过我的姐姐月子了吗？\p还有我的弟弟水夫呢？\p我在七兄妹里排行第三哦。$

label: Route29_Text_Sign1
source: ROUTE 29\pCHERRYGROVE CITY - NEW BARK TOWN$
translation: 29号道路\p吉花市 - 若叶镇$

label: Route2_Text_RobRegister
source: Let me get your number!$
translation: 把你的电话号码告诉我吧！$

label: Route2_Text_RobRematchIntro
source: I've caught even more bugs!\nCheck them out!$
translation: 我又抓到了更多虫宝可梦！\n快来瞧瞧吧！$

label: Route2_Text_RobRematchDefeat
source: I need better bugs!$
translation: 我需要更厉害的虫宝可梦！$

label: Route2_Text_RobPostRematch
source: I caught every bug in VIRIDIAN.\nIs there a better FOREST somewhere?$
translation: 我把常青森林里所有的虫宝可梦都抓遍了。\n哪里还有更好的森林吗？$

label: Route2_Text_BugCatcherRob_Seen
source: My bug POKéMON are tough. Prepare to\nlose!$
translation: 我的虫宝可梦可是很厉害的。\n做好认输的准备吧！$

label: Route2_Text_BugCatcherRob_Beaten
source: I was whipped…$

label: Route2_Text_BugCatcherRob_AfterBattle
source: I'm going to look for stronger bug\nPOKéMON.$
translation: 我要去寻找更强的虫宝可梦。$

label: Route2_Text_BugCatcherEd_Seen
source: If you walk in tall grass wearing\nshorts, do you get nicks and cuts?$
translation: 穿短裤走在草丛里，\n难道不会被划伤吗？$

label: Route2_Text_BugCatcherEd_Beaten
source: Ouch, ouch, ouch!$
translation: 好疼、好疼、好疼！$

label: Route2_Text_BugCatcherEd_AfterBattle
source: They'll really sting when you take a\nbath.$
translation: 洗澡的时候伤口会刺痛得不行呢。$

label: Route2_Text_BugCatcherDoug_Seen
source: Why don't girls like bug POKéMON?$
translation: 为什么女孩子都不喜欢虫宝可梦呢？$

label: Route2_Text_BugCatcherDoug_Beaten
source: No good!$
translation: 完全不行啊！$

label: Route2_Text_BugCatcherDoug_AfterBattle
source: Bug POKéMON squish like plush toys\nwhen you squeeze their bellies.\pI love how they feel!$
translation: 捏捏虫宝可梦的肚子时，\n软绵绵的手感就像毛绒玩具一样。\p我最喜欢这种感觉了！$

label: Route2_Text_Sign
source: ROUTE 2\pVIRIDIAN CITY - PEWTER CITY$
translation: 2号道路\p常青市 - 深灰市$

label: Route2_Text_DiglettsCaveSign
source: 地鼠洞$
translation: 地鼠洞$

label: Route2_House_Text_Fisher
source: Hi! Wow, I'm glad to see you.\pYou're the first visitor I've had in a\nlong time.\pI'm super-happy! Let me give you a\nlittle present.$
translation: 你好！哇，见到你真高兴。\p你可是好久以来第一个造访的客人呢。\p我真是太高兴了！送你一份小礼物吧。$

label: Route2_House_Text_Fisher_GotNugget
source: That's a NUGGET.\pI can't give you any nuggets of\nwisdom, so that'll have to do!$
translation: 那是一颗金珠。\p虽然我没法给你什么金玉良言，\n但这个应该也足够了吧！$

label: Route30_Text_Mailbox
source: MR.POKéMON's House$
translation: 宝可梦爷爷的家$

label: Route30_Text_UseTackle
source: Go, RATTATA!\pTACKLE!$
translation: 上啊，小拉达！\p撞击！$

label: Route30_Text_ThisIsABigBattle
source: What? This is a big battle!\nLeave me alone!$
translation: 干什么？这可是场激烈的对战！\n别来打扰我！$

label: Route30_Text_YoungsterJoey1Seen
source: I just lost, so I'm trying to\nfind more POKéMON.\pWait! You look weak! Come on,\nlet's battle!$
translation: 我刚刚输了，所以正打算多抓几只宝可梦。\p等等！你看上去挺弱的嘛！\n来，跟我对战一场！$

label: Route30_Text_YoungsterJoey1Beaten
source: Ack! I lost again!\nDoggone it!$
translation: 啊！我又输了！\n真可恶！$

label: Route30_Text_YoungsterJoey1After
source: Do I have to have more POKéMON\nin order to battle better?\pNo! I'm sticking with this one\nno matter what!$
translation: 要想对战变得更强，\n就非得收服更多宝可梦不可吗？\p不！不管怎样，\n我都要和这只伙伴坚持到底！$

label: Route30_Text_YoungsterMikeySeen
source: You're a POKéMON trainer,\nright?\pThen you have to battle!$
translation: 你也是宝可梦训练家，\n对吧？\p那就非得和我对战不可啦！$

label: Route30_Text_YoungsterMikeyBeaten
source: That's strange.\nI won before.$
translation:
真奇怪。
我以前明明赢过的。$

label: Route30_Text_YoungsterMikeyAfter
source: Becoming a good trainer is\nreally tough.\pI'm going to battle other\npeople to get better.$
translation:
要成为优秀的训练家
真不容易啊。\p我得去多和别人对战
来提升自己。$

label: Route30_Text_BugCatcherDonSeen
source: Instead of a bug POKéMON,\nI found a trainer!$
translation:
没抓到虫宝可梦，
倒抓到一个训练家！$

label: Route30_Text_BugCatcherDonBeaten
source: Argh! You're too strong!$
translation: 哎呀！你也太强了吧！$

label: Route30_Text_BugCatcherDonAfter
source: I ran out of POKé BALLS while\nI was catching POKéMON.\pI should've bought some more…$
translation:
抓宝可梦的时候
精灵球用光了。\p真应该多买几个备着的......$

label: Route30_Text_YoungsterDirectionsToMrPokemon
source: MR. POKéMON's house?\nIt's a bit farther ahead.$
translation:
宝可梦爷爷的家？
还要往前走一段路呢。$

label: Route30_Text_YoungsterEveryoneIsBattling
source: Everyone's having fun\nbattling!\pYou should too!$
translation: 大家都在开心地对战呢！\p你也一起来吧！$

label: Route30_Text_CooltrainerF
source: I'm not a trainer.\pBut if you look one in the\neyes, prepare to battle.$
translation:
我可不是训练家。\p不过只要和训练家眼神相遇，
就得做好对战的准备哦。$

label: Route30_Text_Sign
source: ROUTE 30\pVIOLET CITY - CHERRYGROVE CITY$
translation: 30号道路\p桔梗市 - 吉花市$

label: Route30_Text_MrPokemonsHouseDirectionsSign
source: MR. POKéMON'S HOUSE\nSTRAIGHT AHEAD!$
translation:
宝可梦爷爷的家
直走即是！$

label: Route30_Text_MrPokemonsHouseSign
source: MR. POKéMON'S HOUSE$
translation: 宝可梦爷爷的家$

label: Route30_Text_TrainerTips
source: TRAINER TIPS\pNo stealing other people's\nPOKéMON!\pPOKé BALLS are to be thrown\nonly at wild POKéMON!$
translation:
训练家心得\p不准偷别人的宝可梦！\p精灵球只能用来收服
野生的宝可梦！$

label: Route30_Text_JoeyRegister
source: You're pretty good!\pMy RATTATA's raring to go,\njust like always.\pIt's the only one I have.\nI'm going to become a great\lTRAINER with it!\pLet's battle again sometime!$
translation:
你真厉害！\p不过我的小拉达也是
干劲满满哦。\p虽然我只有这一只宝可梦，
但我一定要和它一起\l成为顶尖的训练家！\p下次再来对战吧！$

label: Route30_Text_JoeyRematchIntro
source: I promised things would be\ndifferent! Let's battle!$
translation:
我说过这次结果会不一样！
来对战吧！$

label: Route30_Text_JoeyRematchDefeat
source: Ack! I lost again!\nDoggone it!$
translation: 啊！我又输了！\n真可恶！$

label: Route30_Text_JoeyPostRematch
source: I'm checking out my\nRATTATA's moves and devising\lsome strategies.\pWhen I come up with a good\none, let's battle!$
translation:
我正在研究小拉达的招式，
思考新的战术呢。\p等我想到了好点子，
咱们就来对战吧！$

label: Route30_Text_YoungsterJoeyGiveHPUp
source:
I lost again…
Gee, you're tough!\pOh yeah, I almost forgot that
I had to give you this.\pUse it to get even tougher,
OK?\pI'm going to get tougher too.$
translation:
我又输了......
天哪，你也太强了吧！\p对了，我差点忘了
要把这个交给你。\p用它让自己变得更强吧，
好吗？\p我也一定会变得更强的！$

label: Route30_Text_ElmName
source: 空木博士$
translation: 空木博士$

label: Route30_Text_Elm_Disaster
source: PROF.ELM: H-hello? {PLAYER}? It's\na disaster!\pUh, um, it's just terrible!\pWhat should I do? It…\nOh, no…\pPlease get back here now!$
translation:
空木博士：喂......喂？是{PLAYER}吗？
大事不好了！\p呃、呜......简直太糟糕了！\p怎么办才好？它......
天哪......\p请快点赶回研究所来！$

label: Route30_Text_Poliwag
source: POLIWAG: Wag waag!$
translation: 蚊香蝌蚪：呦~呦！$

label: Route30_BerryHouse_Text_MonEatBerries
source:
When you follow that path up north,
you will see MR. POKéMON’s house.\pBut before you go, allow me to
tell you about BERRIES!\pPOKéMON get healthier by eating
BERRIES.\pThey can even eat BERRIES
they're holding in battle.\pBERRIES can also be turned into
BALLS by KURT in AZALEA TOWN.\pHere. I'll share one with you!$
translation:
沿着那条路一直往北走，
就能看到宝可梦爷爷的家了。\p不过在去之前，
先让我给你讲讲树果的事吧！\p宝可梦吃下树果就会变得更有精神。\p它们在对战中甚至可以自己吃下
身上携带的树果哦。\p桧皮镇的钢铁先生
还可以把树果做成精灵球呢。\p来，这个分你一个吧！$

label: Route30_BerryHouse_Text_CheckTrees
source: Check trees for BERRIES.\nThey grow back after a few hours.$
translation:
多调查调查果树上的树果吧。
过几个小时它们就会重新长出来的。$

label: MrPokemonHouse_Text_Intro1
source: Hello, hello! You must be\n{PLAYER}.\pPROF.ELM said that you would\nvisit.$
translation:
你好呀，你好呀！你就是{PLAYER}吧。\p空木博士跟我说过
你会过来。$

label: MrPokemonHouse_Text_Intro2
source: This is what I want PROF.ELM\nto examine.$
translation:
这就是我想拜托空木博士
调查的东西。$

label: MrPokemonHouse_Text_GotEgg
source: {PLAYER} received MYSTERY EGG.$
translation: {PLAYER}收下了不思议的蛋。$

label: MrPokemonHouse_Text_Intro3
source:
I know a couple who run a
POKéMON DAY-CARE service.\pThey gave me that EGG.\pI was intrigued, so I sent
mail to PROF.ELM.\pFor POKéMON evolution,
PROF.ELM is the authority.$
translation:
我认识一对经营宝可梦培育屋的夫妇。\p这个蛋就是他们给我的。\p我觉得很有意思，
就给空木博士发了邮件。\p说到宝可梦的进化，
空木博士可是这方面的权威啊。$

label: MrPokemonHouse_Text_Intro4
source: Even PROF.OAK here recognizes\nthat.$
translation:
就连身旁的这位大木博士
也是这么认可的呢。$

label: MrPokemonHouse_Text_Intro5
source: If my assumption is correct,\nPROF.ELM will know it.$
translation: 如果我的推断没错的话，\n空木博士应该会知道的。$

label: MrPokemonHouse_Text_Heal
source: You are returning to PROF.ELM?\pHere. Your POKéMON should have\nsome rest.$
translation: 你要回空木博士那里吗？\p来，让你的宝可梦\n好好休息一下吧。$

label: MrPokemonHouse_Text_DependingOnYou
source: I'm depending on you!$
translation: 拜托你啦！$

label: MrPokemonHouse_Text_AlwaysNewDiscoveries
source: Life is delightful!\nAlways, new discoveries to be made.$
translation: 生活真是美妙啊！\n总能有新的发现。$

label: MrPokemonHouse_Text_OakIntro
source:
OAK: Aha! So you're {PLAYER}!\pI'm OAK! A POKéMON researcher.\pI was just visiting my old friend
MR. POKéMON.\pI heard you were running an errand
for PROF.ELM, so I waited here.\pOh! What's this? A rare POKéMON!\pLet's see…
Hm, I see!\pI understand why PROF.ELM gave
you a POKéMON for this errand.\pTo researchers like PROF.ELM and
I, POKéMON are our friends.\pHe saw that you would treat your
POKéMON with love and care.\p…Ah!\pYou seem to be dependable. How
would you like to help me out?\pSee? This is the latest version of
the POKéDEX.\pIt automatically records data on
POKéMON you've seen or caught.\pIt's a hi-tech encyclopedia!\pIt shows their habitats, how
they evolve, and their moves.$
translation:
大木：啊哈！原来你就是{PLAYER}！\p我是大木！是一名宝可梦研究员。\p我正好来拜访我的老朋友
宝可梦先生。\p听说你在帮空木博士跑腿，
所以我特意在这里等你。\p哦！这是什么？好罕见的宝可梦！\p让我看看......
嗯，原来如此！\p我明白空木博士为什么会
托付你一只宝可梦来跑腿了。\p对我和空木博士这样的研究员来说，
宝可梦就是我们的伙伴。\p他一定是看出了你对待宝可梦
充满了爱心与关怀。\p......啊！\p你看起来很值得信赖。不知你
愿不愿意帮我一个忙？\p看到了吗？这是最新型的
宝可梦图鉴。\p只要是见过或捉到的宝可梦，
它都会自动记录相关资料。\p这可是高科技的百科全书！\p它能显示栖息地、进化方式
以及能学会的招式呢。$

label: MrPokemonHouse_Text_GetDex
source: {PLAYER} received POKéDEX!$
translation: {PLAYER}获得了宝可梦图鉴！$

label: MrPokemonHouse_Text_OakParting
source: Go meet many kinds of POKéMON and\ncomplete that POKéDEX!\pBut I've stayed too long.\pI have to get to GOLDENROD\nfor my usual radio show.\p{PLAYER}, I'm counting on you!$
translation: 去邂逅各种各样的宝可梦，\n完成那本宝可梦图鉴吧！\p哎呀，我在这里耽搁太久了。\p我还得赶去满金市\n录制常规的广播节目呢。\p{PLAYER}，就拜托你了！$

label: MrPokemonHouse_Text_GimmeTheScale
source:
Hm? That SCALE! What's that?
A red GYARADOS?\pThat's rare! I, I want it…\p{PLAYER}, would you care to
trade it?\pI can offer this EXP.SHARE
that I got from PROF.OAK.$
translation:
嗯？那片鳞片！那是......？
红色暴鲤龙的鳞片？！\p太罕见了！我、好想得到它......\p{PLAYER}，你愿意
跟我交换吗？\p我可以把从大木博士那里得到的
学习装置换给你！$

label: MrPokemonHouse_Text_Disappointed
source: That's disappointing.\nThat happens to be very rare.$
translation: 真让人失望啊。\n那可是非常罕见的东西呢。$

label: MrPokemonHouse_Text_ExpShare
source: I also have a special item\nfor you.$
translation: 我这里也有件特别的物品要给你。$

label: MrPokemonHouse_Text_ForeignMagazines
source: It's packed with foreign\nmagazines.\pCan't even read their titles…$
translation: 塞满了外国的杂志。\p连标题都看不懂......$

label: MrPokemonHouse_Text_BrokenComputer
source: It's a big computer.\nHmm. It's broken.$
translation: 一台大电脑。\n唔......好像坏掉了。$

label: MrPokemonHouse_Text_StrangeCoins
source: A whole pile of strange coins!\pMaybe they're from another\ncountry…$
translation: 堆成小山的奇怪硬币！\p说不定是外国的钱币......$

label: MrPokemonHouse_Text_GotExpShare
source: {PLAYER} received EXP. SHARE!$
translation: {PLAYER}获得了学习装置！$

label: Route31_Text_CooltrainerM
source: DARK CAVE…\pIf POKéMON could light it up,\nI'd explore it.$
translation: 黑暗穴......\p如果有宝可梦能把里面照亮，\n我也想去探索一番呢。$

label: Route31_Text_BugCatcherWade1_Seen
source: I caught a bunch of POKéMON.\nLet me battle with you!$
translation: 我抓了好多宝可梦。\n来和我对战吧！$

label: Route31_Text_BugCatcherWade1_Beaten
source: Awwwww…$

label: Route31_Text_BugCatcherWade1_After
source: You can catch POKéMON even if\nyou have six with you.\pIf you catch one, it'll go to\nyour BOX automatically.$
translation: 就算随身带了6只宝可梦，\n也一样可以捕捉新的宝可梦哦。\p抓到的宝可梦会自动传送\n到你的盒子里。$

label: Route31_Text_SleepyMan
source: … Hnuurg… Huh?\pI walked too far today looking\nfor POKéMON.\pMy feet hurt and I'm sleepy…\pIf I were a wild POKéMON, I'd\nbe easy to catch…\p…Zzzz…$
translation: ......呼噜噜......嗯？\p今天为了找宝可梦，\n走得太远了。\p脚好酸，好困啊......\p如果我是野生宝可梦，\n肯定一下就被捉住了吧......\p......呼--呼--......$

label: Route31_Text_SleepyManGotMail
source: …Zzzz… Huh?\pWhat's that? You have MAIL\nfor me?$
translation: ......呼--......嗯？\p那是什么？你有邮件\n要给我吗？$

label: Route31_Text_SleepyManFail
source: …Zzzz…$

label: Route31_Text_HandOverMailMon
source: {PLAYER} handed over the\nPOKéMON holding the MAIL.$
translation: {PLAYER}交出了\n携带邮件的宝可梦。$

label: Route31_Text_ReadingMail
source:
Let's see…\pThanks for bringing this to
me.\pMy friend's a good guy, and
you're swell too!\pI'd like to do something good
in return too!\pI know! I want you to have
this!$
translation: 我来看看......\p谢谢你特地送来给我。\p我朋友真是个大好人，\n你也是个热心肠！\p我也得好好报答你一下！\p有了！这个就送给你吧！$

label: Route31_Text_DescribeRest
source: ...Zzz...\p...Umm... Rest!\pThe phrase 'recover fast' became\nshortened to 'Rest,' you see?\pThis is a move to sleep and recover\nsome HP.$
translation: ......呼--......\p......唔......睡觉！\p"睡一觉就能恢复体力"，\n所以才叫"睡觉"，明白吗？\p这是一个在睡眠中\n恢复HP的招式哦。$

label: Route31_Text_WrongMail
source: This MAIL isn't for me.$
translation: 这封邮件不是给我的。$

label: Route31_Text_MissingMail
source: Why is this POKéMON so special?\pIt doesn't have any MAIL.$
translation: 这只宝可梦有什么特别的吗？\p上面根本没有携带邮件呀。$

label: Route31_Text_DeclinedToHandOverMail
source: What? You don't want\nanything?$
translation: 什么？你什么\n都不想要吗？$

label: Route31_Text_CantTakeLastMon
source: If I take that POKéMON from\nyou,\pwhat are you going to use in\nbattle?$
translation: 如果我把那只宝可梦收下了，\p你接下来要用什么去战斗呢？$

label: Route31_Text_Youngster
source:
I found a good POKéMON in DARK
CAVE.\pI'm going to raise it to take
on FALKNER.\pHe's the leader of VIOLET
CITY's GYM.$
translation: 我在黑暗穴抓到了一只很棒的宝可梦。\p我打算好好培育它，再去挑战阿速。\p他就是桔梗道馆的馆主哦。$

label: Route31_Text_Sign
source: ROUTE 31\pVIOLET CITY - CHERRYGROVE CITY$
translation: 31号道路\p桔梗市 - 吉花市$

label: Route31_Text_WadeRegister
source:
You're awesome! I like you!\pI look for POKéMON here every
day.\pWhen I'm in the grass, I find
all kinds of BERRIES.\pIf you'd like, I'll share
some.$
translation: 你真厉害！我很中意你！\p我每天都在这里寻找宝可梦。\p钻草丛的时候，总能发现各种各样的树果。\p如果你喜欢的话，我就分你一些吧。$

label: Route31_Text_WadeRematchIntro
source: I was waiting for you.\nLet's battle!$
translation: 我可等你好久了。\n来对战吧！$

label: Route31_Text_WadeRematchDefeat
source: Awwwww…$

label: Route31_Text_WadePostRematch
source: You'll hear from me as soon\nas I find anything that you\lmight like.$
translation: 只要我一找到你可能会喜欢\l的东西，就会立刻联系你！$

label: Route31_Text_WadeHasItem
source: Hey! I've been looking for\nyou!\pI found something while I\nwas in the grass.\pHere, you can have it!$
translation: 嘿！我正找你呢！\p我在草丛里发现了好东西。\p给你，拿去吧！$

label: Route31_Text_WadeGaveItem
source: I'll let you know if I find\nanything else!$
translation: 如果再找到别的东西，\n我还会通知你的！$

label: Route31_Text_WadeNoRoom
source: Hmm, looks like your BAG\nis full.\pCome back when you have\nroom!$
translation: 唔，看起来你的背包已经满了。\p等整理出空位再来找我吧！$

label: Route31_Text_DarkCaveSign
source: DARK CAVE$
translation: 黑暗穴$

label: Route32_Text_CooltrainerM_WhatsTheHurry
source: Wait up!\nWhat's the hurry?$
translation: 等等！\n急急忙忙的干什么去呀？$

label: Route32_Text_CooltrainerM_AideIsWaiting
source: {PLAYER}, right?\nSome guy wearing glasses\pwas looking for you.\pSee for yourself. He's waiting for\nyou at the POKéMON CENTER.$
translation: 你是{PLAYER}对吧？\n刚才有个戴眼镜的男的\p一直在找你呢。\p你自己去瞧瞧吧。他正在宝可梦中心等你呢。$

label: Route32_Text_CooltrainerM_SproutTower
source: Have you gone to SPROUT TOWER?\nIf you ever visit VIOLET CITY,\pthey'll expect you to train there.\nThat's basic for trainers.\pGo to SPROUT TOWER!$
translation: 你去过喇叭芽之塔了吗？\n既然来到了桔梗市，\p大家都会期待你在那里修行呢。\n这对训练家来说可是基本功哦。\p快去喇叭芽之塔吧！$

label: Route32_Text_CooltrainerM_Experiences
source: Your experiences in VIOLET CITY\nshould be useful for your journey.$
translation: 在桔梗市积累的经验，\n一定会对你的旅程大有帮助的。$

label: Route32_Text_SlowpokeTailOffer
source: How would you like to have this\ntasty, nutritious SLOWPOKETAIL?\pFor you right now, just\n¥1,000,000!\pYou'll want this!$
translation: 要不要来一根美味又有营养的\n呆呆兽之尾？\p现在算你的话，只要\n¥1,000,000！\p你肯定很想买吧！$

label: Route32_Text_ThoughtKidsLoaded
source: Tch! I thought kids\nthese days were loaded…$
translation: 切！我还以为\n现在的小鬼都很有钱呢......$

label: Route32_Text_RefusedSlowpokeTail
source: You don't want it?\nThen scram. Shoo!$
translation: 不买？\n那就闪一边去。走走走！$

label: Route32_Text_FisherJustin_Seen
source: Whoa!\pYou made me lose that fish!$
translation: 哇啊！\p你害我把上钩的鱼放跑了！$

label: Route32_Text_FisherJustin_Beaten
source: Sploosh!$
translation: 噗通！$

label: Route32_Text_FisherJustin_After
source: Calm, collected… The essence of\nfishing and POKéMON is the same.$
translation: 沉着、冷静......钓鱼和宝可梦\n对战的精髓是相通的。$

label: Route32_Text_FisherRalph1_Seen
source: I'm really good at both\nfishing and POKéMON.\pI'm not about to lose to any kid!$
translation: 不管是钓鱼还是宝可梦对战，我都非常拿手。\p我才不会输给毛头小孩呢！$

label: Route32_Text_FisherRalph1_Beaten
source: Tch! I tried to rush\nthings…$
translation: 切！太操之过急了......$

label: Route32_Text_FisherRalph1_After
source: Fishing is a lifelong\npassion.\pPOKéMON are lifelong friends!$
translation: 钓鱼是一生的热爱。\p宝可梦是一生的挚友！$

label: Route32_Text_RalphRegister
source: Fishing is a lifelong\npassion.\pPOKéMON are lifelong friends!$
translation: 钓鱼是一生的热爱。\p宝可梦是一生的挚友！$

label: Route32_Text_RalphRematchIntro
source: I'm really good at both\nfishing and POKéMON.\pI'm not about to lose to any kid!$
translation: 不管是钓鱼还是宝可梦对战，我都非常拿手。\p我才不会输给毛头小孩呢！$

label: Route32_Text_RalphRematchDefeat
source: Tch! I tried to rush\nthings…$
translation: 切！太操之过急了......$

label: Route32_Text_RalphPostRematch
source: Fishing is a lifelong\npassion.\pPOKéMON are lifelong friends!$
translation: 钓鱼是一生的热爱。\p宝可梦是一生的挚友！$

label: Route32_Text_FisherHenry_Seen
source: My POKéMON? Freshly caught!$
translation: 我的宝可梦？刚钓上来的！$

label: Route32_Text_FisherHenry_Beaten
source: SPLASH?$
translation: 跃起？！$

label: Route32_Text_FisherHenry_After
source: Freshly caught POKéMON are\nno match for properly raised ones.$
translation:
刚抓来的宝可梦，
果然比不上精心培育过的啊。$

label: Route32_Text_YoungsterAlbert_Seen
source: I haven't seen you around before.\nSo you think you are pretty tough?$
translation:
以前没在这附近见过你呢。
你觉得自己很厉害吗？$

label: Route32_Text_YoungsterAlbert_Beaten
source: You're strong!$
translation: 你好强！$

label: Route32_Text_YoungsterAlbert_After
source: I'm going to try to be the\nbest with my favorites.\pI'm not using the same tough\nPOKéMON as everyone else.$
translation: 我要带着自己最喜欢的宝可梦争当第一。\p我才不要和大家一样用那些千篇一律的强力宝可梦呢。$

label: Route32_Text_YoungsterGordon_Seen
source: I found some good POKéMON\nin the grass!\pI think they'll do it for me!$
translation: 我在草丛里抓到了挺不错的宝可梦！\p我觉得有它们在一定没问题！$

label: Route32_Text_YoungsterGordon_Beaten
source: Darn. I thought I could win.$
translation: 可恶，我还以为能赢的。$

label: Route32_Text_YoungsterGordon_After
source: The grass is full of\nclingy things.$
translation: 草丛里粘了好多甩不掉的草刺。$

label: Route32_Text_CamperRoland_Seen
source: That glance… It's intriguing.$
translation: 刚才那个眼神......真让人在意啊。$

label: Route32_Text_CamperRoland_Beaten
source: Hmmm. This is disappointing.$
translation: 唔......真让人扫兴。$

label: Route32_Text_CamperRoland_After
source: If you don't want to battle,\njust avoid eye contact.$
translation:
如果不想对战的话，
别和人对上眼神就好啦。$

label: Route32_Text_PicnickerLiz1_Seen
source: Uh-huh. Yeah, and you know…\pPardon? Battle? I'm on the phone.\nOh, all right. But make it fast.$
translation:
嗯嗯。对啊，而且你知道吗......\p你说什么？对战？我正打电话呢。
哎，好吧。速战速决哦。$

label: Route32_Text_PicnickerLiz1_Beaten
source: Oh! I've got to relieve\nmy anger!$
translation: 哎呀！气死我了，我得发泄一下！$

label: Route32_Text_PicnickerLiz1_After
source: I was having a nice chat too.$
translation: 我刚才明明聊得很开心呢。$

label: Route32_Text_LizRegister
source: I was having a nice chat too.$
translation: 我刚才明明聊得很开心呢。$

label: Route32_Text_LizRematchIntro
source: Uh-huh. Yeah, and you know…\pPardon? Battle? I'm on the phone.\nOh, all right. But make it fast.$
translation:
嗯嗯。对啊，而且你知道吗......\p你说什么？对战？我正打电话呢。
哎，好吧。速战速决哦。$

label: Route32_Text_LizRematchDefeat
source: Oh! I've got to relieve\nmy anger!$
translation: 哎呀！气死我了，我得发泄一下！$

label: Route32_Text_LizPostRematch
source: I was having a nice chat too.$
translation: 我刚才明明聊得很开心呢。$

label: Route32_Text_BirdKeeperPeter_Seen
source: That BADGE! It's from VIOLET CITY!\nYou beat FALKNER?$
translation:
那个徽章！是桔梗市的！
你打败了阿速吗？$

label: Route32_Text_BirdKeeperPeter_Beaten
source: I know what my weaknesses are.$
translation: 我知道自己的弱点在哪了。$

label: Route32_Text_BirdKeeperPeter_After
source: I should train again at the\nGYM in VIOLET CITY.$
translation: 我应该回桔梗市的道馆重新修行了。$

label: Route32_Text_RoarIntro
source: WROOOOAR! PEOPLE RUN WHEN I\nROAR! BUT YOU CAME LOOKING!\pTHAT PLEASES ME! NOW TAKE THIS!$
translation:
吼喔喔喔！听到我的咆哮，大家都吓跑了！
你竟然还主动找上门来！\p我很中意你！把这个拿去！$

label: Route32_Text_RoarOutro
source: WROOOOAR! IT'S ROAR!\pEVEN POKéMON RUN FROM A GOOD\nROAR!$
translation: 吼喔喔喔！这就是"吼叫"！\p只要气势够足，就连宝可梦也会被吼跑！$

label: Route32_Text_MeetFrieda
source: FRIEDA: Yahoo!\pI'm FRIEDA of the WEEKDAY FAMILY!\nNice to meet you!\pIf you can guess my favorite day,\nI'll give you a reward.$
translation:
金美：呀嚯~！\p我是星期兄弟姐妹中的金美！
初次见面请多关照！\p要是你能猜出我最喜欢星期几，
我就给你一份奖励。$

label: Route32_Text_FriedaGivesGift
source: Here's a POISON BARB for you!$
translation: 这个"毒针"送给你！$

label: Route32_Text_FriedaGaveGift
source: FRIEDA: Give it to a POKéMON\nthat has POISON-type moves.\pOh!\pIt's wicked!\pYou'll be shocked how good it\nmakes poison moves!$
translation: 金美：让学会毒属性招式的宝可梦携带吧。\p哇！\p超厉害的！\p毒属性招式的威力会强到让你大吃一惊哦！$

label: Route32_Text_FriedaFriday
source: FRIEDA: Hiya! What day do\nyou like?\pI love Friday. No doubt about\nit!\pDon't you think it's great too?$
translation: 金美：嗨！你喜欢星期几？\p我最喜欢星期五了！毫无疑问！\p你不觉得星期五很棒吗？$

label: Route32_Text_FriedaNope
source: FRIEDA: Not that one!$
translation: 金美：不是那个啦！$

label: Route32_Text_Sign1
source: ROUTE 32\pVIOLET CITY - AZALEA TOWN$
translation: 32号道路\p桔梗市 - 桧皮镇$

label: Route32_Text_Sign2
source: RUINS OF ALPH\nEAST ENTRANCE$
translation: 阿露福遗迹\n东侧入口$

label: Route32_Text_Sign3
source: UNION CAVE\nAHEAD$
translation: 前方是\n互连洞$

label: Route32_Pokecenter_Text_FishingGuruQuestion
source: This is a great fishing spot.\pYou saw people fishing?\nHow about you?\pWould you like one of my RODS?$
translation: 这里是个绝佳的钓鱼点。\p你看到有人在钓鱼了吧？\n你觉得怎么样？\p想要一根我的钓竿吗？$

label: Route32_Pokecenter_Text_FishingGuruYes
source: Heh, that's good to hear.\pNow you're an angler too!$
translation: 嘿，听到你这么说真高兴。\p现在你也是钓鱼人啦！$

label: Route32_Pokecenter_Text_FishingGuruGiveRod
source: Fishing is great!\pIf there's water, be it the sea or\na stream, try out your ROD.$
translation: 钓鱼太棒了！\p只要有水，不管是大海还是小溪，\n都去试试你的钓竿吧。$

label: Route32_Pokecenter_Text_FishingGuruNo
source: Oh. That's rather disappointing…$
translation: 哎呀。真让人失望啊......$

label: Route32_Pokecenter_Text_FishingGuruAfter
source: Yo, kid. How are they biting?$
translation: 哟，小朋友。鱼上钩了吗？$

label: Route32_Pokecenter_Text_CooltrainerF
source: What should I make my POKéMON hold?\pMaybe an item that increases\nATTACK power…$
translation: 该让我的宝可梦携带什么好呢？\p也许是能提升攻击威力的道具......$

label: Route33_Text_HikerAnthony2Seen
source: I came through the tunnel,\nbut I still have plenty\lof energy left.$
translation: 我一路穿过隧道走过来，\n但还是精力充沛呢！$

label: Route33_Text_HikerAnthony2Beaten
source: Whoa! You've got more zip\nthan me!$
translation: 哇！你比我还要有干劲啊！$

label: Route33_Text_HikerAnthony2After
source: We HIKERS are at our best\nin the mountains.$
translation: 我们登山男在山里\n可是最精神的！$

label: Route33_Text_AnthonyRegister
source: We HIKERS are at our best\nin the mountains.$
translation: 我们登山男在山里\n可是最精神的！$

label: Route33_Text_AnthonyRematchIntro
source: I came through the tunnel,\nbut I still have plenty\lof energy left.$
translation: 我一路穿过隧道走过来，\n但还是精力充沛呢！$

label: Route33_Text_AnthonyRematchDefeat
source: Whoa! You've got more zip\nthan me!$
translation: 哇！你比我还要有干劲啊！$

label: Route33_Text_AnthonyPostRematch
source: We HIKERS are at our best\nin the mountains.$
translation: 我们登山男在山里\n可是最精神的！$

label: Route33_Text_HikerAnthonyDunsparce
source: Hey, did you get a DUNSPARCE?\pI caught one too.\pTake a look at it in the light.\nIt's got a funny face!$
translation: 嘿，你抓到土龙弟弟了吗？\p我也抓到了一只。\p放到光亮的地方看看吧。\n它的长相可搞笑了！$

label: Route33_Text_Lass
source: Pant, pant…\pThat cave was bigger than\nI'd expected.\pI got too tired exploring\nfor MARILL, so I came outside.$
translation: 呼，呼......\p那个洞窟比我想象的还要大。\p为了找玛力露探险累得够呛，\n所以我就先出来了。$

label: Route34_DayCare_Text_Bookshelf1
source: A BABY POKéMON encyclopedia!\pVOLUME 1: ALL ABOUT ABILITIES$
translation: 幼年宝可梦百科全书！\p第1卷：特性大揭秘$

label: Route34_DayCare_Text_Bookshelf2
source: A BABY POKéMON encyclopedia!\pVOLUME 2: TYPICAL TYPES$
translation: 幼年宝可梦百科全书！\p第2卷：常见属性$

label: Route34_DayCare_Text_Bookshelf3
source: A BABY POKéMON encyclopedia!\pVOLUME 3: BABIES' CRIES$
translation: 幼年宝可梦百科全书！\p第3卷：宝宝们的叫声$

label: Route34_DayCare_Text_Bookshelf4
source: A BABY POKéMON encyclopedia!\pVOLUME 4: ADORABLE ACTIONS$
translation: 幼年宝可梦百科全书！\p第4卷：可爱的动作$

label: Route34_DayCare_Text_ClerkBefore
source: I'm the DAY-CARE couple's son.\pAn ODD EGG was found with a TRAINER's\nPOKéMON, but they didn't want it...\pI'd offer it to you...\nBut how can I know you'll take good\lcare of it?$
translation: 我是培育屋夫妇的儿子。\p在一位训练家的宝可梦身边发现了\n一颗不可思议的蛋，但他们并不想要......\p我很想把它交给你......\n但我怎么能确定你会好好照顾它呢？$

label: Route34_DayCare_Text_ClerkNoRoom
source: It looks like you can't carry another\nPOKéMON anyway.$
translation: 看来你身上已经带不下\n更多的宝可梦了。$

label: Route34_DayCare_Text_ClerkQuestion
source: Answer this question for me.\nHow do you feel about this ODD EGG?$
translation: 回答我这个问题。\n你对这颗不可思议的蛋怎么看？$

label: Route34_DayCare_Text_Rejection
source: Hmm, I think this EGG isn't for you.\pIt would be irresponsible of me to\ngive out a precious EGG like this\lto someone who isn't as well-read\lon the subject of baby POKéMON!$
translation: 嗯，我觉得这颗蛋不适合你。\p要是把这么珍贵的蛋交给一个\n对幼年宝可梦不够了解的人，\l未免也太不负责任了！$

label: Route34_DayCare_Text_ReceivedOddEgg
source: {PLAYER} Received the ODD EGG.$
translation: {PLAYER}收下了不可思议的蛋。$

label: Route34_DayCare_Text_TakeCare
source: I knew you were the right trainer\nfor the job. Take good care of it!$
translation:
我就知道你是最合适的人选。
请好好照顾它吧！$

label: Route34_DayCare_Text_ClerkAfter
source: We see a lot of those eggs around\nhere.\pSomething was different about that\none, though.$
translation: 我们在这附近见过很多蛋，\p不过那个蛋总觉得\n有点与众不同呢。$

label: Route34_DayCare_Text_Ditto
source: DITTO: Tto!$
translation: 百变怪：呗哆！$

label: Route34_DayCare_Text_ClosedForChallenge
source: Sorry, we can't look after your\nPOKéMON during a party limit\lchallenge!$
translation: 抱歉，在同行宝可梦数量受限的\n挑战期间，我们不能代为照顾你的宝可梦！$

label: Route34_Text_SeeWifeIfYoudLikeMeToRaiseMon
source: I'm the DAY-CARE MAN.\pI help take care of the precious\nPOKéMON of TRAINERS.\pIf you'd like me to raise your POKéMON,\nhave a word with my wife.$
translation: 我是培育屋的爷爷。\p我负责替训练家照顾\n他们珍贵的宝可梦。\p如果你想寄放宝可梦，\n请跟我老伴说吧。$

label: Route34_Text_DoYouWantEgg
source: Ah, it's you!\pWe were raising your POKéMON,\nand my goodness, were we surprised!\pYour POKéMON had an EGG!\pWe don't know how it got there,\nbut your POKéMON had it.\pYou do want it, yes?$
translation: 哎呀，是你啊！\p在照顾你的宝可梦的时候，\n真是吓了一大跳啊！\p你的宝可梦竟然抱着一个蛋！\p虽然不知道是怎么来的，\n但确实是你的宝可梦带来的。\p你想要这个蛋吧？$

label: Route34_Text_YourMonIsDoingFine
source: Ah, it's you! Good to see you.\nYour {STR_VAR_1}'s doing fine.$
translation: 哎呀，是你啊！见到你真高兴。\n你的{STR_VAR_1}精神得很呢。$

label: Route34_Text_IllKeepIt
source: Well then, I'll keep it.\nThanks!$
translation: 这样啊，那我就自己留着了。\n谢谢你啦！$

label: Route34_Text_YouHaveNoRoomForIt
source: You have no room for it…\nCome back when you've made room.$
translation: 你的同行宝可梦已经满了......\n腾出空位后再来吧。$

label: Route34_Text_ReceivedEgg
source: {PLAYER} received the EGG from\nthe DAY-CARE MAN.$
translation: {PLAYER}从培育屋爷爷那里\n收到了蛋！$

label: Route34_Text_TakeGoodCareOfIt
source: Take good care of it.$
translation: 要好好照顾它哦。$

label: Route34_Text_FriendlyWithOtherTrainersMon
source: By the way, about your {STR_VAR_1},\nit seemed to be friendly with\l{STR_VAR_2}'s {STR_VAR_3}.\pI may even have seen it receiving\na piece of MAIL.$
translation: 顺便说一下你的{STR_VAR_1}，\n它和{STR_VAR_2}的{STR_VAR_3}\l相处得挺不错呢。\p我好像还看到它收到了\n一封邮件呢。$

label: Route34_Text_SeeWifeIfYouWantToPickUpMon
source: If you want to pick up your POKéMON,\nhave a word with my wife.$
translation: 如果你想领回宝可梦，\n请跟我老伴说吧。$

label: Route34_Text_YourMonsAreDoingFine
source: Ah, it's you! Your {STR_VAR_1} and\n{STR_VAR_2} are doing fine.$
translation: 哎呀，是你啊！你的{STR_VAR_1}和\n{STR_VAR_2}都精神得很呢。$

label: Route34_Text_IWillKeepDoYouWantIt
source: I really will keep it.\nYou do want this, yes?$
translation: 我真的会自己留着的哦。\n你其实还是想要的，对吧？$

label: Route34_DayCare_Text_WouldYouLikeUsToRaiseAMon
source: I'm the DAY-CARE LADY.\pWe can raise POKéMON for you.\pWould you like us to raise one?$
translation: 我是培育屋的奶奶。\p我们能替你照顾宝可梦。\p你想寄放宝可梦吗？$

label: Route34_DayCare_Text_WhichMonShouldWeRaise
source: Which POKéMON should we raise for\nyou?$
translation: 要把哪只宝可梦寄放在这里呢？$

label: Route34_DayCare_Text_WellRaiseYourMon
source: Fine, we'll raise your {STR_VAR_1}\nfor a while.\pCome back for it later.$
translation: 好的，我们会替你照顾\n{STR_VAR_1}一阵子的。\p过段时间再来领吧。$

label: Route34_DayCare_Text_WeCanRaiseOneMore
source: We can raise two of your POKéMON.\nWould you like us to raise one more?$
translation: 我们一共可以寄放两只宝可梦。\n还要再寄放一只吗？$

label: Route34_DayCare_Text_HusbandWasLookingForYou
source: My husband was looking for you.$
translation: 我老伴刚才在找你呢。$

label: Route34_DayCare_Text_FineThenComeAgain
source: Oh, fine, then.\nCome again.$
translation: 哎呀，这样啊。\n欢迎下次再来。$

label: Route34_DayCare_Text_NotEnoughMoney
source: You don't have enough money…$
translation: 你的钱不够呢......$

label: Route34_DayCare_Text_TakeOtherOneBackToo
source: Will you take back the other one,\ntoo?$
translation: 另一只也要一起领回去吗？$

label: Route34_DayCare_Text_ComeAgain
source: Fine.\nCome again.$
translation: 好嘞。\n欢迎下次再来。$

label: Route34_DayCare_Text_GoodToSeeYou
source: Ah, it's you! Good to see you.\nYour POKéMON can only be doing good!$
translation: 哎呀，是你啊！见到你真高兴。\n你的宝可梦好得不能再好啦！$

label: Route34_DayCare_Text_YourMonHasGrownXLevels
source: By level, your {STR_VAR_1} has\ngrown by {STR_VAR_2}.$
translation: 按等级来看，你的{STR_VAR_1}\n提升了{STR_VAR_2}级。$

label: Route34_DayCare_Text_YourTeamIsFull
source: Your POKéMON team is full.\nMake room, then come see me.$
translation: 你的宝可梦队伍已经满了。\n腾出空位后再来找我吧。$

label: Route34_DayCare_Text_TakeBackWhichMon
source: Which POKéMON will you take back?$
translation: 你要领回哪只宝可梦？$

label: Route34_DayCare_Text_ItWillCostX
source: If you want your {STR_VAR_1} back,\nit will cost ¥{STR_VAR_2}.$
translation: 如果想领回你的{STR_VAR_1}，\n费用是¥{STR_VAR_2}。$

label: Route34_DayCare_Text_HeresYourMon
source: Perfect!\nHere's your POKéMON.$
translation: 好的！\n这是你的宝可梦。$

label: Route34_DayCare_Text_TookBackMon
source: {PLAYER} took back {STR_VAR_1} from\nthe DAY-CARE LADY.$
translation: {PLAYER}从培育屋婆婆那里\n领回了{STR_VAR_1}。$

label: Route34_DayCare_Text_YouHaveJustOneMon
source: Oh? But you have just one\nPOKéMON.\pCome back another time.$
translation: 哎呀？可是你身上只有一只\n宝可梦呀。\p下次再来吧。$

label: Route34_DayCare_Text_TakeYourMonBack
source: Will you take your POKéMON back?$
translation: 要领回你的宝可梦吗？$

label: Route34_DayCare_Text_WhatWillYouBattleWith
source: If you leave me that POKéMON,\nwhat will you battle with?\pCome back another time.$
translation: 要是把这只宝可梦留在我这儿，\n你拿什么去对战呢？\p下次再来吧。$

label: Route34_DayCare_Text_YoullBeLeftWithJustOne
source:
Huh?
Now, now.\pIf you leave that POKéMON with
me, you'll be left with just one.\pYou will be better off if you catch
some more, I dare say.$
translation:
哎？
等等，等等。\p要是把那只宝可梦留在我这儿，
你就只剩下一只宝可梦了。\p依老夫看，你最好多捉几只
宝可梦再来吧。$

label: Route34_Text_YoungsterSamuel_Seen
source: Hey! I'm looking for MANKEY!$
translation: 喂！我正在找猴怪呢！$

label: Route34_Text_YoungsterSamuel_Beaten
source: Beaten by a passing stranger!$
translation: 竟然输给路过的人了！$

label: Route34_Text_YoungsterSamuel_After
source: I'm going to train even harder.\pAfter all, I'm trying to become\na GYM LEADER.$
translation: 我要加倍努力修行才行。\p毕竟我的目标可是成为\n道馆馆主啊。$

label: Route34_Text_YoungsterIan_Seen
source: I'm the best in my class at\nPOKéMON.$
translation: 在班上我和宝可梦是最强的！$

label: Route34_Text_YoungsterIan_Beaten
source: No! There are better trainers…$
translation: 怎么会！还有更厉害的训练家......$

label: Route34_Text_YoungsterIan_After
source: I'm trying hard so I can be the\nstar in my class.$
translation: 我一直在努力，\n为了能成为班里的明星人物。$

label: Route34_Text_CamperTodd_Seen
source: I'm confident in my ability to\nraise POKéMON.\pWant to see?$
translation: 我对培育宝可梦的能力很有自信。\p想瞧瞧看吗？$

label: Route34_Text_CamperTodd_Beaten
source: Did I screw up my training?$
translation: 难道是我的培育方法搞错了？$

label: Route34_Text_CamperTodd_After
source: Maybe I should take one to DAY-CARE,\nor maybe use some items…$
translation: 也许我该寄存在培育屋一只，\n或者用些道具什么的......$

label: Route34_Text_ToddRegister
source: Maybe I should take one to DAY-CARE,\nor maybe use some items…$
translation: 也许我该寄存在培育屋一只，\n或者用些道具什么的......$

label: Route34_Text_ToddRematchIntro
source: I'm confident in my ability to\nraise POKéMON.\pWant to see?$
translation: 我对培育宝可梦的能力很有自信。\p想瞧瞧看吗？$

label: Route34_Text_ToddRematchDefeat
source: Did I screw up my training?$
translation: 难道是我的培育方法搞错了？$

label: Route34_Text_ToddPostRematch
source: Maybe I should take one to DAY-CARE,\nor maybe use some items…$
translation: 也许我该寄存在培育屋一只，\n或者用些道具什么的......$

label: Route34_Text_GinaRegister
source: You're too strong to be a\npractice partner.$
translation: 作为练习对手，\n你强得过头了啦。$

label: Route34_Text_PicnickerGina_Seen
source: Are you a TRAINER?\pLet's have a practice battle.$
translation: 你是训练家吗？\p来打一场练习赛吧。$

label: Route34_Text_PicnickerGina_Beaten
source: Oh, no! I just can't win…$
translation: 哎呀！完全赢不了啊......$

label: Route34_Text_PicnickerGina_After
source: You're too strong to be a\npractice partner.$
translation: 作为练习对手，\n你强得过头了啦。$

label: Route34_Text_OfficerKeith_Seen
source: Who goes there?\nWhat are you up to?$
translation: 什么人？\n鬼鬼祟祟的想干什么？$

label: Route34_Text_OfficerKeith_Win
source: You're a tough little kid.$
translation: 你这小家伙还挺厉害的。$

label: Route34_Text_OfficerKeith_After
source: Yep, nothing wrong today.\pBe good and stay out of trouble.$
translation: 嗯，今天一切正常。\p乖乖的，别惹麻烦哦。$

label: Route34_Text_OfficerKeith_Daytime
source: I'm on patrol for suspicious\nindividuals.$
translation: 我正在巡逻，搜查可疑人员。$

label: Route34_Text_PokefanBrandon_Seen
source: I just got my POKéMON back from\nDAY-CARE.\pLet's see how much stronger it got!$
translation: 我刚从培育屋领回了宝可梦。\p来看看它变得有多强吧！$

label: Route34_Text_PokefanBrandon_Beaten
source: Why does it end this way?$
translation: 怎么会变成这样？$

label: Route34_Text_PokefanBrandon_After
source: My POKéMON came back with new moves.\pThat confounded me to no end!$
translation: 我的宝可梦领回来时学会了新招式。\p搞得我都不知道该怎么出招了！$

label: Route34_Text_Sign_IlexForest
source: ILEX FOREST\nTHROUGH THE GATE$
translation:
穿过大门即是
栎树林$

label: Route34_Text_Sign_Route34
source: ROUTE 34\nGOLDENROD CITY - AZALEA TOWN\pILEX FOREST SOMEWHERE BETWEEN$
translation:
34号道路
满金市 - 桧皮镇\p栎树林位于其间$

label: Route34_Text_TrainerTips
source: TRAINER TIPS\pBERRY trees grow new BERRIES\nseveral times a day.\pNote which trees bear which\nBERRIES.$
translation:
训练家小贴士\p树果树每天都会多次
结出新的树果。\p记下哪棵树结哪种树果吧。$

label: Route34_Text_CooltrainerIrene_Seen
source: IRENE: Who are you?!$
