translation: 艾琳：你是谁啊？！$

label: Route34_Text_CooltrainerIrene_Beaten
source: IRENE: Ohhh! You're too strong!$
translation: 艾琳：呜哇！你也太强了吧！$

label: Route34_Text_CooltrainerIrene_After1
source: IRENE: My sister KATE will get you\nfor this!$
translation: 艾琳：我姐姐凯特会帮我报仇的！$

label: Route34_Text_CooltrainerIrene_After2
source: IRENE: Isn't this beach great?\pIt's our secret little getaway!$
translation: 艾琳：这片海滩很棒吧？\p这是我们小小的秘密度假胜地！$

label: Route34_Text_CooltrainerJenn_Seen
source: JENN: What the...?\nWhat are you doing?$
translation:
珍恩：搞什么啊......？
你到底在干嘛？$

label: Route34_Text_CooltrainerJenn_Beaten
source: JENN: So sorry, IRENE! Dear Sis!$
translation: 珍恩：对不起，艾琳！亲爱的妹妹！$

label: Route34_Text_CooltrainerJenn_After1
source: JENN: Don't get cocky! My sister\nKATE is tough!$
translation:
珍恩：别得意！我们的大姐
凯特可是很厉害的！$

label: Route34_Text_CooltrainerJenn_After2
source: JENN: Sunlight makes your body\nstronger.$
translation: 珍恩：多晒晒太阳能让身体变得更棒。$

label: Route34_Text_CooltrainerKate_Seen
source: KATE: I must pay you back for\ntaking care of my sisters!$
translation:
凯特：居然敢欺负我的妹妹们，
看我怎么收拾你！$

label: Route34_Text_CooltrainerKate_Beaten
source: KATE: No! I can't believe I lost.$
translation: 凯特：怎么可能！我居然输了。$

label: Route34_Text_CooltrainerKate_GiveSoftSand
source: KATE: You are so strong.\nWe lost with no excuses...\pHere, take this!$
translation:
凯特：你真厉害。
我们输得心服口服......\p来，把这个拿去吧！$

label: Route34_Text_CooltrainerKate_After
source: KATE: I'm sorry we jumped you.\pWe never expected anyone to find\nus here. You sure startled us.$
translation:
凯特：突然袭击你，真对不起。\p我们完全没想到会有人找到这里来。
你可真把我们吓了一跳。$

label: Route34_Text_Sign_DayCare
source: DAY-CARE\pLET US RAISE YOUR POKéMON FOR YOU!$
translation: 培育屋\p让我们替您照料宝可梦！$

label: Route35_Text_CamperIvanSeen
source: I've been getting POKéMON data off\nmy radio. I think I'm good.$
translation:
我一直在收听收音机里的宝可梦情报。
我觉得我已经很强了。$

label: Route35_Text_CamperIvanBeaten
source: I give!$
translation: 我认输！$

label: Route35_Text_CamperIvanAfter
source: Music on the radio changes the\nmoods of wild POKéMON.$
translation:
收音机里的音乐
能改变野生宝可梦的心情。$

label: Route35_Text_CamperElliotSeen
source: I'm gonna show my girlfriend I'm\nhot stuff!$
translation:
我要让我女朋友看看，
我有多帅气！$

label: Route35_Text_CamperElliotBeaten
source: I wish you would have lost for me…$
translation: 真希望你能故意输给我啊......$

label: Route35_Text_CamperElliotAfter
source: I was humiliated in front of my\ngirlfriend…$
translation: 在女朋友面前丢大人了......$

label: Route35_Text_PicnickerBrookeSeen
source: My boyfriend's weak, so I can't rely\non him.$
translation:
我男朋友太弱了，
根本靠不住。$

label: Route35_Text_PicnickerBrookeBeaten
source: Oh, my! You're so strong!$
translation: 哎呀！你好强啊！$

label: Route35_Text_PicnickerBrookeAfter
source: I can count on my POKéMON more than\nmy boyfriend.$
translation:
比起我男朋友，
还是我的宝可梦更靠得住。$

label: Route35_Text_PicnickerKimSeen
source: Are you going to the GYM? Me too!$
translation: 你也是要去道馆吗？我也是！$

label: Route35_Text_PicnickerKimBeaten
source: Oh. I couldn't win…$
translation: 哎呀。没赢过呢......$

label: Route35_Text_PicnickerKimAfter
source: The GYM BADGES are pretty. I collect\nthem.$
translation:
道馆徽章真好看，
我一直在收集呢。$

label: Route35_Text_BirdKeeperBryanSeen
source: What kinds of BALLS do you use?$
translation: 你平时都用些什么球呀？$

label: Route35_Text_BirdKeeperBryanBeaten
source: Yikes! Not fast enough!$
translation: 呀！速度还不够快！$

label: Route35_Text_BirdKeeperBryanAfter
source: Some POKéMON flee right away.\pTry catching them with KURT's\nFAST BALL.\pWhenever I find a ASPEAR BERRY, I\ntake it to KURT.\pHe turns it into a custom BALL.$
translation:
有的宝可梦一转眼就逃跑了。\p用钢铁先生做的
速度球试试看吧。\p我只要一找到生梨果，就会
拿去给钢铁先生。\p他会帮我做成特制的球哦。$

label: Route35_Text_JugglerIrwinSeen
source: Behold my graceful BALL dexterity!$
translation: 见识见识我优雅的控球杂耍吧！$

label: Route35_Text_JugglerIrwinBeaten
source: Whew! That was a jolt!$
translation: 呼！真是被震撼到了！$

label: Route35_Text_JugglerIrwinAfter
source: I was going to dazzle you with my\nprize POKéMON.\pBut your prowess electrified me!$
translation:
我本想用我得意的宝可梦
让你大开眼界的，\p结果却被你的实力彻底震撼到了！$

label: Route35_Text_BugCatcherArnieSeen
source: I'll go anywhere if bug POKéMON\nappear there.$
translation:
只要有虫宝可梦出现，
天涯海角我都去！$

label: Route35_Text_BugCatcherArnieBeaten
source: Huh? I shouldn't have lost that…$
translation: 咦？我不该输的呀......$

label: Route35_Text_BugCatcherArnieAfter
source: My VENONAT won me the Bug-Catching\nContest at the NATIONAL PARK.$
translation:
我的毛球曾在自然公园的
捕虫大赛上拿过优胜呢。$

label: Route35_Text_IrwinRegister
source: I was going to dazzle you with my\nprize POKéMON.\pBut your prowess electrified me!$
translation:
我本想用我得意的宝可梦
让你大开眼界的，\p结果却被你的实力彻底震撼到了！$

label: Route35_Text_ArnieRegister
source: My VENONAT won me the Bug-Catching\nContest at the NATIONAL PARK.$
translation:
我的毛球曾在自然公园的
捕虫大赛上拿过优胜呢。$

label: Route35_Text_ArnieRematchIntro
source: I'll go anywhere if bug POKéMON\nappear there.$
translation:
只要有虫宝可梦出现，
天涯海角我都去！$

label: Route35_Text_ArnieRematchDefeat
source: Huh? I shouldn't have lost that…$
translation: 咦？我不该输的呀......$

label: Route35_Text_ArniePostRematch
source: My VENONAT won me the Bug-Catching\nContest at the NATIONAL PARK.$
translation:
我的毛球曾在自然公园的
捕虫大赛上拿过优胜呢。$

label: Route35_Text_BugCatcherArnieYanma
source: Wow… Look at all those YANMA!\pI'm so blown away, I can't move.$
translation: 哇......看那些蜻蜻蜓！\p太震撼了，我都看呆了。$

label: Route35_Text_FirebreatherWaltSeen
source: I'm practicing my fire breathing.$
translation: 我正在练习喷火呢。$

label: Route35_Text_FirebreatherWaltBeaten
source: Ow! I scorched the tip of my nose!$
translation: 好烫！把鼻尖给烧到了！$

label: Route35_Text_FirebreatherWaltAfter
source: The POKéMON March on the radio\nlures wild POKéMON.$
translation:
收音机里的宝可梦进行曲
能把野生宝可梦引出来哦。$

label: Route35_Text_OfficerDirkSeen
source: Danger lurks in the night!$
translation: 夜晚可是危机四伏的！$

label: Route35_Text_OfficerDirkBeaten
source: Whoops!$
translation: 哎呀！$

label: Route35_Text_OfficerDirkAfter
source: You know, night time is fun in its\nown ways.\pBut don't overdo it, OK?$
translation: 夜晚其实也有别样的乐趣。\p但可别玩得太疯了，好吗？$

label: Route35_Text_OfficerDirkTough
source: Your POKéMON look pretty tough.\pYou could go anywhere safely.$
translation: 你的宝可梦看起来挺强悍的嘛。\p去哪儿应该都很安全。$

label: Route35_Text_Sign
source: ROUTE 35$
translation: 35号道路$

label: Route35_Text_Sign2
source: NATIONAL PARK GATE$
translation: 自然公园 大门$

label: Route36_Text_UseSquirtbottle
source: Use SQUIRTBOTTLE?$
translation: 要使用杰尼龟喷壶吗？$

label: Route36_Text_UsedSquirtbottle
source: {PLAYER} used the SQUIRTBOTTLE.$
translation: {PLAYER}使用了杰尼龟喷壶。$

label: Route36_Text_SudowoodoAttacked
source: The weird tree doesn't like the\nSQUIRTBOTTLE!\pThe weird tree attacked!$
translation: 奇怪的树好像很讨厌\n杰尼龟喷壶！\p奇怪的树袭击过来了！$

label: Route36_Text_RockSmashGuy1
source: Wa-hey!\pI was going to snap that tree\nwith my straight-arm punch.\pBut I couldn't! I'm a failure!$
translation: 哇啊！\p本想用我的直拳把那棵树给打断的。\p可我居然做不到！真是太失败了！$

label: Route36_Text_RockSmashGuy2
source: Did you clear that wretched tree?\pI'm impressed!\nI want you to have this.$
translation: 你把那棵讨厌的树搞定了吗？\p真令人佩服！\n这个就送给你吧。$

label: Route36_Text_RockSmashGuy3
source: That happens to be ROCK SMASH.\pYou can shatter rocks with just a\nsingle well-aimed smack.\pIf any rocks are in your way,\njust smash 'em up!$
translation: 那正是招式"碎岩"。\p只要看准了用力一击，\n就能把岩石打得粉碎。\p要是有岩石挡路，\n就尽管把它砸碎吧！$

label: Route36_Text_OddTree
source: A weird tree is blocking the way.$
translation: 一棵奇怪的树挡住了去路。$

label: Route36_Text_Lass1
source: Be careful at night on this route!\pI saw a POKéMON that looked like\nGROWLITHE, but it had a scary aura\lto it.$
translation: 晚上走这条路可要当心！\p我看到过一只长得像卡蒂狗的宝可梦，\n但它身上散发着非常恐怖的气息。$

label: Route36_Text_Lass2_ClearedSudowoodo
source: That odd tree disappeared without\na trace.\pOh! That tree was really a\nPOKéMON?$
translation: 那棵奇怪的树消失得无影无踪了。\p咦！原来那棵树其实是宝可梦吗？$

label: Route36_Text_PsychicMarkSeen
source: I'm going to read your thoughts!$
translation: 我要读取你的心思！$

label: Route36_Text_PsychicMarkBeaten
source: I misread you!$
translation: 居然读错了吗！$

label: Route36_Text_PsychicMarkAfter
source: I'd be strong if only I could tell\nwhat my opponent was thinking.$
translation: 要是能看透对手的心思，我就能所向披靡了。$

label: Route36_Text_SchoolboyAlan1Seen
source: Thanks to my studies, I'm ready\nfor any POKéMON!$
translation: 经过刻苦用功，我对付什么宝可梦都胸有成竹！$

label: Route36_Text_SchoolboyAlan1Beaten
source: Oops! Computation error?$
translation: 糟糕！计算失误了吗？$

label: Route36_Text_SchoolboyAlanAfter
source: Darn. I study five hours a day too.\pThere's more to learning than just\nreading books.$
translation: 可恶，我明明每天苦读五个小时呢。\p看来光死读书还是远远不够的啊。$

label: Route36_Text_MeetArthur
source: ARTHUR: Who are you?\nI'm ARTHUR of the WEEKDAY FAMILY.\pIf you can guess my favorite day,\nI'll give you a reward.$
translation: 阿木：你是谁？\n我是星期家族的阿木。\p要是你能猜出我最喜欢星期几，\n我就送你一件礼物。$

label: Route36_Text_ArthurNope
source: Not quite!$
translation: 不对哦！$

label: Route36_Text_ArthurGivesGift
source: Here. You can have this.$
translation: 给，这个送给你。$

label: Route36_Text_ArthurGaveGift
source: ARTHUR: A POKéMON that uses ROCK-\ntype moves should hold on to that.\pIt pumps up ROCK-type attacks.$
translation: 阿木：让擅长使用岩石属性招式的\n宝可梦携带它吧。\p它能提升岩石属性招式的威力。$

label: Route36_Text_ArthurThursday
source: ARTHUR: I'm ARTHUR of Thursday.\nI'm the fifth son out of seven.$
translation: 阿木：我是星期四的阿木。\n在七兄妹里排行老五。$

label: Route36_Text_Sign
source: ROUTE 36$
translation: 36号道路$

label: Route36_Text_Sign_RuinsNorth
source: RUINS OF ALPH\nNORTH ENTRANCE$
translation: 阿露福遗迹\n北侧入口$

label: Route36_Text_Tips1
source: TRAINER TIPS\nPOKéMON stats vary--even within\lthe same species.\pTheir stats may be similar at first.\pHowever, differences will become\npronounced as the POKéMON grow.$
translation: 宝可梦指南\n即便是同一种宝可梦，能力值也会有所不同。\p起初它们的能力可能相差无几。\p然而，随着宝可梦的成长，\n彼此间的差异会变得越发明显。$

label: Route36_Text_Tips2
source:
TRAINER TIPS
Use DIG to return to the entrance of
any place.\pIt is convenient for exploring
caves and other landmarks.$
translation: 宝可梦指南\n使用"挖洞"可以瞬间回到任何地方的入口。\p在探索洞窟等迷宫时非常方便。$

label: Route36_Text_AlanRegister
source: Darn. I study five hours a day too.\pThere's more to learning than just\nreading books.$
translation: 可恶，我明明每天苦读五个小时呢。\p看来光死读书还是远远不够的啊。$

label: Route36_Text_AlanRematchIntro
source: Thanks to my studies, I'm ready\nfor any POKéMON!$
translation: 经过刻苦用功，我对付什么宝可梦都胸有成竹！$

label: Route36_Text_AlanRematchDefeat
source: Oops! Computation error?$
translation: 糟糕！计算失误了吗？$

label: Route36_Text_AlanPostRematch
source: Darn. I study five hours a day too.\pThere's more to learning than just\nreading books.$
translation: 可恶，我明明每天苦读五个小时呢。\p看来光死读书还是远远不够的啊。$

label: Route36_Text_AlanHasItem
source: Hey! I found something\nwhile studying!\pHere, you can have it!$
translation: 嘿！我在学习的时候捡到了这个！\p来，送给你吧！$

label: Route36_Text_AlanGaveItem
source: I'll let you know if I find\nanything else!$
translation: 如果再找到别的东西，\n我还会通知你的！$

label: Route37_Text_TwinsAnnAndAnne1_Seen
source: ANN: ANNE and I are in this\ntogether!$
translation: 安：我和安妮可是齐心协力的！$

label: Route37_Text_TwinsAnnAndAnne1_Beaten
source: ANN & ANNE: Nnn… A little too\nstrong.$
translation:
安与安妮：呜呜......稍微有点
太强了吧。$

label: Route37_Text_TwinsAnnAndAnne1_After
source: ANN: I can tell what my sister and\nmy POKéMON are thinking.$
translation:
安：我能明白妹妹和
宝可梦心里在想什么。$

label: Route37_Text_TwinsAnnAndAnne2_Seen
source: ANNE: ANN and I are in this\ntogether!$
translation: 安妮：我和安可是齐心协力的！$

label: Route37_Text_TwinsAnnAndAnne2_Beaten
source: ANN & ANNE: Nnn… A little too\nstrong.$
translation:
安与安妮：呜呜......稍微有点
太强了吧。$

label: Route37_Text_TwinsAnnAndAnne2_After
source: ANNE: We share the same feelings as\nour POKéMON.$
translation:
安妮：我们和宝可梦的心情
是一样的。$

label: Route37_Text_PsychicGreg_Seen
source: POKéMON can't do a thing if they are\nasleep.\pI'll show you how scary that is!$
translation: 宝可梦睡着之后就什么也做不了。\p就让我来让你见识见识这有多可怕吧！$

label: Route37_Text_PsychicGreg_Beaten
source: I lost. That's pretty sad…$
translation: 我输了。好难过啊......$

label: Route37_Text_PsychicGreg_After
source: Putting POKéMON to sleep or paralyz-\ning them are good battle techniques.$
translation:
让宝可梦陷入睡眠或麻痹状态，
是极佳的对战技巧。$

label: Route37_Text_Sunny_Meet
source: SUNNY: Hi!\pI'm SUNNY of the WEEKDAY family!\pIf you can guess my favorite day,\nI'll give you a reward.$
translation:
日夫：你好！\p我是星期兄弟姐妹中的日夫！\p要是你能猜出我最喜欢星期几，
我就送你一份礼物！$

label: Route37_Text_Sunny_GiveGift1
source: I was told to give you this if I saw\nyou!$
translation:
别人交代过我，要是碰见你，
就把这个送给你！$

label: Route37_Text_Sunny_GiveGift2
source: I was told to give you this if I saw\nyou!$
translation:
别人交代过我，要是碰见你，
就把这个送给你！$

label: Route37_Text_Sunny_GaveGift
source: SUNNY: That thing…\pUm…\p… What was it now…\p…\pOh! I remember now!\pA POKéMON that knows electric\nmoves should hold it.\pMy sis MONICA said it powers up\nelectric moves!$
translation:
日夫：那个东西......\p嗯......\p......是什么来着......\p......\p啊！我想起来了！\p让学会电属性招式的宝可梦
携带它吧。\p月子姐姐说它能提升
电属性招式的威力！$

label: Route37_Text_Sunny_Sunday
source: SUNNY: My sisters and brothers are\nMONICA, TUSCANY, WESLEY, ARTHUR,\lFRIEDA and SANTOS.\pThey're all older than me!$
translation:
日夫：我的哥哥姐姐们是
月子、火男、水木、木男、\l金美和土子。\p他们都比我大！$

label: Route37_Text_Sunny_NotSunday
source: SUNNY: Isn't today Sunday?\nUm… I forgot!$
translation:
日夫：今天不是星期天吗？
唔......我忘了！$

label: Route37_Text_Sign
source: ROUTE 37\nECRUTEAK CITY AHEAD$
translation:
37号道路
前方为圆朱市$

label: Route38_Text_BirdKeeperTobySeen
source: Fly high into the sky,\nmy beloved bird POKéMON!$
translation:
向着天空高高飞翔吧，
我心爱的鸟宝可梦！$

label: Route38_Text_BirdKeeperTobyBeaten
source: I feel like just flying\naway now.$
translation:
现在我也想直接
飞走算了。$

label: Route38_Text_BirdKeeperTobyAfter
source: I plan to train in CIANWOOD CITY\nto teach my POKéMON how to FLY.$
translation:
我打算去湛蓝市修行，
去教会我的宝可梦"飞翔"。$

label: Route38_Text_SchoolboyChad1Seen
source: Let me try something\nI learned today.$
translation:
让我来试试
今天学到的东西吧。$

label: Route38_Text_SchoolboyChad1Beaten
source: I didn't study enough,\nI guess.$
translation:
看来我的学习
还不够充分啊。$

label: Route38_Text_SchoolboyChadAfter
source: I have to take so many\ntests, I don't have much\ltime for POKéMON.\pSo when I do get to play,\nI really concentrate.$
translation:
我得应付好多考试，所以没有
太多时间留给宝可梦。\p因此每次有机会玩的时候，
我都格外专注。$

label: Route38_Text_ChadRegister
source: I have to take so many\ntests, I don't have much\ltime for POKéMON.\pSo when I do get to play,\nI really concentrate.$
translation:
我得应付好多考试，所以没有
太多时间留给宝可梦。\p因此每次有机会玩的时候，
我都格外专注。$

label: Route38_Text_ChadRematchIntro
source: Let me try something\nI learned today.$
translation:
让我来试试
今天学到的东西吧。$

label: Route38_Text_ChadRematchDefeat
source: I didn't study enough,\nI guess.$
translation:
看来我的学习
还不够充分啊。$

label: Route38_Text_ChadPostRematch
source: I have to take so many\ntests, I don't have much\ltime for POKéMON.\pSo when I do get to play,\nI really concentrate.$
translation:
我得应付好多考试，所以没有
太多时间留给宝可梦。\p因此每次有机会玩的时候，
我都格外专注。$

label: Route38_Text_LassDana1Seen
source: You seem to be good at\nPOKéMON.\pIf you are, how about\ngiving me some advice?$
translation:
你好像很擅长宝可梦对战呢。\p既然如此，
能不能给我点建议呀？$

label: Route38_Text_LassDana1Beaten
source: I see. So you can battle\nthat way.$
translation:
原来如此。也可以
用那种方式战斗呀。$

label: Route38_Text_LassDanaAfter
source: I know something good!\pMOOMOO FARM's milk is\nfamous for its flavor.$
translation:
我知道一件好事哦！\p哞哞牧场的鲜奶
可是出了名的美味。$

label: Route38_Text_BeautyValerieSeen
source: Hi! Aren't you a cute\ntrainer!\pMay I see your POKéMON?$
translation:
你好！你可真是个
可爱的小训练家！\p能让我看看你的宝可梦吗？$

label: Route38_Text_BeautyValerieBeaten
source: I'm glad I got to see\nyour POKéMON!$
translation:
能看到你的宝可梦，
我真高兴！$

label: Route38_Text_BeautyValerieAfter
source: When I see POKéMON, it\nseems to soothe my nerves.$
translation:
看到宝可梦，
感觉心情都放松下来了。$

label: Route38_Text_SailorHarrySeen
source: I've been overseas, so I\nknow about all sorts of\lPOKéMON!$
translation:
我去过国外，
所以认识各种各样的\l宝可梦哦！$

label: Route38_Text_SailorHarryBeaten
source: Your skill is world class!$
translation: 你的实力堪称世界级！$

label: Route38_Text_SailorHarryAfter
source: All kinds of people around\nthe world live happily with\lPOKéMON.$
translation:
全世界形形色色的人们
都与宝可梦快乐地生活在一起。$

label: Route38_Text_BeautyOliviaSeen
source: Don't you think my POKéMON\nand I are beautiful?$
translation:
你不觉得我和我的宝可梦
都很美吗？$

label: Route38_Text_BeautyOliviaBeaten
source: We drink MOOMOO MILK every\nday.$
translation: 我们每天都喝哞哞鲜奶呢。$

label: Route38_Text_BeautyOliviaAfter
source: MOOMOO MILK is good for\nbeauty and health,\pbut inconveniently, they\nonly sell one bottle at a time.$
translation:
哞哞鲜奶不仅美容还对健康有益，\p不过不太方便的是，
他们一次只卖一瓶。$

label: Route38_Text_Sign
source: ROUTE 38\pOLIVINE CITY - ECRUTEAK CITY$
translation: 38号道路\p浅黄市 - 圆朱市$

label: Route38_Text_TrainerTips
source:
TRAINER TIPS\pIf a POKéMON is trying to
evolve, you can stop it.\pPress the B Button during
evolution to cancel it.\pThat startles the POKéMON
and stops its evolution.$
translation:
宝可梦指南\p宝可梦开始进化时
是可以阻止它的。\p在进化过程中按下B键
就能取消进化。\p宝可梦会吓一跳
并停止进化。$

label: Route38_Text_WaterSign
source: NO SWIMMING OR FISHING.\nWATER FOR FARMING ONLY.\p-ECRUTEAK COUNCIL$
translation:
禁止游泳与垂钓。
本水域仅供农业灌溉使用。\p--圆朱市管理委员会$

label: Route38_Text_DanaRegister
source: I know something good!\pMOOMOO FARM's milk is\nfamous for its flavor.$
translation:
我知道一件好事哦！\p哞哞牧场的鲜奶
可是出了名的美味。$

label: Route38_Text_DanaRematchIntro
source: You seem to be good at\nPOKéMON.\pIf you are, how about\ngiving me some advice?$
translation:
你好像很擅长宝可梦对战呢。\p既然如此，
能不能给我点建议呀？$

label: Route38_Text_DanaRematchDefeat
source: I see. So you can battle\nthat way.$
translation:
原来如此。也可以
用那种方式战斗呀。$

label: Route38_Text_DanaPostRematch
source: I know something good!\pMOOMOO FARM's milk is\nfamous for its flavor.$
translation:
我知道一件好事哦！\p哞哞牧场的鲜奶
可是出了名的美味。$

label: Route38_Text_DanaHasItem
source: Hey! I found something\ninteresting!\pHere, you can have it!$
translation: 喂！我发现了好玩的东西！\p诺，这个送给你！$

label: Route38_Text_DanaGaveItem
source: I'll let you know if I find\nanything else!$
translation: 如果再找到别的东西，\n我还会通知你的！$

label: Route39_Text_BarnTwinMoomooIsSick
source: MOOMOO is sick…\pShe needs lots of ORAN BERRIES.$
translation: 哞哞生病了......\p需要喂它很多橙橙果才行。$

label: Route39_Text_BarnTwinFeedingMoomoo
source: MOOMOO is all better!\nThank you!$
translation:
哞哞已经完全康复了！
太感谢你了！$

label: Route39_Text_MoomooWeakMoo
source: MILTANK: …Moo…$

label: Route39_Text_BarnCryIsWeak
source: Its cry is weak…\nGive an ORAN BERRY to MILTANK?$
translation:
叫声听起来很虚弱......
要给大奶罐一颗橙橙果吗？$

label: Route39_Text_MoomooHappyMoo
source: MILTANK: Mooo!$
translation: 大奶罐：哞--！$

label: Route39_Text_BarnGaveBerry
source: {PLAYER} gave an ORAN BERRY to\nMILTANK.$
translation:
{PLAYER}把橙橙果
喂给了大奶罐。$

label: Route39_Text_BarnLittleHealthier
source: MILTANK became a little\nhealthier!$
translation: 大奶罐稍微恢复了一点活力！$

label: Route39_Text_BarnQuiteHealthy
source: MILTANK became quite\nhealthy!$
translation: 大奶罐恢复得挺有活力了！$

label: Route39_Text_BarnTotallyHealthy
source: MILTANK became totally\nhealthy!$
translation: 大奶罐彻底恢复健康了！$

label: Route39_Text_BarnNoBerries
source: {PLAYER} has no ORAN BERRIES…$
translation: {PLAYER}没有橙橙果......$

label: Route39_Text_BarnRefusedBerry
source: {PLAYER} wouldn't give an\nORAN BERRY.\pMILTANK looks sad.$
translation: {PLAYER}没有给它橙橙果。\p大奶罐看起来很难过。$

label: Route39_Text_FarmerMSickCow
source: My MILTANK ain't givin' me\nmilk no more.\pThis here FARM's got famous milk.\pMost everyone wants a drink.\pIt'll give me lots o' milk if'n\nI feed it lots o' BERRIES,\lI reckon.$
translation:
俺家的大奶罐挤不出奶来了。\p俺们农场的鲜奶可是很有名的，\p大家都争着想喝呢。\p俺琢磨着，要是喂它多多的树果，
它肯定又能产出好多鲜奶了。$

label: Route39_Text_FarmerMBuyMilk
source: How'd you like my MOOMOO MILK?\pIt's my pride and joy, there.\pGive it to POKéMON to restore HP!\pI'll give it to ya fer just\n¥500.$
translation:
要来点俺家的哞哞鲜奶吗？\p这可是俺的骄傲啊。\p喂给宝可梦就能回复HP！\p只要500元，
俺就卖给你一瓶。$

label: Route39_Text_FarmerMGotMilk
source: Here ya go!\nDrink up'n enjoy!$
translation:
拿好喽！
趁新鲜好好享用吧！$

label: Route39_Text_FarmerMNoMoney
source: Sorry, there.\nNo cash, no sale!$
translation:
抱歉啦。
没钱可不能卖给你哦！$

label: Route39_Text_FarmerMNoRoom
source: I reckon yer PACK's full.$
translation: 看来你的背包已经满了啊。$

label: Route39_Text_FarmerMNoSale
source: You don't want it?\nCome again, hear?$
translation:
不想要了吗？
欢迎下次再来啊！$

label: Route39FarmHouse_Text_WouldYouLikeAnother
source: How bout another?$
translation: 要不再来一瓶？$

label: Route39_Text_GotMilk
source: {PLAYER} got MOOMOO MILK.$
translation: {PLAYER}获得了哞哞鲜奶。$

label: Route39_Text_FarmerMMilking
source: I best go do my milkin'.$
translation: 我得去挤奶啦。$

label: Route39_Text_FarmerFInTrouble
source: Our milk even goes out to\nKANTO.\pSo if our own MILTANK won't\ngive us any milk, we're in trouble.$
translation:
我们的牛奶甚至还运往关都呢。\p所以要是我们的大奶罐产不出奶，
那麻烦可就大啦。$

label: Route39_Text_FarmerFHealedMiltank
source: You fixed our MILTANK, hon.\nNow it gives MOOMOO MILK again.\pHere's somethin' fer your trouble.$
translation:
你治好了我们的大奶罐，真是太感谢了。
现在它又能产出哞哞鲜奶啦。\p这点心意请收下，辛苦你啦。$

label: Route39_Text_FarmerFSnatchSpeech
source:
That there's SNATCH.\pIt's a tricky move that lets
a POKéMON steal a foe's move\lright before it's used.\pIf more than one POKéMON use
SNATCH, only the slowest one\lwill end up stealing the move.\pUse it smart, hon. Timing is
everything.$
translation:
那个是"抢夺"。\p这招非常狡黠，可以让宝可梦
在对手使出招式前将其抢先夺取过来。\p如果有不止一只宝可梦使用"抢夺"，
只有速度最慢的那只才能成功抢到招式。\p聪明地使用它吧，时机就是一切。$

label: Route39_Text_ChooseLegend
source: BAOBA: GOOD HEAVENS! Did that\nshadow belong to a POKéMON?\pDid you get a good look at it?\nI can't tell what color it was...$
translation:
巴奥巴：我的天哪！刚才那个影子
是宝可梦吗？\p你看清楚了吗？
我都看不出它是什么颜色的......$

label: Route39_Text_BaobaIntro
source:
How strange...\p...Ohh!
What you are holding is...\lwhat they call... a POKéDEX!\pHaven't seen one of those in ages.\pMy name is BAOBA!
I used to run a SAFARI ZONE in\lFUCHSIA CITY, but it was becoming\lout of date with new entertainment\loptions coming out.\pI decided to go overseas to learn
the newest technology and open a\lstate-of-the-art SAFARI ZONE\lin CIANWOOD.\pIt may be more than a coincidence
that we are chatting.\pWhy don't we register each other's
numbers in the POKéGEAR?\pI can give you a call once the
SAFARI ZONE is open before I call\lanyone else!$
translation:
真是不可思议......\p......哦哦！
你拿着的那个......\l难道就是......宝可梦图鉴吗！\p我真是好久都没见过了。\p我叫巴奥巴！
我以前在浅红市经营狩猎地带，
但随着各种新娱乐项目的出现，\l那里逐渐落伍了。\p于是我决定远渡重洋学习最新技术，
在湛蓝市开辟一个\l最尖端的狩猎地带！\p能在这里和你相遇聊上几句，
这或许是命中注定的缘分呢。\p不如我们在宝可梦齿轮里
交换一下电话号码吧？\p等狩猎地带开业的时候，
我第一个就打电话通知你！$

label: Route39_Text_Registered
source: {PLAYER} registered BAOBA\nin the POKéGEAR!$
translation:
{PLAYER}将巴奥巴
登记到了宝可梦齿轮！$

label: Route39_Text_WillCall
source: BAOBA: I'll let you know\non the POKéGEAR soon!$
translation:
巴奥巴：到时候我会立刻
用宝可梦齿轮联系你的！$

label: Route39_Text_Woman
source: That shadow... Maybe it was a giant\nPIDGEY?$
translation: 刚才那个影子......难道是只巨大的波波？$

label: Route39_Text_Miltank
source: MILTANK: Mooo!$
translation: 大奶罐：哞--！$

label: Route39_Text_SailorEugeneSeen
source: I just got back to OLIVINE.\pSo how about a POKéMON battle?$
translation: 我刚回到浅黄市。\p来一场宝可梦对战怎么样？$

label: Route39_Text_SailorEugeneBeaten
source: Awaaargh!$
translation: 哇啊啊啊！$

label: Route39_Text_SailorEugeneAfter
source: My POKéMON were caught and\nraised overseas.\pThey're my companions on\nthose long voyages.$
translation:
我的宝可梦全都是
在海外捕获并培育的。\p它们是我漫长航海旅途中的伙伴。$

label: Route39_Text_PokefanMDerekSeen
source: This is a good time to brag\nabout my PIKACHU!$
translation: 正好是夸耀我的皮卡丘的好时机！$

label: Route39_Text_PokefanMDerekBeaten
source: I had no time to show off\nPIKACHU…$
translation: 我连展示皮卡丘的机会都没有......$

label: Route39_Text_PokefanMDerekAfter
source: I'm not listening to your\nbragging!\pWe POKé FANS have a policy\nof not listening to bragging!$
translation:
我才不听你的吹嘘呢！\p我们宝可梦发烧友的原则，
就是绝不听别人自夸！$

label: Route39_Text_PokefanFRuthSeen
source: Such darling POKéMON.\pLet's show our POKéMON\ntogether at the same time.$
translation: 多么可爱的宝可梦啊。\p让我们同时亮出各自的宝可梦吧。$

label: Route39_Text_PokefanFRuthBeaten
source: I don't mind losing.$
translation: 输了也没关系啦。$

label: Route39_Text_PokefanFRuthAfter
source: Do you know about baby\nPOKéMON?\pI bet they're just adorable!$
translation: 你知道幼年宝可梦吗？\p它们肯定超级可爱！$

label: Route39_Text_PsychicNormanSeen
source: Let me see what your\nPOKéMON are capable of.$
translation:
让我见识一下
你的宝可梦有几分本事吧。$

label: Route39_Text_PsychicNormanBeaten
source: Ooh, your POKéMON have\npotential.$
translation: 哦，你的宝可梦很有潜力嘛。$

label: Route39_Text_PsychicNormanAfter
source: You know how POKéMON have\ndifferent abilities?\pPeople are like that too.\nEveryone has different\lpotential.$
translation:
你知道宝可梦各自拥有不同的能力吧？\p其实人也是一样的。
每个人都有不同的潜力。$

label: Route39_Text_PokefanFJaimeSeen
source: You came at just the right\ntime.\pLet's battle.$
translation: 你来得正是时候。\p来对战吧。$

label: Route39_Text_PokefanFJaimeBeaten
source: Oh, how disappointing…$
translation: 哎，真让人失望......$

label: Route39_Text_PokefanFJaimeAfter
source:
I met UMBREON at night right
here on ROUTE 39.\pI'm not sure why, but it
seems to like it when I\ltrain here.\pIt seems to become friendlier
by training here than\lanywhere else.$
translation:
我就是在夜里的这条39号道路上
遇见月亮伊布的。\p虽然不知道为什么，
但它似乎很喜欢我在这里特训呢。\p比起在其他地方，
在这里特训好像能让它更亲近我呢。$

label: Route39_Text_Sign
source: ROUTE 39\pOLIVINE CITY - ECRUTEAK CITY$
translation: 39号道路\p浅黄市 - 圆朱市$

label: Route39_Text_MoomooFarmSign
source: MOOMOO FARM\pEnjoy Our Fresh and Tasty Milk$
translation: 哞哞牧场\p请品尝新鲜美味的牛奶$

label: Route39_Text_TrainerTips
source:
TRAINER TIPS\pUse HEADBUTT on trees to shake
POKéMON out.\pDifferent kinds of POKéMON
drop out of trees.\pUse HEADBUTT on any tree
you see!$
translation: 训练家心得\p对着树木使出头锤，\n就能把宝可梦摇下来。\p不同种类的宝可梦\n会从树上掉下来。\p看见树就尽管使出头锤吧！$

label: Route39_Text_DerekRegister
source: I'm not listening to your\nbragging!\pWe POKé FANS have a policy\nof not listening to bragging!$
translation:
我才不听你的吹嘘呢！\p我们宝可梦发烧友的原则，
就是绝不听别人自夸！$

label: Route39_Text_DerekHasItem
source: Hey! I was showing off my\nPIKACHU and found something.\pHere, you can have it!$
translation: 嘿！我刚刚带着皮卡丘\n到处炫耀时捡到了这个东西。\p给你，送你啦！$

label: Route39_Text_DerekGaveItem
source: PIKACHU is it!\nDon't you agree?$
translation: 皮卡丘就是最棒的！\n你也是这么觉得的吧？$

label: Route3_Text_FirebreatherOtis_Seen
source: Ah! The weather's as fine as ever.$
translation: 啊！天气还是这么晴朗呢。$

label: Route3_Text_FirebreatherOtis_Beaten
source: It's sunny, but I'm all wet…$
translation: 虽然是大晴天，但我全身都湿透了......$

label: Route3_Text_FirebreatherOtis_AfterBattle
source: When it rains, it's hard to get\nignition…$
translation: 一下雨，火就很难点起来了......$

label: Route3_Text_YoungsterWarren_Seen
source: Hmmm… I don't know what to do…$
translation: 唔......我不知道该怎么办了......$

label: Route3_Text_YoungsterWarren_Beaten
source: I knew I'd lose…$
translation: 我就知道会输......$

label: Route3_Text_YoungsterWarren_AfterBattle
source: You looked strong.\pI was afraid to take you on…$
translation: 你看起来很强。\p我之前都不敢向你挑战呢......$

label: Route3_Text_YoungsterJimmy_Seen
source: I can run like the wind!$
translation: 我能跑得像风一样快！$

label: Route3_Text_YoungsterJimmy_Beaten
source: Blown away!$
translation: 被吹跑了！$

label: Route3_Text_YoungsterJimmy_AfterBattle
source: I wear shorts the whole year round.\pThat's my fashion policy.$
translation: 我一年四季都穿着短裤。\p这就是我的时尚信条。$

label: Route3_Text_FirebreatherBurt_Seen
source: Step right up and take a look!$
translation: 走过路过，快来看一眼啦！$

label: Route3_Text_FirebreatherBurt_Beaten
source: Yow! That's hot!$
translation: 哇！好烫！$

label: Route3_Text_FirebreatherBurt_AfterBattle
source: The greatest fire-breather in KANTO,\nthat's me.\pBut not the best trainer…$
translation: 关都最厉害的喷火艺人，\n就是本大爷我啦。\p不过可算不上是最厉害的训练家......$

label: Route3_Text_MtMoonSquareSign
source: MT.MOON SQUARE\pJust go up the stairs.$
translation: 月见山广场\p走上台阶即到。$

label: Route40_Text_SwimmermSimonSeen
source: You have to warm up before\ngoing into the water.\pThat's basic.$
translation: 下水之前必须要先做热身运动。\p这可是基本常识。$

label: Route40_Text_SwimmermSimonBeaten
source: OK! Uncle! I give!$
translation: 好啦！我投降！认输了！$

label: Route40_Text_SwimmermSimonAfter
source: CIANWOOD CITY is a good\ndistance away from here.$
translation: 湛蓝市离这里还有一段挺远的距离呢。$

label: Route40_Text_SwimmermRandallSeen
source: Hey, you're young and fit!\pDon't ride your POKéMON!\nSwim!$
translation: 嘿，你这么年轻体壮！\p别骑着宝可梦，\n自己游呀！$

label: Route40_Text_SwimmermRandallBeaten
source: Uh-oh. I lost…$

label: Route40_Text_SwimmermRandallAfter
source: Swimming exercises your\nentire body. It's healthy.$
translation: 游泳可是全身运动，\n对身体很健康的哦。$

label: Route40_Text_SwimmerfElaineSeen
source: Are you going to CIANWOOD?\pHow about a quick battle\nfirst?$
translation: 你要去湛蓝市吗？\p在那之前先来场痛快的对战吧！$

label: Route40_Text_SwimmerfElaineBeaten
source: I lost that one!$
translation: 是我输了！$

label: Route40_Text_SwimmerfElaineAfter
source: I'd say I'm a better swimmer\nthan you. Yeah!$
translation: 论游泳的话还是我更厉害。\n耶！$

label: Route40_Text_SwimmerfPaulaSeen
source: No inner tube for me.\pI'm hanging on to a sea\nPOKéMON!$
translation: 我才不需要游泳圈呢。\p我正抓着一只水宝可梦呢！$

label: Route40_Text_SwimmerfPaulaBeaten
source: Ooh, I'm feeling dizzy!$
translation: 哎呀，头好晕啊！$

label: Route40_Text_SwimmerfPaulaAfter
source: While I float like this,\nthe waves carry me along.$
translation: 像这样浮在水面上，\n海浪就会带着我往前飘。$

label: Route40_Text_Lass1
source: Although you can't see it from here,\nCIANWOOD is across the sea.$
translation: 虽然从这里还看不见，\n但湛蓝市就在大海的另一边哦。$

label: Route40_Text_Lass2
source: I came to OLIVINE by ship to see\nthe sights and soak up the\latmosphere.\pBeing a port, it feels so\ndifferent from a big city.$
translation: 我乘船来浅黄市观光，\n感受这里的港口风情。\p作为一座港口，\n这里的氛围和大都市完全不同呢。$

label: Route40_Text_StandingYoungster
source:
Have you gone to the TRAINER
HILL?\pI think a lot of tough trainers
have gathered there already.\pBut since you have so many BADGES
you shouldn't do badly at all.$
translation: 你去过训练家之丘了吗？\p我想那里一定聚集了好多强力训练家。\p不过你拿到了这么多徽章，\n表现一定不会差的。$

label: Route40_Text_Monica
source: MONICA: Glad to meet you.\nI'm MONICA of the WEEKDAY FAMILY.\pI bet you can't guess my favorite\nday of the week!$
translation: 月姬：很高兴认识你。\n我是曜日七兄妹里的月姬。\p你肯定猜不到我最喜欢星期几吧！$

label: Route40_Text_MonicaGivesGift
source: That's right!\pAs a token of our friendship,\nI have a gift for you!$
translation: 答对啦！\p为了纪念我们的友谊，\n我有样礼物要送给你！$

label: Route40_Text_MonicaGaveGift
source: MONICA: It's an item that raises\nthe power of FLYING-type moves.\pYou should equip a bird\nPOKéMON with that item.$
translation: 月姬：那是能提升\n飞行属性招式威力的道具。\p你一定要让鸟宝可梦携带哦。$

label: Route40_Text_MonicaMonday
source: MONICA: My brothers and\nsisters are all over the place.\pSee if you could find\nthem all!$
translation: 月姬：我的兄弟姐妹们\n分布在各个地方。\p试着把他们都找齐吧！$

label: Route40_Text_MonicaNotMonday
source: MONICA: I don't think today\nis Monday. How sad…$
translation: 月姬：今天好像\n不是星期一呢。真遗憾......$

label: Route40_Text_MonicaNope
source: Not that one.$
translation: 不对哦。$

label: Route41_Text_SwimmermCharlieSeen
source: The water's warm here.\nI'm loose and limber.\pSure, I'll take you on!$
translation: 这里的水温好暖和。\n我筋骨都活动开了。\p好啊，我来跟你切磋切磋！$

label: Route41_Text_SwimmermCharlieBeaten
source: Yikes! I've got prune skin!$
translation: 哎呀！手皮都泡皱了！$

label: Route41_Text_SwimmermCharlieAfter
source: Isn't it relaxing just floating\nlike this?$
translation: 像这样漂浮在水上，\n不是很惬意吗？$

label: Route41_Text_SwimmermGeorgeSeen
source: I'm a bit tired.\nIf I win, lend me your POKéMON.$
translation: 我游得有点累了。\n如果我赢了，把你的宝可梦借我骑骑。$

label: Route41_Text_SwimmermGeorgeBeaten
source: Pant, pant…$

label: Route41_Text_SwimmermGeorgeAfter
source: It's so far to CIANWOOD.\pBut it's no easy return trip\nto OLIVINE either.\pWhat should I do?$
translation: 去湛蓝市还有好远啊。\p可回浅黄市也没那么容易了。\p我该怎么办啊？$

label: Route41_Text_SwimmermBerkeSeen
source: See those islands that are\nblocked by whirlpools?\pThere just has to be a secret!$
translation: 看到那些被漩涡包围的岛屿了吗？\p那里肯定藏着什么秘密！$

label: Route41_Text_SwimmermBerkeBeaten
source: What's the secret to your\nstrength?$
translation: 你强大的秘诀究竟是什么？$

label: Route41_Text_SwimmermBerkeAfter
source: It was a dark and stormy night…\pI saw this giant POKéMON flying\nfrom the islands.\pIt was scattering feathers\nfrom its silver wings.$
translation: 那是一个漆黑而暴风雨交加的夜晚......\p我看见一只巨大的宝可梦从岛上飞了出来。\p它银色的羽翼上洒下点点光芒。$

label: Route41_Text_SwimmermKirkSeen
source: The waves are wild here.\pThey tire you out while\nyou swim.$
translation: 这里的风浪好大啊。\p游起泳来特别耗费体力。$

label: Route41_Text_SwimmermKirkBeaten
source: I'm beat!$
translation: 我认输了！$

label: Route41_Text_SwimmermKirkAfter
source: The currents keep me from\nreaching that island.$
translation:
海流太急了，
我游不到那座岛上去。$

label: Route41_Text_SwimmermMathewSeen
source: Are you seeking the secrets\nof WHIRL ISLANDS?$
translation:
你也是来探寻
漩涡列岛的秘密的吗？$

label: Route41_Text_SwimmermMathewBeaten
source: Ooh, you've got great endurance!$
translation: 呜哇，你的体力真好！$

label: Route41_Text_SwimmermMathewAfter
source: A secret about WHIRL ISLANDS…\pIt's pitch-black inside!$
translation: 关于漩涡列岛的秘密嘛......\p里面可是黑得伸手不见五指！$

label: Route41_Text_SwimmerfKayleeSeen
source: I'm on my way to WHIRL ISLANDS.\pI'm going exploring with friends.$
translation: 我正打算前往漩涡列岛。\p准备和朋友们一起去探险。$

label: Route41_Text_SwimmerfKayleeBeaten
source: Is that how you do it?$
translation: 原来是这么对战的吗？$

label: Route41_Text_SwimmerfKayleeAfter
source: There's supposed to be a big\nPOKéMON deep beneath WHIRL ISLANDS.\pI wonder what it could be?$
translation:
听说漩涡列岛深处
沉睡着一只巨大的宝可梦。\p真想知道它到底是什么呀？$

label: Route41_Text_SwimmerfSusieSeen
source: You look so elegant,\nriding your POKéMON.$
translation:
你乘在宝可梦身上的样子，
看起来可真优雅。$

label: Route41_Text_SwimmerfSusieBeaten
source: I'm crushed…$

label: Route41_Text_SwimmerfSusieAfter
source: Wasn't there a hit song about\na boy riding a LAPRAS?$
translation:
以前是不是有首很火的歌，
讲的是一个乘着拉普拉斯的少年？$

label: Route41_Text_SwimmerfDeniseSeen
source: The weather is so beautiful,\nI'm in a daze!$
translation:
天气这么好，
我都舒服得发呆了！$

label: Route41_Text_SwimmerfDeniseBeaten
source: Ohhh!$

label: Route41_Text_SwimmerfDeniseAfter
source: A sunburn is the worst for skin.\pBut I don't use a sunblock.\pI won't pollute the water.$
translation: 晒伤对皮肤最不好了。\p不过我可不用防晒霜，\p因为我不想污染海水。$

label: Route41_Text_SwimmerfKaraSeen
source: If you need to rest,\njust tread water.\pYou'll get your wind back,\nso you can keep on going strong.$
translation:
要是游累了，
只要踩踩水歇会儿就行。\p缓过气来之后，
就能精神抖擞地继续游了。$

label: Route41_Text_SwimmerfKaraBeaten
source: Oh! You have more energy than I do.$
translation: 哎呀！你的体力比我还充沛呢。$

label: Route41_Text_SwimmerfKaraAfter
source: I heard roars from deep inside\nthe ISLANDS.$
translation:
我听到了从岛屿深处
传来的咆哮声。$

label: Route41_Text_SwimmerfWendySeen
source: At night, STARYU gather near\nthe water's surface.$
translation:
一到晚上，海星星就会
聚集在水面附近。$

label: Route41_Text_SwimmerfWendyBeaten
source: Oh, dear…$

label: Route41_Text_SwimmerfWendyAfter
source: The clusters of STARYU light up\nat the same time.\pIt's so beautiful, it's scary.$
translation:
成群的海星星会
同时散发出光芒。\p美得甚至让人感到有些害怕。$

label: Route41_Text_Tentacruel
source: TENTACRUEL: Cruooo...$
translation: 毒刺水母：咕噜噜噜......$

label: Route41_Text_TentacruelAttack
source: TENTACRUEL: CRUOOOOOO!$
translation: 毒刺水母：咕噜噜噜--！$

label: Route41_Text_TentacruelHeal
source: The TENTACRUEL used RECOVER!\nIt is fully healed!$
translation:
毒刺水母使出了自我再生！
体力完全恢复了！$

label: Route42_Text_EusineAdmireSuicune
source: EUSINE: SUICUNE...\nHow brave it is!\pHow refreshing it is!\nHow beautiful it is!\pAnd how quickly it moves!$
translation:
米那君：水君......
它是多么英武！\p它是多么清澈！
它是多么美丽！\p而且它的身姿是何等迅捷！$

label: Route42_Text_EusineJealous
source:
{PLAYER}!\pYou seem to be around where
SUICUNE would appear.\pWell, that's OK.\lMy desire to search for
SUICUNE is far beyond yours...\pMy grandpa was... quite into
myths.\pI've heard so many stories
about SUICUNE from him.$
translation:
{PLAYER}！\p只要是水君出现的地方，
似乎总能看到你的身影呢。\p不过，这也无所谓。\l我对追求水君的那份执着，
可是远远超越你的......\p我爷爷曾经......对神话传说
非常痴迷。\p我从小就从他那里
听过许多关于水君的故事。$

label: Route42_Text_EusineWontGiveUp
source: SUICUNE...\nI won't stop following you\luntil I've found out what\lyou're after...\pYou hear me!$
translation: 水君......\n在查明你的真正目的之前，\l我是绝对不会放弃追踪你的......\p你听到了吗！$

label: Route42_Text_FisherTullySeen
source: Let me demonstrate the power\nof the POKéMON I caught!$
translation: 就让你见识一下\n我亲手钓到的宝可梦有多强吧！$

label: Route42_Text_FisherTullyBeaten
source: What? That's not right.\nI can't believe this!$
translation: 怎么会？这不对劲啊。\n真不敢相信！$

label: Route42_Text_FisherTullyAfter
source: I want to become the trainer\nCHAMP using the POKéMON I\lcaught myself.\pThat's the best part of fishing!$
translation: 我想用自己钓到的宝可梦\n成为冠军训练家。\p这才是钓鱼最棒的地方！$

label: Route42_Text_HikerBenjaminSeen
source: Ah, it's good to be outside!\nI feel so free!$
translation: 啊，在户外真是舒服！\n感觉好自由啊！$

label: Route42_Text_HikerBenjaminBeaten
source: Gahahah! That was a good\nbattle!$
translation: 嘎哈哈！\n打得真痛快！$

label: Route42_Text_HikerBenjaminAfter
source: Losing feels insignificant\nif you look up at the big sky!$
translation: 抬头望望辽阔的天空，\n输掉比赛也就微不足道了！$

label: Route42_Text_PokemaniacShaneSeen
source: HEY!\pThis is my secret place!\nGet lost, you outsider!$
translation: 喂！\p这里是我的秘密基地！\n闲杂人等快走开！$

label: Route42_Text_PokemaniacShaneBeaten
source: I should have used my\nMOON STONE…$
translation: 早知道就用\n月之石了......$

label: Route42_Text_PokemaniacShaneAfter
source: You're working on a POKéDEX?\pWow, you must know some\npretty rare POKéMON!\pMay I please see it?\nPlease?$
translation: 你在收集宝可梦图鉴吗？\p哇，那你一定认识\n很多稀有的宝可梦吧！\p能让我看看吗？\n求求你了！$

translation: 42号道路\p圆朱市 - 卡吉镇$

source: Hey! I found something\nwhile I was fishing!\pHere, you can have it!$
translation: 嘿！我钓鱼的时候\n捡到了好东西！\p给，这个送你了！$

label: Route42_Text_TullyGaveItem
source: I'll let you know if I\nreel in anything else!$
translation: 要是再钓到什么好东西，\n我会通知你的！$

label: Route43_Text_PokemaniacBenSeen
source: I love POKéMON!\pThat's why I started--and why I'll\nkeep on collecting POKéMON!$
translation: 我最喜欢宝可梦了！\p正因如此我才开始收集，\n而且以后也会一直收集下去！$

label: Route43_Text_PokemaniacBenBeaten
source: How could you do this to me?$
translation: 你怎么能这样对我？！$

label: Route43_Text_PokemaniacBenAfter
source: What else do I like besides\nPOKéMON?\pMARY on the radio. I bet she's\ncute!$
translation: 除了宝可梦我还喜欢什么？\p当然是收音机里的玛丽啦。\n她一定超级可爱！$

label: Route43_Text_PokemaniacBrentSeen
source: Hey! Do you have any rare\nPOKéMON?$
translation: 嘿！\n你有稀有的宝可梦吗？$

label: Route43_Text_PokemaniacBrentBeaten
source: Oh, my poor POKéMON! Darlings!$
translation: 噢，我可怜的宝可梦！宝贝们！$

label: Route43_Text_PokemaniacBrentAfter
source: I'd be happy just to own a single\nrare POKéMON.$
translation: 哪怕只要有一只\n稀有的宝可梦，我就心满意足了。$

label: Route43_Text_BrentRegister
source: I'd be happy just to own a single\nrare POKéMON.$
translation: 哪怕只要有一只\n稀有的宝可梦，我就心满意足了。$

label: Route43_Text_PokemaniacRonSeen
source: Would you get this?\pSome {RIVAL} guy made fun of my\nPOKéMON!\pDarn it! My POKéMON's great!$
translation: 你能相信吗？\p有个叫{RIVAL}的家伙\n居然嘲笑我的宝可梦！\p可恶！我的宝可梦明明很棒！$

label: Route43_Text_PokemaniacRonBeaten
source: My NIDOKING did pretty right on!$
translation: 我的尼多王表现得棒极了！$

label: Route43_Text_PokemaniacRonAfter
source: It's okay for people to like\ndifferent types of POKéMON.\pPOKéMON isn't just about having the\nmost powerful one.$
translation: 每个人喜欢不同类型的宝可梦，\n这本来就很正常。\p宝可梦可不仅仅是\n看谁最厉害而已。$

label: Route43_Text_FisherMarvinSeen
source: I'm in a slump.\pMaybe it's the gear I'm using.\pLet's battle for a change of pace!$
translation: 我最近状态低迷。\p也许是钓具的问题吧。\p来对战一场换换心情吧！$

label: Route43_Text_FisherMarvinBeaten
source: I lost, but I feel better anyway.$
translation: 虽然输了，但我感觉心情好多啦。$

label: Route43_Text_FisherMarvinAfter
source: KURT's LURE BALL is the best for\ncatching hooked POKéMON.\pIt's much more effective than a\nULTRA BALL.$
translation:
钢铁先生制作的诱饵球最适合
用来捕捉钓上来的宝可梦了。\p它比高级球还要有效得多呢。$

label: Route43_Text_CamperSpencerSeen
source: I can do so much with my\nPOKéMON--it's super-fun!$
translation:
我和我的宝可梦能一起做好多事--
真是太开心啦！$

label: Route43_Text_CamperSpencerBeaten
source: Losing isn't fun at all…$
translation: 输掉可一点都不好玩......$

label: Route43_Text_CamperSpencerAfter
source: What is going on at LAKE OF RAGE?\pWe were planning to camp there.$
translation: 愤怒之湖到底出什么事了？\p我们本来还打算在那儿露营呢。$

label: Route43_Text_PicnickerTiffanySeen
source: Are you going to LAKE OF RAGE too?\pLet's play for a little while!$
translation: 你也是要去愤怒之湖吗？\p先来陪我玩一会儿吧！$

label: Route43_Text_PicnickerTiffanyBeaten
source: I played too much!$
translation: 玩得太过火啦！$

label: Route43_Text_PicnickerTiffanyWantsPicnic
source: I'm having a picnic with POKéMON.\pWon't you join us?$
translation: 我正和宝可梦野餐呢。\p你要不要也加入我们？$

label: Route43_Text_TiffanyRegister

label: Route43_TrainerTips
source:
TRAINER TIPS\pAll POKéMON have pros and cons
depending on their types.\pIf their types differ, a higher-
level POKéMON may lose in battle.\pLearn which types are strong and
weak against your POKéMON's type.$
translation:
宝可梦指南\p所有宝可梦的属性不同，
各有优缺点。\p如果属性被克制，即使是等级高的
宝可梦也可能会在对战中落败。\p熟记与自己的宝可梦属性
相生相克的克制关系吧！$

label: Route44_Text_FisherWilton1Seen
source: Aack!\pYou made me lose a POLIWAG!\nWhat are you going to do about it?$
translation:
哎呀！\p你害我的蚊香蝌蚪跑掉了！
你要怎么赔我啊？$

label: Route44_Text_FisherWilton1Beaten
source: Just forget about it.$
translation: 算了，当我没说。$

label: Route44_Text_FisherWiltonHugePoliwag
source: That POLIWAG that got away…\nit was huge.\pI swear it must've been\n16 feet long!$
translation:
刚才跑掉的那只蚊香蝌蚪......
可大着呢。\p我发誓它少说
也得有5米长！$

label: Route44_Text_WiltonHasItem
source: Hey! I reeled in something\nother than a POKéMON!\pHere, you can have it!$
translation:
嘿！我钓上来了个
宝可梦以外的玩意儿！\p来，这个送给你！$

label: Route44_Text_WiltonGaveItem
source: I'll let you know if I\nfish up anything else!$
translation:
要是我还钓到了别的东西，
会再通知你的！$

label: Route44_Text_FisherEdgarSeen
source: I fish until I can't anymore.\pI also battle until I drop.\pThat's my relationship with my\nPOKéMON.$
translation:
我钓鱼直到筋疲力尽，\p对战也是拼到倒下为止。\p这就是我和我的宝可梦之间的
相处之道！$

label: Route44_Text_FisherEdgarBeaten
source: Hmmmm… This isn't right.$
translation: 唔......这不对劲啊。$

label: Route44_Text_FisherEdgarAfter
source: That's 100 wins to 101 losses.\pI won't battle again for a while.$
translation: 这样战绩就是100胜101负了。\p我暂时都不想再对战了。$

label: Route44_Text_BirdKeeperVance1Seen
source: Do you know about the legendary\nbird POKéMON?$
translation:
你知道传说的
鸟宝可梦吗？$

label: Route44_Text_BirdKeeperVance1Beaten
source: Whew! You're hot stuff.$
translation: 呼！你可真有一手。$

label: Route44_Text_BirdKeeperVanceBirds
source: ARTICUNO, ZAPDOS and MOLTRES are\nthe three legendary bird POKéMON.\pI heard there are other legendary\nbirds, though.$
translation:
急冻鸟、闪电鸟和火焰鸟
是三只传说的鸟宝可梦。\p不过我听说，
其实还有其他传说的鸟宝可梦呢。$

label: Route44_Text_PsychicPhilSeen
source: I'm gonna win, for sure!$
translation: 这场我赢定了！$

label: Route44_Text_PsychicPhilBeaten
source: Arrgh… That's a shocking loss…$
translation: 啊......居然输得这么彻底......$

label: Route44_Text_PsychicPhilAfter
source: It's important to have conviction\non your side.$
translation:
无论何时，拥有坚定的信念
都是很重要的。$

label: Route44_Text_PokemaniacZachSeen
source: I'll do anything to get my hands\non rare POKéMON!$
translation:
为了把稀有的宝可梦弄到手，
我什么都愿意做！$

label: Route44_Text_PokemaniacZachBeaten
source: Oooh, your POKéMON are so\nappealing.$
translation:
噢噢，你的宝可梦
真是太迷人了。$

label: Route44_Text_PokemaniacZachAfter
source: If a POKéMON has different colors\nfrom usual, it's more valuable.\pWhat? You mean that's not true?$
translation:
如果宝可梦的颜色和普通的不一样，
那就更有价值啦。\p咦？你说不是那么回事？$

label: Route44_Text_CooltrainermAllenSeen
source: I can tell you're a good trainer\nby looking at you.\pI'm good at POKéMON, and I can\nsee that you are too.$
translation:
我看你一眼就知道，
你是个优秀的训练家。\p我很擅长宝可梦对战，
而且我看得出你也是。$

label: Route44_Text_CooltrainermAllenBeaten
source: Tch! It's a total loss on my part.$
translation: 啧！是我彻底输了。$

label: Route44_Text_CooltrainermAllenAfter
source: Wow. You have a lot of BADGES.\pNo wonder you're so tough.\pI wonder if ECRUTEAK GYM's MORTY\nis still in training?\pHe really hammered me.$
translation:
哇，你收集了好多徽章啊。\p难怪你这么厉害。\p不知道圆朱道馆的小松
还在继续修行吗？\p他之前可把我修理惨了。$

label: Route44_Text_CooltrainerfCybilSeen
source: You look strong.\pGood trainers seek tough\nopponents instinctively.$
translation:
你看起来很强。\p优秀的训练家总是会
本能地去寻找强敌。$

label: Route44_Text_CooltrainerfCybilBeaten
source: Nope! This won't do at all.$
translation: 不行！这样完全不行啊。$

label: Route44_Text_CooltrainerfCybilAfter
source: We all get better by experiencing\nmany battles.\pI battled a lot to become what I\nam today--an elite.$
translation:
经历无数次战斗后，
我们都会变得更强。\p我也是经过了千锤百炼，
才成为如今的精英训练家。$

label: Route44_Text_Sign1
source: ROUTE 44\nICE PATH AHEAD$
translation:
44号道路
前方为冰雪小径$

label: Route44_Text_Sign2
source: ROUTE 44\pMAHOGANY TOWN - BLACKTHORN CITY$
translation: 44号道路\p卡吉镇 - 烟墨市$

label: Route45_Text_HikerErikSeen
source: Be prepared for anything!\pLet me see if your POKéMON have\nbeen raised properly!$
translation:
无论何时都要做好万全的准备！\p让我看看你的宝可梦
有没有被好好培育吧！$

label: Route45_Text_HikerErikBeaten
source: Oh, I lost that!$
translation: 哎呀，我输掉了！$

label: Route45_Text_HikerErikAfter
source: I'll head back to BLACKTHORN's\nICE PATH and train some more.$
translation:
我要回烟墨市那边的
冰雪小径再好好修行一番。$

label: Route45_Text_HikerMichaelSeen
source: Yo! You're spunky! But you know\nwhat?\pWhen it comes to sheer\nspunkiness, I'm the man!$
translation:
哟！你挺有干劲的嘛！不过你知道吗？\p要说干劲冲天，
我可不会输给任何人！$

label: Route45_Text_HikerMichaelBeaten
source: My POKéMON weren't spunky enough!$
translation: 我的宝可梦干劲还不够足啊！$

label: Route45_Text_HikerMichaelAfter
source: Boy, do I love HP UP! Mmmm, yum!\pI keep drinking my POKéMON's!\pI can't help it!$
translation: 哎呀，我真是太喜欢HP增强剂了！嗯~美味！\p我总忍不住喝掉宝可梦的那份！\p根本停不下来啊！$

label: Route45_Text_HikerParrySeen
source: My POKéMON are power packed!$
translation: 我的宝可梦可是充满了力量！$

label: Route45_Text_HikerParryBeaten
source: Wahahah! I'm the big loser!$
translation: 哇哈哈哈！我输得彻彻底底！$

label: Route45_Text_HikerParryAfter
source: I'm not much good at thinking,\nsee?\pSo, I just plow ahead with power!$
translation:
我这人不太擅长动脑筋，
明白吧？\p所以只要靠蛮力一路猛冲就行了！$

label: Route45_Text_ParryRegister
source: I'm not much good at thinking,\nsee?\pSo, I just plow ahead with power!$
translation:
我这人不太擅长动脑筋，
明白吧？\p所以只要靠蛮力一路猛冲就行了！$

label: Route45_Text_ParryRematchIntro
source: My POKéMON are power packed!$
translation: 我的宝可梦可是充满了力量！$

label: Route45_Text_ParryRematchDefeat
source: Wahahah! I'm the big loser!$
translation: 哇哈哈哈！我输得彻彻底底！$

label: Route45_Text_ParryPostRematch
source: I'm not much good at thinking,\nsee?\pSo, I just plow ahead with power!$
translation:
我这人不太擅长动脑筋，
明白吧？\p所以只要靠蛮力一路猛冲就行了！$

label: Route45_Text_HikerTimothySeen
source: Why do I climb mountains?\pBecause they're there.\pWhy do I train POKéMON?\pBecause they're there!$
translation: 我为什么登山？\p因为山就在那里。\p我为什么培育宝可梦？\p因为它们就在那里！$

label: Route45_Text_HikerTimothyBeaten
source: Losses… They're there too!$
translation: 失败......也是无法避免的啊！$

label: Route45_Text_HikerTimothyAfter
source: The best thing to ever happen to\nme was discovering POKéMON.$
translation:
发生在我身上最棒的事，
就是与宝可梦相遇。$

label: Route45_Text_HikerParryGivesIron
source: I just can't find a way to win!\pKeep it up!\pOh, and take this -- it's the\ngift you couldn't take when we\nlast met.$
translation:
我就是找不到获胜的方法！\p继续加油吧！\p哦对了，收下这个吧--
这是上次见面时你包满没能拿走的礼物。$

label: Route45_Text_BlackbeltKenjiSeen
source: I was training here alone.\pBehold the fruits of my labor!$
translation: 我一直独自在此修行。\p见识一下我苦修的成果吧！$

label: Route45_Text_BlackbeltKenjiBeaten
source: Waaaargh!$
translation: 哇啊啊啊！$

label: Route45_Text_BlackbeltKenjiAfter
source: This calls for extreme measures.\pI must take to the hills and train\nin solitude.$
translation:
看来必须采取非常手段了。\p我得隐入深山，
独自闭关苦修。$

label: Route45_Text_KenjiRegister
source: This calls for extreme measures.\pI must take to the hills and train\nin solitude.$
translation:
看来必须采取非常手段了。\p我得隐入深山，
独自闭关苦修。$

label: Route45_Text_KenjiRematchIntro
source: I was training here alone.\pBehold the fruits of my labor!$
translation: 我一直独自在此修行。\p见识一下我苦修的成果吧！$

label: Route45_Text_KenjiRematchDefeat
source: Waaaargh!$
translation: 哇啊啊啊！$

label: Route45_Text_KenjiPostRematch
source: This calls for extreme measures.\pI must take to the hills and train\nin solitude.$
translation:
看来必须采取非常手段了。\p我得隐入深山，
独自闭关苦修。$

label: Route45_Text_KenjiHasItem
source: Hey! I'm taking a break from\ntraining.\pI found something good while I\nwas out. Here, take it!$
translation: 喂！我修行正告一段落呢。\p刚才在外面捡到了好东西。\n来，这个送给你！$

label: Route45_Text_KenjiGaveItem
source: Use it well!\pI need to get back to my\ntraining. Oooooaaarrrgh!$
translation: 好好利用它吧！\p我也得回去继续修行了。\n喝啊啊啊啊啊！$

label: Route45_Text_BlackbeltKenjiMorning
source: I'm going to train a bit more\nbefore I break for lunch.$
translation: 吃午饭前，\n我还要再修行一会儿。$

label: Route45_Text_BlackbeltKenjiNight
source: We had plenty of rest at lunch, so\pnow we're all ready to go again!\pWe're going to train again!$
translation: 午饭时我们休息得非常充分，\p现在已经准备好再次出发了！\p我们又要开始修行啦！$

label: Route45_Text_CooltrainermRyanSeen
source: What are your thoughts on\nraising POKéMON?$
translation: 关于培育宝可梦，\n你有什么心得？$

label: Route45_Text_CooltrainermRyanBeaten
source: You've won my respect.$
translation: 我打心底佩服你。$

label: Route45_Text_CooltrainermRyanAfter
source: I see you're raising your POKéMON\nwith care.\pThe bond you build will save you\nin tough situations.$
translation: 看得出来，你是在用心培育宝可梦。\p你们之间建立的羁绊，\n一定会在关键时刻助你脱离险境。$

label: Route45_Text_CooltrainerfKellySeen
source: What is your battle strategy?\pIt is foolish to use strong moves\nindiscriminately.$
translation: 你的战斗策略是什么？\p盲目胡乱使用强力招式，\n可是很愚蠢的。$

label: Route45_Text_CooltrainerfKellyBeaten
source: Fine. I lost.$
translation: 好吧，是我输了。$

label: Route45_Text_CooltrainerfKellyAfter
source: I'm not in favor of overly\npowerful moves.\pI want to win, but I also don't\nwant to harm POKéMON.$
translation: 我并不赞同滥用威力过大的招式。\p虽然我想赢，\n但我也不想伤害到宝可梦。$

label: Route45_Text_CamperQuentinSeen
source: I'm really, really tough!$
translation: 我可是超级超级强的！$

label: Route45_Text_CamperQuentinBeaten
source: I was tough at the TRAINER HILL…$
translation: 我在训练家之丘的时候明明很强的......$

label: Route45_Text_CamperQuentinAfter
source: Have you been to the TRAINER HILL?\pI never, ever lose there, but…$
translation: 你去过训练家之丘吗？\p我在那里可从来没输过，但是......$

label: Route45_Text_Sign
source: ROUTE 45\nMOUNTAIN RD. AHEAD$
translation: 45号道路\n前方山路$

label: Route46_Text_HikerBaileySeen
source: Awright! I'll show you the\npower of mountain POKéMON!$
translation: 好咧！就让你见识一下\n大山里宝可梦的威力吧！$

label: Route46_Text_HikerBaileyBeaten
source: Mercy! You showed me your\npower!$
translation: 认输了！\n我见识到你的厉害了！$

label: Route46_Text_HikerBaileyAfterBattle
source: It's over. I don't mind.\nWe HIKERS are like that.$
translation: 结束了啊。不过我不在意。\n我们登山男向来都是这么豁达。$

label: Route46_Text_CamperTedSeen
source: I'm raising POKéMON too!\pWill you battle with me?$
translation: 我也在培育宝可梦哦！\p能和我对战一场吗？$

label: Route46_Text_CamperTedBeaten
source: Wha…?$

label: Route46_Text_CamperTedAfterBattle
source: I did my best but came up\nshort.\pNo excuses--I admit I lost.$
translation: 我已经拼尽全力了，但还是棋差一招。\p不找借口--我承认是我输了。$

label: Route46_Text_PicnickerErinSeen
source: I raise POKéMON too!\pWill you battle with me?$
translation: 我也在培育宝可梦呢！\p能和我对战一场吗？$

label: Route46_Text_PicnickerErinBeaten
source: Oh, rats!$
translation: 哎呀，真倒霉！$

label: Route46_Text_PicnickerErinAfterBattle
source: I've been to many GYMS, but the\nGYM in GOLDENROD is my favorite.\pIt's filled with pretty flowers!$
translation: 我去过很多道馆，但我最喜欢的\n还是满金市的道馆。\p因为那里到处都开满了漂亮的花！$

label: Route46_Text_ErinRegister
source: I've been to many GYMS, but the\nGYM in GOLDENROD is my favorite.\pIt's filled with pretty flowers!$
translation: 我去过很多道馆，但我最喜欢的\n还是满金市的道馆。\p因为那里到处都开满了漂亮的花！$

label: Route46_Text_ErinRematchIntro
source: I raise POKéMON too!\pWill you battle with me?$
translation: 我也在培育宝可梦呢！\p能和我对战一场吗？$

label: Route46_Text_ErinRematchDefeat
source: Oh, rats!$
translation: 哎呀，真倒霉！$

label: Route46_Text_ErinPostRematch
source: I've been to many GYMS, but the\nGYM in GOLDENROD is my favorite.\pIt's filled with pretty flowers!$
translation: 我去过很多道馆，但我最喜欢的\n还是满金市的道馆。\p因为那里到处都开满了漂亮的花！$

label: Route46_Text_PicnickerErin2Beaten
source:
Aww… I keep losing all the time!\pI'll just have to try harder!
Anyway, thanks for battling
me again and again.\pHere's that present from the
other time.$
translation: 呜......我怎么总是一直输啊！\p看来我必须更加努力才行！\n不管怎样，谢谢你一次又一次\n陪我对战。\p这是上次说好要送你的礼物。$

label: Route46_Text_Sign
source: ROUTE 46\nMOUNTAIN RD. AHEAD$
translation: 46号道路\n前方山路$

label: Route47_Text_HikerSeen
source: Longing for others is...\nwhat it is. \pBut battles are battles,\nso let's go!$
translation: 想念别人......也就那样吧。\p但对战就是对战，\n放马过来吧！$

label: Route47_Text_HikerBeaten
source: Wahaha!$
translation: 哇哈哈！$

label: Route47_Text_HikerAfter
source: After a battle you should always leave\nwith a parting laugh!$
translation: 对战结束后，就该潇洒地\n大笑着道别嘛！$

label: Route47_Text_CamperSeen
source: I'm not good with large crowds, so\nI'm camping out here with my\lPOKéMON!$
translation: 我不擅长应付人多的地方，\n所以才和宝可梦在这里露营！$

label: Route47_Text_CamperBeaten
source: I should be headed deeper into the\nmountain I guess...$
translation: 我想我该往更深的山里走走了......$

label: Route47_Text_CamperAfter
source: See ya!$
translation: 回见啦！$

label: Route47_Text_Couple1Seen
source: THOM: One plus one is two. But the\ntwo of us together is much\lstronger!\pKAE: The two of us aren't just some\nboring pair!$
translation: THOM: 1加1等于2，但只要\n我们两人联手，就会变得更强！\pKAE: 我们可不是什么普普通通\n的组合哦！$

label: Route47_Text_Couple1Beaten
source: THOM: That wasn't what I expected.\lKAE: You're unusual too!$
translation: THOM: 这可真出乎我的意料。\lKAE: 你也太不按常理出牌了！$

label: Route47_Text_Couple1After1
source: THOM: It seems your power is\nimpossible to predict!$
translation: THOM: 看来你的实力真是难以预测啊！$

label: Route47_Text_Couple1After2
source: KAE: I figured you were an ordinary\nlone trainer. Boy was I wrong!$
translation: KAE: 我还以为你只是个普通的独行训练家，\n真是看走眼了！$

label: Route47_Text_Couple2Seen
source: DUFF: Watching over my girlfriend\nmakes my heart soar!\pEDA: My heart's feelings for my\nboyfriend are as wide and deep\lthe ocean!$
translation: DUFF: 守护着我的女朋友，\n我的心情就会激动澎湃！\pEDA: 我对男朋友的爱意，\n比大海还要辽阔深沉！$

label: Route47_Text_Couple2Beaten
source: DUFF: I was no match for you...\lEDA: You are really something...$
translation: DUFF: 完全不是你的对手......\lEDA: 你真是不简单啊......$

label: Route47_Text_Couple2After1
source: DUFF: Thank you for the awe-\ninspiring battle! Bye!$
translation: DUFF: 感谢你带来如此精彩的对战！\n再见啦！$

label: Route47_Text_Couple2After2
source: EDA: You should really find a\nwonderful partner, too!$
translation: EDA: 你也一定要找一个\n绝妙的伴侣哦！$

label: EmbeddedTower_Text_OldManIntro
source:
Well, hello!\pIt's said that past this hole used to
be a huge tower reaching far into\lthe sky.\pThey say that it was a rather strange
tower with half of it embedded\lin the cliff.\pIt was not just a tall tower reaching
up to the sky, but also reaching deep\ldown underground!\pIt is rumored that it even reached
the bottom of the ocean!\pIn short, the ruins used to connect
the sky, the land, and the sea to\leach other...\pMost of the tower is now crumbled,
and the only things that remain are\lthe entrance and its interior, where\lyou'll see strange patterns.$
translation:
你好呀！\p据说穿过这个洞穴，以前曾耸立着一座
直插云霄的高大巨塔。\p他们说那是一座非常奇特的塔，
有半截甚至嵌在悬崖之中。\p它不仅是一座高耸入云的巨塔，
更是深潜入地底之下！\p甚至有传闻说它一路延伸到了
海底的最深处！\p简而言之，那处遗迹曾经将天空、
大地与海洋彼此连接在一起......\p如今巨塔的大部分都已坍塌，
残留的只有入口与内部，\l在那里能看到一些奇异的纹路。$

label: Route47_Text_Chinchou
source: CHINCHOU: Chou!$
translation: 灯笼鱼：啾--！$

label: Route49_Text_SkylarDefeat
source: OKAY, you can have the PLATE.$
translation: 好吧，这块石板就归你了。$

label: Route49_Text_SkylarAfter
source: As cool as that PLATE is,\nyou earned it fair and square.\pI'll just buy something at the gift\nshop instead.$
translation: 虽然那块石板确实很酷，\n但这是你堂堂正正赢去的。\p我还是去纪念品商店买点别的吧。$

label: Route49_Text_SkylarBeforeBattle
source: What?\pYou want the PLATE?\nIt's an artifact imbued with an\lancient power with a connection\lto the legendary POKéMON?!\pWell now I'm definitely keeping it.\pFine.\pYou'll just have to battle me for it.$
translation: 什么？！\p你想要这块石板？\n这可是蕴含着古代力量、\l还与传说的宝可梦有关的文物啊？！\p那我可就更不能交出去了。\p好吧。\p想拿走就先在对战中赢过我！$

label: Route49_Text_SkylarBefore
source: When I was hitting the slopes, my\nskis snagged on something.\pIt was this strange SKY-blue PLATE.\pI think I'll hold onto it as a\nsouvenir!$
translation: 我在雪道上滑雪的时候，\n滑雪板被什么东西给绊了一下。\p结果就发现了这块奇怪的天蓝色石板。\p我打算留着它当纪念品呢！$

label: Route49_Text_SkierM
source: Hey, watch out for my board!\pWhat? You want to battle?\nNo way, these slopes are too wicked!$
translation: 喂，小心我的滑雪板！\p什么？你想对战？\n才不要，这斜坡太刺激了，我可停不下来！$

label: Route49_Text_KimonoGirl
source: You....\pYou must be {PLAYER}, correct?\nI've heard all about you and\lyour deeds from my cousins\lin ECRUTEAK CITY.\pMy sisters wish to meet with you.\lIf you find the time, please\nseek us out in the town up ahead.$
translation: 你......\p你就是{PLAYER}，对吧？\n我从圆朱市的堂姐妹那里\l听说过关于你的种种事迹。\p我的姐妹们也想与你相见。\l如果有空的话，请去前面的\n城镇找我们吧。$

label: Route49_Text_Sign
source: The sign is faded.\nROUTE 49$
translation: 路牌上的字迹模糊不清。\n49号道路$

label: Route4_Text_BirdKeeperHank_Seen
source: I'm raising my POKéMON. Want to battle\nwith me?$
translation: 我正在培育我的宝可梦。\n想和我对战一场吗？$

label: Route4_Text_BirdKeeperHank_Beaten
source: Ack! I lost that one…$
translation: 哎呀！这局竟然输了......$

label: Route4_Text_BirdKeeperHank_AfterBattle
source: If you have a specific POKéMON that you\nwant to raise, put it out first, then\lswitch it right away.\pThat's how to do it.$
translation:
如果有特别想培育的宝可梦，
先让它打头阵，然后马上换下去。\p这可是培育的诀窍哦。$

label: Route4_Text_PicnickerHope_Seen
source: I have a feeling that I can win.\pLet's see if I'm right!$
translation: 我有种能赢的预感。\p来看看我的直觉准不准吧！$

label: Route4_Text_PicnickerHope_Beaten
source: Aww, you are too strong.$
translation: 啊~你太强了吧。$

label: Route4_Text_PicnickerHope_AfterBattle
source: I heard CLEFAIRY appear at MT.MOON.\pBut where could they be?$
translation: 我听说月见山会有皮皮出没。\p但它们究竟在哪里呢？$

label: Route4_Text_PicnickerSharon_Seen
source: Um…\nI…$

label: Route4_Text_PicnickerSharon_AfterBattle
source: ……I'll go train some more…$
translation: ......我还是再去多修行一下吧......$

label: Route4_Text_MtMoonSquareSign
source: MT.MOON NEW ENTRANCE\nDUE TO CAVE-IN\pWATCH YOUR STEP$
translation: 月见山因塌方开辟新入口\p请注意脚下安全$

label: Route50_Text_BlackBelt1
source: The body must be hardened\nand the mind strengthened\lin the harshest of conditions!$
translation:
必须在最严苛的环境中
磨砺体魄，\l锤炼意志！$

label: Route50_Text_BlackBelt2
source: Phew!\pI'm not as hardcore as he is.\pThere's really not much else\nto do here but train.$
translation:
呼！\p我可没他那么拼命。\p不过在这里除了修行，
也确实没别的事可做了。$

label: Route50_Text_WesselBefore
source:
Incredible, A VOLTORB!\pBut it appears to be made
of... Wood?\pMy hypothesis that this route
would contain many STEEL TYPE\lPOKéMON is disproven yet again.\pBut why else would I have found
this STEEL PLATE here?\pI must collect more data!$
translation:
太不可思议了，是霹雳电球！\p但它看起来居然像是......
木头做的？\p看来我关于这条道路上
栖息着许多钢属性宝可梦的假说，\l又一次被推翻了。\p但如果不是这样，我为什么会在这
捡到这块钢铁石板呢？\p我必须收集更多的数据！$

label: Route50_Text_WesselBeforeBattle
source: You want this PLATE?\nBut I haven't analyzed it yet!\pFine, we will battle for it.$
translation:
你想要这块石板？
但我还没把它分析透彻呢！\p好吧，那就通过对战来决定归属！$

label: Route50_Text_WesselDefeat
source: My hypothesis was wrong...$
translation: 我的假说果然错了......$

label: Route50_Text_WesselAfter
source: Take the PLATE. I don't want to\ntalk about it.$
translation:
把石板拿走吧。
我现在什么都不想说了。$

label: Route50_Text_FinleyBefore
source:
How are the villagers treating
you?\pThey can be very unwelcoming to
strangers.\pBut meeting new people is one
of life's greatest joys.\pOne day, I hope to meet CHAMPION
LANCE.\pHe is a legendary dragon tamer,
much like myself.\lWho am I?\pWell, I am FINLEY, keeper of the
DRACO PLATE.$
translation:
村民们对你的态度怎么样？\p他们对待陌生人可能不太友好。\p但是与新的人相遇，
可是人生一大乐事啊。\p我希望有一天能见到阿渡冠军。\p他是一位传奇的龙使者，
就像我一样。\l我是谁？\p哈哈，我是芬利，
龙之石板的守护者。$

label: Route50_Text_FinleyBeforeBattle
source: I know the KIMONO's have sent you\nto collect these PLATES.\pThey say you are worthy...\nBut can you conquer my dragons?$
translation:
我知道是舞姬们让你来收集这些石板的。\p她们说你很有能耐......
但你能够战胜我的龙宝可梦吗？$

label: Route50_Text_FinleyDefeat
source: My dragons fought well.$
translation: 我的龙宝可梦们表现得很不错。$

label: Route50_Text_FinleyAfter
source: Perhaps you are even strong enough\nto beat LANCE...$
translation: 也许你甚至有实力战胜阿渡......$

label: Route5_Text_UndergroundPathSign
source: UNDERGROUND PATH\pCERULEAN CITY - VERMILION CITY$
translation: 地下通道\p华蓝市~枯叶市$

label: Route5_House_Text_Granny1
source: Eeyaaaah!\pI sense a sinister shadow\nhovering over you.\lTake this to ward it off!$
translation:
噫呀啊啊啊！\p我感应到一团不祥的阴影
正笼罩在你的身上。\l收下这个驱除它吧！$

label: Route5_House_Text_Granny2
source: You were in mortal danger, but\nyou're protected now.$
translation:
你刚才可是命悬一线，
不过现在有它保佑你了。$

label: Route5_House_Text_Woman
source: My grandma is into warding off what\nshe believes to be evil spirits.\pI'm sorry that she startled you.$
translation:
我奶奶特别热衷于驱除
她自认为的恶灵。\p吓到你了真是不好意思。$

label: Route5_PokemonDayCare_Text_WantMeToTakeALookAtYours
source: きみの\nみてみるかね？$
translation:
想看看你的
宝可梦吗？$

label: Route5_PokemonDayCare_Text_CantAcceptMonWithHM
source: わるいけど　ひでんのわざを　もった\nポケモンは　あずかれないなぁ$
translation:
不好意思，学会了秘传招式的
宝可梦可不能寄存在我这里啊。$

label: Route6_Text_PokefanM
source: The road is closed until the\nproblem at the POWER PLANT is\lsolved.$
translation:
在发电厂的问题解决之前，
这条道路一直处于封闭状态。$

label: Route6_Text_UndergroundPathSign
source: UNDERGROUND PATH\pCERULEAN CITY - VERMILION CITY$
translation: 地下通道\p华蓝市~枯叶市$

label: PokefanM_Text_RexSeen
source: My STANTLER is the cutest in the\nworld.$
translation: 我的惊角鹿是世界上最可爱的。$

label: PokefanM_Text_RexBeaten
source: My STANTLER!$
translation: 我的惊角鹿！$

label: PokefanM_Text_RexAfter
source: Look how adorable my STANTLER\nacts!\pIsn't it cute enough to make\nyour heart melt?$
translation: 快看我的惊角鹿有多惹人喜爱！\p是不是可爱到心都要融化了？$

label: PokefanM_Text_AllanSeen
source: My GRANBULL is the cutest in the\nworld.$
translation: 我的布鲁皇是世界上最可爱的。$

label: PokefanM_Text_AllanBeaten
source: My GRANBULL!$
translation: 我的布鲁皇！$

label: PokefanM_Text_AllanAfter
source: Look how adorable my GRANBULL\nacts!\pIsn't it cute enough to make\nyour heart melt?$
translation: 快看我的布鲁皇有多惹人喜爱！\p是不是可爱到心都要融化了？$

label: Route7_Text_UndergroundPathSign
source: What's this flyer?\p… Uncouth trainers have been\nholding battles in the\lUNDERGROUND PATH.\pBecause of rising complaints by\nlocal residents, the UNDERGROUND\lPATH has been sealed indefinitely.\pCELADON POLICE$
translation: 这是什么告示？\p......由于粗暴的训练家们\n在地下通道内肆意对战，\p鉴于当地居民的抗议不断增加，\n地下通道将无限期封闭。\p玉虹警察署$

label: Route7_Text_LockedDoor
source: It's locked…$

label: Route8_Text_BikerDwayneSeen
source: We're the KANTO POKéMON FEDERATION\ntrainer group.\pWe'll drive you under our wheels!$
translation: 我们是关都宝可梦联合！\p让你尝尝被车轮碾压的滋味！$

label: Route8_Text_BikerDwayneBeaten
source: S-sorry!$
translation: 对、对不起！$

label: Route8_Text_BikerDwayneAfter
source: The KANTO POKéMON FEDERATION will\nnever fall!$
translation: 关都宝可梦联合永不灭！$

label: Route8_Text_BikerHarrisSeen
source: The cops shut down our\nUNDERGROUND PATH!\pThat really fries me!$
translation: 条子居然封了我们的地下通道！\p真让人火大！$

label: Route8_Text_BikerHarrisBeaten
source: F-forgive me!$
translation: 饶、饶了我吧！$

label: Route8_Text_BikerHarrisAfter
source: Wiped out by some punk from\nJOHTO…$
translation: 居然被城都来的小鬼给干翻了......$

label: Route8_Text_BikerZekeSeen
source: We're the KANTO POKéMON FEDERA-\nTION!\nRight on!$
translation: 我们是关都宝可梦联合！\n冲啊！$

label: Route8_Text_BikerZekeBeaten
source: Yikes! Sorry!$
translation: 哇啊！对不起！$

label: Route8_Text_BikerZekeAfter
source: We'll try not to disturb anyone\nfrom now on…$
translation: 我们以后尽量不去打扰别人了......$

label: Route8_Text_SupernerdSamSeen
source: How does the MAGNET TRAIN work?$
translation: 磁浮列车到底是怎么运行的呢？$

label: Route8_Text_SupernerdSamBeaten
source: I just want to see the MAGNET\nTRAIN…$
translation: 我只是想看看磁浮列车......$

label: Route8_Text_SupernerdSamAfter
source: The power of magnets is awesome!$
translation: 磁铁的力量太神奇了！$

label: Route8_Text_SupernerdTomSeen
source: Hm… You've got many GYM BADGES.$
translation: 嗯......你收集了不少道馆徽章嘛。$

label: Route8_Text_SupernerdTomBeaten
source: Just as I thought… You're tough!$
translation: 果然不出我所料......你很强！$

label: Route8_Text_SupernerdTomAfter
source: GYM BADGES give you advantages in\nbattles.$
translation: 道馆徽章能让你在对战中占得优势。$

label: Route8_Text_LockedDoor
source: It's locked…$

label: Route8_Text_UndergroundPathSign
source: The flyer's torn.\pIt's impossible to read…$
translation: 传单被撕破了。\p根本没法辨认上面的字......$

label: Route9_Text_CamperDeanSeen
source: I came to explore ROCK TUNNEL.$
translation: 我是来岩山隧道探险的。$

label: Route9_Text_CamperDeanBeaten
source: Whoa! Danger, man.$
translation: 哇！真危险啊，伙计。$

label: Route9_Text_CamperDeanAfter
source: My POKéMON were hurt before even\nentering ROCK TUNNEL.\pI'd better take them to a POKéMON\nCENTER right away.$
translation: 还没进岩山隧道，我的宝可梦就受伤了。\p我得赶紧带它们去宝可梦中心才行。$

label: Route9_Text_PicnickerHeidiSeen
source: Have you ever been to a picnic?\pThey're so much fun!$
translation: 你去野餐过吗？\p野餐可好玩了！$

label: Route9_Text_PicnickerHeidiBeaten
source: Ohhhh!$
translation: 哎呀呀！$

label: Route9_Text_PicnickerHeidiAfter
source: We bake lots of goodies and share\nthem all around.\pThey're delicious!$
translation: 我们烤了好多好吃的点心分给大家。\p味道好极了！$

label: Route9_Text_CamperSidSeen
source: Hey, you! Don't litter!$
translation: 喂，你！不要随地乱扔垃圾！$

label: Route9_Text_CamperSidBeaten
source: I was just pointing out…$
translation: 我只是想提醒一下......$

label: Route9_Text_CamperSidAfter
source: Sorry. You weren't littering. It\nwas my mistake.$
translation: 抱歉，你并没有乱扔垃圾呀。\n是我搞错了。$

label: Route9_Text_PicnickerEdnaSeen
source: People shouldn't leave any litter\nbehind.$
translation: 大家都不应该把垃圾留在这里。$

label: Route9_Text_PicnickerEdnaBeaten
source: Ohh… I lost…$

label: Route9_Text_PicnickerEdnaAfter
source: Conserving energy is important,\nbut the environment is even more\lvital.$
translation: 节约能源固然重要，\n但保护环境更加不可或缺。$

label: Route9_Text_HikerTimSeen
source: She'll be coming 'round MT.SILVER\nwhen she comes…\pMT.SILVER is in JOHTO, right?$
translation: 她翻过白银山走过来，\n当她走过来......\p白银山是在城都对吧？$

label: Route9_Text_HikerTimBeaten
source: I was too busy singing…$
translation: 我光顾着唱歌了......$

label: Route9_Text_HikerTimAfter
source: Battles are about concentration.$
translation: 对战最重要的就是集中精神。$

label: Route9_Text_HikerSidneySeen
source: I'll tell you a secret.\pBut first, we battle!$
translation: 我来告诉你一个秘密。\p不过得先对战一场！$

label: Route9_Text_HikerSidneyBeaten
source: Oh, dang! I lost that…$
translation: 哎呀，糟了！居然输了......$

label: Route9_Text_HikerSidneyAfter
source: The POWER PLANT is across a small\nriver.$
translation: 发电厂就在那条小河的对岸。$

label: Route9_Text_Sign
source: ROUTE 9\pCERULEAN CITY - ROCK TUNNEL$
translation: 9号道路\p华蓝市 - 岩山隧道$

label: Route9_PokemonCenter_Text_Engineer1
source: Sometimes us engineers come here\nfor our break. Or just to get away\lfrom our MANAGER.\pThat guy is crazy.$
translation: 我们工程师偶尔会来这里休息。\n其实就是为了躲开我们的厂长。\p那家伙简直是个工作狂。$

label: Route9_PokemonCenter_Text_Engineer2
source: The POWER PLANT is very remote, so\nI travel far for work.$
translation: 发电厂的位置非常偏僻，\n所以我每天上班都要走很远的路。$

label: RuinsOfAlph_B1F_Text_Presence
source: There is a strange presence here.$
translation: 这里有一股奇妙的气息。$

label: RuinsOfAlph_B1F_Text_Hiker
source: This is a big room, but there's\nnothing here.$
translation: 房间虽然很大，\n但里面什么都没有。$

label: RuinsOfAlph_B1F_Text_Teacher
source: This place has a mystical\nquality to it.\pIt feels sort of ethereal\neven.$
translation: 这个地方透着一股神秘的气质。\p甚至让人觉得有些超凡脱俗。$

label: RuinsOfAlph_B1F_Text_Gramps
source: Ancient buildings are often\ntombs of kings.\pLike the pyramids, for\ninstance.$
translation: 古代建筑物通常是古代君王的陵墓。\p比如说金字塔。$

label: RuinsOfAlph_Lab_Text_Scientist1
source: The RUINS are about 1500 years old.\pBut it's not known why they were\nbuilt--or by whom.$
translation: 这处遗迹大约有1500年的历史。\p但至今仍不清楚是因何而建，\n又是由谁建造的。$

label: RuinsOfAlph_Lab_Text_Scientist2
source: There are odd patterns drawn on\non the walls of the RUINS.\pThey must be the keys for\nunraveling the RUINS' mystery.$
translation: 遗迹的墙上画着奇怪的图案。\p那一定就是解开遗迹之谜的关键。$

label: RuinsOfAlph_Lab_Text_Fossils
source: Fossils found within the RUINS.\nMaybe there are more somewhere...$
translation: 在遗迹内部发现的化石。\n也许在其他地方还能找到更多......$

label: RuinsOfAlph_Lab_Text_DeviceForTalkingToPokemon
source: We're developing a device for talking\nwith POKéMON.\pBut we haven't had much success…$
translation: 我们正在开发一种能与宝可梦\n交谈的装置。\p不过目前还没什么进展......$

label: RuinsOfAlph_Lab_Text_DevelopingNewBalls
source: I'm developing new kinds of\nPOKé BALLS…\pBut I haven't made much headway…$
translation: 我正在开发新型的\n精灵球......\p不过进展不太顺利......$

label: RuinsOfAlph_Lab_Text_WeFinallyMadeNewBalls
source:
We finally made new kinds of
POKé BALLS!\pThe REPEAT BALL makes it easier to
catch POKéMON you've caught before.\pThe TIMER BALL gets better at catching
POKéMON the longer a battle runs.\pBoth are proudly developed by
the DEVON CORPORATION.\pPlease give them a try!$
translation:
我们终于做出了新型的
精灵球！\p"重复球"能更容易捕捉到
曾经捉到过的宝可梦。\p战斗回合数越久，
"时间球"就越容易捉到宝可梦。\p这两款都是由得文公司
引以为傲研发出的产品。\p请一定要买来试试看哦！$

label: RuinsOfAlph_Lab_Text_IMadePokenav
source: I made the POKéNAV!\pAs an engineer, I feel blessed to have\nmade something so great!$
translation: 是我做出了宝可梦领航员！\p作为一名工程师，能做出\n这么棒的杰作，真是无比自豪啊！$

label: RuinsOfAlph_Lab_Text_WowThatsAPokenav
source:
Oh, wow!
That's a POKéNAV!\pIt came about as a result of our
PRESIDENT's desire to learn about\lthe feelings of POKéMON.\pWould you like me to describe its
features in detail?\pNo, no. I think you'll find out just by
trying the POKéNAV out.$
translation:
哇啊！
那是宝可梦领航员吧！\p那是我们社长为了了解
宝可梦的心情，\l倾注心血研发出来的成果。\p需要我为你详细介绍
它的各项功能吗？\p不用不用，我想只要你亲自
用一用宝可梦领航员，就全明白了。$

label: RuinsOfAlph_Lab_Text_DeviceToVisualizePokemonDreams
source: I'm trying to develop a device that\nvisually reproduces the dreams of\lPOKéMON…\pBut it's not going well.$
translation: 我正试着开发一种能把宝可梦的梦境\n具象化呈现出来的装置......\p不过进展并不顺利。$

label: RuinsOfAlph_Lab_Text_DevelopDeviceToResurrectFossils
source: I've been trying to develop a device\nthat resurrects POKéMON from fossils…\pAnd, it's working!$
translation: 我一直在尝试开发能让宝可梦\n从化石中复活的装置......\p而且，它成功运转了！$

label: RuinsOfAlph_Lab_Text_WantToBringFossilBackToLife
source:
Wait! That thing you have there…
Is that a POKéMON fossil?\pWould you like to bring that POKéMON
back to life?\pI can with my newly developed
FOSSIL REGENERATOR.$
translation:
等等！你手上的那个东西......
难道是宝可梦的化石？！\p你想让那只宝可梦
重获新生吗？\p用我最新研发的"化石复原机"，
就能做到哦。$

label: RuinsOfAlph_Lab_Text_OhIsThatSo
source: Oh, is that so?\pMy technological expertise\nis outstanding, I tell you.$
translation: 哦，是这样吗？\p不过我敢说，我的技术水平\n可是出类拔萃的。$

label: RuinsOfAlph_Lab_Text_OhIsThatSo2
source: Oh, you don't have this fossil.\nCome back if you manage to find it.$
translation: 哎呀，你身上没有化石呢。\n如果找到了，欢迎随时再来。$

label: RuinsOfAlph_Lab_Text_TwoFossilsPickOne
source:
Oh, now that's a surprise!
You have more than one fossil?\pUnfortunately, my machine can only
regenerate one POKéMON at a time.\pWhich fossil would you like to
regenerate?$
translation: 哎呀，真令人惊讶！\n你身上带了不止一块化石？\p遗憾的是，我的机器一次只能\n复活一只宝可梦。\p你想复原哪一块化石呢？$

label: RuinsOfAlph_Lab_Text_HandedFossilToResearcher
source: Excellent!\nLet's do this right away.\p{PLAYER} handed the {STR_VAR_1} to\nthe RUINS RESEARCHER.$
translation: 太棒了！\n我们马上开始吧。\p{PLAYER}将{STR_VAR_1}交给了\n遗迹研究员。$

label: RuinsOfAlph_Lab_Text_FossilRegeneratorTakesTime
source:
The FOSSIL REGENERATOR, which I made,
is incredible.\pBut it has one drawback--it takes
a long time to work.\pSo, uh… How about you go for a stroll
and look around for a while?$
translation:
我制造的"化石复原机"
可是非常了不起的。\p但它有一个缺点--复原运转
需要花相当长的一段时间。\p所以，呃......不如你在附近散散步，
四处逛逛消磨一下时间吧？$

label: RuinsOfAlph_Lab_Text_FossilizedMonBroughtBackToLife
source: Thanks for waiting!\pYour fossilized POKéMON has been\nbrought back to life!\pThe fossil was an ancient POKéMON.\n{STR_VAR_2}, it was!$
translation: 让你久等了！\p你的化石宝可梦已经\n顺利复活了！\p从化石里复活的是古代宝可梦，\n它的名字是{STR_VAR_2}！$

label: RuinsOfAlph_Lab_Text_ReceivedMonFromResearcher
source: {PLAYER} received {STR_VAR_2} from\nthe RESEARCHER.$
translation: {PLAYER}从研究员那里\n得到了{STR_VAR_2}。$

label: RuinsOfAlph_Lab_Text_TooManyPokemon
source: Uh-oh, you've got too many POKéMON.\nYou have no room for this one.$
translation: 哎呀，你带的宝可梦已经满了。\n同行队伍里没有它的位置了。$

label: RuinsOfAlph_Lab_Text_DevelopNewPokenavFeature
source: I'm trying to develop a new feature\nfor the POKéNAV…\pBut it's not going well.$
translation: 我正试着为宝可梦领航员\n开发一项新功能......\p不过目前进展不太顺利。$

label: RuinsOfAlph_Lab_Text_WhatToWorkOnNext
source:
Well, now what shall I work on
developing next?\pOur company allows us to make our
inspirations into reality.\pOne couldn't ask for a better
environment as an engineer.$
translation: 好啦，接下来该研发点什么呢？\p在我们的公司，只要有灵感\n就能将其变为现实。\p作为一名工程师，没有比这里\n更棒的工作环境了。$

label: RuinsOfAlph_Outside_Text_Quagsire
source: QUAGSIRE: Quag Quag$
translation: 沼王：吧吧！吧吧！$

label: RuinsOfAlph_Outside_Text_SuperNerdStan_Seen
source: What do you want? I'm studying--\ndon't disturb me!$
translation: 你想干什么？我正在研究呢--\n别来打扰我！$

label: RuinsOfAlph_Outside_Text_SuperNerdStan_Beaten
source: Sorry…\nI'm frustrated by our lack of\preal understanding…$
translation: 对不起......\n我们对这里的真相一无所知，\p这实在让我太焦躁了......$

label: RuinsOfAlph_Outside_Text_SuperNerdStan_After
source: The RUINS are from about 1500\nyears ago.\pNobody knows who built them.\pIt's also not known if the POKéMON\nstatues have any meaning.\pIt's all one big mystery…$
translation: 这座遗迹大约建于1500年前。\p谁也不知道建造者究竟是谁。\p那些宝可梦石雕究竟有什么含义，\n至今也无从得知。\p这里的一切全都是个谜......$

label: RuinsOfAlph_Outside_Text_PsychicNathan_Seen
source: Hmmm… This is a strange place.$
translation: 唔......这里真是个不可思议的地方。$

label: RuinsOfAlph_Outside_Text_PsychicNathan_After
source: I like thinking here.$
translation: 我喜欢在这里思考。$

label: RuinsOfAlph_Outside_Text_MysteryChamberSign
source: MYSTERY STONE PANEL CHAMBER$
translation: 神秘石板房间$

label: RuinsOfAlph_Outside_Text_MainSign
source: RUINS OF ALPH\nVISITORS WELCOME$
translation: 阿露福遗迹\n欢迎游客参观$

label: RuinsOfAlph_Outside_Text_ResearchSign
source: RUINS OF ALPH RESEARCH CENTER\pTHE AUTHORITY ON THE\nRUINS OF ALPH$
translation: 阿露福遗迹研究所\p阿露福遗迹的权威机构$

label: RuinsOfAlph_Outside_Text_Fisher1
source: While exploring the RUINS, we\nsuddenly noticed an odd presence.\pWe all got scared and ran away.\nYou should be careful too.$
translation: 我们在调查遗迹时，\n突然察觉到一股诡异的气息。\p大家都吓坏了，拔腿就跑。\n你也要多加小心啊。$

label: RuinsOfAlph_Outside_Text_Fisher2
source: The RUINS hide a huge secret!\p…I think…$
translation: 遗迹里隐藏着一个巨大的秘密！\p......我是这么觉得的啦......$

label: RuinsOfAlph_Outside_Text_Youngster1
source: There are many kinds of UNOWN, so\nwe use them for our secret codes.$
translation: 未知图腾有好多不同的形态，\n所以我们把它们当作暗号来用呢。$

label: RuinsOfAlph_PuzzleAndRewardChambers_Text_Reward
source: The chamber reacts!\nThe way is open.$
translation: 石室产生了反应！\n道路开启了。$

label: RuinsOfAlph_PuzzleAndRewardChambers_Text_Mon
source: Some kind of ancient sensor.\nWhat is it looking for?$
translation: 似乎是某种古代感应装置。\n它到底在感应什么呢？$

label: RuinsOfAlph_PuzzleAndRewardChambers_Text_Solved
source: The way is open.$
translation: 道路开启了。$

label: RuinsOfAlph_PuzzleAndRewardChambers_Text_Receptionist1
source:
Welcome to this chamber.\pThere are sliding panels that depict
a POKéMON drawn by the ancients.\pSlide the panels around to form
the picture.\pTo the left is a description of
the POKéMON.\pScientists in the lab are examin-
-ing some newly found patterns.$
translation: 欢迎来到这个石室。\p这里的滑块石板上描绘着\n古代人所画的宝可梦。\p滑动这些石板拼出完整的图案吧。\p左边写着关于这只宝可梦的描述。\p研究所的科学家们正在研究\n最新发现的花纹图案呢。$

label: RuinsOfAlph_PuzzleAndRewardChambers_Text_Receptionist2
source: A hole just opened up in the floor!\nI'd better tell the others.$
translation: 地面上突然开了一个大洞！\n我得赶快去告诉其他人。$

label: RuinsOfAlph_PuzzleAndRewardChambers_Text_Receptionist3
source: Now a hole in the wall too?!\nThis is getting spooky.$
translation: 这次连墙上也开了一个洞？！\n真是越来越诡异了。$

label: RuinsOfAlph_PuzzleAndRewardChambers_Text_Kabuto
source: A POKéMON that hid on the sea floor.\nEyes on its back scanned the area.$
translation: 潜藏在海底的宝可梦。\n背上的眼睛会环视周围。$

label: RuinsOfAlph_PuzzleAndRewardChambers_Text_UnownText
source: It's UNOWN text!$
translation: 这是未知图腾文字！$

label: RuinsOfAlph_PuzzleAndRewardChambers_Text_Statue
source: It's a replica of an ancient\nPOKéMON.$
translation: 这是古代宝可梦的模型。$

label: RuinsOfAlph_PuzzleAndRewardChambers_Text_Aerodactyl
source: This flying POKéMON attacked its\nprey with saw-like fangs.$
translation: 翱翔于天空，\n以锯齿状尖牙袭击猎物的宝可梦。$

label: RuinsOfAlph_PuzzleAndRewardChambers_Text_Omanyte
source: This POKéMON drifted in the sea\nby twisting its ten tentacles.$
translation: 扭动着10只触手，\n在海中游曳的宝可梦。$

label: RuinsOfAlph_PuzzleAndRewardChambers_Text_Hooh
source: A POKéMON that flew gracefully on\nrainbow-colored wings.$
translation: 展开七彩翅膀，\n优雅翱翔于天空的宝可梦。$

label: RustboroCity_Text_BrendanPassedBrineyWantToBattle
source:
BRENDAN: By the way, {PLAYER}, I walked
by MR. BRINEY in PETALBURG WOODS.\pI bet he was on his way home to his
cottage by the sea.\p{PLAYER}, how's your POKéDEX?
Have you filled in any pages yet?\pMine rules.\pWant to have a battle to test how
far you've progressed?$
translation:
祐树：对了，{PLAYER}，我刚才在橙华森林
路过哈奇老人的身旁。\p我猜他正准备回海边的小屋吧。\p{PLAYER}，你的宝可梦图鉴收集得怎么样了？
已经登记了不少吗？\p我的可是相当厉害哦。\p要不要来一场对战，
检验一下你成长了多少？$

label: RustboroCity_Text_CitySign
source: RUSTBORO CITY\p“The city probing the integration of\nnature and science.”$
translation: 卡那兹市\p"探索自然与科学相融合的城市"$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_ExplainExpShare
source:
MR. STONE: A POKéMON holding that
EXP. SHARE will be given some of the\lEXP Points from battle.\pIt will get EXP Points even if it didn't
actually battle.\pI would say EXP. SHARE is quite useful
for raising weak POKéMON.$
translation:
得抚社长：让宝可梦携带那个
学习装置，就能在战斗中分得经验值。\p即使没有亲自上场对战，
也能获得经验值哦。\p我觉得学习装置在培育
弱小的宝可梦时可是相当有用的。$

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_ScottMetAlreadyStoneBadge
source:
Hello? Didn't we meet before?
I think back in PETALBURG CITY.\pLet me introduce myself.
My name's SCOTT.\pI've been traveling everywhere in
search of outstanding TRAINERS.\pMore specifically, I'm looking for
POKéMON battle experts.\pOh, what's that?
It's a STONE BADGE, isn't it?\pThat's pretty impressive, I'd say, for
a starting TRAINER like yourself.\pBut, you know, I would've loved to see
you in battle.\pIt's hard to tell what you're like as
a TRAINER from a LEAGUE BADGE.$
translation:
你好呀？我们之前是不是在哪见过？
我想想，是在橙华市吧。\p自我介绍一下，我叫亚希达。\p我一直在周游各地，
寻找优秀的训练家。\p具体来说呢，是在寻找宝可梦对战的高手。\p哦？那是什么？
是岩石徽章对吧？\p对于刚起步的新人训练家来说，
这可真了不起啊。\p不过呢，我其实更想亲眼看看
你对战时的英姿。\p光看联盟徽章，可很难看出
你到底是个怎样的训练家呢。$

label: SafariZone_Text_ForeignFeeling
source: SAFARI ZONE...\nIt makes me feel like I am in a\lforeign country.\pIt brings up a strange feeling.$
translation: 狩猎地带......\n让我感觉就像来到了异国他乡一样。\p真是一种奇妙的感觉呢。$

label: SafariZone_Text_JigglypuffTrainer
source: This SAFARI ZONE is great!\nI just kept going after POKéMON!\pThat made my JIGGLYPUFF upset though.$
translation: 这里的狩猎地带太棒了！\n我只顾着追宝可梦了！\p结果惹得我的胖丁不高兴了。$

label: SafariZone_Text_FirstCatch
source: I have always wanted to catch my first\nPOKéMON at the SAFARI ZONE.$
translation: 我一直都想在狩猎地带\n收服我的第一只宝可梦呢。$

label: SafariZone_Text_SlowpokeFan
source: There are many POKéMON to choose from,\nbut nothing beats the cuteness of\lSLOWPOKE.\pPeople often say that I look like one!$
translation: 这里有很多宝可梦可以选，\n但哪只都比不上呆呆兽可爱！\p大家都说我长得很像呆呆兽呢！$

label: SafariZone_Text_CustomSystem
source: You may be under the impression there\nis a sophisticated system to\lcustomizing the SAFARI ZONE, right?\pThe real truth is that...$
translation: 你可能会觉得自定义狩猎地带\n背后有什么复杂的系统，对吧？\p但其实真相是......$

label: SafariZone_Text_Sign
source: SAFARI ZONE\nThis is where everything is thrilling.\pFeel free to come by and experience\nthe wild!$
translation: 狩猎地带\n处处充满刺激与惊喜！\p欢迎随时前来体验大自然的原野！$

label: SafariZoneGate_Text_VitaminGuruSellWhatYouNeed
source: I'm the ENERGY GURU! I'll go for it and\nsell you what you need!$
translation: 我是能量大叔！豁出去了，\n你需要什么我都卖给你！$

label: SafariZoneGate_PokemonCenter_Text_NPC1
source: Those who come to a POKéMON CENTER\noften take good care of their POKéMON.\pWouldn't you agree?$
translation: 经常来宝可梦中心的人，\n往往都把自己的宝可梦照顾得很好。\p你觉得是不是这样？$

label: SafariZoneGate_PokemonCenter_Text_NPC2
source: After a long walk in the mountains to\nfind a POKéMON CENTER, when you're\ljust about to fall flat...\pThen it feels like you are in paradise!$
translation: 在山路上走了好久，累得快要倒下时，\n终于找到了宝可梦中心......\p那感觉就像来到了天堂一样！$

label: SafariZoneGate_PokemonCenter_Text_SafariSong
