source: Safari, safari, it is so much fun.\nSafari, safari, so interesting, huh!\pSo many POKéMON are waiting for us!\p...That's a song I made up.\nI sing it when I am in the SAFARI ZONE.$
translation: 狩猎、狩猎，真好玩~~\n狩猎、狩猎，真有趣呀~~\p好多宝可梦都在等着我们！\p......这是我自己编的歌。\n来狩猎地带的时候我就会唱呢。$

label: SafariZoneGate_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_BaobaBeachDone
source: Thank you, {PLAYER}!\nHere, take this money to upgrade\lyour SAFARI LEVEL and show me an\lexotic POKéMON from the BRUSH area\lnext!$
translation: 谢谢你，{PLAYER}！\n来，收下这笔钱去提升你的\l狩猎地带等级，接下来再去灌木区\l抓一只稀有的宝可梦给我瞧瞧吧！$

label: SafariZoneGate_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_BaobaBrushDone
source: Thank you, {PLAYER}!\nHere, take this money to upgrade\lyour SAFARI LEVEL and show me an\lexotic POKéMON from the MOUNTAIN\larea next!$
translation: 谢谢你，{PLAYER}！\n来，收下这笔钱去提升你的\l狩猎地带等级，接下来再去山岳区\l抓一只稀有的宝可梦给我瞧瞧吧！$

label: SafariZoneGate_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_BaobaMountainDone
source: Thank you, {PLAYER}!\nHere, take this money to upgrade\lyour SAFARI LEVEL and show me an\lexotic POKéMON from the CAVE area\lnext!$
translation: 谢谢你，{PLAYER}！\n来，收下这笔钱去提升你的\l狩猎地带等级，接下来再去洞窟区\l抓一只稀有的宝可梦给我瞧瞧吧！$

label: SafariZoneGate_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_BaobaCaveDone
source: Thank you, {PLAYER}!\nThat's all I need to see.\pNow that I know what DEVON is up\nto, I'll be able to keep my SAFARI\lcompetitive. Here, take this as a\lreward for your troubles.$
translation: 谢谢你，{PLAYER}！\n我想看的全都看到了。\p既然知道了得文公司的打算，\n我就能让我的狩猎地带保持竞争力了。\l来，拿上这个当作酬谢吧。$

label: SafariZoneGate_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_BaobaWrong
source: That can't be right!$
translation: 这怎么可能！$

label: SafariZoneGate_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_BaobaBeach
source: Ah, {PLAYER}!\pDid you bring an exotic POKéMON\nfrom the BEACH area of the FUCHSIA\lSAFARI ZONE to show me?$
translation: 啊，{PLAYER}！\p你从浅红市狩猎地带的沙滩区\n带回稀有的宝可梦给我看了吗？$

label: SafariZoneGate_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_BaobaBrush
source: Ah, {PLAYER}!\pDid you bring an exotic POKéMON\nfrom the BRUSH area of the FUCHSIA\lSAFARI ZONE to show me?$
translation: 啊，{PLAYER}！\p你从浅红市狩猎地带的灌木区\n带回稀有的宝可梦给我看了吗？$

label: SafariZoneGate_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_BaobaMountain
source: Ah, {PLAYER}!\pDid you bring an exotic POKéMON\nfrom the MOUNTAIN area of the\lFUCHSIA SAFARI ZONE to show me?$
translation: 啊，{PLAYER}！\p你从浅红市狩猎地带的山岳区\n带回稀有的宝可梦给我看了吗？$

label: SafariZoneGate_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_BaobaCave
source: Ah, {PLAYER}!\pDid you bring an exotic POKéMON\nfrom the CAVE area of the FUCHSIA\lSAFARI ZONE to show me?$
translation: 啊，{PLAYER}！\p你从浅红市狩猎地带的洞窟区\n带回稀有的宝可梦给我看了吗？$

label: SafariZoneGate_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_BaobaDeclined
source: What will I do now?\nWe'll never keep up with DEVON!$
translation: 我现在该怎么办？\n我们根本赶不上得文公司啊！$

label: SafariZoneGate_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_BaobaLastMon
source: I can't take your last POKéMON!$
translation: 我不能拿走你最后一只宝可梦！$

label: SafariZoneGate_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_BaobaDone
source:
Ah, {PLAYER}!\pThanks to you, the SAFARI ZONE is
thriving!\pMaybe I should name you OWNER of
the safari zone...\pNo, that would be ridiculous.
Ahahahaha.$
translation: 啊，{PLAYER}！\p多亏了你，狩猎地带现在蒸蒸日上！\p也许我该任命你为狩猎地带的园长......\p不，那也太荒唐了。\n哈哈哈哈！$

label: SafariZoneGate_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_BaobaWelcome
source:
Hi {PLAYER}!
I've been waiting for you.
What do you think?\pThis is a brand new SAFARI ZONE
by the way...\pAnd it's still expanding!\pSo far, we have two zones open
and 4 more on the way!\pEnjoy the SAFARI ZONE! I'll
call you when the other zones\lare ready!$
translation:
嗨，{PLAYER}！
我等你很久了。
你觉得这里怎么样？\p顺便说一句，这是个全新的狩猎地带......\p而且还在扩建中呢！\p目前我们已经开放了两个区域，
还有另外4个区域正在筹备中！\p尽情享受狩猎地带吧！等其他区域
准备就绪，我会给你打电话的！$

label: SafariZoneGate_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_BaobaPokeblocks
source: Oh! I almost forgot.\pPOKéBLOCKS are an essential\nfeature of my SAFARI ZONE, so\lyou'd better have one of these!$
translation: 哎呀！我差点忘了。\p宝可方块是我这狩猎地带的一大特色，\n也是不可或缺的，所以你最好带上这个！$

label: SafariZoneGate_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_Baoba
source: Hi {PLAYER}!\pHow are you enjoying the SAFARI\nZONE?$
translation: 嗨，{PLAYER}！\p狩猎地带玩得开心吗？$

label: SafariZoneGate_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_Boy
source:
Do you know about POKéBLOCK
feeders?\pPutting a POKéBLOCK in the feeder
brings out POKéMON with HIDDEN\lABILITIES!\pThe type of POKéBLOCK also affects
the POKéMON's nature.\pAnd best of all, the type of POKéBLOCK
you use can attract POKéMON with\lperfect IVs!\pThose charts on the wall have all
the details.$
translation:
你知道宝可方块喂食器吗？\p只要把宝可方块放进喂食器里，
就能引出拥有隐藏特性的宝可梦哦！\p宝可方块的种类还会影响
宝可梦的性格。\p更棒的是，根据使用的宝可方块种类，
还能吸引到满个体值的宝可梦呢！\p墙上的图表写满了详细信息。$

label: SafariZoneGate_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_BoyGiveCase
source: Here, you seem like you need this.$
translation: 来，这个你好像用得上。$

label: SafariZoneGate_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_Engineer
source: Sorry Trainer, this area is still\nunder construction. Check back\llater!$
translation: 训练家，抱歉啦！这里还在\n施工中呢。过一阵子再来看看吧！$

label: SafariZone_East_Text_KeepAnyItemFoundOnSafari
source: You can keep any item you find in\nthe SAFARI ZONE.\pBut, you'll run out of time if you\ntry for all of them at once.$
translation: 你在狩猎地带里捡到的道具\n都可以带走哦。\p不过要是想一次把所有道具都捡光，\n时间可是会不够用的。$

label: CopycatsHouse1F_Text_PokefanM
source: My daughter likes to mimic people.\pHer mimicry has earned her the\nnickname COPYCAT around here.$
translation: 我的女儿很喜欢模仿别人。\p因为太擅长模仿，大家背地里都\n叫她"模仿少女"呢。$

label: CopycatsHouse1F_Text_PokefanF
source: My daughter is so self-centered…\pShe only has a few friends.$
translation: 我女儿太以自我为中心了......\p所以她朋友少得可怜。$

label: CopycatsHouse1F_Text_PokefanF_ReturnedPart
source: She recently lost the POKé DOLL\nthat a boy gave her three years\lago.\pEver since then, she's gotten even\nbetter at mimicry…$
translation: 她最近弄丢了三年前一个男孩子\n送给她的宝可梦玩偶。\p从那以后，她的模仿技术\n反而变得更加炉火纯青了......$

label: CopycatsHouse1F_Text_Blissey
source: BLISSEY: Bliisii!$
translation: 幸福蛋：波哩嘻--！$

label: Copycat_Text_Male_1
source: {PLAYER}: Hi! Do you like POKéMON?\p{PLAYER}: Uh, no, I just asked you.\p{PLAYER}: Huh? You're strange!$
translation: {PLAYER}：你好！你喜欢宝可梦吗？\p{PLAYER}：呃，不对，是我在问你呢。\p{PLAYER}：咦？你这人好奇怪啊！$

label: Copycat_Text_QuickMimicking
source: COPYCAT: Hmm? Quit mimicking?\pBut that's my favorite hobby!$
translation: 模仿少女：嗯？叫我别模仿了？\p可这是我最大的爱好呀！$

label: Copycat_Text_Male_2
source:
{PLAYER}: Hi! I heard that you
lost your favorite POKé DOLL.\p{PLAYER}: If I find it, you'll give
me a rail PASS?\p{PLAYER}: I'll go find it for you.\pYou think you lost it when you
went to VERMILION CITY?$
translation: {PLAYER}：你好！听说你弄丢了\n最喜欢的宝可梦玩偶？\p{PLAYER}：如果我能帮你找到，\n你就会送我磁悬浮列车乘车票？\p{PLAYER}：我去帮你找回来吧。\p你觉得是去枯叶市的时候弄丢的吗？$

label: Copycat_Text_Worried
source: COPYCAT: Pardon?\pI shouldn't decide what you\nshould do?\pBut I'm really worried… What if\nsomeone finds it?$
translation: 模仿少女：你说什么？\p我不该擅自替你做决定？\p可我真的好担心啊......万一被别人\n捡走了怎么办？$

label: Copycat_Text_GiveDoll
source: COPYCAT: Yay! That's my CLEFAIRY\nPOKé DOLL!\pSee the tear where the right leg\nis sewn on? That's proof!$
translation: 模仿少女：太棒啦！这是我的皮皮玩偶！\p看到右腿缝补过的痕迹了吗？\n这就是证据！$

label: Copycat_Text_GivePass
source: OK. Here's the MAGNET TRAIN PASS\nlike I promised!$
translation: 好啦。按照约定，\n这磁悬浮列车乘车票就给你吧！$

label: Copycat_Text_ExplainPass
source: COPYCAT: That's the PASS for the\nMAGNET TRAIN.\pThe rail company man gave me\nthat when they tore down our old\lhouse for the STATION.$
translation: 模仿少女：那是磁悬浮列车的乘车票。\p当时铁路公司要建车站，拆了\n我们家老房子，那个叔叔给我的。$

label: Copycat_Text_Male_3
source: {PLAYER}: Hi! Thanks a lot for the\nrail PASS!\p{PLAYER}: Pardon?\p{PLAYER}: Is it that fun to mimic\nmy every move?$
translation: {PLAYER}：你好！非常感谢你送我乘车票！\p{PLAYER}：你说什么？\p{PLAYER}：模仿我的一举一动\n真的有那么好玩吗？$

label: Copycat_Text_ItsAScream
source: COPYCAT: You bet! It's a scream!$
translation: 模仿少女：那当然！简直太有意思了！$

label: Copycat_Text_Dodrio1
source: DODRIO: Gii giii!$
translation: 嘟嘟利：唧唧--！$

label: Copycat_Text_Dodrio2
source: MIRROR, MIRROR ON THE WALL,\nWHO'S THE FAIREST ONE OF ALL?$
translation: 魔镜，魔镜，挂在墙上，\n谁是世界上最美的人？$

label: Copycat_Text_2FDoll
source: This is a rare POKéMON! Huh?\pIt's only a doll…$
translation: 这是稀有的宝可梦！咦？\p原来只是个玩偶啊......$

label: SaffronCity_Dojo_Text_ReceivedMonFromKarateMaster2
source: {PLAYER}は　カラテ　だいおう　から\n{STR_VAR_1}を　もらった！$
translation: {PLAYER}从空手道大王那里\n得到了{STR_VAR_1}！$

label: SaffronCity_FightingDojoVIP_Text_Nurse1
source: Hi! Welcome to the TRAINING DOJO!\nI will heal your POKéMON.$
translation: 你好！欢迎来到格斗道场！\n我来帮你的宝可梦恢复体力吧。$

label: SaffronCity_FightingDojoVIP_Text_Nurse2
source: 欢迎下次再来！$
translation: 欢迎下次再来！$

label: SaffronCity_FightingDojoVIP_Text_Scizor
source: SCIZOR: Scii-zor!$
translation: 巨钳螳螂：侠客--！$

label: SaffronCity_FightingDojoVIP_Text_Miltank
source: MILTANK: MooOOO!$
translation: 大奶罐：哞呜--！$

label: SaffronCity_FightingDojoVIP_Text_Poliwhirl
source: POLIWHIRL: Whirl-whirl!$
translation: 蚊香君：咯噜咯噜！$

label: SaffronCity_FightingDojoVIP_Text_Dewgong
source: DEWGONG: Goooooong!$
translation: 白海狮：呜噢--！$

label: SaffronCity_FightingDojoVIP_Text_Steelix
source: STEELIX: GraaAAANk!$
translation: 大钢蛇：嘎拉拉--！$

label: SaffronCity_FightingDojoVIP_Text_Kingdra
source: KINGDRA: Draaa...$

label: SaffronCity_FightingDojoVIP_Text_Onix
source: ONIX: Oooonix!$
translation: 大岩蛇：吼噢噢--！$

label: SaffronCity_FightingDojoVIP_Text_Starmie
source: STARMIE: Hyaaa!$
translation: 宝石海星：吓--！$

label: SaffronCity_FightingDojoVIP_Text_Victreebel
source: VICTREEBEL: Vreeee!$
translation: 大食花：呜哩--！$

label: SaffronCity_FightingDojoVIP_Text_Muk
source: MUK: Muuuk...$

label: SaffronCity_FightingDojoVIP_Text_Kadabra
source: KADABRA: Kadabra!$
translation: 勇基拉：勇基--！$

label: SaffronCity_FightingDojoVIP_Text_Magmar
source: MAGMAR: Magmaaaar!$
translation: 鸭嘴火兽：玛格玛--！$

label: SaffronCity_FightingDojoVIP_Text_Raichu
source: RAICHU: Rai-CHU!$
translation: 雷丘：雷--丘！$

label: SaffronCity_FightingDojoVIP_Text_Machamp
source: MACHAMP: Maa-champ!$
translation: 怪力：玛恰--！$

label: SaffronCity_FightingDojoVIP_Text_Chased
source: Help!$
translation: 救命啊！$

label: SaffronCity_FightingDojoVIP_Text_Statue
source: FIGHTING DOJO VIP LOUNGE$
translation: 格斗道馆 贵宾休息室$

label: SaffronCity_FightingDojoVIP_Text_Falkner_Rematch
source:
Congratulations on defeating
the ELITE 4!\pI've been training my
FLYING-type POKéMON even harder.\pThink you can take on the power
of the skies again?$
translation:
恭喜你击败了
四天王！\p我更加刻苦地特训了
我的飞行属性宝可梦。\p你觉得自己还能再次对抗
来自天空的力量吗？$

label: SaffronCity_FightingDojoVIP_Text_Falkner_RematchDefeat
source: Wow… You beat me again.\pI'm going to train harder to\nbecome the greatest bird master!$
translation: 哇......我又输给你了。\p我会更加努力修行，\n成为最出色的鸟使者！$

label: SaffronCity_FightingDojoVIP_Text_Bugsy_Rematch
source: Wow, you're the JOHTO CHAMPION\nnow!\pYour skills are truly impressive!\pI've been busy with my research.\pI'm ready to show you my new\nfindings.\pWant to have a rematch with me?$
translation: 哇，你现在已经是\n城都冠军了！\p你的实力真是令人钦佩！\p我一直忙于自己的研究，\p现在正好向你展示我的新发现。\p要不要再跟我来一场对战？$

label: SaffronCity_FightingDojoVIP_Text_Bugsy_RematchDefeat
source: Wow, you must be an expert\ntrainer.\pMy research must not be\ncomplete…$
translation: 哇，你真是个顶尖的\n训练家啊。\p看来我的研究还不够完善......$

label: SaffronCity_FightingDojoVIP_Text_Whitney_Rematch
source: Hi! It's you!\pWow, JOHTO CHAMPION now?\pYou really are amazing!\pI want to see how strong you are.\pWant to have a rematch with me?$
translation: 嗨！是你呀！\p哇，你现在已经是城都冠军啦？\p真是太厉害了！\p我也想看看你到底有多强。\p要不要和我再来对战一场？$

label: SaffronCity_FightingDojoVIP_Text_Whitney_RematchDefeat
source: Waaaaah!\pWaaaaah!\p…Snivel, hic… …You meanie!$

label: SaffronCity_FightingDojoVIP_Text_Morty_Rematch
source:
Ah, the JOHTO CHAMPION! Good of
you to come.\pYou've shown your strength and
skill, but have you improved\lsince our last battle?\pI've been training with my
GHOST-type POKéMON.\pLet's see if you can overcome
the shadows once again.\pWant to have a rematch with me?$
translation:
啊，城都的冠军！你能来
真是太好了。\p你展现过你的力量与技巧，但自从
我们上次对战以来，你是否又变强了呢？\p我一直与我的幽灵属性宝可梦一同修行。\p让我看看你是否能
再次突破重重幽暗吧。\p要不要再跟我来一场对战？$

label: SaffronCity_FightingDojoVIP_Text_Morty_RematchDefeat
source: I'm not good enough yet…\pYou have witnessed much more\nthan I.\pI envy you for that…$
translation: 我修行得还不够......\p你所见识过的世界远比我广阔。\p真是令我羡慕啊......$

label: SaffronCity_FightingDojoVIP_Text_Chuck_Rematch
source: WAHAHAH! JOHTO CHAMPION!\pYou've come back for more!\pI see your skills have improved!\pReady to see who's stronger?$
translation: 哇哈哈哈！城都的冠军！\p你又来找我挑战了吗！\p看得出你的身手更上一层楼了！\p准备好看看谁更强了吗？$

label: SaffronCity_FightingDojoVIP_Text_Chuck_RematchDefeat
source: Wha? Huh? I lost? Again?$
translation: 什么？咦？我又输了？！$

label: SaffronCity_FightingDojoVIP_Text_Jasmine_Rematch
source: …Congratulations, JOHTO\nCHAMPION.\pYou have become so strong…\pI wonder if I have improved.\pWould you like to test that?\pWant to have a rematch with me?$
translation: ......恭喜你，城都的\n冠军。\p你变得好强啊......\p不知我是否也有所长进呢。\p你想检验一下吗？\p要不要再跟我来一场对战？$

label: SaffronCity_FightingDojoVIP_Text_Pryce_RematchDefeat
source: Ah, yet again I'm impressed by\nyour prowess.\pWith your strong will, I know\nyou will overcome all life's\lobstacles.$
translation: 啊，你的高超本领再次令老夫折服。\p凭借你坚韧的意志，老夫相信你定能\n跨越人生中的一切险阻。$

label: SaffronCity_FightingDojoVIP_Text_Clair_Rematch
source: You did it, huh?\pYou are now the JOHTO CHAMP.\pYou've proven your strength but\ncan you handle me again?\pAs a Dragon Master, I won't hold\nback.\pNot this time.\pWant to have a rematch with me?$
translation: 你做到了，是吧？\p你现在已经是城都冠军了。\p虽然你证明了自己的实力，\n但你还能招架得住我吗？\p作为龙之使者，我绝不会手下留情。\p这一次绝不会！\p要不要再跟我来一场对战？$

label: SaffronCity_FightingDojoVIP_Text_Clair_RematchDefeat
source: I lost?\pAgain?\pI don't believe it. There must\nbe some mistake…$
translation: 我输了？\p又输了？\p真不敢相信。一定是\n哪里搞错了......$

label: SaffronCity_FightingDojoVIP_Text_Brock_Rematch
source: BROCK: Hey there, {PLAYER}!\pI heard you are now the KANTO\nCHAMPION.\pThat's incredible!\pYou must be even stronger now.\pWant to have a rematch with me?$
translation: 小刚：哟，{PLAYER}！\p我听说你现在已经是\n关都的冠军了啊。\p真是太厉害了！\p现在的你一定变得更强了吧。\p要不要再跟我对战一次？$

label: SaffronCity_FightingDojoVIP_Text_Brock_RematchDefeat
source: BROCK: Your POKéMON once again\novercame my rock-hard defense…$
translation: 小刚：你的宝可梦再次\n击溃了我如磐石般坚硬的防御......$

label: SaffronCity_FightingDojoVIP_Text_Misty_Rematch
source: MISTY: Wow, you're the KANTO\nCHAMPION now!\pThat's amazing! You've come a\nlong way, {PLAYER}.\pBut I'm not backing down.\pWant to have a rematch with me?$
translation: 小霞：哇，你现在已经是\n关都的冠军了啊！\p太厉害了！你这一路成长了好多呢，\n{PLAYER}。\p但我可不会认输哦。\p要跟我再比一场吗？$

label: SaffronCity_FightingDojoVIP_Text_Misty_RematchDefeat
source: MISTY: You really are good…$
translation: 小霞：你真的很厉害呢......$

label: SaffronCity_FightingDojoVIP_Text_Surge_Rematch
source: SURGE: So, you're now KANTO\nCHAMPION!\pImpressive work, kid! But don't\nthink I'm done!\pHow about we have a go again?$
translation: 马志士：嘿，你现在已经是\n关都冠军啦！\p干得漂亮，小鬼！不过可别以为\n我就这么甘拜下风了！\p要不要再来痛痛快快打一场？$

label: SaffronCity_FightingDojoVIP_Text_Surge_RematchDefeat
source: SURGE: Arrrgh! You're still just\nas strong!$
translation: 马志士：哇啊啊！你果然还是\n那么厉害啊！$

label: SaffronCity_FightingDojoVIP_Text_Erika_Rematch
source: ERIKA: Oh, hello.\pWhat a surprise, CHAMPION!\pIt's so lovely to see you again.\pYour journey must have been so\nexciting.\pEven champions enjoy a challenge.\pWant to have a rematch with me?$
translation: 莉佳：哎呀，你好呀。\p真让人惊喜呢，冠军！\p能再次见到你真是太高兴了。\p你的旅程一定非常精彩吧。\p就算是冠军，也不会拒绝挑战吧？\p要和我再来一场对战吗？$

label: SaffronCity_FightingDojoVIP_Text_Erika_RematchDefeat
source: ERIKA: Losing still leaves a\nbitter aftertaste…\pBut knowing that there are strong\ntrainers spurs me to do better…$
translation: 莉佳：输掉对战果然还是会让人\n心有不甘呢......\p但知道世上还有如此强大的训练家，\n也会激励我更加努力精进......$

label: SaffronCity_FightingDojoVIP_Text_Sabrina_Rematch
source: SABRINA: Ah, the CHAMPION.\pI sensed your return.\pYour power has grown immensely.\pEven now, I feel your aura.\pWant to have a rematch with me?$
translation: 娜姿：啊，冠军。\p我已经预感到了你的归来。\p你的力量有了巨大的成长。\p即便现在，我也能清晰感受到你的气场。\p要和我再来一场对战吗？$

label: SaffronCity_FightingDojoVIP_Text_Sabrina_RematchDefeat
source: SABRINA: Your love for your\nPOKéMON again overwhelmed my\lpsychic power…$
translation: 娜姿：你对宝可梦的爱，\n再次压倒了我的超能力......$

label: SaffronCity_FightingDojoVIP_Text_Janine_Rematch
source: Fufufufu…\pWow, you did it!\pYou're the CHAMPION now!\pI'm so proud of you! But don't\nthink I'll go easy on you.\pWant to have a rematch with me?$
translation: 哼哼哼哼......\p哇，你真的做到了！\p你现在可是冠军了呢！\p真为你感到骄傲！不过我可\n不会对你手下留情哦。\p要不要再跟我对战一次？$

label: SaffronCity_FightingDojoVIP_Text_Janine_RematchDefeat
source: JANINE: You're still just as\ntough!\pYou definitely won…$
translation: 阿杏：你果然还是那么强！\p这次毫无疑问是你赢了......$

label: SaffronCity_FightingDojoVIP_Text_Blaine_Rematch
source: BLAINE: Whoa!\pI see you've become the KANTO\nCHAMPION!\pThat's blazing!\pYour skills are top-notch.\pI'm always up for a battle.\pWant to have a rematch with me?$
translation: 夏伯：噢！\p看来你已经成为关都冠军了啊！\p真是太炽热了！\p你的实力无可挑剔。\p我随时都乐意奉陪。\p要和我再来一场对战吗？$

label: SaffronCity_FightingDojoVIP_Text_Blaine_RematchDefeat
source: BLAINE: Your skills are truly\nfiery!\pYou've burned right through my\ndefenses.$
translation: 夏伯：你的本领真是炽热如火！\p彻底烧透了我的防御啊。$

label: SaffronCity_FightingDojoVIP_Text_Blue_Rematch
source: BLUE: Well, well. CHAMPION!\pLooks like you've come a long way.\pI used to have that title too,\nyou know. But I won't go easy.\pLet's see if you can keep it up.\pWant to have a rematch with me?$
translation: 青绿：哎呀呀，冠军大人！\p看来你一路走来成长了不少嘛。\p虽然本大爷以前也拥有过那个头衔。\n不过我可不会手下留情。\p让我看看你能不能守住这个位置吧。\p要和我再来一场对战吗？$

label: SaffronCity_FightingDojoVIP_Text_Blue_RematchDefeat
source: BLUE: What?\pHow the heck did I lose again?$
translation: 青绿：什么？！\p本大爷到底怎么又输了？！$

label: SaffronCity_FightingDojo_Text_Lickilicky
source: LICKILICKY: LIIIIICK!$
translation: 大舌舔：哧溜溜--！$

label: SaffronCity_FightingDojo_Text_Machamp
source: MACHAMP: CHAMP!$
translation: 怪力：怪力力--！$

label: SaffronCity_FightingDojo_Text_Steelix
source: STEELIX: GRRRIND!$
translation: 大钢蛇：嘎噜噜--！$

label: SaffronCity_FightingDojo_Text_Alakazam
source: ALAKAZAM: ZAM!$
translation: 胡地：胡地--！$

label: SaffronCity_FightingDojo_Text_Slowking
source: SLOWKING: HMMM...$

label: SaffronCity_FightingDojo_Text_Pidgeot
source: PIDGEOT: GEEEE!$
translation: 大比鸟：嘎啊--！$

label: SaffronCity_FightingDojo_Text_HP
source: HP$
translation: HP$

label: SaffronCity_FightingDojo_Text_Attack
source: ATK$
translation: 攻击$

label: SaffronCity_FightingDojo_Text_Defense
source: DEF$
translation: 防御$

label: SaffronCity_FightingDojo_Text_SpecialAttack
source: SP.ATK$
translation: 特攻$

label: SaffronCity_FightingDojo_Text_SpecialDefense
source: SP.DEF$
translation: 特防$

label: SaffronCity_FightingDojo_Text_Speed
source: SPD$
translation: 速度$

label: SaffronCity_FightingDojo_Text_WouldYouLikeToBattle
source: Battle {STR_VAR_1} for 3 {STR_VAR_2} EVs?$
translation: 要与{STR_VAR_1}对战\n来获得3点{STR_VAR_2}基础点数吗？$

label: SaffronCity_FightingDojo_Text_BlackBelt
source: You enter the FIGHTING DOJO!\pHere, you may hone the stats of\nof your POKéMON by battle!$
translation: 你来到了格斗道馆！\p在这里，你可以通过对战\n来磨练宝可梦的各项能力！$

label: SaffronCity_FightingDojo_Text_Sign1
source: Left: HP, DEFENSE, SPECIAL DEFENSE$
translation: 左侧：HP、防御、特防$

label: SaffronCity_FightingDojo_Text_Sign2
source: RIGHT: ATTACK, SPECIAL ATTACK, SPEED$
translation: 右侧：攻击、特攻、速度$

label: SaffronCity_FightingDojo_Text_Cooltrainer
source: Only trainers with all KANTO badges\nmay enter the VIP lounge.$
translation: 只有集齐关都所有徽章的训练家\n才能进入贵宾休息室。$

label: SaffronCity_FightingDojo_Ability_Finish_Text
source: That's it! You're welcome!$
translation: 搞定啦！不用客气！$

label: SaffronCity_FightingDojo_Ability_Text1
source: Welcome! I'm the ABILITY EXPERT!\pI can swap POKéMON's abilities in\na heartbeat, only for 25.000¥!\pWould you like me to swap any\nPOKéMON's ability?$
translation: 欢迎！我是特性专家！\p只要25000元，我就能眨眼间\n帮宝可梦切换特性！\p你想让我给哪只宝可梦切换特性吗？$

label: SaffronCity_FightingDojo_Ability_Text_No
source: Sure. I'll be here if you need me.$
translation: 好的。有需要的话随时来找我。$

label: SaffronCity_FightingDojo_Ability_Text_Cant
source: I cannot do that. This POKéMON\ndoes not have a second ABILITY!$
translation: 这我可办不到。这只宝可梦\n并没有第二种特性！$

label: SaffronCity_FightingDojo_Ability_Text_NoChampion
source: Welcome! I'm the ABILITY EXPERT!\pI can swap POKéMON's abilities\nin a heartbeat.\pUnfortunately, my back hurts and\nI can't work today.\pCome again later!$
translation: 欢迎！我是特性专家！\p我能眨眼间帮宝可梦切换特性。\p真不巧，我今天腰酸背痛，\n没法干活了。\p改天再来吧！$

label: SaffronCity_FightingDojo_SetZeroTextNoMoney
source: You don't have enough money.\pCome back when you have.$
translation: 你的钱不够哦。\p等攒够了钱再来吧。$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_SabrinaIntro
source:
SABRINA: I knew you were coming…\pThree years ago I had a vision
of your arrival.\pYou're after my BADGE.\pI don't enjoy battling, but it's
my duty as a LEADER to confer\lBADGES on anyone who has proven\lhim- or herself worthy.\pSince you wish it, I will show
you my psychic powers!$
translation:
娜姿：我知道你会来......\p早在三年前，我就预见到了
你的到来。\p你是为了得到我的徽章吧。\p我并不喜欢对战，但作为馆主，
把徽章授予证明了自身实力的挑战者\l是我的职责所在。\p既然这是你的愿望，
那就让你见识一下我的超能力吧！$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_SabrinaWinLoss
source: SABRINA: Your power…\pIt far exceeds what I foresaw…\pMaybe it isn't possible to fully\npredict what the future holds…\pOK, you win. You earned yourself\nMARSHBADGE.$
translation: 娜姿：你的力量......\p远远超出了我的预见......\p也许，要彻底看透未来\n是不可能的吧......\p好吧，你赢了。这是你应得的\n金黄徽章。$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_ReceivedMarshBadge
source: {PLAYER} received MARSHBADGE.$
translation: {PLAYER}获得了金黄徽章！$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_MarshBadgeInfo
source:
SABRINA: MARSHBADGE draws out
your subliminal powers…\pAlthough I failed to accurately
predict your power, this much I\lknow to be true.\pYou will become a celebrated and
beloved CHAMPION!$
translation:
娜姿：金黄徽章能激发出
你的潜在能力......\p虽然我没能准确预见出你的力量，
但唯有这一点我深信不疑。\p你定会成为一位受人爱戴的
顶尖冠军！$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_Sabrina_GiveTM
source: Here, take this as well.$
translation: 来，把这个也收下吧。$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_Sabrina_ExplainTM
source: It holds SKILL SWAP.\pIt can take your opponents' abilities\naway from them and give them your own.\pUse it wisely...$
translation: 里面记录着特性互换。\p它能将对手的特性夺走，\n并与自己的特性进行交换。\p要好好运用它......$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_SabrinaPostBattle
source: SABRINA: Your love for your\nPOKéMON overwhelmed my psychic\lpower…\pThe power of love, I think, is\nalso a kind of psychic power…$
translation: 娜姿：你对宝可梦的爱，\n压倒了我的超能力......\p我想，爱的力量\n也是一种超能力吧......$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_SabrinaRematch
source: SABRINA: Ah, the KANTO CHAMPION.\pI sensed your return.\pYour power has grown immensely.\pEven now, I feel your aura.\pWant to have a rematch with me?$
translation: 娜姿：啊，关都的冠军。\p我感应到你的归来了。\p你的力量大幅增长了呢。\p即便现在，我也能感受到你的气场。\p想和我再对战一场吗？$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_SabrinaRematchDefeat
source: SABRINA: Your love for your\nPOKéMON again overwhelmed my\lpsychic power…$
translation: 娜姿：你对宝可梦的爱，\n再次压倒了我的超能力......$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_MediumRebeccaSeen
source: The power of all those you\ndefeated comes to me!$
translation: 被你打倒的那些人的力量，\n都汇聚到我这里了！$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_MediumRebeccaBeaten
source: Strong… Far too strong…$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_MediumRebeccaAfter
source: What is the source of your power?$
translation: 你力量的源泉究竟是什么？$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_PsychicFranklinSeen
source: Psychic power is the power of\nyour soul.$
translation: 超能力就是心灵的力量。$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_PsychicFranklinBeaten
source: Your soul has more power than\nmine!$
translation: 你心灵的力量在我之上！$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_PsychicFranklinAfter
source: You made your soul stronger, not\njust your abilities.$
translation:
你变强的不仅仅是实力，
还有你的灵魂。$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_MediumDorisSeen
source: Fufufufu… I see it clearly.\pI can see into your soul!$
translation: 呵呵呵呵......我看得很清楚。\p我能看透你的灵魂！$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_MediumDorisBeaten
source: Though I read you, I still lost…$
translation: 虽然读懂了你的心思，我还是输了......$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_MediumDorisAfter
source: Darn! I forgot that I predicted I\nwould lose to you.$
translation:
哎呀！我都忘了我之前预知到
自己会输给你了。$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_PsychicJaredSeen
source: The FIGHTING DOJO next door was\nonce this city's GYM.$
translation:
隔壁的格斗道馆
曾经也是这个城市的官方道馆呢。$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_PsychicJaredBeaten
source: I was no match…$
translation: 我完全不是对手......$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_PsychicJaredAfter
source: KARATE KING, the master of the\nFIGHTING DOJO, was just destroyed\lby SABRINA.$
translation:
格斗道馆的首领空手道大王，
刚才被娜姿打得落花流水呢。$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_GymGuideIntro
source: Yo, CHAMP in making!\pA trainer as skilled as you\ndoesn't need to be told how to\ldeal with PSYCHIC-type POKéMON,\lright?\pI expect great things from you!\pGood luck!$
translation:
哟，未来的冠军！\p像你这么优秀的训练家，
应该不需要我教你该怎么\l对付超能力属性的宝可梦了吧？\p我对你可是寄予厚望哦！\p祝你好运！$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_GymGuideWin
source: That was another fantastic battle!$
translation: 刚才那场对战也很精彩啊！$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_GymStatue
source: SAFFRON POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: SABRINA\pWINNING TRAINERS:\nBLUE, RED$
translation:
金黄宝可梦道馆
馆主：娜姿\p胜出训练家：
青绿、赤红$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_GymStatuePlayerWon
source: SAFFRON POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: SABRINA\pWINNING TRAINERS:\nBLUE, RED, {PLAYER}$
translation:
金黄宝可梦道馆
馆主：娜姿\p胜出训练家：
青绿、赤红、{PLAYER}$

label: SaffronCity_Text_BaobaName
source: BAOBA$
translation: 巴奥巴$

label: SaffronCity_Text_Baoba
source:
WARDEN BAOBA: {PLAYER}!\pThis is WARDEN BAOBA.\pI'm calling to tell you that the
SAFARI ZONE has expanded again!\pFinally, my SAFARI ZONE has been
fully realized!\pYou remember where it is, right?\pJust west of CIANWOOD CITY!
see you soon!$
translation:
巴奥巴园长：{PLAYER}！\p我是巴奥巴园长。\p我打电话是想告诉你，
狩猎地带又扩建啦！\p我的狩猎地带终于
完全建成了！\p你还记得它在哪儿吧？\p就在湛蓝市西边！
回头见啦！$

label: SaffronCity_Text_Elli
source: I love VULPIX! :D$
translation: 我最喜欢六尾了！:D$

label: SaffronCity_Text_Lass1
source: A little girl who is an expert at\nmimicking people lives here.\pShe even mimics the people she's\nconversing with. It's confusing.$
translation:
这里住着一个小女孩，是个模仿达人。\p她甚至还会模仿正在跟她说话的人，
搞得人晕头转向的。$

label: SaffronCity_Text_Lass1_ReturnedPart
source: The COPYCAT girl looked unhappy.\pShe said she lost her favorite\nPOKé DOLL--CLEFAIRY.$
translation:
那个模仿少女看起来闷闷不乐的。\p她说她弄丢了最喜欢的
皮皮宝可梦玩偶。$

label: SaffronCity_Text_PokefanM
source: You came out from JOHTO?\pYou can zip back home if the\nMAGNET TRAIN's running.$
translation:
你是从城都地区过来的？\p如果磁悬浮列车通了的话，
一眨眼就能回老家了呢。$

label: SaffronCity_Text_PokefanM_ReturnedPart
source: You came out from JOHTO?\pYou can zip back home by hopping\non the MAGNET TRAIN.$
translation:
你是从城都地区过来的？\p只要坐上磁悬浮列车，
一眨眼就能回到老家了呢。$

label: SaffronCity_Text_CooltrainerM
source: I went to the GYM, raring for\nbattles against trainers…\pIt turns out, I stumbled into the\nunused GYM next door.\pBoy, I was pretty embarrassed.$
translation:
我本来兴致勃勃地去道馆，
想跟训练家们大战一场......\p结果，误闯进了隔壁已经废弃的道馆。\p哎呀，真是丢死人了。$

label: SaffronCity_Text_CooltrainerF
source: This is SILPH CO., famous for\nPOKéMON merchandise.\pIn the past, TEAM ROCKET wanted\nthe company because of that.$
translation:
这里是西尔佛公司，
以生产各种宝可梦用品而闻名。\p以前火箭队就是因为这个盯上了这家公司。$

label: SaffronCity_Text_Fisher
source: Chew… Chew…\pI hear there's big trouble brewing\nat the POWER PLANT.\pChew… Chew…$

label: SaffronCity_Text_Fisher_ReturnedPart
source: Chew… Chew…\pI hear there was big trouble at the\nPOWER PLANT.\pChew… Chew… Haaah, I'm full!$
translation:
嚼......嚼......\p听说发电厂那边
之前出了大乱子啊。\p嚼......嚼......哈啊，吃饱了！$

label: SaffronCity_Text_Youngster1
source: Going into an alley for the first\ntime makes me sorta anxious.$
translation:
第一次走进小巷子里，
心里总有点发慌呢。$

label: SaffronCity_Text_Youngster2
source: There's a place called the CONTEST\nHALL in VIRIDIAN where trainers\lgather from all over the place.$
translation:
常青市有个叫华丽大赛会场的地方，
来自各地的训练家都会聚在那里。$

label: SaffronCity_Text_Lass2
source: Our city was featured on a radio\nprogram.\pIt's nice to hear praise for your\ncity, but it's a bit embarrassing\ltoo.$
translation:
广播节目里提到了我们的城市呢。\p听到别人夸奖自己的家乡固然开心，
但总觉得有点不好意思呢。$

label: SaffronCity_Text_Sign
source: SAFFRON CITY\pShining, Golden Land of Commerce$
translation: 金黄市\p闪耀黄金光芒的商业之都$

label: SaffronCity_Text_GymSign
source: SAFFRON CITY\nPOKéMON GYM\lLEADER: SABRINA\pThe Master of Psychic POKéMON!$
translation: 金黄市\n宝可梦道馆\l馆主：娜姿\p超能力宝可梦的大师！$

label: SaffronCity_Text_FightingDojoSign
source: Everyone Welcome!\nFIGHTING DOJO$
translation: 欢迎任何人挑战！\n格斗道场$

label: SaffronCity_Text_SilphCoSign
source: SILPH CO.\nOFFICE BUILDING$
translation: 西尔佛公司\n办公大楼$

label: SaffronCity_Text_MrPsychicHouseSign
source: MR.PSYCHIC'S\nHOUSE$
translation: 超能力大叔的家$

label: SaffronCity_Text_MagnetTrainStationSign
source: SAFFRON CITY\nMAGNET TRAIN STATION$
translation: 金黄市\n磁浮列车站$

label: MrPsychic_Text_1
source: …\p…\p…\p…I got it!\pYou wanted this!$

label: MrPsychic_Text_2
source: TM29 is PSYCHIC.\pIt may lower the target's\nSP.DEF.$
translation: 招式学习器29是"精神强念"。\p有时会降低对手的\n特防。$

label: SaffronMart_Text_CooltrainerM
source: There's a big RADIO TOWER in\nLAVENDER.$
translation: 紫苑镇建了一座\n很大的广播塔呢。$

label: SaffronMart_Text_CooltrainerF
source: I want to become stronger, but\nI'm not good yet…\pCould you show me how sometime?$
translation: 我想变得更强，\n但我现在还差得远......\p什么时候你能指导我一下吗？$

label: SaffronCity_PokemonCenter1F_Text_Teacher
source:
What are JOHTO's POKéMON CENTERS
like?\p…Oh, I see. So they're not much
different from the ones in KANTO.\pI can go to JOHTO without
worrying, then!$
translation: 城都的宝可梦中心\n是什么样子的？\p......哦，原来如此。跟关都的\n也没什么太大区别嘛。\p那我就能放心地去城都啦！$

label: SaffronCity_PokemonCenter1F_Text_Fisher
source: I just happened to come through\nROCK TUNNEL.\pThere was some commotion at the\nPOWER PLANT.$
translation: 我刚好穿过岩山隧道过来。\p发电厂那边好像出了点骚乱呢。$

label: SaffronCity_PokemonCenter1F_Text_Fisher_ReturnedPart
source: There's an odd cave in CERULEAN.\pAs a pro HIKER, I should explore it,\nbut that place scares even me.$
translation: 华蓝市有个奇怪的洞窟。\p作为一名专业的登山男，我本该去探索的，\n但那个地方连我都觉得毛骨悚然。$

label: SaffronCity_PokemonCenter1F_Text_Youngster
source: SILPH CO.'s HEAD OFFICE and the\nMAGNET TRAIN STATION--they're the\lplaces to see in SAFFRON.$
translation: 西尔佛公司的总公司大楼和磁浮列车站--\n它们可是金黄市最值得一看的地方。$

label: SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_BrocksFanToBitterEnd
source: …  …\p…  …\nI'm BROCK's fan!\pEven if I were his only fan,\nI swear it on my rock-hard will,\land on my shorts!\pI'll be his fan to the bitter end!$
translation: ......  ......\p......  ......\n我是小刚的粉丝！\p就算全世界只剩我一个粉丝，\n我也赌上如磐石般的意志，\l以及我的短裤发誓！\p我要一辈子当他的铁杆粉丝！$

label: SaffronCity_SilphCo_Text_Steven1
source: Hello...\nYou're breaking up...\lI think it depends on my dad.\lI see...\nI'll be on my way. See you soon.$
translation: 喂......\n信号不太好呢......\l我想这得看我爸爸怎么决定了。\l我知道了......\n那我先出发了。回头见。$

label: SaffronCity_SilphCo_Text_Steven2
source:
STEVEN: You are... I remember your
eyes.\pWhen I see a trainer whose eyes
twinkle, I always remember.\pYou have a POKéDEX! So you are
also in search of POKéMON!\lLet me see...\pI think I can help you with that.\pLet's say that you have stones in
front of you. Which color would\l you pick?$
translation:
大吾：你是......我记得你的眼神。\p只要看到眼神澄澈闪烁的训练家，
我就一定能记住。\p你带着宝可梦图鉴呢！
这么说你也在四处探寻宝可梦吗！\l让我想想......\p我想在这方面我能帮上你的忙。\p假设你的面前放着几块石头。
你会选择哪种颜色呢？$

label: SaffronCity_SilphCo_Text_Steven3
source: You chose correctly! I'll give you\n{STR_VAR_1}!$
translation: 选得好！\n那我就把{STR_VAR_1}送给你吧！$

label: SaffronCity_SilphCo_Text_Steven4
source: Take good care of it. Your caring\nfor it will make me very happy.$
translation: 请好好珍惜它。\n如果你能疼爱它，我会非常高兴的。$

label: SilphCo_Text_Sign1
source: SILPH CO.\n1F RECEPTION.$
translation: 西尔佛公司\n1F 接待处$

label: SilphCo_Text_Sign2
source: SILPH CO.\nELEVATOR OUT OF SERVICE$
translation: 西尔佛公司\n电梯暂停使用$

label: SilphCo_Text_Receptionist
source: Welcome. This is SILPH CO.'s HEAD\nOFFICE BUILDING.$
translation: 欢迎光临。这里是西尔佛公司的\n总公司大楼。$

label: SilphCo_Text_Officer
source: Only employees are permitted to\ngo upstairs.\pBut since you came such a long\nway,\phave this neat little souvenir.$
translation: 楼上仅限本公司员工进入。\p不过既然你远道而来，\p这个小纪念品就送给你吧。$

label: SilphCo_Text_Officer_GotUpGrade
source: It's SILPH CO.'s latest product.\pIt's not for sale anywhere yet.$
translation: 这是西尔佛公司的最新产品。\p在别的地方可都还买不到呢。$

label: SaffronMagnetTrainStation_Text_OfficerTrainHasntComeIn
source: The train hasn't come in…\pI know! I'll carry the passengers\non my back!\pThat won't work.$
translation: 电车还没来啊......\p有了！不如由我来背着乘客跑吧！\p--怎么可能行得通嘛。$

label: SaffronMagnetTrainStation_Text_OfficerComingAboard
source: We'll soon depart for GOLDENROD.\pAre you coming aboard?$
translation: 列车马上就要开往满金市了。\p你要上车吗？$

label: SaffronMagnetTrainStation_Text_OfficerRightThisWay
source: May I see your rail PASS, please?\pOK. Right this way, please.$
translation: 请出示您的乘车券。\p好的，请往这边走。$

label: SaffronMagnetTrainStation_Text_OfficerNoRailPass
source: Sorry. You don't have a rail PASS.$
translation: 抱歉，您没有乘车券。$

label: SaffronMagnetTrainStation_Text_OfficerHopeToSeeYouAgain
source: 欢迎下次再来！$
translation: 欢迎下次再来！$

label: SaffronMagnetTrainStation_Text_OfficerArrivedInSaffron
source: We have arrived in SAFFRON.\pWe hope to see you again.$
translation: 金黄市到了。\p期待您的再次乘坐。$

label: SaffronMagnetTrainStation_Text_Officer_TrainNotOperating
source: I'm sorry, but the MAGNET TRAIN\nisn't operating now.$
translation: 非常抱歉，磁力列车\n现在暂停运行。$

label: SaffronMagnetTrainStation_Text_GymGuide
source:
The MAGNET TRAIN is a super-modern
rail liner that uses electricity\pand magnets to attain incredible
speed.\pHowever, if there isn't any
electricity…$
translation: 磁力列车是用电力和磁力\n以惊人速度飞驰的\p超现代化铁路线路。\p可是，要是没有电的话......$

label: SaffronMagnetTrainStation_Text_GymGuide_ReturnedPart
source: Whew…\pHow many times have I gone back\nand forth between KANTO and JOHTO?$
translation: 呼......\p我到底在关都和城都之间\n往返了多少次呢？$

label: SaffronMagnetTrainStation_Text_Teacher
source: Before the MAGNET TRAIN STATION\nwas built, there was a house there.\pA little girl named COPYCAT used\nto live there.$
translation: 在建磁力列车站之前，\n那里原本有一栋房子。\p以前有个叫模仿少女的\n女孩子住在那里呢。$

label: SaffronMagnetTrainStation_Text_Lass
source: Hi. Do you have a rail PASS?\nI have one.\pAll the people in SAFFRON who ride\nthe MAGNET TRAIN have PASSES.$
translation: 你好。你有乘车券吗？\n我可是有一张哦。\p在金黄市搭乘磁力列车的人，\n大家都有乘车券呢。$

label: SaffronCity_Tunnel_NS_Text_BaldingManIntro
source:
Don't be afraid, I'm not a bad
person.\pA place like this...
attracts mean people.\pThey would eventually cause
trouble...\pIt makes me mad just thinking about
it.$
translation: 别害怕，我不是什么坏人。\p像这种地方......\n总会引来心术不正的家伙。\p他们早晚会惹出麻烦来......\p光是想想就让我火大。$

label: SaffronCity_Tunnel_NS_Text_BaldingManCandybarDetected
source: Aha!\nThat's a RAGE CANDYBAR!\pCan I have it?\nPlease!$
translation: 啊哈！\n那是愤怒馒头吧！\p能给我吗？\n拜托了！$

label: SaffronCity_Tunnel_NS_Text_BaldingManGaveCandybar
source: {PLAYER} Gave the RageCandyBar to the\nguy at the underground path.\pMunch!\pHow upsetting!\pBut this is so good!\pMunch munch!\pAargh! It makes me mad!\pMunch munch!\pAargh...\p...................Phew!\pI am feeling much better!\nThank you for your candy!\lI want you to have this!$
translation: {PLAYER}把愤怒馒头交给了\n地下通道的男人。\p吧唧！\p真是气死我了！\p可是好好吃啊！\p吧唧吧唧！\p啊啊！真是火大！\p吧唧吧唧！\p啊啊......\p........................呼！\p感觉心情舒畅多了！\n谢谢你的馒头！\l这个送给你！$

label: SaffronCity_Tunnel_NS_Text_BaldingManGaveTm
source: TM 64 contains........\ptick-\n            tock\ltick-\l            tock\ltick-\l            tock\ltick-\l            tock\ltick.....\l......................\l......................\lKA-BOOM!!!$

label: SeafoamIslands_B1F_Text_ArticunoBattle
source: Gyaoo!$

label: SeafoamIslands_Gym_Text_GymStatue
source: CINNABAR POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: BLAINE\pWINNING TRAINERS:\nBLUE, RED$
translation: 红莲宝可梦道馆\n馆主：夏伯\p获胜训练家：\n青绿、赤红$

label: SeafoamIslands_Gym_Text_GymStatuePlayerWon
source: CINNABAR POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: BLAINE\pWINNING TRAINERS:\nBLUE, RED, {PLAYER}$
translation: 红莲宝可梦道馆\n馆主：夏伯\p获胜训练家：\n青绿、赤红、{PLAYER}$

label: SeafoamIslands_Gym_Text_Blaine_GiveTM
source: Take this too!$
translation: 这个也给你！$

label: SeafoamIslands_Gym_Text_Blaine_ExplainTM
source:
This TM contains
the awesome OVERHEAT!\pThe overwhelming heat scorches your
opponents, but then drops your power.\pI hope your next opponent has an
extra BURN HEAL! Waaah!$
translation:
这个招式学习器里面是
超厉害的"过热"！\p虽然能用压倒性的热量烧焦对手，
但也会让自己的威力下降。\p希望你的下一个对手
带够了灼伤药！哇哈哈！$

label: SeafoamIslands_Gym_Text_BlaineIntro
source:
BLAINE: Waaah!\pMy GYM in CINNABAR burned down.\pMy fire-breathing POKéMON and I are
homeless because of the volcano.\pWaaah!\pBut I'm back in business as a GYM
LEADER here in this cave.\pIf you can beat me, I'll give you
a BADGE.\pHa! You'd better have BURN HEAL!$
translation: 夏伯：哇哈哈！\p我红莲镇的道馆全烧没了。\p托那座火山的福，\n我和喷火的宝可梦们都无家可归了。\p哇哈哈！\p不过我在这山洞里\n重开了道馆馆主的营生。\p你要是能打赢我，我就把徽章给你。\p哈！你最好备好灼伤药！$

label: SeafoamIslands_Gym_Text_BlaineWinLoss
source: BLAINE: Awesome. I've burned out…\pYou've earned VOLCANOBADGE!$
translation: 夏伯：太棒了。我已经完全燃尽了......\p深红徽章归你了！$

label: SeafoamIslands_Gym_Text_ReceivedVolcanoBadge
source: {PLAYER} received VOLCANOBADGE.$
translation: {PLAYER}获得了深红徽章。$

label: SeafoamIslands_Gym_Text_BlaineAfterBattle
source: BLAINE: I did lose this time, but\nI'm going to win the next time.\pWhen I rebuild my CINNABAR GYM,\nwe'll have to have a rematch.$
translation: 夏伯：虽然这次是我输了，\n但下次赢的会是我。\p等我重建了红莲道馆，\n咱们一定要再较量一次。$

label: SeafoamIslands_Gym_Text_BlaineFightDone
source: BLAINE: My fire POKéMON will be\neven stronger.\pJust you watch!$
translation: 夏伯：我的火属性宝可梦\n会变得更强。\p你就走着瞧吧！$

label: SeafoamIslands_Gym_Text_BlaineRematch
source: BLAINE: Whoa!\pI see you've become the KANTO\nCHAMPION!\pThat's blazing!\pYour skills are top-notch.\pI'm always up for a battle.\pWant to have a rematch with me?$
translation: 夏伯：噢！\p看来你已经成为关都冠军了啊！\p真是太炽热了！\p你的实力无可挑剔。\p我随时都乐意奉陪。\p要和我再来一场对战吗？$

label: SeafoamIslands_Gym_Text_BlaineRematchDefeat
source: BLAINE: Your skills are truly fiery!\pYou've burned right through my\ndefenses.$
translation: 夏伯：你的实力真如烈火般炽热！\p竟然彻底突破了我的防线。$

label: SeafoamIslands_Gym_Text_GymGuideWin
source: Yo!\p… Huh? It's over already?\pSorry, sorry!\pCINNABAR GYM was gone, so I didn't\nknow where to find you.\pBut, hey, you're plenty strong even\nwithout my advice. I knew you'd win!$
translation: 哟！\p......咦？已经结束了吗？\p抱歉抱歉！\p红莲道馆没了，\n我不知道去哪里找你。\p不过嘛，就算没有我的建议，\n你也足够强了。我就知道你会赢！$

label: SeafoamIslands_Gym_Text_GymGuideWin2
source: A POKéMON GYM can be anywhere as\nlong as the GYM LEADER is there.\pThere's no need for a building.$
translation: 只要有道馆馆主在，\n哪里都可以是宝可梦道馆。\p根本不需要拘泥于建筑嘛。$

label: SevenIsland_House_Room1_Text_StrVar1_1
source: {STR_VAR_1}$
translation: {STR_VAR_1}$

label: SevenIsland_House_Room1_Text_StrVar1_2
source: {STR_VAR_1}$
translation: {STR_VAR_1}$

label: SevenIsland_House_Room1_Text_StrVar1_3
source: {STR_VAR_1}$
translation: {STR_VAR_1}$

label: SevenIsland_TrainerTower_Text_RodettePostBattle
source: Somewhere on this island, peculiar\nPOKéMON are sleeping.\pCould it be that they're waiting\nfor you?$
translation: 在这座岛上的某个地方，\n沉睡着不同寻常的宝可梦。\p难道说，它们正在等待你的到来吗？$

label: SinjohRuins_ArceusRoom_Text_CryArceus
source: ARCEUS: Dodogyuuun!$
translation: 阿尔宙斯：咚咚咕呜--！$

label: SinjohRuins_ArceusRoom_Text_CryArceus2
source: ARCEUS: Dodogyuuun!\pThe ARCEUS is weakened...\nCan be caught?$
translation: 阿尔宙斯：咚咚咕呜--！\p阿尔宙斯已经衰弱了......\n可以捕捉了吗？$

label: SinjohRuins_ArceusRoom_Text_StevenCongrats
source:
STEVEN: You did it, {PLAYER}!\pThat battle was breathtaking.\pSeeing your power made me realize.\pThe KIMONO GIRLS didn't send you
to help our research.\pI think they sent you because
you were the only one worthy of\ltaming the legendary POKéMON.\pThey didn't trust my team and I
to handle it.\pAnd after what I've just seen...\pI think they were right.\pI've brought a lot of unwanted
attention to this town.\pI think I'll spend some time
with the locals.\pAfter all of this, you and your
POKéMON deserve some rest.\pI'll be at the village if you need me.\pFufufu, what could you need from me?$
translation:
大吾：你成功了，{PLAYER}！\p刚才那场对战真是惊心动魄。\p见识到你的实力后，我终于明白了。\p舞姬们送你过来，
并不是为了协助我们的调查。\p我想，她们是因为唯有你才配得上\l收服传说中的宝可梦，才让你前来的吧。\p她们并不放心让我和我的队伍
来处理这件事。\p而在亲眼目睹了刚才的一切后......\p我认为她们是对的。\p我给这座小镇带来了
太多不必要的关注。\p我想我得花些时间
陪陪这里的当地人。\p经历了这一切后，你和你的宝可梦
都该好好休息一下了。\p如果有什么事找我，我就在村子里。\p呵呵呵，不过你又能有什么事找我呢？$

label: SinjohRuins_Text_StevenGotoStairs1
source: STEVEN: This could only mean one thing.$
translation: 大吾：这只能说明一件事。$

label: SinjohRuins_Text_StevenGotoStairs2
source:
{PLAYER}. We were able to decipher
the rest of the glyphs...\pIf the translation is right, 
the POKéMON at the top of that\lstaircase is the most powerful\lbeing in the universe.\pAnd it is my duty as former
CHAMPION of the HOENN LEAGUE\lto make sure you are strong\lenough to face it.\pMeet me at that landing
when you are ready.$
translation:
{PLAYER}。我们已经解读出
其余的古代文字了......\p如果解读没有出错，
在那座阶梯顶端的宝可梦，\l就是全宇宙最强大的存在。\p而作为丰缘联盟的前任冠军，
我有责任确认你是否具备\l足够直面它的实力。\p等你准备好了，
就到那个平台来找我吧。$

label: SinjohRuins_Text_HealParty
source: STEVEN: Let me heal your POKéMON\nbefore you go.$
translation: 大吾：出发之前，\n让我先为你的宝可梦回复体力吧。$

label: SinjohRuins_Text_StevenAfterPlate
source: STEVEN: Good luck, {PLAYER}\pGo on, I'm right behind you.$
translation: 大吾：祝你好运，{PLAYER}。\p去吧，我就在你身后。$

label: SinjohRuins_Text_StevenAfterBattle
source: STEVEN: To think, another trainer \nwould defeat me like this.\pIncredible.\pTake this, it's the final plate.$
translation: 大吾：真没想到，居然又有一位训练家\n能将我击败至此。\p真是不可思议。\p收下这个吧，这是最后一块石板。$

label: SinjohRuins_Text_StevenReadytoBattle
source: STEVEN: {PLAYER}.\pEver since I first saw the\ndetermination in your eyes,\lI felt it would lead to this.\pI will test the bond between you\nand your POKéMON.\pAre you ready?$
translation: 大吾：{PLAYER}。\p从我第一次看到你眼中坚定的意志起，\n我就预感到会有这么一天。\p就让我来考验你与宝可梦之间的羁绊吧。\p准备好了吗？$

label: SinjohRuins_Text_ChallengeSteven
source: Okay, {PLAYER}{KUN}, if you're going to mount\na serious challenge, expect the worst!$
translation: 好，{PLAYER}{KUN}，既然你要全力以赴\n向我发起挑战，那就做好吃苦头的觉悟吧！$

label: SinjohRuins_Text_StevenDefeat
source: You...\nYou are ready.$
translation: 你......\n你已经做好了万全的准备。$

label: SinjohRuins_Text_Sign
source: SINJOH RUINS$
translation: 神都遗迹$

label: SinjohRuins_Lab_Text_StevenIntroCutscene1
source: STEVEN: Hm?$
translation: 大吾：嗯？$

label: SinjohRuins_Lab_Text_StevenIntroCutscene2
source: STEVEN: {PLAYER}!\pI'd recognize those eyes anywhere.\pWhat brings you this far north?\p.............\pI see, the KIMONO GIRLS of NEW SINJOH\nhave sent you to aid our\linvestigation.\pIn that case, allow me to bring you\nup to speed.$
translation: 大吾：{PLAYER}！\p无论在哪里，我都认得你那坚毅的目光。\p你怎么会来到这么遥远的北方？\p............\p原来如此，新神都的舞姬们\n派你来协助我们的调查啊。\p既然如此，那就让我来向你\n说明一下目前的进展吧。$

label: SinjohRuins_Lab_Text_StevenIntroCutscene3
source:
STEVEN: When I first heard about
these ruins, I had to come see\lthem for myself.\pI assembled a team from DEVON CORP.
and we set off on a research\lexpedition.\pWho knows what we'll find buried
here.\pWe've learned quite a lot
already.$
translation: 大吾：当我第一次听说这处遗迹时，\n就决定无论如何都要亲自来看看。\p我从德文公司召集了一支队伍，\n展开了这次调查探险。\p谁也不知道这里究竟埋藏着什么。\p不过目前，我们已经掌握了不少线索。$

label: SinjohRuins_Lab_Text_StevenIntroCutscene4
source:
LINGUIST: While the full translation
of the glyphs found around the ruins\lstill eludes me, I've been able\lto make out some aspects.\pThere are 17 peculiar PLATES.\pThey have some significance
to the ruins, but we've only\lfound 1 so far.\pThe rest are said to be guarded
by POKéMON and trainers of\lawesome power.$
translation:
语言学家：虽然遗迹周围发现的古代文字
还未能全部破译，\l但我已经辨认出了一部分内容。\p这里一共有17块奇特的石板。\p它们对遗迹而言有着非同寻常的意义，
但目前我们只找到了1块。\p据说其余的石板，正由拥有
强大力量的宝可梦与训练家守护着。$

label: SinjohRuins_Lab_Text_StevenIntroCutscene5
source:
STEVEN: That's the story, {PLAYER}.\pThe NOBLE POKéMON that guard the
remaining PLATES are too strong\lfor my team, I'm afraid.\pAnd I need to stay here to oversee
the research.\pBut I think you could do it.
Will you help us?$
translation: 大吾：情况就是这样，{PLAYER}。\p守护其余石板的王宝可梦实力太过强横，\n恐怕我的队伍难以招架。\p而且我必须留在这里主持调查工作。\p但我相信你一定能做到。\n你愿意帮助我们吗？$

label: SinjohRuins_Lab_Text_StevenIntroCutscene6
source: Excellent.\pThe glyphs say the PLATES are\nheld by NOBLE POKéMON and\lstrong trainers across SINJOH.\pI'll call your POKéGEAR if we\nlearn anything new.\pThank you, {PLAYER}.$
translation: 太好了。\p石碑上的文字显示，那些石板散布在神都各地，\n由王宝可梦以及强大的训练家持有。\p一旦我们有新的发现，\n我会通过宝可梦齿轮联系你。\p拜托你了，{PLAYER}。$

label: SinjohRuins_Lab_Text_StevenIntroCutsceneRefused
source: Are you sure?\pWho knows what we'll find buried\nhere.\pWon't you reconsider?$
translation: 你确定吗？\p谁也不知道这里究竟埋藏着什么。\p你不再考虑一下吗？$

label: SinjohRuins_Lab_Text_FinalPlateScene1
source: STEVEN: {PLAYER}!\pI think I know what's going to\nhappen we bring together all 17 of\lthe PLATES.\pI feel...\l.....................$
translation: 大吾：{PLAYER}！\p我想我知道集齐全部17块石板后\n会发生什么了。\p我感受到了......\l............$

label: SinjohRuins_Lab_Text_FinalPlateScene2
source: STEVEN: I need to see this for\nmyself!\pOutside, {PLAYER}!$
translation: 大吾：我一定要亲眼见识一下！\p到外面去，{PLAYER}！$

label: SinjohRuins_Lab_Text_StevenFindPlates
source: STEVEN: Ah, {PLAYER}.\p{STR_VAR_1} PLATES so far.\nNot bad at all.\pI have to admit, I'm curious\nwhat will happen once they're\lall gathered.\pWell, let's see what you find.$
translation: 大吾：啊，{PLAYER}。\p目前已经收集到{STR_VAR_1}块石板了啊。\n真不错。\p不得不说，我非常好奇\n把它们全部集齐后会发生什么。\p好，期待你的新发现。$

label: SinjohRuins_Lab_Text_StevenFindPlates3
source: STEVEN: Ah, {PLAYER}.\p{STR_VAR_1} PLATES so far.\nNot bad at all.\pHave you investigated that\nchamber yet?\lIt's all quite mysterious.$
translation: 大吾：啊，{PLAYER}。\p目前已经收集到{STR_VAR_1}块石板了啊。\n真不错。\p你调查过那个石室了吗？\l那里处处都透着神秘呢。$

label: SinjohRuins_Lab_Text_StevenFindPlates9
source:
STEVEN: Ah, {PLAYER}.\p{STR_VAR_1} PLATES so far.
Making great progress.\pThe chambers that have opened
up bear a striking similarity\lto a series of chambers\lin the HOENN region.\pEach of those was also home to a
legendary POKéMON.\pBut in HOENN, only 3 were ever
discovered.\pAnd here, there are at least 6.\pWho knows what we'll find next.$
translation:
大吾：啊，{PLAYER}。\p目前已经收集到{STR_VAR_1}块石板了啊。
进展相当顺利。\p那些开启的石室，
与丰缘地区的一系列石室\l有着惊人的相似之处。\p丰缘的那些石室中，
每一处也都沉睡着传说的宝可梦。\p但即便是在丰缘，也仅仅发现了3处。\p而在这里，至少有6处之多。\p真不知道接下来还会发现什么。$

label: SinjohRuins_Lab_Text_StevenAfterAll
source:
STEVEN: {PLAYER}!\pThis expedition has been the
experience of a lifetime.\pEver since I heard about these ruins,
I had this feeling.\pI thought we would discover something
amazing.\pAnd my predictions usually come true.\pThank you for all your help,
Champion.\pWhere will you go from here?\pI hope we can meet again somewhere.$
translation: 大吾：{PLAYER}！\p这次探险真是一段令我终生难忘的经历。\p自从听说这处遗迹起，\n我心中就一直有种预感。\p我觉得我们一定会发现不得了的惊世秘密。\p而且我的预感向来都很准。\p非常感谢你的一路相助，\n冠军。\p接下来你打算去哪里？\p期待我们日后有缘再会。$

label: SinjohRuins_Lab_Text_Geologist
source: Ground-penetrating radar shows\n6 subterranean chambers in this\lvalley.\p5 of them appear to be closer\nto the surface level, with 1\lburied even deeper.$
translation: 探地雷达显示在这个山谷里\n有6处地下石室。\p其中5处似乎更接近地表，\n还有1处埋藏得更深。$

label: SinjohRuins_Lab_Text_GeologistDuring
source: All this time I've directed my\nequipment downward to image\lthe underground.\pWhen clearly I should've pointed\nit up!$
translation: 我一直都把设备对着下方，\n去探测地底的构造。\p但显然我早该把它对准上方的！$

label: SinjohRuins_Lab_Text_GeologistAfter
source: Those PLATES were related to the\nmost powerful POKéMON??\pI wish I had more time to study them.$
translation: 那些石板竟然和最强大的\n宝可梦有关联吗？？\p真希望能有更多时间去研究它们啊。$

label: SinjohRuins_Lab_Text_Linguist
source: Ugh....\nThere's so many glyphs to\ltranslate..\pWe don't have anything like this\nin the HOENN region.$
translation: 唔......\n要解读的古代文字也太多了吧......\p在丰缘地区可没有这种东西啊。$

label: SinjohRuins_Lab_Text_LinguistDuring
source:
Imagine my surprise as I
translated the glyph!\pI triple and quadruple checked
it before telling STEVEN!\pI mean, really, the God of
POKéMON?\pIt's incredible.$
translation:
你可以想象我解读出古代文字时
有多么吃惊！\p在告诉大吾先生之前，
我反复核对了三四遍！\p我是说，真的存在所谓
宝可梦的创造神吗？\p这太不可思议了。$

label: SinjohRuins_Lab_Text_LinguistAfter
source: This expedition has been a\njoy, {PLAYER}.\pThanks for taking care of all\nthe field-work.$
translation: 这次调查真是一趟愉快的旅程，\n{PLAYER}。\p多亏你帮忙搞定了所有的实地调查。$

label: SinjohRuins_Lab_Text_Archaeologist
source:
The existence of a civilization
in this area changes our whole\lunderstanding of history.\pMany of the artifacts we've found
are over a thousand years old.\pThe carbon dating lines up with
artifacts found in the SINNOH region.\pAlthough, that flute you found...
It seems far older.$
translation:
这个地区曾经存在过的文明，
彻底改变了我们对历史的认知。\p我们发现的许多出土文物
都有一千多年的历史了。\p碳十四测年结果与在神奥地区
发现的文物完全吻合。\p不过，你找到的那支笛子......
似乎年代还要久远得多。$

label: SinjohRuins_Lab_Text_ArchaeologistDuring
source: Those plates...\nThe connection to the SINNOH\lregion...\lThat flute....\lIt's all starting to make sense.$
translation: 那些石板......\n与神奥地区的关联......\l还有那支笛子......\l一切都开始串连起来了。$

label: SinjohRuins_Lab_Text_ArchaeologistAfter
source: The historical value of what\nyou've helped us unearth here\lcannot be overstated, \l{PLAYER}.\pTruly, thank you.$
translation: 你协助我们在这里发掘出的成果，\n其历史价值无论怎么估量都不为过，\l{PLAYER}。\p真的很感谢你。$

label: SinjohRuins_Lab_Text_Growlithe_Cry
source: Growh owh!!$

label: SinjohRuins_Lab_Text_GrowlitheBall
source: This appears to be Growlithe's ball..\nBetter leave it alone.$
translation: 这看起来是卡蒂狗的玩具球......\n还是不要碰它吧。$

label: SinjohRuins_Lab_Text_Biologist
source:
Look at this wonderful specimen!\pThis species of GROWLITHE is unlike
those found anywhere else in the\lworld.\pDNA analysis reveals that it shares
a common ancestor with GROWLITHE\lfound in other regions.\pYet, its temperament and typing
differ significantly.\pDescriptions of GROWLITHE found in
ancient SINNOH records seem to match.\pPerhaps this species once occupied
a much larger territory, stretching\lnorth through ancient SINNOH.$
translation:
快看这个绝妙的样本！\p这种卡蒂狗与世界上任何地方
见到的都截然不同。\pDNA分析表明，它与在其他地区
发现的卡蒂狗有着共同的祖先。\p然而，它的习性与属性
却有着极大的差异。\p它似乎与古代神奥文献中
关于卡蒂狗的记载完全吻合。\p也许这个物种曾经占据了广袤的领地，
一路向北延伸至古代神奥。$

label: SinjohRuins_Lab_Text_BiologistDuring
source: If the creature at the top of\nthose stairs really is the God\lof all POKéMON, does that mean\lit is the first common ancestor?$
translation: 如果位于阶梯顶端的那只生物\n真的是所有宝可梦的创造神，\l那是否意味着它就是最初的共同始祖？$

label: SinjohRuins_Lab_Text_BiologistAfter
source: I've been able to gather so much\ndata on regional forms and\ldivergent evolution from this\lexpedition. Thank you,\l{PLAYER}.$
translation: 通过这次考察，我收集到了\n大量关于地区形态与趋异进化的数据。\l太感谢你了，\l{PLAYER}。$

label: SinjohRuins_Lab_Text_Hiker
source:
For ten years, I've hiked these
wilds.\pNo, make that twenty years.\pUntil one day I found those big
stone pillars and that ominous\ltemple.\pThat's the SINJOH RUINS.
Or so I've heard.\pI didn't know about the town then.\pAll I did was tell a few of my
pals. But word travels fast.\pI never thought it would bring
so much attention to the area.\pMakes me feel kinda funny.
Y'know?$
translation:
在这片荒野里，我徒步了十年。\p不，应该说是二十年了。\p直到有一天，我发现了那些巨大的
石柱和那座不祥的神殿。\p那就是神都遗迹。
我听别人都是这么叫的。\p那时我还不知道这附近有村落。\p我只是跟几个朋友随口提了提，
谁知道一传十，十传百。\p我真没想到这会让这片地方
引来这么多的关注。\p感觉还挺微妙的。
你懂吧？$

label: SinjohRuins_Lab_Text_HikerDuringAfter
source:
Don't tell anyone, {PLAYER},
But I saw that temple on\lthe mountaintop when I first\ldiscovered this place.\pI kept it to myself.\pI've blabbed enough about
these ruins.\pIt seems like everything worked
out, at least.$
translation: 别告诉任何人哦，{PLAYER}，\n其实我第一次发现这里的时候，\l就在山顶上看到那座神殿了。\p不过我把它藏在心底，谁都没说。\p关于这处遗迹，我多嘴说出去的\n已经够多的了。\p不过至少，现在看起来一切顺利。$

label: SinjohRuins_Lab_Text_Note1
source:
Research Log 1: May 3, 1975\pWe've arrived at the location
of the ruins.\pThe harsh cold of Mt.Silver
can be felt from all the way\ldown here...\pSoon the main excavation team
will make it through the mountain..\lI cannot wait to see what waits for us\lunderneath our feet!$
translation: 调查日志1：1975年5月3日\p我们已经抵达了遗迹所在地。\p就连在这么深的谷底，\n也能感受到白银山的刺骨严寒......\p不久之后主力发掘队\n就会打通山道赶来......\l我真迫不及待想看看我们的脚下\l究竟隐藏着什么了！$

label: SinjohRuins_Lab_Text_Note2
source:
Research Log 2:  May 10, 1975\pA week of digging has yielded
no result whatsoever.\pThe ice here is impossibly thick,
and the rock just breaks our\lequipment entirely.\pNot even MACHAMP was able to
make a dent.\pWhat is this place?\pWe must find out.$
translation: 调查日志2：1975年5月10日\p挖掘进行了一周，毫无所获。\p这里的冰层厚得匪夷所思，\n坚硬的岩石把我们的设备全都崩坏了。\p就连怪力也无法\n对其造成丝毫损伤。\p这里到底是什么地方？\p我们一定要查个水落石出。$

label: SinjohRuins_Lab_Text_Note3
source:
Research Log 3:  May 14, 1975\pYou don't get ahead in life by
standing by and doing nothing.\pI'm just a worker.\pBut I had an idea of how we could
break through the ice.\pOr rather, melt through it.\pWe need FIRE-TYPE POKéMON and
lots of them.\pBut how will we get them here
all the way from SINNOH?$
translation: 调查日志3：1975年5月14日\p坐以待毙可成不了事。\p虽然我只是个普通工人，\p但我想到了一个突破冰层的办法。\p或者应该说，融化它的办法。\p我们需要火属性宝可梦，\n而且需要很多。\p但我们要怎么把它们\n从远在天边的神奥运送过来呢？$

label: SinjohRuins_Lab_Text_Note4
source:
Research Log 4:  May 21, 1975\pWe've been busy.\pMy idea worked to get us through
the ice. Only we didn't get the\lFIRE-TYPEs from back home.\pThe boss insisted we get them locally.\pWe found a hot spring by a nearby
village....\pAnd we took what we needed...\pI'm not proud of it. But sacrifices
are sometimes required for progress.\pSo, the ice is gone.\pThere are 6 chambers, and a sealed
temple in the center.\pThe architecture of the main 
structure indicates it may be of the\lthe ancient Celestica peoples...\pOur ancestors. Before they moved north.\pThe boss wants that temple open as
soon as possible...$
translation:
调查日志4：1975年5月21日\p我们忙得不可开交。\p我的办法起效了，我们突破了冰层。
只不过火属性宝可梦并不是从老家运来的。\p队长坚持要在当地就地取材。\p我们在附近村子旁的一处温泉......\p强行带走了我们需要的目标......\p我为此感到羞愧。但为了发展，
有时牺牲是不可避免的。\p总之，冰层融化了。\p这里有6处石室，中央矗立着
一座被封印的神殿。\p主体结构的建筑风格表明，
它可能出自古代神阖之民之手......\p也就是我们北迁之前的先祖。\p队长希望尽快打开那座神殿......$

label: SinjohRuins_Lab_Text_Note5
source:
Research Log 5:  June 2, 1975\pWe managed to get it open...\pI thought I'd be overjoyed...\pBut we lost good men in the blast
of energy that sprung from the\ltemple.\pNot to mention the POKéMON that
helped us get it open.\lGod rest their souls...\p........................\pRegardless.\pThe temple is open, but we are
only left with more questions.\pThere is no legendary POKéMON
inside. No treasure.\pOur supplies are starting to run
out and we have nothing to show\lfor our efforts...$
translation:
调查日志5：1975年6月2日\p我们终于把它打开了......\p我本以为自己会欣喜若狂......\p但从神殿中喷涌而出的能量冲击，
夺走了许多优秀同伴的生命。\p更别提那些帮我们开门的宝可梦了。\l愿它们的灵魂得以安息......\p..................\p不论如何。\p神殿是打开了，但留给我们的
只有更多的疑问。\p里面根本没有传说中的宝可梦，
也没有宝藏。\p我们的补给快要耗尽了，
而我们的付出却一无所获......$

label: SinjohRuins_Lab_Text_Note6
source: Research Log 6:  June 10, 1975\pThe expedition is done.\nThe rest of the men are packing up.\pBut I can't.\pI can't abandon this mission.\nNot after what we've lost.\pI'm going to stay behind.$
translation: 调查日志6：1975年6月10日\p调查结束了。\n其他人正在收拾行装。\p但我不能走。\p我无法放弃这项任务。\n在付出了如此惨痛的代价之后。\p我决定留下来。$

label: SinjohRuins_Lab_Text_Note7
source:
Research Log 7:  September 10, 1975\pIt's been months since we got
here. Since I got here.\pThe rest of the men are gone.\pNow it's just me and the
POKéMON we captured to help us\lwith the work.\pI've been training them to get
stronger.\pMy TYPHLOSION, most of all.\pWe must find out what's beneath
the temple.$
translation: 调查日志7：1975年9月10日\p距离我们来到这里已经过去了几个月。\n或者说，自我独自留在这里算起。\p其他人都已经离开了。\p现在这里只剩下我和那些\n为了干活而抓来的宝可梦。\p我一直在训练它们变强。\p尤其是我的火暴兽。\p我们必须查清神殿底下到底有什么。$

label: SinjohRuins_Lab_Text_Note8
source:
Research Log 8:  September 15, 1975\pFailure.\p......................\pMy POKéMON....\pTogether, all 6 of my POKéMON
were able to smash through
A false wall in the temple.\pBut it was waiting for us...\pSomething like a giant titan...\pThe energy it released was just
like what happened before.\pThey were all destroyed...\pAnd worst of all, that beast
sealed the wall back up.\pI can't go home.
They won't recognize me anymore...\pThis place has changed me...\pI'm going to talk with the
villagers.\pThey don't know what I've done.\pSince the other men are long
gone, they'll think I'm just a\llost hiker.\pThere is no place left for me
but here.$
translation:
调查日志8：1975年9月15日\p失败了。\p..................\p我的宝可梦们......\p在我的全部6只宝可梦齐心协力下，
终于击碎了神殿里的一堵暗墙。\p但它就在那里等着我们......\p一个形同巨神般的怪物......\p它释放出的能量与上次如出一辙。\p它们全军覆没了......\p最可怕的是，那只怪物
把暗墙重新封印了起来。\p我回不去了。
大家再也认不出我了......\p这个地方彻底改变了我......\p我打算去和村民们谈谈。\p他们并不知道我都做了些什么。\p既然其他人早就离开了，
他们只会以为我是一个迷路的登山者。\p除了这里，我已无处可去。$

label: SinjohRuins_DisplayCase_Text
source: It's a display case neatly\npacked and lined with samples\land artifacts!$
translation: 这是一个陈列柜，\n里面整整齐齐地摆满了样本\l与文物！$

label: SinjohRuins_WallSign_Text
source: Xray and printing lab.$
translation: X光与冲印研究室。$

label: SinjohRuins_Artifact_Text
source: It's an artifact found from\ninside the ruins!$
translation: 这是在遗迹内部发现的文物！$

label: SinjohRuins_Lab_Text_PlayFlute
source: The AZURE FLUTE is reacting.\nPlay the flute?$
translation:
天界之笛有了反应。
要吹响笛子吗？$

label: SinjohRuins_Lab_Text_DropedItem
source: The NOBLE {STR_VAR_1} dropped\nan item...$
translation: 高贵的{STR_VAR_1}掉落了道具......$

label: SinjohRuins_Lab_Text_StevenName
source: STEVEN$
translation: 大吾$

label: SinjohRuins_Lab_Text_StevenCall3Plates
source:
STEVEN: {PLAYER}.\pWe felt a tremor at the ruins
just now.\pEveryone's fine, don't worry.\pIt's quite intriguing, one of the
subterranean chambers beneath the\lruins has sprung open.\pThe markings inside remind
me of something from HOENN.\pYou should come take a look
when you can.$
translation:
大吾：{PLAYER}。\p刚刚遗迹这里发生了震动。\p大家都没事，别担心。\p非常有意思的是，遗迹地下的
其中一间石室突然打开了。\p里面的刻印让我想起了
丰缘地区的某些东西。\p你有空的话，
不妨过来看一看。$

label: SinjohRuins_Lab_Text_StevenCall6Plates
source:
STEVEN: {PLAYER}.\pHow's the search going?\pWe had another tremor here.
A second chamber opened up\lthis time.\pI've asked our geologist to keep
his instruments ready in case it\lhappens again.\pThe deeper we dig... The more
questions we find.$
translation:
大吾：{PLAYER}。\p调查进展得如何了？\p我们这里又发生了一次震动。
这次打开了第二间石室。\p我已经让地质学家把仪器准备好，
以防再次发生震动。\p挖掘得越深......
未解之谜反而越多了。$

label: SinjohRuins_Lab_Text_StevenCall9Plates
source:
STEVEN: {PLAYER}.\pAnother tremor here at the ruins.\pThe data paints an intriguing
picture.\pIt wasn't an earthquake at all.\pSome kind of energy built up
underground and cracked the\lrock open from the inside.\pWhat could cause that...
I honestly don't know.$
translation:
大吾：{PLAYER}。\p遗迹这里又发生了一次震动。\p根据监测数据，
情况非常有趣。\p这根本就不是地震。\p某种积聚在地底的能量，
由内而外破开了岩石。\p究竟是什么引起的呢......
老实说，我也不清楚。$

label: SinjohRuins_Lab_Text_StevenCall12Plates
source:
STEVEN: {PLAYER}.\pAnother tremor. Another chamber
opening up.\pWe still can't figure out the
pattern behind the timing.\pSay, {PLAYER}... you're not
doing something to cause all\lthis, are you?\pNo, that can't be right.$
translation:
大吾：{PLAYER}。\p又是一次震动。又有石室被打开了。\p我们到现在还没能找出
其中的规律。\p话说回来，{PLAYER}......
引发这一切的，
该不会是你在做什么吧？\p不，应该不可能吧。$

label: SinjohRuins_Lab_Text_StevenCall15Plates
source: STEVEN: {PLAYER}.\pDid you just find another PLATE?\p.................\pOf course.\pThe legendary POKéMON lying\nin these ruins... they're responding\lto you, aren't they?\pAs if they want to be found.\pMy predictions usually come true.\nI should have known better than\lto doubt you.$
translation:
大吾：{PLAYER}。\p你刚才是不是又找到了石板？\p..................\p果然如此。\p长眠于这座遗迹中的传说的宝可梦......
是在回应你，对吧？\p就好像希望被你找到一样。\p我的直觉通常很准。
真不该怀疑你的。$

label: SinjohRuins_Lab_Text_StevenCall16Plates
source: STEVEN: {PLAYER}.\pWe're very close now. I can feel it.\p..................\pYou should come see this for\nyourself.$
translation: 大吾：{PLAYER}。\p我们离真相非常接近了。我能感觉得到。\p..................\p你最好亲自过来看看。$

label: SinjohRuins_Temple_Text_Mon
source: Some kind of ancient sensor.\nWhat is it looking for?$
translation: 似乎是某种古代感应装置。\n它到底在感应什么呢？$

label: SinjohRuins_Temple_Text_ScannerAlreadyDone
source: This sensor has already been activated.$
translation: 这个传感器已经被激活了。$

label: SinjohRuins_Temple_Text_Responds
source: The temple responds to your actions.$
translation: 神殿对你的行动产生了反应。$

label: SinjohRuins_Temple_Text_Door
source: The way is open.$
translation: 道路开启了。$

label: SlateportCity_Text_InterviewerSoCool
source: That lady interviewer is so cool\nand pretty.\pWhen I grow up, I'm going to be\nan international journalist!$
translation:
那位采访的大姐姐又酷又漂亮。\p等我长大了，
也要成为一名国际记者！$

label: SlateportCity_Text_CitySign
source: SLATEPORT CITY\p“The port where people and POKéMON\ncross paths.”$
translation: 凯那市\p"人与宝可梦交织往来的海港。"$

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainTorment
source:
That's, like, TM41, you know?
Hey, it's TORMENT, you hearing me?\pLike, it won't let the other guy
use the same move twice in a row, see?\pHey, now, you listen here, like,
I'm not laying a torment on you!$
translation:
那就是，呃，招式学习器41，懂吗？
喂，就是"无理取闹"，听到了吗？\p就是让对手不能连续使用
相同的招式，明白不？\p喂，你听我说啊，
我可没在对你无理取闹啊！$

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_hns_Text_CouldntFindMonForMe
source:
So, like, I couldn't find myself any
POKéMON that were, like, for me.\pSo, I figured, like, hey, I should file
a complaint to the guy there?\pAnd he wouldn't hear me out, like, hey!
So, like, total bummer, man!\pHey, like, you! Zip it, you know?
Just, you know, take this!$
translation:
所以说啊，我根本找不到
适合我的宝可梦。\p所以我就想，喂，我是不是该去
向那边的负责人投诉一下？\p结果他根本不听我说，喂！
真是太扫兴了，兄弟！\p喂，就是你！闭上嘴行不行？
赶紧的，把这个拿去！$

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_hns_Text_ExplainTorment
source:
That's, like, TM41, you know?
Hey, it's TORMENT, you hearing me?\pLike, it won't let the other guy
use the same move twice in a row, see?\pHey, now, you listen here, like,
I'm not laying a torment on you!$
translation:
那就是，呃，招式学习器41，懂吗？
喂，就是"无理取闹"，听到了吗？\p就是让对手不能连续使用
相同的招式，明白不？\p喂，你听我说啊，
我可没在对你无理取闹啊！$

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_hns_Text_IllTryUsingBugMons
source: I don't really like BUG POKéMON,\nbut maybe I'll try using some for\la change of pace.\pWho knows, I might even get to like\nthem!$
translation:
我其实不太喜欢虫属性宝可梦，
不过换换口味，用用看也不错。\p说不定，我还会渐渐喜欢上它们呢！$

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_hns_Text_BattleEvenWithoutToughMons
source: You can battle all you want here even\nif you don't have any tough POKéMON.$
translation:
就算没有强力的宝可梦，
在这里也能尽情对战。$

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_hns_Text_NiceIfMoreSelection
source: Wouldn't it be nice if they had more of\na selection?$
translation: 要是能有更多选择就好了，不是吗？$

label: SlateportCity_NameRatersHouse_Text_FineNameSuggestBetterOne
source: Hmmm… {STR_VAR_1}, is it? That is\nquite a fine name you bestowed.\pBut! What say you, if I were to\nsuggest a slightly better name?$
translation: 唔......叫{STR_VAR_1}是吧？\n起得相当不错嘛。\p不过！如果让我给它改一个\n稍微好听一点的名字，你意下如何？$

label: SlateportCity_NameRatersHouse_Text_NameNoDifferentYetSuperior
source: Done! From now on, this POKéMON\nshall be known as {STR_VAR_1}!\pIt looks no different from before,\nand yet, this is vastly superior!\pHow fortunate for you!$
translation: 搞定！从现在起，这只宝可梦\n的名字就叫做{STR_VAR_1}了！\p虽然看起来和之前一样，\n但这可是比原来大有长进哦！\p真是太幸运啦！$

label: SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_GiveMonMorePokeblocks
source:
Hmmm… It's not bad, but it's not
good, either…\pYou, the TRAINER, must put more
effort into raising this POKéMON!\pFor instance, may I suggest that
you give it more {POKEBLOCK}S?$
translation:
嗯......不算差，但也不算好......\p作为训练家，你必须在培育
这只宝可梦上付出更多努力！\p比如，建议你给它喂更多{POKEBLOCK}？$

label: SlowpokeWell_B1F_Text_KurtIntro
source:
KURT: Hey there, {PLAYER}!\pThe guard up top took off when
I shouted at him.\pBut then I took a tumble down
the WELL.\pI slammed down hard on my back,
so I can't move.\pRats! If I were fit, my POKéMON
would've punished them…\pAh, it can't be helped.\p{PLAYER}, show them how gutsy
you are in my place!$
translation:
钢铁：哎呀，{PLAYER}！\p我在上面吼了一嗓子，
看守的家伙就逃跑了。\p可是我一不留神摔进了井里。\p把腰给狠狠摔到了，
现在动弹不得。\p可恶！如果我的腰没事，
我的宝可梦早就把他们揍扁了......\p唉，真拿它没办法。\p{PLAYER}，替我好好教训他们，
让他们见识一下你的骨气！$

label: SlowpokeWell_B1F_Text_KurtAfter
source: KURT: Way to go, {PLAYER}!\pTEAM ROCKET has taken off.\pMy back's better too.\nLet's get out of here.$
translation:
钢铁：干得漂亮，{PLAYER}！\p火箭队全都逃跑了。\p我的腰也好多了。
我们赶紧离开这里吧。$

label: SlowpokeWell_B1F_Text_GruntM29Seen
source:
Darn! I was standing guard up
top when some old coot yelled\lat me.\pHe startled me so much that
I fell down here.\pI think I'll vent my anger by
taking it out on you!$
translation:
可恶！我本来在上面看守，
结果一个怪老头冲着我大吼大叫。\p吓得我一失足摔到了这里。\p看来我只能把这股火气
撒在你的身上了！$

label: SlowpokeWell_B1F_Text_GruntM29Beaten
source: Arrgh! This is NOT my day!$
translation: 啊啊啊！今天真是不走运！$

label: SlowpokeWell_B1F_Text_ProtonSeen
source: What do you want?\pIf you interrupt our work,\ndon't expect any mercy!$
translation:
你想干什么？\p敢来妨碍我们干活，
可别指望我们会手下留情！$

label: SlowpokeWell_B1F_Text_ProtonBeaten
source: You did OK today,\nbut wait till next time!$
translation:
今天算你厉害，
下次可就没这么走运了！$

label: SlowpokeWell_B1F_Text_ProtonAfter
source:
Yeah, TEAM ROCKET was broken up
three years ago.\pThe boss went into hiding.\pBut we continued our activities
underground!\pA small obstacle like you won't be
much of a problem for our mission.\pI advise you to be very afraid of
what is to come!$
translation:
没错，火箭队在3年前就解散了。\p老大也隐姓埋名躲了起来。\p但我们一直在地下秘密活动！\p像你这样的小绊脚石，
对我们的任务根本构不成威胁。\p我劝你最好好好害怕一下
接下来要发生的事吧！$

label: SlowpokeWell_B1F_Text_GruntM2Seen
source: Hyuck-hyuck-hyuck!\nQuit taking SLOWPOKETAILS?\pYou're nuts!\nIf we obeyed you, TEAM ROCKET's\lrep would be ruined!$
translation:
嗬嗬嗬！
叫我们别再割呆呆兽之尾？\p你脑子坏掉了吧！
要是听了你的话，\l火箭队的名声可就全毁了！$

label: SlowpokeWell_B1F_Text_GruntM2Beaten
source: Hyuck…\nToo strong…$

label: SlowpokeWell_B1F_Text_GruntM2After
source: We need the money,\nbut selling SLOWPOKETAILS?\pIt's tough being a ROCKET GRUNT!$
translation:
虽然我们需要钱，
但居然沦落到卖呆呆兽之尾......\p当个火箭队手下还真不容易啊！$

label: SlowpokeWell_B1F_Text_GruntF1Seen
source: Stop taking TAILS?\pYeah, just try to defeat all\nof us!$
translation: 不要割尾巴？\p行啊，有本事把我们全都打倒试试看！$

label: SlowpokeWell_B1F_Text_GruntF1Beaten
source: You rotten brat!$
translation: 你这个臭小鬼！$

label: SlowpokeWell_B1F_Text_GruntF1After
source: SLOWPOKETAILS grow back fast!\pWhat's wrong with selling them?$
translation: 呆呆兽之尾很快就会长出来的！\p拿来卖又有什么关系嘛！$

label: SlowpokeWell_B1F_Text_SlowpokeWithMail
source: A SLOWPOKE with its TAIL cut off…\pHuh? It has MAIL.\nRead it?$
translation:
尾巴被割掉的呆呆兽......\p嗯？它携带着邮件。
要阅读吗？$

label: SlowpokeWell_B1F_Text_SlowpokeMail
source: {PLAYER} read the MAIL.\pBe good and look after the\nhouse with Grandpa and SLOWPOKE.\pLove, Dad$
translation:
{PLAYER}读了邮件。\p要乖乖听话，
和爷爷还有呆呆兽一起看家哦。\p--爱你的爸爸上$

label: SlowpokeWell_B1F_Text_TaillessSlowpoke
source: A SLOWPOKE with its TAIL cut off…$
translation: 尾巴被割掉的呆呆兽......$

label: Snowswept_Cavern_Text_DroppedItem
source: The MACHAMP dropped an item...$
translation: 怪力掉落了一个道具......$

label: Snowswept_Text_Machamp_Cry
source: Mahh!!$
translation: 玛呼！！$

label: Snowswept_Text_Machamp_Plate
source: The MACHAMP seems to be holding\na PLATE in one of its hands.\pBattle it?$
translation:
怪力的一只手上
似乎拿着一块石板。\p要与它对战吗？$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_CitySign
source: SOOTOPOLIS CITY\p“The mystical city where history\nslumbers.”$
translation: 琉璃市\p"历史在此沉睡的神秘之城。"$

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_JuanIntro
source:
Let me ask you.
Did you know?\lAh, I should not be so coy.\pIt was I who taught WALLACE everything
there is to know about POKéMON.\pOnce, I had given up my position as
the GYM LEADER.\pIn my place, I had entrusted WALLACE
with the GYM.\pHowever, a compelling reason arose for
me to make a comeback.\pAh, but enough chatter.
Let us begin our match, shall we?\pPlease, you shall bear witness to
our artistry.\pA grand illusion of water sculpted
by POKéMON and myself!$
translation:
我问你，
你知道吗？\l啊，我不该这么卖关子。\p是我把有关宝可梦的一切
都传授给了米可利。\p曾几何时，我卸下了道馆馆主之职。\p并将道馆托付给了米可利。\p然而，出于一些不可抗拒的理由，
我重新复出了。\p啊，闲聊就到此为止吧。
开始我们的对战，如何？\p请务必见证我们的艺术。\p由我和宝可梦一同织就的、
宏伟的水之幻象！$

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_JuanRematchNeedTwoMons
source:
JUAN: Ah, this GYM had returned to its
usual state of serenity…\pBut our young typhoon has returned
to put us to the test again!\pWell, my friend, most certainly!
I shall be delighted to dance with you…\pAh, no, no, no.
You have with you but one POKéMON.\pI wish that you would return with
two, perhaps more, POKéMON, please.$
translation:
亚当：啊，这座道馆本已恢复了
往日的宁静......\p但我们年轻的台风又回来了，
想要再次考验我们！\p好啊，我的朋友，当然没问题！
我很乐意与你共舞......\p啊，不、不、不行。
你身上只带了1只宝可梦呢。\p希望你能带上2只或更多的宝可梦
再来找我，拜托了。$

label: SootopolisCity_MysteryEventsHouse_1F_Text_StrVar1Tie
source: {STR_VAR_1}$
translation: {STR_VAR_1}$

label: SootopolisCity_MysteryEventsHouse_1F_Text_StrVar1Won
source: {STR_VAR_1}$
translation: {STR_VAR_1}$

label: SootopolisCity_MysteryEventsHouse_1F_Text_StrVar1Lost
source: {STR_VAR_1}$
translation: {STR_VAR_1}$

label: SproutTower_Text_SageChow_Seen
source: We stand guard in this tower.\pHere, we express our gratitude\nto honor all POKéMON.$
translation:
我们在塔中修行守护。\p在这里，我们向所有的宝可梦
表达感激与崇敬之情。$

label: SproutTower_Text_SageChow_Beaten
source: Th-Thank you!$
translation: 多、多谢指教！$

label: SproutTower_Text_SageChow_AfterBattle
source: All living beings coexist\nthrough cooperation.\pWe must always be thankful\nfor this.$
translation:
所有的生灵
都是在互相扶持中共存。\p我们必须时刻
对此心怀感激。$

label: SproutTower_Text_1F_Sage1
source: Only if you reach the top will\nyou obtain an HM.$
translation:
只有登上塔顶，
才能获得秘传学习器。$

label: SproutTower_Text_1F_Sage2
source: SPROUT TOWER was built long ago\nas a place for POKéMON training.$
translation:
喇叭芽之塔是很久以前
为了修行宝可梦而建造的。$

label: SproutTower_Text_1F_Granny
source: A BELLSPROUT over 100 feet\ntall…\pPeople say that it became the\ncenter pillar here.$
translation: 高达100英尺的喇叭芽......\p人们都说它化作了这里的\n中心支柱。$

label: SproutTower_Text_1F_Teacher
source: See the pillar shaking?\pPeople are training upstairs.$
translation: 看到柱子在摇晃了吗？\p有人正在楼上修行呢。$

label: SproutTower_Text_1F_Statue
source: A POKéMON statue…\pIt looks very distinguished.$
translation: 宝可梦的雕像......\p看起来非常庄严气派。$

label: SproutTower_Text_SageNico_Seen
source: However hard we battle,\nthe TOWER will stand strong.$
translation: 无论对战多么激烈，\n这座高塔都会屹立不倒。$

label: SproutTower_Text_SageNico_Beaten
source: I fought hard but I'm too weak.$
translation: 我拼尽了全力，但还是太弱了。$

label: SproutTower_Text_SageNico_AfterBattle
source: The flexible pillar protects the\nTOWER, even from earthquakes.$
translation: 柔软而富有弹性的支柱保护着高塔，\n即使面对地震也安然无恙。$

label: SproutTower_Text_SageEdmond_Seen
source: …Sway like leaves in the wind…$

label: SproutTower_Text_SageEdmond_Beaten
source: Oh, I'm weak!$
translation: 哎呀，是我太弱了！$

label: SproutTower_Text_SageEdmond_AfterBattle
source: I tried to copy BELLSPROUT's\ngentle movements for battle…\pBut I didn't train well enough.$
translation: 我试图模仿喇叭芽柔软的动作\n来进行对战......\p但我的修行还远远不够。$

label: SproutTower_Text_2F_Statue
source: A POKéMON statue…\pIt looks very distinguished.$
translation: 宝可梦的雕像......\p看起来非常庄严气派。$

label: SproutTower_Text_ElderLecturesRival
source:
ELDER: You are indeed skilled
as a trainer.\pAs promised, here is your HM.\pBut let me say this: You should
treat your POKéMON better.\pThe way you battle is far too
harsh.\pPOKéMON are not tools of war…$
translation: 长老：作为训练家，\n你的本领确实了得。\p按照约定，这个秘传学习器给你。\p但我有一言相劝：你应该\n对自己的宝可梦更好一些。\p你的对战方式实在太残酷了。\p宝可梦可不是战斗的工具......$

label: SproutTower_Text_RivalOnlyCaresStrong
source:
…
…Humph!\pHe claims to be the ELDER but
he's weak.\pIt stands to reason.\pI'd never lose to fools who babble
about being nice to POKéMON.\pI only care about strong
POKéMON that can win.\pI really couldn't care less
about weak POKéMON.$
translation:
......
......哼！\p自称是什么长老，
实力不过如此。\p这也难怪。\p成天把"要善待宝可梦"挂在嘴边的蠢货，
我怎么可能会输给他们。\p我只在乎能打赢的强力宝可梦。\p弱小的宝可梦，
我根本不屑一顾。$

label: SproutTower_Text_RivalUsedEscapeRope
source: {RIVAL} used an ESCAPE ROPE!$
translation: {RIVAL}使用了脱洞绳！$

label: SproutTower_Text_SageLi_Seen
source:
So good of you to come here!\pSPROUT TOWER is a place of
training.\pPeople and POKéMON test their
bonds to build a bright future\ltogether.\pI am the final test.\pAllow me to check the ties
between your POKéMON and you!$
translation: 欢迎你的到来！\p喇叭芽之塔是一处修行之地。\p人与宝可梦在这里考验彼此的羁绊，\n共同开创光明的未来。\p我就是最后的考验。\p让我来见识一下\n你与宝可梦之间的羁绊吧！$

label: SproutTower_Text_SageLi_Beaten
source: Ah, excellent!$
translation: 啊，精彩绝伦！$

label: SproutTower_Text_SageLi_TakeFlash
source: You and your POKéMON should\nhave no problem using this move.\pTake this FLASH HM.$
translation: 你和你的宝可梦一定能\n熟练运用这个招式。\p收下这个闪光秘传学习器吧。$

label: SproutTower_Text_SageLi_FlashExplain
source: FLASH illuminates even the\ndarkest of all places.\pBut to use it out of battle, you\nneed the BADGE from VIOLET's GYM.$
translation: 闪光能照亮最漆黑的地方。\p但要在对战外使用它，\n你需要桔梗道馆的徽章。$

label: SproutTower_Text_SageLi_AfterBattle
source: I hope you learn and grow from\nyour journey.$
translation: 愿你在旅途中不断学习与成长。$

label: SproutTower_Text_SageJin_Seen
source: I train to find enlightenment\nin POKéMON!$
translation: 我为了从宝可梦中悟道而修行！$

label: SproutTower_Text_SageJin_Beaten
source: My training is incomplete…$
translation: 我的修行还未到家......$

label: SproutTower_Text_SageJin_AfterBattle
source: As POKéMON grow stronger,\nso does the trainer.\pNo, wait. As the trainer\ngrows stronger, so do the\lPOKéMON.$
translation: 宝可梦变强，\n训练家也会跟着变强。\p不，等等。应该是训练家变强了，\n宝可梦才会跟着变强。$

label: SproutTower_Text_SageTroy_Seen
source: Let me see how much you trust\nyour POKéMON.$
translation: 让我看看你有多信任\n自己的宝可梦。$

label: SproutTower_Text_SageTroy_Beaten
source: Yes, your trust is real!$
translation: 确实，你们之间的信赖是真的！$

label: SproutTower_Text_SageTroy_AfterBattle
source: It is not far to the ELDER.$
translation: 长老就在前面不远处了。$

label: SproutTower_Text_SageNeal_Seen
source: The ELDER's HM lights even\npitch-black darkness.$
translation: 长老的秘传学习器能照亮\n伸手不见五指的黑暗。$

label: SproutTower_Text_SageNeal_Beaten
source: It is my head that is bright!$
translation: 明明是我的光头更亮吧！$

label: SproutTower_Text_SageNeal_AfterBattle
source: Let there be light on your\njourney.$
translation: 愿你的旅途充满光明。$

label: SproutTower_Text_3F_Painting
source: It's a powerful painting of a\nBELLSPROUT.$
translation:
这是一幅气势磅礴的
喇叭芽画像。$

label: SSAnne_2F_Corridor_Text_RivalVictory
source: {PLAYER}..！\nふなよい　してるのか！\pもっと　からだ\nきたえた　ほうが　いいぜ！$
translation:
{PLAYER}......！
你晕船了吗！\p最好多去
锻炼锻炼身体吧！$

label: SSAqua_1F_Text_Sailor1_ToVermilion
source: FAST SHIP S.S.AQUA is en route to\nVERMILION CITY.\pWe will make an announcement when\nwe arrive.$
translation:
高速船阿夸号正在开往
枯叶市。\p到达时我们会广播通知。$

label: SSAqua_1F_Text_Sailor1_ToOlivine
source: FAST SHIP S.S.AQUA is en route to\nOLIVINE CITY.\pWe will make an announcement when\nwe arrive.$
translation:
高速船阿夸号正在开往
浅黄市。\p到达时我们会广播通知。$

label: SSAqua_1F_Text_Sailor2_FirstTime
source: Here's your cabin.\pIf your POKéMON are hurt, take a\nnap in the bed.\pThat will heal them.$
translation:
这是您的客舱。\p如果宝可梦受伤了，可以在床上
睡上一觉。\p这样就能让它们恢复活力了。$

label: SSAqua_1F_Text_Sailor3
source: The passengers are all trainers.\pThey're all itching to battle in\ntheir cabins.$
translation:
这里的乘客全都是训练家。\p他们都在各自的客舱里
跃跃欲试地想要对战呢。$

label: SSAqua_1F_Text_Grandpa
source: Whoa! Excuse me. I was in a hurry!\pMy granddaughter is missing!\pShe's just a wee girl. If you see\nher, please let me know!$
translation:
哇！不好意思，我赶时间！\p我的小孙女不见了！\p她还是个小女孩。要是看到她，
请一定要告诉我！$

label: SSAqua_1F_Text_Sailor1_InOlivine
source: FAST SHIP S.S.AQUA has arrived in\nOLIVINE CITY.$
translation:
高速船阿夸号已抵达
浅黄市。$

label: SSAqua_1F_Text_Sailor1_InVermilion
source: FAST SHIP S.S.AQUA has arrived in\nVERMILION CITY.$
translation:
高速船阿夸号已抵达
枯叶市。$

label: SSAqua_1F_Text_SailorDoorArrived
source: We have arrived in VERMILION CITY.\nWould you like to disembark?$
translation:
我们已经抵达枯叶市了。
您要下船吗？$

label: SSAqua_B1F_Text_BarfCan
source: Yuck!\nShouldn't have looked!$
translation:
呃！
真不该看的！$

label: SSAqua_B1F_Text_FastShipOnDutySailor
source:
Hey, kid. Could I get you to
look for my buddy?\pHe's goofing off somewhere,
that lazy bum!\pI want to go find him, but I'm
on duty right now.$
translation:
喂，小朋友。能帮我
找找我的同伴吗？\p那个懒骨头，
不知道又溜去哪里摸鱼了！\p虽然我也想去找他，
但我现在还在当班呢。$

label: SSAqua_B1F_Text_FastShipOnDutySailorRefused
source: Oh, gee…\pThe CAPTAIN will be furious…$
translation: 哎呀，糟了......\p船长一定会大发雷霆的......$

label: SSAqua_B1F_Text_FastShipOnDutySailorThanks
source: Thanks, kid! I chewed him out\ngood so he'll quit slacking off!$
translation:
谢啦，小朋友！我狠狠训了他一顿，
这下他可不敢再偷懒了！$

label: SSAqua_B1F_Text_FastShipOnDutySailorSawGirl
source: A little girl?\pI may have seen her go by here.$
translation: 小女孩？\p我好像看到她从这里经过了。$

label: SSAqua_B1F_Text_FastShipOnDutySailorDirections
source: The dining room is up ahead.\pThe stairs at the end lead to\nthe CAPTAIN's cabin.$
translation:
前方是餐厅。\p尽头的楼梯通往
船长室。$

label: SSAqua_B1F_Text_SailorJeffSeen
source: Nothing beats a battle when\nI'm on my break.$
translation:
休息时间来场对战，
简直再爽不过了。$

label: SSAqua_B1F_Text_SailorJeffBeaten
source: Win or lose, my break's over!$
translation: 输赢无所谓，我的休息时间结束了！$

label: SSAqua_B1F_Text_SailorJeffAfter
source: I guess I can't win if I don't\nget serious.$
translation: 看来不认真起来的话，确实赢不了呢。$

label: SSAqua_B1F_Text_PicnickerDebraSeen
source: I'm so bored. Want to battle?$
translation: 好无聊啊。要来对战吗？$

label: SSAqua_B1F_Text_PicnickerDebraBeaten
source: Yow! You're too strong!$
translation: 哎呀！你也太强了吧！$

label: SSAqua_B1F_Text_PicnickerDebraAfter
source: SAFFRON, CELADON… I hear there\nare many big cities in KANTO.$
translation:
金黄市、玉虹市......听说
关都地区有很多大城市呢。$

label: SSAqua_B1F_Text_JugglerFritzSeen
source: Urrf… I'm seasick!$
translation: 呃呕......我晕船了！$

label: SSAqua_B1F_Text_JugglerFritzBeaten
source: I can't move anymore…$
translation: 我已经一步也走不动了......$

label: SSAqua_B1F_Text_JugglerFritzAfter
source: No more ships for me.\nNext time,\pI'm taking the MAGNET TRAIN.$
translation: 我再也不坐船了。\n下次，\p我一定要坐磁浮列车。$

label: SSAqua_B1F_Text_SailorGarrettSeen
source: This is where we sailors work!$
translation: 这里可是我们水手工作的地方！$

label: SSAqua_B1F_Text_SailorGarrettBeaten
source: I lost on my home field…$
translation: 在自己的主场居然输了......$

label: SSAqua_B1F_Text_SailorGarrettAfter
source: We get different passengers\nfrom VERMILION CITY to\pOLIVINE CITY.$
translation: 从枯叶市到浅黄市之间，\n每次搭载的乘客都\p各不相同呢。$

label: SSAqua_B1F_Text_FisherJonahSeen
source: Even though we're out on the\nsea, I can't fish!\pThis is boring! Let's battle!$
translation: 明明都出到海上了，却不能钓鱼！\p好无聊啊！来对战吧！$

label: SSAqua_B1F_Text_FisherJonahBeaten
source: I… I'm not bored anymore…$

label: SSAqua_B1F_Text_FisherJonahAfter
source: I plan to fish off\nVERMILION's pier.$
translation: 我打算去枯叶市的\n码头上钓鱼。$

label: SSAqua_B1F_Text_BlackbeltWaiSeen
source: I'm building up my legs by\nbracing\pagainst the ship's rocking!$
translation: 我顶着船身的摇晃死撑着，\n以此\p来锻炼我的下盘呢！$

label: SSAqua_B1F_Text_BlackbeltWaiBeaten
source: Rocked and rolled over!$
translation: 彻底被晃翻了！$

label: SSAqua_B1F_Text_BlackbeltWaiAfter
source: I couldn't find the KARATE KING\nin JOHTO.\pHe's supposed to be training in\na cave somewhere.$
translation: 我在城都找不到空手道大王。\p听说他正在\n某个洞窟里修行呢。$

label: SSAqua_B1F_Text_SailorKennethSeen
source: I'm a sailor man!\pBut I'm training POKéMON, so I\ncan become the CHAMP!$
translation: 我是一个水手！\p不过我也在训练宝可梦，\n为了能成为冠军！$

label: SSAqua_B1F_Text_SailorKennethBeaten
source: My lack of training is obvious…$
translation: 显然是我欠缺修行啊......$

label: SSAqua_B1F_Text_SailorKennethAfter
source: Eight BADGES! They must prove\nthat you've beaten\pGYM LEADERS.\pNo wonder you're so good!$
translation: 8枚徽章！这肯定能证明\n你击败了\p道馆馆主们。\p怪不得你实力这么强！$

label: SSAqua_B1F_Text_TeacherShirleySeen
source: Don't lay a finger on my\nstudents!$
translation: 休想碰我的学生一根手指！$

label: SSAqua_B1F_Text_TeacherShirleyBeaten
source: Aaack!$
translation: 啊呀！$

label: SSAqua_B1F_Text_TeacherShirleyAfter
source: We're on a field trip to the\nRUINS outside VIOLET.$
translation: 我们是来桔梗市郊外的\n遗迹进行校外教学的。$

label: SSAqua_B1F_Text_SchoolboyNateSeen
source: Do you know the RUINS OF ALPH?$
translation: 你知道阿露福遗迹吗？$

label: SSAqua_B1F_Text_SchoolboyNateBeaten
source: Yaargh!$
translation: 哇啊！$

label: SSAqua_B1F_Text_SchoolboyNateAfter
source: Radios pick up strange signals\ninside the RUINS.$
translation: 在遗迹里面，\n收音机会接收到奇怪的信号。$

label: SSAqua_B1F_Text_SchoolboyRickySeen
source: There are some odd stone panels\nin the RUINS OF ALPH.$
translation: 阿露福遗迹里\n有一些奇怪的石板。$

label: SSAqua_B1F_Text_SchoolboyRickyBeaten
source: I was done in!$
translation: 被打得落花流水！$

label: SSAqua_B1F_Text_SchoolboyRickyAfter
source: I read that there are four of\nthose stone panels.$
translation: 我曾在书上读到过，\n那种石板一共有4处呢。$

label: SSAqua_CaptainsRoom_Text_GranddaughterCaptainPlayWithMe
source: CAPTAIN, play with me, please?\pI'm bored! I want to play more!$
translation: 船长，陪我玩嘛，好不好？\p好无聊啊！我还想再玩一会儿！$

label: SSAqua_CaptainsRoom_Text_GranddaughterHasToFindGrandpa
source: Hi! Will you play with me?\p…Oh!\pGrandpa's worried about me?\pI have to go!\pI have to go find Grandpa!$
translation: 嗨！你来陪我玩吗？\p......啊！\p爷爷在担心我吗？\p我得走了！\p我得快点去找爷爷才行！$

label: SSAqua_CaptainsRoom_Text_CaptainExhausting
source: Whew! Thanks for coming along.\pKeeping that little girl amused\nwas exhausting.$
translation: 呼！多亏你赶过来了。\p哄那个小姑娘开心\n真是累死我了。$

label: SSAqua_CaptainsRoom_Text_CaptainHowDoYouLike
