source: How do you like S.S.AQUA's ride?\pShe practically skates across\nthe waves.$
translation: 坐水号的感觉如何？\p她简直就像在浪花上\n滑行一样呢。$

label: SSAquaRooms_Text_TakeRestOnBed_PokecenterChallenge
source: Sorry, you are playing with\nthe POKéCENTER challenge!$
translation: 抱歉，你正在进行\n宝可梦中心挑战！$

label: SSAquaRooms_Text_TakeRestOnBed
source: There's a bed…\nLet's take a rest.$
translation: 这里有张床......\n好好休息一下吧。$

label: SSAqua_RoomNE_Text_HikerNolandSeen
source: Are you alone?\nThen let's battle!$
translation: 你是一个人吗？\n那就来对战吧！$

label: SSAqua_RoomNE_Text_HikerNolandBeaten
source: That's too much to handle!$
translation: 根本招架不住啊！$

label: SSAqua_RoomNE_Text_HikerNolandAfterBattle
source: I wonder if there are any\nmountains worth climbing in KANTO?$
translation: 不知道关都\n有没有值得一爬的名山呢？$

label: SSAqua_RoomNE_Text_PokemaniacEthanSeen
source: Do you know LILY?\nShe's a hot DJ in KANTO.$
translation: 你知道莉莉吗？\n她是关都当红的DJ哦。$

label: SSAqua_RoomNE_Text_PokemaniacEthanBeaten
source: Gyaaaah!$
translation: 哇啊啊啊！$

label: SSAqua_RoomNE_Text_PokemaniacEthanAfterBattle
source:
LILY's nice, but
MARY's the best!
I want to check
out JOHTO's radio
programs!$
translation:
莉莉固然不错，
但玛丽才是最棒的！
好想听听看
城都那边的
广播节目啊！$

label: SSAqua_RoomNNE_Text_CooltrainermSeanSeen
source: I'm going to KANTO\nto test my skills.$
translation: 我正要去关都\n检验自己的实力。$

label: SSAqua_RoomNNE_Text_CooltrainermSeanBeaten
source: I wanted to win!$
translation: 好想赢啊！$

label: SSAqua_RoomNNE_Text_CooltrainermSeanAfterBattle
source: Trainers from JOHTO\ncan battle with KANTO\lGYM LEADERS.$
translation: 来自城都的训练家\n也可以挑战关都的\l道馆馆主呢。$

label: SSAqua_RoomNNE_Text_CooltrainerfCarolSeen
source: I'm training to\nbecome the CHAMP!$
translation: 我正为了成为冠军\n而努力修行！$

label: SSAqua_RoomNNE_Text_CooltrainerfCarolBeaten
source: What's so different\nbetween us?$
translation: 我们之间的差距\n到底在哪里？$

label: SSAqua_RoomNNE_Text_CooltrainerfCarolAfterBattle
source: I'm going to beat\nyou someday!$
translation: 总有一天\n我会打败你的！$

label: SSAqua_RoomNW_Text_SailorStanlySeen
source: Yeah, I'm a sailor, all right.\pI wasn't goofing off!\pThis cabin was vacant, so I\njust took a quick nap!\pAh, forget it! Let's battle!$
translation: 没错，我就是水手啦。\p我可没在偷懒哦！\p这间客舱正好空着，\n我只是稍微打了个盹！\p啊，算了！来对战吧！$

label: SSAqua_RoomNW_Text_SailorStanlyBeaten
source: Sorry! It's all my fault!$
translation: 对不起！都是我的错！$

label: SSAqua_RoomNW_Text_SailorStanlyAfterBattle
source: Being a sailor, I have to do\nphysical labor. It's exhausting!$
translation: 当水手净是些体力活，\n真是累死人了！$

label: SSAqua_RoomNW_Text_GentlemanEdwardSeen
source: Oh, no. I've lost something\nthat's very important.$
translation: 哎呀糟了，我把非常重要的\n东西给弄丢了。$

label: SSAqua_RoomNW_Text_GentlemanEdwardBeaten
source: I… I can't find it…$

label: SSAqua_RoomNW_Text_GentlemanEdwardAfterBattle
source: I give up. You don't have to\nlook.\pJust forget about it!$
translation: 我放弃了。你也不用找了。\p彻底忘掉这事吧！$

label: SSAqua_RoomNW_Text_BurglarCoreySeen
source: Yeehaw! Lucky!$
translation: 哟嚯！运气真好！$

label: SSAqua_RoomNW_Text_BurglarCoreyBeaten
source: How unlucky! I lost!$
translation: 真倒霉！输掉了！$

label: SSAqua_RoomNW_Text_BurglarCoreyAfterBattle
source: I found a pretty coin here.\pSomeone must have lost it…$
translation: 我在这里捡到了一枚漂亮的硬币。\p一定是有人不小心弄丢的......$

label: SSAqua_RoomSE_Text_PokefanmColinSeen
source: Hey, kid! Want to battle\nwith me?$
translation: 嘿，小鬼！\n想跟我对战吗？$

label: SSAqua_RoomSE_Text_PokefanmColinBeaten
source: You're strong!$
translation: 你好强！$

label: SSAqua_RoomSE_Text_PokefanmColinAfter
source: You're traveling all alone?\nIsn't your mom worried?$
translation: 你一个人在旅行吗？\n妈妈不担心你吗？$

label: SSAqua_RoomSE_Text_TwinsMegandpeg1Seen
source: You think I'm a baby?\nThat's not fair!$
translation: 你以为我是小宝宝吗？\n太不公平了！$

label: SSAqua_RoomSE_Text_TwinsMegandpeg1Beaten
source: Oh! We lost!$
translation: 哎呀！输掉了！$

label: SSAqua_RoomSE_Text_TwinsMegandpeg1After
source: Baby is a rude name to call\nus girls!$
translation: 把我们女孩子叫做小宝宝，\n太没礼貌了！$

label: SSAqua_RoomSE_Text_TwinsMegandpeg2Seen
source: I'm not a baby!\nThat's not nice to say to a lady!$
translation: 我才不是小宝宝！\n对淑女这么说太失礼了！$

label: SSAqua_RoomSE_Text_TwinsMegandpeg2Beaten
source: Oh! We lost!$
translation: 哎呀！输掉了！$

label: SSAqua_RoomSE_Text_TwinsMegandpeg2After
source: Sometimes, kids are smarter\nthan grown-ups!$
translation: 有时候，小孩子比大人\n还要聪明呢！$

label: SSAqua_RoomSSE_Text_CantFindGranddaughter
source:
Oh, hello…\pI still can't find my
granddaughter.\pIf she's on the ship,
that's OK.\pShe's an energetic child,
so she may be bugging someone\lI'm worried…$
translation: 哎呀，你好......\p我还是找不到我的孙女。\p如果她还在船上倒还好......\p她是个精力旺盛的孩子，\n真担心她会不会给别人添麻烦了......\l好担心啊......$

label: SSAqua_RoomSSE_Text_EntertainedGranddaughter
source: {PLAYER}, was it?\nI heard you entertained my\lgranddaughter.\pI want to thank you for that.$
translation: 是叫{PLAYER}对吧？\n我听说是你陪我孙女玩的。\p真是太感谢你了。$

label: SSAqua_RoomSSE_Text_GrandpaHaveThis
source: I know! I'd like you\nto have this!$
translation: 对了！这个送给你吧！$

label: SSAqua_RoomSSE_Text_GrandpaTravelling
source: We're traveling around\nthe world.$
translation: 我们正在周游世界呢。$

label: SSAqua_RoomSSE_Text_GranddaughterWasPlaying
source: Grandpa, here I am!\nI was playing with\lthe CAPTAIN and this person!$
translation: 爷爷，我在这里！\n我刚才和船长还有\l这个人一起玩呢！$

label: SSAqua_RoomSSE_Text_GranddaughterHadFun
source: I had lots of fun playing!$
translation: 我玩得可开心了！$

label: SSAqua_RoomSSW_Text_FirebreatherLyleSeen
source: I'm going to KANTO to put\non fire-breathing shows!$
translation: 我要去关都表演喷火特技！$

label: SSAqua_RoomSSW_Text_FirebreatherLyleBeaten
source: Fizzle… The flame's tiny…$

label: SSAqua_RoomSSW_Text_FirebreatherLyleAfterBattle
source: I guess fire is weak on the sea.\nIt doesn't matter? Really?$
translation: 看来在海上火势会变弱啊。\n跟这没关系？真的假的？$

label: SSAqua_RoomSSW_Text_BugCatcherKenSeen
source: I'm visiting my grandma to\ncatch me some bugs!$
translation: 我要去奶奶家抓虫宝可梦！$

label: SSAqua_RoomSSW_Text_BugCatcherKenBeaten
source: Ooh, wow. You're tough!$
translation: 哇啊，你好厉害！$

label: SSAqua_RoomSSW_Text_BugCatcherKenAfterBattle
source: You can find lots of POKéMON\nin the trees of JOHTO!$
translation: 在城都的树上\n能找到好多宝可梦呢！$

label: SSAqua_RoomSW_Text_BeautyCassieSeen
source: I'm trying to forget my woes.\nLet's battle!$
translation: 我想忘掉伤心事。\n来对战吧！$

label: SSAqua_RoomSW_Text_BeautyCassieBeaten
source: My heart weeps…$
translation: 我的心在哭泣......$

label: SSAqua_RoomSW_Text_BeautyCassieAfterBattle
source: A voyage is best for getting over\na broken heart.\pBut a FAST SHIP trip is too short\nfor grieving.$
translation: 航海是治愈失恋最好的良药。\p但这高速船的旅途太短了，\n悲伤都还没来得及消散呢。$

label: SSAqua_RoomSW_Text_GuitaristClydeSeen
source: I'm going to audition my songs\nat GOLDENROD's RADIO STATION.$
translation: 我要去满金电台\n为我的新歌试音呢。$

label: SSAqua_RoomSW_Text_GuitaristClydeBeaten
source: Yowza! Total distortion!$
translation: 哇哦！彻底跑调了！$

label: SSAqua_RoomSW_Text_GuitaristClydeAfterBattleMobile
source: I was going to make my debut at\nthe BATTLE TOWER…\pI should go back to VERMILION and\nredo my training…$
translation: 我原本还打算在对战塔上出道呢......\p看来我得先回枯叶市\n重新修行一番了......$

label: SSAqua_RoomSW_Text_GuitaristClydeAfterBattle
source: Speaking of the RADIO STATION,\nwhat's this week's lucky number?$
translation: 说到广播电台，\n这周的幸运号码是多少啊？$

label: ThreeIsland_Text_Biker2PostBattle
source: What's the matter with you,\ngetting all hot like that?\pTotally uncool, man!$
translation: 你怎么回事啊，\n突然发这么大脾气？\p真是一点都不帅气，老兄！$

label: TinTower_1F_Sage1_Text
source:
According to legend…
When the souls of POKéMON and humans\pcommune, from the heavens descends a
POKéMON of rainbow colors…\pCould it mean the legendary POKéMON
are testing us humans?$
translation:
据传说......
当宝可梦与人类的心灵\p产生共鸣之时，彩虹色的宝可梦
便会从天而降......\p难道说传说的宝可梦，
是在试炼我们人类吗？$

label: TinTower_1F_Sage2_Text
source:
When the BRASS TOWER burned down,
three nameless POKéMON were said\lto have perished. It was tragic.\pHowever…\pA rainbow-colored POKéMON…
In other words…\pHO-OH descended from the sky and
gave new life to the three POKéMON.\pThey are…
SUICUNE, ENTEI and RAIKOU.\pThat is what they say.$
translation:
钟之塔被烧毁之时，
据说有三只无名宝可梦丧生其中。\l真是场悲剧啊。\p然而......\p一只彩虹色的宝可梦......
换句话说......\p凤王从天而降，
赋予了那三只宝可梦新的生命。\p它们就是......
水君、炎帝和雷公。\p传说就是这么流传的。$

label: TinTower_1F_Sage3_Text
source: The two TOWERS are said to have been\nbuilt to foster friendship and\phope between POKéMON and people.\nThat was 700 years ago, but the ideal\pstill remains important today.$
translation: 据说这两座塔的建造，\n是为了寄托宝可梦与人类之间的\p友谊与希望。\n虽然那是700年前的事了，但这份信念\p在今天依然至关重要。$

label: TinTower_1F_Sage4_Text1
source: HO-OH appears to have descended\nupon this, the TIN TOWER!$
translation: 凤王似乎已经降临到了\n这座铃铛塔上！$

label: TinTower_1F_Sage4_Text2
source: The legendary POKéMON are said\nto embody three powers…\pThe lightning that struck the TOWER.\nThe fire that burned the TOWER.\pAnd the rain that put out the fire…$
translation: 据说传说的宝可梦\n化身为了三种力量......\p击中塔的雷电、\n燃烧塔的烈火，\p以及浇灭烈火的风雨......$

label: TinTower_1F_Sage6_Text2
source:
Of the legendary POKéMON, SUICUNE
is said to be the closest to HO-OH.\pI hear there may also be a link to
POKéMON known as UNOWN.\pThe POKéMON UNOWN must be sharing a
cooperative bond with SUICUNE.$
translation:
在传说的宝可梦中，据说水君
与凤王之间的关系最为紧密。\p我还听说它可能与一种名为
未知图腾的宝可梦有所关联。\p未知图腾必定与水君
有着同舟共济的羁绊。$

label: TinTower_1F_EusineHoOh_Text
source:
I knew it.\pI knew you'd get to see the POKéMON
of rainbow colors, <PLAYER>.\pIt happened just as I envisioned.
My research isn't bad, I might say.\pI'm going to keep studying POKéMON
to become a famous POKéMANIAC!$
translation:
我就知道！\p我就知道你一定会见到
那只彩虹色的宝可梦，<PLAYER>。\p一切正如我所料。
我的研究还是蛮厉害的吧！\p为了成为著名的宝可梦狂，
我要继续努力研究宝可梦！$

label: TinTower_1F_EusineSuicune_Text
source:
EUSINE: Awesome! Too awesome, even!
I've never seen a battle that great.\pThat was truly inspiring to see.
SUICUNE was tough, but you were even\pmore incredible, <PLAYER>.
I heard SUICUNE's mystic power\psummons a rainbow-colored POKéMON.
Maybe, just maybe, what went on today\pwill cause that POKéMON to appear.
I'm going to study the legends more.\pThanks for showing me that fantastic
battle.\pLater, <PLAYER>!$
translation:
米那君：太精彩了！简直太不可思议了！
我从未见过如此精彩的对战。\p真是一场令人深受震撼的对决。
水君固然强大，但你更是\p令人叹服，<PLAYER>。
我听说水君不可思议的力量\p能唤来彩虹色的宝可梦。
也许，只是也许，今天的经历\p会让那只宝可梦显现身姿。
我要去更加深入地钻研传说了。\p谢谢你让我见识了这么精彩的对决。\p后会有期，<PLAYER>！$

label: TinTower_RoofDay_Text_Kimono_AfterNotCaught
source: You have not only made HO-OH\nappear, but you have also defeated\lit...\pThere is nothing more for us to\nsay. Take care of yourself in your\ljourney...$
translation: 你不仅唤来了凤王，\n甚至还击败了它......\p我们已经没有什么好嘱咐的了。\n旅途中请多保重......$

label: TinTower_RoofDay_Text_Kimono_AfterCaught
source: You have not only made HO-OH\nappear, but you have also caught\lit...\pThere is nothing more for us to\nsay. Take care of yourself in your\ljourney...$
translation: 你不仅唤来了凤王，\n甚至还将它收服了......\p我们已经没有什么好嘱咐的了。\n旅途中请多保重......$

label: TinTower_RoofDay_Text_Zuki_Before
source: ZUKI: Go, face HO-OH. $
translation: 玉绪：去吧，面对凤王。 $

label: TinTower_RoofDay_Text_Naoko_Before
source: NAOKO: Go, face HO-OH. $
translation: 桃子：去吧，面对凤王。 $

label: TinTower_RoofDay_Text_Miki_Before
source: MIKI: Go, face HO-OH. $
translation: 美树：去吧，面对凤王。 $

label: TinTower_RoofDay_Text_Sayo_Before
source: SAYO: Go, face HO-OH. $
translation: 小夜：去吧，面对凤王。 $

label: TinTower_RoofDay_Text_Kuni_Before
source: KUNI: Go, face HO-OH. $
translation: 小国：去吧，面对凤王。 $

label: TinTower_RoofDay_Text_Kimono_Opening
source:
KIMONO GIRL: That's right.
This is where we welcome HO-OH.\pWhen the dance we practiced many
days becomes one with the sound of the\pCLEAR BELL we entrusted to you, then
HO-OH shall come down from the great\larch of the sky once again. $
translation:
和服少女：正是如此。
这里就是迎接凤王的地方。\p当我们练习多日的舞蹈
与托付给你的透明铃铛之声合而为一，\p凤王便会再次自九天苍穹
降临于此。 $

label: TinTower_RoofDay_Text_Kimono_After
source: You have done a great job.\nSay hello to PROF.ELM for us.$
translation: 你做得很出色。\n请代我们向空木博士问好。$

label: TohjoFalls_GiovanniRoom_Text_RadioObject
source: A radio...\nThe battery is dead...$
translation: 是一台收音机......\n电池已经没电了......$

label: TohjoFalls_GiovanniRoom_Text_Radio
source: RADIO: ... ...\nAhem, we are TEAM ROCKET!\lAfter three years of preparation,\lwe have risen again from the ashes!\lGIOVANNI! Can you hear us?\lWe did it!\lWhere is our boss?\lIs he listening?$
translation: 收音机：...... ......\n咳咳，我们是火箭队！\l经过三年的潜心蛰伏，\l我们如今浴火重生了！\l坂木老大！您能听到吗？！\l我们成功了！\l我们的首领在哪？\l他有在听吗？！$

label: TohjoFalls_GiovanniRoom_Text_GiovanniIntro
source:
GIOVANNI: ...\pI don't know why you have come
here.\pAnyway, I have to warn you that
this is not a place for kids like\lyou.\pYou have a certain look.
It reminds me of the kid who stood\lin front of me three years ago...\pYou have the same eyes...\p...\pI'm on my way to GOLDENROD CITY
to answer the call and join my team.\lAre you going to get in my way?$
translation:
坂木：......\p我不知道你为何会来这里。\p不过，我必须警告你，
这里可不是你这种小鬼该来的地方。\p你的眼神......
让我想起了三年前\l站在我面前的那个小鬼......\p你们有着一模一样的眼神......\p......\p我正准备前往满金市，
回应呼唤并与我的部下汇合。\l你打算挡我的路吗？$

label: TohjoFalls_GiovanniRoom_Text_GiovanniBeforeBattle
source: My old associates need me...\nWe will not repeat the failure of\lthree years ago!$
translation: 曾经的同伴正在需要我......\n我们绝不会重蹈三年前的覆辙！$

label: TohjoFalls_GiovanniRoom_Text_GiovanniDefeat
source: What in the world are you?$
translation: 你这家伙到底是什么人？！$

label: TohjoFalls_GiovanniRoom_Text_GiovanniAfter
source:
GIOVANNI: How is this possible...?
The past three years have been a\lwaste...?\pHow can a kid like you manage to
destroy my dream once again?\pThe precious dream of TEAM ROCKET
has become little more than an\lillusion...$
translation:
坂木：怎么可能......？
这三年来全都白费了吗......？\p为什么又会是你这种小鬼，
再次粉碎了我的梦想？！\p火箭队珍视的梦想，
如今竟已彻底沦为幻影了吗......$

label: BattleTowerOutsideYoungsterText
source: Wow, the TRAINER HILL is huge!\pThere must be many kinds of\nPOKéMON in there!$
translation: 哇，训练家之丘好大啊！\p里面一定有各种各样的\n宝可梦吧！$

label: BattleTowerOutsideBeautyText
source: In the BATTLE TENTS, you can\nuse only three POKéMON.\pIt's so hard to decide which\nthree should go into battle…$
translation: 在对战帐篷里，\n只能使用3只宝可梦。\p要决定派哪3只出场\n可真让人纠结啊......$

label: BattleTowerOutsideSailorText
source: Hehehe, I snuck out from work.\pI can't bail out until I've won!\pI have to win it all. That I must!$
translation: 嘿嘿嘿，我是翘班溜出来的。\p不赢我可绝不回去！\p我一定要连赢到底，必须的！$

label: BattleTowerOutsideSignText
source: {UP_ARROW} TRAINER HILL ENTRANCE\p“Scale the heights, you hot-blooded\nTRAINERS!”\p{RIGHT_ARROW} BATTLE TENTS.$
translation: {UP_ARROW} 训练家之丘 入口\p"热血沸腾的训练家们啊，\n勇攀高峰吧！"\p{RIGHT_ARROW} 对战帐篷$

label: BattleTower_Battle_Tent_Text_Factory
source: BATTLE TENT: FACTORY\n“Find it! The ultimate POKéMON!”$
translation: 对战帐篷：工厂\n"寻找吧！究极的宝可梦！"$

label: BattleTower_Battle_Tent_Text_Palace
source: BATTLE TENT: PALACE\n“Feast Your Eyes on Battles!”$
translation: 对战帐篷：宫殿\n"尽情领略对战的魅力！"$

label: BattleTower_Battle_Tent_Text_Arena
source: BATTLE TENT: ARENA\n“May the Greatest Teams Gather!”$
translation: 对战帐篷：竞技场\n"最强的队伍集结于此！"$

label: BattleTowerOutsideText_Closed
source: The TRAINER HILL is currently\nclosed for repairs.$
translation: 训练家之丘目前\n正在进行维护暂停开放。$

label: TrainerHill_Courtyard_ExchangeServiceCorner_EventScript_OldWTMan_Text
source: Hi! If you are looking for the\nWONDERTRADE, they're now located in\levery POKéMON CENTER. Have fun!$
translation: 你好！如果你在找\n奇迹交换的话，现在每个\l宝可梦中心里都有哦。玩得开心！$

label: TrainerHill_Courtyard_ExchangeServiceCorner_Text_WelcomePleaseChoosePrize
source: Hello, this is the EXCHANGE SERVICE\nCORNER.\pWe exchange the Battle Points you\nhave collected for lovely prizes.\pPlease choose a prize from this list.$
translation: 你好，这里是兑换服务处。\p我们可以将您收集的对战点数\n兑换成精美的奖品。\p请从这张清单中选择奖品。$

label: TrainerHill_Courtyard_ExchangeServiceCorner_Text_WishIHadAllDolls
source: Oh, they're so nice!\nI wish I had them!\lCute cushions!\lBig plush DOLLS!\lLittle plush DOLLS!\lI wish I had them all!$
translation: 哇，它们太棒了！\n真想全部拥有！\l可爱的靠垫！\l大毛绒玩偶！\l小毛绒玩偶！\l真希望我能全部带回家！$

label: TrainerHill_Courtyard_ExchangeServiceCorner_Text_GetYouAnythingYouWant
source: Leave it to your mommy!\pIf it's anything you want, I'll go\nthrough anything to get it, honey!$
translation: 包在妈妈身上！\p只要是宝贝想要的，无论怎样\n妈妈都会给你弄到手的！$

label: TrainerHill_Courtyard_ExchangeServiceCorner_Text_ItemsWillGetMonTougher
source: If I can get hold of the items here,\nmy POKéMON will get tougher.\pYou bet they will!\nNo question about it!$
translation: 只要能拿到这里的道具，\n我的宝可梦就会变得更强。\p绝对会变强！\n毫无疑问！$

label: TrainerHill_Courtyard_ExchangeServiceCorner_Text_GoGetYourOwnDoll
source:
Hah?
What are you gawking at?\pI don't like you staring at my plush
doll like that.\pIf you want it, go get one yourself!
Isn't that right, SMOOCHUM?$
translation: 哈？\n你发什么呆地看着我？\p我很讨厌你那样盯着我的毛绒玩偶看。\p想要的话，自己去拿一个啊！\n对吧，迷唇娃？$

label: TrainerHill_Courtyard_ExchangeServiceCorner_Text_MoreBattlePointsForRecord
source: Did you know?\pIf you stretch your record at any of\nthe BATTLE facilities, they start\lgiving you more and more Battle Points.$
translation: 你知道吗？\p只要在任何对战设施里连胜延长纪录，\n他们给你的对战点数就会越来越多。$

label: TrainerHill_Elevator_hns_Text_ReturnToReception
source: Would you like to return to\nthe reception counter?$
translation: 要返回接待处吗？$

label: TrainerHill_Roof_Text_YouFinallyCameBravo
source:
Hm! Hm!\pYou finally came!
Yes, you have arrived!\pWait! Don't say it!
I know why you came all the way\lhere by yourself!\pYou wanted to see me, the owner
of the TRAINER HILL, because…\pYou want to form a tag team with me!
Wa-hoo!\p…Uh?
That's not it?\pAnyway, I watched you on your way up.
Marvelous battling! Bravo, indeed!$
translation:
嗯！嗯！\p你终于来了！
没错，你到了！\p等等！别说！
我知道你一个人千里迢迢\l跑到这里来是为了什么！\p你想见我，训练家之丘的主人，
是因为......\p你想和我组队双打对吧！
哇呼--！\p......咦？
不是吗？\p不管怎样，你一路打上来的英姿我都看到了。
真是精彩绝伦的对战！太棒了！$

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_hns_Text_HereToGetMoney
source: I'm here to make some cash!\nWhy? Because every time you reach\lthe top, you get a money reward!\pI wonder when they'll finally open.\nI can't wait!$
translation: 我是来赚点钱的！\n为什么？因为每次登顶，\l都能拿到奖金啊！\p不知道他们什么时候才开门。\n我都等不及了！$

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_hns_Text_Money
source:
Every time you reach the top,
you earn some money.\pI heard you can win up to 1.000.000¥
if you finish within ten minutes!\pBut if it takes longer, the reward
will be reduced…$
translation:
每次登上顶楼，
都能赚到一笔奖金。\p我听说只要在10分钟以内通关，
最多能拿到1.000.000¥呢！\p但要是花的时间太长，
奖励就会减少......$

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_hns_Text_StillGettingReady
source: This is the TRAINER HILL where\nyou may enjoy tag battles with many\lTRAINERS.\pUnfortunately, we're still getting\nthings ready. Please come back later!$
translation: 这里是训练家之丘，\n在这里可以体验与众多训练家\l的双打对战。\p不过很遗憾，我们目前还在\n筹备中。请过段时间再来吧！$

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_hns_Text_WelcomeToTrainerHill
source: Welcome!\pThis is the TRAINER HILL where\nyou may enjoy tag battles with many\lTRAINERS!$
translation: 欢迎光临！\p这里是训练家之丘，\n在这里可以体验与众多训练家\l的双打对战！$

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_hns_Text_SaveGameBeforeEnter
source: Is this your first visit here?\pBefore you enter, please save\nyour game.$
translation: 你是第一次来这里吗？\p在进入之前，\n请先记录一下游戏进度。$

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_hns_Text_TrainersUpToFloorX
source: Let's see…\nThe TRAINERS here now are…\pUp to floor no. {STR_VAR_1}.$
translation: 我看看......\n现在驻留在此的训练家......\p分布到了第{STR_VAR_1}层。$

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_hns_Text_TrainersInEveryRoom
source: Let's see…\nThe TRAINERS here now are…\pThere appear to be TRAINERS gathered\nin every room.$
translation: 我看看......\n现在驻留在此的训练家......\p似乎每一个房间里\n都聚集了训练家。$

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_hns_Text_LikeToChallengeTrainers
source: Would you like to challenge the\nwaiting TRAINERS?$
translation: 你要向在此等候的\n训练家们发起挑战吗？$

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_hns_Text_TimeProgessGetSetGo
source: I will time your progress.\nBest of luck!\pOn your marks…\pGet set…\pGo!$
translation: 我将为你记录挑战用时。\n祝你好运！\p各就各位......\p预备......\p跑！$

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_hns_Text_PleaseVisitUsAgain
source: Please do visit us again!$
translation: 欢迎下次再来！$

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_hns_Text_TooBadTremendousEffort
source: That was too bad.\pI think you put in a tremendous\neffort in your battling.\pPlease come back and try again!$
translation: 真可惜啊。\p不过我觉得你的对战\n已经非常非常努力了。\p请随时回来再次挑战！$

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_hns_Text_HopeYouGiveItYourBest
source: I hope you give it your best.$
translation: 希望你能全力以赴。$

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_hns_Text_MovedReceptionHereForSwitch
source: When the TRAINERS switch places,\nthe movement can be hectic.\pTo avoid the stampede, we moved\nthe reception counter here.\pI'm sorry for the inconvenience.$
translation: 当训练家们轮换位置时，\n场面可能会相当混乱。\p为了避免拥挤推搡，我们把\n接待处搬到了这里。\p给您带来不便，敬请谅解。$

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_hns_Text_ThankYouForPlaying
source: 感谢您的游玩！$
translation: 感谢您的游玩！$

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_hns_Text_ExplainTrainerHill
source:
Here at the TRAINER HILL, we conduct
an event called the Time Attack.\pIt is a race that measures how long
you take to reach our owner on\lthe rooftop from this counter.\pThe fastest times are posted on
the Time Board--try competing with\lyour friends.\pIn TRAINER battles along the way,
neither Exp. Points nor money will\lbe awarded.$
translation:
在训练家之丘，我们开展了
名为"计时赛"的挑战活动。\p这是一场竞速挑战，记录你从
这个柜台出发到达顶楼主人那里\l所花费的时间。\p最快的时间会记录在计时榜上--
不妨试着和朋友们一决高下吧。\p在途中的训练家对战中，
将无法获得经验值与金钱。$

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_hns_Text_WhatSortOfTrainersAreAhead
source: Who knows what sort of TRAINERS\nand POKéMON combos are ahead?\pAll I know is that I'll knock aside\nanyone that stands in my way!$
translation: 天晓得前面会有怎样的训练家\n和宝可梦组合在等着我们？\p我只知道，谁敢挡我的路，\n我就把谁打倒！$

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_hns_Text_CantWaitToTestTheWaters
source: I heard tough TRAINERS come to this\nTRAINER HILL from all over.\pI can't wait to test the waters!\pI'll knock aside anyone that stands\nin my way!$
translation: 听说来自各地的强力训练家\n都聚集到了这座训练家之丘。\p我都等不及想试探一下实力了！\p谁敢挡我的路，我就把谁打倒！$

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_hns_Text_FriendsTryingToReachTimeBoardTop
source: Do you see the Time Board over there?\pMy friends and I are trying to see who\ncan reach the top in the least time.$
translation: 你看到那边的计时板了吗？\p我和朋友们正在比赛，\n看谁能以最短的时间登顶呢。$

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_hns_Text_DoYouKnowWhenTheyOpen
source: Do you know when they're opening\nthis place up?\pI'm waiting here to be the first\nchallenger ever!$
translation: 你知道这里什么时候开门吗？\p我一直守在这儿，\n就是想成为第一位挑战者！$

label: TrainerHill_Roof_hns_Text_YouFinallyCameBravo
source:
Hm! Hm!\pYou finally came!
Yes, you have arrived!\pWait! Don't say it!
I know why you came all the way\lhere by yourself!\pYou wanted to see me, the owner
of the TRAINER HILL, because…\pYou want to form a tag team with me!
Wa-hoo!\p…Uh?
That's not it?\pAnyway, I watched you on your way up.
Marvelous battling! Bravo, indeed!$
translation:
嗯！嗯！\p你终于来了！
没错，你到了！\p等等！别说！
我知道你一个人千里迢迢\l跑到这里来是为了什么！\p你想见我，训练家之丘的主人，
是因为......\p你想和我组队双打对吧！
哇呼--！\p......咦？
不是吗？\p不管怎样，你一路打上来的英姿我都看到了。
真是精彩绝伦的对战！太棒了！$

label: TrainerHill_Roof_hns_Text_HaveTheMostMarvelousGift
source: For a marvelous someone like you,\nI have the most marvelous gift,\lplus some money for your effort!$
translation: 献给如此出色的你，\n我准备了一份极其绝妙的礼物，\l另外还有一些奖金作为酬谢！$

label: TrainerHill_Roof_hns_Text_FullUpBeBackLaterForThis
source: Oh, no, full up with things!\nYou'll be back later for this!$
translation: 哎呀，你的背包已经装得满满当当了！\n等整理好了再来拿吧！$

label: TrainerHill_Roof_hns_Text_GotHereMarvelouslyQuickly
source:
Oh, hold on here! Did you possibly get
here marvelously quickly?\pHow splendid! You needn't have
hurried so to see me!\pThat is so delightful. I'll have the Time
Board at the reception updated!$
translation:
哎呀，等等！难道你用极快的速度
赶到这里了吗？\p太精彩了！其实您完全不用
为了见我而这么匆忙的！\p真是太令人高兴了。我会让前台
更新计时板上的成绩！$

label: TrainerHill_Roof_hns_Text_YouWerentVeryQuick
source: But, oh…\nYou weren't very quick getting here.$
translation: 不过，哎呀......\n你赶到这里的时间并不算快呢。$

label: TrainerHill_Roof_hns_Text_ArriveZippierNextTime
source: Perhaps it would please me more if you\narrived zippier next time.\pThen, I should be pleased to form\na tag team with you!\pUntil we meet again, amigo!$
translation: 要是你下次能来得更快些，\n我想我会更加开心的。\p到那时，我很乐意与你组成双打拍档！\p期待下次再会，朋友！$

label: TrainerTower_Lobby_Text_HereAreTheResults
source: せいせきひょうです$
translation: 这是成绩表。$

label: Alola_Ulaula_BattlePalossand_Text_0
source: Shuck!$
translation: 壶壶！$

label: Alola_Ulaula_MtLanikalaSign_Text_0
source: This mountain is affectionately\nreferred to as MT. LANIKALA by the\llocals, as it is the tallest mountain\lon the ALOLA ISLES.\pThe real name of this mountain has been\nlost to time.$
translation: 当地人亲切地称这座山为拉纳基拉山，\n因为它是阿罗拉群岛中最高的山峰。\p至于这座山真正的名字，\n早已随着岁月流逝被人们遗忘了。$

label: Alola_Ulaula_UlaulaSign_Text_0
source: ULA'ULA ISLE$
translation: 乌拉乌拉岛$

label: Alola_Ulaula_Phant_outside_Text_0
source: Hello there, {PLAYER}!\pI'm the developer who built this\nsection of the game!\pI hope you enjoyed this taste of ALOLA.\pI'm working on a full demake of the\nregion called ULTRA ECLIPSE.$
translation: 你好啊，{PLAYER}！\p我是制作了这个游戏区域的开发者！\p希望你喜欢这处阿罗拉的风景。\p我目前正在制作阿罗拉地区的复古重制作品--\n《究极日蚀》。$

label: Alola_Ulaula_Phant_outside_Text_1
source: Please come visit me at my house at\nthe top of this isle.\lI'll make it worth your while!$
translation: 欢迎来我位于这座岛屿山顶的家里坐坐。\n绝对不会让你白跑一趟的！$

label: Alola_Ulaula_TrainerBattlePicnicker_Text_0
source: Surprise!\nI was in the trees!$
translation: 惊喜吧！\n我其实一直躲在树上呢！$

label: Alola_Ulaula_TrainerBattlePicnicker_Text_1
source: Back into hiding I go…$
translation: 我又躲回去啦......$

label: Alola_Ulaula_TrainerBattlePicnicker_Text_2
source: I thought I saw something red flying\nthrough the sky.\pCould it have been a POKéMON?$
translation: 我刚才好像看到有什么红色的东西在天上飞。\p难道那是宝可梦吗？$

label: Alola_Ulaula_TrainerBattleYoungster_Text_0
source: Hey, I'm going to be the first to climb\nMT. LANIKALA!$
translation: 嘿，我绝对会成为第一个登顶拉纳基拉山的人！$

label: Alola_Ulaula_TrainerBattleYoungster_Text_1
source: It's not even the real MT. LANIKALA…$
translation: 这里甚至都不是真正的拉纳基拉山......$

label: Alola_Ulaula_TrainerBattleYoungster_Text_2
source: My dad never told me the real name of\nthis mountain.\pWe've always just called it MT. LANIKALA.$
translation: 老爸从没告诉过我这座山真正的名字。\p我们一直都管它叫拉纳基拉山。$

label: Alola_Ulaula_TrainerBattleHiker_Text_0
source: You must be tough to handle this\nrough terrain!$
translation: 能在这么险峻的地形上行动，\n你一定很有两下子吧！$

label: Alola_Ulaula_TrainerBattleHiker_Text_1
source: Oof,\nI should've trained harder…$
translation: 呜呃......\n我真该更刻苦训练的......$

label: Alola_Ulaula_TrainerBattleHiker_Text_2
source: ULA'ULA ISLE has the best hiking!\pThe locals refer to this mountain as\nMT. LANIKALA, as it is the tallest on\lthe ALOLA ISLES!$
translation: 乌拉乌拉岛可是徒步旅行的绝佳去处！\p当地人称这座山为拉纳基拉山，\n因为它是阿罗拉群岛中最高的山峰！$

label: Alola_Ulaula_TrainerBattleCooltrainer_Text_0
source: This cave smells terrible!\nLet's battle to get my mind off of it!$
translation: 这个洞窟闻起来太糟糕了！\n赶紧对战一场，转移一下注意力吧！$

label: Alola_Ulaula_TrainerBattleCooltrainer_Text_1
source: Should've brought some air freshener…$
translation: 真该带个空气清新剂来的......$

label: Alola_Ulaula_TrainerBattleCooltrainer_Text_2
source: You should plug your nose if you plan\non going in that cave.$
translation: 如果你打算进那个洞窟，\n最好先把鼻子捏住。$

label: Alola_Ulaula_LassNPC_Text_0
source: The sea by the ISLES is truly\nbreathtaking.\pI could sit here all day and just\nwatch the waves.$
translation: 群岛附近的大海真是\n美得令人屏息。\p我可以整天坐在这里，\n静静地看波浪翻涌。$

label: Alola_Ulaula_Bench_Heal_Text_0
source: Would you like to take a rest on this\nbench?$
translation: 你想在这张长椅上\n休息一下吗？$

label: Alola_Ulaula_Text_MoveTutorIntro
source:
URGH!
AGH!\pYOU!\pDid the others send you here?
Did they tell you that I am the\lmaster of POKéMON moves?\p........................\pI can train your POKéMON in the
ways of the ISLES, but first, a\lsmall fee.\pThe price is 5 HEART SCALES.\pDo you have them?$
translation:
唔啊！
啊！\p你！\p是其他人让你来这儿的吗？
他们告诉你我是精通宝可梦招式的\l大师了吗？\p..................\p我可以按群岛的方式传授你的宝可梦，
不过嘛，得先收一点点费用。\p价格是5个心之鳞片。\p你带来了吗？$

label: Alola_Ulaula_Text_MoveTutorPaid
source: My wife loves these things.\pFrom now on, my services are\ngranted to you.$
translation: 我老婆最喜欢这东西了。\p从现在起，我的本领随时任你差遣。$

label: Alola_Ulaula_Text_MoveTutorNoScales
source: Five HEART SCALES.\nNot four.\pTry smashing rocks.\nWith your POKéMON, or your fists!$
translation: 是5个心之鳞片。\n可不是4个。\p去试试碎岩吧。\n不管是让宝可梦来，还是用你的拳头！$

label: Alola_Ulaula_Text_MoveTutorChoose
source: Which move would you like?$
translation: 你想学哪个招式？$

label: Alola_Ulaula_Text_MoveTutorConfirm
source: You'd like to learn {STR_VAR_1}?$
translation: 想要学习{STR_VAR_1}吗？$

label: Alola_Ulaula_Text_MoveTutorWhichMon
source: Which POKéMON should learn it?$
translation: 要让哪只宝可梦学习？$

label: Alola_Ulaula_Text_MoveTutorDone
source: EXCELLENT!\pYour POKéMON holds the knowledge\nof the ISLES.$
translation: 太棒了！\p你的宝可梦已经领悟了\n群岛的招式奥秘。$

label: Alola_Ulaula_Text_MoveTutorComeBack
source: The ISLES aren't going anywhere.\nCome back anytime.$
translation: 群岛又不会跑掉。\n随时欢迎你再来。$

label: Alola_Ulaula_TotemBattle_Text_1
source: Totem TANGROWTH was defeated!\nIt scampered off somewhere…$

label: Alola_Ulaula_TotemBattle_Text_2

label: Alola_Ulaula_TotemBattle_Text_3

label: Alola_Ulaula_Totem_sign_Text_0
source: The totem is emanating a strong\nenergy…\pTouch the totem to teleport to another\nIsle?$
translation: 图腾正散发出一股强烈的能量......\p要触碰图腾传送至其他岛屿吗？$

label: Alola_Ulaula_Totem_sign_Text_1

label: Alola_Ulaula_Totem_sign_Text_6
source: A strange totem stands here,\npower is emanating from it…$
translation: 这里伫立着一个奇异的图腾，\n正散发出一股能量......$

label: Alola_Ulaula_BattleVsTapuBulu_Text_0
source: Bu-Bulu!$
translation: 哞-哞噜！$

label: Alola_Ulaula_House_Phant_Text_0
source: Welcome, {PLAYER}.\pThanks again for playing!$
translation: 欢迎，{PLAYER}。\p再次感谢你游玩本作！$

label: Alola_Ulaula_House_Phant_Text_1
source: I hope you're prepared…\ngood luck.$
translation: 希望你已经做好了准备......\n祝你好运。$

label: Alola_Ulaula_House_Phant_Text_2
source: Congratulations, {PLAYER}!$
translation: 恭喜你，{PLAYER}！$

label: Alola_Ulaula_House_Phant_Text_3
source: I think you've earned this.$
translation: 这是你应得的奖励。$

label: Alola_Ulaula_House_Phant_Text_4
source: You received an EGG from PHANTONOMY!$
translation: 从PHANTONOMY那里获得了蛋！$

label: Alola_Ulaula_House_Phant_Text_5
source: That EGG contains my favorite POKéMON.\pPlease, take good care of it…$
translation: 那颗蛋里是我最喜欢的宝可梦。\p请一定要好好照顾它......$

label: Alola_Ulaula_House_Phant_Text_6
source: No worries, {PLAYER}.\nCome back when you're ready…$
translation: 没关系的，{PLAYER}。\n等你准备好了再来吧......$

label: Alola_Ulaula_House_Phant_Text_7
source: I hope you enjoyed this taste of ALOLA.\pI'm working on a full demake of the\nregion called ULTRA ECLIPSE.$
translation: 希望你喜欢这次阿罗拉的小小体验。\p我目前正在制作阿罗拉地区的\n完整复古重制版，名为《究极日蚀》。$

label: Alola_Ulaula_House_Noivern_Text_0
source: Scree!$

label: Alola_Ulaula_House_Typholosion_Text_0
source: Graa!$
translation: 吼啊！$

label: UnionCave_1F_Text_HikerRussellSeen
source: You're headed to AZALEA, are you?\pLet my POKéMON see if you are good\nenough to battle.$
translation: 你正准备前往桧皮镇，是吗？\p让我的宝可梦来试试看，\n你是否已经具备一战的实力吧。$

label: UnionCave_1F_Text_HikerRussellBeaten
source: Oh, oh, oh!$
translation: 哎呀，哎呀，哎呀！$

label: UnionCave_1F_Text_HikerRussellAfter
source: All right, then! I've decided.\pI'm not leaving until my POKéMON\nget tougher!$
translation: 好，决定了！\p我的宝可梦不变得更强，\n我就绝不离开这里！$

label: UnionCave_1F_Text_PokemaniacLarrySeen
source: I roam far and wide in search of\nPOKéMON.\pAre you looking for POKéMON too?\pThen you're my collecting rival!$
translation: 我为了寻找宝可梦走遍了各地。\p你也是来寻找宝可梦的吗？\p那咱们就是收集劲敌了！$

label: UnionCave_1F_Text_PokemaniacLarryBeaten
source: Ugh. My poor POKéMON…$
translation: 唔呃。我可怜的宝可梦......$

label: UnionCave_1F_Text_PokemaniacLarryAfter
source: Sometimes, you can hear POKéMON\nroars from deep inside the cave.$
translation: 有时候，能从洞窟深处\n听到宝可梦的叫声呢。$

label: UnionCave_1F_Text_HikerDanielSeen
source: Whoa! What a surprise!\pI didn't expect to see anyone here!$
translation: 哇！吓我一跳！\p真没想到这里还会有人来！$

label: UnionCave_1F_Text_HikerDanielBeaten
source: Whoa! I'm beaten big time!$
translation: 哇！我输得彻彻底底啊！$

label: UnionCave_1F_Text_HikerDanielAfter
source: I was conned into buying a\nSLOWPOKETAIL.\pI feel sorry for the poor POKéMON.$
translation: 我被人哄骗着买了根呆呆兽之尾。\p现在想想那只可怜的宝可梦真惨。$

label: UnionCave_1F_Text_FirebreatherBillSeen
source: ZUBAT's SUPERSONIC keeps confusing\nmy POKéMON.\pI'm seriously upset about that!$
translation: 超音蝠的超音波老是让我宝可梦混乱。\p真是烦死人了！$

label: UnionCave_1F_Text_FirebreatherBillBeaten
source: I flamed out!$
translation: 我彻底熄火了！$

label: UnionCave_1F_Text_FirebreatherBillAfter
source: On weekends, you can hear strange\nroars from deep in the cave.$
translation: 每到周末，就能从洞窟深处\n听到奇怪的叫声呢。$

label: UnionCave_1F_Text_FirebreatherRaySeen
source: If it's light, a cave isn't scary.\pIf you're strong, POKéMON aren't\nscary.$
translation: 如果光线够亮，洞窟就不可怕。\p如果你自身够强，宝可梦就不可怕。$

label: UnionCave_1F_Text_FirebreatherRayBeaten
source: FLASH!$
translation: 闪光！$

label: UnionCave_1F_Text_FirebreatherRayAfter
source: It's my POKéMON's fire that lights\nup this cave.$
translation: 是我的宝可梦身上的火焰\n照亮了这座洞窟。$

label: UnionCave_B1F_Text_HikerPhillipSeen
source: It's been a while since I last saw\nanother person.\pDon't be shy. Let's battle!$
translation: 好久没见到其他人了。\p别客气，来对战吧！$

label: UnionCave_B1F_Text_HikerPhillipBeaten
source: Uurggh…$

label: UnionCave_B1F_Text_HikerPhillipAfter
source: I've been lost for a long time…\pI don't mind it here, but I am\nsoooo hungry!$
translation: 我已经迷路很久了......\p待在这里倒无所谓，但我肚子\n真--的好饿啊！$

label: UnionCave_B1F_Text_HikerLeonardSeen
source: What do you know! A visitor!$
translation: 哎呀真稀奇！竟然有客人来！$

label: UnionCave_B1F_Text_HikerLeonardBeaten
source: Wahahah! You're a feisty one!$
translation: 哇哈哈！你可真够带劲的！$

label: UnionCave_B1F_Text_HikerLeonardAfter
source: I live down here.\pYou can, too, if you'd like.\pThere's plenty of room, you see.$
translation: 我就住在这下面。\p你想的话也可以住下哦。\p你看，这里的空地方多得很。$

label: UnionCave_B1F_Text_PokemaniacAndrewSeen
source: Who's there?\pLeave me and my POKéMON alone!$
translation: 是谁在那儿？\p别来打扰我和我的宝可梦！$

label: UnionCave_B1F_Text_PokemaniacAndrewBeaten
source: Go… Go away!$

label: UnionCave_B1F_Text_PokemaniacAndrewAfter
source: Just me and my POKéMON. I'm de-\nlirious with joy.$
translation: 只有我和宝可梦相伴，\n我已经乐得找不着北了。$

label: UnionCave_B1F_Text_PokemaniacCalvinSeen
source: I came all the way here to conduct\nmy POKéMON research.\pLet me demonstrate my findings in a\nreal battle!$
translation: 我大老远跑到这里来进行宝可梦研究。\p就让我在实战中展现一下\n我的研究成果吧！$

label: UnionCave_B1F_Text_PokemaniacCalvinBeaten
source: You demonstrated on me!$
translation: 反被你好好上了一课！$

label: UnionCave_B1F_Text_PokemaniacCalvinAfter
source: I should compile and announce my\nstudy findings.\pI might even become famous like\nPROF.ELM.$
translation: 我得好好整理并发表我的研究成果。\p说不定还能像空木博士那样\n变得赫赫有名呢。$

label: UnionCave_B2F_Text_CooltrainermNickSeen
source: There are two kinds of people.\pThose who have style, and those\nwho don't.\pWhat kind of person are you?$
translation:
世上有两种人。\p一种是有格调的人，另一种则是
没有格调的人。\p你是哪种人呢？$

label: UnionCave_B2F_Text_CooltrainermNickBeaten
source: You've got dazzling style!$
translation: 你的格调真是光彩夺目！$

label: UnionCave_B2F_Text_CooltrainermNickAfter
source: Your POKéMON style is stunning and\ncolorful, I admit.\pYou'll just keep getting better!$
translation:
我承认，你的宝可梦风格绚丽
又多姿多彩。\p你一定会变得越来越棒的！$

label: UnionCave_B2F_Text_CooltrainerfGwenSeen
source: I'm in training. Care for a round?$
translation: 我正在特训。要来过过招吗？$

label: UnionCave_B2F_Text_CooltrainerfGwenBeaten
source: Aww, no! You're too good for me.$
translation: 呜哇，不行！你实在太厉害了。$

label: UnionCave_B2F_Text_CooltrainerfGwenAfter
source: I'm going to train by myself until I\nimprove.$
translation:
在变强之前，我还是自己一个人
继续特训吧。$

label: UnionCave_B2F_Text_CooltrainerfEmmaSeen
source: If the POKéMON I liked were there,\nI'd go anywhere.\pThat's what a real trainer does.$
translation:
只要有我喜欢的宝可梦在，
天涯海角我都愿意去。\p这才称得上是真正的训练家。$

label: UnionCave_B2F_Text_CooltrainerfEmmaBeaten
source: I'd rather pet my babies than this!$
translation: 与其做这个，我还不如去摸摸我的小宝贝们！$

label: UnionCave_B2F_Text_CooltrainerfEmmaAfter
source: Just once a week, a POKéMON comes to\nthe water's edge.\pI wanted to see that POKéMON…$
translation:
每周只有一次，会有一只宝可梦
来到水边。\p我好想亲眼见见那只宝可梦啊......$

label: VerdanturfTown_Text_ManTryingToDigTunnel
source:
My papa told me.\pHe says this tunnel is full of
timid POKéMON.\pThey get all scared of loud noise and
make a big uproar.\pSo they had to stop the big tunnel
project.\pBut there's one man. He's trying to dig
the tunnel by himself!$
translation:
我爸爸告诉我，\p这条隧道里到处都是
胆小的宝可梦。\p它们被巨大的噪音吓到，
就会闹腾得翻天覆地。\p所以大型隧道工程不得不停工了。\p但是有一个人，他正试着
靠自己一个人把隧道挖通呢！$

label: VerdanturfTown_Text_MakeBattleTentDebut
source: My POKéMON and I, we've been riding\na hot winning streak.\pSo I decided to make my BATTLE TENT\ndebut in this town.$
translation:
我和我的宝可梦最近连战连胜，
势头正盛。\p所以我决定在这个城镇的
对战帐篷迎来首秀！$

label: VerdanturfTown_Text_TownSign
source: VERDANTURF TOWN\p“The windswept highlands with the\nsweet fragrance of grass.”$
translation: 绿荫镇\p"清风拂过、青草飘香的高原。"$

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_hns_Text_MonsReluctantToUseDislikedMoves
source:
If it doesn't like a certain move,
a POKéMON will be reluctant to use it.\pIt doesn't matter how strong it is,
either.\pFor example, a POKéMON with a GENTLE
nature probably won't enjoy hurting\lits opponents.\pIf it can't seem to live up to its
potential, it's probably failing at\lusing a disliked move against its will.$
translation:
如果宝可梦不喜欢某个招式，
它就会很不情愿去用。\p不管那个招式有多强大也一样。\p比如，性格[温和]的宝可梦
大概不会喜欢去伤害对手。\l\p如果它看起来无法发挥实力，
很可能是被迫使用了讨厌的招式。$

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_hns_Text_GentleMonsScaryIfAngry
source: My big sister is gentle usually.\nBut when she gets angry,\lshe's really, really scary!\pI bet a gentle POKéMON will be scary\nif it gets angry!$
translation:
我姐姐平时很温柔。
但她一生起气来，\l真的超级超级可怕！\p我敢说温和的宝可梦
生起气来肯定也很可怕！$

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_hns_Text_AttractionRunsDeep
source:
My feelings toward my POKéMON…
The attraction runs deep…\pOh, hi, you didn't see that, did you?
Well, it doesn't matter.\pHow would you like this TM for
your POKéMON?$
translation:
我对宝可梦的深情......
这份吸引力如此深沉......\p哎呀，你没看到吧？
算了，没关系。\p你想不想要这个招式学习器，
让你的宝可梦学会呢？$

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_hns_Text_AttractionMutual
source: My feelings toward my POKéMON…\nI'm sure the attraction is mutual!\pThey battle exactly the way I want\nthem to!$
translation:
我对宝可梦的深情......
我相信我们是心意相通、互相吸引的！\p它们对战时的表现完全符合我的心意！$

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_hns_Text_TaughtWhatKindsOfMoves
source: What kind of moves have you taught\nyour POKéMON?\pI think you would give yourself\nan advantage if they knew how to\lheal or protect themselves.$
translation:
你都教了你的宝可梦什么招式？\p我觉得如果它们掌握了回复体力
或保护自己的手段，你就能占据优势。$

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_hns_Text_ScottCanMeetToughTrainers
source:
SCOTT: Hey there, {PLAYER}{KUN}!
I thought I might see you here.\pA BATTLE TENT's a place where
you can meet tough TRAINERS.\pIt doesn't matter what the rules are,
or how battles are waged, either.\p{PLAYER}{KUN}, I expect you to do
the best you can!$
translation:
亚希达：嗨，{PLAYER}{KUN}！
我就猜到会在这里遇到你。\p对战帐篷可是个能遇见
强劲训练家的地方。\p不管规则如何，
也不管对战以何种形式展开。\p{PLAYER}{KUN}，我期待着
你能发挥出自己的最高水平！$

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_hns_Text_ScottVisitRegularly
source: SCOTT: I visit here regularly in hopes\nof seeing tough TRAINERS in action\lin whatever the situation.$
translation:
亚希达：我经常来这里，就是希望能亲眼目睹
强劲训练家在各种局面下的精彩表现。$

label: PokemonFanClub_Text_Chairman_Intro
source:
I'm the CHAIRMAN of the POKéMON
FAN CLUB.\pI've raised over 150 POKéMON.\pI'm very fussy when it comes to
POKéMON.\pDid you visit just to hear about
my POKéMON?$
translation:
我是宝可梦发烧友俱乐部的
会长。\p我已经培育过150多只宝可梦了。\p只要一谈到宝可梦，我可是非常挑剔的。\p你专程过来，是为了听我聊聊
我的宝可梦吗？$

label: PokemonFanClub_Text_Chairman_Rapidash
source:
Good! Then listen up!\pSo… my favorite RAPIDASH…\pIt… cute… lovely… smart…
unbearably…\lplus… amazing… oh… you think\lso?…\lToo much… wild… beautiful…\lkindly…\llove it!\pHug it… when… sleeping… warm
and cuddly…\lOh, and… spectacular…\lravishing… simply divine…\pOops! Look at the time!
I've kept you too long!$
translation:
太好了！那就仔细听好喽！\p话说......我最心爱的烈焰马......\p它......可爱......迷人......聪明......
让人欲罢不能......\l而且......太棒了......哦......你也是这么觉得？......\l简直太......狂野......美丽......\l温柔......\l我超爱它！\p睡觉的时候......抱抱它......暖洋洋
又毛茸茸的......\l哦，还有......帅气逼人......\l令人陶醉......简直宛如天神......\p哎呀！看看时间！
我耽搁你太久了！$

label: PokemonFanClub_Text_Chairman_Gift
source: Thanks for hearing me out.\nI want you to have this!$
translation:
谢谢你愿意听我讲完。
这个就送给你吧！$

label: PokemonFanClub_Text_Chairman_Candy
source: It's a RARE CANDY that makes\nPOKéMON stronger.\pI prefer making my POKéMON\nstronger by battling, so you\lcan have it.$
translation:
这是能让宝可梦变强的神奇糖果。\p比起用这个，我更喜欢通过对战
来让宝可梦成长，所以送给你了。$

label: PokemonFanClub_Text_Chairman_MoreTales
source: Hello, {PLAYER}!\pDid you come see me about my\nPOKéMON again?\pNo? Oh… I had more tales to\ntell…$
translation:
你好呀，{PLAYER}！\p你又是来听我聊宝可梦的吗？\p不是吗？哎呀......我肚子里还有好多话
想讲呢......$

label: PokemonFanClub_Text_Chairman_Disappointed
source: How disappointing…\pCome back if you want to listen.$
translation: 真令人失望......\p想听的时候随时再来找我吧。$

label: PokemonFanClub_Text_Receptionist
source: Our CHAIRMAN is very vocal when\nit comes to POKéMON…$
translation:
我们的会长只要一聊起宝可梦，
就会滔滔不绝呢......$

label: PokemonFanClub_Text_ClefairyGuy_Adorable
source: I love the way CLEFAIRY waggles\nits finger when it's trying to\luse METRONOME.\pIt's so adorable!$
translation:
我最喜欢皮皮在使用挥指时，
摇晃手指的样子了。\p简直太可爱了！$

label: PokemonFanClub_Text_ClefairyGuy_MakingDo
source: I love CLEFAIRY, but I could\nnever catch one.\pSo I'm making do with a\nPOKé DOLL that I found.$
translation:
我很喜欢皮皮，
可惜一直都抓不到。\p所以只能拿捡到的皮皮玩偶
来凑合充数啦。$

label: PokemonFanClub_Text_ClefairyGuy_ReturnDoll
source:
Oh, I see now. The girl who lost
this POKé DOLL is sad…\pOK. Could you take this POKé DOLL
back to that poor little girl?\pI'll befriend a real CLEFAIRY on
my own one day. No worries!$
translation:
啊，原来是这样。弄丢这个皮皮玩偶的
小女孩一定很难过吧......\p好吧。你能把这个皮皮玩偶
送还给那个可怜的小女孩吗？\p不用担心我，总有一天我能凭自己的本事
和真正的皮皮成为好朋友的！$

label: PokemonFanClub_Text_ClefairyGuy_GoingToGetOne
source: You watch. I'm going to get a\nreal CLEFAIRY as my friend.$
translation:
你就瞧好吧。我一定要收服一只
真正的皮皮做我的好朋友。$

label: PokemonFanClub_Text_Teacher
source: Look at my darling BAYLEEF!\pThe leaf on its head is so cute!$
translation: 看看我心爱的月桂叶！\p它头上的那片叶子实在太可爱啦！$

label: PokemonFanClub_Text_ClefairyDoll
source: It's a CLEFAIRY! Huh?\pOh, right. It's a CLEFAIRY POKé\nDOLL.$
translation: 是一只皮皮！咦？\p啊，对了。原来只是个皮皮玩偶啊。$

label: PokemonFanClub_Text_Bayleef
source: BAYLEEF: Li liif!$
translation: 月桂叶：哩哩--！$

label: PokemonFanClub_Text_Listen
source: Let's all listen politely to\nother trainers.$
translation:
大家都要礼貌地倾听
其他训练家说话哦。$

label: PokemonFanClub_Text_Bragging
source: If someone brags, brag right\nback!$
translation:
要是有人吹牛，
那就吹回去！$

label: VermilionCity_Text_Route2AideHasPackageForYou
source:
Oh, hello, {PLAYER}!
How are you doing?\pIt's me, one of PROF. OAK's AIDES.\pDid you meet the other AIDE?\pHe had a package from PROF. OAK
for you, {PLAYER}.\pHe said he'd look for you around
ROUTE 2, {PLAYER}.\pIf you're in the ROUTE 2 area,
please look for him.$
translation:
哎呀，你好呀，{PLAYER}！
最近过得怎么样？\p是我呀，大木博士的助手之一。\p你遇到另一位助手了吗？\p他手里有大木博士托他
带给你的包裹呢，{PLAYER}。\p他说过会去2号道路一带找你的，
{PLAYER}。\p如果你顺路去2号道路，
就请找他碰个面吧。$

label: VermilionGym_Text_LtSurgeIntro
source:
SURGE: Hey, you little tyke!\pI have to hand it to you.
It may not be very smart to\lchallenge me, but it takes guts!\pWhen it comes to electric
POKéMON, I'm number one!\pI've never lost on the
battlefield.\pI'll zap you just like I did my
enemies in war!$
translation:
马志士：嘿，小鬼头！\p我不得不佩服你啊。
敢来挑战我，虽然算不上聪明，\l但胆量确实不小！\p要说起电属性宝可梦，
老子可是天下第一！\p在战场上我可从来没吃过败仗。\p老子会像当年在战争中消灭敌人一样，
把你电个精光！$

label: VermilionGym_Text_LtSurgeWinLoss
source: SURGE: Arrrgh! You are strong!\pOK, kid. You get THUNDERBADGE!$
translation: 马志士：呃啊啊！实力真硬啊！\p好吧，小鬼。这枚橙色徽章归你了！$

label: VermilionGym_Text_ReceivedThunderBadge
source: {PLAYER} received THUNDERBADGE.$
translation: {PLAYER}获得了橙色徽章。$

label: VermilionGym_Text_LtSurge_GiveTM
source: And take this TM. It served me\nwell in the war!$
translation:
还有这个招式学习器也拿去吧。
它在战争中可是立了大功的！$

label: VermilionGym_Text_LtSurge_ExplainTM
source: It's SHOCK WAVE.\pA shockingly accurate move\nwhich hits every time!$
translation:
里面是"电击波"。\p这招奇准无比，
绝对是百发百中！$

label: VermilionGym_Text_LtSurgeThunderstone
source: And take this stone. It has real\nthunder power!$
translation:
再把这块石头也拿去吧。
它里面蕴含着货真价实的雷电之力！$

label: VermilionGym_Text_LtSurgePostBattle
source: SURGE: Hey, kid! Still slugging\nand chugging away?\pMy POKéMON and I are still at it!$
translation: 马志士：嘿，小鬼！还在继续奋勇向前吗？\p我和我的宝可梦也依然在全力操练着呢！$

label: VermilionGym_Text_SurgeRematch
source: SURGE: So, you're now KANTO\nCHAMPION!\pImpressive work, kid!\nBut don't think I'm done!\pHow about we have a go again?$
translation:
马志士：这么说，你现在已经是关都冠军了！\p干得漂亮，小鬼！
但别以为我就认输了！\p怎么样，要不要再跟我战个痛快？$

label: VermilionGym_Text_SurgeRematchDefeat
source: SURGE: Arrrgh! You're still just\nas strong!$
translation: 马志士：哇啊啊！你果然还是\n那么厉害啊！$

label: VermilionGym_Text_GentlemanGregorySeen
source: You're here to defeat LT.SURGE?\pNot if I can help it!$
translation: 你是来打倒马志士馆长的？\p有我在，你休想得逞！$

label: VermilionGym_Text_GentlemanGregoryBeaten
source: Sorry I failed you,\nLT.SURGE, sir!$
translation:
非常抱歉，马志士长官，
属下让您失望了！$

label: VermilionGym_Text_GentlemanGregoryAfter
source: When I was still in the army,\nLT.SURGE saved my life.$
translation:
想当年我还在军队的时候，
是马志士长官救了我的命。$

label: VermilionGym_Text_GuitaristVincentSeen
source: LT.SURGE recognized my potential\nwith electric POKéMON.\pThink you can beat me?$
translation: 马志士长官认可了我使用电属性宝可梦的潜力。\p你觉得你能战胜我吗？$

label: VermilionGym_Text_GuitaristVincentBeaten
source: Ooh, how shocking!$
translation: 哎哟，电得我发麻！$

label: VermilionGym_Text_GuitaristVincentAfter
source: Mom told me not to quit my\nday job, but what am I supposed\lto do when I'm not finding\lsuccess there either?$
translation: 妈妈叫我别辞掉本职工作，\n但既然我在那边也毫无起色，\l又能怎么办呢？$

label: VermilionGym_Text_JugglerHortonSeen
source: I'm going to take you down!\nPrepare to be shocked!$
translation: 我要打倒你！\n准备好被电得麻酥酥的吧！$

label: VermilionGym_Text_JugglerHortonBeaten
source: Gwaaah! I was overpowered…$
translation: 哇啊！被彻底压制了......$

label: VermilionGym_Text_JugglerHortonAfter
source: Don't get too comfortable about\nbeating me…\pLT.SURGE is tough.$
translation: 赢了我可别太得意......\p马志士馆主可是非常厉害的。$

label: VermilionCity_Gym_Text_GymGuyAdvice
source:
Yo!
Champ in the making!\pLT. SURGE has a nickname.\pPeople refer to him as the
Lightning American!\pHe's an expert on electric
POKéMON.\pFLYING/WATER-type POKéMON match
poorly against the ELECTRIC type.\pBeware of paralysis, too.\pLT. SURGE is very cautious.\pHe's locked himself in, so it won't
be easy getting to him.$
translation:
哟！
未来的冠军！\p马志士有个外号。\p大家都叫他
"电光闪闪的美国人"！\p他是电属性宝可梦的行家。\p飞行属性和水属性的宝可梦
对上电属性可是大不利哦。\p还要千万小心麻痹状态。\p马志士非常谨慎。\p他把自己锁在里面了，
想接近他可不容易。$

label: VermilionCity_Gym_Text_GymGuyPostVictory
source: Whew! That was an electrifying\nbout!\pIt sure made me nervous.$
translation: 呼！真是一场激动人心的战斗！\p看得我都紧张死了。$

label: VermilionCity_Gym_Text_GymStatue
source: VERMILION POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: LT. SURGE\pWINNING TRAINERS:\nBLUE, RED$
translation: 枯叶市宝可梦道馆\n馆主：马志士\p获胜训练家：\n青绿、赤红$

label: VermilionCity_Gym_Text_GymStatuePlayerWon
source: VERMILION POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: LT. SURGE\pWINNING TRAINERS:\nBLUE, RED, {PLAYER}$
translation: 枯叶市宝可梦道馆\n馆主：马志士\p获胜训练家：\n青绿、赤红、{PLAYER}$

label: VermilionCity_Gym_Text_NopeOnlyTrashHere
source: Nope!\nThere's only trash here.$
translation: 不对！\n这里只有垃圾。$

label: VermilionCity_Gym_Text_SwitchUnderTrashFirstLockOpened
source: Hey! There's a switch under the\ntrash! Turn it on!\pThe first electric lock opened!$
translation: 嘿！垃圾桶底下有个开关！\n按下去！\p第1道电子锁打开了！$

label: VermilionCity_Gym_Text_SecondLockOpened
source: The second electric lock opened!\nThe motorized door opened!$
translation: 第2道电子锁打开了！\n电动门开启了！$

label: VermilionCity_Gym_Text_OnlyTrashLocksWereReset
source: Nope!\nThere's only trash here.\pHey!\nThe electric locks were reset!$
translation: 不对！\n这里只有垃圾。\p哎呀！\n电子锁被重置了！$

label: VermilionCity_Text_Eusine
source:
EUSINE: That was so close!
I though I could corner it by\lambushing it here.\pBut running on the water is beyond
me.\pStill, I am starting to see
a pattern.\pSUICUNE prefers water!\pThat means...$
translation: 米那君：太可惜了！\n我还以为埋伏在这里\l就能把它逼入绝境呢。\p但要在水面上奔跑，\n我可办不到啊。\p不过，我开始摸清它的行踪规律了。\p水君偏爱水边！\p也就是说......$

label: VermilionCity_Text_Eusine2
source: Sorry {PLAYER}, I've got to go!$
translation: 抱歉啦，{PLAYER}，我得先走了！$

label: VermilionCity_Text_Teacher
source: VERMILION PORT is KANTO's seaside\ngateway.\pLuxury liners from around the\nworld dock here.$
translation: 枯叶港是关都的海上门户。\p来自世界各地的豪华客轮都会停靠在此。$

label: VermilionCity_Text_MachopOwner
source: My POKéMON is preparing the land\nfor construction.\pBut I have no money to start the\nproject…$
translation: 我的宝可梦正在整备土地准备施工。\p但我根本没钱启动这个工程......$

label: VermilionCity_Text_Machop1
source: MACHOP: Guooh gogogoh!$
translation: 腕力：果哦！果果果！$

label: VermilionCity_Text_Machop2
source: A MACHOP is growling while\nstomping the ground flat.$
translation: 腕力正一边低吼着，\n一边把地面踩得平平整整。$

label: VermilionCity_Text_SuperNerd
source: There are eight GYMS in KANTO.\pThat big building is VERMILION's\nPOKéMON GYM.$
translation: 关都一共有8座道馆。\p那栋大建筑就是\n枯叶市的宝可梦道馆。$

label: VermilionCity_Text_SnorlaxSleeping
source: SNORLAX is snoring peacefully…$
translation: 卡比兽正香甜地打着呼噜......$

label: VermilionCity_Text_RadioNearSnorlax
source: The POKéGEAR was placed near \nthe sleeping SNORLAX…\p…\pSNORLAX woke up!$
translation: 把宝可梦齿轮放到了\n睡着的卡比兽身旁......\p......\p卡比兽醒过来了！$

label: VermilionCity_Text_BadgeGuy_Trainer
source: Skilled trainers gather in KANTO.\pGYM LEADERS are especially strong.\pThey won't be easy to defeat.$
translation: 实力高强的训练家都聚集在关都。\p道馆馆主们更是非同小可。\p想打败他们可没那么容易。$

label: VermilionCity_Text_BadgeGuy_SomeBadges
source: You've started to collect KANTO\nGYM BADGES?\pDon't you agree that the trainers\nhere are tough?$
translation: 你开始收集关都的道馆徽章了吗？\p是不是也觉得这里的训练家都很强？$

label: VermilionCity_Text_BadgeGuy_MostBadges
source: I guess you'll be finished with\nyour conquest of KANTO GYMS soon.\pLet me know if you get all eight\nBADGES.$
translation: 看来你很快就能称霸关都的所有道馆了。\p如果你集齐了8枚徽章，记得来告诉我一声。$

label: VermilionCity_Text_BadgeGuy_AllBadges
source: Congratulations!\pYou got all the KANTO GYM BADGES.\pI've got a reward for your efforts.$
translation: 恭喜你！\p你集齐了关都的所有道馆徽章。\p这是对你努力付出的奖励。$

label: VermilionCity_Text_BadgeGuy_BattleEdge
source: Having a variety of POKéMON types\nshould give you an edge in battle.\pI'm sure the KANTO GYM BADGES will\nhelp you.$
translation: 拥有多种不同属性的宝可梦，\n能在对战中占据优势。\p我相信关都地区的道馆徽章\n一定会对你有所帮助的。$

label: VermilionCity_Text_Sign
source: VERMILION CITY\pThe Port of Exquisite Sunsets$
translation: 枯叶市\p落日染红的港湾$

label: VermilionCity_Text_GymSign
source: VERMILION CITY\nPOKéMON GYM\pLEADER: LT.SURGE\pThe Lightning American$
translation: 枯叶市\n宝可梦道馆\p馆主：马志士\p闪电美国人$

label: VermilionCity_Text_FanClubSign
source: POKéMON FAN CLUB\pAll POKéMON Fans Welcome!$
translation: 宝可梦发烧友俱乐部\p欢迎所有宝可梦爱好者！$

label: VermilionCity_Text_DiglettsCaveSign
source: 地鼠洞$
translation: 地鼠洞$

label: VermilionCity_Text_PortSign
source: VERMILION PORT\nENTRANCE$
translation: 枯叶港\n入口$

label: VermilionCity_Text_StevenIntro
source:
Hi!
My name is Steven.\lThe Champion from the HOENN region.\pHave we met...before?\pThat's not possible. 
All the trainers I have battled\lseem to have the same look, anyway.\pEspecially the ones who gave me
tough battles.\pI'm in KANTO for business.
Recently many HOENN POKéMON have\lmigrated to this region.\lThis influx risks disrupting the\lnatural ecosystem here.\pSo with the help of my company,
I'm creating a special habitat\lto attract and contain the most\linvasive species.\pMake sure you keep an eye out
and catch any HOENN POKéMON you see.\pSome trainers have even reported
one that soars through the sky like\la jet... What color was it again?$
translation:
你好！
我叫大吾。\l是来自丰缘地区的冠军。\p我们以前......见过面吗？\p不可能吧。
不过跟我对战过的训练家，\l眼神看起来都差不多。\p尤其是那些曾与我
展开过恶战的训练家。\p我来关都是为了公事。
最近有很多丰缘地区的宝可梦\l迁徙到了这个地区。\l这种涌入可能会破坏这里的自然生态系统。\p所以在我公司的协助下，
我正在建立一个特殊的栖息地，\l以吸引并收容那些外来物种。\p请你多加留意，
尽量收服遇见的丰缘宝可梦。\p甚至有训练家报告称，
看到一只像喷气机一样在空中翱翔的宝可梦......\l那家伙到底是什么颜色来着？$

label: VermilionCity_Text_StevenOutro
source: Ah, that's right.\pI must go.\nMay our journeys cross again.$
translation: 啊，对了。\p我该走了。\n愿我们的旅途再次交汇。$

label: VermilionCity_Text_Samson
source:
Whoah!\pSorry kiddo, I'm in a hurry!\pThe ferry on ROUTE 13 will be
leaving for the ISLES soon, and\lI've got to be on it!\pPhew... Phew...\pI ran all the way here from
MT. MOON.\pSee this tchotchke here?\pI picked up this STRANGE SOUVENIR
at the GIFT SHOP.\pIt's my ticket onto the ISLES.\pWell, see-ya!$
translation:
哇啊！\p抱歉啊小朋友，我赶时间！\p13号道路前往群岛的渡轮
马上就要开了，\l我必须赶上它才行！\p呼......呼......\p我可是一路从
月见山跑过来的。\p看到这个小玩意儿了吗？\p我是在礼品店
买到这个奇妙纪念物的。\p这可是我去群岛的凭证。\p好啦，回头见！$

label: VermilionCity_House1_Text_FishingDude
source:
I am the FISHING DUDE, the elder
of the FISHING BROS.\pHave you met the FISHING GURU at
LAKE OF RAGE?\pHe dreams about seeing the
world's greatest MAGIKARP.\pIf you don't mind, could you show
him any MAGIKARP you catch?\pWho knows, you may catch the
MAGIKARP of his dreams.$
translation:
我是钓鱼老爹，钓鱼兄弟
里的大哥。\p你见过愤怒之湖的
钓鱼大叔了吗？\p他一直梦想着能见到
世界上最棒的鲤鱼王。\p如果不介意的话，你能把钓到的
鲤鱼王拿给他瞧瞧吗？\p说不定，你能钓到
他梦寐以求的那只鲤鱼王呢。$

label: VermilionCity_House1_Text_Photo
source: It's a photo of people fishing…\pThey're having a great time…$
translation: 这是一张大家在钓鱼的照片......\p他们看起来玩得很开心......$

label: VermilionCity_House2_Text_PokefanF
source: Do you know about the MAGNET\nTRAIN?\pIt's a railway that goes to\nGOLDENROD in JOHTO.$
translation: 你知道磁浮列车吗？\p那是通往城都地区\n满金市的铁路哦。$

label: VermilionCity_House2_Text_Youngster
source: I want to go to SAFFRON to see\nthe MAGNET TRAIN.$
translation: 我想去金黄市\n看看磁浮列车。$

label: VermilionCity_House3_Text_Gentleman
source: Over many years, DIGLETT dug a\nlarge tunnel.\pThat tunnel goes to a distant\ntown.$
translation: 地鼠们花了许多年，\n挖出了一条大隧道。\p那条隧道一直通往\n遥远的城镇呢。$

label: VermilionMart_Text_SuperNerd
source: TEAM ROCKET is no longer in\nKANTO.\pThat alone makes me happy.$
translation: 火箭队已经不在关都了。\p光是这一点就足以让我开心了。$

label: VermilionMart_Text_Beauty
source: I'm thinking about going shopping\nin SAFFRON.$
translation: 我正在考虑去金黄市\n买东西呢。$

label: VermilionCity_PokemonCenter1F_Text_FishingGuru
source: A sleeping POKéMON is lying in\nfront of DIGLETT'S CAVE.\pIt's a fantastic opportunity to\nget it, but how do you wake it up?$
translation: 地鼠洞穴前趴着一只\n睡着的宝可梦。\p这可是收服它的绝好机会，\n但要怎么叫醒它呢？$

label: VermilionCity_PokemonCenter1F_Text_FishingGuru_FoughtSnorlax
source: There used to be a sleeping\nPOKéMON lying in front of\lDIGLETT'S CAVE.\pBut it seems to have disappeared.$
translation: 之前地鼠洞穴前\n一直趴着一只睡着的宝可梦。\p不过现在好像不见了。$

label: VermilionCity_PokemonCenter1F_Text_Sailor
source: The FAST SHIP is a great place to\nmeet and battle trainers.$
translation: 水手号可是结识训练家\n并展开对战的好地方。$

label: VermilionCity_PokemonCenter1F_Text_BugCatcher
source: Oh? You have some BADGES I've\nnever seen before.\pOh, I get it. You got them in\nJOHTO.$
translation: 哦？你戴着一些我从没见过的徽章呢。\p啊，我知道了。是在城都地区\n拿到的吧。$

label: VermilionPortPassage_Text_Teacher
source: The FAST SHIP sails every day!$
translation: 水手号每天都在航行！$

label: VermilionPort_Text_SuperNerd
source: You came from JOHTO?\pI hear many rare POKéMON live\nover there.$
translation: 你是从城都地区来的吗？\p听说那边生活着\n很多稀有的宝可梦呢。$

label: VermilionPort_Text_SailorCantSail
source: There's been a break-in at the\nPOWER PLANT, so we cannot set sail\luntil the THIEF is found.$
translation: 发电厂发生了一起入侵事件，\n在抓到小偷之前\l我们不能出航。$

label: VermilionPort_Text_NoPass
source: {PLAYER} tried to show the\n{STR_VAR_1}…\p…But no {STR_VAR_1}!\pSorry!\nYou may board only if you have an\l{STR_VAR_1}.$
translation: {PLAYER}想要出示\n{STR_VAR_1}......\p......但是没有找到{STR_VAR_1}！\p非常抱歉！\n必须持有{STR_VAR_1}\l才能登船。$

label: VermilionPort_Text_SailorGetOnBoard
source: We're departing soon.\nPlease get on board.$
translation: 马上就要启航了。\n请抓紧时间登船。$

label: VermilionPort_Text_CantBoard
source: Sorry. You can't board now.$
translation: 很抱歉，现在还不能登船。$

label: VermilionPort_Text_WhereSail
source: Where would you like to sail?$
translation: 请问您想航行到哪里？$

label: VermilionPort_Text_AskBoard
source: Welcome to FAST SHIP S.S.AQUA.\pWill you be boarding today?$
translation: 欢迎乘坐高速船阿库号。\p您今天要登船吗？$

label: VermilionPort_Text_AskTicket
source: May I see your S.S.TICKET?$
translation: 请出示您的船票。$

label: VermilionPort_Text_ComeAgain
source: 欢迎下次再来！$
translation: 欢迎下次再来！$

label: VermilionPort_Text_FlashTicket
source: {PLAYER} flashed the S.S.TICKET.\pThat's it. Thank you!$
translation: {PLAYER}出示了船票。\p确认无误。非常感谢！$

label: VermilionPort_Text_NoTicket
source: {PLAYER} tried to show the\nS.S.TICKET…\p…But no TICKET!\pSorry!\nYou may board only\lif you have an S.S.TICKET.$
translation: {PLAYER}正准备出示\n船票......\p......但是没有船票！\p很抱歉！\n只有持有船票的乘客\l才可以登船。$

label: VermilionCity_PortOutside_Text_Fisher
source: You just came from JOHTO?\nHow's the fishin' over there\l...\pJOHTO has RED GYARADOS?!$
translation: 你刚从城都地区过来？\n那边的垂钓情况怎么样啊\l......\p城都居然有红色的暴鲤龙？！$

label: VictoryRoad_Text_RivalBefore
source:
Hold it.\p…Are you going to take the POKéMON
LEAGUE challenge?\p…Don't make me laugh.\pYou're so much weaker than I am.\pI'm not like I was before.\pI now have the best and strongest
POKéMON with me.\pI'm invincible!\p{PLAYER}!
I challenge you!$
translation: 慢着。\p......你是准备去挑战宝可梦联盟吗？\p......别笑死人了。\p你明明比我弱多了。\p我已经和以前不一样了。\p我现在带着最优秀、最强大的宝可梦。\p我是无敌的！\p{PLAYER}！\n我要向你挑战！$

label: VictoryRoad_Text_RivalDefeat
source: …I couldn't win…\pI gave it every-thing I had…\pWhat you possess, and what I lack…\pI'm beginning to understand what\nthat dragon master said to me…$
translation: ......我竟然赢不了......\p我已经倾尽了全力......\p你所拥有的，还有我所欠缺的......\p我开始明白那个龙之大师\n对我说过的话了......$

label: VictoryRoad_Text_RivalAfter
source:
…I haven't given up on becoming the
greatest trainer…\pI'm going to find out why I can't
win and become stronger…\pWhen I do, I will challenge you.\pAnd I'll beat you down with all my
power.\p…Humph! You keep at it until then.$
translation:
......我可还没放弃成为
最强训练家的目标......\p我会查明白自己为什么赢不了，
并且变得更强......\p等到了那时候，我一定会再来挑战你。\p然后全力以赴把你打趴下。\p......哼！在那之前，你可别懈怠了。$

label: VictoryRoad_2F_Text_Gyaoo
source: ギヤーオ！$

label: VioletGym_Text_Falkner_WinLoss
source: …Darn! My dad's cherished bird\nPOKéMON…\pAll right. Take this.\pIt's the official POKéMON LEAGUE\nZEPHYRBADGE.$
translation:
......可恶！父亲悉心培育的鸟宝可梦居然......\p好吧。拿去吧。\p这是宝可梦联盟公认的
飞翼徽章。$

label: VioletGym_Text_ReceivedZephyrBadge
source: {PLAYER} received ZEPHYRBADGE.$
translation: {PLAYER}获得了飞翼徽章。$

label: VioletGym_Text_Falkner_BadgeExplain
source: ZEPHYRBADGE raises the ATTACK\npower of POKéMON.\pIt also enables POKéMON to use\nFLASH, if they can learn it,\lanytime.\pHere--take this too.$
translation:
拥有飞翼徽章后，宝可梦的攻击力
就会提升。\p而且只要是能学会闪光的宝可梦，\n随时都可以使用它。\p还有这个--你也一起收下吧。$

label: VioletGym_Text_Falkner_TMExplain
source:
By using a TM, a POKéMON will
instantly learn a new move.\pThat TM contains ROOST.\pIt restores HP up to half of your
POKéMON's maximum.\pIn other words, it heals your
POKéMON.$
translation:
使用招式学习器，可以让宝可梦
立刻学会新的招式。\p这个学习器里记录的是羽栖。\p它可以为宝可梦回复
最大HP的一半。\p换句话说，能够治疗你的宝可梦。$

label: VioletGym_Text_Falkner_AfterFight
source:
There are POKéMON GYMS in cities
and towns ahead.\pYou should test your skills at
these GYMS.\pI'm going to train harder to
become the greatest bird master!$
translation:
前方的城镇里还有许多宝可梦道馆。\p你也应该去那些道馆里
检验一下自己的实力。\p为了成为最顶尖的飞鸟大师，
我也要加倍修行！$

label: VioletGym_Text_Falkner_Rematch
source:
Congratulations on defeating
the ELITE 4!\pI've been training my
FLYING-type POKéMON even harder.\pThink you can take on the power
of the skies again?$
translation:
恭喜你击败了
四天王！\p我更加刻苦地特训了
我的飞行属性宝可梦。\p你觉得自己还能再次对抗
来自天空的力量吗？$

label: VioletGym_Text_Falkner_RematchLoss
source: Wow… You beat me again.\pI'm going to train harder to\nbecome the greatest bird master!$
translation: 哇......我又输给你了。\p我会更加努力修行，\n成为最出色的鸟使者！$

label: VioletGym_Text_BirdKeeperRod_Seen
source: The keyword is guts!\pThose here are training night and\nday to become bird POKéMON masters.\pCome on!$
translation:
关键词就是骨气！\p在这里修行的人，日日夜夜都在为
成为鸟宝可梦大师而努力。\p来吧！$

label: VioletGym_Text_BirdKeeperRod_Beaten
source: Gaaah!$
translation: 哇啊啊！$

label: VioletGym_Text_BirdKeeperRod_After
source: FALKNER's skills are for real!\pDon't get cocky just because\nyou beat me!$
translation: 阿速馆主的实力可是名不虚传！\p别以为赢了我就能得意忘形！$

label: VioletGym_Text_BirdKeeperAbe_Seen
source: Let me see if you are good\nenough to face FALKNER!$
translation:
让我来看看你够不够格
挑战阿速馆主吧！$

label: VioletGym_Text_BirdKeeperAbe_Beaten
source: This can't be true!$
translation: 这不可能！$

label: VioletGym_Text_BirdKeeperAbe_After
source: This is pathetic, losing to some\nrookie trainer…$
translation:
居然输给了一个新手训练家，
真是太丢脸了......$

label: VioletGym_Text_GymGuide_Intro
source:
Hey! What's up? I'm no trainer,
but I can give some advice!\pBelieve me! If you believe, a
championship dream can come true.\pYou believe? Then listen.\pFALKNER's ace is a bulky owl
that loves to eat BERRIES.\pWhile it's not the strongest,
it can take a lot of hits.\pYou can hurt it with ELECTRIC 
and ROCK-type moves, but watch out\lfor MUD-SLAP!\pIf you want more help, go visit the
POKéMON ACADEMY.\pThe students there really know
their stuff!$
translation:
哟！近来如何？虽然我不是训练家，
但我能给你提点建议！\p相信我！只要坚信，
冠军的梦想就一定能实现。\p相信了吗？那就仔细听好。\p阿速的王牌是一只非常耐打的猫头鹰，
而且特别爱吃树果。\p虽然攻击力不算最强，
但特别经打。\p你可以用电属性和岩石属性招式痛击它，\n不过要小心它的掷泥！\p如果还想了解更多技巧，就去逛逛
宝可梦学院吧。\p那里的学生可懂行了！$

label: VioletGym_Text_GymGuide_Win
source: Nice battle! Keep it up,\nand you'll be the CHAMP in no\ltime at all!$
translation: 精彩的对战！保持这个势头，\n用不了多久你就能成为冠军了！$

label: VioletCity_Gym_Text_GymStatue
source: VIOLET CITY POKéMON GYM$
translation: 桔梗市宝可梦道馆$

label: VioletCity_Text_LiquidJustice
source: Look around!\pIt's easy to see what POKéMON\nyou can catch in an area without\lhaving to run around in tall\lgrass all day!$
translation: 仔细瞧瞧周围吧！\p不用整天在草丛里盲目乱跑，\n就能轻松知道这一带能遇到哪些宝可梦了！$

label: VioletCity_Text_EarlAsksIfYouBeatFalkner
source: Hello!\nYou are trainer?\pBattle GYM LEADER,\nwin you did?$
translation: 你好啊！\n你是训练家吗？\p挑战道馆馆主，\n赢了吗？$

label: VioletCity_Text_VeryNiceIndeed
source: Ooh, la la!\nVery indeed nice!$
translation: 哎呀呀！\n真是太棒了！$

label: VioletCity_Text_FollowEarl
source: Is that so? Then study shall\nyou! Follow me!$
translation: 这样啊？那就来学习吧！\n跟我来！$

label: VioletCity_Text_HereTeacherIAm
source: Here, teacher I am.\nGood it is you study here!$
translation: 在这里，我是老师。\n你能在这里学习真好！$

label: VioletCity_Text_Boy
source: Hey, you're a POKéMON trainer?\pIf you head to the ACADEMY,\nyou might learn something new!$
translation:
嘿，你是宝可梦训练家吗？\p去那边的学院转转，
说不定能学到新知识呢！$

label: VioletCity_Text_Gramps
source: FALKNER, from the VIOLET\nPOKéMON GYM, is a fine trainer!\pHe inherited his father's gym\nand has done a great job with\lit.$
translation:
桔梗宝可梦道馆的阿速，
可真是一位优秀的训练家！\p他继承了父亲的道馆，\n并且打理得有声有色呢。$

label: VioletCity_Text_Youngster
source: I saw a wiggly tree up ahead!\pIf you touch it, it squirms\nand dances! Cool!$
translation: 前面有一棵会摇晃的树！\p去碰碰它的话，它还会扭来扭去\n跳起舞呢！太酷了！$

label: VioletCity_Text_Sign
source: VIOLET CITY\pThe City of Nostalgic Scents$
translation: 桔梗市\p怀旧香气弥漫的城镇$

label: VioletCity_Text_GymSign
source: VIOLET CITY POKéMON GYM\pLEADER: FALKNER, The Elegant\nMaster of Flying POKéMON$
translation: 桔梗市宝可梦道馆\p馆主：阿速\n华丽的飞翔名家$

label: VioletCity_Text_SproutTowerSign
source: SPROUT TOWER\pExperience the Way of POKéMON$
translation: 喇叭芽之塔\p领悟宝可梦之道$

label: VioletCity_Text_EarlsAcademySign
source: EARL'S POKéMON ACADEMY$
translation: 杜利尔宝可梦私塾$

label: VioletCity_Text_Pichu
source: PICHU: Chuuuu!$
translation: 皮丘：皮啾--！$

label: VioletCity_Text_Bellsprout
source: BELLSPROUT: Sprouuuut.$
translation: 喇叭芽：叭芽--。$

label: VioletCity_Text_Rattata
source: RATTATA: RATTATARATTA!$
translation: 小拉达：拉达拉达！$

label: VioletCity_Text_ElmName
source: 空木博士$
translation: 空木博士$

label: VioletCity_Text_Elm_Call
source: PROF.ELM: Hello, {PLAYER}? We\ndiscovered something about the EGG!\pMy assistant is at the POKéMON\nCENTER in VIOLET CITY.\pCould you talk to him?$
translation: 空木博士：喂，是{PLAYER}吗？\n我们关于那颗蛋有了新发现！\p我的助手现在在桔梗市的\n宝可梦中心。\p你能去和他见个面吗？$

label: VioletCity_Text_Kimono_Girl1
source: Me oh my...\nThat EGG must be...!$
translation: 哎呀呀......\n那颗蛋一定是......！$

label: VioletCity_Text_Kimono_Girl2
source: I see...\pSo it was handed from MR. POKéMON\nto PROF.ELM, then from \lPROF.ELM to you.\pNow I get it...$
translation: 原来如此......\p是从宝可梦爷爷那里交给了空木博士，\l然后空木博士又交给了你啊。\p我明白了......$

label: VioletCity_Text_Kimono_Girl3
source: That EGG is truly an important EGG.\pPlease do take good care of it\nfor me. Is that understood?$
translation: 那颗蛋真的是非常重要的蛋。\p请务必替我好好照顾它。\n明白了吗？$

label: VioletCity_Text_Kimono_Girl4
source: I am counting on you.$
translation: 一切就拜托你了。$

label: VioletCity_House1_Text_YouWillTradeWontYou
source: I collect POKéMON!\nDo you have a {STR_VAR_1}?\pWant to trade it for my\n{STR_VAR_2}?$
translation: 我正在收集宝可梦！\n你有{STR_VAR_1}吗？\p想用它来交换我的\n{STR_VAR_2}吗？$

label: VioletCity_House1_Text_MonYouTakeCare
source: Yay! I got myself {STR_VAR_1}!\p{STR_VAR_2}, you take care!$
translation: 太好啦！我得到{STR_VAR_1}了！\p{STR_VAR_2}，你要保重哦！$

label: VioletCity_House1_Text_ThisIsntAMon
source: Uh, no, I don't think so.\nThat isn't a {STR_VAR_1}.$
translation: 呃，不对吧。\n这并不是{STR_VAR_1}啊。$

label: VioletCity_House1_Text_YouWontTradeMe
source: You don't want to trade? Aww...$
translation: 不想交换吗？好吧......$

label: VioletCity_House1_Text_After
source: Hi, how's my old ONIX doing?$
translation: 嗨，之前换给你的大岩蛇过得怎么样？$

label: VioletCity_House1_Text_PokefanM
source: A POKéMON you get in a trade\ngrows quickly.\pBut if you don't have the right\nGYM BADGE, they may disobey you.$
translation: 通过交换得到的宝可梦\n成长得非常快。\p但要是没有对应的道馆徽章，\n它们可能就不会听话哦。$

label: VioletCity_NicknameHouse_Text_Teacher
source: She uses the names of her\nfavorite things to eat.\pFor the nicknames she gives to\nher POKéMON, I mean.$
translation: 她都用自己爱吃的东西来起名。\p我是说，她给宝可梦起的昵称啦。$

label: VioletCity_NicknameHouse_Text_Lass
source: I call my PIDGEY STRAWBERRY!$
translation: 我管我的波波叫草莓！$

label: VioletCity_NicknameHouse_Text_Bird
source: STRAWBERRY: Pijji!$
translation: 草莓：哔唧！$

label: VioletCity_Mart_Text_Granny
source:
When you first catch a POKéMON,
it may be weak.\pBut it will eventually grow to
be strong.\pIt's important to treat POKéMON
with love.$
translation: 刚收服宝可梦的时候，\n它可能还很弱小。\p但它终究会成长得越来越强大。\p用爱心去关怀宝可梦是非常重要的。$

label: VioletCity_Mart_Text_CooltrainerM
source: POKéMON can hold items like\nPOTION and ANTIDOTE.\pBut they don't appear to know\nhow to use man-made items.$
translation: 宝可梦可以携带伤药或解毒药之类的道具。\p不过它们好像不知道\n该怎么使用人造的道具呢。$

label: VioletCity_PokeCenter_Text_ElmsAideFavor
source: {PLAYER}, long time, no see.\pPROF.ELM asked me to find you.\pHe has another favor to ask.\pWould you take the POKéMON EGG?$
translation: {PLAYER}，好久不见。\p空木博士让我来找你。\p他还有一件事想拜托你。\p你能收下这颗宝可梦的蛋吗？$

label: VioletCity_PokeCenter_Text_ElmsAideNoRoom
source: {PLAYER}, long time, no see.\pPROF.ELM asked me to find you.\pHe has another favor to ask.\pWould you take the POKéMON EGG?\pOh, wait... You need to make room\nin your party first.$
translation: {PLAYER}，好久不见。\p空木博士让我来找你。\p他还有一件事想拜托你。\p你能收下这颗宝可梦的蛋吗？\p啊，等等......你得先给\n同行的队伍腾出空位才行。$

label: VioletCity_PokeCenter_Text_ElmsAideGiveEgg
source:
We discovered that a POKéMON won't
hatch until it grows in the EGG.\pIt also has to be with other
active POKéMON to hatch.\p{PLAYER}, you're the only person
we can rely on.$
translation: 我们发现，宝可梦在蛋里成长成熟之前\n是不会孵化的。\p而且似乎还要和有活力的宝可梦呆在一起\n才会孵化出来。\p{PLAYER}，我们能依靠的就只有你了。$

label: VioletCity_PokeCenter_Text_ElmsAideGiveItem
source: Oh, and this might help when it hatches.$
translation: 噢，还有这个，孵化的时候也许能派上用场。$

label: VioletCity_PokeCenter_Text_ElmsAideFullParty
source: Oh, no. You can't carry any more\nPOKéMON with you.\pI'll wait here while you make\nroom for the EGG.$
translation: 哎呀，糟糕。你已经带不下更多宝可梦了。\p你先去给蛋腾出个位置吧，\n我在这里等着你。$

label: VioletCity_PokeCenter_Text_ElmsAideEggToPC
source: Oh, but you can't carry any more\nPOKéMON with you.\pDon't worry--I sent the EGG to\nBILL'S PC for you.$
translation:
哎呀，你的同行宝可梦
已经带不下了呢。\p别担心--我已经帮你把宝可梦蛋
送到正辉的电脑里去了。$

label: VioletCity_PokeCenter_Text_ElmsAideRefuse
source: B-but… PROF.ELM asked for you…$
translation: 可、可是......空木博士有事找你......$

label: VioletCity_PokeCenter_Text_BooksAreGreat
source: While my POKéMON are recovering\nI love to read a good book.$
translation:
在宝可梦恢复体力的时候，
我最喜欢读一本好书了。$

label: VioletCity_PokeCenter_Text_MobileAdapter
source: I just battled a friend in\nCIANWOOD over a link.\pIf you connect a MOBILE ADAPTER,\nyou can link with a friend far\laway.$
translation:
我刚刚通过联机和湛蓝市的
朋友对战了一场。\p只要连接上移动适配器，
就能和远方的朋友进行联机哦。$

label: VioletCity_PokeCenter_Text_GameboyKid
source: A guy named BILL made the\nPOKéMON PC storage system.$
translation:
有个叫正辉的人开发了
宝可梦电脑存储系统。$

label: VioletCity_PokeCenter_Text_Gentleman
source: It was around three years ago.\pTEAM ROCKET was up to no good\nwith POKéMON.\pBut justice prevailed--a young\nkid broke 'em up.$
translation:
那大概是三年前的事了。\p火箭队利用宝可梦到处作恶。\p但正义最终战胜了邪恶--一个
年轻的少年把他们彻底瓦解了。$

label: VioletCity_PokeCenter_Text_Youngster
source: POKéMON are smart. They won't\nobey a trainer they don't respect.\pWithout the right GYM BADGES,\nthey will just do as they please.$
translation:
宝可梦可是很聪明的。它们不会听从
自己不尊敬的训练家的指挥。\p要是没有相应的道馆徽章，
它们就会自作主张、随心所欲。$

label: VioletCity_TrainerSchool_Text_Twin
source:
I'm not a GBA kid, but I love
playing POKéMON games!\pIn the old games, you had to battle
a lot of wild POKéMON to get enough\lEXP.\pBut in newer games, the EXP. SHARE
makes your POKéMON level up too fast.\pIn this game, the EXP. SHARE is
balanced to put your POKéMON at just\lthe right level. Or slightly higher,\ldepending on how many battles you do.\pIf you want a traditional GEN 1-4
experience, turn EXP. SHARE off.\lIf you want a modern experience,\lturn EXP. SHARE ON.\pYou choose how you want to play!$
translation:
我虽然不是玩GBA长大的那一辈，
但我超级喜欢玩宝可梦游戏！\p在过去的老游戏里，你得跟大量的
野生宝可梦对战才能攒够经验值。\p而在较新的游戏里，学习装置
又会让宝可梦升级得太快。\p在这个游戏里，学习装置经过了平衡调整，
能让你的宝可梦刚好保持在合适的等级，\l或者稍微高一点，取决于你打了多少场对战。\p如果你想要传统的第1至4世代体验，
可以关掉学习装置。\l如果你想要现代的游玩体验，\l那就开启学习装置。\p怎么玩完全由你来决定！$

label: VioletCity_TrainerSchool_Text_EarlIntro
source: EARL, I am!\pWonderful are POKéMON, yes!\pTeach you I will to be a better\ntrainer!$
translation:
杜利，是在下！\p绝妙无比，宝可梦正是！\p传授于你，让你成为更优秀的
训练家！$

label: VioletCity_TrainerSchool_Text_Teacher
source:
Certain POKéMON start off weak and
require much more EXP to become\lstrong than others do.\pFor example, LARVITAR is quite weak
but will eventually become a\lmighty TYRANITAR, at the cost of\lmuch EXP.\pOnly the most dedicated trainers
should attempt to train such a\lPOKéMON.$
translation:
有些宝可梦刚开始很弱小，而且需要
比其他宝可梦多得多的经验值才能变强。\p比如幼基拉斯虽然十分弱小，
但耗费大量经验值培育后，\l最终会蜕变为强大的班基拉斯。\p只有最有毅力的训练家，
才能坚持培育这样的宝可梦。$

label: VioletCity_TrainerSchool_Text_TeachHowToWin
source: Good! Teach you, I will!\pIn battle, POKéMON top on list\njump out first!\pChange order in list, make\nbattle easy, maybe!\pMore from me you want to hear?$
translation:
甚好！传授于你，在下会！\p在对战中，队伍最上方的宝可梦
会最先登场！\p调换队伍顺序，对战变得轻松，
也许就会！\p还想听在下，继续讲吗？$

label: VioletCity_TrainerSchool_Text_TeachMore
source: So, want to know how to raise\nPOKéMON well?$
translation:
那么，想知道如何好好培育
宝可梦吗？$

label: VioletCity_TrainerSchool_Text_NoMoreToTeach
source: Oh! Smart student you are!\nNothing more do I teach!\pIf you want more, talk to\npupils!$
translation:
哦！聪明的学生，正是你！
在下已经没什么可教的了！\p若是还想了解，不妨去问问
那些学生们！$

label: VioletCity_TrainerSchool_Text_GameboyKid1
source: Notable POKéMON available in an\narea can be seen in the overworld!\pBut make sure to check routes\nat DAY and NIGHT!$
translation:
在地图各处可以直接看到该区域出没的
代表性宝可梦！\p不过别忘了在白天和夜晚
分别去各个道路查看哦！$

label: VioletCity_TrainerSchool_Text_GameboyKid2
source:
BERRIES in the JOHTO region are
good for healing and making BALLS.\pBERRIES in KANTO are good for
reducing a POKéMON's stats.\pThe DOJO in KANTO helps POKéMON
perfect individual stats.$
translation:
城都地区的树果非常适合
用来治疗和制作精灵球。\p而关都地区的树果则适合
用来降低宝可梦的基础点数。\p关都的道场还能帮助宝可梦
将各项个体值提升到完美。$

label: VioletCity_TrainerSchool_Text_Youngster2
source: Be aware that your opponents\nnow use teams with better type\lcoverage, so expect a much\lmore challenging journey ahead.$
translation:
请留意，如今对手们的队伍
属性打击面都更加全面了，\l因此接下来的旅途将会\l极具挑战性。$

label: VioletCity_TrainerSchool_Text_Blackboard
source: The blackboard describes\nPOKéMON HM moves.\pHMs, once unlocked, don't need to\nbe taught to be used.$
translation:
黑板上写着关于宝可梦秘传招式的说明。\p秘传招式一旦解锁，
不需要让宝可梦学会就能直接使用。$

label: VioletCity_TrainerSchool_Text_Notebook
source: It's this kid's notebook…\pCatch POKéMON using POKé BALLS.\pUp to six can be in your party.\pKeep reading?$
translation: 这是这个孩子的笔记本......\p使用精灵球来捕捉宝可梦。\p同行宝可梦最多可以携带6只。\p要继续阅读吗？$

label: VioletCity_TrainerSchool_Text_Notebook1
source: Before throwing a POKé BALL,\nweaken the target first.\pA poisoned or burned POKéMON\nis easier to catch.\pKeep reading?$
translation:
在投掷精灵球之前，
要先削弱目标的体力。\p陷入中毒或灼伤状态的宝可梦
会更容易捕捉。\p要继续阅读吗？$

label: VioletCity_TrainerSchool_Text_Notebook2
source: Some moves may cause confusion.\pConfusion may make a POKéMON\nattack itself.\pLeaving battle clears up any\nconfusion.\pKeep reading?$
translation:
有些招式可能会导致混乱。\p处于混乱状态的宝可梦
可能会攻击自己。\p只要脱离战斗就能解除混乱状态。\p要继续阅读吗？$

label: VioletCity_TrainerSchool_Text_Notebook3
source:
People who catch and use
POKéMON in battle are POKéMON
trainers.\pThey are expected to visit
POKéMON GYMS and defeat other
trainers.\pThe next page is… Blank!\pBoy: E-he-he…\pI haven't written anymore…$
translation:
捕捉宝可梦并带着它们对战的人，
被称为宝可梦训练家。\p他们的目标通常是巡回各个宝可梦道馆，
击败各地的训练家。\p下一页是......一片空白！\p男孩：嘿嘿嘿......\p后面的我还没写呢......$

label: VioletCity_TrainerSchool_Text_StickerMachine
source: This super machine prints data\nout as stickers!$
translation:
这台超级机器可以把数据
打印成贴纸！$

label: ViridianCity_Gym_Text_BlueGotoDojo
source: BLUE: Back for more already?\pIf you want another shot at me,\ncome to the FIGHTING DOJO!$
translation:
青绿：这么快就皮痒了，又想找虐？\p如果还想挑战我的话，
就来格斗道场吧！$

label: ViridianCity_Gym_Text_LeaderBlue_Before
source:
BLUE: Yo! Finally got here, huh?\pI wasn't in the mood at CINNABAR,\pbut now I'm ready to battle you.\p…\pYou're telling me you conquered all
the GYMS in JOHTO?\pHeh! JOHTO's GYMS must be pretty
pathetic then.\pHey, don't worry about it.\pI'll know if you are good or not by
battling you right now.\pReady, JOHTO CHAMP?$
translation: 青绿：哟！总算到这了啊？\p在红莲岛时我可没那个心情，\p但现在我已经准备好和你对战了。\p......\p你说你称霸了城都的所有道馆？\p哼！那城都的道馆水平肯定挺差劲的吧。\p喂，别放在心上。\p只要现在和你打一场，我就知道你有几斤几两了。\p准备好了吗，城都的冠军？$

label: ViridianCity_Gym_Text_LeaderBlue_Win
source: BLUE: What?\pHow the heck did I lose to you?\p…\pTch, all right… Here, take this--it's\nEARTHBADGE.$
translation: 青绿：什么？！\p我到底怎么会输给你啊？！\p......\p切，好吧......拿去吧--这是\n绿色徽章。$

label: ViridianCity_Gym_Text_ReceivedEarthBadge
source: {PLAYER} received EARTHBADGE.$
translation: {PLAYER}获得了绿色徽章。$

label: ViridianCity_Gym_Text_LeaderBlue_After
source: BLUE: …\pAll right, I was wrong. You're the\nreal deal. You are a good trainer.\pBut I'm going to beat you someday.\pDon't you forget it!$
translation: 青绿：......\p好吧，是我看走眼了。你确实名副其实，是个出色的训练家。\p不过总有一天我会赢回来的。\p你可别忘了！$

label: ViridianCity_Gym_Text_LeaderBlue_GiveTM
source: Take this with you.$
translation: 把这个也带上吧。$

label: ViridianCity_Gym_Text_LeaderBlue_ExplainTM
source: That's TRICK ROOM.\pAll POKEMON in battle will change speed.\nSlow goes first. Fast goes last.\pUse it to turn a battle on its head.$
translation: 那是"戏法空间"。\p场上所有宝可梦的速度都会发生颠倒。\n速度慢的先行动，速度快的后行动。\p用它来彻底逆转战局吧。$

label: ViridianCity_Gym_Text_LeaderBlue_Epilogue
source: BLUE: Listen, you.\pYou'd better not lose until I beat\nyou. Got it?$
translation: 青绿：听好了，\p在我打赢你之前，你可不准输给别人。听明白了没？$

label: ViridianCity_Gym_Text_Guide
source: Yo, CHAMP in making!\pHow's it going? Looks like you're on\na roll.\pThe GYM LEADER is a guy who battled\nthe CHAMPION three years ago.\pHe's no pushover.\pGive it everything you've got!$
translation: 哟，未来的冠军！\p最近怎么样？看起来势头很猛嘛！\p这里的道馆馆主可是三年前和冠军交过手的人物哦。\p他可绝不是省油的灯。\p使出你的浑身解数上吧！$

label: ViridianCity_Gym_Text_Guide_Win
source: Man, you are truly tough…\pThat was a heck of an inspirational\nbattle. It brought tears to my eyes.$
translation: 天哪，你可真厉害......\p那场对战太令人热血沸腾了，感动得我眼泪都要掉下来了。$

label: ViridianCity_Gym_Text_GymStatue
source: VIRIDIAN POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: BLUE\pWINNING TRAINERS:\nBLUE, RED$
translation: 常青宝可梦道馆\n馆主：青绿\p胜出训练家：\n青绿、赤红$

label: ViridianCity_Gym_Text_GymStatuePlayerWon
source: VIRIDIAN POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: BLUE\pWINNING TRAINERS:\nBLUE, RED, {PLAYER}$
translation: 常青宝可梦道馆\n馆主：青绿\p胜出训练家：\n青绿、赤红、{PLAYER}$

label: ViridianCity_Text_OakName
source: 大木$
translation: 大木$

label: ViridianCity_Text_OakCall
source: OAK: Ah, {PLAYER}!\pCome and see my at my\nLAB in PALLET TOWN\lwhen you get the chance.$
translation: 大木博士：啊，{PLAYER}！\p你有空的时候，\n请来一趟真新镇的研究所吧。$

label: ViridianCity_Text_CoffeeGramps_Question
source:
Hey, kid! I just had a double shot
of espresso, and I am wired!\pI need to talk to someone, so you'll
have to do!\pI might not look like much now, but
I was an expert at catching POKéMON.\pDo you believe me?$
translation: 喂，小鬼！我刚喝了双份浓缩咖啡，现在精神头足得很！\p我正想找人聊聊呢，就你了吧！\p虽然我现在看起来平平无奇，但我以前可是抓宝可梦的名手呢。\p你相信吗？$

label: ViridianCity_Text_CoffeeGramps_Believed
source: Good, good. Yes, I was something\nout of the ordinary, let me tell\lyou!$
translation: 很好，很好。跟你说，我年轻时可真不是一般人啊！$

label: ViridianCity_Text_CoffeeGramps_Doubted
source: What? You little whelp!\pIf I were just a bit younger, I'd\nshow you a thing or two. Humph!$
translation: 什么？你这个不知天高地厚的小鬼！\p要是我再年轻几岁，非得让你见识见识不可。哼！$

label: ViridianCity_Text_GrampsNearGym
source: This GYM didn't have a LEADER\nuntil recently.\pA young man from PALLET became\nthe LEADER, but he's often away.$
translation: 这家道馆直到最近都还没有馆主呢。\p后来有个来自真新镇的年轻人当上了馆主，不过他经常不在。$

label: ViridianCity_Text_GrampsNearGym_BlueReturned
source: Are you going to battle the\nLEADER?\pGood luck to you. You'll need it.$
translation: 你要去挑战道馆馆主吗？\p祝你好运，你肯定会需要运气的。$

label: ViridianCity_Text_DreamEaterFisherNew
source: …Zzzzz…\pYawn!\pI must have dozed off in the sun.\pWhat? I remind you of somebody?\pI don't know, here, have this.$
translation: ......呼--噜--......\p哈欠--！\p不知不觉在太阳底下睡着了。\p怎么？我让你想起谁了吗？\p我也不清楚，喏，这个给你吧。$

label: ViridianCity_Text_DreamEaterFisher_GotTM
source: …Zzzzz…$

label: ViridianCity_Text_DreamEaterFisher
source: Yawn!\pI must have dozed off in the sun.\p…I had this dream about a DROWZEE\neating my dream. Weird, huh?\pHuh? What's this?\pWhere did this TM come from?\pThis is spooky! Here, you can have\nthis TM.$
translation: 哈欠--！\p不知不觉在太阳底下睡着了。\p......我刚才做了个梦，梦见一只催眠貘吃掉了我的梦。很奇怪吧？\p咦？这是什么？\p这张招式学习器是从哪来的？\p真邪门！喏，这招式学习器就送给你吧。$

label: ViridianCity_Text_DreamEaterFisher_GotDreamEater
source: TM42 contains DREAM EATER…\p…Zzzzz…$

label: ViridianCity_Text_Youngster
source: I heard that there are many items\non the ground in VIRIDIAN FOREST.$
translation: 听说常青森林的地上掉落着不少道具呢。$

label: ViridianCity_Text_Sign
source: VIRIDIAN CITY\pThe Eternally Green Paradise$
translation: 常青市\p绿意常在的常青乐土$

label: ViridianCity_Text_GymSign
source: VIRIDIAN CITY POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: …\pThe rest of the text is illegible…$
translation: 常青市宝可梦道馆\n馆主：......\p后面的文字模糊不清，看不清了......$

label: ViridianCity_Text_WelcomeSign
source: WELCOME TO VIRIDIAN CITY,\pTHE GATEWAY TO INDIGO PLATEAU$
translation: 常青市欢迎你，\p通往石英高原的玄关$

label: ViridianCity_Text_TrainerHouseSign
source: TRAINER HOUSE\pThe Club for Top Trainer Battles$
translation: 训练家之舍\p顶级训练家对战俱乐部$

label: ViridianCity_House1_Text_PokefanM
source: Do you put a lot of thought into\nnaming your POKéMON?\pGiving them good nicknames adds to\nthe fun of trading with others.$
translation: 给宝可梦起昵称时\n你会深思熟虑吗？\p给它们起个好昵称，\n和别人交换时会更有乐趣哦。$

label: ViridianCity_House1_Text_Lass
source: They're SPEARY--a SPEAROW--and\nRATTEY--a RATTATA.$
translation: 它们是烈雀"雀宝"和\n小拉达"拉达宝"。$

label: ViridianCity_House1_Text_Speary
source: SPEARY: Ch-chun!$
translation: 雀宝：啾啾！$

label: ViridianCity_House1_Text_Rattey
source: RATTEY: Kikiii!$
translation: 拉达宝：吱吱--！$

label: ViridianMart_Text_Lass
source: The GYM LEADER here is totally cool.$
translation: 这里的道馆馆主简直帅呆了。$

label: ViridianMart_Text_CooltrainerM
source: Have you been to CINNABAR?\pIt's an island way south of here.$
translation: 你去过红莲岛吗？\p那是从这里一直往南的一座岛屿。$

label: ViridianCity_PokemonCenter_Text_1FCooltrainerM
source: Where in the world is VIRIDIAN's GYM\nLEADER? I wanted to challenge him.$
translation: 常青道馆的馆主到底跑哪儿去了？\n我还想挑战他呢。$

label: ViridianCity_PokemonCenter_Text_1FCooltrainerM_BlueReturned
