source: There are no GYM TRAINERS at the\nVIRIDIAN GYM.\pThe LEADER claims his policy is to\nwin without having any underlings.$
translation: 常青道馆里一个馆内训练家都没有。\p馆主自称他的方针是\n就算没有任何手下也照样能赢。$

label: ViridianCity_PokemonCenter_Text_1FCooltrainerF
source: I heard that the GYM in CINNABAR is\ngone.\pI wonder what became of BLAINE, the\nGYM LEADER.$
translation: 听说红莲岛的道馆已经没了。\p不知道馆主夏伯\n现在怎么样了。$

label: ViridianCity_PokemonCenter_Text_1FBugCatcher
source: My dream is to become a GYM LEADER.$
translation: 我的梦想是成为一名道馆馆主。$

label: ViridianForest_Text_Bugsy
source: BUGSY: I came to KANTO to look for\nBUG-TYPE POKéMON, so I can become\la stronger BUG-TYPE POKéMON\lTRAINER!\pIf you're ready for another match,\nI'll be at the DOJO in SAFFRON!$
translation: 阿笔：我为了成为更强的虫属性训练家，\n特地来关都寻找虫属性宝可梦！\p如果你准备好再切磋一场，\n我就在金黄市的格斗道场等你！$

label: WhirlIslands_LugiaChamber_Text_Kimono_AfterNotCaught
source: You have not only made LUGIA\nappear, but you have also defeated\lit...\pThere is nothing more for us to\nsay. Take care of yourself in your\ljourney...$
translation: 你不仅让洛奇亚现身，\n还击败了它......\p我们已经没有什么好说的了。\n前方的旅途请多加保重......$

label: WhirlIslands_LugiaChamber_Text_Kimono_AfterCaught
source: You have not only made LUGIA\nappear, but you have also caught\lit...\pThere is nothing more for us to\nsay. Take care of yourself in your\ljourney...$
translation: 你不仅让洛奇亚现身，\n还收服了它......\p我们已经没有什么好说的了。\n前方的旅途请多加保重......$

label: WhirlIslands_LugiaChamber_Text_Zuki_Before
source: ZUKI: Go, face LUGIA. $
translation: 玉绪：去吧，直面洛奇亚。 $

label: WhirlIslands_LugiaChamber_Text_Naoko_Before
source: NAOKO: Go, face LUGIA. $
translation: 菜穗子：去吧，直面洛奇亚。 $

label: WhirlIslands_LugiaChamber_Text_Miki_Before
source: MIKI: Go, face LUGIA. $
translation: 美纪：去吧，直面洛奇亚。 $

label: WhirlIslands_LugiaChamber_Text_Sayo_Before
source: SAYO: Go, face LUGIA. $
translation: 小夜：去吧，直面洛奇亚。 $

label: WhirlIslands_LugiaChamber_Text_Kuni_Before
source: KUNI: Go, face LUGIA. $
translation: 国枝：去吧，直面洛奇亚。 $

label: WhirlIslands_LugiaChamber_Text_Kimono_Opening
source: KIMONO GIRL: That's right.\nThis is where we welcome LUGIA.\pWhen the dance we practiced many\ndays becomes one with the sound of the\lTidal Bell we entrusted to you, then\lLUGIA shall come out from deep within\lthe waterfall basin once again. $
translation: 艺妓：没错。\n这里就是迎接洛奇亚的地方。\p当我们苦练多日的舞蹈，\n与托付给你的海鸣之铃的铃声\l融为一体时，洛奇亚便会再次\l从瀑布潭的深处现身。 $

label: WhirlIslands_LugiaChamber_Text_Kimono_Closing1
source:
That is indeed LUGIA...
The guardian of these islands from\lancient times... \pSo many have tried again and again,
only to fail...\p{PLAYER}, your heart in complete
harmony with the Tidal Bell has finally\lallowed it to appear...
{PLAYER}, don't you see?\pLUGIA... It must have been waiting for
someone like you all this time.\pWouldn't you agree? $
translation:
那确实就是洛奇亚......
自古以来便守护着这些岛屿的神明...... \p无数人一次又一次地尝试，
最终却都失败了......\p{PLAYER}，是你那与海鸣之铃
完全交融的心意，才终于让它现身了......
{PLAYER}，难道你还不明白吗？\p洛奇亚......它一直都在等待着
像你这样的人出现啊。\p难道不是吗？ $

label: WhirlIslands_LugiaChamber_Text_Kimono_After
source: KIMONO GIRL: You've proven yourself\ntoday, {PLAYER}.$
translation: 艺妓：{PLAYER}，你今天证明了自己的实力。$

label: gText_ApprenticeLevelModeThanks7
source: {STR_VAR_1} is your choice!\nI see. I will do my best!\pThank you, {PLAYER}.\nI hope I can count on you again.\lPlease take care!$
translation: 你选择的是{STR_VAR_1}啊！\n我明白了，我会全力以赴的！\p谢谢你，{PLAYER}。\n以后也要拜托你指点哦。\l请多保重！$

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach8
source:
Eek! Eek! {PLAYER}!
You spoke to me!\lI… I'm overjoyed!\pMe! My name is {STR_VAR_1}!
I just became a TRAINER!\pI'm delighted I met you, {PLAYER},
the big name in POKéMON circles!\pOh-oh-oh, I know!
May I ask a huge favor, {PLAYER}?\pPlease take me in as your apprentice!
I want to learn from you!$
translation:
呀！呀！{PLAYER}！
你居然主动跟我说话了！\l我......我太高兴了！\p我！我的名字叫{STR_VAR_1}！
是刚刚成为训练家的新人！\p能见到你真是太荣幸了，{PLAYER}，
你可是宝可梦界的大名人啊！\p啊、啊、对了！
{PLAYER}，我能求你一个大忙吗？\p请收我为徒吧！
我想向你学习！$

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach10
source:
Oh, hey, {PLAYER}{KUN}, right?
The police were looking for you!\p… … …
Of course I'm lying!\pMe, I'm {STR_VAR_1}. Despite the way
I look, I'm the POKéMON CHAMPION!\l…That's a lie, too!\pThis is no lie, though.
I'm not very good at battling.\pSo, how about you becoming my master
about all things POKéMON?$
translation:
哎呀，这不是{PLAYER}{KUN}吗？
警察刚刚在到处找你呢！\p............
骗你的啦！\p我叫{STR_VAR_1}。别看我长这样，
我可是宝可梦冠军！\l......这也是骗你的！\p不过接下来这句可不是谎话。
其实我不太擅长宝可梦对战。\p所以，你能收我为徒，
教教我关于宝可梦的一切吗？$

label: gText_ApprenticeLevelModeThanks10
source:
Okay, so {STR_VAR_1} is better!
I'll go to the other level, then!\pJust kidding!
I'll obey your teaching, master!\pThanks, master!
I hope you'll keep teaching me!$
translation:
好嘞，那就选{STR_VAR_1}吧！
那我这就去挑战另一个级别！\p开玩笑的啦！
师父，我绝对听从您的教诲！\p多谢师父！
以后也请您多多指教啦！$

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach11
source:
A-H-O-Y!
And that spells ahoy, and it means hi!\pI'm {STR_VAR_1}, the rappin' SAILOR
am I!\pYour turn now, tell me a little about
yourself, give it a try!\pUh-huh, uh-huh!
{PLAYER}{KUN}'s your name,\land POKéMON's your game!\pAnd you're at a delicate age
when all the world's your stage!\pAnyway, I just want to say,
that you're the tenth TRAINER\lI've spoken to today.\pLet's make that a celebration!
Become my mentor for commemoration!$
translation:
喂--嗬！
"喂嗬"就是"嗨"，水手向你打招呼！\p我是{STR_VAR_1}，
唱着说唱的水手就是我本人！\p现在轮到你了，
快来做个自我介绍吧！\p嗯哼！嗯哼！
{PLAYER}{KUN}是你的大名，\l宝可梦是你的拿手好戏！\p你正处在闪闪发光的年纪，
整个世界都是你的舞台！\p总之，我只是想告诉你，
你是我今天搭话的\l第十个训练家！\p不如我们好好庆祝一番！
你就收我为徒作为纪念吧！$

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach12
source:
Say, hey, aren't you {PLAYER}?
What should I do? Talk to you?\lWhy not? I'm already talking to you!\p{PLAYER}, are you surprised at me?
I'd better tell you who I happen to be!\p{STR_VAR_1} is what you can call me.
The brightest star in guitardom,\lthat's me!\pAre you receiving me?
You are receiving me!\pMy luck's at its best,
I'll hit you with a request!\p{PLAYER}, let me be your underling!
I want you to teach me everything!$
translation:
喂喂喂，你不就是{PLAYER}吗？
我该怎么做？跟你搭话？\l有什么不行，反正我已经在跟你说了！\p{PLAYER}，你觉得很惊讶吗？
还是先让你知道我何许人也吧！\p你可以叫我{STR_VAR_1}。
吉他界最耀眼的一颗新星，\l那就是我！\p你能听懂我的电波吗？
你一定接收到了对吧！\p我今天手气正顺，
不如就向你提个请求！\p{PLAYER}，收我做你的小弟吧！
把你的本事全都传授给我吧！$

label: gText_ApprenticeRejectTeaching12
source: You're turning me down, then?\nI'll just have to ask you again!\p{PLAYER}, I beg to be your underling!\nI need you to teach me everything!$
translation: 这么说，你是要拒绝我吗？\n那我只好再求你一次了！\p{PLAYER}，求你收我做小弟吧！\n我想要你把一切都教给我！$

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach13
source:
Oh, hi! You there!
Can I get you to massage my shoulder?\p…Yes, there! That's it!
Ouch, ouch! Oooh, that feels great!\pMy name's {STR_VAR_1}.
I take karate training, but my body's\lnot built to take the abuse…\pI decided I'll battle POKéMON and
toughen myself up.\pYou're {PLAYER}{KUN}, aren't you?
The POKéMON LEAGUE CHAMP?\pListen, can I get you to give me
advice?$
translation:
啊，你好！那边那位！
能帮我捏捏肩膀吗？\p......对，就是那里！就是那样！
哎哟，痛痛痛！呼......真舒服啊！\p我叫{STR_VAR_1}。
我本来在练空手道，但我的身体底子\l实在经不起那种折腾......\p所以我想通过宝可梦对战
来锻炼自己的体魄。\p你是{PLAYER}{KUN}对吧？
是宝可梦联盟的冠军吧？\p那个，你能给我
一些指点吗？$

label: gText_ApprenticeRejectTeaching13
source: Oh, why?\pI won't be a big bother, I promise!\nPlease?$
translation: 哎，为什么啊？\p我保证绝不会给你添麻烦的！\n求求你了，好不好嘛？$

label: gText_ApprenticeLevelModeThanks13
source: Hm, all right. That's {STR_VAR_1}.\nI'll go there right away.\pI hope I can keep hitting you up for\nhelp--after all, you're my mentor!$
translation: 嗯，好的。那就是{STR_VAR_1}了。\n我这就去那里。\p希望以后还能向你请教--\n毕竟你可是我的师父啊！$

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach14
source:
Er… Um…
{PLAYER}{KUN}…?\pPlease, don't look at me that way.
You're making me all self-conscious.\pI… I'm {STR_VAR_1}.\pI'm really embarrassed to say this,
but I explore ancient ruins and such.\pI'm even more embarrassed to admit
I'm interested in the BATTLE FRONTIER.\p{PLAYER}{KUN}, you have a reputation as
a tough TRAINER…\pIt's hard for me to say this,
but I want to ask something.\pCould you become my teacher and
give me advice?$
translation:
那个......请问......
是{PLAYER}{KUN}......吗？\p请、请不要那样看着我。
搞得我特别不自在......\p我......我是{STR_VAR_1}。\p说出来挺不好意思的，
我平时在到处调查古代遗迹......\p更不好意思的是，
其实我对对战开拓区也很感兴趣。\p{PLAYER}{KUN}，大家都说你
是一位非常厉害的训练家......\p虽然有些难以启齿，
但我有个不情之请。\p你能成为我的师父，
给我一些指导吗？$

label: gText_ApprenticeRejectTeaching14
source: Please don't brush me off like this!\nI can't live with the humiliation.\pPlease become my teacher!\nI need your advice!$
translation: 求求你别这么不理我！\n被拒绝的羞耻感会让我活不下去的......\p请务必成为我的师父！\n我需要你的指点！$

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode14
source:
Th-thank you…\pBut please don't look at me like that.
It makes me all flustered.\pPlease, answer me without looking
at my eyes.\pAt the BATTLE TOWER…
Which level should I attempt?$
translation: 太、太感谢你了......\p但请不要那样直勾勾地看着我。\n我会慌乱得手足无措的。\p请不要看着我的眼睛回答我。\p在对战巨塔里......\n我应该挑战哪种级别呢？$

label: gText_ApprenticeLevelModeThanks14
source:
Oh… Okay!
I'll try my hand at that.\pI hope I can make a valiant challenge
without getting all flustered…\pThank you, {PLAYER}{KUN}.
If we meet again, I hope you will be\las helpful.$
translation:
啊......好的！
那我就去挑战看看。\p希望我能鼓起勇气英勇应战，
不会慌乱成一团......\p谢谢你，{PLAYER}{KUN}。
如果我们再见面的话，\l希望还能得到你的指点。$

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach15
source:
Hm? You appear to be {PLAYER}{KUN}…
But are you really real?\pYou may call me {STR_VAR_1}.\pI have been toying with the idea of
apprenticing under a strong TRAINER.\pSo, I must say I'm lucky you came along!
…You really are {PLAYER}{KUN}, yes?\pNo, no, if you are real, it's fine.
I merely want you to recognize me\las your apprentice.$
translation:
嗯？你看上去像是{PLAYER}{KUN}......
但你真的是本人吗？\p你可以称呼我为{STR_VAR_1}。\p我最近一直在考虑，
拜一位强大的训练家为师。\p所以能遇上你，可真算得上是幸运！
......你确实是{PLAYER}{KUN}没错吧？\p不，不，如果你是本人的话就好办了。
我只是希望你能收我做徒弟。$

label: gText_ApprenticeRejectTeaching15
source:
Oh?
But what would compel you to refuse?\pI apologize for being skeptical about
your identity.\pPlease accept my apology and
accept me as your apprentice.$
translation: 哦？\n究竟是什么理由促使你拒绝我？\p怀疑你的身份，确实是我的失礼。\p请接受我的歉意，\n并正式收我为徒吧。$

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode15
source:
You really are accepting me?
I don't wish to celebrate prematurely.\pIf it is true, I apologize.
But now, I need your advice.\pIf I were to enter the BATTLE TOWER,
what would be worthy of me?\lLevel 50 or Open Level?$
translation:
你真的愿意收我为徒吗？
我可不想高兴得太早。\p如果是真的，那我向刚才的失礼道歉。
不过现在，我需要你的建议。\p如果我要挑战对战巨塔，
哪种级别才配得上我的水准？\l是50级，还是公开级？$

label: gText_ApprenticeLevelModeThanks15
source:
{STR_VAR_1}?
Are you certain?\pI see. If that's the case, that's fine.
I thank you for your time.\pI realize I can annoy, but it delights
me that you have accepted me.\pLet us meet again!$
translation:
{STR_VAR_1}吗？
你确定吗？\p原来如此。既然如此，那就这样吧。
感谢你抽出时间指导我。\p我知道自己有时有些烦人，
但你能接纳我，实在令我欣喜。\p那么，我们后会有期！$

label: gText_ApprenticeWhatHeldItem0
source:
Sigh… Sob…
Oh, {PLAYER}!\pI'm all tangled up in a dilemma
that I can't decide.\pI can't decide what I should make
my {STR_VAR_1} hold.\pPlease tell me, {PLAYER}.
What item should I make it hold?$
translation:
唉......呜呜......
啊，{PLAYER}！\p我陷入了一个两难的困境，
实在拿不定主意。\p我决定不好到底该给
我的{STR_VAR_1}携带什么道具。\p请告诉我吧，{PLAYER}。
我该让它携带什么道具才好？$

label: gText_ApprenticeItemAlreadyRecommended1
source: Oh, uh, no, that's not what I meant.\nI want to know about a different item\lthan the ones I already know.\pOr do you mean that my POKéMON doesn't\nhave to hold anything this time?$
translation: 啊，呃，不，我不是那个意思。\n我想知道一些我还没见过的\l新道具的情报。\p还是说，你的意思是这次\n我的宝可梦什么道具都不用带？$

label: gText_ApprenticeWhatHeldItem5
source:
Yo, {PLAYER}{KUN}!\pWe're both busy, but we seem to run
into each other often anyway!\pToday I have to do some walking,
cleaning, and brushing.\pI haven't even had the time to buy
my precious {STR_VAR_1} anything.\pI don't have any time, so how about
giving me advice on what I should make\lmy {STR_VAR_1} hold?$
translation:
哟，{PLAYER}{KUN}！\p虽然咱俩都挺忙的，
但似乎总能碰上面呢！\p我今天得去散散步，
打扫打扫，再给宝可梦刷刷毛。\p我都还没腾出时间给我心爱的
{STR_VAR_1}买点什么东西呢。\p我实在没时间想了，不如你给我点建议，
我该让我可爱的{STR_VAR_1}\l携带什么道具好呢？$

label: gText_ApprenticeWhatHeldItem6
source:
Hiya, {PLAYER}! It's me!
I need to tap your mind again today.\lPlease, I need your advice!\pDrum roll, please!
The question I have is…\pIf I want to make my {STR_VAR_1} hold
an item, what should it be?$
translation:
嗨，{PLAYER}！是我啦！
今天又得借用一下你的聪明才智了。\l拜托，给我点建议吧！\p请奏擂鼓，当当当！
我的问题就是......\p如果我想让我的{STR_VAR_1}
携带道具的话，带什么最好？$

label: gText_ApprenticeThanksNoHeldItem7
source: I understand clearly now!\nI will keep trying like this.\pThank you, {PLAYER}.\nI hope I can count on you again.\lPlease take care!$
translation: 这下我彻底明白了！\n我会按照这个方向继续努力的。\p谢谢你，{PLAYER}。\n希望下次还能向你请教。\l请多保重！$

label: gText_ApprenticeThanksHeldItem7
source: One {STR_VAR_1} it is!\nI will order it right away.\pThank you, {PLAYER}.\nI hope I can count on you again.\lPlease take care!$
translation: 那就选{STR_VAR_1}了！\n我这就去订购一个。\p谢谢你，{PLAYER}。\n希望下次还能向你请教。\l请多保重！$

label: gText_ApprenticeThanksHeldItem8
source: {STR_VAR_1}! I'll use that!\pUm… Could it be, {PLAYER}, you also\nmake your POKéMON hold that item?\pI'll be sure to get it!\nI hope you'll be willing to teach me\lsome more another time.$
translation: {STR_VAR_1}！就用这个了！\p那个......难道说，{PLAYER}你\n也给自己的宝可梦带这个道具吗？\p我一定会把它弄到手的！\n希望下次你还能多指教指教我。$

label: gText_ApprenticeWhatHeldItem9
source:
Hola!
My maestro, {PLAYER}{KUN}!\pI want to hit you up for advice on
POKéMON tools.\pWhat do you think would be good for
my {STR_VAR_1} to hold?\pDon't be shy now.
Let's blurt it out!$
translation:
你好呀！
我的大师，{PLAYER}{KUN}！\p我想向你请教一下
关于宝可梦携带道具的问题。\p你觉得让我的{STR_VAR_1}
带什么道具好呢？\p别害羞嘛。
尽管脱口而出吧！$

label: gText_ApprenticeWhatHeldItem10
source:
{PLAYER}{KUN}, something unbelievable
has happened!\pI woke up this morning, and my POKéMON
had 10 NUGGETS!\pOf course I'm lying!
Wahahaha!\pThis is no lie, though.
I'm not very good at thinking about\lwhat items POKéMON should hold.\pSo, how about deciding for me what
my {STR_VAR_1} should hold, master?$
translation:
{PLAYER}{KUN}，发生了件不可思议的事！\p我今天早上醒来，发现我的宝可梦
居然抱着10个金珠！\p骗你的啦！
哇哈哈哈哈！\p不过接下来这句可不是骗你的。
我实在不擅长琢磨
宝可梦该携带什么道具。\p所以师父，就由您来替我决定
让{STR_VAR_1}携带什么道具好吗？$

label: gText_ApprenticeThanksNoHeldItem10
source:
Okay, so it shouldn't hold anything.
Then, I'd better get something for it!\pJust kidding!
I'll obey your teaching, master!\pThanks, master!
I hope you'll keep teaching me!$
translation:
好的，所以是什么都不用带对吧。
那我可得赶紧给它带点什么！\p开玩笑的啦！
师父，我绝对听您的教导！\p多谢师父！
以后也要继续指导我哦！$

label: gText_ApprenticeThanksHeldItem10
source:
Okay, so it's one {STR_VAR_1}!
I'll make it hold anything but that!\pJust kidding!
I'll obey your teaching, master!\pThanks, master!
I hope you'll keep teaching me!$
translation:
好的，带一个{STR_VAR_1}对吧！
除了这个我什么都给它带！\p开玩笑的啦！
师父，我绝对听您的教导！\p多谢师父！
以后也要继续指导我哦！$

label: gText_ApprenticeWhatHeldItem12
source:
Say, hey, {PLAYER}!
I found you again today!\pWhat should I do? Get your advice?
Why not? I'm already talking to you!\p{PLAYER}, are you getting sick of me?
Nah, no way, that can't be.\pWill you hear me out?
I'm looking for advice--that's what\lI'm talking about.\pIt's about a hold item for
my {STR_VAR_1} that'd be good.\lMy indecision is making me brood.$
translation:
哟，喂，{PLAYER}！
今天又让我遇上你了！\p该怎么办呢？向你讨教一下？
有何不可！反正话都说上了！\p{PLAYER}，你不会嫌我烦了吧？
哎呀，不可能，绝不可能。\p能听我把话说完吗？
我就是想请教点建议--正经事。\p关于我的{STR_VAR_1}
带什么携带物品比较合适，\l我都纠结得愁眉苦脸了。$

label: gText_ApprenticeThanksHeldItem13
source: Hm, all right. That's one {STR_VAR_1}.\nMy POKéMON's arm is fine, so I'll make\lit hold that item right away.\pI hope I can keep hitting you up\nfor help like this.$
translation: 嗯，好嘞。那就带一个{STR_VAR_1}。\n我的宝可梦手脚利索着呢，这就让它拿上。\p希望以后还能像这样向你求助啊。$

label: gText_ApprenticeItemAlreadyRecommended13
source:
No, no, you told me about that
{STR_VAR_1} before, remember?\pHow about telling me something
even better?\pOh, wait a second.
So your suggestion is my {STR_VAR_2}\ldoesn't have to hold anything?$
translation: 不对不对，你上次就提过\n{STR_VAR_1}了，忘了吗？\p能不能告诉我点更厉害的招数？\p呃，等等。\n你的意思是，我的{STR_VAR_2}\l什么都不用带吗？$

label: gText_ApprenticeWhatHeldItem14
source:
Er… Um…
{PLAYER}{KUN}…\pPlease, don't look at me that way.
My POKéMON don't have anything.\pI… I'm really embarrassed about this,
but I really need your advice.\pI can't decide what hold item would
make my {STR_VAR_1} strong.\p{PLAYER}{KUN}, what do you think would
be good?$
translation:
那个......呜......
{PLAYER}{KUN}......\p求求你，别用那种眼神看我。
我的宝可梦身上什么都没带。\p我......虽然觉得很不好意思，
但我真的很需要你的建议。\p我决定不了带什么物品
才能让我的{STR_VAR_1}变得更强。\p{PLAYER}{KUN}，你觉得
带什么好呢？$

label: gText_ApprenticeThanksNoHeldItem14
source:
Oh… Okay!
I'll go without an item.\pThis is nerve-racking, though.
Wouldn't it be too cool?\pThank you, {PLAYER}{KUN}.
If we meet again, I hope you will be\las helpful.$
translation:
啊......好的！
那就什么物品都不带。\p虽然很让人紧张......
但这样会不会太酷了呢？\p谢谢你，{PLAYER}{KUN}。
如果我们再见面的话，\l希望你还能像这样帮帮我。$

label: gText_ApprenticeThanksHeldItem14
source:
Oh… Okay!
I'll go with that {STR_VAR_1}.\pThis is nerve-racking, though.
Wouldn't it be too cool?\pThank you, {PLAYER}{KUN}.
If we meet again, I hope you will be\las helpful.$
translation:
啊......好的！
那就带上那个{STR_VAR_1}。\p虽然很让人紧张......
但这样会不会太酷了呢？\p谢谢你，{PLAYER}{KUN}。
如果我们再见面的话，\l希望你还能像这样帮帮我。$

label: gText_ApprenticeItemAlreadyRecommended14
source: B-but I already heard about that.\pPlease don't brush me off like this!\nI can't live with the humiliation.\pOh… Am I jumping to conclusions?\nDo you think it would be better if\lmy {STR_VAR_2} didn't have an item?$
translation: 可、可是那个你已经说过了......\p请别这么敷衍我嘛！\n这也太让人难堪了......\p啊......是我自作聪明了吗？\n你是觉得我的{STR_VAR_2}\l什么物品都不带比较好吗？$

label: gText_ApprenticeWhatHeldItem15
source:
Hm? You appear to be {PLAYER}{KUN}…
But are you really?\lPerhaps you're a twin?\pOh, no, no, no, don't worry!
If you really are {PLAYER}, please\lforget about my rudeness.\pWhat I would like is some more of
your fine advice.\pI have here my {STR_VAR_1} that I wish
to make hold a convenient item.\pWhat would be worthy of it?$
translation:
嗯？您看起来像是{PLAYER}{KUN}......
但真的是本人吗？\l莫非是双胞胎？\p噢，不不不，请别介意！
如果您确实是{PLAYER}，请原谅我的失礼。\p在下还想向您请教一些高见。\p在下手头有一只{STR_VAR_1}，
想让它携带一件实用的物品。\p您看配得上它的是什么呢？$

label: gText_ApprenticeHoldNothing15
source: It's better if it held nothing?\nAre you certain?$
translation: 不携带任何物品更好？\n您确定吗？$

label: gText_ApprenticeThanksNoHeldItem15
source: I see. If that's the case, that's fine.\nI thank you for your time.\pLet us meet again!$
translation: 原来如此。既然如此，那就这样吧。\n非常感谢您抽空指点。\p我们后会有期！$

label: gText_ApprenticeThanksHeldItem15
source:
One {STR_VAR_1}?
Are you certain?\pI see. If that's the case, that's fine.
I thank you for your time.\pI do hope my POKéMON will be able to
put it to good use.\pLet us meet again!$
translation: 一个{STR_VAR_1}？\n您确定吗？\p原来如此。既然如此，那就这样吧。\n非常感谢您抽空指点。\p真希望我的宝可梦能物尽其用。\p我们后会有期！$

label: gText_ApprenticeItemAlreadyRecommended15
source:
No, no, wait a minute.
I believe you taught me that before.\pI would like you to recommend
something different this time.\pPerhaps you're suggesting that
my {STR_VAR_2} should hold nothing?\lAre you certain?$
translation: 不不，请稍等片刻。\n在下记得您之前就指导过这点了。\p这次在下希望能得到不同的建议。\p难道您是认为\n我的{STR_VAR_2}什么都不带才好？\l您确定吗？$

label: gText_ApprenticeMonFirstThanks5
source: Okay, gotcha.\nI have enough time at least to put\lmy {STR_VAR_1} at the head of the line!\pWhoops, my girlfriend's waiting!\nThanks! See you around!$
translation: 好嘞，明白啦。\n这点时间我还是有的，\l这就把{STR_VAR_1}排在第一位！\p哎呀，我女朋友还在等我呢！\n谢啦！回头见！$

label: gText_ApprenticeMonFirstThanks7
source: My {STR_VAR_1} it is!\nI will put it first right away!\pThank you, {PLAYER}.\nI hope I can count on you again.\lPlease take care!$
translation: 那就是{STR_VAR_1}了！\n我马上就把它排在第一位！\p谢谢你，{PLAYER}。\n下次也拜托你啦。\l请多保重！$

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichMonFirst9
source:
Hello, hello!
My mentor, {PLAYER}{KUN}!\lHit me with your sage advice today!\pYou see, I pulled together a team of
three POKéMON. So far so good.\pBut the team's battling order's not
settled yet.\pThis is where you come in, {PLAYER}{KUN}!
You decide which POKéMON leads off!\pDon't be shy now.
Let's blurt it out!$
translation:
嗨嗨！
我的导师，{PLAYER}{KUN}！\l今天也用您的金玉良言指点指点我吧！\p你看，我凑齐了一支三只宝可梦的队伍。
到目前为止还挺顺利的。\p可是对战的出场顺序还没定下来。\p这就轮到你出马啦，{PLAYER}{KUN}！
由你来决定哪只宝可梦打头阵！\p别害羞嘛。
痛快地说出来吧！$

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichMonFirst10
source:
{PLAYER}{KUN}, listen!
It's a crisis!\pMy POKéMON, all three of them, go into
battle at once!\pOf course that's impossible!
Wahahaha!\pThis is no lie, though.
I'm not very good at thinking about\lhow I should line up my POKéMON.\pSo, how about deciding for me which
POKéMON should go first, master?$
translation:
{PLAYER}{KUN}，快听我说！
大事不妙啦！\p我的宝可梦，三只全都要一起冲进对战场！\p当然啦，那怎么可能嘛！
哇哈哈哈哈！\p不过说真的，
我实在不擅长琢磨\l该怎么安排宝可梦的出场顺序。\p所以，师父，帮我决定一下
哪只宝可梦打头阵怎么样？$

label: gText_ApprenticeMonFirstThanks10
source:
Okay, so it's my {STR_VAR_1} you chose?
I'll let any but that one go first!\pJust kidding!
I'll obey your teaching, master!\pThanks, master!
I hope you'll keep teaching me!$
translation:
好的，所以您挑了我的{STR_VAR_1}？
除了它我让谁先发都行！\p开玩笑的啦！
师父，我绝对听您的教导！\p多谢师父！
以后也要继续指导我哦！$

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichMonFirst14
source:
Er… Um…
{PLAYER}{KUN}?\pPlease, don't look at me that way.
You're making me feel all flustered.\pUm…
I really need your advice.\pIt makes me bashful to say this,
but I chose my 3-POKéMON team.\lI can't decide on the order, though.\pWhich POKéMON should I send out first
so I at least look capable?$
translation:
那个......呜......
{PLAYER}{KUN}？\p求求你，别用那种眼神看我。
你这样让我好慌乱呀。\p那个......
我真的很需要你的建议。\p虽然说出来有点害羞，
但我已经挑好了三只宝可梦的队伍。\l只是决定不了出场顺序。\p先派哪只宝可梦上场，
才能让我看起来厉害一点呢？$

label: gText_ApprenticeMonFirstThanks14
source:
Oh… Okay!
I'll lead with my {STR_VAR_1}.\pI hope I can do my best without
getting all flustered.\pThank you, {PLAYER}{KUN}.
If we meet again, I hope you will be\las helpful.$
translation: 啊......好的！\n那就让我的{STR_VAR_1}首发。\p希望能顺顺利利，不要手忙脚乱才好。\p谢谢你，{PLAYER}{KUN}。\n如果我们再见面的话，\l希望你还能像这样帮帮我。$

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichMonFirst15
source:
Hm? You appear to be {PLAYER}{KUN}…
But are you really?\lPerhaps you're a clever look-alike?\pOh, no, no, no, don't worry!
If you really are {PLAYER}, please\lforget about my rudeness.\pWhat I would like is your fine advice.\pI have here my POKéMON team.
I would like you to tell me which one\lshould go first in a battle.$
translation:
嗯？您看起来像是{PLAYER}{KUN}......
但真的是本人吗？\l莫非是惟妙惟肖的替身？\p噢，不不不，请别介意！
如果您确实是{PLAYER}，请原谅我的失礼。\p在下希望能听取您的高见。\p在下这里组好了一支宝可梦队伍。
想请教您在对战中\l应该由哪一只率先出战。$

label: gText_ApprenticeMonFirstThanks15
source:
My {STR_VAR_1}…
You aren't pulling my leg?\pI see. If that's the case, that's fine.
I thank you for your time.\pI am as you see, but I shall do
my best.\pLet us meet again!$
translation: 我的{STR_VAR_1}......\n您不是在拿在下寻开心吧？\p原来如此。既然如此，那就这样吧。\n非常感谢您抽空指点。\p在下虽不成器，但也必当竭尽全力。\p我们后会有期！$

label: gText_ApprenticeMonThanks7
source: One {STR_VAR_1} it is!\nI will find one right away!\pThank you, {PLAYER}.\nI hope I can count on you again.\lPlease take care!$
translation: 那就是一个{STR_VAR_1}了！\n我马上就去找一个来！\p谢谢你，{PLAYER}。\n下次也拜托你啦。\l请多保重！$

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichMon8
source:
Eek! {PLAYER}! I met you again!
I… I'm overjoyed!\pOh-oh-oh, I know!
I shouldn't pass up this opportunity!\pMay I ask a huge favor, {PLAYER}?
Please choose a POKéMON for me!\pPlease decide which would be better,
{STR_VAR_1} or {STR_VAR_2}!$
translation:
呀！{PLAYER}！又见到你了！
我......我太高兴了！\p啊、啊、啊，我知道了！
我绝不能放过这个好机会！\p{PLAYER}，能拜托你一件大事吗？
请帮我挑选一只宝可梦吧！\p请帮我决定一下，到底是
{STR_VAR_1}好，还是{STR_VAR_2}好！$

label: gText_ApprenticeMonThanks10
source:
Okay, so it's {STR_VAR_1} you chose?
I'll grab the other kind, then!\pJust kidding!
I'll obey your teaching, master!\pThanks, master!
I hope you'll keep teaching me!$
translation:
好，你选的是{STR_VAR_1}对吧？
那我就选另一只！\p开玩笑的啦！
师父，徒儿谨遵教诲！\p谢谢师父！
以后也请多多指教啦！$

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichMon12
source:
Oh, wow, if it isn't {PLAYER}!\pWhat should I do? Get your advice?
Why not? I'm already talking to you!\pIt's been a long time. Let me break
the ice. I'm also looking for advice!\lAre you receiving me?\lYou are receiving me!\pMy POKéMON--which should I use?
It's either {STR_VAR_1} or {STR_VAR_2}.\lWhich do you choose?$
translation:
哇哦，这不是{PLAYER}吗！\p我该怎么做？听听你的建议？
既然都在聊了，有何不可！\p好久不见啦。先来暖个场，
我也想听听你的意见！\l收到我的信号了吗？\l你肯定收到了！\p我的宝可梦--该用哪只？
{STR_VAR_1}还是{STR_VAR_2}。\l你选哪一只？$

label: gText_ApprenticeMonThanks14
source:
Oh… Okay!
I'll do my best with one {STR_VAR_1}.\pI hope I can do my best without
getting all flustered.\pThank you, {PLAYER}{KUN}.
If we meet again, I hope you will be\las helpful.$
translation:
啊......好的！
我会和{STR_VAR_1}一起加油的。\p希望自己能沉着应对，
不会手忙脚乱。\p谢谢你，{PLAYER}{KUN}。
如果下次还能相遇，\l还请多多指教哦。$

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichMon15
source:
Hm? You appear to be {PLAYER}{KUN}…
But are you really real?\pNo, no, if you are real, it's fine.
Incidentally, I would like to obtain\lyour advice.\pIt's about the POKéMON I am to use.\pIf the choices are the POKéMON
{STR_VAR_1} and {STR_VAR_2}, which is\lmore worthy of me?$
translation:
嗯？你看上去像是{PLAYER}{KUN}......
但你真的是本人吗？\p不不，是本人的话那就太好了。
顺带一提，我有件事\l想征求一下你的意见。\p是关于我要使用的宝可梦。\p如果要在宝可梦{STR_VAR_1}
与{STR_VAR_2}之间做选择，\l哪一只更配得上我呢？$

label: gText_ApprenticeMonThanks15
source:
{STR_VAR_1}?
Are you certain?\pI see. If that's the case, that's fine.
I thank you for your time.\pI do hope it is something even I can
handle with aplomb.\pLet us meet again!$
translation:
{STR_VAR_1}？
你确定吗？\p我明白了。既然如此，那就它吧。
感谢你抽空指点。\p希望这是一只连我也能
从容驾驭的宝可梦。\p期待与你再次相会！$

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichMove0
source:
Waaah! Oh, {PLAYER}!
Snivel… Hiccup…\pI have a dilemma!
I can't decide on a move for\lmy {STR_VAR_1}…\pPlease, please, {PLAYER}.
Can you decide for me?\pFor my {STR_VAR_1}, which move would
be the better choice: {STR_VAR_2}\lor {STR_VAR_3}?$
translation:
哇啊啊！呜，{PLAYER}！
抽泣......嗝......\p我好纠结啊！
我决定不了该让我的{STR_VAR_1}\l学什么招式了......\p求求你，求求你，{PLAYER}。
能帮我决定一下吗？\p对我的{STR_VAR_1}来说，
{STR_VAR_2}和{STR_VAR_3}，\l哪个招式更好呢？$

label: gText_ApprenticeMoveThanks0
source:
{STR_VAR_1}?
Waaaaah!\pOh! I'm so sorry, {PLAYER}!
You've made me so happy by deciding\lthe move, I'm crying…\pSnivel…
Thank you so much!$
translation:
{STR_VAR_1}？
哇啊啊啊！\p啊！对不起，{PLAYER}！
你帮我选好了招式，我太高兴了，\l眼泪停不下来......\p抽泣......
太谢谢你了！$

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichMove1
source:
Yay! Hi, {PLAYER}!
I need your advice again!\pI want to teach my {STR_VAR_1}
a cool move.\pI like either of the moves
{STR_VAR_2} or {STR_VAR_3}.\lWhat's your recommendation?$
translation:
太棒了！嗨，{PLAYER}！
我又想来请教你了！\p我想让我的{STR_VAR_1}
学会一个帅气的招式。\p招式{STR_VAR_2}和{STR_VAR_3}，
我都很喜欢。\l你推荐哪一个呢？$

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichMove2
source:
{PLAYER}, hello!
It's about my {STR_VAR_1}, but I'm\lworried about its moves.\pYou see, it's the moves {STR_VAR_2}
and {STR_VAR_3}.\pWhich is stronger and better for
my {STR_VAR_1}?$
translation:
{PLAYER}，你好！
是关于我的{STR_VAR_1}，\l我正在为它的招式发愁呢。\p就是招式{STR_VAR_2}
和{STR_VAR_3}。\p哪一个更强，更适合
我的{STR_VAR_1}呢？$

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichMove3
source:
Ohhh, {PLAYER}…
I'm hopeless, no, really!\pI've decided to raise a POKéMON,
but now I can't even decide what\lmove I should let it learn…\pI know that it doesn't mean anything
to you, {PLAYER}.\pBut it means a lot to me…\pPlease, {PLAYER}, could you choose
a move for my {STR_VAR_1}?\pIf you could even choose between
{STR_VAR_2} and {STR_VAR_3}…$
translation:
呜呜，{PLAYER}......
我真是太没用了，真的！\p我下定决心要培育宝可梦，
可现在连该让它学什么招式\l都决定不了......\p我知道这对你来说
根本不算什么，{PLAYER}。\p但这对我来说真的很重要......\p拜托了，{PLAYER}，能帮我的{STR_VAR_1}
选一个招式吗？\p在{STR_VAR_2}和{STR_VAR_3}之间
帮我选一个就好......$

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichMove4
source:
Oh, {PLAYER}{KUN}!
I was just hoping to see you, too!\pI was wondering what move would
be suitable for my {STR_VAR_1}.\pI can't decide, so can you decide
for me instead?\pFor instance… How about the moves
{STR_VAR_2} and {STR_VAR_3}?\lWhich one would be better?$
translation:
啊，{PLAYER}{KUN}！
我也正想着能遇到你就好了！\p我正在想什么招式
适合我的{STR_VAR_1}。\p我实在拿不定主意，你能帮我做决定吗？\p比如......招式{STR_VAR_2}
和{STR_VAR_3}怎么样？\l哪一个会更好呢？$

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichMove5
source:
How could things be this busy?
Hey, if it isn't {PLAYER}{KUN}!\lHow's it going?\pSince I got up this morning, I've done
my jogging, swimming, and cooking!\pYou wouldn't believe how busy I am!\pI can't even decide what move
my {STR_VAR_1} should learn!\p{STR_VAR_2} looks good, huh?
But {STR_VAR_3}'s also decent.\p{PLAYER}{KUN}, give me some of your good
advice! Which move'd be good for me?$
translation:
怎么会这么忙啊？
嘿，这不是{PLAYER}{KUN}吗！\l最近怎么样？\p我今天一早起床，又是慢跑，
又是游泳，还做了饭！\p你都不知道我有多忙！\p连我的{STR_VAR_1}该学什么招式
都没时间决定！\p{STR_VAR_2}看起来不错对吧？
但{STR_VAR_3}也很可取。\p{PLAYER}{KUN}，快给我点好建议！
哪个招式更适合我？$

label: gText_ApprenticeMoveThanks5
source: Okay, gotcha.\nI'll make room in my schedule and\lteach that move.\pI'm glad I met a good mentor in you.\nThanks! See you around!$
translation: 好，明白了！\n我会挤出时间把那个招式教会的。\p能遇到你这么好的导师真是太棒了。\n多谢啦！回头见！$

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichMove6
source:
Oh! Lucky!
I met you again, {PLAYER}!\lI need to tap your mind again today.\pDrum roll, please!
The question I have is…\pFor my {STR_VAR_1}, which is the move
best suited, {STR_VAR_2} or\l{STR_VAR_3}?$
translation:
哇！太幸运了！
又遇到你了，{PLAYER}！\l今天也要借你的智慧用用啦。\p请奏擂鼓！
我今天要问的是......\p对于我的{STR_VAR_1}，
最适合它的招式是{STR_VAR_2}\l还是{STR_VAR_3}呢？$

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichMove7
source:
Oh, hello, {PLAYER}.
I trust you've been well?\pI have to seek your advice again.
It's about my dearest {STR_VAR_1}.\pWhat would be the ideal move for
my lovable {STR_VAR_1}?\l{STR_VAR_2} or {STR_VAR_3}?$
translation:
哎呀，你好，{PLAYER}。
近来可好？\p我又得向你请教了。
是关于我最宝贝的{STR_VAR_1}。\p对我可爱的{STR_VAR_1}来说，
最理想的招式是什么呢？\l是{STR_VAR_2}还是{STR_VAR_3}？$

label: gText_ApprenticeMoveThanks7
source: {STR_VAR_1} it is!\nI will teach that right away!\pThank you, {PLAYER}.\nI hope I can count on you again.\lPlease take care!$
translation: 就选{STR_VAR_1}了！\n我这就去教它！\p谢谢你，{PLAYER}。\n下次也请多多关照。\l请多保重！$

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichMove8
source:
Eek! {PLAYER}! I met you again!
I… I'm overjoyed!\pWhenever I'm in need, you're always
there for me, {PLAYER}!\pToday, I want you to recommend
a move for me!\pPlease choose a move for
my {STR_VAR_1}!\pWhich move would be better,
{STR_VAR_2} or {STR_VAR_3}?$
translation:
呀！{PLAYER}！又见到你了！
我......我太高兴了！\p每当我遇到困难时，
你总是陪在我身边，{PLAYER}！\p今天我想请你给我推荐一个招式！\p请帮我的{STR_VAR_1}
选一个招式吧！\p招式{STR_VAR_2}和{STR_VAR_3}，
哪一个会更好呢？$

label: gText_ApprenticeMoveThanks8
source: Oh-oh-oh! Thank you!\n{STR_VAR_1} is it!\lPerfectly understood!\pI hope you'll be willing to teach me\nsome more another time.$
translation: 哦哦哦！谢谢你！\n就是{STR_VAR_1}了！\l完全明白了！\p下次也希望你能继续指教我哦。$

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichMove9
source:
Hola, {PLAYER}{KUN}, bueno!
I'm hoping for some more of\lyour sage advice today!\pWhat would be the best move for
my {STR_VAR_1}?\pIt should be something that'll
let me win just like that!\pWould it be {STR_VAR_2}?
Or {STR_VAR_3}?$
translation:
Hola，{PLAYER}{KUN}，bueno！
今天也想听听你的高见呢！\p什么招式最适合我的{STR_VAR_1}？\p最好是能让我
一下子就能赢下来的招式！\p是{STR_VAR_2}呢？
还是{STR_VAR_3}呢？$

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichMove10
source:
{PLAYER}{KUN}, it's completely wild!\pMy POKéMON!
It learned six moves!\pOf course I'm lying!
Wahahaha!\pThis is no lie, though.
I'm not very good at choosing moves\lfor my POKéMON.\pSo, how about deciding for me which
kind of move I should teach?\p{STR_VAR_2} or {STR_VAR_3}--which
would go with my {STR_VAR_1} best?$
translation:
{PLAYER}{KUN}，太惊人了！\p我的宝可梦！
它学会了六个招式！\p当然是骗你的啦！
哇哈哈哈哈！\p不过下面这句可不是假话。
我真的很不擅长给宝可梦挑选招式。\p所以，帮我决定一下
该教哪种招式怎么样？\p{STR_VAR_2}还是{STR_VAR_3}--
哪一个和我的{STR_VAR_1}最搭？$

label: gText_ApprenticeMoveThanks10
source:
Okay, so it's {STR_VAR_1} you chose?
I'll choose another move, then!\pJust kidding!
I'll obey your teaching, master!\pThanks, master!
I hope you'll keep teaching me!$
translation:
好，你选的是{STR_VAR_1}对吧？
那我就选另一个招式！\p开玩笑的啦！
师父，徒儿谨遵教诲！\p谢谢师父！
以后也请多多指教啦！$

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichMove11
source:
A-H-O-Y!
And that spells ahoy!\pThe rappin' SAILOR am I!
I'm always with it, don't ask me why.\pToday, I have a move question
that begs your suggestion!\p{STR_VAR_2} and {STR_VAR_3} are
the moves. What would be the best\lfor my {STR_VAR_1} so it grooves?$
translation:
A-H-O-Y！
拼出来就是喂--！\p我是个会说唱的水手！
时刻紧跟潮流，无需理由。\p今天我有个招式疑问，
急需你的指点指引！\p{STR_VAR_2}和{STR_VAR_3}，
哪个能让我的{STR_VAR_1}\l把节奏狠狠拿稳？$

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichMove12
source:
Oh, yeahah, if it isn't {PLAYER}!\pWhat should I do? Get your advice?
Why not? I'm already talking to you!\p{PLAYER}, are you surprised by me?
I want your advice, can't you see?\pAre you receiving me?
You are receiving me!\pMy {STR_VAR_1}--what should it use?
It's {STR_VAR_2} or {STR_VAR_3},\lwhat do you choose?$
translation:
哦，耶--这不是{PLAYER}吗！\p我该怎么做？听听你的建议？
既然都在聊了，有何不可！\p{PLAYER}，看到我你惊讶吗？
想听你的高见，你懂的吧？\p收到我的信号了吗？
你肯定收到了！\p我的{STR_VAR_1}--该用什么招式？
{STR_VAR_2}还是{STR_VAR_3}，\l你怎么选？$

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichMove13
source:
Gahack! Gaah! Oh, {PLAYER}{KUN}…
I have this lousy cold, I do…\pI want to pick a move for my POKéMON,
but I'm not up to it…\pSo, things being this way,
I need you to decide for me.\p{PLAYER}{KUN}, if I had to choose between
{STR_VAR_2} and {STR_VAR_3} for\lmy {STR_VAR_1}, which would it be?$
translation:
咳咳！咳！呜，{PLAYER}{KUN}......
我得了可恶的感冒，咳......\p我想给宝可梦挑选招式，
可实在没力气......\p所以，事情就是这样，
我想请你帮我做决定。\p{PLAYER}{KUN}，要为我的{STR_VAR_1}
在{STR_VAR_2}和{STR_VAR_3}之间挑选，\l应该选哪个呢？$

label: gText_ApprenticeMoveThanks13
source: Hm, {STR_VAR_1}, all right. Cough!\nI'll go teach it when I get better.\pI hope I can keep hitting you up\nfor help like this.$
translation: 嗯，{STR_VAR_1}，好的。咳！\n等我好起来就去教它。\p希望下次遇到困难\n也能继续向你求助。$

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichMove14
source:
Er… Um…
{PLAYER}{KUN}…?\pPlease, don't look at me that way.
I'm getting all flustered…\lI… I need your advice.\pI… I'm really embarrassed, but I can't
decide what move I should teach\lmy POKéMON.\pIt's for my {STR_VAR_1}.
If the choices were {STR_VAR_2} or\l{STR_VAR_3}, which would be better?$
translation:
那个......嗯......
{PLAYER}{KUN}......？\p求求你，别那样看着我啦。
我整个人都慌乱起来了......\l我......我想听听你的建议。\p我......虽然很不好意思，但我拿不定主意
到底该给我的宝可梦\l学什么招式。\p是我的{STR_VAR_1}要学的。
如果在{STR_VAR_2}和\l{STR_VAR_3}之间二选一，选哪个更好呢？$

label: gText_ApprenticeMoveThanks14
source:
Oh… Okay!
I'll try that {STR_VAR_1}.\pI hope I can teach that move…
This is so nerve-racking…\pThank you, {PLAYER}{KUN}.
If we meet again, I hope you will be\las helpful.$
translation:
啊......好的！
那我试试{STR_VAR_1}吧。\p希望能学会那个招式......
真是太让人紧张了......\p谢谢你，{PLAYER}{KUN}。
下次见面时，也希望你能\l再帮帮我。$

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichMove15
source:
Hm? You appear to be {PLAYER}{KUN}…
But are you really real?\pPerhaps you're one of those popular
mimics?\pNo, no, if you are real, it's fine.
No need to be upset, I assure you!\pIncidentally, I would like to obtain
your advice.\pIt's about my {STR_VAR_1}.\pWhich move would be better for it to
use, {STR_VAR_2} or {STR_VAR_3}?$
translation:
嗯？你看起来是{PLAYER}{KUN}......
但你真的是本人吗？\p该不会是最近很流行的
模仿艺人假扮的吧？\p哎呀别生气，要是真人的话就没事。
请放心，完全没必要介意！\p顺带一提，我也想请教一下
你的建议。\p是关于我的{STR_VAR_1}的。\p让它学哪招比较好呢，
{STR_VAR_2}还是{STR_VAR_3}？$

label: gText_ApprenticeMoveThanks15
source:
{STR_VAR_1}?
There's no question about that?\pI see. If that's the case, that's fine.
I thank you for your time.\pI do hope it is something even
my POKéMON can learn.\pLet us meet again!$
translation:
{STR_VAR_1}吗？
毫无疑问就是这个了？\p原来如此，既然你这么说就没错了。
非常感谢你抽空指点。\p真希望这招连我的宝可梦
也能顺利学会。\p期待下次再见！$

label: gText_ApprenticePickWinSpeech1
source:
Yay! It's {PLAYER}! Hello!
I wanted to ask you something!\pI want to say something cool when
I win a match.\pDo you have a cool saying that
you could recommend?$
translation:
太棒了！是{PLAYER}！你好呀！
我刚好有事想问你呢！\p在对战获胜的时候，我想说句很帅气的话。\p你有什么帅气的台词
可以推荐给我吗？$

label: gText_ApprenticePickWinSpeech5
source:
Oh, I can't get over how busy I am!
Oh, hey, I was looking for you, {PLAYER}{KUN}.\pAre you well as usual?
Things haven't changed for me at all.\pI've got running, fighting, and mapping
to do. Why am I so busy?\pBut even though I'm busy, it'd be rude
to just turn on my heels and walk away\lfrom a win without saying a word.\pSo, what would be a cool saying to
underline my coolness when I'm done\land walking away? {PLAYER}{KUN}, help me!$
translation:
哎呀，我真是忙得不可开交！
啊，喂！我正找你呢，{PLAYER}{KUN}。\p你还是老样子很有精神吧？
我这边也是一点都没变。\p又要跑步、又要对战、还要画地图。
我怎么会这么忙啊？\p可就算再忙，赢了之后什么话都不说
就直接扭头走掉，未免太失礼了。\p所以说，在获胜离场时，要说什么话
才能凸显出我的帅气呢？\l{PLAYER}{KUN}，快帮帮我吧！$

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks13
source:
{STR_VAR_1}\p… … …That's good.
No, it's awe inspiring!\lIt's bringing fresh tears to my eyes!\pBut in spite of my tears and runny
nose, I will use that saying!\pI'm plumb out of things to ask you,
{PLAYER}{KUN}.\pFrom now on, we're rivals!
Thanks for everything!$
translation:
{STR_VAR_1}\p............太棒了。
不，这简直令人肃然起敬！\l感动得我眼泪都掉下来了！\p虽然眼泪鼻涕直流，
但我一定要用这句台词！\p我已经没有什么可请教你的了，
{PLAYER}{KUN}。\p从现在起，我们就是劲敌了！
一直以来多谢你了！$

label: FallarborTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainFallarborTent
source: In the ARENA BATTLE TENT,\n
translation: 在竞技场对战帐篷，

label: FallarborTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainFallarborTent
source: In the FALLARBOR BATTLE TENT,\n
translation: 在秋叶镇对战帐篷，

label: FallarborTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainFallarborTent
source:
we undertake the Set KO Tourney.\pAll participants enter with a team of
three POKéMON.\pThe three POKéMON must be lined up
in the order that they are to appear in.\pDuring battle, the POKéMON will appear
one at a time in the preset order.\pOnce a POKéMON enters battle, it must
remain out until the match is decided.\pIf a match remains undecided in
three turns, it goes to judging.\pIf you wish to interrupt your challenge,
please save the game.\pIf you don't save, you will not be able
to continue with your challenge.\pIf you pull off the feat of beating
three TRAINERS in succession,\lwe will present you with a fine prize.$
translation:
我们举办的是裁决淘汰赛。\p所有参赛者需携带3只宝可梦
组成队伍入场。\p这3只宝可梦必须预先排好
出场的先后顺序。\p在对战中，宝可梦将按照预设的
顺序依次登场。\p宝可梦一旦出场对战，
就必须战斗到分出胜负为止。\p若3个回合内仍未分出胜负，
将由裁判进行判定裁决。\p若想中断挑战，
请保存记录。\p如果不保存记录，将无法
继续当前的挑战。\p若能达成连胜3位训练家的壮举，
我们将为您送上精美的奖品。$

label: FallarborTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLv50
source:
My dear challenger!\pYou do not have the three POKéMON
required for entry.\pThey also must not hold the same
kinds of items.\pEGGS{STR_VAR_1} ineligible.\pWhen you have made your preparations,
please do return.$
translation:
亲爱的挑战者！\p您未携带参赛所需的3只宝可梦。\p此外，它们所携带的道具
也不能是同一种类。\p宝可梦的蛋{STR_VAR_1}无法参加。\p请您做好准备之后，
再来光临吧。$

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_TakeChallenge
source: Do you wish to take the PALACE\n
translation: 您想要挑战宫殿

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_TakeChallenge
source: Do you wish to take the VERDANTURF\n
translation: 您想要挑战绿荫镇

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_TakeChallenge
source: BATTLE TENT challenge?$
translation: 对战帐篷吗？$

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainVerdanturfTent
source: In the PALACE BATTLE TENT,\n
translation: 在宫殿对战帐篷，

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainVerdanturfTent
source: In the VERDANTURF BATTLE TENT,\n
translation: 在绿荫镇对战帐篷，

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainVerdanturfTent
source:
there is one crucial rule that must\lbe obeyed.\pTRAINERS are permitted only to switch
their POKéMON in and out.\pTRAINERS are otherwise forbidden to
command their POKéMON.\pThe POKéMON are to behave according
to their nature and battle on their own.\pYou must put your trust in your
POKéMON and watch over them.\pIf you achieve the honor of beating
three TRAINERS in succession,\lwe will present you with a prize.\pIf you want to interrupt your
challenge, please save the game.\pIf you don't save before interrupting,
you will be disqualified.$
translation:
有一条必须遵守的铁律。\p训练家只能对宝可梦发出
替换上场或退场的指令。\p除此之外，严禁向宝可梦下达
任何战斗指令。\p宝可梦将遵循自身的性格与心意，
自主进行战斗。\p您必须全心信任自己的宝可梦，
静静注视守护它们。\p若能赢得连胜3位训练家的荣誉，
我们将为您送上一份奖品。\p若想中断挑战，请保存记录。\p如果在中断挑战前没有保存记录，
您将被取消参赛资格。$

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainSlateportTent
source: Here at the FACTORY BATTLE TENT,\n
translation: 在工场对战帐篷，

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainSlateportTent
source: Here at the SLATEPORT BATTLE TENT,\n
translation: 在凯那市对战帐篷，

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainSlateportTent
source:
we hold Battle Swap events\lusing rental POKéMON.\pFirst, you will be loaned three
POKéMON specifically for this event.\pUsing the supplied rental POKéMON,
you must conduct a SINGLE BATTLE.\pIf you win, you are permitted to trade
one of your rental POKéMON.\pRepeat this cycle of battling and
trading--if you win three times in\la row, you will earn a fine prize.\pIf you want to interrupt your
challenge, please save the game.\pIf you don't save before interrupting,
you will be disqualified.$
translation:
我们使用租借宝可梦
举办换装对战比赛。\p首先，我们会借给您3只
本次活动专用的宝可梦。\p您需要使用提供的租借宝可梦
来进行单打对战。\p只要获胜，您就可以交换
其中1只租借宝可梦。\p像这样重复对战并交换--
只要取得3连胜，\l就能获得精美的奖品。\p若想中断挑战，请保存记录。\p如果在中断挑战前没有保存记录，
您将被取消参赛资格。$

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_DidntSaveBeforeQuitting
source: I'm sorry to say this, but you didn't\nsave before you quit playing last time.\pAs a result, you have been disqualified\nfrom your challenge.$
translation: 非常遗憾，您上次在退出游戏前\n没有保存记录。\p因此，您本次的挑战\n已被判定为取消资格。$

label: BattleTentLobby_Text_EarnedBattlePoints
source: You've earned {STR_VAR_1} Battle Points!$
translation: 获得了{STR_VAR_1}点对战点数！$

label: Route111_Text_WateredPlantsEveryDayTakeBerry
source: I watered the plants every day.\nThey grew lots of flowers.\pAnd they gave me lots of BERRIES, too.\pHere you go!\nYou can have it!$
translation:
我每天都给植物浇水，
开出了好多好多花呢。\p而且结出了好多树果哦。\p这个给你！
送给你啦！$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_PokeblocksSuitPokemon
source: When it gets right down to it…\pThe way dignified simplicity suits me,\n{POKEBLOCK}S perfectly suit POKéMON.$
translation:
说到底......\p正如端庄素雅非常适合我一样，
{POKEBLOCK}也同样完美适合宝可梦。$

label: SootopolisCity_Text_OhDoesntMatter
source: Oh…\nIt doesn't matter…\pThere's so much that I want to know…$
translation:
啊......
算了，没关系......\p我想要了解的事情还有好多好多呢......$

label: gText_Birch_Pokemon
source: This is what we call a “POKéMON.”\p\n$
translation:
这就是我们所说的"宝可梦"。\p
$

label: BerryBlender_Text_BlendMasterKnowHowToMakePokeblocks
source: Of course!\nOf course!\pIncidentally…\nYou do know how to blend {POKEBLOCK}S\lfrom BERRIES?$
translation: 当然！当然啦！\p顺便问一句......\n你知道怎么用树果制作{POKEBLOCK}吧？$

label: BerryBlender_Text_BlendMasterNoPokeblockCase
source: Hmmm!\pYou don't appear to have gotten\nthe {POKEBLOCK} CASE!\pI shall be here all day!\nObtain the {POKEBLOCK} CASE and hurry back!$
translation: 嗯哼！\p你好像还没有得到\n{POKEBLOCK}盒呢！\p我整天都会在这里！\n拿到{POKEBLOCK}盒之后就赶快回来吧！$

label: BerryBlender_Text_BlendMasterPokeblockCaseFull
source: Hmmm!\pYour {POKEBLOCK} CASE appears to be full!\pI shall be here all day!\nUse some {POKEBLOCK}S and hurry back!$
translation: 嗯哼！\p你的{POKEBLOCK}盒好像装满了！\p我整天都会在这里！\n用掉一些{POKEBLOCK}之后就赶快回来吧！$

label: BerryBlender_Text_WhoaAwesome
source: Whoa!\nAwesome!$
translation: 哇！\n太厉害了！$

label: BerryBlender_Text_MadeAmazingPokeblocksWithMaster
source: When I blended with the MASTER,\nwe made amazing {POKEBLOCK}S!$
translation: 我和名匠一起制作的时候，\n做出了超级厉害的{POKEBLOCK}！$

label: CableClub_Text_ExplainWirelessClub
source:
Let me explain how the POKéMON
WIRELESS CLUB works.\pOn this, the top floor, there are
two rooms.\pFirst, the room on the left.
It's the UNION ROOM.\pYou may link up with TRAINERS
around you who have also entered\lthe UNION ROOM.\pWith them, you may do things like
chat, battle, and trade.\pSecond, the room on the right is
the DIRECT CORNER.\pYou may trade or battle POKéMON
with your friends in this room.\pSometimes, you may not be able to
find your friends in the UNION ROOM\lor the DIRECT CORNER.\pIn that case, please move closer
to your friends.\pIf the Wireless Adapter isn't
connected, you may still link up\lusing a GBA Game Link cable.\pIf that is the case, you must go
to the DIRECT CORNER.\pI hope you enjoy the Wireless 
Communication System.$
translation:
请让我为您介绍宝可梦
无线俱乐部的功能。\p在最顶层的这一层，
一共有两个房间。\p首先是左手边的房间，
那里是"联谊厅"。\p您可以与周围同样进入了
联谊厅的训练家进行连接。\p您可以与他们一起聊天、
进行对战或是交换。\p其次是右手边的房间，
那里是"直接角"。\p您可以在这个房间里
与朋友交换宝可梦或进行对战。\p有时，您可能无法在联谊厅
或直接角找到您的朋友。\p遇到这种情况时，
请尽量靠近您的朋友。\p如果没有连接无线适配器，
您仍然可以使用GBA通信线进行连接。\p如果是那样的话，
请前往直接角。\p祝您享受无线通信系统的乐趣。$

label: DayCare_Text_ImDaycareManSpeakToMyWife
source: I'm the DAY-CARE MAN.\pI help take care of the precious\nPOKéMON of TRAINERS.\pIf you'd like me to raise your\nPOKéMON, have a word with my wife.$
translation: 我是培育屋爷爷。\p我负责帮训练家照料他们宝贵的宝可梦。\p如果你想寄放宝可梦的话，\n请跟我老伴说吧。$

label: DayCare_Text_DoYouWantEgg
source: Ah, it's you!\pWe were raising your POKéMON, and\nmy goodness, were we surprised!\pYour POKéMON had an EGG!\pWe don't know how it got there,\nbut your POKéMON had it.\pYou do want it, yes?$
translation: 啊，是你啊！\p我们帮你照顾宝可梦的时候，\n哎呀，真是吓了一跳！\p你的宝可梦竟然带着一颗蛋！\p虽然不知道是怎么来的，\n但确实是在你的宝可梦身边的。\p你想要收下它，对吧？$

label: DayCare_Text_YourMonIsDoingFine
source: Ah, it's you! Good to see you.\nYour {STR_VAR_1}'s doing fine.$
translation: 哎呀，是你啊！见到你真高兴。\n你的{STR_VAR_1}精神得很呢。$

label: DayCare_Text_IllKeepIt
source: Well then, I'll keep it.\nThanks!$
translation: 这样啊，那我就自己留着了。\n谢谢你啦！$

label: DayCare_Text_YouHaveNoRoomForIt
source: You have no room for it…\nCome back when you've made room.$
translation: 你的同行宝可梦已经满了......\n腾出空位后再来吧。$

label: DayCare_Text_ReceivedEgg

收件人：{PLAYER}\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}你与宝可梦的超强力量，
我已经亲身体会到了。\p下次，也许我该教教你
如何锻炼自己的体魄了。$

label: gFameCheckerPersonName_Agatha
source: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}AGATHA$
translation: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}菊子$

label: gFameCheckerPersonQuote_Agatha
source: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}From: AGATHA\nTo: {PLAYER}\p{FONT_FEMALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}When you grow older, don't you\ndare go soft like that coot OAK!\pBe like me and keep battling on!$
translation: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}寄件人：菊子\n收件人：{PLAYER}\p{FONT_FEMALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}等你上了年纪，可千万别像大木\n那个老顽固一样变得心慈手软！\p要像我一样，把战斗一直进行到底！$

label: gFameCheckerPersonName_Lance
source: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}LANCE$
translation: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}阿渡$

label: gFameCheckerPersonQuote_Lance
source:
{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}From: LANCE
To: {PLAYER}\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}I'm considering going back to my
hometown.\pI want to retrain my DRAGON-type
POKéMON and strengthen them.\pI'd like to invite you to my
hometown one day.$
translation: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}寄件人：阿渡\n收件人：{PLAYER}\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}我正在考虑回一趟故乡。\p我想重新磨炼我的龙属性宝可梦，\n让它们变得更加强大。\p总有一天，我想邀请你去我的故乡看看。$

label: gFameCheckerPersonName_Bill
source: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}BILL$
translation: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}正辉$

label: gFameCheckerPersonQuote_Bill
source:
{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}From: BILL
To: {PLAYER}\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}Hey, there! CELIO had nothing but
praise for you.\pHearing that makes me happy.\pWhen you catch some rare POKéMON,
come show me, okay? Promise!$
translation: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}寄件人：正辉\n收件人：{PLAYER}\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}哟！锦辉那家伙把你夸上了天呢。\p听得我也跟着高兴起来了。\p要是抓到了稀有的宝可梦，\n可要拿来给我瞧瞧哦？说好了！$

label: gFameCheckerPersonName_MrFuji
source: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}MR. FUJI$
translation: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}富士老人$

label: gFameCheckerPersonQuote_MrFuji
source:
{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}From: MR. FUJI
To: {PLAYER}\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}Instead of hoping for the happiness
of just your POKéMON…\p…Can I get you to wish for the
happiness of all POKéMON?$
translation: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}寄件人：富士老人\n收件人：{PLAYER}\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}与其仅祈愿你自己的宝可梦获得幸福......\p......老夫能否拜托你，\n祈愿所有宝可梦都能得到幸福呢？$

label: gFameCheckerPersonName_Giovanni
source: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}GIOVANNI$
translation: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}坂木$

label: gFameCheckerPersonQuote_Giovanni
source:
{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}From: GIOVANNI
To: {PLAYER}\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}There is nothing that I wish to say
to you.\pI will concentrate solely on
bettering myself, and none other.$
translation: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}寄件人：坂木\n收件人：{PLAYER}\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}我跟你之间已无话可说。\p我唯有潜心磨砺自身，仅此而已。$

label: PokemonJournal_Text_SpecialFeatureBrock
source: POKéMON JOURNAL\pSpecial Feature: PEWTER GYM\nLEADER BROCK!\pBROCK rarely laughs, but is said to\nbe unable to stop if he starts.$
translation: 《宝可梦周刊》\p深灰道馆馆主小刚特辑！\p平时不苟言笑的小刚，\n据说一笑起来就停不下来。$

label: PokemonJournal_Text_SpecialFeatureMisty
source: POKéMON JOURNAL\pSpecial Feature: CERULEAN GYM\nLEADER MISTY!\pMISTY is said to worship LORELEI\nof the ELITE FOUR.$
translation: 《宝可梦周刊》\p华蓝道馆馆主小霞特辑！\p据说小霞十分崇拜\n四天王中的科拿。$

label: PokemonJournal_Text_SpecialFeatureLtSurge
source:
POKéMON JOURNAL\pSpecial Feature: VERMILION GYM
LEADER LT. SURGE!\pLT. SURGE is rumored to have been
a pilot while home in America.\pHe used the electricity generated
by POKéMON to power his plane.$
translation: 《宝可梦周刊》\p枯叶道馆馆主马志士特辑！\p传闻马志士还在美国老家时\n曾是一名飞行员。\p他曾利用宝可梦产生的电力\n来驱动他的飞机。$

label: PokemonJournal_Text_SpecialFeatureErika
source: POKéMON JOURNAL\pSpecial Feature: CELADON GYM\nLEADER ERIKA!\pRumor has it that if you peek into\nCELADON GYM, you can often\lsee ERIKA snoozing.$
translation: 《宝可梦周刊》\p玉虹道馆馆主莉佳特辑！\p传闻只要朝玉虹道馆里偷瞄，\n就经常能看到莉佳在打瞌睡。$

label: PokemonJournal_Text_SpecialFeatureKoga
source:
POKéMON JOURNAL\pSpecial Feature: FUCHSIA GYM
LEADER KOGA!\pKOGA is said to have a thorough
knowledge of medicine.\pHe even concocts medicine to nurse
his POKéMON to health.$
translation: 《宝可梦周刊》\p浅红道馆馆主阿桔特辑！\p据说阿桔对医药有着极为深厚的造诣。\p他甚至会亲自配药\n来为自己的宝可梦调理身体。$

label: PokemonJournal_Text_SpecialFeatureSabrina
source: POKéMON JOURNAL\pSpecial Feature: SAFFRON GYM\nLEADER SABRINA!\pPeople say that SABRINA can\ncommunicate with her POKéMON\lduring battle without speaking.$
translation: 《宝可梦周刊》\p金黄道馆馆主娜姿特辑！\p大家都说娜姿在对战时\n即使不开口，也能与宝可梦心意相通。$

label: PokemonJournal_Text_SpecialFeatureBlaine
source: POKéMON JOURNAL\pSpecial Feature: CINNABAR GYM\nLEADER BLAINE!\pBLAINE is said to remove his dark\nshades only when he is thinking up\lnew quiz questions.$
translation: 《宝可梦周刊》\p红莲道馆馆主夏伯特辑！\p据说夏伯只有在构思新的谜题时，\n才会摘下他的深色墨镜。$

label: PokemonJournal_Text_SpecialFeatureLorelei
source: POKéMON JOURNAL\pSpecial Feature:\nELITE FOUR's LORELEI!\pKnown for her logical, calculated,\nand cool battling style, LORELEI\lhas a surprising secret!$
translation: 《宝可梦周刊》\p四天王科拿特辑！\p以沉着冷静、精于算计的对战风格\n闻名的科拿，其实有着令人意外的秘密！$

label: PokemonJournal_Text_SpecialFeatureBruno
source: POKéMON JOURNAL\pSpecial Feature:\nELITE FOUR's BRUNO!\pBRUNO apparently joined the ELITE\nFOUR out of his burning ambition to\lbattle the best TRAINERS.$
translation: 《宝可梦周刊》\p四天王希巴特辑！\p希巴之所以加入四天王，\n据说是为了能与最顶尖的训练家交手\l而燃起了熊熊斗志。$

label: PokemonJournal_Text_SpecialFeatureAgatha
source: POKéMON JOURNAL\pSpecial Feature:\nELITE FOUR's AGATHA!\pIn her youth, AGATHA and PROF.\nOAK were rivals who vied for\lsupremacy as TRAINERS.$
translation: 《宝可梦周刊》\p四天王菊子特辑！\p菊子在年轻时曾与大木博士\n为了争夺最强训练家之名而针锋相对。$

label: PokemonJournal_Text_SpecialFeatureLance
source: POKéMON JOURNAL\pSpecial Feature:\nELITE FOUR's LANCE!\pLANCE's grandfather is thought to\nbe the elder of a famous clan of\ldragon masters.$
translation: 《宝可梦周刊》\p四天王阿渡特辑！\p据说阿渡的祖父\n是名扬四海的驯龙一族长老。$

label: PokemonJournal_Text_SpecialFeatureProfOak
source: POKéMON JOURNAL\pSpecial Feature: PROF. OAK,\nthe POKéMON Researcher!\pPROF. OAK reportedly lives with his\ngrandchildren DAISY and {RIVAL}.$
translation: 《宝可梦周刊》\p宝可梦研究巨擘--大木博士特辑！\p据报道，大木博士如今与孙女奈奈美\n以及孙子{RIVAL}生活在一起。$

label: PokemonJournal_Text_SpecialFeatureDaisyOak
source:
This is a POKéMON JOURNAL from
years ago…\pPOKéMON JOURNAL
CONTEST Special!\pThe Spring POKéMON CONTEST's
Grand Champion is DAISY OAK of\lPALLET TOWN!$
translation: 这是一份很多年前的《宝可梦周刊》......\p《宝可梦周刊》\n华丽大赛特辑！\p春季宝可梦华丽大赛的总冠军\n是来自真新镇的大木奈奈美！$

label: PokemonJournal_Text_SpecialFeatureMrFuji
source:
POKéMON JOURNAL\pSpecial Feature:
MR. FUJI of POKéMON HOUSE!\pEditor: The shy MR. FUJI turned
down our interview requests.\pHe is a kindly man who is adored
and respected in LAVENDER TOWN.$
translation: 《宝可梦周刊》\p宝可梦之家的富士老人特辑！\p主编注：生性害羞的富士老人\n回绝了我们的采访请求。\p他是一位慈祥的老人，\n在紫苑镇深受居民们的爱戴与尊敬。$

label: Trade_Text_LookingForMonWannaTradeForMon
source: I'm looking for the POKéMON\n{STR_VAR_1}!\pWanna trade one for my\n{STR_VAR_2}?$
translation: 我正在寻找宝可梦{STR_VAR_1}！\p能用我的{STR_VAR_2}\n来和你交换一只吗？$

label: Trade_Text_AwwOhWell
source: Awww!\nOh, well…$

label: Trade_Text_WhatThatsNoMon
source: What?\nThat's no {STR_VAR_1}!$
translation: 哎？\n这可不是{STR_VAR_1}啊！$

label: Trade_Text_HeyThanks
source: Hey, thanks!$
translation: 嘿，太感谢啦！$

label: Trade_Text_IsntMyOldMonGreat
source: Isn't my old {STR_VAR_2} great?$
translation: 我之前的那只{STR_VAR_2}很棒吧？$

label: Trade_Text_DoYouHaveMonWouldYouTradeForMon
source: Hello, there! Do you happen to\nhave a {STR_VAR_1}?\pWould you agree to a trade for\nmy {STR_VAR_2}?$
translation: 你好呀！你身上刚好有{STR_VAR_1}吗？\p愿意用它来交换我的{STR_VAR_2}吗？$

label: Trade_Text_WellIfYouDontWantTo
source: Well, if you don't want to…$
translation: 好吧，不想换就算啦......$

label: Trade_Text_ThisIsntMon
source: Hmmm?\nThis isn't a {STR_VAR_1}.\pThink of me if you get one.$
translation: 嗯？\n这可不是{STR_VAR_1}呀。\p要是抓到的话，可千万要想着我哦。$

label: Trade_Text_Thanks
source: Thanks!$
translation: 谢谢！$

label: Trade_Text_HasTradedMonGrownStronger
source: The {STR_VAR_2} that I traded you,\nhas it grown stronger?$
translation: 我换给你的{STR_VAR_2}，\n有变得更强了吗？$

label: Trade_Text_DoYouHaveMonWantToTradeForMon
source: Hi!\nDo you have a {STR_VAR_1}?\pWant to trade it for my\n{STR_VAR_2}?$
translation: 你好！\n你有{STR_VAR_1}吗？\p想不想用它来交换我的\n{STR_VAR_2}？$

label: Trade_Text_ThatsTooBad
source: That's too bad.$
translation: 真遗憾。$

label: Trade_Text_ThisIsNoMon
source: …This is no {STR_VAR_1}.\pIf you get one, trade it with me.$
translation: ......这不是{STR_VAR_1}啊。\p如果你收服到了，一定要和我交换哦。$

label: Trade_Text_ThanksYoureAPal
source: Thanks, you're a pal!$
translation: 谢谢你，你真是个好伙伴！$

label: Trade_Text_HowIsMyOldMon
source: How is my old {STR_VAR_2}?\nMy {STR_VAR_1} is doing great!$
translation: 之前换给你的{STR_VAR_2}怎么样了？\n我的{STR_VAR_1}精神得很呢！$

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_1F_Text_LotteryCornerDrawTicket
source:
This is the POKéMON LOTTERY CORNER.\pAll shoppers at our DEPARTMENT STORE
get to draw a POKéMON LOTO TICKET.\pIf the LOTO TICKET's number matches
the ID number of any of your POKéMON,\lyou will receive a fabulous gift.\pWould you like to draw a POKéMON
LOTO TICKET?$
translation:
这里是宝可梦奖券角。\p莅临本百货商场的顾客
都可以抽取一张宝可梦彩票。\p如果彩票号码与你的宝可梦中
任何一只的ID完全吻合，\l就能获得豪华大奖哦。\p你想抽取一张宝可梦
彩票吗？$

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_1F_Text_PleasePickTicket

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_1F_Text_PrizeWeveBeenHolding
source: {PLAYER}?\nYes, I've been expecting you.\pThis is the prize we've been holding\nfor you.$
translation: {PLAYER}对吧？\n好的，我正等您呢。\p这是为您保管的奖品。$

label: gText_HowMayIServeYou
source: Welcome!\pHow may I serve you?$
translation: 欢迎光临！\p请问有什么能为您效劳的？$

label: gText_PleaseComeAgain
source: Please come again!$
translation: 欢迎下次再来！$

label: gText_PlayerWhatCanIDoForYou
source: {PLAYER}{STRING 5}, welcome!\pWhat can I do for you?$
translation: {PLAYER}{STRING 5}，欢迎光临！\p请问有什么事吗？$

label: MatchCall_SameRouteBattleRequestText6
source:
Hey, {PLAYER}{KUN}.
{STR_VAR_1} here.\lHow are your POKéMON keeping?\pOh, is that right? You're around
{STR_VAR_2}?\pWell, then, we'd better have
a rematch.\pI can wait, sure.
See you!$
translation: 喂，{PLAYER}{KUN}。\n我是{STR_VAR_1}。\l你的宝可梦都还好吗？\p哦，是吗？你在{STR_VAR_2}附近？\p既然这样，我们一定要再对战一场。\p我随时奉陪。\n回见！$

label: MatchCall_PersonalizedText28
source:
I love POKéMON!
It's {STR_VAR_1} from the FAN CLUB!\pYou have to hear this!
My sweet POKéMON…\pSnort! Wahaha!
I can't say any more! It's a secret!\lIt's just too cute for words!\pOh, my sweet {STR_VAR_2} is begging
for a {POKEBLOCK}!\pIt's the picture of cuteness!\pSorry, but I can't talk now!
You'll have to hear this next time!$
translation:
我最喜欢宝可梦了！
我是宝可梦发烧友俱乐部的{STR_VAR_1}！\p你快听我说！
我可爱的小宝可梦......\p噗嗤！哇哈哈！
不能再说了！这是秘密！\l它真是可爱到无法用语言形容！\p哎呀，我可爱的{STR_VAR_2}正在撒娇
想要吃{POKEBLOCK}呢！\p那样子简直可爱极了！\p抱歉，我现在没空聊啦！
下次再讲给你听吧！$

label: MatchCall_PersonalizedText39
source:
Hey, it's {STR_VAR_1}…
Whoops!\pSplash!\pBlug-blug-blug-blug…\pSploosh!\pWhiff-whiff! Whiff-whiff!\pHey! Sorry about that!
I just put on some suntan oil.\pSo my POKéNAV went whoopsy
out of my hand into the water!\pBut, boy, DEVON's POKéNAV is built
tough. It survived that dunking!\pAnyways, I'm busy sunbathing,
so let's chat another time.$
translation:
喂，我是{STR_VAR_1}......
哎呀！\p噗通！\p咕噜咕噜咕噜......\p哗啦！\p呼--呼--！呼--呼--！\p喂！抱歉啊！
我刚才擦了防晒油。\p结果宝可梦领航员手滑，
直接掉到水里去了！\p不过真厉害，得文的宝可梦领航员
做工真结实。掉进水里居然一点事都没有！\p总之，我正忙着晒日光浴呢，
下次再聊吧。$

label: MatchCall_PersonalizedText52
source:
Hi, this is {STR_VAR_1}.\pI gave a {POKEBLOCK} to my {STR_VAR_2}.
It seemed to enjoy it very much.\pIt looks like POKéMON have their
likes and dislikes with {POKEBLOCK}S.\pI find that quite fascinating.
Please do take care.$
translation:
你好，我是{STR_VAR_1}。\p我给我的{STR_VAR_2}喂了{POKEBLOCK}，
它看起来吃得非常开心。\p看来宝可梦对于{POKEBLOCK}
也是有各自的口味偏好呢。\p我觉得这非常有意思。
请你也多保重。$

label: MatchCall_BattleDomeText3
source:
Hey there, {PLAYER}!
It's me, {STR_VAR_1}.\lHow's it going?\pI heard you won events {STR_VAR_3} times
at the {STR_VAR_2}!\pMake it one more next time!
Catch you soon!$
translation:
你好呀，{PLAYER}！
是我，{STR_VAR_1}。\l最近怎么样？\p我听说你在{STR_VAR_2}
赢了{STR_VAR_3}次比赛呢！\p下次争取再赢一场！
回见啦！$

label: MatchCall_BattleDomeText5
source:
Hiya, {PLAYER}{KUN}!
It's {STR_VAR_1}.\pI heard you won {STR_VAR_3} times
outright at the {STR_VAR_2}.\pI'd better get with it, too!
See you soon!$
translation:
嗨，{PLAYER}{KUN}！
我是{STR_VAR_1}。\p我听说你在{STR_VAR_2}
干脆利落地赢了{STR_VAR_3}次。\p我也得加把劲才行了！
回头见！$

label: MatchCall_BattleDomeText6
source:
Hey, {PLAYER}{KUN}?
{STR_VAR_1} here. How are you?\pBy the way, I heard you became
the champion {STR_VAR_3} times at\lthe {STR_VAR_2}.\pI'd better raise my POKéMON before
you pull farther ahead.$
translation:
喂，是{PLAYER}{KUN}吗？
我是{STR_VAR_1}。你最近好吗？\p话说回来，听说你在{STR_VAR_2}
获得了{STR_VAR_3}次冠军啊。\p在被你拉开更大差距之前，
我也得好好培育宝可梦了。$

label: MatchCall_Text_Baoba1
source: BAOBA: {PLAYER}!\nThe SAFARI ZONE is nearly ready!\pI'll call you first thing when\nit's finished!$
translation: 巴奥巴：{PLAYER}！\n狩猎地带马上就要建好了！\p等建好之后，我一定第一时间通知你！$

label: MatchCall_Text_Baoba2
source: BAOBA: {PLAYER}!\nThe SAFARI ZONE is open! Come\panytime!$
translation: 巴奥巴：{PLAYER}！\n狩猎地带已经开业了！\p欢迎随时来玩！$

label: MatchCall_Text_Roxanne1
source:
ROXANNE: Oh, hello, {PLAYER}!\pI've been hard at work retraining
since we met.\pI will still need some more time
before I can reopen the GYM.\pBut when I do, please visit my GYM
for a rematch!$
translation: 杜娟：哎呀，你好呀，{PLAYER}！\p自从上次见面后，我一直都在刻苦特训。\p不过要重新开放道馆，\n还需要一些时间。\p等开放之后，请务必来我的道馆\n再切磋一场！$

label: MatchCall_Text_Roxanne2
source:
ROXANNE: Is this {PLAYER}?
Congratulations!\lI've been hearing about you!\pAs for me, I need some more time
before I can reopen the GYM.\pBut when I do, please visit my GYM
for a rematch!$
translation:
杜娟：是{PLAYER}吗？
恭喜你！\l你的活跃事迹我都听说了！\p至于我这边，要重新开放道馆
还需要一些时间。\p等开放之后，请务必来我的道馆
再切磋一场！$

label: MatchCall_Text_Roxanne3
source: ROXANNE: {PLAYER}!\nMy GYM is ready!\pPlease visit RUSTBORO whenever\nyou can!$
translation: 杜娟：{PLAYER}！\n我的道馆准备好啦！\p有空请一定要来卡那兹市玩哦！$

label: MatchCall_Text_Roxanne4
source: ROXANNE: At the RUSTBORO GYM,\nthe fact that we battled, {PLAYER},\lis a matter of pride.$
translation: 杜娟：在卡那兹道馆里，\n能与你交手，{PLAYER}，\l令我感到非常自豪。$

label: MatchCall_Text_Brawly1
source:
BRAWLY: Hey, there, {PLAYER}{KUN}!\pI learned a lot from the battle we
had together.\pI intend to do my training over,
then reopen the GYM.\pIt's going to take some time before
I'm ready to run the GYM again.\pBut if I can reopen the GYM,
I want you to challenge us again.$
translation:
藤树：哟，{PLAYER}{KUN}！\p和你的那场对战让我受益匪浅啊。\p我打算重新修行一番，
然后再把道馆开张。\p要重新运营道馆
可能还需要一段时间。\p等道馆重新开张后，
你一定要再来挑战我们啊。$

label: MatchCall_Text_Brawly2
source:
BRAWLY: Hey, {PLAYER}{KUN}!
Congratulations!\pWord about your exploits arrived
on tidal winds!\pIt appears as if I need to work on
my training some more.\pIt's going to take some time before
I'm ready to run the GYM again.\pBut if I can reopen the GYM,
I want you to challenge us again.$
translation:
藤树：哟，{PLAYER}{KUN}！
恭喜你啊！\p你活跃的事迹随着海潮之风
传到我这里来了！\p看来我还得更加拼命修行才行啊。\p要重新运营道馆
可能还需要一段时间。\p等道馆重新开张后，
你一定要再来挑战我们啊。$

label: MatchCall_Text_Brawly3
source: BRAWLY: Hey, {PLAYER}{KUN}!\nMy GYM's ready for action!\pCome back to DEWFORD anytime\nfor another challenge!$
translation: 藤树：嘿，{PLAYER}{KUN}！\n我的道馆已经准备就绪了！\p随时欢迎回到武斗镇\n接受全新的挑战！$

label: MatchCall_Text_Brawly4
source: BRAWLY: {PLAYER}{KUN}, I don't think\nI'll ever get bored of battling you!$
translation: 藤树：{PLAYER}{KUN}，我想我\n一辈子都不会厌倦和你对战的！$

label: MatchCall_Text_Wattson1
source:
WATTSON: Oh, it's you!\pAfter you left, I've been redoing
my training from scratch.\pI'd say I could use a wee bit more
time to reopen my GYM.\pYou'll have to wait till then!
Wahahahaha!$
translation: 铁旋：哦，是你啊！\p你离开后，我又从头开始了修行呢。\p不过要重新开放道馆，\n恐怕还需要一点点时间。\p在那之前你就耐心等等吧！\n哇哈哈哈哈！$

label: MatchCall_Text_Wattson2
source:
WATTSON: Wahahahaha!\pYou've really done it, haven't you?
I've been getting word about you!\pIt seems I need to retrain some
more still.\pI'd say I could use a wee bit more
time to reopen my GYM.\pYou'll have to wait till then!
Wahahahaha!$
translation:
铁旋：哇哈哈哈哈！\p你真的做到了啊，不是吗？
你的传闻我都听说了！\p看来我还得多加修行才行呢。\p要重新开放道馆，
恐怕还需要一点点时间。\p在那之前你就耐心等等吧！
哇哈哈哈哈！$

label: MatchCall_Text_Wattson3
source: WATTSON: Oh, it's you!\nMy GYM's ready!\pVisit MAUVILLE anytime!\nWahahahaha!$
translation: 铁旋：哦，是你啊！\n我的道馆已经准备好啦！\p随时来紫堇市玩吧！\n哇哈哈哈哈！$

label: MatchCall_Text_Wattson4
source: WATTSON: Wahahaha!\pA battle with you is always charged\nwith shocking power!$
translation: 铁旋：哇哈哈哈！\p每次和你对战，都充满着\n令人浑身触电般的震撼力量啊！$

label: MatchCall_Text_Flannery1
source:
FLANNERY: {PLAYER}…\pWhen we battled, I learned exactly
how immature I was.\pBut I'm not done yet!\pI'm going to redo my training and
reopen the GYM.\pWhen the time comes, {PLAYER},
please challenge us again.$
translation: 亚莎：{PLAYER}......\p和你对战之后，我才真切地明白\n自己有多么不成熟。\p但我绝不会就此止步！\p我会重新修行，然后重开道馆。\p到那个时候，{PLAYER}，\n请务必再来向我们挑战！$

label: MatchCall_Text_Flannery2
source:
FLANNERY: Hello, {PLAYER}?
Congratulations!\pWord of your success has reached
us like the heat of a volcano!\pOur training is coming along very
well here.\pWhen the GYM's ready, a mark will
appear beside my name in the\lMATCH CALL list.$
translation:
亚莎：喂喂，是{PLAYER}吗？
祝贺你！\p你成功的捷报像火山的热气一样
传到了我们这里！\p我们这边的修行也进展得非常顺利。\p等道馆准备好了，在对战寻呼的名单里，
我的名字旁就会显示一个标记。$

label: MatchCall_Text_Flannery3
source: FLANNERY: Oh, {PLAYER}?\nOur GYM's ready!\pCome to LAVARIDGE for a soak\nin the hot spring and a challenge!$
translation: 亚莎：啊，是{PLAYER}吗？\n我们的道馆已经准备好啦！\p快来釜炎镇泡泡温泉，\n顺便向我们发起挑战吧！$

label: MatchCall_Text_Flannery4
source: FLANNERY: {PLAYER}…\nI'm positive that you keep getting\lbetter at training every time.$
translation: 亚莎：{PLAYER}......\n我能肯定，你每次都在变得\l越来越强呢。$

label: MatchCall_Text_Winona1
source: WINONA: Hello, {PLAYER}!\pThanks to our battle, I've come\nto understand my weak points!\pWhen I reopen the GYM, I won't go\ndown in defeat again!$
translation: 娜琪：你好，{PLAYER}！\p多亏了和你的对战，\n让我看清了自己的不足之处！\p等到重新开放道馆的时候，\n我可不会再轻易落败了！$

label: MatchCall_Text_Winona2
source: WINONA: You've done it, {PLAYER}!\pNews about the new CHAMPION\nhas reached us in FORTREE!\pBut… The next time we battle,\nit's not going to end the same way.$
translation: 娜琪：你做到了，{PLAYER}！\p新冠军诞生的捷报，\n已经传遍了茵郁市！\p不过......下一次我们交手，\n结果可不会跟上次一样了。$

label: MatchCall_Text_Winona3
source: WINONA: Is this {PLAYER}?\nOur GYM is back in operation!\pWe're waiting for you in FORTREE!$
translation: 娜琪：是{PLAYER}吗？\n我们的道馆已经重新开放了！\p我们正在茵郁市等着你呢！$

label: MatchCall_Text_Winona4
source: WINONA: {PLAYER}…\nThough I have lost, my wings will\lnever break.\pYes, in exactly the same way that\nyou never lost sight of your dream.$
translation: 娜琪：{PLAYER}......\n尽管我输了，但我的羽翼\l绝不会折断。\p没错，就如同你\n从未放弃过自己的梦想一样。$

label: MatchCall_Text_TateLiza1
source:
TATE: Oh! You're…
LIZA: {PLAYER}!\pTATE: We're in training again…
LIZA: So we can reopen our GYM!\pTATE: When our GYM is ready…
LIZA: When our GYM is ready…\pTATE: A mark'll appear by our name…
LIZA: On the MATCH CALL list.$
translation:
枫：哦！你是......
南：{PLAYER}！\p枫：我们正在加紧修行......
南：为了能重开我们的道馆！\p枫：等我们的道馆准备好了......
南：等我们的道馆准备好了......\p枫：名字旁边就会出现标记......
南：就在对战寻呼名单上！$

label: MatchCall_Text_TateLiza2
source:
TATE: {PLAYER}, congratulations!
LIZA: {PLAYER}, congratulations!\pTATE: The two of us are…
LIZA: Still in training!\pTATE: We need some more time, but…
LIZA: When our GYM is ready…\pTATE: A mark'll appear by our name…
LIZA: On the MATCH CALL list.$
translation:
枫：{PLAYER}，恭喜你！
南：{PLAYER}，恭喜你！\p枫：我们两个呢......
南：还在修行当中！\p枫：虽然还需要一点时间，不过......
南：等我们的道馆准备好了......\p枫：名字旁边就会出现标记......
南：就在对战寻呼名单上！$

label: MatchCall_Text_TateLiza3
source:
TATE: {PLAYER}!
LIZA: {PLAYER}!\pTATE: Our GYM is ready!
LIZA: Our GYM is ready!\pTATE: Please come visit…
LIZA: MOSSDEEP anytime!$
translation:
枫：{PLAYER}！
南：{PLAYER}！\p枫：我们的道馆准备好啦！
南：我们的道馆准备好啦！\p枫：随时欢迎......
南：来绿岭市做客！$

label: MatchCall_Text_TateLiza4
source: TATE: {PLAYER}, the battle we had…\nLIZA: Is an invaluable experience.\pTATE: It would be nice if…\nLIZA: We could all battle again!$
translation: 枫：{PLAYER}，和你进行的对战......\n南：是不可多得的宝贵经验。\p枫：要是之后能......\n南：再一起对战就好了！$

label: MatchCall_Text_Juan1
source:
JUAN: Hmm…
{PLAYER}{KUN}… Was it?\pOur battle together--it brought
to me memories of when I first\lencountered WALLACE.\pPerhaps you are a genius who may
yet surpass WALLACE!$
translation: 亚当：唔......\n是叫{PLAYER}{KUN}......对吧？\p与你之间的对战，让我想起了\n第一次见到米可利时的情景。\p或许你是一位甚至能\l超越米可利的天才呢！$

label: MatchCall_Text_Juan2
source:
JUAN: Fufu… {PLAYER}{KUN}…
You've finally achieved your goal.\pMy eye for appraising talent wasn't
mistaken…\pI wish for another chance to meet
you, for you have scaled the peak\lof power and prestige.$
translation: 亚当：呵呵......{PLAYER}{KUN}......\n你终于实现了自己的目标。\p看来我识人的眼光果然没错......\p既然你已经登上了力量与声望的巅峰，\n我真希望有机会能与你再度相会。$

label: MatchCall_Text_Juan3
source: JUAN: Hoho… {PLAYER}{KUN}…\pOur SOOTOPOLIS GYM has finally\nreopened.\pIf you wish to see me, you are\nwelcome to visit anytime.$
translation: 亚当：嚯嚯......{PLAYER}{KUN}......\p我们的琉璃道馆终于重新开放了。\p若是想见我，随时欢迎你的到来。$

label: MatchCall_Text_Juan4
source: JUAN: {PLAYER}{KUN}…\pLike the finest music, the battles\nwe wage together strike chords\lof inspiration in my heart…\pWhen I close my eyes, I see visions\nof you soaring with the melody…$
translation: 亚当：{PLAYER}{KUN}......\p与你交锋的战斗宛如天籁之音，\n在我心弦上拨动出灵感的共鸣......\p每当我闭上双眼，便能看见你\n随着旋律翩跹翱翔的身姿......$

label: MatchCall_Text_Scott4
source:
SCOTT: Hi, {PLAYER}{KUN}!\pI've been hearing about these odd
gangs being a nuisance.\pTEAM MAGMA and TEAM AQUA,
I think they were.\pI would think there'd be some
skilled TRAINERS among them.\p…But if they're thugs…$
translation: 亚希达：嗨，{PLAYER}{KUN}！\p我最近听说有几个奇怪的团伙\n在到处惹麻烦呢。\p好像是叫熔岩队和水舰队吧。\p我本来还以为那帮人里会有\n几位身手不凡的训练家呢。\p......不过如果只是些暴徒的话......$

label: MatchCall_Text_Scott6
source:
SCOTT: Hi, hi, {PLAYER}{KUN}!\pYou know that you can challenge
the POKéMON LEAGUE when you've\lcollected all the GYM BADGES?\pWith your talent, becoming the
CHAMPION isn't a pipe dream.\pBut did you know?
There's somewhere even better.\pBut, that's all I'm willing to say
for the time being.\pIt's something you can look
forward to.\pWhen you've won your way through
the POKéMON LEAGUE into the HALL\lOF FAME!$
translation:
亚希达：嗨，嗨，{PLAYER}{KUN}！\p你知道集齐所有道馆徽章后，
就可以去挑战宝可梦联盟了吧？\p凭你的才能，成为冠军绝非痴人说梦。\p不过你知道吗？
其实还有一个更棒的地方哦。\p不过嘛，目前我也只能透露这么多了。\p这可是个值得期待的大惊喜。\p等你一路披荆斩棘，打通宝可梦联盟
并登上荣誉殿堂之后再说吧！$

label: MatchCall_Text_Norman6
source: DAD: Hiyah! Haah! Dwah!\p…Oh? {PLAYER}!\pYou caught me right in the middle\nof a POKéMON training session!$
translation: 爸爸：喝啊！哈啊！咄啊！\p......哦？是{PLAYER}啊！\p你正好赶上我和宝可梦\n热火朝天地修行呢！$

label: MatchCall_Text_Norman7
source: DAD: {PLAYER}!\pWho would've thought you'd become\nthe POKéMON LEAGUE CHAMPION…\pOkay!\nI won't be left behind!$
translation: 爸爸：{PLAYER}！\p谁能想到你竟然成了\n宝可梦联盟冠军......\p好！\n我也不能落后啊！$

label: MatchCall_Text_Norman8
source:
DAD: Hm? {PLAYER}?
What good timing!\pThis time, I'm going to challenge
you to battle.\pI'm waiting in the PETALBURG GYM.
Accept my challenge anytime!$
translation:
爸爸：嗯？是{PLAYER}吗？
来得正好！\p这一次，我要向你
发起挑战。\p我在橙华道馆等着你。
随时来接受我的挑战吧！$

label: MatchCall_Text_Norman9
source: DAD: …You amaze me, {PLAYER}.\nHow much higher will you soar?$
translation: 爸爸：......你真让我刮目相看啊，{PLAYER}。\n你究竟还能飞得多高呢？$

label: MatchCall_HNS_Joey_General1
source:
Yo, {PLAYER}!
How're you doing?\pHow are your POKéMON doing?\pMy {STR_VAR_3}'s raring to go,
just like always.\pIt's the only one I have.
I'm going to become a great\ltrainer with it!$
translation:
哟，{PLAYER}！
最近怎么样？\p你的宝可梦都还好吗？\p我的{STR_VAR_3}跟平时一样，
干劲十足呢。\p虽然我只有这么一只，
但我要和它一起成为\l出色的训练家！$

label: MatchCall_HNS_Joey_General2
source:
Yo, {PLAYER}!
Got a minute?\pMy {STR_VAR_3}'s looking
sharper than before!\pI doubt there's a POKéMON
as cool as this guy in\lyour party!$
translation:
哟，{PLAYER}！
有空吗？\p我的{STR_VAR_3}看起来
比以前更帅气了！\p你的同伴里肯定没有
比这家伙更酷的宝可梦吧！$

label: MatchCall_HNS_Joey_General3
source:
Yo, {PLAYER}!
How're you doing?\pI'm checking out
{STR_VAR_3}'s moves and\ldevising some strategies.\pWhen I come up with a good
one, let's battle!$
translation:
哟，{PLAYER}！
最近怎么样？\p我正在研究{STR_VAR_3}的招式，
琢磨一些战术呢。\p等我想出好点子，
咱们就来对战吧！$

label: MatchCall_HNS_Joey_Battle
source: Yo, {PLAYER}!\pLet's get together and\nbattle!\pI promise things will be\ndifferent!$
translation: 哟，{PLAYER}！\p聚一聚来场对战吧！\p这次的结果可绝对不一样了！$

label: MatchCall_HNS_Wade_General1
source:
{PLAYER}, howdy!\pHow are your POKéMON doing?\pMy POKéMON have too much
energy to burn.\pIt gets to be a problem.\pOf all my POKéMON,
{STR_VAR_3} is the hardest\lto handle.\pWorking with it is
exhausting.$
translation: {PLAYER}，你好呀！\p你的宝可梦怎么样了？\p我的宝可梦精力实在太旺盛了，\n简直不知道该怎么发泄。\p真让人头疼呢。\p在我所有的宝可梦里，\n{STR_VAR_3}是最难应付的。\p跟它配合简直快把我累垮了。$

label: MatchCall_HNS_Wade_General2
source:
{PLAYER}, howdy!
Isn't it nice out?\pAre your POKéMON growing?\pMy POKéMON are growing a
bit too quickly for me.\lIt's overwhelming!\p{STR_VAR_3}'s growing
especially quickly.\pI think it'll get tough.$
translation:
{PLAYER}，你好呀！
今天天气真不错呢！\p你的宝可梦成长得怎么样了？\p我的宝可梦长得太快了，
我都快应付不过来了！\p特别是{STR_VAR_3}，
成长速度惊人。\p我觉得以后可不好管教了。$

label: MatchCall_HNS_Wade_General3
source: {PLAYER}, howdy!\pOh yeah, we KO'd a wild\n{STR_VAR_3} with one hit\la while back.\pIt went down so easily,\nI felt a little sorry for\lthe poor thing.$
translation: {PLAYER}，你好呀！\p对了对了，前阵子我们一击\n就打倒了一只野生的{STR_VAR_3}。\p它倒下得太容易了，\n我都觉得那可怜的小家伙有点可怜了。$

label: MatchCall_HNS_Wade_FoundItem
source:
{PLAYER}, howdy!\pI found all kinds of
BERRIES.\pIf you want, I'll share
some with you.\pI'll be waiting on
ROUTE 31.$
translation: {PLAYER}，你好呀！\p我找到了各种各样的树果。\p如果你想要的话，我分你一些吧。\p我会在31号道路等你。$

label: MatchCall_HNS_Wade_Battle
source: {PLAYER}, howdy!\pDo you feel like a POKéMON\nbattle?\pIt won't be like last\ntime!$
translation: {PLAYER}，你好呀！\p想来一场宝可梦对战吗？\p这次可不会像上次那样了！$

label: MatchCall_HNS_Ralph_General1
source:
Hey, {PLAYER}!
How's the fishing?\pAre you taking good care of
your POKéMON?\pYou have to be good to
your partners!$
translation: 嗨，{PLAYER}！\n钓鱼钓得怎么样？\p有好好照顾你的宝可梦吗？\p一定要好好对待自己的搭档哦！$

label: MatchCall_HNS_Ralph_General2
source: Hey, {PLAYER}!\pI've been spending more\ntime with my {STR_VAR_3}\lthan I have with my kids.\pThat's a bit sad,\nactually.$
translation: 嗨，{PLAYER}！\p比起陪自己的孩子，我陪我的{STR_VAR_3}\n的时间反而更多呢。\p仔细想想，\n还真有点心酸啊。$

label: MatchCall_HNS_Ralph_General3
source:
Hey, {PLAYER}!
Listen to this!\pI just beat a wild
{STR_VAR_3}.\pI told my kid, but he
scoffed that he could do\lthe same thing easily.\pBoy, has he gotten
cocky…$
translation: 嗨，{PLAYER}！\n听我说啊！\p我刚刚打赢了一只野生的{STR_VAR_3}。\p我跟我家孩子炫耀，他居然嘲笑我，\n说他也能轻轻松松做到。\p哎，这孩子真是越来越狂妄了......$

label: MatchCall_HNS_Ralph_Battle
source: Hey, {PLAYER}!\pI was waiting for you.\nLet's battle!$
translation: 嗨，{PLAYER}！\p我一直在等你呢。\n来对战吧！$

label: MatchCall_HNS_Liz_General1
source:
Hi, {PLAYER}!
I had some time, so I\lcalled you.\pSo anyway, how are your
POKéMON?\pMe, I take my {STR_VAR_3}
to the POKéMON CENTER in\lVIOLET every day,\pso it's doing just
fantastic!\pI'm friends with the
receptionist!$
translation: 嗨，{PLAYER}！\n正好有点时间，就打给你了。\p话说回来，你的宝可梦还好吗？\p我呀，每天都会带我的{STR_VAR_3}\n去桔梗市的宝可梦中心，\p所以它状态棒极了！\p我和前台的护士都成朋友了呢！$

label: MatchCall_HNS_Liz_General2
source:
Hi, {PLAYER}!
You have to hear this.\pMy {STR_VAR_3} is so
adorable!\pIt always wants to
nuzzle me!$
translation: 嗨，{PLAYER}！\n你快听我说。\p我的{STR_VAR_3}真是太可爱了！\p它总是喜欢蹭我撒娇呢！$

label: MatchCall_HNS_Liz_General3
source:
Hi, {PLAYER}!
Listen, listen!\pDon't you think FALKNER of
VIOLET GYM is cool and\lhandsome?\pBut they say his dad, who's
out training on the road,\lis even more cool and\lhandsome than FALKNER.\pI wish I could meet him!$
translation:
嗨，{PLAYER}！
听我说听我说！\p你不觉得桔梗道馆的阿速
又帅又酷吗？\p不过据说他在外修行的爸爸，
比阿速还要帅气有型呢。\p真希望能见他一面啊！$

label: MatchCall_HNS_Liz_Battle
source: Hi, {PLAYER}!\pI was waiting for you.\nLet's battle!$
translation: 嗨，{PLAYER}！\p我一直在等你呢。\n来对战吧！$

label: MatchCall_HNS_Anthony_General1
source:
Hey there, {PLAYER}!\pAre your POKéMON as feisty
as ever?\pMy {STR_VAR_3} and me--we
have energy to burn.\pWe hike up mountains every
day to work out all our\lenergy.$
translation: 你好呀，{PLAYER}！\p你的宝可梦还是那么充满活力吗？\p我和我的{STR_VAR_3}--\n浑身都是使不完的劲儿。\p我们每天都去爬山，\n把旺盛的精力全都发泄出来。$

label: MatchCall_HNS_Anthony_General2
source:
Hey there, {PLAYER}!\pThe other day, I was
watching my {STR_VAR_3}\leat some BERRIES.\pIt looked like it was
enjoying its meal, so I\ldecided to try some.\pI'm not sure if people
should eat that stuff, but\lit was delicious!$
translation:
你好呀，{PLAYER}！\p前几天，我看着我的{STR_VAR_3}
在那里吃树果。\p看它吃得津津有味的样子，
我也忍不住尝了尝。\p虽然不知道人能不能吃那玩意，
但味道真不错呢！$

label: MatchCall_HNS_Anthony_General3
source: Hey there, {PLAYER}!\pLately, I've been running\nacross wild {STR_VAR_3}\lquite often.\pThey're easily taken\ncare of.$
translation: 你好呀，{PLAYER}！\p最近我经常碰到野生的{STR_VAR_3}。\p轻轻松松就能搞定它们。$

label: MatchCall_HNS_Anthony_Battle
source: Hey there, {PLAYER}!\pI was waiting for you.\nLet's battle!$
translation: 你好呀，{PLAYER}！\p我一直在等你呢。\n来对战吧！$

label: MatchCall_HNS_Todd_General1
source:
Hey, {PLAYER}!
What's up?\pHow do you raise your
POKéMON?\pI do all sorts of things,
like leaving them in\lDAY-CARE and\ptoughening them up with
items.$
