translation:
喂，{PLAYER}！
我是健二！\p你还在继续你的
修行之旅吗？\p我也在一心一意地
投入特训呢。\p噢噢噢噢--！$

label: MatchCall_HNS_Kenji_General3
source: Hey, {PLAYER}!\nThis is KENJI!\pI'm in training now.\pI apologize, but call me\nback another time.\pOooooaaarrrgh!$
translation:
喂，{PLAYER}！
我是健二！\p我现在正在特训中。\p很抱歉，换个时间
再打过来吧。\p噢噢噢噢--！$

label: MatchCall_HNS_Kenji_Battle
source: Hey, {PLAYER}!\nThis is KENJI!\pI'm taking a break!\pWhy not drop by if you\nare free?$
translation:
喂，{PLAYER}！
我是健二！\p我现在正在休息呢！\p要是有空的话，
不妨顺道过来坐坐？$

label: MatchCall_HNS_Kenji_FoundItem
source:
Hey, {PLAYER}!
This is KENJI!\pI'm taking a break from
training.\pI found something good.
Come get it if you want!$
translation:
喂，{PLAYER}！
我是健二！\p我正从特训中抽空休息呢。\p我捡到了个好东西。
想要的话就快过来拿吧！$

label: MatchCall_HNS_Parry_General1
source:
Hey, {PLAYER}!
It's PARRY!\pAre your POKéMON looking
good?\pMy {STR_VAR_3} and me--
we're looking mighty\ldandy! Hahahah!$
translation:
喂，{PLAYER}！
我是佩里！\p你的宝可梦状态还好吗？\p我和我的{STR_VAR_3}啊--
精神头简直好得不得了！\l哈哈哈哈！$

label: MatchCall_HNS_Parry_General2
source: Hey, {PLAYER}!\nIt's PARRY!\pNothing can match my\n{STR_VAR_3} now.$
translation:
喂，{PLAYER}！
我是佩里！\p现在可没有任何家伙
能比得上我的{STR_VAR_3}！$

label: MatchCall_HNS_Parry_General3
source:
Hey, {PLAYER}!
It's PARRY!\pYeah, we KO'd a wild
{STR_VAR_3}!\pThat was OK, but I wanted
to get it…$
translation:
喂，{PLAYER}！
我是佩里！\p哈哈，我们击倒了一只野生的
{STR_VAR_3}！\p虽然挺过瘾的，但我本来
还挺想收服它的......$

label: MatchCall_HNS_Parry_Battle
source: Hey, {PLAYER}!\nIt's PARRY!\pYou'll battle with me\nagain, right?$
translation:
喂，{PLAYER}！
我是佩里！\p你会再跟我
对战的，对吧？$

label: MatchCall_HNS_Erin_General1
source:
Hi, {PLAYER}!
It's ERIN!\pAre you raising your
POKéMON?\pMy {STR_VAR_3} is looking
good!$
translation:
嗨，{PLAYER}！
我是艾琳！\p你有好好培育你的
宝可梦吗？\p我的{STR_VAR_3}状态
超级棒哦！$

label: MatchCall_HNS_Erin_General2
source: Hi, {PLAYER}!\nIt's ERIN!\pMy {STR_VAR_3} is much\nstronger than before!$
translation:
嗨，{PLAYER}！
我是艾琳！\p我的{STR_VAR_3}比以前
强多啦！$

label: MatchCall_HNS_Erin_General3
source:
Hi, {PLAYER}!
It's ERIN!\pAnd, and… I just battled
and beat {STR_VAR_3}!\pI've raised my POKéMON
properly!$
translation:
嗨，{PLAYER}！
我是艾琳！\p还有还有......我刚才对战打倒了
{STR_VAR_3}哦！\p看来我有好好
培育我的宝可梦！$

label: MatchCall_HNS_Erin_Battle
source:
Hi, {PLAYER}!
It's ERIN!\pI'm working hard to raise
my POKéMON!\pCome back for another
battle!$
translation:
嗨，{PLAYER}！
我是艾琳！\p我正在努力培育我的宝可梦呢！\p快来再跟我
对战一场吧！$

label: MatchCall_HNS_Jack_General1
source:
Hey, {PLAYER}!
It's JACK!\pHow are your POKéMON
doing?\pMy {STR_VAR_3} is so
curious, it's a problem.\pMaybe it's like me…$
translation:
喂，{PLAYER}！
我是杰克！\p你的宝可梦最近怎么样？\p我的{STR_VAR_3}好奇心太强了，
真是个伤脑筋的问题。\p也许它随了我吧......$

label: MatchCall_HNS_Jack_General2
source:
Hey, {PLAYER}!
It's JACK!\pMy {STR_VAR_3}'s
intelligence keeps rising.\pIt might be smarter
than yours!$
translation:
喂，{PLAYER}！
我是杰克！\p我的{STR_VAR_3}脑筋
越来越灵活了。\p说不定比你的宝可梦
还要聪明呢！$

label: MatchCall_HNS_Jack_General3
source:
Hey, {PLAYER}!
It's JACK!\pDid you know?\pWhen it's raining, THUNDER
is sure to strike.\pMy friend heard some great
tips. When he tells me,\lI'll call right away and\ltell you.$
translation:
喂，{PLAYER}！
我是杰克！\p你知道吗？\p在下雨天的时候，"打雷"
是一定会击中目标的。\p我朋友打听到了很多厉害的小窍门。
只要他告诉我，\l我就会立刻打电话\l转告你的。$

label: MatchCall_HNS_Jack_Battle
source: Hey, {PLAYER}!\nIt's JACK!\pI was waiting for you.\nLet's battle!$
translation:
喂，{PLAYER}！
我是杰克！\p我一直等着你呢。
来对战吧！$

label: MatchCall_HNS_Beverly_General1
source:
Hello, {PLAYER}!
It's BEVERLY!\pKeeping your POKéMON
happy?\pMy {STR_VAR_3} is healthy.
It eats a lot every day.$
translation:
你好呀，{PLAYER}！
我是贝弗莉！\p你的宝可梦每天都开开心心的吗？\p我的{STR_VAR_3}可健康了，
每天都吃得特别多呢。$

label: MatchCall_HNS_Beverly_General2
source: Hello, {PLAYER}!\nIt's BEVERLY!\pI fancied up my\n{STR_VAR_3} and made it\leven cuter than before!$
translation:
你好呀，{PLAYER}！
我是贝弗莉！\p我给我的{STR_VAR_3}精心打扮了一番，
现在它比以前\l还要可爱了呢！$

label: MatchCall_HNS_Beverly_General3
source:
Hello, {PLAYER}!
It's BEVERLY!\pAre your POKéMON in prime
form?\pLet's chat about POKéMON
again.$
translation:
你好呀，{PLAYER}！
我是贝弗莉！\p你的宝可梦都保持在最佳状态吗？\p下次再一起聊聊
宝可梦的话题吧。$

label: MatchCall_HNS_Beverly_FoundItem
source:
Hello, {PLAYER}!
It's BEVERLY!\pMy husband got some
NUGGETS.\pIf you'd like, you could
have one as thanks for\lhelping me out.\pI'll be at NATIONAL PARK.
Please come see me when\lyou can.$
translation:
你好呀，{PLAYER}！
我是贝弗莉！\p我先生弄到了一些金珠。\p如果你想要的话，可以拿一颗，
当作平时陪我解闷的谢礼。\p我就在自然公园。
有空的时候请顺便\l过来看看我呀。$

label: MatchCall_HNS_Beverly_Battle
source: Hello, {PLAYER}!\nIt's BEVERLY!\pI was waiting for you.\nLet's battle!$
translation:
你好呀，{PLAYER}！
我是贝弗莉！\p我一直在等着你呢。
来对战吧！$

label: MatchCall_HNS_Huey_General1
source: Yo, {PLAYER}!\nIt's HUEY!\pHow's it going?$
translation: 哟，{PLAYER}！\n我是休伊！\p最近怎么样？$

label: MatchCall_HNS_Huey_General2
source:
Yo, {PLAYER}!
It's HUEY!\pWe have to battle again
sometime.\pYou can bet I'm going to
keep challenging you till\lI win.$
translation: 哟，{PLAYER}！\n我是休伊！\p咱们什么时候再来对战一场吧。\p我跟你说，\n在赢过你之前，\l我是绝对不会罢休的！$

label: MatchCall_HNS_Huey_Battle
source: Yo, {PLAYER}!\nIt's HUEY!\pI was waiting for you.\nLet's battle!$
translation: 哟，{PLAYER}！\n我是休伊！\p我正等着你呢。\n来对战吧！$

label: MatchCall_HNS_Gaven_General1
source:
Hey, {PLAYER}!
It's GAVEN!\pHow are your POKéMON
doing?\pMy {STR_VAR_3}'s doing as
great as ever.\pLet's keep at it and
become POKéMON CHAMPS!$
translation: 喂，{PLAYER}！\n我是加文！\p你的宝可梦状态如何？\p我的{STR_VAR_3}还是一如既往地精神。\p我们一起努力，\n成为宝可梦冠军吧！$

label: MatchCall_HNS_Gaven_General2
source:
Hey, {PLAYER}!
It's GAVEN!\pMy {STR_VAR_3} might be
greater than I imagined.\pI doubt I'll see a
POKéMON that's better\lthan mine.$
translation: 喂，{PLAYER}！\n我是加文！\p我的{STR_VAR_3}可能比我想象的还要优秀。\p估计很难再碰上\n比我的宝可梦更出色的家伙了吧。$

label: MatchCall_HNS_Gaven_General3
source: Hey, {PLAYER}!\nIt's GAVEN!\pI obsess over how to\nbeat you.$
translation: 喂，{PLAYER}！\n我是加文！\p我脑子里全都在琢磨\n到底该怎么赢过你。$

label: MatchCall_HNS_Gaven_Battle
source: Hey, {PLAYER}!\nIt's GAVEN!\pI was waiting for you.\nLet's battle!$
translation: 喂，{PLAYER}！\n我是加文！\p我等你很久了。\n来对战吧！$

label: MatchCall_HNS_Beth_General1
source:
Hi, {PLAYER}!
It's BETH!\pAre you the kind of person
who goes to POKéMON\lCENTERS often?\pI go every day. Watching
out for the health of your\lPOKéMON is a basic part of\lbeing a POKéMON trainer.$
translation: 你好，{PLAYER}！\n我是贝丝！\p你是那种经常去宝可梦中心的类型吗？\p我可是每天都去哦。\n时刻关注宝可梦的健康，\l可是宝可梦训练家的基本功呢。$

label: MatchCall_HNS_Beth_General2
source:
Hi, {PLAYER}!
It's BETH!\pDo you remember my sweet
{STR_VAR_3}?\p{STR_VAR_3} runs very
fast.\pIt's exhilarating to ride
on its back when it really\lgets going.$
translation: 你好，{PLAYER}！\n我是贝丝！\p你还记得我那可爱的{STR_VAR_3}吗？\p{STR_VAR_3}跑得非常快哦。\p当它全速狂奔时，\n骑在它背上的感觉真是太痛快了。$

label: MatchCall_HNS_Beth_General3
source: Hi, {PLAYER}!\nIt's BETH!\pLet's battle again\nsometime!$
translation: 你好，{PLAYER}！\n我是贝丝！\p什么时候再来对战一场吧！$

label: MatchCall_HNS_Beth_Battle
source: Hi, {PLAYER}!\nIt's BETH!\pI was waiting for you.\nLet's battle!$
translation: 你好，{PLAYER}！\n我是贝丝！\p我一直都在等你呢。\n来对战吧！$

label: MatchCall_HNS_Jose_General1
source:
Hey, {PLAYER}!
It's JOSE!\pAre your POKéMON still
cooking?\pMy {STR_VAR_3} has too
much energy.\pOnce it takes off, it
won't come back for a\lwhile.$
translation: 喂，{PLAYER}！\n我是何塞！\p你的宝可梦还是那么充满干劲吗？\p我的{STR_VAR_3}精力实在太旺盛了。\p只要一飞出去，\n一时半会儿都回不来呢。$

label: MatchCall_HNS_Jose_General2
source:
Hey, {PLAYER}!
It's JOSE!\pHey listen, my
{STR_VAR_3}'s stick has\lthis really delicious\laroma.\pThat aroma gets my
appetite going!$
translation: 喂，{PLAYER}！\n我是何塞！\p跟你说哦，我那只{STR_VAR_3}拿着的大葱，\l闻起来可香了。\p那香味简直勾得我食欲大开！$

label: MatchCall_HNS_Jose_General3
source:
Hey, {PLAYER}!
It's JOSE!\pA while ago, my FARFETCH'D
KO'd this {STR_VAR_3}.\pYou should have seen
FARFETCH'D wield that\lstick.\pAmazing stuff!$
translation: 喂，{PLAYER}！\n我是何塞！\p不久前，我的大葱鸭打倒了一只{STR_VAR_3}。\p你真该看看大葱鸭挥舞大葱的样子。\p真是帅呆了！$

label: MatchCall_HNS_Jose_FoundItem
source:
Hey, {PLAYER}!
It's JOSE!\pMy FARFETCH'D had
something pretty in its\lbeak.\pLike I promised, you can
have it.\pCatch up to me on
ROUTE 27, and I'll let\lyou have it.$
translation: 喂，{PLAYER}！\n我是何塞！\p我的大葱鸭嘴里叼着个很漂亮的东西。\p就像之前答应好的，这个就送给你吧。\p快来27号道路找我，\n我当面交给你。$

label: MatchCall_HNS_Jose_Battle
source: Hey, {PLAYER}!\nIt's JOSE!\pI was waiting for you.\nLet's battle!$
translation: 喂，{PLAYER}！\n我是何塞！\p我等你很久了。\n来对战吧！$

label: MatchCall_HNS_Reena_General1
source:
Hello, {PLAYER}.
It's REENA.\pHey, how are your POKéMON
doing?\pWhat? Great? I see…\pWhat? My POKéMON?\pOf course they're doing
great! What kind of a\lquestion is that?$
translation: 你好啊，{PLAYER}。\n我是莉娜。\p喂，你的宝可梦状态如何？\p什么？很好？这样啊......\p什么？问我的宝可梦？\p那当然是好得不得了啊！\n这是什么傻问题？$

label: MatchCall_HNS_Reena_General2
source:
Hello, {PLAYER}.
It's REENA.\pListen, dear…\pDo you recall my
{STR_VAR_3}?\pYes, exactly. That lovely
{STR_VAR_3}.\pWouldn't you agree it's a
perfect match for me?$
translation: 你好啊，{PLAYER}。\n我是莉娜。\p我说你啊......\p还记得我的{STR_VAR_3}吗？\p没错，就是它。那只可爱的{STR_VAR_3}。\p你不觉得它和我简直是绝配吗？$

label: MatchCall_HNS_Reena_General3
source: Hello, {PLAYER}.\nIt's REENA.\pDon't be too proud just\nbecause you happened to\lbeat me…\pIt was a fluke!$
translation: 你好啊，{PLAYER}。\n我是莉娜。\p可别因为侥幸赢了我一次\n就得意忘形哦......\p那纯粹只是侥幸罢了！$

label: MatchCall_HNS_Reena_Battle
source: Hello, {PLAYER}.\nIt's REENA.\pI was waiting for you.\nLet's battle!$
translation: 你好啊，{PLAYER}。\n我是莉娜。\p我一直在等你呢。\n来对战吧！$

label: MatchCall_HNS_Alex_General1
source:
Hey, {PLAYER}!
It's ALEX!\pMy regal POKéMON
grow sharper by the day.\p{STR_VAR_3} is getting
really tough!$
translation: 喂，{PLAYER}！\n我是亚历克斯！\p我那些高贵的宝可梦\n一天比一天更精悍了。\p{STR_VAR_3}变得越来越强悍了！$

label: MatchCall_HNS_Alex_General2
source: Hey, {PLAYER}!\pI heard other regions have\nkings and queens. Why\ldoesn't KANTO have\pany royalty?$
translation: 喂，{PLAYER}！\p我听说其他地区都有国王和王后。\n为什么关都地区\p就没有王室呢？$

label: MatchCall_HNS_Alex_Battle
source: Hey, {PLAYER}!\nIt's ALEX!\pMy regal POKéMON are ready\nfor a rematch! Come to ROUTE 13!$
translation: 喂，{PLAYER}！\n我是亚历克斯！\p我高贵的宝可梦们已经准备好再次对战了！\n快来13号道路吧！$

label: MatchCall_HNS_Riley_General1
source:
Yo, {PLAYER}!
RILEY here.\pCYCLING ROAD is the best.
Nothing beats the wind\lin your face.\p{STR_VAR_3} loves the
speed too!$
translation: 哟，{PLAYER}！\n我是莱利。\p单车道真是太棒了。\n没有什么比迎风疾驰更痛快的事了。\p{STR_VAR_3}也超喜欢这种风驰电掣的感觉！$

label: MatchCall_HNS_Riley_General2
source: Yo, {PLAYER}!\pYou JOHTO kids aren't bad.\nMaybe I misjudged you.\pDon't let it go to your\nhead though!$
translation: 哟，{PLAYER}！\p你们城都来的小鬼还挺有两下子的嘛。\n看来之前是我小瞧你了。\p不过，可别因此就翘尾巴啊！$

label: MatchCall_HNS_Riley_Battle
source: Yo, {PLAYER}!\nRILEY here.\pGet down to CYCLING ROAD!\nI want a rematch!$
translation: 哟，{PLAYER}！\n我是莱利。\p快到自行车道来！\n我想和你再战一场！$

label: MatchCall_HNS_Trevor_General1
source:
Hi, {PLAYER}!
It's TREVOR.\pDid you know POKéMON get
friendlier when you train\lin memorable places?\p{STR_VAR_3} seems to
like it here.$
translation:
你好呀，{PLAYER}！
我是特雷弗。\p你知道吗？如果在充满回忆的
地方培育宝可梦，\l它会变得更容易和你亲近哦！\p我的{STR_VAR_3}好像
就很喜欢这里呢。$

label: MatchCall_HNS_Trevor_General2
source: Hi, {PLAYER}!\pSome POKéMON moves\nare stronger when your\pPOKéMON feels more\nfriendly toward you!$
translation: 你好呀，{PLAYER}！\p有的宝可梦招式，在宝可梦\n和你越亲密的时候，\p发挥出的威力就越强哦！$

label: MatchCall_HNS_Trevor_Battle
source: Hi, {PLAYER}!\nIt's TREVOR.\pMy friends are ready for battle!\nCome see on ROUTE 14!$
translation: 你好呀，{PLAYER}！\n我是特雷弗。\p我的伙伴们已经准备好对战了！\n快来14号道路找我吧！$

label: MatchCall_HNS_Kyle_General1
source: Who is this?!\nI called you?\pThis is KYLE. Don't forget!$
translation: 谁啊？！\n......咦，是我打过去的？\p我是凯尔啦。可别给忘了！$

label: MatchCall_HNS_Kyle_General2
source: Hey, {PLAYER}!\pDo you remember?\nThe secrets of fishing?$
translation: 喂，{PLAYER}！\p你还记得吗？\n关于钓鱼的秘诀！$

label: MatchCall_HNS_Kyle_Battle
source:
Hey, {PLAYER}!
KYLE here.\pI've reeled in some tough
new POKéMON!\pCome to ROUTE 12 for
a battle!$
translation:
喂，{PLAYER}！
我是凯尔。\p我钓上来几只超厉害的
新宝可梦！\p快来12号道路和
我切磋一下！$

label: MatchCall_HNS_Carter_General1
source:
Hi there, {PLAYER}!
CARTER here.\pI've been collecting rare
starter POKéMON.\pMy {STR_VAR_3} is my
newest pride and joy!$
translation:
你好啊，{PLAYER}！
我是卡特。\p我最近一直在收集稀有的
最初的伙伴宝可梦呢。\p我的{STR_VAR_3}可是
我最新的骄傲哦！$

label: MatchCall_HNS_Carter_General2
source: Hi, {PLAYER}!\pDid you know there are\nstarter POKéMON from many\ldifferent regions?\pI want to collect them\nall!$
translation: 你好啊，{PLAYER}！\p你知道各个不同地区\n都有最初的伙伴宝可梦吗？\p我真想把它们\n全部集齐啊！$

label: MatchCall_HNS_Carter_Battle
source: Hi, {PLAYER}!\nCARTER here.\pI have new starters to\nshow off! Come to\lROUTE 14!$
translation: 你好啊，{PLAYER}！\n我是卡特。\p我有了新的最初伙伴想炫耀一下！\n快来14号道路吧！$

label: MatchCall_HNS_Hillary_General1
source: Hello, {PLAYER}.\nIt's TEACHER HILLARY.\pWhy aren't you in school?$
translation: 你好，{PLAYER}。\n我是希拉里老师。\p你怎么没去上学呢？$

label: MatchCall_HNS_Hillary_General2
source: Hello, {PLAYER}.\pAre you playing games\ninstead of doing homework?$
translation: 你好，{PLAYER}。\p你该不会是不做作业，\n光顾着玩游戏吧？$

label: MatchCall_HNS_Hillary_Battle
source: Hello, {PLAYER}.\nIt's HILLARY.\pMy POKéMON have graduated\nto the next level!\pCome test us on ROUTE 15!$
translation: 你好，{PLAYER}。\n我是希拉里。\p我的宝可梦们已经顺利\n晋级到下一个水平了！\p快来15号道路测验一下我们吧！$

label: MatchCall_HNS_Rob_General1
source: Hey, {PLAYER}!\nROB here!\pVIRIDIAN FOREST is full\nof cool bugs!$
translation: 喂，{PLAYER}！\n我是罗伯！\p常青森林里到处都是\n帅气的虫宝可梦呢！$

label: MatchCall_HNS_Rob_General2
source: Hey, {PLAYER}!\pI saw a BUG TYPE GYM\nLEADER in VIRIDIAN FOREST!$
translation: 喂，{PLAYER}！\p我在常青森林里看到了\n精通虫属性的道馆馆主哦！$

label: MatchCall_HNS_Rob_Battle
source:
Hey, {PLAYER}!
ROB here!\pMy bug team is stronger
than ever!\pCome to ROUTE 2 for a
rematch!$
translation: 喂，{PLAYER}！\n我是罗伯！\p我的虫宝可梦队伍比以前更强了！\p快来2号道路，\n我们再比一场！$

label: MatchCall_HNS_Nicole_General1
source:
Hi, {PLAYER}!
It's NICOLE!\pThe waves are great today!
My POKéMON love swimming\lin the open sea.\p{STR_VAR_3} is getting
so fast!$
translation:
嗨，{PLAYER}！
我是妮可！\p今天的海浪棒极了！
我的宝可梦们都很喜欢在\l宽广的大海里游泳呢。\p{STR_VAR_3}游得
越来越快了！$

label: MatchCall_HNS_Nicole_General2
source: Hi, {PLAYER}!\pSwimming with POKéMON is\nthe best exercise.$
translation: 嗨，{PLAYER}！\p和宝可梦一起游泳\n是最好的锻炼方式啦。$

label: MatchCall_HNS_Nicole_Battle
source: Hi, {PLAYER}!\nIt's NICOLE!\pMy water POKéMON are\nraring to battle!\pCome to ROUTE 20!$
translation: 嗨，{PLAYER}！\n我是妮可！\p我的水属性宝可梦们\n早就跃跃欲试想对战了！\p快来20号水路吧！$

label: MatchCall_HNS_Billy_General1
source:
Hey, {PLAYER}!
It's BILLY.\pI've been studying battle
strategies in class.\p{STR_VAR_3} and I have
been practicing them!$
translation: 喂，{PLAYER}！\n我是比利。\p我一直在课上认真钻研对战战术呢。\p我和{STR_VAR_3}最近\n一直在练习这些战术哦！$

label: MatchCall_HNS_Billy_General2
source: Hey, {PLAYER}!\pTests are coming up, but\nI'd rather be battling.\pBook smarts aren't\neverything, right?$
translation: 喂，{PLAYER}！\p马上就要考试了，\n但我现在只想去对战。\p光会死读书可不行，对吧？$

label: MatchCall_HNS_Billy_Battle
source: Hey, {PLAYER}!\nIt's BILLY.\pI learned some new tricks!\nCome to ROUTE 15!$
translation: 喂，{PLAYER}！\n我是比利。\p我又学到了几招新绝活！\n快来15号道路吧！$

label: MatchCall_HNS_Kenny_General1
source: Hey there, {PLAYER}!\nKENNY here.\pWere all mountains really\nshaped by oceans and rivers?$
translation: 嗨，{PLAYER}！\n我是肯尼。\p所有的山脉真的都是由大海\n和河流塑造出来的吗？$

label: MatchCall_HNS_Kenny_Battle
source:
Hey there, {PLAYER}!
KENNY here.\pI've trained hard in the
mountains!\pCome to ROUTE 13 for
a battle!$
translation: 嗨，{PLAYER}！\n我是肯尼。\p我已经在山里刻苦修行过了！\p快来13号道路\n痛痛快快对战一场吧！$

label: MatchCall_HNS_Joel_General1
source:
Hey, {PLAYER}!
JOEL here.\pI've been working on
looking cool in battle.\p{STR_VAR_3} has some
flashy new moves!$
translation:
喂，{PLAYER}！
我是乔尔。\p我最近一直在琢磨
怎么在对战中显得更帅气呢。\p{STR_VAR_3}学会了
几个非常帅气的新招式哦！$

label: MatchCall_HNS_Joel_General2
source: Hey, {PLAYER}!\pJOEL here.\pThere was an accident on\nCYCLING ROAD.\pBeing safe is the coolest thing\nyou can be.$
translation: 喂，{PLAYER}！\p我是乔尔。\p单车道上刚才发生了一起事故。\p平平安安才是最帅气的事啊。$

label: MatchCall_HNS_Joel_Battle
source: Hey, {PLAYER}!\nJOEL here.\pI look AND fight cool now!\nCome to CYCLING ROAD!$
translation: 喂，{PLAYER}！\n我是乔尔。\p我现在不仅看着帅，对战也很帅！\n快来单车道吧！$

label: MatchCall_HNS_Charles_General1
source: Hey, {PLAYER}!\nCHARLES here.\pI was something of a\nheartbreaker in UNOVA.\pNow I'm a highway star!$
translation: 喂，{PLAYER}！\n我是查尔斯。\p我在合众可是被称为\n'心碎狂客'的男人呢。\p现在的我则是公路之星！$

label: MatchCall_HNS_Charles_General2
source: Hey, {PLAYER}!\pCYCLING ROAD at night is\nsomething else.\pThe streetlights and the\nwind… it's freedom!$
translation: 喂，{PLAYER}！\p夜晚的单车道\n感觉真是别有一番风味啊。\p路灯的光影与拂面的夜风......\n这就是自由啊！$

label: MatchCall_HNS_Charles_Battle
source: Hey, {PLAYER}!\nCHARLES here.\pThe highway stars want\nrevenge! Come to\lCYCLING ROAD!$
translation: 喂，{PLAYER}！\n我是查尔斯。\p公路之星们想要找你雪耻！\n快来单车道吧！$

label: MoveRelearner_Text_WouldLearnNewMoves
source: Hi, I'm the Move Relearner.\nWould you like to learn new moves?$
translation: 你好，我是招式回忆狂。\n想让宝可梦回忆起招式吗？$

label: MoveRelearner_Text_CantTeachMoveToEgg
source: Sorry…\nBut an Egg can't learn moves.$
translation: 抱歉......\n但是蛋是没法学会招式的。$

label: MoveRelearner_Text_MoveLWR
source: 招式$
translation: 招式$

label: MoveTutor_Text_HeadbuttTeach
source: What am I doing?\pI'm shaking trees using HEADBUTT.\pDo you think your POKéMON will\nwant to HEADBUTT, too?\pI can teach one the move HEADBUTT\nif you'd like. It's fun!$
translation: 问我在干什么？\p我正在用头锤撞树呢。\p你觉得你的宝可梦\n也想试试头锤吗？\p如果你愿意的话，我可以把"头锤"\n传授给它。可好玩了！$

label: MoveTutor_Text_HeadbuttWhichMon
source: Ehehe, sure thing! It'd be great if\nthe POKéMON looked like me.$
translation: 嘿嘿，好嘞！要是那只宝可梦\n长得像我那就更棒了。$

label: MoveTutor_Text_HeadbuttDeclined
source: You don't need to be shy about it.\nLet's butt heads!$
translation: 不用那么害羞嘛。\n一起来用头撞吧！$

label: MoveTutor_Text_HeadbuttTaught
source: Rattle trees with HEADBUTT.\nSometimes, sleeping POKéMON fall out.$
translation: 用头锤摇晃树木吧。\n有时候睡着的宝可梦会掉下来哦。$

label: gControlsGuide_Text_Intro
source: The various buttons will be explained in\nthe order of their importance.$
translation: 接下来将按照重要程度\n依次说明各个按键的功能。$

label: gControlsGuide_Text_DPad
source: Moves the main character.\nAlso used to choose various data\nheadings.$
translation: 用于控制主角移动。\n也可以用来选择各项数据\n与菜单选项。$

label: gControlsGuide_Text_AButton
source: Used to confirm a choice, check\nthings, chat, and scroll text.$
translation: 用于确认选择、调查物品、\n对话以及翻页文本。$

label: gControlsGuide_Text_BButton
source: Used to exit, cancel a choice,\nand cancel a mode.$
translation: 用于退出、取消选择\n以及取消当前模式。$

label: gControlsGuide_Text_StartButton
source: Press this button to open the\nMENU.$
translation: 按下此键可以打开\n菜单。$

label: gControlsGuide_Text_SelectButton
source: Used to shift items and to use\na registered item.$
translation: 用于调换道具位置，\n以及使用登记的快捷道具。$

label: gControlsGuide_Text_LRButtons
source: If you need help playing the\ngame, or on how to do things,\npress the L or R Button.$
translation: 在游戏中遇到疑问，\n或想了解操作方法时，\n请按下L键或R键。$

label: gOakSpeech_Text_AskPlayerGender
source: Now tell me. Are you a boy?\nOr are you a girl?$
translation: 那么告诉我。你是男孩子？\n还是女孩子呢？$

label: gPikachuIntro_Text_Page1
source:
In the world which you are about to
enter, you will embark on a grand
adventure with you as the hero.

Speak to people and check things
wherever you go, be it towns, roads,
or caves. Gather information and
hints from every source.$
translation:
在你即将踏入的这个世界里，
你将作为主角展开一场宏大的冒险。

不论是在城镇、道路还是洞穴，
多去和人交谈，调查周围的事物吧。
从各处收集有用的情报和线索。$

label: gPikachuIntro_Text_Page2
source:
New paths will open to you by helping
people in need, overcoming challenges,
and solving mysteries.

At times, you will be challenged by
others and attacked by wild creatures.
Be brave and keep pushing on.$
translation:
通过帮助遇到困难的人、克服难关，
以及解开重重谜团，新的道路将为你敞开。

有时你会被他人发起挑战，
也会遭到野生宝可梦的袭击。
拿出勇气，勇往直前吧！$

label: gPikachuIntro_Text_Page3
source:
Through your adventure, we hope
that you will interact with all sorts
of people and achieve personal growth.
That is our biggest objective.

Press the A Button, and let your
adventure begin!$
translation:
我们希望你在冒险的过程中，
能与各种各样的人交流并获得成长。
这就是我们最大的心愿。

按下A键，开启你的冒险之旅吧！$

label: gOakSpeech_Text_WelcomeToTheWorld
source: Hello, there!\nGlad to meet you!\pWelcome to the world of POKéMON!\pMy name is OAK.\pPeople affectionately refer to me\nas the POKéMON PROFESSOR.\p$
translation: 初次见面！\n很高兴见到你！\p欢迎来到宝可梦的世界！\p我叫大木。\p大家都亲切地称呼我\n为宝可梦博士。\p$

label: gOakSpeech_Text_ThisWorld
source: This world…$
translation: 在这个世界上......$

label: gOakSpeech_Text_IsInhabitedFarAndWide
source: …is inhabited far and wide by\ncreatures called POKéMON.\p$
translation: ......到处都栖息着\n名为"宝可梦"的生物。\p$

label: gOakSpeech_Text_IStudyPokemon
source: For some people, POKéMON are pets.\nOthers use them for battling.\pAs for myself…\pI study POKéMON as a profession.\p$
translation: 有人把宝可梦当作宠物，\n也有人让他们来进行对战。\p至于我嘛......\p则是把研究宝可梦作为毕生的事业。\p$

label: gOakSpeech_Text_TellMeALittleAboutYourself
source: But first, tell me a little about\nyourself.\p$
translation: 不过在此之前，\n先来跟我说说你自己的事吧。\p$

label: gOakSpeech_Text_YourNameWhatIsIt
source: Let's begin with your name.\nWhat is it?\p$
translation: 首先是你的名字，\n你叫什么名字呢？\p$

label: gOakSpeech_Text_SoYourNameIsPlayer
source: Right…\nSo your name is {PLAYER}.$
translation: 好的......\n原来你叫{PLAYER}啊。$

label: gOakSpeech_Text_WhatWasHisName
source: This is my grandson.\pHe's been your rival since you both\nwere babies.\p…Erm, what was his name now?$
translation: 这是我的孙子。\p从你们还是婴儿的时候起，\n他就一直是你的劲敌。\p......呃，他叫什么名字来着？$

label: gOakSpeech_Text_YourRivalsNameWhatWasIt
source: Your rival's name, what was it now?$
translation: 你的劲敌叫什么名字来着？$

label: gOakSpeech_Text_ConfirmRivalName
source: …Er, was it {RIVAL}?$
translation: ......呃，是叫{RIVAL}吗？$

label: gOakSpeech_Text_RememberRivalsName
source: That's right! I remember now!\nHis name is {RIVAL}!\p$
translation: 对啦！我想起来了！\n他的名字叫{RIVAL}！\p$

label: gOakSpeech_Text_LetsGo
source: {PLAYER}!\pYour very own POKéMON legend is\nabout to unfold!\pA world of dreams and adventures\nwith POKéMON awaits! Let's go!$
translation: {PLAYER}！\p属于你自己的宝可梦传奇\n即将拉开序幕！\p与宝可梦相伴、充满梦想与冒险的\n世界正在等待着你！出发吧！$

label: gText_ObtainedTheItem
source: Obtained the {STR_VAR_2}!$
translation: 获得了{STR_VAR_2}！$

label: gText_ObtainedTheItems
source: Obtained {STR_VAR_1} {STR_VAR_2}!$
translation: 获得了{STR_VAR_1}个{STR_VAR_2}！$

label: gText_PkmnTransferredLanettesPCBoxFull
source: BOX “{STR_VAR_3}” on\n
translation: 盒子"{STR_VAR_3}"(\n

label: gText_PkmnTransferredLanettesPCBoxFull
source: BILL'S PC was full.\p
translation: 正辉的电脑)已经满了。\p

label: gText_PkmnTransferredLanettesPCBoxFull
source: LANETTE'S PC was full.\p
translation: 真由美的电脑)已经满了。\p

label: gText_PkmnTransferredLanettesPCBoxFull
source: {STR_VAR_2} was transferred to\nBOX “{STR_VAR_1}.”$
translation: {STR_VAR_2}被传送到了\n盒子"{STR_VAR_1}"。$

label: gText_NoticesGoldCard
source:
Th-that card…
Could it be… The GOLD CARD?!\pOh, the gold color is brilliant!
The four stars seem to sparkle!\pI've seen several TRAINERS with
a SILVER CARD before, but, {PLAYER},\lyou're the first TRAINER I've ever\lseen with a GOLD CARD!\pOkay, {PLAYER}, please allow me
the honor of resting your POKéMON!$
translation:
那、那是......
难道是......金色卡片？！\p哇，金色的光芒好耀眼！
上面的4颗星就像在闪闪发亮！\p我以前见过几位拥有银色卡片的
训练家，不过，{PLAYER}，\l拥有金色卡片的训练家，\l你还是我见到的第一位！\p好，{PLAYER}，请务必让我
为你的宝可梦恢复体力！$

label: gText_YouWantTheUsual
source: I'm delighted to see you, {PLAYER}!\nYou want the usual, am I right?$
translation: 见到你真高兴，{PLAYER}！\n还是老规矩，对吧？$

label: gText_PkmnCenterChallenge_NoVisitsLeft
source: Sorry, but you are playing with\nthe POKéCENTER challenge!\pGood luck!{PAUSE_UNTIL_PRESS}$
translation: 抱歉，你正在进行\n宝可梦中心挑战！\p祝你好运！{PAUSE_UNTIL_PRESS}$

label: gBirchDexRatingText_LessThan110
source: You've finally reached\nthe 100-kind mark.\pThis is an impressive POKéDEX!$
translation: 你终于突破了100种的大关。\p这本图鉴真是令人叹为观止！$

label: gBirchDexRatingText_LessThan160
source: On occasion, some POKéMON appear\nin large numbers like outbreaks.\pDon't miss opportunities like\nthose.$
translation: 有时候，某些宝可梦会成群地\n大量出现。\p可千万不要错失这样的机会哦。$

label: PokedexRating_Text_HowIsPokedexComingAlong
source: OAK: Good to see you!\nHow is your POKéDEX coming along?\pHere, let me take a look.$
translation: 大木：见到你真高兴！\n图鉴收集得怎么样了？\p来，让我看一看。$

label: PokedexRating_Text_SeenXOwnedY
source: The amount of progress you've made\non your POKéDEX is:\p{STR_VAR_1} POKéMON seen and\n{STR_VAR_2} POKéMON owned.\p{FONT_NORMAL}PROF. OAK's rating:$
translation: 目前图鉴的收集进度如下：\p遇见的宝可梦：{STR_VAR_1}只，\n收服的宝可梦：{STR_VAR_2}只。\p{FONT_NORMAL}大木博士的评价：$

label: PokedexRating_Text_LessThan10
source: You still have lots to do.\pGo into every patch of grass you\nsee and look for POKéMON!$
translation: 你还有很长的路要走呢。\p看到草丛就钻进去找找宝可梦吧！$

label: PokedexRating_Text_LessThan20
source: It looks as if you're getting on\nthe right track!\pI've given one of my AIDES a FLASH\nHM. Make sure you go get it!$
translation: 看起来你已经步入正轨了！\p我已经把秘传学习器"闪光"交给助手了。\n一定要记得去拿哦！$

label: PokedexRating_Text_LessThan30
source: Your POKéDEX could use a bit more\nvolume still!\pTry to catch other species of\nPOKéMON!$
translation: 你的宝可梦图鉴还需要再充实一些！\p试着去收服更多不同种类的宝可梦吧！$

label: PokedexRating_Text_LessThan40
source: Good, it's apparent that you're\ntrying hard!\pI've given one of my AIDES an\nITEMFINDER. Be sure to collect it!$
translation: 很好，看得出你非常努力！\p我已经把"探宝器"交给了助手。\n一定要记得去领哦！$

label: PokedexRating_Text_LessThan50
source: Your POKéDEX is coming along quite\nwell!\pI've given one of my AIDES an\nAMULET COIN. Be sure to get it!$
translation: 你的图鉴收集得相当顺利嘛！\p我已经把"护符金币"交给了助手。\n一定要记得去拿！$

label: PokedexRating_Text_LessThan60
source: Ah, you've finally topped 50\nspecies!\pI've given one of my AIDES an EXP.\nSHARE. Be sure to go get it!$
translation: 啊，你终于突破50种了！\p我已经把"学习装置"交给了助手。\n一定要记得去领哦！$

label: PokedexRating_Text_LessThan70
source: Hoho! This is turning into quite the\nrespectable POKéDEX!$
translation: 嗬嗬！这本图鉴变得越来越有模有样了！$

label: PokedexRating_Text_LessThan80
source: Very good!\pI think you'll collect even more\nPOKéMON by going fishing!$
translation: 非常好！\p我想如果你去钓鱼的话，\n一定能收集到更多宝可梦的！$

label: PokedexRating_Text_LessThan90
source: Wonderful! Let me guess… You\nlike to collect things, don't you?$
translation: 太棒了！让我猜猜......\n你平时就很喜欢收集东西，对吧？$

label: PokedexRating_Text_LessThan100
source: I'm impressed!\nIt must have been difficult to do!$
translation: 真令人佩服！\n这一定相当不容易吧！$

label: PokedexRating_Text_LessThan110
source: You've finally hit 100 species!\nI can't believe how good you are!$
translation: 终于突破100种了！\n没想到你居然这么厉害！$

label: PokedexRating_Text_LessThan120
source: You even have the evolved forms\nof POKéMON! Super!$
translation: 连宝可梦的进化形都收集到了！\n太棒了！$

label: PokedexRating_Text_LessThan130
source: Excellent! Trade with friends to\nget some more!$
translation: 干得漂亮！和朋友通信交换，\n收集更多的宝可梦吧！$

label: PokedexRating_Text_LessThan140
source: Outstanding!\nYou've become a real pro at this!$
translation: 太出色了！\n你已经是个货真价实的行家了！$

label: PokedexRating_Text_LessThan150
source: I have nothing left to say!\nYou're the POKéMON PROFESSOR now!$
translation: 我真是无话可说了！\n现在的你简直就是宝可梦博士了！$

label: PokedexRating_Text_Complete
source: Your POKéDEX is entirely complete!\nCongratulations!!$
translation: 你的宝可梦图鉴彻底完成了！\n恭喜你！！$

label: PokedexRating_Text_NationalDexSeenXOwnedY
source: And your NATIONAL POKéDEX is:\p{STR_VAR_1} POKéMON seen and\n{STR_VAR_2} POKéMON owned.$
translation: 而你的全国图鉴则是：\p看见的宝可梦有{STR_VAR_1}只，\n捉到的宝可梦有{STR_VAR_2}只。$

label: PokedexRating_Text_LookForwardToFilledNationalDex
source: I'll be looking forward to seeing\nyou fill the NATIONAL POKéDEX!$
translation: 我很期待看到你填满全国图鉴的那一天！$

label: PokedexRating_Text_YouveCompletedDex
source: Finally…\pYou've finally completed the\nPOKéDEX!\pIt's magnificent!\nTruly, this is a fantastic feat!$
translation: 终于......\p你终于彻底完成了宝可梦图鉴！\p太壮观了！\n这真是一项了不起的壮举！$

label: PokedexRating_Text_Wroooaaarrr
source: Wroooooooaaaaaarrrr!$
translation: 吼噢噢噢噢噢噢噢--！$

label: PokedexRating_Text_ThankYouMadeDreamReality
source: Thank you, {PLAYER}!\nSincerely, thank you!\lYou've made my dream a reality!$
translation: 谢谢你，{PLAYER}！\n衷心地感谢你！\l是你让我的梦想成为了现实！$

label: PokedexRating_Text_LoveSeeingYourPokedex
source: OAK: Ah, welcome!\pTell me, how is your POKéDEX\ncoming along?\pWahaha!\pActually, I know how it is, but I\nlove seeing it anyway!\pLet's see…$
translation: 大木：啊，欢迎！\p快跟我说说，你的图鉴\n收集得怎么样了？\p哇哈哈！\p其实我心里有数，不过我就是\n喜欢亲眼瞧瞧！\p让我来看看......$

label: gElmDexRatingText_Robbery
source: PROF. ELM: {PLAYER}{KUN}!\pGet here quick! Something\nawful has happened!$
translation: 空木博士：{PLAYER}{KUN}！\p快点回来！出大事了！$

label: gElmDexRatingText_AreYouCurious
source: PROF. ELM: Ah, {PLAYER}{KUN}!\pAre you curious about how your\nPOKéDEX is coming along?$
translation: 空木博士：啊，{PLAYER}{KUN}！\p想知道你的宝可梦图鉴\n完成得如何了吗？$

label: gElmDexRatingText_AreYouCuriousNational
source: PROF. ELM: Ah, {PLAYER}{KUN}!\pAre you curious about how your\nNational POKéDEX is coming along?$
translation: 空木博士：啊，{PLAYER}{KUN}！\p想知道你的全国图鉴\n完成得如何了吗？$

label: gJohtoDexRatingText_LessThan10
source: Look for POKéMON in grassy areas!$
translation: 试着去草丛里找找宝可梦吧！$

label: gJohtoDexRatingText_LessThan20
source: Good. I see you understand how to\nuse Poké Balls.$
translation: 不错，看来你已经懂得\n怎么使用精灵球了。$

label: gJohtoDexRatingText_LessThan35
source: You're getting good at this,\nbut you have a long way to go.$
translation: 你越来越熟练了，\n不过前面的路还长着呢。$

label: gJohtoDexRatingText_LessThan50
source: Hmm, you're catching POKéMON at a\ndecent pace!$
translation: 嗯，你捕捉宝可梦的节奏相当不错！$

label: gJohtoDexRatingText_LessThan65
source: You're trying--I can see that.\nYour POKéDEX is coming together.$
translation: 看得到你的努力--\n你的图鉴已经逐渐成形了。$

label: gJohtoDexRatingText_LessThan80
source: You're training them well. You know\nsome POKéMON don't evolve just by\pbattling with others, right?$
translation: 你培育得很好。不过你也知道吧，\n有些宝可梦可不是单靠对战\p就能进化的哦？$

label: gJohtoDexRatingText_LessThan95
source: Do you have a Fishing Rod?\nThere are some POKéMON that can\ponly be found by fishing!$
translation: 你有钓竿吗？\n有些宝可梦可是\p只能通过钓鱼才能遇到的哦！$

label: gJohtoDexRatingText_LessThan110
source: Excellent! You seem to be good at\ncollecting things!$
translation: 太棒了！看来你很擅长收集东西呢！$

label: gJohtoDexRatingText_LessThan125
source: Some POKéMON only appear during\ncertain times of the day.$
translation: 有些宝可梦只会在\n特定的时间段出现哦。$

label: gJohtoDexRatingText_LessThan140
source: Your POKéDEX is really filling up.\nKeep up the good work!$
translation: 你的宝可梦图鉴越来越充实了呢。\n继续保持这股劲头吧！$

label: gJohtoDexRatingText_LessThan155
source: I'm impressed.\nYou're evolving POKéMON, not just\pcatching them.$
translation: 真令人佩服。\n你不仅只是捕捉，\p还在积极让宝可梦进化呢。$

label: gJohtoDexRatingText_LessThan170
source: If you can learn how to use the\ncustom Poké Balls made by Kurt\peffectively, you'll be able to catch\nPOKéMON better!$
translation: 如果能熟练运用钢铁先生\n特制的精灵球，\p捕捉宝可梦就会变得\n更加轻松哦！$

label: gJohtoDexRatingText_LessThan185
source: When you trade POKéMON, you can\nalso trade information. Your\pfriends can really help you!$
translation: 交换宝可梦不仅能互通有无，\n还能交流情报呢。\p朋友们一定能成为你的大帮手！$

label: gJohtoDexRatingText_LessThan200
source: Are you trading your POKéMON?\nIt's tough to do this alone!$
translation: 你有和别人交换宝可梦吗？\n单凭一个人的力量可是很难完成的哦！$

label: gJohtoDexRatingText_LessThan215
source: Wow! You've reached 200!\nYour POKéDEX is looking great!$
translation: 哇！已经达到200只了！\n你的图鉴真了不起！$

label: gJohtoDexRatingText_LessThan230
source: You've proven yourself capable.\nThere's nothing to worry about.\pKeep catching POKéMON the way\nyou've been doing so far.$
translation: 你的实力已经毋庸置疑了。\n完全不需要担心。\p就照着现在的节奏，\n继续去捕捉宝可梦吧。$

label: gJohtoDexRatingText_LessThan245
source: Your POKéDEX is well on the way to\nbeing filled up.\pThis POKéDEX can be considered a\njournal of your adventure.$
translation: 你的图鉴已经逐渐成形了呢。\p这本图鉴，可以说就是\n你冒险历程的日记啊。$

label: gJohtoDexRatingText_LessThan260
source: You've found so many POKéMON!\nYou've really helped my studies!$
translation: 你居然发现了这么多宝可梦！\n对我的研究真是帮了大忙了！$

label: gJohtoDexRatingText_LessThan275
source: Magnificent! You have the ability\nto become a great POKéMON\pProfessor someday!$
translation: 太精彩了！照这样下去，\n你将来甚至能成为一名优秀的\p宝可梦博士呢！$

label: gJohtoDexRatingText_LessThanMaxDex
source: Your POKéDEX is amazing!\nYou're ready to turn professional!$
translation: 你的图鉴太惊人了！\n完全可以去当专业研究员了！$

label: gJohtoDexRatingText_Complete
source:
Wow!
That is a complete Johto POKéDEX!\pThanks to you, {PLAYER}, the Johto
POKéDEX is complete!\pWow...
You've done an incredible job!$
translation:
哇！
城都图鉴已经全部完成了！\p多亏了你，{PLAYER}，
城都图鉴彻底完成了！\p太震撼了......
你交出了一份不可思议的答卷！$

label: gNationalDexRatingText_LessThan100
source: The goal may be far away, but don't\ngive up yet! Keep going!$
translation: 距离目标虽然还很远，\n但千万别放弃！继续加油！$

label: gNationalDexRatingText_LessThan150
source: Don't forget, some POKéMON only\nappear at certain times of the day!$
translation: 别忘了，有些宝可梦只会在\n特定的时间段出现哦！$

label: gNationalDexRatingText_LessThan200
source: If you break rocks, some POKéMON\nthat were hiding there might come\pjumping out!$
translation: 如果把岩石击碎，\n藏在里面的宝可梦说不定\p就会跳出来呢！$

label: gNationalDexRatingText_LessThan250
source: That's wonderful you've been able\nto gather this many POKéMON!\pThe path ahead is long. Keep up the\ngreat work!$
translation: 能收集到这么多宝可梦，\n真了不起！\p未来的路还很长。\n继续保持这个势头加油吧！$

label: gNationalDexRatingText_LessThan300
source: If you Headbutt a tree, sometimes\na POKéMON might fall out!$
translation: 用头锤去撞树的话，\n有时会有宝可梦掉下来哦！$

label: gNationalDexRatingText_LessThan350
source: A lot of POKéMON not found in the\nJohto region like to congregate\pat the Safari Zone$
translation: 许多在城都地区见不到的宝可梦，\n似乎都聚集在\p狩猎地带呢。$

label: gNationalDexRatingText_LessThan400
source: There are hidden locations all\nover the world containing rare\pand unusual POKéMON, try to find\nthem all!$
translation: 世界各地都有一些隐秘的场所，\n栖息着稀有而罕见的宝可梦，\p试着把它们全都找出来吧！$

label: gNationalDexRatingText_LessThan435
source: Wow, you've gotten so far...!\nI'm actually a little surprised!$
translation: 哇，你竟然收集了这么多......！\n老实说，连我都有些惊讶了！$

label: gNationalDexRatingText_LessThan465
source: This is a critical moment!\nYou can't become discouraged!$
translation: 现在正是紧要关头！\n可千万不要灰心啊！$

label: gNationalDexRatingText_LessThan475
source: Just a little more!\nI've got high expectations for you!$
translation: 就差一点点了！\n我对你抱有很高的期望哦！$

label: gNationalDexRatingText_LessThanMaxDex
source: I have never before in all my years\nseen such an incredible Trainer!$
translation: 我活了这么大岁数，\n还从未见过如此惊人的训练家！$

label: gNationalDexRatingText_Complete
source:
Excellent! That is an amazing
National POKéDEX!\pWow...{PAUSE 10}\pYou've lived up to my
expectations wonderfully!\pNo, you've exceeded them, {PLAYER}.
You've become an amazing Trainer!\pThank you, {PLAYER}!$
translation: 太完美了！这份全国图鉴\n实在太不可思议了！\p哇......{PAUSE 10}\p你出色地回应了我的期待！\p不，你甚至超越了我的想象，{PLAYER}。\n你已经是一位了不起的训练家了！\p谢谢你，{PLAYER}！$

label: gPokeNewsTextLilycove_Ongoing
source:
Greetings!
It's time for POKéMON NEWS.\pThis is the news you've all been
waiting for!\pLILYCOVE DEPARTMENT STORE's clear-out
sale has finally arrived!\pAll the thingamajigs and doodads that
you've always dreamt about…\pYou may be in for fateful encounters
with them all!\pThat's the news on POKéMON NEWS.$
translation:
大家好！
现在是"宝可梦新闻"时间。\p这是大家翘首以盼的大新闻！\p水静百货大楼的清仓大特卖
终于开售啦！\p那些你一直梦寐以求的稀奇玩意儿......\p说不定就能在这里与它们命中注定般相遇哦！\p以上就是本期"宝可梦新闻"的全部内容。$

source:
Greetings!
It's time for POKéMON NEWS.\pWe have big news for everyone
involved in the making of {POKEBLOCK}S.\pThe legendary BLEND MASTER will be
appearing in LILYCOVE CITY with just\la mere {STR_VAR_1}-day wait to go!\pThe BLEND MASTER is said to be
the best in all HOENN when it comes to\lspinning a BERRY BLENDER.\pThose people who want to make great
{POKEBLOCK}S or see the MASTER in action\lare urged to save their BERRIES.\pThat's the news on POKéMON NEWS.$
translation:
大家好！
现在是"宝可梦新闻"时间。\p我们为所有制作{POKEBLOCK}的训练家

赶快把树果存好吧！\p以上就是本期"宝可梦新闻"的全部内容。$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer6Intro
source: Welcome to my POKéMON LAB.\pI carry out research on battling in\nsecrecy.\pWould you like to see how strong I am?$
translation: 欢迎来到我的宝可梦研究所。\p我正在秘密进行对战研究。\p想见识一下我有多强吗？$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer6PreChampion
source: Welcome to my POKéMON LAB.\pI carry out research on battling in\nsecrecy.$
translation: 欢迎来到我的宝可梦研究所。\p我正在秘密进行对战研究。$

label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_TryPokemonPrinter
source: It's a POKéMON PRINTER!\pIt can put a print of your POKéMON\non the back of your TRAINER CARD.\pIt costs only ¥50.\nWould you like to try it?$
translation:
这是宝可梦打印机！\p它可以把你的宝可梦印在
训练家卡片的背面。\p只需要¥50。
要试一试吗？$

label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_DontHaveEnoughMoney
source: 你的钱不够。$
translation: 你的钱不够。$

label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_ChoosePrintType
source: Please choose the print type.$
translation: 请选择打印类型。$

label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_BigSmileForPhoto
source: A big smile for the photo, please!\nThree… Two… One…\pFlash!$
translation:
拍照时请露出灿烂的笑容！
三......二......一......\p咔嚓！$

label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_PrintIsReadyCheckTrainerCard
source: Your POKéMON print is ready!\nCheck your TRAINER CARD.$
translation:
宝可梦照片已经打印好啦！
去确认一下你的训练家卡片吧。$

label: FourIsland_House2_Text_WishICouldShowOffStickers
source: Giggle…\nI collected a ton of STICKERS.\lI wish I could show them off…$
translation:
嘻嘻......
我收集了好多贴纸呢。\l真想好好炫耀一下......$

label: FourIsland_House2_Text_GiveYouStickerIfYouBrag
source:
Oh, excellent!
You've come to the right place!\pLook, look! See? See?
These are my STICKERS!\lLook how many I got!\pI bet you want some.
I bet you do!\pI'll give a STICKER if you can tell
me something awesome about\lyourself.\pWhat will you brag about?$
translation:
哇，太棒了！
你可找对人啦！\p看呀看呀！看到了吗看到了吗？
这些都是我的贴纸！\l看我收集了多少！\p你肯定也很想要吧？
绝对想要对不对！\p只要你跟我吹嘘一下
你身上有什么了不起的事情，\l我就送你一张贴纸。\p你要跟我吹嘘什么呢？$

label: FourIsland_House2_Text_BragAboutSomethingForMe
source: Brag about something for me.\nI'll give you a STICKER.$
translation:
跟我吹嘘吹嘘你的事吧。
我就送你一张贴纸。$

label: FourIsland_House2_Text_BragAboutWhatToday
source: Oh, hi!\nHere comes the braggart.\pWhat are you going to brag about\ntoday?$
translation:
哎呀，你好！
吹牛大王来啦。\p你今天打算吹嘘些什么呢？$

label: FourIsland_House2_Text_WowHoFLowest
source: Oh, wow, you made it into the\nHALL OF FAME.\pThat's pretty good, yup!\nI'll give you one of these.$
translation:
哇哦，你成功登上殿堂了啊。\p挺厉害的嘛，嗯！
这个就送你一张吧。$

label: FourIsland_House2_Text_WowHoFLow
source: Oh, wow, you've entered the\nHALL OF FAME often!\pThat's impressive, yup!\nI'll give you one of these.$
translation:
哇哦，你经常登上殿堂呢！\p真让人佩服，嗯！
这个就送你一张吧。$

label: FourIsland_House2_Text_WowHoFHigh
source: Whoa! You've made it into the\nHALL OF FAME that often?\lThat's seriously incredible, yup!\pYou own the POKéMON LEAGUE!\nI'll give you one of these.$
translation:
哇塞！你登上殿堂这么多次啦？\l这真的太厉害了，嗯！\p宝可梦联盟都快成你家开的了！
这个就送你一张吧。$

label: FourIsland_House2_Text_WowHoFHighest
source: No way! You've gone into the\nHALL OF FAME that many times?\pYou're beyond incredible, yup!\nThat's it, I have to give you this.$
translation:
不会吧！你登上殿堂这么多次？！\p简直厉害到没边了，嗯！
服了你了，这个必须送给你。$

label: FourIsland_House2_Text_HoFStickerApplied
source: The HALL OF FAME STICKER was\napplied to the TRAINER CARD.$
translation:
在训练家卡片上贴上了
殿堂贴纸。$

label: FourIsland_House2_Text_ComeBackWithBetterStoryHoF
source: Hmm…\pCome back with a better story next\ntime, okay?$
translation: 嗯......\p下次带个更厉害的故事来，好吗？$

label: FourIsland_House2_Text_LivingLegendHoF
source: Oh, no, no can do.\pYou're practically a living legend.\nI have no SITCKERS left to give.$
translation:
哎呀，不行不行了。\p你简直就是活着的传奇啊。
我已经没有贴纸可以给你了。$

label: FourIsland_House2_Text_WowEggsLowest
source: Oh, wow, there are POKéMON EGGS?\nI didn't know that!\pThat's pretty good, yup!\nI'll give you one of these.$
translation:
哇哦，原来还有宝可梦蛋这种东西？
我以前都不知道呢！\p挺不错的嘛，嗯！
这个就送你一张吧。$

label: FourIsland_House2_Text_WowEggsLow
source: You've hatched that many EGGS?\nYou really must like them!\pThat's impressive, yup!\nI'll give you one of these.$
translation:
你孵化了那么多蛋啊？

这个就送你一张吧。$

label: FourIsland_House2_Text_WowEggsHigh
source: Whoa! You've hatched a whole\nbunch of EGGS!\pYou're an EGG-hatching machine!\nI'll give you one of these.$
translation:
哇塞！你孵了超级多的蛋啊！\p你简直就是一台孵蛋机！
这个就送你一张吧。$

label: FourIsland_House2_Text_WowEggsHighest
source: Wh… You hatched that many EGGS?\pWhat's behind your love of EGGS?\nIt's beyond incredible, yup!\pYou're too awesome, I tell you.\nThat's it, I have to give you this.$
translation:
什......你孵了那么多蛋？！\p你对蛋的爱到底是怎么回事啊？
简直厉害到没边了，嗯！\p你实在太了不起了，真的。
服了你了，这个必须送给你。$

label: FourIsland_House2_Text_EggStickerApplied
source: The EGG STICKER was applied\nto the TRAINER CARD.$

在训练家卡片上贴上了

source: Hmm…\pCome back with a better story next\ntime, okay?$

哇，你在通信对战中
