这个送给你吧。$

label: FourIsland_House2_Text_WowLinkWinsLow
source: You've beaten your friends a lot\nlink battling, huh?\pYou're impressively strong, yup!\nI'll give you one of these.$
translation:
你在通信对战中
赢过朋友很多次吧？\p实力真令人佩服呢！
这个送给你吧。$

label: FourIsland_House2_Text_WowLinkWinsHigh
source: Whoa! You've beaten your friends\na frightful number of times.\pHave you lost friends over this?\nI'll give you one of these.$
translation:
哇！你打败朋友的
次数多得吓人啊。\p可别因此连朋友都做不成哦？
这个送给你吧。$

label: FourIsland_House2_Text_WowLinkWinsHighest
source:
Wh… Wickedly whoa!
You've won mind-blowingly often!\pIt just knocks me out thinking
about how tough you are.\pYou're the stuff of nightmares!
That's it, I have to give you this.$
translation:
哇、哇塞！太可怕了！
你获胜的次数多得难以置信！\p光是想象你到底有多强，
我就觉得喘不过气了。\p你简直就是对手的噩梦！
好，这个非给你不可了。$

label: FourIsland_House2_Text_VictoryStickerApplied
source: The VICTORY STICKER was applied\nto the TRAINER CARD.$
translation:
在训练家卡片上
贴上了胜利贴纸。$

label: FourIsland_House2_Text_ComeBackWithBetterStoryLinkWins
source: Hmm…\pCome back with a better story next\ntime, okay?$
translation: 嗯......\p下次带个更厉害的故事来，好吗？$

label: FourIsland_House2_Text_LivingLegendLinkWins
source: Oh, no, no can do.\pYou're practically a living legend.\nI have no SITCKERS left to give.$
translation:
哎呀，不行不行了。\p你简直就是活着的传奇啊。
我已经没有贴纸可以给你了。$

label: Route110_Text_IsabelRegister
source: That wasn't close to what I could\ndo to show off my POKéMON.\pI'll have you as my captive audience\nas often as possible!$
translation:
我还远远没有把宝可梦的
魅力全部展现出来呢。\p以后可要请你经常来当
我最忠实的观众哦！$

label: Route111_Text_DustyPostRematch
source:
For thirty years I have searched for
ancient ruins!\pNo, wait, was that forty years
I've searched?\pHmm… It could even be fifty…
How long have I been at this?$
translation:
三十年来，我一直在
探寻古代遗迹！\p不，等等，
我已经找了四十年了吗？\p嗯......甚至可能是五十年......
我到底从事这个多久了？$

label: Route111_Text_WiltonRegister
source: There is much to be learned from\nyour training style.\pI request a rematch if it\nbehooves you.$
translation:
从你的培育方式中能学到很多。\p如果不介意的话，
在下希望能与你再战一场。$

label: Route115_Text_KyraPostBattle
source: I made the mistake of trying to battle\nwhile running!\pI should take a run to calm down…$
translation:
我真不该犯糊涂
一边跑步一边对战的！\p我得去跑两步冷静一下......$

label: Route117_Text_LydiaPostRematch
source: POKéMON seem to like different kinds\nof {POKEBLOCK}S, depending on their nature.$
translation:
宝可梦似乎会根据各自的性格，
喜好不同种类的{POKEBLOCK}。$

label: Route119_Text_JacksonIntro
source: Who has the knowledge and\nthe technique for survival?\pPOKéMON RANGERS, that's who!$
translation:
是谁拥有野外生存的
知识与技巧？\p正是我们宝可梦巡护员！$

label: Route123_Text_KindraPostBattle
source: MT. PYRE…\nWhere the spirits of POKéMON sleep…\pIt must overflow with a power that\nsoothes spirits…$
translation:
送神火山......
宝可梦灵魂长眠之地......\p这里一定洋溢着
安抚灵魂的力量吧......$

label: Route124_Text_RoyRematchIntro
source: ROY: If we lose, I'll catch heck.\nI'm going to go totally all out!$
translation: 罗伊：要是输了我可要挨训的。\n我一定要全力以赴！$

label: Route131_Text_RichardPostBattle
source:
Gasp… Gasp…
I'm wiped out…\pThe going's easy. It's the leaving
that's the hard part.\pWill I have any energy left to make
the return trip?$
translation:
哈啊......哈啊......
累死我了......\p来的时候容易，回去可就难了。\p我还有力气
踏上返程的路吗？$

label: Route132_Text_MakaylaPostBattle
source: That young man over there looks just\nlike my husband when he was young.\pHe's making me blush!$
translation:
那边的那个年轻人长得
真像我丈夫年轻的时候啊。\p看得我都害羞了！$

label: VSSeeker_Text_BatteryNotChargedNeedXSteps
source: The battery isn't charged enough.\pNo. of steps required to fully\ncharge the battery: {STR_VAR_1}{PAUSE_UNTIL_PRESS}$
translation:
电池电量不足。\p要充满电量还需走的步数：
{STR_VAR_1}{PAUSE_UNTIL_PRESS}$

label: VSSeeker_Text_NoTrainersWithinRange
source: There are no Trainers within range\nwho can battle…\pThe VS Seeker was turned off.{PAUSE_UNTIL_PRESS}$
translation:
范围内没有
可以对战的训练家......\p对战搜寻镜已关闭。{PAUSE_UNTIL_PRESS}$

label: VSSeeker_Text_TrainersNotReady
source: The other Trainers don't appear\nto be ready for battle.\pLet's wait till later.{PAUSE_UNTIL_PRESS}$
translation:
其他训练家看起来
还没有做好对战的准备。\p过段时间再试吧。{PAUSE_UNTIL_PRESS}$

label: Route3_Text_ColtonRematchIntro
source: Hey!\nI saw you in VIRIDIAN FOREST!$
translation:
喂！
我在常青森林见过你！$

label: Route3_Text_BenRematchIntro
source: Hi! I like shorts!\nThey're comfy and easy to wear!\pYou should be wearing shorts, too!$
translation:
嗨！我喜欢短裤！
穿着既舒服又方便活动！\p你也应该穿短裤才对！$

label: Route3_Text_JaniceRematchIntro
source: Excuse me!\nYou keep looking at me, don't you?$
translation:
打扰一下！
你一直盯着我看，对不对？$

label: Route3_Text_GregRematchIntro
source: You're a TRAINER, aren't you?\nLet's get with it right away!$
translation:
你也是训练家吧？
那就马上来过过招吧！$

label: Route3_Text_SallyRematchIntro
source: That look you give me…\nIt intrigues me so!$
translation:
你看我的那种眼神......
真是让我太感兴趣了！$

label: Route3_Text_CalvinRematchIntro
source: Hey! What's wrong with you?\nYou're still not wearing shorts!$
translation:
喂！你怎么回事啊？
你竟然还是没有穿短裤！$

label: Route3_Text_JamesRematchIntro
source: I'll battle you with the POKéMON\nI started raising.$
translation:
我要用我刚开始培育的
宝可梦来和你对战！$

label: Route3_Text_RobinRematchIntro
source: Eek!\nDid you push me?$
translation: 呀！\n是你推我吗？$

label: Route4_Text_CrissyRematchIntro
source: I always catch mushroom POKéMON\non MT. MOON.$
translation: 我总是在月见山\n捕捉蘑菇宝可梦。$

label: Route6_Text_RickyRematchIntro
source: Oh! You're that nosy kid who\neavesdropped on us!$
translation: 啊！你就是那个偷听我们\n说话的多管闲事的小孩！$

label: Route6_Text_NancyRematchIntro
source: Excuse me! Didn't I tell you that\nthis is a private conversation?\pYou shouldn't be listening in,\nyou uncouth person!$
translation: 打扰一下！我不是说过\n这是我们的私人谈话吗？\p随便偷听别人说话，\n你这也太没礼貌了！$

label: Route6_Text_KeigoRematchIntro
source: I'm trying to find something good\nthat's not a BUG POKéMON, but…$
translation: 我正想找一只不是虫属性的\n好宝可梦，可是......$

label: Route6_Text_JeffRematchIntro
source: Huh?\nYou want to go with me again?$
translation: 咦？\n你还想再和我较量一场吗？$

label: Route6_Text_IsabelleRematchIntro
source: Me?\nWell, okay. I'll play this once.$
translation: 我吗？\n好吧，那我就陪你玩一次。$

label: Route6_Text_ElijahRematchIntro
source: Hey, long time!\nHave you gotten better?$
translation: 嘿，好久不见！\n你的实力变强了吗？$

label: Route8_Text_AidanRematchIntro
source: You are good at POKéMON, but how\nis your chemistry grade?$
translation: 你玩宝可梦挺在行，\n不过化学成绩怎么样呢？$

label: Route8_Text_StanRematchIntro
source: All right!\nLet's play another game!$
translation: 好嘞！\n我们再来战一局吧！$

label: Route8_Text_GlennRematchIntro
source: You need strategy to win at\nbattling.\pAre you following my advice?$
translation: 想要在对战中取胜就必须讲究策略。\p你有照着我的建议做吗？$

label: Route8_Text_PaigeRematchIntro
source: I've collected many NIDORAN.\nI don't want them to evolve, but…$
translation: 我收集了好多尼多兰。\n虽然不想让它们进化，可是......$

label: Route8_Text_LeslieRematchIntro
source: School is fun, but I still think\nPOKéMON are fun, too.$
translation: 上学很有趣，但我觉得\n宝可梦也一样很有趣。$

label: Route8_Text_AndreaRematchIntro
source: MEOWTH and PERSIAN are so cute,\nmeow, meow, meow!$
translation: 喵喵和猫老大都好可爱，\n喵~喵~喵~！$

label: Route8_Text_MeganRematchIntro
source: We may look silly standing here\nlike this, but I can still battle.$
translation: 我们像这样傻站着可能看起来挺蠢的，\n但我随时都能对战！$

label: Route8_Text_RichRematchIntro
source: I'm a rambling, gaming dude!\nI'm on a winning streak!$
translation: 我可是个随性狂放的游戏老手！\n现在正连胜呢！$

label: Route8_Text_JuliaRematchIntro
source: What's a cute, round, and fluffy\nPOKéMON?\pYou already know, don't you?$
translation: 有什么又可爱、又圆滚滚、\n又毛茸茸的宝可梦呢？\p你心里已经有答案了吧？$

label: Route8_Text_RicardoRematchIntro
source: My bike's still acting up, man.$
translation: 哥们，我的单车还是毛病不断。$

label: Route8_Text_JarenRematchIntro
source: Okay, kid!\nDon't expect mercy this time!$
translation: 好小子！\n这次我可绝不会手下留情！$

label: Route8_Text_EliRematchIntro
source: ELI: Our twin power became even\nbetter!$
translation: 惠里：我们双胞胎的力量\n变得更加厉害了！$

label: Route8_Text_AnneRematchIntro
source: ANNE: Our twin power powered up!$
translation: 安妮：我们双胞胎的力量升级了！$

label: Route9_Text_AliciaRematchIntro
source: We're to battle again?\nThis time, you're mine!$
translation: 我们又要对战了吗？\n这次你输定了！$

label: Route9_Text_ChrisRematchIntro
source: I haven't forgotten you were with\nthose good-looking POKéMON.$
translation: 我可没忘记你带着那些\n帅气好看的宝可梦呢。$

label: Route9_Text_DrewRematchIntro
source: I'm taking ROCK TUNNEL to go to\nLAVENDER…\pBut I keep getting stopped by\neveryone along the way…$
translation: 我想穿过岩山隧道去紫苑镇......\p可一路上总是被大家\n拦下来对战......$

label: Route9_Text_CaitlinRematchIntro
source: Don't you dare patronize me today!\nWe're playing for keeps!$
translation: 今天你休想小看我！\n我们来动真格的！$

label: Route9_Text_JeremyRematchIntro
source: Bwahaha!\nGreat! I was bored again, eh!$
translation:
哇哈哈哈！
太棒了！我正闲得发慌呢！$

label: Route9_Text_BriceRematchIntro
source: Hahaha!\nA little toughie, as always!$
translation:
哈哈哈！
还是一如既往地难缠啊！$

label: Route9_Text_BrentRematchIntro
source: I got up early every day to train\nmy POKéMON from cocoons!$
translation:
我每天都起大早特训，
终于把宝可梦从小茧给培养长大了！$

label: Route9_Text_AlanRematchIntro
source: Hahahaha!\nI'll win this time!$
translation:
哈哈哈哈！
这次我一定会赢！$

label: Route9_Text_ConnerRematchIntro
source: Go win, my super BUG POKéMON!$
translation: 去拿下胜利吧，我超级厉害的虫属性宝可梦！$

label: Route10_Text_MarkRematchIntro
source: Wow, you came here again?\nMaybe you're a POKéMANIAC, too?\lWant to see my collection?$
translation:
哇，你又来啦？
难道你也是宝可梦狂？\l想看看我的收藏吗？$

label: Route10_Text_ClarkRematchIntro
source: Ha-hahah-ah-ha!\nI can't stop sneezing!$
translation:
哈--阿嚏--！
喷嚏完全停不下来啦！$

label: Route10_Text_HermanRematchIntro
source: Hi, kid!\nDid I show you my POKéMON?$
translation:
嗨，小朋友！
我给你看过我的宝可梦了吗？$

label: Route10_Text_HeidiRematchIntro
source: I went out to a POKéMON GYM again.\p…But I lost as usual.$
translation: 我又去挑战宝可梦道馆了。\p......不过还是老样子输掉了。$

label: Route10_Text_TrentRematchIntro
source: Ah!\nThis mountain air is delicious!\lIt's so good, I can't leave!$
translation:
啊！
山里的空气太清新美味了！\l真是好得让我舍不得离开！$

label: Route10_Text_CarolRematchIntro
source: My head is starting to spin.\nI've been hiking for too long…$
translation:
我头都开始发晕了。
登山走得太久了......$

label: Route11_Text_HugoRematchIntro
source: Win, lose, or draw!\nNow for our rematch!$
translation:
输赢平手都无所谓！
现在就来再战一场！$

label: Route11_Text_JasperRematchIntro
source: Competing is the ultimate thrill.\nI still can't get enough!$
translation:
全力对战才是最刺激的。
我可还没玩够呢！$

label: Route11_Text_EddieRematchIntro
source: You know, right?\nLet's go, but don't cheat!$
translation:
规则你都懂吧？
来吧，可不许耍赖！$

label: Route11_Text_BraxtonRematchIntro
source: Hi, there!\pBut be careful!\nI'm still laying down some cables!$
translation:
嗨，你好！\p不过小心点！
我还在铺设电缆呢！$

label: Route11_Text_DillonRematchIntro
source: I became a TRAINER a while ago.\nBut, I think I can win.$
translation:
我刚当上训练家不久。
不过，我觉得我能赢。$

label: Route11_Text_DirkRematchIntro
source: Fwahaha!\nI have never lost!\p…And if I did, I've forgotten all\nabout it!$
translation:
哇哈哈哈！
我可从来没输过！\p......就算输过，我也早就忘得一干二净啦！$

label: Route11_Text_DarianRematchIntro
source: I have never won before…\pPerhaps I am destined to remain\nthat way…$
translation: 我以前从来没赢过......\p也许我注定就是这个命吧......$

label: Route11_Text_YasuRematchIntro
source: I'm the best in my class.\nI train every morning and night!$
translation:
我可是全班最厉害的。
每天早晚我都在特训！$

label: Route11_Text_BernieRematchIntro
source: Keep your eyes out for live wires!$
translation: 小心带电的电线！$

label: Route11_Text_DaveRematchIntro
source: I raised my POKéMON carefully.\nThey should be ready by now.\lThis time, they should win, too.$
translation:
我精心培育了我的宝可梦。
它们现在肯定准备好了。\l这次绝对能赢。$

label: Route12_Text_NedRematchIntro
source: Yeah!\nI got a bite, here!\lTh-this might be the real thing!$
translation:
好耶！
有鱼咬钩了！\l这、这说不定是个大家伙！$

label: Route12_Text_ChipRematchIntro
source: You're finally here.\nFishing is a waiting game.$
translation:
你终于来啦。
钓鱼就是一场耐心的等待。$

label: Route12_Text_JustinRematchIntro
source: Still can't find a MOON STONE…\nHave you found one?$
translation:
还是找不到月之石......
你找到了吗？$

label: Route12_Text_LucaRematchIntro
source: Electricity has always been my\nspecialty.\pI don't know a thing about POKéMON\nof the sea, though.$
translation:
电属性一直都是我的专长。\p不过我对海里的宝可梦
可是一窍不通。$

label: Route12_Text_HankRematchIntro
source: The FISHING FOOL vs. POKéMON KID!\nAnother round, fight!$
translation: 钓鱼狂 vs 宝可梦少年！\n再战一轮，开打！$

label: Route12_Text_ElliotRematchIntro
source: I love fishing, don't get me wrong.\nBut, I wish I had more work…\l…It's hard to give up fishing!$
translation: 我很喜欢钓鱼，别误会啊。\n但我真希望能多接点活儿......\l......可要戒掉钓鱼实在太难了！$

label: Route12_Text_AndrewRematchIntro
source: What's catching?\pYou'll never know unless you beat\nme!$
translation: 钓上来了什么？\p不打赢我，\n你可永远都不会知道！$

label: Route12_Text_JesRematchIntro
source: JES: I'll win here today and\npropose to my GIA.$
translation: 杰斯：今天只要赢了，\n我就向吉亚求婚。$

label: Route12_Text_GiaRematchIntro
source: GIA: Hey, JES…\nI've been waiting a long time now.\pIf we win today, I'll marry you!$
translation: 吉亚：喂，杰斯......\n我都已经等了好久啦。\p如果我们今天赢了，我就嫁给你！$

label: Route13_Text_SebastianRematchIntro
source: My bird POKéMON remember you!$
translation: 我的鸟宝可梦还记得你呢！$

label: Route13_Text_SusieRematchIntro
source: I want to be the best TRAINER \nwhile I'm a kid!$
translation: 我想趁着自己还是小孩子的时候，\n成为最厉害的训练家！$

label: Route13_Text_ValerieRematchIntro
source: Wow!\nYou got more cool BADGES!$
translation: 哇！\n你拿到了更多帅气的徽章呢！$

label: Route13_Text_GwenRematchIntro
source: My cutely grown POKéMON wish to\nbecome reacquainted with you.$
translation: 我那些可爱长大的宝可梦，\n希望能和你重新切磋一下呢。$

label: Route13_Text_AlmaRematchIntro
source: I cleaned out my savings and\nbought more CARBOS.$
translation: 我掏空了所有积蓄，\n买了更多的速度增强剂。$

label: Route13_Text_PerryRematchIntro
source: I'm not going to lose this time.\nThe wind's blowing my way!$
translation: 这次我可不会输了。\n风势正站在我这一边！$

label: Route13_Text_LolaRematchIntro
source: Oh, you're back?\pSure, I'll play again with you,\nsweetie.$
translation: 哎呀，你又来啦？\p好啊，小可爱，\n我就再陪你玩一局吧。$

label: Route13_Text_SheilaRematchIntro
source: Can't you forget that you battled\nwith me?$
translation: 你就不能把和我对战过的事给忘了吗？$

label: Route13_Text_JaredRematchIntro
source: What're you starin' at?$
translation: 你瞅啥呢？！$

label: Route13_Text_RobertRematchIntro
source: I always go with bird POKéMON.\nI've dedicated myself to them.$
translation: 我向来只用鸟宝可梦。\n我已经把一切都倾注在它们身上了。$

label: Route14_Text_CarterRematchIntro
source: I used TMs to teach good moves\nto my POKéMON.$
translation: 我用了招式学习器，\n让宝可梦学会了很厉害的招式。$

label: Route14_Text_MitchRematchIntro
source: My bird POKéMON should be ready\nfor battle this time.$
translation: 这一次，我的鸟宝可梦\n应该已经做好战斗的准备了。$

label: Route14_Text_BeckRematchIntro
source: Are you using TMs on POKéMON?\nJust holding them is useless.$
translation: 你有在宝可梦身上用招式学习器吗？\n光放在包里可一点用都没有哦。$

label: Route14_Text_MarlonRematchIntro
source: Have you taught your bird POKéMON\nhow to FLY?\pYou'll be able to soar with it into\nthe sky! Give it a try.$
translation: 你教会鸟宝可梦怎么"飞翔"了吗？\p学会的话，你就能和它一起翱翔天际了！\n一定要试试看哦。$

label: Route14_Text_DonaldRematchIntro
source: The legend of the winged mirages…\nYou've heard it, right?$
translation: 关于生着双翼的幻影传说......\n你应该听说过吧？$

label: Route14_Text_BennyRematchIntro
source: I'm really not into it, but okay.\nLet's go!$
translation: 虽然我提不起什么劲，但行吧。\n来战！$

label: Route14_Text_LukasRematchIntro
source: Hey!\nI remember you!\pC'mon, c'mon.\nLet's go, let's go, let's go!$
translation: 嘿！\n我记得你！\p来吧来吧，\n上啊，上啊，上啊！$

label: Route14_Text_IsaacRematchIntro
source: You're here again, huh?\nShut up and battle.$
translation: 你又跑来了啊？\n少废话，开打！$

label: Route14_Text_GeraldRematchIntro
source: We've been riding here because of\nthe wide-open spaces.$
translation: 就是因为这里地势开阔，\n我们才在这儿飙车的。$

label: Route14_Text_MalikRematchIntro
source: POKéMON battle, right?\nCool! Rumble!$
translation: 要宝可梦对战对吧？\n太酷了！大干一场吧！$

label: Route14_Text_KiriRematchIntro
source: KIRI: JAN, I hope we win today.$
translation: 琪莉：阿让，希望我们今天能赢。$

label: Route14_Text_JanRematchIntro
source: JAN: KIRI, here we go!\nLet's win for sure this time!$
translation: 阿让：琪莉，上吧！\n这次我们一定要赢！$

label: Route15_Text_KindraRematchIntro
source: I'm going to keep battling with the\nPOKéMON I got in trades.$
translation: 我要继续用交换来的宝可梦\n来进行对战！$

label: Route15_Text_BeckyRematchIntro
source: You look gentle, so I think I can\nbeat you.\pI'll give it one more go!$
translation: 你看起来挺好对付的，我觉得我能赢。\p让我再试一次吧！$

label: Route15_Text_EdwinRematchIntro
source: When I whistle, bird POKéMON\ngather around.\pThey're amazingly cute!$
translation: 只要我一吹口哨，鸟宝可梦们\n就会聚集过来。\p真是太可爱了！$

label: Route15_Text_ChesterRematchIntro
source: Hmm? My birds are shivering!\nWait, aren't you that TRAINER…$
translation: 嗯？我的鸟儿们在发抖？！\n等等，你不是那个训练家......$

label: Route15_Text_GraceRematchIntro
source: Oh, you're a little cutie!\nSo like a darling POKéMON!\lI remember you now!$
translation: 哎呀，真是个可爱的小家伙！\n就像招人疼的宝可梦一样！\l我想起你来了！$

label: Route15_Text_OliviaRematchIntro
source: I raise POKéMON for protection\nbecause I live alone.\pThat hasn't changed.$
translation: 因为我一个人住，所以培育宝可梦\n来防身护卫。\p这一点至今未变。$

label: Route15_Text_ErnestRematchIntro
source: Hey, kid! C'mon!\nI got these off some loser!$
translation: 喂，小鬼！放马过来！\n这些可是我从某个窝囊废那里夺来的！$

label: Route15_Text_AlexRematchIntro
source: Fork over all your cash when you\nlose to me, kid!$
translation: 小鬼，输给我的话，\n就把你所有的钱都交出来！$

label: Route15_Text_CeliaRematchIntro
source: What's cool and happening?\nTrading POKéMON, of course.$
translation: 现在什么最潮最流行？\n那当然是交换宝可梦啦。$

label: Route15_Text_YazminRematchIntro
source: Want to play with my POKéMON\nagain?$
translation: 还想再和我的宝可梦对战吗？$

label: Route15_Text_MyaRematchIntro
source: MYA: Hi, we keep meeting,\ndon't we?\pHelp me train my little brother\nagain?$
translation: 玛亚：嗨，我们真有缘呢，\n总能遇到！\p能再帮我陪弟弟特训一下吗？$

label: Route15_Text_RonRematchIntro
source: RON: My sister's gotten more\npowerful…$
translation: 罗恩：我姐姐变得\n更厉害了......$

label: Route16_Text_LaoRematchIntro
source: What do you want?$
translation: 你想干嘛？$

label: Route16_Text_KojiRematchIntro
source: Nice BIKE!\nHand it over quick!$
translation: 这自行车真帅！\n识相的就快交出来！$

label: Route16_Text_LukeRematchIntro
source: Come out and play, little mouse.\nI'll treat you right!$
translation: 出来玩玩吧，小老鼠。\n我会好好招待你的！$

label: Route16_Text_HideoRematchIntro
source: Hey, wait a second!\nDon't call me and then run away!$
translation: 喂，等等！\n不要叫了我之后又跑掉啊！$

label: Route16_Text_CamronRematchIntro
source: I'm feeling hungry and mean!\nI really need a punching bag!$
translation: 我现在肚子饿得发慌，脾气暴躁！\n真想找个沙包好好揍一顿！$

label: Route16_Text_RubenRematchIntro
source: Hey, there!\nWe'll have ourselves a good time!$
translation: 哟，你好啊！\n咱们来痛痛快快玩一场吧！$

label: Route16_Text_JedRematchIntro
source: JED: Are you here to see our\nlove, which knows no bounds?$
translation: 杰德：你是来看我们\n那无边无际的深情厚爱吗？$

label: Route16_Text_LeaRematchIntro
source: LEA: Sometimes, the intensity of\nour love scares me.$
translation: 莉亚：有时候，我们这热烈的爱\n连我自己都感到害怕。$

label: Route17_Text_RaulRematchIntro
source: I told you, there's no getting rich\nquick in battling kids.$
translation: 我早就说过了，靠跟小鬼对战\n根本不可能发大财。$

label: Route17_Text_IsaiahRematchIntro
source: I'm mighty proud of my bod, kiddo.\nCome on!$
translation: 小家伙，我可是对自己的体魄自豪得很。\n放马过来吧！$

label: Route17_Text_VirgilRematchIntro
source: You out for a stroll?$
translation: 你出来散步吗？$

label: Route17_Text_BillyRematchIntro
source: We're BIKERS!\nWe rule the roads, man!$
translation: 我们是骑行族！\n公路可是我们的天下，小子！$

label: Route17_Text_NikolasRematchIntro
source: VOLTORB's going to seriously\nelectrify you today!$
translation: 今天霹雳电球可要\n狠狠电你一顿了！$

label: Route17_Text_ZeekRematchIntro
source: I leveled up my POKéMON, but it\nabsolutely won't evolve. Why?$
translation: 我明明给宝可梦升级了，\n可它就是不进化。为什么啊？$

label: Route17_Text_JamalRematchIntro
source: Gaah! I really need to exercise\nand seriously trim some flab!$
translation: 哇啊！我真的得好好运动，\n狠狠减掉点赘肉了！$

label: Route17_Text_CoreyRematchIntro
source: Be a rebel!$
translation: 来当个叛逆少年吧！$

label: Route17_Text_JaxonRematchIntro
source: Yep, that's a nice BIKE!\nHow's it handle?$
translation: 嘿，真是辆好自行车！\n骑起来手感怎么样？$

label: Route17_Text_WilliamRematchIntro
source: Get lost, kid!\nI'm bushed!$
translation: 走开，小鬼！\n我都快累趴下了！$

label: Route18_Text_WiltonRematchIntro
source: I've been checking every grassy\narea for new POKéMON.\pBut it's not always easy…$
translation: 我找遍了每一片草丛，\n想发现新的宝可梦。\p但找起来可真不容易啊......$

label: Route18_Text_RamiroRematchIntro
source: Koorukukukoo!\nIs my birdcall getting better?$
translation: 咕噜咕噜咕--！\n我学的鸟叫声是不是更像了？$

label: Route18_Text_JacobRematchIntro
source: I warned you before, this is my\nturf!\pI don't want you coming around.$
translation: 我之前就警告过你，这里是我的地盘！\p别再让我看到你在这附近晃悠。$

label: Route19_Text_RichardRematchIntro
source: I'm almost warmed up to go\nout for a swim.$
translation: 我的热身运动差不多做完了，\n准备去游泳咯。$

label: Route19_Text_ReeceRematchIntro
source: Wait! Slow down!\nWhat if you have a heart attack?$
translation: 等等！慢一点！\n万一心脏受不了怎么办？$

label: Route19_Text_MatthewRematchIntro
source: I love swimming!\nI guess you're the surfing type.$
translation: 我最喜欢游泳了！\n我想你是喜欢冲浪的那种吧。$

label: Route19_Text_DouglasRematchIntro
source: What's beyond the horizon?\nHave you seen?$
translation: 海平面的那一头有什么呢？\n你见过吗？$

label: Route19_Text_DavidRematchIntro
source: I tried diving for POKéMON again,\nbut it was a no-go like before.$
translation: 我又尝试潜水去抓宝可梦了，\n但还是跟之前一样无功而返。$

label: Route19_Text_TonyRematchIntro
source: I look at the sea to forget all\nthe bad things that happened.\p…Like losing to you the last time!$
translation: 看着大海就能让我忘掉所有不顺心的事。\p......比如上次输给你的事！$

label: Route19_Text_AnyaRematchIntro
source: You always get to ride your\nPOKéMON…\pIt looks so relaxing.\nCan I have it if I win?$
translation: 你总能骑着你的宝可梦......\p看起来好惬意啊。\n如果我赢了，能把它让给我吗？$

label: Route19_Text_AliceRematchIntro
source: Swimming's great!\nSunburns aren't!$
translation: 游泳虽然很棒！\n但晒伤可一点都不好受！$

label: Route19_Text_AxleRematchIntro
source: These waters are treacherous!\nYou shouldn't come back here!$
translation: 这片海域凶险得很！\n你可别再来这里了！$

label: Route19_Text_ConnieRematchIntro
source: I swam here with my friends…\nI'm tired…\lMust we really battle again?$
translation: 我和朋友一起游到了这里......\n我都累坏了......\l真的还要再对战一次吗？$

label: Route19_Text_LiaRematchIntro
source: LIA: You know my brother just\nbecame a TRAINER, right?\pI want to make him better, so I\nneed your help again.$
translation: 莉亚：你知道我弟弟才刚当上训练家对吧？\p我想让他变得更强，所以还要再请你帮个忙。$

label: Route19_Text_LucRematchIntro
source: LUC: My big sis taught me all\nabout POKéMON.\pI wonder if I'm better?$
translation: 卢克：姐姐把宝可梦的知识都教给我了。\p不知道我是不是变得更厉害了？$

label: Route20_Text_BarryRematchIntro
source: The water is shallow here.\nThere are many people swimming.$
translation: 这里的水很浅，\n有很多人在这边游泳呢。$

label: Route20_Text_ShirleyRematchIntro
source: Are you jealous that I'm\nvacationing on SEAFOAM?$
translation: 看到我在双子岛度假，\n你是不是很羡慕呀？$

label: Route20_Text_TiffanyRematchIntro
source: I love floating with the fishes\nhere among the waves.$
translation: 我喜欢在这波浪之间，\n和鱼儿们一起随波漂浮。$

label: Route20_Text_IreneRematchIntro
source: Were you on vacation, too?$
translation: 你也是在度假吗？$

label: Route20_Text_DeanRematchIntro
source: Check out my physique!\pIt's even more buff than ever\nbefore!$
translation: 瞧瞧我这身健美的体魄！\p比以前还要更加壮硕了呢！$

label: Route20_Text_DarrinRematchIntro
source: Why are you riding a POKéMON?\nHaven't you learned to swim yet?$
translation: 你为什么骑着宝可梦呀？\n难道你还没学会游泳吗？$

label: Route20_Text_RogerRematchIntro
source: I rode my bird POKéMON here.$
translation: 我是骑着鸟宝可梦飞过来的。$

label: Route20_Text_NoraRematchIntro
source: My boyfriend gave me big pearls.\nAnd, they've grown bigger!$
translation: 男朋友送了我大珍珠。\n而且，它们现在变得更大了！$

label: Route20_Text_MissyRematchIntro
source: I swam here from CINNABAR ISLAND.\nIt wasn't easy, like I said.$
translation: 我从红莲岛一路游到了这里。\n正如我之前所说，真是不容易啊。$

label: Route20_Text_MelissaRematchIntro
source: CINNABAR, in the west, has a LAB\nfor POKéMON.\pMy daddy works there.$
translation: 西边的红莲岛上有一座\n宝可梦研究所。\p我爸爸就在那里工作。$

label: Route21_North_Text_RonaldRematchIntro
source: You want to know if the fish are\nbiting?$
translation: 你想知道鱼儿有没有上钩吗？$

label: Route21_North_Text_WadeRematchIntro
source: I got a big haul again!\nWanna go for it once more?$
translation: 我又大丰收了！\n想再跟我比试一次吗？$

label: Route21_North_Text_SpencerRematchIntro
source: The sea cleanses my body and soul!$
translation: 大海洗涤了我的身心！$

label: Route21_North_Text_CueBallRematchIntro
source: きょうも　およぎに\nきちまったぜ$
translation: 今天我又忍不住\n跑来游泳了啊！$

label: Route21_South_Text_JackRematchIntro
source: I caught my POKéMON at sea.\nAnd that's where I train them.$
translation: 我的宝可梦是在海上捉到的。\n我平时就在这里训练它们。$

label: Route21_South_Text_JeromeRematchIntro
source: Right now, I'm in another triathlon\nmeet!$
translation: 我现在又在参加一场铁人三项比赛！$

label: Route21_South_Text_RolandRematchIntro
source: Ahh!\nFeel the sun and the wind!$
translation: 啊！\n感受这阳光和微风吧！$

label: Route21_South_Text_ClaudeRematchIntro
source: Hey, cut it out already.\nYou always scare away the fish!$
translation: 喂，快别闹了。\n你总是把鱼儿吓跑！$

label: Route21_South_Text_NolanRematchIntro
source: Keep me company till I get a hit.$
translation: 在有鱼咬钩之前，来陪陪我吧。$

label: Route21_North_Text_LilRematchIntro
source: LIL: Huh? A battle again?\nIAN, can't you do it alone?$
translation: 莉尔：咦？又要对战吗？\n伊安，你就不能自己一个人上吗？$

label: Route21_North_Text_IanRematchIntro
source: IAN: My sis is still a slob.\nHelp me get her into shape!$
translation: 伊安：我老姐还是这么懒散。\n帮我好好管管她吧！$

label: Route25_Text_JoeyRematchIntro
source: I won't lose while I'm here!$
translation: 只要我在这里，就绝不会认输！$

label: Route25_Text_DanRematchIntro
source: Dad took me to a great party on\nthe S.S. ANNE at VERMILION CITY.$
translation: 爸爸曾带我参加过枯叶市\n圣特安努号上的盛大派对。$

label: Route25_Text_FlintRematchIntro
source: I'm a cool guy.\nI've got a girlfriend!\pI'll show her how cool I am for\nsure this time!$
translation: 我可是个帅气的男人。\n我有女朋友啦！\p这次我一定要让她看看我有多帅气！$

label: Route25_Text_KelseyRematchIntro
source: Hi!\nMy boyfriend is cool!\lMy conditioning's good today!$
translation: 嗨！\n我男朋友超帅的！\l我今天的状态也很棒哦！$

label: Route25_Text_ChadRematchIntro
source: I had this feeling…\nI knew I had to battle you again!$
translation: 我有一种预感......\n我知道一定要再跟你对战一次！$

label: Route25_Text_HaleyRematchIntro
source: My friend has many cute POKéMON.\nI'm so jealous!$
translation: 我的朋友有好多可爱的宝可梦。\n真是太让人羡慕了！$

label: Route25_Text_FranklinRematchIntro
source: I just trained up on MT. MOON,\nbut I've still got gas in the tank!$
translation: 虽然我刚在月见山特训完，\n但我依然干劲十足呢！$

label: Route25_Text_NobRematchIntro
source: A POKéMANIAC lives on the cape.\nHave you seen his collection?$
translation: 海角住着一位宝可梦狂人。\n你看过他的收藏了吗？$

label: Route25_Text_WayneRematchIntro
source: You're going to see BILL again?\nFirst, we battle!$
translation: 你又要去见正辉吗？\n先来和我对战吧！$

label: Route24_Text_ShaneRematchIntro
source: I saw your feat from the grass!$
translation: 我在草丛里看到你神勇的表现了！$

label: Route24_Text_EthanRematchIntro
source: Okay!\nI'll stomp you!$
translation: 好！\n看我把你打得落花流水！$

label: Route24_Text_ReliRematchIntro
source: You always look so busy…\nAren't you getting tired?$
translation: 你看起来总是那么忙碌......\n不觉得累吗？$

label: Route24_Text_TimmyRematchIntro
source: You really must love coming to\nNUGGET BRIDGE.$
translation: 你肯定非常喜欢来金球桥吧。$

label: Route24_Text_AliRematchIntro
source: The time we battled…\pEven though I was the second in\nline, I was the best, wasn't I?$
translation: 上次我们对战的时候......\p虽然我是第二个出场的，\n但我其实是最厉害的，对吧？$

label: Route24_Text_CaleRematchIntro
source:
People call this the NUGGET
BRIDGE!\pYou've already beaten us, so you're
not allowed to take the challenge…\p…But, you're welcome to battle with
us again.$
translation: 大家都叫这里金球桥！\p既然你已经赢过我们了，\n就不能再接受桥上的试炼了......\p......不过，随时欢迎再来和我们切磋！$

label: OneIsland_TreasureBeach_Text_AmaraRematchIntro
source: Lying back, rocked by the waves…\nI don't notice time slipping by…$
translation: 仰躺着随波起伏......\n不知不觉时间就溜走了......$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_MariaRematchIntro
source: The weather's gorgeous!\nI'll try not to spoil it.$
translation: 天气真棒！\n可不能扫了兴致呢。$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_AbigailRematchIntro
source: My sunburn is starting to hurt…$
translation: 晒伤的地方开始痛起来了......$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_FinnRematchIntro
source: The fire bird's mountain casts\na huge shadow…$
translation: 火鸟之山投下了\n一片巨大的阴影......$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_GarrettRematchIntro
source: I have this strong feeling that\nI can win this time!$
translation: 我有种强烈的预感，\n这次一定能赢！$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_TommyRematchIntro
source: Wait! Wait a second!\nI'm sure I've hooked a big one!$
translation: 等等！等一下！\n我好像钓到一条大的了！$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_SharonRematchIntro
source: You'll help me out with my\ntraining again?$
translation: 愿意再陪我特训一次吗？$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_TanyaRematchIntro
source: We haven't missed a single day of\ntraining yet!$
translation: 我们的特训还一天都没落下过！$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_SheaRematchIntro
source: Every morning, before breakfast,\nI swim around this island…\lThree times!$
translation: 每天早上吃早饭前，\n我都会绕着这座岛游......\l整整三圈！$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_HughRematchIntro
source: Dress appropriately for battle!\nLose that frivolous outfit, I said!$
translation: 对战就要有对战的样子！\n我都说了，快脱掉那身轻浮的行头！$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_BryceRematchIntro
source: You know, everything tastes great\nwhen you're out in the wild.$
translation: 你知道吗，在野外吃东西，\n不管什么都格外美味呢。$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_ClaireRematchIntro
source: I ate too much again, so will you\nbattle us for some exercise?$
translation: 我又吃太饱了，\n能陪我们对战运动一下吗？$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_KiaRematchIntro
source: KIA: My big brother and I make\nan awesome combination!\pWe won't lose this time!$
translation: 希亚：我和哥哥的组合\n可是天下无敌的！\p这次我们绝对不会输！$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_MikRematchIntro
source: MIK: Together with KIA, we're\nafraid of nothing!\pWe'll prove it to you this time!$
translation: 米克：只要和希亚在一起，\n我们就无所畏惧！\p这次一定会证明给你看！$

label: ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_NikkiRematchIntro
source: Are we to battle again?$
translation: 我们又要再战一场了吗？$

label: ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_VioletRematchIntro
source: From where have you come, and\nwhere are you bound?$
translation: 你从何处而来，\n又将往何处去？$

label: ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_AmiraRematchIntro
source: I want to swim without my float\nring soon.$
translation: 我好想早点不用救生圈\n就能自己游泳啊。$

label: ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_AlexisRematchIntro
source: Yay, yay!\nPOKéMON!$
translation: 好耶，好耶！\n宝可梦！$

label: ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_TishaRematchIntro
source: Oh, no, didn't I tell you already?\nPlease, stay away from me!$
translation: 哎呀，我不是跟你说过了吗？\n拜托你离我远点！$

label: ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_JoyRematchIntro
source: JOY: We've gotten stronger!\nLots and lots!$
translation: 乔伊：我们变强了！\n变强了好多好多！$

label: ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_MegRematchIntro
source: MEG: You can't beat us today!$
translation: 梅格：今天你可赢不了我们！$

label: FiveIsland_WaterLabyrinth_Text_AlizeRematchIntro
source: Oh, hello!\pAre you raising your POKéMON in a\ngood environment?$
translation: 哎呀，你好！\p你有在优良的环境下\n培育你的宝可梦吗？$

label: FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_DaisyRematchIntro
source: With these hands, I will create\nmy victory today.$
translation: 今天我要用这双手，\n描绘出属于我的胜利！$

label: FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_CelinaRematchIntro
source: Must I repeat myself?\nI'm trying to paint.\lPlease keep out of my sight!$
translation: 还要我说几遍？\n我正在画画呢。\l请别挡着我的视线！$

label: FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_RaynaRematchIntro
source: I haven't made any progress…\nI still can't get the right angle…$
translation: 一点进展都没有......\n还是找不到合适的角度......$

label: FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_JackiRematchIntro
source: Oh, you will give me another\nopportunity to match wits with you?$
translation: 哦，你愿意再给我一次机会\n与你一较高下吗？$

label: FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_GillianRematchIntro
source: They're almost finished making the\npool for my POKéMON.\pYou must drop in for a visit.$
translation: 给我家宝可梦建的泳池\n马上就要完工了。\p到时候你一定要来玩哦。$

label: FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_DestinRematchIntro
source: I'm a good runner.\nI've gotten even faster!$
translation: 我很擅长跑步。\n而且现在跑得更快了！$

label: FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_TobyRematchIntro
source: I say, friend!\nLet us enjoy our time together!$
translation: 我说，朋友！\n让我们好好享受这段时光吧！$

label: FiveIsland_MemorialPillar_Text_MiloRematchIntro
source: I'm the eldest of the BIRD\nBROTHERS. Remember me?\pThat's right, I'm the one who loves\nbirds for their beaks!$
translation: 我是鸟使者三兄弟的老大。还记得我吗？\p没错，我就是最喜欢\n鸟宝可梦喙部的那个人！$

label: FiveIsland_MemorialPillar_Text_ChazRematchIntro
source: I'm the middle kid of the BIRD\nBROTHERS.\pI'm the one that loves wings.\nLet's battle again!$
translation: 我是鸟使者三兄弟的老二。\p我最喜欢的是翅膀。\n再来对战一次吧！$

label: FiveIsland_MemorialPillar_Text_HaroldRematchIntro
source: I'm the youngest of the BIRD\nBROTHERS.\pI love birds for their down.\nI didn't think I'd see you again!$
translation: 我是鸟使者三兄弟的老幺。\p我最喜欢鸟宝可梦的绒毛。\n真没想到还能再见到你！$

label: SixIsland_OutcastIsland_Text_TylorRematchIntro
source: I'm still having no luck at all.\nA battle'd be a change of pace!$
translation: 我的运气还是那么差。\n来场对战换换心情吧！$

label: SixIsland_OutcastIsland_Text_MymoRematchIntro
source: Gasp… Gasp…\pI swam here from SIX ISLAND's port\nin one go again.$
translation: 呼......呼......\p我又一口气从6之岛的港口\n游到这里来了。$

label: SixIsland_OutcastIsland_Text_NicoleRematchIntro
source: You always come along while I'm\nswimming.$
translation: 每次我游泳的时候，\n你总会过来呢。$

label: SixIsland_OutcastIsland_Text_AvaRematchIntro
source: AVA: Let's have another\ntwo-on-two marine battle today!$
translation: 艾娃：今天也来一场\n二对二的海上对战吧！$

label: SixIsland_OutcastIsland_Text_GebRematchIntro
source: GEB: My big sister and I are way\ntougher than before!$
translation: 格布：我和姐姐\n可比以前厉害多啦！$

label: SixIsland_GreenPath_Text_JaclynRematchIntro
source: …Huh?\pI envision my house, but TELEPORT\nalways brings me here!$
translation: ......咦？\p我脑海中明明想着自己家，\n但瞬间移动总是把我送到这里来！$

label: SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_RoseRematchIntro
source: Oh, hello.\nA pleasant breeze is blowing again.$
translation: 哎呀，你好。\n微风吹拂得还是那么舒服呢。$

label: SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_EdwardRematchIntro
source: Hehehe, I'm practicing in secret\nagain.$
translation: 嘿嘿嘿，\n我又在偷偷练习了。$

label: SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_SamirRematchIntro
source: What, you're sick of seeing\nSWIMMERS like me?\pAww, don't be hatin'!\nBattle with me again.$
translation: 怎么，你已经看腻\n像我这样的游泳选手了吗？\p哎呀，别嫌弃嘛！\n再和我对战一场吧。$

label: SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_DeniseRematchIntro
source: Sigh…\nMy boyfriend's busy again…$
translation: 唉......\n我男朋友又在忙了......$

label: SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_EarlRematchIntro
source: Come on, tell me, where are the\nmountains around these parts?$
translation: 快告诉我，这附近的山\n到底都在哪儿啊？$

label: SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_MiuRematchIntro
source: MIU: Hello, POKéMON!\nIt's time to play again!$
translation: 美羽：宝可梦，你好呀！\n又到了玩耍的时间啦！$

label: SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_MiaRematchIntro
source: MIA: Hello, POKéMON!\nIt's time to battle again!$
translation: 美亚：宝可梦，你好呀！\n又到了对战的时间啦！$

label: SixIsland_RuinValley_Text_StanlyRematchIntro
source: There appear to be many secrets\nstill unsolved in this world.$
translation: 看来在这个世界上，\n还留存着许多未解之谜呢。$

label: SixIsland_RuinValley_Text_FosterRematchIntro
source: Hi, didn't we meet before?\nWhat compelled you to come back?$
translation: 嗨，我们之前见过吧？\n是什么风把你又吹来啦？$

label: SixIsland_RuinValley_Text_LarryRematchIntro
source: It's been said that there are\nmysterious stones on this island.\pHave you discovered anything since\nwe last met?$
translation: 据说这座岛上有神秘的石头。\p自从我们上次相遇之后，\n你有什么新发现吗？$

label: SixIsland_RuinValley_Text_DarylRematchIntro
source: A rematch with you, so high up!$
translation: 能在这么高的地方和你再战一场！$

label: SixIsland_RuinValley_Text_HectorRematchIntro
source: I'm pretty familiar with the land\naround these parts.$
translation: 我对这一带的地形相当熟悉呢。$

label: SevenIsland_TrainerTower_Text_DarioRematchIntro
source: I sensed your approach.$
translation: 我感应到你的接近了。$

label: SevenIsland_TrainerTower_Text_RodetteRematchIntro
source: Somewhere on this island, peculiar\nPOKéMON are sleeping.$
translation: 在这座岛上的某处，\n沉睡着奇异的宝可梦。$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Entrance_Text_MiahRematchIntro
source: Kyahaha!\pComing back won't change a thing.\nI'll flick you away effortlessly!$
translation: 呀哈哈！\p就算你再来也是白费力气。\n看我轻轻松松把你弹飞！$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Entrance_Text_MasonRematchIntro
source: Howdy! You're a member of my\nfan club, isn't that right?$
translation: 哈罗！你也是我粉丝俱乐部的\n一员，对不对？$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Entrance_Text_NicolasRematchIntro
source: This island is too spread out…\nPatrolling the place is a drag…$
translation: 这座岛也太大了吧......\n巡逻起来真是一件苦差事......$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Entrance_Text_MadelineRematchIntro
source: I don't forgive people who abuse\nPOKéMON!$
translation: 我绝不原谅虐待宝可梦的家伙！$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Entrance_Text_EveRematchIntro
source: EVE: I'll team up with JON and\nbattle together again.$
translation: 伊芙：我要和乔恩组队，\n再次并肩作战。$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Entrance_Text_JonRematchIntro
source: JON: When I'm with EVE, it feels\nlike we could never lose, not ever.$
translation: 乔恩：只要和伊芙在一起，\n我就感觉我们绝不可能输，永远不会！$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_CyndyRematchIntro
source: Let's have another battle.\nMy conditioning's in top form!$
translation: 再来对战一场吧。\n我现在状态绝佳！$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_EvanRematchIntro
source: It doesn't matter if you happen to\nhave the strongest POKéMON…\pIt doesn't mean a thing if you don't\nknow how to use them properly!$
translation: 就算你碰巧拥有最强的宝可梦\n也是没用的......\p如果不懂得如何驾驭它们，\n那就毫无意义！$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_JacksonRematchIntro
source: I work to protect the environment.\nIn turn, nature protects me!$
translation: 我为了保护环境而工作。\n反过来，大自然也会庇护我！$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_KatelynRematchIntro
source: Every time we meet, you have those\nsnazzy shoes on.$
translation: 每次见到你，\n你都穿着那双帅气的鞋子呢。$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_LeroyRematchIntro
source: You must have gotten tougher.\nLet me battle you, please!$
translation: 你一定变得更强了吧。\n拜托了，请跟我对战一场！$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_MichelleRematchIntro
source: I was given the best possible\neducation to become this strong.\pI won't lose this time.\nAbsolutely not!$
translation: 我接受了最好的英才教育\n才变得如此强大。\p这一次我绝不会输，\n绝对不会！$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_LexRematchIntro
source: LEX: My darling NYA, together\nwe will win for certain!$
translation: 雷克斯：我亲爱的妮娅，\n我们联手就必定能赢！$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_NyaRematchIntro
source: NYA: I won't drag down my mentor\nLEX! We're going to win!$
translation: 妮娅：我不会拖雷克斯导师的\n后腿的！我们赢定了！$

label: SevenIsland_TanobyRuins_Text_BrandonRematchIntro
source: Have you discovered anything about\nthis stone chamber?$
translation: 关于这间石室，\n你有什么新发现吗？$

label: SevenIsland_TanobyRuins_Text_BenjaminRematchIntro
source: A mystic POKéMON is said to sleep\ninside here.$
translation:
据说在这深处沉睡着
一只神秘的宝可梦。$

label: SevenIsland_TanobyRuins_Text_EdnaRematchIntro
source: My teacher is showing me how to\npaint some more.$
translation:
老师正在指导我
如何画出更好的画。$

label: SevenIsland_TanobyRuins_Text_CliffordRematchIntro
source: Today, in addition to our lesson,\nwe came to see the chamber again.$
translation:
今天除了上课，
我们还特意再来看了看这个石室。$

label: BravoTrainerBattleTower_Text_Lost
source:
The twosome finally succumbed to
{STR_VAR_1} in match number {STR_VAR_2}.\lNice try, TRAINER!\pBut, hey, it's just bad luck to run into
{STR_VAR_1} so early in the challenge.\pWe asked the TRAINER for impressions
on the match with {STR_VAR_1}.$
translation:
这队二人组在第{STR_VAR_2}场对战中
终究还是败给了{STR_VAR_1}。\l虽败犹荣啊，训练家！\p哎呀，在挑战这么早期就遇上了
{STR_VAR_1}，实在太不走运了。\p我们采访了这位训练家
关于和{STR_VAR_1}对战的感想。$

label: BravoTrainerBattleTower_Text_Response
source: “{STR_VAR_1}.”$
translation: "{STR_VAR_1}。"$

label: gTVRecentHappeningsText01
source: Wasn't that enlightening?\pThe story gives you a clear idea of what\n{STR_VAR_1} has experienced recently.\lIt's as if we were there as witnesses!$
translation:
是不是很有启发呢？\p这个故事生动地展现了
{STR_VAR_1}最近的经历。\l简直就像我们亲临现场见证了一样！$

label: gTV3CheersForPokeblocksText02
source: {STR_VAR_1}'s blending performance\nleft something to be desired.\pIf this TRAINER could blend better,\nthe {POKEBLOCK} would be much tastier.$
translation:
{STR_VAR_1}的制作手法
还有待提高呢。\p如果这位训练家的手艺能再好一些，
{POKEBLOCK}一定会美味得多。$

label: SmartShopper_Text_OutroNormal
source:
INTERVIEWER: Hmm… {STR_VAR_1} sounds like
quite the shrewd bargain hunter!\pIn total, {STR_VAR_1}'s purchases came to…\p¥{STR_VAR_2}?!
What an amazing sum!\pOops! We're out of time!
See you on our next broadcast!$
translation:
记者：嗯......{STR_VAR_1}听起来
真是个精打细算的购物达人呢！\p{STR_VAR_1}采购的总金额竟然达到了......\p¥{STR_VAR_2}？！
真是个惊人的数字！\p哎呀！时间到了！
下期节目再见啦！$

label: TrendWatcher_Text_Intro
source:
DEWFORD TREND-WATCHER NETWORK!\pMC: Wassup?
We'll keep it real with the latest on\lwhat's hip and happening in DEWFORD.\pOur guest today is this old cat whose
claim to fame is being the authority\lon all things in DEWFORD.\pOld man: Glad to be here.\pMC: Let's cut to the chase, right on.\pWhat's your word on what's groovin'
the good folks of DEWFORD?\pOld man: {STR_VAR_1} {STR_VAR_2}.\pMC: {STR_VAR_1} {STR_VAR_2},
you say?\pOld man: No.\p{STR_VAR_1} {STR_VAR_2} never
did get popular at all.\pWould you like to hear about it?\pMC: Uh, no. What we want to know is
what's the in thing of the moment…$
translation:
武斗流行快讯网！\pMC：哟！大家还好吗？
我们将为大家带来武斗镇\l最新潮、最热门的绝对实况！\p今天的特邀嘉宾是这位老爷爷，
他可是号称无所不知的武斗通哦。\p老爷爷：很高兴能来。\pMC：那咱们就开门见山吧！\p现在武斗镇的老百姓
最着迷的流行是什么呢？\p老爷爷：{STR_VAR_1}{STR_VAR_2}。\pMC：您是说
{STR_VAR_1}{STR_VAR_2}吗？\p老爷爷：不是。\p{STR_VAR_1}{STR_VAR_2}根本就
完全没有流行起来嘛。\p你想听听这是怎么回事吗？\pMC：呃，不用了。我们想知道的是
当下正在流行的东西......$

label: TrendWatcher_Text_PhraseWasHopeless
source:
But it was utterly hopeless.\p{STR_VAR_1} {STR_VAR_2} festival!\p{STR_VAR_1} {STR_VAR_2} contest!\pI tried teaching everyone the best
I could, but…\pPerhaps the {STR_VAR_1} part just
wasn't right…\pMC: Uh, excuse me, compadre, I need
to hear about what's in now…$
translation:
但根本完全行不通啊。\p什么"{STR_VAR_1}{STR_VAR_2}节"！\p什么"{STR_VAR_1}{STR_VAR_2}大赛"！\p我可是拼了命地教大家，然而......\p也许"{STR_VAR_1}"这部分
就是不太对劲吧......\pMC：呃，打扰一下，老哥，我需要
知道的是现在流行什么......$

label: TrendWatcher_Text_Outro
source: MC: …Uh… So, there you have it,\nall you trendy, hep cats out there!\p{STR_VAR_1} {STR_VAR_2}…uh…\nDidn't get hip or happening in DEWFORD!\pMy time is up. Catch you on the fly!\pOld man: {STR_VAR_1} {STR_VAR_2}!$
translation:
MC：......呃......各位走在时尚前沿的
潮人朋友们，你们都听到了！\p{STR_VAR_1}{STR_VAR_2}......呃......
在武斗镇根本就没火起来！\p节目时间到了，咱们下期再会！\p老爷爷：{STR_VAR_1}{STR_VAR_2}！$

label: gTVPokemonNewsBattleFrontierText16
source: And to the four POKéMON: {STR_VAR_1}!\p{STR_VAR_2}!\p{STR_VAR_3}!$
translation: 还有献给这4只宝可梦：{STR_VAR_1}！\p{STR_VAR_2}！\p{STR_VAR_3}！$

label: gTVWhatsNo1InHoennTodayText01
source: In one day, {STR_VAR_1} spun the SLOTS\nat the GAME CORNER {STR_VAR_2} times.\pWhile playing, {STR_VAR_1} was heard\nmurmuring, “For me, the reels don't\leven move…”\lIsn't that interesting?$

label: gTVWhatsNo1InHoennTodayText02
source:
In one day, {STR_VAR_1} played
the ROULETTE game at the GAME\lCORNER {STR_VAR_2} times.\pWhile playing, {STR_VAR_1} shouted,
“Let the balls decide!”\pThe TRAINER's eyes were focused and
the face showed concentration.$
translation:
{STR_VAR_1}在一天之内，在游戏城玩了
{STR_VAR_2}次轮盘游戏。\p在玩的时候，{STR_VAR_1}大喊道：
"一切交给滚球决定！"\p这位训练家眼神专注，
脸上写满了全神贯注。$

label: gTVWhatsNo1InHoennTodayText06
source: In just one day, {STR_VAR_1} picked\n{STR_VAR_2} BERRIES!\p{STR_VAR_1}'s BAG became so filled\nwith BERRIES, the TRAINER had trouble\lwalking afterward!$
translation:
就在一天之内，{STR_VAR_1}采摘了
{STR_VAR_2}个树果！\p{STR_VAR_1}的背包被树果塞得满满当当，
之后甚至连走路都很吃力了呢！$

label: TVSecretBaseSecrets_Text_UsedGlassOrnament
source: The visitor is examining\na GLASS ORNAMENT!\pOh, no!\pThe visitor is touching it!\pIt's getting covered with\nfingerprints…$
translation:
参观者正在端详一件
玻璃装饰品！\p噢，糟糕！\p参观者伸手摸了！\p上面沾满了指纹......$

label: gTVSafariFanClubText02
source: The TRAINER is clever with {POKEBLOCK}S.\nUsed {STR_VAR_2} that time, I think.$
translation:
那位训练家很会巧用{POKEBLOCK}。
那次好像用了{STR_VAR_2}个吧。$

label: gTVSafariFanClubText03
source: The TRAINER didn't use a single\n{POKEBLOCK}! Not a one!\pThere's an expert for you.$
translation:
那位训练家连一个{POKEBLOCK}都没用！
真是一个都没用！\p不愧是真正的高手啊。$

label: gTVSafariFanClubText07
source: The TRAINER does use {POKEBLOCK}S.\nUsed {STR_VAR_2} that time, I think.\pBut, boy, I wish the TRAINER would\nget a bit better at this.$
translation:
那位训练家确实用了{POKEBLOCK}。
那次好像用了{STR_VAR_2}个吧。\p不过哎呀，真希望那位训练家的技巧
能再长进一点呢。$

label: gTVSafariFanClubText08
source: I think the TRAINER would have better\nluck using {POKEBLOCK}S, which weren't\lused at all that time.$
translation:
我觉得那位训练家如果用上{POKEBLOCK}，
运气可能会更好些，\l那次可是一个都没用呢。$

label: ContestLiveUpdates_Text_WonBothRounds
source: Spectator: The {STR_VAR_2} was tops in\nboth primary and secondary judging!\pThat {STR_VAR_2} will keep winning!$
translation:
观众：那只{STR_VAR_2}在第一次
和第二次审查中都名列前茅！\p那只{STR_VAR_2}肯定会一直赢下去的！$

label: ContestLiveUpdates_Text_BetterRound2
source: Spectator: The {STR_VAR_2} didn't do\nwell in the primary judging, but it\lcleaned up in the secondary judging!\pIt was a miraculous comeback\nfor that {STR_VAR_2}. Yippee!$
translation:
观众：那只{STR_VAR_2}在第一次审查时
表现平平，但在第二次审查时\l却大获全胜！\p对那只{STR_VAR_2}来说简直是奇迹般的大逆转。
好耶！$

label: ContestLiveUpdates_Text_GotNervous
source: Spectator: When the {STR_VAR_2} got\nnervous, I couldn't stop myself from\lshouting encouragement.\pI'd like to say this to that\n{STR_VAR_2}, “Congratulations!”$
translation:
观众：在那只{STR_VAR_2}感到紧张时，
我忍不住大声为它加油打气。\p我想对那只{STR_VAR_2}说一句：
"恭喜你！"$

label: ContestLiveUpdates_Text_StartledFoes
source: Spectator: That {STR_VAR_2}'s appeal\nstartled even me!\p{STR_VAR_2}, you were awesome!$
translation: 观众：{STR_VAR_2}的招式展示\n连我都吓了一跳！\p{STR_VAR_2}，你太棒了！$

label: sFullHealDesc
source: Heals all the\nstatus problems of\none Pokémon.
translation: 能治愈1只宝可梦的\n所有异常状态。

label: sPokeDollDesc
source: Use to flee from\nany battle with\na wild Pokémon.
translation: 必定能从与野生宝可梦的\n战斗中逃走。

label: sMaxReviveDesc
source: Revives a fainted\nPokémon with all\nits HP.
translation: 能让1只濒死的宝可梦\n完全恢复HP。

label: sHealthFeatherDesc
source: An item that raises\nthe base HP of\na Pokémon.
translation: 能提高宝可梦\nHP基础点数的道具。

label: sMuscleFeatherDesc
source: An item that raises\nthe base Attack of\na Pokémon.
translation: 能提高宝可梦\n攻击基础点数的道具。

label: sResistFeatherDesc
source: An item that raises\nthe base Defense\nof a Pokémon.
translation: 能提高宝可梦\n防御基础点数的道具。

label: sGeniusFeatherDesc
source: An item that raises\nthe base Sp. Atk.\nof a Pokémon.
translation: 能提高宝可梦\n特攻基础点数的道具。

label: sCleverFeatherDesc
source: An item that raises\nthe base Sp. Def.\nof a Pokémon.
translation: 能提高宝可梦\n特防基础点数的道具。

label: sSwiftFeatherDesc
source: An item that raises\nthe base Speed of\na Pokémon.
translation: 能提高宝可梦\n速度基础点数的道具。

label: sBigMushroomDesc
source: A rare mushroom\nthat would sell at a\nhigh price.
translation: 极其稀有的蘑菇。\n能以高价卖出。

label: sShardsDesc
source: A shard from an\nancient item. Can\nbe sold cheaply.
translation: 古代器具的碎片。\n只能便宜卖出。

label: sRootFossilDesc
source: A fossil of an\nancient, seafloor-\ndwelling Pokémon.
translation: 生活在远古海底的\n宝可梦的化石。

label: sFossilizedFishDesc

label: sBeadMailDesc

source: Makes certain\nspecies of Pokémon\nevolve.
translation: 能让某些特定\n宝可梦进化的道具。

translation: 能改变特定宝可梦\n形态的花蜜。

source: Raises the Defense\nof Ice type {PKMN}\nfor 5 turns.
translation: 在5回合内\n提高冰属性{PKMN}\n的防御。

translation: 降下冰雹，\n对冰属性以外的\n宝可梦造成伤害。

source: Fires an icy cold\nbeam that may\ninflict frostbite.
translation: 发射冰冷的光束攻击。\n有时会让对手陷入\n霜冻状态。

label: ITEM_TM_BLIZZARD.description
source: A snow-and-wind\nattack that may\ninflict frostbite.
translation: 用强烈的风雪攻击对手。\n有时会让对手陷入\n霜冻状态。

label: ITEM_TM51.description
source: Restores the user's\nHP by half of its\nmax HP.
translation: 回复自身最大HP的\n一半。

label: ITEM_TM52.description
source: Attacks at full\npower. May lower\nthe foe's Sp. Def.
translation: 全力进行攻击。\n有时会降低对手的特防。

label: ITEM_TM53.description
source: Draws power from\nnature to attack.\nMay lower Sp. Def.
translation: 汲取大自然的力量攻击。\n有时会降低对手的特防。

label: ITEM_TM54.description
source: Attack that leaves\nthe foe with at\nleast 1 HP.
translation: 攻击对手，但至少会\n为对手保留1点HP。

label: ITEM_TM55.description
source: Does double damage\nto foes with half\nHP or less.
translation: 当对手的HP在一半\n以下时，造成的伤害翻倍。

label: ITEM_TM56.description
source: The effectiveness\nvaries with the\nheld item.
translation: 效果会根据\n携带的道具而改变。

label: ITEM_TM57.description
source: Fires a beam of\nelectricity. May\nraise Sp. Atk.
translation: 发射电击光束攻击。\n有时会提高特攻。

label: ITEM_TM58.description
source: Endures any attack\nfor 1 turn, leaving\nat least 1 HP.
translation: 在1回合内无论受到何种攻击，\n都至少会保留1点HP。

label: ITEM_TM59.description
source: Generates a shock\nwave to damage\nthe foe.
translation: 放出冲击波\n对对手造成伤害。

label: ITEM_TM60.description
source: Attack that\nabsorbs half the\ndamage inflicted.
translation: 吸取给予对手\n伤害的一半HP。

label: ITEM_TM61.description
source: Inflicts a burn on\nthe foe with\nintense fire.
translation: 用猛烈的火焰\n让对手陷入灼伤状态。

label: ITEM_TM62.description
source: A powdery attack\nthat may raise\nall abilities.
translation: 撒出鳞粉起风攻击。\n有时会提高自己的\n全部能力。

label: ITEM_TM63.description
source: Prevents the foe\nfrom using any\nitems.
translation: 在一定时间内，\n让对手无法使用\n任何携带道具。

label: ITEM_TM64.description
source: Inflicts severe\ndamage but makes\nthe user faint.
translation: 引发剧烈的大爆炸，\n给予极大的伤害，\n但自己也会陷入濒死。

label: ITEM_TM65.description
source: Strikes with a\nshadow claw. High\ncritical-hit ratio.
translation: 用漆黑的影子切斩对手。\n容易击中要害。

label: ITEM_TM66.description
source: Attack that gains\npower if the user\nmoves last.
translation: 在对手之后攻击的话，\n招式威力就会提升。

label: ITEM_TM67.description
source: Recycles a used item\nfor one more use.
translation: 回收战斗中使用过的道具，\n能够再次使用。

label: ITEM_TM68.description
source: Powerful, but leaves\nthe user immobile\nthe next turn.
translation: 威力极其强大，\n但下一回合自己\n将无法动弹。

label: ITEM_TM69.description
source: Polishes the body\nto sharply raise\nSpeed.
translation: 打磨自己的身体，\n大幅提高速度。

label: ITEM_TM70.description
source: An all-out charge\nattack that may\nconfuse the foe.
translation: 全身冲撞攻击对手，\n有时会使对手陷入混乱。

label: ITEM_TM70.name
source: TM70
translation: TM70

label: ITEM_TM70.description
source: Looses a powerful\nblast of light that\ncuts accuracy.
translation: 释放出强烈的闪光，\n从而降低对手的命中率。

label: ITEM_TM71.description
source: Stabs the foe with\nstones. High\ncritical-hit ratio.
translation: 用尖锐的岩石刺入对手。\n容易击中要害。

label: ITEM_TM72.description
source: Attack that moves\nlast and gains\npower if hit.
translation: 在对手之后攻击。\n若受到伤害，威力就会提升。

label: ITEM_TM73.description
source: A weak jolt of\nelectricity that\nparalyzes the foe.
translation: 向对手发出微弱的电击，\n使其陷入麻痹状态。

label: ITEM_TM74.description
source: A rapid spin that\ndoes more damage\nto faster foes.
translation: 让身体高速旋转撞击对手。\n对手速度越快，威力越大。

label: ITEM_TM75.description
source: A fighting dance\nthat sharply raises\nAttack.
translation: 跳起战斗之舞，\n大幅提高攻击。

label: ITEM_TM76.description
source: Floating stones\nthat hurt a foe\nswitching in.
translation: 将无数岩石悬浮在周围，\n对替换出场的对手造成伤害。

label: ITEM_TM77.description
source: Copies the foe's\nstat changes and\ngives to the user.
translation: 复制对手的能力变化，\n施加到自己身上。

label: ITEM_TM78.description
source: Makes the opposite\ngender sharply cut\nits Sp. Atk.
translation: 诱惑异性的对手，\n大幅降低其特攻。

label: ITEM_TM79.description
source: Attacks with a\nhorrible aura. May\ncause flinching.
translation: 释放出恐怖的气场攻击。\n有时会使对手畏缩。

label: ITEM_TM80.description
source: Large boulders are\nhurled. May cause\nflinching.
translation: 投掷巨大的岩石攻击对手。\n有时会使对手畏缩。

label: ITEM_TM81.description
source: Slashes the foe with\ncrossed scythes,\nclaws, etc.
translation: 将镰刀或利爪交叉成\n十字切斩对手。

label: ITEM_TM82.description
source: Uses an available\nmove randomly while\nasleep.
translation: 在自己睡着的时候，\n随机使用学会的招式。

label: ITEM_TM83.description
source: The effectiveness\nvaries with the\nheld Berry.
translation: 招式的威力与属性\n会随携带的树果而改变。

label: ITEM_TM84.description
source: A stabbing attack\nthat may poison\nthe foe.
translation: 用带毒的尖刺刺向对手。\n有时会让对手陷入中毒。

label: ITEM_TM85.description
source: Takes one half the\ndamage inflicted on\na sleeping foe.
translation: 吸取睡眠状态下的对手\n所受伤害的一半\n来恢复自己的HP。

label: ITEM_TM86.description
source: A snare attack that\ndoes more damage to\nheavier foes.
translation: 用陷阱缠住对手，\n对手的体重越重，\n造成的伤害越大。

label: ITEM_TM87.description
source: Confuses the foe,\nbut also sharply\nraises its Attack.
translation: 让对手陷入混乱，\n但同时也会大幅提高\n对手的攻击。

label: ITEM_TM88.description
source: Eats the foe's held\nBerry, gaining its\neffect.
translation: 吃掉对手携带的\n树果，\n并获得该树果的效果。

label: ITEM_TM89.description
source: Does damage then\nswitches out the\nuser.
translation: 在攻击之后\n回到队伍中，\n与后备宝可梦替换。

label: ITEM_TM90.description
source: Creates a decoy\nusing 1/4 of the\nuser's maximum HP.
translation: 削减自身最大HP的\n1/4，\n制造出一只替身。

label: ITEM_TM91.description
source: Releases a blast of\nlight that may lower\nSp. Def.
translation: 发射强光进行攻击。\n有时会降低\n对手的特防。

label: ITEM_TM92.description
source: Slower Pokémon get\nto move first for\n5 turns.
translation: 在5回合内，\n速度较慢的宝可梦\n可以先一步行动。

source: HM08
translation: 秘传学习器08

label: ITEM_HM_WHIRLPOOL.description

translation: 将对手困在\n猛烈的旋涡中\n进行攻击。

label: sMegaDrainDescription
source: Attack that absorbs\nhalf the damage inflicted.
translation: 给予伤害，并吸收\n所造成伤害一半的HP。

label: sHyperBeamDescription
source: Powerful, but leaves the\nuser immobile the next turn.
translation: 威力巨大，但下一回合\n自身将无法动弹。

label: sHyperBeamDescription
source: Leaves the user immobile\nif target is not KO'd.
translation: 若未能将对手击倒，\n自身下一回合将无法动弹。

label: sRevengeDescription
source: Attack that moves last\nand gains power if hit.
translation: 必定后手发动。若受到\n对手攻击，威力会提高。

label: sPluckDescription
source: Eats the foe's held Berry\ngaining its effect.
translation: 吃掉对手携带的树果，\n并获得该树果的效果。

label: sHealingWishDescription
source: The user faints to heal up\nthe recipient.
translation: 自身陷入濒死，完全治愈\n替换上场的同伴。

label: sWringOutDescription
source: The higher the foe's HP\nthe more damage caused.
translation: 对手的HP越多，\n造成的伤害就越大。

label: sUTurnDescription
source: Does damage then switches\nout the user.
translation: 给予对手伤害后，\n自身迅速替换下场。

label: sStormThrowDescription
source: This attack always results\nin a critical hit.
translation: 这一攻击必定会\n击中对手的要害。

label: sCircleThrowDescription
source: Knocks foe away to switch\nit out or end wild battle.
translation: 击飞对手以强制替换，\n在野生战斗中能结束战斗。

label: sChipAwayDescription
source: Strikes through the foe's\nstat changes.
translation: 无视对手的能力变化\n进行攻击。

label: sHeavySlamDescription
source: Does more damage if the\nuser outweighs the foe.
translation: 自身比对手越重，\n造成的伤害就越大。

label: sPsyshockDescription
source: Attacks with a psychic wave\nthat does physical damage.
translation: 放出念力波进行攻击，\n造成物理伤害。

label: sLavaPlumeDescription
source: Scarlet flames torch\neverything around the user.
translation: 用深红的烈焰点燃\n自身周围的一切。

label: sShadowForceDescription
source: Vanishes on the first turn\nthen strikes the next turn.
translation: 第一回合隐藏身影，\n下一回合发动袭击。

label: sFalseSwipeDescription
source: Attack that leaves the\nfoe with at least 1 HP.
translation: 对手的HP至少会\n留下1点。

label: sDrainingKissDescription
source: Attack that absorbs over\nhalf the damage inflicted.
translation: 给予伤害，并吸取超过\n所造成伤害一半的HP。

label: sCloseCombatDescription
source: A strong attack but lowers\nthe defensive stats.
translation: 强力的攻击，但会降低\n自身的防御和特防。

label: sHyperspaceHoleDescription
source: Uses a warp hole to attack.\nCan't be evaded.
translation: 通过异次元洞发动袭击。\n必定命中对手。

label: sSuckerPunchDescription
source: Strikes first if the foe\nis preparing Attack.
translation: 若对手正准备发动攻击，\n便能抢先一步出手。

label: sFeintDescription
source: Attack that hits foes\nusing moves like Protect.
translation: 能击中使用了\n守住等招式的对手。

label: sProtectDescription
source: Evades attack, but may fail\nif used in succession.
translation: 完全避开对手的攻击。\n连续使用容易失败。

label: sGMaxOneBlowDescription
source: G-max Urshifu attack.\nIgnores Max Guard.
translation: 超极巨化武道熊师的招式。\n能无视极巨防壁造成伤害。

label: MOVE_ICE_PUNCH.description
source: An icy punch that may\nleave the foe with frostbite.
translation: 充满寒气的拳击。\n有时会让对手陷入霜冻状态。

label: MOVE_RAZOR_WIND.name
source: RAZOR WIND
translation: 旋风刀

label: MOVE_RAZOR_WIND.description
source: A 2-turn move that strikes\nthe foe on the 2nd turn.
translation: 第1回合蓄力，\n第2回合攻击对手。

label: MOVE_RAZOR_WIND.description
source: A 2-turn move with a high\ncritical-hit ratio.
translation: 第2回合攻击对手，\n且容易击中要害。

label: MOVE_BIND.description
source: Binds and squeezes the foe\nfor  turns.
translation: 勒紧并压迫对手，\n持续数回合进行攻击。

label: MOVE_VINE_WHIP.description
source: Strikes the foe with\nslender, whiplike vines.
translation: 用细长如鞭的藤蔓\n摔打对手进行攻击。

label: MOVE_JUMP_KICK.description
source: A strong jumping kick. May\nmiss and hurt the kicker.
translation: 使出强力的腾空踢。\n如果踢偏则自己会受伤害。

label: MOVE_TACKLE.description
source: Charges the foe with a full-\nbody tackle.
translation: 使出全身的力气\n猛烈撞击对手。

label: MOVE_WRAP.description
source: Wraps and squeezes the foe\n times with vines, etc.
translation: 用藤蔓等紧紧勒住对手，\n在数回合内持续攻击。

label: MOVE_DISABLE.description
source:
For 4 turns, prevents foe
For 4-7 turns, prevents foe
For 2-5 turns, prevents foe
from using last used move.
translation:
在4回合内妨碍对手，
在4~7回合内妨碍对手，
在2~5回合内妨碍对手，
使其无法使出上次用的招式。

label: MOVE_ACID.description
source: Sprays a hide-melting acid.\nMay lower Sp. Def.
translation: 喷出能溶化皮肤的强酸。\n有时会降低对手的特防。

label: MOVE_SURF.description
source: Creates a huge wave, then\ncrashes it down on the field.
translation: 掀起巨大的海浪\n猛烈拍击整个战场。

label: MOVE_ICE_BEAM.description
source: Blasts the foe with an icy\nbeam. May cause frostbite.
translation: 向对手发射冰冻光束。\n有时会使其陷入霜冻状态。

label: MOVE_BLIZZARD.description
source: Hits the foes with an icy\nstorm. May cause frostbite.
translation: 向对手刮起强烈的冰风暴。\n有时会使其陷入霜冻状态。

label: MOVE_LOW_KICK.description
source: A kick that inflicts more\ndamage on heavier foes.
translation: 对手的体重越重，\n造成的踢击伤害越大。

label: MOVE_LOW_KICK.description
source: A low, tripping kick that\nmay cause flinching.
translation: 使出绊倒对手的下段踢。\n有时会使对手畏缩。

label: MOVE_GROWTH.description
source: Forces the body to grow,\nraising Attack and Sp. Atk.
translation: 促使身体快速生长，\n从而提高攻击与特攻。

label: MOVE_PETAL_DANCE.description
source: A rampage of 2 to 3 turns\nthat confuses the user.
translation: 在2~3回合内大闹一番。\n之后自己会陷入混乱。

label: MOVE_FIRE_SPIN.description
source: Traps the foe in a ring of\nfire for  turns.
translation: 用熊熊烈火包围对手，\n困住数回合进行攻击。

label: MOVE_TELEPORT.description
source: Switches the user out last.\nFlees when used by wild {PKMN}.
translation: 后制换下自身宝可梦。\n野生{PKMN}使用时会逃跑。

label: MOVE_TELEPORT.description
source: A psychic move for fleeing\nfrom battle instantly.
translation: 利用超能力招式\n瞬间从战斗中脱身。

label: MOVE_RECOVER.description
source: Recovers up to half the\nuser's maximum HP.
translation: 回复自身最大HP的\n一半。

label: MOVE_MINIMIZE.description
source: Minimizes the user's size to\nsharply raise evasiveness.
translation: 缩小自己的身体，\n大幅提高闪避率。

label: MOVE_CLAMP.description
source: Traps and squeezes the\nfoe for  turns.
translation: 紧紧勒住对手，\n困住数回合进行攻击。

label: MOVE_HIGH_JUMP_KICK.description
source: A jumping knee kick. If it\nmisses, the user is hurt.
translation: 跳起使出飞膝撞。\n如果踢偏则自己会受伤害。

label: MOVE_GLARE.description
source: Intimidates and frightens\nthe foe into paralysis.
translation: 瞪视威吓对手使其害怕，\n从而陷入麻痹状态。

label: MOVE_POISON_GAS.description
source: Envelops the foes in a toxic\nEnvelops the foe in a toxic\ngas that may poison.
translation: 用毒瓦斯包围对手，\n用毒瓦斯包围对手，\n有时会使其陷入中毒。

label: MOVE_DIZZY_PUNCH.description
source: A rhythmic punch that may\nconfuse the target.
translation: 节奏轻快地出拳，\n有时会使目标混乱。

label: MOVE_DIZZY_PUNCH.description
source: The target is hit with\nrhythmic punches.
translation: 以节奏轻快的重拳\n击打目标。

label: MOVE_ROCK_SLIDE.description
source: Large boulders are hurled.\nMay cause flinching.
translation: 投掷巨大的岩石。\n有时会使对手畏缩。

label: MOVE_ROCK_SLIDE.description
source: Hits the foe with an\navalanche of rocks.
translation: 用崩塌的岩石\n击打对手。

label: MOVE_CONVERSION.description
source: Changes the user's type\ninto first known move's type.
translation: 将自身的属性转变为\n首个已学会招式的属性。

label: MOVE_TRI_ATTACK.description
source: Fires three types of beams.\nMay burn/para/frostbite.
translation: 射出3种光线。可能使对手\n陷入灼伤、麻痹或霜冻。

label: MOVE_TRI_ATTACK.description
source: A triangular field of energy\nis created and launched.
translation: 制造出三角形的能量场，\n并发射出去。

label: MOVE_STRUGGLE.description
source: Used only if all PP are gone.\nAlso hurts the user a little.
translation: 仅在所有PP耗尽时使用。\n自身也会受到少许伤害。

label: MOVE_COTTON_SPORE.description
source: Spores cling to the foes,\nSpores cling to the foe,\nsharply reducing Speed.
translation: 孢子紧附在对手身上，\n孢子紧附在对手身上，\n大幅降低对手的速度。

label: MOVE_SPITE.description
source: Spitefully cuts the PP\nof the foe's last move by 4.
translation: 怨恨对手最后使用的招式，\n使其PP减少4点。

label: MOVE_POWDER_SNOW.description
source: Blasts the foes with a snowy\ngust. May cause frostbite.
translation: 用暴风雪猛烈吹袭对手。\n有时会使其陷入霜冻。

label: MOVE_FURY_CUTTER.description
source: Attack that intensifies\non each successive hit.
translation: 连续击中对手时，\n威力会逐渐提高。

label: MOVE_RAPID_SPIN.description
source: User spins and removes some\neffects, while upping speed.
translation: 自身旋转摆脱部分束缚，\n同时提高速度。

label: MOVE_SWEET_SCENT.description
source: Allures the foes to harshly\nreduce evasiveness.
translation: 用香气诱惑对手，\n大幅降低其闪避率。

label: MOVE_HIDDEN_POWER.description
source: The type varies\nwith the user.
translation: 招式的属性\n因使用者而异。

label: MOVE_CRUNCH.description
source: Crunches with sharp fangs.\nMay lower Defense.
translation: 用锋利的尖牙咬碎对手。\n有时会降低对手的防御。

label: MOVE_FUTURE_SIGHT.description
source: Heightens inner power to\nstrike 2 turns later.
translation: 提高内在的精神力量，\n在2回合后发动攻击。

label: MOVE_WHIRLPOOL.description
source: Traps and hurts the foe in\na whirlpool for  turns.
translation: 将对手困在漩涡中，\n在数回合内持续造成伤害。

label: MOVE_UPROAR.description
source: Causes an uproar for 3\nCauses an uproar for 2 to 5\nturns and prevents sleep.
translation: 大吵大闹3回合，\n大吵大闹2到5回合，\n期间谁都无法入眠。

label: MOVE_HAIL.description
source: Summons a snowstorm that\nlasts for five turns.
translation: 降下暴风雪，\n持续5回合。

label: MOVE_HAIL.description
source: Summons a hailstorm that\nstrikes every turn.
translation: 降下冰雹，\n在每回合都造成伤害。

label: MOVE_TAIL_GLOW.description
source: Flash light that drastically\nFlashes a light that sharply\nraises Sp. Atk.
translation: 发出强光大幅\n发出强光大幅\n提高特攻。

label: MOVE_SAND_TOMB.description
source: Traps and hurts the foe in\nquicksand for  turns.
translation: 将对手困在流沙中，\n在数回合内持续造成伤害。

label: MOVE_VOLT_TACKLE.name
source: VOLT TACKLE
translation: 伏特攻击

label: MOVE_VOLT_TACKLE.description
source: A life-risking tackle that\nhurts the user. May paralyze.
translation: 拼命冲撞对手进行攻击。\n自己也会受伤。有时会让对手麻痹。

label: MOVE_VOLT_TACKLE.description
source: A life-risking tackle that\nslightly hurts the user.
translation: 拼命扑向对手进行攻击。\n自己也会受到少许伤害。

label: MOVE_TAILWIND.description
source: Whips up a breeze, doubling\nally Speed for 4 turns.
translation: 刮起狂风，在4回合内\n提高同伴的速度。

label: MOVE_ICE_FANG.description
source: May cause flinching or\nleave the foe with frostbite.
translation: 有时会使对手畏缩，\n或者陷入霜冻状态。

label: MOVE_DISCHARGE.description
source: Zaps all other {PKMN} with\nelectricity. May paralyze.
translation: 放电攻击除自己以外的所有{PKMN}。\n有时会让对手陷入麻痹状态。

label: MOVE_MAGMA_STORM.description
source: Traps the foe in a vortex\nof fire for  turns.
translation: 将对手困在火焰旋涡中，\n在回合内持续造成伤害。

label: MOVE_SYNCHRONOISE.description
source: An odd shock wave that only\ndamages same-type {PKMN}.
translation: 发出奇特的电波，只对与自己\n属性相同的{PKMN}造成伤害。

label: MOVE_FREEZE_DRY.description
source: Super effective on Water-\ntypes. May cause frostbite.
translation: 对水属性效果绝佳。\n有时会使对手陷入霜冻状态。

label: MOVE_INFESTATION.description
source: The foe is infested and\nattacked for  turns.
translation: 死缠烂打对手，\n在回合内持续造成伤害。

label: MOVE_AURORA_VEIL.name
source: AURORA VEIL
translation: 极光幕

label: MOVE_AURORA_VEIL.description
source: Weakens all attacks, but\nonly usable with snow.
translation: 减弱所有受到的攻击，\n但只有在下雪时才可以使用。

label: MOVE_AURORA_VEIL.description
source: Weakens all attacks if\nused in hail or snow.
translation: 若在冰雹或下雪时使用，\n可以减弱所有受到的攻击。

label: MOVE_AURORA_VEIL.description
source: Weakens all attacks, but\nonly usable with hail.
translation: 减弱所有受到的攻击，\n但只有在降雹时才可以使用。

label: MOVE_BOUNCY_BUBBLE.description
source: Attack that absorbs\nall the damage inflicted.
translation: 进行攻击，吸取给予对手\n伤害的全部HP。

label: MOVE_THUNDER_CAGE.description
source: Traps the foe in a cage of\nelectricity for  turns.
translation: 将对手困在雷电囚笼中，\n在回合内持续造成伤害。

label: MOVE_FREEZING_GLARE.description
source: Shoots psychic power from\nthe eyes. May frostbite.
translation: 从双眼中发射精神力量进行攻击。\n有时会使对手陷入霜冻状态。

label: MOVE_REVIVAL_BLESSING.description
source: Revives a fainted party {PKMN}\nand restores half of its HP.
translation: 让同行中1只濒死的{PKMN}复活，\n并回复一半HP。

label: MOVE_CHILLY_RECEPTION.name
source: CHILLY RECEPTION
translation: 冷笑话

label: MOVE_CHILLY_RECEPTION.description
source: Bad joke summons hailstorm.\nThe user also switches out.
translation: 讲冷笑话降下冰雹，\n并与后备宝可梦进行替换。

label: MOVE_CHILLY_RECEPTION.description
source: Bad joke summons snowstorm.\nThe user also switches out.
translation: 讲冷笑话降下大雪，\n并与后备宝可梦进行替换。

label: MOVE_SNOWSCAPE.name
source: SNOWSCAPE
translation: 雪景

label: MOVE_SNOWSCAPE.description
source: Summons a hailstorm that\nstrikes every turn.
translation: 降下冰雹，\n在每回合都造成伤害。

label: MOVE_SNOWSCAPE.description
source: Summons a snowstorm that\nlasts for five turns.
translation: 降下暴风雪，\n持续5回合。

label: ABILITY_SNOW_WARNING.name
source: SNOW WARNING
translation: 降雪

label: ABILITY_SNOW_WARNING.description
source: Summons snow in battle.
translation: 在对战中降下大雪。

label: ABILITY_SNOW_WARNING.description
source: Summons hail in battle.
translation: 在对战中降下冰雹。

label: HELP_DEMO_WINDOW.header
source: Information: Help Windows
translation: 提示：帮助窗口

label: HELP_DEMO_WINDOW.desc
source:
This is a help window. You can put
lots of text on the screen that
players won't read!

Isn't that great!
translation:
这是一个帮助窗口。你可以在屏幕上
显示一大堆玩家根本不会读的文字！

很棒吧！

label: HELP_GAMESTART_WINDOW.header
source: Information: More Options
translation: 提示：更多选项

label: HELP_GAMESTART_WINDOW.desc
source:
The clock can be changed from any
POKéMON CENTER with no penalty.
Make sure to check your BAG's KEY ITEMS
and your OPTIONS MENU for even more
ways to customize your experience.
Enjoy!
translation:
在任何宝可梦中心都可以调整时间，
且不会受到任何惩罚。
请务必查看背包里的重要宝物
以及设置菜单，
探索更多自定义游戏体验的方式。
祝你玩得开心！

label: HELP_TRADE_WINDOW.header
source: WARNING: COMPATIBILITY
translation: 警告：兼容性问题

label: HELP_TRADE_WINDOW.desc
source:
Attempting to link incorrectly may result
in permanent damage to your save file.
Only link with another player if:
You are both playing Heart & Soul.
You are both on the same version.
You both have the same challenge settings.
You are NOT using any randomizer settings.

label: HELP_TELEPORTER_WINDOW.header
source: OPTIONAL BONUS CONTENT: TELEPORTER
translation: 可选追加内容：传送机

label: HELP_TELEPORTER_WINDOW.desc
source:
The TELEPORTER can PERMANENTLY change
POKéMON into their GALARIAN forms.
GALARIAN forms are NOT required
for story progression or
NATIONAL POKéDEX completion.
translation:
传送机可以永久将宝可梦
转变为它们的伽勒尔形态。
推进故事剧情或完成全国图鉴
都不强制需要伽勒尔形态。

label: HELP_SINJOH_WINDOW.header
source: OPTIONAL BONUS CONTENT: SINJOH
translation: 可选追加内容：神都

label: HELP_SINJOH_WINDOW.desc
source:
This NPC grants access to optional
bonus content: SINJOH.
It is NOT required for story
or NATIONAL POKéDEX completion.

It's just a bonus. If you want it.
translation:
与这名NPC对话可体验可选的
追加内容：神都。
通关剧情或集齐全国图鉴
均不需要该内容。

这只是额外的奖励内容，全看你想不想去。

label: HELP_ALOLA_WINDOW.header
source: OPTIONAL BONUS CONTENT: ISLES
translation: 额外追加内容：群岛

label: HELP_ALOLA_WINDOW.desc
source:
This NPC grants access to optional
bonus content: ISLES.

此内容非主线通关或
全国图鉴收集所必需。

仅作为额外要素供您体验。

label: HELP_DAYCARE1_WINDOW.header
source: BABY POKéMON ABILITIES
translation: 幼童宝可梦的特性

label: HELP_DAYCARE1_WINDOW.desc
source:
PICHU's ability is STATIC.
CLEFFA's ability is CUTE CHARM.
IGGLYBUFF's ability is CUTE CHARM.
TYROGUE's ability is GUTS.
SMOOCHUM's ability is OBLIVIOUS.
ELEKID's ability is STATIC.
MAGBY's ability is FLAME BODY.
translation:
皮丘的特性是静电。
皮宝宝的特性是迷人之躯。
宝宝丁的特性是迷人之躯。
无畏小子的特性是毅力。
迷唇娃的特性是迟钝。
电击怪的特性是静电。
鸭嘴宝宝的特性是火焰之躯。

label: HELP_DAYCARE2_WINDOW.header
source: BABY POKéMON TYPES
translation: 幼童宝可梦的属性

label: HELP_DAYCARE2_WINDOW.desc
source:
PICHU is ELECTRIC type.
CLEFFA is NORMAL type.
IGGLYBUFF is NORMAL type.
TYROGUE is FIGHTING type.
SMOOCHUM is ICE type.
ELEKID is ELECTRIC type.
MAGBY is FIRE type.
translation:
皮丘是电属性。
皮宝宝是一般属性。
宝宝丁是一般属性。
无畏小子是格斗属性。
迷唇娃是冰属性。
电击怪是电属性。
鸭嘴宝宝是火属性。

label: HELP_DAYCARE3_WINDOW.header
source: BABY POKéMON CRIES
translation: 幼童宝可梦的叫声

label: HELP_DAYCARE3_WINDOW.desc
source:
PICHU says WAAAH.
CLEFFA says EEK.
IGGLYBUFF says LALALA.
TYROGUE says HIYAH.
SMOOCHUM says EHEHE.
ELEKID says OI, OI, OI.
MAGBY says TCH.
translation:
皮丘的叫声是"哇--"。
皮宝宝的叫声是"咿呀！"。
宝宝丁的叫声是"啦啦啦~"。
无畏小子的叫声是"喝啊！"。
迷唇娃的叫声是"诶嘿嘿"。
电击怪的叫声是"喔咿、喔咿、喔咿"。
鸭嘴宝宝的叫声是"啧！"。

label: HELP_DAYCARE4_WINDOW.header
source: BABY POKéMON ACTIONS
translation: 幼童宝可梦的习性

label: HELP_DAYCARE4_WINDOW.desc
source:
PICHU likes to PLAY all day.
CLEFFA LOOKS at the moon.
IGGLYBUFF puts them to SLEEP.
TYROGUE TRAINS constantly.
SMOOCHUM likes to SHOW off.
ELEKID STORES up charge.
MAGBY often ANGERS.
translation:
皮丘喜欢整天玩耍。
皮宝宝喜欢眺望月亮。
宝宝丁能让大家入睡。
无畏小子总是不断修行。
迷唇娃喜欢炫耀自己。
电击怪会积蓄电力。
鸭嘴宝宝常常容易生气。

label: HELP_POKEBLOCK_WINDOW.header
source: FEEDERS: REGULAR POKéBLOCKS
translation: 喂食器：普通宝可方块

label: HELP_POKEBLOCK_WINDOW.desc
source:
POKéBLOCK colors attract perfect IVs:
RED: HP,ATK,SPE   BLU: HP,SPA,SPE
PNK: ATK,SPA,SPE  GRN: HP,DEF,SPD
YEL: HP,ATK,DEF   PUR: ATK,DEF,SPD
IND: HP,SPA,SPD   BRN: DEF,SPE,SPD
LBL: SPA,SPE,SPD  OLV: ATK,DEF,SPE
GRY: HP,ATK,SPA
Every POKéBLOCK attracts HIDDEN ABILITY.
translation:
宝可方块颜色能吸引对应满个体值(V)：
红色：HP、攻击、速度   蓝色：HP、特攻、速度
粉色：攻击、特攻、速度  绿色：HP、防御、特防
黄色：HP、攻击、防御   紫色：攻击、防御、特防
靛色：HP、特攻、特防   褐色：防御、速度、特防
浅蓝：特攻、速度、特防  橄榄：攻击、防御、速度
灰色：HP、攻击、特攻
所有宝可方块均能吸引隐藏特性。

label: HELP_GOLD_POKEBLOCK_WINDOW.header
source: FEEDERS: GOLD POKéBLOCKS
translation: 喂食器：金色宝可方块

label: HELP_GOLD_POKEBLOCK_WINDOW.desc
source:
GOLD POKéBLOCKS attract POKéMON with
5 perfect IVs. Flavor determines which
IV is not perfect.
SPICY: no SP.ATK    DRY:    no ATTACK
SWEET: no SP.DEF   BITTER: no SPEED
SOUR:  no HP
Every POKéBLOCK attracts HIDDEN ABILITY.
translation:
金色宝可方块能吸引拥有5项满个体值的宝可梦。
口味决定了哪项个体值不满：
辣味：缺特攻    涩味：缺攻击
甜味：缺特防    苦味：缺速度
酸味：缺HP
所有宝可方块均能吸引隐藏特性。
